entries.title: cplm (R)
entries.summary: 复合泊松线性模型 R 包（Yanwei Zhang）：纯保费建模的频率-严重度联合似然/贝叶斯方法
entries.body: cplm 实现复合泊松线性模型（Compound Poisson Linear Models, CPLM）的似然与贝叶斯方法（Yanwei Zhang，基于 Zhang (2013) 论文 doi:10.1007/s11222-012-9343-7）：把理赔频率与严重度联合进一个 Tweedie 复合泊松模型，直接建模纯保费——非寿险定价的核心技术。与 [[tweedie]]（Tweedie 分布工具）、[[claim-frequency]]（DAV 理赔频率）互补——CPLM 是频率+严重度一体的建模路线。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuar-r]]。
entries.verified_note: CRAN DESCRIPTION 核实：v0.7-12.1，Yanwei Zhang，CPLM 似然+贝叶斯方法（Zhang 2013 CSDA 论文），依赖 tweedie/statmod
entries.summary_en: R package for compound Poisson linear models (Yanwei Zhang): likelihood/Bayesian methods for pure-premium frequency-severity modelling
entries.summary_hk: 複合泊松線性模型 R 包（Yanwei Zhang）：純保費建模的頻率-嚴重度聯合似然/貝葉斯方法
entries.body_en: cplm implements likelihood-based and Bayesian methods for compound Poisson linear models (CPLM) (Yanwei Zhang, based on the paper Zhang (2013), doi:10.1007/s11222-012-9343-7): joining claim frequency and severity into one Tweedie compound-Poisson model to model the pure premium directly — a core technique of non-life pricing. Complements [[tweedie]] (Tweedie distribution tools) and [[claim-frequency]] (DAV claim frequency) — CPLM is the frequency+severity-in-one modelling route. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[machine-learning-pricing]], [[actuar-r]].
entries.body_hk: cplm 實現複合泊松線性模型（Compound Poisson Linear Models, CPLM）的似然與貝葉斯方法（Yanwei Zhang，基於 Zhang (2013) 論文 doi:10.1007/s11222-012-9343-7）：把理賠頻率與嚴重度聯合進一個 Tweedie 複合泊松模型，直接建模純保費——非壽險定價的核心技術。與 [[tweedie]]（Tweedie 分佈工具）、[[claim-frequency]]（DAV 理賠頻率）互補——CPLM 是頻率+嚴重度一體的建模路線。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuar-r]]。

entries.title: LLM Claims Analysis
entries.summary: 论文《Leveraging LLMs for Unstructured Claims Data Analysis》代码：FHIR 理赔→结构化 JSON→合成文档→精算变量抽取
entries.body: LLM Claims Analysis 是 arXiv 2606.06089《Leveraging LLMs for Unstructured Claims Data Analysis》（41 页论文，含技术规范附录）的官方代码：AI 驱动的医疗理赔处理流水线——四阶段：FHIR 捆绑包转结构化 JSON → 生成合成支持文档 → 文档聚合为统一理赔文件 → 两阶段抽取与合成精算变量。对 RIAA：LLM 处理非结构化理赔数据的完整工程范式（从 FHIR 到精算变量）。与 [[nlp-actuarial-loss-modeling]]（NLP 损失建模）、[[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]（CMS 合成理赔语料）、[[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]]（理赔自动化）互补。关联 [[claimpilot-harness]]（理赔 agent 评测）。

entries.title: CATIA
entries.summary: 巨灾 AI 气候风险建模平台（8★，MIT）：数据/ML/精算模拟/缓解优化一体，EVT+copula 多灾害
entries.body: CATIA（Catastrophe AI for Climate Risk Modeling）是生产级巨灾 AI 平台（v2.5.0，MIT）：统一数据摄入、气候风险 ML 建模、蒙特卡洛模拟与缓解措施优化的端到端流水线。精算严谨性完备——频率-严重度模型、VaR/TVaR、重现期、EVT 尾部建模、copula 多灾害相关性；可解释与可审计——可选 SHAP 特征重要性、合规报告（CAS/SOA/NAIC/IFoA）、运行 ID 与配置快照；生产就绪——REST API 带健康检查/限流/异步任务/结构化错误/可观测性。对 RIAA：气候风险×精算模拟的现代一体化平台参考。与 [[eltr]]（巨灾 ELT）、[[spatialextremes]]（空间极值）、[[oasislmf]]（损失建模框架）、[[cat-bond-pricing]]（巨灾债券）构成巨灾工具链。关联 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[mev]]、[[extremes]]。

entries.body_en: CATIA (Catastrophe AI for Climate Risk Modeling) is a production-grade catastrophe-AI platform (v2.5.0, MIT): an end-to-end pipeline unifying climate-data ingestion, climate-risk ML modelling, Monte Carlo simulation and mitigation optimisation. Actuarially rigorous — frequency-severity models, VaR/TVaR, return periods, EVT tail modelling, copula-based multi-peril correlation; explainable and auditable — optional SHAP feature importance, compliance reports (CAS/SOA/NAIC/IFoA), run IDs and config snapshots; production-ready — REST API with health checks, rate limiting, async jobs, structured errors and observability. For RIAA: a reference for modern integrated climate-risk × actuarial simulation platforms. With [[eltr]] (cat ELT), [[spatialextremes]] (spatial extremes) and [[oasislmf]] (loss-modelling framework) and [[cat-bond-pricing]] (CAT bonds) it forms the catastrophe toolchain. Related: [[reinsurance]], [[actuarial-pricing]], [[mev]], [[extremes]].
entries.body_hk: CATIA（Catastrophe AI for Climate Risk Modeling）是生產級巨災 AI 平台（v2.5.0，MIT）：統一數據攝入、氣候風險 ML 建模、蒙特卡羅模擬與緩解措施優化的端到端流水線。精算嚴謹性完備——頻率-嚴重度模型、VaR/TVaR、重現期、EVT 尾部建模、copula 多災害相關性；可解釋與可審計——可選 SHAP 特徵重要性、合規報告（CAS/SOA/NAIC/IFoA）、運行 ID 與配置快照；生產就緒——REST API 帶健康檢查/限流/異步任務/結構化錯誤/可觀測性。對 RIAA：氣候風險×精算模擬的現代一體化平台參考。與 [[eltr]]（巨災 ELT）、[[spatialextremes]]（空間極值）、[[oasislmf]]（損失建模框架）、[[cat-bond-pricing]]（巨災債券）構成巨災工具鏈。關聯 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[mev]]、[[extremes]]。

entries.title: huggingfaceR (R)
entries.summary: R 接口访问 HuggingFace Hub 模型与数据集（v2.2.0）：R 侧直接调用保险/精算 LLM 与数据集
entries.body: huggingfaceR 让 R 用户直接访问 HuggingFace Hub 上的模型与数据集（v2.2.0，Farach/Terfa/Penzer）：下载/调用模型、拉取数据集——精算师在 R 工作流中接入开源保险 LLM（如 [[open-insurance-llm]]、[[insurance-voice-qwen]]、[[llmware-industry-bert-insurance]]）与评测基准（如 [[ins-actbench]]）的桥梁。对 RIAA：R 侧做精算 ML/LLM 实验时不必切 Python。与 [[actuarial-skills]]（Claude skills）、[[aitools4actuaries]]（R/Python 双语课程）互补。
entries.verified_note: CRAN DESCRIPTION 核实：v2.2.0（2026-08-29 新增），R 访问 HuggingFace Hub 模型与数据集
entries.summary_en: R interface to access HuggingFace Hub models and datasets (v2.2.0): call insurance/actuarial LLMs and datasets from R
entries.summary_hk: R 接口訪問 HuggingFace Hub 模型與數據集（v2.2.0）：R 側直接調用保險/精算 LLM 與數據集
entries.body_en: huggingfaceR lets R users access models and datasets on the HuggingFace Hub directly (v2.2.0, Farach/Terfa/Penzer): download/call models, pull datasets — a bridge for actuaries to use open-source insurance LLMs (e.g. [[open-insurance-llm]], [[insurance-voice-qwen]], [[llmware-industry-bert-insurance]]) and evaluation benchmarks (e.g. [[ins-actbench]]) inside R workflows. For RIAA: actuarial ML/LLM experiments in R without switching to Python. Complements [[actuarial-skills]] (Claude skills) and [[aitools4actuaries]] (bilingual R/Python course).
entries.body_hk: huggingfaceR 讓 R 用戶直接訪問 HuggingFace Hub 上的模型與數據集（v2.2.0，Farach/Terfa/Penzer）：下載/調用模型、拉取數據集——精算師在 R 工作流中接入開源保險 LLM（如 [[open-insurance-llm]]、[[insurance-voice-qwen]]、[[llmware-industry-bert-insurance]]）與評測基準（如 [[ins-actbench]]）的橋樑。對 RIAA：R 側做精算 ML/LLM 實驗時不必切 Python。與 [[actuarial-skills]]（Claude skills）、[[aitools4actuaries]]（R/Python 雙語課程）互補。

entries.title: DetLifeInsurance (R)
entries.summary: 寿险保费与准备金估值 R 包（Bowers/Dickson/Jordan 教材实现）：含变额保障与分数期覆盖
entries.body: DetLifeInsurance 实现寿险保费与准备金（包括变额保障与分数期覆盖）的估值方法（v0.1.3，GPL-3）：基于三本经典教材——Bowers 等《Actuarial Mathematics》、Dickson/Hardy/Waters《Actuarial Mathematics for Life Contingent Risks》、Jordan《Life Contingencies》——另含等效利率/折现率计算、年金现值与终值、贷款摊销表。对 RIAA：寿险精算课程的教材配套实现（学 Bowers 时边算边对答案）。与 [[lifecontingencies]]（R 寿险数学库）、[[lifecontingencies-jl]]（Julia）、[[lifeinsurer]]（LifeInsureR 框架）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]。
entries.verified_note: CRAN DESCRIPTION 核实：v0.1.3，Auza & Alvarez，寿险保费/准备金估值（Bowers/Dickson/Jordan 教材），含变额保障与分数期，GPL-3
entries.summary_en: R package for life-insurance premium and reserve valuation (Bowers/Dickson/Jordan textbook implementations): incl. variable benefits and fractional coverage
entries.summary_hk: 壽險保費與準備金估值 R 包（Bowers/Dickson/Jordan 教材實現）：含變額保障與分數期覆蓋
entries.body_en: DetLifeInsurance implements valuation of life-insurance premiums and reserves (including variable-benefit and fractional coverage) (v0.1.3, GPL-3): based on three classic textbooks — Bowers et al. 'Actuarial Mathematics', Dickson/Hardy/Waters 'Actuarial Mathematics for Life Contingent Risks', and Jordan 'Life Contingencies' — plus equivalent interest/discount-rate calculation, present/future values of annuities, and loan-amortization schedules. For RIAA: a textbook companion implementation for life-insurance courses (compute along while studying Bowers). Complements [[lifecontingencies]] (R life-math library), [[lifecontingencies-jl]] (Julia) and [[lifeinsurer]] (LifeInsureR framework). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]].
entries.body_hk: DetLifeInsurance 實現壽險保費與準備金（包括變額保障與分數期覆蓋）的估值方法（v0.1.3，GPL-3）：基於三本經典教材——Bowers 等《Actuarial Mathematics》、Dickson/Hardy/Waters《Actuarial Mathematics for Life Contingent Risks》、Jordan《Life Contingencies》——另含等效利率/折現率計算、年金現值與終值、貸款攤銷表。對 RIAA：壽險精算課程的教材配套實現（學 Bowers 時邊算邊對答案）。與 [[lifecontingencies]]（R 壽險數學庫）、[[lifecontingencies-jl]]（Julia）、[[lifeinsurer]]（LifeInsureR 框架）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]。

entries.title: PDtoolkit (R)
entries.summary: PD 评分模型开发与验证 R 工具集：单/双/多元分析、单调分箱、WoE/IV、校准验证
entries.body: PDtoolkit（v1.2.0，Djurovic）覆盖违约概率（PD）评级模型开发与验证的最常见步骤：单变量/双变量/多元分析、校准与验证，配套 monobin/monobinShiny 包提供数据变换与建模函数——缺失值插补、数值风险因子单调分箱、类别风险因子分箱、证据权重（WoE）与信息量（IV）计算、WoE 编码、风险因子聚类等。对 RIAA：评分卡/评级模型的 R 侧完整工具集（信用风险、保险核保评分通用方法论）。与 [[scorecardpy]]（Python 评分卡流水线）、[[riskscores]]（整数风险评分优化）形成三语/三法互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]。。
entries.verified_note: CRAN DESCRIPTION 核实：v1.2.0，PD 评级模型开发验证（单/双/多元分析+校准+验证），monobin/monobinShiny 配套
entries.summary_en: R toolkit for PD rating-model development and validation: univariate/bivariate/multivariate analysis, monotonic binning, WoE/IV, calibration and validation
entries.summary_hk: PD 評分模型開發與驗證 R 工具集：單/雙/多元分析、單調分箱、WoE/IV、校準驗證
entries.body_en: PDtoolkit (v1.2.0, Djurovic) covers the most common steps in probability-of-default (PD) rating-model development and validation: univariate, bivariate and multivariate analysis, calibration and validation; together with the companion monobin/monobinShiny packages it provides data-transformation and modelling functions — imputation, monotonic binning of numeric risk factors, binning of categorical risk factors, weights-of-evidence (WoE) and information-value (IV) calculation, WoE coding, risk-factor clustering and more. For RIAA: the R-side complete toolkit for scorecard/rating models (credit risk; the same methodology applies to insurance underwriting scores). Complements [[scorecardpy]] (Python scorecard pipeline) and [[riskscores]] (integer risk-score optimisation) across languages/methods. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]].
entries.body_hk: PDtoolkit（v1.2.0，Djurovic）覆蓋違約概率（PD）評級模型開發與驗證的最常見步驟：單變量/雙變量/多元分析、校準與驗證，配套 monobin/monobinShiny 包提供數據變換與建模函數——缺失值插補、數值風險因子單調分箱、類別風險因子分箱、證據權重（WoE）與信息量（IV）計算、WoE 編碼、風險因子聚類等。對 RIAA：評分卡/評級模型的 R 側完整工具集（信用風險、保險核保評分通用方法論）。與 [[scorecardpy]]（Python 評分卡流水線）、[[riskscores]]（整數風險評分優化）形成三語/三法互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]。

entries.title: BIND Standard
entries.summary: BIND（Business Insurance Normalized Data）：保险互操作开放标准——经纪/承保/再保间机器可读数据交换
entries.body: BIND（Business Insurance Normalized Data）是保险行业开放数据互操作标准（bind-standard.org）：定义一套通用的资源类型与数据结构，让经纪人、保险公司、MGA、TPA、再保人与供应商以一致、机器可读的格式交换信息——一次集成、处处可用。对 RIAA：理解保险价值链数据交换的现代标准（API 驱动的互操作）。与 [[openidl]]（openIDS）、[[pcdm]]（财产险数据模型）同属保险数据标准生态。关联 [[actuarial-ontology]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：BIND（Business Insurance Normalized Data）开放互操作标准，bind-standard.org，经纪/承保/MGA/TPA/再保机器可读交换
entries.summary_en: BIND (Business Insurance Normalized Data): open interoperability standard for insurance — machine-readable exchange between brokers/carriers/reinsurers
entries.summary_hk: BIND（Business Insurance Normalized Data）：保險互操作開放標準——經紀/承保/再保間機器可讀數據交換
entries.body_en: BIND (Business Insurance Normalized Data) is an open data interoperability standard for insurance (bind-standard.org): it defines a common set of resource types and data structures enabling brokers, carriers, MGAs, TPAs, reinsurers and vendors to exchange information in a consistent, machine-readable format — integrate once, use everywhere. For RIAA: understanding the modern standard for data exchange across the insurance value chain (API-driven interoperability). With [[openidl]] (openIDS) and [[pcdm]] (property-casualty data model) it belongs to the insurance data-standards ecosystem. Related: [[actuarial-ontology]], [[insurance-ai-mcp]].
entries.body_hk: BIND（Business Insurance Normalized Data）是保險行業開放數據互操作標準（bind-standard.org）：定義一套通用的資源類型與數據結構，讓經紀人、保險公司、MGA、TPA、再保人與供應商以一致、機器可讀的格式交換信息——一次集成、處處可用。對 RIAA：理解保險價值鏈數據交換的現代標準（API 驅動的互操作）。與 [[openidl]]（openIDS）、[[pcdm]]（財產險數據模型）同屬保險數據標準生態。關聯 [[actuarial-ontology]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]。

entries.title: Open Life Data Standards (AU)
entries.summary: 澳大利亚寿险开放数据标准：顾问软件与保险公司的一次集成四处可用的厂商中立合同
entries.body: Open Life Data Standards (AU) 是澳大利亚寿险的厂商中立数据合同标准（axiscrm.github.io/open-life-au）：让顾问软件与保险公司一次集成、处处可用（替代一对一的逐对集成）——覆盖寿险保单数据交换的四个核心合同。对 RIAA：澳大利亚寿险生态的数据互操作参考（亚太寿险市场数字化基础）。与 [[openidl]]、[[bind-standard]]、[[pcdm]] 同属保险数据标准家族。关联 [[lifecontingencies]]、[[lifeinsurer]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：澳大利亚寿险厂商中立数据合同（axiscrm.github.io/open-life-au），顾问软件↔保险公司一次集成，四合同
entries.summary_en: Open life-insurance data standards (Australia): vendor-neutral contracts so adviser software and insurers integrate once instead of per-pair
entries.summary_hk: 澳大利亞壽險開放數據標準：顧問軟件與保險公司的一次集成四處可用的廠商中立合同
entries.body_en: Open Life Data Standards (AU) is a set of vendor-neutral data contracts for Australian life insurance (axiscrm.github.io/open-life-au): so adviser software and insurers integrate once instead of once per pair — four core contracts covering life-policy data exchange. For RIAA: the data-interoperability reference of the Australian life-insurance ecosystem (digital foundation of an Asia-Pacific life market). With [[openidl]], [[bind-standard]] and [[pcdm]] it belongs to the insurance data-standards family. Related: [[lifecontingencies]], [[lifeinsurer]].
entries.body_hk: Open Life Data Standards (AU) 是澳大利亞壽險的廠商中立數據合同標準（axiscrm.github.io/open-life-au）：讓顧問軟件與保險公司一次集成、處處可用（替代一對一的逐對集成）——覆蓋壽險保單數據交換的四個核心合同。對 RIAA：澳大利亞壽險生態的數據互操作參考（亞太壽險市場數字化基礎）。與 [[openidl]]、[[bind-standard]]、[[pcdm]] 同屬保險數據標準家族。關聯 [[lifecontingencies]]、[[lifeinsurer]]。

entries.title: FIBO (EDM Council)
entries.summary: 金融行业业务本体（683★）：EDM Council 官方的金融/保险业务概念标准本体
entries.body: FIBO（Financial Industry Business Ontology）是 EDM Council（企业数据管理理事会）主办与赞助的金融行业业务本体标准（683★）：定义金融工具、商业实体、业务过程等的统一本体，含保险领域概念——为金融/保险数据的语义互操作提供标准词汇。对 RIAA：保险数据语义层（本体/术语）的行业标准参考，与 [[actuarial-ontology]]（精算本体）、[[openidl]]（openIDS 数据标准）、[[bind-standard]]（BIND 互操作标准）、[[icd-hcc-mappings]]（编码映射）共同构成保险数据标准生态。关联 [[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[actuarial-skills]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README + HTML 核实：683★，EDM Council 主办，金融行业业务本体（含保险概念），金融/保险数据语义标准
entries.summary_en: Financial Industry Business Ontology (683★): the EDM Council's standard ontology for financial/insurance business concepts
entries.summary_hk: 金融行業業務本體（683★）：EDM Council 官方的金融/保險業務概念標準本體
entries.body_en: FIBO (Financial Industry Business Ontology) is the standard business ontology of the financial industry, hosted and sponsored by the Enterprise Data Management Council (EDM Council) (683★): it defines unified ontologies for financial instruments, business entities and processes, including insurance-domain concepts — providing standard vocabulary for semantic interoperability of financial/insurance data. For RIAA: the industry-standard reference for the semantic layer (ontology/terminology) of insurance data, joining [[actuarial-ontology]] (actuarial ontology), [[openidl]] (openIDS data standards), [[bind-standard]] (BIND interoperability standard) and [[icd-hcc-mappings]] (code mappings) in the insurance data-standards ecosystem. Related: [[insurance-ai-mcp]], [[actuarial-skills]].
entries.body_hk: FIBO（Financial Industry Business Ontology）是 EDM Council（企業數據管理理事會）主辦與贊助的金融行業業務本體標準（683★）：定義金融工具、商業實體、業務過程等的統一本體，含保險領域概念——為金融/保險數據的語義互操作提供標準詞彙。對 RIAA：保險數據語義層（本體/術語）的行業標準參考，與 [[actuarial-ontology]]（精算本體）、[[openidl]]（openIDS 數據標準）、[[bind-standard]]（BIND 互操作標準）、[[icd-hcc-mappings]]（編碼映射）共同構成保險數據標準生態。關聯 [[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[actuarial-skills]]。

entries.title: vasicekfit (R)
entries.summary: 扩展 Vasicek 单因子信用损失模型 R 包（宏观因子，SSRN 论文背书）：闭合式 MLE 估计资产相关性
entries.body: vasicekfit 拟合扩展的 Vasicek 单因子信用损失模型（v0.2.0，MIT）：违约概率依赖宏观协变量，通过 probit 变换的闭合式 OLS 回归获得所有参数（含资产价值相关性）的极大似然估计——推导见 Mayorov (2026)（SSRN 6506378）。对 RIAA：保险/银行信用风险的行业标准模型（Vasicek 违约相关模型是资本计量与压力测试核心）。与 [[pdtoolkit]]（PD 模型开发）、[[riskscores]]（整数风险评分）、[[scorecardpy]]（评分卡）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-thin-data]]。
entries.verified_note: CRAN DESCRIPTION 核实：v0.2.0，Mayorov (2026) SSRN 6506378，Vasicek 单因子信用损失模型+宏观因子，闭合式 probit-OLS MLE，MIT
entries.summary_en: Extended Vasicek single-factor credit-loss model with macroeconomic covariates (R, SSRN-paper backed): closed-form MLE incl. asset correlation
entries.summary_hk: 擴展 Vasicek 單因子信用損失模型 R 包（宏觀因子，SSRN 論文背書）：閉合式 MLE 估計資產相關性
entries.body_en: vasicekfit fits the extended Vasicek single-factor credit-loss model (v0.2.0, MIT): probability of default depends on macroeconomic covariates, and maximum-likelihood estimates of all parameters including asset-value correlation are obtained via closed-form probit-transformed OLS regression — derivation in Mayorov (2026) (SSRN 6506378). For RIAA: the industry-standard credit-risk model for insurance/banking (the Vasicek default-correlation model underpins capital measurement and stress testing). Complements [[pdtoolkit]] (PD model development), [[riskscores]] (integer risk scores) and [[scorecardpy]] (scorecards). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-thin-data]].
entries.body_hk: vasicekfit 擬合擴展的 Vasicek 單因子信用損失模型（v0.2.0，MIT）：違約概率依賴宏觀協變量，通過 probit 變換的閉合式 OLS 回歸獲得所有參數（含資產價值相關性）的極大似然估計——推導見 Mayorov (2026)（SSRN 6506378）。對 RIAA：保險/銀行信用風險的行業標準模型（Vasicek 違約相關模型是資本計量與壓力測試核心）。與 [[pdtoolkit]]（PD 模型開發）、[[riskscores]]（整數風險評分）、[[scorecardpy]]（評分卡）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-thin-data]]。

entries.title: Reinsurance Networks (AKL)
entries.summary: 再保网络级联损失论文代码（arXiv 1805.12222）：NAIC Schedule F 构建网络+Eisenberg-Noe 清算+传染模拟
entries.body: reinsurance_networks 是论文《Cascading Losses in Reinsurance Networks》（arXiv:1805.12222）的代码：用 NAIC Schedule F 的分保保费数据构建再保网络图、用 Eisenberg-Noe 清算算法计算均衡负债、稀疏矩阵实现、模拟冲击与传染并生成图——研究再保险网络中的系统性风险与级联损失。对 RIAA：再保险网络/系统性风险的前沿研究实现（理解『再保把风险连在一起』的量化分析）。与 [[reinsurer]]（再保险建模）、[[insurance-governance]]（模型治理）、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]] 互补。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：arXiv 1805.12222《Cascading Losses in Reinsurance Networks》代码，NAIC Schedule F 网络构建+Eisenberg-Noe 清算+传染模拟
entries.summary_en: Paper code for cascading losses in reinsurance networks (arXiv 1805.12222): NAIC Schedule F network construction + Eisenberg-Noe clearing + contagion simulation
entries.summary_hk: 再保網絡級聯損失論文代碼（arXiv 1805.12222）：NAIC Schedule F 構建網絡+Eisenberg-Noe 清算+傳染模擬
entries.body_en: reinsurance_networks is the code of the paper 'Cascading Losses in Reinsurance Networks' (arXiv:1805.12222): constructing reinsurance-network graphs from NAIC Schedule F ceded-premium data, computing equilibrium liabilities with the Eisenberg-Noe clearing algorithm (sparse-matrix implementation), and simulating shocks and contagion with figure generation — studying systemic risk and cascading losses in reinsurance networks. For RIAA: a frontier research implementation of reinsurance networks/systemic risk (quantifying how reinsurance links risks together). Complements [[reinsurer]] (reinsurance modelling), [[insurance-governance]] (model governance), [[actuarial-pricing]] and [[reinsurance]].
entries.body_hk: reinsurance_networks 是論文《Cascading Losses in Reinsurance Networks》（arXiv:1805.12222）的代碼：用 NAIC Schedule F 的分保保費數據構建再保網絡圖、用 Eisenberg-Noe 清算算法計算均衡負債、稀疏矩陣實現、模擬衝擊與傳染並生成圖——研究再保險網絡中的系統性風險與級聯損失。對 RIAA：再保險網絡/系統性風險的前沿研究實現（理解『再保把風險連在一起』的量化分析）。與 [[reinsurer]]（再保險建模）、[[insurance-governance]]（模型治理）、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]] 互補。

entries.title: Bayesian IBNR for Cyber (CAS)
entries.summary: CAS 贝叶斯网络风险 IBNR 模型（nimble）：负二项似然+时间/延迟预测因子估计未决网络理赔
entries.body: bayesIBNRcyber 是 CAS 研究仓库：用 R 的 nimble 包实现贝叶斯网络风险 IBNR（已发生未报告理赔）模型——负二项似然配合时间与延迟特定的预测因子，基于历史数据预测网络事件计数。网络风险是新险种，IBNR 估计是网络险准备金的前沿问题。对 RIAA：贝叶斯×新风险（网络险）准备金建模的官方研究参考。与 [[cyber-risk-classification]]（网络风险分类）、[[reserving-robust]]（稳健准备金）、[[chainladder]]（经典链梯）互补。关联 [[insurance-governance]]、[[reinsurance]]。

entries.body_en: bayesIBNRcyber is a CAS research repo: a Bayesian model for estimating incurred-but-not-reported (IBNR) cyber incidents using R's nimble package — a negative-binomial likelihood with time- and delay-specific predictors forecasting incident counts from historical data. Cyber is a new risk class and cyber IBNR is a frontier reserving problem. For RIAA: the official research reference for Bayesian × emerging-risk (cyber) reserving. Complements [[cyber-risk-classification]] (cyber-risk taxonomy), [[reserving-robust]] (robust reserving) and [[chainladder]] (classic chain ladder). Related: [[insurance-governance]], [[reinsurance]].

entries.title: Longitudinal Reserving (CAS)
entries.summary: CAS 准备金工作组纵向方法论文代码：二十年数百家公司公开数据的非寿险纵向准备金研究
entries.body: reserves_wg_longitudinal_reserving 是 CAS 准备金工作组（Reserves Working Group）的纵向方法论文代码：用纵向数据分析技术研究非寿险损失准备金——预测已发生未结案理赔的负债，数据为数百家保险公司二十年公开数据。纵向方法（面板数据视角看准备金）是传统链梯之外的新视角。对 RIAA：CAS 官方研究，准备金方法论的前沿扩展。与 [[chainladder]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]、[[reserving-mmnpp]]（UNSW 系列）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：CAS Reserves Working Group 纵向非寿险准备金论文（20 年数百家公司公开数据）
entries.summary_en: CAS reserves-working-group paper code: longitudinal data analysis for non-life loss reserving (20 years of public data from hundreds of companies)
entries.summary_hk: CAS 準備金工作組縱向方法論文代碼：二十年數百家公司公開數據的非壽險縱向準備金研究
entries.body_en: reserves_wg_longitudinal_reserving is the paper code of the CAS Reserves Working Group: a longitudinal approach to non-life loss reserving using longitudinal-data-analysis techniques — forecasting the liability for incurred-but-not-yet-settled claims, on public data from several hundred insurance companies over twenty years. The longitudinal (panel-data) view of reserving is a new perspective beyond the classic chain ladder. For RIAA: official CAS research extending reserving methodology. Complements [[chainladder]], [[reserving-ensemble]] and [[reserving-mmnpp]] (UNSW series). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]].
entries.body_hk: reserves_wg_longitudinal_reserving 是 CAS 準備金工作組（Reserves Working Group）的縱向方法論文代碼：用縱向數據分析技術研究非壽險損失準備金——預測已發生未結案理賠的負債，數據為數百家保險公司二十年公開數據。縱向方法（面板數據視角看準備金）是傳統鏈梯之外的新視角。對 RIAA：CAS 官方研究，準備金方法論的前沿擴展。與 [[chainladder]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]、[[reserving-mmnpp]]（UNSW 系列）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

entries.title: bnn-claims (BMDN)
entries.summary: 个体理赔预测论文代码（kasaai，CAS 资助）：贝叶斯混合密度网络（BMDN）
entries.body: bnn-claims 是论文《Individual Claims Forecasting with Bayesian Mixture Density Networks》的仓库（kasaai，CAS 资助）：用贝叶斯混合密度网络（BMDN）对个体理赔做预测——混合密度网络输出完整分布而非点预测，贝叶斯化处理不确定性。对 RIAA：个体理赔预测（现金流的分布预测）的前沿深度学习方法。与 [[simulationmachine]]（个体理赔模拟）、[[deeptriangle]]（深度学习准备金）、[[drn]]（分布精炼网络）同属精算深度学习分布预测谱系。关联 [[chainladder]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。

For RIAA: a frontier deep-learning method for individual-claims (cashflow distributional) forecasting. Joins [[simulationmachine]] (individual claims simulation), [[deeptriangle]] (deep-learning reserving) and [[drn]] (distributional refinement networks) in the actuarial deep-learning distributional-forecasting spectrum. Related: [[chainladder]], [[actuarial-pricing]].

entries.title: fastcashflow
entries.summary: 开源 IFRS 17 计量引擎（Python，MPL-2.0）：模型点+估值基础→月度现金流投影→BEL/RA/CSM
entries.body: fastcashflow 是开源 IFRS 17 计量引擎（Python 3.10+，MPL-2.0）：输入模型点与估值基础，投影月度现金流，计量保险合同负债——BEL（最佳估计负债）、RA（风险调整）、CSM（合同服务边际），支持 GMM（一般计量模型）、PAA（保费分配法）、VFA（可变收费法）。目标是与企业级平台同速同准、源码可读、无授权墙无闭源二进制——任何精算师都能打开跑真实估值。对 RIAA：IFRS 17 计量从概念到可运行引擎的最佳开源参考。与 [[ifrs17a]]（lifelib IFRS17A 库）、[[lifelib]]、[[financemodels-jl]]（现金流合同建模）、[[esg]]/[[pyesg]]（情景生成）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[solvency2rfr]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：MPL-2.0，Python 3.10+，IFRS 17 计量引擎（月度现金流投影，BEL/RA/CSM，GMM/PAA/VFA），开源可读目标

entries.summary_hk: 開源 IFRS 17 計量引擎（Python，MPL-2.0）：模型點+估值基礎→月度現金流投影→BEL/RA/CSM
entries.body_en: fastcashflow is an open-source IFRS 17 measurement engine (Python 3.10+, MPL-2.0): it takes model points and a valuation basis, projects monthly cash flows, and measures the insurance-contract liability — BEL (best-estimate liability), RA (risk adjustment) and CSM (contractual service margin) — under the GMM, PAA and VFA models. The goal is an engine that matches enterprise platforms on speed and correctness, with readable source and no licence wall or closed binaries — any actuary can open it and run a real valuation. For RIAA: the best open-source reference for IFRS 17 measurement from concept to runnable engine. Complements [[ifrs17a]] (lifelib IFRS17A library), [[lifelib]], [[financemodels-jl]] (cashflow/contract modelling) and [[esg]]/[[pyesg]] (scenario generation). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[solvency2rfr]].
entries.body_hk: fastcashflow 是開源 IFRS 17 計量引擎（Python 3.10+，MPL-2.0）：輸入模型點與估值基礎，投影月度現金流，計量保險合同負債——BEL（最佳估計負債）、RA（風險調整）、CSM（合同服務邊際），支持 GMM（一般計量模型）、PAA（保費分配法）、VFA（可變收費法）。目標是與企業級平台同速同準、源碼可讀、無授權牆無閉源二進制——任何精算師都能打開跑真實估值。對 RIAA：IFRS 17 計量從概念到可運行引擎的最佳開源參考。與 [[ifrs17a]]（lifelib IFRS17A 庫）、[[lifelib]]、[[financemodels-jl]]（現金流合同建模）、[[esg]]/[[pyesg]]（情景生成）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[solvency2rfr]]。

entries.summary: Smith-Wilson 算法 Python 实现（OSM/Richman）：EIOPA 无风险利率曲线外推标准方法
entries.body: Smith-Wilson 算法是 EIOPA 规定的 Solvency II 无风险利率曲线外推标准方法（把市场利率平滑外推到远期终值利率 UFR）。本仓库是 Ronald Richman（OSM）的 Python 实现。对 RIAA：Solvency II 折现率曲线构造的核心算法（与 [[solvency2rfr]] 的 EIOPA 数据配套——一个拉数据，一个外推）。关联 [[nelson-siegel-svensson]]（NSS 拟合）、[[yieldcurves]]（R 曲线工具）、[[esg]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。

entries.summary_en: Python implementation of the Smith-Wilson algorithm (OSM/Richman): the EIOPA standard method for risk-free-curve extrapolation
entries.summary_hk: Smith-Wilson 算法 Python 實現（OSM/Richman）：EIOPA 無風險利率曲線外推標準方法
entries.body_en: The Smith-Wilson algorithm is the EIOPA-standard method for extrapolating Solvency II risk-free curves (smoothing market rates into a long-term ultimate forward rate UFR). This repo is Ronald Richman's (OSM) Python implementation. For RIAA: the core algorithm for Solvency II discount-curve construction (paired with [[solvency2rfr]]'s EIOPA data — one pulls the data, one extrapolates). Related: [[nelson-siegel-svensson]] (NSS fitting), [[yieldcurves]] (R curve tools), [[esg]], [[actuarial-pricing]].
entries.body_hk: Smith-Wilson 算法是 EIOPA 規定的 Solvency II 無風險利率曲線外推標準方法（把市場利率平滑外推到遠期終值利率 UFR）。本倉庫是 Ronald Richman（OSM）的 Python 實現。對 RIAA：Solvency II 折現率曲線構造的核心算法（與 [[solvency2rfr]] 的 EIOPA 數據配套——一個拉數據，一個外推）。關聯 [[nelson-siegel-svensson]]（NSS 擬合）、[[yieldcurves]]（R 曲線工具）、[[esg]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。

entries.body: Car Classification 是 Databricks 官方行业方案：图像分类识别车辆（车型识别）——保险场景用于承保信息自动提取、理赔图片车型确认。DBR 10.4ML，5 天 POC。对 RIAA：保险计算机视觉（车辆识别）的官方工程范式。与 [[erm159-image-recognition]]（SOA 图像识别）、[[mongodb-insurance-image-search]]（图像检索）互补。关联 [[ins-mmbench]]（多模态基准）、[[claimpilot-harness]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：Databricks 官方车辆图像分类方案（DBR 10.4ML，POC 5 天）
entries.summary_en: Official Databricks vehicle-classification solution: image classification for car-model recognition (insurance underwriting/claims auto-identification)
entries.summary_hk: Databricks 官方車輛分類方案：圖像分類識別車型（保險承保/理賠自動識別）
entries.body_en: Car Classification is an official Databricks industry solution: image classification to recognize vehicles (car-model identification) — for insurance use in automatic underwriting-information extraction and claim-photo vehicle confirmation. DBR 10.4ML, 5-day POC. For RIAA: the official engineering pattern for insurance computer vision (vehicle recognition). Complements [[erm159-image-recognition]] (SOA image recognition) and [[mongodb-insurance-image-search]] (image retrieval). Related: [[ins-mmbench]] (multimodal benchmark), [[claimpilot-harness]].
entries.body_hk: Car Classification 是 Databricks 官方行業方案：圖像分類識別車輛（車型識別）——保險場景用於承保信息自動提取、理賠圖片車型確認。DBR 10.4ML，5 天 POC。對 RIAA：保險計算機視覺（車輛識別）的官方工程範式。與 [[erm159-image-recognition]]（SOA 圖像識別）、[[mongodb-insurance-image-search]]（圖像檢索）互補。關聯 [[ins-mmbench]]（多模態基準）、[[claimpilot-harness]]。

entries.title: Seaworthy Insurance MCP
entries.summary: 保险 MCP 服务器（MIT，已入 MCP Registry）：保单/理赔/核保数据的模型上下文协议接口

entries.title: ActEval
entries.summary: 非寿险定价模型评估工具（PyPI acteval-insurance）：预测数组的多维评估——校准/判别/尾部风险/财务决策
entries.body: ActEval 评估预测数组（而非拟合模型对象）的多个维度：精度、校准、判别力、概率质量、不确定性、观测尾部风险与财务决策影响——兼容 GLM、scikit-learn、XGBoost、CatBoost、神经网络等任意建模栈。设计目标：非寿险定价工作流，保持精算目标分离（不做武断的通用模型分数）——低 RMSE 的模型可能聚合校准更差、大额损失行为更弱、定价后果更不利，ActEval 让这些权衡显性化。对 RIAA：精算定价模型评估的正确打开方式。与 [[insurance-governance]]（模型治理）、[[machine-learning-pricing]] 互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[claim-frequency]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README + PyPI 核实：acteval-insurance（PyPI），预测数组多维评估（校准/判别/尾部/财务），非寿险定价专用，CI+文档
entries.summary_en: Non-life pricing model evaluation tool (PyPI acteval-insurance): multi-dimensional evaluation of prediction arrays — calibration/discrimination/tail risk/financial decisions
entries.summary_hk: 非壽險定價模型評估工具（PyPI acteval-insurance）：預測數組的多維評估——校準/判別/尾部風險/財務決策
entries.body_en: ActEval evaluates prediction arrays (not fitted model objects) across accuracy, calibration, discrimination, probabilistic quality, uncertainty, observed-tail risk and financial decisions — working with outputs from GLMs, scikit-learn, XGBoost, CatBoost, neural networks or any modelling stack. Designed for non-life insurance pricing: actuarial objectives stay separate, with no arbitrary universal model score — a model with lower RMSE can still have worse aggregate calibration, weaker large-loss behaviour or a less favourable pricing consequence; ActEval makes those trade-offs explicit. For RIAA: the right way to evaluate actuarial pricing models. Complements [[insurance-governance]] (model governance) and [[machine-learning-pricing]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[claim-frequency]].
entries.body_hk: ActEval 評估預測數組（而非擬合模型對象）的多個維度：精度、校準、判別力、概率質量、不確定性、觀測尾部風險與財務決策影響——兼容 GLM、scikit-learn、XGBoost、CatBoost、神經網絡等任意建模棧。設計目標：非壽險定價工作流，保持精算目標分離（不做武斷的通用模型分數）——低 RMSE 的模型可能聚合校準更差、大額損失行為更弱、定價後果更不利，ActEval 讓這些權衡顯性化。對 RIAA：精算定價模型評估的正確打開方式。與 [[insurance-governance]]（模型治理）、[[machine-learning-pricing]] 互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[claim-frequency]]。

entries.title: GINSIM
entries.summary: GINA 基因信息非歧视政策的保险经济评估（JAX 蒙特卡洛+博弈论）：政策模拟沙盒
entries.body: GINSIM（Genetic Information Non-Discrimination Policy Integrated Economic Evaluation）是基因信息非歧视政策（GINA）的保险经济评估模型：JAX/XLA 高性能蒙特卡洛模拟 + 梯度优化，基准政策场景（status_quo/moratorium/ban）对比，分布性成本效益分析（DCBA，跨风险五分位与土著人群），博弈论框架（投保人与保险公司的纳什均衡、对抗性重优化），Streamlit 交互沙盒。对 RIAA：保险×基因信息×政策的计算建模前沿（精算与政策交叉）。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]（风险分类）、[[insurance-governance]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：JAX 蒙特卡洛+博弈论，GINA 政策经济评估（DCBA/纳什均衡/Streamlit 沙盒），Python 3.10+
entries.summary_en: Insurance-economic evaluation of the GINA genetic-information non-discrimination policy (JAX Monte Carlo + game theory): policy simulation sandbox
entries.summary_hk: GINA 基因信息非歧視政策的保險經濟評估（JAX 蒙特卡羅+博弈論）：政策模擬沙盒
entries.body_en: GINSIM (Genetic Information Non-Discrimination Policy Integrated Economic Evaluation) is an insurance-economic model of genetic-information non-discrimination policy (GINA): JAX/XLA high-performance Monte Carlo simulation + gradient-based optimisation, policy-benchmark comparisons (status_quo/moratorium/ban), distributional cost-benefit analysis (DCBA across risk quintiles and Indigenous populations), a game-theoretic framework (Nash equilibria between insurers and applicants, adversarial re-optimisation) and a Streamlit interactive sandbox. For RIAA: the computational-modelling frontier of insurance × genetic information × policy. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]] (risk classification), [[insurance-governance]], [[machine-learning-pricing]].
entries.body_hk: GINSIM（Genetic Information Non-Discrimination Policy Integrated Economic Evaluation）是基因信息非歧視政策（GINA）的保險經濟評估模型：JAX/XLA 高性能蒙特卡羅模擬 + 梯度優化，基準政策場景（status_quo/moratorium/ban）對比，分佈性成本效益分析（DCBA，跨風險五分位與土著人群），博弈論框架（投保人與保險公司的納什均衡、對抗性重優化），Streamlit 交互沙盒。對 RIAA：保險×基因信息×政策的計算建模前沿（精算與政策交叉）。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]（風險分類）、[[insurance-governance]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]。

entries.title: Claims Reserving Benchmark
entries.summary: 准备金方法对比基准（MIT）：经典链梯 vs 分布 GLM/表格 ML/PyTorch NN/约束混合，统一滚动估值协议
entries.body: Claims Reserving Benchmark 是一个准备金方法对比基准（MIT，CI 完备，v0.3.0）：在同一个滚动估值协议下比较经典准备金方法（链梯系）与分布 GLM、表格机器学习、PyTorch 神经网络与约束链梯残差混合模型——『度量灵活性在哪里真正有帮助，而不是假设 AI 必胜』，附工作论文与研究协议。对 RIAA：准备金方法论对比的科学基准（用数据说话而非立场）。与 [[chainladder]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]、[[drn]]、[[bnn-claims]] 互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：MIT，CI，统一滚动估值协议对比经典/GLM/ML/NN/混合准备金方法，工作论文+研究协议
entries.summary_en: Reserving-method comparison benchmark (MIT): classic chain-ladder vs distributional GLM/tabular ML/PyTorch NN/constrained hybrid under one rolling-valuation protocol
entries.summary_hk: 準備金方法對比基準（MIT）：經典鏈梯 vs 分佈 GLM/表格 ML/PyTorch NN/約束混合，統一滾動估值協議
entries.body_en: Claims Reserving Benchmark is a reserving-method comparison benchmark (MIT, CI-complete, v0.3.0): comparing classical reserving methods (chain-ladder family) with distributional GLMs, tabular machine learning, a PyTorch neural network and a constrained chain-ladder residual hybrid under the same rolling-valuation protocol — 'measuring where flexibility helps instead of assuming that AI wins', with a working paper and research protocol. For RIAA: a scientific benchmark for reserving-method comparison (data-driven rather than positional). Complements [[chainladder]], [[reserving-ensemble]], [[drn]] and [[bnn-claims]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]].
entries.body_hk: Claims Reserving Benchmark 是一個準備金方法對比基準（MIT，CI 完備，v0.3.0）：在同一個滾動估值協議下比較經典準備金方法（鏈梯系）與分佈 GLM、表格機器學習、PyTorch 神經網絡與約束鏈梯殘差混合模型——『度量靈活性在哪裡真正有幫助，而不是假設 AI 必勝』，附工作論文與研究協議。對 RIAA：準備金方法論對比的科學基準（用數據說話而非立場）。與 [[chainladder]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]、[[drn]]、[[bnn-claims]] 互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

entries.title: Insurance Reports DNN
entries.summary: 论文代码：用深度神经网络自动分析保险理赔报告文本识别重大理赔（不平衡数据+嵌入方法）
entries.body: Insurance-reports-through-deep-neural-networks 是论文配套代码：用深度神经网络自动分析理赔报告文本（开案时脱敏文本）预测理赔是否特别重大——难点是极端理赔在数据中稀少（类别不平衡），作者提出不同再平衡算法处理，并讨论多种文本嵌入方法与网络架构。对 RIAA：理赔严重度的文本分类深度学习研究实现（NLP×理赔）。与 [[nlp-actuarial-loss-modeling]]、[[llm-claims-analysis]]、[[insurance-severity]] 互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[claim-frequency]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：论文（理赔报告文本→严重度分类，再平衡算法+嵌入方法），带论文链接

entries.summary_hk: 論文代碼：用深度神經網絡自動分析保險理賠報告文本識別重大理賠（不平衡數據+嵌入方法）
entries.body_en: Insurance-reports-through-deep-neural-networks is the companion code of a paper: automatically classifying claims using text-report information (redacted at opening) to predict whether a claim will be particularly severe — the difficulty is the rarity of extreme claims (class imbalance), addressed with rebalancing algorithms, plus a discussion of text-embedding methods and network architectures. For RIAA: a deep-learning research implementation of claims-severity text classification (NLP × claims). Complements [[nlp-actuarial-loss-modeling]], [[llm-claims-analysis]] and [[insurance-severity]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[claim-frequency]].
entries.body_hk: Insurance-reports-through-deep-neural-networks 是論文配套代碼：用深度神經網絡自動分析理賠報告文本（開案時脫敏文本）預測理賠是否特別重大——難點是極端理賠在數據中稀少（類別不平衡），作者提出不同再平衡算法處理，並討論多種文本嵌入方法與網絡架構。對 RIAA：理賠嚴重度的文本分類深度學習研究實現（NLP×理賠）。與 [[nlp-actuarial-loss-modeling]]、[[llm-claims-analysis]]、[[insurance-severity]] 互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[claim-frequency]]。

entries.title: verified-reserving (Lean 4)
entries.summary: 机器验证的精算准备金数学（Lean 4，Apache-2.0）：Mack/Munich 链梯、ODP、BF、信度、Panjer 递推全部形式化证明
entries.body: verified-reserving 是用 Lean 4 定理证明器对准备金与精算风险数学做机器验证的项目（Apache-2.0，无 sorry/自定义公理，CI 审计 479 个命名声明的证明依赖）：覆盖 Mack 与 Munich 链梯、随机 ODP、一年期理赔发展、Bornhuetter-Ferguson、Bühlmann-Straub 信度与 Panjer 递推。形式化证明包括：发展因子=个体因子加权平均、Mack 方差估计的自由度分解、Mack MSEP、Quarg-Mack 的 Munich 相关性调整恒等式（分离链梯保留付/收比例的系统性缺口）、以及精确复现 Mack (1993) 表 1 的数值（Taylor-Ashe 三角形，总准备金落在印刷值 18,681 的最邻近千位区间内）。对 RIAA：『数学证明也能机器验证』的前沿范式——精算算法的形式化保证。与 [[chainladder]]、[[profileladder]]、[[reserving-ensemble]] 互补（方法 vs 证明）。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：Lean 4 机器验证（Mack/Munich/ODP/BF/信度/Panjer），无 sorry，CI 审计 479 声明，复现 Mack 1993 表 1
entries.summary_en: Machine-checked actuarial reserving mathematics in Lean 4 (Apache-2.0): Mack/Munich chain ladder, ODP, BF, credibility, Panjer recursion — all formally proved
entries.summary_hk: 機器驗證的精算準備金數學（Lean 4，Apache-2.0）：Mack/Munich 鏈梯、ODP、BF、信度、Panjer 遞推全部形式化證明
entries.body_en: verified-reserving is a project that machine-checks claims-reserving and actuarial risk mathematics with the Lean 4 theorem prover (Apache-2.0, no sorry/custom axioms, CI audits the proof dependencies of 479 named declarations): covering Mack and Munich chain ladder, stochastic ODP, one-year claims development, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, Bühlmann-Straub credibility and Panjer recursion. Formal proofs include: the development factor as the weighted mean of individual factors, the weighted sum-of-squares decomposition giving the degrees of freedom of Mack's variance estimator, Mack's MSEP, the Quarg-Mack identity behind the Munich correlation adjustment (separate chain ladder preserving each row's paid/incurred ratio — the systematic gap), and an exact reproduction of Mack (1993) Table 1 numerics (Taylor-Ashe triangle; the summed reserve lands in the nearest-thousand interval printed as 18,681). For RIAA: the frontier paradigm that 'mathematical proofs can also be machine-verified' — formal guarantees for actuarial algorithms. Complements [[chainladder]], [[profileladder]] and [[reserving-ensemble]] (methods vs proofs). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]].
entries.body_hk: verified-reserving 是用 Lean 4 定理證明器對準備金與精算風險數學做機器驗證的項目（Apache-2.0，無 sorry/自定義公理，CI 審計 479 個命名聲明的證明依賴）：覆蓋 Mack 與 Munich 鏈梯、隨機 ODP、一年期理賠發展、Bornhuetter-Ferguson、Bühlmann-Straub 信度與 Panjer 遞推。形式化證明包括：發展因子=個體因子加權平均、Mack 方差估計的自由度分解、Mack MSEP、Quarg-Mack 的 Munich 相關性調整恆等式（分離鏈梯保留付/收比例的系統性缺口）、以及精確複現 Mack (1993) 表 1 的數值（Taylor-Ashe 三角形，總準備金落在印刷值 18,681 的最鄰近千位區間內）。對 RIAA：『數學證明也能機器驗證』的前沿範式——精算算法的形式化保證。與 [[chainladder]]、[[profileladder]]、[[reserving-ensemble]] 互補（方法 vs 證明）。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

entries.body_en: actudist is a Python actuarial loss-distribution package (PyPI, MIT, Python 3.10+): it follows the parameterizations of Klugman's 'Loss Models' — every severity distribution exposes layer statistics (LEV, excess pure premium, ILF) as methods, and MLE accepts right-censored and one-/two-sided truncated samples. For RIAA: the Python-side utility library for loss (severity) modelling — LEV/ILF are exactly the quantities needed for reinsurance pricing and stop-loss analysis. Complements [[pareto-r]], [[comppareto]], [[logngpd]] (spliced distributions) and [[insurance-severity]] (burning-cost severity). Related: [[actuar-r]], [[actuarial-pricing]], [[reinsurance]].
entries.body_hk: actudist 是精算損失分佈 Python 包（PyPI，MIT，Python 3.10+）：遵循 Klugman《Loss Models》的參數化約定——每個嚴重度分佈都暴露分層統計（LEV 損失期望值、超額純保費、ILF 損失遞增因子）作為方法，MLE 支持右刪失與單/雙側截斷樣本。對 RIAA：損失建模（severity）的 Python 側實用庫——LEV/ILF 正是再保險定價與止損分析需要的量。與 [[pareto-r]]、[[comppareto]]、[[logngpd]]（拼接分佈）、[[insurance-severity]]（burning-cost 嚴重度）互補。關聯 [[actuar-r]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]。

entries.title: PolicyExplainer AI
entries.summary: 家财险保单 RAG 问答助手：只基于保单文本回答+引用来源+诚实拒答+真实评测框架
entries.body: PolicyExplainer AI 是家财险保单的检索增强（RAG）问答助手：用自然语言回答保单问题（如『飓风免赔额多少』『洪水是否承保』）——答案只来自保单文本（绝不来自模型泛化知识），带页码引用；保单未覆盖的问题诚实拒答而非猜测；配备真实评测框架。对 RIAA：保险保单文档问答的最佳实践（grounded + 引用 + 拒答 + 评测）。与 [[underwriting-copilot]]（承保 copilot）、[[mongodb-insurance-pdf-search]]（PDF 检索）互补。关联 [[finixdocbench]]、[[claimpilot-harness]]。

entries.summary_hk: 家財險保單 RAG 問答助手：只基於保單文本回答+引用來源+誠實拒答+真實評測框架
entries.body_en: PolicyExplainer AI is a retrieval-augmented (RAG) assistant for homeowners-insurance policy Q&A: plain-language answers (e.g. 'What's my hurricane deductible?', 'Is flood damage covered?') — grounded only in the policy text (never the model's general knowledge), with page citations; honest refusals when the policy doesn't address the question; and a real evaluation harness. For RIAA: best practice for insurance policy-document Q&A (grounded + citations + refusals + evaluation). Complements [[underwriting-copilot]] (underwriting copilot) and [[mongodb-insurance-pdf-search]] (PDF retrieval). Related: [[finixdocbench]], [[claimpilot-harness]].
entries.body_hk: PolicyExplainer AI 是家財險保單的檢索增強（RAG）問答助手：用自然語言回答保單問題（如『颶風免賠額多少』『洪水是否承保』）——答案只來自保單文本（絕不來自模型泛化知識），帶頁碼引用；保單未覆蓋的問題誠實拒答而非猜測；配備真實評測框架。對 RIAA：保險保單文檔問答的最佳實踐（grounded + 引用 + 拒答 + 評測）。與 [[underwriting-copilot]]（承保 copilot）、[[mongodb-insurance-pdf-search]]（PDF 檢索）互補。關聯 [[finixdocbench]]、[[claimpilot-harness]]。

entries.title: QARM · Solvency II Portfolio Optimizer
entries.summary: 寿险 Solvency II 投资组合优化 Web 应用（Streamlit）：收益与 SCR 平衡的合规组合优化
entries.body: QARM（Solvency II Portfolio Optimizer）是面向寿险公司的投资组合优化 Web 应用（Streamlit）：在 Solvency II 监管框架下平衡预期收益与偿付能力资本要求（SCR），同时维持监管合规——投资组合层面的收益-资本权衡工具。对 RIAA：Solvency II 语境下的 ALM/投资组合优化交互工具。与 [[open-source-economic-model]]（开源 ALM）、[[capital-modeling]]（CAS 资本建模）、[[solvency2rfr]]（RFR 曲线）、[[insurance-scr-data]]（SCR 数据）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[esg]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：寿险 Solvency II 投资组合优化 Streamlit 应用（收益 vs SCR 平衡，合规）

entries.summary_hk: 壽險 Solvency II 投資組合優化 Web 應用（Streamlit）：收益與 SCR 平衡的合規組合優化
entries.body_en: QARM (Solvency II Portfolio Optimizer) is a web application for life insurers to optimize investment portfolios under the Solvency II regulatory framework (Streamlit): balancing expected returns against Solvency Capital Requirements (SCR) while maintaining regulatory compliance — the return-vs-capital trade-off at portfolio level. For RIAA: an interactive tool for ALM/portfolio optimization in a Solvency II context. Complements [[open-source-economic-model]] (open-source ALM), [[capital-modeling]] (CAS capital modelling), [[solvency2rfr]] (RFR curves) and [[insurance-scr-data]] (SCR data). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[esg]].
entries.body_hk: QARM（Solvency II Portfolio Optimizer）是面向壽險公司的投資組合優化 Web 應用（Streamlit）：在 Solvency II 監管框架下平衡預期收益與償付能力資本要求（SCR），同時維持監管合規——投資組合層面的收益-資本權衡工具。對 RIAA：Solvency II 語境下的 ALM/投資組合優化交互工具。與 [[open-source-economic-model]]（開源 ALM）、[[capital-modeling]]（CAS 資本建模）、[[solvency2rfr]]（RFR 曲線）、[[insurance-scr-data]]（SCR 數據）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[esg]]。

entries.title: Reproducible Actuarial Work (Philip Darke)
entries.summary: 精算工作的可复现数据科学技术（Philip Darke 讲稿+网站）：精算数据分析的最佳实践
entries.body: Reproducible Actuarial Work 是英国精算师 Philip Darke（保险科技与精算数据科学知名教育者）在 Data Science: Opportunities for Actuaries 活动（2019）的讲稿与配套网站：精算工作中应用可复现数据科学技术（版本控制、自动化报告、代码可复现）的最佳实践。对 RIAA：把『可复现性』引入精算工作的入门资源（精算报告应该像软件一样可复现）。与 [[actuarial-cookbook]]（澳洲精算菜谱）、[[aitools4actuaries]]（AI 精算课程）互补。关联 [[actuarial-skills]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

entries.summary_hk: 精算工作的可複現數據科學技術（Philip Darke 講稿+網站）：精算數據分析的最佳實踐
entries.body_en: Reproducible Actuarial Work is the talk and companion website of UK actuary Philip Darke (a well-known educator in insurtech and actuarial data science) from the Data Science: Opportunities for Actuaries event (2019): best practice for applying reproducible data-science techniques (version control, automated reporting, reproducible code) in actuarial work. For RIAA: the entry resource for bringing 'reproducibility' into actuarial work (actuarial reports should be reproducible like software). Complements [[actuarial-cookbook]] (Australian actuarial cookbook) and [[aitools4actuaries]] (AI actuarial course). Related: [[actuarial-skills]], [[insurance-governance]].

entries.summary: 人类死亡率数据库（HMD）Julia 接口（MIT，文档/测试完备）：直接拉取死亡率数据
entries.body: HMD.jl 是 Julia 的人类死亡率数据库（Human Mortality Database）接口包（MIT，docs/tests/codecov 完备）：直接下载与使用 HMD 的死亡率/生命表数据——长寿风险研究的数据源接入。与 [[mortalitylaws]]（R，参数模型+HMD）、[[pymort]]（Python SOA 表）、[[mortalitytables-jl]]（Julia 死亡率表）互补——HMD 是人口学/长寿研究的权威数据源。关联 [[demofit]]、[[bamp]]、[[stmomo]]、[[longevity]]。

entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：再/保险合同建模 DSL（可计算合同表达）
entries.summary_en: Domain-specific language for modelling re/insurance contracts: computable expression of contract structures
entries.summary_hk: 再保險/保險合同建模的領域特定語言（DSL）：合同結構的可計算表達
entries.body_en: Reactor.DSL is a domain-specific language for modelling re/insurance contracts: expressing contract clauses (cession structures, limits, triggers) in a computable form — the direction of contract digitisation/machine-readability. For RIAA: a frontier direction in insurance-contract formalisation (contract as code). Complements [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]] (contract corpus), [[openrater]] (rate filing → engine) and [[fastcashflow]] (IFRS 17 engine). Related: [[reinsurance]], [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]].
entries.body_hk: Reactor.DSL 是用於建模再保險/保險合同的領域特定語言（DSL）：把合同條款（分保結構、限額、觸發條件）表達為可計算的形式——合同數字化/機器可讀的方向。對 RIAA：保險合同形式化的前沿方向（合同即代碼）。與 [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]（合同語料）、[[openrater]]（費率文件→引擎）、[[fastcashflow]]（IFRS 17 引擎）互補。關聯 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

entries.title: Underwriting Workbench
entries.summary: 证据优先寿险核保 AI 工作台（POC）：确定性规则引擎+引用 RAG+Llama-3.2 LoRA 微调+MLflow+FastAPI
entries.body: Underwriting Workbench 是证据优先的寿险核保助手（可运行 POC）：确定性、保单感知的规则引擎 + 引用 grounded 的 RAG 流水线 + Llama-3.2-3B 的 MLX LoRA 微调 + MLflow 实验追踪 + FastAPI 评审工作台。对 RIAA：寿险核保 AI 的完整工程参考（规则+RAG+微调的组合）。与 [[underwriting-copilot]]（承保 copilot）、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]（核保 agent）、[[credibility-gated-xai]]（XAI）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：寿险核保 POC（规则引擎+引用 RAG+Llama-3.2 LoRA+MLflow+FastAPI）
entries.summary_en: Evidence-first life-insurance underwriting AI workbench (POC): deterministic rules engine + citation-grounded RAG + Llama-3.2 LoRA fine-tune + MLflow + FastAPI
entries.summary_hk: 證據優先壽險核保 AI 工作台（POC）：確定性規則引擎+引用 RAG+Llama-3.2 LoRA 微調+MLflow+FastAPI
entries.body_en: Underwriting Workbench is an evidence-first life-insurance underwriting assistant (a complete, runnable POC): a deterministic, plan-aware rules engine paired with a citation-grounded RAG pipeline, an MLX LoRA fine-tune of Llama-3.2-3B, MLflow-tracked experiments, and a FastAPI review workbench. For RIAA: a complete engineering reference for life-underwriting AI (the rules+RAG+fine-tune combination). Complements [[underwriting-copilot]] (underwriting copilot), [[agentic-bop-underwriting]] (underwriting agent) and [[credibility-gated-xai]] (XAI). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]].
entries.body_hk: Underwriting Workbench 是證據優先的壽險核保助手（可運行 POC）：確定性、保單感知的規則引擎 + 引用 grounded 的 RAG 流水線 + Llama-3.2-3B 的 MLX LoRA 微調 + MLflow 實驗追蹤 + FastAPI 評審工作台。對 RIAA：壽險核保 AI 的完整工程參考（規則+RAG+微調的組合）。與 [[underwriting-copilot]]（承保 copilot）、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]（核保 agent）、[[credibility-gated-xai]]（XAI）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

entries.summary_hk: CMS 官方 Medicare 理賠定價軟件（源碼+JAR）：原始 Medicare 理賠定價引擎
entries.body_en: Medicare Claims Pricer Source is the official CMS (US Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) release of the Original Medicare claims-pricing software: source code and executable JARs — the official implementation of the Medicare claims-pricing engine. For RIAA: an official health-insurance claims-pricing engine (open-sourced by a government agency). Complements [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]] (synthetic claims corpus), [[openimis]] (health-insurance system) and [[icd-hcc-mappings]] (code mappings). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[ait168-synthetic-medical-claims]].
entries.body_hk: Medicare Claims Pricer Source 是 CMS（美國聯邦醫療保險與醫療補助服務中心）官方發佈的 Original Medicare 理賠定價軟件：含源碼與可執行 JAR——Medicare 理賠定價（pricing）引擎的官方實現。對 RIAA：官方健康險理賠定價引擎（政府機構開源）。與 [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]（合成理賠語料）、[[openimis]]（健康險系統）、[[icd-hcc-mappings]]（編碼映射）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[ait168-synthetic-medical-claims]]。

entries.title: BasicTerm Model in Rust
entries.summary: lifelib BasicTerm 示例的 Rust 实现（hnlearndev/rslife 作者）：寿险基础模型的 Rust 移植
entries.body: Basic-Term-Model-Rust 是 hnlearndev（rslife Rust 精算库作者）把 lifelib 的 BasicTerm 示例模型移植到 Rust：定期寿险基础模型（保费/准备金/现金流）的 Rust 实现——精算建模的 Rust 侧起点（BasicTerm 是 lifelib 教学入口模型）。对 RIAA：Rust 精算建模的入门参考（与 [[lifelib]] 的 Python BasicTerm 对应）。与 [[rslife]]（Rust 寿险数学）、[[lifecontingencies-jl]]（Julia）、[[ilp-uvl-cashflow-illustration]]（现金流表）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[lifeinsurer]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：hnlearndev 把 lifelib BasicTerm 移植到 Rust（定期寿险基础模型）

entries.body_en: Basic-Term-Model-Rust is hnlearndev's (author of the rslife Rust actuarial library) port of the lifelib BasicTerm example model to Rust: the basic term-life model (premiums/reserves/cashflows) in Rust — the Rust-side starting point for actuarial modelling (BasicTerm is lifelib's teaching entry model). For RIAA: an entry reference for Rust actuarial modelling (the Rust counterpart of lifelib's Python BasicTerm). Complements [[rslife]] (Rust life math), [[lifecontingencies-jl]] (Julia) and [[ilp-uvl-cashflow-illustration]] (cashflow illustration). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[lifeinsurer]].

entries.title: Car Damage Assessment AI
entries.summary: 车损评估 AI（MIT，CI，FastAPI）：车辆损伤图像评估服务
entries.body: Car Damage Assessment AI 是车辆损伤评估 AI 服务（MIT，CI 完备，Python 3.11+，FastAPI）：对车损图像做损伤评估——理赔图片自动评估的工程实现。对 RIAA：车险理赔图像 AI 的服务化参考。与 [[databricks-car-classification]]（车型分类）、[[erm159-image-recognition]]（SOA 图像识别）、[[mongodb-insurance-image-search]]（图像检索）互补。关联 [[ins-mmbench]]（多模态基准）、[[claimpilot-harness]]。

entries.body: Typhoon Catastrophe Risk Model 是台风巨灾风险建模与巨灾金融定价项目（MIT，Python 3.13，19 个测试通过，在线交互 demo，中文文档）：台风灾害的风险评估与巨灾金融定价（风险融资）。对 RIAA：中文生态的台风巨灾建模参考（中国是台风灾害高频区）。与 [[catia]]（巨灾 AI 平台）、[[eltr]]（巨灾 ELT）、[[spatialextremes]]（空间极值）、[[cat-bond-pricer]]（巨灾债券）互补。关联 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[tailloss]]。

For RIAA: a Chinese-ecosystem reference for typhoon cat modelling (China is a high-frequency typhoon-hazard region). Complements [[catia]] (catastrophe-AI platform), [[eltr]] (cat ELT), [[spatialextremes]] (spatial extremes) and [[cat-bond-pricer]] (cat bonds). entries.title: MortalityForecast (R)
entries.summary: 死亡率预测方法评估 R 包（MortalityLaws 作者，实验期）：估计/比较/评估各类预测方法
entries.body: MortalityForecast 是 Marius Pascariu（MortalityLaws 作者）的实验性 R 包：提供标准工具估计、比较与评估各类死亡率预测方法的预测力——方法对比框架（LC/APC 等）。对 RIAA：死亡率预测方法的横向比较工具。与 [[mortalitylaws]]（参数模型+HMD）、[[demofit]]（参数拟合）、[[bamp]]（贝叶斯 APC）、[[stmomo]] 互补。关联 [[longevity]]、[[lifecontingencies]]、[[hmd-jl]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：mpascariu（MortalityLaws 作者）实验包，死亡率预测方法估计/比较/评估
entries.summary_en: Experimental R package for mortality-forecasting methods (MortalityLaws author): estimate/compare/evaluate the predictive power of forecasting methods
entries.summary_hk: 死亡率預測方法評估 R 包（MortalityLaws 作者，實驗期）：估計/比較/評估各類預測方法
entries.body_en: MortalityForecast is an experimental R package by Marius Pascariu (author of MortalityLaws): standard tools to estimate, compare and evaluate the predictive power of various mortality-forecasting methods — a method-comparison framework (LC/APC etc.). For RIAA: a horizontal comparison tool for mortality-forecasting methods. Complements [[mortalitylaws]] (parametric models + HMD), [[demofit]] (parametric fitting), [[bamp]] (Bayesian APC) and [[stmomo]]. Related: [[longevity]], [[lifecontingencies]], [[hmd-jl]].
entries.body_hk: MortalityForecast 是 Marius Pascariu（MortalityLaws 作者）的實驗性 R 包：提供標準工具估計、比較與評估各類死亡率預測方法的預測力——方法對比框架（LC/APC 等）。對 RIAA：死亡率預測方法的橫向比較工具。與 [[mortalitylaws]]（參數模型+HMD）、[[demofit]]（參數擬合）、[[bamp]]（貝葉斯 APC）、[[stmomo]] 互補。關聯 [[longevity]]、[[lifecontingencies]]、[[hmd-jl]]。

entries.title: Risk Management Ontologies (open-risk)
entries.summary: 风险管理本体序列化（BMRO 业务模型风险本体等）：风险语义的标准化
entries.body: Risk Management Ontologies 提供当前与早期版本的风险管理本体序列化（open-risk 出品）：Business Model Risk Ontology（BMRO）等——风险语义（风险类型、风险因素、控制）的标准表达。对 RIAA：风险管理的语义层标准（与精算/保险数据本体互补）。与 [[actuarial-ontology]]（精算本体）、[[fibo]]（FIBO）、[[openidl]]（数据标准）构成保险数据语义生态。关联 [[insurance-governance]]、[[capital-modeling]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：open-risk 风险管理本体序列化（BMRO 等）
entries.summary_en: Serializations of risk-management ontologies (BMRO business-model risk ontology etc.): standardisation of risk semantics
entries.summary_hk: 風險管理本體序列化（BMRO 業務模型風險本體等）：風險語義的標準化
entries.body_en: Risk Management Ontologies provides serializations of current and early versions of risk-management ontologies (by open-risk): the Business Model Risk Ontology (BMRO) and others — standard expression of risk semantics (risk types, risk factors, controls). For RIAA: the semantic-layer standard of risk management (complementing actuarial/insurance data ontologies). With [[actuarial-ontology]] (actuarial ontology), [[fibo]] (FIBO) and [[openidl]] (data standards) it forms the insurance data-semantics ecosystem. Related: [[insurance-governance]], [[capital-modeling]].

entries.title: One-Year Correlated Chain Ladder
entries.summary: Solvency II 合规的一年期相关链梯（MDPI Risks 论文代码）：准备金风险的一年期视角
entries.body: One-Year Correlated Chain Ladder 是符合 Solvency II 指引的一年期相关链梯实现（论文《A bayesian internal model for reserve risk: an extension of the Correlated Chain Ladder》发表于 MDPI Risks 8(4):125）：把相关链梯适配到一年期准备金风险视角（Solvency II 的一年期折现与风险边际）。对 RIAA：Solvency II 准备金风险的一年期方法论文代码。与 [[chainladder]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]]（一年期视角）、[[profileladder]] 互补。关联 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[solvency2rfr]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：MDPI Risks 8(4):125 论文代码，Solvency II 一年期相关链梯
entries.summary_en: Solvency II-compliant one-year correlated chain ladder (MDPI Risks paper code): the one-year view of reserve risk
entries.summary_hk: Solvency II 合規的一年期相關鏈梯（MDPI Risks 論文代碼）：準備金風險的一年期視角
entries.body_en: One-Year Correlated Chain Ladder is an implementation of the one-year correlated chain ladder compliant with Solvency II guidelines (paper 'A bayesian internal model for reserve risk: an extension of the Correlated Chain Ladder', MDPI Risks 8(4):125): adapting the correlated chain ladder to the one-year view of reserve risk (Solvency II's one-year discounting and risk margins). For RIAA: paper code for the one-year perspective of Solvency II reserve risk. Complements [[chainladder]], [[stochastic-reserving-england]] (one-year view) and [[profileladder]]. Related: [[insurance-scr-data]], [[solvency2rfr]], [[actuarial-pricing]].
entries.body_hk: One-Year Correlated Chain Ladder 是符合 Solvency II 指引的一年期相關鏈梯實現（論文《A bayesian internal model for reserve risk: an extension of the Correlated Chain Ladder》發表於 MDPI Risks 8(4):125）：把相關鏈梯適配到一年期準備金風險視角（Solvency II 的一年期折現與風險邊際）。對 RIAA：Solvency II 準備金風險的一年期方法論文代碼。與 [[chainladder]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]]（一年期視角）、[[profileladder]] 互補。關聯 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[solvency2rfr]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。

entries.title: NetworkFraud (BiRank/M2V/SAGE)
entries.summary: 保险欺诈网络分析论文代码（EAJ 2024）：BiRank/Metapath2Vec/GraphSAGE 网络学习方法
entries.body: NetworkFraud 是论文《Network Analytics for Insurance Fraud Detection - A Critical Case Study》（Deprez, Vandervorst, Verbeke, Verdonck, Baesens；European Actuarial Journal 2024，doi:10.1007/s13385-024-00384-6）的实验代码：实现论文中使用的多种网络学习方法（BiRank、Metapath2Vec、GraphSAGE 等）用于保险欺诈检测。对 RIAA：图神经网络×保险欺诈的研究实现（欺诈检测的关联分析）。与 [[insurance-reports-dnn]]（文本分类）、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、保险欺诈主题互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：EAJ 2024 论文代码（BiRank/Metapath2Vec/GraphSAGE 保险欺诈网络分析）
entries.summary_en: Paper code for network analytics in insurance fraud detection (EAJ 2024): BiRank/Metapath2Vec/GraphSAGE network-learning methods
entries.summary_hk: 保險欺詐網絡分析論文代碼（EAJ 2024）：BiRank/Metapath2Vec/GraphSAGE 網絡學習方法
entries.body_en: NetworkFraud is the experimental code of the paper 'Network Analytics for Insurance Fraud Detection — A Critical Case Study' (Deprez, Vandervorst, Verbeke, Verdonck, Baesens; European Actuarial Journal 2024, doi:10.1007/s13385-024-00384-6): implementing the various network-learning techniques used in the paper (BiRank, Metapath2Vec, GraphSAGE etc.) for insurance fraud detection. For RIAA: a research implementation of graph neural networks × insurance fraud (relational analysis for fraud detection). Complements [[insurance-reports-dnn]] (text classification) and [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]].

entries.title: Insurance Pricing Tweedie (freMTPL2)
entries.summary: 车险纯保费定价（繁体中文，freMTPL2 678,013 保单）：曝险处理/损失函数选择/验收标准
entries.body: Insurance Pricing Tweedie 用法国第三方责任车险公开数据 freMTPL2（678,013 张保单）检验定价模型的三件事：曝险处理、损失函数选择、以及『怎样才算验收通过』（排序对了不代表保费够）——繁体中文教学实现，CI 完备。对 RIAA：车险纯保费（Tweedie）定价的完整教学范例（与 Risk Atlas 三语 wiki 的繁中语境契合）。与 [[claim-frequency]]（DAV 理赔频率）、[[cplm]]（复合泊松）、[[tweedie]] 互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[casdatasets]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：freMTPL2（678,013 保单）车险纯保费定价（曝险/损失函数/验收），繁体中文，CI

entries.summary_hk: 車險純保費定價（繁體中文，freMTPL2 678,013 保單）：曝險處理/損失函數選擇/驗收標準
entries.body_en: Insurance Pricing Tweedie uses the French third-party-liability motor public dataset freMTPL2 (678,013 policies) to test three things about pricing models: exposure handling, loss-function selection, and 'what counts as acceptance' (being correctly ranked does not mean the premium is enough) — a Traditional-Chinese teaching implementation, CI-complete. For RIAA: a complete teaching example of motor pure-premium (Tweedie) pricing (fitting the trilingual Risk Atlas wiki's Traditional-Chinese context). Complements [[claim-frequency]] (DAV claim frequency), [[cplm]] (compound Poisson) and [[tweedie]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[machine-learning-pricing]], [[casdatasets]].

entries.title: AutoScan AI

entries.summary_hk: 車損分析端到端 AI 流水線（單照片檢測/分割/驗證/評分，Flask GPU 本地運行）

entries.title: Parametric Payout Assurance Standard
entries.summary: 参数险赔付保障开放标准（PPAS）：机器核验参数化气候保险是否按承诺赔付
entries.body: Parametric Payout Assurance Standard（PPAS）是开放标准：用机器核验参数化气候保险产品是否真的按承诺向承诺对象赔付——参数险的赔付透明度与问责（参数险自动赔付的『实际兑现』验证）。对 RIAA：参数险治理/赔付验证的标准参考（与 [[parametric-insurance-demo]] 的自动化理赔互补）。关联 [[insurance-governance]]、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：PPAS 开放标准（机器核验参数险按承诺赔付）
entries.summary_en: Open standard for machine-checking whether a parametric climate-insurance product actually paid what it promised (PPAS)
entries.summary_hk: 參數險賠付保障開放標準（PPAS）：機器核驗參數化氣候保險是否按承諾賠付
entries.body_en: The Parametric Payout Assurance Standard (PPAS) is an open standard for machine-checking whether a parametric climate-insurance product actually paid what it promised to the people it promised — payout transparency and accountability for parametric insurance (verifying the 'actual fulfilment' of automatic parametric payouts). For RIAA: the standard reference for parametric-insurance governance/payout verification (complementing [[parametric-insurance-demo]]'s automated claims). Related: [[insurance-governance]], [[fair-pricing-playbook]], [[actuarial-pricing]], [[reinsurance]].
entries.body_hk: Parametric Payout Assurance Standard（PPAS）是開放標準：用機器核驗參數化氣候保險產品是否真的按承諾向承諾對象賠付——參數險的賠付透明度與問責（參數險自動賠付的『實際兌現』驗證）。對 RIAA：參數險治理/賠付驗證的標準參考（與 [[parametric-insurance-demo]] 的自動化理賠互補）。關聯 [[insurance-governance]]、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]。

entries.body_en: YOLO11m Car Damage Detector is a YOLO11m-based car body-damage detector: fine-tuned on a specialised dataset to detect and classify common vehicle body damage — dents, scratches, cracks, broken lamps, shattered glass and flat tyres — built for real-world inspection workflows. For RIAA: a modern implementation of auto-claims image detection (YOLO11). Complements [[autoscan-ai]] (damage-analysis pipeline), [[car-damage-assessment-ai]] (damage assessment) and [[databricks-car-classification]] (vehicle classification). Related: [[ins-mmbench]] (multimodal benchmark), [[claimpilot-harness]].
entries.body_hk: YOLO11m Car Damage Detector 是基於 YOLO11m 的車體損傷檢測器：在專門數據集上微調，檢測與分類常見車體損傷——凹陷、劃痕、裂縫、破損車燈、碎玻璃與癟胎——面向真實世界檢驗流程。對 RIAA：車險理賠圖像檢測的現代實現（YOLO11）。與 [[autoscan-ai]]（車損分析流水線）、[[car-damage-assessment-ai]]（車損評估）、[[databricks-car-classification]]（車型分類）互補。關聯 [[ins-mmbench]]（多模態基準）、[[claimpilot-harness]]。

entries.title: OpenQuake Engine (GEM)
entries.summary: 全球地震模型（GEM）基金会开源地震灾害与风险评估引擎（447★）：地震巨灾风险计算标准工具
entries.body: OpenQuake Engine 是 GEM（Global Earthquake Model）基金会开发的开源地震灾害与风险评估引擎（447★，DOI:10.13117/openquake.engine）：通过 GEM 的数据、方法与标准提供地震灾害、风险计算与决策支持工具——地震巨灾风险建模的事实标准。对 RIAA：地震 cat 风险的标准开源引擎（巨灾建模/再保定价基础）。与 [[catia]]（巨灾 AI）、[[spatialextremes]]（空间极值）、[[eltr]]（巨灾 ELT）、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]（地震巨灾债券）互补。关联 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[tailloss]]。

entries.body_en: OpenQuake Engine is the open-source seismic hazard and risk assessment engine developed by the GEM (Global Earthquake Model) Foundation (447★, DOI:10.13117/openquake.engine): providing earthquake hazard, risk calculation and decision-support tools via GEM's data, methods and standards — the de-facto standard for earthquake catastrophe-risk modelling. For RIAA: the standard open-source engine for seismic cat risk (catastrophe modelling / reinsurance-pricing foundation). Complements [[catia]] (catastrophe AI), [[spatialextremes]] (spatial extremes), [[eltr]] (cat ELT) and [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] (earthquake cat bonds). Related: [[reinsurance]], [[actuarial-pricing]], [[tailloss]].

entries.summary: GEM 全球建筑暴露模型：全球地震/巨灾风险评估的暴露数据基础
entries.body: GEM Global Exposure Model 是全球地震模型基金会（GEM）的全球建筑暴露（exposure）模型：全球建筑存量/价值/居住的暴露数据——地震与多灾害风险评估的暴露层基础。对 RIAA：全球暴露数据的标准源（巨灾建模的『暴露』输入）。与 [[openquake-engine]]（风险引擎）、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]] 互补。关联 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[spatialextremes]]。

entries.summary_hk: GEM 全球建築暴露模型：全球地震/巨災風險評估的暴露數據基礎

entries.title: CoMoMo
entries.summary: 堆叠回归集成死亡率预测 R 包：Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/Elastic 元学习器组合 GAPC 模型
entries.body: CoMoMo（R 包，SSRN 论文《Mortality Forecasting Using Stacked Regression Ensembles》配套代码，被 The Actuary 报道）用堆叠回归集成（stacked regression ensemble）组合多个随机死亡率模型的预测：基于 [[stmomo]] 的 GAPC 模型族（LC/APC/CBD/M7/RH/PLAT），用 Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/弹性网等元学习器在交叉验证元数据上学得动态权重，再外推组合预测。对 RIAA：长寿/死亡率预测的进阶方法——组合多个模型以降低单一模型偏差；与 [[mortalityforecast]]（方法对比框架）、[[mortalitylaws]] 同属死亡率建模工具箱；关联 [[longevity]]、[[longevity-risk]]（年金/养老场景）。
entries.verified_note: raw README+SSRN 论文核实：堆叠回归集成死亡率预测（Kessy 2021, SSRN 3823511），9★ 学术背书入池
entries.summary_en: R package for mortality forecasting with stacked regression ensembles: Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/Elastic metalearners combine GAPC models
entries.summary_hk: 堆疊回歸集成死亡率預測 R 包：Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/Elastic 元學習器組合 GAPC 模型
entries.body_en: CoMoMo (R package, companion code to the SSRN paper "Mortality Forecasting Using Stacked Regression Ensembles", featured in The Actuary) combines the forecasts of several stochastic mortality models via stacked regression ensembles: starting from the GAPC family in [[stmomo]] (LC/APC/CBD/M7/RH/PLAT), Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/Elastic-net metalearners learn dynamic weights on cross-validated metadata, then extrapolate the combined forecast. For RIAA: an advanced method for longevity/mortality forecasting — combining models to reduce single-model bias; with [[mortalityforecast]] (method comparison) and [[mortalitylaws]] it forms the mortality-modelling toolbox; related: [[longevity]], [[longevity-risk]] (annuity/pension settings).
entries.body_hk: CoMoMo（R 套件，SSRN 論文《Mortality Forecasting Using Stacked Regression Ensembles》配套程式碼，獲 The Actuary 報道）以堆疊回歸集成組合多個隨機死亡率模型的預測：基於 [[stmomo]] 的 GAPC 模型族（LC/APC/CBD/M7/RH/PLAT），用 Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/彈性網等元學習器在交叉驗證元數據上學習動態權重，再外推組合預測。對 RIAA：長壽/死亡率預測的進階方法——組合多個模型以降低單一模型偏差；與 [[mortalityforecast]]（方法對比框架）、[[mortalitylaws]] 同屬死亡率建模工具箱；關聯 [[longevity]]、[[longevity-risk]]（年金/退休場景）。

entries.summary: 金融分析综合库（37★，Beta）：经济情景生成器 Xenarix + ALM + 定价，基于 QuantLib-Python
entries.body: MxDevTool（montrixdev/mxdevtool-python，Beta）是基于 [[quantlib]] 的 Python 金融分析集成开发工具：内置经济情景生成器（ESG，Xenarix 已并入子模块）、资产负债管理（ALM）、随机数生成（MersenneTwister/Sobol）与矩匹配（Moment-Matching）过程。对 RIAA：Python 侧 ESG/ALM 工具链——与 [[pyesg]]（通用 ESG）、[[esg-generator-python]]（Solvency II/IFRS 17 负债估值场景）并列；关联 [[esg]]（R 侧 Planchet 等）、[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]（Julia 侧）、[[hull-white-esg-checks]]（情景校验）。

entries.summary_hk: 金融分析綜合庫（37★，Beta）：經濟情景生成器 Xenarix + ALM + 定價，基於 QuantLib-Python
entries.body_en: MxDevTool (montrixdev/mxdevtool-python, Beta) is an integrated Python development tool for financial analysis built on [[quantlib]]: an economic scenario generator (ESG; Xenarix merged in as a submodule), asset-liability management (ALM), random number generators (MersenneTwister/Sobol) and moment-matching processes. For RIAA: a Python-side ESG/ALM toolchain — alongside [[pyesg]] (general-purpose ESG) and [[esg-generator-python]] (Solvency II / IFRS 17 liability-valuation scenarios); related: [[esg]] (R side, Planchet et al.), [[economicscenariogenerators-jl]] (Julia side) and [[hull-white-esg-checks]] (scenario validation).

entries.title: IndividualClaimsSimulator (R)
entries.summary: 个体索赔模拟器（Wüthrich 团队，SSRN 4127073 配套）：准备金研究用个体责任索赔生成器
entries.body: IndividualClaimsSimulator（actuarial-data-science 官方 R 包）是 SSRN 论文《Individual Claims Generator for Claims Reserving Studies: data simulation.R》（Wang & Wüthrich, 4127073）的配套代码：模拟个体责任索赔（个体保单层级的索赔产生与发展），用于准备金研究方法研究——检验 Mack 链梯法/个体索赔模型在模拟数据上的表现。对 RIAA：准备金研究的实验数据生成器——与 [[chainladder]]（经典准备金方法）互补；关联 [[ads-tutorials]]（同组织教程，神经网络精算实战）。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：SSRN 4127073（Wang & Wüthrich）配套个体索赔模拟 R 包，学术背书入池

entries.body_en: IndividualClaimsSimulator (official R package of the actuarial-data-science org) is the companion code to the SSRN paper "Individual Claims Generator for Claims Reserving Studies: data simulation.R" (Wang & Wüthrich, 4127073): it simulates individual liability claims (claim generation and development at individual-policy level) for claims-reserving methodology research — e.g. testing Mack chain ladder and individual claims models on simulated data. For RIAA: an experimental data generator for reserving research — complements [[chainladder]] (classical reserving); related: [[ads-tutorials]] (sister tutorials in the same org).
entries.body_hk: IndividualClaimsSimulator（actuarial-data-science 官方 R 套件）是 SSRN 論文《Individual Claims Generator for Claims Reserving Studies: data simulation.R》（Wang & Wüthrich, 4127073）的配套程式碼：模擬個體責任索償（個體保單層級的索償產生與發展），用於準備金研究方法研究——檢驗 Mack 鏈梯法/個體索償模型在模擬數據上的表現。對 RIAA：準備金研究的實驗數據生成器——與 [[chainladder]]（經典準備金方法）互補；關聯 [[ads-tutorials]]（同組織教程，神經網絡精算實戰）。

entries.title: Explainable AI in Fraud Detection
entries.summary: 金融欺诈可解释 AI 全流水线（800★）：GNN+梯度提升+自编码器，SHAP/GNNExplainer 解释+PSI 漂移
entries.body: Explainable-AI-in-Financial-Fraud-and-Anomaly-Detection（jiyuanwang-afk，800★）实现可解释欺诈/异常检测混合流水线：交易图上的图神经网络（GNN）+ 表格梯度提升（基线）+ 自编码器无监督异常评分，事后可解释性用 SHAP/置换重要性/GNNExplainer 式节点边重要性，另含总体稳定性指数（PSI）漂移追踪与 F1/PR-AUC 阈值优化，带可配置训练 CLI 与单元测试。对 RIAA：反欺诈与异常检测的可解释建模学习——与 [[networkfraud]]（保险欺诈网络分析）、[[aws-fraud-graph]]（AWS 图检测样例）、[[fraud-detection]]（概念）配套；可解释性方法与 [[insurance-conformal-fraud]] 同属可信 AI 方向。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：GNN+GBDT+AE 混合可解释欺诈流水线（SHAP/PSI/阈值优化），800★
entries.summary_en: Explainable AI pipeline for financial fraud/anomaly detection (800★): GNN + gradient boosting + autoencoder, SHAP/GNNExplainer explanations + PSI drift
entries.summary_hk: 金融欺詐可解釋 AI 全流水線（800★）：GNN+梯度提升+自編碼器，SHAP/GNNExplainer 解釋+PSI 漂移
entries.body_en: Explainable-AI-in-Financial-Fraud-and-Anomaly-Detection (jiyuanwang-afk, 800★) implements a hybrid explainable fraud/anomaly-detection pipeline: GNNs over a transaction graph, tabular gradient boosting (baseline) for calibrated probabilities, autoencoders for unsupervised anomaly scoring, post-hoc explainability via SHAP / permutation importance / GNNExplainer-style node-and-edge importance, plus population stability index (PSI) drift tracking and F1/PR-AUC threshold optimisation, with a configurable training CLI and unit tests. For RIAA: learning explainable modelling for fraud and anomaly detection — pairs with [[networkfraud]] (insurance fraud network analysis), [[aws-fraud-graph]] (AWS graph-detection sample) and [[fraud-detection]] (the concept); explainability methods align with [[insurance-conformal-fraud]] in the trustworthy-AI direction.
entries.body_hk: Explainable-AI-in-Financial-Fraud-and-Anomaly-Detection（jiyuanwang-afk，800★）實現可解釋欺詐/異常檢測混合流水線：交易圖上的圖神經網絡（GNN）+ 表格梯度提升（基線）+ 自編碼器無監督異常評分，事後可解釋性用 SHAP/置換重要性/GNNExplainer 式節點邊重要性，另含總體穩定性指數（PSI）漂移追蹤與 F1/PR-AUC 閾值優化，帶可配置訓練 CLI 與單元測試。對 RIAA：反欺詐與異常檢測的可解釋建模學習——與 [[networkfraud]]（保險欺詐網絡分析）、[[aws-fraud-graph]]（AWS 圖檢測樣例）、[[fraud-detection]]（概念）配套；可解釋性方法與 [[insurance-conformal-fraud]] 同屬可信 AI 方向。

For RIAA: a production-grade reference architecture for fraud detection with graph DB + GNN — complements [[explainable-ai-fraud]] (explainable fraud pipeline), [[networkfraud]] (insurance fraud network paper code) and [[aws-fraud-graph]] (AWS graph-detection starter); compare the production angle with [[claims-fraud-guardian]] (Microsoft claims-fraud demo).

entries.body: transitionMatrix（Open Risk，88★，Apache-2.0）是 Python 状态转移现象统计分析库：从带时间戳的历史事件数据估计转移矩阵（多种估计器）、转移矩阵运算（生成元/比较）、事件数据与转移矩阵可视化，附标准化测试数据集。典型场景：信用评级迁移、多状态系统事件日志。对 RIAA：多状态建模与信用转移分析——与 [[credit-risk]]（概念）、[[ifrs9-ecl]]（IFRS 9 减值模型）配套；多状态视角可与 [[stochastic-reserving-england]] 等随机方法对照。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：Open Risk 状态转移矩阵库（多估计器+可视化+测试数据），88★
entries.summary_en: State-transition-matrix statistical analysis library (Open Risk, 88★): credit-rating migrations / multi-state systems, multiple estimators + visualisation
entries.summary_hk: 狀態轉移矩陣統計分析庫（Open Risk，88★）：信用評級遷移/多狀態系統，多種估計器+可視化
entries.body_en: transitionMatrix (Open Risk, 88★, Apache-2.0) is a Python library for the statistical analysis of state-transition phenomena: it estimates transition matrices from timestamped historical event data (a variety of estimators), manipulates transition matrices (generators, comparisons), visualises event data and transition matrices, and ships standardised test datasets. Typical use cases: credit-rating migrations and multi-state system event logs. For RIAA: multi-state modelling and credit-transition analysis — pairs with [[credit-risk]] (the concept) and [[ifrs9-ecl]] (IFRS 9 impairment); the multi-state angle can be compared with stochastic approaches such as [[stochastic-reserving-england]].
entries.body_hk: transitionMatrix（Open Risk，88★，Apache-2.0）是 Python 狀態轉移現象統計分析庫：從帶時間戳的歷史事件數據估計轉移矩陣（多種估計器）、轉移矩陣運算（生成元/比較）、事件數據與轉移矩陣可視化，附標準化測試數據集。典型場景：信用評級遷移、多狀態系統事件日誌。對 RIAA：多狀態建模與信用轉移分析——與 [[credit-risk]]（概念）、[[ifrs9-ecl]]（IFRS 9 減值模型）配套；多狀態視角可與 [[stochastic-reserving-england]] 等隨機方法對照。

For RIAA: a reference framework for risk-model/data interoperability and standardisation — pairs with [[risk-management-ontology]] (sister ontology from the same org) and [[credit-risk]]; instructive for agent-era risk-data integration (MCP-style).

entries.body: correlationMatrix（Open Risk，14★，Apache-2.0）是 Python 相关矩阵库：从历史时间序列用多种模型估计相关矩阵、可视化、矩阵运算（压力矩阵/问题矩阵修复等），附标准化测试数据集，数学文档对接 Open Risk Manual。对 RIAA：风险因子相关性与聚合建模——Solvency II 标准公式 SCR 聚合用相关矩阵（[[ggsolvencyii]] 可视图），信用组合相关结构（[[concentrationmetrics]] 分散度配套）；与 copula 类方法衔接。

entries.body_en: correlationMatrix (Open Risk, 14★, Apache-2.0) is a Python library for correlation matrices: estimate correlation matrices from historical time series with a variety of models, visualise them, manipulate them (stress matrices, fix problematic matrices), and ship standardised test datasets; mathematical documentation links to the Open Risk Manual. For RIAA: risk-factor correlation and aggregation modelling — Solvency II standard-formula SCR aggregation uses correlation matrices (see [[ggsolvencyii]] for visualisation), and credit-portfolio dependence structures pair with [[concentrationmetrics]] (diversification); connects to copula-style approaches.
entries.body_hk: correlationMatrix（Open Risk，14★，Apache-2.0）是 Python 相關矩陣庫：從歷史時間序列用多種模型估計相關矩陣、可視化、矩陣運算（壓力矩陣/問題矩陣修復等），附標準化測試數據集，數學文檔對接 Open Risk Manual。對 RIAA：風險因子相關性與聚合建模——Solvency II 標準公式 SCR 聚合用相關矩陣（[[ggsolvencyii]] 可視圖），信用組合相關結構（[[concentrationmetrics]] 分散度配套）；與 copula 類方法銜接。

entries.title: Copulas (SDV, Python)
entries.summary: Python copula 表格合成数据库（SDV 团队）：copula 建模生成合成表格数据
entries.body: Copulas（sdv-dev/Copulas，Python 0.14.1）是 SDV 团队（合成数据领域知名团队）的 copula 建模库：用 copula 创建表格合成数据（Gaussian/Student-t/Clayton/Gumbel 等族），是合成数据生态（SDV）的基础组件。对 RIAA：基于 copula 的合成数据生成——合成理赔/保单数据用于模型开发与隐私保护场景（[[synthetic]] 概念）；与 [[copula-r]]（R 侧标准库）同族，配 [[pyvinecopulib]]（高维藤 copula）；保险合成数据应用可参考 [[ait168-synthetic-medical-claims]]。
entries.verified_note: PyPI 0.14.1 + README 核实：SDV copula 表格合成数据库

entries.summary_hk: Python copula 表格合成數據庫（SDV 團隊）：copula 建模生成合成表格數據
entries.body_en: Copulas (sdv-dev/Copulas, Python 0.14.1) is the copula-modelling library of the SDV team (well known in the synthetic-data space): it creates tabular synthetic data with copulas (Gaussian / Student-t / Clayton / Gumbel families), and is a foundation component of the SDV synthetic-data ecosystem. For RIAA: copula-based synthetic-data generation — synthetic claims/policy data for model development and privacy-preserving settings (see the [[synthetic]] concept); same family as [[copula-r]] (the R standard), paired with [[pyvinecopulib]] (high-dimensional vine copulas); insurance synthetic-data applications: see [[ait168-synthetic-medical-claims]].
entries.body_hk: Copulas（sdv-dev/Copulas，Python 0.14.1）是 SDV 團隊（合成數據領域知名團隊）的 copula 建模庫：用 copula 創建表格合成數據（Gaussian/Student-t/Clayton/Gumbel 等族），是合成數據生態（SDV）的基礎組件。對 RIAA：基於 copula 的合成數據生成——合成理賠/保單數據用於模型開發與隱私保護場景（[[synthetic]] 概念）；與 [[copula-r]]（R 側標準庫）同族，配 [[pyvinecopulib]]（高維藤 copula）；保險合成數據應用可參考 [[ait168-synthetic-medical-claims]]。

entries.title: pyvinecopulib
entries.summary: Python 藤 copula 接口（vinecopulib 官方）：高维 vine copula 建模/采样/选择
entries.body: pyvinecopulib（vinecopulib/pyvinecopulib，Python 0.7.6）是 C++ vine copula 库 vinecopulib 的官方 Python 接口：高维藤（vine）copula 的结构选择、参数估计、采样与条件抽样，性能由 C++ 后端保证。对 RIAA：高维相依建模（>2 维）的利器——多风险因子聚合、巨灾多险种组合的相依结构（[[vinecopula-r]] 的 Python 侧）；配 [[copulas-sdv]]（合成数据）与 [[extremes]]（极值）；关联 [[extreme-value-theory]]。
entries.verified_note: PyPI 0.7.6 + 项目页核实：vinecopulib 官方 Python 接口（高维 vine copula）
entries.summary_en: Python interface to vinecopulib (official): high-dimensional vine-copula modelling / sampling / selection
entries.summary_hk: Python 藤 copula 接口（vinecopulib 官方）：高維 vine copula 建模/採樣/選擇
entries.body_en: pyvinecopulib (vinecopulib/pyvinecopulib, Python 0.7.6) is the official Python interface to the C++ vine-copula library vinecopulib: high-dimensional vine-copula structure selection, parameter estimation, sampling and conditional sampling, with performance backed by the C++ core. For RIAA: the go-to tool for high-dimensional dependence modelling (beyond 2D) — dependence structures for multi-risk-factor aggregation and multi-line catastrophe portfolios (the Python side of [[vinecopula-r]]); pairs with [[copulas-sdv]] (synthetic data) and [[extremes]] (extreme values); related: [[extreme-value-theory]].
entries.body_hk: pyvinecopulib（vinecopulib/pyvinecopulib，Python 0.7.6）是 C++ 藤 copula 庫 vinecopulib 的官方 Python 接口：高維藤（vine）copula 的結構選擇、參數估計、採樣與條件抽樣，性能由 C++ 後端保證。對 RIAA：高維相依建模（>2 維）的利器——多風險因子聚合、巨災多險種組合的相依結構（[[vinecopula-r]] 的 Python 側）；配 [[copulas-sdv]]（合成數據）與 [[extremes]]（極值）；關聯 [[extreme-value-theory]]。

entries.title: pyextremes
entries.summary: Python 极值分析库（EVA）：GEV/GPD 拟合、阈值选择、重现期与可视化
entries.body: pyextremes（mhostetter/pyextremes，Python 2.5.0）是极值分析（Extreme Value Analysis, EVA）库：广义极值（GEV）与广义帕累托（GPD）分布拟合（含阈值选择）、重现期计算、年最大/峰值超阈值（POT）两种方法、诊断图与可视化。对 RIAA：保险巨灾与极端损失建模——洪水/风暴/热浪等极端事件的频率-强度-重现期（[[extreme-value-theory]] 概念、[[extremeloss]] 应用）；与 [[extremes]]（R 侧标准库）互补，R 侧见 [[copula-r]] 的极值 copula 族。
entries.verified_note: PyPI 2.5.0 + README 核实：Python EVA 库（GEV/GPD/阈值选择/重现期）
entries.summary_en: Python Extreme Value Analysis library: GEV/GPD fitting, threshold selection, return periods and visualisation
entries.summary_hk: Python 極值分析庫（EVA）：GEV/GPD 擬合、閾值選擇、重現期與可視化
entries.body_en: pyextremes (mhostetter/pyextremes, Python 2.5.0) is an Extreme Value Analysis (EVA) library: generalised extreme value (GEV) and generalised Pareto (GPD) fitting with threshold selection, return-period computation, both annual-maxima and peaks-over-threshold (POT) approaches, diagnostic plots and visualisation. For RIAA: modelling of catastrophe and extreme losses — frequency-severity-return-period analysis of floods/storms/heatwaves (concept: [[extreme-value-theory]], applications: [[extremeloss]]); complements [[extremes]] (the R standard); on the R side see the extreme-value copula families in [[copula-r]].
entries.body_hk: pyextremes（mhostetter/pyextremes，Python 2.5.0）是極值分析（Extreme Value Analysis, EVA）庫：廣義極值（GEV）與廣義帕累托（GPD）分佈擬合（含閾值選擇）、重現期計算、年最大/峰值超閾值（POT）兩種方法、診斷圖與可視化。對 RIAA：保險巨災與極端損失建模——洪水/風暴/熱浪等極端事件的頻率-強度-重現期（[[extreme-value-theory]] 概念、[[extremeloss]] 應用）；與 [[extremes]]（R 側標準庫）互補，R 側見 [[copula-r]] 的極值 copula 族。
