entries.title: LatticePolicy（开源 P&C 保单管理框架）
entries.summary: 开源 P&C 保单核保与管理框架（8★ TS，2026 活跃）：多租户 quote→核保→签发→续保全生命周期 PAS
entries.body: LatticePolicy（kishorjakkula，8★，TypeScript，2026-05 创建 09 活跃）是开源的 P&C 保单管理框架：多租户保单生命周期 API（quote 报价→核保评审→费率→bind→签发→批改→取消→复效→续保全流程）、产品包与租户配置、统一门户架构（内部运营/代理/核保/客户同框架不同视图）、PostgreSQL+Redis、Docker 部署。对 RIAA：开源 PAS（保单管理系统）的新实现——TypeScript 全栈、多租户产品化架构；与 [[titanium-insurance-core]]（保单域核心）、[[quickfire-ams]]（代理工作流）、[[faktorips]]（Java 建模平台）对照理解保险核心系统的不同技术路线（TS 现代全栈 vs Java/运行时）。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：LatticePolicy 开源 P&C PAS（多租户保单生命周期 TS 框架 8★）
entries.title_hk: LatticePolicy（開源 P&C 保單管理框架）
entries.summary_en: Open-source P&C policy underwriting & administration framework (8★ TS, active 2026): multi-tenant quote→underwrite→issue→renew life-cycle PAS
entries.summary_hk: 開源 P&C 保單核保與管理框架（8★ TS，2026 活躍）：多租戶 quote→核保→簽發→續保全生命週期 PAS
entries.body_en: LatticePolicy (kishorjakkula, 8★, TypeScript, created 2026-05, active 09) is an open-source P&C policy framework: multi-tenant policy life-cycle APIs (quote intake → underwriting review → rating → bind → issue → endorse → cancel → reinstate → renew), product packs and tenant configuration, a unified portal architecture (internal ops/agents/underwriters/customers in one framework with different views), PostgreSQL+Redis, Docker deployment. For RIAA: a new open-source PAS (policy administration system) implementation — TypeScript full-stack, multi-tenant productized architecture; contrasts [[titanium-insurance-core]] (policy domain core), [[quickfire-ams]] (agency workflows) and [[faktorips]] (Java modelling platform) to see different technology routes for insurance core systems (modern TS full-stack vs Java/runtime).
entries.body_hk: LatticePolicy（kishorjakkula，8★，TypeScript，2026-05 創建 09 活躍）是開源的 P&C 保單管理框架：多租戶保單生命週期 API（quote 報價→核保評審→費率→bind→簽發→批改→取消→復效→續保全流程）、產品包與租戶配置、統一門戶架構、PostgreSQL+Redis、Docker 部署。對 RIAA：開源 PAS 的新實現——TypeScript 全棧、多租戶產品化架構；與 [[titanium-insurance-core]]（保單域核心）、[[quickfire-ams]]（代理工作流）、[[faktorips]]（Java 建模平台）對照理解保險核心系統的不同技術路線。

entries.title: xaci（精算气候指数 R 包）
entries.title_hk: xaci（精算氣候指數 R 包）
entries.summary: 全球精算气候指数 ACI（CRAN 0.1.0，2026-09 新发）：气温/降水/干旱/风/海平面五分量
entries.summary_en: Global Actuarial Climate Index (CRAN 0.1.0, released 2026-09): five components — temperature, precipitation, drought, wind, sea level
entries.summary_hk: 全球精算氣候指數 ACI（CRAN 0.1.0，2026-09 新發）：氣溫/降水/乾旱/風/海平面五分量
entries.body: xaci（CRAN 0.1.0，2026-09-09 发布，MIT）把「精算气候指数」（Actuarial Climate Index, ACI）做成可复现的 R 包：从网格化气候数据（NetCDF）与验潮站记录计算 ACI 及其五个分量——气温、降水、干旱、风、海平面。方法取自 Garrido, Milhaud & Olympio (2025)，沿用美国精算师学会（American Academy of Actuaries）框架并**扩展到任意国家**（依赖 ncdf4 / terra / sf / geodata，作者 Xavier Milhaud 等，ISFA Lyon）。与 [[riaci]]（伊比利亚 IACI，北大西洋与地中海口径）是**不同作者、不同区域口径**的两条路线：riaci 偏伊比利亚，xaci 走全球通用框架。对 RIAA：气候风险「指数化」的标准做法——把非平稳气候信号压缩成可入模的指标，是 [[extreme-value-theory]] 之外描述气候尾部趋势的另一条路径，可直接喂给 [[catmodeling]] 一类巨灾定价/资本模型；适合气候风险、巨灾与 ESG 交叉方向。
entries.body_en: xaci (CRAN 0.1.0, released 2026-09-09, MIT) packages the Actuarial Climate Index (ACI) as reproducible R code: it computes the ACI and its five components — temperature, precipitation, drought, wind and sea level — from gridded climate data (NetCDF) and tide gauge records. The methodology follows Garrido, Milhaud & Olympio (2025), building on the American Academy of Actuaries framework and **extending it to any country** (depends on ncdf4 / terra / sf / geodata; authors incl. Xavier Milhaud, ISFA Lyon). It is a distinct route from [[riaci]] (Iberian IACI, North Atlantic/Mediterranean scope): riaci is Iberia-specific, xaci is a global framework. For RIAA: the standard way to index climate risk — compressing a non-stationary climate signal into model-ready indicators, an alternative to [[extreme-value-theory]] for describing climate tail trends, feeding directly into catastrophe pricing/capital models such as [[catmodeling]]; suits climate risk, catastrophe and ESG crossover work.
entries.body_hk: xaci（CRAN 0.1.0，2026-09-09 發布，MIT）把「精算氣候指數」（Actuarial Climate Index, ACI）做成可複現的 R 包：從網格化氣候數據（NetCDF）與驗潮站記錄計算 ACI 及其五個分量——氣溫、降水、乾旱、風、海平面。方法取自 Garrido, Milhaud & Olympio (2025)，沿用美國精算師學會框架並**擴展到任意國家**（依賴 ncdf4 / terra / sf / geodata；作者含 Xavier Milhaud，ISFA Lyon）。與 [[riaci]]（伊比利亞 IACI）是不同作者、不同區域口徑的兩條路線。對 RIAA：氣候風險「指數化」的標準做法——把非平穩氣候信號壓縮成可入模指標，是 [[extreme-value-theory]] 之外描述氣候尾部趨勢的另一條路徑，可直接餵給 [[catmodeling]] 一類巨災定價/資本模型；適合氣候風險、巨災與 ESG 交叉方向。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页面核实（v0.1.0，2026-09-09 发布，MIT，作者 Xavier Milhaud 等；GitHub 仓库 2026-09-10 仍有推送），未实测

entries.title: OpenL Tablets（Excel 决策表 BRMS）
entries.summary: 开源 BRMS 6.4.0（205★）：Excel 决策表编译为 REST API，官方定位保险费率与核保
entries.summary_en: Open-source BRMS 6.4.0 (205★): Excel decision tables compiled to REST APIs; positioned for insurance rating and underwriting
entries.summary_hk: 開源 BRMS 6.4.0（205★）：Excel 決策表編譯為 REST API，官方定位保險費率與核保
entries.body: OpenL Tablets（GitHub 205★ / 52 fork，LGPL-3.0，Java 21+，6.4.0 于 2026-08-19 发布）是开源业务规则管理系统（BRMS）：业务分析师直接在 **Excel 决策表**里写费率/核保规则，框架把表格编译成原生 Java 字节码并自动暴露为 REST 服务，带版本管理与审计轨迹；README 明确把「保险公司计算保费与核保政策」列为首要场景，并支持通过 **MCP 协议**接入 Claude / ChatGPT——即「规则引擎被 Agent 调用」的现成形态。与池内规则族对照：[[drools]]（Apache KIE，DRL 规则语言，偏开发者）、[[illogical]]（Briza 的轻量声明式规则语言）、[[morphir]]（FINOS 业务逻辑中间表示）、[[insurax]] 和 [[underwriting-workbench]]（核保工作台）。对 RIAA：理解「费率和核保规则在真实保险公司里如何工程化落地」的最完整开源样本，也是 Agent 与传统精算系统对接的参考。
entries.body_en: OpenL Tablets (GitHub 205★ / 52 forks, LGPL-3.0, Java 21+, release 6.4.0 on 2026-08-19) is an open-source Business Rules Management System (BRMS): business analysts author rating and underwriting rules directly in **Excel decision tables**, and the framework compiles those tables to native Java bytecode exposed automatically as REST services, with versioning and audit trails. Its README names "insurance companies calculating premiums and underwriting policies" as the first target scenario, and it supports integrating Claude/ChatGPT over the **MCP protocol** — a ready-made shape for an agent-callable rules engine. Compare with the pool rules family: [[drools]] (Apache KIE, DRL, developer-facing), [[illogical]] (Briza lightweight declarative rules), [[morphir]] (FINOS business-logic IR), [[insurax]] and [[underwriting-workbench]]. For RIAA: the most complete open-source sample of how rating/underwriting rules are actually engineered in a real insurer, and a reference for wiring agents into legacy actuarial systems.
entries.body_hk: OpenL Tablets（GitHub 205★ / 52 fork，LGPL-3.0，Java 21+，6.4.0 於 2026-08-19 發布）是開源業務規則管理系統（BRMS）：業務分析師直接在 **Excel 決策表**撰寫費率/核保規則，框架把表格編譯成原生 Java 位元碼並自動暴露為 REST 服務，附版本管理與審計軌跡；README 明確把「保險公司計算保費與核保政策」列為首要場景，並支援透過 **MCP 協議**接入 Claude / ChatGPT——即「規則引擎被 Agent 調用」的現成形態。與池內規則族對照：[[drools]]、[[illogical]]、[[morphir]]、[[insurax]] 與 [[underwriting-workbench]]。對 RIAA：理解費率與核保規則如何在真實保險公司工程化落地的最完整開源樣本。
entries.verified_note: GitHub 官方仓库核实（205★/52 fork/LGPL-3.0/6.4.0 于 2026-08-19 发布/README 明示保险费率与核保场景及 MCP 支持），未部署实测

entries.title: survPen
entries.summary: 多维惩罚样条（超额）风险模型与相对死亡率比（CRAN 2.0.5）
entries.summary_en: Multidimensional penalized splines for (excess) hazard and relative mortality ratio models (CRAN 2.0.5)
entries.summary_hk: 多維懲罰樣條（超額）風險模型與相對死亡率比（CRAN 2.0.5）
entries.body: survPen（CRAN 2.0.5，2026-06-09 更新）用多维惩罚回归样条拟合（超额）风险模型、**相对死亡率比模型**与复发事件的边际强度模型：可同时处理时变效应、非线性效应与多个连续协变量之间的交互，并且因为显式推导似然导数而**又快又稳**；关键在于它把「期望死亡率」内建进模型，直接输出净生存（net survival）与超额风险估计。作者为 Mathieu Fauvernier 等，方法见 Fauvernier et al. (2019a, JOSS；2019b, JRSS-C)。对 RIAA：寿险/健康险「相对死亡率」建模的标准开源实现——与 [[lifelines]]、[[scikit-survival]]、[[pycox]] 构成生存分析工具矩阵（后三者偏通用/机器学习，survPen 偏超额风险与人群对照）；可与 [[actxps]]（经验研究）、[[stmomo]] 与 [[hmdhfdplus]]（死亡率数据与随机死亡率模型）、[[mortsoa]] 串成完整链路；适合寿险定价、长寿风险与健康险方向。
entries.body_en: survPen (CRAN 2.0.5, updated 2026-06-09) fits (excess) hazard models, **relative mortality ratio** models and marginal intensity models for recurrent events using multidimensional penalized regression splines: it handles time-dependent effects, non-linear effects and interactions among several continuous covariates at once, and is fast and stable thanks to explicit computation of likelihood derivatives. Crucially it builds expected mortality into the model, returning net survival and excess hazard estimates directly. Authors: Mathieu Fauvernier et al.; see Fauvernier et al. (2019a, JOSS; 2019b, JRSS-C). For RIAA: the standard open-source implementation of relative-mortality modelling for life/health insurance — together with [[lifelines]], [[scikit-survival]] and [[pycox]] it forms a survival-analysis toolkit (the latter three are general/ML-oriented, survPen is excess-risk and population-reference oriented); it chains with [[actxps]] (experience studies), [[stmomo]] and [[hmdhfdplus]] (mortality data and stochastic mortality models) and [[mortsoa]]; suits life pricing, longevity risk and health insurance.
entries.body_hk: survPen（CRAN 2.0.5，2026-06-09 更新）用多維懲罰回歸樣條擬合（超額）風險模型、**相對死亡率比模型**與復發事件的邊際強度模型：可同時處理時變效應、非線性效應與多個連續協變量之間的交互，且因顯式推導似然導數而**又快又穩**；關鍵在於把「期望死亡率」內建進模型，直接輸出淨生存與超額風險估計。作者為 Mathieu Fauvernier 等。對 RIAA：壽險/健康險「相對死亡率」建模的標準開源實現——與 [[lifelines]]、[[scikit-survival]]、[[pycox]] 構成生存分析工具矩陣；可與 [[actxps]]、[[stmomo]]、[[hmdhfdplus]]、[[mortsoa]] 串成完整鏈路；適合壽險定價、長壽風險與健康險方向。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页面核实（v2.0.5，2026-06-09 发布；Fauvernier et al. 2019 方法论文），未实测

entries.title: evgam
entries.summary: GAM 形式的极值模型（CRAN 1.0.2，2026-09 更新）：参数随协变量平滑变化
entries.summary_en: Generalised additive extreme value models (CRAN 1.0.2, updated 2026-09): parameters varying smoothly with covariates
entries.summary_hk: GAM 形式的極值模型（CRAN 1.0.2，2026-09 更新）：參數隨協變量平滑變化
entries.body: evgam（CRAN 1.0.2，2026-09-03 更新；作者 Ben Youngman）把极值分布的参数写成**广义可加模型（GAM）形式**：GEV/GPD 的位置、尺度、形状参数可以是协变量的平滑函数，底层借 mgcv 的惩罚项与 Rcpp/RcppArmadillo 的拟合算法（Wood, Pya & Safken 2016；方法详见 Youngman 2022, JSS 103(3)）。对 RIAA：巨灾建模里最常见的现实是「强度随海拔、区域、时间平滑变化」——evgam 正好补上 [[extremes]]（经典 EVT 拟合）与 [[extreme-value-theory]]（理论）之间缺的那块：**带协变量的尾部回归**，可直接产出随区域/年份变化的重现期水平，供 [[catmodeling]] 一类巨灾定价与资本模型使用；适合巨灾、气候与空间风险方向。
entries.body_en: evgam (CRAN 1.0.2, updated 2026-09-03; author Ben Youngman) writes the parameters of extreme value distributions in **generalised additive model (GAM) form**: the location, scale and shape parameters of GEV/GPD models can be smooth functions of covariates, using mgcv penalties and Rcpp/RcppArmadillo fitting (Wood, Pya & Safken 2016; see Youngman 2022, JSS 103(3)). For RIAA: the everyday reality in catastrophe modelling is that severity varies smoothly with elevation, region and time — evgam fills the gap between [[extremes]] (classical EVT fitting) and [[extreme-value-theory]] (theory) with **covariate-aware tail regression**, producing return levels that vary by region and year for catastrophe pricing and capital models such as [[catmodeling]]; suits catastrophe, climate and spatial risk work.
entries.body_hk: evgam（CRAN 1.0.2，2026-09-03 更新；作者 Ben Youngman）把極值分布的參數寫成**廣義可加模型（GAM）形式**：GEV/GPD 的位置、尺度、形狀參數可以是協變量的平滑函數，底層借 mgcv 的懲罰項與 Rcpp/RcppArmadillo 的擬合算法（Youngman 2022, JSS 103(3)）。對 RIAA：巨災建模裡最常見的現實是「強度隨海拔、區域、時間平滑變化」——evgam 正好補上 [[extremes]] 與 [[extreme-value-theory]] 之間缺的那塊：**帶協變量的尾部回歸**，可直接產出隨區域/年份變化的重現期水平，供 [[catmodeling]] 一類巨災定價與資本模型使用；適合巨災、氣候與空間風險方向。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页面核实（v1.0.2，2026-09-03 发布，作者 Ben Youngman），未实测

entries.title: GLmom
entries.summary: 广义 L-矩 GEV 估计（CRAN 2.0.1，2026-07）：非平稳 GEV11 + 模型平均高分量
entries.summary_en: Generalized L-moments GEV estimation (CRAN 2.0.1, 2026-07): non-stationary GEV11 plus model-averaged high quantiles
entries.summary_hk: 廣義 L-矩 GEV 估計（CRAN 2.0.1，2026-07）：非平穩 GEV11 + 模型平均高分量
entries.body: GLmom（CRAN 2.0.1，2026-07-25 发布）实现广义 L-矩（GLME）方法估计广义极值分布：既支持平稳 GEV，也支持**非平稳 GEV11**（位置与尺度随时间变化），内置 Martins-Stedinger、Park、Cannon、Coles-Dixon 等多种形状参数惩罚函数以抑制小样本下的形状参数失控，并提供模型平均 `ma.gev`——把极大似然与 L-矩估计按不同权重方案组合，得到更稳健的高分量（high quantile）估计。方法见 Shin et al. (2025a/b, 2026)。对 RIAA：L-矩是洪水频率分析的传统标准，而「非平稳 + 小样本 + 高分量稳健性」正是巨灾与气候风险的三大痛点——GLmom 是 [[extremes]] 之外更偏**重现期与高分量稳健估计**的路线，与 [[evgam]]（带协变量平滑）互补，输出可直接进 [[catmodeling]] 与 [[extreme-value-theory]] 框架；适合巨灾定价、资本建模与极端事件方向。
entries.body_en: GLmom (CRAN 2.0.1, released 2026-07-25) implements generalized L-moment estimation (GLME) for the generalized extreme value distribution: stationary GEV and **non-stationary GEV11** (location and scale varying with time), with several shape-parameter penalty functions (Martins-Stedinger, Park, Cannon, Coles-Dixon) to keep the shape parameter under control in small samples, plus model averaging (`ma.gev`) that combines MLE and L-moment estimates under multiple weighting schemes for more robust high-quantile estimation. Methods: Shin et al. (2025a/b, 2026). For RIAA: L-moments are the traditional standard in flood frequency analysis, and "non-stationary + small sample + robust high quantiles" are exactly the three pain points of catastrophe and climate risk — GLmom is a route toward **robust return-period and high-quantile estimation** alongside [[extremes]], complementary to [[evgam]] (covariate smoothing), with output feeding [[catmodeling]] and the [[extreme-value-theory]] framework; suits catastrophe pricing, capital modelling and extreme-event work.
entries.body_hk: GLmom（CRAN 2.0.1，2026-07-25 發布）實現廣義 L-矩（GLME）方法估計廣義極值分布：既支援平穩 GEV，也支援**非平穩 GEV11**（位置與尺度隨時間變化），內建 Martins-Stedinger、Park、Cannon、Coles-Dixon 等多種形狀參數懲罰函數以抑制小樣本下的形狀參數失控，並提供模型平均 `ma.gev`——把極大似然與 L-矩估計按不同權重方案組合，得到更穩健的高分量估計。方法見 Shin et al. (2025a/b, 2026)。對 RIAA：L-矩是洪水頻率分析的傳統標準，而「非平穩 + 小樣本 + 高分量穩健性」正是巨災與氣候風險的三大痛點——GLmom 是 [[extremes]] 之外更偏**重現期與高分量穩健估計**的路線，與 [[evgam]] 互補，輸出可直接進 [[catmodeling]] 與 [[extreme-value-theory]] 框架；適合巨災定價、資本建模與極端事件方向。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页面核实（v2.0.1，2026-07-25 发布，Shin et al. 方法论文），未实测

entries.title: DCL（双链梯法准备金）
entries.summary: 双链梯（Double Chain Ladder）准备金 R 包（CRAN 0.1.2）：方法作者原版实现
entries.summary_en: Double Chain Ladder claims reserving in R (CRAN 0.1.2): the method authors’ own implementation
entries.summary_hk: 雙鏈梯（Double Chain Ladder）準備金 R 包（CRAN 0.1.2）：方法作者原版實現
entries.body: DCL（CRAN 0.1.2）是非寿险**双链梯法（Double Chain Ladder）**准备金的官方实现，作者就是方法提出者本人——Martinez-Miranda、Nielsen 与 Verrall（2012）。DCL 把已发生（incurred）与已付（paid）三角形拆成「报案数三角形 × 案均赔付」两条链，从而在**不需要先验损失率**的情况下分离出报告延迟与结算延迟，比传统链梯法多一层可解释性，也天然产出案均赔付与准备金分布。对 RIAA：产险准备金族里方法学分量最重的一支，与 [[chainladder-python]]（Python Mack/GLM/BF/ODP 全家族）、[[chainladder]]（R 上的 Mack 与 GLM）、[[faslr]]（CAS 开源准备金系统）、[[apc-r]]（年龄-期间-队列模型）、[[resurv]]（索赔次数的机器学习预测）互为参照；DCL 是 CAS/IFoA 考试与准备金论文的高频方法，适合准备金与偿付能力方向。
entries.body_en: DCL (CRAN 0.1.2) is the official implementation of non-life **Double Chain Ladder** reserving, authored by the method’s own proposers — Martinez-Miranda, Nielsen and Verrall (2012). DCL splits the incurred and paid triangles into "reported counts triangle × average severity", separating reporting delay from settlement delay **without needing a prior loss ratio**, adding a layer of interpretability over classical chain ladder and naturally producing average severities and reserve distributions. For RIAA: the most methodologically substantial branch of the non-life reserving family, to be read against [[chainladder-python]] (full Python Mack/GLM/BF/ODP suite), [[chainladder]] (Mack and GLM in R), [[faslr]] (CAS open-source reserving system), [[apc-r]] (age-period-cohort models) and [[resurv]] (ML prediction of claim counts); DCL is a frequent topic in CAS/IFoA exams and reserving papers; suits reserving and solvency work.
entries.body_hk: DCL（CRAN 0.1.2）是非壽險**雙鏈梯法（Double Chain Ladder）**準備金的官方實現，作者就是方法提出者本人——Martinez-Miranda、Nielsen 與 Verrall（2012）。DCL 把已發生與已付三角形拆成「報案數三角形 × 案均賠付」兩條鏈，從而在**不需要先驗損失率**的情況下分離出報告延遲與結算延遲，比傳統鏈梯法多一層可解釋性。對 RIAA：產險準備金族裡方法學分量最重的一支，與 [[chainladder-python]]、[[chainladder]]、[[faslr]]、[[apc-r]]、[[resurv]] 互為參照；DCL 是 CAS/IFoA 考試與準備金論文的高頻方法，適合準備金與償付能力方向。

entries.title: excessmort
entries.summary: 超额死亡率统计框架（CRAN 0.8.2）：周/日计数数据的弹性基线
entries.summary_en: Excess mortality framework (CRAN 0.8.2): flexible baselines for weekly/daily count data
entries.summary_hk: 超額死亡率統計框架（CRAN 0.8.2）：週/日計數數據的彈性基線
entries.body: excessmort（CRAN 0.8.2）实现 Acosta & Irizarry (2021) 的超额死亡率框架：用周/日粒度的死亡计数与弹性基线模型（含季节性与长期趋势）估计「超出预期」的死亡，并给出置信区间与可视化；作者团队来自哈佛（Rafael A. Irizarry 等），是公共卫生领域估计疫情与热浪超额死亡的主流开源实现。对 RIAA：寿险与健康险的**死亡率经验监控**正好需要这套方法——它不是建模死亡率曲线，而是判断「某段时期的死亡是否异常」，因此与 [[stmomo]]（随机死亡率建模）、[[hmdhfdplus]]（HMD/HFD 数据接口）、[[mortsoa]]（SOA 死亡率表）、[[actxps]]（经验研究）形成互补：先判异常、再建模型。也可服务长寿风险、巨灾死亡（ Mortality CAT bond ）与 ESG 健康风险方向。
entries.body_en: excessmort (CRAN 0.8.2) implements the excess mortality framework of Acosta & Irizarry (2021): using weekly/daily death counts and a flexible baseline model (with seasonality and long-term trend) it estimates deaths above expectation, with confidence intervals and visualisation. The author team is from Harvard (Rafael A. Irizarry et al.) and it is the mainstream open-source implementation for estimating pandemic and heat-wave excess mortality in public health. For RIAA: life and health insurers’ **mortality experience monitoring** needs exactly this — it does not model a mortality curve, it judges whether deaths in a period are anomalous, complementing [[stmomo]] (stochastic mortality modelling), [[hmdhfdplus]] (HMD/HFD data access), [[mortsoa]] (SOA mortality tables) and [[actxps]] (experience studies): detect the anomaly first, then model. Also serves longevity risk, mortality catastrophe bonds and ESG health-risk work.
entries.body_hk: excessmort（CRAN 0.8.2）實現 Acosta & Irizarry (2021) 的超額死亡率框架：用週/日粒度的死亡計數與彈性基線模型（含季節性與長期趨勢）估計「超出預期」的死亡，並給出置信區間與可視化；作者團隊來自哈佛（Rafael A. Irizarry 等），是公共衛生領域估計疫情與熱浪超額死亡的主流開源實現。對 RIAA：壽險與健康險的**死亡率經驗監控**正好需要這套方法——它不是建模死亡率曲線，而是判斷「某段時期的死亡是否異常」，因此與 [[stmomo]]、[[hmdhfdplus]]、[[mortsoa]]、[[actxps]] 形成互補：先判異常、再建模型。亦可服務長壽風險、巨災死亡（mortality CAT bond）與 ESG 健康風險方向。

entries.title: mcmodule
entries.summary: 模块化蒙特卡洛风险分析（CRAN 1.3.1，2026-09 新发）：多路径/多情景 + 敏感性
entries.summary_en: Modular Monte Carlo risk analysis (CRAN 1.3.1, new in 2026-09): multiple pathways/scenarios plus sensitivity
entries.summary_hk: 模組化蒙特卡洛風險分析（CRAN 1.3.1，2026-09 新發）：多路徑/多情景 + 敏感性
entries.body: mcmodule（CRAN 1.3.1，2026-09-02 发布）在经典 Monte Carlo 包 mc2d 之上提供**模块化**风险分析框架：把风险模型拆成独立模块（多个风险路径、变量与情景），支持对齐多元 mcnode、自动生成节点、可视化模型结构、收敛诊断与敏感性分析（可接 sensitivity / sensobol 做全局敏感性）。作者 Natalia Ciria（2026）。对 RIAA：保险风险量化（如 ORSA 内部模型、承保与投资风险聚合）本质上就是「多风险路径 + 相关结构 + 情景」的蒙特卡洛问题，mcmodule 提供了比裸 mc2d 更贴近工程实践的组织方式；与 [[aggregate-python]]（聚合损失分布）、[[monte-carlo]]（方法）、[[riskfolio-lib]]（组合优化）、[[qarm]]（Solvency II 组合优化器）搭配使用；适合风险建模、资本与内部模型方向。
entries.body_en: mcmodule (CRAN 1.3.1, released 2026-09-02) adds a **modular** risk-analysis framework on top of the classical Monte Carlo package mc2d: risk models are split into independent modules (multiple risk pathways, variates and scenarios), with aligned multivariate mcnodes, automated node creation, model-structure visualisation, convergence diagnostics and sensitivity analysis (pluggable with sensitivity / sensobol for global sensitivity). Author: Natalia Ciria (2026). For RIAA: insurance risk quantification (ORSA internal models, aggregation of underwriting and investment risk) is fundamentally a Monte Carlo problem of "multiple risk pathways + dependence structure + scenarios", and mcmodule offers a more engineering-friendly organisation than bare mc2d; pairs with [[aggregate-python]] (aggregate loss distributions), [[monte-carlo]] (method), [[riskfolio-lib]] (portfolio optimisation) and [[qarm]] (Solvency II portfolio optimiser); suits risk modelling, capital and internal-model work.
entries.body_hk: mcmodule（CRAN 1.3.1，2026-09-02 發布）在經典 Monte Carlo 包 mc2d 之上提供**模組化**風險分析框架：把風險模型拆成獨立模組（多個風險路徑、變量與情景），支援對齊多元 mcnode、自動生成節點、可視化模型結構、收斂診斷與敏感性分析（可接 sensitivity / sensobol 做全局敏感性）。作者 Natalia Ciria（2026）。對 RIAA：保險風險量化（如 ORSA 內部模型、承保與投資風險聚合）本質上就是「多風險路徑 + 相關結構 + 情景」的蒙特卡洛問題；與 [[aggregate-python]]、[[monte-carlo]]、[[riskfolio-lib]]、[[qarm]] 搭配使用；適合風險建模、資本與內部模型方向。

entries.title: ClaimsProblems（冲突索赔分配规则）
entries.summary: 冲突索赔分配规则集（CRAN）：比例/CEA/CEL/Talmud 等清算分配 + 图示
entries.summary_en: Conflicting-claims allocation rules (CRAN): proportional/CEA/CEL/Talmud and more, with diagrams
entries.summary_hk: 衝突索賠分配規則集（CRAN）：比例/CEA/CEL/Talmud 等清算分配 + 圖示
entries.body: ClaimsProblems（CRAN）解决的是「可分配金额小于索赔总额时如何分」这一经典问题：当一组索赔人的请求总额超过可用资产，规则（rule）决定分配方案。包内实现了文献中从古至今的主要规则——比例规则与调整比例规则、约束均等分配（CEA）与约束均等损失（CEL）、约束平均主义、Piniles 规则、最小重叠规则、随机到达规则、**Talmud 规则**，以及 Dominguez-Thomson 规则与平均分配规则，并提供分配集合、分配路径与规则日程的图形化。理论见 Thomson (2019)《How to divide when there isn’t enough》。对 RIAA：这是**保险清算与索赔优先级**的形式化工具箱——保险公司破产清算、相互/共保池资金不足、再保摊回不足、共保与分摊条款下的索赔切分，本质都是同一类问题；与 [[insurance-recourse]]（代位追偿）、[[insurance-credibility]] 等业务概念形成「规则/制度 ↔ 方法」的对照；适合保险法商、清算与再保险方向。
entries.body_en: ClaimsProblems (CRAN) addresses the classic question of how to divide an available amount that is smaller than the total claims: when a group of claimants asks for more than is available, a "rule" selects a division. The package implements the main rules from the literature, ancient to modern — proportional and adjusted proportional rules, constrained equal awards (CEA) and constrained equal losses (CEL), constrained egalitarian, Piniles’ rule, minimal overlap, random arrival, the **Talmud rule**, plus the Dominguez-Thomson and average-of-awards rules — with graphical diagrams of the set of awards, award paths and rule schedules. Theory: Thomson (2019), "How to divide when there isn’t enough". For RIAA: a formal toolkit for **insurance liquidation and claim priority** — insurer insolvency, shortfalls in mutual/pool arrangements, insufficient reinsurance recoverables and claim splitting under coinsurance/contribution clauses are all the same problem class; it pairs with business concepts such as [[insurance-recourse]] (subrogation) as "institution ↔ method"; suits insurance legal/commercial, run-off and reinsurance work.
entries.body_hk: ClaimsProblems（CRAN）解決「可分配金額小於索賠總額時如何分」這一經典問題：當一組索賠人的請求總額超過可用資產，規則（rule）決定分配方案。包內實現了文獻中從古至今的主要規則——比例規則與調整比例規則、約束均等分配（CEA）與約束均等損失（CEL）、約束平均主義、Piniles 規則、最小重疊規則、隨機到達規則、**Talmud 規則**，以及 Dominguez-Thomson 規則與平均分配規則，並提供分配集合、分配路徑與規則日程的圖形化。理論見 Thomson (2019)《How to divide when there isn’t enough》。對 RIAA：這是**保險清算與索賠優先級**的形式化工具箱——保險公司破產清算、相互/共保池資金不足、再保攤回不足、共保與分攤條款下的索賠切分，本質都是同一類問題；與 [[insurance-recourse]]（代位追償）等業務概念形成「規則/制度 ↔ 方法」的對照；適合保險法商、清算與再保險方向。

entries.title: ibnr（概率准备金 Python 包）
entries.title_hk: ibnr（概率準備金 Python 包）
entries.summary: 画廊式概率准备金（PyPI 0.5.9，2026-09 活跃迭代）：贝叶斯 MCMC + 神经网络 + 强制评测
entries.summary_en: Gallery-centric probabilistic loss reserving (PyPI 0.5.9, actively developed 2026-09): Bayesian MCMC plus neural networks, mandatory evaluation
entries.summary_hk: 畫廊式概率準備金（PyPI 0.5.9，2026-09 活躍迭代）：貝葉斯 MCMC + 神經網絡 + 強制評測
entries.body: ibnr（PyPI 0.5.9，2026-09-07 发布；自 2026-07-23 起已迭代 13 个版本）把「画廊式（gallery-centric）概率准备金」做成一等公民：贝叶斯 MCMC（PyMC / NumPyro / cmdstanpy / ArviZ）与神经网络准备金方法并列成画廊，配套**强制评测**与模型堆叠，底层是长表（long-format）三角形数据层——通过 ibis 一次编写、同时跑 duckdb 与 polars 两个后端，并提供 `as_of()` 回溯切片做严格 backtesting。作者明确写明它是 [[chainladder-python]] 的**伴生包而非 fork**：三角形可与 chainladder 无损互转，并在 raa / clrd 公共样本上对得上；另通过 [interop] extra 与 [[bermuda-ledger]] 互通。对 RIAA：准备金族里少见的把「多方法并列 + 强制回测 + 模型堆叠」一起工程化的开源实现——与 [[dcl]]（方法学原版实现）、[[reservingmodels]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]]（随机准备金）、[[resurv]]（索赔次数机器学习）、[[bayesian-pricing]] 互为参照；作者自标状态为 Early development（0.5.x），生产使用需自行评估。适合准备金、模型风险与贝叶斯方法方向。
entries.body_en: ibnr (PyPI 0.5.9, released 2026-09-07; 13 releases since 2026-07-23) treats "gallery-centric probabilistic reserving" as a first-class idea: Bayesian MCMC methods (PyMC / NumPyro / cmdstanpy / ArviZ) and neural-network reserving methods sit side by side in a gallery, with **mandatory evaluation** and model stacking, over a long-format triangle data layer — written once in ibis and run against both the duckdb and polars backends, with `as_of()` backtesting slices for strict evaluation. The author states explicitly that it is a **companion to [[chainladder-python]], not a fork**: triangles round-trip losslessly and tie out on the public raa/clrd samples, and an [interop] extra connects it to [[bermuda-ledger]]. For RIAA: a rare open-source implementation that engineers "many methods side by side + mandatory backtesting + model stacking" in one place — read against [[dcl]] (the method authors’ own implementation), [[reservingmodels]], [[stochastic-reserving-england]] (stochastic reserving), [[resurv]] (ML for claim counts) and [[bayesian-pricing]]; the project labels itself Early development (0.5.x), so production use needs its own assessment. Suits reserving, model risk and Bayesian methods.
entries.body_hk: ibnr（PyPI 0.5.9，2026-09-07 發布；自 2026-07-23 起已迭代 13 個版本）把「畫廊式（gallery-centric）概率準備金」做成一等公民：貝葉斯 MCMC（PyMC / NumPyro / cmdstanpy / ArviZ）與神經網絡準備金方法並列成畫廊，配套**強制評測**與模型堆疊，底層是長表三角形數據層——透過 ibis 一次編寫、同時跑 duckdb 與 polars 兩個後端，並提供 `as_of()` 回溯切片做嚴格 backtesting。作者明確寫明它是 [[chainladder-python]] 的**伴生包而非 fork**：三角形可與 chainladder 無損互轉，並在 raa / clrd 公共樣本上對得上；另透過 [interop] extra 與 [[bermuda-ledger]] 互通。對 RIAA：準備金族裡少見的把「多方法並列 + 強制回測 + 模型堆疊」一起工程化的開源實現——與 [[dcl]]、[[reservingmodels]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]]、[[resurv]]、[[bayesian-pricing]] 互為參照；作者自標狀態 Early development（0.5.x）。適合準備金、模型風險與貝葉斯方法方向。

entries.title: tidyextreme（气候极端指数工具箱）
entries.summary: ETCCDI 气候极端指数（CRAN 1.0.0）：日/小时气温降水数据 → tidy 工作流
entries.summary_en: ETCCDI climate extreme indices (CRAN 1.0.0): from daily/hourly temperature and precipitation data, in a tidy workflow
entries.summary_hk: ETCCDI 氣候極端指數（CRAN 1.0.0）：日/小時氣溫降水數據 → tidy 工作流
entries.body: tidyextreme（CRAN 1.0.0，2026-02-04，MIT）实现 ETCCDI（Expert Team on Climate Change Detection and Indices）气候极端指数体系：从日/小时粒度的气温与降水数据算出一整套**标准化极端指标**，并走 tidyverse 数据处理范式（dplyr / lubridate / zoo / data.table）。对 RIAA：气候风险「可入模化」的第一步就是把原始气象序列翻译成有精算含义的极端指标——ETCCDI 指数正是 [[xaci]]（精算气候指数 ACI）与 [[riaci]] 这类指数化框架的**原料层**，也是 [[catmodeling]]、[[climada]] 与 [[dfa-climate-datasets]] 的上游数据加工环节；与 [[ml-flood]]、[[ml-drought]]（ECMWF 洪涝/干旱模型）配合，可把「气象 → 指数 → 损失」串成完整链条；适合气候风险、巨灾与 ESG 方向。
entries.body_en: tidyextreme (CRAN 1.0.0, released 2026-02-04, MIT) implements the ETCCDI (Expert Team on Climate Change Detection and Indices) family of climate extreme indices: it derives a full set of **standardised extreme indices** from daily or hourly temperature and precipitation data, following a tidyverse workflow (dplyr / lubridate / zoo / data.table). For RIAA: the first step in making climate risk model-ready is translating raw meteorological series into extreme indicators with actuarial meaning — ETCCDI indices are the **raw-material layer** beneath index frameworks such as [[xaci]] (Actuarial Climate Index) and [[riaci]], and an upstream processing step for [[catmodeling]], [[climada]] and [[dfa-climate-datasets]]; combined with [[ml-flood]] and [[ml-drought]] (ECMWF flood/drought models) it completes the chain "weather → index → loss"; suits climate risk, catastrophe and ESG work.
entries.body_hk: tidyextreme（CRAN 1.0.0，2026-02-04，MIT）實現 ETCCDI（Expert Team on Climate Change Detection and Indices）氣候極端指數體系：從日/小時粒度的氣溫與降水數據算出一整套**標準化極端指標**，並走 tidyverse 數據處理範式（dplyr / lubridate / zoo / data.table）。對 RIAA：氣候風險「可入模化」的第一步就是把原始氣象序列翻譯成有精算含義的極端指標——ETCCDI 指數正是 [[xaci]] 與 [[riaci]] 這類指數化框架的**原料層**，也是 [[catmodeling]]、[[climada]] 與 [[dfa-climate-datasets]] 的上游加工環節；與 [[ml-flood]]、[[ml-drought]] 配合可把「氣象 → 指數 → 損失」串成完整鏈條；適合氣候風險、巨災與 ESG 方向。

entries.title: ExtremeStats.jl
entries.summary: Julia 极值统计（47★，JuliaEarth）：带空间结构口径的极值建模
entries.summary_en: Extreme value statistics in Julia (47★, JuliaEarth): extreme modelling with spatial structure
entries.summary_hk: Julia 極值統計（47★，JuliaEarth）：帶空間結構口徑的極值建模
entries.body: ExtremeStats.jl（GitHub 47★ / 6 fork，MIT，JuliaEarth 出品，2026-06 仍有推送）是 Julia 生态里的极值统计分析包。它隶属 JuliaEarth（GeoStats.jl 空间统计体系），特色因此很明确：**空间与地质统计口径的极值建模**——把 [[extremes]]（经典 EVT）那套单点尾部拟合，延伸到存在空间相关结构的场景。对 RIAA：巨灾风险的损失强度几乎总是空间相关的（台风路径、洪水流域、地震带），而这恰恰是 R/Python 主流 EVT 包普遍较弱的一环；可作为 [[spatialrisk]]、[[extremrisks]] 与 [[catmodeling]] 的 Julia 侧补充，与 [[extreme-value-theory]] 的理论框架配套；适合巨灾、空间风险与 Julia 技术栈方向。
entries.body_en: ExtremeStats.jl (GitHub 47★ / 6 forks, MIT, by JuliaEarth, still pushed in 2026-06) is the extreme value statistics package in the Julia ecosystem. It belongs to JuliaEarth (the GeoStats.jl spatial statistics family), so its emphasis is clear: **extreme value modelling with spatial and geostatistical structure** — extending the single-site tail fitting of [[extremes]] (classical EVT) to settings where spatial dependence matters. For RIAA: catastrophe loss severity is almost always spatially dependent (typhoon tracks, flood basins, seismic zones), which is precisely where mainstream R/Python EVT packages are weak; it complements [[spatialrisk]], [[extremrisks]] and [[catmodeling]] on the Julia side and pairs with the theoretical framework of [[extreme-value-theory]]; suits catastrophe, spatial risk and Julia-stack work.
entries.body_hk: ExtremeStats.jl（GitHub 47★ / 6 fork，MIT，JuliaEarth 出品，2026-06 仍有推送）是 Julia 生態裡的極值統計分析包。它隸屬 JuliaEarth（GeoStats.jl 空間統計體系），特色因此很明確：**空間與地質統計口徑的極值建模**——把 [[extremes]]（經典 EVT）那套單點尾部擬合，延伸到存在空間相關結構的場景。對 RIAA：巨災風險的損失強度幾乎總是空間相關的（颱風路徑、洪水流域、地震帶），而這恰恰是 R/Python 主流 EVT 包普遍較弱的一環；可作為 [[spatialrisk]]、[[extremrisks]] 與 [[catmodeling]] 的 Julia 側補充，與 [[extreme-value-theory]] 的理論框架配套；適合巨災、空間風險與 Julia 技術棧方向。

entries.summary: 风险导向组合构建（CRAN 2.1.8，2026-08 更新）：ERC/风险预算等 Ardia 等原版实现
entries.summary_en: Risk-based portfolio construction (CRAN 2.1.8, updated 2026-08): ERC, risk budgeting and more, by Ardia et al.

entries.body: RiskPortfolios（CRAN 2.1.8，2026-08-21 更新；作者 David Ardia、Kris Boudt、Jean-Philippe Gagnon-Fleury）实现**风险导向（risk-based）组合构建**方法族：等风险贡献（ERC）、风险预算、最小方差等，用 quadprog 做凸优化、nloptr 做非线性求解。方法出自 Ardia et al. (2017, Annals of Operations Research) 与 JOSS 短文，是这一支文献的**作者原版实现**。对 RIAA：保险公司资产端的标准开源工具——与 [[riskfolio-lib]]（Python 侧同类实现，功能更宽）和 [[qarm]]（Solvency II 组合优化器）互补；组合构建完成后的集中度与相关性诊断可接 [[concentrationmetrics]] 与 [[correlationmatrix]]；偿付能力资本的市场风险模块、ALM 与风险预算讨论都常用这套视角；适合投资风险、ALM 与偿付能力方向。
entries.body_en: RiskPortfolios (CRAN 2.1.8, updated 2026-08-21; authors David Ardia, Kris Boudt, Jean-Philippe Gagnon-Fleury) implements the **risk-based portfolio construction** family: equal risk contribution (ERC), risk budgeting, minimum variance and more, using quadprog for convex optimisation and nloptr for nonlinear solving. The methods come from Ardia et al. (2017, Annals of Operations Research) and a JOSS paper — this is the **authors’ own implementation** of that literature. For RIAA: a standard open-source tool on the insurance asset side — complementary to [[riskfolio-lib]] (the broader Python counterpart) and [[qarm]] (Solvency II portfolio optimiser); post-construction concentration and correlation diagnostics connect to [[concentrationmetrics]] and [[correlationmatrix]]; market-risk modules of solvency capital, ALM and risk-budgeting discussions all draw on this perspective; suits investment risk, ALM and solvency work.

(2017, Annals of Operations Research) 與 JOSS 短文，是這一支文獻的**作者原版實現**。對 RIAA：保險公司資產端的標準開源工具——與 [[riskfolio-lib]]（Python 側同類實現，功能更寬）和 [[qarm]]（Solvency II 組合優化器）互補；組合構建完成後的集中度與相關性診斷可接 [[concentrationmetrics]] 與 [[correlationmatrix]]；償付能力資本的市場風險模組、ALM 與風險預算討論都常用這套視角；適合投資風險、ALM 與償付能力方向。

entries.body: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts（MIT，TypeScript，2026-08-18 建仓 / 2026-09-04 更新）把三个保险领域专家 agent 封装成 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**并发布到 npm——与本 wiki 所用运行时同源，可直接加载试用：① `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-company-analyst`（v1.0.1）：保险公司财务经营分析，做利润表/资产负债表结构拆解、偿付能力充足率与风险评级跟踪、投资端资产配置与减值、渠道分析与同业对标；② `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-ops-analyst`（v1.0.1）：经营分析（代号「盈安」），五维测算——核心/综合偿付能力充足率、盈利能力、内含价值（EV）、投资风险、监管合规；③ `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-product-analyst`（v1.8.4，2026-09-10）：产品分析与建议书（代号「险析君」），覆盖条款解读、性价比、产品横向对比、储蓄险选型、高客传承、核保敏感处理与建议书生成。三个包共用同一 monorepo，故合并为一条词条。对 RIAA：这是「保险实务专家知识如何被封装成可运行 agent」的中文样本——偿付能力、EV、财务结构这些正是精算与公司经营方向的核心议题；与本 wiki 的 [[deepseek-harness]]、[[dsh-plugin-toolkit]]（插件开发工具包）同栈，可与 [[aria-actuarial-agent]]（精算编码 Agent）、[[insurance-agentic-medical]] 等对照阅读；做经营分析时数据侧可接 [[nfra-statistics]] 与 [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]。注意：仓库星标为 0（新项目，仅两个仓库），价值判断基于其已发布包与方法论披露，而非采用度。
entries.body_en: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts (MIT, TypeScript, created 2026-08-18 / updated 2026-09-04) packages three insurance domain expert agents as **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins** and publishes them to npm — the same runtime this wiki runs on, so they can be loaded and tried directly: (1) `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-company-analyst` (v1.0.1): insurer financial and operating analysis — profit & loss / balance-sheet structure breakdown, solvency ratio and risk-rating tracking, asset-side allocation and impairments, channel analysis and peer benchmarking; (2) `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-ops-analyst` (v1.0.1): operations analyst (codenamed "Ying’an") with five-dimension calculation — core/comprehensive solvency ratios, profitability, embedded value (EV), investment risk and regulatory compliance; (3) `@kevinsales/dsh-insurance-product-analyst` (v1.8.4, 2026-09-10): product and proposal expert ("InsureGuide") covering clause analysis, value-for-money, product comparison, savings-product selection, HNW succession, underwriting-sensitive handling and proposal generation. The three packages share one monorepo, so they are recorded as a single entry. For RIAA: a Chinese-language sample of how insurance practice expertise is packaged into runnable agents — solvency, EV and financial structure are exactly the core topics of actuarial and company-operations work; it is on the same stack as [[deepseek-harness]] and [[dsh-plugin-toolkit]] (the plugin development toolkit) and can be read against [[aria-actuarial-agent]] (actuarial coding agent) and [[insurance-agentic-medical]]; for operational analysis the data side connects to [[nfra-statistics]] and [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]. Note: the repository has 0 stars (new project, only two repos) — the judgement rests on its published packages and disclosed methodology, not on adoption.

entries.body: ESHM20-MCP（sreenathvemula，Python，2026-05 建仓 / 2026-08-03 更新）把欧洲地震危险模型 ESHM20 与欧洲地震风险模型 ESRM20 封装成 **24 个可调用的 MCP 工具**，底层由 `openquake.hazardlib` 驱动：覆盖概率地震危险分析（PSHA）、一致危险谱（UHS）、条件均值谱（CMS）、易损性/脆弱性、破坏评估、**年均损失（AAL）**，并支持从 ESM 强震数据库做条件谱选波，以及按构造区类型（TRT）传入**用户自定义地震动模型（GMM）**覆盖 ESHM20 默认逻辑树。输入可用自然语言参数（城市名、EC8 场地类别、建筑类型），输出为结构化 JSON，可直接用于结构设计、**保险定价**或应急规划；同一套 24 工具同时服务 MCP 客户端（Claude Code / Desktop、VS Code、Codex）与一个 Streamlit 网页前端。配套论文为 Vemula, Gatti, Jehel & Cotton (2026)，已见 DOI 10.1038/s44304-026-00262-z（npj Natural Hazards）。对 RIAA：这是「巨灾模型引擎 agent 化」目前最完整的公开样本——把原本只有专家能跑的 OpenQuake 管线（[[openquake-engine]]）变成 agent 可调用的工具集，直接产出 [[catmodeling]] 所需的危险曲线、易损性与 AAL；与监管数据 MCP [[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[apra-mcp]] 属于同一「开放引擎 + MCP」范式；区域模型可与 [[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]] 对照；地震参数化产品设计参考 [[parametric-insurance-demo]] 与 [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]；适合巨灾、地震风险与参数化保险方向。注意星标仅 3（新项目），价值判断基于其学术论文与工程完整度。
entries.body_en: ESHM20-MCP (sreenathvemula, Python, created 2026-05 / updated 2026-08-03) wraps the European Seismic Hazard Model 2020 (ESHM20) and European Seismic Risk Model 2020 (ESRM20) as **24 callable MCP tools** backed by `openquake.hazardlib`: probabilistic seismic hazard analysis (PSHA), uniform hazard spectra (UHS), conditional mean spectra (CMS), fragility/vulnerability, damage assessment and **average annual loss (AAL)**, plus conditional-spectrum ground-motion record selection from the Engineering Strong-Motion (ESM) database and user-supplied **custom ground-motion models (GMMs) per tectonic region type** that override the ESHM20 default logic tree. Inputs accept natural-language parameters (city name, EC8 site class, building type) and outputs are structured JSON ready for structural design, **insurance pricing** or emergency planning; the same 24 tools serve MCP clients (Claude Code / Desktop, VS Code, Codex) and a Streamlit web front-end. The companion paper is Vemula, Gatti, Jehel & Cotton (2026), with DOI 10.1038/s44304-026-00262-z (npj Natural Hazards). For RIAA: the most complete public sample of "catastrophe-model engine as agent" — turning the OpenQuake pipeline that only experts could run ([[openquake-engine]]) into an agent-callable toolset that directly produces the hazard curves, vulnerability and AAL that [[catmodeling]] needs; it belongs to the same "open engine + MCP" pattern as the regulatory-data MCPs [[fema-nfhl-mcp]] and [[apra-mcp]]; the regional model can be read against [[canada-seismic-risk-model]] and [[gem-global-exposure-model]]; for parametric product design see [[parametric-insurance-demo]] and [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]; suits catastrophe, seismic risk and parametric insurance work. Note: only 3 stars (new project) — the judgement rests on its paper and engineering completeness.
entries.body_hk: ESHM20-MCP（sreenathvemula，Python，2026-05 建倉 / 2026-08-03 更新）把歐洲地震危險模型 ESHM20 與歐洲地震風險模型 ESRM20 封裝成 **24 個可調用的 MCP 工具**，底層由 `openquake.hazardlib` 驅動：覆蓋概率地震危險分析（PSHA）、一致危險譜（UHS）、條件均值譜（CMS）、易損性/脆弱性、破壞評估、**年均損失（AAL）**，並支援從 ESM 強震數據庫做條件譜選波，以及按構造區類型（TRT）傳入**用戶自訂地震動模型（GMM）**覆蓋 ESHM20 預設邏輯樹。輸入可用自然語言參數（城市名、EC8 場地類別、建築類型），輸出為結構化 JSON，可直接用於結構設計、**保險定價**或應急規劃。配套論文為 Vemula, Gatti, Jehel & Cotton (2026)，DOI 10.1038/s44304-026-00262-z（npj Natural Hazards）。對 RIAA：這是「巨災模型引擎 agent 化」目前最完整的公開樣本——把原本只有專家能跑的 OpenQuake 管線（[[openquake-engine]]）變成 agent 可調用的工具集，直接產出 [[catmodeling]] 所需的危險曲線、易損性與 AAL；與監管數據 MCP [[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[apra-mcp]] 屬同一「開放引擎 + MCP」範式；區域模型可與 [[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]] 對照；地震參數化產品設計參考 [[parametric-insurance-demo]] 與 [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]；適合巨災、地震風險與參數化保險方向。注意星標僅 3（新項目）。

entries.body: 《Scaling Laws, Tabular Data and Actuarial Ratemaking Models》（arXiv 2609.03106，2026-09-02）研究一个精算生最常问的问题：深度学习里的**缩放律（scaling law）**——留出损失随模型容量、数据量与算力增加而按幂律改善——在**表格型、异质、含噪**的精算费率厘定数据上是否同样成立？作者在一个**真实车险组合**上训练多个模型，与仍属强基线的经典 GLM 对比。对 RIAA：这是「神经网络到底能不能打败 GLM」这一争论的近期实证证据，价值在于它把问题从「谁更强」改写为「**在什么数据规模与容量下**谁更强」；阅读时可与 [[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[glm]]（经典基线）、[[tabpfn-insurance]]（表格基础模型用于保险）、[[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定价路线）、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]] 对照，并与 [[frmtpl-scaling-laws]]（巨灾风险的缩放律研究）形成「定价端 vs 巨灾端」的缩放律对照；[[ins-actbench]] 则从 LLM 能力评测角度覆盖精算任务。注意：预印本，**未发现配套代码仓库**，结论以文中数字为准。
entries.body_en: "Scaling Laws, Tabular Data and Actuarial Ratemaking Models" (arXiv 2609.03106, 2026-09-02) investigates a question actuarial students ask constantly: do the **scaling laws** of deep learning — held-out loss improving as a power law with model capacity, data and compute — also hold on the **tabular, heterogeneous and noisy** data of actuarial ratemaking? The authors train multiple models on a **real-world motor insurance portfolio** and compare against classical GLMs, which remain strong baselines. For RIAA: recent empirical evidence in the "can neural nets beat GLMs" debate, valuable because it reframes the question from "which is stronger" to "**at what data scale and capacity** is each stronger"; read it against [[insurance-glm-tools]] and [[glm]] (classical baselines), [[tabpfn-insurance]] (tabular foundation models for insurance), [[machine-learning-pricing]] (the ML pricing route) and [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]], and set it against [[frmtpl-scaling-laws]] (scaling laws in catastrophe risk) as a "pricing side vs catastrophe side" contrast; [[ins-actbench]] covers actuarial tasks from the LLM-capability angle. Note: preprint, with **no accompanying code repository found** — treat the conclusions as those reported in the paper.
entries.body_hk: 《Scaling Laws, Tabular Data and Actuarial Ratemaking Models》（arXiv 2609.03106，2026-09-02）研究一個精算生最常問的問題：深度學習裡的**縮放律（scaling law）**——留出損失隨模型容量、數據量與算力增加而按冪律改善——在**表格型、異質、含噪**的精算費率釐定數據上是否同樣成立？作者在一個**真實車險組合**上訓練多個模型，與仍屬強基線的經典 GLM 對比。對 RIAA：這是「神經網絡到底能不能打敗 GLM」這一爭論的近期實證證據，價值在於它把問題從「誰更強」改寫為「**在什麼數據規模與容量下**誰更強」；閱讀時可與 [[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[glm]]、[[tabpfn-insurance]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]] 對照，並與 [[frmtpl-scaling-laws]]（巨災風險的縮放律研究）形成「定價端 vs 巨災端」的對照；[[ins-actbench]] 則從 LLM 能力評測角度覆蓋精算任務。注意：預印本，**未發現配套代碼倉庫**。

entries.body: XihongActuary/alm-kb（「执两用中 · 精算师手记系列」，静态站点，2026-08-22）是**保险公司资产负债管理（ALM）的中文长文知识库**：正文 13 篇独立长文，每篇 27–82KB——序章、执两、时间、利率、现金、变局、瘦身、守底、双向、利器、筑基、终章，外加一篇《正式版新规解读》；结构化模块 10 个，覆盖 foundations（基础）、framework（框架）、regulation（监管）、calculations（计算）、practice（实务）、resources（资源），并单列 regulation-draft / regulation-final / rule4 / rule5 四份规则文本。对 RIAA：ALM 是寿险经营与精算的核心交叉领域，而**中文体系化的 ALM 材料相对稀缺**——这份知识库把久期/凸性/免疫（[[duration]]、[[convexity]]、[[immunization]]）、收益率曲线（[[yield-curve]]）与保险公司负债特性、监管资本约束串在一起讲；可与 [[eaa-alm-ai-web-session]]（EAA 的 ALM+AI 讲座）、[[solvency2rfr]]（EIOPA 无风险利率期限结构）、[[qarm]]（Solvency II 组合优化）、[[open-source-economic-model]]（开源经济情景生成）互为中英/理论实务的对照；适合作 ALM、投资风险与偿付能力方向的入门到进阶阅读。注意：仓库未声明许可证，站点为静态 HTML；与同作者的 [[product-actuary-kb]] 同属「精算师手记系列」。
entries.body_en: XihongActuary/alm-kb ("holding both ends", the Actuary’s Notes series; a static site, 2026-08-22) is a **Chinese-language long-form knowledge base on insurer asset-liability management (ALM)**: 13 standalone essays of 27–82KB each (preface, dual balance, time, interest rates, cash, regime change, slimming, defending the floor, two-way, toolkit, foundations, finale) plus an interpretation of the final version of the new rules; 10 structured modules cover foundations, framework, regulation, calculations, practice and resources, with regulation-draft / regulation-final / rule4 / rule5 texts broken out. For RIAA: ALM sits at the core intersection of life insurance management and actuarial work, yet **systematic Chinese-language ALM material is relatively scarce** — this knowledge base ties duration/convexity/immunisation ([[duration]], [[convexity]], [[immunization]]) and the yield curve ([[yield-curve]]) to insurer liability characteristics and regulatory capital constraints; read it against [[eaa-alm-ai-web-session]] (the EAA ALM + AI session), [[solvency2rfr]] (EIOPA risk-free rate term structures), [[qarm]] (Solvency II portfolio optimisation) and [[open-source-economic-model]] (open-source ESG) for a Chinese-vs-English, theory-vs-practice contrast; suited to introductory through advanced reading in ALM, investment risk and solvency. Note: no licence declared, static HTML; shares the "Actuary’s Notes" series with the same author’s [[product-actuary-kb]].
entries.body_hk: XihongActuary/alm-kb（「執兩用中 · 精算師手記系列」，靜態站點，2026-08-22）是**保險公司資產負債管理（ALM）的中文長文知識庫**：正文 13 篇獨立長文，每篇 27–82KB——序章、執兩、時間、利率、現金、變局、瘦身、守底、雙向、利器、築基、終章，外加一篇《正式版新規解讀》；結構化模組 10 個，覆蓋 foundations、framework、regulation、calculations、practice、resources，並單列 regulation-draft / regulation-final / rule4 / rule5。對 RIAA：ALM 是壽險經營與精算的核心交叉領域，而**中文體系化的 ALM 材料相對稀缺**——這份知識庫把久期/凸性/免疫（[[duration]]、[[convexity]]、[[immunization]]）、收益率曲線（[[yield-curve]]）與保險公司負債特性、監管資本約束串在一起講；可與 [[eaa-alm-ai-web-session]]、[[solvency2rfr]]、[[qarm]]、[[open-source-economic-model]] 互為中英/理論實務的對照；適合作 ALM、投資風險與償付能力方向的閱讀。注意：倉庫未聲明許可證，站點為靜態 HTML；與同作者的 [[product-actuary-kb]] 同屬「精算師手記系列」。

entries.body_en: XihongActuary/product-actuary-kb-detailed ("Xihong Actuary", a static site, created 2026-08-27 / updated 08-29) is a **Chinese-language knowledge base for life-insurance product actuarial work**, with a dozen independent pages: product types (baoxing.html), calculators (calculators.html), cases (cases.html), coverage formulas (cov-formula.html), family allocation (family.html, 50KB), and a **quartet of formula pages** — cash value (formula-cv.html), value of reserves/NBV (formula-nbv.html), pricing (formula-pricing.html) and reserves (formula-reserve.html) — plus a practice handbook (handbook.html), navigator (navigator.html, 10KB), negative list (negative-list.html, 33KB) and occurrence rates (occurrence.html, 56KB). The same author’s product-actuary-kb is a working copy of the same content, so both are recorded as one entry. For RIAA: a **Chinese-language index of life product actuarial formulas and practice** — cash value, NBV, pricing and reserves are exactly the four core calculations of actuarial exams and product development; compare with [[gn16]] (Hong Kong dividend realisation disclosure) to see how mainland and Hong Kong regulation differ on dividends and illustrations; it pairs with [[insurance-actuarial-cn]] and [[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]] (Chinese actuarial pricing), [[lifecontingencies]] and [[lifecontingencies-jl]] (life-contingency maths), [[mortality-table]], [[actuarial-present-value]] and [[level-premium]] as formulas-vs-tools references; suited to Chinese-language reference work in product actuarial, life pricing and reserving. Note: no licence declared; shares the "Actuary’s Notes" series with the same author’s [[alm-kb]].

entries.body: Agrisky AI（穹野智保，XvHaoR/Agrisky-AI-Open，Apache-2.0，2026-08-15 建仓 / 2026-09-03 更新）是**开源的农业保险查勘、定损与理赔协同 Agent 工作台**，也是目前看到的「保险 Agent 治理」做得最完整的中文样本之一。核心设计：① **合规知识与合同闭环**——内置农业保险法规、保险法、农业法及条款费率文本并规范化为可引用语料，保单版本绑定并冻结保险合同 SHA-256 摘要，合同责任/保险期间/作物/生育期系数/赔付规则共同约束案件；② **可执行 Agent**——模型通过 **20 项白名单工具**读取案件、检索法规与合同、核验材料、调度遥感分析、测算赔付、生成带来源引用的报告草稿；③ **确定性定损**——面积、受灾比例、减产率、赔付金额与风险等级由服务端空间引擎、遥感分析与**版本化规则引擎**计算，模型只负责理解意图与编排工具，**不得直接改写关键数值**；④ **多源遥感证据链**——Sentinel-1 SAR、Sentinel-2 NDVI 与植被指标，支持卫星初筛、当前长势、历史季度趋势与分地块分析，证据与计算过程写入案件审计链路；⑤ **人工审核门禁**——Agent 最多推进到 `REPORT_DRAFTED`，需具名管理员审核后才能进入 `ARCHIVED`；⑥ **可追溯交付**——报告/评估表/审计回执保留合同、法规、规则版本、技术指标与产物 SHA-256。工程上含 Docker/Caddy 编排、前后端分离、pytest 配置与演示视频。对 RIAA：这是「**模型提建议、人类做决定、全程可审计**」这一治理范式在保险场景的完整落地，与本 wiki 关注的 AI 治理主线直接呼应；农险是中国保费体量大且高度依赖查勘定损的险种，agent 化的价值点（遥感 + 规则 + 审计）非常典型；可对照 [[ins-mmbench]]（保险多模态基准）、[[evidence-review-claims]]（图像证据理赔裁决）、[[claims-triage-mcp]]（理赔分诊 MCP）、[[suture-vlm]]（核保 VLM）来看不同环节的 agent 化；遥感证据侧与 [[ml-drought]]、[[gdacs]] 等公开风险数据源属同一技术栈。注意：星标为 0（新项目），价值判断基于其工程完整度与治理设计。
entries.body_en: Agrisky AI (XvHaoR/Agrisky-AI-Open, Apache-2.0, created 2026-08-15 / updated 2026-09-03) is an **open-source agent workbench for agricultural insurance survey, loss assessment and claims collaboration**, and one of the most complete Chinese-language samples of insurance agent governance found so far. Its design: (1) **compliance-knowledge and contract closure** — agricultural insurance regulations, insurance law, agricultural law and clause/rate texts are normalised into a citable corpus; the policy version is bound to a frozen SHA-256 digest of the contract, and liability, cover period, crop, growth-stage coefficients and payout rules jointly constrain the case; (2) **an executable agent** — the model uses **20 whitelisted tools** to read cases, retrieve regulations and contracts, verify materials, dispatch remote-sensing analysis, compute payouts and draft reports with source citations; (3) **deterministic loss assessment** — area, affected ratio, yield-reduction rate, payout and risk grade are computed by a server-side spatial engine, remote-sensing analysis and a **versioned rules engine**; the model only interprets intent and orchestrates tools and **may not rewrite key numbers**; (4) **a multi-source remote-sensing evidence chain** — Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 NDVI and vegetation indices support satellite screening, current growth, historical seasonal trends and per-plot analysis, with evidence and computation written into the case audit trail; (5) **a human review gate** — the agent can advance a case only to `REPORT_DRAFTED`; a named administrator must approve before `ARCHIVED`; (6) **traceable delivery** — reports, assessment tables and audit receipts retain contract, regulation, rule version, technical indicators and artefact SHA-256 hashes. Engineering includes Docker/Caddy orchestration, a separated front end and back end, pytest configuration and a demo video. For RIAA: a full implementation of "**the model advises, humans decide, and everything is auditable**" in an insurance setting, directly echoing this wiki’s AI-governance thread; agricultural insurance is a large Chinese line whose economics depend heavily on survey and loss assessment, so the agentic value points (remote sensing + rules + audit) are archetypal; compare with [[ins-mmbench]] (insurance multimodal benchmark), [[evidence-review-claims]] (image-evidence claims adjudication), [[claims-triage-mcp]] (claims triage MCP) and [[suture-vlm]] (underwriting VLM) to see agentification at different stages; on the remote-sensing side it shares a stack with public risk sources such as [[ml-drought]] and [[gdacs]]. Note: 0 stars (new project) — the judgement rests on engineering completeness and governance design.
entries.body_hk: Agrisky AI（穹野智保，XvHaoR/Agrisky-AI-Open，Apache-2.0，2026-08-15 建倉 / 2026-09-03 更新）是**開源的農業保險查勘、定損與理賠協同 Agent 工作台**，也是目前所見「保險 Agent 治理」做得最完整的中文樣本之一。核心設計：① **合規知識與合同閉環**——內置農業保險法規、保險法、農業法及條款費率文本並規範化為可引用語料，保單版本綁定並凍結合約 SHA-256 摘要；② **可執行 Agent**——模型透過 **20 項白名單工具**讀取案件、檢索法規與合同、核驗材料、調度遙感分析、測算賠付、生成帶來源引用的報告草稿；③ **確定性定損**——面積、受災比例、減產率、賠付金額與風險等級由服務端空間引擎、遙感分析與**版本化規則引擎**計算，模型只負責理解意圖與編排工具，**不得直接改寫關鍵數值**；④ **多源遙感證據鏈**——Sentinel-1 SAR、Sentinel-2 NDVI 與植被指標；⑤ **人工審核門禁**——Agent 最多推進到 `REPORT_DRAFTED`，需具名管理員審核後才能進入 `ARCHIVED`；⑥ **可追溯交付**——保留合約、法規、規則版本與產物 SHA-256。對 RIAA：這是「**模型提建議、人類做決定、全程可審計**」這一治理範式在保險場景的完整落地；可對照 [[ins-mmbench]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[suture-vlm]] 來看不同環節的 agent 化；遙感證據側與 [[ml-drought]]、[[gdacs]] 屬同一技術棧。注意：星標為 0（新項目）。

entries.body: Wooz08/study-webpages（2026-09-09）是一个**中文保险考试刷题站点**，两个独立板块：① **偿付能力监管规则**——按偿二代二期（C-ROSS II）**20 份监管规则**组织的 **840 题**题库，题目结构含 rule_no（规则编号）、rule_title（如「实际资本」）、qtype、题干、选项、答案、**解析**（明确引用规则条文，如「第四条规定，实际资本等于认可资产减去认可负债后的余额」）、difficulty 与 type 标注；② **财务管理**——同结构的另一套题库（数据量约 450KB）。两套均为纯静态页面（index + app.js + data.js），可直接本地打开离线刷题。对 RIAA：偿二代是中国偿付能力监管的核心框架，也是中文保险考试（精算师、核保核赔、公司财务）的高频考点，而**按监管规则逐条组织的题库**能直接把「规则文本 → 考点 → 解析」串起来；可与 [[solvency2rfr]]（Solvency II 无风险利率期限结构，欧式对照）、[[eaa-alm-ai-web-session]]、[[qarm]] 一起建立「中/欧偿付能力体系」的对照认知；备考侧与 [[iiqe-1]]（香港保险中介考试）、[[ashk-examination]]、[[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[ruc-nonlife-actuarial]]、[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]] 形成内地+香港的备考资源组合。注意：仓库未声明许可证，星标为 0；题库为自动生成，答案与解析以监管规则原文为准，使用前建议抽查核对。
entries.body_en: Wooz08/study-webpages (2026-09-09) is a **Chinese-language insurance exam quiz site** with two independent sections: (1) **solvency regulatory rules** — a **840-question** bank organised by the **20 regulatory rules of C-ROSS II** (China’s second-generation solvency regime), where each item carries rule_no, rule_title (e.g. "actual capital"), qtype, question, options, answer, an **explanation** that cites the rule text explicitly (e.g. "Article 4: actual capital equals admitted assets minus admitted liabilities"), plus difficulty and type tags; (2) **financial management** — a second bank with the same structure (roughly 450KB of data). Both are purely static pages (index + app.js + data.js) that can be opened locally for offline practice. For RIAA: C-ROSS is the core Chinese solvency framework and a frequent topic in Chinese insurance exams (actuarial, underwriting/claims, corporate finance), and a bank **organised rule by rule** ties together "regulation text → exam point → explanation" directly; read it alongside [[solvency2rfr]] (Solvency II risk-free rate term structures, the European counterpart), [[eaa-alm-ai-web-session]] and [[qarm]] to build a China-vs-Europe solvency contrast; on the exam-prep side it combines with [[iiqe-1]] (Hong Kong insurance intermediary exam), [[ashk-examination]], [[actuarial-exam-database]], [[ruc-nonlife-actuarial]] and [[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]] into a mainland + Hong Kong resource set. Note: no licence declared, 0 stars; the bank is auto-generated, so answers and explanations should be spot-checked against the original rules before use.
entries.body_hk: Wooz08/study-webpages（2026-09-09）是一個**中文保險考試刷題站點**，兩個獨立板塊：① **償付能力監管規則**——按償二代二期（C-ROSS II）**20 份監管規則**組織的 **840 題**題庫，題目結構含 rule_no、rule_title（如「實際資本」）、qtype、題幹、選項、答案、**解析**（明確引用規則條文）、difficulty 與 type 標註；② **財務管理**——同結構的另一套題庫（約 450KB）。兩套均為純靜態頁面（index + app.js + data.js），可直接本地打開離線刷題。對 RIAA：償二代是中國償付能力監管的核心框架，也是中文保險考試的高頻考點，而**按監管規則逐條組織的題庫**能把「規則文本 → 考點 → 解析」串起來；可與 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[eaa-alm-ai-web-session]]、[[qarm]] 一起建立「中/歐償付能力體系」的對照認知；備考側與 [[iiqe-1]]、[[ashk-examination]]、[[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[ruc-nonlife-actuarial]]、[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]] 形成內地+香港的備考資源組合。注意：倉庫未聲明許可證，星標為 0；題庫為自動生成，使用前建議抽查核對。

entries.body: 日本生命保険協会（Life Insurance Association of Japan, LIAJ）的英文统计页（`seiho.or.jp/english/statistics/`）是**日本寿险业的官方数据入口**，两块主要内容：**Monthly Statistics**（月度统计，逐月的保费/给付/资产等经营活动数据）与 **Life Insurance Fact Book**（寿险统计年鉴，日本寿险业最常被引用的年度参考书）。对 RIAA：日本是全球第二大寿险市场，而**英文口径的日本寿险统计**是亚洲市场分析作业中最常缺的一块拼图——本 wiki 的监管统计轴此前已有香港（[[hk-ia-statistics]]）、中国（[[nfra-statistics]]）、韩国（[[fss-korea-insurance]]）、台湾（[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]）、新加坡（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]）与澳洲（[[apra-insurance-statistics]]），日本是明显的空缺；可与 [[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[iais-gimar]] 的跨国口径互相对照，与 [[soa]]、[[japan-insurance-advanced-course]]（日本保险进阶课程）搭配使用；适合作亚洲市场分析、跨国比较与寿险经营方向。
entries.body_en: The English statistics section of the Life Insurance Association of Japan (LIAJ, `seiho.or.jp/english/statistics/`) is the **official data entry point for Japan’s life insurance industry**, with two main parts: **Monthly Statistics** (monthly premiums, benefits, assets and other operating data) and the **Life Insurance Fact Book** (the annual reference most often cited on the Japanese life market). For RIAA: Japan is the world’s second-largest life insurance market, and **English-language Japanese life statistics** are the piece most often missing from Asian market-analysis work — this wiki’s regulatory-statistics axis already covers Hong Kong ([[hk-ia-statistics]]), China ([[nfra-statistics]]), Korea ([[fss-korea-insurance]]), Taiwan ([[tii-taiwan-insurance]]), Singapore ([[mas-insurance-statistics]]) and Australia ([[apra-insurance-statistics]]), leaving Japan an obvious gap; read it against the cross-country series in [[oecd-insurance-data]] and [[iais-gimar]], and alongside [[soa]] and [[japan-insurance-advanced-course]]; suits Asian market analysis, cross-country comparison and life-insurer operations.
entries.body_hk: 日本生命保険協会（Life Insurance Association of Japan, LIAJ）的英文統計頁（`seiho.or.jp/english/statistics/`）是**日本壽險業的官方數據入口**，兩塊主要內容：**Monthly Statistics**（月度統計）與 **Life Insurance Fact Book**（壽險統計年鑑，日本壽險業最常被引用的年度參考書）。對 RIAA：日本是全球第二大壽險市場，而**英文口徑的日本壽險統計**是亞洲市場分析作業中最常缺的一塊拼圖——本 wiki 的監管統計軸此前已有香港（[[hk-ia-statistics]]）、中國（[[nfra-statistics]]）、韓國（[[fss-korea-insurance]]）、台灣（[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]）、新加坡（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]）與澳洲（[[apra-insurance-statistics]]），日本是明顯的空缺；可與 [[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[iais-gimar]] 的跨國口徑互相對照，與 [[soa]]、[[japan-insurance-advanced-course]] 搭配使用；適合作亞洲市場分析、跨國比較與壽險經營方向。

entries.body: 马来西亚国家银行（Bank Negara Malaysia, BNM）的「Insurance & Takaful」板块（`bnm.gov.my/insurance-takaful`，位于 Rates & Statistics 之下）是**马来西亚保险与回教保险（takaful）的官方监管与数据门户**，涵盖：面向保险人与 takaful 经营者的**风险资本框架（RBC）**、**数字保险人与数字 takaful 经营者的牌照与监管框架**、takaful 中 **ta’awun（互助）**机制的扩大适用及配套意见反馈、医疗与健康保险/takaful 业务、以及保险人与 takaful 经营者—维修商的行业行为准则等。对 RIAA：马来西亚是**全球回教保险（takaful）的中心市场**，而 takaful 是本 wiki 此前完全空白的主题——它的互助（ta’awun）与盈余分配逻辑和传统保险的股东—保户结构有本质差别，是理解亚洲多元保险市场绕不开的一环；监管框架侧可与 [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[insurance-governance]] 对照，市场数据侧与本 wiki 的亚洲统计轴（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]）补齐东盟；适合作市场分析、监管比较与新兴市场方向。
entries.body_en: The "Insurance & Takaful" section of Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM, `bnm.gov.my/insurance-takaful`, filed under Rates & Statistics) is the **official regulatory and data portal for Malaysian insurance and takaful**. It covers the **risk-based capital (RBC) framework** for insurers and takaful operators, the **licensing and regulatory framework for digital insurers and digital takaful operators**, the broader application of **ta’awun** (mutual assistance) in takaful together with the related feedback statement, medical and health insurance/takaful business, and the code of conduct between insurers/takaful operators and repairers. For RIAA: Malaysia is the **global hub of takaful**, a topic this wiki previously left entirely blank — its mutual (ta’awun) logic and surplus-sharing differ fundamentally from the shareholder-policyholder structure of conventional insurance, making it essential to understanding Asia’s plural insurance markets; on the regulatory side compare [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]] and [[insurance-governance]], and on market data it completes ASEAN within this wiki’s Asian statistics axis ([[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[tii-taiwan-insurance]]); suits market analysis, regulatory comparison and emerging-market work.
entries.body_hk: 馬來西亞國家銀行（Bank Negara Malaysia, BNM）的「Insurance & Takaful」板塊（`bnm.gov.my/insurance-takaful`，位於 Rates & Statistics 之下）是**馬來西亞保險與回教保險（takaful）的官方監管與數據門戶**，涵蓋：面向保險人與 takaful 經營者的**風險資本框架（RBC）**、**數字保險人與數字 takaful 經營者的牌照與監管框架**、takaful 中 **ta’awun（互助）**機制的擴大適用及配套意見反饋、醫療與健康保險/takaful 業務、以及行業行為準則等。對 RIAA：馬來西亞是**全球回教保險（takaful）的中心市場**，而 takaful 是本 wiki 此前完全空白的主題——它的互助（ta’awun）與盈餘分配邏輯和傳統保險的股東—保戶結構有本質差別，是理解亞洲多元保險市場繞不開的一環；監管框架側可與 [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[insurance-governance]] 對照，市場數據側與本 wiki 的亞洲統計軸（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]）補齊東盟；適合作市場分析、監管比較與新興市場方向。

entries.body: 印尼金融服务管理局（Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, OJK）的英文「Insurance Statistics」页（`ojk.go.id/en/kanal/iknb/data-dan-statistik/asuransi/`）是**印尼保险业的官方统计与信息入口**，栏目覆盖保险、担保（surety）与养老基金三大板块：统计与数据、保险及辅助服务目录（institution directories）、牌照信息与出版物等。对 RIAA：印尼是**东南亚人口与保费体量最大的保险市场之一**，且处于快速增长与强监管重塑期，是亚洲市场研究的高频题目；本 wiki 的亚洲监管统计轴此前覆盖香港、中国、韩国、台湾、新加坡、澳洲、印度，东盟侧仅有新加坡——OJK 补齐了东盟最大市场；可与 [[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 做区域内对比，与 [[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[iais-gimar]] 做全球口径对照；适合作新兴市场分析、区域比较与保险科技（[[openinsurance]] 一类的开放保险方向）研究。注意：该站为 SharePoint 门户，部分栏目以下载列表形式呈现。
entries.body_en: The English "Insurance Statistics" section of Indonesia’s Financial Services Authority (Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, OJK; `ojk.go.id/en/kanal/iknb/data-dan-statistik/asuransi/`) is the **official statistics and information entry point for Indonesian insurance**, spanning insurance, surety and pension funds: statistics and data, institution directories for insurance and auxiliary services, licensing information and publications. For RIAA: Indonesia is **one of Southeast Asia’s largest insurance markets by population and premium**, and is in a phase of rapid growth and regulatory reshaping, making it a frequent subject of Asian market research; this wiki’s Asian regulatory-statistics axis previously covered Hong Kong, China, Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, Australia and India, with only Singapore in ASEAN — OJK fills in ASEAN’s largest market; compare within the region against [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[irdai-market-statistics]] and [[apra-insurance-statistics]], and globally against [[oecd-insurance-data]] and [[iais-gimar]]; suits emerging-market analysis, regional comparison and insurtech research in the open-insurance direction ([[openinsurance]]). Note: the site is a SharePoint portal and some sections are presented as download lists.

entries.body: 中国精算师协会（China Association of Actuaries, CAA，`e-caa.org.cn`）是**中国全国性精算专业组织**，也是中国人身保险业**行业经验数据（生命表 / 重大疾病经验发生率表口径）**的发布主体。官网结构可直接对应到实用栏目：**经验分析**（`/dataUpload/empirical`）与**专业资料**（`/dataUpload/professional`）为数据与资料下载入口，**动态要闻 / 通知公告**（`/systemNews/…`）发布行业动态与考试/标准通知，另有面向精算师的**招聘**栏目；站点同时外链 IAA、SOA、CAS、IFoA 与中保协，是观察中国精算行业与全球精算体系对接的入口。对 RIAA：在中国做寿险定价或准备金，**经验发生率表是绕不开的基准**，而这类表的行业发布主体正是本协会——它是查「数据从哪来、口径是什么」的第一站；与 [[nfra-statistics]]（金融监管总局官方保险数据，监管口径）形成「行业经验数据 vs 监管统计」的分工，与 [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]]（偿二代规则题库）、[[product-actuary-kb]]（产品精算公式）与 [[alm-kb]]（ALM 知识库）搭配可构成中文精算自学的完整链路；国际对照见 [[soa]]、[[cas]]、[[ifoa]]。
entries.body_en: The China Association of Actuaries (CAA, `e-caa.org.cn`) is **China’s national actuarial professional body** and the industry publisher of Chinese life-insurance **experience data (mortality tables and critical-illness incidence tables)**. Its site maps directly onto practical sections: **experience analysis** (`/dataUpload/empirical`) and **professional materials** (`/dataUpload/professional`) are the data and document entry points; **news and notices** (`/systemNews/…`) carry industry developments plus exam and standard announcements; there is also a recruitment section for actuaries. The site links out to the IAA, SOA, CAS, IFoA and the China Insurance Association, making it an entry point for watching how Chinese actuarial practice connects to the global profession. For RIAA: pricing or reserving life business in China cannot avoid the **industry experience tables**, and this association is their publisher — the first stop for "where does the data come from and what is its basis"; it divides labour with [[nfra-statistics]] (official regulatory statistics) as "industry experience data vs regulatory statistics", and together with [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]] (C-ROSS rule bank), [[product-actuary-kb]] (product actuarial formulas) and [[alm-kb]] (ALM knowledge base) it forms a complete Chinese-language actuarial self-study chain; for international comparison see [[soa]], [[cas]] and [[ifoa]].
entries.body_hk: 中國精算師協會（China Association of Actuaries, CAA，`e-caa.org.cn`）是**中國全國性精算專業組織**，也是中國人身保險業**行業經驗數據（生命表 / 重大疾病經驗發生率表口徑）**的發布主體。官網結構可直接對應實用欄目：**經驗分析**（`/dataUpload/empirical`）與**專業資料**（`/dataUpload/professional`）為數據與資料下載入口，**動態要聞 / 通知公告**（`/systemNews/…`）發布行業動態與考試/標準通知，另有面向精算師的**招聘**欄目；站點同時外鏈 IAA、SOA、CAS、IFoA 與中保協。對 RIAA：在中國做壽險定價或準備金，**經驗發生率表是繞不開的基準**，而這類表的行業發布主體正是本協會；與 [[nfra-statistics]]（金融監管總局官方保險數據）形成「行業經驗數據 vs 監管統計」的分工，與 [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]]、[[product-actuary-kb]]、[[alm-kb]] 搭配可構成中文精算自學的完整鏈路；國際對照見 [[soa]]、[[cas]]、[[ifoa]]。

entries.body: 中国保险行业协会（中保协，`iachina.cn`）是**中国保险业的自律组织与行业标准发布方**，其网站的价值集中在「**条款费率**」与「实践研究 / 研究报告」两块。可核实的近期与常设内容：《车险承保理赔实务指南（2026版）》（2026-08 印发）、人身保险业**利率研究专家咨询委员会**季度例会机制、《定期寿险示范条款》与《终身寿险示范条款》修订、《反保险欺诈数据元》协会标准公开征求意见、重点新材料首批次应用保险示范条款及费率表，以及**玉米 / 小麦 / 水稻成本保险行业示范条款**（编号形如 `BXMC2020NXYM0101`）；研究侧有意外险基础发生率研究与承保理赔数据归集分析、寿险及护理保险转换机制研究、《中国保险业社会责任报告（2024）》。对 RIAA：**行业示范条款是产品开发的基准**——在中国做产品定价，条款责任边界直接决定发生率口径与费率结构，而示范条款给出了全行业的公共起点；农险示范条款可与 [[agrisky-ai]]（农险查勘定损 agent）对照「条款标准 → 实务执行」的链路；与 [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]（新规速递）、[[nfra-statistics]]（监管统计）、[[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]]、[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]] 搭配使用；适合作产品开发、条款实务与国内市场方向。
entries.body_en: The China Insurance Association (IACHINA, `iachina.cn`) is **the Chinese insurance industry’s self-regulatory body and standards publisher**, and its site concentrates value in two areas: **clauses and rates** and **practice research / research reports**. Verifiable recent and standing content includes: the *Motor Insurance Underwriting and Claims Practice Guide (2026 edition)* (issued 2026-08); a quarterly expert advisory committee on **interest-rate research** for the life sector; revisions to the *Term Life Model Clauses* and *Whole Life Model Clauses*; an industry standard on *Anti-Insurance-Fraud Data Elements* out for consultation; model clauses and rate tables for first-batch application insurance for key new materials; and **model clauses for corn / wheat / rice cost insurance** (IDs such as `BXMC2020NXYM0101`). On the research side: baseline accident-incidence research and claims-data aggregation analysis, research on life-to-long-term-care conversion mechanisms, and the *China Insurance Industry Social Responsibility Report (2024)*. For RIAA: **model clauses are the baseline of product development** — pricing in China depends on clause liability boundaries that directly determine incidence bases and rate structures, and the model clauses supply the industry’s common starting point; the agricultural model clauses can be read against [[agrisky-ai]] (an agricultural claims agent) as a "clause standard → operational execution" chain; use it with [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]], [[nfra-statistics]], [[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]] and [[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]]; suits product development, clause practice and domestic-market work.
entries.body_hk: 中國保險行業協會（中保協，`iachina.cn`）是**中國保險業的自律組織與行業標準發布方**，其網站的價值集中在「**條款費率**」與「實踐研究 / 研究報告」兩塊。可核實的近期與常設內容：《車險承保理賠實務指南（2026版）》（2026-08 印發）、人身保險業**利率研究專家諮詢委員會**季度例會機制、《定期壽險示範條款》與《終身壽險示範條款》修訂、《反保險欺詐數據元》協會標準公開徵求意見、重點新材料首批次應用保險示範條款及費率表，以及**玉米 / 小麥 / 水稻成本保險行業示範條款**（編號形如 `BXMC2020NXYM0101`）；研究側有意外險基礎發生率研究與承保理賠數據歸集分析、壽險及護理保險轉換機制研究、《中國保險業社會責任報告（2024）》。對 RIAA：**行業示範條款是產品開發的基準**——在中國做產品定價，條款責任邊界直接決定發生率口徑與費率結構；農險示範條款可與 [[agrisky-ai]] 對照「條款標準 → 實務執行」的鏈路；與 [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]、[[nfra-statistics]]、[[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]]、[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]] 搭配使用；適合作產品開發、條款實務與國內市場方向。

entries.title: 自愿医保计划官网（VHIS）
entries.title_en: Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) official portal
entries.summary: 香港特区政府自愿医保计划官方门户：认可产品清单、认可产品提供者、税务扣除规则
entries.summary_en: HKSAR government VHIS official portal: list of certified plans, list of VHIS providers, and tax-deduction rules
entries.summary_hk: 香港特區政府自願醫保計劃官方門戶：認可產品清單、認可產品提供者、稅務扣除規則
entries.body: 自愿医保计划（Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme, VHIS）是香港特区政府推出的**规管型自愿医保**框架，其官网（`vhis.gov.hk`，HKSAR 官方主页）是计划的一手信息入口，栏目包括：**About VHIS**（计划设计与背景）、**VHIS Office**（计划办事处）、**Tax Deduction**（自愿医保保费税务扣除规则）、**List of VHIS Providers**（认可产品提供者名单，即获准销售认可产品的保险公司）、**Identification of Certified Plans**（如何识别认可产品）。对 RIAA：香港医疗保障体系由公营（公立医院）+ 私营（医保）双层构成，VHIS 是**政府以「标准计划 + 灵活计划」双层产品规格介入私营医保市场**的典型案例——理解它的产品规格、保证续保与税务激励设计，是研究香港健康险与医疗融资的起点；本词条（计划门户）与 [[vhis-standard-premium]]（data.gov.hk 上的标准保费数据集）构成「规则层 vs 数据层」的一对；从业侧「哪些公司可卖认可产品」直接指向 [[bupa]]、[[blue-cross]] 等提供者，纠纷与投诉机制见 [[hk-icb]]；与 [[mpf-fund-platform]]（强积金基金平台）、[[hk-ia-statistics]]（保监局统计）共同构成香港保险业「制度 + 数据」的本地资源组；适合作健康险、医疗融资与香港市场方向。
entries.body_en: The Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) is the Hong Kong SAR government’s **regulated voluntary health insurance** framework, and its official portal (`vhis.gov.hk`, an HKSAR official homepage) is the first-hand entry point, with sections: **About VHIS** (scheme design and background), **VHIS Office**, **Tax Deduction** (rules for deducting VHIS premiums), **List of VHIS Providers** (insurers authorised to sell certified plans) and **Identification of Certified Plans**. For RIAA: Hong Kong’s health financing is two-tier — public hospitals plus private insurance — and VHIS is the archetypal case of **government intervening in the private health insurance market with a two-tier product specification (Standard Plan plus Flexi Plan)**; understanding its product specification, guaranteed renewal and tax-incentive design is the starting point for research on Hong Kong health insurance and healthcare financing. This entry (the scheme portal) and [[vhis-standard-premium]] (the standard-premium dataset on data.gov.hk) form a "rules layer vs data layer" pair; on the practitioner side, "which companies may sell certified plans" points to providers such as [[bupa]] and [[blue-cross]], with dispute and complaint mechanisms covered by [[hk-icb]]; together with [[mpf-fund-platform]] (the MPF fund platform) and [[hk-ia-statistics]] (Insurance Authority statistics) it forms a local "institutions + data" resource set for the Hong Kong insurance industry; suits health insurance, healthcare financing and Hong Kong market work.
entries.body_hk: 自願醫保計劃（Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme, VHIS）是香港特區政府推出的**規管型自願醫保**框架，其官網（`vhis.gov.hk`，HKSAR 官方主頁）是計劃的一手資訊入口，欄目包括：**About VHIS**（計劃設計與背景）、**VHIS Office**（計劃辦事處）、**Tax Deduction**（自願醫保保費稅務扣除規則）、**List of VHIS Providers**（認可產品提供者名單）、**Identification of Certified Plans**（如何識別認可產品）。對 RIAA：香港醫療保障體系由公營（公立醫院）+ 私營（醫保）雙層構成，VHIS 是**政府以「標準計劃 + 靈活計劃」雙層產品規格介入私營醫保市場**的典型案例——理解其產品規格、保證續保與稅務激勵設計，是研究香港健康險與醫療融資的起點；本詞條（計劃門戶）與 [[vhis-standard-premium]]（data.gov.hk 標準保費數據集）構成「規則層 vs 數據層」的一對；從業側「哪些公司可賣認可產品」直接指向 [[bupa]]、[[blue-cross]] 等提供者，糾紛與投訴機制見 [[hk-icb]]；與 [[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[hk-ia-statistics]] 共同構成香港保險業「制度 + 數據」的本地資源組；適合作健康險、醫療融資與香港市場方向。

entries.title: 日内瓦协会（The Geneva Association）
entries.title_en: The Geneva Association (global insurance think tank)
entries.summary: 全球保险业智库：气候、人口健康、数字与 AI、网络风险四大研究主线 + 研究报告库
entries.summary_en: Global insurance think tank: climate, population health, digital & AI and cyber research tracks, plus a research-report library
entries.summary_hk: 全球保險業智庫：氣候、人口健康、數字與 AI、網絡風險四大研究主線 + 研究報告庫
entries.body: 日内瓦协会（The Geneva Association，`genevaassociation.org`）自我定位为 **Global Insurance Think Tank**，是保险业最具影响力的国际研究机构（由全球主要保险公司 CEO 组成成员体系，现任主席为 Aegon CEO Lard Friese）。其研究主线清晰可辨，正好覆盖精算与保险业的中长期议题：**Macro & Geoeconomic Shifts**（宏观与地缘经济变迁）、**Climate Change & Environment**（气候变化与环境）、**Population Health Trends**（人口健康趋势）、**Digital & AI Transformation**（数字化与 AI 转型）、**Cyber**（网络风险）；出版侧有 **Research reports**、**Annual reports** 与 **Gen AI** 专题报告，并举办 Health & Demography Conference 等年度会议。对 RIAA：这是做**保险业宏观/战略级研究**时的首选高质量出处——它的报告通常给的是「行业级判断 + 数据」，而非单一公司的营销材料；气候主线可与 [[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[swiss-re-sigma]]、[[gdacs]] 搭配，人口健康主线与 [[mortality-table]]、[[excessmort]]、[[stmomo]] 对接，数字与 AI 主线可与 [[insurance-governance]]、[[iais-gimar]]、[[risk-radar-2026]] 对照；适合作研究型作业、行业报告写作与面试时的行业观点储备。
entries.body_en: The Geneva Association (`genevaassociation.org`) describes itself as the **Global Insurance Think Tank** and is the insurance industry’s most influential international research body (its membership is drawn from the CEOs of leading insurers; its current chair is Aegon CEO Lard Friese). Its research tracks are clearly delineated and map onto the actuarial and insurance industry’s medium- and long-term agenda: **Macro & Geoeconomic Shifts**, **Climate Change & Environment**, **Population Health Trends**, **Digital & AI Transformation** and **Cyber**; on the publishing side there are **research reports**, **annual reports** and dedicated **Gen AI** reports, plus annual conferences such as the Health & Demography Conference. For RIAA: a first-choice high-quality source for **macro/strategic-level insurance research** — its reports typically offer industry-level judgement plus data rather than a single company’s marketing material; the climate track pairs with [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[swiss-re-sigma]] and [[gdacs]]; the population-health track connects to [[mortality-table]], [[excessmort]] and [[stmomo]]; the digital and AI track can be read against [[insurance-governance]], [[iais-gimar]] and [[risk-radar-2026]]; suits research assignments, industry-report writing and building an industry viewpoint for interviews.
entries.body_hk: 日內瓦協會（The Geneva Association，`genevaassociation.org`）自我定位為 **Global Insurance Think Tank**，是保險業最具影響力的國際研究機構（成員體系由全球主要保險公司 CEO 組成，現任主席為 Aegon CEO Lard Friese）。其研究主線清晰可辨，正好覆蓋精算與保險業的中長期議題：**Macro & Geoeconomic Shifts**、**Climate Change & Environment**、**Population Health Trends**、**Digital & AI Transformation**、**Cyber**；出版側有 **Research reports**、**Annual reports** 與 **Gen AI** 專題報告，並舉辦 Health & Demography Conference 等年度會議。對 RIAA：這是做**保險業宏觀/戰略級研究**時的首選高質量出處——報告通常給「行業級判斷 + 數據」，而非單一公司的營銷材料；氣候主線可與 [[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[swiss-re-sigma]]、[[gdacs]] 搭配，人口健康主線與 [[mortality-table]]、[[excessmort]]、[[stmomo]] 對接，數字與 AI 主線可與 [[insurance-governance]]、[[iais-gimar]]、[[risk-radar-2026]] 對照；適合作研究型作業、行業報告寫作與面試時的行業觀點儲備。

entries.summary: 欧洲保险业联合会：Solvency II/气候/数字与 AI/消费者保护议题文件 + 统计 + GFIA 秘书处

entries.summary_hk: 歐洲保險業聯合會：Solvency II/氣候/數字與 AI/消費者保護議題文件 + 統計 + GFIA 秘書處
entries.body: Insurance Europe（`insuranceeurope.eu`）是**欧洲保险与再保险业的联合会**（成员为各国保险协会），其网站是追踪欧洲保险监管议题的高效入口。栏目按议题组织，可核实的重点包括：**Regulation & competitiveness**（Solvency II、跨境监管与国际审慎动态、恢复与处置 recovery & resolution、税务、简化）、**Climate, sustainability & resilience**（气候变化、自然灾害巨灾风险、Sustainability Hub）、**Digital, AI & cyber**（网络、数据保护、数字化）、**Serving & protecting consumers**（Consumer Hub、消费者保护监管、分销、金融教育 #InsureWisely、PRIIPs 与零售投资策略 RIS 包）、**Insurance, people & society**（反欺诈、健康保险、责任险、车险、风险导向核保、DEI）、以及 **Statistics** 与 **Publications** 板块。此外它是 **GFIA（全球保险协会联合会）的秘书处**，也是 **FinDatEx** 成员，并设有**再保险顾问委员会（RAB）**。对 RIAA：这是「**欧洲监管议题 → 行业立场 → 支撑数据**」的完整链条样本——想知道 Solvency II 修订、巨灾保障缺口、AI 在保险中的监管态度如何演化，这里能一次拿到行业侧的正式回应；与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]（EIOPA 官方统计与数据）、[[solvency2rfr]]（无风险利率期限结构）构成「监管机构 vs 行业组织」的一对；消费者保护与反欺诈议题可与 [[hk-icb]]、[[insurance-governance]] 对照；适合作监管比较、偿付能力与欧洲市场方向。
entries.body_en: Insurance Europe (`insuranceeurope.eu`) is **the federation of the European insurance and reinsurance industry** (its members are national insurance associations), and its site is an efficient entry point for tracking European insurance regulation. Content is organised by topic; verifiable highlights include **Regulation & competitiveness** (Solvency II, international prudential developments, recovery & resolution, taxation, simplification), **Climate, sustainability & resilience** (climate change, natural catastrophes, Sustainability Hub), **Digital, AI & cyber** (cyber, data protection, digitalisation), **Serving & protecting consumers** (Consumer Hub, consumer-protection regulation, distribution, financial education #InsureWisely, PRIIPs and the Retail Investment Strategy package), **Insurance, people & society** (fraud prevention, health insurance, liability, motor insurance, risk-based underwriting, DEI), plus **Statistics** and **Publications** sections. It also serves as the **secretariat of GFIA** (the Global Federation of Insurance Associations), is a **FinDatEx** member, and hosts the **Reinsurance Advisory Board (RAB)**. For RIAA: a complete sample of the chain "**European regulatory agenda → industry position → supporting data**" — to see how Solvency II revision, the catastrophe protection gap or regulatory attitudes to AI in insurance are evolving, this is where the industry’s formal responses are collected; together with [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] (EIOPA’s official statistics and data) and [[solvency2rfr]] (risk-free rate term structures) it forms a "supervisor vs industry body" pair; consumer-protection and fraud topics can be read against [[hk-icb]] and [[insurance-governance]]; suits regulatory comparison, solvency and European-market work.
entries.body_hk: Insurance Europe（`insuranceeurope.eu`）是**歐洲保險與再保險業的聯合會**（成員為各國保險協會），其網站是追蹤歐洲保險監管議題的高效入口。欄目按議題組織，可核實的重點包括：**Regulation & competitiveness**（Solvency II、國際審慎動態、恢復與處置、稅務、簡化）、**Climate, sustainability & resilience**（氣候變化、自然災害巨災風險、Sustainability Hub）、**Digital, AI & cyber**（網絡、數據保護、數字化）、**Serving & protecting consumers**（Consumer Hub、消費者保護監管、分銷、金融教育 #InsureWisely、PRIIPs 與 RIS 包）、**Insurance, people & society**（反欺詐、健康保險、責任險、車險、風險導向核保、DEI）、以及 **Statistics** 與 **Publications** 板塊。此外它是 **GFIA 的秘書處**，也是 **FinDatEx** 成員，並設有**再保險顧問委員會（RAB）**。對 RIAA：這是「**歐洲監管議題 → 行業立場 → 支撐數據**」的完整鏈條樣本；與 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[solvency2rfr]] 構成「監管機構 vs 行業組織」的一對；消費者保護與反欺詐議題可與 [[hk-icb]]、[[insurance-governance]] 對照；適合作監管比較、償付能力與歐洲市場方向。

entries.summary: 全球精算业伞形组织：成员目录、精算标准（ISAP）、气候与可持续/教育等专业委员会
entries.summary_en: Global umbrella body for the actuarial profession: member directories, actuarial standards (ISAPs), and committees on climate & sustainability, education and more
entries.summary_hk: 全球精算業傘形組織：成員目錄、精算標準（ISAP）、氣候與可持續/教育等專業委員會
entries.body: 国际精算协会（International Actuarial Association, IAA，`actuaries.org`）是**全球精算业的伞形组织**——各国精算协会是其 Full Member，个人与机构可作 Associate Member。网站可核实的实用栏目包括：**Full / Associate Member 目录**（查任一国家精算学会的官方对口）、**Council & Statutory Committees**、**Actuarial Standards**（国际精算实务准则 ISAP 的制定主体）、**Climate & Sustainability** 委员会、**Education** 委员会、**ADVANCE** 等。此外 IAA 下设若干**专业分会（Sections）**，其中与本 wiki 主题最相关的两个是 **ASTIN（非寿险）** 与 **AFIR-ERM（金融风险与企业风险管理）**，各自出版期刊并举办 Section Colloquia。对 RIAA：这是判断「**某个国家的精算资格与标准是谁说了算、能否互认**」的顶层入口——例如把 [[china-actuarial-association]]、[[ashk]]、[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]] 等区域学会放回 IAA 框架下，就能看清资格互认与标准趋同的路径；气候与可持续委员会的存在本身也说明 ESG 已进入精算标准议程（对照 [[geneva-association]]、[[insurance-governance]]）；研究会话与研究资源见 [[cas-research-tools]]、[[actuarialdatascience]]；适合作职业路径规划、资格对比与行业标准方向。
entries.body_en: The International Actuarial Association (IAA, `actuaries.org`) is **the global umbrella body for the actuarial profession** — national actuarial associations are Full Members, while individuals and institutions may join as Associate Members. Verifiable practical sections include: the **Full / Associate Member directories** (to find the official counterpart association in any country), **Council & Statutory Committees**, the **Actuarial Standards** committee (which develops the ISAPs, International Standards of Actuarial Practice), the **Climate & Sustainability** committee, the **Education** committee and **ADVANCE**. The IAA also hosts **Sections**, of which the two most relevant to this wiki are **ASTIN (non-life)** and **AFIR-ERM (financial risks and enterprise risk management)**, each publishing a journal and running Section Colloquia. For RIAA: the top-level entry point for "**who sets actuarial qualifications and standards in a given country, and are they mutually recognised**" — placing regional bodies such as [[china-actuarial-association]], [[ashk]], [[actuaries-institute]] and [[singapore-actuarial-society]] inside the IAA framework clarifies the paths of mutual recognition and standards convergence; the existence of a climate & sustainability committee also shows ESG has entered the actuarial standards agenda (compare [[geneva-association]] and [[insurance-governance]]); for research sessions and resources see [[cas-research-tools]] and [[actuarialdatascience]]; suits career-path planning, qualification comparison and standards work.
entries.body_hk: 國際精算協會（International Actuarial Association, IAA，`actuaries.org`）是**全球精算業的傘形組織**——各國精算協會是其 Full Member，個人與機構可作 Associate Member。網站可核實的實用欄目包括：**Full / Associate Member 目錄**、**Council & Statutory Committees**、**Actuarial Standards**（國際精算實務準則 ISAP 的制定主體）、**Climate & Sustainability** 委員會、**Education** 委員會、**ADVANCE** 等。此外 IAA 下設若干**專業分會（Sections）**，其中與本 wiki 主題最相關的兩個是 **ASTIN（非壽險）** 與 **AFIR-ERM（金融風險與企業風險管理）**。對 RIAA：這是判斷「**某個國家的精算資格與標準是誰說了算、能否互認**」的頂層入口——把 [[china-actuarial-association]]、[[ashk]]、[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]] 等區域學會放回 IAA 框架下，就能看清資格互認與標準趨同的路徑；適合作職業路徑規劃、資格對比與行業標準方向。
