entries.title: ASTIN · ASTIN Bulletin（非寿险精算）
entries.summary: IAA 非寿险分会与旗舰期刊：ASTIN Bulletin 论文 + Section Colloquia
entries.summary_en: The IAA’s non-life section and its flagship journal: ASTIN Bulletin papers plus Section Colloquia
entries.summary_hk: IAA 非壽險分會與旗艦期刊：ASTIN Bulletin 論文 + Section Colloquia
entries.body: ASTIN（`actuaries.org/astin`）是**国际精算协会（IAA）下属的非寿险分会**，也是非寿险精算研究最核心的学术共同体；其旗舰刊物 **ASTIN Bulletin** 长期是产险精算方法论文的主要发表地（准备金、信度理论、极值、巨灾、GLM/GAM 定价、损失分布等），分会另组织 **Section Colloquia** 系列会议。对 RIAA：如果研究方向是产险（RIAA 的一大主线），**ASTIN Bulletin 是把「课程里的方法」与「学界前沿」接上的地方**——池内许多工具的原始方法都首发于此，例如准备金族的 [[chainladder-python]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]，极值族的 [[extremes]]，以及 [[cas-research-tools]]（CAS 侧研究资源）形成产险研究的东西两岸对照；教育类资源见 [[actuarial-open-book]]、[[loss-models-computer-labs]]；IAA 整体框架与资格体系见 [[iaa]]，行业组织见 [[cas]]。适合作论文选题、方法论溯源与研究型作业。
entries.body_en: ASTIN (`actuaries.org/astin`) is **the non-life section of the International Actuarial Association (IAA)** and the core academic community for non-life actuarial research; its flagship journal, the **ASTIN Bulletin**, has long been the main venue for methodological papers in general insurance (reserving, credibility theory, extremes, catastrophe, GLM/GAM pricing, loss distributions), and the section runs the **Section Colloquia** series. For RIAA: if the direction is general insurance (one of RIAA’s main streams), **the ASTIN Bulletin is where course methods meet the research frontier** — many tools in this corpus originate in methods first published here, e.g. the reserving family ([[chainladder-python]], [[reserving-ensemble]]) and the extremes family ([[extremes]]), and it forms an east-west pairing with [[cas-research-tools]] (the CAS research side); for educational resources see [[actuarial-open-book]] and [[loss-models-computer-labs]]; for the overall IAA framework and qualification system see [[iaa]], and for the society itself see [[cas]]. Suits paper topic selection, methodological tracing and research assignments.
entries.body_hk: ASTIN（`actuaries.org/astin`）是**國際精算協會（IAA）下屬的非壽險分會**，也是非壽險精算研究最核心的學術共同體；其旗艦刊物 **ASTIN Bulletin** 長期是產險精算方法論文的主要發表地（準備金、信度理論、極值、巨災、GLM/GAM 定價、損失分布等），分會另組織 **Section Colloquia** 系列會議。對 RIAA：如果研究方向是產險，**ASTIN Bulletin 是把「課程裡的方法」與「學界前沿」接上的地方**——池內許多工具的原始方法都首發於此，例如準備金族的 [[chainladder-python]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]，極值族的 [[extremes]]，並與 [[cas-research-tools]] 形成產險研究的東西兩岸對照；教育類資源見 [[actuarial-open-book]]、[[loss-models-computer-labs]]；IAA 整體框架見 [[iaa]]。適合作論文選題、方法論溯源與研究型作業。

entries.body: 澳洲精算学会（Actuaries Institute，`actuaries.asn.au`）是**澳大利亚的精算专业团体与资格授予机构**，站点结构围绕职业路径展开：What is an actuary / Why become an actuary / **Career paths for actuaries**、如何成为精算师（资格路径）、会员与 CPD、行业活动与政策倡导，并对外发布研究与实践资源。它对 RIAA 的价值有三层：① **区域资格路径**——澳洲是亚太精算人才流动的重要一极，ASI 与 [[ashk]]（香港）、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]（新加坡）共同构成亚太资格地图，顶端框架见 [[iaa]]；② **数据科学落地**——该学会下属社区出品的 **[[actuarial-cookbook]]（Data and Analytics Cookbook）** 是「精算师如何真的用 Python/R 做数据工作」的高质量开源范例，另有 [[actuarialdatascience]] 一类资源；③ **政策与标准**——与 [[ifoa]]、[[soa]]、[[cas]] 形成国际参照。适合作职业路径规划、亚太资格对比与实务技能方向。
entries.body_en: The Actuaries Institute (`actuaries.asn.au`) is **Australia’s actuarial professional body and qualifying body**. Its site is organised around career routes: what an actuary is, why become one, **career paths for actuaries**, the qualification pathway, membership and CPD, industry events and policy advocacy, plus published research and practice resources. Three layers of value for RIAA: (1) **regional qualification pathway** — Australia is a major pole of Asia-Pacific actuarial talent mobility, and together with [[ashk]] (Hong Kong) and [[singapore-actuarial-society]] (Singapore) it completes the Asia-Pacific qualification map, under the top-level framework of [[iaa]]; (2) **data science in practice** — the **[[actuarial-cookbook]] (Data and Analytics Cookbook)** produced by its community is a high-quality open-source example of how actuaries actually do data work in Python/R, alongside resources such as [[actuarialdatascience]]; (3) **policy and standards** — with international reference points [[ifoa]], [[soa]] and [[cas]]. Suits career-path planning, Asia-Pacific qualification comparison and practical-skills work.
entries.body_hk: 澳洲精算學會（Actuaries Institute，`actuaries.asn.au`）是**澳大利亞的精算專業團體與資格授予機構**，站點結構圍繞職業路徑展開：What is an actuary / Why become an actuary / **Career paths for actuaries**、如何成為精算師、會員與 CPD、行業活動與政策倡導，並對外發布研究與實踐資源。對 RIAA 的價值有三層：① **區域資格路徑**——澳洲是亞太精算人才流動的重要一極，與 [[ashk]]（香港）、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]（新加坡）共同構成亞太資格地圖，頂端框架見 [[iaa]]；② **數據科學落地**——其社區出品的 **[[actuarial-cookbook]]** 是高質量開源範例，另有 [[actuarialdatascience]] 一類資源；③ **政策與標準**——與 [[ifoa]]、[[soa]]、[[cas]] 形成國際參照。適合作職業路徑規劃、亞太資格對比與實務技能方向。

entries.body: 新加坡精算学会（Singapore Actuarial Society, SAS，`actuaries.org.sg`）是**新加坡的精算专业团体**，站点围绕会员与活动组织：Events（年度活动日历，例如 **Practising Certificate Seminar（PCS）** 系列——2026 年为第 22 届，11 月 24 日）、Join Us As A Member、行业新闻与资源。对 RIAA：新加坡是**亚洲保险与再保险的区域枢纽**（区域内大量再保、区域总部与保险科技团队设在新加坡），因此 SAS 既是职业网络的落点，也是观察「亚洲精算执业监管与执业证书制度」如何运作的窗口——PCS 这类执业证书研讨会在港、新、马等地都是精算师取得签字资格的关键环节；与本 wiki 的亚洲体系形成一组：资格框架见 [[iaa]]，同业组织见 [[ashk]]、[[actuaries-institute]]，市场数据侧见 [[mas-insurance-statistics]]，香港对照见 [[hk-ia-statistics]] 与 [[ia]]；适合作区域求职、执业资格与行业活动方向。
entries.body_en: The Singapore Actuarial Society (SAS, `actuaries.org.sg`) is **Singapore’s actuarial professional body**, organised around members and events: an annual events calendar including the **Practising Certificate Seminar (PCS)** series (the 22nd edition in 2026, on 24 November), membership sign-up, and industry news and resources. For RIAA: Singapore is **Asia’s regional hub for insurance and reinsurance** (many reinsurers, regional headquarters and insurtech teams sit there), so SAS is both a landing point for professional networking and a window onto how **Asian actuarial practising regulation and practising-certificate regimes** work — PCS-type seminars are a key step for actuaries obtaining signing rights in Hong Kong, Singapore and Malaysia. It forms a set with this wiki’s Asian framework: qualifications under [[iaa]], peer bodies [[ashk]] and [[actuaries-institute]], market data via [[mas-insurance-statistics]], and Hong Kong contrasts via [[hk-ia-statistics]] and [[ia]]; suits regional job hunting, practising qualifications and industry events.
entries.body_hk: 新加坡精算學會（Singapore Actuarial Society, SAS，`actuaries.org.sg`）是**新加坡的精算專業團體**，站點圍繞會員與活動組織：Events（年度活動日曆，例如 **Practising Certificate Seminar（PCS）** 系列——2026 年為第 22 屆，11 月 24 日）、Join Us As A Member、行業新聞與資源。對 RIAA：新加坡是**亞洲保險與再保險的區域樞紐**，因此 SAS 既是職業網絡的落點，也是觀察「亞洲精算執業監管與執業證書制度」如何運作的窗口——PCS 這類研討會在港、新、馬等地都是精算師取得簽字資格的關鍵環節；與本 wiki 的亞洲體系形成一組：資格框架見 [[iaa]]，同業組織見 [[ashk]]、[[actuaries-institute]]，市場數據側見 [[mas-insurance-statistics]]，香港對照見 [[hk-ia-statistics]] 與 [[ia]]；適合作區域求職、執業資格與行業活動方向。

entries.title: Reinsurance Layer Pricing Engine（再保分层定价引擎）
entries.title_hk: Reinsurance Layer Pricing Engine（再保分層定價引擎）
entries.summary: 开源 XoL/停止损失再保分层定价引擎（Python）：频率-强度蒙特卡洛 → 分出损失分布 → 技术保费
entries.summary_en: Open-source XoL / stop-loss reinsurance layer pricing engine (Python): frequency-severity Monte Carlo to ceded loss distributions and technical premiums
entries.summary_hk: 開源 XoL/停止損失再保分層定價引擎（Python）：頻率-強度蒙特卡洛 → 分出損失分布 → 技術保費
entries.body: Reinsurance Layer Pricing Engine（`RS-ins/Reinsurance-Layer-Pricing-Engine`，Python 3.10+，2026-04-28 建仓 / 2026-05-10 更新）是**开源的再保分层定价引擎**：用频率-强度蒙特卡洛模拟构造**年度总损失分布**，套上再保合约结构，推导**分出损失分布、风险度量与技术保费**（含资本成本加载）。支持的合约要素覆盖实操中最关键的那几项：**Excess-of-Loss（XL）与 Stop-Loss** 两大类、**年度累计限额（Aggregate Annual Limit）**、**年度累计免赔（Annual Aggregate Deductible）**与**恢复保费（reinstatement premiums）**；分布参数可手工指定，也可用最大似然从历史损失数据自动拟合。项目另提供一个**在线交互仪表盘**（11,250+ 预计算情景，可拖动滑杆看合约结构、频率分布、严重性尾部、资本成本如何影响技术保费，每张指标卡附白话解释）。对 RIAA：**分层定价与分出结构**是再保定价的核心技能，而开源侧长期缺少完整实现——池内再保族此前偏「合约数据/合约文本/保费计算」（[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]、[[reinsurer]]、[[reinspy]]、[[rippy]]、[[reins]]）或商业/经纪侧工具（[[layerloss-locktonre]]），本引擎补的是**「分层结构 → 分出损失分布 → 技术保费」这条完整链路**；与 [[monte-carlo]]、[[aggregate-python]]（聚合损失分布）、[[retention]]（自留额）配套，巨灾场景可接 [[catmodeling]] 与 [[oasislmf]]；适合作再保定价、分出结构与资本成本方向。注意：仓库星标 4（新项目），许可证以仓库 README 标注的 Apache 2.0 为准（GitHub API 未识别到 SPDX 标识）。
entries.body_en: The Reinsurance Layer Pricing Engine (`RS-ins/Reinsurance-Layer-Pricing-Engine`, Python 3.10+, created 2026-04-28 / updated 2026-05-10) is an **open-source reinsurance layer pricing engine**: it uses frequency-severity Monte Carlo simulation to build an **aggregate annual loss distribution**, applies reinsurance treaty structures, and derives **ceded loss distributions, risk measures and capital-loaded technical premiums**. The treaty features it supports are the practically critical ones: **Excess-of-Loss (XL) and Stop-Loss** treaty types, **Aggregate Annual Limits**, **Annual Aggregate Deductibles** and **reinstatement premiums**; distribution parameters can be set manually or fitted automatically from historical loss data by maximum likelihood. The project also ships an **interactive online dashboard** (11,250+ pre-computed scenarios) where sliders show how treaty structure, frequency distribution, severity tail and cost of capital move the technical premium, with plain-English explanations on each metric card. For RIAA: **layer pricing and cession structure** are core reinsurance pricing skills, and the open-source side has long lacked a complete implementation — this corpus’s reinsurance family previously leaned toward contract data, contract text or premium calculators ([[reinsurance-contracts-repository]], [[reinsurer]], [[reinspy]], [[rippy]], [[reins]]) or commercial/broker tools ([[layerloss-locktonre]]); this engine fills in the **full chain "layer structure → ceded loss distribution → technical premium"**; it pairs with [[monte-carlo]] and [[aggregate-python]] (aggregate loss distributions) and [[retention]] (retentions), and catastrophe scenarios can connect to [[catmodeling]] and [[oasislmf]]; suits reinsurance pricing, cession structuring and cost-of-capital work. Note: 4 stars (new project); licence per the Apache 2.0 badge in the repository README (GitHub’s API did not detect an SPDX identifier).
entries.body_hk: Reinsurance Layer Pricing Engine（`RS-ins/Reinsurance-Layer-Pricing-Engine`，Python 3.10+，2026-04-28 建倉 / 2026-05-10 更新）是**開源的再保分層定價引擎**：用頻率-強度蒙特卡洛模擬構造**年度總損失分布**，套上再保合約結構，推導**分出損失分布、風險度量與技術保費**（含資本成本加載）。支持的合約要素覆蓋實操中最關鍵的幾項：**Excess-of-Loss（XL）與 Stop-Loss** 兩大類、**年度累計限額**、**年度累計免賠**與**恢復保費（reinstatement premiums）**；分布參數可手工指定，也可用最大似然從歷史損失數據自動擬合。項目另提供**在線交互儀表盤**（11,250+ 預計算情景）。對 RIAA：**分層定價與分出結構**是再保定價的核心技能，而開源側長期缺少完整實現——池內再保族此前偏「合約數據/合約文本/保費計算」（[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]、[[reinsurer]]、[[reinspy]]、[[rippy]]、[[reins]]）或商業/經紀側工具（[[layerloss-locktonre]]），本引擎補的是**「分層結構 → 分出損失分布 → 技術保費」這條完整鏈路**；與 [[monte-carlo]]、[[aggregate-python]]、[[retention]] 配套，巨災場景可接 [[catmodeling]] 與 [[oasislmf]]；適合作再保定價、分出結構與資本成本方向。注意：倉庫星標 4（新項目），許可證以 README 標註的 Apache 2.0 為準。
entries.verified_note: GitHub 仓库 + README 核实（Python 3.10+、XoL/Stop-Loss、年度累计限额/免赔、恢复保费、MLE 参数拟合、11,250+ 情景在线仪表盘；README 标注 Apache 2.0），未安装实测

entries.summary_hk: 對智能體審議記錄做確定性裁決（Rust，MIT）：共識/分歧/爭議/無據四帶 + 完整性摘要
entries.body: QuorumForge（`VanTaS15/QuorumForge`，Rust 核心，MIT，2020 年建仓、2026-09-05 更新）是一个**多智能体证据裁决引擎**，但它刻意**不做编排**：它不运行 agent、不调用模型、不管提示词，只在辩论结束之后处理**审议记录（record）**——谁支持了什么、谁提出了反对、各自有多确定、引用了什么——并让这些经过一个「加权推理棱镜」，输出四条干净的裁决带：**consensus（共识）/ split（分歧）/ contested（争议）/ unsupported（无据）**。关键性质是**确定性**：同一份证据文件永远得到同一个裁决、同一份报告字节与同一个完整性摘要，因此裁决结果可以提交进版本库、下周再做 diff。实现为 Rust 核心、仅用标准库。对 RIAA：这条思路正对**保险 AI 治理**的软肋——当理赔、核保、产品比较这类流程由多个 agent 分工给出结论时，「**最终结论是怎么从各方意见里得出的、能不能复现、能不能被审计**」往往是最难回答的问题；QuorumForge 把它变成一个可版本化、可复算的对象，与池内几个治理样本正好互补：[[agrisky-ai]] 用 SHA-256 审计回执固定「谁在什么时候批了什么」，[[evidence-review-claims]] 做图像证据裁决，[[phi-boundary-gate]] 做边界门禁，[[insurance-governance]] 记录行业治理标准；评测与可靠性侧另见 [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[garak]]、[[agentbench]]。⚠️ 术语提醒：这里的 **claim 指「智能体的断言」，不是保险索赔**——不要按理赔系统理解。适合作 AI 治理、智能体可靠性与审计追踪方向。
entries.body_en: QuorumForge (`VanTaS15/QuorumForge`, Rust core, MIT, created 2020, updated 2026-09-05) is a **multi-agent evidence adjudication engine** that deliberately **does not orchestrate**: it does not run agents, call models or manage prompts. It works only on the **record** of a deliberation once the debate is over — who supported what, who pushed back, how confident each was, what they cited — and passes that through a "prism of weighted reasoning" to output four clean verdict bands: **consensus, split, contested and unsupported**. The key property is **determinism**: the same evidence file always yields the same verdict, the same report bytes and the same integrity digest, so a verdict can be committed to version control and diffed next week. It is implemented as a Rust core using only the standard library. For RIAA: this addresses the soft spot of **AI governance in insurance** — when claims, underwriting or product comparison are split across several agents, "**how was the final conclusion derived from their opinions, can it be reproduced, can it be audited**" is often the hardest question to answer; QuorumForge turns it into a versionable, recomputable object, complementing several governance samples in this corpus: [[agrisky-ai]] pins down "who approved what, when" with SHA-256 audit receipts, [[evidence-review-claims]] adjudicates image evidence, [[phi-boundary-gate]] enforces boundary gates, and [[insurance-governance]] records industry governance standards; for evaluation and reliability see [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]], [[garak]] and [[agentbench]]. ⚠️ Terminology note: here **"claim" means an agent’s assertion, not an insurance claim** — do not read this as a claims system. Suits AI governance, agent reliability and audit-trail work.
entries.body_hk: QuorumForge（`VanTaS15/QuorumForge`，Rust 核心，MIT，2020 年建倉、2026-09-05 更新）是一個**多智能體證據裁決引擎**，但它刻意**不做編排**：它不運行 agent、不調用模型、不管提示詞，只在辯論結束之後處理**審議記錄（record）**——誰支持了什麼、誰提出反對、各自有多確定、引用了什麼——並讓這些經過一個「加權推理稜鏡」，輸出四條乾淨的裁決帶：**consensus（共識）/ split（分歧）/ contested（爭議）/ unsupported（無據）**。關鍵性質是**確定性**：同一份證據文件永遠得到同一個裁決、同一份報告位元組與同一個完整性摘要，因此裁決結果可以提交進版本庫、下週再做 diff。實現為 Rust 核心、僅用標準庫。對 RIAA：這條思路正對**保險 AI 治理**的軟肋——當理賠、核保、產品比較這類流程由多個 agent 分工給出結論時，「**最終結論是怎麼從各方意見裡得出的、能不能複現、能不能被審計**」往往是最難回答的問題；QuorumForge 把它變成可版本化、可複算的對象，與 [[agrisky-ai]]（SHA-256 審計回執）、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[phi-boundary-gate]]、[[insurance-governance]] 互補；評測與可靠性側另見 [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[garak]]、[[agentbench]]。⚠️ 術語提醒：這裡的 **claim 指「智能體的斷言」，不是保險索賠**。適合作 AI 治理、智能體可靠性與審計追蹤方向。
entries.verified_note: GitHub 仓库 + README 核实（Rust 核心/std-only/MIT；只读审议记录而不做编排；四裁决带 consensus/split/contested/unsupported；同输入同字节同摘要的可复现性主张），未安装实测

entries.body: Artemis.bm 是**巨灾债券与保险连结证券（ILS）市场的行业标杆情报与数据源**，覆盖范围包括 Catastrophe Bonds & ILS、ILS Funds & Managers、Reinsurance Renewals、**Retrocession（转分保）**、**Parametric Insurance（参数化保险）**、**Reinsurance Sidecars（侧车）**、**Industry Loss Warranty（ILW）**、Casualty ILS、**Cyber Cat Bonds & ILS**、Longevity Risk Transfer（长寿风险转移）、Weather Risk Management、Climate Change & Climate Risk、Protection Gap（保障缺口）、Alternative Reinsurance Capital 等专题。除新闻外，它的**数据类栏目**才是对精算与风险分析最有价值的部分：**Deal Directory**（逐笔巨灾债券/ILS 交易目录）、**Cat Bond & ILS Market Dashboard**（市场规模演进）、**Catastrophe Bond Market Yield**（市场收益率曲线）、**Cat Bond Losses & Bonds At Risk**（触发与在险债券追踪）、Reinsurance Sidecars、**Longevity Swaps & Risk Transfers**、**Reinsurance Market Survey Results**、MarketView 与 ILS Fund Managers 名录。对 RIAA：这是理解**「风险如何被资本市场化」**的第一手窗口——巨灾债券把保险风险打包成可交易证券，是保险与资本市场交叉的核心机制；定价与建模侧可接 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[cat-bond-pricer]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[climada-petals]]，市场与行业数据可与 [[swiss-re-sigma]]、[[perils-ied]] 对照，巨灾模型侧见 [[catmodeling]]、[[oasislmf]]，参数化产品设计见 [[parametric-insurance-demo]]；适合作 ILS、巨灾风险转移、资本管理与行业研究（含面试谈资）方向。
entries.body_en: Artemis.bm is **the benchmark intelligence and data source for the catastrophe bond and insurance-linked securities (ILS) market**. Its coverage spans Catastrophe Bonds & ILS, ILS Funds & Managers, Reinsurance Renewals, **retrocession**, **parametric insurance**, **reinsurance sidecars**, **Industry Loss Warranty (ILW)**, casualty ILS, **cyber cat bonds & ILS**, longevity risk transfer, weather risk management, climate change & climate risk, the protection gap and alternative reinsurance capital. Beyond news, its **data sections** are what matters most for actuarial and risk analysis: the **Deal Directory** (deal-by-deal cat bond / ILS records), the **Cat Bond & ILS Market Dashboard** (market size over time), **Catastrophe Bond Market Yield** (market yield series), **Cat Bond Losses & Bonds At Risk** (triggers and exposed bonds), reinsurance sidecars, **longevity swaps & risk transfers**, **reinsurance market survey results**, MarketView and an ILS investment manager directory. For RIAA: a first-hand window onto **how risk is capitalised** — cat bonds package insurance risk into tradable securities, a core mechanism where insurance meets capital markets; for pricing and modelling connect [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[cat-bond-pricer]], [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] and [[climada-petals]]; market and industry data can be read against [[swiss-re-sigma]] and [[perils-ied]]; for the catastrophe model side see [[catmodeling]] and [[oasislmf]], and for parametric product design see [[parametric-insurance-demo]]; suits ILS, catastrophe risk transfer, capital management and industry research (including interview preparation).
entries.body_hk: Artemis.bm 是**巨災債券與保險連結證券（ILS）市場的行業標杆情報與數據源**，覆蓋範圍包括 Catastrophe Bonds & ILS、ILS Funds & Managers、Reinsurance Renewals、**Retrocession（轉分保）**、**Parametric Insurance**、**Reinsurance Sidecars**、**Industry Loss Warranty（ILW）**、Casualty ILS、**Cyber Cat Bonds & ILS**、Longevity Risk Transfer、Weather Risk Management、Climate Change & Climate Risk、Protection Gap、Alternative Reinsurance Capital 等專題。除新聞外，其**數據類欄目**對精算與風險分析最有價值：**Deal Directory**（逐筆交易目錄）、**Cat Bond & ILS Market Dashboard**、**Catastrophe Bond Market Yield**、**Cat Bond Losses & Bonds At Risk**、Reinsurance Sidecars、**Longevity Swaps & Risk Transfers**、**Reinsurance Market Survey Results**、MarketView 與 ILS Fund Managers 名錄。對 RIAA：這是理解**「風險如何被資本市場化」**的第一手窗口；定價與建模側可接 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[cat-bond-pricer]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[climada-petals]]，市場與行業數據可與 [[swiss-re-sigma]]、[[perils-ied]] 對照，巨災模型側見 [[catmodeling]]、[[oasislmf]]；適合作 ILS、巨災風險轉移、資本管理與行業研究方向。

entries.title: lmomco（L-矩与概率加权矩）
entries.summary: L-矩完整实现（CRAN 2.5.7）：30+ 分布的 L-矩估计、比值图、删失与解析自举
entries.summary_en: Comprehensive L-moments implementation (CRAN 2.5.7): L-moment estimation for 30+ distributions, ratio diagrams, censoring and analytical bootstrap
entries.summary_hk: L-矩完整實現（CRAN 2.5.7）：30+ 分布的 L-矩估計、比值圖、刪失與解析自舉
entries.body: lmomco（CRAN 2.5.7，2026-07-04）是 **L-矩（L-moments）与概率加权矩（PWMs）** 最完整的开源实现：分布参数估计、**L-矩比值图（LM ratio diagram）**、多元 L-余矩（L-comoments）、非对称截尾 L-矩（TLM），并提供极大似然与最大乘积间距（maximum product spacings）估计；支持按阈值或指示变量做**右尾/左尾删失**、残差与反残差寿命的 L-矩、13 个分位算子（可靠性分析），以及次序统计量/L-矩/L-矩方差协方差的**解析自举**与 Harri-Coble Tau34 正态性检验。带 L/TL/RC 支持的分布超过 30 个，含 GEV、广义 Pareto、Kappa、Wakeby、Pearson III 型、3 参数对数正态等。依赖侧 Import goftest / Lmoments / MASS，Suggests **copBasic**。对 RIAA：L-矩在洪水频率分析与极值估计里的地位，相当于「小样本下更稳健的极大似然」——尤其形状参数在样本量小时极不稳定，L-矩是传统的解药；它与本 wiki 新收录的 [[glmom]]（广义 L-矩 + 非平稳 GEV11）是同一条方法论线索的两端（lmomco 是**估计方法工具箱**，glmom 是**面向非平稳与高分量稳健性**的封装）；与 [[extremes]]、[[extreme-value-theory]]、[[insurance-evt]] 配套，洪水/巨灾场景可接 [[ml-flood]]、[[floodmodeller-api]]、[[catmodeling]]；适合作巨灾、气候风险与极值估计方向。
entries.body_en: lmomco (CRAN 2.5.7, 2026-07-04) is the most complete open-source implementation of **L-moments and probability-weighted moments (PWMs)**: distribution parameter estimation, **LM ratio diagrams**, multivariate L-comoments, asymmetric trimmed L-moments (TLMs), plus maximum likelihood and maximum product spacings estimation; it supports **right- and left-tail LM censoring** by threshold or indicator variable, L-moments of residual and reversed residual life, 13 quantile operators for reliability analysis, **analytical bootstrap** of order statistics / LMs / LM var-covars, and the Harri-Coble Tau34-squared normality test. More than 30 distributions carry L/TL/RC support, including GEV, generalised Pareto, Kappa, Wakeby and Pearson Type III. It Imports goftest / Lmoments / MASS and Suggests **copBasic**. For RIAA: in flood frequency analysis and extreme value estimation, L-moments stand where "a more robust maximum likelihood in small samples" stands — the shape parameter is notoriously unstable at small n, and L-moments are the traditional remedy; it is one end of the same methodological thread as this wiki’s newly added [[glmom]] (generalized L-moments with non-stationary GEV11) — lmomco is the **estimation toolbox**, glmom the **wrapper aimed at non-stationarity and robust high quantiles**; it pairs with [[extremes]], [[extreme-value-theory]] and [[insurance-evt]], and flood/catastrophe use cases connect to [[ml-flood]], [[floodmodeller-api]] and [[catmodeling]]; suits catastrophe, climate risk and extreme value estimation.
entries.body_hk: lmomco（CRAN 2.5.7，2026-07-04）是 **L-矩（L-moments）與概率加權矩（PWMs）** 最完整的開源實現：分布參數估計、**L-矩比值圖**、多元 L-餘矩、非對稱截尾 L-矩（TLM），並提供極大似然與最大乘積間距估計；支持按閾值或指示變量做**右尾/左尾刪失**、殘差與反殘差壽命的 L-矩、13 個分位算子（可靠性分析），以及次序統計量/L-矩/方差協方差的**解析自舉**與 Harri-Coble Tau34 正態性檢驗。帶 L/TL/RC 支持的分布超過 30 個，含 GEV、廣義 Pareto、Kappa、Wakeby、Pearson III 型等。對 RIAA：L-矩在洪水頻率分析與極值估計裡的地位，相當於「小樣本下更穩健的極大似然」——形狀參數在樣本量小時極不穩定，L-矩是傳統的解藥；它與本 wiki 新收錄的 [[glmom]] 是同一條方法論線索的兩端；與 [[extremes]]、[[extreme-value-theory]]、[[insurance-evt]] 配套，洪水/巨災場景可接 [[ml-flood]]、[[floodmodeller-api]]、[[catmodeling]]；適合作巨災、氣候風險與極值估計方向。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页面核实（v2.5.7，2026-07-04 发布；L-矩/PWM/截尾 L-矩/比值图/解析自举；Imports goftest、Lmoments、MASS，Suggests copBasic；30+ 分布含 L/TL/RC 支持），未实测

entries.title: GAMLSS（位置-尺度-形状的分布回归）
entries.title_en: GAMLSS (distributional regression for location, scale and shape)
entries.title_hk: GAMLSS（位置-尺度-形狀的分布回歸）
entries.summary: 分布回归经典实现（CRAN 5.5-0）：条件分布的每个参数都用解释变量建模
entries.summary_en: The canonical distributional regression implementation (CRAN 5.5-0): every parameter of the conditional distribution is modelled with explanatory variables
entries.summary_hk: 分布回歸經典實現（CRAN 5.5-0）：條件分布的每個參數都用解釋變量建模
entries.body: GAMLSS（CRAN 5.5-0）实现 Rigby & Stasinopoulos (2005) 提出的**广义可加模型 for 位置、尺度与形状**：这是一套**分布回归（distributional regression）**框架——响应变量条件分布的**全部参数**（位置 μ、尺度 σ、偏度 ν、峰度 τ）都用解释变量建模，而不是像 GLM 那样只建模均值。因此它天然适配保险损失数据的三大特征：重尾、偏斜、零膨胀。依赖侧挂 gamlss.data、**gamlss.dist**（分布库，2026-09-10 仍在更新）与 nlme/parallel，Imports MASS、survival。对 RIAA：在保险定价里 GAMLSS 常被当作「**GLM 的直接升级**」——GLM 只让均值随风险因子变，GAMLSS 让整个分布随因子变，这正好是索赔频度-强度建模最需要的自由度（例如让免赔额只影响尺度、让车型影响尾部形状）；它与 [[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[insurance-distributional]]、[[insurance-zit-dglm]]（零膨胀分布回归）、[[insurance-gam]]、[[glm]]、[[tweedie]] 构成从经典到现代的完整谱系，其梯度提升版本见 [[gamboostlss]]，极值方向的同构思路见 [[evgam]]（GAM 形式的极值模型）；适合作定价、频度-强度建模与分布假设方向。说明：gamlss 与 gamlss.dist 属同一作者家族，本词条合并记录。
entries.body_en: GAMLSS (CRAN 5.5-0) implements the **generalized additive models for location, scale and shape** of Rigby and Stasinopoulos (2005): a **distributional regression** framework in which **every parameter** of the response’s conditional distribution (location μ, scale σ, skewness ν, kurtosis τ) is modelled with explanatory variables, rather than only the mean as in a GLM. That makes it a natural fit for the three defining features of insurance loss data: heavy tails, skewness and zero inflation. It depends on gamlss.data, **gamlss.dist** (the distribution library, still updated 2026-09-10), nlme and parallel, and Imports MASS and survival. For RIAA: in insurance pricing GAMLSS is often treated as **the direct upgrade from a GLM** — a GLM lets only the mean vary with rating factors, GAMLSS lets the whole distribution vary, which is exactly the extra freedom claim frequency-severity modelling needs (e.g. letting a deductible affect only the scale, or vehicle type affect the tail shape); it sits in a lineage from classical to modern alongside [[insurance-distributional-glm]], [[insurance-distributional]], [[insurance-zit-dglm]] (zero-inflated distributional regression), [[insurance-gam]], [[glm]] and [[tweedie]], with a gradient-boosting version in [[gamboostlss]] and a structurally similar idea for extremes in [[evgam]] (extreme value models in GAM form); suits pricing, frequency-severity modelling and distributional assumptions. Note: gamlss and gamlss.dist belong to the same author family and are recorded as one entry.
entries.body_hk: GAMLSS（CRAN 5.5-0）實現 Rigby & Stasinopoulos (2005) 提出的**廣義可加模型 for 位置、尺度與形狀**：這是一套**分布回歸**框架——響應變量條件分布的**全部參數**（位置 μ、尺度 σ、偏度 ν、峰度 τ）都用解釋變量建模，而不是像 GLM 那樣只建模均值。因此它天然適配保險損失數據的三大特徵：重尾、偏斜、零膨脹。依賴側掛 gamlss.data、**gamlss.dist**（分布庫，2026-09-10 仍在更新）與 nlme/parallel。對 RIAA：在保險定價裡 GAMLSS 常被當作「**GLM 的直接升級**」——GLM 只讓均值隨風險因子變，GAMLSS 讓整個分布隨因子變，這正是索賠頻度-強度建模最需要的自由度；與 [[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[insurance-distributional]]、[[insurance-zit-dglm]]、[[insurance-gam]]、[[glm]]、[[tweedie]] 構成完整譜系，梯度提升版本見 [[gamboostlss]]，極值方向的同構思路見 [[evgam]]；適合作定價、頻度-強度建模與分布假設方向。說明：gamlss 與 gamlss.dist 屬同一作者家族，本詞條合併記錄。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页面核实（v5.5-0；Rigby & Stasinopoulos 2005 分布回归框架；Depends 含 gamlss.data 与 gamlss.dist；gamlss.dist 于 2026-09-10 仍有更新），未实测

entries.summary_hk: D-藤 Copula 分位回歸（CRAN 0.13.0）：參數/非參數 pair-copula，直接給出條件分位數
entries.body: vinereg（CRAN 0.13.0）实现 **D-藤 Copula 分位回归（D-vine quantile regression）**，配对函数可用参数或非参数 pair-copula，方法出自 Kraus & Czado (2017) 与 Schallhorn et al. (2017)；底层依赖 rvinecopulib、kde1d 与 Rcpp（含 RcppEigen/RcppThread/BH）。它的定位是：**不建模条件均值，而是直接给出条件分位数**，并且允许变量之间的相依结构随协变量变化。对 RIAA：保险定价与风险度量真正关心的往往不是均值而是**条件分位数**（VaR、分位定价、高分位情景），而普通线性分位回归在多变量、非线性、尾部相依的数据上不够用——vinereg 把藤 Copula 的灵活性直接接到分位回归上，适合变量多、相依结构复杂且需要向尾部外推的场景；它属于 VineCopula/rvinecopulib 的作者生态（Python 侧对应 [[pyvinecopulib]]），与 [[vinecopula-r]]、[[copula-r]]、[[simcop]] 构成 copula 工具链，与 [[insurance-copula]]、[[insurance-vine-longitudinal]]（纵向 vine copula）、[[insurance-quantile]]（分位方法）在方法上直接对接；适合作相依建模、尾部风险与分位定价方向。
entries.body_en: vinereg (CRAN 0.13.0) implements **D-vine copula quantile regression**, with parametric or nonparametric pair-copulas, following Kraus & Czado (2017) and Schallhorn et al. (2017); it depends on rvinecopulib, kde1d and Rcpp (with RcppEigen/RcppThread/BH). Its positioning is precise: it does **not model the conditional mean but delivers conditional quantiles directly**, and it lets the dependence structure among variables vary with covariates. For RIAA: what insurance pricing and risk measurement actually care about is often a **conditional quantile** (VaR, quantile pricing, high-quantile scenarios), and ordinary linear quantile regression is insufficient on multivariate, non-linear data with tail dependence — vinereg wires the flexibility of vine copulas straight into quantile regression, suiting problems with many variables, complex dependence and a need to extrapolate into the tail; it belongs to the VineCopula/rvinecopulib author ecosystem (the Python counterpart being [[pyvinecopulib]]) and forms a copula toolchain with [[vinecopula-r]], [[copula-r]] and [[simcop]], connecting methodologically to [[insurance-copula]], [[insurance-vine-longitudinal]] (longitudinal vine copulas) and [[insurance-quantile]] (quantile methods); suits dependence modelling, tail risk and quantile pricing.
entries.body_hk: vinereg（CRAN 0.13.0）實現 **D-藤 Copula 分位回歸**，配對函數可用參數或非參數 pair-copula，方法出自 Kraus & Czado (2017) 與 Schallhorn et al. (2017)；底層依賴 rvinecopulib、kde1d 與 Rcpp。其定位是：**不建模條件均值，而是直接給出條件分位數**，並允許變量之間的相依結構隨協變量變化。對 RIAA：保險定價與風險度量真正關心的往往不是均值而是**條件分位數**（VaR、分位定價、高分位情景），而普通線性分位回歸在多變量、非線性、尾部相依的數據上不夠用——vinereg 把藤 Copula 的靈活性直接接到分位回歸上；它屬於 VineCopula/rvinecopulib 的作者生態（Python 側對應 [[pyvinecopulib]]），與 [[vinecopula-r]]、[[copula-r]]、[[simcop]] 構成 copula 工具鏈，與 [[insurance-copula]]、[[insurance-vine-longitudinal]]、[[insurance-quantile]] 在方法上直接對接；適合作相依建模、尾部風險與分位定價方向。

entries.title: synthpop（合成微数据与披露控制）
entries.title_hk: synthpop（合成微數據與披露控制）
entries.summary: 敏感微数据合成（CRAN 1.9-3）：序贯条件建模生成合成数据，效用与披露风险双评估
entries.summary_en: Synthetic microdata generation (CRAN 1.9-3): sequential conditional modelling, with joint assessment of utility and disclosure risk
entries.summary_hk: 敏感微數據合成（CRAN 1.9-3）：序貫條件建模生成合成數據，效用與披露風險雙評估
entries.body: synthpop（CRAN 1.9-3）用于生成**敏感微数据的合成版本**，目标是让含机密信息的数据可以安全发布给使用者做探索性分析：核心方法是对变量**逐个按条件分布序贯合成**（可选用参数模型或 CART 类分类回归树，底层 rpart/party），也提供 `sample`、`ipf`、`catall` 等一次性合成全部变量的非序贯方法；主函数 `syn()` 用默认设置时基本可自动化，也可由用户自定义方法，并通过参数调节**披露风险与分析质量之间的取舍**。包里另含**效用评估**与**披露风险度量**两套工具（附 Utility 与 Disclosure 两篇 vignette）。对 RIAA：保险数据高度敏感（保单、健康、理赔），跨机构共享、模型开发与外部验证常受隐私约束，合成数据是最主流的解法；synthpop 是官方统计领域的经典实现，其关键设计在于**同时给出效用与披露风险两套度量**，而不是只追求「看起来像」——这正是保险场景最需要的证据链；它与 [[sdv]]（Python 侧通用合成数据）、[[ctgan-r]]（GAN 路线）、[[insurance-datasets-synthetic]]（保险合成数据集）、[[gen-syn]]、[[gnotheia]] 构成合成数据工具矩阵，与 [[insurance-synthetic]] 在应用场景上直接对应；适合作数据隐私、合成数据与建模数据准备方向。
entries.body_en: synthpop (CRAN 1.9-3) generates **synthetic versions of sensitive microdata** so that confidential data can be released safely for exploratory analysis: its core method synthesises variables **one by one from conditional distributions** (parametric models or CART-type classification and regression trees, via rpart/party), and it also offers non-sequential methods (`sample`, `ipf`, `catall`) that synthesise all variables at once; the main function `syn()` is largely automatable with defaults or user-defined methods, and its parameters tune the **trade-off between disclosure risk and analytical quality**. The package also ships tools for **assessing utility** and **measuring disclosure risk** (with dedicated Utility and Disclosure vignettes). For RIAA: insurance data is highly sensitive (policies, health, claims), and cross-institution sharing, model development and external validation are all constrained by privacy — synthetic data is the mainstream answer, and synthpop is the classic implementation from official statistics; its key design is that it reports **both utility and disclosure-risk measures** rather than merely aiming for "looks similar", which is exactly the evidence chain insurance work needs; it forms a synthetic-data toolkit with [[sdv]] (general-purpose synthesis in Python), [[ctgan-r]] (the GAN route), [[insurance-datasets-synthetic]] (insurance synthetic datasets), [[gen-syn]] and [[gnotheia]], and corresponds directly to [[insurance-synthetic]] in application; suits data privacy, synthetic data and modelling-data preparation.
entries.body_hk: synthpop（CRAN 1.9-3）用於生成**敏感微數據的合成版本**，目標是讓含機密資訊的數據可以安全發布給使用者做探索性分析：核心方法是對變量**逐個按條件分布序貫合成**（可選參數模型或 CART 類分類回歸樹，底層 rpart/party），也提供 `sample`、`ipf`、`catall` 等一次性合成全部變量的非序貫方法；主函數 `syn()` 用預設設置時基本可自動化，也可由用戶自訂方法，並透過參數調節**披露風險與分析質量之間的取捨**。包裡另含**效用評估**與**披露風險度量**兩套工具（附 Utility 與 Disclosure 兩篇 vignette）。對 RIAA：保險數據高度敏感（保單、健康、理賠），跨機構共享、模型開發與外部驗證常受隱私約束，合成數據是最主流的解法；synthpop 是官方統計領域的經典實現，其關鍵設計在於**同時給出效用與披露風險兩套度量**；它與 [[sdv]]、[[ctgan-r]]、[[insurance-datasets-synthetic]]、[[gen-syn]]、[[gnotheia]] 構成合成數據工具矩陣，與 [[insurance-synthetic]] 在應用場景上直接對應；適合作數據隱私、合成數據與建模數據準備方向。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页面核实（v1.9-3，2026-09-10 更新；序贯条件合成 + sample/ipf/catall 非序贯方法；含效用与披露风险两套评估及两篇 vignette），未实测

entries.body: 高峰进修学院考试中心（PEAK Examination Centre，职业训练局 VTC 旗下，`peak.edu.hk/exam/`）是**香港多个法定与专业资格考试的官方举办机构**，其考试清单本身就是一张「香港持牌职业资格地图」：**保险中介人资格考试（IIQE）**、**强制性公积金计划考试（MPFE）**、地产代理/营业员资格考试、二级游乐船只操作人合格证明书考试、**ESG 认证专业人员考试**、专利代理人资格考试、升降机及自动梯工程师注册考试、杠杆式外汇交易考试、保安人员技能测试等；考点位于湾仔活道 27 号 VTC 大楼 1 楼，站内提供考试选择、在线报名流程（econline）、考试手册与 FAQ。对 RIAA：这是**本 wiki 既有 IIQE 与 MPFE 词条的官方源头**——[[iiqe-1]]（保险原理及实务）、[[iiqe-2]]（一般保险）、[[iiqe-3]]（长期保险）、[[iiqe-5]]（投资相连长期保险）与 [[mpfe]]（强积金考试）此前都只有知识内容而没有权威出处，本词条把它们锚定到官方考务入口；在香港，IIQE 是**从事保险中介工作的法定前置**，与精算资格（[[ashk-examination]]、[[iaa]] 体系）分属「执业主线」与「专业深化主线」两条路径，同属 [[industry-cpd]] 所描述的行业能力建设范畴；备考侧可与 [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]]（偿二代题库）、[[cii-ds-ai-qualification]] 搭配；适合作入行准备、执业资格与考试规划方向。
entries.body_en: The PEAK Examination Centre (under the Vocational Training Council, `peak.edu.hk/exam/`) is **the official administering body for several statutory and professional examinations in Hong Kong**, and its examination list is itself a map of licensed professions in the city: the **Insurance Intermediaries Qualifying Examination (IIQE)**, the **Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Examination (MPFE)**, estate agent/salesperson qualifying examinations, the Pleasure Vessel Operator Grade 2 certificate examination, the **ESG Certified Professional Examination**, the patent attorney qualification examination, lift and escalator engineer registration examinations, leveraged foreign exchange trading examinations and security-guard trade tests. The centre is at 1/F, VTC Tower, 27 Wood Road, Wan Chai, and the site offers exam selection, an online enrolment flow (econline), handbooks and FAQs. For RIAA: this is **the official source behind this wiki’s existing IIQE and MPFE entries** — [[iiqe-1]] (principles and practice of insurance), [[iiqe-2]] (general insurance), [[iiqe-3]] (long term insurance), [[iiqe-5]] (investment-linked long term insurance) and [[mpfe]] previously carried only content and no authoritative origin, and this entry anchors them to the official examination portal; in Hong Kong the IIQE is a **statutory prerequisite for insurance intermediary work**, sitting on the "practising licence" line as distinct from the "professional deepening" line of actuarial qualifications ([[ashk-examination]], the [[iaa]] system), both falling under the industry capability building described by [[industry-cpd]]; for exam preparation it pairs with [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]] (the C-ROSS question bank) and [[cii-ds-ai-qualification]]; suits entry preparation, practising qualifications and exam planning.
entries.body_hk: 高峰進修學院考試中心（PEAK Examination Centre，職業訓練局 VTC 旗下，`peak.edu.hk/exam/`）是**香港多個法定與專業資格考試的官方舉辦機構**，其考試清單本身就是一張「香港持牌職業資格地圖」：**保險中介人資格考試（IIQE）**、**強制性公積金計劃考試（MPFE）**、地產代理/營業員資格考試、二級遊樂船隻操作人合格證明書考試、**ESG 認證專業人員考試**、專利代理人資格考試、升降機及自動梯工程師註冊考試、槓桿式外匯交易考試、保安人員技能測試等；考點位於灣仔活道 27 號 VTC 大樓 1 樓。對 RIAA：這是**本 wiki 既有 IIQE 與 MPFE 詞條的官方源頭**——[[iiqe-1]]、[[iiqe-2]]、[[iiqe-3]]、[[iiqe-5]] 與 [[mpfe]] 此前都只有知識內容而沒有權威出處，本詞條把它們錨定到官方考務入口；在香港，IIQE 是**從事保險中介工作的法定前置**，與精算資格（[[ashk-examination]]、[[iaa]] 體系）分屬「執業主線」與「專業深化主線」兩條路徑；備考側可與 [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]]、[[cii-ds-ai-qualification]] 搭配；適合作入行準備、執業資格與考試規劃方向。

entries.summary: 英国保险业专业团体与资格授予机构：ACII/FCII 资格体系与全球会员网络
entries.summary_en: The UK insurance profession’s chartered body and awarding organisation: the ACII/FCII qualification pathway and a global member network

entries.body: 英国特许保险学会（Chartered Insurance Institute, CII，`cii.co.uk`）是**英国保险与金融服务业的专业团体与资格授予机构**，也是全球历史最悠久、覆盖面最广的**保险（非精算）专业资格体系**之一——其 ACII（特许保险师）与 FCII（资深）层级是英联邦体系保险从业者的主流资格标识，覆盖一般保险、寿险、经纪、理赔、承保与风险管理等方向。站内结构围绕「选定地区 → 资格与学习路径 → 会员与 CPD」展开（首次访问会要求选择国家/地区以呈现对应产品与服务，说明其资格体系在多国运作）。对 RIAA：本 wiki 此前只有 CII 的**单一产品**词条 [[cii-ds-ai-qualification]]（数据科学与 AI 资格），而**机构本体缺位**；在香港，CII 资格在核保、理赔与经纪群体中相当普遍，与法定前置的 IIQE 体系（[[iiqe-1]] 等，官方入口见 [[peak-exam-centre]]）构成「**法定执业 vs 专业资格**」两层结构，可对照同类保险专业团体 [[anziif]]（澳新）与 [[loma]]（美/寿险运营），精算侧的对应团体见 [[ashk]]、[[ifoa]]、[[iaa]]；适合作职业资格规划、保险实务方向与跨地区资格对比。
entries.body_en: The Chartered Insurance Institute (CII, `cii.co.uk`) is **the professional body and awarding organisation for the UK insurance and financial services profession**, and one of the world’s oldest and broadest **insurance (non-actuarial) qualification systems** — its ACII (Chartered Insurer) and FCII tiers are the mainstream credential among insurance practitioners across the Commonwealth, spanning general insurance, life, broking, claims, underwriting and risk management. The site is organised around "select your region → qualifications and study routes → membership and CPD" (first-time visitors are asked to choose a country/region so that relevant products and services are shown, evidencing a qualification system operating across many countries). For RIAA: this wiki previously held only a **single CII product** entry, [[cii-ds-ai-qualification]] (the data science and AI qualification), while **the institute itself was missing**; in Hong Kong, CII qualifications are common among underwriters, claims staff and brokers and form a two-layer structure with the statutory IIQE prerequisite ([[iiqe-1]] etc., official portal at [[peak-exam-centre]]) — "**statutory licence vs professional qualification**" — comparable to peer insurance bodies [[anziif]] (Australia/New Zealand) and [[loma]] (US, life operations), and to the actuarial-side bodies [[ashk]], [[ifoa]] and [[iaa]]; suits qualification planning, insurance practice and cross-region qualification comparison.
entries.body_hk: 英國特許保險學會（Chartered Insurance Institute, CII，`cii.co.uk`）是**英國保險與金融服務業的專業團體與資格授予機構**，也是全球歷史最悠久、覆蓋面最廣的**保險（非精算）專業資格體系**之一——其 ACII（特許保險師）與 FCII 層級是英聯邦體系保險從業者的主流資格標識，覆蓋一般保險、壽險、經紀、理賠、承保與風險管理等方向。站內結構圍繞「選定地區 → 資格與學習路徑 → 會員與 CPD」展開。對 RIAA：本 wiki 此前只有 CII 的**單一產品**詞條 [[cii-ds-ai-qualification]]，而**機構本體缺位**；在香港，CII 資格在核保、理賠與經紀群體中相當普遍，與法定前置的 IIQE 體系（[[iiqe-1]] 等，官方入口見 [[peak-exam-centre]]）構成「**法定執業 vs 專業資格**」兩層結構，可對照同類保險專業團體 [[anziif]] 與 [[loma]]，精算側見 [[ashk]]、[[ifoa]]、[[iaa]]；適合作職業資格規劃、保險實務方向與跨地區資格對比。

entries.title: 澳新保险学会（ANZIIF）
entries.title_en: Australian and New Zealand Institute of Insurance and Finance (ANZIIF)
entries.summary: 澳新保险与金融专业团体：按领域组织（理赔/一般保险/经纪/再保/风险管理/寿险）的资格与 CPD
entries.summary_en: The Australia/New Zealand insurance and finance professional body: qualifications and CPD organised by sector (claims, general insurance, broking, reinsurance, risk management, life)
entries.summary_hk: 澳新保險與金融專業團體：按領域組織（理賠/一般保險/經紀/再保/風險管理/壽險）的資格與 CPD
entries.body: 澳新保险学会（Australian and New Zealand Institute of Insurance and Finance, ANZIIF，`anziif.com`）是**澳大利亚与新西兰保险及金融服务业的教育与专业团体**，也是亚太地区影响最广的保险专业资格与持续教育提供方之一。其站内结构价值很高：**按领域（View by Sector）**组织内容——理赔（Claims）、一般保险（General Insurance）、保险经纪（Insurance Broking）、**再保险（Reinsurance）**、风险管理（Risk Management）、寿险与退休收入（Life and Retirement Income）；专业发展侧提供短期课程、**资格（Qualifications）**、技能单元、合规课程、网络研讨会与点播活动，并出版 **The Journal**（行业期刊）；另设**先前学习认可（Recognition of Prior Learning, RPL）**、学术日历与评估体系，以及「Your Career in Insurance」职业路径指南。对 RIAA：这是「**保险实务的体系化学习路径**」在亚太的样板——尤其它的**按险种/职能分域组织**方式，正好对应对口岗位（[[underwriter]] 核保、[[claims-specialist]] 理赔、[[insurance-broker]] 经纪）；与英国体系的 [[cii]]、美国寿险运营方向的 [[loma]] 构成三大保险专业团体参照系，精算侧见 [[actuaries-institute]]；市场数据侧可接 [[apra-insurance-statistics]]；适合作职业路径规划、实务技能与亚太市场方向。
entries.body_en: The Australian and New Zealand Institute of Insurance and Finance (ANZIIF, `anziif.com`) is **the education and professional body for insurance and financial services in Australia and New Zealand**, and one of the most influential providers of insurance qualifications and continuing education in the Asia-Pacific. Its site structure is notably useful: content is organised **by sector** — Claims, General Insurance, Insurance Broking, **Reinsurance**, Risk Management, and Life and Retirement Income; the professional development side offers short courses, **qualifications**, skills units, compliance courses, webinars and on-demand events, and it publishes **The Journal**; it also operates **Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL)**, an academic calendar and an assessment system, plus a "Your Career in Insurance" pathway guide. For RIAA: a template for **systematic learning pathways in insurance practice** in Asia-Pacific — especially its organisation by line of business and function, which maps directly onto counterpart roles ([[underwriter]], [[claims-specialist]], [[insurance-broker]]); with the UK system’s [[cii]] and the US life-operations-oriented [[loma]] it forms a three-way reference frame of insurance professional bodies, while the actuarial side is [[actuaries-institute]]; market data can connect to [[apra-insurance-statistics]]; suits career-path planning, practical skills and Asia-Pacific market work.
entries.body_hk: 澳新保險學會（Australian and New Zealand Institute of Insurance and Finance, ANZIIF，`anziif.com`）是**澳大利亞與紐西蘭保險及金融服務業的教育與專業團體**，也是亞太地區影響最廣的保險專業資格與持續教育提供方之一。其站內結構價值很高：**按領域（View by Sector）**組織內容——理賠、一般保險、保險經紀、**再保險**、風險管理、壽險與退休收入；專業發展側提供短期課程、**資格**、技能單元、合規課程、網絡研討會與點播活動，並出版 **The Journal**；另設**先前學習認可（RPL）**、學術日曆與評估體系。對 RIAA：這是「**保險實務的體系化學習路徑**」在亞太的樣板——其按險種/職能分域的組織方式正好對應對口崗位（[[underwriter]]、[[claims-specialist]]、[[insurance-broker]]）；與英國體系的 [[cii]]、美國壽險運營方向的 [[loma]] 構成三大保險專業團體參照系，精算側見 [[actuaries-institute]]；市場數據側可接 [[apra-insurance-statistics]]；適合作職業路徑規劃、實務技能與亞太市場方向。

entries.summary: 寿险/健康险运营与教育机构：行业能力课程、FLMI 类资格与 MarketFacts 行业研究
entries.summary_en: Life and health insurance operations and education body: industry capability programmes, FLMI-type designations and the MarketFacts research publication
entries.summary_hk: 壽險/健康險運營與教育機構：行業能力課程、FLMI 類資格與 MarketFacts 行業研究
entries.body: LOMA（`loma.org`，Life Office Management Association）是**面向寿险与健康险运营与管理的国际教育与研究机构**，与偏重核保/经纪的 [[cii]]、[[anziif]] 不同，它的重心落在**保险公司的运营与后台职能**：产品设计、核保运营、客服与理赔处理、分销与渠道管理、财务与合规运营，以及行业人才培养体系（Industry Advantage 一类的岗位能力学习方案，以及其经典资格体系）。同时它出版 **MarketFacts** 行业研究刊物——可核实的最新一期（2026 年 9 月）覆盖了寿险意识月、领导力重建、年轻人与寿险、遗属需求、最终费用市场（final expense）、寿险赔付、分销结构变化、**研究与 AI**、加拿大团体福利等主题。对 RIAA：寿险公司的岗位远不止精算——运营、产品、渠道与后台职能是应届生进入寿险业的主要入口之一，LOMA 提供的正是这条路径的**知识地图与行业语汇**；其 MarketFacts 的研究选题（分销变化、最终费用市场、AI 在保险研究中的应用）也是面试与行业作业的现成素材；与 [[lifeinsurer]]（寿险公司图谱）、[[gn16]]（香港分红披露）、[[vhis-portal]]（香港自愿医保制度）搭配可覆盖「运营 + 产品 + 披露」三块；适合作寿险运营、产品管理与行业研究方向。
entries.body_en: LOMA (`loma.org`, the Life Office Management Association) is an **international education and research body focused on life and health insurance operations and management**. Unlike [[cii]] and [[anziif]], which lean toward underwriting and broking, LOMA’s centre of gravity is the **insurer’s operations and back office**: product design, underwriting operations, customer service and claims processing, distribution and channel management, finance and compliance operations, and the industry’s talent development systems (capability programmes such as Industry Advantage, alongside its classic designation framework). It also publishes the **MarketFacts** research publication — the verifiable current issue (September 2026) covers Life Insurance Awareness Month, rebuilding leadership, young adults and life insurance, supporting widows’ needs, the final expense market, life insurance payouts, shifts in distribution, research and AI, and Canadian benefits. For RIAA: roles at a life insurer go far beyond actuarial work — operations, product, distribution and back-office functions are among the main entry points for graduates, and LOMA supplies the **knowledge map and industry vocabulary** for that route; its MarketFacts topics (distribution shifts, the final expense market, AI in insurance research) are ready material for interviews and industry assignments; together with [[lifeinsurer]] (the life insurer landscape), [[gn16]] (Hong Kong dividend disclosure) and [[vhis-portal]] (the Hong Kong VHIS scheme) it covers "operations + product + disclosure"; suits life insurance operations, product management and industry research.
entries.body_hk: LOMA（`loma.org`，Life Office Management Association）是**面向壽險與健康險運營與管理的國際教育與研究機構**，與偏重核保/經紀的 [[cii]]、[[anziif]] 不同，它的重心落在**保險公司的運營與後台職能**：產品設計、核保運營、客服與理賠處理、分銷與渠道管理、財務與合規運營，以及行業人才培養體系（Industry Advantage 一類的崗位能力學習方案，以及其經典資格體系）。同時它出版 **MarketFacts** 行業研究刊物——可核實的最新一期（2026 年 9 月）覆蓋壽險意識月、領導力重建、年輕人與壽險、遺屬需求、最終費用市場、壽險賠付、分銷結構變化、**研究與 AI**、加拿大團體福利等主題。對 RIAA：壽險公司的崗位遠不止精算——運營、產品、渠道與後台職能是應屆生進入壽險業的主要入口之一，LOMA 提供的正是這條路徑的**知識地圖與行業語彙**；與 [[lifeinsurer]]、[[gn16]]、[[vhis-portal]] 搭配可覆蓋「運營 + 產品 + 披露」三塊；適合作壽險運營、產品管理與行業研究方向。

entries.summary: 日本金融厅英文统计页：主要保险公司财务结果概览 + 银行/不良贷款/衍生品等金融统计
entries.summary_en: The Japan FSA’s English statistics page: overview of major insurance companies’ financial results plus banking, NPL and derivatives statistics
entries.summary_hk: 日本金融廳英文統計頁：主要保險公司財務結果概覽 + 銀行/不良貸款/衍生品等金融統計
entries.body: 日本金融厅（Financial Services Agency, FSA）的英文统计页（`fsa.go.jp/en/regulated/statistics/`）是**日本金融监管口径的一手数据入口**，栏目包括：**Overview of financial results of major insurance companies**（主要保险公司财务结果概览——保险业最关键的一栏）、Status of Non-Performing Loans（不良贷款状况）、Overview of major banks’ / regional banks’ financial results、subprime-related product exposures、OTC 衍生品交易汇总、存款保险机构（DICJ）金融援助与资本注入、以及日本银行（BOJ）统计的入口。对 RIAA：本 wiki 的亚洲监管统计轴此前已有日本**行业协会口径**（[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]，LIAJ 的月度统计与 Fact Book），但**监管机构口径**缺位——FSA 这一栏正好补上「监管者眼中的日本保险业财务结果」，两者构成「行业统计 vs 监管披露」的配对（同一市场两个口径互相校验，是做市场分析作业时最容易踩坑的地方）；可与中国（[[nfra-statistics]]）、韩国（[[fss-korea-insurance]]）、台湾（[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]）、新加坡（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]）、澳洲（[[apra-insurance-statistics]]）在区域内横向比较，跨国口径见 [[oecd-insurance-data]] 与 [[iais-gimar]]；适合作亚洲市场分析、监管比较与跨国财务对比。
entries.body_en: The English statistics page of Japan’s Financial Services Agency (FSA, `fsa.go.jp/en/regulated/statistics/`) is **a first-hand data entry point for Japan’s financial regulatory perspective**. Its sections include: **Overview of financial results of major insurance companies** (the key one for insurance), status of non-performing loans, overviews of major and regional banks’ financial results, subprime-related product exposures, aggregates of OTC derivative transactions, financial assistance and capital injection by the Deposit Insurance Corporation of Japan, and a gateway to Bank of Japan statistics. For RIAA: this wiki’s Asian regulatory-statistics axis already had Japan at the **industry-association level** ([[japan-life-insurance-statistics]], LIAJ’s monthly statistics and Fact Book) but was **missing the regulator’s view** — the FSA section supplies exactly "the Japanese insurance industry’s financial results as the supervisor sees them", forming a pair with the industry data as "**industry statistics vs regulatory disclosure**" (two perspectives on one market that cross-check each other — and the easiest place to slip up in a market-analysis assignment); it supports regional comparison with China ([[nfra-statistics]]), Korea ([[fss-korea-insurance]]), Taiwan ([[tii-taiwan-insurance]]), Singapore ([[mas-insurance-statistics]]) and Australia ([[apra-insurance-statistics]]), and cross-country series via [[oecd-insurance-data]] and [[iais-gimar]]; suits Asian market analysis, regulatory comparison and cross-country financial comparison.
entries.body_hk: 日本金融廳（Financial Services Agency, FSA）的英文統計頁（`fsa.go.jp/en/regulated/statistics/`）是**日本金融監管口徑的一手數據入口**，欄目包括：**Overview of financial results of major insurance companies**（主要保險公司財務結果概覽——保險業最關鍵的一欄）、不良貸款狀況、主要銀行/地區銀行財務結果、次貸相關產品敞口、OTC 衍生品交易匯總、存款保險機構金融援助與資本注入、以及日本銀行（BOJ）統計入口。對 RIAA：本 wiki 的亞洲監管統計軸此前已有日本**行業協會口徑**（[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]），但**監管機構口徑**缺位——FSA 這一欄正好補上「監管者眼中的日本保險業財務結果」，兩者構成「行業統計 vs 監管披露」的配對；可與中國（[[nfra-statistics]]）、韓國（[[fss-korea-insurance]]）、台灣（[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]）、新加坡（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]）、澳洲（[[apra-insurance-statistics]]）橫向比較，跨國口徑見 [[oecd-insurance-data]] 與 [[iais-gimar]]；適合作亞洲市場分析、監管比較與跨國財務對比。

entries.body: 台湾金融监督管理委员会保险局（Insurance Bureau, Financial Supervisory Commission，`ib.gov.tw/en/`）是**台湾保险业的监管机构**，英文站结构完整：About the IB / Our Director General / Organization、Bulletin Board 与 Press Release、**Important Measures**、**International Activities**、Enforcement（执法），法规侧提供 **Insurance Laws and Regulations DataBase** 与金管会法规数据库，数据侧提供 **Insurance Information and Statistics / Statistics** 与 **Life Insurance Product**（寿险商品）栏目，另有 Publications 与消费者保护专区（含金融消费者保护法）。对 RIAA：台湾是亚洲重要的寿险市场（寿险密度与渗透率长期居前），而本 wiki 此前只有**行业研究机构**口径（[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]，台湾保险事业发展中心）——本词条补上**监管机构口径**，两者一「研究/行业」一「监管/法规」，正好覆盖台湾市场的两种信息需求；其法规数据库与寿险商品栏目对做**产品比较与监管比较**的作业特别有用；与中国（[[nfra-statistics]]、[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]] 一类的精算条例对照）、香港（[[hk-ia-statistics]]）、韩国（[[fss-korea-insurance]]）构成大中华与东亚监管对照；适合作市场分析、法规比较与产品研究方向。
entries.body_en: The Insurance Bureau of Taiwan’s Financial Supervisory Commission (`ib.gov.tw/en/`) is **Taiwan’s insurance regulator**, with a well-structured English site: About the IB / Our Director General / Organization, a bulletin board and press releases, **Important Measures**, **International Activities** and Enforcement; on the regulatory side it offers an **Insurance Laws and Regulations DataBase** and the FSC laws database, and on the data side an **Insurance Information and Statistics / Statistics** section plus a **Life Insurance Product** section, along with Publications and a consumer-protection area (including the Financial Consumer Protection Act). For RIAA: Taiwan is a major Asian life market (long among the leaders in life insurance density and penetration), and this wiki previously held only the **industry research institute** perspective ([[tii-taiwan-insurance]], the Taiwan Insurance Institute) — this entry adds the **regulator’s perspective**, giving one "research/industry" and one "regulatory/legal" source for the two information needs a Taiwan market study has; its laws database and life product sections are especially useful for **product comparison and regulatory comparison** assignments; with China ([[nfra-statistics]] and actuarial-regulation contrasts such as [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]), Hong Kong ([[hk-ia-statistics]]) and Korea ([[fss-korea-insurance]]) it forms a Greater China and East Asia regulatory frame; suits market analysis, regulatory comparison and product research.
entries.body_hk: 台灣金融監督管理委員會保險局（Insurance Bureau, Financial Supervisory Commission，`ib.gov.tw/en/`）是**台灣保險業的監管機構**，英文站結構完整：About the IB / Our Director General / Organization、Bulletin Board 與 Press Release、**Important Measures**、**International Activities**、Enforcement，法規側提供 **Insurance Laws and Regulations DataBase**，數據側提供 **Insurance Information and Statistics / Statistics** 與 **Life Insurance Product** 欄目，另有 Publications 與消費者保護專區。對 RIAA：台灣是亞洲重要的壽險市場，而本 wiki 此前只有**行業研究機構**口徑（[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]）——本詞條補上**監管機構口徑**，兩者覆蓋台灣市場的兩種資訊需求；其法規數據庫與壽險商品欄目對**產品比較與監管比較**作業特別有用；與中國（[[nfra-statistics]]）、香港（[[hk-ia-statistics]]）、韓國（[[fss-korea-insurance]]）構成大中華與東亞監管對照；適合作市場分析、法規比較與產品研究方向。

entries.body: 菲律宾保险委员会（Insurance Commission, IC，隶属财政部 DOF）是**菲律宾保险业的监管机构**，其发布的 **Key Data** 统计附件（`insurance.gov.ph` 上的 Annex A，覆盖 2019–2023 年，含寿险分项数据）是菲律宾保险市场**官方口径的市场规模与结构数据**。对 RIAA：菲律宾是东南亚人口过亿、保险渗透率仍低因而增长空间明确的市场，属于东盟市场分析的常见选题；本 wiki 的东盟侧此前已有新加坡（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]）、马来西亚（[[bnm-insurance-takaful]]，含 takaful）、印尼（[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]）——菲律宾补上东盟第四大市场，与 [[iais-gimar]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]] 的跨国口径，以及 [[geneva-association]] 一类的保障缺口（protection gap）研究互为参照；适合作新兴市场分析、东盟比较与保障缺口方向。**核实说明**：该机构官网首页受 Cloudflare 保护（HTTP 403），本词条仅**引用并核实了可直接访问的官方统计附件**（745KB PDF，已验证为 IC Statistics / Life Insurance 数据表），未对其门户网站内容作描述。
entries.body_en: The Insurance Commission (IC) of the Philippines, under the Department of Finance, is **the country’s insurance regulator**; its **Key Data** statistical annex (Annex A on `insurance.gov.ph`, covering 2019–2023 and including life insurance breakdowns) is **official-source data on the size and structure of the Philippine insurance market**. For RIAA: the Philippines has a population above 100 million and still-low insurance penetration, hence clear growth headroom, making it a common subject for ASEAN market analysis; this wiki’s ASEAN coverage previously had Singapore ([[mas-insurance-statistics]]), Malaysia ([[bnm-insurance-takaful]], including takaful) and Indonesia ([[ojk-insurance-statistics]]) — the Philippines adds ASEAN’s fourth major market, complementing the cross-country series of [[iais-gimar]] and [[oecd-insurance-data]] and protection-gap research such as that of [[geneva-association]]; suits emerging-market analysis, ASEAN comparison and protection-gap work. **Verification note**: the commission’s homepage is behind Cloudflare (HTTP 403), so this entry **cites and verifies only the directly accessible official statistics annex** (a 745KB PDF confirmed to contain IC Statistics / Life Insurance tables) and makes no claims about the portal’s other content.
entries.body_hk: 菲律賓保險委員會（Insurance Commission, IC，隸屬財政部 DOF）是**菲律賓保險業的監管機構**，其發布的 **Key Data** 統計附件（`insurance.gov.ph` 上的 Annex A，覆蓋 2019–2023 年，含壽險分項數據）是菲律賓保險市場**官方口徑的市場規模與結構數據**。對 RIAA：菲律賓是東南亞人口過億、保險滲透率仍低因而增長空間明確的市場，屬東盟市場分析的常見選題；本 wiki 的東盟側此前已有新加坡（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]）、馬來西亞（[[bnm-insurance-takaful]]，含 takaful）、印尼（[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]）——菲律賓補上東盟第四大市場，與 [[iais-gimar]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]] 的跨國口徑及 [[geneva-association]] 一類保障缺口研究互為參照；適合作新興市場分析、東盟比較與保障缺口方向。**核實說明**：該機構官網首頁受 Cloudflare 保護（HTTP 403），本詞條僅**引用並核實了可直接訪問的官方統計附件**（745KB PDF），未對其門戶網站其他內容作描述。

entries.body: 日本损保料率算出机构（General Insurance Rating Organization of Japan, GIROJ，`giroj.or.jp/english/`）是**日本法定的非寿险费率厘定机构**——这是一类在多数市场并不存在的机构：它负责计算并公布**参考纯率（reference loss cost rates）**与法定汽车责任保险等险种的费率，供各家保险公司使用。英文站的三大业务栏目正是它的职能：**Ratemaking（费率厘定）**、**ClaimsSurvey（理赔调查）**、**DataBank（数据库）**，另设 **Disclosure & Publication**、Press 与 Links。可核实的近期公告（2026-08）包括：**Voluntary Automobile Insurance 与 Personal Accident Insurance 的参考纯率修订**，以及 **「按都道府县分类的地震保险附着率（Attachment Ratio）趋势」**更新——后者的地震保险附着率是观察日本巨灾保险渗透的独特指标。对 RIAA：这是理解「**费率标准由谁定、行业如何共用一套纯率**」的极佳对照样本——它与中国的 [[china-insurance-association]]（发布行业**示范条款及费率表**）、以及各市场的商业费率机构形成「**行业统一定价基准**」这一共同现象的不同制度形态；在定价与风险量化侧，参考纯率与日本地震保险的附着率数据可接入 [[catmodeling]] 与 [[cat-bond-pricing]]（日本地震风险是 ILS 市场的重要标的）；市场数据侧与 [[japan-fsa-statistics]]（监管口径）、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]（寿险行业协会口径）构成日本市场三源；适合作费率厘定、巨灾保险与监管比较方向。
entries.body_en: The General Insurance Rating Organization of Japan (GIROJ, `giroj.or.jp/english/`) is **Japan’s statutory non-life insurance ratemaking body** — an institution that does not exist in most markets: it calculates and publishes **reference loss cost rates** and the rates for lines such as compulsory automobile liability insurance, for member insurers to use. Its three main operations on the English site are exactly that mandate: **Ratemaking**, **ClaimsSurvey** and **DataBank**, alongside **Disclosure & Publication**, press and links. Verifiable recent announcements (August 2026) include **revisions of reference loss cost rates for voluntary automobile insurance and personal accident insurance**, and an update to **"Trends in Attachment Ratio of Earthquake Insurance, Classified by Prefecture"** — the earthquake insurance attachment ratio being a distinctive indicator of catastrophe insurance penetration in Japan. For RIAA: an excellent comparative sample of "**who sets the rate standard and how an industry shares one set of loss cost rates**" — it forms different institutional shapes of the same phenomenon alongside China’s [[china-insurance-association]] (which issues industry **model clauses and rate tables**) and commercial rating bureaux in other markets; on the pricing and risk-quantification side, reference loss cost rates and Japanese earthquake attachment data connect to [[catmodeling]] and [[cat-bond-pricing]] (Japanese earthquake risk is a major ILS subject); on market data it makes Japan a three-source market with [[japan-fsa-statistics]] (regulatory) and [[japan-life-insurance-statistics]] (life industry association); suits ratemaking, catastrophe insurance and regulatory comparison.
entries.body_hk: 日本損保料率算出機構（General Insurance Rating Organization of Japan, GIROJ，`giroj.or.jp/english/`）是**日本法定的非壽險費率釐定機構**——這是一類在多數市場並不存在的機構：它負責計算並公布**參考純率（reference loss cost rates）**與法定汽車責任保險等險種的費率，供各家保險公司使用。英文站的三大業務欄目正是它的職能：**Ratemaking（費率釐定）**、**ClaimsSurvey（理賠調查）**、**DataBank（數據庫）**，另設 **Disclosure & Publication**、Press 與 Links。可核實的近期公告（2026-08）包括：**Voluntary Automobile Insurance 與 Personal Accident Insurance 的參考純率修訂**，以及**「按都道府縣分類的地震保險附加率趨勢」**更新。對 RIAA：這是理解「**費率標準由誰定、行業如何共用一套純率**」的極佳對照樣本——它與中國的 [[china-insurance-association]]（發布行業**示範條款及費率表**）形成「**行業統一定價基準**」這一共同現象的不同制度形態；定價與風險量化側可接入 [[catmodeling]] 與 [[cat-bond-pricing]]；市場數據側與 [[japan-fsa-statistics]]（監管口徑）、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]（壽險行業協會口徑）構成日本市場三源；適合作費率釐定、巨災保險與監管比較方向。

entries.body: SOA（Society of Actuaries，北美精算师协会）官方教育入口（`soa.org/education/overview/`）是**整条北美精算资格路径的权威起点**，站内结构可核实且完整：**Future Actuaries**（What is an Actuary / Why Become an Actuary / How to Become an Actuary）、**Education & Exams**（**Exams & Requirements** 考试与要求、University Resources、Educational Pathways）、三大资格 **ASA（准精算师）/ FSA（正精算师）/ CERA（特许企业风险分析师）** 与 Micro-Credentials、**Exam Registration 与 Exam Results**、**Past Exams and Solutions（历年真题与解答）**、**VEE（Validation by Educational Experience，教育经历认证）**、以及面向院校的 **UCAP（Universities & Colleges with Actuarial Programs）**、**CAE（Centers of Actuarial Excellence）** 与 **UEC（University-Earned Credit，校内学分抵免）** 计划、**Hickman Scholars** 奖学金；研究侧另有 **Artificial Intelligence** 与 **Catastrophe and Climate** 等研究专题。对 RIAA：这是**「要考什么、怎么抵免、真题在哪」的唯一权威来源**——特别是 **Past Exams and Solutions** 与 **UEC/VEE** 两块，前者是备考的核心材料，后者决定岭大/RIM 课程能否抵免考试；与 [[soa-jobs]]（就业）、[[soa-practice-tools]]（实务工具）、[[soa-exam-pa-r-doc]]（PA 科目 R 文档）、[[actuarial-exam-database]] 搭配可覆盖「路径 → 材料 → 工具」；与 [[ifoa-studying]]、[[cas-syllabus]] 构成三大体系的官方对照，区域性资格见 [[ashk]]、[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]；适合作考试规划、资格路径与院校抵免方向。
entries.body_en: The SOA’s (Society of Actuaries) official education portal (`soa.org/education/overview/`) is **the authoritative starting point for the entire North American actuarial qualification pathway**, with a verifiable and complete structure: **Future Actuaries** (What is an Actuary / Why Become an Actuary / How to Become an Actuary), **Education & Exams** (**Exams & Requirements**, University Resources, Educational Pathways), the three designations **ASA / FSA / CERA** plus Micro-Credentials, **Exam Registration and Exam Results**, **Past Exams and Solutions**, **VEE (Validation by Educational Experience)**, and for universities **UCAP (Universities & Colleges with Actuarial Programs)**, **CAE (Centers of Actuarial Excellence)**, the **UEC (University-Earned Credit)** programme and the **Hickman Scholars** programme; on the research side there are dedicated topics for **Artificial Intelligence** and **Catastrophe and Climate**. For RIAA: the single authoritative source for "**what must be examined, how credits transfer, and where the past papers are**" — especially **Past Exams and Solutions** and **UEC/VEE**, the former being core revision material and the latter determining whether Lingnan/RIM courses can earn exemptions; it pairs with [[soa-jobs]] (employment), [[soa-practice-tools]] (practice tools), [[soa-exam-pa-r-doc]] (Exam PA R documentation) and [[actuarial-exam-database]] to cover "pathway → material → tools"; with [[ifoa-studying]] and [[cas-syllabus]] it forms an official three-system comparison, and regional qualifications are covered by [[ashk]], [[actuaries-institute]] and [[singapore-actuarial-society]]; suits exam planning, qualification pathways and university credit transfer.
entries.body_hk: SOA（Society of Actuaries，北美精算師協會）官方教育入口（`soa.org/education/overview/`）是**整條北美精算資格路徑的權威起點**，站內結構可核實且完整：**Future Actuaries**、**Education & Exams**（**Exams & Requirements**、University Resources、Educational Pathways）、三大資格 **ASA / FSA / CERA** 與 Micro-Credentials、**Exam Registration 與 Exam Results**、**Past Exams and Solutions（歷年真題與解答）**、**VEE（教育經歷認證）**、以及面向院校的 **UCAP**、**CAE** 與 **UEC（校內學分抵免）** 計劃、**Hickman Scholars** 獎學金；研究側另有 **Artificial Intelligence** 與 **Catastrophe and Climate** 專題。對 RIAA：這是**「要考什麼、怎麼抵免、真題在哪」的唯一權威來源**——特別是 **Past Exams and Solutions** 與 **UEC/VEE**；與 [[soa-jobs]]、[[soa-practice-tools]]、[[soa-exam-pa-r-doc]]、[[actuarial-exam-database]] 搭配可覆蓋「路徑 → 材料 → 工具」；與 [[ifoa-studying]]、[[cas-syllabus]] 構成三大體系的官方對照；適合作考試規劃、資格路徑與院校抵免方向。

entries.body: CAS（Casualty Actuarial Society，北美产险精算学会）的**基础教育教学大纲（Syllabus of Basic Education, SOBE）**是**产险精算考试的唯一官方考纲**：它逐科列出**学习目标（learning objectives）、指定参考文献与阅读范围**，并按 Bloom 认知层级（认知/应用/分析等）标注每项要求的掌握深度——这意味着它不只是「书单」，而是**命题与阅卷的依据**。CAS 每年发布新版 SOBE，并配有一篇解释性文章（What Is the CAS Syllabus of Basic Education?）说明大纲的作用与使用方法。对 RIAA：RIAA 的主线是产险与风险分析，因此**CAS 体系与本课程的相关度高于 SOA**；这份大纲是「**该读什么、读到什么程度才算会**」的权威标尺，也是判断某本教材/某篇论文是否在考纲内的依据；它与池内产险方法工具（[[chainladder-python]]、[[faslr]] 等 CAS 出品的准备金工具，研究资源见 [[cas-research-tools]]、[[astin-bulletin]]）构成「**考纲 → 方法 → 工具**」的完整链条；与 [[soa-education]]、[[ifoa-studying]] 对照可看清北美产险、北美寿险、英国三大体系的差异；就业侧见 [[cas-jobs]]；适合作考试规划、学习方法论与产险方向。说明：SOBE **按年度更新**，本条源链接为可核实的 2025 版官方 PDF（728KB），使用时应确认最新版年份。
entries.body_en: The Casualty Actuarial Society’s (CAS) **Syllabus of Basic Education (SOBE)** is **the sole official syllabus for the casualty actuarial examinations**: it lists, exam by exam, the **learning objectives, prescribed references and reading ranges**, and tags each requirement with a Bloom cognitive level (knowledge/application/analysis and so on) — meaning it is not merely a reading list but **the basis for question setting and marking**. CAS issues a new SOBE each year and publishes an explainer article ("What Is the CAS Syllabus of Basic Education?") on its role and use. For RIAA: RIAA’s main line is general insurance and risk analytics, so **the CAS system is more relevant to this programme than the SOA’s**; this syllabus is the authoritative yardstick for "**what to read and to what depth counts as knowing it**", and the basis for judging whether a given textbook or paper is in scope; with the corpus’s general insurance method tools (CAS-produced reserving tools such as [[chainladder-python]] and [[faslr]], plus research resources [[cas-research-tools]] and [[astin-bulletin]]) it completes a "**syllabus → method → tool**" chain; comparing it with [[soa-education]] and [[ifoa-studying]] makes the differences among the North American casualty, North American life and UK systems clear; for employment see [[cas-jobs]]; suits exam planning, study methodology and general insurance work. Note: the SOBE is **reissued annually**; the source link here is the verifiable 2025 official PDF (728KB), so confirm the latest edition when using it.
entries.body_hk: CAS（Casualty Actuarial Society，北美產險精算學會）的**基礎教育教學大綱（Syllabus of Basic Education, SOBE）**是**產險精算考試的唯一官方考綱**：它逐科列出**學習目標、指定參考文獻與閱讀範圍**，並按 Bloom 認知層級標註每項要求的掌握深度——這意味著它不只是「書單」，而是**命題與閱卷的依據**。CAS 每年發布新版 SOBE，並配有解釋性文章說明大綱的作用與使用方法。對 RIAA：RIAA 的主線是產險與風險分析，因此 **CAS 體系與本課程的相關度高於 SOA**；這份大綱是「**該讀什麼、讀到什麼程度才算會**」的權威標尺；它與池內產險方法工具（[[chainladder-python]]、[[faslr]]，研究資源見 [[cas-research-tools]]、[[astin-bulletin]]）構成「**考綱 → 方法 → 工具**」的完整鏈條；與 [[soa-education]]、[[ifoa-studying]] 對照可看清三大體系差異；就業側見 [[cas-jobs]]；適合作考試規劃、學習方法論與產險方向。說明：SOBE **按年度更新**，本條源鏈接為可核實的 2025 版官方 PDF（728KB）。

entries.body: IFoA（Institute and Faculty of Actuaries，英国精算师协会）的官方学习入口 **Qualify**（`actuaries.org.uk/studying`）是英国精算资格路径的权威起点，结构分四大块：**Qualify**（Become an actuary 入门、**Curriculum 课程体系**、**Exams 考试**——含考试日期与必备资源、**After exams**——成绩缓解情形/申诉/咨询、**Personal and Professional Development**——**实务工作经验是资格的组成部分**）；**Learn**（Lifelong learning、**CPD 持续专业发展**、**Professional Skills Training 专业技能训练三阶段**、Regional societies 区域分会、志愿者机会）；**Events**（活动日历、征稿、第三方活动）；**Insight**（政策与公共事务）。对 RIAA：IFoA 体系的特点是**「考试 + 实务经历 + 分阶段专业技能训练」三位一体**——资格不是考完试就结束，这与 SOA/CAS 的侧重不同，是理解不同市场精算职业制度的良好对照；香港有大量 IFoA 资格持有者，与本地 [[ashk]]、以及英国体系在港的落地直接相关；考试资源侧见 [[ifoa-formulae-tables]]（官方公式表）、[[ifoa-ai-innovation-2026]]（AI 与新兴风险实践领域）、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]（CMI 死亡率预测，持续教育体系的一部分）；三体系对照见 [[soa-education]] 与 [[cas-syllabus]]，职业发展侧见 [[ifoa-jobs]]、[[industry-cpd]]；适合作资格路径规划、实务经历要求与长期职业发展设计。
entries.body_en: IFoA’s (Institute and Faculty of Actuaries) official study portal, **Qualify** (`actuaries.org.uk/studying`), is the authoritative starting point for the UK actuarial qualification pathway, structured in four blocks: **Qualify** (Become an actuary, the **curriculum**, **Exams** — dates and essential resources, **After exams** — mitigating circumstances, appeals and counselling, **Personal and Professional Development** — where **practical work experience is a component of the qualification**); **Learn** (lifelong learning, **CPD**, three-stage **Professional Skills Training**, regional societies, volunteering); **Events** (calendar, calls for speakers, third-party events); and **Insight** (policy and public affairs). For RIAA: the IFoA system is distinctive for combining **"exams + practical experience + staged professional skills training"** — the qualification does not end when the exams do — which differs in emphasis from the SOA and CAS and makes a good comparison for understanding actuarial professions across markets; Hong Kong has many IFoA-qualified actuaries, tying directly to the local [[ashk]] and the UK system’s presence in the city; on exam resources see [[ifoa-formulae-tables]] (the official formulae and tables), [[ifoa-ai-innovation-2026]] (the AI and emerging risks practice area) and [[cmi-mortality-projections]] (CMI mortality projections, part of the continuing education system); for the three-system comparison see [[soa-education]] and [[cas-syllabus]], and for career development [[ifoa-jobs]] and [[industry-cpd]]; suits qualification-pathway planning, practical experience requirements and long-term career design.
entries.body_hk: IFoA（Institute and Faculty of Actuaries，英國精算師協會）的官方學習入口 **Qualify**（`actuaries.org.uk/studying`）是英國精算資格路徑的權威起點，結構分四大塊：**Qualify**（Become an actuary、**Curriculum 課程體系**、**Exams 考試**、**After exams** 成績緩解/申訴/諮詢、**Personal and Professional Development**——**實務工作經驗是資格的組成部分**）；**Learn**（Lifelong learning、**CPD**、**Professional Skills Training 三階段**、Regional societies、志願者機會）；**Events**；**Insight**（政策與公共事務）。對 RIAA：IFoA 體系的特點是**「考試 + 實務經歷 + 分階段專業技能訓練」三位一體**——資格不是考完試就結束，這與 SOA/CAS 的側重不同，是理解不同市場精算職業制度的良好對照；香港有大量 IFoA 資格持有者，與本地 [[ashk]] 直接相關；考試資源側見 [[ifoa-formulae-tables]]、[[ifoa-ai-innovation-2026]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]；三體系對照見 [[soa-education]] 與 [[cas-syllabus]]，職業發展側見 [[ifoa-jobs]]、[[industry-cpd]]；適合作資格路徑規劃、實務經歷要求與長期職業發展設計。

entries.body: Asia Insurance Review（AIR，`asiainsurancereview.com`）是**亚洲最具影响力的保险行业刊物**，栏目按「市场 / 险种 / 职能」三维切分，可核实结构包括：Magazine（纸质刊物）、News（**Asia / China / China CEO / C-Suite / Non-Life / Life and Health / People / Regional / Regulations / Reinsurance / Risk Management / Technology / Agents / Middle East** / AIR+）、Archives（含 **Conference Dailies** 与 Supplements）、Press Release；另设 **Conferences（会议）**、**Awards（奖项：Asia Industry Awards、Middle East Industry Awards、Trusted Life Agents Awards、Global Insurance Excellence Awards）**、**Calendar 2026**、**eDirectory（行业名录）**。其报道主题也直接反映区域热点（如「寿险正在走向财务规划对话的中心」「亚太可能是全球增长最快的保险区域」「保障需求随风险复杂化而增长」）。对 RIAA：这是**亚洲市场分析的行业口径来源**——与官方监管数据（[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[japan-fsa-statistics]] 等）互补，官方数据给「市场多大」，行业刊物给「市场在发生什么」；其**年度奖项与会议日历**也是了解区域玩家与建立行业认知的入口，与 [[insuranceasia-news]]（同类亚洲刊物）、[[geneva-association]]（全球智库口径）、[[artemis]]（ILS 专门口径）构成不同粒度的情报层；适合作市场分析作业、行业认知与面试准备。
entries.body_en: Asia Insurance Review (AIR, `asiainsurancereview.com`) is **Asia’s most influential insurance industry publication**, structured along three axes — market, line of business and function. Its verifiable structure includes: Magazine (print), News (**Asia / China / China CEO / C-Suite / Non-Life / Life and Health / People / Regional / Regulations / Reinsurance / Risk Management / Technology / Agents / Middle East** / AIR+), Archives (including **Conference Dailies** and supplements) and press releases; it also runs **Conferences**, **Awards** (Asia Industry Awards, Middle East Industry Awards, Trusted Life Agents Awards, Global Insurance Excellence Awards), a **Calendar 2026** and an **eDirectory** of the industry. Its editorial themes mirror regional hot topics (e.g. "life insurance shifting to the centre of the financial planning conversation", "APAC may be the fastest-growing insurance region globally", and protection needs rising as risks become more complex). For RIAA: an **industry-voice source for Asian market analysis** — complementary to official regulatory data ([[hk-ia-statistics]], [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[japan-fsa-statistics]] and others): official data says "how big the market is", the trade press says "what is happening in it"; its **annual awards and conference calendar** are also entry points for knowing the regional players and building industry awareness, and with [[insuranceasia-news]] (a peer Asian title), [[geneva-association]] (global think-tank voice) and [[artemis]] (ILS-specific) it forms intelligence layers at different granularities; suits market-analysis assignments, industry awareness and interview preparation.
entries.body_hk: Asia Insurance Review（AIR，`asiainsurancereview.com`）是**亞洲最具影響力的保險行業刊物**，欄目按「市場 / 險種 / 職能」三維切分：Magazine、News（**Asia / China / China CEO / C-Suite / Non-Life / Life and Health / People / Regional / Regulations / Reinsurance / Risk Management / Technology / Agents / Middle East** / AIR+）、Archives（含 **Conference Dailies** 與 Supplements）、Press Release；另設 **Conferences**、**Awards**、**Calendar 2026**、**eDirectory**。其報道主題也直接反映區域熱點。對 RIAA：這是**亞洲市場分析的行業口徑來源**——與官方監管數據（[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[japan-fsa-statistics]] 等）互補：官方數據給「市場多大」，行業刊物給「市場在發生什麼」；其**年度獎項與會議日曆**也是了解區域玩家的入口，與 [[insuranceasia-news]]、[[geneva-association]]、[[artemis]] 構成不同粒度的情報層；適合作市場分析作業、行業認知與面試準備。

entries.body: InsuranceAsia News（`insuranceasianews.com`，自我定位「Insights on Asia’s Insurance Market」）是**面向亚洲（再）保险市场的行业洞察平台**，其最有价值的特征是**双维度索引**：**Markets** 维度覆盖 **Hong Kong / Singapore / Australia / Japan / China / India / South Korea / Taiwan / Malaysia / New Zealand**（共 11 个市场），**Business Line** 维度覆盖 Property / Casualty / Marine / Cyber / Energy / **Financial Lines** / **W&I（保证与 indemnity）** / **Parametrics（参数化）**，Topic 维度覆盖 Claims / Catastrophe / M&A / Regulatory / ESG / Renewals / **MGA** / Climate；Content Type 则区分 Analysis / Spotlight / Analytics / **Opinion** / Exclusives；Segments 覆盖 Brokers / Insurers / Reinsurers / **Loss Adjusters** / **Lloyd’s**，另有 Podcasts、Reports、Videos、Conferences、Awards 与 Print Edition。对 RIAA：**「按市场 + 按险种」切分**正是做区域市场研究时最需要的组织方式——尤其 **Hong Kong 单列**、**Lloyd’s 与 Loss Adjusters 单列**、以及 **Parametrics（参数化保险）与 Financial Lines 单列**，说明其编辑口径贴近专业再保与特殊险种市场；与 [[asia-insurance-review]]（更广的亚洲行业刊物）、[[artemis]]（ILS/巨灾债券专门）分工互补；市场规模与监管口径仍应回到官方源（[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[vhis-portal]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[japan-fsa-statistics]]、[[taiwan-insurance-bureau]]）；参数化产品设计可接 [[parametric-insurance-demo]]；适合作香港/亚太市场分析、再保与特殊险种方向。
entries.body_en: InsuranceAsia News (`insuranceasianews.com`, self-described as "Insights on Asia’s Insurance Market") is **an industry insight platform for the Asian (re)insurance market**, and its most valuable feature is a **two-dimensional index**: the **Markets** dimension covers **Hong Kong / Singapore / Australia / Japan / China / India / South Korea / Taiwan / Malaysia / New Zealand** (11 markets), the **Business Line** dimension covers Property / Casualty / Marine / Cyber / Energy / **Financial Lines** / **W&I** / **Parametrics**, and the Topic dimension covers Claims / Catastrophe / M&A / Regulatory / ESG / Renewals / **MGA** / Climate; Content Type distinguishes Analysis / Spotlight / Analytics / **Opinion** / Exclusives; Segments cover Brokers / Insurers / Reinsurers / **Loss Adjusters** / **Lloyd’s**, alongside Podcasts, Reports, Videos, Conferences, Awards and a print edition. For RIAA: that **"by market + by line" split** is exactly the organisation regional market research needs — particularly with **Hong Kong listed separately**, and **Lloyd’s and loss adjusters** and **Parametrics and Financial Lines** given their own slots, indicating an editorial stance close to the professional reinsurance and specialty market; it divides labour with [[asia-insurance-review]] (a broader Asian trade title) and [[artemis]] (ILS/cat bond specific); market size and regulatory figures should still come from official sources ([[hk-ia-statistics]], [[vhis-portal]], [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[japan-fsa-statistics]], [[taiwan-insurance-bureau]]); parametric product design connects to [[parametric-insurance-demo]]; suits Hong Kong and Asia-Pacific market analysis, reinsurance and specialty lines.
entries.body_hk: InsuranceAsia News（`insuranceasianews.com`）是**面向亞洲（再）保險市場的行業洞察平台**，其最有價值的特徵是**雙維度索引**：**Markets** 覆蓋 **Hong Kong / Singapore / Australia / Japan / China / India / South Korea / Taiwan / Malaysia / New Zealand**（11 個市場），**Business Line** 覆蓋 Property / Casualty / Marine / Cyber / Energy / **Financial Lines** / **W&I** / **Parametrics**，Topic 覆蓋 Claims / Catastrophe / M&A / Regulatory / ESG / Renewals / **MGA** / Climate；Content Type 區分 Analysis / Spotlight / Analytics / **Opinion** / Exclusives；Segments 覆蓋 Brokers / Insurers / Reinsurers / **Loss Adjusters** / **Lloyd’s**。對 RIAA：**「按市場 + 按險種」切分**正是做區域市場研究時最需要的組織方式——尤其 **Hong Kong 單列**、**Lloyd’s 與 Loss Adjusters 單列**、**Parametrics 與 Financial Lines 單列**；與 [[asia-insurance-review]]、[[artemis]] 分工互補；市場規模與監管口徑仍應回到官方源（[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[japan-fsa-statistics]]、[[taiwan-insurance-bureau]]）；參數化產品設計可接 [[parametric-insurance-demo]]；適合作香港/亞太市場分析、再保與特殊險種方向。

entries.title: Reinsurance News（再保险日报）
entries.summary: 全球再保险每日要闻：续转、业绩、巨灾损失、Lloyd’s、网络再保、参数化与 AI 专题
entries.summary_en: Daily global reinsurance news: renewals, results, major losses, Lloyd’s, cyber reinsurance, parametric and AI topics
entries.summary_hk: 全球再保險每日要聞：續轉、業績、巨災損失、Lloyd’s、網絡再保、參數化與 AI 專題
entries.body: Reinsurance News（`reinsurancene.ws`）是**全球再保险业的每日要闻平台**，定位明确：「把知识管理与再保险洞察结合技术，带来重要的再保险行业新闻（网站 + 每日邮件）」。其分类体系可核实且贴合再保职能：**Monte Carlo Rendez-Vous（蒙特卡洛再保年会）**、**Reinsurance Renewals（续转）**、**Re/Insurer results（业绩）**、People Moves、**Major loss news（巨灾/大额损失）**、**Lloyd’s of London**、**Cyber reinsurance news**、**Parametric re/insurance news**、M&A、**Legacy reinsurance news（遗留业务）**、InsurTech & Technology、**Climate Resilience**、**Artificial intelligence news**，Lines of Business 侧再按 P&C Reinsurance、Marine Reinsurance 等分。对 RIAA：再保险是保险价值链的上游，也是**理解承保周期与资本供给**的关键——这份日报的价值在于它按**再保业务职能**（续转/业绩/巨灾/遗留/网络）而非按综合新闻分类，等于给出了一张「再保行业每天在关心什么」的清单；与 [[artemis]]（ILS 与巨灾债券专门口径）互为上下游（ILS 是再保资本的替代来源），与 [[reinsurance]]、[[reinsurance-networks]]、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]] 构成概念到实务的链条；AI 与网络再保专题可与 [[lma-ai-governance]]、[[catmodeling]] 对照；行业基准数据仍以 [[swiss-re-sigma]] 与 [[munich-re]] 等为准；适合作再保方向、行业跟踪与面试准备。
entries.body_en: Reinsurance News (`reinsurancene.ws`) is **a daily news platform for the global reinsurance industry**, with a clear pitch: "by combining our experience in knowledge management and reinsurance insight with technology, we aim to bring you the reinsurance industry news that matters", online and by daily email. Its verifiable taxonomy maps onto reinsurance functions: **Monte Carlo Rendez-Vous**, **Reinsurance Renewals**, **Re/Insurer results**, People Moves, **Major loss news**, **Lloyd’s of London**, **Cyber reinsurance news**, **Parametric re/insurance news**, M&A, **Legacy reinsurance news**, InsurTech & Technology, **Climate Resilience** and **Artificial intelligence news**, with Lines of Business splitting further into P&C Reinsurance, Marine Reinsurance and others. For RIAA: reinsurance is upstream in the insurance value chain and key to **understanding the underwriting cycle and the supply of capital** — this daily’s value is that it organises by **reinsurance function** (renewals / results / catastrophe / legacy / cyber) rather than general news, effectively a checklist of "what the reinsurance industry cares about each day"; it sits upstream/downstream of [[artemis]] (ILS and cat bond specific — ILS being an alternative source of reinsurance capital), and with [[reinsurance]], [[reinsurance-networks]] and [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]] it forms a concept-to-practice chain; the AI and cyber reinsurance strands tie to [[lma-ai-governance]] and [[catmodeling]]; benchmark industry data should still come from [[swiss-re-sigma]] and [[munich-re]]; suits reinsurance specialisation, industry tracking and interview preparation.
entries.body_hk: Reinsurance News（`reinsurancene.ws`）是**全球再保險業的每日要聞平台**，定位明確：「把知識管理與再保險洞察結合技術，帶來重要的再保險行業新聞（網站 + 每日郵件）」。其分類體系可核實且貼合再保職能：**Monte Carlo Rendez-Vous**、**Reinsurance Renewals**、**Re/Insurer results**、People Moves、**Major loss news**、**Lloyd’s of London**、**Cyber reinsurance news**、**Parametric re/insurance news**、M&A、**Legacy reinsurance news**、InsurTech & Technology、**Climate Resilience**、**Artificial intelligence news**。對 RIAA：再保險是保險價值鏈的上游，也是**理解承保週期與資本供給**的關鍵——這份日報按**再保業務職能**而非綜合新聞分類，等於給出一張「再保行業每天在關心什麼」的清單；與 [[artemis]]（ILS 與巨災債券專門口徑）互為上下游，與 [[reinsurance]]、[[reinsurance-networks]]、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]] 構成概念到實務的鏈條；AI 與網絡再保專題可與 [[lma-ai-governance]]、[[catmodeling]] 對照；行業基準數據仍以 [[swiss-re-sigma]] 與 [[munich-re]] 為準；適合作再保方向、行業跟蹤與面試準備。

entries.title: Triple-I（美国保险信息协会）
entries.summary: 美国保险业数据与洞察机构：议题简报、州级可负担性指数、Fact Book 类行业统计
entries.summary_en: US insurance data and insight body: issues briefs, a state-level affordability index and Fact Book-type industry statistics
entries.summary_hk: 美國保險業數據與洞察機構：議題簡報、州級可負擔性指數、Fact Book 類行業統計
entries.body: Triple-I（Insurance Information Institute，`iii.org`）自我定位为「**The Trusted Voice of Risk and Insurance**」，是**美国保险业的数据与公众洞察机构**（与 [[aiai-designation]] 所属的 The Institutes 同源体系）。站内可核实栏目：**Insurance Types**（按险种，如 Auto、Homeowners & Renters）、**Preparedness & Claims**、**Insights & Trends（数据与趋势）**、News & Events、Members、About Us；发布物包括 **Triple-I Index（追踪各州保险可负担性趋势的指数）**、**Triple-I Blog**、**Triple-I Issues Briefs（议题简报，如「法律体系滥用如何推高社会性通胀」）**、州级市场分析（如「State of the State: California Homeowners Insurance」）、以及 Executive Exchange 对话视频（如与 [[munich-re]] 的对谈）。对 RIAA：这是**「保险业如何被公共讨论」的样本**——它把行业数据翻译成公众与政策语言，其中**可负担性指数（affordability by state）与社会性通胀（social inflation）议题简报**是美国市场分析的高频切入点；数据侧与监管数据（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]）形成「监管原始数据 vs 行业加工洞察」的配对，巨灾与保障侧可接 [[hurricaneguard]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[claims-risk-scoring-dataset]]；对理解「保险可信度与公众沟通」这一职业议题也有直接价值（对照 [[iii-underwriter-ai-talent]] 一类人才与行业研究）；适合作美国市场分析、行业议题研究与政策沟通方向。
entries.body_en: Triple-I (Insurance Information Institute, `iii.org`) describes itself as "**The Trusted Voice of Risk and Insurance**" and is **the US insurance industry’s data and public-insight body** (from the same family as The Institutes, home of [[aiai-designation]]). Verifiable sections include: **Insurance Types** (Auto, Homeowners & Renters and more), **Preparedness & Claims**, **Insights & Trends**, News & Events, Members and About Us; its publications include the **Triple-I Index** (tracking insurance affordability trends by state), the **Triple-I Blog**, **Triple-I Issues Briefs** (e.g. "How legal system abuse drives social inflation"), state-level market analyses (e.g. "State of the State: California Homeowners Insurance") and Executive Exchange video conversations (for instance with [[munich-re]]). For RIAA: a sample of **how the insurance industry is discussed publicly** — it translates industry data into public and policy language, and its **affordability index and social-inflation issues briefs** are high-frequency entry points for US market analysis; on data it forms a "regulatory raw data vs industry-processed insight" pairing with [[naic-financial-data-repository]] and [[naic-ai-oversight]], while catastrophe and protection topics connect to [[hurricaneguard]], [[fema-nfhl-mcp]] and [[claims-risk-scoring-dataset]]; it is also directly useful for understanding "insurance credibility and public communication" as a professional theme (compare talent and industry research such as [[iii-underwriter-ai-talent]]); suits US market analysis, industry-issues research and policy communication.
entries.body_hk: Triple-I（Insurance Information Institute，`iii.org`）自我定位為「**The Trusted Voice of Risk and Insurance**」，是**美國保險業的數據與公眾洞察機構**（與 [[aiai-designation]] 所屬的 The Institutes 同源體系）。站內可核實欄目：**Insurance Types**、**Preparedness & Claims**、**Insights & Trends**、News & Events、Members、About Us；發布物包括 **Triple-I Index（追蹤各州保險可負擔性趨勢）**、**Triple-I Blog**、**Triple-I Issues Briefs（議題簡報）**、州級市場分析與 Executive Exchange 對話視頻。對 RIAA：這是**「保險業如何被公共討論」的樣本**——把行業數據翻譯成公眾與政策語言，其中**可負擔性指數與社會性通脹議題簡報**是美國市場分析的高頻切入點；數據側與監管數據（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]）形成「監管原始數據 vs 行業加工洞察」的配對；巨災與保障側可接 [[hurricaneguard]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[claims-risk-scoring-dataset]]；適合作美國市場分析、行業議題研究與政策溝通方向。
