entries.title: InsurTech100（全球百强保险科技榜）
entries.summary: 年度全球最具创新力 100 家保险科技公司榜单：专家评审、评选标准与历届名单
entries.summary_en: The annual list of the world’s 100 most innovative InsurTech companies: expert panel, selection criteria and previous lists
entries.summary_hk: 年度全球最具創新力 100 家保險科技公司榜單：專家評審、評選標準與歷屆名單
entries.body: InsurTech100（`theinsurtech100.com`）是**年度评选的「全球最具创新力 100 家保险科技公司」榜单**——官方表述是：「由行业专家与分析师组成的小组选出，是保险业每位领导者在制定数字化转型战略时都需要了解的公司」。站内结构完整且可核实：**About the List / InsurTech100 2025（历届名单）/ Process（评选流程）/ Criteria（评选标准）/ Nominations（提名）/ Timeline / FAQs / News & Research**，并附 **Global InsurTech Summit – USA** 会议。它对入选公司的实际影响也被明确写出：大量入选公司因此在保险公司与更广的保险社群中获得关注，有的被金融机构直接接洽，有的获得客户与合作伙伴的青睐。对 RIAA：这是**保险科技行业图景的一手索引**——做市场研究或求职时，「这个领域有哪些玩家、谁被认为最具创新力」比任何二手总结都直接；可与池内具体公司样本对照阅读（定价侧的 [[akur8]]、车险视觉定损的 [[tractable]]、巨灾风险的 [[zestyai]]、核心系统的 [[socotra]] 与 [[covergo]]），并与开放保险方向的 [[openinsurance]] 呼应；行业情报层已收 [[fintech-global]]（本榜单的发布方，含融资数据）与 [[insurtech-insights]]（全球最大保险科技社群与会议）；适合作行业研究、求职目标筛选与创业方向调研。
entries.body_en: InsurTech100 (`theinsurtech100.com`) is **the annual list of "the world’s 100 most innovative InsurTech companies"** — in its own words, "selected by a panel of industry experts and analysts… the companies every leader in the insurance industry needs to know about as they consider and develop their digital transformation strategies". Its structure is complete and verifiable: **About the List / InsurTech100 2025 (previous lists) / Process / Criteria / Nominations / Timeline / FAQs / News & Research**, plus the **Global InsurTech Summit – USA**. It also states the practical effect on selected companies: many gained substantial awareness among insurers and the wider community, some were approached directly by financial institutions, others gained clients and partners. For RIAA: **a first-hand index of the InsurTech landscape** — for market research or job hunting, "who are the players here and who is considered most innovative" beats any second-hand summary; read it against concrete company samples already in the corpus (pricing side [[akur8]], vehicle damage vision [[tractable]], catastrophe risk [[zestyai]], core systems [[socotra]] and [[covergo]]) and against the open-insurance direction of [[openinsurance]]; the intelligence layer now holds [[fintech-global]] (the publisher of this list, with funding data) and [[insurtech-insights]] (the world’s largest InsurTech community and conference); suits industry research, target-company shortlisting and start-up research.
entries.body_hk: InsurTech100（`theinsurtech100.com`）是**年度評選的「全球最具創新力 100 家保險科技公司」榜單**——官方表述是：「由行業專家與分析師組成的小組選出，是保險業每位領導者在制定數字化轉型戰略時都需要了解的公司」。站內結構完整：**About the List / InsurTech100 2025 / Process / Criteria / Nominations / Timeline / FAQs / News & Research**，並附 **Global InsurTech Summit – USA**。對 RIAA：這是**保險科技行業圖景的一手索引**——做市場研究或求職時，「這個領域有哪些玩家、誰被認為最具創新力」比任何二手總結都直接；可與池內具體公司樣本對照（[[akur8]]、[[tractable]]、[[zestyai]]、[[socotra]]、[[covergo]]），並與 [[openinsurance]] 呼應；行業情報層已收 [[fintech-global]]（本榜單發布方，含融資數據）與 [[insurtech-insights]]；適合作行業研究、求職目標篩選與創業方向調研。

entries.body: FinTech Global（`fintech.global`）是**面向金融科技与保险科技的情报平台**，栏目按可核实的方式组织：**News（Industry News 行业新闻 / Company News 公司新闻 / Funding Rounds 融资轮次 / Partnerships 合作）**，并设有专门的 **InsurTech** 垂直频道（`fintech.global/insurtech/`）；同时它是 **[[insurtech100]]**（全球百强保险科技榜）的发布方，另有其他金融科技榜单。对 RIAA：它的核心价值不是新闻本身，而是**「融资轮次」这一维度**——保险科技的资本流向是判断哪些细分赛道在升温、哪些公司在扩张的直接信号，也是求职时判断公司健康度的参考；与 [[insurtech100]]（榜单产物）构成「数据 → 排名」的关系，与 [[insurtech-insights]]（社群与会议）构成「情报 → 人脉」的关系；具体公司样本可对照 [[akur8]]、[[tractable]]、[[zestyai]]、[[socotra]]、[[covergo]]、[[shift-technology]]；池内与本条同源的既有词条 [[hybrid-actuarial-role]] 亦出自该站（说明其内容已进入精算职业议题讨论）；适合作行业研究、赛道判断与求职公司调研。
entries.body_en: FinTech Global (`fintech.global`) is **an intelligence platform for financial and insurance technology**, organised in a verifiable way: **News (Industry News / Company News / Funding Rounds / Partnerships)** plus a dedicated **InsurTech** vertical (`fintech.global/insurtech/`); it is also the publisher of **[[insurtech100]]** (the annual InsurTech ranking) and of other fintech lists. For RIAA: its value is not the news itself but the **"funding rounds" dimension** — the flow of capital into InsurTech is a direct signal of which sub-sectors are heating up and which companies are expanding, and a reference point for judging company health when job hunting; it stands to [[insurtech100]] (the ranking it produces) as "data → ranking", and to [[insurtech-insights]] (community and conferences) as "intelligence → network"; concrete company samples include [[akur8]], [[tractable]], [[zestyai]], [[socotra]], [[covergo]] and [[shift-technology]]; the corpus’s existing [[hybrid-actuarial-role]] is likewise sourced from this site (evidence that its content has entered actuarial career discussion); suits industry research, sub-sector judgement and company due diligence for applications.

entries.body: 美国农业部风险管理局（USDA Risk Management Agency, RMA，`rma.usda.gov`）是**美国联邦农作物保险计划的官方管理机构**，也是**全球规模最大的农业保险体系的政策与数据来源**。可核实的关键板块：**Policy & Procedure（政策与程序）**——发布保险政策、程序与**精算通告（Actuarial Release，如 26-022 号）**，即费率与条款的正式变更依据；**Summary of Business**——逐作物/州/年度的**承保面积、保费与赔付经验数据**（农业保险精算分析的标准数据源）；另有 Margin Protection 等具体产品页、About RMA 与官方公告。对 RIAA：这是**农险方向唯一体量足够、且带精算口径的一手来源**——「政策 → 费率（精算通告）→ 经验数据（Summary of Business）」三段齐全，正好是做农险定价、赔付率分析与巨灾情景研究所需的完整链路；与本 wiki 的农险相关词条形成互补：中国侧的 **[[china-agrore]]**（国家农业再保险）与 **[[moa-data]]**（农业数据），技术侧的 **[[agrisky-ai]]**（农险查勘定损 agent，用遥感做定损）与 **[[earth-engine]]**；参数化产品设计见 [[parametric-insurance-demo]]，气候与巨灾侧见 [[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[catmodeling]]、[[ml-drought]]、[[un-spider-radar-flood-mapping]]；行业基准见 [[swiss-re-sigma]]、[[perils-ied]]；适合作农险、参数化产品与巨灾农业风险方向。
entries.body_en: The USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA, `rma.usda.gov`) is **the official administrator of the US federal crop insurance programme** and the policy and data source for **the world’s largest agricultural insurance system**. Its verifiable sections include: **Policy & Procedure** — issuing policies, procedures and **Actuarial Releases** (e.g. release 26-022), the formal basis for rate and term changes; **Summary of Business** — **insured acreage, premium and indemnity experience data by crop, state and year** (the standard dataset for crop insurance actuarial analysis); plus product pages such as Margin Protection, About RMA and official notices. For RIAA: **the only first-hand source in agricultural insurance with enough scale and an actuarial basis** — the full chain "policy → rates (actuarial releases) → experience data (Summary of Business)" is exactly what crop insurance pricing, loss-ratio analysis and catastrophe scenario work require; it complements this wiki’s agricultural entries: on the China side **[[china-agrore]]** (the national agricultural reinsurer) and **[[moa-data]]** (agricultural data), and on the technical side **[[agrisky-ai]]** (an agricultural claims agent using remote sensing for loss assessment) and **[[earth-engine]]**; for parametric product design see [[parametric-insurance-demo]], and for climate and catastrophe [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[catmodeling]], [[ml-drought]] and [[un-spider-radar-flood-mapping]]; industry benchmarks are [[swiss-re-sigma]] and [[perils-ied]]; suits agricultural insurance, parametric products and agricultural catastrophe risk.
entries.body_hk: 美國農業部風險管理局（USDA Risk Management Agency, RMA，`rma.usda.gov`）是**美國聯邦農作物保險計劃的官方管理機構**，也是**全球規模最大的農業保險體系的政策與數據來源**。可核實的關鍵板塊：**Policy & Procedure（政策與程序）**——發布保險政策、程序與**精算通告（Actuarial Release）**；**Summary of Business**——逐作物/州/年度的**承保面積、保費與賠付經驗數據**；另有 Margin Protection 等產品頁與官方公告。對 RIAA：這是**農險方向唯一體量足夠、且帶精算口徑的一手來源**——「政策 → 費率（精算通告）→ 經驗數據（Summary of Business）」三段齊全；與本 wiki 的農險相關詞條互補：中國側 **[[china-agrore]]** 與 **[[moa-data]]**，技術側 **[[agrisky-ai]]** 與 **[[earth-engine]]**；參數化產品設計見 [[parametric-insurance-demo]]，氣候與巨災側見 [[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[catmodeling]]、[[ml-drought]]、[[un-spider-radar-flood-mapping]]；適合作農險、參數化產品與巨災農業風險方向。

entries.body: 中国农业再保险股份有限公司（`china-agrore.com`）是**中国的国家农业再保险公司**，也是**政策性农业保险大灾风险分散机制的核心承接方**。网站栏目可核实且结构清晰：**新闻中心**（公司动态 / 行业资讯 / 媒体关注 / 图片新闻）、**政策咨询**（**专家委员会**、**农再研究院**、**研究成果**、**政策解析**、**法律法规**）、**业务领域**（**再保险服务**、**标准协议签署情况**、**农业风险管理**、高峰论坛）、**公开信息披露**（基本信息 / 年度信息 / 专项信息）、党建工作与企业文化等。对 RIAA：中国的农业保险是**全球第二大农险市场**，而农业再保险是这个体系「**最后一道风险分散层**」——理解它，才能理解中国农险的定价约束、大灾赔付机制与政策工具；其中**农再研究院与研究成果 / 政策解析**两块对学术研究与作业最有用（提供官方视角的农险政策解读），**再保险服务与标准协议签署情况**则给出实务上「谁与谁做再保」的结构；与美国侧的 **[[usda-rma]]**（政策与经验数据）、**[[moa-data]]**（农业数据）形成中美对照，技术侧与 **[[agrisky-ai]]**（农险查勘定损 agent）配套；监管与行业制度侧见 [[china-insurance-association]]、[[nfra-statistics]]，中国再保险集团见 [[china-re]]；适合作农险、政策性保险与大灾风险分散机制方向。
entries.body_en: China Agricultural Reinsurance (`china-agrore.com`) is **China’s national agricultural reinsurer** and the **core carrier of the catastrophe risk-spreading mechanism for policy-driven agricultural insurance**. Its sections are clear and verifiable: **News** (company / industry / media / photos), **Policy advisory** (an **expert committee**, the **Agricultural Reinsurance Research Institute**, **research outputs**, **policy analysis**, laws and regulations), **Business areas** (**reinsurance services**, **status of standard agreement signings**, **agricultural risk management**, a summit forum) and **public disclosure** (basic / annual / specific information), plus party-building and culture sections. For RIAA: China has **the world’s second-largest agricultural insurance market**, and agricultural reinsurance is the system’s "**final layer of risk spreading**" — understanding it is how one understands Chinese crop insurance’s pricing constraints, catastrophe payout mechanics and policy tools; the **research institute, research outputs and policy analysis** sections are most useful for studies and assignments (offering an official view of agricultural insurance policy), while **reinsurance services and standard agreement signings** reveal the practical "who reinsures whom" structure; it forms a China–US contrast with **[[usda-rma]]** (policy and experience data) and **[[moa-data]]** (agricultural data), and pairs technically with **[[agrisky-ai]]** (an agricultural claims agent); for the regulatory and industry framework see [[china-insurance-association]] and [[nfra-statistics]], and for the China Re group see [[china-re]]; suits agricultural insurance, policy-driven insurance and catastrophe risk-spreading mechanisms.
entries.body_hk: 中國農業再保險股份有限公司（`china-agrore.com`）是**中國的國家農業再保險公司**，也是**政策性農業保險大災風險分散機制的核心承接方**。網站欄目清晰：**新聞中心**、**政策諮詢**（**專家委員會**、**農再研究院**、**研究成果**、**政策解析**、**法律法規**）、**業務領域**（**再保險服務**、**標準協議簽署情況**、**農業風險管理**、高峰論壇）、**公開信息披露**。對 RIAA：中國的農業保險是**全球第二大農險市場**，而農業再保險是這個體系「**最後一道風險分散層**」——理解它，才能理解中國農險的定價約束、大災賠付機制與政策工具；**農再研究院與研究成果 / 政策解析**對學術研究與作業最有用，**再保險服務與標準協議簽署情況**則給出實務結構；與美國側 **[[usda-rma]]**、**[[moa-data]]** 形成中美對照，技術側與 **[[agrisky-ai]]** 配套；監管與行業制度側見 [[china-insurance-association]]、[[nfra-statistics]]，中國再保險集團見 [[china-re]]；適合作農險、政策性保險與大災風險分散機制方向。

entries.body: 农业农村部数据（`data.moa.gov.cn`）是**中国农业农村部的官方数据入口**，与部委门户（`moa.gov.cn`）的「数据」栏目同源，提供农产品批发价格指数与价格行情、生产与农村经济类数据等。对 RIAA：农业保险的**风险因子与损失评估需要农业本身的底数据**——作物与畜产品的价格水平（决定保额与赔付标准）、产量与生产结构（决定暴露与集中度）、以及区域农业经济指标（决定市场容量）；这些在保险公司内部数据之外，官方口径就来自这里。它与 **[[usda-rma]]**（美国侧的经验数据与精算通告）、**[[china-agrore]]**（中国农业再保险的政策与研究）形成「**底数据 → 经验数据 → 制度解读**」的三层结构，技术侧与 **[[agrisky-ai]]**（遥感定损）、**[[earth-engine]]**（卫星数据平台）配套；气象与灾害侧另见 [[open-meteo]]（历史与预报气象）、[[gdacs]]（全球灾害预警）、[[ml-drought]]（干旱监测）；适合作农险定价数据准备、区域市场研究与农业巨灾分析。
entries.body_en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs data portal (`data.moa.gov.cn`) is **the official data entry point of China’s agriculture ministry**, from the same source as the "data" section of the ministry site (`moa.gov.cn`); it provides the agricultural wholesale price index and market prices, production and rural-economy data and more. For RIAA: agricultural insurance’s **risk factors and loss assessment depend on agriculture’s own base data** — crop and livestock price levels (which set sums insured and payout standards), output and production structure (which set exposure and concentration), and regional agricultural economic indicators (which set market size); beyond an insurer’s internal data, this official source is where those come from. It forms a three-layer structure with **[[usda-rma]]** (US experience data and actuarial releases) and **[[china-agrore]]** (Chinese agricultural reinsurance policy and research) — "**base data → experience data → institutional interpretation**" — and pairs technically with **[[agrisky-ai]]** (remote-sensing loss assessment) and **[[earth-engine]]** (the satellite data platform); for weather and hazards see [[open-meteo]] (historical and forecast weather), [[gdacs]] (global disaster alerts) and [[ml-drought]] (drought monitoring); suits data preparation for crop insurance pricing, regional market studies and agricultural catastrophe analysis.
entries.body_hk: 農業農村部數據（`data.moa.gov.cn`）是**中國農業農村部的官方數據入口**，與部委門戶（`moa.gov.cn`）的「數據」欄目同源，提供農產品批發價格指數與價格行情、生產與農村經濟類數據等。對 RIAA：農業保險的**風險因子與損失評估需要農業本身的底數據**——作物與畜產品的價格水平（決定保額與賠付標準）、產量與生產結構（決定暴露與集中度）、以及區域農業經濟指標（決定市場容量）；官方口徑就來自這裡。它與 **[[usda-rma]]**、**[[china-agrore]]** 形成「**底數據 → 經驗數據 → 制度解讀**」的三層結構，技術側與 **[[agrisky-ai]]**、**[[earth-engine]]** 配套；氣象與災害側另見 [[open-meteo]]、[[gdacs]]、[[ml-drought]]；適合作農險定價數據準備、區域市場研究與農業巨災分析。
entries.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（62.6KB）+ 页面核实（「数据 - 首页」，与 moa.gov.cn 同一导航体系下的数据栏目入口；首页可见农产品批发价格 200 指数等数据发布）

entries.title: Google Earth Engine（行星尺度卫星分析平台）
entries.title_hk: Google Earth Engine（行星尺度衛星分析平台）
entries.summary: 行星尺度地球观测分析平台：Landsat/Sentinel 等公开卫星影像目录 + 云端计算，用于作物与灾害监测
entries.summary_en: Planetary-scale Earth observation platform: public Landsat/Sentinel imagery catalogues plus cloud compute, used for crop and hazard monitoring
entries.summary_hk: 行星尺度地球觀測分析平台：Landsat/Sentinel 等公開衛星影像目錄 + 雲端計算，用於作物與災害監測
entries.body: Google Earth Engine（`earthengine.google.com`）是**行星尺度的地球观测分析平台**：把 Landsat、Sentinel 等**公开卫星影像目录**与云端计算能力放在一起，提供 Platform overview、**Code Editor**、Documentation、**Datasets**、Noncommercial / Commercial 使用方式、**Timelapse**、Case Studies 与 FAQ。对 RIAA：卫星遥感已经成为**农业保险查勘定损与巨灾损失评估的常规手段**——作物长势与受灾范围靠 Sentinel-2 的 NDVI 一类植被指标、洪涝范围靠 Sentinel-1 的合成孔径雷达（SAR，可穿透云层），而这些数据在过去要把原始影像下载下来本地处理，Earth Engine 的价值就在于**在云端直接对整年整区域的影像做时序分析**，让「地块级别、季度趋势、灾前灾后对比」这类分析变得可行；它是本 wiki 农险技术链的底座：**[[agrisky-ai]]**（农险查勘定损 agent，明确使用 Sentinel-1 SAR 与 Sentinel-2 NDVI 构建证据链）即建立在这类平台上，与 **[[usda-rma]]**、**[[china-agrore]]**、**[[moa-data]]** 构成「数据与制度 → 技术手段」的组合；灾害与暴露侧可对接 [[gdacs]]、[[un-spider-radar-flood-mapping]]、[[ml-flood]]、[[lisflood]]、[[inasafe]]、[[hazus]]、[[climada]]；适合作农险定损、巨灾损失评估与空间风险方向。
entries.body_en: Google Earth Engine (`earthengine.google.com`) is a **planetary-scale Earth observation analysis platform**: it combines **public satellite imagery catalogues** such as Landsat and Sentinel with cloud compute, offering a platform overview, a **Code Editor**, documentation, **Datasets**, noncommercial/commercial access, **Timelapse**, case studies and an FAQ. For RIAA: satellite remote sensing has become **standard practice in agricultural insurance survey and loss assessment and in catastrophe loss estimation** — crop condition and affected extent via vegetation indices such as Sentinel-2 NDVI, and flood extent via Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar (SAR, which penetrates cloud) — and where this once meant downloading raw imagery for local processing, Earth Engine’s value is **time-series analysis of whole regions and whole years directly in the cloud**, making plot-level, seasonal-trend and before/after comparisons feasible; it is the platform layer of this wiki’s agricultural insurance technology chain: **[[agrisky-ai]]** (an agricultural claims agent that explicitly builds its evidence chain on Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 NDVI) rests on such platforms, and with **[[usda-rma]]**, **[[china-agrore]]** and **[[moa-data]]** it forms a "data and institutions → technical means" combination; for hazards and exposure it connects to [[gdacs]], [[un-spider-radar-flood-mapping]], [[ml-flood]], [[lisflood]], [[inasafe]], [[hazus]] and [[climada]]; suits crop insurance loss assessment, catastrophe loss estimation and spatial risk work.
entries.body_hk: Google Earth Engine（`earthengine.google.com`）是**行星尺度的地球觀測分析平台**：把 Landsat、Sentinel 等**公開衛星影像目錄**與雲端計算能力放在一起，提供 Platform overview、**Code Editor**、Documentation、**Datasets**、Noncommercial / Commercial、**Timelapse**、Case Studies 與 FAQ。對 RIAA：衛星遙感已成為**農業保險查勘定損與巨災損失評估的常規手段**——作物長勢與受災範圍靠 Sentinel-2 的 NDVI 一類植被指標、洪澇範圍靠 Sentinel-1 的合成孔徑雷達（SAR，可穿透雲層），而 Earth Engine 的價值在於**在雲端直接對整年整區域的影像做時序分析**，讓「地塊級別、季度趨勢、災前災後對比」變得可行；它是本 wiki 農險技術鏈的底座：**[[agrisky-ai]]**（農險查勘定損 agent，明確使用 Sentinel-1 SAR 與 Sentinel-2 NDVI）即建立在這類平台上，與 **[[usda-rma]]**、**[[china-agrore]]**、**[[moa-data]]** 構成「數據與制度 → 技術手段」的組合；災害與暴露側可對接 [[gdacs]]、[[un-spider-radar-flood-mapping]]、[[ml-flood]]、[[lisflood]]、[[inasafe]]、[[hazus]]、[[climada]]；適合作農險定損、巨災損失評估與空間風險方向。

entries.title: IAIS 保险核心原则与共同框架（ICP / ComFrame）
entries.title_en: IAIS Insurance Core Principles and ComFrame (ICP / ComFrame)
entries.title_hk: IAIS 保險核心原則與共同框架（ICP / ComFrame）
entries.summary: 全球保险监管的基础标准文本：保险核心原则（ICPs）与共同框架（ComFrame），各国制度的共同参照
entries.summary_en: The foundational global insurance supervisory standards: the Insurance Core Principles (ICPs) and the Common Framework (ComFrame)
entries.summary_hk: 全球保險監管的基礎標準文本：保險核心原則（ICPs）與共同框架（ComFrame），各國制度的共同參照
entries.body: 国际保险监督官协会（IAIS）的 **ICPs and ComFrame** 页面（`iaisweb.org/page/supervisory-material/insurance-core-principles`）是**全球保险监管的基础标准文本入口**：**保险核心原则（Insurance Core Principles, ICPs）**规定了保险监管应满足的 20 余项原则（治理、偿付能力、市场行为、集团监管等），**共同框架（Common Framework, ComFrame）**则是面向国际活跃保险集团（IAIG）的监管框架。对 RIAA：**这是理解「为什么各国偿付能力制度长得像」的钥匙**——本 wiki 已收的各地制度（中国**偿二代**、欧盟 **Solvency II**、美国 **RBC**、香港保监局的资本制度）虽然在参数与结构上不同，但都可以看作对 ICPs 中「偿付能力评估、资本充足、治理与风险管理」等原则的**本土实现**；因此本词条是**制度比较的总纲**：与 [[iais-gimar]]（IAIS 的全球保险市场报告，市场数据口径）同为 IAIS 出品，与中国侧的 [[china-actuarial-association]]、[[china-insurance-association]] 与 [[nfra-portal]]、区域侧的 [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]（印度精算条例）、欧洲侧的 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] 与 [[solvency2rfr]] 搭配，可建立「**全球原则 → 区域制度 → 国家规则**」的三层认知；适合作监管制度比较、偿付能力与治理方向的研究与作业。
entries.body_en: The IAIS **ICPs and ComFrame** page (`iaisweb.org/page/supervisory-material/insurance-core-principles`) is **the entry point to the foundational global insurance supervisory standards**: the **Insurance Core Principles (ICPs)** set out the 20-plus principles insurance supervision should satisfy (governance, solvency, market conduct, group supervision and more), while the **Common Framework (ComFrame)** is the supervisory framework for Internationally Active Insurance Groups (IAIGs). For RIAA: **this is the key to understanding why national solvency regimes resemble one another** — the regimes already collected in this wiki (China’s **C-ROSS**, the EU’s **Solvency II**, the US **RBC**, the Hong Kong Insurance Authority’s capital regime) differ in parameters and structure yet can all be read as **local implementations of ICP principles** on solvency assessment, capital adequacy, governance and risk management; this entry is therefore a **general framework for regime comparison**: with [[iais-gimar]] (IAIS’s global insurance market report, the market-data side), the China-side [[china-actuarial-association]], [[china-insurance-association]] and [[nfra-portal]], the regional [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]] (India’s actuarial regulations) and the European [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] and [[solvency2rfr]], it builds a three-layer understanding of "**global principles → regional regimes → national rules**"; suits research and assignments in regulatory comparison, solvency and governance.
entries.body_hk: 國際保險監督官協會（IAIS）的 **ICPs and ComFrame** 頁面（`iaisweb.org/page/supervisory-material/insurance-core-principles`）是**全球保險監管的基礎標準文本入口**：**保險核心原則（ICPs）**規定保險監管應滿足的 20 餘項原則（治理、償付能力、市場行為、集團監管等），**共同框架（ComFrame）**則是面向國際活躍保險集團（IAIG）的監管框架。對 RIAA：**這是理解「為什麼各國償付能力制度長得像」的鑰匙**——本 wiki 已收的各地制度（中國**償二代**、歐盟 **Solvency II**、美國 **RBC**、香港保監局的資本制度）雖在參數與結構上不同，但都可看作對 ICPs 中「償付能力評估、資本充足、治理與風險管理」等原則的**本土實現**；因此本詞條是**制度比較的總綱**：與 [[iais-gimar]] 同為 IAIS 出品，與中國側 [[china-actuarial-association]]、[[china-insurance-association]]、[[nfra-portal]]、區域側 [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、歐洲側 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[solvency2rfr]] 搭配，可建立「**全球原則 → 區域制度 → 國家規則**」三層認知；適合作監管制度比較、償付能力與治理方向的研究與作業。
entries.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（125KB，页面标题「ICPs and ComFrame - International Association of Insurance Supervisors」；站点首页 iaisweb.org 亦 200/139KB）

entries.title_en: China NFRA portal (with its rules and regulations sections)
entries.title_hk: 國家金融監督管理總局門戶（含政策法規欄目）
entries.summary: 中国金融监管总局官方门户：政策法规 / 政策解读 / 征求意见 / 统计信息 / 监管动态栏目入口
entries.summary_en: The official portal of China’s financial regulator: entry sections for rules and regulations, policy interpretation, consultations, statistics and supervisory updates
entries.summary_hk: 中國金融監管總局官方門戶：政策法規 / 政策解讀 / 徵求意見 / 統計信息 / 監管動態欄目入口
entries.body: 国家金融监督管理总局（NFRA）官方门户（`nfra.gov.cn`，实际入口为 `/cn/view/pages/index/index.html`；根路径为 meta 跳转页）是**中国银行、保险业监管的一手信息总入口**。可核实的首页栏目结构（渲染后的页面已确认）包括：**时政要闻 / 国务院信息 / 总局监管动态 / 公告通知 / 政策法规 / 政策解读 / 征求意见 / 统计信息 / 政府信息公开 / 派出机构 / 政务咨询 / 信访咨询**，并列出金融消费者保护与投诉热线。对 RIAA：**这是查找中国保险监管规则正文的官方入口**——做中国市场研究或产品合规定价时需要的《保险公司偿付能力监管规则（Ⅱ）》（**偿二代二期**）一类文件，官方发布主体就是这里；它的**「政策法规 / 政策解读 / 征求意见」三个栏目**分别对应「规则正文 / 官方解读 / 尚未定稿的草案」，是做制度跟踪时区分「已生效 / 已解读 / 征求意见中」的关键。**核实说明（重要）**：NFRA 的**文档详情页为纯前端模板渲染**（HTML 中仅含 `{{data.…}}` 占位符，正文由 XHR 加载），因此本词条**只对门户的栏目结构作了核实**，未对任何具体规则文档的正文作断言；阅读规则正文请以浏览器访问本门户为准。与 [[nfra-statistics]]（NFRA 保险数据）、[[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]（AI 指导意见）同源，与中国精算与行业制度侧 [[china-actuarial-association]]、[[china-insurance-association]] 配套，全球原则层见 [[iais-icp]]；适合作中国监管跟踪、合规与市场研究方向。
entries.body_en: The official portal of China’s National Financial Regulatory Administration (NFRA, `nfra.gov.cn`; the effective entry is `/cn/view/pages/index/index.html`, as the root path is a meta-refresh page) is **the first-hand gateway to Chinese banking and insurance supervision**. Its verifiable home-page section structure (confirmed on the rendered page) includes: **top news / State Council information / NFRA supervisory updates / notices / rules and regulations / policy interpretation / consultations (draft rules) / statistics / government information disclosure / regional offices / government enquiries / petition enquiries**, plus consumer-protection and complaint hotlines. For RIAA: **this is the official entry point for finding the text of Chinese insurance regulation** — documents such as the *Regulations on the Solvency Supervision of Insurance Companies (II)* (**C-ROSS II**), needed for China market research or compliance-aware pricing, are published by this body; its three sections for **rules / policy interpretation / consultations** map exactly onto "final rule text / official interpretation / not-yet-final drafts", which is what lets you distinguish "in force / interpreted / still out for comment" when tracking regulation. **Verification note (important)**: NFRA’s **document detail pages are pure client-side templates** (the HTML contains only `{{data.…}}` placeholders and the body loads via XHR), so this entry **verifies only the portal’s section structure** and makes no assertion about the content of any specific rule document; to read rule text, visit this portal in a browser. It shares a source with [[nfra-statistics]] (NFRA insurance data) and [[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]] (AI guidance), pairs with the actuarial and industry bodies [[china-actuarial-association]] and [[china-insurance-association]], and sits under the global principles in [[iais-icp]]; suits China regulatory tracking, compliance and market research.
entries.body_hk: 國家金融監督管理總局（NFRA）官方門戶（`nfra.gov.cn`，實際入口為 `/cn/view/pages/index/index.html`）是**中國銀行、保險業監管的一手信息總入口**。可核實的首頁欄目結構包括：**時政要聞 / 國務院信息 / 總局監管動態 / 公告通知 / 政策法規 / 政策解讀 / 徵求意見 / 統計信息 / 政府信息公開 / 派出機構 / 政務諮詢 / 信訪諮詢**。對 RIAA：**這是查找中國保險監管規則正文的官方入口**——例如《保險公司償付能力監管規則（Ⅱ）》（**償二代二期**）；其**「政策法規 / 政策解讀 / 徵求意見」三個欄目**分別對應「規則正文 / 官方解讀 / 尚未定稿的草案」。**核實說明（重要）**：NFRA 的**文檔詳情頁為純前端模板渲染**（HTML 僅含 `{{data.…}}` 佔位符，正文由 XHR 載入），因此本詞條**只對門戶的欄目結構作了核實**，未對任何具體規則文檔的正文作斷言。與 [[nfra-statistics]]、[[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]] 同源，與 [[china-actuarial-association]]、[[china-insurance-association]] 配套，全球原則層見 [[iais-icp]]；適合作中國監管跟蹤、合規與市場研究方向。

entries.title: Reinsure-8B（保险/再保原生大模型）
entries.summary: 自述「全球首个保险原生语言模型」（8B，基于 Llama-3）：以再保险为原生定位
entries.summary_en: Self-described "world’s first insurance-native language model" (8B, Llama-3 based): natively positioned on reinsurance
entries.summary_hk: 自述「全球首個保險原生語言模型」（8B，基於 Llama-3）：以再保險為原生定位
entries.body: Reinsure-8B（Reinsured AI，HuggingFace，2026-03-14 发布，Llama-3 8B 架构，支持 vLLM 文本生成，截至核实 104 次下载）自我定位为「**The world’s first insurance-native language model**」（全球首个保险原生语言模型），标签含 insurance / reinsurance / sovereign-ai。对 RIAA：池内保险领域模型已有若干——通用保险语料的 [[open-insurance-llm]]、行业 BERT 的 [[llmware-industry-bert-insurance]]、精算对话方向的 [[morbi]] 与 [[insurance-expert-llama3b-lora]]、语音的 [[insurance-voice-qwen]]——但**以「再保险」为原生定位的基座模型这是第一条**。这个定位有实质意义：再保险的术语与业务逻辑（分层、摊回、比例/非比例、合约与临分）与传统直保差异明显，通用保险语料未必覆盖。可与再保侧其他条目配合阅读：合约数据见 [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]，合约文本抽取见 [[re-ink-reinsurance]]，业务概念见 [[reinsurance]]；框架侧参考 [[insurance-llm-framework]]。注意：下载量仅 104，属**新发布、采用度尚低**的模型，且模型卡未提供评测指标——使用前需自行验证输出质量。
entries.body_en: Reinsure-8B (by Reinsured AI, on HuggingFace, released 2026-03-14, Llama-3 8B architecture, vLLM text generation, 104 downloads at verification) describes itself as "**The world’s first insurance-native language model**", tagged insurance / reinsurance / sovereign-ai. For RIAA: this corpus already holds several insurance-domain models — [[open-insurance-llm]] (general insurance corpus), [[llmware-industry-bert-insurance]] (industry BERT), [[morbi]] and [[insurance-expert-llama3b-lora]] (actuarial dialogue), and [[insurance-voice-qwen]] (voice) — but **this is the first foundation model positioned natively on reinsurance**. That positioning matters: reinsurance terminology and mechanics (layers, recoveries, proportional vs non-proportional, treaty vs facultative) differ markedly from direct insurance, so a general insurance corpus may not cover them. Read it with the other reinsurance-side entries: contract data in [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]], contract-text extraction in [[re-ink-reinsurance]], and the business concepts in [[reinsurance]]; for the framework side see [[insurance-llm-framework]]. Note: only 104 downloads — a **newly released, low-adoption** model with no evaluation metrics in the model card, so verify output quality yourself before use.

entries.body: FinProof Bench（Zytra，HuggingFace，2026-05-09 创建，CC-BY-4.0，截至核实 601 次下载 / 11 赞）自我定位为「**首个面向银行、金融服务与保险（BFSI）AI 护栏的对抗性基准**」，监管框架覆盖 **RBI（印度央行）· SEBI（印度证券交易委员会）· IRDAI（印度保险监管局）· DPDP（印度数据保护法）· 欧盟 AI 法案 · FATF · BCBS · IEEE 7010**；标注方式为**专家生成 + 机器生成**混合，语言含 en / hi / te / ta（英 / 印地 / 泰卢固 / 泰米尔），卡片说明公开层 T1 含 1,228 行、规模区间 1K–10K。对 RIAA：这是**「监管合规 → 对抗测试」这一环的现成基准**。池内已收 AI 治理类条目（[[insurance-governance]] 与各国监管口径 [[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]、[[osfi-ai-risk-controls]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]）以及评测类条目（[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[garak]] 红队、[[ins-actbench]]、[[ins-mmbench]]），但**把「具体监管条款」直接做成对抗测试集，这是第一条**——它回答的是「模型在真实监管红线上的表现如何」而非「模型会不会做精算题」；多语言 + 南亚监管框架也提示了区域合规测试的思路。⚠️ 核实说明：HuggingFace 数据集页显示**访问受限（需登录/授权）**，卡片虽提到 T1 公开层，但本词条**未实际下载数据**，仅核实其卡片描述与元数据。
entries.body_en: FinProof Bench (Zytra, HuggingFace, created 2026-05-09, CC-BY-4.0, 601 downloads and 11 likes at verification) describes itself as "**the first adversarial benchmark for AI guardrails in Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI)**", covering the regulatory frameworks of **RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, DPDP, the EU AI Act, FATF, BCBS and IEEE 7010**; annotations are **expert-generated plus machine-generated**, with languages en / hi / te / ta, and the card states a public T1 tier of 1,228 rows within the 1K–10K size band. For RIAA: a ready-made benchmark for the **"regulatory compliance → adversarial testing"** stage. This corpus already holds AI-governance entries ([[insurance-governance]] and national regulatory positions [[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]], [[irdai-ai-governance]], [[naic-ai-oversight]], [[osfi-ai-risk-controls]], [[aae-ai-act-position]]) and evaluation entries ([[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]], [[garak]] red-teaming, [[ins-actbench]], [[ins-mmbench]]), but **this is the first to turn specific regulatory provisions directly into an adversarial test set** — it answers "how does a model perform against real regulatory red lines" rather than "can it do actuarial maths"; its multilingual, South-Asian regulatory framing also suggests a template for regional compliance testing. ⚠️ Verification note: the HuggingFace dataset page shows **restricted access (login/authorisation required)**; although the card mentions a public T1 tier, this entry **did not download the data** and verifies only the card description and metadata.

entries.body: EraX-VL（erax-ai，HuggingFace，Apache-2.0，基于 **Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct**）是**面向保险单据的多模态（视觉语言）模型**：从单据照片与扫描件做图像到文本抽取，主干有 **7B 与 2B 两个规模**、含 V1.0 / V1.5 / V2.0-Preview 多个版本，语言覆盖**越南语 / 英语 / 中文**，标签含 insurance / OCR / vietnamese / bcg / image-to-text。其社区热度在保险类模型中相当突出：**V1.0 版本获 44 赞**，是本次 HuggingFace 全量扫描中保险相关模型里最高之一（同族另有 2B / V1.5 / V2.0-Preview 多个衍生与量化版本）。对 RIAA：**保险单据 OCR 是理赔与核保自动化的入口环节**——越南语保险单据（保单、处方、发票）的抽取需求，说明这项能力在东南亚市场有真实落地场景，也提示「多语言单据处理」是区域扩张的实际障碍；池内已有同类但不同环节/语种的条目：[[suture-vlm]]（核保 binder 与保单差异检测 VLM）、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]（中文条款文档解析数据集）、[[insurance-voice-qwen]]（保险语音），EraX-VL 补上的是**越南语保险单据的视觉抽取**这一格；与 [[insurance-agentic-medical]]、[[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]] 等实务环节可衔接。注意：模型卡未提供详细评测指标，采用前需自测。
entries.body_en: EraX-VL (by erax-ai, on HuggingFace, Apache-2.0, based on **Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct**) is a **multimodal (vision-language) model for insurance documents**: it extracts image-to-text from document photos and scans, with **7B and 2B** backbones and V1.0 / V1.5 / V2.0-Preview versions, covering **Vietnamese, English and Chinese**, tagged insurance / OCR / vietnamese / bcg / image-to-text. Its community traction is notable among insurance models: **V1.0 has 44 likes**, among the highest in this full HuggingFace sweep of insurance-related models (the family also includes 2B, V1.5 and V2.0-Preview derivatives and quantisations). For RIAA: **insurance document OCR is the entry point for claims and underwriting automation** — demand for extracting Vietnamese insurance documents (policies, prescriptions, invoices) shows this capability has real deployments in Southeast Asia, and points to multilingual document handling as a practical barrier to regional expansion; the corpus holds comparable entries at different stages or in different languages: [[suture-vlm]] (underwriting binder vs policy difference detection, a VLM), [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]] (a Chinese clause-document parsing dataset) and [[insurance-voice-qwen]] (insurance voice); EraX-VL fills the slot for **visual extraction of Vietnamese insurance documents**; it connects to practical stages such as [[insurance-agentic-medical]] and [[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]]. Note: the model card provides no detailed evaluation metrics, so test before adopting.
entries.body_hk: EraX-VL（erax-ai，HuggingFace，Apache-2.0，基於 **Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct**）是**面向保險單據的多模態（視覺語言）模型**：從單據照片與掃描件做圖像到文本抽取，主幹有 **7B 與 2B 兩個規模**、含 V1.0 / V1.5 / V2.0-Preview 多個版本，語言覆蓋**越南語 / 英語 / 中文**。其社區熱度在保險類模型中相當突出：**V1.0 版本獲 44 讚**，是本次 HuggingFace 全量掃描中保險相關模型裡最高之一。對 RIAA：**保險單據 OCR 是理賠與核保自動化的入口環節**——越南語保險單據（保單、處方、發票）的抽取需求，說明這項能力在東南亞市場有真實落地場景；池內已有 [[suture-vlm]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[insurance-voice-qwen]]，EraX-VL 補上的是**越南語保險單據的視覺抽取**這一格；與 [[insurance-agentic-medical]]、[[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]] 等實務環節可銜接。注意：模型卡未提供詳細評測指標，採用前需自測。

entries.body: ConTEB · Insurance（illuin-conteb，HuggingFace，2025-02-02 创建 / 2025-05-30 更新，246 次下载）是 **ConTEB（Context-aware Text Embedding Benchmark，上下文感知文本嵌入基准）** 的保险主题子集，用于**评估上下文嵌入模型在保险文本上的检索能力**。其底料是 **EIOPA（欧洲保险与职业养老金管理局）的一份官方文件**，规模为 **60 篇文档 / 120 条查询**（含 documents 与 queries 两个 config，parquet 格式）。对 RIAA：做保险 RAG（条款问答、监管文件检索、产品资料助手）时最实际的问题是「**通用嵌入模型在保险术语与监管文本上到底行不行**」——这个基准就是回答该问题的工具，而且它**以监管机构官方文件为底料**，检索难度贴近真实场景（长文档、术语密集、法律措辞）。池内 RAG 侧已有 [[insuranceqa-corpus]]（保险问答语料）、[[rag-insurance]]、[[mongodb-rag-insurance]]、[[valact-rag]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]（监管检索 MCP），ConTEB 补的是「**评估**」这一环：与 [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]（可靠性）、[[ins-mmbench]] 与 [[ins-actbench]]（专业能力）并列，构成「**能力 / 可靠性 / 检索**」三类评测的第三类；其监管文本来源与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] 同属 EIOPA 体系。注意：数据集规模小（60/120），适合做嵌入模型的**对比选型**而非训练。
entries.body_en: ConTEB · Insurance (illuin-conteb, HuggingFace, created 2025-02-02 / updated 2025-05-30, 246 downloads) is the insurance subset of **ConTEB (Context-aware Text Embedding Benchmark)**, designed to **evaluate contextual embedding models on insurance text retrieval**. Its source material is **an official EIOPA (European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority) document**, at a scale of **60 documents and 120 queries** (two configs, documents and queries, in parquet). For RIAA: the most practical question when building insurance RAG (clause Q&A, regulatory document search, product-material assistants) is "**do general embedding models actually work on insurance terminology and regulatory text**" — this benchmark answers it, and because it is **grounded in an official supervisory document**, its retrieval difficulty is close to real conditions (long documents, dense terminology, legal phrasing). The corpus’s RAG side already holds [[insuranceqa-corpus]] (insurance Q&A corpus), [[rag-insurance]], [[mongodb-rag-insurance]], [[valact-rag]] and [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] (a regulatory retrieval MCP); ConTEB supplies the "**evaluation**" stage: alongside [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] (reliability) and [[ins-mmbench]] / [[ins-actbench]] (professional capability), it forms the third of three evaluation classes — **capability / reliability / retrieval**; its regulatory source shares the EIOPA family with [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]. Note: the dataset is small (60/120), suited to **comparative model selection** for embeddings rather than training.
entries.body_hk: ConTEB · Insurance（illuin-conteb，HuggingFace，2025-02-02 創建 / 2025-05-30 更新，246 次下載）是 **ConTEB（Context-aware Text Embedding Benchmark）** 的保險主題子集，用於**評估上下文嵌入模型在保險文本上的檢索能力**。其底料是 **EIOPA（歐洲保險與職業養老金管理局）的一份官方文件**，規模為 **60 篇文檔 / 120 條查詢**。對 RIAA：做保險 RAG（條款問答、監管文件檢索、產品資料助手）時最實際的問題是「**通用嵌入模型在保險術語與監管文本上到底行不行**」——這個基準就是回答該問題的工具，而且它**以監管機構官方文件為底料**，檢索難度貼近真實場景。池內 RAG 側已有 [[insuranceqa-corpus]]、[[rag-insurance]]、[[mongodb-rag-insurance]]、[[valact-rag]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]，ConTEB 補的是「**評估**」這一環：與 [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[ins-mmbench]]、[[ins-actbench]] 並列，構成「**能力 / 可靠性 / 檢索**」三類評測的第三類。注意：數據集規模小（60/120），適合做嵌入模型的**對比選型**而非訓練。

entries.title: RePEc / IDEAS · 保险与精算研究（JEL G22）
entries.title_en: RePEc / IDEAS — insurance and actuarial studies (JEL G22)
entries.title_hk: RePEc / IDEAS · 保險與精算研究（JEL G22）
entries.summary: 经济学文献库的保险分类入口：JEL G22「保险；保险公司；精算研究」+ NEP-IAS 保险经济学报告
entries.summary_en: The economics literature library’s insurance gateway: JEL G22 "Insurance; Insurance Companies; Actuarial Studies" plus the NEP-IAS insurance economics report
entries.summary_hk: 經濟學文獻庫的保險分類入口：JEL G22「保險；保險公司；精算研究」+ NEP-IAS 保險經濟學報告
entries.body:
RePEc（Research Papers in Economics）及其门户 IDEAS（`ideas.repec.org`）是**经济学与金融研究的全球文献库**，其按 **JEL 分类**浏览的 **G22「Insurance; Insurance Companies; Actuarial Studies」（保险；保险公司；精算研究）**页面是**保险与精算学术文献的规范入口**——把工作论文、期刊文章、书籍章节与软件按学科编码归集（G22 隶属 G2「金融机构与服务」，上承 G「金融经济学」；榜单分页与「follow this JEL code」订阅均可核实）。平台另有几项对本领域有用的能力：**NEP（New Economics Papers）** 按主题把 RePEc 新增文献编成邮件报告，其中 **NEP-IAS「Insurance Economics」** 即保险专题（由 Thomas Krichel 编辑，每期约 12 篇；归档页显示统计截至 2024-12-31，并另有 Bluesky 频道）；**软件组件索引**（`/i/c.html`，当前收录 37 个软件系列）；以及作者/机构排名与 RePEc Biblio 主题书单。

对 RIAA：做**文献综述**时，JEL G22 是「这个领域的学术文献全集在哪」的标准答案——它比通用搜索更结构化（按 JEL 编码 + 可按系列/作者/机构筛选），而 RePEc 只收录有工作论文系列背书的来源，因此噪声低于 Google Scholar 一类的全网检索；NEP-IAS 则是以最低成本（邮件订阅）追踪「最近新增了哪些保险经济学研究」的方式。与本 wiki 研究类条目互补：开放教材见 [[actuarial-open-book]]、[[loss-data-analytics]]，SSRN 来源的研究条目见 [[ai-in-actuarial-science]]、[[experience-rating-insurance-pricing]]，预印本见 [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]，行业研究见 [[geneva-association]]、[[cas-research-tools]]，学科期刊见 [[astin-bulletin]]；适合作文献综述、选题调研与学术方向规划。

**核实说明**：NEP-IAS 的 `/latest` 在核实当时返回的是较早一期（2022-07-18），而归档页显示的统计截至 2024-12-31——因此**该报告的更新节奏需以归档页或 Bluesky 频道为准**，不要假定它仍按原频率出刊。
entries.body_en:
RePEc (Research Papers in Economics) and its portal IDEAS (`ideas.repec.org`) are **the global literature library for economics and finance research**, and their browse-by-JEL-classification page for **G22, "Insurance; Insurance Companies; Actuarial Studies"**, is **the canonical gateway to insurance and actuarial academic literature** — gathering working papers, journal articles, book chapters and software under the discipline’s classification code (G22 sits under G2 "Financial Institutions and Services", itself under G "Financial Economics"; the paginated listings and a "follow this JEL code" subscription are verifiable). The platform offers several further capabilities useful in this field: **NEP (New Economics Papers)**, which filters new RePEc additions into edited email reports by topic — including **NEP-IAS, "Insurance Economics"** (edited by Thomas Krichel, roughly 12 papers per issue; the archive page shows statistics as of 2024-12-31, and there is also a Bluesky channel); a **software components index** (`/i/c.html`, currently covering 37 software series); and author/institution rankings plus RePEc Biblio reading lists.

For RIAA: for a **literature review**, JEL G22 is the standard answer to "where is the full set of academic literature in this field" — more structured than general search (by JEL code, filterable by series, author and institution), and because RePEc only indexes sources backed by a working-paper series, it is less noisy than whole-web search such as Google Scholar; NEP-IAS is the lowest-cost way (email subscription) to track "what insurance economics research was just added". It complements this wiki’s research entries: open textbooks in [[actuarial-open-book]] and [[loss-data-analytics]], SSRN-sourced research entries in [[ai-in-actuarial-science]] and [[experience-rating-insurance-pricing]], preprints in [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]], industry research in [[geneva-association]] and [[cas-research-tools]], and the discipline’s journal in [[astin-bulletin]]; suits literature reviews, topic scoping and academic planning.

**Verification note**: at the time of verification NEP-IAS’s `/latest` returned an earlier issue (2022-07-18) while the archive page showed statistics as of 2024-12-31 — so **treat the archive page or the Bluesky channel as authoritative for the report’s current cadence** and do not assume it still publishes at its original frequency.

**核實說明**：NEP-IAS 的 `/latest` 在核實當時返回的是較早一期（2022-07-18），而歸檔頁顯示統計截至 2024-12-31——因此**該報告的更新節奏需以歸檔頁或 Bluesky 頻道為準**。

entries.body: 这是一个 **MSc 学位论文的可复现分析管道**（Zenodo 开放获取，MIT 许可，2026-08-20，DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22020127`），对应伦敦玛丽女王大学（Queen Mary University of London）2026 年论文《A Study of Claims Inflation in Malaysian Motor Insurance: An Inflation-Adjusted Chain Ladder Approach》。包内 5 个文件、代码主体为单个 63KB Python 管道（另含 README、requirements、LICENSE、CHANGELOG，工程规范完整）：从**市场整体汇总理赔数据**估计马来西亚**私家车 Own Damage（车损）与 Third Party Property Damage（三者财损）**的**逐日历季度理赔通胀**，方法用对数线性与分段回归（piecewise regression），并做验证。对 RIAA：这条补上的是一个**此前完全空白的形态——「学位论文级可复现包」**：它不只是方法，而是**一线可跑的完整代码 + 数据来源说明 + 项目结构规范**，对准备做毕业论文的学生价值非常直接（可对照自己的代码组织、requirements 管理、CHANGELOG 实践）。方法上它串起了本 wiki 的两条主线：**理赔通胀**（[[insurance-trend]]、[[insurance-nowcast]] 是对应的方法论条目）与**链梯法准备金**（[[chainladder-python]]、[[chainladder]]、[[dcl]]），而「通胀调整」正是把两者接起来的关键环节；可复现工程实践可对照 [[reproducible-actuarial-work]] 与 [[actuarial-python-lab]]；区域上马来西亚车险参见 [[bnm-insurance-takaful]]。适合作毕业论文选题、准备金与通胀方法论、以及代码工程规范参考。
entries.body_en: This is an **MSc dissertation reproducibility package** (open access on Zenodo, MIT licensed, 2026-08-20, DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22020127`), accompanying the 2026 Queen Mary University of London dissertation "A Study of Claims Inflation in Malaysian Motor Insurance: An Inflation-Adjusted Chain Ladder Approach". The record has five files with the code as a single 63KB Python pipeline (plus README, requirements, LICENSE and CHANGELOG — complete engineering hygiene): it estimates **calendar-quarter claims inflation** for **Malaysian private car Own Damage and Third Party Property Damage** from market-wide aggregated claims data, using log-linear and piecewise regression, and includes validation. For RIAA: this fills a **previously empty form — the dissertation-grade reproducibility package**. It is not just a method but **a complete runnable codebase with documented data provenance and project structure**, directly useful to students preparing a dissertation (compare your own code organisation, requirements management and CHANGELOG practice). Methodologically it connects two of this wiki’s threads: **claims inflation** (with [[insurance-trend]] and [[insurance-nowcast]] as the corresponding methodology entries) and **chain-ladder reserving** ([[chainladder-python]], [[chainladder]], [[dcl]]) — inflation adjustment being the link between them; for reproducible engineering practice compare [[reproducible-actuarial-work]] and [[actuarial-python-lab]]; for the regional context of Malaysian motor insurance see [[bnm-insurance-takaful]]. Suits dissertation topic selection, reserving and inflation methodology, and code-engineering standards.

entries.body: 这是**一份 MSc 精算学位论文的配套软件包**（Zenodo 开放获取，2026-09-08，DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22662352`），完整归档了 v1.0.0 论文提交版本（单个 33.6MB zip）。功能覆盖**模拟、准备金评估、敏感性分析与报告**，研究主题是：**理赔通胀、结构性变化，以及 Excess-of-Loss（超赔）合约的指数化条款，如何影响毛准备金与分出准备金的估计**。对 RIAA：这条正好落在本 wiki 两条重要线索的**交叉点上**——**准备金**（[[reservingmodels]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]]、[[ibnr]]、[[chainladder-python]]）与**再保分层**（[[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]]、[[layerloss-locktonre]]、[[retention]]）。它的独特价值在于把三件常在实务中分开讨论的事放在一个模型里：**通胀、结构断点、再保合约指数化**——而这三者恰恰是「分出准备金」估计误差的主要来源；同时它是**可复现包形态**（见另一条同批入库的 [[claims-inflation-motor-my]]），两份 MSc 论文包并列展示同一条思路的两种论文选题（车险通胀链梯 vs XoL 通胀准备金）。适合作准备金、再保定价与通胀方法论方向，以及毕业论文选题参考。
entries.body_en: This is the **accompanying software package of an MSc actuarial dissertation** (open access on Zenodo, 2026-09-08, DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22662352`), archiving the exact v1.0.0 submission release (a single 33.6MB zip). It covers **simulation, reserving, sensitivity analysis and reporting**, and studies how **claims inflation, structural change, and excess-of-loss (XoL) treaty indexation** affect gross and ceded reserve estimates. For RIAA: this sits precisely at the **intersection of two important threads** in this wiki — **reserving** ([[reservingmodels]], [[stochastic-reserving-england]], [[ibnr]], [[chainladder-python]]) and **reinsurance layering** ([[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]], [[layerloss-locktonre]], [[retention]]). Its distinctive value is putting three things usually discussed separately into one model: **inflation, structural breaks and reinsurance treaty indexation** — and these are exactly the main sources of error in ceded reserve estimation; it is also a **reproducibility package** (see [[claims-inflation-motor-my]], added in the same batch), and the two MSc packages side by side show two dissertation takes on one idea (motor inflation chain ladder vs inflation-aware XoL reserving). Suits reserving, reinsurance pricing and inflation methodology, plus dissertation topic selection.

entries.body:
data.gov.au 是**澳大利亚政府的开放数据门户**，采用 CKAN 标准架构并**开放只读 API**——这一点很关键，因为它让保险数据可以被**程序化取用**，而不是只能一页页下载 PDF。用其 CKAN 接口核实：关键词 `insurance` 返回 **2,167 个数据集**，覆盖联邦与州两级、多个与保险直接相关的机构，包括 **Australian Prudential Regulation Authority（APRA，澳洲审慎监管局）**、NSW Government、Victorian Managed Insurance Authority、Motor Accident Insurance Commission、各州财政厅（DTF / Department of Treasury and Finance）等；其中对本领域最有价值的几条是：**Quarterly General Insurance Performance Statistics**（季度产险业绩统计）、**Life Insurance Institution-level Statistics**（寿险**逐机构**统计）、**General Insurance Institution-level Statistics**（产险逐机构统计）、**Intermediated General Insurance Statistics**（中介渠道产险统计）、各类 **Insurance Duty Rates**（印花税/保费税率）以及灾后专项（如 **Insurance - Flood Event 2026**）。

对 RIAA：**「逐机构（institution-level）」这四个字是它最大的价值**——做公司层面分析、同业对比或市场集中度研究时，需要的正是分机构的口径，而这类数据在多数市场并不公开或只以 PDF 呈现；本 wiki 此前与澳洲保险数据相关的条目是 [[apra-insurance-statistics]]（APRA 官方发布页，**人读口径**）与 [[apra-mcp]]（把 APRA 数据做成 agent 可调用的 MCP），本词条补上的是**机器可读的整站入口**，三者构成「官方发布页 → 开放数据 API → agent 调用」的完整链路；区域刊物 [[insuranceasia-news]] 可提供这些数字背后的行业语境，资格与行业侧见 [[actuaries-institute]]；跨国口径仍应回 [[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[iais-gimar]]；巨灾与风险转移侧可接 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[perils-ied]]。**核实方式**：经其 CKAN `package_search` API 实测（count 2,167、机构与标题均已列出）；首页与搜索页均 HTTP 200。适合作市场与公司分析、数据工程取数与澳洲市场方向。
entries.body_en:
data.gov.au is **the Australian government’s open data portal**, built on the CKAN standard with an **open read-only API** — which matters, because it makes insurance data **programmatically accessible** rather than only downloadable as PDFs page by page. Verified through its CKAN interface: the keyword `insurance` returns **2,167 datasets** spanning federal and state levels and several directly relevant agencies, including the **Australian Prudential Regulation Authority (APRA)**, the NSW Government, the Victorian Managed Insurance Authority, the Motor Accident Insurance Commission and state treasuries (DTF / Department of Treasury and Finance); the most valuable for this field include **Quarterly General Insurance Performance Statistics**, **Life Insurance Institution-level Statistics**, **General Insurance Institution-level Statistics**, **Intermediated General Insurance Statistics**, the various **Insurance Duty Rates**, and event-specific sets such as **Insurance - Flood Event 2026**.

For RIAA: **"institution-level" is the key phrase** — company-level analysis, peer comparison and market-concentration studies need exactly that granularity, and in most markets such data is either not public or only available as PDFs; this wiki’s existing Australia-related entries are [[apra-insurance-statistics]] (APRA’s publication page, a **human-readable** view) and [[apra-mcp]] (APRA data exposed to agents via MCP), and this entry adds the **machine-readable whole-of-portal entry point**, so the three form a complete chain: "official publication page → open data API → agent tooling"; the regional title [[insuranceasia-news]] supplies industry context behind those numbers, and [[actuaries-institute]] covers qualifications and the profession; for cross-country figures return to [[oecd-insurance-data]] and [[iais-gimar]]; for catastrophe and risk transfer connect [[cat-bond-pricing]] and [[perils-ied]]. **Verification method**: measured via its CKAN `package_search` API (count 2,167; organisations and titles listed); home page and search page both HTTP 200. Suits market and company analysis, data-engineering access and Australian market work.
entries.body_hk:
data.gov.au 是**澳大利亞政府的開放數據門戶**，採用 CKAN 標準架構並**開放只讀 API**——這點很關鍵，因為它讓保險數據可以被**程序化取用**。用其 CKAN 接口核實：關鍵詞 `insurance` 返回 **2,167 個數據集**，覆蓋聯邦與州兩級，機構包括 **APRA（澳洲審慎監管局）**、NSW Government、Victorian Managed Insurance Authority、Motor Accident Insurance Commission、各州財政廳等；對本領域最有價值的幾條：**Quarterly General Insurance Performance Statistics**、**Life Insurance Institution-level Statistics**（壽險**逐機構**統計）、**General Insurance Institution-level Statistics**、**Intermediated General Insurance Statistics**、各類 **Insurance Duty Rates**，以及災後專項（如 **Insurance - Flood Event 2026**）。

對 RIAA：**「逐機構（institution-level）」是它最大的價值**——做公司層面分析、同業對比或市場集中度研究時需要的正是分機構口徑；本 wiki 此前與澳洲保險數據相關的是 [[apra-insurance-statistics]]（**人讀口徑**）與 [[apra-mcp]]（agent 可調用），本詞條補上**機器可讀的整站入口**，三者構成「官方發布頁 → 開放數據 API → agent 調用」的完整鏈路；跨國口徑仍應回 [[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[iais-gimar]]；巨災與風險轉移側可接 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[perils-ied]]。**核實方式**：經其 CKAN `package_search` API 實測（count 2,167）。適合作市場與公司分析、數據工程取數與澳洲市場方向。

entries.body:
data.europa.eu 是**欧盟的官方开放数据门户**（聚合欧盟机构与各成员国的开放数据），并提供**公开检索 API**。用其检索接口核实：关键词 `insurance` 命中 **3,028 个数据集**，结果按国家标注，样例包括立陶宛的动物保险风险管理措施、西班牙的**保险经纪与保险机构之间的合约**数据、欧洲层面的**国际保险交易**统计等——说明它覆盖的不只是「保险统计」，还包括**与保险定价相关的周边数据**（农业、道路、健康、税收）。门户另有一个面向开发者的检索端点与数据集页面。

对 RIAA：欧陆保险研究常用「**监管统计 + 成员国开放数据**」两层结构——本 wiki 已有 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]（EIOPA 的**监管口径**统计）与 [[insurance-europe]]（行业联合会的议题与立场），但**成员国层面的开放数据此前缺位**；data.europa.eu 正好补上这一层，且它常能提供**保险公司年报之外**的底料（如事故统计、农业与气候数据），适合做**地区细分**或**风险因子**研究。跨国口径对照 [[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[iais-gimar]]，偿付能力侧 [[solvency2rfr]]，行业研究 [[geneva-association]]，气候与灾害底数据 [[climada]]、[[gdacs]]、[[open-meteo]]。**核实说明**：门户前端为 JS 单页应用（`/data/datasets` 页面本身渲染文本很少），因此本词条的核实**通过其公开检索 API 完成**——确认命中数量、国家标注与数据集标题均真实返回；未逐个下载数据集。适合作欧洲地区细分研究、风险因子数据与跨国数据工程方向。
entries.body_en:
data.europa.eu is **the European Union’s official open data portal** (aggregating open data from EU institutions and member states) and it exposes a **public search API**. Verified through that search interface: the keyword `insurance` returns **3,028 datasets**, tagged by country — samples include Lithuanian animal-insurance risk-management measures, Spanish data on **contracts between insurance brokers and insurance entities**, and Europe-level **international insurance transactions** statistics — showing that it covers not only "insurance statistics" but also **adjacent data used in insurance pricing** (agriculture, roads, health, taxation). The portal also offers a developer-facing search endpoint and dataset pages.

For RIAA: European insurance research typically uses a two-layer structure of "**supervisory statistics + member-state open data**" — this wiki already has [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] (EIOPA’s **regulatory** statistics) and [[insurance-europe]] (the industry federation’s positions), but the **member-state open data layer was missing**; data.europa.eu fills it, and it often supplies material **beyond insurer annual reports** (accident statistics, agricultural and climate data) suited to **sub-regional** or **risk-factor** research. For cross-country figures compare [[oecd-insurance-data]] and [[iais-gimar]], for solvency see [[solvency2rfr]], for industry research [[geneva-association]], and for climate and hazard base data [[climada]], [[gdacs]] and [[open-meteo]]. **Verification note**: the portal front end is a JavaScript single-page app (the `/data/datasets` page itself renders very little text), so this entry was **verified through its public search API** — confirming that the hit count, country tags and dataset titles are genuinely returned; datasets were not downloaded individually. Suits European sub-regional research, risk-factor data and cross-country data engineering.

對 RIAA：歐陸保險研究常用「**監管統計 + 成員國開放數據**」兩層結構——本 wiki 已有 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]（**監管口徑**）與 [[insurance-europe]]（行業聯合會立場），但**成員國層面的開放數據此前缺位**；data.europa.eu 正好補上，且常能提供**保險公司年報之外**的底料（事故統計、農業與氣候數據）。跨國口徑對照 [[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[iais-gimar]]，償付能力側 [[solvency2rfr]]，行業研究 [[geneva-association]]，氣候與災害底數據 [[climada]]、[[gdacs]]、[[open-meteo]]。**核實說明**：門戶前端為 JS 單頁應用，因此本詞條的核實**通過其公開檢索 API 完成**——確認命中數量、國家標註與數據集標題均真實返回；未逐個下載數據集。適合作歐洲地區細分研究、風險因子數據與跨國數據工程方向。

entries.body:
Root Insurance MCP Server（`@rootplatform/mcp-server`，npm，MIT，最新 1.7.1 / 2026-04-21，**自 2025-07-10 起已发布 36 个版本**）是**保险平台官方提供的 MCP 服务器**（stdio 传输）：让 AI 模型可以直接调用 Root Insurance 的工具来完成**创建报价（quotes）、管理保单（policies）以及产品模块开发**等完整保险工作流；使用前需要 Root Platform 的 API Key（README 明确指向 root.co.za）。

对 RIAA：这条补的是**「保险核心平台把自身能力开放给 agent」这一形态**——池内 MCP 已有十几条，但多数是**数据源型**（监管数据 [[apra-mcp]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、准备金工具 [[mcp-chainladder]]、理赔 [[claims-triage-mcp]]、核保 [[underwriting-intel-mcp]]、平台对接 [[guidewire-mcp]]），而**由保险平台厂商自己发布、覆盖「报价 → 保单 → 产品模块」全流程的官方 MCP，这是第一条**。它和池内的核心系统条目构成「系统 → 接口 → agent」的层次：PAS/核心系统见 [[latticepolicy]]、[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[quickfire-ams]]、[[socotra]]、[[covergo]]，规则/费率引擎见 [[openl-tablets]]，参考架构见 [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]]；开放保险方向的整体思路见 [[openinsurance]]。

**核实说明**：npm 官方元数据与 README（4,985 字）已核实（含安装方式与 API Key 前置要求）；其 GitHub 仓库 `RootBank/root-mcp` **当前不可公开访问（Not Found，可能为私有）**，因此本词条的能力描述**仅依据 npm 描述与 README**，未对其内部实现作评判。适合作保险平台集成、agent 工程与核心系统对接方向。
entries.body_en:
The Root Insurance MCP Server (`@rootplatform/mcp-server`, npm, MIT, latest 1.7.1 / 2026-04-21, **36 versions since 2025-07-10**) is **an insurance platform’s official MCP server** (stdio transport): it lets AI models call Root Insurance tools to complete the full insurance workflow — **creating quotes, managing policies and developing product modules** — and requires a Root Platform API key (the README points to root.co.za).

For RIAA: this fills in the form of "**an insurance core platform opening its own capabilities to agents**" — the corpus already has a dozen-plus MCPs, but most are **data-source type** (regulatory data [[apra-mcp]], [[insurance-ai-mcp]], reserving tools [[mcp-chainladder]], claims [[claims-triage-mcp]], underwriting [[underwriting-intel-mcp]], platform integration [[guidewire-mcp]]), whereas **an official MCP published by the platform vendor itself and covering the entire "quote → policy → product module" flow is the first of its kind here**. With the corpus’s core-system entries it forms a "system → interface → agent" hierarchy: PAS/core systems in [[latticepolicy]], [[titanium-insurance-core]], [[quickfire-ams]], [[socotra]] and [[covergo]]; rules/rating engines in [[openl-tablets]]; reference architectures in [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]] and [[acord-mcp-architecture]]; the broader open-insurance direction in [[openinsurance]].

**Verification note**: the npm metadata and README (4,985 characters, including installation and the API-key prerequisite) have been verified; its GitHub repository `RootBank/root-mcp` is **currently not publicly accessible (Not Found — possibly private)**, so the capability description here **relies only on the npm description and README** and makes no judgement about the internal implementation. Suits insurance platform integration, agent engineering and core-system connectivity.

entries.body:
CL-SDK（`@claritylabs/cl-sdk`，npm，Apache-2.0，最新 4.6.0 / 2026-08-11，**自 2026-03-22 起已发布 127 个版本**）自我定位为「**Deterministic insurance intelligence primitives for regulated AI agents**」（面向受监管 AI agent 的**确定性**保险智能基元），README 达 13,362 字并附独立文档站（`cl-sdk.claritylabs.inc/docs`）；首位能力是 **Document Extraction — 源树抽取（source-tree extraction）**，即把解析器产物结构化为可用的保险文档数据。

对 RIAA：这条的价值点在「**deterministic（确定性）**」与「**regulated（受监管）**」这两个限定词上——它们精准描述了保险业采用 AI 时最难的那道门槛：**监管要求结论可复现、可追溯，而生成式模型本质是概率性的**。池内此前已有一条思路相近的条目 [[quorumforge]]（对智能体审议记录做**确定性裁决**，同输入同字节同摘要），CL-SDK 补的是**文档环节**的确定性：把非结构化保单/条款转成结构化数据时，让抽取结果可复现而非「每次略有不同」。它与池内文档抽取族形成分工：[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]（中文条款数据集）、[[suture-vlm]]（核保 binder 差异检测 VLM）、[[erax-vl]]（越南语保险单据多模态抽取）、[[evidence-review-claims]]（图像证据裁决）；治理与可信度侧见 [[insurance-governance]]、[[phi-boundary-gate]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]；实务 agent 侧见 [[agrisky-ai]]（农险查勘定损，同样强调「模型不得改写关键数值」的确定性设计）。适合作文档自动化、受监管 AI 与 agent 工程方向。

**核实说明**：npm 官方元数据与 README 已核实；其 GitHub 仓库 `claritylabs-inc/cl-sdk` 可访问（Apache-2.0、TypeScript、2.1MB），但**仓库描述与 topics 为空、星标仅 1**，故本词条的能力描述**主要依据 npm README 与官方文档站**，未对其实现质量作评判。
entries.body_en:
CL-SDK (`@claritylabs/cl-sdk`, npm, Apache-2.0, latest 4.6.0 / 2026-08-11, **127 versions since 2026-03-22**) describes itself as "**Deterministic insurance intelligence primitives for regulated AI agents**", with a 13,362-character README and a dedicated documentation site (`cl-sdk.claritylabs.inc/docs`); its first listed capability is **Document Extraction — source-tree extraction that turns parser products into structured data**.

For RIAA: the value here lies in the two qualifiers "**deterministic**" and "**regulated**" — they describe precisely the hardest threshold for AI adoption in insurance: **supervisors require reproducible and traceable conclusions, while generative models are probabilistic by nature**. The corpus already holds a closely related idea in [[quorumforge]] (deterministic adjudication over agent deliberation records — same input, same bytes, same digest), and CL-SDK supplies the deterministic counterpart **at the document stage**: when turning unstructured policies and clauses into structured data, it aims to make extraction reproducible rather than "slightly different each time". It divides labour with the corpus’s document-extraction family: [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]] (Chinese clause dataset), [[suture-vlm]] (underwriting binder difference detection via a VLM), [[erax-vl]] (Vietnamese insurance document extraction) and [[evidence-review-claims]] (image-evidence adjudication); for governance and trust see [[insurance-governance]], [[phi-boundary-gate]] and [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]; for practical agents see [[agrisky-ai]] (agricultural claims assessment, which likewise insists that the model must not rewrite key numbers). Suits document automation, regulated AI and agent engineering.

**Verification note**: the npm metadata and README have been verified; its GitHub repository `claritylabs-inc/cl-sdk` is reachable (Apache-2.0, TypeScript, 2.1MB), but the **repository description and topics are empty and it has only 1 star**, so the capability description here **rests mainly on the npm README and the official documentation site**, with no judgement about implementation quality.

entries.body:
Annals of Actuarial Science 是**英国精算师协会（IFoA）的会刊**，由 Cambridge University Press 出版（`cambridge.org/core/journals/annals-of-actuarial-science`）。可核实信息：**ISSN 1748-4995（印刷）/ 1748-5002（在线）**，**主编 Andreas Tsanakas**（City St George’s, University of London），编委含 Andrew Cairns、Angus Macdonald 等知名精算学者；学科归类为「社会科学—数学方法 / 数学—交叉应用 / 统计与概率」，期刊页面列有 2025 年影响因子与全部过刊（All issues）。

对 RIAA：这是**英式精算研究的主场之一**，与 [[ifoa]] 的资格与教育体系同源——若考虑在英国体系下做研究或深造，这是最需要对标的期刊。它和本 wiki 已有的 [[astin-bulletin]]（IAA 非寿险分会会刊，**产险方法论**为主）形成互补：ASTIN Bulletin 偏方法（准备金、极值、定价），Annals 覆盖面更宽（含职业议题、监管、数据科学）。文献检索入口见 [[repec-g22]]（JEL G22），研究资源见 [[cas-research-tools]]、[[ifoa-data-science-research]]，开放教材见 [[actuarial-open-book]]，近期预印本例子见 [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]。适合作文献综述、投稿方向选择与研究型作业。**核实说明**：期刊主页与过刊页均 HTTP 200（745KB / 803KB）实测；**未核实具体文章全文**（多数需订阅或机构访问）。
entries.body_en:
Annals of Actuarial Science is **the journal of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA)**, published by Cambridge University Press (`cambridge.org/core/journals/annals-of-actuarial-science`). Verifiable details: **ISSN 1748-4995 (print) / 1748-5002 (online)**, **Editor Andreas Tsanakas** (City St George’s, University of London), with an editorial board including well-known actuarial academics such as Andrew Cairns and Angus Macdonald; its subject classifications are "Social Sciences – Mathematical Methods / Mathematics – Interdisciplinary Applications / Statistics and Probability", and the journal page lists a 2025 impact factor plus the full archive (All issues).

For RIAA: this is **one of the main venues for British-style actuarial research**, sharing its lineage with the [[ifoa]] qualification and education system — the journal to benchmark against if you are considering research or further study within the UK system. It complements this wiki’s existing [[astin-bulletin]] (the IAA’s non-life section journal, focused on **general insurance methodology**): ASTIN Bulletin leans methodological (reserving, extremes, pricing) while Annals covers a wider remit including professional issues, regulation and data science. For literature searching see [[repec-g22]] (JEL G22); research resources in [[cas-research-tools]] and [[ifoa-data-science-research]]; open textbooks in [[actuarial-open-book]]; a recent preprint example in [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]. Suits literature reviews, choosing where to submit, and research assignments. **Verification note**: the journal home page and archive page were both measured at HTTP 200 (745KB / 803KB); **individual article full texts were not verified** (most require a subscription or institutional access).

European Actuarial Journal（EAJ，Springer，`link.springer.com/journal/13385`）是**欧洲精算学界的研究期刊**。可核实信息：**印刷 ISSN 2190-9733 / 电子 ISSN 2190-9741**；**Journal Impact Factor 1.7（2025）**、五年影响因子 1.6（2025）；**投稿到首次决定中位数 15 天**；出版模式为 **Hybrid**（混合开放获取，即部分文章开放获取、其余需订阅）；宗旨聚焦「保险及相关金融风险的研究、建模与管理，以随机模型为核心」。近期开放获取文章示例：*The actuarial origins of survival models*（Stephen J. 对 RIAA：EAJ 的定位介于「纯方法论」与「职业实践」之间，且**明确以欧洲监管环境为背景**——这与本 wiki 的欧洲条目正好成套：行业联合会立场见 [[insurance-europe]]，监管统计见 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]，全球智库口径见 [[geneva-association]]；方法论上它与 [[astin-bulletin]]（非寿险方法论）互补，主题覆盖可对照池内 [[resurv]]（准备金）、[[openirm]]（开放内部模型）一类条目。**15 天初审中位数**这个数字对考虑投稿的学生也有参考价值。文献检索入口见 [[repec-g22]]。适合作文献综述、欧洲方向研究与投稿参考。**核实说明**：期刊主页 HTTP 200（234KB）实测，未核实文章全文。
entries.body_en:
The European Actuarial Journal (EAJ, Springer, `link.springer.com/journal/13385`) is **the European actuarial community’s research journal**. Verifiable details: **print ISSN 2190-9733 / electronic ISSN 2190-9741**; **Journal Impact Factor 1.7 (2025)** and five-year IF 1.6 (2025); **median submission-to-first-decision of 15 days**; **Hybrid** publishing model (some articles open access, the rest by subscription); its aims and scope centre on "the study, modelling and managing of insurance and related financial risks", with stochastic models at the core. A recent open-access example: *The actuarial origins of survival models* (Stephen J. Richards, 2026-09-05).

For RIAA: EAJ sits between "pure methodology" and "professional practice" and is **explicitly framed against the European regulatory environment** — which pairs neatly with this wiki’s European entries: the industry federation’s positions in [[insurance-europe]], supervisory statistics in [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], and the global think-tank view in [[geneva-association]]; methodologically it complements [[astin-bulletin]] (non-life methodology), and its topical range can be compared with corpus entries such as [[resurv]] (reserving) and [[openirm]] (open internal models). The **15-day median first decision** is also a useful data point for students considering where to submit. For literature searching see [[repec-g22]]. Suits literature reviews, European-focused research and submission choices. **Verification note**: the journal home page was measured at HTTP 200 (234KB); article full texts were not verified.

The Geneva Papers on Risk and Insurance – Issues and Practice 是 **[[geneva-association]]（日内瓦协会）的旗舰期刊**，由 Springer/Palgrave 出版（`link.springer.com/journal/41288`）。可核实信息：**印刷 ISSN 1018-5895 / 电子 ISSN 1468-0440**；**Journal Impact Factor 1.3（2025）**、五年影响因子 2.1（2025）；**投稿到首次决定中位数 9 天**；出版模式为 **Hybrid**；期刊自述为「推进全球保险业科学知识的旗舰期刊（Flagship journal）」。近期开放获取文章示例：*Systemic cyber risks and insurance regulatory capital*（2026-08）。

对 RIAA：这份期刊的定位与另两份**明显不同**——[[astin-bulletin]] 与 [[european-actuarial-journal]] 偏**数理方法论**，而 Geneva Papers 偏**保险业的经济、监管与实务议题**（风险与保险的经济学、监管资本、网络风险、气候与保障缺口等），因此它是「**方法论期刊 → 行业与政策期刊**」两个层次里的后者；这与本 wiki 的行业与政策条目天然配套：全球智库研究见 [[geneva-association]]，行业联合会立场见 [[insurance-europe]]，行业基准数据见 [[swiss-re-sigma]]，治理议题见 [[insurance-governance]]，网络风险与资本议题可对照 [[cyber-risk-classification]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]。适合作行业研究、监管与政策方向的论文阅读与选题。**核实说明**：期刊主页 HTTP 200（225KB）实测，未核实文章全文。

entries.body:
**logmu**（GitHub `logmu-org/r-logmu`，文档站 `r-logmu.logmu.org`）是 2026 年新出的 R 包，自述标题为 **「Actuarial Mortality Experience Analysis and Modelling（精算死亡率经验分析与建模）」**。可核实信息：**版本 0.1.0**、**Apache-2.0**、作者 **Tim Gordon**（ORCID 0009-0006-3087-4384）、仓库 **2026-08-31 创建、2026-09-10 仍在推送**、**9,261 KB**、主语言 **C++**（`cpp11` + **C++20**）、**Depends R ≥ 4.6.0**、Imports `datey`、`ggplot2 ≥ 4.0.0`、`Language: en-GB`；文档站 HTTP 200（17KB）实测。

能力（据 DESCRIPTION 与 README）：**①** 灵活的死亡率框架，含**时间型协变量**与**任意比例风险模型**；**②** A/E（实际/预期）分析含**置信区间与残差**及可视化；**③** 极大似然拟合、**AIC 选模型**、**协变量聚类**一条流水线完成；**④** 全程支持**权重（金额 vs 人数）**、**概率相关性加权**（例如让较早数据权重更低）与**时间型纳入条件**（例如按年龄切分经验期）；**⑤** 特别支持**邮编型社会经济死亡率模型**；**⑥** 计算用 **SIMD 向量化 + 多线程**。README 称作者已把其中原理用于**英美荷约 £1,000 亿的 longevity 交易**（**这是作者自述**，非独立核实）。⚠️ **两处如实标注**：NEWS 写 "Initial CRAN release"，但 **CRAN 包页在本次核实（2026-09-11）返回 Not Found**，即尚未正式上架；仓库 **0 star、无 topics**，尚无社区采用。

对 RIAA：**「设定与复核基础死亡率（base mortality）」是人寿、年金与养老金负债估值的第一道工序**，而 A/E 分析正是它的日常工作语言。这个包的价值不在「又一个模型」，而在**把 A/E → 模型拟合 → 选型 → 可视化做成一条流水线**，且**权重口径（金额/人数）与数据时效加权是一等公民**——这两点恰恰是学生作业里最容易做错、报告里又最容易被追问的地方。**邮编型社会经济模型**这一支在池内属于空白：池中有 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[mortalitylaws]]、[[mortsoa]]、[[cvmortalitymult]]、[[multipopulation-mortality-models]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[mortalitytables]] 等**人群/表层面**资源，也有 [[expstudy]]、[[experienceanalysis-jl]] 一类**经验分析**工具，但**「同一张表按地区/社会经济分层调参」**这一层此前没有专门条目。姊妹包见 [[datey]]（年格日期运算，本包的依赖），公司型寿险建模见 [[lifeinsurer]]，生存模型见 [[lifecontingencies]]，公式手册见 [[ifoa-formulae-tables]]，开放教材见 [[actuarial-open-book]]。适合人寿/年金/养老金方向的作业与毕设。**核实说明**：GitHub 仓库元数据、DESCRIPTION、NEWS、README、文档站均实测；**未运行代码，未验证性能宣称**。
entries.body_en:
**logmu** (GitHub `logmu-org/r-logmu`, docs at `r-logmu.logmu.org`) is a 2026 R package whose DESCRIPTION title is **"Actuarial Mortality Experience Analysis and Modelling"**. Verifiable details: **version 0.1.0**, **Apache-2.0**, author **Tim Gordon** (ORCID 0009-0006-3087-4384), repository **created 2026-08-31 and still pushed on 2026-09-10**, **9,261 KB**, primary language **C++** (`cpp11` + **C++20**), **Depends R ≥ 4.6.0**, Imports `datey` and `ggplot2 ≥ 4.0.0`, `Language: en-GB`; the docs site measured HTTP 200 (17KB).

Capabilities (from DESCRIPTION and README): **①** a flexible mortality framework with **time-based covariates** and **arbitrary proportional hazards models**; **②** A/E (actual vs expected) analysis including **confidence intervals and residuals** with visualisation; **③** maximum-likelihood fitting, **AIC-based model selection** and **covariate clustering** in a single pipeline; **④** end-to-end support for **weighting (amounts vs lives)**, **probabilistic relevance weighting** (e.g. down-weighting older data) and **time-based inclusion criteria** (e.g. sub-setting experience by age); **⑤** particular support for **postcode-based socio-economic mortality models**; **⑥** calculations using **SIMD vectorisation and multi-threading**. The README states that the author has applied these principles to **longevity transactions of c.£100Bn across the UK, US and Netherlands** (**the author’s own claim**, not independently verified). ⚠️ **Two honest caveats**: NEWS says "Initial CRAN release" but the **CRAN package page returned Not Found at this check (2026-09-11)**, i.e. not yet formally published there; the repository has **0 stars and no topics** and no community adoption yet.

For RIAA: **setting and reviewing base mortality is the first step in valuing life, annuity and pension liabilities**, and A/E analysis is the everyday language of that work. This package’s value is not "yet another model" but **turning A/E → model fitting → selection → visualisation into one pipeline**, with **weighting conventions (amounts vs lives) and data-recency weighting as first-class citizens** — precisely the two things students most often get wrong in assignments and are most often challenged on in reports. Its **postcode-based socio-economic models** fill a gap in this corpus: it holds population/table-level resources such as [[human-mortality-db]], [[mortalitylaws]], [[mortsoa]], [[cvmortalitymult]], [[multipopulation-mortality-models]], [[cmi-mortality-projections]] and [[mortalitytables]], plus experience-analysis tools such as [[expstudy]] and [[experienceanalysis-jl]], but **"adjusting one table by region and socio-economic stratum"** had no dedicated entry. Sister package: [[datey]] (annual-grid date arithmetic, a dependency of this package); company life modelling: [[lifeinsurer]]; survival models: [[lifecontingencies]]; formulae handbook: [[ifoa-formulae-tables]]; open textbooks: [[actuarial-open-book]]. Suits life/annuity/pension assignments and dissertations. **Verification note**: GitHub repository metadata, DESCRIPTION, NEWS, README and the docs site were all measured; **the code was not run and performance claims were not verified**.
entries.body_hk:
**logmu**（GitHub `logmu-org/r-logmu`，文檔站 `r-logmu.logmu.org`）是 2026 年新出的 R 包，自述標題為 **「Actuarial Mortality Experience Analysis and Modelling（精算死亡率經驗分析與建模）」**。可核實資訊：**版本 0.1.0**、**Apache-2.0**、作者 **Tim Gordon**（ORCID 0009-0006-3087-4384）、倉庫 **2026-08-31 建立、2026-09-10 仍在推送**、**9,261 KB**、主語言 **C++**（`cpp11` + **C++20**）、**Depends R ≥ 4.6.0**、Imports `datey`、`ggplot2 ≥ 4.0.0`；文檔站 HTTP 200 實測。

能力：**①** 靈活死亡率框架，含**時間型協變量**與**任意比例風險模型**；**②** A/E 分析含**置信區間與殘差**及可視化；**③** 極大似然擬合、**AIC 選模型**、**協變量聚類**一條流水線完成；**④** 全程支援**權重（金額 vs 人數）**、**概率相關性加權**與**時間型納入條件**；**⑤** 特別支援**郵編型社會經濟死亡率模型**；**⑥** 計算用 **SIMD 向量化 + 多線程**。README 稱作者已把其中原理用於**英美荷約 £1,000 億的 longevity 交易**（**作者自述**）。⚠️ **如實標注**：NEWS 寫 "Initial CRAN release"，但 **CRAN 包頁在本次核實（2026-09-11）返回 Not Found**；倉庫 **0 star、無 topics**。

對 RIAA：**「設定與覆核基礎死亡率」是人壽、年金與養老金負債估值的第一道工序**，A/E 分析正是其日常工作語言。這個包的價值在於**把 A/E → 模型擬合 → 選型 → 可視化做成一條流水線**，且**權重口徑與數據時效加權是一等公民**。**郵編型社會經濟模型**在池內屬空白：池中有 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[mortalitylaws]]、[[mortsoa]]、[[cvmortalitymult]]、[[multipopulation-mortality-models]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[mortalitytables]] 等**人群/表層面**資源，也有 [[expstudy]]、[[experienceanalysis-jl]] 一類**經驗分析**工具，但**「同一張表按地區/社會經濟分層調參」**這一層此前沒有專門條目。姊妹包見 [[datey]]，公司型壽險建模見 [[lifeinsurer]]，生存模型見 [[lifecontingencies]]，公式手冊見 [[ifoa-formulae-tables]]，開放教材見 [[actuarial-open-book]]。適合人壽/年金/養老金方向的作業與畢設。**核實說明**：倉庫元數據、DESCRIPTION、NEWS、README、文檔站均實測；**未運行代碼、未驗證性能宣稱**。

entries.title: datey · 年格日期与期间精确运算（R 包，CRAN）
entries.title_en: datey — exact date and duration arithmetic on an annual grid (R package on CRAN)
entries.title_hk: datey · 年格日期與期間精確運算（R 包，CRAN）
entries.summary: 把日期映射到离散「年格」并做精确日期/期间运算：解决死亡率按年、数据按日暴露的错位（CRAN 0.1.1）
entries.summary_en: Maps dates onto a discrete annual grid with exact date/duration arithmetic, fixing the year-rate vs date-data exposure mismatch (CRAN 0.1.1)
entries.summary_hk: 把日期映射到離散「年格」並做精確日期/期間運算：解決死亡率按年、數據按日暴露的錯位（CRAN 0.1.1）
entries.body:
**datey** 是 CRAN 上的 R 包，解决一个听起来琐碎、实际上**天天在精算表里制造误差**的问题：**当计量的基本单位是「年」，而输入数据用的是「日期」时，两者之间怎么精确对齐**。CRAN 页面自述的动机写得很直白：**死亡率按年定义，而经验分析与寿险/年金估值的数据通常按日期给出**。可核实信息：**CRAN 版本 0.1.1、2026-07-14 发布**、**MIT + file LICENSE**、作者 **Tim Gordon**（维护者邮箱 tim.gordon@btinternet.com）、**Depends R ≥ 4.0.0**、**LinkingTo cpp11（NeedsCompilation: yes）**、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.datey`、有 vignette **「Get started with datey」**、`Language: en-GB`、项目站 `r-datey.logmu.org`（HTTP 200，16KB）实测、仓库 `logmu-org/r-datey`。

它为什么值得单独收一条：**「年 vs 日」的错位是精算计算里最隐蔽的一类错误**——年龄用「上一个生日（age last birthday）」还是「精确年龄（age nearest/next）」、暴露期用整年还是按日比例、期末评估日是自然日还是工作日，这些选择会**静默地**改变 A/E 比率和准备金，却很少在结果里留下痕迹。池内相关的日期/期间条目是**金融数学**口径（[[tvm-python]]、[[tmval]]），而**死亡率经验分析口径的年格对齐**此前没有条目；它同时也是 [[logmu]] 的依赖包，两者构成「**年格运算 → 死亡率经验分析**」的一条链。与 [[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[mortalitytables]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 的表/人口数据配合使用时，正是把「按年的表」落到「按日的数据」上的那一层。**核实说明**：CRAN 页面 HTTP 200 实测并逐项读取（版本/发布日期/许可证/依赖/vignette/DOI），文档站 HTTP 200 实测；**未逐行审阅算法，未验证「精确」宣称在各种边界情形下均成立**。
entries.body_en:
**datey** is an R package on CRAN that solves a problem which sounds trivial but **silently creates errors in actuarial work every day**: **when the unit of measurement is a year but the input data is given as dates, how do the two align exactly?** The CRAN page states the motivation plainly: **mortality rates are defined per year, while experience analysis and life/annuity valuation data are typically given as dates**. Verifiable details: **CRAN version 0.1.1, published 2026-07-14**, **MIT + file LICENSE**, author **Tim Gordon** (maintainer email tim.gordon@btinternet.com), **Depends R ≥ 4.0.0**, **LinkingTo cpp11 (NeedsCompilation: yes)**, DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.datey`, a vignette **"Get started with datey"**, `Language: en-GB`, project site `r-datey.logmu.org` measured at HTTP 200 (16KB), repository `logmu-org/r-datey`.

Why it merits its own entry: **the year-vs-day mismatch is one of the most insidious classes of error in actuarial calculation** — whether age is "age last birthday" or exact age, whether exposure is counted in whole years or pro rata by day, and whether the valuation date is a calendar or working day — these choices **silently** move A/E ratios and reserves while leaving little trace in the output. The corpus’s related date/period entries are **financial-mathematics** ones ([[tvm-python]], [[tmval]]); **annual-grid alignment for mortality experience analysis** had no entry. It is also a dependency of [[logmu]], and together they form a chain from **annual-grid arithmetic → mortality experience analysis**. Combined with the table/population resources [[cmi-mortality-projections]], [[mortalitytables]] and [[human-mortality-db]], it is exactly the layer that lands "a table defined per year" onto "data recorded per day". **Verification note**: the CRAN page was measured at HTTP 200 and read item by item (version / publication date / licence / dependencies / vignette / DOI) and the docs site at HTTP 200; **the algorithm was not reviewed line by line and the "exact" claim was not verified across all boundary cases**.

entries.title: qrmtools · 定量风险管理工具箱（R，含资本分摊）
entries.title_en: qrmtools — quantitative risk management toolkit for R (with capital allocation)
entries.title_hk: qrmtools · 定量風險管理工具箱（R，含資本分攤）
entries.summary: QRM 教材配套 R 包：VaR/ES、GPD 尾部、资本分摊（Euler 原则）；维护者在香港大学（CRAN 0.0-19）
entries.summary_en: R companion to the QRM textbook: VaR/ES, GPD tails and Euler-principle capital allocation; maintained at the University of Hong Kong (CRAN 0.0-19)
entries.summary_hk: QRM 教材配套 R 包：VaR/ES、GPD 尾部、資本分攤（Euler 原則）；維護者在香港大學（CRAN 0.0-19）
entries.body:
**qrmtools**（CRAN）是《**Quantitative Risk Management**》（McNeil–Frey–Embrechts）体系的 **R 配套工具包**。可核实信息：**版本 0.0-19、2025-12-10 发布**、**GPL (≥ 3)**、作者 **Marius Hofert（维护者，邮箱 mhofert@hku.hk，即香港大学）**、**Kurt Hornik**、**Alexander J. McNeil**、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.qrmtools`、Imports `quantmod`、`rugarch`、`zoo`、`xts`、`ADGofTest` 等、含 vignette（如 VaR 拟合与预测）、同时列于 **Distributions 与 Finance 两个 CRAN Task View**。

能力（**已从 CRAN 参考手册 PDF 逐项核对，非据描述推断**）：**① 资本分摊**——手册中 `alloc` 函数自述为「Computing (capital) allocations」，按 **Euler 原则**分摊，并区分 `alloc_np`（非参数）与 `alloc_t_GPD`（**GPD 尾部**口径）；**② 风险度量**——`VaR_GPDtail`（GPD 尾部 VaR）、`ES_np`（非参数期望短缺）等，手册中 VaR 相关函数出现逾 200 处；**③ 极值/GPD 尾部建模**；**④ 相依结构（copula）**相关工具。

对 RIAA：这个包补的是池内一个**结构性空缺**——池中有大量 EVT/copula 条目（[[extremes]]、[[evd]]、[[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[logngpd]]、[[fitheavytail]]、[[copula-r]]、[[vinecopula-r]]、[[pycop]]、[[pyvinecopulib]]、[[simcop]]、[[insurance-evt]]、[[insurance-copula]]），但**「把总风险度量分摊到各业务线/子组合」这一层此前没有条目**（检索 `allocat`、`euler`、`capital alloc` 在池与 wiki 中均为 0 命中），而**这正是资本配置、分业务线风险预算、再保与自留决策的核心计算**；`alloc_np` 与 `alloc_t_GPD` 两种口径的并存，也正好对应「数据多时用经验分布、数据少时用尾部模型」的实际选择。另一层价值是**教材同源**：QRM 是风险度量与相依结构课程的标准参考书，这个包是它的官方配套，**做题与复现教材结果可以对齐**。**本地关联**：维护者 Marius Hofert 在**香港大学**任教——对在香港读研的学生，这是「教材作者之一就在本地」的少数几个条目之一。相关：[[concentrationmetrics]]（集中度）、[[riskfolio-lib]] 与 [[quantlib]]（组合与定价）、[[insurance-quantile]]（分位数）、[[solvency2rfr]]（监管口径）。**核实说明**：CRAN 页面与参考手册 PDF（350KB）均 HTTP 200 实测，函数能力**从手册原文核对**；**未运行代码**。
entries.body_en:
**qrmtools** (CRAN) is the **R companion toolkit to the *Quantitative Risk Management* (McNeil–Frey–Embrechts) body of work**. Verifiable details: **version 0.0-19, published 2025-12-10**, **GPL (≥ 3)**, authors **Marius Hofert (maintainer, email mhofert@hku.hk — the University of Hong Kong)**, **Kurt Hornik** and **Alexander J. McNeil**, DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.qrmtools`, Imports including `quantmod`, `rugarch`, `zoo`, `xts`, `ADGofTest`, with vignettes (e.g. fitting and predicting VaR), listed under both the **Distributions and Finance CRAN Task Views**.

Capabilities (**checked item by item from the CRAN reference manual PDF, not inferred from the description**): **① capital allocation** — the manual’s `alloc` function describes itself as "Computing (capital) allocations", allocating by the **Euler principle**, with `alloc_np` (non-parametric) and `alloc_t_GPD` (**GPD-tail**) variants; **② risk measures** — `VaR_GPDtail` (GPD-tail VaR), `ES_np` (non-parametric expected shortfall), with VaR-related functions appearing over 200 times in the manual; **③ extreme-value / GPD tail modelling**; **④ dependence (copula) tooling**.

For RIAA: this package fills a **structural gap** in the corpus. It holds many EVT/copula entries ([[extremes]], [[evd]], [[evir]], [[mev]], [[logngpd]], [[fitheavytail]], [[copula-r]], [[vinecopula-r]], [[pycop]], [[pyvinecopulib]], [[simcop]], [[insurance-evt]], [[insurance-copula]]), but **"allocating an aggregate risk measure down to business lines or sub-portfolios" had no entry** (searches for `allocat`, `euler` and `capital alloc` return 0 hits across the pool and wiki) — and **that is exactly the core calculation behind capital allocation, per-line risk budgets, and reinsurance/retention decisions**. The coexistence of `alloc_np` and `alloc_t_GPD` mirrors the practical choice between "use the empirical distribution when data is plentiful" and "use a tail model when it is scarce". A second source of value is **textbook lineage**: QRM is the standard reference for risk-measure and dependence courses, and this is its official companion, so **exercises and textbook reproductions line up**. **Local connection**: maintainer Marius Hofert teaches at **the University of Hong Kong** — for students studying in Hong Kong, this is one of the few entries where a textbook author is in the same city. Related: [[concentrationmetrics]] (concentration), [[riskfolio-lib]] and [[quantlib]] (portfolios and pricing), [[insurance-quantile]] (quantiles), [[solvency2rfr]] (regulatory discounting). **Verification note**: the CRAN page and the reference manual PDF (350KB) were both measured at HTTP 200 and function capabilities were **checked against the manual text**; **the code was not run**.
