entries.title: atRisk · 下行情景的密度预测（R 包，Growth-at-Risk 方法）
entries.title_en: atRisk — density forecasting for downside scenarios (R package, Growth-at-Risk approach)
entries.title_hk: atRisk · 下行情景的密度預測（R 包，Growth-at-Risk 方法）
entries.summary: 两步参数法预测经济变量在未来期限的完整条件分布，再据此生成 VaR/ES 等下行风险度量（CRAN 0.2.0）
entries.summary_en: A two-step parametric method forecasting the full conditional distribution of an economic variable at a horizon, yielding coherent VaR/ES downside measures (CRAN 0.2.0)
entries.summary_hk: 兩步參數法預測經濟變量在未來期限的完整條件分布，再據此生成 VaR/ES 等下行風險度量（CRAN 0.2.0）
entries.body:
**atRisk**（CRAN）实现的是 **aR（At-Risk）方法**：用**两步参数估计**预测某个经济变量在给定期限上的**完整条件分布**（而不只是点预测），再由这个分布**一致地导出任意下行风险度量**——**VaR、期望短缺（ES）、下行熵**等。CRAN 页面写明该方法源自 **Adrian et al. (2019, *AER*, doi:10.1257/aer.20161923)** 用于揭示经济增长对金融条件的脆弱性，**目前被国际金融机构广泛用于给出 GDP 增长（Growth-at-Risk）与通胀（Inflation-at-Risk）的 VaR 型预测**，且包内**自带美国与欧元区数据集**。可核实信息：**版本 0.2.0、2025-01-14 发布**、**GPL-3**、作者 **Quentin Lajaunie、Guillaume Flament、Christophe Hurlin**（审阅 Souzan Kazemi）、Imports `quantreg`、`sn`、`dfoptim`、`ggplot2`、`ggridges`、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.atRisk`、**列于 CRAN Task View: ActuarialScience**。

对 RIAA：它的定位与池内既有的情景工具**互补而非重复**。池中「经济情景」一族是**生成器路线**——[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[pyesg]]、[[esg-generator-python]]、[[hull-white-esg-checks]] 从模型假设出发模拟利率/通胀路径；**atRisk 走的是数据驱动的分位数回归路线**：不假设过程，而是**直接预测「未来分布长什么样」**，因此更适合回答**「在当前金融条件下，未来一年的下行情景有多宽」**这类问题——也就是 **ORSA 与情景分析里最常被问到的那一问**。与 [[insurance-nowcast]]（当下状态的即时估计）相比，它补的是**前瞻分布的尾部**；与 [[insurance-quantile]]、[[genmr-scor]]（分位数/SCR 口径）相比，它补的是**宏观因子 → 分布**这一段的建模。适合资产负债管理、宏观情景与资本充足性方向的作业与论文。**核实说明**：CRAN 页面 HTTP 200 实测并逐项读取（版本/日期/许可证/作者/依赖/Task View 归属/方法出处）；**未运行代码，未验证其在保险组合数据上的适用性**——原方法是为宏观变量设计的，用到保险公司层面数据时口径需自行论证。
entries.body_en:
**atRisk** (CRAN) implements the **aR (At-Risk) approach**: a **two-step parametric estimation** procedure that forecasts the **full conditional distribution** of an economic variable at a given horizon (rather than only a point forecast), from which **any downside risk measure follows coherently** — **value-at-risk, expected shortfall, downside entropy** and others. The CRAN page states the method was introduced by **Adrian et al. (2019, *AER*, doi:10.1257/aer.20161923)** to reveal the vulnerability of economic growth to financial conditions, and is **now extensively used by international financial institutions to produce VaR-type forecasts of GDP growth (Growth-at-Risk) and inflation (Inflation-at-Risk)**; the package **ships US and Eurozone datasets**. Verifiable details: **version 0.2.0, published 2025-01-14**, **GPL-3**, authors **Quentin Lajaunie, Guillaume Flament and Christophe Hurlin** (reviewed by Souzan Kazemi), Imports `quantreg`, `sn`, `dfoptim`, `ggplot2`, `ggridges`, DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.atRisk`, **listed in the CRAN Task View: ActuarialScience**.

For RIAA: it is **complementary to, not a duplicate of,** the existing scenario tools in the corpus. The corpus’s "economic scenario" family takes the **generator route** — [[economicscenariogenerators-jl]], [[pyesg]], [[esg-generator-python]] and [[hull-white-esg-checks]] simulate interest-rate and inflation paths from model assumptions. **atRisk takes the data-driven quantile-regression route**: instead of assuming a process it **predicts directly what the future distribution looks like**, which suits questions like **"given current financial conditions, how wide is the downside over the next year?"** — **the question most often asked in ORSA and scenario analysis**. Against [[insurance-nowcast]] (an instant read on the present state) it adds **the tail of a forward-looking distribution**; against [[insurance-quantile]] and [[genmr-scor]] (quantile / SCR conventions) it adds **the modelling step from macro factors to a distribution**. Suits assignments and dissertations in ALM, macro scenarios and capital adequacy. **Verification note**: the CRAN page was measured at HTTP 200 and read item by item (version / date / licence / authors / dependencies / Task View membership / method citation); **the code was not run and its suitability for insurer-level (as opposed to macro) data was not verified** — the original method is designed for macroeconomic variables, so applying it to company data requires its own justification.

(2019, *AER*)**，**現被國際金融機構廣泛用於 GDP 增長（Growth-at-Risk）與通脹（Inflation-at-Risk）的 VaR 型預測**，包內**自帶美國與歐元區數據集**。可核實資訊：**版本 0.2.0、2025-01-14 發布**、**GPL-3**、作者 **Quentin Lajaunie、Guillaume Flament、Christophe Hurlin**、Imports `quantreg`、`sn`、`dfoptim`、`ggplot2`、`ggridges`、**列於 CRAN Task View: ActuarialScience**。

對 RIAA：它與池內既有的情景工具**互補而非重複**。池中「經濟情景」一族是**生成器路線**（[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[pyesg]]、[[esg-generator-python]]、[[hull-white-esg-checks]]）；**atRisk 走數據驅動的分位數回歸路線**，更適合回答**「在當前金融條件下，未來一年的下行情景有多寬」**——也就是 **ORSA 與情景分析裡最常被問到的那一問**。與 [[insurance-nowcast]] 相比，它補的是**前瞻分布的尾部**；與 [[insurance-quantile]]、[[genmr-scor]] 相比，它補的是**宏觀因子 → 分布**這一段。適合資產負債管理、宏觀情景與資本充足性方向的作業與論文。**核實說明**：CRAN 頁面 HTTP 200 實測並逐項讀取；**未運行代碼，未驗證其在保險組合數據上的適用性**。

entries.body:
**Juliette**（GitLab `tomgriffin/juliette`，自述「A Claude Plugin for NY VBC Strategists and Analysts」）是目前见到的**最完整的「单一司法辖区精算 AI 插件」样本**。可核实信息：项目 **2026-05-01 创建、最后活动 2026-05-02**、**★0、无许可证**、**版本 1.1.1**（提交 "Bump version to 1.1.1"）、**文件树实测 274 个条目**（分页 API 100+100+74）、**提交 17 个**、安装方式为 `install-remote.sh` / `install-remote.ps1`（README 给出 `curl -fsSL … | sh` 与 PowerShell `irm … | iex`）。

结构（据 README 与实测文件树）：**① 23 个技能、分 7 个领域**——VBP 设计与认证、**MA 投标（bid）开发**、**风险调整**、**Stars/QARR 质量分析**、**SPARCS 医院对标**、Medicaid 参保、MLTC、**HRSN 投资回报**、**DRG 定价**、rebasing 策略、**MCO 费率设定**、SCN 协调、完整 ACO/IPA 管理，另含 **262 词术语表**、平实语言翻译、记忆持久化与引导上手；**② 8 个实时数据 MCP 服务器**——分别封装 **NYSDOH、CMS、Census、NPPES、NLM VSAC、FDA（openFDA）、CDC（PLACES）**等公共 API（实测目录为 `cdc_places`/`census_data`/`cms_data`/`medicaid_data`/`nppes`/`ny_health_data`/`openfda`/`vsac`）；**③ 权威参考文件**——**NYSDOH 2026 VBP Roadmap 与 7 套 measure set** 的 PDF，以及 **49+ 份随包 CSV/PDF**（费率单元 rate cells、measure sets、MCO 与医疗机构名册、地理对照表、**风险调整因子表**、ACO 治理、分配方法、行为健康危机连续体、孕产妇死亡回顾、癌症登记、HRSN/SDOH 语境）；**④ 评测集**——**15 个测试用例，覆盖技能路由、拒答行为与输出准确性**；另有 `scripts/validators` 与 `evals/regression_results`。

对 RIAA：它的价值**不在「又一个技能库」**，而在三点。**第一，它是「辖区纵深」的极端样本**——池内 AI 技能条目多为**跨市场通用**（[[insurance-skills]]、[[hcls-agent-skills]]、[[dsh-insurance-experts]]），也有单一市场切片（[[indian-health-claims-skill]]、[[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]]），但**把「一个州 + 一个支付制度（Medicaid 价值医疗）」拆到 23 个技能 + 49 份官方文件**的深度，此前没有。**第二，8 个 MCP 数据源本身就是一份可用的数据地图**——即使完全不使用这个插件，**VSAC 值集、NPPES 提供者名录、SPARCS 住院数据、CMS 与 CDC PLACES** 正是美国健康险**风险调整与价值医疗分析的底层数据源清单**，可与 [[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[hhs-hcc-sql]]、[[cms-open-data]]、[[medicare-claims-pricer]]、[[databricks-medicare-risk-adjustment]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]] 对照使用。**第三，评测集里明确包含「拒答行为」测试**——这与本 wiki 关注的[[payer-agent-audit]]一类「受监管场景下 AI 该说不」的问题同源，提供了一个**技能库上线前怎么测**的具体做法。

⚠️ **三条必须如实标注的风险**：**①** **★0、无许可证、全部提交集中在 2026-05-01 当天**，此后无活动——属于**一次性发布**，长期维护无保障；**②** 安装方式把远端脚本直接管道给 shell（`curl … | sh`），**执行第三方脚本前应自行审阅**，本词条不对其安全性作任何担保；**③** 它是 **Claude Code/Cowork 生态的插件**，不是通用格式，**与本 wiki 所讨论的其他 harness 不通用**；README 中的能力清单（23 技能、49 文件、15 用例）为**项目自述**，本次核实到文件树与目录结构层面，**未逐份打开 274 个文件，也未运行其评测**。**核实说明**：GitLab 项目元数据、文件树、提交列表与 README 均经 API 实测；**未安装、未运行**。
entries.body_en:
**Juliette** (GitLab `tomgriffin/juliette`, self-described as "A Claude Plugin for NY VBC Strategists and Analysts") is the **most complete sample of a single-jurisdiction actuarial AI plugin** encountered so far. Verifiable details: project **created 2026-05-01, last activity 2026-05-02**, **0 stars, no licence**, **version 1.1.1** (commit "Bump version to 1.1.1"), **file tree measured at 274 entries** (paginated API: 100+100+74), **17 commits**, installed via `install-remote.sh` / `install-remote.ps1` (the README gives `curl -fsSL … | sh` and PowerShell `irm … | iex`).

Structure (per the README and the measured tree): **① 23 skills in 7 domain categories** — VBP design and attestation, **MA bid development**, **risk adjustment**, **Stars/QARR quality analytics**, **SPARCS hospital benchmarking**, Medicaid enrolment, MLTC, **HRSN ROI**, **DRG pricing**, rebasing strategy, **MCO rate setting**, SCN coordination, full ACO/IPA management, plus a **262-term glossary**, plain-language translation, memory persistence and guided onboarding; **② 8 live-data MCP servers** wrapping public APIs from **NYSDOH, CMS, Census, NPPES, NLM VSAC, FDA (openFDA) and CDC (PLACES)** (measured directories: `cdc_places`, `census_data`, `cms_data`, `medicaid_data`, `nppes`, `ny_health_data`, `openfda`, `vsac`); **③ authoritative reference files** — PDFs of the **NYSDOH 2026 VBP Roadmap and seven measure sets**, plus **49+ bundled CSV/PDF files** (rate cells, measure sets, MCO and provider rosters, geography crosswalks, **risk adjustment factor tables**, ACO governance, distribution methodology, behavioural health crisis continuum, maternal mortality review, cancer registry, HRSN/SDOH context); **④ an eval harness** — **15 test cases covering skill routing, refusal behaviour and output accuracy**, alongside `scripts/validators` and `evals/regression_results`.

For RIAA: its value is **not "yet another skill library"** but three things. **First, it is an extreme sample of jurisdictional depth** — most AI skill entries in the corpus are **cross-market and general** ([[insurance-skills]], [[hcls-agent-skills]], [[dsh-insurance-experts]]) or single-market slices ([[indian-health-claims-skill]], [[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]]), but **splitting "one state plus one payment regime (Medicaid value-based care)" into 23 skills and 49 official documents** had no precedent here. **Second, the eight MCP data servers are themselves a usable data map** — even without adopting the plugin, **VSAC value sets, the NPPES provider directory, SPARCS inpatient data, CMS and CDC PLACES** are precisely the underlying data sources for **US health-insurance risk adjustment and value-based care analysis**, and can be read alongside [[icd-hcc-mappings]], [[hhs-hcc-sql]], [[cms-open-data]], [[medicare-claims-pricer]], [[databricks-medicare-risk-adjustment]] and [[healthcare-mrf-api]]. **Third, the eval harness explicitly includes "refusal behaviour" tests** — the same concern as [[payer-agent-audit]] in this wiki ("an agent must know when to say no" in a regulated setting), and it offers a concrete answer to how a skill library should be tested before release.

⚠️ **Three risks that must be stated plainly**: **①** **0 stars, no licence, and every commit confined to 2026-05-01** with no activity since — a **one-off publication** with no maintenance guarantee; **②** the install method pipes a remote script straight into a shell (`curl … | sh`), so **review any third-party script before running it** — this entry makes no security claim; **③** it is a plugin for the **Claude Code/Cowork ecosystem**, not a portable format, and **does not transfer to the other harnesses discussed in this wiki**. The capability list in the README (23 skills, 49 files, 15 test cases) is **the project’s own claim**; this check reached the file-tree and directory-structure level, **did not open all 274 files and did not run its evals**. **Verification note**: GitLab project metadata, file tree, commit list and README were all measured through the API; **nothing was installed or executed**.

entries.body:
**PricingBandits**（CRAN，**2026-09-09 发布**，即本轮核实前两日）实现**在需求曲线未知时的定价实验**。可核实信息：**版本 2.0.0**、**MIT + file LICENSE**、作者 **Ian N. Weaver（作者兼维护者）、Vineet Kumar、Lalit Jain**、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.PricingBandits`（CRAN 页注明 **may not be active yet**）、**Depends R ≥ 3.5.0**、Imports `Matrix`、`hash`、`nloptr`、`MASS`、`dplyr`、`TruncatedNormal`、`R.utils`、无需编译、仓库 `github.com/ian-weaver/PricingBandits`。

方法出处（CRAN 页面写明）：**Weaver, Kumar & Jain, "Nonparametric Pricing Bandits Leveraging Informational Externalities to Learn the Demand Curve"**（*Marketing Science*，doi:10.1287/mksc.2022.0247）。方法族含：**UCB（上置信界）**与**Thompson Sampling（TS）**两个基线，**GP-UCB 与 GP-TS**（高斯过程变体），以及**「约束需求随价格弱递减」的单调高斯过程变体**与**异方差噪声扩展**。设计上值得注意的一点：**支付意愿（WTP）分布由用户以「消费者估值向量」完全指定**，因此**任何需求环境都可以被模拟或复现（replay）**。

对 RIAA：保险定价课程几乎全在**成本侧**展开——频率-强度模型、GLM、费用与利润加成；但**一个费率调整到底赚不赚钱，取决于需求侧的价格弹性**，而这恰恰是课程与实习里最少被量化的一环。这个包把定价问题写成**「在未知需求曲线下边学边定价」的探索-利用权衡**，其中**单调性约束**（价格越高需求不增）正好对应经济学上唯一不能违背的定价事实——**没有这个约束的纯 GP 拟合会给出「涨价反而增量」的荒谬需求曲线**。WTP 向量化输入也让它可以直接当**定价策略的基准环境**使用。池内既有条目中，[[insurance-uplift]] 处理的是「该不该给这个客户营销」的因果提升，而**「该定什么价」的在线学习**此前没有专门条目。相关：[[rate-optimiser]]（费率优化）、[[openrater]] 与 [[ratecraft]]（费率引擎）、[[price-contour]]（价格等高线）、[[insurance-pricing-demo]] 与 [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]（定价演示）、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]（公平定价）、[[insurance-bunching]]（价格聚束）、[[akur8]]（商业定价平台）。

⚠️ **如实标注三点**：**①** 这是**市场营销学方法在 R 中的实现，并非保险专用**——保险场景存在**费率监管（不得随意差异化定价）、逆选择与续保动态**，直接照搬价格实验有合规风险，须自行论证适用性；**②** 本轮只核实到 CRAN 页面与仓库层面，**未运行代码，未复现论文结果**；**③** CRAN 页面自述 DOI **「may not be active yet」**，即 DOI 可能尚未生效。**核实说明**：CRAN 页面 HTTP 200 实测并逐项读取（版本/发布日期/许可证/作者/依赖/方法出处/DOI 状态）；**未运行、未复现**。
entries.body_en:
**PricingBandits** (CRAN, **published 2026-09-09**, two days before this check) implements **pricing experiments when the demand curve is unknown**. Verifiable details: **version 2.0.0**, **MIT + file LICENSE**, authors **Ian N. Weaver (author and maintainer), Vineet Kumar and Lalit Jain**, DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.PricingBandits` (the CRAN page notes it **"may not be active yet"**), **Depends R ≥ 3.5.0**, Imports `Matrix`, `hash`, `nloptr`, `MASS`, `dplyr`, `TruncatedNormal`, `R.utils`, no compilation needed, repository `github.com/ian-weaver/PricingBandits`.

Method provenance (stated on the CRAN page): **Weaver, Kumar & Jain, "Nonparametric Pricing Bandits Leveraging Informational Externalities to Learn the Demand Curve"** (*Marketing Science*, doi:10.1287/mksc.2022.0247). The method family includes **UCB (upper confidence bound)** and **Thompson Sampling (TS)** baselines, **GP-UCB and GP-TS** (Gaussian-process variants), and — notably — **monotonic Gaussian-process variants that constrain demand to be weakly decreasing in price**, plus heterogeneous-noise extensions. One design point worth flagging: the **willingness-to-pay distribution is fully specified by the user as a vector of consumer valuations**, so **any demand environment can be simulated or replayed**.

For RIAA: insurance pricing courses are almost entirely **cost-side** — frequency–severity models, GLMs, expense and profit loadings. But **whether a rate change actually makes money depends on demand-side price elasticity**, which is precisely the link least often quantified in coursework and internships. This package frames pricing as **the exploration–exploitation trade-off of learning while pricing under an unknown demand curve**, and its **monotonicity constraint** (demand does not increase with price) encodes the one pricing fact economics will not let you violate — **without it, an unconstrained GP fit will happily produce the absurd demand curve on which raising price raises volume**. Specifying WTP as a vector also makes it directly usable as **a benchmark environment for pricing strategies**. Among existing entries, [[insurance-uplift]] addresses the causal question of "should this customer be targeted", whereas **online learning of "what price to set"** had no dedicated entry. Related: [[rate-optimiser]] (rate optimisation), [[openrater]] and [[ratecraft]] (rating engines), [[price-contour]] (price contours), [[insurance-pricing-demo]] and [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]] (pricing demos), [[fair-pricing-playbook]] (fair pricing), [[insurance-bunching]] (price bunching), [[akur8]] (commercial pricing platform).

⚠️ **Three honest caveats**: **①** this is **a marketing-science method implemented in R, not an insurance-specific tool** — insurance involves **rate regulation (differentiated pricing is restricted), adverse selection and renewal dynamics**, so copying price experimentation across carries compliance risk and needs its own justification; **②** this check reached the CRAN page and repository level only — **the code was not run and the paper’s results were not reproduced**; **③** the CRAN page itself says the DOI **"may not be active yet"**. **Verification note**: the CRAN page was measured at HTTP 200 and read item by item (version / publication date / licence / authors / dependencies / method citation / DOI status); **nothing was run or reproduced**.

entries.summary: 42 条记录覆盖 9 个州：受理确认/回复/决定/支付等各环节的天数、日类型与法规出处，逐条可回溯

entries.body:
这份数据集回答一个很具体、很实务的问题：**美国各州给了保险公司多少天来处理一笔理赔**。数据由 **referencesource** 发布，**HF 镜像**为 `referencesource/insurance-claim-handling-deadlines`，**权威站点**为 `referencesource.org/insurance-claim-handling-deadlines/`（HTTP 200，30.8KB），并提供**机器可读**的 `…/data.json`（HTTP 200，47KB）。

**实测结构**：**42 条记录、覆盖 9 个州**；**10 类义务**——受理确认（8）、接受或拒赔（7）、回复往来函件（6）、提供理赔表格（5）、完成调查（4）、告知需要更多时间（4）、支付已接受赔案（4）、启动调查（2）、现场查勘（1）、寄送损失估算（1）；**日类型**——`days` 25、`working days` 9、`business days` 5、`calendar days` 3；**载体**——**行政法规 27 条、成文法 15 条**。每条记录带 `citation`（法条编号）、`clock_starts`（**时钟从哪个事件起算**）、`deadline_days`、`day_type`、`obligation`、`instrument_type`、`line_of_business`、`penalty_or_interest`、`source`（读取该值的页面 URL）与 **`source_quote`（该页面的逐字引文）**；实测 **42 条全部含 source 与 source_quote，无一条缺失**。

**本次亲自复核（本 wiki 的核实标准）**：抽取两条记录回到**官方原始出处**逐字比对，**两条均完全吻合**——**明尼苏达州 Stat. 72A.201**（`revisor.mn.gov`，HTTP 200，107KB：「failing to complete its investigation and inform the insured or claimant of acceptance or denial of a claim **within 30 business days after receipt of notification of claim**」）与**内华达州 NAC 686A.675**（`leg.state.nv.us`，HTTP 200，314KB：「**Within 30 working days** after receipt by the insurer of properly executed proofs of loss…」）。

对 RIAA：理赔时限是**运营与合规的第一线知识**，也是「理赔到底谁说了算」的法律起点。这份数据的价值有三层：**①** 它把笼统的「及时处理」拆成**十个可计时的义务**——学生做理赔流程、SLA 或自动理赔设计时，这十个环节就是天然的检查表；**②** 它显式区分**日历日 / 工作日 / 营业日**（42 条中分别有 3 / 9 / 5 条不是普通日）——**这正是理赔时效计算里最经典的坑**，把 30 天当自然日算会直接算错合规期限；**③** 它替使用者做了法规溯源：**每条都给出法条编号与原文句子**，可以直接引到作业或合规文档里。相关条目：监管数据见 [[naic-financial-data-repository]]，州级费率申报数据见 [[texas-rate-filings]]，理赔自动化与代理见 [[claims-intake-agent]]、[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[claims-api]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]，规则即代码的同类做法见 [[openfisca]]、[[psl-tax-calculator]]、[[bind-standard]]、[[acord]]。

⚠️ **必须如实标注的四点**：**① 只有 9 个州、42 条记录**，并非「全美五十州」——标题里的「by state」容易让人高估覆盖面；**② 发布方 `referencesource` 同时批量发布数百份彼此无关的参考数据**（鹿猎季日期、自行车传动兼容、刀具牌号对照等），**属于流水线式出版**，本次核实的是**这一份**的质量，不代表其全部数据集同等可靠，同类数据应逐份核查；**③ HF 镜像只是某一时点的快照**——该数据集自述 **last verified 2026-08-11、stale after 2026-12-09**，并明确要求过期后改用权威站点（该站点按节奏重新核验）；**④** 许可证为 `other`（自述为「引用来源条款」：法条文本依美国法不受版权保护，每条仅引用一句并回链到州政府页面）。**核实说明**：HF 数据集元数据、records.jsonl 全量解析、权威站点与 data.json 均实测（HTTP 200）；**并亲自回到明尼苏达与内华达两处官方原文比对引文，两处吻合**；**其余 40 条未逐条回源核对**。
entries.body_en:
This dataset answers a very concrete, practical question: **how many days each US state gives an insurer to handle a claim**. It is published by **referencesource**; the **Hugging Face mirror** is `referencesource/insurance-claim-handling-deadlines` and the **canonical site** is `referencesource.org/insurance-claim-handling-deadlines/` (HTTP 200, 30.8KB), with a **machine-readable** `…/data.json` (HTTP 200, 47KB).

**Measured structure**: **42 records across 9 states**; **10 obligation types** — acknowledge receipt of claim (8), accept or deny claim (7), reply to communication (6), provide claim forms (5), complete investigation (4), notify of need for more time (4), pay accepted claim (4), begin investigation (2), conduct physical inspection (1), send loss estimate (1); **day types** — `days` 25, `working days` 9, `business days` 5, `calendar days` 3; **instrument** — **27 administrative regulations, 15 statutes**. Every record carries `citation`, `clock_starts` (**which event starts the clock**), `deadline_days`, `day_type`, `obligation`, `instrument_type`, `line_of_business`, `penalty_or_interest`, `source` (the URL the value was read from) and **`source_quote` (a verbatim quote from that page)**; measured: **all 42 records carry both source and source_quote, none missing**.

**Checked personally here (this wiki’s verification standard)**: two records were taken back to their **official primary sources** and compared word for word, and **both matched exactly** — **Minnesota Stat. 72A.201** (`revisor.mn.gov`, HTTP 200, 107KB: "failing to complete its investigation and inform the insured or claimant of acceptance or denial of a claim **within 30 business days after receipt of notification of claim**") and **Nevada NAC 686A.675** (`leg.state.nv.us`, HTTP 200, 314KB: "**Within 30 working days** after receipt by the insurer of properly executed proofs of loss…").

For RIAA: claim-handling deadlines are **front-line operational and compliance knowledge**, and the legal starting point for "who decides a claim, and by when". The value is threefold: **①** it breaks the vague instruction to "handle claims promptly" into **ten clock-able obligations** — a ready-made checklist when students design claims processes, SLAs or automated claims; **②** it distinguishes explicitly between **calendar, working and business days** (of the 42 records, 3, 9 and 5 respectively are not plain days) — **the classic trap in claims-timeliness calculation**, where treating 30 days as calendar days simply computes the wrong deadline; **③** it does the legal sourcing for the user: **every record gives the citation and the original sentence**, quotable directly into coursework or compliance documents. Related entries: regulatory data in [[naic-financial-data-repository]], state rate filings in [[texas-rate-filings]], claims automation and agents in [[claims-intake-agent]], [[claims-triage-mcp]], [[digital-claims-management]], [[claims-api]] and [[evidence-review-claims]], and the "rules as code" analogue in [[openfisca]], [[psl-tax-calculator]], [[bind-standard]] and [[acord]].

⚠️ **Four things that must be stated plainly**: **① only 9 states and 42 records** — this is not "all fifty states", and the "by state" phrasing invites overestimating coverage; **② the publisher `referencesource` also bulk-publishes hundreds of unrelated reference datasets** (deer season dates, bike drivetrain compatibility, cutting-tool grade cross-references), i.e. **pipeline publishing** — what was verified here is **this one dataset**, and its siblings should be checked individually rather than assumed equally reliable; **③ the Hugging Face mirror is a point-in-time snapshot** — the dataset states **last verified 2026-08-11, stale after 2026-12-09**, and explicitly asks users to switch to the canonical site (which re-verifies on a cadence) past that date; **④** the licence is `other` (self-described as "source terms cited": statutory text is not copyrightable in the US, and each record quotes a single sentence and links back to the state’s own page). **Verification note**: HF dataset metadata, a full parse of records.jsonl, the canonical site and data.json were all measured (HTTP 200); **two citations were personally traced back to Minnesota and Nevada official texts and matched**; **the remaining 40 records were not traced back individually**.

entries.body:
**glmMisrep** 要解决的，是精算建模里一个**大家都心知肚明、却极少写进模型**的问题：**投保人可能在核保时故意否认某项风险状态，以换取更低保费**。CRAN 页面把动机写得很直白——**"in insurance settings where policy holders may purposely deny a risk status in order to lower the insurance premium"**。可核实信息：**版本 0.1.3、2026-09-09 发布**、**GPL (≥ 2)**、作者 **Patrick Rafael（作者兼维护者，弗吉尼亚理工 pbr2608@vt.edu）、Michelle Xia、Rexford Akakpo**、**Depends R ≥ 3.5.0**、Imports `MASS`、**`poisson.glm.mix`**（CRAN 上确有此包，HTTP 200 实测）、无需编译、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.glmMisrep`。

方法（据 CRAN 描述）：对**连续型与计数型结果**拟合 GLM 的同时，**估计某个关键二元预测变量的「瞒报比例」**；做法是**把一部分响应视为来自混合分布**，用 **EM 算法**估计参数，标准误取自 **观测 Fisher 信息的闭式解**。方法出处：**Xia 等（2023）《Variance》——"Maximum likelihood approaches to misrepresentation models in GLM ratemaking: model comparisons"**（`variancejournal.org/article/73151`，HTTP 200 实测，813KB）——**《Variance》是 CAS（意外险精算学会）主办的研究期刊**，也就是说这不是通用统计套路，而是**直接出自产险费率厘定文献**。

对 RIAA：**瞒报（misrepresentation / 未如实告知）是保险的一等问题，不是数据清洗的小毛病**。标准 GLM 定价假定协变量被正确测量；一旦某个风险状态（吸烟、年里程、既往理赔、职业类别、车辆用途）**被系统性地低报**，拟合出的费率因子就会**沿着可预测的方向偏离**——低报风险的类别看上去「更安全」，于是拿到更便宜的费率、吸引更多同类人进来，**定价错误与逆选择相互加强**。这个包的价值在于把瞒报从「假设不存在」变成**一个被估计出来的参数（瞒报比例）**，从而可以**量化纠偏**，并在模型比较中检验「纠偏后费率是否更稳」。对做定价、核保或数据质量方向作业与论文的学生，这是一个**能直接落地的具体方法**，而不是又一篇泛泛讨论。相关条目：GLM 定价工具见 [[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[easy-glm]]、[[superglm]]、[[aglm]]，费率厘定全流程见 [[ratemaking]]，Tweedie 与索赔建模见 [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-severity]]，离散度建模见 [[insurance-dispersion]]，可信度理论见 [[insurance-credibility]]，公平性议题见 [[insurance-fairness]]，费率因子解释见 [[shap-relativities]]，高基数协变量见 [[high-cardinality-covariates-regularization]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 版本 **0.1.3**，属早期实现，**CRAN 页面未列出代码仓库**（无可跟踪的 issue 与提交历史）；**②** 方法要求使用者**先假定瞒报的方向**（哪一类人往哪边瞒），**假定本身需要论证**；**③** 本轮只核实到 CRAN 页面与所引论文页面层面，**未运行代码、未在真实数据上验证纠偏效果**。**核实说明**：CRAN 页面与《Variance》论文页均 HTTP 200 实测，依赖包 `poisson.glm.mix` 在 CRAN 上确认存在；**未运行、未复现**。
entries.body_en:
**glmMisrep** addresses something every actuarial modeller knows about but rarely writes into the model: **a policyholder may deliberately deny a risk status during underwriting in order to pay less**. The CRAN page states the motivation plainly — **"in insurance settings where policy holders may purposely deny a risk status in order to lower the insurance premium"**. Verifiable details: **version 0.1.3, published 2026-09-09**, **GPL (≥ 2)**, authors **Patrick Rafael (author and maintainer, Virginia Tech, pbr2608@vt.edu), Michelle Xia and Rexford Akakpo**, **Depends R ≥ 3.5.0**, Imports `MASS` and **`poisson.glm.mix`** (confirmed present on CRAN, HTTP 200), no compilation, DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.glmMisrep`.

Method (per the CRAN description): fit GLMs to **continuous and count outcomes** while **estimating the prevalence of misrepresentation of an important binary predictor**; the approach treats **a subset of the response as arising from a mixture distribution**, estimates parameters by **EM**, and obtains standard errors from **closed-form observed Fisher information**. Provenance: **Xia et al. (2023), *Variance* — "Maximum likelihood approaches to misrepresentation models in GLM ratemaking: model comparisons"** (`variancejournal.org/article/73151`, measured HTTP 200, 813KB) — ***Variance* is the research journal of the CAS (Casualty Actuarial Society)**, so this is not a generic statistics recipe but work **straight out of the general-insurance ratemaking literature**.

For RIAA: **misrepresentation is a first-order insurance problem, not a data-cleaning nuisance**. Standard GLM pricing assumes covariates are measured correctly; once a risk status is **systematically under-reported** (smoking, annual mileage, prior claims, occupation class, vehicle use), the fitted relativities **shift in a predictable direction** — the under-reporting class *looks* safer, gets a cheaper rate, and attracts more of the same, so **pricing error and adverse selection reinforce each other**. What this package does is turn misrepresentation from an assumption of non-existence into **an estimated parameter (its prevalence)**, so the bias can be **quantified and corrected**, and "does the corrected rate hold up better?" becomes a testable model comparison. For students working on pricing, underwriting or data-quality assignments and dissertations, this is **a concrete method that can be applied**, rather than another general discussion. Related: GLM pricing tooling in [[insurance-glm-tools]], [[easy-glm]], [[superglm]] and [[aglm]]; the full ratemaking workflow in [[ratemaking]]; Tweedie and claim modelling in [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]], [[insurance-frequency-severity]] and [[insurance-severity]]; dispersion modelling in [[insurance-dispersion]]; credibility theory in [[insurance-credibility]]; fairness questions in [[insurance-fairness]]; rating-factor interpretation in [[shap-relativities]]; high-cardinality covariates in [[high-cardinality-covariates-regularization]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** version **0.1.3** is an early implementation and **the CRAN page lists no code repository** (no issue tracker or commit history to follow); **②** the method requires the user to **assume the direction of misreporting** (who misreports which way), and **that assumption itself needs justification**; **③** this check reached the CRAN page and the cited paper’s page only — **the code was not run and the correction was not validated on real data**. **Verification note**: the CRAN page and the *Variance* article page were both measured at HTTP 200, and the dependency `poisson.glm.mix` was confirmed to exist on CRAN; **nothing was run or reproduced**.

**glmMisrep** 要解決的是精算建模裡一個**大家都心知肚明、卻極少寫進模型**的問題：**投保人可能在核保時故意否認某項風險狀態，以換取更低保費**。CRAN 頁面把動機寫得很直白——**"in insurance settings where policy holders may purposely deny a risk status in order to lower the insurance premium"**。可核實資訊：**版本 0.1.3、2026-09-09 發布**、**GPL (≥ 2)**、作者 **Patrick Rafael（弗吉尼亞理工）、Michelle Xia、Rexford Akakpo**、**Depends R ≥ 3.5.0**、Imports `MASS` 與 **`poisson.glm.mix`**（CRAN 上確有此包）、無需編譯、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.glmMisrep`。

方法：對**連續型與計數型結果**擬合 GLM 的同時，**估計某個關鍵二元預測變量的「瞞報比例」**；把一部分響應視為來自**混合分布**，用 **EM** 估計參數，標準誤取自**觀測 Fisher 信息的閉式解**。出處：**Xia 等（2023）《Variance》**（`variancejournal.org/article/73151`，HTTP 200 實測）——**《Variance》是 CAS（意外險精算學會）的研究期刊**，即**直接出自產險費率釐定文獻**。

對 RIAA：**瞞報是保險的一等問題**。標準 GLM 定價假定協變量被正確測量；一旦某風險狀態（吸煙、年里程、既往理賠、職業類別）**被系統性低報**，費率因子就會**沿可預測方向偏離**——低報風險的類別看上去「更安全」，拿到更便宜費率、吸引更多同類人進來，**定價錯誤與逆選擇相互加強**。這個包把瞞報變成**一個被估計的參數**，從而可以**量化糾偏**。相關：[[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[easy-glm]]、[[superglm]]、[[aglm]]、[[ratemaking]]、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-severity]]、[[insurance-dispersion]]、[[insurance-credibility]]、[[insurance-fairness]]、[[shap-relativities]]、[[high-cardinality-covariates-regularization]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 版本 **0.1.3** 屬早期實現，**CRAN 頁面未列出代碼倉庫**；**②** 方法要求先**假定瞞報方向**，假定本身需論證；**③** 本輪只核實到 CRAN 頁面與論文頁面，**未運行代碼、未在真實數據上驗證**。**核實說明**：兩處均 HTTP 200 實測，依賴包在 CRAN 確認存在；**未運行、未複現**。

entries.summary: MNL/MXL/NL 与贝叶斯多项概率模型：给出价格弹性、转移比、支付意愿与福利反事实——定价的需求侧

entries.summary_hk: MNL/MXL/NL 與貝葉斯多項概率模型：給出價格彈性、轉移比、支付意願與福利反事實——定價的需求側
entries.body:
**choicer** 是定价问题的**需求侧工具箱**。可核实信息：**版本 0.2.1、2026-09-04 发布**（比本轮窗口起点早一天，属同一周新包）、**LGPL (≥ 3)**、作者 **Fernando Cordeiro**、**Depends R ≥ 4.1.0**、Imports `data.table`、`nloptr`、`randtoolbox`、`Rcpp`、**LinkingTo `Rcpp`/`RcppArmadillo`（NeedsCompilation: yes）**、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.choicer`、含 vignette、仓库与文档站均 HTTP 200 实测（`github.com/fpcordeiro/choicer`、`fpcordeiro.github.io/choicer/`）。

能力（据 CRAN 描述）：覆盖 **MNL（多项 Logit）**、**MXL（混合 Logit）**、**NL（嵌套 Logit）**、**贝叶斯多项 Probit（MNP）**与**分层贝叶斯 MNL/MNP（HMNL、HMNP）**；似然、梯度与 Hessian 用 **C++ + OpenMP** 实现，可扩展到含大量备选特定常数的设定；**事后计算**覆盖**预测份额、自身与交叉价格弹性、转移比（diversion ratios）、支付意愿（WTP）与福利反事实**。

对 RIAA：上一轮刚收的 [[pricingbandits]] 解决的是**「在不知道需求曲线时边定价边学」**，而 choicer 解决的是**「用已有数据把需求曲线估出来」**——两者是一个问题的两端，合起来才构成池内此前缺失的**需求侧**。为什么这对保险重要：保费定价课程教的是**成本侧**（频率×强度＋费用＋利润），但**「保费涨 5%，会流失多少客户、他们跑去哪家」**才是定价决策真正要回答的问题；其中**转移比**尤其贴合现实——**比价平台让投保人只需点一下就能换公司**，此时「涨价后的去向」比「涨价的平均弹性」更关键，因为它决定**哪些险种/渠道可以涨价、哪些一涨就空心化**。**交叉价格弹性**还直接对应监管与公平议题：某类客户补贴另一类客户的程度，本质上就是交叉弹性在起作用（可对照 [[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[insurance-bunching]]）。相关条目：[[pricingbandits]]（在线学习定价）、[[insurance-uplift]]（该不该营销这个客户）、[[rate-optimiser]]（费率优化）、[[price-contour]]（价格等高线）、[[insurance-online]]（在线投保行为）、[[insurance-pricing-demo]]（定价演示）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 这是**应用经济学的通用离散选择实现，并非保险专用**；**②** 保险需求估计有其特殊约束——**逆选择、续保动态、监管对差异定价的限制**，弹性与 WTP 的估计结果须结合这些条件解读，**直接照搬零售结论会出错**；**③** 版本 **0.2.1** 仍属早期，且需编译 C++；**④** 本轮只核实到 CRAN 页面与仓库/文档站层面，**未运行代码、未做弹性估计的实证验证**。**核实说明**：CRAN 页面、GitHub 仓库页（363KB）与文档站（36KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并逐项读取；**未运行、未复现**。
entries.body_en:
**choicer** is a **demand-side toolbox for pricing**. Verifiable details: **version 0.2.1, published 2026-09-04** (one day before this round’s window start, from the same week), **LGPL (≥ 3)**, author **Fernando Cordeiro**, **Depends R ≥ 4.1.0**, Imports `data.table`, `nloptr`, `randtoolbox`, `Rcpp`, **LinkingTo `Rcpp`/`RcppArmadillo` (NeedsCompilation: yes)**, DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.choicer`, with a vignette; the repository and docs site both measured HTTP 200 (`github.com/fpcordeiro/choicer`, `fpcordeiro.github.io/choicer/`).

Capabilities (per the CRAN description): **MNL (multinomial logit)**, **MXL (mixed logit)**, **NL (nested logit)**, **Bayesian multinomial probit (MNP)** and **hierarchical Bayesian MNL/MNP (HMNL, HMNP)**; likelihoods, gradients and Hessians are implemented in **C++ with OpenMP**, scaling to specifications with many alternative-specific constants; **post-estimation** covers **predicted shares, own- and cross-price elasticities, diversion ratios, willingness to pay and welfare counterfactuals**.

For RIAA: [[pricingbandits]], added last round, addresses **"learn the demand curve while pricing"**; choicer addresses **"estimate the demand curve from data you already have"** — two ends of one problem that together supply the **demand side** this corpus previously lacked. Why it matters for insurance: premium pricing courses teach the **cost side** (frequency × severity + expenses + profit), but **"if the premium rises 5%, how many customers leave and where do they go?"** is the question a pricing decision actually turns on. **Diversion ratios** are especially apt here — **comparison sites let a policyholder switch insurer with one click**, so "where the business goes after a price rise" matters more than the average elasticity, because it determines **which lines and channels can carry a rate increase and which empty out if they try**. **Cross-price elasticities** also map directly onto regulatory and fairness debates: the degree to which one class of customers subsidises another *is* cross-elasticity at work (compare [[fair-pricing-playbook]], [[insurance-bunching]]). Related: [[pricingbandits]] (online learning of prices), [[insurance-uplift]] (whether to target a customer), [[rate-optimiser]] (rate optimisation), [[price-contour]] (price contours), [[insurance-online]] (online buying behaviour), [[insurance-pricing-demo]] (pricing demos).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this is **a general applied-economics discrete-choice implementation, not an insurance-specific tool**; **②** insurance demand has its own constraints — **adverse selection, renewal dynamics and regulatory limits on differentiated pricing** — so elasticity and WTP estimates must be read against those conditions, **and retail conclusions cannot simply be transplanted**; **③** version **0.2.1** is still early and requires compiling C++; **④** this check reached the CRAN page, repository and docs site only — **the code was not run and no empirical elasticity estimate was validated**. **Verification note**: the CRAN page, the GitHub repository page (363KB) and the docs site (36KB) were all measured at HTTP 200 and read item by item; **nothing was run or reproduced**.

entries.body:
**npi** 是 **rOpenSci** 出品的 R 包，封装 **CMS 的 NPPES（National Provider Identifier Registry）API**，用于取回美国**医疗服务提供者**的登记与行政数据。可核实信息：**版本 0.3.1、2026-09-06 发布**、**MIT + file LICENSE**、作者 **Frank Farach（作者兼维护者）**，贡献者 Sam Parmar，评审 **Matthias Grenié、Emily C. Zabor**（**rOpenSci 的同行评审流程**）、**Depends R ≥ 3.1**、Imports `checkLuhn`、`checkmate`、`curl`、`dplyr`、`glue`、`httr`、`magrittr`、`purrr`、`rlang`、`stringr`、`tibble`、`tidyr`、无需编译、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.npi`、仓库 `github.com/ropensci/npi`、文档站 `docs.ropensci.org/npi/`（HTTP 200，40KB 实测）。能力：**按提供者姓名、地点、服务类型、资质等属性做检索**，或**取回与某个个人/机构提供者关联的行政数据**；上游 API 为 `npiregistry.cms.hhs.gov/api/`（**本次实测该端点返回合法 JSON，服务在线**）。

对 RIAA：**NPPES 是美国健康险做「提供者维度」分析的基础登记库**——它给出的是**谁在提供医疗服务、在哪儿、提供什么**。三个具体用途：**① 网络充分性（network adequacy）**——健康险必须证明其网络覆盖足够，这需要**按地区与专科统计提供者**；**② 提供者名录准确性（directory validation）**——监管要求保险公司维护准确的名录，**美国监管处罚中名录错误是常见事由**；**③ 提供者侧集中度与议价**——按机构（organizational provider）聚合可以看**医院集团在某个地区的集中度**，这与本 wiki 已有的[[spatialrisk]]一类**风险集中度**分析正好是一体两面（一个看被保险人集中，一个看服务方集中）。它还有一个「条目互补」的意义：本 wiki 刚收的 [[juliette]] 里，**NPPES 是它 8 个 MCP 数据源之一**——同一个上游登记库，一个以**面向 agent 的 MCP**形式接入，一个以 **rOpenSci 的 R 客户端**形式接入，两者读的是同一份数据，可互相印证。相关条目：[[healthcare-mrf-api]]（医保价格透明文件）、[[cms-open-data]]、[[cms-beneficiary-fhir]]、[[hhs-hcc-sql]]、[[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[omop-common-data-model]]、[[databricks-hls-patient-risk]]、[[insurance-ner-nre]]、[[databricks-jsl-medical]]、[[axa-ch-health-insurance-data]]、[[kasaai-insurance-data]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** **限美国**，且 **NPPES 是「自报」数据**——提供者自行登记与更新，**准确性与时效性均有已知局限**（这也正是「名录核验」成为一个独立工作方向的原因）；**②** 本轮实测的是**上游 API 可访问**（返回合法 JSON），**并未运行 R 包本身**；**③** 对非美国市场的学生，其价值主要是**方法参照**（如何用官方登记库做网络与名录分析），而非可直接套用的数据。**核实说明**：CRAN 页面、文档站（40KB）、上游 NPPES API 端点均实测（HTTP 200 / 合法 JSON 响应）；**未运行 R 包，未做实际检索分析**。
entries.body_en:
**npi** is an **rOpenSci** R package wrapping the **CMS NPPES (National Provider Identifier Registry) API**, for retrieving US **healthcare provider** registration and administrative data. Verifiable details: **version 0.3.1, published 2026-09-06**, **MIT + file LICENSE**, author **Frank Farach (author and maintainer)**, contributor Sam Parmar, reviewers **Matthias Grenié and Emily C. Zabor** (**rOpenSci’s peer-review process**), **Depends R ≥ 3.1**, Imports `checkLuhn`, `checkmate`, `curl`, `dplyr`, `glue`, `httr`, `magrittr`, `purrr`, `rlang`, `stringr`, `tibble`, `tidyr`, no compilation, DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.npi`, repository `github.com/ropensci/npi`, docs site `docs.ropensci.org/npi/` (measured HTTP 200, 40KB). Capabilities: **search by provider name, location, type of service and credentials**, or **retrieve the administrative data linked to a specific individual or organisational provider**; the upstream API is `npiregistry.cms.hhs.gov/api/` (**measured live here, returning valid JSON**).

For RIAA: **NPPES is the foundational registry for provider-level analysis in US health insurance** — it establishes **who delivers care, where, and what kind**. Three concrete uses: **① network adequacy** — a health insurer must show its network is sufficient, which requires **counting providers by geography and specialty**; **② provider directory accuracy** — regulators require accurate directories, and **directory errors are a recurring enforcement theme in the US**; **③ provider-side concentration and bargaining** — aggregating by organisational provider reveals **how concentrated hospital groups are in a region**, which is the mirror image of the **risk-concentration** analysis in this wiki’s [[spatialrisk]] (one looks at where the insured are concentrated, the other at where the providers are). There is also an entry-level complementarity: in [[juliette]], added earlier this session, **NPPES is one of its eight MCP data sources** — the same upstream registry reached one way as an **agent-facing MCP** and another as an **rOpenSci R client**, so the two can cross-check each other. Related: [[healthcare-mrf-api]] (healthcare price transparency files), [[cms-open-data]], [[cms-beneficiary-fhir]], [[hhs-hcc-sql]], [[icd-hcc-mappings]], [[omop-common-data-model]], [[databricks-hls-patient-risk]], [[insurance-ner-nre]], [[databricks-jsl-medical]], [[axa-ch-health-insurance-data]], [[kasaai-insurance-data]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** it is **US-only**, and **NPPES data is self-reported** — providers register and update it themselves, with **known limits on accuracy and timeliness** (which is exactly why "directory validation" exists as a workstream); **②** what was measured here is that **the upstream API is reachable** (returning valid JSON) — **the R package itself was not run**; **③** for students outside the US its value is mainly **methodological** (how to use an official registry for network and directory analysis) rather than directly reusable data. **Verification note**: the CRAN page, the docs site (40KB) and the upstream NPPES API endpoint were all measured (HTTP 200 / valid JSON response); **the R package was not run and no actual search analysis was performed**.

entries.body:
**bandit-risk**（GitHub `m-aghababaie/bandit-risk`，MIT，**2026-09-09 仍在推送**）自述为「**为保险与房产智能而做的多臂老虎机算法**」。可核实信息：**MIT 许可**、**★2、0 fork**、**2026-05-19 创建、2026-09-09 最后推送**、**666 KB**、**Python 3.10+**、`pyproject.toml`、带 CI（GitHub Actions）、black 代码风格；代码结构实测为 **`bandit_risk/agents/`（`epsilon_greedy.py`、`ucb1.py`）+ `bandit_risk/envs/`（`esg_env.py`、`inspection_env.py`、`outreach_env.py`）+ `utils/plotting.py` + `experiments/` + 7 个测试文件**（含 `test_epsilon_greedy.py`、`test_ucb1.py`、三个环境各自的测试）。

**它解决什么问题**（README 原文）：财产险公司要做**成百上千次重复决策**——**用哪种查勘策略**、**推荐哪一项 ESG 改造**、**把资源投在哪条触达渠道**；bandit-risk 把多臂老虎机强化学习用在这些决策上，**从经验中学习策略，而不是用历史平均值**。作者为 Mohammad Aghababaie（Hubbcast / Insurmatics），属其「From Bandits to Buildings」开源系列。

**⭐ 这个项目最值得记录的一点，是它对方法适用性的自我审查**：README 用一整节论证——**多臂老虎机要求「奖励只取决于所采取的动作，而绝不取决于历史、经过时间或演化状态」**；一旦这个条件被破坏，问题其实是**马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）**，bandit 的 regret 保证随即失效。于是它**对每个环境都做这项检验，并主动排除那些经检验属于 MDP 的问题**：保留 `InspectionBanditEnv`（5 臂、最优臂 Full structural、μ=0.70）与 `ESGBanditEnv`（6 臂、最优臂 Heat pump ASHP、μ=0.71），而**主动剔除**「维保排程」（判为 **MDP**）与「传感器事件排序」（判为 **POMDP**），并附专门文档 `docs/genuine_bandits.md` 说明。**结果汇报里也给出了一条真正有信息量的结论**：在查勘问题上有一个策略明显最优，**低探索反而更好**；而在 ESG 问题上**前两名几乎持平，探索不足会卡在次优臂**——所以**「正确」的探索率取决于选项有多难区分**。

对 RIAA：前两轮刚补上**需求侧**（[[choicer]] 估需求曲线、[[pricingbandits]] 边定价边学需求），本轮补的是**决策侧**——**当同一类决策要重复做几千次、且每次都能观察到结果时，用老虎机学习比用历史平均更合适**。对保险学生的实际用处有两层：**①** 检索/查勘/触达这类「高频、可观测反馈」的运营决策，是实习与案例作业里真实存在的场景，而课程通常只教到「算一个平均数」；**② 更重要的是一套判断纪律**——**先问「这到底是不是老虎机」**。这条纪律在保险里格外容易踩坑：**赔付经验、续保与退保、维修排程、客户状态迁移都会让状态随时间演化**，此时套用 bandit 而声称「保证」是错的；这个项目把这一判断**写成可执行的检验并公开剔除案例**，比多收一个算法库有价值得多。相关条目：需求侧见 [[choicer]]、[[pricingbandits]]；费率与运营优化见 [[rate-optimiser]]、[[insurance-optimise]]、[[insurance-uplift]]；ESG 与气候改造场景见 [[esg-generator-python]]、[[esg]]、[[awesome-sustainable-finance]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]；车联网与行为数据场景见 [[insurance-telematics]]、[[zenroad-telematics]]；决策与决策过程建模见 [[imaginator]]、[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ★2、0 fork**，尚无社区采用；**② README 的 Install 段写明「**PyPI release coming soon**」、当前需从源码安装（`pip install -e ".[dev]"`），而仓库简介里却写着 `pip install bandit-risk`——**两处不一致**，且**本次实测 PyPI 上查不到该包**；**③** README 的 regret 曲线与「最优臂」数值均为**作者自述**，**未复现**；**④** 环境是**作者构造的合成决策问题**（如 μ=0.70/0.71 的收益分布），**并非真实保险公司数据**。**核实说明**：GitHub 仓库元数据、完整文件树（43 个文件）、README 原文均经 API 实测；**未安装、未运行代码，未复现其 regret 结果**。
entries.body_en:
**bandit-risk** (GitHub `m-aghababaie/bandit-risk`, MIT, **still pushed on 2026-09-09**) describes itself as "**multi-armed bandit algorithms for insurance and property intelligence**". Verifiable details: **MIT licence**, **2 stars, 0 forks**, **created 2026-05-19, last pushed 2026-09-09**, **666 KB**, **Python 3.10+**, `pyproject.toml`, CI via GitHub Actions, black code style; the measured structure is **`bandit_risk/agents/` (`epsilon_greedy.py`, `ucb1.py`) plus `bandit_risk/envs/` (`esg_env.py`, `inspection_env.py`, `outreach_env.py`), `utils/plotting.py`, `experiments/` and seven test files** (including `test_epsilon_greedy.py`, `test_ucb1.py` and one test per environment).

**The problem it addresses** (from the README): property insurers make **hundreds of repeated decisions** — **which inspection strategy to deploy**, **which ESG retrofit to recommend**, **which outreach channel to invest in**; bandit-risk applies multi-armed bandit reinforcement learning to these decisions so the policy is **learned from experience instead of from historical averages**. The author is Mohammad Aghababaie (Hubbcast / Insurmatics), and the project is part of his "From Bandits to Buildings" open-source series.

**⭐ Most notable is the project’s self-audit of method applicability.** The README devotes a section to arguing that **a multi-armed bandit requires reward to depend only on the action taken — never on history, elapsed time or evolving state**; the moment that condition breaks, the problem is really a **Markov decision process (MDP)** and bandit regret guarantees no longer hold. It therefore **validates every environment against that test and deliberately excludes those found to be MDPs**: it keeps `InspectionBanditEnv` (5 arms, best arm Full structural, μ=0.70) and `ESGBanditEnv` (6 arms, best arm Heat pump ASHP, μ=0.71) while **excluding** "maintenance scheduling" (judged an **MDP**) and "sensor incident sequencing" (judged a **POMDP**), with a dedicated `docs/genuine_bandits.md` explaining the reasoning. Its reported results also contain a genuinely informative finding: on the inspection problem one strategy clearly dominates, so **low exploration wins**; on the ESG problem **the top two are nearly tied, so too little exploration gets stuck on the second-best arm** — hence **the "right" exploration rate depends on how distinguishable the options are**.

For RIAA: the previous two rounds supplied the **demand side** ([[choicer]] estimating the demand curve, [[pricingbandits]] learning it while pricing); this round adds the **decision side** — **when the same kind of decision is repeated thousands of times and each outcome is observable, learning with a bandit beats averaging history**. Two practical uses for students: **①** operational decisions like inspection, investigation and outreach are "high-frequency, observable-feedback" problems that genuinely appear in internships and case work, while courses usually stop at "compute an average"; **② more importantly, it supplies a discipline of judgement** — **first ask whether this really is a bandit**. That discipline is especially easy to get wrong in insurance, because **claims experience, renewal and lapse, maintenance scheduling and customer-state transitions all make state evolve over time**, so bolting on a bandit while claiming guarantees is simply incorrect; this project turns that judgement into **an executable check with published exclusions**, which is worth far more than one more algorithm library. Related: demand side in [[choicer]] and [[pricingbandits]]; rate and operations optimisation in [[rate-optimiser]], [[insurance-optimise]] and [[insurance-uplift]]; ESG and climate-retrofit scenarios in [[esg-generator-python]], [[esg]], [[awesome-sustainable-finance]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]] and [[climate-conditioned-cat]]; telematics and behaviour data in [[insurance-telematics]] and [[zenroad-telematics]]; decision modelling in [[imaginator]], [[claims-triage-mcp]] and [[agentic-bop-underwriting]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** at **2 stars and 0 forks** it has no community adoption yet; **②** the README’s Install section says "**PyPI release coming soon**" and requires a source install (`pip install -e ".[dev]"`), while the repository description advertises `pip install bandit-risk` — **the two disagree**, and **the package could not be found on PyPI at this check**; **③** the regret curves and "best arm" values are **the author’s own claims** and were **not reproduced**; **④** the environments are **synthetic decision problems constructed by the author** (e.g. reward distributions with μ = 0.70/0.71), **not real insurer data**. **Verification note**: GitHub repository metadata, the full file tree (43 files) and the README text were all measured through the API; **nothing was installed or run, and the regret results were not reproduced**.

**bandit-risk**（GitHub `m-aghababaie/bandit-risk`，MIT，**2026-09-09 仍在推送**）自述為「**為保險與房產智能而做的多臂老虎機算法**」。可核實資訊：**MIT 許可**、**★2、0 fork**、**2026-05-19 建立、2026-09-09 最後推送**、**666 KB**、**Python 3.10+**、帶 CI；結構實測為 **`bandit_risk/agents/`（`epsilon_greedy.py`、`ucb1.py`）+ `bandit_risk/envs/`（`esg_env.py`、`inspection_env.py`、`outreach_env.py`）+ `utils/plotting.py` + `experiments/` + 7 個測試檔**。

**⭐ 最值得記錄的是它對方法適用性的自我審查**：README 用一整節論證——**老虎機要求「獎勵只取決於所採取的動作」**，一旦破壞，問題其實是 **MDP**，regret 保證隨即失效。於是它**對每個環境做此檢驗並主動排除屬於 MDP 的問題**：保留 `InspectionBanditEnv`（5 臂、μ=0.70）與 `ESGBanditEnv`（6 臂、μ=0.71），**剔除**「維保排程」（判為 **MDP**）與「傳感器事件排序」（判為 **POMDP**），並附 `docs/genuine_bandits.md`。結論也有一條真信息：查勘問題上有一個策略明顯最優，**低探索更好**；ESG 問題上前兩名幾乎持平，**探索不足會卡在次優臂**——**正確探索率取決於選項有多難區分**。

對 RIAA：前兩輪補了**需求側**（[[choicer]]、[[pricingbandits]]），本輪補的是**決策側**。實際用處：**①** 查勘/調查/觸達這類「高頻、可觀測反饋」的運營決策是真實場景；**② 更重要的是一套判斷紀律——先問「這到底是不是老虎機」**。保險裡格外容易踩坑：**賠付經驗、續保退保、維修排程都會讓狀態隨時間演化**，此時套用 bandit 並聲稱「保證」是錯的。相關：[[choicer]]、[[pricingbandits]]、[[rate-optimiser]]、[[insurance-optimise]]、[[insurance-uplift]]、[[esg-generator-python]]、[[esg]]、[[awesome-sustainable-finance]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[insurance-telematics]]、[[zenroad-telematics]]、[[imaginator]]、[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ★2、0 fork**，尚無社區採用；**②** README Install 段寫「**PyPI release coming soon**」、需源碼安裝，而倉庫簡介卻寫 `pip install bandit-risk`——**兩處不一致**，且**本次實測 PyPI 查不到該包**；**③** regret 曲線與「最優臂」數值均為**作者自述**，**未複現**；**④** 環境是**作者構造的合成決策問題**，**並非真實保險公司數據**。**核實說明**：倉庫元數據、完整文件樹（43 個檔案）、README 原文均經 API 實測；**未安裝、未運行**。

entries.body:
**clausegraph** 做的是把**保险标准约款（표준약관）建成知识图谱**，并在此基础上**辅助理赔审核**——输入一笔索赔，**同时给出判定结论与所依据的约款条款**（README 示例输出的依据形如 `20260506/실손의료보험 특별약관1(중증 비급여 실손의료비)/제4조#(3)3대비급여#4-1`，**版本号 + 商品 + 条款号 + 项号**逐级定位到条）。可核实信息：**MIT 许可**（仓库 `LICENSE` 文件为 MIT © 2026 JAEHUN AN；GitHub 元数据因格式识别为 NOASSERTION）、**★0、0 fork**、**2026-09-05 创建、2026-09-06 最后推送**、**1,273 KB**、**Python**、**实测 130 个文件、30 个提交**，含 `docker-compose.yml`、`infra/postgres/init/01_schema.sql`、**22 篇编号研究笔记**（`docs/`/`notes/`：法源 API、标准约款采集、**条款解析器**、图谱装载、**免责表解析器**、**免责召回**、代理编排、**MCP 服务器**、延迟、本地 LLM、**引用完整性**、参考边等）、**金标准数据集**（`data/goldset/exclusion_gold.jsonl`、`reference_labels.jsonl`、标注工作表）与 CI。技术栈：**知识图谱 + 向量检索混合**（topics 含 graphrag、knowledge-graph、neo4j、pgvector、mcp、korean、insurance）。

**⭐ 这个项目最有价值的是它把「为什么必须用图谱」量化了**（README 自述，数字为其自报告）。第一，**免责（면책）是「否定条件」，向量检索会漏**：在 **18 条**投保人口吻的测试问句上实测——**纯向量** hit@10 **50.0%**、recall@10 **32.9%**、recall@30 55.1%、recall@100 88.0%；**图** hit@10 **100%**、recall@10 **100%**、recall@30 100%（候选 106 条）；**混合** hit@10 88.9%、recall@10 86.1%、recall@30 **100%**（候选 285–388 条）。也就是说：**向量要把 k 放大十倍才能追到 88%**（候选 100 条 ≈ 1,689 个切块的 6%），而**图谱与 k 无关地拿到 100%——因为它不做排序，而是把「该商品、该版本下的免责事由」一条不漏地列出来**。原因很具体：*「蛀牙严重做了种植牙」* 语义上最接近的是**保障**条款，而真正推翻赔付的 `치과치료(K00∼K08)`**与问句里任何措辞都不相似**——约款里根本没有「种植牙」这个词。**一句话结论（原文）：免责查询不是排序问题，而是枚举问题。**

**⭐ 第二，它处理了约款的「时点轴」**：保险适用**投保当时**的约款，**同一条文号在不同时点内容不同**。实测：收集的 **4 个版本共出现 16 个商品**，最新版 14 个——**2026-05-06 第五代 실손（实损医疗）改版把「실손의료보험 특별약관」拆成重症/非重症两个，原来的商品就此消失**；于是**2025 年投保的客户说「실손 특별약관」时，指的是现行文件里已经不存在的商品**，此时用向量索引现行约款会把 특별약관1 或 2 检索出来，**而这两者对该合同都不适用**。更细的坑：**细则施行日与约款适用日不同**——细则施行 20260506，而**约款适用 20260606**，**差一个月**。

对 RIAA：这个条目补的是**条款层（clause level）如何被检索、比对与举证**，而这正是池内**最薄的一层**——已有条目多停在**文档抽取**（[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[suture-vlm]]、[[insurance-ner-nre]]）、**问答语料**（[[insuranceqa-corpus]]、[[strata-insurance-corpus]]）、**条款审查**（[[clauseguard]]）、**保单解释**（[[policy-explainer-ai]]）与**产品知识图谱问答**（[[kgqa-insurance-product]]）层面，而**「免责是枚举问题」「约款时点版本对应哪份合同」这两条具体结论，此前没有任何条目给出过**。对学生的实际用处：**①** 若做条款/GrapRAG 方向，这两条量化结论直接回答了「为什么不能只做向量检索」；**②** 「**投保时点 → 适用约款版本**」这条要求，同样适用于**中文与香港市场的保单**——池内已有 [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[guidewire-mcp]] 等 MCP 形态，也能与 [[actuarial-ontology]]、[[risk-management-ontology]]、[[neo4j-gds]]、[[rag-insurance]] 一类本体/图谱工具串起来。相关：[[llm-claims-analysis]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[insurance-llm-framework]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[acteval]]、[[kasaai-insurance-data]]（韩国市场数据）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ★0、0 fork**，且**提交集中在 2026-09-05 至 09-06 两天**，属**一次性冲刺**，长期维护无保障；**②** 上述**全部量化数字为项目 README 自报告**，本次**只核实到 README 原文与文件结构层面，未复现其评测**；**③** 免责评测只有 **18 条**样本，**样本量小**，且索引规模为 **1,689 个切块**，**规模有限**；**④** 仅覆盖**韩国市场**约款，**结论不能直接外推到其他市场**（不同市场的约款体例、免责写法与监管术语差异很大）；**⑤** 项目含**本地 LLM 与 MCP** 组件，本次**未安装、未运行、未连接任何数据库**。**核实说明**：GitHub 仓库元数据、LICENSE 原文（MIT）、README 原文、完整文件树（130 文件 / 30 提交 / 22 篇笔记 / 金标准数据文件）均经 API 实测；**未运行、未复现评测数字**。
entries.body_en:
**clausegraph** builds **Korean insurance standard policy terms (표준약관) into a knowledge graph** and uses it to **assist claims adjudication**: given a claim, it returns **both a decision and the clause it rests on** (the README’s example citation reads `20260506/실손의료보험 특별약관1(중증 비급여 실손의료비)/제4조#(3)3대비급여#4-1`, locating the exact version, product, article and item). Verifiable details: **MIT licence** (the repository’s `LICENSE` file is MIT © 2026 JAEHUN AN; GitHub metadata reports NOASSERTION because of formatting), **0 stars, 0 forks**, **created 2026-09-05, last pushed 2026-09-06**, **1,273 KB**, **Python**, with a measured **130 files and 30 commits**, including `docker-compose.yml`, `infra/postgres/init/01_schema.sql`, **22 numbered research notes** (`docs/`, `notes/`: legal-source APIs, standard-terms collection, **clause parser**, graph load, **exclusion-table parser**, **exclusion recall**, agent orchestration, **MCP server**, latency, local LLM, **citation integrity**, reference edges), a **gold-set dataset** (`data/goldset/exclusion_gold.jsonl`, `reference_labels.jsonl`, a labelling worksheet) and CI. Stack: **hybrid knowledge graph + vector retrieval** (topics include graphrag, knowledge-graph, neo4j, pgvector, mcp, korean, insurance).

**⭐ Its most valuable contribution is quantifying why a graph is needed** (figures are the project’s own, from the README). First, **exclusions (면책) are negative conditions, and vector search misses them**: measured on **18** policyholder-style questions — **pure vector** hit@10 **50.0%**, recall@10 **32.9%**, recall@30 55.1%, recall@100 88.0%; **graph** hit@10 **100%**, recall@10 **100%**, recall@30 100% (106 candidates); **hybrid** hit@10 88.9%, recall@10 86.1%, recall@30 **100%** (285–388 candidates). In other words, **vector search needs ten times the k just to reach 88%** (100 candidates ≈ 6% of **1,689 chunks**), whereas **the graph reaches 100% regardless of k — because it does not rank, it enumerates every exclusion ground for that product and that version**. The reason is concrete: *"my cavity was severe so I had an implant"* is semantically closest to a **coverage** clause, while the clause that actually reverses payment, `치과치료(K00∼K08)`, **resembles nothing in the question** — the wording never contains the word for implant. The README’s one-line conclusion: **exclusion lookup is an enumeration problem, not a ranking problem.**

**⭐ Second, it handles the policy wording’s time axis**: insurance applies the wording **in force at inception**, and **the same article number has different content at different times**. Measured: the **4 collected versions contain 16 products**, the latest 14 — the **2026-05-06 fifth-generation 실손 (indemnity) reform split the 실손의료보험 특별약관 into severe and non-severe variants, and the original product ceased to exist**; so when a 2025 policyholder says "실손 특별약관" they are naming **a product absent from current documents**, and vector-indexing only the current wording will return 특별약관1 or 2 — **neither of which applies to that contract**. A subtler trap: **the rule’s effective date and the wording’s application date differ** — rule effective 20260506, wording applies **20260606**, **a one-month gap**.

For RIAA: this entry supplies **how clauses are retrieved, compared and evidenced at the clause level**, which is **the thinnest layer in this corpus** — existing entries stop at **document extraction** ([[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]], [[suture-vlm]], [[insurance-ner-nre]]), **Q&A corpora** ([[insuranceqa-corpus]], [[strata-insurance-corpus]]), **clause review** ([[clauseguard]]), **policy explanation** ([[policy-explainer-ai]]) and **product knowledge-graph QA** ([[kgqa-insurance-product]]), while **"exclusions are an enumeration problem" and "which wording version applies to which contract" had no precedent here**. Practical uses: **①** for anyone working on clause-level GraphRAG, these two measured conclusions answer directly why vector-only retrieval is insufficient; **②** the requirement to map **inception date → applicable wording version** applies equally to **Chinese and Hong Kong policies** — and the corpus already holds MCP-shaped entries such as [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], [[insurance-ai-mcp]] and [[guidewire-mcp]] that can be combined with ontology/graph tooling like [[actuarial-ontology]], [[risk-management-ontology]], [[neo4j-gds]] and [[rag-insurance]]. Related: [[llm-claims-analysis]], [[evidence-review-claims]], [[digital-claims-management]], [[insurance-llm-framework]], [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]], [[acteval]], [[kasaai-insurance-data]] (Korean market data).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** at **0 stars and 0 forks**, with **commits confined to 2026-09-05 and 09-06**, it is a **one-off sprint** with no maintenance guarantee; **②** **every figure above is the README’s own claim** — this check reached the README text and the file structure, and **did not reproduce the evaluation**; **③** the exclusion evaluation rests on **only 18 samples**, and the index is **1,689 chunks** — **small in both respects**; **④** it covers **Korean** wording only, and **the conclusions cannot be extrapolated to other markets** (wording conventions, exclusion drafting and regulatory terminology differ substantially); **⑤** the project includes **local-LLM and MCP components**, and **nothing was installed, run or connected to any database here**. **Verification note**: GitHub repository metadata, the `LICENSE` text (MIT), the README and the full file tree (130 files / 30 commits / 22 notes / gold-set files) were all measured through the API; **the evaluation figures were not reproduced**.
entries.body_hk:
**clausegraph** 把**保險標準約款（표준약관）建成知識圖譜**，並用於**輔助理賠審核**——輸入一筆索賠，**同時給出判定結論與所依據的約款條款**（README 示例依據形如 `20260506/실손의료보험 특별약관1(중증 비급여 실손의료비)/제4조#(3)3대비급여#4-1`，逐級定位到版本、商品、條號與項號）。可核實資訊：**MIT 許可**（倉庫 `LICENSE` 為 MIT © 2026 JAEHUN AN；GitHub 元數據因格式顯示 NOASSERTION）、**★0、0 fork**、**2026-09-05 建立、2026-09-06 最後推送**、**Python**、**實測 130 個檔案、30 個提交**，含 `docker-compose.yml`、Postgres schema、**22 篇編號研究筆記**（法源 API、約款採集、**條款解析器**、圖譜裝載、**免責表解析器**、**免責召回**、代理編排、**MCP 伺服器**、延遲、本地 LLM、**引用完整性**）、**金標準數據集**與 CI。

**⭐ 最有價值的是它把「為什麼必須用圖譜」量化了**（數字為 README 自報告）。**免責是否定條件，向量會漏**：在 **18 條**測試問句上——**純向量** hit@10 **50.0%**、recall@10 **32.9%**、recall@100 88.0%；**圖** hit@10 **100%**、recall@10 **100%**（候選 106）；**混合** recall@30 **100%**（候選 285–388）。**向量要把 k 放大十倍才追到 88%**，而**圖譜與 k 無關地拿到 100%——因為它不做排序，而是把「該商品、該版本的免責事由」一條不漏地列出**。原因很具體：*「蛀牙嚴重做了種植牙」* 語義上最接近**保障**條款，而真正推翻賠付的 `치과치료(K00∼K08)`**與問句任何措辭都不相似**。**結論：免責查詢不是排序問題，而是列舉問題。**

**⭐ 第二，它處理約款的「時點軸」**：保險適用**投保當時**的約款，**同一條文號在不同時點內容不同**。實測 **4 個版本共出現 16 個商品**，最新版 14 個——**2026-05-06 第五代 실손 改版把 특별약관 拆成重症/非重症，原商品消失**；**2025 年投保者說「실손 특별약관」時指的是現行文件裡已不存在的商品**。更細的坑：**細則施行日與約款適用日不同**——施行 20260506、**適用 20260606**，**差一個月**。

對 RIAA：本條目補的是**條款層如何檢索、比對與舉證**，這正是池內**最薄的一層**——已有條目多停在**文檔抽取**（[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[suture-vlm]]）、**問答語料**（[[insuranceqa-corpus]]、[[strata-insurance-corpus]]）、**條款審查**（[[clauseguard]]）、**保單解釋**（[[policy-explainer-ai]]）與**產品知識圖譜問答**（[[kgqa-insurance-product]]）層面，而**這兩條具體結論此前沒有條目給出過**。相關：[[llm-claims-analysis]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[rag-insurance]]、[[actuarial-ontology]]、[[neo4j-gds]]、[[insurance-llm-framework]]、[[acteval]]、[[kasaai-insurance-data]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ★0、0 fork**，**提交集中在 2026-09-05 至 09-06 兩天**，屬**一次性衝刺**；**② 上述全部數字為 README 自報告**，**未複現評測**；**③** 免責評測僅 **18 條**樣本、索引 **1,689 個切塊**，**規模有限**；**④** 僅覆蓋**韓國市場**，**不能直接外推**；**⑤** 含**本地 LLM 與 MCP** 組件，**未安裝、未運行**。**核實說明**：倉庫元數據、LICENSE 原文（MIT）、README 原文、完整文件樹均經 API 實測；**未複現評測數字**。

entries.summary_hk: 把承保案件寫成 .uw.md 的開放標準：確定性引擎重算 NOI/DSCR/IRR、附核驗回執與簽名，並提供 MCP/HTTP 綁定
entries.body:
**必须先说清适用范围**：UW Markdown（UWMD，官网 `uwmd.org`，仓库 `github.com/UWMD-OSP/UW-Markdown`）是**商业地产/信贷口径的「承保」**（underwriting）标准——即**贷款人核贷**场景，术语是 NOI、DSCR、IRR、waterfall、credit memo、lender package，**不是产险/寿险的核保标准**。把它收进本 wiki 的理由在下面「为什么值得收」一节，但**先把边界讲明白**。

可核实信息：**MIT 许可**、仓库 **2026-08-07 创建、2026-09-10 仍在推送**、**6,926 KB**、**TypeScript**、**★1、0 fork**；官网 `uwmd.org` HTTP 200（32.8KB），站点状态栏自述 **PROJECT STATUS: ACTIVE ｜ Format v2.0 ｜ Protocol v2.3.0 ｜ Core v2.3.0 ｜ License MIT ｜ Updated 2026-09-03**。实测仓库 **1,355 个文件**，规格齐全：`spec/` 下有 **格式规范 v1 与 v2、LITE 规范、PROTOCOL、RECEIPT（回执）、COMPOSITION、XML 映射、CSV Bundle**；`spec/bindings/` 下有 **HTTP API 的 OpenAPI 定义**与 **`UW_MCP_BINDING_v1.md`（MCP 绑定）**；`spec/schemas/` 下有 `calc-result`、`edit-operation`、`module-signature`、`implementation-manifest`、`protocol-error`、`issue-remediation`、`module-manifest` 等 JSON Schema；另有 **`conformance/` 一致性测试样例**（`.uw.md` 输入与 expected 输出，含「单位不匹配」「未知字段」「frontmatter 缺失」等反例）。工程侧另有 GOVERNANCE、MAINTAINERS、ROADMAP、SECURITY、VERSIONS、CONTRIBUTING、CODE_OF_CONDUCT 与 **AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md**。npm 上为**一套 8 个包**：`@uwmd/core`（v2.6.1，2026-09-10 发布，**17 个版本**）、`@uwmd/cli`（`npx uwmd init|parse|validate|render|run`）、`@uwmd/report`（PDF/贷方包）、`@uwmd/signing`（**Ed25519 / ES256 / ES384** 的区块与**回执签名**）、`@uwmd/batch`、`@uwmd/excel`、`@uwmd/module-data-center`、`@uwmd/module-hospitality`。

**它的核心主张，也正是本 wiki 最该记下来的一句**（官网原文）：**「AI never does the financial math: every NOI, DSCR, IRR, and waterfall split is recomputed by deterministic engines, attested by verification receipts, and portable into any data lake.」**——**AI 不负责算钱**：所有 NOI/DSCR/IRR 与 waterfall 分配**由确定性引擎重算**，并**附核验回执（verification receipts）**，可整体搬进数据湖。配套的机器交换设计同样明确：**UW Document Envelope 1.0** 是同一套模型背后的共享结构，**确定性 UW JSON 1.0 / UW XML 1.0 / 规范化 UW CSV Bundle 1.0 三种表示共存**，且**三者都保留 provenance、prose、扩展、数组与「被取代历史（superseded history）」并校验同一个语义 SHA-256 摘要**。

为什么值得收（三层理由）：**① 它是「AI 必须不做算术」这一原则的最完整工程样本**——池内已有多条同源思路：[[quorumforge]]（确定性裁决）、[[clarity-sdk]]（确定性 + 受监管的文档抽取）、[[bind-standard]]（机器可读交换）、[[actuarial-ts]]（TS 原生精算数学 + ASOP 23 合规），而 UWMD 把**「确定性重算 + 回执 + 签名 + 一致性测试 + MCP/HTTP 绑定」四件套**一次性做全，**这是保险 AI 落地时最难拼齐的一环**；**② 它给出了 agent 时代数据标准的形状**——**格式规范 + JSON Schema + OpenAPI + MCP 绑定 + conformance fixtures 同步发布**，其中**「MCP 绑定」与「给 AI 的 bounded agent skills」直接进规范正文**，这在承保/核保这类文书密集场景里是现成模板；**③ 业务邻接**：保险公司的**不动产与信贷敞口**（抵押贷款保险、贷方置保险、自有物业与债权组合）与这套口径直接相关，且**「同一条款不同版本/被取代历史」的记录方式**与上一轮 [[clausegraph]] 遇到的**约款时点版本问题**是同一类难题的另一种解法（一个用图谱、一个用带 provenance 的确定性文档模型）。相关条目：[[acord]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]]（保险数据标准的在位者）、[[bind-standard]]、[[risk-data-library-standard]]、[[payout-assurance-standard]]、[[morphir]]、[[reactor-dsl]]、[[actuarial-ts]]、[[quorumforge]]、[[clarity-sdk]]、[[clausegraph]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 领域边界**——它是**商业地产/信贷承保**标准，**不是保险核保标准**，本词条**不主张其适用于产险/寿险核保**；**② ★1、0 fork、仓库无描述字段**，属**极早期、无社区采用**；**③ 迭代极快**（`@uwmd/core` 一个月内 17 个版本、规格已到 v2.0），**接口与规范仍在变动**；**④** 官网的能力陈述与站点状态均为**项目自述**，本次核实到**规范文件、Schema、一致性样例、8 个 npm 包与仓库结构**层面，**未安装、未运行、未跑一致性测试**；**⑤** 站点「Updated 2026-09-03」与仓库「2026-09-10 推送」**不是同一天**，两者各自如实记录。**核实说明**：官网 HTTP 200（32.8KB）、GitHub 仓库页 HTTP 200（352KB）、仓库完整文件树（1,355 文件）、4 个 npm 包的 registry 元数据与 README 均实测；**未安装、未运行**。
entries.body_en:
**Scope first**: UW Markdown (UWMD; site `uwmd.org`, repository `github.com/UWMD-OSP/UW-Markdown`) is a **commercial real-estate / credit** underwriting standard — the **lender credit** sense, whose vocabulary is NOI, DSCR, IRR, waterfall, credit memo and lender package — **not a P&C or life insurance underwriting standard**. The reasons for including it in this wiki are set out below, but **the boundary comes first**.

Verifiable details: **MIT licence**, repository **created 2026-08-07, still pushed on 2026-09-10**, **6,926 KB**, **TypeScript**, **1 star, 0 forks**; the site `uwmd.org` measured HTTP 200 (32.8KB) and its status block reads **PROJECT STATUS: ACTIVE | Format v2.0 | Protocol v2.3.0 | Core v2.3.0 | License MIT | Updated 2026-09-03**. The repository was measured at **1,355 files** with a complete specification set: under `spec/` are the **format specs v1 and v2, a LITE spec, PROTOCOL, RECEIPT, COMPOSITION, an XML mapping and a CSV Bundle**; `spec/bindings/` holds an **OpenAPI definition for the HTTP API** and **`UW_MCP_BINDING_v1.md` (the MCP binding)**; `spec/schemas/` holds JSON Schemas including `calc-result`, `edit-operation`, `module-signature`, `implementation-manifest`, `protocol-error`, `issue-remediation` and `module-manifest`; there is also a **`conformance/` consistency-test suite** (`.uw.md` inputs with expected outputs, including negative cases such as "unit mismatch", "unknown field" and "missing frontmatter"). Engineering norms are covered too: GOVERNANCE, MAINTAINERS, ROADMAP, SECURITY, VERSIONS, CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT and **AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md**. On npm it ships as **a set of eight packages**: `@uwmd/core` (v2.6.1, published 2026-09-10, **17 versions**), `@uwmd/cli` (`npx uwmd init|parse|validate|render|run`), `@uwmd/report` (PDF / lender package), `@uwmd/signing` (**Ed25519 / ES256 / ES384** block and **receipt signing**), `@uwmd/batch`, `@uwmd/excel`, `@uwmd/module-data-center` and `@uwmd/module-hospitality`.

**Its central claim is also the sentence this wiki should keep** (from the site): **"AI never does the financial math: every NOI, DSCR, IRR, and waterfall split is recomputed by deterministic engines, attested by verification receipts, and portable into any data lake."** The machine-interchange design is equally explicit: **UW Document Envelope 1.0** is the shared model behind **deterministic UW JSON 1.0, UW XML 1.0 and a normalized UW CSV Bundle 1.0**, and **all three preserve provenance, prose, extensions, arrays and superseded history while verifying the same semantic SHA-256 digest**.

Why include it — three reasons. **① It is the most complete engineering sample of the "AI must not do the arithmetic" principle.** This corpus already holds kindred entries — [[quorumforge]] (deterministic adjudication), [[clarity-sdk]] (deterministic, regulated document extraction), [[bind-standard]] (machine-readable interchange) and [[actuarial-ts]] (TypeScript-native actuarial maths with ASOP 23 compliance) — and UWMD assembles the full set of four in one place: **deterministic recomputation + receipts + signing + a conformance suite + MCP/HTTP bindings**. That is precisely the part insurance AI deployments find hardest to assemble. **② It shows the shape of a data standard in the agent era** — a **format spec, JSON Schemas, an OpenAPI definition, an MCP binding and conformance fixtures released together**, with **"the MCP binding" and "bounded agent skills for AI" written into the specification itself**; in document-heavy workflows like underwriting that is a ready template. **③ Business adjacency**: insurers’ **real-estate and credit exposures** (mortgage insurance, lender-placed insurance, owned property and debt portfolios) sit directly on this vocabulary, and its **"superseded history"** record-keeping is another solution to the same class of problem [[clausegraph]] hit last round (which policy-wording version applies) — one solves it with a graph, this one with a provenance-carrying deterministic document model. Related: [[acord]] and [[acord-mcp-architecture]] (the incumbent in insurance data standards), [[bind-standard]], [[risk-data-library-standard]], [[payout-assurance-standard]], [[morphir]], [[reactor-dsl]], [[actuarial-ts]], [[quorumforge]], [[clarity-sdk]], [[clausegraph]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① domain boundary** — this is a **commercial real-estate / credit underwriting** standard, **not an insurance underwriting standard**, and this entry **does not claim applicability to P&C or life underwriting**; **② at 1 star and 0 forks with no repository description**, it is **very early with no community adoption**; **③ iteration is extremely fast** (`@uwmd/core` shipped 17 versions in a month and the spec is already at v2.0), so **interfaces and the specification are still moving**; **④** the site’s capability statements and status block are **the project’s own**; this check reached the **spec files, schemas, conformance fixtures, eight npm packages and repository structure** — **nothing was installed or run, and no conformance suite was executed**; **⑤** the site says "Updated 2026-09-03" while the repository was pushed **2026-09-10** — **not the same day**, and both are reported as found. **Verification note**: the site (HTTP 200, 32.8KB), the GitHub repository page (HTTP 200, 352KB), the full repository file tree (1,355 files) and the registry metadata and READMEs of four npm packages were all measured; **nothing was installed or run**.

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 領域邊界**——**商業地產／信貸承保**標準，**非保險核保標準**；**② ★1、0 fork、倉庫無描述**，**極早期、無社區採用**；**③ 迭代極快**（一個月 17 個版本、規範已到 v2.0），**接口仍在變動**；**④** 官網陳述為**項目自述**，本次核實到**規範檔案、Schema、一致性樣例、8 個 npm 包與倉庫結構**層面，**未安裝、未運行、未跑一致性測試**；**⑤** 官網「Updated 2026-09-03」與倉庫「2026-09-10 推送」**並非同日**，兩者各自如實記錄。**核實說明**：官網、倉庫頁、完整文件樹（1,355 檔案）、4 個 npm 包元數據與 README 均實測；**未安裝、未運行**。

entries.body:
**InsuranceOracle** 是**官方 MCP registry**（`registry.modelcontextprotocol.io`）上的一条条目（`io.tooloracle/insuranceoracle`，**v1.0.0，2026-05-07 发布/更新，status active**），远程端点 `https://tooloracle.io/insurance/mcp/`（streamable-http），仓库 `github.com/ToolOracle/insuranceoracle`（★0、**许可证 NOASSERTION**、2026-03-22 创建、2026-04-05 最后推送、主语言 Dockerfile——即仓库更多是**容器/清单**而非完整源码）。

**本次做了完整的 MCP 握手实测（不是只看描述）**：`initialize` 返回 `serverInfo {"name":"InsuranceOracle","version":"1.0.0"}`、协议 `2025-03-26`；`tools/list` 返回 **12 个工具**，逐个可核实：**`insurance_company`**（按名称或 **LEI 法人识别码**查欧盟保险公司，返回 **GLEIF** 注册状态/国别/地址）、**`insurance_news`**（按主题的行业新闻：solvency、life、health、property、liability、auto、reinsurance、regu…）、**`natcat_live`**（全球实时巨灾预警，来自 **GDACS**）、**`earthquake_risk`**（**USGS** 实时地震数据，可按时间/震级/位置过滤）、**`weather_risk`**（任意地点 7 日风暴/洪水/风灾风险）、**`natcat_history`**（历史巨灾统计，供风险建模）、**`solvency_check`**（**Solvency II** 合规资讯 + GLEIF 注册状态）、**`insurance_regulation`**（欧盟与德国监管动态，主题含 **bafin、eiopa、idd、gdpr、dora、ifrs17**）、**`risk_score`**（**承保用** 0–100 区位风险评分：地震＋气候＋巨灾邻近度）、**`insurance_glossary`**（用**德语或英语**解释保险与 Solvency II 术语：SCR、MCR、ORSA、SFCR、IDD、LEI、NAT CAT…）、**`claim_news`**（按事件类型的重大理赔新闻：storm/flood/earthquake/hail/fire/cyber）、**`health_check`**。**免费工具 `health_check` 的实测返回还给出了后端连通性**：`gleif` ✅、`usgs_earthquake` ✅、`gdacs_natcat` ✅、`open_meteo` ✅、`google_news_rss` ✅、`wikidata` ✅——**即它确实在实时打这些上游**（版本 1.0.0、12 个工具、端口 8501）。

**⚠️ 访问模式必须放在前面说**：实测调用计费工具 `insurance_glossary` 时，返回的是 **HTTP 402 `payment_required`**（`error_type: no_wallet`，协议 `feedoracle-402`），提示「该工具需要 API key：先在 `feedoracle.io/mcp/` 调 `kya_register`（免费、无需 API key）创建钱包并获**每月 500 个欢迎单位**，之后在请求头带 `X-API-Key`」。也就是说**它是「按量计费的商业 MCP」而非免费开放服务**（厂商 ToolOracle 自述为「自主 agent 的能力路由器」，在需要时以 **x402 / USDC on Base** 结算）。**免费额度存在，但需要注册钱包。**

对 RIAA：它的价值有两层。**① 它补的是池内一个空白——「欧盟/德国监管口径」的 MCP**：池内 MCP 已有 16 条（[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 美国监管、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[apra-mcp]] 澳洲、[[guidewire-mcp]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]] 等），但**以德国 BaFin / GDV 口径、并把 Solvency II 术语做成德英双语词条**的，此前没有；对做欧盟偿付能力（Solvency II）或德国市场研究的学生，**`insurance_glossary` 与 `insurance_regulation` 是最直接可用的两个**（相关条目：[[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]]、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[iais-icp]]）。**② 它的工具清单本身就是一份「上游数据源地图」**：工具背后的 **GLEIF（法人识别码）、GDACS（全球灾害预警）、USGS（地震）、Open-Meteo（天气）、Wikidata** 全部是**免费开放**的——**而其中 [[usgs-earthquake-api]]、[[gdacs]]、[[open-meteo]] 本 wiki 都已单独收录**，因此**即使不使用这个计费服务，读者也能顺着这份清单直接用免费上游**；`risk_score` 这类「区位承保风险评分」也可与 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[climada]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[perils-ied]]、[[earth-engine]] 一类巨灾工具对照。

⚠️ **其余如实标注**：**①** 仓库**★0、许可证状态 NOASSERTION、主语言为 Dockerfile**，**没有可逐行审阅的完整源码**；**②** `risk_score`、`weather_risk` 的具体算法**未公开**，属**启发式评分，非可审计模型**，不应当作定价或核保依据；**③** `insurance_news`/`claim_news` 一类依赖新闻 RSS，**信息质量取决于媒体源**；**④** 计费与结算涉及加密支付通道，**读者使用前应自行了解条款与成本**；**⑤** 版本号 v1.0.0 且厂商为小型供应商，**长期可用性无保障**。**核实说明**：官方 registry 条目、远程端点 `initialize` 与 `tools/list`、免费工具 `health_check` 的真实返回、计费工具的 402 响应、仓库与厂商首页均经实测（HTTP 200 / 合法 JSON-RPC 响应）；**未注册钱包、未调用任何计费工具的实际数据返回**。
entries.body_en:
**InsuranceOracle** is an entry in the **official MCP registry** (`registry.modelcontextprotocol.io`; `io.tooloracle/insuranceoracle`, **v1.0.0, published/updated 2026-05-07, status active**), with remote endpoint `https://tooloracle.io/insurance/mcp/` (streamable-http) and repository `github.com/ToolOracle/insuranceoracle` (**0 stars, licence NOASSERTION**, created 2026-03-22, last pushed 2026-04-05, primary language Dockerfile — i.e. the repository is a **container/manifest** rather than full source).

**A full MCP handshake was performed here (not merely reading the description)**: `initialize` returned `serverInfo {"name":"InsuranceOracle","version":"1.0.0"}` on protocol `2025-03-26`; `tools/list` returned **12 tools**, each checkable: **`insurance_company`** (look up an EU insurer by name or **LEI** legal entity identifier, returning **GLEIF** registration status, country and address), **`insurance_news`** (industry news by topic: solvency, life, health, property, liability, auto, reinsurance, regu…), **`natcat_live`** (live global catastrophe alerts from **GDACS**), **`earthquake_risk`** (**USGS** real-time earthquake data filterable by period, magnitude and location), **`weather_risk`** (7-day storm, flood and wind risk for any location), **`natcat_history`** (historical catastrophe statistics for risk modelling), **`solvency_check`** (**Solvency II** compliance news plus GLEIF registration status), **`insurance_regulation`** (EU and German regulatory updates covering **bafin, eiopa, idd, gdpr, dora, ifrs17**), **`risk_score`** (a 0–100 location risk score **for underwriting**: earthquake + weather + catastrophe proximity), **`insurance_glossary`** (explains insurance and Solvency II terms **in German or English**: SCR, MCR, ORSA, SFCR, IDD, LEI, NAT CAT…), **`claim_news`** (major claims news by event type: storm/flood/earthquake/hail/fire/cyber) and **`health_check`**. The free `health_check` call also returned **live backend connectivity**: `gleif` ✅, `usgs_earthquake` ✅, `gdacs_natcat` ✅, `open_meteo` ✅, `google_news_rss` ✅, `wikidata` ✅ — so it genuinely hits those upstreams (version 1.0.0, 12 tools, port 8501).

**⚠️ The access model belongs at the front**: calling the metered tool `insurance_glossary` returned **HTTP 402 `payment_required`** (`error_type: no_wallet`, protocol `feedoracle-402`), stating that the tool needs an API key: first call `kya_register` at `feedoracle.io/mcp/` (free, no API key needed) to create a wallet and receive **500 free units per month**, then pass the key in the `X-API-Key` header. In other words **this is a metered commercial MCP, not a free open service** (the vendor ToolOracle describes itself as a "capability router for autonomous agents", settling via **x402 / USDC on Base** where required). **A free tier exists, but a wallet registration is needed.**

For RIAA, its value is twofold. **① It fills a genuine gap: an EU/German-regulatory MCP.** The corpus already holds 16 MCP entries ([[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] for US regulation, [[insurance-ai-mcp]], [[apra-mcp]] for Australia, [[guidewire-mcp]], [[acord-mcp-architecture]] and others), but **nothing framed in German BaFin/GDV terms with Solvency II terminology as a German–English glossary**; for students working on Solvency II or the German market, **`insurance_glossary` and `insurance_regulation` are the two most directly usable tools** (related: [[solvency2rfr]], [[ggsolvencyii]], [[sii-equity-risk-scr]], [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[insurance-europe]], [[iais-icp]]). **② Its tool inventory is itself a map of upstream data sources**: behind the tools sit **GLEIF (legal entity identifiers), GDACS (global disaster alerts), USGS (earthquakes), Open-Meteo (weather) and Wikidata** — all **free and open** — and **[[usgs-earthquake-api]], [[gdacs]] and [[open-meteo]] are already separately catalogued in this wiki**, so **even without using the metered service a reader can go straight to the free upstreams via this list**; scores like `risk_score` can also be compared against catastrophe tooling such as [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[openquake-engine]], [[climada]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[perils-ied]] and [[earth-engine]].

⚠️ **Other honest caveats**: **①** the repository has **0 stars, NOASSERTION licence status and Dockerfile as its primary language**, so **there is no complete source to review line by line**; **②** the algorithms behind `risk_score` and `weather_risk` are **not public** — they are **heuristic scores, not auditable models**, and must not be used as a basis for pricing or underwriting; **③** `insurance_news` and `claim_news` depend on news RSS, so **quality tracks the media sources**; **④** metering and settlement involve a crypto payment channel, so **readers should check terms and cost before use**; **⑤** at v1.0.0 from a small vendor, **long-term availability is not guaranteed**. **Verification note**: the official registry entry, the remote endpoint’s `initialize` and `tools/list`, the real return of the free `health_check` tool, the 402 response from a metered tool, the repository and the vendor home page were all measured (HTTP 200 / valid JSON-RPC responses); **no wallet was registered and no metered tool returned actual data**.
