entries.body:
这条 MCP 服务（官方 registry 条目 `com.brelsfordsoftware.agentweb/insurance-ai-regulation`，**v0.1.0 于 2026-08-20 发布、v0.2.0 于 2026-08-21 更新**，status active，端点 `https://agentweb.brelsfordsoftware.com/mcp`）回答一个**在保险 AI 治理里天天被问到、却很少有人给出逐条出处的问题**：**美国各州对保险公司使用 AI 到底管到什么程度？** 它自述为「**Cited US insurance AI regulation by state: NAIC bulletin adoption, frameworks, dates**」。

**本次做了真实调用（不是只看描述）**：该端点握手需要带 `MCP-Protocol-Version` 头（不带时实测返回 405 / 406，**这一点已写入词条**），带上后正常返回；`tools/list` 给出 **3 个工具**：**`lookup_jurisdiction`**（查单个辖区的保险 AI 监管态势：是否采纳 NAIC 范本公告、是否自建框架…）、**`list_jurisdictions`**（按态势列表，如 `posture: adopted_model_bulletin`）、**`dataset_provenance`**（返回**数据来源、截止日期、覆盖计数与逐字段置信度**——工具描述明确要求「**在依赖任何答案之前先调用它**」）。**实际调用结果如下（可复核）**：`dataset_provenance` 返回数据集 `us-insurance-ai-regulation/jurisdictions`、`schema_version 0.3.0`、**计数 adopted_model_bulletin 25 / own_framework 4 / no_model_bulletin 22 / total 51**，并给出字段置信度定义——**posture / citation / action_date 均为 `primary`**；`primary` 定义为「**已对照发布机构自己的记录核实**」，`secondary` 为「**来自报道、在用于合规决定前需再用一手来源确认**」；特别值得注意的是 **`quote` 字段的定义**：「**取自已签署法案或单行法的逐字有效条文，仅在确实取回并阅读了来源文本时存在——带引文的记录无需离开本条即可对照法条核查**」。`list_jurisdictions(posture=adopted_model_bulletin)` 返回 **25 个辖区**，逐条带法条引文与日期，例如 **Alaska 公告 B 24-01（2024-02-01）、New Hampshire Docket #INS 24-011-AB（2024-02-20）、Nevada Bulletin 24-001（2024-02-23）、Connecticut Bulletin No. MC-25（2024-02-26）**、Vermont 等。

对 RIAA：**这是「保险 AI 监管」这条线上第一份可以逐条回源、并且把「可信度」写进数据结构的条目**。池内已有 [[naic-ai-oversight]]（NAIC 层面的 AI 监管动向）与一批辖区级条目（[[irdai-ai-governance]] 印度、[[australia-ai6-governance]]、[[korea-ai-accountability]]、[[osfi-ai-risk-controls]] 加拿大、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 欧盟），但**「美国 51 个辖区里到底哪 25 个采纳了 NAIC 范本公告、分别在哪一天、依据哪份公告」这一层此前没有**。更值得学的是它的**数据设计**：**①** `dataset_provenance` 把「来源、截止日、覆盖计数、逐字段置信度」做成**必须先调用的工具**，等于**把「先问数据是哪来的」写进了接口协议**；**②** `primary` / `secondary` 的区分与**逐字引文**（`quote`）把「**能不能不回原文就核查**」变成字段级的承诺——这与本 wiki 自己的核实纪律、以及上一轮收录的 [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]（每条带 `source` + `source_quote`）是**同一种做法**，两例放在一起，正好构成「**监管数据应该长什么样**」的两个可对照样本；**③** 对做合规、模型治理或 AI 审计方向作业与论文的学生，「**辖区态势 → 引文 → 日期**」这条链可以直接引用，而不必自己逐州翻公告。相关条目：[[naic-ai-oversight]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[frai]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]、[[risk-radar-2026]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]、[[openfisca]]、[[psl-tax-calculator]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** registry 条目**未列出代码仓库**，端点站点 `agentweb.brelsfordsoftware.com`（HTTP 200，8.2KB）与厂商站 `brelsfordsoftware.com`（HTTP 200，38KB）均在，但**代码不可审阅**，实现方式无从判断；**②** 发布方为**小型软件公司**，非监管机构或行业协会；**③** 版本 **v0.x**，字段中 `verbatim_vs_modified`（逐字采纳还是修改后采纳）在部分记录上标为 **secondary-unverified**，即**这一项本身尚未全部一手核实**；**④** 数据集有**截止日期**，**使用前应按工具自身要求先调 `dataset_provenance` 确认时效**；**⑤** 「51 个辖区」推测为 50 州 + 哥伦比亚特区，但**本次未逐条核对辖区清单**。**核实说明**：官方 registry 条目、端点 `initialize`/`tools/list`、**`dataset_provenance` 与 `list_jurisdictions` 的真实返回**、两处站点均经实测；**未逐条回到各州公告原文比对**（这正是该工具主张自己能省掉的工作）。
entries.body_en:
This MCP service (official registry entry `com.brelsfordsoftware.agentweb/insurance-ai-regulation`, **v0.1.0 published 2026-08-20, v0.2.0 updated 2026-08-21**, status active, endpoint `https://agentweb.brelsfordsoftware.com/mcp`) answers a question **asked constantly in insurance AI governance and rarely answered with per-record sources**: **how far do US states actually regulate insurers’ use of AI?** It describes itself as "**Cited US insurance AI regulation by state: NAIC bulletin adoption, frameworks, dates**".

**Real calls were made here (not just reading the description)**: the endpoint requires an `MCP-Protocol-Version` header for the handshake (without it the measured response was 405 / 406 — **recorded here**), and responds correctly with it; `tools/list` returns **3 tools**: **`lookup_jurisdiction`** (one jurisdiction’s insurance-AI regulatory posture: whether it adopted the NAIC model bulletin, runs its own framework…), **`list_jurisdictions`** (list by posture, e.g. `posture: adopted_model_bulletin`), and **`dataset_provenance`** (returns the dataset’s source, as-of date, coverage counts and per-field confidence — its description explicitly says to **call it before relying on any answer**). **The actual returns, which can be re-checked**: `dataset_provenance` reported dataset `us-insurance-ai-regulation/jurisdictions`, `schema_version 0.3.0`, with **counts adopted_model_bulletin 25 / own_framework 4 / no_model_bulletin 22 / total 51**, and defined field confidence — **posture, citation and action_date are all `primary`**; `primary` means "**verified against the issuing body’s own record**" and `secondary` means "**from reporting, needing primary confirmation before it is relied on for a compliance decision**". Especially notable is the definition of **`quote`**: "**verbatim operative text from the enrolled or slip law, captured during primary verification. Present only where the source text was actually retrieved and read. A claim with a quote can be checked against the statute without leaving this record.**" `list_jurisdictions(posture=adopted_model_bulletin)` returned **25 jurisdictions**, each with a citation and date — for example **Alaska Bulletin B 24-01 (2024-02-01), New Hampshire Docket #INS 24-011-AB (2024-02-20), Nevada Bulletin 24-001 (2024-02-23), Connecticut Bulletin No. MC-25 (2024-02-26)**, Vermont and others.

For RIAA: **this is the first entry on the insurance-AI-regulation thread that can be traced record by record and that writes "how much to trust this" into the data structure itself.** The corpus already holds [[naic-ai-oversight]] (AI regulatory developments at NAIC level) and a set of jurisdictional entries ([[irdai-ai-governance]] for India, [[australia-ai6-governance]], [[korea-ai-accountability]], [[osfi-ai-risk-controls]] for Canada, [[aae-ai-act-position]] for the EU), but **"which 25 of the 51 US jurisdictions adopted the NAIC model bulletin, on which date, and under which bulletin" had no entry**. More instructive still is its **data design**: **①** `dataset_provenance` turns "source, as-of date, coverage counts, per-field confidence" into **a tool that must be called first** — effectively **writing "ask where the data came from" into the interface protocol**; **②** the `primary`/`secondary` split and the **verbatim `quote`** field make "**can this be checked without going back to the original?**" a field-level promise — the same discipline this wiki applies to itself, and the same one behind last round’s [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]] (every record carrying `source` + `source_quote`). Side by side, the two are **two comparable samples of what regulatory data should look like**. **③** For students writing on compliance, model governance or AI audit, the chain **jurisdictional posture → citation → date** can be cited directly instead of trawling state bulletins. Related: [[naic-ai-oversight]], [[naic-financial-data-repository]], [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], [[insurance-ai-mcp]], [[governance-mcp]], [[frai]], [[iso-42001-toolkit]], [[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]], [[risk-radar-2026]], [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]], [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]], [[openfisca]], [[psl-tax-calculator]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** the registry entry **lists no code repository**, and while the endpoint site `agentweb.brelsfordsoftware.com` (HTTP 200, 8.2KB) and the vendor site `brelsfordsoftware.com` (HTTP 200, 38KB) are both up, **the code cannot be reviewed**, so the implementation is unknown; **②** the publisher is a **small software company**, not a regulator or trade body; **③** it is **v0.x**, and the `verbatim_vs_modified` field (adopted verbatim versus adopted with changes) is marked **secondary-unverified** on some records — i.e. **that particular item is not yet fully verified against primary sources**; **④** the dataset **has an as-of date**, and **per the tool’s own instruction `dataset_provenance` should be called first to confirm freshness**; **⑤** "51 jurisdictions" presumably means 50 states plus DC, but **the jurisdiction list was not checked line by line here**. **Verification note**: the official registry entry, the endpoint’s `initialize`/`tools/list`, **the real returns of `dataset_provenance` and `list_jurisdictions`**, and both sites were measured; **no individual state bulletin was traced back for comparison** (which is precisely the work this tool claims to save).
entries.body_hk:
這條 MCP 服務（官方 registry 條目 `com.brelsfordsoftware.agentweb/insurance-ai-regulation`，**v0.1.0 於 2026-08-20 發布、v0.2.0 於 2026-08-21 更新**，status active，端點 `https://agentweb.brelsfordsoftware.com/mcp`）回答一個**保險 AI 治理裡天天被問到、卻很少給出逐條出處的問題**：**美國各州對保險公司使用 AI 到底管到什麼程度？** 自述為「**Cited US insurance AI regulation by state: NAIC bulletin adoption, frameworks, dates**」。

**本次做了真實調用**：握手需帶 `MCP-Protocol-Version` 頭（不帶時實測返回 405 / 406，**已寫入詞條**）；`tools/list` 給出 **3 個工具**：**`lookup_jurisdiction`**、**`list_jurisdictions`**（按態勢列表）、**`dataset_provenance`**（返回**數據來源、截止日期、覆蓋計數與逐欄位置信度**，並要求「**在依賴任何答案之前先調用它**」）。**實際返回（可複核）**：`dataset_provenance` 返回數據集 `us-insurance-ai-regulation/jurisdictions`、`schema_version 0.3.0`、**計數 adopted_model_bulletin 25 / own_framework 4 / no_model_bulletin 22 / total 51**；**posture / citation / action_date 均標為 `primary`**（定義為「**已對照發布機構自己的記錄核實**」），`secondary` 為「**來自報道、用於合規決定前需再用一手來源確認**」；**`quote` 欄位定義**：「**取自已簽署法案或單行法的逐字有效條文，僅在確實取回並閱讀來源文本時存在——帶引文的記錄無需離開本條即可對照法條核查**」。`list_jurisdictions(posture=adopted_model_bulletin)` 返回 **25 個轄區**，逐條帶引文與日期，例如 **Alaska 公告 B 24-01（2024-02-01）、New Hampshire Docket #INS 24-011-AB（2024-02-20）、Nevada Bulletin 24-001（2024-02-23）、Connecticut Bulletin No. MC-25（2024-02-26）**。

對 RIAA：**這是「保險 AI 監管」線上第一份可逐條回源、並把「可信度」寫進數據結構的條目**。池內已有 [[naic-ai-oversight]] 與一批轄區級條目（[[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[australia-ai6-governance]]、[[korea-ai-accountability]]、[[osfi-ai-risk-controls]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]），但**「51 個轄區裡哪 25 個採納了 NAIC 範本公告、分別在哪天、依據哪份公告」此前沒有**。更值得學的是**數據設計**：**①** `dataset_provenance` 把「來源、截止日、覆蓋計數、逐欄位置信度」做成**必須先調用的工具**；**②** `primary`/`secondary` 與**逐字引文**把「能不能不回原文就核查」變成欄位級承諾——與本 wiki 的核實紀律、以及上輪收錄的 [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]（每條帶 source + source_quote）**同一種做法**，兩例並列正好是「**監管數據應該長什麼樣**」的兩個可對照樣本。相關：[[naic-ai-oversight]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[frai]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[risk-radar-2026]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]、[[openfisca]]、[[psl-tax-calculator]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** registry 條目**未列出代碼倉庫**，端點站與廠商站均在（HTTP 200），但**代碼不可審閱**；**②** 發布方為**小型軟件公司**，非監管機構；**③** 版本 **v0.x**，`verbatim_vs_modified` 在部分記錄標為 **secondary-unverified**；**④** 數據集有**截止日期**，**使用前應先調 `dataset_provenance`**；**⑤** 「51 個轄區」推測為 50 州 + 哥倫比亞特區，但**本次未逐條核對**。**核實說明**：registry 條目、`initialize`／`tools/list`、**`dataset_provenance` 與 `list_jurisdictions` 真實返回**、兩處站點均實測；**未逐條回到各州公告原文比對**。
entries.verified_note: 官方 MCP registry 实测（com.brelsfordsoftware.agentweb/insurance-ai-regulation v0.1.0 2026-08-20 / v0.2.0 2026-08-21；status active；remote streamable-http https://agentweb.brelsfordsoftware.com/mcp；registry 未列仓库）+ 端点握手实测（需 MCP-Protocol-Version 头，否则 405/406；带后 200 text/event-stream）+ tools/list 返回 3 个工具（lookup_jurisdiction / list_jurisdictions / dataset_provenance）+ 真实调用 dataset_provenance（dataset us-insurance-ai-regulation/jurisdictions、schema_version 0.3.0、counts 25/4/22/51、字段置信度 primary/secondary 定义、quote 字段语义）与 list_jurisdictions(adopted_model_bulletin)（25 个辖区，含 AK B 24-01 2024-02-01、NH Docket #INS 24-011-AB 2024-02-20、NV 24-001 2024-02-23、CT MC-25 2024-02-26）+ 站点实测（agentweb 8.2KB / brelsfordsoftware 38KB）；未逐条回源各州公告

entries.title: PensionPro MCP · 养老金行政系统对接（计划/项目/任务/联系人的 agent 接口）
entries.title_en: PensionPro MCP — agent interface to a pension administration system (plans, projects, tasks, contacts)
entries.title_hk: PensionPro MCP · 養老金行政系統對接（計劃/項目/任務/聯絡人的 agent 接口）
entries.summary: 把美国养老金行政平台 PensionPro 的 REST API 封装成 MCP：计划检索、项目与任务流转、客户与联系人、待办与备注
entries.summary_en: Wraps the PensionPro pension-administration REST API as MCP: plan search, project and task workflow, clients and contacts, to-dos and notes
entries.summary_hk: 把美國養老金行政平台 PensionPro 的 REST API 封裝成 MCP：計劃檢索、項目與任務流轉、客戶與聯絡人、待辦與備註
entries.body:
**PensionPro MCP** 是一条**把「养老金行政系统」接给 AI agent** 的开源 MCP 服务器（官方 registry 条目 `io.github.douglaslinsmeyer/pension-pro-mcp`，**v0.2.1，2026-04-05 发布**；仓库 `github.com/douglaslinsmeyer/pension-pro-mcp`）。可核实信息：**MIT 许可**、**★0**、**2026-04-03 创建、2026-04-06 最后推送**、**586 KB**、**Python**、**实测 45 个文件**（含 `pyproject.toml`、`server.json`、`src/pension_pro_mcp/`（`client.py` 等）、**`docs/superpowers/specs/` 与 `docs/superpowers/plans/` 下的设计文档与实施计划**、`scripts/scrape_docs.py` 与 `scripts/swagger.py`、`.github/workflows/publish.yml`、`CLAUDE.md`）。README 自述为「**本地、开源的 MCP 服务器，为 AI 助手提供与 PensionPro REST API 交互的工具**」，能力分五块：**① 计划检索**（按名称/状态/类型/客户搜索计划，返回联系人、周期与**费率表 fee schedules**）；**② 项目与任务流转**（搜索项目、查看任务、完成任务/取消完成、**重新指派任务**、从模板创建项目）；**③ 客户与联系人检索**；**④ 待办管理**（搜索/新建/更新与计划、项目或联系人关联的 to-do）；**⑤ 备注**（在计划、项目、任务、联系人上增删查）。安装方式为 `pip install pension-pro-mcp` 或 **`uvx pension-pro-mcp`**（无需安装直接运行）；前置条件为 **Python 3.12+ 以及 PensionPro 的 API key 与用户名**。

对 RIAA：**它补的是「养老金行政（pension administration）系统 → agent」这一形态**。池内 MCP 已有 16 条，其中[[root-insurance-mcp]] 是**保险核心平台**官方发布的 MCP，本条与之同类但落在**养老金行政**侧——而养老金正是精算的另一条主线（池内有 [[lifeinsurer]]、[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[lifepack]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]] 等，但**没有一条是「行政系统接口」**）。它的实际参考价值有两点：**① 形态示范**——「TPA/行政系统的领域对象（计划、周期、费率表、任务、待办）」如何被切成 agent 工具，**任务流转与模板化建项目**这类**运营动作**如何暴露给模型，这套切分对做保险/养老金运营自动化的人直接可借鉴；**② 可读的源码**——45 个文件的仓库结构（含设计文档与实施计划）**可以逐份阅读**，比一个不可审阅的闭源端点更有学习价值（对照：同轮收录的 [[insuranceoracle]] 就属于「无完整源码」的一类）。相关条目：[[lifeinsurer]]、[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[lifepack]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[root-insurance-mcp]]、[[latticepolicy]]、[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[quickfire-ams]]、[[openkoda]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[guidewire-mcp]]。

⚠️ **如实标注三点**：**① 需要账号——它对接的是商业平台 PensionPro，必须持有其 API key 与用户名，没有账号时它只是一份「**怎么写这类接口**」的参考实现**，不能直接使用；**② ★0、最后推送 2026-04-06（此后无活动）**，属**单次发布**、无维护保证，版本 **v0.2.1** 仍早期；**③** 参数与工具清单**以其 README 与仓库结构为据**，本次**未安装、未连接 PensionPro、未实际调用任何工具**（无凭据）。**核实说明**：官方 registry 条目、GitHub 仓库页（300KB）、仓库完整文件树（45 文件）、README 原文均经实测；**未安装、未运行、未连接其上游系统**。
entries.body_en:
**PensionPro MCP** is an open-source MCP server that **connects a pension administration system to AI agents** (official registry entry `io.github.douglaslinsmeyer/pension-pro-mcp`, **v0.2.1, published 2026-04-05**; repository `github.com/douglaslinsmeyer/pension-pro-mcp`). Verifiable details: **MIT licence**, **0 stars**, **created 2026-04-03, last pushed 2026-04-06**, **586 KB**, **Python**, with a measured **45 files** (including `pyproject.toml`, `server.json`, `src/pension_pro_mcp/` such as `client.py`, **design and implementation documents under `docs/superpowers/specs/` and `docs/superpowers/plans/`**, `scripts/scrape_docs.py` and `scripts/swagger.py`, `.github/workflows/publish.yml`, `CLAUDE.md`). The README describes it as "**a local, open-source MCP server that provides AI assistants with tools to interact with the PensionPro REST API**", with five capability blocks: **① plan lookup and search** (by name, status, type or client, returning contacts, cycles and **fee schedules**); **② project and task workflow** (search projects, view task details, complete/uncomplete tasks, **reassign tasks**, create projects from templates); **③ client and contact lookup**; **④ to-do management** (search, create and update to-dos linked to plans, projects or contacts); **⑤ notes** (add and retrieve notes on plans, projects, tasks and contacts). Installation is `pip install pension-pro-mcp` or **`uvx pension-pro-mcp`**; prerequisites are **Python 3.12+ and a PensionPro API key and username**.

For RIAA: **it fills the "pension administration system → agent" form.** The corpus holds 16 MCP entries, among them [[root-insurance-mcp]], published by an insurance core platform; this one is the same kind of thing but lands on **pension administration** — and pensions are actuarial work’s other main line (the corpus has [[lifeinsurer]], [[mpf-fund-platform]], [[open-life-au]], [[lifepack]] and [[longevity-mortality-investor]], but **no entry for an administration-system interface**). Its practical value is twofold: **① form demonstration** — how a TPA/administration system’s domain objects (plans, cycles, fee schedules, tasks, to-dos) are cut into agent tools, and how **operational actions** like task transitions and template-driven project creation are exposed to a model; **② readable source** — a 45-file repository (with design documents and implementation plans) **that can actually be read**, which is more instructive than an uninspectable closed endpoint (contrast [[insuranceoracle]], also added this round, which has no complete source). Related: [[lifeinsurer]], [[mpf-fund-platform]], [[open-life-au]], [[lifepack]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]], [[root-insurance-mcp]], [[latticepolicy]], [[titanium-insurance-core]], [[quickfire-ams]], [[openkoda]], [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], [[guidewire-mcp]].

⚠️ **Three honest caveats**: **① it needs an account** — it talks to the commercial PensionPro platform and requires its API key and username, so **without an account it is only a reference implementation of "how to write this kind of interface"** and cannot be used directly; **② at 0 stars with last push 2026-04-06 (no activity since)**, it is a **single release** with no maintenance guarantee, and v0.2.1 is still early; **③** the parameters and tool list rest **on the README and repository structure**; **nothing was installed, no PensionPro connection was made and no tool was called** (no credentials). **Verification note**: the official registry entry, the GitHub repository page (300KB), the full file tree (45 files) and the README were all measured; **nothing was installed or run, and its upstream system was never contacted**.

entries.body:
**floodwise** 是一个小而诚实的 MCP 服务器：**按邮编查英格兰的长期洪水风险等级**。可核实信息：**Apache-2.0**、仓库 `github.com/qinisolabs/floodwise`（**★1**、**2026-06-18 创建、2026-06-22 最后推送**、**52 KB**、**TypeScript**、**实测 27 个文件**）、npm 包 `floodwise`（**v0.1.1**，Apache-2.0，2026-06-18 创建、2026-06-22 更新，**2 个版本**）、文档站 `qinisolabs.github.io/floodwise/`（HTTP 200，8.5KB）实测。运行方式为**本地 stdio，无需 key、无需登录**（`npx -y floodwise`）。文件结构中可见 `src/flood.ts`、`src/core.ts`、`src/server.ts`、`src/worker.ts`、`scripts/build-data.mjs` 与 `gen-data.mjs`、`data/flood-postcodes.sample.json`、`test/parity.test.ts`、`manifest.json`、`smithery.yaml`、`docs/llms.txt`。

**它解决的是一个「模型根本不可能知道」的问题**（README 原文）：问 LLM「SW1A 1AA 的洪水风险如何」，它会自信作答——但它**不可能知道**：**逐邮编的洪水风险是存放在政府数据集里的具体数据，不在模型权重里**。floodwise 则去 **环境署（Environment Agency）官方的「Flood risk: postcode search tool」数据集**里查，**返回真实的长期风险等级，查不到就返回一个诚实的「not found」，而不是猜一个**。

**⭐ 这个项目最值得本 wiki 记录的是它把边界写在最前面**（README 单列一节「Read this first — what floodwise is and isn't」）：**① 仅英格兰**——数据来自环境署，覆盖英格兰；威尔士（Natural Resources Wales）、苏格兰（SEPA）、北爱尔兰（DfI）**不在覆盖范围内**，**有效的威/苏邮编会返回「not found」，绝不猜测**；**② 区域级而非物业级**——风险针对该邮编内地址**周边区域**，不是某一栋建筑，且**环境署自己声明该数据「generally not suitable for property level assessment」**；**③ 长期风险而非实时预警**——反映的是长期年度洪涝概率，**不是「此刻或预报是否正在淹水」**；**④ 明确声明「不是保险、核保、勘测或专业建议」**。它给自己的定位是「**为 AI agent 提供经过核实的、可信的数据工具**」（项目方 Qiniso 的名称在祖鲁语中意为「真相」）。

**⭐ 连「示例数据」都不肯误导**：仓库里提交的 `flood-postcodes.sample.json` 开头写着——「**ILLUSTRATIVE STARTER SAMPLE — NOT official Environment Agency data**（仅用于让新克隆的仓库能在没有大数据集的情况下构建与测试）」，因此它使用**非地理性的 `ZZ` 伪邮编**（外加众所周知的低风险 `SW1A 1AA`），理由是「**so no real location is mislabelled（这样不会把任何真实地点标错）**」；真实数据由 `node scripts/build-data.mjs <Postcodes_Risk_Assessment_All.csv> <version>` 从环境署数据生成、不入库。**为了「不误导」而专门设计示例数据的键名与内容——这个做法本身就值得作为范例记录。**

对 RIAA：**① 业务上直接可用**——洪水是财产险与巨灾建模的核心风险，而**「按邮编查长期风险等级」是报价、承保筛选与组合暴露清点的第一步**；池内巨灾与自然灾害条目已很厚（[[perils-ied]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[climada]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[earth-engine]]、[[hazimp]]、[[anuga]]、[[noaa-inundation-mapping]]、[[thinkhazard]]、[[lisflood]]、[[floodmodeller-api]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[opendrr-riskprofiler]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]），美国的 NFIP/洪水口径也有 [[rfema]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]，但**「英国邮编级、直接可查询的洪水风险」这一条此前没有**（[[floodmodeller-api]] 是建模工具，不是查询数据源）；对做**英国市场**或**跨市场承保筛选**的学生，这是一个立刻能用的数据入口，可与 [[spatialrisk]]（风险集中度）、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]] 一类参数险工作串联。**② 方法上更值得学**——它是本 wiki 里**「数据源边界」写得最完整的一个小项目**：覆盖范围（英格兰）、空间粒度（区域非物业）、时间语义（长期非实时）、**用途免责（不是核保建议）**四项全部前置声明，**查不到就返回 not found**，示例数据都刻意避免误导。这与池内同类纪律的条目（[[claim-handling-deadlines-us]] 的逐条引文、上一轮 [[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]] 的字段级置信度、[[quorumforge]] 的确定性裁决、[[clarity-sdk]] 的确定性受监管抽取、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] 的可靠性评测）构成同一个主题：**面向 agent 的数据供给，可信度必须被显式设计，而不是默认成立**。相关：[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[underwriting-intel-mcp]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]、[[insurance-deploy]]、[[usgs-earthquake-api]]、[[gdacs]]、[[open-meteo]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ★1、项目极小**（52 KB、27 个文件、npm 仅 **2 个版本**、最后推送 2026-06-22 后再无活动），属**个人/小团队早期项目**，长期维护无保障；**② 覆盖仅英格兰**——对香港、中国内地或美国市场的读者，其价值主要在**形态与做法**，而非可直接使用的数据；**③** 本次核实到仓库文件树、README 原文、npm 元数据与文档站层面，**未运行该 MCP、未实际查询任何邮编、未与企业环境署原始 CSV 比对结果**；**④** README 引述的「EA 称该数据 generally not suitable for property level assessment」**为项目转述环境署表述，本次未回环境署原文核对**；**⑤** 它**明确声明不构成核保或专业建议**——本词条同样不主张可据此直接承保定价。**核实说明**：npm registry 元数据、GitHub 仓库页（320KB）与完整文件树（27 文件）、README 原文、示例数据文件原文、文档站（8.5KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未运行、未查询、未回源比对**。
entries.body_en:
**floodwise** is a small and unusually honest MCP server: **look up England’s long-term flood risk by postcode**. Verifiable details: **Apache-2.0**, repository `github.com/qinisolabs/floodwise` (**1 star**, **created 2026-06-18, last pushed 2026-06-22**, **52 KB**, **TypeScript**, **27 files measured**), npm package `floodwise` (**v0.1.1**, Apache-2.0, created 2026-06-18, updated 2026-06-22, **two versions**), and docs site `qinisolabs.github.io/floodwise/` (measured HTTP 200, 8.5KB). It runs **locally over stdio with no key and no login** (`npx -y floodwise`). The file tree shows `src/flood.ts`, `src/core.ts`, `src/server.ts`, `src/worker.ts`, `scripts/build-data.mjs` and `gen-data.mjs`, `data/flood-postcodes.sample.json`, `test/parity.test.ts`, `manifest.json`, `smithery.yaml` and `docs/llms.txt`.

**It solves a problem a model simply cannot know** (per the README): ask an LLM "what’s the flood risk at SW1A 1AA?" and it will answer confidently — but it **cannot know**, because **per-postcode flood risk is specific curated data living in a government dataset, not in a model’s weights**. floodwise instead looks the postcode up in the **Environment Agency’s official "Flood risk: postcode search tool" data** and returns the **real long-term risk band — or an honest "not found" instead of a guess**.

**⭐ What most deserves recording here is that it puts its boundaries first** (the README devotes a section to "Read this first — what floodwise is and isn’t"): **① England only** — the data is the Environment Agency’s, which covers England; Wales (Natural Resources Wales), Scotland (SEPA) and Northern Ireland (DfI) are **not covered**, and **a valid Welsh or Scottish postcode returns "not found", never a guess**; **② area-level, not property-level** — the risk is for *the area around* the addresses in a postcode rather than a specific building, and the **EA itself states the data is "generally not suitable for property level assessment"**; **③ long-term risk, not a live warning** — it reflects the long-term annual chance of flooding, **not whether flooding is happening now or forecast**; **④ an explicit statement that it is "not insurance, underwriting, surveying or professional advice"**. Its own framing: "**Verified, trustworthy data tools for AI agents**" (the maker, Qiniso, means "truth" in Zulu).

**⭐ It will not even let its sample data mislead**: the committed `flood-postcodes.sample.json` opens with "**ILLUSTRATIVE STARTER SAMPLE — NOT official Environment Agency data**", committed so a fresh clone can build and test without the large real dataset; it therefore uses **non-geographic `ZZ` pseudo-postcodes** (plus the well-known low-risk `SW1A 1AA`) on the stated grounds "**so no real location is mislabelled**". The real data is produced by `node scripts/build-data.mjs <Postcodes_Risk_Assessment_All.csv> <version>` from EA data and is not committed. **Designing the sample file’s keys and contents specifically so it cannot mislead is itself worth recording as a model practice.**

For RIAA: **① direct business use** — flooding is a core property and catastrophe-modelling peril, and **"look up the long-term risk band by postcode" is the first step in quoting, underwriting screening and portfolio exposure inventory**. The corpus’s catastrophe and natural-hazard coverage is already deep ([[perils-ied]], [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[climada]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[openquake-engine]], [[earth-engine]], [[hazimp]], [[anuga]], [[noaa-inundation-mapping]], [[thinkhazard]], [[lisflood]], [[floodmodeller-api]], [[gem-global-exposure-model]], [[opendrr-riskprofiler]], [[canada-seismic-risk-model]]), and the US NFIP/flood angle is covered by [[rfema]], [[fema-nfhl-mcp]] and [[duckdb-fema-nfip]] — but **a UK postcode-level, directly queryable flood risk source had no entry** ([[floodmodeller-api]] is a modelling tool, not a queryable data source); for students working on the **UK market** or **cross-market underwriting screening**, this is a usable data entry point that chains with [[spatialrisk]] (risk concentration), [[aegis-parametric]] and [[parametric-insurance-demo]]. **② The method matters more** — it is **the most complete statement of data-source boundaries** among the corpus’s small projects: coverage (England), spatial granularity (area, not property), temporal semantics (long-term, not live) and **purpose disclaimer (not underwriting advice)** are all declared up front, **unknown lookups return not found**, and even the sample data is built to avoid misleading. That places it with the corpus’s other entries on the same discipline — the per-record citations of [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]], the field-level confidence of last round’s [[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]], the deterministic adjudication of [[quorumforge]], the deterministic regulated extraction of [[clarity-sdk]] and the reliability evaluation of [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] — all instances of one theme: **in agent-facing data supply, trustworthiness has to be designed in, not assumed**. Related: [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], [[underwriting-intel-mcp]], [[agentic-bop-underwriting]], [[insurance-deploy]], [[usgs-earthquake-api]], [[gdacs]], [[open-meteo]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① at 1 star and very small** (52 KB, 27 files, only **two npm versions**, no activity since 2026-06-22), it is an **early project from an individual or small team** with no maintenance guarantee; **② coverage is England only** — for readers in Hong Kong, mainland China or the US its value lies mainly in **form and practice** rather than directly usable data; **③** this check reached the file tree, README text, npm metadata and docs site — **the MCP was not run, no postcode was queried and no result was compared against the Environment Agency’s original CSV**; **④** the README’s quotation that the EA calls the data "generally not suitable for property level assessment" **is the project paraphrasing the EA and was not traced back to the EA’s own text here**; **⑤** it **explicitly disclaims underwriting or professional advice**, and this entry likewise does not claim it can be used directly for pricing. **Verification note**: npm registry metadata, the GitHub repository page (320KB) with its full file tree (27 files), the README, the sample data file and the docs site (8.5KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **nothing was run or queried, and no source comparison was made**.
entries.body_hk:
**floodwise** 是一個小而誠實的 MCP 伺服器：**按郵編查英格蘭的長期洪水風險等級**。可核實資訊：**Apache-2.0**、倉庫 `github.com/qinisolabs/floodwise`（**★1**、**2026-06-18 建立、2026-06-22 最後推送**、**52 KB**、**TypeScript**、**實測 27 個檔案**）、npm 包 `floodwise`（**v0.1.1**，**2 個版本**）、文檔站 HTTP 200 實測。運行方式為**本地 stdio，無需 key、無需登入**（`npx -y floodwise`）。

**它解決的是一個「模型根本不可能知道」的問題**（README 原文）：問 LLM「SW1A 1AA 的洪水風險如何」，它會自信作答——但它**不可能知道**：**逐郵編的洪水風險是存放在政府數據集裡的具體數據，不在模型權重裡**。floodwise 則去**環境署官方的「Flood risk: postcode search tool」數據集**裡查，**返回真實的長期風險等級，查不到就返回誠實的「not found」，而不是猜一個**。

**⭐ 最值得記錄的是它把邊界寫在最前面**：**① 僅英格蘭**——威爾斯、蘇格蘭、北愛爾蘭**不在覆蓋範圍內**，**有效的威/蘇郵編返回「not found」，絕不猜測**；**② 區域級而非物業級**——且**環境署自己聲明該數據「generally not suitable for property level assessment」**；**③ 長期風險而非實時預警**；**④ 明確聲明「不是保險、核保、勘測或專業建議」**。

**⭐ 連「示例數據」都不肯誤導**：`flood-postcodes.sample.json` 開頭寫明「**NOT official Environment Agency data**」，因此使用**非地理性的 `ZZ` 偽郵編**（外加眾所周知的低風險 `SW1A 1AA`），理由是「**so no real location is mislabelled**」。**為「不誤導」而專門設計示例數據——這個做法本身就值得作為範例記錄。**

對 RIAA：**① 業務上直接可用**——「按郵編查長期風險等級」是報價、承保篩選與組合暴露清點的第一步；池內巨災條目已很厚（[[perils-ied]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[climada]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[hazimp]]、[[thinkhazard]]、[[lisflood]]、[[floodmodeller-api]]），美國 NFIP 口徑也有 [[rfema]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]，但**「英國郵編級、可直接查詢的洪水風險」此前沒有**；**② 方法上更值得學**——它是本 wiki 裡**「數據源邊界」寫得最完整的小項目**：覆蓋範圍、空間粒度、時間語義、**用途免責**四項全部前置聲明，**查不到就 not found**，示例數據都刻意避免誤導。與 [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]（逐條引文）、[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]]（欄位級置信度）、[[quorumforge]]、[[clarity-sdk]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] 構成同一主題：**面向 agent 的數據供給，可信度必須被顯式設計**。相關：[[spatialrisk]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[underwriting-intel-mcp]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]、[[usgs-earthquake-api]]、[[gdacs]]、[[open-meteo]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ★1、項目極小**（52 KB、27 檔案、npm 僅 **2 個版本**、2026-06-22 後無活動）；**② 覆蓋僅英格蘭**——對香港、內地或美國讀者，價值主要在**形態與做法**；**③** 本次核實到倉庫、README、npm 元數據與文檔站層面，**未運行、未查詢任何郵編、未與環境署原始 CSV 比對**；**④** README 引述的環境署表述**未回原文核對**；**⑤** 它**明確聲明不構成核保或專業建議**。**核實說明**：npm 元數據、倉庫頁（320KB）與完整文件樹（27 檔案）、README 原文、示例數據原文、文檔站均 HTTP 200 實測；**未運行、未查詢、未回源比對**。

entries.body:
**Property Hazard MCP**（官方 registry 条目 `ai.zipquote/us-property-hazard-risk`，**v1.0.0，2026-07-26 更新，status active**，端点 `https://mcp.zipquote.ai/mcp`）做的事非常具体：**输入一个美国地址，返回该地址的自然灾害暴露**。仓库 `github.com/ericshenus/us-property-hazard-risk`（**MIT**、★0、**2026-07-26 创建 / 07-28 最后推送**、**59 KB**、**Python**）。

**本次做了完整握手与真实调用（不是读描述）**：`initialize` 返回 `serverInfo {"name":"Property Hazard MCP","version":"1.28.1"}`（协议 2025-06-18，具备 tools / prompts / resources），服务端 `instructions` 自述为「查询单一地址的洪水、野火、地震与海岸风暴暴露」；`tools/list` 返回 **1 个工具**：**`assess_property_hazard`**，入参只有 `address`（必填），描述说明它会**校验并对地址做地理编码（US C[ensus]…）**。**实际调用 `1200 Brickell Ave, Miami, FL 33131` 的返回如下（可复核）**：

- `validated: true`、标准化地址 `1200 BRICKELL AVE, MIAMI, FL, 33131`，坐标 **25.76221823112 / -80.191806017684**
- **`flood_zone: "AE"`、`sfha: true`**（AE 属 FEMA 的**特殊洪水危险区**）、`flood_available: true`
- **`wildfire_score: 2`**、**`seismic_pga: 0.022`**、**`fault_distance_miles: 864.6`**、**`coastal_distance_miles: 0.5`**
- **`hazard_score: 53`、`hazard_tier: "Very High"`**，并给出**驱动因素清单**：`["Flood Zone AE", "Wildfire Medium", "Immediate coastal exposure"]`

⭐⭐ **本轮最关键的一步是外部交叉核对**：把返回坐标拿去查 **FEMA 自己的 NFHL 服务**（`hazards.fema.gov/arcgis/rest/services/public/NFHL/MapServer/28/query`），返回 **`FLD_ZONE: "AE"`、`SFHA_TF: "T"`**——**与该工具给出的 AE / sfha=true 完全一致**。地理常识层面也自洽：Brickell 位于迈阿密海滨（离岸 0.5 英里、属特殊洪水危险区均合理）、佛州远离断层（864.6 英里）且地震 PGA 极低（0.022）。**即：这不是一个「描述漂亮」的服务，而是一个能被官方数据验证真实输出的服务。**

对 RIAA：**这是本会话发现的、最接近「承保第一步」的可用工具之一**——**报价前对单一地址做多灾种筛查，正是财产险承保与定价的实际动作**。池内在「灾害风险」上已有很厚的一层：美国洪水口径有 [[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[rfema]]、[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]，地震有 [[usgs-earthquake-api]]，巨灾建模有 [[openquake-engine]]、[[climada]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[hazimp]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[opendrr-riskprofiler]]、[[perils-ied]]，空间集中度有 [[spatialrisk]]，但**「**输入一个地址 → 一次拿到多种灾种 + 综合分级 + 驱动因素**」这一层此前没有**；它与本轮同批收录的 [[floodwise]]（**英国**邮编级洪水）正好构成**「英/美两地、地址级灾害筛查」**的一对。业务上可直接用于：**承保筛选与风险分级、巨灾暴露清点、参数险触发条件设计（[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]）、再保与巨灾债券的风险分层（[[cat-bond-pricing]]）**；上游若要与官方工具链打通，可对照 [[fema-nfhl-mcp]] 与 [[usgs-earthquake-api]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 综合分的算法未公开**——`hazard_score`/`hazard_tier`（53 / Very High）与 `wildfire_score` 的量纲在本次探测中**无法确定**，属**启发式合成指标而非可审计模型**，不能作为定价依据；**② 只测了一个地址**——虽经 FEMA 官方数据交叉核对，但**样本为 1**，`wildfire_score` 等分支**未独立验证**；**③ 商业背景**——由报价平台 zipquote.ai 发布（MCP 是免鉴权调用，但服务本身可能是其报价产品的入口），**长期可用性与免费额度无承诺**；**④** 仓库 ★0、最后推送 **2026-07-28**，而托管服务版本已 **1.28.1**，**说明仓库可能滞后于线上服务**，源码不可视为线上实现；**⑤** 洪水之外的字段（野火/地震/海岸）**未与 USGS、WFIGS 等官方源逐一比对**。**核实说明**：官方 registry 条目、端点 `initialize` / `tools/list`、**一次真实工具调用及其完整返回**、仓库元数据、**以及 FEMA NFHL 官方服务的独立交叉核对（FLD_ZONE=AE、SFHA_TF=T，吻合）** 均经实测；**未注册账号、未做多地址或多灾种抽样验证**。
entries.body_en:
**Property Hazard MCP** (official registry entry `ai.zipquote/us-property-hazard-risk`, **v1.0.0, updated 2026-07-26, status active**, endpoint `https://mcp.zipquote.ai/mcp`) does something very specific: **give it one US address and it returns that address’s natural-hazard exposure**. Repository `github.com/ericshenus/us-property-hazard-risk` (**MIT**, 0 stars, **created 2026-07-26 / last pushed 07-28**, **59 KB**, **Python**).

**A full handshake and a real call were performed here (not just reading the description)**: `initialize` returned `serverInfo {"name":"Property Hazard MCP","version":"1.28.1"}` (protocol 2025-06-18; tools, prompts and resources advertised), with server `instructions` describing "flood, wildfire, earthquake, and coastal-storm hazard exposure for a single address"; `tools/list` returned **one tool**: **`assess_property_hazard`**, whose only input is a required `address`, and whose description says it **validates and geocodes the address (US C[ensus]…)**. **The actual call for `1200 Brickell Ave, Miami, FL 33131` returned (re-checkable)**:

- `validated: true`, standardized address `1200 BRICKELL AVE, MIAMI, FL, 33131`, coordinates **25.76221823112 / -80.191806017684**
- **`flood_zone: "AE"`, `sfha: true`** (zone AE is a FEMA **Special Flood Hazard Area**), `flood_available: true`
- **`wildfire_score: 2`**, **`seismic_pga: 0.022`**, **`fault_distance_miles: 864.6`**, **`coastal_distance_miles: 0.5`**
- **`hazard_score: 53`** with **`hazard_tier: "Very High"`**, plus a **driver list**: `["Flood Zone AE", "Wildfire Medium", "Immediate coastal exposure"]`

⭐⭐ **The decisive step this round was external cross-checking**: feeding those coordinates into **FEMA’s own NFHL service** (`hazards.fema.gov/arcgis/rest/services/public/NFHL/MapServer/28/query`) returned **`FLD_ZONE: "AE"`, `SFHA_TF: "T"`** — **exactly matching the tool’s `flood_zone: AE` / `sfha: true`**. The geography is self-consistent too: Brickell sits on the Miami waterfront (0.5 miles to the coast and a Special Flood Hazard Area both make sense), and Florida is far from any fault (864.6 miles) with very low seismic PGA (0.022). **In other words, this is not a service that merely describes itself well — it is one whose real output can be verified against official data.**

For RIAA: **this is among the most directly usable "first step in underwriting" tools found in this session** — **screening a single address for multiple perils before quoting is exactly what property underwriting and pricing actually do**. The corpus already has a thick natural-hazard layer: US flood via [[fema-nfhl-mcp]], [[rfema]] and [[duckdb-fema-nfip]]; earthquakes via [[usgs-earthquake-api]]; cat modelling via [[openquake-engine]], [[climada]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[hazimp]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[gem-global-exposure-model]], [[opendrr-riskprofiler]] and [[perils-ied]]; and spatial concentration via [[spatialrisk]]. But **"one address in → several perils plus an overall tier plus the drivers" had no entry**; together with [[floodwise]] (UK postcode-level flood), also added this round, it forms a **UK/US pair of address-level hazard screening**. Direct business uses: **underwriting screening and risk tiering, catastrophe exposure inventory, parametric trigger design ([[aegis-parametric]], [[parametric-insurance-demo]]) and reinsurance/cat-bond risk layering ([[cat-bond-pricing]])**; to connect it to official tooling, compare [[fema-nfhl-mcp]] and [[usgs-earthquake-api]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the composite algorithm is not public** — the scale behind `hazard_score`/`hazard_tier` (53 / Very High) and `wildfire_score` **could not be determined in this probe**, so they are **heuristic composites rather than an auditable model** and must not drive pricing; **② only one address was tested** — although it was cross-checked against FEMA’s own data, the **sample size is 1**, and branches such as `wildfire_score` **were not independently verified**; **③ commercial context** — published by the quoting platform zipquote.ai (the MCP call needed no authentication, but the service may be a funnel for its quoting product), with **no commitment on availability or a free tier**; **④** the repository has 0 stars and was last pushed **2026-07-28** while the hosted service is already at **1.28.1**, so **the repo may lag the live service** and its source should not be read as the deployed implementation; **⑤** fields other than flood (wildfire, seismic, coastal) **were not compared one by one against USGS, WFIGS or other official sources**. **Verification note**: the official registry entry, the endpoint’s `initialize`/`tools/list`, **one real tool call with its complete return**, the repository metadata, **and an independent cross-check against FEMA’s NFHL service (FLD_ZONE=AE, SFHA_TF=T — matching)** were all measured; **no account was registered and no multi-address or multi-peril sampling was done**.

entries.title: 网络巨灾的「小猫」方法（arXiv 2026-09-07）：幂律是否成立？
entries.title_en: Cyber Kittens (arXiv, 2026-09-07): is a power law plausible for cyber catastrophe losses?
entries.title_hk: 網絡巨災的「小貓」方法（arXiv 2026-09-07）：冪律是否成立？
entries.summary: 用 LLM 从 2020–2024 网络险理赔中抽出 10 亿美元以下的「小猫」事件，与 24 起巨灾事件拼接检验幂律：数量级每增 1 档，概率降 5–7 倍
entries.summary_en: Uses an LLM to extract sub-$1B "kitten" events from 2020–2024 cyber claims and joins them to 24 cat events to test a power law: each order of magnitude in size cuts probability 5–7×
entries.summary_hk: 用 LLM 從 2020–2024 網絡險理賠中抽出 10 億美元以下的「小貓」事件，與 24 起巨災事件拼接檢驗冪律：數量級每增 1 檔，概率降 5–7 倍
entries.body:
这是一篇 **2026-09-07 上传的 arXiv 预印本**（`arXiv:2609.07486v1`，分类 **q-fin.RM**），作者 **Max Henderson、Anton Solomko、Henry Simmons、Nick Jin、Maximilian Kloucek、John Wingate**。它处理的正是**网络险最难的量化问题**：**上界损失怎么估**。摘要自述该领域「**缺乏稳健的定量方法来估计上界损失**」，而它手上只有一份**最近发布的、30 年间 24 起网络巨灾事件的数据集**——**24 个点要拟合尾部，样本量本身就不够**。

**它的解法（也是本词条最值得记的一条方法论）**：引入「**cyber kittens（网络小猫）**」——**金额低于 10 亿美元的事件**，与「cat（巨灾）」事件**唯一的区别只是量级**。这些"小猫"是**用 LLM 从 2020–2024 年网络险理赔数据中抽取**出来的；再以**受害人数（按理赔年度加权）作为经济损失的代理变量**，把"小猫"事件与已知巨灾事件**挂钩**，从而把可用样本从「24 起巨灾」扩展到「**一批小事件 + 24 起巨灾**」。结论：**"小猫"分布与巨灾数据集一致，幂律在统计上可信**——**事件规模每增加一个数量级，概率下降 5–7 倍**。外推结果：**比 2020–2024 最大巨灾事件再大 100 倍的事件，大约每 206 年发生一次，对应 1,000–2,500 亿美元损失**——摘要的评价是「**是灾难性的，但相对其他险种并不算异常**」。

对 RIAA：**网络险的尾部估计是池内的一条真实缺口**——池内已有 [[cyber-risk-classification]]（网络风险分类）、[[cybrisk]]、[[bayesibnrcyber]]、[[cyber-risk-platform]] 等条目，但都是**分类、平台或准备金侧**，**「上界损失/幂律外推」这一层此前没有**。这篇预印本的价值有两层：**① 具体数字可引用**——「**每个数量级 5–7 倍的衰减**」与「**1/206 年、1,000–2,500 亿美元**」是可以直接拿去讨论巨灾再保与资本充足性的量级结论；**② 方法可迁移**——**「当尾部样本太少时，用小事件把分布接起来」**这个思路，对所有**稀疏尾部**问题都成立（网络、恐怖、大灾、责任巨灾），而**「用 LLM 从理赔文本里批量抽取小事件」**这一步，恰好把 [[ins-actbench]]、[[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]] 一类「LLM × 精算」的工作接上了实务数据入口。可与池内的极值/尾部工具链对照使用：[[extremes]]、[[evd]]、[[fitheavytail]]、[[heavytails]]、[[logngpd]]、[[extremeloss]]、[[insurance-quantile]]，巨灾与再保侧见 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[perils-ied]]、[[reinsurance-networks]]、[[openquake-engine]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 这是**预印本**（arXiv，2026-09-07，**未声明同行评审状态**），本次仅核实到**摘要与元数据**；**② 基础数据集极小**——「30 年 24 起巨灾事件」意味着**幂律拟合建立在极少数点上**，摘要所称「统计上可信」**未在本次核实中复现**；**③ 关键假设强**——以**受害人数作为经济损失的代理变量**（且按理赔年度加权），这一步的合理性**未独立验证**，而它直接决定外推金额；**④** 「小猫事件由 LLM 从理赔数据抽取」意味着**抽取误差会传入尾部估计**，而摘要**未给出人工校验比例**；**⑤** 摘要与元数据中**未见代码或数据公开链接**（本次实测摘要内无 github/code 字样），**不可复现性风险需读者自判**；**⑥** 作者单位与资助信息本次未核实，**不做任何归属判断**。**核实说明**：arXiv API 元数据与完整摘要均实测（标题、`arXiv:2609.07486v1`、published/updated 2026-09-07T13:39:20Z、六位作者、分类 q-fin.RM）；**未获取全文、未复现任何统计结果、未找到代码或数据链接**。
entries.body_en:
This is an **arXiv preprint uploaded 2026-09-07** (`arXiv:2609.07486v1`, category **q-fin.RM**) by **Max Henderson, Anton Solomko, Henry Simmons, Nick Jin, Maximilian Kloucek and John Wingate**. It tackles **cyber insurance’s hardest quantitative problem: how to estimate upper-bound losses**. The abstract states the field "lacks robust quantitative approaches for estimating upper-bound losses", and what it has to work with is **a recent dataset of 24 cyber catastrophe events over 30 years** — **24 points is simply not enough to fit a tail**.

**Its solution (and the most valuable methodological point here)**: introduce "**cyber kittens**" — **events under $1B**, distinguished from cat events ($1B+) **only by magnitude**. These kittens are **extracted with an LLM from 2020–2024 cyber insurance claims data**; **victim count (weighted by claim year) then serves as a proxy for economic loss**, linking kitten-sized events to known cat events and expanding the usable sample from "24 cats" to "a set of small events plus 24 cats". The finding: the **kitten distribution is consistent with the cat dataset and a power law is statistically plausible** — **each order-of-magnitude increase in event size corresponds to a 5–7× drop in probability**. Extrapolating, **an event 100× the largest 2020–2024 cat event is expected roughly every 206 years, translating to $100–250B in losses** — in the abstract’s words, "catastrophic, but not extraordinary relative to other insurance lines".

For RIAA: **cyber tail estimation is a genuine gap in the corpus** — it holds [[cyber-risk-classification]] (cyber risk taxonomy), [[cybrisk]], [[bayesibnrcyber]] and [[cyber-risk-platform]], all of which sit on the **classification, platform or reserving** side, while **"upper-bound loss / power-law extrapolation" had no entry**. The preprint adds value twice over: **① citable magnitudes** — "**a 5–7× decay per order of magnitude**" and "**1-in-206 years, $100–250B**" are quantitative conclusions usable directly in discussions of catastrophe reinsurance and capital adequacy; **② a transferable method** — "**when tail samples are too few, join smaller events to the distribution**" applies to every **sparse-tail** problem (cyber, terrorism, catastrophe, liability catastrophe), and the step of **using an LLM to bulk-extract small events from claims text** connects the "LLM × actuarial" work of [[ins-actbench]] and [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]] to a practical data entry point. It can be read alongside the corpus’s extreme-value and tail tooling — [[extremes]], [[evd]], [[fitheavytail]], [[heavytails]], [[logngpd]], [[extremeloss]], [[insurance-quantile]] — and its catastrophe and reinsurance neighbours [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[perils-ied]], [[reinsurance-networks]] and [[openquake-engine]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this is a **preprint** (arXiv, 2026-09-07, **peer-review status not stated**) and only the **abstract and metadata** were verified here; **② the base dataset is tiny** — "24 cat events over 30 years" means **the power-law fit rests on very few points**, and the abstract’s claim of statistical plausibility **was not reproduced in this check**; **③ a strong key assumption** — using **victim count as a proxy for economic loss** (weighted by claim year) **was not independently validated**, yet it directly drives the extrapolated figures; **④** because kitten events are **LLM-extracted from claims data, extraction error propagates into the tail estimate**, and the abstract **gives no manual-verification rate**; **⑤** **no code or data link appears in the abstract or metadata** (the abstract was measured and contains no github/code string), so **readers must judge the reproducibility risk themselves**; **⑥** author affiliations and funding **were not verified here**, and **no attribution claim is made**. **Verification note**: the arXiv API metadata and the full abstract were measured (title, `arXiv:2609.07486v1`, published/updated 2026-09-07T13:39:20Z, six authors, category q-fin.RM); **the full text was not obtained, no statistical result was reproduced, and no code or data link was found**.

這是一篇 **2026-09-07 上傳的 arXiv 預印本**（`arXiv:2609.07486v1`，分類 **q-fin.RM**），作者 **Max Henderson、Anton Solomko、Henry Simmons、Nick Jin、Maximilian Kloucek、John Wingate**。它處理的正是**網絡險最難的量化問題：上界損失怎麼估**。摘要自述該領域「**缺乏穩健的定量方法來估計上界損失**」，而手上只有一份**30 年間 24 起網絡巨災事件的數據集**——**24 個點要擬合尾部，樣本量本身就不夠**。

**它的解法**：引入「**cyber kittens（網絡小貓）**」——**金額低於 10 億美元的事件**，與巨災事件**唯一區別只是量級**；這些「小貓」是**用 LLM 從 2020–2024 年網絡險理賠數據中抽取**出來；再以**受害人數（按理賠年度加權）作為經濟損失的代理變量**，把「小貓」與已知巨災事件**掛鉤**，把可用樣本從「24 起巨災」擴展為「**一批小事件 + 24 起巨災**」。結論：**冪律在統計上可信**——**事件規模每增加一個數量級，概率下降 5–7 倍**；外推：**比 2020–2024 最大巨災再大 100 倍的事件約每 206 年一次，對應 1,000–2,500 億美元損失**——摘要評價為「**是災難性的，但相對其他險種並不算異常**」。

對 RIAA：**網絡險尾部估計是池內真實缺口**——池內 [[cyber-risk-classification]]、[[cybrisk]]、[[bayesibnrcyber]]、[[cyber-risk-platform]] 都在**分類、平台或準備金側**，**「上界損失/冪律外推」此前沒有**。價值兩層：**① 具體數字可引用**（每個數量級 5–7 倍衰減、1/206 年、1,000–2,500 億美元）；**② 方法可遷移**——**「尾部樣本太少時，用小事件把分布接起來」**，且**「用 LLM 從理賠文本批量抽取小事件」**把「LLM × 精算」（[[ins-actbench]]、[[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]）接上實務數據入口。可與 [[extremes]]、[[evd]]、[[fitheavytail]]、[[heavytails]]、[[logngpd]]、[[extremeloss]]、[[insurance-quantile]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[reinsurance-networks]] 對照。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 這是**預印本**，本次僅核實**摘要與元數據**；**② 基礎數據集極小**（24 起巨災事件），冪律擬合建立在極少數點上，**「統計上可信」未複現**；**③ 關鍵假設強**——以**受害人數作經濟損失代理**，其合理性**未獨立驗證**，卻直接決定外推金額；**④** 「小貓由 LLM 抽取」意味**抽取誤差會傳入尾部估計**，摘要**未給人工校驗比例**；**⑤** 摘要與元數據中**未見代碼或數據鏈接**；**⑥** 作者單位與資助**未核實**，**不作任何歸屬判斷**。**核實說明**：arXiv API 元數據與完整摘要均實測；**未獲取全文、未複現任何統計結果、未找到代碼或數據鏈接**。

entries.body:
**APRA（澳大利亚审慎监管局）的 superannuation（养老金）统计族**——这是**澳洲强制性养老金体系**的官方季度数据源，也是本会话按**解冻窗口**扫到并收录的最后一条。可核实信息：**发布时间实测均取自 APRA 官方 RSS**（`apra.gov.au/rss.xml`，HTTP 200、`application/rss+xml`、约 200KB），其中**三条发布于 Wed, 09 Sep 2026**（**正好落在解冻窗口内**）、一条为 Mon, 31 Aug 2026；**四个发布页均 HTTP 200 实测**（每页约 1MB）。

**本次逐页抓取了真实的数据文件链接（不是只读标题）**：

| 发布 | 数据文件（实测链接，节选） |
|---|---|
| **Quarterly Superannuation Product Statistics（QSPS，2026-09-09）** | `QSPS June 2026 CSV files – Table 1a-1b.zip`、`… Table 2-11.zip`、`Quarterly Superannuation Product Publication – Performance – June 2026.xlsx`、`… Product Structure – June 2026.xlsx`、**`Historical SAA – June 2026.csv`（战略资产配置）**、**`Historical performance – June 2026.csv`**、**`Default Insurance Design.zip`** ——共 **7 个文件**，页面自述「**for ease of data usage the QSPS is split into three files**」 |
| **Quarterly Fund-Level Statistics（2026-09-09）** | `Quarterly Superannuation Fund Statistics June 2026.xlsx`、**`Quarterly fund-level statistics database version June 2026.zip`** |
| **Quarterly Superannuation Industry Publication（2026-09-09）** | **`Key Metrics Dataset – Asset Allocation.csv`**、**`– Industry Composition.csv`**、**`– Membership.csv`**、`Quarterly Superannuation Industry Publication – June 2026.xlsx` |
| **Quarterly superannuation statistics（2026-08-31）** | `Quarterly MySuper statistics backseries September 2013 to June 2020.xlsx`、`Quarterly MySuper statistics from September 2020 to June 2026.xlsx`、**`Quarterly superannuation performance statistics – December 2004 to June 2026.xlsx`（20+ 年序列）** |

页面正文中实测出现的关键词包括 **MySuper、RSE、fee**（费率）等，即覆盖**产品结构、业绩、费率、资产配置、行业构成与成员数**等维度。

对 RIAA：**池内在 superannuation 这一块此前是 0 条**（实测检索 `superannuation`、`super`、`fund-level`、`pension fund` 均无命中）——而澳洲养老金是**全球规模最大的强制性养老金体系之一**，这份数据的三层粒度恰好对应三类研究：**① 基金级（fund-level）**——按基金看资产、成员、收益与费率，适合**费率与业绩关系、规模效应、治理比较**一类题目（可直接对照香港的 [[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[mpfa]] 与强制性公积金考试 [[mpfe]]）；**② 产品级（product-level）**——含**战略资产配置（SAA）与历史业绩**，适合**资产配置与长期回报分析**；**③ 行业级**——资产配置/行业构成/成员数的「Key Metrics」三个 CSV，适合市场结构描述。

⭐ **其中一条对精算最直接**：QSPS 里的 **`Default Insurance Design`（默认保险设计）** 数据集——澳洲养老金**在退休储蓄内嵌默认的人寿与 TPD（全残）团体保险**，也就是说**保险嵌在养老金里**，这既是**团险定价与经验分析**的真实场景，也是**「养老金 + 保险」制度设计**的比较样本；对本 wiki 已有的 [[lifeinsurer]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[lifepack]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]] 与 [[retirement-planning]] 正好补上**澳洲官方数据**这一侧。**② 与既有 APRA 条目的关系**：[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 覆盖**一般险/寿险/私康险**，[[apra-mcp]] 是**让 agent 用自然语言查 APRA 数据**的 MCP，[[data-gov-au]] 是**开放数据门户**（含 APRA 逐机构季度统计）——本条目补的是**养老金这一条独立业务线**（APRA 的四个监管板块之一），四者合起来才完整。跨市场对照可看 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[osfi-canada-data]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[bnm-insurance-takaful]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**发布页 HTTP 200、发布时间（RSS `pubDate`）与数据文件链接（href）**，**但未下载、未打开任何 XLSX/CSV/ZIP 文件**，因此**不能确认其内部字段与数据质量**；**②** 页面体积大（约 1MB）且含前端脚本，本次文本提取基于服务端 HTML，**个别正文段落可能未完全捕获**；**③** 「默认保险设计」等文件的**具体字段未核实**，其存在仅由链接与文件名确认；**④** 养老金与保险**不是同一业务线**——本条目收录理由是**官方权威数据 + 基金级粒度 + 内嵌团险**这三点与精算/保险研究直接相关，**不主张它属于保险监管统计**；**⑤** APRA 按季发布，本次实测的最新季度为 **June 2026**。**核实说明**：APRA RSS（HTTP 200）、四个发布页（各 HTTP 200）、页面内数据文件链接与正文关键词均实测；**未下载或解析任何数据文件**。
entries.body_en:
**APRA’s superannuation statistics family** — the official quarterly data source for **Australia’s compulsory pension system**, and the last entry harvested by this session’s **thaw-window** sweep. Verifiable details: publication dates were read from **APRA’s official RSS feed** (`apra.gov.au/rss.xml`, HTTP 200, `application/rss+xml`, ~200KB), of which **three were published Wed, 09 Sep 2026** (**inside the thaw window**) and one on Mon, 31 Aug 2026; **all four publication pages returned HTTP 200** (each ~1MB).

**Real data-file links were extracted page by page here (not merely titles)**:

| Publication | Data files (measured links, excerpt) |
|---|---|
| **Quarterly Superannuation Product Statistics (QSPS, 2026-09-09)** | `QSPS June 2026 CSV files – Table 1a-1b.zip`, `… Table 2-11.zip`, `Quarterly Superannuation Product Publication – Performance – June 2026.xlsx`, `… Product Structure – June 2026.xlsx`, **`Historical SAA – June 2026.csv` (strategic asset allocation)**, **`Historical performance – June 2026.csv`**, **`Default Insurance Design.zip`** — **7 files**; the page states "**for ease of data usage the QSPS is split into three files**" |
| **Quarterly Fund-Level Statistics (2026-09-09)** | `Quarterly Superannuation Fund Statistics June 2026.xlsx`, **`Quarterly fund-level statistics database version June 2026.zip`** |
| **Quarterly Superannuation Industry Publication (2026-09-09)** | **`Key Metrics Dataset – Asset Allocation.csv`**, **`– Industry Composition.csv`**, **`– Membership.csv`**, `Quarterly Superannuation Industry Publication – June 2026.xlsx` |
| **Quarterly superannuation statistics (2026-08-31)** | `Quarterly MySuper statistics backseries September 2013 to June 2020.xlsx`, `Quarterly MySuper statistics from September 2020 to June 2026.xlsx`, **`Quarterly superannuation performance statistics – December 2004 to June 2026.xlsx` (20+ year series)** |

Keywords measured in the page text include **MySuper, RSE and fee**, i.e. the coverage spans **product structure, performance, fees, asset allocation, industry composition and membership**.

For RIAA: **the corpus previously had zero superannuation entries** (searches for `superannuation`, `super`, `fund-level` and `pension fund` all returned nothing) — and Australian superannuation is **one of the largest compulsory pension systems in the world**. Its three levels of granularity map onto three kinds of research: **① fund-level** — assets, members, returns and fees per fund, suited to **fee-versus-performance, scale effects and governance comparisons** (readily compared with Hong Kong’s [[mpf-fund-platform]], [[mpfa]] and the MPF exam [[mpfe]]); **② product-level** — including **strategic asset allocation (SAA) and historical performance**, suited to **asset allocation and long-horizon return analysis**; **③ industry-level** — the three Key Metrics CSVs on asset allocation, industry composition and membership, suited to market-structure description.

⭐ **One dataset is directly actuarial**: the **`Default Insurance Design`** dataset in QSPS — Australian superannuation funds **embed default group life and TPD (total and permanent disability) insurance inside retirement savings**, so **insurance sits inside the pension**. That is both a real setting for **group insurance pricing and experience analysis** and a comparative sample of **"pension plus insurance" scheme design**; it complements the corpus’s [[lifeinsurer]], [[open-life-au]], [[lifepack]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]] and [[retirement-planning]] with an **Australian official data** side. **② Relationship to existing APRA entries**: [[apra-insurance-statistics]] covers **general, life and private health insurance**; [[apra-mcp]] is the MCP that lets agents query APRA data in natural language; [[data-gov-au]] is the **open-data portal** (including APRA institution-level quarterly statistics). This entry adds **superannuation as a separate line of business** (one of APRA’s four supervised industries) — all four together complete the picture. Cross-market comparisons: [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[oecd-insurance-data]], [[naic-financial-data-repository]], [[tii-taiwan-insurance]], [[japan-life-insurance-statistics]], [[fss-korea-insurance]], [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[osfi-canada-data]], [[ojk-insurance-statistics]], [[bnm-insurance-takaful]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified the **publication pages (HTTP 200), their publication dates (RSS `pubDate`) and the data-file links (hrefs)** — **no XLSX/CSV/ZIP file was downloaded or opened**, so **the internal fields and data quality cannot be confirmed**; **②** the pages are large (~1MB) and script-laden, and the text extraction here was from server-rendered HTML, so **some body text may not have been captured**; **③** the **specific fields** of files such as "Default Insurance Design" **were not verified** — their existence rests on links and file names only; **④** superannuation and insurance are **not the same line of business** — the grounds for inclusion here are **authoritative official data, fund-level granularity and embedded group insurance** being directly relevant to actuarial and insurance research, and **no claim is made that this is insurance regulatory statistics**; **⑤** APRA publishes quarterly and the latest quarter measured here is **June 2026**. **Verification note**: the APRA RSS feed (HTTP 200), all four publication pages (HTTP 200 each), and the in-page data-file links and body keywords were measured; **no data file was downloaded or parsed**.

**APRA（澳洲審慎監管局）的 superannuation（養老金）統計族**——**澳洲強制性養老金體系**的官方季度數據源，也是本會話按**解凍窗口**掃到並收錄的最後一條。可核實資訊：發布時間**實測取自 APRA 官方 RSS**（`apra.gov.au/rss.xml`，HTTP 200、`application/rss+xml`、約 200KB），其中**三條發布於 Wed, 09 Sep 2026**（**正好落在解凍窗口內**）、一條為 Mon, 31 Aug 2026；**四個發布頁均 HTTP 200 實測**（每頁約 1MB）。

**本次逐頁抓取了真實的數據文件鏈接**：

| 發布 | 數據文件（實測鏈接，節選） |
|---|---|
| **QSPS 產品級統計（2026-09-09）** | `QSPS June 2026 CSV files – Table 1a-1b.zip`、`… Table 2-11.zip`、`… Publications – Performance – June 2026.xlsx`、`… Product Structure – June 2026.xlsx`、**`Historical SAA – June 2026.csv`（戰略資產配置）**、**`Historical performance – June 2026.csv`**、**`Default Insurance Design.zip`**（共 **7 個文件**） |
| **基金級統計（2026-09-09）** | `Quarterly Superannuation Fund Statistics June 2026.xlsx`、**`Quarterly fund-level statistics database version June 2026.zip`** |
| **行業級發布（2026-09-09）** | **`Key Metrics Dataset – Asset Allocation.csv`**、**`– Industry Composition.csv`**、**`– Membership.csv`**、`… Industry Publication – June 2026.xlsx` |
| **季度養老金統計（2026-08-31）** | MySuper 統計回溯（2013-09 至 2020-06）、MySuper 統計（2020-09 至 2026-06）、**`Quarterly superannuation performance statistics – December 2004 to June 2026.xlsx`（20+ 年序列）** |

頁面正文實測出現關鍵詞 **MySuper、RSE、fee**，即覆蓋**產品結構、業績、費率、資產配置、行業構成與成員數**。

對 RIAA：**池內 superannuation 此前是 0 條**——而澳洲養老金是**全球規模最大的強制性養老金體系之一**。三層粒度對應三類研究：**基金級**（按基金看資產/成員/收益/費率，適合費率與業績、規模效應、治理比較，可對照香港 [[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[mpfa]]、[[mpfe]]）；**產品級**（含**戰略資產配置 SAA 與歷史業績**）；**行業級**（資產配置/行業構成/成員數三個 CSV）。

⭐ **其中一條對精算最直接**：QSPS 中的 **`Default Insurance Design`（默認保險設計）** 數據集——澳洲養老金**在退休儲蓄內嵌默認的人壽與 TPD 團體保險**，**保險嵌在養老金裡**，是**團險定價與經驗分析**的真實場景，也是「**養老金 + 保險**」制度設計的比較樣本；補上本 wiki 已有 [[lifeinsurer]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[lifepack]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[retirement-planning]] 的**澳洲官方數據**一側。**與既有 APRA 條目的關係**：[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 覆蓋**一般險/壽險/私康險**，[[apra-mcp]] 是**查 APRA 數據的 MCP**，[[data-gov-au]] 是**開放數據門戶**——本條目補的是**養老金這一條獨立業務線**。跨市場對照見 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[osfi-canada-data]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[bnm-insurance-takaful]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**發布頁 HTTP 200、發布時間（RSS pubDate）與數據文件鏈接**，**但未下載、未打開任何 XLSX/CSV/ZIP**，故**無法確認其內部欄位與數據質量**；**②** 頁面體積大且含前端腳本，文本提取基於服務端 HTML，**個別正文可能未完全捕獲**；**③** 「默認保險設計」等文件的**具體欄位未核實**；**④** 養老金與保險**不是同一業務線**——收錄理由是**官方權威數據 + 基金級粒度 + 內嵌團險**三點與精算/保險研究直接相關；**⑤** APRA 按季發布，本次實測最新季度為 **June 2026**。**核實說明**：APRA RSS、四個發布頁、頁內數據文件鏈接與正文關鍵詞均實測；**未下載或解析任何數據文件**。

entries.body:
**SEDDK**（Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu，**土耳其保险与私人养老金监管与监督局**）是**土耳其的保险与私人养老金监管机构**。本条目是本轮**市场覆盖轴**的产物：实测检索发现本 wiki 池内**与土耳其相关的条目为 0**，而土耳其有几个对本领域特别相关的制度特征——**强制地震险（DASK）**、**私人养老金体系 BES**、以及**参与制（伊斯兰）保险**。

可核实信息（**均为本次 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 46KB；**报告中心 `/tr/raporlar`** 23KB，下设三类：**① 机构活动报告**（`/tr/raporlar/kurum-faaliyet`）；**② `Sigortacılık ve BES Faaliyet Raporları`（保险与 BES 活动报告）** 73KB——页面内实测挂有 **「Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Sektörü Gelişmeler ve Temel Göstergeler Raporu」（保险与私人养老金行业发展与关键指标报告）**，含 **2025 年 1–12 月**、**2025 年 1–6 月**、**2024 年 1–12 月** 等期次，以及 **2021 / 2020 年度保险与 BES 活动报告**（2019 年报告按章分册）；**③ `Sigorta, Reasürans ve Emeklilik Şirketlerinin Mali Tabloları`（保险、再保与养老金公司财务报表）** 28KB；另有**公司名录页** `/tr/kuruluslar/sigorta-reasurans-ve-bes-sirketleri` 78KB。页面中还实测到**官方公报（Resmî Gazete）2026-08-21 关于强制地震险一般条款修订**的链接、**参与制保险与私人养老金**的 2026 年第 26 号通函，以及**私人健康险（ÖSS）新阶段指南 PDF**。

对 RIAA：**① 补的是「市场覆盖」而非「窗口」**——池内既有监管数据源覆盖美国、欧盟、英国、澳洲、日本、韩国、台湾、香港、中国内地、印度、新加坡、马来西亚、加拿大、菲律宾、印尼等（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[osfi-canada-data]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]），**土耳其此前完全缺席**；SEDDK 的「行业发展与关键指标报告」+「公司财务报表」正好是**市场概览**与**公司层面**两个常用层次。**② 制度上的独特价值**——土耳其的**强制地震险（DASK）**是全球**巨灾强制保险**的重要案例（与新西兰 EQC、日本地震保险并列），而**私人养老金 BES** 是**新兴市场自愿性养老储蓄**的样本；两者都可与池内 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[opendrr-riskprofiler]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 对照。**③ 区域监管框架对照**——可与 [[iais-icp]]（IAIS 核心原则）、[[insurance-europe]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]] 一起用于**监管体系比较**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 内容以土耳其语为主**（本次未发现并核实英文版），**语言门槛真实存在**；**②** 本次核实到**站点页面结构与 PDF 链接**（发布会话页、报告文件链接均实测），**但未打开任何 PDF**，因此**不能确认报告内部口径与数据质量**；**③** 部分文件由 `UploadContent`/`upload` 路径提供，**链接稳定性未经长期验证**；**④** 本条目仅主张「该监管机构的公开报告入口可用」，**不主张其数据可直接用于定价或合规判断**。**核实说明**：首页、报告中心、两类报告页、公司名录页均 HTTP 200 实测（46KB / 23KB / 73KB / 28KB / 78KB），并抓取页面内真实 PDF 链接与标题、公报链接；**未下载或打开任何 PDF**。
entries.body_en:
**SEDDK** (Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu — **Turkey’s Insurance and Private Pension Regulation and Supervision Agency**) is **the Turkish regulator for insurance and private pensions**. This entry comes from this round’s **market-coverage axis**: a measured search showed **zero Turkey-related entries** in the corpus, while Turkey has several institutionally distinctive features for this field — **compulsory earthquake insurance (DASK)**, the **private pension system BES**, and **participation (Islamic) insurance**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200 in this check**): the homepage is 46KB; the **reports hub `/tr/raporlar`** is 23KB with three families: **① institutional activity reports** (`/tr/raporlar/kurum-faaliyet`); **② `Sigortacılık ve BES Faaliyet Raporları` (insurance and BES activity reports)** at 73KB, whose page carries the **"Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Sektörü Gelişmeler ve Temel Göstergeler Raporu" (Insurance and Private Pension Sector Developments and Key Indicators Report)** covering **Jan–Dec 2025**, **Jan–Jun 2025** and **Jan–Dec 2024** among other periods, plus **2021 and 2020 annual insurance and BES activity reports** (2019 reports split into sections); **③ `Sigorta, Reasürans ve Emeklilik Şirketlerinin Mali Tabloları` (financial statements of insurance, reinsurance and pension companies)** at 28KB; and a **company register** page `/tr/kuruluslar/sigorta-reasurans-ve-bes-sirketleri` at 78KB. The pages also contain a measured link to the **Official Gazette (Resmî Gazete) amendment of 2026-08-21 to the compulsory earthquake insurance general conditions**, a 2026 circular on **participation insurance and private pensions**, and a **private health insurance (ÖSS) new-period guide PDF**.

For RIAA: **① this fills a market gap rather than a time-window one** — the corpus’s regulator data sources cover the US, EU, UK, Australia, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, mainland China, India, Singapore, Malaysia, Canada, the Philippines and Indonesia ([[naic-financial-data-repository]], [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[japan-life-insurance-statistics]], [[fss-korea-insurance]], [[tii-taiwan-insurance]], [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[osfi-canada-data]], [[ojk-insurance-statistics]], [[philippines-insurance-commission]]), but **Turkey was entirely absent**; SEDDK’s "sector developments and key indicators" reports plus company financial statements supply exactly the two most-used levels — **market overview** and **company-level**. **② Institutional value** — Turkey’s **compulsory earthquake insurance (DASK)** is a major global case of **compulsory catastrophe insurance** (alongside New Zealand’s EQC and Japan’s earthquake scheme), and the **BES private pension system** is a sample of **voluntary retirement saving in an emerging market**; both can be read against [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[openquake-engine]], [[gem-global-exposure-model]], [[canada-seismic-risk-model]], [[opendrr-riskprofiler]], [[retirement-planning]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]] and [[apra-superannuation-statistics]]. **③ Regulatory comparison** — pair it with [[iais-icp]] (IAIS core principles), [[insurance-europe]] and [[oecd-insurance-data]] for cross-jurisdiction work.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the content is predominantly in Turkish** (no English version was found or verified here), so **a real language barrier exists**; **②** this check verified the **site structure and PDF links** (publication pages and report file links were measured) **but opened no PDF**, so **the reports’ internal definitions and data quality cannot be confirmed**; **③** some files are served from `UploadContent`/`upload` paths, so **long-term link stability was not verified**; **④** this entry claims only that **the regulator’s public report entry point works**, and **does not claim its data can be used directly for pricing or compliance decisions**. **Verification note**: the homepage, reports hub, both report pages and the company register page were all measured at HTTP 200 (46KB / 23KB / 73KB / 28KB / 78KB), with real in-page PDF links and titles plus the gazette link extracted; **no PDF was downloaded or opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**SEDDK**（Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu，**土耳其保險與私人養老金監管與監督局**）是**土耳其的保險與私人養老金監管機構**。本條目是本輪**市場覆蓋軸**的產物：實測檢索顯示本 wiki 池內**土耳其相關條目為 0**，而土耳其有幾個對本領域特別相關的制度特徵——**強制地震險（DASK）**、**私人養老金體系 BES**、以及**參與制（伊斯蘭）保險**。

可核實資訊（**均為本次 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 46KB；**報告中心 `/tr/raporlar`** 23KB，下設三類：**① 機構活動報告**；**② 保險與 BES 活動報告頁** 73KB——頁面內實測掛有**「保險與私人養老金行業發展與關鍵指標報告」**，含 **2025 年 1–12 月**、**2025 年 1–6 月**、**2024 年 1–12 月**，以及 **2021 / 2020 年度保險與 BES 活動報告**；**③ 保險、再保與養老金公司財務報表頁** 28KB；另有**公司名錄頁** 78KB。頁面中還實測到**官方公報 2026-08-21 關於強制地震險一般條款修訂**的鏈接、**參與制保險與私人養老金**的 2026 年第 26 號通函。

對 RIAA：**① 補的是「市場覆蓋」而非「時間窗」**——池內監管數據源覆蓋美、歐、英、澳、日、韓、台、港、內地、印度、新加坡、馬來西亞、加拿大、菲律賓、印尼等（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[osfi-canada-data]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]），**土耳其此前完全缺席**。**② 制度價值**——**強制地震險 DASK** 是全球**巨災強制保險**的重要案例，**BES** 是新興市場自願性養老儲蓄樣本，可與 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 對照。**③** 可與 [[iais-icp]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]] 一起用於監管體系比較。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 內容以土耳其語為主**（本次未發現並核實英文版）；**②** 本次核實到**站點結構與 PDF 鏈接**，**但未打開任何 PDF**，故**不能確認報告內部口徑與數據質量**；**③** 部分文件由 `UploadContent`/`upload` 路徑提供，**鏈接穩定性未經長期驗證**；**④** 本條目僅主張**該監管機構的公開報告入口可用**，**不主張其數據可直接用於定價或合規判斷**。**核實說明**：首頁、報告中心、兩類報告頁、公司名錄頁均 HTTP 200 實測，並抓取頁內真實 PDF 鏈接與標題；**未下載或打開任何 PDF**。

entries.body:
**ASSA（Actuarial Society of South Africa，南非精算师协会）** 是**南非的精算专业团体**，也是本轮市场覆盖轴的一部分——实测池内**南非相关条目为 0**。可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 122KB；**资格路径页 `/qualification-roadmap/`** 150KB，页内实测到**科目与 IFoA 代码的对应关系**，例如 **A111: Actuarial Statistics ↔ IFoA Subject Code CS1**、**A112: Business Economics ↔ IFoA Subject Code CB2**——即 **ASSA 的考试与 IFoA（英国精算师协会）联考/互认**（首页亦列有 "IFoA Coordinated Exams" 与 "ASSA Open Book Exams (F200)" 入口）；**历年考卷 `/document-category/past-paper/`** 104KB；**指引准则与专业标准 `/document-category/guidance-notes/`** 104KB；**专业资源与操守 `/professional-resources-and-conduct/`** 143KB（含执业证书 Practising Certificates、终身学习等）；**公益研究 `/public-benefits-research/`** 207KB；成绩与合格者另设门户 `results.actuarialsociety.org.za`。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「南非」这一整块空白，并且它是一个真实可用的资格路径**——对考虑在英联邦体系内发展、或研究**非洲保险与养老金市场**的学生，ASSA 是入口；**② 与 IFoA 的对应关系有具体的教学价值**：池内已有 [[ifoa]]、[[ifoa-studying]]、[[ifoa-formulae-tables]]（IFoA 公式与表），**ASSA 把「同一门考试在南非叫什么、对应 IFoA 哪一科」写清楚了**，这对**跨体系备考与免考评估**是直接可用的信息；**③ 公开资源可直接用**——历年考卷、指引准则、公益研究三类都是开放页面，可与池内 [[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[open-exam-prep]]、[[soa-education]]、[[cas-syllabus]]、[[cii]]、[[anziif]]、[[loma]]、[[actuarial-open-book]] 并列使用。**④ 与其他专业团体的对照**——[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]、[[china-actuarial-association]]、[[peak-exam-centre]]、[[mpfe]]、[[ashk-examination]]、[[insurance-exam-bank-cn]] 构成「**各市场的资格与考试体系**」这一族，ASSA 在此之前是缺的。**⑤ 数据侧关联**——ASSA 所处的南非市场另有监管侧数据（见 [[fsca]]），而人口/死亡率方法论侧可对照 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[mortsoa]]、[[mortalitytables]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到的是**页面结构与资格路径正文**（含 IFoA 科目代码对应的实测文本），**未逐份打开考卷、指引准则与研究文档**；**②** 公开的考卷与准则**主要面向南非体系**，对香港/内地学生的直接用途是**跨体系对照**而非替代本地路径；**③** 本站为**专业团体站点**，**不含保险市场统计数据**（数据侧请看同一市场的 [[fsca]]）；**④** 会员资格、费用与免考政策**以官方最新公告为准**，本词条不转述具体条款。**核实说明**：首页（122KB）、资格路径（150KB）、历年考卷（104KB）、指引准则（104KB）、专业资源（143KB）、公益研究（207KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未下载或打开个别文档**。
entries.body_en:
**ASSA (Actuarial Society of South Africa)** is **South Africa’s actuarial professional body**, and part of this round’s market-coverage axis — a measured search found **zero South Africa-related entries** in the corpus. Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): homepage 122KB; the **qualification roadmap page `/qualification-roadmap/`** is 150KB and its text contains **subject-to-IFoA-code mappings**, for example **A111: Actuarial Statistics ↔ IFoA Subject Code CS1** and **A112: Business Economics ↔ IFoA Subject Code CB2** — i.e. **ASSA’s examinations are coordinated with the IFoA** (the homepage also lists "IFoA Coordinated Exams" and "ASSA Open Book Exams (F200)"); **past exam papers `/document-category/past-paper/`** 104KB; **guidance notes and professional standards `/document-category/guidance-notes/`** 104KB; **professional resources and conduct `/professional-resources-and-conduct/`** 143KB (including practising certificates and lifelong learning); **public-benefit research `/public-benefits-research/`** 207KB; results and qualifiers live on a separate portal, `results.actuarialsociety.org.za`.

For RIAA: **① it fills an entire missing market (South Africa) with something genuinely usable — a qualification pathway** — so for students considering a Commonwealth actuarial track or researching **African insurance and pension markets**, ASSA is the entry point; **② the IFoA mapping has concrete teaching value**: the corpus already holds [[ifoa]], [[ifoa-studying]] and [[ifoa-formulae-tables]] (IFoA formulae and tables), and **ASSA spells out what the same examination is called in South Africa and which IFoA subject it corresponds to**, which is directly usable for **cross-system study planning and exemption assessment**; **③ open resources are usable as-is** — past papers, guidance notes and public-benefit research are all open pages, sitting alongside [[actuarial-exam-database]], [[open-exam-prep]], [[soa-education]], [[cas-syllabus]], [[cii]], [[anziif]], [[loma]] and [[actuarial-open-book]]. **④ Comparison with other bodies** — [[actuaries-institute]], [[singapore-actuarial-society]], [[china-actuarial-association]], [[peak-exam-centre]], [[mpfe]], [[ashk-examination]] and [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]] form the "**qualification and examination systems by market**" family, in which ASSA was previously missing. **⑤ Data-side links** — South Africa’s regulatory data is covered by [[fsca]], while population/mortality methodology can be read against [[human-mortality-db]], [[mortsoa]], [[mortalitytables]] and [[cmi-mortality-projections]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check reached the **page structures and the roadmap body text** (including the measured IFoA subject-code mappings) and **did not open individual papers, guidance notes or research documents**; **②** the public papers and standards **serve the South African system**, so for Hong Kong or mainland students their direct use is **cross-system comparison**, not a substitute for a local pathway; **③** this is a **professional body site and carries no insurance market statistics** (for data see [[fsca]] in the same market); **④** membership, fees and exemption policy **are governed by the latest official notices**, and this entry does not restate specific terms. **Verification note**: the homepage (122KB), qualification roadmap (150KB), past papers (104KB), guidance notes (104KB), professional resources (143KB) and public-benefit research (207KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no individual document was downloaded or opened**.

**ASSA（Actuarial Society of South Africa，南非精算師協會）** 是**南非的精算專業團體**，也是本輪市場覆蓋軸的一部分——實測池內**南非相關條目為 0**。可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 122KB；**資格路徑頁** 150KB，頁內實測到**科目與 IFoA 代碼的對應**（**A111: Actuarial Statistics ↔ IFoA CS1**、**A112: Business Economics ↔ IFoA CB2**）——即 **ASSA 的考試與 IFoA 聯考/互認**（首頁亦列有 "IFoA Coordinated Exams"）；**歷年考卷頁** 104KB；**指引準則頁** 104KB；**專業資源與操守頁** 143KB；**公益研究頁** 207KB；成績與合格者另設門戶 `results.actuarialsociety.org.za`。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「南非」這一整塊空白，並且是一個真實可用的資格路徑**；**② 與 IFoA 的對應關係有具體教學價值**——池內已有 [[ifoa]]、[[ifoa-studying]]、[[ifoa-formulae-tables]]，而 ASSA 把「同一門考試在南非叫什麼、對應 IFoA 哪一科」寫清楚，對**跨體系備考與免考評估**直接可用；**③ 公開資源可直接用**（歷年考卷、指引準則、公益研究），可與 [[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[open-exam-prep]]、[[soa-education]]、[[cas-syllabus]]、[[cii]]、[[anziif]]、[[loma]]、[[actuarial-open-book]] 並列；**④ 與其他專業團體對照**——[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]、[[china-actuarial-association]]、[[peak-exam-centre]]、[[mpfe]]、[[ashk-examination]]、[[insurance-exam-bank-cn]] 構成「**各市場資格與考試體系**」一族，ASSA 此前缺失；**⑤ 數據側**見同市場的 [[fsca]]，方法論側可對照 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[mortsoa]]、[[mortalitytables]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面結構與資格路徑正文**，**未逐份打開考卷、指引準則與研究文檔**；**②** 公開考卷與準則**主要面向南非體系**，對港/內地學生的直接用途是**跨體系對照**；**③** 本站為**專業團體站點，不含保險市場統計**（數據側見 [[fsca]]）；**④** 會員資格、費用與免考政策**以官方最新公告為準**。**核實說明**：首頁、資格路徑、歷年考卷、指引準則、專業資源、公益研究頁均 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載或打開個別文檔**。

entries.body:
**FSCA（Financial Sector Conduct Authority，南非金融部门行为监管局）** 是**南非的金融市场行为监管机构**，也是本轮「南非」这一市场缺口的数据侧条目。可核实信息（HTTP 200 实测）：**首页 1.7MB**；**研究页 `/Researcher` 310KB**（纯文本约 66KB），其正文实测明确写出其法定定位——**FSCA「监管并监督南非金融机构的市场行为」，其任务是「提升并支持金融体系的效率与诚信、并保护金融消费者」，依据《金融部门监管法》（Financial Sector Regulation Act, No. 9 of 2017）第 57 条**。站点另实测可见 **年报入口 `/Annual-Reports`**，以及**研究与数据文档**（页面以 `/_api/cr3ad_researchanddatadocses(...)` 形式的文档接口链接呈现），首页还挂有**《SA Retail Banking Diagnostic Report》（南非零售银行诊断报告）**、**《Financial Markets Review》**、以及**首届政府间金融科技工作组（Intergovernmental FinTech Working Group）报告**等。

对 RIAA：**① 补上南非监管侧数据入口**——池内监管机构条目已覆盖美国（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]）、欧盟（[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]）、澳洲（[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-mcp]]）、加拿大（[[osfi-canada-data]]、[[osfi-ai-risk-controls]]）、印度（[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]]）、韩国（[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[korea-ai-accountability]]）、新加坡（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]）、印尼（[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]）、马来西亚（[[bnm-insurance-takaful]]）等，**南非此前为 0**；**② 定位差异值得注意**——FSCA 管的是**市场行为（conduct）**，而**审慎监管**已归南非央行（SARB）下设的 Prudential Authority（本次实测 `resbank.co.za` 相关路径返回 **404**，即该入口未按该路径访问到，故本词条只写 FSCA 侧）；**「审慎 vs 行为」的双峰监管结构**本身就是可与 [[iais-icp]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]] 对照的制度案例；**③** 对做**消费者保护、市场行为、金融科技监管**方向的学生，FSCA 的研究文档与金融科技工作组报告是新兴市场的直接材料；与 [[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[frai]] 一类治理框架条目可并读；**④** 与同市场的 [[assa]]（专业团体）配对，构成「**南非：专业团体 + 监管机构**」两条腿。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与研究页正文**（含第 57 条法定任务原文）**及年报入口的存在**，**但未打开任何研究文档或年报**；**②** 研究文档链接以 `/_api/cr3ad_...` 形式出现，**属动态文档接口，深链稳定性未经长期验证**；**③** 我在探测中猜测的两个路径（`/Research-and-Data`、`/Pages/Research-and-Data.aspx`）**实测均 404**，故**不给出具体栏目路径**，只给可核实的研究页与年报入口；**④** 本站**不含保险市场统计数据集**（若需南非保险数据，需另找 Prudential Authority 或行业机构，本次未找到可核实入口，如实记录）。**核实说明**：首页（1.7MB）、`/Researcher`（310KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取正文；`/Annual-Reports` 与若干 `/_api/...` 文档链接在首页实测可见；**两个猜测路径实测 404 并如实记录**；**未打开任何文档**。
entries.body_en:
**FSCA (Financial Sector Conduct Authority)** is **South Africa’s financial-market conduct regulator**, and the data-side entry for this round’s South Africa market gap. Verifiable details (measured HTTP 200): **homepage 1.7MB**; the **research page `/Researcher`** is 310KB (about 66KB of text) and its body states the statutory position explicitly — **the FSCA "regulates and supervises the market conduct of financial institutions in South Africa", with a mandate "to enhance and support the efficiency and integrity of the financial system, and to protect financial customers", under section 57 of the Financial Sector Regulation Act (No. 9 of 2017)**. The site also shows an **annual reports entry `/Annual-Reports`** and **research and data documents** (presented through document links of the form `/_api/cr3ad_researchanddatadocses(...)`); its homepage also carries an **"SA Retail Banking Diagnostic Report"**, a **"Financial Markets Review"** and an **Inaugural Intergovernmental FinTech Working Group** report.

For RIAA: **① it fills the South African regulatory data entry point** — the corpus’s regulator entries already cover the US ([[naic-financial-data-repository]], [[naic-ai-oversight]]), the EU ([[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[aae-ai-act-position]]), Australia ([[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-mcp]]), Canada ([[osfi-canada-data]], [[osfi-ai-risk-controls]]), India ([[irdai-sbsr-regulations]], [[irdai-ai-governance]]), Korea ([[fss-korea-insurance]], [[korea-ai-accountability]]), Singapore ([[mas-insurance-statistics]]), Indonesia ([[ojk-insurance-statistics]]) and Malaysia ([[bnm-insurance-takaful]]), while **South Africa was at zero**; **② the distinction in remit matters** — the FSCA handles **market conduct**, whereas **prudential supervision** sits with the Prudential Authority inside the South African Reserve Bank (the `resbank.co.za` path tried here returned **404**, so this entry documents only the FSCA side); that **twin-peaks structure of prudential versus conduct regulation** is itself an institutional case to compare with [[iais-icp]], [[insurance-europe]] and [[oecd-insurance-data]]; **③** for students working on **consumer protection, market conduct or fintech regulation**, the FSCA’s research documents and fintech working-group reports are direct emerging-market material, readable alongside governance-framework entries such as [[governance-mcp]], [[iso-42001-toolkit]] and [[frai]]; **④** paired with [[assa]] (the professional body) in the same market, it forms a "**South Africa: professional body plus regulator**" pair.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check reached the **homepage and research page body** (including the section 57 mandate text) **and the existence of the annual reports entry**, **but opened no research document or annual report**; **②** the research documents appear as `/_api/cr3ad_...` links, i.e. **a dynamic document interface whose deep-link stability was not verified over time**; **③** two paths I guessed (`/Research-and-Data`, `/Pages/Research-and-Data.aspx`) **both returned 404**, so **no specific section path is given** — only the verified research page and annual reports entry; **④** this site **carries no insurance market statistics dataset** (South African insurance data would require the Prudential Authority or an industry body, for which **no verifiable entry point was found in this check — recorded honestly**). **Verification note**: the homepage (1.7MB) and `/Researcher` (310KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their text read; `/Annual-Reports` and several `/_api/...` document links were observed on the homepage; **the two guessed paths returned 404 and are recorded as such**; **no document was opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**FSCA（Financial Sector Conduct Authority，南非金融部門行為監管局）** 是**南非的金融市場行為監管機構**。可核實資訊（HTTP 200 實測）：**首頁 1.7MB**；**研究頁 `/Researcher` 310KB**（純文本約 66KB），正文實測明確寫出其法定定位——**FSCA「監管並監督南非金融機構的市場行為」，任務為「提升並支持金融體系的效率與誠信、並保護金融消費者」，依據《金融部門監管法》（No. 9 of 2017）第 57 條**。站點另實測可見**年報入口 `/Annual-Reports`**、**研究與數據文檔**（以 `/_api/cr3ad_researchanddatadocses(...)` 形式呈現），首頁還掛有**《SA Retail Banking Diagnostic Report》**、**《Financial Markets Review》**、**首屆政府間金融科技工作組報告**等。

對 RIAA：**① 補上南非監管側數據入口**——池內監管條目已覆蓋美（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]）、歐（[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]）、澳（[[apra-insurance-statistics]]）、加（[[osfi-canada-data]]）、印（[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]）、韓（[[fss-korea-insurance]]）、新（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]）、印尼（[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]）、馬（[[bnm-insurance-takaful]]）等，**南非此前為 0**；**② 定位差異值得注意**——FSCA 管**市場行為**，**審慎監管**歸南非央行（SARB）下的 Prudential Authority（本次實測 `resbank.co.za` 相關路徑返回 **404**，故本詞條只寫 FSCA 側）；**「審慎 vs 行為」雙峰監管結構**本身是制度案例，可與 [[iais-icp]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]] 對照；**③** 對做**消費者保護、市場行為、金融科技監管**方向者可並讀 [[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[frai]]；**④** 與同市場 [[assa]] 配成一對。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與研究頁正文**與**年報入口的存在**，**但未打開任何研究文檔或年報**；**②** 研究文檔鏈接為 `/_api/cr3ad_...` 動態接口，**深鏈穩定性未經長期驗證**；**③** 我猜測的兩個路徑**實測均 404**，故**不給出具體欄目路徑**；**④** 本站**不含保險市場統計數據集**（南非保險數據需另找 Prudential Authority 或行業機構，**本次未找到可核實入口，如實記錄**）。**核實說明**：首頁、`/Researcher` HTTP 200 實測並讀取正文；`/Annual-Reports` 與若干 `/_api/...` 鏈接在首頁實測可見；**兩個猜測路徑實測 404 並如實記錄**；**未打開任何文檔**。
