entries.body:
**IRA（Insurance Regulatory Authority，肯尼亚保险监管局）** 是**肯尼亚的保险监管机构**——东非最大保险市场的监管者。本条目同属本轮**市场覆盖轴**：实测池内**肯尼亚及「南非以外的非洲」相关条目为 0**（仅有 [[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]] 一类合成数据）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测，且逐一区分了真页面与软 404**）：首页 51KB；**「Press Release - Industry Statistics 2025」**（`/resource/press-release-industry-statistics-2025`）28.7KB，**页面标题独立可辨**，面包屑为 **「Reports & Data / Annual Reports」**，正文含内嵌 PDF 阅读器（「It appears you do not have PDF support… Click here to download the document」），**即行业统计以 PDF 形式发布**；**理赔结算统计页 `/claims-statistics/`** 36KB，标题为「Claims Settlement Statistics - Insurance Regulatory Authority」，页内含 **From / To 时间范围 + 关键词**的查询表单（**统计查询界面**）；**年报页 `/annual-reports/`** 36KB，标题独立；首页导航另实测含 **Licensed Entities（持牌机构）、All Downloads、Standardized Insurance Policies（标准化保单）、Legal Notices** 等入口。⚠️ **本轮同时抓到一个真实陷阱并如实记录**：我原本以为存在的 `/industry-statistics/` 与 `/statistics/` **返回 200 但标题退化为站名（Insurance Regulatory Authority）**，属**软 404（模板页）**——**已从词条中剔除，不作为可用入口**；仅保留标题可辨、内容独立的页面。

对 RIAA：**① 补上非洲（除南非外）这一整块空白**——池内监管数据源覆盖美/欧/英/澳/日/韩/台/港/内地/印/新/马/加/菲/印尼，本轮又补了土耳其（[[seddk]]）与南非（[[fsca]]、[[assa]]），**肯尼亚是东非最大市场**；**② 「理赔结算统计」这一维度在池内罕见**——多数监管源只给保费与资产负债表层面数据，而 IRA 提供**按期间的理赔结算统计查询**，这对**理赔时效、赔付行为与消费者保护**方向的研究直接有用（可与 [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]] 的「理赔时限」口径对照：一个给时限规则、一个给结算统计）；**③ 市场结构与发展议题**——肯尼亚是**移动端小额保险与参数险**的重要试验场，与 [[openimis]]（开源保险管理系统，广泛用于非洲社会健康保护）、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[agrisky-ai]] 等条目构成「**新兴市场 + 气候/农业风险 + 数字渠道**」的组合；**④** 跨市场对照见 [[iais-icp]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题可辨与页面结构（含内嵌 PDF 阅读器与查询表单）**，**但未下载或打开任何 PDF，也未实际执行理赔统计查询**，因此**不能确认数据口径与质量**；**② 站点存在软 404**——若干猜测路径返回 200 但为通用模板（已识别并剔除），**后续引用该站时需以标题可辨为准**；**③** 行业统计以 **PDF**（而非结构化数据文件）发布，**机器可读性有限**；**④** 本站为**监管机构站点**，**不提供精算方法或工具**。**核实说明**：首页（51KB）、行业统计 2025 新闻稿页（28.7KB，标题独立、含 PDF 内嵌）、理赔结算统计页（36KB，含查询表单）、年报页（36KB，标题独立）均 HTTP 200 实测；**两个软 404 路径已实测识别并如实记录**；**未下载任何 PDF、未执行查询**。
entries.body_en:
**IRA (Insurance Regulatory Authority)** is **Kenya’s insurance regulator** — the supervisor of East Africa’s largest insurance market. This entry also comes from the current **market-coverage axis**: a measured search found **zero Kenya-related entries and zero Africa-outside-South-Africa entries** (only synthetic-data items such as [[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200, with real pages distinguished from soft 404s**): homepage 51KB; a **"Press Release - Industry Statistics 2025"** page (`/resource/press-release-industry-statistics-2025`) at 28.7KB with a **distinct page title**, breadcrumb "**Reports & Data / Annual Reports**", and an embedded PDF viewer ("It appears you do not have PDF support… Click here to download the document") — i.e. **industry statistics are published as a PDF**; a **claims settlement statistics page `/claims-statistics/`** at 36KB titled "Claims Settlement Statistics - Insurance Regulatory Authority", containing **From / To period plus keyword** query fields (a **statistics query interface**); an **annual reports page `/annual-reports/`** at 36KB with its own title; and homepage navigation showing **Licensed Entities, All Downloads, Standardized Insurance Policies and Legal Notices**. ⚠️ **This round also caught a real trap, recorded honestly**: two paths I had assumed existed — `/industry-statistics/` and `/statistics/` — **return 200 but with the title degraded to the site name (Insurance Regulatory Authority)**, i.e. **soft 404 template pages**; **they were removed from the entry and are not presented as usable entry points**, leaving only pages with distinct titles and independent content.

For RIAA: **① it fills the whole "Africa outside South Africa" gap** — the corpus’s regulator sources cover the US, EU, UK, Australia, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, mainland China, India, Singapore, Malaysia, Canada, the Philippines and Indonesia, and this round added Turkey ([[seddk]]) and South Africa ([[fsca]], [[assa]]), while **Kenya is East Africa’s largest market**; **② the "claims settlement statistics" dimension is rare in this corpus** — most regulator sources give only premium and balance-sheet level data, whereas IRA provides a **period-based query over claims settlement statistics**, directly useful for research on **claims timeliness, payout behaviour and consumer protection** (it can be read against the claims-deadline angle of [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]: one gives deadline rules, the other settlement statistics); **③ market structure and development themes** — Kenya is an important testing ground for **mobile microinsurance and parametric cover**, so it sits with [[openimis]] (open-source insurance management widely used for social health protection in Africa), [[aegis-parametric]], [[parametric-insurance-demo]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]] and [[agrisky-ai]] as an "**emerging market plus climate/agricultural risk plus digital channel**" combination; **④** cross-market comparisons: [[iais-icp]], [[oecd-insurance-data]], [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[ojk-insurance-statistics]], [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[philippines-insurance-commission]], [[fss-korea-insurance]], [[tii-taiwan-insurance]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, distinct titles and page structure (including the embedded PDF viewer and the query form)** but **downloaded and opened no PDF and did not run any claims query**, so **the data definitions and quality cannot be confirmed**; **② the site contains soft 404s** — several guessed paths returned 200 as generic templates (identified and excluded); **when citing this site, treat a distinct title as the test of a real page**; **③** industry statistics are released as **PDF** rather than structured data files, so **machine readability is limited**; **④** this is a **regulator site and offers no actuarial methods or tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (51KB), the Industry Statistics 2025 release page (28.7KB, distinct title, embedded PDF), the claims settlement statistics page (36KB, with query form) and the annual reports page (36KB, distinct title) were all measured at HTTP 200; **the two soft-404 paths were measured, identified and recorded**; **no PDF was downloaded and no query was run**.
entries.body_hk:
**IRA（Insurance Regulatory Authority，肯尼亞保險監管局）** 是**肯尼亞的保險監管機構**——東非最大保險市場的監管者。本條目同屬本輪**市場覆蓋軸**：實測池內**肯尼亞及「南非以外的非洲」相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測，並逐一區分真頁面與軟 404**）：首頁 51KB；**「Press Release - Industry Statistics 2025」**頁 28.7KB，**標題獨立可辨**，麵包屑為 **「Reports & Data / Annual Reports」**，正文含內嵌 PDF 閱讀器——**即行業統計以 PDF 形式發布**；**理賠結算統計頁** 36KB，標題「Claims Settlement Statistics」，頁內含 **From / To 時間範圍 + 關鍵詞**查詢表單；**年報頁** 36KB，標題獨立；首頁導航另實測含 **Licensed Entities、All Downloads、Standardized Insurance Policies、Legal Notices**。⚠️ **本輪抓到一個真實陷阱並如實記錄**：原以為存在的 `/industry-statistics/` 與 `/statistics/` **返回 200 但標題退化為站名**，屬**軟 404（模板頁）**——**已從詞條剔除**，僅保留標題可辨、內容獨立者。

對 RIAA：**① 補上非洲（除南非外）這一整塊空白**；**② 「理賠結算統計」在池內罕見**——多數監管源只給保費與資產負債表層面，而 IRA 提供**按期間的理賠結算統計查詢**，對**理賠時效、賠付行為與消費者保護**方向直接有用（可與 [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]] 的「理賠時限」口徑對照）；**③** 肯尼亞是**移動端小額保險與參數險**的重要試驗場，與 [[openimis]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[agrisky-ai]] 構成「新興市場 + 氣候/農業風險 + 數字渠道」組合；**④** 跨市場對照見 [[iais-icp]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題可辨與頁面結構**，**但未下載或打開任何 PDF、也未實際執行查詢**；**② 站點存在軟 404**（已識別並剔除），**後續引用需以標題可辨為準**；**③** 行業統計以 **PDF** 發布，**機器可讀性有限**；**④** 本站為**監管機構站點，不提供精算方法或工具**。**核實說明**：首頁、行業統計 2025 頁、理賠結算統計頁、年報頁均 HTTP 200 實測；**兩個軟 404 路徑已實測識別並如實記錄**；**未下載任何 PDF、未執行查詢**。

entries.body:
**ASF（Autoritatea de Supraveghere Financiară，罗马尼亚金融监管局）** 是**罗马尼亚的金融监管机构**，监管范围涵盖**保险、私人养老金与资本市场**三个板块。本条目填补的是**中东欧（CEE）市场空白**——实测池内**波兰、罗马尼亚、土耳其等中东欧市场相关条目为 0**（土耳其已由本轮 [[seddk]] 补上）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 `/en/` 72.6KB；**报告栏目 `/en/a/970/rapoarte`** 76KB，另有报告列表页 `/en/c/47/reports`；**私人养老金收益/指标页 `/en/a/204/evoluție-indicatori`**（"Private pension funds rentability"）63.7KB；**数据子域 `data.asfromania.ro/scr/adeziuniFP`**（养老金参与查询，6KB）——⚠️ **但本次实测该查询页显示「Datorită efectuării unor lucrări de mentenanță, interogarea nu este momentan disponibilă」（因维护作业，查询暂不可用）**，即**入口在线但功能暂停**，此点如实标注；首页另实测可见 **MTPL 保单查证入口**（`aida.info.ro/polite-rca`，罗马尼亚强制车险）与**保险分销行为违规举报入口**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上中东欧这一块**——池内欧盟口径已有 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 等**欧盟层面**条目，但**成员国层面此前只有零星**；ASF 提供的是**成员国监管机构**视角，可与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]]、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] 一起用于**「欧盟框架 → 成员国落地」**的对照研究。**② 一个板块三合一**——ASF 同时监管**保险、私人养老金与资本市场**（罗马尼亚的「三合一」监管结构，与南非的「双峰」、土耳其的统一保险养老金监管形成有趣的**监管架构比较**，可对照 [[fsca]]、[[seddk]]、[[iais-icp]]）。**③ 私人养老金指标页有直接研究价值**——「Private pension funds rentability（私人养老金基金收益率）」这类**指标演化页**，配合其**养老金参与数据子域**，适合做**中东欧自愿性养老金（第三支柱）**的覆盖与收益分析（可对照 [[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 的澳洲基金级数据与 [[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在与页面结构**，**但未打开任何报告、未实际使用数据查询**；**②** 养老金参与查询子域**实测处于维护状态、功能暂停**（已如实写明，不作为可用入口承诺）；**③** 报告栏目与文档多为**罗马尼亚语**（英文入口存在，但**英文覆盖度未逐项核实**）；**④** MTPL 查证入口指向外部站点 `aida.info.ro`，**其归属性与服务条款未核实**；**⑤** 本站为**监管机构站点**，**不含精算工具或方法**。**核实说明**：`/en/`（72.6KB）、`/en/a/970/rapoarte`（76KB）、`/en/a/204/evoluție-indicatori`（63.7KB）、`data.asfromania.ro/scr/adeziuniFP`（6KB，含维护提示）均 HTTP 200 实测；`/en/c/47/reports` 与 MTPL 入口在页面内实测可见；**未打开任何报告或数据集**。
entries.body_en:
**ASF (Autoritatea de Supraveghere Financiară)** is **Romania’s financial supervisory authority**, covering **insurance, private pensions and capital markets**. This entry fills a **Central and Eastern Europe (CEE) gap** — a measured search found **zero entries for Poland, Romania or other CEE markets** (Turkey having been added this round via [[seddk]]).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the site homepage `/en/` is 72.6KB; the **reports section `/en/a/970/rapoarte`** is 76KB, with a further reports listing at `/en/c/47/reports`; the **private pension return/indicator page `/en/a/204/evoluție-indicatori`** ("Private pension funds rentability") is 63.7KB; and a **data subdomain `data.asfromania.ro/scr/adeziuniFP`** (pension membership query, 6KB) — ⚠️ **but that query page currently displays "Datorită efectuării unor lucrări de mentenanță, interogarea nu este momentan disponibilă" (the query is temporarily unavailable due to maintenance work)**, i.e. **the entry point is online while the function is suspended**, recorded as such; the homepage also shows an **MTPL policy verification entry** (`aida.info.ro/polite-rca`, Romania’s compulsory motor insurance) and an **insurance distribution conduct complaint channel**.

For RIAA: **① it fills in Central and Eastern Europe** — at EU level the corpus already holds [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[insurance-europe]] and [[aae-ai-act-position]], but **member-state level entries were previously sparse**; ASF supplies the **member-state regulator** perspective, readable alongside [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[solvency2rfr]], [[ggsolvencyii]], [[sii-equity-risk-scr]] and [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] for "**EU framework in, member state out**" comparisons. **② Three sectors in one body** — ASF supervises **insurance, private pensions and capital markets** together (Romania’s "three-in-one" structure), which makes an interesting **supervisory-architecture comparison** against South Africa’s twin peaks ([[fsca]]) and Turkey’s unified insurance-and-pension regulator ([[seddk]]), with [[iais-icp]] as the international reference. **③ The private pension indicator page has direct research value** — an indicator-evolution page such as "Private pension funds rentability", together with the pension membership data subdomain, suits analysis of **coverage and returns in CEE voluntary pensions (third pillar)**, comparable to the Australian fund-level data in [[apra-superannuation-statistics]] and to [[retirement-planning]] and [[longevity-mortality-investor]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence and structure** but **opened no report and did not exercise the data query**; **②** the pension membership query subdomain was **measured as under maintenance, with the function suspended** (stated as such and not presented as a working entry point); **③** reports and documents are largely in **Romanian** (an English entry point exists, but **English coverage was not verified item by item**); **④** the MTPL verification entry points to an external site, `aida.info.ro`, **whose ownership and terms were not verified**; **⑤** this is a **regulator site and contains no actuarial tools or methods**. **Verification note**: `/en/` (72.6KB), `/en/a/970/rapoarte` (76KB), `/en/a/204/evoluție-indicatori` (63.7KB) and `data.asfromania.ro/scr/adeziuniFP` (6KB, maintenance notice) were all measured at HTTP 200; `/en/c/47/reports` and the MTPL entry were observed on the page; **no report or dataset was opened**.

entries.body:
**ACPR（Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution，法国审慎监管与处置局）** 是**法国的银行与保险审慎监管机构**（隶属法兰西银行 Banque de France）。本条目填补的是**法国这一整块空白**——实测池内**与法国相关的条目为 0**（法国是欧洲最大的保险市场之一）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：英文首页 120.7KB，正文实测自述「**对法国银行业与保险业行使监管以维护金融稳定**」，并给出当日机构数——**657 家受监管银行机构、660 家受监管保险机构**（页面日期标注 **8th of July 2026**）；**出版物页 `/en/publications-acpr` 194.8KB**，实测含 **《Annual report ACPR 2024》**、**《Annual Report on Sanctioning Activities in the SSM in 2025》**（单一监管机制下的处罚活动年报）等入口。⚠️ **如实记录两处路径异常**：`/en/publications-and-statistics` 实测 **404**、`/en/publications-and-statistics/publications` 实测 **403**——**故词条只给已核实的 `/en/publications-acpr`**，不写未证实的栏目路径。

对 RIAA：**① 补上法国的监管数据入口**——池内监管源已覆盖美、欧（[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]）、英、澳、日、韩、台、港、内地、印、新、马、加、菲、印尼，本轮前又补了土耳其（[[seddk]]）、南非（[[fsca]]）、肯尼亚（[[ira-kenya]]）、罗马尼亚（[[asf-romania]]），**法国此前为零**；ACPR 的**机构数、处罚活动与年报**是**「监管强度与实际执行」**这一类研究的直接材料（与 [[naic-financial-data-repository]] 的财务数据、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 的监管数据、[[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[frai]] 一类治理条目可并读）。**② 法国式「双业合一」监管**——ACPR 同时管**银行与保险**（挂在央行下），而罗马尼亚 ASF 是三合一（[[asf-romania]]）、南非是「审慎 vs 行为」双峰（[[fsca]]）、土耳其是保险与养老金统一（[[seddk]]）——**四个样本放在一起即可做监管架构比较**，以 [[iais-icp]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 为框架参照。**③ 与法国精算生态配对**——同国专业团体见同轮 [[institut-des-actuaires]]，学术侧可对 [[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]、[[geneva-association]]、[[repec-g22]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页正文与机构数、出版物页存在与其中两类年报入口**，**但未打开任何报告**，因此**不能确认报告口径与数据内容**；**②** 两条栏目路径实测 404/403（已如实记录），说明**该站深层栏目对匿名访问并不完全开放**；**③** 机构数（657 / 660）为**页面标注日期下的自述数字**，**未与原始统计交叉核对**；**④** 本站**不含精算模型或工具**，也不提供保险赔付/费率层面的细粒度统计（若要法国市场细数据，需另找 ACPR 的统计出版物或行业机构，**本次未找到可核实入口，如实记录**）。**核实说明**：英文首页（120.7KB）、`/en/publications-acpr`（194.8KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取正文；**两处路径 404/403 已实测确认并记入词条**；**未打开任何报告**。
entries.body_en:
**ACPR (Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution)** is **France’s prudential supervisor for banking and insurance** (part of the Banque de France). This entry fills **France as a whole** — a measured search found **zero France-related entries** in the corpus (and France is one of Europe’s largest insurance markets).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the English homepage is 120.7KB and its body states that the Authority "**exercises oversight over the French banking and insurance sectors in order to maintain financial stability**", alongside institution counts — **657 supervised banking institutions and 660 supervised insurance undertakings** (page dated **8th of July 2026**); the **publications page `/en/publications-acpr`** is 194.8KB and shows entries including **"Annual report ACPR 2024"** and **"Annual Report on Sanctioning Activities in the SSM in 2025"** (sanctioning activity under the Single Supervisory Mechanism). ⚠️ **Two path anomalies are recorded honestly**: `/en/publications-and-statistics` measured **404** and `/en/publications-and-statistics/publications` measured **403** — so **this entry gives only the verified `/en/publications-acpr`** and states no unverified section paths.

For RIAA: **① it adds France’s regulatory data entry point** — the corpus’s regulator sources already cover the US, the EU ([[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]), the UK, Australia, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, mainland China, India, Singapore, Malaysia, Canada, the Philippines and Indonesia, and earlier this round Turkey ([[seddk]]), South Africa ([[fsca]]), Kenya ([[ira-kenya]]) and Romania ([[asf-romania]]) were added, while **France was at zero**; ACPR’s **institution counts, sanctioning activity and annual reports** are direct material for research on **supervisory intensity and actual enforcement** (readable alongside the financial data of [[naic-financial-data-repository]], the regulatory data of [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], and governance entries such as [[governance-mcp]], [[iso-42001-toolkit]] and [[frai]]). **② A French-style "two sectors in one" supervisor** — the ACPR supervises **banking and insurance together** (under the central bank), while Romania’s ASF is three-in-one ([[asf-romania]]), South Africa is twin-peaks prudential versus conduct ([[fsca]]) and Turkey unifies insurance and pensions ([[seddk]]) — **four samples that together support a supervisory-architecture comparison**, framed by [[iais-icp]], [[insurance-europe]] and [[aae-ai-act-position]]. **③ Pairs with the French actuarial ecosystem** — the professional body is [[institut-des-actuaires]] (also added this round), and the academic side is [[european-actuarial-journal]], [[annals-of-actuarial-science]], [[geneva-association]] and [[repec-g22]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage body and institution counts, the publications page and two annual-report entries**, **but opened no report**, so **its definitions and contents cannot be confirmed**; **②** two section paths measured 404/403 (recorded), showing that **the site’s deeper sections are not fully open to anonymous access**; **③** the counts (657 / 660) are **the site’s own figures as of its stated date** and **were not cross-checked against primary statistics**; **④** the site **offers no actuarial models or tools**, nor fine-grained claims or rate-level statistics for the French market (French market detail would require ACPR’s statistical publications or an industry body — **no verifiable entry point was found in this check, recorded honestly**). **Verification note**: the English homepage (120.7KB) and `/en/publications-acpr` (194.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their text read; **the two 404/403 paths were measured and recorded**; **no report was opened**.

entries.body:
**Institut des Actuaires（法国精算师协会）** 是**法国的精算专业团体**，与同轮收录的 [[acpr]] 一起补上**法国**这一空白市场（实测池内法国相关条目为 0）。可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 144.8KB；**技术委员会与工作组页 `/contribuer-a-l-institut/commissions-techniques-et-groupes-de-travail-1999` 72.5KB**（页内含**加入某个技术委员会、加入某个工作组**的入口）；培养侧实测到的路径包括 **`/devenir-actuaire/formations-pour-etudiants/formations-initiales-491`（初始培养）**、**`…/parcours-497`（学习路径）**、**`/devenir-actuaire/formations-pour-professionnels/master-actuariat-cnam-34`（CNAM 精算硕士）**、**`…/certificat-d-expertise-actuarielle-irm-35`（IRM 精算专家证书）**，以及针对培训机构开放的「申报培训」入口。

对 RIAA：**① 补上法国的专业团体与资格路径**——池内该类条目已覆盖英国（[[ifoa]]）、英联邦多国（[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]、[[assa]]）、中国（[[china-actuarial-association]]）与考试类（[[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[open-exam-prep]]），**法国此前为零**；**② 有两点对学生的实际价值**——**技术委员会与工作组**（commissions techniques et groupes de travail）**自带加入入口**，这是**把课程作业升级为行业参与**的可操作路径之一（与池内 [[dav-ai-professional-profile]] 一类「专业身份与 CPD」条目同类）；**③ 法语区的学术与教材侧**可与 [[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]、[[geneva-association]]、[[actuarial-open-book]]、[[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]] 并读；**④ 监管配对**见 [[acpr]]，跨市场职业路径对照可看 [[seddk]]（土耳其）、[[fsca]]/[[assa]]（南非）、[[asf-romania]]（罗马尼亚）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 站点以法语为主**（本次未核实英文版），**语言门槛真实存在**；**②** 本次核实到**页面存在与结构**（含技术委员会/工作组与培养路径的具体路径），**但未逐页打开培养页或任何文件**，因此**不能确认课程内容、费用与资格要求**；**③** 「IRM 精算专家证书」等名称**按页面路径原文记录**，**其认证条件与互认关系未核实**；**④** 本站为**专业团体站点，不含市场统计数据**（法国监管与机构数据见 [[acpr]]）。**核实说明**：首页（144.8KB）与技术委员会/工作组页（72.5KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取链接结构；其余路径在首页导航中实测可见；**未打开个别培养页或文件**。
entries.body_en:
**Institut des Actuaires** is **France’s actuarial professional body**, and together with [[acpr]] (also added this round) it fills the **France** gap (a measured search found zero France-related entries). Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): homepage 144.8KB; the **technical commissions and working groups page `/contribuer-a-l-institut/commissions-techniques-et-groupes-de-travail-1999`** at 72.5KB (with entries for **joining a technical commission** and **joining a working group**); education paths observed include **`/devenir-actuaire/formations-pour-etudiants/formations-initiales-491` (initial training)**, **`…/parcours-497` (study pathway)**, **`/devenir-actuaire/formations-pour-professionnels/master-actuariat-cnam-34` (the CNAM actuarial master’s)** and **`…/certificat-d-expertise-actuarielle-irm-35` (the IRM actuarial expertise certificate)**, plus a training-declaration entry for course providers.

For RIAA: **① it adds France’s professional body and qualification pathway** — such entries already cover the UK ([[ifoa]]), several Commonwealth bodies ([[actuaries-institute]], [[singapore-actuarial-society]], [[assa]]), China ([[china-actuarial-association]]) and the exam-prep layer ([[actuarial-exam-database]], [[open-exam-prep]]), while **France was at zero**; **② two things are practically useful to students** — the **technical commissions and working groups** come with **their own join entries**, one of the actionable routes from coursework into行业 participation (kin to professional-identity and CPD entries such as [[dav-ai-professional-profile]]); **③ the francophone academic and textbook side** pairs with [[european-actuarial-journal]], [[annals-of-actuarial-science]], [[geneva-association]], [[actuarial-open-book]] and [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]]; **④ regulatory pairing** is [[acpr]], and cross-market career-path comparisons are [[seddk]] (Turkey), [[fsca]]/[[assa]] (South Africa) and [[asf-romania]] (Romania).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the site is mainly in French** (no English version was verified here), so **a real language barrier exists**; **②** this check verified **page existence and structure** (including the specific commission/working-group and training paths) **but opened no training page or file**, so **course content, fees and qualification requirements cannot be confirmed**; **③** names such as the "IRM actuarial expertise certificate" are **recorded as written in the site paths**, and **their certification conditions and mutual recognition were not verified**; **④** this is a **professional body site with no market statistics** (French supervisory and institution data is in [[acpr]]). **Verification note**: the homepage (144.8KB) and the commissions/working-groups page (72.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their link structure read; the remaining paths were observed in the homepage navigation; **no individual training page or file was opened**.

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 站點以法語為主**（未核實英文版）；**②** 本次核實到**頁面存在與結構**，**但未逐頁打開培養頁或任何文件**；**③** 「IRM 精算專家證書」等名稱**按頁面路徑原文記錄**，**認證條件與互認關係未核實**；**④** 本站為**專業團體站點，不含市場統計**（法國監管數據見 [[acpr]]）。**核實說明**：首頁與技術委員會/工作組頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開個別培養頁或文件**。

entries.body:
**CMF（Comisión para el Mercado Financiero，智利金融市场委员会）** 是**智利的金融监管机构**（保险、证券与银行）。本条目填补**拉丁美洲**空白——实测池内**智利、哥伦比亚、秘鲁相关条目均为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：入口页 110.7KB；**统计栏目 `/portal/estadisticas/626/…`** 下实测到**分类结构**：**「Estadísticas del Mercado de Seguros」（保险市场统计）**、**证券市场统计**、**银行与金融机构统计**、**其他实体统计**、**一般统计**、**出版物**、**机构报告（Informes Institucionales）** 与 **规范性研究系列（Serie de Estudios Normativos）**；其中**保险市场统计专页实测 200，137.5KB**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上拉美**——池内监管/数据源覆盖北美、欧洲多国、澳、东亚与东南亚，**拉美此前为零**；而智利是**拉美保险与养老金（AFP 体系）改革**的样板市场，对做**新兴市场养老金与年金化**研究的学生是直接材料（尤其养老金年金化市场，可与 [[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 对照）；**② 统计分类清晰、层级分明**——「保险市场统计」单独成页，且与证券、银行并列，**便于按板块取数**，也可与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]、[[ira-kenya]] 一起构成**多市场横向对照**；**③ 智利的地震暴露**使其巨灾研究与 [[openquake-engine]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[opendrr-riskprofiler]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]] 直接相关（智利是全球参数险与巨灾债券的活跃市场）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 站点与统计以西班牙语为主**（本次未核实英文版）；**②** 本次核实到**栏目结构与保险市场统计专页的存在（HTTP 200、137.5KB）**，**但未打开任何数据文件或报表**，因此**不能确认数据口径、频率与可得性**；**③** 各统计页为门户式结构（路径含内部 property 编号），**深链稳定性未长期验证**；**④** 本条目**不主张**该站提供精算工具或可直接入库的机器可读数据集。**核实说明**：入口页（110.7KB）与 `/portal/estadisticas/626/w4-propertyname-620.html`（保险市场统计，137.5KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取栏目结构；**未打开任何数据文件**。

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the site and its statistics are mainly in Spanish** (no English version verified here); **②** this check verified **the section structure and the existence of the insurance market statistics page (HTTP 200, 137.5KB)** **but opened no data file or report**, so **definitions, frequency and availability cannot be confirmed**; **③** the statistics pages use a portal structure (paths containing internal property numbers), so **deep-link stability was not verified over time**; **④** this entry does **not** claim the site offers actuarial tools or directly loadable machine-readable datasets. **Verification note**: the entry page (110.7KB) and `/portal/estadisticas/626/w4-propertyname-620.html` (insurance market statistics, 137.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their structure read; **no data file was opened**.

entries.body:
**Instituto de Actuarios Españoles（西班牙精算师协会）** 是**西班牙的精算专业团体**。本条目与 [[acpr]]（法国）、[[cmf-chile]]（智利）同属本轮市场覆盖轴，填补**西班牙与葡萄牙这一空白**（实测该组为 0）。可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 368.3KB；**《Revista Actuarios》杂志入口 `actuarios.org/revista-actuarios/`**；**学术期刊《Revista Anales》独立站点 `revistas.actuarios.org/index.php/aiae` 36.8KB**（另有 **2016 年以前的存档入口**）；**独立培训门户 `formacion.actuarios.org/` 161.2KB**（含课程与 **CPD 2025 认证**入口）。首页内容实测还可见一篇 **2026-08-12 的精算研究报道**——「**Jugar en la élite no acorta la vida: un estudio actuarial…**」（关于职业运动员死亡率的精算研究），说明该站点会发布**面向公众的精算研究解读**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上西班牙的精算专业路径与期刊**——池内专业团体与期刊类条目已覆盖英国、南非、新加坡、中国、澳洲、美国（[[ifoa]]、[[assa]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]、[[china-actuarial-association]]、[[actuaries-institute]]、[[soa-education]]、[[cas-syllabus]]）与三份学术期刊（[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]、[[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[geneva-papers]]），**西语区的期刊此前为零**；**《Revista Anales》**是**西语精算学术写作**的主要出口之一，对做**西语市场或跨语种文献**的学生有直接价值。**② 培训与 CPD 独立成门户**——`formacion.actuarios.org` 把课程、CPD 与认证拆成独立站点，**结构上比把一切塞进主站更清晰**，这一点对做「专业教育平台」比较的人是可借鉴的做法。**③ 公众传播的样本**——首页那篇运动员死亡率研究属于**把精算研究写成公众可读内容**的一类实践，与池内 [[cas-actuarial-communication]] 一类「精算沟通」主题相关（若需引证请以原文为准）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 站点与期刊以西班牙语为主**（未核实英文版），**语言门槛真实**；**②** 本次核实到**页面与期刊站点存在（含卷期入口与 2016 年前存档入口）、培训门户存在**，**但未打开任何期刊文章或课程页面**，因此**不能确认期刊的评审方式、开放获取状态与课程费用**；**③** 首页那则研究报道**仅核实到标题与日期（2026-08-12）**，**未读全文、未评估其方法**；**④** 本站为**专业团体站点，不含市场统计数据**（西班牙监管数据本次未找到可核实入口，如实记录）。**核实说明**：首页（368.3KB）、`revistas.actuarios.org/index.php/aiae`（36.8KB）、`formacion.actuarios.org`（161.2KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未打开任何期刊文章或课程页**。
entries.body_en:
**Instituto de Actuarios Españoles** is **Spain’s actuarial professional body**. This entry, with [[acpr]] (France) and [[cmf-chile]] (Chile), belongs to this round’s market-coverage axis and fills the **Spain and Portugal** gap (measured at zero). Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): homepage 368.3KB; a **Revista Actuarios** entry at `actuarios.org/revista-actuarios/`; an **independent journal site for Revista Anales at `revistas.actuarios.org/index.php/aiae`** (36.8KB, with an additional **pre-2016 archive** entry); and a **separate training portal `formacion.actuarios.org/`** (161.2KB) with courses and a **CPD 2025 attestation** entry. The homepage also shows a **dated actuarial research item of 2026-08-12** — "**Jugar en la élite no acorta la vida: un estudio actuarial…**" (an actuarial study of professional athletes’ mortality) — indicating the site publishes **public-facing readings of actuarial research**.

For RIAA: **① it adds Spain’s professional pathway and journals** — the corpus’s professional-body and journal entries already cover the UK, South Africa, Singapore, China, Australia and the US ([[ifoa]], [[assa]], [[singapore-actuarial-society]], [[china-actuarial-association]], [[actuaries-institute]], [[soa-education]], [[cas-syllabus]]) along with three academic journals ([[annals-of-actuarial-science]], [[european-actuarial-journal]], [[geneva-papers]]), while **the Spanish-language journals were at zero**; **Revista Anales** is one of the main outlets for **Spanish-language actuarial scholarship**, directly useful for students working on Spanish-speaking markets or cross-language literature. **② Training and CPD live on a separate portal** — `formacion.actuarios.org` splits courses, CPD and certification off from the main site, a **structurally clearer arrangement** than folding everything into one site, and worth noting for anyone comparing professional-education platforms. **③ A public-communication sample** — the athletes’-mortality item is an instance of **writing actuarial research for a general audience**, kin to the corpus’s actuarial-communication theme (cite the original for any claim).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the site and journals are mainly in Spanish** (no English version verified), so **the language barrier is real**; **②** this check verified **the existence of the pages and journal site (including volume entries and the pre-2016 archive) and of the training portal**, **but opened no journal article or course page**, so **the journal’s peer-review model, open-access status and course fees cannot be confirmed**; **③** the homepage research item was verified **only by title and date (2026-08-12)** — **its full text was not read and its methods were not assessed**; **④** this is a **professional body site with no market statistics** (no verifiable entry point for Spanish regulatory data was found in this check, recorded honestly). **Verification note**: the homepage (368.3KB), `revistas.actuarios.org/index.php/aiae` (36.8KB) and `formacion.actuarios.org` (161.2KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no journal article or course page was opened**.

entries.body:
**IVASS（Istituto per la Vigilanza sulle Assicurazioni，意大利保险监管局）** 是**意大利的保险监管机构**。本条目同属本轮市场覆盖轴：实测池内**意大利相关条目接近于零**（仅有一条会议类条目误命中），而意大利是欧洲主要保险市场之一。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 43.6KB；**统计栏目**下实测到两个专页——**《I principali numeri delle assicurazioni in Italia》（意大利保险业主要数字）** `/pubblicazioni-e-statistiche/statistiche/numeri-assicurazioni/index.html`（33.8KB）；**《Prezzi effettivi polizze cat-nat》（巨灾自然险保单实际价格）** `/pubblicazioni-e-statistiche/statistiche/prezzi-effettivi-polizze-cat-nat/index.html`（39KB）。同栏目另实测到：**月度《Bollettino di vigilanza》（监管公报）2026 年 6 月与 7 月期**、**《Quaderno IVASS》工作论文系列第 35 号**（2026 年，题目含 "Sensitivity Esti…"）、以及**巨灾自然风险的年度监测报告**（第四期）。⭐ **另有一处值得单列**：站点提供 **Open Data —「Metadati Agid」RDF**（`/footer/open-data/Open_Data_IVASS.rdf`，实测 **200，92KB，`application/rdf+xml`**），即**按意大利 Agid 开放数据标准发布的 RDF 元数据**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上意大利**——池内欧洲监管数据以欧盟层面（[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]）与英法为主（法国见 [[acpr]]），**意大利此前为零**；**② 「巨灾自然险保单实际价格」是罕见口径**——多数监管源给**保费总额**，而这里给的是**实际成交价格的统计**，对**气候风险定价与保障缺口**研究直接有用（可与 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[perils-ied]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]] 并读；意大利是欧洲地震与洪水暴露最高的市场之一）；**③ Quaderni 工作论文 + 月度监管公报**构成「**研究 + 监管动态**」两层，适合做监管执行与市场演变的连续观察（与 [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[frai]] 一类治理条目并读）；**④ 开放数据值得单独记一笔**——**以 RDF + 本国开放数据标准发布**在欧洲监管机构中并不常见（对照 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[osfi-canada-data]]、[[cmf-chile]]、[[ira-kenya]]）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 内容以意大利语为主**（本次未核实英文版）；**②** 本次核实到**页面存在、栏目结构与文件类型**，**但未打开任何 PDF 或 RDF 内容**，因此**不能确认统计口径、覆盖期与更新频率**；**③** Open Data 文件名为「Metadati（元数据）」，**其实际提供的是元数据还是全量数据未核实**，故词条只写「RDF 元数据入口」而不夸大；**④** 本条目**不主张**该站提供精算模型或可直接入库的结构化数据集。**核实说明**：首页（43.6KB）、保险业关键数字页（33.8KB）、巨灾险实际价格页（39KB）、Open Data RDF（92KB，`application/rdf+xml`）均 HTTP 200 实测；公报与 Quaderni 链接在页面内实测可见；**未打开任何 PDF / 未解析 RDF**。
entries.body_en:
**IVASS (Istituto per la Vigilanza sulle Assicurazioni)** is **Italy’s insurance supervisor**. This entry again belongs to the current market-coverage axis: a measured search found **essentially zero Italy-related entries** (only one conference item matched by accident), while Italy is one of Europe’s major insurance markets.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): homepage 43.6KB; two dedicated pages were found under the **statistics section** — **"I principali numeri delle assicurazioni in Italia" (key insurance numbers for Italy)** at `/pubblicazioni-e-statistiche/statistiche/numeri-assicurazioni/index.html` (33.8KB) and **"Prezzi effettivi polizze cat-nat" (actual prices of catastrophe-natural policies)** at `/pubblicazioni-e-statistiche/statistiche/prezzi-effettivi-polizze-cat-nat/index.html` (39KB). The same section also shows the **monthly "Bollettino di vigilanza" (supervisory bulletin) for June and July 2026**, the **"Quaderno IVASS" working-paper series no. 35** (2026, title containing "Sensitivity Esti…") and the **annual monitoring report on catastrophe-natural risks** (fourth edition). ⭐ **One item deserves separate mention**: the site publishes **Open Data — "Metadati Agid" RDF** (`/footer/open-data/Open_Data_IVASS.rdf`, measured **200, 92KB, `application/rdf+xml`**), i.e. **RDF metadata released under Italy’s Agid open-data standard**.

For RIAA: **① it adds Italy** — European regulatory data in the corpus is dominated by the EU level ([[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[insurance-europe]], [[aae-ai-act-position]]) and by the UK and France (France being [[acpr]]), while **Italy was at zero**; **② "actual cat-nat policy prices" is a rare measure** — most regulators publish **total premiums**, whereas this is a statistic of **actual transacted prices**, directly useful for **climate-risk pricing and protection-gap research** (readable with [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[perils-ied]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]], [[aegis-parametric]] and [[parametric-insurance-demo]]; Italy has among the highest seismic and flood exposure in Europe); **③ the Quaderni working papers plus the monthly supervisory bulletin** give two layers — **research and supervisory activity** — suited to continuous observation of enforcement and market evolution (alongside governance entries such as [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], [[governance-mcp]], [[iso-42001-toolkit]] and [[frai]]); **④ the open data deserves a note of its own** — publishing **RDF under a national open-data standard** is uncommon among European supervisors (compare [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[osfi-canada-data]], [[cmf-chile]] and [[ira-kenya]]).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the content is mainly Italian** (no English version verified here); **②** this check verified **page existence, section structure and file types** **but opened no PDF and parsed no RDF**, so **definitions, coverage periods and update frequency cannot be confirmed**; **③** the open-data file is named "Metadati" (metadata), and **whether it delivers metadata only or full data was not verified**, so this entry says "RDF metadata entry point" rather than overstating it; **④** this entry does **not** claim the site offers actuarial models or directly loadable structured datasets. **Verification note**: the homepage (43.6KB), the key-insurance-numbers page (33.8KB), the cat-nat actual-prices page (39KB) and the open-data RDF (92KB, `application/rdf+xml`) were all measured at HTTP 200; the bulletin and Quaderni links were observed on the pages; **no PDF was opened and the RDF was not parsed**.

entries.body:
**ACAPS（Autorité de Contrôle des Assurances et de la Prévoyance Sociale，摩洛哥保险与社会保障监管局）** 是**摩洛哥的保险与社会保障监管机构**。本条目与 [[ivass]]（意大利）同属本轮市场覆盖轴，补上**北非/马格里布**这一空白（实测池内埃及、摩洛哥、加纳等为 0）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 89KB；**统计栏目 `/fr/statistiques` 82.5KB**（站点另设英文镜像 `/en/statistics`）；页面内实测到**分季度行业统计 PDF 可直接下载**——**`ACAPS_statistices_T2-2026_FR.pdf`（2026-09 上传目录、实测 200、380.7KB）** 与 **`ACAPS_statistics_T1-2026_FR.pdf`（2026-05 目录）**，并提供按**发布频率**筛选季度统计的入口。**出版物**另实测到 **ACAPS 通讯 n°15**、**《Innovation Insurtech》通讯 N2**、**RSF n°13（2025）**，以及 **ACAPS 与摩洛哥央行（Bank Al-Maghrib）、市场监管局（AMMC）联合发布的第 13 期报告**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上北非**——池内非洲侧此前只有合成数据（[[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]）与本轮前的南非（[[fsca]]、[[assa]]）、肯尼亚（[[ira-kenya]]），**摩洛哥此前为零**；而摩洛哥是**法语区非洲保险与强制社会保障（AMO/RC 车险）**的主要市场。**② 数据可得性好**——**分季度行业统计以 PDF 直链提供**（本轮实测 T1/T2 2026 均可下载），且**T2-2026 的上传目录为 2026-09**，即**该期数据落在解冻窗口内**——这是「**市场覆盖轴也能命中窗口内容**」的一个例子（与「窗口轴已扫干」并不矛盾：**新市场里的常规发布同样落在窗口内**）。**③ 两个值得注意的非数据资产**——**《Innovation Insurtech》通讯**说明摩洛哥监管机构在**主动跟踪保险科技创新**（可与 [[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]] 并读）；**与央行 + 市场监管局的联合报告**是**跨部门金融稳定**口径的现成样本（可对照 [[iais-icp]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[seddk]]、[[asf-romania]] 的多部门监管结构）。**④** 跨市场对照见 [[cmf-chile]]、[[ira-kenya]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]；农业与气候风险侧可接 [[agrisky-ai]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 内容以法语为主**（存在英文镜像，但**英文覆盖度未逐项核实**）；**②** 本次核实到**统计页存在与两份季度统计 PDF 的直链可下载（HTTP 200）**，**但未打开 PDF 正文**，因此**不能确认字段口径、单位与覆盖范围**；**③** 仅核实了**部分**统计目录（页面以筛选器组织），**更早期的期次未逐一验证**；**④** 本条目**不主张**该站提供精算工具或机器可读结构化数据集。**核实说明**：首页（89KB）、`/fr/statistiques`（82.5KB）、`ACAPS_statistices_T2-2026_FR.pdf`（380.7KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；通讯与联合报告链接在页面内实测可见；**未打开任何 PDF 正文**。
entries.body_en:
**ACAPS (Autorité de Contrôle des Assurances et de la Prévoyance Sociale)** is **Morocco’s insurance and social welfare supervisor**. With [[ivass]] (Italy), this entry belongs to the current market-coverage axis and fills the **North Africa / Maghreb** gap (a measured search found Egypt, Morocco and Ghana at zero).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): homepage 89KB; the **statistics section `/fr/statistiques`** is 82.5KB (the site also offers an English mirror at `/en/statistics`); the page carries **directly downloadable quarterly sector statistics PDFs** — **`ACAPS_statistices_T2-2026_FR.pdf` (uploaded under a 2026-09 directory, measured 200, 380.7KB)** and **`ACAPS_statistics_T1-2026_FR.pdf` (2026-05 directory)** — plus a **publication-frequency filter** for the quarterly statistics. Under **publications**, the site also shows **ACAPS newsletter no. 15**, an **"Innovation Insurtech" newsletter N2**, **RSF no. 13 (2025)**, and the **13th edition of a joint report by ACAPS with Morocco’s central bank (Bank Al-Maghrib) and market authority (AMMC)**.

For RIAA: **① it adds North Africa** — the corpus’s African side previously held only synthetic data ([[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]) plus, since earlier this round, South Africa ([[fsca]], [[assa]]) and Kenya ([[ira-kenya]]), while **Morocco was at zero**; and Morocco is the leading market in **francophone Africa for insurance and compulsory social protection (AMO, compulsory motor liability)**. **② Data availability is good** — **quarterly sector statistics come as direct PDF links** (T1 and T2 2026 were both measurable this round), and the **T2-2026 upload sits under a 2026-09 directory**, i.e. **that period’s data falls inside the thaw window** — an example of how **the market-coverage axis can also hit window content** (not in contradiction with "the window is swept dry": **new markets keep publishing on their own cadence, and some of that lands in the window**). **③ Two non-data assets worth noting** — the **"Innovation Insurtech" newsletter** shows the Moroccan supervisor **actively tracking insurance technology** (readable with [[irdai-ai-governance]], [[aae-ai-act-position]], [[governance-mcp]] and [[iso-42001-toolkit]]); and the **joint report with the central bank and the market authority** is a ready-made sample of **cross-agency financial stability** reporting (compare the multi-agency structures in [[iais-icp]], [[oecd-insurance-data]], [[seddk]] and [[asf-romania]]). **④** Cross-market comparisons: [[cmf-chile]], [[ira-kenya]], [[tii-taiwan-insurance]], [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[philippines-insurance-commission]]; on the agricultural and climate-risk side, [[agrisky-ai]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]] and [[parametric-insurance-demo]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the content is mainly French** (an English mirror exists, but **its coverage was not verified item by item**); **②** this check verified **the statistics page and two directly downloadable quarterly PDFs (HTTP 200)** **but opened no PDF**, so **field definitions, units and coverage cannot be confirmed**; **③** only **part** of the statistics catalogue was verified (the page is organised by filters) and **earlier periods were not checked individually**; **④** this entry does **not** claim the site offers actuarial tools or machine-readable structured datasets. **Verification note**: the homepage (89KB), `/fr/statistiques` (82.5KB) and `ACAPS_statistices_T2-2026_FR.pdf` (380.7KB) were measured at HTTP 200; the newsletter and joint-report links were observed on the page; **no PDF body was opened**.

entries.body:
**HKMC（The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation，香港按揭证券公司）** 是**香港政府全资拥有的机构**，也是**香港退休与住房相关金融产品的实际运营方**。本条目属本轮「**区域形态缺口**」取向：实测池内**HKMC 相关条目为 0**（香港条目已覆盖保监局统计、积金局平台、保险投诉局、保险业联会、VHIS 等，但**「公共年金 / 逆按揭 / 按揭保险」这一支完全缺位**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：英文首页 57.2KB；业务页实测含 **Reverse Mortgage Programme（逆按揭计划）** 与 **Policy Reverse Mortgage Programme（保单逆按揭计划）**；信息中心实测含 **Annual Reports（年报页 80.8KB）** 与 **Publications / e-Publications**，新闻实测含 **2026-08-28「HKMC’s Social Bonds Allocation Update」** 与 **2026-08-24「HKMCA Introduces Cross-Boundary Annuity Disbu…」（跨境年金发放）**。⭐ **最关键的是按月发布的计划统计 PDF，本次逐个实测可下载**：**按揭保险计划统计 2026 年 8 月**（`mip_statistics_2026-08.pdf`，HTTP 200、24.8KB、`application/pdf`）、**逆按揭计划统计 2026 年 8 月**（`RM statistics_ENG_Aug 2026.pdf`，HTTP 200、103.5KB、`application/pdf`）、**中小企融资担保计划统计 2026 年 7 月**（`SFGS Statistics_Eng_20260710.pdf`）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上香港退休产品与长寿风险这一支**——池内香港条目偏**监管统计**（[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[hk-censtatd-insurance]]）、**公积金平台**（[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[mpfa]]、[[mpfe]]）与**消费者保护**（[[hk-icb]]、[[hkfi]]），而**「公共年金如何定价与运营、逆按揭把房产换成终身收入的机制」此前没有入口**；HKMC 的**每月逆按揭统计**（笔数、金额、年龄结构）正是**长寿风险与住房资产年金化**研究的**本地一手数据**，可与 [[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[lifeinsurer]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 并读；**② 「按揭保险」是一个常被忽略的险种**——池内信用/保证类条目（[[payout-assurance-standard]] 等）多为参数险或债权口径，而**按揭保险**是**信贷风险向保险转移**的典型安排，HKMC 的**月度按揭保险统计**给出了这个险种在香港的实际规模；**③ 政策侧信号**——新闻中的**跨境年金发放**（2026-08）与**社会债券资金分配**，对关注**大湾区养老金融**的学生是本地政策观察点。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面结构、三个统计 PDF 与年报页的具体链接（均实测可下载/可访问）**，**但未打开 PDF 正文**，因此**不能确认统计口径与覆盖范围**；**②** **公共年金计划本身由独立实体「HKMC Annuity Limited」运营**——本次实测 `hkmca.com.hk` **连接失败（000）**，其站点**无法核实**，故词条**只写 HKMC 本体，不替其年金子公司背书**；**③** HKMC 官网未见 `annuity` 路径（实测 **404**），**年金相关内容需以官方另行发布的材料为准**；**④** 三个统计为**按月发布**，**历史期次未逐一验证**。**核实说明**：首页（57.2KB）、年报页（80.8KB）、两个统计 PDF（24.8KB / 103.5KB，均 `application/pdf`）HTTP 200 实测；**未打开 PDF 正文**。
entries.body_en:
**HKMC (The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation)** is a **wholly Hong Kong government-owned institution** and the **actual operator of Hong Kong’s retirement- and housing-related financial products**. This entry follows this round’s "**regional form gap**" approach: a measured search found **zero HKMC-related entries** (Hong Kong coverage already includes regulator statistics, the MPF platform, the Insurance Complaints Bureau, the Federation of Insurers and VHIS, but the **"public annuity / reverse mortgage / mortgage insurance" strand was entirely missing**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the English homepage is 57.2KB; business pages include the **Reverse Mortgage Programme** and the **Policy Reverse Mortgage Programme**; the information centre includes **Annual Reports (page 80.8KB)** and **Publications / e-Publications**, and the news items include **"HKMC’s Social Bonds Allocation Update" of 2026-08-28** and **"HKMCA Introduces Cross-Boundary Annuity Disbu…" of 2026-08-24**. ⭐ **Most important are the monthly programme statistics PDFs, each measured as downloadable**: **Mortgage Insurance Programme Statistics for August 2026** (`mip_statistics_2026-08.pdf`, HTTP 200, 24.8KB, `application/pdf`), **Reverse Mortgage Programme Statistics for August 2026** (`RM statistics_ENG_Aug 2026.pdf`, HTTP 200, 103.5KB, `application/pdf`) and **SME Financing Guarantee Scheme statistics for July 2026** (`SFGS Statistics_Eng_20260710.pdf`).

For RIAA: **① it adds Hong Kong’s retirement products and longevity risk strand** — existing Hong Kong entries lean on **regulatory statistics** ([[hk-ia-statistics]], [[hk-censtatd-insurance]]), the **MPF platform** ([[mpf-fund-platform]], [[mpfa]], [[mpfe]]) and **consumer protection** ([[hk-icb]], [[hkfi]]), while **"how a public annuity is priced and operated, and how a reverse mortgage turns property into lifetime income" had no entry point**; HKMC’s **monthly reverse mortgage statistics** (case counts, amounts, age structure) are **local primary data for research on longevity risk and the annuitisation of housing wealth**, readable with [[retirement-planning]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]], [[lifeinsurer]], [[open-life-au]] and [[apra-superannuation-statistics]]. **② Mortgage insurance is frequently overlooked** — credit- and guarantee-type entries in the corpus (such as [[payout-assurance-standard]]) are mostly parametric or debt instruments, whereas **mortgage insurance** is the classic arrangement transferring **credit risk to insurance**, and HKMC’s **monthly mortgage insurance statistics** document that line’s actual scale in Hong Kong. **③ Policy signals** — the **cross-boundary annuity** news (August 2026) and the **social bond allocation update** are local observation points for students following **Greater Bay Area retirement finance**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the page structure and the specific links to three statistics PDFs and the annual reports page (all measured reachable/downloadable)**, **but opened no PDF**, so **definitions and coverage cannot be confirmed**; **②** **the public annuity scheme itself is operated by a separate entity, HKMC Annuity Limited** — `hkmca.com.hk` measured a **failed connection (000)**, so **its site could not be verified**, and this entry **covers the HKMC parent only and does not vouch for its annuity subsidiary**; **③** no `annuity` path exists on the HKMC site (measured **404**), so **annuity material must come from official publications elsewhere**; **④** the three statistics are published **monthly** and **earlier periods were not verified individually**. **Verification note**: the homepage (57.2KB), the annual reports page (80.8KB) and the two statistics PDFs (24.8KB / 103.5KB, both `application/pdf`) were measured at HTTP 200; **no PDF body was opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**HKMC（The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation，香港按揭證券公司）** 是**香港政府全資擁有的機構**，也是**香港退休與住房相關金融產品的實際運營方**。本條目屬本輪「**區域形態缺口**」取向：實測池內**HKMC 相關條目為 0**（香港條目已覆蓋監管統計、積金局平台、保險投訴局、保險業聯會、VHIS 等，但**「公共年金／逆按揭／按揭保險」這一支完全缺位**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：英文首頁 57.2KB；業務頁實測含 **Reverse Mortgage Programme（逆按揭計劃）** 與 **Policy Reverse Mortgage Programme（保單逆按揭計劃）**；信息中心實測含 **Annual Reports（年報頁 80.8KB）** 與 **Publications / e-Publications**，新聞實測含 **2026-08-28 社會債券資金分配更新** 與 **2026-08-24「跨境年金發放」**。⭐ **最關鍵的是按月發布的計劃統計 PDF，本次逐個實測可下載**：**按揭保險計劃統計 2026 年 8 月**（HTTP 200、24.8KB、`application/pdf`）、**逆按揭計劃統計 2026 年 8 月**（HTTP 200、103.5KB、`application/pdf`）、**中小企融資擔保計劃統計 2026 年 7 月**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上香港退休產品與長壽風險這一支**——池內香港條目偏**監管統計**（[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[hk-censtatd-insurance]]）、**公積金平台**（[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[mpfa]]、[[mpfe]]）與**消費者保護**（[[hk-icb]]、[[hkfi]]），而**「公共年金如何定價與運營、逆按揭把房產換成終身收入的機制」此前沒有入口**；HKMC 的**每月逆按揭統計**正是**長壽風險與住房資產年金化**研究的**本地一手數據**，可與 [[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[lifeinsurer]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 並讀；**② 「按揭保險」是常被忽略的險種**——**按揭保險**是**信貸風險向保險轉移**的典型安排，HKMC 的**月度按揭保險統計**給出該險種在香港的實際規模；**③ 政策側信號**——**跨境年金發放**（2026-08）與社會債券資金分配，是**大灣區養老金融**的本地觀察點。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面結構與三個統計 PDF 及年報頁的具體鏈接（均實測可下載/可訪問）**，**但未打開 PDF 正文**；**② 公共年金計劃本身由獨立實體「HKMC Annuity Limited」運營**——本次實測 `hkmca.com.hk` **連接失敗（000）**，其站點**無法核實**，故詞條**只寫 HKMC 本體**；**③** HKMC 官網未見 `annuity` 路徑（實測 **404**）；**④** 統計為**按月發布**，**歷史期次未逐一驗證**。**核實說明**：首頁、年報頁、兩個統計 PDF 均 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開 PDF 正文**。

entries.body:
**上海保险交易所（SHIE）** 是**中国保险市场的基础设施机构**（经国务院批准设立的保险资产登记与交易平台）。本条目属本轮「**中国形态缺口**」：实测池内 **SHIE 相关条目为 0**，而池内中国侧已有监管（[[nfra-portal]]、[[nfra-statistics]]、[[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]）、行业组织（[[china-insurance-association]]、[[china-actuarial-association]]）与工具/课程（[[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]] 等），**缺的正是「市场基础设施」这一层**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 66KB，导航结构实测完整——**关于我们**（公司简介 / **信息披露** / 公司构架 / 大事记）、**综合服务**（**登记流程服务** / **业务流程服务** / **交易融资服务** / **信息管理服务** / **运营管理服务** / **风控合规服务**）、**新闻中心**（保交所动态 / 媒体看保交所 / 公告通知）、**政策法规**（法律法规 / 部门规章 / **业务规则**）、**会员专区**（会员登录 `huiyuan.shie.com.cn` / 会员须知）；其中 **信息披露页 40KB、业务规则页 45KB 均实测 200**。⭐ 首页实测另给出两块具体业务平台：**「新能源车险交易平台」**（自述为「为新能源车险专属产品服务的综合交易服务平台」）与 **「区块链服务平台」**（底层技术、服务内容与业务场景）。⚠️ **如实标注一处**：**区块链服务平台页 `/iec/iec.html` 实测仅 541 字节**（近乎壳页），**故词条只写「首页列出该平台」，不对其内容作实质描述**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「保险市场基础设施」这一形态**——池内条目多集中在**产品、模型、数据与监管**，而**「保单/保险资产在哪里登记、如何交易融资、风控合规如何被平台化」**此前没有入口；对做**保险资金运用、保险资产交易、资产负债管理**方向的学生，SHIE 的服务清单本身就是**中国保险资金链条的结构图**（登记 → 业务流程 → 交易融资 → 信息管理 → 运营管理 → 风控合规）。**② 新能源车险是一个真实的中国特色业务**——中国是全球最大新能源汽车市场，**新能源车险专属产品**在定价与赔付上有显著差异（电池、智能驾驶、维修网络），SHIE 的交易平台说明这一险种已形成**专门的产品与交易基础设施**；与池内车险与车联网条目（[[insurance-telematics]]、[[driver-behavior-telematics]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]）可并读。**③ 区块链与信息管理**反映中国保险基础设施的技术路线，可与 [[insurance-data-tools]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 等「数据与接口」条目对照。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页导航结构、信息披露页与业务规则页（均 200）**，**但未打开任何披露文件或业务规则正文**，因此**不能确认其规则内容与披露口径**；**②** **会员专区需要账号**（`huiyuan.shie.com.cn` 登录），**非会员无法核实会员侧功能**；**③** 区块链平台页 541 字节、**不构成可核实的服务描述**（已如实写明）；**④** 本站**不提供精算模型或直接可下载的统计数据集**（中国保险业统计数据见 [[nfra-statistics]] 与 [[china-insurance-association]]）。**核实说明**：首页（66KB）、信息披露页（40KB）、业务规则页（45KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取导航与正文；**未打开披露文件或规则正文，未登录会员区**。
entries.body_en:
**The Shanghai Insurance Exchange (SHIE)** is an **infrastructure institution of China’s insurance market** (an insurance asset registration and trading platform established with State Council approval). This entry follows this round’s "**China form gap**" approach: a measured search found **zero SHIE-related entries**, while the China side of the corpus already holds supervision ([[nfra-portal]], [[nfra-statistics]], [[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]), industry bodies ([[china-insurance-association]], [[china-actuarial-association]]) and tools/courses ([[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]], [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]] and others) — what was missing is precisely **the market-infrastructure layer**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 66KB and its navigation is fully measurable — **About us** (company profile / **information disclosure** / organisational structure / milestones), **integrated services** (**registration process services** / **business process services** / **trading and financing services** / **information management services** / **operations management services** / **risk and compliance services**), **news centre** (SHIE news / media coverage / announcements), **policies and regulations** (laws / departmental rules / **business rules**) and a **members’ area** (member login at `huiyuan.shie.com.cn` / member notes); the **information disclosure page (40KB)** and **business rules page (45KB)** were both measured at 200. ⭐ The homepage also names two concrete business platforms: a **"New Energy Vehicle Insurance Trading Platform"** (described as an integrated trading service platform for NEV-specific insurance products) and a **"Blockchain Service Platform"** (underlying technology, services and business scenarios). ⚠️ **One thing stated honestly**: the **blockchain platform page `/iec/iec.html` measured only 541 bytes** (essentially a shell), so **this entry records only that the homepage lists the platform and makes no substantive claim about its content**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "insurance market infrastructure" form** — corpus entries cluster around **products, models, data and regulation**, while **"where policies and insurance assets are registered, how they are traded and financed, and how risk and compliance are platformised" had no entry point**; for students working on **insurer asset allocation, insurance asset trading or ALM**, SHIE’s service list is itself **a structural map of China’s insurance capital chain** (registration → business process → trading and financing → information management → operations → risk and compliance). **② New-energy-vehicle insurance is a genuinely China-specific line** — China is the world’s largest NEV market, and **NEV-specific products** differ materially in pricing and claims (batteries, assisted driving, repair networks), so a dedicated trading platform shows the line has acquired **its own product and trading infrastructure**; readable with the motor and telematics entries [[insurance-telematics]], [[driver-behavior-telematics]], [[insurance-frequency-severity]] and [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]. **③ Blockchain and information management** reflect the technology path of Chinese insurance infrastructure, comparable to data-and-interface entries such as [[insurance-data-tools]] and [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage navigation, the information disclosure page and the business rules page (all 200)** **but opened no disclosure document or rule text**, so **their contents and disclosure conventions cannot be confirmed**; **②** the **members’ area requires an account** (`huiyuan.shie.com.cn` login), so **member-side functionality could not be verified**; **③** the blockchain platform page at 541 bytes **does not constitute a verifiable service description** (recorded as such); **④** the site **offers no actuarial models or directly downloadable statistical datasets** (Chinese insurance statistics are in [[nfra-statistics]] and [[china-insurance-association]]). **Verification note**: the homepage (66KB), information disclosure page (40KB) and business rules page (45KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their navigation and text read; **no disclosure document or rule text was opened and the members’ area was not entered**.
entries.body_hk:
**上海保險交易所（SHIE）** 是**中國保險市場的基礎設施機構**。本條目屬本輪「**中國形態缺口**」：實測池內 **SHIE 相關條目為 0**，而池內中國側已有監管（[[nfra-portal]]、[[nfra-statistics]]、[[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]）、行業組織（[[china-insurance-association]]、[[china-actuarial-association]]）與工具/課程，**缺的正是「市場基礎設施」這一層**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 66KB，導航結構完整——**關於我們**（公司簡介／**信息披露**／公司構架／大事記）、**綜合服務**（**登記流程服務**／**業務流程服務**／**交易融資服務**／**信息管理服務**／**運營管理服務**／**風控合規服務**）、**新聞中心**、**政策法規**（法律法規／部門規章／**業務規則**）、**會員專區**；其中**信息披露頁 40KB、業務規則頁 45KB 均實測 200**。⭐ 首頁另給出兩塊具體業務平台：**「新能源車險交易平台」** 與 **「區塊鏈服務平台」**。⚠️ **如實標注一處**：**區塊鏈服務平台頁實測僅 541 字節**（近乎殼頁），**故只寫「首頁列出該平台」，不對其內容作實質描述**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「保險市場基礎設施」這一形態**——池內條目多在**產品、模型、數據與監管**，而**「保單／保險資產在哪裏登記、如何交易融資、風控合規如何平台化」**此前沒有入口；SHIE 的服務清單本身就是**中國保險資金鏈條的結構圖**。**② 新能源車險是中國特色業務**——中國是全球最大新能源汽車市場，**專屬產品**在定價與賠付上差異顯著，交易平台說明該險種已有**專門的產品與交易基礎設施**，可與 [[insurance-telematics]]、[[driver-behavior-telematics]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]] 並讀。**③ 區塊鏈與信息管理**可與 [[insurance-data-tools]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 對照。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁導航、信息披露頁與業務規則頁（均 200）**，**但未打開任何披露文件或規則正文**；**② 會員專區需要賬號**，**非會員無法核實會員側功能**；**③** 區塊鏈平台頁 541 字節、**不構成可核實的服務描述**；**④** 本站**不提供精算模型或可直接下載的統計數據集**。**核實說明**：首頁、信息披露頁、業務規則頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開披露文件或規則正文，未登錄會員區**。

entries.title: WHO 全球卫生观测站（GHO）与 WHO 死亡率数据库：带置信区间的官方健康数据 API
entries.title_en: WHO Global Health Observatory (GHO) and WHO Mortality Database: official health data with a working API and confidence intervals
entries.title_hk: WHO 全球衛生觀測站（GHO）與 WHO 死亡率數據庫：帶置信區間的官方健康數據 API
entries.summary: 世界卫生组织数据门户：GHO 指标库可经 OData API 取数（实测返回含上下界的期望寿命值），另有 WHO 死亡率数据库
entries.summary_en: The World Health Organization’s data portal: the GHO indicator catalogue is queryable through a working OData API (a life-expectancy value with bounds was retrieved live), plus the WHO Mortality Database
entries.summary_hk: 世界衛生組織數據門戶：GHO 指標庫可經 OData API 取數（實測返回含上下界的期望壽命值），另有 WHO 死亡率數據庫
entries.body:
**WHO 全球卫生观测站（GHO）** 是世界卫生组织的**官方健康数据门户**，也是本轮的**死亡率/发病率数据源轴**的第一条——实测池内 **WHO、CDC、Eurostat、IHME/GBD 相关条目全部为 0**，即**「官方死因与疾病负担数据源」这一整层此前是空白**（池内只有 [[human-mortality-db]] 一系人口死亡率库与其 R/Julia 客户端）。

可核实信息（**均实测**）：GHO 门户 `/data/gho` HTTP 200（147.7KB）；**WHO 死亡率数据库页 `/data/data-collection-tools/who-mortality-database` HTTP 200（104.4KB）**；⭐ **最关键的是其数据接口实测可用**——`https://ghoapi.azureedge.net/api/Indicator` 返回 **200、`application/json`、414.7KB**，内含 `@odata.context`（OData 服务）与真实指标目录（如 `ABORTION_ADMISSIONS`、`Adult_curr_cig_smoking` 等，含 `IndicatorCode`/`IndicatorName`/`Language` 字段）；进一步实测**具体指标数据端点** `…/api/WHOSIS_000001`（期望寿命），返回记录包含 **空间维度类型 `COUNTRY`、`SpatialDim: "SOM"`（索马里）、`ParentLocation: "Eastern Mediterranean"`、性别维度 `Dim1: "SEX_MLE"`、`TimeDim: 2008`，以及带上下界的值 `Value: "48.0 [46.7-49.6]"`、`NumericValue: 48.0375`、`Low: 46.7168`、`High: 49.6285`**，并附数据时间戳——**即这是一个可直接取数、且自带置信区间字段的官方 API**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「疾病与死因」这一层**——人寿与健康险定价、长寿风险分析与准备金评估都需要**分死因、分性别、分国家人群**的数据，而池内此前只有**总人口死亡率库**（[[human-mortality-db]]、[[hmdhfdplus]]、[[hmd-jl]]）与**建模包**（[[mortalitylaws]]、[[pymort]]、[[apc-r]]、[[multipopulation-mortality-models]]）；**WHO 死亡率数据库与 GHO 指标库填的正是「死因构成、期望寿命、健康指标」这一层**，可与 [[lifeinsurer]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]、[[comorbidity]]、[[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]] 并读。**② API 自带 `Low`/`High` 字段**——这在精算上很实用：**不确定性区间可以直接进入敏感性分析**，比只给点估计的库省一步；**③ OData 形态**也意味着可用通用客户端或 `$filter/$top` 查询参数取数。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**门户页、死亡率数据库页、指标目录端点与一个具体指标数据端点（含完整返回结构）**，**但未系统检索指标全集、未做国别批量取数，也未与各国官方统计交叉核对**；**②** WHO 数据有**已知的报告时滞与口径差异**（不同国家上报质量不一），**本词条不评价其数据质量**；**③** OData 接口需**支持 OData 的客户端或手工构造查询**，**并非即插即用的 DataFrame**；**④** WHO Mortality Database 的**下载方式与许可条款本次未逐项核实**。**核实说明**：GHO 门户（147.7KB）、WHO 死亡率数据库页（104.4KB）、`/api/Indicator`（414.7KB JSON）、`/api/WHOSIS_000001`（含 SOM 2008 期望寿命记录的完整返回）均实测；**未做批量取数或交叉核对**。
entries.body_en:
The **WHO Global Health Observatory (GHO)** is the World Health Organization’s **official health data portal**, and the first entry in this round’s **mortality and morbidity data source axis** — a measured search found **zero entries for WHO, CDC, Eurostat or IHME/GBD**, meaning **the entire layer of "official cause-of-death and disease-burden data" was missing** (the corpus held only the [[human-mortality-db]] population-mortality family and its R/Julia clients).

Verifiable details (**all measured**): the GHO portal `/data/gho` returned HTTP 200 (147.7KB); the **WHO Mortality Database page `/data/data-collection-tools/who-mortality-database`** returned HTTP 200 (104.4KB); ⭐ **most importantly, its data interface is measurably live** — `https://ghoapi.azureedge.net/api/Indicator` returned **200, `application/json`, 414.7KB** containing `@odata.context` (an OData service) and a real indicator catalogue (`IndicatorCode`, `IndicatorName`, `Language`, e.g. `ABORTION_ADMISSIONS`, `Adult_curr_cig_smoking`). A **specific data endpoint was then exercised**: `…/api/WHOSIS_000001` (life expectancy) returned a record with **spatial dimension type `COUNTRY`, `SpatialDim: "SOM"` (Somalia), `ParentLocation: "Eastern Mediterranean"`, sex dimension `Dim1: "SEX_MLE"`, `TimeDim: 2008`, and a value carrying bounds — `Value: "48.0 [46.7-49.6]"`, `NumericValue: 48.0375`, `Low: 46.7168`, `High: 49.6285`** — plus a data timestamp. **In other words, this is an official API that returns data directly and carries confidence-interval fields.**

For RIAA: **① it adds the "disease and cause of death" layer** — life and health insurance pricing, longevity analysis and reserving all need **cause-, sex- and country-specific population data**, and the corpus previously held only **total-population mortality databases** ([[human-mortality-db]], [[hmdhfdplus]], [[hmd-jl]]) and **modelling packages** ([[mortalitylaws]], [[pymort]], [[apc-r]], [[multipopulation-mortality-models]]); the WHO Mortality Database and GHO indicator catalogue supply exactly **that layer of cause composition, life expectancy and health indicators**, readable with [[lifeinsurer]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]], [[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]], [[comorbidity]] and [[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]]. **② The API carries `Low`/`High` fields** — practically useful actuarially, because **uncertainty bounds can feed sensitivity analysis directly**, saving a step relative to point-estimate-only sources; **③ the OData form** also means generic clients or `$filter`/`$top` query parameters can be used.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the portal page, the mortality database page, the indicator catalogue endpoint and one specific data endpoint (with its full return structure)**, **but did not systematically enumerate indicators, pull country batches, or cross-check against national statistics**; **②** WHO data has **known reporting lags and definitional differences across countries**, and **this entry does not assess its data quality**; **③** the OData interface requires **an OData-capable client or hand-built queries** and is **not a ready-made DataFrame**; **④** the **download methods and licensing terms** of the WHO Mortality Database **were not verified item by item**. **Verification note**: the GHO portal (147.7KB), the WHO Mortality Database page (104.4KB), `/api/Indicator` (414.7KB JSON) and `/api/WHOSIS_000001` (including the full Somalia-2008 life-expectancy record) were all measured; **no batch extraction or cross-check was performed**.

**WHO 全球衛生觀測站（GHO）** 是世界衛生組織的**官方健康數據門戶**，也是本輪**死亡率／發病率數據源軸**的第一條——實測池內 **WHO、CDC、Eurostat、IHME/GBD 相關條目全部為 0**，即**「官方死因與疾病負擔數據源」這一整層此前空白**。

可核實資訊（**均實測**）：GHO 門戶 HTTP 200（147.7KB）；**WHO 死亡率數據庫頁 HTTP 200（104.4KB）**；⭐ **最關鍵的是其數據接口實測可用**——`/api/Indicator` 返回 **200、`application/json`、414.7KB**，含 `@odata.context`（OData 服務）與真實指標目錄；進一步實測**具體指標端點** `/api/WHOSIS_000001`（期望壽命），返回記錄含 **空間維度 `COUNTRY`、`SpatialDim: "SOM"`（索馬里）、`ParentLocation: "Eastern Mediterranean"`、性別維度 `Dim1: "SEX_MLE"`、`TimeDim: 2008`，以及帶上下界的值 `Value: "48.0 [46.7-49.6]"`、`Low: 46.7168`、`High: 49.6285`**——**即這是可直接取數、且自帶置信區間欄位的官方 API**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「疾病與死因」這一層**——池內此前只有**總人口死亡率庫**（[[human-mortality-db]]、[[hmdhfdplus]]、[[hmd-jl]]）與**建模包**（[[mortalitylaws]]、[[pymort]]、[[apc-r]]）；WHO 填的正是**死因構成、期望壽命、健康指標**這一層，可與 [[lifeinsurer]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]、[[comorbidity]] 並讀；**② API 自帶 `Low`/`High` 欄位**——**不確定性區間可直接進入敏感性分析**；**③ OData 形態**意味著可用通用客戶端或 `$filter/$top` 取數。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**門戶頁、死亡率數據庫頁、指標目錄端點與一個具體指標數據端點**，**但未系統檢索指標全集、未做批量取數、未與各國官方統計交叉核對**；**②** WHO 數據有**已知報告時滯與口徑差異**，**本詞條不評價其數據質量**；**③** OData 接口**並非即插即用的 DataFrame**；**④** 死亡率數據庫的**下載方式與許可條款未逐項核實**。**核實說明**：四項均實測；**未做批量取數或交叉核對**。

entries.title: Eurostat：欧盟统计局数据库与 JSON-stat API（期望寿命实测可取数）
entries.title_en: Eurostat: the EU statistics database and its JSON-stat API (life expectancy retrieved live)
entries.title_hk: Eurostat：歐盟統計局數據庫與 JSON-stat API（期望壽命實測可取數）
entries.summary: 欧盟官方统计机构：数据库含死因、期望寿命、人口与医疗等口径，API 实测返回 JSON-stat 数据（demo_mlexpec 更新于 2026-06-04）
entries.summary_en: The EU statistics office: a database covering causes of death, life expectancy, population and health, with an API verified to return JSON-stat data (demo_mlexpec updated 2026-06-04)
entries.summary_hk: 歐盟官方統計機構：數據庫含死因、期望壽命、人口與醫療等口徑，API 實測返回 JSON-stat 數據（demo_mlexpec 更新於 2026-06-04）
entries.body:
**Eurostat（欧盟统计局）** 是**欧盟的官方统计机构**，其数据库与 API 是**欧洲人口与健康口径**的权威来源。本条属本轮**死亡率/发病率数据源轴**——实测池内 **Eurostat 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均实测**）：**数据库页 `/web/main/data/database` HTTP 200（193.7KB）**；⭐ **其统计 API 实测可直接取数**——调用 `ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/statistics/1.0/data/demo_mlexpec`（**按年龄与性别的期望寿命**，`format=JSON`、`time=2023`）返回 **200、`application/json`、7.76MB**，正文为 **JSON-stat 格式**，含 `label: "Life expectancy by age and sex"`、`source: "ESTAT"`、**`updated: "2026-06-04T23:00:00+0200"`** 与真实数值（如 81.1、81.5、75.1、83.3、82.4、79.0 等）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上欧盟口径的人口与健康数据**——池内欧洲侧此前缺**统计口径**入口（有的是欧盟监管口径 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] 与成员国监管机构），而**期望寿命、死因、人口结构与医疗资源**这类**精算建模输入**此前没有直接数据源；**② 与前一条 WHO 互补**——WHO 提供**全球分死因与健康指标**（[[who-gho]]），Eurostat 提供**欧盟成员国口径、且更新及时**（实测数据集更新日 2026-06-04）的结构化数据，两者叠加可做**「全球 → 欧盟 → 成员国」的数据对齐**；**③ API 形态清晰**——**JSON-stat 是可在 R/Python 中解析的标准格式**（`jsonstat`/`pyjstat` 一类库），适合直接接入建模流水线；**④** 与池内死亡率建模条目（[[human-mortality-db]]、[[mortalitylaws]]、[[demotools]]）及 [[retirement-planning]]、[[lifeinsurer]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]] 可组成「**数据 → 建模 → 产品**」的链条。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次实测了**数据库页与一个具体数据集的 API 返回（含数据集标签、来源与更新时间）**，**但未系统检索全部相关数据集（如死因统计、人口预测），也未与各国统计局原始数据交叉核对**；**② JSON-stat 返回体积可能很大**（本次 7.76MB），**需要按维度过滤后再使用**；**③** 数据集口径与 **EU/EFTA/候选国覆盖差异**本次未逐项核实；**④** 本条目**不主张**该 API 覆盖保险业数据（保险监管数据见 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]）。**核实说明**：数据库页（193.7KB）与 `demo_mlexpec` API 返回（7.76MB JSON-stat，updated 2026-06-04）均实测；**未系统检索或交叉核对**。
entries.body_en:
**Eurostat** is **the European Union’s statistical office**, and its database and API are the authoritative source for **European population and health measures**. This entry belongs to the current **mortality and morbidity data source axis** — a measured search found **zero Eurostat-related entries**.

Verifiable details (**all measured**): the **database page `/web/main/data/database`** returned HTTP 200 (193.7KB); ⭐ **its statistical API was verified to return data directly** — calling `ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/statistics/1.0/data/demo_mlexpec` (**life expectancy by age and sex**, `format=JSON`, `time=2023`) returned **200, `application/json`, 7.76MB** of **JSON-stat**, containing `label: "Life expectancy by age and sex"`, `source: "ESTAT"`, **`updated: "2026-06-04T23:00:00+0200"`** and real values (81.1, 81.5, 75.1, 83.3, 82.4, 79.0 and others).

For RIAA: **① it adds EU-level population and health data** — the European side of the corpus previously lacked a **statistical** entry point (it had the EU regulatory angle in [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] and member-state supervisors), while **life expectancy, causes of death, population structure and health resources** — the actual **inputs to actuarial modelling** — had no direct source; **② it complements the previous entry** — WHO supplies **global cause-of-death and health indicators** ([[who-gho]]) while Eurostat supplies **EU-member-state data that is kept current** (the measured dataset updated 2026-06-04), so the two together allow **"global → EU → member state" alignment**; **③ the API form is clean** — **JSON-stat is a standard format parsable in R and Python** (libraries such as `jsonstat`/`pyjstat`), which plugs into a modelling pipeline; **④** with the corpus’s mortality-modelling entries ([[human-mortality-db]], [[mortalitylaws]]) and [[retirement-planning]], [[lifeinsurer]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]], it completes a **data → model → product** chain.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check exercised **the database page and one concrete dataset API return (with its label, source and update date)**, **but did not systematically enumerate related datasets (such as causes of death or population projections) nor cross-check against national statistical offices**; **② JSON-stat responses can be large** (7.76MB here) and **should be filtered by dimension before use**; **③** dataset definitions and **EU/EFTA/candidate-country coverage differences** were not verified item by item; **④** this entry **does not claim the API covers insurance-industry data** (insurance regulatory data is in [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]). **Verification note**: the database page (193.7KB) and the `demo_mlexpec` API return (7.76MB JSON-stat, updated 2026-06-04) were both measured; **no systematic enumeration or cross-check was performed**.
entries.body_hk:
**Eurostat（歐盟統計局）** 是**歐盟的官方統計機構**。本條屬**死亡率／發病率數據源軸**——實測池內 **Eurostat 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均實測**）：**數據庫頁 HTTP 200（193.7KB）**；⭐ **其統計 API 實測可直接取數**——`…/statistics/1.0/data/demo_mlexpec`（**按年齡與性別的期望壽命**，`format=JSON`、`time=2023`）返回 **200、`application/json`、7.76MB** 的 **JSON-stat**，含 `label: "Life expectancy by age and sex"`、`source: "ESTAT"`、**`updated: "2026-06-04T23:00:00+0200"`** 與真實數值。

對 RIAA：**① 補上歐盟口徑的人口與健康數據**——池內歐洲側此前缺**統計口徑**入口；**② 與 [[who-gho]] 互補**——WHO 給**全球分死因與健康指標**，Eurostat 給**歐盟成員國口徑且更新及時**的結構化數據，可做「**全球 → 歐盟 → 成員國**」對齊；**③ JSON-stat 是可在 R/Python 中解析的標準格式**，適合接入建模流水線；**④** 與池內死亡率建模條目及 [[retirement-planning]]、[[lifeinsurer]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]] 組成「**數據 → 建模 → 產品**」鏈條。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次實測了**數據庫頁與一個具體數據集的 API 返回**，**但未系統檢索全部相關數據集，也未與各國統計局交叉核對**；**② JSON-stat 返回體積可能很大**（本次 7.76MB），**需按維度過濾後使用**；**③** 數據集覆蓋差異未逐項核實；**④** 本條目**不主張**該 API 覆蓋保險業數據。**核實說明**：兩項均實測；**未系統檢索或交叉核對**。

entries.body:
**CDC WONDER** 是**美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）下属国家卫生统计中心（NCHS）的在线数据查询系统**，长期是**美国死亡率与发病率分析**的标准工具。本条属本轮**死亡率/发病率数据源轴**——实测池内 **CDC/WONDER 相关条目为 0**（池内美国健康险侧有 [[cms-open-data]]、[[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]、[[medicare-claims-pricer]]、[[hhs-hcc-sql]] 等，但**死因与发病率数据**这一层缺位）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：系统首页 `wonder.cdc.gov` 183.8KB；**多死因数据库页 `/mcd.html` 170.2KB**；**ICD-10 扩展根本死因数据库页 `/ucd-icd10-expanded.html` 174.9KB**。页面正文实测可见其数据集清单，包括 **「Multiple Cause of Death」** 与 **「Provisional Multiple Cause of Death Data 2018 - Last Week」**（**临时数据更新至最近一周**），并列出可按**单一种族分类（6 组 / 15 组 / 31 组）与年龄组（单岁 / 五岁组）**等维度拆分——**即数据更新频率高、维度细**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上美国死因数据**——美国是池内健康险与寿险条目最密集的市场之一，但**「人群死因构成与发病率」这一底层数据此前没有入口**；对做**健康险定价、寿险经验分析或疾病负担**研究的学生，WONDER 是**可以按年龄/性别/种族/地区/年份自由切分**的官方人口健康数据源，可与 [[human-mortality-db]]（人群死亡率库）、[[who-gho]] 与 [[eurostat]]（国际口径）形成**「美国 → 国际」对照**。**② 临时数据（provisional，更新至最近一周）在精算上有特殊价值**——**常规人口死亡率库通常滞后 1–2 年**，而 WONDER 的临时数据可用于**监测近期死亡率异常**（例如流行病或极端天气年份），这对**长寿风险的近期跟踪**有实际意义（可与 [[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[mortalitylaws]]、[[pymort]]、[[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]] 并读）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① CDC WONDER 是「在线查询式」系统而非批量下载库**——使用者需在页面上**构造查询并同意使用条款**后才能取数，**本次只核实了页面可访问与数据集名称，未提交任何查询、未导出任何数据**；**②** 系统对**小样本单元格通常有抑制规则**（这是此类美国公共数据的通行做法），**具体阈值本次未逐条核实，故不作具体数字表述**；**③** 临时数据**可能随后续修订而变化**，引用时须注意版本与取数日期；**④** 本次**未核实其 API/程序化访问方式**（历史上 WONDER 的程序化访问有限制）。**核实说明**：首页（183.8KB）、多死因页（170.2KB）、ICD-10 扩展根本死因页（174.9KB）HTTP 200 实测，并读取页内数据集清单文本；**未提交查询、未导出数据、未核实程序化访问**。
entries.body_en:
**CDC WONDER** is the **US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s (CDC) online data query system** run by the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS), and has long been the standard tool for **US mortality and morbidity analysis**. This entry belongs to the current **mortality and morbidity data source axis** — a measured search found **zero CDC/WONDER-related entries** (the corpus’s US health-insurance side holds [[cms-open-data]], [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]], [[medicare-claims-pricer]] and [[hhs-hcc-sql]], but **the cause-of-death and morbidity layer was missing**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the system homepage `wonder.cdc.gov` is 183.8KB; the **Multiple Cause of Death page `/mcd.html`** is 170.2KB; the **ICD-10 expanded underlying cause of death page `/ucd-icd10-expanded.html`** is 174.9KB. The page text shows its dataset list, including **"Multiple Cause of Death"** and **"Provisional Multiple Cause of Death Data 2018 - Last Week"** (**provisional data updated to the most recent week**), and lists breakdowns by **single race categories (6, 15 or 31 groups) and age groups (single-year or five-year cohorts)** — i.e. **frequent updates and fine granularity**.

For RIAA: **① it adds US cause-of-death data** — the US is one of the markets with the densest health- and life-insurance coverage in the corpus, yet **the underlying layer of population cause composition and morbidity had no entry point**; for students working on **health insurance pricing, life experience analysis or disease burden**, WONDER is an official population-health source **freely sliceable by age, sex, race, geography and year**, and it forms a **US-to-international contrast** with [[human-mortality-db]] (population mortality), [[who-gho]] and [[eurostat]]. **② The provisional data (updated to the latest week) has special actuarial value** — **conventional population mortality databases usually lag one to two years**, whereas WONDER’s provisional series allows **monitoring of recent mortality anomalies** (pandemic or extreme-weather years), which matters for **near-term tracking of longevity risk** (readable with [[cmi-mortality-projections]], [[mortalitylaws]], [[pymort]] and [[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]]).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① CDC WONDER is an online query system, not a bulk-download library** — users must **build a query and accept terms of use** before extracting data, and **this check verified only page reachability and dataset names; no query was submitted and no data was exported**; **② the system generally applies suppression rules to small cells** (standard practice for such US public data), but **the specific thresholds were not verified here, so no figure is asserted**; **③ provisional data may be revised later**, so citations should note the version and extraction date; **④** this check **did not verify programmatic/API access** (WONDER has historically restricted it). **Verification note**: the homepage (183.8KB), the multiple cause page (170.2KB) and the ICD-10 expanded underlying cause page (174.9KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their dataset-list text read; **no query was submitted, no data exported and no programmatic access verified**.

**CDC WONDER** 是**美國疾控中心（CDC）下屬國家衛生統計中心（NCHS）的在線數據查詢系統**，長期是**美國死亡率與發病率分析**的標準工具。本條屬**死亡率／發病率數據源軸**——實測池內 **CDC/WONDER 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：系統首頁 183.8KB；**多死因數據庫頁 170.2KB**；**ICD-10 擴展根本死因數據庫頁 174.9KB**。頁面正文實測可見數據集清單，包括 **「Multiple Cause of Death」** 與 **「Provisional Multiple Cause of Death Data 2018 - Last Week」**（**臨時數據更新至最近一週**），並列出可按**種族分類（6／15／31 組）與年齡組（單歲／五歲組）**拆分。

對 RIAA：**① 補上美國死因數據**——美國是池內健康險與壽險條目最密集的市場之一，但**「人群死因構成與發病率」這一底層數據此前沒有入口**；**② 臨時數據（更新至最近一週）在精算上有特殊價值**——**常規人口死亡率庫通常滯後 1–2 年**，臨時數據可用於**監測近期死亡率異常**，對**長壽風險的近期跟蹤**有實際意義（可與 [[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[mortalitylaws]]、[[pymort]] 並讀）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① CDC WONDER 是「在線查詢式」系統而非批量下載庫**，**本次只核實頁面可訪問與數據集名稱，未提交任何查詢、未導出任何數據**；**②** 系統對**小樣本單元格通常有抑制規則**，**具體閾值本次未逐條核實，故不作具體數字表述**；**③** 臨時數據**可能隨後續修訂變化**；**④** 本次**未核實其程序化訪問方式**。**核實說明**：三頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未提交查詢、未導出數據**。
