entries.title_en: IHME Global Burden of Disease (GBD): the GHDx data catalog and results tool
entries.title_hk: IHME 全球疾病負擔研究（GBD）：GHDx 數據目錄與結果工具
entries.summary: 华盛顿大学 IHME 的疾病负担研究：GHDx 数据目录（GBD 2021 等）与 GBD 结果工具，广泛用于健康与寿险的发病率研究
entries.summary_en: The University of Washington’s IHME disease-burden programme: the GHDx data catalog (GBD 2021 and others) and the GBD results tool, widely used for morbidity work in health and life insurance
entries.summary_hk: 華盛頓大學 IHME 的疾病負擔研究：GHDx 數據目錄（GBD 2021 等）與 GBD 結果工具，廣泛用於健康與壽險的發病率研究
entries.body:
**IHME（健康测量与评价研究所，华盛顿大学）的全球疾病负担研究（GBD）** 是**全球疾病、伤害与风险因素负担**的主流量化项目，其数据被**健康险、寿险与公共卫生**领域广泛引用。本条属本轮**死亡率/发病率数据源轴**——实测池内 **IHME/GBD 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**GHDx 数据目录站 `ghdx.healthdata.org` 首页 45.7KB**；**GBD 2021 研究目录页 `/gbd-2021` 63.7KB**（实测有独立页面标题与内容）；**GBD 结果工具入口 `/gbd-results-tool` 5.8KB（4? 实测为 6.3KB）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「疾病负担」这一层**——池内卫生/健康侧已有健康险定价工具（[[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]）、美国行政数据（[[cms-open-data]]、[[hhs-hcc-sql]]）与共病相关条目（[[comorbidity]]），但**「按国家、年龄、性别、年份与病因的疾病负担估计」此前没有数据源**；GBD 提供的正是**发病率、患病率、伤残权重（YLD）与早死损失（YLL）**一类**健康险与失能险建模需要的口径**（可与 [[insurance-survival]]、[[insurance-multilevel]]、[[apc-r]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]] 并读）。**② 与 WHO/Eurostat/CDC 形成完整光谱**——WHO（[[who-gho]]）给**官方会员国上报口径**、Eurostat（[[eurostat]]）给**欧盟成员国统计口径**、CDC WONDER（[[cdc-wonder]]）给**美国行政口径**，而 **GBD 给的是「经统一建模调和后的可比估计」**——四者放在一起，恰好覆盖**「官方上报 → 区域统计 → 单一国家 → 调和估计」**四种数据性质，这一点对做**跨市场发病率比较**的学生尤其重要（**不同来源的差异本身就是研究问题**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① GBD 是「建模估计」而非原始行政记录**——其数值由统计模型调和产生，**引用时必须说明这一点**，不可与各国官方登记数据等同；**②** 本次核实到**GHDx 首页与 GBD 2021 页面可访问、结果工具入口存在**，**但结果工具为前端应用（页面极小，实测 6.3KB）**，**其取数流程、下载条件与注册要求未核实**，**故词条不描述具体操作步骤**；**③** GBD 版本迭代频繁（2021 版为本次核实版本），**引用须写明版本与取数日期**；**④** 使用条款与引用规范**本次未逐项核实**。**核实说明**：GHDx 首页（45.7KB）、`/gbd-2021`（63.7KB）、`/gbd-results-tool`（6.3KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未下载任何 GBD 数据、未核实下载条件**。
entries.body_en:
**The Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME) at the University of Washington runs the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) study**, the mainstream quantification of **global disease, injury and risk-factor burden**, widely cited in **health insurance, life insurance and public health**. This entry belongs to the current **mortality and morbidity data source axis** — a measured search found **zero IHME/GBD-related entries**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the **GHDx catalog site `ghdx.healthdata.org`** homepage is 45.7KB; the **GBD 2021 study page `/gbd-2021`** is 63.7KB (with its own page title and content); the **GBD results tool entry `/gbd-results-tool`** measured 6.3KB.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "disease burden" layer** — the health side of the corpus already holds health-pricing tooling ([[insurance-glm-tools]], [[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]), US administrative data ([[cms-open-data]], [[hhs-hcc-sql]]) and comorbidity entries ([[comorbidity]]), but **estimates of disease burden by country, age, sex, year and cause had no source**; GBD supplies exactly **incidence, prevalence, years lived with disability (YLD) and years of life lost (YLL)** — the measures **health and disability insurance modelling need** (readable with [[insurance-survival]], [[insurance-multilevel]], [[apc-r]] and [[longevity-mortality-investor]]). **② Together with WHO, Eurostat and CDC it completes a spectrum** — WHO ([[who-gho]]) gives **official member-state reporting**, Eurostat ([[eurostat]]) **EU member-state statistics**, CDC WONDER ([[cdc-wonder]]) **US administrative reporting**, while **GBD gives harmonised, modelled comparable estimates** — four sources covering **official reporting → regional statistics → single country → harmonised estimates**, which matters especially for students doing **cross-market morbidity comparisons**, where **the differences between sources are themselves a research question**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① GBD figures are modelled estimates, not raw administrative records** — they arise from statistical harmonisation, and **citations must say so** rather than equating them with national registration data; **②** this check verified **that the GHDx homepage and the GBD 2021 page are reachable and that a results-tool entry exists**, **but the results tool is a front-end application (the page measured only 6.3KB)**, and **its data-extraction flow, download conditions and registration requirements were not verified**, so **no operational steps are described**; **③** GBD is revised frequently (2021 was the version verified here), so **citations should state the version and extraction date**; **④** terms of use and citation requirements **were not verified item by item**. **Verification note**: the GHDx homepage (45.7KB), `/gbd-2021` (63.7KB) and `/gbd-results-tool` (6.3KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no GBD data was downloaded and no download conditions were verified**.
entries.body_hk:
**IHME（華盛頓大學健康測量與評價研究所）的全球疾病負擔研究（GBD）** 是**全球疾病、傷害與風險因素負擔**的主流量化項目，其數據被**健康險、壽險與公共衛生**廣泛引用。本條屬**死亡率／發病率數據源軸**——實測池內 **IHME/GBD 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：**GHDx 數據目錄站首頁 45.7KB**；**GBD 2021 研究頁 63.7KB**；**GBD 結果工具入口 6.3KB（前端應用）**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「疾病負擔」這一層**——池內健康側已有定價工具（[[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]）、美國行政數據（[[cms-open-data]]、[[hhs-hcc-sql]]）與共病條目（[[comorbidity]]），但**「按國家/年齡/性別/年份/病因的疾病負擔估計」此前沒有數據源**；GBD 提供**發病率、患病率、YLD 與 YLL** 一類口徑（可與 [[insurance-survival]]、[[insurance-multilevel]]、[[apc-r]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]] 並讀）。**② 與 WHO／Eurostat／CDC 形成完整光譜**——WHO（[[who-gho]]）**官方上報**、Eurostat（[[eurostat]]）**歐盟統計**、CDC WONDER（[[cdc-wonder]]）**美國行政**、**GBD 給「經建模調和後的可比估計」**，四者覆蓋「**官方上報 → 區域統計 → 單一國家 → 調和估計**」，對做**跨市場發病率比較**尤為重要（**來源差異本身就是研究問題**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① GBD 是「建模估計」而非原始行政記錄**，**引用時必須說明**；**②** 本次核實到**GHDx 首頁與 GBD 2021 頁可訪問、結果工具入口存在**，**但結果工具為前端應用（6.3KB）**，**取數流程、下載條件與註冊要求未核實**；**③** GBD 版本迭代頻繁，**引用須寫明版本與取數日期**；**④** 使用條款與引用規範**未逐項核實**。**核實說明**：三頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載任何 GBD 數據**。

entries.body:
**世界银行开放数据（World Bank Open Data）** 是**全球最常用的国别社会经济指标数据源之一**，也是本轮「**国际统计数据 API 层**」的第一条。实测池内 **World Bank 相关条目为 0**（此前的 4 条命中经查为其他条目引用世界银行**作为数据来源**，并非其数据平台本身）。

可核实信息（**均实测**）：门户 `data.worldbank.org` HTTP 200（212.2KB）；⭐ **API 实测可取数**——调用 `https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/CHN/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL?format=json&per_page=2` 返回 **200、`application/json`**，正文为**两段式结构**（先元数据、后数据数组），元数据含 **`"lastupdated":"2026-07-13"`、`sourceid: "2"`、`total: 66`**，数据含 **中国（`countryiso3code: "CHN"`）总人口指标 `SP.POP.TOTL`：`date: "2025"`、`value: 1406585000`**。⚠️ **一处如实的性能说明**：该 API 在本环境**首次请求出现过连接失败与超时**（先后 000 与 60 秒超时），**重试后正常返回**——故词条写明「可用但响应可能较慢，建议加重试」。

对 RIAA：**① 补上国别社会经济指标层**——池内宏观/情景侧目前主要靠**经济情景生成器**（[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[pyesg]]、[[esg-generator-python]]、[[hull-white-esg-checks]]）与**宏观下行预测**（[[atrisk]]、[[insurance-nowcast]]），但这些工具**本身不提供原始宏观数据**；世界银行 API 正好补上**「GDP、人口、卫生支出、金融普惠」等输入指标**，可用于**保险需求建模、市场进入分析、偿付能力情景的宏观驱动因子**。**② API 形态友好**——`/v2/country/{国家}/indicator/{指标}?format=json` 结构简单，**可批量拼接（多国 × 多年）**，且**元数据自带更新日期**，便于在论文里标注数据截止时点；**③ 与谁/欧/Eurostat 互补**——本会话前一轮已收 [[who-gho]]（健康与死因）、[[eurostat]]（欧盟统计）、[[cdc-wonder]]（美国死因）；世界银行补的是**全球国别社会经济口径**，四者叠加可支撑**「社会经济条件 → 健康结果 → 保险需求」**的跨市场分析链条。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次**只实测了一个指标（中国总人口）**，**未系统检索指标全集**，也未验证世界银行著名的 **Global Findex（金融普惠，与小额保险直接相关）** 等子库是否同样可通过该 API 取到——**故词条不列具体子库承诺**；**②** 该 API **在本环境出现首次慢/失败、重试成功**（已如实写明）；**③** 世界银行数据**本身来自各国上报，存在口径与时滞差异**，**本词条不评价其数据质量**；**④** 使用条款与引用规范**本次未逐项核实**。**核实说明**：门户（212.2KB）与 `SP.POP.TOTL` API 返回（200，含 lastupdated=2026-07-13 与 CHN 2025 值 1406585000）均实测；**未系统检索指标或子库**。
entries.body_en:
**World Bank Open Data** is **one of the most widely used sources of country-level socio-economic indicators**, and the first entry in this round’s "**international statistics API layer**". A measured search found **zero World Bank-related entries** (four earlier matches turned out to be other entries citing the World Bank **as a data source**, not its data platform).

Verifiable details (**all measured**): the portal `data.worldbank.org` returned HTTP 200 (212.2KB); ⭐ **the API was verified to return data** — calling `https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/CHN/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL?format=json&per_page=2` returned **200, `application/json`**, whose body is a **two-part structure** (metadata first, then the data array): the metadata contains **`"lastupdated":"2026-07-13"`**, `sourceid: "2"` and `total: 66`, while the data contains **China (`countryiso3code: "CHN"`) total population (`SP.POP.TOTL`): `date: "2025"`, `value: 1406585000`**. ⚠️ **One honest performance note**: in this environment the API **failed or timed out on the first attempts** (a connection error and a 60-second timeout) and **returned normally on retry** — so the entry states "usable, but responses may be slow; retries recommended".

For RIAA: **① it adds the country socio-economic indicator layer** — the corpus’s macro and scenario side relies on **economic scenario generators** ([[economicscenariogenerators-jl]], [[pyesg]], [[esg-generator-python]], [[hull-white-esg-checks]]) and **macro downside forecasts** ([[atrisk]], [[insurance-nowcast]]), but those tools **do not themselves supply raw macro data**; the World Bank API supplies exactly the **input indicators — GDP, population, health expenditure, financial inclusion** — usable for **insurance demand modelling, market-entry analysis and the macro drivers of solvency scenarios**. **② The API form is friendly** — `/v2/country/{country}/indicator/{indicator}?format=json` is simple, **batchable across countries and years**, and **carries its own update date in the metadata**, which helps date-stamp data in a dissertation; **③ it complements WHO, Eurostat and CDC** — the previous round added [[who-gho]] (health and causes of death), [[eurostat]] (EU statistics) and [[cdc-wonder]] (US causes of death); the World Bank adds the **global country socio-economic lens**, so the four together support a **"socio-economic conditions → health outcomes → insurance demand"** chain across markets.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check exercised **only one indicator (China total population)** and **did not systematically enumerate the indicator catalogue**, nor verify whether well-known sub-databases such as **Global Findex (financial inclusion, directly relevant to microinsurance)** are equally retrievable through this API — so **the entry promises no specific sub-database**; **②** the API **was slow/failed at first in this environment and succeeded on retry** (recorded above); **③** World Bank data **comes from national reporting and carries definitional and lag differences**, and **this entry does not assess its data quality**; **④** terms of use and citation requirements **were not verified item by item**. **Verification note**: the portal (212.2KB) and the `SP.POP.TOTL` API response (200, with `lastupdated` 2026-07-13 and the CHN 2025 value 1406585000) were both measured; **no systematic enumeration of indicators or sub-databases was performed**.
entries.body_hk:
**世界銀行開放數據（World Bank Open Data）** 是**全球最常用的國別社會經濟指標數據源之一**，也是本輪「**國際統計數據 API 層**」的第一條。實測池內 **World Bank 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均實測**）：門戶 HTTP 200（212.2KB）；⭐ **API 實測可取數**——`/v2/country/CHN/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL?format=json` 返回 **200、`application/json`**，正文為**兩段式（元數據 + 數據）**，元數據含 **`"lastupdated":"2026-07-13"`**，數據含**中國總人口 `SP.POP.TOTL`：`date: "2025"`、`value: 1406585000`**。⚠️ **一處如實的性能說明**：該 API 在本環境**首次請求出現過失敗與超時**，**重試後正常返回**，故詞條寫明「可用但可能較慢，建議加重試」。

對 RIAA：**① 補上國別社會經濟指標層**——池內宏觀/情景側靠**經濟情景生成器**（[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[pyesg]]、[[esg-generator-python]]、[[hull-white-esg-checks]]）與**宏觀下行預測**（[[atrisk]]、[[insurance-nowcast]]），但**本身不提供原始宏觀數據**；世界銀行補上**GDP、人口、衛生支出、金融普惠**等輸入指標；**② API 形態友好**（結構簡單、可批量拼接、**元數據自帶更新日期**）；**③ 與 [[who-gho]]、[[eurostat]]、[[cdc-wonder]] 互補**，可支撐「**社會經濟 → 健康結果 → 保險需求**」鏈條。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次**只實測一個指標**，**未系統檢索指標全集**，也未驗證 **Global Findex** 等子庫是否同樣可取——**故不列具體子庫承諾**；**②** 該 API **首次慢/失敗、重試成功**（已寫明）；**③** 數據來自各國上報，**存在口徑與時滯差異**；**④** 使用條款**未逐項核實**。**核實說明**：門戶與 `SP.POP.TOTL` API 返回均實測；**未系統檢索指標或子庫**。

entries.body:
**联合国人口数据门户（UN Population Data Portal）** 承载**联合国人口司**的人口估计与预测，其中包括最广为人知的 **《世界人口展望》（World Population Prospects, WPP）**。本条属本轮**国际统计数据 API 层**——实测池内 **UN WPP 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均实测**）：人口司门户 `population.un.org/wpp/` HTTP 200（26KB）；数据门户 `population.un.org/dataportal/home` HTTP 200（12.4KB）。⭐ **API 实测可用**——调用 `https://population.un.org/dataportalapi/api/v1/indicators` 返回 **200、`application/json`、98.5KB**，正文为分页结构（`pageNumber`/`pageSize`/`total`），**共 86 个指标**，每个指标含 **`name`、`shortName`、`description`，以及维度标记 `dimAge`、`dimSex`、`dimVariant`、`dimCategory`** 与默认维度设置——**即「按年龄、按性别、按情景（variant）」是接口契约的一部分**。⚠️ **一处如实记录**：我原本猜测的下载路径 `/wpp/Download/Standard/MostUsed/` 实测返回 **404，且响应体与门户页同为 26KB**（站点对未命中路径返回同一外壳），**故词条不提供该下载路径**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「人口预测」这一层**——本会话上一轮已收 [[who-gho]]（健康与死因）、[[eurostat]]、[[cdc-wonder]]、[[ihme-gbd]]（疾病负担）与 [[worldbank-data]]（社会经济），但**「未来人口结构」此前没有数据源**；而**养老金、年金、长寿风险与产品定价都需要按年龄/性别的人口预测**，池内现有 [[human-mortality-db]] 一系**是历史死亡率**（[[hmdhfdplus]]、[[hmd-jl]]）、[[mortalitylaws]]、[[demotools]]、[[ungroup]]、[[granmomo-rs]] 一类**是建模与投影工具**——**输入端的官方人口预测正是缺的那一块**。**② `dimVariant` 维度在精算上很实用**——联合国的人口预测自带**不同情景（如中位、高、低生育率）**，这意味着**情景分析可以直接从数据层获得，而不必自行假设**，与 [[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[lifeinsurer]] 的寿命/养老金工作直接衔接。**③** 与 [[worldbank-data]]（社会经济指标）、[[who-gho]]（健康）叠加，可构成**「人口 → 健康 → 社会经济」**的跨市场输入层。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的**只是指标目录端点（86 个指标及其维度元数据）**，**未实际拉取任何人口数据序列**，因此**不能确认数据可用性、覆盖国家数与版本**；**②** 站点为**前端门户结构**（页面体积小），**未命中路径会返回同一外壳**（已实测），**故本词条只给已核实的 API 端点与门户页**；**③** 联合国人口预测**每两年左右更新一版**（WPP 版本号），**引用时必须写明版本与取数日期**——本次**未核实当前版本号**；**④** 使用条款**未逐项核实**。**核实说明**：WPP 门户（26KB）、数据门户（12.4KB）与 `/dataportalapi/api/v1/indicators`（98.5KB，共 86 指标）均实测；**未拉取任何数据序列、未核实版本号**。
entries.body_en:
The **UN Population Data Portal** carries the **UN Population Division’s** population estimates and projections, including the best-known **World Population Prospects (WPP)**. This entry belongs to the current **international statistics API layer** — a measured search found **zero UN WPP-related entries**.

Verifiable details (**all measured**): the Division’s portal `population.un.org/wpp/` returned HTTP 200 (26KB); the data portal `population.un.org/dataportal/home` returned HTTP 200 (12.4KB). ⭐ **The API was verified live** — calling `https://population.un.org/dataportalapi/api/v1/indicators` returned **200, `application/json`, 98.5KB** with a paginated structure (`pageNumber`/`pageSize`/`total`) and **86 indicators**, each carrying **`name`, `shortName`, `description` and the dimension flags `dimAge`, `dimSex`, `dimVariant`, `dimCategory`** plus default dimension settings — i.e. **"by age, by sex, by variant" is part of the interface contract**. ⚠️ **One honest note**: the download path I had guessed, `/wpp/Download/Standard/MostUsed/`, returned **404 with the same 26KB body as the portal** (the site serves one shell for unmatched paths), **so this entry does not offer that download path**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "population projection" layer** — the previous round in this session added [[who-gho]] (health and causes of death), [[eurostat]], [[cdc-wonder]], [[ihme-gbd]] (disease burden) and [[worldbank-data]] (socio-economic indicators), but **future population structure had no source**; and **pensions, annuities, longevity risk and product pricing all require age- and sex-specific population projections**. The corpus’s [[human-mortality-db]] family is **historical mortality** ([[hmdhfdplus]], [[hmd-jl]]) and [[mortalitylaws]], [[demotools]], [[ungroup]], [[granmomo-rs]] are **modelling and projection tools** — **the official population projection on the input side was the missing piece**. **② The `dimVariant` dimension is actuarially useful** — UN projections come with **alternative scenarios (e.g. median, high and low fertility)**, meaning **scenario analysis is available at the data layer rather than needing bespoke assumptions**, connecting directly to longevity and pension work in [[longevity-mortality-investor]], [[retirement-planning]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]] and [[lifeinsurer]]. **③** Layered with [[worldbank-data]] (socio-economic indicators) and [[who-gho]] (health), it forms a **"population → health → socio-economy"** cross-market input layer.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** what was verified is **the indicator catalogue endpoint only (86 indicators and their dimension metadata)**; **no population series was actually pulled**, so **data availability, country coverage and version cannot be confirmed**; **②** the site is a **front-end portal** (small pages) that **returns the same shell for unmatched paths** (measured), so **this entry gives only the verified API endpoint and portal pages**; **③** UN population projections are **revised roughly every two years** (an WPP version number), so **citations must state the version and extraction date** — **the current version number was not verified here**; **④** terms of use **were not verified item by item**. **Verification note**: the WPP portal (26KB), the data portal (12.4KB) and `/dataportalapi/api/v1/indicators` (98.5KB, 86 indicators) were all measured; **no data series was pulled and no version number was verified**.
entries.body_hk:
**聯合國人口數據門戶** 承載**聯合國人口司**的人口估計與預測，含最廣為人知的**《世界人口展望》（WPP）**。本條屬**國際統計數據 API 層**——實測池內 **UN WPP 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均實測**）：人口司門戶 HTTP 200（26KB）；數據門戶 HTTP 200（12.4KB）。⭐ **API 實測可用**——`/dataportalapi/api/v1/indicators` 返回 **200、`application/json`、98.5KB**，**共 86 個指標**，每個含 **`name`／`shortName`／`description` 與維度標記 `dimAge`、`dimSex`、`dimVariant`、`dimCategory`**——**即「按年齡、按性別、按情景」是接口契約的一部分**。⚠️ **如實記錄一處**：我猜測的下載路徑 `/wpp/Download/Standard/MostUsed/` **實測 404 且響應體與門戶同為 26KB**（站點對未命中路徑返回同一外殼），**故不提供該下載路徑**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「人口預測」這一層**——上一輪已收 [[who-gho]]、[[eurostat]]、[[cdc-wonder]]、[[ihme-gbd]]、[[worldbank-data]]，但**「未來人口結構」此前沒有數據源**；而**養老金、年金與長壽風險都需要按年齡/性別的人口預測**，池內 [[human-mortality-db]] 一系**是歷史死亡率**，[[mortalitylaws]]、[[demotools]]、[[ungroup]]、[[granmomo-rs]] **是建模與投影工具**——**輸入端的官方人口預測正是缺的那一塊**。**② `dimVariant` 維度很實用**——聯合國預測自帶**不同情景**，**情景分析可直接從數據層獲得**，與 [[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 直接銜接。**③** 與 [[worldbank-data]]、[[who-gho]] 疊加構成「**人口 → 健康 → 社會經濟**」輸入層。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實的**只是指標目錄端點**，**未實際拉取任何人口數據序列**；**②** 站點為**前端門戶結構**、**未命中路徑返回同一外殼**（已實測）；**③** 聯合國人口預測**約每兩年更新一版**，**引用須寫明版本與取數日期**——**本次未核實當前版本號**；**④** 使用條款**未逐項核實**。**核實說明**：三項均實測；**未拉取任何數據序列**。

entries.body:
**IMF 数据（IMF Data）** 是**国际货币基金组织的官方数据平台**，也是本轮「**国际统计数据 API 层**」的第三条。实测池内 **IMF 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均实测**）：数据门户 `data.imf.org` HTTP 200（319.9KB），页面标题「Data Home」，正文自述为「ACCESS TO ECONOMIC AND FINANCIAL DATA」；门户首页实测另列出 **「AI TOOL FOR ACCESSING OFFICIAL STATISTICS (PREVIEW RELEASE) — Global Trusted Data Commons with StatGPT」**（**用 AI 访问官方统计的工具预览版**），并显示 **「IMF DATA SIGN IN」**（即**部分数据集需要登录**）。⚠️ **一处如实记录**：`imf.org/en/Data` 实测返回 **403**（被拦），而 `data.imf.org` 正常——**故词条只给可访问的 `data.imf.org`**。⭐ **DataMapper API 实测可取数**：`https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/api/v1/indicators` 返回 **200、48.3KB**，**共 132 个指标**（实测标签如 **`NGDP_RPCH`＝Real GDP growth**、**`NGDPD`＝GDP, current prices**、`NGDPDPC`＝GDP per capita、`PPPPGDP`、`PPPSH` 等）；进一步调用 `…/api/v1/NGDP_RPCH/CHN` 返回 **200、121.7KB**，正文为**按国家分组的年度序列**（实测可见 1980 年起的逐年实际 GDP 增长率数值）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上宏观情景所需的原始序列**——池内经济情景与偿付能力工具（[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[pyesg]]、[[esg-generator-python]]、[[hull-white-esg-checks]]、[[vasicekfit]]、[[nelson-siegel-svensson]]、[[solvency2rfr]]）**都需要宏观输入**，而 IMF 提供的是**增长率、通胀、财政与债务**一类**官方且长期一致**的年序列，正适合做**情景校准与回测**；结合 [[atrisk]]（下行情景的密度预测）与 [[insurance-nowcast]]（即时状态估计），可组成**「原始宏观数据 → 分布预测 → 情景」**的链条。**② DataMapper 的形态很适合教学**——`/api/v1/{指标}/{国家}` 一次取一国一指标的**全历史序列**，**结构简单、无需登录**，学生可用几行代码把「某国 40 年 GDP 增长率」拉进作业；**③ 值得注意的一处前沿信号**——门户把**「用 AI 访问官方统计」的工具（StatGPT 预览版）**放在首页，说明**官方统计机构正在把数据入口 agent 化**，这与本 wiki 关注的 [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[governance-mcp]] 一类「监管/数据接口 agent 化」趋势同源。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**门户页、`/api/v1/indicators` 指标目录（132 个）与一个具体指标的国别序列（中国实际 GDP 增长率）**，**但未系统检索全部数据集**，也**未核实需要登录的数据集范围**；**②** `imf.org/en/Data` **实测 403**（已如实记录）；**③** IMF 数据**以成员国上报为基础，存在修订与口径差异**，**版本（如 WEO 期次）在引用时必须写明**——本次**未核实当前 WEO 期次**；**④** DataMapper 的**更新频率与许可条款本次未逐项核实**。**核实说明**：`data.imf.org`（319.9KB）、`/api/v1/indicators`（48.3KB，132 指标）、`/api/v1/NGDP_RPCH/CHN`（121.7KB 年度序列）均实测；`imf.org/en/Data` 403 已记录；**未系统检索数据集、未核实登录范围**。
entries.body_en:
**IMF Data** is the **International Monetary Fund’s official data platform**, and the third entry in this round’s "**international statistics API layer**". A measured search found **zero IMF-related entries**.

Verifiable details (**all measured**): the data portal `data.imf.org` returned HTTP 200 (319.9KB) with the title "Data Home" and the strapline "ACCESS TO ECONOMIC AND FINANCIAL DATA"; the homepage also lists an **"AI TOOL FOR ACCESSING OFFICIAL STATISTICS (PREVIEW RELEASE) — Global Trusted Data Commons with StatGPT"** and shows an **"IMF DATA SIGN IN"** control, i.e. **some datasets require an account**. ⚠️ **One honest note**: `imf.org/en/Data` returned **403** (blocked) while `data.imf.org` works — **so this entry gives only the reachable `data.imf.org`**. ⭐ **The DataMapper API was verified to return data**: `https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/api/v1/indicators` returned **200, 48.3KB** with **132 indicators** (measured labels include **`NGDP_RPCH` = Real GDP growth**, **`NGDPD` = GDP, current prices**, `NGDPDPC` = GDP per capita, `PPPPGDP`, `PPPSH`), and a further call to `…/api/v1/NGDP_RPCH/CHN` returned **200, 121.7KB** containing **country-grouped annual series** (annual real GDP growth values visible from 1980 onward).

For RIAA: **① it adds the raw series macro scenarios need** — the corpus’s economic-scenario and solvency tooling ([[economicscenariogenerators-jl]], [[pyesg]], [[esg-generator-python]], [[hull-white-esg-checks]], [[vasicekfit]], [[nelson-siegel-svensson]], [[solvency2rfr]]) **all require macro inputs**, and the IMF supplies **official, consistently long-run annual series for growth, inflation, fiscal balance and debt** — ideal for **scenario calibration and backtesting**. With [[atrisk]] (density forecasts for downside scenarios) and [[insurance-nowcast]] (nowcasting) it forms a **raw macro data → distributional forecast → scenario** chain. **② The DataMapper form suits teaching** — `/api/v1/{indicator}/{country}` returns **one country-indicator pair with its full history**, **simple, no login required**, so a student can pull "40 years of GDP growth for country X" into an assignment in a few lines; **③ one notable frontier signal** — the portal puts an **AI tool for accessing official statistics (StatGPT preview)** on its homepage, showing that **official statistical agencies are making their data entry points agent-facing**, the same trend as the regulator and data interfaces discussed in [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] and [[governance-mcp]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the portal page, the `/api/v1/indicators` catalogue (132 indicators) and one indicator’s country series (China real GDP growth)**, **but did not systematically enumerate all datasets** nor verify **which datasets require sign-in**; **②** `imf.org/en/Data` **measured 403** (recorded); **③** IMF data **rests on member-state reporting and carries revisions and definitional differences**, and **the version (e.g. the WEO round) must be cited** — **the current WEO round was not verified here**; **④** the DataMapper’s **update frequency and licensing terms were not verified item by item**. **Verification note**: `data.imf.org` (319.9KB), `/api/v1/indicators` (48.3KB, 132 indicators) and `/api/v1/NGDP_RPCH/CHN` (121.7KB annual series) were all measured; `imf.org/en/Data` returned 403 and is recorded; **no systematic dataset enumeration and no verification of the sign-in boundary**.
entries.body_hk:
**IMF 數據（IMF Data）** 是**國際貨幣基金組織的官方數據平台**，也是「**國際統計數據 API 層**」的第三條。實測池內 **IMF 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均實測**）：`data.imf.org` HTTP 200（319.9KB），標題「Data Home」，正文自述「ACCESS TO ECONOMIC AND FINANCIAL DATA」；首頁另列出 **「AI TOOL FOR ACCESSING OFFICIAL STATISTICS (PREVIEW RELEASE) — StatGPT」** 與 **「IMF DATA SIGN IN」**（**部分數據集需登入**）。⚠️ **如實記錄**：`imf.org/en/Data` 實測 **403**（被攔），**故只給可訪問的 `data.imf.org`**。⭐ **DataMapper API 實測可取數**：`/external/datamapper/api/v1/indicators` 返回 **200、48.3KB**，**共 132 個指標**（如 `NGDP_RPCH`＝Real GDP growth、`NGDPD`＝GDP, current prices 等）；`/api/v1/NGDP_RPCH/CHN` 返回 **200、121.7KB**，為**按國家分組的年度序列**（1980 年起）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上宏觀情景所需的原始序列**——池內情景與償付能力工具都需要宏觀輸入，IMF 提供**增長率、通脹、財政與債務**一類**官方且長期一致**的年序列，適合**情景校準與回測**；與 [[atrisk]]、[[insurance-nowcast]] 可組成「**原始宏觀數據 → 分布預測 → 情景**」鏈條。**② DataMapper 形態適合教學**——`/api/v1/{指標}/{國家}` 一次取一國一指標的**全歷史序列**，**無需登入**；**③ 一處前沿信號**——門戶把**「用 AI 訪問官方統計」工具（StatGPT 預覽版）**放在首頁，說明**官方統計機構正在把數據入口 agent 化**，與 [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[governance-mcp]] 同源。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**門戶頁、132 個指標的目錄與一個國別序列**，**但未系統檢索全部數據集**，也**未核實需登入的範圍**；**②** `imf.org/en/Data` **實測 403**（已記錄）；**③** IMF 數據**存在修訂與口徑差異**，**引用必須寫明版本（如 WEO 期次）**——**本次未核實當前期次**；**④** DataMapper 的**更新頻率與許可條款未逐項核實**。**核實說明**：三項均實測；`imf.org/en/Data` 403 已記錄；**未系統檢索數據集**。

entries.body:
**NGFS（央行与监管机构绿色金融网络）气候情景**是全球**气候压力测试的事实基准**——由各国央行与监管机构共同维护，**保险监管与保险公司的气候情景分析（含 ORSA 与气候披露）普遍以其为起点**。本条属本轮的**数据层缺口**取向：实测池内 **NGFS 相关条目为 0**，而池内气候侧已有大量**建模与巨灾工具**（[[climada]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[physrisk]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[perils-ied]]）与**情景生成器**（[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[pyesg]]、[[esg-generator-python]]、[[hull-white-esg-checks]]）——**缺的正是「监管与行业共同认可的情景集」本身**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：NGFS 主站 122.2KB；**情景门户 `/ngfs-scenarios-portal/` 133.4KB**，导航实测含 **Introduction／Explore long-term scenarios／Use long-term scenarios／Data & Resources**；**Data & Resources 页 91.9KB**，其正文实测写明：**「The data and technical resources available here correspond to version 5 of the NGFS scenarios published in November 2024」**，并预告可查**第四批（2023）、第三批（2022）、第二批（2021）与第一批**的数据资源；页面实测链接到 **NGFS IIASA 情景浏览器**（`data.ene.iiasa.ac.at/ngfs/`）、**Climate Impact Explorer**（`climate-impact-explorer.climateanalytics.org`）以及第三方数据集（如 ANU CAMA 的 G-CUBED 建模结果、FINEXUS 的 CPRS 项目）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「情景集」这一层**——气候风险在保险里最终要落到**「用哪套情景、怎么映射到资产与负债」**；池内工具体系（巨灾模型、情景生成器、偿付能力计算 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]]、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]]）**都需要一个公认的情景基准**，NGFS 正是那个基准，且**其版本号（本次实测为第 5 版，2024-11）在论文中必须写明**。**② 结构上可与监管口径对接**——监管气候压力测试（如 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] 所属监管体系、[[iais-icp]] 一类国际框架、[[iais-gimar]] 的全球市场报告）常引用 NGFS 情景，故它同时是**「监管 → 情景 → 保险公司内部模型」**链条的中间环节；**③ 与 ESG/可持续条目并读**——[[esg]]、[[awesome-sustainable-finance]]、[[insurance-scr-data]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**门户结构、Data & Resources 页正文（含第 5 版与 2024-11 的时间信息）与若干资源链接**，**但未下载任何情景数据集**；**② IIASA 情景浏览器页实测仅 1,847 字节（前端应用外壳，含登录跳转）**，**故词条不描述其取数步骤**；**③** 第三方数据集（CAMA G-CUBED、FINEXUS CPRS）**归属与许可未核实**；**④** NGFS 情景**按批次更新**（本次为第 5 版），**历史批次与最新批次口径可能不同**，引用须写明**版本与下载日期**。**核实说明**：主站（122.2KB）、情景门户（133.4KB）、Data & Resources（91.9KB）、IIASA 入口（1.8KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未下载任何情景数据**。
entries.body_en:
**The NGFS (Network for Greening the Financial System) climate scenarios** are the de facto **baseline for climate stress testing** worldwide — maintained by central banks and supervisors, they are **the usual starting point for insurers’ and supervisors’ climate scenario analysis, including ORSA and climate disclosure**. This entry follows the current **data-layer gap** approach: a measured search found **zero NGFS-related entries**, while the corpus’s climate side already holds substantial **modelling and catastrophe tooling** ([[climada]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[physrisk]], [[openquake-engine]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[perils-ied]]) and **scenario generators** ([[economicscenariogenerators-jl]], [[pyesg]], [[esg-generator-python]], [[hull-white-esg-checks]]) — **what was missing is the commonly accepted scenario set itself**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the NGFS main site is 122.2KB; the **scenarios portal `/ngfs-scenarios-portal/`** is 133.4KB and its navigation shows **Introduction / Explore long-term scenarios / Use long-term scenarios / Data & Resources**; the **Data & Resources page** is 91.9KB and its text states verbatim: **"The data and technical resources available here correspond to version 5 of the NGFS scenarios published in November 2024"**, while pointing to the fourth batch (2023), third (2022), second (2021) and first batches. The page links to the **NGFS IIASA Scenario Explorer** (`data.ene.iiasa.ac.at/ngfs/`), the **Climate Impact Explorer** (`climate-impact-explorer.climateanalytics.org`) and third-party datasets (such as ANU CAMA’s G-CUBED modelling results and the FINEXUS CPRS project).

For RIAA: **① it adds the "scenario set" layer** — climate risk in insurance ultimately comes down to **which scenarios are used and how they map onto assets and liabilities**; the corpus’s tooling (catastrophe models, scenario generators, solvency calculations in [[solvency2rfr]], [[ggsolvencyii]], [[sii-equity-risk-scr]], [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]]) **all need an agreed scenario baseline**, and NGFS is that baseline — whose **version number (measured here as version 5, November 2024) must be stated in any citation**. **② It connects to the supervisory chain** — supervisory climate stress tests (the regime behind [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], international frameworks such as [[iais-icp]], and global market reporting such as [[iais-gimar]]) commonly cite NGFS scenarios, so it is also **the middle link in "supervisor → scenario → insurer internal model"**. **③** Read with the sustainability entries [[esg]], [[awesome-sustainable-finance]] and [[insurance-scr-data]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the portal structure, the Data & Resources body text (including version 5 and the November 2024 date) and several resource links**, **but downloaded no scenario dataset**; **② the IIASA Scenario Explorer page measured only 1,847 bytes (a front-end shell with a login redirect)**, so **no extraction steps are described**; **③** the third-party datasets (CAMA G-CUBED, FINEXUS CPRS) **were not verified for ownership or licensing**; **④** NGFS scenarios **are released in batches** (version 5 here) and **earlier and latest batches may differ in definition**, so citations must state **version and download date**. **Verification note**: the main site (122.2KB), scenarios portal (133.4KB), Data & Resources (91.9KB) and the IIASA entry (1.8KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no scenario data was downloaded**.
entries.body_hk:
**NGFS（央行與監管機構綠色金融網絡）氣候情景**是全球**氣候壓力測試的事實基準**，**保險監管與保險公司的氣候情景分析普遍以其為起點**。本條屬**數據層缺口**取向：實測池內 **NGFS 相關條目為 0**，而池內氣候側已有大量**建模與巨災工具**（[[climada]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[physrisk]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[perils-ied]]）與**情景生成器**（[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[pyesg]]、[[esg-generator-python]]、[[hull-white-esg-checks]]）——**缺的正是「監管與行業共同認可的情景集」本身**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：主站 122.2KB；**情景門戶 133.4KB**，導航含 **Introduction／Explore／Use／Data & Resources**；**Data & Resources 頁 91.9KB**，正文實測寫明 **「…correspond to version 5 of the NGFS scenarios published in November 2024」**，並指向第四批（2023）、第三（2022）、第二（2021）與第一批；頁面實測鏈接 **NGFS IIASA 情景瀏覽器**與 **Climate Impact Explorer**，以及第三方數據集。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「情景集」這一層**——氣候風險最終要落到**「用哪套情景、如何映射到資產與負債」**；池內工具（巨災模型、情景生成器、償付能力計算 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]]）**都需要公認的情景基準**，NGFS 正是該基準，**其版本號（本次實測第 5 版，2024-11）在論文中必須寫明**；**②** 監管氣候壓力測試常引用 NGFS 情景，故它同時是**「監管 → 情景 → 保險公司內部模型」**的中間環節；**③** 可與 [[esg]]、[[awesome-sustainable-finance]]、[[insurance-scr-data]] 並讀。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**門戶結構、Data & Resources 正文與資源鏈接**，**但未下載任何情景數據集**；**② IIASA 情景瀏覽器頁實測僅 1,847 字節（前端外殼，含登入跳轉）**，**故不描述取數步驟**；**③** 第三方數據集**歸屬與許可未核實**；**④** NGFS 情景**按批次更新**，引用須寫明**版本與下載日期**。**核實說明**：四項均 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載任何情景數據**。

entries.summary_hk: 美國聖路易斯聯儲的宏觀數據庫：實測免密鑰取得 1947 年起的 GDP 季度序列 CSV，另有正式 API 文檔
entries.body:
**FRED（Federal Reserve Economic Data，圣路易斯联储经济数据）** 是**美国圣路易斯联邦储备银行维护的宏观数据库**，收载数十万条经济时间序列，是**经济研究与情景分析中最常用的免费数据源之一**。本条属本轮**数据层缺口**取向——实测池内 **FRED 相关条目为 0**（原 2 条命中经查为其他条目的误匹配）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 58.6KB；**单个序列页（如 `/series/GDP`）86.6KB**；**正式 API 文档页 `/docs/api/fred/` 36.7KB**；⭐ **最实用的一点：免密钥 CSV 下载实测可用**——`https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=GDP` 返回 **200、`application/csv`、6.4KB**，表头为 `observation_date,GDP`，首几行为 **`1947-01-01,243.164`、`1947-04-01,245.968`、`1947-07-01,249.585`**——**即无需注册、无需 API key 即可取到长历史序列**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「宏观序列」这一层的另一条腿**——上一轮已收 [[worldbank-data]]（国别指标）与 [[imf-data]]（IMF DataMapper），FRED 补的是**美国高频与长历史序列**（GDP、利率、通胀、失业率等），**对利率环境建模、资产负债管理与情景校准直接可用**；与池内 [[vasicekfit]]、[[nelson-siegel-svensson]]（利率曲线）及 [[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[pyesg]]、[[esg-generator-python]]（情景生成）配合，正好形成**「原始序列 → 曲线/模型 → 情景」**的链条。**② 免密钥 CSV 在教学上很实用**——学生**无需申请账号**即可用一条 URL 取到长序列，降低「想做个宏观图先卡在数据获取」的门槛；正式 API（需 key）则适合批量取数。**③** 与 [[atrisk]]、[[insurance-nowcast]]（宏观下行与即时估计）以及 [[imf-data]]、[[worldbank-data]] 可做**跨源一致性比较**（不同机构对同一口径的修订差异本身就是研究素材）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次实测**只取了一个序列（GDP）**，**未验证批量取数、未测试正式 API（需 API key）**；**②** 免密钥 CSV 是站点为**图表导出**提供的便捷通道，**其条款与稳定性未逐项核实**，**不宜假定为长期稳定接口**；**③** FRED 数据**来自各原始机构，修订频繁**，**引用须写明序列 ID 与取数日期**；**④** 部分序列**受第三方版权限制**（站点会标注），**本次未逐条核查所用序列的许可**。**核实说明**：首页（58.6KB）、序列页（86.6KB）、API 文档页（36.7KB）与 `fredgraph.csv?id=GDP`（200，`application/csv`，1947 年起）均实测；**未测试 API key 流程与批量取数**。
entries.body_en:
**FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data)** is the **macro database maintained by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis**, holding hundreds of thousands of economic time series and ranking among the **most used free data sources in economic research and scenario analysis**. This entry follows the current **data-layer gap** approach — a measured search found **zero FRED-related entries** (two earlier matches proved to be false positives from other entries).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the site homepage is 58.6KB; a **single series page (e.g. `/series/GDP`)** is 86.6KB; the **formal API documentation page `/docs/api/fred/`** is 36.7KB; ⭐ **most usefully, keyless CSV download was verified live** — `https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=GDP` returned **200, `application/csv`, 6.4KB** with the header `observation_date,GDP` and first rows **`1947-01-01,243.164`, `1947-04-01,245.968`, `1947-07-01,249.585`** — i.e. **long historical series are retrievable with no registration and no API key**.

For RIAA: **① it adds another leg to the "macro series" layer** — the previous round added [[worldbank-data]] (country indicators) and [[imf-data]] (IMF DataMapper), and FRED adds **US high-frequency and long-history series** (GDP, interest rates, inflation, unemployment), **directly usable for interest-rate environment modelling, ALM and scenario calibration**; with [[vasicekfit]] and [[nelson-siegel-svensson]] (yield curves) and the scenario generators [[economicscenariogenerators-jl]], [[pyesg]] and [[esg-generator-python]], it completes a **raw series → curve/model → scenario** chain. **② The keyless CSV is practically useful for teaching** — students can pull a long series with a single URL **without applying for an account**, removing the "plot one macro chart and get stuck at data access" barrier; the formal API (key required) suits batch extraction. **③** With [[atrisk]] and [[insurance-nowcast]] (macro downside and nowcasting) and with [[imf-data]] and [[worldbank-data]], it supports **cross-source consistency checks** — the revision differences between institutions on the same concept are themselves research material.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check retrieved **only one series (GDP)** and **did not test batch extraction or the formal API (which needs a key)**; **②** the keyless CSV is a convenience channel the site provides **for chart export**, and **its terms and stability were not verified item by item** — it **should not be assumed to be a long-term stable interface**; **③** FRED data **comes from originating agencies and is revised frequently**, so **citations should state the series ID and extraction date**; **④** some series **carry third-party copyright restrictions** (which the site labels), and **the licensing of any particular series was not checked here**. **Verification note**: the homepage (58.6KB), a series page (86.6KB), the API docs page (36.7KB) and `fredgraph.csv?id=GDP` (200, `application/csv`, data from 1947) were all measured; **the API key flow and batch extraction were not tested**.

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 58.6KB；**單序列頁 86.6KB**；**API 文檔頁 36.7KB**；⭐ **最實用的一點：免密鑰 CSV 下載實測可用**——`/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=GDP` 返回 **200、`application/csv`、6.4KB**，表頭 `observation_date,GDP`，首幾行 **`1947-01-01,243.164`、`1947-04-01,245.968`、`1947-07-01,249.585`**——**無需註冊、無需 API key**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「宏觀序列」的另一條腿**——上一輪已收 [[worldbank-data]] 與 [[imf-data]]，FRED 補的是**美國高頻與長歷史序列**，**對利率環境建模、資產負債管理與情景校準直接可用**；與 [[vasicekfit]]、[[nelson-siegel-svensson]] 及情景生成器配合形成**「原始序列 → 曲線/模型 → 情景」**鏈條。**② 免密鑰 CSV 在教學上很實用**（**無需申請帳號**即可取長序列）；**③** 可與 [[atrisk]]、[[insurance-nowcast]]、[[imf-data]]、[[worldbank-data]] 做**跨源一致性比較**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次**只取了一個序列（GDP）**，**未測試批量取數與正式 API（需 key）**；**②** 免密鑰 CSV 是**圖表導出**的便捷通道，**條款與穩定性未逐項核實**，**不宜假定為長期穩定接口**；**③** FRED 數據**修訂頻繁**，**引用須寫明序列 ID 與取數日期**；**④** 部分序列**受第三方版權限制**，**本次未逐條核查許可**。**核實說明**：四項均實測；**未測試 API key 流程與批量取數**。

entries.summary: 欧洲央行数据门户：欧元区金融与宏观统计入口，其中「保险公司与养老金统计（ICPF）」页面实测标注为已停止（discontinued）
entries.summary_en: The ECB’s data portal: the entry point for euro area financial and macro statistics, whose "Insurance Corporations & Pension Funds Statistics (ICPF)" page is measured as marked discontinued
entries.summary_hk: 歐洲央行數據門戶：歐元區金融與宏觀統計入口，其中「保險公司與養老金統計（ICPF）」頁面實測標註為已停止（discontinued）
entries.body:
**ECB Data Portal（欧洲央行数据门户）** 是**欧元区官方金融与宏观统计入口**，也是本轮**数据层缺口**取向的第三条——实测池内 **ECB 相关条目为 0**（池内欧洲侧此前有欧盟监管口径 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、行业联合会 [[insurance-europe]] 与统计局 [[eurostat]]，**但欧洲央行的金融统计入口缺位**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：门户首页 `data.ecb.europa.eu` **272.2KB**；**数据集页 `…/data/datasets/ICPF` 74KB**；**保险相关数据集检索页 `…/data/datasets?search=insurance` 360.9KB**。⚠️ **本轮最值得如实记录的一点**：ICPF 数据集页的**页面标题实测为「Insurance Corporations & Pension Funds Statistics (discontinued) - ICPF | ECB Data Portal」**——**即该数据集已被标注为「已停止」（discontinued）**；门户导航中实测另有 **「Non-bank financial corporations」** 分类（保险公司与养老金统计已并入更广的非银金融机构统计体系）。**故本词条明确写出「ICPF 已停更」，不把它当作现行数据源推荐**，只作为**历史序列与统计体系演变的入口**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上欧元区央行口径的金融统计**——欧洲保险公司**大量持有债券与利率敏感负债**，做**资产负债管理、利率情景与信用风险**时，**欧元区层面的金融统计**（利率、收益率曲线、货币与信贷、非银金融机构）是常用输入；ECB 门户与 [[eurostat]]（统计局口径）、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]（保险监管口径）**三者口径不同但互补**，**「同一市场、三种口径」恰好是很好的方法学练习**（同一指标在三处的定义与覆盖差异）。**② 「数据集被停更」这件事本身有信息量**——ICPF 从独立数据集并入非银金融机构统计，反映**监管统计体系的重组**；对写文献综述的学生，**「某数据集已 discontinued」是必须检查的一步**，本条目把这个事实**直接写在标题与摘要里**，避免误用。**③ 与欧元区宏观序列配套**——可为 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]]（无风险利率）与 [[vasicekfit]]、[[nelson-siegel-svensson]]（曲线建模）提供实证输入。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**门户首页、ICPF 数据集页与其「discontinued」标注、保险相关数据集检索页**，**但未下载任何数据、未核实替代 ICPF 的具体数据集编号**；**②** 门户为**前端应用结构**（首页 272KB、检索页 361KB），**部分数据可能需要登录或通过 API**，**本次未核实取数路径与许可**；**③** 「discontinued」标注是**页面标题的字面事实**，**其停止时间与替代关系未进一步核实**（**故不作时间推断**）；**④** ECB 数据**以欧元区成员国上报为基础，存在口径与修订差异**。**核实说明**：门户首页（272.2KB）、ICPF 数据集页（74KB，标题含 discontinued）、保险数据集检索页（360.9KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未下载数据、未核实替代数据集与许可**。
entries.body_en:
**The ECB Data Portal** is the **official entry point for euro area financial and macro statistics**, and the third entry in this round’s **data-layer gap** approach — a measured search found **zero ECB-related entries** (the European side of the corpus held the EU supervisory angle in [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], the industry federation in [[insurance-europe]] and the statistical office in [[eurostat]], but **the central bank’s financial statistics were missing**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the portal homepage `data.ecb.europa.eu` is **272.2KB**; the **dataset page `…/data/datasets/ICPF`** is 74KB; the **insurance dataset search page `…/data/datasets?search=insurance`** is 360.9KB. ⚠️ **The most important thing to record honestly this round**: the ICPF dataset page’s **measured title is "Insurance Corporations & Pension Funds Statistics (discontinued) - ICPF | ECB Data Portal"** — i.e. **the dataset is marked discontinued**; the portal navigation also shows a **"Non-bank financial corporations"** section (insurance and pension statistics having been folded into the broader non-bank financial institution framework). **This entry therefore states plainly that ICPF is no longer updated and does not recommend it as a current source**, presenting it only as an entry point to historical series and to the evolution of the statistical framework.

For RIAA: **① it adds central-bank-level euro area financial statistics** — European insurers **hold large bond portfolios against interest-sensitive liabilities**, so **euro-area financial statistics** (rates, yield curves, money and credit, non-bank financial institutions) are common inputs for **ALM, interest-rate scenarios and credit risk**; the ECB portal, [[eurostat]] (statistical office) and [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] (insurance supervision) are **three different but complementary lenses on one market** — **the same market measured three ways is itself a good methodological exercise** in how definitions and coverage differ. **② The fact that a dataset was discontinued is informative** — ICPF moved from a standalone dataset into non-bank financial corporation statistics, reflecting a **reorganisation of supervisory statistics**; for anyone writing a literature review, **checking whether a dataset is marked discontinued is a required step**, and this entry puts that fact **directly in its title and summary** to prevent misuse. **③ It pairs with euro area macro series** — supplying empirical input to [[solvency2rfr]] and [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] (risk-free rates) and to [[vasicekfit]] and [[nelson-siegel-svensson]] (curve modelling).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the portal homepage, the ICPF dataset page and its "discontinued" marker, and the insurance dataset search page**, **but downloaded no data and did not identify the specific dataset that replaced ICPF**; **②** the portal is a **front-end application** (homepage 272KB, search page 361KB) where **some data may require sign-in or the API**, and **the extraction path and licensing were not verified**; **③** the "discontinued" marker is **a literal fact of the page title**, and **its date and replacement relationship were not investigated further** (**so no timing inference is made**); **④** ECB data **rests on member-state reporting and carries definitional and revision differences**. **Verification note**: the homepage (272.2KB), the ICPF dataset page (74KB, title containing "discontinued") and the insurance dataset search page (360.9KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no data was downloaded and neither the replacement dataset nor licensing was verified**.
entries.body_hk:
**ECB Data Portal（歐洲央行數據門戶）** 是**歐元區官方金融與宏觀統計入口**，也是本輪**數據層缺口**取向的第三條——實測池內 **ECB 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：門戶首頁 **272.2KB**；**數據集頁 `…/data/datasets/ICPF` 74KB**；**保險相關數據集檢索頁 360.9KB**。⚠️ **本輪最值得如實記錄的一點**：ICPF 數據集頁的**頁面標題實測為「Insurance Corporations & Pension Funds Statistics (discontinued) - ICPF」**——**即該數據集已被標注為「已停止」**；門戶導航實測另有 **「Non-bank financial corporations」** 分類。**故本詞條明確寫出「ICPF 已停更」，不把它當作現行數據源推薦**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上歐元區央行口徑的金融統計**——歐洲保險公司**持有大量債券與利率敏感負債**，做**資產負債管理、利率情景與信用風險**時，**歐元區金融統計**是常用輸入；ECB 門戶與 [[eurostat]]（統計局口徑）、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]（保險監管口徑）**三者互補**——**「同一市場、三種口徑」是很好的方法學練習**。**② 「數據集被停更」本身有信息量**——ICPF 併入非銀金融機構統計，反映**監管統計體系的重組**；本條目把該事實**直接寫在標題與摘要裡**，避免誤用。**③** 可為 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] 與 [[vasicekfit]]、[[nelson-siegel-svensson]] 提供實證輸入。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**門戶首頁、ICPF 頁與其 discontinued 標注、保險數據集檢索頁**，**但未下載任何數據、未核實替代 ICPF 的具體數據集編號**；**②** 門戶為**前端應用結構**，**部分數據可能需登入或走 API**，**未核實取數路徑與許可**；**③** discontinued 是**頁面標題的字面事實**，**其停止時間與替代關係未進一步核實**（**故不作時間推斷**）；**④** ECB 數據**存在口徑與修訂差異**。**核實說明**：三項均 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載數據、未核實替代數據集與許可**。
entries.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（门户首页 data.ecb.europa.eu 272.2KB；数据集页 /data/datasets/ICPF 74KB；保险数据集检索页 /data/datasets?search=insurance 360.9KB）+ ★如实记录：ICPF 数据集页标题实测为「Insurance Corporations & Pension Funds Statistics (discontinued) - ICPF | ECB Data Portal」，即已标注 discontinued，故词条明确写出并明确不作为现行数据源推荐；导航另见 Non-bank financial corporations 分类；未下载数据、未核实替代数据集编号与许可

entries.title_en: PBGC (US Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation): annuity valuation mortality tables and pension insurance statistics
entries.title_hk: PBGC（美國養老金給付保證公司）：年金估值死亡率表與養老金保險統計
entries.summary: 美国养老金给付保险机构：ERISA 4044/4050 死亡率表与退休假设（用于困境终止时年金估值），以及单一/多雇主计划的养老金保险数据

entries.summary_hk: 美國養老金給付保險機構：ERISA 4044/4050 死亡率表與退休假設（用於困境終止時年金估值），以及單一／多雇主計劃的養老金保險數據
entries.body:
**PBGC（Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation，美国养老金给付保证公司）** 是**美国的养老金给付保险机构**——为私营确定给付（DB）计划的参与者提供退休金保障。本条目属本轮的**养老金与退休保障数据层**，也是**形态上很特别的一条**：它本身就是**「养老金 + 保险」的结合体**（用保险机制承接计划终止风险），而池内此前**PBGC 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 71.5KB；⭐ **估值表页 `/employers-practitioners/rates`（72.2KB），页面标题实测为「Mortality, retirement, and present value max guarantee」**，正文写明提供 **「ERISA 4044/4050 mortality tables」——用于「valuing annuities in distress and involuntary plan terminations（困境终止与非自愿终止中的年金估值）」以及 missing participants program 的现行与历史死亡率表**，并另有 **「ERISA 4044 retirement assumptions」（退休假设）**；⭐ **养老金保险数据页 `/about/reports/pension-insurance-data`（83.6KB）**，正文写明「Find **statistics for PBGC’s single-employer and multiemployer programs** and for the **private defined benefit pension system**」，分类含 **Net Financial Position of Program Claims（单一雇主）、Benefit Payments、Coverage、PBGC Premiums** 等，**并实测到可下载文件：`2023-pension-data-tables.pdf`、`2023-pension-data-tables.xlsx`、`2024-pension-data-tables.pdf`**（另有风险转移报告 PDF）；页面另提供**单一雇主与多雇主「当前缴纳 PBGC 保费的计划清单」**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「养老金保障机制」这一形态**——池内养老金相关条目多在产品与数据侧（[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[hkmc]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]），**而「当雇主计划终止、由谁兜底、按什么表估值」此前没有入口**；PBGC 的 **ERISA 4044/4050 死亡率表**正是**终止场景下的法定估值口径**，对做**养老金估值、年金化与计划终止分析**的学生是**可直接引用的官方表**。**② 程序性数据可用于实证**——「单一/多雇主计划统计」与「缴纳保费的计划清单」给出**美国 DB 体系的规模、覆盖率与保费分布**，适合做**养老金风险集中度与保障缺口**研究；**③ 与精算教科书主题直接对应**——年金估值、死亡率表选取、终止假设，都是课程主题在真实制度中的落地。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**两个关键页面的存在、标题与正文要点，以及四个数据文件的链接**，**但未下载或打开任何文件**；**②** 页面正文以**要点列表**呈现，**具体条目的完整内容（如表的年份范围）未逐项核实**；**③** PBGC 数据**受美国制度与法律框架限定**，**不能直接外推到其他市场**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供精算建模工具。**核实说明**：首页（71.5KB）、估值表页（72.2KB）、养老金保险数据页（83.6KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与正文；`2023/2024 pension-data-tables` 等文件链接在页面内实测可见；**未下载文件**。
entries.body_en:
**PBGC (Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation)** is **the United States’ pension benefit insurer**, protecting participants in private defined-benefit (DB) plans. This entry belongs to this round’s **pension and retirement security data layer** and is **unusual in form**: it is itself a **combination of pension and insurance** (an insurance mechanism absorbing plan-termination risk), and the corpus previously held **zero PBGC-related entries**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 71.5KB; ⭐ the **valuation page `/employers-practitioners/rates` (72.2KB)** has the **measured title "Mortality, retirement, and present value max guarantee"** and states that it provides **"ERISA 4044/4050 mortality tables" — for "valuing annuities in distress and involuntary plan terminations"** and for the missing participants programme, current and historical, plus separate **"ERISA 4044 retirement assumptions"**; ⭐ the **pension insurance data page `/about/reports/pension-insurance-data` (83.6KB)** states "Find **statistics for PBGC’s single-employer and multiemployer programs** and for the **private defined benefit pension system**", with categories including **Net Financial Position of Program Claims (single-employer), Benefit Payments, Coverage and PBGC Premiums**, and **measured downloadable files: `2023-pension-data-tables.pdf`, `2023-pension-data-tables.xlsx`, `2024-pension-data-tables.pdf`** (plus a risk-transfer report PDF); the site also offers **current lists of single-employer and multiemployer plans paying PBGC premiums**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "pension protection mechanism" form** — pension entries in the corpus sit mostly on the product and data side ([[mpf-fund-platform]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]], [[hkmc]], [[retirement-planning]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]]), while **"when an employer plan terminates, who stands behind it and by which table is it valued" had no entry point**; PBGC’s **ERISA 4044/4050 mortality tables** are precisely **the statutory valuation basis in termination scenarios**, making them **officially citable tables** for students working on **pension valuation, annuitisation and plan termination**. **② The programme data supports empirical work** — the single/multiemployer statistics and the premium-paying plan lists give **the scale, coverage and premium distribution of the US DB system**, useful for research on **pension risk concentration and protection gaps**; **③ it maps directly onto textbook topics** — annuity valuation, mortality table selection and termination assumptions are course themes landing in a real regime.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and key body points of two pages and the links to four data files**, **but downloaded and opened no file**; **②** the pages present **bullet-point summaries**, and **the full contents of individual items (such as the year ranges of the tables) were not verified item by item**; **③** PBGC data is **bounded by the US institutional and legal framework** and **cannot be extrapolated to other markets**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers actuarial modelling tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (71.5KB), the valuation page (72.2KB) and the pension insurance data page (83.6KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and body text read; the `2023/2024 pension-data-tables` file links were observed on the page; **no file was downloaded**.

entries.body:
**GAD（Government Actuary’s Department，英国政府精算部）** 是**英国政府的内部精算机构**（挂靠 gov.uk），为政府部门提供精算服务。本条目属本轮**养老金与退休保障数据层**——池内 **GAD 相关条目为 0**（英国侧此前有 [[ifoa]] 专业团体与 [[cmi-mortality-projections]] 等，但**政府精算部门的官方出版物入口缺位**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：GAD 机构页 `gov.uk/government/organisations/government-actuarys-department` **105KB**；**出版物清单页 `/government/publications/gad-publications/gad-publications` 71.9KB**；⭐⭐ **《Ogden tables: actuarial compensation tables for injury and death》页 79.6KB**，页面内实测到**官方 PDF 文件链接**（`assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/…/Ogden_Tables_8th_Edition_Upd…`，即**第 8 版**）；页面另实测可见 **GAD Services（服务清单）**、**Climate scenario analysis: internal data collection（气候情景分析内部数据收集指引）**、**Cost control mechanism – Government Actuary’s review（公共部门养老金成本控制机制复核报告）**、**GAD 客户反馈（2025-04 至 2026-03）** 等出版物，以及团队博客 `actuaries.blog.gov.uk`（2026-08-03 一篇关于**养老金数字韧性**）。

对 RIAA：**① 「Ogden Tables」是一件很特别的精算产物**——它是**英国法院在人身伤害与死亡赔偿中使用的官方精算表**（含**折现率与死亡率假设**），把**精算假设直接写进司法赔偿计算**；对学精算的人来说，这是**「精算表 → 法律赔偿金额」**这条链条的**教科书级实例**，池内此前没有同类条目（池内 [[payout-assurance-standard]] 是参数险赔付标准，性质不同）。**② 政府精算部门的职能清单本身有信息量**——GAD Services、公共部门养老金成本控制复核、气候情景分析指引，展示了**「精算师在政府部门做什么」**：公共养老金估值、政策成本评估、气候压力情景，对学生理解**精算的职业边界**很有用（可与 [[actuarial-outpost]]、[[actubase]]、[[dav-ai-professional-profile]] 一类职业路径条目并读）。**③ 英国公共部门养老金**（public service pension schemes）的估值与成本控制，与 [[ifoa]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[retirement-planning]] 以及池内英国条目形成互补。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**机构页、出版物清单页、Ogden Tables 页与其中一个 PDF 的文件链接**，**但未下载或打开任何 PDF**，因此**不能确认表的具体假设、折现率与版本差异**（**版本以页面所示第 8 版为准，未核对是否有更新版**）；**②** gov.uk 页面结构复杂（cookie 与导航占比较大），**本次只提取了可核实的要点**；**③** Ogden Tables **受英国司法辖区限定**，**不能直接用于其他法域**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供建模工具或数据集下载服务。**核实说明**：机构页（105KB）、出版物清单页（71.9KB）、Ogden Tables 页（79.6KB）HTTP 200 实测；`Ogden_Tables_8th_Edition` PDF 链接在页面内实测可见；**未下载或打开 PDF**。
entries.body_en:
**GAD (Government Actuary’s Department)** is **the UK government’s in-house actuarial department** (hosted on gov.uk), providing actuarial services to government departments. This entry belongs to this round’s **pension and retirement security data layer** — the corpus held **zero GAD-related entries** (the UK side had the professional body [[ifoa]] and entries such as [[cmi-mortality-projections]], but **no entry point to the government actuary’s official publications**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the GAD organisation page on gov.uk is **105KB**; the **publications list `/government/publications/gad-publications/gad-publications`** is 71.9KB; ⭐⭐ the **"Ogden tables: actuarial compensation tables for injury and death" page** is 79.6KB and carries a **measured official PDF link** (`assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/…/Ogden_Tables_8th_Edition_Upd…`, i.e. the **8th edition**); the pages also show **GAD Services**, **"Climate scenario analysis: internal data collection"**, the **"Cost control mechanism – Government Actuary’s review"** report, **GAD client feedback (April 2025 to March 2026)** and the team blog `actuaries.blog.gov.uk` (a post of 2026-08-03 on **digital resilience for pensions**).

For RIAA: **① the Ogden Tables are a distinctly actuarial artefact** — they are **the official actuarial tables UK courts use to assess injury and death compensation** (with **discount-rate and mortality assumptions**), placing **actuarial assumptions directly into judicial damages calculation**; for actuarial students this is a **textbook-grade instance of the "actuarial table → legal award" chain**, and the corpus had nothing comparable ([[payout-assurance-standard]] is a parametric payout standard, a different thing). **② The department’s service list is itself informative** — GAD Services, the public service pension cost-control review and climate scenario guidance show **what actuaries do inside government**: public pension valuation, policy cost assessment, climate stress scenarios — useful for understanding **the professional boundary of actuarial work** (readable with career-path entries such as [[actuarial-outpost]], [[actubase]] and [[dav-ai-professional-profile]]). **③ UK public service pensions** — their valuation and cost control complement [[ifoa]], [[cmi-mortality-projections]], [[retirement-planning]] and the corpus’s other UK entries.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the organisation page, the publications list, the Ogden Tables page and a PDF link within it**, **but downloaded and opened no PDF**, so **the tables’ assumptions, discount rates and version differences cannot be confirmed** (**the version is taken as the 8th edition shown on the page; no check was made for a newer edition**); **②** gov.uk pages are structurally complex (cookies and navigation dominate), so **only verifiable points were extracted**; **③** the Ogden Tables **are bounded by the UK jurisdiction** and **cannot be applied directly elsewhere**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers modelling tools or a dataset download service**. **Verification note**: the organisation page (105KB), publications list (71.9KB) and Ogden Tables page (79.6KB) were measured at HTTP 200; the `Ogden_Tables_8th_Edition` PDF link was observed on the page; **no PDF was downloaded or opened**.

entries.body:
**DNB（De Nederlandsche Bank，荷兰央行）** 是**荷兰的中央银行与审慎监管机构**，同时监管**银行、保险公司与养老金基金**。本条目属本轮**养老金与退休保障数据层**——实测池内**荷兰相关条目接近 0**（此前仅有一条会议类误命中），而**荷兰是全球人均养老金资产最高、DB 向 DC 转型最受关注的市场之一**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：DNB 英文首页 **234KB**；⭐ **统计栏目 `/en/statistics`（221.2KB）实测标题为「Statistics | De Nederlandsche Bank」**，正文写明「we provide the latest financial and economic statistics on **household savings, mortgage interest rates and foreign direct investment**. We also publish **data based on supervisory information, such as the average funding ratio of pension funds**」——**即它把「监管信息」直接转化为公开统计，其中包含养老金基金的平均覆盖率**。页面另实测可见 **Pensions 专题入口**（`/en/current-economic-issues/pensions/towards-the-new-pension-system/`，即**荷兰养老金制度改革**专题）与金融监管相关栏目。⚠️ **一处如实记录**：我猜测的 `/en/data` 路径实测 **404**（站点结构以 `/en/statistics` 为准）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上荷兰与「监管信息转统计」这一形态**——池内养老金数据源多为**监管机构发布的行业统计**（[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[hkmc]]、[[fsca]]）或**专业团体**（[[assa]]、[[institut-des-actuaires]]），**而「央行基于监管报送数据发布养老金基金覆盖率」这一形态此前没有**；**覆盖率（funding ratio）是 DB 体系最核心的风险指标**，其历史序列对**低利率环境下的养老金偿付能力**研究是直接材料。**② 荷兰案例本身重要**——荷兰养老金体系**正在从 DB 向 DC 转型**（页面专题即「Towards the new pension system」），对做**养老金改革比较**的学生，这是**与智利 AFP（[[cmf-chile]]）、澳洲 super（[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]）、香港 MPF（[[mpf-fund-platform]]）并列的第五个制度样本**（加上英国 [[gad-uk]] 与美国 [[pbgc]] 共六个）。**③ 家庭储蓄与房贷利率统计**也直接相关——家庭资产负债与住房抵押是**寿险与按揭保险**的需求侧输入（对应 [[hkmc]] 的按揭保险口径）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、统计栏目页的标题与正文要点，以及养老金专题入口**，**但未下载任何统计数据（DNB 统计多通过其 StatLine/API 提供，本次未核实取数路径）**；**②** 覆盖率等数据的**频率、口径与历史长度未核实**；**③** `/en/data` 实测 404（已记录）；**④** DNB 数据**以荷兰监管报送为基础**，**口径与其他市场不可直接比较**。**核实说明**：英文首页（234KB）与 `/en/statistics`（221.2KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取正文；养老金专题链接在页面内实测可见；**未下载统计数据、未核实取数路径**。
entries.body_en:
**DNB (De Nederlandsche Bank)** is **the Dutch central bank and prudential supervisor**, overseeing **banks, insurers and pension funds**. This entry belongs to this round’s **pension and retirement security data layer** — a measured search found **essentially zero Netherlands-related entries** (only one conference item matched by accident), while **the Netherlands has among the highest pension assets per capita and is one of the most watched markets for the DB-to-DC transition**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the DNB English homepage is **234KB**; ⭐ the **statistics section `/en/statistics` (221.2KB)** has the **measured title "Statistics | De Nederlandsche Bank"** and states that DNB provides "the latest financial and economic statistics on **household savings, mortgage interest rates and foreign direct investment**" and also publishes "**data based on supervisory information, such as the average funding ratio of pension funds**" — i.e. it **converts supervisory reporting directly into public statistics, including pension funds’ average funding ratio**. The site also shows a **Pensions topic entry** (`/en/current-economic-issues/pensions/towards-the-new-pension-system/`, i.e. the **Dutch pension reform**) and financial-supervision sections. ⚠️ **One honest note**: the `/en/data` path I guessed measured **404** (the site’s structure runs through `/en/statistics`).

For RIAA: **① it adds both the Netherlands and the "supervisory data turned into statistics" form** — pension data sources in the corpus are mostly **industry statistics published by supervisors** ([[apra-superannuation-statistics]], [[hkmc]], [[fsca]]) or **professional bodies** ([[assa]], [[institut-des-actuaires]]), whereas **"a central bank publishing pension funds’ funding ratio from supervisory reporting" had no precedent**; **the funding ratio is the core risk metric of any DB system**, and its history is direct material for research on **pension solvency in a low-rate environment**. **② The Dutch case matters in itself** — the Dutch system **is shifting from DB to DC** (the site’s own topic is "Towards the new pension system"), making it **a fifth institutional sample** alongside Chile’s AFP ([[cmf-chile]]), Australian super ([[apra-superannuation-statistics]]) and Hong Kong MPF ([[mpf-fund-platform]]) — six including the UK ([[gad-uk]]) and US ([[pbgc]]). **③ Household savings and mortgage-rate statistics** are also relevant — household balance sheets and mortgages are demand-side inputs for **life and mortgage insurance** (matching the mortgage-insurance angle of [[hkmc]]).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage, the title and key body points of the statistics page, and the pensions topic entry**, **but downloaded no statistics** (DNB data is largely served through StatLine/API, and **the extraction path was not verified**); **②** the **frequency, definitions and history length** of the funding-ratio data were not verified; **③** `/en/data` measured 404 (recorded); **④** DNB data **rests on Dutch supervisory reporting** and **is not directly comparable across markets**. **Verification note**: the English homepage (234KB) and `/en/statistics` (221.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their text read; the pensions topic link was observed on the page; **no statistics were downloaded and no extraction path was verified**.

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：英文首頁 **234KB**；⭐ **統計欄目 `/en/statistics`（221.2KB）標題實測為「Statistics | De Nederlandsche Bank」**，正文寫明提供**家庭儲蓄、房貸利率、外商直接投資**等統計，**並基於監管信息發布「養老金基金平均覆蓋率」**；頁面另實測可見**荷蘭養老金制度改革專題入口**與金融監管欄目。⚠️ **如實記錄**：我猜測的 `/en/data` 實測 **404**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上荷蘭與「監管信息轉統計」這一形態**——「**央行基於監管報送發布養老金覆蓋率**」此前沒有；**覆蓋率是 DB 體系最核心的風險指標**，其歷史序列對**低利率環境下的養老金償付能力**研究是直接材料；**② 荷蘭案例本身重要**——正在**由 DB 向 DC 轉型**，構成**第五個制度樣本**（加上 [[cmf-chile]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[mpf-fund-platform]]，以及英國 [[gad-uk]] 與美國 [[pbgc]] 共六個）；**③ 家庭儲蓄與房貸利率統計**是**壽險與按揭保險**的需求側輸入（對應 [[hkmc]]）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁、統計欄目標題與正文要點、養老金專題入口**，**但未下載任何統計數據（DNB 多經 StatLine/API 提供，本次未核實取數路徑）**；**②** 覆蓋率數據的**頻率、口徑與歷史長度未核實**；**③** `/en/data` 實測 404（已記錄）；**④** DNB 數據**口徑不可直接跨市場比較**。**核實說明**：兩頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載統計數據**。

entries.body:
**Pensions Authority（爱尔兰养老金监管局）** 是**爱尔兰的职业养老金监管机构**，监管**职业养老金计划、PRSA（个人退休储蓄账户）与信托 RAC**。本条目属本轮**养老金与退休保障数据层**——池内**爱尔兰相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **226.2KB**；⭐ **开放数据页 `/corporate-governance/open_data/`（214.8KB）**，页面内实测到多份 PDF（如 **《The Pensions Authority Register of Administr…》（文件名含 2026-03，即**行政管理人登记**）、**PRSA 精算相关问与答**、**供款汇缴（remittance of contributions）指引**）；⭐ **欧洲职业养老金计划公开登记册页 `/data/public_register_of_european_occupational_pension_schemes`（200KB）**；页面另实测可见 **Corporate publications（含年报与账目、审计与风险委员会年报）**、**性别薪酬差距报告**、**数据保护声明** 与 **数据共享协议**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「养老金计划登记册」这一形态**——登记册（register）是**监管透明度的直接产物**：谁在运营、哪些计划在册、行政管理人是谁，这类**实体级名录**在池内此前只有零星（如 [[texas-rate-filings]] 的费率申报、[[tpa-transparency-data]] 的透明度数据），**养老金侧的公开登记册此前没有**。**② 与同轮其他养老金机构形成完整光谱**——**美国 [[pbgc]]（给付保险）／英国 [[gad-uk]]（政府精算）／荷兰 [[dnb]]（央行监管统计）／爱尔兰（监管登记册）**，四者展示**同一个「养老金保障」问题在不同制度下的四种机构解法**：**兜底保险、政府精算、央行统计、登记披露**。**③ 「欧洲职业养老金计划」登记册的跨境维度**值得注意——它对应**欧盟 IORP 指令下的跨境计划**，对做**跨境养老金与欧盟监管**的学生是直接入口（可与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[asf-romania]]、[[insurance-europe]] 并读）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、开放数据页、公开登记册页与页内若干 PDF 链接**，**但未打开任何 PDF**，因此**不能确认登记册字段、覆盖范围与更新频率**；**②** 页面文件名中出现的月份（如 2026-03）**仅作链接存在性的证据**，**未据此推断数据更新时间**；**③** 爱尔兰养老金制度**受本国与欧盟框架限定**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供精算建模工具。**核实说明**：首页（226.2KB）、开放数据页（214.8KB）、公开登记册页（200KB）HTTP 200 实测；**未打开任何 PDF**。
entries.body_en:
**The Pensions Authority** is **Ireland’s occupational pension regulator**, supervising **occupational pension schemes, PRSAs (personal retirement savings accounts) and trust RACs**. This entry belongs to this round’s **pension and retirement security data layer** — the corpus held **zero Ireland-related entries**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the site homepage is **226.2KB**; ⭐ the **open data page `/corporate-governance/open_data/` (214.8KB)** carries several measured PDFs (such as **"The Pensions Authority Register of Administr…"** with a 2026-03 filename, i.e. the **administrators register**, **PRSA actuarial questions and answers**, and guidance on the **remittance of contributions**); ⭐ a **public register of European occupational pension schemes page** (`/data/public_register_of_european_occupational_pension_schemes`, 200KB) was also verified; the site additionally shows **corporate publications (annual reports and accounts, audit and risk committee reports)**, **gender pay gap reports**, a **data protection statement** and a **data sharing agreement**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "pension scheme register" form** — a register is a direct product of regulatory transparency: who the operators are, which schemes are on the books, who the administrators are; such **entity-level directories** were previously only sporadic in the corpus (e.g. rate filings in [[texas-rate-filings]], transparency data in [[tpa-transparency-data]]), and **a pension-side public register had no precedent**. **② Together with the other pension bodies added this round it forms a complete spectrum** — the US [[pbgc]] (benefit insurance), the UK [[gad-uk]] (government actuarial), the Netherlands [[dnb]] (central bank supervisory statistics) and Ireland (regulatory registers) show **four institutional answers to the same pension-protection problem**: **insurance backstop, government actuarial work, central bank statistics, register disclosure**. **③ The cross-border dimension of a "European occupational pension schemes" register deserves note** — it corresponds to **cross-border schemes under the EU IORP Directive**, a direct entry point for students of **cross-border pensions and EU supervision** (readable with [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[asf-romania]] and [[insurance-europe]]).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage, the open data page, the public register page and several in-page PDF links**, **but opened no PDF**, so **the register’s fields, coverage and update frequency cannot be confirmed**; **②** month markers in filenames (e.g. 2026-03) **serve only as evidence that the links exist** and **were not used to infer update dates**; **③** Irish pension arrangements **are bounded by national and EU frameworks**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers actuarial modelling tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (226.2KB), open data page (214.8KB) and public register page (200KB) were measured at HTTP 200; **no PDF was opened**.

entries.body:
**Pensionsmyndigheten（瑞典养老金局）** 是**瑞典国家养老金（inkomstpension 收入养老金 + premiepension 保费养老金）的管理机构**。本条目属本轮**填补北欧空白**——实测池内**瑞典、芬兰、挪威、丹麦四国相关条目全部为 0**，而北欧是**养老金制度研究中最常被引用的地区之一**（瑞典的名义确定缴费 NDC 与基金制保费养老金是国际改革模板）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 79.2KB；⭐ **「Statistik och publikationer（统计与出版物）」栏目 `/statistik-och-rapporter`**，下设实测可见：**Årsredovisningar och utgiftsprognoser（年度报告与支出预测）**、**Statistik（统计）**、**Rapporter och svar på regeringsuppdrag（报告与政府委托答复）**、**Undersökningar（调查）**，以及 ⭐ **「Pensions- och typfallsmodellen（养老金与典型情形模型）」`/statistik-och-rapporter/pensionsmodellen`（70KB）**；**统计栏目页 `/statistik-och-rapporter/statistik`（77.9KB）实测标题为「Statistik, publikationer och rapporter | Pensionsmyndigheten」**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「养老金管理机构 + 公开模型」这一形态**——池内养老金机构此前已有六个制度样本（[[pbgc]] 兜底保险、[[gad-uk]] 政府精算、[[dnb]] 央行监管统计、[[pensions-authority-ie]] 登记披露、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 行业统计、[[cmf-chile]] 智利 AFP），而**瑞典这条补的是「管理国家养老金的机构自己发布统计、支出预测与投影模型」**——**尤其是「典型情形模型」：它把「一个普通人的养老金会是多少」变成可复现的计算**，对做**养老金充足性（adequacy）与制度改革评估**的学生是直接可用的工具，而不只是数据。**② 支出预测（utgiftsprognoser）**对应**公共养老金的财政可持续性**，可与 [[un-population-data]]（人口预测）、[[dnb]]（覆盖率）、[[retirement-planning]] 并读；**③ 制度价值**——瑞典的 **NDC + 基金制**组合与智利（纯个人账户）、荷兰（DB→DC 转型）、澳洲（super）构成**四种养老金制度路径**，加上本轮同批的机构条目，池内养老金样本达到**七个**。

entries.body_en:

This entry belongs to this round’s **Nordic gap-filling** — a measured search found **zero Sweden-, Finland-, Norway- or Denmark-related entries**, while the Nordics are **among the most cited regions in pension research** (Sweden’s notional defined-contribution and funded premium pension are international reform templates).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 79.2KB; ⭐ the **"Statistik och publikationer" (statistics and publications) section `/statistik-och-rapporter`** shows **"Årsredovisningar och utgiftsprognoser" (annual reports and expenditure forecasts)**, **"Statistik"**, **"Rapporter och svar på regeringsuppdrag"** (reports and responses to government commissions) and **"Undersökningar"** (surveys), plus ⭐ the **"Pensions- och typfallsmodellen" (pension and typical-case model)** at `/statistik-och-rapporter/pensionsmodellen` (70KB); the **statistics page `/statistik-och-rapporter/statistik` (77.9KB)** has the **measured title "Statistik, publikationer och rapporter | Pensionsmyndigheten"**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "pension administration agency with a published model" form** — the corpus already had six institutional pension samples ([[pbgc]] insurance backstop, [[gad-uk]] government actuarial, [[dnb]] central bank supervisory statistics, [[pensions-authority-ie]] register disclosure, [[apra-superannuation-statistics]] industry statistics, [[cmf-chile]] Chile’s AFP), and **Sweden adds "the agency that administers the state pension publishing its own statistics, expenditure forecasts and projection model"** — **in particular the typical-case model, which turns "what pension will an ordinary person get" into a reproducible calculation**, directly usable for students working on **pension adequacy and reform evaluation**, not merely a data source. **② The expenditure forecasts** speak to **the fiscal sustainability of public pensions**, readable with [[un-population-data]] (population projections), [[dnb]] (funding ratios) and [[retirement-planning]]; **③ institutionally**, Sweden’s **NDC plus funded** combination, alongside Chile (pure individual accounts), the Netherlands (DB-to-DC) and Australia (super), gives **four pension pathways**, bringing the corpus’s pension samples to **seven** with this round’s other entries.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the site is mainly in Swedish** (no English version verified here), so **the language barrier is real**; **②** this check verified **the section structure and the existence and titles of the statistics and model pages**, **but opened no statistical table and did not run the model**, so **definitions, model assumptions and openness cannot be confirmed**; **③** the **format in which the typical-case model is available (web tool, Excel, code) was not verified**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers a general actuarial modelling framework**. **Verification note**: the homepage (79.2KB), the statistics section page (77.9KB) and the model page (70KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no statistical table was opened and the model was not run**.

entries.body:
**Finanssivalvonta（芬兰金融监管局，FIN-FSA）** 是**芬兰的金融监管机构**，监管**银行、保险公司与养老金机构**。本条目属本轮**填补北欧空白**——池内**芬兰相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：英文首页 **217.3KB**；⭐ **统计栏目 `/en/statistics/`（174.3KB，实测标题「Statistics - www.finanssivalvonta.fi」）**；站点顶层导航实测含 **Publications and press releases／Forms／Statistics／Regulation／Reporting／Registers／Contact information**，并另设 **Financial market participants**（按行业分类，含 Banks 等）、**Consumers → Insurances** 分支（实测含**保险中介**、**保险理赔**、**保险种类**、**保险合同终止**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上芬兰**——北欧四国此前在池内均为 0；对做**北欧监管与保险市场比较**的学生，这是继瑞典（本轮 [[pensionsmyndigheten]]、[[finansinspektionen]]）之后的第二块拼图。**② 该站的结构本身有参考价值**——把 **Statistics／Reporting／Registers／Regulation** 拆成顶层栏目，意味着**「统计数据、报送要求、登记册、法规」四件事被明确分开**，这与池内其他监管站点（[[fsca]] 的研究与数据、[[dnb]] 的统计、[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 的行业统计）形成**监管信息架构的比较样本**；其中 **Registers（登记册）** 与 [[pensions-authority-ie]] 的公开登记册同类。**③ 保险消费者侧**（理赔、中介、合同终止）反映**北欧监管对消费者保护口径的重视**，可与 [[hk-icb]]、[[fca-open-data]] 一类消费者保护条目对照。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、统计栏目页与顶层导航结构**，**但未打开任何统计数据集**，因此**不能确认其保险统计的具体口径、频率与覆盖**；**② 站点的英文覆盖度未逐项核实**（芬兰语/瑞典语版本为原版）；**③** 登记册与报送要求**可能需要账号或另设门户**，本次未核实；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供精算工具。**核实说明**：首页（217.3KB）与 `/en/statistics/`（174.3KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与导航；**未打开任何统计数据集**。

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage, the statistics section and the top-level navigation structure**, **but opened no statistical dataset**, so **the specific definitions, frequency and coverage of its insurance statistics cannot be confirmed**; **② English coverage was not verified item by item** (Finnish and Swedish are the original versions); **③** registers and reporting requirements **may require an account or a separate portal, which was not verified**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (217.3KB) and `/en/statistics/` (174.3KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no statistical dataset was opened**.

entries.body:
**Finansinspektionen（瑞典金融监管局，FI）** 是**瑞典的金融监管机构**，监管**银行、保险公司与金融市场**。本条目与 [[pensionsmyndigheten]]（养老金局）、[[finanssivalvonta]]（芬兰监管局）同属本轮**填补北欧空白**，形成**「瑞典：管理机构 + 监管机构」「芬兰：监管机构」**的组合。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：英文首页 **26.9KB**；⭐ **保险栏目 `/en/insurance/`（23.8KB）** 与 **市场栏目 `/en/markets/`** 实测存在；**出版物**实测可见多类报告与决定——**《Financial stability report》2026 期**（`/en/published/reports/stability-report/2026/financial-stability-and-prepardness-20261/`）、**消费者保护报告**（`/en/published/reports/consumer-protection-on-the-financial-market/…`）、**洗钱与恐怖融资风险报告**（`/en/published/reports/reports/2026/prioritised-risks-related-to-money-laundering-terro…`）、以及**处罚决定**（如对某上市公司会计处理不当的警示）；另实测可见 **AML 定期报送将有大改动** 的新闻（2026）；站内另有 **Applying and reporting** 栏目。

对 RIAA：**① 补上瑞典监管侧**——本轮三条瑞典/芬兰条目合起来给出**「同一国家的不同机构分工」**：**养老金局管给付与预测、监管局管审慎与市场行为**；对照池内既有条目（[[dnb]] 荷兰央行、[[fsca]] 南非行为监管、[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 澳洲审慎、[[acpr]] 法国双业监管），**北欧这一组补的是「小型开放经济体 + 高保险渗透率」的制度样本**。**② 报告体系值得注意**——FI 的**出版物结构把「金融稳定」「消费者保护」「反洗钱」「处罚」并列**，这对做**监管有效性与披露比较**的学生是现成的框架对照；其中**金融稳定报告**与 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]] 一类偿付能力主题直接相关。**③ 报送（Reporting）栏目**提示**监管数据来自机构定期报送**，与 [[dnb]]「基于监管信息发布统计」的口径一致。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、保险栏目页、市场栏目页与若干报告/决定的链接**，**但未打开任何报告**，因此**不能确认报告内容与统计口径**；**② 未核实该站是否有保险行业统计数据集**（FI 的统计可能通过瑞典统计局或其他渠道发布，**本次未确认，故不作主张**）；**③** 英文页面体积较小（首页 26.9KB、保险页 23.8KB），**可能少于瑞典语版本内容**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供精算工具。**核实说明**：英文首页（26.9KB）与 `/en/insurance/`（23.8KB）HTTP 200 实测，报告与处罚链接在站内实测可见；**未打开任何报告、未核实是否有保险统计数据集**。
entries.body_en:
**Finansinspektionen (FI)** is **Sweden’s financial supervisory authority**, supervising **banks, insurers and financial markets**. With [[pensionsmyndigheten]] (the pensions agency) and [[finanssivalvonta]] (the Finnish supervisor), this entry belongs to this round’s **Nordic gap-filling**, forming a "**Sweden: administration plus supervision**" and "**Finland: supervision**" combination.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the English homepage is **26.9KB**; ⭐ an **insurance section `/en/insurance/` (23.8KB)** and a **markets section `/en/markets/`** were verified; under **published material** several report types and decisions were observed — the **Financial Stability Report, 2026 edition** (`/en/published/reports/stability-report/2026/financial-stability-and-prepardness-20261/`), a **consumer-protection report** (`/en/published/reports/consumer-protection-on-the-financial-market/…`), a **money-laundering and terrorist-financing risk report** (`/en/published/reports/reports/2026/prioritised-risks-related-to-money-laundering-terro…`) and **sanction decisions** (e.g. a caution to a listed company over accounting), plus a 2026 news item that **periodic AML reporting is changing materially**; the site also has an **Applying and reporting** section.

For RIAA: **① it adds the Swedish supervisory side** — the three Swedish/Finnish entries this round together show **how one country divides the work**: **the pensions agency handles benefits and projections, the supervisor handles prudential and conduct matters**; against existing entries ([[dnb]] the Dutch central bank, [[fsca]] South Africa’s conduct regulator, [[apra-insurance-statistics]] Australian prudential data, [[acpr]] France’s combined banking-and-insurance supervisor), **the Nordic group adds the "small open economy with high insurance penetration" sample**. **② The reporting framework deserves note** — FI lists **financial stability, consumer protection, anti-money-laundering and sanctions side by side**, a ready-made framework for comparing **supervisory effectiveness and disclosure**; the **financial stability report** connects directly to solvency topics such as [[solvency2rfr]], [[ggsolvencyii]] and [[sii-equity-risk-scr]]. **③ The Reporting section** signals that **supervisory data arrives through periodic institution reporting**, consistent with [[dnb]]’s "statistics from supervisory information".

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage, the insurance and markets section pages and links to several reports and decisions**, **but opened no report**, so **their content and statistical definitions cannot be confirmed**; **② it was not verified whether the site publishes insurance-industry statistics** (FI’s statistics may be released via Statistics Sweden or another channel — **not confirmed, so no claim is made**); **③** the English pages are small (homepage 26.9KB, insurance page 23.8KB), **possibly carrying less than the Swedish versions**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the English homepage (26.9KB) and `/en/insurance/` (23.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200, and the report and sanction links were observed on the site; **no report was opened and the existence of an insurance statistics dataset was not verified**.
