entries.body:
**AP7** 是**瑞典保费养老金（premiepension）体系中「默认选项」的公共基金管理人**——瑞典参保人若不自选基金，缴费即进入 AP7 的默认组合（含**股票基金 AP7 Aktiefond** 与**固定收益/杠杆结构**）。本条目属本轮**填补北欧空白**，补的是**「公共默认基金」这一形态**：池内已有大量**资产管理工具与养老金机构**（[[dnb]]、[[pbgc]]、[[pensionsmyndigheten]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]），但**「国家为默认选项设立的公共基金，其回报与年报公开可查」这一条此前没有**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **70.4KB**；⭐ **年度财务报告页 `/english/about-us/annual-financial-reports/`（58KB）** 实测存在；站点新闻实测可见 **「AP7:s avkastning 17,9 procent under första halvåret 2026」**（**2026 年上半年回报 17.9%**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「默认选项基金」这一形态**——**默认选项的设计（默认基金、生命周期调整、杠杆）本身就是养老金政策工具**，而 AP7 是**全球最受关注的公共默认基金之一**；对做**养老金投资与默认选项设计**的学生，其**公开回报与年报**是**可直接引用的实证材料**（与 [[pensionsmyndigheten]] 的统计、[[dnb]] 的覆盖率、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 的基金级数据形成**「管理机构 → 默认基金 → 覆盖率 → 基金级统计」**的链条）。**② 与「回报披露」这一主题相关**——公共基金的年度报告与定期回报是**养老金透明度的样板**，可与 [[pensions-authority-ie]]（登记披露）、[[hkmc]]（计划统计）并读。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、年度财务报告页的存在与首页新闻中的回报数字**，**但未打开年报、未核实回报口径**（如是否含费用、是否杠杆后），**故词条只记录页面实测到的事实，不解释回报来源**；**② 站点以瑞典语为主**，英文页面（`/english/…`）**覆盖度未逐项核实**；**③** AP7 的投资策略（含杠杆与生命周期设计）**本次未核实其官方说明**，**不作描述**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供基金分析工具或投资建议。**核实说明**：首页（70.4KB）与年度财务报告页（58KB）HTTP 200 实测；**未打开年报、未核实回报口径**。
entries.body_en:
**AP7** is **the public fund managing the default option in Sweden’s premium pension (premiepension)** — savers who do not choose a fund have their contributions directed into AP7’s default portfolio (including the **AP7 Aktiefond equity fund** and a fixed-income/leveraged structure). This entry belongs to this round’s **Nordic gap-filling**, adding the "**public default fund**" form: the corpus already holds many **asset-management tools and pension institutions** ([[dnb]], [[pbgc]], [[pensionsmyndigheten]], [[retirement-planning]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]]), but **"a public fund established as the state default option, with published returns and annual reports" had no entry**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the site homepage is **70.4KB**; ⭐ the **annual financial reports page `/english/about-us/annual-financial-reports/` (58KB)** was verified; a site news item shows **"AP7:s avkastning 17,9 procent under första halvåret 2026"** (**a 17.9% return in the first half of 2026**).

For RIAA: **① it adds the "default-option fund" form** — **the design of the default option (default fund, lifecycle adjustment, leverage) is itself a pension policy instrument**, and AP7 is **one of the most watched public default funds worldwide**; for students working on **pension investment and default design**, its **published returns and annual reports are directly citable empirical material** (chaining with the statistics of [[pensionsmyndigheten]], the funding ratios of [[dnb]] and the fund-level data of [[apra-superannuation-statistics]] as an "**administrator → default fund → funding ratio → fund-level statistics**" sequence). **② It bears on return disclosure** — a public fund’s annual reports and periodic returns are a **template for pension transparency**, readable with the register disclosure of [[pensions-authority-ie]] and the scheme statistics of [[hkmc]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage, the existence of the annual financial reports page and the return figure appearing in homepage news**, **but opened no annual report and did not verify the return’s definition** (e.g. whether it is net of fees or levered), so **this entry records only what was measured and does not explain the source of the return**; **② the site is mainly Swedish**, and **English coverage (`/english/…`) was not verified item by item**; **③** AP7’s investment strategy (including leverage and lifecycle design) **was not verified against official documentation, so it is not described**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers fund-analysis tools or investment advice**. **Verification note**: the homepage (70.4KB) and the annual financial reports page (58KB) were measured at HTTP 200; **no annual report was opened and the return definition was not verified**.

entries.body:
**CEPAR（ARC Centre of Excellence in Population Ageing Research，人口老龄化研究卓越中心）** 设于**新南威尔士大学（UNSW）**，是**澳大利亚政府「卓越研究中心」计划资助的老龄化研究机构**。本条属本轮**新形态**：实测池内**「研究机构与研究网络」这一整类此前为 0**（池内有**期刊**（[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]、[[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[geneva-papers]]、[[astin-bulletin]]）、**专业团体**、**监管机构**与**数据源**，但**「做研究并产出可引用成果的机构/网络」缺位**；实测 **CEPAR 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 51.7KB；**研究栏目 `/research`（36.3KB）**，实测按阶段列出研究计划——**Research Program（2025 - present）**、**（2017 - 2024）**、**（2011 - 2017）**；**出版物页 `/publications`（553.3KB，体量显示条目众多）**；⭐ **「CEPAR Data Archive for Population Ageing Futures（人口老龄化未来数据档案）」页 `/cepar-population-ageing-projections`（51.4KB）**；另有 **Annual Reports（年报）** 页。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「老龄化研究机构 + 数据档案」这一形态**——池内人口/死亡率侧已有官方数据（[[un-population-data]] 的联合国人口预测、[[who-gho]]、[[eurostat]]、[[ihme-gbd]]）与建模工具（[[mortalitylaws]]、[[demotools]]、[[granmomo-rs]]），但**「由研究机构维护、面向老龄化未来的专门数据档案与预测」此前没有**；对做**老龄化、长寿风险与养老金可持续性**方向论文的学生，这是**既有一手投影又可引用的研究型来源**。**② 与养老金制度样本互补**——本会话已收七个养老金机构样本（[[pbgc]]、[[gad-uk]]、[[dnb]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[cmf-chile]]、[[pensionsmyndigheten]]），**CEPAR 补的是「学术侧如何看待同一问题」**，可与 [[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[ap7]] 并读。**③ 研究计划的分阶段存档**本身是**学术脉络的现成素材**（2011→2025 三期，看得出研究议程如何演变）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、研究页、出版物页、数据档案页与年报页的存在及页面体量**，**但未打开任何出版物或下载任何数据**，因此**不能确认数据档案的具体字段、许可与开放程度**；**②** 出版物页体积很大（553KB），**说明列表条目多，但本次未统计条目数**；**③** 站点为**研究机构官网**，**不提供精算软件**；**④** 数据档案的**更新频率与访问条件未核实**。**核实说明**：首页（51.7KB）、`/research`（36.3KB）、`/publications`（553.3KB）、`/cepar-population-ageing-projections`（51.4KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未打开出版物、未下载数据**。
entries.body_en:
**CEPAR (the ARC Centre of Excellence in Population Ageing Research)** is hosted at **UNSW** and funded under **Australia’s ARC Centres of Excellence scheme**. This entry introduces a new form this round: a measured search found **the whole category of "research institutions and research networks" absent** (the corpus had **journals** ([[annals-of-actuarial-science]], [[european-actuarial-journal]], [[geneva-papers]], [[astin-bulletin]]), **professional bodies**, **regulators** and **data sources**, but nothing for **institutions and networks that produce citable research**); **CEPAR-related entries measured zero**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 51.7KB; the **research section `/research` (36.3KB)** lists research programmes by phase — **Research Program (2025 - present)**, **(2017 - 2024)** and **(2011 - 2017)**; the **publications page `/publications` (553.3KB**, its size indicating a large catalogue); ⭐ the **"CEPAR Data Archive for Population Ageing Futures" page `/cepar-population-ageing-projections` (51.4KB)**; plus an **Annual Reports** page.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "ageing research centre with a data archive" form** — the population and mortality side of the corpus already has official data ([[un-population-data]] UN projections, [[who-gho]], [[eurostat]], [[ihme-gbd]]) and modelling tools ([[mortalitylaws]], [[demotools]], [[granmomo-rs]]), but **a research-maintained archive and projections aimed specifically at ageing futures had no entry**; for students writing on **ageing, longevity risk and pension sustainability**, this is a **research-grade source that supplies both primary projections and citable studies**. **② It complements the pension institutional samples** — this session has already collected seven ([[pbgc]], [[gad-uk]], [[dnb]], [[pensions-authority-ie]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]], [[cmf-chile]], [[pensionsmyndigheten]]), and **CEPAR adds the academic view of the same questions**, readable with [[retirement-planning]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]] and [[ap7]]. **③ The phased research-programme archive** is itself **ready material on how a research agenda evolved** (three phases from 2011 to 2025).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence and page sizes of the homepage, research page, publications page, data archive page and annual reports page**, **but opened no publication and downloaded no data**, so **the archive’s fields, licensing and openness cannot be confirmed**; **②** the publications page is large (553KB), **indicating many entries, but the number was not counted**; **③** this is a **research institution’s website and offers no actuarial software**; **④** the archive’s **update frequency and access conditions were not verified**. **Verification note**: the homepage (51.7KB), `/research` (36.3KB), `/publications` (553.3KB) and `/cepar-population-ageing-projections` (51.4KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no publication was opened and no data was downloaded**.

entries.body:
**Netspar（Network for Studies on Pensions, Aging and Retirement）** 是**荷兰的养老金研究网络**——由**学界与养老金行业（基金、保险公司、监管与政策部门）共同参与**，属**「产学研网络」**形态。本条与 [[cepar]]、[[nber]] 同属本轮**新形态**（研究机构/网络），实测池内 **Netspar 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **306.8KB**；⭐ **知识中心（Publications）`/en/knowledge-hub/`（294.5KB）**；**在研与已完成研究 `/en/research/`（211.8KB）**；⭐ **项目组 `/en/project-groups/`（176.6KB）**；另有 **For Researchers（面向研究者）** 入口与**按主题组织的页面**（实测含 **well-being and welfare of older people**、**communication and choice**、**work, retirement, housing and healthcare**）；**日程**实测含 **2026-09-24 在鹿特丹的项目组例会**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「产学研网络」这一形态**——它的独特之处是**成果由学界与业界共同生产**：项目组（project groups）把**研究者、养老金基金与保险公司的人放在同一议题下**，因此其**出版物往往比纯学术论文更贴近制度与实务**；对做**荷兰养老金改革（DB→DC）**、**行为金融与退休选择**、**养老金沟通**类题目的学生，这是**比期刊更容易进入的入口**（可与 [[dnb]] 的荷兰覆盖率统计、[[pensionsmyndigheten]] 的瑞典模型并读，形成**「荷兰：监管统计 + 产学研研究」「瑞典：机构统计 + 公开模型」**的对照）。**② 与 [[cepar]]（学术中心）、[[nber]]（经济学工作论文）构成研究来源的三层**——**网络（Netspar）／中心（CEPAR）／国家局（NBER）**，三者在**「谁生产研究、面向谁、以什么形式发布」**上各不相同；**③ 主题分类**（老年福祉、沟通与选择、工作/退休/住房与医疗）本身就是**养老金研究议程的现成地图**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、知识中心、研究页、项目组页与主题/日程链接的存在及页面体量**，**但未打开任何出版物**，因此**不能确认其出版物的评审方式、语言与开放获取状态**；**②** 站点以**荷兰语/英语双语**呈现，**英文覆盖度未逐项核实**；**③** 项目组与例会的**参与门槛（是否需会员）未核实**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供数据或软件。**核实说明**：首页（306.8KB）、`/en/knowledge-hub/`（294.5KB）、`/en/research/`（211.8KB）、`/en/project-groups/`（176.6KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未打开任何出版物、未核实会员门槛**。
entries.body_en:

With [[cepar]] and [[nber]], it belongs to this round’s **new form** (research institutions and networks); **Netspar-related entries measured zero**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **306.8KB**; ⭐ the **knowledge hub (publications) `/en/knowledge-hub/` (294.5KB)**; **ongoing and completed research `/en/research/` (211.8KB)**; ⭐ **project groups `/en/project-groups/` (176.6KB)**; plus a **For Researchers** entry and **theme-based pages** (measured to include **well-being and welfare of older people**, **communication and choice**, and **work, retirement, housing and healthcare**); the **calendar** shows a **project group meeting in Rotterdam on 2026-09-24**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence and page sizes of the homepage, knowledge hub, research page, project groups page and the theme/calendar links**, **but opened no publication**, so **their review process, language and open-access status cannot be confirmed**; **② the site presents Dutch and English**, and **English coverage was not verified item by item**; **③** the **participation threshold for project groups and meetings (whether membership is required) was not verified**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site provides data or software**. **Verification note**: the homepage (306.8KB), `/en/knowledge-hub/` (294.5KB), `/en/research/` (211.8KB) and `/en/project-groups/` (176.6KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no publication was opened and no membership threshold was verified**.

entries.body:
**NBER（National Bureau of Economic Research，美国国家经济研究局）** 是**全球经济学工作论文的主要发布机构**，其**工作论文系列（Working Papers）**长期是**保险经济学研究最早可引用的出处**——**逆向选择、年金市场、健康保险、长寿风险**等主题的经典论文多先以 NBER 工作论文形式出现，随后才进入期刊。本条与 [[cepar]]、[[netspar]] 同属本轮**新形态**（研究机构/网络），实测池内 **NBER 相关条目接近 0**（仅一处文献引用）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 191.5KB；⭐ **工作论文页 `/papers`（72.2KB）**；⭐ **公共数据档案 `/research/data`（71.7KB）**；**研究栏目 `/research`**；**Boston Research Data Center（波士顿研究数据中心）**；另有 **Open Calls（征稿）** 与视频栏目。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「工作论文系列」这一文献形态**——池内已有**期刊**（[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]、[[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[geneva-papers]]、[[astin-bulletin]]）与**文献检索入口**（[[repec-g22]]），但**「论文在期刊之前的首发形态」此前没有**；对写**文献综述**的学生，**NBER 往往能拿到比期刊版更早、且常含完整模型与数据的版本**——这是**检索策略上的实际差别**，不只是多一个站点。**② 公共数据档案是真正可用的数据资源**（`/research/data`），与 [[who-gho]]、[[worldbank-data]]、[[imf-data]]、[[un-population-data]] 一类官方数据源不同，它属于**研究者整理并公开的微观/宏观数据**；**③ 与 [[cepar]]（学术中心，侧重老龄化）、[[netspar]]（产学研网络，侧重荷兰养老金）构成三层**——**国家局（NBER）／中心（CEPAR）／网络（Netspar）**，覆盖**「顶级经济学工作论文 → 区域老龄化研究 → 行业共研」**的不同发布逻辑。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、工作论文页、公共数据档案页与研究栏目、数据中心的存在及体量**，**但未下载任何论文或数据**，因此**不能确认论文的获取条件（是否需订阅或付费）与数据许可**；**②** NBER 工作论文**有版权与访问限制（部分内容需订阅）**，**本次未核实具体限制范围，故不作「完全开放」的表述**；**③** 站点栏目众多（视频、征稿、周期测定等），**本次只核实与检索/数据直接相关的部分**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供精算软件或行业统计。**核实说明**：首页（191.5KB）、`/papers`（72.2KB）、`/research/data`（71.7KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取导航；**未下载论文或数据、未核实访问限制**。
entries.body_en:
**NBER (National Bureau of Economic Research)** is **the world’s leading publisher of economics working papers**, and its **Working Papers series** has long been **the earliest citable source in insurance economics** — classic work on **adverse selection, annuity markets, health insurance and longevity risk** typically appears first as an NBER working paper before reaching a journal. With [[cepar]] and [[netspar]], it belongs to this round’s **new form** (research institutions and networks); **NBER-related entries measured essentially zero** (one bibliographic reference only).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 191.5KB; ⭐ the **working papers page `/papers` (72.2KB)**; ⭐ the **public use data archive `/research/data` (71.7KB)**; the **research section `/research`**; the **Boston Research Data Center**; plus **Open Calls** and a video section.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "working paper series" literature form** — the corpus already holds **journals** ([[annals-of-actuarial-science]], [[european-actuarial-journal]], [[geneva-papers]], [[astin-bulletin]]) and a **literature search entry** ([[repec-g22]]), but **"the pre-journal form in which papers first appear" had no entry**; for students writing **literature reviews**, **NBER frequently provides an earlier version than the journal article, often with the full model and data** — a **practical difference in search strategy**, not merely another website. **② The public use data archive** (`/research/data`) is a genuinely usable data resource; unlike official sources such as [[who-gho]], [[worldbank-data]], [[imf-data]] and [[un-population-data]], this is **data curated and released by researchers**. **③ With [[cepar]] (an academic centre focused on ageing) and [[netspar]] (an industry–academia network focused on Dutch pensions) it forms three layers** — **national bureau / centre / network** — covering **"top economics working papers → regional ageing research → industry co-research"**, three different publication logics.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence and page sizes of the homepage, working papers page, public use data page, research section and data centre**, **but downloaded no paper or data**, so **access conditions (whether subscription or payment is required) and data licensing cannot be confirmed**; **② NBER working papers carry copyright and access restrictions (some content requires a subscription)**, and **the extent of those restrictions was not verified, so no claim of full openness is made**; **③** the site has many sections (videos, calls, business cycle dating) and **only the parts directly relevant to search and data were verified**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers actuarial software or industry statistics**. **Verification note**: the homepage (191.5KB), `/papers` (72.2KB) and `/research/data` (71.7KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with navigation read; **no paper or data was downloaded and access restrictions were not verified**.

對 RIAA：**① 補上「工作論文系列」這一文獻形態**——池內已有**期刊**與**文獻檢索入口**（[[repec-g22]]），但**「論文在期刊之前的首發形態」此前沒有**；對寫**文獻綜述**的學生，**NBER 常能拿到比期刊版更早、且常含完整模型與數據的版本**——這是**檢索策略上的實際差別**；**② 公共數據檔案是真正可用的數據資源**，屬**研究者整理並公開的數據**；**③ 與 [[cepar]]、[[netspar]] 構成三層**（**國家局／中心／網絡**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**相關頁面的存在與體量**，**但未下載任何論文或數據**；**②** NBER 工作論文**有版權與訪問限制（部分需訂閱）**，**本次未核實具體範圍，故不作「完全開放」的表述**；**③** 本次只核實與**檢索/數據**直接相關的部分；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供精算軟件或行業統計。**核實說明**：三頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載論文或數據、未核實訪問限制**。

entries.body:
**Club Vita** 是**面向养老金计划的长寿风险分析机构**，业务覆盖**英国、加拿大与美国**。本条目属本轮**长寿风险与普惠保险**取向——实测池内 **Club Vita 相关条目为 0**，而池内长寿/死亡率侧此前以**公共数据（[[human-mortality-db]]）与官方研究（[[cmi-mortality-projections]]）**为主，**「由商业机构维护的养老金长寿数据与曲线服务」这一形态缺位**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 78.9KB（**英国站 `/uk/`，站点选择器实测含 Canada（English/French）、United Kingdom、United States 四个版本**）；⭐ **服务族实测为四项**：**`VitaData`（`/uk/services-overview/vitadata`，68KB）**、**`VitaCurves`（`/uk/services-overview/vitacurves`，68KB）**、**VitaInsights**、**VitaIntel**；另有 **Why Club Vita?**、**Vital statistics**、**Timeline**、**Tools**、**News and insights**、**Event recordings** 与 **Office Login** 等入口。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「养老金长寿数据的商业供给」这一形态**——公共死亡率库（[[human-mortality-db]]、[[hmd-jl]]）给的是**国家人口层面**，[[cmi-mortality-projections]] 给的是**英国精算行业的官方改善模型**，而 **Club Vita 的定位是「按养老金计划成员特征（职业、地区、财富等）分层」的长寿经验数据与曲线**——**这正是长寿风险定价与养老金去风险（longevity de-risking）中最难获得的一层**；对做**长寿风险、年金化、养老金计划估值**方向的学生，理解「公共表 → 行业模型 → 计划级经验数据」三层的差别很重要。**② 与制度侧条目串成链条**——本会话已收多个养老金机构样本（[[pbgc]]、[[gad-uk]]、[[dnb]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[cmf-chile]]、[[pensionsmyndigheten]]、[[ap7]]），**Club Vita 补的是「计划层面数据从哪来」**，可与 [[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[retirement-planning]] 并读；**③ 跨三国的版本结构**本身说明**长寿经验数据的地区差异是实务关注点**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 这是商业机构**——`VitaData`/`VitaCurves` 的**数据内容、覆盖计划数与获取条件（是否需付费或成为客户）本次未核实**，**故词条只描述服务形态，不描述数据规模**；**②** 本次核实到**页面存在与站点结构（含四地版本与四项服务）**，**但未进入任何登录区、未下载任何数据或报告**；**③** 站点为**前端丰富型**（首页 78.9KB），**正文细节未逐段核实**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供免费数据或公开发表物。**核实说明**：首页（78.9KB）、`VitaData`（68KB）、`VitaCurves`（68KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与站点结构；**未登录、未下载数据**。
entries.body_en:
**Club Vita** is a **longevity risk analytics provider for pension schemes**, operating across **the UK, Canada and the US**. This entry follows this round’s **longevity-risk and inclusive-insurance** direction — a measured search found **zero Club Vita-related entries**, while the corpus’s longevity and mortality side had until now been dominated by **public data ([[human-mortality-db]]) and official research ([[cmi-mortality-projections]])**, with **the "commercial provider of scheme-level longevity data and curves" form missing**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 78.9KB (**the UK site `/uk/`, with a site selector measured to offer Canada (English and French), the United Kingdom and the United States**); ⭐ **four services were measured**: **`VitaData` (`/uk/services-overview/vitadata`, 68KB)**, **`VitaCurves` (`/uk/services-overview/vitacurves`, 68KB)**, **VitaInsights** and **VitaIntel**; other entries include **Why Club Vita?**, **Vital statistics**, **Timeline**, **Tools**, **News and insights**, **Event recordings** and an **Office Login**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "commercial supply of scheme-level longevity data" form** — public mortality databases ([[human-mortality-db]], [[hmd-jl]]) provide the **national population** view and [[cmi-mortality-projections]] provides **the UK profession’s official improvement model**, whereas **Club Vita is positioned as longevity experience data and curves stratified by pension scheme member characteristics (occupation, region, wealth and so on)** — **precisely the layer that is hardest to obtain in longevity pricing and pension de-risking**; for students working on **longevity risk, annuitisation or pension scheme valuation**, understanding the difference between **public tables → industry models → scheme-level experience data** matters. **② It chains with the institutional entries** — this session has collected several pension institution samples ([[pbgc]], [[gad-uk]], [[dnb]], [[pensions-authority-ie]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]], [[cmf-chile]], [[pensionsmyndigheten]], [[ap7]]), and **Club Vita answers "where scheme-level data comes from"**, readable with [[longevity-mortality-investor]] and [[retirement-planning]]; **③ the three-country structure** itself shows that **regional differences in longevity experience are a practical concern**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① this is a commercial provider** — the **contents of `VitaData`/`VitaCurves`, the number of schemes covered and the access conditions (fees or client status) were not verified**, so **the entry describes the service forms only, not data scale**; **②** this check verified **page existence and site structure (including four regional versions and four services)**, **but entered no login area and downloaded no data or report**; **③** the site is **front-end rich** (homepage 78.9KB) and **body details were not verified paragraph by paragraph**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers free data or published research**. **Verification note**: the homepage (78.9KB), `VitaData` (68KB) and `VitaCurves` (68KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and site structure read; **no login was used and no data was downloaded**.
entries.body_hk:
**Club Vita** 是**面向養老金計劃的長壽風險分析機構**，業務覆蓋**英國、加拿大與美國**。本條目屬本輪**長壽風險與普惠保險**取向——實測池內 **Club Vita 相關條目為 0**，池內長壽側此前以**公共數據（[[human-mortality-db]]）與官方研究（[[cmi-mortality-projections]]）**為主，**「由商業機構維護的計劃級長壽數據與曲線服務」這一形態缺位**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 78.9KB（**英國站，站點選擇器實測含 Canada（英/法）、United Kingdom、United States**）；⭐ **服務族實測四項**：**`VitaData`（68KB）**、**`VitaCurves`（68KB）**、**VitaInsights**、**VitaIntel**；另有 **Vital statistics**、**Timeline**、**Tools**、**News and insights** 與 **Office Login**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「計劃級長壽數據的商業供給」這一形態**——公共死亡率庫給**國家人口**，[[cmi-mortality-projections]] 給**英國行業官方改善模型**，而 **Club Vita 的定位是「按計劃成員特徵分層」的長壽經驗數據與曲線**——這正是**長壽風險定價與去風險中最難獲得的一層**；**② 與制度側條目串成鏈條**（[[pbgc]]、[[gad-uk]]、[[dnb]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[cmf-chile]]、[[pensionsmyndigheten]]、[[ap7]]），**Club Vita 補的是「計劃層面數據從哪來」**；**③ 三國版本結構**說明地區長壽經驗差異是實務關注點。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 這是商業機構**——**數據內容、覆蓋計劃數與獲取條件未核實**，**故只描述服務形態**；**②** 本次核實到**頁面存在與站點結構**，**但未登入任何區域、未下載任何數據或報告**；**③ 正文細節未逐段核實**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供免費數據或公開發表物。**核實說明**：三頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未登入、未下載數據**。

entries.title_en: Microinsurance Network: the microinsurance network and the "Landscape of Microinsurance" study
entries.title_hk: Microinsurance Network：小額保險網絡與《小額保險景觀》研究
entries.summary_hk: 小額保險（普惠保險）行業網絡：出版物、資源庫、培訓與最佳實踐小組，另有旗艦研究《Landscape of Microinsurance》獨立站點
entries.summary: 小额保险（普惠保险）行业网络：出版物、资源库、培训与最佳实践小组，另有旗舰研究《Landscape of Microinsurance》独立站点
entries.summary_en: The microinsurance (inclusive insurance) network: publications, a resource library, training and best-practice groups, plus a separate site for its flagship "Landscape of Microinsurance" study
entries.body:
**Microinsurance Network（小额保险网络）** 是**小额保险/普惠保险领域的国际行业网络**（成员包括保险人、再保人、中介、研究者与发展机构）。本条目与 [[a2ii]] 同属本轮**普惠保险**取向——实测池内 **Microinsurance Network 相关条目为 0**，而池内普惠/小额保险侧此前只有零星条目（如 [[openimis]]、[[bima-mcp]]、[[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]），**「行业网络 + 景观研究」这一形态缺位**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 24.3KB，导航实测含 **About our network／About inclusive insurance／Annual reports／Our work／Events／Best practice groups／Publications／Resources／Training／Landscape of Microinsurance／News／Newsletter／Sign in／Join us**，并有 **EN／ES／FR 三个语言版本**；**出版物页 `/publications`（12.8KB）**正文实测以 **「The Landscape of Microinsura…」** 开头，即**旗舰研究《小额保险景观》**居于首位；⭐ 该研究**另设独立站点 `landscape.microinsurancenetwork.org`（实测 HTTP 200，但页面仅 2,258 字节，为前端应用外壳）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「普惠保险的行业网络与景观研究」这一形态**——池内普惠保险侧此前是**工具与合成数据**（[[openimis]] 开源保险管理系统、[[bima-mcp]]、[[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]），而**「这个领域谁在做、覆盖多少国家、市场规模多大」这一层此前没有来源**；**《Landscape of Microinsurance》**正是**行业公认的年度景观研究**（覆盖国家、产品数、保费规模、监管环境），对做**普惠保险/小额保险选题**的学生是**最直接的领域地图与引用来源**。**② 与监管侧条目互补**——普惠保险的另一半是**监管能力建设**（见同轮 [[a2ii]] 与 [[iais-icp]]），**行业网络给市场侧、监管倡议给规则侧**，两者合起来才是完整图景；**③ 与市场数据条目并列**——可与 [[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]、[[ira-kenya]]、[[acaps-morocco]]、[[seddk]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]] 一起用于**新兴市场保险覆盖比较**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页导航、出版物页与独立景观研究站点的存在**，**但《Landscape》站点仅 2,258 字节（前端外壳）、出版物条目未逐条打开**，因此**不能确认该研究的最新版本、覆盖范围与获取条件**（**部分资源可能仅对会员开放**——导航中实测存在 **Sign in** 与 **members only** 的注册入口）；**②** 首页体积较小（24.3KB），**可能为前端应用**；**③** 本次**未核实该网络的成员构成与治理**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供数据下载或精算工具。**核实说明**：首页（24.3KB）、`/publications`（12.8KB）、`landscape.microinsurancenetwork.org`（2,258 字节）HTTP 200 实测；**未打开出版物、未核实会员门槛**。
entries.body_en:
**The Microinsurance Network** is **the international industry network in microinsurance and inclusive insurance** (its members include insurers, reinsurers, intermediaries, researchers and development agencies). With [[a2ii]], it belongs to this round’s **inclusive insurance** direction — a measured search found **zero Microinsurance Network-related entries**, while the corpus’s inclusive and microinsurance side held only scattered items (such as [[openimis]], [[bima-mcp]] and [[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]), with **the "industry network plus landscape study" form missing**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 24.3KB and its navigation shows **About our network / About inclusive insurance / Annual reports / Our work / Events / Best practice groups / Publications / Resources / Training / Landscape of Microinsurance / News / Newsletter / Sign in / Join us**, with **EN / ES / FR** versions; the **publications page `/publications` (12.8KB)** opens with **"The Landscape of Microinsura…"**, i.e. the **flagship Landscape of Microinsurance study** ranks first; ⭐ that study **has its own site, `landscape.microinsurancenetwork.org` (measured HTTP 200, but only 2,258 bytes — a front-end shell)**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "inclusive-insurance network and landscape study" form** — the corpus’s inclusive-insurance side previously consisted of **tools and synthetic data** ([[openimis]] open-source insurance management, [[bima-mcp]], [[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]), while **"who works in this field, how many countries are covered, how large the market is" had no source**; **the Landscape of Microinsurance** is precisely **the sector’s recognised annual landscape study** (countries, products, premium volumes, regulatory environment), making it **the most direct field map and citation for students choosing an inclusive or microinsurance topic**. **② It complements the regulatory side** — the other half of inclusive insurance is **supervisory capacity building** (see [[a2ii]] this round and [[iais-icp]]): **the network covers the market side, the initiative the rule-making side**, and together they form the complete picture; **③ it sits alongside market data entries** — usable with [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[philippines-insurance-commission]], [[ira-kenya]], [[acaps-morocco]], [[seddk]] and [[mas-insurance-statistics]] for **emerging-market insurance coverage comparisons**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage navigation, the publications page and the existence of the separate landscape site**, **but the Landscape site measured only 2,258 bytes (a front-end shell) and publication entries were not opened one by one**, so **the study’s latest edition, coverage and access conditions cannot be confirmed** (**some resources may be members-only** — the navigation shows **Sign in** and a members-only registration entry); **②** the homepage is small (24.3KB) and **may be a front-end application**; **③** the **network’s membership and governance were not verified**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers data downloads or actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (24.3KB), `/publications` (12.8KB) and `landscape.microinsurancenetwork.org` (2,258 bytes) were measured at HTTP 200; **no publication was opened and no membership threshold was verified**.

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 24.3KB，導航實測含 **About our network／About inclusive insurance／Annual reports／Our work／Events／Best practice groups／Publications／Resources／Training／Landscape of Microinsurance／Sign in／Join us**，並有 **EN／ES／FR** 三語版本；**出版物頁（12.8KB）**正文以 **「The Landscape of Microinsura…」** 開頭；⭐ 該研究**另設獨立站點（HTTP 200，但僅 2,258 字節，前端外殼）**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「普惠保險的網絡與景觀研究」這一形態**——池內此前只有**工具與合成數據**（[[openimis]]、[[bima-mcp]]、[[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]），而**「這個領域誰在做、覆蓋多少國家、市場多大」此前沒有來源**；**《Landscape of Microinsurance》**正是**行業公認的年度景觀研究**，是**最直接的領域地圖與引用來源**；**② 與監管側互補**（[[a2ii]]、[[iais-icp]]）——**行業網絡給市場側、監管倡議給規則側**；**③ 可與 [[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[ira-kenya]]、[[acaps-morocco]]、[[seddk]] 等並用於新興市場比較**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁導航、出版物頁與獨立站點的存在**，**但景觀研究站點僅 2,258 字節、出版物未逐條打開**，**故不能確認最新版本、覆蓋與獲取條件**（**部分資源可能僅會員可見**）；**②** 首頁體積小，**可能為前端應用**；**③ 未核實成員構成與治理**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供數據下載或精算工具。**核實說明**：三項 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開出版物、未核實會員門檻**。

entries.title: A2ii（Access to Insurance Initiative）：面向保险监管者的普惠保险倡议（现由 CGAP 主导）
entries.title_en: A2ii (Access to Insurance Initiative): an inclusive-insurance initiative working with insurance supervisors, now led by CGAP
entries.title_hk: A2ii（Access to Insurance Initiative）：面向保險監管者的普惠保險倡議（現由 CGAP 主導）
entries.summary_hk: 與保險監管者合作的普惠保險倡議（2009 年起）：現由 CGAP 主導，推行《普惠保險宣言》、創新實驗室、監管地圖等
entries.summary: 与保险监管者合作的普惠保险倡议（2009 年起）：现由 CGAP 主导，推行《普惠保险宣言》、创新实验室、监管地图等
entries.summary_en: An inclusive-insurance initiative working with insurance supervisors since 2009, now led by CGAP, promoting the Inclusive Insurance Declaration plus an Innovation Lab and a regulations map
entries.body:
**A2ii（Access to Insurance Initiative，保险可及性倡议）** 是**面向保险监管者的普惠保险倡议**，自 **2009 年**起运作，**现由 CGAP（世界银行集团的普惠金融扶贫协商小组）主导**。本条目与 [[microinsurance-network]] 同属本轮**普惠保险**取向——实测池内 **A2ii 与 CGAP 相关条目均为 0**，而池内**普惠/小额保险**与**监管能力建设**两条线此前都缺入口。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**`a2ii.org/en` 实测已整站呈现为 CGAP 站点**（页面标题实测为 **「Access to Insurance Initiative (A2ii) | CGAP」**），**页面正文原文**：**「The Access to Insurance Initiative (A2ii) works with insurance supervisors to promote inclusive and responsible insurance, thereby reducing vulnerability. Since 2009, A2ii has played a key role in disseminating knowledge, supporting peer learning, and facilitating dialogue between s[upervisors…]」**；页面另实测出现 **「Key A2ii initiatives led by CGAP」**（**由 CGAP 主导的 A2ii 关键倡议**），并明确提到 **Championing the Inclusive Insurance Declaration, advocating for its adoption within national financial inclusion strategies**（**推动《普惠保险宣言》被纳入各国普惠金融战略**）以及 **（IAIS）** 与 **Innovation Lab、Cape Town Declaration、Fema-Meter、Regulations Map** 等具体项目名；对应集合页 `cgap.org/topics/collections/access-to-insurance-initiative` **HTTP 200（56.2KB）**。

Since 2009, A2ii has played a key role in disseminating knowledge, supporting peer learning, and facilitating dialogue between s[upervisors…]**"; the page also shows "**Key A2ii initiatives led by CGAP**" and states its work includes **"Championing the Inclusive Insurance Declaration, advocating for its adoption within national financial inclusion strategies"**, with mentions of **(IAIS)** and specific projects such as an **Innovation Lab**, the **Cape Town Declaration**, **Fema-Meter** and a **Regulations Map**; the corresponding collection page `cgap.org/topics/collections/access-to-insurance-initiative` measured **HTTP 200 (56.2KB)**.

entries.body:
**IAI（Institute of Actuaries of India，印度精算师学会）** 是**印度的精算专业团体**，负责印度的精算资格体系。本条目属本轮**亚洲资格路径**取向——实测池内**印度精算师学会本身相关条目为 0**（池内印度侧此前只有监管与市场类条目，如 [[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]]，以及 [[aiai-designation]]——**后者是美国的 The Institutes 认证，与印度 IAI 无关**，容易混淆故在此点明）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **109.7KB**，页面标题实测为 **「Home | Institute of Actuaries of India」**；⭐ **入学考试体系**：实测含 **ACET（Actuarial Common Entrance Test）** 入口与说明页 **`/about-acet`（76.6KB）**、**`/acet-exam-structure`（考试结构）**、**`/examination-dates-1`（考期）**，以及与会员系统打通的 **ACET SignUp / Login**（`member.actuariesindia.org/acetstudents`）；⭐ **会员统计页 `/membership-statistic`（77.2KB）**（带 `field_as_on_target_id` 参数，即**按统计基准日查询**）；**Annual Report（年报）** 页；另有 **Meet Some Of Our Members**、**Annual Membership** 等入口。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「印度精算资格路径」这一形态**——池内专业团体条目已覆盖英国（[[ifoa]]）、南非（[[assa]]）、法国（[[institut-des-actuaires]]）、西班牙（[[instituto-de-actuarios-espanoles]]）、新加坡（[[singapore-actuarial-society]]）、中国（[[china-actuarial-association]]），**印度此前为零**；而印度的特色是**自设入学考试 ACET**（而非直接对接 IFoA/SoA 体系），这与 ASSA 的「与 IFoA 联考」形成**两种路径模式的对照**——对考虑**多体系报考或免考评估**的学生有直接参考价值。**② 会员统计是可用的实证材料**——**按基准日公开会员数**（含不同会员类别）可用于分析**新兴市场精算职业的规模与增长**，这类数据在多数国家并不公开，可与 [[asia-actuarial-job-market]]、[[actuarial-outpost]]、[[actubase]]、[[graduate-hiring-model-breakdown]] 一类职业市场条目并读。**③ 与印度监管/市场条目配套**——[[irdai-market-statistics]]（市场统计）、[[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]（保险业监管报告）加上 IAI（**人才供给侧**），构成**「监管 → 市场 → 人才」**的印度三件套。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、导航结构（含 ACET 相关页面与会员统计页的具体路径）**，**但未打开任何年报、未查询会员统计的具体数值**，因此**不能提供印度的会员人数与增长数据**；**②** 考试与会员制度的**具体规则（费用、资格、免考）以官方最新公告为准，本词条不转述条款**；**③** 站点为**专业团体官网**，**不提供精算软件或市场数据**；**④** 印度精算资格体系的**国际互认关系本次未核实**。**核实说明**：首页（109.7KB）、`/about-acet`（76.6KB）、`/membership-statistic`（77.2KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与导航；**未打开年报、未查询会员数值**。
entries.body_en:
**IAI (Institute of Actuaries of India)** is **India’s actuarial professional body**, responsible for the country’s actuarial qualification system. This entry follows this round’s **Asian qualification-pathway** direction — a measured search found **zero entries for the Institute itself** (the corpus’s India side previously held regulatory and market items such as [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]] and [[irdai-ai-governance]], plus [[aiai-designation]] — **which is a US "The Institutes" credential unrelated to India’s IAI**, a confusion worth flagging here).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **109.7KB** with the **measured title "Home | Institute of Actuaries of India"**; ⭐ the **entrance examination system** shows an **ACET (Actuarial Common Entrance Test)** entry with an explanatory page **`/about-acet` (76.6KB)**, **`/acet-exam-structure`** and **`/examination-dates-1`**, plus **ACET SignUp / Login** wired to the member system (`member.actuariesindia.org/acetstudents`); ⭐ a **membership statistics page `/membership-statistic` (77.2KB)** (parameterised by `field_as_on_target_id`, i.e. **queryable as of a given reference date**); an **Annual Report** page; and entries such as **Meet Some Of Our Members** and **Annual Membership**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "Indian actuarial qualification pathway" form** — professional-body entries already cover the UK ([[ifoa]]), South Africa ([[assa]]), France ([[institut-des-actuaires]]), Spain ([[instituto-de-actuarios-espanoles]]), Singapore ([[singapore-actuarial-society]]) and China ([[china-actuarial-association]]), while **India was at zero**; India’s distinctive feature is **its own entrance examination, ACET** (rather than direct alignment with the IFoA/SoA systems), which contrasts with ASSA’s **IFoA-coordinated examinations** — **two pathway models side by side**, directly useful for students weighing **multi-system qualification or exemption assessment**. **② The membership statistics are usable evidence** — **membership counts published as of a reference date** (across member categories) support analysis of **the size and growth of the actuarial profession in an emerging market**, data that most countries do not publish, and can be read with career-market entries such as [[asia-actuarial-job-market]], [[actuarial-outpost]], [[actubase]] and [[graduate-hiring-model-breakdown]]. **③ It completes an Indian trio** — [[irdai-market-statistics]] (market data), [[irdai-ai-governance]] and [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]] (regulation) plus the IAI (**talent supply**) give a **regulation → market → talent** chain.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles and navigation structure (including the specific ACET and membership-statistics paths)**, **but opened no annual report and queried no membership figures**, so **no Indian membership count or growth rate is provided**; **② the detailed rules of the examinations and membership (fees, eligibility, exemptions) are governed by the latest official notices, and this entry restates no terms**; **③** this is a **professional body site and offers no actuarial software or market data**; **④** the **international mutual-recognition relationships of India’s qualification system were not verified**. **Verification note**: the homepage (109.7KB), `/about-acet` (76.6KB) and `/membership-statistic` (77.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no annual report was opened and no membership figures were queried**.

entries.body:
**PPI（Pensions Policy Institute，英国养老金政策研究所）** 是**英国独立的养老金政策研究机构**，自述为「以证据为基础、影响退休结果的研究」。本条目属本轮**养老金政策建模**取向——实测池内 **Pensions Policy Institute 相关条目为 0**，而池内养老金侧此前已在**机构样本**（[[pbgc]]、[[gad-uk]]、[[dnb]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[pensionsmyndigheten]]、[[ap7]]）与**数据来源**（[[club-vita]]）上很厚，**「由独立机构维护的养老金政策模拟模型」这一形态缺位**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **43.8KB**，页面标题实测为 **「Pensions Policy Institute | Independent UK Pensions Research」**；⭐ **模型页 `/about-us/ppi-models/`（38KB）**，正文原文：**「The PPI maintains a suite of simulation models used to build up a view of the future, considering the world either in relation to the impacts upon individuals and their finances or the impact to the Exchequer and their cashflows.」**，并写明 **「The PPI’s suite of pension models enables independent analysis of pension policy, retirement outcomes and long-term trends across the UK pensions…」**；⭐ **研究库 `/research-library/`** 与 **研究报吿 `/research-library/research-reports/`（60KB）**，并按类型细分 **Briefing Notes（简报）** 与 **Responses And Submissions（对政策咨询的回应）**；另有 **Report and accounts**、**Funding Research** 等入口。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「养老金政策模拟模型」这一形态**——**PPI Models 的定位是「对个人财务影响 + 对财政（Exchequer）现金流影响」两个方向同时建模**，这正是**养老金政策评估的标准问题结构**（个人层面的退休收入充足性 ↔ 政府层面的长期财政成本）；对做**养老金改革、退休收入充足性、财政可持续性**方向论文的学生，**这是一条比单篇报告更有结构的入口**（可与 [[pensionsmyndigheten]] 的「典型情形模型」对照：**瑞典是国家机构的自用模型、PPI 是独立机构的公开模型**）。**② 研究库的三种类型（研究报告／简报／政策回应）本身就是「研究如何进入政策过程」的样本**——尤其 **Responses And Submissions（对咨询的正式回应）**，这类材料在学术检索里通常找不到，但对理解**政策如何被影响**很有价值。**③ 与英国侧条目配套**——[[gad-uk]]（政府精算部门的 Ogden 表与公共部门养老金成本控制）、[[ifoa]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]，以及老龄研究类条目可并读。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、模型页正文原文、研究库与研究报吿页的存在**，**但未打开任何报告、未获取模型文档或代码**，因此**不能描述模型的类型（微观模拟/队列模型等）、覆盖范围与可获取性**；**②** 模型页只说「维护一套模拟模型」，**具体的模型清单与访问方式本次未核实**，**故不作「模型可下载/可用」的表述**；**③** 站点为**研究机构官网**，**不提供精算软件或原始数据**；**④** 研究库按年份与类型筛选（实测含 2025 年筛选参数），**本次未统计报告数量**。**核实说明**：首页（43.8KB）、`/about-us/ppi-models/`（38KB）、`/research-library/research-reports/`（60KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取正文；**未打开任何报告与模型文档**。
entries.body_en:
**PPI (Pensions Policy Institute)** is **an independent UK pension policy research institute**, describing itself as producing evidence-based research that shapes better retirement outcomes. This entry follows this round’s **pension policy modelling** direction — a measured search found **zero Pensions Policy Institute-related entries**, and while the corpus’s pension side is already rich in **institutional samples** ([[pbgc]], [[gad-uk]], [[dnb]], [[pensions-authority-ie]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]], [[pensionsmyndigheten]], [[ap7]]) and **data sources** ([[club-vita]]), **the "pension policy simulation models maintained by an independent institute" form was missing**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **43.8KB** with the **measured title "Pensions Policy Institute | Independent UK Pensions Research"**; ⭐ the **models page `/about-us/ppi-models/` (38KB)** states verbatim: "**The PPI maintains a suite of simulation models used to build up a view of the future, considering the world either in relation to the impacts upon individuals and their finances or the impact to the Exchequer and their cashflows.**" and notes that "**The PPI’s suite of pension models enables independent analysis of pension policy, retirement outcomes and long-term trends across the UK pensions…**"; ⭐ a **research library `/research-library/`** with **research reports `/research-library/research-reports/` (60KB)**, broken out into **Briefing Notes** and **Responses And Submissions**; plus **Report and accounts** and **Funding Research**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "pension policy simulation models" form** — **PPI Models is positioned to model two directions at once: impacts on individuals’ finances and impacts on the Exchequer’s cashflows** — precisely **the standard problem structure of pension policy evaluation** (individual retirement income adequacy against long-run public fiscal cost); for students writing on **pension reform, retirement income adequacy or fiscal sustainability**, **this is a more structured entry point than a single report** (compare [[pensionsmyndigheten]]’s typical-case model: **Sweden’s is a state agency’s own model, PPI’s is an independent institute’s publicly described one**). **② The three publication types (research reports, briefing notes, policy responses) are themselves a sample of how research enters the policy process** — especially **Responses And Submissions**, material that academic search rarely surfaces but that is valuable for understanding **how policy gets influenced**. **③ It pairs with the UK entries** — [[gad-uk]] (the Government Actuary’s Department, Ogden Tables and the public service pension cost-control review), [[ifoa]] and [[cmi-mortality-projections]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage, the models page body text and the existence of the research library and reports pages**, **but opened no report and obtained no model documentation or code**, so **the model types (microsimulation, cohort and so on), coverage and availability cannot be described**; **②** the models page says only that a suite of simulation models is maintained, and **the specific model list and access route were not verified**, so **no claim is made that the models are downloadable or usable**; **③** this is a **research institute’s website and offers no actuarial software or raw data**; **④** the research library filters by year and type (a 2025 filter parameter was measured) and **the number of reports was not counted**. **Verification note**: the homepage (43.8KB), `/about-us/ppi-models/` (38KB) and `/research-library/research-reports/` (60KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with body text read; **no report or model document was opened**.

**PPI（Pensions Policy Institute，英國養老金政策研究所）** 是**英國獨立的養老金政策研究機構**。本條目屬本輪**養老金政策建模**取向——實測池內 **Pensions Policy Institute 相關條目為 0**，而池內養老金側此前已在**機構樣本**與**數據來源**（[[club-vita]]）上很厚，**「由獨立機構維護的養老金政策模擬模型」這一形態缺位**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **43.8KB**，標題實測為 **「Pensions Policy Institute | Independent UK Pensions Research」**；⭐ **模型頁（38KB）** 正文原文：**「The PPI maintains a suite of simulation models used to build up a view of the future, considering the world either in relation to the impacts upon individuals and their finances or the impact to the Exchequer and their cashflows.」**；⭐ **研究庫**與**研究報告頁（60KB）**，並按類型細分 **Briefing Notes** 與 **Responses And Submissions**；另有 **Report and accounts**、**Funding Research** 入口。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「養老金政策模擬模型」這一形態**——**PPI Models 同時對「個人財務影響」與「財政（Exchequer）現金流影響」兩個方向建模**，正是**養老金政策評估的標準問題結構**；可與 [[pensionsmyndigheten]] 的典型情形模型對照（**瑞典是國家機構自用模型、PPI 是獨立機構公開描述的模型**）；**② 研究庫的三種類型**（研究報告／簡報／政策回應）本身是**「研究如何進入政策過程」的樣本**；**③ 與英國側條目配套**（[[gad-uk]]、[[ifoa]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在與模型頁正文原文**，**但未打開任何報告、未獲取模型文檔或代碼**，故**不能描述模型類型、覆蓋範圍與可獲取性**；**② 模型清單與訪問方式未核實，故不作「模型可下載／可用」的表述**；**③** 本站為**研究機構官網，不提供精算軟件或原始數據**；**④ 未統計報告數量**。**核實說明**：三頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開任何報告與模型文檔**。

entries.summary: 国际清算银行下属的监管能力建设机构：面向金融业监管者的培训与出版系列，覆盖银行、保险等监管议题
entries.body:
**FSI（Financial Stability Institute，金融稳定学院）** 是**国际清算银行（BIS）下设的监管能力建设机构**——面向各国**金融业监管者**提供培训、技术援助与出版。本条目属本轮**监管能力建设**取向——实测池内 **Toronto Centre 0（且 403）、FSI 相关条目 0**（仅有两处无关误命中）。这一形态与同批的 [[a2ii]]（普惠保险监管倡议）互补：**A2ii 聚焦普惠保险，FSI 覆盖整体审慎监管议题**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **关于页 `/fsi/about.htm`（168.2KB）**，页面标题实测为 **「Financial Stability Institute | Bank for International Settlements」**；⭐ **出版系列页 `/fsi/publications.htm`（178.1KB）**；站点位于 **BIS 域名之下**（`bis.org`，其顶层导航实测含 **About／Research & publications／Committees／Speeches／Statistics／Media & events**，即 FSI 是**BIS 整体研究出版体系的一部分**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「监管者能力建设」这一形态**——池内监管侧条目多为**监管机构本身的统计与规则**（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[fsca]]、[[dnb]] 等），而 **FSI 补的是「监管者自己被培训与研究支持」这一层**；对做**监管比较、监管有效性、保险监管能力**方向的学生，**FSI 的出版系列是把「监管实践」写成可引用文本的地方**，且**常覆盖新兴市场的能力差距议题**。**② 与 [[a2ii]]、[[iais-icp]] 形成完整监管知识链**——**IAIS 定原则（[[iais-icp]]、[[iais-gimar]]）→ FSI 做能力建设（本条）→ A2ii 做普惠保险监管专项（[[a2ii]]）**，三者层次分明；**③ BIS 的统计与研究体系可顺带使用**（BIS 相关统计入口本轮未单独收录，但 FSI 页面处于同一站点体系，读者可自然扩展到 BIS 的统计栏目）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**关于页与出版系列页的存在、标题与页面体量**，**但未打开任何 FSI 出版物**，因此**不能描述其具体系列（如 FSI Insights 等）与最新期次**；**②** `bis.org/fsi/`（无文件名的路径）实测 **404**，**故词条只给已核实的 `/fsi/about.htm` 与 `/fsi/publications.htm`**；**③** FSI 的**培训项目的参与条件（是否面向所有监管者、是否有名额限制）本次未核实**；**④** 本条**只写 FSI**，**未把 BIS 的银行业统计打包进来**（避免越界描述）。**核实说明**：`/fsi/about.htm`（168.2KB）、`/fsi/publications.htm`（178.1KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取标题；`/fsi/` 实测 404 已如实记录；**未打开任何 FSI 出版物**。
entries.body_en:
**The FSI (Financial Stability Institute)** is **the supervisory capacity-building institute of the Bank for International Settlements**, providing training, technical assistance and publications for **financial-sector supervisors** worldwide. This entry follows this round’s **supervisory capacity building** direction — a measured search found **Toronto Centre at 0 (and returning 403) and FSI-related entries at 0** (only two unrelated matches). The form complements [[a2ii]] (the inclusive-insurance supervisory initiative) added earlier: **A2ii focuses on inclusive insurance, the FSI spans the broader prudential agenda**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **about page `/fsi/about.htm` (168.2KB)** with the **measured title "Financial Stability Institute | Bank for International Settlements"**; ⭐ the **publications page `/fsi/publications.htm` (178.1KB)**; the institute sits **under the BIS domain** (`bis.org`, whose top-level navigation shows **About / Research & publications / Committees / Speeches / Statistics / Media & events**, i.e. the FSI is **part of the BIS research and publication system**).

For RIAA: **① it adds the "supervisory capacity building" form** — corpus entries on the regulatory side are mostly **regulators’ own statistics and rules** ([[naic-financial-data-repository]], [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[fsca]], [[dnb]] and others), while **the FSI adds the layer where supervisors themselves are trained and supported by research**; for students working on **regulatory comparison, supervisory effectiveness or insurance supervisory capacity**, **the FSI publication series is where supervisory practice is written up in citable form**, and it **frequently addresses capacity gaps in emerging markets**. **② With [[a2ii]] and [[iais-icp]] it forms a complete supervisory knowledge chain** — **the IAIS sets principles ([[iais-icp]], [[iais-gimar]]) → the FSI builds capacity (this entry) → A2ii handles inclusive-insurance supervision ([[a2ii]])** — three clearly layered roles; **③ the wider BIS statistical and research system is then within reach** (BIS statistics were not separately entered this round, but FSI pages sit in the same site, so readers can extend naturally to the BIS statistics section).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and page sizes of the about and publications pages**, **but opened no FSI publication**, so **its specific series (such as FSI Insights) and latest editions cannot be described**; **②** the path `bis.org/fsi/` (without a file name) measured **404**, so **this entry gives only the verified `/fsi/about.htm` and `/fsi/publications.htm`**; **③** the **participation conditions for FSI training (whether open to all supervisors, whether places are limited) were not verified**; **④** this entry covers **the FSI only** and **does not package in the BIS banking statistics** (avoiding out-of-scope description). **Verification note**: `/fsi/about.htm` (168.2KB) and `/fsi/publications.htm` (178.1KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles read; `/fsi/` measured 404 and is recorded; **no FSI publication was opened**.

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **關於頁（168.2KB）**，標題實測為 **「Financial Stability Institute | Bank for International Settlements」**；⭐ **出版系列頁（178.1KB）**；站點位於 **BIS 域名之下**（頂層導航含 About／Research & publications／Committees／Speeches／Statistics／Media & events）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「監管者能力建設」這一形態**——池內監管側多為**監管機構自身的統計與規則**，而 **FSI 補的是「監管者自己被培訓與研究支持」這一層**；**② 與 [[a2ii]]、[[iais-icp]] 形成完整監管知識鏈**——**IAIS 定原則 → FSI 做能力建設 → A2ii 做普惠保險監管專項**；**③ BIS 統計與研究體系可順帶使用**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**兩頁的存在、標題與體量**，**但未打開任何 FSI 出版物**，故**不能描述其具體系列與最新期次**；**② `bis.org/fsi/` 實測 404**，**故只給已核實的兩個路徑**；**③ 培訓參與條件未核實**；**④ 本條只寫 FSI**，**未把 BIS 銀行業統計打包進來**。**核實說明**：兩頁 HTTP 200 實測；`/fsi/` 404 已記錄；**未打開任何 FSI 出版物**。

entries.body:
**IAJ（日本アクチュアリー会，Institute of Actuaries of Japan，日本精算师会）** 是**日本的精算专业团体**，负责日本的精算资格体系。本条目属本轮**亚洲资格路径补缺**：上一轮已收 [[iai-india]]（印度），实测池内**日本精算师会本身相关条目为 0**（池内日本侧此前只有监管与市场类条目，如 [[japan-fsa-statistics]]、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]、[[japan-giro]]、[[japan-insurance-advanced-course]]）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **32.4KB**，页面标题实测为 **「アクチュアリー会」**；⭐ **资格试验信息页 `/examin/info.html`（22.9KB）**，页面内实测含 **「2026年度資格試験情報を掲載しました」** 的更新提示；⭐ **「教科書・参考書」页 `/examin/textbook/index.html`（32.3KB）**，正文实测写明 **「当会発行の教科書・参考書はこちらにて提供しております」**（**由学会自己发行教科书与参考书**）；**英文入口 `/english/`（9.5KB）**；另有 **アクチュアリー講座情報（讲座/培训信息）**、**合格者の声（合格者经验，含往期）**、**受験に関するFAQ**、**アクチュアリー座談会**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「日本精算资格路径」这一形态**——日本是全球第三大保险市场，而池内日本侧此前**只有市场与监管数据**，**没有人才与资格体系的入口**；日本精算师会的特点是**自设资格试验 + 自编教材**（而非直接对接 IFoA/SoA 体系），与上一轮 [[iai-india]] 的 ACET 入学考试、[[assa]] 的「与 IFoA 联考」共同构成**三种亚洲/英联邦资格路径的对照样本**。**② 「自编教材」这一点有实际价值**——多数专业团体的学习材料依赖外部出版，而日本精算师会**自己发行教科书与参考书**，这对**研究各国精算教育体系差异**的学生是一个具体观察点（可与 [[actuarial-open-book]]、[[open-exam-prep]]、[[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[soa-education]]、[[cas-syllabus]] 并读）。**③ 英文入口存在但体量小（9.5KB）**，说明其**主要面向日本国内考生**——这一点已在词条中写明。

entries.body:
**AAE（Actuarial Association of Europe，欧洲精算协会）** 是**欧洲各国精算协会的伞状组织**，其自述定位为「**促进精算职业的角色、声誉与认可度**」。本条目补的是**「区域伞状专业组织」这一形态**——实测池内 **AAE 本身相关条目为 0**，但**池内已收一条 AAE 的立场文件**（[[aae-ai-act-position]]，AAE 对欧盟 AI 法案的立场）——**即「有它的文件、没有它的机构条目」**，这正是本条的补位点。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **86.6KB**，页面标题实测含 **「Promoting the role, reputation, and recognition of the actuarial profession」**；⭐ **「European standards of actuarial practice（欧洲精算实务准则）」页 `/about-the-aae/european-standards-of-actuarial-practice/`（70.6KB）**；⭐ **成员协会名录 `/about-the-aae/members/`（76.4KB）**（欧洲各国协会的集合入口，可与池内 [[ifoa]]、[[institut-des-actuaires]]、[[instituto-de-actuarios-espanoles]]、[[assa]] 等国家级团体对照）；**出版物 `/papers/`**；⭐ **刊物《The European Actuary》`/publications/the-european-actuary/`（66.5KB）**；另有 **AAE Media**、**Member value**、**Board reports to Member Associations** 与 **Members only** 区域。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「专业标准层」这一形态**——池内已有**监管层**（欧盟 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 的政策立场、[[asf-romania]] 等成员国监管）与**国家专业团体层**（[[ifoa]]、[[institut-des-actuaires]]、[[instituto-de-actuarios-espanoles]]），但**「跨国的专业实务准则由谁制定」这一层此前没有**；**AAE 的 European standards of actuarial practice 正是这一层**，与 IAIS 的国际原则（[[iais-icp]]、[[iais-gimar]]）形成**「国际原则 → 欧洲实务准则 → 国家标准」**的三级结构。**② 成员协会名录是现成的欧洲精算生态地图**——用于**跨国报考、互认与职业流动**研究时，可以直接看到**哪些国家有协会、名称如何**；**③ 刊物《The European Actuary》**是了解**欧洲精算行业议题**的连续来源，可与 [[european-actuarial-journal]]（学术期刊）、[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]、[[geneva-papers]] 并读——**一个是行业刊物、一个是学术期刊**，性质不同。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、欧洲精算实务准则页、成员协会页与刊物页的存在、标题与页面体量**，**但未打开任何准则文本或刊物文章**，因此**不能转述准则的具体条款与编号**；**② 站点设有 Members only 区域**，**会员内容的范围本次未核实**；**③** 本次**未核实 AAE 与 IAA（国际精算协会）及各国家标准的具体对应关系**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供精算软件或数据。**核实说明**：首页（86.6KB）、`/about-the-aae/european-standards-of-actuarial-practice/`（70.6KB）、`/about-the-aae/members/`（76.4KB）、`/publications/the-european-actuary/`（66.5KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与导航；**未打开准则文本或刊物文章**。
entries.body_en:
**The AAE (Actuarial Association of Europe)** is **the umbrella body of Europe’s national actuarial associations**, describing its mission as "**promoting the role, reputation, and recognition of the actuarial profession**". This entry adds the "**regional umbrella professional body**" form — a measured search found **zero entries for the AAE itself**, although the corpus already holds **one AAE position paper** ([[aae-ai-act-position]], its stance on the EU AI Act) — i.e. **its documents were present but its institution was not**, which is precisely the gap this entry fills.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **86.6KB** with a **measured title containing "Promoting the role, reputation, and recognition of the actuarial profession"**; ⭐ the **"European standards of actuarial practice" page `/about-the-aae/european-standards-of-actuarial-practice/` (70.6KB)**; ⭐ a **member-association directory `/about-the-aae/members/` (76.4KB)** (the collective entry point to Europe’s national associations, comparable with national bodies already in the corpus such as [[ifoa]], [[institut-des-actuaires]], [[instituto-de-actuarios-espanoles]] and [[assa]]); **publications `/papers/`**; ⭐ the magazine **The European Actuary `/publications/the-european-actuary/` (66.5KB)**; plus **AAE Media**, **Member value**, **Board reports to Member Associations** and a **Members only** area.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "professional standards layer"** — the corpus already had the **regulatory layer** (EU [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], the policy stance in [[aae-ai-act-position]], member-state supervisors such as [[asf-romania]]) and the **national professional-body layer** ([[ifoa]], [[institut-des-actuaires]], [[instituto-de-actuarios-espanoles]]), but **"who sets cross-border professional practice standards" had no entry**; **the AAE’s European standards of actuarial practice is exactly that layer**, forming with the IAIS international principles ([[iais-icp]], [[iais-gimar]]) a three-level structure of **international principles → European practice standards → national standards**. **② The member directory is a ready map of the European actuarial landscape** — for work on **cross-border qualification, mutual recognition and professional mobility**, it shows directly which countries have associations and what they are called; **③ the magazine The European Actuary** is a continuous source on **European actuarial industry issues**, readable alongside the academic journals [[european-actuarial-journal]], [[annals-of-actuarial-science]] and [[geneva-papers]] — **an industry magazine and an academic journal are different things**. 

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and page sizes of the homepage, the European standards page, the members page and the magazine page**, **but opened no standards text or magazine article**, so **the specific clauses and numbering of the standards cannot be restated**; **② the site has a Members only area**, and **the extent of member-only content was not verified**; **③** the **mapping between the AAE, the IAA and national standards was not verified**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers actuarial software or data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (86.6KB), `/about-the-aae/european-standards-of-actuarial-practice/` (70.6KB), `/about-the-aae/members/` (76.4KB) and `/publications/the-european-actuary/` (66.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no standards text or magazine article was opened**.

entries.body:
**ILC-UK（International Longevity Centre UK，国际长寿中心英国）** 是**英国的长寿与老龄化政策智库**。本条目属本轮**长寿主题的政策侧补位**——池内长寿/老龄化侧此前已有**研究机构**（[[cepar]]，侧重老龄化研究 + 数据档案）与**养老金政策建模**（[[pensions-policy-institute]]），而**「以长寿经济为框架、面向政策与公众的智库产出」这一形态缺位**；实测池内 **ILC 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **70.8KB**；⭐ **实测到的报告页面**包括：**《Making China longevity ready》（中国长寿准备度，`/making-china-longevity-ready/`，98.7KB）**、**《ILC briefing: longevity economy》（长寿经济简报，`/ilc-briefing-longevity-economy/`，136.9KB）**、**《Economies for long lives – quantifying the longevity…》（为长寿人生构建经济，`/economies-for-long-lives/`，110.5KB）**，以及首页实测可见的 **《An age of economic opportunity: maximising the European…》（欧洲长寿经济机遇）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「长寿经济」这一分析框架**——池内长寿侧此前主要沿**死亡率/长寿风险的建模口径**（[[human-mortality-db]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]）与**养老金制度/产品口径**（[[pbgc]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[ap7]]、[[club-vita]]），而 **ILC-UK 采用的是「长寿经济（longevity economy）」框架——把老龄化看成消费、就业与增长的经济机会，而非单纯的负债**；对做**老龄化与保险/养老金市场关系**方向的学生，**这是与精算口径互补的第二种视角**（同一现象，一个算成本、一个算机会）。**② 中国专题报告对本站读者有直接相关性**——实测报告页 **《Making China longevity ready》** 说明该机构把中国作为研究样本，**对香港/内地的学生而言，这提供了一个「外部机构如何看中国老龄化」的可引用文本**（可与 [[un-population-data]]、[[hk-censtatd-insurance]]、[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[retirement-planning]] 并读）。**③ 与 [[cepar]] 形成「研究机构 vs 政策智库」的对照**——**同一老龄化议题，一个以数据档案与研究计划为主线，一个以政策简报与公众沟通为主线**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 这是智库/倡导型机构而非同行评审来源**——其报告**结论带有政策主张**，引用时应与学术期刊区别对待（本词条在此明确提示）；**②** 本次核实到**首页与四个报告页面的存在、标题与页面体量**，**但未打开任何报告正文**，因此**不能转述其数据来源、方法与结论**；**③ 机构的资助结构、治理与独立性本次未核实**——这一点对评估智库研究尤为关键，**故不作任何独立性评价**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供数据下载或精算工具。**核实说明**：首页（70.8KB）、`/making-china-longevity-ready/`（98.7KB）、`/ilc-briefing-longevity-economy/`（136.9KB）、`/economies-for-long-lives/`（110.5KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题；**未打开报告正文、未核实资助结构**。

This entry fills the **policy side of the longevity theme** — the corpus’s longevity and ageing side already had **research institutions** ([[cepar]], focused on ageing research and a data archive) and **pension policy modelling** ([[pensions-policy-institute]]), while **the "think-tank output framed around the longevity economy and aimed at policy and the public" form was missing**; **ILC-related entries measured zero**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **70.8KB**; ⭐ **measured report pages** include **"Making China longevity ready" (`/making-china-longevity-ready/`, 98.7KB)**, **"ILC briefing: longevity economy" (`/ilc-briefing-longevity-economy/`, 136.9KB)** and **"Economies for long lives – quantifying the longevity…" (`/economies-for-long-lives/`, 110.5KB)**, plus **"An age of economic opportunity: maximising the European…"** visible on the homepage.

entries.body:
**TISS（Troca de Informações na Saúde Suplementar，补充医疗信息交换标准）** 是**巴西的强制性电子数据交换标准**，由 **ANS（Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar，巴西补充医疗监管局）** 制定。所谓「补充医疗（saúde suplementar）」指**私人健康计划与健康保险**——与公立 SUS 体系并行。本条目补的是**「强制性国家级理赔/就诊数据标准」这一形态**：实测池内 **TISS / HL7 / claims standard 等相关条目为 0**（池内健康险侧此前是**美国** CMS／Medicare 系、**瑞士** [[axa-ch-health-insurance-data]]、**韩国** [[ohdsi-korean-nsc-etl]]、**香港** [[vhis-standard-premium]]、**印度** [[indian-health-claims-skill]]、**中国** 侧若干，**拉美整片为 0**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**，页面体量实测）：⭐ **TISS 标准主页 177.2KB，标题实测「TISS - Padrão para Troca de Informação de Saúde Suplementar」**，正文实测写明它「**foi estabelecida como um padrão obrigatório para as trocas eletrônicas de dados de atenção à saúde dos beneficiários de planos**」（**被确立为计划受益人健康照护数据电子交换的强制性标准**），目标为「**padronizar as ações administrativas, subsidiar as ações de avaliação e acompanhamento econômico, financeiro e assistencial das operadoras**」并**组成 Registro Eletrônico de Saúde（电子健康记录）**，其指导原则是在 ANS 与卫生部系统之间实现**互操作性**并**降低受益人的信息不对称**；页面实测列出 **「Padrão TISS – Julho/2026」（2026 年 7 月版）**、**「Histórico das versões dos Componentes」（各组件版本历史）**、**「Tabelas Relacionadas」（相关表）** 与 **TUSS 代码**入口；**页面更新日期实测 30/07/2026 11h44**。⭐ **TUSS 代码页 176.5KB，标题实测「Códigos da TUSS」**，正文实测写明 **TUSS（Terminologia Unificada da Saúde Suplementar，补充医疗统一术语）** 的代码可在**一个为组织、管理与标准化健康术语而开发的开源工具**中访问，且「**a plataforma é baseada no Open Concept Lab (OCL)**」，TUSS **集成于 TISS 标准之内**，被**健康计划运营商、服务提供方与系统开发者**使用；**页面更新日期实测 15/07/2026 17h54**。配套数据：**ANS「Dados e Indicadores do Setor」232.3KB** 与 **ANS「Dados Abertos」187.6KB**（后者实测含 **PDA 2026-2028** 数据开放计划文件，**更新日期实测 04/09/2026 13h07**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「标准层」这一形态，而且是强制性的**——池内健康险数据侧此前**全是数据本身或工具**（CMS 开放数据、HCC 风险调整、[[omop-common-data-model]] 等），**「这些数据以什么标准被强制交换」这一层此前没有**；TISS 是**政府强制、覆盖全行业**的口径，与池内 [[badx12]]（美国 X12 837/835 理赔报文的编辑规则）形成**两地对照**——**同是理赔报文层，美国以行业标准 X12 为载体，巴西以监管强制标准 TISS 为载体**（可与 [[healthcare-mrf-api]] 的美国价格透明口径、[[uwmd]] 的承保互操作标准并读）。**② TUSS 用 Open Concept Lab 发布代码，是一个具体可借鉴的做法**——**国家级医疗术语表没有做成静态 PDF，而是放到开源术语平台上**，这对做**条款/术语标准化**方向的学生是一个现成案例；可与 [[vhis-standard-premium]]（香港自愿医保按标准计划与保费）、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]、[[lossratio-r]] 并读。**③ 它解释了「为什么巴西的健康险数据可分析」**——强制标准 + 电子健康记录目标 + 数据开放计划三者叠加，**是拉美唯一具备这一数据底座的健康险市场**（可与 [[cmf-chile]] 的智利监管统计、[[ans-tiss-standard]] 同轮其他条目并读）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、关键正文表述（强制性、电子健康记录目标、TUSS 与 OCL 的关系、版本号与更新日期）与页面体量**，**但未下载任何 TISS 组件文件、未打开任何 XML/JSON 规范、未打开 TUSS 代码表**，因此**不能转述 TISS 的具体字段、报文结构与版本差异**；**② TUSS 代码表本次未实际检索**——**只是核实到「载体是 Open Concept Lab」这一事实**；**③ ANS 开放数据页所列数据集的清单与下载可用性本次未逐项核实**（**未下载任何数据集**）；**④ 页面以葡萄牙语为主，英文覆盖度未核实**；**⑤** 本词条**不主张** TISS 或 ANS 提供精算工具或模型。**核实说明**：TISS 主页（177.2KB）、Códigos da TUSS（176.5KB）、Dados e Indicadores do Setor（232.3KB）、Dados Abertos（187.6KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与正文表述；**未下载组件文件、未打开规范或代码表**。
entries.body_en:
**TISS (Troca de Informações na Saúde Suplementar)** is **Brazil’s mandatory electronic data-exchange standard**, set by **ANS (Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar)**, the supplementary-health regulator. "Supplementary health" means **private health plans and health insurance**, running in parallel with the public SUS system. This entry adds the **"mandatory national claims and encounter data standard"** form: a measured search found **zero entries for TISS, HL7 or any "claims standard"** (the corpus’s health-insurance side previously held **US** CMS/Medicare items, **Swiss** [[axa-ch-health-insurance-data]], **Korean** [[ohdsi-korean-nsc-etl]], **Hong Kong** [[vhis-standard-premium]], **Indian** [[indian-health-claims-skill]] and several **Chinese** items — **with Latin America entirely absent**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**, with page sizes measured): ⭐ the **TISS homepage is 177.2KB with the measured title "TISS - Padrão para Troca de Informação de Saúde Suplementar"**, and its body states verbatim that it **"foi estabelecida como um padrão obrigatório para as trocas eletrônicas de dados de atenção à saúde dos beneficiários de planos"** (it **was established as a mandatory standard for the electronic exchange of health-care data for plan beneficiaries**), aims to **"padronizar as ações administrativas, subsidiar as ações de avaliação e acompanhamento econômico, financeiro e assistencial das operadoras"** and to form the **Registro Eletrônico de Saúde (Electronic Health Record)**, its guiding principle being **interoperability** between ANS and Ministry of Health systems and **reducing beneficiaries’ information asymmetry**; the page lists a measured **"Padrão TISS – Julho/2026"** (July 2026 version), a **"Histórico das versões dos Componentes"** (component version history), **"Tabelas Relacionadas"** and an entry to **TUSS** codes; the **measured last-updated date is 30/07/2026 11h44**. ⭐ The **TUSS codes page is 176.5KB with the measured title "Códigos da TUSS"**, stating verbatim that **TUSS (Terminologia Unificada da Saúde Suplementar)** codes can be accessed in **an open-source tool built to organise, manage and standardise health terminologies** and that **"a plataforma é baseada no Open Concept Lab (OCL)"**; TUSS **is a component of the TISS standard** and is used by **health-plan operators, service providers and system developers**; the **measured last-updated date is 15/07/2026 17h54**. Companion data: ANS **"Dados e Indicadores do Setor" (232.3KB)** and ANS **"Dados Abertos" (187.6KB)**, the latter with measured **PDA 2026-2028** open-data plan files and a **measured last-updated date of 04/09/2026 13h07**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "standards layer", and a mandatory one** — the corpus’s health-insurance side previously held **only data or tools** (CMS open data, HCC risk adjustment, [[omop-common-data-model]] and so on), and **"the standard by which that data must be exchanged" had no entry**; TISS is a **government-mandated, industry-wide** regime, contrasting with [[badx12]] (US edit rules for X12 837/835 claim messages) — **the same claim-message layer, carried in the US by an industry standard (X12) and in Brazil by a regulator-mandated standard (TISS)** (readable with [[healthcare-mrf-api]] on US price transparency and [[uwmd]] on underwriting interoperability). **② TUSS publishing its codes through the Open Concept Lab is a concrete, transferable practice** — a **national health-terminology table delivered on an open terminology platform rather than as a static PDF**, a ready case for students working on **clause and terminology standardisation** (read with [[vhis-standard-premium]] on Hong Kong’s VHIS standard plans and premiums, [[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]] and [[lossratio-r]]). **③ It explains why Brazilian health-insurance data is analysable** — a mandatory standard plus an Electronic Health Record goal plus an open-data plan together make Brazil **the only Latin American health-insurance market with this data foundation** (read with [[cmf-chile]] and the other entries added this round).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, key body statements (mandatoriness, the Electronic Health Record goal, the TUSS-OCL relationship, version labels and update dates) and page sizes**, **but downloaded no TISS component file, opened no XML or JSON specification and opened no TUSS code table**, so **TISS field definitions, message structures and version differences cannot be restated**; **② the TUSS code table was not actually searched** — **only the fact that its carrier is the Open Concept Lab was verified**; **③ the dataset list on the ANS open-data page and its download availability were not verified item by item** (**no dataset was downloaded**); **④ the pages are mainly in Portuguese and English coverage was not verified**; **⑤** this entry **does not claim TISS or ANS provides actuarial tools or models**. **Verification note**: the TISS homepage (177.2KB), Códigos da TUSS (176.5KB), Dados e Indicadores do Setor (232.3KB) and Dados Abertos (187.6KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and body statements read; **no component file, specification or code table was opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**TISS（Troca de Informações na Saúde Suplementar，補充醫療信息交換標準）** 是**巴西的強制性電子數據交換標準**，由 **ANS（Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar，巴西補充醫療監管局）** 制定。「補充醫療」指**私人健康計劃與健康保險**，與公立 SUS 並行。本條目補的是**「強制性國家級理賠／就診數據標準」這一形態**：實測池內 **TISS / HL7 / claims standard 相關條目為 0**（池內健康險側此前是**美國** CMS／Medicare 系、**瑞士** [[axa-ch-health-insurance-data]]、**韓國** [[ohdsi-korean-nsc-etl]]、**香港** [[vhis-standard-premium]]、**印度** [[indian-health-claims-skill]] 等，**拉美整片為 0**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **TISS 主頁 177.2KB，標題實測「TISS - Padrão para Troca de Informação de Saúde Suplementar」**，正文寫明它「**foi estabelecida como um padrão obrigatório**」（**被確立為強制性標準**），目標為統一營運商的行政與經濟／財務／照護評估口徑並**組成電子健康記錄（Registro Eletrônico de Saúde）**，指導原則是在 ANS 與衛生部系統之間實現**互操作性**、**降低資訊不對稱**；頁面列出 **「Padrão TISS – Julho/2026」**、**組件版本歷史**與 **TUSS 代碼**入口；**更新日期實測 30/07/2026 11h44**。⭐ **TUSS 代碼頁 176.5KB，標題實測「Códigos da TUSS」**，正文寫明 **TUSS（補充醫療統一術語）** 代碼可在**一個為組織、管理與標準化健康術語而開發的開源工具**中訪問，且「**a plataforma é baseada no Open Concept Lab (OCL)**」，TUSS **集成於 TISS 之內**，被**健康計劃運營商、服務提供方與系統開發者**使用；**更新日期實測 15/07/2026 17h54**。配套：**ANS「Dados e Indicadores do Setor」232.3KB**、**ANS「Dados Abertos」187.6KB**（含 **PDA 2026-2028**，**更新日期實測 04/09/2026 13h07**）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「標準層」，而且是強制性的**——池內健康險數據側此前**全是數據本身或工具**，**「這些數據以什麼標準被強制交換」此前沒有**；與 [[badx12]]（美國 X12 837/835 理賠報文編輯規則）形成**兩地對照**——**同是理賠報文層，美國以行業標準為載體，巴西以監管強制標準為載體**（可與 [[healthcare-mrf-api]]、[[uwmd]] 並讀）。**② TUSS 用 Open Concept Lab 發布代碼是具體可借鑑的做法**——**國家級醫療術語表沒有做成靜態 PDF，而是放到開源術語平台**（可與 [[vhis-standard-premium]]、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]、[[lossratio-r]] 並讀）。**③ 它解釋了「為何巴西的健康險數據可分析」**——強制標準 + 電子健康記錄目標 + 數據開放計劃三者疊加，**是拉美唯一具備此數據底座的健康險市場**（可與 [[cmf-chile]] 並讀）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、關鍵正文表述、版本號與更新日期**，**但未下載任何 TISS 組件檔案、未打開任何 XML/JSON 規範、未打開 TUSS 代碼表**，故**不能轉述 TISS 的具體欄位、報文結構與版本差異**；**② TUSS 代碼表本次未實際檢索**——**只核實到「載體是 Open Concept Lab」**；**③ ANS 開放數據集清單與下載可用性未逐項核實**（**未下載任何數據集**）；**④ 頁面以葡萄牙語為主，英文覆蓋度未核實**；**⑤** 本詞條**不主張** TISS 或 ANS 提供精算工具或模型**。**核實說明**：四頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載組件檔案、未打開規範或代碼表**。

entries.title: Monitora TISS（巴西）：强制上报数据的质量监测程序与 TISS×DIOPS 完整度比对
entries.title_en: Monitora TISS (Brazil): a data-quality monitoring programme for mandated reporting, with a TISS-vs-DIOPS completeness comparison
entries.title_hk: Monitora TISS（巴西）：強制上報數據的質量監測程序與 TISS×DIOPS 完整度比對
entries.summary: ANS 对强制 TISS 上报数据设立的质量监测程序：以「答疑值班」答疑、按主题归类常见问题，并做 TISS 与 DIOPS 会计口径之间的完整度比对
entries.summary_en: A data-quality monitoring programme the ANS runs over mandated TISS reporting: question-and-answer sessions, FAQs grouped by theme, and a completeness comparison between TISS and the DIOPS accounting source
entries.summary_hk: ANS 對強制 TISS 上報數據設立的質量監測程序：以「答疑值班」答疑、按主題歸類常見問題，並做 TISS 與 DIOPS 會計口徑之間的完整度比對
entries.body:
**Monitora TISS** 是 **ANS（巴西补充医疗监管局）** 针对 **[[ans-tiss-standard]]** 上报数据设立的**质量监测程序**。本条目是上一则条目的配套，补的是**「监管者如何治理被强制上报数据的质量」这一形态**——**「有标准」不等于「数据能用」**，而池内此前**有数据质量工具、没有监管侧的数据质量治理机制**（对比：[[acord-data-quality-monitor]] 是**行业组织 ACORD 的提交数据质量监控工具**、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] 是**单点数据校验脚本**、[[great-expectations]] 是**通用数据质量框架**——**三者都不是「监管者对全体被监管机构上报数据的治理程序」**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **页面 273.1KB，标题实测「Monitora TISS」**；正文实测写明 **「O Monitora TISS é o programa de monitoramento da qualidade dos dados do Padrão TISS」**（**Monitora TISS 是 TISS 标准的数据质量监测程序**）；⭐ 实测写明 **「A realização de Plantões de Dúvidas se constitui em uma ação do monitoramento do Padrão TISS, a fim de prestar orientações necessárias ao aprimoramento da qualidade dos dados informados」**——**以「答疑值班（Plantões de Dúvidas）」作为监测手段，目的是提升所报数据质量**；⭐ 实测写明 **「As perguntas sobre o Padrão e a completude TISS X DIOPS encontram-se detalhadas a seguir e estão divididas de acordo com o tema」**——**围绕标准本身以及 TISS 与 DIOPS 之间的「完整度（completude）」比对，问题按主题分类列出**；实测可见的问答分组包括 **「VERSÃO 4 / NOVA VERSÃO DO PADRÃO」** 等；**页面更新日期实测 21/11/2025 16h42**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「监管侧数据治理」这一形态**——池内数据质量条目**全在工具层**（见上），而 **Monitora TISS 是「监管者发布标准 → 全行业被迫上报 → 监管者反过来监测上报质量」的闭环**；对做**监管科技与数据治理**方向的学生，**这是比工具更上层的一种机制**（可与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[ivass]] 的监管统计口径并读——**那些是监管者「发布统计」，这一条是监管者「治理上游数据」**）。**② 「TISS × DIOPS 完整度比对」是一个可直接迁移的方法论**——**同一批业务，用两条不同口径的上报数据互相校验完整度**；对做**数据质量评估**的学生，这是一个**具体的、有官方定义的对账思路**（可与 [[lossratio-r]]、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]、[[databricks-medicare-risk-adjustment]] 并读）。**③ 「答疑值班」这一做法本身值得注意**——**监管者把「答疑问」制度化为质量改进手段**，而不是单纯罚款；这对研究**监管执行风格差异**的学生是一个具体观察点。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、三处关键正文表述、问答分组标签与更新日期**，**但未展开阅读任何一条问答内容**，因此**不能转述 TISS 与 DIOPS 完整度比对的**具体指标定义、阈值或判定规则**；**② DIOPS 是什么、其与 TISS 的字段对应关系本次未单独核实**——**「DIOPS」仅作为页面正文中出现的术语被引用**，本词条不展开其定义；**③ 「Plantões de Dúvidas」的实际举办频率、参与情况与效果未核实**；**④ 本词条不主张该程序公布具体机构的合规排名或评分**（**这一点未核实，故不主张**）；**⑤ 页面以葡萄牙语为主**。**核实说明**：页面（273.1KB，标题「Monitora TISS」）HTTP 200 实测，三处正文表述逐字读取，更新日期 21/11/2025 16h42；**未展开任何问答条目、未单独核实 DIOPS 定义**。
entries.body_en:
**Monitora TISS** is the **data-quality monitoring programme** the **ANS** (Brazil’s supplementary-health regulator) runs over reporting under **[[ans-tiss-standard]]**. This entry accompanies the previous one and adds the **"how a regulator governs the quality of mandated reporting"** form — **a standard does not by itself make data usable** — the corpus previously had **data-quality tools but no regulator-side data-quality governance mechanism** (compare [[acord-data-quality-monitor]], an **industry body’s submission-quality monitor**; [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]], a **single-point validation script**; and [[great-expectations]], a **general-purpose data-quality framework** — **none of the three is a regulator’s programme for governing reporting across all supervised firms**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **page is 273.1KB with the measured title "Monitora TISS"**; its body states verbatim that **"O Monitora TISS é o programa de monitoramento da qualidade dos dados do Padrão TISS"** (**Monitora TISS is the data-quality monitoring programme of the TISS standard**); ⭐ it states verbatim that **"A realização de Plantões de Dúvidas se constitui em uma ação do monitoramento do Padrão TISS, a fim de prestar orientações necessárias ao aprimoramento da qualidade dos dados informados"** — **question-and-answer duty sessions serve as a monitoring action aimed at improving the quality of reported data**; ⭐ it states verbatim that **"As perguntas sobre o Padrão e a completude TISS X DIOPS encontram-se detalhadas a seguir e estão divididas de acordo com o tema"** — **questions about the standard and about the "completeness" comparison between TISS and DIOPS are set out below, grouped by theme**; measured question groups include **"VERSÃO 4 / NOVA VERSÃO DO PADRÃO"**; the **measured last-updated date is 21/11/2025 16h42**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "regulator-side data governance" form** — the corpus’s data-quality entries are **all at the tool level** (see above), whereas **Monitora TISS closes the loop of "regulator issues a standard → the whole industry must report → the regulator then monitors the quality of what it receives"**; for students working on **regtech and data governance**, this is **a mechanism one layer above the tools** (readable with the regulatory-statistics entries [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[hk-ia-statistics]] and [[ivass]] — **those publish statistics; this one governs the upstream data**). **② The "TISS vs DIOPS completeness" comparison is a directly transferable methodology** — **the same business, reported through two different channels, cross-checked for completeness**; for **data-quality assessment** work this is **a concrete, officially defined reconciliation approach** (readable with [[lossratio-r]], [[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]] and [[databricks-medicare-risk-adjustment]]). **③ The "question-and-answer duty session" practice is itself notable** — **the regulator institutionalises answering questions as a quality-improvement instrument** rather than relying on penalties alone, a concrete observation point for students studying **differences in supervisory enforcement style**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, the title, three verbatim body statements, question-group labels and the update date**, **but read no individual question-and-answer item**, so **the specific indicator definitions, thresholds or decision rules of the TISS-DIOPS completeness comparison cannot be restated**; **② what DIOPS is, and how its fields map to TISS, was not separately verified** — **"DIOPS" is cited only as a term appearing in the page text, and this entry does not expand its definition**; **③ the actual frequency, participation and effect of the "Plantões de Dúvidas" sessions were not verified**; **④ this entry does not claim the programme publishes per-firm compliance rankings or scores** (**unverified, therefore not claimed**); **⑤ the page is mainly in Portuguese**. **Verification note**: the page (273.1KB, title "Monitora TISS") was measured at HTTP 200, three body statements were read verbatim, and the update date is 21/11/2025 16h42; **no question item was expanded and the DIOPS definition was not separately verified**.

**Monitora TISS** 是 **ANS（巴西補充醫療監管局）** 針對 **[[ans-tiss-standard]]** 上報數據設立的**質量監測程序**。本條目是上一則的配套，補的是**「監管者如何治理被強制上報數據的質量」這一形態**——**「有標準」不等於「數據能用」**，池內此前**有數據質量工具、沒有監管側的數據質量治理機制**（對比：[[acord-data-quality-monitor]] 是**行業組織的提交數據質量監控工具**、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] 是**單點校驗腳本**、[[great-expectations]] 是**通用數據質量框架**——**三者都不是「監管者對全體被監管機構上報數據的治理程序」**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **頁面 273.1KB，標題實測「Monitora TISS」**；正文寫明 **「O Monitora TISS é o programa de monitoramento da qualidade dos dados do Padrão TISS」**；⭐ 寫明 **「A realização de Plantões de Dúvidas se constitui em uma ação do monitoramento do Padrão TISS, a fim de prestar orientações necessárias ao aprimoramento da qualidade dos dados informados」**——**以「答疑值班」作為監測手段以提升上報數據質量**；⭐ 寫明 **「As perguntas sobre o Padrão e a completude TISS X DIOPS encontram-se detalhadas a seguir e estão divididas de acordo com o tema」**——**圍繞標準本身以及 TISS 與 DIOPS 之間的「完整度」比對，問題按主題分類**；實測可見分組含 **「VERSÃO 4 / NOVA VERSÃO DO PADRÃO」**；**更新日期實測 21/11/2025 16h42**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「監管側數據治理」這一形態**——池內數據質量條目**全在工具層**，而 **Monitora TISS 是「監管者發標準 → 全行業上報 → 監管者反過來監測上報質量」的閉環**；對做**監管科技與數據治理**的學生，**這是比工具更上層的機制**（可與 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[ivass]] 並讀——**那些是監管者「發布統計」，這一條是監管者「治理上游數據」**）。**② 「TISS × DIOPS 完整度比對」是可遷移的方法論**——**同一批業務、兩條口徑互相校驗完整度**；**③ 「答疑值班」這做法本身值得注意**——**監管者把「答疑問」制度化為質量改進手段**，而非單純罰款，對研究**監管執行風格差異**是一個具體觀察點。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、三處關鍵正文表述、問答分組標籤與更新日期**，**但未展開閱讀任何一條問答內容**，故**不能轉述完整度比對的具體指標定義、閾值或判定規則**；**② DIOPS 是什麼、其與 TISS 的欄位對應關係本次未單獨核實**——**「DIOPS」僅作為頁面正文中出現的術語被引用**；**③ 「Plantões de Dúvidas」的實際頻率、參與情況與效果未核實**；**④ 本詞條不主張該程序公布具體機構的合規排名或評分**（**未核實，故不主張**）；**⑤ 頁面以葡萄牙語為主**。**核實說明**：頁面（273.1KB）HTTP 200 實測，三處正文逐字讀取，更新日期 21/11/2025 16h42；**未展開任何問答條目、未單獨核實 DIOPS 定義**。
