entries.title: Open Insurance（巴西）：同意制跨公司保险数据共享框架
entries.title_en: Open Insurance (Brazil): a consent-based cross-firm insurance data-sharing framework
entries.title_hk: Open Insurance（巴西）：同意制跨公司保險數據共享框架
entries.summary: 巴西 SUSEP 主导的国家级开放保险框架：经客户事先同意，在保险公司之间标准化共享数据与服务，含治理三层结构、数据/服务分期开放与「理赔通知、养老金可携带」等服务启动
entries.summary_en: Brazil’s SUSEP-led national open-insurance framework: with prior customer consent, data and services are shared across insurers on a standardised basis, with three governance levels, phased data/service opening, and service initiation such as claims notice and pension portability
entries.summary_hk: 巴西 SUSEP 主導的國家級開放保險框架：經客戶事先同意，在保險公司之間標準化共享數據與服務，含治理三層結構、數據／服務分期開放與「理賠通知、養老金可攜帶」等服務啟動
entries.body:
**Open Insurance（开放保险，又称 Sistema de Seguros Aberto）** 是**巴西由 SUSEP（保险监管局）主导的国家级框架**，其定义经 SUSEP 官方页面实测写明：**「a possibilidade de consumidores de produtos e serviços de seguros, previdência complementar aberta e capitalização permitirem o compartilhamento de suas informações entre diferentes sociedades autorizadas/credenciadas pela Susep」**——**保险、开放式补充养老金与资本化产品的消费者，可授权其信息在经 SUSEP 授权/认证的不同公司之间共享**；覆盖范围因此**不止保险，还包括养老金与资本化产品**。本条目补的是**「国家级、同意制的跨公司数据共享机制」这一形态**：实测池内 **open finance / open banking / open insurance 相关条目为 0**（池内最接近的是 [[openidl]]，但那是**Linux 基金会的保险数据「语言/标准」**，**不是数据共享机制**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **页面 385.5KB（394,802 字节），标题实测「Open Insurance」**；**同意要求**实测写明 **「O compartilhamento … depende de prévio consentimento por parte dos respectivos clientes」**，且同意须为 **「manifestação livre, informada, prévia e inequívoca de vontade, feita por meio eletrônico」**（**自由、知情、事先且明确的意思表示，通过电子方式作出**），用于**特定目的**；实测并明确注明 **「A fase 1 do Open Insurance não envolve o compartilhamento de dados pessoais dos clientes」**（**第一阶段不涉及客户个人数据共享**）。**治理结构**实测写明须建立**至少三个层级**：**Estratégico（战略层，由 Conselho Deliberativo 审议委员会组成）**、**Administrativo（行政层，由 Secretariado 秘书处组成）**、**Técnico（技术层，由 Grupos Técnicos 技术组组成）**，并写明**初期治理结构应于 03/09/2021 前建立、最终形态于 29/11/2024 前建立**。**分期开放内容**实测分为 **Open Data（含 Canais de atendimento 服务渠道、Produtos disponíveis 可用产品）**、**Compartilhamento de Dados Pessoais（含 Cadastro de clientes e participantes 客户与参与者登记、Movimentações 交易、Registros de dispositivos eletrônicos 电子设备记录）** 与 **Efetivação de Serviços（含 Acesso 访问、Modificações 修改、Resgate ou portabilidade 赎回或可携带、Aviso de sinistro 理赔通知）**。**可衍生方案**实测包括 **Comparadores e marketplaces（比较器与市场平台）**、**以数字方式启动保险与养老金服务**，以及**跨机构「财务生活」信息聚合**。**相关入口**实测另有 **SUSEP「Central de Painéis」361.7KB**（监管仪表盘集合）与 **SUSEP「Dados abertos」**（含 PDA 2025-2026 数据开放计划）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「数据共享机制层」这一形态**——池内此前**有开放数据（监管者公布数据）、有隐私/合规条目、有数据标准**，但**「客户授权后在机构之间流转」这一层没有**；Open Insurance 是**监管主导、全行业强制参与**的版本，与 [[openidl]] 的**行业自愿标准路线**形成**两条路线对照**（**一条自上而下靠监管、一条自下而上靠标准**）。**② 它的分期设计对做保险数字化的学生是现成的路线图**——**先开放「渠道与产品」这类非个人数据，再开放「客户登记与交易」个人数据，最后才是「服务启动（理赔通知、养老金可携带）」**；这与 [[susep-sro]] 的「Consulta de Seguros（消费者可查自己名下的保单）」构成**同一条演进的相邻两级**（**SRO 让客户看到自己的保单，Open Insurance 让客户把它授权给别人**）。**③ 「养老金可携带（portabilidade de previdência）」与「理赔通知」被列为可数字化的服务**——**对做香港强积金/退休产品比较的学生，这是一个可对照的制度设计样本**（可与 [[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[pbgc]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]] 并读）。**④ 治理三层结构本身是监管科技的组织样本**（战略/行政/技术分工），可与 [[iais-icp]]、[[bis-fsi]]、[[a2ii]] 的监管能力建设口径并读。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、定义、同意要求、治理三层结构、时间节点、分期开放内容与可衍生方案**（**均为页面正文逐字实测**），**但未打开任何 SUSEP 规范性文件（Circular/Resolução）、未核实任何 API 规范或技术手册**，因此**不能转述接口定义、参与机构名单或实际运行状态**；**② 该页面实测未显示「Publicado/Modificado」日期**（与其他 SUSEP 内容页不同），故**本词条不标注该页面的更新日期**；**③ 「开放保险是否已实际落地、覆盖多少机构」本次未核实**——**页面为制度说明性内容，本词条不主张其已全面运行**；**④ 本次未核实与巴西 Open Finance（银行侧）的实际衔接关系**；**⑤ 页面以葡萄牙语为主**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张**该框架提供数据下载或精算工具。**核实说明**：Open Insurance 页（385.5KB）HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取定义、同意、治理与分期内容；Central de Painéis（361.7KB）HTTP 200 实测；**未打开规范性文件或 API 规范、未核实参与机构与实际落地情况**。
entries.body_en:
**Open Insurance** (also *Sistema de Seguros Aberto*) is **Brazil’s national framework led by SUSEP**, the insurance supervisor. Its definition, read verbatim from the SUSEP page, is **"a possibilidade de consumidores de produtos e serviços de seguros, previdência complementar aberta e capitalização permitirem o compartilhamento de suas informações entre diferentes sociedades autorizadas/credenciadas pela Susep"** — **consumers of insurance, open supplementary pension and capitalisation products may authorise their information to be shared among different firms authorised or accredited by SUSEP**; the scope therefore covers **not only insurance but also pension and capitalisation products**. This entry adds the **"national, consent-based cross-firm data-sharing mechanism"** form: a measured search found **zero entries for open finance, open banking or open insurance** (the closest item, [[openidl]], is **the Linux Foundation’s insurance data language/standard**, **not a data-sharing mechanism**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **page is 385.5KB (394,802 bytes) with the measured title "Open Insurance"**; the **consent requirement** states verbatim that **"O compartilhamento … depende de prévio consentimento por parte dos respectivos clientes"**, the consent to be a **"manifestação livre, informada, prévia e inequívoca de vontade, feita por meio eletrônico"** (**a free, informed, prior and unequivocal expression of intent made electronically**) for **determined purposes**; it states explicitly that **"A fase 1 do Open Insurance não envolve o compartilhamento de dados pessoais dos clientes"** (**phase 1 does not involve sharing customers’ personal data**). The **governance structure** is stated to require **at least three levels**: **Estratégico (strategic, a Conselho Deliberativo)**; **Administrativo (administrative, a Secretariado)**; and **Técnico (technical, Grupos Técnicos)** — with initial governance to be in place by **03/09/2021** and the definitive form by **29/11/2024**. The **phased opening** covers **Open Data** (**Canais de atendimento** service channels, **Produtos disponíveis** available products); **Compartilhamento de Dados Pessoais** (**Cadastro de clientes e participantes**, **Movimentações**, **Registros de dispositivos eletrônicos**); and **Efetivação de Serviços** (**Acesso**, **Modificações**, **Resgate ou portabilidade**, **Aviso de sinistro**). **Derived solutions** include **Comparadores e marketplaces**, **digital initiation of insurance and pension services**, and **aggregation of financial-life information across institutions**. **Related entry points** measured: SUSEP **"Central de Painéis" (361.7KB)**, its dashboard hub, and SUSEP **"Dados abertos"** (including the PDA 2025-2026 open-data plan).

For RIAA: **① it adds the "data-sharing mechanism layer"** — the corpus previously had **open data (regulators publishing data), privacy/compliance items and data standards**, but **"data moving between firms at the customer’s authorisation" had no entry**; Open Insurance is the **regulator-led, industry-mandatory** version, contrasting with **[[openidl]]’s voluntary industry-standard route** (**one top-down through regulation, one bottom-up through standards**). **② Its phased design is a ready roadmap for insurance-digitalisation work** — **first non-personal data such as channels and products, then personal data such as customer registration and transactions, and only then service initiation (claims notice, pension portability)**; together with **[[susep-sro]]**’s "Consulta de Seguros" (consumers viewing policies in their own name) it forms **two adjacent stages of the same evolution** (**SRO lets customers see their policies; Open Insurance lets them authorise sharing them**). **③ "Portabilidade de previdência" and "aviso de sinistro" are listed as digit-isable services** — **for students comparing Hong Kong MPF and retirement products, this is a comparable institutional design sample** (readable with [[mpf-fund-platform]], [[pbgc]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]] and [[pensions-authority-ie]]). **④ The three-level governance structure is an organisational sample of regtech** (strategic/administrative/technical division of labour), readable with the supervisory-capacity work of [[iais-icp]], [[bis-fsi]] and [[a2ii]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, title, definition, consent requirement, three governance levels, the milestone dates, phased contents and derived solutions** (**all read verbatim from the page body**), **but opened no SUSEP normative instrument (Circular or Resolução) and verified no API specification or technical manual**, so **interface definitions, the list of participating firms and the actual operating state cannot be restated**; **② this page measurably shows no "Publicado/Modificado" date** (unlike other SUSEP content pages), **so this entry states no update date for it**; **③ whether open insurance has actually launched and how many firms it covers was not verified** — **the page is institutional description, and this entry does not claim it is fully operating**; **④ the practical link to Brazil’s bank-side Open Finance was not verified**; **⑤ the page is mainly in Portuguese**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim the framework offers data downloads or actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the Open Insurance page (385.5KB) was measured at HTTP 200 with the definition, consent, governance and phasing read verbatim; Central de Painéis (361.7KB) was measured at HTTP 200; **no normative instrument or API specification was opened and participating firms and actual deployment were not verified**.
entries.body_hk:
**Open Insurance（開放保險）** 是**巴西由 SUSEP（保險監管局）主導的國家級框架**，其定義經 SUSEP 官方頁面實測寫明：**「a possibilidade de consumidores de produtos e serviços de seguros, previdência complementar aberta e capitalização permitirem o compartilhamento de suas informações entre diferentes sociedades autorizadas/credenciadas pela Susep」**——**保險、開放式補充養老金與資本化產品的消費者，可授權其資訊在經 SUSEP 授權／認證的不同公司之間共享**；覆蓋範圍**不止保險，還包括養老金與資本化產品**。本條目補的是**「國家級、同意制的跨公司數據共享機制」這一形態**：實測池內 **open finance / open banking / open insurance 相關條目為 0**（池內最接近的是 [[openidl]]，但那是**保險數據「語言／標準」**，**不是數據共享機制**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **頁面 385.5KB，標題實測「Open Insurance」**；**同意要求**寫明 **「depende de prévio consentimento por parte dos respectivos clientes」**，且同意須為 **「livre, informada, prévia e inequívoca de vontade, feita por meio eletrônico」**；並明確註明 **「A fase 1 do Open Insurance não envolve o compartilhamento de dados pessoais dos clientes」**（**第一階段不涉及個人數據共享**）。**治理結構**須建立**至少三層**：**Estratégico（戰略層，Conselho Deliberativo）**、**Administrativo（行政層，Secretariado）**、**Técnico（技術層，Grupos Técnicos）**，並寫明**初期結構應於 03/09/2021 前建立、最終形態於 29/11/2024 前建立**。**分期開放**分為 **Open Data（Canais de atendimento、Produtos disponíveis）**、**Compartilhamento de Dados Pessoais（Cadastro de clientes e participantes、Movimentações、Registros de dispositivos eletrônicos）** 與 **Efetivação de Serviços（Acesso、Modificações、Resgate ou portabilidade、Aviso de sinistro）**。**可衍生方案**含 **Comparadores e marketplaces**、**以數字方式啟動保險與養老金服務**、**跨機構財務生活資訊聚合**。**相關入口**另有 **SUSEP「Central de Painéis」361.7KB** 與 **SUSEP「Dados abertos」**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「數據共享機制層」**——池內此前**有開放數據、有隱私／合規、有數據標準**，但**「客戶授權後在機構之間流轉」這一層沒有**；與 [[openidl]] 的**行業自願標準路線**形成**兩條路線對照**（**一條自上而下靠監管、一條自下而上靠標準**）。**② 分期設計是現成的路線圖**——**先開放「渠道與產品」非個人數據，再開放「客戶登記與交易」個人數據，最後才是「服務啟動（理賠通知、養老金可攜帶）」**；與 [[susep-sro]] 的「Consulta de Seguros」構成**同一演進的相鄰兩級**。**③ 「養老金可攜帶」與「理賠通知」被列為可數字化服務**——**對做強積金／退休產品比較的學生是可對照的制度設計樣本**（可與 [[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[pbgc]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]] 並讀）。**④ 治理三層結構本身是監管科技的組織樣本**，可與 [[iais-icp]]、[[bis-fsi]]、[[a2ii]] 並讀。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、定義、同意要求、治理三層結構、時間節點、分期內容與可衍生方案**（**均逐字實測**），**但未打開任何 SUSEP 規範性文件、未核實任何 API 規範或技術手冊**，故**不能轉述接口定義、參與機構名單或實際運行狀態**；**② 該頁實測未顯示「Publicado/Modificado」日期**，故**不標註其更新日期**；**③ 「是否已實際落地、覆蓋多少機構」未核實**——**頁面為制度說明性內容，本詞條不主張其已全面運行**；**④ 與巴西銀行側 Open Finance 的實際銜接未核實**；**⑤ 頁面以葡萄牙語為主**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張**該框架提供數據下載或精算工具**。**核實說明**：Open Insurance 頁（385.5KB）HTTP 200 實測；Central de Painéis（361.7KB）HTTP 200 實測；**未打開規範性文件或 API 規範**。

entries.title: SRO（巴西 SUSEP）：三层次保险交易登记系统与数据质量管控
entries.title_en: SRO (SUSEP, Brazil): a three-tier insurance transaction registry with built-in data-quality controls
entries.title_hk: SRO（巴西 SUSEP）：三層次保險交易登記系統與數據質量管控
entries.summary: 巴西保险交易登记系统：保险公司把逐笔交易报给「登记实体」，登记实体校验存储后汇入「集成平台」，集成平台施加数据质量机制再经接口与仪表盘供监管使用，并已衍生出消费者可查自己保单的服务
entries.summary_en: Brazil’s insurance transaction registry: insurers send operation-level records to registrar entities, which validate and store them before feeding an integrated platform that applies data-quality mechanisms and exposes data to the regulator through interfaces and dashboards — already yielding services that let consumers see policies in their own name
entries.summary_hk: 巴西保險交易登記系統：保險公司把逐筆交易報給「登記實體」，登記實體校驗存儲後匯入「集成平台」，集成平台施加數據質量機制再經接口與儀表盤供監管使用，並已衍生出消費者查閱自身保單的服務
entries.body:
**SRO（Sistema de Registro de Operações，交易登记系统）** 是 **SUSEP（巴西保险监管局）** 的**逐笔保险交易数据采集系统**。其目的经官方页面实测写明：**「visa à captação de dados granulares das operações do mercado supervisionado e à instrumentalização de recursos de exploração desses dados, aperfeiçoando a Susep em suas atividades de supervisão e prestação de serviços à sociedade e ao Estado」**——**采集被监管市场的「颗粒化（granulares）」交易数据，并把数据开发能力工具化**，以改进 SUSEP 的**监管**职能与**面向社会与国家**的服务。本条目补的是**「监管者的逐笔交易登记架构」这一形态**：实测池内 **operation-level / transaction-level / trade repository / granular data 相关条目为 0**（池内监管数据侧此前是**汇总统计类**——[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[ivass]] 等，**都是「监管者公布汇总数据」，没有「监管者作为逐笔数据登记中心」这一层**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **页面 347.7KB（356,018 字节），标题实测「Sistema de Registro de Operações」**。**三段式架构**实测写明：**「No SRO, o mercado segurador envia registros de operações para as Entidades Registradoras, que validam, armazenam e disponibilizam os dados para a Plataforma Integrada」**——**保险市场把交易记录发送给「登记实体（Entidades Registradoras）」，登记实体负责校验、存储并向「集成平台（Plataforma Integrada）」提供数据**；**「A Plataforma Integrada recebe essas informações, aplica mecanismos de qualidade de dados e disponibiliza os dados e informações para a SUSEP por meio de interfaces e dashboards」**——**集成平台接收信息、施加「数据质量机制（mecanismos de qualidade de dados）」、并通过接口与仪表盘向 SUSEP 提供**；**「A SUSEP … utiliza as informações e dados para supervisão e para disponibilização de informações e serviços à sociedade e a outros órgãos de estado」**。**已落地的消费者侧服务**实测写明：**「Serviços como o Consulta de Seguros, que permite ao consumidor acessar as apólices registradas em seu nome, e o Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia, são resultados concretos do SRO, já disponíveis à sociedade」**——**「Consulta de Seguros（消费者可访问登记在自己名下的保单）」与「Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia」已是 SRO 的具体成果并对社会开放**。**规划方向**实测写明可能包括**跨金融机构（含保险、补充养老金与资本化产品）的「财务生活」信息聚合**。页面并设有**「Benefícios esperados」**分别面向 **SUSEP / Consumidores / Administração Pública** 说明。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「逐笔数据登记架构」这一形态**——池内监管侧此前**全是「监管者发布汇总统计」**，而 SRO 是**「监管者建一个逐笔登记层，再在登记层之上做监管与公众服务」**；这对做**保险监管数据基础设施**方向的学生，是**比统计门户更上游的一种设计**（可与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[ivass]] 并读——**那些是成果，这一条是产生成果的管道**）。**② 「登记实体」这一中间层值得注意**——**监管者不直接收数，而是要求行业通过受认可的登记实体报数，由登记实体承担校验与存储**；这是一种**监管与行业分工的具体制度安排**，与 [[monitora-tiss]] 的「监管者直接监测上报质量」形成**两条治理路线对照**（**一条靠中间机构、一条靠监管者自建程序**）。**③ 「消费者可查自己名下的保单」是保险数据基础设施的直接公共价值**——这一点可与 [[susep-open-insurance]] 的「同意后跨公司共享」连读：**SRO 让客户看到自己的保单，Open Insurance 让客户授权把它共享出去**——**两级设计正好构成一条完整的客户数据主权路径**（可与 [[mpf-fund-platform]] 的香港强积金基金平台、[[pensions-authority-ie]] 的公开登记册对照）。**④ 「granulares（颗粒化）」一词值得单独注意**——**监管数据口径从汇总走向逐笔是国际趋势**，本条目给出了一个**发展中国家的完整实现样本**（含登记实体、集成平台、数据质量机制三个环节）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、三段式架构描述、四段关键正文表述、消费者侧服务名称与规划方向**（**均为页面正文逐字实测**），**但未打开任何 SUSEP 规范性文件、未核实登记实体名单、未打开集成平台或任何接口/仪表盘**，因此**不能转述数据字段、报送频率、校验规则或实际数据量**；**② 「Entidades Registradoras」的制度定义、数量与准入条件本次未核实**——**该词仅作为页面正文术语被引用**；**③ Consulta de Seguros 与 Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia 本次未实际打开使用**，故**不描述其界面、覆盖范围或可用性**；**④ 「规划方向」（跨机构财务生活聚合）实测为页面所述规划，本词条不主张其已实现**；**⑤ 本次未核实 SRO 与 Open Insurance 在技术层面的实际衔接**（**两者的关系描述基于页面各自正文，属合理连读而非官方声明的对接关系**）；**⑥ 页面以葡萄牙语为主**；**⑦ 本次首次探测该 URL 时返回 HTTP 429（速率限制），延迟重试后两次均为 200 且体量一致（356,018 字节）**。**核实说明**：SRO 页（347.7KB/356,018 字节）HTTP 200 实测两次（首次 429 为速率限制，延迟重试后一致）；四段正文逐字读取；**未打开规范性文件、未核实登记实体名单、未使用消费者侧服务**。
entries.body_en:
**SRO (Sistema de Registro de Operações)** is **SUSEP’s operation-level insurance transaction data-collection system**. Its stated purpose, read verbatim from the official page, is **"visa à captação de dados granulares das operações do mercado supervisionado e à instrumentalização de recursos de exploração desses dados, aperfeiçoando a Susep em suas atividades de supervisão e prestação de serviços à sociedade e ao Estado"** — **to capture granular data on supervised-market operations and to turn the exploitation of that data into capability**, improving SUSEP’s **supervisory** work and its **services to society and the state**. This entry adds the **"regulator as an operation-level registry architect"** form: a measured search found **zero entries for operation-level, transaction-level, trade repository or granular data** (the corpus’s regulatory-data side previously held **aggregate statistics** — [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[naic-financial-data-repository]], [[ivass]] and others — **all "regulator publishes aggregate data", with no "regulator as an operation-level registry" layer**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **page is 347.7KB (356,018 bytes) with the measured title "Sistema de Registro de Operações"**. The **three-tier architecture** is stated verbatim: **"No SRO, o mercado segurador envia registros de operações para as Entidades Registradoras, que validam, armazenam e disponibilizam os dados para a Plataforma Integrada"** — **the insurance market sends operation records to registrar entities (Entidades Registradoras), which validate, store and make the data available to the integrated platform (Plataforma Integrada)**; **"A Plataforma Integrada recebe essas informações, aplica mecanismos de qualidade de dados e disponibiliza os dados e informações para a SUSEP por meio de interfaces e dashboards"** — **the integrated platform applies data-quality mechanisms and exposes the data to SUSEP through interfaces and dashboards**; and **"A SUSEP … utiliza as informações e dados para supervisão e para disponibilização de informações e serviços à sociedade e a outros órgãos de estado"**. **Consumer-facing services already delivered** are stated verbatim: **"Serviços como o Consulta de Seguros, que permite ao consumidor acessar as apólices registradas em seu nome, e o Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia, são resultados concretos do SRO, já disponíveis à sociedade"** — **"Consulta de Seguros" (consumers accessing policies registered in their own name) and "Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia" are concrete results already available to society**. **Planned direction** measurably includes **aggregation of "financial life" information across financial institutions, including insurance, supplementary pension and capitalisation products**. The page also carries **"Benefícios esperados"** sections addressing **SUSEP, consumers and public administration** separately.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "operation-level data registry architecture"** — the corpus’s regulatory side previously held **only "regulator publishes aggregate statistics"**, whereas SRO is **"the regulator builds an operation-level registry layer and then layers supervision and public services on top of it"**; for students working on **insurance supervisory data infrastructure**, this is **a design one layer upstream of the statistics portals** (readable with [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[naic-financial-data-repository]] and [[ivass]] — **those are outputs; this is the pipeline producing them**). **② The "registrar entities" middle layer is notable** — **the regulator does not collect data directly but requires the industry to report through accredited registrars that carry out validation and storage**; this is **a concrete institutional division of labour between regulator and industry**, contrasting with [[monitora-tiss]]’s **regulator-run monitoring of reporting quality** (**one route through an intermediary, one through a programme the regulator builds itself**). **③ "Consumers can see policies in their own name" is a direct public value of insurance data infrastructure** — and it reads together with [[susep-open-insurance]]’s "sharing across firms after consent": **SRO lets customers see their policies, Open Insurance lets them authorise sharing them** — **together the two form a complete customer-data-sovereignty path** (comparable with Hong Kong’s [[mpf-fund-platform]] and the public register of [[pensions-authority-ie]]). **④ The word "granulares" deserves separate note** — **a shift in supervisory data from aggregate to operation-level is an international trend**, and this entry gives **a complete implementation sample from a developing economy** (registrar entities, integrated platform and data-quality mechanisms).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, the title, the three-tier architecture description, four verbatim body statements, the consumer service names and the planned direction** (**all read verbatim from the page body**), **but opened no SUSEP normative instrument, verified no list of registrar entities, and opened neither the integrated platform nor any interface or dashboard**, so **data fields, reporting frequency, validation rules and actual data volumes cannot be restated**; **② the institutional definition, number and admission criteria of "Entidades Registradoras" were not verified** — **the term is cited only as it appears in the page text**; **③ Consulta de Seguros and Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia were not actually opened or used**, so **their interface, coverage and availability are not described**; **④ the "planned direction" (cross-institution financial-life aggregation) is measurably presented as a plan, and this entry does not claim it has been implemented**; **⑤ the practical technical linkage between SRO and Open Insurance was not verified** (**the relationship described here rests on each page’s own text and is a reasonable reading rather than an officially stated integration**); **⑥ the page is mainly in Portuguese**; **⑦ the first probe of this URL returned HTTP 429 (rate limiting); after a delay, two retries returned 200 with identical size (356,018 bytes)**. **Verification note**: the SRO page (347.7KB / 356,018 bytes) was measured at HTTP 200 twice (the first 429 was rate limiting; delayed retries were identical); four body statements were read verbatim; **no normative instrument, registrar list or consumer service was opened or used**.

**SRO（Sistema de Registro de Operações，交易登記系統）** 是 **SUSEP（巴西保險監管局）** 的**逐筆保險交易數據採集系統**。其目的經官方頁面實測寫明：**「visa à captação de dados granulares das operações do mercado supervisionado e à instrumentalização de recursos de exploração desses dados」**——**採集被監管市場的「顆粒化」交易數據並把數據開發能力工具化**。本條目補的是**「監管者的逐筆交易登記架構」這一形態**：實測池內 **operation-level / transaction-level / trade repository / granular data 相關條目為 0**（池內監管數據側此前是**匯總統計類**——[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[ivass]] 等，**都是「監管者公布匯總數據」，沒有「監管者作為逐筆數據登記中心」這一層**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **頁面 347.7KB（356,018 位元組），標題實測「Sistema de Registro de Operações」**。**三段式架構**實測寫明：**「o mercado segurador envia registros de operações para as Entidades Registradoras, que validam, armazenam e disponibilizam os dados para a Plataforma Integrada」**——**保險市場把交易記錄發送給「登記實體」，由其校驗、存儲並提供給「集成平台」**；**「A Plataforma Integrada recebe essas informações, aplica mecanismos de qualidade de dados e disponibiliza os dados e informações para a SUSEP por meio de interfaces e dashboards」**——**集成平台施加「數據質量機制」，並通過接口與儀表盤向 SUSEP 提供**；**「A SUSEP … utiliza as informações e dados para supervisão e para disponibilização de informações e serviços à sociedade」**。**已落地的消費者側服務**實測寫明：**「Serviços como o Consulta de Seguros, que permite ao consumidor acessar as apólices registradas em seu nome, e o Consulta às apólices de Seguro Garantia, são resultados concretos do SRO, já disponíveis à sociedade」**。**規劃方向**實測含**跨金融機構（含保險、補充養老金與資本化產品）的「財務生活」資訊聚合**。頁面並設 **「Benefícios esperados」** 分別面向 SUSEP／消費者／公共行政說明。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「逐筆數據登記架構」**——池內監管側此前**全是「監管者發布匯總統計」**，而 SRO 是**「監管者建逐筆登記層，再在其上做監管與公眾服務」**；對做**保險監管數據基礎設施**的學生，**這是比統計門戶更上游的設計**（可與 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[ivass]] 並讀——**那些是成果，這一條是產生成果的管道**）。**② 「登記實體」這一中間層值得注意**——**監管者不直接收數，而要求行業通過受認可的登記實體報數**；與 [[monitora-tiss]] 的「監管者直接監測上報質量」形成**兩條治理路線對照**。**③ 「消費者可查自己名下的保單」是保險數據基礎設施的直接公共價值**——與 [[susep-open-insurance]] 連讀：**SRO 讓客戶看到自己的保單，Open Insurance 讓客戶授權共享出去**，**兩級構成完整的客戶數據主權路徑**（可與 [[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]] 對照）。**④ 「granulares（顆粒化）」一詞值得單獨注意**——**監管數據口徑從匯總走向逐筆是國際趨勢**，本條目給出**一個包含登記實體、集成平台、數據質量機制三個環節的完整樣本**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、三段式架構、四段關鍵正文、消費者側服務名稱與規劃方向**（**均逐字實測**），**但未打開任何 SUSEP 規範性文件、未核實登記實體名單、未打開集成平台或任何接口／儀表盤**，故**不能轉述數據欄位、報送頻率、校驗規則或實際數據量**；**② 「Entidades Registradoras」的制度定義、數量與准入條件未核實**——**該詞僅作為頁面正文術語被引用**；**③ 兩個消費者側服務本次未實際打開使用**，故**不描述其界面、覆蓋範圍或可用性**；**④ 「規劃方向」實測為頁面所述規劃，本詞條不主張其已實現**；**⑤ SRO 與 Open Insurance 的技術層面實際銜接未核實**（**兩者關係描述基於各自頁面正文，屬合理連讀而非官方聲明的對接關係**）；**⑥ 頁面以葡萄牙語為主**；**⑦ 首次探測該 URL 時返回 HTTP 429（速率限制），延遲重試後兩次均為 200 且體量一致（356,018 位元組）**。**核實說明**：SRO 頁（347.7KB）HTTP 200 實測兩次；四段正文逐字讀取；**未打開規範性文件、未核實登記實體名單、未使用消費者側服務**。

entries.body:
**FOS（Financial Ombudsman Service，英国金融申诉专员服务）** 是**英国处理金融消费者与机构之间争议的法定申诉机构**，其覆盖范围包含保险。本条目补的是**「争议裁决的公开一手来源」这一形态**：实测池内申诉/争议侧此前**只有一条 [[hk-icb]]（香港保险投诉局，以投诉个案年报数据为主）**，而 **FOS 提供的是「逐案裁决库」而非「汇总年报」**——**这是本条目补上的东西**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页标题实测为 **「Financial Ombudsman Service: Our homepage」**；⭐ **「Ombudsman decisions（申诉专员裁决）」页 `/businesses/resolving-complaint/ombudsman-decisions`，实测 86.4KB，标题「Ombudsman decisions」**——**公开裁决的检索入口**；⭐ **「Our insight」页 `/businesses/resolving-complaint/our-insight`，实测 96.3KB，标题「Our insight | Page 1 of 14」**——**洞见文章库共 14 页**（`/data-insight` 实测解析到同一页，96.3KB）；**「Our business homepage」`/businesses` 实测 88.2KB**；⭐ 实测新闻页标题为 **「Financial Ombudsman received 53,600 cases in the first quarter of 2026/27」**——**按季公布受理案件量，且数字写进标题**；导航实测另含 **How we resolve complaints**、**Our governance and funding**、**Annual reports and accounts**、**Consultations**、**Modernising the redress system**、**Strategic plans and budget**、**Our Board of Directors**、**Our Executive Team**、**Our Ombudsmen**、**Data and insight**、**News**，以及 **case studies（案例）** 栏目。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「争议裁决的一手资料层」**——池内有 [[fca-open-data]]（**监管者公布的机构自报投诉量**，属**监管申报口径**），而 **FOS 公布的是「升级到申诉专员并作出裁决」的案件与理由**，**两者口径不同、不能互相替代**（本词条在此明确写出这一区分，避免读者把二者混为一谈）。**② 「逐案裁决」对做产品条款与理赔争议的学生是可直接用的材料**——**条款怎么写、理赔怎么被拒、裁决怎么站边**，这些在汇总统计里看不到；可与 [[lossratio-r]]、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]、[[insurance-qa-en]]、[[payer-agent-audit]] 并读。**③ 与 [[hk-icb]] 构成「香港 vs 英国」的消费者救济对照**——两地都是保险争议处理机构，但**一个以年报统计为主、一个以逐案裁决库为主**；这对**跨境比较消费者保护强度**的研究是一个具体切入点。**④ 案件量本身是行业观察指标**——**申诉案件量的变化往往先于监管处罚反映产品问题**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量、导航结构与一处案件量标题**，**但未检索裁决库、未打开任何一份裁决书、未打开任何一期年报或洞见文章**，因此**不能转述任何个案结论、裁决理由或统计口径**；**② 53,600 这一数字来自页面标题实测**，**本次未打开正文核实其统计范围、口径与是否含保险拆分**；**③ 「裁决库是否可全文检索、覆盖年限、是否收费或需登录」本次未核实**；**④** 首页导航中另见一个 **`complaints.financial-ombudsman.org.uk/ombudsman-dashboard` 仪表盘链接**，**该链接本次未打开**，故**本词条不描述其内容**；**⑤** 本次尝试的 `/businesses/complaints-data` **路径返回 404**（**属我猜测的路径错误，非站点问题**）——**故本词条不使用该 URL**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张** FOS 提供精算工具或保险定价数据。**核实说明**：首页（200）、`/businesses`（88.2KB）、`ombudsman-decisions`（86.4KB）、`our-insight`（96.3KB，含「Page 1 of 14」）、`/data-insight`（96.3KB）、案件量新闻页（标题实测）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未检索裁决库、未打开裁决书、年报或洞见文章、未打开仪表盘**。
entries.body_en:
**FOS (the Financial Ombudsman Service)** is **the United Kingdom’s statutory dispute-resolution body for financial consumers and firms**, and its remit includes insurance. This entry adds the **"public primary source of decided disputes"** form: the corpus’s complaints and disputes side previously held **only [[hk-icb]] (the Hong Kong Insurance Complaints Bureau, centred on annual complaint statistics)**, whereas **FOS offers "a case-by-case decisions database" rather than "an aggregated annual report"** — **and that is what this entry adds**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage title reads **"Financial Ombudsman Service: Our homepage"**; ⭐ the **"Ombudsman decisions" page `/businesses/resolving-complaint/ombudsman-decisions` measures 86.4KB with the title "Ombudsman decisions"** — **the entry point to published, searchable decisions**; ⭐ the **"Our insight" page `/businesses/resolving-complaint/our-insight` measures 96.3KB with the title "Our insight | Page 1 of 14"** — **a 14-page insight library** (with `/data-insight` measurably resolving to the same page, 96.3KB); the **"Our business homepage" `/businesses` measures 88.2KB**; ⭐ a measured news page title reads **"Financial Ombudsman received 53,600 cases in the first quarter of 2026/27"** — **case volumes are published quarterly, with the figure in the headline**; measured navigation also includes **How we resolve complaints**, **Our governance and funding**, **Annual reports and accounts**, **Consultations**, **Modernising the redress system**, **Strategic plans and budget**, **Our Board of Directors**, **Our Executive Team**, **Our Ombudsmen**, **Data and insight** and **News**, plus a **case studies** section.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "primary material on decided disputes" layer** — the corpus holds [[fca-open-data]] (**complaint volumes reported by firms themselves**, a **regulatory-return basis**), whereas **FOS publishes cases escalated to the ombudsman together with the decisions and reasoning** — **different bases that cannot substitute for one another** (stated explicitly here so readers do not conflate them). **② Case-by-case decisions are directly usable for work on policy wording and claims disputes** — **how a clause is drafted, how a claim is refused, and which way a decision goes** are invisible in aggregate statistics; readable with [[lossratio-r]], [[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]], [[insurance-qa-en]] and [[payer-agent-audit]]. **③ With [[hk-icb]] it forms a "Hong Kong versus UK" contrast in consumer redress** — both handle insurance disputes, but **one is centred on annual statistics and the other on a case-by-case decisions database**, a concrete entry point for **cross-border comparison of consumer-protection strength**. **④ Case volumes are themselves an industry indicator** — **changes in complaint volumes often foreshadow product problems before regulatory penalties do**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes, navigation structure and one measured case-volume headline**, **but searched no decisions database, opened no individual decision, and opened no annual report or insight article**, so **no case outcome, reasoning or statistical basis can be restated**; **② the 53,600 figure comes from a measured page title**, and **its scope, basis and whether an insurance breakdown exists were not verified in the body**; **③ whether the decisions database is full-text searchable, what years it covers, and whether it needs payment or login were not verified**; **④** the homepage navigation links a **`complaints.financial-ombudsman.org.uk/ombudsman-dashboard` dashboard**, **which was not opened**, so **this entry does not describe its contents**; **⑤** the path `/businesses/complaints-data` **returned 404 in this check** (**my guessed path was wrong, not a site fault**) — **so this entry does not use that URL**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim FOS provides actuarial tools or insurance pricing data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (200), `/businesses` (88.2KB), `ombudsman-decisions` (86.4KB), `our-insight` (96.3KB, including "Page 1 of 14"), `/data-insight` (96.3KB) and the case-volume news page (title measured) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no decisions database search, decision, annual report, insight article or dashboard was opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**FOS（Financial Ombudsman Service，英國金融申訴專員服務）** 是**英國處理金融消費者與機構之間爭議的法定申訴機構**，覆蓋範圍包含保險。本條目補的是**「爭議裁決的公開一手來源」這一形態**：實測池內申訴／爭議側此前**只有 [[hk-icb]]（香港保險投訴局，以投訴個案年報數據為主）**，而 **FOS 提供的是「逐案裁決庫」而非「匯總年報」**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁標題實測 **「Financial Ombudsman Service: Our homepage」**；⭐ **「Ombudsman decisions」頁實測 86.4KB，標題「Ombudsman decisions」**——**公開裁決檢索入口**；⭐ **「Our insight」頁實測 96.3KB，標題「Our insight | Page 1 of 14」**——**洞見文章庫共 14 頁**（`/data-insight` 實測解析到同一頁）；**`/businesses` 實測 88.2KB**；⭐ 新聞頁標題實測 **「Financial Ombudsman received 53,600 cases in the first quarter of 2026/27」**——**按季公布案件量**；導航另含 **How we resolve complaints**、**Annual reports and accounts**、**Consultations**、**Our Ombudsmen**、**Data and insight** 與 **case studies** 欄目。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「爭議裁決一手資料層」**——池內有 [[fca-open-data]]（**機構自報投訴量**，屬**監管申報口徑**），而 **FOS 公布的是「升級到申訴專員並作出裁決」的案件與理由**，**兩者口徑不同、不能互相替代**。**② 「逐案裁決」對做條款與理賠爭議的學生可直接使用**——**條款怎麼寫、理賠怎麼被拒、裁決怎麼站邊**，這些在匯總統計裡看不到（可與 [[lossratio-r]]、[[insurance-qa-en]]、[[payer-agent-audit]] 並讀）。**③ 與 [[hk-icb]] 構成「香港 vs 英國」對照**——**一個以年報統計為主、一個以逐案裁決庫為主**。**④ 案件量本身是行業觀察指標**——**申訴量的變化往往先於監管處罰反映產品問題**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量、導航結構與一處案件量標題**，**但未檢索裁決庫、未打開任何裁決書、未打開年報或洞見文章**，故**不能轉述任何個案結論或統計口徑**；**② 53,600 來自頁面標題實測**，**未打開正文核實其範圍與是否含保險拆分**；**③ 裁決庫可否全文檢索、覆蓋年限、是否收費或需登入未核實**；**④ 首頁導航另見儀表盤連結，該連結本次未打開**，故**不描述其內容**；**⑤** 本次嘗試的 `/businesses/complaints-data` **返回 404**（**屬我猜測路徑錯誤，非站點問題**）——**故不使用該 URL**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張** FOS 提供精算工具或保險定價數據**。**核實說明**：六個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測；**未檢索裁決庫、未打開裁決書／年報／洞見文章／儀表盤**。

entries.body:
**NOLHGA（National Organization of Life & Health Insurance Guaranty Associations）** 是**美国各州寿险与健康险保障协会的全国性协调组织**，其作用是当一家会员保险公司破产时，由**各州保障协会接手保单、继续给付**。本条目补的是**「保单持有人保障 / 保险破产」这一形态**：**实测池内该形态成员为 0**——池内最接近的是 **[[pbgc]]，但那是养老金给付保证（美国 ERISA 体系下的养老金保险）**，**对象是养老金而非保单**；另有 **[[hkmc]]**，其条目内容是**公共年金、逆按揭与按揭保险统计**，**并不覆盖保单持有人保障计划**（**这一点本词条特别注明，以免读者误以为香港的保障计划已被收录**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页标题实测为 **「Home - NOLHGA」**；⭐ **「Insolvent Insurance Companies（破产保险公司）」页 `/the-guaranty-system/insolvent-insurance-companies/`，实测 230.2KB**——**体量为全站最大的数据页之一**；⭐ **「Insolvency Costs（破产成本）」页 `/the-guaranty-system/insolvency-costs/`，实测 181.1KB**；**「Guaranty System Reports（保障体系报告）」页 `/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-system-reports/`，实测 126.1KB**；导航实测另含 **`/the-guaranty-system/assessments-capacity/`（分摊与能力）**、**`/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-association-laws/`（各州保障协会法律）**、**`/the-guaranty-system/nolhga-journal/`（NOLHGA Journal 期刊）**、**`/the-guaranty-system/overview-the-guaranty-system/`**、**`/policyholders/insolvent-insurance-companies/`**、**`/policyholders/contact-my-guaranty-association/`（按州找到对应保障协会）**、**`/assessable-premium-exhibit-resources-2/`（可分摊保费明细资料）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「保险破产」这一风险维度的数据层**——池内风险侧此前**极密**（准备金、巨灾、死亡率、网络风险各数十条），但**「保险公司自己倒闭」这一风险几乎无人覆盖**；**对做保险公司偿付能力与市场退出分析的学生，这是唯一一类「真实破产案例 + 真实保障成本」的公开数据**（可与 [[run-off-tracker]] 的退出/清盘追踪、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[insurance-mrm]]、[[insurance-governance]] 并读——**前者是模型算资本，这一条是资本不够时实际发生了什么**）。**② 与 [[pbgc]] 构成「同一逻辑、两个对象」的清晰对照**——**两者都是「给付保证」机制：PBGC 保证养老金给付，NOLHGA 体系保证保单给付**；把两条并读，学生可以一次看清**保障型金融机制的通用结构（会员分摊 + 触发条件 + 给付上限 + 接管机构）**。**③ 「各州保障协会法律」与「分摊能力」两栏对研究监管结构的学生有独特价值**——**美国保险保障是州级而非联邦级**，这与 [[naic-financial-data-repository]] 的州级监管体系一致，**是「分散监管」的一个具体成本与协调机制的样本**（可与 [[iais-icp]] 的国际原则层、[[a2ii]] 的监管能力建设并读）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量与导航结构**，**但未打开破产公司名单的具体内容、未打开成本数据、未下载任何报告或期刊**，因此**不能转述任何一家破产公司名称、成本金额、年份或分摊规则**；**② 「破产保险公司名单」页体量 230.2KB 是实测值**，**但其中有多少是实际名单、有多少是页面框架与导航，本次未区分**；**③ 「保障上限、触发条件、分摊公式」本次全部未核实**——**这些都在保障体系的法律与规则文件中，本词条不转述**；**④ 该组织与各州保障协会的权责分工、以及其与 NAIC 的关系本次未核实**；**⑤** 本词条**不主张** NOLHGA 提供逐家保险公司的财务数据或精算工具。**核实说明**：首页、`/the-guaranty-system/insolvent-insurance-companies/`（230.2KB）、`/the-guaranty-system/insolvency-costs/`（181.1KB）、`/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-system-reports/`（126.1KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与导航；**未打开名单内容、成本数据、报告或期刊**。
entries.body_en:
**NOLHGA (the National Organization of Life & Health Insurance Guaranty Associations)** is **the national coordinating body of the US state life and health insurance guaranty associations**; when a member insurer fails, the **state guaranty associations take over the policies and continue paying benefits**. This entry adds the **"policyholder protection and insurance insolvency"** form: **a measured count found zero members of this form** — the closest item, **[[pbgc]], is pension benefit insurance (the US ERISA pension guaranty system)**, **covering pensions rather than policies**; and **[[hkmc]]**’s entry covers **public annuities, reverse mortgages and mortgage insurance statistics, not a policyholder protection scheme** (**flagged explicitly here so readers do not assume Hong Kong’s scheme is already covered**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage title reads **"Home - NOLHGA"**; ⭐ the **"Insolvent Insurance Companies" page `/the-guaranty-system/insolvent-insurance-companies/` measures 230.2KB** — **among the largest data pages on the site**; ⭐ the **"Insolvency Costs" page `/the-guaranty-system/insolvency-costs/` measures 181.1KB**; the **"Guaranty System Reports" page `/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-system-reports/` measures 126.1KB**; measured navigation also includes **`/the-guaranty-system/assessments-capacity/`**, **`/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-association-laws/`**, **`/the-guaranty-system/nolhga-journal/` (the NOLHGA Journal)**, **`/the-guaranty-system/overview-the-guaranty-system/`**, **`/policyholders/insolvent-insurance-companies/`**, **`/policyholders/contact-my-guaranty-association/`** and **`/assessable-premium-exhibit-resources-2/`**.

For RIAA: **① it adds a data layer for the "insurance insolvency" risk dimension** — the corpus’s risk side is **very dense** (dozens of entries each on reserving, catastrophe, mortality and cyber risk), yet **"an insurer going bust itself" is barely covered**; **for students analysing insurer solvency and market exit, this is the only class of public data offering "real insolvency cases plus real guaranty costs"** (readable with [[run-off-tracker]]’s exit and run-off tracking, [[ggsolvencyii]], [[insurance-mrm]] and [[insurance-governance]] — **the others model capital; this shows what actually happens when capital runs out**). **② With [[pbgc]] it forms a clean "same logic, two objects" contrast** — **both are benefit-guaranty mechanisms: PBGC guarantees pension benefits, the NOLHGA system guarantees policy benefits**; read together they reveal **the generic structure of a guarantee mechanism (member assessments, trigger conditions, benefit caps, a taking-over institution)**. **③ The "guaranty association laws" and "assessments capacity" sections are unusually valuable for studying regulatory structure** — **US insurance guaranty is state-level rather than federal**, consistent with the state-based supervision behind [[naic-financial-data-repository]], and **a concrete sample of the costs and coordination mechanisms of fragmented supervision** (readable with the international-principles layer of [[iais-icp]] and the supervisory-capacity work of [[a2ii]]).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes and navigation structure**, **but opened none of the insolvent-company list contents, none of the cost data, and downloaded no report or journal**, so **no insolvent company name, cost figure, year or assessment rule can be restated**; **② the 230.2KB size of the insolvency list page is a measured value**, **but how much of it is actual list content versus page frame and navigation was not distinguished**; **③ benefit caps, trigger conditions and assessment formulas were entirely unverified** — **they live in the scheme’s legal and rule documents and are not restated here**; **④ the division of responsibilities between this organisation and the state guaranty associations, and its relationship to the NAIC, were not verified**; **⑤** this entry **does not claim NOLHGA provides firm-level financial data or actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage, `/the-guaranty-system/insolvent-insurance-companies/` (230.2KB), `/the-guaranty-system/insolvency-costs/` (181.1KB) and `/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-system-reports/` (126.1KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no list content, cost data, report or journal was opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**NOLHGA（National Organization of Life & Health Insurance Guaranty Associations）** 是**美國各州壽險與健康險保障協會的全國性協調組織**；當會員保險公司破產時，由**各州保障協會接手保單、繼續給付**。本條目補的是**「保單持有人保障／保險破產」這一形態**：**實測池內該形態成員為 0**——最接近的是 **[[pbgc]]，但那是養老金給付保證**，**對象是養老金而非保單**；另有 **[[hkmc]]**，其內容是**公共年金、逆按揭與按揭保險統計**，**並不覆蓋保單持有人保障計劃**（**本詞條特別註明，以免讀者誤以為香港的保障計劃已被收錄**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁標題實測 **「Home - NOLHGA」**；⭐ **「Insolvent Insurance Companies」頁實測 230.2KB**；⭐ **「Insolvency Costs」頁實測 181.1KB**；**「Guaranty System Reports」頁實測 126.1KB**；導航另含 **assessments-capacity（分攤與能力）**、**guaranty-association-laws（各州保障協會法律）**、**NOLHGA Journal 期刊**、**policyholders/contact-my-guaranty-association（按州找到對應保障協會）**、**assessable-premium-exhibit-resources**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「保險破產」這一風險維度的數據層**——池內風險側此前**極密**（準備金、巨災、死亡率、網絡風險各數十條），但**「保險公司自己倒閉」幾乎無人覆蓋**；**對做償付能力與市場退出分析的學生，這是唯一一類「真實破產案例 + 真實保障成本」的公開數據**（可與 [[run-off-tracker]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[insurance-mrm]]、[[insurance-governance]] 並讀——**前者是模型算資本，這一條是資本不夠時實際發生了什麼**）。**② 與 [[pbgc]] 構成「同一邏輯、兩個對象」的清晰對照**——**PBGC 保證養老金給付，NOLHGA 體系保證保單給付**；並讀可一次看清**保障型金融機制的通用結構（會員分攤 + 觸發條件 + 給付上限 + 接管機構）**。**③ 「各州保障協會法律」與「分攤能力」對研究監管結構有獨特價值**——**美國保險保障是州級而非聯邦級**，**是「分散監管」的一個具體成本與協調機制樣本**（可與 [[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[iais-icp]]、[[a2ii]] 並讀）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量與導航結構**，**但未打開破產公司名單內容、未打開成本數據、未下載任何報告或期刊**，故**不能轉述任何破產公司名稱、成本金額、年份或分攤規則**；**② 230.2KB 為實測值**，**但其中多少是實際名單、多少是頁面框架，本次未區分**；**③ 保障上限、觸發條件、分攤公式本次全部未核實**——**本詞條不轉述**；**④ 該組織與各州保障協會的權責分工、以及與 NAIC 的關係未核實**；**⑤** 本詞條**不主張** NOLHGA 提供逐家保險公司財務數據或精算工具**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並讀取標題與導航；**未打開名單內容、成本數據、報告或期刊**。

entries.body:
**FSCS（Financial Services Compensation Scheme，英国金融服务补偿计划）** 是**英国的法定补偿基金**——当受监管金融机构倒闭、无法自行赔付时，对**合资格客户**给付补偿，范围含**保险保单持有人**（与拟保障事项不同，**FSCS 处理的是「公司已经倒了」这一情形**）。本条目与同轮的 **[[fos-uk]]** 构成一对：**FOS 处理「公司还活着但有争议」，FSCS 处理「公司倒了」**——**这是消费者保护事后层的两条不同通道**。实测池内该形态（保险补偿/失败机构处理）**成员为 0**；池内最接近的是 **[[hkmc]]**（按揭保险与公共年金，**性质不同**）与 **[[pbgc]]**（**养老金**给付保证）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页标题实测为 **「Financial Services Compensation Scheme | FSCS」**；⭐ **「Failed insurance companies – what happens next?」页 `/making-a-claim/claims-process/failed-ins-co-next/`，实测 142.4KB，标题与页面名一致**；⭐ **「Industry resources」页 `/industry-resources/`，实测 140.3KB**；⭐ **「FSCS Annual Report 2025/26」页 `/industry-resources/other-publications/annual-report/`，实测 148.3KB**；**「Levy information（征费信息）」页 `/about-us/funding/levy-info/`，实测 143.0KB**；导航实测另含 **`/about-us/funding/`**、**`/about-us/funding/recoveries/`（追偿）**、**`/making-a-claim/claims-process/eligibility-rules/`（合资格规则）**、**`/making-a-claim/claims-process/temporary-high-balances/`（临时高额余额）**、**`/making-a-claim/claims-process/appeal-claim-decision/`（对决定上诉）**、**`/making-a-claim/claims-process/claim-status/`**、**`/making-a-claim/claims-process/defined-benefit-pension-transfers/`**、**`/making-a-claim/customer-info/financial-protection/`** 与 **`/making-a-claim/customer-info/fscs-fos/`（FSCS 与 FOS 的分工说明页）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「补偿机制」这一形态**——池内此前**有监管、有统计、有消费者申诉，但没有「谁最终掏钱赔」这一层**；**FSCS 是法定、由行业征费出资的补偿基金**，与 [[nolhga]] 的**美国州级保障协会模式**形成**「统一法定基金 vs 分散州级协会」两种制度对照**（**两者都叫保障，组织形态完全不同**）。**② 「征费（levy）与追偿（recoveries）」两栏是理解保障成本如何分摊的关键**——**这类机制的成本不是财政承担，而是行业分摊**，对做**保险市场风险与系统性成本**方向的学生是具体材料（可与 [[insurance-governance]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[run-off-tracker]] 并读）。**③ FSCS 与 FOS 的分工值得单独记住**——站点设有专门的 **`fscs-fos`** 说明页，**这正好印证了本条目与 [[fos-uk]] 的结构区分**；**对做消费者保护体系比较的学生，这是一组现成的「两通道」样本**。**④ 年度报告为 2025/26**，说明其披露是连续且近期的。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量与导航结构**，**但未打开年度报告正文、未打开征费或追偿的具体数字、未打开合资格规则、未查看任何补偿案例**，因此**不能转述保障上限金额、征费规模、已赔付金额或合资格条件**；**② 「保障上限」本次完全未核实**——**这是 FSCS 制度最核心的参数，本词条明确不转述**；**③ `fscs-fos` 页本次仅核实其作为导航链接存在，未打开**，故**本词条不转述该页对两机构分工的具体表述**（**文中对 FSCS 与 FOS 的区分来自两站各自页面的性质判断**）；**④ 保险业务在 FSCS 各业务类别中的占比、以及长尾责任（如雇主责任强制保险）的处理本次未核实**；**⑤** 本词条**不主张** FSCS 提供精算工具或保险定价数据。**核实说明**：首页、`/making-a-claim/claims-process/failed-ins-co-next/`（142.4KB）、`/industry-resources/`（140.3KB）、`/industry-resources/other-publications/annual-report/`（148.3KB，标题含 2025/26）、`/about-us/funding/levy-info/`（143.0KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与导航；**未打开年报正文、征费与追偿数字、合资格规则或任何补偿案例**。
entries.body_en:
**FSCS (the Financial Services Compensation Scheme)** is **the United Kingdom’s statutory compensation fund**: when a regulated firm fails and cannot pay, it compensates **eligible customers**, including **insurance policyholders** (unlike a prospective guarantee, **FSCS handles the case where the firm has already failed**). This entry pairs with [[fos-uk]] from the same round: **FOS handles "the firm is alive but there is a dispute"; FSCS handles "the firm has failed"** — **two distinct channels of the post-sale consumer-protection layer**. A measured count found **zero members of this form** (insurance compensation and failed-firm handling); the closest items are **[[hkmc]]** (mortgage insurance and public annuities, **a different thing**) and **[[pbgc]]** (**pension** benefit insurance).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage title reads **"Financial Services Compensation Scheme | FSCS"**; ⭐ the **"Failed insurance companies – what happens next?" page `/making-a-claim/claims-process/failed-ins-co-next/` measures 142.4KB with a matching title**; ⭐ the **"Industry resources" page `/industry-resources/` measures 140.3KB**; ⭐ the **"FSCS Annual Report 2025/26" page `/industry-resources/other-publications/annual-report/` measures 148.3KB**; the **"Levy information" page `/about-us/funding/levy-info/` measures 143.0KB**; measured navigation also includes **`/about-us/funding/`**, **`/about-us/funding/recoveries/`**, **`/making-a-claim/claims-process/eligibility-rules/`**, **`/making-a-claim/claims-process/temporary-high-balances/`**, **`/making-a-claim/claims-process/appeal-claim-decision/`**, **`/making-a-claim/claims-process/claim-status/`**, **`/making-a-claim/claims-process/defined-benefit-pension-transfers/`**, **`/making-a-claim/customer-info/financial-protection/`** and **`/making-a-claim/customer-info/fscs-fos/` (a page explaining the FSCS-FOS division of labour)**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "compensation mechanism" form** — the corpus previously had **supervision, statistics and consumer complaints, but no layer for "who ultimately pays"**; **FSCS is a statutory fund financed by industry levies**, contrasting with **[[nolhga]]**’s **US state-level guaranty association model** — **"a unified statutory fund versus dispersed state associations": both are called guarantees, yet their organisational forms differ completely**. **② The "levy" and "recoveries" sections are key to understanding how the cost is shared** — **this mechanism is not financed by the public purse but by the industry**, concrete material for students working on **insurance market risk and systemic cost** (readable with [[insurance-governance]], [[ggsolvencyii]] and [[run-off-tracker]]). **③ The FSCS-FOS division is worth remembering on its own** — the site keeps a dedicated **`fscs-fos`** page, **which corroborates the structural distinction between this entry and [[fos-uk]]**; **for students comparing consumer-protection systems, this is a ready "two-channel" sample**. **④ The annual report is for 2025/26**, indicating continuous and recent disclosure.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes and navigation structure**, **but opened no annual report body, no levy or recovery figures, no eligibility rules and no compensation case**, so **compensation limits, levy size, amounts paid and eligibility conditions cannot be restated**; **② compensation limits were entirely unverified** — **the single most central parameter of the FSCS regime, explicitly not restated here**; **③ the `fscs-fos` page was verified only as an existing navigation link and not opened**, so **this entry does not restate that page’s own account of the division** (**the distinction drawn here rests on the nature of each body’s pages**); **④ the share of insurance within FSCS business categories, and the treatment of long-tail liabilities such as compulsory employers’ liability, were not verified**; **⑤** this entry **does not claim FSCS provides actuarial tools or insurance pricing data**. **Verification note**: the homepage, `/making-a-claim/claims-process/failed-ins-co-next/` (142.4KB), `/industry-resources/` (140.3KB), `/industry-resources/other-publications/annual-report/` (148.3KB, title containing 2025/26) and `/about-us/funding/levy-info/` (143.0KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no annual report body, levy or recovery figure, eligibility rule or compensation case was opened**.

對 RIAA：**① 補上「補償機制」這一形態**——池內此前**有監管、有統計、有申訴，但沒有「誰最終掏錢賠」這一層**；**FSCS 是法定、由行業徵費出資的補償基金**，與 [[nolhga]] 的**美國州級保障協會模式**形成**「統一法定基金 vs 分散州級協會」兩種制度對照**。**② 「徵費與追償」是理解保障成本如何分攤的關鍵**——**成本不是財政承擔，而是行業分攤**（可與 [[insurance-governance]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[run-off-tracker]] 並讀）。**③ FSCS 與 FOS 的分工值得單獨記住**——站點設有專門的 **`fscs-fos`** 說明頁，**正好印證本條目與 [[fos-uk]] 的結構區分**。**④ 年度報告為 2025/26**，披露連續且近期。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量與導航結構**，**但未打開年度報告正文、未打開徵費或追償數字、未打開合資格規則、未查看任何補償案例**，故**不能轉述保障上限金額、徵費規模、已賠付金額或合資格條件**；**② 「保障上限」本次完全未核實**——**本詞條明確不轉述**；**③ `fscs-fos` 頁本次僅核實其作為導航連結存在、未打開**，故**不轉述該頁對兩機構分工的具體表述**；**④ 保險業務在 FSCS 各類別中的佔比、以及長尾責任（如僱主責任強制保險）的處理未核實**；**⑤** 本詞條**不主張** FSCS 提供精算工具或保險定價數據**。**核實說明**：五個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並讀取標題與導航；**未打開年報正文、徵費與追償數字、合資格規則或任何補償案例**。

entries.title: Assuris（加拿大）：寿险与健康险保单持有人保障 + 保障计算器
entries.title_en: Assuris (Canada): life and health insurance policyholder protection plus a protection calculator
entries.title_hk: Assuris（加拿大）：壽險與健康險保單持有人保障 + 保障計算器
entries.summary: 加拿大寿险与健康险保单持有人保障机构：按产品公布保障水平与上限、成员公司名单，并提供「保障计算器」让持有人查询自身保障额度
entries.summary_en: Canada’s life and health insurance policyholder protection body: it publishes protection levels and limits by product and a list of member companies, and offers a "protection calculator" letting policyholders check their own coverage
entries.summary_hk: 加拿大壽險與健康險保單持有人保障機構：按產品公布保障水平與上限、成員公司名單，並提供「保障計算器」讓持有人查詢自身保障額度
entries.body:
**Assuris** 是**加拿大的寿险与健康险保单持有人保障机构**——**当成员保险公司倒闭时，保障保单持有人继续获得给付**。本条目与同轮的 [[nolhga]]、[[fscs-uk]] 同属**「保单持有人保障」形态**，但 Assuris 补的是该形态此前没有的东西：**一个把「我到底有多少受保障」做成可自测工具的实例**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页实测 **269.7KB，标题「Assuris」**（体量在四站中最大，说明**包含大量面向公众的说明内容**）；⭐ **「Assuris Protection Calculator（保障计算器）」页 `/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection-calculator/`，实测 171.3KB，标题「Assuris Protection Calculator | Assuris」**——**这是一个让保单持有人自测保障额度的交互工具**；⭐ **「Assuris Protection by Product（按产品的保障）」页 `/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection/`，实测 231.4KB，标题「Assuris Protection by Product」**——**按产品类型列明保障水平与上限**；⭐ **「List of Member Companies（成员公司名单）」页 `/how-am-i-protected/list-of-member-companies/`，实测 252.2KB，标题「List of Member Companies」**；导航实测另含 **`/member-companies/member-companies-resources/`**、**`/i-am-a-financial-advisor/steps-to-determine-protection/`（判断保障的步骤）**、**`/i-am-a-financial-advisor/continuing-education-accreditation/`（继续教育认证）**、**`/i-am-a-financial-advisor/financial-advisor-toolkit/`**、**`/about-us/industry-partners/`（行业伙伴）**、**`/how-am-i-protected/policyholder-resources/`**，并外链 **`financeprotection.ca`**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「保障上限的可查询化」这一做法**——[[nolhga]] 是「破产名单 + 成本」，[[fscs-uk]] 是「失败机构处理 + 征费」，而 **Assuris 把「按产品的保障上限」与「自测计算器」直接做给保单持有人用**；**对做产品设计与消费者沟通的学生，「保障上限」从监管文件变成用户可查的参数，是一个具体的产品化样本**（可与 [[vhis-standard-premium]] 的按标准计划与保费、[[mpf-fund-platform]] 的公众查询平台并读——**三者都是「把监管参数做成公众可用工具」**）。**② 「成员公司名单」是现成的市场结构资料**——**252.2KB 的名单页**可用于确认**哪些公司受保、哪些不受保**，这对**评估加拿大寿险市场集中度与保障覆盖面**是直接材料。**③ 与 [[nolhga]]、[[fscs-uk]] 并读构成三地制度对照**——**美国是州级协会分摊、英国是统一法定基金、加拿大是单一行业机构**；**同一功能，三种组织形态**，这是本轮最有价值的横向结构。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量与导航结构**，**但未使用保障计算器、未打开任何产品的保障上限数字、未查看成员公司名单内容**，因此**不能转述任何保障上限金额、产品范围或成员公司名称**；**② 「保障计算器」的输入项、算法逻辑与实际输出本次未核实**——**本词条只主张该工具存在并有独立页面，不描述其如何计算**；**③ Assuris 的法定地位、其与加拿大监管机构（OSFI）的关系、以及保障触发条件本次未核实**（**[[osfi-canada-data]] 已在池内，但两者关系本次未核实，故不作关联陈述**）；**④ 其覆盖范围是否含财产险本次未核实**——**名称中的「life and health」来自机构名称与页面结构，本词条据此表述，未另行核实**；**⑤** 本词条**不主张** Assuris 提供精算工具或市场统计数据。**核实说明**：首页（269.7KB）、`/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection-calculator/`（171.3KB）、`/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection/`（231.4KB）、`/how-am-i-protected/list-of-member-companies/`（252.2KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与导航；**未使用计算器、未打开保障上限数字或成员名单内容**。
entries.body_en:
**Assuris** is **Canada’s life and health insurance policyholder protection body** — **when a member insurer fails, it protects policyholders so their benefits continue**. This entry belongs with [[nolhga]] and [[fscs-uk]] from the same round in the **"policyholder protection"** form, but adds something that form previously lacked: **a working example of turning "how much of my coverage is actually protected" into a tool people can check themselves**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage measures **269.7KB with the title "Assuris"** (the largest of the four sites, indicating **substantial public-facing explanatory content**); ⭐ the **"Assuris Protection Calculator" page `/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection-calculator/` measures 171.3KB with the title "Assuris Protection Calculator | Assuris"** — **an interactive tool letting policyholders check their own protected amount**; ⭐ the **"Assuris Protection by Product" page `/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection/` measures 231.4KB with the title "Assuris Protection by Product"** — **protection levels and limits set out by product type**; ⭐ the **"List of Member Companies" page `/how-am-i-protected/list-of-member-companies/` measures 252.2KB with the title "List of Member Companies"**; measured navigation also includes **`/member-companies/member-companies-resources/`**, **`/i-am-a-financial-advisor/steps-to-determine-protection/`**, **`/i-am-a-financial-advisor/continuing-education-accreditation/`**, **`/i-am-a-financial-advisor/financial-advisor-toolkit/`**, **`/about-us/industry-partners/`** and **`/how-am-i-protected/policyholder-resources/`**, with an outbound link to **`financeprotection.ca`**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "making protection limits queryable" practice** — [[nolhga]] offers "insolvency lists and costs" and [[fscs-uk]] "failed-firm handling and levies", whereas **Assuris builds "protection limits by product" and a self-check calculator directly for policyholders**; **for students working on product design and consumer communication, a protection limit moving from a regulatory document into a user-queryable parameter is a concrete productisation sample** (readable with [[vhis-standard-premium]] on VHIS standard plans and premiums and [[mpf-fund-platform]]’s public platform — **all three turn regulatory parameters into public-facing tools**). **② The member company list is ready-made market-structure material** — **a 252.2KB list page** usable to establish **which firms are covered and which are not**, direct material for **assessing Canadian life market concentration and protection coverage**. **③ Read with [[nolhga]] and [[fscs-uk]] it forms a three-country institutional comparison** — **US: state-level association assessments; UK: a unified statutory fund; Canada: a single industry body**; **one function, three organisational forms** — the most valuable cross-cutting structure of this round.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes and navigation structure**, **but used no protection calculator, opened no product protection limit and viewed no member company list content**, so **no limit amount, product scope or member company name can be restated**; **② the calculator’s inputs, algorithm and actual output were not verified** — **this entry claims only that the tool exists with its own page, and does not describe how it computes**; **③ Assuris’s statutory status, its relationship with the Canadian regulator (OSFI) and the trigger conditions for protection were not verified** (**[[osfi-canada-data]] is already in the corpus, but the relationship was not verified, so no linkage is asserted**); **④ whether the scope includes property and casualty insurance was not verified** — **"life and health" is taken from the organisation’s name and page structure, and is stated on that basis only**; **⑤** this entry **does not claim Assuris provides actuarial tools or market statistics**. **Verification note**: the homepage (269.7KB), `/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection-calculator/` (171.3KB), `/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection/` (231.4KB) and `/how-am-i-protected/list-of-member-companies/` (252.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no calculator was used and no limit figure or member list content was opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**Assuris** 是**加拿大的壽險與健康險保單持有人保障機構**——**當成員保險公司倒閉時，保障保單持有人繼續獲得給付**。本條目與同輪的 [[nolhga]]、[[fscs-uk]] 同屬**「保單持有人保障」形態**，但補上該形態此前沒有的東西：**一個把「我到底有多少受保障」做成可自測工具的實例**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁實測 **269.7KB，標題「Assuris」**（四站中體量最大）；⭐ **「Assuris Protection Calculator」頁實測 171.3KB**——**讓保單持有人自測保障額度的交互工具**；⭐ **「Assuris Protection by Product」頁實測 231.4KB**——**按產品類型列明保障水平與上限**；⭐ **「List of Member Companies」頁實測 252.2KB**；導航另含 **member-companies-resources**、**steps-to-determine-protection（判斷保障的步驟）**、**continuing-education-accreditation（繼續教育認證）**、**financial-advisor-toolkit**、**about-us/industry-partners**、**policyholder-resources**，並外鏈 **`financeprotection.ca`**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「保障上限的可查詢化」這一做法**——[[nolhga]] 是「破產名單 + 成本」、[[fscs-uk]] 是「失敗機構處理 + 徵費」，而 **Assuris 把「按產品的保障上限」與「自測計算器」直接做給保單持有人用**；**保障上限從監管文件變成用戶可查的參數**（可與 [[vhis-standard-premium]]、[[mpf-fund-platform]] 並讀——**三者都是「把監管參數做成公眾可用工具」**）。**② 「成員公司名單」（252.2KB）是現成的市場結構資料**。**③ 與 [[nolhga]]、[[fscs-uk]] 並讀構成三地制度對照**——**美國州級協會分攤、英國統一法定基金、加拿大單一行業機構**；**同一功能，三種組織形態**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量與導航結構**，**但未使用保障計算器、未打開任何產品的保障上限數字、未查看成員公司名單內容**，故**不能轉述任何保障上限金額、產品範圍或成員公司名稱**；**② 計算器的輸入項、算法邏輯與實際輸出未核實**——**本詞條只主張該工具存在並有獨立頁面，不描述其如何計算**；**③ 其法定地位、與加拿大監管機構（OSFI）的關係、保障觸發條件未核實**（**[[osfi-canada-data]] 已在池內，但兩者關係未核實，故不作關聯陳述**）；**④ 覆蓋範圍是否含財產險未核實**——**「壽險與健康險」來自機構名稱與頁面結構，本詞條據此表述**；**⑤** 本詞條**不主張** Assuris 提供精算工具或市場統計數據**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並讀取標題與導航；**未使用計算器、未打開保障上限數字或成員名單內容**。

entries.title: Cefor / NoMIS（北欧水险协会）：共享理赔统计与「船体理赔通胀指数」
entries.title_en: Cefor / NoMIS (the Nordic Association of Marine Insurers): shared claims statistics and a hull claims inflation index
entries.title_hk: Cefor / NoMIS（北歐水險協會）：共享理賠統計與「船體理賠通脹指數」
entries.summary: 北欧水险协会：以 NoMIS 共享统计提供年度与半年度水险理赔数据（2021–2026 年度档），并发布「沿海船体通胀指数」——按钢铁/材料/人工权重结合挪威统计局三个指数合成，且自行声明与实际损失成本可能背离
entries.summary_en: The Nordic Association of Marine Insurers: its NoMIS shared statistics provide annual and half-yearly marine claims data (with 2021–2026 archives), and it publishes a "Coastal Hull Inflation Index" composed from steel, materials and labour weights combined with three Statistics Norway indices — while stating itself that it may diverge from actual claims cost trends
entries.summary_hk: 北歐水險協會：以 NoMIS 共享統計提供年度與半年度水險理賠數據（2021–2026 年度檔），並發布「沿海船體通脹指數」——按鋼鐵／材料／人工權重結合挪威統計局三個指數合成，且自行聲明與實際損失成本可能背離
entries.body:
**Cefor（The Nordic Association of Marine Insurers，北欧水险协会）** 是**北欧水险业的行业组织**（站点页脚自述为「Cefor - The Nordic Association of Marine Insurers, P.O Box 2550 Solli, NO-0202 OSLO, Norway」）。本条目补的是**「专业险种自己的共享数据层」这一形态**：**实测池内水险/货运险/船舶险相关条目为 0**——**注意一个假命中**：关键词「hull」曾命中 [[hull-white-esg-checks]]，**但那是 Hull-White 利率模型，与船舶险无关**；同理 [[insurance-python]] 只是模块名巧合。**故「水险」此前是真正的空白险种**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 200，标题实测 **「Home」**；⭐ **「Statistics」页 `/statistics/` 实测 14.5KB**；⭐ **「NoMIS（Nordic Marine Insurance Statistics，北欧水险统计）」页 `/statistics/nomis/` 实测 12.2KB**，正文实测写明 **「Here you can download the lastest and historical versions of Nordic Marine Insurance Statistics (NoMIS) Reports, Cefor Annual Reports and half yearly NoMIS statistics」**（**可下载 NoMIS 报告、协会年报与半年度的 NoMIS 统计**），页面实测列出 **2026 / 2025 / 2024 / 2023 / 2022 / 2021 共六年年度档**，并给出数据联系人；⭐ **「Coastal Hull Index（沿海船体指数）」页 `/statistics/coastal-hull-inflation-index/` 实测 14.7KB**，正文实测写明 **「The ‘Coastal Hull Inflation Index’ is one example for how a claims inflation index for Norwegian coastal hull business may be composed as a weighted index」**，并说明 **「The weight is the typical average % split of claims into steel, other materials and labour costs. This is coupled with three indices from Statistics Norway (SSB)」**——**即按「钢铁 / 其他材料 / 人工」的典型平均赔款占比加权，再与挪威统计局（SSB）的三个指数结合**；**同一页 Cefor 自行声明局限**：**「One should however be aware that the actual claims cost trend in any one year may differ from such a calculated index and show a higher variance from year to year」**，并写明 **「Recently, the actual claim cost inflation in the Nordic coastal hull portfolio exceeded that of the calculated index derived from SSB figures」**（**近期实际理赔成本通胀高于按 SSB 推算的指数**）；⭐ **「Cefor in Figures」页 `/statistics/market-overview/` 实测 15.1KB**，正文实测写明 **「Download the latest as well as historical versions of Cefor Fact Sheets and Market Premium Overviews」**，实测档期含 **2026 Cefor in Figures**、**2025 Cefor Facts**、**The Cefor Marine Insurance Market 2024 (premiums)**、**2024 Cefor Facts**、**2023 Cefor Facts** 等；**「Hull Clauses」页 `/clauses/hull-clauses/` 实测 23.5KB**；**「2026 Mid-year hull report」页 `/statistics/news/2026-mid-year-hull-report/` 实测 11.1KB**；导航实测另含 **Nordic Plan（北欧计划，标准水险合同）**、**Cargo Clauses（货运条款）**、**Small craft clauses（小艇条款）**、**Nordic Offshore Wind Insurance Conditions（北欧离岸风电保险条件）**、**Safety regulations**、**Interest Rates**、**Ask the analyst**、**NoMIS Special focus analyses**、**Broker’s Letter of Authority**、**Code of Conduct**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「水险」这一整条业务线**——池内险种侧此前**极密于寿险/健康险/车险/财产险/巨灾**，**唯独水险与货运险为 0**；水险是**历史最久的专业险种之一**（船体与货物），**对想做 specialty lines 的学生，这是一个从零开始的入口**。**② ⭐ 「理赔通胀指数」是本轮最有教学价值的发现**——池内已有 [[claims-inflation-motor-my]]（马来西亚车险理赔通胀）与 [[inflation-aware-xol-reserving]]（通胀感知的超额赔款准备），而 **Cefor 给出的是「第三种险种、且方法论完全公开」的理赔通胀构造**：**按成本构成（钢/材料/人工）加权 → 挂接国家统计局的三个投入指数**；**更难得的是它把方法的局限写在页面上**（**合成指数与实际赔款趋势可能背离、逐年方差更大**）——**这对做「理赔通胀假设」的学生是一个可直接引用的方法样本与警示**（可与 [[lossratio-r]]、[[gi-loss-reserving]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]] 并读）。**③ 「共享理赔统计」这一机制本身值得注意**——**由行业组织汇总多家公司的理赔数据形成共同基准（NoMIS）**，这**不是监管强制申报，也不是公开数据，而是行业自组织的共享池**；对研究**数据共享激励机制**的学生，这是一个与 [[susep-sro]]（监管强制逐笔登记）**完全相反的路线**。**④ 离岸风电保险条件与港口/沿海业务的条款也在此站点**——[[oasis-piwind]] 是离岸风电的开放灾损模型，**两者正好构成「条件（条款侧）+ 模型（量化侧）」的一对**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量、六年年度档列表、指数方法论表述与 Cefor 自述局限、以及条款与条件的导航条目**，**但未下载任何 NoMIS 报告、未下载任何年度档、未打开沿海船体指数文件本身、未打开任何 Fact Sheet 或保费概览、未打开任何条款文本**，因此**不能转述任何具体损失率、保费规模、指数数值或条款条文**；**② 沿海船体指数的具体数值与权重比例本次未读取**（**只读到方法描述与定性结论**）；**③ 站点设有 Log in 区域**，**会员专区的内容范围本次未核实**；**④ NoMIS 的成员覆盖范围（几家会员、覆盖哪些国家）本次未核实**；**⑤ Cefor 与北欧各国监管、与 IUMI 的关系本次未核实**；**⑥ 首页标题实测仅为「Home」，信息量低，故本词条的标题与摘要依据各功能页而非首页**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** Cefor 提供精算软件或建模工具。**核实说明**：首页（200）、`/statistics/`（14.5KB）、`/statistics/nomis/`（12.2KB）、`/statistics/coastal-hull-inflation-index/`（14.7KB）、`/statistics/market-overview/`（15.1KB）、`/clauses/hull-clauses/`（23.5KB）、`/statistics/news/2026-mid-year-hull-report/`（11.1KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取方法论段落；**未下载报告、指数文件、Fact Sheet 或条款文本**。
entries.body_en:
**Cefor (the Nordic Association of Marine Insurers)** is **the trade body of the Nordic marine insurance industry** (its footer reads "Cefor - The Nordic Association of Marine Insurers, P.O Box 2550 Solli, NO-0202 OSLO, Norway"). This entry adds the **"specialty line’s own shared data layer"** form: **a measured count found zero entries on marine, cargo or hull insurance** — and note **a false positive**: the keyword "hull" matched [[hull-white-esg-checks]], **which is the Hull-White interest-rate model, not marine insurance**; likewise [[insurance-python]] is a naming coincidence. **Marine insurance was therefore a genuinely empty line of business**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage returns 200 with the measured title **"Home"**; ⭐ the **"Statistics" page `/statistics/` measures 14.5KB**; ⭐ the **"NoMIS (Nordic Marine Insurance Statistics)" page `/statistics/nomis/` measures 12.2KB** and states verbatim **"Here you can download the lastest and historical versions of Nordic Marine Insurance Statistics (NoMIS) Reports, Cefor Annual Reports and half yearly NoMIS statistics"**, listing measured **2026 / 2025 / 2024 / 2023 / 2022 / 2021 archives** (six years) plus a named data contact; ⭐ the **"Coastal Hull Index" page `/statistics/coastal-hull-inflation-index/` measures 14.7KB** and states verbatim **"The ‘Coastal Hull Inflation Index’ is one example for how a claims inflation index for Norwegian coastal hull business may be composed as a weighted index"**, explaining that **"The weight is the typical average % split of claims into steel, other materials and labour costs. This is coupled with three indices from Statistics Norway (SSB)"** — **weighted by the typical average share of claims going to steel, other materials and labour, combined with three Statistics Norway indices**; **on the same page Cefor states its own limitation**: **"One should however be aware that the actual claims cost trend in any one year may differ from such a calculated index and show a higher variance from year to year"**, adding that **"Recently, the actual claim cost inflation in the Nordic coastal hull portfolio exceeded that of the calculated index derived from SSB figures"**; ⭐ the **"Cefor in Figures" page `/statistics/market-overview/` measures 15.1KB** and states verbatim **"Download the latest as well as historical versions of Cefor Fact Sheets and Market Premium Overviews"**, with measured issues including **2026 Cefor in Figures**, **2025 Cefor Facts**, **The Cefor Marine Insurance Market 2024 (premiums)**, **2024 Cefor Facts** and **2023 Cefor Facts**; the **"Hull Clauses" page `/clauses/hull-clauses/` measures 23.5KB**; the **"2026 Mid-year hull report" page measures 11.1KB**; measured navigation also includes the **Nordic Plan** (a standard marine insurance contract), **Cargo Clauses**, **Small craft clauses**, **Nordic Offshore Wind Insurance Conditions**, **Safety regulations**, **Interest Rates**, **Ask the analyst**, **NoMIS Special focus analyses**, **Broker’s Letter of Authority** and **Code of Conduct**.

For RIAA: **① it adds an entire line of business** — the corpus’s line-of-business side is **very dense in life, health, motor, property and catastrophe**, **yet marine and cargo were at zero**; marine is **one of the oldest specialty lines** (hull and cargo), **a from-zero entry point for students interested in specialty lines**. **② ⭐ The claims inflation index is this round’s most instructive find** — the corpus already holds [[claims-inflation-motor-my]] (Malaysian motor claims inflation) and [[inflation-aware-xol-reserving]] (inflation-aware excess-of-loss reserving), and **Cefor supplies a third line of business with a fully disclosed method**: **weight by cost component (steel, materials, labour), then link to three national statistics indices**; **rarer still, it states the method’s limitation on the page itself** (**a composed index may diverge from actual claims trends and varies more year to year**) — **a directly citable method sample and caution for students setting claims inflation assumptions** (readable with [[lossratio-r]], [[gi-loss-reserving]] and [[stochastic-reserving-england]]). **③ The "shared claims statistics" mechanism is itself notable** — **a trade body aggregating member claims data into a common benchmark (NoMIS)** is **neither a mandatory regulatory return nor open data, but an industry-run sharing pool**; for work on **incentives for data sharing**, this is **the mirror image of [[susep-sro]]** (a regulator-mandated operation-level registry). **④ Offshore wind insurance conditions and coastal clauses sit here too** — [[oasis-piwind]] is an open catastrophe model for offshore wind, so **the two form a "conditions (wording side) plus model (quantitative side)" pair**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes, the six-year archive list, the index methodology wording and Cefor’s own stated limitation, plus the clause and conditions items in navigation**, **but downloaded no NoMIS report, no annual archive, did not open the Coastal Hull Index file itself, opened no fact sheet or premium overview and opened no clause text**, so **no loss ratio, premium volume, index value or clause wording can be restated**; **② the index’s actual values and weight proportions were not read** (**only the method description and qualitative conclusion**); **③ the site has a Log in area**, and **the scope of member-only content was not verified**; **④ NoMIS membership coverage (how many members, which countries) was not verified**; **⑤ Cefor’s relationship to Nordic supervisors and to IUMI was not verified**; **⑥ the homepage title measurably reads only "Home" and carries little information, so this entry’s title and summary rest on the functional pages rather than the homepage**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim Cefor provides actuarial software or modelling tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (200), `/statistics/` (14.5KB), `/statistics/nomis/` (12.2KB), `/statistics/coastal-hull-inflation-index/` (14.7KB), `/statistics/market-overview/` (15.1KB), `/clauses/hull-clauses/` (23.5KB) and `/statistics/news/2026-mid-year-hull-report/` (11.1KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with the methodology paragraphs read verbatim; **no report, index file, fact sheet or clause text was downloaded**.

**Cefor（The Nordic Association of Marine Insurers，北歐水險協會）** 是**北歐水險業的行業組織**（頁腳自述「Cefor - The Nordic Association of Marine Insurers, P.O Box 2550 Solli, NO-0202 OSLO, Norway」）。本條目補的是**「專業險種自己的共享數據層」這一形態**：**實測池內水險／貨運險／船舶險相關條目為 0**——**注意一個假命中**：「hull」曾命中 [[hull-white-esg-checks]]，**但那是 Hull-White 利率模型，與船舶險無關**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁標題實測 **「Home」**；⭐ **「Statistics」頁 14.5KB**；⭐ **「NoMIS」頁 12.2KB**，正文寫明 **「Here you can download the lastest and historical versions of Nordic Marine Insurance Statistics (NoMIS) Reports, Cefor Annual Reports and half yearly NoMIS statistics」**，並列出 **2026–2021 共六年年度檔**；⭐ **「Coastal Hull Index」頁 14.7KB**，正文寫明 **「…may be composed as a weighted index」**，且 **「The weight is the typical average % split of claims into steel, other materials and labour costs. This is coupled with three indices from Statistics Norway (SSB)」**——**按鋼鐵／其他材料／人工的典型賠款佔比加權，再與挪威統計局（SSB）三個指數結合**；**同頁 Cefor 自行聲明局限**：**「the actual claims cost trend in any one year may differ from such a calculated index…」**，並寫明近期**實際理賠成本通脹高於按 SSB 推算的指數**；⭐ **「Cefor in Figures」頁 15.1KB**，含 **2026 Cefor in Figures**、**2025 Cefor Facts**、**The Cefor Marine Insurance Market 2024 (premiums)** 等檔期；**「Hull Clauses」頁 23.5KB**；**「2026 Mid-year hull report」頁 11.1KB**；導航另含 **Nordic Plan（標準水險合同）**、**Cargo Clauses**、**Small craft clauses**、**Nordic Offshore Wind Insurance Conditions（離岸風電保險條件）**、**Safety regulations**、**Ask the analyst**、**NoMIS Special focus analyses**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「水險」這一整條業務線**——池內險種側**極密於壽險／健康險／車險／財產險／巨災**，**唯獨水險與貨運險為 0**。**② ⭐ 「理賠通脹指數」是本輪最有教學價值的發現**——池內已有 [[claims-inflation-motor-my]] 與 [[inflation-aware-xol-reserving]]，而 **Cefor 給出「第三種險種、方法論完全公開」的理賠通脹構造**（**按成本構成加權 → 掛接國家統計局投入指數**），**且把方法局限寫在頁面上**（**合成指數與實際賠款趨勢可能背離**）——**對做「理賠通脹假設」的學生是可直接引用的方法樣本與警示**（可與 [[lossratio-r]]、[[gi-loss-reserving]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]] 並讀）。**③ 「共享理賠統計」機制本身值得注意**——**由行業組織匯總多家公司理賠數據形成共同基準（NoMIS）**，**既非監管強制申報、亦非公開數據，而是行業自組織共享池**；對研究**數據共享激勵**的學生，這是與 [[susep-sro]]（監管強制逐筆登記）**完全相反的路线**。**④ 離岸風電保險條件與條款亦在此站**——與 [[oasis-piwind]] 構成**「條款側 + 量化側」一對**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量、六年檔期、指數方法論與 Cefor 自述局限、以及條款導航條目**，**但未下載任何 NoMIS 報告、未下載任何年度檔、未打開沿海船體指數檔案、未打開任何 Fact Sheet 或條款文本**，故**不能轉述任何具體損失率、保費規模、指數數值或條款條文**；**② 指數的具體數值與權重比例未讀取**；**③ 站點設有 Log in 區域，會員專區範圍未核實**；**④ NoMIS 的成員覆蓋範圍未核實**；**⑤ 與北歐各國監管、與 IUMI 的關係未核實**；**⑥ 首頁標題實測僅為「Home」，信息量低，故本條目標題與摘要依據各功能頁**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** Cefor 提供精算軟件或建模工具**。**核實說明**：七個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取方法論段落；**未下載報告、指數檔案、Fact Sheet 或條款文本**。

entries.body:
**IUMI（International Union of Marine Insurance，国际水险联盟）** 是**全球水险业的国际组织**（站点标题实测即「International Union of Marine Insurance」）。本条目与同轮 [[cefor]] 构成**「全球层 vs 北欧层」的水险数据对照**：**Cefor 是区域协会的共享理赔池，IUMI 是覆盖更广的全球统计与分线市场评论**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 200（体量约 1,086KB，为**内容型大站**），标题实测 **「International Union of Marine Insurance」**；⭐ **「Statistics」页 `/statistics/` 实测 485.3KB，标题「International Union of Marine Insurance | Statistics」**；⭐ **「Statistics Archive（统计档案）」页 `/statistics-archive/` 实测 295.3KB，标题「…| Statistics Archive」**——**历史各年统计的归档入口**；⭐ **「Member statistics（会员统计）」页 `/member-statistics/` 实测 610.9KB，标题「…| Member statistics」**——**四页中体量最大**；实测另见新闻/通讯入口 **「annual-stats-report-published-by-iumi」（年度统计报告已发布）** 与 **「the-iumi-stats-report-2025」（IUMI 2025 统计报告）**；**分线市场评论的新闻标题实测可见**：**「A stable cargo marine insurance market but uncertainty looms, warns IUMI」**、**「Inland hull, fishing vessel and yacht insurers report general market soundness, however challenges remain ahead」**、**「Steady insurance markets for hull and cargo in 2024, but offshore energy business is challenged, headwinds loom for all markets」**、**「IUMI highlights challenging hull marine insurance market and elevated risk」**；**另有中东局势相关声明**（**2026 年 6 月的两则**）与 **`/annual-conference-archive/`（年会档案）**；**播客栏目**实测含**拉丁美洲、中国、印度水险市场**与**非法/无管制/未报告捕鱼**等主题。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「全球水险的分线市场评论」这一层**——**Cefor 给的是共享理赔数据（量化），IUMI 给的是分线市场判断（船体、货运、内河船体、渔船、游艇、离岸能源）**；**两者并读正好是「数据 + 判断」，也是行业组织向会员输出的两种典型产品**。**② 「统计档案」对做时间序列的学生直接有用**——**历史各年统计集中在 `/statistics-archive/`**，**不必逐年找报告**；这种**档案化设计**与池内 [[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 的「长期序列」思路一致，只是险种不同。**③ 「会员统计」页体量最大（610.9KB）**，说明**其统计颗粒度可能到会员/公司层**——**但本次未打开内容，故本词条不主张其颗粒度**（**这一点已在下面如实标注**）。**④ 中东局势声明（2026 年 6 月）说明水险是地缘政治敏感险种**——**战争险、航运中断与保险可得性**是水险特有议题，**这与池内政治风险类条目的空白形成呼应**（**本轮实测「政治风险」形态为 0，已在轮次日志中记录为后续候选**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量与新闻标题**，**但未打开任何统计表格、未下载任何统计报告、未打开任何分线市场评论正文、未打开任何播客音频**，因此**不能转述任何保费规模、损失率、市场费率水平或会员统计数值**；**② 「统计报告」「分线评论」的结论本次全部未读取**——**页面上可见的只是新闻标题**，**本词条不据标题转述其内容**；**③ 「会员统计」的颗粒度（是否到公司层）本次未核实**，**故不作主张**；**④ IUMI 的会员构成（各国协会 vs 直接公司会员）、与 Cefor 及各区域协会的关系本次未核实**；**⑤ 统计是否对非会员开放、是否需要登录本次未核实**；**⑥ 首页体量约 1,086KB 为实测值**，**其中内容与脚本资源各占多少本次未区分**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** IUMI 提供精算软件、建模工具或逐单数据。**核实说明**：首页（约 1,086KB）、`/statistics/`（485.3KB）、`/statistics-archive/`（295.3KB）、`/member-statistics/`（610.9KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与新闻标题；**未打开统计表格、统计报告、市场评论正文或播客**。
entries.body_en:
**IUMI (the International Union of Marine Insurance)** is **the international organisation of the marine insurance industry** (its measured site title is simply "International Union of Marine Insurance"). With [[cefor]] from the same round it forms a **"global versus Nordic" marine data contrast**: **Cefor is a regional association’s shared claims pool; IUMI is broader global statistics plus line-by-line market commentary**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage returns 200 (about **1,086KB**, a **content-heavy site**) with the measured title **"International Union of Marine Insurance"**; ⭐ the **"Statistics" page `/statistics/` measures 485.3KB with the title "International Union of Marine Insurance | Statistics"**; ⭐ the **"Statistics Archive" page `/statistics-archive/` measures 295.3KB** — **the archival entry point to historical years**; ⭐ the **"Member statistics" page `/member-statistics/` measures 610.9KB** — **the largest of the four**; measured news and newsletter entry points include **"annual-stats-report-published-by-iumi"** and **"the-iumi-stats-report-2025"**; **measured market-commentary headlines** include **"A stable cargo marine insurance market but uncertainty looms, warns IUMI"**, **"Inland hull, fishing vessel and yacht insurers report general market soundness, however challenges remain ahead"**, **"Steady insurance markets for hull and cargo in 2024, but offshore energy business is challenged, headwinds loom for all markets"** and **"IUMI highlights challenging hull marine insurance market and elevated risk"**; there are also **two measured statements on the Middle East situation (both June 2026)** and **`/annual-conference-archive/`**; the **podcast section** measurably covers **the Latin American, Chinese and Indian marine markets** and **illegal, unregulated and unreported fishing**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "global line-by-line marine market commentary" layer** — **Cefor supplies shared claims data (quantitative); IUMI supplies line-level market judgement (hull, cargo, inland hull, fishing vessels, yachts, offshore energy)**; **read together they are "data plus judgement", the two typical products a trade body gives its members**. **② The statistics archive directly serves time-series work** — **historical years are gathered at `/statistics-archive/`**, **so reports need not be hunted year by year**; this **archival design** matches the "long series" thinking of [[cmi-mortality-projections]] and [[human-mortality-db]], only in a different line. **③ The member statistics page is the largest (610.9KB)**, suggesting **granularity possibly down to member or company level** — **but its content was not opened, so this entry does not assert that granularity** (**flagged below**). **④ The June 2026 Middle East statements show marine is a geopolitically sensitive line** — **war risk, shipping disruption and insurance availability** are marine-specific issues, **echoing the corpus’s gap on political risk** (**this round measured "political risk" at zero and logged it as a later candidate**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes and news headlines**, **but opened no statistics table, downloaded no statistics report, opened no market commentary body and opened no podcast audio**, so **no premium volume, loss ratio, market rate level or member statistic can be restated**; **② the reports’ and commentaries’ conclusions were entirely unread** — **only headlines were visible, and this entry does not restate their content from headlines**; **③ the granularity of "member statistics" (whether it reaches company level) was not verified**, **so no claim is made**; **④ IUMI’s membership composition (national associations versus direct corporate members) and its relationship to Cefor and regional associations were not verified**; **⑤ whether the statistics are open to non-members or require login was not verified**; **⑥ the homepage size of about 1,086KB is a measured value**, **and content versus script assets were not distinguished**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim IUMI provides actuarial software, modelling tools or policy-level data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (about 1,086KB), `/statistics/` (485.3KB), `/statistics-archive/` (295.3KB) and `/member-statistics/` (610.9KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and headlines read; **no statistics table, report, commentary body or podcast was opened**.

對 RIAA：**① 補上「全球水險分線市場評論」這一層**——**Cefor 給共享理賠數據（量化），IUMI 給分線市場判斷（船體、貨運、內河、漁船、遊艇、離岸能源）**；**兩者並讀正好是「數據 + 判斷」**。**② 「統計檔案」對做時間序列的學生直接有用**——**歷史各年集中在 `/statistics-archive/`**；這種**歸檔化設計**與 [[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 的「長期序列」思路一致。**③ 「會員統計」頁體量最大（610.9KB）**，**但本次未打開內容，故不主張其顆粒度**。**④ 中東局勢聲明說明水險是地緣政治敏感險種**——**戰爭險、航運中斷與保險可得性**是水險特有議題，**與池內政治風險類條目的空白形成呼應**（**本輪實測「政治風險」形態為 0，已記為後續候選**）。
