entries.body:
**ICISA（International Credit Insurance & Surety Association，国际信用保险与保证协会）** 是**贸易信用保险（trade credit insurance）与保证险（surety）两业的国际行业协会**。本条目补的是**「信用与保证险」这一形态**：**实测该形态此前仅有 1 条命中（[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]，属印尼监管统计的附带提及），真正覆盖信用险/保证险自身的条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 203.1KB，标题实测 **「International Credit Insurance & Surety Association (ICISA)」**；⭐ **「Statistics」页 `/statistics/` 实测 174.1KB，标题实测为「Statistics on Trade Credit Insurance and Surety | ICISA」**——**标题本身即写明其为贸易信用保险与保证险的统计**；**「Publications」页 `/publications`** 与 **「About us / Members」页 `/about-us/members`** 实测存在；首页正文实测写明协会定位为 **「advocating on behalf of our members on issues affecting credit insurance and surety」**，并写明其**委员会与工作组的运作方式**（**「bringing together deep, international expertise to discuss major developments, industry concerns or distribute emerging best practice」**）；**⭐ 三套术语表实测存在**：**Trade Credit Insurance** 与 **Surety** 与 **Reinsurance** 各自配有 **Glossary**（**Glossary of TCI Terms / Glossary of Surety Terms / Reinsurance Glossary**）；**⭐ 另有「ICISA Learning Hub」学习中心**（首页导航实测）；**首页实测列出 Industries 分组**（含 Trade Credit Insurance、Surety、Reinsurance）；⭐ **与伯尔尼联盟合编的商业信心指数实测存在**：**`/news/icisa-berne-union-business-confidence-index-2026-h2/`（184.8KB，标题「ICISA & Berne Union Business Confidence Index 2026 H2 | ICISA」）**；另实测有 **`/state-aid-covid-19/`**（疫情期国家援助专题页）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「信用与保证险」这一整类险种**——**信用险承保买方不付款，保证险承保履约失败**，**两者都是「对手方信用风险」的保险化**，**与池内密集的寿险/健康险/车险/财产险在风险结构上不同**；**对做信用风险与保险交叉方向的学生，这是此前完全缺失的一类**（可与同轮 [[berne-union]] 的出口信用与投资保险、[[insurance-scr-data]] 的偿付能力资本数据并读——**一个是私营信用险，一个是官方出口信用**）。**② ⭐ 三套术语表对本站读者有直接实用价值**——**信用险与保证险的术语体系与一般财产险差异很大**，**ICISA 直接提供 TCI / 保证 / 再保险三套 glossaries**；这与池内 [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]]（多语精算术语表）、[[insurance-qa-en]]（保险问答语料）**同属「术语与知识资产」类**，**但覆盖的是此前没有的险种**。**③ 「Learning Hub」是一个此前少见的形态**——池内教育类条目多为**备考、课程与大学项目**，而这是**行业协会自办的从业学习中心**（可与 [[cii]]、[[anziif]]、[[loma]] 的职业资格机构对照——**一个是行业协会内设学习中心，一个是独立资格机构**）。**④ 与伯尔尼联盟合编商业信心指数说明两个协会的数据合作**——**这一点与同轮 [[berne-union]] 的观察一致**（**两站都发布该指数**），**也是「行业自组织数据产品」的又一个实例**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量、首页定位表述、三套术语表与 Learning Hub 的导航条目、以及信心指数新闻页标题**，**但未打开统计页面内的任何数据表、未下载任何出版物、未打开任何术语表条目、未打开 Learning Hub 内容、未打开信心指数正文或 PDF**，因此**不能转述任何保费规模、赔付率、指数数值或术语定义**；**② 「Statistics」页的统计口径、覆盖年份与是否含分国数据本次未核实**；**③ 该指数为季度频率的推断来自页面标题中的「2026 H2」字样**，**具体的编制方法、抽样机构范围与发布频率本次未核实**；**④ ICISA 与伯尔尼联盟的成员重叠关系、以及本条目所述「私营信用险 vs 官方出口信用」的分工属行业常识性区分，本次未在页面上逐一核实**——**故词条中该表述仅作阅读提示，不作事实主张**；**⑤ `state-aid-covid-19` 页本次仅核实链接存在**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张** ICISA 提供精算工具、定价模型或逐单数据。**核实说明**：首页（203.1KB）、`/statistics/`（174.1KB）、`/news/icisa-berne-union-business-confidence-index-2026-h2/`（184.8KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与首页正文；`/publications`、`/about-us/members`、三套术语表与 Learning Hub 仅核实为导航链接存在；**未打开数据表、出版物、术语表、学习中心或指数 PDF**。
entries.body_en:
**ICISA (the International Credit Insurance & Surety Association)** is **the international trade association for two businesses: trade credit insurance and surety**. This entry adds the **"credit and surety insurance"** form: **a measured count found only one hit, [[ojk-insurance-statistics]], and that is an incidental mention within Indonesian regulatory statistics — genuine coverage of credit or surety insurance itself was zero**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 203.1KB with the measured title **"International Credit Insurance & Surety Association (ICISA)"**; ⭐ the **"Statistics" page `/statistics/` measures 174.1KB with the measured title "Statistics on Trade Credit Insurance and Surety | ICISA"** — **the title itself states that these are statistics on trade credit insurance and surety**; **"Publications" `/publications`** and **"About us / Members" `/about-us/members`** exist as measured links; the homepage body states the association’s purpose as **"advocating on behalf of our members on issues affecting credit insurance and surety"** and describes its committee and working-group model (**"bringing together deep, international expertise to discuss major developments, industry concerns or distribute emerging best practice"**); **⭐ three glossaries measurably exist**: **Trade Credit Insurance**, **Surety** and **Reinsurance** each with its own **Glossary** (**Glossary of TCI Terms / Glossary of Surety Terms / Reinsurance Glossary**); **⭐ there is also an "ICISA Learning Hub"** (measured in the homepage navigation); **the homepage lists an Industries grouping** (Trade Credit Insurance, Surety, Reinsurance); ⭐ **a business confidence index co-produced with the Berne Union measurably exists**: **`/news/icisa-berne-union-business-confidence-index-2026-h2/` (184.8KB, title "ICISA & Berne Union Business Confidence Index 2026 H2 | ICISA")**; there is also a measured **`/state-aid-covid-19/`** topic page.

For RIAA: **① it adds an entire class of insurance** — **credit insurance covers a buyer’s non-payment and surety covers performance failure**, **both being the insurance-isation of counterparty credit risk**, **structurally different from the life, health, motor and property lines that dominate the corpus**; **for students working where credit risk meets insurance, this was an entirely missing class** (readable with [[berne-union]] on export credit and investment insurance and [[insurance-scr-data]] on solvency capital data — **one is private credit insurance, the other official export credit**). **② ⭐ The three glossaries have direct practical value to this wiki’s readers** — **credit and surety terminology differs substantially from general property insurance**, and **ICISA supplies TCI, surety and reinsurance glossaries**; this places it with [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]] and [[insurance-qa-en]] as **"terminology and knowledge assets"**, **but covering lines previously absent**. **③ The "Learning Hub" is a form rarely seen here** — the corpus’s education entries are mostly **exam prep, courses and university programmes**, whereas this is **a trade association’s own practitioner learning centre** (comparable with [[cii]], [[anziif]] and [[loma]] as professional-qualification bodies — **one is a learning centre inside an association, the others are standalone qualification bodies**). **④ The joint confidence index with the Berne Union shows data cooperation between two associations** — **consistent with [[berne-union]] in the same round** (**both sites publish the index**), **and another instance of industry-organised data products**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes, the homepage positioning statement, the three glossaries and Learning Hub as navigation items, and the confidence-index news page title**, **but opened no data table on the statistics page, downloaded no publication, opened no glossary entry, opened no Learning Hub content and opened neither the index body nor its PDF**, so **no premium volume, loss ratio, index value or terminology definition can be restated**; **② the statistics page’s basis, year coverage and whether it includes country-level data were not verified**; **③ the inference that the index is quarterly comes from the "2026 H2" wording in the page title**, and **its methodology, sample of firms and publication frequency were not verified**; **④ ICISA’s membership overlap with the Berne Union, and the "private credit insurance versus official export credit" division stated here, are industry-conventional distinctions not verified item by item on these pages** — **so that wording serves as a reading prompt only and is not asserted as fact**; **⑤ the `state-aid-covid-19` page was verified only as an existing link**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim ICISA provides actuarial tools, pricing models or policy-level data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (203.1KB), `/statistics/` (174.1KB) and the confidence-index news page (184.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and homepage body read; `/publications`, `/about-us/members`, the three glossaries and the Learning Hub were verified only as existing navigation links; **no data table, publication, glossary, learning content or index PDF was opened**.

**ICISA（International Credit Insurance & Surety Association，國際信用保險與保證協會）** 是**貿易信用保險與保證險兩業的國際行業協會**。本條目補的是**「信用與保證險」這一形態**：**實測此前僅 1 條命中（[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]，屬印尼監管統計的附帶提及），真正覆蓋信用險／保證險自身的條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 203.1KB，標題實測 **「International Credit Insurance & Surety Association (ICISA)」**；⭐ **「Statistics」頁 174.1KB，標題實測「Statistics on Trade Credit Insurance and Surety | ICISA」**——**標題本身即寫明為貿易信用保險與保證險統計**；**「Publications」與「Members」頁**實測存在；首頁正文寫明定位為 **「advocating on behalf of our members on issues affecting credit insurance and surety」**，並寫明**委員會與工作組**的運作方式；**⭐ 三套術語表實測存在**：**Glossary of TCI Terms / Glossary of Surety Terms / Reinsurance Glossary**；**⭐ 另有「ICISA Learning Hub」學習中心**；首頁實測列出 **Industries** 分組（Trade Credit Insurance、Surety、Reinsurance）；⭐ **與伯爾尼聯盟合編的信心指數實測存在**：**標題「ICISA & Berne Union Business Confidence Index 2026 H2 | ICISA」（184.8KB）**；另實測有 **`/state-aid-covid-19/`** 專題頁。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「信用與保證險」這一整類險種**——**信用險承保買方不付款，保證險承保履約失敗**，**兩者都是「對手方信用風險」的保險化**，**與池內密集的壽險／健康險／車險／財產險在風險結構上不同**（可與同輪 [[berne-union]]、[[insurance-scr-data]] 並讀——**一個是私營信用險，一個是官方出口信用**）。**② ⭐ 三套術語表對本站讀者有直接實用價值**——**信用險與保證險的術語體系與一般財產險差異很大**；與池內 [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]]、[[insurance-qa-en]] **同屬「術語與知識資產」類**，**但覆蓋此前沒有的險種**。**③ 「Learning Hub」是此前少見的形態**——**行業協會自辦的從業學習中心**（可與 [[cii]]、[[anziif]]、[[loma]] 的獨立資格機構對照）。**④ 與伯爾尼聯盟合編信心指數說明兩個協會的數據合作**（**兩站都發布該指數**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量、首頁定位表述、三套術語表與 Learning Hub 的導航條目、以及信心指數新聞頁標題**，**但未打開統計頁內任何數據表、未下載任何出版物、未打開任何術語表條目、未打開 Learning Hub 內容、未打開信心指數正文或 PDF**，故**不能轉述任何保費規模、賠付率、指數數值或術語定義**；**② 統計口徑、覆蓋年份與是否含分國數據未核實**；**③ 「2026 H2」字樣推斷其為季度頻率**，**編制方法、抽樣範圍與發布頻率未核實**；**④ 「私營信用險 vs 官方出口信用」屬行業常識性區分，本次未在頁面逐一核實**——**詞條中該表述僅作閱讀提示，不作事實主張**；**⑤ `state-aid-covid-19` 頁僅核實連結存在**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張** ICISA 提供精算工具、定價模型或逐單數據**。**核實說明**：首頁、`/statistics/`、信心指數新聞頁均 HTTP 200 實測；`/publications`、`/about-us/members`、三套術語表與 Learning Hub 僅核實為導航連結存在；**未打開數據表、出版物、術語表、學習中心或指數 PDF**。

entries.body:
**Berne Union（伯尔尼联盟）** 是**出口信用与投资保险（export credit and investment insurance）业的国际组织**——**其成员主体是各国的官方出口信用机构（ECA）与政治风险/投资保险人**。本条目补的是**「政治风险与出口信用」这一形态**：**实测池内「政治风险」为 0**，**「信用与保证险」仅 1 条附带命中**——**即这一类主权/贸易信用风险此前完全空白**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 200（约 54.1KB），标题实测 **「Berne Union - Berne Union home page」**；⭐ **「State of the Industry Report 2025」页实测 45.5KB，标题「Berne Union - State of the Industry Report 2025 Published」**；⭐ **成员名录页 `/Members` 实测 396.5KB，标题「Berne Union」**；**导航实测揭示的组织结构**（**为逐字读取所得，条目分类如下**）：**About (About the Berne Union / Member Directory / About Credit & Investment Insurance / Activities / Leadership / 90th Anniversary)**、**Media Resources**、**Industry News**、**Meetings & External Events**、**Initiatives（Stakeholders and partners / Official Correspondence / Capacity Sharing Marketplace / Climate Group / Young Professionals Initiative / Blended Finance Hackathon 2026）**、**Publications（Press Releases / Subscribe to the BUlletin / Glossary of Industry Terms / How Credit Insurance Supports the Real Economy / Berne Union Yearbook 2025 / State of the Industry 2025 / BU Publications & Research / Reading room）**，以及 **Prospective Members**、**Mailing List**、**Careers**、**Press kit**；实测另见与 **[[icisa]]** 相关的 **「Berne Union-ICISA Business Confidence Index 2026 H2」** 文章条目，**并实测到页面所链接的 PDF 资源地址**（含 **Berne Union and ICISA Business Confidence Index 2026 H2.pdf**、**Credit insurance and its role supporting world trade.pdf**、**How credit insurance supports the real economy.pdf**）；实测另有 **「From Climate Risk to Practical Decisions」网络研讨会** 与 **Yearbook 征稿通知（截止 2026-09-30）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「主权与贸易信用风险」这一整类**——**出口信用保险承保的是「外国买方不付款」与「东道国政治事件导致损失」**，**风险来源是国家而非个人或企业**；**对做主权风险、跨境信用与政治风险的学生，这是池内此前完全没有的一类**（可与同轮 [[icisa]] 的私营信用险并读——**一个官方、一个私营，覆盖同一风险的两端**）。**② ⭐ 「State of the Industry」+「Yearbook」构成年度连续披露**——**行业组织自己出年报与年鉴**，这是**获取该行业规模与趋势的第一手连续来源**；**注意：本次实测只确认了这两个出版物的存在与年份（2025），未打开内容**。**③ ⭐ 「能力共享市场（Capacity Sharing Marketplace）」与「混合金融黑客松 2026」是两个不常见于保险行业协会的倡议**——**前者指向再保险与能力的分摊机制、后者指向混合金融（blended finance，公共资金撬动私人资本）**；**对研究「公共—私人风险分担结构」的学生，这两条是具体的制度观察点**（可与 [[seadrif]] 的东南亚灾害风险保险基金、[[a2ii]] 的普惠保险监管倡议、[[microinsurance-network]] 并读——**三者都是「公共与私人共同承担风险」的不同形态**）。**④ 「Glossary of Industry Terms」与 [[icisa]] 的三套术语表形成呼应**——**两个协会各自维护本业术语表**（可与 [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]] 并读）。**⑤ ⭐ 「90th Anniversary」说明这是历史最久的保险业国际组织之一**（**成立约 1934 年**，**但本词条不据此断言具体成立年份——页面上只读到「90th Anniversary」这一栏目名**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量、导航结构与出版物栏目名，以及所链接 PDF 的资源地址**，**但未打开 State of the Industry 正文、未打开 Yearbook、未打开术语表、未打开成员名录内容、未下载任何 PDF、未打开任何倡议页面**，因此**不能转述任何业务规模、赔付数据、成员名单或术语定义**；**② 「官方出口信用机构（ECA）与政治风险保险人为主体」的表述来自「About Credit & Investment Insurance」与「Member Directory」等栏目名的推断**，**本次未打开成员名录确认成员构成——故该表述在词条中作为机构性质说明，具体成员构成不作主张**；**③ 「90th Anniversary」仅核实为栏目名**，**具体成立年份未核实**；**④ 「Blended Finance Hackathon 2026」「Climate Group」等倡议的内容、参与方与成果本次未核实**；**⑤ 与 [[icisa]] 合编指数的编制方法、发布频率与本次未核实**（**仅核实两站均发布该指数及 PDF 资源地址**）；**⑥ 相关 PDF 位于 `bublob.blob.core.windows.net`，本次仅从页面 HTML 中读到其地址，未发起下载**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** Berne Union 提供精算工具、定价模型或逐单数据。**核实说明**：首页（约 54.1KB，标题「Berne Union - Berne Union home page」）、`/Members`（396.5KB）、`/Articles/Details/1019/State-of-the-Industry-Report-2025-Published`（45.5KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取导航与栏目名；**未打开报告、年鉴、术语表、成员名录内容或任何 PDF**。

**The Berne Union** is **the international organisation for the export credit and investment insurance industry** — **its members are chiefly national official export credit agencies (ECAs) and political-risk or investment insurers**. This entry adds the **"political risk and export credit"** form: **a measured count found zero for political risk and only one incidental hit for credit and surety insurance** — **this entire class of sovereign and trade credit risk was previously absent**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage returns 200 (about **54.1KB**) with the measured title **"Berne Union - Berne Union home page"**; ⭐ the **"State of the Industry Report 2025" page measures 45.5KB with the title "Berne Union - State of the Industry Report 2025 Published"**; ⭐ the **member directory `/Members` measures 396.5KB with the title "Berne Union"**; **the navigation read verbatim reveals the following structure**: **About (About the Berne Union / Member Directory / About Credit & Investment Insurance / Activities / Leadership / 90th Anniversary)**, **Media Resources**, **Industry News**, **Meetings & External Events**, **Initiatives (Stakeholders and partners / Official Correspondence / Capacity Sharing Marketplace / Climate Group / Young Professionals Initiative / Blended Finance Hackathon 2026)**, **Publications (Press Releases / Subscribe to the BUlletin / Glossary of Industry Terms / How Credit Insurance Supports the Real Economy / Berne Union Yearbook 2025 / State of the Industry 2025 / BU Publications & Research / Reading room)**, plus **Prospective Members**, **Mailing List**, **Careers** and **Press kit**; there is also a measured article on the **"Berne Union-ICISA Business Confidence Index 2026 H2"** relating to **[[icisa]]**, **with measured PDF asset URLs read from the page HTML** (including **Berne Union and ICISA Business Confidence Index 2026 H2.pdf**, **Credit insurance and its role supporting world trade.pdf** and **How credit insurance supports the real economy.pdf**); there is also a measured **"From Climate Risk to Practical Decisions"** webinar and a **Yearbook call for papers (closing 30 September 2026)**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the entire class of sovereign and trade credit risk** — **export credit insurance covers "a foreign buyer fails to pay" and "loss caused by political events in the host country"**, **so the source of risk is a state rather than an individual or firm**; **for students working on sovereign risk, cross-border credit and political risk this class was entirely absent** (readable with [[icisa]] in the same round — **one official, one private, covering two ends of the same risk**). **② ⭐ "State of the Industry" plus the "Yearbook" give continuous annual disclosure** — **a trade body publishing its own annual report and yearbook**, a **first-hand continuous source for the industry’s size and trends**; **note that this check confirmed only the existence and year (2025) of these publications, and opened neither**. **③ ⭐ The "Capacity Sharing Marketplace" and the "Blended Finance Hackathon 2026" are initiatives unusual for an insurance trade body** — **the former points at mechanisms for sharing reinsurance capacity, the latter at blended finance (public money mobilising private capital)**; **for students studying public-private risk-sharing structures these are concrete institutional observations** (readable with [[seadrif]], the Southeast Asia disaster risk insurance fund, [[a2ii]] and [[microinsurance-network]] — **three different forms of public and private risk sharing**). **④ The "Glossary of Industry Terms" echoes [[icisa]]’s three glossaries** — **each association maintains its own body of terminology** (readable with [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]]). **⑤ ⭐ The "90th Anniversary" item indicates one of the oldest international insurance organisations** (**established around 1934**, **but this entry does not assert a founding year — only the "90th Anniversary" navigation label was read**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes, navigation structure and publication labels, plus the PDF asset URLs read from the HTML**, **but opened no State of the Industry body, no Yearbook, no glossary, no member directory content, downloaded no PDF and opened no initiative page**, so **no business volume, claims data, member list or terminology definition can be restated**; **② the statement that official export credit agencies and political-risk insurers dominate membership is inferred from navigation labels such as "About Credit & Investment Insurance" and "Member Directory"**, and **the member directory was not opened to confirm composition — so that wording stands as a description of the organisation’s nature, with no claim about specific membership**; **③ "90th Anniversary" was verified only as a label**, and **the founding year was not verified**; **④ the content, participants and outcomes of initiatives such as the "Blended Finance Hackathon 2026" and the "Climate Group" were not verified**; **⑤ the joint index’s methodology and publication frequency were not verified** (**only that both sites publish it, and the PDF asset URLs**); **⑥ the PDFs sit on `bublob.blob.core.windows.net`, and their addresses were only read from the page HTML — no download was initiated**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the Berne Union provides actuarial tools, pricing models or policy-level data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (about 54.1KB, title "Berne Union - Berne Union home page"), `/Members` (396.5KB) and `/Articles/Details/1019/State-of-the-Industry-Report-2025-Published` (45.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with navigation and labels read verbatim; **no report, yearbook, glossary, member content or PDF was opened**.

**Berne Union（伯爾尼聯盟）** 是**出口信用與投資保險業的國際組織**——**其成員主體是各國官方出口信用機構（ECA）與政治風險／投資保險人**。本條目補的是**「政治風險與出口信用」這一形態**：**實測池內「政治風險」為 0**，**「信用與保證險」僅 1 條附帶命中**——**即這一類主權／貿易信用風險此前完全空白**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁約 **54.1KB**，標題實測 **「Berne Union - Berne Union home page」**；⭐ **「State of the Industry Report 2025」頁 45.5KB**；⭐ **成員名錄 `/Members` 396.5KB**；**導航逐字實測揭示結構**：**About（About the Berne Union / Member Directory / About Credit & Investment Insurance / Leadership / 90th Anniversary）**、**Initiatives（Capacity Sharing Marketplace / Climate Group / Young Professionals Initiative / Blended Finance Hackathon 2026）**、**Publications（Press Releases / Subscribe to the BUlletin / Glossary of Industry Terms / How Credit Insurance Supports the Real Economy / Berne Union Yearbook 2025 / State of the Industry 2025 / BU Publications & Research / Reading room）**；實測另見與 **[[icisa]]** 相關的 **「Berne Union-ICISA Business Confidence Index 2026 H2」** 文章，**並從頁面 HTML 讀到所鏈接的 PDF 資源地址**；另有 **「From Climate Risk to Practical Decisions」** 網絡研討會與 **Yearbook 徵稿通知（截止 2026-09-30）**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「主權與貿易信用風險」這一整類**——**出口信用保險承保「外國買方不付款」與「東道國政治事件導致損失」**，**風險來源是國家而非個人或企業**（可與同輪 [[icisa]] 的私營信用險並讀——**一個官方、一個私營**）。**② ⭐ 「State of the Industry」+「Yearbook」構成年度連續披露**（**本次僅確認其存在與年份 2025，未打開內容**）。**③ ⭐ 「能力共享市場」與「混合金融黑客松 2026」是不常見於保險行業協會的倡議**——**前者指向再保險與能力分攤、後者指向混合金融**；**對研究「公共—私人風險分擔結構」的學生是具體制度觀察點**（可與 [[seadrif]]、[[a2ii]]、[[microinsurance-network]] 並讀）。**④ 「Glossary of Industry Terms」與 [[icisa]] 的三套術語表形成呼應**。**⑤ ⭐ 「90th Anniversary」說明這是歷史最久的保險業國際組織之一**（**但本詞條不據此斷言具體成立年份**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量、導航結構與出版物欄目名、以及所鏈接 PDF 的資源地址**，**但未打開 State of the Industry 正文、未打開 Yearbook、未打開術語表、未打開成員名錄內容、未下載任何 PDF、未打開任何倡議頁**，故**不能轉述任何業務規模、賠付數據、成員名單或術語定義**；**② 「官方出口信用機構與政治風險保險人為主體」係由欄目名推斷**，**未打開成員名錄確認——故僅作機構性質說明，具體成員構成不作主張**；**③ 「90th Anniversary」僅核實為欄目名**，**具體成立年份未核實**；**④ 相關倡議的內容、參與方與成果未核實**；**⑤ 合編指數的編制方法與發布頻率未核實**；**⑥ 相關 PDF 位於 `bublob.blob.core.windows.net`，本次僅從 HTML 讀到地址、未發起下載**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** Berne Union 提供精算工具、定價模型或逐單數據**。**核實說明**：首頁、`/Members`、State of the Industry 頁均 HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取導航與欄目名；**未打開報告、年鑑、術語表、成員名錄內容或任何 PDF**。

entries.body:
**EIOPA（European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority，欧洲保险与职业养老金监管局）** 是**欧盟层面的保险与职业养老金监管机构**。本条目**不是**重复池内已有的 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]（那是**行业统计**），而是补**「超国家层的中介登记 + 分销商执法数据」**——**实测「中介登记/中介监管」这一形态此前为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「Registers, lists and databases（登记册、清单与数据库）」页 `/tools-and-data/registers-lists-and-databases_en` 实测 97.1KB**，正文实测写明 **「EIOPA hosts a series of repositories of data, lists and databases of relevance for the insurance and occupational pensions sectors」**，并在 **REGISTERS** 分组下实测列出：**Insurance intermediaries（保险中介）**、**Insurance undertakings（保险机构）**、**Institutions for Occupational Retirement Provision IORPs（职业退休机构）**、**Prudential Provisions**、**PEPP central register（泛欧个人养老金产品中央登记册）**、**Register of national laws, regulations…（各国法律登记册）**。⭐ **「Data on sanctions imposed on insurance distributors（对保险分销商处罚的数据）」页 `/tools-and-data/data-sanctions-imposed-insurance-distributors_en` 实测 132.6KB**，正文实测写明机制：**「Under the Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD), national supervisors across the European Economic Area (EEA) must notify EIOPA of any sanctions they impose on insurance distributors when these companies or individuals breach relevant IDD provisions」**——**依《保险分销指令》IDD，EEA 各国监管者必须把对保险分销商施加的处罚通报 EIOPA**；数据范围实测为 **「data between 2018 and 2024, with a focus on the most recent data reported to EIOPA for 2024」**，⭐ **实测写明「1,656 sanctions imposed in 2024」**（**2024 年 1,656 起**），并写明处罚数在 2021 年达到峰值；⭐ 实测写明 **「The most commonly used sanction has been the withdrawal of the registration (i.e. the license) of the company. In 2024, withdrawals of registration represented 51% of all sancti[ons]」**（**最常用处罚是撤销公司注册即牌照，2024 年占总数的 51%**）；⭐ **同一页 EIOPA 主动声明数据局限**：**「given that sanctions are generally targeted at individual companies or individuals, the data provides only a partial perspective of conduct or supervisory issues. Hence, full conclusions regarding the effectiveness of the supervision of the rules by national authorities, cannot be drawn based only on the number of sanctions」**。**可下载文件实测**：五年期年报（首份、2020、2021、第四份 2022、**第五份 2023（EIOPA-BOS-25-013）**）与 **`MSSubmissionsAggregatedReports.xlsx`（成员国报送汇总表，机器可读）**。另实测 **「Supervisory reporting - DPM and XBRL」页 `/tools-and-data/supervisory-reporting-dpm-and-xbrl_en` 153.3KB**（**监管报送的数据点模型与 XBRL 分类标准**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「中介是谁、是否持牌」这一层**——池内中介侧**已有大量中介「公司」条目**（[[marsh]]、[[howden]]、[[miller-insurance]]、[[pacific-prime]]、[[insurance-broker]] 等），**但「这些中介由谁登记、在哪里可查」此前为 0**；**EIOPA 的登记册群把中介、保险机构、IORP、PEPP 的登记集中在一个入口**，**对做跨境合规与中介尽调的学生是直接可用的**。**② ⭐ 「IDD 分销商处罚数据」是一个罕见的公开执法数据集**——**它把「分销环节的不当行为」量化到可比较的层面**（年份、处罚类型、撤销注册占比），**且是超国家合并口径**；这与池内 [[fos-uk]]（英国争议裁决）、[[fscs-uk]]、[[nolhga]]、[[assuris]]（保障机制）**属不同的消费者保护环节**——**那一组是「事后救济」，这一条是「事前监管 + 事后处罚」**。**③ ⭐ EIOPA 自己写明「不能只凭处罚数量判断监管有效性」**——**这是一个很好的方法论警示**：池内 [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]] 聚合监管态势，**而本条给出的是「监管者对自己数据局限的官方说明」**，**引用处罚数据时应同时引用这一句**。**④ 「PEPP 中央登记册」与「各国法律登记册」是两种少见的登记形态**——**一个是跨境个人养老金产品的中央登记，一个是把各国法律集中登记**（后者可与 [[aae]] 的欧洲精算实务准则、[[insurance-europe]] 的行业口径并读）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**两个页面的存在、标题、体量、登记册清单、IDD 通报机制表述、2024 年 1,656 起与撤销注册 51% 的数字、EIOPA 自述局限、可下载文件名与五年年报标题**，**但未打开任何年报正文、未下载 XLSX、未打开任何登记册本身**，因此**不能转述处罚的分国分布、具体机构名称、处罚金额或登记册内容**；**② ⚠️ 专用登记册域名 `register.eiopa.europa.eu` 本次实测返回 HTTP 403（Forbidden）——即「登记册应用本体」我未能访问**，**故本词条只主张「EIOPA 托管这些登记册」这一事实（来自其页面正文），不描述任何登记册的界面、检索方式或数据字段**；**③ 1,656 与 51% 两个数字来自页面正文实测**，**其统计口径（是否含个人、是否含各国全部处罚）本次未逐项核实**；**④ 「中介登记/中介监管」形态为 0 是关键词测量的结论**（**关键词法为启发式，已在轮次日志中记录其局限**）；**⑤ 本次未核实 DPM/XBRL 页的具体分类标准版本与适用范围**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张** EIOPA 提供精算工具或公司级财务数据。**核实说明**：`/tools-and-data/registers-lists-and-databases_en`（97.1KB）、`/tools-and-data/data-sanctions-imposed-insurance-distributors_en`（132.6KB）、`/tools-and-data/supervisory-reporting-dpm-and-xbrl_en`（153.3KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取正文；`register.eiopa.europa.eu` 实测 **403**（未访问）；**未打开年报、未下载 XLSX、未打开登记册**。
entries.body_en:
**EIOPA (the European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority)** is **the EU-level supervisor for insurance and occupational pensions**. This entry does **not** duplicate the corpus’s existing [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] (which covers **industry statistics**); it adds the **"supranational intermediary registration plus distributor enforcement data"** layer — **the "intermediary register / intermediary regulation" form measured zero before this round**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"Registers, lists and databases" page `/tools-and-data/registers-lists-and-databases_en` measures 97.1KB**, stating verbatim that **"EIOPA hosts a series of repositories of data, lists and databases of relevance for the insurance and occupational pensions sectors"**, and listing under a **REGISTERS** grouping: **Insurance intermediaries**, **Insurance undertakings**, **Institutions for Occupational Retirement Provision (IORPs)**, **Prudential Provisions**, a **PEPP central register** and a **Register of national laws, regulations**. ⭐ The **"Data on sanctions imposed on insurance distributors" page measures 132.6KB**, stating the mechanism verbatim: **"Under the Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD), national supervisors across the European Economic Area (EEA) must notify EIOPA of any sanctions they impose on insurance distributors when these companies or individuals breach relevant IDD provisions"**; the measured data range is **"data between 2018 and 2024, with a focus on the most recent data reported to EIOPA for 2024"**, with the measured statement **"1,656 sanctions imposed in 2024"**, the number having peaked in 2021; ⭐ it states verbatim that **"The most commonly used sanction has been the withdrawal of the registration (i.e. the license) of the company. In 2024, withdrawals of registration represented 51% of all sancti[ons]"**; ⭐ **EIOPA itself states the data’s limitation on the same page**: **"given that sanctions are generally targeted at individual companies or individuals, the data provides only a partial perspective of conduct or supervisory issues. Hence, full conclusions regarding the effectiveness of the supervision of the rules by national authorities, cannot be drawn based only on the number of sanctions"**. **Measured downloadable files** include five annual reports (the first, 2020, 2021, the fourth for 2022 and the **fifth for 2023, EIOPA-BOS-25-013**) and **`MSSubmissionsAggregatedReports.xlsx`** (a machine-readable aggregated member-state submission file). Also measured: the **"Supervisory reporting - DPM and XBRL" page (153.3KB)**, covering the supervisory-reporting **data point model and XBRL taxonomy**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "who the intermediaries are and whether they are licensed" layer** — the corpus **already holds many intermediary *firms*** ([[marsh]], [[howden]], [[miller-insurance]], [[pacific-prime]], [[insurance-broker]] and others), **but "who registers them and where they can be checked" was at zero**; **EIOPA’s register group brings intermediaries, undertakings, IORPs and PEPP registration into a single entry point**, **directly usable for cross-border compliance and intermediary due diligence**. **② ⭐ The IDD distributor-sanctions data is a rare public enforcement dataset** — **it quantifies misconduct in the distribution chain at a comparable level** (year, sanction type, share of registration withdrawals) **on a supranational consolidated basis**; this sits at a **different point in consumer protection** from [[fos-uk]] (UK dispute decisions), [[fscs-uk]], [[nolhga]] and [[assuris]] (protection mechanisms) — **that group is ex-post redress; this is ex-ante supervision plus ex-post penalties**. **③ ⭐ EIOPA states that sanction counts alone cannot establish supervisory effectiveness** — **a valuable methodological caution**: the corpus’s [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] and [[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]] aggregate regulatory postures, **whereas this entry supplies the regulator’s own official statement of its data’s limits**, **and that sentence should be cited alongside any use of the sanction figures**. **④ The "PEPP central register" and the "register of national laws" are two uncommon register forms** — **one is a central register for a cross-border personal pension product, the other registers national laws in one place** (the latter readable with [[aae]] on European actuarial practice standards and [[insurance-europe]]).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **two pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the register list, the IDD notification mechanism, the 2024 figures of 1,656 sanctions and 51% registration withdrawals, EIOPA’s own limitation statement, downloadable file names and five annual report titles**, **but opened no annual report body, downloaded no XLSX and opened none of the registers themselves**, so **the country breakdown, named firms, penalty amounts and register contents cannot be restated**; **② ⚠️ the dedicated register domain `register.eiopa.europa.eu` returned HTTP 403 (Forbidden) in this check — I could not access the register application itself**, **so this entry asserts only that EIOPA hosts these registers (from its own page text) and describes no register interface, search method or data field**; **③ the figures 1,656 and 51% come from measured page text**, and **their statistical basis (whether individuals are included, whether all national sanctions are covered) was not verified item by item**; **④ the zero count for the "intermediary register / regulation" form is a keyword-measurement result** (**the method is heuristic and its limitations are recorded in the round log**); **⑤ the DPM/XBRL page’s taxonomy version and scope were not verified**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim EIOPA provides actuarial tools or firm-level financial data**. **Verification note**: `/tools-and-data/registers-lists-and-databases_en` (97.1KB), `/tools-and-data/data-sanctions-imposed-insurance-distributors_en` (132.6KB) and `/tools-and-data/supervisory-reporting-dpm-and-xbrl_en` (153.3KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with body text read verbatim; `register.eiopa.europa.eu` measured **403** (not accessed); **no annual report, XLSX or register was opened**.

Hence, full conclusions regarding the effectiveness of the supervision of the rules by national authorities, cannot be drawn based only on the number of sanctions」**。**可下載檔案實測**：五期年報（首份、2020、2021、第四份 2022、**第五份 2023**）與 **`MSSubmissionsAggregatedReports.xlsx`**。另實測 **「Supervisory reporting - DPM and XBRL」頁 153.3KB**（**監管報送的數據點模型與 XBRL 分類標準**）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「中介是誰、是否持牌」這一層**——池內中介側**已有大量中介「公司」條目**（[[marsh]]、[[howden]]、[[miller-insurance]]、[[pacific-prime]]、[[insurance-broker]] 等），**但「這些中介由誰登記、在哪裡可查」此前為 0**。**② ⭐ 「IDD 分銷商處罰數據」是罕見的公開執法數據集**——**把分銷環節的不當行為量化到可比較層面**，**且是超國家合併口徑**；與池內 [[fos-uk]]、[[fscs-uk]]、[[nolhga]]、[[assuris]] **屬不同環節**——**那一組是「事後救濟」，這一條是「事前監管 + 事後處罰」**。**③ ⭐ EIOPA 自己寫明「不能只憑處罰數量判斷監管有效性」**——**引用處罰數據時應同時引用這一句**。**④ 「PEPP 中央登記冊」與「各國法律登記冊」是兩種少見的登記形態**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**兩頁的存在、標題、體量、登記冊清單、IDD 通報機制、2024 年 1,656 起與撤銷註冊 51%、EIOPA 自述局限、可下載檔名與年報標題**，**但未打開任何年報正文、未下載 XLSX、未打開任何登記冊本身**，故**不能轉述分國分佈、機構名稱、處罰金額或登記冊內容**；**② ⚠️ 專用登記冊域名 `register.eiopa.europa.eu` 本次實測返回 HTTP 403（Forbidden），即「登記冊應用本體」未能訪問**，**故本詞條只主張「EIOPA 託管這些登記冊」這一事實，不描述任何登記冊的界面、檢索方式或數據欄位**；**③ 1,656 與 51% 來自頁面正文實測**，**其統計口徑未逐項核實**；**④ 「中介登記」形態為 0 屬關鍵詞測量結論**（**方法為啟發式，局限已記錄於輪次日誌**）；**⑤ DPM/XBRL 的分類標準版本與適用範圍未核實**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張** EIOPA 提供精算工具或公司級財務數據**。**核實說明**：三頁均 HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取正文；`register.eiopa.europa.eu` 實測 **403**（未訪問）；**未打開年報、未下載 XLSX、未打開登記冊**。

entries.body:
**WFII（World Federation of Insurance Intermediaries，世界保险中介人联盟）** 是**全球保险中介业的伞状组织**，站点实测地址为 **Avenue Albert-Elisabeth 40, 1200 Bruxelles, Belgium（布鲁塞尔）**。本条目补的是**「中介业的全球行业组织」这一形态**：**池内中介侧此前是「一家家中介公司」与「辖区监管」，缺「全球中介业自身的组织与立场」这一层**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页标题实测 **「Home | World Federation of Insurance Intermediaries (WFII)」**；⭐ **「Members（成员）」页 `/members` 实测 447.0KB（本站体量最大的页面）**；⭐ **「Key issues and positions（核心议题与立场）」页 `/key-issues` 实测 445.6KB，标题「Key issues and positions」**；⭐ **「Insurance Intermediaries（保险中介）」页 `/insurance-intermediaries` 实测 422.9KB**；⭐ **「Who are they?（他们是谁？）」页 `/who-are-they` 实测 397.7KB**；⭐ **「Captives（专属保险公司）」页 `/captives` 实测 393.8KB**；**「Structure（结构）」页 `/structure` 实测 404.2KB**；**「About」页 `/about` 实测 389.1KB**。**导航逐字实测揭示的内容分组**：**Key issues and positions** 下含 **Regulation（监管）**、**Liberalisation（自由化）**、**Multinational placements（跨国投保）**、**Remuneration（报酬）**、**Transparency（透明度）**、**Education（教育）**、**Microinsurance（微型保险）**；**Insurance Intermediaries** 下含 **Who are they?**、**Their role（其角色）**、**In practice（实务中）**、**Risk management（风险管理）**、**Captives**；另有 **Objectives**、**Working principles**、**Links**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「中介业的全球组织」这一层**——池内**中介「公司」**（[[marsh]]、[[howden]]、[[miller-insurance]]、[[pacific-prime]]、[[guy-carpenter]] 等）与**辖区监管**（[[eiopa-registers]]、[[fca-open-data]]、[[hk-ia-statistics]]）都已有人覆盖，**但「中介业自己如何组织、如何对外表态」此前没有**；**这与 [[aae]]（精算职业的欧洲伞状组织）、[[insurance-europe]]（保险业的欧洲伞状组织）构成三层行业组织的对照**——**一个代表中介、一个代表精算师、一个代表保险公司**。**② ⭐ 「Insurance Intermediaries: Who are they? / Their role / In practice」是一套现成的从业解释材料**——**对刚入行或转行的学生，这是把「中介到底做什么」讲清楚的一组页面**（**注意：本次只核实了页面存在与体量，未打开正文，故不转述其具体论述**）；可与池内 [[insurance-broker]]（中介岗位）、[[mga-actuarial-survey]]（MGA 形态）并读。**③ ⭐ 「Captives（专属保险公司）」是一个此前池内没有的形态**——**专属保险公司是企业为自保而设的保险公司**，**与商业保险、再保险并列为第三种风险融资方式**；**WFII 把它放在中介议题下讲解**，**这一点本身反映了一个制度事实：专属保险的设立与运行高度依赖中介与顾问服务**。**④ 议题清单是「中介业与监管的摩擦面」的现成列表**——**报酬（Remuneration）、透明度（Transparency）、跨国投保（Multinational placements）** 三项都是中介监管中最常引发争议的题目；**对做保险分销监管比较的学生，这份议题清单可直接当作分析框架的起点**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与六个功能页的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航逐字实测出的议题与内容分组**，**但未打开任何一页的正文内容**（**上述「页面讲什么」均为依据标题与分组的合理描述，未转述具体论述**），因此**不能转述 WFII 对任何议题的具体立场、成员协会名单或其结构细节**；**② 站点为 Wix 建站（页脚实测含 ©2018 与「PRIVACY POLICY HERE」）**，**内容主要在子页面且 About 页正文本身很薄（实测仅有小标题列表）**——**这一点已在词条中体现（标题与摘要依据功能页而非 About 页）**；**③ 我猜测的 `/key-issues-and-positions` 路径实测 404**（**真实路径为 `/key-issues`**）——**又一次「不要猜路径、从导航反查」**；**④ 成员协会的具体数量与构成本次未核实**（**`/members` 页体量 447.0KB 为实测值，但其中多少是名单、多少是页面框架未区分**）；**⑤ WFII 的法定地位（是否为行业自律组织）、其与各国中介协会的关系本次未核实**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张** WFII 提供数据下载、统计或精算工具。**核实说明**：首页（200）、`/about`（389.1KB）、`/members`（447.0KB）、`/key-issues`（445.6KB）、`/insurance-intermediaries`（422.9KB）、`/who-are-they`（397.7KB）、`/captives`（393.8KB）、`/structure`（404.2KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取导航分组；**未打开任何页面正文**；`/key-issues-and-positions` 实测 404（猜错路径）。
entries.body_en:
**WFII (the World Federation of Insurance Intermediaries)** is **the global umbrella body of the insurance intermediary industry**, with a measured site address of **Avenue Albert-Elisabeth 40, 1200 Bruxelles, Belgium**. This entry adds the **"global trade body of the intermediary industry"** form: the corpus’s intermediary side previously held **individual intermediary firms and jurisdictional supervision, but no layer for how the intermediary industry organises and positions itself globally**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage title reads **"Home | World Federation of Insurance Intermediaries (WFII)"**; ⭐ the **"Members" page `/members` measures 447.0KB (the largest page on the site)**; ⭐ the **"Key issues and positions" page `/key-issues` measures 445.6KB with the title "Key issues and positions"**; ⭐ the **"Insurance Intermediaries" page `/insurance-intermediaries` measures 422.9KB**; ⭐ the **"Who are they?" page `/who-are-they` measures 397.7KB**; ⭐ the **"Captives" page `/captives` measures 393.8KB**; the **"Structure" page `/structure` measures 404.2KB**; the **"About" page measures 389.1KB**. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the content groupings**: under **Key issues and positions** — **Regulation**, **Liberalisation**, **Multinational placements**, **Remuneration**, **Transparency**, **Education** and **Microinsurance**; under **Insurance Intermediaries** — **Who are they?**, **Their role**, **In practice**, **Risk management** and **Captives**; plus **Objectives**, **Working principles** and **Links**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "global organisation of the intermediary industry"** — the corpus already covers **intermediary firms** ([[marsh]], [[howden]], [[miller-insurance]], [[pacific-prime]], [[guy-carpenter]] and others) and **jurisdictional supervision** ([[eiopa-registers]], [[fca-open-data]], [[hk-ia-statistics]]), **but "how the intermediary industry organises itself and what it says publicly" was absent**; this contrasts with [[aae]] (the European umbrella for the actuarial profession) and [[insurance-europe]] (the European umbrella for insurers) — **one representing intermediaries, one actuaries, one insurers**. **② ⭐ "Insurance Intermediaries: Who are they? / Their role / In practice" is a ready-made explaining set** — **for students entering or transitioning into the field, this is a group of pages that sets out what intermediaries actually do** (**note: this check confirmed only page existence and size, opened no body text, and so restates no specific argument**); readable with [[insurance-broker]] (the job) and [[mga-actuarial-survey]] (the MGA form). **③ ⭐ "Captives" is a form the corpus did not have** — **a captive is an insurer a company sets up to insure itself**, **standing alongside commercial insurance and reinsurance as a third way of financing risk**; **WFII places it under intermediary topics**, **which itself reflects an institutional fact: setting up and running a captive depends heavily on intermediary and advisory services**. **④ The topics list is a ready inventory of the friction points between intermediaries and regulators** — **Remuneration, Transparency and Multinational placements** are among the most contested subjects in intermediary regulation; **for comparative work on insurance distribution regulation, this list can serve directly as a starting analytical frame**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and page sizes of the homepage and six functional pages, plus the topic and content groupings read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no page body** (**so "what the page discusses" above is a reasonable description from titles and groupings, with no specific argument restated**), and therefore **WFII’s positions on any topic, its member-association list and its structural details cannot be restated**; **② the site is built on Wix (the footer measurably carries ©2018 and "PRIVACY POLICY HERE")**, and **content sits in subpages with the About page body itself thin (measurably only a list of subheadings)** — **reflected in this entry by resting its title and summary on the functional pages rather than About**; **③ my guessed path `/key-issues-and-positions` measured 404** (**the real path is `/key-issues`**) — **another "do not guess paths; read the navigation"**; **④ the number and composition of member associations were not verified** (**the 447.0KB `/members` page size is measured, but content versus page frame was not distinguished**); **⑤ WFII’s legal status (whether it is a self-regulatory body) and its relationship with national intermediary associations were not verified**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim WFII provides data downloads, statistics or actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (200), `/about` (389.1KB), `/members` (447.0KB), `/key-issues` (445.6KB), `/insurance-intermediaries` (422.9KB), `/who-are-they` (397.7KB), `/captives` (393.8KB) and `/structure` (404.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with navigation groupings read verbatim; **no page body was opened**; `/key-issues-and-positions` measured 404 (guessed path).

**WFII（World Federation of Insurance Intermediaries，世界保險中介人聯盟）** 是**全球保險中介業的傘狀組織**，站點實測地址為 **Avenue Albert-Elisabeth 40, 1200 Bruxelles, Belgium（布魯塞爾）**。本條目補的是**「中介業的全球行業組織」這一形態**：**池內中介側此前是「一家家中介公司」與「轄區監管」，缺「全球中介業自身的組織與立場」**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁標題實測 **「Home | World Federation of Insurance Intermediaries (WFII)」**；⭐ **「Members」頁 447.0KB（本站體量最大）**；⭐ **「Key issues and positions」頁 445.6KB**；⭐ **「Insurance Intermediaries」頁 422.9KB**；⭐ **「Who are they?」頁 397.7KB**；⭐ **「Captives」頁 393.8KB**；**「Structure」頁 404.2KB**；**「About」頁 389.1KB**。**導航逐字實測分組**：**Key issues and positions** 含 **Regulation／Liberalisation／Multinational placements／Remuneration／Transparency／Education／Microinsurance**；**Insurance Intermediaries** 含 **Who are they?／Their role／In practice／Risk management／Captives**；另有 **Objectives／Working principles／Links**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「中介業的全球組織」這一層**——池內**中介「公司」**與**轄區監管**都已有人覆蓋，**但「中介業自己如何組織、如何對外表態」此前沒有**；與 [[aae]]（精算職業的歐洲傘狀組織）、[[insurance-europe]]（保險業的歐洲傘狀組織）構成**三層行業組織對照**。**② ⭐ 「Who are they? / Their role / In practice」是現成的從業解釋材料**（**本次僅核實頁面存在與體量，未打開正文，故不轉述其具體論述**）；可與 [[insurance-broker]]、[[mga-actuarial-survey]] 並讀。**③ ⭐ 「Captives（專屬保險公司）」是此前池內沒有的形態**——**企業為自保而設的保險公司**，**與商業保險、再保險並列為第三種風險融資方式**；**WFII 把它放在中介議題下，反映「專屬保險的設立與運行高度依賴中介與顧問服務」這一制度事實**。**④ 議題清單是「中介業與監管摩擦面」的現成列表**——**報酬、透明度、跨國投保**三項都是中介監管中最常引發爭議的題目。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與六個功能頁的存在、標題、體量、以及導航逐字實測的分組**，**但未打開任何一頁正文**（**上述「頁面講什麼」均為依據標題與分組的合理描述，未轉述具體論述**），故**不能轉述 WFII 對任何議題的具體立場、成員協會名單或結構細節**；**② 站點為 Wix 建站（頁腳實測含 ©2018）**，**About 頁正文本身很薄**——**故本條目標題與摘要依據功能頁**；**③ 我猜測的 `/key-issues-and-positions` 實測 404**（**真實路徑為 `/key-issues`**）；**④ 成員協會的數量與構成未核實**；**⑤ 其法定地位、與各國中介協會的關係未核實**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張** WFII 提供數據下載、統計或精算工具**。**核實說明**：八個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取導航分組；**未打開任何頁面正文**。

entries.body:
**LIMRA** 是**美国寿险与金融服务业的研究协会**（站点标题实测 **「LIMRA - Navigate With Confidence」**）。本条目补的是**「分销渠道与销售研究」这一形态**：**实测池内该形态为 0**——**池内已有的大量保险数据是「监管统计」与「理赔/定价数据」，缺「保险产品怎么卖出去、卖给谁、通过什么渠道」这一层的行业研究**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 200，标题实测 **「LIMRA - Navigate With Confidence」**；⭐ **「Research（研究）」页 `/en/research/` 实测 141.1KB，标题「Research」**，正文实测写明 **「Delivering Relevant Insights in an Ever-Evolving Landscape」** 与 **「We offer member benefits research covering key industry topics a[nd]…」**；**首页实测可见四类受众分组**：**MEMBERS**、**FINANCIAL PROFESSIONALS**、**CONSUMERS**、**LEARNERS**；⭐ **实测设有 `AML/Compliance Training`（反洗钱与合规培训）**；⭐ **站点实测提供六种语言切换**：**English / español / 한국어 / 日本語 / 中文(简体) / 中文(繁體)**；**实测另有 Topics 栏目与「Create Account / Log In」入口**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「分销与销售」这一研究层**——池内寿险侧**极密于死亡率、长寿风险、准备金与定价**，**但「寿险如何分销（专属代理、独立代理、银保、直销、职场渠道）」这一层的行业研究此前没有**；**对想做产品与渠道方向的学生，这是与精算口径互补的一层**（可与池内大量中介公司条目 [[marsh]]、[[howden]]、[[pacific-prime]]、[[insurance-broker]] 并读——**那些是渠道参与者，这一条是渠道研究**）。**② ⭐ 与 [[loma]] 的关系需要留意**——**本次实测在 LIMRA 站点上读到维护通知里提到 `LOMA.org`**，说明 **LIMRA 与 LOMA 关系密切**；**池内已有 [[loma]]，故本词条只主张 LIMRA 自身的内容，不主张两者的组织关系**（**这一点在下面如实标注**）。**③ 「四类受众」的设计本身值得注意**——**同一机构把研究分别对接会员、从业者、消费者与学习者**，**这种分层输出对做「知识产品设计」的学生是一个具体样本**；⭐ **其中 CONSUMERS 一档尤其少见**——**多数行业协会只服务会员，LIMRA 直接面向消费者**。**④ 六语站点（含简繁中文与韩日文）说明其受众跨语言**——**对本站的三语读者，这是一个可预期的可用性信号**（**但本次未核实中文页面的内容深度**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与 Research 页的存在、标题、页面体量、四类受众分组、AML/合规培训与六语切换**，**但未打开任何研究报告、未查看任何数据产品、未打开任何培训课程内容**，因此**不能转述任何销售数据、渠道占比、保费规模或研究结论**；**② ⭐ 多数研究内容很可能仅对会员开放**——**首页实测有「Create Account / Log In」入口，而本次未登录，故未核实免费可见的内容范围**（**本词条因此不主张其研究可公开获取**）；**③ ⭐ LIMRA 与 [[loma]] 的关系本次仅为「在 LIMRA 站点上读到提及 LOMA.org 的维护通知」这一间接证据，未打开任何说明两者关系的页面，故本词条不主张其组织关系**；**④ LIMRA 的会员构成、成立年份与治理结构本次未核实**；**⑤ 「分销渠道」这一形态为 0 是关键词测量的结论**（**方法为启发式，局限已记录于轮次日志**）；**⑥** 本词条**不主张** LIMRA 提供精算工具、建模软件或逐单数据。**核实说明**：首页（200，标题「LIMRA - Navigate With Confidence」）与 `/en/research/`（141.1KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取正文片段与受众分组；**未打开研究报告、数据产品或培训课程**；**未登录，故未核实免费内容范围**。
entries.body_en:
**LIMRA** is **a research association for the US life insurance and financial services industry** (its measured site title is **"LIMRA - Navigate With Confidence"**). This entry adds the **"distribution channel and sales research"** form: **that form measured zero** — the corpus’s abundant insurance data is **regulatory statistics and claims or pricing data, with no layer for how insurance products are sold, to whom, and through which channels**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage returns 200 with the measured title **"LIMRA - Navigate With Confidence"**; ⭐ the **"Research" page `/en/research/` measures 141.1KB with the title "Research"**, stating verbatim **"Delivering Relevant Insights in an Ever-Evolving Landscape"** and **"We offer member benefits research covering key industry topics a[nd]…"**; **the homepage measurably shows four audience groupings**: **MEMBERS**, **FINANCIAL PROFESSIONALS**, **CONSUMERS** and **LEARNERS**; ⭐ **measurably present is `AML/Compliance Training`**; ⭐ **the site measurably offers six language options**: **English, español, 한국어, 日本語, 中文(简体), 中文(繁體)**; there are also measured **Topics** sections and **Create Account / Log In** entry points.

For RIAA: **① it adds a distribution and sales research layer** — the corpus’s life insurance side is **very dense on mortality, longevity risk, reserving and pricing**, **but industry research on how life products are distributed (captive agents, independent agents, bancassurance, direct, worksite) was absent**; **for students leaning towards product and channel work this is a layer complementary to the actuarial one** (readable with the many intermediary firms in the corpus — [[marsh]], [[howden]], [[pacific-prime]], [[insurance-broker]] — **those are channel participants; this is channel research**). **② ⭐ The relationship with [[loma]] deserves care** — **this check read a maintenance notice mentioning `LOMA.org` on the LIMRA site**, indicating **LIMRA and LOMA are closely related**; **since [[loma]] is already in the corpus, this entry asserts only LIMRA’s own content and makes no claim about the organisational relationship** (**flagged below**). **③ The four-audience design is itself notable** — **one body addressing members, practitioners, consumers and learners separately**, **a concrete sample for work on knowledge-product design**; ⭐ **the CONSUMERS tier is especially uncommon** — **most trade bodies serve members only, while LIMRA addresses consumers directly**. **④ The six-language site (including simplified and traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese) indicates a cross-language audience** — **a usability signal for this wiki’s trilingual readers** (**though the depth of the Chinese pages was not verified**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and sizes of the homepage and Research page, the four audience groupings, the AML/compliance training and the six language options**, **but opened no research report, viewed no data product and opened no training course**, so **no sales figure, channel share, premium volume or research conclusion can be restated**; **② ⭐ most research content is likely member-only** — **the homepage measurably carries a "Create Account / Log In" entry point and this check did not log in, so the extent of freely visible content was not verified** (**this entry therefore does not claim the research is publicly accessible**); **③ ⭐ the LIMRA-LOMA relationship rests only on this indirect evidence (a maintenance notice mentioning LOMA.org read on the LIMRA site); no page explaining the relationship was opened, so no organisational relationship is asserted**; **④ LIMRA’s membership, founding year and governance were not verified**; **⑤ the zero count for the "distribution channel" form is a keyword-measurement result** (**the method is heuristic; limitations are recorded in the round log**); **⑥** this entry **does not claim LIMRA provides actuarial tools, modelling software or policy-level data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (200, title "LIMRA - Navigate With Confidence") and `/en/research/` (141.1KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with body fragments and audience groupings read; **no research report, data product or training course was opened**; **no login was performed, so free-content scope was not verified**.
entries.body_hk:
**LIMRA** 是**美國壽險與金融服務業的研究協會**（標題實測 **「LIMRA - Navigate With Confidence」**）。本條目補的是**「分銷渠道與銷售研究」這一形態**：**實測該形態為 0**——**池內大量保險數據是「監管統計」與「理賠／定價數據」，缺「保險產品怎麼賣、賣給誰、通過什麼渠道」這一層的行業研究**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁標題實測 **「LIMRA - Navigate With Confidence」**；⭐ **「Research」頁 141.1KB**，正文實測含 **「Delivering Relevant Insights in an Ever-Evolving Landscape」** 與 **「We offer member benefits research covering key industry topics…」**；**首頁實測四類受眾**：**MEMBERS／FINANCIAL PROFESSIONALS／CONSUMERS／LEARNERS**；⭐ **實測設有 `AML/Compliance Training`**；⭐ **實測提供六種語言**：**English／español／한국어／日本語／中文(简体)／中文(繁體)**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「分銷與銷售」這一研究層**——池內壽險側**極密於死亡率、長壽風險、準備金與定價**，**但「壽險如何分銷」這一層此前沒有**（可與中介公司條目 [[marsh]]、[[howden]]、[[insurance-broker]] 並讀——**那些是渠道參與者，這一條是渠道研究**）。**② ⭐ 與 [[loma]] 的關係需要留意**——**本次在 LIMRA 站點讀到維護通知提及 `LOMA.org`**，**但池內已有 [[loma]]，故本詞條只主張 LIMRA 自身內容，不主張兩者組織關係**。**③ 「四類受眾」設計本身值得注意**——⭐ **其中 CONSUMERS 一檔尤其少見**（**多數行業協會只服務會員**）。**④ 六語站點（含簡繁中文與韓日文）說明受眾跨語言**（**但未核實中文頁面深度**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與 Research 頁的存在、標題、體量、四類受眾、AML 培訓與六語切換**，**但未打開任何研究報告、未查看任何數據產品、未打開任何培訓課程**，故**不能轉述任何銷售數據、渠道佔比、保費規模或研究結論**；**② ⭐ 多數研究內容很可能僅對會員開放**——**首頁實測有「Create Account / Log In」入口，本次未登入，未核實免費可見範圍**（**故不主張其研究可公開獲取**）；**③ ⭐ LIMRA 與 [[loma]] 的關係本次僅為「讀到提及 LOMA.org 的維護通知」這一間接證據，未打開任何說明關係的頁面，故不主張其組織關係**；**④ 會員構成、成立年份與治理結構未核實**；**⑤ 「分銷渠道」形態為 0 屬關鍵詞測量結論**（**方法為啟發式**）；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張** LIMRA 提供精算工具、建模軟件或逐單數據**。**核實說明**：首頁與 `/en/research/`（141.1KB）HTTP 200 實測；**未打開研究報告、數據產品或培訓課程；未登入**。

entries.title: MPFA 中介人规管与执法：强积金中介人的规管、执法统计与常见不当行为罚则
entries.title_en: MPFA intermediary regulation and enforcement: supervision of MPF intermediaries, enforcement statistics, and penalties for common improper conduct
entries.title_hk: MPFA 中介人規管與執法：強積金中介人的規管、執法統計與常見不當行為罰則
entries.summary: 香港积金局对强积金中介人的规管与执法栏目：发布执法统计、常见不当行为与罚则、执法提示，并覆盖中介人与受托人两侧；站点提供英文、繁体与简体中文
entries.summary_en: The MPFA’s supervision and enforcement sections for MPF intermediaries: it publishes enforcement statistics, common improper conduct and penalties, and enforcement alerts, covering both intermediaries and trustees, with the site available in English, traditional and simplified Chinese
entries.summary_hk: 香港積金局對強積金中介人的規管與執法欄目：發布執法統計、常見不當行為與罰則、執法提示，並覆蓋中介人與受託人兩側；站點提供英文、繁體與簡體中文
entries.body:
**MPFA（Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority，香港强积金计划管理局／积金局）** 的中介人规管与执法栏目——本条目补的是**「中介人执法与处罚公开」这一形态**：**实测「中介登记/中介监管」形态为 0**，而**本条目给的是该形态中「处罚与不当行为」这一侧**（同轮 [[eiopa-registers]] 给的是**超国家层的登记册与合并处罚数据**）。

⭐ **与池内已有条目的分工（本词条特别写明）**：池内已有 **[[mpfa]]（积金局本身）**、**[[mpf-fund-platform]]（积金局基金平台，属基金与收费数据）**、**[[mpfe]]（强积金考试）** 与 **[[peak-exam-centre]]（IIQE / MPFE 官方考点）**——**即「机构」「基金数据」「考试」三块都已有人覆盖**；**本条目补的是此前完全没有的「对中介人的规管与执法」**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「Regulation（规管）」页 `/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries` 实测 94.2KB，标题实测「Regulation - MPFA」**；⭐ **「Enforcement Statistics（执法统计）」页 `/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics` 实测 98.6KB，标题实测「Enforcement Statistics - MPFA」**；⭐ **「Common Improper Conduct and Penalties（常见不当行为与罚则）」页 `/en/enforcement/mpf-intermediary/common-offences-and-penalties` 实测 89.9KB，标题实测「Common Improper Conduct and Penalties - MPFA」**；**导航逐字实测揭示的执法栏目结构**：**Enforcement** 下含 **Overview**、**MPF Intermediaries**、**MPF Trustees**、**ORSO Employers and Administrators**、**Employers**、**Scheme Members**、**Self-employed Persons**、**Plan Members**、**Enforcement Statistics**、**Beware of Scams**、**Enforcement Alerts**；**Regulation** 下含 **MPF Trustees** 与 **MPF Intermediaries**；另有 **Approved Supplier Lists（认可供应商名单）**、**Glossary（词汇表）**、**Useful Tools**、**eMPF Platform** 与 **eMPF Platform Oversight**；⭐ **站点实测提供 EN / 繁 / 简 三种语言**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「强积金中介人」这一香港本地的持牌与执法环节**——**MPF 中介人是强积金销售与顾问环节的持牌主体**，**而池内此前只有考试与基金数据**；**对在香港求职或做合规方向的学生，这是了解「谁可以卖强积金、违规会怎样」的官方入口**（可与 [[insurance-broker]]、[[marsh]]、[[howden]] 等中介条目并读——**那些是保险中介，这一条是退休金中介**，**两个牌照体系不同**）。**② ⭐ 「常见不当行为与罚则」是本轮少见的「官方列明的违规清单」**——**监管者把「哪些行为算不当、对应什么罚则」直接写成一页**，**这与 [[eiopa-registers]] 的「撤销注册占 51%」形成两种公开口径**：**一个是汇总统计、一个是行为清单**；**对做合规与消费者保护的学生，两者互补**（可与 [[hk-icb]] 的投诉个案、[[fos-uk]] 的争议裁决并读——**投诉、裁决、处罚是消费者保护链条上的三个不同环节**）。**③ 「执法提示（Enforcement Alerts）」与「提防骗案（Beware of Scams）」是两个少见的栏目**——**监管者主动发布风险提示**，**对做投资者/保单持有人教育的学生是现成素材**。**④ 执法对象覆盖中介人、受托人、ORSO 雇主与计划成员多侧**——**这一点值得注意：同一执法栏目按「被规管主体类型」组织**，**而不只是按「违规类型」组织**，**是一种以主体为中心的信息架构**。**⑤ 站点为 EN / 繁 / 简 三语**——**对本站三语读者是直接的可用性优势**（**但本次仅核实语言切换存在，未核实简繁版本的内容完整度是否与英文一致**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**三个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航逐字实测的执法与规管栏目结构、语言切换**，**但未打开执法统计的具体数字、未打开常见不当行为与罚则的具体条目、未打开任何执法提示或骗案警示内容**，因此**不能转述任何执法案件数量、罚款金额、被处罚机构名称或具体罚则条文**；**② 我猜测的两条路径 `/en/enforcement/statistics` 与 `/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries/statistics` 均实测 404**（**真实路径为 `/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics`**）——**又一次「不要猜路径、从导航反查」**；**③ 「执法统计」页的具体统计维度、覆盖年份与更新频率本次未核实**；**④ 中介人登记册本身（可供公众查询持牌中介的检索入口）本次未定位到并核实**——**故本词条不主张提供一个可检索的中介人登记册**（**这一点与同轮 [[eiopa-registers]] 形成对照：那边的登记册我因 403 未访问，这边我未定位到**）；**⑤ 简繁中文版本与英文版本的内容是否一致本次未核实**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张** MPFA 提供精算工具或基金层面的投资数据（**后者见 [[mpf-fund-platform]]**）。**核实说明**：`/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries`（94.2KB）、`/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics`（98.6KB）、`/en/enforcement/mpf-intermediary/common-offences-and-penalties`（89.9KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取导航与标题；两条猜测路径实测 404；**未打开统计数字、罚则条目、执法提示或骗案警示的内容**。
entries.body_en:
The intermediary regulation and enforcement sections of the **MPFA (Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority, Hong Kong)** — this entry adds the **"public enforcement and penalties against intermediaries"** form: the **"intermediary register / intermediary regulation" form measured zero**, and **this entry supplies its "penalties and improper conduct" side** (while [[eiopa-registers]] in the same round supplies the **supranational registers and consolidated sanction data**).

⭐ **Division of labour with existing entries (stated explicitly here)**: the corpus already holds **[[mpfa]] (the authority itself)**, **[[mpf-fund-platform]] (its fund platform, covering funds and fees)**, **[[mpfe]] (the MPF examination)** and **[[peak-exam-centre]] (the official IIQE / MPFE test centre)** — **i.e. "the institution", "fund data" and "examinations" are all covered**; **this entry adds the previously absent "regulation of and enforcement against intermediaries"**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"Regulation" page `/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries` measures 94.2KB with the measured title "Regulation - MPFA"**; ⭐ the **"Enforcement Statistics" page `/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics` measures 98.6KB with the measured title "Enforcement Statistics - MPFA"**; ⭐ the **"Common Improper Conduct and Penalties" page measures 89.9KB with the measured title "Common Improper Conduct and Penalties - MPFA"**; **navigation read verbatim reveals the enforcement structure**: under **Enforcement** — **Overview**, **MPF Intermediaries**, **MPF Trustees**, **ORSO Employers and Administrators**, **Employers**, **Scheme Members**, **Self-employed Persons**, **Plan Members**, **Enforcement Statistics**, **Beware of Scams** and **Enforcement Alerts**; under **Regulation** — **MPF Trustees** and **MPF Intermediaries**; there are also **Approved Supplier Lists**, a **Glossary**, **Useful Tools**, the **eMPF Platform** and **eMPF Platform Oversight**; ⭐ **the site measurably offers EN / traditional Chinese / simplified Chinese**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the Hong Kong local licensing and enforcement link for MPF intermediaries** — **MPF intermediaries are the licensed parties in MPF sales and advice**, **and the corpus previously had only examinations and fund data**; **for students seeking work in Hong Kong or moving into compliance, this is the official entry point for understanding who may sell MPF and what happens on breach** (readable with intermediary entries such as [[insurance-broker]], [[marsh]] and [[howden]] — **those are insurance intermediaries, this is retirement-scheme intermediaries, and the two licensing regimes differ**). **② ⭐ "Common Improper Conduct and Penalties" is the rare "officially enumerated misconduct list"** — **the regulator sets out on one page which conduct counts as improper and what penalties attach**, **giving a second disclosure style alongside [[eiopa-registers]]’ "51% of sanctions were registration withdrawals"**: **one is aggregate statistics, the other a conduct list**, **and for compliance and consumer-protection work the two complement each other** (readable with [[hk-icb]]’s complaint cases and [[fos-uk]]’s dispute decisions — **complaints, decisions and penalties are three different links in the consumer-protection chain**). **③ "Enforcement Alerts" and "Beware of Scams" are two uncommon sections** — **a regulator proactively issuing risk warnings**, **ready material for work on investor and policyholder education**. **④ Enforcement covers intermediaries, trustees, ORSO employers and scheme members** — **notably, the enforcement section is organised by the type of regulated party as well as by type of breach**, **a subject-centred information architecture**. **⑤ The site is trilingual EN / traditional / simplified Chinese** — **a direct usability advantage for this wiki’s readers** (**though this check verified only that the language switch exists, not whether the Chinese content matches the English in completeness**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **three pages’ existence, titles and sizes, plus the enforcement and regulation structure and language switch read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no enforcement statistics figures, no individual misconduct or penalty item, and no enforcement alert or scam warning content**, so **no enforcement case count, fine amount, sanctioned firm name or specific penalty provision can be restated**; **② both paths I guessed — `/en/enforcement/statistics` and `/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries/statistics` — measured 404** (**the real path is `/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics`**) — **another "do not guess paths; read the navigation"**; **③ the enforcement statistics page’s dimensions, year coverage and update frequency were not verified**; **④ a searchable public register of licensed intermediaries was not located or verified in this check** — **so this entry does not claim to provide a searchable intermediary register** (**note the contrast with [[eiopa-registers]] in the same round: there the register app was unreachable due to 403; here none was located**); **⑤ whether the Chinese versions match the English in content was not verified**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim MPFA provides actuarial tools or fund-level investment data** (**the latter is covered by [[mpf-fund-platform]]**). **Verification note**: `/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries` (94.2KB), `/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics` (98.6KB) and `/en/enforcement/mpf-intermediary/common-offences-and-penalties` (89.9KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with navigation and titles read verbatim; two guessed paths measured 404; **no statistics figures, penalty items, enforcement alerts or scam warnings were opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**MPFA（Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority，香港強積金計劃管理局／積金局）** 的中介人規管與執法欄目——本條目補的是**「中介人執法與處罰公開」這一形態**：**實測「中介登記／中介監管」形態為 0**，而**本條目給的是該形態中「處罰與不當行為」這一側**（同輪 [[eiopa-registers]] 給的是**超國家層的登記冊與合併處罰數據**）。

⭐ **與池內已有條目的分工（本詞條特別寫明）**：池內已有 **[[mpfa]]（積金局本身）**、**[[mpf-fund-platform]]（基金平台）**、**[[mpfe]]（強積金考試）** 與 **[[peak-exam-centre]]（官方考點）**——**即「機構」「基金數據」「考試」三塊都已覆蓋**；**本條目補的是此前完全沒有的「對中介人的規管與執法」**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **「Regulation」頁 94.2KB，標題實測「Regulation - MPFA」**；⭐ **「Enforcement Statistics」頁 98.6KB，標題實測「Enforcement Statistics - MPFA」**；⭐ **「Common Improper Conduct and Penalties」頁 89.9KB，標題實測「Common Improper Conduct and Penalties - MPFA」**；**導航逐字實測**：**Enforcement** 下含 **Overview／MPF Intermediaries／MPF Trustees／ORSO Employers and Administrators／Employers／Scheme Members／Self-employed Persons／Plan Members／Enforcement Statistics／Beware of Scams／Enforcement Alerts**；**Regulation** 下含 **MPF Trustees／MPF Intermediaries**；另有 **Approved Supplier Lists／Glossary／Useful Tools／eMPF Platform**；⭐ **站點實測提供 EN／繁／簡 三語**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「強積金中介人」這一香港本地的持牌與執法環節**——**對在香港求職或做合規方向的學生，這是了解「誰可以賣強積金、違規會怎樣」的官方入口**（可與 [[insurance-broker]]、[[marsh]]、[[howden]] 並讀——**兩個牌照體系不同**）。**② ⭐ 「常見不當行為與罰則」是罕見的「官方列明的違規清單」**——**與 [[eiopa-registers]] 的「撤銷註冊佔 51%」形成兩種公開口徑**：**一個是匯總統計、一個是行為清單**；可與 [[hk-icb]] 的投訴個案、[[fos-uk]] 的爭議裁決並讀——**投訴、裁決、處罰是消費者保護鏈條上的三個不同環節**。**③ 「執法提示」與「提防騙案」是兩個少見的欄目**——**監管者主動發布風險提示**。**④ 執法對象覆蓋中介人、受託人、ORSO 僱主與計劃成員多側**——**是按「被規管主體類型」組織資訊架構**。**⑤ 站點為 EN／繁／簡 三語**（**但未核實簡繁版本與英文內容是否一致**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**三個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的欄目結構與語言切換**，**但未打開執法統計的具體數字、未打開常見不當行為與罰則的具體條目、未打開任何執法提示或騙案警示內容**，故**不能轉述任何執法案件數量、罰款金額、被處罰機構名稱或具體罰則條文**；**② 我猜測的兩條路徑 `/en/enforcement/statistics` 與 `/en/supervision/mpf-intermediaries/statistics` 均實測 404**（**真實路徑為 `/en/enforcement/enforcement-statistics`**）；**③ 「執法統計」頁的統計維度、覆蓋年份與更新頻率未核實**；**④ 可供公眾查詢持牌中介的登記冊檢索入口本次未定位到並核實**——**故不主張提供可檢索的中介人登記冊**（**與同輪 [[eiopa-registers]] 形成對照：那邊因 403 未訪問，這邊未定位到**）；**⑤ 簡繁版本與英文內容是否一致未核實**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張** MPFA 提供精算工具或基金層面投資數據（**後者見 [[mpf-fund-platform]]**）**。**核實說明**：三個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取導航與標題；兩條猜測路徑實測 404；**未打開統計數字、罰則條目、執法提示或騙案警示內容**。

entries.body:
**MIGA（Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency，多边投资担保机构）** 是**世界银行集团成员**，站点标题实测为 **「World Bank Group Guarantees | MIGA」**。本条目是**第 307、308 两轮明确记账后兑现的主条**，补的是**「政治风险与主权信用风险的实际承保方」这一形态**——**实测池内「政治风险」在标题与摘要层面为 0**（池内最接近的是 307 轮刚收的 [[berne-union]]，**但那是行业组织与统计，不是承保机构**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「All Guarantees（全部担保）」页 `/all-guarantees` 实测 109.2KB，标题「All Guarantees | World Bank Group Guarantees | MIGA」**；⭐ **「Non-honoring of Public Debt（不履行公共债务）」产品页 `/product/non-honoring-public-debt` 实测 93.3KB**；**「Annual Reports」页 `/annual-reports` 实测 89.0KB**；首页实测 106.2KB。**导航逐字实测揭示的完整产品分类**：**POLITICAL RISK GUARANTEES（政治风险担保）** 下含 **Breach of Contract（违约）**、**Currency Inconvertibility and Transfer Restriction（汇兑不可兑换与转移限制）**、**Capital Optimization（资本优化）**、⭐ **War and Civil Disturbances（战争与内乱）**、**Project-Based Loan Guarantees for Private Sector Borrowers**、**Project-Based Payment Guarantee for the Private Sector**；**TRADE FINANCE GUARANTEES（贸易融资担保）** 下含 **Letter of Credit Confirmation（信用证保兑）** 与 **Trade Loans**；**CREDIT GUARANTEES（信用担保）** 下含 ⭐ **Non-honoring of Public Debt（不履行公共债务）**、**Partial/Full Credit Guarantees for Loan**、**Partial Credit Guarantees for Bonds**、**Unfunded Risk Participation**、**Risk-Sharing Facility**、**Significant Risk Transfer**。**站点结构实测**另含 **About（含 Reports and Resources、History、MIGA Convention）**、**Partnerships（DFIs and MDBs、Trust Fund Facilities、Government Partnerships、Global Platforms & Initiatives、MIGA in Japan）**、**Accountability（Integrity、Annual Reports）**、**Projects** 与 **Get Coverage**；并实测存在**逐项担保项目页**（如 Almaty Railway Bypass、Al Ahli Bank Kuwait-Egypt Capital Optimization）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「主权与政治风险的实际承保方」**——池内此前**有主权风险池（[[seadrif]]）、有行业组织（[[berne-union]]）、有官方出口信用（同轮 [[credendo]]）**，**但「多边机构自己开出什么担保」这一层没有**；**MIGA 的产品清单本身就是一份政治风险产品的完整分类法**（**违约、汇兑限制、战争内乱属政治风险；不履行公共债务属主权信用；信用证保兑属贸易融资**）——**对做主权风险与跨境项目融资的学生，这是一个可直接引用的产品框架**。**② ⭐ 「资本优化（Capital Optimization）」与「重大风险转移（Significant Risk Transfer）」两个产品值得单独注意**——**这两类不是传统「保损失」，而是「帮银行释放资本」**；**与池内 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]] 的偿付能力资本口径并读，可以看出「保险与担保如何被用作资本工具」这一前沿用法**（**注意：本次只读到产品名，未打开产品条款正文**）。**③ 「担保项目库」是现成的项目级一手材料**——**实测存在逐项项目页**，**对做案例研究（哪个国家、哪个行业、什么风险被担保）是直接可用的**；可与 [[worldbank-data]] 的宏观数据、[[imf-data]] 并读——**一个给宏观、一个给项目级**。**④ 与 [[berne-union]] 的分工很清楚**：**伯尔尼联盟是「行业的统计与立场」，MIGA 是「自己承保并公布项目」**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**三个页面的存在、标题、体量、首页体量、导航逐字实测的完整产品分类、站点结构区块与项目页的存在**，**但未打开任何产品条款正文、任何项目页内容、任何年报或「Reports and Resources」的具体文件**，因此**不能转述承保金额、费率、免责条款、项目细节或任何担保业务量**；**② 「担保项目库」本次仅核实到项目页 URL 形态存在（在首页链接中出现）**，**未验证其是否可按国家/行业/风险类型检索**；**③ 产品分类的完整性（是否还有其他产品）本次未核实**——**所述分类来自导航逐字实测**；**④ 「资本优化」与「重大风险转移」的产品含义本次仅为依据产品名的推断，未打开任何说明**（**故词条内该处已写明为阅读提示**）；**⑤ MIGA 的资本规模、成员国数量与成立年份本次未核实**；**⑥ 站点有 `Get Coverage` 与 `Log In` 入口，本次未登录，故未核实非公开内容范围**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** MIGA 提供精算工具或模型**。**核实说明**：`/all-guarantees`（109.2KB）、`/product/non-honoring-public-debt`（93.3KB）、`/annual-reports`（89.0KB）与首页（106.2KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取导航；**未打开产品条款、项目页内容、年报或资源文件**。
entries.body_en:
**MIGA (the Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency)** is **a member of the World Bank Group**, with a measured site title of **"World Bank Group Guarantees | MIGA"**. After being explicitly put on the books in rounds 307 and 308, this entry is that commitment honoured, adding the **"actual underwriter of political and sovereign credit risk"** form — **the "political risk" form measured zero at title and summary level** (the closest item is [[berne-union]] from round 307, **but that is a trade body and its statistics, not an underwriter**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"All Guarantees" page `/all-guarantees` measures 109.2KB with the title "All Guarantees | World Bank Group Guarantees | MIGA"**; ⭐ the **"Non-honoring of Public Debt" product page measures 93.3KB**; the **"Annual Reports" page measures 89.0KB**; the homepage measures 106.2KB. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the complete product classification**: under **POLITICAL RISK GUARANTEES** — **Breach of Contract**, **Currency Inconvertibility and Transfer Restriction**, **Capital Optimization**, ⭐ **War and Civil Disturbances**, **Project-Based Loan Guarantees for Private Sector Borrowers** and **Project-Based Payment Guarantee for the Private Sector**; under **TRADE FINANCE GUARANTEES** — **Letter of Credit Confirmation** and **Trade Loans**; under **CREDIT GUARANTEES** — ⭐ **Non-honoring of Public Debt**, **Partial/Full Credit Guarantees for Loan**, **Partial Credit Guarantees for Bonds**, **Unfunded Risk Participation**, **Risk-Sharing Facility** and **Significant Risk Transfer**. **Measured site structure** also includes **About (with Reports and Resources, History, MIGA Convention)**, **Partnerships (DFIs and MDBs, Trust Fund Facilities, Government Partnerships, Global Platforms & Initiatives, MIGA in Japan)**, **Accountability (Integrity, Annual Reports)**, **Projects** and **Get Coverage**; **individual guarantee project pages** measurably exist (such as Almaty Railway Bypass and Al Ahli Bank Kuwait-Egypt Capital Optimization).

For RIAA: **① it adds the actual underwriter of sovereign and political risk** — the corpus previously had **sovereign risk pools ([[seadrif]]), a trade body ([[berne-union]]) and official export credit ([[credendo]] in the same round)**, **but no layer for what a multilateral institution itself guarantees**; **MIGA’s product list is itself a complete taxonomy of political risk products** (**breach of contract, currency restriction and war/civil disturbance are political risk; non-honoring of public debt is sovereign credit; letter of credit confirmation is trade finance**) — **a directly citable product framework for students working on sovereign risk and cross-border project finance**. **② ⭐ "Capital Optimization" and "Significant Risk Transfer" deserve separate note** — **these two are not traditional "insure the loss" products but instruments that free up a bank’s capital**; **read with the solvency-capital material in [[insurance-scr-data]], [[ggsolvencyii]] and [[sii-equity-risk-scr]], they show how insurance and guarantees are used as capital tools** (**note: this check read only product names, not product terms**). **③ The guarantee/project database is ready-made project-level primary material** — **individual project pages measurably exist**, **directly usable for case studies (which country, which sector, what risk was guaranteed)**; readable with the macro data of [[worldbank-data]] and [[imf-data]] — **one provides macro, the other project level**. **④ The division of labour with [[berne-union]] is clear**: **the Berne Union is the industry’s statistics and positions; MIGA underwrites itself and publishes the projects**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **three pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the homepage size, the complete product classification read verbatim from navigation, the site structure blocks, and the existence of project pages**, **but opened no product terms, no project page content, no annual report and no specific file in "Reports and Resources"**, so **no guaranteed amount, premium rate, exclusion clause, project detail or business volume can be restated**; **② the "guarantee database" was verified only as the existence of project-page URL forms (appearing among homepage links)**, **not whether it is searchable by country, sector or risk type**; **③ the completeness of the product classification was not verified** — **the classification given comes from navigation read verbatim**; **④ the meaning of "Capital Optimization" and "Significant Risk Transfer" is inferred from the product names, with no description opened** (**so that passage in the entry is flagged as a reading prompt**); **⑤ MIGA’s capital size, member country count and founding year were not verified**; **⑥ the site has `Get Coverage` and `Log In` entry points and this check did not log in, so non-public content was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim MIGA provides actuarial tools or models**. **Verification note**: `/all-guarantees` (109.2KB), `/product/non-honoring-public-debt` (93.3KB), `/annual-reports` (89.0KB) and the homepage (106.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with navigation read verbatim; **no product terms, project page content, annual report or resource file was opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**MIGA（Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency，多邊投資擔保機構）** 是**世界銀行集團成員**，站點標題實測 **「World Bank Group Guarantees | MIGA」**。本條目是**第 307、308 兩輪明確記賬後兌現的主條**，補的是**「政治風險與主權信用風險的實際承保方」這一形態**——**實測池內「政治風險」在標題與摘要層面為 0**（最接近的是 307 輪剛收的 [[berne-union]]，**但那是行業組織與統計，不是承保機構**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **「All Guarantees」頁 109.2KB**；⭐ **「Non-honoring of Public Debt」產品頁 93.3KB**；**「Annual Reports」頁 89.0KB**；首頁 106.2KB。**導航逐字實測的完整產品分類**：**POLITICAL RISK GUARANTEES** 下含 **Breach of Contract／Currency Inconvertibility and Transfer Restriction／Capital Optimization／⭐War and Civil Disturbances／Project-Based Loan Guarantees for Private Sector Borrowers／Project-Based Payment Guarantee for the Private Sector**；**TRADE FINANCE GUARANTEES** 下含 **Letter of Credit Confirmation／Trade Loans**；**CREDIT GUARANTEES** 下含 ⭐**Non-honoring of Public Debt／Partial-Full Credit Guarantees for Loan／Partial Credit Guarantees for Bonds／Unfunded Risk Participation／Risk-Sharing Facility／Significant Risk Transfer**。站點結構另含 **About（含 Reports and Resources、History、MIGA Convention）／Partnerships（DFIs and MDBs、Trust Fund Facilities、Government Partnerships、Global Platforms & Initiatives）／Accountability（Integrity、Annual Reports）／Projects／Get Coverage**；並實測存在**逐項擔保項目頁**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「主權與政治風險的實際承保方」**——池內此前**有主權風險池（[[seadrif]]）、有行業組織（[[berne-union]]）、有官方出口信用（同輪 [[credendo]]）**，**但「多邊機構自己開出什麼擔保」這一層沒有**；**MIGA 的產品清單本身就是一份政治風險產品的完整分類法**（**違約、匯兌限制、戰爭內亂屬政治風險；不履行公共債務屬主權信用；信用證保兌屬貿易融資**）。**② ⭐ 「資本優化」與「重大風險轉移」兩個產品值得單獨注意**——**這兩類不是傳統「保損失」，而是「幫銀行釋放資本」**；可與池內 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]] 並讀（**注意：本次只讀到產品名，未打開產品條款**）。**③ 「擔保項目庫」是現成的項目級一手材料**；可與 [[worldbank-data]]、[[imf-data]] 並讀——**一個給宏觀、一個給項目級**。**④ 與 [[berne-union]] 的分工很清楚**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**三個頁面的存在、標題、體量、首頁體量、導航逐字實測的完整產品分類、站點結構區塊與項目頁的存在**，**但未打開任何產品條款正文、任何項目頁內容、任何年報或資源文件**，故**不能轉述承保金額、費率、免責條款、項目細節或業務量**；**② 擔保項目庫本次僅核實到項目頁 URL 形態存在**，**未驗證其是否可按國家／行業／風險類型檢索**；**③ 產品分類完整性未核實**；**④ 「資本優化」與「重大風險轉移」的產品含義僅為依據產品名的推斷，未打開任何說明**（**詞條內已寫明為閱讀提示**）；**⑤ 資本規模、成員國數量與成立年份未核實**；**⑥ 有 `Get Coverage` 與 `Log In` 入口，本次未登入**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** MIGA 提供精算工具或模型**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取導航；**未打開產品條款、項目頁內容、年報或資源文件**。

entries.title: CCRIF SPC（加勒比巨灾风险保险基金）：主权参数化风险池、赔付记录与国别风险档案
