entries.body:
**CCRIF SPC** 是**加勒比地区的主权参数化巨灾风险池**（站点标题实测 **「CCRIF SPC」**）——**其成员是加勒比各国政府，出险后按参数触发、快速赔付**。本条目与池内已有的 [[seadrif]]（东南亚灾害风险保险基金）**同属「主权参数化风险池」这一形态**；**按形态重复纪律，本条目必须补上该形态此前没有的东西——CCRIF 补的是「赔付记录公开 + 逐国页面 + 逐灾事件报告 + 学生论文与奖学金」这四样「seadrif 那一侧没有的」**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「CCRIF SPC Payouts（赔付）」页 `/aboutus/ccrif-spc-payouts` 实测 74.5KB，标题「CCRIF SPC Payouts | CCRIF SPC」**；⭐ **「CCRIF’s Country Risk Profiles（国别风险档案）」页 `/en/ccrifs-country-risk-profiles` 实测 46.1KB**；**「CCRIF Products（产品）」页 `/aboutus/ccrif-products` 实测 33.9KB**；站点首页实测 **202.1KB**。**导航逐字实测揭示的内容结构**：**Publications（出版物）** 下含 **Strategic Plan**、**Annual Reports**、**Newsletters**、⭐ **Hazard Event Reports（逐灾事件报告）**、**Country Risk Profiles**、**Technical Materials**、**Other Materials**、⭐ **Student Papers（学生论文）**；**TA Programme（技术援助计划）** 下含 **CCRIF Scholarship Programme**、⭐ **CCRIF-UWI Scholarship Programme（与西印度大学合作奖学金）**、**Regional Internship Programme**、**Small Grants Programme**、**Scholarship/Professional Development Programme**、**Training Programmes/Capacity Building Initiatives**；**Special Projects** 下含 **Caribbean Ocean and Aquaculture Sustainability（COAST）**；并实测存在**逐成员国页面**（Anguilla、Antigua & Barbuda、Bahamas、Barbados、Belize、Bermuda、British Virgin Islands、Cayman Islands 等）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「主权参数化风险池」这一形态在加勒比的样本**——**池内 [[seadrif]] 是东南亚样本**，**两者并读可看出「同一机制在不同区域如何落地」**；**更关键的是 CCRIF 公开的东西更多**：**赔付记录 + 逐国页面 + 逐灾事件报告**，**这三样对做「参数化产品实际触发与赔付」研究的学生是一手材料**（可与 [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[cat-bond-pricer]]、[[hurricaneguard]]、[[payout-assurance-standard]] 并读——**那几条是定价与赔付保障的模型/标准，这一条是真实运作记录**）。**② ⭐ 「逐灾事件报告（Hazard Event Reports）」是一个少见的产品形态**——**每有一次灾害触发赔付就出一份报告**，**这相当于把「参数是否触发、赔了多少、依据什么」逐次公开**；**对参数化保险研究而言，这是解决「基差风险（basis risk）」争论的实证材料来源**（**注意：本次只读到栏目名，未打开任何一份事件报告**）。**③ 学生论文与技术援助计划值得单独注意**——**CCRIF 不但公开 Student Papers，还设「CCRIF-UWI 奖学金」「区域实习计划」与「小额资助计划」**；**对本站读者（学生）而言，这是一个「区域风险池如何培养本地能力」的具体样本**，**也是罕见的「风险池办奖学金」的例子**（可与池内教育类条目 [[cii]]、[[anziif]]、[[actuarial-open-book]] 并读，**但性质完全不同：那些是资格与教材，这是资助与研究**）。**④ 「国别风险档案」把风险信息按国家组织**——**与逐国页面配合，形成「一国一档」的理解路径**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**三个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、首页体量、导航逐字实测的出版物与计划结构、以及逐成员国页面的存在**，**但未打开任何赔付数字、任何国别页面、任何年报、任何逐灾事件报告、任何学生论文或技术文件**，因此**不能转述任何赔付金额、触发参数、覆盖国家数量、保费规模或研究结论**；**② ⭐ 「赔付记录」页本次只核实其存在与标题（74.5KB）**，**未读取任何一笔赔付**——**故本词条不主张任何赔付总额或历史**；**③ 「逐灾事件报告」与「学生论文」本次只核实栏目存在，未打开任何一份**；**④ 奖学金与实习计划的申请条件、名额与现行状态本次未核实**（**栏目存在不等于计划在办**）；**⑤ 「主权参数化风险池」这一形态归类为我的判断**（**依据机构性质与产品栏目名**），**本次未打开任何一页说明其法律结构或成员政府出资机制**；**⑥ COAST 等特别项目的进展本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** CCRIF 提供精算软件或建模工具。**核实说明**：`/aboutus/ccrif-spc-payouts`（74.5KB）、`/en/ccrifs-country-risk-profiles`（46.1KB）、`/aboutus/ccrif-products`（33.9KB）与首页（202.1KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取导航；**未打开赔付数字、国别页面、年报、事件报告、学生论文或技术文件**。
entries.body_en:
**CCRIF SPC** is **the Caribbean sovereign parametric catastrophe risk pool** (measured site title **"CCRIF SPC"**) — **its members are Caribbean governments, and payouts are triggered by parameters and made quickly after an event**. This entry shares the **"sovereign parametric risk pool"** form with the corpus’s existing [[seadrif]] (the Southeast Asia disaster risk insurance fund); **under the form-repetition discipline, this entry must add what that form lacked — and CCRIF adds four things the SEADRIF side does not show: public payout records, per-country pages, per-hazard event reports, and student papers with scholarships**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"CCRIF SPC Payouts" page `/aboutus/ccrif-spc-payouts` measures 74.5KB with the title "CCRIF SPC Payouts | CCRIF SPC"**; ⭐ the **"CCRIF’s Country Risk Profiles" page measures 46.1KB**; the **"CCRIF Products" page measures 33.9KB**; the homepage measures **202.1KB**. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the structure**: under **Publications** — **Strategic Plan**, **Annual Reports**, **Newsletters**, ⭐ **Hazard Event Reports**, **Country Risk Profiles**, **Technical Materials**, **Other Materials** and ⭐ **Student Papers**; under **TA Programme** — **CCRIF Scholarship Programme**, ⭐ **CCRIF-UWI Scholarship Programme** (with the University of the West Indies), **Regional Internship Programme**, **Small Grants Programme**, **Scholarship/Professional Development Programme** and **Training Programmes/Capacity Building Initiatives**; under **Special Projects** — **Caribbean Ocean and Aquaculture Sustainability (COAST)**; **per-member-country pages** measurably exist (Anguilla, Antigua & Barbuda, Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Bermuda, British Virgin Islands, Cayman Islands and others).

For RIAA: **① it adds a Caribbean sample of the sovereign parametric risk pool form** — **the corpus’s [[seadrif]] is the Southeast Asian sample**, **and reading the two shows how one mechanism lands differently across regions**; **more importantly CCRIF discloses more**: **payout records, per-country pages and per-hazard event reports**, **primary material for students studying how parametric products actually trigger and pay** (readable with [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]], [[cat-bond-pricer]], [[hurricaneguard]] and [[payout-assurance-standard]] — **those are pricing models and payout standards; this is a real operating record**). **② ⭐ "Hazard Event Reports" is an uncommon product form** — **a report is issued each time a hazard triggers a payout**, **effectively disclosing event by event whether the parameter triggered, how much was paid and on what basis**; **for parametric insurance research this is a source of empirical material for the basis-risk debate** (**note: this check read only the section label, and opened no event report**). **③ The student papers and technical assistance programme deserve separate note** — **CCRIF not only publishes Student Papers but runs a "CCRIF-UWI Scholarship", a regional internship programme and a small grants programme**; **for this wiki’s readers (students) this is a concrete sample of how a regional risk pool builds local capacity**, **and a rare case of a risk pool running scholarships** (readable with education entries such as [[cii]], [[anziif]] and [[actuarial-open-book]] — **but of a completely different nature: those are qualifications and textbooks; this is funding and research**). **④ Country risk profiles organise risk information by country** — **together with the per-country pages they form a "one file per country" reading path**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **three pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the homepage size, the publication and programme structure read verbatim from navigation, and the existence of per-member-country pages**, **but opened no payout figure, no country page, no annual report, no hazard event report, no student paper and no technical document**, so **no payout amount, trigger parameter, country count, premium volume or research conclusion can be restated**; **② ⭐ the "payout records" page was verified only as to existence and title (74.5KB)**, **with not a single payout read** — **so this entry claims no payout total or history**; **③ the "hazard event reports" and "student papers" were verified only as existing sections, with nothing opened**; **④ the eligibility, quotas and current status of the scholarships and internship programme were not verified** (**a section existing does not mean a programme runs**); **⑤ classifying the entity as a "sovereign parametric risk pool" is my judgement** (**based on the institution’s nature and the product section names**), **and no page describing its legal structure or member-government funding mechanism was opened**; **⑥ the progress of special projects such as COAST was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim CCRIF provides actuarial software or modelling tools**. **Verification note**: `/aboutus/ccrif-spc-payouts` (74.5KB), `/en/ccrifs-country-risk-profiles` (46.1KB), `/aboutus/ccrif-products` (33.9KB) and the homepage (202.1KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with navigation read verbatim; **no payout figure, country page, annual report, event report, student paper or technical document was opened**.

**CCRIF SPC** 是**加勒比地區的主權參數化巨災風險池**（標題實測 **「CCRIF SPC」**）——**成員是加勒比各國政府，出險後按參數觸發、快速賠付**。本條目與池內已有的 [[seadrif]]（東南亞災害風險保險基金）**同屬「主權參數化風險池」這一形態**；**按形態重複紀律，本條目必須補上該形態此前沒有的東西——CCRIF 補的是「賠付記錄公開 + 逐國頁面 + 逐災事件報告 + 學生論文與獎學金」**。

entries.body:
**Global Shield against Climate Risks（全球气候风险盾）** 是**G7 与 V20（易受气候影响国家集团）联合发起的主权气候风险融资倡议**。站点首页正文实测写明它是 **「A joint G7/V20 initiative to strengthen the financial protection and resilience of [脆弱国家]」**。本条目补的是**「把风险分层做成国家级工具箱」这一形态**——**实测池内该形态为 0**（池内已有主权风险池 [[seadrif]]、[[ccrif]]，**但那是「已建成的池」；本条是「面向多国的工具箱与建设进程」**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「Instruments（工具）」页 `/instruments-offer-financial-tools/` 实测 127.2KB，标题「Instruments | The Global Shield against Climate Risks」**，正文实测写明 **「A toolbox of tailored CDRFI instruments for the Global Shield」**，⭐ **并写明它「facilitates Climate and Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance (CDRFI) instruments to help vulnerable countries close protection gaps」**，以及 **「This is enabled through an In-Country Process, which fosters sustainable and inclusive CDRFI capacities within the country」**；⭐ **该页实测的层级结构为：Risk Management → Risk Layering → CDRFI Instruments → Key benefits of CDRFI**（**即把「风险管理 → 风险分层 → 工具 → 效益」作为叙述框架**）；⭐ **「Financing Structure（融资结构）」页 `/about/financing-structure-global-shield/` 实测 157.5KB**；⭐ **「Where we work（我们在哪些国家工作）」页 `/where-we-work/` 实测 2097.2KB**（**本站最大页面，提示为较完整的国别清单或地图应用**）；站点首页实测 133.6KB。**导航逐字实测揭示的结构**：**What we offer** 下含 **Value proposition**、**Instruments**、**Process**、**Capacity Support**；**Where we work**；**Get Involved** 下含 **Access Support**、**Join a Country Community**、**Events**；**About** 下含 **Vision & Mission**、**Global Shield Setup**、**Board**、**Financing Structure**、**Coordination Hub**、**Technical Advisory Group**、**Secretariat**；另有 **Resources** 与 **FAQ**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「风险分层（risk layering）在主权层的操作化」这一层**——**风险分层是保险与风险管理的基础概念（自留/保险/再保/资本市场逐层转移）**，**而 Global Shield 把它直接做成一国可用的工具箱**：**以「风险管理 → 风险分层 → CDRFI 工具 → 效益」组织页面**；**对想做主权风险融资或公共部门风险管理的学生，这是一个把教科书概念落到国家级操作的样本**（可与 [[seadrif]]、[[ccrif]]、[[a2ii]]、[[microinsurance-network]] 并读——**「已建成的池 vs 建设池的进程 vs 监管能力建设 vs 微型保险」四种路径**）。**② ⭐ 「国别进程（In-Country Process）」与「加入国家共同体（Join a Country Community）」是两个值得注意的机制设计**——**不是外部机构直接给钱给保险，而是在国内培育可持续能力**；**这与池内 [[a2ii]] 的监管者能力建设思路同源**（**都强调「本地能力」而非「一次性方案」**）。**③ 治理结构实测含有「协调中心（Coordination Hub）」「技术顾问组（Technical Advisory Group）」与「秘书处」**——**对研究国际倡议如何组织（G7 出资源、V20 出需求、秘书处与顾问组出执行）的学生，这是一个具体样本**（可与 [[bis-fsi]] 的监管者能力建设、[[iais-icp]] 的国际原则层并读）。**④ 与 [[ccrif]]、[[seadrif]] 的关系值得留意**——**Global Shield 是「倡议与进程」，CCRIF/SEADRIF 是「已运行的风险池」**；**两者在现实中可能存在项目层面的衔接，但本次未核实，故本词条不作关联陈述**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与三个功能页的存在、标题、页面体量、三处关键正文表述、页面层级结构、以及导航逐字实测的治理与流程结构**，**但未打开任何工具详情、未打开融资结构的具体数字、未打开「我们在哪些国家工作」的国别清单内容、未打开任何 Resources 文件**，因此**不能转述任何资助金额、参与国家名单、工具的具体设计或项目进展**；**② ⭐ 「Where we work」页体量 2097.2KB 为实测值**，**该页是否为一个国别地图/数据库应用、其可检索性如何，本次未核实**（**故本词条不主张可通过该页查询具体国家**）；**③ 「CDRFI」为站点自身使用的缩写（Climate and Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance），已在词条内写明其展开**；**④ Global Shield 与 [[ccrif]]、[[seadrif]] 是否有项目层面衔接本次未核实——词条内已明确不作关联陈述**；**⑤ 该倡议的存续状态、资金来源与已承诺规模本次未核实**（**站点存在不等于现已全面运作**）；**⑥ 站点为 WordPress 建站**（实测可见 `/wp-content/uploads/` 资源路径），**部分导航项指向 `?page_id=` 形式**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** Global Shield 提供精算工具、模型或可下载数据**。**核实说明**：首页（133.6KB）、`/instruments-offer-financial-tools/`（127.2KB）、`/about/financing-structure-global-shield/`（157.5KB）、`/where-we-work/`（2097.2KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取正文与导航；**未打开工具详情、融资数字、国别清单内容或 Resources 文件**。
entries.body_en:
**The Global Shield against Climate Risks** is **a sovereign climate risk financing initiative jointly launched by the G7 and the V20** (the group of climate-vulnerable countries). Its homepage states verbatim that it is **"A joint G7/V20 initiative to strengthen the financial protection and resilience of [vulnerable countries]"**. This entry adds the **"risk layering turned into a country-level instrument toolbox"** form — **that form measured zero** (the corpus has sovereign risk pools in [[seadrif]] and [[ccrif]], **but those are pools already built; this is a toolbox and a process aimed at many countries**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"Instruments" page `/instruments-offer-financial-tools/` measures 127.2KB with the title "Instruments | The Global Shield against Climate Risks"**, stating verbatim **"A toolbox of tailored CDRFI instruments for the Global Shield"**, ⭐ stating that it **"facilitates Climate and Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance (CDRFI) instruments to help vulnerable countries close protection gaps"**, and adding **"This is enabled through an In-Country Process, which fosters sustainable and inclusive CDRFI capacities within the country"**; ⭐ **the page’s measured hierarchy is: Risk Management → Risk Layering → CDRFI Instruments → Key benefits of CDRFI** (**i.e. it frames the narrative as risk management → risk layering → instruments → benefits**); ⭐ the **"Financing Structure" page measures 157.5KB**; ⭐ the **"Where we work" page measures 2097.2KB** (**the site’s largest page, suggesting a fairly complete country list or map application**); the homepage measures 133.6KB. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the structure**: under **What we offer** — **Value proposition**, **Instruments**, **Process**, **Capacity Support**; **Where we work**; under **Get Involved** — **Access Support**, **Join a Country Community**, **Events**; under **About** — **Vision & Mission**, **Global Shield Setup**, **Board**, **Financing Structure**, **Coordination Hub**, **Technical Advisory Group** and **Secretariat**; plus **Resources** and **FAQ**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the operationalisation of risk layering at sovereign level** — **risk layering is a foundational insurance and risk-management concept (retention, insurance, reinsurance, capital markets, each layer transferring risk)**, **and the Global Shield turns it into a toolbox a country can use**, organising its pages as **risk management → risk layering → CDRFI instruments → benefits**; **for students working on sovereign risk financing or public-sector risk management this is a sample of a textbook concept implemented at national level** (readable with [[seadrif]], [[ccrif]], [[a2ii]] and [[microinsurance-network]] — **four paths: a pool already built, a process for building pools, supervisory capacity building, and microinsurance**). **② ⭐ The "In-Country Process" and "Join a Country Community" are notable mechanism designs** — **not an external body simply handing over money and insurance, but cultivating sustainable capacity domestically**; **this shares its logic with [[a2ii]]’s supervisory capacity building** (**both emphasise local capability over one-off solutions**). **③ The measured governance includes a "Coordination Hub", a "Technical Advisory Group" and a "Secretariat"** — **a concrete sample for studying how international initiatives organise (G7 providing resources, V20 demand, secretariat and advisory group delivery)** (readable with [[bis-fsi]] and the international-principles layer of [[iais-icp]]). **④ Its relationship with [[ccrif]] and [[seadrif]] deserves attention** — **the Global Shield is an initiative and process; CCRIF and SEADRIF are pools already running**; **there may be project-level links in practice, but these were not verified, so this entry makes no claim about them**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and sizes of the homepage and three functional pages, three key verbatim body statements, the page hierarchy, and the governance and process structure read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no instrument detail, no financing figures, no country-list content on "Where we work", and no Resources file**, so **no funding amount, participating country list, instrument design or project progress can be restated**; **② ⭐ the 2097.2KB size of the "Where we work" page is a measured value**, **but whether it is a country map or database application, and how searchable it is, were not verified** (**so this entry does not claim the page can be used to look up specific countries**); **③ "CDRFI" is the site’s own abbreviation (Climate and Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance), expanded in the entry**; **④ whether the Global Shield links at project level to [[ccrif]] or [[seadrif]] was not verified — the entry explicitly makes no such claim**; **⑤ the initiative’s current status, funding sources and committed amounts were not verified** (**a site existing does not mean it is fully operating**); **⑥ the site runs on WordPress** (measurably serving `/wp-content/uploads/` assets), **with some navigation items pointing to `?page_id=` URLs**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the Global Shield provides actuarial tools, models or downloadable data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (133.6KB), `/instruments-offer-financial-tools/` (127.2KB), `/about/financing-structure-global-shield/` (157.5KB) and `/where-we-work/` (2097.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with body text and navigation read verbatim; **no instrument detail, financing figure, country-list content or Resources file was opened**.

entries.summary_en: Belgium’s official export credit agency: it offers trade credit insurance, financing, bonds and guarantees, investment cover and reinsurance solutions, publishes country risk ratings, and runs a "knowledge hub" of rating actions and analyses; the site is available in nine languages
entries.summary_hk: 比利時官方出口信用機構：提供貿易信用險、融資、保函／擔保、投資與再保險方案，並公布國別風險評級與「知識中心」的評級調整分析；站點提供九種語言
entries.body:
**Credendo** 是**比利时的官方出口信用机构（ECA）**（站点标题实测 **「Homepage | Credendo」**；导航实测含 **Credendo – Export Credit Agency**、**Credendo – Trade Credit Insurance**、**Credendo – Guarantees & Speciality Risks** 三块）。本条目补的是**「出口信用机构本身」这一形态**——**池内 [[berne-union]] 是同业组织与统计、[[icisa]] 是信用险与保证险的行业协会，而「一家实际承保的出口信用机构」此前为 0**。⭐ **特别说明（避免误导）**：**本条目不是 OECD 国家风险分类的替代**——**OECD 的国别风险分类页面本次实测 HTTP 403（Cloudflare「Just a moment...」）而被阻断**；**Credendo 发布的是其自有的国别风险评级，方法论与用途都与 OECD 分类不同，故本词条不作任何等价或替代主张**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「Country risk（国别风险）」页 `/en/country-risk` 实测 132.9KB，标题「Country risk | Credendo」**，正文实测写明 **「Get an immediate risk assessment for any country or continent. Monitor the important risk parameters at a glance. Dive into relevant alerts, risk analyses and background stories」**，并含 **「Select a country」选择器**；⭐ **「Country risk - World」页 `/en/country-risk/world` 实测 91.4KB**；⭐ **「Knowledge hub（知识中心）」页 `/en/knowledge-hub` 实测 115.5KB**；**「Credendo – Export Credit Agency」页 `/en/about-credendo/credendo-export-credit-agency` 实测 94.2KB**；首页实测 163.7KB。**导航逐字实测揭示的业务结构**：**Solutions** 下含 **Trade credit insurance**、**Financing**、**Bonds / Guarantees**、**Investment**、**Financial guarantees**、**Reinsurance**、**Risk Participation**、⭐ **Credendo Green Package**、**Credendo Export Finance Solutions**；**Country risk**；**Knowledge hub**；**About Credendo**（含三块业务实体与 **Sustainability**）、**Pressroom**、**Careers**；另有 **Podcasts** 与 **Become export savvy**。⭐ **「知识中心」实测含具体的评级调整与国别分析条目**，例如 **「argentina-mlt-political-risk-upgraded-category-67」**（阿根廷中长期政治风险上调类别）与 **「zambia-incumbent-president-wins-tainted-election」**；⭐ **站点实测提供九种语言**：**English / Česky / Nederlands / Français / Deutsch / Italiano / Polski / Slovensky / Español**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「实际承保的出口信用机构」这一层**——**池内已有行业组织（[[berne-union]]、[[icisa]]）与多边机构（同轮 [[miga]]）**，**而一家国家级 ECA「自己怎么定价国别风险、卖什么产品」此前没有**；**Credendo 的业务清单本身就是一份出口信用与政治风险的实务产品表**（**贸易信用险、融资、保函/担保、投资险、财务担保、再保险、风险参与**）——**对做贸易信用与跨境风险的学生，这是一个可对照 [[berne-union]] 的「实践侧」**。**② ⭐ 「国别风险评级 + 知识中心评级调整」是一个连续的观察窗口**——**评级不是静态表格，而是「上调/下调 + 分析理由」的事件流**（实测条目如阿根廷中长期政治风险上调类别）；**对做主权风险监测的学生，这种「评级动作流」比静态评级表更有信息量**（**注意：本次只读到条目 slug 与标题，未打开任何分析正文**）。**③ 「Credendo Green Package」值得单独注意**——**绿色/ESG 相关的出口信用方案**，**与池内 [[ngfs]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]] 的气候口径并读，可以看出「气候议题如何进入出口信用与贸易融资」**。**④ 九语站点（含捷克、波兰、斯洛伐克语）说明其服务中东欧市场**——**这与比利时 ECA 的贸易促进定位一致**，**对研究中东欧贸易融资的学生是可用的语言覆盖**。**⑤ ⚠️ 与 OECD 分类的关系必须说清楚**：**OECD 的国别风险分类是出口信用领域的一个常见基准，但本次其站点被 403 阻断，我未能核实其内容**；**Credendo 的评级是其自有产品，两者不可互换**——**本词条据此不作任何替代主张**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、首页体量、国别风险页的关键正文与「Select a country」选择器、知识中心的两个具体条目标题、以及导航逐字实测的业务结构与九语清单**，**但未检索任何国家的评级数值、未打开任何评级分析正文、未打开任何产品条款、未打开任何播客或新闻稿**，因此**不能转述任何国家的评级、任何评级调整的理由、任何费率或承保条件**；**② ⭐ OECD 国别风险分类页本次实测 HTTP 403（Cloudflare）而被阻断**，**故本词条不仅未引用该 URL，且明确标注「Credendo 的评级不是 OECD 分类的替代」**；**③ 「知识中心」条目标题（阿根廷中长期政治风险上调类别、赞比亚选举）来自页面链接实测**，**本词条不转述其内容与结论**；**④ Credendo 与比利时政府的关系、其官方 ECA 身份的法律依据本次未核实**——**「官方出口信用机构」这一表述依据其页面导航中的 `Credendo – Export Credit Agency` 与 `About Credendo` 分区名，未打开法律说明**；**⑤ 评级方法论（期限划分、类别定义）本次未核实**；**⑥ 九语语言切换仅核实其存在，未核实各语言版本内容完整度**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** Credendo 提供精算工具、可下载的评级数据集或建模软件。**核实说明**：首页（163.7KB）、`/en/country-risk`（132.9KB）、`/en/country-risk/world`（91.4KB）、`/en/knowledge-hub`（115.5KB）、`/en/about-credendo/credendo-export-credit-agency`（94.2KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取正文与导航；⛔ **OECD 国别风险分类页实测 403（未收录、未引用）**；**未检索评级数值、未打开评级分析、产品条款、播客或新闻稿**。
entries.body_en:
**Credendo** is **Belgium’s official export credit agency (ECA)** (measured site title **"Homepage | Credendo"**; measured navigation shows three blocks: **Credendo – Export Credit Agency**, **Credendo – Trade Credit Insurance** and **Credendo – Guarantees & Speciality Risks**). This entry adds the **"export credit agency itself"** form — the corpus has [[berne-union]] as the **trade body and its statistics** and [[icisa]] as the **credit and surety industry association**, **but "an export credit agency that actually underwrites" was at zero**. ⭐ **Stated to avoid any misreading**: **this entry is not a substitute for the OECD country risk classification** — **the OECD’s country risk classification page returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare "Just a moment...") to this check and was blocked**; **Credendo publishes its own country risk ratings, with a different methodology and purpose from the OECD classification, so this entry makes no equivalence or substitution claim**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"Country risk" page `/en/country-risk` measures 132.9KB with the title "Country risk | Credendo"**, stating verbatim **"Get an immediate risk assessment for any country or continent. Monitor the important risk parameters at a glance. Dive into relevant alerts, risk analyses and background stories"**, and carrying a **"Select a country"** selector; ⭐ the **"Country risk - World" page measures 91.4KB**; ⭐ the **"Knowledge hub" page measures 115.5KB**; the **"Credendo – Export Credit Agency" page measures 94.2KB**; the homepage measures 163.7KB. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the business structure**: under **Solutions** — **Trade credit insurance**, **Financing**, **Bonds / Guarantees**, **Investment**, **Financial guarantees**, **Reinsurance**, **Risk Participation**, ⭐ **Credendo Green Package** and **Credendo Export Finance Solutions**; **Country risk**; **Knowledge hub**; **About Credendo** (with the three business entities and **Sustainability**), **Pressroom** and **Careers**; plus **Podcasts** and **Become export savvy**. ⭐ **The knowledge hub measurably carries specific rating actions and country analyses**, such as **"argentina-mlt-political-risk-upgraded-category-67"** (Argentina medium/long-term political risk upgraded a category) and **"zambia-incumbent-president-wins-tainted-election"**; ⭐ **the site measurably offers nine languages**: **English, Česky, Nederlands, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Polski, Slovensky, Español**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the actually-underwriting export credit agency layer** — the corpus already had **trade bodies ([[berne-union]], [[icisa]]) and a multilateral institution ([[miga]] in the same round)**, **but not how a national ECA prices country risk and what it sells**; **Credendo’s business list is itself a practitioner product table for export credit and political risk** (**trade credit insurance, financing, bonds/guarantees, investment cover, financial guarantees, reinsurance, risk participation**) — **for students working on trade credit and cross-border risk, this is the "practice side" to set against [[berne-union]]**. **② ⭐ "Country risk ratings plus knowledge hub rating actions" form a continuous observation window** — **the rating is not a static table but a stream of upgrade/downgrade events with reasoning** (measured items include Argentina’s MLT political risk being upgraded a category); **for sovereign risk monitoring this stream of rating actions carries more information than a static table** (**note: this check read only item slugs and titles, opening no analysis body**). **③ "Credendo Green Package" deserves separate note** — **a green/ESG-related export credit offering**; **read with the climate material in [[ngfs]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]] and [[climate-conditioned-cat]], it shows how climate issues enter export credit and trade finance**. **④ The nine-language site (including Czech, Polish and Slovak) indicates a Central and Eastern European reach** — **consistent with a Belgian ECA’s trade-promotion role**, **useful language coverage for students studying CEE trade finance**. **⑤ ⚠️ The relationship with the OECD classification must be stated clearly**: **the OECD country risk classification is a common benchmark in export credit, but its site was blocked with 403 in this check and I could not verify its content**; **Credendo’s ratings are its own product and the two are not interchangeable** — **so this entry makes no substitution claim**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the homepage size, the country risk page’s key body text and "Select a country" selector, two specific knowledge-hub item titles, and the business structure and nine-language list read verbatim from navigation**, **but searched no country’s rating value, opened no rating analysis, no product terms and no podcast or press release**, so **no country rating, rating-action rationale, premium rate or underwriting condition can be restated**; **② ⭐ the OECD country risk classification page returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) and was blocked**, **so this entry neither cites that URL nor fails to note that Credendo’s ratings are not a substitute for the OECD classification**; **③ the knowledge hub item titles (Argentina MLT political risk upgraded; Zambia election) come from measured page links**, **and this entry restates neither their content nor conclusions**; **④ Credendo’s relationship with the Belgian state and the legal basis of its official ECA status were not verified** — **the "official export credit agency" wording rests on the navigation section names `Credendo – Export Credit Agency` and `About Credendo`, with no legal document opened**; **⑤ the rating methodology (tenor bands, category definitions) was not verified**; **⑥ the nine language switches were verified only as existing, not for content completeness per language**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim Credendo provides actuarial tools, a downloadable ratings dataset or modelling software**. **Verification note**: the homepage (163.7KB), `/en/country-risk` (132.9KB), `/en/country-risk/world` (91.4KB), `/en/knowledge-hub` (115.5KB) and `/en/about-credendo/credendo-export-credit-agency` (94.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with body text and navigation read verbatim; ⛔ **the OECD country risk classification page measured 403 (not included, not cited)**; **no rating value, rating analysis, product terms, podcast or press release was opened**.

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **「Country risk」頁 132.9KB**，正文實測 **「Get an immediate risk assessment for any country or continent. Monitor the important risk parameters at a glance. 對 RIAA：**① 補上「實際承保的出口信用機構」這一層**——**Credendo 的業務清單本身就是一份出口信用與政治風險的實務產品表**，**對做貿易信用與跨境風險的學生，這是可對照 [[berne-union]] 的「實踐側」**。**② ⭐ 「國別風險評級 + 知識中心評級調整」是連續的觀察窗口**——**評級不是靜態表格，而是「上調／下調 + 分析理由」的事件流**；**對做主權風險監測的學生，這種「評級動作流」比靜態評級表更有信息量**（**注意：本次只讀到條目 slug 與標題**）。**③ 「Credendo Green Package」值得單獨注意**——**綠色／ESG 相關出口信用方案**，可與 [[ngfs]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]] 並讀。**④ 九語站點（含捷克、波蘭、斯洛伐克語）說明其服務中東歐市場**。**⑤ ⚠️ 與 OECD 分類的關係必須說清楚**：**本次其站點被 403 阻斷，我未能核實其內容**；**Credendo 的評級是其自有產品，兩者不可互換**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**四個頁面的存在、標題、體量、首頁體量、國別風險頁關鍵正文與選擇器、知識中心兩個具體條目標題、導航逐字實測的業務結構與九語清單**，**但未檢索任何國家的評級數值、未打開任何評級分析正文、未打開任何產品條款、未打開任何播客或新聞稿**，故**不能轉述任何國家評級、評級調整理由、費率或承保條件**；**② ⭐ OECD 國別風險分類頁本次實測 HTTP 403（Cloudflare）而被阻斷**，**故本詞條不僅未引用該 URL，且明確標注「Credendo 的評級不是 OECD 分類的替代」**；**③ 知識中心條目標題來自頁面連結實測**，**本詞條不轉述其內容與結論**；**④ 其與比利時政府的關係、官方 ECA 身份的法律依據未核實**——**「官方出口信用機構」表述依據導航分區名**；**⑤ 評級方法論未核實**；**⑥ 九語切換僅核實存在，未核實各語言內容完整度**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** Credendo 提供精算工具、可下載評級數據集或建模軟件**。**核實說明**：五個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取正文與導航；⛔ **OECD 國別風險分類頁實測 403（未收錄、未引用）**；**未檢索評級數值、未打開評級分析、產品條款、播客或新聞稿**。

entries.body:
**ASB（Actuarial Standards Board，美国精算实务准则委员会）** 是**美国制定精算实务准则的机构**。站点自述实测为 **「The Actuarial Standards Board (ASB) establishes and improves standards of actuarial practice」**，并写明 **「These Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOPs) identify what the actuary should consider, document, and dis[close]」**。本条目补的是**「精算准则的可检索库 + 公开立规流程」这一形态**——**池内最接近的是 [[aae]]（欧洲精算协会的欧洲精算实务准则）**，**但那条我上一轮只核实到准则页的存在，且其形态是「区域准则发布方」**；**ASB 补上的是该形态没有的东西：按业务领域筛选的准则库、已废止准则、以及在征/往期征求意见稿**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **首页 67.2KB，标题实测「Home - Actuarial Standards Board」**；⭐ **「Standards of Practice（实务准则）」页 `/standards-of-practice/` 实测 121.7KB**，**页面实测带按业务领域的筛选入口**：**`#filter=*`（全部）**、**`.Casualty`（意外险）**、**`.ERM`（企业风险管理）**、**`.General`（通用）**、**`.Health`（健康）**、**`.Life`（寿险）**、**`.Pension`（养老金）**，⭐ **以及 `.Repealed`（已废止）**——**即已废止准则仍保留可查**；⭐ **「Ongoing Exposure Drafts（在征征求意见稿）」页 `/drafts/ongoing-exposure-drafts/` 实测 75.4KB**，另有 **`/drafts/past-exposure-drafts/`（往期征求意见稿）**、**`/site-map/`** 与 **`/contact/`**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「准则的可检索化与时效管理」这一做法**——**准则不是一份 PDF，而是可按业务领域筛选的库，且明确区分现行与已废止**；**对做精算工作底稿或复核的学生，「哪一条 ASOP 管这件事、它是否已被废止」是可以直接查的**（可与 [[aae]] 的欧洲准则、[[iais-icp]] 的保险核心原则并读——**一条是执业准则、一条是监管原则，层级不同**）。**② ⭐ 「公开征求意见稿」这一流程本身就是教学材料**——**准则怎么被修改、业界怎么反馈**都留痕；**这与池内 [[eiopa-registers]] 的「监管报送 DPM/XBRL」、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 的监管态势聚合不同**——**那些是监管产出，这是职业自律的立规过程**。**③ 按业务领域分类的七个维度是一份现成的「精算业务领域清单」**——**对刚入行、不确定精算分几条线的学生，这个筛选器本身就是一张地图**（可与 [[cas-syllabus]]、[[soa-education]]、[[actuarial-exam-database]] 的考试分科并读——**考试分科与准则领域不完全重合，这个差异本身值得注意**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与准则页、在征征求意见稿页的存在、标题、体量、筛选维度（含 Repealed）、以及往期征求意见稿与站点地图的链接存在**，**但未打开任何一条 ASOP 正文、未打开任何一份征求意见稿、未核实准则总数**，因此**不能转述任何 ASOP 的编号、条款内容或适用范围**；**② 首页正文我只读到一个被截断的句子片段**（**「…should consider, document, and dis」**）——**故词条内只引用到该片段为止，不补全其后的词**；**③ 「ASB 与 AAA（美国精算师协会）、ABCD 的关系」本次未核实**（**本轮的 [[abcd]] 条目同属美国精算自律体系，但两者的制度关系本词条不作主张**）；**④ 筛选维度实测为 URL 片段形式（`#filter=…`）**，**其是否为前端筛选、是否需要 JS 本次未核实**；**⑤ ASB 的成员构成与任命方式未核实**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张** ASB 提供精算软件、模型或数据**。**核实说明**：首页（67.2KB）、`/standards-of-practice/`（121.7KB）、`/drafts/ongoing-exposure-drafts/`（75.4KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取筛选维度与自述；**未打开任何 ASOP 正文或征求意见稿**。
entries.body_en:
**ASB (the Actuarial Standards Board)** is **the body that sets actuarial standards of practice in the United States**. Its own measured wording is **"The Actuarial Standards Board (ASB) establishes and improves standards of actuarial practice"**, adding that **"These Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOPs) identify what the actuary should consider, document, and dis[close]"**. This entry adds the **"searchable standards library plus open standard-setting process"** form — **the closest corpus item is [[aae]] (the Actuarial Association of Europe and its European standards of actuarial practice)**, **but that entry verified only the existence of its standards page and its form is "a regional standards publisher"**; **ASB supplies what that form lacked: a library filterable by practice area, repealed standards, and ongoing and past exposure drafts**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **homepage is 67.2KB with the measured title "Home - Actuarial Standards Board"**; ⭐ the **"Standards of Practice" page `/standards-of-practice/` measures 121.7KB**, **measurably carrying filter entry points by practice area**: **`#filter=*` (all)**, **`.Casualty`**, **`.ERM`**, **`.General`**, **`.Health`**, **`.Life`**, **`.Pension`**, ⭐ and **`.Repealed`** — **i.e. repealed standards remain searchable**; ⭐ the **"Ongoing Exposure Drafts" page measures 75.4KB**, with **`/drafts/past-exposure-drafts/`**, **`/site-map/`** and **`/contact/`** also present.

For RIAA: **① it adds "making standards searchable and managing their currency"** — **a standard is not a PDF but a library filterable by practice area that explicitly separates current from repealed**; **for students preparing actuarial work papers or reviews, "which ASOP governs this, and has it been repealed" becomes directly checkable** (readable with the European standards in [[aae]] and the insurance core principles in [[iais-icp]] — **one is practice standards, one regulatory principles, at different levels**). **② ⭐ The public exposure-draft process is itself teaching material** — **how a standard is amended and how the industry responds is all on record**; **this differs from the regulatory reporting DPM/XBRL in [[eiopa-registers]] and the regulatory-posture aggregation in [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]** — **those are supervisory outputs; this is rule-making within a profession’s self-regulation**. **③ The seven practice-area filters are a ready-made list of actuarial practice areas** — **for a newcomer unsure how many lines actuarial work divides into, the filter itself is a map** (readable with the examination structures in [[cas-syllabus]], [[soa-education]] and [[actuarial-exam-database]] — **exam streams and standards areas do not fully coincide, and that difference is itself worth noting**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and sizes of the homepage, the standards page and the ongoing exposure drafts page, the filter dimensions (including Repealed), and the presence of past exposure drafts and the site map as links**, **but opened no ASOP text, no exposure draft, and did not establish how many standards exist**, so **no ASOP number, clause content or scope can be restated**; **② the homepage body was read only as a truncated sentence fragment** (**"…should consider, document, and dis"**) — **so the entry quotes no further than that fragment and does not complete the word**; **③ the relationship between the ASB, the AAA (American Academy of Actuaries) and the ABCD was not verified** (**this round’s [[abcd]] entry belongs to the same US actuarial self-regulation system, but this entry makes no claim about their institutional relationship**); **④ the filter dimensions were measured as URL fragments (`#filter=…`)**, and **whether filtering is client-side and requires JavaScript was not verified**; **⑤ the ASB’s membership and appointment were not verified**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim the ASB provides actuarial software, models or data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (67.2KB), `/standards-of-practice/` (121.7KB) and `/drafts/ongoing-exposure-drafts/` (75.4KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with filter dimensions and self-description read verbatim; **no ASOP text or exposure draft was opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**ASB（Actuarial Standards Board，美國精算實務準則委員會）** 是**美國制定精算實務準則的機構**。站點自述實測為 **「The Actuarial Standards Board (ASB) establishes and improves standards of actuarial practice」**，並寫明 **「These Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOPs) identify what the actuary should consider, document, and dis…」**。本條目補的是**「精算準則的可檢索庫 + 公開立規流程」這一形態**——**池內最接近的是 [[aae]]（歐洲精算實務準則）**，**但 ASB 補上該形態沒有的東西：按業務領域篩選的準則庫、已廢止準則、以及在徵／往期徵求意見稿**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **首頁 67.2KB，標題「Home - Actuarial Standards Board」**；⭐ **「Standards of Practice」頁 121.7KB**，⭐ **實測帶業務領域篩選入口**：**`#filter=*`／`.Casualty`／`.ERM`／`.General`／`.Health`／`.Life`／`.Pension`**，⭐ 以及 **`.Repealed`（已廢止）**——**已廢止準則仍保留可查**；⭐ **「Ongoing Exposure Drafts」頁 75.4KB**，另有 **`/drafts/past-exposure-drafts/`／`/site-map/`／`/contact/`**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「準則的可檢索化與時效管理」這一做法**——**準則不是一份 PDF，而是可按業務領域篩選、且明確區分現行與已廢止的庫**；**對做工作底稿或複核的學生，「哪一條 ASOP 管這件事、是否已廢止」可直接查**（可與 [[aae]]、[[iais-icp]] 並讀）。**② ⭐ 「公開徵求意見稿」流程本身就是教學材料**——**準則怎麼被修改、業界怎麼反饋都留痕**；**與 [[eiopa-registers]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 的監管產出不同，這是職業自律的立規過程**。**③ 七個業務領域篩選是一份現成的「精算業務領域清單」**——**對剛入行的學生，這個篩選器本身就是一張地圖**（可與 [[cas-syllabus]]、[[soa-education]] 並讀——**考試分科與準則領域不完全重合，這個差異值得注意**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁、準則頁、在徵徵求意見稿頁的存在、標題、體量、篩選維度（含 Repealed）、以及往期徵求意見稿與站點地圖的連結存在**，**但未打開任何一條 ASOP 正文、未打開任何一份徵求意見稿、未核實準則總數**，故**不能轉述任何 ASOP 編號、條款內容或適用範圍**；**② 首頁正文我只讀到一個被截斷的句子片段，故詞條內只引用到該片段為止**；**③ ASB 與 AAA、ABCD 的關係本次未核實**；**④ 篩選維度實測為 URL 片段形式，是否需 JS 未核實**；**⑤ 成員構成與任命方式未核實**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張** ASB 提供精算軟件、模型或數據**。**核實說明**：三個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測；**未打開任何 ASOP 正文或徵求意見稿**。

entries.body:
**ABCD（Actuarial Board for Counseling and Discipline，美国精算咨询与纪律委员会）** 是**美国精算职业的纪律与咨询机构**——**既接受对精算师的投诉并调查，也提供「咨询（counseling）」这一预防性渠道**。本条目补的是**「职业纪律与公开纪律记录」这一形态**：**实测池内「精算伦理/行为准则」形态为 0**（**池内有 [[compliance-officer]] 这类岗位条目、[[three-lines-of-defense]] 这类治理概念，但「职业纪律机构与其公开记录」此前没有**）。

⭐ **一个必须写明的实测细节**：**ABCD 的内容托管在 `actuary.org`（美国精算师协会 American Academy of Actuaries 的域名）上**——**`abcdboard.org` 实测返回的页面标题即「Actuarial Board Of Counseling And Discipline - Actuary.org」**；**故本词条引用的是 `actuary.org` 下的规范路径**。⚠️ **我最初依据相对链接猜测的 `abcdboard.org/professionalism/…/complaints/` 实测 404**——**真实路径在 `actuary.org` 下**（**又一次「不要猜路径」**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「Professionalism（职业操守）」页 `/professionalism/` 实测 70.1KB，标题「Professionalism - Actuary.org」**；⭐ **「Public Discipline（公开纪律）」页 `/professionalism/public-discipline/` 实测 56.4KB，标题「Public Discipline - Actuary.org」**；⭐ **「Complaints（投诉）」页 `/professionalism/actuarial-board-of-counseling-and-discipline/complaints/` 实测 60.5KB**；**「Code of Conduct（行为守则）」页 `/professionalism/code-of-conduct/` 实测 50.9KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的职业操守结构**：**Professionalism** 下含 **Understanding Professionalism**、**Code of Conduct**、**U.S. Qualification Standards**、**Discussion Papers**、⭐ **Public Discipline**、⭐ **Potentially Disruptive Events（潜在破坏性事件）**、**Actuarial Standards Board**、**Actuarial Board For Counseling And Discipline**；ABCD 分组下实测含 **about-abcd / abcd-responsibilities**、**standards-guidance（标准指引）**、**complaints**、⭐ **complaints/flow-chart-of-the-abcds-investigation-process-target-timeline（调查流程与目标时限流程图）**、**presentations**、**abcd-members**、**contact-the-abcd**；站点另有 **Newsroom**、**Calendar**、**Resources** 与 **`/publication/contingencies/`**（会刊 Contingencies，实测含 **「Up to Code」** 专栏）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「职业纪律」这一层**——**精算职业的约束不只来自考试与准则，还来自「被投诉 → 调查 → 处理」这条线**；**对准备入行或已在实习的学生，「哪些行为会被投诉、流程怎么走、什么会被公开」是可查的**（可与同轮 [[asb-us]] 的准则、[[cia-ica]] 的强制职业操守模块并读——**「定准则 / 纪律 / 教育」是职业自律的三条不同腿**）。**② ⭐ 「公开纪律（Public Discipline）」栏是本轮最值得注意的一处**——**纪律结果被公开**，**这与池内 [[fos-uk]] 的公开裁决库、[[eiopa-registers]] 的分销商处罚统计属同一类「把处理结果公开」的做法**，**但对象不同：那两条处理的是机构与消费者争议，这一条处理的是职业成员的执业行为**。**③ 「调查流程与目标时限流程图」值得单独注意**——**把「多久内该有下文」写进流程图**，**对研究程序正义与监管效率的学生是一个具体设计**（**注意：本次只核实该链接存在，未打开流程图**）。**④ 「潜在破坏性事件（Potentially Disruptive Events）」是一个少见议题**——**职业操守在极端情形（如机构危机、被迫签字）下的适用问题**，**对做职业伦理讨论的学生是可用的题目来源**。**⑤ 会刊《Contingencies》设有「Up to Code」专栏**——**把职业操守做成连续专栏**，**说明这是长期议题而非一次性宣导**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、导航与链接逐字实测的职业操守与 ABCD 分组结构、以及若干子页链接的存在**，**但未打开任何一条公开纪律记录、未打开任何投诉案例、未打开流程图、未打开行为守则或资格标准正文、未打开「Up to Code」专栏文章**，因此**不能转述任何纪律案件、处理结果、被处理人、行为守则条款或调查时限的具体数值**；**② ⭐ 本词条不主张「公开纪律」栏中现有多少条记录、也不主张其公开范围**——**本次仅核实该栏目存在（56.4KB）**；**③ 我猜测的 `abcdboard.org/professionalism/…/complaints/` 路径实测 404**——**真实路径在 `actuary.org` 下，词条内已写明这一点**；**④ 「ABCD 与 AAA（美国精算师协会）、ASB 的关系」本次未核实**——**虽在同一域名下，本词条不据域名推断制度隶属**；**⑤ 「咨询（counseling）」职能的具体运作方式本次未核实**（**仅从机构名称与其导航条目推断，本词条已将其表述为「预防性渠道」并在此标注为推断**）；**⑥ Public Discipline 页 56.4KB 中多少是记录、多少是页面框架本次未区分**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** ABCD 提供精算工具、数据或模型**。**核实说明**：`/professionalism/`（70.1KB）、`/professionalism/public-discipline/`（56.4KB）、`/professionalism/actuarial-board-of-counseling-and-discipline/complaints/`（60.5KB）、`/professionalism/code-of-conduct/`（50.9KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取导航；`abcdboard.org` 上的猜测路径实测 **404**（真实路径在 actuary.org）；**未打开任何纪律记录、投诉案例、流程图、守则正文或专栏文章**。
entries.body_en:
**ABCD (the Actuarial Board for Counseling and Discipline)** is **the US actuarial profession’s discipline and counseling body** — **it both receives and investigates complaints against actuaries and offers "counseling" as a preventive channel**. This entry adds the **"professional discipline and its public record"** form: **the "actuarial ethics / code of conduct" form measured zero** (**the corpus has role entries such as [[compliance-officer]] and governance concepts such as [[three-lines-of-defense]], but no disciplinary body and its public record**).

⭐ **A measured detail that must be stated**: **ABCD’s content is hosted on `actuary.org`** (the domain of the American Academy of Actuaries) — **`abcdboard.org` measures a page titled "Actuarial Board Of Counseling And Discipline - Actuary.org"**; **so this entry cites canonical paths under `actuary.org`**. ⚠️ **The path I first guessed from a relative link, `abcdboard.org/professionalism/…/complaints/`, measured 404** — **the real path sits under `actuary.org`** (**another "do not guess paths"**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"Professionalism" page `/professionalism/` measures 70.1KB with the title "Professionalism - Actuary.org"**; ⭐ the **"Public Discipline" page measures 56.4KB with the title "Public Discipline - Actuary.org"**; ⭐ the **"Complaints" page measures 60.5KB**; the **"Code of Conduct" page measures 50.9KB**. **Navigation and links read verbatim reveal the professionalism structure**: under **Professionalism** — **Understanding Professionalism**, **Code of Conduct**, **U.S. Qualification Standards**, **Discussion Papers**, ⭐ **Public Discipline**, ⭐ **Potentially Disruptive Events**, **Actuarial Standards Board** and **Actuarial Board For Counseling And Discipline**; the ABCD grouping measurably includes **about-abcd / abcd-responsibilities**, **standards-guidance**, **complaints**, ⭐ **complaints/flow-chart-of-the-abcds-investigation-process-target-timeline**, **presentations**, **abcd-members** and **contact-the-abcd**; the site also has **Newsroom**, **Calendar**, **Resources** and **`/publication/contingencies/`** (the magazine Contingencies, measurably carrying an **"Up to Code"** column).

For RIAA: **① it adds the professional discipline layer** — **the actuarial profession is constrained not only by examinations and standards but by the track from complaint to investigation to outcome**; **for students preparing to enter the field or already interning, "what conduct draws a complaint, how the process runs, and what gets published" is checkable** (readable with the standards in [[asb-us]] and the mandatory professionalism module in [[cia-ica]] — **setting standards, disciplining, and teaching are three different legs of self-regulation**). **② ⭐ The "Public Discipline" section is the round’s most notable find** — **disciplinary outcomes are published**; **this belongs with [[fos-uk]]’s public decisions database and [[eiopa-registers]]’ distributor sanction statistics as "publishing the outcome"**, **but the subjects differ: those two handle firms and consumer disputes, this handles the professional conduct of individual members**. **③ The investigation flow chart with a target timeline deserves separate note** — **"how long before you hear something" is written into a flow chart**, **a concrete design for students studying procedural fairness and supervisory efficiency** (**note: only the link’s existence was verified, not the chart**). **④ "Potentially Disruptive Events" is an uncommon topic** — **how professional conduct standards apply in extreme situations such as an institutional crisis or pressure to sign**, **a usable source of essay questions for professional-ethics work**. **⑤ The magazine Contingencies runs an "Up to Code" column** — **professional conduct treated as a continuous column**, **indicating a long-term agenda rather than a one-off campaign**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the professionalism and ABCD groupings read verbatim from navigation and links, and the existence of several subpage links**, **but opened no public discipline record, no complaint case, no flow chart, no code of conduct or qualification standard text and no "Up to Code" article**, so **no disciplinary case, outcome, named individual, code clause or specific investigation deadline can be restated**; **② ⭐ this entry does not claim how many records the "Public Discipline" section contains, nor its scope of publication** — **only the section’s existence (56.4KB) was verified**; **③ the path I guessed on `abcdboard.org` measured 404** — **the real path is under `actuary.org`, as stated in the entry**; **④ the relationship between the ABCD, the AAA and the ASB was not verified** — **although they share a domain, this entry does not infer institutional affiliation from the domain**; **⑤ how the "counseling" function actually operates was not verified** (**inferred from the body’s name and its navigation items; the entry labels it a "preventive channel" and flags that as inference here**); **⑥ how much of the 56.4KB Public Discipline page is records versus page frame was not distinguished**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the ABCD provides actuarial tools, data or models**. **Verification note**: `/professionalism/` (70.1KB), `/professionalism/public-discipline/` (56.4KB), `/professionalism/actuarial-board-of-counseling-and-discipline/complaints/` (60.5KB) and `/professionalism/code-of-conduct/` (50.9KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with navigation read verbatim; the guessed path on `abcdboard.org` measured **404** (real path under actuary.org); **no discipline record, complaint case, flow chart, code text or column article was opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**ABCD（Actuarial Board for Counseling and Discipline，美國精算諮詢與紀律委員會）** 是**美國精算職業的紀律與諮詢機構**——**既接受對精算師的投訴並調查，也提供「諮詢」這一預防性渠道**。本條目補的是**「職業紀律與公開紀律記錄」這一形態**：**實測池內「精算倫理／行為準則」形態為 0**（**池內有 [[compliance-officer]] 這類崗位條目、[[three-lines-of-defense]] 這類治理概念，但「職業紀律機構與其公開記錄」此前沒有**）。

⭐ **一個必須寫明的實測細節**：**ABCD 的內容託管在 `actuary.org` 上**——**`abcdboard.org` 實測返回的頁面標題即「Actuarial Board Of Counseling And Discipline - Actuary.org」**；**故本詞條引用的是 `actuary.org` 下的規範路徑**。⚠️ **我最初依據相對連結猜測的 `abcdboard.org/professionalism/…/complaints/` 實測 404**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **「Professionalism」頁 70.1KB**；⭐ **「Public Discipline（公開紀律）」頁 56.4KB**；⭐ **「Complaints（投訴）」頁 60.5KB**；**「Code of Conduct」頁 50.9KB**。**導航與連結逐字實測**：**Professionalism** 下含 **Understanding Professionalism／Code of Conduct／U.S. Qualification Standards／Discussion Papers／⭐Public Discipline／⭐Potentially Disruptive Events／Actuarial Standards Board／Actuarial Board For Counseling And Discipline**；ABCD 分組下含 **about-abcd-responsibilities／standards-guidance／complaints／⭐complaints-flow-chart-of-the-abcds-investigation-process-target-timeline／presentations／abcd-members／contact-the-abcd**；站點另有 **Newsroom／Calendar／Resources** 與 **`/publication/contingencies/`**（會刊 Contingencies，實測含 **「Up to Code」** 專欄）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「職業紀律」這一層**——**精算職業的約束不只來自考試與準則，還來自「被投訴 → 調查 → 處理」這條線**（可與同輪 [[asb-us]] 的準則、[[cia-ica]] 的強制職業操守模組並讀——**「定準則／紀律／教育」是職業自律的三條不同腿**）。**② ⭐ 「公開紀律」欄是本輪最值得注意的一處**——**紀律結果被公開**；與 [[fos-uk]] 的公開裁決庫、[[eiopa-registers]] 的分銷商處罰統計屬同一類做法，**但對象不同：那兩條處理機構與消費者爭議，這一條處理職業成員的執業行為**。**③ 「調查流程與目標時限流程圖」值得單獨注意**——**把「多久內該有下文」寫進流程圖**（**注意：本次只核實該連結存在**）。**④ 「潛在破壞性事件」是少見議題**——**職業操守在極端情形下的適用問題**。**⑤ 會刊設「Up to Code」專欄**——**把職業操守做成連續專欄**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**四個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航與連結逐字實測的分組結構、以及若干子頁連結的存在**，**但未打開任何一條公開紀律記錄、未打開任何投訴案例、未打開流程圖、未打開行為守則或資格標準正文、未打開專欄文章**，故**不能轉述任何紀律案件、處理結果、被處理人、守則條款或調查時限的具體數值**；**② ⭐ 本詞條不主張「公開紀律」欄現有多少條記錄、也不主張其公開範圍**——**本次僅核實該欄目存在（56.4KB）**；**③ 猜測路徑實測 404，真實路徑在 `actuary.org` 下**；**④ 「ABCD 與 AAA、ASB 的關係」本次未核實**——**雖在同一域名下，不據域名推斷制度隸屬**；**⑤ 「諮詢」職能的具體運作方式未核實**（**已標注為推斷**）；**⑥ 56.4KB 中多少是記錄、多少是頁面框架未區分**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** ABCD 提供精算工具、數據或模型**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取導航；**未打開任何紀律記錄、投訴案例、流程圖、守則正文或專欄文章**。

entries.body:
**CRO Forum（Chief Risk Officer Forum，首席风险官论坛）** 是**欧洲大型保险与再保险公司首席风险官组成的论坛**（站点标题实测 **「Home - The CRO Forum」**）。本条目补的是**「CRO 层级的从业者治理组织」这一形态**——⭐ **这里必须说清口径**：**池内「治理」并非空白**（实测已有 [[insurance-governance]]、[[three-lines-of-defense]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[lma-ai-governance]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[australia-ai6-governance]] 等）；**本条补的不是「治理」这个词，而是「由公司首席风险官自己组成、并连续 20 年输出风险议题的行业论坛」这一具体机构形态**（**实测池内此前为 0**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **首页 93.0KB，标题「Home - The CRO Forum」**；⭐ **「About CRO Forum」页 `/about-cro-forum/` 实测 67.7KB**；⭐ **「Publications（出版物）」页 `/category/publications/` 实测 99.7KB，标题「Publications Archives - The CRO Forum」**。**该页实测的筛选结构**：**Filter by Keyword**；⭐ **Filter by Category** 三档为 **「Best practices in risk management（风险管理最佳实践）」**、**「Insights on emerging and long-term risks（新兴与长期风险洞察）」**、**「Risk Management i.r.t regulatory requirements（监管要求下的风险管理）」**；⭐ **Filter by Year 实测覆盖 2026 至 2005**（**共约 22 年**）。**首页实测的当期议题**：⭐ **「AI Governance & Compliance」**，正文实测写明 **「Artificial intelligence is becoming increasingly embedded across the insurance value chain, creating significant opportunities for innovation, efficiency and improved decision-making. At the same time, AI introduces new governance, operational, conduct and third-party risks that require [...]」**，**并带实测时间戳 2026-08-12**。**导航实测**：Home、About us、Members、Publications、News、Contact。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「从业者视角的风险议题连续输出」这一层**——**池内风险议题的来源此前主要是监管者（[[eiopa-registers]]、[[ngfs]]）、学术（[[geneva-papers]]、[[astin-bulletin]]）与行业组织（[[geneva-association]]、[[insurance-europe]]）**，**而 CRO Forum 是「公司首席风险官本人」的集体声音**；**对做企业风险管理（ERM）方向的学生，「实务界的 CRO 在关心什么」与「监管者在要求什么」是两套不同的议程**（可与 [[insurance-governance]]、[[insurance-mrm]]、[[risk-management-ontology]]、[[ggsolvencyii]] 并读）。**② ⭐ 「2005–2026 共 22 年的可筛选档案」是本站少见的时间纵深**——**一个论坛能连续输出二十年，说明议题有生命周期而非一次性报告**；**按年份与类别交叉筛选，可以看出一类议题（如新兴风险）的兴衰曲线**——**这种「档案即研究材料」的用法，与 [[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 的长序列思路同源，只是议题而非数据**。**③ 三个类别本身就是一份 ERM 议题分类法**——**最佳实践 / 新兴与长期风险 / 监管要求**；**注意第三类的措辞「i.r.t regulatory requirements」（with respect to）**——**即它把「监管要求」当作风险管理的输入条件而非全部内容**，**这个立场与纯合规视角有区别**。**④ 实测当期议题是 AI 治理与合规，且时间戳为 2026-08-12**——**说明该论坛的产出是当期而非历史存量**；**可与池内 [[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]]、[[korea-ai-accountability]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 并读——那些是标准、监管态势与立场文件，这一条是行业 CRO 的集体议题**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与两个功能页的存在、标题、页面体量、筛选结构与年份跨度、以及当期议题的正文片段与时间戳**，**但未打开任何一份出版物正文**，因此**不能转述任何一份报告的内容、结论或建议**；**② 「由欧洲大型保险与再保险公司的首席风险官组成」这一表述依据机构名称与站点自述栏目（About us / Members）**，**本次未打开 Members 页核实成员名单与机构范围**——**故本词条不主张成员数量、成员公司名单或其地域范围**；**③ 「共约 22 年」由「Filter by Year 2026…2005」实测推得**，**但本次未核实 2005 与 2006 等早期年份是否确有出版物**（**筛选器列出年份不等于该年必有产出**）；**④ 「AI Governance & Compliance」的正文片段实测以「require [...]」截断**——**故词条内只引用到该处为止，不补全其后的内容**；**⑤ CRO Forum 的法定地位（是否为协会、是否设在某国）、其与 [[geneva-association]]、[[insurance-europe]] 的关系本次未核实**；**⑥ 站点为 WordPress 建站**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** CRO Forum 提供精算软件、模型或可下载数据**。**核实说明**：首页（93.0KB）、`/about-cro-forum/`（67.7KB）、`/category/publications/`（99.7KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取筛选结构与议题片段；**未打开 Members 页、未打开任何出版物正文**。

**The CRO Forum (Chief Risk Officer Forum)** is **a forum of chief risk officers from major European insurers and reinsurers** (measured site title **"Home - The CRO Forum"**). This entry adds the **"CRO-level practitioner governance body"** form — ⭐ **and the scope must be stated precisely**: **"governance" is not a blank in the corpus** (measured items include [[insurance-governance]], [[three-lines-of-defense]], [[governance-mcp]], [[iso-42001-toolkit]], [[lma-ai-governance]], [[irdai-ai-governance]] and [[australia-ai6-governance]]); **what this entry adds is not the word "governance" but the specific institutional form of "an industry forum formed by companies’ own chief risk officers that has published on risk topics for twenty consecutive years"** (**measured zero before this entry**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **homepage is 93.0KB with the measured title "Home - The CRO Forum"**; ⭐ the **"About CRO Forum" page measures 67.7KB**; ⭐ the **"Publications" page `/category/publications/` measures 99.7KB with the title "Publications Archives - The CRO Forum"**. **The filtering structure measured on that page**: **Filter by Keyword**; ⭐ **Filter by Category** with three options — **"Best practices in risk management"**, **"Insights on emerging and long-term risks"** and **"Risk Management i.r.t regulatory requirements"**; ⭐ **Filter by Year measurably spans 2026 down to 2005** (**about 22 years**). **The current topic measured on the homepage**: ⭐ **"AI Governance & Compliance"**, with body text reading **"Artificial intelligence is becoming increasingly embedded across the insurance value chain, creating significant opportunities for innovation, efficiency and improved decision-making. At the same time, AI introduces new governance, operational, conduct and third-party risks that require [...]"**, **carrying a measured timestamp of 2026-08-12**. **Measured navigation**: Home, About us, Members, Publications, News, Contact.

For RIAA: **① it adds a layer of continuous practitioner-authored risk topics** — **the corpus’s risk agenda has come mainly from supervisors ([[eiopa-registers]], [[ngfs]]), academia ([[geneva-papers]], [[astin-bulletin]]) and trade bodies ([[geneva-association]], [[insurance-europe]])**, **whereas the CRO Forum is the collective voice of companies’ own chief risk officers**; **for students working on enterprise risk management, "what practitioners’ CROs care about" and "what supervisors require" are two different agendas** (readable with [[insurance-governance]], [[insurance-mrm]], [[risk-management-ontology]] and [[ggsolvencyii]]). **② ⭐ A filterable archive spanning 2005–2026, about 22 years, is unusual temporal depth here** — **a forum sustaining output for two decades indicates topics with life cycles rather than one-off reports**; **cross-filtering by year and category reveals the rise and fall of a topic class such as emerging risks** — **this "archive as research material" use parallels the long-series thinking of [[cmi-mortality-projections]] and [[human-mortality-db]], only in topics rather than data**. **③ The three categories are themselves an ERM topic taxonomy** — **best practice / emerging and long-term risk / regulatory requirements**; **note the third one’s wording, "i.r.t regulatory requirements" (with respect to)** — **it treats regulatory requirements as an input to risk management rather than the whole of it**, **a stance distinct from a purely compliance-driven view**. **④ The measured current topic is AI governance and compliance, timestamped 2026-08-12** — **indicating current rather than historical output**; **readable with [[iso-42001-toolkit]], [[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]], [[korea-ai-accountability]] and [[aae-ai-act-position]] — those are standards, regulatory postures and position papers; this is the collective agenda of industry CROs**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and two functional pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the filtering structure and year span, and a body fragment and timestamp for the current topic**, **but opened no publication body**, so **no report’s content, conclusion or recommendation can be restated**; **② the statement that it comprises chief risk officers of major European insurers and reinsurers rests on the body’s name and its own section labels (About us / Members)**, **and the Members page was not opened to verify the roster or institutional scope** — **so this entry claims no member count, company list or geographic scope**; **③ "about 22 years" is inferred from the measured "Filter by Year 2026…2005"**, **but whether early years such as 2005 and 2006 actually contain publications was not verified** (**a year listed in a filter does not prove output in that year**); **④ the "AI Governance & Compliance" body fragment measurably truncates at "require [...]"** — **so the entry quotes no further and does not complete it**; **⑤ the CRO Forum’s legal status (whether an association, and where registered) and its relationship to [[geneva-association]] and [[insurance-europe]] were not verified**; **⑥ the site runs on WordPress**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the CRO Forum provides actuarial software, models or downloadable data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (93.0KB), `/about-cro-forum/` (67.7KB) and `/category/publications/` (99.7KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with the filtering structure and topic fragment read verbatim; **no Members page and no publication body was opened**.

**CRO Forum（Chief Risk Officer Forum，首席風險官論壇）** 是**歐洲大型保險與再保險公司首席風險官組成的論壇**（標題實測 **「Home - The CRO Forum」**）。本條目補的是**「CRO 層級的從業者治理組織」這一形態**——⭐ **這裡必須說清口徑**：**池內「治理」並非空白**（實測已有 [[insurance-governance]]、[[three-lines-of-defense]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[lma-ai-governance]] 等）；**本條補的不是「治理」這個詞，而是「由公司首席風險官自己組成、並連續 20 年輸出風險議題的行業論壇」這一具體機構形態**（**實測此前為 0**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **首頁 93.0KB**；⭐ **「About CRO Forum」頁 67.7KB**；⭐ **「Publications」頁 99.7KB**。**該頁實測篩選結構**：**Filter by Keyword**；⭐ **Filter by Category** 三檔為 **「Best practices in risk management」／「Insights on emerging and long-term risks」／「Risk Management i.r.t regulatory requirements」**；⭐ **Filter by Year 實測覆蓋 2026 至 2005**（**約 22 年**）。**首頁實測當期議題**：⭐ **「AI Governance & Compliance」**，正文實測 **「Artificial intelligence is becoming increasingly embedded across the insurance value chain, creating significant opportunities for innovation, efficiency and improved decision-making. At the same time, AI introduces new governance, operational, conduct and third-party risks that require [...]」**，**帶實測時間戳 2026-08-12**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「從業者視角的風險議題連續輸出」**——**池內風險議題來源此前主要是監管者、學術與行業組織，而 CRO Forum 是「公司首席風險官本人」的集體聲音**；**對做 ERM 方向的學生，「實務界 CRO 在關心什麼」與「監管者在要求什麼」是兩套議程**。**② ⭐ 「2005–2026 共約 22 年的可篩選檔案」是本站少見的時間縱深**——**按年份與類別交叉篩選，可看出一類議題的興衰曲線**——**這種「檔案即研究材料」與 [[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 的長序列思路同源**。**③ 三個類別本身就是一份 ERM 議題分類法**；**注意第三類措辭「i.r.t regulatory requirements」——它把監管要求當作風險管理的輸入條件而非全部**。**④ 實測當期議題是 AI 治理與合規，時間戳 2026-08-12**——**可與 [[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 並讀**。

entries.body:
**CIA（Canadian Institute of Actuaries / Institut canadien des actuaires，加拿大精算师协会）** 是**加拿大的精算专业团体**（站点为英法双语，标题实测 **「Homepage - Canadian Institute of Actuaries | Institut canadien des actuaires」**）。本条目补的是**「把职业操守做成必修教育」这一形态**——**同类机构（[[ifoa]]、[[aae]]、[[actuaries-institute]]）多以准则与纪律为主**，而 **CIA 的实测结构显示它同时设有监察机构、行为规则、强制模块与工作坊**。⭐ **与池内已有条目的分工**：**池内已有 [[cia-ai-practitioner]]**，**但那是 CIA 的一则 AI 立场/新闻条目**；**本条目补的是「CIA 这个机构本身及其职业操守治理架构」**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **256.7KB**；⭐ **「Professionalism（职业操守）」页 `/professionalism/` 实测 197.2KB，标题「Professionalism - Canadian Institute of Actuaries | Institut canadien des actuaires」**；⭐ **「Professional conduct（职业行为）」页 `/profession-oversight/professional-conduct-board/` 实测 202.5KB**；⭐ **「Conduct and complaints（行为与投诉）」页 `/professionalism/conduct-and-complaints/` 实测 199.9KB**；⭐ **「Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important（职业行为规则及其重要性）」页 `/being-a-member/rules-of-professional-conduct-and-why-they-are-important/` 实测 251.0KB**；⭐ **「Mandatory Professionalism Module（强制职业操守模块）」页 `/being-a-member/mandatory-professionalism-module/` 实测 235.3KB**；⭐ **「Virtual Professionalism Workshop（虚拟职业操守工作坊）」页 `/courses-and-exams/professionalism-workshop/` 实测 193.8KB**。**导航逐字实测揭示的架构**：**Profession Oversight（职业监察）** 下含 ⭐ **Actuarial Standards Board（精算准则委员会）**、⭐ **Professional Conduct Board（职业行为委员会）**、⭐ **Professionalism and Credential Monitoring Board（职业操守与资格监察委员会）**——**三个并列监察机构**；**Professionalism** 下含 **CPD FAQ** 与 **Conduct and complaints**；**Being a member** 下含 **Continuing Professional Development（持续专业发展）**、**Mandatory Professionalism Module**、**Standards of Practice**、**Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important**；**Courses and exams** 下含 **Professionalism Workshop** 与 ⭐ **Advanced Professionalism and Leadership Course（APLC，高级职业操守与领导力课程）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「职业操守被制度化为一门必修教育」这一形态**——**多数职业团体的职业操守是「写在文件里」**（**如 [[asb-us]] 的准则、同轮 [[abcd]] 的纪律**），**而 CIA 实测设有「强制职业操守模块」与「虚拟职业操守工作坊」，另有 APLC 高级课程**；**即把「操守」做成必须完成的学分与可参加的课程**——**对准备入行、需要做 CPD 的学生，这是「职业操守怎么被考核」的具体样本**（可与 [[ifoa]]、[[actuaries-institute]]、[[cii]]、[[anziif]]、[[loma]] 的继续教育体系对照）。**② ⭐ 「三个并列监察委员会」的架构值得单独注意**——**准则委员会（定标准）／职业行为委员会（管行为）／职业操守与资格监察委员会（查操守与资格）三者分开**；**这与同轮 [[asb-us]]（定准则）与 [[abcd]]（纪律）在美国分属不同机构形成对照：美国是「跨机构分工」，加拿大是「同一协会内设三个委员会」**——**两种自律架构的对照本身就是一个可写的题目**。**③ 「Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important」这一页名值得注意**——**它不只列规则，还解释「为什么重要」**；**对做职业伦理教学的学生，这是一种可直接借鉴的呈现方式**。**④ 英法双语站点**——**对研究双语辖区监管与职业文件编制的学生有参考价值**（**注意：本次仅核实标题同时含英法名称，未核实两语版本内容是否等长**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与六个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航逐字实测的三委员会与教育架构**，**但未打开职业行为规则正文、未打开任何一条投诉或纪律案例、未打开强制模块或工作坊的任何内容、未核实 CPD 的具体学时要求**，因此**不能转述任何规则条款、案件、学时数值或课程内容**；**② ⭐ 「强制性」这一表述依据页面名「Mandatory Professionalism Module」与导航归属（Being a member）**，**本次未打开该页核实其适用范围、豁免条件与考核方式**——**故本词条不主张谁必须完成、何时完成、未完成有何后果**；**③ 「三个并列监察机构」的职能划分依据导航分组名与页面标题**，**本次未打开各委员会页面核实其权责边界**——**故词条内对三者职能的表述（定标准/管行为/查操守与资格）为**依据名称的**合理描述**，**已在此标注**；**④ CIA 与加拿大各省监管、与 [[osfi-canada-data]] 的关系本次未核实**（**池内已有 [[osfi-canada-data]]，但两者关系未核实，故不作关联陈述**）；**⑤ 英法两语版本的内容完整度是否一致未核实**；**⑥ CIA 的会员规模与成立年份未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** CIA 提供精算软件、模型或可下载数据**。**核实说明**：首页（256.7KB）与 `/professionalism/`（197.2KB）、`/profession-oversight/professional-conduct-board/`（202.5KB）、`/professionalism/conduct-and-complaints/`（199.9KB）、`/being-a-member/rules-of-professional-conduct-and-why-they-are-important/`（251.0KB）、`/being-a-member/mandatory-professionalism-module/`（235.3KB）、`/courses-and-exams/professionalism-workshop/`（193.8KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开规则正文、投诉案例、模块或工作坊内容**。
entries.body_en:
**CIA (the Canadian Institute of Actuaries / Institut canadien des actuaires)** is **Canada’s actuarial professional body** (the site is bilingual English and French, with a measured title of **"Homepage - Canadian Institute of Actuaries | Institut canadien des actuaires"**). This entry adds the **"professional conduct institutionalised as required education"** form — **peer bodies ([[ifoa]], [[aae]], [[actuaries-institute]]) lean on standards and discipline**, whereas **CIA’s measured structure shows oversight bodies, conduct rules, a mandatory module and a workshop together**. ⭐ **Division of labour with an existing entry**: **the corpus already holds [[cia-ai-practitioner]]**, **but that is a CIA AI position or news item**; **this entry adds the institution itself and its professionalism governance architecture**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **256.7KB**; ⭐ the **"Professionalism" page `/professionalism/` measures 197.2KB**; ⭐ the **"Professional conduct" page `/profession-oversight/professional-conduct-board/` measures 202.5KB**; ⭐ the **"Conduct and complaints" page measures 199.9KB**; ⭐ the **"Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important" page measures 251.0KB**; ⭐ the **"Mandatory Professionalism Module" page measures 235.3KB**; ⭐ the **"Virtual Professionalism Workshop" page measures 193.8KB**. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the architecture**: under **Profession Oversight** — ⭐ an **Actuarial Standards Board**, ⭐ a **Professional Conduct Board** and ⭐ a **Professionalism and Credential Monitoring Board** (**three parallel oversight bodies**); under **Professionalism** — **CPD FAQ** and **Conduct and complaints**; under **Being a member** — **Continuing Professional Development**, the **Mandatory Professionalism Module**, **Standards of Practice** and the **Rules of Professional Conduct explainer**; under **Courses and exams** — the **Professionalism Workshop** and ⭐ an **Advanced Professionalism and Leadership Course (APLC)**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the form of professional conduct institutionalised as required education** — **most professional bodies keep conduct "written down in a document"** (**such as the standards in [[asb-us]] and the discipline in [[abcd]] this round**), **whereas CIA measurably runs a "Mandatory Professionalism Module", a "Virtual Professionalism Workshop" and an advanced APLC course**; **conduct is thus made into credits that must be completed and courses that can be attended** — **for students preparing to enter the field and needing CPD, this is a concrete sample of how professional conduct is assessed** (comparable with the continuing-education systems of [[ifoa]], [[actuaries-institute]], [[cii]], [[anziif]] and [[loma]]). **② ⭐ The three parallel oversight bodies deserve separate note** — **a standards board (setting standards), a professional conduct board (governing conduct) and a professionalism and credential monitoring board (monitoring conduct and credentials) are held apart**; **this contrasts with the same round’s [[asb-us]] (standards) and [[abcd]] (discipline) sitting in separate US bodies: the US separates across organisations, Canada creates three committees inside one institute** — **the comparison of the two self-regulation architectures is itself a writable topic**. **③ The page name "Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important" is notable** — **it does not merely list rules but explains why they matter**, **a directly borrowable presentation for teaching professional ethics**. **④ A bilingual English-French site** — **useful for students studying bilingual jurisdictions and the drafting of professional documents** (**note: this check verified only that the title carries both names, not that the two language versions are of equal length**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and six pages’ existence, titles and sizes, plus the three-committee and education architecture read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no rules text, no complaint or discipline case, no module or workshop content, and did not establish specific CPD hour requirements**, so **no rule clause, case, hour figure or course content can be restated**; **② ⭐ the word "mandatory" rests on the page name "Mandatory Professionalism Module" and its navigation placement (under Being a member)**, **and that page was not opened to verify scope, exemptions or assessment** — **so this entry claims nothing about who must complete it, by when, or with what consequence**; **③ the division of functions among the three oversight bodies rests on navigation group names and page titles**, **and the individual committee pages were not opened to verify their remits** — **so the descriptions given in the entry (setting standards / governing conduct / monitoring conduct and credentials) are reasonable descriptions from those names, flagged here**; **④ the relationship between CIA, provincial Canadian regulation and [[osfi-canada-data]] was not verified** (**[[osfi-canada-data]] is in the corpus, but the relationship was not verified, so no linkage is asserted**); **⑤ whether the English and French versions are equal in content was not verified**; **⑥ CIA’s membership size and founding year were not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim CIA provides actuarial software, models or downloadable data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (256.7KB) and `/professionalism/` (197.2KB), `/profession-oversight/professional-conduct-board/` (202.5KB), `/professionalism/conduct-and-complaints/` (199.9KB), `/being-a-member/rules-of-professional-conduct-and-why-they-are-important/` (251.0KB), `/being-a-member/mandatory-professionalism-module/` (235.3KB) and `/courses-and-exams/professionalism-workshop/` (193.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no rules text, complaint case, module or workshop content was opened**.

**CIA（Canadian Institute of Actuaries／Institut canadien des actuaires，加拿大精算師協會）** 是**加拿大的精算專業團體**（站點為英法雙語）。本條目補的是**「把職業操守做成必修教育」這一形態**——**同類機構多以準則與紀律為主**，而 **CIA 的實測結構顯示它同時設有監察機構、行為規則、強制模組與工作坊**。⭐ **與池內已有條目的分工**：**池內已有 [[cia-ai-practitioner]]**，**但那是 CIA 的一則 AI 立場／新聞條目**；**本條目補的是「CIA 這個機構本身及其職業操守治理架構」**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **256.7KB**；⭐ **「Professionalism」頁 197.2KB**；⭐ **「Professional conduct」頁 202.5KB**；⭐ **「Conduct and complaints」頁 199.9KB**；⭐ **「Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important」頁 251.0KB**；⭐ **「Mandatory Professionalism Module」頁 235.3KB**；⭐ **「Virtual Professionalism Workshop」頁 193.8KB**。**導航逐字實測架構**：**Profession Oversight** 下含 ⭐ **Actuarial Standards Board**、⭐ **Professional Conduct Board**、⭐ **Professionalism and Credential Monitoring Board**（**三個並列監察機構**）；**Professionalism** 下含 **CPD FAQ** 與 **Conduct and complaints**；**Being a member** 下含 **CPD**、**Mandatory Professionalism Module**、**Standards of Practice**、**Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important**；**Courses and exams** 下含 **Professionalism Workshop** 與 ⭐ **Advanced Professionalism and Leadership Course（APLC）**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「職業操守被制度化為一門必修教育」**——**多數團體把操守「寫在文件裡」，而 CIA 實測設有強制模組與工作坊，另有 APLC 高級課程**；**即把「操守」做成必須完成的學分與可參加的課程**（可與 [[ifoa]]、[[actuaries-institute]]、[[cii]]、[[anziif]]、[[loma]] 的繼續教育體系對照）。**② ⭐ 「三個並列監察委員會」值得單獨注意**——**準則委員會（定標準）／職業行為委員會（管行為）／職業操守與資格監察委員會（查操守與資格）分開**；**與同輪 [[asb-us]]、[[abcd]] 在美國分屬不同機構形成對照：美國是「跨機構分工」，加拿大是「同一協會內設三個委員會」**。**③ 「Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important」這一頁名值得注意**——**不只列規則，還解釋「為什麼重要」**。**④ 英法雙語站點**（**僅核實標題含英法名稱，未核實兩語版本是否等長**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與六個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的三委員會與教育架構**，**但未打開職業行為規則正文、未打開任何投訴或紀律案例、未打開強制模組或工作坊內容、未核實 CPD 學時要求**，故**不能轉述任何規則條款、案件、學時數值或課程內容**；**② ⭐ 「強制性」依據頁面名「Mandatory Professionalism Module」與導航歸屬**，**未打開該頁核實適用範圍、豁免條件與考核方式**——**故不主張誰必須完成、何時完成、未完成有何後果**；**③ 三機構職能劃分依據導航分組名與頁面標題**，**未打開各委員會頁核實權責邊界**——**詞條內對三者職能的表述為依據名稱的合理描述，已在此標注**；**④ CIA 與加拿大各省監管、與 [[osfi-canada-data]] 的關係未核實**（**故不作關聯陳述**）；**⑤ 英法兩語版本內容完整度是否一致未核實**；**⑥ 會員規模與成立年份未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** CIA 提供精算軟件、模型或可下載數據**。**核實說明**：七個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開規則正文、投訴案例、模組或工作坊內容**。
