entries.body:
**联合资信评估股份有限公司（Lianhe Ratings，简称「联合资信」）** 是**中国的信用评级机构**（站点标题实测 **「联合资信评估股份有限公司」**）。本条目补的是**「评级机构」这一形态**——**实测池内 `rating agency`、`credit rating`、`am best`、`fitch`、`moody`、`kbra` 均为 0 条**（**池内最接近的是 [[credendo]]（第 309 轮收录，属出口信用机构的国别风险评级）与 [[transitionmatrix]]、[[credit-risk-analyst]]（工具与岗位）**，**「谁给发债主体与保险公司打分」这一层此前完全空白**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **48.7KB，标题「联合资信评估股份有限公司」**；⭐ **「评级技术 → 评级方法 → 总论相关」页 `/lists/60.html` 实测 17.8KB，标题「总论相关」**——**实测为一个可搜索的方法库**，**分类维度为**：**总论相关 / 国家主权 / 地方政府 / 非金融企业 / ⭐ 金融机构 / 结构融资产品 / 债项及其他**，**并实测列出带日期的具体方法文件**，例如 **「联合资信评估股份有限公司宏观经济评价方法与模型」（2026-08-12）**、**「…行业信用风险分析总论」（2026-08-12）**、**「…工商企业信用评级方法总论」（2026-05-29）**、**「…外部支持评估方法」（2026-05-29）**、**「…资产支持证券评级方法总论」（2025-11-1…）**；⭐ **「金融机构」页 `/lists/39.html` 实测 15.6KB**、**「信用评级定义」页 `/lists/85.html` 实测 16.1KB**、**「非金融企业」页 `/lists/107.html` 实测 26.5KB**。**导航逐字实测揭示的公开结构**：**评级产品** 含 非金融企业 / ⭐**金融机构** / 结构融资产品 / 地方政府 / 国家主权；**评级技术** 含 关于评级、**评级方法**；**评级结果** 含 ⭐**初始评级 / 定期跟踪评级 / 不定期跟踪 / 终止评级 / 延迟评级 / 主动评级 / 国际评级 / 其他**；**信用研究** 含 研究报告 / 出版物 / 视频报告；**信息披露** 含 公司基本信息 / 注册申请文件 / **合规运行报告** / ⭐**评级质量相关报告** / 业务及内控制度 / 重大事项公告 / ⭐**独立性与利益冲突报告** / 其他。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「评级机构公开什么」这一层**——**保险公司的财务实力评级是再保抵押、投资级要求与资本计量的实际输入**，**而池内此前只有「资本要求怎么算」（[[insurance-scr-data]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-spread-risk-scr]]）与「信用风险怎么建模」（[[transitionmatrix]]、[[ifrs9-ecl]]），没有「评级本身从哪来、方法是什么」**；**联合资信的评级方法库按「金融机构」单列一类**，**对做保险公司信用分析的学生是可直接查的中文方法来源**。**② ⭐ 「评级结果按评级生命周期分类」是本轮最值得注意的一处**——**初始 / 定期跟踪 / 不定期跟踪 / 终止 / 延迟 / 主动**——**即不只公布一个等级，而是把「这个等级是怎么被持续维护的」一并公开**；**这与池内 [[susep-sro]] 的「逐笔登记」思路相通但对象不同：那条是交易数据，这条是评级状态的变更历史**。**③ ⭐ 「国际评级」单列为一个独立类目**——**与国内评级并列**，**说明该机构的国内等级尺度与国际等级尺度是分开的两套**；**这对做跨境信用比较的学生是一个重要的实务认知**（**这一点在同轮 [[dagong]] 也有相同设计，两家一致，故不属孤例**）。**④ 信息披露栏含「评级质量相关报告」与「独立性与利益冲突报告」**——**评级机构把自身的质量与独立性拿出来披露**；**对研究「谁来监督评级机构」这一问题的学生，这是被监管者的自我披露样本**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、方法库的分类维度与五份带日期的具体方法文件名、以及导航逐字实测的评级结果与信息披露类目**，**但未打开任何一份评级方法正文、任何一条评级结果、任何一份评级质量或独立性报告、任何研究报告**，因此**不能转述任何评级方法的实质内容、任何主体的等级、任何违约率数据或报告结论**；**② ⭐ 方法库中「金融机构」一类下是否含保险专项方法本次未核实**——**故本词条不主张其有保险专章**；**③ 「主要服务中国市场」这一判断依据站点语言（简体中文）、机构名称与「国家主权 / 地方政府」等类目**，**本次未打开任何一页说明其监管资质或业务范围**，**故词条内不主张其牌照或资质**；**④ 五份方法文件的日期来自列表页实测，未打开文件核对版本**；**⑤ 站点提供「返回旧版」入口**，**旧版内容本次未核实**；**⑥ 本次未核实该公司与国际评级机构的关系或其评级是否被境外采用**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张**该机构提供精算工具、模型或可下载数据集**。**核实说明**：首页（48.7KB）、`/lists/60.html`（17.8KB）、`/lists/39.html`（15.6KB）、`/lists/85.html`（16.1KB）、`/lists/107.html`（26.5KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题、分类与文件名；**未打开任何方法文件、评级结果或披露报告**。
entries.body_en:
**Lianhe Ratings (联合资信评估股份有限公司)** is **a Chinese credit rating agency** (measured site title **"联合资信评估股份有限公司"**). This entry adds the **"rating agency"** form — **`rating agency`, `credit rating`, `am best`, `fitch`, `moody` and `kbra` all measured zero** (the closest corpus items are [[credendo]], added in round 309 as an export credit agency’s country risk ratings, and the tools or roles [[transitionmatrix]] and [[credit-risk-analyst]]) — **"who assigns the scores to issuers and insurers" was entirely absent**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **48.7KB with the measured title "联合资信评估股份有限公司"**; ⭐ the **"Methods → General" page `/lists/60.html` measures 17.8KB with the measured title "总论相关"**, **measurably a searchable methodology library** whose **categories are**: **general**, **sovereign**, **local government**, **non-financial corporates**, ⭐ **financial institutions**, **structured finance** and **debt instruments and others**, **with measured dated methodology documents listed**, such as **"宏观经济评价方法与模型" (2026-08-12)**, **"行业信用风险分析总论" (2026-08-12)**, **"工商企业信用评级方法总论" (2026-05-29)**, **"外部支持评估方法" (2026-05-29)** and **"资产支持证券评级方法总论" (2025-11-…)**; ⭐ the **"Financial institutions" page `/lists/39.html` measures 15.6KB**, the **"Credit rating definitions" page `/lists/85.html` measures 16.1KB** and the **"Non-financial corporates" page `/lists/107.html` measures 26.5KB**. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the disclosure structure**: **Rating products** covers non-financial corporates, ⭐ **financial institutions**, structured finance, local government and sovereigns; **Rating technology** covers about ratings and **rating methodologies**; **Rating results** covers ⭐ **initial ratings / periodic reviews / ad-hoc reviews / withdrawals / delayed / unsolicited / international / other**; **Credit research** covers research reports, publications and video reports; **Disclosure** covers company basics, registration filings, **compliance operation reports**, ⭐ **rating-quality reports**, business and internal control systems, major-event announcements, ⭐ **independence and conflict-of-interest reports** and others.

For RIAA: **① it adds "what a rating agency discloses"** — **insurers’ financial strength ratings are real inputs to reinsurance collateral, investment-grade requirements and capital measurement**, **whereas the corpus previously had only "how capital requirements are computed" ([[insurance-scr-data]], [[ggsolvencyii]], [[sii-spread-risk-scr]]) and "how credit risk is modelled" ([[transitionmatrix]], [[ifrs9-ecl]]), with no entry on where ratings come from or what their methods are**; **Lianhe’s methodology library lists financial institutions as its own category**, **a directly checkable Chinese-language method source for students analysing insurer credit**. **② ⭐ Classifying rating results by rating lifecycle is the round’s most notable feature** — **initial / periodic review / ad-hoc review / withdrawal / delayed / unsolicited** — **i.e. not just a grade but also how that grade is continuously maintained**; **this parallels the operation-level registry thinking of [[susep-sro]], though the object differs: that is transaction data, this is the change history of a rating status**. **③ ⭐ "International ratings" is listed as a separate category** — **alongside domestic ratings**, **indicating that the firm’s domestic scale and international scale are two distinct sets**; **an important practical point for cross-border credit comparison** (**the same design appears in [[dagong]] this round, so it is not an isolated case**). **④ The disclosure section carries "rating-quality reports" and "independence and conflict-of-interest reports"** — **a rating agency disclosing its own quality and independence**; **a sample of regulated-entity self-disclosure for students studying who supervises the raters**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the method library’s categories, five dated methodology document titles, and the rating-result and disclosure categories read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no methodology text, no rating result, no rating-quality or independence report and no research report**, so **no methodology substance, issuer grade, default figure or report conclusion can be restated**; **② ⭐ whether the "financial institutions" category contains an insurance-specific methodology was not verified** — **so this entry does not claim an insurance chapter**; **③ the judgement that it serves mainly the Chinese market rests on site language, the firm’s name and categories such as sovereign and local government**, **and no page describing its regulatory licence or business scope was opened**, **so the entry claims no licence or qualification**; **④ the five methodology dates come from measured list pages; the files were not opened to check versions**; **⑤ the site offers a "back to old version" entry, and the old version was not verified**; **⑥ its relationship with international rating agencies, or whether its ratings are used abroad, was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the agency provides actuarial tools, models or downloadable datasets**. **Verification note**: the homepage (48.7KB), `/lists/60.html` (17.8KB), `/lists/39.html` (15.6KB), `/lists/85.html` (16.1KB) and `/lists/107.html` (26.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles, categories and file names read verbatim; **no methodology file, rating result or disclosure report was opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**聯合資信評估股份有限公司（Lianhe Ratings，簡稱「聯合資信」）** 是**中國的信用評級機構**（站點標題實測 **「聯合資信評估股份有限公司」**）。本條目補的是**「評級機構」這一形態**——**實測池內 `rating agency`、`credit rating`、`am best`、`fitch`、`moody`、`kbra` 均為 0 條**（**最接近的是 [[credendo]]（第 309 輪收錄）與 [[transitionmatrix]]、[[credit-risk-analyst]]**，**「誰給發債主體與保險公司打分」這一層此前完全空白**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **48.7KB**；⭐ **「評級技術 → 評級方法 → 總論相關」頁 `/lists/60.html` 17.8KB**——**實測為可搜索的方法庫**，**分類為**：**總論相關／國家主權／地方政府／非金融企業／⭐金融機構／結構融資產品／債項及其他**，**並實測列出帶日期的具體方法文件**（**「宏觀經濟評價方法與模型」2026-08-12**、**「行業信用風險分析總論」2026-08-12**、**「工商企業信用評級方法總論」2026-05-29**、**「外部支持評估方法」2026-05-29**、**「資產支持證券評級方法總論」2025-11-…**）；⭐ **「金融機構」頁 15.6KB**、**「信用評級定義」頁 16.1KB**、**「非金融企業」頁 26.5KB**。**導航逐字實測**：**評級結果** 含 ⭐**初始評級／定期跟蹤評級／不定期跟蹤／終止評級／延遲評級／主動評級／國際評級／其他**；**信息披露** 含 公司基本信息／註冊申請文件／**合規運行報告**／⭐**評級質量相關報告**／業務及內控制度／重大事項公告／⭐**獨立性與利益衝突報告**／其他。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「評級機構公開什麼」**——**保險公司財務實力評級是再保抵押、投資級要求與資本計量的實際輸入**，**而池內此前只有「資本要求怎麼算」與「信用風險怎麼建模」，沒有「評級從哪來、方法是什麼」**；**聯合資信的評級方法庫把「金融機構」單列一類**。**② ⭐ 「評級結果按評級生命週期分類」是本輪最值得注意的一處**——**初始／定期跟蹤／不定期跟蹤／終止／延遲／主動**——**不只要一個等級，還把「等級如何被持續維護」一併公開**。**③ ⭐ 「國際評級」單列為獨立類目**——**與國內評級並列**，**說明國內等級尺度與國際等級尺度是分開的兩套**（**同輪 [[dagong]] 亦有相同設計**）。**④ 信息披露含「評級質量相關報告」與「獨立性與利益衝突報告」**——**評級機構把自身質量與獨立性拿出來披露**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與四個頁面的存在、標題、體量、方法庫分類、五份帶日期的具體方法文件名、導航逐字實測的評級結果與信息披露類目**，**但未打開任何方法正文、任何一條評級結果、任何評級質量或獨立性報告、任何研究報告**，故**不能轉述任何方法實質、任何主體等級、任何違約率或報告結論**；**② ⭐ 方法庫「金融機構」類下是否含保險專項方法未核實**——**故不主張有保險專章**；**③ 「主要服務中國市場」依據站點語言、機構名稱與類目**，**未打開任何一頁說明其監管資質**，**故不主張其牌照或資質**；**④ 方法文件日期來自列表頁實測，未打開核對版本**；**⑤ 設有「返回舊版」入口，舊版未核實**；**⑥ 與國際評級機構的關係未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張**該機構提供精算工具、模型或可下載數據集**。**核實說明**：五個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取；**未打開任何方法文件、評級結果或披露報告**。

entries.body:
**大公国际资信评估有限公司（Dagong Global Credit Rating）** 是**中国的信用评级机构**（站点标题实测 **「大公国际资信评估有限公司」**）。本条目与同轮 [[lianhe-ratings]] 同为**中国评级机构**，**按形态重复纪律，本条目补上该形态此前没有的东西：把「评级方法的历史版本」单独存档，并把评级公告做成可按月归档的 PDF**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **72.1KB，标题「大公国际资信评估有限公司」**；⭐ **「评级方法总论」页实测 21.2KB**；⭐ **「评级方法」页实测 30.7KB**；⭐ **「信用等级符号及定义」页实测 21.4KB**；**「评级定义」页**（实测存在）；⭐ **「历史评级方法与制度」页实测 34.5KB**——**把历史版本的方法单独存档**；⭐ **「评级结果分析（评级分布）」页实测 34.7KB**；⭐ **「国际评级（主权信用评级）」页**（实测存在）。**导航逐字实测揭示的公开结构**：**评级动态** 含 初始评级 / 定期跟踪 / 不定期跟踪 / 主动评级 / 终止评级 / **评级报告到期** / 信誉评级 / 其他评级；**信用研究** 含 债市研究 / 宏观研究 / 行业研究 / 专题研究 / **大公季刊**；**投资者服务** 含 服务介绍 / 调研路演 / 论坛活动 / 投资者反馈；**产品与服务** 含 债项评级 / 主体信用评级 / 信用评价 / **绿色金融服务** / **比一比小程序**；**评级技术** 含 评级定义 / 评级方法总论 / 评级方法 / 信用等级符号及定义 / 国际评级；**国际评级** 含 主权信用评级 / 主权研究报告 / 企业信用评级 / 投资环境评价；**信息披露** 含 **合规运行报告** / 评级结果分析 / 注册文件。⭐ **评级公告的归档结构实测**：公告以 **PDF** 形式放在按类别与年月分层的路径下（实测到 **`/dggj/content_file/ratingNotice/initialRating/2026/9/…pdf` 多份**，以及 **`/otherRatings/2026/7/…pdf`、`/otherRatings/2026/8/…pdf`**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「评级方法的历史版本可查」这一做法**——**评级方法会改，而判断一个旧评级是用哪一版方法做的，需要历史版本**；**大公把「历史评级方法与制度」单独存档**，**这与池内 [[asf-romania]]、[[eiopa-registers]] 的「现行规则」不同——那条是规则原文，这条是规则的时间序列**；**对做评级可比性或回测的学生，这是一个具体的方法论档案样本**。**② ⭐ 评级公告按「类别 + 年月」分层归档为 PDF**——**实测到 2026 年 9 月的初始评级公告多份、2026 年 7-8 月的其他评级公告**；**这意味着「某月有哪些新评级」是可查的**；**与 [[lianhe-ratings]] 的「按评级生命周期分类的结果页」形成两种公开方式：一个是数据库式检索、一个是按月归档的公告流**。**③ 「评级结果分布分析」页是评级机构对自身评级分布的分析**——**评级分布（多少 AAA、多少 AA）是评级尺度是否过宽的直接证据**，**对做评级质量评估的学生是少见的自披露材料**。**④ 「国际评级」单列含主权信用评级、主权研究报告、企业信用评级、投资环境评价**——**与 [[lianhe-ratings]] 一致，两家中国机构都把「国际评级」与国内评级分开**；**这对理解「国内 AAA 与国际 AAA 不是同一尺度」这一实务要点是关键证据**（**本词条与同轮 [[lianhe-ratings]] 一致，故该观察有两个独立样本**）。**⑤ 「绿色金融服务」与「比一比小程序」是两个非典型栏目**——**前者说明 ESG/绿色评级已成为中国评级机构的业务线**，**后者是一个面向投资者的工具**（**具体功能本次未核实**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与六个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、导航逐字实测的公开结构、以及评级公告 PDF 的分层路径形态**，**但未打开任何一份评级方法正文、任何一份评级公告 PDF、任何一份评级分布数据、任何主权研究报告**，因此**不能转述任何方法条款、任何主体等级、任何评级分布比例或任何报告结论**；**② ⭐ 公告 PDF 的数量、覆盖月份范围与内容本次均未核实**——**只核实到该类 URL 形态存在（含 2026 年 9 月初始评级与 2026 年 7-8 月其他评级）**；**③ 「评级结果分析（评级分布）」页 34.7KB 为实测体量，其中多少是数据、多少是页面框架未区分**；**④ 「比一比小程序」的功能、数据来源与是否可用本次未核实**——**词条内仅表述为「面向投资者的工具」**；**⑤ 该机构的监管资质、股东背景与成立年份本次未核实**；**⑥ 站点为简体中文，无英文版本次核实**（**与同轮 [[r-i]] 的英文站形成对照**）；**⑦** 本词条**不主张**该机构提供精算工具、模型或可机读的数据集（**其公告为 PDF 而非结构化数据**）。**核实说明**：首页（72.1KB）、`/dggj/ratingManage/ratingWaysPandect/A009007002index_1.htm`（21.2KB）、`/dggj/ratingManage/ratingWays/A009007003index_1.htm`（30.7KB）、`/dggj/ratingManage/ratingLevelSignDefin/A009007004index_1.htm`（21.4KB）、`/dggj/infoPublish/historicalRatingMeth/A009009009index_1.htm`（34.5KB）、`/dggj/infoPublish/ratingResult/distributionOfRatin/A009009002001index_1.htm`（34.7KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开任何方法正文、公告 PDF、分布数据或研究报告**。
entries.body_en:
**Dagong Global Credit Rating (大公国际资信评估有限公司)** is **a Chinese credit rating agency** (measured site title **"大公国际资信评估有限公司"**). This entry shares the **Chinese rating agency** form with [[lianhe-ratings]] in the same round, and **under the form-repetition discipline it adds what that form lacked: historical versions of rating methodologies archived separately, and rating notices issued as month-archived PDFs**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **72.1KB with the measured title "大公国际资信评估有限公司"**; ⭐ the **"Methodology overview" page measures 21.2KB**; ⭐ the **"Rating methodologies" page measures 30.7KB**; ⭐ the **"Credit rating symbols and definitions" page measures 21.4KB**; a **"Rating definitions" page** measurably exists; ⭐ the **"Historical rating methodologies and systems" page measures 34.5KB** — **historical methodology versions archived separately**; ⭐ the **"Rating result analysis (rating distribution)" page measures 34.7KB**; ⭐ an **"International ratings (sovereign credit ratings)" page** measurably exists. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the disclosure structure**: **Rating actions** covers initial ratings, periodic reviews, ad-hoc reviews, unsolicited ratings, withdrawals, **expiring rating reports**, creditworthiness ratings and other ratings; **Credit research** covers bond-market, macro, industry and thematic research and a **Dagong quarterly**; **Investor services**; **Products and services** covers debt and issuer credit ratings, credit assessments, **green finance services** and a **"compare" mini-program**; **Rating technology** covers rating definitions, methodology overviews, methodologies, symbol definitions and international ratings; **International ratings** covers sovereign credit ratings, sovereign research reports, corporate credit ratings and investment-environment assessments; **Disclosure** covers **compliance operation reports**, rating result analysis and registration documents. ⭐ **The measured rating-notice archive structure**: notices are PDFs under paths layered by category and year-month (measurably **multiple `/dggj/content_file/ratingNotice/initialRating/2026/9/…pdf`**, plus **`/otherRatings/2026/7/…pdf`** and **`/otherRatings/2026/8/…pdf`**).

For RIAA: **① it adds "historical methodology versions are checkable"** — **methodologies change, and judging which version produced an old rating requires the historical versions**; **Dagong archives "historical rating methodologies and systems" separately**, **unlike the current-rules entries in [[asf-romania]] and [[eiopa-registers]] — that is rule text; this is the time series of rules**; **for rating comparability or backtesting work this is a concrete methodology-archive sample**. **② ⭐ Rating notices are archived as PDFs layered by category and year-month** — **measured: multiple initial-rating notices for September 2026 and other-rating notices for July–August 2026**; **so "what new ratings appeared in a given month" is checkable**; **this contrasts with [[lianhe-ratings]]’ results pages classified by rating lifecycle: one is database-like retrieval, the other a monthly notice stream**. **③ The "rating distribution" page is the agency’s own analysis of its rating distribution** — **how many AAAs versus AAs is direct evidence of whether a rating scale is stretched**, **uncommon self-disclosure for students assessing rating quality**. **④ The separate "international ratings" section contains sovereign credit ratings, sovereign research reports, corporate credit ratings and investment-environment assessments** — **consistent with [[lianhe-ratings]]; both Chinese agencies separate international from domestic ratings**, **key evidence for the practical point that a domestic AAA and an international AAA are not the same scale** (**this entry and [[lianhe-ratings]] give two independent samples**). **⑤ "Green finance services" and a "compare" mini-program are two atypical sections** — **the former shows ESG and green rating as a business line for Chinese agencies**, **the latter an investor-facing tool** (**its function was not verified**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and six pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the disclosure structure read verbatim from navigation, and the layered URL pattern of rating-notice PDFs**, **but opened no methodology text, no rating notice PDF, no rating distribution data and no sovereign research report**, so **no methodology clause, issuer grade, distribution share or report conclusion can be restated**; **② ⭐ the number of notice PDFs, their month coverage and their content were not verified** — **only the existence of that URL class (including September 2026 initial ratings and July–August 2026 other ratings)**; **③ the 34.7KB size of the rating-distribution page is measured, but data versus page frame was not distinguished**; **④ the function, data source and availability of the "compare" mini-program were not verified** — **the entry describes it only as an investor-facing tool**; **⑤ the agency’s regulatory qualification, ownership and founding year were not verified**; **⑥ the site is Simplified Chinese with no verified English version** (**contrasting with the English site of [[r-i]] in the same round**); **⑦** this entry **does not claim the agency provides actuarial tools, models or machine-readable datasets** (**its notices are PDFs rather than structured data**). **Verification note**: the homepage (72.1KB), the methodology overview (21.2KB), rating methodologies (30.7KB), symbol definitions (21.4KB), historical methodologies (34.5KB) and rating result analysis (34.7KB) pages were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no methodology text, notice PDF, distribution data or research report was opened**.

對 RIAA：**① 補上「評級方法的歷史版本可查」**——**評級方法會改，判斷舊評級用哪一版方法需要歷史版本**；**大公把「歷史評級方法與制度」單獨存檔**，**與 [[asf-romania]]、[[eiopa-registers]] 的「現行規則」不同——那條是規則原文，這條是規則的時間序列**。**② ⭐ 評級公告按「類別 + 年月」分層歸檔為 PDF**——**與 [[lianhe-ratings]] 的「按生命週期分類的結果頁」形成兩種公開方式**。**③ 「評級結果分佈分析」是評級機構對自身評級分佈的分析**——**多少 AAA、多少 AA 是評級尺度是否過寬的直接證據**。**④ 「國際評級」單列含主權信用評級等**——**與 [[lianhe-ratings]] 一致，兩家都把國際評級與國內評級分開**；**這對理解「國內 AAA 與國際 AAA 不是同一尺度」是關鍵證據**。**⑤ 「綠色金融服務」與「比一比小程序」是兩個非典型欄目**（**小程序功能本次未核實**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與六個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的公開結構、以及公告 PDF 的分層路徑形態**，**但未打開任何方法正文、任何公告 PDF、任何分佈數據、任何主權研究報告**，故**不能轉述任何方法條款、主體等級、分佈比例或報告結論**；**② ⭐ 公告 PDF 的數量、覆蓋月份與內容未核實**——**只核實到該類 URL 形態存在**；**③ 34.7KB 中多少是數據、多少是頁面框架未區分**；**④ 「比一比小程序」的功能、數據來源與可用性未核實**；**⑤ 監管資質、股東背景與成立年份未核實**；**⑥ 站點為簡體中文，無英文版本次核實**（**與同輪 [[r-i]] 的英文站形成對照**）；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張**該機構提供精算工具、模型或可機讀數據集（**其公告為 PDF 而非結構化數據**）**。**核實說明**：六個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開任何方法正文、公告 PDF、分佈數據或研究報告**。

entries.body:
**R&I（Rating and Investment Information, Inc.，格付投資情報センター）** 是**日本的信用评级机构**（英文站标题实测 **「Credit Rating Service｜Rating and Investment Information, Inc.」**）。本条目与同轮两家中国机构构成**「日本 vs 中国」的评级机构对照**，**且它补的是本轮完全不同的东西：定量信用数据**——⭐ **实测该站在「Rating Studies & Data（评级研究与数据）」下公开自 1978 财年起的日本企业违约率与评级迁移矩阵**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「Rating Methodologies（评级方法论）」页 `/en/rating/about/rating_method.html` 实测 38.3KB，标题「Rating Methodologies｜Credit Rating Service｜Rating and Investment Information, Inc.」**；⭐ **「Default Rates and Rating Transition Matrices（违约率与评级迁移矩阵）」页 `/en/rating/data/defaults.html` 实测 26.8KB**，**面包屑实测为 Home > Rating Studies & Data > Default Rates and Rating Transition Matrices**，**页面实测列出两类内容**：**「Japanese Corporate Default Rates and Rating Transition Matrices（日本企业违约率与评级迁移矩阵）」** 与 **「Rating Transition Matrix for Securitized Products（证券化产品评级迁移矩阵）」**；⭐ **该页实测列出的历史版本含**：**（FY1978-2014）[Jun. 30, 2014]**、**（FY1978-2013）[Jun. 28, 2013]**、**（FY1978-2012）[Jun. 28, 2013]**，以及 ⭐ **最新一期「<Report> Japanese Corporate Default Rates and Rating Transition Matrices (FY1978-2025)」与「<Data Tables> …」[Jun. 30, 2026]**——**即同一系列同时提供「报告」与「数据表」两种格式，时间跨度为 FY1978 至 FY2025（约 47 年）**。**首页实测另有实时内容**：⭐ **「Rating Actions & Comments」带实测更新时间戳「Sep. 10, 2026 15:30」与按「Segments／title」组织的条目**（实测样例为 Corporations 类的 Issuer Rating Affirmed AA Stable / CP Rating Affirmed a-1）。**导航与链接实测另含**：**`/en/rating/about/definition.html`（评级定义）**、**`/en/rating/about/process.html`（评级流程）**、**`/en/rating/about/rating_grant.html`**、**`/en/rating/about/rating_provision.html`**、**`/en/rating/how/decision.html`**、**`/en/rating/how/risk.html`**、**`/en/rating/data/financial.html`**、**`/en/rating/data/history.html`**、**`/en/rating/data/rating.html`**、**`/en/rating/data/reports.html`**、**`/en/rating/esg/index.html`**、**`/en/rating/products/data_service/index.html`**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐ 「FY1978–2025 违约率与评级迁移矩阵」是可直接用于信用风险建模的定量数据**——**评级迁移矩阵是信用风险资本计量（如内部评级法）与多期违约概率估计的核心输入**；**池内已有工具层的 [[transitionmatrix]] 与资本层的 [[sii-spread-risk-scr]]、[[insurance-scr-data]]、[[ifrs9-ecl]]**，**而本条提供的是「真实的、近半个世纪的历史迁移与违约数据」**——**从「怎么算」到「用真实数据算」之间，这是一块此前缺失的实测基础**。**② ⭐ 「报告 + 数据表」双格式是一个值得注意的披露选择**——**报告便于理解方法，数据表便于直接使用**；**且同一系列自 2012、2013、2014 年起的旧版仍可查**，**即历史版本不被覆盖**——**这与同轮 [[dagong]] 的「历史评级方法与制度」存档是两种不同的「留痕」思路**（**一个留方法版本，一个留数据版本**）。**③ 英文站使该资源对本站读者可直接使用**——**同轮两家中国机构均为简体中文**，**R&I 提供英文方法论与英文数据说明**；**对做跨国信用比较或需要英文引用来源的学生，这是本轮最可用的一份**。**④ 「证券化产品评级迁移矩阵」单列**——**说明该机构把企业类与结构化产品类的迁移数据分开**；**对做 ABS/CLO 相关信用分析的学生是额外的可用数据**。**⑤ `how/risk.html` 与 `about/process.html` 的存在说明它公开「评级如何作出、风险如何评估」的过程**（**本次仅核实链接存在**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与两个核心页面的存在、标题、页面体量、面包屑路径、两类数据的名称、四个带日期的历史版本与最新一期（FY1978-2025，Jun. 30, 2026）、以及十余个子页链接的存在**，**但未下载任何数据表、未打开任何报告、未打开任何评级方法论正文**，因此**不能转述任何违约率数值、任何迁移概率、任何方法论条款或任何评级结论**；**② ⭐ 「FY1978-2025」与发布日期「Jun. 30, 2026」来自列表页实测**，**但本次未核实该系列的更新频率是否为年度、也未核实数据表的字段与格式（Excel/CSV/PDF）**；**③ 「约 47 年」由 FY1978 至 FY2025 推算**，**属算术推断而非页面自述**；**④ ⭐ 本次未核实该公司是否对保险公司单独发布评级或保险专项方法论**——**首页修订动态样例为 Corporates 类**，**故本词条不主张其有保险专章或保险评级列表**；**⑤ 「英文站」这一表述指 `/en/` 路径下的内容；站点同时提供日文版**（首页实测含「Japanese」切换），**日文版内容完整度本次未核实**；**⑥ 该机构与日本监管的关系、其评级是否被用于监管目的本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张**该机构提供精算软件或保险定价工具**。**核实说明**：首页（15.9KB）、`/en/rating/about/rating_method.html`（38.3KB）、`/en/rating/data/defaults.html`（26.8KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题、面包屑、数据名称与版本日期；**未下载数据表、未打开报告或方法论正文**。
entries.body_en:
**R&I (Rating and Investment Information, Inc.)** is **a Japanese credit rating agency** (measured English-site title **"Credit Rating Service｜Rating and Investment Information, Inc."**). With the two Chinese agencies in the same round it forms a **Japan-versus-China rating agency contrast**, **and it adds something entirely different: quantitative credit data** — ⭐ **measurably, under "Rating Studies & Data" the site publishes Japanese corporate default rates and rating transition matrices going back to fiscal 1978**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"Rating Methodologies" page `/en/rating/about/rating_method.html` measures 38.3KB**; ⭐ the **"Default Rates and Rating Transition Matrices" page `/en/rating/data/defaults.html` measures 26.8KB**, with a measured breadcrumb of **Home > Rating Studies & Data > Default Rates and Rating Transition Matrices**, **listing two classes of content**: **"Japanese Corporate Default Rates and Rating Transition Matrices"** and **"Rating Transition Matrix for Securitized Products"**; ⭐ **measured historical editions include (FY1978-2014) [Jun. 30, 2014]**, **(FY1978-2013) [Jun. 28, 2013]** and **(FY1978-2012) [Jun. 28, 2013]**, plus ⭐ the latest **"<Report> Japanese Corporate Default Rates and Rating Transition Matrices (FY1978-2025)"** and **"<Data Tables> …" [Jun. 30, 2026]** — **the same series offered in both report and data-table form, spanning FY1978 to FY2025 (about 47 years)**. **The homepage measurably carries current content**: ⭐ a **"Rating Actions & Comments"** block with a measured timestamp **"Sep. 10, 2026 15:30"** and entries organised by **Segments / title** (a measured sample being a Corporates item: Issuer Rating Affirmed AA Stable / CP Rating Affirmed a-1). **Measured navigation and links also include** `/en/rating/about/definition.html`, `/en/rating/about/process.html`, `/en/rating/about/rating_grant.html`, `/en/rating/about/rating_provision.html`, `/en/rating/how/decision.html`, `/en/rating/how/risk.html`, `/en/rating/data/financial.html`, `/en/rating/data/history.html`, `/en/rating/data/rating.html`, `/en/rating/data/reports.html`, `/en/rating/esg/index.html` and `/en/rating/products/data_service/index.html`.

For RIAA: **① ⭐ "FY1978–2025 default rates and rating transition matrices" is quantitative data directly usable for credit risk modelling** — **rating transition matrices are a core input to credit risk capital measurement (such as the internal ratings-based approach) and to multi-period default probability estimation**; **the corpus already has the tool-layer [[transitionmatrix]] and the capital-layer [[sii-spread-risk-scr]], [[insurance-scr-data]] and [[ifrs9-ecl]]**, **whereas this supplies real historical transition and default data covering nearly half a century** — **between "how to compute it" and "computing it on real data" sat a missing empirical foundation**. **② ⭐ Offering both a report and data tables is a notable disclosure choice** — **the report aids understanding of method, the tables allow direct use**; **and old editions from 2012, 2013 and 2014 remain available, so historical versions are not overwritten** — **a different way of leaving a trail from the historical-methodology archive of [[dagong]] in the same round** (**one preserves method versions, the other data versions**). **③ The English site makes this resource directly usable for this wiki’s readers** — **both Chinese agencies in this round are Simplified Chinese**, **while R&I provides English methodologies and English data descriptions**; **for cross-border credit comparison or English-language citation, this is the most usable item of the round**. **④ The transition matrix for securitized products is listed separately** — **the agency keeps corporate and structured-product transition data apart**; **extra usable data for students analysing ABS or CLO credit**. **⑤ The presence of `how/risk.html` and `about/process.html` indicates it discloses how ratings are decided and risks assessed** (**only the existence of those links was verified**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and two core pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the breadcrumb path, the names of the two data classes, four dated historical editions and the latest (FY1978-2025, Jun. 30, 2026), plus the existence of a dozen subpage links**, **but downloaded no data table, opened no report and opened no methodology text**, so **no default rate, transition probability, methodology clause or rating conclusion can be restated**; **② ⭐ "FY1978-2025" and the "Jun. 30, 2026" publication date come from the measured list page**, **but whether the series updates annually, and the tables’ fields and format (Excel, CSV or PDF), were not verified**; **③ "about 47 years" is arithmetic from FY1978 to FY2025**, **an inference rather than a site statement**; **④ ⭐ whether the firm rates insurers separately or publishes insurance-specific methodology was not verified** — **the measured homepage action sample was a Corporates item**, **so this entry claims no insurance chapter or insurer rating list**; **⑤ "English site" refers to content under `/en/`; the site also offers Japanese** (a measured "Japanese" switch), **and the completeness of the Japanese version was not verified**; **⑥ the firm’s relationship with Japanese regulation and whether its ratings are used for regulatory purposes were not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the firm provides actuarial software or insurance pricing tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (15.9KB), `/en/rating/about/rating_method.html` (38.3KB) and `/en/rating/data/defaults.html` (26.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles, breadcrumb, data names and edition dates read verbatim; **no data table, report or methodology text was opened**.

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與兩個核心頁面的存在、標題、體量、麵包屑、兩類數據名稱、四個帶日期歷史版本與最新一期、以及十餘個子頁鏈接的存在**，**但未下載任何數據表、未打開任何報告或方法論正文**，故**不能轉述任何違約率數值、遷移概率、方法條款或評級結論**；**② ⭐ 版本與日期來自列表頁實測**，**但更新頻率、數據表字段與格式未核實**；**③ 「約 47 年」由 FY1978 至 FY2025 推算，屬算術推斷**；**④ ⭐ 該公司是否對保險公司單獨發布評級或保險專項方法論未核實**——**首頁實測樣例為 Corporates 類**，**故不主張有保險專章或保險評級列表**；**⑤ 「英文站」指 `/en/` 路徑內容；站點同時提供日文版**，**日文版完整度未核實**；**⑥ 與日本監管的關係、評級是否用於監管目的未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張**該機構提供精算軟件或保險定價工具**。**核實說明**：三個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題、麵包屑、數據名稱與版本日期；**未下載數據表、未打開報告或方法論正文**。

entries.body:
**KBRA（Kroll Bond Rating Agency，美国信用评级机构）** 的**保险部门页面**——本条目补的是**「保险财务实力评级（Insurance Financial Strength）的公开发行人库」这一形态**：**实测池内 `rating agency` / `insurance financial strength` 均为 0**，**而这是本轮四家机构中唯一在页面上直接把「保险财务实力」写进标题的一家**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「Insurance Credit Ratings」页 `/sectors/insurance/issuers` 实测 90.7KB，标题实测为「Insurance Credit Ratings | Insurance Financial Strength」**；**面包屑实测为 Home > Insurance > Insurance Issuers | Publications**。⭐ **该页实测提供三重筛选**：**Subsector（子行业）** 含 **Composite/Multi-Line（综合/多线）**、**Financial Guaranty（金融担保）**、**Life/Health/Annuity（寿险/健康/年金）**、**Non-Life/Property and Casualty（非寿险/财产险）**、**Reinsurance（再保险）**；**Title Rating Action（评级动作）** 含 **Assigned（首次授予）** 与 **Surveillance（跟踪监测）**；**Geography（地区）** 含 **Europe（Belgium / France / Gibraltar / Guernsey / Luxembourg / United Kingdom）** 与 **North America（Bermuda / Cayman Islands / Puerto Rico / United States）**；另有 **Filter by keyword**。⭐ **页面实测列出具体发行人条目及其评级动作与日期**，例如 **「California Earthquake Authority 10 Sep 2026 Surveillance Non-Life/Property and Casualty United States」**、**「US Coastal Insurance Company 4 Sep 2026 Surveillance Non-Life/Property and Casualty United States」**、**「US Coastal Property & Casualty Insurance Company 4 Sep 2026 Surveillance …」**。**站点行业列表实测**：**abs / cmbs / corporates / financial-institutions / funds / insurance / project-finance / public-finance / rmbs / sovereigns**，**其中 insurance 下另有 `issuers` 与 `publications` 两个子路径**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐ 补上「保险财务实力评级的公开发行人库」这一形态**——**本轮另外三家（[[lianhe-ratings]]、[[dagong]]、[[r-i]]）以「方法论 + 评级结果/违约数据」为主**，**而 KBRA 公开的是「我评了哪些保险公司」这一可筛选名单**；**对做保险公司信用分析或再保对手方评估的学生，这是一个可直接查找的发行人清单**（**可与 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[sii-spread-risk-scr]] 的资本计量口径并读——那些算「一家公司要留多少资本」，这条给「这家公司的财务实力被打了什么」**）。**② ⭐ 「子行业五分法」本身就是一份保险公司类型清单**——**综合/多线、金融担保、寿险健康年金、非寿险产险、再保险**；**注意其中单列了「金融担保（Financial Guaranty）」与「再保险」**——**这两类是保险业中信用风险结构最特殊的两类**（**金融担保是保单化的信用增强，再保险是保险公司的对手方**），**评级机构把它们与寿险/产险并列，说明其风险口径不同**；**对做险种风险比较的学生，这个分类可直接引用**。**③ ⭐ 「地区筛选」实测覆盖欧洲六地与北美四地（含百慕大、开曼、波多黎各）**——**百慕大、开曼与波多黎各的出现说明了保险发行人注册地的特殊性**（**离岸与属地监管辖区**）；**对做跨境保险监管或离岸保险市场研究的学生，这是一个具体的地理分布线索**。**④ 发行人条目带最近评级动作日期（实测 2026 年 9 月 4 日与 10 日）**——**说明该列表是当期维护的**；**「Assigned vs Surveillance」的区分与同轮 [[lianhe-ratings]] 的「初始评级 vs 定期跟踪」异曲同工，但 KBRA 把它做成筛选器而非类目页**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**该页的存在、标题、页面体量、面包屑、三重筛选的完整取值、以及若干发行人条目及其日期**，**但未打开任何一份评级报告、未打开 `publications` 子页内容、未核实该库的发行人总数或完整名单**，因此**不能转述任何发行人的具体等级、评级展望、评级理由或报告结论**——**实测看到的条目只含名称、日期、动作类型、子行业与地区，未含等级符号**；**② ⭐ 本次未核实该库是否可按「发行人名称」直接检索、是否需要登录**（**首页实测有 `Log In` 与 `Sign Up` 入口**）；**③ 本次未核实 KBRA 的监管资质（如是否为美国 SEC 认可的全国性统计评级机构）与成立年份**；**④ 「该页列出的是 KBRA 自己评级的发行人」属依据页面归属的合理判断**，**本词条不主张该名单覆盖市场上所有保险公司评级**；**⑤ 站点另有 Private Credit、Publications、Topics & Insights 等栏目，本次均未打开**；**⑥ 我最初猜测的 `/insurance` 路径实测为「Page Not Found」**——**真实路径为 `/sectors/insurance/issuers`**（**又一次「不要猜路径」**）；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** KBRA 提供精算工具、模型或可下载数据集**。**核实说明**：`/sectors/insurance/issuers`（90.7KB）与首页均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取筛选取值与发行人条目；`/insurance` 实测为 Page Not Found；**未打开任何评级报告或 publications 子页**。
entries.body_en:
**KBRA (Kroll Bond Rating Agency)** — its **insurance sector page**. This entry adds the **"public issuer database for insurance financial strength ratings"** form: **`rating agency` and `insurance financial strength` both measured zero**, **and this is the only one of this round’s four agencies whose page title carries "Insurance Financial Strength" directly**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"Insurance Credit Ratings" page `/sectors/insurance/issuers` measures 90.7KB with the measured title "Insurance Credit Ratings | Insurance Financial Strength"**; **the measured breadcrumb is Home > Insurance > Insurance Issuers | Publications**. ⭐ **The page measurably offers three filters**: **Subsector** covering **Composite/Multi-Line**, **Financial Guaranty**, **Life/Health/Annuity**, **Non-Life/Property and Casualty** and **Reinsurance**; **Title Rating Action** covering **Assigned** and **Surveillance**; **Geography** covering **Europe (Belgium, France, Gibraltar, Guernsey, Luxembourg, United Kingdom)** and **North America (Bermuda, Cayman Islands, Puerto Rico, United States)**; plus **Filter by keyword**. ⭐ **The page measurably lists concrete issuer rows with action type and date**, such as **"California Earthquake Authority 10 Sep 2026 Surveillance Non-Life/Property and Casualty United States"**, **"US Coastal Insurance Company 4 Sep 2026 Surveillance Non-Life/Property and Casualty United States"** and **"US Coastal Property & Casualty Insurance Company 4 Sep 2026 Surveillance …"**. **Measured sector list**: **abs, cmbs, corporates, financial-institutions, funds, insurance, project-finance, public-finance, rmbs, sovereigns**, with **insurance carrying `issuers` and `publications` subpaths**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐ it adds the "public issuer database of insurance financial strength ratings"** — **the other three agencies this round ([[lianhe-ratings]], [[dagong]], [[r-i]]) centre on methodology plus rating results or default data**, **whereas KBRA discloses a filterable list of which insurers it rates**; **for insurer credit analysis or reinsurance counterparty assessment this is a directly searchable issuer list** (readable with the capital-measurement entries [[insurance-scr-data]] and [[sii-spread-risk-scr]] — **those compute how much capital a company must hold; this tells you how its financial strength has been scored**). **② ⭐ The five-way subsector split is itself a list of insurer types** — **composite/multi-line, financial guaranty, life/health/annuity, non-life P&C, reinsurance**; **note that "financial guaranty" and "reinsurance" are listed separately** — **two classes with the most distinctive credit risk structures in insurance** (**financial guaranty is credit enhancement in policy form; reinsurance is an insurer’s counterparty**), **and the agency placing them alongside life and P&C indicates a different risk lens**; **a directly citable classification for comparing risk by line**. **③ ⭐ The geography filter measurably covers six European and four North American jurisdictions including Bermuda, the Cayman Islands and Puerto Rico** — **their presence illustrates the special registration geographies of insurance issuers** (**offshore and territorial supervisory jurisdictions**); **a concrete geographic lead for students studying cross-border insurance regulation or offshore insurance markets**. **④ Issuer rows carry their latest rating-action date (measured 4 and 10 September 2026)** — **indicating a currently maintained list**; **the Assigned versus Surveillance distinction parallels [[lianhe-ratings]]’ initial versus periodic review, but KBRA implements it as a filter rather than category pages**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the page’s existence, title, size, breadcrumb, the complete values of the three filters, and several issuer rows with dates**, **but opened no rating report, opened no content on the `publications` subpath, and did not establish the database’s total issuer count or full list**, so **no issuer’s rating level, outlook, rationale or report conclusion can be restated** — **the measured rows carry only name, date, action type, subsector and geography, with no rating symbols**; **② ⭐ whether the database is searchable directly by issuer name, or requires login, was not verified** (**the homepage measurably carries `Log In` and `Sign Up`**); **③ KBRA’s regulatory status (for example whether it is a US SEC-recognised nationally recognised statistical rating organisation) and its founding year were not verified**; **④ that the page lists issuers rated by KBRA is a reasonable judgement from the page’s own placement**, **and this entry does not claim the list covers all insurer ratings in the market**; **⑤ the site’s other sections such as Private Credit, Publications and Topics & Insights were not opened**; **⑥ the path I first guessed, `/insurance`, measured "Page Not Found"** — **the real path is `/sectors/insurance/issuers`** (**another "do not guess paths"**); **⑦** this entry **does not claim KBRA provides actuarial tools, models or downloadable datasets**. **Verification note**: `/sectors/insurance/issuers` (90.7KB) and the homepage were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with filter values and issuer rows read verbatim; `/insurance` measured Page Not Found; **no rating report or publications subpage was opened**.

對 RIAA：**① ⭐ 補上「保險財務實力評級的公開發行人庫」**——**本輪另外三家以「方法論 + 評級結果／違約數據」為主，而 KBRA 公開的是「我評了哪些保險公司」這一可篩選名單**；**對做保險公司信用分析或再保對手方評估的學生，這是可直接查找的發行人清單**（可與 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[sii-spread-risk-scr]] 並讀——**那些算「要留多少資本」，這條給「財務實力被打了什麼」**）。**② ⭐ 「子行業五分法」本身就是一份保險公司類型清單**；**注意單列了「金融擔保」與「再保險」**——**這兩類信用風險結構最特殊**，**評級機構把它們與壽險／產險並列，說明風險口徑不同**。**③ ⭐ 地區篩選涵蓋歐洲六地與北美四地（含百慕大、開曼、波多黎各）**——**說明保險發行人註冊地的特殊性**，**對做跨境監管或離岸保險市場研究是具體線索**。**④ 發行人條目帶最近評級動作日期（實測 2026-09-04 與 09-10）**——**說明列表是當期維護的**。

entries.body:
**CILA（Chartered Institute of Loss Adjusters，英国特许公估师学会）** 是**英国公估师（loss adjuster，保险公估人）的专业团体**（站点标题实测 **「Home - CILA | Chartered Institute of Loss Adjusters」**）。本条目补的是**「理赔侧专业资格」这一形态**——**实测池内 `loss adjuster` / `公估` / `claims professional` 等相关条目为 0**（**池内理赔侧此前几乎全是技术条目：[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[claims-fraud-guardian]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[payer-agent-audit]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[workshop-loss-reserv-fraud]] 等，缺「谁来做理赔、他们如何被认证」这一层**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **124.1KB**；⭐ **「About us」页 `/about-us/` 实测 113.3KB**；⭐ **「What We Do（我们做什么）」页 `/about-us/what-we-do/` 实测 111.6KB**；⭐ **「Guide to Professional Conduct（专业行为准则）」页 `/about-us/guide-to-professional-conduct/` 实测 121.8KB**；⭐ **「Membership（会员）」页 `/membership/` 实测 112.2KB**；⭐ **「Types of Membership（会员类型）」页 `/membership/types-of-membership/` 实测 114.5KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的治理与会员结构**：**About us** 下含 **Who Are We**、**CILA Council（理事会）**、**CILA Committees（委员会）**、**Meet the Team**、**What We Do**、⭐ **The Charter（特许状）**、⭐ **Bye-Laws（章程细则）**、⭐ **Guide to Professional Conduct**、**Our History & CILA Arms**；**Membership** 下含 **Why Join CILA**、**Types of Membership**、**Join Us**、**Reactivate your membership**；⭐ **并实测存在按公估专长组织的会员条目路径**，例如 **`/members/commercial-property-adjuster/…`**（**即会员可按「商业财产公估」这类专长被检索**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「理赔侧的职业与资格」这一整层**——**池内保险职业侧此前几乎只有精算（[[ifoa]]、[[cia-ica]]、[[asb-us]] 等）与中介（[[insurance-broker]]、[[marsh]]、[[howden]]）**，**而「理赔/公估」这条职业线此前完全空白**；**对考虑进入理赔、公估或损失理算方向的学生，这是该职业线在英国的专业团体入口**（**同时可与精算职业自律的对照并读：精算以 [[asb-us]] 定准则、[[abcd]] 管纪律，而公估以 Chartered Institute + 专业行为准则 + 会员类型构成另一套体系**）。**② ⭐ 「按专长的会员名录」是一个可直接使用的资源**——**实测路径形如 `/members/commercial-property-adjuster/…`**，**即可以按「商业财产公估」等专长找会员**；**这与池内 [[marsh]]、[[howden]] 等中介公司条目属不同颗粒度——那些是机构，这是**个人执业者**层面**；**对做理赔资源寻源或案例研究的读者是可检索的**（**注意：本次实测到的路径中含 `anom-lastname` 这样的占位性名称，故本词条只主张「存在按专长组织的会员路径」，不主张名录的规模或完整性**）。**③ 「特许状 + 章程细则 + 专业行为准则」三件套是职业治理的完整样本**——**这与池内 [[three-lines-of-defense]]（治理概念）、[[insurance-governance]] 属不同层面：那些是公司治理，这是职业团体对自己的治理**。**④ 该学会是本轮 [[fuedi]] 的英国与爱尔兰成员协会**——**两条目构成「国家标准机构 ← 区域伞状组织」的一对**（**该成员关系由 FUEDI 站点导航逐字实测确认**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与五个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、导航逐字实测的治理与会员结构、以及按专长组织的会员路径形态**，**但未打开特许状、章程细则、专业行为准则的正文、未打开任何会员记录、未核实会员等级的具体要求与费用**，因此**不能转述任何准则条款、会员等级条件、考试要求或执业限制**；**② ⭐ 本词条不主张该学会设有考试或资格认证体系**——**「Types of Membership」页本次只核实其存在（114.5KB）**，**是不是通过考试入会、是否有实习要求，本次均未核实**；**③ `anom-lastname` 这类占位名称提示该名录可能有匿名或样例条目**，**故本词条不主张名录的真实规模**；**④ 该学会的皇家特许状取得时间、与英国监管的关系本次未核实**；**⑤ 「公估师」这一中文译法的通行度本次未核实**——**词条内以英文原词 loss adjuster 为准并给出中文对译**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张**该学会提供精算工具、数据或模型**。**核实说明**：首页（124.1KB）、`/about-us/`（113.3KB）、`/about-us/what-we-do/`（111.6KB）、`/about-us/guide-to-professional-conduct/`（121.8KB）、`/membership/`（112.2KB）、`/membership/types-of-membership/`（114.5KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开特许状、章程细则、准则正文或任何会员记录**。
entries.body_en:
**CILA (the Chartered Institute of Loss Adjusters)** is **the UK professional body for loss adjusters** (measured site title **"Home - CILA | Chartered Institute of Loss Adjusters"**). This entry adds the **"professional qualification on the claims side"** form — **`loss adjuster` and `claims professional` measured zero** (**the corpus’s claims side held almost only technical items: [[claims-triage-mcp]], [[claims-fraud-guardian]], [[digital-claims-management]], [[payer-agent-audit]], [[evidence-review-claims]], [[workshop-loss-reserv-fraud]] and others, with no layer for who does claims work and how they are certified**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **124.1KB**; ⭐ the **"About us" page measures 113.3KB**; ⭐ the **"What We Do" page measures 111.6KB**; ⭐ the **"Guide to Professional Conduct" page measures 121.8KB**; ⭐ the **"Membership" page measures 112.2KB**; ⭐ the **"Types of Membership" page measures 114.5KB**. **Navigation and links read verbatim reveal the governance and membership structure**: under **About us** — **Who Are We**, **CILA Council**, **CILA Committees**, **Meet the Team**, **What We Do**, ⭐ **The Charter**, ⭐ **Bye-Laws**, ⭐ **Guide to Professional Conduct** and **Our History & CILA Arms**; under **Membership** — **Why Join CILA**, **Types of Membership**, **Join Us** and **Reactivate your membership**; ⭐ **and member entry paths organised by adjusting specialism measurably exist**, such as **`/members/commercial-property-adjuster/…`** (**i.e. members can be found by a specialism such as commercial property adjusting**).

For RIAA: **① it adds the whole layer of careers and qualifications on the claims side** — **the corpus’s insurance-profession side previously held almost only actuarial bodies ([[ifoa]], [[cia-ica]], [[asb-us]]) and intermediaries ([[insurance-broker]], [[marsh]], [[howden]])**, **while claims and loss adjusting was entirely absent**; **for students considering claims, adjusting or loss assessment, this is the entry point to that career line in the UK** (**and it reads as a contrast with actuarial self-regulation: actuaries set standards through [[asb-us]] and discipline through [[abcd]], whereas adjusters work through a Chartered Institute with a professional conduct guide and defined membership grades**). **② ⭐ The member directory by specialism is a directly usable resource** — **measured paths take the form `/members/commercial-property-adjuster/…`**, **so members can be found by specialism**; **this is a different granularity from the intermediary-firm entries [[marsh]] and [[howden]] — those are organisations; this is the individual practitioner level**; **searchable for claims resourcing or case-study work** (**note: the measured path contained a placeholder name such as `anom-lastname`, so this entry claims only that specialism-based member paths exist, not the directory’s size or completeness**). **③ Charter, bye-laws and a professional conduct guide form a complete sample of professional governance** — **different from the governance concepts in [[three-lines-of-defense]] and [[insurance-governance]]: those are corporate governance, this is a professional body governing itself**. **④ The institute is FUEDI’s United Kingdom and Ireland member association** ([[fuedi]] this round) — **the two entries form a "national standards body ← regional umbrella" pair** (**the membership is confirmed by FUEDI’s navigation read verbatim**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and five pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the governance and membership structure read verbatim from navigation, and the existence of specialism-based member paths**, **but opened no charter, bye-law or conduct-guide text, no member record, and did not establish membership grade requirements or fees**, so **no conduct clause, membership condition, examination requirement or practice restriction can be restated**; **② ⭐ this entry does not claim the institute runs an examination or certification system** — **only the existence of the "Types of Membership" page (114.5KB) was verified**, **and whether entry is by examination or requires practical experience was not established**; **③ placeholder names such as `anom-lastname` suggest the directory may include anonymised or sample entries**, **so this entry claims no real directory size**; **④ when the royal charter was granted and the institute’s relationship with UK regulation were not verified**; **⑤ the currency of the Chinese rendering for loss adjuster was not verified** — **the entry gives the English term as authoritative with a Chinese gloss**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim the institute provides actuarial tools, data or models**. **Verification note**: the homepage (124.1KB), `/about-us/` (113.3KB), `/about-us/what-we-do/` (111.6KB), `/about-us/guide-to-professional-conduct/` (121.8KB), `/membership/` (112.2KB) and `/membership/types-of-membership/` (114.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no charter, bye-law, conduct text or member record was opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**CILA（Chartered Institute of Loss Adjusters，英國特許公估師學會）** 是**英國公估師（loss adjuster）的專業團體**。本條目補的是**「理賠側專業資格」這一形態**——**實測池內 `loss adjuster` / `公估` / `claims professional` 等相關條目為 0**（**池內理賠側此前幾乎全是技術條目，缺「誰來做理賠、他們如何被認證」這一層**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **124.1KB**；⭐ **`/about-us/` 113.3KB**；⭐ **`/about-us/what-we-do/` 111.6KB**；⭐ **`/about-us/guide-to-professional-conduct/` 121.8KB（專業行為準則）**；⭐ **`/membership/` 112.2KB**；⭐ **`/membership/types-of-membership/` 114.5KB**。**導航逐字實測**：**About us** 含 Who Are We／CILA Council／CILA Committees／Meet the Team／What We Do／⭐**The Charter（特許狀）**／⭐**Bye-Laws（章程細則）**／⭐**Guide to Professional Conduct**／Our History & CILA Arms；**Membership** 含 Why Join CILA／Types of Membership／Join Us／Reactivate；⭐ **並實測存在按公估專長組織的會員路徑**，例如 **`/members/commercial-property-adjuster/…`**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「理賠側的職業與資格」這一整層**——**池內保險職業側此前幾乎只有精算與中介**，**而「理賠／公估」這條職業線此前完全空白**（**並可與精算職業自律對照：精算以 [[asb-us]] 定準則、[[abcd]] 管紀律，公估則以特許學會 + 專業行為準則 + 會員類型構成另一套體系**）。**② ⭐ 「按專長的會員名錄」是可直接使用的資源**——**與 [[marsh]]、[[howden]] 等中介公司條目屬不同顆粒度：那些是機構，這是個人執業者層面**（**注意：本次實測到的路徑含 `anom-lastname` 這類佔位名稱，故只主張存在按專長組織的會員路徑，不主張名錄規模**）。**③ 「特許狀 + 章程細則 + 專業行為準則」三件套是職業治理的完整樣本**——**與 [[three-lines-of-defense]]、[[insurance-governance]] 的公司治理屬不同層面**。**④ 該學會是本輪 [[fuedi]] 的英國與愛爾蘭成員協會**——**兩條目構成「國家標準機構 ← 區域傘狀組織」一對**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與五個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的治理與會員結構、以及按專長組織的會員路徑形態**，**但未打開特許狀、章程細則、準則正文、任何會員記錄、未核實會員等級要求與費用**，故**不能轉述任何準則條款、會員條件、考試要求或執業限制**；**② ⭐ 本詞條不主張該學會設有考試或資格認證體系**——**「Types of Membership」頁本次只核實其存在（114.5KB）**；**③ 佔位名稱提示名錄可能有匿名或樣例條目**，**故不主張名錄真實規模**；**④ 皇家特許狀取得時間與與英國監管的關係未核實**；**⑤ 「公估師」這一中文譯法的通行度未核實**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張**該學會提供精算工具、數據或模型**。**核實說明**：六個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開特許狀、章程細則、準則正文或任何會員記錄**。

entries.body:
**FUEDI（The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts，欧洲公估专家联合会）** 是**欧洲公估行业的伞状组织**（站点标题实测 **「FUEDI | The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts」**）。本条目补的是**「区域伞状公估组织 + 各国协会名录」这一形态**——**实测池内该形态为 0**，**而它同时提供一份「欧洲各国公估协会有哪些」的现成地图**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **147.1KB**；⭐ **「All Associations（全部协会）」页 `/member-associations/all-associations/` 实测 207.2KB**；⭐ **「Members Organisation Qualification（成员组织与资格）」页 `/members-organisation-qualification/` 实测 294.6KB**（**本条目四页中体量最大**）。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的成员协会名单（共 12 个国家级协会，逐国列出）**：**Austria AFILA（奥地利）**、**Belgium GEBCAI（比利时）**、**Denmark DALAX（丹麦）**、**France FEDEA（法国）**、**Germany BTE（德国）**、**Greece HALA（希腊）**、**Italy AIPAI（意大利）**、**Luxembourg CEL（卢森堡）**、**The Netherlands NIVRE（荷兰）**、**Portugal CNPR（葡萄牙）**、**Spain APCAS（西班牙）**、⭐ **UK & Ireland CILA（英国与爱尔兰，即同轮 [[cila]]）**。**导航逐字实测揭示的其余结构**：**About Us** 下含 **About Fuedi**、**Benefits**、⭐ **Constitution（宪章）**、⭐ **Executive Committee（执行委员会）**、**History**、**Qualifications**、**Member Associations**；⭐ **A Loss Adjusters Role（公估师的角色）**；⭐ **Catastrophe Committee（巨灾委员会）**；**News & Events** 下含 **News**、**Publications**、**Events**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「欧洲公估行业的协会地图」这一现成资源**——**12 个国家级协会逐国列出（含各自的缩写：AFILA／GEBCAI／DALAX／FEDEA／BTE／HALA／AIPAI／CEL／NIVRE／CNPR／APCAS／CILA）**；**对做欧洲理赔市场或跨境公估协调的学生，这张名单本身就是研究起点**（**可与池内 [[aae]] 的欧洲精算协会名录对照——两者都是「欧洲各国协会名录」，但一个是精算、一个是公估**）。**② ⭐ 与同轮 [[cila]] 构成「国家协会 ← 区域伞状」的完整一对**——**且这一关系是双向往返的：CILA 条目说明其会员类型与资格，FUEDI 条目说明它在 12 国中的位置**；**这是池内少见的「同轮两条目互为上下游」的结构**。**③ ⭐ 「巨灾委员会（Catastrophe Committee）」值得单独注意**——**公估行业设巨灾专门委员会，说明「巨灾后的理赔能力」被当作行业级议题**；**这与池内巨灾侧（[[perils-ied]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[oasislmf]]、[[openquake-engine]] 等**模型与**资本**工具）完全互补——**那些算损失，这个管「巨灾来了谁来定损」**；**对做巨灾风险全链条的学生，这是一个此前缺失的「人力与组织」环节**。**④ 「Qualifications」页 294.6KB 是本站点体量最大的页面**——**提示该联合会在各国资格互认或资格说明上有较多内容**（**注意：本次未打开正文，故不主张其有互认机制**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与两个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、导航逐字实测的 12 国成员协会名单与站点结构**，**但未打开宪章、执行委员会页、资格页正文、巨灾委员会页、任何成员协会页面或任何出版物**，因此**不能转述任何宪章条款、资格要求、互认安排、委员会职能或协会详情**；**② ⭐ 12 国名单来自导航逐字实测与各国页 URL 实测**，**但本次未打开任何一国协会页面核实其名称、规模或现状**——**「AFILA」等缩写的全称本次未核实**；**③ 「Qualifications」页 294.6KB 为实测体量**，**其中有多少是资格内容、多少是页面框架未区分**；**④ 「是否有资格互认机制」本次未核实，故本词条不主张**；**⑤ 该联合会的法定地位（是否为协会）、成立年份与秘书处所在地本次未核实**；**⑥ 该站点为 WordPress 建站，且含 cookie 同意组件**（实测见 `cookiedatabase.org` 引用）；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** FUEDI 提供精算工具、数据或可下载名录**。**核实说明**：首页（147.1KB）、`/member-associations/all-associations/`（207.2KB）、`/members-organisation-qualification/`（294.6KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题、导航与 12 国名单（**另单独重取首页至独立文件名以确认名单，避免临时文件复用污染**）；**未打开宪章、委员会页、资格正文、成员协会页或出版物**。
entries.body_en:
**FUEDI (The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts)** is **the umbrella body for the European loss adjusting industry** (measured site title **"FUEDI | The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts"**). This entry adds the **"regional umbrella adjusting body with a national association directory"** form — **that form measured zero**, **and it supplies a ready map of which loss adjusting associations exist across Europe**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **147.1KB**; ⭐ the **"All Associations" page `/member-associations/all-associations/` measures 207.2KB**; ⭐ the **"Members Organisation Qualification" page `/members-organisation-qualification/` measures 294.6KB** (**the largest of the round’s four pages**). **The member association list read verbatim from navigation and links (twelve national associations, listed country by country)**: **Austria AFILA**, **Belgium GEBCAI**, **Denmark DALAX**, **France FEDEA**, **Germany BTE**, **Greece HALA**, **Italy AIPAI**, **Luxembourg CEL**, **The Netherlands NIVRE**, **Portugal CNPR**, **Spain APCAS** and ⭐ **UK & Ireland CILA** (**the same round’s [[cila]]**). **The rest of the structure read verbatim**: under **About Us** — **About Fuedi**, **Benefits**, ⭐ **Constitution**, ⭐ **Executive Committee**, **History**, **Qualifications** and **Member Associations**; ⭐ **A Loss Adjusters Role**; ⭐ **Catastrophe Committee**; under **News & Events** — **News**, **Publications** and **Events**.

For RIAA: **① it adds a ready resource: the map of European adjusting associations** — **twelve national associations listed country by country with their abbreviations (AFILA, GEBCAI, DALAX, FEDEA, BTE, HALA, AIPAI, CEL, NIVRE, CNPR, APCAS, CILA)**; **for work on European claims markets or cross-border adjusting coordination, the list is itself a research starting point** (**comparable with the European actuarial directory in [[aae]] — both are directories of national European associations, one actuarial, one adjusting**). **② ⭐ With [[cila]] it forms a complete "national association ← regional umbrella" pair** — **and the relationship runs both ways: the CILA entry explains its membership grades and governance, while the FUEDI entry places it among twelve countries**; **an uncommon structure in the corpus where two entries in the same round are each other’s up- and downstream**. **③ ⭐ The "Catastrophe Committee" deserves separate note** — **an adjusting industry running a dedicated catastrophe committee indicates that "claims capacity after a catastrophe" is treated as an industry-level issue**; **this is fully complementary to the corpus’s catastrophe side** (modelling and capital tools such as [[perils-ied]], [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[oasislmf]] and [[openquake-engine]]) — **those compute the loss; this governs who assesses it**; **a previously missing "people and organisation" link in the catastrophe chain**. **④ The "Qualifications" page at 294.6KB is the site’s largest page** — **suggesting substantial content on qualification descriptions or mutual recognition across countries** (**note: the body was not opened, so no mutual recognition mechanism is claimed**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and two pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the twelve-country member list and site structure read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no constitution, executive committee page, qualifications text, catastrophe committee page, member association page or publication**, so **no constitutional clause, qualification requirement, recognition arrangement, committee remit or association detail can be restated**; **② ⭐ the twelve-country list comes from measured navigation and country-page URLs**, **but no individual association page was opened to verify its name, size or current status** — **the expansions of abbreviations such as "AFILA" were not verified**; **③ the 294.6KB size of the Qualifications page is measured**, **but content versus page frame was not distinguished**; **④ whether a mutual recognition mechanism exists was not verified, so none is claimed**; **⑤ the federation’s legal status, founding year and secretariat location were not verified**; **⑥ the site runs on WordPress with a cookie-consent component** (a measured `cookiedatabase.org` reference); **⑦** this entry **does not claim FUEDI provides actuarial tools, data or a downloadable directory**. **Verification note**: the homepage (147.1KB), `/member-associations/all-associations/` (207.2KB) and `/members-organisation-qualification/` (294.6KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with the title, navigation and twelve-country list read verbatim (**the homepage was additionally re-fetched to a separate filename to confirm the list, avoiding contamination from temp-file reuse**); **no constitution, committee page, qualification text, association page or publication was opened**.

**FUEDI（The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts，歐洲公估專家聯合會）** 是**歐洲公估行業的傘狀組織**（標題實測 **「FUEDI | The European Federation of Loss Adjusting Experts」**）。本條目補的是**「區域傘狀公估組織 + 各國協會名錄」這一形態**——**實測該形態為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **147.1KB**；⭐ **「All Associations」頁 207.2KB**；⭐ **「Members Organisation Qualification」頁 294.6KB**（**本輪四頁中體量最大**）。**導航與連結逐字實測的成員協會名單（共 12 個，逐國列出）**：**Austria AFILA／Belgium GEBCAI／Denmark DALAX／France FEDEA／Germany BTE／Greece HALA／Italy AIPAI／Luxembourg CEL／The Netherlands NIVRE／Portugal CNPR／Spain APCAS**，⭐ **UK & Ireland CILA（即同輪 [[cila]]）**。**導航逐字實測其餘結構**：**About Us** 含 About Fuedi／Benefits／⭐**Constitution**／⭐**Executive Committee**／History／**Qualifications**／Member Associations；⭐ **A Loss Adjusters Role**；⭐ **Catastrophe Committee**；**News & Events** 含 News／Publications／Events。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「歐洲公估行業的協會地圖」這一現成資源**——**12 個國家級協會逐國列出**（可與 [[aae]] 的歐洲精算協會名錄對照——**兩者都是「歐洲各國協會名錄」，一個精算、一個公估**）。**② ⭐ 與同輪 [[cila]] 構成「國家協會 ← 區域傘狀」的完整一對**——**且關係雙向往返**，**是池內少見的「同輪兩條目互為上下游」結構**。**③ ⭐ 「巨災委員會」值得單獨注意**——**公估行業設巨災專門委員會，說明「巨災後的理賠能力」被當作行業級議題**；**與池內巨災側（模型與資本工具）完全互補——那些算損失，這個管「巨災來了誰來定損」**，**是此前缺失的「人力與組織」環節**。**④ 「Qualifications」頁 294.6KB 為本站最大頁**（**未打開正文，故不主張有互認機制**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與兩個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的 12 國名單與站點結構**，**但未打開憲章、執行委員會頁、資格頁正文、巨災委員會頁、任何成員協會頁或出版物**，故**不能轉述任何憲章條款、資格要求、互認安排、委員會職能或協會詳情**；**② ⭐ 12 國名單來自導航與各國頁 URL 實測**，**但未打開任何一國協會頁核實其名稱、規模或現狀**——**「AFILA」等縮寫全稱未核實**；**③ 294.6KB 中多少是資格內容、多少是頁面框架未區分**；**④ 是否有資格互認機制未核實，故不主張**；**⑤ 法定地位、成立年份與秘書處所在地未核實**；**⑥ 站點為 WordPress 建站並含 cookie 同意組件**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** FUEDI 提供精算工具、數據或可下載名錄**。**核實說明**：三個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取（**另單獨重取首頁至獨立檔名以確認名單，避免臨時檔案複用污染**）；**未打開憲章、委員會頁、資格正文、成員協會頁或出版物**。

entries.body:
**CLM（Claims and Litigation Management Alliance，美国理赔与诉讼管理联盟）** 是**美国理赔与诉讼管理领域的跨行业专业组织**（站点标题实测 **「Claims and Litigation Management Alliance」**）。本条目补的是**「理赔作为跨行业专业共同体」这一形态**——**与同轮 [[cila]]（个人资格认证）和 [[fuedi]]（欧洲区域伞状）不同，CLM 补的是「理赔与诉讼管理这条线上多方（保险公司、外部律师、服务商、企业）共同的专业组织与教育体系」**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **66.6KB，标题「Claims and Litigation Management Alliance」**；**公开可见页面实测含** **`/IndustryResourceDirectory`（60.8KB）**、**`/resourceecourses`**、**`/event/calendar`**、**`/InPersonEvents`**、**`/VirtualEvents`**、**`/Register/Fellow`**。⭐ **⚠️ 一个必须说明的技术事实**：**该站导航由 JavaScript 拼装**（**实测 href 中含 `+ item.URL +` 这类模板片段**），**故导航链接无法从 href 抽取——本词条的内容结构是从页面正文文字读出的**。**正文逐字实测揭示的结构**：⭐ **会员类型** 共五类——**Insurance Professional（保险专业）**、**Outside Counsel（外部律师）**、**Service Provider（服务商）**、**Corporate（企业）**、**Fellows**；⭐ **资源** 含 **CLM Tracker**、**Designations（专业称号）**、**Litigation Management Task Force（诉讼管理工作组）**、**E-Courses（线上课程）**、**Magazines（杂志）**、**Sponsorship Opportunities**、⭐ **Dispute Resolution（争议解决）**、⭐ **Job Search（职位搜索）**；**News** 含 **Professional of the Year**、UCC；⭐ **活动与教育项目** 实测含 **2026 Claims College（理赔学院）**、**2026 Construction Conference**、**Insurance Coverage Bootcamp（保险责任训练营）**、**2026 Litigation Management Symposium**、⭐ **2026 Litigation Management Institute（诉讼管理研究院）**；⭐ **「Our network」分组** 实测含 **Member Directory（会员名录）**、**Advisory Board**、⭐ **Young Professionals Advisory Board（青年专业者顾问委员会）**、**Fellows**、**Members**、⭐ **Mediators / Arbitrators（调解员/仲裁员）**；**Communities** 下含 ⭐ **Local Chapters（地方分会）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「理赔作为一门专业」的组织与教育体系**——**池内理赔侧此前全是技术工具**，**而 CLM 展示的是一条完整路径：五类会员 → 专业称号（Designations）→ 线上课程 → 理赔学院/诉讼管理研究院 → 地方分会**；**对考虑进入理赔、诉讼管理或保险责任（coverage）方向的 RIAA 毕业生，这是一个美国侧的完整专业发展地图**（**与同轮 [[cila]] 的英国侧形成「英/美」对照**）。**② ⭐ 「五类会员」的设计值得单独注意**——**保险专业、外部律师、服务商、企业、Fellows**：**理赔实务天然是多方协作（理赔员 + 律师 + 定损/服务商 + 企业风险经理）**，**故该组织把「跨角色」写进会员结构**；**这与池内 [[three-lines-of-defense]]（公司内部治理分工）属不同层面的「协作结构」**。**③ ⭐ 「保险责任训练营（Insurance Coverage Bootcamp）」与「理赔学院」是两种不同性质的教育**——**前者针对「什么在保单责任范围内」这一法律判断，后者针对理赔作业**；**对做保单条款与理赔争议的学生，「coverage」是一条独立的知识线**（**可与池内 [[insurance-qa-en]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[clausegraph]]、[[clauseguard]] 的条款/责任侧并读**）。**④ 「调解员/仲裁员名录」与「争议解决」把理赔延伸到纠纷解决**——**与同轮 [[mib]] 的「行业补偿机制」和 [[hk-icb]]、[[fos-uk]] 的「消费者争议裁决」构成理赔后的三条不同路径**（**内部争议解决 / 行业仲裁 / 监管申诉**）。**⑤ 「青年专业者顾问委员会」是少见的设计**——**行业组织为青年从业者设专门的顾问委员会**（**对本站读者（学生/新入行）直接相关**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与六个公开页面的存在、标题（部分无标题）、页面体量、以及正文逐字实测的会员类型、资源、活动与网络分组**，**但未打开任何课程、杂志、称号说明、资源目录内容、会员名录或活动详情**，因此**不能转述任何课程内容、称号要求、会员条件、费用或活动安排**；**② ⭐ 导航为 JS 拼装（href 中实测含 `+ item.URL +`），故本词条的结构信息全部来自正文文字而非链接抽取**——**这一点已在词条内明确写出，以便后续维护者理解为何无法逐条给出 URL**；**③ `Member Directory`、`Fellows`、`Mediators / Arbitrators` 等条目很可能需要登录**（**首页实测有 `JOIN/LOGIN` 与 `/account/login`**）——**故本词条不主张这些名录可公开检索**；**④ ⭐ 我猜测的 `/membership` 路径实测 404**——**真实入口为 `/Register/Fellow` 与站内 JS 导航**；**⑤ `/IndustryResourceDirectory` 实测无页面标题（NO-TITLE）**，**其内容结构未核实**；**⑥ 「Fellows」是会员类型还是称号层级本次未核实**（**词条内按页面实测的并列关系列出，未作层级判断**）；**⑦ 该组织的规模、成立年份与治理结构本次未核实**；**⑧** 本词条**不主张** CLM 提供精算工具、数据或模型**。**核实说明**：首页（66.6KB）与公开页 `/IndustryResourceDirectory`（60.8KB）等均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测，**结构信息由正文文字逐字读取**（因导航为 JS 拼装）；`/membership` 实测 404；**未打开课程、杂志、称号说明、资源目录内容、会员名录或活动详情**。
entries.body_en:
**CLM (the Claims and Litigation Management Alliance)** is **a US cross-industry professional body for claims and litigation management** (measured site title **"Claims and Litigation Management Alliance"**). This entry adds the **"claims as a cross-industry professional community"** form — **unlike [[cila]] (individual qualification) and [[fuedi]] (a European regional umbrella) in the same round, CLM adds the professional body and education system shared along the claims and litigation management line by insurers, outside counsel, service providers and corporates**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **66.6KB with the measured title "Claims and Litigation Management Alliance"**; **measured publicly visible pages include `/IndustryResourceDirectory` (60.8KB)**, **`/resourceecourses`**, **`/event/calendar`**, **`/InPersonEvents`**, **`/VirtualEvents`** and **`/Register/Fellow`**. ⭐ **⚠️ A technical fact that must be stated**: **this site’s navigation is assembled by JavaScript** (**measured hrefs contain template fragments such as `+ item.URL +`**), **so navigation links cannot be extracted from hrefs — the structural information in this entry was read from the page body text**. **Structure read verbatim from the body**: ⭐ **five membership classes** — **Insurance Professional**, **Outside Counsel**, **Service Provider**, **Corporate** and **Fellows**; ⭐ **resources** — **CLM Tracker**, **Designations**, **Litigation Management Task Force**, **E-Courses**, **Magazines**, **Sponsorship Opportunities**, ⭐ **Dispute Resolution** and ⭐ **Job Search**; **News** covers **Professional of the Year** and UCC; ⭐ **measured events and education programmes** include **2026 Claims College**, **2026 Construction Conference**, **Insurance Coverage Bootcamp**, **2026 Litigation Management Symposium** and ⭐ **2026 Litigation Management Institute**; ⭐ the **"Our network"** grouping measurably includes **Member Directory**, **Advisory Board**, ⭐ **Young Professionals Advisory Board**, **Fellows**, **Members** and ⭐ **Mediators / Arbitrators**; **Communities** includes ⭐ **Local Chapters**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the organisation and education system of claims as a profession** — **the corpus’s claims side previously held only technical tools**, **whereas CLM sets out a complete path: five membership classes → designations → e-courses → a Claims College and Litigation Management Institute → local chapters**; **for RIAA graduates considering claims, litigation management or coverage work, this is a complete US-side professional development map** (**contrasting with the UK side in [[cila]]**). **② ⭐ The five membership classes deserve separate note** — **insurance professional, outside counsel, service provider, corporate and fellows**: **claims practice is inherently multi-party (adjuster plus lawyer plus loss assessor or provider plus corporate risk manager)**, **so the body writes cross-role participation into its membership structure**; **a different kind of "collaboration structure" from the internal-governance division in [[three-lines-of-defense]]**. **③ ⭐ The "Insurance Coverage Bootcamp" and the "Claims College" are two different kinds of education** — **the former addresses the legal judgement of what falls within policy coverage, the latter claims operations**; **for students working on policy wording and claims disputes, "coverage" is an independent knowledge line** (readable with the wording and coverage items [[insurance-qa-en]], [[policy-explainer-ai]], [[clausegraph]] and [[clauseguard]]). **④ The mediators/arbitrators listing and Dispute Resolution extend claims into dispute resolution** — **together with [[mib]]’s industry compensation mechanism and the consumer dispute adjudication of [[hk-icb]] and [[fos-uk]], they mark three different post-claim paths** (**internal dispute resolution / industry arbitration / regulatory complaint**). **⑤ A "Young Professionals Advisory Board" is an uncommon design** — **a trade body creating a dedicated advisory board for early-career practitioners** (**directly relevant to this wiki’s student and new-entrant readers**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and six public pages’ existence, titles (some with none), page sizes, and the membership classes, resources, events and network groupings read verbatim from the body**, **but opened no course, magazine, designation description, resource-directory content, member listing or event detail**, so **no course content, designation requirement, membership condition, fee or event schedule can be restated**; **② ⭐ the navigation is JavaScript-assembled (measured hrefs contain `+ item.URL +`), so all structural information here comes from body text rather than link extraction** — **stated explicitly in the entry so future maintainers understand why per-item URLs cannot be given**; **③ items such as Member Directory, Fellows and Mediators / Arbitrators are likely login-gated** (**the homepage measurably carries `JOIN/LOGIN` and `/account/login`**) — **so this entry does not claim these listings are publicly searchable**; **④ ⭐ the path I guessed, `/membership`, measured 404** — **the real entry points are `/Register/Fellow` and the in-site JS navigation**; **⑤ `/IndustryResourceDirectory` measurably has no page title (NO-TITLE)**, **and its content structure was not verified**; **⑥ whether "Fellows" is a membership class or a designation tier was not verified** (**the entry lists it as the page measurably presents it, making no hierarchy claim**); **⑦ the organisation’s size, founding year and governance were not verified**; **⑧** this entry **does not claim CLM provides actuarial tools, data or models**. **Verification note**: the homepage (66.6KB) and public pages such as `/IndustryResourceDirectory` (60.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with **structure read verbatim from body text** (because the navigation is JavaScript-assembled); `/membership` measured 404; **no course, magazine, designation description, resource-directory content, member listing or event detail was opened**.

**CLM（Claims and Litigation Management Alliance，美國理賠與訴訟管理聯盟）** 是**美國理賠與訴訟管理領域的跨行業專業組織**。本條目補的是**「理賠作為跨行業專業共同體」這一形態**——**與同輪 [[cila]]（個人資格）和 [[fuedi]]（歐洲區域傘狀）不同，CLM 補的是「保險公司、外部律師、服務商、企業多方共同參與的專業組織與教育體系」**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **66.6KB**；**公開頁面實測含 `/IndustryResourceDirectory`（60.8KB）／`/resourceecourses`／`/event/calendar`／`/InPersonEvents`／`/VirtualEvents`／`/Register/Fellow`**。⭐ **⚠️ 必須說明的技術事實**：**該站導航由 JavaScript 拼裝**（**實測 href 中含 `+ item.URL +` 這類模板片段**），**故導航連結無法從 href 抽取——本詞條的結構信息是從頁面正文文字讀出的**。**正文逐字實測**：⭐ **會員類型五類**——**Insurance Professional／Outside Counsel／Service Provider／Corporate／Fellows**；⭐ **資源** 含 **CLM Tracker／Designations／Litigation Management Task Force／E-Courses／Magazines／Sponsorship Opportunities／⭐Dispute Resolution／⭐Job Search**；⭐ **活動與教育** 含 **2026 Claims College（理賠學院）／2026 Construction Conference／Insurance Coverage Bootcamp（保險責任訓練營）／2026 Litigation Management Symposium／⭐2026 Litigation Management Institute（訴訟管理研究院）**；⭐ **「Our network」** 含 **Member Directory／Advisory Board／⭐Young Professionals Advisory Board／Fellows／Members／⭐Mediators-Arbitrators**；**Communities** 含 ⭐ **Local Chapters**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「理賠作為一門專業」的組織與教育體系**——**池內理賠側此前全是技術工具**，**而 CLM 展示完整路徑：五類會員 → 專業稱號 → 線上課程 → 理賠學院／訴訟管理研究院 → 地方分會**（**與同輪 [[cila]] 的英國側形成「英／美」對照**）。**② ⭐ 「五類會員」值得單獨注意**——**理賠實務天然是多方協作，故該組織把「跨角色」寫進會員結構**。**③ ⭐ 「保險責任訓練營」與「理賠學院」是兩種不同性質的教育**——**前者針對「什麼在保單責任範圍內」這一法律判斷，後者針對理賠作業**（可與 [[insurance-qa-en]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[clausegraph]]、[[clauseguard]] 並讀）。**④ 「調解員/仲裁員名錄」與「爭議解決」把理賠延伸到糾紛解決**——**與同輪 [[mib]] 及 [[hk-icb]]、[[fos-uk]] 構成理賠後的三條不同路徑**（**內部爭議解決／行業仲裁／監管申訴**）。**⑤ 「青年專業者顧問委員會」是少見設計**——**對本站讀者直接相關**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與六個公開頁面的存在、標題（部分無標題）、體量、正文逐字實測的會員類型、資源、活動與網絡分組**，**但未打開任何課程、雜誌、稱號說明、資源目錄內容、會員名錄或活動詳情**，故**不能轉述任何課程內容、稱號要求、會員條件、費用或活動安排**；**② ⭐ 導航為 JS 拼裝，故本詞條結構信息全部來自正文文字而非連結抽取**——**已在詞條內明確寫出**；**③ Member Directory／Fellows／Mediators-Arbitrators 等很可能需要登入**（**首頁實測有 `JOIN/LOGIN` 與 `/account/login`**）——**故不主張可公開檢索**；**④ ⭐ 我猜測的 `/membership` 實測 404**；**⑤ `/IndustryResourceDirectory` 實測無頁面標題（NO-TITLE）**，**內容結構未核實**；**⑥ 「Fellows」是會員類型還是稱號層級未核實**；**⑦ 規模、成立年份與治理結構未核實**；**⑧** 本詞條**不主張** CLM 提供精算工具、數據或模型**。**核實說明**：首頁與公開頁均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測，**結構信息由正文文字逐字讀取**；`/membership` 實測 404；**未打開課程、雜誌、稱號說明、資源目錄內容、會員名錄或活動詳情**。

entries.body:
**MIB（Motor Insurers’ Bureau，英国汽车保险人局）** 是**英国汽车保险业出资设立的非营利机构**（站点正文实测自述：**「MIB is a not-for-profit organisation making roads safer by tackling uninsured and hit-and-run driving. We’ve been here since 1946」**）。本条目补的是**「行业级理赔与数据基础设施」这一形态**——**实测池内该形态为 0**；**它与同轮三条（[[cila]] 资格、[[fuedi]] 欧洲伞状、[[clm]] 跨行业专业组织）的区别在于：MIB 不是专业团体，而是一个**由全行业出资、承担法定/行业性补偿与全国数据职能的机构**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **72.2KB，标题实测「Make a claim or check and learn about insurance | Making roads safer | MIB」**；⭐ **「About MIB」页 `/about-mib/` 实测 50.9KB，标题实测「Our purpose and how we’re funded（我们的宗旨与资金来源）」**，正文逐字含上述 1946 年与非营利自述；⭐ **「Check your vehicle（查验你的车辆）」页 `/check-and-stay-insured/check-your-vehicle/` 实测 52.5KB，标题实测「Check your vehicle insurance status online」**，正文逐字含 **「Check your motor insurance status instantly using our free Check Your Vehicle online tool」**；⭐ **「Our members（我们的成员）」页 `/about-mib/our-members/` 实测 52.4KB**；⭐ **「Data resources for data recipients（面向数据接收方的数据资源）」页 `/for-professionals/data-recipients/` 实测 42.2KB**。**导航逐字实测揭示的结构**：**Check and stay insured** 含 **Am I insured?（我投保了吗？）**、⭐ **Check your vehicle**、**I’ve received a letter（我收到了一封信）**；**Make a claim** 含 **Can I claim with MIB?**、**How the claims process works**、**Manage an existing claim**、⭐ **I’ve been hit by a foreign vehicle（我被外国车辆撞了）**、**Support and reassurance**；**Learn about insurance** 含 **Common insurance myths**、**New and young drivers**、**Parents of young drivers**、**What to do after an accident**、**Driving abroad**、**Avoiding insurance scams**、**The future of driving**、⭐ **Motor terrorism（汽车恐怖主义）**；**Professionals** 含 **Insurers and brokers**、**Solicitors and claims handlers**、⭐ **Data recipients**、⭐ **Police（警方）**；**About MIB** 含 **Business plan 2026**、**Governance and compliance**、**Our members**、**Our strategy**、**Your data and privacy**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「无保险驾驶」这一风险池的行业补偿机制**——**无保险驾驶与肇事逃逸是车险中无法向对方追偿的情形**，**MIB 的存在说明这类风险由全行业出资兜底**；**这与池内 [[fscs-uk]]（金融机构倒闭）、[[nolhga]]（保险公司破产）、[[assuris]]（保单持有人保障）属同一「兜底机制」家族，但触发原因完全不同（不是机构倒闭，而是**肇事方无保险**）**——**对本轮而言，它把兜底机制的谱系又扩出一格**（**可与 [[pbgc]]、[[seadrif]] 并读**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「车辆保险状态公开查验」是本条最有实用价值的机制**——**任何人均可免费在线查验一辆车的保险状态**；**这背后必然是全国性的保险数据库**（**即从保险公司汇集投保数据、供公众与警方查询**）；**对做保险数据基础设施的学生，这是一个「以公共目的汇集行业数据」的成熟样本**——**可与池内 [[susep-sro]]（监管强制逐笔登记）、[[susep-open-insurance]]（同意制跨公司共享）并读，形成「强制登记 / 同意共享 / 公共查验」三种数据汇集目的对照**（**注意：本次未运行任何查询，也未核实数据库的名称、规模与开放范围**）。**③ 明确区分「Insurers and brokers / Solicitors and claims handlers / Data recipients / Police」四类专业用户**——**同一机构按「谁需要什么数据」组织面向专业人士的入口**；**其中**警方**出现在数据用户名单里，说明该数据库也服务于执法**。**④ ⭐ 「Motor terrorism（汽车恐怖主义）」是罕见栏目**——**把车辆作为恐袭工具所致的第三方损害单列**（**本次未打开内容，故不转述其处理方式**）。**⑤ 「Business plan 2026」与「Governance and compliance」公开**——**该机构披露年度业务计划与治理合规**（**本次未打开**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、两处关键正文自述（1946 年、非营利、免费查验工具）、以及导航逐字实测的完整栏目结构**，**但未打开业务计划、治理与合规页、成员页内容、任何数据接收方资源、未运行车辆查验工具、未核实数据库的名称与规模**，因此**不能转述任何索赔金额、案件数量、成员名单、数据库字段或查询结果**；**② ⭐ 「运营全国车辆保险数据库」是我依据「免费在线查验车辆保险状态」这一实测事实所作的**合理推断**，**本次未打开任何页面证明该数据库的名称、运营方或数据范围**——**词条内已将其表述为「背后必然是全国性的保险数据库」并在此标注为推断**；**③ 「由全行业出资」依据页标题「Our purpose and **how we’re funded**」与「Our members / Insurers and brokers」等栏目**，**本次未打开核实具体出资机制**；**④ 「1946 年成立」为页面正文逐字实测**，**但该机构与英国法定强制车险制度的关系（如是否具有法定职能）本次未核实**；**⑤ 「Motor terrorism」栏目内容未核实**；**⑥ 该机构与同轮 [[fscs-uk]] 的职能边界本次未核实**——**词条内未作两者关系主张**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** MIB 提供精算工具、定价数据或可下载数据集**。**核实说明**：首页（72.2KB）、`/about-mib/`（50.9KB）、`/check-and-stay-insured/check-your-vehicle/`（52.5KB）、`/about-mib/our-members/`（52.4KB）、`/for-professionals/data-recipients/`（42.2KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题、正文自述与导航；**未打开业务计划、治理页、成员内容、数据接收方资源，亦未运行查验工具**。
entries.body_en:
**MIB (the Motor Insurers’ Bureau)** is **a UK not-for-profit funded by the motor insurance industry** (measured verbatim from its own page: **"MIB is a not-for-profit organisation making roads safer by tackling uninsured and hit-and-run driving. We’ve been here since 1946"**). This entry adds the **"industry-level claims and data infrastructure"** form — **measured zero**; **unlike the round’s other three ([[cila]] qualifications, [[fuedi]] a European umbrella, [[clm]] a cross-industry professional body), MIB is not a professional association but an institution funded by the whole industry that carries out statutory or industry-wide compensation and national data functions**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **72.2KB with the measured title "Make a claim or check and learn about insurance | Making roads safer | MIB"**; ⭐ the **"About MIB" page `/about-mib/` measures 50.9KB with the measured title "Our purpose and how we’re funded"**, its body carrying the 1946 and not-for-profit statement quoted above; ⭐ the **"Check your vehicle" page `/check-and-stay-insured/check-your-vehicle/` measures 52.5KB with the measured title "Check your vehicle insurance status online"**, its body stating verbatim **"Check your motor insurance status instantly using our free Check Your Vehicle online tool"**; ⭐ the **"Our members" page measures 52.4KB**; ⭐ the **"Data resources for data recipients" page measures 42.2KB**. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the structure**: **Check and stay insured** covers **Am I insured?**, ⭐ **Check your vehicle** and **I’ve received a letter**; **Make a claim** covers **Can I claim with MIB?**, **How the claims process works**, **Manage an existing claim**, ⭐ **I’ve been hit by a foreign vehicle** and **Support and reassurance**; **Learn about insurance** covers **Common insurance myths**, **New and young drivers**, **Parents of young drivers**, **What to do after an accident**, **Driving abroad**, **Avoiding insurance scams**, **The future of driving** and ⭐ **Motor terrorism**; **Professionals** covers **Insurers and brokers**, **Solicitors and claims handlers**, ⭐ **Data recipients** and ⭐ **Police**; **About MIB** covers **Business plan 2026**, **Governance and compliance**, **Our members**, **Our strategy** and **Your data and privacy**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the industry compensation mechanism for the uninsured-driving risk pool** — **uninsured driving and hit-and-run are the cases in motor insurance where there is no counterparty to recover from**, **and MIB’s existence means the whole industry funds a backstop for them**; **this belongs to the same "backstop mechanism" family as [[fscs-uk]] (failed financial firms), [[nolhga]] (insolvent insurers) and [[assuris]] (policyholder protection), but the triggering cause is entirely different (not an institutional failure, but a tortfeasor with no insurance)** — **it extends the family tree of backstop mechanisms by one branch** (readable with [[pbgc]] and [[seadrif]]). **② ⭐⭐ The public vehicle insurance status check is the most practically valuable mechanism here** — **anyone can check a vehicle’s insurance status online for free**; **this necessarily rests on a national insurance database** (**policy data collected from insurers and made queryable by the public and the police**); **for work on insurance data infrastructure this is a mature sample of aggregating industry data for a public purpose** — **readable with [[susep-sro]] (mandatory operation-level reporting) and [[susep-open-insurance]] (consented cross-firm sharing) to give three purposes of data aggregation: mandatory registry, consented sharing, and public verification** (**note: no query was run, and the database’s name, size and scope were not verified**). **③ It explicitly separates four professional audiences — Insurers and brokers, Solicitors and claims handlers, Data recipients and Police** — **one body organising professional entry points by who needs which data**; **that the police appear among data users indicates the database also serves law enforcement**. **④ ⭐ "Motor terrorism" is a rare section** — **third-party damage caused by using a vehicle as a terror instrument is treated separately** (**its content was not opened, so its treatment is not restated**). **⑤ The 2026 business plan and the governance and compliance page are public** (**neither was opened**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, two key verbatim self-descriptions (1946, not-for-profit, a free check tool), and the complete section structure read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no business plan, governance page, member content or data-recipient resource, ran no vehicle check, and did not establish the database’s name or size**, so **no claim amount, case count, member list, database field or query result can be restated**; **② ⭐ "operates a national vehicle insurance database" is a reasonable inference from the measured fact that vehicle insurance status can be checked online for free**, **and no page proving the database’s name, operator or data scope was opened** — **the entry phrases it as "this necessarily rests on a national insurance database" and the inference is flagged here**; **③ "funded by the whole industry" rests on the page title "Our purpose and how we’re funded" and sections such as Our members and Insurers and brokers**, **with the funding mechanism itself not opened**; **④ "established 1946" is read verbatim from the page body**, **but the body’s relationship with the UK’s compulsory motor insurance regime (for example whether its functions are statutory) was not verified**; **⑤ the content of the Motor terrorism section was not verified**; **⑥ the boundary between MIB and [[fscs-uk]] was not verified, and the entry makes no claim about their relationship**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim MIB provides actuarial tools, pricing data or downloadable datasets**. **Verification note**: the homepage (72.2KB), `/about-mib/` (50.9KB), `/check-and-stay-insured/check-your-vehicle/` (52.5KB), `/about-mib/our-members/` (52.4KB) and `/for-professionals/data-recipients/` (42.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles, body statements and navigation read verbatim; **no business plan, governance page, member content or data-recipient resource was opened and no check tool was run**.
