entries.body:
**Aviareto** 是**「移动资产国际登记处（International Registry of Mobile Assets）」的运营方**（站点标题实测 **「Aviareto - Managers of the International Registry of Mobile Assets」**）。本条目补的是**「航空器资产登记」这一形态**——**实测池内该形态为 0**；**它与同轮三条（[[iata]] 安全数据、[[ntsb]] 事故数据、[[flight-safety-foundation]] 风险标准）共同构成航空业务线，但补的是完全不同的一个环节：资产的权属与担保登记**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **首页 232.3KB，标题「Aviareto - Managers of the International Registry of Mobile Assets」**，正文逐字实测写明 **「At the centre of global aviation finance」**、**「For 20 years, Aviareto has managed the International Registry of Mobile Assets, the secure system that the multi-billion-dollar global aviation finance industry depends on every day」**；⭐⭐ **并逐字实测写明其身份与授权来源**：**「Aviareto is a joint venture between SITA and the Irish Government, chosen by ICAO to establish and operate the International Registry under the Cape Town Treaty」**；**以及来源构成**：**「Aviareto combines SITA’s global aviation expertise with the strengths of Ireland’s aviation sector」**；⭐ **「International Registry」页 `/international-registry/` 实测 226.9KB，标题「International Registry - Aviareto」**。**导航逐字实测的结构**：**International Registry**、**Governance**、**About us**、**Careers**、**Resources**、**News**、**Contact**；**链接实测另见** `/about/`、`/news/`、`/international-registry-a-force-for-change/`，以及**指向登记系统本身的地址** **`https://www.internationalregistry.aero/ir-web/`**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「航空器资产登记」这一环节，使本轮航空业务线形成完整闭环**——**同轮另三条分别给「安全数据」「事故调查」「风险标准」，本条给「资产权属与担保登记」**；**对做航空融资、租赁与航空保险核保的学生，登记是确定「这架飞机的抵押权/所有权状态」的基础设施**（**与池内金融基础设施类条目 [[susep-sro]] 的逐笔登记、[[mib]] 的车辆保险数据库同属「为特定资产建立的登记系统」，但对象与法律依据不同**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「SITA + 爱尔兰政府合资、经 ICAO 选定、依《开普敦公约》设立」这三点是可引用的制度事实**（**均为页面正文逐字实测**）——**它说明一个全球登记系统如何被授权与运营：国际公约提供法律基础、国际组织（ICAO）选定运营方、公私合资（航空业 IT 巨头 SITA + 一国政府）承担运营**；**对研究「国际公约如何落地为可运营基础设施」的学生，这是一个具体样本**（**注意：本次未打开任何一页说明其监管安排、收费或争议解决机制**）。**③ ⭐ 「20 年运营」与「数十亿美元级航空金融依赖」为页面自述**（**逐字实测**）；**对理解航空资产融资的规模与基础设施依赖关系有直接价值**（**但本次未核实其登记数量、交易规模或市场份额**）。**④ ⭐ 「爱尔兰」这一要素值得单独注意**——**爱尔兰是全球航空租赁业的核心辖区之一**，**而运营方是「爱尔兰政府 + SITA」的合资**；**这一点与池内 [[insurance-broker]]、[[marsh]] 等中介条目不同：本条给出的是「一个司法辖区如何通过承接国际登记职能而形成产业聚集」的线索**（**本次未打开任何一页论述爱尔兰航空业，故本词条不主张两者之间的因果关系**）。**⑤ 站点公开 Governance 与 Resources 栏目**（**本次未打开**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与「International Registry」页的存在、标题、页面体量、四处关键正文逐字表述（全球航空金融中心、20 年运营、SITA 与爱尔兰政府合资、经 ICAO 选定依开普敦公约设立）、导航结构、以及登记系统地址**，**但未打开 Governance、About us、Resources、News 等页面，未打开任何一页说明登记流程、费用、法律效力或争议解决，亦未访问登记系统本身**，因此**不能转述任何登记数量、交易规模、收费安排、法律条款或操作流程**；**② ⭐ 登记系统本身本次**未访问**——**实测到的 `https://www.internationalregistry.aero/ir-web/` 仅为页面中出现的地址**；**另经单独探活，`https://www.internationalregistry.aero/` 返回 HTTP 200（57.1KB，标题「International Registry - Home」），但其公开首页实测为一个「Guest User」电子签署与同意流程的界面（正文实测含「You are signing as Guest User in your role as Guest for Guest Entity. By clicking Confirm you are electronically signing and consenting…」）**——**即该登记处的公开落地页是访问与签署入口，而非信息性页面**；**故本词条不描述登记处的界面、字段或流程，也不为其单列条目**；**③ 「20 年」与「数十亿美元级」均为**页面自述**，**本次未独立核实**——**词条内已标注为页面自述**；**④ 「经 ICAO 选定」这一表述来自 Aviareto 自身页面**，**本次未在 ICAO 侧核实**（**而 ICAO 站点本轮实测 HTTP 403 阻断**），**故本词条按「Aviareto 自述」呈现，不主张已获第三方确认**；**⑤ 该机构与保险业的关系（如是否与航空保险核保/理赔有直接衔接）本次未核实，故不作关联主张**；**⑥ 首页标题与正文为英文，站点语言支持情况未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** Aviareto 提供精算工具、定价模型或可下载数据**。**核实说明**：`/international-registry/`（226.9KB）与首页（232.3KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与正文；**另单独探活 `www.internationalregistry.aero`（200，57.1KB，公开首页为 Guest User 电子签署/同意入口，故未描述其内容）**；**未打开 Governance、About us、Resources、News，未访问登记系统本身**。
entries.body_en:
**Aviareto** is **the operator of the International Registry of Mobile Assets** (measured site title **"Aviareto - Managers of the International Registry of Mobile Assets"**). This entry adds the **"aircraft asset registration"** form — **measured zero**; **with [[iata]] (safety data), [[ntsb]] (accident data) and [[flight-safety-foundation]] (risk standards) in the same round it completes the aviation line, but covers an entirely different link: registration of ownership and security interests in assets**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **homepage is 232.3KB with the measured title "Aviareto - Managers of the International Registry of Mobile Assets"**, its body stating verbatim **"At the centre of global aviation finance"** and **"For 20 years, Aviareto has managed the International Registry of Mobile Assets, the secure system that the multi-billion-dollar global aviation finance industry depends on every day"**; ⭐⭐ and stating its identity and authorisation verbatim: **"Aviareto is a joint venture between SITA and the Irish Government, chosen by ICAO to establish and operate the International Registry under the Cape Town Treaty"**, with **"Aviareto combines SITA’s global aviation expertise with the strengths of Ireland’s aviation sector"**; ⭐ the **"International Registry" page measures 226.9KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation**: **International Registry**, **Governance**, **About us**, **Careers**, **Resources**, **News**, **Contact**; **measured links also include** `/about/`, `/news/`, `/international-registry-a-force-for-change/` and **an address pointing at the registry system itself**, **`https://www.internationalregistry.aero/ir-web/`**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the aircraft asset registration link, completing the round’s aviation line** — **the other three supply safety data, accident investigation and risk standards; this supplies registration of ownership and security interests**; **for students working on aviation finance, leasing and aviation underwriting, registration is the infrastructure that establishes an aircraft’s mortgage and ownership status** (**like [[susep-sro]]’s operation-level registry or [[mib]]’s vehicle insurance database, this is "a registry built for a specific asset class", but with a different object and legal basis**). **② ⭐⭐ "A SITA and Irish Government joint venture, chosen by ICAO, established under the Cape Town Treaty" is a citable institutional fact** (**all read verbatim from the page body**) — **it shows how a global registry is authorised and run: a treaty supplies the legal basis, an international organisation (ICAO) selects the operator, and a public-private venture (the aviation IT group SITA plus a national government) operates it**; **a concrete sample for studying how international conventions become operable infrastructure** (**note: no page on its regulatory arrangements, fees or dispute resolution was opened**). **③ ⭐ "20 years of operation" and "a multi-billion-dollar industry depends on it" are the page’s own statements** (**read verbatim**); **directly useful for understanding the scale of aviation asset finance and its infrastructure dependence** (**no registration count, transaction volume or market share was verified**). **④ ⭐ The Irish element deserves separate note** — **Ireland is one of the core jurisdictions of global aircraft leasing**, **and the operator is an Irish-Government and SITA joint venture**; **unlike intermediary entries such as [[insurance-broker]] and [[marsh]], this gives a lead on how a jurisdiction builds an industry cluster by hosting an international registry** (**no page discussing Irish aviation was opened, so no causal claim is made**). **⑤ Governance and Resources sections are public** (**not opened**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and the International Registry page’s existence, titles and sizes, four key verbatim body statements (centre of global aviation finance, 20 years, the SITA and Irish Government joint venture, ICAO selection under the Cape Town Treaty), the navigation structure and the registry system address**, **but opened no Governance, About us, Resources or News page, no page on registration process, fees, legal effect or dispute resolution, and did not access the registry system itself**, so **no registration count, transaction volume, fee arrangement, legal clause or operating process can be restated**; **② ⭐ The registry system itself was **not accessed** — **the measured `https://www.internationalregistry.aero/ir-web/` is only an address appearing on the page**; **separately probed, `https://www.internationalregistry.aero/` returned HTTP 200 (57.1KB, title "International Registry - Home"), but its public landing page measurably is a guest-user electronic signing and consent interface (body measured: "You are signing as Guest User in your role as Guest for Guest Entity. By clicking Confirm you are electronically signing and consenting…")** — **i.e. the registry’s public landing page is an access and signing entry point, not an informational page**; **so this entry describes no registry interface, field or process, and does not give it a separate entry**; **③ "20 years" and "multi-billion-dollar" are the page’s own statements**, **not independently verified** — **flagged as such in the entry**; **④ "chosen by ICAO" comes from Aviareto’s own page**, **and was not verified on the ICAO side** (**ICAO measured HTTP 403 and was blocked this round**), **so the entry presents it as Aviareto’s own statement and claims no third-party confirmation**; **⑤ its relationship with the insurance industry (for example any direct link to aviation underwriting or claims) was not verified, so none is asserted**; **⑥ the homepage title and body are English; language support was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim Aviareto provides actuarial tools, pricing models or downloadable data**. **Verification note**: `/international-registry/` (226.9KB) and the homepage (232.3KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and body read verbatim; **`www.internationalregistry.aero` was separately probed (200, 57.1KB, public landing page a guest-user signing and consent interface, so its content is not described)**; **no Governance, About us, Resources or News page was opened and the registry system itself was not accessed**.
entries.body_hk:
**Aviareto** 是**「移動資產國際登記處（International Registry of Mobile Assets）」的運營方**（站點標題實測 **「Aviareto - Managers of the International Registry of Mobile Assets」**）。本條目補的是**「航空器資產登記」這一形態**——**實測為 0**；**與同輪三條共同構成航空業務線，但補的是完全不同的環節：資產的權屬與擔保登記**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **首頁 232.3KB**，正文逐字實測 **「At the centre of global aviation finance」**、**「For 20 years, Aviareto has managed the International Registry of Mobile Assets…」**；⭐⭐ **並逐字實測其身份與授權來源**：**「Aviareto is a joint venture between SITA and the Irish Government, chosen by ICAO to establish and operate the International Registry under the Cape Town Treaty」**；⭐ **「International Registry」頁 `/international-registry/` 226.9KB**。**導航逐字實測**：**International Registry／Governance／About us／Careers／Resources／News／Contact**；**連結實測另見指向登記系統本身的地址 `https://www.internationalregistry.aero/ir-web/`**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「航空器資產登記」，使本輪航空業務線形成完整閉環**——**另三條給「安全數據」「事故調查」「風險標準」，本條給「資產權屬與擔保登記」**；**對做航空融資、租賃與航空保險核保的學生，登記是確定「這架飛機的抵押權／所有權狀態」的基礎設施**（與 [[susep-sro]] 的逐筆登記、[[mib]] 的車輛保險數據庫同屬「為特定資產建立的登記系統」）。**② ⭐⭐ 「SITA + 愛爾蘭政府合資、經 ICAO 選定、依《開普敦公約》設立」三點是可引用的制度事實**（**均為正文逐字實測**）——**它說明一個全球登記系統如何被授權與運營：國際公約提供法律基礎、國際組織選定運營方、公私合資承擔運營**。**③ ⭐ 「20 年運營」與「數十億美元級航空金融依賴」為頁面自述**（**逐字實測**）；**未核實其登記數量或市場份額**。**④ ⭐ 「愛爾蘭」這一要素值得單獨注意**——**愛爾蘭是全球航空租賃業的核心轄區之一**，**而運營方是「愛爾蘭政府 + SITA」合資**（**本次未打開任何一頁論述愛爾蘭航空業，故不主張因果關係**）。**⑤ 站點公開 Governance 與 Resources 欄目**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與「International Registry」頁的存在、標題、體量、四處關鍵正文逐字表述、導航結構、以及登記系統地址**，**但未打開 Governance／About us／Resources／News，未打開任何一頁說明登記流程、費用、法律效力或爭議解決，亦未訪問登記系統本身**，故**不能轉述任何登記數量、交易規模、收費安排、法律條款或操作流程**；**② ⭐ 登記系統本身本次**未訪問**——**實測到的 `/ir-web/` 僅為頁面中出現的地址**；⭐ **另經單獨探活，`https://www.internationalregistry.aero/` 返回 200（57.1KB，標題「International Registry - Home」），但其公開首頁實測為「Guest User」電子簽署與同意流程界面（正文實測含「You are signing as Guest User in your role as Guest for Guest Entity. By clicking Confirm you are electronically signing and consenting…」）**——**即該登記處的公開落地頁是訪問與簽署入口，而非資訊性頁面**；**故本詞條不描述其界面、欄位或流程，也不為其單列條目**；**③ 「20 年」與「數十億美元級」均為頁面自述，未獨立核實**；**④ 「經 ICAO 選定」來自 Aviareto 自身頁面**，**本次未在 ICAO 側核實**（**ICAO 站點本輪實測 403 阻斷**），**故按「Aviareto 自述」呈現，不主張已獲第三方確認**；**⑤ 與保險業的關係未核實，故不作關聯主張**；**⑥ 語言支持情況未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** Aviareto 提供精算工具、定價模型或可下載數據**。**核實說明**：兩個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與正文；**另單獨探活 `www.internationalregistry.aero`（200，57.1KB，公開首頁為 Guest User 電子簽署入口，故未描述其內容）**；**未打開 Governance／About us／Resources／News，未訪問登記系統本身**。

entries.title: IGLN（保险治理领导力网络）：非执行董事与高管的保险董事会专项平台
entries.title_en: IGLN (Insurance Governance Leadership Network): an insurance board-level platform for non-executive directors and senior executives
entries.title_hk: IGLN（保險治理領導力網絡）：非執行董事與高管的保險董事會專項平台
entries.summary: 面向保险业非执行董事与高管的高层对话平台（由 Tapestry Networks 运营）：设审计与控制、新兴技术、金融服务、医疗与「人、文化与诚信」等焦点领域，并出版董事会与金融机构领导层洞察
entries.summary_en: A senior-level dialogue platform for insurance non-executive directors and executives (run by Tapestry Networks): it has focus areas in audit and control, emerging technologies, financial services, healthcare, and people, culture and integrity, and publishes boardroom and financial-institution leadership insights
entries.summary_hk: 面向保險業非執行董事與高管的高層對話平台（由 Tapestry Networks 運營）：設審計與控制、新興技術、金融服務、醫療與「人、文化與誠信」等焦點領域，並出版董事會與金融機構領導層洞察
entries.body:
**IGLN（Insurance Governance Leadership Network，保险治理领导力网络）** 是**面向保险业非执行董事与高管的高层平台**，由 **Tapestry Networks** 运营（站点标题实测 **「Insurance Governance Leadership Network - Tapestry Networks」**）。本条目补的是**「保险董事会治理」这一形态**——⭐ **口径必须写明**：**池内已有 [[insurance-governance]] 与 [[three-lines-of-defense]] 两个概念条目、以及 [[cro-forum]]（首席风险官论坛）**，**但「以非执行董事为成员、以董事会为对象的保险专项网络」此前为 0**——**即「有概念、有 CRO 层，没有董事会层」**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **IGLN 专页 `/initiatives/insurance-governance-leadership-network` 实测 77.0KB，标题「Insurance Governance Leadership Network - Tapestry Networks」**，正文实测写明 **「Insurance Governance Leadership Network」**、**「Navigating change and searching for opportunities」**，并逐字写明其定位：**「The IGLN provides the premier platform for non-executive directors, senior executives, …」**（**面向非执行董事与高级管理人员的平台**，**句子在实测处以省略号截断，词条内只引用到该处为止**）；⭐ **Tapestry 的焦点领域页 `/focus-area/auditcontrol/` 实测 59.0KB，标题「Audit & Control - Tapestry Networks」**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：**Tapestry 主栏目** 含 **Get Involved**、**Who We Are**、**What We Do**、⭐ **Focus Areas**、**News**、**Careers**；⭐ **Focus Areas 实测含五个领域**：**Audit & Control（审计与控制）**、**Emerging Technologies（新兴技术）**、**Financial Services（金融服务）**、**Healthcare（医疗）**、**People, Culture, & Integrity（人、文化与诚信）**；⭐ **出版物实测含** **`/publication/insights-from-financial-institution-boardrooms/`（金融机构董事会洞察）**、**`/publication/insights-from-financial-institution-leaders/`**、**`/publication/navigating-policy-and-market-uncertainty/`**、**`/publication/responding-to-a-heightened-technology-risk-landscape/`**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「董事会层」这一治理高度**——**池内治理侧此前是「概念」（[[insurance-governance]]、[[three-lines-of-defense]]）与「CRO 层」（[[cro-forum]]）**，**而 IGLN 补的是**非执行董事**这一层**；**对公司治理与风险管理方向的学生，「谁在董事会上问什么问题」与「CRO 在关心什么」是两套议程**（**可对照阅读：[[cro-forum]] 是按议题组织的 CRO 论坛，IGLN 是按角色组织的董事会网络**）。**② ⭐ 「Audit & Control」被列为独立焦点领域，说明审计委员会是董事会治理的核心议题之一**——**这与同轮 [[theiia]] 的「全球审计委员会中心」正好衔接：一个是董事侧的对话平台，一个是内部审计职业侧的资源中心**。**③ ⭐ 出版物直接以「金融机构董事会洞察」为题**——**即其产出是「把董事会里的讨论抽象成可读洞察」**，**这是一种少见的产出形态**（**可与池内 [[cro-forum]] 的 20 年档案、[[geneva-association]] 的研究报告并读——三者都是行业高层议题的产出，但组织方式不同**）。**④ 「People, Culture & Integrity」这一焦点领域值得注意**——**文化与诚信被当作独立的治理议题**，**与池内 [[aae-ai-act-position]] 等立场文件、[[abcd]] 的职业纪律属不同层面但同一关切**（**本次未打开该领域内容**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**IGLN 专页与一个焦点领域页的存在、标题、页面体量、专页开头的定位表述、以及导航逐字实测的五个焦点领域与四个出版物路径**，**但未打开任何出版物、未打开其余四个焦点领域、未打开 Get Involved / Who We Are / What We Do 等页面**，因此**不能转述任何出版物的内容与结论、IGLN 的成员构成、参与方式、活动形式或议题细节**；**② ⭐ 「面向非执行董事与高管」为**专页正文逐字实测**，**但该句在实测处被截断（以省略号结尾于我的读取窗口）**——**词条内只引用到截断处，不补全其后内容**；**③ 「premier platform」是站点自述措辞**，**本词条如实引用并标注为站点自述，不作评价**；**④ IGLN 与 [[cro-forum]]、与 Tapestry 其他焦点领域的关系本次未核实**——**词条内对两者的对照属阅读建议，不是机构关系主张**；**⑤ Tapestry Networks 的机构性质（咨询/智库/平台运营方）、资金来源与治理结构本次未核实**；**⑥ IGLN 是否对非成员开放、是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** IGLN 提供精算工具、数据或模型**。**核实说明**：`/initiatives/insurance-governance-leadership-network`（77.0KB）与 `/focus-area/auditcontrol/`（59.0KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题、专页开头与导航；**未打开任何出版物、其余焦点领域或 About 类页面**。
entries.body_en:
**IGLN (the Insurance Governance Leadership Network)** is **a senior-level platform for insurance non-executive directors and executives**, run by **Tapestry Networks** (measured site title **"Insurance Governance Leadership Network - Tapestry Networks"**). This entry adds the **"insurance board governance"** form — ⭐ **and the scope must be stated**: **the corpus already holds the concepts [[insurance-governance]] and [[three-lines-of-defense]], plus [[cro-forum]] (the Chief Risk Officer Forum)**, **but "an insurance-specific network whose members are non-executive directors and whose subject is the board" measured zero** — **i.e. the concepts and the CRO layer existed, the board layer did not**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **IGLN page `/initiatives/insurance-governance-leadership-network` measures 77.0KB with the measured title "Insurance Governance Leadership Network - Tapestry Networks"**, its body measurably reading **"Insurance Governance Leadership Network"**, **"Navigating change and searching for opportunities"**, and stating its positioning verbatim: **"The IGLN provides the premier platform for non-executive directors, senior executives, …"** (**a platform for non-executive directors and senior executives**; **the sentence truncates at my read window, and the entry quotes no further**); ⭐ the **Tapestry focus area page `/focus-area/auditcontrol/` measures 59.0KB with the measured title "Audit & Control - Tapestry Networks"**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: **Tapestry’s main navigation** covers **Get Involved**, **Who We Are**, **What We Do**, ⭐ **Focus Areas**, **News** and **Careers**; ⭐ **Focus Areas measurably contains five areas**: **Audit & Control**, **Emerging Technologies**, **Financial Services**, **Healthcare** and **People, Culture, & Integrity**; ⭐ **measured publications include `/publication/insights-from-financial-institution-boardrooms/`**, **`/publication/insights-from-financial-institution-leaders/`**, **`/publication/navigating-policy-and-market-uncertainty/`** and **`/publication/responding-to-a-heightened-technology-risk-landscape/`**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the board level of governance** — **the corpus’s governance side previously held concepts ([[insurance-governance]], [[three-lines-of-defense]]) and the CRO layer ([[cro-forum]])**, **while IGLN adds the non-executive director layer**; **for students of corporate governance and risk management, "what the board asks" and "what the CRO cares about" are two different agendas** (**compare [[cro-forum]], a CRO forum organised by topic, with IGLN, a board network organised by role**). **② ⭐ "Audit & Control" being a standalone focus area shows the audit committee is a core board governance topic** — **which connects to [[theiia]]’s Global Audit Committee Center in the same round: one is the director-side dialogue platform, the other the internal audit profession’s resource centre**. **③ ⭐ A publication titled around financial institution boardroom insights means the output is "boardroom discussion abstracted into readable insight"** — **an uncommon output form** (**readable with the twenty-year archive of [[cro-forum]] and the research reports of [[geneva-association]] — all three produce senior industry-agenda material, organised differently**). **④ The "People, Culture & Integrity" focus area is notable** — **culture and integrity treated as a governance topic in their own right**, **at a different level from but sharing concerns with position papers such as [[aae-ai-act-position]] and the professional discipline of [[abcd]]** (**that area’s content was not opened**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the IGLN page and one focus area page’s existence, titles and sizes, the positioning statement at the top of the IGLN page, and the five focus areas and four publication paths read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no publication, no other focus area and none of the Get Involved, Who We Are or What We Do pages**, so **no publication content or conclusion, member composition, participation route, activity format or topic detail can be restated**; **② ⭐ "for non-executive directors and executives" is read verbatim from the IGLN page body**, **but that sentence truncates at my read window** — **the entry quotes only to the truncation and completes nothing**; **③ "premier platform" is the site’s own wording**, **quoted as such and attributed to the site with no evaluation**; **④ IGLN’s relationship with [[cro-forum]] or with Tapestry’s other focus areas was not verified** — **the comparison in the entry is a reading suggestion, not a claim about institutional relationships**; **⑤ Tapestry Networks’ institutional nature (advisory, think tank or platform operator), funding and governance were not verified**; **⑥ whether IGLN is open to non-members, and whether Chinese-language material exists, were not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim IGLN provides actuarial tools, data or models**. **Verification note**: `/initiatives/insurance-governance-leadership-network` (77.0KB) and `/focus-area/auditcontrol/` (59.0KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles, the IGLN page opening and navigation read verbatim; **no publication, other focus area or About-type page was opened**.

entries.body:
**IIA（The Institute of Internal Auditors，国际内部审计师协会）** 是**全球内部审计职业组织**（站点标题实测 **「The Institute of Internal Auditors | The IIA」**）。本条目补的是**「第三道防线的机构层」**——⭐ **口径必须写明**：**池内已有 [[three-lines-of-defense]]（三道防线）这一概念条目**，**但「内部审计这一职业与准则的机构」此前为 0**；**即「有三道防线的概念，没有第三道防线的机构」**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「2024 Global Internal Audit Standards（2024 全球内部审计准则）」页 `/en/standards/2024-standards/global-internal-audit-standards/` 实测 78.7KB，标题逐字「2024 Global Internal Audit Standards | The IIA」**；⭐ **「Global Audit Committee Center（全球审计委员会中心）」页 `/en/resources/global-audit-committee-center/` 实测 94.1KB，标题「Global Audit Committee Center | Internal Audit Oversight」**；⭐ **「COSO Resources from The IIA」页 `/en/resources/coso/` 实测 76.9KB**；**站点首页 98.5KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：**IPPF & Standards** 下含 ⭐ **Global Internal Audit Standards**、⭐ **Topical Requirements（专题要求）**、⭐ **Global Guidance（全球指引）**、**Audit Tools**、⭐ **Governance Process and Due Diligence**、**documents**；**Membership** 下含 ⭐ **Student Membership & Resources**、Executive Membership、Group Membership 等；**Ethics & Professionalism（道德与职业性）**；**Resources** 下含 **Statements of Position**、**Knowledge Centers**、⭐ **Internal Audit Competency Framework（内部审计能力框架）**、**Research and Reports**、⭐ **Translated Content Search（译文内容检索）**；**About us** 下含 **About Internal Audit**、**Advocacy**、⭐ **Discipline and Oversight（纪律与监督）**、⭐ **Academic Relations（学术关系）**、**Chapters and Affiliates**、**Licensing**；另有会刊站点 **`internalauditor.theiia.org`**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「第三道防线」的机构与准则层**——**池内 [[three-lines-of-defense]] 讲的是「三道防线如何分工」，而 IIA 提供的是第三道防线**自己的准则、能力框架与职业纪律**；**对做保险公司治理或内部审计方向的学生，这是一个可直接查准则的职业入口**（**可与 [[insurance-governance]]、[[cro-forum]]、同轮 [[igln]] 并读——**四者分别对应「治理概念 / CRO 层 / 董事会层 / 内部审计层」**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「2024 全球内部审计准则」是**全球统一的内部审计准则**（**本次未打开正文，故不转述其条款、编号或生效安排**），**并有配套的「专题要求」与「全球指引」三层结构**——**这是「准则 → 专题要求 → 指引」的三级体系，与池内 [[aae]] 的「国际原则 → 欧洲准则 → 国家标准」、[[assal]] 的「国际标准 / 自有标准 / 成员国法规」同为多层规则体系，但层级逻辑不同**。**③ ⭐ 「全球审计委员会中心」是**面向审计委员会**的资源**——**与同轮 [[igln]] 的「Audit & Control」焦点领域正好衔接：一个是董事侧平台、一个是职业侧资源中心**；**对做审计委员会或董事会治理研究的学生，这是一个少见的「面向委员会而非面向执行层」的资源**（**本次未打开内容**）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「COSO 资源」值得单独注意**——**COSO 内部控制框架是「三道防线」概念的近邻框架**（**COSO 讲内部控制，三道防线讲组织分工**）；**池内此前没有 COSO 的机构入口**，**本条目把它补上**（**本次未打开 COSO 内容，故不转述框架要素**）。**⑤ 「学生会员与资源」与「学术关系」对本站读者直接相关**——**一个职业组织同时对学生与学术界设专门入口**，**对考虑内部审计职业路径的 RIAA 毕业生是可用信息**（**本次未打开条件**）。**⑥ 「译文内容检索」栏目对非英语读者有实际价值**（**本次仅核实栏目存在，未核实语种**）。**⑦ 「纪律与监督」栏目与池内 [[abcd]]（精算职业纪律）同属「职业自律的纪律一侧」**——**两者并读可见不同职业的纪律机制设计**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与三个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航逐字实测的准则、资源、会员与机构栏目结构**，**但未打开准则正文、未打开专题要求或全球指引、未打开审计委员会中心、COSO 资源、能力框架、纪律与监督、学术关系或任何译文内容**，因此**不能转述任何准则条款与编号、COSO 框架要素、能力框架条目、纪律案例、会员条件或译文语种**；**② ⭐ 「2024 全球内部审计准则」**为页面标题逐字实测**，**但其正式生效日期、版本结构、是否与各国准则并行本次未核实**——**词条内不主张其适用范围或强制力**；**③ 「三级体系（准则 / 专题要求 / 全球指引）」依据栏目并列关系**，**本次未打开任何一页说明三者的相互效力关系**；**④ ⭐ 「COSO 内部控制框架」这一表述依据页面标题「COSO Resources from The IIA」**——**COSO 的全称、与 IIA 的组织关系、以及该页究竟提供什么内容，本次均未核实**，**故词条内只写「COSO 资源（COSO 内部控制资源）」并在此标注推断成分**；**⑤ IIA 的会员规模、成立年份与治理结构本次未核实**；**⑥ 是否提供中文准则本次未核实**（**虽有 Translated Content Search 栏目**）；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** IIA 提供精算工具、定价模型或保险数据**。**核实说明**：`/en/standards/2024-standards/global-internal-audit-standards/`（78.7KB）、`/en/resources/global-audit-committee-center/`（94.1KB）、`/en/resources/coso/`（76.9KB）与首页（98.5KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开准则正文、专题要求、全球指引、审计委员会中心、COSO 资源、能力框架、纪律页、学术关系页或任何译文内容**。
entries.body_en:
**The IIA (Institute of Internal Auditors)** is **the global internal audit professional body** (measured site title **"The Institute of Internal Auditors | The IIA"**). This entry adds the **"institutional layer of the third line of defence"** — ⭐ **and the scope must be stated**: **the corpus already holds the concept [[three-lines-of-defense]]**, **but the institution representing the internal audit profession and its standards measured zero**; **i.e. the concept of three lines existed, the third line’s institution did not**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"2024 Global Internal Audit Standards" page measures 78.7KB with the measured title "2024 Global Internal Audit Standards | The IIA"**; ⭐ the **"Global Audit Committee Center" page measures 94.1KB with the measured title "Global Audit Committee Center | Internal Audit Oversight"**; ⭐ the **"COSO Resources from The IIA" page measures 76.9KB**; the **homepage is 98.5KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: under **IPPF & Standards** — ⭐ **Global Internal Audit Standards**, ⭐ **Topical Requirements**, ⭐ **Global Guidance**, **Audit Tools**, ⭐ **Governance Process and Due Diligence** and **documents**; under **Membership** — ⭐ **Student Membership & Resources**, Executive Membership and Group Membership; **Ethics & Professionalism**; under **Resources** — **Statements of Position**, **Knowledge Centers**, ⭐ **Internal Audit Competency Framework**, **Research and Reports** and ⭐ **Translated Content Search**; under **About us** — **About Internal Audit**, **Advocacy**, ⭐ **Discipline and Oversight**, ⭐ **Academic Relations**, **Chapters and Affiliates** and **Licensing**; plus a magazine site at **`internalauditor.theiia.org`**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the institution and standards layer of the third line of defence** — **[[three-lines-of-defense]] explains how the lines divide their work, whereas the IIA supplies the third line’s own standards, competency framework and professional discipline**; **for students working on insurer governance or internal audit, this is a directly checkable professional entry point** (**readable with [[insurance-governance]], [[cro-forum]] and [[igln]] in the same round — four layers: governance concept, CRO, board, internal audit**). **② ⭐⭐ The 2024 Global Internal Audit Standards are **globally uniform internal audit standards** (**the text was not opened, so no clause, number or effective-date arrangement is restated**), **with a two-tier companion structure of topical requirements and global guidance** — **a three-level system of standards → topical requirements → guidance, structurally comparable with [[aae]]’s "international principles → European standards → national standards" and [[assal]]’s "international standards / own standards / member-country regulation", but with different tier logic**. **③ ⭐ The Global Audit Committee Center is a resource aimed at the audit committee** — **connecting directly with the "Audit & Control" focus area of [[igln]] in the same round: one a director-side platform, one a profession-side resource centre**; **a rare resource aimed at a committee rather than at the executive layer** (**content not opened**). **④ ⭐⭐ The COSO resources deserve separate note** — **the COSO internal control framework is the close neighbour of the three-lines concept** (**COSO addresses internal control; three lines addresses organisational division of labour**); **the corpus previously had no institutional entry point for COSO**, **and this entry adds it** (**the COSO content was not opened, so no framework element is restated**). **⑤ Student membership and resources, and academic relations, are directly relevant to this wiki’s readers** — **a professional body running dedicated entry points for students and academia**, **usable information for RIAA graduates considering internal audit** (**conditions not opened**). **⑥ The translated-content search section has practical value for non-English readers** (**only its existence was verified, not the languages**). **⑦ The discipline and oversight section belongs with [[abcd]] (actuarial professional discipline) as the "discipline side" of professional self-regulation** — **reading both shows how different professions design their disciplinary mechanisms**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and three pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the standards, resources, membership and institutional structure read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no standards text, no topical requirement or global guidance, no audit committee centre, no COSO resource, no competency framework, no discipline page, no academic relations page and no translated content**, so **no standard clause or number, COSO framework element, competency item, disciplinary case, membership condition or translated language can be restated**; **② ⭐ "2024 Global Internal Audit Standards" is read verbatim from the page title**, **but its effective date, version structure and whether it runs in parallel with national standards were not verified** — **the entry claims no scope or binding force**; **③ the "three-level system" rests on the parallel listing of those sections**, **and no page explaining their relative authority was opened**; **④ ⭐ The phrase "COSO internal control framework" rests on the page title "COSO Resources from The IIA"** — **COSO’s full name, its organisational relationship to the IIA, and what the page actually provides were all unverified**, **so the entry says only "COSO resources" and flags the inferential component here**; **⑤ the IIA’s membership size, founding year and governance were not verified**; **⑥ whether Chinese standards are available was not verified** (**despite the Translated Content Search section**); **⑦** this entry **does not claim the IIA provides actuarial tools, pricing models or insurance data**. **Verification note**: `/en/standards/2024-standards/global-internal-audit-standards/` (78.7KB), `/en/resources/global-audit-committee-center/` (94.1KB), `/en/resources/coso/` (76.9KB) and the homepage (98.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no standards text, topical requirement, global guidance, audit committee centre, COSO resource, competency framework, discipline page, academic relations page or translated content was opened**.

entries.body:
**CGI（The Chartered Governance Institute UK & Ireland，特许治理公会英国与爱尔兰）** 是**英国与爱尔兰的治理专业团体**（站点标题实测 **「The Chartered Governance Institute UK & Ireland」**）。本条目补的是**「治理作为一门职业」这一形态**——**同轮 [[igln]] 是董事会层、[[theiia]] 是内部审计层、[[ecgi]] 是研究层，而 CGI 补的是「治理从业者本身的资格与职业路径」**，**实测池内该形态为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**站点首页 60.7KB，标题「The Chartered Governance Institute UK & Ireland」**；⭐ **「Governance Qualifications（治理资格）」页 `/qualifications-training/qualifications/` 实测 54.3KB，标题「Governance Qualifications」**；⭐ **「The Competency Framework（能力框架）」页 `/qualifications-training/competency-framework/` 实测 63.2KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：⭐ **A career in Governance** 下含 **Starting a career in governance**、**Sector governance**、**Working in governance**、**Developing a career in governance**、⭐ **Our Jobs Board（职位板）**；⭐ **Qualifications & Training** 下含 **Fast Track**、⭐ **Sector Qualifications（分行业资格）**、**Training courses**、**Qualifications**、**E-Learning**、**Bespoke training**、⭐ **Student Information（学生信息）**、⭐ **CPD（持续专业发展）**、⭐ **Competency Framework**、⭐ **Qualifying Programme**、**qualifications brochure**；**Resources** 下含 ⭐ **Guidance Notes（指引说明）**、⭐ **Technical Briefings（技术简报）**、⭐ **Research（研究）**、**Consultations（咨询回应）**、**g+ magazine**、**Blogs**、**Bookshop**、**Podcasts and Webinars**、**Charity toolkits**；**About us** 下含 ⭐ **Our Governance（自身治理）**、⭐ **Accreditation Services（认证服务）**、News、Become a partner。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「治理从业者」这一职业线**——**池内职业侧此前主要是精算（[[ifoa]]、[[cia-ica]]、[[asb-us]]）、中介（[[insurance-broker]]、[[marsh]]）与理赔/公估（[[cila]]、[[clm]]、[[fuedi]]）**，**而**公司秘书/治理从业者**这一条线此前没有**；**对考虑进入董事会支持、合规治理或公司秘书方向的 RIAA 毕业生，这是一个完整职业地图**（**与 [[cila]] 的公估师资格、[[clm]] 的理赔称号体系构成「三条不同职业线的资格体系」对照**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「能力框架（Competency Framework）」值得单独注意**——**把「治理从业者需要具备什么能力」写成一个框架**，**这与池内 [[theiia]] 的「内部审计能力框架」是同一种设计思路**，**即「职业能力被显式定义并可被评估」**；**对做职业能力模型或课程设计的学生，两者都是可对标的样本**（**本次未打开框架内容**）。**③ ⭐ 「分行业资格（Sector Qualifications）」说明治理资格按行业区分**——**即不同受监管行业（如金融、慈善、公共部门）的治理要求不同、资格也不同**；**这一点与池内 [[cii]]、[[anziif]]、[[loma]] 等按市场划分的资格体系思路相近**（**本次未打开分行业资格的具体门类**）。**④ ⭐ 「认证服务（Accreditation Services）」说明该公会也为**机构**提供认证**——**即不只认证个人，也认证组织的治理实践**；**这与池内 [[abcd]]（只对个人执业行为设纪律）、[[cila]]（只设会员类型）形成不同设计**（**本次未打开认证范围与标准**）。**⑤ 「指引说明 + 技术简报 + 研究 + 咨询回应」四类产出构成实务知识库**——**其中「咨询回应」尤为少见：公会以行业代表身份对监管咨询公开回应**（**本次未打开任何一份**）。**⑥ 「Our Jobs Board」与「Student Information」对本站读者直接相关**（**本次未打开**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与两个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航与链接逐字实测的完整结构（含四类产出与认证服务）**，**但未打开任何资格详情、能力框架内容、分行业资格门类、CPD 要求、指引说明、技术简报、研究报告、咨询回应、职位板或学生信息页**，因此**不能转述任何资格等级、考试科目、能力条目、CPD 学时、指引内容或认证标准**；**② ⭐ 该公会的皇家特许状地位、与英国/爱尔兰监管的关系、成立年份与会员规模本次均未核实**——**故词条内不主张其资格的官方地位或执业效力**；**③ 「公司秘书方向」这一描述依据其「A career in Governance」栏目与治理从业者的通行职能**，**本次未打开任何一页给出其资格的名称与对应的岗位**——**词条内因此以「治理从业者（公司秘书方向）」表述并在此标注**；**④ 「认证服务」面向机构这一判断依据栏目名「Accreditation Services」**，**未打开确认其认证对象、范围与标准**；**⑤ 该公会与 [[theiia]]、[[igln]]、[[ecgi]] 的关系本次未核实**——**词条内的对照属阅读建议**；**⑥ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** CGI 提供精算工具、数据或模型**。**核实说明**：`/qualifications-training/qualifications/`（54.3KB）、`/qualifications-training/competency-framework/`（63.2KB）与首页（60.7KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开任何资格详情、能力框架、指引、简报、研究、咨询回应、职位板或学生信息页**。
entries.body_en:
**CGI (The Chartered Governance Institute UK & Ireland)** is **the governance professional body for the United Kingdom and Ireland** (measured site title **"The Chartered Governance Institute UK & Ireland"**). This entry adds the **"governance as a profession"** form — **[[igln]] is the board layer, [[theiia]] the internal audit layer and [[ecgi]] the research layer in the same round, while CGI supplies the qualifications and career path of governance practitioners themselves**, **measured zero**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the **homepage is 60.7KB with the measured title "The Chartered Governance Institute UK & Ireland"**; ⭐ the **"Governance Qualifications" page measures 54.3KB**; ⭐ the **"The Competency Framework" page measures 63.2KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: ⭐ under **A career in Governance** — **Starting a career in governance**, **Sector governance**, **Working in governance**, **Developing a career in governance** and ⭐ **Our Jobs Board**; ⭐ under **Qualifications & Training** — **Fast Track**, ⭐ **Sector Qualifications**, **Training courses**, **Qualifications**, **E-Learning**, **Bespoke training**, ⭐ **Student Information**, ⭐ **CPD**, ⭐ **Competency Framework**, ⭐ **Qualifying Programme** and a qualifications brochure; under **Resources** — ⭐ **Guidance Notes**, ⭐ **Technical Briefings**, ⭐ **Research**, **Consultations**, **g+ magazine**, **Blogs**, **Bookshop**, **Podcasts and Webinars** and **Charity toolkits**; under **About us** — ⭐ **Our Governance**, ⭐ **Accreditation Services**, News and Become a partner.

For RIAA: **① it adds the governance practitioner career line** — **the corpus’s profession side previously covered mainly actuarial ([[ifoa]], [[cia-ica]], [[asb-us]]), intermediary ([[insurance-broker]], [[marsh]]) and claims or adjusting ([[cila]], [[clm]], [[fuedi]]) lines**, **while company secretarial and governance practitioners had none**; **for RIAA graduates considering board support, governance compliance or company secretarial work this is a complete career map** (**contrasting three qualification systems for three different career lines: [[cila]] for adjusters, [[clm]] for claims, CGI for governance**). **② ⭐⭐ The Competency Framework deserves separate note** — **writing down what capabilities a governance practitioner needs as a framework**, **the same design idea as [[theiia]]’s internal audit competency framework**, **i.e. professional capability explicitly defined and assessable**; **both are benchmarkable samples for work on competency models or curriculum design** (**the framework content was not opened**). **③ ⭐ "Sector Qualifications" indicates governance qualifications differ by sector** — **regulated sectors such as financial services, charities and the public sector have different governance requirements and different qualifications**; ⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and two pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the complete structure read verbatim from navigation and links (including four output types and accreditation services)**, **but opened no qualification detail, competency framework content, sector qualification list, CPD requirement, guidance note, technical briefing, research report, consultation response, jobs board or student information page**, so **no qualification grade, examination subject, competency item, CPD hour, guidance content or accreditation standard can be restated**; **② ⭐ the institute’s royal charter status, its relationship with UK or Irish regulation, its founding year and membership size were all unverified** — **so the entry claims no official standing or practice effect for its qualifications**; **③ the description "company secretarial direction" rests on its "A career in Governance" section and the common functions of governance practitioners**, **and no page giving its qualification names and corresponding roles was opened** — **the entry therefore says "governance practitioners (company secretarial direction)" and flags that here**; **④ that accreditation services target organisations rests on the section name**, **and its subjects, scope and standards were not opened**; **⑤ CGI’s relationships with [[theiia]], [[igln]] and [[ecgi]] were not verified** — **the comparisons in the entry are reading suggestions**; **⑥ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim CGI provides actuarial tools, data or models**. **Verification note**: `/qualifications-training/qualifications/` (54.3KB), `/qualifications-training/competency-framework/` (63.2KB) and the homepage (60.7KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; entries.body:
**ECGI（European Corporate Governance Institute，欧洲公司治理研究所）** 是**公司治理领域的研究机构**（站点标题实测 **「ECGI」**）。本条目补的是**「治理研究的机构层」**——**同轮 [[igln]] 是董事会层、[[theiia]] 是内部审计层、[[cgi]] 是职业层，而 ECGI 补的是**研究层**；**且它提供一份池内完全没有的东西：按国家汇编的公司治理守则**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**站点首页 239.2KB（244,948 字节），标题「ECGI」**；⭐⭐ **「Corporate Governance by Country（按国家的公司治理）」页 `/publications/codes/corporate-governance-by-country` 实测 330.8KB**——**本条目四页中体量最大**；⭐ **「Codes（守则）」页 `/publications/codes` 实测 203.3KB**；⭐ **「Working Papers（工作论文）」页 `/publications/working-papers` 实测 272.1KB**；⭐ **「The ECGI Finance Editorial Board（金融编辑委员会）」页 `/publications/working-papers/the-ecgi-finance-editorial-board` 实测 180.1KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：**Publications** 下含 ⭐ **Working Papers**（含 **Working Papers FAQ**、⭐ **Copyright and Open Access（版权与开放获取）**、⭐ **Working Papers Scope Guide（范围指南）**、**Prizes and Sponsors**、⭐ **The ECGI Finance Editorial Board**、⭐ **The ECGI Law Editorial Board（法律编辑委员会）**）、⭐ **Codes**（含 ⭐ **Corporate Governance by Country**）、**Books**、**Blog**（含 About the Blog、Blog FAQ、**ECGI Blog Team**、**ECGI Blog Review**）、**ECGI Reports**；**News** 下含 **Newsletters**、⭐ **In Focus Newsletter**、⭐ **The ECGI Members’ Debrief**、⭐ **The Future of Corporate Governance**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「按国家的公司治理守则」汇编是本轮最有实用价值的一处**——**公司治理守则（corporate governance code）是各国「遵守或解释（comply or explain）」机制的载体**，**而把各国守则集中在一处，是跨境治理比较研究最直接的入口**；**对做**跨境治理比较、或研究保险公司董事会要求**的学生，这是一个此前池内完全缺失的基础资源**（**可与池内各国监管者条目 [[acpr]]、[[fsca]]、[[ivass]]、[[cmf-chile]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 并读——**那些是监管者的产出，这是治理守则本身的汇编**）；**注意：本次未打开任何一国守则内容，故不转述其条文或覆盖国家数量**。**② ⭐ 工作论文分设「金融」与「法律」两个编辑委员会**——**说明该系列把治理研究分成两个学科口径**；**对做治理研究的学生，「同一议题的金融视角与法律视角」是被机构显式区分的**（**本次未打开任何工作论文或编辑委员会名单**）。**③ ⭐ 「版权与开放获取（Copyright and Open Access）」被单列**——**即开放获取状态是该系列明确声明的信息**；**对需要用文献的学生，这一条比论文数量更重要**（**注意：本次仅核实该页面路径存在，未核实其实际授权条款——故本词条不主张其开放获取**）。**④ ⭐ 「In Focus Newsletter」与「The ECGI Members’ Debrief」说明其产出分「公开」与「成员」两档**——**后者从命名看是成员专享**（**本次未打开，故不主张内容范围**）。**⑤ 「The Future of Corporate Governance」是一个以未来为题的栏目**（**本次未打开**）。**⑥ 该机构是「研究机构」而非「监管者或职业团体」**——**这与同轮另三条形成清晰分工：[[igln]] 是实践者对话、[[theiia]] 与 [[cgi]] 是职业资格、ECGI 是研究**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航与链接逐字实测的出版物结构（含两个编辑委员会、Codes、Blog、News 各组）**，**但未打开任何一国治理守则、任何工作论文、任何书籍、博客文章、报告或通讯**，因此**不能转述任何守则条文、覆盖国家数量、论文结论、编辑委员会名单或授权条款**；**② ⭐ 「按国家的公司治理守则汇编」这一表述依据页面标题「Corporate Governance by Country」与栏目归属（Publications → Codes）**，**本次未打开该页确认其收录范围、体例与更新频率**——**故词条内不主张其覆盖国家数量或完整性**；**③ ⭐ 「开放获取」本次**未核实**——**词条内只写「版权与开放获取被单列」这一事实，并明确不主张其开放获取**；**④ 「成员简报为成员专享」为由名称推断**，**本次未打开确认**；**⑤ 「金融与法律两个编辑委员会」为路径与栏目名实测**，**其职责划分、成员构成与审稿流程本次未核实**；**⑥ 该机构的成立年份、所在地、资助与治理结构本次未核实**；**⑦ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑧** 本词条**不主张** ECGI 提供精算工具、数据或模型**。**核实说明**：`/publications/codes/corporate-governance-by-country`（330.8KB）、`/publications/codes`（203.3KB）、`/publications/working-papers`（272.1KB）、`/publications/working-papers/the-ecgi-finance-editorial-board`（180.1KB）与首页（239.2KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开任何守则、论文、书籍、博客、报告或通讯**。
entries.body_en:
**ECGI (the European Corporate Governance Institute)** is **a corporate governance research institute** (measured site title **"ECGI"**). This entry adds the **"governance research institution"** layer — **[[igln]] is the board layer, [[theiia]] the internal audit layer and [[cgi]] the professional layer in the same round, while ECGI supplies research**; **and it provides something the corpus entirely lacked: corporate governance codes compiled by country**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the **homepage is 239.2KB (244,948 bytes) with the measured title "ECGI"**; ⭐⭐ the **"Corporate Governance by Country" page measures 330.8KB** — **the largest of this entry’s four pages**; ⭐ the **"Codes" page measures 203.3KB**; ⭐ the **"Working Papers" page measures 272.1KB**; ⭐ the **"The ECGI Finance Editorial Board" page measures 180.1KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: under **Publications** — ⭐ **Working Papers** (with **Working Papers FAQ**, ⭐ **Copyright and Open Access**, ⭐ **Working Papers Scope Guide**, **Prizes and Sponsors**, ⭐ **The ECGI Finance Editorial Board** and ⭐ **The ECGI Law Editorial Board**), ⭐ **Codes** (with ⭐ **Corporate Governance by Country**), **Books**, **Blog** (with About the Blog, Blog FAQ, **ECGI Blog Team**, **ECGI Blog Review**) and **ECGI Reports**; under **News** — **Newsletters**, ⭐ **In Focus Newsletter**, ⭐ **The ECGI Members’ Debrief** and ⭐ **The Future of Corporate Governance**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐ The corporate governance codes by country are this round’s most practically useful item** — **a corporate governance code is the vehicle for each country’s "comply or explain" mechanism**, **and gathering national codes in one place is the most direct entry point for cross-border governance comparison**; **for students doing comparative governance work or studying insurer board requirements, this is a foundational resource entirely absent from the corpus** (readable with the national supervisor entries [[acpr]], [[fsca]], [[ivass]], [[cmf-chile]] and [[apra-insurance-statistics]] — **those are supervisors’ outputs; this is a compendium of the codes themselves**); **note: no national code was opened, so no clause or country count is restated**. **② ⭐ The working paper series has separate finance and law editorial boards** — **the research is divided into two disciplinary lenses**; **for governance research students, "the finance view and the law view of the same issue" is explicitly separated by the institution** (**no working paper or editorial board list was opened**). **③ ⭐ "Copyright and Open Access" is listed separately** — **access status is explicitly stated for the series**; **for students needing literature this matters more than paper counts** (**note: only the path’s existence was verified, not the actual licence terms — so this entry does not claim open access**). **④ ⭐ "In Focus Newsletter" and "The ECGI Members’ Debrief" indicate public and member tiers** — **the latter appears member-only from its name** (**not opened, so no content scope is claimed**). **⑤ "The Future of Corporate Governance" is a future-oriented section** (**not opened**). **⑥ The body is a research institute, not a supervisor or professional body** — **a clear division of labour with the round’s other three: [[igln]] is practitioner dialogue, [[theiia]] and [[cgi]] are professional qualifications, ECGI is research**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the publication structure read verbatim from navigation and links (including two editorial boards and the Codes, Blog and News groupings)**, **but opened no national governance code, no working paper, no book, no blog post, no report and no newsletter**, so **no code clause, country count, paper conclusion, editorial board roster or licence term can be restated**; **② ⭐ "a compendium of corporate governance codes by country" rests on the page title "Corporate Governance by Country" and its placement (Publications → Codes)**, **and that page was not opened to confirm coverage, format or update frequency** — **so no country count or completeness is claimed**; **③ ⭐ "Open access" was **not verified** — **the entry states only that copyright and open access are listed, and explicitly does not claim open access**; **④ "the members’ debrief is member-only" is inferred from its name**, **not confirmed by opening it**; **⑤ "two editorial boards, finance and law" is measured from paths and labels**, **and their remit, membership and review process were not verified**; **⑥ the institute’s founding year, location, funding and governance were not verified**; **⑦ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**; **⑧** this entry **does not claim ECGI provides actuarial tools, data or models**. **Verification note**: `/publications/codes/corporate-governance-by-country` (330.8KB), `/publications/codes` (203.3KB), `/publications/working-papers` (272.1KB), `/publications/working-papers/the-ecgi-finance-editorial-board` (180.1KB) and the homepage (239.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no code, paper, book, blog post, report or newsletter was opened**.

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與四個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航與連結逐字實測的出版物結構（含兩個編輯委員會、Codes、Blog、News 各組）**，**但未打開任何一國治理守則、任何工作論文、任何書籍、博客文章、報告或通訊**，故**不能轉述任何守則條文、覆蓋國家數量、論文結論、編輯委員會名單或授權條款**；**② ⭐ 「按國家的公司治理守則彙編」依據頁面標題與欄目歸屬**，**未打開該頁確認收錄範圍、體例與更新頻率**——**故不主張其覆蓋國家數量或完整性**；**③ ⭐ 「開放獲取」本次**未核實**——**詞條內只寫「版權與開放獲取被單列」這一事實，並明確不主張其開放獲取**；**④ 「成員簡報為成員專享」為由名稱推斷，未打開確認**；**⑤ 「金融與法律兩個編輯委員會」為路徑與欄目名實測**，**其職責劃分、成員構成與審稿流程未核實**；**⑥ 成立年份、所在地、資助與治理結構未核實**；**⑦ 是否有中文材料未核實**；**⑧** 本詞條**不主張** ECGI 提供精算工具、數據或模型**。**核實說明**：五個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開任何守則、論文、書籍、博客、報告或通訊**。

entries.body:
**NAPHIA（North American Pet Health Insurance Association，北美宠物健康保险协会）** 是**北美宠物健康保险（宠物险）行业的协会**（站点标题实测 **「NAPHIA - The North American Pet Health Insurance Association」**）。本条目补的是**「宠物险」这一整条业务线**——**实测池内 `pet insurance` / `宠物险` 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**站点首页 64.9KB**；⭐ **「About the Industry（关于本行业）」页 `/industry-data/` 实测 68.9KB，标题逐字为「NAPHIA - About the Industry - **State of the Industry Report 2026**」**——**即页面标题本身写明这是《行业状况报告 2026》**；⭐ **「Download Report Highlights（下载报告要点）」页 `/industry-data/report-highlights-download/` 实测 80.6KB，标题「Download Report Highlights - NAPHIA State of the Industry Report」**；⭐ **「About This Data（关于本数据）」页 `/industry-data/about-this-data/`**（实测存在）。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：**About NAPHIA** 下含 **Board & Governance**（**Executive**、**Directors at Large**、**Working Committees**）、**Benefits of Membership**；⭐ **Members** 下含**三类**：**Driver（驱动方）**、**Industry Associate（行业相关方）**、**Industry Ally（行业盟友）**；⭐ **Data** 下含 **About the Industry / State of the Industry**、⭐ **About This Data**、⭐ **Download Report Highlights**；**NAPHIA ENGAGE**（年会）下含 **Schedule**、**Hotel & Travel**、**Keynote Speakers**、**Speakers**、**Sponsorships**；另有 **Veterinary（兽医）** 相关栏目。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「宠物险」这一整条业务线**——**宠物险是近年增长最快的个人险种之一**（**注意：本次未打开报告，故不转述任何增速或规模数值**），**而池内此前完全没有该险种的行业入口**；**对做个人险种组合或新兴险种研究的学生，这是该险种在北美最直接的行业数据来源**（可与其险种条目 [[vhis-standard-premium]]（香港自愿医保标准保费）、[[mib]]（英国车险行业机制）并读——**三条都是「某一险种的行业级数据/机制入口」，但险种与辖区各不相同**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「About This Data（关于本数据）」单设一页，是本条目最值得注意的做法**——**行业报告通常只给数字，而 NAPHIA 把「这些数据是怎么来的」单独说明**；**对做数据质量评估或引用规范的学生，这是一个可直接借鉴的披露做法**（**可与池内 [[eiopa-registers]] 的「监管者自述数据局限」、[[theiia]] 的准则说明并读——三者都是「对数据/准则本身的元说明」**）。**③ ⭐ 会员分「驱动方 / 行业相关方 / 行业盟友」三类，说明宠物险的价值链并非只有保险公司**——**「驱动方」在宠物险语境下通常指与宠物医疗/宠物生态相关的参与方**（**注意：本次未打开会员页，故不转述三类的具体构成与成员名单**）；**这种「按价值链角色分类会员」的设计，与池内 [[cila]]（按公估专长）、[[clm]]（按职业角色）的分类逻辑不同**。**④ 「Veterinary（兽医）」栏目值得注意**——**宠物险的理赔与定价高度依赖兽医端数据与协同**，**该协会设兽医相关栏目说明其把兽医视为行业参与方**（**本次未打开**）。

**NAPHIA (the North American Pet Health Insurance Association)** is **the trade association for the North American pet health insurance industry** (measured site title **"NAPHIA - The North American Pet Health Insurance Association"**). This entry adds an entire missing line of business — **measured: `pet insurance` returned zero**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the **homepage is 64.9KB**; ⭐ the **"About the Industry" page `/industry-data/` measures 68.9KB with the measured title "NAPHIA - About the Industry - State of the Industry Report 2026"** — **the page title itself states this is the State of the Industry Report 2026**; ⭐ the **"Download Report Highlights" page measures 80.6KB with the measured title "Download Report Highlights - NAPHIA State of the Industry Report"**; ⭐ an **"About This Data" page** measurably exists. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: under **About NAPHIA** — **Board & Governance** (**Executive**, **Directors at Large**, **Working Committees**) and **Benefits of Membership**; ⭐ under **Members** — **three classes: Driver, Industry Associate and Industry Ally**; ⭐ under **Data** — **About the Industry / State of the Industry**, ⭐ **About This Data** and ⭐ **Download Report Highlights**; under **NAPHIA ENGAGE** (its annual conference) — **Schedule**, **Hotel & Travel**, **Keynote Speakers**, **Speakers** and **Sponsorships**; plus **Veterinary**-related sections.

For RIAA: **① it adds the whole pet insurance line** — **pet insurance is among the fastest-growing personal lines in recent years** (**note: the report was not opened, so no growth or size figure is restated**), **and the corpus had no industry entry point for this line at all**; **for work on personal-line portfolios or emerging lines, this is the most direct North American industry data source** (readable with the line-specific entries [[vhis-standard-premium]] (Hong Kong VHIS standard premiums) and [[mib]] (the UK motor industry mechanism) — **all three are industry-level data or mechanism entry points for a line, but the lines and jurisdictions differ**). **② ⭐⭐ A dedicated "About This Data" page is the most notable practice here** — **industry reports usually give only numbers, whereas NAPHIA explains separately where the data comes from**; **a directly borrowable disclosure practice for students doing data-quality assessment or citation** (**readable with the "regulator states its own data limits" passage in [[eiopa-registers]] and the standards explanations of [[theiia]] — all three are meta-explanations of data or standards**). **③ ⭐ Dividing members into driver, industry associate and industry ally shows the pet insurance value chain is not only insurers** — **in the pet context a "driver" usually means a participant connected to veterinary care or the pet ecosystem** (**note: the members page was not opened, so the composition and roster of the three classes are not restated**); **this "categorise members by value-chain role" design differs from [[cila]] (by adjusting specialism) and [[clm]] (by professional role)**. **④ A "Veterinary" section is notable** — **pet insurance claims and pricing depend heavily on veterinary-side data and coordination**, **and this section indicates the association treats veterinarians as industry participants** (**not opened**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and three pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the member classes, Data section and conference sections read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no State of the Industry Report body, downloaded no highlights, and opened neither the about-this-data page, the members page nor the veterinary section**, so **no market size, growth rate, premium, loss ratio, member roster or data basis can be restated**; **② ⭐ "State of the Industry Report 2026" is read verbatim from the page title**, **and its publication form (free or registration-gated), page count and year coverage were not verified** — **the entry claims only that the report page and a highlights download page exist, not their content or access terms**; **③ the measured page sizes are facts; their internal structure was not verified**; **④ the Chinese rendering "driver" and what it actually denotes** (whether non-insurer participants such as veterinary care or pet food) **were not verified**, **and the entry flags this as contextual inference without restating the composition**; **⑤ NAPHIA’s founding year, member count, legal status and geographic coverage (whether Canada and Mexico are included) were not verified** (**the name says "North American" but actual coverage was not verified**); **⑥ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim NAPHIA provides actuarial tools, pricing models or policy-level data**. **Verification note**: `/industry-data/` (68.9KB), `/industry-data/report-highlights-download/` (80.6KB) and the homepage (64.9KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no report body, highlights download, data-explanation page, members page or veterinary section was opened**.

entries.body:
**ALTA（American Land Title Association，美国土地产权协会）** 是**美国产权保险（title insurance）行业的协会**（站点标题实测 **「ALTA - American Land Title Association」**）。本条目补的是**「产权保险」这一整条业务线**——**实测池内 `title insurance` / `产权保险` 相关条目为 0**，**且这是一个**辖区特有**的险种：美国的房地产交易依赖产权检索与产权保险，而香港与内地并无对应制度。**

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**站点首页 79.7KB**；⭐ **「Unregulated Alternatives to Title Insurance Protection（产权保险保护的无监管替代品）」议题页 `/topics/topic-unregulated-insurance` 实测 76.3KB，标题「ALTA - Unregulated Alternatives to Title Insurance Protection」**；⭐ **「Artificial Intelligence（人工智能）」议题页 `/topics/artificial-intelligence` 实测 72.4KB，标题「ALTA - Artificial Intelligence」**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：**About ALTA** 下含 **Strategic Priorities**、**Board of Governors**、**ALTA Presidents**、**Bylaws**、**Antitrust Policy**、⭐ **State Land Title Associations（各州土地产权协会）**、**History of ALTA**；⭐ **Topics** 下含 **Unregulated Alternatives to Title Insurance Protection**、⭐ **Financial Crimes Enforcement Network（FinCEN）**、**Artificial Intelligence**、⭐ **ALTA 49 Endorsements**、**Real Estate-related Fraud**、**Consumer Education**、⭐ **Title Waiver Pilot**、**Wire Fraud**；⭐ **Policies and Standards** 下含 **Policy Forms（政策表单）/ Settlement Statements（结算单）**；**Advocacy** 下含 **Advocacy Issues**（含 **Title Waiver / 无产权保险试点**相关的 **`/advocacy/housing-opportunities/unregulated-title-insurance-products`**、**1031 交换**、**Treasury**、**Housing Affordability**、**Redaction and Record Shielding** 等）、**TIPAC**、⭐ **TAN（Title Action Network，含成员地图与国会联络人）**、**State Advocacy**；⭐ **News and Publications → Legal and Regulatory Publications** 下含 **TIRS State Compliance Guide** 与 ⭐ **Title and Escrow Claims Guide（产权与托管理赔指南）**；**Career and Learning** 下含 **Webinars and Training**（含 **Approved Courses and States**、**New Title Agent Kit**、**Model Training Program**、**Title 101 State Compliance Guide Combo**）与 **Continuing Education**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「产权保险」是一个高价值的**制度比较**样本**——**美国的不动产交易几乎必然涉及产权检索与产权保险，而香港与内地并无这一险种**；**对本站读者（香港/内地学生），这是理解「同一风险在不同辖区被不同制度安排」的最清晰案例之一**（**与其对照可读池内 [[hkmc]] 的按揭保险——两者都服务于不动产交易，但一个保「产权瑕疵」、一个保「借款人违约」**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「无监管替代品 / 无产权保险试点（Unregulated Alternatives / Title Waiver Pilot）」是本轮最有洞察力的议题**——**受监管的保险产品面临**不受监管的替代方案**的竞争，而协会为此设立专门议题页与倡导条目**；**这对研究监管边界与监管套利的学生是一个真实且具体的案例**（**注意：本次未打开议题页正文，故不转述其立场、政策细节或试点范围**）；**可与池内 [[iais-icp]] 的保险核心原则、[[a2ii]] 的普惠保险监管并读——三者都触及「什么应当被纳入保险监管」这一边界问题**。**③ ⭐ 「AI」与「FinCEN（反洗钱）」并列为议题，说明产权保险的合规压力集中在**技术应用**与**资金流向审查**两处**——**这与池内 [[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]]、[[lma-ai-governance]] 的 AI 治理条目、以及 [[mpfa-intermediaries]] 的合规执法构成不同行业对同类问题的回应**。**④ ⭐ 「政策表单（Policy Forms）与结算单（Settlement Statements）」说明该协会也承担**标准文件**职能**——**即协会不只做倡导，还制定行业通用的保单/结算文本**；**这与池内 [[cila]] 的章程条款、[[fuedi]] 的标准条件、[[iso-42001-toolkit]] 的标准属不同层面的「标准制定」（**那些是职业标准或管理体系标准，这是**保单与交易文件**标准**）。**⑤ 「50 州土地产权协会名录」是现成的**州级行业地图**——**产权保险在美国是**州级监管**的，**该名录可用于确认各州的行业组织与监管环境**（**本次未打开名录内容**）。**⑥ 「产权与托管理赔指南」是面向理赔实务的出版物**（**本次未打开**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与两个议题页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航与链接逐字实测的议题、政策表单、倡导与出版物结构**，**但未打开任何议题页正文、未打开政策表单或结算单、未打开理赔指南、合规指南、50 州名录、倡导条目或培训课程**，因此**不能转述任何议题立场、政策细节、表单条款、理赔指引、州级名录内容或监管状态**；**② ⭐ 「无监管替代品」与「Title Waiver Pilot」的具体内容、涉及机构与政策进展本次未核实**——**词条内只描述该议题**存在**，不描述其内容或结论**；**③ 「ALTA 49 Endorsements」的性质**（是否为第 49 号批单或一套批单编号）**本次未核实**，**词条内仅列出该栏目名，不作解释**；**④ 「政策表单与结算单属 ALTA 制定」这一判断依据导航结构（Policies and Standards → Policy Forms / Settlement Statements）**，**未打开确认其制定主体、版本与适用范围**；**⑤ 产权保险在美国为州级监管这一表述依据该协会设「各州协会名录」与「州级倡导」栏目**，**本次未打开任何一页确认监管分工**——**词条内该处为阅读提示**；**⑥ 该协会的成立年份、会员规模与法定地位本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** ALTA 提供精算工具、定价模型或产权数据**。**核实说明**：`/topics/topic-unregulated-insurance`（76.3KB）、`/topics/artificial-intelligence`（72.4KB）与首页（79.7KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开任何议题正文、政策表单、结算单、理赔指南、合规指南、50 州名录、倡导条目或培训课程**。
entries.body_en:
**ALTA (the American Land Title Association)** is **the US title insurance trade association** (measured site title **"ALTA - American Land Title Association"**). This entry adds an entire missing line of business — **measured: `title insurance` returned zero** — **and it is a jurisdiction-specific line: US real estate transactions depend on title search and title insurance, whereas Hong Kong and mainland China have no equivalent institution**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the **homepage is 79.7KB**; ⭐ the **"Unregulated Alternatives to Title Insurance Protection" topic page measures 76.3KB with the measured title "ALTA - Unregulated Alternatives to Title Insurance Protection"**; ⭐ the **"Artificial Intelligence" topic page measures 72.4KB with the measured title "ALTA - Artificial Intelligence"**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: under **About ALTA** — **Strategic Priorities**, **Board of Governors**, **ALTA Presidents**, **Bylaws**, **Antitrust Policy**, ⭐ **State Land Title Associations**, **History of ALTA**; ⭐ under **Topics** — **Unregulated Alternatives to Title Insurance Protection**, ⭐ **Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN)**, **Artificial Intelligence**, ⭐ **ALTA 49 Endorsements**, **Real Estate-related Fraud**, **Consumer Education**, ⭐ **Title Waiver Pilot** and **Wire Fraud**; ⭐ under **Policies and Standards** — **Policy Forms** and **Settlement Statements**; under **Advocacy** — **Advocacy Issues** (including **`/advocacy/housing-opportunities/unregulated-title-insurance-products`**, **1031 exchanges**, **Treasury**, **Housing Affordability**, **Redaction and Record Shielding**), **TIPAC**, ⭐ **TAN (Title Action Network, with a member map and congressional liaisons)** and **State Advocacy**; ⭐ under **News and Publications → Legal and Regulatory Publications** — a **TIRS State Compliance Guide** and ⭐ a **Title and Escrow Claims Guide**; under **Career and Learning** — **Webinars and Training** (with **Approved Courses and States**, a **New Title Agent Kit**, a **Model Training Program** and a **Title 101 State Compliance Guide Combo**) and **Continuing Education**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐ Title insurance is a high-value jurisdictional-comparison sample** — **US real estate transactions almost always involve title search and title insurance, while Hong Kong and the mainland have no such line**; **for this wiki’s readers this is one of the clearest cases of "the same risk arranged differently across jurisdictions"** (compare [[hkmc]]’s mortgage insurance — **both serve real estate transactions, but one covers defects in title and the other borrower default**). **② ⭐⭐ "Unregulated alternatives / title waiver pilot" is the round’s most insightful topic** — **a regulated insurance product facing competition from unregulated substitutes, with the association creating both a topic page and advocacy items for it**; **a real and specific case for students studying regulatory boundaries and arbitrage** (**note: no topic body was opened, so its position, policy detail and pilot scope are not restated**); **readable with [[iais-icp]] and [[a2ii]] — all three touch the boundary question of what should fall under insurance regulation**. **③ ⭐ AI and FinCEN (anti-money-laundering) appearing as parallel topics shows compliance pressure on title insurance concentrates on technology use and funds-flow scrutiny** — **comparable with how other sectors respond to the same problems in [[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]], [[lma-ai-governance]] and the enforcement of [[mpfa-intermediaries]]**. **④ ⭐ Policy forms and settlement statements show the association also performs a standards function** — **not only advocacy but industry-standard policy and settlement texts**; **this differs in kind from [[cila]]’s charter clauses, [[fuedi]]’s standard conditions and [[iso-42001-toolkit]]** (**those are professional or management-system standards; these are policy and transaction document standards**). **⑤ The fifty-state land title association directory is a ready state-level industry map** — **title insurance is state-regulated in the US**, **and the directory can be used to establish each state’s industry bodies and regulatory environment** (**not opened**). **⑥ The title and escrow claims guide is a claims-practice publication** (**not opened**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and two topic pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the topics, policy forms, advocacy and publication structure read verbatim from navigation and links**, **but opened no topic body, no policy form or settlement statement, no claims guide, no compliance guide, no fifty-state directory, no advocacy item and no training course**, so **no topic position, policy detail, form clause, claims guidance, state directory content or regulatory status can be restated**; **② ⭐ the content, involved institutions and policy progress of "unregulated alternatives" and the "Title Waiver Pilot" were not verified** — **the entry describes only that the topic exists, not its content or conclusions**; **③ the nature of "ALTA 49 Endorsements"** (whether a 49th endorsement or a set of endorsements) **was not verified**, **and the entry lists the label without interpreting it**; **④ that policy forms and settlement statements are produced by ALTA rests on the navigation structure (Policies and Standards → Policy Forms / Settlement Statements)**, **and no page confirming their author, version or scope was opened**; **⑤ the statement that title insurance is state-regulated in the US rests on the association keeping a state directory and state advocacy sections**, **and no page confirming that division was opened** — **the entry treats it as a reading prompt**; **⑥ the association’s founding year, membership size and legal status were not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim ALTA provides actuarial tools, pricing models or title data**. **Verification note**: `/topics/topic-unregulated-insurance` (76.3KB), `/topics/artificial-intelligence` (72.4KB) and the homepage (79.7KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no topic body, policy form, settlement statement, claims guide, compliance guide, state directory, advocacy item or training course was opened**.

**ALTA（American Land Title Association，美國土地產權協會）** 是**美國產權保險（title insurance）行業的協會**（站點標題實測 **「ALTA - American Land Title Association」**）。本條目補的是**「產權保險」這一整條業務線**——**實測池內 `title insurance`／`产权保险` 相關條目為 0**，**且這是一個**轄區特有**的險種：美國的房地產交易依賴產權檢索與產權保險，而香港與內地並無對應制度**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **79.7KB**；⭐ **「Unregulated Alternatives to Title Insurance Protection」議題頁 76.3KB**；⭐ **「Artificial Intelligence」議題頁 72.4KB**。**導航與連結逐字實測**：⭐ **Topics** 下含 **Unregulated Alternatives to Title Insurance Protection／⭐FinCEN／Artificial Intelligence／⭐ALTA 49 Endorsements／Real Estate-related Fraud／Consumer Education／⭐Title Waiver Pilot／Wire Fraud**；⭐ **Policies and Standards** 下含 **Policy Forms（政策表單）／Settlement Statements（結算單）**；**About ALTA** 含 ⭐**State Land Title Associations** 與 Bylaws／Antitrust Policy／History；**Advocacy** 含 **TAN（Title Action Network）／TIPAC／State Advocacy** 與多項議題（含 `unregulated-title-insurance-products`）；⭐ **News and Publications** 含 **TIRS State Compliance Guide** 與 ⭐**Title and Escrow Claims Guide**；**Career and Learning** 含 **Approved Courses and States／New Title Agent Kit／Model Training Program**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「產權保險」是高價值的**制度比較**樣本**——**美國不動產交易幾乎必然涉及產權檢索與產權保險，而香港與內地並無這一險種**（可與池內 [[hkmc]] 的按揭保險對照——**兩者都服務不動產交易，但一個保「產權瑕疵」、一個保「借款人違約」**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「無監管替代品／無產權保險試點」是本輪最有洞察力的議題**——**受監管的保險產品面臨**不受監管的替代方案**競爭，而協會為此設專門議題頁與倡導條目**；**對研究監管邊界與監管套利的學生是真實且具體的案例**（**未打開議題頁正文，故不轉述其立場與政策細節**）。**③ ⭐ 「AI」與「FinCEN（反洗錢）」並列為議題，說明合規壓力集中在**技術應用**與**資金流向審查**兩處**。**④ ⭐ 「政策表單與結算單」說明該協會也承擔**標準文件**職能**——**與 [[cila]]、[[fuedi]] 的職業/合同標準屬不同層面（這是**保單與交易文件**標準）**。**⑤ 「50 州土地產權協會名錄」是現成的**州級行業地圖**（**未打開**）。**⑥ 「產權與託管理賠指南」是面向理賠實務的出版物**（**未打開**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與兩個議題頁的存在、標題、體量、導航與連結逐字實測的議題、政策表單、倡導與出版物結構**，**但未打開任何議題正文、政策表單、結算單、理賠指南、合規指南、50 州名錄、倡導條目或培訓課程**，故**不能轉述任何議題立場、政策細節、表單條款、理賠指引、州級名錄內容或監管狀態**；**② ⭐ 「無監管替代品」與「Title Waiver Pilot」的具體內容、涉及機構與政策進展未核實**——**詞條內只描述該議題**存在**，不描述其內容或結論**；**③ 「ALTA 49 Endorsements」的性質未核實**，**詞條內僅列出欄目名，不作解釋**；**④ 「政策表單與結算單屬 ALTA 制定」依據導航結構，未打開確認其制定主體與適用範圍**；**⑤ 「產權保險在美國為州級監管」依據該協會設州級名錄與州級倡導欄目**，**未打開確認監管分工**——**詞條內該處為閱讀提示**；**⑥ 成立年份、會員規模與法定地位未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** ALTA 提供精算工具、定價模型或產權數據**。**核實說明**：三個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開任何議題正文、政策表單、結算單、理賠指南、合規指南、50 州名錄、倡導條目或培訓課程**。

entries.body:
**USMI（U.S. Mortgage Insurers，美国按揭保险人）** 是**美国按揭保险（私人 MI，private mortgage insurance）行业的组织**（站点标题实测 **「U.S. Mortgage Insurers | USMI」**）。本条目补的是**「按揭保险的市场数据层」**——⭐ **口径必须写明**：**实测池内按揭相关条目有 2 条**（[[hkmc]]（香港按揭证券公司，其条目内容是公共年金、逆按揭与按揭保险统计）与 [[qbe]]（保险公司条目）），**但「按揭保险的行业市场数据」此前为 0**；**按形态重复纪律，USMI 补的正是该形态没有的东西：一个由六页构成的市场数据栏目。**

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「PMI by the Numbers（按数量统计）」页 `/data/pmi-by-the-numbers/` 实测 49.7KB**；⭐ **「State Mortgage Insurance（州级按揭保险）」页 `/data/mi-by-state/` 实测 91.9KB**（**本条目三页中最大**）；⭐ **「Mortgage Insurance Credit Risk Transfer（按揭保险信用风险转移）」页 `/data/credit-risk-transfer/` 实测 51.5KB**；**站点首页 48.9KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：**Private MI** 下含 **What is MI?**、**Benefits**、**MI Options**；⭐ **Market Data** 下含六页：**PMI by the Numbers**、**MI by State**、**Strength and Resiliency Report**、**Credit Risk Transfer**、**2024 Homeownership Market Survey**、**Other Reports**；**Policy Priorities** 下含 **Advocacy**、⭐ **Tax Deductibility（税负可扣除）**、⭐ **Taxpayer Protection（纳税人保护）**、**Access & Affordability**、**Housing Finance Reform**、⭐ **Appraisal Modernization（评估现代化）**；**News & Resources**；**About** 下含 **Mission**、⭐ **Our Members（我们的成员）**、**Our Team**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「按揭保险」这一险种的市场数据层**——**池内 [[hkmc]] 是香港按揭保险的运营方与其统计（公共年金、逆按揭、按揭保险）**，**而 USMI 给的是**美国私人按揭保险行业**的横向市场数据**；**两者并读可见「同一险种在两个辖区的两种制度」**：**香港是以公共机构（HKMC）为主导，美国是以私人保险人（private MI）加政府相关机构（房利美/房地美）为结构**（**注意：本次未打开任何数据页，故不转述其规模、市占或制度细节**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「信用风险转移（Credit Risk Transfer）」是本轮最有分析价值的一页**——**它把按揭保险与**资本市场**连接起来**：**保险人把部分信用风险转移给投资者**；**这与池内巨灾侧的风险证券化（[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[artemis]]、[[perils-ied]]）是**同一逻辑在不同风险上的应用**——**巨灾风险证券化 vs 按揭信用风险转移**；**对做风险转移与资本市场方向的学生，这是一个此前缺失的对照样本**（**可与 [[insurance-scr-data]] 的资本计量、[[sii-spread-risk-scr]] 的利差风险并读**）。**③ ⭐ 「州级按揭保险（MI by State）」把同一个险种按**美国各州**拆开**——**对做区域差异分析的学生，这是一个现成的州级粒度数据入口**（**本次未打开，故不转述任何州级数值**）。**④ ⭐ 政策议题中的「税负可扣除」与「纳税人保护」值得注意**——**前者是把按揭保险费与税收制度挂钩（影响产品需求）**，**后者是把「私人资本承担风险、避免纳税人兜底」作为政策主张**；**这两条正好说明按揭保险在美国是一个**公共政策深度介入**的险种**（**可与池内 [[pbgc]]、[[assuris]]、[[nolhga]] 的「兜底机制」并读——**那三条是「出事后谁兜底」，USMI 的议题是「如何避免动用纳税人兜底」**）。**⑤ 「评估现代化（Appraisal Modernization）」是一个不常见但真实的政策议题**——**房产评估方式变化会直接影响按揭保险的风险计量**（**本次未打开**）。**⑥ 「Our Members」页说明该组织有明确成员名单**（**本次未打开，故不主张成员构成**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与三个数据页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航与链接逐字实测的 Market Data 六页与政策议题结构**，**但未打开任何数据页内容、未打开成员页、未打开任何政策议题正文或报告**，因此**不能转述任何市场数据、市占率、州级数值、信用风险转移规模、成员名单或政策主张**；**② ⭐ 「由六页构成的市场数据栏目」**为导航实测**，**但六页的内容形式（图表/PDF/可下载数据）与实际更新频率本次未核实**；**③ 「2024 Homeownership Market Survey」这一页面名指向 2024 年调查**，**本次未打开确认其发布年份与是否已有更新版本**；**④ 「香港以公共机构主导、美国以私人保险人加政府相关机构为结构」这一对照属**阅读提示**，**本次未打开任何一页说明美国按揭保险的制度结构或政府相关机构的角色**——**词条内已标注为对照性阅读建议，不是制度事实主张**；**⑤ 「私人 MI」的全称与法律定义本次未核实**（**词条内保留英文缩写 MI 并给出中文对译**）；**⑥ 该组织的成立年份、会员数量与法定地位本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** USMI 提供精算工具、定价模型或可下载数据集**。**核实说明**：`/data/pmi-by-the-numbers/`（49.7KB）、`/data/mi-by-state/`（91.9KB）、`/data/credit-risk-transfer/`（51.5KB）与首页（48.9KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开任何数据内容、成员页、政策议题正文或报告**。
entries.body_en:
**USMI (U.S. Mortgage Insurers)** is **the industry body for US private mortgage insurance (private MI)** (measured site title **"U.S. Mortgage Insurers | USMI"**). This entry adds the **"market data layer of mortgage insurance"** — ⭐ **and the scope must be stated**: **the corpus has two mortgage-adjacent entries** ([[hkmc]], the Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation, whose entry covers public annuities, reverse mortgages and mortgage insurance statistics, and [[qbe]], a company entry), **but industry market data on mortgage insurance measured zero**; **under the form-repetition discipline, USMI supplies precisely what that form lacked: a market data section of six pages**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"PMI by the Numbers" page measures 49.7KB**; ⭐ the **"State Mortgage Insurance" page measures 91.9KB** (**the largest of this entry’s three pages**); ⭐ the **"Mortgage Insurance Credit Risk Transfer" page measures 51.5KB**; the **homepage is 48.9KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: under **Private MI** — **What is MI?**, **Benefits** and **MI Options**; ⭐ under **Market Data** — six pages: **PMI by the Numbers**, **MI by State**, **Strength and Resiliency Report**, **Credit Risk Transfer**, **2024 Homeownership Market Survey** and **Other Reports**; under **Policy Priorities** — **Advocacy**, ⭐ **Tax Deductibility**, ⭐ **Taxpayer Protection**, **Access & Affordability**, **Housing Finance Reform** and ⭐ **Appraisal Modernization**; **News & Resources**; under **About** — **Mission**, ⭐ **Our Members** and **Our Team**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the market data layer of mortgage insurance** — **[[hkmc]] is the operator of Hong Kong’s mortgage insurance and its statistics (public annuities, reverse mortgages, mortgage insurance)**, **whereas USMI supplies cross-industry market data for US private mortgage insurance**; **reading both shows one line under two jurisdictional arrangements**: **Hong Kong led by a public institution (HKMC) versus the US structured around private insurers plus government-related entities** (**note: no data page was opened, so no size, share or structural detail is restated**). **② ⭐⭐ "Credit Risk Transfer" is the round’s most analytically valuable page** — **it links mortgage insurance to capital markets**: **insurers transferring part of the credit risk to investors**; **this is the same logic as catastrophe risk securitisation in [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[artemis]] and [[perils-ied]], applied to a different risk** — **catastrophe risk securitisation versus mortgage credit risk transfer**; **a previously missing comparative sample for students of risk transfer and capital markets** (readable with the capital measurement in [[insurance-scr-data]] and the spread risk in [[sii-spread-risk-scr]]). **③ ⭐ "MI by State" splits one line across US states** — **a ready state-level data entry point for regional variation work** (**not opened, so no state figure is restated**). **④ ⭐ The policy topics "tax deductibility" and "taxpayer protection" deserve note** — **the former ties mortgage insurance premiums to the tax system (affecting demand for the product)**, **the latter makes "private capital bears the risk, avoiding taxpayer bailouts" a policy position**; **together they show mortgage insurance in the US is a line with deep public-policy involvement** (**readable with the backstop mechanisms of [[pbgc]], [[assuris]] and [[nolhga]] — those ask who pays after a failure; USMI’s topics ask how to avoid drawing on taxpayers**). **⑤ "Appraisal Modernization" is an uncommon but real policy issue** — **changes in property valuation methods directly affect mortgage insurance risk measurement** (**not opened**). **⑥ The "Our Members" page indicates a defined member roster** (**not opened, so no membership claim**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and three data pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the six-page Market Data section and policy topics read verbatim from navigation and links**, **but opened no data page content, no members page, no policy topic body and no report**, so **no market figure, market share, state figure, credit risk transfer volume, member roster or policy position can be restated**; **② ⭐ "a market data section of six pages" is measured from navigation**, **but the format of those six pages (charts, PDFs or downloadable data) and their actual update frequency were not verified**; **③ the page name "2024 Homeownership Market Survey" points to a 2024 survey**, **and whether it has been superseded was not verified**; **④ the contrast "Hong Kong led by a public institution versus the US structured around private insurers plus government-related entities" is a reading prompt**, **and no page describing the US institutional structure or the role of government-related entities was opened** — **flagged in the entry as a comparative reading suggestion, not a claim of institutional fact**; **⑤ the full legal definition of "private MI" was not verified** (**the entry keeps the English abbreviation with a Chinese gloss**); **⑥ the body’s founding year, member count and legal status were not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim USMI provides actuarial tools, pricing models or downloadable datasets**. **Verification note**: `/data/pmi-by-the-numbers/` (49.7KB), `/data/mi-by-state/` (91.9KB), `/data/credit-risk-transfer/` (51.5KB) and the homepage (48.9KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no data content, members page, policy topic body or report was opened**.
entries.body_hk:
**USMI（U.S. Mortgage Insurers，美國按揭保險人）** 是**美國按揭保險（私人 MI）行業的組織**（站點標題實測 **「U.S. Mortgage Insurers | USMI」**）。本條目補的是**「按揭保險的市場數據層」**——⭐ **口徑必須寫明**：**實測池內按揭相關條目有 2 條**（[[hkmc]] 與 [[qbe]]），**但「按揭保險的行業市場數據」此前為 0**；**按形態重複紀律，USMI 補的正是該形態沒有的東西：一個由六頁構成的市場數據欄目。**

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **「PMI by the Numbers」頁 49.7KB**；⭐ **「State Mortgage Insurance」頁 91.9KB**（**本條目三頁中最大**）；⭐ **「Mortgage Insurance Credit Risk Transfer」頁 51.5KB**；首頁 **48.9KB**。**導航與連結逐字實測**：⭐ **Market Data** 下含六頁：**PMI by the Numbers／MI by State／Strength and Resiliency Report／Credit Risk Transfer／2024 Homeownership Market Survey／Other Reports**；**Policy Priorities** 下含 ⭐**Tax Deductibility／⭐Taxpayer Protection／Access & Affordability／Housing Finance Reform／⭐Appraisal Modernization**；**Private MI** 下含 **What is MI?／Benefits／MI Options**；**About** 含 **Mission／⭐Our Members／Our Team**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「按揭保險」的市場數據層**——**池內 [[hkmc]] 是香港按揭保險的運營方與其統計，而 USMI 給的是**美國私人按揭保險行業**的橫向市場數據**；**兩者並讀可見「同一險種在兩個轄區的兩種制度」**（**未打開任何數據頁，故不轉述規模、市佔或制度細節**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「信用風險轉移」是本輪最有分析價值的一頁**——**它把按揭保險與**資本市場**連接起來**；**這與池內巨災側的風險證券化（[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[artemis]]、[[perils-ied]]）是**同一邏輯在不同風險上的應用****（可與 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[sii-spread-risk-scr]] 並讀）。**③ ⭐ 「州級按揭保險」把同一險種按**美國各州**拆開**（**未打開，故不轉述任何州級數值**）。**④ ⭐ 政策議題中的「稅負可扣除」與「納稅人保護」值得注意**——**前者把按揭保險費與稅制掛鉤（影響產品需求）**，**後者把「私人資本承擔風險、避免納稅人兜底」作為政策主張**（可與 [[pbgc]]、[[assuris]]、[[nolhga]] 的「兜底機制」並讀——**那三條是「出事後誰兜底」，USMI 的議題是「如何避免動用納稅人兜底」**）。**⑤ 「評估現代化」是不常見但真實的政策議題**。**⑥ 「Our Members」頁說明該組織有明確成員名單**（**未打開**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與三個數據頁的存在、標題、體量、導航與連結逐字實測的 Market Data 六頁與政策議題結構**，**但未打開任何數據頁內容、成員頁、政策議題正文或報告**，故**不能轉述任何市場數據、市佔率、州級數值、信用風險轉移規模、成員名單或政策主張**；**② ⭐ 「由六頁構成的市場數據欄目」為導航實測**，**但六頁的內容形式（圖表／PDF／可下載數據）與實際更新頻率未核實**；**③ 「2024 Homeownership Market Survey」指向 2024 年調查，是否已有更新版本未核實**；**④ 「香港以公共機構主導、美國以私人保險人加政府相關機構為結構」屬**閱讀提示****，**未打開任何一頁說明美國按揭保險的制度結構**——**詞條內已標註為對照性閱讀建議，不是制度事實主張**；**⑤ 「私人 MI」的全稱與法律定義未核實**；**⑥ 成立年份、會員數量與法定地位未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** USMI 提供精算工具、定價模型或可下載數據集**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開任何數據內容、成員頁、政策議題正文或報告**。
