entries.body:
**THIA（Travel Health Insurance Association of Canada，加拿大旅游健康保险协会）** 是**加拿大旅游健康保险（旅游医疗保险）行业的协会**（站点标题实测 **「Home - Travel Health Insurance Association」**，**页面正文实测其全称为「Travel Health Insurance Association of Canada」**）。本条目补的是**「旅游险」这一整条业务线**——**实测池内 `travel insurance` / `旅游险` 相关条目为 0**。⭐ **口径须写明**：**该协会聚焦的是**旅游健康（医疗）保险**，属旅游险中的一个子险种**，**不是覆盖全部旅游险（如行程取消、行李损失）的协会**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**站点首页 19.9KB**；⭐ **「Travel Insurance Bill of Rights and Responsibilities（旅游保险权利与责任法案）」页实测 15.7KB，标题「Travel Insurance Bill of Rights and Responsibilities - Travel Health Insurance Association」**；⭐ **「Find an Insurer（查找保险人）」页实测 63.2KB，标题「Find an Insurer - Travel Health Insurance Association」**；⭐ **「Canadian Regulators and Insurance Organizations（加拿大监管者与保险组织）」页实测 16.0KB，标题逐字为「Canadian Regulators and Insurance Organizations」**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：**Consumers** 下含 **Consumer Resources**、⭐ **Find an Insurer**、**Travel Insurance FAQ**、**THIA videos**、⭐ **Travel Insurance Bill of Rights and Responsibilities**；**Industry** 下含 **Join/Renew**、⭐ **Industry News**、⭐ **public member directory（公开会员名录，industry 版）**、**Career Opportunities**；**About**、**Join/Renew**、**Events**、**What’s New**；⭐ **`thia-regulators.htm`（加拿大监管者与保险组织）**；另有 **TRIP** 相关页面、**Dream On** 消费者页面与 ⭐ **法语版 `/index_Fr.html`**；⭐ **行业新闻提供 RSS 订阅**（实测两条 RSS 源）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「旅游险」这一整条业务线（以旅游健康险为切口）**——**旅游险是典型的**短期限、跨境、低客单价、高争议率**险种**，**而池内此前完全没有该险种的行业入口**；**对做短期健康险或跨境保障的学生，这是一个可用的行业侧起点**（**注意：本次未打开任何内容，故不转述产品、费率或市场数据**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「旅游保险权利与责任法案（Bill of Rights and Responsibilities）」是本轮最值得注意的一处**——**由行业协会自行发布一份面向消费者的「权利与责任」清单**，**这在保险消费者保护的文件形态中少见**：**常见的两类是**监管者制定的规则**（如池内 [[eiopa-registers]]、[[mpfa-intermediaries]]）与**企业自定的服务承诺**，**而这是行业协会制定的中间形态**；**对研究消费者保护工具的学生，「谁写的、约束谁、怎么执行」是可直接展开的问题**（**注意：本次未打开该文件正文，故不转述其条款、约束力或执行机制**）。**③ ⭐ ⭐ 「加拿大监管者与保险组织」页是一个现成的**辖区监管地图**——**对跨境销售或比较加拿大旅游保险监管的学生，这是一个把联邦与省级监管者及行业组织列在一起的入口**（**本次未打开内容，故不转述其收录范围**）。**④ 「Find an Insurer（查找保险人）」是面向消费者的**会员名录**——**与池内 [[kbra]] 的保险发行人库、[[iais]] 的成员名录同属「公开名录」，但这条是**面向消费者选保**的**（**本次未打开，故不主张其成员数量**）。**⑤ 「行业新闻提供 RSS」是一个实用细节**——**对做行业动态跟踪的学生，RSS 比逐页浏览更可自动**（**本次未验证 RSS 内容**）。**⑥ 「法语版」说明该站点为加拿大双语辖区服务**（**本次仅核实法语版路径存在，未核实两语版本内容是否一致**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与三个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航与链接逐字实测的消费者、行业与监管者栏目、法语版路径与 RSS 源**，**但未打开《权利与责任法案》正文、未打开「查找保险人」名录、未打开「加拿大监管者与保险组织」名录、未打开行业新闻、会员名录、FAQ 或任何视频**，因此**不能转述任何条款、成员名单、监管者清单、行业新闻内容或产品信息**；**② ⭐ 「旅游健康保险是旅游险的一个子险种」这一界定依据机构名称（Travel **Health** Insurance Association of Canada）与页面正文自述**，**本次未打开任何一页给出其覆盖范围的定义**——**故本词条明确只主张覆盖旅游健康险这一子线，不主张覆盖全部旅游险**；**③ ⭐ 该站点为较早期的 CGI 建站**（**实测大量路径形如 `/cgi/page.cgi/…`**），**页面体量普遍偏小（15.7–63.2KB）**；**这属于可访问但**技术形态较旧**，已如实说明**；**④ 《权利与责任法案》的**制定主体、法律效力与执行机制**本次均未核实**——**词条内只描述「由行业协会发布」这一事实（依据页面标题与所属站点），不主张其约束力**；**⑤ 该协会的成立年份、会员数量与法定地位本次未核实**；**⑥ RSS 源的更新频率与内容本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** THIA 提供精算工具、定价模型或可下载数据集**。**核实说明**：`/Travel_Insurance_Bill_of_Rights_and_Responsibilities.html`（15.7KB）、`/cgi/page.cgi/find_an_insurer.html`（63.2KB）、`/thia-regulators.htm`（16.0KB）与首页（19.9KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开《权利与责任法案》正文、查找保险人名录、监管者名录、行业新闻、会员名录、FAQ 或视频**。
entries.body_en:
**THIA (the Travel Health Insurance Association of Canada)** is **Canada’s travel health insurance association** (measured site title **"Home - Travel Health Insurance Association"**, with the page body measurably giving the full name as **"Travel Health Insurance Association of Canada"**). This entry adds an entire missing line of business — **measured: `travel insurance` returned zero**. ⭐ **And the scope must be stated**: **the association focuses on travel **health** (medical) insurance, a sub-line of travel insurance**, **rather than covering all travel insurance such as trip cancellation or baggage loss**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the **homepage is 19.9KB**; ⭐ the **"Travel Insurance Bill of Rights and Responsibilities" page measures 15.7KB**; ⭐ the **"Find an Insurer" page measures 63.2KB**; ⭐ the **"Canadian Regulators and Insurance Organizations" page measures 16.0KB** with that measured title. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: under **Consumers** — **Consumer Resources**, ⭐ **Find an Insurer**, **Travel Insurance FAQ**, **THIA videos** and ⭐ **Travel Insurance Bill of Rights and Responsibilities**; under **Industry** — **Join/Renew**, ⭐ **Industry News**, ⭐ a **public member directory (industry version)** and **Career Opportunities**; plus **About**, **Events**, **What’s New**, ⭐ **`thia-regulators.htm`**, a **TRIP**-related page, a **Dream On** consumer page, ⭐ a **French version `/index_Fr.html`** and ⭐ **two RSS feeds** for industry news.

For RIAA: **① it adds the travel insurance line, entering through travel health** — **travel insurance is typically short-term, cross-border, low-premium and dispute-prone**, **and the corpus had no industry entry point for it at all**; **a usable industry-side starting point for students working on short-term health or cross-border cover** (**note: no content was opened, so no product, rate or market figure is restated**). **② ⭐⭐ The Travel Insurance Bill of Rights and Responsibilities is the round’s most notable item** — **a trade association publishing a consumer-facing bill of rights and responsibilities**; **this is an uncommon document form in insurance consumer protection**: **the usual two are rules made by regulators (such as [[eiopa-registers]] and [[mpfa-intermediaries]]) and service promises made by individual firms**, **whereas this is an intermediate form made by the industry association**; **for students studying consumer-protection instruments, "who wrote it, whom it binds, and how it is enforced" is a directly openable question** (**note: the document body was not opened, so its clauses, binding force and enforcement are not restated**). **③ ⭐⭐ The "Canadian regulators and insurance organizations" page is a ready jurisdictional regulatory map** — **a single entry point listing federal and provincial regulators and industry organisations for students working on cross-border sales or comparing Canadian travel insurance supervision** (**not opened, so its coverage is not restated**). **④ "Find an Insurer" is a consumer-facing member directory** — **like the issuer database of [[kbra]] or the member list of [[iais]], but aimed at consumers choosing cover** (**not opened, so no member count is claimed**). **⑤ That industry news offers RSS is a practical detail** — **for tracking industry developments, RSS is more automatable than browsing pages** (**the RSS content was not verified**). **⑥ A French version indicates service to a bilingual jurisdiction** (**only the path’s existence was verified, not whether the two versions are consistent**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and three pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the consumer, industry and regulator sections, the French path and the RSS feeds read verbatim from navigation and links**, **but opened no bill-of-rights body, no find-an-insurer directory, no regulators listing, no industry news, no member directory, no FAQ and no video**, so **no clause, member roster, regulator list, news content or product information can be restated**; **② ⭐ "travel health insurance is a sub-line of travel insurance" rests on the organisation’s name and its own page text**, **and no page defining its coverage was opened** — **so the entry explicitly claims only the travel health sub-line, not all travel insurance**; **③ ⭐ The site is an earlier-generation CGI build** (**many measured paths take the form `/cgi/page.cgi/…`**) **with generally small pages (15.7–63.2KB)**; **reachable but technically dated, stated as such**; **④ The bill of rights’ authorship, legal effect and enforcement were all unverified** — **the entry describes only the fact that an industry association published it (from the page title and its site), claiming no binding force**; **⑤ the association’s founding year, member count and legal status were not verified**; **⑥ the RSS feeds’ update frequency and content were not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim THIA provides actuarial tools, pricing models or downloadable datasets**. **Verification note**: `/Travel_Insurance_Bill_of_Rights_and_Responsibilities.html` (15.7KB), `/cgi/page.cgi/find_an_insurer.html` (63.2KB), `/thia-regulators.htm` (16.0KB) and the homepage (19.9KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no bill-of-rights body, find-an-insurer directory, regulators listing, industry news, member directory, FAQ or video was opened**.

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **19.9KB**；⭐ **《旅遊保險權利與責任法案》頁 15.7KB**；⭐ **「Find an Insurer」頁 63.2KB**；⭐ **「Canadian Regulators and Insurance Organizations」頁 16.0KB**。**導航與連結逐字實測**：**Consumers** 下含 **Consumer Resources／⭐Find an Insurer／Travel Insurance FAQ／THIA videos／⭐Travel Insurance Bill of Rights and Responsibilities**；**Industry** 下含 **Join-Renew／⭐Industry News／⭐公開會員名錄（industry 版）／Career Opportunities**；另有 ⭐ **`thia-regulators.htm`**、**TRIP** 相關頁、**Dream On** 消費者頁、⭐ **法語版 `/index_Fr.html`**，以及 ⭐ **兩條行業新聞 RSS 源**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「旅遊險」這一整條業務線（以旅遊健康險為切口）**——**旅遊險是典型的**短期、跨境、低客單價、高爭議率**險種**，**而池內此前完全沒有該險種的行業入口**（**未打開任何內容，故不轉述產品、費率或市場數據**）。**② ⭐⭐ 《旅遊保險權利與責任法案》是本輪最值得注意的一處**——**由行業協會自行發布一份面向消費者的「權利與責任」清單**；**常見的兩類是**監管者制定的規則**（如 [[eiopa-registers]]、[[mpfa-intermediaries]]）與**企業自定的服務承諾**，**而這是行業協會制定的中間形態**（**未打開正文，故不轉述條款、約束力或執行機制**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「加拿大監管者與保險組織」頁是現成的**轄區監管地圖****（**未打開，故不轉述收錄範圍**）。**④ 「Find an Insurer」是面向消費者的**會員名錄****（**未打開，故不主張成員數量**）。**⑤ 「行業新聞提供 RSS」是實用細節**（**未驗證 RSS 內容**）。**⑥ 「法語版」說明該站點為加拿大雙語轄區服務**（**僅核實路徑存在**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與三個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航與連結逐字實測的欄目、法語版路徑與 RSS 源**，**但未打開《權利與責任法案》正文、查找保險人名錄、監管者名錄、行業新聞、會員名錄、FAQ 或任何視頻**，故**不能轉述任何條款、成員名單、監管者清單、行業新聞內容或產品資訊**；**② ⭐ 「旅遊健康保險是旅遊險的子險種」依據機構名稱與頁面正文自述**，**未打開任何一頁給出其覆蓋範圍的定義**——**故本詞條明確只主張覆蓋旅遊健康險這一子線**；**③ ⭐ 該站點為較早期的 CGI 建站**（**實測大量路徑形如 `/cgi/page.cgi/…`**），**頁面體量普遍偏小（15.7–63.2KB）**——**屬可訪問但技術形態較舊，已如實說明**；**④ 《權利與責任法案》的制定主體、法律效力與執行機制均未核實**——**詞條內只描述「由行業協會發布」這一事實，不主張其約束力**；**⑤ 成立年份、會員數量與法定地位未核實**；**⑥ RSS 源的更新頻率與內容未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** THIA 提供精算工具、定價模型或可下載數據集**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開《權利與責任法案》正文、查找保險人名錄、監管者名錄、行業新聞、會員名錄、FAQ 或視頻**。

entries.body:
**SIIA（Self-Insurance Institute of America，美国自保协会）** 是**美国自保（self-insurance）市场的行业协会**（站点标题实测 **「Home | Self-Insurance Institute of America, Inc.」**）。本条目补的是**「自保与第三方管理人（TPA）」这一整块形态**——**实测池内 `third-party administrator` 为 0、`self-insurance` 为 0**（**池内 `tpa` 的 4 条命中经复核全为假阳性：`tpa-transparency-data` 是美国医疗价格透明数据，与 TPA 无关**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**站点首页 59.9KB**，正文逐字实测 **「THIS is where the business of self-insurance gets done」** 与 **「As the largest and most-respected association in the self-insurance marketplace, the Self-Insurance Institute of America (SIIA) brings together industry experts, thought leaders, innovative solution providers and the next generation of leaders to ensure that self-insurance remains a sustainable alternative for employers」**；⭐⭐ **并逐字实测其服务范围（含 TPA）**：**「Since 1981, SIIA has been committed to providing self-insured payers, captives, TPA’s and the partners that support them with advocacy on Capitol Hill, timely education on industry tre[nds]」**——**即该协会明确服务「自保付款方、专属保险公司、第三方管理人（TPA）及其支持伙伴」**；⭐ **「About SIIA」页实测 35.8KB**；⭐ **「About Self-Insurance」页实测 36.2KB，标题「About Self-Insurance | Self-Insurance Institute of America, Inc.」**；⭐ **「Captive Insurance」页实测 35.5KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**（⭐ **该站点的 URL 为不透明参数形式 `/i4a/pages/index.cfm?pageid=NNNN`，本词条所述页面均系由锚文本映射后逐一实测标题确认**）：**About** 下含 **About Self-Insurance**、⭐ **Stop-Loss Excess Insurance（止损超额保险）**、**Captive Insurance**、⭐ **Understanding Captive Insurance**、⭐ **Onshore Captive Domicile Information（在岸专属保险辖区信息）**、⭐ **Offshore Captive Domicile Information（离岸专属保险辖区信息）**、⭐ **Self-Insured Group Health Plans（自保团体健康计划）**、⭐ **Glossary of Self-Insurance Terms（自保术语表）**、⭐ **Captive Resource Center**；**Advocacy** 下含 **Advocacy in Action Resource Center** 与 **Self-Insurance Political Action Committee**；⭐ **Self-Insurance Marketplace Directory（自保市场名录）** 实测 80.3KB；**The Self-Insurer Magazine（会刊）**；**会员分档实测**为 **Diamond Members / 2026 Gold Members / 2026 Silver Members / Members Only / Welcome New Members**；另有 **2026 Event Schedule** 与 **Career Hub**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「自保」与「第三方管理人（TPA）」这两个此前完全空白的形态**——**自保（企业自行承担风险、以止损超额保险兜底）是商业保险之外的一条主要风险融资路径**，**而 TPA 是替企业或保险公司承担理赔与行政职能的第三方**；**两者此前在池内都没有入口**（**可与池内 [[mib]]（英国车险的行业级理赔机制）、[[clm]]（理赔专业组织）、[[cila]]（公估师）并读——**那三条都在「理赔由谁做」这一层，但都不涉及「企业自保」这一风险融资安排**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「同时收录在岸与离岸专属保险辖区信息」是本轮最重要的结构发现之一**——**SIIA 把 Onshore 与 Offshore 两类辖区并列收录**，**即协会在辖区选择上保持**信息中性****；**这与同轮 [[cica]] 自称「住所中立（Domicile-Neutral）」、以及同轮两个辖区（[[bma]] 离岸、[[vermont-captive]] 在岸）各自主动招揽形成完整对照**（**本次未打开任何辖区页面，故不转述其具体内容或推荐立场**）。**③ ⭐ 「止损超额保险（Stop-Loss Excess Insurance）」是自保安排的关键配套险种**——**企业自保后需以止损保单封顶自身风险**，**这解释了「自保不是不买保险，而是换一种买法」**；**对做企业风险融资的学生，这是一个清晰的产品—制度配套样本**（**本次未打开该页，故不转述其承保方式或触发机制**）。**④ 「自保术语表」与「自保市场名录」是两份实用资产**——**前者是术语入口、后者是服务提供者入口**（**本次均未打开，故不主张名录的规模或构成**）。**⑤ URL 形态值得记一笔**：**该站点大量页面使用 `pageid=NNNN` 这类不透明参数**——**对做网络资源编目的学生，这提示「同一站点的页面无法从 URL 推断内容，必须靠锚文本或站内检索」**（**本词条正是这样做的**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、两处关键正文逐字表述、以及导航与链接逐字实测的完整板块结构**，**但未打开任何内容页正文、未打开在岸/离岸辖区页、术语表、市场名录、Captive Resource Center、会刊或倡导资源中心**，因此**不能转述任何自保机制细节、TPA 的职能与监管安排、辖区信息内容、名录成员或术语定义**；**② ⭐ 「服务 TPA」为**首页正文逐字实测**（**引文在实测处以「industry tre…」截断，词条内只引用到该处为止**）；**但该协会对 TPA 的具体服务形式、会员中 TPA 的占比本次未核实**；**③ 「TPA」与「第三方管理人」的中文译法**（亦见「第三方管理机构」）**本次未核实其通行度**，**词条内保留英文缩写并给出中文对译**；**④ 「1981 年至今」与「largest and most-respected」均为**站点自述**，**已在词条内如此标注，不作独立核实或评价**；**⑤ 该协会的会员规模、法定地位与资金来源本次未核实**；**⑥ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** SIIA 提供精算工具、定价模型或可下载数据**。**核实说明**：首页（59.9KB）、`/about/`（35.8KB）、`pageid=7439`（36.2KB）、`pageid=7022`（35.5KB）、`pageid=7024`（40.7KB）、`pageid=8121`（80.3KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与正文；**未打开任何内容页正文**。
entries.body_en:
**SIIA (the Self-Insurance Institute of America)** is **the trade association for the US self-insurance market** (measured site title **"Home | Self-Insurance Institute of America, Inc."**). This entry adds the entire **"self-insurance and third-party administrators (TPAs)"** form — **measured: `third-party administrator` returned zero and `self-insurance` returned zero** (**the four `tpa` hits in the corpus were reviewed and are all false positives: `tpa-transparency-data` is US healthcare price-transparency data, unrelated to TPAs**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the **homepage is 59.9KB**, its body stating verbatim **"THIS is where the business of self-insurance gets done"** and **"As the largest and most-respected association in the self-insurance marketplace, the Self-Insurance Institute of America (SIIA) brings together industry experts, thought leaders, innovative solution providers and the next generation of leaders to ensure that self-insurance remains a sustainable alternative for employers"**; ⭐⭐ **and stating its service scope verbatim, including TPAs**: **"Since 1981, SIIA has been committed to providing self-insured payers, captives, TPA’s and the partners that support them with advocacy on Capitol Hill, timely education on industry tre[nds]"** — **i.e. the association explicitly serves self-insured payers, captives, third-party administrators and their supporting partners**; ⭐ the **"About SIIA" page measures 35.8KB**; ⭐ the **"About Self-Insurance" page measures 36.2KB**; ⭐ the **"Captive Insurance" page measures 35.5KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links** (⭐ **the site uses opaque parameter URLs of the form `/i4a/pages/index.cfm?pageid=NNNN`; every page described here was mapped from anchor text and then verified by measuring its title**): under **About** — **About Self-Insurance**, ⭐ **Stop-Loss Excess Insurance**, **Captive Insurance**, ⭐ **Understanding Captive Insurance**, ⭐ **Onshore Captive Domicile Information**, ⭐ **Offshore Captive Domicile Information**, ⭐ **Self-Insured Group Health Plans**, ⭐ **Glossary of Self-Insurance Terms** and ⭐ **Captive Resource Center**; under **Advocacy** — an **Advocacy in Action Resource Center** and a **Self-Insurance Political Action Committee**; ⭐ a **Self-Insurance Marketplace Directory** measuring 80.3KB; **The Self-Insurer Magazine**; **measured membership tiers** — **Diamond Members, 2026 Gold Members, 2026 Silver Members, Members Only and Welcome New Members**; plus a **2026 Event Schedule** and a **Career Hub**.

For RIAA: **① it adds "self-insurance" and "third-party administrators (TPAs)", both entirely absent** — **self-insurance (a company retaining risk and capping it with stop-loss cover) is a major alternative risk-financing route alongside commercial insurance**, **and a TPA is a third party performing claims and administrative functions for employers or insurers**; **neither had an entry point before** (**readable with [[mib]] (the UK motor industry claims mechanism), [[clm]] (a claims professional body) and [[cila]] (loss adjusters) — those three all sit in the "who does claims" layer but none touches corporate self-insurance as a risk-financing arrangement**). **② ⭐⭐ Carrying both onshore and offshore captive domicile information is one of the round’s most important structural findings** — **SIIA lists onshore and offshore domiciles side by side**, **i.e. the association keeps an information-neutral stance on domicile choice**; **this forms a complete contrast with [[cica]]’s self-description as "domicile-neutral" and with the two domiciles in the same round actively soliciting business ([[bma]] offshore, [[vermont-captive]] onshore)** (**no domicile page was opened, so neither its content nor any recommendation is restated**). **③ ⭐ Stop-loss excess insurance is the key companion cover to a self-insurance arrangement** — **a company that retains risk must cap its exposure with a stop-loss policy**, **which explains that "self-insurance is not buying less insurance but buying it differently"**; **a clear product-institution pairing for students of corporate risk financing** (**not opened, so no underwriting method or trigger is restated**). **④ The glossary of self-insurance terms and the marketplace directory are two practical assets** — **a terminology entry point and a service-provider entry point** (**neither opened, so no scale or composition is claimed**). **⑤ The URL pattern is worth noting**: **many pages use opaque `pageid=NNNN` parameters** — **for students cataloguing web resources, this shows a site whose page content cannot be inferred from the URL and must be found via anchor text or site search** (**which is exactly what this entry did**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, two key verbatim body statements, and the complete section structure read verbatim from navigation and links**, **but opened no content page body, no onshore or offshore domicile page, no glossary, no marketplace directory, no Captive Resource Center, no magazine and no advocacy resource centre**, so **no self-insurance mechanics, TPA function or regulatory arrangement, domicile content, directory member or term definition can be restated**; **② ⭐ "serves TPAs" is read verbatim from the homepage** (**the quotation truncates at "industry tre…" and the entry quotes no further**); **but how the association services TPAs, and what share of members are TPAs, were not verified**; **③ the Chinese rendering of "TPA"** (also seen as 第三方管理机构) **was not verified for currency**, **and the entry keeps the English abbreviation with a Chinese gloss**; **④ "since 1981" and "largest and most-respected" are the site’s own statements**, **labelled as such in the entry with no independent verification or evaluation**; **⑤ the association’s membership size, legal status and funding were not verified**; **⑥ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim SIIA provides actuarial tools, pricing models or downloadable data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (59.9KB), `/about/` (35.8KB), `pageid=7439` (36.2KB), `pageid=7022` (35.5KB), `pageid=7024` (40.7KB) and `pageid=8121` (80.3KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and body read verbatim; **no content page body was opened**.

**CICA（Captive Insurance Companies Association，专属保险公司协会）** 是**专属保险（captive insurance）行业的协会**（站点标题实测为 **「CICA | Domicile-Neutral Captive Insurance Association」**）。⭐ **本条目最值得注意的一点就在标题里：该协会自称「Domicile-Neutral（住所中立）」**——**即它刻意不偏向任何一个专属保险注册辖区**。本条目与同轮 [[siia]]（同时收录在岸与离岸辖区信息）、[[bma]]（离岸辖区监管者）、[[vermont-captive]]（在岸辖区州政府）**共同构成一组关于「辖区立场」的完整对照**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**站点首页 164.8KB（168,768 字节），标题「CICA | Domicile-Neutral Captive Insurance Association」**；⭐ **「About CICA」页 `/about-cica/` 实测 110.3KB，标题「About CICA | Growing & Supporting the Captive Industry」**；⭐ **「CICA 2025 Year in Review」页 `/cica-2025-year-in-review/` 实测 105.3KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：**Join**、**About**、**Contact**、**CICA News**；⭐ **Attend & Learn** 下含 **Attend CICA International Conference（CICA 国际会议）**、**Industry Event Calendar（行业活动日历）**、**Learn**；⭐ **Advocacy（倡导）**；⭐ **Professional Development（专业发展）**；**Membership**；⭐ **Awards（奖项）**；**Volunteer Opportunities**；**Connect & Engage**。⭐ **名录实测（重要限制）**：**成员名录 `members.cicaworld.com/memberdirectory` 实测 85.5KB、服务提供者名录 `members.cicaworld.com/serviceproviderdirectory` 实测 85.6KB，两者的页面标题实测均为「Sign In」——即需登录后才可见**。⭐ **一则当期动态实测**：站点含 2026 年会议相关文章（路径实测含 `dan-towle-highlights-advocacy-and-talent-development-at-cica-2026-conference`）。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「住所中立（domicile-neutral）」这一自我定位是本轮最有分析价值的发现**——**专属保险的注册地选择（在岸如佛蒙特、离岸如百慕大）本身是一个受监管竞争驱动的市场**，**而一个行业协会公开宣称自己不偏向任何辖区，等于在「辖区竞争」中主动采取中立位置**；**对做监管竞争、辖区选择或离岸金融的学生，这是一个可直接引用的机构立场样本**（**可与同轮 [[siia]] 的「同时收录在岸与离岸」并读——**两者都是中立，但一个体现为立场声明，一个体现为信息并列****）。**② ⭐ 「倡导（Advocacy）」与「专业发展」并列为两个主要板块，说明该协会同时做**政策代表**与**人才培养****——**这与池内 [[clm]] 的「理赔学院 + 诉讼管理研究院」、[[cia-ica]] 的「强制职业操守模块」属同一层次：**行业组织把教育当作核心职能**（**本次未打开，故不转述其课程与倡导主张**）。**③ ⭐ 「Volunteer Opportunities」与「Awards」是两个少见的板块**——**行业协会设志愿者机会与奖项**，**对想参与行业组织或建立行业可见度的学生，这是一个实际入口**（**本次未打开**）。**④ ⭐ 「CICA 国际会议」与「行业活动日历」构成行业活动入口**（**可与池内 [[iais]] 的 2026 香港年会、[[cro-forum]] 的出版物档案并读——**三者都是行业高层聚会的组织者，但一个是监管者、一个是 CRO、一个是专属保险****）。**⑤ 名录需登录这一点对读者有直接影响**——**同轮 [[siia]] 的市场名录、池内 [[kbra]] 的保险发行人库均可公开访问，而 CICA 的两个名录不行**；**本词条因此明确不主张其可公开检索**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与两个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、导航与链接逐字实测的板块结构、两个名录页的**需登录**事实、以及一则 2026 年会议文章的路径**，**但未打开 About CICA 或年度回顾正文、未打开倡导、专业发展、奖项、志愿者或会议内容、未登录故未见到任何名录内容**，因此**不能转述任何会员或服务提供者名单、倡导立场、课程内容、奖项得主或会议安排**；**② ⭐ 「住所中立」为**站点标题逐字实测**（**「Domicile-Neutral Captive Insurance Association」**）——**本词条据此引用其自我定位；但该定位的含义、是否有成文政策、是否曾因辖区议题表态而受检验，本次均未核实**，**故词条内只主张「标题自称」，不主张其实际中立性**；**③ 两个名录页标题实测为「Sign In」**——**故不主张其可公开检索，也不主张名录规模**；**④ 「CICA 2025 Year in Review」为年度回顾页，其内容与发布形式未核实**；**⑤ 该协会的成立年份、会员规模、法定地位与所在地本次未核实**（**「国际会议」提示其国际化，但覆盖范围未核实**）；**⑥ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** CICA 提供精算工具、定价模型或可下载数据**。**核实说明**：首页（164.8KB）、`/about-cica/`（110.3KB）、`/cica-2025-year-in-review/`（105.3KB）、`members.cicaworld.com/memberdirectory`（85.5KB）、`members.cicaworld.com/serviceproviderdirectory`（85.6KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开任何内容正文，未登录，故未见到名录内容**。
entries.body_en:
**CICA (the Captive Insurance Companies Association)** is **a trade association for the captive insurance industry** (measured site title **"CICA | Domicile-Neutral Captive Insurance Association"**). ⭐ **Its most notable feature is in the title itself: the association describes itself as "Domicile-Neutral"** — **i.e. it deliberately favours no captive domicile**. Along with [[siia]] (which carries both onshore and offshore domicile information), [[bma]] (an offshore regulator) and [[vermont-captive]] (an onshore state government) in the same round, **this entry completes a set of contrasting stances on domicile**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the **homepage is 164.8KB (168,768 bytes) with the measured title "CICA | Domicile-Neutral Captive Insurance Association"**; ⭐ the **"About CICA" page measures 110.3KB with the measured title "About CICA | Growing & Supporting the Captive Industry"**; ⭐ the **"CICA 2025 Year in Review" page measures 105.3KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: **Join**, **About**, **Contact**, **CICA News**; ⭐ under **Attend & Learn** — **Attend CICA International Conference**, **Industry Event Calendar** and **Learn**; ⭐ **Advocacy**; ⭐ **Professional Development**; **Membership**; ⭐ **Awards**; **Volunteer Opportunities**; **Connect & Engage**. ⭐ **A measured limitation on the directories**: **the member directory measures 85.5KB and the service provider directory 85.6KB, and both measured titles are "Sign In" — they require a login**. ⭐ **One measured current item**: the site carries a 2026 conference article (path measurably containing `dan-towle-highlights-advocacy-and-talent-development-at-cica-2026-conference`).

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐ The "domicile-neutral" self-description is the round’s most analytically valuable finding** — **choosing where to register a captive (onshore such as Vermont, offshore such as Bermuda) is itself a market driven by regulatory competition**, **and a trade association publicly declaring it favours no domicile takes a deliberately neutral position within that competition**; **a directly citable sample of an institution’s stance for students of regulatory competition, domicile choice or offshore finance** (**readable with [[siia]]’s parallel listing of onshore and offshore — both neutral, one as a stated position, the other as parallel information**). **② ⭐ Advocacy and professional development as two main sections show the association does both policy representation and talent development** — **the same layer as [[clm]]’s Claims College and Litigation Management Institute or [[cia-ica]]’s mandatory professionalism module: industry bodies treating education as a core function** (**not opened, so no course or advocacy position is restated**). **③ ⭐ Volunteer opportunities and awards are two uncommon sections** — **a trade association offering volunteering and awards**, **a practical entry point for students wanting to participate in industry bodies or build visibility** (**not opened**). **④ ⭐ The CICA International Conference and the industry event calendar form an industry-events entry point** (**readable with the 2026 Hong Kong annual conference of [[iais]] and the publication archive of [[cro-forum]] — three organisers of senior industry gatherings: one supervisors, one CROs, one captives**). **⑤ The login requirement on the directories has a direct bearing on readers** — **[[siia]]’s marketplace directory and [[kbra]]’s insurer database are publicly accessible, while CICA’s two directories are not**; **the entry therefore explicitly does not claim they are publicly searchable**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and two pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the section structure read verbatim from navigation and links, the login requirement measured on both directory pages, and the path of one 2026 conference article**, **but opened no About CICA or year-in-review body, no advocacy, professional development, awards, volunteer or conference content, and logged in nowhere so no directory content was seen**, so **no member or service-provider roster, advocacy position, course content, award recipient or conference arrangement can be restated**; **② ⭐ "domicile-neutral" is read verbatim from the site title** (**"Domicile-Neutral Captive Insurance Association"**) — **the entry quotes the self-description, but what it means, whether there is a written policy, and whether it has been tested by any domicile controversy were all unverified**, **so the entry claims only the self-description and not actual neutrality**; **③ both directory pages measured "Sign In"** — **so this entry claims neither public searchability nor directory size**; **④ the content and publication form of the "CICA 2025 Year in Review" page were not verified**; **⑤ the association’s founding year, membership size, legal status and location were not verified** (**an "international conference" suggests an international reach, but its coverage was not verified**); **⑥ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim CICA provides actuarial tools, pricing models or downloadable data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (164.8KB), `/about-cica/` (110.3KB), `/cica-2025-year-in-review/` (105.3KB), `members.cicaworld.com/memberdirectory` (85.5KB) and `members.cicaworld.com/serviceproviderdirectory` (85.6KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no content body was opened, no login was performed and no directory content was seen**.

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **164.8KB**；⭐ **「About CICA」頁 110.3KB，標題「About CICA | Growing & Supporting the Captive Industry」**；⭐ **「CICA 2025 Year in Review」頁 105.3KB**。**導航與連結逐字實測**：⭐ **Attend & Learn** 下含 **CICA International Conference／Industry Event Calendar／Learn**；⭐ **Advocacy／Professional Development／Awards／Volunteer Opportunities**。⭐ **名錄實測（重要限制）**：**成員名錄 85.5KB、服務提供者名錄 85.6KB，兩者頁面標題實測均為「Sign In」——即需登入後才可見**。⭐ **一則當期動態實測**：站點含 2026 年會議相關文章（路徑含 `dan-towle-highlights-advocacy-and-talent-development-at-cica-2026-conference`）。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「住所中立」這一自我定位是本輪最有分析價值的發現**——**專屬保險的註冊地選擇本身是一個受監管競爭驅動的市場，而一個行業協會公開宣稱不偏向任何轄區，等於主動採取中立位置**（可與同輪 [[siia]] 的「同時收錄在岸與離岸」並讀——**兩者都是中立，但一個體現為立場聲明，一個體現為資訊並列**）。**② ⭐ 「倡導」與「專業發展」並列為兩個主要板塊**（與 [[clm]]、[[cia-ica]] 同屬「行業組織把教育當作核心職能」）。**③ ⭐ 「Volunteer Opportunities」與「Awards」是兩個少見板塊**（**未打開**）。**④ ⭐ 「CICA 國際會議」與「行業活動日曆」構成行業活動入口**（可與 [[iais]] 的 2026 香港年會、[[cro-forum]] 的出版物檔案並讀——**三者都是行業高層聚會的組織者，但一個是監管者、一個是 CRO、一個是專屬保險**）。**⑤ 名錄需登入這一點對讀者有直接影響**——**本詞條因此明確不主張其可公開檢索**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與兩個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的板塊結構、兩個名錄頁的需登入事實、以及一則 2026 年會議文章路徑**，**但未打開 About CICA 或年度回顧正文、未打開倡導／專業發展／獎項／志願者／會議內容、未登入故未見到任何名錄內容**，故**不能轉述任何名單、倡導立場、課程內容、獎項得主或會議安排**；**② ⭐ 「住所中立」為站點標題逐字實測**——**本詞條據此引用其自我定位；但該定位的含義、是否有成文政策、是否曾受檢驗，本次均未核實**，**故只主張「標題自稱」，不主張其實際中立性**；**③ 兩個名錄頁標題實測為「Sign In」**——**故不主張可公開檢索，也不主張名錄規模**；**④ 「CICA 2025 Year in Review」的內容與發布形式未核實**；**⑤ 成立年份、會員規模、法定地位與所在地未核實**（**「國際會議」提示國際化，但覆蓋範圍未核實**）；**⑥ 是否有中文材料未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** CICA 提供精算工具、定價模型或可下載數據**。**核實說明**：五個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開任何內容正文、未登入、未見到名錄內容**。

entries.body:
**BMA（Bermuda Monetary Authority，百慕大金融管理局）** 是**百慕大的金融监管机构**（站点标题实测 **「Regulatory, Monetary, and Financial Advisory Body of Bermuda - BMA」**）。本条目补的是**「离岸保险辖区的监管者」这一形态**——**同轮 [[siia]] 与 [[cica]] 是行业侧、[[vermont-captive]] 是在岸辖区政府，而 BMA 补的是**离岸辖区的监管者视角****。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**站点首页 145.7KB，标题「Regulatory, Monetary, and Financial Advisory Body of Bermuda - BMA」**；⭐⭐ **「Bermuda Insurance Innovation（保险沙盒与保险创新中心）」页 `/innovative-insurance-sandbox` 实测 144.0KB，标题「Bermuda Insurance Innovation | BMA Sandbox and Insurance Innovation Hub | InsurTech」**；⭐⭐ **「Corporate Service Provider Licensing in Bermuda（企业服务提供者发牌）」页 `/csp-licensing` 实测 130.9KB**；⭐ **「How to Set Up a Captive/Commercial Insurer（如何设立专属/商业保险公司）」页 `/insurance-licensing-how-to-set-up-an-insurance-company` 实测 131.1KB**；⭐ **「Insurance（保险文件中心）」页 `/documents-centre/statstics/documents-insurance` 实测 235.8KB**（**注意：该路径中「statstics」为站点自身的拼写，词条内照实引用**）。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：**保险侧** 含 **`/insurance-licensing-requirements`**、**`/insurance-licensing-how-to-set-up-an-insurance-company`**、**`/insurance-supervision-regulation`**、⭐ **`/insurance-group-supervision`（集团监管）**、⭐ **`/insurance-innovation`**、⭐ **`/innovative-insurance-sandbox`**；⭐ **企业服务提供者（CSP）侧单独设 `csp-licensing` 与 `csp-supervision-regulation`**；**其他受监管业务**实测含银行、投资业务、投资基金、信托、信用合作社、货币服务、数字资产等各自的发牌与监管栏目；⭐ **文件中心按类型分层实测**：**`documents-legislation`（立法）**、**`bulletins`（公告）**、**`discussion-consultation-papers`（讨论与征求意见稿）**、**`documents-policy-and-guidance`（政策与指引）**、**`documents-reporting-forms-and-guidelines`（报送表与指引）**、⭐ **`statstics`（统计）**、以及 **`publications/annual-reports`（年报）** 与 **`publications/business-plan`（业务计划）**；另有 **`/regulated-entities`**、**`/standards-regulations`** 与 **`/about-us`**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「离岸辖区的监管者如何主动招揽」是本轮的核心对照之一**——**BMA 不只做监管，还提供「如何设立专属/商业保险公司」的操作指引、**保险沙盒与创新中心**、以及**企业服务提供者发牌**；**这三件事合起来构成一个辖区的**供给侧制度组合****：**降低设立摩擦（指引）+ 允许试错（沙盒）+ 规范中介服务者（发牌）**；**与同轮 [[vermont-captive]] 的「Why Vermont（含事实与数据）+ 设立与运营（含费用）」形成**离岸 vs 在岸两种招揽方式**的对照**（**注意：本次未打开任何一页内容，故不转述其要求、流程或费用**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「保险沙盒」补上一个此前缺失的形态**——**池内「监管沙盒」实测仅 3 条，且全部是 AI 或黑客松性质**（[[hk-genai-sandbox-axa-manulife]]、[[ginsim]]、[[thinkingbox]]），**而 BMA 的沙盒是**保险产品与保险科技创新**的监管沙盒**；**对做保险创新与监管试验的学生，这是一个制度形态不同的样本**（**且其页面标题实测含「InsurTech」**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「企业服务提供者（CSP）单独发牌」与池内的 TPA 形态构成一组有价值的对照**——**同轮 [[siia]] 代表美国的 TPA（第三方管理人）**，**而 BMA 对 CSP（企业服务提供者，在专属保险语境下即管理人/服务公司）单独发牌并单独监管**；**即「保险业里的第三方服务者」在两个辖区被分别组织与监管**——**这是池内此前没有的一层**（**本次未打开 CSP 页面，故不转述发牌条件、资本要求或监管范围**）。**④ ⭐ 「集团监管（insurance group supervision）」栏目值得注意**——**专属保险常以集团形式组建**，**故集团层监管是其制度的一部分**（**本次未打开**）。**⑤ ⭐ 文件中心按**文件类型**而非按业务线分层，是一种清晰的监管披露结构**——**立法 / 公告 / 讨论与征求意见稿 / 政策与指引 / 报送表与指引 / 统计 / 年报 / 业务计划**；**对需要查找某类监管文件的读者，这种结构比按业务线混杂更可用**；**可与池内 [[eiopa-registers]] 的 DPM/XBRL 报送、[[assal]] 的「国际标准/自有标准/成员国法规」三层并读——三者都是**监管文件的组织方式**，但结构不同**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航与链接逐字实测的保险、CSP、文件中心与出版物结构**，**但未打开任何内容页正文、未打开沙盒与创新中心内容、CSP 发牌要求、设立指引、集团监管页、任何监管文件或年报**，因此**不能转述任何发牌条件、资本要求、沙盒准入标准、设立流程、监管文件内容或统计数值**；**② ⭐ 「保险沙盒与创新中心」为**页面标题逐字实测**（**标题含「Sandbox and Insurance Innovation Hub | InsurTech」**），**但其准入条件、参与机构与运作方式本次未核实**；**③ ⭐ 「CSP 即专属保险管理人/服务公司」这一对应关系为**依据专属保险行业通行术语的推断**——**本次未打开任何一页定义 CSP 的业务范围**，**词条内因此以「企业服务提供者」直译并标注该推断**；**④ 路径中的「statstics」为**站点自身拼写**，**本词条照实引用以保持可核对**；**⑤ 「百慕大为全球主要专属保险辖区之一」这类规模判断**本次未核实，**故词条内不主张其市场排名或份额**；**⑥ BMA 的法定地位、成立年份与治理结构本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** BMA 提供精算工具、定价模型或可批量下载的数据集**。**核实说明**：首页（145.7KB）、`/innovative-insurance-sandbox`（144.0KB）、`/csp-licensing`（130.9KB）、`/insurance-licensing-how-to-set-up-an-insurance-company`（131.1KB）、`/documents-centre/statstics/documents-insurance`（235.8KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开任何内容正文、监管文件或年报**。
entries.body_en:
**BMA (the Bermuda Monetary Authority)** is **Bermuda’s financial regulator** (measured site title **"Regulatory, Monetary, and Financial Advisory Body of Bermuda - BMA"**). This entry adds the **"regulator of an offshore insurance domicile"** form — **[[siia]] and [[cica]] are the industry side and [[vermont-captive]] an onshore domicile government in the same round, while BMA supplies the offshore regulator’s perspective**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the **homepage is 145.7KB with the measured title "Regulatory, Monetary, and Financial Advisory Body of Bermuda - BMA"**; ⭐⭐ the **"Bermuda Insurance Innovation" page `/innovative-insurance-sandbox` measures 144.0KB with the measured title "Bermuda Insurance Innovation | BMA Sandbox and Insurance Innovation Hub | InsurTech"**; ⭐⭐ the **"Corporate Service Provider Licensing in Bermuda" page measures 130.9KB**; ⭐ the **"How to Set Up a Captive/Commercial Insurer" page measures 131.1KB**; ⭐ the **"Insurance" documents-centre page measures 235.8KB** (**note: "statstics" in that path is the site’s own spelling, quoted verbatim so the reference stays checkable**). **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: on the **insurance** side — **`/insurance-licensing-requirements`**, **`/insurance-licensing-how-to-set-up-an-insurance-company`**, **`/insurance-supervision-regulation`**, ⭐ **`/insurance-group-supervision`**, ⭐ **`/insurance-innovation`** and ⭐ **`/innovative-insurance-sandbox`**; ⭐ **corporate service providers (CSPs) have separate `csp-licensing` and `csp-supervision-regulation` sections**; **other regulated sectors** measurably include banking, investment business, investment funds, trusts, credit unions, money service business and digital assets, each with licensing and supervision sections; ⭐ **the documents centre is layered by document type**: **legislation**, **bulletins**, **discussion and consultation papers**, **policy and guidance**, **reporting forms and guidelines**, ⭐ **statistics**, plus **annual reports** and a **business plan**; there are also **`/regulated-entities`**, **`/standards-regulations`** and **`/about-us`**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐ How an offshore domicile regulator actively solicits business is one of the round’s core contrasts** — **BMA not only supervises but also provides an operational guide to setting up a captive or commercial insurer, runs an insurance sandbox and innovation hub, and licenses corporate service providers**; **together these three form a domicile’s supply-side institutional package**: **lowering setup friction (guidance) + allowing experimentation (sandbox) + regulating intermediary service providers (licensing)**; **this contrasts with [[vermont-captive]]’s "Why Vermont (with facts and figures) + forming and operating (with fees)" as offshore versus onshore solicitation styles** (**note: no page content was opened, so no requirement, process or fee is restated**). **② ⭐⭐ The insurance sandbox fills a previously missing form** — **the corpus’s "regulatory sandbox" entries measured only three, all AI or hackathon in nature** ([[hk-genai-sandbox-axa-manulife]], [[ginsim]], [[thinkingbox]]), **whereas BMA’s is a sandbox for insurance products and insurance technology innovation**; **a sample of a different institutional form for students of insurance innovation and regulatory experimentation** (**and its page title measurably includes "InsurTech"**). **③ ⭐⭐ Separate licensing of corporate service providers (CSPs) forms a valuable contrast with the corpus’s TPA form** — **[[siia]] in the same round represents US TPAs (third-party administrators)**, **while BMA licenses and supervises CSPs (corporate service providers, in the captive context the managers and service companies) separately**; **i.e. "third-party service providers in insurance" are organised and regulated differently in two jurisdictions** — **a layer the corpus lacked** (**the CSP page was not opened, so no licensing condition, capital requirement or supervisory scope is restated**). **④ ⭐ An "insurance group supervision" section is notable** — **captives are often organised in groups**, **so group-level supervision is part of the regime** (**not opened**). **⑤ ⭐ The documents centre is layered by document type rather than by business line, a clear supervisory disclosure structure** — **legislation / bulletins / discussion and consultation papers / policy and guidance / reporting forms and guidelines / statistics / annual reports / business plan**; **for readers looking for a class of supervisory document this is more usable than a mix by business line**; **readable with the DPM/XBRL reporting of [[eiopa-registers]] and [[assal]]’s three layers of international standards, own standards and member-country regulation — all three organise supervisory documents, but differently**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the insurance, CSP, documents-centre and publication structures read verbatim from navigation and links**, **but opened no content page body, no sandbox or innovation hub content, no CSP licensing requirement, no setup guide, no group supervision page, no supervisory document and no annual report**, so **no licensing condition, capital requirement, sandbox admission criterion, setup process, supervisory document content or statistic can be restated**; **② ⭐ "insurance sandbox and innovation hub" is read verbatim from the page title** (**which contains "Sandbox and Insurance Innovation Hub | InsurTech"**), **but its admission criteria, participating institutions and operation were not verified**; **③ ⭐ The equivalence "CSP means captive manager or service company" is an inference from standard captive-industry terminology** — **no page defining the CSP business scope was opened**, **so the entry gives the literal rendering "corporate service provider" and flags the inference**; **④ "statstics" in the path is the site’s own spelling**, **quoted verbatim to keep the reference checkable**; **⑤ Claims about Bermuda’s scale as a captive domicile** were not verified, **so the entry asserts no market ranking or share**; **⑥ BMA’s legal status, founding year and governance were not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim BMA provides actuarial tools, pricing models or a bulk-downloadable dataset**. **Verification note**: the homepage (145.7KB), `/innovative-insurance-sandbox` (144.0KB), `/csp-licensing` (130.9KB), `/insurance-licensing-how-to-set-up-an-insurance-company` (131.1KB) and `/documents-centre/statstics/documents-insurance` (235.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no content body, supervisory document or annual report was opened**.

entries.body:
**Vermont Captive Insurance（佛蒙特专属保险）** 是**美国佛蒙特州的官方站点**（站点标题实测 **「Home - Vermont Captive Insurance」**；**页面内实测自称「Vermont official state website」**）。本条目补的是**「在岸辖区以州政府身份招揽专属保险注册」这一形态**——**同轮 [[bma]] 是离岸辖区监管者、[[siia]] 与 [[cica]] 是行业侧，而本条补的是**在岸辖区的政府招揽视角****。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**站点首页 51.9KB，标题「Home - Vermont Captive Insurance」**；⭐ **「Why Vermont?（为何选择佛蒙特）」页 `/why-vermont/` 实测 65.0KB，标题「Why Vermont? - Vermont Captive Insurance」**；⭐ **「Forming & operating a captive（设立与运营专属保险公司）」页 `/forming-operating-a-captive/` 实测 53.5KB**；⭐ **「40 Years Anniversary」页 `/40-years/` 实测 49.9KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：⭐ **`/captive/`** 下含锚点 **Why-Form（为何设立）**、**How-It-Works（如何运作）**、**Types（类型）**、**FAQ**；⭐ **`/why-vermont/`** 下含锚点 **Team**、⭐ **Providers（服务提供者）**、**Resources**、⭐ **Facts-Figures（事实与数据）**；⭐ **`/forming-operating-a-captive/`** 下含锚点 **Steps（步骤）**、⭐ **Key-Attributes（关键属性）**、⭐ **Fees（费用）**；**News & Events**；⭐ **`/40-years/`**；⭐ **`/featured-podcasts/`**；⭐ **`/careers/`** 下含锚点 **What-Is-Captive（什么是专属保险）**、**Why-Vermont**、**Far-From-Boring**、**Lifestyle**、**Career-Resources（职业资源）**；⭐ **`/building-the-next-generation-of-captive-insurance-professionals/`（培养下一代专属保险专业人才）**；**Contact Us**、**Site Map**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「辖区主动招揽」的完整样本，且与离岸侧形成对照**——**佛蒙特用「为何选择佛蒙特（含事实与数据）」「设立与运营（含步骤、关键属性、费用）」「40 周年」「服务提供者」「职业机会」组织其招揽**；**而同轮 [[bma]] 用「如何设立保险公司」「保险沙盒与创新中心」「CSP 发牌」组织**；**两者并读可见**离岸与在岸辖区在招揽方式上的差异：一个强调创新与灵活（沙盒、InsurTech），一个强调历史、人才与服务生态（40 年、职业、服务提供者）****（**注意：本次未打开任何内容页，故不转述其事实数据或费用金额**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「费用（Fees）」被列为「设立与运营」页的一个锚点，是本轮最值得注意的披露之一**——**由州政府公开专属保险的设立与年度费用，等于把**辖区成本**明码标价**；**对做辖区选择或监管竞争研究的学生，「哪里的成本是多少」通常最难获得，而这里由辖区自己公布**（**注意：本次未打开该页，故不转述任何费用金额、币种或计费方式**）。**③ ⭐ 「服务提供者（Providers）」与「职业机会 + 培养下一代」两个板块值得注意**——**前者指向辖区内的服务生态（律所、会计师事务所、管理人）**，**后者指向**人才供给****；**即该州不只在招揽公司注册，还在建设**配套服务与人才池****；**这与池内 [[clm]] 的「理赔学院」、[[cia-ica]] 的「职业操守模块」同属「行业组织投资于人」，但出发点是**辖区的产业政策****（**本次未打开**）。**④ ⭐ 「40 周年」是一个以时间建立可信度的做法**——**专属保险辖区的竞争在很大程度上是**信誉与稳定性的竞争****（**本次未打开，故不转述其历史细节**）。**⑤ 「Featured Podcasts」是一个少见的传播渠道**——**州政府以播客做产业推广**（**本次未打开**）。**⑥ 与同轮 [[cica]] 的「住所中立」形成最鲜明的一组对照**：**一个协会刻意不偏向任何辖区，而这个州政府本身就是辖区并在主动招揽**——**这正是本轮的收束点**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与三个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航与链接逐字实测的完整板块与锚点结构**，**但未打开任何内容页正文、未打开事实与数据、费用、步骤、关键属性、服务提供者、职业资源或播客内容**，因此**不能转述任何专属保险的事实数据、费用金额、设立步骤、类型定义或职业信息**；**② ⭐ 「费用」为**导航锚点逐字实测**（**`/forming-operating-a-captive/#Fees`**）——**本词条只主张「存在费用板块」，**不主张任何费用金额、币种、计费方式或是否分档****；**③ ⭐ 「Vermont official state website」为**页面内逐字实测**，**但该站点的具体主办机构（州政府哪个部门或官方推广机构）、其与州保险监管机构（Vermont 的 captive 监管由州金融服务部承担）的关系本次均未核实**——**故词条内只主张「美国佛蒙特州的官方站点」，不主张具体主办单位或监管分工**；**④ 「40 年」来自页面标题「40 Years Anniversary」（实测）**，**其起算年份与是否连续本次未核实**；**⑤ ⭐ 「佛蒙特为美国主要专属保险辖区之一」这类规模判断**本次未核实，**故不主张其国内排名或市场份额**；**⑥ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张**该站点提供精算工具、定价模型或可下载数据集**。**核实说明**：`/why-vermont/`（65.0KB）、`/forming-operating-a-captive/`（53.5KB）、`/40-years/`（49.9KB）与首页（51.9KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题、导航与锚点；**未打开任何内容正文**。
entries.body_en:
**Vermont Captive Insurance** is **an official State of Vermont website** (measured site title **"Home - Vermont Captive Insurance"**; the page itself measurably states **"Vermont official state website"**). This entry adds the **"onshore domicile soliciting captive registrations as a state government"** form — **[[bma]] is an offshore regulator and [[siia]] and [[cica]] are the industry side in the same round, while this adds the onshore government’s solicitation perspective**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the **homepage is 51.9KB with the measured title "Home - Vermont Captive Insurance"**; ⭐ the **"Why Vermont?" page measures 65.0KB**; ⭐ the **"Forming & operating a captive" page measures 53.5KB**; ⭐ the **"40 Years Anniversary" page measures 49.9KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation, links and anchors**: ⭐ **`/captive/`** carries anchors for **why form one**, **how it works**, **types** and **FAQ**; ⭐ **`/why-vermont/`** carries anchors for **Team**, ⭐ **Providers**, **Resources** and ⭐ **Facts-Figures**; ⭐ **`/forming-operating-a-captive/`** carries anchors for **Steps**, ⭐ **Key-Attributes** and ⭐ **Fees**; **News & Events**; ⭐ **`/40-years/`**; ⭐ **`/featured-podcasts/`**; ⭐ **`/careers/`** with anchors for **what a captive is**, **why Vermont**, **far from boring**, **lifestyle** and **career resources**; ⭐ **`/building-the-next-generation-of-captive-insurance-professionals/`**; plus **Contact Us** and a **site map**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐ A complete sample of domicile solicitation, contrasting with the offshore side** — **Vermont organises its pitch around "Why Vermont?" (with facts and figures), forming and operating (with steps, key attributes and fees), a 40th anniversary, providers and careers**; **whereas [[bma]] organises around "how to set up an insurer", an insurance sandbox and innovation hub, and CSP licensing**; **read together they show the difference in solicitation style between offshore and onshore domiciles: one emphasises innovation and flexibility (sandbox, InsurTech), the other history, talent and the service ecosystem (40 years, careers, providers)** (**note: no content page was opened, so no fact figure or fee amount is restated**). **② ⭐⭐ "Fees" as an anchor on the forming-and-operating page is one of the round’s most notable disclosures** — **a state government publishing captive setup and annual fees puts the jurisdiction’s cost in plain view**; **for students of domicile choice or regulatory competition, "what does each place cost" is usually the hardest information to obtain, and here the jurisdiction publishes it itself** (**note: that page was not opened, so no fee amount, currency or charging basis is restated**). **③ ⭐ The "Providers" section and the "careers plus next-generation" sections deserve note** — **one points to the domicile’s service ecosystem (law firms, accounting firms, managers)**, **the other to talent supply**; **i.e. the state is not only attracting registrations but building supporting services and a talent pool**; **the same "industry bodies investing in people" as [[clm]]’s Claims College or [[cia-ica]]’s professionalism module, but originating in a jurisdiction’s industrial policy** (**not opened**). **④ ⭐ A 40th anniversary is a way of building credibility through time** — **competition among captive domiciles is substantially a competition of reputation and stability** (**not opened, so no historical detail is restated**). **⑤ "Featured Podcasts" is an uncommon outreach channel** — **a state government using podcasts for industry promotion** (**not opened**). **⑥ With [[cica]]’s "domicile-neutral" this forms the round’s sharpest contrast**: **an association deliberately favouring no jurisdiction, versus a state government that is itself a jurisdiction and is actively soliciting** — **the closing point of the round**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and three pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the complete section and anchor structure read verbatim from navigation and links**, **but opened no content page body, no facts and figures, fees, steps, key attributes, providers, career resources or podcast content**, so **no captive fact figure, fee amount, setup step, type definition or career information can be restated**; **② ⭐ "Fees" is read verbatim as a navigation anchor** (**`/forming-operating-a-captive/#Fees`**) — **the entry claims only that a fees section exists, and claims no amount, currency, charging basis or tiering**; **③ ⭐ "Vermont official state website" is read verbatim from the page**, **but the specific host body (which department or official promotion agency) and its relationship to the state’s captive supervisor (Vermont’s captive supervision sits with its Department of Financial Regulation) were not verified** — **so the entry claims only "an official State of Vermont website", not a specific host or regulatory division of labour**; **④ "40 years" comes from the measured page title "40 Years Anniversary"**, **and its start year and continuity were not verified**; **⑤ ⭐ Claims about Vermont’s scale as a US captive domicile** were not verified, **so no national ranking or market share is asserted**; **⑥ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the site provides actuarial tools, pricing models or downloadable datasets**. **Verification note**: `/why-vermont/` (65.0KB), `/forming-operating-a-captive/` (53.5KB), `/40-years/` (49.9KB) and the homepage (51.9KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles, navigation and anchors read verbatim; **no content body was opened**.

**Vermont Captive Insurance（佛蒙特專屬保險）** 是**美國佛蒙特州的官方站點**（站點標題實測 **「Home - Vermont Captive Insurance」**；**頁面內實測自稱「Vermont official state website」**）。本條目補的是**「在岸轄區以州政府身份招攬專屬保險註冊」這一形態**——**同輪 [[bma]] 是離岸轄區監管者、[[siia]] 與 [[cica]] 是行業側，而本條補的是**在岸轄區的政府招攬視角****。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **51.9KB**；⭐ **「Why Vermont?」頁 65.0KB**；⭐ **「Forming & operating a captive」頁 53.5KB**；⭐ **「40 Years Anniversary」頁 49.9KB**。**導航與連結及錨點逐字實測**：⭐ **`/captive/`** 下含錨點 **Why-Form／How-It-Works／Types／FAQ**；⭐ **`/why-vermont/`** 下含 **Team／⭐Providers／Resources／⭐Facts-Figures**；⭐ **`/forming-operating-a-captive/`** 下含 **Steps／⭐Key-Attributes／⭐Fees**；**News & Events**；⭐ **`/40-years/`**；⭐ **`/featured-podcasts/`**；⭐ **`/careers/`** 下含 **What-Is-Captive／Why-Vermont／Far-From-Boring／Lifestyle／Career-Resources**；⭐ **`/building-the-next-generation-of-captive-insurance-professionals/`**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「轄區主動招攬」的完整樣本，且與離岸側形成對照**——**佛蒙特用「為何選擇佛蒙特（含事實與數據）」「設立與運營（含步驟、關鍵屬性、費用）」「40 週年」「服務提供者」「職業機會」組織其招攬**；**而同輪 [[bma]] 用「如何設立保險公司」「保險沙盒與創新中心」「CSP 發牌」組織**；**兩者並讀可見離岸與在岸在招攬方式上的差異：一個強調創新與靈活（沙盒、InsurTech），一個強調歷史、人才與服務生態（40 年、職業、服務提供者）**（**未打開任何內容頁，故不轉述其事實數據或費用金額**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「費用（Fees）」被列為「設立與運營」頁的一個錨點，是本輪最值得注意的披露之一**——**由州政府公開專屬保險的設立與年度費用，等於把**轄區成本**明碼標價**；**對做轄區選擇或監管競爭研究的學生，「哪裡的成本是多少」通常最難獲得，而這裡由轄區自己公布**（**未打開該頁，故不轉述任何費用金額、幣種或計費方式**）。**③ ⭐ 「服務提供者（Providers）」與「職業機會＋培養下一代」兩個板塊值得注意**——**前者指向轄區內的服務生態，後者指向**人才供給****；**即該州不只在招攬公司註冊，還在建設配套服務與人才池**（**本次未打開**）。**④ ⭐ 「40 週年」是以時間建立可信度的做法**——**專屬保險轄區的競爭在很大程度上是**信譽與穩定性的競爭****（**未打開，故不轉述歷史細節**）。**⑤ 「Featured Podcasts」是一個少見的傳播渠道**（**未打開**）。**⑥ 與同輪 [[cica]] 的「住所中立」形成最鮮明的一組對照**：**一個協會刻意不偏向任何轄區，而這個州政府本身就是轄區並主動招攬**——**這正是本輪的收束點**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與三個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航與連結及錨點逐字實測的完整結構**，**但未打開任何內容頁正文、事實與數據、費用、步驟、關鍵屬性、服務提供者、職業資源或播客內容**，故**不能轉述任何專屬保險的事實數據、費用金額、設立步驟、類型定義或職業資訊**；**② ⭐ 「費用」為導航錨點逐字實測**（**`/forming-operating-a-captive/#Fees`**）——**本詞條只主張「存在費用板塊」，不主張任何金額、幣種、計費方式或是否分檔**；**③ ⭐ 「Vermont official state website」為頁面內逐字實測**，**但具體主辦機構及其與州專屬保險監管機構（佛蒙特的 captive 監管由州金融服務部承擔）的關係本次均未核實**——**故只主張「美國佛蒙特州的官方站點」，不主張具體主辦單位或監管分工**；**④ 「40 年」來自頁面標題「40 Years Anniversary」（實測）**，**其起算年份與是否連續未核實**；**⑤ ⭐ 「佛蒙特為美國主要專屬保險轄區之一」這類規模判斷未核實，故不主張其國內排名或市場份額**；**⑥ 是否有中文材料未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張**該站點提供精算工具、定價模型或可下載數據集**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題、導航與錨點；**未打開任何內容正文**。

entries.body:
**ActuaryRadar** 是一个开源的精算行业情报聚合与学习平台（仓库 `wjr0704/actuaryradar`），**MIT 许可，实测 ★3、fork 0、主语言 JavaScript、仓库体量 2,103 KB、创建于 2026-07-06、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**全部为 GitHub API 实测值**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「可核实性的四种做法」**中的**第一种：靠精选来源（curation）****。

可核实信息（**均由 GitHub API 与 README 逐字实测**）：**README 实测 3,310 字节**，首句逐字为 **「ActuaryRadar」**，副标题逐字为 **「An AI-powered all-in-one Insurance Intelligence & Actuarial Learning Platform.」**；**其功能清单逐字实测为七项**：**Curated Insurance Intelligence（精选保险情报）**、**Personalized Learning Journey（个性化学习路径）**、**Actuarial Knowledge Library（精算知识库）**、**Company Results（公司业绩）**、**Regulatory Updates（监管更新）**、⭐ **Trusted Public Sources（可信公共来源）**、**AI-assisted Learning（AI 辅助学习）**；**技术栈自述逐字实测为 Next.js / React / TypeScript / Tailwind CSS / Netlify / AI-assisted development**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「Trusted Public Sources」被单列为一项功能，是本轮最值得注意的一点**——**一个工具把「来源是否可信」做成产品里的一等公民，而不是让用户自己去判断**；**这与本词条所在站点的做法同源：不是给你更多链接，而是标注来源**（**可与池内 [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]] 的术语来源、[[actuarial-open-book]] 的开源教材体系并读——三者都是「把可信材料的入口集中起来」，但一个做术语、一个做教材、一个做行业动态**）。**② ⭐ 「公司业绩 + 监管更新 + 再保险洞察」三项合起来，说明它覆盖的是**行业跟踪**而非仅学习**——**可与池内 [[triple-i]]（美国行业数据与洞察）、[[asia-insurance-review]] 与 [[reinsurance-news]]（行业新闻）并读**：**那些是内容生产者，而 ActuaryRadar 是内容**聚合者****；**对精算学生，「每天要看的几个来源」被收进一个页面是有实际价值的**（**本次未打开站点，故不转述其实际收录了哪些来源、更新频率或覆盖面**）。**③ ⚠️ 最重要的一条如实标注：README 自己写明当前形态与所述技术栈不一致**——**其原文逐字为「the current MVP is a static Python/JavaScript prototype that generates a deployable site. The stack above reflects the intended production directi[on]」**——**即**上面那份 Next.js/React 技术栈是「预期方向」而非现状，现阶段的 MVP 只是一个生成静态站点的 Python/JavaScript 原型****；**同时其截图表格中三处实测均为「Placeholder」，README 亦写明「Screenshots will be added soon」**——**故本词条明确不主张该平台已具备所述的现代前端形态，也不主张其已有可用界面**。**这一条正是本轮主题的反面教材：**当一个项目把「可信来源」当卖点时，读者更应先看清它自己现在到底跑起来了多少****。**④ ⭐ 「AI-assisted development」被列入技术栈，说明该项目自身也是 AI 辅助开发的产物**（**与池内 [[agentic-bop-underwriting]]、[[claude-code]] 所代表的开发方式同属一类现象；本次未核实其 AI 辅助的具体程度**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据（★数、fork、许可、语言、体量、创建与推送时间）与 README 全文（3,310 字节）**，**未克隆仓库、未运行、未打开其线上站点、未核实其是否已部署**，因此**不能转述其实际功能、数据来源清单、覆盖面或更新频率**；**② ⭐ 技术栈为**README 自述且被 README 自身标注为「预期方向」****——**词条内已如实说明现阶段的 MVP 形态，不主张其已实现该技术栈**；**③ 截图实测为占位符（Placeholder），故不主张该项目已有可展示界面**；**④ ★3 说明关注度很低**，**本词条不主张其成熟度、用户规模或被行业采用**；**⑤ 「AI 驱动」为**项目自述**，**其 AI 成分的具体实现与效果本次未核实**；**⑥ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张**该项目提供精算计算、定价模型或可下载数据集**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/wjr0704/actuaryradar` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（元数据字段与 README 原文均已逐字核对）；**未运行、未部署核实、未打开线上站点**。

It belongs to the first of this round’s four approaches to verifiability: **relying on curated sources (curation)**.

Verifiable details (**all measured verbatim from the GitHub API and README**): the **README measures 3,310 bytes**, its subtitle stating verbatim **"An AI-powered all-in-one Insurance Intelligence & Actuarial Learning Platform."**; **its feature list measurably names seven items**: **Curated Insurance Intelligence**, **Personalized Learning Journey**, **Actuarial Knowledge Library**, **Company Results**, **Regulatory Updates**, ⭐ **Trusted Public Sources** and **AI-assisted Learning**; and **the self-described stack measurably reads Next.js / React / TypeScript / Tailwind CSS / Netlify / AI-assisted development**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐ That "Trusted Public Sources" is listed as a feature in its own right is the round’s most notable point** — **the tool makes source trustworthiness a first-class part of the product rather than leaving users to judge it alone**; **the same instinct as the site this entry lives on: not more links, but labelled sources** (**readable with [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]]’s terminology sources and [[actuarial-open-book]]’s open textbook system — all three centralise entry points to trustworthy material, one for terms, one for textbooks, one for industry developments**). **② ⭐ Company results, regulatory updates and reinsurance insights together show it covers industry tracking rather than learning alone** — **readable with [[triple-i]] (US industry data and insight), [[asia-insurance-review]] and [[reinsurance-news]]**: **those produce content, whereas ActuaryRadar aggregates it**; **for an actuarial student, the daily reading list collected onto one page has real value** (**the site was not opened, so what it actually indexes, how often it updates, and its coverage are not restated**). **③ ⚠️ The most important honest note: the README itself states that the current form does not match the described stack** — **its verbatim wording is "the current MVP is a static Python/JavaScript prototype that generates a deployable site. The stack above reflects the intended production directi[on]"** — **i.e. that Next.js/React stack is a stated direction, not the present reality, and today’s MVP is merely a Python/JavaScript prototype that generates a static site**; **moreover three cells of its screenshot table measurably read "Placeholder" and the README states "Screenshots will be added soon"** — **so this entry explicitly does not claim the platform has the modern front end described, nor that it has a usable interface**. **This is the round’s counter-example: when a project’s selling point is trusted sources, the reader should first see how much of it actually runs today**. **④ ⭐ "AI-assisted development" appearing in the stack shows the project is itself an AI-assisted build** (**the same phenomenon as [[agentic-bop-underwriting]] and [[claude-code]]; the degree of AI assistance was not verified**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the repository metadata (stars, forks, licence, language, size, creation and push dates) and the full 3,310-byte README**, **but did not clone, run, or open any deployed site**, so **its actual functionality, source list, coverage and update frequency cannot be restated**; **② ⭐ The stack is a README self-description that the README itself labels as a direction** — **the entry states the current MVP form honestly and does not claim that stack is implemented**; **③ Screenshots measurably read as placeholders, so no presentable interface is claimed**; **④ ★3 indicates very low attention**, **and the entry claims no maturity, user base or industry adoption**; **⑤ "AI-powered" is the project’s own description**, **and the concrete AI implementation and its effectiveness were not verified**; **⑥ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the project provides actuarial computation, pricing models or a downloadable dataset**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/wjr0704/actuaryradar` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (metadata fields and README text checked verbatim); **nothing was run, no deployment was verified and no live site was opened**.

entries.title: Klein Auto Research：让 AI 智能体在「可验证的研究纪律」内工作（预测先于证据登记、逐次运行存证、独立裁判）
entries.title_en: Klein Auto Research: making an AI agent work inside a verifiable research discipline (predictions registered before evidence, every run notarised, an independent referee)
entries.title_hk: Klein Auto Research：讓 AI 智能體在「可驗證的研究紀律」內工作（預測先於證據登記、逐次運行存證、獨立裁判）
entries.summary: 面向精算与数据科学的开源智能体研究框架：把研究纪律做成智能体运行的「实验记录本」——预测在证据出现前登记、每次运行以 git 存证、结论强度须被挣得、任何结论在被称为发现前须过独立裁判；Python ≥3.11，数据集随仓库捆绑或本地生成，无需凭证与下载
entries.summary_en: An open-source agentic research framework for actuaries and data scientists that makes research discipline the lab notebook the agent runs inside: predictions registered before their evidence, every run notarised in git, claim strength earned rather than asserted, and an independent referee before anything is called a finding; Python ≥3.11, with every needed dataset bundled or generated locally and no credentials or downloads required

entries.body:
**Klein Auto Research** 是一个面向精算与数据科学的智能体研究框架（仓库 `Xiang-Shan/klein-auto-research`），**MIT 许可，实测 ★2、fork 1、主语言 Python、仓库体量 30,802 KB、创建于 2026-07-10、最后推送 2026-09-08**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**其仓库 topics 逐字实测为 actuarial-science、agentic-research、ai-agents、claude-code、insurance、machine-learning、optimization、research-framework、simulation、tabular-data**。本条目属于本轮主题**「可核实性的四种做法」**中的**第二种：靠过程（process）****——**也是最贴合本词条所在站点自身方法论的一条**。

可核实信息（**均由 GitHub API 与 README 逐字实测**）：**README 实测 18,658 字节**，其首段逐字为 **「Process-verifiable research for AI for Science. Klein is the lab-notebook discipline an AI agent runs *inside*: predictions registered before their evidence, every run notarized in git, claims whose strength is earned, an independent referee before anything is called a finding.」**——**即它把研究纪律做成了智能体运行其中的**实验记录本****：**① 预测先于证据登记；② 每次运行在 git 中存证；③ 主张的强度是「挣来的」而非声称的；④ 任何东西在被称作「发现」之前要过一名独立裁判**。⭐ **可执行的证据（README 逐字实测）**：**需要 Python ≥3.11、uv 与 git，且「No credentials and no downloads: every dataset an exhibit needs is bundled or generated」**——**无需凭证、无需下载，每个示例所需数据集要么随仓库捆绑、要么本地生成**；**实测命令含 `uv run --no-sync klein doctor`（本机可跑什么，不取任何东西）与 `uv run --no-sync klein verify --study studies/00-known-truth-quickstart --numbers`**；⭐ **并实测到产物中的 `claims.lock` 文件，README 逐字称「every number on that page has a home there」**——**报告页面上每一个数字在 `claims.lock` 里都有一个可追溯的出处**；**另有两个更长检查**：**pytest 测试套件**，以及 **`scripts/verify_shipped_studies.py` 重新验证每一个随仓库发布的账本——README 逐字称这是「the same proof CI runs on every push」**（**每次推送时 CI 跑的同一套证明**）。**可选扩展实测**：**`--extra gbdt` 引入 LightGBM/XGBoost/CatBoost**、**`--extra deep` 引入 PyTorch**。**README 章节结构逐字实测**：**Quickstart (5 minutes) / Why Klein / One kernel, any inquiry / Run it on your own question / ⭐ Detection limit: audit headroom before spending challengers / The generation layer (opt-in, since 2.1) / Drive it with your agent — or none / The shipped studies / ⭐ Limitations / ⭐ Harness or skill? Both — a harness that carries a skill / Layout / Lineage & citing**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「predictions registered before their evidence（预测先于证据登记）」是本轮最有价值的一条**——**这正是**预注册（pre-registration）**这一科研诚信机制，被搬进了 AI 智能体的工作流**；**对精算学生，这条直接对应一个真实痛点：**模型是智能体跑出来的，读者凭什么相信这个结果不是调出来的****；**预注册把「调参直到好看」这一空间提前封死**（**可与池内 [[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 并读——**那三条分别从可复现、可验证与基准比较三个角度处理同一问题，而 Klein 补的是**过程顺序**这一维度：证据与预测的先后****）。**② ⭐⭐ 「claims.lock：页面上每个数字都有出处」是一个可直接借鉴的工程做法**——**把报告里的数字与产生它的那次运行**机械绑定****，**而不是靠作者自觉**；**这与池内 [[claude-code]] 之类的编码智能体形成互补：后者让智能体**写**代码，前者让智能体**交账****（**可与 [[phi-boundary-gate]] 的边界门控、[[ins-mmbench]] 的基准评测并读：都是「在结论出门前设一道必须通过的关」**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「an independent referee before anything is called a finding」是三个机制里最贵的一个**——**前面两条靠工具即可强制，而独立裁判意味着**不是自己判自己****；**词条内不主张它真的是独立第三方（README 未如此说明，本次亦未核实裁判的实现方式）**——**这正是本词条所在站点反复强调的一点：机制的名称不等于机制的强度**。**④ ⭐ 「Harness or skill? Both — a harness that carries a skill」这一章节标题值得单独记一笔**——**它把本轮之前几轮一直在讨论的「工具（harness）与技能（skill）之别」显式地作为设计问题提出，并给出「一个是承载另一个」的答案**；**实测其仓库内含 `.claude/skills/klein/scripts/tests` 路径，与该自我描述一致**（**⚠️ 本词条不据此展开其 skill 形态，仅如实记录路径存在**）。**⑤ ⭐ 「Detection limit: audit headroom before spending challengers」是一个统计学味很重的章节名**——**「在花掉挑战者（检验）之前先审计余量」接近**功效分析（power analysis）**的思路：先确认这套数据能分辨多大的效应，再决定值不值得做检验**；**这与池内 [[insurance-conformal]]、[[insurance-quantile]] 所代表的「先量化不确定性再下结论」同属一类纪律**（**本次未读该章节正文，故不转述其具体判据**）。**⑥ ⭐ 「Why Klein」「Limitations」两章并置值得注意**——**一个工具主动写出自己的局限**（**本次未读 Limitations 正文，故不转述其自述边界**）。**⑦ ⭐ 「每个示例数据集捆绑或本地生成、无需凭证与下载」对教学场景有直接价值**——**课堂上最常卡住的不是方法而是环境**；**README 逐字称 `klein doctor` 用于说明本机能跑什么且不取任何东西**（**本次未运行任何命令，故不主张其实际可跑通**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据（★2、fork 1、MIT、Python、30,802 KB、创建与推送时间）、topics 十项、README 全文（18,658 字节）的标题结构与其中逐字引用的关键段落与命令名**，⭐ **但 README 的多数章节正文（含 Limitations、Detection limit、shipped studies、generation layer）本次仅读到标题，未读正文**，**未克隆仓库、未安装、未运行任何命令、未跑 pytest 或 verify 脚本、未打开任何生成的报告**，因此**不能转述其机制的具体实现、判据、局限自述或随仓库发布的示例研究内容**；**② ⭐⭐ 「独立裁判」为**README 自述**——**词条内明确不主张其为真正独立第三方，其实现方式与独立性本次未核实**；**③ ⭐ ★2 说明关注度很低**，**不主张其成熟度、稳定性或被采用情况**，**亦不主张其在真实研究场景中已被验证有效**；**④ 「process-verifiable（过程可验证）」是**项目自述的定位**，**本次未独立检验其是否真的做到**；**⑤ 「for actuaries & data scientists」为**仓库描述自述**，**其精算专用程度本次未核实**；**⑥ 该框架与 Claude/智能体平台的绑定程度、是否需要付费服务本次未核实**（**topics 含 claude-code，但其依赖关系未核实**）；**⑦ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Xiang-Shan/klein-auto-research` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取；**未克隆、未安装、未运行**。
entries.body_en:
**Klein Auto Research** is an agentic research framework for actuaries and data scientists (repository `Xiang-Shan/klein-auto-research`), **MIT licensed, with measured ★2, 1 fork, Python as the primary language, a 30,802 KB repository, created 2026-07-10 and last pushed 2026-09-08** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **its repository topics measurably read actuarial-science, agentic-research, ai-agents, claude-code, insurance, machine-learning, optimization, research-framework, simulation and tabular-data**. It belongs to the second of this round’s four approaches to verifiability: **relying on process** — **and it is the entry that most closely mirrors the methodology of the site it lives on**.

Verifiable details (**all measured verbatim from the GitHub API and README**): the **README measures 18,658 bytes** and its opening paragraph states verbatim **"Process-verifiable research for AI for Science. Klein is the lab-notebook discipline an AI agent runs *inside*: predictions registered before their evidence, every run notarized in git, claims whose strength is earned, an independent referee before anything is called a finding."** — **i.e. it turns research discipline into the lab notebook the agent runs inside**: **① predictions registered before their evidence; ② every run notarised in git; ③ claim strength earned rather than asserted; ④ an independent referee before anything is called a finding**. ⭐ **Executable evidence (read verbatim from the README)**: it needs **Python ≥3.11, uv and git, and states "No credentials and no downloads: every dataset an exhibit needs is bundled or generated"**; **the commands measurably include `uv run --no-sync klein doctor` and `uv run --no-sync klein verify --study studies/00-known-truth-quickstart --numbers`**; ⭐ **and a `claims.lock` artefact is measurably present, of which the README says verbatim "every number on that page has a home there"** — **every number on the report page has a traceable origin in `claims.lock`**; **two longer checks are also described**: a **pytest suite**, and **`scripts/verify_shipped_studies.py` re-verifying every shipped ledger — which the README calls "the same proof CI runs on every push"**. **Measurable optional extras**: **`--extra gbdt` brings in LightGBM/XGBoost/CatBoost, `--extra deep` brings in PyTorch**. **README section headings read verbatim**: **Quickstart (5 minutes) / Why Klein / One kernel, any inquiry / Run it on your own question / ⭐ Detection limit: audit headroom before spending challengers / The generation layer (opt-in, since 2.1) / Drive it with your agent — or none / The shipped studies / ⭐ Limitations / ⭐ Harness or skill? Both — a harness that carries a skill / Layout / Lineage & citing**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "Predictions registered before their evidence" is the round’s most valuable point** — **this is the research-integrity mechanism of pre-registration, moved into an AI agent’s workflow**; **for actuarial students it maps onto a real pain point: the model was produced by an agent, so why should a reader believe the result was not tuned into existence?**; **pre-registration closes off the "tune until it looks good" space in advance** (**readable with [[reproducible-actuarial-work]], [[verified-reserving]] and [[actuarial-benchmarks]] — those three address the same problem through reproducibility, verifiability and benchmarking respectively, while Klein adds the dimension of process ordering: which came first, prediction or evidence**). **② ⭐⭐ "claims.lock: every number on the page has an origin" is a directly borrowable engineering practice** — **it mechanically binds numbers in a report to the run that produced them rather than relying on the author’s diligence**; **this complements coding agents such as [[claude-code]]: those let the agent write code, this makes the agent render accounts** (**readable with the boundary gating of [[phi-boundary-gate]] and the benchmark evaluation of [[ins-mmbench]] — all three place a gate a conclusion must pass before leaving the room**). **③ ⭐⭐ "An independent referee before anything is called a finding" is the most expensive of the three mechanisms** — **the first two can be enforced by tooling, but an independent referee means not judging your own work**; **the entry does not claim it is genuinely an independent third party (the README does not say so and the referee’s implementation was not verified)** — **exactly the point this site keeps making: the name of a mechanism is not its strength**. **④ ⭐ The section heading "Harness or skill? Both — a harness that carries a skill" deserves separate note** — **it raises explicitly, as a design question, the tool-versus-skill distinction discussed in earlier rounds, and answers that one carries the other**; **the repository measurably contains a `.claude/skills/klein/scripts/tests` path consistent with that self-description** (**⚠️ the entry records only that the path exists and does not extrapolate its skill form**). **⑤ ⭐ "Detection limit: audit headroom before spending challengers" is a strongly statistical section title** — **auditing headroom before spending challengers is close to the logic of power analysis: first establish what effect this data can resolve, then decide whether a test is worth running**; **the same discipline as [[insurance-conformal]] and [[insurance-quantile]], which quantify uncertainty before concluding** (**the section body was not read, so its criteria are not restated**). **⑥ ⭐ Placing "Why Klein" and "Limitations" side by side is notable** — **a tool volunteering its own limits** (**the Limitations body was not read, so its self-stated boundaries are not restated**). **⑦ ⭐ That every dataset is bundled or generated locally with no credentials and no downloads has direct teaching value** — **what usually blocks a classroom is not the method but the environment**; **the README states that `klein doctor` reports what this machine can run and fetches nothing** (**no command was run, so the entry does not claim it actually works**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the repository metadata (★2, 1 fork, MIT, Python, 30,802 KB, creation and push dates), ten topics, and the README’s full 18,658 bytes in respect of its heading structure and the key passages and command names quoted verbatim**, ⭐ **but most section bodies (including Limitations, Detection limit, the shipped studies and the generation layer) were read only as headings**, **and the repository was not cloned, installed or run, no pytest or verify script was executed and no generated report was opened**, so **the mechanisms’ concrete implementation, criteria, self-stated limits and shipped example studies cannot be restated**; **② ⭐⭐ "Independent referee" is a README self-description** — **the entry explicitly does not claim it is genuinely an independent third party, and neither its implementation nor its independence was verified**; **③ ⭐ ★2 indicates very low attention**, **so no maturity, stability or adoption is claimed**, **nor that it has been shown effective in real research settings**; **④ "Process-verifiable" is the project’s own positioning**, **not independently tested here**; **⑤ "for actuaries & data scientists" is the repository description’s own wording**, **and how actuarial-specific it really is was not verified**; **⑥ how tightly the framework binds to Claude or agent platforms, and whether paid services are required, were not verified** (**its topics include claude-code, but the dependency was not verified**); **⑦ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Xiang-Shan/klein-auto-research` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11; **nothing was cloned, installed or run**.

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「預測先於證據登記」是本輪最有價值的一條**——**這正是**預註冊（pre-registration）**這一科研誠信機制，被搬進 AI 智能體的工作流**；**它把「調參直到好看」這一空間提前封死**（可與 [[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 並讀——**那三條分別從可複現、可驗證與基準比較處理同一問題，而 Klein 補的是**過程順序**這一維度**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「claims.lock：頁面上每個數字都有出處」是可直接借鑑的工程做法**——**把報告數字與產生它的那次運行機械綁定**；**與 [[claude-code]] 之類的編碼智能體互補：後者讓智能體**寫**代碼，前者讓智能體**交賬****（可與 [[phi-boundary-gate]]、[[ins-mmbench]] 並讀）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「獨立裁判」是三個機制裡最貴的一個**——**前兩條可靠工具強制，而獨立裁判意味著**不是自己判自己****；**⚠️ 本詞條不主張它真的是獨立第三方，其實現方式本次未核實**——**這正是本站反覆強調的一點：機制的名稱不等於機制的強度**。**④ ⭐ 「Harness or skill? Both」這一章節標題值得單獨記一筆**——**它把「工具與技能之別」顯式作為設計問題提出，並給出「一個承載另一個」的答案**；**實測其倉庫內含 `.claude/skills/klein/scripts/tests` 路徑，與該自我描述一致**。**⑤ ⭐ 「Detection limit: audit headroom before spending challengers」是一個統計味很重的章節名**——**接近**功效分析**的思路：先確認這套數據能分辨多大的效應，再決定值不值得做檢驗**（**本次未讀該章正文，故不轉述其具體判據**）。**⑥ ⭐ 「Why Klein」與「Limitations」兩章並置值得注意**。**⑦ ⭐ 「數據集捆綁或本地生成、無需憑證與下載」對教學場景有直接價值**。
