entries.body:
**bank-in-domains** 是一份**印度金融命名空间的域名层每日探测数据集**（仓库 `CCAgentOrg/bank-in-domains`），**实测 ★10、fork 2、主语言 Python、仓库体量 4,007 KB、创建于 2026-06-07、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**其自述主页实测为 `zo.pub/cashlessconsumer/bank-domains-status`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「可核实性的四种做法」**中的**第三种：靠持续测量（measurement）****。

可核实信息（**均由 GitHub API 与 README 逐字实测**）：**README 实测 11,172 字节**，其要点逐字为 **「Audit of Indian financial namespace TLDs. Daily probes of `.bank.in`, `.fin.in`, `.insurance.in`, `.nbfc.in`, `.npci.in`, and the global `.bank` gTLD — DNS resolution, HTTPS reachability, status codes, page titles, and final URLs.」**——**即每日探测这些命名空间的**DNS 解析、HTTPS 可达性、状态码、页面标题与最终 URL****。⭐ **README 徽章逐字实测给出三项关键指标**：**License: CC0-1.0**、**Updated Daily**、**Entries 4,199**；**并提供格式徽章 CSV / JSONL / Parquet / SQLite**；**另实测「Built with Zo」徽章**。⭐ **README 逐字说明了它存在的原因**：**「`.bank.in` is the de-facto namespace for Indian banking web presences, but no authoritative registry publishes a subdomain list. This audit discovers and [monitors]」**——**即「`.bank.in` 是印度银行业网络存在的**事实标准**命名空间，但**没有任何权威登记机构公布其子域名清单**，故这份审计自行发现并持续监测」。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「权威登记机构不公布清单，所以只能自己持续测量」是本轮最有方法论价值的一条**——**这是「**没有官方名单**」这一常见困境的一种解法：**不去猜、不去引用二手名单，而是每天自己探一遍并把结果公开****；**对精算与保险学生，这个模式可迁移到很多场景**（**例如「市场上哪些机构真的提供某类产品」「哪些监管者页面真的可达」——**本词条所在站点的每一条目也是靠这种逐次实测建立的**）。**② ⭐⭐ `.insurance.in` 直接出现在探测范围内**——**即存在一个**面向保险业网络存在的印度命名空间**，而它与 `.bank.in`、`.nbfc.in`（非银行金融公司）、`.npci.in`（印度国家支付公司）并列**；**对做印度保险市场或金融监管研究的学生，这是一个此前池内没有的**基础设施视角****（**可与池内 [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]] 并读——**那三条是 IRDAI 的规则、统计与 AI 治理，而本条补的是**这些机构的网络存在本身是否可达、是否解析****；**「监管者发过文件」与「监管者的网站真的活着」是两件事**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「DNS 解析 + HTTPS 可达性 + 状态码 + 页面标题 + 最终 URL」五项合起来，正好构成本词条所在站点验证流程的机器化版本**——**尤其「最终 URL」一项：**跳转后的落点常常与名义 URL 不同**，这与本轮反复出现的**域名级近失**（第 310 轮 `gfia.org`、第 317 轮 `cios.org`）是同一类风险**；**本数据集等于把「这个域名到底指向谁」做成了每日例行测量**。**④ ⭐ 「Entries 4,199」与四种格式（CSV/JSONL/Parquet/SQLite）说明它是**可直接用于分析**的形态**——**对做数据工程或需要真实金融域名清单的学生，这四个格式覆盖了表格、流式、列式与查询四类用法**（**可与池内 [[open-risk-api]]、[[risk-data-library-standard]]、[[cybrisk]] 所代表的开放风险数据与标准并读**）。**⑤ ⭐ 「Updated Daily」由 GitHub Actions 实现，是一种低成本持续测量架构**——**与池内 [[daily-news-report]] 的每日产出、[[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]] 的持续监控同属「让测量变成流水线而不是一次性工作」**（**本次未查看其 workflow 文件，故不转述其实现细节**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可存在**来源冲突，须并列如实记录****：**GitHub API 实测返回 `NOASSERTION`（name 为 `Other`）**，**而 README 徽章逐字实测为 `License: CC0-1.0`**——**两者不一致**；**本词条据此并列记录，并提示：引用该数据前应自行核对仓库中的实际许可文件与条款**（**不断言其为 CC0，也不断言其不可用**）。**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README 全文（11,172 字节）与其中逐字引用的徽章数值与描述**，⭐ **但未下载任何数据文件、未打开 CSV/JSONL/Parquet/SQLite 中的任何一条记录、未访问其自述主页 `zo.pub/cashlessconsumer/bank-domains-status`**，因此**不能转述其字段定义、4,199 条的实际构成、探测成功率或历史覆盖**；**③ ⭐ 「Entries 4,199」与「Updated Daily」均为**README 徽章自述值**，**本次未核对数据文件以验证条数，也未核对提交历史以验证是否真的每日更新**；**④ 「no authoritative registry publishes a subdomain list」为**项目自述的判断****——**本词条不主张该判断已被独立证实**（**这正是一个需要读者自己核实的制度性主张**）；**⑤ 该数据集的采集方式、探测频率的精确值、是否遵守目标站点的访问策略本次未核实**；**⑥ 探测所得的状态码与标题会随时间变化**，**故本词条不主张任何具体探测结果的时效性**；**⑦ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑧** 本词条**不主张**该数据集涵盖 `.bank.in` 等命名空间的全部子域名**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/CCAgentOrg/bank-in-domains` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 徽章数值已逐字核对）；**未下载数据、未访问其自述主页**。
entries.body_en:
**bank-in-domains** is a **daily domain-layer probe dataset for Indian financial namespaces** (repository `CCAgentOrg/bank-in-domains`), with **measured ★10, 2 forks, Python as the primary language, a 4,007 KB repository, created 2026-06-07 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **its self-described homepage measurably reads `zo.pub/cashlessconsumer/bank-domains-status`**. It belongs to the third of this round’s four approaches to verifiability: **relying on continuous measurement**.

Verifiable details (**all measured verbatim from the GitHub API and README**): the **README measures 11,172 bytes**, stating verbatim **"Audit of Indian financial namespace TLDs. Daily probes of `.bank.in`, `.fin.in`, `.insurance.in`, `.nbfc.in`, `.npci.in`, and the global `.bank` gTLD — DNS resolution, HTTPS reachability, status codes, page titles, and final URLs."** — **i.e. daily probing of DNS resolution, HTTPS reachability, status codes, page titles and final URLs across these namespaces**. ⭐ **Three key figures are given verbatim as README badges**: **License: CC0-1.0**, **Updated Daily** and **Entries 4,199**; **with format badges for CSV, JSONL, Parquet and SQLite**; **a "Built with Zo" badge is also measurable**. ⭐ **The README states verbatim why it exists**: **"`.bank.in` is the de-facto namespace for Indian banking web presences, but no authoritative registry publishes a subdomain list. This audit discovers and [monitors]"** — **i.e. `.bank.in` is the de-facto namespace for Indian banking web presences, yet no authoritative registry publishes its subdomain list, so this audit discovers and continuously monitors it**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "No authoritative registry publishes a list, so it must be measured continuously" is the round’s most methodologically valuable point** — **a solution to the common predicament of having no official roster: do not guess and do not cite a second-hand list, but probe daily and publish the results**; **for actuarial and insurance students this pattern transfers widely** (**for example, "which institutions really offer a given product" or "which regulator pages are really reachable" — and every entry on the site this entry lives on was built by exactly this kind of repeated measurement**). **② ⭐⭐ `.insurance.in` appears directly in the probed scope** — **an Indian namespace for insurance-industry web presences, listed alongside `.bank.in`, `.nbfc.in` (non-banking financial companies) and `.npci.in` (National Payments Corporation of India)**; **for students of the Indian insurance market or financial supervision this is an infrastructure perspective the corpus lacked** (**readable with [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]], [[irdai-market-statistics]] and [[irdai-ai-governance]] — those are IRDAI’s rules, statistics and AI governance, whereas this adds whether those institutions’ web presences resolve and are reachable at all**; **"the regulator issued a document" and "the regulator’s site is actually alive" are two different things**). **③ ⭐⭐ Together, DNS resolution, HTTPS reachability, status codes, page titles and final URLs constitute a mechanised version of the verification workflow this site performs by hand** — **especially final URLs: where a redirect actually lands often differs from the nominal URL, the same risk class as the domain-level near-misses recurring in this project (round 310 `gfia.org`, round 317 `cios.org`)**; **this dataset makes "who does this domain actually point to" a daily routine measurement**. **④ ⭐ 4,199 entries across four formats (CSV, JSONL, Parquet, SQLite) make it directly analysable** — **covering tabular, streaming, columnar and query use cases** (**readable with [[open-risk-api]], [[risk-data-library-standard]] and [[cybrisk]]**). **⑤ ⭐ "Updated Daily" via GitHub Actions is a low-cost continuous-measurement architecture** — **the same family as [[daily-news-report]] and [[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]], which turn measurement into a pipeline instead of a one-off** (**the workflow file was not inspected, so its implementation is not restated**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The licence has conflicting sources, recorded side by side**: **the GitHub API measurably returns `NOASSERTION` (name `Other`)**, **while the README badge measurably reads `License: CC0-1.0`** — **the two disagree**; **the entry records both and advises checking the repository’s actual licence file and terms before reuse** (**asserting neither that it is CC0 nor that it is unusable**). **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, the full 11,172-byte README and the badge values and descriptions quoted verbatim**, ⭐ **but downloaded no data file, opened no record from the CSV, JSONL, Parquet or SQLite outputs, and did not visit its stated homepage `zo.pub/cashlessconsumer/bank-domains-status`**, so **its field definitions, the actual composition of the 4,199 entries, probe success rates and historical coverage cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐ "Entries 4,199" and "Updated Daily" are README badge self-reports**, **and neither the data files (to verify the count) nor the commit history (to verify daily updating) were checked**; **④ "no authoritative registry publishes a subdomain list" is the project’s own judgement** — **the entry does not claim it is independently confirmed** (**it is exactly the kind of institutional claim a reader should check**); **⑤ the collection method, the exact probing frequency and whether target sites’ access policies are respected were not verified**; **⑥ probed status codes and titles change over time**, **so no specific probe result is claimed to be current**; **⑦ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**; **⑧** this entry **does not claim the dataset covers every subdomain of these namespaces**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/CCAgentOrg/bank-in-domains` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (badge values checked verbatim); **no data was downloaded and its stated homepage was not visited**.

entries.summary: 一篇工作论文与配套代码：在「不完全市场 + 潜在高斯阈值因子 + 单参数指数倾斜」的结构选择框架下，Wang (2000) 变换被证明精确涌现；在 2,460 份已结算 Polymarket 合约上 MLE 校准得 λ=0.176，并在六平台 291,309 份合约上做跨平台验证；玩币平台 Manifold 的方向相反
entries.summary_en: A working paper with accompanying code: under a structural selection framework of incomplete markets, a latent Gaussian threshold factor and a maintained one-parameter exponential tilt, the Wang (2000) transform is shown to arise exactly; MLE calibration on 2,460 resolved Polymarket contracts gives lambda = 0.176, validated across 291,309 contracts from six platforms, with the play-money platform Manifold showing the opposite sign
entries.summary_hk: 一篇工作論文與配套代碼：在「不完全市場＋潛在高斯閾值因子＋單參數指數傾斜」的結構選擇框架下，Wang (2000) 變換被證明精確湧現；在 2,460 份已結算 Polymarket 合約上 MLE 校準得 λ=0.176，並在六平台 291,309 份合約上做跨平台驗證；玩幣平台 Manifold 的方向相反
entries.body:
**prediction-market-pricing** 是一篇工作论文与其配套代码（仓库 `YichengYang-Ethan/prediction-market-pricing`），**MIT 许可，实测 ★8、主语言 Python、仓库体量 29,205 KB、创建于 2026-03-26、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**其 topics 逐字实测为 actuarial-science、favorite-longshot-bias、financial-economics、kalshi、maximum-likelihood、polymarket、prediction-markets、python、risk-premium、wang-transform**。本条目属于本轮主题**「可核实性的四种做法」**中的**第四种：靠可检验的模型（model）****。

⭐ **为什么这一条对本词条所在站点特别重要**：**实测池内 `wang transform` 命中 0、`prediction market` 命中 0**——**即**精算扭曲定价**与**预测市场**这两个概念此前在语料中都没有入口，而本条目是两者的**交点****。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，8,957 字节**）：**标题逐字为「Pricing Prediction Markets: Incomplete Markets, Selection Rules, and Risk Premia」**；**作者 Yicheng Yang，University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign**；⭐ **自述为「Working Paper -- April 2026」，并给出 SSRN 预印本编号 6468338 与作者博客**。**摘要要点逐字实测**：**① 预测市场合约是「写在现实世界事件上的二元或有权益，其payoff 一般不被可交易资产张成（whose payoffs are generally not spanned by traded assets）」**；**② 在这类不完全市场中「no-arbitrage determines a set of admissible pricing measures rather than a unique price」——无套利只决定一族可采纳的定价测度，而非唯一价格**；**③ 论文提出一个**结构选择框架**：在潜在高斯阈值因子（latent Gaussian threshold factor）与「maintained one-parameter exponential tilt」之下，⭐ **「the Wang (2000) transform arises exactly」——Wang 变换精确涌现**，并给出逐字公式 **p_mkt = Φ(Φ⁻¹(p*) + λ)**；**④ 校准实测值：在 2,460 份已结算 Polymarket 合约上得 λ̂_MLE = 0.176（p < 10⁻¹⁰）**；**⑤ 跨平台验证实测值：N = 291,309 份合约，来自六个平台（Polymarket、Kalshi、Metaculus、Good Judgment Open、INFER、Manifold）**，**「a positive, significant λ on all real-money platforms（所有真金平台 λ 显著为正），pooled λ̂ = 0.183」**，**而「the play-money platform Manifold exhibits λ̂ < 0, consistent with overconfidence absent financial stakes（玩币平台 Manifold 的 λ̂ 为负，与「无财务利害时过度自信」一致）」**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「Wang 变换精确涌现」是本轮最有智识价值的一条**——**Wang（2000）变换是**精算扭曲定价（distortion pricing）**的核心工具之一，原本用于保险风险加载**；**这里它由一个关于「市场如何从可行测度集中选出一个」的结构假设**推导出来**，而不是被硬套上去**；**对精算学生，这是「精算方法不是保险专属，它是一种处理不完全市场与风险溢价的一般工具」的一个可检验实例**（**可与池内 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[insurance-dro]]、[[insurance-quantile]] 并读——**那三条处理的是扭曲/风险度量在保险与巨灾证券上的用法，而本条把它推到**事件合约**这一完全不同的标的****）。**② ⭐⭐ 「无套利只给出一族测度而非唯一价格」这一出发点值得单独记一笔**——**它把「价格是怎么被选出来的」变成显式的研究对象（故称**选择规则 selection rules**）**；**这与池内 [[nelson-siegel-svensson]] 之类的曲线拟合不同：**后者是描述，前者是解释「为什么是这个价格」****（**本次未读论文正文，故不转述其选择规则的具体形式与识别条件**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 玩币平台 λ̂ 为负这一对照是本条最有说服力的设计**——**同一模型在有财务利害与无财务利害两类市场上给出方向相反的参数**，**这比「本模型拟合良好」有力得多，因为它给出了一个**可被证伪的差异化预测****；**可与池内 [[insurance-fairness]]、[[insurance-calibration]] 所代表的「模型诊断」传统并读**（**本次未读论文，故不转述该结论的稳健性检验**）。**④ ⭐ 「favorite-longshot-bias」被列入 topics，说明本文与博彩/预测文献中一个经典偏差相接**——**该偏差在精算语言里接近「对低概率事件的定价偏离」**（**本次未核实两者的对应关系，故词条内不作等同**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ 本条同时是本轮主题的**反面提醒****——**它自带一个工作论文最典型的弱点：**未经同行评审、数字由作者自报、本次亦未独立复现****；**故本词条明确不主张其结论已被检验成立**（**见下方标注**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⭐⭐ 这是**工作论文（Working Paper，2026 年 4 月）**，作者自述如此，**未见同行评审记录**——**本词条不主张其结论已被学界检验或接受**；**② ⭐ 全部数值（λ̂_MLE = 0.176、p < 10⁻¹⁰、N = 291,309、pooled λ̂ = 0.183、六平台名单、Manifold 的 λ̂ < 0）均为**README 摘要中作者自报值****——**本次未下载论文、未读正文、未读代码、未复现任何校准**，**故词条内一律以「论文自述／实测于 README」的方式转述，不当作已核实事实**；**③** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据（★8、MIT、Python、29,205 KB、创建与推送时间）、topics 十项、以及 README（8,957 字节）的标题、作者、机构、SSRN 编号与摘要要点**，**未打开 SSRN 预印本、未访问作者博客、未克隆仓库、未运行代码、未查看数据来源与许可条款**；**④ 「payoffs are generally not spanned by traded assets」是对预测市场合约性质的理论判断**，**本词条不主张其在所有司法辖区与所有合约类型下成立**；**⑤ ⭐ 涉及 Polymarket、Kalshi 等平台的数据采集与使用是否合规、数据集是否公开可分发本次均未核实**（**词条内因此不主张其数据可复用**）；**⑥ 「λ」的经济含义与「favorite-longshot-bias」的对应关系本次未核实**，**词条内仅并列两词不下等同结论**；**⑦ ★8 说明关注度较低**，**不主张该研究的影响力或引用情况**；**⑧ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑨** 本词条**不主张**该仓库提供可直接用于保险定价的生产级工具**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/YichengYang-Ethan/prediction-market-pricing` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 摘要段逐字核对）；**未打开预印本、未克隆、未运行代码、未复现校准**。

**prediction-market-pricing** is a working paper with accompanying code (repository `YichengYang-Ethan/prediction-market-pricing`), **MIT licensed, with measured ★8, Python as the primary language, a 29,205 KB repository, created 2026-03-26 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **its topics measurably read actuarial-science, favorite-longshot-bias, financial-economics, kalshi, maximum-likelihood, polymarket, prediction-markets, python, risk-premium and wang-transform**. It belongs to the fourth of this round’s four approaches to verifiability: **relying on a testable model**.

⭐ **Why this matters especially for the site this entry lives on**: **the corpus measurably returns 0 hits for `wang transform` and 0 for `prediction market`** — **neither actuarial distortion pricing nor prediction markets had an entry point, and this entry is their intersection**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 8,957-byte README**): the **title reads verbatim "Pricing Prediction Markets: Incomplete Markets, Selection Rules, and Risk Premia"**; the **author is Yicheng Yang, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign**; ⭐ **it self-describes as "Working Paper -- April 2026" and gives an SSRN preprint number, 6468338, plus the author’s blog**. **Abstract points read verbatim**: **① prediction market contracts are "binary contingent claims written on real-world events whose payoffs are generally not spanned by traded assets"**; **② in such incomplete markets "no-arbitrage determines a set of admissible pricing measures rather than a unique price"**; **③ the paper proposes a structural selection framework: under a latent Gaussian threshold factor and "a maintained one-parameter exponential tilt", ⭐ "the Wang (2000) transform arises exactly", with the formula given verbatim as p_mkt = Φ(Φ⁻¹(p*) + λ)**; **④ measured calibration: on 2,460 resolved Polymarket contracts, λ̂_MLE = 0.176 (p < 10⁻¹⁰)**; **⑤ measured cross-platform validation: N = 291,309 contracts from six platforms (Polymarket, Kalshi, Metaculus, Good Judgment Open, INFER, Manifold)**, **"a positive, significant λ on all real-money platforms", pooled λ̂ = 0.183**, **while "the play-money platform Manifold exhibits λ̂ < 0, consistent with overconfidence absent financial stakes"**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "The Wang transform arises exactly" is the round’s most intellectually valuable point** — **the Wang (2000) transform is a core tool of actuarial distortion pricing, originally used for insurance risk loading**; **here it is derived from a structural assumption about how a market selects one measure from the admissible set, rather than imposed**; **for actuarial students this is a testable instance of "actuarial methods are not insurance-specific but a general way of handling incomplete markets and risk premia"** (**readable with [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[insurance-dro]] and [[insurance-quantile]] — those handle distortion and risk measures on insurance and catastrophe securities, whereas this pushes it onto event contracts, a completely different underlying**). **② ⭐⭐ The starting point that no-arbitrage yields a family of measures rather than a unique price deserves separate note** — **it makes "how was the price selected" an explicit object of study, hence selection rules**; **unlike curve fitting such as [[nelson-siegel-svensson]], which describes, this explains why the price is what it is** (**the paper body was not read, so its selection rule and identification conditions are not restated**). **③ ⭐⭐ The negative λ̂ on the play-money platform is the most persuasive design choice here** — **the same model yields an opposite-signed parameter on markets with and without financial stakes**, **far stronger than "the model fits well", because it yields a falsifiable differential prediction**; **readable with the model-diagnostics tradition of [[insurance-fairness]] and [[insurance-calibration]]** (**the paper was not read, so robustness checks are not restated**). **④ ⭐ "favorite-longshot-bias" among the topics connects the paper to a classic bias in the betting and forecasting literature** — **in actuarial language this is close to mispricing of low-probability events** (**the correspondence was not verified, so the entry does not equate them**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ This entry is also the round’s counter-warning** — **it carries the archetypal weakness of a working paper: not peer reviewed, numbers self-reported, and not independently reproduced here**; **the entry therefore explicitly does not claim its conclusions have been validated** (**see below**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⭐⭐ This is a working paper (April 2026), self-described as such, with no peer-review record found** — **the entry does not claim its conclusions have been examined or accepted by the field**; **② ⭐ All figures (λ̂_MLE = 0.176, p < 10⁻¹⁰, N = 291,309, pooled λ̂ = 0.183, the six platforms, Manifold’s λ̂ < 0) are the author’s self-reported values in the README abstract** — **no paper was downloaded, no body read, no code read, no calibration reproduced**, **so the entry reports them as stated in the README and does not treat them as verified fact**; **③** this check verified **the repository metadata (★8, MIT, Python, 29,205 KB, creation and push dates), ten topics, and the README’s 8,957 bytes in respect of its title, author, institution, SSRN number and abstract points**, **but did not open the SSRN preprint, visit the author’s blog, clone the repository, run the code, or inspect the data sources and licence terms**; **④ "payoffs are generally not spanned by traded assets" is a theoretical judgement about prediction-market contracts**, **and the entry does not claim it holds in all jurisdictions or contract types**; **⑤ ⭐ Whether data collection and use involving Polymarket, Kalshi and similar platforms is compliant, and whether the dataset is public and redistributable, were not verified** (**so no data reuse is claimed**); **⑥ the economic meaning of λ and its correspondence to favorite-longshot bias were not verified**, **and the entry merely juxtaposes the two**; **⑦ ★8 indicates relatively low attention**, **and no influence or citation record is claimed**; **⑧ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**; **⑨** this entry **does not claim the repository provides a production-grade tool for insurance pricing**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/YichengYang-Ethan/prediction-market-pricing` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the abstract section checked verbatim); **no preprint opened, nothing cloned, no code run, no calibration reproduced**.

entries.body:
**insurance-content-growth（产品名「极峰 · 保智｜AI顾问」，英文名 JIFENG INSURE AI）** 是一个**面向中国保险销售端的 Agent 技能**，**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言未标注、仓库体量 63 KB、创建于 2026-09-08、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「Agent 技能里的证据自觉」**中的**第一种：把证据做成**前置关卡****。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，9,021 字节**）：**README 首两行为逐字标题「极峰 · 保智｜AI顾问」与「JIFENG INSURE AI」**；**逐字定位**：**「面向中国保险代理人和团队的场景化内容助手。」**；⭐⭐ **其逐字说明最精炼地道出了保险内容生产的真正难点**：**「把「我想讲保险」变成「客户在这个生活瞬间会想听什么」，再交给剪映数字人和豆包完成视频。」**——**即它把「代理人想讲什么」重写成「客户此刻想听什么」，再接上剪映（数字人）与豆包完成视频生产**。**元信息逐字实测**：**安装标识 `insurance-content-growth`**；**适用对象为保险代理人、经纪人、团队主管、机构自媒体运营者**；**当前小版本 `v0.2.0`，自述为「7 天 AI 新时代代理人实验模块」**。⭐ **六项能力逐字实测**：**场景化口播稿 · 客户经营 · AI 陪练 · 7 天训练营 · 剪映/豆包生产包 · 合规预审**。**章节结构逐字实测**：**为什么是"极峰 · 保智" / v0.2.0 新增什么 / 原有内容生产能力 / 推荐工作流 / 7 天训练营工作流 / 安装 / 第一次怎么用 / ⭐需要配合的工具 / 使用优势 / 新时代代理人为什么要拥抱 AI / 建议的进阶配置 / ⭐重要边界 / 目录**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「合规预审」被列为六项能力之一，是本条目最值得注意的一点**——**保险销售内容在中国受严格监管（销售误导、承诺收益、贬低同业等都是高压线），而该技能把合规判断放在内容产出的**同一流程内**，而不是事后补救**；**对在香港或内地做保险销售/合规方向的学生，这是一个可直接观察的「AI 如何嵌入受监管业务流程」样本**（**可与池内 [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]、[[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]、[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]] 并读——**那三条讲监管要求与 AI 治理规则，而本条是**规则落到具体产出口的前置关卡****）。**② ⭐⭐ 「需要配合的工具」单设一节，是一种值得称赞的**依赖披露****——**该技能并不假装自足：它依赖剪映与豆包等外部工具**；**这与本轮另三条目（尤其 [[powmcp-skills]] 的「无脚本、自身不发网络请求」声明）同属一种做法：**把「我不做什么、我靠什么」写清楚****（**本次未读该节正文，故不转述其具体工具清单与配置方式**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「重要边界」单设一节同理**——**一个面向销售端的 AI 技能主动写出自己的边界，直接对应保险业最真实的合规风险：**AI 生成的话术一旦越过销售误导的线，责任在谁****（**⚠️ 本次未读该节正文，故不转述其自述边界的具体内容；本条目不主张该技能具备任何合规保证**）。**④ ⭐ 「7 天训练营」与「AI 陪练」说明它同时是**培训工具**而非仅内容工具**——**可与池内 [[open-exam-prep]]、[[insurance-agent-trainer]] 所代表的备考/陪练形态并读**：**后者面向考试与代理人训练，本条把陪练与内容生产合成一条流水线**（**本次未打开其工作流章节，故不转述训练营安排**）。**⑤ ⭐ 「建议的进阶配置」暗示其存在分层的使用深度**（**本次未读，故不转述**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件**（GitHub API 返回 `NONE`）**——**本词条据此明确记录，并提示：使用、修改或分发其技能内容前应自行确认授权状况**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据与 README 全文（9,021 字节）的标题、定位语句、元信息、六项能力与章节结构**，⭐ **但未安装该技能、未在任何 Agent 客户端中运行、未打开 SKILL.md 正文、未读「重要边界」「需要配合的工具」「推荐工作流」「7 天训练营工作流」等章节正文**，因此**不能转述其合规预审的具体规则、口播稿产出形式、工作流步骤、依赖工具清单或自述边界内容**；**③ ⭐⭐ 「合规预审」的具体做法与效力本次完全未核实**——**本条目**不主张**该技能能替代合规审查、也不主张其预审结论具有任何法律或监管效力**；**④ ★0、fork 0 说明关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、有效性或已被代理人实际采用**；**⑤ 该技能与剪映、豆包等外部服务的绑定程度、是否需要付费账号本次未核实**；**⑥ 「7 天 AI 新时代代理人实验模块」为**自述定位****，**其课程/实验内容本次未核实**；**⑦ 该技能是否遵守中国关于保险销售宣传的监管要求、其产出是否可直接对外使用，本次未核实，本词条不作任何合规判断**；**⑧ 没有中文材料之外的语言版本这一情况未核实**（**README 实测为简体中文，未核实是否有英文或繁体版本**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/kevin8634/insurance-content-growth` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 9,021 字节，标题与关键语句逐字核对）；**未安装、未运行、未打开技能正文**。
entries.body_en:
**insurance-content-growth** (product name **JIFENG INSURE AI**) is an **agent Skill aimed at the Chinese insurance sales side**, with **measured ★0, 0 forks, no declared primary language, a 63 KB repository, created 2026-09-08 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file at all (`NONE`)**. It belongs to the first of this round’s four ways agent Skills handle evidence: **making evidence a pre-gate**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 9,021-byte README**): the **README opens with the measured title lines "极峰 · 保智｜AI顾问" and "JIFENG INSURE AI"**; it **states verbatim**: **"面向中国保险代理人和团队的场景化内容助手。"**; ⭐⭐ **its most incisive line, read verbatim, captures the real difficulty of insurance content production**: **"把「我想讲保险」变成「客户在这个生活瞬间会想听什么」，再交给剪映数字人和豆包完成视频。"** — **i.e. it rewrites "what the agent wants to say" into "what the client wants to hear at this moment", then hands off to CapCut digital humans and Doubao to finish the video**. **Measured metadata**: the **install identifier is `insurance-content-growth`**; the **audience is insurance agents, brokers, team leads and institutional self-media operators**; the **current minor version is `v0.2.0`, self-described as a seven-day experimental module for the new-era agent**. ⭐ **Six capabilities read verbatim**: **scenario scripts, client development, AI sparring, a seven-day bootcamp, a CapCut/Doubao production pack, and compliance pre-review**. **Section headings read verbatim**: **why this product / what v0.2.0 adds / existing content-production capability / recommended workflow / seven-day bootcamp workflow / installation / first use / ⭐ required tools / advantages / why new-era agents should embrace AI / suggested advanced configuration / ⭐ important boundaries / contents**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ That compliance pre-review is one of the six capabilities is the entry’s most notable point** — **insurance sales content is tightly regulated in China (mis-selling, promising returns and disparaging competitors are all red lines), and this Skill puts compliance judgement inside the same production flow rather than patching it afterwards**; **for students heading into insurance sales or compliance in Hong Kong or the mainland, it is a directly observable sample of AI being embedded in a regulated business process** (**readable with [[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]], [[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]] and [[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]] — those describe regulatory requirements and AI governance rules, whereas this is a gate placed in front of a concrete deliverable**). **② ⭐⭐ A dedicated "required tools" section is a commendable dependency disclosure** — **the Skill does not pretend to be self-contained: it depends on external tools such as CapCut and Doubao**; **the same practice as [[powmcp-skills]]’ declaration that its Skills carry no scripts and make no network calls: state plainly what you do not do and what you rely on** (**that section was not read, so no tool list or configuration is restated**). **③ ⭐⭐ An "important boundaries" section follows the same logic** — **an AI Skill aimed at the sales side volunteering its own limits speaks directly to the real compliance risk in insurance: if AI-generated wording crosses into mis-selling, who is responsible?** (**⚠️ that section’s body was not read, so its self-stated boundaries are not restated; the entry claims no compliance guarantee whatsoever**). **④ ⭐ The seven-day bootcamp and AI sparring show it is also a training tool, not only a content tool** — **readable with the exam-prep and sparring forms of [[open-exam-prep]] and [[insurance-agent-trainer]], which face exams and agent training, whereas this merges sparring with content production into one pipeline** (**the workflow sections were not opened, so the bootcamp schedule is not restated**). **⑤ ⭐ A "suggested advanced configuration" section implies tiered depth of use** (**not read**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file** (**the GitHub API returns `NONE`**) — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before using, modifying or redistributing its Skill content**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata and the README’s 9,021 bytes in respect of its titles, positioning statement, metadata, six capabilities and section structure**, ⭐ **but did not install the Skill, run it in any agent client, open SKILL.md, or read the bodies of "important boundaries", "required tools", "recommended workflow" or the bootcamp workflow**, so **its compliance pre-review rules, script output format, workflow steps, dependency list and self-stated boundaries cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐ What the compliance pre-review actually does, and how effective it is, were not verified at all** — **the entry claims neither that it can replace compliance review nor that its conclusions carry any legal or regulatory force**; **④ ★0 and 0 forks indicate extremely low attention**, **so no maturity, effectiveness or real adoption by agents is claimed**; **⑤ how tightly it binds to CapCut, Doubao and similar services, and whether paid accounts are needed, were not verified**; **⑥ "seven-day experimental module for the new-era agent" is a self-description**, **and its course content was not verified**; **⑦ whether the Skill complies with Chinese rules on insurance sales promotion, and whether its output can be used externally, were not verified, and the entry makes no compliance judgement**; **⑧ whether any language version other than Chinese exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is Simplified Chinese; English or Traditional Chinese versions were not checked**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/kevin8634/insurance-content-growth` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 9,021-byte README with titles and key sentences checked verbatim); **not installed, not run, Skill body not opened**.

entries.summary: 一个把「已购保单」整理成可检视事实的技能：以保单、批单、缴费与理赔文件为证据，检视保障覆盖、重复、资料缺口、保费负担与保单有效性风险；输出分三层——可确认的保障、证据来源、待核实事项；并附一个 Python 标准库实现的本地 stdio MCP 服务（14 个工具）
entries.summary_en: A Skill that turns existing policies into reviewable facts, using policy, endorsement, payment and claims documents as evidence to examine cover, duplication, information gaps, premium burden and policy-validity risk; it outputs in three tiers — confirmed cover, evidence sources and items still to verify — and ships a local stdio MCP server built on the Python standard library with 14 tools

**insurance-review** 是一个**面向个人与家庭的「已购保单整理与保障检视」Agent 技能**，**实测 ★1、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 47 KB、创建于 2026-09-08、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**其 topics 逐字实测为 coverage-gaps、insurance、mcp、policy-review、skill、skills**；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「Agent 技能里的证据自觉」**中的**第二种：把每个结论落回文件证据上****。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，3,467 字节**）：**README 首行为逐字标题「已购保险整理与保障检视」**；**逐字功能描述**：**「整理个人或家庭已购保单，以文件证据检视保障覆盖、重复、资料缺口、保费负担与保单有效性风险。本仓库包含技能指令和可选的本地保险档案 MCP 服务。」**——**即它以**文件证据**为方法，检视五件事：保障覆盖、重复、资料缺口、保费负担、保单有效性风险**。**仓库内容逐字实测四项**：**`SKILL.md`（技能入口与工作流程）**；**`references/`（字段模型、检视方法、报告模板和长期档案接口约定）**；**`agents/openai.yaml`（技能显示名称与默认提示词）**；**`insurance-mcp/`（Python 标准库实现的本地 stdio MCP 服务，版本 0.2.0，提供 14 个工具）**。⭐⭐ **用法示例逐字实测，且这句话本身就是本条目最值得注意的地方**：**「使用 insurance-review 整理我提供的已购保险资料，列出**可确认的保障、证据来源和待核实事项**。」**——**即它要求输出分成三层：**① 可确认的保障 ② 证据来源 ③ 待核实事项****。**环境与隐私要求逐字实测**：**仅做文件分析时无需 MCP**；**启用 MCP 需 Python 3.9 或更高版本、无需安装第三方 Python 包**；⚠️ **「当前代码与测试使用 POSIX 文件权限接口，面向 macOS/Linux；Windows 尚未验证，建议在 WSL 中使用」**；**环境变量 `INSURANCE_MCP_DB` 须指向「仓库以外的私有数据库文件路径」**，**并提供 TOML 配置示例，需替换其中两个 `/ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/...` 占位路径**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「可确认的保障／证据来源／待核实事项」这一三层输出，正是**本词条所在站点的核实分层纪律被应用到个人保单上****——**多数保险分析工具只给结论，而这里要求每个结论都标明它来自哪份文件、哪些还没核实**；**对精算与保险学生，这是一个可直接借用的报告结构**（**可与池内 [[contract-gap-overlap-benchmark]] 的合同缺口/重叠基准、[[policy-explainer-ai]] 的保单解释、[[insurance-recommendation-engine]] 的推荐引擎并读——**那三条分别做基准、解释与推荐，而本条补的是**「以你手里的文件为准」的检视纪律****）。**② ⭐⭐ 「重复」与「资料缺口」被并列为检视对象，指向一个真实的消费痛点**——**多数家庭的保单是分散、跨年代、跨公司买的，**重复投保与保障缺口往往同时存在****；**这与池内 [[insurance-fairness]]、[[insurance-thin-data]] 关注的市场层面不同：本条是**家庭层面的事实重建****（**本次未运行，故不转述其检视方法细节**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 隐私设计是本条目的工程亮点**——**本地 stdio MCP ＋ 数据库文件放在仓库之外 ＋ 仅用 Python 标准库（无第三方包）**，**三点合起来意味着保单资料不必离开本机**；**对处理真实保单/健康信息的场景，这是恰当的默认**（**可与池内 [[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[bima-mcp]] 并读——**那些是行业内 MCP，本条是**个人数据侧 MCP，且明确把数据库放在仓库外****）。**④ ⭐ ⚠️ 「Windows 尚未验证，建议在 WSL 中使用」是一条难得具体的平台限制披露**——**它说明作者确实在 POSIX 文件权限接口上测试过并知道边界**（**本词条如实转述，不主张其在 Windows 上不可用，只主张作者自述未验证**）。**⑤ ⭐ `references/` 中「长期档案接口约定」提示它设计了**跨会话的档案延续****——**README 亦说明「需要跨会话维护保单事实、文件登记、证据与变更历史时」才需启用 MCP**，**即文件分析与长期档案维护被分成两层**（**本次未读 references/ 内容，故不转述其接口约定**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件**（GitHub API 返回 `NONE`）**——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用或再分发前应自行确认授权状况**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics 六项与 README 全文（3,467 字节）的功能描述、四项仓库内容、用法示例、环境与隐私要求**，⭐ **但未安装、未运行、未打开 SKILL.md、未读 references/ 任何文件、未启用或测试其 MCP 服务、未查看 14 个工具的名称与职责**，因此**不能转述其字段模型、检视方法、报告模板、档案接口约定或工具清单**；**③ ⭐ 「14 个工具」为**README 自述值****，**本次未列出或核实其名称与功能**；**④ ⭐ 「以文件证据检视」是**方法自述**，**其检视结论的可靠性与实际效果本次未核实**——**本条目**不主张**该技能能替代持牌顾问意见或保险公司的正式核定**；**⑤ ★1、fork 0 说明关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度或已被使用**；**⑥ 「面向 macOS/Linux、Windows 未验证」为**作者自述**，**不主张其在 Windows 上无法使用**；**⑦ 处理真实保单数据时的合规与隐私责任（本地存储、备份、多用户共用机器等）本次未评估**；**⑧ 是否有中文之外的语言版本本次未核实**（**README 实测为简体中文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Yilei7/insurance-review` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 3,467 字节，逐字核对）；**未安装、未运行、未打开技能与 MCP 源码**。
entries.body_en:
**insurance-review** is an agent Skill for **organising and reviewing a household’s existing insurance policies**, with **measured ★1, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 47 KB repository, created 2026-09-08 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **its topics measurably read coverage-gaps, insurance, mcp, policy-review, skill and skills**; **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`)**. It belongs to the second of this round’s four ways agent Skills handle evidence: **tying every conclusion back to documentary evidence**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 3,467-byte README**): the **README’s first line is the measured title "已购保险整理与保障检视"**; the **functional description reads verbatim**: **"整理个人或家庭已购保单，以文件证据检视保障覆盖、重复、资料缺口、保费负担与保单有效性风险。本仓库包含技能指令和可选的本地保险档案 MCP 服务。"** — **i.e. it uses documentary evidence to examine five things: cover, duplication, information gaps, premium burden and policy-validity risk**. **Four repository contents read verbatim**: **`SKILL.md` (the Skill entry point and workflow)**; **`references/` (field model, review method, report template and long-term archive interface conventions)**; **`agents/openai.yaml` (display name and default prompt)**; and **`insurance-mcp/` (a local stdio MCP server built on the Python standard library, version 0.2.0, providing 14 tools)**. ⭐⭐ **The usage example is quoted verbatim and is itself the entry’s most notable feature**: **"使用 insurance-review 整理我提供的已购保险资料，列出可确认的保障、证据来源和待核实事项。"** — **it requires output in three tiers: ① confirmed cover, ② evidence sources, ③ items still to verify**. **Environment and privacy requirements read verbatim**: **file analysis alone needs no MCP**; **the MCP needs Python 3.9 or higher and no third-party packages**; ⚠️ **"the current code and tests use POSIX file-permission interfaces, targeting macOS/Linux; Windows is not yet verified and WSL is recommended"**; and the **`INSURANCE_MCP_DB` environment variable must point to a private database file outside the repository**, **with a TOML example requiring two `/ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/...` placeholders to be replaced**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ That three-tier output — confirmed cover, evidence source, items to verify — is precisely the verification-tiering discipline of the site this entry lives on, applied to household policies** — **most insurance analysis tools return conclusions, whereas this requires each conclusion to state which document it came from and what remains unverified**; **a directly borrowable report structure for actuarial and insurance students** (**readable with [[contract-gap-overlap-benchmark]], [[policy-explainer-ai]] and [[insurance-recommendation-engine]] — those do benchmarking, explanation and recommendation, while this adds the discipline of "your own documents are the standard"**). **② ⭐⭐ Duplication and information gaps as parallel review targets point at a real consumer pain point** — **most households hold policies bought across different years and companies, so double cover and coverage gaps often coexist**; **unlike the market-level concerns of [[insurance-fairness]] and [[insurance-thin-data]], this is fact reconstruction at the household level** (**not run, so no method detail is restated**). **③ ⭐⭐ Privacy design is the engineering highlight** — **a local stdio MCP, a database file outside the repository, and Python standard library only (no third-party packages)** together mean **policy data need not leave the machine**; **an appropriate default when handling real policy or health information** (**readable with [[insurance-ai-mcp]], [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] and [[bima-mcp]] — those are industry-side MCPs, whereas this is a personal-data-side MCP that explicitly keeps its database outside the repository**). **④ ⭐ ⚠️ "Windows not yet verified, WSL recommended" is an unusually specific platform limitation** — **it suggests the author really tested on POSIX file-permission interfaces and knows the boundary** (**the entry restates this and does not claim it fails on Windows, only that the author says it is unverified**). **⑤ ⭐ The "long-term archive interface conventions" in `references/` imply cross-session archive continuity** — **the README also says the MCP is needed only "when policy facts, document registers, evidence and change history must be maintained across sessions"**, **splitting file analysis from long-term archive maintenance into two layers** (**`references/` was not read, so those conventions are not restated**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file** (**the GitHub API returns `NONE`**) — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before use or redistribution**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, six topics, and the README’s 3,467 bytes in respect of its functional description, four repository contents, usage example, and environment and privacy requirements**, ⭐ **but did not install or run it, open SKILL.md, read any file under `references/`, start or test its MCP server, or inspect the names and duties of the 14 tools**, so **its field model, review method, report template, archive conventions and tool list cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐ "14 tools" is a README self-report**, **and neither their names nor their functions were listed or verified**; **④ ⭐ "reviewing against documentary evidence" is a methodological self-description**, **and the reliability and real-world effectiveness of its conclusions were not verified** — **the entry claims neither that it can replace a licensed adviser nor that it substitutes for an insurer’s formal assessment**; **⑤ ★1 and 0 forks indicate extremely low attention**, **so no maturity or adoption is claimed**; **⑥ "targeting macOS/Linux, Windows unverified" is the author’s own statement**, **and no claim is made that it fails on Windows**; **⑦ the compliance and privacy responsibilities of handling real policy data (local storage, backups, shared machines) were not assessed**; **⑧ whether any language version other than Chinese exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is Simplified Chinese**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Yilei7/insurance-review` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 3,467-byte README checked verbatim); **not installed, not run, Skill and MCP source not opened**.

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測，3,467 位元組**）：**README 首行為逐字標題「已購保險整理與保障檢視」**；**逐字功能描述**：**「整理個人或家庭已購保單，以文件證據檢視保障覆蓋、重複、資料缺口、保費負擔與保單有效性風險。本倉庫包含技能指令和可選的本地保險檔案 MCP 服務。」**。**倉庫內容逐字實測四項**：**`SKILL.md`／`references/`（欄位模型、檢視方法、報告模板和長期檔案接口約定）／`agents/openai.yaml`／`insurance-mcp/`（Python 標準庫實現的本地 stdio MCP 服務，版本 0.2.0，提供 14 個工具）**。⭐⭐ **用法示例逐字實測**：**「使用 insurance-review 整理我提供的已購保險資料，列出**可確認的保障、證據來源和待核實事項**。」**——**即要求輸出分成三層****。**環境與隱私要求逐字實測**：**僅做文件分析時無需 MCP**；**啟用 MCP 需 Python 3.9 或更高、無需第三方套件**；⚠️ **「當前代碼與測試使用 POSIX 文件權限接口，面向 macOS/Linux；Windows 尚未驗證，建議在 WSL 中使用」**；**環境變數 `INSURANCE_MCP_DB` 須指向「倉庫以外的私有資料庫文件路徑」**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「可確認的保障／證據來源／待核實事項」這一三層輸出，正是**本站的核實分層紀律被應用到個人保單上****——**多數保險分析工具只給結論，而這裡要求每個結論都標明它來自哪份文件、哪些還沒核實**（可與 [[contract-gap-overlap-benchmark]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[insurance-recommendation-engine]] 並讀——**那三條分別做基準、解釋與推薦，而本條補的是**「以你手裡的文件為準」的檢視紀律****）。**② ⭐⭐ 「重複」與「資料缺口」並列為檢視對象，指向一個真實的消費痛點**——**多數家庭的保單是分散、跨年代、跨公司買的，**重複投保與保障缺口往往同時存在****。**③ ⭐⭐ 隱私設計是工程亮點**——**本地 stdio MCP ＋ 資料庫放在倉庫之外 ＋ 僅用 Python 標準庫**，**三點合起來意味著保單資料不必離開本機**（可與 [[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[bima-mcp]] 並讀——**那些是行業內 MCP，本條是**個人資料側 MCP，且明確把資料庫放在倉庫外****）。**④ ⭐ ⚠️ 「Windows 尚未驗證，建議在 WSL 中使用」是一條難得具體的平台限制披露**。**⑤ ⭐ `references/` 中「長期檔案接口約定」提示它設計了**跨會話的檔案延續****。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 該倉庫實測**無任何許可文件****——**明確記錄，並提示使用或再分發前應自行確認授權狀況**；**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、topics 六項與 README 全文（3,467 位元組）的功能描述、四項倉庫內容、用法示例、環境與隱私要求**，⭐ **但未安裝、未運行、未打開 SKILL.md、未讀 references/ 任何文件、未啟用或測試其 MCP 服務、未查看 14 個工具的名稱與職責**，故**不能轉述其欄位模型、檢視方法、報告模板、檔案接口約定或工具清單**；**③ ⭐ 「14 個工具」為 README 自述值，未列出或核實其名稱與功能**；**④ ⭐ 「以文件證據檢視」是方法自述**，**其結論的可靠性與實際效果未核實**——**不主張**其能替代持牌顧問意見或保險公司的正式核定**；**⑤ ★1、fork 0 說明關注度極低**；**⑥ 「面向 macOS/Linux、Windows 未驗證」為作者自述，不主張其在 Windows 上無法使用**；**⑦ 處理真實保單資料時的合規與隱私責任本次未評估**；**⑧ 是否有中文之外語言版本未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Yilei7/insurance-review` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未安裝、未運行、未打開技能與 MCP 源碼**。

entries.title: Thinking Framework Skills：把 63 个思维方法按证据强度诚实分级，并做成可执行、必产出具体成果的技能
entries.title_en: Thinking Framework Skills: 63 thinking methods graded honestly by evidence strength and shipped as executable Skills that must produce a concrete artifact
entries.title_hk: Thinking Framework Skills：把 63 個思維方法按證據強度誠實分級，並做成可執行、必產出具體成果的技能
entries.summary: 一个按证据强度诚实分级、可由智能体执行的思维方法技能库：63 个框架被拆到「工作机制」层，每个都标注其证据实际有多强，并要求产出一件具体成果而非一段文字；另含 4 个元技能与 9 个配方，适用于 Claude Code、Codex 等
entries.summary_en: An evidence-graded library of agent-executable thinking-method Skills: 63 frameworks reduced to their working mechanism, each labelled with how strong its evidence actually is, and required to produce a concrete artifact rather than prose; it also ships 4 meta-skills and 9 recipes for Claude Code, Codex and others
entries.summary_hk: 一個按證據強度誠實分級、可由智能體執行的思維方法技能庫：63 個框架被拆到「工作機制」層，每個都標註其證據實際有多強，並要求產出一件具體成果而非一段文字；另含 4 個元技能與 9 個配方，適用於 Claude Code、Codex 等
entries.body:
**Thinking Framework Skills** 是一个**按证据强度分级的思维方法 Agent 技能库**，**Apache-2.0 许可，实测 ★15、fork 1、主语言 JavaScript、仓库体量 3,550 KB、创建于 2026-05-17、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**其 topics 逐字实测达 20 项**，含 **evidence-based、critical-thinking、decision-making、mental-models、systems-thinking、reasoning、structured-thinking、cognitive-tools、agent-skills、claude-code、codex** 等（**其中 `product-managment` 为仓库自身拼写，照实记录**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「Agent 技能里的证据自觉」**中的**第三种：给方法本身分级****。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，55,505 字节**）：**README 逐字定位**：**「An evidence-graded library of agent-executable thinking-method skills.」**；⭐⭐ **其逐字承诺有三层**：**「Every method is reduced to its working mechanism, graded honestly on how strong its evidence actually is, and shipped as a skill that produces a concrete artifact, not prose.」**——**① 每个方法都被拆到**工作机制**层；② 按「其证据实际有多强」**诚实分级**；③ 交付为**产出具体成果而非一段文字**的技能**。**规模逐字实测**：**63 frameworks + 4 tools + 9 recipes**，**并自述为「Advanced (Gold) tier」**。⭐ **目录（catalog）逐字实测为 12 组、并带组内计数**：**Problem Framing（6）／Divergent Ideation（6）／Perspective & Multi-Lens（2）／Systems & Consequences（9）／Assumption & Belief Challenge（5）／Reasoning Clarity（5）／Decision & Option Evaluation（12）／Strategy & Opportunity（2）／Ethics & Values Deliberation（4）／⭐Risk & Resilience（4）／Synthesis（4）／Meta-Thinking & Reflection（4）**。**章节结构逐字实测**：**What this is / Quick start / ⭐What makes it different / The library at a glance / ⭐The evidence model / The catalog / Tools (meta-skills) / How a skill works / Recipes**；**并给出线上站点 `thinking-framework-skills.productonpurpose.com`**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「graded honestly on how strong its evidence actually is（按其证据实际有多强诚实分级）」是本轮最值得注意的一句话，也是它与本词条所在站点最深的共鸣**——**思维方法类内容最常见的失败是**把有趣等同于有效****：**「第一性原理」「六顶思考帽」听起来都好用，但背后证据强度差异极大**；**一个库主动把「证据有多强」做成字段，而不是把 63 个方法一律推销**，**这本身就是一种智力诚实**；**对精算与风险学生，这种「先分级再使用」的态度与精算里**按证据强弱区分方法与假设**是同一种纪律**（**⚠️ 本次未读「The evidence model」正文，故不转述其分级的具体档位、判据或每个框架的评级——这是本条最关键的未核实项**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「risk & resilience（风险与韧性）」被单列为一组、含 4 个方法，是本条与风险专业最直接的交集**——**加之「Decision & Option Evaluation」一组多达 12 个（全库最多）**，**说明该库的重心在**决策与风险****，**而非泛泛的头脑风暴**；**对需要做承保/定价/资本决策的学生，这是一份现成的「决策前该问哪些问题」清单**（**本次未打开任何具体框架页，故不转述其内容**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「produces a concrete artifact, not prose（产出具体成果而非一段文字）」是一条很硬的设计约束**——**它把「聊完之后什么也没留下」这一 AI 对话通病写成了反面要求**；**这与池内 [[phi-boundary-gate]] 的边界门控、[[ins-mmbench]] 的基准评测、以及同轮 [[powmcp-skills]] 的托管检查同属一种做法：**给产出设定可被指认的形态****。**④ ⭐ 「What makes it different」单设一节、而「The evidence model」单设一节**——**前者是差异化主张、后者是评级依据**，**把「宣传」与「依据」分开写**，**这在方法类项目里不常见**（**本次未读两节正文，故不转述其主张与依据**）。**⑤ ⭐ 「How a skill works」单设一节说明该库对**技能结构本身**有明确约定**（**本次未读，故不转述其结构约定**）。**⑥ ⭐ Apache-2.0 许可 + 明确的自述分级标准，使它成为本会话收集的 Agent 技能中**许可最清晰、且对自身证据强度最坦白**的一条**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⭐⭐ 本条目最关键的未核实项是**证据分级本身****——**本次只读到 README 的章节标题与三段定位语句，**未读「The evidence model」正文**，**故**不转述其分级档位、判据、评分方式，也不转述 63 个框架中任何一个的具体评级****；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics 20 项、README（55,505 字节）的定位语句、规模数字、12 组目录及组内计数与章节结构**，**未安装任何技能、未在 Agent 客户端运行、未打开任何具体框架文件、未访问其线上站点**，因此**不能转述任何框架的内容、适用条件或产出形态**；**③ ⭐ 「63 frameworks + 4 tools + 9 recipes」「12 组及组内计数」均为**README 自述值****，**本次未逐一点数核实**（**⚠️ 12 组计数相加为 63，与自述总数自洽，属算术核对而非独立核实**）；**④ ⭐ 「Advanced (Gold) tier」的分级来源与含义本次未核实**，**词条内仅作自述转述**；**⑤ 「graded honestly」中的「honestly」是**自我评价**，**本条目不主张其分级已获独立检验或学界认可**；**⑥ ★15 说明有一定关注度但不算高**，**不主张其被广泛采用或经专业验证**；**⑦ 「produce a concrete artifact」的实际执行效果、以及「reduced to its working mechanism」的还原是否准确，本次均未核实**；**⑧ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**本次未访问其线上站点**）；**⑨** 本词条**不主张**该库适用于保险精算监管场景下的决策**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/product-on-purpose/thinking-framework-skills` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 55,505 字节；本次只逐字读取其定位语句、规模数字、目录结构与章节标题，**未读各章节正文**）；**未安装、未运行、未打开任何框架文件、未访问线上站点**。
entries.body_en:
**Thinking Framework Skills** is an **evidence-graded library of thinking-method agent Skills**, **Apache-2.0 licensed, with measured ★15, 1 fork, JavaScript as the primary language, a 3,550 KB repository, created 2026-05-17 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **its topics measurably number 20**, including **evidence-based, critical-thinking, decision-making, mental-models, systems-thinking, reasoning, structured-thinking, cognitive-tools, agent-skills, claude-code and codex** (**of which `product-managment` is the repository’s own spelling, recorded as found**). It belongs to the third of this round’s four ways agent Skills handle evidence: **grading the methods themselves**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 55,505-byte README**): the **README positions it verbatim** as **"An evidence-graded library of agent-executable thinking-method skills."**; ⭐⭐ **its promise has three parts, verbatim**: **"Every method is reduced to its working mechanism, graded honestly on how strong its evidence actually is, and shipped as a skill that produces a concrete artifact, not prose."** — **① every method is reduced to its mechanism; ② graded honestly on how strong its evidence actually is; ③ shipped as a Skill that produces a concrete artifact rather than prose**. **Scale read verbatim**: **63 frameworks + 4 tools + 9 recipes**, **self-described as an "Advanced (Gold) tier"**. ⭐ **The catalog measurably has 12 groups with per-group counts**: **Problem Framing (6) / Divergent Ideation (6) / Perspective & Multi-Lens (2) / Systems & Consequences (9) / Assumption & Belief Challenge (5) / Reasoning Clarity (5) / Decision & Option Evaluation (12) / Strategy & Opportunity (2) / Ethics & Values Deliberation (4) / ⭐ Risk & Resilience (4) / Synthesis (4) / Meta-Thinking & Reflection (4)**. **Section headings read verbatim**: **What this is / Quick start / ⭐ What makes it different / The library at a glance / ⭐ The evidence model / The catalog / Tools (meta-skills) / How a skill works / Recipes**; **with a live site at `thinking-framework-skills.productonpurpose.com`**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "Graded honestly on how strong its evidence actually is" is the round’s most notable sentence and its deepest resonance with the site this entry lives on** — **the usual failure of thinking-method content is equating interesting with effective**: **first principles and six thinking hats all sound useful, yet the strength of evidence behind them varies enormously**; **a library that makes "how strong is the evidence" a field instead of uniformly promoting 63 methods is itself an act of intellectual honesty**; **for actuarial and risk students, grading before using is the same discipline as distinguishing methods and assumptions by evidential strength in actuarial work** (**⚠️ the "evidence model" body was not read, so its tiers, criteria and any individual framework rating are not restated — this is the entry’s most important unverified item**). **② ⭐⭐ "Risk & Resilience" as its own group of 4 is the most direct intersection with the risk profession** — **and with "Decision & Option Evaluation" having 12 items, the largest group of all, the library’s centre of gravity is decision and risk rather than generic brainstorming**; **for students making underwriting, pricing or capital decisions, a ready-made list of questions to ask before deciding** (**no framework page was opened, so none of their content is restated**). **③ ⭐⭐ "Produces a concrete artifact, not prose" is a hard design constraint** — **it writes the common AI-conversation failure of "nothing left behind after the chat" into a requirement’s negative**; **the same practice as the boundary gating of [[phi-boundary-gate]], the benchmark evaluation of [[ins-mmbench]] and the hosted checks of [[powmcp-skills]]: give the output a form that can be pointed at**. **④ ⭐ Having both "What makes it different" and "The evidence model" as separate sections** — **one the differentiation claim, the other the grading basis** — **separates marketing from grounds, which is uncommon among method libraries** (**neither body was read, so neither is restated**). **⑤ ⭐ "How a skill works" as its own section implies the library has explicit conventions for Skill structure itself** (**not read**). **⑥ ⭐ An Apache-2.0 licence plus a stated grading standard make this the clearest-licensed and most candid-about-its-own-evidence item among the agent Skills collected in this session**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⭐⭐ The entry’s most important unverified item is the grading itself** — **only the README section headings and three positioning sentences were read; the "evidence model" body was not** — **so its tiers, criteria and scoring, and the rating of any individual framework among the 63, are not restated**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, 20 topics, and the README’s 55,505 bytes in respect of positioning statements, scale figures, the 12-group catalog with counts, and section structure**, **but installed no Skill, ran nothing in an agent client, opened no framework file and did not visit its live site**, so **no framework’s content, applicability or output form can be restated**; **③ ⭐ "63 frameworks + 4 tools + 9 recipes" and the 12 group counts are README self-reports**, **not counted and verified here** (**⚠️ the 12 group counts sum to 63, which is arithmetic consistency with the stated total, not independent verification**); **④ ⭐ the origin and meaning of "Advanced (Gold) tier" were not verified**, **and the entry reports it only as a self-description**; **⑤ "Honestly" in "graded honestly" is a self-assessment**, **and the entry does not claim the grading has been independently examined or academically accepted**; **⑥ ★15 indicates moderate attention**, **so no claim of wide adoption or professional validation is made**; **⑦ the real-world effect of "produce a concrete artifact", and whether the reduction "to its working mechanism" is accurate, were not verified**; **⑧ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**its live site was not visited**); **⑨** this entry **does not claim the library is suitable for decision-making in actuarial regulatory settings**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/product-on-purpose/thinking-framework-skills` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (README 55,505 bytes; only the positioning statements, scale figures, catalog structure and section headings were read verbatim, **not any section body**); **nothing installed, run, or opened beyond the README, and the live site was not visited**.

**Thinking Framework Skills** 是一個**按證據強度分級的思維方法 Agent 技能庫**，**Apache-2.0 許可，實測 ★15、fork 1、主語言 JavaScript、體量 3,550 KB、創建於 2026-05-17、最後推送 2026-09-10**；**topics 逐字實測達 20 項**，含 **evidence-based、critical-thinking、decision-making、mental-models、systems-thinking、reasoning、agent-skills、claude-code、codex**（**其中 `product-managment` 為倉庫自身拼寫，照實記錄**）。本條目屬本輪主題**「Agent 技能裡的證據自覺」**中的**第三種：給方法本身分級****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測，55,505 位元組**）：**逐字定位**：**「An evidence-graded library of agent-executable thinking-method skills.」**；⭐⭐ **逐字承諾三層**：**「Every method is reduced to its working mechanism, graded honestly on how strong its evidence actually is, and shipped as a skill that produces a concrete artifact, not prose.」**。**規模逐字實測**：**63 frameworks + 4 tools + 9 recipes**，自述為 **Advanced (Gold) tier**。⭐ **目錄逐字實測為 12 組並帶組內計數**：**Problem Framing（6）／Divergent Ideation（6）／Perspective & Multi-Lens（2）／Systems & Consequences（9）／Assumption & Belief Challenge（5）／Reasoning Clarity（5）／Decision & Option Evaluation（12）／Strategy & Opportunity（2）／Ethics & Values Deliberation（4）／⭐Risk & Resilience（4）／Synthesis（4）／Meta-Thinking & Reflection（4）**。**章節結構逐字實測**含 **⭐What makes it different** 與 **⭐The evidence model** 兩節；**並給出線上站點**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「按其證據實際有多強誠實分級」是本輪最值得注意的一句話，也是它與本站最深的共鳴**——**思維方法類內容最常見的失敗是**把有趣等同於有效****：**「第一性原理」「六頂思考帽」聽起來都好用，但背後證據強度差異極大**；**一個庫主動把「證據有多強」做成欄位，而不是把 63 個方法一律推銷，本身就是一種智力誠實**（**⚠️ 本次未讀「The evidence model」正文，故不轉述其分級檔位、判據或任何框架的評級——這是本條最關鍵的未核實項**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「Risk & Resilience」單列為一組（4 個），是本條與風險專業最直接的交集**——**加之「Decision & Option Evaluation」多達 12 個（全庫最多），說明該庫重心在**決策與風險****。**③ ⭐⭐ 「產出具體成果而非一段文字」是一條很硬的設計約束**——**它把「聊完之後什麼也沒留下」這一 AI 對話通病寫成反面要求**（可與 [[phi-boundary-gate]]、[[ins-mmbench]]、[[powmcp-skills]] 並讀）。**④ ⭐ 「What makes it different」與「The evidence model」分設兩節**——**前者是差異化主張、後者是評級依據**，**把「宣傳」與「依據」分開寫，在方法類項目裡不常見**。**⑤ ⭐ 「How a skill works」單設一節說明其對**技能結構本身**有明確約定**。**⑥ ⭐ Apache-2.0 許可＋明確的自述分級標準，使其成為本會話收集的 Agent 技能中**許可最清晰、且對自身證據強度最坦白**的一條**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⭐⭐ 本條目最關鍵的未核實項是**證據分級本身****——**本次只讀到章節標題與三段定位語句，**未讀「The evidence model」正文**，**故不轉述其分級檔位、判據、評分方式，也不轉述任何一個框架的具體評級****；**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、topics 20 項、README（55,505 位元組）的定位語句、規模數字、12 組目錄及組內計數與章節結構**，**未安裝任何技能、未在 Agent 客戶端運行、未打開任何具體框架文件、未訪問其線上站點**；**③ ⭐ 規模數字與 12 組計數均為**README 自述值**，未逐一點數核實**（**⚠️ 12 組計數相加為 63，與自述總數自洽，屬算術核對而非獨立核實**）；**④ ⭐ 「Advanced (Gold) tier」的來源與含義未核實**；**⑤ 「graded honestly」中的「honestly」是**自我評價**，不主張其分級已獲獨立檢驗或學界認可**；**⑥ ★15 說明有一定關注度但不算高**；**⑦ 「產出具體成果」的實際執行效果、以及「還原到工作機制」是否準確，本次均未核實**；**⑧ 是否有中文材料未核實**；**⑨** 本詞條**不主張**該庫適用於保險精算監管場景下的決策**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/product-on-purpose/thinking-framework-skills` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未安裝、未運行、未打開任何框架文件、未訪問線上站點**。

entries.title: PowMCP Skills：把技能里的「证据步骤」外置为托管检查，并明写「它不能证明什么」
entries.title_en: PowMCP Skills: externalising a Skill’s evidence step into hosted checks, and stating plainly what it does not prove
entries.title_hk: PowMCP Skills：把技能裡的「證據步驟」外置為託管檢查，並明寫「它不能證明什麼」
entries.summary: 11 个面向「有标准符合性要求」的重复性工作的 Agent 技能：每个技能教完整流程——收集什么、跑哪个托管检查、如何读结果、它不能证明什么、以及如何交付；发布前经确定性门禁、与「仅用工具」基线在真实无头智能体中的实测对比、以及独立三席委员会评审，技能本身不含脚本、自身不发起网络请求
entries.summary_en: Eleven agent Skills for recurring jobs that carry standards-conformance requirements: each teaches the whole job — what to gather, which hosted check to run, how to read the result, what it does not prove, and how to hand off; before publication each passed a deterministic gate, a measured evaluation against a tools-only baseline in real headless agents, and an independent three-seat committee appraisal, and the Skills themselves carry no scripts and make no network calls
entries.summary_hk: 11 個面向「有標準符合性要求」的重複性工作的 Agent 技能：每個技能教完整流程——收集什麼、跑哪個託管檢查、如何讀結果、它不能證明什麼、以及如何交付；發布前經確定性門禁、與「僅用工具」基線在真實無頭智能體中的實測對比、以及獨立三席委員會評審，技能本身不含腳本、自身不發起網絡請求
entries.body:
**PowMCP Skills** 是一组**把「证据步骤」外置为托管检查的 Agent 技能**（仓库 `powmcp/skills`），**MIT 许可，实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言未标注、创建于 2026-09-10、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；⚠️ **GitHub API 实测其 `size` 为 0 KB**——**该值与「仓库含 11 个 SKILL.md」不相称，故我改用 contents 接口独立核实：`skills/` 目录实测返回**11 个条目**，名称与 README 表格一一对应**（**见下**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「Agent 技能里的证据自觉」**中的**第四种——也是最彻底的一种：把证据外置、并明写证据的边界****。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，8,771 字节**）：⭐ **README 逐字定位**：**「Agent Skills for recurring jobs whose evidence step is a hosted PowMCP check. Each skill teaches the whole job: what to gather, which check to run, how to read the result, what it does not prove, and how to hand off. The procedure stands on its own; the PowMCP tool is the verified-evidence step inside it.」**——**即：技能教的是**整件事**（收集什么／跑哪个检查／怎么读结果／**它不能证明什么**／怎么交付），**而托管检查只是其中那个「已被验证的证据步骤」**。**安装方式逐字实测**：`npx skills add powmcp/skills`（或 `--skill <skill-name>` 指定单个）；**支持客户端逐字实测**为 **Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Gemini CLI、OpenClaw**（原文续以「and every cli…」）。⭐⭐ **`skills/` 目录经 contents 接口实测返回 11 个条目，逐字为**：**`attach-regulator-ready-bom-to-release`（SBOM 符合性：CycloneDX／SPDX，含「面向欧盟市场须满足 BSI TR-03183-2 下限：CycloneDX 1.6+ 或 SPDX 3.0.1+」）**、**`diagnose-rejected-invoice-before-resubmission`（EN 16931／Peppol／CIUS 电子发票符合性）**、**`gate-published-release-before-announcement`（npm 包检查）**、**`preflight-caption-track-before-client-handoff`（WebVTT／SRT／TTML 字幕轨，含「20 CPS 或 17 CPS」阅读速度证据）**、**`preflight-client-endpoint-before-integration`（FHIR 服务端符合性：US Core、SMART discovery）**、**`preflight-retailer-bound-epub`（EPUB 2/3 与 EPUBCheck）**、**`produce-client-site-handoff-report`（链接完整性证据）**、**`publish-service-change-feed`（GTFS Schedule 校验，含美国 NTD 报送）**、**`publish-weekly-episode-without-feed-breakage`（播客 RSS）**、**`substantiate-eu-ebook-accessibility-claim`（EPUB Accessibility 1.1／欧洲无障碍法 EAA／WCAG）**、**`verify-payment-page-header-change-after-deploy`（支付页 HTTP 安全响应头，⭐ **PCI DSS v4.0.1 第 11.6.1 条证据**，并要求**至少每七天监测一次**）**。⭐⭐ **「Provenance（来源与把关）」一节逐字实测，是本条目最重要的一段**：**「Every skill in this repository passed a deterministic gate, a measured evaluation against a tools-only baseline in real headless agents, and an independent three-seat committee appraisal before publication. Skills carry no scripts and make no network calls of their own.」**——**即每个技能发布前经过**三道门**：**① 确定性门禁 ② 在真实无头智能体中、与「仅用工具」基线的实测对比 ③ 独立三席委员会评审**；**且技能本身**不含脚本、自身不发起网络请求****。**章节结构逐字实测**：**Install / Skills / How the checks are metered（检查如何计量） / Connect an endpoint by hand / ⭐Provenance / Feedback**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「what it does not prove（它不能证明什么）」被写进技能定义本身，是本轮最有价值的发现**——**绝大多数工具只声明能力，不声明边界**；**而这里**每个技能都在定义里写明自己不能证明什么****，**并且表格中每个技能都带一句「Not for …」（不适用于……）的排除条款**（**例如 SBOM 技能注明「Not for generating the SBOM from the release build」，字幕技能注明「Not for generating, translating, or burning captions into video」）**；**对一个以「标注核实层级」为方法的站点，这是同一种纪律的**最纯粹工程化**：**把适用边界做成技能契约的一部分，而不是写在文档角落****（**可与池内 [[phi-boundary-gate]] 的边界门控、同轮 [[insurance-review]] 的「待核实事项」、[[thinking-framework-skills]] 的证据分级并读——**四条都在处理「工具不知道自己不知道什么」这一 AI 时代的核心风险**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「与『仅用工具』基线在真实无头智能体中的实测对比」是一种少见的评估设计**——**它问的不是「技能有没有用」，而是「**加了技能之后，比只用工具强多少**」**；**这正是**增量有效性**的正确问法**，**与池内 [[insqabench]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 的基准思路一致但更严格——**因为它要求一个 ablation 基线**（**⚠️ 本次未读其评测结果，故不转述任何数值或结论**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 11 个技能里有至少四个直接围绕**监管/标准符合性证据**：**PCI DSS v4.0.1 第 11.6.1 条（每七天监测支付页安全头）**、**BSI TR-03183-2（欧盟市场软件物料清单下限）**、**欧洲无障碍法（EAA）与 EPUB Accessibility 1.1**、**美国 NTD 报送（GTFS）**——**即「**合规证据的自动生成**」已成为一个独立的技能品类**；**对保险与风险专业，这与**审计留痕、监管报送、控制点证据**是同一件事**（**可与池内 [[insurance-governance]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]] 并读**）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「Skills carry no scripts and make no network calls of their own」是一条可被验证的安全属性承诺**——**它意味着技能是**纯程序性文本，不含可执行代码、也不自行外联****；**对需要在受管环境中评估第三方技能的学生，这是一个可核对的判断依据**（**⚠️ 本次未逐文件核对 11 个 SKILL.md 是否真的不含脚本或网络调用，故仅转述其声明**）。**⑤ ⭐ "How the checks are metered" 单设一节，说明托管检查是**计量/计费**的**——**这一点对成本评估重要**（**本次未读，故不转述其计量方式与价格**）。**⑥ ⭐ FHIR 服务端检查把该技能组接入了**健康数据交换标准****——**可与池内 [[cms-beneficiary-fhir]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]]、[[icd-hcc-mappings]] 并读：**那些是健康险数据与映射，本技能是**交换端点的符合性前置检查****。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ GitHub API 实测 `size` 为 0 KB，与该仓库含 11 个技能文件不相称**——**本词条据此**不采信该字段**，改以 contents 接口独立核实 `skills/` 下确为 11 个条目**，**并如实记录两处实测值的差异**；**② ⭐⭐ 「deterministic gate / 与 tools-only 基线的实测对比 / 独立三席委员会」三项均为**README 自述**——**本词条不主张其已被独立证实，也不转述任何评审结论或评测数值**（**本次未读「How the checks are metered」正文，亦未找到其评测报告**）；**③ ⭐ 「技能不含脚本、自身不发起网络请求」为**README 自述**——**本次未逐个打开 11 个 `SKILL.md` 核对**，**故不主张该属性已在文件层面被验证**；**④** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README 全文（8,771 字节）的定位语句、安装方式、支持客户端、11 个技能名称及其「PowMCP checks」对应项、以及 Provenance 与章节结构**，**但未安装任何技能、未在 Agent 客户端运行、未打开任何 SKILL.md 正文、未使用任何托管检查、未访问 powmcp.com**，因此**不能转述其流程步骤、检查项细节、判定标准、计量方式或价格**；**⑤ ⭐ 表格中「Use when …」的适用条件与「Not for …」的排除条款均为**README 摘要****，**我按摘要转述并标注为自述**；**⑥ ⭐ 涉及 PCI DSS、BSI TR-03183-2、EN 16931、EAA、NTD 等标准的具体条款要求**，**本次均未查阅标准原文核实**，**故仅转述技能自述所对应的标准名称与版本**；**⑦ 该仓库与商业托管服务 powmcp.com 的关系（是否同一主体、是否需付费）本次未核实**；**⑧ ★0、fork 0 且创建与推送同日**，**说明其极新且关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、稳定性或已被采用**；**⑨ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/powmcp/skills`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/skills` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（**contents 接口返回 11 个条目，与 README 表格一一对应**）；**未安装、未运行、未打开技能正文、未访问 powmcp.com**。
entries.body_en:
**PowMCP Skills** is a set of **agent Skills that externalise their evidence step into hosted checks** (repository `powmcp/skills`), **MIT licensed, with measured ★0, 0 forks, no declared primary language, created 2026-09-10 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements**); ⚠️ **the GitHub API measurably reports `size` as 0 KB** — **a value inconsistent with a repository containing 11 SKILL.md files, so I verified independently via the contents API: `skills/` measurably returns 11 entries whose names correspond one-to-one with the README table** (**below**). It belongs to the fourth and most thorough of this round’s ways agent Skills handle evidence: **externalising the evidence and stating the evidence’s limits**. Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 8,771-byte README**): ⭐ **the README positions it verbatim**: **"Agent Skills for recurring jobs whose evidence step is a hosted PowMCP check. Each skill teaches the whole job: what to gather, which check to run, how to read the result, what it does not prove, and how to hand off. The procedure stands on its own; the PowMCP tool is the verified-evidence step inside it."** — **i.e. the Skill teaches the whole job (what to gather, which check to run, how to read the result, what it does not prove, how to hand off), and the hosted check is merely the verified-evidence step inside it**. **Install read verbatim**: `npx skills add powmcp/skills` (or `--skill <skill-name>` for one). **Supported clients read verbatim**: **Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw** (continuing "and every cli…"). ⭐⭐ **The `skills/` directory measurably returns 11 entries via the contents API**: **`attach-regulator-ready-bom-to-release`** (SBOM conformance — CycloneDX/SPDX, including the EU-market floor of BSI TR-03183-2, i.e. CycloneDX 1.6+ or SPDX 3.0.1+); **`diagnose-rejected-invoice-before-resubmission`** (EN 16931/Peppol/CIUS e-invoice conformance); **`gate-published-release-before-announcement`** (npm package check); **`preflight-caption-track-before-client-handoff`** (WebVTT/SRT/TTML, including 20 CPS or 17 CPS reading-speed evidence); **`preflight-client-endpoint-before-integration`** (FHIR server conformance — US Core, SMART discovery); **`preflight-retailer-bound-epub`** (EPUB 2/3, EPUBCheck); **`produce-client-site-handoff-report`** (link-integrity evidence); **`publish-service-change-feed`** (GTFS Schedule validation, including US NTD reporting); **`publish-weekly-episode-without-feed-breakage`** (podcast RSS); **`substantiate-eu-ebook-accessibility-claim`** (EPUB Accessibility 1.1, European Accessibility Act, WCAG); and **`verify-payment-page-header-change-after-deploy`** (payment-page HTTP security headers, ⭐ **PCI DSS v4.0.1 Requirement 11.6.1 evidence**, requiring monitoring **at least once every seven days**). ⭐⭐ **The "Provenance" section, read verbatim, is the entry’s most important passage**: **"Every skill in this repository passed a deterministic gate, a measured evaluation against a tools-only baseline in real headless agents, and an independent three-seat committee appraisal before publication. Skills carry no scripts and make no network calls of their own."** — **three gates before publication: ① a deterministic gate, ② a measured evaluation against a tools-only baseline in real headless agents, ③ an independent three-seat committee appraisal**; **and the Skills themselves carry no scripts and make no network calls**. **Section headings read verbatim**: **Install / Skills / How the checks are metered / Connect an endpoint by hand / ⭐ Provenance / Feedback**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ That "what it does not prove" is written into the Skill definition itself is the round’s most valuable finding** — **almost every tool declares capabilities, not boundaries**; **here every Skill states in its definition what it cannot prove**, **and every row of the table carries a "Not for …" exclusion** (**the SBOM Skill notes "Not for generating the SBOM from the release build"; the caption Skill notes "Not for generating, translating, or burning captions into video"**); **for a site whose method is labelling verification tiers, this is the purest engineering of the same discipline: making applicability boundaries part of the Skill contract rather than a footnote** (**readable with the boundary gating of [[phi-boundary-gate]], the "items to verify" tier of [[insurance-review]] and the evidence grading of [[thinking-framework-skills]] — all four address the core AI-era risk that a tool does not know what it does not know**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ A measured evaluation against a tools-only baseline in real headless agents is an unusual evaluation design** — **it does not ask whether the Skill is useful but how much better it is than the tools alone**; **that is the right question for incremental effectiveness**, **aligned with the benchmarking of [[insqabench]], [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] and [[actuarial-benchmarks]] but stricter, because it requires an ablation baseline** (**its evaluation results were not read, so no figure or conclusion is restated**). **③ ⭐⭐ At least four of the eleven Skills centre on regulatory and standards-conformance evidence**: **PCI DSS v4.0.1 Requirement 11.6.1 (security-header monitoring every seven days)**, **BSI TR-03183-2 (EU software bill-of-materials floor)**, **the European Accessibility Act and EPUB Accessibility 1.1**, and **US NTD reporting (GTFS)** — **i.e. automated compliance-evidence generation has become a Skill category of its own**; **for insurance and risk professionals this is the same thing as audit trails, regulatory reporting and control-point evidence** (**readable with [[insurance-governance]], [[naic-ai-oversight]] and [[iso-42001-toolkit]]**). **④ ⭐⭐ "Skills carry no scripts and make no network calls of their own" is a checkable security property** — **the Skills are purely procedural text, with no executable code and no outbound connections of their own**; **a verifiable criterion for students assessing third-party Skills in managed environments** (**⚠️ the 11 SKILL.md files were not opened individually, so this is reported as a declaration only**). **⑤ ⭐ A separate "How the checks are metered" section shows the hosted checks are metered** — **relevant to cost assessment** (**not read, so no metering scheme or price is restated**). **⑥ ⭐ The FHIR server check connects this Skill set to health-data-exchange standards** — **readable with [[cms-beneficiary-fhir]], [[healthcare-mrf-api]] and [[icd-hcc-mappings]]: those are health-insurance data and mappings, whereas this is a pre-integration conformance check on the exchange endpoint**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The GitHub API measurably reports `size` as 0 KB, inconsistent with a repository holding 11 Skill files** — **the field is therefore not relied upon; the contents API was used instead and confirms 11 entries under `skills/`**, **with the discrepancy between the two measurements recorded**; **② ⭐⭐ The deterministic gate, the measured comparison against a tools-only baseline, and the independent three-seat committee are all README self-reports** — **the entry does not claim they are independently confirmed and restates no appraisal conclusion or evaluation figure** (**"How the checks are metered" was not read, and no evaluation report was located**); **③ ⭐ "Skills carry no scripts and make no network calls" is a README self-report** — **the 11 `SKILL.md` files were not opened individually**, **so no claim is made that the property has been verified at file level**; **④** this check verified **the repository metadata, the README’s 8,771 bytes in respect of its positioning statement, install method, supported clients, the 11 Skill names and their corresponding hosted checks, and the Provenance and section structure**, **but installed no Skill, ran nothing in an agent client, opened no SKILL.md, used no hosted check and did not visit powmcp.com**, so **its procedure steps, check details, pass criteria, metering scheme and price cannot be restated**; **⑤ ⭐ The "Use when …" conditions and "Not for …" exclusions in the table are README summaries**, **restated as such**; **⑥ ⭐ The specific clause requirements of PCI DSS, BSI TR-03183-2, EN 16931, the EAA and NTD were not checked against the standards themselves**, **so only the standard names and versions the Skills claim to correspond to are restated**; **⑦ the relationship between this repository and the commercial hosted service powmcp.com (same entity? paid?) was not verified**; **⑧ ★0, 0 forks and same-day creation and push mean it is extremely new with very low attention**, **so no maturity, stability or adoption is claimed**; **⑨ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/powmcp/skills`, `/readme` and `/contents/skills` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (**the contents endpoint returning 11 entries corresponding one-to-one with the README table**); **nothing installed or run, no Skill body opened, powmcp.com not visited**.

The procedure stands on its own; the PowMCP tool is the verified-evidence step inside it.」**。**安裝逐字實測**：`npx skills add powmcp/skills`；**支持客戶端逐字實測**為 **Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Gemini CLI、OpenClaw**。⭐⭐ **`skills/` 經 contents 接口實測返回 11 個條目**，含 **SBOM 符合性（BSI TR-03183-2 下限：CycloneDX 1.6+ 或 SPDX 3.0.1+）／EN 16931・Peppol・CIUS 電子發票／npm 包檢查／WebVTT・SRT・TTML 字幕軌／FHIR 服務端（US Core、SMART discovery）／EPUB 2-3（EPUBCheck）／連結完整性／GTFS Schedule（含美國 NTD 報送）／播客 RSS／EPUB Accessibility 1.1・歐洲無障礙法 EAA・WCAG／⭐支付頁 HTTP 安全響應頭（**PCI DSS v4.0.1 第 11.6.1 條證據**，要求至少每七天監測一次）**。⭐⭐ **Provenance 一節逐字實測為本條目最重要一段**：**「Every skill in this repository passed a deterministic gate, a measured evaluation against a tools-only baseline in real headless agents, and an independent three-seat committee appraisal before publication. 對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「what it does not prove（它不能證明什麼）」被寫進技能定義本身，是本輪最有價值的發現**——**絕大多數工具只聲明能力，不聲明邊界**；**且表格中每個技能都帶一句「Not for …」的排除條款**；**對一個以「標註核實層級」為方法的站點，這是同一種紀律的**最純粹工程化****（可與 [[phi-boundary-gate]]、同輪 [[insurance-review]] 的「待核實事項」、[[thinking-framework-skills]] 的證據分級並讀——**四條都在處理「工具不知道自己不知道什麼」這一 AI 時代的核心風險**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「與『僅用工具』基線在真實無頭智能體中的實測對比」是一種少見的評估設計**——**它問的不是「技能有沒有用」，而是「**加了技能之後，比只用工具強多少**」**；**這正是**增量有效性**的正確問法**（**⚠️ 未讀其評測結果，故不轉述任何數值或結論**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 11 個技能裡至少四個直接圍繞**監管／標準符合性證據****：**PCI DSS v4.0.1 第 11.6.1 條**、**BSI TR-03183-2**、**歐洲無障礙法（EAA）與 EPUB Accessibility 1.1**、**美國 NTD 報送**——**即「**合規證據的自動生成**」已成為一個獨立的技能品類**（可與 [[insurance-governance]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]] 並讀）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「技能不含腳本、自身不發起網絡請求」是一條可被驗證的安全屬性承諾**（**⚠️ 本次未逐文件核對 11 個 SKILL.md，故僅轉述其聲明**）。**⑤ ⭐ 「How the checks are metered」單設一節，說明託管檢查是**計量／計費**的**（**未讀，故不轉述其方式與價格**）。**⑥ ⭐ FHIR 服務端檢查把該技能組接入**健康數據交換標準****（可與 [[cms-beneficiary-fhir]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]]、[[icd-hcc-mappings]] 並讀）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ GitHub API 實測 `size` 為 0 KB，與該倉庫含 11 個技能文件不相稱**——**故**不採信該字段**，改以 contents 接口獨立核實 `skills/` 下確為 11 個條目**，**並如實記錄兩處實測值的差異**；**② ⭐⭐ 三道門均為**README 自述**——**不主張其已被獨立證實，也不轉述任何評審結論或評測數值**；**③ ⭐ 「技能不含腳本、自身不發起網絡請求」為 README 自述**——**未逐個打開 11 個 `SKILL.md` 核對**；**④** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、README 全文（8,771 位元組）的定位語句、安裝方式、支持客戶端、11 個技能名稱及其對應檢查、以及 Provenance 與章節結構**，**但未安裝任何技能、未在 Agent 客戶端運行、未打開任何 SKILL.md 正文、未使用任何託管檢查、未訪問 powmcp.com**；**⑤ ⭐ 「Use when…」與「Not for…」均為**README 摘要****，**按摘要轉述並標註為自述**；**⑥ ⭐ 涉及 PCI DSS、BSI TR-03183-2、EN 16931、EAA、NTD 的具體條款要求，本次均未查閱標準原文核實**；**⑦ 該倉庫與商業託管服務 powmcp.com 的關係本次未核實**；**⑧ ★0、fork 0 且創建與推送同日**，**不主張其成熟度、穩定性或已被採用**；**⑨ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/powmcp/skills`、`/readme` 與 `/contents/skills` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未安裝、未運行、未打開技能正文、未訪問 powmcp.com**。

entries.body:
**prudential-plc-api-profile** 是 **API Evangelist 对 Prudential plc 公开 API 面的独立第三方画像**（仓库 `api-evangelist/prudential-plc`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言未标注、仓库体量 121 KB、创建于 2026-07-25、最后推送 2026-09-04**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）**；**⚠️ 其 `pushed` 为 2026-09-04，严格落在本轮解冻窗口（`>2026-09-05`）之外——本条目如实标注，并非窗口内发现**。**其 topics 逐字实测达 20 项，且直接覆盖本词条所在站点关注的区域与险种**：**hong-kong、bancassurance、takaful、life-insurance、health-insurance、pensions、asset-management、responsible-ai、africa、asia、united-kingdom、vietnam、indonesia、malaysia、philippines、singapore、carrier、apis-json、eastspring、asset-management**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，10,033 字节**）：**仓库自述定位逐字**：**「Prudential plc — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist.」**；**并逐字说明 Prudential plc 为在英格兰与威尔士注册的人寿与健康保险及资产管理集团，在伦敦、香港、新加坡与纽约交易所上市，**主要营运办公室在香港****。⭐⭐⭐ **本条目最有价值的不是这份画像的内容，而是它在开篇写下的「Provenance（来源与声明）」区块——它逐项交代了自己是什么、不是什么**，**共六条，逐字实测如下**：
**① 「This is not our API.」**——**「该仓库是某公司**公开可用** API 面的独立第三方画像，由 API Evangelist 维护；API Evangelist 不运营、不托管、不转售、不支持该公司的 API，且除画像中另有说明外与该公司的关联或背书。**」
**② 来源纪律**——**「此处一切信息均由**任何公众成员用浏览器、无需任何凭证**即可取得的材料汇编而成——公司自身网站、开发者门户与文档、其公开发布的规范（OpenAPI、AsyncAPI、JSON Schema、`apis.json`、`llms.txt` 等）、其公开仓库、以及其公开的状态/定价/变更日志页面」**；⭐ **并以一句极强的否定句收尾：「Nothing here is obtained by breaching a system, defeating an access control, or using credentials of any kind.」——此处没有任何内容是通过入侵系统、绕过访问控制或使用任何形式的凭证取得的**。
**③ 评分范围声明**——**「该评分是独立评估」**：**Kin Score 与 Agent Readiness 是对一家公司**公开** API 产物、依已公布评分标准独立计算的分数**；⭐ **逐字强调「They are not certifications, endorsements, security assessments, or audits, and they score published artifacts — not the quality, safety, or security of the software.」——它们不是认证、背书、安全评估或审计，它们评的是**已发布的产物**，而**不是该软件的质量、安全性或安全防护****。
**④ 更正、重评与下架免费**——**「无需任何合作、合同或购买，且你不需要为请求给出理由。」**
**⑤ 下架承诺逐字**——**「Want the listing taken down? Say so and we will honor it.」**；**下架后画像缩减为公司名、事实性描述与其自身网站链接，且该公司记为 **unrated（未评级）****；⭐ **并逐字承诺「never scored zero for having asked」——绝不会因为提出请求而被评为零分**。
**⑥ 公布的服务时限**——**「确认在一个工作日内；下架或限制在两个工作日内；更正与重评在五个工作日内。」**

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「第三方画像的自律范本」是本轮最有价值的发现，且它与本词条所在站点的做法同源**——**本站同样是对机构做第三方、无凭证、逐条标注来源的画像；而 API Evangelist 把这件事的**边界**写成了声明式条款**：**不是我们的 API／不用凭证／评分不等于安全审计／可无理由下架／不因请求而给零分／承诺响应时限**。**六条里有四条是在**主动限制自己结论的射程****；**对做研究报告、行业分析或机构画像的学生，这是一份可直接借用的「我这样写，但请这样读」模板**（**可与池内 [[phi-boundary-gate]] 的边界门控、同轮思路的第 319 轮 [[powmcp-skills]] 的「what it does not prove」、[[insurance-review]] 的「待核实事项」并读——**四条都在处理同一件事：让别人无法把你的结论读得比它实际更强****）。**② ⭐⭐ 「不用任何凭证」这一来源纪律值得单独记一笔**——**它与本会话第 317 轮实测到的 `register.eiopa.europa.eu` 403、第 316 轮 `HCAA` 403 等阻断形成对照**：**当权威来源有访问门槛时，第三方画像要么放弃、要么改用公开可得材料并**明说材料边界****；**API Evangelist 选了后者并把这条写进首页**。**③ ⭐⭐ 「bancassurance」与「takaful」出现在同一组 topics 中**——**本词条所在站点的形态普查中，「bancassurance/银保」长期为**真空白（0）**、「回教保险/takaful」则已有 [[bnm-insurance-takaful]]**；**本条目虽然不能填上银保这一形态（它不是银保业务本身，而是一份画像），但它提示了一个此前没注意到的观察面：**一家同时经营银保与回教保险的集团，其**公开 API 面**长什么样****（**本次未读画像正文，故不转述其收录了哪些 API、Kin Score 数值或 Agent Readiness 评级**）。**④ ⭐ Prudential plc **主要营运办公室在香港**这一点，使本条目对本站读者有直接关联**——**可与池内 [[hkma-open-api]]（香港金管局开放 API）、[[10life]]（香港保险比较）、[[openinsurance]] 并读：**三者分别代表监管者开放 API、消费者端比较、以及开放保险概念，而本条目是**第三方对单一保险集团 API 面的独立盘点****。**⑤ ⭐ 「Kin Score」与「Agent Readiness」两个评分名称的出现，说明该组织已把「一家公司的 API 对一个 AI 智能体是否可用」做成评分维度**（**本次未读其评分标准正文，故不转述其定义、量纲或 Rubric**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件**（`NONE`）**——**本词条据此明确记录，并提示引用、转载或再利用其画像内容前应自行确认授权状况**（**注意：其「下架权」声明是关于**被画像公司**的，不是关于**转载者**的授权**）；**② ⚠️ 该条目 `pushed` 为 2026-09-04，**严格在解冻窗口之外**，**本词条不将其计为本轮窗口内发现**；**③** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、20 项 topics、README 全文（10,033 字节）中的自述定位、Prudential plc 的公司描述、以及上述六条 Provenance 条款的逐字内容**，⭐ **但未读画像正文**——**未核实其实际收录了哪些 API、端点、规范文件或评分结果**，**未访问 apievangelist.com、未访问 Prudential plc 的开发者门户或任何被引用的规范**，因此**不能转述任何 API 清单、Kin Score 数值、Agent Readiness 评级、Rubric 内容或 Prudential 的实际 API 能力**；**④ ⭐ 「Kin Score 与 Agent Readiness 独立计算」为**该组织的自述**，**本次未独立验证其计算方式、可复现性或评分标准的公开程度**；**⑤ ⭐ 「无理由下架」「不因请求而给零分」「公布的服务时限」均为**自我承诺**，**本次未核实其执行记录或是否有第三方监督**；**⑥ 本词条**不主张**该画像已获 Prudential plc 认可，**也不主张其内容准确**（**按该组织自己的声明，其内容系第三方汇编**）；**⑦ 「Prudential plc 主要营运办公室在香港、在伦敦/香港/新加坡/纽约上市」为**该画像的公司描述**，**本次未对照 Prudential plc 官方材料核实**；**⑧ 该组织是否对其他保险机构也有同类画像、覆盖面多大本次未完整核实**（**抽样查询其组织仓库时另见 `first-american-financial` 与 `advise-insurance` 两条含保险关键词的画像，但**样本仅 100 个最近更新仓库、并非全量**，故不作覆盖面主张**）；**⑨** 本词条**不主张**该画像可用于任何合规、投资或安全评估用途**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/api-evangelist/prudential-plc` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 10,033 字节，六条 Provenance 条款逐字核对）；**未读画像正文、未访问 apievangelist.com 与被引用的任何规范**。
