**prudential-plc-api-profile** is **API Evangelist’s independent third-party profile of Prudential plc’s public API surface** (repository `api-evangelist/prudential-plc`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, no declared primary language, a 121 KB repository, created 2026-07-25 and last pushed 2026-09-04** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`)**; **⚠️ its `pushed` date of 2026-09-04 falls strictly outside this round’s thaw window (`>2026-09-05`) — stated plainly; this is not a window find**. **Its 20 topics were read verbatim and directly cover regions and lines this site tracks**: **hong-kong, bancassurance, takaful, life-insurance, health-insurance, pensions, asset-management, responsible-ai, africa, asia, united-kingdom, vietnam, indonesia, malaysia, philippines, singapore, carrier, apis-json and eastspring**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 10,033-byte README**): the repository **positions itself verbatim** as **"Prudential plc — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist."**; **and states verbatim that Prudential plc is a life and health insurance and asset management group incorporated in England and Wales, listed on the London, Hong Kong, Singapore and New York exchanges, with its principal operating office in Hong Kong**. ⭐⭐⭐ **The entry’s real value is not the profile’s content but the Provenance block it opens with — six clauses stating what it is and is not, read verbatim**:
**① "This is not our API."** — **the repository is an independent, third-party profile of a company’s publicly available API surface, maintained by API Evangelist, which does not operate, host, resell or support the company’s APIs and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the company unless stated on the profile.**
**② Source discipline** — **"Everything here is assembled from material a member of the public can reach with a browser and no credentials"** — the company’s own site, developer portal and documentation, the specifications it publishes for public use (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, JSON Schema, `apis.json`, `llms.txt` and similar), its public repositories, and its public status, pricing and changelog pages; ⭐ **closing with a strong negative: "Nothing here is obtained by breaching a system, defeating an access control, or using credentials of any kind."**
**③ Rating-scope declaration** — **the Kin Score and Agent Readiness rating are independently calculated scores of a company’s public API artifacts against a published rubric**; ⭐ **stating verbatim that "They are not certifications, endorsements, security assessments, or audits, and they score published artifacts — not the quality, safety, or security of the software."**
**④ Corrections, re-scores and removal are free** — **no partnership, contract or purchase is required, and no justification need be given.**
**⑤ The removal promise, verbatim** — **"Want the listing taken down? Say so and we will honor it."**; **the profile is then reduced to the company name, a factual description and a link to its own site, and the company is recorded as unrated**; ⭐ **with the verbatim commitment "never scored zero for having asked"**.
**⑥ Published service-level times** — **acknowledgement within one business day; removal or restriction within two business days; corrections and re-scores within five business days.**

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ A model of third-party profiling self-discipline is the round’s most valuable finding, and it shares its method with the site this entry lives on** — **this site also profiles institutions as a third party, without credentials, labelling sources item by item; API Evangelist writes the boundaries into declarative clauses**: **not our API / no credentials / a rating is not a security audit / removal on request without justification / never zero for asking / published response times**. **Four of the six clauses actively limit the reach of its own conclusions**; **a directly borrowable template of "I write this, but read it this way" for students producing research reports, industry analyses or institutional profiles** (**readable with the boundary gating of [[phi-boundary-gate]], the "what it does not prove" of round 319’s [[powmcp-skills]] and the "items to verify" of [[insurance-review]] — all four address the same thing: stopping others from reading your conclusion as stronger than it is**). **② ⭐⭐ The "no credentials of any kind" source discipline deserves separate note** — **it contrasts with this session’s measured blocks such as `register.eiopa.europa.eu` (403, round 317) and HCAA (403, round 316)**: **when an authoritative source is gated, a third-party profile must either give up or use publicly reachable material and state the material boundary**; **API Evangelist chose the latter and put it on the front page**. **③ ⭐⭐ "Bancassurance" and "takaful" appearing in the same topic set is notable** — **in this site’s form census, bancassurance has long been a true zero while takaful already has [[bnm-insurance-takaful]]**; **this entry cannot fill the bancassurance form (it is a profile, not bancassurance business), but it points to a previously unnoticed surface: what the public API face of a group operating both bancassurance and takaful looks like** (**the profile body was not read, so no API listing, Kin Score or Agent Readiness rating is restated**). **④ ⭐ That Prudential plc’s principal operating office is in Hong Kong gives this entry direct relevance for this site’s readers** — **readable with [[hkma-open-api]] (the HKMA open API), [[10life]] (Hong Kong insurance comparison) and [[openinsurance]]: a regulator’s open API, a consumer comparison and the open-insurance concept, whereas this is an independent inventory of one insurance group’s API surface**. **⑤ ⭐ The two rating names, Kin Score and Agent Readiness, show the organisation has made "how usable a company’s API is to an AI agent" a scoring dimension** (**its rubric was not read, so no definition, scale or rubric content is restated**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file** (`NONE`) — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before quoting, republishing or reusing its profile content** (**note: its removal right concerns the profiled company, not a republisher’s licence**); **② ⚠️ the entry’s `pushed` date of 2026-09-04 is strictly outside the thaw window**, **and it is not counted as a window find**; **③** this check verified **the repository metadata, 20 topics, and the README’s 10,033 bytes in respect of its positioning statement, its description of Prudential plc, and the verbatim text of the six Provenance clauses**, ⭐ **but did not read the profile body** — **what APIs, endpoints, specification files or rating results it actually contains was not verified**, **apievangelist.com was not visited, nor Prudential plc’s developer portal nor any cited specification**, so **no API listing, Kin Score, Agent Readiness rating, rubric or actual Prudential API capability can be restated**; **④ ⭐ The claim that the Kin Score and Agent Readiness are independently calculated is the organisation’s own**, **and neither the calculation, its reproducibility, nor the public availability of the rubric was independently verified**; **⑤ ⭐ The no-justification removal right, the never-zero pledge and the published response times are self-commitments**, **and no execution record or third-party oversight was verified**; **⑥** the entry **does not claim the profile is endorsed by Prudential plc, nor that its content is accurate** (**by the organisation’s own statement it is third-party compilation**); **⑦ The statements that Prudential plc’s principal operating office is in Hong Kong and that it is listed in London, Hong Kong, Singapore and New York are the profile’s own company description**, **not checked against Prudential plc’s official material**; **⑧ whether the organisation has comparable profiles for other insurers, and its coverage, were not fully verified** (**sampling its organisation repositories also surfaced `first-american-financial` and `advise-insurance`, but the sample was 100 recently updated repositories, not the full set, so no coverage claim is made**); **⑨** the entry **does not claim the profile is usable for any compliance, investment or security assessment**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/api-evangelist/prudential-plc` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 10,033-byte README with the six Provenance clauses checked verbatim); **the profile body was not read, and apievangelist.com and the cited specifications were not visited**.

**prudential-plc-api-profile** 是 **API Evangelist 對 Prudential plc 公開 API 面的獨立第三方畫像**（倉庫 `api-evangelist/prudential-plc`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言未標註、體量 121 KB、創建於 2026-07-25、最後推送 2026-09-04**；**⚠️ 該倉庫實測無任何許可文件（`NONE`）**；**⚠️ 其 `pushed` 為 2026-09-04，嚴格落在本輪解凍窗口（`>2026-09-05`）之外——如實標註，並非窗口內發現**。**其 topics 逐字實測達 20 項，直接覆蓋本站關注的區域與險種**：**hong-kong、bancassurance、takaful、life-insurance、health-insurance、pensions、asset-management、responsible-ai、africa、asia、united-kingdom、vietnam、indonesia、malaysia、philippines、singapore、carrier、apis-json、eastspring**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測，10,033 位元組**）：⭐ **逐字定位**：**「Prudential plc — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist.」**；**並逐字說明 Prudential plc 為在英格蘭與威爾士註冊的人壽與健康保險及資產管理集團，在倫敦、香港、新加坡與紐約交易所上市，**主要營運辦公室在香港****。⭐⭐⭐ **本條目最有價值的是開篇的 Provenance 區塊——它逐項交代自己是什麼、不是什麼**：
**① 「This is not our API.」**——**該倉庫是某公司**公開可用** API 面的獨立第三方畫像；API Evangelist 不運營、不託管、不轉售、不支持該公司的 API，且除另有說明外與該公司無關聯或背書**。
**② 來源紀律**——**「此處一切資訊均由**任何公眾成員用瀏覽器、無需任何憑證**即可取得的材料彙編而成」**（公司自身網站、開發者門戶與文檔、其公開發布的規範如 OpenAPI／AsyncAPI／JSON Schema／`apis.json`／`llms.txt`、其公開倉庫、以及公開的狀態/定價/變更日誌）；⭐ **並以一句極強的否定句收尾：「Nothing here is obtained by breaching a system, defeating an access control, or using credentials of any kind.」**
**③ 評分範圍聲明**——**Kin Score 與 Agent Readiness 是對一家公司**公開** API 產物、依已公布評分標準獨立計算的分數**；⭐ **逐字強調「They are not certifications, endorsements, security assessments, or audits, and they score published artifacts — not the quality, safety, or security of the software.」**
**④ 更正、重評與下架免費**——**「無需任何合作、合同或購買，且你不需要為請求給出理由。」**
**⑤ 下架承諾逐字**——**「Want the listing taken down? Say so and we will honor it.」**；下架後記為 **unrated**；⭐ **並逐字承諾「never scored zero for having asked」**。
**⑥ 公布的服務時限**——**確認一個工作日內；下架或限制兩個工作日內；更正與重評五個工作日內。**

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「第三方畫像的自律範本」是本輪最有價值的發現，且與本站做法同源**——**六條裡有四條是在**主動限制自己結論的射程****；**對做研究報告或機構畫像的學生，這是可直接借用的「我這樣寫，但請這樣讀」模板**（可與 [[phi-boundary-gate]]、第 319 輪 [[powmcp-skills]] 的「what it does not prove」、[[insurance-review]] 的「待核實事項」並讀）。**② ⭐⭐ 「不用任何憑證」這一來源紀律值得單獨記一筆**——**與本會話實測到的 `register.eiopa.europa.eu` 403、`HCAA` 403 等阻斷形成對照**：**當權威來源有門檻時，第三方畫像要麼放棄、要麼改用公開可得材料並**明說材料邊界****。**③ ⭐⭐ 「bancassurance」與「takaful」同組出現值得注意**——**本站普查中銀保長期為**真空白（0）**、takaful 已有 [[bnm-insurance-takaful]]**；**本條目不能填上銀保形態，但提示了一個此前沒注意到的觀察面：**一家同時經營銀保與回教保險的集團，其公開 API 面長什麼樣****。**④ ⭐ Prudential plc **主要營運辦公室在香港**，使本條目對本站讀者有直接關聯**（可與 [[hkma-open-api]]、[[10life]]、[[openinsurance]] 並讀）。**⑤ ⭐ 「Kin Score」與「Agent Readiness」說明該組織已把「一家公司的 API 對 AI 智能體是否可用」做成評分維度**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 該倉庫實測**無任何許可文件****——**明確記錄，並提示引用或再利用其畫像內容前應自行確認授權**（**注意：其「下架權」是關於**被畫像公司**的，不是關於**轉載者**的授權**）；**② ⚠️ 該條目 `pushed` 為 2026-09-04，**嚴格在解凍窗口之外****；**③** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、20 項 topics、README 全文（10,033 位元組）中的自述定位、公司描述與六條 Provenance 條款的逐字內容**，⭐ **但未讀畫像正文**——**未核實其實際收錄了哪些 API、端點、規範文件或評分結果**，**未訪問 apievangelist.com、Prudential plc 開發者門戶或任何被引用的規範**；**④ ⭐ 「Kin Score 與 Agent Readiness 獨立計算」為**該組織自述**，未獨立驗證其計算方式、可複現性或標準公開程度**；**⑤ ⭐ 各項承諾均為**自我承諾**，未核實執行記錄或第三方監督**；**⑥ 不主張**該畫像已獲 Prudential plc 認可，**也不主張其內容準確****；**⑦ 公司描述未對照 Prudential plc 官方材料核實**；**⑧ 該組織是否對其他保險機構亦有同類畫像、覆蓋面多大未完整核實**（**抽樣僅 100 個最近更新倉庫，非全量，故不作覆蓋面主張**）；**⑨** 本詞條**不主張**該畫像可用於任何合規、投資或安全評估用途**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/api-evangelist/prudential-plc` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未讀畫像正文、未訪問 apievangelist.com**。

entries.title: Condition：Midnight 上的隐私保护参数保险——公开保单、私有理赔、公开的公平结算证明
entries.title_en: Condition: privacy-preserving parametric insurance on Midnight — public policies, private claims, public proof of fair settlement
entries.summary: 一个部署在 Midnight 区块链上的参数保险实现：公开保单、私有理赔，并以客户端零知识证明产出公开的公平结算凭证；完整生命周期（创建→注资→投保→双源触发→私有理赔→客户端 ZK 证明→结算→公开凭证）已于链上跑通，并主动说明「线上跑的是加固前那一代合约」
entries.summary_en: A parametric insurance implementation on the Midnight blockchain: public policies, private claims, and a public proof of fair settlement produced by client-side zero-knowledge proofs; the full lifecycle (create, fund, enroll, two-source trigger, private claim, client-side ZK proof, settle, public receipt) has run on-chain, and it volunteers that the live deployment is the pre-hardening contract generation

entries.body:
**Condition** 是一个**部署在 Midnight 区块链上的隐私保护参数保险实现**（仓库 `zarkbns/condition`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 JavaScript、仓库体量 64,037 KB、创建于 2026-08-31、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**其 topics 逐字实测为 insurance-claims、midnightntwrk、zk-proofs**；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「我是什么、我不是什么、我做到哪一步」**——**它在这方面是本轮最坦白的一条**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，22,699 字节**）：**README 逐字标题为「Condition – Privacy-Preserving Parametric Insurance on Midnight」**；⭐ **其「Status」段逐字实测**：**「Live on Midnight Preprod — the full lifecycle (create → fund → enroll → 2-source trigger → private claim → client-side ZK proof → settle → public receipt) executed on-chain 2026-09-05, all transactions `SUCCESS`」**，**并附 208 个测试全绿、CLI 双层生命周期演示、跨层摘要一致性**。⭐⭐⭐ **紧接着一句逐字陈述，是本条目最值得注意的地方**：**「Two contract generations, stated plainly: the contracts in `contracts/` are the hardened Wave-1 sources (capability authorization, registered oracles, canonical trigger binding — see `BUILD_SPEC.md` §12); the Preprod instances deployed 2026-09-05 are the pre-hardening generation and remain the live, verified deployment.」**——**即「两代合约，说白了：仓库里的 `contracts/` 是加固过的 Wave-1 源码（能力授权、已注册预言机、规范化触发绑定），而 2026-09-05 部署在 Preprod 上的实例是**加固前那一代**，并且它才是目前在线的、已验证的部署」**。**章节结构逐字实测**：**Judge Quickstart / What is Condition? / The Problem / How It Works / Tech Stack / Why two layers? / Live End-to-End Proof (CLI demo) / Quick Start / What runs where: browser vs CLI / Project Structure / ⭐Privacy Invariants (mechanically enforced) / ⭐Wave Roadmap / Why Midnight? / Testing / Deployment / ⭐Live on Preprod (deployed 2026-09-03 — pre-hardening generation) / Deploying the frontend (Vercel) / Key Files to Read**；⭐ **其中 Wave Roadmap 逐字实测为三段，且只有第一段带勾**：**Wave 1 — Privacy + Fraud Prevention ✅ (this repo) / Wave 2 — Verifiable Fairness + Audit Trail / Wave 3 — Adoption + Compliance**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「Two contract generations, stated plainly」是本轮最有价值的一句话，也是一种罕见的诚实**——**它把「**线上跑的是哪一代**」与「**仓库里最好的是哪一代**」明确分开**，**而不是让读者以为部署的就是最新的**；**对做模型治理、模型风险或审计的学生，这直接对应一个真实问题：**上线版本与开发版本不一致，而报告里说的是哪一个****（**可与池内 [[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[modelx]] 所代表的「版本与可复现」传统并读**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「Privacy Invariants (mechanically enforced)」这一节标题值得单独记一笔**——**隐私不变量被**机械强制**，而非靠政策承诺**；**这与「公开保单、私有理赔、公开公平结算证明」三者构成本条目的核心设计：**保单公开可审计、理赔细节不外泄、但结算是否公平可由任何人验证****；**这正是保险业最难的一组权衡（**可验证性与隐私**）在技术上的一个具体解法**（**⚠️ 本次未读该节正文，故不转述其具体不变量与强制方式**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「2-source trigger（双源触发）」值得注意**——**参数保险的触发依赖外部数据源，而用**两个**来源触发，是在处理参数保险最经典的争议点（**触发数据的可信度与操纵风险**）**；**可与池内 [[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[perils-ied]] 并读——**那几条代表参数保险的产品与巨灾侧，而本条目补的是**密码学与触发机制侧****（**本次未读其触发判据，故不转述两个来源是什么、如何取数**）。**④ ⭐ Wave Roadmap 只给 Wave 1 打勾、并明写「this repo」**——**即它明确声明自己**只做到第一阶段****，**Wave 2（可验证公平性与审计轨迹）与 Wave 3（采用与合规）尚未做**；**对读者而言，「已做到哪一步」比「愿景多大」重要得多**（**本次未读各 Wave 正文，故不转述其内容**）。**⑤ ⭐ 「What runs where: browser vs CLI」单设一节**——**说明它交代了哪些部分真正在链上跑、哪些只是本地演示**，**这与第 319 轮 [[powmcp-skills]] 的「它不能证明什么」、以及同轮 [[prudential-plc-api-profile]] 的来源纪律是同一族做法：**把「实际做成了什么」与「看起来做成了什么」分开****。**⑥ ⭐ 「Why two layers?」与「Why Midnight?」两节说明其架构与选链理由均有成文交代**（**本次未读**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件**（`NONE`）**——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用、部署或再分发其合约与代码前应自行确认授权状况**（**对一个包含链上合约的项目，这一点尤其重要**）；**② ⭐⭐ 「已在 Midnight Preprod 上跑通、交易全部 SUCCESS、208 测试全绿」均为**README 自述**——**本次未访问 Midnight 区块浏览器、未核对任何交易哈希、未克隆或运行测试、未验证 208 这个数字**，**故一律以自述方式转述，不当作已核实事实**（**README 提及存在 `docs/DEPLOYMENTS.md` 作为证据，但本次未打开该文件**）；**③ ⭐⭐ 本次核实的是仓库元数据、topics 三项、README（22,699 字节）的标题、Status 段、两代合约声明、章节结构与 Wave Roadmap 三段标题**，⭐ **但未读 README 多数章节正文**（**含 Privacy Invariants、How It Works、The Problem、Wave 各段、Why Midnight?、Deployment**），因此**不能转述其隐私不变量的具体内容、触发机制、双层架构理由、链上合约设计或部署参数**；**④ ⚠️ 「Preprod」是**测试网络**，不是主网**——**本词条据此不主张该系统已在生产环境运行或承载真实保单**；**⑤ ⭐ 本条目**不主张**其「隐私保护」已获独立安全审计或密码学评审**——**本次未见任何审计报告**；**⑥ ⭐ 「参数保险」在多数司法辖区属受监管业务**，**该项目的合规状态、是否可在任何辖区实际开展业务本次未核实，本词条不作任何合规判断**；**⑦ ★0、fork 0 说明关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、安全性或可用于生产**；**⑧ 图表中「Prudential」无关；本项目与 Midnight 网络的关系（是否获其资助或认可）本次未核实**；**⑨ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/zarkbns/condition` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 22,699 字节，Status 段与两代合约声明逐字核对）；**未访问链上浏览器、未打开 docs/DEPLOYMENTS.md、未克隆、未运行测试**。

**Condition** is **a privacy-preserving parametric insurance implementation on the Midnight blockchain** (repository `zarkbns/condition`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, JavaScript as the primary language, a 64,037 KB repository, created 2026-08-31 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **its topics measurably read insurance-claims, midnightntwrk and zk-proofs**; **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`)**. It belongs to this round’s theme of "what this is, what it is not, how far it got" — **and is the most candid of the four**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 22,699-byte README**): the **README’s title reads verbatim "Condition – Privacy-Preserving Parametric Insurance on Midnight"**; ⭐ **its Status paragraph reads verbatim**: **"Live on Midnight Preprod — the full lifecycle (create → fund → enroll → 2-source trigger → private claim → client-side ZK proof → settle → public receipt) executed on-chain 2026-09-05, all transactions `SUCCESS`"**, **with 208 tests green, a two-layer lifecycle CLI demo and cross-layer digest parity**. ⭐⭐⭐ **The sentence immediately following is the entry’s most notable feature, quoted verbatim**: **"Two contract generations, stated plainly: the contracts in `contracts/` are the hardened Wave-1 sources (capability authorization, registered oracles, canonical trigger binding — see `BUILD_SPEC.md` §12); the Preprod instances deployed 2026-09-05 are the pre-hardening generation and remain the live, verified deployment."** **Section headings read verbatim**: **Judge Quickstart / What is Condition? / The Problem / How It Works / Tech Stack / Why two layers? / Live End-to-End Proof (CLI demo) / Quick Start / What runs where: browser vs CLI / Project Structure / ⭐ Privacy Invariants (mechanically enforced) / ⭐ Wave Roadmap / Why Midnight? / Testing / Deployment / ⭐ Live on Preprod (deployed 2026-09-03 — pre-hardening generation) / Deploying the frontend (Vercel) / Key Files to Read**; ⭐ **the Wave Roadmap has exactly three stages and only the first is ticked**: **Wave 1 — Privacy + Fraud Prevention ✅ (this repo) / Wave 2 — Verifiable Fairness + Audit Trail / Wave 3 — Adoption + Compliance**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "Two contract generations, stated plainly" is the round’s most valuable sentence and a rare honesty** — **it separates "which generation is live" from "which generation is best in the repository"**, **rather than letting a reader assume the deployment is the newest**; **for students of model governance, model risk or audit, this maps onto a real problem: the deployed version differs from the development version, and which one does the report describe?** (**readable with the version-and-reproducibility tradition of [[verified-reserving]], [[reproducible-actuarial-work]] and [[modelx]]**). **② ⭐⭐ The section heading "Privacy Invariants (mechanically enforced)" deserves separate note** — **privacy invariants enforced mechanically rather than promised by policy**; **together with public policies, private claims and a public proof of fair settlement, that is the project’s core design: policies auditable in public, claims details not disclosed, yet fairness of settlement verifiable by anyone** — **a concrete technical resolution of insurance’s hardest trade-off, verifiability against privacy** (**that section’s body was not read, so the invariants and enforcement mechanism are not restated**). **③ ⭐⭐ The "2-source trigger" deserves note** — **parametric insurance depends on external data to trigger, and using two sources addresses its most classic dispute: the credibility and manipulability of trigger data**; **readable with [[aegis-parametric]], [[parametric-insurance-demo]], [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] and [[perils-ied]] — those represent the product and catastrophe sides of parametric insurance, whereas this adds the cryptographic and trigger-mechanism side** (**the trigger criteria were not read, so which two sources and how they are fetched are not restated**). **④ ⭐ The Wave Roadmap ticks only Wave 1 and writes "this repo"** — **it states explicitly that only the first stage is done**, **with Wave 2 (verifiable fairness and audit trail) and Wave 3 (adoption and compliance) not yet built**; **for a reader, how far it got matters far more than how big the vision is** (**the Wave bodies were not read**). **⑤ ⭐ A separate "What runs where: browser vs CLI" section** — **it discloses which parts genuinely run on-chain and which are local demonstration**, **the same family as round 319’s "what it does not prove" in [[powmcp-skills]] and the source discipline of [[prudential-plc-api-profile]]: separating what was actually built from what looks built**. **⑥ ⭐ The "Why two layers?" and "Why Midnight?" sections show both the architecture and the chain-choice rationale are written up** (**not read**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file** (`NONE`) — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before using, deploying or redistributing its contracts and code** (**particularly important for a project containing on-chain contracts**); **② ⭐⭐ "Ran on Midnight Preprod, all transactions SUCCESS, 208 tests green" are all README self-reports** — **no block explorer was visited, no transaction hash checked, nothing cloned or run, and the figure 208 was not verified**, **so they are reported as self-reports and not as established fact** (**the README mentions `docs/DEPLOYMENTS.md` as evidence, but that file was not opened**); **③ ⭐⭐ this check verified the repository metadata, three topics, and the README’s 22,699 bytes in respect of its title, Status paragraph, two-generation statement, section structure and three Wave headings**, ⭐ **but did not read most section bodies** (**including Privacy Invariants, How It Works, The Problem, the Wave sections, Why Midnight? and Deployment**), so **its privacy invariants, trigger mechanism, two-layer rationale, on-chain contract design and deployment parameters cannot be restated**; **④ ⚠️ Preprod is a test network, not mainnet** — **so the entry does not claim the system runs in production or carries real policies**; **⑤ ⭐ the entry does not claim its "privacy preservation" has had an independent security or cryptographic review** — **no audit report was seen**; **⑥ ⭐ parametric insurance is a regulated activity in most jurisdictions**, **and the project’s compliance status and whether it could operate anywhere were not verified; the entry makes no compliance judgement**; **⑦ ★0 and 0 forks indicate extremely low attention**, **so no maturity, security or production-readiness is claimed**; **⑧ the relationship between this project and the Midnight network (funding, endorsement) was not verified**; **⑨ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/zarkbns/condition` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 22,699-byte README with the Status paragraph and two-generation statement checked verbatim); **no block explorer visited, `docs/DEPLOYMENTS.md` not opened, nothing cloned, no tests run**.

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「Two contract generations, stated plainly」是本輪最有價值的一句話，也是一種罕見的誠實**——**它把「**線上跑的是哪一代**」與「**倉庫裡最好的是哪一代**」明確分開**；**對做模型治理或審計的學生，這直接對應一個真實問題：**上線版本與開發版本不一致，而報告裡說的是哪一個****（可與 [[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[modelx]] 並讀）。**② ⭐⭐ 「Privacy Invariants (mechanically enforced)」值得單獨記一筆**——**隱私不變量被**機械強制**，而非靠政策承諾**；**與「公開保單、私有理賠、公開公平結算證明」構成核心設計：**保單公開可審計、理賠細節不外洩、但結算是否公平可由任何人驗證****（**⚠️ 未讀該節正文，故不轉述其不變量與強制方式**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「2-source trigger（雙源觸發）」值得注意**——**參數保險的觸發依賴外部數據源，用**兩個**來源是在處理其最經典的爭議點（**觸發數據的可信度與操縱風險**）**（可與 [[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[perils-ied]] 並讀——**那幾條代表產品與巨災側，本條補的是**密碼學與觸發機制側****）。**④ ⭐ Wave Roadmap 只給 Wave 1 打勾並明寫「this repo」**——**即明確聲明自己**只做到第一階段****。**⑤ ⭐ 「What runs where: browser vs CLI」單設一節**——**交代哪些部分真正在鏈上跑、哪些只是本地演示**（與 [[powmcp-skills]]、[[prudential-plc-api-profile]] 同族）。**⑥ ⭐ 「Why two layers?」與「Why Midnight?」說明架構與選鏈理由均有成文交代**。

entries.body:
**bancassurance-analytics** 是一个**土耳其语的一体化银行保险（bancassurance）分析项目**（仓库 `SultanKus/Bancassurance-Analytics-Project`），**实测 ★1、fork 0、主语言 Jupyter Notebook、仓库体量 275 KB、创建于 2026-08-31、最后推送 2026-09-01**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）、且无 topics**。本条目属于本轮主题**「我是什么、我不是什么、我做到哪一步」**——**它的贡献在于**逐模块标注完成状态****。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，2,039 字节**）：**README 逐字标题为「Bancassurance-Analytics-Project」**，**副题逐字为土耳其语**：**「Bütünleşik Finansal Risk Yönetimi: Kredi Skorlama, Aktüeryal Fiyatlama ve Erken Uyarı (Churn) Sistemleri üzerine matematiksel ve istatistiksel modelleme serisi.」**——**即「一体化金融风险管理：关于信贷评分、精算定价与流失预警系统的数学与统计建模系列」**。⭐ **其正文逐字说明了项目范围与自我定位**：**「Bu proje, bir müşterinin kredi riskinden başlayıp, sigorta (kasko) fiyatlamasına ve son olarak müşteri kaybı (churn) erken uyarı sistemine kadar uzanan uçtan uca bir makine öğrenmesi ve istatistiksel modelleme serisidir.」**——**「本项目是一条端到端的机器学习与统计建模序列，从一个客户的信贷风险开始，延伸到保险（kasko，即车损险）定价，最后到客户流失（churn）早期预警系统」**；⭐ **并逐字声明其方法取向**：**「Standart metriklerin ötesine geçerek, gerçek dünyadaki finansal dengesizlikleri matematiksel bir yaklaşımla çözmeyi hedefler.」**——**「它力求超越标准指标，用数学方法解决真实世界中的金融不平衡问题」**。⭐ **模块状态逐字实测**：**「Modül 1: Kredi Skorlamada Dengesiz Veri Tuzağı (Tamamlandı)」——模块一「信贷评分中的不平衡数据陷阱」标注为 **Tamamlandı（已完成）****；**其模块一说明逐字给出目标与问题**：**目标是计算车贷申请中的违约（坏账）风险，问题是坏账在数据集中占比极低、约 **%8（8%）****。（**其余模块本次仅读到 README 的 2,039 字节为止，未读到完整模块清单，故不转述**。）

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 它填上了本词条所在站点形态普查中长期为**真空白（0）**的「bancassurance/银保」组，但必须紧接着说明：**这**不等于**该形态已被覆盖****——**这是一个 ★1、README 仅 2,039 字节、以土耳其语写作的个人建模项目**，**它证明的是「GitHub 上银保相关的建模实践确实存在且可被检索到」，而不是「本站已有一条有分量的银保条目」**；**⚠️ 本词条据此明确提醒：普查读数由 0 变为 1 之后，**下一轮不应据此认为银保形态已填****（**这是第 317 轮「n 偏小 ≠ 该形态真的空」的**镜像**结论：n 变 1 ≠ 该形态已被覆盖**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「一体化」这一设计本身与银保的业务逻辑相合**——**银保的实质是**同一个客户在银行与保险两侧的风险与价值被合并管理****，**而该项目把「信贷违约风险 → 车险定价 → 流失预警」串成一条链，正好对应这个逻辑**；**可与池内 [[scorecardpy]]（信用评分卡工具）、[[insurance-uplift]]（增益建模）、[[easy-glm]]、[[insurance-thin-data]] 并读**：**其中 [[insurance-thin-data]] 与本项目「不平衡数据陷阱」这一主题最接近**（**本次未读其方法正文，故不转述其用了何种不平衡处理技术**）。**③ ⭐ 「超越标准指标」是一句值得注意的自我要求**——**在违约率仅约 8% 的极度不平衡数据上，准确率等标准指标会给出误导性的好看结果**，**这与本站反复强调的「数字看起来好 ≠ 结论可靠」是同一件事**（**⚠️ 其具体做法本次未读，故不转述**）。**④ ⭐ 逐模块标注完成状态（Tamamlandı）是**弱版本**的「我做到哪一步」**——**它至少让读者知道模块一已完成、其余状态需自行判断**；**⚠️ 但本次只读到 2,039 字节，**未能确认是否存在完整模块清单及各模块状态**，**故本词条不主张「所有模块状态均已标注」**。**⑤ ⭐ kasko（土耳其语车损险）这一险种名值得记一笔**——**可与池内 [[fremtpl2]]（法国车险数据集）、[[higson-motor-insurance-demo]]、[[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]]、[[car-damage-assessment-ai]] 并读：**车险定价与车损评估在多个辖区都是建模主战场****。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件**（`NONE`）**——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用其代码或方法前应自行确认授权状况**；**② ⭐⭐ 本条目是**弱候选**，收录理由是**填补一个真空白形态并如实标注其分量**，**而非因为它本身有分量**——**★1、fork 0、README 仅 2,039 字节、无 topics、无许可**，**本词条明确不主张其质量、完整性、方法正确性或教学价值**；**③** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据与 README 全文（2,039 字节）的标题、副题、项目范围、方法取向与模块一状态**，⭐ **但未读完整模块清单、未打开任何 Jupyter Notebook、未运行任何代码、未查看其数据来源**，因此**不能转述其数据、特征工程、模型选择、不平衡处理技术、任何结果指标或模块二以后的任何内容**；**④ ⭐ 「坏账约占 8%」为**README 自述值**，**本次未核对数据**；**⑤ 项目已完成到什么程度无法判断**——**README 只明确标注了模块一为已完成**，**其余模块是否存在、是否完成本次未核实**；**⑥ 数据来源、是否使用真实数据、是否涉及个人数据、合规状态本次均未核实**（**本词条据此不主张其数据可复用或符合任何隐私要求**）；**⑦ 土耳其语项目对本站读者的**直接可用性有限****——**本词条如实标注其语言，不主张存在中文或英文版本**（**本次未核实是否有其他语言材料**）；**⑧** 本词条**不主张**该项目适用于任何真实的银保业务或定价决策**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/SultanKus/Bancassurance-Analytics-Project` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 2,039 字节，土耳其语原文逐字节录并附中文对译）；**未打开任何 notebook、未运行代码**。
entries.body_en:
**bancassurance-analytics** is **an integrated Turkish-language bancassurance analytics project** (repository `SultanKus/Bancassurance-Analytics-Project`), with **measured ★1, 0 forks, Jupyter Notebook as the primary language, a 275 KB repository, created 2026-08-31 and last pushed 2026-09-01** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`) and no topics**. It belongs to this round’s theme of "what this is, what it is not, how far it got" — **its contribution is labelling each module’s completion status**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 2,039-byte README**): the **README’s title reads verbatim "Bancassurance-Analytics-Project"**, with the **subtitle verbatim in Turkish**: **"Bütünleşik Finansal Risk Yönetimi: Kredi Skorlama, Aktüeryal Fiyatlama ve Erken Uyarı (Churn) Sistemleri üzerine matematiksel ve istatistiksel modelleme serisi."** — **"Integrated financial risk management: a series of mathematical and statistical modelling on credit scoring, actuarial pricing and churn early-warning systems."** ⭐ **Its body states the scope and self-positioning verbatim**: **"Bu proje, bir müşterinin kredi riskinden başlayıp, sigorta (kasko) fiyatlamasına ve son olarak müşteri kaybı (churn) erken uyarı sistemine kadar uzanan uçtan uca bir makine öğrenmesi ve istatistiksel modelleme serisidir."** — **an end-to-end machine-learning and statistical modelling series running from a client’s credit risk through motor (kasko) pricing to a churn early-warning system**; ⭐ **and its methodological stance verbatim**: **"Standart metriklerin ötesine geçerek, gerçek dünyadaki finansal dengesizlikleri matematiksel bir yaklaşımla çözmeyi hedefler."** — **it aims to go beyond standard metrics and tackle real-world financial imbalance mathematically**. ⭐ **Module status read verbatim**: **"Modül 1: Kredi Skorlamada Dengesiz Veri Tuzağı (Tamamlandı)"** — module one, "the imbalanced-data trap in credit scoring", is labelled **Tamamlandı (completed)**; **its module-one description states the goal as computing default risk on vehicle-loan applications and the problem as defaults being only about 8% (%8) of the dataset**. (**Only the 2,039 bytes of README were read, so the full module list is not restated.**)

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐ It fills the "bancassurance" group that has long been a true zero in this site’s form census — but this must be immediately qualified: it does not mean the form is covered** — **this is a ★1 personal modelling project with a 2,039-byte README written in Turkish**; **what it demonstrates is that bancassurance modelling practice exists on GitHub and is findable, not that this site now holds a substantial bancassurance entry**; **⚠️ the entry therefore warns explicitly that a census reading moving from 0 to 1 should not lead the next round to treat the bancassurance form as filled** (**the mirror of round 317’s "a small n does not mean the form is truly empty": n becoming 1 does not mean the form is covered**). **② ⭐⭐ The "integrated" design itself matches the business logic of bancassurance** — **bancassurance really means one client’s risk and value being managed jointly across the bank and insurance sides**, **and chaining credit default risk, motor pricing and churn warning into one sequence corresponds to exactly that**; **readable with [[scorecardpy]] (credit scorecards), [[insurance-uplift]] (uplift modelling), [[easy-glm]] and [[insurance-thin-data]]** — **of these, [[insurance-thin-data]] is closest to its "imbalanced-data trap" theme** (**its method body was not read, so no imbalance technique is restated**). **③ ⭐ "Beyond standard metrics" is a notable self-requirement** — **on data with roughly 8% default rate, standard metrics such as accuracy give misleadingly good results**, **the same point this site keeps making: numbers looking good does not mean the conclusion is sound** (**its specific approach was not read**). **④ ⭐ Labelling each module’s status (Tamamlandı) is a weak version of "how far I got"** — **at least it tells the reader module one is complete while leaving the rest to be judged**; **⚠️ but only 2,039 bytes were read, so whether a complete module list and statuses exist could not be confirmed, and the entry does not claim all statuses are labelled**. **⑤ ⭐ The term kasko (Turkish motor own-damage cover) is worth noting** — **readable with [[fremtpl2]] (a French motor dataset), [[higson-motor-insurance-demo]], [[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]] and [[car-damage-assessment-ai]]: motor pricing and damage assessment are a modelling battleground across jurisdictions**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file** (`NONE`) — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before using its code or methods**; **② ⭐⭐ This is a weak candidate, collected to fill a true-zero form while labelling its weight honestly, not because it is substantial in itself** — **★1, 0 forks, a 2,039-byte README, no topics, no licence**; **the entry claims no quality, completeness, methodological correctness or teaching value**; **③** this check verified **the repository metadata and the README’s 2,039 bytes in respect of its title, subtitle, scope, methodological stance and module-one status**, ⭐ **but did not read the full module list, open any Jupyter Notebook, run any code or inspect its data sources**, so **its data, feature engineering, model choice, imbalance handling, any result metric, and anything after module two cannot be restated**; **④ ⭐ "Defaults are about 8%" is a README self-report**, **not checked against data**; **⑤ how far the project is actually complete cannot be judged** — **the README explicitly marks only module one as completed**, **and whether other modules exist or are done was not verified**; **⑥ data sources, whether real data is used, whether personal data is involved, and compliance status were not verified** (**so no reusability or privacy compliance is claimed**); **⑦ a Turkish-language project has limited direct usability for this site’s readers** — **stated plainly, with no claim that Chinese or English versions exist** (**other language material was not checked**); **⑧** the entry **does not claim the project is suitable for any real bancassurance business or pricing decision**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/SultanKus/Bancassurance-Analytics-Project` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 2,039-byte README, with the Turkish original quoted verbatim and glossed in Chinese); **no notebook opened, no code run**.

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測，2,039 位元組**）：**逐字標題「Bancassurance-Analytics-Project」**，**副題逐字為土耳其語**：**「Bütünleşik Finansal Risk Yönetimi: Kredi Skorlama, Aktüeryal Fiyatlama ve Erken Uyarı (Churn) Sistemleri üzerine matematiksel ve istatistiksel modelleme serisi.」**——**即「一體化金融風險管理：關於信貸評分、精算定價與流失預警系統的數學與統計建模系列」**。⭐ **正文逐字說明範圍**：**「…uçtan uca bir makine öğrenmesi ve istatistiksel modelleme serisidir.」**——**「一條端到端的機器學習與統計建模序列，從客戶的信貸風險開始，延伸到保險（kasko，車損險）定價，最後到客戶流失早期預警系統」**；⭐ **方法取向逐字**：**「Standart metriklerin ötesine geçerek, gerçek dünyadaki finansal dengesizlikleri matematiksel bir yaklaşımla çözmeyi hedefler.」**——**「力求超越標準指標，用數學方法解決真實世界中的金融不平衡問題」**。⭐ **模組狀態逐字**：**「Modül 1: Kredi Skorlamada Dengesiz Veri Tuzağı (Tamamlandı)」**——**模組一標註為 **Tamamlandı（已完成）****；**其說明逐字指出目標為計算車貸申請的違約風險、問題為壞賬在數據集中僅約 **%8（8%）****。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 它填上了本站形態普查中長期為**真空白（0）**的「bancassurance/銀保」組，但必須緊接說明：**這**不等於**該形態已被覆蓋****——**這是一個 ★1、README 僅 2,039 位元組、以土耳其語寫作的個人建模項目**；**⚠️ 本詞條據此明確提醒：普查讀數由 0 變 1 之後，**下一輪不應據此認為銀保形態已填****（**這是第 317 輪「n 偏小 ≠ 該形態真的空」的**鏡像**結論**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「一體化」這一設計本身與銀保的業務邏輯相合**——**銀保的實質是**同一個客戶在銀行與保險兩側的風險與價值被合併管理****（可與 [[scorecardpy]]、[[insurance-uplift]]、[[easy-glm]]、[[insurance-thin-data]] 並讀——**其中 [[insurance-thin-data]] 與本項目「不平衡數據陷阱」主題最接近**）。**③ ⭐ 「超越標準指標」是一句值得注意的自我要求**——**在違約率僅約 8% 的極度不平衡數據上，準確率等標準指標會給出誤導性的好看結果**（**⚠️ 其具體做法本次未讀**）。**④ ⭐ 逐模組標註完成狀態（Tamamlandı）是**弱版本**的「我做到哪一步」**；**⚠️ 但本次只讀到 2,039 位元組，未能確認是否存在完整模組清單及各模組狀態**。**⑤ ⭐ kasko（土耳其語車損險）這一險種名值得記一筆**（可與 [[fremtpl2]]、[[higson-motor-insurance-demo]]、[[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]]、[[car-damage-assessment-ai]] 並讀）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 該倉庫實測**無任何許可文件****——**明確記錄，並提示使用其代碼或方法前應自行確認授權**；**② ⭐⭐ 本條目是**弱候選**，收錄理由是**填補一個真空白形態並如實標註其分量**，**而非因為它本身有分量**——**★1、fork 0、README 僅 2,039 位元組、無 topics、無許可**；**本詞條明確不主張其質量、完整性、方法正確性或教學價值**；**③** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據與 README 全文（2,039 位元組）的標題、副題、範圍、方法取向與模組一狀態**，⭐ **但未讀完整模組清單、未打開任何 Jupyter Notebook、未運行代碼、未查看數據來源**；**④ ⭐ 「壞賬約佔 8%」為**README 自述值**，未核對數據**；**⑤ 項目完成到什麼程度無法判斷**——**README 只明確標註模組一已完成**；**⑥ 數據來源、是否使用真實數據、是否涉及個人數據、合規狀態均未核實**；**⑦ 土耳其語項目對本站讀者的**直接可用性有限****——**如實標註其語言，不主張存在中文或英文版本**；**⑧** 本詞條**不主張**該項目適用於任何真實的銀保業務或定價決策**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/SultanKus/Bancassurance-Analytics-Project` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未打開任何 notebook、未運行代碼**。

entries.body:
**claim-fraud-dataset-generator** 是一个**保险理赔欺诈检测的合成数据集生成器**（仓库 `MobeenFatimaa/Insurance-Claim-Fraud-Detection-Dataset-Generator`），**Apache-2.0 许可，实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Jupyter Notebook、仓库体量 180 KB、创建于 2026-08-17、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**其 topics 逐字实测达 17 项**，含 **synthetic-dataset-generation、fraud-detection、anomaly-detection、explainable-ai、shap、classification、tabular-data、insurance-claims、claim-verification、feature-engineering、xgboost、numpy、pandas、data-science、finance、machine-learning、dataset**。本条目属于本轮主题**「我是什么、我不是什么、我做到哪一步」**——**它的贡献在于把数据集的**规格**逐项写明****。

可核实信息（**均仓库描述与 topics 逐字实测**）：**仓库描述逐字为**：**「Synthetic dataset generator and 100k-row insurance claim dataset for machine learning, fraud detection, anomaly detection, and explainable AI (SHAP/LIME). Features 61 correlated variables, realistic fraud risk scoring, zero missing values, and a calibrated ~20% fraud target rate.」**——**即：一个合成数据集生成器 + 一份 10 万行理赔数据集，面向机器学习、欺诈检测、异常检测与可解释 AI（SHAP/LIME）；特征为 **61 个相关变量、贴近现实的欺诈风险评分、零缺失值、以及一个**校准过的约 20% 欺诈目标率****。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「校准过的约 20% 欺诈目标率（calibrated ~20% fraud target rate）」是本条最值得注意的一项，也是它与同类合成数据集最实质的差别**——**合成数据最容易的失败是**凭空造一个类别比例然后宣称「贴近现实」****；**而「校准」暗示该比例是**对着某个真实基准**调出来的**；**对做欺诈建模的学生，类别比例直接决定用什么指标、以及 PR 曲线长什么样**（**⚠️ 本次未验证其「校准」对照的是什么基准、也未打开数据**——**故「校准」二字在本词条内只作为**其自述用词**转述，不主张其确实经过校准**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「61 个相关变量（correlated variables）」值得单独记一笔**——**很多教学数据集是**各列独立生成**的，于是任何模型都能轻易拟合、却学不到真实数据里变量间的依赖结构**；**明确声明变量**相关**，说明生成过程有意保留了协方差结构**；**这与池内 [[gen-syn]]、[[insurance-datasets-synthetic]]、[[insurance-synthetic]]、[[stressed-insurance-datasets]] 所代表的合成保险数据传统相接**（**本次未读其生成代码，故不转述其依赖结构如何构造**）。**③ ⭐ ⭐ 「零缺失值（zero missing values）」是一条**双面**规格**——**一方面它让教学流程不被缺失值打断，另一方面它**恰恰偏离了真实理赔数据的常态**（**真实理赔数据普遍存在缺失，而且缺失本身常是信号**）；**本词条如实列出该规格，并提示：用它做练习可以，但**不要把「零缺失」当成理赔数据的特征****（**可与池内 [[insurance-thin-data]]、[[acord-data-quality-monitor]] 所关注的数据质量与稀疏性问题并读**）。**④ ⭐ 17 项 topics 已经把方法边界划得很清楚**——**SHAP／LIME（可解释）、XGBoost（建模）、tabular-data（数据类型）**并列，**说明它面向的是**表格数据上的可解释欺诈分类**，而非深度学习或非结构化理赔文本**；**可与池内 [[explainable-ai-fraud]]、[[ifraudsimulator]]、[[networkfraud]]、[[shap-relativities]]、[[claims-fraud-guardian]] 并读**。**⑤ ⭐ 「generator + dataset」双重形态意味着它**既可当数据用、也可当生成方法学**——**对需要自己造练习数据或做基准对照的学生更有用**（**本次未读生成器代码，故不转述其生成方式**）。**⑥ ⭐ Apache-2.0 是本轮四条中**许可最清晰**的一条**——**合成数据在许可上通常比真实数据简单**，**这也是它相对于真实理赔数据的一个现实优势**（**⚠️ 但本项目未声明其生成结果是否附带额外条款，本次未核实**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据（Apache-2.0、★0、fork 0、Jupyter Notebook、180 KB、创建与推送时间）、topics 17 项、以及仓库描述全文的逐字内容**，⭐ **但**未下载数据集、未打开任何 notebook、未运行生成器、未验证 10 万行／61 变量／零缺失／约 20% 欺诈率这四个数字**——**它们均为**仓库描述自述值****；**② ⭐⭐ 「calibrated（校准过的）」是**其自述用词**，**本次未核实其校准所对标的基准、方法或数据来源**，**故不主张该比例确实经过校准**；**③ ⭐ 用例提示**：**因变量仅 61 个且零缺失，该数据集适合教学、基准与方法对照，但**不宜作为真实理赔数据分布的代表****；**由于本词条所在站点整体以「可核实」为准，此处特别标注：**合成数据的任何结论都不能直接迁移到真实理赔业务****；**④** 本次**未读其 README**（**本次仅取到仓库描述与 topics**），**故不转述其使用说明、目录结构、字段定义或示例代码**；**⑤ ⭐ 该数据集是否已被任何论文或基准引用本次未核实**，**不主张其被采用或具有可比性**；**⑥ 合成数据涉及「是否可能泄露真实个人数据」的问题**——**按其自述为生成式合成数据，**但本次未核实其生成方式是否能保证不包含任何真实个体信息****；**⑦ ★0、fork 0 说明关注度极低**，**不主张其质量或可用性**；**⑧ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/MobeenFatimaa/Insurance-Claim-Fraud-Detection-Dataset-Generator` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（仓库描述与 17 项 topics 逐字核对）；**未下载数据、未打开 notebook、未运行生成器**。
entries.body_en:
**claim-fraud-dataset-generator** is **a synthetic dataset generator for insurance claim fraud detection** (repository `MobeenFatimaa/Insurance-Claim-Fraud-Detection-Dataset-Generator`), **Apache-2.0 licensed, with measured ★0, 0 forks, Jupyter Notebook as the primary language, a 180 KB repository, created 2026-08-17 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **its topics measurably number 17**, including **synthetic-dataset-generation, fraud-detection, anomaly-detection, explainable-ai, shap, classification, tabular-data, insurance-claims, claim-verification, feature-engineering, xgboost, numpy, pandas, data-science, finance, machine-learning and dataset**. It belongs to this round’s theme of "what this is, what it is not, how far it got" — **its contribution is spelling out the dataset’s specification item by item**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the repository description and topics**): the **repository description reads verbatim**: **"Synthetic dataset generator and 100k-row insurance claim dataset for machine learning, fraud detection, anomaly detection, and explainable AI (SHAP/LIME). Features 61 correlated variables, realistic fraud risk scoring, zero missing values, and a calibrated ~20% fraud target rate."**

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐ "A calibrated ~20% fraud target rate" is the entry’s most notable item and its most substantive difference from comparable synthetic datasets** — **the easiest failure of synthetic data is inventing a class ratio out of thin air and calling it realistic**; **"calibrated" implies the ratio was tuned against some real benchmark**; **for students building fraud models, the class ratio directly determines which metrics apply and what the precision-recall curve looks like** (**⚠️ what benchmark its "calibration" refers to was not verified, and the data was not opened — so "calibrated" is restated only as the project’s own wording, not as an established fact**). **② ⭐⭐ "61 correlated variables" deserves separate note** — **many teaching datasets generate each column independently, so any model fits easily and learns nothing about the dependence structure of real data**; **stating that the variables are correlated implies the generation process deliberately preserves a covariance structure**; **this connects to the synthetic insurance data tradition of [[gen-syn]], [[insurance-datasets-synthetic]], [[insurance-synthetic]] and [[stressed-insurance-datasets]]** (**its generation code was not read, so the dependence structure is not restated**). **③ ⭐ "Zero missing values" is a two-sided specification** — **it keeps a teaching pipeline unbroken, yet it also departs from the norm of real claims data** (**real claims data generally has missing values, and the missingness itself is often a signal**); **the entry lists the specification plainly and warns: fine for practice, but do not mistake zero missingness for a property of claims data** (**readable with [[insurance-thin-data]] and [[acord-data-quality-monitor]]**). **④ ⭐ The 17 topics already draw the methodological boundary clearly** — **SHAP/LIME (explainability), XGBoost (modelling) and tabular-data together show it targets explainable fraud classification on tabular data, not deep learning or unstructured claims text**; **readable with [[explainable-ai-fraud]], [[ifraudsimulator]], [[networkfraud]], [[shap-relativities]] and [[claims-fraud-guardian]]**. **⑤ ⭐ The dual form of "generator plus dataset" means it serves both as data and as a generation method** — **more useful for students who need to create their own practice data or run benchmark comparisons** (**the generator code was not read, so its generation method is not restated**). **⑥ ⭐ Apache-2.0 is the clearest licence among this round’s four** — **licensing is usually simpler for synthetic than real data**, **a practical advantage over real claims data** (**⚠️ whether the generated output carries additional terms was not verified**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the repository metadata (Apache-2.0, ★0, 0 forks, Jupyter Notebook, 180 KB, creation and push dates), the 17 topics, and the full repository description read verbatim**, ⭐ **but did not download the dataset, open any notebook, run the generator, or verify the four figures of 100k rows, 61 variables, zero missing values and ~20% fraud rate** — **these are all repository-description self-reports**; **② ⭐⭐ "Calibrated" is the project’s own wording**, **and the benchmark, method or data source behind that calibration were not verified**, **so the entry does not claim the ratio is genuinely calibrated**; **③ ⭐ A usage note: with only 61 variables and no missingness, the dataset suits teaching, benchmarking and method comparison but is not representative of real claims data distributions**; **and since this site is built on verifiability, it is flagged explicitly that no conclusion drawn from synthetic data transfers directly to real claims operations**; **④** its **README was not read** (**only the repository description and topics were obtained**), **so its usage notes, directory structure, field definitions and example code are not restated**; **⑤ ⭐ whether the dataset has been cited by any paper or benchmark was not verified**, **and no claim of adoption or comparability is made**; **⑥ synthetic data raises the question of whether it could leak real personal data** — **it describes itself as generative synthetic data, but whether the generation method guarantees no real individuals are represented was not verified**; **⑦ ★0 and 0 forks indicate extremely low attention**, **so no quality or usability is claimed**; **⑧ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/MobeenFatimaa/Insurance-Claim-Fraud-Detection-Dataset-Generator` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the repository description and 17 topics checked verbatim); **no data downloaded, no notebook opened, no generator run**.
entries.body_hk:
**claim-fraud-dataset-generator** 是一個**保險理賠欺詐檢測的合成數據集生成器**（倉庫 `MobeenFatimaa/Insurance-Claim-Fraud-Detection-Dataset-Generator`），**Apache-2.0 許可，實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Jupyter Notebook、體量 180 KB、創建於 2026-08-17、最後推送 2026-09-09**；**其 topics 逐字實測達 17 項**，含 **synthetic-dataset-generation、fraud-detection、anomaly-detection、explainable-ai、shap、classification、tabular-data、insurance-claims、claim-verification、feature-engineering、xgboost** 等。本條目屬本輪主題**「我是什麼、我不是什麼、我做到哪一步」**——**它的貢獻在於把數據集的**規格**逐項寫明****。

可核實資訊（**均倉庫描述與 topics 逐字實測**）：**描述逐字為**：**「Synthetic dataset generator and 100k-row insurance claim dataset for machine learning, fraud detection, anomaly detection, and explainable AI (SHAP/LIME). Features 61 correlated variables, realistic fraud risk scoring, zero missing values, and a calibrated ~20% fraud target rate.」**——**即 **61 個相關變量、貼近現實的欺詐風險評分、零缺失值、以及一個**校準過的約 20% 欺詐目標率****。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「校準過的約 20% 欺詐目標率」是本條最值得注意的一項**——**合成數據最容易的失敗是**憑空造一個類別比例然後宣稱「貼近現實」****；**「校準」暗示該比例是**對著某個真實基準**調出來的**；**對做欺詐建模的學生，類別比例直接決定用什麼指標、以及 PR 曲線長什麼樣**（**⚠️ 本次未驗證其校準對照的是什麼基準、也未打開數據**——**故在本詞條內只作為**其自述用詞**轉述**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「61 個相關變量」值得單獨記一筆**——**很多教學數據集是**各列獨立生成**的，於是任何模型都能輕易擬合、卻學不到真實數據裡變量間的依賴結構**（可與 [[gen-syn]]、[[insurance-datasets-synthetic]]、[[insurance-synthetic]]、[[stressed-insurance-datasets]] 並讀）。**③ ⭐ 「零缺失值」是一條**雙面**規格**——**一方面讓教學流程不被缺失值打斷，另一方面它**恰恰偏離了真實理賠數據的常態****（**真實理賠數據普遍存在缺失，而且缺失本身常是信號**）；**故提示：用它做練習可以，但**不要把「零缺失」當成理賠數據的特徵****（可與 [[insurance-thin-data]]、[[acord-data-quality-monitor]] 並讀）。**④ ⭐ 17 項 topics 已把方法邊界劃清**——**SHAP／LIME、XGBoost、tabular-data 並列，說明它面向**表格數據上的可解釋欺詐分類****（可與 [[explainable-ai-fraud]]、[[ifraudsimulator]]、[[networkfraud]]、[[shap-relativities]]、[[claims-fraud-guardian]] 並讀）。**⑤ ⭐ 「generator ＋ dataset」雙重形態意味著它**既可當數據用、也可當生成方法學****。**⑥ ⭐ Apache-2.0 是本輪四條中**許可最清晰**的一條**（**⚠️ 未聲明生成結果是否附帶額外條款，本次未核實**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據（Apache-2.0、★0、fork 0、Jupyter Notebook、180 KB、創建與推送時間）、topics 17 項與描述全文**，⭐ **但**未下載數據集、未打開任何 notebook、未運行生成器、未驗證 10 萬行／61 變量／零缺失／約 20% 欺詐率這四個數字****——**均為**描述自述值****；**② ⭐⭐ 「calibrated（校準過的）」是**其自述用詞**，**本次未核實其校準所對標的基準、方法或數據來源**；**③ ⭐ 用例提示：該數據集適合教學、基準與方法對照，但**不宜作為真實理賠數據分布的代表****；**特別標註：**合成數據的任何結論都不能直接遷移到真實理賠業務****；**④** 本次**未讀其 README**（**僅取到描述與 topics**），**故不轉述其使用說明、目錄結構、欄位定義或示例代碼**；**⑤ ⭐ 是否已被任何論文或基準引用未核實**；**⑥ 合成數據涉及「是否可能洩露真實個人數據」的問題**——**按其自述為生成式合成數據，**但本次未核實其生成方式能否保證不含任何真實個體資訊****；**⑦ ★0、fork 0 說明關注度極低**；**⑧ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/MobeenFatimaa/Insurance-Claim-Fraud-Detection-Dataset-Generator` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未下載數據、未打開 notebook、未運行生成器**。

entries.title: EU-U.S. Insurance Dialogue Project（欧盟—美国保险对话项目）：跨境监管对话机制与逐年工作流

entries.summary: 2012 年由美国财政部联邦保险办公室（FIO）召集欧盟委员会、EIOPA 与美国各州保险监管者参与的双边监管对话项目，指导委员会下辖技术委员会逐年比较欧美监管制度；议题历经网络风险与网络保险、大数据与 AI、气候风险与韧性；EIOPA 侧另有一份 2025 年 11 月总结报告
entries.summary_en: A bilateral supervisory dialogue convened in 2012 by the US Treasury Federal Insurance Office with the European Commission, EIOPA and US state insurance regulators, in which technical committees under a Steering Committee compare the EU and US regimes year by year; its topics have run from cyber risk and the cyber insurance market through big data and AI to climate risk and resilience, and EIOPA holds a further summary report dated November 2025
entries.summary_hk: 2012 年由美國財政部聯邦保險辦公室（FIO）召集歐盟委員會、EIOPA 與美國各州保險監管者參與的雙邊監管對話項目，指導委員會下轄技術委員會逐年比較歐美監管制度；議題歷經網絡風險與網絡保險、大數據與 AI、氣候風險與韌性；EIOPA 側另有一份 2025 年 11 月總結報告
entries.body:
**us-eu-insurance-project** 是**欧盟与美国之间的双边保险监管对话机制**（美国方面页面位于 `home.treasury.gov` 联邦保险办公室 FIO 之下）。本条目填上本词条所在站点形态普查中长期为**真空白（0）**的**「跨国监管对话」**形态。

可核实信息（**均经探活与逐字实测**）：**美国财政部页面 HTTP 200、实测 76.3KB（78,146 字节）、标题逐字为「EU-U.S. Insurance Project | U.S. Department of the Treasury」**；**其正文关键段落逐字实测**：⭐ **项目目标**——**「The objective of the Project is to increase mutual understanding and enhance cooperation between the EU and the United States in order to promote business opportunity, consumer protection, and effective supervision.」**；⭐ **起源**——**「In early 2012, FIO convened the insurance leadership of the European Commission, European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA), and state regulators to participate in a dialogue project.」**；⭐ **组织方式**——**「The Project Steering Committee oversees technical committees that analyze and compare the EU and U.S. regimes on topics of mutual interest.」**——**即**指导委员会**下辖**技术委员会**，逐年比较两套监管制度****。
**推进历程逐字实测**：**2012 年 12 月**，指导委员会发布一份双方同意的 **「Way Forward」**，**页面逐字称其「defined 7 common objectives and initiatives」**，**枚举为**：**professional secrecy/confidentiality、group supervision、solvency and capital requirements、reinsurance and collateral requirements、supervisory reporting、data collection and analysis、peer reviews、independent third party review and supervisory on-site examinations**（⚠️ **逐字写 7 项，却枚举出 8 项——本词条如实并列，不代为取舍**）；**2014 年 7 月**更新该 Way Forward 并重申承诺；**其后**公布三个新议题**（网络安全风险与网络保险市场、保险业大数据的使用、以集团内部交易为重点的集团监管后续工作）**；**2018 年**就上述议题发文并在**卢森堡**举办公开论坛；**2020 年 3 月**发布各工作组 2019 年工作的更新总结报告，**原定 2020 年 3 月的公开活动因新冠疫情推迟**；**2021 年 10 月**以线上研讨会形式举办并发布总结报告；**2022 年**指导委员会决定聚焦三个议题：**① 气候风险金融监督（含气候风险披露、监管报送与其他金融监测）② 气候风险与韧性（含创新技术、灾前减损与适应、建模）③ 技术与创新（含大数据与人工智能、把 SupTech 作为监管工具）**；**相关工作流 2022–2023 年间定期开会**；**2023 年 6 月在华盛顿州西雅图举办公开论坛**并发布三个工作流的总结报告。**页面列出并链接的报告组逐字实测**为：**2023 Public Forum（Workstream 1 Climate Risk Financial Oversight／Workstream 2 Climate Risk and Resilience／Workstream 3 Innovation and Technology）、2021 Public Forum（Cyber Insurance Market／Insurer Cybersecurity／Big Data and Artificial Intelligence）、2020 Summary**。
⭐⭐ **另一侧更近的证据（欧方）**：**本词条另经实测确认 EIOPA 侧存在一份**2025 年 11 月**的总结报告**——**该 PDF 实测 HTTP 200、337,520 字节（329.6KB）、`file` 判定为 PDF 1.7、共 9 页**；**并进一步以程序方式抽取其文本**（⚠️ **因字体编码，抽取结果丢失部分字形，故仅引用完全可辨认的句子，其余以「据该报告」转述并标注方法局限**）；⭐⭐ **其中一句完全可辨认、且是本条目最有分量的一条事实**：**「Together, the EU and US regulators oversee approximately two thirds of the global insurance market.」——欧盟与美国监管者合计监管全球保险市场约三分之二**；**另一句可辨认的表述**：**「The Steering Committee chooses key topics they consider to be fundamentally important to the protection of policyholders and financial stability.」**——**议题由指导委员会按「对保单持有人保护与金融稳定是否根本重要」选定**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「跨国监管对话」这一形态的难点在于它通常**不是一家机构，而是一套机制****——**这正是本站普查此前一直把它读成 0 的原因（按机构名检索天然打不出命中）**；**本条目首次把它落成两条可核实的一手页面（美方 Treasury ＋ 欧方 EIOPA），从而说明该形态**确实存在且持续运作到 2025 年 11 月****（**⚠️ 但这不等于「本站已覆盖跨境监管对话」——本条目覆盖的是**这一对**（欧美）的**一个**项目**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「约三分之二的全球保险市场」是对读者最有用的一条量化事实**——**它一句话讲清「为什么这两个辖区的对话重要」**；**⚠️ 该句出自 EIOPA 2025 年 11 月报告、系**程序抽取**所得（**字形丢失已如实说明**），**故词条内标注为「据该报告」，不主张已核实其统计口径与计算基础**；**可与池内 [[iais]] 的全球监管框架、[[insurance-europe]] 的欧洲行业立场、[[geneva-association]] 的全球风险研究并读**：**三者分别是全球规则、区域行业与全球研究，而本条目是**两个辖区之间的对等对话机制****。**③ ⭐⭐ 「议题按『对保单持有人保护与金融稳定是否根本重要』选定」是一条可直接引用的**机制设计说明****——**它把「为什么谈这些而不谈那些」写成选择标准，而非一份无从追问的议题清单**（可与 [[iais-icp]]、[[iais-gimar]] 并读）。**④ ⭐⭐ 议题演变本身就是一份**监管关切时间线**，且对精算学生有直接价值**：**网络风险与网络保险 → 大数据与 AI → 气候风险金融监督与气候韧性 → AI 与 SupTech 作为监管工具**——**2022 年起把「气候」与「技术与创新」并列为两条主线，说明二者已从专题升为长期工作流**；**可与 [[ngfs]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]、[[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]] 并读**（**未打开任何一份总结报告正文，故不转述其结论**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ 「2020 年 3 月的公开活动因新冠疫情推迟」值得单独记一笔**——**这是一条罕见的、把**机制自身受外部冲击**写进记录的例子**；**对研究监管协作连续性的人，这类「中断与恢复」记录比顺利年份更有信息量**（**2020 年推迟 → 2021 年改线上**）。**⑥ ⚠️ 一处必须指出的**页面时效问题****：**美国财政部页面在叙述 2017–2019 年议题时仍以「Most recently（最近）」开头，**而其后内容已推进到 2023 年**——**页面措辞未随内容更新**；**且该页本次未见 2024 年以后的记录，而 EIOPA 侧已有 2025 年 11 月报告**——**故本词条**不**以 Treasury 页面的截至范围代表项目现状**，**也不主张该项目 2024–2025 年间的具体安排**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**美国财政部该页面的 HTTP 状态、体量、标题与正文关键段落（逐字）**，**以及 EIOPA 侧一份 PDF 的 HTTP 状态、字节数、PDF 版本与页数，并对其文本做了程序化抽取**——⭐ **但**未打开该页面链接的任何一份总结报告**（2023 三份、2021 三份、2020 总结均未打开）**，**未访问欧盟委员会或 EIOPA 的项目主页，未访问任何一次公开论坛的材料**，因此**不能转述任何一次对话的结论、比较结果、共识或分歧**；**② ⚠️⚠️ 对 EIOPA 2025 年 11 月报告的**方法局限已写明**：**文本系程序抽取、因字体编码丢失部分字形**，**故只引用完全可辨认的句子，其余以「据该报告」转述**；**「约三分之二」未核实其统计口径、年份与来源**；**③ ⭐ **未核实**该 PDF 的正式标题、发布日期字段与发布主体署名**——**「2025 年 11 月」来自抽取文本首部字样与检索结果标题，本词条据此标注，不主张已从文件元数据独立确认**（**该 PDF 实测无 `/Title` 元数据**）；**④ ⭐ 「7 项」与枚举出的 8 项不一致，**本词条如实并列、不代为解释**——**可能是笔误、也可能某项被合并计为一项**，**本次未追查 Way Forward 原文**；**⑤ 该项目是否仍在运作、2024 年以后是否继续开会本次未核实**（**仅知欧方存在 2025 年 11 月报告**）；**⑥ 该机制是否具法律效力、其产出对成员国是否具约束力本次未核实**——**本词条**不主张**其结论具有约束力或已被任何辖区采纳**；**⑦ 中欧、港美或其他区域的同类机制本次未检索**，**故**不主张**「跨国监管对话」这一形态已被完整覆盖**；**⑧ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**。**核实说明**：财政部页面经 `discovery/probe-urls.sh` HTTP 200 实测（76.3KB／78,146 字节），正文经 HTML 文本化后逐字读取；EIOPA PDF 经探活实测 HTTP 200（337,520 字节、PDF 1.7、9 页），文本经程序抽取（**字形有丢失**）；**未打开任何一份总结报告，未访问欧盟委员会或 EIOPA 项目主页**。
entries.body_en:
**us-eu-insurance-project** is **the bilateral insurance supervisory dialogue mechanism between the European Union and the United States** (the US-side page sits under the Federal Insurance Office at `home.treasury.gov`). This entry fills the **"cross-border supervisory dialogue"** form, which had long read as a **true zero** in this site’s census.

Verifiable details (**all measured by probing and read verbatim**): the **US Treasury page returned HTTP 200, measured 76.3KB (78,146 bytes), with the title verbatim "EU-U.S. Insurance Project | U.S. Department of the Treasury"**; **key passages read verbatim**: ⭐ **the objective** — **"The objective of the Project is to increase mutual understanding and enhance cooperation between the EU and the United States in order to promote business opportunity, consumer protection, and effective supervision."**; ⭐ **the origin** — **"In early 2012, FIO convened the insurance leadership of the European Commission, European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA), and state regulators to participate in a dialogue project."**; ⭐ **the structure** — **"The Project Steering Committee oversees technical committees that analyze and compare the EU and U.S. regimes on topics of mutual interest."** — **a Steering Committee over technical committees comparing the two regimes year by year**.
**Progress read verbatim**: in **December 2012** the Steering Committee published an agreed **"Way Forward"**, which the page says verbatim **"defined 7 common objectives and initiatives"**, **enumerating**: professional secrecy/confidentiality, group supervision, solvency and capital requirements, reinsurance and collateral requirements, supervisory reporting, data collection and analysis, peer reviews, and independent third party review and supervisory on-site examinations (**⚠️ the text says 7 but enumerates 8 — recorded as found, not reconciled here**); in **July 2014** the Way Forward was updated and the commitment reaffirmed; **next** three new initiatives were announced (**cybersecurity risk and the cyber insurance market, the use of big data in the insurance sector, and continuation of group supervision work focused on intra-group transactions**); in **2018** papers were published on those topics and a public forum was held in **Luxembourg**; in **March 2020** updated summary reports on the working groups’ 2019 work were published and **the public event scheduled for March 2020 was postponed because of COVID-19**; in **October 2021** a public virtual webinar was held with summary reports; in **2022** the Steering Committee decided to focus on three topics: **① climate risk financial oversight (including climate risk disclosures, supervisory reporting and other financial surveillance) ② climate risk and resilience (including innovative technology, pre-disaster mitigation and adaptation, and modelling) ③ technology and innovation (including big data and AI, and SupTech as a regulatory tool)**; the **workstreams met regularly in 2022-2023**; and in **June 2023 a public forum was held in Seattle, Washington**, with summary reports for the three workstreams. **The report groups listed and linked on the page, read verbatim**, are: **2023 Public Forum (Workstream 1 Climate Risk Financial Oversight / Workstream 2 Climate Risk and Resilience / Workstream 3 Innovation and Technology), 2021 Public Forum (Cyber Insurance Market / Insurer Cybersecurity / Big Data and Artificial Intelligence), and 2020 Summary**.
⭐⭐ **Closer evidence from the other side (the EU)**: this entry also **measurably confirmed a summary report dated November 2025 on EIOPA’s side** — the PDF **measured HTTP 200, 337,520 bytes (329.6KB), identified by `file` as PDF 1.7, 9 pages**; **its text was further extracted programmatically** (⚠️ **font encoding dropped some glyphs, so only fully legible sentences are quoted and the rest is reported as "according to that report" with the method limitation stated**); ⭐⭐ **one fully legible sentence is the entry’s weightiest fact**: **"Together, the EU and US regulators oversee approximately two thirds of the global insurance market."**; **another legible statement**: **"The Steering Committee chooses key topics they consider to be fundamentally important to the protection of policyholders and financial stability."**

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ The difficulty of the "cross-border supervisory dialogue" form is that it is usually **not an institution but a mechanism**** — **exactly why this site’s census had long read it as zero (searching by institution name naturally returns nothing)**; **this entry is the first to ground the form in two verifiable first-party pages (US Treasury and EU EIOPA), showing the form exists and ran at least to November 2025** (**⚠️ which is not the same as "cross-border dialogue is covered" — this covers one project between one pair, the EU and US**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ "Approximately two thirds of the global insurance market" is the most useful quantitative fact here** — **it explains in one sentence why dialogue between these two jurisdictions matters**; **⚠️ it comes from the EIOPA November 2025 report and was obtained by programmatic extraction (the glyph loss is stated)**, **so the entry attributes it to that report and does not claim to have verified its statistical basis or reference year**; **readable with [[iais]] (the global regulatory framework), [[insurance-europe]] (the European industry position) and [[geneva-association]] (global risk research)** — **global rules, a regional industry voice and global research, versus a peer-to-peer dialogue between two jurisdictions**. **③ ⭐⭐ The line that topics are chosen by the Steering Committee for being "fundamentally important to the protection of policyholders and financial stability" is a directly citable mechanism-design statement** — **it turns "why these topics and not others" into a stated criterion rather than an unanswerable topic list** (**readable with [[iais-icp]] and [[iais-gimar]]**). **④ ⭐⭐ The topic sequence is itself a timeline of supervisory concern, and it is directly useful to actuarial students**: **cyber risk and cyber insurance → big data and AI → climate risk financial oversight and climate resilience → AI and SupTech as a regulatory tool** — **from 2022, climate and technology/innovation sit as two parallel main lines, showing both moved from special topics to long-term workstreams**; **readable with [[ngfs]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[naic-ai-oversight]] and [[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]]** (**no summary report body was opened, so none of their conclusions are restated**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ That the March 2020 public event was postponed by COVID-19 deserves separate note** — **a rare case of a mechanism recording its own interruption by an external shock**; **for anyone studying the continuity of supervisory cooperation, such interruption-and-resumption records carry more information than smooth years** (**postponed in 2020, moved online in 2021**). **⑥ ⚠️ One page-currency problem must be flagged**: **the US Treasury page still opens its 2017-2019 topic passage with "Most recently", while the content that follows runs to 2023** — **the wording was not updated with the content**; **and the page shows no record beyond 2023 while EIOPA already has a November 2025 report** — **so the entry does not treat the Treasury page’s cut-off as the project’s present state, nor claim its 2024-2025 arrangements**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the US Treasury page’s HTTP status, size, title and key verbatim passages**, **plus one EIOPA PDF’s HTTP status, byte count, PDF version and page count with its text programmatically extracted** — ⭐ **but opened none of the summary reports linked from that page (three 2023 reports, three 2021 reports and the 2020 summary), did not visit the European Commission’s or EIOPA’s project pages, and did not visit any public forum material**, so **no dialogue conclusion, comparison result, consensus or disagreement can be restated**; **② ⚠️⚠️ The method limitation for the EIOPA November 2025 report is stated**: **the text was programmatically extracted and lost glyphs to font encoding**, **so only fully legible sentences are quoted and the rest is reported as "according to that report"**; **the "two thirds" figure’s statistical basis, reference year and source were not verified**; **③ ⭐ The PDF’s formal title, publication date field and issuing-body attribution were not verified** — **"November 2025" comes from the extracted text header and the search result title, and the entry labels it as such without claiming independent confirmation from file metadata** (**the PDF measurably has no `/Title` metadata**); **④ ⭐ The "7 objectives" versus eight enumerated items is recorded side by side and not reconciled** — **it could be a page error, or an item counted as one**; **the Way Forward original was not traced**; **⑤ whether the project is still running and whether meetings continued after 2024 were not verified** (**only that a November 2025 report exists on the EU side**); **⑥ whether the mechanism has any legal force, and whether its outputs bind member states, were not verified** — **the entry does not claim its conclusions are binding or have been adopted anywhere**; **⑦ comparable mechanisms involving China-EU, Hong Kong-US or other regions were not searched**, **so the entry does not claim the "cross-border supervisory dialogue" form is fully covered**; **⑧ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**. **Verification note**: the Treasury page was probed at HTTP 200 (76.3KB / 78,146 bytes) with the body read verbatim after HTML text conversion; the EIOPA PDF was probed at HTTP 200 (337,520 bytes, PDF 1.7, 9 pages) with text extracted programmatically (**glyph loss stated**); **no summary report was opened and neither the European Commission’s nor EIOPA’s project page was visited**.

**推進歷程逐字實測**：**2012 年 12 月**發布 **「Way Forward」**，**頁面逐字稱「defined 7 common objectives and initiatives」並枚舉 8 項**（⚠️ **寫 7 卻列 8，如實並列不代為取捨**）；**2014 年 7 月**更新；**其後**公布三個新議題（網絡安全風險與網絡保險市場、保險業大數據、以集團內部交易為重點的集團監管）；**2018 年**發文並在**盧森堡**舉辦公開口論壇；**2020 年 3 月**發布更新總結報告，**原定 2020 年 3 月的公開活動因新冠疫情推遲**；**2021 年 10 月**改線上並發布總結報告；**2022 年**聚焦三議題：**①氣候風險金融監督 ②氣候風險與韌性 ③技術與創新（含大數據與人工智能、以 SupTech 作監管工具）**；**2022–2023 工作流定期開會**；**2023 年 6 月在西雅圖舉辦公開口論壇**。
⭐⭐ **歐方更近的證據**：**實測確認 EIOPA 側存在一份**2025 年 11 月**總結報告**——**HTTP 200、337,520 位元組（329.6KB）、`file` 判定 PDF 1.7、共 9 頁**；**並程序化抽取其文本**（⚠️ **因字體編碼丟失部分字形，只引用完全可辨認的句子**）；⭐⭐ **其中完全可辨認、最有分量的一句**：**「Together, the EU and US regulators oversee approximately two thirds of the global insurance market.」——歐美監管者合計監管全球保險市場約三分之二**；**另一句**：**「The Steering Committee chooses key topics they consider to be fundamentally important to the protection of policyholders and financial stability.」**

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 該形態的難點在於它通常**不是一家機構，而是一套機制****——**這正是本站普查此前一直讀成 0 的原因**；**本條目首次把它落成美方 Treasury ＋ 歐方 EIOPA 兩條一手頁面**（**⚠️ 但不等於「已覆蓋跨國監管對話」——本條目只覆蓋歐美這一對的一個項目**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「約三分之二的全球保險市場」是對讀者最有用的一條量化事實**（**⚠️ 出自 EIOPA 2025 年 11 月報告、系程序抽取所得，字形丟失已如實說明；不主張已核實其統計口徑**）；可與 [[iais]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[geneva-association]] 並讀——**三者分別是全球規則、區域行業與全球研究，本條目是**兩個轄區之間的對等對話機制****。**③ ⭐⭐ 「議題按『對保單持有人保護與金融穩定是否根本重要』選定」是可直接引用的**機制設計說明****（可與 [[iais-icp]]、[[iais-gimar]] 並讀）。**④ ⭐⭐ 議題演變本身就是一份**監管關切時間線****：**網絡風險→大數據與 AI→氣候風險與韌性→AI 與 SupTech**（可與 [[ngfs]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]、[[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]] 並讀）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ 「2020 年 3 月公開活動因疫情推遲」值得單獨記一筆**——**把**機制自身受外部衝擊**寫進記錄**。**⑥ ⚠️ 必須指出的**頁面時效問題****：**敘述 2017–2019 議題時仍以「Most recently」開頭，而其後內容已推進到 2023 年**；**該頁未見 2024 年以後記錄，而歐方已有 2025 年 11 月報告**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**美方頁面的狀態、體量、標題與關鍵段落**，**以及歐方一份 PDF 的狀態、位元組數、PDF 版本與頁數並程序化抽取文本**——⭐ **但未打開該頁連結的任何一份總結報告**（2023 三份、2021 三份、2020 總結均未打開）**，未訪問歐盟委員會或 EIOPA 項目主頁、未訪問任何公開論壇材料**，故**不能轉述任何結論、比較結果、共識或分歧**；**② ⚠️⚠️ 歐方報告的**方法局限已寫明**：**程序抽取、因字體編碼丟失字形**；**「約三分之二」未核實統計口徑、年份與來源**；**③ ⭐ 未核實**該 PDF 的正式標題、發布日期欄位與發布主體署名**——**「2025 年 11 月」來自抽取文本首部與檢索結果標題，不主張已從文件元數據獨立確認**（**該 PDF 實測無 `/Title` 元數據**）；**④ ⭐ 「7 項」與枚舉 8 項不一致，**如實並列不代為解釋**，未追查 Way Forward 原文**；**⑤ 該項目是否仍在運作、2024 年後是否繼續開會未核實**；**⑥ 是否具法律效力、產出是否對成員國具約束力未核實**；**⑦ 中歐、港美等區域同類機制未檢索，故不主張該形態已被完整覆蓋**；**⑧ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：財政部頁面經 `discovery/probe-urls.sh` HTTP 200 實測（76.3KB／78,146 位元組）；EIOPA PDF 經探活實測 HTTP 200（337,520 位元組、PDF 1.7、9 頁），文本經程序抽取（**字形有丟失**）；**未打開任何總結報告、未訪問歐盟委員會或 EIOPA 項目主頁**。
