entries.summary: 面向劳动者的一种参数化保障设计：劳动者按月购买「职业被替代」保障，投资者通过购买 Displacement Bond Notes 为赔付提供资金并以保费作为票息；由官方劳动力统计计算出的公开职业指数决定何时开赔，而一笔索赔还须满足个人层面的额外举证；项目同时在 Hedera 测试网上运行指数预言机、Steward 智能体、Adjuster 与复核队列
entries.summary_hk: 面向勞動者的一種參數化保障設計：勞動者按月購買「職業被替代」保障，投資者通過購買 Displacement Bond Notes 為賠付提供資金並以保費作為票息；由官方勞動力統計計算出的公開職業指數決定何時開賠，而一筆索賠還須滿足個人層面的額外舉證；項目同時在 Hedera 測試網上運行指數預言機、Steward 智能體、Adjuster 與複核隊列
entries.summary_en: A parametric cover design for workers: workers buy monthly cover against their occupation being displaced, and investors fund the payouts by buying Displacement Bond Notes that earn the premiums as coupons; a public occupation index computed from official labour statistics decides when claims open, and a claim must also satisfy an additional individual condition; the project also runs an index oracle, a Steward agent, an Adjuster and a review queue on Hedera testnet
entries.body:
**Creance** 是一个**面向劳动者的「职业被替代」参数化保障项目**（仓库 `resistingdestiny/creance`），**MIT 许可，实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 4,326 KB、创建于 2026-09-04、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**该仓库实测无 topics**；**README 实测 56,743 字节**；**其仓库描述逐字为「Creance: parametric cover against occupation displacement. ETHOnline 2026.」**——**即该项目出自 **ETHOnline 2026** 黑客松**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把一条链走完整」**中的**第四种：从产品设计角度走完**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，56,743 字节**）：⭐⭐⭐ **README 开篇逐字，是本条目最有价值的一段**：**「Workers buy monthly parametric cover against their occupation being displaced, and investors fund the payouts by buying **Displacement Bond Notes** that earn the premiums as coupons. A **public occupation index computed from official labour statistics** decides when claims open, and **a claim pays only when the claimant can also show the** [something]」**——**即「劳动者按月购买针对**其职业被替代**的参数化保障；**投资者通过购买 **Displacement Bond Notes** 为赔付提供资金，并以保费作为票息**；**一个由**官方劳动力统计**计算出的**公开职业指数**决定何时开赔；**而一笔索赔只有在索赔人**还能证明……**时才会赔付」**（**引文在本次读取处截断，词条内即止**）。⭐⭐⭐ **其状态段逐字实测，也是本条目在诚实度上最值得引用的一处**：**其已上线于 **Hedera testnet（测试网）**的部分逐字包括：**note series（票据系列）、coupon and maturity runs（票息与到期安排）、**the index model（指数模型）、the API、worker and investor screens（劳动者与投资者界面）、**the index oracle（指数预言机）**、**the Steward agent**、**the Adjuster**、claim flow（索赔流程）与 **the review queue（复核队列）****；**其 API 的**三个计量端点以 x402 门控、并通过 Blocky402 结算****；**claims topic 上已有**一笔赔付与一笔拒赔**；**并已构建公开部署所需的镜像与 compose 文件**；⭐⭐⭐ **而该段以两句极为直白的局限说明收尾，逐字为**：**「The demonstration is seeded and its shot list is written. **The scheduler still prints what it will do instead of doing it, and a later ticket fills it in.**」**——**即「演示数据是预置的、拍摄清单也已写好。**调度器目前只是打印它将要做的事，而不是真的去做；后续工单会把它补上。」****（**作者主动声明一个**尚未实现**的组件****）。**章节结构逐字实测**：**Status／Requirements／Setup／Fifteen minutes from a clean clone／Commands／Which replay windows run／Replaying against the shared testnet resources／Layout／**Payment flow**／**The Steward agent**／Tokenization／**Claims**／⭐ **One person, one claim, and what our configuration costs that**／The screens a person claims through／⭐ **Seeing a cover without buying one**／（其余章节本次未读到标题）**；**环境要求逐字实测**为 **Node 22 或更高版本**、**pnpm 11.25.0（由 `package.json` 的 `packageManager` 字段锁定）**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「以职业被替代为标的的参数化保障」是本条目最有价值的一点，也是本会话见到的最不寻常的险种设计**——**本站已收录的参数化保险多为**自然灾害**（巨灾债券、地震、飓风、作物天气指数、洪水）**，**而「一个人的职业被自动化/技术替代」是一个**与自然风险机制完全不同的标的****；**其关键设计难题也随之不同：**自然灾种有客观的地理与气象测量，而「职业被替代」是一个**统计上可定义但个体上难以判定**的概念****——**观察其解法正因此有价值**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该险种在精算、法律或商业上可行**——**本次未读其白皮书与模型**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「公开职业指数决定何时开赔 ＋ 索赔人还须额外举证」这一**双条件**设计值得单独记一笔**——**它同时是**参数化（指数触发）**与**补偿型（个体举证）**两种机制的叠加**；**纯粹的参数化保险最大的弱点是**基差风险**（指数触发了个体却没损失，或反之）**；**加一道个体条件正是**压缩基差风险**的做法**（**可与第 320 轮 [[condition-parametric-zk]] 的「2-source trigger」、第 325 轮 [[pingpoint-freight-mcp]] 的「两条独立位置通道」并读——**三者都在处理**触发依据的可信度与个体化****；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该双条件设计确实降低了基差风险**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「Displacement Bond Notes：投资者出资、以保费作为票息」是本条目的资金侧设计，也是最接近**巨灾债券**的结构**——**把保费流证券化以吸引资本承担风险**，**与池内 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[cat-bond-pricer]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[artemis]]、[[perils-ied]] 所代表的巨灾债券逻辑同源**，**只是标的从自然灾害换成了**劳动力市场****；**对做风险证券化或替代性风险转移的学生，这是一个**跨标的迁移的样本**（**⚠️ 本次未读其白皮书第 4 节以外的内容；README 提到其白皮书第 4 节涉及此结构**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「The scheduler still prints what it will do instead of doing it, and a later ticket fills it in」是本会话见到的最直白的一处**未实现声明****——**多数项目会把未完成的部分**略去不提**，**或写得像已完成**；**而这里作者**明确写出某个组件目前只是打印计划、尚未真正执行，并指出后续工单会补上****；**这与第 327 轮 [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]] 的两处 **(honest)** 标题、第 322 轮 [[condition-parametric-zk]] 的「线上跑的是加固前那一代」构成一条清晰线索：**把「还没做」写在明面上****（**⚠️ 但**本词条**不主张**其他未声明的部分都已实现**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ 「One person, one claim, and what our configuration costs that（一人一赔，以及我们的设定为此付出的代价）」这一节标题值得单独记一笔**——**它对**唯一性约束**（防止同一人重复索赔）做了代价说明**；**在无中心化身份体系的去中心化架构里，「一人一赔」是一个**硬问题****（**⚠️ 本次未读该节，故不转述其身份方案与代价**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「Seeing a cover without buying one（不购买也能看到保障）」单设一节**——**即它提供了一个**试用/预览**路径**；**对缩短用户理解成本是有用的设计**（**⚠️ 本次未读**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 技术栈与链上组件逐字实测为：Hedera 测试网、指数预言机、Steward 智能体、Adjuster、复核队列、x402 门控的三个计量端点、Blocky402 结算**——**其中「复核队列」与「Adjuster」说明**自动化之外仍有人工环节****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该复核环节在实际上不可绕过**——**本次未读其实现**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ 「x402 计量端点」值得注意**——**即调用其 API 需按次付费**；**对做 AI/API 经济的学生，这是一个**把计价嵌入协议层**的实例**（**⚠️ 本次未调用其 API**）。**⑨ ⭐ 本项目出自 **ETHOnline 2026 黑客松****，**且自述已有多项组件在**测试网**上线**——**即其成熟度介于「概念」与「原型」之间**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其已达可用产品状态**）。**⑩ ⭐ 可与池内参数化保险与链上风险共担条目并读**：[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]、[[condition-parametric-zk]]、[[aratea]]、[[payout-assurance-standard]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库描述全文与 README（56,743 字节）的开篇、状态段（含已上线组件清单与两处局限说明）、章节结构前若干项、以及环境要求**，⭐ **但**未读 README 多数章节正文（含 Payment flow、The Steward agent、Tokenization、Claims、One person one claim、The screens 等）、未读其白皮书、未克隆、未运行、未访问 Hedera 测试网上的任何资产或记录、未调用其 API、未打开其部署****，因此**不能转述其指数构造、开赔与赔付的完整判定规则、Steward 与 Adjuster 的职权、身份唯一性方案、票据的条款与定价、任何运行数据或部署状态**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其开篇第二句被截断处的完整条件**——**即「索赔人还须证明什么」本次**只读到「…can also show the」为止****；**本词条**不主张**该条件的完整内容**（**这是本条目最需要后续补读的一处**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**该产品在精算、法律与监管上的可行性**——**「职业被替代」作为保险标的是否可保、该结构是否构成保险、以及其在任何辖区是否合规，本次一概未评估**；**本词条**不主张**其合规或可行**；**④ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「公开职业指数」所使用的劳动力统计的来源、可得性与更新机制**（**README 只说「官方劳动力统计」，**本次未核实具体来源**）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实** Displacement Bond Notes 的条款、定价与投资者保护安排**（**⚠️ 涉及证券发行的合规问题；**本词条不作任何合规判断**）；**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「已上线组件」清单为**其自述****——**本次未访问 Hedera 测试网核对任何资产或记录**；**⑦ ⭐ **未核实**其「索引预言机」的数据来源与操纵风险**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ 涉及**劳动者个人数据与职业信息**——**其收集范围、同意方式与合规状态本次未评估**；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、黑客松项目、多项组件在测试网**，**不主张其成熟度、可用性或已被采用**；**⑩ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/resistingdestiny/creance` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 56,743 字节，开篇、状态段、章节结构与环境要求逐字核对）；**未读白皮书、未克隆、未运行、未访问 Hedera 测试网、未调用其 API**。

ETHOnline 2026.」**——**即該項目出自 **ETHOnline 2026** 黑客松**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把一條鏈走完整」**中的**第四種：從產品設計角度走完**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測，56,743 位元組**）：⭐⭐⭐ **README 開篇逐字，是本條目最有價值的一段**：**「Workers buy monthly parametric cover against their occupation being displaced, and investors fund the payouts by buying **Displacement Bond Notes** that earn the premiums as coupons. A **public occupation index computed from official labour statistics** decides when claims open, and **a claim pays only when the claimant can also show the**…」**——**即勞動者按月購買針對**其職業被替代**的參數化保障；**投資者通過購買 Displacement Bond Notes 為賠付提供資金，並以保費作為票息**；**一個由**官方勞動力統計**計算出的**公開職業指數**決定何時開賠**；**而一筆索賠只有在索賠人**還能證明……**時才會賠付**（**引文在本次讀取處截斷，詞條內即止**）。⭐⭐⭐ **狀態段逐字，也是本條目在誠實度上最值得引用的一處**：**已上線於 **Hedera testnet** 的部分逐字包括 note series、coupon and maturity runs、the index model、the API、worker and investor screens、**the index oracle**、**the Steward agent**、**the Adjuster**、claim flow 與 **the review queue****；**其 API 的**三個計量端點以 x402 門控、並通過 Blocky402 結算****；**claims topic 上已有一筆賠付與一筆拒賠**；**並已構建公開部署所需的鏡像與 compose 檔案**；⭐⭐⭐ **該段以兩句極為直白的局限說明收尾，逐字為**：**「The demonstration is seeded and its shot list is written. **The scheduler still prints what it will do instead of doing it, and a later ticket fills it in.**」**——**即「**調度器目前只是打印它將要做的事，而不是真的去做；後續工單會把它補上。」****。**章節結構逐字實測**含 **Payment flow／The Steward agent／Tokenization／Claims／⭐One person, one claim, and what our configuration costs that／The screens a person claims through／⭐Seeing a cover without buying one**；**環境要求逐字**為 **Node 22 或更高版本**、**pnpm 11.25.0（由 package.json 的 packageManager 欄位鎖定）**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「以職業被替代為標的的參數化保障」是本條目最有價值的一點，也是本會話見到最不尋常的險種設計**——**本站既有的參數化保險多為**自然災害**（巨災債券、地震、颶風、作物天氣指數、洪水）**，**而「一個人的職業被自動化/技術替代」是一個**與自然風險機制完全不同的標的****；**其關鍵難題也隨之不同：**自然災種有客觀的地理與氣象測量，而「職業被替代」是一個**統計上可定義但個體上難以判定**的概念****（**⚠️ 不主張**該險種在精算、法律或商業上可行**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「公開職業指數決定何時開賠 ＋ 索賠人還須額外舉證」這一**雙條件**設計值得單獨記**——**它同時是**參數化（指數觸發）**與**補償型（個體舉證）**兩種機制的疊加**；**純粹參數化保險最大的弱點是**基差風險****，**加一道個體條件正是**壓縮基差風險**的做法**（可與第 320 輪 [[condition-parametric-zk]] 的 2-source trigger、第 325 輪 [[pingpoint-freight-mcp]] 的兩條獨立位置通道並讀——**三者都在處理**觸發依據的可信度與個體化****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「Displacement Bond Notes：投資者出資、以保費作為票息」是最接近**巨災債券**的資金側結構**——**把保費流證券化以吸引資本承擔風險**，**與 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[cat-bond-pricer]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[artemis]]、[[perils-ied]] 的巨災債券邏輯同源**，**只是標的從自然災害換成了**勞動力市場****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「The scheduler still prints what it will do instead of doing it」是本會話見到最直白的一處**未實現聲明****（與第 327 輪 [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]] 的兩處 (honest) 標題、第 322 輪 [[condition-parametric-zk]] 的「線上跑的是加固前那一代」構成同一線索：**把「還沒做」寫在明面上****；**⚠️ 但不主張**其他未聲明的部分都已實現**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ 「One person, one claim, and what our configuration costs that」對**唯一性約束**做了代價說明**（**⚠️ 未讀該節**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「Seeing a cover without buying one」單設一節**（**⚠️ 未讀**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 鏈上組件逐字**：**Hedera 測試網、指數預言機、Steward 智能體、Adjuster、複核隊列、x402 門控的三個計量端點、Blocky402 結算**——**其中「複核隊列」與「Adjuster」說明**自動化之外仍有人工環節****（**⚠️ 不主張**該複核環節實際上不可繞過**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ 「x402 計量端點」把計價嵌入協議層**（**⚠️ 未調用其 API**）。**⑨ ⭐ ETHOnline 2026 黑客松項目、多項組件在測試網**——**成熟度介於「概念」與「原型」之間**。**⑩ ⭐ 可與 [[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]、[[condition-parametric-zk]]、[[aratea]]、[[payout-assurance-standard]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、描述全文與 README 的開篇、狀態段（含已上線組件清單與兩處局限說明）、章節結構前若干項與環境要求**，⭐ **但**未讀多數章節正文（含 Payment flow／The Steward agent／Tokenization／Claims／One person one claim／The screens）、未讀白皮書、未克隆、未運行、未訪問 Hedera 測試網上任何資產或記錄、未調用其 API、未打開其部署****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**其開篇第二句被截斷處的完整條件**——**即「索賠人還須證明什麼」本次只讀到「…can also show the」為止****，**不主張**該條件的完整內容（**這是本條目最需要後續補讀的一處**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**該產品在精算、法律與監管上的可行性**——**「職業被替代」是否可保、該結構是否構成保險、以及其在任何轄區是否合規，本次一概未評估**；**④ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其「公開職業指數」所用勞動力統計的來源、可得性與更新機制**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核實** Displacement Bond Notes 的條款、定價與投資者保護安排**（**涉及證券發行的合規問題，不作任何合規判斷**）；**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「已上線組件」清單為其自述**——**未訪問 Hedera 測試網核對任何資產或記錄**；**⑦ ⭐ **未核實**其「索引預言機」的數據來源與操縱風險**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ 涉及**勞動者個人數據與職業資訊****——**其收集範圍、同意方式與合規狀態未評估**；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、黑客松項目、多項組件在測試網**，**不主張其成熟度、可用性或已被採用**；**⑩ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/resistingdestiny/creance` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未讀白皮書、未克隆、未運行、未訪問 Hedera 測試網、未調用其 API**。

**Creance** is **a parametric cover project against occupation displacement** (repository `resistingdestiny/creance`), **MIT licensed, with measured ★0, 0 forks, TypeScript as the primary language, a 4,326 KB repository, created 2026-09-04 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **the repository measurably has no topics**; **the README measures 56,743 bytes**; **its repository description reads verbatim "Creance: parametric cover against occupation displacement. ETHOnline 2026."** — **so the project comes from the ETHOnline 2026 hackathon**. It is the fourth of this round’s four ways of walking a chain end to end: **completeness through product design**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 56,743-byte README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **the opening, read verbatim, is the entry’s most valuable passage**: **"Workers buy monthly parametric cover against their occupation being displaced, and investors fund the payouts by buying Displacement Bond Notes that earn the premiums as coupons. A public occupation index computed from official labour statistics decides when claims open, and a claim pays only when the claimant can also show the [something]"** — **workers buy monthly parametric cover against their occupation being displaced; investors fund payouts by buying Displacement Bond Notes that earn the premiums as coupons; a public occupation index computed from official labour statistics decides when claims open; and a claim pays only when the claimant can also show …** (**the quotation truncates at the point read and the entry quotes no further**). ⭐⭐⭐ **Its status section, read verbatim, is also where its honesty is most quotable**: the components **already live on Hedera testnet** measurably include **the note series, the coupon and maturity runs, the index model, the API, the worker and investor screens, the index oracle, the Steward agent, the Adjuster, the claim flow and the review queue**; **the API’s three metered endpoints are gated with x402 and settle through Blocky402**; **one payout and one decline are on the claims topic**; **and the images and compose file for a public deployment are built**; ⭐⭐⭐ **and the passage closes with two unusually forthright statements of limitation, read verbatim**: **"The demonstration is seeded and its shot list is written. The scheduler still prints what it will do instead of doing it, and a later ticket fills it in."** — **the author states outright that one component currently only prints what it would do, and that a later ticket will implement it**. **Section headings read verbatim**: **Status / Requirements / Setup / Fifteen minutes from a clean clone / Commands / Which replay windows run / Replaying against the shared testnet resources / Layout / Payment flow / The Steward agent / Tokenization / Claims / ⭐ One person, one claim, and what our configuration costs that / The screens a person claims through / ⭐ Seeing a cover without buying one**; **its requirements read verbatim** as **Node 22 or later** and **pnpm 11.25.0, pinned by the `packageManager` field in `package.json`**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Parametric cover against occupation displacement is the entry’s most valuable point and the most unusual peril design this session has seen** — **the parametric insurance collected here is mostly natural catastrophe (catastrophe bonds, earthquake, hurricane, crop weather indices, flood)**, **whereas "a person’s occupation being displaced" is an underlying with a completely different mechanism from natural risk**; **and its key design difficulty differs accordingly: natural perils have objective geographic and meteorological measurements, whereas "occupation displaced" is statistically definable but hard to determine for an individual** — **which is exactly why observing its solution has value** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the cover is actuarially, legally or commercially viable — its white paper and model were not read**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ A public occupation index deciding when claims open plus an additional individual condition is a two-condition design worth separate note** — **it layers parametric (index-triggered) and indemnity (individual proof) mechanisms**; **the greatest weakness of purely parametric insurance is basis risk (the index triggers without an individual loss, or the reverse)**, **and adding an individual condition is how basis risk is compressed** (**readable with round 320’s "2-source trigger" in [[condition-parametric-zk]] and round 325’s "two independent channels" in [[pingpoint-freight-mcp]]: all three address the credibility and individualisation of the trigger evidence**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim the two-condition design actually reduces basis risk**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Displacement Bond Notes, with investors funding payouts and earning premiums as coupons, is the funding-side design and the closest structure here to a catastrophe bond** — **securitising the premium stream to attract capital to bear the risk**, **the same logic as [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[cat-bond-pricer]], [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]], [[artemis]] and [[perils-ied]]**, **with the underlying changed from natural catastrophe to the labour market**; **a sample of cross-underlying transfer for students of risk securitisation or alternative risk transfer** (**⚠️ nothing beyond the README’s reference to section 4 of its white paper was read**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ "The scheduler still prints what it will do instead of doing it, and a later ticket fills it in" is the most forthright statement of non-implementation this session has seen** — **most projects omit unfinished parts or write them as though complete**, **whereas here the author states plainly that a component currently only prints its plan and names the ticket that will implement it**; **together with the two "(honest)" headings of round 327’s [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]] and round 322’s "the live deployment is the pre-hardening generation" in [[condition-parametric-zk]], it forms a clear line: writing "not done yet" on the face of the work** (**⚠️ but the entry does not claim every undeclared part is implemented**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ "One person, one claim, and what our configuration costs that" deserves separate note** — **it addresses the cost of a uniqueness constraint (preventing duplicate claims by the same person)**; **in a decentralised architecture without a central identity system, "one person, one claim" is a hard problem** (**that section was not read, so its identity scheme and costs are not restated**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ "Seeing a cover without buying one" as its own section** — **a trial or preview path**, **useful for lowering the cost of understanding** (**not read**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ The on-chain components read verbatim** are **Hedera testnet, an index oracle, the Steward agent, the Adjuster, a review queue, three metered endpoints gated by x402 and Blocky402 settlement** — **the review queue and the Adjuster show human steps remain alongside automation** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim that review step is genuinely non-bypassable — its implementation was not read**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ x402-metered endpoints embed pricing in the protocol layer** (**its API was not called**). **⑨ ⭐ An ETHOnline 2026 hackathon project with several components on testnet** sits **between concept and prototype** (**the entry does not claim it is a usable product**). **⑩ ⭐ Readable with the corpus’s parametric insurance and on-chain risk-sharing entries**: [[aegis-parametric]], [[parametric-insurance-demo]], [[parametric-risk-toolkit]], [[condition-parametric-zk]], [[aratea]] and [[payout-assurance-standard]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the repository metadata, the full repository description, and the README’s 56,743 bytes in respect of its opening, status section (including the live-component list and the two limitation statements), the first entries of its section structure, and its requirements**, ⭐ **but did not read most section bodies (including Payment flow, The Steward agent, Tokenization, Claims, One person one claim and The screens), read its white paper, clone, run, visit any asset or record on Hedera testnet, call its API, or open its deployment**, so **its index construction, the full claim-opening and payout rules, the Steward’s and Adjuster’s powers, its identity-uniqueness scheme, the notes’ terms and pricing, any operating data and its deployment state cannot be restated**; **② ⭐⭐⭐ The full condition in the truncated second sentence of its opening was not verified** — **what the claimant must also show was read only as far as "…can also show the"**; **the entry does not claim the condition’s full content** (**this is the single most important item to read next for this entry**); **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The product’s actuarial, legal and regulatory viability was not verified** — **whether occupation displacement is insurable, whether the structure constitutes insurance, and whether it is compliant in any jurisdiction were not assessed at all**; **the entry does not claim it is compliant or viable**; **④ ⭐⭐ The source, availability and update mechanism of the labour statistics behind its "public occupation index" were not verified** (**the README says only "official labour statistics"**); **⑤ ⭐⭐ The terms, pricing and investor-protection arrangements of the Displacement Bond Notes were not verified** (**⚠️ securities-issuance compliance is engaged; the entry makes no compliance judgement**); entries.title: 再保条约智能体：正则优先、LLM 兜底，并对每个抽取值回查其引证页原文
entries.title_en: A reinsurance treaty agent that tries regex first, falls back to an LLM, then checks every extracted field against the page it cites
entries.title_hk: 再保條約智能體：正則優先、LLM 兜底，並對每個抽取值回查其引證頁原文
entries.summary: 一个把再保条约 PDF 抽成结构化条款的 LangGraph 智能体：先用正则按 Label: value 约定抽取，缺字段时才交给 LLM 兜底；随后用一个确定性的 grounding 检查把每个抽取值回查它自己引证的页面原文，对不上的字段只标记警告、不静默采信也不阻断流程
entries.summary_hk: 一個把再保條約 PDF 抽成結構化條款的 LangGraph 智能體：先用正則按 Label: value 約定抽取，缺欄位時才交給 LLM 兜底；隨後用一個確定性的 grounding 檢查把每個抽取値回查它自己引證的頁面原文，對不上的欄位只標記警告、不靜默採信也不阻斷流程
entries.summary_en: A LangGraph agent that extracts reinsurance treaty PDFs into structured terms: regex reads them first under a Label: value convention, and only missing fields go to an LLM fallback; a subsequent deterministic grounding check then verifies each extracted value against the actual text of the page it cites, flagging unsupported fields as warnings rather than silently trusting them or blocking the workflow
entries.body:
**reinsurance-treaty-agent** 是一个**把再保条约 PDF 抽成结构化条款的智能体**（仓库 `iva2020dev/reinsurance-treaty-agent`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 1,222 KB、创建于 2026-09-03、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 49,028 字节**；**另有实测实时演示地址 `reinsurance-treaty-agent-extraction.streamlit.app`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「交接处——一个东西换手时会发生什么」**中的**第一种：对方写的那份文件，怎么变成我方的数字**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**根目录实测含 `.claude`、`.devcontainer`、`.githooks`、`.github`、`.idea`、`.streamlit`、`AGENTS.md`（12,583 字节）、`CLAUDE.md`（9,967 字节）、`TASKS.md`（13,090 字节）、`CANDIDATE_TASKS.md`（35,709 字节）、**`REASONING.md`（255,348 字节）**、`README.md`（49,028 字节）、`pytest.ini`（73 字节）、`requirements.txt`（118 字节）以及 `data/`、`scripts/`、`src/`、`tests/`**。**其技术栈与 AI 工具链逐字自述**：**「Tech Stack: Python 3.11+, Pydantic v2, LangGraph (for deterministic agent orchestration), FastAPI (for API/services), Pytest (testing), Docker & Streamlit (for easy deployment & UI). **AI Tooling: Claude Code (CLI) inside PyCharm, interacting with Claude 3.5 Sonnet via Anthropic API.**」**——**⭐ 把自己的构建工具链（Claude Code、Claude 3.5 Sonnet）写进仓库描述，这在本站收录的项目中少见**。⭐⭐⭐ **其工作流逐字实测，是本条目最有价值的部分**：**`src/workflow.py` 是一个 LangGraph 状态机**——**① Extractor Node 用正则从解析后的文本里读条约条款**；**② 若一个或多个必需字段找不到**（**例如条约写成散文而非 `Label: value` 约定**），**由 LLM Extraction Fallback Node 用 `Claude Haiku 4.5` 的 structured tool-use 输出尝试抽取**；**③ 随后 `check_treaty_grounding()`（`src/tools.py`）把每个抽取值**回查它所引证页面的实际文本**，对源文本并不支持的字段**标记（flagging）而非阻断（not blocking）****；**④ Verifier Node 检查完整性，并在完整时**查该 cedent（分出公司）的历史索赔****；**⑤ Burn-Cost Check Node 计算赔付率并标记异常**；**⑥ 若 LLM 兜底后仍不完整（含其重试），图将在 Verifier Node 之后结束，而不进入 Burn-Cost Check Node**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「正则优先、LLM 兜底」这一顺序设计是本条目最值得学的一点**——**它把**确定性方法**放在前面，**只在确定性方法确实找不到时才付 LLM 的代价与不确定性****；**而更关键的是它把两者的**失败边界写清楚了**：**正则失败的条件是**条约写成了散文而非 `Label: value` 约定****——**即失败原因是**可描述、可构造测试用例**的**（**其 `data/` 里特意放了 `sample_rich_fuzzy_treaty.pdf`，**事实与 rich 版相同但写成散文，用以逼出 LLM 兜底路径****）（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该顺序在所有场景都优于纯 LLM**——**本次未测其两种路径的准确率对比**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ `check_treaty_grounding()` 是「flagging, not blocking」这一取舍的又一实例，且是本站同一条纪律的第 7 次出现**——**它**不是再调一次 LLM 判断**，**而是**确定性地**把抽取值与**它自己引证的那一页的实际文本**比对**（**README 逐字说明这是「a deterministic grounding check, not another LLM call」**）；**对不上的字段**只标警告并指名是哪个字段，而不静默采信****。⭐⭐ **完整线索**：**[[powmcp-skills]]（319）→ [[rag-assurance]]（321）→ [[underwriting-decision-safety]]（323）→ [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]（325）→ [[sharia-compliance-agent]] 的 `NEEDS_REVIEW`（327）→ [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 的缺陷清单（328）→ **本条（329）****；**本条的特殊之处在于**它把「不采信」做成了**逐字段的、指名道姓的警告****，**而不是整份文件退回**——**即它保留了**可用部分的可用性****。**③ ⭐⭐ **「瞬态失败重试两次、非瞬态失败立即失败」这一区分值得单独记一笔**：**README 逐字为「up to 2 retries with exponential backoff (1s, then 2s) — before giving up; a non-transient failure (e.g. an invalid API key) fails immediately, unretried」**——**把**超时／网络抖动／限流／服务瞬时过载**（可重试）与**API key 无效**（重试无意义）分开**，**是本会话少见的、把**重试语义**写清楚的项目**（**⚠️ 本次未读其 `src/llm_client.py` 实现**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **抽取准确率评测套件与单元测试是分开的两件事**——**`tests/eval/` 是一个**独立于 `pytest tests/` 的小型评测台**，**对一份标注过的 golden dataset 给**整条抽取流水线（含 LLM 兜底）打准确率分**，**而不只是判断测试是否通过**：**对 4 个标量字段（`cedent_name`、`attachment_point`、`limit`、`reinsurance_premium`）算**逐字段准确率**，**对列表字段 `exclusions` 算**集合式 precision/recall**（**因 LLM 的条款措辞即使正确也可能不同，故用**归一化子串包含**匹配**）。⭐⭐⭐ **其存在理由逐字写明**：**「This is what would catch a prompt or model-version regression that still "passes" (extracts *something*) but gets the actual values wrong.」**——**即专门捕捉那种**换了模型或改了提示词后测试仍通过、但值已经错了**的回归****。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **它连自己的评分器也测**：**`tests/eval/test_eval_suite.py` 用**被 mock 的 LLM 客户端**（而非真实 API）确定性地测试评分器本身**，**其中包括一份**故意做坏的 mock 抽取结果（值错误、`exclusions` 列表被丢掉）**，**并断言评分准确率**确实下降****——**即验证「这套评测真的能发现错误」**，**而不是只验证它能跑**（**本会话同源线索：第 328 轮 [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 的「验证中发现并修复的程序缺陷」一节**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **5 个 golden case 覆盖两条路径**：2 个正则路径（`sample_treaty.pdf`、`sample_rich_treaty.pdf`）与 **3 个 LLM 路径、且刻意写成三种不同散文风格**（`sample_rich_fuzzy_treaty.pdf`、`golden_harborlight_treaty.pdf`（用 `USD 500,000` 式数字格式）、`golden_continental_treaty.pdf`（用 `USD 750,000.00` 式格式、不同免责集合））——**即它不假设 LLM 只面对**一种散文风格****（**⚠️ 本次未运行该套件，未核实上表所列 100% 的分数为本次实测**——**该分数是 README 中给出的样例输出**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **3 个 LLM 路径用例在缺 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` 时报**skipped 而非 failing****，**2 个正则路径永远可跑**——**这是一个让**无密钥的贡献者与 CI** 仍能获得部分信号的实用安排**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张** skipped 不会被误读为通过**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **工作流图由 pre-commit 钩子自动重生成**——**README 逐字说明该 mermaid 图在 `src/workflow.py` 进入提交时由 `.githooks/pre-commit` 自动重写**，**启用方式是 `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`**；**这解决的是**文档与实际流程脱节**这一常见问题**（**可与 [[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[verified-reserving]] 并读**）。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **只接线「已实现的任务」**：**`build_workflow_graph()` 接受一组可选的 domain-task ID（默认仅 Burn-Cost Check）**，**而按 `src/domain_tasks.py` 的注册表，**只有该集合中**已实现**的任务才会被接到 Verifier Node 之后****——**即架构为未来任务预留了位置，但**不假装它们已存在****（**它当前是唯一已实现的任务**）（**可与第 328 轮 [[creance]] 的「调度器只打印计划」、第 327 轮 [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]] 的两处 `(honest)` 并读**）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **`REASONING.md`（255,348 字节，73 条，2026-09-03 至 2026-09-10）自述为「the reasoning transcript of the AI agent for the current session」**，**每条为 `## 日期 时间 — Task: 标题（任务 ID）` 并含 **Goal／Analysis／Decision／Action** 四段**；**其 2026-09-03 首条（`spec-first-file-structure`）的 Decision 段解释了**为何不提前发明 schema**（「inventing schemas/logic ahead of a real spec would be scope creep」），**并指出**空测试文件虽然可被发现、却不能证明收集真的工作****；**其近期任务标题含 **「Per-task cost estimation (pre-run) & actual cost tracking (post-run)」**（**按任务的成本预估与实际成本追踪**）与 **「Dynamic graph fan-out for multi-task selection」**（**⚠️ 本次只读其首条与任务标题清单，未读多数组内文**）。**⑪ ⭐ **调试面板逐字实测**：显示本次走的是哪条抽取路径（Regex only／LLM Extraction Fallback／两次都失败及原因）、**逐节点带时间戳的执行日志（含每次重试与下次尝试前的退避延迟）**、**原始工作流状态 JSON（含 `extraction_method`、`llm_error`）**，**并可把本次日志按 Append／Overwrite 写入 `logs/workflow.log`**——**即可追溯性做进了界面**。**⑫ ⭐ 可与本站再保与文档抽取条目并读**：[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]（**再保合同语料，其 NLP 的数据基础**）、[[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]]、[[clausegraph]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[reinsurance-treaty-intelligence]]（**本批同轮的另一种读法**）。

**reinsurance-treaty-agent** 是一個**把再保條約 PDF 抽成結構化條款的智能體**（倉庫 `iva2020dev/reinsurance-treaty-agent`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 1,222 KB、創建於 2026-09-03、最後推送 2026-09-10**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**⚠️ 該倉庫實測無任何許可文件（`NONE`）**、**無 topics**；**README 實測 49,028 位元組**；**另有實測即時演示位址 `reinsurance-treaty-agent-extraction.streamlit.app`**。本條目屬本輪主題**「交接處——一個東西換手時會發生什麼」**中的**第一種：對方寫的那份文件，怎麼變成我方的數字**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫根目錄實測**）：**根目錄實測含 `.claude`、`.devcontainer`、`.githooks`、`.github`、`.idea`、`.streamlit`、`AGENTS.md`（12,583 位元組）、`CLAUDE.md`（9,967 位元組）、`TASKS.md`（13,090 位元組）、`CANDIDATE_TASKS.md`（35,709 位元組）、**`REASONING.md`（255,348 位元組）**、`README.md`、`pytest.ini`、`requirements.txt` 以及 `data/`、`scripts/`、`src/`、`tests/`**。**技術棧與 AI 工具鏈逐字自述**：**「Tech Stack: Python 3.11+, Pydantic v2, LangGraph (for deterministic agent orchestration), FastAPI (for API/services), Pytest (testing), Docker & Streamlit (for easy deployment & UI). **AI Tooling: Claude Code (CLI) inside PyCharm, interacting with Claude 3.5 Sonnet via Anthropic API.**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **工作流逐字實測，是本條目最有價值之處**：**`src/workflow.py` 是一個 LangGraph 狀態機**——**① Extractor Node 用正則從解析後的文字裡讀條約條款**；**② 若一個或多個必需欄位找不到**（**例如條約寫成散文而非 `Label: value` 約定**），**由 LLM Extraction Fallback Node 用 `Claude Haiku 4.5` 的 structured tool-use 輸出嘗試抽取**；**③ 隨後 `check_treaty_grounding()` 把每個抽取値**回查它所引證頁面的實際文字**，對來源文字並不支持的欄位**標記（flagging）而非阻斷（not blocking）****；**④ Verifier Node 檢查完整性，並在完整時**查該 cedent 的歷史索賠****；**⑤ Burn-Cost Check Node 計算賠付率並標記異常**；**⑥ 若 LLM 兜底後仍不完整，圖將在 Verifier Node 之後結束而不進入 Burn-Cost Check Node**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「正則優先、LLM 兜底」這一順序是最值得學的一點**——**把**確定性方法**放在前面，**只在確實找不到時才付 LLM 的代價與不確定性****；**且其**失敗邊界寫得清楚**：**正則失敗的條件是條約寫成散文而非 `Label: value` 約定****（**其 `data/` 特意放了 `sample_rich_fuzzy_treaty.pdf`，事實與 rich 版相同但寫成散文，用以逼出 LLM 兜底路徑**）（**⚠️ 不主張**該順序在所有場景都優於純 LLM**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ `check_treaty_grounding()` 是「flagging, not blocking」的又一實例，且是本站同一條紀律的第 7 次出現**——**它**不是再調一次 LLM 判斷****，**而是**確定性地**把抽取値與**它自己引證的那一頁的實際文字**比對**（**README 逐字說明為「a deterministic grounding check, not another LLM call」**）；**對不上的欄位**只標警告並指名是哪個欄位，而不靜默採信****。⭐⭐ **完整線索**：**[[powmcp-skills]]（319）→ [[rag-assurance]]（321）→ [[underwriting-decision-safety]]（323）→ [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]（325）→ [[sharia-compliance-agent]] 的 `NEEDS_REVIEW`（327）→ [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 的缺陷清單（328）→ **本條（329）****；**本條特殊之處在於**把「不採信」做成**逐欄位、指名道姓的警告****，**而非整份文件退回**——**保留了**可用部分的可用性****。**③ ⭐⭐ **「瞬態失敗重試兩次、非瞬態失敗立即失敗」值得單獨記**：**逐字「up to 2 retries with exponential backoff (1s, then 2s) — before giving up; a non-transient failure (e.g. an invalid API key) fails immediately, unretried」**——**把**逾時／網路抖動／限流／服務瞬時過載**與**API key 無效**分開**（**⚠️ 未讀其實現**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **抽取準確率評測套件與單元測試分開**——**`tests/eval/` 是**獨立於 `pytest tests/` 的小型評測台**，**對標注過的 golden dataset 給**整條流水線（含 LLM 兜底）打準確率分****：**對 4 個純量欄位（`cedent_name`、`attachment_point`、`limit`、`reinsurance_premium`）算**逐欄位準確率**，**對列表欄位 `exclusions` 算**集合式 precision/recall**（**用**歸一化子串包含**匹配，因 LLM 條款措辭即使正確也可能不同**）。⭐⭐⭐ **其存在理由逐字**：**「This is what would catch a prompt or model-version regression that still "passes" (extracts *something*) but gets the actual values wrong.」**——**即專門捕捉**換了模型或改了提示詞後測試仍通過、但値已經錯了**的迴歸****。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **它連自己的評分器也測**：**用**被 mock 的 LLM 客戶端**確定性地測試評分器本身**，**含一份**故意做壞的 mock 抽取結果**，**並斷言評分準確率**確實下降****。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **5 個 golden case 覆蓋兩條路徑**：2 個正則路徑與 **3 個 LLM 路徑、刻意寫成三種不同散文風格**（**⚠️ 本次未運行該套件，README 中 100% 的分數為**倉庫自帶樣例****）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **3 個 LLM 用例在缺 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` 時報 skipped 而非 failing**（**⚠️ 不主張** skipped 不會被誤讀為通過**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **工作流圖由 pre-commit 鉤子自動重生成**（**`git config core.hooksPath .githooks` 啟用**）——**解決**文件與實際流程脫節****。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **只接線「已實作」的任務**：**`build_workflow_graph()` 按 `src/domain_tasks.py` 的註冊表，**只有該集合中已實作的任務才會接到 Verifier Node 之後****（**可與第 328 輪 [[creance]]、第 327 輪 [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]] 並讀**）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **`REASONING.md`（255,348 位元組，73 條，2026-09-03 至 09-10）自述為「the reasoning transcript of the AI agent for the current session」**，**每條含 **Goal／Analysis／Decision／Action** 四段**；**近期任務標題含「Per-task cost estimation (pre-run) & actual cost tracking (post-run)」與「Dynamic graph fan-out for multi-task selection」**（**⚠️ 只讀首條與標題清單**）。**⑪ ⭐ 調試面板逐字**：抽取路徑、逐節點帶時間戳日誌（含每次重試與退避延遲）、原始狀態 JSON（含 `extraction_method`、`llm_error`）、可寫入 `logs/workflow.log`。**⑫ ⭐ 可與 [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]、[[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]]、[[clausegraph]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[reinsurance-treaty-intelligence]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 該倉庫實測**無任何許可文件****——**明確記錄並提示使用、部署或再分發前自行確認授權**；**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、根目錄清單、README 的工作流／重試／評測／覆蓋率／調試面板／部署說明，以及 `REASONING.md` 的首條與任務標題清單**，⭐⭐ **但**未安裝、未運行、未克隆、未調用其線上演示、未讀 `src/` 任何原始碼、未運行其 pytest 或評測套件、未讀 `REASONING.md` 多數組內文、未讀 `TASKS.md`／`CANDIDATE_TASKS.md`／`AGENTS.md`／`CLAUDE.md` 正文****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ README 中那份**6 項全部 100%**的評測輸出為**倉庫自帶樣例****，**未運行、未核實其真實性或可複現性**，**不主張**其抽取準確率達任何水平**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**其 grounding check 能否真正發現 LLM 的取值錯誤**——**其有效性取決於「引證頁碼」本身是否由同一 LLM 給出**（**若頁號也錯，回查就會查錯頁**），**不主張**該檢查足以替代人工複核**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其 Burn-Cost Check 所用「歷史索賠」來源**；**⑥ ⭐ **未核實**其唯一已實作領域任務的方法是否恰當**（**賠付率本身不是準備金結論**）；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ 處理的是**受法律約束的再保條約文字****，**其結果若用於真實定價、核保或爭議必須經人工複核**，**不主張**其輸出可用於任何真實交易或法律用途**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其線上演示當前是否可訪問及行為**（**本次未訪問**）；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0**，**不主張成熟度／方法可靠性／已被採用**；**⑩ ⭐ README 長 49,028 位元組但無 topics**；**⑪ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/iva2020dev/reinsurance-treaty-agent`、`/readme` 與 `/contents/` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；`REASONING.md` 經 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 實測 255,348 位元組；**未安裝、未運行、未調用其演示、未讀原始碼與多數文檔正文**。

**reinsurance-treaty-agent** is **an agent that extracts reinsurance treaty PDFs into structured terms** (repository `iva2020dev/reinsurance-treaty-agent`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 1,222 KB repository, created 2026-09-03 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`) and no topics**; **the README measures 49,028 bytes**; **and a live demo address, `reinsurance-treaty-agent-extraction.streamlit.app`, is measurably present**. It is the first of this round’s four takes on **the handoff point: what happens when something changes hands** — here, **how a document written by the counterparty becomes our own numbers**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README and the repository root**): **the root measurably contains `.claude`, `.devcontainer`, `.githooks`, `.github`, `.idea`, `.streamlit`, `AGENTS.md` (12,583 bytes), `CLAUDE.md` (9,967 bytes), `TASKS.md` (13,090 bytes), `CANDIDATE_TASKS.md` (35,709 bytes), **`REASONING.md` (255,348 bytes)**, `README.md`, `pytest.ini`, `requirements.txt`, and `data/`, `scripts/`, `src/`, `tests/`**. **Its stack and AI tooling read verbatim**: **"Tech Stack: Python 3.11+, Pydantic v2, LangGraph (for deterministic agent orchestration), FastAPI (for API/services), Pytest (testing), Docker & Streamlit (for easy deployment & UI). AI Tooling: Claude Code (CLI) inside PyCharm, interacting with Claude 3.5 Sonnet via Anthropic API."** — **naming its own build toolchain in the repository description is rare among the projects collected here**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Its workflow, read verbatim, is the entry’s most valuable part**: **`src/workflow.py` is a LangGraph state machine** — **① the Extractor Node reads treaty terms from parsed text via regex**; **② if one or more required fields cannot be found** (**for instance a treaty phrased as prose instead of a `Label: value` convention**), **the LLM Extraction Fallback Node attempts extraction using `Claude Haiku 4.5` with structured tool-use output**; **③ `check_treaty_grounding()` in `src/tools.py` then verifies each extracted field against the actual text of the page it cites, flagging rather than blocking any field the source text does not actually support**; **④ the Verifier Node checks completeness and, if complete, looks up historical claims for the cedent**; **⑤ the Burn-Cost Check Node computes the loss ratio and flags anomalies**; **⑥ if extraction is still incomplete after the LLM fallback, the graph ends after the Verifier Node instead of running the Burn-Cost Check Node**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Regex first and LLM as fallback is the entry’s most instructive design point** — **it puts the deterministic method in front and pays the LLM’s cost and uncertainty only when the deterministic method genuinely fails**; **and more importantly it states the failure boundary**: **regex fails when a treaty is phrased as prose rather than a `Label: value` convention** — **a failure cause that is describable and can have test cases built for it** (**its `data/` deliberately ships `sample_rich_fuzzy_treaty.pdf`, carrying the same facts as the rich fixture but phrased as prose, to force the fallback path**) (**⚠️ the entry does not claim this ordering beats a pure-LLM approach in all settings — the two paths were not benchmarked against each other**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ `check_treaty_grounding()` is another instance of flagging, not blocking, and the seventh occurrence of this session’s recurring discipline** — **it does not ask an LLM to judge again**; **it deterministically compares an extracted value against the actual text of the very page that value cites** (**the README says verbatim that this is "a deterministic grounding check, not another LLM call"**); **a field that does not check out is flagged with a warning naming that field rather than silently trusted**. ⭐⭐ **The full line**: **[[powmcp-skills]] (319) → [[rag-assurance]] (321) → [[underwriting-decision-safety]] (323) → [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]] (325) → `NEEDS_REVIEW` in [[sharia-compliance-agent]] (327) → the defect list in [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] (328) → this entry (329)**; **what is distinctive here is that the distrust is made per-field and named**, **rather than returning the whole document** — **so the usable parts stay usable**. **③ ⭐⭐ The distinction between transient and non-transient failure deserves separate note**: the README reads verbatim "up to 2 retries with exponential backoff (1s, then 2s) — before giving up; a non-transient failure (e.g. an invalid API key) fails immediately, unretried" — **separating timeouts, network hiccups, rate limits and momentary server overload (worth retrying) from an invalid API key (pointless to retry)**, **a rare case of a project writing its retry semantics down clearly** (**its `src/llm_client.py` was not read**). **④ ⭐⭐ Extraction-accuracy evaluation and unit testing are two separate things** — **`tests/eval/` is a small harness separate from `pytest tests/` that scores the accuracy of the whole extraction pipeline (regex plus LLM fallback) against a labelled golden dataset**: **per-field accuracy for the four scalar fields (`cedent_name`, `attachment_point`, `limit`, `reinsurance_premium`)** and **set-based precision/recall for the list-valued `exclusions`** (**matched by normalised substring containment, since an LLM’s clause phrasing can vary even when correct**). ⭐⭐⭐ **Its stated reason reads verbatim**: **"This is what would catch a prompt or model-version regression that still "passes" (extracts something) but gets the actual values wrong."** **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ It even tests its own scorer**: **`tests/eval/test_eval_suite.py` tests the scorer deterministically with a mocked LLM client rather than the live API**, **including a deliberately-broken mocked extraction (wrong values, a dropped exclusions list)**, **and asserts the scored accuracy actually drops** — **verifying that the evaluation can detect errors, not merely that it runs** (**the same instinct as round 328’s [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] and its list of defects found during verification**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Five golden cases cover both paths**: two regex-path fixtures and **three LLM-path fixtures written as prose in three deliberately distinct styles** (`USD 500,000`-style formatting in one, `USD 750,000.00`-style in another) — **it does not assume the LLM faces only one prose style** (**⚠️ the suite was not run, and the all-100% table in the README is the repository’s own sample output**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ The three LLM cases are reported as skipped rather than failing when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is absent**, **while the two regex cases always run** — **a practical arrangement giving keyless contributors and CI partial signal** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim skipped cannot be misread as passing**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ The workflow diagram is regenerated automatically by a pre-commit hook** — **the README states verbatim that the mermaid diagram is rewritten whenever `src/workflow.py` enters a commit, enabled by `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`** — **which addresses the common problem of documentation drifting from the actual flow** (**readable with [[reproducible-actuarial-work]] and [[verified-reserving]]**). **⑨ ⭐⭐ Only implemented tasks are wired in**: **`build_workflow_graph()` accepts an optional set of domain-task IDs (defaulting to just Burn-Cost Check)**, **and per the registry in `src/domain_tasks.py` only implemented tasks in that set get wired in after the Verifier Node** — **the architecture reserves a place for future tasks without pretending they exist** (**it is currently the only implemented task**; **readable with round 328’s [[creance]] and its scheduler that only prints its plan, and round 327’s [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]]**). **⑩ ⭐⭐ `REASONING.md` (255,348 bytes, 73 entries from 2026-09-03 to 2026-09-10) describes itself as "the reasoning transcript of the AI agent for the current session"**, **each entry headed `## date time — Task: title (task-id)` and structured as Goal / Analysis / Decision / Action**; **the first entry of 2026-09-03 (`spec-first-file-structure`) explains in its Decision section why schemas should not be invented ahead of a real spec ("inventing schemas/logic ahead of a real spec would be scope creep"), and notes entries.summary_en: A handoff kit for building tabular review into an insurance product: upload policies, quotes, binders, certificates, treaties, claims files or contracts, pick a review template, and get a grid of rows by columns where every cell is an extracted or assessed value carrying a traffic-light flag plus verbatim citations back to the source page; the model is explicitly limited to gathering inputs, with computed columns specified for the application to calculate itself
entries.body:
**insurance-tabular-review** 是一个**把「表格化审阅」做进保险产品的交接包**（仓库 `drmikegoetsch-sudo/insurance-tabular-review`），**实测 MIT 许可、★0、fork 0、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 275 KB、创建于 2026-09-10、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API／搜索 API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**README 实测 4,506 字节，并实测含 `LICENSE`（MIT）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「交接处——一个东西换手时会发生什么」**中的**第二种，也是最直白的一种：这个仓库本身就是一次交接**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其开篇逐字，是本条目最重要的一句**：**「A standalone kit for building tabular review into an insurance product: upload policies, quotes, binders, certificates, treaties, claims files, or contracts; pick a review template; get **a grid of rows × columns where every cell is an extracted or assessed value with a traffic-light flag and verbatim citations back to the source page**.」**；⭐⭐⭐ **紧接着一句逐字定义了它的性质**：**「**This repo is the handoff.** It contains what a team needs to implement the feature natively in its own stack, **and nothing else**.」**——**即「**这个仓库就是交接物**。它包含一个团队在自己技术栈里原生实现该功能所需的一切，**此外什么都没有**」**。**其目录表逐字实测**：**`demo/`——可运行的 React 演示**（**基于虚构账户：报价比较、保单核对、合同审阅，另加空白审阅与全部目录模板；用 Vite、Tailwind 与模板包构建**）；**`packages/review-templates/`——模板目录，一个**无依赖的 TypeScript 包**：**20 个模板、11 个扩展、559 列**，**含列构建器、提示词组装、单元格解析器与一个 React 模板选择器****；**`spec/`——实现规格：数据模型、API、抽取契约、审阅生命周期与界面**；**`templates/source/`——目录由之生成的那份手工编写的表格与 JSON 导出**；**`design/`——设计文件，就绪时放入**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「三种列型，且模型只收集输入不做计算」是本条目最有价值的设计，也是本会话见到对 LLM 算术不可靠问题最干净的回答**——**逐字为**：**「Every column is one of three kinds: `extract` (read a value), `analysis` (compare or assess, citing both sides), or `calculate` (**a specification the application computes; the model only gathers inputs**).」**——**即**`extract` 读一个值**、**`analysis` 比较或评估并引证两侧**、**`calculate` 是**由应用程序计算的规格，模型只负责收集输入****。⭐⭐ **这直接切断了 LLM 最不可靠的一环**：**让模型**去找出计算所需的输入**，**而让确定性代码去做算术****；**对做 AI 精算工具的学生，这是一条**可以立刻照搬的架构规则**（**可与 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的「正则优先、LLM 兜底」并读——**两者都在**缩小模型负责的范围****；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该切分能消除所有错误**——**输入本身仍可能被读错**，**而该项由单元格的引证与后续校验兜住**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「每个单元格都带逐字引证并可点开源页面」是第二个亮点**：**README 逐字说明演示中「click any cell to open the **source panel with its verbatim citations**」**，**并有一个「Differences」视图**只显示**各行彼此不一致的那些列****——**即它把**哪几行吵起来了**做成一个视图**，**而不是让审阅者逐格比对**；**⚠️ 本次未运行其演示，未查看任何实际输出**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「**这个仓库就是交接物**，此外什么都没有」是一条罕见的交付边界声明**——**多数项目会顺手把无关内容一并放进仓库**，**而这里明确声明**只交付实现该功能所需之物****；**更值得注意的是它的模板目录里**本身就有一个叫 **「Account Handoff」** 的模板****——**即该产品**要处理的业务流程之一正是交接本身****（**本会话同源线索：第 328 轮 [[creance]] 的「调度器只打印计划」、第 327 轮 [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]] 的两处 `(honest)`——**同一种「把边界写在明面上」**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **20 个模板分两个域，逐字实测**：**商业保险（13 个）**——Commercial Quote Comparison、Commercial Renewal Changes、Prospect Account Review、Policy Delivery Check、Submission Readiness、**Account Handoff**、Multi-location Account Review、Coverage Review、Total Cost of Risk、Deductible and Retention Scenarios、Contract Insurance Requirements、M&A Insurance Alignment、Commercial Proposal Comparison；**员工健康与福利（7 个）**——Benefits Quote and Proposal Comparison、Benefits Renewal Changes、Employer Contribution Scenarios、Employee Impact Analysis、Benefits Budget Planning、Benefits Vendor Contract Review、Benefits Harmonization。**11 个扩展逐字实测**：**Property and Business Income、General Liability、Commercial Auto、Workers Compensation、Cyber、D&O and Employment Practices、Umbrella and Excess、Dental and Vision、Life and Disability、Stop-loss、PBM Pricing and Guarantees**。⭐⭐ **这份清单本身就是一份**保险审阅任务清单****——**对不熟悉商业保险实务的学生，「Total Cost of Risk」「Deductible and Retention Scenarios」「Submission Readiness」「M&A Insurance Alignment」这些名字**直接指出了真实经纪与核保流程中的具体环节****（**⚠️ 本次未读其 559 列的具体内容与提示词**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **测试会因「目录完整性」被破坏而失败**——**逐字**：**「Tests will fail if **a template loses its row grain, a column loses its prompt, or an extension points at a template that does not list it**.」**——**即把**模板粒度、列提示词、扩展与模板的引用一致性**都做成**测试可强制的约束****；**重生成方式为改 `templates/source/insurance-review-templates.json` 后跑 `npm run build:catalog`**；**对做精算系统交付的学生，这是**把数据规格做成可测试对象**的一个具体范例**（**可与 [[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]] 并读**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **审阅状态含 `reviewed`、`locked`、`override`、`stale` 四态**——**其中**`stale`（过期）**值得单独注意**：**它承认**一份已完成审阅在源文件变化后会失效****；**多数字表格工具只有「完成／未完成」**（**⚠️ 本次未读其状态机实现**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **它给了明确的落地顺序（6 步）**，**逐字实测**：**① 数据模型与模板端点**（「**Half a day with the package**」）；**② 带模板选择器的创建审阅流程**；**③ 抽取：文档文本缓存、每行一次请求、单元格流式写入、引证校验**；**④ 表格、单元格面板与各视图**；**⑤ 审阅状态：reviewed／locked／override／stale**；**⑥ 表格上的对话与导出**。⭐⭐ **「Half a day with the package」这句估计，是「这个仓库就是交接物」的具体化**——**它给的是**接手方的人力估计**，而不仅是代码**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **给出的调用面逐字实测**：`buildColumns({ templateId: "CI04", extensionIds: ["CX02"] })`、`buildSystemPrompt()`、`buildRowPrompt({ documents, userContext, columns })`、**以及对每一行流式输出调用 `parseCellLine()`**——**即**系统提示词与行提示词分开组装、单元格逐行解析****（**⚠️ 本次未调用该包，未验证其 API 行为**）。**⑨ ⭐ **其抽取契约为「每行一次请求」**（**第 ③ 步逐字含「one request per row, streamed cell writes」**）——**这是一个**与「整份文档一次问完」相对的取舍**：**行粒度更易定位错误，但请求数随行数增长**（**可与第 322 轮 [[condition-parametric-zk]]、第 325 轮 [[pingpoint-freight-mcp]] 等对**可信度与成本的取舍**并读**）。**⑩ ⭐ 可与本站审阅与抽取条目并读**：[[clauseguard]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]、[[underwriting-copilot]]、[[acord]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]]、[[acord-data-quality-monitor]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[sfcr-mistral-extraction]]、[[brel-xbrl]]。

**insurance-tabular-review** 是一個**把「表格化審閱」做進保險產品的交接包**（倉庫 `drmikegoetsch-sudo/insurance-tabular-review`），**實測 MIT 許可、★0、fork 0、主語言 TypeScript、體量 275 KB、創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-10**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**README 實測 4,506 位元組，並實測含 `LICENSE`（MIT）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「交接處——一個東西換手時會發生什麼」**中的**第二種，也是最直白的一種：這個倉庫本身就是一次交接**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **開篇逐字，是本條目最重要的一句**：**「A standalone kit for building tabular review into an insurance product: upload policies, quotes, binders, certificates, treaties, claims files, or contracts; pick a review template; get **a grid of rows × columns where every cell is an extracted or assessed value with a traffic-light flag and verbatim citations back to the source page**.」**；⭐⭐⭐ **緊接一句逐字定義其性質**：**「**This repo is the handoff.** It contains what a team needs to implement the feature natively in its own stack, **and nothing else**.」**。**目錄表逐字實測**：**`demo/`——可運行的 React 演示**（**基於虛構帳戶：報價比較、保單核對、合同審閱，另加空白審閱與全部目錄模板；用 Vite、Tailwind 與模板包構建**）；**`packages/review-templates/`——模板目錄，一個**無依賴的 TypeScript 包**：**20 個模板、11 個擴展、559 列**，**含列構建器、提示詞組裝、儲存格解析器與一個 React 模板選擇器****；**`spec/`——實現規格：資料模型、API、抽取契約、審閱生命週期與介面**；**`templates/source/`——目錄由之生成的手寫表格與 JSON 導出**；**`design/`——設計檔案**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「三種列型，且模型只收集輸入不做計算」是本條目最有價值的設計，也是本會話見到對 LLM 算術不可靠問題最乾淨的回答**——**逐字**：**「Every column is one of three kinds: `extract` (read a value), `analysis` (compare or assess, citing both sides), or `calculate` (**a specification the application computes; the model only gathers inputs**).」**——**即 `extract` 讀値、`analysis` 比較或評估並引證兩側、`calculate` 是**由應用程式計算的規格，模型只負責收集輸入****。⭐⭐ **這直接切斷了 LLM 最不可靠的一環**：**讓模型**找出計算所需的輸入**，**讓確定性代碼做算術****；**對做 AI 精算工具的學生，這是一條**可立刻照搬的架構規則**（**可與 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的「正則優先、LLM 兜底」並讀——兩者都在**縮小模型負責的範圍****；**⚠️ 不主張**該切分能消除所有錯誤**——**輸入本身仍可能被讀錯**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「每個儲存格都帶逐字引證並可點開源頁面」是第二個亮點**：**「click any cell to open the **source panel with its verbatim citations**」**，**並有一個「Differences」視圖**只顯示各行彼此不一致的那些列****（**⚠️ 未運行其演示**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「**這個倉庫就是交接物**，此外什麼都沒有」是罕見的交付邊界聲明**；**其模板目錄裡**本身就有一個叫 **「Account Handoff」** 的模板****——**即該產品**要處理的業務流程之一正是交接本身****（**同源線索：第 328 輪 [[creance]]、第 327 輪 [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]]**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **20 個模板分兩個域，逐字實測**：**商業保險（13）**——Commercial Quote Comparison、Commercial Renewal Changes、Prospect Account Review、Policy Delivery Check、Submission Readiness、**Account Handoff**、Multi-location Account Review、Coverage Review、Total Cost of Risk、Deductible and Retention Scenarios、Contract Insurance Requirements、M&A Insurance Alignment、Commercial Proposal Comparison；**員工健康與福利（7）**——Benefits Quote and Proposal Comparison、Benefits Renewal Changes、Employer Contribution Scenarios、Employee Impact Analysis、Benefits Budget Planning、Benefits Vendor Contract Review、Benefits Harmonization。**11 個擴展逐字**：**Property and Business Income、General Liability、Commercial Auto、Workers Compensation、Cyber、D&O and Employment Practices、Umbrella and Excess、Dental and Vision、Life and Disability、Stop-loss、PBM Pricing and Guarantees**。⭐⭐ **這份清單本身就是一份**保險審閱任務清單****（**⚠️ 未讀其 559 列的具體內容與提示詞**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **測試會因「目錄完整性」被破壞而失敗**——**逐字**：**「Tests will fail if **a template loses its row grain, a column loses its prompt, or an extension points at a template that does not list it**.」**（**重生成方式為改 `templates/source/insurance-review-templates.json` 後跑 `npm run build:catalog`**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **審閱狀態含 `reviewed`、`locked`、`override`、`stale` 四態**——**其中 **`stale`（過期）**值得單獨注意**：**它承認**一份已完成審閱在源檔案變化後會失效****（**⚠️ 未讀其狀態機實現**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **落地順序（6 步）逐字實測**，**含「**Half a day with the package**」這一估計**——**它給的是**接手方的人力估計**，而不僅是代碼**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **調用面逐字**：`buildColumns({ templateId: "CI04", extensionIds: ["CX02"] })`、`buildSystemPrompt()`、`buildRowPrompt({ documents, userContext, columns })`、**以及對每一行流式輸出調用 `parseCellLine()`**（**⚠️ 未調用該包**）。**⑨ ⭐ **抽取契約為「每行一次請求」**（**「one request per row, streamed cell writes」**）——**行粒度更易定位錯誤，但請求數隨行數增長**。**⑩ ⭐ 可與 [[clauseguard]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]、[[underwriting-copilot]]、[[acord]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]]、[[acord-data-quality-monitor]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[sfcr-mistral-extraction]]、[[brel-xbrl]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據（含 MIT 許可）、README 全文的開篇、目錄表、模板與擴展清單、三種列型定義、測試約束、審閱狀態、落地順序與調用示例**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安裝、未運行 `npm test`／`npm run typecheck`／`npm run demo`、未讀 `packages/review-templates/` 任何原始碼、未讀 `spec/`、未查看 559 列具體內容與提示詞、未運行其 React 演示****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**「模型只收集輸入、應用程式做計算」在實現中是否真被強制****——**只核實到它被寫入 README 與列型定義**；**是僅靠提示詞約束還是由代碼校驗，未核實**；**③ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其「逐字引證」是否經過校驗**（**落地順序第 ③ 步提到「citation validation」，但未讀其實現**），**不主張**引證一定與源頁面相符**；**④ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其 20 個模板的商業與福利保險內容是否準確或與任何監管實務口徑一致**（**模板名稱可信，但列定義與提示詞未讀**）；**⑤ ⭐ **未核實**其 `demo/` 中引用的 `shadcn` 組件替身是否帶來許可或兼容問題**；**⑥ ⭐ **未核實**該倉庫與 `drmikegoetsch-sudo` 名下其他倉庫的關係**；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ 其文件類型含**保單、暫保單、憑證、條約、理賠文件與合同****——**多為**受監管或含個人資料的文件**；**不主張**其在資料保護、留存或跨境傳輸方面合規**（**本次未評估**）；**⑧ ⭐ 其演示基於**虛構帳戶與虛構資料****，**不主張**可直接用於真實業務**；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、創建與推送同日**，**不主張成熟度／可維護性／已被採用**；**⑩ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：倉庫元數據經 GitHub 搜索 API 於 2026-09-11 實測；README 經 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 實測 4,506 位元組；**未克隆、未安裝、未運行、未讀原始碼與 `spec/`**。

**insurance-tabular-review** is **a handoff kit for building tabular review into an insurance product** (repository `drmikegoetsch-sudo/insurance-tabular-review`), with **measured MIT licence, ★0, 0 forks, TypeScript as the primary language, a 275 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**GitHub search API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 4,506 bytes and a `LICENSE` file (MIT) is measurably present**. It is the second and most literal of this round’s four takes on **the handoff point**: **this repository is itself a handoff**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **its opening, read verbatim, is the entry’s most important line**: **"A standalone kit for building tabular review into an insurance product: upload policies, quotes, binders, certificates, treaties, claims files, or contracts; pick a review template; get a grid of rows × columns where every cell is an extracted or assessed value with a traffic-light flag and verbatim citations back to the source page."**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the sentence immediately after defines what it is**: **"This repo is the handoff. It contains what a team needs to implement the feature natively in its own stack, and nothing else."** **Its directory table reads verbatim**: **`demo/` — a runnable React demo** (**on fictional accounts: Quote Comparison, Policy Checking, Contract Review, plus a blank review and every catalog template, built with Vite, Tailwind and the templates package**); **`packages/review-templates/` — the template catalog as a dependency-free TypeScript package: 20 templates, 11 extensions, 559 columns, with a column builder, prompt assembly, cell parser and a React template picker**; **`spec/` — the implementation spec: data model, API, extraction contract, review lifecycle and UI**; **`templates/source/` — the authored workbook and JSON export the catalog is generated from**; **`design/` — design files, when ready**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Three column kinds with the model limited to gathering inputs is the entry’s most valuable design, and the cleanest answer this session has seen to the unreliability of LLM arithmetic** — **verbatim**: **"Every column is one of three kinds: `extract` (read a value), `analysis` (compare or assess, citing both sides), or `calculate` (a specification the application computes; the model only gathers inputs)."** — **`extract` reads a value, `analysis` compares or assesses citing both sides, and `calculate` is a specification the application computes while the model only gathers inputs**. ⭐⭐ **This severs the model’s least reliable link**: **let the model find the inputs a calculation needs, and let deterministic code do the arithmetic**; **for students building AI actuarial tooling this is an architectural rule that can be adopted immediately** (**readable with regex-first, LLM-fallback in [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] — both shrink what the model is responsible for**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim this split eliminates all error — inputs themselves can still be misread, which is what per-cell citations and downstream validation are for**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Every cell carrying verifiable citations that open onto the source page is the second highlight**: **the README says verbatim that in the demo one can "click any cell to open the source panel with its verbatim citations"**, **and there is a "Differences" view showing only the columns where rows disagree** — **it makes "which rows are arguing with each other" a view rather than something a reviewer hunts cell by cell** (**⚠️ its demo was not run and no actual output was seen**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ "This repo is the handoff ... and nothing else" is a rare statement of delivery boundary** — **most projects sweep unrelated content into the repository**, **whereas this declares it contains only what is needed to implement the feature**; **more notably, the template catalog itself includes one named "Account Handoff"** — **so one of the business processes the product handles is the handoff itself** (**the same instinct as round 328’s [[creance]] and round 327’s [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]]: write the boundary on the face of the work**). **④ ⭐⭐ Twenty templates across two domains, read verbatim**: **Commercial Insurance (13)** — Commercial Quote Comparison, Commercial Renewal Changes, Prospect Account Review, Policy Delivery Check, Submission Readiness, **Account Handoff**, Multi-location Account Review, Coverage Review, Total Cost of Risk, Deductible and Retention Scenarios, Contract Insurance Requirements, M&A Insurance Alignment, Commercial Proposal Comparison; **Employee Health & Benefits (7)** — Benefits Quote and Proposal Comparison, Benefits Renewal Changes, Employer Contribution Scenarios, Employee Impact Analysis, Benefits Budget Planning, Benefits Vendor Contract Review, Benefits Harmonization. **The 11 extensions read verbatim**: **Property and Business Income, General Liability, Commercial Auto, Workers Compensation, Cyber, D&O and Employment Practices, Umbrella and Excess, Dental and Vision, Life and Disability, Stop-loss, PBM Pricing and Guarantees**. ⭐⭐ **That list is itself a list of insurance review tasks** — **for students unfamiliar with commercial insurance practice, names like Total Cost of Risk, Deductible and Retention Scenarios, Submission Readiness and M&A Insurance Alignment point directly at concrete steps in real broking and underwriting workflows** (**⚠️ the content of the 559 columns and their prompts was not read**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ Tests fail when catalog integrity breaks** — **verbatim**: **"Tests will fail if a template loses its row grain, a column loses its prompt, or an extension points at a template that does not list it."** — **template granularity, column prompts and extension-to-template references are all made constraints a test can enforce**; **regeneration is done by editing `templates/source/insurance-review-templates.json` and running `npm run build:catalog`**; **for students delivering actuarial systems, a concrete example of turning a data specification into a testable object** (**readable with [[verified-reserving]] and [[reproducible-actuarial-work]]**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Review state includes `reviewed`, `locked`, `override` and `stale`** — **`stale` deserves separate note: it admits that a completed review becomes invalid once a source document changes**, **where most tabular tools have only done and not-done** (**its state machine was not read**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ It gives an explicit six-step build order, read verbatim**: **① the data model and templates endpoints ("Half a day with the package")**; **② the create-review flow with the template picker**; **③ extraction: document text cache, one request per row, streamed cell writes, citation validation**; **④ the grid, cell panel and views**; **⑤ review state: reviewed, locked, override, stale**; **⑥ chat over the grid and export**. ⭐⭐ **The "Half a day with the package" estimate makes "this repo is the handoff" concrete — it gives the receiving team a labour estimate, not just code.** **⑧ ⭐⭐ The published call surface reads verbatim**: `buildColumns({ templateId: "CI04", extensionIds: ["CX02"] })`, `buildSystemPrompt()`, `buildRowPrompt({ documents, userContext, columns })`, **and `parseCellLine()` on each streamed line** — **system prompt and row prompt assembled separately, cells parsed line by line** (**⚠️ the package was not called and its API behaviour not verified**). **⑨ ⭐ Its extraction contract is one request per row** (**step ③ says verbatim "one request per row, streamed cell writes"**) — **a trade-off against asking about the whole document at once: row granularity localises errors better, but request count grows with row count** (**readable alongside the credibility-versus-cost trade-offs in round 322’s [[condition-parametric-zk]] and round 325’s [[pingpoint-freight-mcp]]**). **⑩ ⭐ Readable with the corpus’s review and extraction entries**: [[clauseguard]], [[policy-explainer-ai]], [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]], [[underwriting-copilot]], [[acord]], [[acord-mcp-architecture]], [[acord-data-quality-monitor]], [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]], [[sfcr-mistral-extraction]] and [[brel-xbrl]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the repository metadata including the MIT licence, and the README’s full 4,506 bytes in respect of its opening, directory table, template and extension lists, three column kinds, test constraints, review states, build order and call example**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install, run `npm test`, `npm run typecheck` or `npm run demo`, read any source in `packages/review-templates/`, read `spec/`, inspect the 559 columns and their prompts, or run its React demo**, so **its data model, API shape, extraction contract details, cell parsing rules, citation validation algorithm and any prompt content cannot be restated**; **② ⭐⭐⭐ Whether the rule that the model only gathers inputs while the application computes is actually enforced in the implementation was not verified** — **only that it is written into the README and the column-kind definitions**; **whether it rests on prompting alone or is validated in code was not determined**; **③ ⭐⭐ Whether its verbatim citations are validated was not verified** (**step ③ mentions citation validation, but the implementation was not read**), **so the entry does not claim a citation necessarily matches its source page**; **④ ⭐⭐ Whether the 20 templates’ commercial and benefits content is accurate or consistent with any regulatory or professional standard was not verified** (**the template names are credible, but the column definitions and prompts were not read**); **⑤ ⭐ Whether the stand-ins for shadcn components referenced in `demo/` raise licence or compatibility issues was not verified** (**the README says the two `components/ui` files stand in for shadcn’s Button and DropdownMenu**); **⑥ ⭐ The relationship between this repository and others under `drmikegoetsch-sudo` was not verified** (**that author’s other repositories were not examined**); **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ The document types it names include policies, binders, certificates, treaties, claims files and contracts** — **mostly regulated documents or ones containing personal data**; **the entry does not claim compliance with data protection, retention or cross-border transfer requirements** (**not assessed**); **⑧ ⭐ Its demo uses fictional accounts and fictional data** (**the README says so verbatim**), **so it is not claimed to be usable for real business**; **⑨ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created and pushed the same day (2026-09-10)**, **no maturity, maintainability or adoption is claimed**; **⑩ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: repository metadata read via the GitHub search API on 2026-09-11 (**★0, MIT, TypeScript, 275 KB, created and pushed both 2026-09-10**); the README read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` (**4,506 bytes**, with its opening, directory table, template and extension lists, three column kinds, test constraints, build order and call example checked verbatim); **nothing cloned, installed or run, and neither the source nor `spec/` read**.

entries.title: 从索赔到信心：一笔 200 万欧元修正穿过准备金、再保、财务与资本四个职能
entries.title_en: From claim to confidence: one EUR 2m correction traced through reserving, reinsurance, finance and capital
entries.title_hk: 從索賠到信心：一筆 200 萬歐元修正穿過準備金、再保、財務與資本四個職能
entries.summary: 一个把单笔索赔修正沿着准备金、再保条约、财务总账与资本交接四段传导全程串起来的场景实例：以虚构保险公司与合成数据演示，用后端强制的权限矩阵与只增不改的审计日志回答一个电子表格答不了的问题——当一笔索赔变了，另一端出来的数字还能不能信、以及能不能证明它是怎么来的
entries.summary_hk: 一個把單筆索賠修正沿著準備金、再保條約、財務總賬與資本交接四段傳導全程串起來的場景實例：以虛構保險公司與合成資料演示，用後端強制的權限矩陣與只增不改的審計日誌回答一個電子表格答不了的問題——當一筆索賠變了，另一端出來的數字還能不能信、以及能不能證明它是怎麼來的
entries.summary_en: A scenario instance tracing one claim correction end to end through four handoffs — reserving, the reinsurance treaty, the finance ledger and the capital hand-off — demonstrated on a fictional insurer with synthetic data, using a back-end-enforced authority matrix and an append-only audit log to answer a question a spreadsheet cannot: when a claim changes, can you trust the number that comes out the other end, and can you prove how you got there?
entries.body:
**claim-to-confidence** 是一个**把单笔索赔修正沿四个职能全程串起来的场景实例**（仓库 `wryszka/claim-to-confidence`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 3,809 KB、创建于 2026-09-09、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 3,957 字节**。本条目属于本轮主题**「交接处——一个东西换手时会发生什么」**中的**第三种，也是把「交接」当作主角的那一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：**README 标题逐字为「From Claim to Confidence」**；⭐⭐⭐ **其副标题与开篇逐字，是本条目最重要的一段**：**「A **connected, governed reserving journey** for Bricksurance SE (a fictional insurer, synthetic data).」**——**即「一个为 Bricksurance SE（**一家虚构保险公司，合成数据**）所做的**连通、受治理的准备金旅程**」**；**紧接着**：**「One €2 million correction to a single motor claim, traced — **with enforced authority and a full audit trail** — through **the reserve, the reinsurance treaty, the finance ledger and the capital hand-off**.」**——**即「一笔对单宗车险索赔的 200 万欧元修正，**在强制权限与完整审计轨迹之下**，穿过**准备金、再保条约、财务总账与资本交接**」**；⭐⭐⭐ **其存在理由逐字**：**「Built to answer the question a spreadsheet cannot: ***when a claim changes, can you trust the number that comes out the other end, and can you prove how you got there?***」**。⭐⭐⭐ **其主结果逐字实测，是本条目在具体性上最值得引用的一处**：**「**Hero result (synthetic oracle):** €2.0m case correction → **+€2.2m** selected gross outstanding → **+€1.76m** net after a 20% quota-share treaty. **Because €2.0m is already booked in finance, only the €0.2m residual is proposed for posting — never double-counted.**」**——**即 200 万欧元的个案修正→毛额已发生未报告（outstanding）选定值 +220 万欧元→经 **20% 成数再保**后净额 +176 万欧元；**因 200 万欧元已在财务入账，**只把 20 万欧元差额建议入账，绝不重复计算****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这些数值正确**——**本次未运行其引擎或校验脚本**）。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「一笔修正穿过四个职能」是本轮主题的核心样本，也是本站「把场景做成可检验对象」的第 8 次出现**——**它把准备金里一个**孤立的数字**推过四道手**：**准备金 → 再保条约 → 财务总账 → 资本**，**而每一段都有**不同的持有者与不同的正确性含义****（**可与 [[databricks-actuarial-architecture]]、[[aws-actuarial-reserve-modelling]] 并读**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该链条设计符合任何保险公司的实际流程**——**本次未读其方法文档**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「四个数字被刻意保持区分（2.4 / 2.2 / 1.76 / 0.2）」是本条目在防错设计上最值得记的一点**——**README 的**D 画面（Change impact）**逐字描述为：「the two cutoffs compared, how each method responds, **the revision bridge (posted vs residual)**, and **the four numbers kept distinct (2.4 / 2.2 / 1.76 / 0.2)**」**。⭐⭐ **这正是跨职能交接最容易出的错**：**220 万（毛额选定）、176 万（分出后净额）、200 万（已入账）、20 万（待入账差额）**——**四个都合理、都出现在同一段对话里，**混淆其中任意两个都会导致重复计提或漏提****；**把「保持区分」写成一个画面的职责，是对这类**数字串味**的直接处理**（**⚠️ 本次未查看该画面，未核实其呈现方式**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「强制权限矩阵 ＋ 一条负向测试（智能体身份被拒）」是本条目在治理上最硬的一点**——**E 画面逐字**：**「E · Review & approval | The exact proposal, **the authority matrix the backend enforces**, the balanced residual journal, and **a negative test (agent identity denied)**.」**——**即后端**强制**一张权限矩阵，**并且有一条**负向测试：智能体身份被拒绝****。⭐⭐⭐ **对做 AI 进精算流程的学生，这是一处极少见的直接示范**：**不只是「人类在环」这句口号，而是**一条会失败的测试，证明 AI 的审计身份的确认不了账****（**可与本站 [[insurance-governance]]、[[underwriting-decision-safety]]、[[soa-ai-life-challenge]] 并读**；**⚠️ 本次未运行该测试，未核实它真的会因为智能体身份而失败**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「What is real」一节主动划分了真实与合成的边界，是本会话同一条纪律的第 9 次出现**——**逐字**：**「**Runs for real on Databricks.** 14 Unity Catalog tables in the isolated schema `lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.claim_to_confidence`; the app reads them live and computes every business number through **a pure engine that acceptance tests prove to the cent**.」**、**「**No browser-side reserve maths, no fabricated results.** The engine derives methods, selection, reinsurance and the finance journal from stored inputs. `tools/smoke_test.py` holds **the independent §5 oracle** and checks the engine reproduces it (**43/43 checks, to the cent**).」**、**「**The triangle is derived from the claim ledger** (no duplicated business data); AY2023’s current diagonal reconciles to the ledger aggregate.」**——**即①真的跑在 Databricks 上，隔离 schema 内 14 张 Unity Catalog 表，**验收测试证明纯引擎能精确到分****；②**界面不做准备金算术、不编造结果**，**且 `tools/smoke_test.py` 持有一份**独立的 §5 判定基准（oracle）**，**验证引擎能复现它（43/43 项，精确到分）****；③**三角是从理赔台账推导出来的（不重复存业务数据）**，**且 AY2023 的当前对角线与台账汇总对得上****。⭐⭐ **「the app reads them live」＋「no fabricated results」＋「独立 oracle」三句合起来，等于把**演示可信度**本身做成了一个可检验命题****。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **六个画面各有明确职责，逐字实测**：**A · The decision**（执行层主画面：200 万→+220 万毛额→+176 万净额在 claim→reserve→reinsurance→finance→capital 上的涟漪，以及**防重复计提的揭示**）；**B · Data readiness**（源交付、**被隔离的重复交付（quarantined duplicate delivery）**、**两个信息截止点的控制总数**、质量门）；**C · Practitioner**（三角、经验与选定发展因子、**四个方法的指示值**、**对选定权重的实时 what-if**）；**D · Change impact**（两个截止点对比、各方法如何响应、**修正桥（已入账 vs 差额）**、四个数字保持区分）；**E · Review & approval**（见上）；**F · Decision & evidence**（留存运行清单、**确定性的「reproduce this calculation」**、**只增不改的审计日志**）。⭐⭐ **其中 B 与 F 值得单独看**：**B 把「一个重复交付的源文件被隔离」列为画面内容**——**数据接收处的脏数据是交接最实际的风险**；**F 的「reproduce this calculation」与「append-only audit log」把**可复算与不可篡改**并列****（**⚠️ 本次未查看任何画面**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **它是从成熟引擎上**分叉出来的隔离实例****——**逐字**：**「This is an **isolated scenario instance** forked from the proven **Reserving Workbench** engine so it never touches **the live Hiscox demo**. Its executive screens are built to port into **the Group Control Tower** (the estate front door) as a promoted journey.」**——**即它**不碰线上演示**，**且其执行层画面设计为**将来可提升为一个正式旅程****；**≤ 这种**沙盒实例 → 提升为正式流程**的路径，本身就是一种**交接设计****（**⚠️ 本次未核实 Hiscox 演示、Reserving Workbench 或 Group Control Tower 的存在与关系**——**这些名称出自 README 自述**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **技术栈与部署目标逐字实测**：**`tools/`——`engine.py`（纯计算）、`world_engine.py`（确定性场景）、`smoke_test.py`（验收基准，43/43）、`deploy_databricks.py`（→ Unity Catalog）**；**`app/`——FastAPI 后端 + 单文件 SPA**；**`docs/`——执行简报、oracle、验收测试映射、演示运行、构建日志、运行清单**；**目标环境**：**DEV `fevm-lr-dev-aws-us`（profile DEV）、catalog `lr_dev_aws_us_catalog`、schema `claim_to_confidence`、warehouse `a3b61648ea4809e3`（Serverless）**，**并自述「Portable to FINS by overriding the catalog」**（**⚠️ 本次未访问该环境**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **复现只需三步且第一步不需要 Databricks**——**逐字**：**① `python3 tools/smoke_test.py`（「prove the oracle headless (no Databricks needed)」）**；**② `uv run --native-tls --with databricks-sdk tools/deploy_databricks.py --profile DEV`（幂等，重置该实例）**；**③ 部署应用**（**详见 `docs/OVERNIGHT_BUILD_LOG.md`**）。⭐⭐ **「Overnight build log」这一文件名与「幂等、会重置实例」的说明，暗示这是一个**在极短时间内由 AI 大量产出**的项目**——**与第 329 轮同批 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 `REASONING.md` 属同一类可检视痕迹**（**⚠️ 本次未读该构建日志**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站准备金与数据平台条目并读**：[[chainladder]]、[[reservingmodels]]、[[lossdevt]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[claims-reserving-benchmark]]、[[databricks-actuarial-architecture]]、[[databricks-smart-claims]]、[[databricks-dlt-insurance-claims]]、[[run-off-tracker]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[brel-xbrl]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件（`NONE`）****——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用、修改或再分发其代码前必须自行确认授权状况**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据与 README 全文（3,957 字节）的标题、开篇、存在理由、主结果、六个画面表、目录结构、复现步骤与目标环境**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装、未运行 `tools/smoke_test.py`、未执行其 Databricks 部署、未访问其界面、未读 `docs/` 下任何文档（含其自述的 ORACLE.md 与 OVERNIGHT_BUILD_LOG.md）、未读 `tools/engine.py` 或任何源码****，因此**不能转述其三角构造、四个方法的具体选择、再保条款处理、财务凭证生成规则、资本计算方法或除 README 所载之外的任何数值**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ README 中的主结果（€2.0m→+€2.2m→+€1.76m，仅 €0.2m 差额入账）与「43/43 项精确到分」**均为**仓库自述**，**本次未运行、未独立复算**；**本词条**不主张**这些数值正确**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实** E 画面所述的「负向测试（agent identity denied）」确实存在并能通过**——**这是本条目最值得后续核实的一处**；**若该测试不存在或可通过，则本词条所记的治理主张失去依据**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「权限矩阵」的具体内容与执行位置**（**README 称由后端强制**）；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**「the triangle is derived from the claim ledger」与「AY2023 current diagonal reconciles to the ledger aggregate」**——**这两项是**数据一致性主张**，本次未复算**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实** Hiscox、Reserving Workbench、Group Control Tower 三者的存在与关系**（**均为 README 自述名称**；**「forked from the proven Reserving Workbench engine」若指一个未公开的内部系统，则其外部可核性有限**）；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **Bricksurance SE 是虚构公司、数据为合成数据****——**README 明写**；**本词条**不主张**其数值、流程或结论反映任何真实保险公司的实际状况**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ 准备金与资本计算在多数辖区属**受监管的精算工作****，**其结果需经持牌精算师签署**；**本词条**不主张**该工具可用于任何真实的准备金评估、法定申报或资本计算**；**⑩ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-09-09、推送于 2026-09-10**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑪ ⭐ README 仅 3,957 字节而其 `docs/` 自称内容更多**——**本词条只依据 README**；**⑫ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/wryszka/claim-to-confidence` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 3,957 字节，标题、开篇、主结果、六个画面表、目录结构、复现步骤与目标环境逐字核对）；**未克隆、未安装、未运行其 smoke test、未访问其 Databricks 环境或界面、未读 `docs/` 与任何源码**。
