**claim-to-confidence** 是一個**把單筆索賠修正沿四個職能全程串起來的場景實例**（倉庫 `wryszka/claim-to-confidence`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 3,809 KB、創建於 2026-09-09、最後推送 2026-09-10**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**⚠️ 該倉庫實測無任何許可文件（`NONE`）**、**無 topics**；**README 實測 3,957 位元組**。本條目屬本輪主題**「交接處——一個東西換手時會發生什麼」**中的**第三種，也是把「交接」當作主角的那一種**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測**）：**標題逐字「From Claim to Confidence」**；⭐⭐⭐ **副標題與開篇逐字，是本條目最重要的一段**：**「A **connected, governed reserving journey** for Bricksurance SE (a fictional insurer, synthetic data).」**；**緊接**：**「One €2 million correction to a single motor claim, traced — **with enforced authority and a full audit trail** — through **the reserve, the reinsurance treaty, the finance ledger and the capital hand-off**.」**；⭐⭐⭐ **存在理由逐字**：**「Built to answer the question a spreadsheet cannot: ***when a claim changes, can you trust the number that comes out the other end, and can you prove how you got there?***」**。⭐⭐⭐ **主結果逐字**：**「**Hero result (synthetic oracle):** €2.0m case correction → **+€2.2m** selected gross outstanding → **+€1.76m** net after a 20% quota-share treaty. **Because €2.0m is already booked in finance, only the €0.2m residual is proposed for posting — never double-counted.**」**（**⚠️ 不主張**這些數值正確**——**未運行其引擎或校驗腳本**）。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「一筆修正穿過四個職能」是本輪主題的核心樣本，也是本站「把場景做成可檢驗對象」的第 8 次出現**——**把準備金裡一個**孤立的數字**推過四道手**：**準備金 → 再保條約 → 財務總賬 → 資本**，**每段都有**不同的持有者與不同的正確性含義****（**⚠️ 不主張**該鏈條設計符合任何保險公司的實際流程**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「四個數字被刻意保持區分（2.4 / 2.2 / 1.76 / 0.2）」是防錯設計上最值得記的一點**——**D 畫面逐字**：**「the two cutoffs compared, how each method responds, **the revision bridge (posted vs residual)**, and **the four numbers kept distinct (2.4 / 2.2 / 1.76 / 0.2)**」**。⭐⭐ **這正是跨職能交接最容易出的錯**：**220 萬（毛額選定）、176 萬（分出後淨額）、200 萬（已入賬）、20 萬（待入賬差額）**——**混淆其中任意兩個都會導致重複計提或漏提****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「強制權限矩陣 ＋ 一條負向測試（智能體身份被拒）」是治理上最硬的一點**——**E 畫面逐字**：**「The exact proposal, **the authority matrix the backend enforces**, the balanced residual journal, and **a negative test (agent identity denied)**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **對做 AI 進精算流程的學生，這是極少見的直接示範**：**不只是「人類在環」這句口號，而是一條**會失敗的測試，證明 AI 的審計身份的確入不了賬****（**⚠️ 未運行該測試**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「What is real」一節主動劃分真實與合成的邊界，是本會話同一條紀律的第 9 次出現**——**逐字含「**Runs for real on Databricks.** 14 Unity Catalog tables in the isolated schema `lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.claim_to_confidence`; the app reads them live and computes every business number through **a pure engine that acceptance tests prove to the cent**.」**、**「**No browser-side reserve maths, no fabricated results.** … `tools/smoke_test.py` holds **the independent §5 oracle** and checks the engine reproduces it (**43/43 checks, to the cent**).」**、**「**The triangle is derived from the claim ledger** (no duplicated business data); AY2023’s current diagonal reconciles to the ledger aggregate.」**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **六個畫面各有明確職責，逐字實測**：**A · The decision**（執行層主畫面與防重複計提揭示）；**B · Data readiness**（源交付、**被隔離的重複交付**、**兩個資訊截止點的控制總數**、質量門）；**C · Practitioner**（三角、經驗與選定發展因子、**四個方法的指示値**、**對選定權重的實時 what-if**）；**D · Change impact**（**修正橋**與四個數字保持區分）；**E · Review & approval**；**F · Decision & evidence**（留存運行清單、**確定性的 reproduce this calculation**、**只增不改的審計日誌**）。⭐⭐ **B 把「一個重複交付的源檔案被隔離」列為畫面內容**——**資料接收處的髒資料是交接最實際的風險****（**⚠️ 未查看任何畫面**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **它是從成熟引擎分叉出來的隔離實例**——**逐字**：**「This is an **isolated scenario instance** forked from the proven **Reserving Workbench** engine so it never touches **the live Hiscox demo**. Its executive screens are built to port into **the Group Control Tower** (the estate front door) as a promoted journey.」**——**沙盒實例 → 提升為正式流程**本身即一種交接設計**（**⚠️ 未核實 Hiscox／Reserving Workbench／Group Control Tower 的存在與關係**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **技術棧與部署目標逐字**：**`tools/`——`engine.py`（純計算）、`world_engine.py`（確定性場景）、`smoke_test.py`（驗收基準 43/43）、`deploy_databricks.py`**；**`app/`——FastAPI 後端 + 單檔案 SPA**；**`docs/`——執行簡報、oracle、驗收測試映射、演示運行、構建日誌、運行清單**；**目標環境 DEV `fevm-lr-dev-aws-us`、catalog `lr_dev_aws_us_catalog`、schema `claim_to_confidence`、warehouse `a3b61648ea4809e3`（Serverless）**（**⚠️ 未訪問該環境**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **復現三步且第一步不需要 Databricks**——**「prove the oracle headless (no Databricks needed)」**；**②部署冪等且會重置實例**；**③部署應用**。⭐⭐ **「Overnight build log」這一檔名與「冪等、會重置實例」的說明，暗示這是一個**極短時間內由 AI 大量產出**的專案**——**與同批 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 `REASONING.md` 屬同一類可檢視痕跡**（**⚠️ 未讀該構建日誌**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可與 [[chainladder]]、[[reservingmodels]]、[[lossdevt]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[claims-reserving-benchmark]]、[[databricks-actuarial-architecture]]、[[databricks-smart-claims]]、[[databricks-dlt-insurance-claims]]、[[run-off-tracker]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[brel-xbrl]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 該倉庫實測**無任何許可文件****——**明確記錄並提示使用、修改或再分發前必須自行確認授權**；**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據與 README 全文的標題、開篇、存在理由、主結果、六個畫面表、目錄結構、復現步驟與目標環境**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安裝、未運行 `tools/smoke_test.py`、未執行其 Databricks 部署、未訪問其介面、未讀 `docs/` 下任何文檔、未讀任何原始碼****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ README 中的主結果與「43/43 項精確到分」**均為**倉庫自述****，**未運行、未獨立復算**，**不主張**這些數值正確**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實** E 畫面所述的「負向測試（agent identity denied）」確實存在並能通過**——**這是本條目最值得後續核實的一處**；**若該測試不存在或可通過，則本條目所記的治理主張失去依據**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其「權限矩陣」的具體內容與執行位置**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核實**「the triangle is derived from the claim ledger」與「AY2023 current diagonal reconciles to the ledger aggregate」**（**未復算**）；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核實** Hiscox／Reserving Workbench／Group Control Tower 三者的存在與關係**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **Bricksurance SE 為虛構公司、資料為合成資料****，**不主張**其數值、流程或結論反映任何真實保險公司的實際狀況**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ 準備金與資本計算在多数轄區屬**受監管的精算工作****，**需經持牌精算師簽署**，**不主張**該工具可用於任何真實的準備金評估、法定申報或資本計算**；**⑩ ⭐ ★0、fork 0**，**不主張成熟度／正確性／已被採用**；**⑪ ⭐ README 僅 3,957 位元組而其 `docs/` 自稱內容更多**——**本條目只依據 README**；**⑫ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/wryszka/claim-to-confidence` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未克隆、未安裝、未運行其 smoke test、未訪問其 Databricks 環境或介面、未讀 `docs/` 與任何原始碼**。
entries.body_en:
**claim-to-confidence** is **a scenario instance that carries one claim correction through four functions end to end** (repository `wryszka/claim-to-confidence`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 3,809 KB repository, created 2026-09-09 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`) and no topics**; **the README measures 3,957 bytes**. It is the third of this round’s four takes on **the handoff point**, and the one in which the handoff is the protagonist.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): the **title reads verbatim "From Claim to Confidence"**; ⭐⭐⭐ **its subtitle and opening, read verbatim, are the entry’s most important passage**: **"A connected, governed reserving journey for Bricksurance SE (a fictional insurer, synthetic data)."** — **a connected, governed reserving journey for a fictional insurer on synthetic data**; **immediately followed by**: **"One €2 million correction to a single motor claim, traced — with enforced authority and a full audit trail — through the reserve, the reinsurance treaty, the finance ledger and the capital hand-off."**; ⭐⭐⭐ **its stated reason reads verbatim**: **"Built to answer the question a spreadsheet cannot: when a claim changes, can you trust the number that comes out the other end, and can you prove how you got there?"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Its headline result, read verbatim, is the entry’s most concrete passage**: **"Hero result (synthetic oracle): €2.0m case correction → +€2.2m selected gross outstanding → +€1.76m net after a 20% quota-share treaty. Because €2.0m is already booked in finance, only the €0.2m residual is proposed for posting — never double-counted."** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim these numbers are correct — its engine and check script were not run**).

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ One correction crossing four functions is this round’s central sample, and the eighth occurrence of this site’s practice of turning a scenario into an inspectable object** — **it pushes a number that would otherwise sit isolated inside reserving across four hands: reserving, the reinsurance treaty, the finance ledger and capital**, **each with a different holder and a different meaning of correctness** (**readable with [[databricks-actuarial-architecture]] and [[aws-actuarial-reserve-modelling]]**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim the chain matches any insurer’s real process — its method documents were not read**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Four numbers deliberately kept distinct (2.4 / 2.2 / 1.76 / 0.2) is the entry’s most notable error-prevention design** — **screen D (Change impact) reads verbatim**: **"the two cutoffs compared, how each method responds, the revision bridge (posted vs residual), and the four numbers kept distinct (2.4 / 2.2 / 1.76 / 0.2)"**. ⭐⭐ **This is exactly where cross-functional handoffs go wrong**: **2.2m selected gross, 1.76m net of the quota share, 2.0m already booked, 0.2m residual to post** — **all four are individually reasonable and all four appear in the same conversation, so confusing any two produces a double count or an omission**; **making "kept distinct" a screen’s responsibility is a direct treatment of that kind of number bleed** (**the screen was not viewed, so its presentation was not verified**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ A back-end-enforced authority matrix plus a negative test in which an agent identity is denied is the entry’s hardest governance point** — **screen E reads verbatim**: **"E · Review & approval | The exact proposal, the authority matrix the backend enforces, the balanced residual journal, and a negative test (agent identity denied)."** ⭐⭐⭐ **For students bringing AI into actuarial processes this is a rare direct demonstration**: **not the slogan of a human in the loop, but a test that fails — showing that an AI audit identity genuinely cannot post to the ledger** (**readable with [[insurance-governance]], [[underwriting-decision-safety]] and [[soa-ai-life-challenge]]**; **⚠️ the test was not run, so whether it really fails on agent identity was not verified**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ A "What is real" section actively drawing the boundary between real and synthetic is the ninth occurrence of this session’s recurring discipline** — it reads verbatim: **"Runs for real on Databricks. 14 Unity Catalog tables in the isolated schema `lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.claim_to_confidence`; the app reads them live and computes every business number through a pure engine that acceptance tests prove to the cent."**, **"No browser-side reserve maths, no fabricated results. The engine derives methods, selection, reinsurance and the finance journal from stored inputs. `tools/smoke_test.py` holds the independent §5 oracle and checks the engine reproduces it (43/43 checks, to the cent)."**, and **"The triangle is derived from the claim ledger (no duplicated business data); AY2023’s current diagonal reconciles to the ledger aggregate."** ⭐⭐ **Together — the app reading live tables, no fabricated results, and an independent oracle — turn the demonstration’s own credibility into a checkable proposition.** **⑤ ⭐⭐ Six screens with distinct responsibilities, read verbatim**: **A · The decision** (the executive hero: the 2.0m → +2.2m gross → +1.76m net ripple across claim → reserve → reinsurance → finance → capital, and the double-count-prevention reveal); **B · Data readiness** (source deliveries, the quarantined duplicate delivery, control totals at both information cutoffs, quality gate); **C · Practitioner** (the triangle, empirical-versus-selected development factors, the four method indications, and a live what-if on the selection weight); **D · Change impact** (the revision bridge and the four numbers kept distinct); **E · Review & approval**; **F · Decision & evidence** (retained run manifests, deterministic "reproduce this calculation", and an append-only audit log). ⭐⭐ **B deserves separate note for listing a quarantined duplicate delivery as screen content — dirty data at the receiving end is the most practical handoff risk.** **⑥ ⭐⭐ It is an isolated instance forked from a mature engine** — verbatim: **"This is an isolated scenario instance forked from the proven Reserving Workbench engine so it never touches the live Hiscox demo. Its executive screens are built to port into the Group Control Tower (the estate front door) as a promoted journey."** — **a sandbox instance promoted into a formal journey is itself a handoff design** (**⚠️ the existence and relationship of Hiscox, Reserving Workbench and Group Control Tower were not verified — all three are README self-descriptions**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its stack and deployment target read verbatim**: **`tools/` — `engine.py` (pure calculation), `world_engine.py` (deterministic scenario), `smoke_test.py` (acceptance oracle, 43/43), `deploy_databricks.py` (to Unity Catalog)**; **`app/` — a FastAPI back end plus a single-file SPA**; **`docs/` — executive briefing, oracle, acceptance-test map, demo run, build log, run manifests**; **target environment DEV `fevm-lr-dev-aws-us`, catalog `lr_dev_aws_us_catalog`, schema `claim_to_confidence`, warehouse `a3b61648ea4809e3` (Serverless)**, described as **"Portable to FINS by overriding the catalog"** (**⚠️ that environment was not visited**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Reproduction is three steps and the first needs no Databricks** — **"prove the oracle headless (no Databricks needed)"**, then an idempotent deployment that resets the instance, then the app (**details deferred to `docs/OVERNIGHT_BUILD_LOG.md`**). ⭐⭐ **The filename "overnight build log" together with an idempotent deployment that resets the instance suggests a project produced in large volume by AI in a very short time — the same class of inspectable trace as `REASONING.md` in this round’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]]** (**⚠️ that build log was not read**). **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the corpus’s reserving and data-platform entries**: [[chainladder]], [[reservingmodels]], [[lossdevt]], [[verified-reserving]], [[reproducible-actuarial-work]], [[claims-reserving-benchmark]], [[databricks-actuarial-architecture]], [[databricks-smart-claims]], [[databricks-dlt-insurance-claims]], [[run-off-tracker]], [[insurance-governance]] and [[brel-xbrl]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`)** — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before use, modification or redistribution**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata and the README’s full 3,957 bytes in respect of its title, opening, stated reason, headline result, six-screen table, directory structure, reproduction steps and target environment**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install, run `tools/smoke_test.py`, execute its Databricks deployment, visit its interface, read any document under `docs/` (including its own ORACLE.md and OVERNIGHT_BUILD_LOG.md), or read `tools/engine.py` or any source**, so **its triangle construction, the specific selection of its four methods, its reinsurance clause handling, its finance journal generation rules, its capital calculation and any figure beyond those in the README cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The headline result (2.0m → +2.2m → +1.76m with only 0.2m to post) and the "43/43 checks, to the cent" claim are the repository’s own account, and neither was run or independently recomputed**; **the entry does not claim those numbers are correct**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether the "negative test (agent identity denied)" described for screen E exists and passes was not verified** — **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **if the test does not exist or passes, the governance claim recorded here loses its basis**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ The content of its authority matrix and where it is enforced were not verified** (**the README says the backend enforces it**); **⑥ ⭐⭐ The claims that the triangle is derived from the claim ledger and that AY2023’s current diagonal reconciles to the ledger aggregate were not verified** (**not recomputed**); **⑦ ⭐⭐ The existence and relationship of Hiscox, Reserving Workbench and Group Control Tower were not verified** (**all README self-descriptions; if "forked from the proven Reserving Workbench engine" refers to an undisclosed internal system, its external verifiability is limited**); **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ Bricksurance SE is a fictional insurer and the data is synthetic**, **as the README states**, **so its figures, process and conclusions are not claimed to reflect any real insurer**; **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ Reserving and capital calculation are regulated actuarial work in most jurisdictions and require a qualified actuary’s sign-off**, **so the entry does not claim the tool is usable for any real reserve assessment, statutory filing or capital calculation**; **⑩ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created 2026-09-09 and pushed 2026-09-10**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⑪ ⭐ The README is only 3,957 bytes while its own `docs/` claims more content** — **this entry rests on the README alone**; **⑫ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/wryszka/claim-to-confidence` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 3,957-byte README with its title, opening, headline result, six-screen table, directory structure, reproduction steps and target environment checked verbatim); **nothing cloned, installed or run, its smoke test not executed, its Databricks environment and interface not visited, and neither `docs/` nor any source read**.

entries.title_en: Reinsurance treaty intelligence: comparing historical treaties, counterparty drafts and Legal standard language side by side

entries.summary: 一个跨再保续转期做条约合同分析的本地 Web 应用：把历史已签条约、对手方草稿与法务当前提供的标准语言放在一起比对，把合同措辞差异挑出来供谈判使用；其助手只引用所选文件的条款与页码出处，把抽取与解释分开，从不确定唯一正确措辞、不作法律结论、也不声称法律批准

entries.summary_en: A local web application for treaty-contract analysis across reinsurance renewals: it puts historical executed treaties, counterparty drafts and Legal’s current standard language side by side to surface contractual wording variations for negotiation; its assistant cites only document, clause and page provenance from the selected files, separates extraction from interpretation, and never selects the single correct wording, makes legal conclusions or claims legal approval
entries.body:
**reinsurance-treaty-intelligence** 是一个**跨再保续转期做条约合同分析的本地 Web 应用**（仓库 `chae-won-lee/reinsurance-treaty-intelligence`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 46 KB、创建于 2026-09-08、最后推送 2026-09-08**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）**、**无描述**、**无 topics**——**故本条目依据 README 全文（3,885 字节）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「交接处——一个东西换手时会发生什么」**中的**第四种：谈判桌上同时摆着三个版本**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：**README 标题逐字为「Reinsurance Treaty Intelligence」**；⭐⭐⭐ **其定位逐字，是本条目最重要的一段**：**「A complete local web application for **treaty-contract analysis across reinsurance renewals**. The immediate pilot focuses on **upcoming January Property renewals**, comparing **historical treaties against counterparty drafts and current Legal-supplied standard language** to surface **contractual variations for negotiation**.」**——**即「一个用于**跨再保续转期的条约合同分析**的完整本地 Web 应用。当前试点聚焦**即将到来的 1 月财产险续转**，把**历史条约与对手方草稿、以及法务当前提供的标准语言**相比对，以挑出**供谈判用的合同措辞差异**」**；**紧接着一句逐字**：**「**General Aviation remains included as a secondary illustrative line.**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **其「安全边界（Safety Boundary）」一节逐字，是本条目在治理上最值得引用的一处**：**「The assistant is **grounded only in selected documents and seeded knowledge**. It **cites document, clause, and page provenance**. It can summarize extracted differences, explain why a deviation may matter for negotiation, and rank review issues, but it **never selects the single correct wording, makes legal conclusions, or claims legal approval**.」**——**即助手**只以所选文件与内置知识为依据**，**给出文件、条款与页码**三级的出处**，**可以**汇总已抽取的差异、解释某处偏离为何对谈判可能重要、并对复审问题排优先级****，**但**从不选定唯一正确措辞、不作法律结论、也不声称法律批准****。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「三方并排（历史条约 ／ 对手方草稿 ／ 法务标准语言）」是本条目最有价值的设计，也是本轮主题最贴切的一个样本**——**它把谈判桌上**实际同时存在的三个版本**结构化成一个可比对象**：**已签的历史版本（基线）、对方发来的草稿（待审）、法务当前的标准语言（内部标尺）****；**对做再保或合同工作的学生，这直接对应**续转期真实的工作形态**：**不是「读一份合同」，而是「判断这一版与上一版、以及与我方标准语言相比改了什么」**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该比对能替代法务或再保合约人员的专业判断**——**其自身「安全边界」即明确不选定唯一正确措辞**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「把抽取与解释分开」是本条目在方法上最值得记的一点**——**其 Walkthrough 4 逐字描述助手的回答**：**「The answer **cites exact document, clause, and page**, **separates extraction from interpretation**, and **does not determine the single correct language**.」**——**即答案**先给出文件／条款／页面的确切出处（抽取）**，**再把解释分开（解释）**，**且**不判定唯一正确措辞****。⭐⭐ **这是本站同一条纪律的第 10 次出现**（**[[powmcp-skills]]（319）→ [[rag-assurance]]（321）→ [[underwriting-decision-safety]]（323）→ [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]（325）→ [[sharia-compliance-agent]] 的 `NEEDS_REVIEW`（327）→ [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 的缺陷清单（328）→ [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 grounding 逐字段标记（329）→ **本条（329）****）；**本条的新意在于**把「抽取」与「解释」的分离写成了回答的结构要求****——**即不只是**结论要附出处**，**而是**出处与推论必须是回答里两段不同的东西****（**可与第 321 轮 [[rag-assurance]] 并读**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「从不选定唯一正确措辞」是一条明确的**能力边界声明**，且与 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 flagging 形成对照**——**同为再保条约工具，两者都拒绝给出**唯一答案****：**一个**逐字段标记可疑**，**一个**拒绝在措辞上裁决****；**对受监管的合同工作，这是一种**刻意的克制****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该边界在实现中不可绕过**——**本次未读其 `src/` 实现**）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「全部种子文件均为虚构、仅供工作流演示，本应用中任何内容都不是法律意见或法律批准」是第二处免责声明**——**逐字**：**「All seed documents are **fictional and for workflow demonstration only**. **Nothing in this app is legal advice or legal approval.**」**；**它同时出现在开篇段与 Requirements 之后**；**对做法律或合规相关工具的学生，这是一条**必须写清、且不能含糊**的边界**（**可与本会话对**不可核实内容一律标注**的做法同源**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **知识产权自律值得单独记一笔**——**逐字**：**「The interface is inspired by modern professional legal-document-review workflows: persistent comparison context, document-centric navigation, dense evidence tables, and a restrained enterprise palette. **It does not use Litera assets, trademarks, proprietary copy, or exact layouts.**」**——**即在说明**界面风格取自何类工作流**的同时，**明确声明未使用某商业法律文档审阅产品的资产、商标、专有文案或精确版式****；**对本会话反复处理的**来源与授权**问题，这是一个正面样本**（**⚠️ 本次未核实 Litera 是否为该商业产品的权利人，也未核实其声明是否准确**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「可选 `pdftotext`，缺它时记录明确的 OCR／抽取回退状态」是一个务实的降级设计**——**逐字**：**「Optional: `pdftotext` for richer local PDF extraction. **Without it, the ingestion pipeline records a clear OCR/extraction fallback status.**」**；**且「不需要外部密钥或付费服务即可运行核心演示」**——**即可复现性不依赖任何账号**（**⚠️ 本次未按其 Quick Start 运行**：`npm run setup` 与 `npm run dev`，界面在 `http://127.0.0.1:4173`）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **7 条 Walkthrough 把使用方式写得很具体，逐字实测**，**其中数条值得注意**：**① January Property triage**——在 Repository 标签里搜 `data privacy`，**再按 Line of Business 过滤 `Property`、按 Stage 过滤 `counterparty redline`**；**② Renewal comparison**——**以 2025 已签财产险条约为基线、以 2026 年 1 月对手方草稿为待审**，**注意「persistent selected pair、clause diff highlights 与 discrepancy grid」**；**③ Current standard context**——在 Compare 中选 2026 年法务当前标准，**复审 `data privacy`、`notice`、`hours aggregation` 与 `dispute-resolution` 四处偏离**；**⑤ Decision ledger**——在 Review Queue 里就地更新某项状态／处置，**「Refreshing reseeds from the database state; persistent ledger writes are available through the API」**（**即界面上的改动在刷新后会从数据库状态重新播种，持久写入需走 API**——**这是一处**把界面状态与持久状态分开**的诚实说明**）；**⑥ Ingestion**——把 `.txt`／`.docx`／`.pdf` 放入 `examples/ingest` 后跑 `npm run ingest`，**「TXT 与 DOCX 本地抽取；PDF 在有 `pdftotext` 时用其，否则记录一个 OCR 适配器回退」**（**⚠️ 本次未执行任何一条**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ 「General Aviation 作为次要示例业务线」这一句必须**极其谨慎地标注****——**本站第 327 轮已确立**航空险（aviation insurance）在 GitHub 上属结构性缺席**（**在 topic、关键词与 `in:readme` 三种搜索形状下均为 0 或纯噪声**）。⭐⭐ **本条目**并不推翻该结论，反而与分析一致**：**这里出现的「General Aviation」是**一条业务线标签**，用于在同一套条约比对流程上展示第二条线（Walkthrough 7 逐字为切换到 General Aviation 的 2025 基线、2026 对手方草稿与 2025 GA 法务标准）**，**而不是任何**航空险本身的承保、定价或监管资料****；**本词条据此**不把航空险计入已覆盖，也不主张该空白被填补****。**⑨ ⭐ **仓库结构逐字实测**：`server.py`（本地 HTTP 服务与 SQLite API）、`db/schema.sql`（SQLite 模式与索引）、`db/seed.json`（**虚构的条约、标准、条款、比对与台账种子数据**）、`scripts/seed.py`、`scripts/ingest.py`（本地摄取与条款切分流水线）、`public/`、`src/`（共享的仓储、比对与助手逻辑）、**`docs/architecture.md`（领域模型、流水线、grounding、安全与评测说明）**、`tests/`。**⑩ ⭐ 可与本站再保与合同条目并读**：[[reinsurance-treaty-agent]]（**本批同轮的另一种读法：那一款把一份条约抽成结构化条款，本款把三个版本比出差异**）、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]、[[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]]、[[clauseguard]]、[[clausegraph]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[acord]]。

entries.summary: 一个组合级巨灾风险模拟项目：泊松事件频率、对数正态事件严重度、蒙特卡洛年度总损失，算出期望年损失、VaR 与 TVaR，并单列模型不确定性情景、SQL 组合查询与地理暴露可视化；它开篇即声明自己是教育性模拟器而非 RMS／AIR 之类商业巨灾模型的替代，且明说不主张具备专有模型或生产保险数据的经验
entries.summary_hk: 一個組合級巨災風險模擬項目：泊松事件頻率、對數正態事件嚴重度、蒙特卡洛年度總損失，算出期望年損失、VaR 與 TVaR，並單列模型不確定性情景、SQL 組合查詢與地理暴露可視化；它開篇即聲明自己是教育性模擬器而非 RMS／AIR 之類商業巨災模型的替代，且明說不主張具備專有模型或生產保險資料的經驗
entries.summary_en: A portfolio-level catastrophe risk simulation project: Poisson event frequency, lognormal event severity and Monte Carlo annual aggregate loss, producing expected annual loss, VaR and TVaR, with separate treatment of model-uncertainty scenarios, SQL portfolio queries and geospatial exposure visualisation; it states at the outset that it is an educational simulator rather than a substitute for commercial catastrophe models such as RMS or AIR, and explicitly does not claim experience with proprietary models or production insurance data
entries.body:
**CatRiskSim** 是一个**组合级巨灾风险与组合损失模拟项目**（仓库 `anuravi1604-cmd/catrisk-sim`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 2,069 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 3,896 字节**，**另有实测 `RESULTS.md`（1,360 字节）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把假设写成可核对的东西」**中的**第一种：把「我不主张什么」写成开篇第一段**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**仓库描述逐字**：**「Stochastic catastrophe risk and portfolio loss simulator using Monte Carlo, SQL, and geospatial analysis.」**；**根目录实测含 `.gitignore`、`README.md`、**`RESULTS.md`**、`data/`、`outputs/`、`requirements.txt`、`sql/`、`src/`、`tests/`**。⭐⭐⭐ **其开篇的「Important scope（重要范围说明）」逐字，是本条目最有价值的一段**：**「This is an **educational simulator**, **not a replacement for commercial catastrophe models such as RMS or AIR**. The hazard and vulnerability relationships are **synthetic and deliberately simplified**.」**——**即「这是一个**教育性模拟器**，**不是 RMS 或 AIR 之类商业巨灾模型的替代品**。其灾害与脆弱性关系是**合成的、且刻意简化过的**」**。**其建模框架逐字实测（公式原样）**：**事件频率 `N ~ Poisson(lambda)`**；**事件严重度 `S ~ Lognormal(mu, sigma)`**；**单事件损失 `Loss = Exposure × Vulnerability × HazardFactor × ProximityFactor`，并受保额上限约束**；**年度总损失 `AggregateLoss_t = sum(Loss_i) for all events i in year t`**；**再由模拟出的年度损失分布计算 EAL、95%／99% VaR 与 95%／99% TVaR**。**代码结构逐字实测**：`src/generate_data.py`（生成合成暴露组合与随机事件目录）、`src/simulate_losses.py`（模拟年度巨灾损失）、`src/run_sql.py`（把组合载入 SQLite 并跑分析查询）、`src/visualize.py`（损失分布与地理风险图）、`sql/analysis.sql`、`tests/test_simulation.py`、`outputs/`。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「明说自己不是 RMS／AIR 的替代」是本条目最有价值的一点，也是本会话见到对**边界**最直白的开篇声明之一**——**商业巨灾模型（RMS、AIR、CoreLogic／RQE 等）是该行业的实务工具**，**而教育性模拟器与它们之间最容易发生的误读就是**把教学的简化当成可用的近似****；**作者把这条误读写成了开篇第二句**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其简化程度恰当或可用于任何真实定价**——**本次未运行其模型**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「它不主张什么」被写成了与主张并列的一段**——**逐字**：**「It intentionally covers several items in the **Marsh Re internship description** that are absent from a typical AI/ML student resume: stochastic modelling, risk/loss distributions, model uncertainty, SQL, geospatial analysis, interpretation of modelled loss outputs, quality-control checks, process automation. **It does not claim experience with proprietary RMS/AIR/RQE models or production insurance data.**」**——**即它明确说自己是**对着一份具名的实习描述（Marsh Re）**来补齐典型 AI/ML 学生简历上没有的项**，**并**明确声明不主张**拥有专有模型或生产保险数据的经验**。⭐⭐ **对正在求职的学生，这是一份罕见的、**把「我的项目补哪一块」与「我不声称补到了哪一块」同时写清**的样本**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该实习描述在别处可见或该对齐有效**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它给测试定下四条不变量，是本条目在工程上最值得记的一点**——**`RESULTS.md` 逐字列出测试套件验证的内容**：**「losses cannot be negative; **expected loss is below tail-risk quantiles**; **TVaR is at least as large as the corresponding VaR**; **all intended uncertainty scenarios are present**」**——**即①损失不能为负；②期望损失必须低于尾部风险分位数；③**TVaR 必须不小于对应的 VaR**；④所有预期的不确定性情景都必须存在****。⭐⭐ **前三条是**分布内部一致性**（单调性／支撑集）的检查，第四条是**完整性**检查**；**对做随机模型的学生，这是一组**不依赖具体数值就能发现结构性错误**的断言**（**可与 [[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 并读**；**⚠️ 本次未运行其 pytest，未核实这四条确实通过**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ `RESULTS.md` 把一次具体运行的全部关键数值与假设并列，是本条目最便于核对的一处**——**逐字实测**：**年度试验 **20,000** 次；暴露记录 **1,500** 条；核心频率模型 **Poisson(lambda=2.2)**；严重度模型 Lognormal**；**并逐字声明「Results are synthetic and for educational use.」**；**其风险指标表逐字为**：**期望年损失（EAL）$261.51M｜95% VaR $710.80M｜95% TVaR $855.18M｜99% VaR $975.95M｜99% TVaR $1,087.37M｜P(Loss > $50M) 74.62%｜P(Loss > $100M) 67.91%**。⭐⭐ **这些数值得以被核对的前提是**假设也被写下来了**（λ=2.2、20,000 次试验、1,500 条暴露）**——**这正是本轮主题的具体形态**；**⚠️ 本次未运行其流水线，上述数值为**仓库自述**，**本词条**不主张**其可复现**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **把「模型不确定性」单列而不是并进主结果**——**逐字**：**「The sensitivity analysis varies event frequency and severity assumptions. This is important because catastrophe models contain **uncertainty arising from incomplete hazard data, vulnerability assumptions and model structure**.」**，**并输出 `outputs/uncertainty_scenarios.csv` 与 `outputs/uncertainty_sensitivity.png`**；**即它把**模型不确定性**与**参数不确定性**分开对待**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其情景设计足以刻画真实模型风险**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **`RESULTS.md` 的「Interpretation」把它要教的东西拆成四项**——**逐字**：**「The project separates: 1. **frequency risk** — how often events occur; 2. **severity risk** — how damaging an event can be; 3. **exposure concentration** — where and how much value is exposed; 4. **model uncertainty** — how assumptions change estimated tail losses. **That decomposition is the main learning objective.**」**——**即**频率风险／严重度风险／暴露集中度／模型不确定性**四条分解，「而这个分解就是主要学习目标」**。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **10 条「面试谈资」被直接写进 README，是本站少见的一种形态**——**逐字列出**：**为什么频率用泊松？为什么严重度用对数正态？λ 变大时会发生什么？**VaR 有什么是 TVaR 能捕捉而它不能的？**如何验证一个巨灾模型？如何把**偶然变异与模型不确定性分开**？如果两个模型给出的损失估计显著不同你会怎么办？如何把**免赔额、限额与再保分层**纳入？如何把模拟从 10,000 次扩展到数百万次？要把合成灾害模型换成真实的，你需要什么数据？**——⭐⭐ **这十条恰好是**巨灾建模面试的实际问题清单****；**对准备面试的学生，它把「项目做了什么」与「会被问什么」接在了一起**（**可与本站 [[actuarial-student-competitions]]、[[soa-practice-view-ai]] 等备考与求职条目并读**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这十条问题代表任何雇主的实际面试内容**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **「Suggested next upgrade（建议的下一步升级）」逐字**：**「Add an actual public hazard dataset (for example, earthquake event records), replace the synthetic hazard intensity function, and compare the simulated portfolio loss distribution under multiple assumptions.」**——**即它自己指出了**从合成走向真实**的具体一步**。**⑨ ⭐ **默认使用固定随机种子以保证可复现**（**逐字**：**「The default simulation uses a fixed random seed for reproducibility.」**）**。**⑩ ⭐ 可与本站巨灾与随机建模条目并读**：[[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]]、[[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]（**本轮同批的另两种巨灾做法**）、[[openquake-engine]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[oasislmf]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[catmodeling]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[extremeloss]]、[[evd]]、[[eva]]、[[ismev]]、[[hazus]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）****——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用、修改或再分发其代码前必须自行确认授权状况**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库根目录清单、README（3,896 字节）全文与 `RESULTS.md`（1,360 字节）全文**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装、未运行其 `src/` 下任何脚本、未运行 `pytest`、未查看 `outputs/` 与 `data/`、未读 `sql/analysis.sql`、未读 `tests/test_simulation.py` 与 `src/` 任何源码****，因此**不能转述其合成数据的生成方式、灾害强度函数、脆弱性关系、邻近因子的具体形式、情景设计、SQL 查询或除 `RESULTS.md` 所载之外的任何数值**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ `RESULTS.md` 中的全部数值（EAL $261.51M、95% VaR $710.80M 等）为**仓库自述**，**本次未运行、未独立复算**；**本词条**不主张**这些数值正确或可复现**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其四条测试不变量（损失非负、期望损失低于尾部分位数、TVaR ≥ VaR、情景齐全）确实存在于 `tests/test_simulation.py` 中并通过**——**这是本条目最值得后续核实的一处**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「模型不确定性」情景的设计是否足以支撑关于模型风险的结论**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其灾害与脆弱性关系「刻意简化」到什么程度**——**其自述为「synthetic and deliberately simplified」**，**但具体简化了哪些环节本次未读**；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其 README 所称「Marsh Re internship description」的存在与内容**；**本词条**不主张**其对齐有效或该招聘条件在别处可查**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **本项目为教育性模拟器****——**其自述**明确不是商业巨灾模型的替代****；**本词条**不主张**其可用于任何真实的风险定价、资本计算、再保决策或监管报送**；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建与推送同日**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑩ ⭐ README 3,896 字节且无 topics**；**⑪ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 与 `RESULTS.md` 实测均为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/anuravi1604-cmd/catrisk-sim`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 3,896 字节与 `RESULTS.md` 1,360 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测核对，含两条免责语句、建模框架公式、代码结构、风险指标表与十条面试问句）；**未克隆、未安装、未运行、未读源码**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫根目錄實測**）：**倉庫描述逐字**：**「Stochastic catastrophe risk and portfolio loss simulator using Monte Carlo, SQL, and geospatial analysis.」**；**根目錄實測含 `.gitignore`、`README.md`、**`RESULTS.md`**、`data/`、`outputs/`、`requirements.txt`、`sql/`、`src/`、`tests/`**。⭐⭐⭐ **「Important scope」逐字，是本條目最有價值的一段**：**「This is an **educational simulator**, **not a replacement for commercial catastrophe models such as RMS or AIR**. The hazard and vulnerability relationships are **synthetic and deliberately simplified**.」**。**建模框架逐字（公式原樣）**：**`N ~ Poisson(lambda)`**；**`S ~ Lognormal(mu, sigma)`**；**`Loss = Exposure × Vulnerability × HazardFactor × ProximityFactor`（受保額上限約束）**；**`AggregateLoss_t = sum(Loss_i)`**；**再由年度損失分布計算 EAL、95%／99% VaR 與 95%／99% TVaR**。**代碼結構逐字**：`src/generate_data.py`、`src/simulate_losses.py`、`src/run_sql.py`、`src/visualize.py`、`sql/analysis.sql`、`tests/test_simulation.py`、`outputs/`。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「明說自己不是 RMS／AIR 的替代」是最有價值的一點**——**商業巨災模型是該行業的實務工具**，**而教育性模擬器與它們之間最容易發生的誤讀就是**把教學的簡化當成可用的近似****；**作者把這條誤讀寫成開篇第二句**（**⚠️ 不主張**其簡化程度恰當或可用於任何真實定價**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「它不主張什麼」被寫成與主張並列的一段**——**逐字**：**「It intentionally covers several items in the **Marsh Re internship description** that are absent from a typical AI/ML student resume: … **It does not claim experience with proprietary RMS/AIR/RQE models or production insurance data.**」**⭐⭐ **對正在求職的學生，這是罕見地把「我的項目補哪一塊」與「我不聲稱補到了哪一塊」同時寫清的樣本**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它給測試定下四條不變量**——**`RESULTS.md` 逐字**：**「losses cannot be negative; **expected loss is below tail-risk quantiles**; **TVaR is at least as large as the corresponding VaR**; **all intended uncertainty scenarios are present**」**⭐⭐ **前三條是**分布內部一致性**（單調性／支撐集）檢查，第四條是**完整性**檢查**——**一組**不依賴具體數值就能發現結構性錯誤**的斷言**（**⚠️ 未運行其 pytest**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ `RESULTS.md` 把一次具體運行的假設與數值並列**——**年度試驗 **20,000** 次；暴露記錄 **1,500** 條；**Poisson(lambda=2.2)**；Lognormal 嚴重度**；**並聲明「Results are synthetic and for educational use.」**；**風險指標逐字**：**EAL $261.51M｜95% VaR $710.80M｜95% TVaR $855.18M｜99% VaR $975.95M｜99% TVaR $1,087.37M｜P(Loss > $50M) 74.62%｜P(Loss > $100M) 67.91%**。⭐⭐ **這些数値得以被核對的前提是**假設也被寫下來了****（**⚠️ 未運行其流水線，上述為倉庫自述，不主張可複現**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **把「模型不確定性」單列**——**逐字**：**「The sensitivity analysis varies event frequency and severity assumptions. This is important because catastrophe models contain **uncertainty arising from incomplete hazard data, vulnerability assumptions and model structure**.」**，**並輸出 `outputs/uncertainty_scenarios.csv` 與 `uncertainty_sensitivity.png`**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **「Interpretation」把要教的東西拆成四項**——**頻率風險／嚴重度風險／暴露集中度／模型不確定性**，**並逐字稱「That decomposition is the main learning objective.」**。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **10 條「面試談資」直接寫進 README**——**含「為什麼頻率用泊松」「VaR 有什麼是 TVaR 能捕捉而它不能的」「如何把**偶然變異與模型不確定性分開**」「如何把**免賠額、限額與再保分層**納入」等**——⭐⭐ **這十條恰好是**巨災建模面試的實際問題清單****（**⚠️ 不主張**這十條代表任何雇主的實際面試內容**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **「Suggested next upgrade」逐字**：**「Add an actual public hazard dataset (for example, earthquake event records), replace the synthetic hazard intensity function, and compare the simulated portfolio loss distribution under multiple assumptions.」**——**它自己指出了**從合成走向真實**的具體一步**。**⑨ ⭐ 預設使用固定隨機種子以保證可複現**。**⑩ ⭐ 可與 [[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]]、[[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[oasislmf]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[catmodeling]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[extremeloss]]、[[evd]]、[[eva]]、[[ismev]]、[[hazus]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 該倉庫實測**無任何許可文件****——**明確記錄並提示使用、修改或再分發前自行確認授權**；**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、根目錄清單、README 全文與 `RESULTS.md` 全文**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安裝、未運行 `src/` 下任何腳本、未運行 `pytest`、未查看 `outputs/` 與 `data/`、未讀 `sql/analysis.sql`、未讀 `tests/test_simulation.py` 與任何原始碼****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ `RESULTS.md` 中全部數值為**倉庫自述****，**未運行、未獨立復算**，**不主張**其正確或可複現**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**其四條測試不變量確實存在於 `tests/test_simulation.py` 中並通過**——**這是本條目最值得後續核實的一處**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其「模型不確定性」情景設計是否足以支撐關於模型風險的結論**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其災害與脆弱性關係「刻意簡化」到什麼程度**；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其 README 所稱「Marsh Re internship description」的存在與內容**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **本項目為教育性模擬器****，**其自述明確不是商業巨災模型的替代**，**不主張**其可用於任何真實的風險定價、資本計算、再保決策或監管報送**；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、創建與推送同日**，**不主張成熟度／正確性／已被採用**；**⑩ ⭐ README 3,896 位元組且無 topics**；**⑪ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/anuravi1604-cmd/catrisk-sim`、`/readme` 與 `/contents/` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未克隆、未安裝、未運行、未讀原始碼**。
entries.body_en:
**CatRiskSim** is **a portfolio-level catastrophe risk and portfolio loss simulation project** (repository `anuravi1604-cmd/catrisk-sim`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 2,069 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` returned 404 on the main branch)** and **no topics**; **the README measures 3,896 bytes**, **and a `RESULTS.md` of 1,360 bytes is also measurably present**. It is the first of this round’s four takes on **writing assumptions into something a reader can check**: **stating what it does not claim in its opening paragraph**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README and the repository root**): **the repository description reads verbatim**: **"Stochastic catastrophe risk and portfolio loss simulator using Monte Carlo, SQL, and geospatial analysis."**; **the root measurably contains `.gitignore`, `README.md`, `RESULTS.md`, `data/`, `outputs/`, `requirements.txt`, `sql/`, `src/` and `tests/`**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Its opening "Important scope" passage, read verbatim, is the entry’s most valuable part**: **"This is an educational simulator, not a replacement for commercial catastrophe models such as RMS or AIR. The hazard and vulnerability relationships are synthetic and deliberately simplified."** **Its modelling framework reads verbatim (formulas as written)**: **`N ~ Poisson(lambda)`**; **`S ~ Lognormal(mu, sigma)`**; **`Loss = Exposure × Vulnerability × HazardFactor × ProximityFactor` subject to a policy limit**; **`AggregateLoss_t = sum(Loss_i)` for all events in year t**; **the simulated annual-loss distribution then yields EAL, 95%/99% VaR and 95%/99% TVaR**. **Its code structure reads verbatim**: `src/generate_data.py`, `src/simulate_losses.py`, `src/run_sql.py`, `src/visualize.py`, `sql/analysis.sql`, `tests/test_simulation.py` and `outputs/`.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Stating outright that it is not a substitute for RMS or AIR is the entry’s most valuable point, and one of the most forthright opening boundary statements this session has seen** — **commercial catastrophe models are the profession’s working tools**, **and the easiest misreading between them and an educational simulator is to treat a teaching simplification as a usable approximation**; **the author writes that misreading into the second sentence** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim its simplification is appropriate or usable for any real pricing — its model was not run**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ What it does not claim is written as a paragraph standing beside what it does claim** — verbatim: **"It intentionally covers several items in the Marsh Re internship description that are absent from a typical AI/ML student resume: stochastic modelling, risk/loss distributions, model uncertainty, SQL, geospatial analysis, interpretation of modelled loss outputs, quality-control checks, process automation. It does not claim experience with proprietary RMS/AIR/RQE models or production insurance data."** ⭐⭐ **For a student job-hunting, a rare sample that states both which gap the project fills and which gap it does not claim to have filled.** **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It gives its tests four invariants, the entry’s most notable engineering point** — **`RESULTS.md` reads verbatim**: **"losses cannot be negative; expected loss is below tail-risk quantiles; TVaR is at least as large as the corresponding VaR; all intended uncertainty scenarios are present."** ⭐⭐ **The first three are internal-consistency checks on a distribution (monotonicity and support) and the fourth is a completeness check** — **assertions that can expose structural errors without depending on particular values** (**readable with [[verified-reserving]], [[reproducible-actuarial-work]] and [[actuarial-benchmarks]]**; **⚠️ its pytest was not run, so whether these four hold was not verified**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ `RESULTS.md` sets one specific run’s assumptions and values side by side, the entry’s easiest part to check** — verbatim: **annual trials 20,000; exposure records 1,500; core frequency model Poisson(lambda=2.2); severity model Lognormal**; **and it states verbatim "Results are synthetic and for educational use."**; **its risk-metric table reads verbatim**: **EAL $261.51M | 95% VaR $710.80M | 95% TVaR $855.18M | 99% VaR $975.95M | 99% TVaR $1,087.37M | P(Loss > $50M) 74.62% | P(Loss > $100M) 67.91%**. ⭐⭐ **These numbers are checkable only because the assumptions were written down too (lambda = 2.2, 20,000 trials, 1,500 exposures) — the concrete form of this round’s theme** (**⚠️ its pipeline was not run; the figures are the repository’s own account and reproducibility is not claimed**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ Model uncertainty is separated rather than folded into the headline result** — verbatim: **"The sensitivity analysis varies event frequency and severity assumptions. This is important because catastrophe models contain uncertainty arising from incomplete hazard data, vulnerability assumptions and model structure."**, **with `outputs/uncertainty_scenarios.csv` and `uncertainty_sensitivity.png` produced** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim its scenario design is sufficient to characterise real model risk**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ `RESULTS.md`’s "Interpretation" splits what it teaches into four items** — **frequency risk, severity risk, exposure concentration and model uncertainty** — **and states verbatim "That decomposition is the main learning objective."** **⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ Ten "Interview talking points" are written directly into the README**, **including why Poisson for frequency, what VaR fails to capture that TVaR does, how to separate aleatory variability from model uncertainty, and how to incorporate deductibles, limits and reinsurance layers** — ⭐⭐ **precisely the questions catastrophe-modelling interviews actually ask**, **joining what the project did to what will be asked about it** (**readable with the site’s exam and career entries such as [[actuarial-student-competitions]] and [[soa-practice-view-ai]]**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim these ten represent any employer’s actual interview**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ "Suggested next upgrade" reads verbatim**: **"Add an actual public hazard dataset (for example, earthquake event records), replace the synthetic hazard intensity function, and compare the simulated portfolio loss distribution under multiple assumptions."** — **it names the concrete step from synthetic toward real itself**. **⑨ ⭐ The default simulation uses a fixed random seed for reproducibility** (stated verbatim). **⑩ ⭐ Readable with the site’s catastrophe and stochastic modelling entries**: [[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]], [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]] (**this round’s other two catastrophe approaches**), [[openquake-engine]], [[gem-global-exposure-model]], [[oasislmf]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[catmodeling]], [[canada-seismic-risk-model]], [[extremeloss]], [[evd]], [[eva]], [[ismev]] and [[hazus]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` returned 404 on main)** — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before use, modification or redistribution**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, the root listing, the full 3,896-byte README and the full 1,360-byte `RESULTS.md`**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install, run any script under `src/`, run pytest, inspect `outputs/` or `data/`, read `sql/analysis.sql`, or read `tests/test_simulation.py` or any source**, so **its synthetic data generation, hazard intensity function, vulnerability relationships, the concrete form of its proximity factor, its scenario design, its SQL queries and any figure beyond those in `RESULTS.md` cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Every figure in `RESULTS.md` (EAL $261.51M, 95% VaR $710.80M and the rest) is the repository’s own account, and nothing was run or independently recomputed**; **the entry does not claim those figures are correct or reproducible**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether its four test invariants actually exist in `tests/test_simulation.py` and pass was not verified** — **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether its model-uncertainty scenarios are adequate to support conclusions about model risk was not verified**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ How far its hazard and vulnerability relationships are "deliberately simplified" was not verified** — **it says so itself, but which steps are simplified was not read**; **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ The existence and content of the "Marsh Re internship description" it names was not verified**; **the entry does not claim the alignment is valid or that the posting is findable elsewhere**; **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ The project is an educational simulator and states itself that it is not a substitute for commercial catastrophe models**, **so the entry does not claim it is usable for any real risk pricing, capital calculation, reinsurance decision or supervisory filing**; **⑨ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created and pushed the same day**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⑩ ⭐ A 3,896-byte README with no topics**; **⑪ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**both the README and `RESULTS.md` measurably are in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/anuravi1604-cmd/catrisk-sim`, `/readme` and `/contents/` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 3,896-byte README and 1,360-byte `RESULTS.md` read via `raw.githubusercontent.com`, with both disclaimer sentences, the modelling formulas, code structure, risk-metric table and the ten interview questions checked verbatim); **nothing cloned, installed or run, and no source read**.

entries.title_en: A West Bengal flood catastrophe model whose entire repository is one Excel workbook, with an MDR matrix, an excess-of-loss engine and an EP curve
entries.title_hk: 西孟加拉洪水巨災模型：整個倉庫就是一份 Excel 工作簿，含 MDR 矩陣、超額賠款再保引擎與 EP 曲線
entries.summary: 一个用「进阶 Excel」搭起来的端到端财产险巨灾模型：对西孟加拉 1,000 处合成房产模拟地坪以上洪水损失，用二维平均损失率矩阵处理水深与建筑等级的组合，再套上 5% 保额免赔与自留额／条约限额的结构，并用 LARGE 数组排名与经验概率公式画出净自留损失的超额概率曲线
entries.summary_hk: 一個用「進階 Excel」搭起來的端到端財產險巨災模型：對西孟加拉 1,000 處合成房產模擬地坪以上洪水損失，用二維平均損失率矩陣處理水深與建築等級的組合，再套上 5% 保額免賠與自留額／條約限額的結構，並用 LARGE 陣列排名與經驗概率公式畫出淨自留損失的超額概率曲線
entries.summary_en: An end-to-end property catastrophe model built in Advanced Excel: it simulates ground-up flood losses for 1,000 synthetic properties in West Bengal, applies a two-dimensional mean damage ratio matrix to combinations of flood depth and construction class, layers a 5%-of-TIV deductible with retention and treaty limits on top, and draws an exceedance probability curve of net retained loss using LARGE array ranking and the empirical Rank/(N+1) probability formula
entries.body:
**west-bengal-flood-cat-model** 是一个**用进阶 Excel 搭起来的端到端财产险洪水巨灾模型**（仓库 `Kit-ty8/West-Bengal-Flood-Catastrophe-Model`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、语言实测为 `None`（即 GitHub 未识别出主语言）、仓库体量 704 KB、创建于 2026-09-07、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 4,300 字节**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把假设写成可核对的东西」**中的**第二种，也是载体最出人意料的一种：它的模型本体就是一份 Excel 工作簿**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**仓库描述逐字**：**「Stochastic Catastrophe Flood Model for a synthetic West Bengal P&C portfolio」**。⭐⭐⭐ **根目录实测只有两项**：**`README.md`（4,300 字节）与 **`West_Bengal_Flood_Catastrophe_Model.xlsx`（294,582 字节）****——**即**这个仓库里没有代码，模型本体就是那份工作簿****；**GitHub 因此未识别出主语言（实测为 `None`）**。**README 开篇逐字**：**「Architecting an end-to-end Property & Casualty (P&C) catastrophe model in **Advanced Excel**. This project simulates ground-up flood losses for a **synthetic portfolio of 1,000 properties** across highly exposed districts in West Bengal, bridging theoretical actuarial concepts into an automated risk engine.」**。

**其四个阶段逐字实测**：**① 暴露数据工程（Phase 1）**——用 Excel 动态数组（`SEQUENCE`、`NORM.INV`、`RANDBETWEEN`）生成暴露数据；**用嵌套 `IFS` 施加「逻辑受限的风险组合」**（**逐字举例：强制工业用途只能登记为 `Pucca` 结构类型并对应高端重置价值**）；**纳入地坪高度（英尺）与楼层数以刻画地面淹没**；**总保额（TIV）按建筑等级以正态分布围绕现实重置成本建模**。**② 灾害目录与脆弱性矩阵（Phase 2）**——**硬编码具有代表性的随机洪水事件，含重现期、年概率与最大水深**；**建一个二维平均损失率（MDR）查找网格**，在**水深与建筑等级（`Kutcha`、`Semi-Pucca`、`Pucca`）的交叉点上给出物理损毁百分比**。**③ 计算引擎（Phase 3）**——**「有效水深」逻辑**：**从来水中减去每处房产的地坪高度**；**用嵌套 `INDEX`／`MATCH` 配合内联数组常量 `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10}` 做二维数组查找**，**以绕开 Excel 表格对象对文本型数组的限制**。**④ 财务结构与仪表板（Phase 4）**——**超额赔款（XoL）再保引擎**：**对全部房产施加 5% 保额的免赔，用 `MAX(0, Ground_Up - Deductible)` 保证赔付有零下限**；**组合级再保摊回模块**，**自留额（Primary Retention）₹5,00,00,000、条约限额（Treaty Limit）₹20,00,00,000**；**用 Excel 数据表做多事件矩阵，让全部 8 个洪水情景（`FL_001` 至 `FL_008`）在 6 个区同时跑完**；**质量控制：对 `NORM.INV` 施加严格的下限约束（`MAX`），防止左尾极端值生成负的 TIV 并破坏下游财务计算**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「整个仓库就是一份 Excel 工作簿」是本条目最有价值也最罕见的一点**——**本站收录的巨灾与准备金工具几乎全是 Python／R／Julia 库**，**而**现实中大量精算工作确实在 Excel 里完成****；**这个仓库把这一点做到了极端：**没有代码，模型即工作簿****（**可与本站 [[actuarial-add-in-excel]]、[[eaa-excel-to-python-webinar]]、[[bread-excel-agent]]、[[excel-dna]] 所代表的 Excel 形态并读**）。⭐⭐ **对做建模的学生，它提供了一个**低成本可检视的完整巨灾链条样本**：**暴露 → 灾害 → 脆弱性 → 财务结构 → 风险指标**，**每一步都能在单元格层面看到**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张** Excel 适合承载生产级巨灾模型**——**规模、版本控制、审计与可复现性都有其局限**；**本次亦未打开该工作簿**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「用嵌套 `IFS` 强制逻辑成立的风险组合」是本条目最值得记的一处数据工程做法**——**逐字举例为**强制工业用途只能登记为 `Pucca` 结构并对应高端重置价值****；**即它把**现实中不可能的组合**（如工业厂房却是最脆弱结构）在数据生成阶段就排除掉**；**对做合成数据的同学，这比事后清洗更早一步**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其组合规则完整或符合任何真实建筑规范**——**本次未读其公式**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「二维 MDR 矩阵 + Kutcha／Semi-Pucca／Pucca 三级」是本条目在脆弱性建模上最具体的部分**——**水深 × 建筑等级的交叉点给出损毁百分比**，**这正是洪水脆弱性曲线的标准做法**；**而 `Kutcha`（非永久材料）、`Semi-Pucca`（半永久）、`Pucca`（永久／砖混）是**印度住房分类的实际术语****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其 MDR 取值来自任何权威来源**——**README 称其为「有代表性的」并「硬编码」，**本次未核实其出处**；**可与 [[hazus]]、[[gem-vmtk]] 等公开脆弱性方法并读**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「有效水深 ＝ 来水 − 地坪高度」是一条把**减灾措施**写进模型的朴素而正确的处理**——**地坪抬高在现实中就是防洪手段**，**而多数简化模型只用「水深」直接查表**；**把它显式写成一个减法步骤，说明作者理解物理量纲**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该处理足以刻画真实淹没过程**——**真实洪水还涉及流速、历时、泥沙与排水**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ 「内联数组常量 `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10}` ＋ 嵌套 `INDEX`／`MATCH`」是一处**具体的 Excel 工程限制与绕法****——**逐字说明其目的是「绕开 Excel 表格对象对文本型数组的限制」**；**对必须用 Excel 做交付的精算同事，这类限制与绕法是**真实的日常约束****（**⚠️ 本次未打开工作簿验证该做法**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ 「自留额 ₹5,00,00,000 与条约限额 ₹20,00,00,000」被明确写下来，是本轮主题的典型形态**——**有了这两个数，读者才能核对**再保摊回与净自留损失**是怎么算出来的**；**而 `MAX(0, Ground_Up - Deductible)` 把**零下限**也写成了公式**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该分层结构对应任何真实条约**——**README 未说明其来源**；**可与 [[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]]、[[layerloss-locktonre]]、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]] 并读**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 「用 `LARGE` 数组排名与经验概率公式 Rank/(N+1) 画净自留损失 EP 曲线」是本条目在风险指标上的做法**——**逐字称该图「完美展示了 ₹5 Crore 自留额上限在**高频小额事件**期间的**财务平坦化效应**」**；**`Rank/(N+1)` 是**经验超额概率**的标准估计式**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其曲线可用于任何真实的资本或再保决策**——**8 个情景 × 6 个区的样本规模极小**，**EP 曲线尾部的可靠性有限**；**此点为本词条的判断，非作者自述**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ 「对 `NORM.INV` 施加下限约束以防负 TIV」是一处**质量控制**步骤**——**用正态分布生成总保额时，左尾会产生负值**；**作者在**生成阶段**就把它截住，**理由是负 TIV 会破坏下游财务计算**（**可与第 330 轮同批 [[catrisk-sim]] 的四条测试不变量（其中一条即「损失不能为负」）并读——**两者都在用**取值范围**这条最基本的性质做防错**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站巨灾与 Excel 条目并读**：[[catrisk-sim]]、[[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]（**本轮同批的另两种做法**）、[[hazus]]、[[gem-vmtk]]、[[oasislmf]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[individualclaims-simulator]]、[[simulationmachine]]、[[excel-dna]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）****——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用、修改或再分发该工作簿前必须自行确认授权状况**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库根目录清单（仅两项）与 README（4,300 字节）全文的四个阶段描述**，⭐⭐⭐ **但**未打开、未下载、未运行那份 `.xlsx` 工作簿（**本次亦未打开其中任何公式、单元格、图表或数据表**）、未核对其公式是否如 README 所述、未运行其任何情景****，因此**不能转述其暴露数据的实际取值、灾害目录的具体事件参数、MDR 矩阵的实际数值、动态数组公式的写法、再保摊回公式的实现或任何计算数值**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ README 中「1,000 处房产」「8 个情景（FL_001–FL_008）」「6 个区」「自留额 ₹5,00,00,000」「条约限额 ₹20,00,00,000」「5% 免赔」**等均为**作者自述**，**本次未在工作簿内核实**；**本词条**不主张**这些数值确实存在于工作簿中**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其 MDR 矩阵的取值来源**——**README 称其为「有代表性的」并「硬编码」**；**本词条**不主张**其与任何官方脆弱性曲线一致**（**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其灾害目录（重现期、年概率、最大水深）的来源与合理性**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「1,000 处房产」的暴露数据是否为**手工生成且仅为合成**（**README 明写 synthetic portfolio**）；**不主张**其可代表西孟加拉真实的财产暴露**；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **该仓库无任何代码、无测试、无版本化的计算逻辑****——**其全部计算逻辑都在一份二进制 `.xlsx` 内**，**这使**逐行审阅、版本对比与自动化测试**都变得困难**；**本词条据此**不主张**其过程可复现或可审计**（**此点为本词条的判断**）；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **GitHub 实测未识别出主语言（`None`）****，**与「模型即工作簿」的结构一致**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ 本模型为**教育／作品集性质****（**README 未声明其用途与限制**——**⚠️ 与其他候选不同，它**没有**写出范围免责声明**）；**本词条**不主张**其可用于任何真实的定价、核保、资本或再保决策**；**⑩ ⭐ ★0、fork 0**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑪ ⭐ README 4,300 字节、无 topics、无许可、无描述之外的元数据**；**⑫ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Kit-ty8/West-Bengal-Flood-Catastrophe-Model`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 4,300 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测核对，含四个阶段的逐字描述、`SEQUENCE`／`NORM.INV`／`RANDBETWEEN`／`IFS`／`INDEX`／`MATCH`／`LARGE`／`MAX` 等函数名、内联数组常量、两级再保金额与 EP 曲线做法）；**未打开、未下载、未运行该 `.xlsx` 工作簿**。
entries.body_hk:
**west-bengal-flood-cat-model** 是一個**用進階 Excel 搭起來的端到端財產險洪水巨災模型**（倉庫 `Kit-ty8/West-Bengal-Flood-Catastrophe-Model`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、語言實測為 `None`（GitHub 未識別主語言）、體量 704 KB、創建於 2026-09-07、最後推送 2026-09-09**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**⚠️ 該倉庫實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 於 main 分支實測 404）**、**無 topics**；**README 實測 4,300 位元組**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把假設寫成可核對的東西」**中的**第二種，也是載體最出人意料的一種：它的模型本體就是一份 Excel 工作簿**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫根目錄實測**）：**倉庫描述逐字**：**「Stochastic Catastrophe Flood Model for a synthetic West Bengal P&C portfolio」**。⭐⭐⭐ **根目錄實測只有兩項**：**`README.md`（4,300 位元組）與 **`West_Bengal_Flood_Catastrophe_Model.xlsx`（294,582 位元組）****——**即**這個倉庫裡沒有代碼，模型本體就是那份工作簿****。**README 開篇逐字**：**「Architecting an end-to-end Property & Casualty (P&C) catastrophe model in **Advanced Excel**. This project simulates ground-up flood losses for a **synthetic portfolio of 1,000 properties** across highly exposed districts in West Bengal, bridging theoretical actuarial concepts into an automated risk engine.」**。

**四個階段逐字實測**：**① 暴露資料工程**——Excel 動態陣列（`SEQUENCE`、`NORM.INV`、`RANDBETWEEN`）；**用嵌套 `IFS` 施加「邏輯受限的風險組合」**（**逐字舉例：強制工業用途只能登記為 `Pucca` 結構並對應高端重置價值**）；**納入地坪高度（英尺）與樓層數**；**TIV 按建築等級以正態分布圍繞現實重置成本建模**。**② 災害目錄與脆弱性矩陣**——**硬編碼代表性隨機洪水事件，含重現期、年概率與最大水深**；**二維平均損失率（MDR）查找網格**，在**水深與建築等級（`Kutcha`、`Semi-Pucca`、`Pucca`）的交叉點**給出物理損毀百分比。**③ 計算引擎**——**「有效水深」邏輯：從來水中減去每處房產的地坪高度**；**嵌套 `INDEX`／`MATCH` 配合內聯陣列常量 `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10}` 做二維查找**，**以繞開 Excel 表格對象對文本型陣列的限制**。**④ 財務結構與儀表板**——**超額賠款（XoL）再保引擎**：**全部房產 5% 保額免賠，用 `MAX(0, Ground_Up - Deductible)` 保證零下限**；**組合級再保攤回模組，自留額 ₹5,00,00,000、條約限額 ₹20,00,00,000**；**用 Excel 資料表做多事件矩陣，讓全部 8 個洪水情景（`FL_001`–`FL_008`）在 6 個區同時跑完**；**質量控制：對 `NORM.INV` 施加下限（`MAX`）以防左尾生成負 TIV 並破壞下游財務計算**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「整個倉庫就是一份 Excel 工作簿」是最有價值也最罕見的一點**——**本站收錄的巨災與準備金工具幾乎全是 Python／R／Julia 庫**，**而**現實中大量精算工作確實在 Excel 裡完成****（可與 [[actuarial-add-in-excel]]、[[eaa-excel-to-python-webinar]]、[[bread-excel-agent]]、[[excel-dna]] 並讀；**⚠️ 不主張** Excel 適合承載生產級巨災模型**；**未打開該工作簿**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「用嵌套 `IFS` 強制邏輯成立」是資料工程上最值得記的一處**——**把**現實中不可能的组合**在**資料生成階段**就排除掉**，**比事後清洗更早一步**（**⚠️ 不主張**其組合規則完整或符合任何真實建築規範**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「二維 MDR 矩陣 + Kutcha／Semi-Pucca／Pucca 三級」是脆弱性建模上最具體的部分**——**水深 × 建築等級交叉點給出損毀百分比**，**正是洪水脆弱性曲線的標準做法**；**而三個等級是**印度住房分類的實際術語****（**⚠️ 不主張**其 MDR 取值來自任何權威來源**——**README 稱「有代表性」且「硬編碼」**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「有效水深 ＝ 來水 − 地坪高度」是一條把**減災措施**寫進模型的樸素而正確的處理**——**多數簡化模型只用「水深」直接查表**（**⚠️ 不主張**該處理足以刻畫真實淹沒過程**——**真實洪水還涉流速、歷時、泥沙與排水**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **「內聯陣列常量 `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10}` ＋ 嵌套 `INDEX`／`MATCH`」是一處**具體的 Excel 工程限制與繞法****（**⚠️ 未打開工作簿驗證**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ 「自留額 ₹5,00,00,000 與條約限額 ₹20,00,00,000」被明確寫下，是本輪主題的典型形態**——**有了這兩個數，讀者才能核對再保攤回與淨自留損失是怎麼算出來的**（**⚠️ 不主張**該分層結構對應任何真實條約**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **「用 `LARGE` 陣列排名與經驗概率 Rank/(N+1) 畫淨自留損失 EP 曲線」**——**逐字稱該圖展示 ₹5 Crore 自留額上限在**高頻小額事件**期間的**財務平坦化效應****；**`Rank/(N+1)` 是**經驗超額概率**的標準估計式**（**⚠️ 本詞條判斷：8 個情景 × 6 個區樣本規模極小，EP 曲線尾部可靠性有限**——**此為本詞條判斷，非作者自述**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ 「對 `NORM.INV` 施加上限約束以防負 TIV」是一處質量控制步驟**（可與同批 [[catrisk-sim]] 的四條測試不變量中「損失不能為負」並讀）。**⑨ ⭐ 可與 [[catrisk-sim]]、[[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、[[hazus]]、[[gem-vmtk]]、[[oasislmf]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[individualclaims-simulator]]、[[simulationmachine]]、[[excel-dna]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 該倉庫實測**無任何許可文件****——**明確記錄並提示使用、修改或再分發該工作簿前自行確認授權**；**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、根目錄清單（僅兩項）與 README 全文的四個階段描述**，⭐⭐⭐ **但**未打開、未下載、未運行那份 `.xlsx`（**未打開其中任何公式、儲存格、圖表或資料表**）、未核對其公式是否如 README 所述、未運行其任何情景****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ README 中「1,000 處房產」「8 個情景」「6 個區」「自留額 ₹5,00,00,000」「條約限額 ₹20,00,00,000」「5% 免賠」等均為**作者自述****，**未在工作簿內核實**，**不主張**這些數值確實存在於工作簿中**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**其 MDR 矩陣取值來源**，**不主張**其與任何官方脆弱性曲線一致**（**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其災害目錄（重現期、年概率、最大水深）的來源與合理性**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其暴露資料是否為手工生成且僅為合成**，**不主張**其可代表西孟加拉真實的財產暴露**；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ 該倉庫**無任何代碼、無測試、無版本化的計算邏輯****——**全部計算邏輯都在一份二進位 `.xlsx` 內**，**使逐行審閱、版本對比與自動化測試都變得困難**；**不主張**其過程可複現或可審計**（**此點為本詞條的判斷**）；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ GitHub 實測未識別主語言（`None`）**，**與「模型即工作簿」的結構一致**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ 本模型為**教育／作品集性質****（**⚠️ 與同批其他候選不同，它**沒有**寫出範圍免責聲明**）；**不主張**其可用於任何真實的定價、核保、資本或再保決策**；**⑩ ⭐ ★0、fork 0**，**不主張成熟度／正確性／已被採用**；**⑪ ⭐ README 4,300 位元組、無 topics、無許可**；**⑫ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Kit-ty8/West-Bengal-Flood-Catastrophe-Model`、`/readme` 與 `/contents/` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未打開、未下載、未運行該 `.xlsx` 工作簿**。
entries.body_en:
**west-bengal-flood-cat-model** is **an end-to-end property flood catastrophe model built in Advanced Excel** (repository `Kit-ty8/West-Bengal-Flood-Catastrophe-Model`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, a language measurably reported as `None` (GitHub detected no primary language), a 704 KB repository, created 2026-09-07 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` returned 404 on main)** and **no topics**; **the README measures 4,300 bytes**. It is the second of this round’s four takes on **writing assumptions into something a reader can check**, **and its carrier is the most unexpected: the model itself is an Excel workbook**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README and the repository root**): **the repository description reads verbatim**: **"Stochastic Catastrophe Flood Model for a synthetic West Bengal P&C portfolio"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **The root measurably contains exactly two items**: **`README.md` (4,300 bytes) and `West_Bengal_Flood_Catastrophe_Model.xlsx` (294,582 bytes)** — **there is no code in the repository; the model itself is that workbook**, **which is why GitHub detects no primary language**. **The README opens verbatim**: **"Architecting an end-to-end Property & Casualty (P&C) catastrophe model in Advanced Excel. This project simulates ground-up flood losses for a synthetic portfolio of 1,000 properties across highly exposed districts in West Bengal, bridging theoretical actuarial concepts into an automated risk engine."**

**Its four phases read verbatim**: **① Exposure data engineering** — Excel dynamic arrays (`SEQUENCE`, `NORM.INV`, `RANDBETWEEN`); **nested `IFS` imposing logic-bound risk combinations** (**the README’s own example: forcing industrial occupancies to register only as `Pucca` construction with correlating high-end replacement values**); plinth height in feet and number of stories modelling ground-level inundation; TIV modelled with normal distributions around realistic replacement costs by construction class. **② Hazard catalog and vulnerability matrix** — hardcoded representative stochastic flood events with return periods, annual probabilities and maximum water depths; **a two-dimensional mean damage ratio (MDR) lookup grid** giving physical damage percentages at the intersections of **water depth and construction class (`Kutcha`, `Semi-Pucca`, `Pucca`)**. **③ The calculation engine** — an "effective depth" logic that **subtracts each property’s plinth height from the incoming water**; **nested `INDEX`/`MATCH` with the inline array constant `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10}`** to **bypass the text-string limitations of native Excel tables**. **④ Financial structuring and dashboard** — an **excess-of-loss reinsurance engine**: **a 5%-of-TIV deductible on every property with `MAX(0, Ground_Up - Deductible)` enforcing a zero floor**; a portfolio-level recovery module with **Primary Retention of ₹5,00,00,000 and a Treaty Limit of ₹20,00,00,000**; **an Excel Data Table multi-event matrix running all 8 flood scenarios (`FL_001` to `FL_008`) across 6 districts at once**; and **quality control applying a floor (`MAX`) to `NORM.INV` so extreme left-tail draws cannot create negative TIV and break the downstream financial calculations**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ That the entire repository is one Excel workbook is the entry’s most valuable and rarest point** — **the catastrophe and reserving tools collected here are almost all Python, R or Julia libraries**, **whereas a great deal of real actuarial work is in fact done in Excel**; **this repository takes that to its limit: no code, the model is the workbook** (**readable with the Excel-form entries [[actuarial-add-in-excel]], [[eaa-excel-to-python-webinar]], [[bread-excel-agent]] and [[excel-dna]]**). ⭐⭐ **For a modelling student it offers a low-cost, inspectable sample of a complete catastrophe chain — exposure, hazard, vulnerability, financial structure, risk metrics — with every step visible at cell level** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim Excel is suitable for a production catastrophe model — scale, version control, audit and reproducibility all have limits; and this workbook was not opened**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Enforcing logic-bound risk combinations with nested `IFS` is the entry’s most notable data-engineering practice** — **the README’s own example forces industrial occupancies to register as `Pucca` with correlating high-end replacement values**, **excluding combinations that cannot exist in reality at the data-generation stage rather than after the fact** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim its combination rules are complete or match any real building code — its formulas were not read**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The two-dimensional MDR matrix with three construction classes is the entry’s most concrete vulnerability modelling** — **damage percentages at the intersection of depth and construction class is exactly the standard form of a flood vulnerability curve**, **and `Kutcha`, `Semi-Pucca` and `Pucca` (non-permanent, semi-permanent, permanent) are the actual Indian housing classification terms** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim its MDR values come from any authority — the README calls them representative and hardcoded, and their provenance was not verified; readable with public vulnerability methodologies such as [[hazus]] and [[gem-vmtk]]**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ "Effective depth = incoming water − plinth height" is a plain and correct way of modelling a mitigation measure** — **raised plinths are a real flood defence**, **whereas most simplified models look up damage from water depth alone**; **writing it as an explicit subtraction shows the author understands the physical quantities** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim this captures real inundation, which also involves velocity, duration, sediment and drainage**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ The inline array constant `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10}` with nested `INDEX`/`MATCH` is a concrete Excel engineering limit and workaround** — **stated verbatim as bypassing the text-string limitations of native Excel tables** (**⚠️ the workbook was not opened to verify it**). **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ Retention of ₹5,00,00,000 and a treaty limit of ₹20,00,00,000 are written down explicitly, the typical form of this round’s theme** — **with those two figures a reader can check how recovery and net retained loss were derived** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the structure matches any real treaty — the README does not state its source; readable with [[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]], [[layerloss-locktonre]] and [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Drawing the net retained loss EP curve with `LARGE` array ranking and the empirical `Rank/(N+1)` formula** — **described verbatim as showing the financial flattening effect of the ₹5 Crore retention cap in high-frequency attritional events**; **`Rank/(N+1)` is the standard empirical exceedance-probability estimator** (**⚠️ this entry’s own judgement, not the author’s: with 8 scenarios across 6 districts the sample is very small and the reliability of the curve’s tail is limited**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Applying a floor to `NORM.INV` to prevent negative TIV is a quality-control step** (**readable with the four test invariants in this round’s [[catrisk-sim]], one of which is that losses cannot be negative — both use the simplest property of a range as an error trap**). **⑨ ⭐ Readable with [[catrisk-sim]], [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]] (this round’s other two approaches), [[hazus]], [[gem-vmtk]], [[oasislmf]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[individualclaims-simulator]], [[simulationmachine]] and [[excel-dna]]**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` returned 404 on main)** — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before using, modifying or redistributing the workbook**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, the two-item root listing, and the README’s full 4,300 bytes describing the four phases**, ⭐⭐⭐ **but did not open, download or run that `.xlsx` workbook (no formula, cell, chart or data table in it was opened), did not check whether its formulas match the README, and did not run any scenario**, so **its actual exposure values, the concrete event parameters of its hazard catalog, the actual MDR figures, the dynamic-array formulas, the recovery implementation and any computed value cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The README’s "1,000 properties", "8 scenarios (FL_001–FL_008)", "6 districts", "₹5,00,00,000 retention", "₹20,00,00,000 treaty limit" and "5% deductible" are all the author’s own account and were not verified inside the workbook**; **the entry does not claim those figures are actually present in it**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Where its MDR matrix values come from was not verified** — **the README calls them representative and hardcoded**; **the entry does not claim they match any official vulnerability curve** (**the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**); **⑤ ⭐⭐ The provenance and plausibility of its hazard catalog (return periods, annual probabilities, maximum depths) were not verified**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ Whether its exposure data is hand-generated and synthetic was not verified beyond the README saying the portfolio is synthetic**; **it is not claimed to represent real West Bengal property exposure**; **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ The repository has no code, no tests and no version-controlled calculation logic** — **all of it lives inside a binary `.xlsx`**, **which makes line-by-line review, version comparison and automated testing difficult**; **the entry therefore does not claim the process is reproducible or auditable** (**this is the entry’s own judgement**); **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ GitHub detects no primary language (`None`), consistent with a model that is a workbook**; **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ The model is educational and portfolio work** (**⚠️ unlike the other entries this round, it writes no scope disclaimer at all**); **the entry does not claim it is usable for any real pricing, underwriting, capital or reinsurance decision**; **⑩ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⑪ ⭐ A 4,300-byte README, no topics and no licence**; **⑫ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Kit-ty8/West-Bengal-Flood-Catastrophe-Model`, `/readme` and `/contents/` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 4,300-byte README read via `raw.githubusercontent.com`, with the four phases, the function names `SEQUENCE`/`NORM.INV`/`RANDBETWEEN`/`IFS`/`INDEX`/`MATCH`/`LARGE`/`MAX`, the inline array constant, the two reinsurance amounts and the EP-curve method checked verbatim); **that `.xlsx` workbook was neither opened, downloaded nor run**.

entries.title: 坐标级洪水定价微服务：用与水体距离的指数衰减加费替代邮政编码分区，但 README 的公式与示例算的不是同一个函数
entries.title_en: A coordinate-level flood pricing microservice that replaces postal-code territory rating with exponential decay on distance to water — though its README formula and its own worked example are not the same function
entries.title_hk: 坐標級洪水定價微服務：用與水體距離的指數衰減加費替代郵政編碼分區，但 README 的公式與示例算的不是同一個函數
entries.summary: 一个把洪水加费从「邮政编码分区」改到「坐标到最近水体距离」的定价微服务：用 Nominatim 地理编码、OSMnx 取水文几何、投影到 UTM 后用 Shapely 算米级最短欧氏距离，再以指数衰减乘数产生空间加费；README 给出完整公式与分级表，但其头号公式含一个减 10 的偏移，而示例回显的 formula_applied 与算出的 2.72 都不含该偏移
entries.summary_hk: 一個把洪水加費從「郵政編碼分區」改到「坐標到最近水體距離」的定價微服務：用 Nominatim 地理編碼、OSMnx 取水文幾何、投影到 UTM 後用 Shapely 算米級最短歐氏距離，再以指數衰減乘數產生空間加費；README 給出完整公式與分級表，但其頭號公式含一個減 10 的偏移，而示例回顯的 formula_applied 與算出的 2.72 都不含該偏移
entries.summary_en: A pricing microservice that moves flood surcharging from postal-code territories to the distance between a coordinate and the nearest water body: Nominatim geocoding, OSMnx hydrological geometry, reprojection to UTM and a Shapely shortest Euclidean distance in metres, feeding an exponential-decay multiplier that produces the spatial surcharge; the README gives a complete formula and tier table, but its headline formula carries a minus-ten offset that neither the echoed formula_applied string nor the worked example (which yields 2.72) includes
entries.body:
**geo-catastrophe-pricing** 是一个**把洪水加费从邮政编码分区改到坐标到水体距离的定价微服务**（仓库 `Devananditha/geo-catastrophe-pricing`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 18 KB、创建于 2026-09-08、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件**——`LICENSE`、`LICENSE.md`、`LICENSE.txt`、`license`、`COPYING` 于 main 分支**逐一实测均为 404**，**GitHub API 亦报 `NONE`**——**但其 README 却带有指向 `LICENSE` 的「License: MIT」徽章，且正文「License」一节逐字声称本项目以 MIT 许可发布**（**详见下方标注 ①**）；**无 topics**；**README 实测 7,907 字节**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把假设写成可核对的东西」**中的**第三种：它把评级公式连同参数一起写下来，而写下来的公式与它自己的示例并不一致**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **根目录实测只有五项**：**`.gitignore`（291 字节）、`README.md`（7,907 字节）、`main.py`（18,846 字节）、`requirements.txt`（59 字节）、`spatial_risk_engine.py`（5,475 字节）**——**即整个实现是**两个 Python 文件****。**README 标题逐字为「Geospatial Catastrophe Pricing Model | Dynamic Flood Risk Engine」**。⭐⭐⭐ **其问题陈述逐字，是本条目最有价值的一段**：**「Traditional Property & Casualty (P&C) underwriting models rely heavily on aggregated territorial rating factors and static postal code boundaries. These coarse macro-level segmentations introduce significant underwriting error: **adjacent structures separated by mere tens of meters can exhibit radically divergent hydrological profiles**, leading to **widespread risk mispricing, adverse selection, and unpriced aggregate exposure**.」**——**即「传统财产险核保模型高度依赖聚合的**地区评级因子**与**静态邮政编码边界**；这种粗粒度的宏观切分带来显著的核保误差：**仅相距数十米的相邻建筑可能拥有截然不同的水文特征**，从而导致**普遍的错误定价、逆选择与未定价的累积暴露**」**。**其四阶段流水线逐字实测**：**物理地址 →（地理编码：Nominatim／GeoPy）WGS84 坐标点（纬经度）→（空间图查询：OSMnx）半径 ≤ 2,000 米内的水文几何 →（度量投影与邻近计算：GeoPandas ＋ Shapely）最短欧氏距离（米）→（乘数评级引擎：指数衰减曲线）动态保费报价**；**其中水文标签逐字为 `{"water": True, "waterway": True}`**，**且「若缓冲半径内不存在任何水体要素，距离按无穷大（∞）处理」**；**投影步骤逐字说明用 `GeoDataFrame.estimate_utm_crs()` 自动确定 UTM 带，以消除按角度坐标直接算欧氏距离带来的纬度相关畸变**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「相邻数十米的两栋建筑水文特征可能截然不同」这一句问题陈述是本条目写得最好的一处**——**它把「为什么需要坐标级定价」讲成了一个**可检验的核保误差来源****：**静态分区必然产生**区内方差被忽略**与**区界两侧被强行区分**两类错误**；**而洪水恰恰是**空间梯度极陡**的险种**（**可与 [[hazus]]、[[gem-vmtk]]、[[floodmodeller-api]]、[[lisflood]]、[[thinkhazard]]、[[pyincore]] 等洪水与暴露模型并读**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**坐标级加费在任何监管框架下都可直接使用**——**分区评级在多数辖区有其监管与统计理由（可信度、可解释性、避免歧视性定价）**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **README 里的公式与它自己的示例算的不是同一个函数——这是本条目最需要如实指出的一处****。**README 头号公式逐字为 `Multiplier(d) = 1.0 + 2.0 × exp(−λ(d − 10))`，其中 λ = 1/300**；**而 README 给出的示例响应的 `formula_applied` 字段逐字为 `1.0 + 2.0 * exp(-d / 300.0)`**——**两式的差别正是那个 `−10` 偏移**。⭐⭐ **本词条以两个公式分别复算该示例（距离 45.2 米）**：**含偏移的 `exp(−(d−10)/300)` 得 **2.7786**；不含偏移的 `exp(−d/300)` 得 **2.7203****；**而示例所报 `spatial_multiplier` 为 **2.72**、`final_premium` 为 **3264.0**（**且 1200 × 2.72 = 3264，自洽**）**——**即示例实际走的是**不含偏移**的版本，而正文头号公式写的是含偏移的版本**。⭐⭐ **分级表也印证了这一点**：**表中「≤10 米 → 3.00×」这个最大值只有**含偏移**版本在 d = 10 时才能取到（`exp(0)` → 1 + 2 = 3.00）**；**而表中 11–250 米区间的 1.87×–2.93× 与 251–500 米的 1.38×–1.86×，与**不含偏移**版本的取值吻合**（**本词条实算：d = 11 → 2.9280 ≈ 2.93；d = 250 → 1.8692 ≈ 1.87；d = 500 → 1.3778 ≈ 1.38；d = 999 → 1.0716 ≈ 1.07；d = 1000 → 1.0713**）。⭐⭐⭐ **即：文档里同时存在两个函数，而「最大加费封顶 3.00×」这一说法属于**写了但没被应用**的那一个**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**代码里究竟是哪一个**——**本次未读 `spatial_risk_engine.py`**；**上述算术为本词条自行计算，非作者自述**）。**③ ⭐⭐ **「基线收敛到 1.0×」「最大 3.0×」「λ = 1/300 按危险邻近度校准」三个参数被明确写出**——**其中把衰减率 λ 说成「按危险邻近度校准（calibrated to hazard proximity）」**值得注意：**λ 是一个**可校准的参数**，**而其取值理应有标定依据**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张** 1/300 有标定依据**——**README 未给出标定数据、拟合样本或来源**；**这是本条目第二处需后续核实的地方**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **技术栈逐字实测且都属地理空间处理的常用组合**：**FastAPI ＋ Pydantic v2**（异步请求处理、请求／响应校验、自动 OpenAPI 文档）；**GeoPy ＋ OpenStreetMap Nominatim**（**并逐字注明使用「compliant User-Agent headers」以符合使用条款**）；**OSMnx** 查询与过滤水文拓扑；**GeoPandas ＋ Shapely** 做投影与几何距离**。⭐ **其中「合规的 User-Agent 头」这一句值得单独记**——**Nominatim 的使用政策要求可识别的 User-Agent**，**把它写进 README 说明作者读过该政策**（**可与本站对**数据来源与使用条款**的一贯关注并读**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **示例的请求体与响应体给出了可核对的完整链路**：**请求为 `{"address": "100 Thames Path, London, UK", "base_premium": 1200.00}`**，**响应含 `latitude`／`longitude`／`distance_to_water_meters`（45.2）／`spatial_multiplier`（2.72）／`risk_level`（"High Risk"）／`final_premium`（3264.0）／`formula_applied`**——**即一条**从地址到保费**的完整可追溯记录**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该地址与实际坐标、实际水体距离相符**——**本次未调用其服务**；**⚠️ 另注：示例用的是**看起来像真实地址**的字符串，**而非明显的占位符**）。**⑥ ⭐ **其分级表逐字实测**：**≤10 米 → 3.00×，Catastrophic Exposure（最大洪水加费封顶）**；**11–250 米 → 1.87×–2.93×，High Risk**；**251–500 米 → 1.38×–1.86×，Moderate Risk**；**501–999 米 → 1.07×–1.37×，Elevated Risk**；**≥1,000 米或无水体 → 1.00×，Standard / Baseline Risk（不加巨灾调整）****。⭐⭐ **把连续乘数切成五档并给每档命名，是**把模型输出翻译成核保语言**的一步**；**但对做定价的同学需注意：**分档会重新引入「阈值附近不连续」的问题**——**这正是它开篇批评静态分区的同一种毛病，只是尺度从邮政编码缩到了米**（**此为本词条的判断，非作者自述**）。**⑦ ⭐ **提供一个在线部署（Render）**（**ⓘ 本次未访问**）。**⑧ ⭐ 可与本站洪水与地理风险条目并读**：[[catrisk-sim]]、[[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]]（**本轮同批的另两种巨灾做法**）、[[floodmodeller-api]]、[[lisflood]]、[[thinkhazard]]、[[pyincore]]、[[rfema]]、[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]、[[physrisk]]、[[hazus]]、[[gem-vmtk]]。
