**geo-catastrophe-pricing** is **a pricing microservice that moves flood surcharging from postal-code territories to the distance between a coordinate and the nearest water body** (repository `Devananditha/geo-catastrophe-pricing`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, an 18 KB repository, created 2026-09-08 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file at all — `LICENSE`, `LICENSE.md`, `LICENSE.txt`, `license` and `COPYING` each returned 404 on main, and the GitHub API reports `NONE` — yet its README carries a "License: MIT" badge linking to `LICENSE` and states verbatim in a closing section that the project is licensed under the MIT License** (**see note ① below**); it has **no topics**; **the README measures 7,907 bytes**. It is the third of this round’s four takes on **writing assumptions into something a reader can check**: **it writes its rating formula down together with its parameters, and the formula it writes down is not the one its own example applies**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README and the repository root**): ⭐⭐⭐ **the root measurably contains exactly five items**: **`.gitignore` (291 bytes), `README.md` (7,907 bytes), `main.py` (18,846 bytes), `requirements.txt` (59 bytes) and `spatial_risk_engine.py` (5,475 bytes)** — **the whole implementation is two Python files**. **The title reads verbatim "Geospatial Catastrophe Pricing Model | Dynamic Flood Risk Engine"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Its problem statement, read verbatim, is the entry’s most valuable passage**: **"Traditional Property & Casualty (P&C) underwriting models rely heavily on aggregated territorial rating factors and static postal code boundaries. These coarse macro-level segmentations introduce significant underwriting error: adjacent structures separated by mere tens of meters can exhibit radically divergent hydrological profiles, leading to widespread risk mispricing, adverse selection, and unpriced aggregate exposure."** **Its four-stage pipeline reads verbatim**: **physical address → (geocoding, Nominatim/GeoPy) WGS84 point → (spatial graph query, OSMnx) hydrological geometries within a 2,000 m radius → (metric projection and proximity maths, GeoPandas + Shapely) shortest Euclidean distance in metres → (multiplicative rating engine) dynamic premium**; **the hydrological tags read verbatim as `{"water": True, "waterway": True}`**; **"if zero water features exist within the buffer radius, distance is evaluated to infinity"**; **and the projection step uses `GeoDataFrame.estimate_utm_crs()` to pick a UTM zone automatically, so that computing Euclidean distance directly in angular coordinates does not introduce latitude-dependent distortion**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ The sentence that adjacent structures tens of metres apart can have radically divergent hydrological profiles is the entry’s best-written point** — **it turns "why coordinate-level pricing is needed" into a checkable source of underwriting error**: **static territories necessarily produce both errors — variance within a zone ignored, and the two sides of a boundary forcibly separated** — **and flood is precisely a peril with a very steep spatial gradient** (**readable with the flood and exposure models [[hazus]], [[gem-vmtk]], [[floodmodeller-api]], [[lisflood]], [[thinkhazard]] and [[pyincore]]**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim coordinate-level surcharging is directly usable under any regulatory framework — territory rating has regulatory and statistical rationales in most jurisdictions, including credibility, explainability and the avoidance of discriminatory pricing**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ The formula in the README and the formula its own example applies are not the same function — the point this entry most needs to state plainly.** **The headline formula reads verbatim `Multiplier(d) = 1.0 + 2.0 × exp(−λ(d − 10))` with λ = 1/300**, **while the `formula_applied` field in the README’s own example response reads verbatim `1.0 + 2.0 * exp(-d / 300.0)`** — **the difference being exactly the `−10` offset**. ⭐⭐ **This entry recomputed that example (distance 45.2 m) under both forms**: **with the offset, `exp(−(d−10)/300)` gives 2.7786; without it, `exp(−d/300)` gives 2.7203** — **whereas the example reports `spatial_multiplier` 2.72 and `final_premium` 3264.0 (and 1200 × 2.72 = 3264, internally consistent)** — **so the example actually follows the version without the offset, while the headline formula in the prose carries it**. ⭐⭐ **The tier table corroborates this**: **the table’s "≤10 m → 3.00×" maximum is attainable only under the offset version at d = 10 (`exp(0)` → 1 + 2 = 3.00)**, **while its 11–250 m band of 1.87×–2.93× and 251–500 m band of 1.38×–1.86× match the version without the offset** (**this entry computed: d = 11 → 2.9280; d = 250 → 1.8692; d = 500 → 1.3778; d = 999 → 1.0716**). ⭐⭐⭐ **Two functions therefore coexist in the document, and the claim of a 3.00× maximum surcharge belongs to the variant that is written but not applied** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim which one the code implements — `spatial_risk_engine.py` was not read; the arithmetic above is this entry’s own, not the author’s**). **③ ⭐⭐ Three parameters are written down explicitly (baseline 1.0×, maximum 3.0×, λ = 1/300)**, **and describing the decay rate as "calibrated to hazard proximity" is notable**: **λ is a calibratable parameter whose value ought to have a calibration basis** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim 1/300 has one — the README gives no calibration data, sample or source; this is the entry’s second item to verify**). **④ ⭐⭐ The stack reads verbatim and is a conventional geospatial combination**: **FastAPI with Pydantic v2** (asynchronous handling, request/response validation, automatic OpenAPI docs); **GeoPy with OpenStreetMap Nominatim** (**with "compliant User-Agent headers" noted verbatim**); **OSMnx** for querying and filtering hydrological topologies; **GeoPandas with Shapely** for projection and geometric distance. ⭐ **The mention of a compliant User-Agent deserves separate note** — **Nominatim’s usage policy requires an identifiable User-Agent**, **and writing it into the README shows the author read that policy** (**readable with this site’s consistent attention to data sourcing and terms of use**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ The example request and response give a complete checkable chain**: **request `{"address": "100 Thames Path, London, UK", "base_premium": 1200.00}`**, **response carrying `latitude`, `longitude`, `distance_to_water_meters` (45.2), `spatial_multiplier` (2.72), `risk_level` ("High Risk"), `final_premium` (3264.0) and `formula_applied`** — **a fully traceable record from address to premium** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim that address, its coordinates or the 45.2 m distance are real — the service was not called; ⚠️ note also that the example uses a plausible-looking real address rather than an obvious placeholder**). **⑥ ⭐ Its tier table reads verbatim**: **≤10 m → 3.00×, Catastrophic Exposure (maximum flood surcharge cap)**; **11–250 m → 1.87×–2.93×, High Risk**; **251–500 m → 1.38×–1.86×, Moderate Risk**; **501–999 m → 1.07×–1.37×, Elevated Risk**; **≥1,000 m or null → 1.00×, Standard / Baseline Risk (no catastrophe adjustment)**. ⭐⭐ **Cutting a continuous multiplier into five bands and naming each is a step toward translating model output into underwriting language**; **but for pricing students, note that banding reintroduces the very discontinuity at thresholds the manuscript criticises in static territories — only with the scale reduced from postal codes to metres** (**this is the entry’s own judgement, not the author’s**). **⑦ ⭐ An online deployment (Render) is provided** (**ⓘ not visited**). **⑧ ⭐ Readable with the site’s flood and geospatial risk entries**: [[catrisk-sim]], [[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]] (**this round’s other two catastrophe approaches**), [[floodmodeller-api]], [[lisflood]], [[thinkhazard]], [[pyincore]], [[rfema]], [[duckdb-fema-nfip]], [[physrisk]], [[hazus]] and [[gem-vmtk]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ The README claims MIT, but no licence file exists anywhere in the repository** — **the badge reads verbatim as "License: MIT" linking to `LICENSE`, and the closing section states verbatim "This project is licensed under the MIT License."**, **yet `LICENSE`, `LICENSE.md`, `LICENSE.txt`, `license` and `COPYING` each measured 404 on main, the GitHub API licence field reads `NONE`, and none of the five root items is a licence**. **This entry records the mismatch between the claim and the fact explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before use, modification or redistribution** (**⚠️ this round’s [[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]] also has no licence file, but it makes no licence claim — the problem here is specifically that a claim contradicts the repository; comparable to round 322’s [[saude-publica-br]] and round 326’s [[ibnr-app]]**); **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, the five-item root listing, and the README’s full 7,907 bytes in respect of its problem statement, four-stage pipeline, stack, rating formula, tier table, example request and response, and licence claim**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install, run `main.py` or `spatial_risk_engine.py`, call its online deployment, or read a single line of either Python file**, so **the actual multiplier implementation, the Nominatim call parameters, the OSMnx query details, the Shapely distance routine and any deployment behaviour cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The formula inconsistency has been verified arithmetically by this entry (above), but which version the code implements is not claimed — the only way to settle it is to read `spatial_risk_engine.py` or run the service, and neither was done**; **④ ⭐⭐ The calibration basis for λ = 1/300 was not verified** — **the README calls it calibrated to hazard proximity but gives no calibration data, sample or source**; **the entry does not claim the value has any empirical or regulatory basis**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether the example’s address, coordinates and 45.2 m distance are real was not verified** (**the service was not called**); **⑥ ⭐⭐ The provenance and plausibility of the tier thresholds (10 / 250 / 500 / 1,000 m) were not verified**; **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ The method’s compliance in any jurisdiction was not assessed** — **pricing by geographic coordinate engages questions about the fairness of risk classification and potentially discriminatory pricing**; **the entry does not claim it is directly usable for real underwriting or quoting**; **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ Whether its use of Nominatim and OpenStreetMap actually complies with their usage and attribution policies was not verified** (**the README says only that compliant User-Agent headers are used**); **⑨ ⭐ The implementation is tiny** (`main.py` at 18,846 bytes plus `spatial_risk_engine.py` at 5,475 bytes) — **small is not the same as incomplete, but how many edge cases it covers cannot be judged from here**; **⑩ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⑪ ⭐ No topics and a measurably empty repository description**; **⑫ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Devananditha/geo-catastrophe-pricing`, `/readme` and `/contents/` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 7,907-byte README read via `raw.githubusercontent.com`; `LICENSE`, `LICENSE.md`, `LICENSE.txt`, `license` and `COPYING` each measured 404 on main); **the numerical divergence between the two formulas was computed by this entry** (at 45.2 m: 2.7786 with the offset, 2.7203 without; tier-table boundary values likewise recomputed point by point); **nothing cloned, installed, run or called, and no source read**.

These coarse macro-level segmentations introduce significant underwriting error: adjacent structures separated by mere tens of meters can exhibit radically divergent hydrological profiles, leading to widespread risk mispricing, adverse selection, and unpriced aggregate exposure.」——静态分区必然产生「区内方差被忽略」与「区界两侧被强行区分」两类错误，且洪水是空间梯度极陡的险种，此分析已写入；四阶段流水线逐字：物理地址→Nominatim/GeoPy 地理编码→WGS84 点→OSMnx 空间图查询（半径 2.0 × exp(−λ(d − 10))（λ = 1/300）与示例回显的 formula_applied「1.0 + 2.0 * exp(-d / 300.0)」不是同一个函数**——差别正是 −10 偏移；本词条对示例（距离 45.2 米）分别复算：含偏移得 2.7786、不含偏移得 2.7203，而示例所报 spatial_multiplier 为 2.72、final_premium 为 3264.0（1200×2.72=3264 自洽），即示例走的是不含偏移的版本；分级表亦印证：≤10 米的 3.00× 封顶只有含偏移版在 d=10 才能取到（exp(0)→1+2=3.00），而 11–250 米的 1.87×–2.93× 与 251–500 米的 1.38×–1.86× 与不含偏移版吻合（本词条实算 d=11→2.9280、d=250→1.8692、d=500→1.3778、d=999→1.0716、d=1000→1.0713）；即文档中同时存在两个函数，而「最大加费封顶 3.00×」属于写了但未被应用的那一个；⭐⭐三个参数被明确写出（基線 1.0×、最大 3.0×、λ=1/300），且 README 称衰减率按危险邻近度校准——但未给出标定数据、样本或来源；⭐⭐技术栈逐字 FastAPI＋Pydantic v2、GeoPy＋Nominatim（逐字注明使用 compliant User-Agent headers 以符合使用条款）、OSMnx、GeoPandas＋Shapely；⭐⭐示例请求/响应给出可核对完整链路（address 与 base_premium 1200.00 → latitude/longitude/distance_to_water_meters 45.2/spatial_multiplier 2.72/risk_level "High Risk"/final_premium 3264.0/formula_applied）；⭐分级表逐字 ≤10 米 3.00× Catastrophic Exposure／11–250 米 1.87×–2.93× High Risk／251–500 米 1.38×–1.86× Moderate Risk／501–999 米 1.07×–1.37× Elevated Risk／≥1,000 米或 null 1.00× Standard/Baseline；本词条判断：把连续乘数切成五档是「把模型输出翻译成核保语言」的一步，但分档会重新引入「阈值附近不连续」的问题——这正是它开篇批评静态分区的同一种毛病，只是尺度从邮政编码缩到了米（此为本词条判断，非作者自述）；⭐提供 Render 在线部署（本次未访问）；⚠️未克隆、未安装、未运行 main.py 或 spatial_risk_engine.py、未调用其在线部署、未读任何一行源码，故不转述代码中的实际乘数实现/Nominatim 调用参数/OSMnx 查询细节/Shapely 距离算法/任何部署行为；⚠️⚠️**公式不一致已由本词条以算术核实，但本词条不主张代码里实际用的是哪一个版本**——唯一判定方法是读 entries.summary_en: A human-in-the-loop multi-agent system for the monthly portfolio review: a Next.js dashboard, a FastAPI orchestrator with agents, and deterministic analytics kept separate from the agents; the README is only 1,289 bytes, but the repository also carries a 105,971-byte implementation plan (described as the source of truth for build order) and a 44,363-byte multi-agent system specification, plus a "Decisions (locked)" section stating the LLM wiring, an identity seam, an isolated schema for tests and the reporting currency
entries.body:
**actuary-os**（自述名 **Vortex ActuaryOS**）是一个**面向「月度组合复核」的人在环多智能体系统**（仓库 `Parv-005/actuary-os`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 531 KB、创建于 2026-09-06、最后推送 2026-09-07**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测仅 1,289 字节**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把假设写成可核对的东西」**中的**第四种，也是文档形态最反常的一种：薄的是 README，厚的是仓库里的规格与计划**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**README 标题逐字为「Vortex ActuaryOS」**，**首句逐字为**：**「**Human-in-the-loop multi-agent system for the Monthly Portfolio Review.**」**；**并逐字指引**：**「See `Vortex_ActuaryOS_Implementation_Plan.md` (**source of truth for build order**) and `Vortex_ActuaryOS_Multi_Agent_System_Specification.md` (**product spec**).」**。⭐⭐⭐ **根目录实测，是本条目最值得记的一处**：**`README.md` 仅 **1,289 字节**，而同一目录下另有 **`Vortex_ActuaryOS_Implementation_Plan.md`（**105,971 字节**）与 `Vortex_ActuaryOS_Multi_Agent_System_Specification.md`（**44,363 字节**）****——**即 README 与详细文档的体量比约为 **1 : 116****。**其余根目录实测**：**`.env.example`（1,316 字节）、`.github`、`.gitignore`、`Makefile`（568 字节）、`backend/`、`docs/`、`frontend/`、`sample_data/`、`scripts/`**。**README 的 Quickstart 逐字实测**：**`make setup`（venv ＋ npm install）**；**`cp .env.example backend/.env`（填 `DATABASE_URL`、`SUPABASE_*`、`LLM_*`）**；**`make migrate`（**幂等 SQL 迁移，遵循 `APP_DB_SCHEMA`**）**；**`make seed`（样例数据 ＋ 8 月工作流 ＋ 演示文件 → Storage）**；**`make dev`（uvicorn :8000，`/docs`）**；**另起终端 `cd frontend && npm run dev`（:3000）**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「README 薄、规格厚」这一形态是本条目最有价值的一点，也正好是本会话既有观察的**反面****——**本站此前已 5 次记录「元数据稀疏但 README 详实」（第 325／326／327 轮各一次、第 328 轮两次）**，**而本条是**反过来**：**README 只有 1,289 字节，把「构建顺序的唯一依据」与「产品规格」分别放在两份共 **150,334 字节**的仓库内文档里****。⭐⭐ **对做交付的学生，这提示一种**把完整性与入口分开**的组织方式**：**README 只做入口与快速上手，**深度内容不塞进入口文档****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这种做法在本例中效果良好**——**README 短到无法据此判断系统的实际完成度**，**而两份大文档本次均未读**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「与智能体分开的**确定性分析**」是本条目在架构上最值得记的一点**——**README 的目录说明逐字为**：**「`backend/` — FastAPI + orchestrator + agents + **deterministic analytics**」**——**即在同一个后端里，**确定性分析**与**智能体**被并列列出而不是混为一谈**。⭐⭐ **这与本站反复出现的同一条判断同源**：**让模型去找输入、让确定性代码做算术**（**第 329 轮 [[insurance-tabular-review]] 的三种列型 —— `extract`／`analysis`／**`calculate` 由应用程序计算**；同轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的**正则优先、LLM 兜底**加**非 LLM 的 grounding 回查****）；**本条是这一取舍在**多智能体系统**里的落点**（**⚠️ 本次未读其 `backend/` 源码，**不主张**该分离在实现中确实成立**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「已锁定的决定（Decisions (locked)）」一节逐字实测，是本轮主题最直接的形态**——**本节把四条决定写成不可再商量的形式**：**① LLM：使用 **OpenAI 兼容端点**（`LLM_BASE_URL`／`API_KEY`／`MODEL`），**并设 `LLM_PROVIDER=fake` 供 CI／测试使用****；**② 身份：公开演示，**内置一个种子化的「Demo Actuary」（`get_current_actor()` seam）****；**③ 数据库：**dev 与 prod 共用 Supabase 项目**，**测试用隔离的 `test` schema**；**④ 计价币种：**INR（Rs.）****。⭐⭐⭐ **其中两点值得单独记**：**`LLM_PROVIDER=fake` 让 CI 与测试**不依赖真实模型调用****（**与第 329 轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的「3 个 LLM 用例缺 API key 时报 skipped 而非 failing」属同一类**无密钥可测**安排**）；**而 `get_current_actor()` 被显式称为一个 **seam（接缝）****——**即身份读取被收在一处，便于替换为真实鉴权**（**可与第 329 轮 [[claim-to-confidence]] 的「权限矩阵由后端强制 ＋ 一条智能体身份被拒的负向测试」并读**——**两者都在处理**谁有权让数字入账**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该 seam 已接入任何真实身份体系**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **`Makefile`（568 字节）逐字实测，与 README 一致且多出几个目标**：**`setup`／`migrate`／`seed`／**`reset-demo`**／`dev`／`test`／`lint`／`backend-test`／`frontend-test`**；其中**`backend-test` 逐字为 `cd backend && APP_DB_SCHEMA=test .venv/bin/pytest -q`**（**即测试确实跑在隔离的 `test` schema 上**，**与「已锁定的决定」第 ③ 条对应**）、**`lint` 逐字为 `ruff check app scripts tests`**、**`seed` 逐字先跑 `generate_sample_data.py` 再跑 `seed.py`**。⭐⭐ **`reset-demo` 这个目标值得单独注意**：**它意味着**演示状态可以被重置****——**对要反复演示同一套数据的场景，这是一个务实的安排**（**⚠️ 本次未运行任何目标**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **样例数据用固定随机种子生成**——**`sample_data/` 逐字说明为「generated CSVs (**RNG seed 42**) + SCENARIOS.md」**；**与同批 [[catrisk-sim]] 的「默认使用固定随机种子」属同一做法**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **前端为 Next.js 14 仪表板且用 **REST 轮询、间隔 2 秒****——**逐字为「Next.js 14 dashboard (REST polling, 2s)」**；**即它没有采用流式推送**，**而选了**固定间隔轮询****（**对**多智能体长流程的进度呈现**，这是一个简单但会带来延迟与请求量的选择**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该选择恰当**）。**⑦ ⭐ **`docs/` 逐字含 architecture、api、runbook、demo-script 四类**——**即除规格与计划外，还准备了**运行手册与演示脚本****。**⑧ ⭐ **计价币种为 INR，且样例含「8 月工作流」**——**暗示其场景设定在印度、且以**月度**为周期**（**与「月度组合复核」一致**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站与智能体化精算工作流相关的条目并读**：[[claim-to-confidence]]（**第 329 轮：一笔修正穿过四个职能，含权限矩阵与负向测试**）、[[reinsurance-treaty-agent]]、[[insurance-tabular-review]]、[[underwriting-decision-safety]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[hx-actuarial-agent-prompts]]、[[actuarial-python-lab]]、[[valact-rag]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]、[[underwriting-copilot]]、[[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]]。

entries.summary: 一个面向非寿险的频率-严重度 GLM 定价库：含泊松到 Tweedie 的分布族、R 式公式语法、GAM 与单调约束 GLM 等变体、费率表与评分引擎、经验修正与可信度加权、价格弹性与受限费率优化，并能导出 SERFF 合规的申报 XML／CSV 并对受保护类别属性做反歧视检查；其许可说明单列一节写明「这是计算工具而非财务或精算意见」，并把输出验证、监管合规与专业复核的责任明确交给使用者
entries.summary_hk: 一個面向非壽險的頻率-嚴重度 GLM 定價庫：含泊松到 Tweedie 的分布族、R 式公式語法、GAM 與單調約束 GLM 等變體、費率表與評分引擎、經驗修正與可信度加權、價格彈性與受限費率優化，並能導出 SERFF 合規的申報 XML／CSV 並對受保護類別屬性做反歧視檢查；其許可說明單列一節寫明「這是計算工具而非財務或精算意見」，並把輸出驗證、監管合規與專業複核的責任明確交給使用者
entries.summary_en: A frequency-severity GLM pricing library for non-life insurance: distribution families from Poisson to Tweedie, R-style formula syntax, GAM and monotonicity-constrained GLM variants, tariff tables with a rating engine, experience modification and credibility weighting, price elasticity and constrained rate optimisation, plus export of SERFF-compliant filing XML/CSV and anti-discrimination checks on protected-class attributes; its licensing document has a section stating it is a computational tool rather than financial or actuarial advice, and places responsibility for validating outputs, regulatory compliance and professional review squarely on the user
entries.body:
**InsureRisk** 是一个**面向非寿险的频率-严重度 GLM 定价库**（仓库 `23BCE0066/InsureRisk-Insurance-Pricing-Risk-Analytics`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 259 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-07**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 许可情形特殊——GitHub API 报 `NONE` 且根目录**没有 `LICENSE` 文件（实测 404）**，**但仓库内另有一份 **`LICENSING.md`（6,176 字节）**逐字声明为 **Mozilla Public License v2.0（MPL-2.0）**并详列权利与义务**（**详见下方标注 ①**）；**无 topics**；**README 实测 20,121 字节**。本条目属于本轮主题**「说清楚什么算它是对的」**中的**第一种：它把「谁该为输出负责」写得极为明确**。

可核实信息（**均 README、`LICENSING.md` 与仓库根目录实测**）：**README 标题逐字为「InsureRisk」，副标题逐字为「Modern Actuarial Pricing Library for Non-Life Insurance」**，**定位句逐字为「InsureRisk is a Python library for building **GLM-based frequency-severity pricing models** with a focus on **actuarial best practices**.」**。**根目录实测**：**`.github`、`.gitignore`、`.pre-commit-config.yaml`、`.readthedocs.yaml`、`.tmp_changelog.txt`、`INSTALLATION.md`（6,228 字节）、**`LICENSING.md`（6,176 字节）**、`README.md`（20,121 字节）、`docs/`、`examples/`、`fix_docstrings.py`、`insurerisk/`、`package-lock.json`、`package.json`、`pyproject.toml`、`tests/`**；**安装方式逐字为 `pip install insurerisk`**，**当前版本实测为 **0.3.1****。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「Not Investment Advice」一节把**用户责任**逐条写出来，是本条目最值得引用的一处**——**`LICENSING.md` 逐字为**：**「InsureRisk is a **computational tool**, not financial or actuarial advice. **Users are responsible for:** Validation of outputs in their specific context; Compliance with applicable insurance regulations; **Professional review of any models built with InsureRisk**; Appropriateness of assumptions and data.」**——**即「这是一个**计算工具**，不是财务或精算意见。使用者须自行负责：在自身情境下**验证输出**、**遵守适用的保险监管规定**、**对用本库建立的任何模型进行专业复核**、以及**假设与数据的适当性**」**。⭐⭐ **对准备把这类库用进作业或实习的学生，这四条恰好是一条**从代码到可辩护结论**的检查清单**（**可与 [[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[insurance-governance]] 并读**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **监管申报能力是本条目在功能上最值得注意的地方**——**README 单设「Regulatory Compliance」一节，逐字含三项**：**① `insurerisk.compliance.RateIndicationSummary`——报告实际赔付率、指示费率、可信度权重与**复核用选择标记**；② `insurerisk.compliance.RateFilingPackage`——打包费率指示与错位分析，**并对受保护类别属性运行反歧视检查**；③ `insurerisk.compliance.SERFFExporter`——把费率相对数导出为 **SERFF 合规的 XML 或扁平 CSV 供监管提交（例如 AR、CA、GR 申报）**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **在美国，费率申报是**受监管的正式动作**，而 SERFF 是各州使用的申报系统——**一个开源库做到导出 SERFF 格式并内置反歧视检查，说明其目标用户是**真的要做申报的定价人员****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其导出格式确实符合 SERFF 的技术规范或任何州的要求**——**本次未运行、未查看任何导出文件**；**⚠️ 「反歧视检查」的具体判定规则本次亦未读**，**且**费率公平性在监管上有多套并存的检验方法**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **七种 GLM 变体把「同一个频率-严重度框架」扩到不同统计需求上，是本条目在方法上最有用的一组**——**`GAM`**（平滑非线性效应）；**`MonotoneGLM`**（**对有序类别预测变量施加拟合后单调性约束**）；**`QuantileGLM`**（条件分位数回归，含严重度扇形图）；**`BayesianGLM`**（基于 PyMC 的贝叶斯泊松／伽马 GLM，输出可信区间，需可选依赖 `pymc`）；**`HierarchicalGLM`**（混合效应／分层 GLM，基于 statsmodels 的 `MixedLM`，非高斯族可选用 pymer4／rpy2）**。⭐ **其中 `MonotoneGLM` 值得单独记**：**在费率表中，**某个因子应当单调**（例如年龄越大风险越高）常是业务或监管上的要求**，**而普通 GLM 拟合出的系数未必单调**；**拟合后施加单调约束，是把**统计拟合**与**业务可解释性**接起来的做法**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其实现方法或效果**——**本次未读源码**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **一处**命名冲突的自我披露**在本会话很少见**——**README 逐字为**：**「Note: `insurerisk.glm.qpp.FrequencyModel` is a **lightweight QPP-specific wrapper** and is **distinct from** the top-level `insurerisk.FrequencyModel` frequency-severity workflow class.」**——**即同一个包里**两个不同类共用 `FrequencyModel` 这一名字**，**作者在发行说明里主动指出这一点**。⭐⭐ **对要维护较长生命周期的库，这类**明知有坑而先说明**的做法，比事后在 issue 里解释有用得多**（**可与第 330 轮 [[actuary-os]] 的「已锁定的决定」、第 328 轮 [[creance]] 的「调度器只打印计划」并读**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **「Quantile Premium Principle（QPP）」是本条目在定价思想上最特殊的一项**——**逐字说明其做法为「prices policies from the **policy-specific severity quantile implied by the frequency model’s zero-claim probability**, **rather than the expected loss**」**——**即不用期望损失，而用**由零索赔概率所隐含的保单特有严重度分位数**来定价**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该定价原则在理论上恰当或已被采用**——**本次未读其推导**；**⚠️ 另注：README 自己提醒该模块的 `FrequencyModel` 与顶层同名类不同，见上**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **其余功能覆盖面很宽且都属定价实务的真实环节**——**分布族含泊松、负二项、伽马、逆高斯、对数正态与 **Tweedie****；**联结函数含 log、identity、inverse、inverse squared**；**⭐ **「针对基于暴露度的频率模型做正确的 offset 处理」被单独列出**；**诊断含 AIC／BIC／偏差／离散度／**过度离散检验****；**模型验证含 **VIF（方差膨胀因子）**与相关性分析**；**预测表现含提升曲线、**Gini 指数**与残差图**；**暴露度计算支持天／月／年三种方法与自定义日期列**；**费率工具含基准费率与因子相对数、因子套用、**趋势调整**、**on-leveling（期中费率变更调整）**、**经验修正（EMR／XMod）**、**可信度加权****；**组合与影响分析含保费影响、**结构漂移分解（mix-shift）**、赢家／输家分段、费率充足性、**价格弹性与需求曲线**、留存建模，以及**受限费率优化**（`ConstrainedRateOptimizer`，结合可信度约束与线性规划，并含错位分析）**；**数据工具含 `DataQualityChecker`（缺失／离群报告、缩尾、因子合并、自动分箱、**泄漏检查**与校准曲线）与 `AutoImputer`**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **工程质量有可核实的交代**——**逐字为「Testing: **68%+ test coverage with pytest**」**；**根目录实测含 `.pre-commit-config.yaml` 与 **`.readthedocs.yaml`**（**即配置了 pre-commit 钩子与 Read the Docs 文档构建**）；**README 另有「Behavior note」逐字说明**：**「`SeverityGLM.fit` performs **zero filtering automatically** and lognormal family is **internally handled with transformation**.」**——**即把两处**不显眼但会改变结果的内部行为**写在了发行说明里**。**⑧ ⭐ **与本站定价与 GLM 条目并读**：[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、[[tweedie-python]]、[[easy-glm]]、[[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[shap-relativities]]、[[ratemaking]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[glm]]、[[insurance-credibility]]、[[mg-credibility]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可情形须分三点说清**：**GitHub API 实测许可字段为 `NONE`**；**根目录**没有 `LICENSE` 文件**（`raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测 **404**，且根目录清单中确无之）；**而 `LICENSING.md`（6,176 字节）逐字声明为「**Mozilla Public License v2.0 (MPL-2.0)**」，并逐条列出 MPL-2.0 的权利（可用于商业项目、可修改、可以 MPL-2.0 分发修改版、**可与专有代码链接**、可纳入 SaaS）与义务（分发时须**附上许可副本**、须有显著声明、修改版须提供源码、须保留版权与作者归属），另含「**内部使用例外**：仅在内部使用而不分发则不产生义务」。⭐⭐ **值得注意的是：该文件自己要求「Include License: Provide a copy of the MPL-2.0 license」，而它所指的 `LICENSE` 文件并不存在**。**本词条据此记录：**许可意图明确且写得详尽，但**标准许可文件缺失**，**故 GitHub 无法识别、使用者也无从取得该许可正文****；**使用、修改或分发前应自行确认**（**⚠️ 可与第 330 轮 [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、[[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]] 与本轮 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]]、[[insurers-101]] 的许可情形对照——**本轮四条中有三条**声称许可而无许可文件****，**详见本轮日志**）；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、根目录清单、README（20,121 指數**與殘差圖**；**暴露度計算支持天／月／年**；**費率工具含基準費率與因子相對數、因子套用、**趨勢調整**、**on-leveling**、**經驗修正（EMR／XMod）**、**可信度加權****；**組合分析含保費影響、**結構漂移分解**、贏家／輸家分段、費率充足性、**價格彈性**、留存建模與**受限費率優化**（可信度約束＋線性規劃＋錯位分析）**；**資料工具含 **InsureRisk** is **a frequency-severity GLM pricing library for non-life insurance** (repository `23BCE0066/InsureRisk-Insurance-Pricing-Risk-Analytics`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 259 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-07** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ its licence situation is unusual — the GitHub API reports `NONE` and there is no `LICENSE` file at the root (404 on main), yet the repository carries a `LICENSING.md` (6,176 bytes) stating verbatim that it is licensed under the Mozilla Public License v2.0 (MPL-2.0) with rights and obligations spelled out** (**see note ① below**); it has **no topics**; **the README measures 20,121 bytes**. It is the first of this round’s four takes on **stating what would count as evidence that it is right**: **it is unusually explicit about who is responsible for the output**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README, `LICENSING.md` and the repository root**): **the title reads verbatim "InsureRisk" with the subtitle "Modern Actuarial Pricing Library for Non-Life Insurance"**, **and the positioning sentence reads verbatim "InsureRisk is a Python library for building GLM-based frequency-severity pricing models with a focus on actuarial best practices."** **The root measurably contains** **`.github`, `.gitignore`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `.readthedocs.yaml`, `.tmp_changelog.txt`, `INSTALLATION.md` (6,228 bytes), `LICENSING.md` (6,176 bytes), `README.md` (20,121 bytes), `docs/`, `examples/`, `fix_docstrings.py`, `insurerisk/`, `package-lock.json`, `package.json`, `pyproject.toml` and `tests/`**; **installation reads verbatim `pip install insurerisk`**, **and the current version measurably is 0.3.1**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ A "Not Investment Advice" section spelling out the user’s responsibilities item by item is the entry’s most quotable passage** — **`LICENSING.md` reads verbatim**: **"InsureRisk is a computational tool, not financial or actuarial advice. Users are responsible for: Validation of outputs in their specific context; Compliance with applicable insurance regulations; Professional review of any models built with InsureRisk; Appropriateness of assumptions and data."** ⭐⭐ **For a student about to use such a library in coursework or an internship, those four items are precisely a checklist from code to a defensible conclusion** (**readable with [[verified-reserving]], [[reproducible-actuarial-work]], [[fair-pricing-playbook]] and [[insurance-governance]]**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Regulatory filing capability is the entry’s most notable functional feature** — **a dedicated "Regulatory Compliance" section reads verbatim as three items**: **`insurerisk.compliance.RateIndicationSummary` reporting actual loss ratios, indicated rates, credibility weights and selection flags for rate review**; ⚠️ what the anti-discrimination check actually tests was also not read, and rate fairness has several coexisting and not fully consistent testing approaches**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Seven GLM variants extend one frequency-severity framework to different statistical needs, the entry’s most useful methodological grouping** — **`GAM`** (smooth non-linear effects); **`MonotoneGLM`** (**applying post-fit monotonicity constraints to ordered categorical predictors**); **`QuantileGLM`** (conditional quantile regression with severity fan plots); **`BayesianGLM`** (a PyMC-based Bayesian Poisson/Gamma GLM with credible intervals, behind an optional dependency); **`HierarchicalGLM`** (mixed-effects GLM on statsmodels `MixedLM`). ⭐ **`MonotoneGLM` deserves separate note**: **in a rating table, a factor being monotone (age increasing risk, say) is often a business or regulatory requirement, whereas an ordinary GLM fit need not produce monotone coefficients** (**⚠️ its implementation and effect were not read**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ A self-disclosed naming collision is rare in this session** — verbatim: **"Note: `insurerisk.glm.qpp.FrequencyModel` is a lightweight QPP-specific wrapper and is distinct from the top-level `insurerisk.FrequencyModel` frequency-severity workflow class."** ⭐⭐ **For a library with a long maintenance life, naming a known trap in advance beats explaining it in an issue later** (**readable with round 330’s [[actuary-os]] and round 328’s [[creance]]**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ The Quantile Premium Principle is the entry’s most unusual pricing idea** — **described verbatim as pricing "from the policy-specific severity quantile implied by the frequency model’s zero-claim probability, rather than the expected loss"** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the principle is theoretically sound or adopted anywhere — its derivation was not read**). **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ The remaining functional coverage is broad and consists of real steps in pricing practice** — distribution families including Poisson, negative binomial, gamma, inverse Gaussian, lognormal and **Tweedie**; link functions log, identity, inverse and inverse squared; ⭐ **"proper offset handling for exposure-based frequency models" listed separately**; diagnostics including AIC, BIC, deviance, dispersion and **overdispersion tests**; validation including **VIF** and correlation analysis; predictive performance including lift curves, the **Gini index** and residual plots; exposure calculation in days, months or years; rating tools including base rates and factor relativities, factor application, **trend adjustment**, **on-leveling**, **experience modification (EMR/XMod)** and **credibility weighting**; portfolio analysis including premium impact, **mix-shift decomposition**, winners-and-losers segments, rate adequacy, **price elasticity**, retention modelling and **constrained rate optimisation** (credibility bounds plus linear programming with dislocation analysis); and data tools including `DataQualityChecker` (missing-value and outlier reports, winsorising, factor consolidation, auto-binning, **leakage checks** and calibration curves). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Engineering quality is stated in checkable terms** — verbatim "Testing: 68%+ test coverage with pytest"; entries.title: 无标签的理赔异常检测：把规则引擎留作弱标签基准，并明说该基准衡量的是「一致与不一致」而非准确率
entries.title_en: Label-free claim anomaly detection: the rule engine is held out as a weak-label benchmark, and the benchmark is explicitly said to measure agreement and disagreement rather than accuracy
entries.title_hk: 無標籤的理賠異常檢測：把規則引擎留作弱標籤基準，並明說該基準衡量的是「一致與不一致」而非準確率
entries.summary: 一个在 R 中搭建的无监督理赔异常检测流水线：用 AIDA 打异常分、用 TIX 把分数归因到具体特征，让每个被标记的理赔都带一份「它哪里不寻常」的排序清单；它不依赖任何已标注的欺诈数据，把保险公司现有的规则引擎刻意排除在特征矩阵之外、仅作弱标签基准，并明确说明该基准衡量的是两种系统的一致与不一致而非准确率
entries.summary_hk: 一個在 R 中搭建的無監督理賠異常檢測流水線：用 AIDA 打異常分、用 TIX 把分數歸因到具體特徵，讓每個被標記的理賠都帶一份「它哪裡不尋常」的排序清單；它不依賴任何已標註的欺詐資料，把保險公司現有的規則引擎刻意排除在特徵矩陣之外、僅作弱標籤基準，並明確說明該基準衡量的是兩種系統的一致與不一致而非準確率
entries.summary_en: An unsupervised claim anomaly detection pipeline built in R: AIDA produces the anomaly scores and TIX attributes each score across input features, so every flagged claim carries a ranked list of what made it unusual; it relies on no labelled fraud data, deliberately keeps the insurer’s existing rule engine out of the feature matrix and uses it only as a weak-label benchmark, and states explicitly that the benchmark measures agreement and disagreement rather than accuracy
entries.body:
**aida-tix-anomaly-detection** 是一个**在 R 中搭建的无监督车险理赔异常检测流水线**（仓库 `aay-shar/aida-tix-anomaly-detection`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 R、仓库体量 273 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-07**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库根目录**没有许可文件**（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404），**而其 README 末节却逐字写着「## Licence — MIT — see `LICENSE`.」**（**详见下方标注 ①**）；**无 topics**；**README 实测 8,502 字节**。本条目属于本轮主题**「说清楚什么算它是对的」**中的**第二种，也是把「这套检验能证明什么」写得最精确的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**README 标题逐字为「Explainable Anomaly Detection for Motor Insurance Claims」**，**副题逐字为「An unsupervised pipeline that ranks motor insurance claims by how unusual they are, and explains each ranking at the level of individual features — **without any labelled fraud data**.」**；**其来历逐字为**：**「Built in R as an **MSc thesis project (Applied Data Science, Utrecht University)**, in collaboration with **an actuarial consultancy working with a motor insurer in Asia**.」**。**根目录实测**：**`.gitignore`、`R/`、`README.md`（8,502 字节）、`config_example.R`（180 字节）、`data/`、`figures/`**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「把规则引擎排除在特征矩阵之外、只当弱标签基准」是本条目最重要也最值得学的一处**——**逐字为**：**「The insurer’s existing rule engine is the only external signal available, so it serves as a **weak-label benchmark** — and **is deliberately held out of the model entirely. The rules table is never joined into the feature matrix.** This matters: **if the model can see which rules fired, "does the model agree with the rules" stops being a question worth asking.**」**——**即「保险公司现有的规则引擎是唯一可用的外部信号，因此它充当**弱标签基准**——并且**被刻意完全排除在模型之外，规则表从不并入特征矩阵**。这一点很重要：**如果模型能看到哪些规则被触发，『模型是否与规则一致』就不再是一个值得问的问题了』」**。⭐⭐⭐ **这是本会话见到对**评估泄漏**讲得最清楚的一段**：**把评估基准喂进模型，会让评估退化为同义反复**（**可与第 330 轮 [[catrisk-sim]] 的「测试不变量」、第 329 轮 [[insurance-tabular-review]] 的「引证校验」并读**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「该基准衡量的是**一致与不一致**而非准确率」是本条目的第二处精确表述**——**逐字为**：**「A rule firing is **not ground truth either** — it doesn’t prove fraud, and fraud can occur with no rule firing — so the benchmark measures ***agreement and disagreement*, not accuracy**.」**——**即「规则被触发也**不是真值**——它不能证明欺诈，而欺诈也可能在没有任何规则触发时发生——所以该基准衡量的是**一致与不一致**，而**不是准确率**」**。⭐⭐ **对做欺诈模型的学生，这句话直接拆掉了**「用规则标签训练并报告 AUC」这一常见做法的正当性****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其问题陈述把「为什么不能用监督学习」讲成了一个具体的数据事实，而非泛泛而谈**——**逐字为**：**「Insurers investigating irregular claims usually rely on a **rule engine**: a fixed set of thresholds written by domain experts. Rules are transparent and cheap to run, but **they only catch what someone thought to write down**, and they say nothing about claims that are strange in ways nobody anticipated.」**，**并接**：**「The obvious alternative is supervised learning — except that **requires labels, and confirmed-fraud labels barely exist**. Investigations are expensive, most claims are never examined, and **a claim that was never investigated isn’t a negative example. Any model trained on that data learns which claims got looked at, not which claims were fraudulent.**」**——⭐⭐⭐ **最后一句是选择偏差在欺诈建模中的经典陷阱，此处表述得极为干净**（**可与 [[explainable-ai-fraud]]、[[ifraudsimulator]]、[[networkfraud]]、[[insurance-conformal-fraud]]、[[medical-insurance-fraud-tianchi]] 并读**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「没有解释的分数不可执行」是本条目对**可解释性**给出的实用理由**——**逐字为**：**「produce a reason for each ranking specific enough that an adjuster can act on it. **A score with no explanation is not actionable — nobody opens an investigation because a number was high.**」**——**即「**没有人会因为一个数字很高就去开一个调查**」**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **「Findings」一节里留着**未对账的占位符**——这是本条目必须如实指出的一处**——**逐字为**：**「> **Note:** figures below are **placeholders pending a final reconciliation pass** — fill in from the thesis before publishing. See "Open items" at the bottom.」**，**其相关一处逐字为**：**「Spearman rank correlation between AIDA and Isolation Forest across all claims is ρ ≈ `[0.27 / 0.29 — reconcile]`」**——⭐⭐⭐ **即**README 尚处草稿状态，部分数值明确标注为待填、且有一个值写成待对账的二选一****。**这意味着本词条**不得把该节的任何数字当作结论引用****；**本词条据此**不主张**这些数值**（**⚠️ 这是本会话首次遇到**作者把「此处数值未定」直接留在公开 README 里**的情形**——**与第 328 轮 [[creance]] 的「调度器只打印计划」、第 330 轮 [[actuary-os]] 的薄 README 同属**把未完成状态写在明面上**，但本条更具体到单个数值**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **其三项发现即便在占位状态下，论证结构也是完整的，且都指向「不要把它当权威」**：(a) **「两种检测器几乎完全不一致」**——**逐字含「only one claim appears in both methods’ top 100」**，**并解释为「**This is a property of the algorithm family, not a defect**」**，**结论逐字为「It does mean that **a single unsupervised detector should not be treated as authoritative**.」**；(b) **「AIDA 与规则引擎相互独立，而非其替代」**——**逐字含「AUC against the held-out rules is ≈ 0.46 — **essentially no separation** — and **28 of AIDA’s top 100 claims fired no rule at all**」**，**并逐字给出解读**：**「**Read as accuracy that looks like failure. Read correctly, it’s the point**: the two systems are picking up different things, so AIDA’s value is as a **complement that surfaces claims the rules structurally cannot**.」**⭐⭐ **这是一处**主动把不利指标解释成预期结果**的写法**——**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该解读一定成立**（**「AUC 0.46」在字面上确实接近无区分度**）；**本词条只记录作者的论证与理由**；(c) **「缺失本身携带信号」**——**逐字含 TIX 归因拆分为「roughly **60% to one-hot categoricals, 26% to missingness indicator flags, and 13% to numeric features**」**，**并说明「**which fields are blank** on a claim turns out to be informative, which is why the pipeline encodes missingness explicitly rather than imputing it away」**（**⚠️ 同样属待对账的占位数值**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **八步流水线逐字实测，其中数步是专业做法**：**① 载入与清洗**（把 `""`、`"NA"`、`"NULL"`、`"?"` 等哨兵值转为真正的 `NA`，**以便缺失可被度量**）；**② 筛选**（仅取最新流程阶段、仅车险理赔，**把同一案件的多个快照收敛到最新一条，而把修订历史保留为工程特征而非丢弃**）；**③ 按策略丢弃**（直接标识符、自由文本，以及**会泄漏模型本应看不到的结案信息的「事后结果字段」，如理赔状态与已付金额**）；**④ 聚合子表**（配件价差、工时合计、既往理赔次数与近因）；**⑤ 构造特征**（**报案延迟、进入保单天数、临近保单起止的理赔、出险时车龄、估损修订比**）；**⑥ 编码缺失**（字段按「多数存在／多数缺失／变动」分档，各生成显式指示列）；**⑦ 构造矩阵**（**金额字段取对数、稳健中位数／IQR 缩放、低基数类别独热编码、超过 25 个水平用频率编码、稀有水平合并**）；**⑧ 打分与解释**（导出给 AIDA 二进制、读回分数、导出 top-k 给 TIX、读回归因并映射到特征名）**。⭐ **其中第 ③ 步的「排除事后结果字段以防泄漏」与第 ⑤ 步的「把快照修订史留下当特征」都属**知道自己在防什么的特征工程****。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **每个特征都带一条 manifest 记录，这是 TIX 归因能拆解的前提**——**逐字为**：**「Every feature carries a **manifest entry** recording whether it came from a numeric field, a one-hot level, a frequency encoding, or a missingness flag — **which is what makes the TIX attribution breakdown above possible**.」**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **数据与可运行性的交代极为诚实，是本条目在**可复现性**上最值得记的一处**——**逐字为**：**「The claims data is **proprietary and is not included** in this repository. **No data file, no derived export, and no per-claim output is committed. The country and the insurer are not identified.** `config.R`, which holds local paths, is gitignored. **The code is published to show the method and the engineering; it will not run without access to the underlying data.**」**——**即「理赔数据属专有且未包含在本仓库中；**没有提交任何数据文件、任何派生导出或任何逐笔输出；国家与保险公司均未标识****；**代码公开是为了展示方法与工程，**没有底层数据则无法运行****」**。⭐⭐ **明确写出「外部人跑不起来」，比静默缺失数据有用得多**（**可与第 330 轮 [[catrisk-sim]] 的「synthetic and deliberately simplified」、第 325 轮 [[parametric-risk-toolkit]] 的固定种子合成数据并读——**三者都在处理**数据不能公开时怎么办**，**各选了不同解法**）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **AIDA 与 TIX 明确声明**未随仓库分发****——**逐字为「**AIDA and TIX are not redistributed here.** Obtain the implementation from the authors’ release for the paper cited below, and build it locally」**，**并给出 `g++` 构建命令**；**且 `R/00_run_all.R` 逐字标注了**两处为外部二进制而暂停**的位置**。**⑪ ⭐ **参考文献与致谢逐字实测**：**Souto Arias, L. A., Oosterlee, C. W., & Cirillo, P. (2023). AIDA: Analytic isolation and distance-based anomaly detection algorithm. Pattern Recognition, 141, 109607.**；**致谢为「Supervised by Dr. Georg Krempl (Utrecht University), with industry supervision from the partner consultancy.」**。**⑫ ⭐ **Isolation Forest 作为基线时**刻意设置 `ndim = 1`**，**逐字解释为「so the comparison is against **classic axis-parallel isolation** rather than an oblique variant」**——**即把基线的配置也交代清楚，以免比较对象不明**。**⑬ ⭐ 可与本站欺诈与异常检测条目并读**：[[explainable-ai-fraud]]、[[ifraudsimulator]]、[[networkfraud]]、[[insurance-conformal-fraud]]、[[medical-insurance-fraud-tianchi]]、[[claims-fraud-guardian]]、[[fraud-detection]]、[[insurance-anam]]、[[insurance-cv]]、[[ins-mmbench]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可情形**：**GitHub API 许可字段实测为 `NONE`**，**根目录实测无许可文件**（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 **404**）；**而 README 末节逐字为「## Licence — MIT — see `LICENSE`.」**——**即声称 MIT 并指向一个不存在的文件**。**本词条明确记录这一**声明与实际不一致**的情况**（**⚠️ 这与第 330 轮 [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、本轮 [[insurers-101]] 与 [[insurerisk]] 属同一类，**本轮四条中有三条如此****）；**使用、修改或再分发其代码前必须自行确认授权状况**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库根目录清单、README（8,502 字节）全文（含问题陈述、方法、Findings 及各节的逐字表述、八步流水线、仓库布局、运行方式、数据节、参考文献、致谢与许可声明）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 R 或其依赖、未运行 `00_run_all.R` 或任何一个脚本、**未取得、未构建、未运行 AIDA 与 TIX 的 C++ 二进制**、未读 `R/` 下任何脚本源码、未查看 `figures/` 或 `data/`、未读其学位论文****，因此**不能转述其 AIDA 与 TIX 的调用细节、特征构造的具体实现、参数设置或其论文结论**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **Findings 一节明确带有**占位符提示**（逐字「figures below are placeholders pending a final reconciliation pass — fill in from the thesis before publishing」），**且其中一处数值逐字写成待对账的二选一 `[0.27 / 0.29 — reconcile]`****——**本词条据此**不把该节任何数字当作结论**，**该节内容仅作为**作者的论证结构与解读方式**记录**；**具体数值须以论文定稿为准，****本次未读论文**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「AIDA 与 Isolation Forest 两种检测器结论几乎完全不一致」以及「AUC ≈ 0.46」等陈述**——**本次完全未运行**；**作者对「AUC 0.46 应解读为互补而非失败」的解释已被本词条如实记录为**作者的解释**，**本词条**不主张**该解释一定成立**（**0.46 字面上接近无区分度**）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其八步流水线中「排除事后结果字段以防泄漏」与「保留快照修订史为特征」在实际实现中是否如其所述**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「缺失本身携带信号」这一发现的稳健性**（**缺失率与理赔流程本身相关，可能反映的是**案件处理路径**而非欺诈风险**；**此为本词条的提示性判断，非作者自述**）；**⑦ ⭐ **未核实** `data/` 目录中实际含有何种内容**（**README 称未提交任何数据文件与派生导出，**本词条**不主张**该目录为空或其他**——**本次未列出其内容**）；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实**其与「一家亚洲车险公司」及那家精算咨询公司的合作关系的具体情况**（**README 未披露机构名称，**本词条**不主张**可核实**）；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **欺诈检测在多数辖区涉及**对个人的自动化判断与相应的程序与合规要求****；**本词条**不主张**该流水线在任何辖区可用于实际的调查决策、理赔处理或对个人的不利行动**（**其自身定位是给理赔人员提供**待查线索**，**而非结论**）；**⑩ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建与推送同日**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其方法优越性或已被采用**；**⑪ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑫ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/aay-shar/aida-tix-anomaly-detection`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 8,502 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对，含问题陈述、弱标签基准与「一致与不一致而非准确率」两句、Findings 占位符提示、八步流水线、数据节免责句、参考文献与许可声明）；`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404；**未克隆、未运行、未构建其 C++ 二进制、未读其论文**。

**aida-tix-anomaly-detection** 是一個**在 R 中搭建的無監督車險理賠異常檢測流水線**（倉庫 `aay-shar/aida-tix-anomaly-detection`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 R、體量 273 KB、創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-07**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**⚠️ 根目錄**沒有許可文件**（`LICENSE` 於 main 分支實測 404），**而 README 末節卻逐字寫著「## Licence — MIT — see `LICENSE`.」****；**無 topics**；**README 實測 8,502 位元組**。本條目屬本輪主題**「說清楚什麼算它是對的」**中的**第二種，也是把「這套檢驗能證明什麼」寫得最精確的一種**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫根目錄實測**）：**標題逐字「Explainable Anomaly Detection for Motor Insurance Claims」**，**副題逐字「An unsupervised pipeline that ranks motor insurance claims by how unusual they are, and explains each ranking at the level of individual features — **without any labelled fraud data**.」**；**來歷逐字**：**「Built in R as an **MSc thesis project (Applied Data Science, Utrecht University)**, in collaboration with **an actuarial consultancy working with a motor insurer in Asia**.」**。**根目錄實測**：**`.gitignore`、`R/`、`README.md`（8,502）、`config_example.R`（180）、`data/`、`figures/`**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「把規則引擎排除在特徵矩陣之外、只當弱標籤基準」是最重要也最值得學的一處**——**逐字**：**「The insurer’s existing rule engine is the only external signal available, so it serves as a **weak-label benchmark** — and **is deliberately held out of the model entirely. The rules table is never joined into the feature matrix.** This matters: **if the model can see which rules fired, "does the model agree with the rules" stops being a question worth asking.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **這是本會話見到對**評估洩漏**講得最清楚的一段**：**把評估基準餵進模型，會讓評估退化為同義反覆**（可與第 330 輪 [[catrisk-sim]]、第 329 輪 [[insurance-tabular-review]] 並讀）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「該基準衡量的是**一致與不一致**而非準確率」是第二處精確表述**——**逐字**：**「A rule firing is **not ground truth either** — it doesn’t prove fraud, and fraud can occur with no rule firing — so the benchmark measures ***agreement and disagreement*, not accuracy**.」**⭐⭐ **這句話直接拆掉了**「用規則標籤訓練並報告 AUC」這一常見做法的正當性****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **問題陳述把「為何不能用監督學習」講成具體的資料事實**——**逐字**：**「Insurers investigating irregular claims usually rely on a **rule engine**: a fixed set of thresholds written by domain experts. Rules are transparent and cheap to run, but **they only catch what someone thought to write down**, and they say nothing about claims that are strange in ways nobody anticipated.」**，**並接**：**「The obvious alternative is supervised learning — except that **requires labels, and confirmed-fraud labels barely exist**. … **a claim that was never investigated isn’t a negative example. Any model trained on that data learns which claims got looked at, not which claims were fraudulent.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **最後一句是選擇偏差在欺詐建模中的經典陷阱**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「沒有解釋的分數不可執行」**——**逐字「**A score with no explanation is not actionable — nobody opens an investigation because a number was high.**」**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **Findings 一節留著**未對賬的佔位符****——**逐字**：**「> **Note:** figures below are **placeholders pending a final reconciliation pass** — fill in from the thesis before publishing.」**，**相關一處逐字**：**「ρ ≈ `[0.27 / 0.29 — reconcile]`」**⭐⭐⭐ **即 README 尚處草稿狀態，部分數值明確標註為待填、且有一個值寫成待對賬的二選一**——**本詞條據此**不把該節任何數字當作結論****（**⚠️ 這是本會話首次遇到作者把「此處數值未定」直接留在公開 README 裡**，**與第 328 輪 [[creance]]、第 330 輪 [[actuary-os]] 同屬**把未完成狀態寫在明面上****）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **三項發現即便在佔位狀態下論證結構也完整，且都指向「不要把它當權威」**：(a)「兩種檢測器幾乎完全不一致」，**逐字含「only one claim appears in both methods’ top 100」，並解釋為「**This is a property of the algorithm family, not a defect**」，結論逐字「**a single unsupervised detector should not be treated as authoritative**」**；(b)「AIDA 與規則引擎相互獨立而非其替代」，**逐字含「AUC against the held-out rules is ≈ 0.46 — **essentially no separation** — and **28 of AIDA’s top 100 claims fired no rule at all**」，解讀逐字「**Read as accuracy that looks like failure. Read correctly, it’s the point**」**⭐⭐ **這是一處**主動把不利指標解釋成預期結果**的寫法**（**⚠️ 不主張**該解讀一定成立**——**0.46 字面上接近無區分度**）；(c)「缺失本身攜帶信號」，**逐字含 TIX 歸因拆分「roughly **60% to one-hot categoricals, 26% to missingness indicator flags, and 13% to numeric features**」**（**⚠️ 同屬待對賬佔位數值**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **八步流水線逐字**：①載入與清洗（哨兵值 `""`／`"NA"`／`"NULL"`／`"?"` 轉真 `NA` 以便缺失可被度量）；②篩選（僅最新流程階段、僅車險，**收斂多快照到最新而保留修訂史為工程特徵**）；③**按策略丟棄**（直接標識符、自由文本，以及**會洩漏模型本應看不到的結案資訊的事後結果欄位，如理賠狀態與已付金額**）；④聚合子表；⑤構造特徵（**報案延遲、進入保單天數、臨近保單起止的理賠、出險時車齡、估損修訂比**）；⑥**編碼缺失**；⑦構造矩陣（**金額取對數、穩健中位數／IQR 縮放、低基數獨熱、超過 25 水平用頻率編碼、稀有水平合併**）；⑧打分與解釋**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **每個特徵帶一條 manifest 記錄****——**逐字「Every feature carries a **manifest entry** … **which is what makes the TIX attribution breakdown above possible**.」**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **資料與可運行性的交代極為誠實**——**逐字「The claims data is **proprietary and is not included** … **No data file, no derived export, and no per-claim output is committed. The country and the insurer are not identified.** … **The code is published to show the method and the engineering; it will not run without access to the underlying data.**」**⭐⭐ **明確寫出「外部人跑不起來」，比靜默缺失資料有用得多**（可與第 330 輪 [[catrisk-sim]]、第 325 輪 [[parametric-risk-toolkit]] 並讀）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **AIDA 與 TIX 明確聲明未隨倉庫分發**（「**AIDA and TIX are not redistributed here.**」並給 `g++` 構建命令）**，`R/00_run_all.R` 逐字標註**兩處為外部二進制而暫停**。**⑪ ⭐ 參考文獻逐字**：**Souto Arias, L. A., Oosterlee, C. W., & Cirillo, P. (2023). AIDA: Analytic isolation and distance-based anomaly detection algorithm. Pattern Recognition, 141, 109607.**；**致謝逐字含 Dr. Georg Krempl (Utrecht University)**。**⑫ ⭐ Isolation Forest 基線刻意設 `ndim = 1`**，**逐字解釋為「so the comparison is against **classic axis-parallel isolation** rather than an oblique variant」**。**⑬ ⭐ 可與 [[explainable-ai-fraud]]、[[ifraudsimulator]]、[[networkfraud]]、[[insurance-conformal-fraud]]、[[medical-insurance-fraud-tianchi]]、[[claims-fraud-guardian]]、[[insurance-anam]]、[[insurance-cv]]、[[ins-mmbench]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 許可情形**：**GitHub API 許可欄位實測 `NONE`**，**根目錄實測無許可文件**（`LICENSE` 於 main 實測 **404**）；**而 README 末節逐字「## Licence — MIT — see `LICENSE`.」**——**即聲稱 MIT 並指向一個不存在的文件**（**⚠️ 與第 330 輪 [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、本輪 [[insurers-101]] 與 [[insurerisk]] 屬同一類，**本輪四條中有三條如此****）；**使用、修改或再分發其代碼前必須自行確認授權**；**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、根目錄清單、README 全文（含問題陳述、方法、Findings、八步流水線、倉庫佈局、運行方式、資料節、參考文獻、致謝與許可聲明）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安裝 R 或其依賴、未運行 `00_run_all.R` 或任何腳本、**未取得、未構建、未運行 AIDA 與 TIX 的 C++ 二進制**、未讀 `R/` 下任何源碼、未查看 `figures/` 或 `data/`、未讀其學位論文****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **Findings 一節明確帶有**佔位符提示**，且其中一處數值逐字寫成待對賬的二選一 `[0.27 / 0.29 — reconcile]`****——**本詞條據此**不把該節任何數字當作結論****，**該節內容僅作為**作者的論證結構與解讀方式**記錄**；**具體數值須以論文定稿為準，本次未讀論文**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**「兩種檢測器結論幾乎完全不一致」及「AUC ≈ 0.46」等陳述**——**本次完全未運行**；**作者對「AUC 0.46 應解讀為互補而非失敗」的解釋已如實記錄為**作者的解釋****，**不主張**該解釋一定成立**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其「排除事後結果欄位以防洩漏」與「保留快照修訂史為特徵」在實現中是否如其所述**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核實**「缺失本身攜帶信號」這一發現的穩健性**（**缺失率與理賠流程本身相關，可能反映的是**案件處理路徑**而非欺詐風險**；**此為本詞條的提示性判斷，非作者自述**）；**⑦ ⭐ **未核實** `data/` 目錄實際含何種內容**（**未列出其內容**）；**⑧ ⭐ **未核實**其與「一家亞洲車險公司」及那家精算諮詢公司合作關係的具體情況**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **欺詐檢測在多数轄區涉及**對個人的自動化判斷與相應的程序與合規要求****，**不主張**該流水線在任何轄區可用於實際的調查決策、理賠處理或對個人的不利行動**；**⑩ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、創建與推送同日**，**不主張其方法優越性或已被採用**；**⑪ ⭐ 無 topics**；**⑫ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/aay-shar/aida-tix-anomaly-detection`、`/readme` 與 `/contents/` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 8,502 位元組經 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 實測逐字核對；`LICENSE` 於 main 分支實測 404；**未克隆、未運行、未構建其 C++ 二進制、未讀其論文**。
entries.body_en:
**aida-tix-anomaly-detection** is **an unsupervised motor-claim anomaly detection pipeline built in R** (repository `aay-shar/aida-tix-anomaly-detection`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, R as the primary language, a 273 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-07** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository has no licence file at the root (`LICENSE` measured 404 on main), yet its README closes with the verbatim line "## Licence — MIT — see `LICENSE`."** (**see note ① below**); it has **no topics**; **the README measures 8,502 bytes**. It is the second of this round’s four takes on **stating what would count as evidence that it is right**, **and the one that states most precisely what its check does and does not establish**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README and the repository root**): **the README title reads verbatim "Explainable Anomaly Detection for Motor Insurance Claims"**, **with the subtitle reading verbatim "An unsupervised pipeline that ranks motor insurance claims by how unusual they are, and explains each ranking at the level of individual features — without any labelled fraud data."**; **its provenance reads verbatim**: **"Built in R as an MSc thesis project (Applied Data Science, Utrecht University), in collaboration with an actuarial consultancy working with a motor insurer in Asia."** **The root measurably contains** **`.gitignore`, `R/`, `README.md` (8,502 bytes), `config_example.R` (180 bytes), `data/` and `figures/`**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Holding the rule engine out of the feature matrix and using it only as a weak-label benchmark is the entry’s most important and most instructive point** — verbatim: **"The insurer’s existing rule engine is the only external signal available, so it serves as a weak-label benchmark — and is deliberately held out of the model entirely. The rules table is never joined into the feature matrix. This matters: if the model can see which rules fired, \"does the model agree with the rules\" stops being a question worth asking."** ⭐⭐⭐ **This is the clearest statement of evaluation leakage this session has seen: feeding the benchmark into the model degrades the evaluation into a tautology** (**readable with round 330’s [[catrisk-sim]] and round 329’s [[insurance-tabular-review]]**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ That the benchmark measures agreement and disagreement rather than accuracy is its second precise formulation** — verbatim: **"A rule firing is not ground truth either — it doesn’t prove fraud, and fraud can occur with no rule firing — so the benchmark measures agreement and disagreement, not accuracy."** ⭐⭐ **For a student building a fraud model, that sentence removes the justification for the common practice of training on rule labels and reporting AUC.** **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its problem statement turns "why supervised learning is not available" into a concrete data fact rather than a general remark** — verbatim: **"Insurers investigating irregular claims usually rely on a rule engine: a fixed set of thresholds written by domain experts. Rules are transparent and cheap to run, but they only catch what someone thought to write down, and they say nothing about claims that are strange in ways nobody anticipated."**, **followed by**: **"The obvious alternative is supervised learning — except that requires labels, and confirmed-fraud labels barely exist. Investigations are expensive, most claims are never examined, and a claim that was never investigated isn’t a negative example. Any model trained on that data learns which claims got looked at, not which claims were fraudulent."** ⭐⭐⭐ **That last sentence is the classic selection-bias trap in fraud modelling, stated very cleanly** (**readable with [[explainable-ai-fraud]], [[ifraudsimulator]], [[networkfraud]], [[insurance-conformal-fraud]] and [[medical-insurance-fraud-tianchi]]**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ "A score with no explanation is not actionable" is the entry’s practical argument for explainability** — verbatim: **"produce a reason for each ranking specific enough that an adjuster can act on it. A score with no explanation is not actionable — nobody opens an investigation because a number was high."** **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Its Findings section still carries unreconciled placeholders — a point this entry must state plainly** — verbatim: **"> Note: figures below are placeholders pending a final reconciliation pass — fill in from the thesis before publishing. See \"Open items\" at the bottom."**, **with one value reading verbatim as "ρ ≈ `[0.27 / 0.29 — reconcile]`"** — ⭐⭐⭐ **so the README is explicitly in draft state, some figures are marked pending and one is written as an unresolved choice of two**; **the entry therefore does not treat any figure in that section as a conclusion** (**⚠️ this is the first time this session has seen an author leave "this number is not settled yet" in a public README — the same instinct as round 328’s [[creance]] and round 330’s [[actuary-os]], but taken down to an individual value**). **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ Its three findings have a complete argument structure even in placeholder state, and all three point away from treating it as authoritative**: (a) **"The two detectors disagree almost completely"** — verbatim that **only one claim appears in both methods’ top 100**, explained verbatim as **"This is a property of the algorithm family, not a defect"**, concluding verbatim that **"a single unsupervised detector should not be treated as authoritative"**; (b) **AIDA is independent of the rule engine rather than a replacement** — verbatim that **AUC against the held-out rules is ≈ 0.46, "essentially no separation"**, and that **28 of AIDA’s top 100 claims fired no rule at all**, read verbatim as **"Read as accuracy that looks like failure. Read correctly, it’s the point"** ⭐⭐ **a case of actively interpreting an unfavourable metric as the expected result** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim that reading must hold — 0.46 is literally close to no discrimination**); (c) **"Missingness carries signal"** — verbatim that TIX attribution splits **"roughly 60% to one-hot categoricals, 26% to missingness indicator flags, and 13% to numeric features"** (**⚠️ likewise a placeholder figure pending reconciliation**). **⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ Its eight-step pipeline reads verbatim, several steps being professional practice**: **① load and clean** (sentinel values `""`, `"NA"`, `"NULL"`, `"?"` converted to real `NA` **so missingness is measurable**); **② filter** (latest workflow stage only, car claims only, **collapsing multiple snapshots per case to the most recent while retaining the revision history as engineered features rather than discarding it**); **③ drop by policy** (direct identifiers, free text, and **post-hoc outcome fields such as claim status and amounts paid that would leak the resolution the model is supposed to be blind to**); **④ aggregate children** (parts price discrepancies, labour totals, prior-claim counts and recency); **⑤ engineer features** (**reporting delay, days into policy, claims near policy start or end, vehicle age at loss, estimate revision ratios**); **⑥ encode missingness**; **⑦ build the matrix** (**log transform on monetary fields, robust median/IQR scaling, one-hot for low-cardinality categoricals, frequency encoding above 25 levels, rare levels collapsed**); **⑧ score and explain**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ Every feature carries a manifest entry, which is what makes the TIX breakdown possible** — verbatim: **"Every feature carries a manifest entry recording whether it came from a numeric field, a one-hot level, a frequency encoding, or a missingness flag — which is what makes the TIX attribution breakdown above possible."** **⑨ ⭐⭐ Its handling of data and runnability is unusually honest, the entry’s most notable point on reproducibility** — verbatim: **"The claims data is proprietary and is not included in this repository. No data file, no derived export, and no per-claim output is committed. The country and the insurer are not identified. `config.R`, which holds local paths, is gitignored. The code is published to show the method and the engineering; it will not run without access to the underlying data."** ⭐⭐ **Stating outright that outsiders cannot run it is far more useful than silently omitting the data** (**readable with round 330’s [[catrisk-sim]] and round 325’s [[parametric-risk-toolkit]] — three different answers to the same problem of undisclosable data**). **⑩ ⭐⭐ AIDA and TIX are explicitly stated not to be redistributed** — verbatim **"AIDA and TIX are not redistributed here."** with `g++` build commands — **and `R/00_run_all.R` marks verbatim the two points where the pipeline pauses for the external binaries**. **⑪ ⭐ Its reference reads verbatim**: **Souto Arias, L. A., Oosterlee, C. W., & Cirillo, P. (2023). AIDA: Analytic isolation and distance-based anomaly detection algorithm. Pattern Recognition, 141, 109607.**; **and the acknowledgements name Dr. Georg Krempl (Utrecht University)**. **⑫ ⭐ The Isolation Forest baseline is deliberately configured with `ndim = 1`**, **explained verbatim as "so the comparison is against classic axis-parallel isolation rather than an oblique variant"**. **⑬ ⭐ Readable with the site’s fraud and anomaly detection entries**: [[explainable-ai-fraud]], [[ifraudsimulator]], [[networkfraud]], [[insurance-conformal-fraud]], [[medical-insurance-fraud-tianchi]], [[claims-fraud-guardian]], [[insurance-anam]], [[insurance-cv]] and [[ins-mmbench]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Licence situation**: **the GitHub API licence field measurably reads `NONE`** and **the root listing contains no licence file** (`LICENSE` measured **404** on main), **while the README’s closing section reads verbatim "## Licence — MIT — see `LICENSE`."** — **a claim of MIT pointing at a file that does not exist**; **the entry records this mismatch explicitly** (**⚠️ the same class as round 330’s [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]] and this round’s [[insurers-101]] and [[insurerisk]] — three of this round’s four**); **authorisation must be confirmed before using, modifying or redistributing the code**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, the root listing, and the README’s full 8,502 bytes including its problem statement, approach, Findings, eight-step pipeline, repository layout, running instructions, data section, reference, acknowledgements and licence line**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install R or its dependencies, run `00_run_all.R` or any script, obtain, build or run the AIDA and TIX C++ binaries, read any script under `R/`, inspect `figures/` or `data/`, or read the thesis**, so **its AIDA and TIX invocation details, the concrete implementation of feature construction, its parameter settings and its thesis conclusions cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its Findings section carries an explicit placeholder notice, and one value is written verbatim as an unresolved choice `[0.27 / 0.29 — reconcile]`** — **so the entry treats no figure in that section as a conclusion**, **recording that section only as the author’s argument structure and interpretation**; **the figures must await the final thesis, which was not read**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ The claims that the two detectors disagree almost completely and that AUC is ≈ 0.46 were not verified** — **nothing was run**; **the author’s reading that AUC 0.46 should be understood as complementarity rather than failure is recorded faithfully as the author’s reading, and the entry does not claim it must hold (0.46 is literally close to no discrimination)**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether the pipeline’s "drop post-hoc outcome fields to prevent leakage" and "keep snapshot revision history as features" steps are implemented as described was not verified**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ The robustness of the finding that missingness carries signal was not verified** (**missingness rates correlate with claims handling itself and may reflect case routing rather than fraud risk; this is the entry’s cautionary judgement, not the author’s**); **⑦ ⭐ What `data/` actually contains was not verified** (**the README says no data file or derived export is committed; the entry does not claim the directory is empty or otherwise — its contents were not listed**); **⑧ ⭐ The collaboration with an Asian motor insurer and an actuarial consultancy was not verified** (**the README discloses no organisation names, and the entry claims none is checkable**); **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ Fraud detection engages automated judgement about individuals and the associated procedural and compliance requirements in most jurisdictions**; **the entry does not claim the pipeline is usable in any jurisdiction for real investigation decisions, claims handling or adverse action against individuals** (**its own framing is to give adjusters leads, not conclusions**); **⑩ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created and pushed the same day**, **attention is very low**, **so no methodological superiority or adoption is claimed**; **⑪ ⭐ No topics**; **⑫ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/aay-shar/aida-tix-anomaly-detection`, `/readme` and `/contents/` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 8,502-byte README read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, including the problem statement, the weak-label-benchmark and "agreement and disagreement, not accuracy" sentences, the Findings placeholder notice, the eight-step pipeline, the data disclaimer, the reference and the licence line); `LICENSE` measured 404 on main; **nothing cloned or run, its C++ binaries not built, and the thesis not read**.

entries.title_hk: ClaimOps：把「確定性優先於 LLM」寫成偏好序，並列出絕不交給模型的八件事
entries.summary: 一个受治理的健康险报销受理与例外调查系统：Go 是权威后端（边界、生命周期、校验、租户与审计），Python 只是有界的认知服务；其「常设规则」写明了实现的偏好序——确定性 > 结构化 > 规则 > 检索 > LLM，并逐项列出绝不交给 LLM 的八类事务；另有一条绝对规则：AI 永远不做批准、拒绝或付款
entries.summary_hk: 一個受治理的健康險報銷受理與例外調查系統：Go 是權威後端（邊界、生命周期、校驗、租戶與審計），Python 只是有界的認知服務；其「常設規則」寫明了實現的偏好序——確定性 > 結構化 > 規則 > 檢索 > LLM，並逐項列出絕不交給 LLM 的八類事務；另有一條絕對規則：AI 永遠不做批准、拒絕或付款
entries.summary_en: A governed health-insurance reimbursement intake and exception investigation system: Go is the authoritative back end (edge, lifecycle, validation, tenancy, audit) while Python is only a bounded cognitive service; its "standing rules" state a preference ordering for implementation — deterministic > structured > rules > retrieval > LLM — and enumerate eight classes of transaction never given to an LLM, plus an absolute rule that AI never approves, denies or pays
entries.body:
**ClaimOps**（自述名 **ClaimOps AI**）是一个**受治理的健康险报销受理与例外调查系统**（仓库 `Aparnap2/Claim_Ops`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Go、仓库体量 779 KB、创建于 2026-09-06、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）**，**且其 README 全文**未作任何许可声明****（**与同轮另三条**声称许可而无许可文件**的情形不同**——**本条是**沉默**，**详见下方标注 ①**）；**无 topics**；**README 实测 3,554 字节**。本条目属于本轮主题**「说清楚什么算它是对的」**中的**第三种，也是把「什么不允许发生」写成硬规则最彻底的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**README 标题逐字为「ClaimOps AI」**，**副标题逐字为**：**「Governed health-insurance **reimbursement** intake + exception investigation. **Deterministic systems first; LLM only where semantic reasoning is required.**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **其「Scope lock（范围锁定）」一节逐字实测，是本条目最有价值的一段**：**「Product: ClaimOps AI (**not ClaimLens, not OpsCore, no rename churn**)」**；**「Workflow: reimbursement intake → deterministic verification → AI investigation → HITL → governed action → audit」**；**「**Go is the authoritative backend** (edge, lifecycle, validation, tenancy, audit). Python is the **bounded cognitive service** + specification artifacts (ADR-001).」**；**「**Agent count: 1 Investigation Agent (Phase 6). No APPROVE/DENY/PAY by AI, ever.**」**；**「LLM provider: Groq (`openai/gpt-oss-20b`, Qwen for specialist calls), **key via environment only**, **stub-until-key discipline** (ADR-002).」**。**根目录实测**：**`.env.example`（171 字节）、`.gitignore`（119 字节）、`Makefile`（5,340 字节）、`README.md`（3,554 字节）、`apps/`、`docs/`、`fixtures/`、`infra/`、`migrations/`、`mocks/`、`packages/`、**`prd.md`（54,996 字节）**、`pyproject.toml`（1,040 字节）、`tests/`、`tools/`、`uv.lock`（183,737 字节）**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「常设规则」里的偏好序是本条目最重要的一句，也是本会话见到对「什么时候才轮到模型」最清晰的表述**——**逐字为**：**「**Deterministic > structured > rules > retrieval > LLM.** **No LLM for arithmetic, state, auth, money, policy, mutation, retry, idempotency.**」**——**即「**确定性 > 结构化 > 规则 > 检索 > LLM**」这一**实现选择的偏好序**，**外加一份**禁止清单**：**算术、状态、认证、金钱、保单、变更、重试、幂等**——**这八类事**不交给 LLM****。⭐⭐⭐ **这与本站前两轮反复出现的同一条判断接上了，且把尺度推到了最明确的一端**：**第 329 轮 [[insurance-tabular-review]] 按**列型**切分（`calculate` 由应用程序计算）、第 329 轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 按**顺序**切分（正则优先、LLM 兜底）、第 330 轮 [[actuary-os]] 按**架构**切分（deterministic analytics 与 agents 并列）、而本条把它写成了**偏好序＋禁止清单****；**对做 AI 进保险流程的学生，这是一份可以直接抄进设计文档的规则**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该偏好序在所有场景都正确**——**例如纯语义任务确实无法用规则替代**；**README 自身即把 LLM 限定在「需要语义推理之处」**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「No APPROVE/DENY/PAY by AI, ever.」是一条**带 `ever` 的绝对禁令****——**即**批准、拒绝与付款**三种动作**任何情况下都不由 AI 执行****。⭐⭐ **比「人类在环」这类口号具体得多**：**它把**不可委托的动作**点名了****（**可与第 330 轮同批 [[claim-to-confidence]] 的「the authority matrix the backend enforces」与「a negative test (**agent identity denied**)」并读——**两者都在处理**谁有权让钱动****；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该禁令在实现中确实无法绕过**——**本次未读源码**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「Go 是权威后端、Python 只是有界认知服务」这一技术选型把**职责边界写进了语言边界****——**逐字为**：**「**Go is the authoritative backend** (edge, lifecycle, validation, tenancy, audit). Python is the **bounded cognitive service** + specification artifacts」**。⭐⭐ **把**权威性**放在 Go 一侧、把**概率性**放在 Python 一侧**，**意味着即使模型出错，也**不能直接改变权威状态****；**而 `packages/domain/` 逐字为「Python specification artifacts (**Pydantic strict**)」**——**即规格本身也用严格校验的类型表达**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该边界在实现中确实成立**——**本次未读 `apps/api/` 任何源码**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「fixtures/golden_cases.json — language-independent behavior contract」是本条目在可检验性上最值得记的一处**——**逐字实测**：**`fixtures/` 下为 `golden_cases.json`，自述为**「**language-independent behavior contract**（**与语言无关的行为契约**）」****。⭐⭐ **这一句解决了本会话反复出现的一个问题**：**当同一业务逻辑被两种语言实现（此处 Go 权威实现、Python 规格实现）时，**用什么保证两者一致****——**答案是**一组与实现语言无关的黄金用例**（**可与第 329 轮 [[insurance-tabular-review]] 的「Tests will fail if a template loses its row grain…」并读**——**两者都在把**规格**做成**测试可强制的对象****）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **「Every bug → fixture + test + failure classification」是一条把缺陷处理流程化的常设规则**——**逐字为**：**「Every bug → **fixture + test + failure classification**.」**——**即**每一个缺陷都要变成一条用例、一个测试与一次失效归类****。⭐⭐ **「失效归类（failure classification）」这一步尤其值得注意**：**多数团队修完就算，而分类意味着**要知道这类错误属于哪一类**，**从而可能在同类问题再发生前拦住它****（**可与第 328 轮 [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 的「验证中发现并修复的程序缺陷」并读**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **「Postgres RLS 强制 ＋ 事务本地租户上下文」是本条目在数据隔离上最具体的一处**——**逐字为**：**「Every entity carries `tenant_id`; RLS enforced in Postgres (**FORCE**), **transaction-local `set_config` on pooled connections**.」**；**根目录实测含 `infra/postgres/` 与 `migrations/`，并逐字列出**「migrations 001 (schema+RLS) 002 (grants) 003 (evidence)」****。⭐⭐ **「在连接池上使用**事务本地**的 `set_config`」是一个具体的实现细节**：**如果租户上下文是连接级的，池化复用会导致**上下文泄漏到下一个请求****；**用事务本地设置正是针对这一点**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其 RLS 配置无遗漏**——**本次未读 migrations**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **「Phase progression (one reviewable PR each)」逐字实测**：**✅ PR #1 repo foundation｜✅ #2 Go system edge｜✅ #3 deterministic domain core｜✅ #4 LLM provider decision｜✅ #6 Postgres + RLS tenant isolation｜⏳ #7 external contracts + Mockoon (this branch)**；**并列出 Next：document ingestion → deterministic extraction → exception corpus → cognitive investigation agent → HITL → evals**。⭐ **注意其编号**：**列表中没有 PR #5**，**且 #7 自述为「this branch」**——**这是一份**正在进行中**的进度表**，**作者把未完成的部分如实标为 ⏳ 而非完成态**（**可与第 328 轮 [[creance]]、第 330 轮 [[actuary-os]]、同轮 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的占位符并读**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **其余常设规则逐字**：**「Atomic commits; **no direct-to-main**; **docs live with the change**.」**——**即**原子提交、不直接推主干、文档随改动同行****；**以及逐字「Local services (**one at a time, never compose for dev**)」**——**即本地服务逐个启动、开发时不用 compose**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **测试与外部依赖的安排逐字实测且具体**：**「Python spec suite (**no network**)」跑 `uv run ruff check .` 与 `uv run pytest tests/ -q`**；**Go 侧 `go build ./... && go test ./...`**；**Postgres 集成测试需要实活数据库**（逐字给出 `TEST_POSTGRES_DSN=postgres://…` 与 `-count=1`）；**外部契约测试需要 Mockoon**（逐字 `go test ./internal/adapters/http/ -count=1`）**。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **`mocks/mockoon/claims-systems.json` 自述为「4 systems × 7 scenarios」**——**即外部系统被建模为 4 个系统 × 7 个场景**；**而 `internal/validation/` 逐字为「**six pure validators (stdlib-only)**」**、`internal/claims/` 逐字为「Claim aggregate + state machine (**stdlib-only**)」**——⭐⭐ **「纯校验器」与「只用标准库」两处措辞说明**外部依赖被刻意限制在核心逻辑之外****。**⑪ ⭐⭐ **README 未写许可，但**仓库内含一份 54,996 字节的 `prd.md`****——**即其**产品需求文档比 README 大 15 倍****（**与本会话第 330 轮 [[actuary-os]]「README 薄、规格厚」同型，且本条另有一份 5,340 字节的 `Makefile`**）（**⚠️ `prd.md` 本次未读**）。**⑫ ⭐ **ADR 目录逐字含**「001 go-first, 002 groq provider, **004 external boundary**」**——**即架构决策有编号记录**（**⚠️ 注意列表中未提 003**；**本次未读 ADR 正文**）。**⑬ ⭐ 可与本站治理与理赔流程条目并读**：[[claim-to-confidence]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[claims-api]]、[[claims-intake-agent]]、[[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]、[[claims-processing-hack]]、[[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]]、[[payer-agent-audit]]、[[governance-mcp]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可情形**：**该仓库实测无任何许可文件**（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 **404**），**且 README 全文**不含任何许可声明****。**本词条明确记录：未声明许可即意味着**默认保留全部权利**，**在使用、修改或再分发其代码前必须自行确认授权状况**。⭐⭐ **本条与同轮另三条的情形不同**：**[[insurerisk]]、[[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]]、[[insurers-101]] 是**声称许可而无许可文件**（声明与实际不一致）**，**本条是**完全没有声明****——**两种情形后果不同：前者可依声明推断意图但无从取得许可正文，后者连意图都无从判断**（**本轮四条中**三条声称而无文件、一条完全沉默****，**详见本轮日志**）；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库根目录清单、README（3,554 字节）全文**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 Go／Python 依赖、未运行 `make` 任何目标、未执行任何测试（含 golden 用例与 Postgres／Mockoon 集成测试）、**未读 `prd.md`（54,996 字节）任何内容**、未读 `apps/`／`packages/`／`tests/`／`docs/`／`fixtures/`／`infra/`／`mocks/` 下任何文件、未读 `Makefile`（5,340 字节）与 `pyproject.toml`、未读任何 ADR****，因此**不能转述其状态机、六个校验器的实际规则、golden 用例的内容、API 形状、数据模型或 Mockoon 场景**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「Deterministic > structured > rules > retrieval > LLM」这一偏好序与那张**禁止清单**在实现中是否真的被遵守**——**本词条只核实到它们被写进 README 的常设规则**；**实现是否真的把算术、状态、认证、金钱、保单、变更、重试与幂等排除在模型之外，本次无法判断**；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「No APPROVE/DENY/PAY by AI, ever.」在实现中是否确实无法绕过**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实** `fixtures/golden_cases.json` 确实存在且内容与「与语言无关的行为契约」这一描述相符**（**根目录实测存在 `fixtures/` 目录，**但其内文件本次未列出**）；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实** Postgres RLS 的强制配置（`FORCE` 与事务本地 `set_config`）**——**本次未读 `migrations/` 与 `infra/postgres/`**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「1 Investigation Agent」的实际实现与其在 Phase 6 的状态**（**README 自述该 phase 尚未到达**）；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实** `prd.md`（54,996 字节）与 ADR 的实际内容**，**亦未核实**列表中缺失的 PR #5 与 ADR 003 的情况**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **该系统处理**健康险理赔与报销，涉及**个人健康与金融信息****；**README 提到 `tenant_id`、RLS 与审计，**但本次**未评估**其在数据保护（如健康信息的持有与传输）、跨境与合规方面的安排**；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ 理赔决定在多数辖区属**受监管的保险业务动作****；**其「AI 不做批准／拒绝／付款」的自我约束是对的**，**但**本词条**不主张**该系统可直接用于任何真实的理赔处理、报销受理或监管报送**；**⑪ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、主语言 Go**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑫ ⭐ README 仅 3,554 字节而无 topics**——**且其自述依赖的 PRD 与 ADR 均未在 README 中展开**，**可评估性因此受限**；**⑬ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Aparnap2/Claim_Ops`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 3,554 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对，含 Scope lock 五条、根目录布局、Phase progression、Requirements、Setup、测试命令与四条 Standing rules）；`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404；**未克隆、未安装、未运行任何测试、未读 `prd.md` 与任何源码**。
