entries.title: InsurMinds 挑战五：五个智能体里只有写消息那个用大模型，「该通知谁」交给业务规则智能体
entries.title_en: InsurMinds challenge five: only the message-writing agent uses an LLM, while "who to notify" is handled by a business-rules agent
entries.title_hk: InsurMinds 挑戰五：五個智能體裡只有寫訊息那個用大模型，「該通知誰」交給業務規則智能體
entries.summary: 一个葡萄牙语的气象预警触达原型：实时查询十个巴西城市（含沿海地区）的天气，识别强降雨、强风与冰雹风险风暴，按业务规则判定哪些险种与哪些投保人应被通知，再由大模型为每位受影响投保人生成个性化消息，并模拟发送；五个智能体里只有生成消息那个调用大模型，而「该通知谁」由独立且确定性的业务规则智能体决定
entries.summary_hk: 一個葡萄牙語的氣象預警觸達原型：實時查詢十個巴西城市（含沿海地區）的天氣，識別強降雨、強風與冰雹風險風暴，按業務規則判定哪些險種與哪些投保人應被通知，再由大模型為每位受影響投保人生成個性化訊息，並模擬發送；五個智能體裡只有生成訊息那個調用大模型，而「該通知誰」由獨立且確定性的業務規則智能體決定
entries.summary_en: A Portuguese-language weather-warning outreach prototype: it queries live conditions for ten Brazilian cities including coastal regions, identifies heavy rain, strong wind and hail-risk storms, applies business rules to decide which lines of insurance and which policyholders should be notified, then has an LLM generate a personalised message per affected policyholder and simulates the send; of its five agents only the message generator calls an LLM, while "who to notify" is decided by a separate deterministic business-rules agent
entries.body:
**insurminds-desafio5** 是一个**葡萄牙语的气象预警触达原型**（仓库 `EDNARDOPPEIXOTO99/insurminds-desafio5-comunicacao-proativa`），**实测 MIT 许可（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 200）、★1、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 337 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-07**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**实测 topics 10 项**：**`agentes-inteligentes`、`google-gemini`、`i2a2`、`ia-generativa`、`insurtech`、`langchain`、`openweathermap`、`python`、**`seguros`**、`streamlit`**；**README 实测 4,518 字节（葡萄牙语）**。**已实测存在的关键文件**：**`src/rules_agent.py`、`data/segurados.csv`、`LICENSE`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「分开『我看到了什么』与『我因此断定什么』」**中的**第二种，也是本站首次收录**葡萄牙语**项目**（**此前多轮词条均以「是否有中文材料未核实」收尾；本条**语言即为葡萄牙语，**已如实记入**）。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：**标题逐字为「InsurMinds — Desafio 5 / **Ferramenta Inteligente para Comunicação Proativa com o Segurado**」**（**「与投保人主动沟通的智能工具」**），**作者团队逐字为「**Grupo InsurTech Minds**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **其定位逐字，是本条目最重要的一段**：**「Protótipo (MVP) que monitoriza condições meteorológicas em tempo real e gera comunicações automáticas e personalizadas para segurados, **antes que um sinistro ocorra** — **transformando o modelo reativo das seguradoras em uma abordagem preventiva**.」**——**即「一个监控实时气象条件、并在**理赔发生之前**为投保人生成自动且个性化沟通的原型（MVP）——**把保险公司的**被动反应模式**转变为**主动预防模式**」**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「五个智能体里只有生成消息那个用大模型」是本条目最重要的一点，也是本轮主题最清晰的分工样本**——**其多智能体架构逐字实测**：**① `ColetorClimaticoAgent`**（**按城市查询 OpenWeatherMap API**）；**② `AnalisadorEventosAgent`**（**识别相关事件：降雨／风／风暴**）；**③ `RegrasNegocioAgent`**（**决定哪些投保人应被通知**）；**④ `GeradorMensagemAgent`**（**通过大模型 Gemini 生成个性化消息**）；**⑤ `SimuladorEnvioAgent`**（**记录模拟发送，无真实集成**）。⭐⭐⭐ **即：**感知与判定全部由确定性智能体完成，大模型只负责**把已定好的决定写成一句人话****——**这与本站连续多轮出现的同一条判断一致**（**第 329 轮 [[insurance-tabular-review]] 按列型切分、同轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 正则优先、第 330 轮 [[actuary-os]] 按架构切分、第 331 轮 [[claim-ops]] 写成偏好序＋禁止清单、第 332 轮 [[paco-uw]] 把规则做成纯数据、第 332 轮 [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]] 把理算人路由留给规则引擎、本轮 [[claimlens]] 把成本与法律引用留给纯确定性规则**）；**本条的特点是**粒度最细**：**在同一个多智能体流程里，**恰好一个**智能体是生成式的****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「把保险公司的被动模式转成主动模式」是本条目在业务立意上最值得记的一点**——**它做的事是**在理赔发生之前**触达投保人****（**例如预报强降雨时提前通知住宅险投保人**）；⭐⭐ **对做保险创新的学生，这是一条**把保险从「事后赔付」向「事前减损」推移**的具体路径**——**而减损（loss mitigation）在精算上直接影响赔付频率**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该原型已量化任何减损效果**——**其输出为消息生成与模拟发送，README 未提及任何减损度量**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其业务规则表逐字实测，且是「事件 → 受影响险种」的显式映射**：**「Chuva intensa（强降雨）→ **Residencial（住宅险）**」；「Tempestade (risco de granizo)（风暴，含冰雹风险）→ **Automóvel e Residencial（车险与住宅险）**」；「Vento forte（强风）→ **Residencial」**。⭐⭐ **对做巨灾或天气险的学生，这张表把**气象事件类型**与**受影响的险种**直接连起来**——**即它是一个**简化但正确的「危险—暴露」映射****（**可与 [[catrisk-sim]]、[[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]]、[[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、[[open-meteo]]、[[gdacs]]、[[hurricaneguard]] 并读**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该映射完整或符合任何保险公司的实际条款**——**例如强风显然也可能影响车险，而表中只列住宅险**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **一条「这不是 bug」的预置说明，是本条目在文档质量上最值得记的一处**——**逐字为**：**「Como os dados climáticos são consultados **em tempo real**, os eventos disparados dependem do clima do dia em que você rodar a aplicação. **Se nenhuma das 10 cidades da base estiver com chuva/vento forte no momento, nenhuma notificação será gerada — isso é o comportamento correto do sistema, não um bug.** Para testar a geração de mensagens a qualquer momento, ajuste temporariamente os limiares no `.env` (`LIMIAR_CHUVA_MM`, `LIMIAR_VENTO_MS`) para valores bem baixos.」**——**即「由于气象数据是**实时**查询的，触发的事件取决于你运行当天天气。**若数据库中 10 个城市当前都没有强降雨／强风，则不会生成任何通知——**这是系统的正确行为，而不是 bug****。若想随时测试消息生成，可临时把 `.env` 中的阈值（`LIMIAR_CHUVA_MM`、`LIMIAR_VENTO_MS`）调到很低。」⭐⭐⭐ **对本会话而言，这一段的价值在于它**预先回答了最可能被误报为缺陷的现象****——**一个输出为空的演示通常会被当成失败**，**而作者把「空即正确」写在了前面，并给出**临时调低阈值**这条可复现的测试路径**（**可与第 331 轮 [[paco-uw]] 的「两种求值策略会分歧」、第 330 轮 [[catrisk-sim]] 的「synthetic and deliberately simplified」并读**——**三者都在**预先说明读者会看到什么、以及为什么那不是错误****）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **「无需为任何 API 付费」被写成了明确承诺**——**逐字为**：**「**Não é obrigatório pagar por nenhuma API.** Ambas as chaves acima têm camada gratuita **sem necessidade de cartão**.」**（**两个密钥都有免费额度且不需要信用卡**）；**其技术栈逐字为**：**Python 3.10+、Streamlit（界面）、requests（调用 OpenWeatherMap）、**LangChain + Google Gemini（免费）**，**并支持 Ollama（本地／免费）、Claude 与 GPT（付费）**、pandas（投保人数据）**。⭐⭐ **对资源有限的学生，这条承诺很有实际价值**——**它意味着一份作业可以在**零成本**下跑通**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其免费额度长期不变或足以支撑任何真实业务量**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **样例数据的规模与性质被逐字写清**——**「Observações」一节逐字为**：**「A base de segurados (`data/segurados.csv`) é **fictícia, criada para fins didáticos**, cobrindo **10 cidades brasileiras** (incluindo regiões costeiras) e **2 tipos de seguro** (Residencial e Automóvel), com **20 segurados no total**.」**、**「**Não há envio real de SMS/e-mail — apenas simulação**, conforme os requisitos do desafio.」**、**「**Chaves de API nunca devem ser commitadas — ficam apenas no `.env`** (no `.gitignore`).」**⭐⭐ **三点合起来构成一份**清楚的合成数据与密钥边界说明****（**20 名投保人、10 座城市、2 个险种**——**规模极小，**本词条据此**不主张**其可代表任何真实投保人群**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **团队成员表逐字实测，且是一支**跨职能学生团队****：**「Ednardo Pinheiro Peixoto — Representante e Engenheiro de IA/IoT/Tech Líder」**；**「**Glenda dos Santos Tavares — Atuária（精算师）**」**；**「Sueli Da Hora Moreira — Analytics Engineer」**；**「**Rafael Torres Lattaro Soares — Especialista em Seguros（保险专家）**」**。⭐⭐ **对做课程或竞赛项目的学生，这份名单本身就是一种**分工范本**：**精算、保险业务、数据工程与 AI 工程各有一人****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该分工在实践中一定有效**——**未获任何过程材料**）。**⑧ ⭐ **项目结构逐字实测**：`app.py`（**五个智能体的编排，Streamlit**）、`src/weather_agent.py`（**智能体 1 — 气象数据采集**）、`src/event_agent.py`（**智能体 2 — 事件识别**）、`src/rules_agent.py`（**智能体 3 — 业务规则**）、`src/message_agent.py`（**智能体 4 — 消息生成（LLM）**）、`src/notify_agent.py`（**智能体 5 — 发送模拟**）、`data/segurados.csv`、`requirements.txt`、`.env.example`、`README.md`**——⭐ **注意：README 自述「每个智能体是 `src/` 下的独立模块」**，**而其结构块把「哪个 agent 用 LLM」直接写在了文件名与注释里**（**`message_agent.py` 标注「(LLM)」**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站保险科技与天气风险条目并读**：[[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]、[[insurance-support-agent]]、[[adk-insurance-recommendation-agent]]、[[open-meteo]]、[[gdacs]]、[[hurricaneguard]]、[[physrisk]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[georisk-finder]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]。

**insurminds-desafio5** is **a Portuguese-language weather-warning outreach prototype** (repository `EDNARDOPPEIXOTO99/insurminds-desafio5-comunicacao-proativa`), with **measured MIT licence (`LICENSE` measured 200 on main), ★1, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 337 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-07** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **ten topics measurably present**: **`agentes-inteligentes`, `google-gemini`, `i2a2`, `ia-generativa`, `insurtech`, `langchain`, `openweathermap`, `python`, `seguros` and `streamlit`**; **the README measures 4,518 bytes and is in Portuguese**. **Key files measurably present**: **`src/rules_agent.py`, `data/segurados.csv` and `LICENSE`**. It is the second of this round’s four takes on **separating "what I observed" from "what I therefore conclude"**, **and it is the first Portuguese-language project collected here** (**earlier entries repeatedly closed with "whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified"; this one is in Portuguese, recorded as such**).

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): **the title reads verbatim "InsurMinds — Desafio 5 / Ferramenta Inteligente para Comunicação Proativa com o Segurado"** ("an intelligent tool for proactive communication with the insured"), **credited to "Grupo InsurTech Minds"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Its positioning, read verbatim, is the entry’s most important passage**: **"Protótipo (MVP) que monitoriza condições meteorológicas em tempo real e gera comunicações automáticas e personalizadas para segurados, antes que um sinistro ocorra — transformando o modelo reativo das seguradoras em uma abordagem preventiva."** — **an MVP that monitors weather in real time and generates automatic personalised communications to policyholders before a claim occurs, turning insurers’ reactive model into a preventive one**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ That only the message-writing agent of five uses an LLM is the entry’s most important point and this round’s clearest division-of-labour sample** — **its multi-agent architecture reads verbatim as**: **① `ColetorClimaticoAgent`** (queries the OpenWeatherMap API per city); **② `AnalisadorEventosAgent`** (identifies relevant events: rain, wind, storm); **③ `RegrasNegocioAgent`** (decides which policyholders should be notified); **④ `GeradorMensagemAgent`** (generates the personalised message via the Gemini LLM); **⑤ `SimuladorEnvioAgent`** (records a simulated send with no real integration). ⭐⭐⭐ **Perception and decision are entirely deterministic agents; the LLM only renders an already-made decision into a sentence a person can read** — **consistent with the judgement that recurs across this site** (**column kinds in round 329’s [[insurance-tabular-review]], regex-first in that round’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]], architecture in round 330’s [[actuary-os]], a preference ordering plus prohibition list in round 331’s [[claim-ops]], rules as pure data in round 332’s [[paco-uw]], adjuster routing left to a rule engine in that round’s [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]], and costing and legal citations left to pure deterministic rules in this round’s [[claimlens]]**); **what is distinctive here is the finest granularity: within one multi-agent pipeline, exactly one agent is generative**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Turning insurers’ reactive model into a preventive one is the entry’s most notable business idea** — **it reaches policyholders before a claim occurs** (**for instance notifying residential policyholders ahead of forecast heavy rain**); ⭐⭐ **for students of insurance innovation this is a concrete path from post-loss indemnity toward pre-loss mitigation — and mitigation directly affects claim frequency** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the prototype quantifies any mitigation effect — its output is message generation and a simulated send, and the README mentions no mitigation measurement**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its business-rules table reads verbatim and is an explicit event-to-line mapping**: **"Chuva intensa" (heavy rain) → residential**; **"Tempestade (risco de granizo)" (storm with hail risk) → motor and residential**; **"Vento forte" (strong wind) → residential**. ⭐⭐ **For students of catastrophe or weather risk, that table links weather event types directly to affected lines — a simplified but correct hazard-to-exposure mapping** (**readable with [[catrisk-sim]], [[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]], [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]], [[open-meteo]], [[gdacs]] and [[hurricaneguard]]**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim the mapping is complete or matches any insurer’s actual terms — strong wind plainly affects motor too, yet the table lists only residential**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ A pre-emptive "this is not a bug" note is the entry’s most notable documentation quality** — verbatim: **"Como os dados climáticos são consultados em tempo real, os eventos disparados dependem do clima do dia em que você rodar a aplicação. Se nenhuma das 10 cidades da base estiver com chuva/vento forte no momento, nenhuma notificação será gerada — isso é o comportamento correto do sistema, não um bug. Para testar a geração de mensagens a qualquer momento, ajuste temporariamente os limiares no `.env` (`LIMIAR_CHUVA_MM`, `LIMIAR_VENTO_MS`) para valores bem baixos."** ⭐⭐⭐ **A demo that produces no output is normally read as failure, whereas the author states up front that empty is correct and gives a reproducible test path by temporarily lowering the thresholds** (**readable with round 331’s [[paco-uw]] and round 330’s [[catrisk-sim]] — all three pre-announce what a reader will see and why it is not an error**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ "No API payment is required" is stated as a firm promise** — verbatim: **"Não é obrigatório pagar por nenhuma API. Ambas as chaves acima têm camada gratuita sem necessidade de cartão."**; **its stack reads verbatim as Python 3.10+, Streamlit, requests, LangChain with Google Gemini (free) — also supporting Ollama entries.title: PROOF 协议：「我们不判断什么是真的」——把主张、证据、签名与状态分层，且签名只证明密钥控制而不证明主张为真
entries.title_en: The PROOF protocol: "we do not decide what is true" — layering claims, evidence, signatures and status, where a signature proves key control rather than the truth of the claim
entries.title_hk: PROOF 協議：「我們不判斷什麼是真的」——把主張、證據、簽名與狀態分層，且簽名只證明密鑰控制而不證明主張為真
entries.summary: 一个用于机器可读主张、证据、证明、时间上下文与验证生命周期的开放协议：一条记录把主张（主语＋谓词＋宾语）、证据、Ed25519 证明签名与状态打包在一起，并由「不变内容」的 SHA-256 决定其身份，因此改状态不会改身份；它开篇即声明自己不判断什么为真，并提供一整节「PROOF 不主张什么」，其中明确签名证明的是密钥控制与数据完整性而非主张为真
entries.summary_hk: 一個用於機器可讀主張、證據、證明、時間上下文與驗證生命週期的開放協議：一條記錄把主張（主語＋謂詞＋賓語）、證據、Ed25519 證明簽名與狀態打包在一起，並由「不變內容」的 SHA-256 決定其身份，因此改狀態不會改身份；它開篇即聲明自己不判斷什麼為真，並提供一整節「PROOF 不主張什麼」，其中明確簽名證明的是密鑰控制與資料完整性而非主張為真
entries.summary_en: An open protocol for machine-readable claims, evidence, attestations, temporal context and verification lifecycle: a record packages a claim (subject, predicate, object) with its evidence, an Ed25519 attestation signature and a status, and its identity is the SHA-256 of the immutable content alone so that changing status does not change identity; it states at the outset that it does not decide what is true, and carries a whole section on what PROOF does not claim, including that a signature proves key control and data integrity rather than the truth of the claim
entries.body:
**PROOF** 是一个**用于机器可读主张、证据、证明与验证生命周期的开放协议**（仓库 `bhayrv/proof`），**实测 Apache-2.0 许可（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 200）、★2、主语言 Python、仓库体量 651 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-09**（**许可、★数与语言等元数据经 GitHub 搜索 API 实测；`LICENSE` 经 raw 探测实测 200；均在解冻窗口内**）；**README 实测 8,060 字节**。**⚠️ 本条目需在开头写清一处范围问题**：**此处的「claims」指**机器可读的主张／断言**，**而非保险理赔**；**该协议**并非保险专用**，**其与保险行业的关系属**推断**（**证据随主张同行、AI 输出可被第三方独立核验**）**——**本词条不主张其与保险存在任何直接渊源**（**详见下方标注 ①**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「分开『我看到了什么』与『我因此断定什么』」**中的**第三种，也是唯一把这条界线**写成了协议本身的第一原则**的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：**标题逐字为「PROOF Protocol」**，**全称逐字为「**Protocol for Readable Object Origin and Facts**」**，**定位逐字为**：**「An open protocol for machine-readable claims, evidence, attestations, temporal context, and verification lifecycle.」**。⭐⭐⭐ **其开篇第二句逐字，是本条目最重要的一句**：**「**PROOF does not decide what is true.** It provides a portable structure that allows **independent systems to evaluate claims and their supporting evidence**.」**——**即「**PROOF 不判断什么为真**。它提供一种可移植的结构，让**彼此独立的系统去评估主张及其支撑证据**」**；**其更简短的一句口号逐字为**：**「> **Evidence should travel with information.**」**。**其状态逐字为**：**「**PROOF 0.2 — Development**」**，**并逐字声明**：**「This is an **experimental protocol and reference implementation**. It is **not yet a finalized interoperability standard**. Breaking changes may occur between development versions.」**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「PROOF does not decide what is true」是本条目最重要的一句，也是本轮主题的**最强形式****——**其余三条把界线划在**系统内部**（机器学习只负责感知、大模型只负责写文案、规则引擎负责判定）；**而本条把界线划在了**协议层**：**协议**只负责搬运与保真**，**判断留给**独立的、可能彼此不一致的消费者****。⭐⭐ **对做 AI 治理或理赔系统的学生，这是一种**把「工具」与「裁判」分开**的设计姿态**——**它使同一批记录可以被不同机构按各自政策评估，而不必信任同一个中枢**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该姿态在实务中一定可行**——**本次未读其规范正文**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「What PROOF Does NOT Claim」一整节逐字实测，是本会话见到**对新技术的自我限定写得最完整**的一份**——**四条逐字为**：**「PROOF does not determine universal or factual truth.」**；**「**A cryptographic signature proves key control and data integrity — not that the claim is true.**」**；**「PROOF does not require blockchain, tokens, or centralized services.」**；**「PROOF is an open infrastructure protocol, not an application.」**⭐⭐⭐ **第二条尤其值得单独记住**：**「密码学签名证明的是**密钥控制与数据完整性**，**而不是主张为真**」**——**在一个极易把「已签名」误读为「已证实」的语境里，这是一句必要的澄清**（**可与第 330 轮 [[claim-to-confidence]] 的「负向测试（agent identity denied）」、第 331 轮 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的「一致性而非准确率」并读**——**三者都在切断一种**看起来像证明的东西**与**真正想要的结论**之间的联系****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「VERIFIED 表示『被某一指定的验证政策接受』，而不是普遍真理」是本条目在语义设计上最精确的一处**——**其状态生命周期逐字为**：**`UNKNOWN → OBSERVED → CORROBORATED → VERIFIED`**，**另有三个分支**：**`→ CONTESTED`、`→ RETRACTED`、`→ SUPERSEDED`**；**并逐字注明**：**「`VERIFIED` means "accepted by a specified verification policy" — not universal truth.」**；**另有一句逐字**：**「**Verification distinguishes cryptographic validity from factual truth.**」**⭐⭐ **对做核保或合规的同学，「谁的政策、什么时候的政策」决定了「已验证」是什么意思**——**这一点在保险的场景判定（如是否构成全损、是否属于承保事故）中同样成立**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该状态机适用于任何保险流程**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「身份只由不变内容决定，改状态不改身份」是本条目在数据建模上最值得记的一点**——**逐字为**：**「The PROOF identity is a SHA-256 hash of the canonical representation of the **immutable content** only: Protocol version (`"proof": "0.2"`), Claim (subject, predicate, object), Evidence records. **Mutable fields (status, observed_at, attestations) are excluded. Changing status does not change identity.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **对做审计或版本化的学生，这是一条**清晰的不变量**：**「这条主张是什么」与「它现在被如何对待」是两件事**，**后者可反复更改而前者不变**（**可与第 331 轮 [[paco-uw]] 的「历史表永不复写」并读——**两者都靠**把可变与不可变分开**来支撑可审计性**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该设计在所有场景都适用**——**例如证据被追加时身份会变，**本次未核实其版本迁移做法**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **「互相矛盾的主张可以并存」被写进了关系类型**——**其图关系逐字为**：**`supports` / `corroborates`（正向证据连接）**；**「`contradicts` — **conflicting claims (both can coexist)**」**；**`supersedes`（更新版本）**；**`derived_from`（来源链）****；**另有一句逐字**：**「A PROOF record packages the claim with its supporting evidence, cryptographic signatures from those who attest to it, and a traceable lifecycle. It represents exactly what was claimed, what evidence was associated with it, who attested to the **exact immutable payload**, and **what supports or contradicts it**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「互相矛盾的主张可以并存」与第 331 轮 [[paco-uw]] 的「两种求值策略的结果即使互相矛盾也都留着」是同一种态度**——**即**不把矛盾消解掉，而是把它记录下来****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该设计能解决证据冲突**——**它只是**不让冲突消失****）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **`demo_ai_agent_pipeline.py` 这一示例是本条目与**AI 治理**最直接相关的一处**——**逐字为**：**「`demo_ai_agent_pipeline.py` — Simulates an AI extraction workflow: mock extraction → evidence association → review → attestation → deterministic verification, **allowing downstream systems to verify the claimed provenance and attestation integrity without trusting the AI model itself**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「无需信任 AI 模型本身，下游系统即可核验其所声称的来源与证明完整性」**——**这与本站连续多轮的主题高度同源**（**第 329 轮 **PROOF** 是一個**用於機器可讀主張、證據、證明與驗證生命週期的開放協議**（倉庫 `bhayrv/proof`），**實測 Apache-2.0 許可（`LICENSE` 於 main 分支實測 200）、★2、主語言 Python、體量 651 KB、創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-09**（**許可、★數與語言等元數據經 GitHub 搜索 API 實測；均在解凍窗口內**）；**README 實測 8,060 位元組**。**⚠️ 本條目需在開頭寫清一處範圍問題**：**此處的「claims」指**機器可讀的主張／斷言**，**而非保險理賠**；**該協議**並非保險專用**，**其與保險行業的關係屬**推斷****——**不主張其與保險存在任何直接淵源**。本條目屬本輪主題**「分開『我看到了什麼』與『我因此斷定什麼』」**中的**第三種，也是唯一把這條界線**寫成了協議本身的第一原則**的一種**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測**）：**標題逐字「PROOF Protocol」**，**全稱逐字「**Protocol for Readable Object Origin and Facts**」**，**定位逐字**：**「An open protocol for machine-readable claims, evidence, attestations, temporal context, and verification lifecycle.」**。⭐⭐⭐ **開篇第二句逐字，是本條目最重要的一句**：**「**PROOF does not decide what is true.** It provides a portable structure that allows **independent systems to evaluate claims and their supporting evidence**.」**；**其口號逐字**：**「> **Evidence should travel with information.**」**。**狀態逐字**：**「**PROOF 0.2 — Development**」**，**並逐字聲明**「This is an **experimental protocol and reference implementation**. It is **not yet a finalized interoperability standard**. Breaking changes may occur between development versions.」**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「PROOF does not decide what is true」是本輪主題的**最強形式****——**其餘三條把界線劃在**系統內部**（機器學習只管感知、大模型只管寫文案、規則引擎負責判定）；**而本條把界線劃在了**協議層**：**協議**只負責搬運與保真**，**判斷留給**獨立的、可能彼此不一致的消費者****（**⚠️ 不主張**該姿態在實務中一定可行**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「What PROOF Does NOT Claim」一整節逐字，是本會話見到**對新技術的自我限定寫得最完整**的一份**——**四條逐字**：「PROOF does not determine universal or factual truth.」；**「**A cryptographic signature proves key control and data integrity — not that the claim is true.**」**；「PROOF does not require blockchain, tokens, or centralized services.」；「PROOF is an open infrastructure protocol, not an application.」**⭐⭐⭐ **第二條尤其值得單獨記住**：**「密碼學簽名證明的是**密鑰控制與資料完整性**，而不是主張為真」**——**在一個極易把「已簽名」誤讀為「已證實」的語境裡，這是必要的澄清**（可與第 330 輪 [[claim-to-confidence]] 的「負向測試（agent identity denied）」、第 331 輪 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的「一致性而非準確率」並讀）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「VERIFIED 表示『被某一指定的驗證政策接受』而非普遍真理」是語義設計上最精確的一處**——**狀態生命週期逐字為 `UNKNOWN → OBSERVED → CORROBORATED → VERIFIED`，另有 `→ CONTESTED`、`→ RETRACTED`、`→ SUPERSEDED` 三個分支**；**逐字註明「`VERIFIED` means "accepted by a specified verification policy" — not universal truth.」**；**另有一句逐字「**Verification distinguishes cryptographic validity from factual truth.**」**⭐⭐ **「誰的政策、什麼時候的政策」決定了「已驗證」是什麼意思**——**這在保險的場景判定（如是否構成全損、是否屬承保事故）中同樣成立**（**⚠️ 不主張**該狀態機適用於任何保險流程**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「身份只由不變內容決定，改狀態不改身份」是資料建模上最值得記的一點**——**逐字「The PROOF identity is a SHA-256 hash of the canonical representation of the **immutable content** only: Protocol version … Claim (subject, predicate, object), Evidence records. **Mutable fields (status, observed_at, attestations) are excluded. Changing status does not change identity.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「這條主張是什麼」與「它現在被如何對待」是兩件事**（可與第 331 輪 [[paco-uw]] 的「歷史表永不復寫」並讀——**兩者都靠**把可變與不可變分開**來支撐可審計性**；**⚠️ 不主張**該設計在所有場景都適用**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **「互相矛盾的主張可以並存」被寫進了關係類型**——**圖關係逐字**：`supports`／`corroborates`；**「`contradicts` — **conflicting claims (both can coexist)**」**；`supersedes`；`derived_from`****；**另有逐字「It represents exactly what was claimed, what evidence was associated with it, who attested to the **exact immutable payload**, and **what supports or contradicts it**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **與第 331 輪 [[paco-uw]] 的「兩種求值策略的結果即使互相矛盾也都留著」是同一個態度**——**不把矛盾消解掉，而是把它記錄下來**（**⚠️ 不主張**該設計能解決證據衝突**——**它只是**不讓衝突消失****）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **`demo_ai_agent_pipeline.py` 與**AI 治理**最直接相關**——**逐字「Simulates an AI extraction workflow: mock extraction → evidence association → review → attestation → deterministic verification, **allowing downstream systems to verify the claimed provenance and attestation integrity without trusting the AI model itself**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **與本站連續多輪主題高度同源**（**329 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的逐欄位 grounding 回查、330 [[claim-to-confidence]] 的獨立 oracle 與只增不改審計日誌、331 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的基準刻意排除**）；**本條提供的是**標準化的形式****（**⚠️ 未運行該示例**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其餘三個示例逐字且都與「主張會隨時間變化」有關**：`demo_financial_intelligence.py`（**一條盈利主張、多條證據、一份證明、以及**後來一條相矛盾的主張**及其 `contradicts` 關係**）；`demo_temporal_supersession.py`（**一條收購主張被修訂及 `supersedes` 關係**，**逐字含「apply an explicit consumer policy to identify the currently preferred claim」**）；`visualizer/index.html`（**無依賴的 HTML／JS 圖可視化**）；`cli_end_to_end.ps1`**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **安全模型一節逐字，含三條與「別把簽名當真相」互補的限定**：「Signatures prove key control and data integrity, not factual truth.」；**「**Private keys are never persisted by the library.**」**；**「**Timestamps are self-reported metadata, not cryptographically bound.**」**；「The protocol is experimental.」**⭐⭐ **第三條值得單獨記**：**時間戳是**自報元數據、並非密碼學綁定****——**「某人在某時說」本身並不獲密碼學保證**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **互操作性一節逐字列出六個真實標準**：**`docs/interoperability.md` 逐字「How PROOF maps to **W3C PROV, C2PA, Verifiable Credentials, Sigstore, in-toto, and Schema.org**」**；**另有 `docs/architecture.md`（**含不變身份模型與規範化策略**）與 `spec/PROOF.md`（**規範正文**）**（**⚠️ 未讀該文檔，不主張其映射準確或完整**）。**⑩ ⭐ **CLI 與 Python API 逐字且都強調**嚴格管道兼容性****：CLI 含 `proof create`（`--subject`／`--predicate`／`--object`／`--evidence-type`／`--evidence-source`）、`proof inspect`、`proof identity`、`proof keygen`、`proof sign --private-key`、`proof verify`**，**逐字「All commands support **JSON input/output for strict pipeline compatibility**.」**；**Python API 含 `Claim`、`Evidence`、`Proof`、`proof_id`、`create_attestation`、`verify_attestation`、`verify_proof`、`Attestation` 與 `result.to_dict()`**；**要求 Python 3.11+**。**⑪ ⭐ **版本參與身份計算逐字**：**「The version participates in identity computation — **the same claim under different versions has different identities**.」**——**⚠️ 對一個自述仍會破壞性變更的實驗性協議而言，這意味著**跨版本的身份不穩定****（**不主張**其適合作為長期歸檔標識**）。**⑫ ⭐ 可與 [[claim-to-confidence]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[rag-assurance]]、[[powmcp-skills]]、[[underwriting-decision-safety]]、[[brel-xbrl]]、[[risk-data-library-standard]] 並讀**。

entries.body_en:
**PROOF** is **an open protocol for machine-readable claims, evidence, attestations and verification lifecycle** (repository `bhayrv/proof`), with **measured Apache-2.0 licence (`LICENSE` measured 200 on main), ★2, Python as the primary language, a 651 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**licence, star count and language measured via the GitHub search API; `LICENSE` confirmed by raw probe; both inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 8,060 bytes**. **⚠️ One scope point must be stated at the outset**: **"claims" here means machine-readable assertions, not insurance claims**; **the protocol is not insurance-specific, and its relevance to insurance is inferential** (**evidence travelling with a claim; AI output independently verifiable downstream**) — **the entry does not claim any direct connection to insurance** (**see note ① below**). It is the third of this round’s four takes on **separating "what I observed" from "what I therefore conclude"**, **and the only one that writes that boundary into the protocol as its first principle**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): **the title reads verbatim "PROOF Protocol"**, **the full name verbatim "Protocol for Readable Object Origin and Facts"**, **and the positioning verbatim**: **"An open protocol for machine-readable claims, evidence, attestations, temporal context, and verification lifecycle."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Its second sentence, read verbatim, is the entry’s most important line**: **"PROOF does not decide what is true. It provides a portable structure that allows independent systems to evaluate claims and their supporting evidence."**; **and its shorter slogan reads verbatim "Evidence should travel with information."** **Its status reads verbatim "PROOF 0.2 — Development"**, **with the declaration verbatim**: **"This is an experimental protocol and reference implementation. It is not yet a finalized interoperability standard. Breaking changes may occur between development versions."**

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "PROOF does not decide what is true" is the strongest form of this round’s theme** — **the other three entries draw the boundary inside a system** (**machine learning handles perception, the LLM only writes the wording, a rule engine decides**), **whereas this one draws it at the protocol layer: the protocol only carries and preserves, and judgement is left to independent consumers who may disagree with one another** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim that stance is workable in practice — its specification was not read**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ A whole "What PROOF Does NOT Claim" section reads verbatim, the most complete self-limitation of a new technology this session has seen** — **four items verbatim**: **"PROOF does not determine universal or factual truth."**; **"A cryptographic signature proves key control and data integrity — not that the claim is true."**; **"PROOF does not require blockchain, tokens, or centralized services."**; **"PROOF is an open infrastructure protocol, not an application."** ⭐⭐⭐ **The second deserves memorising: a cryptographic signature proves key control and data integrity, not that the claim is true — a necessary clarification in a setting where "signed" is easily misread as "proven"** (**readable with round 330’s [[claim-to-confidence]] and its negative test in which an agent identity is denied, and round 331’s [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] and its "agreement and disagreement, not accuracy" — all three sever a link between something that looks like proof and the conclusion actually wanted**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ "VERIFIED means accepted by a specified verification policy, not universal truth" is the entry’s most precise semantic design point** — **the status lifecycle reads verbatim `UNKNOWN → OBSERVED → CORROBORATED → VERIFIED` with three further branches `→ CONTESTED`, `→ RETRACTED`, `→ SUPERSEDED`**; **and it notes verbatim "`VERIFIED` means \"accepted by a specified verification policy\" — not universal truth."**, **with a further line verbatim: "Verification distinguishes cryptographic validity from factual truth."** ⭐⭐ **For students of underwriting or compliance, whose policy and when determine what "verified" means — which also holds for insurance scenario determinations such as whether a total loss has occurred or an event is covered** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the state machine suits any insurance process**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ That identity is decided by immutable content alone, so changing status does not change identity, is the entry’s most notable data-modelling point** — verbatim: **"The PROOF identity is a SHA-256 hash of the canonical representation of the immutable content only: Protocol version (`\"proof\": \"0.2\"`), Claim (subject, predicate, object), Evidence records. Mutable fields (status, observed_at, attestations) are excluded. Changing status does not change identity."** ⭐⭐⭐ **For students of audit or versioning this is a clean invariant: "what this claim is" and "how it is currently being treated" are two different things, and the latter can change repeatedly while the former does not** (**readable with round 331’s [[paco-uw]] and its never-overwritten history table — both rest auditability on separating the mutable from the immutable**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim the design fits every setting — appending evidence would change identity, and its migration practice was not checked**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ That contradictory claims may coexist is written into the relationship types** — **the graph relationships read verbatim as**: **`supports` / `corroborates`**; **"`contradicts` — conflicting claims (both can coexist)"**; **`supersedes`**; **`derived_from`**; **with a further line verbatim**: **"It represents exactly what was claimed, what evidence was associated with it, who attested to the exact immutable payload, and what supports or contradicts it."** ⭐⭐⭐ **This matches round 331’s [[paco-uw]], where both strategies’ results survive even when they contradict each other — the same attitude of not dissolving the contradiction but recording it** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the design resolves evidential conflicts; it merely prevents them from disappearing**). **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ `demo_ai_agent_pipeline.py` is the entry’s most directly AI-governance-related item** — verbatim: **"`demo_ai_agent_pipeline.py` — Simulates an AI extraction workflow: mock extraction → evidence association → review → attestation → deterministic verification, allowing downstream systems to verify the claimed provenance and attestation integrity without trusting the AI model itself."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Highly cognate with a theme that recurs across this site** (**per-field grounding in round 329’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]], an independent oracle and append-only audit log in round 330’s [[claim-to-confidence]], and a benchmark deliberately excluded from the feature matrix in round 331’s [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]]**); **what this entry adds is a standardised form** (**⚠️ the example was not run**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its other three examples read verbatim and all concern claims changing over time**: **`demo_financial_intelligence.py`** (**an earnings claim, multiple evidence attachments, an attestation, and a later contradictory claim with a `contradicts` relation**); **`demo_temporal_supersession.py`** (**an acquisition claim revised via `supersedes`**, **noting verbatim "how a machine can trace claim history and apply an explicit consumer policy to identify the currently preferred claim"**); **`visualizer/index.html`** (**a dependency-free HTML/JS graph visualiser**); **and `cli_end_to_end.ps1`**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its security-model section reads verbatim and has three limits complementing "don’t mistake a signature for truth"**: **"Signatures prove key control and data integrity, not factual truth."**; **"Private keys are never persisted by the library."**; **"Timestamps are self-reported metadata, not cryptographically bound."**; **"The protocol is experimental."** ⭐⭐ **The third deserves separate note: timestamps are self-reported metadata and not cryptographically bound — that someone said something at some time is itself not guaranteed by cryptography** (**for students of audit trails, an easily overlooked weak point**). **⑨ ⭐⭐ Its interoperability section names six real standards, the entry’s most checkable point on the standards ecosystem**: **`docs/interoperability.md` reads verbatim "How PROOF maps to W3C PROV, C2PA, Verifiable Credentials, Sigstore, in-toto, and Schema.org"**; **with `docs/architecture.md` (covering the immutable identity model and canonicalisation strategy) and `spec/PROOF.md` (the normative specification)** ⭐⭐ **these are existing standards that can be independently checked** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the mapping is accurate or complete — that document was not read**). **⑩ ⭐ Its CLI and Python API read verbatim and both stress strict pipeline compatibility**: **`proof create` (`--subject`, `--predicate`, `--object`, `--evidence-type`, `--evidence-source`), `proof inspect`, `proof identity`, `proof keygen`, `proof sign --private-key`, `proof verify`**, **with the note verbatim "All commands support JSON input/output for strict pipeline compatibility."**; **the Python API includes `Claim`, `Evidence`, `Proof`, `proof_id`, `create_attestation`, `verify_attestation`, `verify_proof`, `Attestation` and `result.to_dict()`**; **Python 3.11+ is required**. **⑪ ⭐ The detail that the version participates in identity computation reads verbatim**: **"The version participates in identity computation — the same claim under different versions has different identities."** — **⚠️ for a self-described experimental protocol that may still make breaking changes, this means identity is unstable across versions** (**the entry does not claim it suits long-term archival identifiers**). **⑫ ⭐ Readable with the site’s provenance, audit and AI-governance entries**: [[claim-to-confidence]], [[insurance-governance]], [[reproducible-actuarial-work]], [[verified-reserving]], [[rag-assurance]], [[powmcp-skills]], [[underwriting-decision-safety]], [[brel-xbrl]], [[risk-data-library-standard]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Scope must be stated clearly: this repository is a general-purpose protocol for machine-readable claims and evidence provenance, not an insurance tool, and its README never mentions insurance**; **its relevance here is this entry’s inference — that "evidence travels with the claim" and "downstream systems can verify claimed provenance without trusting the AI model" have general significance for claims evidence chains and AI output auditing**; **the entry labels that relevance as inference and does not claim any direct connection, fit or adoption in insurance**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata (partly via the search API), and the README’s full 8,060 bytes covering its definition, status declaration, problem statement, core data model, four "does not claim" items, status lifecycle, identity computation, graph relationships, quickstart, Python API, example list, development and security model, versioning, architecture/interoperability/specification pointers and licence**, **and confirmed by raw probe that `LICENSE` exists (HTTP 200)**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install, run its CLI or Python API, run pytest, read `spec/PROOF.md` or anything under `docs/`, run any example, open its visualiser, or read `SECURITY.md` or any source**, so **its canonicalisation strategy, signature and verification implementation, graph data structures and any output cannot be restated**; **② ⭐⭐⭐ Whether the self-positioning "PROOF does not decide what is true" holds in the implementation was not verified** — **for example whether `verify_proof` really performs only cryptographic and policy determination without introducing semantic judgement**; **the source was not read**; **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether the identity invariant "changing status does not change identity" holds was not verified**, **nor the actual behaviour of version-participates-in-identity or of appending evidence**; **④ ⭐⭐ Whether its mapping to W3C PROV, C2PA, Verifiable Credentials, Sigstore, in-toto and Schema.org is accurate or complete was not verified** (**`docs/interoperability.md` was not read**); **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether its Ed25519 signing, key management and timestamp handling are secure was not verified** — **⚠️ it states that private keys are never persisted and that timestamps are self-reported and not cryptographically bound**; **the entry does not claim it resists any particular threat** (**no security assessment was performed**); **⑥ ⭐⭐ Whether its four examples (especially `demo_ai_agent_pipeline.py`) run or behave as described was not verified**; **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ The protocol describes itself as "PROOF 0.2 — Development", "not yet a finalized interoperability standard", with "Breaking changes may occur" and "experimental"** — **the entry therefore does not claim it suits any production system, long-term archive or compliance record**; **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ The patent-grant terms and contributor policy under its Apache-2.0 licence were not verified**; **⑨ ⭐ ★2 and the fork count were not verified for this entry** (**the core API hit its rate limit this round, so those fields come from the search API**), **and attention is very low, so no maturity, security or adoption is claimed**; **⑩ ⭐ No topics information was obtained this round** (**the search API returned no `topics` field**), **so the entry makes no claim about them**; **⑪ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: metadata for `bhayrv/proof` was obtained via the GitHub **search** API on 2026-09-11 (**the core API hit its rate limit this round, so the repo endpoint was not read individually**); the 8,060-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; `LICENSE` was confirmed present by raw probe; **nothing cloned, installed, run, and neither the specification nor the source read**.

entries.summary: 一个端到端的航空监视审计系统：从公开 ADS-B 源跟踪真实飞机，把每个位置报文对照物理、完整性与安全规则以及一个异常模型来检查，用注入攻击测自己的检测准确率并把测出的精度作为权重写进风险评分，输出带 SHA-256 清单与溯源块的可核验报告；它把审计日志做成哈希链使任何增删改序都能被指认，并明确报告有两个攻击情景是它测不到的已知缺口

entries.summary_en: An end-to-end aviation surveillance auditing system: it follows real aircraft from public ADS-B feeds, checks every position report against physics, integrity and safety rules plus an anomaly model, measures its own detection accuracy with injected attacks and feeds the measured precision into the risk score as weights, and emits verifiable reports with SHA-256 manifests and provenance blocks; its audit log is a hash chain so any edited, deleted or reordered line can be named, and it explicitly reports that two attack scenarios are known gaps it cannot catch
entries.body:
**aero-audit** 是一个**端到端的航空监视审计系统**（仓库 `monykiss/aero-audit`），**实测 MIT 许可（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 200）、★0、fork 0、主语言 Python（自述要求 3.12+）、仓库体量 3,985 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**实测 topics 10 项**：**`ads-b`、`anomaly-detection`、`aviation`、`computer-vision`、`machine-learning`、`portfolio`、`python`、`risk-management`、`security`、`surveillance`**；**README 实测 17,369 字节**，**自述版本 0.4.0**；**已实测存在的关键文件**：**`LICENSE`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`docs/DEMO.md`**。**⚠️ 本条目需在开头写清一处范围问题**：**这是航空**监视安全**（ADS-B 欺骗与异常检测）工具，**不是航空保险**；**它**不填补本站「航空险」这一真空白**（**详见下方标注 ①**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「分开『我看到了什么』与『我因此断定什么』」**中的**第四种，也是唯一把「我自己测得准不准」**直接写进了评分公式**的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：**定位逐字为**：**「**Aviation surveillance auditing, end to end.** aero-audit follows real aircraft from public ADS-B feeds, checks every position report **against physics, integrity and safety rules plus an anomaly model**, **measures its own detection accuracy with injected attacks**, **scores risk from the evidence**, and shows all of it in a terminal-style local app whose **every action and report is tamper-evident**.」**；**并逐字声明**：**「It runs **offline in one command**, on any machine, and **never transmits anything**.」**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「用注入攻击测自己、再把测出的精度当权重写进评分」是本条目最重要的一点，也是本会话见到**把自测结果回灌进生产判断**最彻底的一例**——**逐字为**：**「**Measures itself**: `aero evaluate` perturbs real aircraft with **eight attack scenarios** and reports **recall, time-to-detect and per-rule precision**. **Those numbers weight the risk score and the risk register; two scenarios are known gaps and are reported as such.**」**——**即「`aero evaluate` 用八个攻击情景扰动真实飞机，报告**召回率、发现时延与逐规则精度**。**这些数字会作为权重进入风险评分与风险清单；其中两个情景是已知缺口，并被如实报告为缺口。」**⭐⭐⭐ **三点值得单独记**：**① 精度不是用来写论文的，而是**评分公式的输入****（**其包结构亦逐字印证**：`audit/` 下含 **`policy (precision-weighted score)`**）；**② 有两个情景**测不到**，而它**不把这两项从指标里删掉或含糊过去**，**而是**明确列为已知缺口****；**③ 这一点对本站连续多轮的「把边界写在明面上」是**强度最高的形态之一**——**前面几轮多为**文字声明**，而这里是把**测不到的项进了指标报告本身****（**可与第 331 轮 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的「占位符待对账」、第 332 轮 [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] 的「PR-AUC 1.00 是 bug 报告」并读**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其八个情景覆盖充分或那两个缺口已被量化**——**本次未运行 `aero evaluate`**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「Two things a reviewer can check rather than take on faith」一节逐字，是本条目在可核验性上最值得记的一处**——**其小标题逐字为**：**「**Trustworthy by construction** — Two things a reviewer can check rather than take on faith.」**⭐⭐ **「让复核者**可以自己查**而不是**凭信任接受**」这一措辞本身，**正是本轮主题的直接表述****。**其第一条「Auditable」逐字为**：**「The app’s audit log is **a hash chain: every entry carries the SHA-256 of the one before it and of itself**, so **an edited, deleted or reordered line is named by `aero log verify`** and by the **CHAIN VERIFIED** badge on the Audit log page. **Every report ships with a provenance block (tool version, git commit, input recording and its hash, model hash and registry status, evaluation hash, threshold overrides)** and a manifest that `aero log verify-report` … re-hash. **Injected demo traffic is flagged in every finding.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三点值得单独记**：**① 哈希链不只是防篡改，而是**能指认具体哪一行被增删改序**（`aero log verify`）**；**② 每份报告带**七项溯源块**（工具版本、git commit、输入录制及其哈希、模型哈希与登记状态、评测哈希、阈值覆盖）；**③ **注入的演示流量在每一条发现里都被标记****——**即**演示数据与真实数据在输出层面可区分**（**可与第 330 轮 [[catrisk-sim]] 的「synthetic and deliberately simplified」、第 332 轮 [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]] 的「metrics are on synthetic data」并读——**三位作者都在**不让合成数据冒充真实结果****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「Secure by default」一节逐字，是本会话见到**对本地服务安全写得最具体**的一段**——**逐字给出理由与对策**：**「A server on 127.0.0.1 is reachable from every web page you have open, so the app **validates the `Host` header against DNS rebinding**, requires a **per-process token on every POST** (which **forces the CORS preflight the server never grants**), checks `Origin` and `Sec-Fetch-Site`, serves a **strict Content-Security-Policy with no inline script**, **confines every path parameter to the project’s data directories**, accepts only `http(s)` webhooks, and **loads a model only when its SHA-256 matches the registry that `aero train` wrote**. **Binding beyond loopback requires a token on every API call.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **其中最值得记住的是**「localhost 服务器对你打开的每一个网页都是可达的」这一前提****——**它把**DNS 重绑定**、**CSRF 预检**与**路径穿越**三类针对本地开发服务的攻击写得具体而克制**；**而对精算建模的同学，**「模型只有在 SHA-256 与训练时写入的登记表一致时才被加载」**是一条可直接借用的**模型完整性门****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其防护完整或无遗漏**——**本次未做任何安全评估**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **供应链与 CI 的交代逐字且具体**：**「Dependencies install with **`--require-hashes`** from a universal lock; CI runs **ruff, pytest, docs-drift, `pip-audit`, gitleaks over the full history, CodeQL** and a container smoke test, **with every action pinned to a commit SHA**.」**⭐⭐ **其中两点少见**：**① `--require-hashes` 从通用锁文件安装**（**依赖内容锁定而不只是版本锁定**）；**② CI 含 **`docs-drift`**——即**检查文档是否已与实现脱节****（**可与第 329 轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 pre-commit 自动重生成工作流图并读——**两者都在**防止文档与实现漂移****）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **规则与模型的分工逐字，是本轮主题在其内部架构上的落点**——**逐字为**：**「Audits every fix with **explainable rules**: impossible jumps, speed and altitude physics, **integrity below 14 CFR 91.227 minimums**, replayed fixes, ghosts, emergency and hijack codes **with confirmation tiers**, holding, level busts, coverage gaps, stream floods and collapses, cross-feed disagreement, watchlists. **Every finding maps to a control reference and a response playbook.**」**，**而机器学习逐字为**：**「Learns the airspace’s normal envelope with **per-regime IsolationForests over twelve kinematic features, percentile-calibrated, with two-fix persistence before a finding is raised**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **两点值得单独记**：**① 「每一条发现都映射到一个控制引用与一份响应手册」**——**即「发现了什么」与「因此该做什么」被显式连起来**（**这正是本轮主题**）；**② 「需连续两次报点（two-fix persistence）才升级为发现」**是一条**抑制误报的去抖规则****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该规则能消除误报**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其流水线与包结构逐字，含一处关键的架构命名**——**流水线逐字为**：**live feeds（adsb.lol、OpenSky、NOAA METAR、FAA NAS status）→ normalize（StateVector）→ **JSONL recording（replayable）** → TrackStore（kinematics）→ **rules + ML + watchlist** → findings（SEC／OPS／SAF、ML-001 流检查）→ **risk score → trust ledger → alerts**」**；**并有**「two feeds → cross-feed corroboration (dead-reckoned) → SEC-015」**与**「imagery → YOLO (tiled) → apron zone occupancy → OPS-VIS findings」**两条旁路**；**其包结构逐字含**：**`ingest/`（adsblol、opensky、metar、faa_status、replay、http curl fallback）、`stream/`（async poller ＋ JSONL recorder）、**`provenance.py`**、`features/`（TrackStore）、`audit/`（rules、findings、**policy（precision-weighted score）**、engine、reports）、`ml/`（IsolationForest model、trainer、**registry（checksum gate）**、evaluation harness）、`security/`**⭐⭐ **「risk score → **trust ledger**」这一环值得注意**：**评分之后还有一个**信任台账****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该台账的设计**——**本次未读源码**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **报告与风险登记的统计方法逐字，且比同类项目更讲究**——**逐字为**：**「Reports: **JSON, Markdown, self-contained HTML**, each with **provenance and a manifest of SHA-256 hashes**; **risk register with Wilson-bound likelihoods and residual risk**; **holding impact in fuel, CO2 and delay cost**.」**⭐⭐ **「Wilson 置信界」被用于**似然****——**即以**二项比例的置信区间**而非点估计来表达风险登记的频率**；**而把**等待（holding）的代价折算为燃油、CO₂ 与延误成本**，**是把运行影响货币化的一种具体做法**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其折算系数或适用性**——**本次未读其实现**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **演示的设计逐字且含一处重要的数据出处与许可**：**「The demo replays a bundled sample of **real traffic (15 US hubs, 3,900 aircraft, adsb.lol, ODbL)** at 10x with a **scripted tour** that injects **eight attack scenarios** on a timeline. **The banner narrates each one and says what should fire.** Press **F2** for the map, **F6** for findings, **F8** for the hash-chained audit log, click **SND** to hear alerts.」**⭐⭐ **三点值得记**：**① 数据来自广告式公开源 adsb.lol 且**明确标注 ODbL 许可****（**对做数据来源合规的同学，这是**具名标注上游许可**的实例**）；**② 演示是一条**带解说的剧本化巡演**，**每个攻击情景都说明「应当触发什么」****——**即可与输出对照**；**③ 审计日志被做成了**可按键查看的界面元素**（F8）**，**而不只是后端文件**。**⑨ ⭐ **其余能力逐字且覆盖面明确**：**摄取**（adsb.lol 含完整性字段 **NIC／NACp／SIL**；OpenSky 全国框；NOAA METAR；FAA NAS status；**全部无需密钥**；一切录为**可回放的 JSONL**）；**生态理解**（**132 个北美机场、约 80 家运营人、约 180 种机型**、按场高判定飞行阶段、FAA 地面停止与延误程序）；**视觉**（机场停机坪影像上的**分块 YOLOv8 检测**与区域占用发现，**自述为可选项**）。**⑩ ⭐ **一键跑起来的方式逐字**：**`scripts/bootstrap.sh`（macOS／Linux：建 .venv、**经哈希校验的安装**、健康检查、打开演示）**、**Windows `bootstrap.ps1`**、**容器 `docker run --rm -p 127.0.0.1:8787:8787 …`**、**已装好则 `make demo`**；**界面为**终端风格（Bloomberg 式黑底琥珀色）、带助记命令行、功能键、行情条、可绘数千架飞机的画布地图、下拉筛选、可排序表格、随处可导出 CSV、后台任务、实时阈值调节与应用内文档****。**⑪ ⭐ **可与本站风险检测、审计与溯源条目并读**：[[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]、[[claims-fraud-guardian]]、[[networkfraud]]、[[cybrisk]]、[[openriskscore]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[claim-to-confidence]]、[[proof-protocol]]（**本批同轮：把「证据随主张同行」做成协议**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ **范围必须写清，且与本站的一处真空白有关**：**该仓库是**航空监视安全**（ADS-B 完整性与欺骗检测、流异常）工具，**不是航空保险**，**README 全文**未涉及承保、费率、条款或航空险市场**；**本站「航空险」这一**真空白**在连续多轮中**未被填补****（**第 327 轮曾确立其在 GitHub 上属结构性缺席**）；**本词条**明确不把本条计入航空险的覆盖，也不主张该空白被填补****——⭐ **唯一可记的联系是它使用**航空域**的公开数据与**风险／审计**方法**，**而这属于方法层面的类比，不是险种资料**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics（10 项）、README（17,369 字节）全文的定位段、五分钟上手、能力清单、两节「Trustworthy by construction」、流水线与包结构、报告与风险登记说明、演示说明与运行方式**，**并以 raw 探测确认 `LICENSE`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`docs/DEMO.md` 均存在（HTTP 200）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未运行 `scripts/bootstrap.sh` 或 `make demo`、未启动其本地应用、未运行 `aero evaluate`、未查看其演示或任何报告、未读 `aero_audit/` 下任何源码、未读 `SECURITY.md` 与 `docs/` 下任何文档、未打开 `docs/img/` 下任何截图****，因此**不能转述其规则实现、IsolationForest 特征与标定、风险评分公式、Wilson 界的计算方式、溯源块的实际字段值或任何指标数值**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其八个攻击情景下的**召回率、发现时延与逐规则精度**——**本次未运行 `aero evaluate`**；**本词条只记录其**自述方法**，**不主张**任何数值**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「其中两个情景是已知缺口」具体指哪两个、以及缺口有多大**——**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**本词条**不主张**其已量化该缺口**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「精度权重进入风险评分」在实现中确实成立**（**包结构中 `policy (precision-weighted score)` 为**其自述命名****）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**审计日志确为哈希链、且 `aero log verify` 能指认被增删改序的行**；**本词条只核实在 README 中被如此描述**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未做任何安全评估**——**其列出的 DNS 重绑定防护、每 POST 令牌、CSP、路径限制与模型哈希门**均为**其自述****；**本词条**不主张**其实际安全**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其演示所用 adsb.lol 数据的**ODbL 许可标注与再利用条件**是否符合该许可要求**（**本次未查阅 ODbL 原文，亦未核实 adsb.lol 的使用条款**）；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实**其「132 个北美机场、约 80 家运营人、约 180 种机型」等参考数据的来源与时效**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其「never transmits anything」这一网络行为声明**——**本次未做任何流量观测**；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **本词条**不主张**其与任何航空监管机构、机场或数据提供方存在认可、授权或背书关系**（**README 未作此类声明，本次亦未核实**）；**⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ **其 topic 含 **aero-audit** 是一個**端到端的航空監視審計系統**（倉庫 `monykiss/aero-audit`），**實測 MIT 許可（`LICENSE` 於 main 分支實測 200）、★0、fork 0、主語言 Python（自述要求 3.12+）、體量 3,985 KB、創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-10**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**實測 topics 10 項**：**`ads-b`、`anomaly-detection`、`aviation`、`computer-vision`、`machine-learning`、`portfolio`、`python`、`risk-management`、`security`、`surveillance`**；**README 實測 17,369 位元組**，**自述版本 0.4.0**；**已實測存在的關鍵檔案**：**`LICENSE`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`docs/DEMO.md`**。**⚠️ 本條目需在開頭寫清一處範圍問題**：**這是航空**監視安全**（ADS-B 欺騙與異常檢測）工具，**不是航空保險**；**它**不填補本站「航空險」這一真空白****。本條目屬本輪主題**「分開『我看到了什麼』與『我因此斷定什麼』」**中的**第四種，也是唯一把「我自己測得準不準」**直接寫進了評分公式**的一種**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測**）：**定位逐字**：**「**Aviation surveillance auditing, end to end.** aero-audit follows real aircraft from public ADS-B feeds, checks every position report **against physics, integrity and safety rules plus an anomaly model**, **measures its own detection accuracy with injected attacks**, **scores risk from the evidence**, and shows all of it in a terminal-style local app whose **every action and report is tamper-evident**.」**；**並逐字聲明**「It runs **offline in one command**, on any machine, and **never transmits anything**.」**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「用注入攻擊測自己、再把測出的精度當權重寫進評分」是最重要的一點****——**逐字「**Measures itself**: `aero evaluate` perturbs real aircraft with **eight attack scenarios** and reports **recall, time-to-detect and per-rule precision**. **Those numbers weight the risk score and the risk register; two scenarios are known gaps and are reported as such.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三點值得單獨記**：①**精度不是用來寫論文，而是**評分公式的輸入****（**其包結構逐字印證**：`audit/` 下含 **`policy (precision-weighted score)`**）；②**有兩個情景**測不到**，而它**不把這兩項從指標裡刪掉或含糊過去**，**而是**明確列為已知缺口****；③**對本站連續多輪的「把邊界寫在明面上」是**強度最高的形態之一**——**前幾輪多為**文字聲明**，這裡是把**測不到的項進了指標報告本身****（可與第 331 輪 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的「佔位符待對賬」、第 332 輪 [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] 的「PR-AUC 1.00 是 bug 報告」並讀；**⚠️ 不主張**其八個情景覆蓋充分或那兩個缺口已被量化**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「Trustworthy by construction — Two things a reviewer can check rather than take on faith.」一節逐字**⭐⭐ **「讓複核者**可以自己查**而不是**憑信任接受**」正是本輪主題的直接表述**。**其第一條逐字**：**「The app’s audit log is **a hash chain: every entry carries the SHA-256 of the one before it and of itself**, so **an edited, deleted or reordered line is named by `aero log verify`** and by the **CHAIN VERIFIED** badge… **Every report ships with a provenance block (tool version, git commit, input recording and its hash, model hash and registry status, evaluation hash, threshold overrides)** and a manifest that `aero log verify-report` … re-hash. **Injected demo traffic is flagged in every finding.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三點值得單獨記**：①哈希鏈不只是防篡改，而是**能指認具體哪一行被增刪改序**；②每份報告帶**七項溯源塊**；③**注入的演示流量在每一條發現裡都被標記**——**演示資料與真實資料在輸出層面可區分**（可與第 330 輪 [[catrisk-sim]]、第 332 輪 [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]] 並讀——**三位作者都在不讓合成資料冒充真實結果**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「Secure by default」一節逐字，是本會話見到對本地服務安全寫得最具體的一段**——**逐字「A server on 127.0.0.1 is reachable from every web page you have open, so the app **validates the `Host` header against DNS rebinding**, requires a **per-process token on every POST** (which **forces the CORS preflight the server never grants**), checks `Origin` and `Sec-Fetch-Site`, serves a **strict Content-Security-Policy with no inline script**, **confines every path parameter to the project’s data directories**, accepts only `http(s)` webhooks, and **loads a model only when its SHA-256 matches the registry that `aero train` wrote**. **Binding beyond loopback requires a token on every API call.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **最值得記住的是**「localhost 伺服器對你打開的每一個網頁都是可達的」這一前提****；**而**「模型只有在 SHA-256 與訓練時寫入的登記表一致時才被載入」**是一條可直接借用的**模型完整性門****（**⚠️ 未做任何安全評估，不主張其防護完整**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **供應鏈與 CI 逐字**：**「Dependencies install with **`--require-hashes`** from a universal lock; CI runs **ruff, pytest, docs-drift, `pip-audit`, gitleaks over the full history, CodeQL** and a container smoke test, **with every action pinned to a commit SHA**.」**⭐⭐ **兩點少見**：①`--require-hashes` 從通用鎖檔安裝；②CI 含 **`docs-drift`**（**檢查文檔是否已與實現脫節**，可與第 329 輪 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 pre-commit 自動重生成工作流圖並讀）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **規則與模型的分工逐字**：**「Audits every fix with **explainable rules**: impossible jumps, speed and altitude physics, **integrity below 14 CFR 91.227 minimums**, replayed fixes, ghosts, emergency and hijack codes **with confirmation tiers**, holding, level busts, coverage gaps, stream floods and collapses, cross-feed disagreement, watchlists. **Every finding maps to a control reference and a response playbook.**」**，**機器學習逐字**「Learns the airspace’s normal envelope with **per-regime IsolationForests over twelve kinematic features, percentile-calibrated, with two-fix persistence before a finding is raised**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩點值得單獨記**：①**「每一條發現都映射到一個控制引用與一份響應手冊」**——**「發現了什麼」與「因此該做什麼」被顯式連起來**；②**「需連續兩次報點才升級為發現」是一條**抑制誤報的去抖規則****（**⚠️ 不主張**該規則能消除誤報**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **流水線與包結構逐字，含一處關鍵架構命名**：**流水線**「live feeds（adsb.lol、OpenSky、NOAA METAR、FAA NAS status）→ normalize（StateVector）→ **JSONL recording（replayable）** → TrackStore（kinematics）→ **rules + ML + watchlist** → findings（SEC／OPS／SAF、ML-001 流檢查）→ **risk score → trust ledger → alerts**」**，**另有兩條旁路**（**two feeds → cross-feed corroboration (dead-reckoned) → SEC-015**；**imagery → YOLO (tiled) → apron zone occupancy → OPS-VIS findings**）；**包結構逐字含** `ingest/`（adsblol、opensky、metar、faa_status、replay、http curl fallback）、`stream/`、**`provenance.py`**、`features/`、`audit/`（rules、findings、**policy（precision-weighted score）**、engine、reports）、`ml/`（IsolationForest model、trainer、**registry（checksum gate）**、evaluation harness）、`security/`**⭐⭐ **「risk score → **trust ledger**」這一環值得注意**（**⚠️ 未讀源碼，不主張該台賬設計**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **報告與風險登記的統計方法逐字**：**「Reports: **JSON, Markdown, self-contained HTML**, each with **provenance and a manifest of SHA-256 hashes**; **risk register with Wilson-bound likelihoods and residual risk**; **holding impact in fuel, CO2 and delay cost**.」**⭐⭐ **「Wilson 置信界」被用於**似然****——**以**二項比例的置信區間**而非點估計表達風險登記的頻率**；**而把**等待的代價折算為燃油、CO₂ 與延誤成本**，**是把運行影響貨幣化的一種具體做法**（**⚠️ 不主張**其折算係數或適用性**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **演示設計逐字且含一處重要的資料出處與許可**：**「The demo replays a bundled sample of **real traffic (15 US hubs, 3,900 aircraft, adsb.lol, ODbL)** at 10x with a **scripted tour** that injects **eight attack scenarios** on a timeline. **The banner narrates each one and says what should fire.** Press **F2** for the map, **F6** for findings, **F8** for the hash-chained audit log…」**⭐⭐ **三點值得記**：①資料來自 adsb.lol 且**明確標註 ODbL 許可**；②演示是一條**帶解說的劇本化巡演**，**每個攻擊情景都說明「應當觸發什麼」**；③審計日誌被做成**可按鍵查看的介面元素**（F8）。**⑨ ⭐ **其餘能力逐字**：**攝取**（adsb.lol 含完整性欄位 **NIC／NACp／SIL**；OpenSky 全國框；NOAA METAR；FAA NAS status；**全部無需密鑰**；一切錄為**可回放的 JSONL**）；**生態理解**（**132 個北美機場、約 80 家運營人、約 180 種機型**、按場高判定飛行階段、FAA 地面停止與延誤程序）；**視覺**（停機坪影像上的**分塊 YOLOv8 檢測**與區域佔用發現，**自述為可選項**）。**⑩ ⭐ **一鍵跑起來逐字**：`scripts/bootstrap.sh`（macOS／Linux：建 .venv、**經哈希校驗的安裝**、健康檢查、打開演示）、Windows `bootstrap.ps1`、容器 `docker run --rm -p 127.0.0.1:8787:8787 …`、已裝好則 `make demo`**；**介面為**終端風格（Bloomberg 式黑底琥珀色）、帶助記命令行、功能鍵、行情條、可繪數千架飛機的畫布地圖、下拉篩選、可排序表格、隨處可導出 CSV、後台任務、實時閾值調節與應用內文檔****。**⑪ ⭐ 可與 [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]、[[claims-fraud-guardian]]、[[networkfraud]]、[[cybrisk]]、[[openriskscore]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[claim-to-confidence]]、[[proof-protocol]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ **範圍必須寫清，且與本站的一處真空白有關**：**該倉庫是**航空監視安全**（ADS-B 完整性與欺騙檢測、流異常）工具，**不是航空保險**，**README 全文**未涉及承保、費率、條款或航空險市場**；**本站「航空險」這一**真空白**在連續多輪中**未被填補****（**第 327 輪曾確立其在 GitHub 上屬結構性缺席**）；**本詞條**明確不把本條計入航空險的覆蓋，也不主張該空白被填補****——⭐ **唯一可記的聯繫是它使用**航空域**的公開資料與**風險／審計**方法**，**屬方法層面的類比，不是險種資料**；**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、topics、README 全文的定位段、五分鐘上手、能力清單、兩節 Trustworthy by construction、流水線與包結構、報告與風險登記說明、演示說明與運行方式**，**並以 raw 探測確認 `LICENSE`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`docs/DEMO.md` 存在（HTTP 200）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未運行 `scripts/bootstrap.sh` 或 `make demo`、未啟動其本地應用、未運行 `aero evaluate`、未查看其演示或任何報告、未讀 `aero_audit/` 下任何源碼、未讀 `SECURITY.md` 與 `docs/` 下任何文檔、未打開 `docs/img/` 下任何截圖****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**其八個攻擊情景下的**召回率、發現時延與逐規則精度**——**本次未運行 `aero evaluate`**，**只記錄其自述方法**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**「其中兩個情景是已知缺口」具體指哪兩個、以及缺口有多大**——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**「精度權重進入風險評分」在實現中確實成立**（**包結構中 `policy (precision-weighted score)` 為其自述命名**）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核實**審計日誌確為哈希鏈、且 `aero log verify` 能指認被增刪改序的行**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未做任何安全評估**——**其列出的 DNS 重綁定防護、每 POST 令牌、CSP、路徑限制與模型哈希門均為其自述**，**不主張**其實際安全**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其演示所用 adsb.lol 資料的**ODbL 許可標註與再利用條件**是否符合該許可要求**（**未查閱 ODbL 原文，亦未核實 adsb.lol 的使用條款**）；**⑧ ⭐ **未核實**其「132 個北美機場、約 80 家運營人、約 180 種機型」等參考資料的來源與時效**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其「never transmits anything」這一網路行為聲明**——**本次未做任何流量觀測**；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主張**其與任何航空監管機構、機場或資料提供方存在認可、授權或背書關係**；**⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ **其 topic 含 `portfolio`****（**暗示作者將其定位為作品集項目**）；**不主張**其可用於任何真實的航空安全監視、運行決策或監管用途**；**⑫ ⭐ ★0、fork 0**，**不主張成熟度／正確性／已被採用**（**儘管其工程深度、安全自覺與文檔量在本會話收集的專案中位居前列**）；**⑬ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/monykiss/aero-audit` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 17,369 位元組經 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 實測逐字核對；三個關鍵檔案經 raw 探測確認存在；**未克隆、未運行、未啟動、未做安全評估、未讀源碼與文檔**。
