**aero-audit** is **an end-to-end aviation surveillance auditing system** (repository `monykiss/aero-audit`), with **measured MIT licence (`LICENSE` measured 200 on main), ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language (self-described as requiring 3.12+), a 3,985 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **ten topics measurably present**: **`ads-b`, `anomaly-detection`, `aviation`, `computer-vision`, `machine-learning`, `portfolio`, `python`, `risk-management`, `security` and `surveillance`**; **the README measures 17,369 bytes** and **describes version 0.4.0**; **key files measurably present**: **`LICENSE`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/DEMO.md`**. **⚠️ One scope point must be stated at the outset**: **this is aviation surveillance security (ADS-B integrity and spoofing detection), not aviation insurance**; **it does not fill this site’s true-zero aviation-insurance gap** (**see note ① below**). It is the fourth of this round’s four takes on **separating "what I observed" from "what I therefore conclude"**, **and the only one that writes "how accurate am I actually" directly into its scoring formula**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): **the positioning reads verbatim**: **"Aviation surveillance auditing, end to end. aero-audit follows real aircraft from public ADS-B feeds, checks every position report against physics, integrity and safety rules plus an anomaly model, measures its own detection accuracy with injected attacks, scores risk from the evidence, and shows all of it in a terminal-style local app whose every action and report is tamper-evident."**; **with the declaration verbatim**: **"It runs offline in one command, on any machine, and never transmits anything."**

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Measuring itself with injected attacks and then feeding the measured precision into the score as weights is the entry’s most important point, and the most thorough case this session has seen of self-measurement being plumbed back into production judgement** — verbatim: **"Measures itself: `aero evaluate` perturbs real aircraft with eight attack scenarios and reports recall, time-to-detect and per-rule precision. Those numbers weight the risk score and the risk register; two scenarios are known gaps and are reported as such."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three points deserve separate note**: **① the precision figures are not for a paper but are inputs to the scoring formula** (**its package structure corroborates this verbatim**: `audit/` contains **`policy (precision-weighted score)`**); **② two scenarios cannot be caught at all, and rather than deleting them from the metric or glossing over them it explicitly lists them as known gaps**; **③ against this site’s recurring theme of writing boundaries on the face of the work, this is one of the strongest forms — earlier rounds were mostly textual declarations, whereas here the uncatchable is inside the metric report itself** (**readable with round 331’s [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] and its reconciliation placeholders, and round 332’s [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] and its PR-AUC of 1.00 as a bug report**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim its eight scenarios are sufficient or that the two gaps have been quantified — `aero evaluate` was not run**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ The "Trustworthy by construction — two things a reviewer can check rather than take on faith" section is the entry’s most notable verifiability point** — ⭐⭐ **that phrasing — letting a reviewer check for themselves rather than take it on faith — is this round’s theme stated directly**. **Its first item, "Auditable", reads verbatim**: **"The app’s audit log is a hash chain: every entry carries the SHA-256 of the one before it and of itself, so an edited, deleted or reordered line is named by `aero log verify` and by the CHAIN VERIFIED badge on the Audit log page. Every report ships with a provenance block (tool version, git commit, input recording and its hash, model hash and registry status, evaluation hash, threshold overrides) and a manifest that `aero log verify-report` … re-hash. Injected demo traffic is flagged in every finding."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three points deserve separate note**: **① the hash chain does not merely resist tampering but names which line was edited, deleted or reordered**; **② every report carries a seven-field provenance block**; **③ injected demo traffic is flagged in every finding, so synthetic and real data are distinguishable at the output layer** (**readable with round 330’s [[catrisk-sim]] and round 332’s [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]] — all three authors refuse to let synthetic data pass as real results**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its "Secure by default" section reads verbatim and is the most concrete treatment of local-service security this session has seen** — verbatim: **"A server on 127.0.0.1 is reachable from every web page you have open, so the app validates the `Host` header against DNS rebinding, requires a per-process token on every POST (which forces the CORS preflight the server never grants), checks `Origin` and `Sec-Fetch-Site`, serves a strict Content-Security-Policy with no inline script, confines every path parameter to the project’s data directories, accepts only `http(s)` webhooks, and loads a model only when its SHA-256 matches the registry that `aero train` wrote. Binding beyond loopback requires a token on every API call."** ⭐⭐⭐ **The premise worth remembering is that a localhost server is reachable from every web page you have open**; **and "a model is loaded only when its SHA-256 matches the registry written at training time" is a model-integrity gate students can borrow directly** (**⚠️ no security assessment was performed, so the entry does not claim the protections are complete**). **④ ⭐⭐ Its supply-chain and CI arrangements read verbatim and are concrete**: **"Dependencies install with `--require-hashes` from a universal lock; CI runs ruff, pytest, docs-drift, `pip-audit`, gitleaks over the full history, CodeQL and a container smoke test, with every action pinned to a commit SHA."** ⭐⭐ **Two things are unusual**: **`--require-hashes` from a universal lock (locking content rather than just versions)**, **and a `docs-drift` check — verifying that documentation has not drifted from the implementation** (**readable with round 329’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] and its pre-commit hook that regenerates the workflow diagram — both fight documentation drift**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ The division between rules and model reads verbatim and lands this round’s theme inside its architecture** — verbatim: **"Audits every fix with explainable rules: impossible jumps, speed and altitude physics, integrity below 14 CFR 91.227 minimums, replayed fixes, ghosts, emergency and hijack codes with confirmation tiers, holding, level busts, coverage gaps, stream floods and collapses, cross-feed disagreement, watchlists. Every finding maps to a control reference and a response playbook."**, **with the machine learning reading verbatim**: **"Learns the airspace’s normal envelope with per-regime IsolationForests over twelve kinematic features, percentile-calibrated, with two-fix persistence before a finding is raised."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Two points deserve separate note**: **① "every finding maps to a control reference and a response playbook" explicitly links what was found to what should therefore be done — precisely this round’s theme**; **② "two-fix persistence before a finding is raised" is a debouncing rule to suppress false positives** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim it eliminates them**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its pipeline and package structure read verbatim and include one architecturally significant name**: **the pipeline reads "live feeds (adsb.lol, OpenSky, NOAA METAR, FAA NAS status) → normalize (StateVector) → JSONL recording (replayable) → TrackStore (kinematics) → rules + ML + watchlist → findings (SEC/OPS/SAF, ML-001 stream checks) → risk score → trust ledger → alerts"**, **with two side paths (two feeds → cross-feed corroboration, dead-reckoned → SEC-015; imagery → YOLO tiled → apron zone occupancy → OPS-VIS findings)**; **and the package structure includes `ingest/` (adsblol, opensky, metar, faa_status, replay, http curl fallback), `stream/`, `provenance.py`, `features/`, `audit/` (rules, findings, `policy (precision-weighted score)`, engine, reports), `ml/` (IsolationForest model, trainer, `registry (checksum gate)`, evaluation harness) and `security/`** ⭐⭐ **The "risk score → trust ledger" step deserves note** (**⚠️ its design was not read**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its reporting and risk-register statistics read verbatim and are more careful than comparable projects**: **"Reports: JSON, Markdown, self-contained HTML, each with provenance and a manifest of SHA-256 hashes; risk register with Wilson-bound likelihoods and residual risk; holding impact in fuel, CO2 and delay cost."** ⭐⭐ **Wilson confidence bounds are used for the likelihoods — expressing a risk register’s frequency as a binomial confidence interval rather than a point estimate — and the cost of holding is monetised in fuel, CO2 and delay** (**⚠️ the conversion factors and their applicability were not verified**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its demo design reads verbatim and includes an important data source and licence**: **"The demo replays a bundled sample of real traffic (15 US hubs, 3,900 aircraft, adsb.lol, ODbL) at 10x with a scripted tour that injects eight attack scenarios on a timeline. The banner narrates each one and says what should fire. Press F2 for the map, F6 for findings, F8 for the hash-chained audit log, click SND to hear alerts."** ⭐⭐ **Three points**: **the data comes from adsb.lol with its ODbL licence stated explicitly**; **the demo is a narrated scripted tour in which each attack scenario says what should fire, so output can be compared against expectation**; **and the audit log is a press-to-view interface element (F8), not just a backend file**. **⑨ ⭐ Its remaining capabilities read verbatim and are clearly bounded**: **ingestion** (adsb.lol with integrity fields **NIC/NACp/SIL**, OpenSky whole-country boxes, NOAA METARs, the FAA NAS status feed, **all keyless**, everything recorded as **replayable JSONL**); **ecosystem knowledge** (**132 North American airports, about 80 operators, about 180 aircraft types**, flight phases from altitude above field, FAA ground stops and delay programs); **vision** (tiled YOLOv8 detection on apron imagery with zone-occupancy findings, **self-described as optional**). **⑩ ⭐ Running it reads verbatim**: **`scripts/bootstrap.sh` (macOS/Linux: creates the .venv, a hash-verified install, a health check and opens the demo), Windows `bootstrap.ps1`, a container `docker run --rm -p 127.0.0.1:8787:8787 …`, or `make demo` once set up**; **the interface is a Bloomberg-style black-and-amber terminal with a mnemonic command line, function keys, a ticker, a canvas map for thousands of aircraft, dropdown filters, sortable grids, CSV everywhere, background jobs, live threshold tuning and in-app docs**. **⑪ ⭐ Readable with the site’s risk-detection, audit and provenance entries**: [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]], [[claims-fraud-guardian]], [[networkfraud]], [[cybrisk]], [[openriskscore]], [[reproducible-actuarial-work]], [[insurance-governance]], [[claim-to-confidence]] and [[proof-protocol]] (**this round’s sibling entry, which turns "evidence travels with the claim" into a protocol**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Scope must be stated clearly and it bears on a true-zero gap here: this repository is an aviation surveillance security tool (ADS-B integrity and spoofing detection, stream anomalies), not aviation insurance, and its README never touches underwriting, rates, terms or the aviation insurance market**; **this site’s true-zero aviation-insurance gap has not been filled across many rounds** (**round 327 established it is structurally absent from GitHub**); **the entry explicitly does not count this against aviation insurance coverage and does not claim the gap has been filled** — ⭐ **the only connection worth recording is that it uses aviation-domain public data and risk/audit methods, which is a methodological analogy rather than line-of-business material**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, topics, and the README’s full 17,369 bytes covering its positioning, sixty-second start, capability list, both "Trustworthy by construction" subsections, pipeline and package structure, reporting and risk-register notes, and demo and run instructions**, **and confirmed by raw probe that `LICENSE`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/DEMO.md` exist (HTTP 200)**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, run `scripts/bootstrap.sh` or `make demo`, start its local app, run `aero evaluate`, view its demo or any report, read any source under `aero_audit/`, read `SECURITY.md` or anything under `docs/`, or open any screenshot under `docs/img/`**, so **its rule implementations, IsolationForest features and calibration, risk-score formula, Wilson-bound computation, actual provenance field values and any metric cannot be restated**; **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its recall, time-to-detect and per-rule precision under the eight attack scenarios were not verified** — **`aero evaluate` was not run**; **the entry records only the described method and claims no figures**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Which two scenarios are the known gaps, and how large those gaps are, was not verified** — **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **the entry does not claim the gap has been quantified**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether "precision weights the risk score" actually holds in the implementation was not verified** (**the package name `policy (precision-weighted score)` is the project’s own naming**); **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether the audit log really is a hash chain and whether `aero log verify` can name edited, deleted or reordered lines was not verified**; **only that the README describes it so**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ No security assessment was performed** — **the listed DNS-rebinding defence, per-POST token, CSP, path confinement and model hash gate are all the project’s own account**; **the entry does not claim it is actually secure**; **⑦ ⭐⭐ Whether the ODbL licence attribution and reuse conditions for the adsb.lol data used in the demo are satisfied was not verified** (**the ODbL text was not consulted, nor adsb.lol’s terms**); **⑧ ⭐ The provenance and currency of its reference data (132 airports, about 80 operators, about 180 aircraft types) were not verified**; **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ The "never transmits anything" network-behaviour claim was not verified** — **no traffic observation was performed**; **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ The entry does not claim any recognition, authorisation or endorsement by any aviation regulator, airport or data provider** (**the README makes no such claim, and none was verified**); **⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ Its topics include `portfolio`** (**suggesting the author positions it as portfolio work**); **the entry does not claim it is usable for any real aviation safety surveillance, operational decision or regulatory purpose** — **air safety and aviation security are heavily regulated domains, and the project describes itself as local, offline and non-transmitting**; **⑫ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks attention is very low** (**despite engineering depth, security awareness and documentation volume that rank among the highest of projects collected in this session**); **⑬ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/monykiss/aero-audit` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence, stars, language, size, created/pushed dates and ten topics); the 17,369-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; **`LICENSE`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/DEMO.md` were confirmed present by raw probe (HTTP 200)**; **nothing cloned, run or started, no security assessment performed, and neither the source nor the docs read**.
entries.verified_note: GitHub API 实测（repo，2026-09-11）：MIT 许可（LICENSE 于 main 分支 raw 实测 200）｜★0｜fork 0｜Python（自述要求 3.12+）｜3,985 KB｜created 与 pushed 均为 2026-09-10（在解冻窗口内）｜topics 10 项：ads-b、anomaly-detection、aviation、computer-vision、machine-learning、portfolio、python、risk-management、security、surveillance｜README 17,369 字节｜自述版本 0.4.0；raw 探测确认存在的关键文件：LICENSE、CHANGELOG.md、docs/DEMO.md（均 HTTP 200）；⚠️⚠️**范围必须写清，且与本站一处真空白有关**：该仓库是**航空监视安全**（ADS-B 完整性与欺骗检测、流异常）工具，**不是航空保险**，README 全文**未涉及承保、费率、条款或航空险市场**；本站「航空险」这一真空白**未被填补**（第 327 轮曾确立其在 GitHub 上属结构性缺席），**本词条明确不把本条计入航空险的覆盖，也不主张该空白被填补**——唯一可记的联系是它使用航空域公开数据与风险/审计方法，属方法层面类比而非险种资料；定位逐字「**Aviation surveillance auditing, end to end.** aero-audit follows real aircraft from public ADS-B feeds, checks every position report **against physics, integrity and safety rules plus an anomaly model**, **measures its own detection accuracy with injected attacks**, **scores risk from the evidence**, and shows all of it in a terminal-style local app whose **every action and report is tamper-evident**.」及「It runs **offline in one command**, on any machine, and **never transmits anything**.」；⭐⭐⭐「用注入攻击测自己、再把测出的精度当权重写进评分」逐字「**Measures itself**: `aero evaluate` perturbs real aircraft with **eight attack scenarios** and reports **recall, time-to-detect and per-rule precision**. **Those numbers weight the risk score and the risk register; two scenarios are known gaps and are reported as such.**」——三点已分别写明：①精度是评分公式的输入（包结构逐字印证 audit/ 下含 policy (precision-weighted score)）；②两个情景测不到而它**明确列为已知缺口**而非删除或含糊；③这是本会话「把边界写在明面上」强度最高的形态之一（前几轮多为文字声明，这里把测不到的项进了指标报告本身），并已与第 331 轮 aida-tix-anomaly-detection 的占位符、第 332 轮 insurance-fraud-risk-scoring 的「PR-AUC 1.00 是 bug 报告」建立并读关系；⭐⭐⭐「Trustworthy by construction — Two things a reviewer can check rather than take on faith.」一节的 Auditable 条逐字「The app’s audit log is **a hash chain: every entry carries the SHA-256 of the one before it and of itself**, so **an edited, deleted or reordered line is named by `aero log verify`** and by the **CHAIN VERIFIED** badge on the Audit log page. **Every report ships with a provenance block (tool version, git commit, input recording and its hash, model hash and registry status, evaluation hash, threshold overrides)** and a manifest that `aero log verify-report` … re-hash. **Injected demo traffic is flagged in every finding.**」——三点已写明（哈希链能指认具体行；每份报告带七项溯源块；注入的演示流量在每条发现里都被标记，演示与真实数据在输出层面可区分，并与第 330 轮 catrisk-sim、第 332 轮 guidewire-claim-intelligence 建立并读关系）；⭐⭐⭐「Secure by default」逐字「A server on 127.0.0.1 is reachable from every web page you have open, so the app **validates the `Host` header against DNS rebinding**, requires a **per-process token on every POST** (which **forces the CORS preflight the server never grants**), checks `Origin` and `Sec-Fetch-Site`, serves a **strict Content-Security-Policy with no inline script**, **confines every path parameter to the project’s data directories**, accepts only `http(s)` webhooks, and **loads a model only when its SHA-256 matches the registry that `aero train` wrote**. **Binding beyond loopback requires a token on every API call.**」——「localhost 服务器对你打开的每一个网页都是可达的」这一前提与「模型哈希门」可借用性已写明（并注明未做任何安全评估）；⭐⭐供应链与 CI 逐字「Dependencies install with **`--require-hashes`** from a universal lock; CI runs **ruff, pytest, docs-drift, `pip-audit`, gitleaks over the full history, CodeQL** and a container smoke test, **with every action pinned to a commit SHA**.」——--require-hashes 与 docs-drift 两点少见之处已写明（docs-drift 与第 329 轮 reinsurance-treaty-agent 的 pre-commit 图重生成并读）；⭐⭐⭐规则与模型分工逐字「Audits every fix with **explainable rules**: impossible jumps, speed and altitude physics, **integrity below 14 CFR 91.227 minimums**, replayed fixes, ghosts, emergency and hijack codes **with confirmation tiers**, holding, level busts, coverage gaps, stream floods and collapses, cross-feed disagreement, watchlists. **Every finding maps to a control reference and a response playbook.**」与「Learns the airspace’s normal envelope with **per-regime IsolationForests over twelve kinematic features, percentile-calibrated, with two-fix persistence before a finding is raised**.」——「每条发现映射到控制引用与响应手册」（发现什么与因此该做什么被显式连起来）与「两次报点才升级」的去抖规则两点已写明；⭐⭐流水线与包结构逐字（live feeds→normalize→JSONL recording→TrackStore→rules+ML+watchlist→findings（SEC/OPS/SAF、ML-001）→risk score→trust ledger→alerts；旁路 cross-feed corroboration→SEC-015 与 imagery→YOLO→OPS-VIS；包含 ingest/、stream/、provenance.py、features/、audit/（含 policy (precision-weighted score)）、ml/（含 registry (checksum gate)）、security/）；⭐⭐报告与风险登记逐字「Reports: **JSON, Markdown, self-contained HTML**, each with **provenance and a manifest of SHA-256 hashes**; **risk register with Wilson-bound likelihoods and residual risk**; **holding impact in fuel, CO2 and delay cost**.」——Wilson 置信界用于似然、等待代价折算为燃油/CO₂/延误成本两点已写明；⭐⭐演示逐字「The demo replays a bundled sample of **real traffic (15 US hubs, 3,900 aircraft, adsb.lol, ODbL)** at 10x with a **scripted tour** that injects **eight attack scenarios** on a timeline. **The banner narrates each one and says what should fire.** Press **F2** for the map, **F6** for findings, **F8** for the hash-chained audit log…」——ODbL 许可具名标注、剧本化巡演说明「应当触发什么」、审计日志做成可按键查看的界面元素三点已写明；⭐其余能力逐字（adsb.lol 含 NIC/NACp/SIL 完整性字段、OpenSky 全国框、NOAA METAR、FAA NAS status，全部无需密钥，录为可回放 JSONL；132 个北美机场、约 80 家运营人、约 180 种机型；停机坪分块 YOLOv8 检测自述为可选）；⭐运行逐字（scripts/bootstrap.sh 含经哈希校验的安装与健康检查、Windows bootstrap.ps1、docker run、make demo；介面为 Bloomberg 式终端风格并含数千架飞机的画布地图等）；⚠️未克隆、未运行 scripts/bootstrap.sh 或 make demo、未启动其本地应用、未运行 aero evaluate、未查看其演示或任何报告、未读 aero_audit/ 下任何源码、未读 SECURITY.md 与 docs/ 下任何文档、未打开 docs/img/ 下任何截图，故不转述规则实现/IsolationForest 特征与标定/风险评分公式/Wilson 界计算方式/溯源块实际字段值/任何指标数值；⚠️⚠️**未核实**其八个攻击情景下的召回率、发现时延与逐规则精度（未运行 aero evaluate），只记录其自述方法；⚠️⚠️**未核实**「其中两个情景是已知缺口」具体指哪两个、以及缺口有多大——**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；⚠️⚠️未核实「精度权重进入风险评分」在实现中确实成立（policy (precision-weighted score) 为其自述命名）；⚠️未核实审计日志确为哈希链、且 aero log verify 能指认被增删改序的行；⚠️⚠️未做任何安全评估——其列出的 DNS 重绑定防护、每 POST 令牌、CSP、路径限制与模型哈希门均为其自述，不主张其实际安全；⚠️未核实其演示所用 adsb.lol 数据的 ODbL 许可标注与再利用条件是否符合该许可要求（未查 ODbL 原文，亦未核实 adsb.lol 使用条款）；⚠️未核实其「132 个北美机场、约 80 家运营人、约 180 种机型」等参考数据的来源与时效；⚠️⚠️未核实其「never transmits anything」这一网络行为声明（未做任何流量观测）；⚠️不主张其与任何航空监管机构、机场或数据提供方存在认可、授权或背书关系；⚠️其 topic 含 portfolio（暗示作者将其定位为作品集项目），不主张其可用于任何真实的航空安全监视、运行决策或监管用途；★0、fork 0 故不主张成熟度/正确性/已被采用（尽管其工程深度、安全自觉与文档量在本会话收集的项目中位居前列）；是否有中文材料未核实

entries.title_en: A Chinese restaurant-insurance quoting MVP covering public liability, food-safety liability and employer liability, with rule data carrying an explicit version number
entries.title_hk: 餐飲保險智能報價器：公眾責任險／食品安全責任險／雇主責任險三類中文險種的規則報價 MVP，規則數據帶版本號
entries.summary: 一个面向中国餐饮企业的移动端保费预估工具：三类真实商业险种（公众责任险、食品安全责任险、雇主责任险）可单选或组合报价，按经营面积自动匹配保费系数，雇主责任险按保障方案、岗位人数与八人起保门槛计算；报价引擎是与界面解耦的纯 TypeScript 模块且规则数据按版本管理，结果区分正常报价、部分报价、人工报价与不符合承保条件四种状态
entries.summary_hk: 一個面向中國餐飲企業的移動端保費預估工具：三類真實商業險種（公眾責任險、食品安全責任險、雇主責任險）可單選或組合報價，按經營面積自動匹配保費係數，雇主責任險按保障方案、崗位人數與八人起保門檻計算；報價引擎是與界面解耦的純 TypeScript 模組且規則數據按版本管理，結果區分正常報價、部分報價、人工報價與不符合承保條件四種狀態
entries.summary_en: A mobile premium estimation tool for Chinese restaurant businesses: three real commercial lines (public liability, food-safety liability and employer liability) can be quoted individually or in combination, with premium coefficients matched automatically by operating area and employer liability computed from the protection plan, headcount per role and a minimum eight-person underwriting threshold; the quoting engine is a pure TypeScript module decoupled from the UI, its rule data is managed by version, and results distinguish four states — normal quote, partial quote, manual quote and not eligible for underwriting
entries.body:
**restaurant-insurance-quote**（餐饮保险智能报价器）是一个**面向中国餐饮企业的移动端保费预估工具**（仓库 `BenjaminNH/restaurant-insurance-quote`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 1,356 KB、创建于 2026-09-07、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，均落在解冻窗口或其之后**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 未出现于其文档结构，且 README 对此有**明确声明**——见下方标注 ①）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 3,310 字节（中文）**。**已实测存在的关键文件**：**`package.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md`**（**该两个中文名文档经 raw 探测实测 HTTP 200**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「把边界写成清单」**中的**第一种，也是**中文险种**在这批候选中最集中的一条**（**本站此前多轮词条均以「是否有中文材料未核实」收尾，本条整条为中文且险种名即为中文实务名称**）。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其定位逐字为**：**「一个面向餐饮企业客户的移动端保险保费预估工具。用户可以选择**公众责任险、食品安全责任险和雇主责任险**方案，填写单一门店及员工人数信息，快速获得标准规则下的预估保费。」**；**并逐字说明当前形态为**：**「当前项目为可独立运行的 **MVP 静态前端**，重点验证移动端报价流程、规则计算和**异常报价状态**。」**。**其核心功能逐字实测**：**「三类险种可独立选择，也可组合报价。」**；**「公众责任险和食品安全责任险**根据经营面积自动匹配保费系数**。」**；**「雇主责任险根据保障方案、岗位人数和**最低 8 人承保门槛**计算。」**；**「支持**正常报价、部分报价、人工报价和不符合承保条件**等结果状态。」**；**「展示**责任限额、免赔条件、投保资料**和对应的处理提示。」**；**「使用会话草稿保存填写进度，刷新页面后可继续操作。」**；**「针对移动端输入、软键盘遮挡、底部安全区域和触摸操作进行了适配。」**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **三条中文险种名与它们的报价维度逐字实测，是本条目对中国保险实务学生最直接有用的一处**——**公众责任险（按经营面积匹配系数）**、**食品安全责任险（同按经营面积）**、**雇主责任险（按保障方案、岗位人数与**最低 8 人承保门槛**）**。⭐⭐ **「八人起保」这一门槛本身是一条**具体的承保实务约束****（**雇主责任险通常对小规模雇主设最低投保人数**），**而「按经营面积匹配保费系数」则是**场所类责任险的典型费率结构**；**对不熟悉中国商业险条款的学生，这三点是把**险种—风险暴露—费率驱动因素**串起来的最小样本**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这三个险种的费率结构在中国市场上确如此**——**本次未查任何保险公司条款或监管费率表**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「报价引擎采用与 UI 解耦的纯 TypeScript 模块，规则数据按版本管理」是本条目在工程上最值得记的一句**——**逐字见上**（**原文为「报价引擎采用与 UI 解耦的纯 TypeScript 模块，规则数据按版本管理」**）。⭐⭐ **这句话同时含两个要点**：**① **引擎与界面解耦**——使规则可被单独测试与替换**；**② **规则数据按版本管理**——使「这次报价用的是哪一版规则」成为可回答的问题****。**其 README 另逐字给出**当前规则版本为 `mvp-1.1`**，**并直接链接两份可打开的文件**：【保费规则说明】（`docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md`）与【结构化规则配置】（`docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json`）**⭐⭐ **而这两份文件**经 raw 探测实测确实存在（HTTP 200）****——**即「规则说明」与「机器可读的规则数据」同时公开**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读该两份文件的内容**——**本次只核实其存在**；**故**不转述任何保费公式、系数取值或承保边界**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **四种结果状态中「人工报价」与「不符合承保条件」是本轮主题的核心样本**——**逐字为「支持**正常报价、部分报价、人工报价和不符合承保条件**等结果状态」**⭐⭐ **即报价系统**不是只有「给出价格」一条出路****：**它可以**报一部分**（部分报价）、**转人工**（人工报价）、**或直接说明不可承保**（不符合承保条件）**——**这与本站连续多轮出现的同一条纪律同源**（**第 329 轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 flagging-not-blocking、第 331 轮 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的抑制误报、**本轮 [[insurance-rag-assistant]] 的 `answer_status`、以及 [[claimlens]] 的四类状态**）；**本条的特殊之处在于它把这套状态**用在报价环节**而非核保或理赔环节**——**即**在客户还只是问价时就说清「这个不能按标准规则报」****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该四态设计符合任何保险公司的实际报价流程**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「当前限制」一节逐字列了五条，是本轮主题最直接的形态**——**其一**：**「MVP 仅支持**单一门店**报价，不处理多门店合并报价。」**；**其二**：**「员工年龄条件在正式投保时核验，**当前页面不采集员工年龄明细**。」**；**其三**：**「尚未接入客户留资、数据库、员工个性化配置或管理后台。」**；**其四**：**「报价计算在**浏览器端**完成；**未来保存报价时需要由服务端按输入和规则版本重新计算**。」**；**其五**：**「结果页显示的业务手机号为**演示号码**，不能作为正式咨询渠道。」**⭐⭐⭐ **第四条尤其值得单独记住**：**它指出**客户端算出的价格若被保存，就必须由服务端按「输入＋规则版本」重算****——**即**防止客户端报价被当作权威记录****；**对做保险系统的同学，这是一条**很容易被忽略却直接影响可审计性**的设计约束**（**可与第 331 轮 [[paco-uw]] 的「改规则会改变过去报价的重新求值结果」并读——**两者都在处理**报价与规则版本的时间关系****）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **免责声明逐字，且把「替代什么」列得很具体**——**「本项目**仅用于咨询阶段的保费预估**，**不替代保险核心系统、正式核保或正式出单**。最终承保范围、保费及条款**以保险公司审核和正式保单为准**。」**⭐⭐ **三点合起来界定了**这份估算不能用于什么****（**不替代核心系统、不替代核保、不替代出单**）；**对做报价系统的学生，这是**把「输出不是承诺」写成业务语言**的样本**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其免责声明在任何辖区具有法律效力**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **技术栈与工程配置逐字且可核实**：**Next.js App Router、React、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS、React Hook Form、Zod、**Vitest、Playwright****；**两条命令逐字**：**`npm run check`（**lint、类型检查、单元测试与静态构建**）**与 **`npm run test:e2e`（端到端测试）**；**静态构建产物生成在 `out/`**，**可部署到任何静态托管**；⭐ **即**单元测试与端到端测试分开，且静态构建被纳入 `check`****（**⚠️ 本词条**未运行任何一条**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **移动端适配逐字实测且列出了具体处理项**：**「针对移动端输入、软键盘遮挡、底部安全区域和触摸操作进行了适配」**——⭐ **「软键盘遮挡」与「底部安全区域」是**真实移动端报价流程中会实际出问题**的两处**（**对做保险移动端的同学，这类细节通常不在需求文档里而在上线后才被发现**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **文档结构逐字实测，含三份设计文档**：**「技术选型」（技术架构、静态导出方案及后续演进方向）**、**「MVP 开发与验收」（当前功能范围、测试方式与已知限制）**、**「移动端 UX 设计说明」（移动端信息层级和交互设计原则）**，**另有「保费规则说明」与「结构化规则配置」**⭐⭐ **对做课程项目的学生，这套**功能范围／测试方式／已知限制**三件事并列的交付文档是一种可直接照搬的结构**。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站报价引擎与中文保险条目并读**：[[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[insurance-pricing-demo]]、[[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[insurance-exam-bank-cn]]、[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]]、[[ruc-nonlife-actuarial]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **许可情形在本条属**第三种形态**，且是作者**主动写明**的**：**README 末节逐字为**：**「**本仓库当前未附加开源许可证。公开内容仅供查看与交流，未经许可不得复制、修改或分发。**」**——**即**不只是「沉默」，而是**明确声明保留全部权利**（**⚠️ 本词条据此提示：**复制、修改或分发该仓库内容均需先获授权****；**⚠️ 这与本站此前记录的两种形态不同**：第 330／331 轮的 [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、[[insurerisk]]、[[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 等属「**声称许可而无许可文件**」（**声明与实际不一致**），而 [[claim-ops]] 与 [[paco-uw]] 属「**完全未声明**」，**本条是**明确声明无许可****——**三者的使用者风险相近，但本条的可判断性最高**）；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README（3,310 字节）全文的定位段、核心功能六条、技术栈、运行与测试命令、业务规则与免责声明、当前限制五条、相关文档索引与许可声明**，**并以 raw 探测确认 `package.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md` 均存在（HTTP 200）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未 `npm install`、未运行 `npm run dev`／`check`／`test:e2e`、未读 `docs/` 下**任何文件的内容**（**含规则说明与规则 JSON**）、未读任何组件源码、未查看其界面或在移动设备上试运行****，因此**不能转述其保费公式、系数取值、承保边界、状态判定条件或任何报价结果**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其「公众责任险与食品安全责任险按经营面积匹配系数」与「雇主责任险八人起保」是否与中国市场上任何保险公司的实际条款或费率一致**——**本次未查任何保险公司条款、监管费率表或行业示范条款**；**本词条只记录其在 README 中被如此描述**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其四种结果状态（正常／部分／人工／不符合承保条件）的判定规则与阈值**（**未读规则 JSON**）；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**「规则数据按版本管理」的实际实现**（**其 README 自述当前版本为 `mvp-1.1`**）；**亦未核实**「报价引擎与 UI 解耦」在代码中是否成立**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「未读的两份中文规则文件」的完整性与准确性**——**⚠️ 其存在经 raw 探测确认为 200，但内容本次未读**；**⑦ ⭐ **未核实**其移动端适配项（软键盘遮挡、底部安全区域）是否确实生效**；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实**其静态构建是否可成功产出 `out/`**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **其「业务手机号为演示号码」**已由作者声明；**本词条**不主张**该页面可用于任何真实的客户咨询或留资**；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **该项目自述为**MVP 静态前端、用于咨询阶段保费预估****，**且明确不替代核心系统、正式核保与出单**；**本词条据此**不主张**其可用于任何真实的报价、核保、承保或监管用途**；**⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ **其规则数据**可能随版本变化且为演示性质****——**本词条**不主张**其任一版本的规则可用于真实定价**；**⑫ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-09-07、推送于 2026-09-10**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑬ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑭ **README 为中文**——**本词条已如实记入，**本次未核实是否有英文或繁体版本**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/BenjaminNH/restaurant-insurance-quote` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可字段、★数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 topics）；README 3,310 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**`package.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json`、`docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md` 经 raw 探测确认存在（HTTP 200）**；**未克隆、未安装、未运行、未读文档内容与源码**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **三條中文險種名與其報價維度逐字，對中國保險實務學生最直接有用****：**公眾責任險（按經營面積匹配係數）**、**食品安全責任險（同）**、**雇主責任險（按保障方案、崗位人數與**最低 8 人承保門檻**）**⭐⭐ **「八人起保」是一條**具體的承保實務約束**，而「按經營面積匹配係數」是**場所類責任險的典型費率結構****（**⚠️ 不主張**這三個險種的費率結構在中國市場上確如此**——**未查任何保險公司條款或監管費率表**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「報價引擎採用與 UI 解耦的純 TypeScript 模組，規則數據按版本管理」是工程上最值得記的一句****⭐⭐ **含兩個要點**：①引擎與界面解耦；②**規則數據按版本管理**，使「這次報價用的是哪一版規則」成為可回答的問題**。**其 README **restaurant-insurance-quote** is **a mobile premium estimation tool for Chinese restaurant businesses** (repository `BenjaminNH/restaurant-insurance-quote`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, TypeScript as the primary language, a 1,356 KB repository, created 2026-09-07 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, on or after the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file, and its README states this explicitly** (**see note ① below**); it has **no topics**; **the README measures 3,310 bytes and is in Chinese**. **Key files measurably present**: **`package.json`, `docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json` and `docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md`** (**both Chinese-named documents measured HTTP 200 by raw probe**). It is the first of this round’s four takes on **writing the boundary as a list**, **and the entry in this batch with the densest concentration of Chinese lines of business** (**earlier entries repeatedly closed with "whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified"; this one is entirely Chinese and its line names are the actual Chinese practice terms**).

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **its positioning reads verbatim**: **"A mobile insurance premium estimation tool for restaurant business clients. Users can select public liability, food-safety liability and employer liability plans, enter single-store and staff-count information, and quickly obtain an estimated premium under standard rules."**; **and it states its current form verbatim**: **"The current project is an independently runnable MVP static front end, focused on validating the mobile quoting flow, rule calculation and abnormal quote states."** **Its core features read verbatim**: **"The three lines can be selected independently or quoted in combination."**; **"Public liability and food-safety liability automatically match a premium coefficient by operating area."**; **"Employer liability is calculated from the protection plan, headcount per role and a minimum eight-person underwriting threshold."**; **"Supports result states including normal quote, partial quote, manual quote and not eligible for underwriting."**; **"Displays liability limits, deductible conditions, application materials and the corresponding handling prompts."**; **"Session drafts save progress so work continues after a page refresh."**; **"Adapted for mobile input, soft-keyboard occlusion, bottom safe areas and touch interaction."**

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ The three Chinese line names and their rating dimensions, read verbatim, are the entry’s most directly useful point for students of Chinese insurance practice** — **public liability (coefficient matched by operating area)**, **food-safety liability (likewise)** and **employer liability (protection plan, headcount per role and a minimum eight-person underwriting threshold)**. ⭐⭐ **"Minimum eight to underwrite" is itself a concrete underwriting constraint** (**employer liability normally sets a minimum headcount for small employers**), **and "premium coefficient matched by operating area" is the typical rate structure for premises liability**; **for students unfamiliar with Chinese commercial lines, those three points are a minimal sample linking line, risk exposure and rating driver** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the three lines’ rate structures are as described in the Chinese market — no insurer terms or regulatory rate table were consulted**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ "The quoting engine is a pure TypeScript module decoupled from the UI, with rule data managed by version" is the entry’s most notable engineering statement** — it reads verbatim as above. ⭐⭐ **The sentence carries two points**: **the engine is decoupled from the interface, so rules can be tested and replaced independently**; **and rule data is version-managed, so "which version of the rules produced this quote" becomes answerable**. **Its README also states verbatim that the current rule version is `mvp-1.1`** and **links two openable files directly**: the premium rule write-up (`docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md`) and the structured rule configuration (`docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json`) ⭐⭐ **and both were measured present by raw probe (HTTP 200) — so the rule explanation and the machine-readable rule data are published together** (**⚠️ their contents were not read, so no premium formula, coefficient value or underwriting boundary is restated**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Among the four result states, "manual quote" and "not eligible for underwriting" are this round’s central sample** — verbatim: **"Supports result states including normal quote, partial quote, manual quote and not eligible for underwriting."** ⭐⭐ **A quoting system therefore does not have only one way out: it may quote part, refer to a human, or state outright that the risk cannot be written under standard rules** — **cognate with a discipline that recurs across this site** (**flagging rather than blocking in round 329’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]], round 331’s [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]], this round’s `answer_status` in [[insurance-rag-assistant]], and the four states in [[claimlens]]**); **what is distinctive here is applying that set of states at the quoting stage rather than at underwriting or claims — saying "this cannot be quoted under standard rules" while the customer is merely asking for a price** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the four-state design matches any insurer’s real quoting flow**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its "Current limitations" section lists five items verbatim, the most direct form of this round’s theme** — **first**: **"The MVP supports single-store quoting only and does not handle consolidated quoting across multiple stores."**; **second**: **"Employee age conditions are verified at formal application; the current page does not collect employee age details."**; **third**: **"Customer lead capture, a database, employee personalisation and an admin backend are not yet connected."**; **fourth**: **"Quote calculation happens in the browser; when quotes are saved in future the server must recompute them from the inputs and the rule version."**; **fifth**: **"The business phone number shown on the results page is a demo number and cannot serve as a formal enquiry channel."** ⭐⭐⭐ **The fourth deserves separate note: it points out that a client-computed price, once saved, must be recomputed server-side from "inputs plus rule version" — preventing a browser-side quote from being treated as an authoritative record**; **for students building insurance systems that is an easily overlooked constraint with direct auditability consequences** (**readable with round 331’s [[paco-uw]], where editing a rule changes how past quotes would re-evaluate — both address the time relationship between a quote and a rule version**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Its disclaimer reads verbatim and lists specifically what it does not replace** — **"This project is for premium estimation at the consultation stage only; it does not replace the insurance core system, formal underwriting or formal policy issuance. Final coverage, premium and terms are subject to the insurer’s review and the formal policy."** ⭐⭐ **The three items together bound what the estimate cannot be used for** (**not a core system, not underwriting, not issuance**), **and for students building quoting systems it is a sample of putting "the output is not a promise" into business language** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the disclaimer has legal effect in any jurisdiction**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its stack and engineering configuration read verbatim and are checkable**: **Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Hook Form, Zod, Vitest and Playwright**; **two commands verbatim**: **`npm run check` (lint, type checking, unit tests and the static build)** and **`npm run test:e2e`**; **the static build output goes to `out/`** and **can be deployed to any static host**; ⭐ **unit tests and end-to-end tests are separated, and the static build is part of `check`** (**⚠️ neither was run**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its mobile adaptations read verbatim and name specific items**: **"adapted for mobile input, soft-keyboard occlusion, bottom safe areas and touch interaction"** — ⭐ **soft-keyboard occlusion and bottom safe areas are two things that genuinely break in real mobile quoting flows** (**for students building mobile insurance journeys, such details usually live outside the requirements document and only surface after launch**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its documentation structure reads verbatim and includes three design documents**: **technology selection** (architecture, static-export approach and future direction), **MVP development and acceptance** (current functional scope, test approach and known limitations), and **mobile UX design notes** (mobile information hierarchy and interaction principles), **alongside the premium rule write-up and structured rule configuration** ⭐⭐ **The three-part pairing of functional scope, test approach and known limitations is a delivery structure students can copy directly**. **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s quoting-engine and Chinese insurance entries**: [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]], [[openrater]], [[ratecraft]], [[insurance-pricing-demo]], [[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]], [[insurance-actuarial-cn]], [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]], [[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]], [[ruc-nonlife-actuarial]] and [[insurance-governance]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ The licence situation here is a third form, and the author states it proactively**: **the README’s closing section reads verbatim "This repository currently has no open-source licence attached. The public content is for viewing and discussion only; copying, modification or distribution without permission is not permitted."** — **not mere silence but an explicit reservation of all rights** (**⚠️ the entry therefore advises that copying, modifying or distributing its content requires prior authorisation**; **⚠️ this differs from the two forms recorded earlier: [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]], [[insurerisk]] and [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] claim a licence with no licence file (a mismatch between claim and fact), while [[claim-ops]] and [[paco-uw]] make no statement at all — this one explicitly declares the absence**; **the user risk is similar across all three but this one is the most determinable**); **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, and the README’s full 3,310 bytes covering its positioning, six core features, stack, run and test commands, business rules and disclaimer, five current limitations, related-document index and licence statement**, **and confirmed by raw probe that three key files exist (HTTP 200)**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, `npm install`, run `npm run dev`, `check` or `test:e2e`, read the contents of any file under `docs/` (including the rule write-up and rule JSON), read any component source, or view its interface or run it on a mobile device**, so **its premium formulas, coefficient values, underwriting boundaries, state decision conditions and any quote result cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether its rating dimensions for the three lines match any Chinese insurer’s actual terms or rates was not verified** — **no insurer terms, regulatory rate table or industry model wording was consulted**; **the entry records only that the README describes them so**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ The decision rules and thresholds behind its four result states were not verified** (**the rule JSON was not read**); **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether "rule data managed by version" is actually implemented was not verified** (**the README says the current version is `mvp-1.1`**), **nor whether "the quoting engine is decoupled from the UI" holds in the code**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ The completeness and accuracy of its two Chinese rule documents were not verified** — **⚠️ their existence is confirmed at HTTP 200 but their contents were not read**; **⑦ ⭐ Whether its mobile adaptations actually take effect was not verified**; **⑧ ⭐ Whether its static build successfully produces `out/` was not verified**; **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ That the business phone number is a demo number is stated by the author**, and **the entry does not claim the page is usable for any real customer enquiry or lead capture**; **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ The project describes itself as an MVP static front end for consultation-stage premium estimation and explicitly does not replace the core system, formal underwriting or issuance**, **so the entry does not claim it is usable for any real quoting, underwriting, binding or regulatory purpose**; **⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ Its rule data may change by version and is demonstrative**, **so no version’s rules are claimed usable for real pricing**; **⑫ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created 2026-09-07 and pushed 2026-09-10**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⑬ ⭐ No topics**; **⑭ The README is in Chinese** — **recorded as such, and whether English or traditional-Chinese versions exist was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/BenjaminNH/restaurant-insurance-quote` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field, stars, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 3,310-byte Chinese README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; **`package.json`, `docs/餐饮保险报价器-MVP规则.json` and `docs/餐饮保险报价器-保费规则梳理.md` were confirmed present by raw probe (HTTP 200)**; **nothing cloned, installed or run, and neither the document contents nor any source read**.

仅支持单一门店报价、不处理多门店合并报价；②员工年龄条件在正式投保时核验、当前页面不采集员工年龄明细；③尚未接入客户留资、数据库、员工个性化配置或管理后台；④报价计算在浏览器端完成、未来保存报价时需要由服务端按输入和规则版本重新计算；⑤结果页显示的业务手机号为演示号码、不能作为正式咨询渠道——第④条「客户端报价若被保存须由服务端按输入＋规则版本重算」作为「防止客户端报价被当作权威记录」的审计性约束已单独写明，并与第 331 轮 paco-uw 的「改规则会改变过去报价的重新求值结果」建立并读关系；⭐⭐⭐免责声明逐字「本项目仅用于咨询阶段的保费预估，不替代保险核心系统、正式核保或正式出单。最终承保范围、保费及条款以保险公司审核和正式保单为准。」——三项界定（不替代核心系统、不替代核保、不替代出单）已写明；⭐⭐技术栈逐字（Next.js App Router、React、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS、React Hook Form、Zod、Vitest、Playwright），两条命令逐字 npm run check（lint、类型检查、单元测试与静态构建）与 npm run test:e2e，静态构建产物生成在 out/ 并可部署到任何静态托管——单元测试与端到端测试分开、静态构建纳入 check 两点已写明；⭐⭐移动端适配逐字含软键盘遮挡与底部安全区域两项，其「通常在需求文档里没有而上线后才被发现」的意义已写明；⭐⭐文档结构逐字含技术选型、MVP 开发与验收、移动端 UX 设计说明三份设计文档，另加保费规则说明与结构化规则配置——「功能范围／测试方式／已知限制」三件事并列的交付文档结构可照搬，此点已写明；⚠️未克隆、未 npm install、未运行 npm run dev／check／test:e2e、未读 docs/ 下任何文件的内容（含规则说明与规则 JSON）、未读任何组件源码、未查看其界面或在移动设备上试运行，故不转述保费公式、系数取值、承保边界、状态判定条件或任何报价结果；⚠️⚠️**未核实**其三类的报价维度是否与中国市场上任何保险公司的实际条款或费率一致，只记录其在 README 中被如此描述；⚠️⚠️**未核实**其四种结果状态的判定规则与阈值（未读规则 JSON），**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；⚠️未核实「规则数据按版本管理」的实际实现，亦未核实「报价引擎与 UI 解耦」在代码中是否成立；⚠️未核实其两份中文规则文件的完整性与准确性（存在性已确认，内容未读）；⚠️未核实其移动端适配项是否确实生效；⚠️未核实其静态构建是否可成功产出 out/；⚠️⚠️其「业务手机号为演示号码」已由作者声明，不主张该页面可用于任何真实的客户咨询或留资；⚠️⚠️该项目自述为 MVP 静态前端、用于咨询阶段保费预估，且明确不替代核心系统、正式核保与出单，不主张其可用于任何真实的报价、核保、承保或监管用途；⚠️其规则数据可能随版本变化且为演示性质，不主张其任一版本的规则可用于真实定价；★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-09-07、推送于 2026-09-10，故不主张成熟度/正确性/已被采用；无 topics；README 为中文（已如实记入，本次未核实是否有英文或繁体版本）

entries.title: 保单问答 RAG：把四次检索未命中留在评测里，并修正一个曾虚高自身指标的 nDCG 实现
entries.title_en: Policy-document RAG that keeps its four retrieval misses in the evaluation, and fixed an nDCG implementation that had been inflating its own metrics
entries.title_hk: 保單問答 RAG：把四次檢索未命中留在評測裡，並修正一個曾虛高自身指標的 nDCG 實現
entries.summary: 一个面向复杂保单文档的检索增强问答系统：混合稠密（BGE-M3）与稀疏（BM25）检索并做倒数排名融合、加一层重排，再用结构化输出回答，答案附状态、引证、条件、限制与来源页码；其评测刻意保留四个前十候选未命中的查询，并明确「评测应当暴露弱点，而不是被优化到每个用例都消失」，另在第二阶段加固中修正了会让同一黄金页的多个分块重复计分的 nDCG 实现
entries.summary_hk: 一個面向複雜保單文檔的檢索增強問答系統：混合稠密（BGE-M3）與稀疏（BM25）檢索並做倒數排名融合、加一層重排，再用結構化輸出回答，答案附狀態、引證、條件、限制與來源頁碼；其評測刻意保留四個前十候選未命中的查詢，並明確「評測應當暴露弱點，而不是被優化到每個用例都消失」，另在第二階段加固中修正了會讓同一黃金頁的多個分塊重複計分的 nDCG 實現
entries.summary_en: A retrieval-augmented question answering system for complex policy documents: it fuses dense (BGE-M3) and sparse (BM25) retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion, adds a reranking stage and answers in a structured form carrying status, citations, conditions, limitations and source page numbers; its evaluation deliberately retains four queries that miss the top-ten candidates, stating that evaluation should reveal weaknesses rather than be optimised until every test case disappears, and during Phase-2 hardening it corrected an nDCG implementation that was giving duplicate credit to multiple chunks from the same golden page
entries.body:
**Insurance-Rag-Assistant** 是一个**面向复杂保单文档的检索增强问答系统**（仓库 `Swapnadip-DataScientist/Insurance-Rag-Assistant`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 12,882 KB、**创建于 2026-08-28、最后推送于 2026-09-10****（**均 GitHub API 实测值**；**⚠️ 注意：其**创建日**在本轮解冻窗口之前，但**推送日**落在窗口内——按本轮目标「pushed/created > 2026-09-05」的口径，它以**推送**入窗**）；**实测 topics 13 项**：**`bge-m3`、`bm25`、`chunking`、`docker`、`fastapi`、`genai`、**`insurance`**、`llm`、`python`、`qdrant`、`rag`、**`reinsurance`**、`reranking`**；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）**、**README 全文未作许可声明**；**README 实测 47,543 字节**（**本批最长**）。**已实测存在的关键文件**：**`requirements.txt`（HTTP 200）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把边界写成清单」**中的**第二种，也是把「失败项」**放在结果里**最彻底的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其开篇核心原则逐字，是本条目最重要的一句**：**「**The LLM is only one component.** **The difficult engineering work is making sure the right insurance evidence reaches the model, in the right order, with enough controls to explain why the final answer should be trusted.**」**——**即「大模型只是其中一个组件。真正困难的工程工作是**确保正确的保险证据以正确的顺序到达模型，并有足够的控制来**解释为什么最终答案应当被信任****」**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「评测应当暴露弱点，而不是被优化到每个用例都消失」是本条目乃至本轮主题最锋利的一句**——**其上下文逐字为**：**「The final evaluation still contains **four Top-10 candidate retrieval misses**: `Q002`、`Q005`、`Q007`、`Q009`. **These are intentionally retained as documented residual failures rather than tuning repeatedly against a small benchmark until it reaches an artificial 100% score.** This is an important engineering principle: **evaluation should reveal weaknesses, not be optimized until every test case disappears.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三点值得单独记**：**① 它把未命中的**四个查询编号**写进了文档**（`Q002`／`Q005`／`Q007`／`Q009`）——**即**哪些用例失败是可查的，而不是一个通过率****；**② 它给出**为何保留**的理由**（**反复对着小基准调参直到 100% 是一种人为结果**）；**③ 它把这件事上升为一条**工程原则****。**对做模型评测的学生，这与第 332 轮 [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] 把 PR-AUC 1.00 定性为 bug 报告属**同一枚硬币的两面**：**一条拒绝让分数**虚高**，一条拒绝让分数**假装完美****（**另可与第 331 轮 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的 AUC 0.46 并读**——**三条分别在**过高、过低与残缺**三处守住同一条纪律**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「修正了一个曾虚高自身指标的 nDCG 实现」是本条目在度量诚信上最值得记的一处**——**逐字为**：**「During Phase-2 hardening, the nDCG implementation was **corrected so multiple chunks from the same golden page do not receive duplicate relevance credit**. **Standard normalized DCG is now kept within the expected 0–1 range.** The same correction **prevents multiple chunks from the same golden source from artificially inflating Precision@K**.」**⭐⭐ **即**同一页被切成多个分块时会重复获得相关性得分**，**使指标**人为偏高****；**作者在第二阶段加固中发现并修正了它**，**并同时把 nDCG 收回到应有的 0–1 区间**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**修正后的实现已无其他问题**——**本次未读其评测代码**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「一条与直觉相反的延迟结论」是本条目在工程方法上最值得记的一处**——**逐字为**：**「**Without instrumentation, an 80–130 second request could incorrectly be blamed on hybrid retrieval.** With stage metrics, one observed cold request was: Retrieval : 13.85 s；Reranking : 19.86 s；**Generation : 81.12 s**；Total : 114.83 s」**，**其结论逐字为**：**「**The main cold-start bottleneck is the generation model / Ollama path, followed by reranker/model initialization. Hybrid retrieval itself is not responsible for the majority of the observed end-to-end latency.** This investigation also demonstrated why **performance problems should be isolated by stage instead of guessed from UI response time**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **这与第 330 轮 [[claim-to-confidence]] 的「What is real」、第 333 轮 [[aero-audit]] 的「用注入攻击测自己」同属**用测量取代猜测**；**其价值在于**结论与最自然的猜测相反**——**混合检索是最显眼的复杂部件，却**不是**瓶颈****（**warning：本词条**不主张**在别的机器或模型上瓶颈仍是生成**——**其自述为本地 CPU 开发环境**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「答案不是只有一个，而是带状态」是本条目在输出设计上最值得记的一点**——**其结构化响应逐字含**：**`answer_status`（**示例值为 `covered`**）、`answer`、`citations`、`conditions`、`limitations`、`sources`（每项含 **`citation_id`、`document_id`、`page_number`、`page_chunk_index`**）**，**另有分阶段耗时**（`retrieval_ms`、`rerank_ms`、`generation_ms`、`total_ms`、`latency_ms`）**；**并逐字说明**：**「**The expected output is not just an answer.** It also includes the **answer status, citations, conditions, limitations and source provenance**.」**，**以及**：**「**This makes the answer inspectable rather than treating the LLM as a black box.**」**⭐⭐ **其第 13 节的示例显示**状态取值含 `conditional`（条件承保）**——**即系统可以回答「视条件而定」而非只答「保」或「不保」**（**可与本轮 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的四种报价状态、第 333 轮 [[claimlens]] 的弃权状态并读**——**三条都在把**二值判断**展开成多值状态**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **其六个示例业务问题逐字实测，且都是真实保单语义**：**「Will **Aviva** replace a fitted child seat after an accident even if there is no visible damage?」**（**车险：事故后儿童座椅是否更换，即使无明显损坏**）；**「Is damage caused by normal wear and tear covered by a repair guarantee?」**（**正常磨损是否属维修保证范围**）；**「Will a motor insurer recover an electric vehicle if its battery runs out of charge?」**（**电动车电量耗尽是否属救援范围**）；**「What are the Policy Type and Stream Name for policy ID `92010664`?」**（**精确保单编号查询**）；**「When must premium and commission be paid under a reinsurance agreement?」**（**再保协议下的保费与佣金支付时点**）；**「What compensation percentage applies to a specific injury listed in a policy table?」**（**保单表格中特定伤残的赔付比例**）**⭐⭐⭐ **对做保险文档问答的学生，这六问本身就是一份**测试集设计范例**：**四条考语义（磨损、电量、儿童座椅、再保支付），一条考**精确编号检索**，一条考**表格取值****——**恰好覆盖其自述的两类检索弱点**。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **「为什么要混合检索」的论证逐字，且把两类检索的失效方式写得很具体**——**其文档类型逐字含**：**「long contractual wording, **exclusions and conditional clauses**, **tables and schedules**, **policy identifiers and exact reference numbers**, **similar clauses with materially different meanings**, scanned or low-quality pages, domain-specific terminology across **Motor, Travel, Home, Marine and Reinsurance** documents」**；**并逐字给出两类检索各自的失效面**：**「A normal keyword search may **miss semantically similar wording**. A dense-vector search may **understand meaning but fail on exact policy IDs, codes or table values**.」**⭐⭐ **「语义相似但措辞不同」与「措辞相同但含义实质不同」同时被列为难点**——**后者是保单文本的特有风险**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**混合检索能完全解决这两类问题**——**其自述仍有四个未命中**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **其拒答与保守生成的行为被单列为评测情景，是本轮主题的又一处落点**——**第 13 节「生成评测」逐字列出三条示例**：**「Example — successful retrieval」**、**「**Example — retrieval failure propagating downstream**」**、**「**Example — conservative generation under missing evidence**」**⭐⭐ **「检索失败如何向下游传播」被作为一个**评测情景**而非事故**——**即它把**错误如何传导**也纳入了被观测范围**；**其生成评测独立于检索评测**，**检查项逐字为**：**「answer-status correctness, groundedness, answer correctness, citation correctness, **unsupported claims**, **hallucination-free behavior」**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其结果达到任何水平**——**本次未运行**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **文档摄取与分块策略逐字，且给出**分阶段**做法**：**摄取含「Native extraction first（原生抽取优先）」「Table-aware extraction（表格感知抽取）」「Selective OCR strategy（选择性 OCR 策略）」与「Phase-2 corpus」**；**分块含「Phase 1 — generic narrative chunking」与「**Phase 2 — structure-aware chunking（结构感知分块）**」**⭐⭐ **「原生抽取优先、表格单独处理、OCR 仅在必要时」这一顺序**，**与第 329 轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的「正则优先、LLM 兜底」是同一种**由廉价确定方法向昂贵方法递进**的结构**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **其负载测试表逐字实测，且包含了**对自己不利**的一行**：**「1 concurrent / 1 request：mean **116.38 s**，吞吐 **0.0086 req/s**」**；**「1 concurrent / 4 requests：mean **65.69 s**，p50 63.63 s，p95 90.94 s，**0.0152 req/s**」**；**「4 concurrent / 10 requests：mean **201.40 s**，p50 **236.95 s**，p95 **249.85 s**，0.0165 req/s」**⭐⭐ **即**并发升到 4 时平均与 p95 延迟显著恶化**（**mean 从 116 s 升到 201 s**）**——**这一行若不写，读者会以为并发更好**；**且其对「1 concurrent / 4 requests 反而更快」也**未作掩饰性解释****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该表可外推到其他硬件**）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **服务接口与健康检查逐字**：**FastAPI 服务含 `/ask`、`/health/live`、`/health/ready`，并单列一节「Blocking ML work（阻塞式机器学习工作）」**——⭐ **把「机器学习推理会阻塞事件循环」单列成节，说明作者意识到该架构的并发瓶颈所在**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读该节正文**）。**⑪ ⭐ 可与本站 RAG 与保单文档条目并读**：[[clauseguard]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[rag-assurance]]、[[valact-rag]]、[[sfcr-mistral-extraction]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]]、[[mongodb-insurance-pdf-search]]、[[insurance-qa-en]]、[[insuranceqa-original]]、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可情形**：**GitHub API 许可字段实测为 `NONE`**，**`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404**，**且 README 全文**未作任何许可声明****。**未声明许可即意味着**默认保留全部权利**，**使用、修改或再分发其代码前必须自行确认授权状况**（**本条属「完全未声明」一类，与同轮 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的**明确声明无许可**及第 332 轮多条「声称而无文件」不同**）；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics（13 项）、README（47,543 字节）全文的开篇核心原则、业务问题与六个示例问题、结构化响应示例、架构图、混合检索与重排两节、文档摄取与分块策略两节、检索评测三小节（含四个未命中）、评测指标说明（含 nDCG 修正）、生成评测三示例、可观测性与延迟（含最终结论与负载表）、FastAPI 服务与端点清单**，**并以 raw 探测确认 `requirements.txt` 存在（HTTP 200）与 `LICENSE` 不存在（404）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装、未运行其 RAG 或评测、未启动 FastAPI 服务、未读 `src/` 下任何源码、未读 `requirements.txt` 内容、未查看其任何查询输出或评测报告、未读 README 第 15 节「Blocking ML work」正文****，因此**不能转述其检索实现、重排模型、分块参数、向量库配置、生成提示词或任何实际指标数值**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其「四个 Top-10 未命中被刻意保留」的说法**，**亦未核实**其命中率、召回率、精确率、MRR 或 nDCG 的**任何具体数值****（**README 第 11 节含评测表，**本次只读到其文字结论与四个查询编号**）；**本词条**不主张**其检索质量达到任何水平**；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其 nDCG 修正确实解决了重复计分问题**——**本词条只核实在 README 中被如此描述**；**⚠️ **Insurance-Rag-Assistant** is **a retrieval-augmented question answering system for complex policy documents** (repository `Swapnadip-DataScientist/Insurance-Rag-Assistant`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 12,882 KB repository, created 2026-08-28 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements**; **⚠️ note that its creation date precedes this round’s thaw window while its push date falls inside it — under the objective’s "pushed/created > 2026-09-05" wording it enters on the push**); **thirteen topics measurably present** including **`insurance`**, **`reinsurance`**, `rag`, `qdrant`, `bge-m3`, `bm25`, `reranking`, `fastapi`, `docker`, `llm`, `genai`, `chunking` and `python`; **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` measured 404 on main) and its README makes no licence statement**; **the README measures 47,543 bytes, the longest in this batch**. **Key files measurably present**: **`requirements.txt` (HTTP 200)**. It is the second of this round’s four takes on **writing the boundary as a list**, **and the most thorough in putting its failures into the result**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **its opening core principle reads verbatim**: **"The LLM is only one component. The difficult engineering work is making sure the right insurance evidence reaches the model, in the right order, with enough controls to explain why the final answer should be trusted."**

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "Evaluation should reveal weaknesses, not be optimized until every test case disappears" is the sharpest line of this round’s theme** — its context reads verbatim: **"The final evaluation still contains four Top-10 candidate retrieval misses: `Q002`, `Q005`, `Q007`, `Q009`. These are intentionally retained as documented residual failures rather than tuning repeatedly against a small benchmark until it reaches an artificial 100% score. This is an important engineering principle: evaluation should reveal weaknesses, not be optimized until every test case disappears."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three points deserve separate note**: **the four missing queries are written into the document by ID, so which cases fail is checkable rather than reduced to a pass rate**; **the reason for keeping them is stated — repeatedly tuning against a small benchmark until it reads 100% is an artificial result**; **and it is elevated to an engineering principle**. **It is the other side of the same coin as round 332’s [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] calling a PR-AUC of 1.00 a bug report — one refuses a score that is inflated, the other refuses a score that pretends to be perfect** (**and both can be read with round 331’s [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] and its AUC of 0.46 — three entries holding one discipline at the too-high, too-low and incomplete ends**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Correcting an nDCG implementation that had been inflating its own metrics is the entry’s most notable piece of measurement integrity** — verbatim: **"During Phase-2 hardening, the nDCG implementation was corrected so multiple chunks from the same golden page do not receive duplicate relevance credit. Standard normalized DCG is now kept within the expected 0–1 range. The same correction prevents multiple chunks from the same golden source from artificially inflating Precision@K."** ⭐⭐ **That is, several chunks cut from the same page were each receiving relevance credit, biasing the metrics upward; the author found and fixed it during Phase-2 hardening and brought nDCG back into the expected 0–1 range** (**⚠️ the evaluation code was not read, so the entry does not claim the corrected implementation is free of other issues**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ A latency conclusion that contradicts the obvious guess is the entry’s most notable piece of engineering method** — verbatim: **"Without instrumentation, an 80–130 second request could incorrectly be blamed on hybrid retrieval. With stage metrics, one observed cold request was: Retrieval 13.85 s; Reranking 19.86 s; Generation 81.12 s; Total 114.83 s"**, **with the conclusion verbatim**: **"The main cold-start bottleneck is the generation model / Ollama path, followed by reranker/model initialization. Hybrid retrieval itself is not responsible for the majority of the observed end-to-end latency. This investigation also demonstrated why performance problems should be isolated by stage instead of guessed from UI response time."** ⭐⭐⭐ **This belongs with round 330’s [[claim-to-confidence]] "What is real" section and round 333’s [[aero-audit]] measuring itself with injected attacks — measurement replacing guesswork — and its value lies in the conclusion running against the most natural guess: hybrid retrieval is the most conspicuous complex component, yet it is not the bottleneck** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim generation remains the bottleneck on other hardware or models — the author describes a local CPU environment**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ "The answer is not a single value but carries a status" is the entry’s most notable output design point** — **its structured response contains verbatim `answer_status` (example value `covered`), `answer`, `citations`, `conditions`, `limitations`, `sources` (each with `citation_id`, `document_id`, `page_number` and `page_chunk_index`) plus stage timings**, **and it states verbatim**: **"The expected output is not just an answer. It also includes the answer status, citations, conditions, limitations and source provenance."**, **and**: **"This makes the answer inspectable rather than treating the LLM as a black box."** ⭐⭐ **Its section 13 examples show a status value of `conditional`** — **the system can answer "it depends on conditions" rather than only yes or no** (**readable with this round’s four quote states in [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] and round 333’s abstention states in [[claimlens]] — all three expand a binary judgement into multiple states**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Its six example business questions read verbatim and are genuinely policy-semantic**: **"Will Aviva replace a fitted child seat after an accident even if there is no visible damage?"**; **"Is damage caused by normal wear and tear covered by a repair guarantee?"**; **"Will a motor insurer recover an electric vehicle if its battery runs out of charge?"**; **"What are the Policy Type and Stream Name for policy ID `92010664`?"**; **"When must premium and commission be paid under a reinsurance agreement?"**; **"What compensation percentage applies to a specific injury listed in a policy table?"** ⭐⭐⭐ **For students building policy-document QA, those six questions are themselves a test-set design template: four test semantics (wear and tear, battery charge, child seat, reinsurance payment), one tests exact-identifier retrieval and one tests table lookup — precisely covering the two retrieval weaknesses the author describes.** **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ Its argument for hybrid retrieval reads verbatim and names each retrieval type’s failure mode** — **the document types read verbatim as**: **"long contractual wording, exclusions and conditional clauses, tables and schedules, policy identifiers and exact reference numbers, similar clauses with materially different meanings, scanned or low-quality pages, domain-specific terminology across Motor, Travel, Home, Marine and Reinsurance documents"**; **and the two failure modes verbatim**: **"A normal keyword search may miss semantically similar wording. A dense-vector search may understand meaning but fail on exact policy IDs, codes or table values."** ⭐⭐ **Both "semantically similar but differently worded" and "identically worded but materially different in meaning" are listed as difficulties — the latter a risk peculiar to policy text** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim hybrid retrieval fully solves either — four misses remain by the author’s own account**). **⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ Its abstention and conservative generation are given their own evaluation scenarios, another landing point for this round’s theme** — **section 13 lists three examples verbatim**: **"Example — successful retrieval"**, **"Example — retrieval failure propagating downstream"** and **"Example — conservative generation under missing evidence"** ⭐⭐ **"How a retrieval failure propagates downstream" is treated as an evaluation scenario rather than an incident — the propagation of error is itself put under observation**; **generation evaluation is separate from retrieval evaluation and checks verbatim**: **"answer-status correctness, groundedness, answer correctness, citation correctness, unsupported claims, hallucination-free behavior"** (**⚠️ nothing was run, so no level of performance is claimed**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its ingestion and chunking strategies read verbatim and are staged**: **ingestion includes "Native extraction first", "Table-aware extraction", "Selective OCR strategy" and a "Phase-2 corpus"; chunking includes "Phase 1 — generic narrative chunking" and "Phase 2 — structure-aware chunking"** ⭐⭐ **The ordering — native extraction first, tables handled separately, OCR only when necessary — has the same shape as round 329’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] and its regex-first, LLM-fallback design: progressing from cheap deterministic methods to expensive ones.** **⑨ ⭐⭐ Its load-test table reads verbatim and includes a row that is unfavourable to itself**: **"1 concurrent / 1 request: mean 116.38 s, throughput 0.0086 req/s"**; **"1 concurrent / 4 requests: mean 65.69 s, p50 63.63 s, p95 90.94 s, 0.0152 req/s"**; **"4 concurrent / 10 requests: mean 201.40 s, p50 236.95 s, p95 249.85 s, 0.0165 req/s"** ⭐⭐ **At four concurrent requests mean and p95 latency degrade markedly (mean rising from 116 s to 201 s) — a row whose omission would have left a reader assuming concurrency helped** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the table generalises to other hardware**). **⑩ ⭐⭐ Its service interface reads verbatim**: **FastAPI with `/ask`, `/health/live` and `/health/ready`, plus a section titled "Blocking ML work"** — ⭐ **singling out that machine-learning inference blocks the event loop shows the author is aware where the architecture’s concurrency ceiling lies** (**⚠️ that section’s body was not read**). **⑪ ⭐ Readable with the site’s RAG and policy-document entries**: [[clauseguard]], [[policy-explainer-ai]], [[rag-assurance]], [[valact-rag]], [[sfcr-mistral-extraction]], [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]], [[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]], [[mongodb-insurance-pdf-search]], [[insurance-qa-en]], [[insuranceqa-original]] and [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Licence situation**: **the GitHub API licence field measurably reads `NONE`**, **`LICENSE` measured 404 on main**, **and the README contains no licence statement whatsoever** (**a no-statement case, unlike this round’s [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] with its explicit declaration of no licence, and unlike the several "claim without a file" cases in round 332**); **no licence declaration means all rights are by default reserved, and authorisation must be confirmed before use, modification or redistribution**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, topics, and the README’s full 47,543 bytes covering its opening core principle, the business problem and six example questions, the structured response example, architecture, the hybrid-retrieval and reranking sections, ingestion and chunking strategies, the three retrieval-evaluation subsections (including the four misses), the metric notes (including the nDCG correction), the three generation-evaluation examples, observability and latency (including the conclusion and load table), and the FastAPI service and endpoints**, **and confirmed by raw probe that `requirements.txt` exists (200) and `LICENSE` does not (404)**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install, run its RAG or evaluation, start the FastAPI service, read any source under `src/`, read `requirements.txt`, view any query output or evaluation report, or read section 15’s body**, so **its retrieval implementation, reranking model, chunking parameters, vector-store configuration, generation prompts and any actual metric value cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The claim that four top-10 misses were deliberately retained was not verified**, **nor was any concrete figure for hit rate, recall, precision, MRR or nDCG** (**section 11 contains an evaluation table; only its prose conclusion and the four query IDs were read**); **the entry claims no level of retrieval quality**; **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ That its nDCG correction genuinely removes the duplicate-credit problem was not verified** — **only that the README describes it so**; **⚠️ this class of issue — a metric implementation itself inflating the score — has now appeared twice in this session (the other being round 332’s PR-AUC of 1.00), both times self-disclosed by the author**; **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ The conclusion that generation rather than hybrid retrieval is the bottleneck was not verified** — **no performance measurement was performed**; **the author describes a local CPU environment and mentions the Ollama path, so the entry does not claim it generalises**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ Whether its six example questions are actually answerable from its corpus was not verified**, **nor the full value domain of `answer_status`** (**only `covered` and `conditional` were seen**); **⑦ ⭐⭐ How it uses the real insurer name Aviva was not verified** (**it appears in an example question**), **and the entry does not claim any relationship, authorisation or data provenance involving Aviva**; **⑧ ⭐⭐ The provenance and lawfulness of its corpus were not verified** — **the README mentions motor, travel, home, marine and reinsurance documents and one specific policy ID but does not say whether these are public, redacted or client material**; **the entry does not claim the use of that corpus is free of legal or contractual risk** (**not assessed**); **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ The project describes itself as production-oriented**, **yet reports 20–115 second latency per request on local CPU and 0.0086–0.0165 requests per second, with latency degrading under concurrency**, **so the entry does not claim it is usable for any real production QA service or customer-facing scenario**; **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ Policy-clause QA used for claims or underwriting judgement is a regulated activity in most jurisdictions**, **so the entry does not claim its output is usable for any real claim decision, underwriting judgement, legal opinion or customer reply**; **⑪ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created 2026-08-28 and pushed 2026-09-10**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⑫ ⭐ Its thirteen topics include `insurance`, `reinsurance`, `rag`, `qdrant`, `bge-m3`, `bm25` and `reranking`, consistent with its content**; **⑬ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Swapnadip-DataScientist/Insurance-Rag-Assistant` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field, stars, language, size, created/pushed dates and thirteen topics); the 47,543-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; **`LICENSE` measured 404 and `requirements.txt` measured 200 by raw probe**; **nothing cloned, installed or run, and neither the source nor the evaluation report read**.

entries.summary: 一个面向再保巨灾风险的亚太多灾种实时事件看板：从 USGS（地震，亚太边界框且震级不低于 4.5）、GDACS（多灾种，亚太边界框）、ReliefWeb（联合国人道协调厅，约 50 个亚太 ISO3 国家码）与 NASA EONET（野火、风暴、火山，亚太边界框）四个公开源摄取事件，写入 SQLite 做幂等 upsert，再由 Streamlit 呈现地图、指标与图表；摄取由 GitHub Actions 每三小时定时运行并把数据库文件提交回仓库
entries.summary_hk: 一個面向再保巨災風險的亞太多災種實時事件看板：從 USGS（地震，亞太邊界框且震級不低於 4.5）、GDACS（多災種，亞太邊界框）、ReliefWeb（聯合國人道協調廳，約 50 個亞太 ISO3 國家碼）與 NASA EONET（野火、風暴、火山，亞太邊界框）四個公開源攝取事件，寫入 SQLite 做冪等 upsert，再由 Streamlit 呈現地圖、指標與圖表；攝取由 GitHub Actions 每三小時定時運行並把資料庫檔案提交回倉庫
entries.summary_en: A real-time multi-hazard event dashboard for reinsurance catastrophe risk across Asia-Pacific: it ingests events from four public sources — USGS (earthquakes, APAC bounding box and magnitude at least 4.5), GDACS (multi-hazard, APAC bounding box), ReliefWeb (UN OCHA, about 50 APAC ISO3 country codes) and NASA EONET (wildfires, storms, volcanoes, APAC bounding box) — writes them to SQLite with idempotent upserts, and presents maps, KPIs and charts in Streamlit; ingestion runs on a three-hourly GitHub Actions schedule that commits the database file back to the repository
entries.body:
**APAC Catastrophe Monitor** 是一个**面向再保巨灾风险的亚太多灾种实时事件看板**（仓库 `hks619/apac-catastrophe-monitor`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 75,800 KB、**创建于 2026-04-22、最后推送于 2026-09-10****（**均 GitHub API 实测值**；**⚠️ 注意：其**创建日**在本轮解冻窗口之前，但**推送日**落在窗口内——按「pushed/created > 2026-09-05」的口径，它以**推送**入窗**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 3,235 字节**。**已实测存在的关键文件（均 HTTP 200）**：**`src/ingest.py`、`src/storage.py`、`tests/test_geo_filter.py`、`.github/workflows/ingest.yml`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把边界写成清单」**中的**第三种，也是把「收录什么、排除什么」按源逐条写明的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：**其定位逐字为**：**「Real-time multi-hazard event dashboard for **reinsurance catastrophe risk analysis** across the **Asia-Pacific region**.」**。**其架构逐字为**：**「Data Sources（USGS FDSN、GDACS RSS、ReliefWeb、NASA EONET）→ Ingestion `src/ingest.py`（**orchestrator, fault-tolerant**）→ Storage `data/events.db`（**SQLite, idempotent upserts**）→ Visualization `src/dashboard.py`（**Streamlit — map, KPIs, charts, CSV**）」**；⭐⭐⭐ **其调度方式逐字为**：**「GitHub Actions: **cron every 3 h** → `python -m src.ingest` → **git commit `data/events.db`**」**。
