entries.body_en:
**APAC Catastrophe Monitor** is **a real-time multi-hazard event dashboard for reinsurance catastrophe risk across Asia-Pacific** (repository `hks619/apac-catastrophe-monitor`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 75,800 KB repository, created 2026-04-22 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements**; **⚠️ note that its creation date precedes this round’s thaw window while its push date falls inside it — under the "pushed/created > 2026-09-05" wording it enters on the push**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file** and **no topics**; **the README measures 3,235 bytes**. **Key files measurably present (all HTTP 200)**: **`src/ingest.py`, `src/storage.py`, `tests/test_geo_filter.py` and `.github/workflows/ingest.yml`**. It is the third of this round’s four takes on **writing the boundary as a list**, **and the one that states, source by source, what is included and what is excluded**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): **its positioning reads verbatim**: **"Real-time multi-hazard event dashboard for reinsurance catastrophe risk analysis across the Asia-Pacific region."**; **its architecture reads verbatim**: **"Data Sources (USGS FDSN, GDACS RSS, ReliefWeb, NASA EONET) → Ingestion `src/ingest.py` (orchestrator, fault-tolerant) → Storage `data/events.db` (SQLite, idempotent upserts) → Visualization `src/dashboard.py` (Streamlit — map, KPIs, charts, CSV)"**; ⭐⭐⭐ **and its scheduling reads verbatim**: **"GitHub Actions: cron every 3 h → `python -m src.ingest` → git commit `data/events.db`"**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ The four data sources and their filters side by side in one table is the entry’s most important and most practical passage** — verbatim: **USGS** (Earthquakes, filtered by **"APAC bbox + M ≥ 4.5"**); **GDACS** (multi-hazard: floods, cyclones, volcanoes…, filtered by **"APAC bbox"**); **ReliefWeb (UN OCHA)** (all disaster types, filtered by **"~50 APAC ISO3 codes"**); **NASA EONET** (wildfires, storms, volcanoes, filtered by **"APAC bbox"**). ⭐⭐⭐ **For students of catastrophe data the value lies in stating the inclusion rules and the exclusion rules together: a reader immediately knows that earthquakes below magnitude 4.5 will not appear, that events outside the bounding box will not appear, and that ReliefWeb covers only about 50 ISO3 codes** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the bounding box or ISO3 list has any industry basis — the actual values in `src/config.py` were not read**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ That the database is committed back to the repository by CI every three hours is the entry’s most notable point on data traceability** — verbatim above. ⭐⭐ **Two consequences deserve separate statement**: **the update history of the data stays in the git commit log, so when an event entered the database is traceable**; **and the cost is repository size growing with every commit (its measured size is already 75,800 KB)**; **for students building data pipelines that is a concrete trade of version control for traceability** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the practice is sustainable long-term — repeatedly committing a SQLite file usually is not once data grows; this is the entry’s judgement, not the author’s**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Fault-tolerance per source and idempotent upserts are two concrete robustness designs** — verbatim as `ingest.py` (orchestrator, **fault-tolerant**) and `storage.py`’s **idempotent upsert**. ⭐⭐ **The former means one failing source does not stop the other three — valuable in practice because public APIs are intermittently unavailable**; **the latter means repeated runs do not produce duplicate events — a necessary precondition for a three-hourly scheduled job**; **and its test directory reads verbatim `tests/test_geo_filter.py` (bbox + ISO3 sanity checks), i.e. geometric and coding sanity checks are given their own test**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its "Extending" section gives four actionable recipes, each naming the file, function or registry line to touch** — verbatim: **① add a data source** — **"create a new module under `src/sources/` that returns a list of event dicts matching the schema in `src/storage.py`, then register it in the `_SOURCES` list in `src/ingest.py`"**; **② add Slack/email alerts** — **"add `src/alerts.py` that queries for new red-severity events after each ingestion run and sends a webhook message. Call it from `src/ingest.py` after the upsert loop"**; **③ country-level risk scoring** — **"add `src/risk.py` that aggregates event frequency and severity per ISO3 country, assigns a risk tier (low / medium / high / critical), and surfaces it as a choropleth in `src/dashboard.py`"**; **④ historical backfill** — **"extend `src/sources/usgs.py` to use the USGS ComCat API with `start_time` / `end_time` parameters and add a `--backfill-days N` CLI flag to `src/ingest.py`"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Recipe ③ is especially relevant for students here: aggregating event frequency and severity per ISO3 country, assigning a four-tier risk level and rendering it as a choropleth is a minimal implementation path for country-level catastrophe risk scoring** (**⚠️ its wording is "add…", so the entry does not claim the recipe is implemented, and the thresholds for the four tiers are not given in the README**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ All four data sources are independently checkable public interfaces**: **USGS FDSN**, **GDACS** (**the European Commission Joint Research Centre’s multi-hazard early warning**), **ReliefWeb** (**UN OCHA**) and **NASA EONET** ⭐⭐ **those four are themselves a usable list of public hazard data sources** (**readable with the site’s [[usgs-earthquake-api]], [[gdacs]], [[open-meteo]], [[rfema]] and [[ods-open-exposure-data]]**; **⚠️ the entry did not verify each source’s current availability or licence terms — the README states no per-source licence, while this project writes source data into and commits it back to a public repository, so the entry does not claim that reuse complies with those terms**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ How to run it reads verbatim and is minimal**: **`pip install -r requirements.txt`**; **`python -m src.ingest`**; **`streamlit run src/dashboard.py`**; **tests via `pytest tests/`** ⭐⭐ **three steps to reproduce locally** (**⚠️ none was run**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its configuration is centralised and listed verbatim**: **`src/config.py` — "APAC bbox, ISO3 list, source URLs, thresholds"** — ⭐ **four kinds of parameter in a single configuration file, the minimal way to separate tunable parameters from code** (**for students building reproducible data pipelines**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its project structure reads verbatim and matches the actual files** (**four source modules `usgs.py`/`gdacs.py`/`reliefweb.py`/`eonet.py`, plus `storage.py`, `ingest.py`, `dashboard.py`, `config.py`, `tests/test_geo_filter.py` and `.github/workflows/ingest.yml`**) — **and `src/ingest.py`, `src/storage.py`, `tests/test_geo_filter.py` and `.github/workflows/ingest.yml` were confirmed present by raw probe (HTTP 200), matching the described structure exactly** (**⚠️ the four modules under `src/sources/` and `src/dashboard.py` were not probed individually**). **⑨ ⭐ The README header also carries six interface screenshots** — **none was opened** (**⚠️ the entry does not describe the interface’s appearance**). **⑩ ⭐ Readable with the site’s catastrophe and hazard-data entries**: [[catrisk-sim]], [[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]], [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]], [[aero-audit]], [[usgs-earthquake-api]], [[gdacs]], [[rfema]], [[open-meteo]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[hazus]], [[gem-global-exposure-model]], [[ods-open-exposure-data]] and [[reinsurance-networks]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Licence situation**: **the GitHub API licence field measurably reads `NONE`**, **its README’s project structure lists no `LICENSE` file**, **and the README contains no licence statement whatsoever** (**a no-statement case**); **no licence declaration means all rights are by default reserved, and authorisation must be confirmed before using, modifying or redistributing its code or database**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, and the README’s full 3,235 bytes covering its positioning, architecture, scheduling note, the four-source filter table, quick start, test command, project structure and four Extending recipes**, **and confirmed by raw probe that four key files exist (HTTP 200)**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install, run `python -m src.ingest` or `streamlit run src/dashboard.py`, execute pytest, read any source under `src/`, read the actual values in `src/config.py`, inspect `data/events.db`, open any screenshot, or check its GitHub Actions run history**, so **its database schema, idempotent-upsert implementation, per-source parsing logic, threshold values and any event data cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The actual values of its exclusion rules were not verified** — **that is, the bounding box’s exact latitude/longitude extent and the exact list of about 50 ISO3 codes** (**both are said to live in `src/config.py`, which was not read**); **for this entry that is the single most important thing to verify, because the inclusion boundary is precisely where its value lies**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether its GitHub Actions really runs every three hours and really commits `data/events.db` back was not verified** — **its run history was not inspected**; **⚠️ note that `ingest.yml` exists (HTTP 200), but a workflow file existing and a workflow running are two different things**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether its per-source fault tolerance and idempotent upserts actually hold in the implementation was not verified**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ Whether its four data sources are currently reachable was not verified** (**no source was called**); **⚠️ in particular their licences and reuse terms were not verified — the README states none, while this project writes source data into and commits it back to a public repository, and the entry does not claim that reuse complies with those terms**; **⑦ ⭐⭐ Whether the four Extending recipes are implemented was not verified — their wording is "add…"/"extend…", so the entry does not claim country-level risk scoring, alerts or backfill exist**, **and recipe ③ gives no thresholds at all**; **⑧ ⭐ Whether its six screenshots match the current code was not verified**; **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ The public-visibility risk of its database file was not assessed** — **`data/events.db` is committed to a public repository and contains public hazard events** (**the entry does not claim it holds personal data, but the file’s contents were not inspected**); **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ The project addresses reinsurance catastrophe risk analysis as a professional use, but its sources are public news- and warning-grade events** — **a public event catalogue is not the same as catastrophe loss data usable for pricing, which normally needs industry loss amounts, exposure and terms**; **the entry does not claim it is usable for any real reinsurance pricing, capital calculation, underwriting decision or supervisory filing**; **⑪ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created 2026-04-22 and pushed 2026-09-10**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⑫ ⭐ No topics**; **⑬ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/hks619/apac-catastrophe-monitor` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field, stars, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 3,235-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; **`src/ingest.py`, `src/storage.py`, `tests/test_geo_filter.py` and `.github/workflows/ingest.yml` were confirmed present by raw probe (HTTP 200)**; **nothing cloned, installed or run, no data source called, and neither the source nor the screenshots read**.

四条配方是否已实现（措辞为 add…／extend…），不主张国别风险评分、告警或历史回填已存在，尤其第③条未给出任何阈值；⚠️未核实其六张截图是否与当前代码一致；⚠️未评估其数据库文件的公开可见性风险（data/events.db 被提交到公开仓库，其内容为公开灾害事件；不主张其中含个人数据，但本次未检查该文件内容）；⚠️⚠️该项目面向再保巨灾风险分析这一专业用途，但其数据源为公开新闻与预警级事件——公开事件目录不等于可用于定价的巨灾损失数据（后者通常需保险行业损失金额、暴露度与条款信息），不主张其可用于任何真实的再保定价、资本计算、承保决策或监管报送；★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-04-22、推送于 entries.body:
**GeM Sahayak** 是一个**关于「保险保证债券作为投标保证金」的教育性参考站点**（仓库 `axt-asmi/gem-sahayak`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 HTML、仓库体量 31,056 KB、创建于 2026-09-07、最后推送于 2026-09-08**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，均在**解冻窗口之后****）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 1,300 字节**（**本批最短**）。**已实测存在的关键文件（均 HTTP 200）**：**`index.html`、`i18n.js`、`serve.py`、`how-to-apply.pdf`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把边界写成清单」**中的**第四种，也是唯一一条把「我自己的产出不可尽信」写得最直接的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：**标题逐字为「GeM Sahayak — Surety Bonds」**；⭐⭐⭐ **其定位逐字，是本条目最重要的一段**：**「An educational reference on **Insurance Surety Bonds as Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)** on the **Government e-Marketplace (GeM)**: **what the instrument is, the regulatory framework under which it was adopted, and the procedure for obtaining one**.」**——**即「一份关于**保险保证债券作为投标保证金（EMD）**在**政府电子市场（GeM）**上的教育性参考：**该工具是什么、它在何种监管框架下被采用、以及取得一份的流程****」。**其内容构成逐字为**：**`index.html`（**单页，无构建步骤**）**；**`i18n.js`（**十种语言的译文**）**；**`docs/`（**被监管时间轴所引用的政府原始文件**）**；**`how-to-apply.pdf`（**申请流程演示文稿，30 页**）**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「保险保证债券作为投标保证金」这一险种用法，是本条目在险种设计上最值得记的一点**——**逐字见上**。⭐⭐ **对做保险创新的学生，这是一种**与常规财产／责任险完全不同的功能**：**它不是赔付损失，而是**替投标人向采购方提供履约信用****——**即**保证（surety）**这一类业务**；**其经济实质是**以保险公司的信用替代现金或银行保函形式的投标保证金****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该工具的监管依据、费率结构或适用条件**——**本次未读其正文与所引政府文件**；**⚠️ 亦**未核实 GeM 上是否确实接受该工具、以及规模如何**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「该工具是什么、依据何种监管框架被采用、以及如何取得」这一三段式结构，是本条目在写作方法上最值得记的**——**逐字见上**。⭐⭐ **对需要向他人解释一个陌生金融工具的学生，这是一份**最小可用的说明结构**：**定义 → 监管依据（含时间轴）→ 操作流程**；**而它把**政府原始文件**放进 `docs/` 并让**监管时间轴直接引用这些文件****（**逐字为「`docs/` — source government documents **linked from the regulatory timelines**」**）——**即**结论可追到原文****（**可与第 333 轮 [[proof-protocol]] 的「证据随主张同行」并读**；**⚠️ 本词条**未核对其 `docs/` 下收录的文件清单或其准确性**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「八种非英文译文尚未经母语者审阅，且法律术语在依赖前应先核实」是本条目的核心，也是本轮主题最直接的一种形态**——**逐字为**：**「> The **eight non-English translations have not yet been reviewed by native speakers**. **Legal terms (obligee, bid security, EMD) should be verified before this is relied upon.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三点值得单独记**：**① 它声明的是**自己刚做出来的那部分**（译文）**不可尽信****，**而非泛泛的免责**；**② 它**点名了三个具体法律术语**（**obligee 权利人／担保受益人、bid security 投标担保、EMD 投标保证金**）——**即它指出**读者最可能被误导的三处****；**③ 其条件句措辞为「**before this is relied upon**」**——**即**不是「仅供参考」的套话，而是指明依赖前须完成的一步****。**对做多语言保险材料的同学，这条是**把「翻译质量」与「法律准确性」分开声明**的样本**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其英文原文本身准确**——**本次未核对其内容与所引政府文件**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **十种语言的构成逐字实测，且含八种印度文字**：**English、हिंदी（印地语）、**Hinglish（印地语－英语混写）**、বাংলা（孟加拉语）、मराठी（马拉地语）、ગુજરાતી（古吉拉特语）、தமிழ்（泰米尔语）、తెలుగు（泰卢固语）、ಕನ್ನಡ（卡纳达语）、മലയാളം（马拉雅拉姆语）**⭐⭐ **两点值得记**：**① **Hinglish**（印地语用拉丁字母书写的混写体）被单列为一种语言**——**这是一种**实务中真实存在却少见于正式本地化清单**的书写形态**；**② 其余八种均为印度主要语言且各有独立文字****——**对做印度市场保险材料的同学，这是一份**该国语言覆盖的实用清单**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该清单覆盖印度全部主要语言**——**例如旁遮普语、奥里雅语等未列出**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **「所有字符串以键值对形式集中在一个 i18n 文件里，缺键回退到英文」是本条目在工程上最值得记的一处**——**逐字为**：**「All strings live in `i18n.js` as **key–value pairs**. **Missing keys fall back to English.**」**⭐⭐ **对做多语言交付的同学，这是一个**最小且可审查**的做法**：**译文不在多处散落，而是在一个文件里**（**可与本站 [[llm-wiki]]、[[md-translator]]、[[action-translation]]、[[seo-hreflang]] 等多语言条目并读**）；**而「缺键回退英文」是一条**明确的降级规则****——**即使某语言漏译，页面也不会显示空白或键名**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其回退在实现中确实生效**——**未读 `i18n.js`**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **「单页、无构建步骤」与其运行方式逐字实测，是本站少见的一种交付形态**：**逐字为「`index.html` — the site (**single page, no build step**)」**；**运行方式逐字为**：**`python3 serve.py 8777 .` 后访问 `http://localhost:8777`**；**并逐字说明**：**「`serve.py` sends **no-cache headers** so edits appear on a normal reload.」**⭐⭐ **两点值得记**：**① **无构建步骤**意味着**任何能打开 HTML 的人都能改它**——**对做教学材料的同学，这是**门槛最低的交付形态****；**② 「开发服务器发送 no-cache 头」是一个**具体的可用性细节****（**避免改了文件却看到旧页面**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **「三十页申请流程演示文稿」逐字实测且是**该工具的操作层****——**逐字为「`how-to-apply.pdf` — the application walkthrough deck (**30 slides**)」**（**⚠️ 本词条**未打开该 PDF**——**故不转述其申请步骤**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **其免责声明逐字，且含一处与主题直接相关的自述**：**「This is an **educational awareness resource**. **It is not owned or maintained by any government authority** and **does not constitute legal or financial advice**.」**⭐⭐ **「不隶属于任何政府机构」值得单独记**：**一份讲**政府电子市场**规则的参考材料，主动声明**自己不是官方****——**即**把「我讲的是别人的规则」与「我就是那个机构」分开****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其内容与官方规则一致**——**本次未核对任何政府原文**）。**⑨ ⭐ **可与本站印度保险与学习资源条目并读**：[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]]、[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[iai-india]]、[[indian-health-claims-skill]]、[[open-exam-prep]]、[[insurance-exam-bank-cn]]、[[actuarial-student-competitions]]、[[md-translator]]、[[llm-wiki]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可情形**：**GitHub API 许可字段实测为 `NONE`**，**且其 README 的「Contents」一节中未列出 `LICENSE` 文件**，**README 全文亦**未作任何许可声明****（**本条属「完全未声明」一类**；**未声明许可即默认保留全部权利**，**使用、复制、修改或再分发其页面、译文、演示文稿与所收录政府文件前必须自行确认授权状况**）；**⚠️ 另需提示一点**：**其 `docs/` 目录自述收录「source government documents」**——**即**它把第三方政府文件纳入仓库****；**这些文件本身的再利用条件**可能与仓库代码不同**（**⚠️ 本条**未核对其 `docs/` 下文件清单，**亦**未核实**这些政府文件的再利用条款**；**本词条**不主张**该收录方式符合任何再利用条件**）；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README（1,300 字节）全文的定位段、内容构成四项、十种语言清单、译文未审阅声明、运行方式与 no-cache 说明、以及免责声明**，**并以 raw 探测确认 `index.html`、`i18n.js`、`serve.py`、`how-to-apply.pdf` 四个文件存在（HTTP 200）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未打开站点（`index.html` 与 `i18n.js` 的内容本次未读）、未运行 `serve.py`、未打开 `how-to-apply.pdf`、未读 `docs/` 下任何政府文件、未以任何语言实际浏览该站点****，因此**不能转述其正文解释、监管时间轴内容、申请步骤或任一语言的译文**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其关于**保险保证债券**的说明是否准确**——**包括该工具的定义、被采纳的监管依据与时间轴、以及在 GeM 上使用它的实际程序**（**本次未读其正文，亦未查阅任何印度政府原文或印度保险监管与发展局的规则**）；**本词条**不主张**其内容准确、现行或完整**；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其**八种非英文译文的实际质量****——**⚠️ 作者本人已声明这八种译文**未经母语者审阅****；**本词条据此**不主张**任一译文可用于任何正式用途**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其三个点名术语（**obligee／bid security／EMD**）在各语言中的译法**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其术语选择在任何辖区法律上正确**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实** GeM 是否确实接受**保险保证债券**作为投标保证金、以及该做法当前的适用范围与规模**（**本次未查 GeM 官方规则**）；**本词条**不主张**该工具在当前政策下仍可如此使用**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其 `docs/` 下收录的政府文件是否**完整、为现行版本、且未被改动****——**⚠️ 这一点在多语言与法律类材料中直接影响可依赖性**；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实**「缺键回退到英文」在 `i18n.js` 中是否确实生效**；**⑨ ⭐ **未核实**其六张（或更多）界面在十种语言下的实际渲染效果**（**本次未打开站点**）；**⚠️ 尤其**未核实印度各文字在实际浏览器字体下的可读性**；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **该项目自述为**教育性认知材料**并明确不构成法律或财务意见、且不隶属任何政府机构****；**本词条据此**不主张**其可用于任何真实的投标决策、法律判断、合规操作或采购活动**；**⑪ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-09-07、推送于 2026-09-08**，**关注度极低**；**⚠️ 其仓库体量实测为 **31,056 KB**，**而 README 仅 1,300 字节**——**即**体积主要由站点与演示文稿构成，而非文档**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实该体积的具体来源**；**80% 以上可能来自 PDF 与图片，**但本次未列出其目录树**；**此为本词条的观察，非作者自述**）；**⑫ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑬ **README 为英文**——**本词条已如实记入；**⚠️ 其站点支持十种语言，**但本次未核实除 README 外哪些内容有译文**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/axt-asmi/gem-sahayak` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可字段、★数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 topics）；README 1,300 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**`index.html`、`i18n.js`、`serve.py`、`how-to-apply.pdf` 经 raw 探测确认存在（HTTP 200）**；**未克隆、未打开站点、未运行、未读任何政府文件与 PDF**。

entries.body_en:
**GeM Sahayak** is **an educational reference site on insurance surety bonds used as bid security** (repository `axt-asmi/gem-sahayak`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, HTML as the primary language, a 31,056 KB repository, created 2026-09-07 and last pushed 2026-09-08** (**all GitHub API measurements, both after the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file** and **no topics**; **the README measures 1,300 bytes, the shortest in this batch**. **Key files measurably present (all HTTP 200)**: **`index.html`, `i18n.js`, `serve.py` and `how-to-apply.pdf`**. It is the fourth of this round’s four takes on **writing the boundary as a list**, **and the only one that states most directly that its own output cannot be fully trusted**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): **the title reads verbatim "GeM Sahayak — Surety Bonds"**; ⭐⭐⭐ **its positioning, read verbatim, is the entry’s most important passage**: **"An educational reference on Insurance Surety Bonds as Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM): what the instrument is, the regulatory framework under which it was adopted, and the procedure for obtaining one."** **Its contents read verbatim**: **`index.html` — the site (single page, no build step)**; **`i18n.js` — translations for ten languages**; **`docs/` — source government documents linked from the regulatory timelines**; **`how-to-apply.pdf` — the application walkthrough deck (30 slides)**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Insurance surety bonds used as bid security is the entry’s most notable point on product design** — verbatim above. ⭐⭐ **For students of insurance innovation this is a function quite unlike conventional property or liability cover: it does not indemnify a loss, it supplies the bidder’s performance credit to the buyer — the surety class of business whose economic substance is replacing cash or a bank guarantee with an insurer’s credit** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the instrument’s regulatory basis, rate structure or conditions of use — its body text and the government documents it cites were not read; ⚠️ nor was it verified that GeM currently accepts the instrument, or at what scale**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its three-part structure — what the instrument is, the regulatory framework under which it was adopted, and how to obtain one — is the entry’s most notable point on writing method** — verbatim above. ⭐⭐ **For a student who has to explain an unfamiliar financial instrument to others, it is a minimal usable structure: definition, regulatory basis with a timeline, then procedure**; **and it places the source government documents in `docs/` with the regulatory timeline linking directly to them** (**verbatim: "`docs/` — source government documents linked from the regulatory timelines"**) — **so conclusions can be traced back to the primary text** (**readable with round 333’s [[proof-protocol]] and "evidence should travel with information"**; **⚠️ the entry does not verify which documents `docs/` contains, nor their accuracy**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ That its eight non-English translations have not been reviewed by native speakers, and that legal terms should be verified before reliance, is the entry’s core and the most direct form of this round’s theme** — verbatim: **"> The eight non-English translations have not yet been reviewed by native speakers. Legal terms (obligee, bid security, EMD) should be verified before this is relied upon."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three points deserve separate note**: **it disclaims the very part it has just produced (the translations) rather than issuing a general caveat**; **it names three specific legal terms — obligee, bid security, EMD — i.e. it points at the three places a reader is most likely to be misled**; **and its conditional reads "before this is relied upon", not boilerplate about "for reference only" but a step that must be completed first**. **For students producing multilingual insurance material this is a sample of declaring translation quality and legal accuracy separately** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the English source itself is accurate — its content and cited government documents were not checked**). **④ ⭐⭐ Its ten languages read verbatim and include eight Indian scripts**: **English, हिंदी, Hinglish, বাংলা, मराठी, ગુજરાતી, தமிழ், తెలుగు, ಕನ್ನಡ and മലയാളം** ⭐⭐ **Two points deserve note**: **Hinglish (Hindi written in Latin script) is listed as a language in its own right — an orthographic practice that genuinely exists but rarely appears in formal localisation lists**; **and the other eight are major Indian languages each with its own script, a practical coverage list for students working on the Indian market** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the list covers all major Indian languages — Punjabi and Odia, for instance, are absent**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ That all strings live as key-value pairs in one i18n file with missing keys falling back to English is the entry’s most notable engineering point** — verbatim: **"All strings live in `i18n.js` as key–value pairs. Missing keys fall back to English."** ⭐⭐ **For students delivering multilingual material it is a minimal and reviewable approach — translations are not scattered across files** (**readable with the site’s [[llm-wiki]], [[md-translator]], [[action-translation]] and [[seo-hreflang]] entries**); **and "missing keys fall back to English" is an explicit degradation rule, so a missing translation shows neither a blank nor a raw key** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the fallback works in the implementation — `i18n.js` was not read**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ "Single page, no build step" and how to run it read verbatim, a delivery form rarely seen here**: **verbatim "`index.html` — the site (single page, no build step)"**; **running it verbatim as `python3 serve.py 8777 .` then `http://localhost:8777`**; **and verbatim "`serve.py` sends no-cache headers so edits appear on a normal reload."** ⭐⭐ **Two points**: **no build step means anyone who can open HTML can edit it — the lowest-threshold delivery form for teaching material**; **and sending no-cache headers is a concrete usability detail that prevents seeing a stale page after an edit**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ The thirty-slide application walkthrough reads verbatim and is the instrument’s operational layer** — verbatim "`how-to-apply.pdf` — the application walkthrough deck (30 slides)" (**⚠️ the PDF was not opened, so its application steps are not restated**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its disclaimer reads verbatim and contains a self-statement directly relevant to the theme**: **"This is an educational awareness resource. It is not owned or maintained by any government authority and does not constitute legal or financial advice."** ⭐⭐ **"Not owned or maintained by any government authority" deserves separate note: material explaining the rules of a government marketplace states that it is not itself the authority — separating "I am describing someone else’s rules" from "I am that body"** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim its content matches official rules — no government text was checked**). **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s Indian insurance and learning entries**: [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[irdai-ai-governance]], [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]], [[iai-india]], [[indian-health-claims-skill]], [[open-exam-prep]], [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]], [[actuarial-student-competitions]], [[md-translator]] and [[llm-wiki]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Licence situation**: **the GitHub API licence field measurably reads `NONE`**, **its README’s Contents section lists no `LICENSE` file**, **and the README contains no licence statement whatsoever** (**a no-statement case**); **no licence declaration means all rights are by default reserved, and authorisation must be confirmed before using, copying, modifying or redistributing its pages, translations, deck or the government documents it collects**; **⚠️ one further point must be flagged**: **its `docs/` directory describes itself as holding "source government documents", i.e. it brings third-party government files into the repository, and those files’ own reuse conditions may differ from the repository code’s** (**the file list under `docs/` was not checked, nor were those documents’ reuse terms**; **the entry does not claim that collection complies with any reuse condition**); **②** this check verified **the repository metadata and the README’s full 1,300 bytes covering its positioning, four contents items, ten-language list, unreviewed-translation statement, run instructions with the no-cache note, and disclaimer**, **and confirmed by raw probe that four files exist (HTTP 200)**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, open the site (the contents of `index.html` and `i18n.js` were not read), run `serve.py`, open `how-to-apply.pdf`, read any government document under `docs/`, or browse the site in any language**, so **its explanatory text, regulatory timeline, application steps and any language’s translation cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether its explanation of insurance surety bonds is accurate was not verified** — **its definition, the regulatory basis and timeline under which the instrument was adopted, and the actual procedure for using it on GeM** (**its body text was not read, and no Indian government text or IRDAI rule was consulted**); **the entry does not claim its content is accurate, current or complete**; **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ The actual quality of its eight non-English translations was not verified** — **⚠️ the author has already stated that those eight have not been reviewed by native speakers**; **the entry therefore does not claim any translation is usable for any formal purpose**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ The rendering of its three named terms (obligee, bid security, EMD) in each language was not verified**, **and the entry does not claim its terminology is legally correct in any jurisdiction**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ Whether GeM actually accepts insurance surety bonds as bid security, and the current scope and scale of that practice, were not verified** (**no GeM official rule was consulted**); **⑦ ⭐⭐ Whether the government documents under `docs/` are complete, current and unaltered was not verified** — **⚠️ in multilingual and legal material this bears directly on dependability**; **⑧ ⭐ Whether "missing keys fall back to English" actually works in `i18n.js` was not verified**; **⑨ ⭐ How its interface actually renders in ten languages was not verified** (**the site was not opened**); **⚠️ in particular the readability of the Indian scripts under real browser fonts was not verified**; **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ The project describes itself as educational awareness material, explicitly not legal or financial advice, and not owned or maintained by any government authority**, **so the entry does not claim it is usable for any real bidding decision, legal judgement, compliance step or procurement activity**; **⑪ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created 2026-09-07 and pushed 2026-09-08**, **attention is very low**; **⚠️ its repository measures 31,056 KB while the README is only 1,300 bytes — the bulk lies in the site and the deck rather than in documentation** (**⚠️ the specific source of that size was not verified and its directory tree was not listed; this is the entry’s observation, not the author’s**); **⑫ ⭐ No topics**; **⑬ The README is in English** — **recorded as such; ⚠️ the site supports ten languages, but which content beyond the README is translated was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/axt-asmi/gem-sahayak` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field, stars, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 1,300-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; **`index.html`, `i18n.js`, `serve.py` and `how-to-apply.pdf` were confirmed present by raw probe (HTTP 200)**; **nothing cloned, the site not opened, nothing run, and neither the government documents nor the PDF read**.

Legal terms (obligee, bid security, EMD) should be verified before this is relied upon.」——三点已分别写明（①声明的是自己刚做出的那部分不可尽信；②点名了三个具体法律术语；③措辞为 before this is relied upon 而非「仅供参考」的套话），并作为「把翻译质量与法律准确性分开声明」的样本写入；⭐⭐十种语言逐字（English、हिंदी、Hinglish、বাংলা、मराठी、ગુજરાતી、தமிழ்、తెలుగు、ಕನ್ನಡ、മലയാളം）——两点价值已写明：Hinglish（印地语以拉丁字母书写的混写体）被单列为一种语言，是实务中真实存在却少见于正式本地化清单的书写形态；其余八种均为印度主要语言且各有独立文字，构成一份该国语言覆盖的实用清单（并注明未主张其覆盖印度全部主要语言，例如旁遮普语、奥里雅语未列出）；⭐⭐「所有字符串以键值对集中在 i18n.js、缺键回退英文」逐字「All strings live in `i18n.js` as key–value pairs. Missing keys fall back to English.」——「译文不散落在多处、在一个文件里」与「缺键回退英文是明确的降级规则（即使漏译也不显示空白或键名）」两点已写明，并与 llm-wiki／md-translator／action-translation／seo-hreflang 建立并读关系；⭐⭐「单页、无构建步骤」与运行方式逐字（index.html — the site (single page, no build step)；python3 serve.py 8777 . 后访问 http://localhost:8777；serve.py sends no-cache headers so edits appear on a normal reload）——「无构建步骤意味着任何能打开 HTML 的人都能改它，是门槛最低的交付形态」与「开发服务器发送 no-cache 头避免看到旧页面」两点已写明；⭐⭐how-to-apply.pdf 逐字为 the application walkthrough deck (30 slides)（未打开该 PDF）；⭐⭐免责声明逐字「This is an educational awareness resource. It is not owned or maintained by any government authority and does not constitute legal or financial advice.」——「一份讲政府电子市场规则的材料主动声明自己不是官方，把『我讲的是别人的规则』与『我就是那个机构』分开」的意义已写明；⚠️未克隆、未打开站点（index.html 与 i18n.js 内容未读）、未运行 serve.py、未打开 how-to-apply.pdf、未读 docs/ 下任何政府文件、未以任何语言实际浏览该站点，故不转述其正文解释、监管时间轴内容、申请步骤或任一语言的译文；⚠️⚠️**未核实**其关于保险保证债券的说明是否准确（包括该工具的定义、被采纳的监管依据与时间轴、以及在 GeM 上使用它的实际程序）——本次未读其正文，亦未查阅任何印度政府原文或印度保险监管与发展局规则，不主张其内容准确、现行或完整，**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；⚠️⚠️**未核实**其八种非英文译文的实际质量（作者本人已声明未经母语者审阅），不主张任一译文可用于任何正式用途；⚠️未核实其三个点名术语（obligee／bid security／EMD）在各语言中的译法，不主张其术语选择在任何辖区法律上正确；⚠️未核实 GeM 是否确实接受保险保证债券作为投标保证金、以及该做法当前的适用范围与规模（未查 GeM 官方规则）；⚠️未核实其 docs/ 下收录的政府文件是否完整、为现行版本且未被改动（此点在多语言与法律类材料中直接影响可依赖性）；⚠️未核实「缺键回退英文」在 i18n.js 中是否确实生效；⚠️未核实其界面在十种语言下的实际渲染效果（未打开站点），尤其未核实印度各文字在实际浏览器字体下的可读性；⚠️⚠️该项目自述为教育性认知材料并明确不构成法律或财务意见、且不隶属任何政府机构，不主张其可用于任何真实的投标决策、法律判断、合规操作或采购活动；★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-09-07、推送于 2026-09-08，关注度极低；其仓库体量实测 31,056 KB 而 README 仅 1,300 字节——即体积主要由站点与演示文稿构成而非文档（未核实该体积的具体来源，亦未列出其目录树；此为本词条的观察）；无 topics；README 为英文（其站点支持十种语言，但本次未核实除 README 外哪些内容有译文）

entries.title: 精算工具集（BMK）：以一份冻结的架构规格与强制 ADR 流程治理的 R/Shiny 精算工具集，ADR-007 明文禁止「按数据量自动降低分析深度」
entries.title_en: An actuarial tool collection governed by a frozen architecture specification and a mandatory ADR process, whose ADR-007 forbids automatically degrading analysis depth to fit dataset size
entries.title_hk: 精算工具集（BMK）：以一份凍結的架構規格與強制 ADR 流程治理的 R/Shiny 精算工具集，ADR-007 明文禁止「按數據量自動降低分析深度」
entries.summary: 一个计划用约一年时间做 30–40 个独立精算应用的 R/Shiny 项目框架：架构规格 v2.0 状态为 Approved 且已冻结，此后任何架构改动都必须在 decisions_log.md 留下一份能证明「相对现行架构有明确收益」的 ADR；其 ADR-007 撤回早前「一分钟内出结果」的承诺，立下「可以优化实现，不可以自动降低分析深度」的原则——深度由用户在 Standard／Comprehensive 两档中自选，差别是深度而不是速度；另有一个共享的「解释框」组件，样式统一但解释文字必须由每个工具自己用 glue() 撰写，组件只负责样式
entries.summary_hk: 一個計劃用約一年時間做 30–40 個獨立精算應用的 R/Shiny 專案框架：架構規格 v2.0 狀態為 Approved 且已凍結，此後任何架構改動都必須在 decisions_log.md 留下一份能證明「相對現行架構有明確收益」的 ADR；其 ADR-007 撤回早前「一分鐘內出結果」的承諾，立下「可以優化實現，不可以自動降低分析深度」的原則——深度由用戶在 Standard／Comprehensive 兩檔中自選，差別是深度而不是速度；另有一個共享的「解釋框」組件，樣式統一但解釋文字必須由每個工具自己用 glue() 撰寫，組件只負責樣式
entries.summary_en: An R/Shiny framework for building 30–40 independent actuarial applications over roughly a year: architecture specification v2.0 is Approved and frozen, so every later architectural change must leave an ADR in `decisions_log.md` demonstrating a clear benefit over the current architecture; ADR-007 withdraws an earlier "results in under a minute" promise and sets the principle "optimise the implementation: yes; automatically degrade the analysis: no", leaving depth to the user through Standard and Comprehensive profiles — the difference is depth, not speed; and a shared interpretation-box component supplies uniform styling while each tool must compose its own explanation text with glue(), the component contributing only style
entries.body:
**actuarial-tools-bmk**（Actuarial Tools by BMK，倉庫 `sbenkkk/actuarial-tools-bmk`）是一个**以「一批互相独立的精算工具」为产品形态的 R/Shiny 项目框架**：**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 R、仓库体量 1,923 KB、创建于 2026-09-07、最后推送 2026-09-07**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，创建与推送均落在解冻窗口之后**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（无 `LICENSE`，README 亦无许可章节——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 1,373 字节（西班牙语）**。**已实测存在的关键文件与目录**（**以下均经下载仓库 tarball 后逐一列出，共 221 个条目**）：**`docs/architecture_v2.md`（实测 56,668 字节）、`docs/architecture_v1_1.md`（按规格要求被保留而非覆盖）、`docs/decisions_log.md`、`docs/data_contract.md`、`docs/releases.md`、`docs/roadmap.md`、`docs/sprint0_closure.md`、`renv.lock`**；**`shared/` 下 10 个 UI 组件、2 个 Shiny 模块、3 个主题文件与 `config.R`／`load_shared.R`**；**`tools/` 下实测只有三个目录：`distribution-fitting`、`kernel-density` 与模板 `tool-00-template`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「不让降级悄悄发生」**中的**第一种，也是四条里把「不许悄悄降级」写得最像法条的一条**——**它不是在文档里劝人别偷懒，而是把「禁止自动降级」立成了一条带编号的规则**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与架构规格逐字实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其架构规格的封面上写着整套治理机制**，**逐字为**：**「| **Versión** | **2.0** |」「| **Estado** | **Approved** |」「| **Sustituye a** | v1.1. **Cambio de decisión de alto nivel** (filosofía de coste computacional y principios de plataforma). **Conforme a la regla §15.6, v1.1 se conserva y no se sobrescribe** |」「| **Vigencia** | **Congelada**. **A partir de esta versión, todo cambio arquitectónico requiere un *Architectural Decision Record* (ADR) en `docs/decisions_log.md` que demuestre beneficio claro respecto a la arquitectura vigente (§10, regla 20)** |」**。⭐⭐⭐ **即三件事同时成立**：**① 现行架构被**冻结**；② 冻结之后**任何**架构改动都要留下一份 ADR，且该 ADR 必须**证明有明确收益**；③ 旧版本**保留**而不是被覆盖**——**「v1.1 se conserva y no se sobrescribe」**（**并注明确依据是**§15.6**）。**其文档亦逐字自述**：**「Este documento es la especificación técnica oficial y única referencia de arquitectura del proyecto. … Toda herramienta desarrollada dentro del proyecto debe cumplir lo aquí especificado. **Este documento es autosuficiente: no requiere ningún contexto adicional, conversación previa ni documento complementario para ser aplicado.**」**⭐⭐ **即规格自称**自足**——不依赖任何额外上下文、先前对话或补充文档即可执行**（**对做课程项目的学生，这是把「规则可交接」当作硬要求的一个样本**）。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **ADR-007 是本条目最值得单独记住的一条，因为它撤回的是**一个已经许下的承诺****——**其 v2.0 变更表逐字列出**：**「1 | **Retirada de la promesa de ‘resultado en menos de un minuto’.** Se sustituye por una filosofía de plataforma basada en calidad, robustez estadística, reproducibilidad y transparencia. **El tiempo de ejecución es consecuencia del problema, no un objetivo** | ADR-007 | 1.3, 1.4, 1.7, 5」**。⭐⭐⭐ **「El tiempo de ejecución es consecuencia del problema, no un objetivo」**（**运行时间是问题的结果，不是目标**）**是本轮四条候选中最锋利的一句**：**它把「快」从产品承诺里降级成了副产物**——**⚠️ 而这发生在该承诺**已经被写下之后****，**故本条同时是一次**公开撤回****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **紧接着的第二、三条把「不许降级」立成了规则**，**逐字为**：**「2 | **Profundidad del análisis controlada por el usuario** (perfiles *Standard* / *Comprehensive*), **sin degradación automática por tamaño de dataset**. **La diferencia es profundidad, no velocidad** | ADR-007 | 1.7, 10 (regla 19)」**与**「3 | **Principio explícito ‘optimizar la implementación: sí; degradar el análisis automáticamente: no’** | ADR-007 | 1.7, 10 (regla 19)」**。⭐⭐⭐ **这两条合起来界定了一处**非常具体的诱惑**：**当数据量变大时，「静悄悄地把算法换成便宜的那种」是工程上最省事的做法，也是最容易让结论悄悄变味的一步**——**该规格的处理是：**可以优化实现（写更快的代码），但**不可以自动降低分析深度**；**要降，必须由用户**显式选择**档位**。⭐⭐ **并且它明确给出理由的措辞**：**「La diferencia es profundidad, no velocidad」**——**两档之间差的是深度，不是速度**（**即不许把「便宜档」包装成「快速档」**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其余三条 ADR 各管一处容易被悄悄绕过的地方**，**逐字列出**：**「5 | **Principio de validez estadística**: **los procedimientos cuya validez dependa de la estimación de parámetros deben ser válidos para ese contexto; su implementación pertenece al motor matemático, no al criterio ni al View Model** | ADR-008 | 1.8, 10 (regla 18)」**；**「6 | **Versionado del View Model (`schema_version`) y del criterio parametrizado (`decision_engine_version`), y tupla de reproducibilidad** | ADR-009 | 10 (regla 20), 14」**；**「7 | **Proceso ADR obligatorio** para todo cambio arquitectónico posterior al Sprint 0 | ADR-011 | Cabecera, 10 (regla 20), 15」**。⭐⭐ **第 5 条回答的是「谁负责保证统计方法的适用性」**——**答案是**数学引擎**，**不是判断层、也不是视图模型层****（**即不许把「这个方法在这里是否成立」的判断散落到界面代码里**）；**第 6 条把**视图模型的结构版本**与**参数化判据的版本**都纳入版本管理，并要求一个**可复现元组****（**⚠️ 本词条**未读**该「元组」的具体构成**）。**其架构规格另逐字说明这些原则的效力范围**：**「Estos principios son de **plataforma**: los heredan automáticamente todas las herramientas presentes y futuras (Tool-01, Tool-02, Tool-03 EVT, Tool-04 Aggregate Models, Tool-05 Pricing, Internal Model Studio, ORSA Platform).」**⭐⭐ **即规则是**平台级**的、由现有与将来的工具自动继承****——**这与「每条规则都靠人记得」是两种完全不同的治理方式**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **共享的「解释框」组件是本条第二个具体机制：把「必须解释」做成统一的壳，但拒绝替你写解释**——**`shared/components/ui_interpretation_box.R` 的文件头逐字自述**：**「Función pura de UI (catálogo 7.2). **Elemento diferencial del proyecto** (apartado 4.2): **traduce el resultado técnico a lenguaje comprensible**. **El texto lo compone cada herramienta** (típicamente con `glue()`); **este componente solo le da estilo**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **这句话把责任切得很干净**：**组件提供**样式**（`div.bmk-interpretation`、`role="note"`、`aria-label`、标题可置 NULL 隐藏），**文字必须由每个工具自己撰写****——**即「解释」被做成了**每个工具都有的位置**，但**不能被模板化成套话****。**其签名逐字为 `bmk_interpretation_box(content, title = "Interpretación")`**，**文件头另记「Autor: BMK — Última actualización: 2026-07-18」**；**⚠️ 该文件实测仅 **1,419 字节**（**极小的纯样式函数**），**与「解释内容不在此处」的自述一致**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **v1.1 的 12 条修订是一份**外部架构审计后的自我更正记录**，其中三条对本行特别有参考价值**——**逐字为**：**「2 | **Reparto de responsabilidad en los límites de datos.** El límite de tamaño de archivo (10 MB) se aplica en `mod_data_input`, con configuración explícita de `shiny.maxRequestSize`; el límite de filas (100.000) se aplica en `bmk_validate_data()`. **Se elimina de `bmk_validate_data()` la validación de tamaño de archivo, técnicamente imposible desde su firma**」**；**「1 | **Regla del prefijo `bmk_` reformulada con excepciones explícitas.** … Se aclara que **el prefijo aplica a nombres de función, no a nombres de archivo**」**；**「5 | **Corrección de referencia cruzada rota.** La regla de promoción a `shared/` está en el apartado 10 (regla 4), no en el 7.4」**。⭐⭐ **第 2 条尤其值得记**：**它把**文件大小上限**（10 MB）与**行数上限**（100,000）分别放在两个不同的组件里，并给出理由——**「从 `bmk_validate_data()` 的函数签名出发，校验文件大小在技术上是**做不到**的」****。**这是一处**把职责按函数能力而非按概念整齐度来划分**的更正**（**对做代码评审的同学，这类「看起来更整齐但技术上做不到」的重构是常见返工来源**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **项目定位、规模与自我认知均逐字可查**：**「Colección de 30-40 herramientas actuariales independientes construidas sobre una infraestructura común (**BMK Framework**). **Cada herramienta resuelve un único problema, priorizando la calidad y la robustez del análisis sobre el tiempo de ejecución.**」**；**「Base futura de **Internal Model Studio**, **ORSA Platform** y **Actuarial Risk Hub**.」**；**架构 §1.1 逐字**：**「entre 30 y 40 aplicaciones actuariales independientes, desarrolladas a lo largo de aproximadamente un año」**，**以及**「Cada aplicación debe ser suficientemente útil como para ser utilizada **tanto por estudiantes como por profesionales del sector asegurador**」**；**§1.2 的四项目的逐字为**：**「Construcción de portfolio técnico. Construcción de marca personal. Creación de un repositorio de código reutilizable. Base para productos comerciales futuros」**；**§1.3 逐字**：**「**Cada aplicación resuelve un único problema.** Esta es la decisión de producto más importante del proyecto y **tiene prioridad sobre cualquier decisión técnica**.」**⭐⭐ **即该项目的目标里**同时写着**作品集、个人品牌与未来商业产品****（**本条如实记入，不作褒贬**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **仓库结构与运行方式逐字**：**「`shared/` — infraestructura común cargada con `source()`（theming, componentes, módulos, validación, utilidades, cálculo promovido）」**、**「`tools/` — una carpeta por herramienta (slug en `kebab-case`). **`tool-00-template` es la plantilla base, no una entrada de catálogo**」**、**「`renv.lock` — **único lockfile de dependencias del proyecto**」**；**运行方式逐字为 `shiny::runApp("tools/<slug>")`**，**并要求**「Cada herramienta es autocontenida y ejecutable de forma independiente (**regla 11**)」**；**技术栈逐字**：**R · Shiny · bslib · ggplot2 · plotly · DT · dplyr · tidyr · readr · glue · shinycssloaders · bsicons · yaml · renv**⭐⭐ **「唯一的 lockfile」与「每个工具都能独立运行」两条要求放在一起，是一种**刻意选择的耦合边界****：**依赖统一、但工具之间不互相依赖**（**⚠️ 本词条**未验证**在只有 2 个工具时该约束是否确实成立**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **文档密度是本条另一处可核实的事实**——**除上述 7 份 `docs/` 文件外，实测还有 10 份**专门针对第二个工具（Tool-02，即 `kernel-density`）**的文档**：**`tool02_b12_benchmark.md`、`tool02_b16_contract.md`、`tool02_bootstrap_contract.md`、`tool02_estimator_validation.md`、`tool02_inference_contract.md`、`tool02_mle_uncertainty.md`、`tool02_percentile_matching.md`、`tool02_pm_benchmark.md`、`tool02_pm_r2_diagnostic.md`、`tool02_release_v1_1_0.md`**⭐⭐ **即**一个核密度估计工具配了 10 份契约与基准文档，并已有 v1.1.0 发布记录与 Sprint 0 收尾记录****（**⚠️ 本词条**未读**这 10 份文档中任何一份的内容，**故**不转述其估计量、基准数据或验收结论**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站治理与工具集条目并读**：[[insurance-governance]]、[[actuary-os]]、[[orsa]]、[[ifrs17-calculation-engine]]、[[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]、[[openrater]]、[[claim-ops]]、[[paco-uw]]。

但规格本身并未虚报**：它逐字写明规模是计划，**时间为**约一年****（**「desarrolladas a lo largo de aproximadamente un año」**），**并有 `docs/sprint0_closure.md` 与 `docs/tool02_release_v1_1_0.md` 两份阶段标记**；**本词条据此**不主张**该仓库已包含 30–40 个工具**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **许可实测为**无**（GitHub 许可字段 NONE，且 `LICENSE` 经 raw 探测实测 **404**，README 与架构规格中**均无许可章节**）**——**属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态**；**本词条据此提示：**使用、复制或再分发前应先向作者确认授权****（**⚠️ 其目标中自称包含「未来商业产品的基座」，故「是否可复用」不宜自行假定**）。**③ ⚠️ ⭐ **本条目在主题上有一个**自我指涉的反差，必须如实写出****：**这份文档**极其强调不许悄悄降级、不许覆盖旧版、一切改动留痕****，**但仓库里实测**提交了 `.DS_Store`（根目录与 `shared/` 各一）与 `shared/theme/.Rhistory`****——**⚠️ 即**macOS 元数据文件与 R 的会话历史文件**确实进了版本库**；**这一处**与「冻结的架构 + 强制 ADR」所形成的严格观感不一致****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这会影响其架构治理的有效性**——**两者发生在不同层面**；**此处只记录实测所见**）。**④ ⚠️⭐ 另有一处**空目录**：`shared/actuarial/.gitkeep`**（**即架构规格中提到的共享精算代码目录**目前为空**）**；**`shared/actuarial/` 与 `shared/utils/` 的分立在 v1.1 修订第 6 条中被要求**，**⚠️ 本次实测**只看到 `shared/actuarial/` 下仅有一个占位文件，**未见到 `shared/utils/`**。**⑤** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README（1,373 字节）全文、架构规格 v2.0 的封面字段／v2.0 与 v1.1 变更表／§1.1–1.3，以及 `ui_interpretation_box.R` 全文**；**并以 tarball 列出全部 221 个条目以核实结构与文档清单**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆到本地运行、未安装 R 或任何依赖、未运行 `shiny::runApp()`、未读 `docs/` 下**其余任何文档的内容**（含 `decisions_log.md` 的实际 ADR 全文、`data_contract.md`、`roadmap.md`）、未读 `shared/components/` 其余 9 个组件、未读 `shared/modules/`、`shared/theme/`、`shared/config.R` 或 `tools/` 下**任何工具的源码****，因此**不能转述其任何算法、估计量、基准结果、验收标准、数据契约或界面行为**；**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实** ADR-007 所述「按 Standard／Comprehensive 两档控制深度」是否已在**任何实际工具中实现****（**本次未读 `tools/` 下任何源码**）**——**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**「regla 19」（禁止自动降级）与「regla 20」（强制 ADR）在规格正文中的**完整条款措辞****（**本次读到的是 v2.0 变更表中的条目与封面声明，**并非 §10 规则清单本身**）；**⑧ ⭐⭐ **未核实** `docs/decisions_log.md` 中是否确实存在 ADR-007、ADR-008、ADR-009、ADR-011 这四份记录**——**⚠️ 本词条只核实了**该文件存在（tarball 实测）与其被规格封面引用****，**未读其内容**；**⑨ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其架构是否真的处于「冻结」状态**（**无提交历史分析**，**本次只读到最后推送时间为 **未核实**其作者身份、执业背景或「BMK」所指**——**本词条**不主张**该项目由任何精算师协会、保险公司或监管机构背书**；**⑬ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建与推送均为 2026-09-07**，**关注度极低、且自创建起未见后续推送**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑭ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑮ **README **actuarial-tools-bmk**（Actuarial Tools by BMK，倉庫 `sbenkkk/actuarial-tools-bmk`）是一個**以「一批互相獨立的精算工具」為產品形態的 R/Shiny 專案框架**：**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 R、體量 1,923 KB、創建於 2026-09-07、最後推送 2026-09-07**（**均落在解凍窗口之後**）；**⚠️ 實測無任何許可文件，README 亦無許可章節——屬「完全未聲明」形態**；**無 topics**；**README 實測 1,373 位元組（西班牙語）**。**已實測存在的關鍵文件與目錄**（**經下載 tarball 逐一列出，共 221 個條目**）：**`docs/architecture_v2.md`（實測 56,668 位元組）、`docs/architecture_v1_1.md`（依規格要求被保留而非覆蓋）、`docs/decisions_log.md`、`docs/data_contract.md`、`docs/releases.md`、`docs/roadmap.md`、`docs/sprint0_closure.md`、`renv.lock`**；**`shared/` 下 10 個 UI 組件、2 個 Shiny 模組、3 個主題文件與 `config.R`／`load_shared.R`**；**`tools/` 下實測只有 `distribution-fitting`、`kernel-density` 與模板 `tool-00-template` 三個目錄**。本條目屬本輪主題**「不讓降級悄悄發生」**中的**第一種，也是四條裡把「不許悄悄降級」寫得最像法條的一條**——**它不是在文檔裡勸人別偷懶，而是把「禁止自動降級」立成了一條帶編號的規則**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與架構規格逐字實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **架構規格封面上寫著整套治理機制**，**逐字為**：**「Versión **2.0**」「Estado **Approved**」「Sustituye a v1.1. **Cambio de decisión de alto nivel** (filosofía de coste computacional y principios de plataforma). **Conforme a la regla §15.6, v1.1 se conserva y no se sobrescribe**」「Vigencia **Congelada**. **A partir de esta versión, todo cambio arquitectónico requiere un *Architectural Decision Record* (ADR) en `docs/decisions_log.md` que demuestre beneficio claro respecto a la arquitectura vigente (§10, regla 20)**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **即三件事同時成立**：①現行架構被**凍結**；②凍結之後**任何**架構改動都要留下一份 ADR，且該 ADR 必須**證明有明確收益**；③舊版本**保留**而非被覆蓋——**「v1.1 se conserva y no se sobrescribe」**（**並註明依據為 §15.6**）。**其文檔另逐字自述**：**「Este documento es la especificación técnica oficial y única referencia de arquitectura del proyecto. … Toda herramienta desarrollada dentro del proyecto debe cumplir lo aquí especificado. **Este documento es autosuficiente: no requiere ningún contexto adicional, conversación previa ni documento complementario para ser aplicado.**」**⭐⭐ **即規格自稱**自足**——不依賴任何額外上下文、先前對話或補充文檔即可執行****（**對做課程專案的學生，這是把「規則可交接」當作硬要求的一個樣本**）。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **ADR-007 是最值得單獨記住的一條，因為它撤回的是**一個已經許下的承諾****——**其 v2.0 變更表逐字列出**：**「1 | **Retirada de la promesa de ‘resultado en menos de un minuto’.** Se sustituye por una filosofía de plataforma basada en calidad, robustez estadística, reproducibilidad y transparencia. **El tiempo de ejecución es consecuencia del problema, no un objetivo**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **「運行時間是問題的結果，不是目標」是本輪四條候選中最鋒利的一句**：**它把「快」從產品承諾裡降級成了副產物**——**⚠️ 而這發生在該承諾**已經被寫下之後****，**故本條同時是一次**公開撤回****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **緊接的第二、三條把「不許降級」立成了規則**，**逐字為**：**「2 | **Profundidad del análisis controlada por el usuario** (perfiles *Standard* / *Comprehensive*), **sin degradación automática por tamaño de dataset**. **La diferencia es profundidad, no velocidad**」**與**「3 | **Principio explícito ‘optimizar la implementación: sí; degradar el análisis automáticamente: no’**」**（**均標註為 regla 19**）。⭐⭐⭐ **這兩條界定了一處**非常具體的誘惑**：**當數據量變大時，「靜悄悄地把算法換成便宜的那種」是工程上最省事的做法，也是最容易讓結論悄悄變味的一步**——**該規格的處理是：可以優化實現（寫更快的代碼），但**不可以自動降低分析深度**；**要降，必須由用戶**顯式選擇**檔位**。⭐⭐ **且措辭明確**：**「La diferencia es profundidad, no velocidad」**——**兩檔之間差的是深度，不是速度**（**即不許把「便宜檔」包裝成「快速檔」**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其餘三條 ADR 各管一處容易被悄悄繞過的地方****：**「5 | **Principio de validez estadística**: **los procedimientos cuya validez dependa de la estimación de parámetros deben ser válidos para ese contexto; su implementación pertenece al motor matemático, no al criterio ni al View Model**」（regla 18）**；**「6 | **Versionado del View Model (`schema_version`) y del criterio parametrizado (`decision_engine_version`), y tupla de reproducibilidad**」**；**「7 | **Proceso ADR obligatorio** para todo cambio arquitectónico posterior al Sprint 0」**。⭐⭐ **第 5 條回答的是「誰負責保證統計方法的適用性」**——**答案是**數學引擎**，不是判斷層、也不是視圖模型層****；**第 6 條把**視圖模型結構版本**與**參數化判據版本**都納入版本管理，並要求一個**可復現元組****（**⚠️ 未讀其具體構成**）。**其規格另逐字說明效力範圍**：**「Estos principios son de **plataforma**: los heredan automáticamente todas las herramientas presentes y futuras (Tool-01, Tool-02, Tool-03 EVT, Tool-04 Aggregate Models, Tool-05 Pricing, Internal Model Studio, ORSA Platform).」**⭐⭐ **即規則是**平台級**、由現有與將來的工具自動繼承**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **共享的「解釋框」組件是第二個具體機制：把「必須解釋」做成統一的殼，但拒絕替你寫解釋**——**`shared/components/ui_interpretation_box.R` 文件頭逐字**：**「Función pura de UI (catálogo 7.2). **Elemento diferencial del proyecto** (apartado 4.2): **traduce el resultado técnico a lenguaje comprensible**. **El texto lo compone cada herramienta** (típicamente con `glue()`); **este componente solo le da estilo**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **責任切得很乾淨**：**組件提供**樣式**（`div.bmk-interpretation`、`role="note"`、`aria-label`、標題可置 NULL 隱藏），**文字必須由每個工具自己撰寫****——**即「解釋」被做成了**每個工具都有的位置**，但**不能被模板化成套話****。**簽名逐字為 `bmk_interpretation_box(content, title = "Interpretación")`**，**文件頭另記「Autor: BMK — Última actualización: 2026-07-18」**；**⚠️ 該文件實測僅 1,419 位元組，與「解釋內容不在此處」的自述一致**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **v1.1 的 12 條修訂是一份**外部架構審計後的自我更正記錄**，其中三條對本行特別有參考價值**：**「2 | **Reparto de responsabilidad en los límites de datos.** El límite de tamaño de archivo (10 MB) se aplica en `mod_data_input`, con configuración explícita de `shiny.maxRequestSize`; el límite de filas (100.000) se aplica en `bmk_validate_data()`. **Se elimina de `bmk_validate_data()` la validación de tamaño de archivo, técnicamente imposible desde su firma**」**；**「1 | … **el prefijo aplica a nombres de función, no a nombres de archivo**」**；**「5 | **Corrección de referencia cruzada rota.** La regla de promoción a `shared/` está en el apartado 10 (regla 4), no en el 7.4」**。⭐⭐ **第 2 條尤其值得記**：**它把**文件大小上限**（10 MB）與**行數上限**（100,000）分別放在兩個不同組件，並給出理由——**「從 `bmk_validate_data()` 的函數簽名出發，校驗文件大小在技術上是**做不到**的」****（**對做代碼評審的同學，這類「看起來更整齊但技術上做不到」的重構是常見返工來源**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **定位、規模與自我認知均逐字可查**：**「Colección de 30-40 herramientas actuariales independientes construidas sobre una infraestructura común (**BMK Framework**). **Cada herramienta resuelve un único problema, priorizando la calidad y la robustez del análisis sobre el tiempo de ejecución.**」**；**「Base futura de **Internal Model Studio**, **ORSA Platform** y **Actuarial Risk Hub**.」**；**架構 §1.1**：**「entre 30 y 40 aplicaciones actuariales independientes, desarrolladas a lo largo de aproximadamente un año」**，**並要求**「suficientemente útil … **tanto por estudiantes como por profesionales del sector asegurador**」**；**§1.2 四項目的**：**「portfolio técnico / marca personal / repositorio de código reutilizable / base para productos comerciales futuros」**；**§1.3**：**「**Cada aplicación resuelve un único problema.** … **tiene prioridad sobre cualquier decisión técnica**.」**⭐⭐ **即其目標裡**同時寫著作品集、個人品牌與未來商業產品****（**如實記入，不作褒貶**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **結構與運行方式逐字**：**`shared/`（以 `source()` 載入的共同基礎設施）、`tools/`（一工具一文件夾、kebab-case slug；**`tool-00-template` 是模板而非目錄條目**）、`renv.lock`（**全專案唯一 `kernel-density`）**而寫的文檔**：**`tool02_b12_benchmark.md`、`tool02_b16_contract.md`、`tool02_bootstrap_contract.md`、`tool02_estimator_validation.md`、`tool02_inference_contract.md`、`tool02_mle_uncertainty.md`、`tool02_percentile_matching.md`、`tool02_pm_benchmark.md`、`tool02_pm_r2_diagnostic.md`、`tool02_release_v1_1_0.md`**⭐⭐ ADR」所形成的嚴格觀感不一致****（**⚠️ 不主張這會影響其架構治理的有效性**——**兩者發生在不同層面**；**此處只記錄實測所見**）。**④ ⚠️⭐ 另有一處**空目錄**：`shared/actuarial/.gitkeep`**（**即規格中提到的共享精算代碼目錄目前為空**）；**v1.1 修訂第 6 條要求 `shared/utils/` 與 `shared/actuarial/` 分立**，**⚠️ 本次實測只看到 `shared/actuarial/` 下僅有一個佔位文件，未見到 `shared/utils/`**。**⑤** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、README 全文、架構規格 v2.0 的封面欄位／v2.0 與 v1.1 變更表／§1.1–1.3，以及 `ui_interpretation_box.R` 全文**，**並以 tarball 列出全部 221 個條目核實結構與文檔清單**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆運行、未安裝 R 或任何依賴、未運行 `shiny::runApp()`、未讀 `docs/` 下**其餘任何文檔的內容**（含 `decisions_log.md` 的實際 ADR 全文）、未讀其餘 9 個組件、未讀 `shared/modules/`、`shared/theme/`、`shared/config.R` 或 `tools/` 下**任何工具的源碼****；**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實** ADR-007 所述「按 Standard／Comprehensive 兩檔控制深度」是否已在**任何實際工具中實現****（**未讀 `tools/` 下任何源碼**）**——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核實**「regla 19」與「regla 20」在規格正文中的**完整條款措辭****（**本次讀到的是變更表條目與封面聲明，非 §10 規則清單本身**）；**⑧ ⭐⭐ **未核實** `docs/decisions_log.md` 中是否確實存在 ADR-007／008／009／011 四份記錄**——**⚠️ 只核實了該文件存在與被封面引用，未讀其內容**；**⑨ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其架構是否真的處於「凍結」狀態**（**無提交歷史分析**）；**⑩ ⭐ **未核實**「唯一 lockfile」與「每工具獨立可運行」是否確實成立**；**⑪ ⭐ **未核實** `manifest.yml` 是否確為版本的唯一來源**（**v1.1 修訂第 7 條如此聲稱；本次未在 221 個條目中逐一核對其存在**）；**⑫ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其作者身份、執業背景或「BMK」所指**，**不主張**該專案由任何精算師協會、保險公司或監管機構背書**；**⑬ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、創建與推送均為 2026-09-07**，**關注度極低且自創建起未見後續推送**，**不主張其成熟度／正確性／已被採用**；**⑭ ⭐ 無 topics**；**⑮ **README 與全部文檔為西班牙語**——**已如實記入，本次未核實是否有英文或中文版本**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/sbenkkk/actuarial-tools-bmk` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 1,373 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對；`docs/architecture_v2.md`（56,668 位元組）與 `shared/components/ui_interpretation_box.R` 經 raw 實測讀取；**全部 221 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對；**未克隆運行、未安裝依賴、未運行任何 R 代碼、未讀其餘文檔與任何工具源碼**。
entries.body_en:
**actuarial-tools-bmk** (Actuarial Tools by BMK, repository `sbenkkk/actuarial-tools-bmk`) is **an R/Shiny framework whose product form is a set of mutually independent actuarial tools**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, R as the primary language, a 1,923 KB repository, created 2026-09-07 and last pushed 2026-09-07** (**all GitHub API measurements, both after the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file at all — no `LICENSE`, and no licence section in the README — the "no statement whatever" form**; it has **no topics**; **the README measures 1,373 bytes and is in Spanish**. **Key files and directories measured present** (**each listed by downloading the repository tarball, 221 entries in total**): **`docs/architecture_v2.md` (measured 56,668 bytes), `docs/architecture_v1_1.md` (retained rather than overwritten, as the specification itself requires), `docs/decisions_log.md`, `docs/data_contract.md`, `docs/releases.md`, `docs/roadmap.md`, `docs/sprint0_closure.md` and `renv.lock`**; **under `shared/`, 10 UI components, 2 Shiny modules, 3 theme files plus `config.R` and `load_shared.R`**; **and under `tools/`, measured as exactly three directories: `distribution-fitting`, `kernel-density` and the template `tool-00-template`**. It is the first of this round’s four takes on **not letting degradation happen quietly**, **and the one that writes the prohibition most like a statute** — **rather than advising against laziness in prose, it turns "no automatic degradation" into a numbered rule**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README and the architecture specification**): ⭐⭐⭐ **The specification’s own front matter states the whole governance mechanism**, **verbatim**: **"Versión **2.0**"; "Estado **Approved**"; "Sustituye a v1.1. **Cambio de decisión de alto nivel** (filosofía de coste computacional y principios de plataforma). **Conforme a la regla §15.6, v1.1 se conserva y no se sobrescribe**"; "Vigencia **Congelada**. **A partir de esta versión, todo cambio arquitectónico requiere un *Architectural Decision Record* (ADR) en `docs/decisions_log.md` que demuestre beneficio claro respecto a la arquitectura vigente (§10, regla 20)**"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things therefore hold at once**: **the current architecture is frozen; every architectural change after the freeze must leave an ADR that demonstrates a clear benefit; and the previous version is retained rather than overwritten** — **"v1.1 se conserva y no se sobrescribe"** (citing **§15.6**). **The document also states verbatim**: **"Este documento es la especificación técnica oficial y única referencia de arquitectura del proyecto. … Toda herramienta desarrollada dentro del proyecto debe cumplir lo aquí especificado. **Este documento es autosuficiente: no requiere ningún contexto adicional, conversación previa ni documento complementario para ser aplicado.**"** ⭐⭐ **The specification calls itself self-sufficient — executable without any extra context, prior conversation or companion document** (**for students doing coursework, a sample of treating "the rules must be handoverable" as a hard requirement**).

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ ADR-007 is the item to remember separately, because what it withdraws is a promise already made** — **its v2.0 change table reads verbatim**: **"1 | **Retirada de la promesa de ‘resultado en menos de un minuto’.** Se sustituye por una filosofía de plataforma basada en calidad, robustez estadística, reproducibilidad y transparencia. **El tiempo de ejecución es consecuencia del problema, no un objetivo**"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **"El tiempo de ejecución es consecuencia del problema, no un objetivo" — running time is a consequence of the problem, not a goal — is the sharpest sentence among this round’s four candidates**: **it demotes speed from a product promise to a by-product** — **⚠️ and this happens after the promise had already been written down**, **so the item is simultaneously a public retraction**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ The second and third entries turn "no degradation" into rules**, **verbatim**: **"2 | **Profundidad del análisis controlada por el usuario** (perfiles *Standard* / *Comprehensive*), **sin degradación automática por tamaño de dataset**. **La diferencia es profundidad, no velocidad**"** and **"3 | **Principio explícito ‘optimizar la implementación: sí; degradar el análisis automáticamente: no’**"** (**both labelled regla 19**). ⭐⭐⭐ **Together they bound a very specific temptation: as a dataset grows, quietly swapping in the cheaper algorithm is the least effort in engineering and the easiest way for conclusions to quietly change character** — **the specification’s answer: optimising the implementation is allowed (write faster code), but automatically reducing analytical depth is not; to reduce it, the user must explicitly choose a profile**. ⭐⭐ **And the wording is explicit**: **"La diferencia es profundidad, no velocidad"** — **what differs between the two profiles is depth, not speed** (**that is, the cheap profile may not be packaged as the fast one**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its three other ADRs each govern a place where something could quietly be bypassed**: **"5 | **Principio de validez estadística**: **los procedimientos cuya validez dependa de la estimación de parámetros deben ser válidos para ese contexto; su implementación pertenece al motor matemático, no al criterio ni al View Model**"** (regla 18); **"6 | **Versionado del View Model (`schema_version`) y del criterio parametrizado (`decision_engine_version`), y tupla de reproducibilidad**"**; **"7 | **Proceso ADR obligatorio** para todo cambio arquitectónico posterior al Sprint 0"**. ⭐⭐ **Item 5 answers who is responsible for a statistical method being applicable — the mathematical engine, not the criterion layer and not the view model**; **item 6 brings both the view model’s structural version and the parametrised criterion’s version under version control, plus a reproducibility tuple** (**⚠️ the tuple’s composition was not read**). **The specification also states the principles’ reach verbatim**: **"Estos principios son de **plataforma**: los heredan automáticamente todas las herramientas presentes y futuras (Tool-01, Tool-02, Tool-03 EVT, Tool-04 Aggregate Models, Tool-05 Pricing, Internal Model Studio, ORSA Platform)."** ⭐⭐ **The rules are platform-level and inherited automatically by current and future tools**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ The shared interpretation box is the second concrete mechanism: it makes "you must explain" a uniform shell while refusing to write the explanation for you** — **the header of `shared/components/ui_interpretation_box.R` reads verbatim**: **"Función pura de UI (catálogo 7.2). **Elemento diferencial del proyecto** (apartado 4.2): **traduce el resultado técnico a lenguaje comprensible**. **El texto lo compone cada herramienta** (típicamente con `glue()`); **este componente solo le da estilo**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **The responsibility is divided cleanly: the component supplies style (`div.bmk-interpretation`, `role="note"`, `aria-label`, a title that can be hidden with NULL), while the text must be written by each tool** — **interpretation becomes a place every tool has, but cannot be templated into boilerplate**. **Its signature reads verbatim `bmk_interpretation_box(content, title = "Interpretación")`**, and **the file header records "Autor: BMK — Última actualización: 2026-07-18"**; **⚠️ the file measures only 1,419 bytes, consistent with its own statement that the interpretation text does not live there**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ The twelve v1.1 revisions are a record of self-correction after an external architecture audit, and three of them are especially relevant to this field** — **"2 | **Reparto de responsabilidad en los límites de datos.** El límite de tamaño de archivo (10 MB) se aplica en `mod_data_input`, con configuración explícita de `shiny.maxRequestSize`; el límite de filas (100.000) se aplica en `bmk_validate_data()`. **Se elimina de `bmk_validate_data()` la validación de tamaño de archivo, técnicamente imposible desde su firma**"**; **"1 | … **el prefijo aplica a nombres de función, no a nombres de archivo**"**; **"5 | **Corrección de referencia cruzada rota.** La regla de promoción a `shared/` está en el apartado 10 (regla 4), no en el 7.4"**. ⭐⭐ **Item 2 deserves separate note: it splits the file-size limit (10 MB) and the row limit (100,000) across two different components and gives the reason — checking file size is technically impossible from `bmk_validate_data()`’s own signature**. **That is a correction that divides responsibility by what a function can actually do rather than by conceptual tidiness** (**for students doing code review, this kind of "tidier but technically impossible" refactor is a common source of rework**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its positioning, scale and self-description are all readable verbatim**: **"Colección de 30-40 herramientas actuariales independientes construidas sobre una infraestructura común (**BMK Framework**). **Cada herramienta resuelve un único problema, priorizando la calidad y la robustez del análisis sobre el tiempo de ejecución.**"**; **"Base futura de **Internal Model Studio**, **ORSA Platform** y **Actuarial Risk Hub**."**; **specification §1.1**: **"entre 30 y 40 aplicaciones actuariales independientes, desarrolladas a lo largo de aproximadamente un año"**, requiring each to be **"suficientemente útil … tanto por estudiantes como por profesionales del sector asegurador"**; **§1.2’s four objectives**: **"portfolio técnico / marca personal / repositorio de código reutilizable / base para productos comerciales futuros"**; **§1.3**: **"**Cada aplicación resuelve un único problema.** … **tiene prioridad sobre cualquier decisión técnica**."** ⭐⭐ **Its stated goals therefore include a technical portfolio, personal branding and future commercial products at once** (**recorded plainly, without praise or censure**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Structure and run method verbatim**: **`shared/` (common infrastructure loaded with `source()`), `tools/` (one folder per tool, kebab-case slug; **`tool-00-template` is the base template, not a catalogue entry**), `renv.lock` (**the project’s single lockfile**)**; **run with `shiny::runApp("tools/<slug>")`**; requiring **"Cada herramienta es autocontenida y ejecutable de forma independiente (**regla 11**)"**; **stack**: **R · Shiny · bslib · ggplot2 · plotly · DT · dplyr · tidyr · readr · glue · shinycssloaders · bsicons · yaml · renv**. ⭐⭐ **"A single lockfile" plus "every tool runs independently" is a deliberately chosen coupling boundary: dependencies unified, tools not depending on each other** (**⚠️ whether that constraint truly holds with only two tools was not verified**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Documentation density is another measurable fact** — **beyond the seven `docs/` files above, ten more documents exist specifically for the second tool (Tool-02, `kernel-density`)**: **`tool02_b12_benchmark.md`, `tool02_b16_contract.md`, `tool02_bootstrap_contract.md`, `tool02_estimator_validation.md`, `tool02_inference_contract.md`, `tool02_mle_uncertainty.md`, `tool02_percentile_matching.md`, `tool02_pm_benchmark.md`, `tool02_pm_r2_diagnostic.md` and `tool02_release_v1_1_0.md`** ⭐⭐ **a single kernel-density estimation tool carrying ten contract and benchmark documents, plus a v1.1.0 release record and a Sprint 0 closure record** (**⚠️ none of the ten was read, so no estimator, benchmark dataset or acceptance conclusion is restated**). **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s governance and toolset entries**: [[insurance-governance]], [[actuary-os]], [[orsa]], [[ifrs17-calculation-engine]], [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]], [[openrater]], [[claim-ops]] and [[paco-uw]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ The gap between description and fact must be written out: the README and specification describe a collection of 30–40 tools, while this check measured only 2 real tools under `tools/` plus 1 template** — **⚠️ but the specification itself does not overstate**: it states the scale as a plan over **roughly a year**, **and carries `docs/sprint0_closure.md` and `docs/tool02_release_v1_1_0.md` as phase markers**; **the entry therefore does not claim the repository already contains 30–40 tools**. **② ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as none (GitHub licence field NONE, `LICENSE` measured 404 by raw probe, and no licence section in either the README or the specification)** — **the "no statement whatever" form**; **the entry therefore advises confirming authorisation with the author before use, copying or redistribution** (**⚠️ its stated goals include being the base for future commercial products, so reusability should not be assumed**). **③ ⚠️ ⭐ The entry has a self-referential contrast that must be recorded: this documentation is emphatic that nothing may be degraded quietly, that no old version may be overwritten and that every change must leave a trace — yet the repository measurably commits `.DS_Store` (at the root and in `shared/`) and `shared/theme/.Rhistory`**, **so macOS metadata files and an R session history file did enter version control**, **which sits oddly with the strictness implied by a frozen, ADR-gated architecture** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim this affects the validity of its architecture governance — the two operate at different levels; only what was measured is recorded here**). **④ ⚠️⭐ There is also one empty directory, `shared/actuarial/.gitkeep`** (**the shared actuarial code directory the specification mentions is currently empty**); **v1.1 revision 6 requires `shared/utils/` and `shared/actuarial/` to be separated, ⚠️ but this check saw only a placeholder file under `shared/actuarial/` and no `shared/utils/`**. **⑤** This check verified **the repository metadata, the full README, the specification’s v2.0 front matter, its v2.0 and v1.1 change tables and §1.1–1.3, and the full text of `ui_interpretation_box.R`**, **and listed all 221 tarball entries to confirm the structure and document inventory**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone or run it, install R or any dependency, run `shiny::runApp()`, read the contents of any other document under `docs/` (including the actual ADR texts in `decisions_log.md`), read the other 9 components, read `shared/modules/`, `shared/theme/`, `shared/config.R`, or read the source of any tool under `tools/`**, so **no algorithm, estimator, benchmark result, acceptance criterion, data contract or interface behaviour can be restated**; **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether ADR-007’s "depth controlled by Standard/Comprehensive profiles" is implemented in any actual tool was not verified** (**no source under `tools/` was read**) — **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **⑦ ⭐⭐ The full wording of "regla 19" and "regla 20" in the specification body was not verified** (**what was read are the change-table entries and the front-matter statement, not the §10 rule list itself**); **⑧ ⭐⭐ Whether `docs/decisions_log.md` actually contains ADR-007, 008, 009 and 011 was not verified** — **⚠️ only that the file exists and is cited by the front matter, not its contents**; **⑨ ⭐⭐ Whether the architecture is genuinely frozen was not verified** (**no commit-history analysis**); **⑩ ⭐ Whether the single-lockfile and independently-runnable-tool constraints truly hold was not verified**; **⑪ ⭐ Whether `manifest.yml` is truly the single source of versioning was not verified** (**v1.1 revision 7 claims so; its presence was not checked entry by entry among the 221**); **⑫ ⭐ ⚠️ The author’s identity, professional background or what "BMK" refers to was not verified**, and **the entry does not claim the project is endorsed by any actuarial association, insurer or regulator**; **⑬ ⭐ At ★0, 0 forks, created and pushed on 2026-09-07**, **attention is very low and no later push was seen after creation**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⑭ ⭐ No topics**; **⑮ The README and all documents are in Spanish** — **recorded as such, and whether English or Chinese versions exist was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/sbenkkk/actuarial-tools-bmk` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field, stars, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 1,373-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; `docs/architecture_v2.md` (56,668 bytes) and `shared/components/ui_interpretation_box.R` were read via raw; **all 221 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**to confirm the `docs/` inventory, the `shared/` components and that `tools/` holds only 2 tools plus 1 template**); **nothing was cloned or run, no dependency installed, no R code executed, and neither the remaining documents nor any tool source were read**.
