**soa-srm-study-tracker**（倉庫 `JkMerlin/Actuarial-Data-Science-SRM`）是一個**面向 SOA「風險建模統計」（Exam SRM, Statistics for Risk Modeling）考試的備考作品集與進度追蹤系統**：**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 R、體量 66 KB、創建於 2026-08-31、最後推送 2026-09-09**（**創建在解凍窗口之前，推送落在窗口之內**）；**⚠️ 實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 實測 404，README 亦無許可章節——屬「完全未聲明」形態）**、**無 topics**；**README 實測 6,845 位元組（英語）**。**已實測存在的文件**（**經下載 tarball 逐一列出，共 13 個條目**）：**`README.md`、`parcourt.csv`、`parcourt.xlsx`、`code-implementations/update_readme.R`（實測 5,454 位元組）、`summaries/00_review.md`（實測 1,083 位元組），以及四個目錄 `summaries/`、`code-implementations/`、`cheatsheets/`、`soa-samples/` 各自的 `.gitkeep`**。本條目屬本輪主題**「不讓降級悄悄發生」**中的**第四種，也是四條裡唯一一條把「別高估自己」直接做成一個數字的一條**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與 `update_readme.R` 源碼逐字實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **本條目最值得記的是它**同時公佈兩個進度數字**，而這兩個數字的差距本身就帶信息**——**README 逐字為**：**「**Overall Reading Progress:** 21.0%」**與**「**Exam-Weighted Reading Progress:** 10.7%」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩個數字差了將近一倍，而原因是可查的**：**README 分主題表逐字為**：**「Basics of Statistical Learning 5-10% | 15 | 20 | 75.0% | 10.0%」「Decision Trees 20-25% | 0 | 11 | 0.0% | 22.5%」「Introduction and Review 0% | 10 | 10 | **100.0%** | **0.0%**」「Linear Models 40-50% | 5 | 70 | 7.1% | **45.0%**」「Time Series Models 10-15% | 0 | 18 | 0.0% | 12.5%」「Unsupervised Learning Techniques 10-15% | 0 | 14 | 0.0% | 12.5%」**⭐⭐⭐ **即：唯一讀完的那個主題（Introduction and Review）考試權重為 **0.0%**，而佔考試 **45%** 的線性模型只完成 **5/70（7.1%）****——**所以**原始閱讀進度 21.0% 幾乎全由不計分的部分撐起來，加權後只剩 10.7%****。**對備考的同學，這是一處很值得記住的對照**：**同一個人的同一份進度數據，用**讀完多少頁**和用**按考分加權讀完多少**衡量，會得出差一倍的兩個結論**——**而這一條是**由機制自動算出並同時擺出來的**（**⚠️ 未核實其權重向量是否與 SOA 現行 SRM 考綱一致——見標注 ②**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **生成這個面板的腳本實測可讀，其權重向量硬編碼在腳本裡**——**`update_readme.R` 中逐字為** **`weights <- c("Introduction and Review 0%" = 0.00, "Basics of Statistical Learning 5-10%" = 0.10, "Linear Models 40-50%" = 0.45, "Time Series Models 10-15%" = 0.125, "Decision Trees 20-25%" = 0.225, "Unsupervised Learning Techniques 10-15%" = 0.125)`**。⭐⭐⭐ **⚠️ 這一組權重實測**加起來是 1.025****（**0.00 + 0.10 + 0.45 + 0.125 + 0.225 + 0.125 = 1.025**），**而腳本對加權進度的計算逐字為** **`weighted_progress <- sum(progress$weighted, na.rm = TRUE)`**，**隨後直接以** **`percent(weighted_progress, accuracy = 0.1)`** **輸出，全程沒有截斷或上限處理****——**⚠️ 即**若所有主題都讀到 100%，該面板會顯示出 **102.5%** 的「按考試權重加權閱讀進度」****（**⚠️ 未運行該腳本，故記為由源碼與算術得出的推斷；當前 10.7% 的狀態下該缺陷是潛在的、不可見的**）。**③ ⭐⭐ **權重取值口徑本身有一處不一致，正是 1.025 的來源**——**四個帶區間的主題都取了**區間中點****（**20-25% 取 0.225、10-15% 取 0.125、40-50% 取 0.45**），**而**「Basics of Statistical Learning 5-10%」取了區間**上限 0.10 而非中點 0.075****——**⚠️ 即五處取中點、一處取上限**；**若該處也取中點，六個權重之和正好為 1.000****（**據此指出：**1.025 與「102.5%」都源於這一處取值口徑的不同****；**⚠️ 不主張作者是否有意如此**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **腳本裡還有兩處很細的工程判斷**：**其一，CSV 的 Section 列存在**重複空格**（**實測 `parcourt.csv` 中確有 `Basics of Statistical Learning  5-10%` 這樣的雙空格寫法**），**而腳本逐字先做規範化** **`Section = trimws(gsub("\s+", " ", Section))`** **再拿去與權重向量的鍵名匹配**——⭐ **即**權重向量的鍵名與 CSV 裡的寫法不必逐字相同，靠一次空白規範化對上****（**對做數據處理的同學，這是「同一件事在兩處寫法不一致」的最小修法**）；**其二，腳本在 README 標記缺失時直接停止**，**逐字為** **`start_marker <- "<!-- AUTO_PROGRESS_START -->"`**、**`end_marker <- "<!-- AUTO_PROGRESS_END -->"`**、**`if (is.na(start) || is.na(end)) { stop(paste0("README.md must contain both:
", start_marker,`**⭐⭐⭐ **即它**不猜、不追加、不靜默跳過，而是報錯停止****——**與本輪其餘三條候選的紀律同源**（**⚠️ 未運行該腳本，故未實測該 `stop` 是否確實觸發**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其「優先複習」一節是按**考試權重**排序，而不是按「完成得最少」排序**——**腳本逐字為** **`priority <- progress %>% filter(Total > 0, pct < 1) %>% arrange(desc(weight), pct) %>% slice_head(n = 3)`**⭐⭐ **即：先按權重降序，取權重最高的三個未完成主題**——**這解釋了 README 裡「優先複習」逐字為** **「1. **Linear Models 40-50%** — 5 / 70 completed (7.1%)」「2. **Decision Trees 20-25%** — 0 / 11 completed (0.0%)」「3. **Time Series Models 10-15%** — 0 / 18 completed (0.0%)」**⭐⭐⭐ **對備考的同學，這是本條最可直接借用的一處**：**排序依據是**這門考試看重什麼**，而不是**我哪裡落下最多****。**⚠️ 並如實指出**：**時間序列（0.125，完成 0.0%）與無監督學習（0.125，完成 0.0%）的**權重與完成率完全相同**，**`slice_head(n = 3)` 只取三個，第三個名額由數據行序決定**——**即**第 3 項是**並列中的任意一個****。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **追蹤表 `parcourt.csv` 的表頭與一條**很說明問題的**記錄逐字實測**：**表頭為** **`Section,Subsection,Source Reading,Total,Completed`**；**其「Source Reading」列同時出現教科書與模型名**——**逐字例如** **`Introduction and Review 0%,Maximum Likelihood Estimation,"Frees 11.9, GPT-4o",2,2`**⭐⭐ **即**該行把「Frees 11.9」與「GPT-4o」並列寫成了同一節的**閱讀來源****——**如實記入這一寫法，**不作褒貶、也不推斷其實際使用方式****。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **README 自述的學習方法與目錄設計逐字可查**：**定位逐字為** **「A technical portfolio and structured learning environment for my preparation for the **Society of Actuaries (SOA) Exam SRM (Statistics for Risk Modeling)**.」**；**並逐字說明**「… **Track learning progress programmatically**」**；**其方法比較表逐字列出五種方式**：**「Mathematical solution | Develop conceptual and quantitative understanding」「R implementation」「SQL implementation」「Visualization」「Written interpretation」**，**並逐字限定** **「**Not every problem requires every tool.** SQL is incorporated when the structure of the problem naturally lends itself to data extraction, filtering, aggregation, joining, or other relational operations.」**⭐⭐ **「不是每道題都要用上每種工具」是一句很實在的限定**（**即那張表是**可選工具菜單**而不是**流程清單****）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **其數據敘事一節逐字列出六條**可視化紀律**，並明確說這是為補上一種能力**：**逐字為** **「… through the study of *Storytelling with Data* by Cole Nussbaumer Knaflic. **The goal is to move beyond producing technically correct analyses toward communicating quantitative results clearly and effectively.**」**，**並列六條**：**Identifying the primary analytical message／Choosing visualizations based on the question being asked／Reducing unnecessary visual complexity／Directing attention toward important findings／Using appropriate comparisons／Providing sufficient context for interpretation**⭐⭐ **其中「根據所問的問題選擇圖表」與「減少不必要的視覺複雜度」兩條，對做課程匯報的同學是很具體的檢查項**。**⑨ ⭐ 可與 **soa-srm-study-tracker** (repository `JkMerlin/Actuarial-Data-Science-SRM`) is **a study portfolio and progress-tracking system for the Society of Actuaries Exam SRM (Statistics for Risk Modeling)**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, R as the primary language, a 66 KB repository, created 2026-08-31 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**both GitHub API measurements; creation before the thaw window, push inside it**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` measured 404, and the README has no licence section — the "no statement whatever" form)**; it has **no topics**; **the README measures 6,845 bytes and is in English**. **Files measured present** (**each listed by downloading the tarball, 13 entries in total**): **`README.md`, `parcourt.csv`, `parcourt.xlsx`, `code-implementations/update_readme.R` (measured 5,454 bytes), `summaries/00_review.md` (measured 1,083 bytes), and a `.gitkeep` in each of the four directories `summaries/`, `code-implementations/`, `cheatsheets/` and `soa-samples/`**. It is the fourth of this round’s four takes on **not letting degradation happen quietly**, **and the only one that turns "do not overstate your own position" directly into a number**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README and from `update_readme.R`**): ⭐⭐⭐ **What is most worth recording here is that it publishes two progress numbers at once, and the gap between them carries information** — **the README reads verbatim**: **"**Overall Reading Progress:** 21.0%"** and **"**Exam-Weighted Reading Progress:** 10.7%"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **The two differ by nearly a factor of two, and the reason is checkable**: **the README’s per-topic table reads verbatim**: **"Basics of Statistical Learning 5-10% | 15 | 20 | 75.0% | 10.0%"; "Decision Trees 20-25% | 0 | 11 | 0.0% | 22.5%"; "Introduction and Review 0% | 10 | 10 | **100.0%** | **0.0%**"; "Linear Models 40-50% | 5 | 70 | 7.1% | **45.0%**"; "Time Series Models 10-15% | 0 | 18 | 0.0% | 12.5%"; "Unsupervised Learning Techniques 10-15% | 0 | 14 | 0.0% | 12.5%"** ⭐⭐⭐ **the only fully completed topic, Introduction and Review, carries an exam weight of 0.0%, while linear models at 45% of the exam stand at 5 of 70, or 7.1%** — **so the 21.0% raw reading figure is carried almost entirely by material worth no marks, and the weighted figure is 10.7%**. **For students preparing an exam this is a contrast worth remembering: the same person’s same progress data, measured by pages read and measured by marks-weighted coverage, yields two conclusions a factor of two apart — and here that is computed and displayed side by side by a mechanism rather than left to self-awareness** (**⚠️ whether the weight vector matches the current SOA SRM syllabus was not verified — see note ②**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ The script that generates the panel is readable, and its weight vector is hardcoded** — **in `update_readme.R`, verbatim**: **`weights <- c("Introduction and Review 0%" = 0.00, "Basics of Statistical Learning 5-10%" = 0.10, "Linear Models 40-50%" = 0.45, "Time Series Models 10-15%" = 0.125, "Decision Trees 20-25%" = 0.225, "Unsupervised Learning Techniques 10-15%" = 0.125)`**. ⭐⭐⭐ **⚠️ Those weights measure, when added, to 1.025** (**0.00 + 0.10 + 0.45 + 0.125 + 0.225 + 0.125 = 1.025**), **and the weighted progress is computed verbatim as** **`weighted_progress <- sum(progress$weighted, na.rm = TRUE)`**, **then printed directly with** **`percent(weighted_progress, accuracy = 0.1)`**, **with no clamping or ceiling anywhere** — **⚠️ so if every topic reached 100%, the panel would display 102.5% exam-weighted reading progress** (**⚠️ the script was not run, so this is an inference from source and arithmetic rather than a measured output; at the current 10.7% the defect is latent and invisible**). **③ ⭐⭐ The weight convention itself is inconsistent in one place, and that is where 1.025 comes from** — **all four topics given as a range use the range midpoint** (**0.225 for 20-25%, 0.125 for 10-15%, 0.45 for 40-50%**), **while "Basics of Statistical Learning 5-10%" uses the upper bound 0.10 rather than the midpoint 0.075** — **⚠️ five midpoints and one upper bound**; **had that one also used its midpoint, the six weights would sum to exactly 1.000** (**the entry therefore points out that both the 1.025 and the "102.5%" arise from this single difference in convention; ⚠️ it does not claim this was deliberate**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ The script contains two further fine engineering judgements, both readable**: **first, the CSV’s Section column contains repeated spaces** (**`parcourt.csv` measurably contains values such as `Basics of Statistical Learning  5-10%` with a double space**), **and the script normalises before matching, verbatim** **`Section = trimws(gsub("\s+", " ", Section))`** — ⭐ **so the weight vector keys and the CSV values need not match character for character; one whitespace normalisation bridges them** (**for students doing data work, the minimal fix for "the same thing is written two ways in two places"**); **second, the script stops outright when the README markers are absent**, **verbatim** **`start_marker <- "<!-- AUTO_PROGRESS_START -->"`, `end_marker <- "<!-- AUTO_PROGRESS_END -->"`, `start <- match(start_marker, readme)`, `end <- match(end_marker, readme)`, `if (is.na(start) || is.na(end)) { stop(paste0("README.md must contain both:
", start_marker,`** ⭐⭐⭐ **it does not guess, append or silently skip — it errors and stops**, **cognate with the discipline of the round’s other three candidates** (**⚠️ the script was not run, so the `stop` was not measured to fire**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its "Current Study Priorities" section orders by exam weight rather than by least completed** — **the script reads verbatim** **`priority <- progress %>% filter(Total > 0, pct < 1) %>% arrange(desc(weight), pct) %>% slice_head(n = 3)`** ⭐⭐ **that is, descending weight, taking the three highest-weight unfinished topics** — **which explains why the README reads verbatim "1. **Linear Models 40-50%** — 5 / 70 completed (7.1%)", "2. **Decision Trees 20-25%** — 0 / 11 completed (0.0%)", "3. **Time Series Models 10-15%** — 0 / 18 completed (0.0%)"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **For students revising, this is the most directly borrowable point in the entry: the ordering criterion is what the exam rewards, not where one has fallen furthest behind** (**⚠️ ordered by "furthest behind", the 5-of-70 linear models and 0-of-11 decision trees would be followed by a tie between 0-of-18 time series and 0-of-14 unsupervised learning**). **⚠️ And the entry states plainly here that time series (0.125, 0.0% complete) and unsupervised learning (0.125, 0.0% complete) have identical weight and identical completion, so `slice_head(n = 3)` takes only three and the third slot is decided by row order — the third item is one of a tie** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the author chose time series over unsupervised learning deliberately**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ The tracking sheet’s header and one revealing record, measured verbatim**: **the header is** **`Section,Subsection,Source Reading,Total,Completed`**; **its "Source Reading" column contains textbooks and a model name together** — **for example, verbatim** **`Introduction and Review 0%,Maximum Likelihood Estimation,"Frees 11.9, GPT-4o",2,2`** ⭐⭐ **that row lists "Frees 11.9" and "GPT-4o" together as the reading sources for one section** — **recorded plainly, with neither praise nor censure and no inference about how it was actually used** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim this record represents any recommended study method**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ The README’s stated method and directory design are readable verbatim**: **its positioning reads** **"A technical portfolio and structured learning environment for my preparation for the **Society of Actuaries (SOA) Exam SRM (Statistics for Risk Modeling)**."**; **it states verbatim** "Rather than treating the required readings and examples solely as examination material, I use them as opportunities to … **Track learning progress programmatically**"; **its comparison table lists five approaches verbatim**: **"Mathematical solution | Develop conceptual and quantitative understanding", "R implementation", "SQL implementation", "Visualization", "Written interpretation"**, **qualified verbatim by** **"**Not every problem requires every tool.** SQL is incorporated when the structure of the problem naturally lends itself to data extraction, filtering, aggregation, joining, or other relational operations."** ⭐⭐ **"Not every problem requires every tool" is a genuinely practical qualifier — the table is a menu of available tools, not a process checklist**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its data-storytelling section lists six visualisation disciplines verbatim and says outright that this is about filling a gap**: **verbatim** **"… through the study of *Storytelling with Data* by Cole Nussbaumer Knaflic. **The goal is to move beyond producing technically correct analyses toward communicating quantitative results clearly and effectively.**"**, **listing six**: **Identifying the primary analytical message / Choosing visualizations based on the question being asked / Reducing unnecessary visual complexity / Directing attention toward important findings / Using appropriate comparisons / Providing sufficient context for interpretation** ⭐⭐ **"choosing visualizations based on the question being asked" and "reducing unnecessary visual complexity" are concrete check items for students presenting coursework**. **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s exam-preparation and portfolio entries**: [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]], [[actuaryradar]], [[insurers-101]], [[actxps]], [[tidyactuarial]], [[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]], [[actuarial-tools-bmk]], [[uae-health-pricing-model]] and [[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ The gap between description and fact must be written out**: **the README describes the four directories as four kinds of existing content** — **verbatim: "`summaries/` — **Granular technical notes** detailing statistical assumptions and conceptual definitions."; "`code-implementations/` — **Programmatic applications (R / Python)** of textbook methodologies."; "`cheatsheets/` — **Consolidated, high-density reference guides** outlining core formulas."; "`soa-samples/` — **Comprehensive solutions to official SOA sample examination problems**."** — **⚠️ yet this check measured three of the four directories as containing only a `.gitkeep` placeholder** (**`code-implementations/` excepted, which also holds `update_readme.R`**), **and `summaries/` as holding exactly one file, `00_review.md` at 1,083 bytes** — **⚠️ so of the four kinds of content listed, this check found one 1,083-byte review note**. **The entry therefore does not claim the repository already contains a technical-note collection, an R/Python implementation set, formula cheatsheets or SOA sample solutions**; **⚠️ but it must also state plainly**: **the README’s own per-topic table already publishes verbatim "Linear Models 5 / 70", "Decision Trees 0 / 11", "Time Series 0 / 18" and "Unsupervised 0 / 14"** — **so the repository’s disclosure of how little it contains is adequate and checkable**, **and its "10.7% exam-weighted progress" is consistent with it** (**this is not misreporting but a directory description written in the future tense**); **readers are therefore advised to judge the repository’s present state by its per-topic table rather than by its directory descriptions**. **② ⚠️⭐ The provenance of the weight vector is unexplained**: **it is hardcoded, the script reads no SOA syllabus file, and the README gives no source or version for those weights** — **⚠️ whether the six weights (0.00 / 0.10 / 0.45 / 0.125 / 0.225 / 0.125) match the official weight ranges of the current SOA SRM syllabus was not verified** (**no SOA syllabus or official document was consulted**); **and the entry records plainly that the convention differs in one place (five midpoints, one upper bound), making the weights sum to 1.025**. **③ ⚠️⭐ The weighted progress has no ceiling** (**see point ②**): **⚠️ `update_readme.R` was not run, so "it would display 102.5% at 100%" is an inference from source and arithmetic, not a measured output**. **④ ⚠️⭐ The README’s "Core Competencies" list is long** (**including supervised learning, regression and GLMs, decision trees and pruning, bagging, random forests, time series and ARIMA, PCA and clustering, bias-variance tradeoff, K-fold and leave-one-out cross-validation, R, SQL and Git**), **while this check measured very little content** (**see point ①**) — **⚠️ the list is therefore best read as study goals rather than completed output** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the author lacks any of these skills; it records only the gap between the list as declared and what the repository measurably contains**). **⑤** This check verified **the repository metadata and the README in full (positioning, competency lists, the method comparison table, the six data-storytelling disciplines, the four directory descriptions, the per-topic progress table, the three priorities, and the timestamp "September 09, 2026 at 10:28 AM")**, **the full text of `code-implementations/update_readme.R` (5,454 bytes, read line by line)**, **and the opening rows of `parcourt.csv` including the header and the GPT-4o row**, **and listed all 13 tarball entries to confirm the actual contents of the four directories and each file’s size**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install R or `dplyr`/`glue`/`scales`, run `update_readme.R`, read the contents of `summaries/00_review.md`, read all rows of `parcourt.csv`, open `parcourt.xlsx`, or read any other file**, so **no statistical implementation, formula, exercise solution, note content or progress figure beyond those quoted here can be restated**; **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether the weight vector and the "exam-weighted" definition match the current SOA SRM syllabus was not verified** (**see point ②**) — **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **⑦ ⭐⭐ `update_readme.R` was not run**, **so it was not measured whether the panel regenerates successfully, whether the `stop` truly fires when a marker is missing, whether `progress_bar()` renders correctly, or what the weighted progress actually evaluates to**; **⑧ ⭐⭐ The content and quality of `summaries/00_review.md` (1,083 bytes) were not verified**, **nor whether it is indeed statistical-assumptions and conceptual-definitions notes as the directory description says**; **⑨ ⭐⭐ The full contents of `parcourt.csv` were not verified** — **beyond the header and the GPT-4o row quoted here, its per-section Total and Completed values, whether they agree with the README table, and the overall style of the Source Reading column were not checked** (**⚠️ so the README’s 21.0% and 10.7% are recorded only as the values the README currently displays, and were not independently recomputed**); **⑩ ⭐ The relationship between `parcourt.xlsx` and `parcourt.csv` was not verified**; **⑪ ⭐ Whether `cheatsheets/`, `soa-samples/` or `summaries/` ever held content in earlier commits that was later emptied was not verified** (**no commit-history analysis**); **⑫ ⭐ ⚠️ Licence measured as none (`LICENSE` 404, no licence section in the README)** — **the "no statement whatever" form**; **the entry advises confirming authorisation with the author before reusing its notes, tracking data or script** (**⚠️ especially relevant to students building their own revision material**); **⑬ ⭐ ⚠️ The repository is also a job-seeking portfolio project, described in its own README as a "technical portfolio"** — **recorded plainly, so its competency lists are best read in that light; ⚠️ whether the author is still studying, has sat, or has passed the exam was not verified**; **⑭ ⭐ At ★0, 0 forks, created 2026-08-31 and pushed 2026-09-09**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⑮ ⭐ No topics**; **⑯ The README is in English** — **recorded as such, and whether Chinese or other language versions exist was not verified**; **⑰ ⭐ The entry does not claim this tracker’s design — in particular the exam-weighting approach — is the only or best one**; **it records the implementation and the two numbers published side by side**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/JkMerlin/Actuarial-Data-Science-SRM` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field, stars, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 6,845-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; `code-implementations/update_readme.R` (5,454 bytes) was read in full via raw; `parcourt.csv` was read via raw for its opening rows; **all 13 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**to confirm the actual contents of `summaries/`, `cheatsheets/` and `soa-samples/` and each file’s size**); **nothing was cloned, no R or package installed, no script run, neither `summaries/00_review.md` nor all of `parcourt.csv` read, and `parcourt.xlsx` not opened**.

entries.title_en: IPN — Insurance Product Notation: an open proposal for declaring an insurance product end to end as text from the quote questions through to claims, with a reference engine using only the Python standard library and examples and templates separately CC0-licensed so they can be copied into one’s own product

entries.summary: 一个把保险产品写成文本文件的记法提案：从报价时问哪些问题，到核保资格、保障范围、费率、保单生命周期与理赔，全部在同一个声明式文件里描述，并由一个仅用 Python 标准库的参考引擎（ipngine）读取、校验与报价；引擎提供 check、quote、batch 三个子命令，batch 支持把风险清单 CSV 批量定价后输出 CSV；仓库内有 16 份以上完整产品示例与每种产品形态各一份起手模板，且每份都带通过的场景测试；文档站由 GitHub Pages 托管并含一个浏览器内可试的 playground，docs/reference 下有一页专门列出这门语言**尚不支持**什么；许可按产物分层——语言与引擎为 Apache-2.0，而 examples/ 与 templates/ 内的文件为 CC0-1.0，因此可以直接抄进自己的产品而无需署名
entries.summary_hk: 一個把保險產品寫成文本文件的記法提案：從報價時問哪些問題，到核保資格、保障範圍、費率、保單生命週期與理賠，全部在同一個聲明式文件裡描述，並由一個僅用 Python 標準庫的參考引擎（ipngine）讀取、校驗與報價；引擎提供 check、quote、batch 三個子命令，batch 支持把風險清單 CSV 批量定價後輸出 CSV；倉庫內有 16 份以上完整產品示例與每種產品形態各一份起手模板，且每份都帶通過的場景測試；文檔站由 GitHub Pages 託管並含一個瀏覽器內可試的 playground，docs/reference 下有一頁專門列出這門語言**尚不支持**什麼；許可按產物分層——語言與引擎為 Apache-2.0，而 examples/ 與 templates/ 內的文件為 CC0-1.0，因此可以直接抄進自己的產品而無需署名
entries.summary_en: A proposal for a notation that writes an insurance product as a text file: from the questions asked at quote through eligibility, cover, rating, the policy lifecycle and claims, all described in one declarative file and read, validated and quoted by a reference engine (`ipngine`) that uses only the Python standard library; the engine offers `check`, `quote` and `batch` subcommands, with `batch` pricing a CSV of risks into a CSV of premiums; the repository holds more than sixteen complete example products plus one starter template per product kind, each carrying scenarios that pass; the documentation site is hosted on GitHub Pages with an in-browser playground, and `docs/reference/` includes a page listing what the language does **not** yet support; licensing is layered by artefact — Apache-2.0 for the language and engine, but CC0-1.0 for the files in `examples/` and `templates/`, so they can be copied into one’s own products without attribution
entries.body:
**ipn-insurance-dsl**（IPN — Insurance Product Notation，仓库 `jorjives/ipn`）**是一份把**保险产品本身**写成文本文件的记法提案**：**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 Apache-2.0（`LICENSE` 经 raw 实测存在，11,358 字节，首行为「Apache License」）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 1,215 KB、创建于 2026-09-07、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，创建与推送均落在解冻窗口之后**）、**无 topics**；**README 实测 1,597 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 183 个条目**。**其自述定位逐字为**：**「Insurance Product Notation: **an open proposal for declaring an insurance product end to end, from the questions asked at quote through eligibility, cover, rating, the policy lifecycle and claims**. **Written for insurance professionals.** The site is the place to learn it.」**，**文档站为 `https://jorjives.github.io/ipn/`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「宁可拒绝，也不假装」**中的**第一种，也是四条里唯一以**一门语言**而非一个系统为形态的一条**——**它不回答「这个风险该收多少钱」，而是回答「**这份产品的规则怎么写成一份可以被机器校验的文本**」。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其形态在本质上把「产品定义」与「执行产品的引擎」分开了**——**逐字为**：**「**The reference engine is the `ipngine` package: Python 3.12, standard library only.** `python3 -m unittest` runs its tests.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「standard library only」（仅用标准库）是一句**可实测**的话**：**本次列出的 `ipngine/` 下 10 个模块为 `__init__.py`、`__main__.py`、`cli.py`、`engine.py`、`expr.py`、`model.py`、`parser.py`、`scenarios.py`、`tables.py`、`versions.py`**——**⭐ 即一份解析器、一个表达式求值器、一个引擎、一个模型层、一张表与一个版本层**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读任何模块的源码**，**故**不主张其实现细节或「仅标准库」这一声明在每一行都成立**）。**② ⭐⭐ **引擎的四个命令逐字，且其中两个揭示了它面向的工作形态**——**逐字为**：**「`python3 -m ipngine check examples/home.ipn`」**、**「`python3 -m ipngine quote examples/household.ipn rebuild_cost=250000 contents_sum=20000 property_type=flat year_built=1990 previous_claims=0 ‘select=Buildings;Contents’`」**、**「`python3 -m ipngine batch examples/household.ipn examples/household-risks.csv > priced.csv`」**、**「`python3 -m ipngine batch examples/home.ipn examples/home-risks.csv specified_items=examples/home-specified-items.csv > home-priced.csv`」**⭐⭐⭐ **三个命令分别对应三件事**：**`check` 只校验那份产品文件；`quote` 对单个风险报价（**且参数以 `键=值` 形式从命令行传入，含 `select=Buildings;Contents` 这样的可选保障选择**）；`batch` 把**一整份风险清单 CSV**定价成**一份保费 CSV****——**⭐ 对做定价的同学，这是一条**很熟悉也很实在的工作流**：**产品规则写成文件 → 先校验 → 再单件试价 → 最后批量出价**（**可与本站 [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]] 与 [[openrater]] 并读**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其示例目录的规模与「每份都带通过的场景」这一要求是本条最值得记的一处**——**逐字为**：**「`examples/`: **sixteen complete products and one across three versions, each with scenarios that pass**. `home.ipn` is a familiar place to begin.」**与**「`templates/`: **starter products, one per kind, each with scenarios that pass**.」**⭐⭐ **实测 `examples/` 下有 **18 个顶层 `.ipn` 文件**——`cycle`、`ebike-fleet`、`family`、`gadget`、`home`、`household`、`income`、`irish-cycle`、`leasing`、`life`、`mortality`、`motor`、`multibike`、`pet`、`pi`、`runoff`、`travel`、`van`**——**另有 `examples/versioned/` 下**同一个产品的三个版本**（`bike-2026-01-01.ipn`、`bike-2026-07-01.ipn`、`bike-2027-01-01.ipn`）**⭐⭐⭐ **「each with scenarios that pass」是一条**可执行的要求**：**每份产品示例都必须自带**能通过的场景**，而不是一段演示文字****——**即**示例本身是被测试约束住的**（**⚠️ 本词条**未运行 `python3 -m unittest`**，**故**不主张这些场景确实通过**）；**⭐ 而 `versioned/` 下同一产品留三个日期版本，正对应 `docs/reference/versions.md` 与 `versions.py` 这一层**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **许可按**产物**分层，且两层都有实际文件**——**这是本站连续多轮记录许可问题后遇到的一个**正面样本****——**逐字为**：**「Licence: **Apache-2.0 for the language and the engine**; **the files in `examples/` and `templates/` are CC0-1.0, so they can be copied into your own products without attribution**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **实测该声明由三个许可文件支撑**：**根目录 `LICENSE`（11,358 字节，Apache License）**、**`examples/LICENSE`（7,048 字节，首行逐字为「Creative Commons Legal Code / **CC0 1.0 Universal**」）**与**`templates/LICENSE`（7,048 字节，同为 CC0 1.0）****——**⭐ 即**工具用 Apache-2.0、可被抄走当起点的产品示例用 CC0****，**而两处 CC0 文件实测都真的在对应目录里**；**对做课程项目或想搭自己产品的同学，这条分层意味着**可以合法地把它的示例产品当作起点**（**⚠️ 本词条**未逐份核对其 `examples/` 下每个文件是否都适用 CC0**——**只核实了两个 `LICENSE` 文件的存在与首行**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **文档里有一页专门列出这门语言**做不到什么****——**实测 `docs/reference/` 下共 14 页**，**逐字含** `product`、`inputs`、`eligibility`、`cover`、`rating`、`enrichment`、`table`、`lifecycle`、`claims`、`scenarios`、`versions`、`grammar`、`index` 与 ⭐⭐ **`not-yet-supported.md`**⭐⭐ **即「**尚未支持**」与「已支持」并列在同一个参考目录里**——**这与本轮其余三条候选的「宁可拒绝」是同一种姿态**：**先把边界写在读者能找到的地方**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读该页内容**，**故**不转述它列出哪些限制**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **文档站的三个可核实细节**：**其一，站点是 GitHub Pages 上的 Jekyll 站**（**实测含 `docs/_config.yml`、`docs/_includes/`、`docs/_sass/`**），**README 逐字说**「Start at the playground; engineers have their own section.」**⭐⭐ **其二，`playground` 有实际实现**：**实测 `docs/assets/js/` 下有 `ipn.js`、`ipn-complete.js`、`playground.js`、`book.js`**——**即存在一份**浏览器内的实现**，**故 playground 不需要服务端**；**其三，另有一份**机器可读的语法**：**实测 `docs/assets/ipn-grammar.json`**（**并对应 `docs/reference/grammar.md` 与生成脚本 `scripts/grammar_table.py`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **「同一个语言：一份给人读的参考、一份机器可读的语法文件、一份浏览器内可试的实现」三样齐备**，**是这门记法在本条最具体的技术特征**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **文档与示例**同源****——**逐字为**：**「`docs/examples/` and `docs/templates/` **are generated from the files above by `scripts/site_pages.py`**.」**⭐⭐ **即示例只维护一份（在 `examples/`／`templates/`），站点上的对应页面是**生成**出来的**（**实测 `scripts/site_pages.py` 存在**）**——**对做文档的同学，这是把「文档与代码不同步」从流程问题变成结构问题的一种做法**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **测试的命名方式值得单独记一句**：**实测 `tests/` 下 10 个模块（`test_book`、`test_cli`、`test_engine`、`test_expr`、`test_grammar`、`test_parser`、`test_scenarios`、`test_site`、`test_tables`、`test_versions`）**，**另有 `tests/batch-collections/` 下两个**以句子命名的测试**：**`test_1_price_a_book_whose_risks_carry_items.py`** 与 **`test_2_the_site_tells_the_two_file_shape.py`**⭐⭐ **「给一本风险条目里带明细的保单定价」「站点把两种文件形态讲清楚」——测试名直接写成它要证明的一句话**；**⭐ 第二个测试针对的还是**文档站本身****（**与第 334 轮 [[soa-srm-study-tracker]] 的「README 面板由脚本生成」属同一类做法：**让说明性产出也受测试约束**）。**⑨ ⭐ **可与本站报价引擎、产品与本体条目并读**：[[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[insurance-pricing-demo]]、[[product-actuary-kb]]、[[actuarial-ontology]]、[[risk-management-ontology]]、[[openinsurance]]、[[openidl]]、[[acord]]、[[bind-standard]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⭐ **本条目有一处**数字对不上，如实记录但不作错误断言****：**README 逐字说 `examples/` 是**「sixteen complete products and one across three versions」**（**十六份完整产品加一份跨三个版本的**），**而本次实测 `examples/` 下有 **18 个顶层 `.ipn` 文件**，另有 `versioned/` 下三个版本**——**⚠️ 即**实测的顶层产品数比 README 所说的多两个****（**⚠️ 一种可能是其中两份不算「完整产品」**——**例如 `mortality.ipn` 与 `pi.ipn` 看起来是特定用途的演示**，**⚠️ 但**本次未读任何 `.ipn` 文件的内容，也未读 `docs/examples/index.md`**，**故**不判断哪两份未被计入，也不断言此处有错****）。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次未能核实其「仅用 Python 标准库」这一声明的真实性**——**⚠️ 虽然 `pyproject.toml` 存在**，**但本词条**未读该文件的依赖声明**、**未安装、未运行**，**故**不主张 `ipngine` 在运行时不引入任何第三方包**；**⚠️ 也**未运行 `python3 -m unittest`****，**故**不主张其测试通过**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**任何一份示例产品的内容与正确性**——**包括其在中文语境下无对应物的险种（`irish-cycle`、`ebike-fleet`、`pi`、`runoff` 等）**，**故**不转述任何费率结构、保障条件或核保规则**；**⭐ 尤其**不主张**其示例中的任何产品定义与中国市场上任何保险公司的实际条款相符**（**本次未查任何条款、监管费率表或行业示范条款**）。**④ ⚠️⭐ **未核实** `docs/reference/not-yet-supported.md` 的内容**——**⚠️ 该页存在经实测确认**，**但**本次未读**；**本词条只记录「有一页专门列出尚不支持的功能」这一事实**，**不列举其限制清单**（**这是本条目最值得后续核实的一处**）。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**其 `docs/reference/versions.md` 与 `templates/versioned/` 所体现的版本机制**——**即**产品规则变更后**旧报价如何重新求值**这一问题**（**可与第 331 轮 [[paco-uw]] 与第 334 轮 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的「规则版本与报价的时间关系」并读**）；**本次只核实了三个按日期命名的版本文件存在**。**⑥ ⚠️ **本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README（1,597 字节）全文、以及仓库全部 183 个条目的文件清单**，**并核实了三个许可文件的存在与首行**（**根 `LICENSE` 11,358 字节；`examples/LICENSE` 与 `templates/LICENSE` 各 7,048 字节且首行为 CC0 1.0 Universal**），**以及 `docs/reference/` 14 页、`docs/assets/ipn-grammar.json`、`docs/assets/js/` 下四个脚本、`scripts/` 三个文件、`ipngine/` 10 个模块与 `tests/` 下 12 个测试文件的存在**；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 Python、未运行 `check`／`quote`／`batch`／`unittest`、**未读 `ipngine/` 任何模块的源码**、**未读任何 `.ipn` 文件**、未读 `pyproject.toml`、未读 `docs/` 下**任何页面的内容**、未打开其文档站或 playground****；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**该「开放式提案」是否有任何外部采用、讨论或实现**——**本次**未查其 issue、讨论区、引用或第三方实现**；**⚠️ 其自述为「**an open proposal**」（**一份开放式提案**）**而非已确立的标准**，**本词条据此**不主张**它已成为任何行业标准、被任何保险公司采纳或被任何监管机构认可**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其文档站 `https://jorjives.github.io/ipn/` 当前是否可访问**（**本次未访问该 URL**；**词条只记录 README 如此指向**）；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-09-07、推送于 2026-09-10**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑩ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑪ **README 与文档为英语**——**本词条已如实记入，**本次未核实是否有中文或其他语言版本**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/jorjives/ipn` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可字段 Apache-2.0、★数、fork 数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 topics）；README 1,597 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**仓库全部 183 个条目**经下载 `codeload.github.com` tarball 后以 `tar tz` 列出核对；**根 `LICENSE`（11,358 字节）、`examples/LICENSE` 与 `templates/LICENSE`（各 7,048 字节，首行 CC0 1.0 Universal）经 raw 实测读取**；**未克隆、未安装、未运行任何命令、未读任何源码或 `.ipn` 文件、未读任何文档页内容、未访问其文档站**。

**ipn-insurance-dsl**（IPN — Insurance Product Notation，倉庫 `jorjives/ipn`）**是一份把**保險產品本身**寫成文本文件的記法提案**：**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 Apache-2.0（`LICENSE` 經 raw 實測存在，11,358 位元組，首行為「Apache License」）、主語言 Python、體量 1,215 KB、創建於 2026-09-07、最後推送 2026-09-10**（**均落在解凍窗口之後**）、**無 topics**；**README 實測 1,597 位元組（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 183 個條目**。**其自述定位逐字為**：**「Insurance Product Notation: **an open proposal for declaring an insurance product end to end, from the questions asked at quote through eligibility, cover, rating, the policy lifecycle and claims**. **Written for insurance professionals.** The site is the place to learn it.」**，**文檔站為 `https://jorjives.github.io/ipn/`**。本條目屬本輪主題**「寧可拒絕，也不假裝」**中的**第一種，也是四條裡唯一以**一門語言**而非一個系統為形態的一條**——**它不回答「這個風險該收多少錢」，而是回答「**這份產品的規則怎麼寫成一份可以被機器校驗的文本**」。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其形態在本質上把「產品定義」與「執行產品的引擎」分開了**——**逐字為**：**「**The reference engine is the `ipngine` package: Python 3.12, standard library only.** `python3 -m unittest` runs its tests.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「standard library only」（僅用標準庫）是一句**可實測**的話**：**本次列出的 `ipngine/` 下 10 個模組為 `__init__.py`、`__main__.py`、`cli.py`、`engine.py`、`expr.py`、`model.py`、`parser.py`、`scenarios.py`、`tables.py`、`versions.py`**——**⭐ 即一份解析器、一個表達式求值器、一個引擎、一個模型層、一張表與一個版本層**（**⚠️ 未讀任何模組的源碼，故不主張其實現細節或「僅標準庫」在每一行都成立**）。**② ⭐⭐ **引擎的四個命令逐字，其中兩個揭示了它面向的工作形態**——**逐字為**：**「`python3 -m ipngine check examples/home.ipn`」**、**「`python3 -m ipngine quote examples/household.ipn rebuild_cost=250000 contents_sum=20000 property_type=flat year_built=1990 previous_claims=0 ‘select=Buildings;Contents’`」**、**「`python3 -m ipngine batch examples/household.ipn examples/household-risks.csv > priced.csv`」**、**「`python3 -m ipngine batch examples/home.ipn examples/home-risks.csv specified_items=examples/home-specified-items.csv > home-priced.csv`」**⭐⭐⭐ **三個命令分別對應三件事**：**`check` 只校驗那份產品文件；`quote` 對單個風險報價（**參數以 `鍵=值` 從命令行傳入，含 `select=Buildings;Contents` 這類可選保障選擇**）；`batch` 把**一整份風險清單 CSV**定價成**一份保費 CSV****——**⭐ 對做定價的同學，這是一條很熟悉也很實在的工作流：**產品規則寫成文件 → 先校驗 → 再單件試價 → 最後批量出價****（**可與 [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]] 與 [[openrater]] 並讀**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其示例目錄的規模與「每份都帶通過的場景」這一要求是本條最值得記的一處**——**逐字**：**「`examples/`: **sixteen complete products and one across three versions, each with scenarios that pass**. `home.ipn` is a familiar place to begin.」**與**「`templates/`: **starter products, one per kind, each with scenarios that pass**.」**⭐⭐ **實測 `examples/` 下有 **18 個頂層 `.ipn`**——`cycle`、`ebike-fleet`、`family`、`gadget`、`home`、`household`、`income`、`irish-cycle`、`leasing`、`life`、`mortality`、`motor`、`multibike`、`pet`、`pi`、`runoff`、`travel`、`van`**——**另有 `examples/versioned/` 下**同一個產品的三個版本**（`bike-2026-01-01.ipn`、`bike-2026-07-01.ipn`、`bike-2027-01-01.ipn`）**⭐⭐⭐ **「each with scenarios that pass」是一條**可執行的要求**：**每份產品示例都必須自帶**能通過的場景**，而不是一段演示文字****——**即**示例本身是被測試約束住的**（**⚠️ 未運行 `python3 -m unittest`，故不主張這些場景確實通過**）；**⭐ 而 `versioned/` 下同一產品留三個日期版本，正對應 `docs/reference/versions.md` 與 `versions.py` 這一層**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **許可按**產物**分層，且兩層都有實際文件**——**這是本站連續多輪記錄許可問題後遇到的一個**正面樣本****——**逐字**：**「Licence: **Apache-2.0 for the language and the engine**; **the files in `examples/` and `templates/` are CC0-1.0, so they can be copied into your own products without attribution**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **實測該聲明由三個許可文件支撐**：**根目錄 `LICENSE`（11,358 位元組，Apache License）**、**`examples/LICENSE`（7,048 位元組，首行逐字為「Creative Commons Legal Code / **CC0 1.0 Universal**」）**與**`templates/LICENSE`（7,048 位元組，同為 CC0 1.0）****——**⭐ 即**工具用 Apache-2.0、可被抄走當起點的產品示例用 CC0****，**而兩處 CC0 文件實測都真的在對應目錄裡**；**對做課程專案或想搭自己產品的同學，這條分層意味著**可以合法地把它的示例產品當作起點****（**⚠️ 未逐份核對其 `examples/` 下每個文件是否都適用 CC0——只核實了兩個 `LICENSE` 文件的存在與首行**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **文檔裡有一頁專門列出這門語言**做不到什麼****——**實測 `docs/reference/` 下共 14 頁**，**逐字含** `product`、`inputs`、`eligibility`、`cover`、`rating`、`enrichment`、`table`、`lifecycle`、`claims`、`scenarios`、`versions`、`grammar`、`index` 與 ⭐⭐ **`not-yet-supported.md`**⭐⭐ **即「**尚未支持**」與「已支持」並列在同一個參考目錄裡**——**這與本輪其餘三條候選的「寧可拒絕」是同一種姿態**：**先把邊界寫在讀者能找到的地方**（**⚠️ 未讀該頁內容，故不轉述它列出哪些限制**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **文檔站的三個可核實細節**：**其一，站點是 GitHub Pages 上的 Jekyll 站**（**實測含 `docs/_config.yml`、`docs/_includes/`、`docs/_sass/`**），**README 逐字說**「Start at the playground; engineers have their own section.」**⭐⭐ **其二，`playground` 有實際實現**：**實測 `docs/assets/js/` 下有 `ipn.js`、`ipn-complete.js`、`playground.js`、`book.js`**——**即存在一份**瀏覽器內的實現**，**故 playground 不需要服務端**；**其三，另有一份**機器可讀的語法**：**實測 `docs/assets/ipn-grammar.json`**（**對應 `docs/reference/grammar.md` 與生成腳本 `scripts/grammar_table.py`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **「同一門語言：一份給人讀的參考、一份機器可讀的語法文件、一份瀏覽器內可試的實現」三樣齊備**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **文檔與示例**同源****——**逐字**：**「`docs/examples/` and `docs/templates/` **are generated from the files above by `scripts/site_pages.py`**.」**⭐⭐ **即示例只維護一份（在 `examples/`／`templates/`），站點上的對應頁面是**生成**出來的**——**對做文檔的同學，這是把「文檔與代碼不同步」從流程問題變成結構問題的一種做法**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **測試的命名方式值得單獨記一句**：**實測 `tests/` 下 10 個模組，另有 `tests/batch-collections/` 下兩個**以句子命名的測試**：**`test_1_price_a_book_whose_risks_carry_items.py`** 與 **`test_2_the_site_tells_the_two_file_shape.py`**⭐⭐ **測試名直接寫成它要證明的一句話**；**⭐ 第二個測試針對的還是**文檔站本身****（**與第 334 輪 [[soa-srm-study-tracker]] 的「README 面板由腳本生成」同類：**讓說明性產出也受測試約束**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可與 [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[insurance-pricing-demo]]、[[product-actuary-kb]]、[[actuarial-ontology]]、[[risk-management-ontology]]、[[openinsurance]]、[[openidl]]、[[acord]]、[[bind-standard]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⭐ **一處**數字對不上，如實記錄但不作錯誤斷言****：**README 逐字說 `examples/` 是**「sixteen complete products and one across three versions」**，**而實測 `examples/` 下有 **18 個頂層 `.ipn`**，另有 `versioned/` 下三個版本**——**⚠️ 即**實測的頂層產品數比 README 所說的多兩個****（**⚠️ 一種可能是其中兩份不算「完整產品」**——**例如 `mortality.ipn` 與 `pi.ipn` 看起來是特定用途的演示**，**⚠️ 但本次未讀任何 `.ipn` 文件的內容，也未讀 `docs/examples/index.md`，故不判斷哪兩份未被計入，也不斷言此處有錯****）。**② ⚠️⚠️ **未核實其「僅用 Python 標準庫」這一聲明的真實性**——**⚠️ 雖然 `pyproject.toml` 存在**，**但未讀其依賴聲明、未安裝、未運行**；**⚠️ 也**未運行 `python3 -m unittest`****。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**任何一份示例產品的內容與正確性**，**故**不轉述任何費率結構、保障條件或核保規則**；**⭐ 尤其**不主張**其示例中的任何產品定義與中國市場上任何保險公司的實際條款相符**。**④ ⚠️⭐ **未核實** `docs/reference/not-yet-supported.md` 的內容**——**⚠️ 該頁存在經實測確認，但本次未讀**；**只記錄「有一頁專門列出尚不支援的功能」這一事實**（**這是本條目最值得後續核實的一處**）。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核實**其版本機制**——**即**產品規則變更後**舊報價如何重新求值**（**可與第 331 輪 [[paco-uw]] 與第 334 輪 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 並讀**）；**本次只核實了三個按日期命名的版本文件存在**。**⑥ ⚠️ **本次核實到**倉庫元數據、README 全文、以及全部 183 個條目的文件清單**，**並核實三個許可文件的存在與首行**，**以及 `docs/reference/` 14 頁、`docs/assets/ipn-grammar.json`、`docs/assets/js/` 下四個腳本、`scripts/` 三個文件、`ipngine/` 10 個模組與 `tests/` 下 12 個測試文件的存在**；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安裝 Python、未運行 `check`／`quote`／`batch`／`unittest`、**未讀 `ipngine/` 任何源碼**、**未讀任何 `.ipn` 文件**、未讀 `pyproject.toml`、未讀 `docs/` 下**任何頁面內容**、未打開其文檔站或 playground****；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核實**該「開放式提案」是否有任何外部採用、討論或實現**——**本次未查其 issue、討論區、引用或第三方實現**；**⚠️ 其自述為「**an open proposal**」而非已確立的標準**，**據此**不主張**它已成為任何行業標準、被任何保險公司採納或被任何監管機構認可**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其文檔站當前是否可訪問**（**本次未訪問該 URL**）；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、創建於 2026-09-07、推送於 2026-09-10**，**不主張其成熟度／正確性／已被採用**；**⑩ ⭐ 無 topics**；**⑪ **README 與文檔為英語**——**已如實記入，本次未核實是否有中文或其他語言版本**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/jorjives/ipn` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 1,597 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對；**全部 183 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對；**根 `LICENSE`（11,358 位元組）、`examples/LICENSE` 與 `templates/LICENSE`（各 7,048 位元組，首行 CC0 1.0 Universal）經 raw 實測讀取**；**未克隆、未安裝、未運行任何命令、未讀任何源碼或 `.ipn` 文件、未讀任何文檔頁內容、未訪問其文檔站**。

**ipn-insurance-dsl** (IPN — Insurance Product Notation, repository `jorjives/ipn`) **is a proposal for a notation that writes the insurance product itself as a text file**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, licence Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE` measured present by raw probe at 11,358 bytes, first line "Apache License"), Python as the primary language, a 1,215 KB repository, created 2026-09-07 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, both after the thaw window**), **no topics**; **the README measures 1,597 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 183 entries in total**. **Its stated positioning reads verbatim**: **"Insurance Product Notation: **an open proposal for declaring an insurance product end to end, from the questions asked at quote through eligibility, cover, rating, the policy lifecycle and claims**. **Written for insurance professionals.** The site is the place to learn it."**, with the documentation site at `https://jorjives.github.io/ipn/`. It is the first of this round’s four takes on **rather refusing than pretending**, **and the only one whose form is a language rather than a system** — **it does not answer "what should this risk be charged" but "how are this product’s rules written as a text file a machine can validate"**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its form separates the product definition from the engine that executes it** — **verbatim**: **"**The reference engine is the `ipngine` package: Python 3.12, standard library only.** `python3 -m unittest` runs its tests."** ⭐⭐⭐ **"standard library only" is a measurable claim**: **the ten modules listed under `ipngine/` are `__init__.py`, `__main__.py`, `cli.py`, `engine.py`, `expr.py`, `model.py`, `parser.py`, `scenarios.py`, `tables.py` and `versions.py`** — ⭐ **a parser, an expression evaluator, an engine, a model layer, a table layer and a version layer** (**⚠️ no module source was read, so no claim is made about implementation detail or that "standard library only" holds on every line**). **② ⭐⭐ Its four engine commands are verbatim, and two of them reveal the working shape it targets** — **verbatim**: **"`python3 -m ipngine check examples/home.ipn`"; "`python3 -m ipngine quote examples/household.ipn rebuild_cost=250000 contents_sum=20000 property_type=flat year_built=1990 previous_claims=0 ‘select=Buildings;Contents’`"; "`python3 -m ipngine batch examples/household.ipn examples/household-risks.csv > priced.csv`"; "`python3 -m ipngine batch examples/home.ipn examples/home-risks.csv specified_items=examples/home-specified-items.csv > home-priced.csv`"** ⭐⭐⭐ **the three commands map to three things**: **`check` validates the product file alone; `quote` prices a single risk (with parameters passed as `key=value` on the command line, including optional-cover selections such as `select=Buildings;Contents`); `batch` prices an entire CSV of risks into a CSV of premiums** — ⭐ **for students of pricing this is a familiar and practical workflow: write the product rules as a file, validate first, try a single quote, then price in bulk** (**readable with the site’s [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]] and [[openrater]]**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The size of its example directory and the "scenarios that pass" requirement are the most notable point in the entry** — **verbatim**: **"`examples/`: **sixteen complete products and one across three versions, each with scenarios that pass**. `home.ipn` is a familiar place to begin."** and **"`templates/`: **starter products, one per kind, each with scenarios that pass**."** ⭐⭐ **`examples/` measurably holds 18 top-level `.ipn` files** — `cycle`, `ebike-fleet`, `family`, `gadget`, `home`, `household`, `income`, `irish-cycle`, `leasing`, `life`, `mortality`, `motor`, `multibike`, `pet`, `pi`, `runoff`, `travel` and `van` — **plus three versions of one product under `examples/versioned/`** (`bike-2026-01-01.ipn`, `bike-2026-07-01.ipn`, `bike-2027-01-01.ipn`). ⭐⭐⭐ **"each with scenarios that pass" is an executable requirement: every example product must carry scenarios that pass rather than a demonstration paragraph** — **the examples are themselves held by tests** (**⚠️ `python3 -m unittest` was not run, so the scenarios are not claimed to pass**); ⭐ **and keeping three dated versions of one product under `versioned/` corresponds to the version layer in `versions.py`**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Licensing is layered by artefact, and both layers have actual files — a positive sample after many consecutive rounds of the site recording licence problems** — **verbatim**: **"Licence: **Apache-2.0 for the language and the engine**; **the files in `examples/` and `templates/` are CC0-1.0, so they can be copied into your own products without attribution**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three licence files measurably back that statement**: **the root `LICENSE` (11,358 bytes, Apache License)**, **`examples/LICENSE` (7,048 bytes, first lines verbatim "Creative Commons Legal Code / **CC0 1.0 Universal**")** and **`templates/LICENSE` (7,048 bytes, likewise CC0 1.0)** — ⭐ **the tooling is Apache-2.0 while the product examples meant to be copied as a starting point are CC0, and both CC0 files are measurably present in the directories they govern**; **for students doing coursework or wanting to build their own product, that layering means the example products can legitimately be used as a starting point** (**⚠️ whether every file under `examples/` is covered by CC0 was not checked file by file — only the two `LICENSE` files’ presence and first lines were verified**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ The documentation includes a page listing what the language **cannot** do** — **`docs/reference/` measurably holds 14 pages**, **verbatim including** `product`, `inputs`, `eligibility`, `cover`, `rating`, `enrichment`, `table`, `lifecycle`, `claims`, `scenarios`, `versions`, `grammar`, `index` and ⭐⭐ **`not-yet-supported.md`** ⭐⭐ **"not yet supported" sits in the same reference directory as what is supported** — **the same posture as the round’s other three candidates: write the boundary where a reader can find it** (**⚠️ that page was not read, so the limitations it lists are not restated**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Three checkable details about the documentation site**: **first, the site is a Jekyll site on GitHub Pages** (**`docs/_config.yml`, `docs/_includes/` and `docs/_sass/` measured present**), and the README says verbatim "Start at the playground; engineers have their own section."; ⭐⭐ **second, the playground has a real implementation**: **`docs/assets/js/` measurably holds `ipn.js`, `ipn-complete.js`, `playground.js` and `book.js`** — **so a browser-side implementation exists and the playground needs no server**; **third, a machine-readable grammar also exists**: **`docs/assets/ipn-grammar.json` is measurably present** (**corresponding to `docs/reference/grammar.md` and the generator `scripts/grammar_table.py`**) ⭐⭐⭐ **one language with three artefacts: a reference for people, a machine-readable grammar file, and an implementation runnable in the browser**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ The documentation and the examples share one source** — **verbatim**: **"`docs/examples/` and `docs/templates/` **are generated from the files above by `scripts/site_pages.py`**."** ⭐⭐ **the examples exist once (under `examples/` and `templates/`) and the site pages are generated from them** — **for students writing documentation, a way to turn "the docs and the code drift apart" from a process problem into a structural one**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its test naming deserves a separate sentence**: **`tests/` measurably holds ten modules, plus two sentence-named tests under `tests/batch-collections/`**: **`test_1_price_a_book_whose_risks_carry_items.py`** and **`test_2_the_site_tells_the_two_file_shape.py`** ⭐⭐ **the test names are written as the sentence each one proves**; ⭐ **and the second targets the documentation site itself** (**the same family as round 334’s [[soa-srm-study-tracker]], where the README panel is script-generated: making explanatory output subject to tests too**). **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s quoting-engine, product and ontology entries**: [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]], [[openrater]], [[ratecraft]], [[insurance-pricing-demo]], [[product-actuary-kb]], [[actuarial-ontology]], [[risk-management-ontology]], [[openinsurance]], [[openidl]], [[acord]] and [[bind-standard]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⭐ One count does not match, recorded plainly without asserting an error**: **the README says verbatim that `examples/` holds "sixteen complete products and one across three versions", while this check measured 18 top-level `.ipn` files plus three versions under `versioned/`** — **⚠️ the measured top-level product count is two higher than the README says** (**⚠️ one possibility is that two are not counted as complete products — `mortality.ipn` and `pi.ipn` look like purpose-specific demonstrations; ⚠️ but no `.ipn` file was read and `docs/examples/index.md` was not read, so the entry neither judges which two were excluded nor asserts an error**). **② ⚠️⚠️ Whether "standard library only" is true was not verified** — **⚠️ `pyproject.toml` is present but its dependency declaration was not read, nothing was installed and nothing was run**; **⚠️ nor was `python3 -m unittest` run**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ The content and correctness of any example product was not verified**, **so no rating structure, cover condition or underwriting rule is restated**; ⭐ **in particular, no example product definition is claimed to match any insurer’s actual terms in the Chinese market**. **④ ⚠️⭐ The contents of `docs/reference/not-yet-supported.md` were not verified** — **⚠️ the page is measurably present but was not read**; entries.title: 尼日利亚海洋保险核心引擎：设计信条第一条写「到处 fail-closed」，并明说「成功从不被伪造」、再保险分保「省略而非留桩」，且以数据库约束拒绝提交任何不平衡的分录
entries.title_en: A Nigerian marine insurance core engine whose first design principle is fail-closed everywhere, which states that success is never fabricated, declares reinsurance ceding omitted rather than stubbed, and has the database refuse to commit any unbalanced journal
entries.title_hk: 尼日利亞海洋保險核心引擎：設計信條第一條寫「到處 fail-closed」，並明說「成功從不被偽造」、再保險分保「省略而非留樁」，且以數據庫約束拒絕提交任何不平衡的分錄
entries.summary: 一个面向尼日利亚 BlueEconomy 公私合营平台的海洋保险引擎：产品目录、服务端确定性保费计算、报价→承保（maker-checker 双人控制）→以 W3C VC 2.0 凭证签发保单、批单、失效／注销（配位串状态表撤销）与双分录结算的理赔；其设计信条逐条可核对——到处 fail-closed（启动即拒绝占位签名密钥、全局可读的密钥文件、畸形的策略配置；未配置的集成报告不可用并返回 503，而文档明言「成功从不被伪造」）；金额只用整数最小币种单位、费率与风险因子只用基点，「任何地方都没有浮点数」，且客户端自报的保费总额对不上就被拒；不变式由数据库强制（checker ≠ maker 的 CHECK 约束、哈希链式追加审计、触发器拒绝 UPDATE/DELETE、以及一个延迟约束触发器拒绝提交任何借贷不平衡的分录）；再保险分保功能「省略而非留桩」，能力注册表会以明确的「未实现」理由报告其不可用
entries.summary_hk: 一個面向尼日利亞 BlueEconomy 公私營合營平台的海洋保險引擎：產品目錄、服務端確定性保費計算、報價→承保（maker-checker 雙人控制）→以 W3C VC 2.0 憑證簽發保單、批單、失效／註銷（配位串狀態表撤銷）與雙分錄結算的理賠；其設計信條逐條可核對——到處 fail-closed（啟動即拒絕佔位簽名密鑰、全局可讀的密鑰文件、畸形的策略配置；未配置的集成報告不可用並返回 503，而文檔明言「成功從不被偽造」）；金額只用整數最小幣種單位、費率與風險因子只用基點，「任何地方都沒有浮點數」，且客戶端自報的保費總額對不上就被拒；不變式由數據庫強制（checker ≠ maker 的 CHECK 約束、哈希鏈式追加審計、觸發器拒絕 UPDATE/DELETE、以及一個延遲約束觸發器拒絕提交任何借貸不平衡的分錄）；再保險分保功能「省略而非留樁」，能力註冊表會以明確的「未實現」理由報告其不可用
entries.summary_en: A marine insurance engine for Nigeria’s BlueEconomy public-private partnership platform: product catalogue, deterministic server-side premium rating, a quote to bind (maker-checker dual control) to issuance flow that issues policies as W3C VC 2.0 credentials, endorsements, lapse and cancellation with bitstring status-list revocation, and claims settled by double entry; its design doctrine is stated point by point and is checkable — fail-closed everywhere (boot refuses placeholder signing keys, world-readable key files and malformed policy or adapter configuration; unconfigured integrations report unavailable and return 503, with the documentation stating that success is never fabricated); money is integer minor units only and rates and risk factors are basis points, with no floats anywhere, and a client-supplied premium total is rejected on mismatch; invariants are enforced by the database (a CHECK constraint for checker not equal to maker, an append-only hash-chained audit with UPDATE and DELETE rejected by trigger, and a deferred constraint trigger that rejects the commit of any unbalanced journal); and reinsurance ceding is declared omitted rather than stubbed, with the capabilities registry reporting it unavailable for an explicit not-implemented reason
entries.body:
**blueeconomy-marine-insurance**（仓库 `munisp/blueeconomy-insurance`）**是一个面向尼日利亚 BlueEconomy 公私合营（PPP）平台的**海洋保险（marine insurance）核心引擎****：**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 Apache-2.0（`LICENSE` 经 raw 实测存在，11,358 字节，首行「Apache License」）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 157 KB、创建于 2026-08-31、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）、**无 topics**；**README 实测 4,316 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 100 个条目**。**其自述范围逐字为**：**「Marine insurance engine for the BlueEconomy PPP platform: **product catalogue, deterministic server-side premium rating, quote → bind (maker-checker) → policy issuance as W3C VC 2.0 credentials, endorsements, lapse/cancel with bitstring status-list revocation, and claims with double-entry settlement**.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「宁可拒绝，也不假装」**中的**第二种，也是四条里把这条原则写得最系统、最像工程信条的一条**——**它整节叫「Design doctrine」（设计信条）**，**而第一条就是「到处 fail-closed」**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **「Design doctrine」第一节逐字，是本轮主题最完整的单段表述**——**逐字为**：**「**Fail-closed everywhere.** **Boot refuses placeholder/dummy signing keys, world-readable key files, malformed PBAC policies and malformed partner adapter config.** Unconfigured integrations report unavailable via `GET /v1/capabilities` and return 503 from dependent routes — **success is never fabricated**. Partner-insurer calls to an unconfigured adapter fail with `ADAPTER_UNCONFIGURED` **before any network I/O**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **这一段里三条各自拒绝一件不同的事**：**① **拒绝启动**——占位或伪签名密钥、**全局可读的密钥文件**、畸形的策略（PBAC）与畸形的合作方适配器配置，**都在启动阶段就被拒**（**「world-readable key files」是一条很具体的文件权限检查，值得单独记住**）；**② **「success is never fabricated」（成功从不被伪造）**——**未配置的集成以能力注册表报告不可用、依赖它的路由返回 503，**而不是返回一个看起来成功的空结果****；**③ **「before any network I/O」（在任何网络 I/O 之前）**——**对未配置适配器的调用**先失败、不发生请求****（**⭐ 即**不发出去再报模糊的错**，而是**根本不发**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **第二节把「钱」写成了类型问题，并给出了一句最直接的理由**——**逐字为**：**「**Integer money only.** All amounts are integer kobo (1 NGN = 100 kobo); all rates and risk factors are basis points. **No floats anywhere**; client-supplied premium totals are rejected on mismatch (`client-total-rejected`).」**⭐⭐⭐ **两件事值得分开记**：**① **金额用整数最小币种单位（kobo，1 奈拉 = 100 kobo）、费率与风险因子用基点**，**并明言「任何地方都没有浮点数」****——**这是把**浮点误差**这一类**不报错、只在极少数情况下让数字差一分钱**的失败，从根上排除掉**（**可与第 335 轮 [[uae-health-pricing-model]] 的「当前保费与未来保费分列」并读：**两者都在处理**不会报错却会让数字变味**的问题**）；**② **客户端自报的保费总额若与服务端算出的不符，直接拒绝**（`client-total-rejected`）**⭐⭐⭐ **这一条尤其值得定价方向的同学记住**：**它比「服务端重算一遍」更硬——**客户端报的数与服务端不一致时**交易不成立****（**可与第 334 轮 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的「未来保存报价时须由服务端按输入与规则版本重新计算」并读；**那一条是**应当如此**，这一条是**已经这样拦住了****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **第三节把不变式放进数据库，并具体点名了四处**——**逐字为**：**「**DB-enforced invariants.** CHECK constraints (status enums, **dual control: checker ≠ maker on binds, adjuster assignment and settlement**), unique constraints, **append-only hash-chained audit (trigger-rejected UPDATE/DELETE)**, immutable bind decisions/endorsements/evidence/receipts, and **a deferred constraint trigger that rejects COMMIT of any unbalanced double-entry journal**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处各拒绝一件事**：**① **双人控制由 CHECK 约束保证**（**承保、理算人指派与结算三处的 checker 不得等于 maker**）——**即**四眼原则不是流程规定而是表结构约束****；**② **追加式哈希链审计**，**UPDATE 与 DELETE 被触发器拒绝****；**③ **承保决定、批单、证据、收据不可变****；**④ **一个延迟约束触发器**拒绝提交任何借贷不平衡的分录****⭐⭐⭐ **第 ④ 条是本条最值得单独记住的一处**：**它把「分录必须平衡」这条会计不变式放在**COMMIT 时刻由数据库拒绝**，而不是放在应用代码里检查****——**即**账不平，事务就提交不了****（**⚠️ 本词条**未读任何 SQL 或迁移脚本**，**故**不主张这四个触发器／约束确实已实现或确实生效**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「省略而非留桩」是本轮主题最锋利的一句，且它点名的是**一个缺失的整块功能****——**逐字为**：**「**Reinsurance/ceding** — **Omitted, not stubbed.** There is no ceding ledger in this service; **the capabilities registry reports `reinsurance.ceding` unavailable with an explicit "not implemented" reason**. Partner gateways exist for evidence exchange only and are fail-closed when unconfigured.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「Omitted, not stubbed」（省略，而不是留桩）**：**即**没做的功能不在代码里留一个看起来能用的空壳，而是**在机器可读的能力注册表里报为不可用并附明确的「未实现」理由****——**这本条目的判断是：它与本轮其余三条同属一种姿态**——**宁可让调用方拿到一个明确的「这里没有」，也不要让它拿到一个假的「有」**（**⚠️ 本词条**未请求 `/v1/capabilities`**，**故**不主张该注册表当前确实如此报告**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **整张 API 路由表本身带**权限标注**，这在同类文档里不常见**——**逐字实测其「Surface」表按六区列出**：**Products／Quotes／Policies／Claims／Integrations／Ops**；**其中两处带明确标注**：**「`GET /v1/status-list/{purpose}`（**public**）」**与**「`GET /v1/aggregates/portfolio`（**regulator, `insurer-aggregator` role**）」**⭐⭐ **即**哪一条路由对公众开放、哪一条需要监管方角色**，**写在了路由表里而不是别处****（**对做保险系统的同学：**把授权需求与接口清单放在一起，评审时才不用另找一份权限矩阵**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **报价与理赔两条流都把「提议」与「决定」拆成了两个路由**——**逐字为**：**报价侧** **「`POST ...:bind`、`POST ...:bind-decision`、`POST ...:issue`」**；**理赔侧** **「`...:propose-adjuster`、`...:confirm-adjuster`、`...:propose-settlement`、`...:approve-settlement`、`...:reject`」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**双人控制在接口形态上也成立**：**提出动作的人与确认动作的人是两次不同的调用**（**而第三节的 CHECK 约束保证这两个调用背后不是同一个人**）**——**接口与数据库两处同时表达同一条控制**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **另外三处可核实的工程细节**：**① **事件层**逐字为**「**Envelope v1.0 events.** FHIR R4 message Bundle + JWS compact EdDSA over RFC 8785 JCS, `kid = "insurance-<epoch>"`. Published via the **transactional outbox**」**，**并列出五个事件名**（`insurance.policy.v1`、`insurance.policy-endorsed.v1`、`insurance.policy-cancelled.v1`、`insurance.claim.v1`、`insurance.claim-paid.v1`）**⭐ 即**事件走事务性发件箱，与业务写入同一事务****；**② **保单凭证的**最小披露****——逐字为**「**Policy credentials are minimal-disclosure: no premiums, values or assured identifiers inside the credential.**」**⭐ 即**一张可验证凭证里不放保费、保额与被保险人标识****（**Vault 与撤销用 `eddsa-jcs-2022` 证明与配位串状态表**）；**③ **保单号带 Luhn mod-34 校验位**且**「gated before any database lookup」**（**格式为 `NG-<KIND3>-<YYYY>-<SEQ10>-<CHECK>`**）**⭐⭐ **即**格式不合法的保单号在查库之前就被拒**——**又一次「在任何 I/O 之前」**。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **本条目最有力的可核实证据在测试目录里：其信条是**被测**的，不只是被写的**——**实测 `tests/unit/` 下 7 个模块**（`test_envelope`、`test_jcs`、`test_pbac`、`test_policy_numbers`、`test_rating`、`test_statuslist`、`test_vc`）**与 `tests/integration/` 下 6 个模块**（`test_claims`、⭐ **`test_failclosed.py`**、`test_integrations`、`test_lifecycle`、`test_premium_economics`、⭐ **`test_race.py`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **其中 `test_failclosed.py` 直接把「到处 fail-closed」当作集成测试的对象**，**而 `test_race.py` 针对并发竞争**——**⭐ 对做核心系统的同学，这两个测试文件名的存在说明**「fail-closed」在这里是一个**有验收标准的断言**，而不是一句形容词**（**⚠️ 本词条**未运行任何测试**，**故**不主张它们通过，**也未读其内容**）。**⑨ ⭐ **其开发流程逐字，含两处便于自学的地方**：**逐字为** **「`pip install -e ‘.[dev]’ pgserver`   # **pgserver bundles a REAL PostgreSQL**」**、**「`pytest tests/unit -q`   # pure unit tests」**、**「`pytest tests/integration -q`   # real PostgreSQL (pgserver or INSURANCE_TEST_DATABASE_URL)」**、**「`ruff check src tests && mypy src」****⭐⭐ **即**单元测试是纯的、集成测试跑在**真的 PostgreSQL** 上，**而本地可以用 `pgserver` 直接把真库跑起来**；**并逐字为** **「Configuration is 12-factor env-only (`INSURANCE_*`); **blueeconomy-marine-insurance**（倉庫 `munisp/blueeconomy-insurance`）**是一個面向尼日利亞 BlueEconomy 公私營合營（PPP）平台的**海洋保險（marine insurance）核心引擎****：**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 Apache-2.0（`LICENSE` 經 raw 實測存在，11,358 位元組，首行「Apache License」）、主語言 Python、體量 157 KB、創建於 2026-08-31、最後推送 2026-09-09**（**創建在解凍窗口之前，推送落在窗口之內**）、**無 topics**；**README 實測 4,316 位元組（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 100 個條目**。**其自述範圍逐字為**：**「Marine insurance engine for the BlueEconomy PPP platform: **product catalogue, deterministic server-side premium rating, quote → bind (maker-checker) → policy issuance as W3C VC 2.0 credentials, endorsements, lapse/cancel with bitstring status-list revocation, and claims with double-entry settlement**.」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「寧可拒絕，也不假裝」**中的**第二種，也是四條裡把這條原則寫得最系統、最像工程信條的一條**——**它整節叫「Design doctrine」（設計信條），而第一條就是「到處 fail-closed」**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **「Design doctrine」第一節逐字，是本輪主題最完整的單段表述**——**逐字為**：**「**Fail-closed everywhere.** **Boot refuses placeholder/dummy signing keys, world-readable key files, malformed PBAC policies and malformed partner adapter config.** Unconfigured integrations report unavailable via `GET /v1/capabilities` and return 503 from dependent routes — **success is never fabricated**. Partner-insurer calls to an unconfigured adapter fail with `ADAPTER_UNCONFIGURED` **before any network I/O**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **這一段裡三條各拒絕一件不同的事**：**① **拒絕啟動**——佔位或偽簽名密鑰、**全局可讀的密鑰文件**、畸形的策略（PBAC）與畸形的合作方適配器配置；**② **「success is never fabricated」（成功從不被偽造）**——**未配置的集成以能力註冊表報告不可用、依賴它的路由返回 503，而不是返回一個看起來成功的空結果****；**③ **「before any network I/O」（在任何網路 I/O 之前）**——**對未配置適配器的調用**先失敗、不發生請求****（**⭐ 即**不發出去再報模糊的錯，而是根本不發****）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **第二節把「錢」寫成了類型問題**——**逐字**：**「**Integer money only.** All amounts are integer kobo (1 NGN = 100 kobo); all rates and risk factors are basis points. **No floats anywhere**; client-supplied premium totals are rejected on mismatch (`client-total-rejected`).」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩件事分開記**：**① **金額用整數最小幣種單位（kobo）、費率與風險因子用基點**，**並明言「任何地方都沒有浮點數」**——**這是把**浮點誤差**這類**不報錯、只在極少數情況下讓數字差一分錢**的失敗從根上排除掉****（**可與第 335 輪 [[uae-health-pricing-model]] 的「當前保費與未來保費分列」並讀**）；**② **客戶端自報的保費總額若與服務端算出的不符，直接拒絕**（`client-total-rejected`）**⭐⭐⭐ **這一條尤其值得定價方向的同學記住**：**它比「服務端重算一遍」更硬——**客戶端報的數與服務端不一致時**交易不成立****（**可與第 334 輪 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 並讀：那條是**應當如此**，這條是**已經這樣攔住了****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **第三節把不變式放進數據庫，並具體點名四處**——**逐字**：**「**DB-enforced invariants.** CHECK constraints (status enums, **dual control: checker ≠ maker on binds, adjuster assignment and settlement**), unique constraints, **append-only hash-chained audit (trigger-rejected UPDATE/DELETE)**, immutable bind decisions/endorsements/evidence/receipts, and **a deferred constraint trigger that rejects COMMIT of any unbalanced double-entry journal**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處各拒絕一件事**：**① **雙人控制由 CHECK 約束保證**（**承保、理算人指派與結算三處的 checker 不得等於 maker**）——**即**四眼原則不是流程規定而是表結構約束****；**② **追加式哈希鏈審計**，**UPDATE 與 DELETE 被觸發器拒絕****；**③ **承保決定、批單、證據、收據不可變****；**④ **一個延遲約束觸發器拒絕提交任何借貸不平衡的分錄****⭐⭐⭐ **第 ④ 條最值得單獨記住**：**它把「分錄必須平衡」放在**COMMIT 時刻由數據庫拒絕**，而不是放在應用代碼裡檢查****——**即**賬不平，事務就提交不了****（**⚠️ 未讀任何 SQL 或遷移腳本，故不主張這四個觸發器／約束確實已實現或生效**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「省略而非留樁」是本輪主題最鋒利的一句，且它點名的是**一整塊缺失的功能****——**逐字**：**「**Reinsurance/ceding** — **Omitted, not stubbed.** There is no ceding ledger in this service; **the capabilities registry reports `reinsurance.ceding` unavailable with an explicit "not implemented" reason**. Partner gateways exist for evidence exchange only and are fail-closed when unconfigured.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「Omitted, not stubbed」**：**即**沒做的功能不在代碼裡留一個看起來能用的空殼，而是在機器可讀的能力註冊表裡報為不可用並附明確的「未實現」理由****（**⚠️ 未請求 `/v1/capabilities`，故不主張該註冊表當前確實如此報告**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **整張 API 路由表本身帶**權限標註****——**逐字實測其「Surface」表按六區列出**：**Products／Quotes／Policies／Claims／Integrations／Ops**；**其中兩處帶明確標註**：**「`GET /v1/status-list/{purpose}`（**public**）」**與**「`GET /v1/aggregates/portfolio`（**regulator, `insurer-aggregator` role**）」**⭐⭐ **即**哪一條路由對公眾開放、哪一條需要監管方角色，寫在了路由表裡而不是別處****。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **報價與理賠兩條流都把「提議」與「決定」拆成兩個路由**——**報價側** **「`POST ...:bind`、`POST ...:bind-decision`、`POST ...:issue`」**；**理賠側** **「`...:propose-adjuster`、`...:confirm-adjuster`、`...:propose-settlement`、`...:approve-settlement`、`...:reject`」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**雙人控制在接口形態上也成立**：**提出動作的人與確認動作的人是兩次不同的調用**（**而第三節的 CHECK 約束保證這兩個調用背後不是同一個人**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **另外三處可核實的細節**：**① **事件層**逐字**「**Envelope v1.0 events.** FHIR R4 message Bundle + JWS compact EdDSA over RFC 8785 JCS, `kid = "insurance-<epoch>"`. Published via the **transactional outbox**」**並列出五個事件名**⭐ **即**事件走事務性發件箱，與業務寫入同一事務****；**② **保單憑證的**最小披露****——逐字**「**Policy credentials are minimal-disclosure: no premiums, values or assured identifiers inside the credential.**」**；**③ **保單號帶 Luhn mod-34 校驗位**且**「gated before any database lookup」**（**格式 `NG-<KIND3>-<YYYY>-<SEQ10>-<CHECK>`**）**⭐⭐ **即**格式不合法的保單號在查庫之前就被拒**——**又一次「在任何 I/O 之前」**。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **最有力的可核實證據在測試目錄：其信條是**被測**的，不只是被寫的**——**實測 `tests/unit/` 下 7 個模組**（`test_envelope`、`test_jcs`、`test_pbac`、`test_policy_numbers`、`test_rating`、`test_statuslist`、`test_vc`）**與 `tests/integration/` 下 6 個模組**（`test_claims`、⭐ **`test_failclosed.py`**、`test_integrations`、`test_lifecycle`、`test_premium_economics`、⭐ **`test_race.py`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **其中 `test_failclosed.py` 直接把「到處 fail-closed」當作整合測試的對象**，**而 `test_race.py` 針對並發競爭**——**⭐ 即**「fail-closed」在這裡是一個**有驗收標準的斷言**，而不是一句形容詞****（**⚠️ 未運行任何測試，故不主張它們通過，也未讀其內容**）。**⑨ ⭐ **開發流程逐字，含兩處便於自學的地方**：**「`pip install -e ‘.[dev]’ pgserver`   # **pgserver bundles a REAL PostgreSQL**」「`pytest tests/unit -q`   # pure unit tests」「`pytest tests/integration -q`   # real PostgreSQL (pgserver or INSURANCE_TEST_DATABASE_URL)」「`ruff check src tests && mypy src」****⭐⭐ **即**單元測試是純的、整合測試跑在**真的 PostgreSQL** 上，本地可用 `pgserver` 直接把真庫跑起來**；**並逐字** **「Configuration is 12-factor env-only (`INSURANCE_*`); see `src/insurance/config.py`. **Secrets never have defaults and are never committed.**」**⭐⭐ **與第一節的「拒絕全局可讀的密鑰文件」是同一條紀律的兩端**。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **另有一處結構細節**：**實測倉庫裡有 `keys/README.md`**——**即**掛載密鑰的那個目錄裡放了一份說明****。**⑪ ⭐ 可與 [[tokio-marine]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[openinsurance]]、[[openimis]]、[[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]]、[[quorumforge]]、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]、[[payout-assurance-standard]]、[[bind-standard]]、[[acord]]、[[verified-reserving]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未讀一行源碼、未讀一份遷移腳本、未運行任何測試****——**故所述四處數據庫不變式、五條設計信條、事件封裝與憑證格式**全部只記錄為 README 如此聲明****；**⭐ 本詞條**已實測的只是**這些機制各自對應的文件或測試確實存在****（**`src/insurance/config.py`、`tests/integration/test_failclosed.py`、`tests/integration/test_race.py` 等**），**⚠️ 但**文件存在不等於其中實現了 README 所述的約束****——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其「確定性服務端保費計算」的具體算法**（**未讀 `test_rating.py` 或任何評分代碼**）；**⚠️ 也**未核實**其「整數 kobo ＋ 基點、無浮點」是否在全部代碼路徑中成立**（**未運行 `mypy`／`ruff`，未做靜態檢查**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其海洋險的險種設定是否與尼日利亞現行監管要求或任何保險公司的實際條款一致**——**本次未查尼日利亞保險監管機構（NAICOM）的任何規則、也未查任何條款或費率表**；**⭐ 尤其**不主張**其產品目錄、費率結構或承保規則可用於任何真實的海洋險定價、承保或監管報送**。**④ ⚠️⭐ **未核實**其 ISR 結果賬本集成**——**README 逐字描述了從另一服務消費保費差額證據、按掛載密鑰目錄驗簽、以環境變數**釘住摘要**、**防重放**、存儲後不可變，並以**已確認的保費差額基點之和**作為走廊航線風險**（**按費率表設上限**）**——**⚠️ 本次**未讀任何集成代碼、未請求任何接口****。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核實**其 W3C 可驗證憑證部分**（**`eddsa-jcs-2022` 證明、配位串狀態表撤銷、Luhn mod-34 校驗位與最小披露**）；**⚠️ 本次**未做任何密碼學驗證**，**故**不主張其密碼學實現正確或安全****（**本條目**不建議**任何人據此實現生產系統**）。**⑥ ⚠️ **本次核實到**倉庫元數據、README 全文、以及全部 100 個條目的文件清單**，**並核實根 `LICENSE` 的存在與首行**；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安裝 Python 或 PostgreSQL、未運行 `pytest`／`ruff`／`mypy`、未啟動服務、**未請求任何路由**（**含 `/v1/capabilities`**）、**未讀 `src/` 下任何源碼、未讀任何測試內容、未讀任何遷移腳本**、未讀 `pyproject.toml`、未讀 `keys/README.md` 內容****；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其與 BlueEconomy PPP 平台及 blueeconomy-maritime-intelligence 的關係**——**即**這是一個真實項目的一部分，還是一個概念演示****；**⚠️ 本次**未查該平台**，**故**不主張該項目已部署、已上線或已被任何機構採用**；**⭐ README 中出現的**機構性詞彙不構成任何機構背書的證據****。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其「再保險分保省略而非留樁」是否確實如此**——**⚠️ 該聲明依賴**能力註冊表的實際響應**，**本次**未請求該接口**；**⚠️ 但本詞條如實記下：它的**聲明方式本身**值得記**。**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、創建於 2026-08-31、推送於 2026-09-09**，**不主張其成熟度／正確性／已被採用**；**⑩ ⭐ 無 topics**；**⑪ **README 為英語**——**已如實記入，本次未核實是否有其他語言版本**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/munisp/blueeconomy-insurance` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 4,316 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對；**全部 100 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對；**根 `LICENSE`（11,358 位元組，首行 Apache License）經 raw 實測讀取**；**未克隆、未安裝、未運行任何命令、未啟動服務、未請求任何路由、未讀任何源碼或測試內容、未讀任何遷移腳本、未讀 `keys/README.md` 內容、未做任何密碼學驗證**。

**blueeconomy-marine-insurance** (repository `munisp/blueeconomy-insurance`) **is a marine insurance core engine for Nigeria’s BlueEconomy public-private partnership (PPP) platform**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, licence Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE` measured present by raw probe at 11,358 bytes, first line "Apache License"), Python as the primary language, a 157 KB repository, created 2026-08-31 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**both GitHub API measurements; creation before the thaw window, push inside it**), **no topics**; **the README measures 4,316 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 100 entries in total**. **Its stated scope reads verbatim**: **"Marine insurance engine for the BlueEconomy PPP platform: **product catalogue, deterministic server-side premium rating, quote → bind (maker-checker) → policy issuance as W3C VC 2.0 credentials, endorsements, lapse/cancel with bitstring status-list revocation, and claims with double-entry settlement**."** It is the second of this round’s four takes on **rather refusing than pretending**, **and the one that states the principle most systematically, as an engineering creed** — **an entire section is titled "Design doctrine", and its first entry is fail-closed everywhere**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **The first design-doctrine entry is verbatim, and is the fullest single statement of this round’s theme** — **verbatim**: **"**Fail-closed everywhere.** **Boot refuses placeholder/dummy signing keys, world-readable key files, malformed PBAC policies and malformed partner adapter config.** Unconfigured integrations report unavailable via `GET /v1/capabilities` and return 503 from dependent routes — **success is never fabricated**. Partner-insurer calls to an unconfigured adapter fail with `ADAPTER_UNCONFIGURED` **before any network I/O**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three distinct refusals sit in that paragraph**: **first, a refusal to start** — placeholder or dummy signing keys, **world-readable key files**, malformed policy (PBAC) and malformed partner adapter configuration are all rejected at boot; **second, "success is never fabricated"** — **an unconfigured integration reports itself unavailable in the capabilities registry and dependent routes return 503, rather than returning a plausible-looking empty success**; **third, "before any network I/O"** — **a call to an unconfigured adapter fails first and the request is never made** (⭐ **rather than sending it and then reporting a vague error, it is not sent at all**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ The second entry turns money into a type question** — **verbatim**: **"**Integer money only.** All amounts are integer kobo (1 NGN = 100 kobo); all rates and risk factors are basis points. **No floats anywhere**; client-supplied premium totals are rejected on mismatch (`client-total-rejected`)."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Two things belong apart**: **first, amounts are integer minor units (kobo) and rates and risk factors are basis points, with "no floats anywhere" stated outright** — **this removes at the root a class of failure that raises no error and only occasionally leaves a figure a penny out** (**readable with round 335’s [[uae-health-pricing-model]]**); **second, a client-supplied premium total that disagrees with the server’s is rejected outright** (`client-total-rejected`) ⭐⭐⭐ **and that is worth remembering for anyone working on pricing: it is firmer than "recompute it server-side" — when the client’s number and the server’s disagree, the transaction does not stand** (**readable with round 334’s [[restaurant-insurance-quote]], where server-side recomputation is what *should* happen; here it is what already blocks**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The third entry puts invariants in the database and names four of them** — **verbatim**: **"**DB-enforced invariants.** CHECK constraints (status enums, **dual control: checker ≠ maker on binds, adjuster assignment and settlement**), unique constraints, **append-only hash-chained audit (trigger-rejected UPDATE/DELETE)**, immutable bind decisions/endorsements/evidence/receipts, and **a deferred constraint trigger that rejects COMMIT of any unbalanced double-entry journal**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four refusals**: **dual control guaranteed by a CHECK constraint** (**checker must not equal maker on binds, adjuster assignment and settlement**) — **the four-eyes principle is a table constraint rather than a procedural rule**; **an append-only hash-chained audit with UPDATE and DELETE rejected by trigger**; **bind decisions, endorsements, evidence and receipts immutable**; **and a deferred constraint trigger rejecting the COMMIT of any unbalanced double-entry journal** ⭐⭐⭐ **the fourth deserves its own sentence: the accounting invariant that a journal must balance is enforced by the database at COMMIT time rather than checked in application code** — **if the books do not balance, the transaction cannot commit** (**⚠️ no SQL or migration script was read, so these four triggers and constraints are not claimed to be implemented or effective**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ "Omitted, not stubbed" is the sharpest sentence of this round’s theme, and it names a whole missing block of functionality** — **verbatim**: **"**Reinsurance/ceding** — **Omitted, not stubbed.** There is no ceding ledger in this service; **the capabilities registry reports `reinsurance.ceding` unavailable with an explicit "not implemented" reason**. Partner gateways exist for evidence exchange only and are fail-closed when unconfigured."** ⭐⭐⭐ **A feature that does not exist leaves no plausible-looking shell in the code; instead the machine-readable capabilities registry reports it unavailable with an explicit not-implemented reason** (**⚠️ `/v1/capabilities` was not requested, so the registry is not claimed to report this today**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ The API route table itself carries permission annotations, which is uncommon in documentation of this kind** — **its "Surface" table measurably lists six areas**: **Products / Quotes / Policies / Claims / Integrations / Ops**; **two entries carry explicit annotations**: **"`GET /v1/status-list/{purpose}` (**public**)"** and **"`GET /v1/aggregates/portfolio` (**regulator, `insurer-aggregator` role**)"** ⭐⭐ **which route is open to the public and which requires a regulator role is written in the route table rather than somewhere else**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Both the quoting and the claims flows split "propose" from "decide" into two routes** — **quoting**: **"`POST ...:bind`, `POST ...:bind-decision`, `POST ...:issue`"**; **claims**: **"`...:propose-adjuster`, `...:confirm-adjuster`, `...:propose-settlement`, `...:approve-settlement`, `...:reject`"** ⭐⭐⭐ **dual control therefore holds in the interface shape too: the person proposing an action and the person confirming it are two different calls**, **while the CHECK constraint from the third entry guarantees they are not the same person behind those calls**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Three further checkable details**: **the event layer** reads verbatim **"**Envelope v1.0 events.** FHIR R4 message Bundle + JWS compact EdDSA over RFC 8785 JCS, `kid = "insurance-<epoch>"`. Published via the **transactional outbox**"**, naming five events — ⭐ **events go through a transactional outbox, in the same transaction as the business write**; **policy credentials are minimal-disclosure** — verbatim **"**Policy credentials are minimal-disclosure: no premiums, values or assured identifiers inside the credential**"**; **and policy numbers carry a Luhn mod-34 check digit and are "gated before any database lookup"** (format `NG-<KIND3>-<YYYY>-<SEQ10>-<CHECK>`) ⭐⭐ **a malformed policy number is refused before any database lookup — another "before any I/O"**. **⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ The strongest verifiable evidence sits in the test directory: the doctrine is tested, not merely written** — **`tests/unit/` measurably holds seven modules** (`test_envelope`, `test_jcs`, `test_pbac`, `test_policy_numbers`, `test_rating`, `test_statuslist`, `test_vc`) **and `tests/integration/` six** (`test_claims`, ⭐ **`test_failclosed.py`**, `test_integrations`, `test_lifecycle`, `test_premium_economics`, ⭐ **`test_race.py`**) ⭐⭐⭐ **`test_failclosed.py` makes fail-closed everywhere the object of an integration test, and `test_race.py` targets concurrency races** — ⭐ **the existence of those two filenames says that "fail-closed" is here an assertion with acceptance criteria rather than an adjective** (**⚠️ no test was run, so they are not claimed to pass, and their contents were not read**). **⑨ ⭐ Its development flow is verbatim and includes two things useful for self-study**: **"`pip install -e ‘.[dev]’ pgserver`   # **pgserver bundles a REAL PostgreSQL**"; "`pytest tests/unit -q`   # pure unit tests"; "`pytest tests/integration -q`   # real PostgreSQL (pgserver or INSURANCE_TEST_DATABASE_URL)"; "`ruff check src tests && mypy src`"** ⭐⭐ **unit tests are pure and integration tests run against a real PostgreSQL, which `pgserver` brings up locally**; **and verbatim "Configuration is 12-factor env-only (`INSURANCE_*`); see `src/insurance/config.py`. **Secrets never have defaults and are never committed.**"** ⭐⭐ **two ends of the same discipline as the refusal of world-readable key files**. **⑩ ⭐⭐ One further structural detail**: **the repository measurably contains `keys/README.md`** — **the directory that holds mounted keys carries a note explaining itself**. **⑪ ⭐ Readable with the site’s marine, governance, open core-system and settlement entries**: [[tokio-marine]], [[insurance-governance]], [[titanium-insurance-core]], [[openinsurance]], [[openimis]], [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]], [[quorumforge]], [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]], [[payout-assurance-standard]], [[bind-standard]], [[acord]] and [[verified-reserving]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Not one line of source, not one migration script and no test was run** — **so the four database invariants, the five design-doctrine entries, the event envelope and the credential formats are recorded only as the README states them**; ⭐ **what this check did measure is that the file or test each mechanism corresponds to actually exists** (**`src/insurance/config.py`, `tests/integration/test_failclosed.py`, `tests/integration/test_race.py` and so on**), **⚠️ but a file existing does not mean the constraint the README describes is implemented inside it** — **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **② ⚠️⚠️ The algorithm behind its "deterministic server-side premium rating" was not verified** (**neither `test_rating.py` nor any rating code was read**); **⚠️ nor was whether "integer kobo plus basis points and no floats" holds across every code path** (**no `mypy` or `ruff` run, no static analysis**). **③ ⚠️⚠️ Whether its marine line settings match current Nigerian regulation or any insurer’s actual terms was not verified** — **no rule of Nigeria’s insurance regulator (NAICOM) was consulted, nor any policy wording or rate table**; ⭐ **in particular no product catalogue, rating structure or underwriting rule in it is claimed usable for real marine pricing, underwriting or regulatory reporting**. **④ ⚠️⭐ Its ISR outcome-ledger integration was not verified** — **the README describes consuming premium-delta evidence from another service, verifying signatures against a mounted key directory, digest-pinning via an environment variable, killing replays and storing immutably, with corridor route risk as the sum of confirmed premium-delta basis points capped per rate table** — **⚠️ no integration code was read and no route was requested**. **⑤ ⚠️⭐ Its W3C verifiable credential layer was not verified** (**the `eddsa-jcs-2022` proofs, the bitstring status list, the Luhn mod-34 check digit and the minimal-disclosure choice**); **⚠️ no cryptographic verification was performed**, **so no claim is made that its cryptography is correct or secure** (**the entry does not recommend anyone build a production system on it**). **⑥ ⚠️** This check verified **the repository metadata, the README in full, and the complete list of all 100 entries**, **and the presence and first line of the root `LICENSE`**; ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install Python or PostgreSQL, run `pytest`/`ruff`/`mypy`, start the service, request any route (including `/v1/capabilities`), read any module under `src/`, read any test file’s contents, read any migration script, read `pyproject.toml`, or read the contents of `keys/README.md`**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its relationship to the BlueEconomy PPP platform and to blueeconomy-maritime-intelligence was not verified** — **that is, whether this is part of a real project or a concept demonstration**;
