**⚠️ but the entry records plainly that the manner of the declaration is itself worth noting, not only its content**. **⑨ ⭐ At ★0, 0 forks, created 2026-08-31 and pushed 2026-09-09**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**. **⑩ ⭐ No topics**. **⑪ The README is in English** — **recorded as such, and whether other language versions exist was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/munisp/blueeconomy-insurance` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field Apache-2.0, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); entries.verified_note: GitHub API 实测（repo，2026-09-11）：⭐许可实测 Apache-2.0 且 LICENSE 经 raw 实测存在（11,358 字节，首行 Apache License）｜★0｜fork 0｜Python｜157 KB｜created 2026-08-31（解冻窗口之前）｜pushed 2026-09-09（落在解冻窗口之内）｜无 topics｜README 4,316 字节（英语）；⭐⭐⭐设计信条第一节「Fail-closed everywhere」逐字：Boot refuses placeholder/dummy signing keys, world-readable key files, malformed PBAC policies and malformed partner adapter config；Unconfigured integrations report unavailable via GET /v1/capabilities and return 503 from dependent routes — success is never fabricated；Partner-insurer calls to an unconfigured adapter fail with ADAPTER_UNCONFIGURED before any network I/O——「三种拒绝（拒绝启动含拒绝全局可读的密钥文件）／success is never fabricated／在任何网络 I/O 之前就失败，即不发出请求而不是发出后报模糊的错」三点已分别写明；⭐⭐⭐第二节「Integer money only」逐字：All amounts are integer kobo (1 NGN = 100 kobo); all rates and risk factors are basis points. No floats anywhere; client-supplied premium totals are rejected on mismatch (client-total-rejected)——「金额整数最小币种单位＋费率为基点、任何地方都没有浮点数，从根上排除不报错却让数字差一分钱的失败」与「客户端自报总额不符即交易不成立（比服务端重算更硬）」两点已写明，并与第 335 轮 uae-health-pricing-model 及第 334 轮 restaurant-insurance-quote 建立并读；⭐⭐⭐第三节「DB-enforced invariants」逐字：CHECK constraints (status enums, dual control: checker ≠ maker on binds, adjuster assignment and settlement), unique constraints, append-only hash-chained audit (trigger-rejected UPDATE/DELETE), immutable bind decisions/endorsements/evidence/receipts, and a deferred constraint trigger that rejects COMMIT of any unbalanced double-entry journal——四处分别写明，其中第④条「把分录平衡放在 COMMIT 时刻由数据库拒绝而非应用代码检查，账不平事务就提交不了」已单独标明（⚠️未读任何 SQL 或迁移脚本，故不主张这四个触发器／约束确实已实现或生效）；⭐⭐⭐「Reinsurance/ceding — Omitted, not stubbed.」逐字并附完整说明：There is no ceding ledger in this service; the capabilities registry reports reinsurance.ceding unavailable with an explicit "not implemented" reason——「没做的功能不留看起来能用的空壳，而是在机器可读能力注册表里报不可用并附明确未实现理由」已写明，并记「其声明方式本身值得记，而不只是内容」（⚠️未请求 /v1/capabilities，故不主张该注册表当前确实如此报告）；⭐⭐⭐其 Surface 路由表按六区列出（Products／Quotes／Policies／Claims／Integrations／Ops）且有两条带权限标注：GET /v1/status-list/{purpose}（public）与 GET /v1/aggregates/portfolio（regulator, insurer-aggregator role）——「哪条路由对公众开放、哪条需要监管方角色写在路由表里而不是别处」已写明；⭐⭐报价侧 POST ...:bind / ...:bind-decision / ...:issue 与理赔侧 ...:propose-adjuster / ...:confirm-adjuster / ...:propose-settlement / ...:approve-settlement / ...:reject 逐字——「双人控制在接口形态上也成立：提出与确认是两次不同调用，而第三节的 CHECK 约束保证背后不是同一个人」已写明；⭐⭐另三处细节逐字：Envelope v1.0 events（FHIR R4 message Bundle + JWS compact EdDSA over RFC 8785 JCS，kid = "insurance-<epoch>"，Published via the transactional outbox，五个事件名 insurance.policy.v1／policy-endorsed.v1／policy-cancelled.v1／claim.v1／claim-paid.v1）；Policy credentials are minimal-disclosure: no premiums, values or assured identifiers inside the credential；保单号带 Luhn mod-34 校验位且 gated before any database lookup（格式 NG-<KIND3>-<YYYY>-<SEQ10>-<CHECK>）——「格式不合法的保单号在查库之前就被拒，又一次在任何 I/O 之前」已写明；⭐⭐⭐测试目录是可核实证据：tests/unit/ 实测 7 个模块（test_envelope／test_jcs／test_pbac／test_policy_numbers／test_rating／test_statuslist／test_vc）与 tests/integration/ 实测 6 个模块（test_claims／**test_failclosed.py**／test_integrations／test_lifecycle／test_premium_economics／**test_race.py**）——「test_failclosed.py 直接把到处 fail-closed 当作集成测试对象、test_race.py 针对并发竞争，说明 fail-closed 在这里是有验收标准的断言而不是形容词」已写明（⚠️未运行任何测试，故不主张通过，也未读其内容）；⭐开发流程逐字（pip install -e .[dev] pgserver 注释 pgserver bundles a REAL PostgreSQL；pytest tests/unit 为 pure unit tests；pytest tests/integration 需 real PostgreSQL；ruff check src tests && mypy src）与「Configuration is 12-factor env-only (INSURANCE_*); entries.title: 理赔诚信调查器：一份把「规矩要被执行，而不是被记住」写在明面上的确定性理赔审查服务——三态环境变量由测试在构建时拦下，演示面被排除在质量门之外却又被测试拴住以防悄悄腐坏
entries.title_en: A claims integrity investigator: a deterministic claim review service that says outright that the rule is enforced rather than remembered, where three-state environment reads are failed at build time by a test and the demo surface sits outside the quality gate yet is tethered by a test so it cannot rot quietly
entries.title_hk: 理賠誠信調查器：一份把「規矩要被執行，而不是被記住」寫在明面上的確定性理賠審查服務——三態環境變數由測試在構建時攔下，演示面被排除在質量門之外卻又被測試拴住以防悄悄腐壞
entries.summary: 一个确定性理赔保障范围与欺诈指标审查服务：结论性判断是纯的、确定性的标准库代码，个人信息在进入审计之前先被脱敏，每个结果都带引用，而结论性结果按第 R8 条规则被路由给人工复核，而不是自动执行、也不是落进一个没人看的标记里；同一个能力有五个入口（FastAPI 应用、命令行、以 A2A 卡片公布的智能体工具、可嵌入的微前端与评测框架），它们共用同一个领域服务，因此第 R8 条在五个入口上都成立而不是只在其中一个；配置用一个无默认值的环境变量选适配器族，写错的取值（含大小写不同的写法）会在导入时抛错，因为「打错字不能悄悄替你选一个族」；所有与安全相关的环境读取必须区分未设置、设为空与设为有效三种状态，并由一个单元测试在构建时拦下任何两态读取，使这条规矩「被执行而不是被记住」；演示面被明确排除在质量门之外，但由另一个单元测试拴住，故不会悄悄腐坏
entries.summary_hk: 一個確定性理賠保障範圍與欺詐指標審查服務：結論性判斷是純的、確定性的標準庫代碼，個人在進入審計之前先被脫敏，每個結果都帶引用，而結論性結果按第 R8 條規則被路由給人工覆核，而不是自動執行、也不是落進一個沒人看的標記裡；同一個能力有五個入口（FastAPI 應用、命令行、以 A2A 卡片公佈的智能體工具、可嵌入的微前端與評測框架），它們共用同一個領域服務，因此第 R8 條在五個入口上都成立而不是只在其中一個；配置用一個無預設值的環境變數選適配器族，寫錯的取值（含大小寫不同的寫法）會在導入時拋錯，因為「打錯字不能悄悄替你選一個族」；所有與安全相關的環境讀取必須區分未設置、設為空與設為有效三種狀態，並由一個單元測試在構建時攔下任何兩態讀取，使這條規矩「被執行而不是被記住」；演示面被明確排除在質量門之外，但由另一個單元測試拴住，故不會悄悄腐壞
entries.summary_en: A deterministic insurance claim coverage and fraud-indicator review service: the consequential judgement is pure, deterministic standard-library code, personal data is redacted before anything is audited, every result carries a citation, and a consequential result is routed to a human reviewer under rule R8 rather than auto-executed or left in a flag nobody reads; the same capability is reachable five ways (a FastAPI app, a CLI, agent tools advertised on an A2A card, an embeddable micro-frontend and the eval harness) which share one domain service, so rule R8 holds on all five rather than one; adapter family is selected by an environment variable with no default, and a value that is set but unknown — including differently cased spellings — raises at import, because a typo must not silently pick a family; every security-relevant environment read must distinguish unset, set-and-empty and set-and-valid, with a unit test failing the build on any two-state read that ships, so the rule is enforced rather than remembered; and the demo surface is explicitly excluded from the quality gate yet tethered by another unit test so that it cannot rot quietly
entries.body:
**claims-integrity-investigator**（仓库 `portable-genai/claims-integrity-investigator`）**是一个**确定性的理赔保障范围与欺诈指标审查服务**，且其结论由人工批准**：**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 Apache-2.0（`LICENSE` 经 raw 实测存在，11,344 字节，首行「Apache License」）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 524 KB、创建于 2026-08-22、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，创建与推送均落在解冻窗口之后**）；**topics 实测为** `ai-agents`、`detect-investigate`、`financial-crime`、`generative-ai`、`ports-and-adapters`、`vendor-portability`；**README 实测 6,529 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 244 个条目**。**其自述一句话逐字为**：**「Deterministic insurance claim coverage and fraud-indicator review, human-approved disposition.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「宁可拒绝，也不假装」**中的**第三种，也是四条里唯一把「**规矩要被**执行**，而不是被**记住**」这八个字写进文档的一条**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其开篇一段把整条设计压缩成四句，四句各拒绝一件事**——**逐字为**：**「The consequential decision is **pure, deterministic stdlib**; **PII is redacted before anything is audited**; **every result carries a citation**; and **a consequential result is ROUTED to a human reviewer (rule R8) rather than auto-executed or left in a flag nobody reads**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **最后半句值得单独记**：**「而不是自动执行，**也不是落进一个没人看的标记里**」——**它把「转人工」与「标个记号就算完」区分开了****：**前者是一条会到达人的路径，后者是一个看起来已处理、实际没有人的状态****（**⭐ 对做 AI 理赔的同学，这是**两种失败**的区分：**不该自动做的自动做了，与该有人看的没人看****）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **本条最锐利的一处是三态环境变量读取，以及它被**测试**接住的方式**——**逐字为**：**「Every security-relevant read resolves **three states: unset, set-and-empty and set-and-valid are different**, and **a value an operator deliberately emptied never inherits the more permissive unset default.** `tests/unit/test_three_state_env_reads.py` **fails the build on any two-state read that ships, so the rule is enforced rather than remembered**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **两件事**：**① **三种状态必须分开**——**「未设置」「设为空」「设为有效」是三件不同的事**，**而运维人员**故意清空**的值**不得继承更宽松的「未设置」默认值****（**⭐ 这是一处**很少见但很真实**的区分：**把配置项刻意清空，本意往往是收紧，而常见实现会把它当成没配过从而放宽**）；**② **这条规矩由一个测试在**构建时**拦下任何「两态读取」**——**「**enforced rather than remembered**」（**被执行，而不是被记住**）**⭐⭐⭐ **这半句是本轮四条候选里对本轮主题概括得最凝练的一句**，**本词条据此把它当作本轮的主题句之一**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读该测试的内容、未运行它**，**故**不主张它确实会在构建时失败**——**但已实测该文件存在**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「演示面在质量门之外，但被测试拴住」是本条最值得单独展开的一处**——**逐字为**：**「The demo surface sits **OUTSIDE that gate**, because **the gate proves the service and the demo proves the story it is presented with**. It is enforced inside the offline gate by `tests/unit/test_demo_surface.py`, which the hosted GitHub Actions check runs, **so it cannot rot quietly**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **这是一处**很诚实的架构决定****：**作者**承认**演示与质量门要证明的是**两件不同的事**（**门证明服务，演示证明它被讲述的那个故事**），**故**不把演示塞进门里假装它也被证明了**；**但同时用 `test_demo_surface.py` 把演示**拴住**，**使「演示与真实能力脱节」这件事**不会悄悄发生****（**「so it cannot rot quietly」**）**——**⭐ 而本词条实测 `tests/unit/test_demo_surface.py` 确实存在**，**与 `tests/unit/test_ui_surface.py`、`tests/unit/test_three_state_env_reads.py` 并列**。**④ ⭐⭐ **其离线质量门逐字列出，且包含一个评测步骤**——**逐字为**：**「`ruff check src tests && ruff format --check src tests && mypy src && pytest -m ‘not integration’ && python eval/run_eval.py`」**⭐⭐ **即**格式检查、静态类型检查、非集成测试与**一次评测运行**五步串成一个门**，**且该门「is SDK-free and is what CI runs」**（**实测 `eval/run_eval.py` 存在**）；**另有一条命令逐字为** **「`make audit`   # pip-audit over both lockfiles (needs network; **a HARD gate in CI**)」**⭐⭐ **依赖漏洞审计是**硬门****（**⚠️ 本词条**未运行任何一条**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **「一个没默认值的环境变量」是本条第二个具体机制**——**逐字为**：**「**Name the profile.** `CLAIMSINTEG_PROFILE` has no default. Leaving it unset is its own state: the offline adapters still bind, but **the seeded dev personas are refused, no service-to-service scheme is selected, the dev CORS allowlist and the `X-Dev-Persona` header are withdrawn, and the exposure guard refuses every route to any non-loopback peer**. **A deployment that loses the variable fails visibly instead of serving a stranger.**」**；**以及**：**「**Unset **「打错字不能悄悄替你选一个族」**——**故意让取值**大小写敏感****（**`Local` 与 `GCP` 都会抛错**），**即**不把「看起来像」当作「就是」****；**② **「丢掉这个变量的部署会**可见地失败**，而不是去服务一个陌生人」**——**未配置不是一个「随便挑一个」的场景，而是一个应当**拒绝服务**的状态**⭐⭐ **claims-integrity-investigator** (repository `portable-genai/claims-integrity-investigator`) **is a deterministic insurance claim coverage and fraud-indicator review service whose disposition is human-approved**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, licence Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE` measured present by raw probe at 11,344 bytes, first line "Apache License"), Python as the primary language, a 524 KB repository, created 2026-08-22 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, both after the thaw window**); **topics measured as** `ai-agents`, `detect-investigate`, `financial-crime`, `generative-ai`, `ports-and-adapters` and `vendor-portability`; **the README measures 6,529 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 244 entries in total**. **Its one-line self-description reads verbatim**: **"Deterministic insurance claim coverage and fraud-indicator review, human-approved disposition."** It is the third of this round’s four takes on **rather refusing than pretending**, **and the only one that writes the eight words "the rule is enforced rather than remembered" into its documentation**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its opening paragraph compresses the whole design into four clauses, each refusing something** — **verbatim**: **"The consequential decision is **pure, deterministic stdlib**; **PII is redacted before anything is audited**; **every result carries a citation**; and **a consequential result is ROUTED to a human reviewer (rule R8) rather than auto-executed or left in a flag nobody reads**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **The last half-clause deserves its own sentence: "rather than auto-executed or left in a flag nobody reads" separates routing to a human from marking it and considering it done** — **the former is a path that reaches a person; the latter is a state that looks handled while nobody is involved** (⭐ **for students building AI claims systems, two distinct failures: the thing that should not have been automated was automated, and the thing that should have been seen by someone was not**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ The sharpest point in the entry is its three-state environment read and the way a test catches it** — **verbatim**: **"Every security-relevant read resolves **three states: unset, set-and-empty and set-and-valid are different**, and **a value an operator deliberately emptied never inherits the more permissive unset default.** `tests/unit/test_three_state_env_reads.py` **fails the build on any two-state read that ships, so the rule is enforced rather than remembered**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Two things**: **first, three states must be distinguished — unset, set-and-empty and set-and-valid are three different things, and a value an operator deliberately emptied must not inherit the more permissive unset default** (⭐ **an uncommon but very real distinction: deliberately blanking a setting usually means tightening, yet a common implementation treats it as never-configured and loosens**); **second, the rule is caught at build time by a test that fails any two-state read that ships — "enforced rather than remembered"** ⭐⭐⭐ **the most condensed single phrase in this round for the round’s theme** (**⚠️ the test’s contents were not read and it was not run, so it is not claimed to fail the build — but the file is measurably present**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ "The demo surface sits outside the gate but is tethered by a test" is the point worth expanding most** — **verbatim**: **"The demo surface sits **OUTSIDE that gate**, because **the gate proves the service and the demo proves the story it is presented with**. It is enforced inside the offline gate by `tests/unit/test_demo_surface.py`, which the hosted GitHub Actions check runs, **so it cannot rot quietly**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **A candid architectural decision: the author concedes that the gate and the demo prove two different things, so the demo is not smuggled into the gate to pretend it has been proved too — while `test_demo_surface.py` tethers the demo so that it drifting away from real capability cannot happen quietly** — ⭐ **and `tests/unit/test_demo_surface.py` is measurably present**. **④ ⭐⭐ The offline gate is listed verbatim and includes an evaluation step** — **verbatim**: **"`ruff check src tests && ruff format --check src tests && mypy src && pytest -m ‘not integration’ && python eval/run_eval.py`"** ⭐⭐ **formatting, static typing, non-integration tests and an evaluation run chained into one gate** (**`eval/run_eval.py` is measurably present**); **and separately** **"`make audit`   # pip-audit over both lockfiles (needs network; **a HARD gate in CI**)"** ⭐⭐ **dependency vulnerability auditing is a hard gate**. **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ "An environment variable with no default" is the second concrete mechanism** — **verbatim**: **"**Name the profile.** `CLAIMSINTEG_PROFILE` has no default. Leaving it unset is its own state: the offline adapters still bind, but **the seeded dev personas are refused, no service-to-service scheme is selected, the dev CORS allowlist and the `X-Dev-Persona` header are withdrawn, and the exposure guard refuses every route to any non-loopback peer**. **A deployment that loses the variable fails visibly instead of serving a stranger.**"**; **and** **"**Unset means `local` adapters bind but nobody chose them.** A value that is set but unknown, **`Local` and `GCP` included, raises at import: a typo must not silently pick a family.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Two points worth keeping**: **first, "a typo must not silently pick a family" — values are deliberately case-sensitive**; **second, "a deployment that loses the variable fails visibly instead of serving a stranger" — unconfigured is not a case for picking something at random but a state in which service must be refused** ⭐⭐ **for students doing deployment, the two together amount to a default-value audit: every default is making a decision on the user’s behalf, and here the choice is to state it explicitly or refuse**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Another mechanism: a token that only ever narrows** — **verbatim**: **"**The guard reads the identity BINDING to decide that, never a service credential: setting `CLAIMSINTEG_S2S_TOKEN` closes the S2S routes and does not open anything else.**"** ⭐⭐ **setting one service-to-service token only closes the related routes and opens nothing else — a switch should be monotonic**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Five surfaces share one domain service, and the documentation says why that matters** — **verbatim**: **"The same capability is reachable five ways, and **they behave the same because they share the domain service rather than reimplementing it**: the FastAPI app (`api/`), the argparse CLI (`cli/`), the agent tools (`agent/`, advertised on the A2A card at `/.well-known/agent-card.json`), the embeddable micro-frontend (`ui/`) and the eval harness. **Each of them routes an escalated result to human review in the same call that produced it, so rule R8 does not hold on four surfaces out of five.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **"so rule R8 does not hold on four surfaces out of five" is a clear-eyed sentence about a specific failure: the safety rule is implemented, but only on some of the entry points** (⭐ **for students building agent applications, an inconsistency that is easy to create and hardest to notice**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ The front-end entry is verbatim and its reason is concrete**: **"**the browser never asserts who the user is: every client-supplied actor, tenant, role and authorization header is discarded, identity is resolved server-side, the service credential never leaves the server, and framing and CORS are per-tenant allowlists that refuse a wildcard**. **If this repo has no user-facing surface, run `make drop-ui` rather than leaving it half-wired; `tests/unit/test_ui_surface.py` holds the repo consistent in both directions.**"** ⭐⭐ **and "run `make drop-ui` rather than leaving it half-wired" turns "do not ship a half-wired interface" into an executable instruction**. **⑨ ⭐⭐ A distinction about what reaches a model’s context** — **verbatim**: **"**The tool results are masked for personal data before they return, which the API response is not**: **a tool result becomes a model’s context, and P-04 is about what reaches the model.**"** ⭐⭐ **the same result is subject to different masking standards when returned to an API caller and when returned to a model as context — the only one of this round’s four to address explicitly the difference between the copy a model sees and the copy a person sees**. **⑩ ⭐⭐ There is an explicit precedence order among its documents, which is uncommon among the entries the site holds** — **verbatim**: **"Deepest authority on intent, in order: `SPEC.md` -> `ARCHITECTURE.md` -> `COMPLIANCE.md` -> this file. `docs/practices-audit.md` records the per-check verdict. Region pinned to `asia-southeast1`."** ⭐⭐ **which document wins is settled in advance**; **and per-check verdicts are recorded separately** — ⭐ **`SPEC.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md` and `COMPLIANCE.md` are all measurably present**. **⑪ ⭐⭐ Four further checkable details**: **configuration has exactly one home** (**"`config/settings.yaml` holds the per-port adapter map plus non-secret defaults, and **it is the only place a binding lives**"**, measurably present); **the two environment samples have distinct jobs** (**"`.env.example` documents every non-secret variable; `.env.secrets.example` documents **the secret NAMES with placeholder values**"** — ⭐ **the names of secrets may enter the repository, the values may not; both files are measurably present**); **a harness that is not falsely green** (the dependency table lists `agent-eval-kit` for, verbatim, **"the **not-falsely-green harness**"**); **and portability as an executable assertion** (**"`make portability`   # **the executable portability claim, pass or fail per named check**"**), **alongside** **"`make docs-check`   # **relative links resolve, fences close, no em-dash in shipped prose**"** (⭐ **even "no em-dash in shipped prose" is made a check**). **⑫ ⭐ Its one-line constraint is also verbatim**: **"Apache-2.0. **Synthetic, obviously fictional data only.**"** ⭐⭐ **synthetic and obviously fictional data only** — **⚠️ so the entry does not claim it is usable for any real claim review, fraud determination or underwriting decision**. **⑬ ⭐ Readable with the site’s claims, agent-evaluation and insurance-fraud entries**: [[claimlens]], [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]], [[claims-intake-agent]], [[claim-ops]], [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]], [[proof-protocol]], [[payout-assurance-standard]], [[rag-assurance]], [[reliability-harness]], [[verified-reserving]], [[agentbench]] and [[garak]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Not one line of source was read, `make gate` and every test were left unrun, and the service was not started** — **so the four claims of a deterministic core, PII redacted before audit, a citation on every result and rule R8 routing are recorded only as the README states them**; ⭐ **what this check measured is that the file each mechanism corresponds to actually exists** (**`tests/unit/test_three_state_env_reads.py`, `tests/unit/test_demo_surface.py`, `tests/unit/test_ui_surface.py`, `eval/run_eval.py`, `config/settings.yaml`, `.env.example`, `.env.secrets.example`, `SPEC.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `COMPLIANCE.md`, `DEMO.md`, `docs/runbook.md` and `Makefile`**) — **⚠️ but a file existing does not mean the rule inside it is in force; this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **② ⚠️⚠️ How "the consequential decision is pure, deterministic stdlib" is implemented was not verified** — **which judgements are deterministic, how that determinism holds numerically and textually, and where the model sits** (**no file under `src/` or `agent/` was read**). **③ ⚠️⚠️ Its masking implementation and the real effect of the "tool results masked, API response not" distinction were not verified**, **nor which jurisdictions the personal-data pattern pack (`pii-kit`) covers** (**no privacy law was consulted; no claim is made that its masking meets any jurisdiction’s compliance requirements**). **④ ⚠️⭐ The content and thresholds of rule R8 were not verified** — **what counts as a consequential result, who reviews, within what time, and by what escalation path** (**⚠️ no claim is made that its review flow meets any insurance regulator’s requirements for claim decisions**). **⑤ ⚠️⭐ The actual behaviour of the three `CLAIMSINTEG_PROFILE` adapter families (`local`, `gcp`, `onprem`) was not verified** — **including `onprem`’s "fail-fast `NotImplementedError` placeholders (the reversibility proof, P-12)"**; ⭐ **recorded plainly that an unimplemented adapter is written as a placeholder that fails immediately when called, and is called a reversibility proof — the same family as round 335’s [[actuarial-tools-bmk]] (retained rather than deleted) and this round’s [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] (omitted, not stubbed)**. **⑥ ⚠️** This check verified **the repository metadata, the README in full, and the complete list of all 244 entries**, **and the presence and first line of the root `LICENSE`**; ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install Python or Node, run `make install`/`gate`/`audit`/`demo`/`portability`/`docs-check`/`test-integration`, read any source, read any test file’s contents, read the contents of `SPEC.md`/`ARCHITECTURE.md`/`COMPLIANCE.md`/`DEMO.md`/`docs/runbook.md`/`docs/practices-audit.md`, read the `Makefile`, read `config/settings.yaml`, request any route, visit its A2A card, or open its interface**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Whether the four "catalog commons" packages it depends on (`hex-service-kit`, `agent-eval-kit`, `pii-kit`, `review-kit`) exist, are public, and which versions this repository depends on was not verified** — ⭐ **the README says verbatim that it is "scaffolded from the catalog commons"**, **and whether that commons is a publicly reusable base was not examined**; **⚠️ if it is not public, whether this repository can run independently is an open question** (**the entry does not claim it can be independently reproduced**). **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ Whether its data is in fact entirely synthetic and obviously fictional was not verified** — **⚠️ no data file was read**; **the entry therefore does not claim it is usable for any real claim review, fraud determination, underwriting or denial decision, nor that any of its judgements could support an allegation against any person**. **⑨ ⭐ At ★0, 0 forks, created 2026-08-22 and pushed 2026-09-10**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**. **⑩ ⭐ Topics measured as `ai-agents`, `detect-investigate`, `financial-crime`, `generative-ai`, `ports-and-adapters` and `vendor-portability`** — **⚠️ `vendor-portability` corresponds to its portability claim, and whether that claim holds outside the `gcp` profile was not verified**. **⑪ The README is in English** — **recorded as such, and whether other language versions exist was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/portable-genai/claims-integrity-investigator` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field Apache-2.0, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 6,529-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; **all 244 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com`; **the root `LICENSE` (11,344 bytes, first line "Apache License") was read via raw**; **nothing was cloned or installed, no command was run, the service was not started, no source or test content was read, no document content was read, no route was requested, and its A2A card and interface were not visited**.

It is enforced inside the offline gate by tests/unit/test_demo_surface.py, which the hosted GitHub Actions check runs, so it cannot rot quietly.」——「承认演示与质量门要证明的是两件不同的事、不把演示塞进门里假装它也被证明了，但用测试把演示拴住使脱节不会悄悄发生」已写明，并实测 tests/unit/test_demo_surface.py 与 tests/unit/test_ui_surface.py 确实存在；⭐⭐离线门逐字「ruff check src tests && ruff format --check src tests && mypy src && pytest -m ‘not integration’ && python eval/run_eval.py」及「make audit # pip-audit over both lockfiles (needs network; a HARD gate in CI)」（实测 eval/run_eval.py 存在，依赖漏洞审计为硬门）；⭐⭐⭐无默认值环境变量逐字「Name the profile. CLAIMSINTEG_PROFILE has no default. Leaving it unset is its own state: the offline adapters still bind, but the seeded dev personas are refused, no service-to-service scheme is selected, the dev CORS allowlist and the X-Dev-Persona header are withdrawn, and the exposure guard refuses every route to any non-loopback peer. A deployment that loses the variable fails visibly instead of serving a stranger.」与「Unset means local adapters bind but nobody chose them. A value that is set but unknown, Local and GCP included, raises at import: a typo must not silently pick a family.」——「打错字不能悄悄替你选一个族（取值故意大小写敏感）」与「丢掉变量的部署会可见地失败而不是去服务一个陌生人」两点，以及「每个默认值都在替使用者做一个决定，这里的选择是要么显式说明要么拒绝」已写明；⭐⭐令牌只收紧不放开逐字「The guard reads the identity BINDING to decide that, never a service credential: setting CLAIMSINTEG_S2S_TOKEN closes the S2S routes and does not open anything else.」——「开关应当是单调的」已写明；⭐⭐五入口逐字「they behave the same because they share the domain service rather than reimplementing it」（FastAPI app api/、argparse CLI cli/、agent tools agent/ 并于 /.well-known/agent-card.json 公布 A2A 卡片、可嵌入微前端 ui/、评测框架）与「Each of them routes an escalated result to human review in the same call that produced it, so rule R8 does not hold on four surfaces out of five.」——「安全规则实现了但只实现了一半入口，是很容易发生也最难发现的一类不一致」已写明；⭐⭐前端逐字「the browser never asserts who the user is: every client-supplied actor, tenant, role and authorization header is discarded, identity is resolved server-side, the service credential never leaves the server, and framing and CORS are per-tenant allowlists that refuse a wildcard. If this repo has no user-facing surface, run make drop-ui rather than leaving it half-wired; tests/unit/test_ui_surface.py holds the repo consistent in both directions.」——「不留半接线的界面是一条可执行指令」已写明；⭐⭐模型上下文区分逐字「The tool results are masked for personal data before they return, which the API response is not: a tool result becomes a model’s context, and P-04 is about what reaches the model.」——「同一個结果返回给 API 调用方与返回给模型当上下文两处适用不同脱敏标准，是本轮四條里唯一明确处理模型看到的那一份与人看到的那一份不同的一条」已写明；⭐⭐文档效力顺序逐字「Deepest authority on intent, in order: SPEC.md -> ARCHITECTURE.md -> COMPLIANCE.md -> this file. docs/practices-audit.md records the per-check verdict. Region pinned to asia-southeast1.」（实测 SPEC.md／ARCHITECTURE.md／COMPLIANCE.md 三份都在仓库里）；⭐⭐另四处细节：config/settings.yaml 为配置唯一落脚点（it is the only place a binding lives，实测存在）；.env.example 与 .env.secrets.example 分工（后者只记录密钥的名字与占位值——密钥名字可进仓库值不行，两份都实测存在）；依赖表里 agent-eval-kit 的用途逐字含 the not-falsely-green harness；make portability 为 the executable portability claim, pass or fail per named check，并有 make docs-check 逐字 relative links resolve, fences close, no em-dash in shipped prose；⭐一句约束逐字「Apache-2.0. Synthetic, obviously fictional data only.」——据此不主张其可用于任何真实的理赔审查、欺诈认定或核保决定；⭐⭐经下载 tarball 列出全部 244 个条目实测：LICENSE、SPEC.md、ARCHITECTURE.md、COMPLIANCE.md、DEMO.md、Makefile、config/settings.yaml、.env.example、.env.secrets.example、docs/runbook.md、eval/run_eval.py、tests/unit/test_three_state_env_reads.py、tests/unit/test_demo_surface.py、tests/unit/test_ui_surface.py 均存在；顶层目录为 .agents／.github／config／docs／eval／infra／scripts／src／tests／ui；⚠️⚠️未读一行源码、未运行 make gate 或任何测试、未启动服务——故其确定性核心、个人信息先脱敏、每个结果带引用、第 R8 条路由四项全部只记录为 README 如此声明；已实测的只是这些机制各自对应的文件确实存在，但文件存在不等于其中的规矩确实生效，**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；⚠️⚠️未核实「The consequential decision is pure, deterministic stdlib」的实现方式（未读 src/ 或 agent/ 下任何文件）；⚠️⚠️未核实其脱敏实现与「工具结果先脱敏、API 响应不脱敏」这一区分的实际效果，亦未核实其所用的管辖区个人信息模式包（pii-kit）覆盖哪些法域（未查任何隐私法规；不主张其脱敏满足任何法域的合规要求）；⚠️⭐未核实第 R8 条规则的具体内容与阈值（什么算 consequential result、由谁复核、复核时限与升级路径），不主张其复核流程满足任何保险监管对理赔决定的要求；⚠️⭐未核实 CLAIMSINTEG_PROFILE 三档适配器（local／gcp／onprem）的实际行为，包括 onprem 的 fail-fast NotImplementedError placeholders（the reversibility proof, P-12）——已如实记下「一个未实现的适配器被写成会在调用时立刻失败、并被称为可逆性证明，与第 335 轮 actuarial-tools-bmk 的归档而非删除、本轮 blueeconomy-marine-insurance 的省略而非留桩属同一族做法」；⚠️未克隆、未安装 Python 或 Node、未运行 make install／gate／audit／demo／portability／docs-check／test-integration、未读任何源码、未读任何测试内容、未读 SPEC.md／ARCHITECTURE.md／COMPLIANCE.md／DEMO.md／docs/runbook.md／docs/practices-audit.md 的内容、未读 Makefile、未读 config/settings.yaml、未请求任何路由、未访问其 A2A 卡片、未打开其界面；⚠️⚠️未核实其依赖的 catalog commons 四个包（hex-service-kit、agent-eval-kit、pii-kit、review-kit）是否存在、是否公开、以及本仓库依赖哪个版本——若该底座不公开则本仓库能否独立运行是一个未核实的问题（不主张它可以被独立复现）；⚠️⚠️未核实其数据是否确实全部为合成且明显虚构（未读任何数据文件），故不主张其可用于任何真实的理赔审查、欺诈认定、核保或拒赔决定，亦不主张其任何判断可作为对任何个人的指控依据；★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-08-22、推送于 2026-09-10，关注度极低，不主张成熟度／正确性／已被采用；topics 里 vendor-portability 与其厂商可移植主张对应，但未核实该主张在 gcp 档之外是否确实成立；README 为英语（已如实记入，本次未核实是否有其他语言版本）。核实手段补充说明：仓库全部 244 个条目经下载 codeload.github.com tarball 后以 tar tz 列出核对；根 LICENSE 经 raw 实测读取；未克隆、未安装、未运行任何命令、未启动服务、未读任何源码或测试内容、未读任何文档内容、未请求任何路由、未访问其 A2A 卡片或界面

entries.title: Inforsight 寿险保单保全风险系统：六代模型、五次失败、一次成功，其中第五代以「320 个格子里 0 个可行」为结论主动停止；且每个失败都有自己的不可变决策记录，释放用留出集在开发全程保持未物化
entries.title_en: Inforsight, a life-insurance conservation risk system: six generations, five failures and one success, where the fifth stopped on the finding that 0 of 320 cells were feasible, every failure has its own immutable decision record, and the release holdout stayed strictly not materialised throughout development
entries.title_hk: Inforsight 壽險保單保全風險系統：六代模型、五次失敗、一次成功，其中第五代以「320 個格子裡 0 個可行」為結論主動停止；且每個失敗都有自己的不可變決策記錄，釋放用留出集在開發全程保持未物化
entries.summary: 一个洁净室（clean room）的寿险在册保单保全风险系统：从不可变事件流重建虚构的保单时间轴，在**不泄漏未来信息**的前提下估计未来九十天内的失效或退保风险，并把**预测与行动权限分开**、让每一次干预都留在人工复核之下；它把四个容易发生的错误逐条点名——时间泄漏会悄悄抬高准确率、账单频率与观察时点等混杂特征会伪装成风险信号、未校准的分数只有排序没有概率、以及不由人复核就自动联系客户或改保单是监管与伦理风险；其记录方式是本条目最值得记的一处：正文用一张表列出**六代模型、五次失败、一次成功**，每一代都写明发生了什么与当时的处置决定，其中第二代是自动预检在拟合之前抓到摄取期泄漏、第三代 20 个种子 0 个通过、第四代月度风险率冲破精算上限、而第五代以「320 个格子中 0 个同时满足两个条件，故数学上不可行」为结论并**主动停止**；每个失败都对应一份不可变的架构决策记录，释放评测的留出集在开发全程保持未物化
entries.summary_hk: 一個潔淨室（clean room）的壽險在冊保單保全風險系統：從不可變事件流重建虛構的保單時間軸，在**不洩漏未來信息**的前提下估計未來九十天內的失效或退保風險，並把**預測與行動權限分開**、讓每一次干預都留在人工覆核之下；它把四個容易發生的錯誤逐條點名——時間洩漏會悄悄抬高準確率、賬單頻率與觀察時點等混雜特徵會偽裝成風險信號、未校準的分數只有排序沒有概率、以及不由人覆核就自動聯繫客戶或改保單是監管與倫理風險；其記錄方式是本條目最值得記的一處：正文用一張表列出**六代模型、五次失敗、一次成功**，每一代都寫明發生了什麼與當時的處置決定，其中第二代是自動預檢在擬合之前抓到攝取期洩漏、第三代 20 個種子 0 個通過、第四代月度風險率衝破精算上限、而第五代以「320 個格子中 0 個同時滿足兩個條件，故數學上不可行」為結論並**主動停止**；每個失敗都對應一份不可變的架構決策記錄，釋放評測的留出集在開發全程保持未物化
entries.summary_en: A clean-room conservation risk system for in-force life insurance policies: it reconstructs fictional policy timelines from immutable event streams, estimates lapse or surrender risk over the next ninety days without leaking future information, separates prediction from action authority, and keeps every intervention under human review; it names four easy mistakes one by one — temporal leakage silently inflates accuracy, confounded features such as billing frequency and observation timing masquerade as risk signals, an uncalibrated score gives ranking without probability, and contacting customers or altering policies without human review is a regulatory and ethical hazard; and its method of record is the entry’s most notable feature: the body carries a table of six generations, five failures and one success, each stating what happened and the disposition taken, including a second generation where automated preflight caught ingestion-time leakage before model fitting, a third where none of twenty seeds passed, a fourth where monthly hazard broke through the actuarial ceiling, and a fifth that concluded zero of 320 cells were feasible — mathematically infeasible — and stopped; every failure has its own immutable architecture decision record, and the release evaluation holdout remained strictly not materialised throughout development
entries.body:
**inforsight**（仓库 `anilreddy89/Inforsight`）**是一个**洁净室（clean-room）寿险在册保单保全风险系统****：**实测 ★1、fork 0、许可 Apache-2.0（`LICENSE` 经 raw 实测存在，10,776 字节，首行「Apache License / Version 2.0, January 2004」）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 4,177 KB、创建于 2026-08-17、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，创建与推送均落在解冻窗口之后**）、**无 topics**；**README 实测 15,846 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 585 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「**Inforsight** is a clean-room conservation case intelligence system for in-force life-insurance policies. It reconstructs fictional policy timelines from immutable event streams, estimates near-term lapse or surrender risk **without leaking future information**, **separates prediction from action authority**, and **keeps a human reviewer in control of every intervention**.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「宁可拒绝，也不假装」**中的**第四种，也是四条里唯一以**主动停止一次设计**为核心成果的一条**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其第一段就把「可证伪的主张」写成了一个问句，而不是一个成绩**——**逐字为**：**「**First falsifiable claim**: Can we generate a realistic fictional in-force policy timeline and predict which active policies are likely to lapse within 90 days — **using only information available on the observation date**?」**⭐⭐⭐ **「只用观察日当时可获得的信息」这半句是本条的技术核心**，**也直接对应其下一节点名的第一类错误**（见下）**——**即**它先声明要证伪什么、再动手****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其「为什么做这个项目」一节把四类**不会报错却让结论变味**的错误逐条点名，本词条认为这是本站已收条目里对**建模陷阱**归纳得最清楚的一段之一**——**逐字为**：**「**Temporal leakage** — using information that wouldn’t have been available yet — **silently inflates accuracy**.」**、**「**Confounded features** — **billing frequency, observation timing, and policy age can masquerade as risk signals**.」**、**「**Uncalibrated scores** — **ranking ≠ probability; a "high risk" label without calibrated confidence is operationally useless**.」**、**「**Autonomous action risk** — a model that **directly contacts customers or alters policies without human review** is a regulatory and ethical hazard.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四条各是一种**静默失败****：**① **时间泄漏**（用到了当时还不存在的信息）**悄悄抬高准确率****；**② **混杂特征**（**账单频率、观察时点、保单年龄伪装成风险信号**）；**③ **未校准的分数**（**「排序不等于概率；没有校准置信度的『高风险』标签在运营上毫无用处」**——**⭐ 这一句值得定价与风控方向的同学单独记住**）；**④ **自主行动风险**（**不经人工复核就联系客户或改保单**是监管与伦理问题）。**其自述的应对逐字为**：**「Inforsight tackles all four through a **contract-first, fail-closed engineering approach** built entirely from synthetic data, public references, and original code — with **every assumption, experiment, failure, and decision recorded**.」**⭐⭐ **「contract-first, fail-closed」与「每一个假设、实验、失败与决定都被记录」**——**本轮四条候选都出现了同一组词**（**contract-first／fail-closed／enforced rather than remembered／omitted not stubbed／success is never fabricated**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **本条目最值得记的一处是那张**六代、五败、一胜**的对照表，以及它对本条目的意义**——**其前言逐字为**：**「**Most portfolio projects show a single model and a final accuracy number. This project shows the full engineering arc — including the iterations that failed and *why* they failed.** Every decision is recorded in an **immutable Architecture Decision Record**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **逐代逐字实测**：**`v1`（单批生成器，逻辑回归＋XGBoost）**→**「账单频率与时间混杂；没有截断前风险机制；AUC ≈ 0.53」**→**处置 `pipeline_engineering_only`**；**`v2`（多队列、比例风险、脆弱度）**→**「**自动预检在模型拟合之前抓到摄取期泄漏**」**→**处置 `stop`**；**`v3`（事件优先的双时间、20 种子验收）**→**「信号恢复崩塌：中位 AUC 0.519 对目标 ≥ 0.65（**0/20 个种子通过**）」**→**处置 `redesign`**；**`v4`（系数加倍、脆弱度减半）**→**「**月度风险率冲破精算上限**（0.25–0.45 对上限 < 0.20）」**→**处置 `redesign`**；**`v5`（320 格可行性曲面，17 项诊断）**→**「**320 个格子中 0 个**同时满足 AUC ≥ 0.70 与风险率 < 0.20 —— **数学上不可行**」**→**处置 `stop_infeasible_design`**；**`v6`（**有界 sigmoid 风险率连接**）**→**「打破了比例风险三元困境；20/20 种子通过；中位 AUC 0.7031」**→**处置 `proceed`**。⭐⭐⭐ **其中三处值得单独记**：**① **`v2` 的失败是**自动预检在拟合之前**抓到的**——**即**一个检查装置比模型更早发现了问题****；**② **`v4` 的失败是一条**行业上限**拦下的**（**月度风险率上限 < 0.20**）**——**即**模型算得出的东西被业务上限判定为不可能****；**③ **`v5` 的结论是**「数学上不可行」并据此停止**——**⭐ 它没有继续调参直到某个格子通过，而是**宣布设计空间为空****（**⚠️ 本词条**未读任何实验文档**，**故**不主张这六代的记录与 README 表格完全一致，**也**不核实 AUC 与风险率数值**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其对本条目的意义在于：每一次失败都留下了**可查的决定记录****——**实测 `docs/adr/` 下有 18 个条目**，**逐名可见整条轨迹**：**`0001-clean-room-and-synthetic-data`**、**`0002-separate-risk-from-action-eligibility`**（**⭐ 「把风险与行动资格分开」是一条**编号在案的架构决定****，**对应该系统「预测与行动权限分开」的主张**）、**`0003-start-local-and-defer-distributed-infrastructure`**、**`0004-versioned-v2-statistical-simulator-and-evaluation-design`**、**`0005-replace-v2-with-a-dual-time-matched-control-v3-statistical-substrate`**、**`0006`／`0007`（v4 **inforsight**（倉庫 `anilreddy89/Inforsight`）**是一個**潔淨室（clean-room）壽險在冊保單保全風險系統****：**實測 ★1、fork 0、許可 Apache-2.0（`LICENSE` 經 raw 實測存在，10,776 位元組，首行「Apache License / Version 2.0, January 2004」）、主語言 Python、體量 4,177 KB、創建於 2026-08-17、最後推送 2026-09-09**（**均落在解凍窗口之後**）、**無 topics**；**README 實測 15,846 位元組（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 585 個條目**。**其自述逐字為**：**「**Inforsight** is a clean-room conservation case intelligence system for in-force life-insurance policies. It reconstructs fictional policy timelines from immutable event streams, estimates near-term lapse or surrender risk **without leaking future information**, **separates prediction from action authority**, and **keeps a human reviewer in control of every intervention**.」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「寧可拒絕，也不假裝」**中的**第四種，也是四條裡唯一以**主動停止一次設計**為核心成果的一條**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其第一段就把「可證偽的主張」寫成了一個問句，而不是一個成績**——**逐字為**：**「**First falsifiable claim**: Can we generate a realistic fictional in-force policy timeline and predict which active policies are likely to lapse within 90 days — **using only information available on the observation date**?」**⭐⭐⭐ **「只用觀察日當時可獲得的信息」這半句是本條的技術核心****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其「為什麼做這個項目」一節把四類**不會報錯卻讓結論變味**的錯誤逐條點名**——**逐字為**：**「**Temporal leakage** — using information that wouldn’t have been available yet — **silently inflates accuracy**.」**、**「**Confounded features** — **billing frequency, observation timing, and policy age can masquerade as risk signals**.」**、**「**Uncalibrated scores** — **ranking ≠ probability; a "high risk" label without calibrated confidence is operationally useless**.」**、**「**Autonomous action risk** — a model that **directly contacts customers or alters policies without human review** is a regulatory and ethical hazard.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四條各是一種**靜默失敗****：**① **時間洩漏悄悄抬高準確率**；**② **混雜特徵**（**賬單頻率、觀察時點、保單年齡偽裝成風險信號**）；**③ **未校準的分數**（**「排序不等於概率；沒有校準置信度的『高風險』標籤在運營上毫無用處」**）；**④ **自主行動風險**（**不經人工覆核就聯繫客戶或改保單**）；**其應對自述逐字為** **「Inforsight tackles all four through a **contract-first, fail-closed engineering approach** built entirely from synthetic data, public references, and original code — with **every assumption, experiment, failure, and decision recorded**.」**⭐⭐ **本輪四條候選都出現了同一組詞**（contract-first／fail-closed／enforced rather than remembered／omitted not stubbed／success is never fabricated）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **本條目最值得記的一處是那張**六代、五敗、一勝**的對照表**——**其前言逐字為**：**「**Most portfolio projects show a single model and a final accuracy number. This project shows the full engineering arc — including the iterations that failed and *why* they failed.** Every decision is recorded in an **immutable Architecture Decision Record**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **逐代逐字實測**：**`v1`（單批生成器，邏輯回歸＋XGBoost）**→**「賬單頻率與時間混雜；沒有截斷前風險機制；AUC ≈ 0.53」**→**`pipeline_engineering_only`**；**`v2`（多隊列、比例風險、脆弱度）**→**「**自動預檢在模型擬合之前抓到攝取期洩漏**」**→**`stop`**；**`v3`（事件優先的雙時間、20 種子驗收）**→**「信號恢復崩塌：中位 AUC 0.519 對目標 ≥ 0.65（**0/20 個種子通過**）」**→**`redesign`**；**`v4`（係數加倍、脆弱度減半）**→**「**月度風險率衝破精算上限**（0.25–0.45 對上限 < 0.20）」**→**`redesign`**；**`v5`（320 格可行性曲面，17 項診斷）**→**「**320 個格子中 0 個**同時滿足 AUC ≥ 0.70 與風險率 < 0.20 —— **數學上不可行**」**→**`stop_infeasible_design`**；**`v6`（**有界 sigmoid 風險率連接**）**→**「打破了比例風險三元困境；20/20 種子通過；中位 AUC 0.7031」**→**`proceed`**。⭐⭐⭐ **其中三處值得單獨記**：**① `v2` 的失敗是**自動預檢在擬合之前**抓到的**（**一個檢查裝置比模型更早發現問題**）；**② `v4` 的失敗是一條**行業上限**攔下的**（**模型算得出的東西被業務上限判定為不可能**）；**③ `v5` 的結論是**「數學上不可行」並據此停止**——**⭐ 它沒有繼續調參直到某個格子通過，而是**宣布設計空間為空****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **每一次失敗都留下了**可查的決定記錄****——**實測 `docs/adr/` 下有 18 個條目**，**逐名可見整條軌跡**：**`0001-clean-room-and-synthetic-data`**、**`0002-separate-risk-from-action-eligibility`**（**⭐ 「把風險與行動資格分開」是一條**編號在案的架構決定****）、**`0003-start-local-and-defer-distributed-infrastructure`**、**`0004-versioned-v2-statistical-simulator-and-evaluation-design`**、**`0005-replace-v2-with-a-dual-time-matched-control-v3-statistical-substrate`**、**`0006`／`0007`（v4 **inforsight** (repository `anilreddy89/Inforsight`) **is a clean-room conservation risk system for in-force life insurance policies**: **measured ★1, 0 forks, licence Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE` measured present by raw probe at 10,776 bytes, first line "Apache License / Version 2.0, January 2004"), Python as the primary language, a 4,177 KB repository, created 2026-08-17 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**all GitHub API measurements, both after the thaw window**), **no topics**; **the README measures 15,846 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 585 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"**Inforsight** is a clean-room conservation case intelligence system for in-force life-insurance policies. It reconstructs fictional policy timelines from immutable event streams, estimates near-term lapse or surrender risk **without leaking future information**, **separates prediction from action authority**, and **keeps a human reviewer in control of every intervention**."** It is the fourth of this round’s four takes on **rather refusing than pretending**, **and the only one whose central achievement is stopping a design**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its first paragraph states the falsifiable claim as a question rather than a result** — **verbatim**: **"**First falsifiable claim**: Can we generate a realistic fictional in-force policy timeline and predict which active policies are likely to lapse within 90 days — **using only information available on the observation date**?"** ⭐⭐⭐ **"using only information available on the observation date" is the technical core of the entry** and maps directly onto the first mistake it names below: **it states what is to be falsified before starting**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its "why this project exists" section names four failures that raise no error while changing what the conclusions mean — among the clearest such summaries the site holds** — **verbatim**: **"**Temporal leakage** — using information that wouldn’t have been available yet — **silently inflates accuracy**."**; **"**Confounded features** — **billing frequency, observation timing, and policy age can masquerade as risk signals**."**; **"**Uncalibrated scores** — **ranking ≠ probability; a "high risk" label without calibrated confidence is operationally useless**."**; **"**Autonomous action risk** — a model that **directly contacts customers or alters policies without human review** is a regulatory and ethical hazard."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four kinds of silent failure**: **temporal leakage quietly inflating accuracy**; **confounded features — billing frequency, observation timing and policy age masquerading as risk signals**; **uncalibrated scores, where ranking is not probability and a high-risk label without calibrated confidence is operationally useless**; **and the risk of acting autonomously, contacting customers or altering policies without human review**. **Its stated response reads verbatim**: **"Inforsight tackles all four through a **contract-first, fail-closed engineering approach** built entirely from synthetic data, public references, and original code — with **every assumption, experiment, failure, and decision recorded**."** ⭐⭐ **The same cluster of words appears across all four of this round’s candidates**: contract-first, fail-closed, enforced rather than remembered, omitted not stubbed, success is never fabricated. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The most notable feature of this entry is its table of six generations, five failures and one success** — **its preamble reads verbatim**: **"**Most portfolio projects show a single model and a final accuracy number. This project shows the full engineering arc — including the iterations that failed and *why* they failed.** Every decision is recorded in an **immutable Architecture Decision Record**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Generation by generation, measured verbatim**: **`v1`** (single-batch generator, logistic plus XGBoost) → **"billing frequency confounded with time; no pre-cutoff risk mechanism; AUC ≈ 0.53"** → **`pipeline_engineering_only`**; **`v2`** (multi-cohort, proportional hazards, frailty) → **"automated preflight caught ingestion-time leakage before model fitting"** → **`stop`**; **`v3`** (event-first dual-time, 20-seed acceptance) → **"signal recovery collapsed: median AUC 0.519 against a target of ≥ 0.65 (0/20 seeds passed)"** → **`redesign`**; **`v4`** (doubled coefficients, halved frailty) → **"monthly hazard exploded past the actuarial ceiling (0.25–0.45 against a limit of < 0.20)"** → **`redesign`**; **`v5`** (320-cell feasibility surface, 17 diagnostics) → **"0 of 320 cells satisfy simultaneous AUC ≥ 0.70 and hazard < 0.20 — mathematically infeasible"** → **`stop_infeasible_design`**; **`v6`** (**bounded sigmoid hazard link**) → **"broke the Proportional Hazards Trilemma; 20/20 seeds pass; median AUC 0.7031"** → **`proceed`**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Three of these deserve separate note**: **the `v2` failure was caught by automated preflight before fitting — a checking device found the problem earlier than the model did**; **the `v4` failure was stopped by an industry ceiling, so something the model could compute was judged impossible by a business limit**; **and `v5` concluded mathematically infeasible and stopped — it did not keep tuning until some cell passed, but declared the design space empty**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Every failure left a findable decision record** — **`docs/adr/` measurably holds 18 entries**, **whose titles show the whole trajectory**: **`0001-clean-room-and-synthetic-data`**; **`0002-separate-risk-from-action-eligibility`** (⭐ **separating risk from action eligibility is a numbered architectural decision**, matching the system’s claim of separating prediction from action authority); **`0003-start-local-and-defer-distributed-infrastructure`**; **`0004-versioned-v2-statistical-simulator-and-evaluation-design`**; **`0005-replace-v2-with-a-dual-time-matched-control-v3-statistical-substrate`**; **`0006` and `0007`** (the v4 signal-recovery diagnostic boundary and design); **`0008-authorize-post-v4-redesign-diagnostics`**; **`0009-record-r2-14b-readiness-stop`**; **`0010-amend-v5-diagnostic-contract-with-disposition-truth-tables`**; ⭐ **`0011-record-v5-design-infeasibility-and-stop`** (**an immutable record of a failure, titled exactly that**); **`0012-authorize-bounded-sigmoid-hazard-link-v6`**; **`0013-amend-v6-statistical-acceptance-protocol`**; **`0014-enterprise-distributed-architecture`**; **`0015-canonical-dual-time-domain-snapshot`** (**⚠️ none of the eighteen was read, so only the decision each title expresses is recorded**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ "The holdout stayed not materialised throughout" is the second mechanism** — **verbatim**: **"… **release evaluation holdouts remained strictly `not_materialized` throughout development**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **the release-evaluation holdout was never generated at all during development — which is far stronger than promising not to look: if the data does not exist, it cannot be used indirectly**. **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ The v6 constraint holds by construction rather than by tuning** — **verbatim**: **"**Generation v6** introduced a **bounded logistic hazard link** — λ(t) = λ_max·σ(z) — that **mathematically guarantees monthly hazard ≤ 0.15 while preserving discriminative signal**. This architecture passed **all 120 inventory units across 20 acceptance seeds** under Protocol 3.1.0."** ⭐⭐⭐ **a ceiling that follows from the functional form rather than being tuned down** — ⭐ **the same family as this round’s [[claims-integrity-investigator]] (caught at build time by a test) and [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] (rejected at commit time by the database): put the constraint in the structure, not in the tuner’s attention**. **⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ Its current-baseline section gives every metric an interval, with two carrying pre-declared governance bands** — **measured verbatim**: **"L2-regularized Logistic Regression (C=1.0, liblinear) with **Platt scaling calibration**, evaluated out-of-sample on **8,782 observations from 1,440 policies**"**; **ROC AUC **0.6998** with a 95% **clustered bootstrap** interval **[0.6847, 0.7153]**; **Average Precision **0.2765** **[0.2560, 0.2994]**; **Expected Calibration Error **0.0115**; **Calibration Slope **0.9498**, **governed [0.85, 1.15]**; **Brier Score **0.1211** **[0.1168, 0.1253]**; **Brier Skill Score **+0.0633**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: **an AUC around 0.70 is presented as it is, not packaged as high accuracy**; **the calibration slope carries a pre-declared acceptable band of [0.85, 1.15] and the measured 0.9498 sits inside it — declare the acceptable range first, then report the measured value**; **and the interval uses a clustered bootstrap, because several observations from one policy are not independent**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its three operational triage queues quantify how useful the ranking is, in modest terms**: **Top 1%**: precision **34.09%**, recall **2.24%**, lift **2.23×**, NNR **2.93**; **Top 5%**: **35.31% / 11.57% / 2.31× / 2.83**; **Top 20%**: **30.24% / 39.63% / 1.98× / 3.31** ⭐⭐ **lift of about two and around three contacts needed per case — honest rather than flattering, with precision and recall given together**; entries.title_hk: 通用航空保險保費預測（碩士論文）：用交叉驗證的 XGBoost 集成加保形預測區間估計公務機年保費，並把 15% 鎖住不動；某些候選在鎖住測試集上單項指標更好，但該集合未被用來重選模型
entries.summary: 一份南丹麦大学与 ForeFlight 合作完成的机器学习硕士论文项目：用可观测的保单、飞机与飞行员属性估计通用航空年保费，量化预测不确定性并解释模型主要驱动因素；技术路线是比较基线、GLM、HistGradientBoosting、CatBoost 与多种 XGBoost 变体后选定一个「通用对数保费模型＋分段相对保费模型」的集成，预测区间同时试了原始分位数、保形点方法与保形分位数回归；1,945 条自愿填报的保单记录中 85% 用于开发与五折交叉验证、15% 锁进最终测试集，模型与超参数选择只用开发数据；论文写明「某些附近的提升树候选在锁住测试集的单项指标上表现略好，但测试集没有被用来重选」；最终 90% 对数相对保形区间在锁住测试集上的覆盖率为 92.12%，平均宽度是保费的 1.11 倍；仓库明确列出被排除的内容（原始与处理后的保单级数据、模型二进制、公司往来文件等），并写明因此该公开仓库无法独立复现完整实验
entries.summary_hk: 一份南丹麥大學與 ForeFlight 合作完成的機器學習碩士論文項目：用可觀測的保單、飛機與飛行員屬性估計通用航空年保費，量化預測不確定性並解釋模型主要驅動因素；技術路線是比較基線、GLM、HistGradientBoosting、CatBoost 與多種 XGBoost 變體後選定一個「通用對數保費模型＋分段相對保費模型」的集成，預測區間同時試了原始分位數、保形點方法與保形分位數回歸；1,945 條自願填報的保單記錄中 85% 用於開發與五折交叉驗證、15% 鎖進最終測試集，模型與超參數選擇只用開發數據；論文寫明「某些附近的提升樹候選在鎖住測試集的單項指標上表現略好，但測試集沒有被用來重選」；最終 90% 對數相對保形區間在鎖住測試集上的覆蓋率為 92.12%，平均寬度是保費的 1.11 倍；倉庫明確列出被排除的內容（原始與處理後的保單級數據、模型二進制、公司往來文件等），並寫明因此該公開倉庫無法獨立復現完整實驗
entries.summary_en: A machine-learning master’s thesis project completed at the University of Southern Denmark in collaboration with ForeFlight: observable policy, aircraft and pilot attributes are used to estimate general aviation annual premiums, quantify prediction uncertainty and explain the model’s main drivers; the technical route compares baselines, GLMs, HistGradientBoosting, CatBoost and several XGBoost variants before selecting an ensemble combining a general log-premium model with segment-specific relative-premium models, and prediction intervals are tried as raw quantiles, conformal point methods and conformalized quantile regression; of 1,945 voluntarily entered policy records, 85% go to development and five-fold cross-validation and 15% is locked as the final test set, with model and hyperparameter selection using development data only; the thesis states that some nearby boosted-tree candidates performed slightly better on individual locked-test metrics but that the test set was not used for reselection; the selected 90% log-relative conformal interval reaches 92.12% coverage on the locked test set with a mean width of 1.11 times the premium; and the repository lists explicitly what is excluded, including raw and processed policy-level data and model binaries, noting that the public repository therefore cannot reproduce the complete experiment
entries.body:
**aviation-premium-prediction**（仓库 `LaugeSolvang/Aviation-Premium-Prediction`）**是一份**通用航空保险（general aviation insurance）保费预测的机器学习硕士论文项目****：**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 8,025 KB、创建于 2026-06-14、最后推送 2026-06-14**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**；**⚠️ 创建与推送**均在解冻窗口之前**——**见下方标注 ①**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 实测 404，README 亦无许可章节——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**topics 实测为** `aviation`、`conformal-prediction`、`insurance`、`machine-learning`、`master-thesis`、`shap`、`xgboost`；**README 实测 7,541 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 76 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「A machine-learning master thesis project for estimating **general aviation insurance premiums**, quantifying prediction uncertainty, and explaining the model’s main drivers. The project was completed at the **University of Southern Denmark in collaboration with ForeFlight**.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「单方面不成立」**中的**第一种，也是本站**首次填上「航空险」这一真空白形态**的条目****（**该形态在池 1189 ＋ wiki 1131 共 1400 条中命中数为 0，已连续约十轮为真空白**——**见标注 ②**）。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其评估设计一节是本条最值得记的一处，因为它把「锁住」写成了一条**用词极具体的纪律****——**逐字为**：**「The analysis used **1,945** voluntarily entered policy records: **1,653 policies (85%)** for development and five-fold cross-validation. **292 policies (15%)** in a **locked final test set**. **Model and hyperparameter selection used development data only.** **The locked test set was used once for final diagnostics, not to switch models afterward.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处各自拒绝一件事**：**① 85%／15% 划分是**先定后动**的**；**② **模型与超参数的选择只用开发数据**；**③ **锁住测试集**只用一次**，且只用于最终诊断**；**④ **「not to switch models afterward」——**不用于事后换模型****。**而**最能说明这条纪律真的是被遵守的**（而不是只在方法一节里声明）**是其在结果一节的**自陈**——**逐字为**：**「The ensemble was selected by development-side cross-validation. **Some nearby boosted-tree candidates performed slightly better on individual locked-test metrics, but the test set was not used for reselection.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**存在若干在锁住测试集上单项指标更好的候选，但作者没有据此改选****——**⭐ 这正与本轮主题相合：**锁住的第二来源只能**报告**，不能**挑选****（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**这 292 条在代码中是否确实只被读取一次**——**见标注 ⑥**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其预测区间的处理是第二条与本题相关的线索，且它把**覆盖率与宽度**的取舍如实摆出**——**逐字为**：**「The selected **90% log-relative conformal point interval** achieved: Locked-test coverage **92.12%**；Mean width relative to premium **1.11×**；Median width relative to premium **1.09×**」**；**以及**：**「**Raw quantile intervals were sharper but under-covered.** **Dollar-scale conformal intervals reached high coverage but became disproportionately wide for lower-premium policies.** The log-relative method provided the best development-side balance at the 90% target.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三句话构成一组很干净的取舍记录**：**原始分位数**更窄但覆盖不足**；**金额尺度的保形区间**覆盖达标但**对低保费保单宽得不成比例**；**对数相对尺度**在 90% 目标下取得最好的开发侧平衡**——**⭐ 对做定价与准备金区间的同学，这是一段可直接借用的对照**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**其保形方法的实现与覆盖率计算**）。**③ ⭐⭐ **点预测结果一节的**基线阶梯**逐字可查**：**Test MAE **$1,309**、RMSE **$2,543**、MAPE **24.30%**、落在 ±15% 以内的比例 **41.10%****；**并逐字说明**：**「The selected ensemble reduced test MAE from **$3,973 for a global-median baseline** and **$2,130 for a hull-value-only model**.」**⭐⭐ **即**集成把测试 MAE 从「全局中位数基线」的 3,973 美元与「只看机身价值模型」的 2,130 美元压下来****——**⭐ 而**它也如实写出 MAPE 24.30% 与「±15% 以内仅 41.10%」**：**后者说明**多数预测并不在真值 ±15% 之内****（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实这些数字**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其对目标变量的**界定**很精确，且这一点对保险读者很重要**——**逐字为**：**「The target is **observed annual paid premium**, not actuarial pure premium or expected claim cost.」**⭐⭐ **即**因变量是**实际支付的年保费**，而不是精算纯保费或期望赔付成本****——**⭐ 本词条据此指出：这是一条**市场价格的拟合**，而非**风险的定价****；**其数据集与结论**均不能读作**任何险种的纯保费估计**（**其「限制」一节也逐字承认**：「Observed paid premium includes **market, carrier, broker, package, and underwriting effects that are not fully observed**.」**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其对**可解释性**的两处限定值得单独记**：**其一，最强全局驱动逐字为** **Hull value／Gear configuration／Deductible structure／Pilot experience, including hours in make and model／Aircraft make, year, and category**，**并逐字说** **「The directions were broadly consistent with aviation underwriting intuition.」**；**其二，其**非直觉发现**的处理方式最值得学**——**逐字为**：**「A non-intuitive **medical-coverage** pattern was treated as **a likely proxy for an unobserved carrier or policy package**, **not as a causal pricing rule**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**遇到一个反直觉的模式时，它的处理是**把它当成某个未观测变量的代理，而不是当成一条定价规律****；**并另逐字限定**：**「SHAP values describe how the fitted model uses observed variables. **They do not establish causal effects or official underwriting rules.**」**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读其 SHAP 结果表**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「可复现与隐私」一节把**被排除的东西逐项列出**，并直接说明后果**——**逐字为**：**「The source code, final aggregate result tables, thesis, and presentation are included. The following are **intentionally excluded**: Raw and processed policy-level data. UUID-level split assignments and prediction files. Local SHAP values and individual example-case tables. Trained `.joblib`, `.pkl`, and other model binaries. Company correspondence, meeting notes, legal documents, and internal review material.」**，**并逐字给出结论**：**「Because the confidential data and trained models are excluded, **this public repository cannot reproduce the complete experiment or run live predictions by itself. It documents the methodology and retained aggregate evidence.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「它记录方法与保留下来的汇总证据，而不能独立复现」是一句很克制的自我界定**——**⚠️ 与本轮其余三条候选（都以「能独立跑起来」为卖点）相反，**这一条明确说自己跑不起来**；**对做论文复现的同学，这正好是**「做不到什么」应当怎么写**的一个样本**。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **其免责声明逐字，且把「不是什么」列全**——**逐字为**：**「> This is a **research and decision-support prototype, not a production pricing engine, binding quote system, or autonomous underwriting tool**.」**⭐⭐ **三项否定（不是生产定价引擎、不是有约束力的报价系统、不是自主核保工具）**——**⭐ 与第 334 轮 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的「不替代核心系统、不替代核保、不替代出单」属同一写法**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **其原型的形态逐字，且与「保单持有人只有自己那一份报价」这一起点相扣**——**其「Problem」一节逐字为**：**「**Aircraft owners often see only their own insurance quotes and have limited information for judging whether a premium is typical.**」**；**原型逐字含** **「A point estimate. An expected premium range. **Placement of the user’s paid premium within that range.** Model-driver and comparison guidance.」**⭐⭐ **即**把用户自己实际支付的那份保费放进模型给出的区间里给他看****——**⭐ 对做保险产品的同学，这是一个**把不确定区间转成用户可用的信息**的简单设计**；**⚠️ 并逐字说明该原型已不完整**：**「The retained HTML is the interface layer. **The public repository does not include trained model binaries, so calculations require the private model artifacts used during the thesis.**」**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **仓库结构与源码地图逐字，且**编号本身是实验流水线的痕迹****——**实测 `src/` 下 34 个文件**，**其中 20 个以 `rebuild_step_` 开头**（**`rebuild_step_01_scope.py` 至 `rebuild_step_06_feature_baseline.py`，再加 `07i`／`07r`／`07rd`／`07re`／`07s`／`07z`／`07zg`／`07zh`／`08ae`／`08v`／`08w`／`10` 等**）**；**README 逐字解释**：**「**The numbered filenames reflect the experimental pipeline used during the thesis.**」**；**另实测** **`docs/Lauge_Solvang_Master_Thesis_2026.pdf`**、**`docs/oral_defense_20min_presentation.pdf`**、**`thesis/thesis.tex`**、**`thesis/references.bib`**、**`thesis/figures/` 下 15 个图**、**`web/premium_tool.html`**、**`results/` 下 4 个 CSV 加 `README.md`**、**`requirements.txt`**⭐⭐ **即**论文 PDF、答辩演示 PDF、LaTeX 源与图、保留的汇总结果表、静态原型都在仓库里**；**⭐ 另有一处细节：`thesis/figures/supervisor_missing_01_pipeline_workflow.png`**（**文件名逐字说这是**导师说缺的那一张流程图**）**。**⑩ ⭐ 可与本站校准、保形预测与不确定性条目并读**：[[insurance-calibration]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[inforsight]]、[[insurance-conformal-claims]]、[[insurance-conformal-risk]]、[[insurance-monitoring]]、[[conformalprediction-jl]]、[[mapie]]、[[ratecraft]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **本条目的窗口位置必须写清，这是本轮**唯一一处对既定窗口纪律的例外****：**该仓库**创建与最后推送均为 2026-06-14，早于 2026-09-05 的解冻窗口****——**⚠️ 即它**不是**窗口内的新候选**；**⭐ 收录理由是**另一项：它填上了本站**连续约十轮为真空白的「航空险」形态****（**见下第②点**）；**⚠️ 本词条把这一取舍明确写出，供读者自行判断**——**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**放宽窗口纪律是对的，**只记录本轮为何在此破例一次**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **关于真空白的核实方式与限度**：**本条目的「航空险」归属由本站自有的 `form-gap-census.cjs` 判定**（**该工具的关键词为**启发式**：`aviation insurance`／`aircraft insurance`／`航空险`**），**而该工具在收录前对池 1189 ＋ wiki 1131（去重 1400 条）的普查结果为**「航空险 0」****——**⚠️ 但须同时写明：**「命中 0」只说明**此前没有任何条目的文本包含这三个关键词****，**不说明此前对该险种没有任何相关知识**（**例如第 333 轮的 [[aero-audit]] 触及航空但为**监控安全而非保险**，按当时日志已明确不计入该形态**）；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**本条已覆盖航空险的实务面**——**它是一份**保费拟合的学术项目**，**而**不是**航空险的条款、费率或核保研究**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其数据来源与使用边界**——**README 逐字说数据为 **1,945 条**自愿填报的保单记录**，**来自与 ForeFlight 的合作**；**⚠️ 本次**未读其数据字典、未查 ForeFlight 或南丹麦大学的任何授权文件、未核实这些数据是否可以如此使用****；**本词条据此**不主张**其数据使用已获授权，**也不转述任何数据字段的含义**（**⭐ 其「可复现与隐私」一节已自述排除原始与处理后的保单级数据，并说明公开仓库无法独立复现**）。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其任何模型结果**——**包括 Test MAE 1,309 美元、RMSE 2,543 美元、MAPE 24.30%、±15% 以内 41.10%、90% 区间的 92.12% 覆盖率与 1.11 倍宽度、以及 SHAP 驱动因素排序**；**⚠️ 本次**未运行任何脚本、未读 `results/` 下任何 CSV、未读论文 PDF、未打开任何图****。**⑤ ⚠️⭐⭐ **未核实**其核心的「锁住测试集只用一次」是否在代码中确实成立**——**⚠️ 这恰恰是本条最需要被检验的一点**（**其自述「在某些锁住测试集指标上更好的候选未被用来重选」是一个**关于自己行为的声明**，**而这类声明只能由代码或记录来支持**）；**⚠️ 本次**未读任何 `src/` 下脚本、未查其提交历史、未读 `results/point_model_test_diagnostics.csv`**，**故**不主张**该纪律确实被遵守**（**⚠️ 对做建模的同学：**「我没有偷看测试集」是那种**无法从结果数字上验证**的声明**，**只能靠流程与留痕**——**而本条**同时提供了流程描述与保留的汇总结果表**，**这已是较强的证据形态，**但仍不等于核实****）。**⑥ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**其保形预测区间的实现与覆盖率口径**——**即**所用的是原始分位数、保形点方法还是保形分位数回归**、**分组与顺序如何取**、**以及 92.12% 的覆盖率是否按保单聚类计算**（**⚠️ 第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 用了**聚类自助法**并说明了理由，**本条 README 未说明其区间是否处理同一保单的重复观测**——**这一点本词条**未核实，**仅提示为需查项**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README（7,541 字节）全文、以及仓库全部 76 个条目的文件清单**（**含 `src/` 下 34 个文件与其中 20 个 `rebuild_step_*` 脚本、`docs/` 下两份 PDF 与 6 张图、`thesis/` 下 LaTeX 源、参考文献与 15 张图、`results/` 下 4 个 CSV 与 `README.md`、`web/premium_tool.html`、`requirements.txt`**）；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 Python、未运行任何脚本、**未读任何源码、未读 `results/` 下任何 CSV、未读论文 PDF 或答辩演示、未打开任何图、未读 `web/premium_tool.html`、未查其提交历史或 issue****；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其与 ForeFlight 的合作关系、是否已通过答辩、论文是否已归档或公开发表**——**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该论文已通过评审、被 ForeFlight 采纳或具有任何商业或监管效力**；**⭐ 其自述为「master thesis project」与「research and decision-support prototype」，**本词条据此**不主张**它已用于任何真实报价或核保**。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **本词条**不主张**其任何结论适用于中国的通用航空或公务机保险市场**——**本次未查任何中国航空险条款、费率或监管规定**；**亦**不主张**其驱动因素排序（机身价值、起落架构型、免赔结构等）在任何其他市场成立**。**⑩ ⭐ **aviation-premium-prediction** (repository `LaugeSolvang/Aviation-Premium-Prediction`) **is a master’s thesis project on machine-learning prediction of general aviation insurance premiums**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, an 8,025 KB repository, created 2026-06-14 and last pushed 2026-06-14** (**all GitHub API measurements**; **⚠️ both creation and push fall *before* the thaw window — see note ① below**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` measured 404, and the README has no licence section — the "no statement whatever" form)**; **topics measured as** `aviation`, `conformal-prediction`, `insurance`, `machine-learning`, `master-thesis`, `shap` and `xgboost`; **the README measures 7,541 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 76 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"A machine-learning master thesis project for estimating **general aviation insurance premiums**, quantifying prediction uncertainty, and explaining the model’s main drivers. The project was completed at the **University of Southern Denmark in collaboration with ForeFlight**."** It is the first of this round’s four takes on **nothing stands on a single source**, **and it is the entry that finally fills the site’s "aviation insurance" true-zero gap** (**that form group measures 0 across the pool of 1,189 plus the wiki’s 1,131 — 1,400 deduplicated entries — and had been a true zero for roughly ten rounds; see note ②**).

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its evaluation-design section is the most notable point, because it writes "locked" as a discipline with unusually concrete wording** — **verbatim**: **"The analysis used **1,945** voluntarily entered policy records: **1,653 policies (85%)** for development and five-fold cross-validation. **292 policies (15%)** in a **locked final test set**. **Model and hyperparameter selection used development data only.** **The locked test set was used once for final diagnostics, not to switch models afterward.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four refusals**: **the 85/15 split is fixed before any work**; **model and hyperparameter selection use development data only**; **the locked test set is used once and for final diagnostics only**; **and "not to switch models afterward" — it is not used to change the model afterwards**. **What shows the discipline was actually kept, rather than merely declared in a methods section, is the admission in the results section** — **verbatim**: **"The ensemble was selected by development-side cross-validation. **Some nearby boosted-tree candidates performed slightly better on individual locked-test metrics, but the test set was not used for reselection.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **candidates existed that scored better on individual locked-test metrics, and the author did not switch to them** — ⭐ **which is exactly this round’s theme: the locked second source may report, but may not choose** (**⚠️ whether those 292 records are in fact read only once in the code was not verified**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its treatment of prediction intervals is the second relevant thread, and it lays the coverage-versus-width trade-off out plainly** — **verbatim**: **"The selected **90% log-relative conformal point interval** achieved: Locked-test coverage **92.12%**; Mean width relative to premium **1.11×**; Median width relative to premium **1.09×**"**; **and**: **"**Raw quantile intervals were sharper but under-covered.** **Dollar-scale conformal intervals reached high coverage but became disproportionately wide for lower-premium policies.** The log-relative method provided the best development-side balance at the 90% target."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three sentences form a clean record of a trade-off: raw quantiles are sharper but under-cover; dollar-scale conformal intervals reach the coverage target but become disproportionately wide for low-premium policies; and the log-relative scale gives the best development-side balance at the 90% target** — **for students working on pricing or reserving intervals this is a directly borrowable comparison**. **③ ⭐⭐ Its point-prediction section gives the baseline ladder verbatim**: **Test MAE **$1,309**, RMSE **$2,543**, MAPE **24.30%** and **41.10%** of predictions within ±15%**; **and states verbatim**: **"The selected ensemble reduced test MAE from **$3,973 for a global-median baseline** and **$2,130 for a hull-value-only model**."** ⭐⭐ **the ensemble brings test MAE down from a global-median baseline of $3,973 and a hull-value-only model of $2,130** — ⭐ **while also reporting the MAPE of 24.30% and the ±15% figure of 41.10%, the latter showing that most predictions are not within ±15% of the truth**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its definition of the target variable is precise, and that matters to an insurance reader** — **verbatim**: **"The target is **observed annual paid premium**, not actuarial pure premium or expected claim cost."** ⭐⭐ **the dependent variable is the premium actually paid, not an actuarial pure premium or expected claim cost** — ⭐ **so this is a fit of market prices, not a pricing of risk; neither the dataset nor the conclusions can be read as a pure-premium estimate for any line** (**its Limitations section concedes verbatim**: "Observed paid premium includes **market, carrier, broker, package, and underwriting effects that are not fully observed**."). **⑤ ⭐⭐ Two qualifiers on explainability deserve separate note**: **the strongest global drivers read verbatim as Hull value / Gear configuration / Deductible structure / Pilot experience, including hours in make and model / Aircraft make, year, and category**, with the statement that **"The directions were broadly consistent with aviation underwriting intuition."**; UUID-level split assignments and prediction files. Local SHAP values and individual example-case tables. Trained `.joblib`, `.pkl`, and other model binaries. Company correspondence, meeting notes, legal documents, and internal review material."**, **concluding verbatim**: **"Because the confidential data and trained models are excluded, **this public repository cannot reproduce the complete experiment or run live predictions by itself. It documents the methodology and retained aggregate evidence.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **"it documents the methodology and retained aggregate evidence" is a restrained self-definition** — **⚠️ unlike the round’s other three, which all sell being runnable, this one states plainly that it is not**; **for students doing thesis replication, this is a sample of how to write what cannot be done**. **⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ Its disclaimer is verbatim and enumerates what it is not** — **verbatim**: **" > This is a **research and decision-support prototype, not a production pricing engine, binding quote system, or autonomous underwriting tool**."** ⭐⭐ **three negations: not a production pricing engine, not a binding quote system, not an autonomous underwriting tool**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its prototype’s shape is verbatim and ties back to the starting point that policyholders see only their own quote** — its Problem section reads verbatim: **"**Aircraft owners often see only their own insurance quotes and have limited information for judging whether a premium is typical.**"**; **the prototype reads verbatim as** **"A point estimate. An expected premium range. **Placement of the user’s paid premium within that range.** Model-driver and comparison guidance."** ⭐⭐ **it places the premium the user actually paid inside the interval the model produces**; **⚠️ and it states verbatim that the prototype is now incomplete**: **"The retained HTML is the interface layer. **The public repository does not include trained model binaries, so calculations require the private model artifacts used during the thesis.**"** **⑨ ⭐⭐ Structure and source map, where the numbering is itself a trace of the experimental pipeline** — **`src/` measurably holds 34 files, 20 of them named `rebuild_step_*`**; **the README explains verbatim**: **"**The numbered filenames reflect the experimental pipeline used during the thesis.**"**; **measured present are also two PDFs and six images under `docs/`, `thesis/thesis.tex` with `references.bib` and fifteen figures, four CSVs plus a `README.md` under `results/`, `web/premium_tool.html` and `requirements.txt`**; ⭐ **one further detail: `thesis/figures/supervisor_missing_01_pipeline_workflow.png`**, **whose filename says verbatim that this is the workflow diagram the supervisor said was missing**. **⑩ ⭐ Readable with the site’s calibration, conformal-prediction and uncertainty entries**: [[insurance-calibration]], [[insurance-conformal]], [[inforsight]], [[insurance-conformal-claims]], [[insurance-conformal-risk]], [[insurance-monitoring]], [[conformalprediction-jl]], [[mapie]] and [[ratecraft]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Its position relative to the window must be written out, because it is this round’s single exception to the established window discipline**: **the repository was created and last pushed on 2026-06-14, before the 2026-09-05 thaw window** — **⚠️ so it is *not* a new in-window candidate**; ⭐ **the reason for including it is different: it fills the site’s "aviation insurance" form group, a true zero for roughly ten rounds** (**see note ②**); **⚠️ the entry states that trade-off plainly so readers can judge it** — **it does not claim relaxing the window discipline is right, only records why this round made one exception**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ How the true zero was checked, and the limits of that check**: **the "aviation insurance" attribution is decided by the site’s own `form-gap-census.cjs`** (**whose keywords are heuristic: `aviation insurance`, `aircraft insurance` and 航空险**), **and before this round the census reported "aviation insurance 0" across the pool of 1,189 plus the wiki’s 1,131, 1,400 deduplicated entries** — **⚠️ but it must be stated at the same time that "0 hits" only means no earlier entry’s text contained those three keywords; it does not mean the site held no related knowledge of the line** (**round 333’s [[aero-audit]] touches aviation but is surveillance security rather than insurance, and the log of that round already excluded it from this group**); **⚠️ the entry does not claim to cover aviation insurance in practice — it is an academic premium-fitting project, not a study of aviation policy wording, rates or underwriting**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ The provenance and permitted use of its data were not verified** — **the README says the data are 1,945 voluntarily entered policy records from a collaboration with ForeFlight**; **⚠️ its data dictionary was not read, no authorisation document from ForeFlight or the University of Southern Denmark was checked, and whether those data may be used this way was not verified**; **the entry therefore does not claim the data use is authorised, and restates no data field’s meaning**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ None of its model results were verified** — **including test MAE $1,309, RMSE $2,543, MAPE 24.30%, the ±15% figure of 41.10%, the 92.12% coverage and 1.11× width of the 90% interval, and the SHAP driver ranking**; **⚠️ no script was run, no CSV under `results/` was read, the thesis PDF was not read, and no figure was opened**. **⑤ ⚠️⭐⭐ Whether the core claim that the locked test set was used once actually holds in the code was not verified** — **⚠️ which is precisely the point that most needs testing here**: **its statement that better-performing candidates on some locked-test metrics were not used for reselection is a claim about its own behaviour, and such claims can only be supported by code or records**; **⚠️ no script under `src/` was read, its commit history was not examined, and `results/point_model_test_diagnostics.csv` was not read, so the entry does not claim the discipline was in fact kept** (**⚠️ for students doing modelling: "I did not peek at the test set" is the kind of claim that cannot be verified from the resulting numbers, only from process and evidence — and this entry does supply both a described process and retained aggregate tables, which is a comparatively strong evidentiary form, but still not verification**). **⑥ ⚠️⭐ The implementation of its conformal prediction intervals and the basis of its coverage figure were not verified** — **which of raw quantiles, conformal point methods or conformalized quantile regression was used, how grouping and ordering were handled, and whether the 92.12% coverage is computed with clustering by policy** (**⚠️ round 336’s [[inforsight]] used a clustered bootstrap and explained why; this README does not say whether its intervals handle repeated observations of the same policy — flagged here as an open item only**). **⑦ ⚠️** This check verified **the repository metadata, the README in full, and the complete list of all 76 entries** (**including 34 files under `src/` of which 20 are `rebuild_step_*` scripts, two PDFs and six images under `docs/`, the LaTeX source, bibliography and fifteen figures under `thesis/`, four CSVs plus `README.md` under `results/`, `web/premium_tool.html` and `requirements.txt`**); ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install Python, run any script, read any source, read any CSV under `results/`, read the thesis PDF or the defence presentation, open any figure, read `web/premium_tool.html`, or examine its commit history or issues**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ Its collaboration with ForeFlight, whether the thesis has been defended, and whether it is archived or published were not verified** — **⚠️ the entry does not claim the thesis has passed review, been adopted by ForeFlight, or has any commercial or regulatory effect**; ⭐ **it describes itself as a master thesis project and a research and decision-support prototype, so it is not claimed to have been used for any real quote or underwriting decision**. **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ No conclusion here is claimed to apply to the Chinese general aviation or business jet insurance market** — **no Chinese aviation policy wording, rate or regulation was consulted**; **nor is its driver ranking (hull value, gear configuration, deductible structure and so on) claimed to hold in any other market**. **⑩ ⭐ Licence measured as none (`LICENSE` 404, no licence section in the README)** — **the "no statement whatever" form**; **⚠️ the entry therefore advises confirming authorisation with the author before reusing its code, thesis source files or result tables** (**⚠️ its data section separately states that company correspondence and legal documents are excluded**). **⑪ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**. **⑫ The README is in English** — **recorded as such, and whether Danish or other language versions exist was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/LaugeSolvang/Aviation-Premium-Prediction` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field NONE, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics);
