entries.title: Amanat 天气风险矿工与 WASM 评分模块：网络自报的 verified: true 从外部无法核对，于是改为交付一份任何人用 Node 就能验的 Ed25519 签名；并逐条把「文档说的」与「实测到的」差量写出来
entries.title_en: The Amanat weather-risk miner and WASM scoring module: because the network’s own verified: true cannot be checked from outside, it ships an Ed25519 signature anyone can verify with Node instead — and writes out the measured gap between what the docs say and what the network actually does
entries.title_hk: Amanat 天氣風險礦工與 WASM 評分模組：網絡自報的 verified: true 從外部無法核對，於是改為交付一份任何人用 Node 就能驗的 Ed25519 簽名；並逐條把「文檔說的」與「實測到的」差量寫出來
entries.summary: 一个建立在 Telegraph Protocol 上的天气与风暴风险矿工，加一个编译成 WebAssembly 的评分模块，加一条以链上任务结算的参数化保险应用：其出发点是一句很硬的判断——网络自报的「已核实」从外部无法被核对，因此它改为对合约据以结算的字段逐一签名（Ed25519），并把公钥公布在 .well-known 路径下，使任何人都能用一条 Node 命令自行验证；其判词逐字为「Signed, not verified」；评分模块是一个 15.5 KB、零导入的 no_std Rust 程序，只做加减乘除与比较（IEEE-754 精确定义，故两台验证者返回完全相同的位），并从答案里读出量纲相同的数值来评分，另外两条规则承担大部分反作弊工作——问题里已经说过的数字再出现不得分，以及「押注胜过罗列」；仓库同时逐条公布自己实测到的网络现状与文档不符之处，包括评分模块比较文本而矿工回答数字、代币轨道长期闲置（341 个注册矿工对 14 个任务，其中 8 个是它自己的）、四分之三的活跃矿工无法接收任务，以及「64 中的 43 这个 BFT 门槛是主网属性、不是今天在跑的东西」
entries.summary_hk: 一個建立在 Telegraph Protocol 上的天氣與風暴風險礦工，加一個編譯成 WebAssembly 的評分模組，加一條以鏈上任務結算的參數化保險應用：其出發點是一句很硬的判斷——網絡自報的「已核實」從外部無法被核對，因此它改為對合約據以結算的字段逐一簽名（Ed25519），並把公鑰公佈在 .well-known 路徑下，使任何人都能用一條 Node 命令自行驗證；其判詞逐字為「Signed, not verified」；評分模組是一個 15.5 KB、零導入的 no_std Rust 程序，只做加減乘除與比較（IEEE-754 精確定義，故兩台驗證者返回完全相同的位），並從答案裡讀出量綱相同的數值來評分，另外兩條規則承擔大部分反作弊工作——問題裡已經說過的數字再出現不得分，以及「押注勝過羅列」；倉庫同時逐條公佈自己實測到的網絡現狀與文檔不符之處，包括評分模組比較文本而礦工回答數字、代幣軌道長期閒置（341 個註冊礦工對 14 個任務，其中 8 個是它自己的）、四分之三的活躍礦工無法接收任務，以及「64 中的 43 這個 BFT 門檻是主網屬性、不是今天在跑的東西」
entries.summary_en: A weather and storm-risk miner on Telegraph Protocol, a scoring module compiled to WebAssembly, and a parametric insurance application settled through on-chain jobs: its starting point is a hard judgement — the network’s self-reported "verified" cannot be checked from outside — so it signs the fields a contract settles on individually with Ed25519 and publishes the key at a .well-known path, letting anyone verify with a single Node command; its verdict reads verbatim as "Signed, not verified"; the scoring module is a 15.5 KB no_std Rust program with zero imports that performs only addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and comparison (exactly defined by IEEE-754, so two validators on different hosts return identical bits) and scores answers by reading same-dimension quantities out of them, with two further rules carrying most of the anti-gaming work — a number the question already stated earns nothing when it comes back, and committing beats covering; and the repository writes out its own measurements of where the network diverges from its documentation, including that scoring modules compare text while miners answer with numbers, that the on-chain rail sits idle (341 miner registrations against 14 jobs, eight of them its own), that three quarters of live miners cannot receive a job at all, and that the 43-of-64 BFT threshold is a mainnet property rather than something running today
entries.body:
**amanat-telegraph-miner**（Amanat，仓库 `PugarHuda/amanat`）**是一个建立在 Telegraph Protocol 上的**天气与风暴风险矿工**，加一个编译成 WebAssembly 的**评分模块**，加一条以链上任务结算的**参数化保险应用****：**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **MIT**（`LICENSE` 实测存在）、主语言 JavaScript、仓库体量 42,353 KB、创建于 2026-08-21、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，创建与推送均落在解冻窗口之后**）；**topics 实测为** `ai-agents`、`base-sepolia`、`erc-8183`、`mcp`、`model-context-protocol`、`openapi`、`oracle`、`parametric-insurance`、`smart-contracts`、`storm-risk`、`telegraph-protocol`、`wasm`、`weather`、`x402`；**README 实测 **48,267 字节**（英语）**；**仓库实测共 489 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「**Signed weather intelligence that a contract acts on by itself.**」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「只报别人能重算的数」**中的**第一种，也是四条里唯一**把网络自报的布尔值换成可外部重算的签名**的一条**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其开篇就是本轮主题最纯粹的表述，且它点名的是一个**具体的、别人系统里的**布尔值****——**逐字为**：**「**Signed*, not "verified": the network’s own `verified: true` **cannot be checked from outside** ([bug report](docs/bug-report.md#a-signal-commitment-that-cannot-be-re-derived)), so **every answer here carries an Ed25519 signature over the fields a contract settles on, and anyone can check it with Node and nothing else**:」**，**随后逐字给出那条命令**（**一条 `node -e` 单行，从接口取回 attestation，用 `crypto.verify` 对着它自带的公钥验 `canonical` 上的签名**）**——**并逐字补充**：**「The key it checks against is the one published at [`/.well-known/amanat.json`]」**⭐⭐⭐ **四件事合起来构成一条完整的可外包复核链**：**① 它指出网络自报的 `verified: true` **从外部不可核对**；**② 它把**合约据以结算的字段**（而不是整个响应）拿去签名；**③ 它把验签所需的一切（公钥、canonical 串、签名）都放进响应，并把公钥另公布在 `.well-known` 路径**；**④ 它把验证压缩到**一条不需要任何依赖的命令****——**⭐ 而它另有一份 `docs/bug-report.md`**（**实测存在**），**其锚点逐字为 `#a-signal-commitment-that-cannot-be-re-derived`**（**「一个无法被重新导出的信号承诺」**）**⭐⭐ 即**它不只绕过这个缺陷，还把它作为缺陷记录了下来****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其 Track 2 评分模块是全条最值得本行细读的部分，因为它把「评分」变成了一件**量纲工作****——**逐字为**：**「`scorer/` is a `no_std` Rust module compiled to `wasm32-unknown-unknown`: **15.5 KB, zero imports**, exporting `alloc`, `dealloc`, `rank_answer` and `breakdown_answer`.」**；**「It reads the *quantities* out of an answer and grades them as measurements: **`38.2 °C`, `100.8 F` and `311.35 K` are one reading**; `10 m/s` and `36 km/h` are one wind speed; **being 0.3° out is right and 30° out is wrong**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① **零导入、15.5 KB、`no_std`**——**体积与依赖被压到极小，便于作为 WASM 在任何节点上确定性执行**；**② **温度与风速的等价换算**——**「38.2 °C／100.8 F／311.35 K 是同一个读数」**——**即评分先做**单位归一化**，再判对错****（**⭐ 对本行读者：**这正是精算与工程里**最常见的静默错误**之一——**12 °C 与 12 毫米**在纯文本比较下看不出区别**，**而该仓库后文恰好点名了一个因此出错的冠军模块**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其两条反作弊规则各自针对一种**看起来像答案的东西****——**逐字为**：**「**A number the question already stated earns nothing when it comes back.** "Will it exceed 40 °C?" answered with "40 °C" is the prompt, not a reading — unless the ground truth also says 40.」**；**「**Committing beats covering.** Listing every candidate value is charged for, so **a hedged answer cannot outscore a decision**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **第一条封的是**复述问题**，第二条封的是**罗列所有可能值**（**即**押注式回答**）**——**⭐ 对做模型评测或智能体评分的同学，这两条是**很具体的反刷分设计**（**可与本站 [[insqabench]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] 并读**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其确定性来源逐字，且理由是本行会欣赏的那一类**——**逐字为**：**「Every float operation is `+ - * /` and comparison, **which IEEE-754 defines exactly, so two validators on different hosts return identical bits**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**把浮点运算限制在 IEEE-754 **精确定义**的那几种上，**从而使**两台主机上的验证者返回完全相同的位****——**⭐ 这与第 336 轮 [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] 的「金额只用整数、费率只用基点、任何地方都没有浮点数」是**同一目标的两条路径**：**那一条用整数回避浮点，这一条用**受限的浮点子集**取得确定性**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **其基准表最值得记的不是自己那一行，而是它对**赢了自己的那一行**的处理**——**逐字为**：**「The top row is the one to read first: **registration 1265, the module that took the `GAME_RESULT` slot back off us after forty minutes, beats this module on this corpus. It is a good module.** The three seated on the weather intents are not, and that is the gap this project is about.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**它主动指出**把自己挤下去的那个模块**、**称之为「一个好模块」**、**并说明被它取代的时间是「四十分钟后」****——**⭐ 对做评测的同学，这是一处**关于如何报告「我输了」的样本**；**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**这些基准数字**（**见标注 ③**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **「仓库替你做不了的那一步」逐字，且它把原因与重建方法都写了**——**逐字为**：**「**Reproducing this table needs one step the repo cannot do for you.** `scorer/champions/*.wasm` **is gitignored** — **they are other people’s binaries, some of them 25 MB** — so **a clean clone has nothing to compare against and `npm run bench` will report only our own**. Fetch them first from the `wasm_url` each registration publishes at … and drop them in `scorer/champions/`.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**干净克隆跑不出那张表，因为对手的二进制是他人的、且有的 25 MB，故不入库；**重建方法是**从每个注册公布的 `wasm_url` 自行抓取****——**⭐ 这正是本轮主题的核心形态之一：**它说清**哪些数字需要你自己动手才能重算、以及怎么做****（**⚠️ 本词条**未抓取任何 champion 二进制、未运行 `npm run bench`**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **其对自己语料的界定也有两处限定**——**逐字为**：**「**Read the rest honestly: this corpus is ours, and it says the approach works on the cases we can see, not that it wins the protocol’s own hidden fixtures.**」**；**以及**：**「**Widening the corpus from 20 cases to 38 is what found the real bugs.**」**（**随后逐条列出三个真实 bug**：**「812.4 million」被解析成 812.4 而「812.4M」解析正确**；**一个省略了数字的**正确改写**得分**低于**一个引用了该数字的**错误答案**；**以及「not a human」在 AI 检测题上被读成了负面判定**）**——**并逐字给出结论**：**「**Each of those was a wrong rule, not a missing special case.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「每一个都是**规则错了**，而不是**少了一个特例****」是一句值得单独记住的工程判断**（**⭐ 可与第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 的「六个模型五败一胜」并读：两处都在**把失败归类到正确的层级**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **「没人谈的那道门」一节揭示了评测之外的**第二道门槛**，且给了一个很具体的反差**——**逐字为**：**「**### The gate nobody talks about** — Beating the champion’s margin is not sufficient on an intent that carries traffic: **the node also checks that your module orders *real* miner answers roughly the way the champion does, and rejects below about 0.60**. **That is why a 0.68-margin module was refused on `WEB_SEARCH` while a 0.388 one went live.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**在流量意图上，**指标赢了还不够，还要与现任冠军的排序足够一致（低于约 0.60 即拒）****——**⭐ 这解释了「一个 0.68 的模块在网页搜索上被拒，而一个 0.388 的上线了」**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**该门槛阈值与其实现**）。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **其反作弊与「真实信号」的判据逐字**：**「**Anti-gaming: 14/14 attacks held.**」**；**并逐字说明最后一条为何需要第三个信号**：**「A negator flips the next verdict word inside its own clause, so "no malicious behaviour" reads positive, while "**No,** it is a phishing page" is itself the verdict because a clause break ends the negator’s reach. **An answer that commits the other way from the ground truth keeps 15% of its score, however much of the right vocabulary it carries.**」**⭐⭐ **并逐字给出这一改动**同时**带来的两个结果**：**「That closed the keyword dump (**0.84 to 0.13 against an honest 0.53**) and raised the benchmark margin at the same time, **which is the shape of a real signal rather than a patch**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「这是一个**真信号**的形状，而不是一个补丁」**——**即**判据是**关掉作弊的同时指标也上升**，**而不是**只顾一头****。**⑩ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「网络实际长什么样」一节是本条第二个主题支柱：它逐条对比**文档说的**与**实测到的****——**逐字实测**：**「**Deterministic intents are scored as if they were prose.** In epoch 240 the rank-1 miner on `WEATHER_CHECK` scored **0.0206** and on `STORM_ALERT` **0.0067**. **The miners are not bad; every scoring module on the network compares text, and those miners answer with numbers. A leaderboard built from those scores is noise — and routing follows the leaderboard.**」**；**「epochs run **hourly** on testnet, **not the 24 hours the docs describe**.」**；**「each one scores 70 results across 17 intents and **29 of the 66 registered miners** — **more than half are never scored at all**.」**；**「**There is one active validator** … so **the 43-of-64 BFT threshold is a mainnet property, not something running today**.」**；**「**The shape held; the size did not.**」****⭐⭐⭐ **四处各是一种**文档与实测的差****：**① **排名是噪声**——**因为评分比较文本、而矿工回答数字**，**而**路由跟着排名走****；**② **epoch 实际是每小时而非文档说的 24 小时**；**③ **超过一半的注册矿工从未被打分**；**④ **只有一个活跃验证者**，**故**「64 中的 43」是主网属性、不是今天在跑的****（**⭐ 第 ④ 条对本行读者尤其值得记：**一个门槛写在文档里，与它今天是否被满足，是两件事****）。**⑪ ⭐⭐ **它对**链上轨道闲置**的量化同样是自陈的，且包含对自己份额的核算**——**逐字为**：**「the Diamond … carried **139 miner registrations** against **6 ERC-8183 jobs in its entire lifetime**」**；**「Read again on 31 August: **341 miner registrations, and still only 14 jobs. Eight of the fourteen are ours. Five settled; the last three have not moved.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「十四个里有八个是我们的」是一句很少见的自我披露****——**⚠️ 且**「最后三个还没动」也一并写出****。**⑫ ⭐⭐⭐ **其第三个问题指出了一条**很具体的接入瓶颈**，并给出可复现的审计命令**——**逐字为**：**「A job hands the node raw `OnChainData` arrays; **without an `on_chain.request` block in its YAML the node cannot turn those into an HTTP call**. `npm run audit` fetches every registered YAML and checks. On 31 August: of **125 live miners, 29 declare an `on_chain` block at all**, and a name-hashable intent has between one and three job-able miners — **`STORM_ALERT` has exactly one, and it is this one**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「`STORM_ALERT` 恰好只有一个，而它就是这一个」**——**⭐ 这句话同时解释了第 337 轮 [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] 为何必须自己造矿工**（**⚠️ 本词条**未运行 `npm run audit`**）。**⑬ ⭐⭐ **其第三个主题支柱是一次**有代价的现场发现**，且同一类失败在第 337 轮出现过**——**逐字为**：**「Policy 2 was written at latitude `1` and policy 3 at `10.32`. **Both came back risk 0.382, forecast for `0.00, 0.00`.** The contract stored the coordinates correctly and passed them in `strings[0..1]`; the YAML maps them from `strings.0` and `strings.1`. **They do not survive the node’s `on_chain.request` mapping.**」**；**「On job 9 it changed the outcome. The Engine screen for Manila read risk **0.488**, above the escalation threshold; **the job opened for that same policy came back 0.361, the value for Null Island**, and the contract declined the claim. **A contract that paid a dollar for a signal acted on a reading of somewhere else.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「一个花了**一美元**买信号的合约，据以行动的却是**别处**的读数」**——**⭐ 与本轮主题相合：**一条**成功返回**的信号，其内容指向的却是另一个地方****；**⭐ 而它之所以被发现，是因为**两条不同纬度的保单返回了完全相同的值****（**即可疑之处不是任何一条单独的信号，而是**两条信号之间的一致**）。**⑭ ⭐⭐ **其两处「花一笔交易才学到的事」对本行读者也很实在**：**「`createJob` draws on the escrow of **whoever calls it** — the contract, not the wallet that deployed it」**；**以及** **「**The public Base Sepolia RPC serves its own writes back stale.** A confirmed transfer read as a zero balance, a confirmed `approve` simulated as `exceeds allowance`, and a `requestCheck` that reverted on `estimateGas` while the same call returned `jobId 7` when simulated directly one command later.」**⭐⭐⭐ **第二条指出的是一类**很值得记住的失败**：**一个权威来源（公共 RPC）把**已确认的写入**读成了旧值**——**⭐ 即**「刚写完就读」这件事本身不可靠****。**⑮ ⭐ **其复现命令逐字且分成了**花钱与不花钱两档****——**逐字含** `npm run agent:dry`（**注释逐字**「the loop, read-only, **spends nothing**」）、`npm run survey`（「the scoring board: **measured bar vs displayed score**, free」）、`npm run audit`（「**which intents an on-chain job cannot survive**, free」）、`npm run impact`（「what changed on any intent our module scores, free」）、`npm run expire`（**gas only**）、`npm run build:profiles`（**「ten binaries, **fails if any two match**」**）**⭐⭐ **其中两处值得记**：**① **「measured bar vs displayed score」**——**即**有一条免费命令专门用来对照**实测门槛**与**显示分数****（**⭐ 本轮的又一处「自报的数 vs 可重算的数」**）；**② **「十个二进制，任意两个相同即失败」**——**即**构建会验证**十个 profile 确实互不相同****。**⑯ ⭐ **另有两处可核实细节**：**其合约地址经 **Sourcify 验证**，**创建期与运行期字节码**均为完整匹配**（**README 逐字**「creation and runtime bytecode both a full match, so what the chain runs is what this repo shows」），**且**旧部署被替换而非留在原地**，**理由是逐字**「**the tests only prove the code in this repo, and a deployment running different code from the one under test is the sort of gap this project keeps finding in other people’s systems**」**；**其三个轨道**按**由便宜到贵**排序（**免费守护进程 / x402 引擎调用 0.01 美元 / 一个任务 1.00 美元**），**逐字理由为** **「the agent asks a hundred cheap questions before it asks one expensive one」**（**一次运行逐字为「42 paid Engine calls, one escalation, $1.42」**）**⭐⭐⭐ **「用与仓库同一份代码的部署」这一条尤其值得记**：**字节码级验证使**链上在跑的**与**仓库里显示的**是同一个东西****。**⑰ ⭐ 可与本站保险评测、智能体评测、参数化险与验证条目并读**：[[storm-parametric-corroboration]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[insqabench]]、[[agentbench]]、[[acteval]]、[[actuarial-math-bench]]、[[proof-protocol]]、[[reliability-harness]]、[[finproof-bench]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未读一行源码、未运行任何命令、未做任何链上或网络请求****——**故其签名方案、评分模块的 15.5 KB／零导入／量纲归一化、两条反作弊规则、确定性论述、基准表、排序一致门槛、反作弊 14/14、以及全部实测数字，**都只记录为 README 如此声明****；**⭐ entries.body_hk:
**amanat-telegraph-miner**（Amanat，倉庫 `PugarHuda/amanat`）**是一個建立在 Telegraph Protocol 上的**天氣與風暴風險礦工**，加一個編譯成 WebAssembly 的**評分模組**，加一條以鏈上任務結算的**參數化保險應用****：**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 **MIT**（`LICENSE` 實測存在）、主語言 JavaScript、體量 42,353 KB、創建於 2026-08-21、最後推送 2026-09-10**（**均落在解凍窗口之後**）；**topics 實測 14 個**（含 `parametric-insurance`、`storm-risk`、`wasm`、`x402`、`erc-8183` 等）；**README 實測 **48,267 位元組**（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 489 個條目**。**其自述逐字為**：**「**Signed weather intelligence that a contract acts on by itself.**」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「只報別人能重算的數」**中的**第一種，也是四條裡唯一**把網絡自報的布爾值換成可外部重算的簽名**的一條**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其開篇就是本輪主題最純粹的表述，且它點名的是一個**具體的、別人系統裡的**布爾值****——**逐字為**：**「**Signed*, not "verified": the network’s own `verified: true` **cannot be checked from outside**, so **every answer here carries an Ed25519 signature over the fields a contract settles on, and anyone can check it with Node and nothing else**」**，**隨後逐字給出那條 `node -e` 單行命令**（**從接口取回 attestation，用 `crypto.verify` 對著它自帶的公鑰驗 `canonical` 上的簽名**）**，**並逐字補充** **「The key it checks against is the one published at [`/.well-known/amanat.json`]」**⭐⭐⭐ **四件事合起來構成完整的可外包複核鏈**：**① 它指出網絡自報的 `verified: true` 從外部不可核對**；**② 它把**合約據以結算的字段**（而非整個響應）拿去簽名**；**③ 驗簽所需的一切都在響應裡，且公鑰另公佈在 `.well-known` 路徑**；**④ 驗證被壓縮到**一條不需要任何依賴的命令****——**⭐ 而它另有一份 `docs/bug-report.md`**（**實測存在**），**其錨點逐字為 `#a-signal-commitment-that-cannot-be-re-derived`**（**「一個無法被重新導出的信號承諾」**）**⭐⭐ 即**它不只繞過這個缺陷，還把它作為缺陷記錄了下來****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **Track 2 評分模組最值得本行細讀，因為它把「評分」變成了一件**量綱工作****——**逐字**：**「`scorer/` is a `no_std` Rust module compiled to `wasm32-unknown-unknown`: **15.5 KB, zero imports**, exporting `alloc`, `dealloc`, `rank_answer` and `breakdown_answer`.」**；**「It reads the *quantities* out of an answer and grades them as measurements: **`38.2 °C`, `100.8 F` and `311.35 K` are one reading**; `10 m/s` and `36 km/h` are one wind speed; **being 0.3° out is right and 30° out is wrong**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩處值得記**：**① **零導入、15.5 KB、`no_std`**——**體積與依賴被壓到極小，便於作為 WASM 在任何節點上確定性執行**；**② **溫度與風速的等價換算**——**即評分先做**單位歸一化**再判對錯****（**⭐ 對本行讀者：**這正是精算與工程裡**最常見的靜默錯誤**之一——**12 °C 與 12 毫米**在純文本比較下看不出區別**，而該倉庫後文恰好點名了一個因此出錯的冠軍模組**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **兩條反作弊規則各針對一種**看起來像答案的東西****——**逐字**：**「**A number the question already stated earns nothing when it comes back.** "Will it exceed 40 °C?" answered with "40 °C" is the prompt, not a reading — unless the ground truth also says 40.」**；**「**Committing beats covering.** Listing every candidate value is charged for, so **a hedged answer cannot outscore a decision**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **第一條封的是**複述問題**，第二條封的是**羅列所有可能值（押注式回答）****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其確定性來源逐字**：**「Every float operation is `+ - * /` and comparison, **which IEEE-754 defines exactly, so two validators on different hosts return identical bits**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**把浮點運算限制在 IEEE-754 精確定義的那幾種上****——**⭐ 與第 336 輪 [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] 的「金額只用整數、費率只用基點、任何地方都沒有浮點數」是**同一目標的兩條路徑**：**那條用整數迴避浮點，這條用**受限的浮點子集**取得確定性**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **其基準表最值得記的不是自己那一行，而是它對**贏了自己的那一行**的處理**——**逐字**：**「The top row is the one to read first: **registration 1265, the module that took the `GAME_RESULT` slot back off us after forty minutes, beats this module on this corpus. It is a good module.** The three seated on the weather intents are not, and that is the gap this project is about.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**它主動指出把自己擠下去的那個模組、**稱之為「一個好模組」**、**並說明取代發生在「四十分鐘後」****——**⭐ 這是一處**關於如何報告「我輸了」的樣本****。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **「倉庫替你做不了的那一步」逐字**：**「**Reproducing this table needs one step the repo cannot do for you.** `scorer/champions/*.wasm` **is gitignored** — **they are other people’s binaries, some of them 25 MB** — so **a clean clone has nothing to compare against and `npm run bench` will report only our own**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**乾淨克隆跑不出那張表，因為對手的二進制是他人的、有的 25 MB，故不入庫；**重建方法是**從每個註冊公佈的 `wasm_url` 自行抓取****——**⭐ 這正是本輪主題的核心形態之一：**它說清**哪些數字需要你自己動手才能重算、以及怎麼做****。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **其對自己語料的界定有兩處限定**：**「**Read the rest honestly: this corpus is ours, and it says the approach works on the cases we can see, not that it wins the protocol’s own hidden fixtures.**」**；**「**Widening the corpus from 20 cases to 38 is what found the real bugs.**」**（**隨後逐條列出三個真實 bug**：**「812.4 million」被解析成 812.4 而「812.4M」解析正確**；**一個省略了數字的**正確改寫**得分**低於**一個引用了該數字的**錯誤答案**；**「not a human」在 AI 檢測題上被讀成負面判定**）**——**並逐字給出結論**：**「**Each of those was a wrong rule, not a missing special case.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「每一個都是**規則錯了**，而不是**少了一個特例****」值得單獨記住**（**⭐ 可與第 336 輪 [[inforsight]] 的「六個模型五敗一勝」並讀：兩處都在**把失敗歸類到正確的層級**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **「沒人談的那道門」揭示了評測之外的**第二道門檻****——**逐字**：**「**### The gate nobody talks about** — Beating the champion’s margin is not sufficient on an intent that carries traffic: **the node also checks that your module orders *real* miner answers roughly the way the champion does, and rejects below about 0.60**. **That is why a 0.68-margin module was refused on `WEB_SEARCH` while a 0.388 one went live.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **即在流量意圖上，指標贏了還不夠，還要與現任冠軍的排序足夠一致（低於約 0.60 即拒）****。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **反作弊與「真實信號」的判據逐字**：**「**Anti-gaming: 14/14 attacks held.**」**；**「A negator flips the next verdict word inside its own clause … **An answer that commits the other way from the ground truth keeps 15% of its score, however much of the right vocabulary it carries.**」**；**「That closed the keyword dump (**0.84 to 0.13 against an honest 0.53**) and raised the benchmark margin at the same time, **which is the shape of a real signal rather than a patch**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「這是一個**真信號**的形狀，而不是一個補丁」——**即**判據是**關掉作弊的同時指標也上升****。**⑩ ⭐⭐⭐ **「網絡實際長什麼樣」是本條第二個主題支柱：逐條對比**文檔說的**與**實測到的****——**逐字實測**：**「**Deterministic intents are scored as if they were prose.** In epoch 240 the rank-1 miner on `WEATHER_CHECK` scored **0.0206** and on `STORM_ALERT` **0.0067**. **The miners are not bad; every scoring module on the network compares text, and those miners answer with numbers. A leaderboard built from those scores is noise — and routing follows the leaderboard.**」**；**「epochs run **hourly** on testnet, **not the 24 hours the docs describe**.」**；**「each one scores 70 results across 17 intents and **29 of the 66 registered miners** — **more than half are never scored at all**.」**；**「**There is one active validator** … so **the 43-of-64 BFT threshold is a mainnet property, not something running today**.」**；**「**The shape held; the size did not.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處各是一種**文檔與實測的差****：**① 排名是噪聲（評分比較文本、礦工回答數字，而路由跟著排名走）**；**② epoch 實際每小時而非文檔說的 24 小時**；**③ 超過一半註冊礦工從未被打分**；**④ 只有一個活躍驗證者，故「64 中的 43」是主網屬性、不是今天在跑的****（**⭐ 第 ④ 條尤其值得記：**一個門檻寫在文檔裡，與它今天是否被滿足，是兩件事****）。**⑪ ⭐⭐ **對**鏈上軌道閒置**的量化同樣自陳，且包含對自己份額的核算**：**「the Diamond … carried **139 miner registrations** against **6 ERC-8183 jobs in its entire lifetime**」**；**「Read again on 31 August: **341 miner registrations, and still only 14 jobs. Eight of the fourteen are ours. Five settled; the last three have not moved.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「十四個裡有八個是我們的」是一句很少見的自我披露****（**⚠️ 且「最後三個還沒動」也一併寫出**）。**⑫ ⭐⭐⭐ **第三個問題指出一條**具體的接入瓶頸**並給出可複現的審計命令**：**「without an `on_chain.request` block in its YAML the node cannot turn those into an HTTP call. `npm run audit` fetches every registered YAML and checks. On 31 August: of **125 live miners, 29 declare an `on_chain` block at all** … **`STORM_ALERT` has exactly one, and it is this one**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「`STORM_ALERT` 恰好只有一個，而它就是這一個」**——**⭐ 這句話同時解釋了第 337 輪 [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] 為何必須自己造礦工**（**⚠️ 未運行 `npm run audit`**）。**⑬ ⭐⭐ **第三個支柱是一次**有代價的現場發現**，且同類失敗在第 337 輪出現過**：**「Policy 2 was written at latitude `1` and policy 3 at `10.32`. **Both came back risk 0.382, forecast for `0.00, 0.00`.** … **They do not survive the node’s `on_chain.request` mapping.**」**；**「On job 9 it changed the outcome. The Engine screen for Manila read risk **0.488** … **the job opened for that same policy came back 0.361, the value for Null Island**, and the contract declined the claim. **A contract that paid a dollar for a signal acted on a reading of somewhere else.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「一個花了**一美元**買信號的合約，據以行動的卻是**別處**的讀數」**——**⭐ 而它之所以被發現，是因為**兩條不同緯度的保單返回了完全相同的值****（**即可疑之處不是任何一條單獨的信號，而是**兩條信號之間的一致**）。**⑭ ⭐⭐ **兩處「花一筆交易才學到的事」**：**「`createJob` draws on the escrow of **whoever calls it** — the contract, not the wallet that deployed it」**；**「**The public Base Sepolia RPC serves its own writes back stale.** A confirmed transfer read as a zero balance, a confirmed `approve` simulated as `exceeds allowance` …」**⭐⭐⭐ **第二條指出的是一類值得記住的失敗：**一個權威來源把**已確認的寫入**讀成了舊值****。**⑮ ⭐ **復現命令分成**花錢與不花錢兩檔****——**逐字含** `npm run agent:dry`（**「the loop, read-only, **spends nothing**」**）、`npm run survey`（**「the scoring board: **measured bar vs displayed score**, free」**）、`npm run audit`（**「**which intents an on-chain job cannot survive**, free」**）、`npm run impact`、`npm run expire`（**gas only**）、`npm run build:profiles`（**「ten binaries, **fails if any two match**」**）**⭐⭐ **兩處值得記**：**① **「measured bar vs displayed score」**——**即**有一條免費命令專門用來對照**實測門檻**與**顯示分數****（**⭐ 又一處「自報的數 vs 可重算的數」**）；**② **「十個二進制，任意兩個相同即失敗」**——**即**構建會驗證**十個 profile 確實互不相同****。**⑯ ⭐ **另兩處細節**：**其合約經 **Sourcify 驗證**，**創建期與運行期字節碼**均為完整匹配**（**逐字**「creation and runtime bytecode both a full match, **so what the chain runs is what this repo shows**」），**且**舊部署被替換而非留在原地**，**理由是**「**the tests only prove the code in this repo, and a deployment running different code from the one under test is the sort of gap this project keeps finding in other people’s systems**」**；**其三個軌道按**由便宜到貴**排序（**免費守護進程／x402 引擎調用 0.01 美元／一個任務 1.00 美元**），**逐字理由**「the agent asks a hundred cheap questions before it asks one expensive one」**（**一次運行逐字為「42 paid Engine calls, one escalation, $1.42」**）**⭐⭐⭐ **amanat-telegraph-miner** (Amanat, repository `PugarHuda/amanat`) **is a weather and storm-risk miner on Telegraph Protocol, plus a scoring module compiled to WebAssembly and a parametric insurance application settled through on-chain jobs**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **MIT** (`LICENSE` measured present), JavaScript as the primary language, a 42,353 KB repository, created 2026-08-21 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, both after the thaw window**); **14 topics measured**, including `parametric-insurance`, `storm-risk`, `wasm`, `x402` and `erc-8183`; **the README measures **48,267 bytes** and is in English**; **the repository measures 489 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"**Signed weather intelligence that a contract acts on by itself.**"** It is the first of this round’s four takes on **reporting only numbers someone else can recompute**, **and the only one that replaces a self-reported boolean with a signature an outsider can check**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its opening is the purest statement of this round’s theme, and it names a specific boolean in somebody else’s system** — **verbatim**: **"**Signed*, not "verified": the network’s own `verified: true` **cannot be checked from outside**, so **every answer here carries an Ed25519 signature over the fields a contract settles on, and anyone can check it with Node and nothing else**"**, **followed verbatim by that one-line `node -e` command** (**fetching the attestation and using `crypto.verify` against the public key carried in it**), **and by** **"The key it checks against is the one published at [`/.well-known/amanat.json`]"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things together form a complete, outsourceable verification chain**: **it points out that the network’s `verified: true` cannot be checked from outside**; **it signs the fields a contract settles on rather than the whole response**; **everything needed to verify travels in the response, with the key also published at a .well-known path**; **and verification is compressed into one command needing no dependencies** — ⭐ **and a `docs/bug-report.md` also exists** (**measurably present**), **whose anchor reads verbatim `#a-signal-commitment-that-cannot-be-re-derived`** ⭐⭐ **so it does not merely route around the defect, it records it as a defect**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Track 2, the scoring module, is the part this field should read most closely, because it turns scoring into dimensional work** — **verbatim**: **"`scorer/` is a `no_std` Rust module compiled to `wasm32-unknown-unknown`: **15.5 KB, zero imports**, exporting `alloc`, `dealloc`, `rank_answer` and `breakdown_answer`."**; **"It reads the *quantities* out of an answer and grades them as measurements: **`38.2 °C`, `100.8 F` and `311.35 K` are one reading**; `10 m/s` and `36 km/h` are one wind speed; **being 0.3° out is right and 30° out is wrong**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Two things worth noting**: **zero imports, 15.5 KB and `no_std` keep size and dependencies minimal so the WASM executes deterministically on any node**; **and the temperature and wind-speed equivalences mean scoring normalises units before judging** — ⭐ **and this is one of the most common silent errors in this field: "12 °C" and "12 millimetres" are indistinguishable under plain text comparison, and the repository later names a champion module that fails on exactly that**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its two anti-gaming rules each close off something that looks like an answer** — **verbatim**: **"**A number the question already stated earns nothing when it comes back.** "Will it exceed 40 °C?" answered with "40 °C" is the prompt, not a reading — unless the ground truth also says 40."**; **"**Committing beats covering.** Listing every candidate value is charged for, so **a hedged answer cannot outscore a decision**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **the first closes off restating the question, the second closes off listing every possible value**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its source of determinism is verbatim**: **"Every float operation is `+ - * /` and comparison, **which IEEE-754 defines exactly, so two validators on different hosts return identical bits**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **floating-point operations are restricted to those IEEE-754 defines exactly** — ⭐ **the same goal as round 336’s [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] (integer minor units, basis points, no floats anywhere), reached by the opposite route: there integers avoid floating point, here a restricted floating-point subset buys determinism**. **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ The most notable row of its benchmark table is not its own, but how it treats the row that beat it** — **verbatim**: **"The top row is the one to read first: **registration 1265, the module that took the `GAME_RESULT` slot back off us after forty minutes, beats this module on this corpus. It is a good module.** The three seated on the weather intents are not, and that is the gap this project is about."** ⭐⭐⭐ **it names the module that displaced it, calls it a good module, and records that the displacement took forty minutes** — ⭐ **a sample of how to report losing**. **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ "The step the repo cannot do for you" is verbatim**: **"**Reproducing this table needs one step the repo cannot do for you.** `scorer/champions/*.wasm` **is gitignored** — **they are other people’s binaries, some of them 25 MB** — so **a clean clone has nothing to compare against and `npm run bench` will report only our own**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **a clean clone cannot reproduce that table, because the opponents’ binaries are other people’s and some are 25 MB, so they are not committed; reconstruction is to fetch them from the `wasm_url` each registration publishes** — ⭐ **the core shape of this round’s theme: it states which numbers require your own work to recompute, and how**. **⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ Two qualifiers on its own corpus are verbatim**: **"**Read the rest honestly: this corpus is ours, and it says the approach works on the cases we can see, not that it wins the protocol’s own hidden fixtures.**"**; **"**Widening the corpus from 20 cases to 38 is what found the real bugs.**"** (**followed by three real bugs: "812.4 million" parsed as 812.4 while "812.4M" parsed correctly; a correct paraphrase omitting a figure scoring below a wrong answer that quoted it; and "not a human" read as a negative verdict on an AI-detection question**), **concluding verbatim**: **"**Each of those was a wrong rule, not a missing special case.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **"each of those was a wrong rule, not a missing special case" is worth remembering separately** (**⭐ readable with round 336’s [[inforsight]] and its six generations, five failures and one success: both classify failure at the right level**). **⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ Its "gate nobody talks about" reveals a second threshold beyond the metric** — **verbatim**: **"**### The gate nobody talks about** — Beating the champion’s margin is not sufficient on an intent that carries traffic: **the node also checks that your module orders *real* miner answers roughly the way the champion does, and rejects below about 0.60**. **That is why a 0.68-margin module was refused on `WEB_SEARCH` while a 0.388 one went live.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **on a traffic-carrying intent, winning on the metric is not enough; rank agreement with the incumbent champion must also hold, with roughly 0.60 as the floor**. **⑨ ⭐⭐ Its anti-gaming result and its criterion for a real signal are verbatim**: **"**Anti-gaming: 14/14 attacks held.**"**; **an answer committing the other way from the ground truth keeps 15% of its score however much right vocabulary it carries**; **"That closed the keyword dump (**0.84 to 0.13 against an honest 0.53**) and raised the benchmark margin at the same time, **which is the shape of a real signal rather than a patch**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **the criterion is that closing the exploit also raised the metric — not one at the expense of the other**. **⑩ ⭐⭐⭐ "What the network actually looks like" is the entry’s second pillar: it sets what the docs say against what was measured** — **verbatim**: **"**Deterministic intents are scored as if they were prose.** In epoch 240 the rank-1 miner on `WEATHER_CHECK` scored **0.0206** and on `STORM_ALERT` **0.0067**. **The miners are not bad; every scoring module on the network compares text, and those miners answer with numbers. A leaderboard built from those scores is noise — and routing follows the leaderboard.**"**; **"epochs run **hourly** on testnet, **not the 24 hours the docs describe**."**; **"each one scores 70 results across 17 intents and **29 of the 66 registered miners** — **more than half are never scored at all**."**; **"**There is one active validator** … so **the 43-of-64 BFT threshold is a mainnet property, not something running today**."**; **"**The shape held; the size did not.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four documented-versus-measured gaps**: **the ranking is noise because scoring compares text while miners answer with numbers, and routing follows the ranking**; **epochs actually run hourly rather than the documented 24 hours**; **more than half of registered miners are never scored**; **there is one active validator, so the 43-of-64 threshold is a mainnet property rather than something running today** (**⭐ especially worth remembering: a threshold written in documentation and a threshold satisfied today are two different things**). **⑪ ⭐⭐ Its quantification of the idle on-chain rail is likewise self-reported and includes its own share** — **verbatim**: **"the Diamond … carried **139 miner registrations** against **6 ERC-8183 jobs in its entire lifetime**"**; **"Read again on 31 August: **341 miner registrations, and still only 14 jobs. Eight of the fourteen are ours. Five settled; the last three have not moved.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **"eight of the fourteen are ours" is a rare self-disclosure** (**⚠️ together with "the last three have not moved"**). **⑫ ⭐⭐⭐ Its third problem names a concrete onboarding bottleneck and ships a reproducible audit command** — **verbatim**: **"without an `on_chain.request` block in its YAML the node cannot turn those into an HTTP call. `npm run audit` fetches every registered YAML and checks. On 31 August: of **125 live miners, 29 declare an `on_chain` block at all** … **`STORM_ALERT` has exactly one, and it is this one**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **"`STORM_ALERT` has exactly one, and it is this one" also explains why round 337’s [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] had to build its own miner**. **⑬ ⭐⭐ Its third pillar is a costly field finding of the same class as round 337’s** — **verbatim**: **"Policy 2 was written at latitude `1` and policy 3 at `10.32`. **Both came back risk 0.382, forecast for `0.00, 0.00`.** … **They do not survive the node’s `on_chain.request` mapping.**"**; **"On job 9 it changed the outcome. The Engine screen for Manila read risk **0.488** … **the job opened for that same policy came back 0.361, the value for Null Island**, and the contract declined the claim. **A contract that paid a dollar for a signal acted on a reading of somewhere else.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **a contract that paid a dollar for a signal acted on a reading of somewhere else** — ⭐ **and it was caught because two policies at different latitudes returned identical values: the suspicion came not from any single signal but from agreement between two**. **⑭ ⭐⭐ Two things that cost a transaction to learn**: **"`createJob` draws on the escrow of **whoever calls it** — the contract, not the wallet that deployed it"**; **"**The public Base Sepolia RPC serves its own writes back stale.** A confirmed transfer read as a zero balance, a confirmed `approve` simulated as `exceeds allowance` …"** ⭐⭐⭐ **the second names a class worth remembering: an authoritative source reads back a confirmed write as stale**. **⑮ ⭐ Its reproduction commands split into spending and non-spending tiers** — **verbatim including** `npm run agent:dry` (**"the loop, read-only, **spends nothing**"**), `npm run survey` (**"the scoring board: **measured bar vs displayed score**, free"**), `npm run audit` (**"**which intents an on-chain job cannot survive**, free"**), `npm run impact`, `npm run expire` (**gas only**) and `npm run build:profiles` (**"ten binaries, **fails if any two match**"**) ⭐⭐ **Two things worth noting**: **"measured bar vs displayed score" is a free command specifically for comparing the measured threshold against the displayed score — another instance of self-reported versus recomputable**; **and the build verifies that ten profile binaries really do differ**. **⑯ ⭐ Two further details**: **its contract is verified on **Sourcify**, with creation and runtime bytecode both a full match** (**verbatim "so what the chain runs is what this repo shows"**), **and the previous deployment was replaced rather than left in place** because **"the tests only prove the code in this repo, and a deployment running different code from the one under test is the sort of gap this project keeps finding in other people’s systems"**; **and its three rails are ordered cheapest first** (**a free daemon feed, a $0.01 x402 Engine call and a $1.00 job**), verbatim because **"the agent asks a hundred cheap questions before it asks one expensive one"** (**one run reads verbatim "42 paid Engine calls, one escalation, $1.42"**) ⭐⭐⭐ **bytecode-level verification makes what the chain runs and what the repository shows the same thing**. **⑰ ⭐ Readable with the site’s insurance-benchmark, agent-evaluation, parametric and verification entries**: [[storm-parametric-corroboration]], [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]], [[insqabench]], [[agentbench]], [[acteval]], [[actuarial-math-bench]], [[proof-protocol]], [[reliability-harness]], [[finproof-bench]], [[aegis-parametric]], [[parametric-insurance-demo]] and [[parametric-risk-toolkit]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Not one line of source was read, no command was run, and no network or on-chain request was made** — **so the signature scheme, the scoring module’s three characteristics, the two anti-gaming rules, the determinism argument, the benchmark table, the rank-agreement threshold, the 14/14 anti-gaming result and every measured figure are recorded only as the README states them**; ⭐ **what this check measured is that the file each mechanism corresponds to exists** (**`LICENSE`, `docs/bug-report.md`, 22 scripts under `agent/` including `audit-jobable.mjs`, `survey.mjs`, `impact.mjs`, `crosscheck.mjs` and `verify.mjs`, `miner/`, `scorer/`, `onchain/`, `mcp/` with its `README.md`, `package.json`, `server.mjs` and `test.mjs`, and `app/`**) — **⚠️ but a file existing does not mean the logic and numbers inside it are as documented**; **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **② ⚠️⚠️ Whether that Node verification command currently works was not verified** — **`amanat-miner.vercel.app` was not visited, `/.well-known/amanat.json` was not requested, no attestation was fetched and no signature was verified**; **the entry therefore does not claim that its "anyone can check it with Node" holds at the present moment** (**⚠️ that claim can only be supported by executing it from outside**). **③ ⚠️⚠️ None of its benchmark numbers were verified** (**including the 0.5977 margin, the 37/38 wins and the nine-module comparison**); **no champion binary was fetched and `npm run bench`, `npm run attacks` and `cargo test` were not run**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ No on-chain verification was performed** — **Base Sepolia was not visited, its contract address was not looked up, no transaction was read, the 341 registrations against 14 jobs and the eight that are its own were not verified, and the settlement state of jobs 7 to 10 was not verified**; **the entry does not claim the application has really run or paid out on any policy**. **⑤ ⚠️⭐ The measurements in its "what the network actually looks like" section were not verified** (**including epoch 240’s 0.0206 and 0.0067, epochs running hourly, 29 of 66 registered miners being scored, a single active validator, and 29 of 125 live miners declaring an `on_chain` block**); **its `/api/epochs`, `/api/validators` and `/api/jobable` endpoints were not requested, the Diamond was not read, and `npm run audit` and `npm run survey` were not run**. **⑥ ⚠️⭐ The contents of `docs/bug-report.md` were not verified** — **⚠️ only its existence and the anchor quoted in the README were checked, not its body**; **so no argument, reproduction step or communication status from that bug report is restated**. **⑦ ⚠️⭐ Its Sourcify verification and the "bytecode full match" claim were not verified** (**neither Sourcify nor any block explorer was visited**), **nor the general judgement behind replacing the previous deployment**. **⑧ ⚠️** This check verified **the repository metadata, the README in full, and the complete list of all 489 entries**; **the README’s opening, its three problems, the Track 1/2/3 sections, "the gate nobody talks about", the on-chain progress, both costly findings, the miner and scoring-module comparison, and the reproduction command list were read in detail**; ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install Node, Rust or Foundry, run any script, make any network or on-chain request, read any source, read any file under `docs/`, read the MCP or app READMEs, hit any `/api/` endpoint, or visit its site or any block explorer**. **⑨ ⚠️ Its relationship to Telegraph Protocol, any hackathon organiser or any institution was not verified**, **nor whether it won an award, was adopted, or whether its MCP server is really in the official registry**; **the entry does not claim the project has been adopted by any institution, is live providing any insurance cover, or has produced any real payout**. **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ Whether "parametric insurance" holds as a description in legal or regulatory terms was not verified** (**the application runs on a testnet with test tokens**), **and the entry does not claim it constitutes an insurance contract or a regulated product in any jurisdiction**. **⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ The entry does not claim its scoring approach applies to any specific scoring task in a reader’s own setting**; **it records the design and the stated reasoning**. **⑫ ⭐ At ★0, 0 forks, created 2026-08-21 and pushed 2026-09-10**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**. **⑬ ⭐ 14 topics measured**. **⑭ The README is in English** — **recorded as such, and whether other language versions exist was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/PugarHuda/amanat` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field MIT, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and 14 topics); the 48,267-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; **all 489 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com`; **nothing was cloned, no Node, Rust or Foundry was installed, no command was run, no network or on-chain request was made, no source or document content was read, and neither its site, its `/.well-known` path nor any block explorer was visited**.

entries.title: Ballast 链上参数化下跌保障：明说「它卖的是参数化保险，不是对冲」，并自己列出两侧都赔不准的基差风险表；界面永远显示**实际达成**的保本点，而不是你要求的那个
entries.title_en: Ballast, on-chain parametric downside cover: it states plainly that it sells parametric cover rather than a hedge, publishes its own basis-risk table showing it over- and under-compensates on either side, and its interface always shows the make-whole point actually achieved rather than the one requested
entries.title_hk: Ballast 鏈上參數化下跌保障：明說「它賣的是參數化保險，不是對沖」，並自己列出兩側都賠不準的基差風險表；界面永遠顯示**實際達成**的保本點，而不是你要求的那個
entries.summary: 一个在链上自动为加密资产买入下行保障的产品：用户存入一次抵押品并说出想覆盖多深的跌幅，之后每个交易窗口自动买入一份固定赔付款；其技术要点是「场所自身的事件就是触发器」——市场创建事件一触发，其处理函数在同一个区块内运行，因此产品不需要任何运营方、定时任务或自建守护进程；文档最值得记的是它对自身性质的界定：事件合约是每窗口一个执行价的平值二元合约，因此**没有任何数量的下行合约能拼出一条平直的净损益线**，它明确不主张这一点，而是把自己称为参数化保障，并逐格列出跌幅 1%／2.5%／5% 三种情形下现货损失、保障赔付与净额的对照（+75 过度补偿／0 保本点／−125 补偿不足）；它把两侧的差额称为基差风险，并说这不是要工程掉的缺陷而是你买到的东西；因此界面上永远显示**实际达成**的保本点而不是你要求的那个；仓库另有一份给平台方的反馈文档与一份运行记录
entries.summary_hk: 一個在鏈上自動為加密資產買入下行保障的產品：用戶存入一次抵押品並說出想覆蓋多深的跌幅，之後每個交易窗口自動買入一份固定賠付款；其技術要點是「場所自身的事件就是觸發器」——市場創建事件一觸發，其處理函數在同一個區塊內運行，因此產品不需要任何運營方、定時任務或自建守護進程；文檔最值得記的是它對自身性質的界定：事件合約是每窗口一個執行價的平值二元合約，因此**沒有任何數量的下行合約能拼出一條平直的淨損益線**，它明確不主張這一點，而是把自己稱為參數化保障，並逐格列出跌幅 1%／2.5%／5% 三種情形下現貨損失、保障賠付與淨額的對照（+75 過度補償／0 保本點／−125 補償不足）；它把兩側的差額稱為基差風險，並說這不是要工程掉的缺陷而是你買到的東西；因此界面上永遠顯示**實際達成**的保本點而不是你要求的那個；倉庫另有一份給平台方的反饋文檔與一份運行記錄
entries.summary_en: A product that automatically buys downside cover for crypto on-chain: a user deposits collateral once and states how deep a fall to cover, and thereafter each trading window automatically buys a fixed payout; its technical point is that the venue’s own event is the trigger — when the market-creation event fires its handler runs in the same block, so the product needs no operator, no cron and nothing of its own running; the most notable part of its documentation is how it defines its own nature: Event Contracts are at-the-money binaries with one strike per window, so no quantity of Down contracts produces a flat net line, and it explicitly does not claim one — instead it calls itself parametric cover and lays out a table of spot loss, cover paid and net for falls of 1%, 2.5% and 5% (+75 over-compensated, 0 at the make-whole point, −125 under-compensated); it calls the gap either side basis risk and says it is not a defect to be engineered away but what you are buying; consequently its interface always shows the make-whole point actually achieved rather than the one requested; and the repository also carries a feedback document to the platform and a run record
entries.body:
**ballast-parametric-cover**（Ballast，仓库 `Jagadeeshftw/ballast`）**是一个在链上自动为加密资产买入下行保障的产品**：**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **MIT**（`LICENSE` 实测存在）、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 1,714 KB、创建于 2026-09-01、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，创建与推送均落在解冻窗口之后**）；**topics 实测为** `defi`、`dreamdex`、`event-contracts`、`foundry`、`parametric-insurance`、`prediction-markets`、`reactivity`、`solidity`、`somnia`；**README 实测 20,374 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 192 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「**Ballast buys downside cover for your crypto automatically — a small, fixed payout that lands if the price falls, bought fresh every trading window.** You deposit collateral once and say how deep a fall you want covered; **the chain does the rest, with no keeper, no cron and nothing of ours running.**」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「只报别人能重算的数」**中的**第二种，也是四条里唯一**把「我到底卖的是什么」以及**它的误差范围**同时公开**的一条**。

可核实信息（**均 README 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其最值得记的一节标题本身就是一句拒绝模糊化的话**——**逐字为**：**「## It sells parametric cover, not a hedge — **This distinction is the whole product and the README will not blur it.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「这个区别就是整个产品，而 README 不会把它模糊掉」**——**⭐ 这句话在结构上与本轮主题相合：**它拒绝用一个更好听的名字（对冲）来掩盖自己实际交付的东西（参数化保障）****。**其理由逐字给出，且理由本身是一条**可核实的市场结构事实****：**「Event Contracts are **at-the-money binaries**: one strike per window, struck at the window’s opening price, paying a fixed 1 collateral unit per winning contract. **There is no strike ladder — 562 markets checked, at most one strike per venue per window.** So **no quantity of Down contracts produces a flat net line, and Ballast does not claim one.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① 「**562 个市场逐一看过，每个场所每个窗口至多一个执行价**」**——**即**这不是推测，而是**数出来的**（**⭐ 与第 337 轮 [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] 的「12 个地点、24 次调用」同属**先测后说**）；**② **没有执行价阶梯**，**故**没有任何数量的下行合约能拼出一条平直的净损益线**；**③ 「**and Ballast does not claim one**」**——**即**它不去主张一个自己做不到的性质****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其基差风险表是本条最值得借用的一处：它把自己**赔不准的地方**逐格列出来**——**逐字为**：**「| ETH falls | Spot loss | Cover pays | Net |」**：**1% | −$50 | +$125 | **+$75 — over-compensated**」**；**「2.5% | −$125 | +$125 | **$0 — the make-whole point**」**；**「5% | −$250 | +$125 | **−$125 — under-compensated**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三行各说一件事**：**跌得浅**过度补偿**、**在保本点上**刚好抵消**、**跌得深**补偿不足****——**⭐ 对做产品的同学，这是一张**把「我什么时候帮不上忙」摆在最前面**的表**（**本站在第 330／331 轮已记录过「把假设与检验边界写成明文」的同族做法，而**这张表的不同之处在于它会计量的是**结果对客户的偏差****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它对「基差风险」这一定性的表述逐字，且明确说这不是要工程掉的东西**——**逐字为**：**「The gap either side is **basis risk**, and it is **the defining property of parametric cover** — the same trade flight-delay insurance makes, paying the same amount whether you missed a meeting or a wedding. **It is not a defect to be engineered away here; it is what you are **ballast-parametric-cover**（Ballast，倉庫 `Jagadeeshftw/ballast`）**是一個在鏈上自動為加密資產買入下行保障的產品**：**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 **MIT**（`LICENSE` 實測存在）、主語言 TypeScript、體量 1,714 KB、創建於 2026-09-01、最後推送 2026-09-10**（**均落在解凍窗口之後**）；**topics 實測 9 個**（含 `defi`、`event-contracts`、`parametric-insurance`、`prediction-markets`、`reactivity`、`somnia`）；**README 實測 20,374 位元組（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 192 個條目**。**其自述逐字為**：**「**Ballast buys downside cover for your crypto automatically … the chain does the rest, with no keeper, no cron and nothing of ours running.**」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「只報別人能重算的數」**中的**第二種，也是四條裡唯一**把「我到底賣的是什麼」以及**它的誤差範圍**同時公開**的一條**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其最值得記的一節標題本身就是一句拒絕模糊化的話**——**逐字為**：**「## It sells parametric cover, not a hedge — **This distinction is the whole product and the README will not blur it.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「這個區別就是整個產品，而 README 不會把它模糊掉」**——**⭐ 在結構上與本輪主題相合：**它拒絕用一個更好聽的名字（對沖）來掩蓋自己實際交付的東西（參數化保障）****。**其理由逐字給出，且理由本身是一條**可核實的市場結構事實****：**「Event Contracts are **at-the-money binaries**: one strike per window … **There is no strike ladder — 562 markets checked, at most one strike per venue per window.** So **no quantity of Down contracts produces a flat net line, and Ballast does not claim one.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① 「**562 個市場逐一看過，每個場所每個窗口至多一個執行價**」——**即**這不是推測，而是**數出來的****；**② **沒有執行價階梯**，**故**沒有任何數量的下行合約能拼出平直的淨損益線**；**③ 「**and Ballast does not claim one**」——**即**它不去主張一個自己做不到的性質****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其基差風險表把自己**賠不準的地方**逐格列出**——**逐字為**：**ETH 跌 1% | 現貨損失 −$50 | 保障賠付 +$125 | 淨額 **+$75 過度補償****；**跌 2.5% | −$125 | +$125 | **$0 保本點****；**跌 5% | −$250 | +$125 | **−$125 補償不足****⭐⭐⭐ **三行各說一件事：跌得淺過度補償、在保本點上剛好抵消、跌得深補償不足****——**⭐ 對做產品的同學，這是一張**把「我什麼時候幫不上忙」擺在最前面**的表**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它對「基差風險」的定性逐字，且明確說這不是要工程掉的東西**：**「The gap either side is **basis risk**, and it is **the defining property of parametric cover** — the same trade flight-delay insurance makes, paying the same amount whether you missed a meeting or a wedding. **It is not a defect to be engineered away here; it is what you are buying.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「這不是一個要在這裡被工程掉的缺陷；它就是你所購買的東西」**——**⭐ 本條對保險讀者最有價值的一句**：**它把一個通常被當作**缺點**來解釋的性質，明確改述為一個**產品定義****；**並**用航班延誤險作類比**——**⭐ 這正是**參數化（指數）保險與傳統 indemnity 保險的核心分野****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其界面的一處設計決定是本條的**核心機制****——**逐字**：**「which is why **the UI always shows the make-whole point it *achieved*, never the one you asked for, whenever liquidity bound the size**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**當流動性限制了規模時，界面顯示的是**實際達成**的保本點，而不是用戶要求的那個****——**⭐ 與第 337 輪 [[insurance-qa-evidence]] 的「被機器人攔截的外部結果不算作已確認的死鏈」、第 336 輪 [[inforsight]] 的「校準斜率帶事先聲明的治理帶」屬同一族紀律：**交付的是**實際值**，不是**目標值****。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其規模公式逐字公開，且含一個**讀回來的實際值****：**「Sizing: `N = exposure × x* / (1 − q)`, premium `N·q`, and **the achieved point read back as `qty·(1−q)·10000 / exposureAtOpen`**.」**⭐⭐ **即**「實際達成的保本點」是**從成交結果反算回來的**，而不是把用戶輸入原樣回顯****。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **其技術要點「場所自身的事件就是觸發器」逐字**：**「the venue’s own event is the trigger. **`MarketCreated` fires, and Ballast’s handler runs in the same block**, so **the product needs no operator at all**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**處理函數與市場創建事件**在同一個區塊內**運行，**故**不需要守護進程、定時任務或人工操作****（**可與第 337 輪 [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] 的「GitHub 的 cron 是盡力而為、實際每 2–5 小時而非 15 分鐘」並讀：**兩者都在處理**「誰來定時觸發」**這一層**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其「為什麼一個對沖產品會出現在預測市場黑客松」一節把**類別歸屬**也講明**：**「**None of the published categories is risk management, so the frame is worth stating outright.**」**；**「Almost everything built on such a primitive is a way to *take* a view. **Ballast is the opposite — it is a consumer of the primitive that is not a bet.**」**⭐⭐ **即**它先承認公開的賽道裡沒有風險管理這一類，**再把理由寫出來****。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **其鏈上部署與文檔結構實測可查**：**README 逐字列出五個合約地址**（**BallastVault、HedgeEngine、SpotExposureSource、Collateral（tUSDC，6 位小數）、dreamDEX 二元模組**）**並給出鏈 ID 與 RPC**；**實測倉庫含 `foundry.toml` 與 `foundry.lock`、`package.json`、`assets/ballast_logo.png`，以及 `docs/` 下十份文檔**——逐名為 `go-live.md`、`instrument-economics.md`、`latch-sweep.md`、`onchain-lifecycle.md`、`phase0-dashboard.md`、**`phase0-findings.md`**、**`run-record.json`**、**`somnia-feedback.md`**、`tailwind-migration-estimate.md`、`video-script.md`**⭐⭐ **其中三份值得單獨記**：**`instrument-economics.md`（工具本身的定價與經濟性）**、**`phase0-findings.md`（第 0 階段的發現）**、**⭐ **`somnia-feedback.md`（給平台方的一份反饋文檔）****——**⭐ 與第 337 輪 [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] 把調度問題歸因到平台同屬一種做法：**把問題交回給上游，而不是自己吞下****；**另有 `run-record.json`（一份運行記錄）**。**⑨ ⭐ 可與 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **本條目需要先說清：**這不是一份保險合同****——**⚠️ 它運行在測試網上，**topics 含 `defi`／`prediction-markets`／`event-contracts`**，**其標的是**加密資產的價格**；**⭐ 收錄理由是**它把**參數化保障的基差風險**寫得比本站已收的多數條目更清楚**（**Basis risk 正是參數化／指數保險的核心概念**），**⚠️ 而**不主張**它是一個保險產品、受任何保險監管、或可用於任何真實的風險轉移**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次只讀了 README 的**開篇、鏈上地址表、「為什麼一個對沖產品會出現在預測市場黑客松」、「它賣的是參數化保障，不是對沖」與規模公式各節****——**⚠️ 即**本次**未通讀其 20,374 位元組的全文**，**也未讀 `docs/` 下十份文檔中**任何一份的內容****；**故**本詞條所述內容限於上述各節**（**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其任何數字**（**含 562 個市場、基差表各值、以及規模公式的各次計算**）；**本次**未克隆、未安裝 Foundry 或 Node、未運行任何測試、未訪問任何區塊瀏覽器或鏈上數據**。**④ ⚠️⭐ **未核實**「界面永遠顯示實際達成的保本點而不是用戶要求的那個」這一設計**（**本次**未訪問其站點或儀表盤、未讀任何前端代碼**）；**⭐ 這是本條目第二處需要後續核實的地方**（**因為它正是本條對本輪主題的核心貢獻**）。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核實**五個合約地址是否確實部署、是否可讀、以及 `HedgeEngine` 是否確如標註為 live**（**本次未訪問 Shannon 瀏覽器**）。**⑥ ⚠️⭐ **未核實**其「處理函數與 `MarketCreated` 在同一區塊內運行」這一技術主張**——**⚠️ 這是一個**平台級**的性質**；**本次**未讀其合約或平台文檔、未做任何鏈上核實**；**不主張**該「同區塊」性質在該鏈上確實成立**。**⑦ ⚠️ **未核實**其 `docs/somnia-feedback.md` 的內容與對象**（**只核實該文件存在**）。**⑧ ⚠️ **本次核實到**倉庫元數據、README 的上述各節、以及全部 192 個條目的文件清單**；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安裝 Foundry 或 Node、未運行任何測試或腳本、未做任何鏈上請求、**未讀任何合約源碼、未讀任何一份 `docs/` 文檔的內容、未訪問其站點或儀表盤或任何區塊瀏覽器****。**⑨ ⚠️ **未核實**其與 Somnia／dreamDEX 或任何黑客松主辦方的關係**，**亦**未核實**其是否獲獎、是否被採用、或是否有任何真實資金參與**；**不主張**該產品已上線運營、已產生任何賠付或已被任何人使用**。**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其所引航班延誤險類比在保險實務或條款上的準確性**（**本次未查任何航班延誤險條款**）。**⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主張**其參數化保障的定價在精算上充分或正確**（**其公式中 `q` 與 `x*` 的確定方式本次未核實——未讀 `docs/instrument-economics.md`**）。**⑫ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、創建於 2026-09-01、推送於 2026-09-10**，**不主張其成熟度／正確性／已被採用**；**⑬ **README 為英語**——**已如實記入，本次未核實是否有其他語言版本**；**⑭ ⭐ 許可實測為 **MIT** 且 `LICENSE` 實測存在**——**⭐ 與本輪其他三條對照：[[amanat-telegraph-miner]] 同為 MIT，而 [[claimscope-benchmark]] 與 [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] 實測**無許可文件****。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Jagadeeshftw/ballast` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 20,374 位元組經 raw 實測讀取上述各節；**全部 192 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對；**未克隆、未安裝 Foundry 或 Node、未運行任何測試、未做任何鏈上請求、未讀任何合約源碼或 `docs/` 文檔內容、未訪問其站點或儀表盤或任何區塊瀏覽器**。

**ballast-parametric-cover** (Ballast, repository `Jagadeeshftw/ballast`) **is a product that automatically buys downside cover for crypto on-chain**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **MIT** (`LICENSE` measured present), TypeScript as the primary language, a 1,714 KB repository, created 2026-09-01 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, both after the thaw window**); **9 topics measured**, including `defi`, `event-contracts`, `parametric-insurance`, `prediction-markets`, `reactivity` and `somnia`; **the README measures 20,374 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 192 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"**Ballast buys downside cover for your crypto automatically … the chain does the rest, with no keeper, no cron and nothing of ours running.**"** It is the second of this round’s four takes on **reporting only numbers someone else can recompute**, **and the only one that publishes both what it actually sells and the size of its own error**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **The heading of its most notable section is itself a refusal to blur** — **verbatim**: **"## It sells parametric cover, not a hedge — **This distinction is the whole product and the README will not blur it.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **"this distinction is the whole product and the README will not blur it"** — ⭐ **structurally aligned with this round’s theme: it refuses to let a better-sounding name (a hedge) conceal what it actually delivers (parametric cover)**. **The reason is given verbatim and is itself a checkable market-structure fact**: **"Event Contracts are **at-the-money binaries**: one strike per window … **There is no strike ladder — 562 markets checked, at most one strike per venue per window.** So **no quantity of Down contracts produces a flat net line, and Ballast does not claim one.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things worth noting**: **"562 markets checked, at most one strike per venue per window" is counted rather than assumed**; **with no strike ladder, no quantity of Down contracts produces a flat net line**; **and "Ballast does not claim one" — it does not assert a property it cannot deliver**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its basis-risk table lays out cell by cell where it compensates wrongly** — **verbatim**: **ETH falls 1% | spot loss −$50 | cover pays +$125 | net **+$75, over-compensated**; 2.5% | −$125 | +$125 | **$0, the make-whole point**; 5% | −$250 | +$125 | **−$125, under-compensated**** ⭐⭐⭐ **three rows saying three things: shallow falls are over-compensated, the make-whole point cancels exactly, deep falls are under-compensated** — ⭐ **for students of product design, a table that puts "when I cannot help" first**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its characterisation of basis risk is verbatim and says outright that it is not to be engineered away**: **"The gap either side is **basis risk**, and it is **the defining property of parametric cover** — the same trade flight-delay insurance makes, paying the same amount whether you missed a meeting or a wedding. **It is not a defect to be engineered away here; it is what you are buying.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **"it is not a defect to be engineered away here; it is what you are buying"** — ⭐ **the most valuable sentence here for an insurance reader: a property usually explained as a shortcoming is restated explicitly as the product definition**, **using the flight-delay analogy** — ⭐ **which is exactly the core distinction between parametric (index) insurance and traditional indemnity insurance**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ One interface decision is the entry’s central mechanism** — **verbatim**: **"which is why **the UI always shows the make-whole point it *achieved*, never the one you asked for, whenever liquidity bound the size**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **when liquidity constrained the size, the interface shows the make-whole point actually achieved rather than the one requested** — ⭐ **the same family as round 337’s [[insurance-qa-evidence]] ("externally bot-blocked results are not classified as confirmed dead links") and round 336’s [[inforsight]] (a pre-declared governance band for the calibration slope): what is delivered is the actual value, not the target value**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its sizing formulas are published verbatim and include a value read back** : **"Sizing: `N = exposure × x* / (1 − q)`, premium `N·q`, and **the achieved point read back as `qty·(1−q)·10000 / exposureAtOpen`**."** ⭐⭐ **the achieved point is recomputed from the filled result rather than echoed from user input**. **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ Its technical point that the venue’s own event is the trigger is verbatim**: **"the venue’s own event is the trigger. **`MarketCreated` fires, and Ballast’s handler runs in the same block**, so **the product needs no operator at all**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **the handler runs in the same block as the market-creation event, so no keeper daemon, cron job or human operator is needed** (**readable with round 337’s [[storm-parametric-corroboration]], where GitHub’s cron is best-effort and observed at every 2 to 5 hours rather than every 15 minutes: both are dealing with who triggers on schedule — one via a platform event, one via a best-effort scheduler**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its "why a hedging product is in a prediction-market hackathon" section also states the category problem**: **"**None of the published categories is risk management, so the frame is worth stating outright.**"**; **"Almost everything built on such a primitive is a way to *take* a view. **Ballast is the opposite — it is a consumer of the primitive that is not a bet.**"** ⭐⭐ **it concedes first that no published track covers risk management, then gives its reason for being there**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its on-chain deployment and document structure are measurable**: **the README lists five contract addresses verbatim** (**BallastVault, HedgeEngine, SpotExposureSource, Collateral (tUSDC, 6dp) and the dreamDEX binary module**) **with the chain ID and RPC**; **the repository measurably contains `foundry.toml`, `foundry.lock`, `package.json`, `assets/ballast_logo.png` and ten documents under `docs/`** — namely `go-live.md`, `instrument-economics.md`, `latch-sweep.md`, `onchain-lifecycle.md`, `phase0-dashboard.md`, **`phase0-findings.md`**, **`run-record.json`**, **`somnia-feedback.md`**, `tailwind-migration-estimate.md` and `video-script.md` ⭐⭐ **three of which deserve separate note**: **`instrument-economics.md` (the instrument’s own pricing and economics)**, **`phase0-findings.md` (phase-0 findings)**, **and ⭐⭐ `somnia-feedback.md` — a feedback document to the platform** — ⭐ **the same move as round 337’s [[storm-parametric-corroboration]] attributing its scheduling gap to the platform: hand the problem back upstream rather than absorbing it**; **plus `run-record.json`, a run record**. **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s parametric, catastrophe and related entries**: [[storm-parametric-corroboration]], [[amanat-telegraph-miner]], [[parametric-risk-toolkit]], [[parametric-insurance-demo]], [[aegis-parametric]], [[condition-parametric-zk]], [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] and [[cat-bond-pricing]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ One thing must be said first: this is not an insurance contract** — **⚠️ it runs on a testnet, its topics include `defi`, `prediction-markets` and `event-contracts`, and its underlying is the price of a crypto asset**; ⭐ **the entry includes it because it sets out parametric cover’s basis risk more clearly than most entries the site already holds** (**basis risk being a core concept of parametric and index insurance**), **⚠️ but it does not claim this is an insurance product, is subject to insurance regulation, or is usable for any real risk transfer**. **② ⚠️⚠️ Only the README’s opening, its on-chain address table, "why a hedging product is in a prediction-market hackathon", "it sells parametric cover, not a hedge" and the sizing formulas were read** — **⚠️ its full 20,374 bytes were not read through, and none of the ten documents under `docs/` was read**; **so the entry is limited to those sections** (**this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**). **③ ⚠️⚠️ None of its numbers were verified** (**including the 562 markets, the basis-risk table values and the sizing arithmetic**); **nothing was cloned, no Foundry or Node was installed, no test was run, and no block explorer or on-chain data was consulted**. **④ ⚠️⭐ The interface decision that the make-whole point shown is always the achieved one rather than the requested one was not verified** (**its site and dashboard were not visited and no front-end code was read**); ⭐ **this is the second thing to verify next here, because it is the entry’s central contribution to this round’s theme**. **⑤ ⚠️⭐ Whether the five contract addresses are really deployed and readable, and whether `HedgeEngine` is truly live as labelled, was not verified** (**the Shannon explorer was not visited**). **⑥ ⚠️⭐ The technical claim that the handler runs in the same block as `MarketCreated` was not verified** — **⚠️ it is a platform-level property**; **its contracts and platform documentation were not read and no on-chain check was made**, **so the entry does not claim the same-block property holds on that chain**. **⑦ ⚠️ The content and recipient of `docs/somnia-feedback.md` were not verified** (**only its existence**). **⑧ ⚠️** This check verified **the repository metadata, the README sections named above, and the complete list of all 192 entries**; ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install Foundry or Node, run any test or script, make any on-chain request, read any contract source, read the contents of any of the ten `docs/` documents, or visit its site, dashboard or any block explorer**. **⑨ ⚠️ Its relationship to Somnia, dreamDEX or any hackathon organiser was not verified**, **nor whether it won an award, was adopted, or involved any real funds**; **the entry does not claim the product is live, has paid out, or has been used by anyone**. **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ Whether the flight-delay analogy it cites is accurate in insurance practice or policy wording was not verified** (**no flight-delay policy wording was consulted**). **⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ The entry does not claim its parametric pricing is actuarially sufficient or correct** (**how `q` and `x*` are determined was not verified — `docs/instrument-economics.md` was not read**). **⑫ ⭐ At ★0, 0 forks, created 2026-09-01 and pushed 2026-09-10**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**. **⑬ The README is in English** — **recorded as such, and whether other language versions exist was not verified**. **⑭ ⭐ Licence measured as **MIT** with `LICENSE` measurably present** — ⭐ **in contrast with the round’s other entries: [[amanat-telegraph-miner]] is also MIT, while [[claimscope-benchmark]] and [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] measurably have **no licence file**.** **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Jagadeeshftw/ballast` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field MIT, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and 9 topics); the 20,374-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` for the sections named above; **all 192 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com`; **nothing was cloned, no Foundry or Node was installed, no test was run, no on-chain request was made, no contract source or `docs/` content was read, and neither its site, dashboard nor any block explorer was visited**.

It is not a defect to be engineered away here; it is what you are buying.」——「把通常被当作缺点来解释的性质明确改述为产品定义」以及「航班延误险类比正是参数化（指数）保险与传统 indemnity 保险的核心分野」已写明；⭐⭐⭐界面设计决定逐字「which is why the UI always shows the make-whole point it achieved, never the one you asked for, whenever liquidity bound the size.」——「当流动性限制规模时界面显示实际达成的保本点而不是用户要求的那个，与第 337 轮 insurance-qa-evidence 的『被拦截不算死链』、第 336 轮 inforsight 的『校准斜率带事先声明的治理带』属同一族纪律：交付的是实际值不是目标值」已写明；⭐⭐规模公式逐字「Sizing: N = exposure × x* / (1 − q), premium N·q, and the achieved point read back as qty·(1−q)·10000 / exposureAtOpen」——「实际达成的保本点是从成交结果反算回来的而不是把用户输入原样回显」已写明；⭐⭐⭐技术要点逐字「the venue’s own event is the trigger. MarketCreated fires, and Ballast’s handler runs in the same block, so the product needs no operator at all.」——「处理函数与市场创建事件在同一区块内运行故不需要守护进程／定时任务／人工操作」已写明，并与第 337 轮 storm-parametric-corroboration 的「GitHub cron 尽力而为、实际每 2–5 小时」建立并读（两者都在处理谁来确定时触发这一层）；⭐⭐类别归属逐字「None of the published categories is risk management, so the frame is worth stating outright.」与「Almost everything built on such a primitive is a way to take a view. Ballast is the opposite — it is a consumer of the primitive that is not a bet.」；⭐⭐经下载 tarball 列出全部 192 个条目实测：README 逐字列出五个合约地址（BallastVault／HedgeEngine／SpotExposureSource／Collateral（tUSDC，6dp）／dreamDEX 二元模块）并给出链 ID 与 RPC；实测含 foundry.toml、foundry.lock、package.json、assets/ballast_logo.png，以及 docs/ 下十份文档（go-live.md／instrument-economics.md／latch-sweep.md／onchain-lifecycle.md／phase0-dashboard.md／phase0-findings.md／run-record.json／somnia-feedback.md／tailwind-migration-estimate.md／video-script.md）——其中三份值得单独记：instrument-economics.md（工具本身的定价与经济性）、phase0-findings.md（第 0 阶段的发现）、somnia-feedback.md（给平台方的一份反馈文档，与第 337 轮把调度问题归因到平台同属把问题交回上游的做法）；⚠️⚠️本次只读了 README 的开篇、链上地址表、「为什么一个对冲产品会出现在预测市场黑客松」、「它卖的是参数化保障，不是对冲」与规模公式各节——即未通读其 20,374 字节全文，也未读 docs/ 下十份文档中任何一份的内容，故本词条所述内容限于上述各节，**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；⚠️⚠️未核实其任何数字（含 562 个市场、基差表各值、规模公式各次计算），本次未克隆、未安装 Foundry 或 Node、未运行任何测试、未访问任何区块浏览器或链上数据；⚠️⭐未核实「界面永远显示实际达成的保本点」这一设计（未访问其站点或仪表盘、未读任何前端代码），**这是本条目第二处需要后续核实的地方**（因为它正是本条对本轮主题的核心贡献）；⚠️⭐未核实五个合约地址是否确实部署、是否可读、以及 HedgeEngine 是否确如标注为 live（未访问 Shannon 浏览器）；⚠️⭐未核实「处理函数与 MarketCreated 在同一区块内运行」这一技术主张（这是平台级性质；未读其合约或平台文档、未做任何链上核实），不主张该同区块性质在该链上确实成立；⚠️未核实 docs/somnia-feedback.md 的内容与对象（只核实该文件存在），亦未核实其是否真的向平台提交过反馈；⚠️本次核实到仓库元数据、README 的上述各节、以及全部 192 个条目的文件清单；但未克隆、未安装 Foundry 或 Node、未运行任何测试或脚本、未做任何链上请求、未读任何合约源码、未读任何一份 docs/ 文档的内容、未访问其站点或仪表盘或任何区块浏览器；⚠️未核实其与 Somnia／dreamDEX 或任何黑客松主办方的关系，亦未核实其是否获奖、是否被采用、或是否有任何真实资金参与，不主张该产品已上线运营、已产生任何赔付或已被任何人使用；⚠️未核实其所引航班延误险类比在保险实务或条款上的准确性（本次未查任何航班延误险条款）；⚠️不主张其参数化保障的定价在精算上充分或正确（其公式中 q 与 x* 的确定方式本次未核实——未读 docs/instrument-economics.md）；★0、fork 0、创建於 2026-09-01、推送於 2026-09-10，关注度极低，不主张成熟度／正确性／已被採用；README 为英语（已如实记入，本次未核实是否有其他语言版本）；许可实测为 MIT 且 LICENSE 实测存在——与本轮其他三条对照：amanat-telegraph-miner 同为 MIT，而 claimscope-benchmark 与 cbuae-rag-benchmark 实测无许可文件。核实手段补充说明：仓库全部 192 个条目经下载 codeload.github.com tarball 后以 tar tz 列出核对；未克隆、未安装 Foundry 或 Node、未运行任何测试、未做任何链上请求、未读任何合约源码或 docs/ 文档内容、未访问其站点或仪表盘或任何区块浏览器

entries.title: ClaimScope 理赔严重度基准：一份把「模型没跑赢常数均值」当作主要发现的公开数据复现研究——数据钉在不可变修订与 SHA-256 校验和上，原始数据与模型产物都不入库
entries.title_en: ClaimScope, a claim severity benchmark: a public-data replication study whose main finding is that the model did not beat the constant mean, with data pinned to an immutable revision and SHA-256 checksums and both the raw data and the fitted artefacts excluded from Git
entries.title_hk: ClaimScope 理賠嚴重度基準：一份把「模型沒跑贏常數均值」當作主要發現的公開數據復現研究——數據釘在不可變修訂與 SHA-256 校驗和上，原始數據與模型產物都不入庫
entries.summary: 一个用公开数据做的理赔成本与严重度研究：它问的是保单特征能否估计**一笔已存在理赔的记录金额**并识别相对高成本的理赔，而**原本的「早期成本／最终成本」设想被主动收窄**，因为公开数据源无法确立首次报案时点的特征可得性或最终结算的成熟度；其主要发现被写在最前面——有限保单特征提供的预测信号很弱，**验证环节选中了常数均值严重度基线**，高成本分类仅略高于基准发生率，并自述这是一份「带透明负面结果的可复现研究，而不是一个生产用保险决策系统」；数据取自已固定到不可变修订与 SHA-256 校验和的公开包（本次运行 677,991 张保单与 26,444 条理赔记录），并明确说明「一行仍是一条严重度记录，金额未被汇总为保单级损失」；工作流为「固定来源 → 质量检查 → SQLite → SQL 连接 → 按保单分组切分 → 仅用训练集预处理 → 验证选择 → 留出评估 → 保存管线 → FastAPI 推理」，其中「按保单分组切分」与「仅用训练集预处理」是防泄漏的两处；仓库刻意不用 notebook，理由是「可执行模块能在没有隐藏 notebook 状态的情况下重新生成摘要与图」；结果表、图、数据质量报告与计数对账均入库，而原始数据、连接后的行、单条预测与训练产物均被排除
entries.summary_hk: 一個用公開數據做的理賠成本與嚴重度研究：它問的是保單特徵能否估計**一筆已存在理賠的記錄金額**並識別相對高成本的理賠，而**原本的「早期成本／最終成本」設想被主動收窄**，因為公開數據源無法確立首次報案時點的特徵可得性或最終結算的成熟度；其主要發現被寫在最前面——有限保單特徵提供的預測信號很弱，**驗證環節選中了常數均值嚴重度基線**，高成本分類僅略高於基準發生率，並自述這是一份「帶透明負面結果的可復現研究，而不是一個生產用保險決策系統」；數據取自已固定到不可變修訂與 SHA-256 校驗和的公開包（本次運行 677,991 張保單與 26,444 條理賠記錄），並明確說明「一行仍是一條嚴重度記錄，金額未被匯總為保單級損失」；工作流為「固定來源 → 質量檢查 → SQLite → SQL 連接 → 按保單分組切分 → 僅用訓練集預處理 → 驗證選擇 → 留出評估 → 保存管線 → FastAPI 推理」，其中「按保單分組切分」與「僅用訓練集預處理」是防洩漏的兩處；倉庫刻意不用 notebook，理由是「可執行模組能在沒有隱藏 notebook 狀態的情況下重新生成摘要與圖」；結果表、圖、數據質量報告與計數對賬均入庫，而原始數據、連接後的行、單條預測與訓練產物均被排除
entries.summary_en: A study of claim cost and severity using public data: it asks whether policy characteristics can estimate the recorded amount of an existing claim and identify relatively high-cost claims, while the original early-cost versus final-cost idea was deliberately narrowed because the public source cannot establish first-report feature timing or final settlement maturity; its main finding comes first — limited policy features provide weak predictive signal, validation selected the constant-mean severity baseline, and high-cost classification performs only modestly above prevalence — and it describes itself as a reproducible investigation with transparent negative results rather than a production insurance decision system; the data comes from a public package pinned to an immutable revision and SHA-256 checksums (this run uses 677,991 policies and 26,444 claim records), with the explicit note that a row remains a severity record and amounts are not aggregated into policy-level losses; the workflow runs pinned source, quality checks, SQLite, SQL join, policy-group split, train-only preprocessing, validation selection, held-out evaluation, saved pipelines and FastAPI inference, where the policy-group split and train-only preprocessing are the two leakage controls; the repository deliberately avoids notebooks because executable modules regenerate the summaries and plots without hidden notebook state; and result tables, figures, data-quality reports and count reconciliation are committed while raw data, joined rows, individual predictions and trained artefacts are excluded
entries.body:
**claimscope-benchmark**（ClaimScope，仓库 `ThomsonThomas-V/claimscope`）**是一份用**公开数据**做的理赔成本与严重度研究**：**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 210 KB、创建于 2026-09-08、最后推送 2026-09-08、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，创建与推送均落在解冻窗口之后**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 在 70 个条目中实测不存在——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**README 实测 10,066 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 70 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「**Insurance Claim Cost & Severity Intelligence** — an independent data-science portfolio project built with public data. **No affiliation with Allianz; no proprietary data, pricing, underwriting process, or branding is reproduced.**」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「只报别人能重算的数」**中的**第三种，也是四条里唯一**把「我的模型输给了一个常数」当作主要发现发布**的一条**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其主要发现写在 README 最前面，且结论是**负面的****——**逐字为**：**「**Main finding:** limited policy features provide **weak predictive signal**. **Validation selected the constant mean severity baseline**; high-cost classification performs **modestly above prevalence**. This repository demonstrates **a reproducible investigation with transparent negative results, not a production insurance decision system**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① 「**验证环节选中了常数均值严重度基线**」**——**即**按流程走完模型选择之后，选出来的是「就用平均值」****（**⭐ 对做建模的同学，这是一条**很罕见也很值得学的结论形态**：**多数项目不会发布「我的候选模型全部输给了一个常数」**；**⭐ 而它与第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 的「六代模型、五次失败、一次成功」同属**把失败留在记录里****）；**② **「高成本分类仅略高于基准发生率」**——**即**它给出的不是「提升多少倍」而是**与发生率相比只高一点****；**③ **「可复现研究…而不是一个生产用保险决策系统」**——**与本轮 [[storm-parametric-corroboration]]、[[ballast-parametric-cover]] 的「不是什么」写法同源**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**原本的研究问题收窄了**，并把收窄的理由写成了一条**数据可得性判断****——**逐字为**：**「ClaimScope asks whether policy characteristics can estimate the **recorded amount of an existing claim** and identify relatively high-cost claims. **The original early/final-cost idea was narrowed because the public source cannot establish first-report feature timing or final settlement maturity.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**原本想做「早期成本 vs 最终成本」，但**因为公开数据源无法确立「首次报案时点上的特征可得性」与「最终结算的成熟度」，故主动收窄到「已存在理赔的记录金额」****——**⭐ 这两条恰好是本站连续多轮反复出现的两种失败**（**时间泄漏**与**结算成熟度**）；**⭐ 而它的处理是**改问题**而不是**假装数据支持原问题****（**可与第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 的「时间泄漏会悄悄抬高准确率」并读**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **数据来源的可重算性做得比本站已收多数条目更硬**——**逐字为**：**「Original `freMTPL2freq` and `freMTPL2sev` files from [CASdatasets](…), **pinned to an immutable repository revision and SHA-256 checksums**. This run uses **677,991 policies and 26,444 claim records**, linked by policy ID. **A row remains a severity record; amounts are not aggregated into policy-level losses.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **钉到不可变修订 + SHA-256 校验和****（**⭐ 即**别人可以确认拿到的是同一份字节**——**本词条认为这是「别人能重算」这一要求的**基础层****）；**② **677,991 张保单与 26,444 条理赔记录按保单 ID 关联**；**③ **「一行仍是一条严重度记录，金额未被汇总为保单级损失」**——**⭐ 这是一条**单位与口径声明****，**它确定了后续所有指标的含义**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**该声明在代码中是否成立**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其工作流逐字，且其中两处正是**防泄漏措施****——**逐字为**：**「Pinned source → quality checks → SQLite → SQL join → **policy-group split** → **train-only preprocessing** → validation selection → held-out evaluation → saved pipelines → FastAPI inference」**⭐⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① **按**保单**分组切分**（**而不是按行随机切分**）**——**⭐ 即**同一张保单的多条理赔记录不会被分到训练集与测试集两边****（**这正是第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 用**聚类自助法**处理同一问题的同一关切**）；**② **预处理**只在训练集上拟合****——**⭐ 即**编码、缩放等步骤不接触验证与留出数据****（**⭐ 对做建模的同学，这两步是**最容易漏、也最不容易从指标上发现**的泄漏来源**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **它刻意不用 notebook，理由是一句很实在的话**——**逐字为**：**「**An EDA notebook is unnecessary: executable modules regenerate the summaries and plots without hidden notebook state.** SQLite provides real joins, indexes, count reconciliation, and regional/vehicle-age summaries.」**⭐⭐⭐ **「可执行模块能在没有隐藏 notebook 状态的情况下重新生成摘要与图」**——**⭐ 即**拒绝 notebook 的理由是**隐藏状态**（**单元格可以按任意顺序执行、中间变量不落在任何可复核的地方**），**而它给出的替代是**模块 + 真实 SQL 连接 + 计数对账****（**⭐ 实测其 `sql/` 与 `reports/count_reconciliation.csv` 都存在**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其「哪些入库、哪些不入库」的界线逐字，且两侧都很具体**——**逐字为**：**「The pinned package declares GPL (>= 2). **Raw files, joined rows, individual predictions, and trained artifacts are excluded from Git.** See the provenance and usage record before redistribution.」**；**以及** **「Outcomes are **positive recorded amounts in source monetary units**; **currency and final settlement status are not independently verified**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① **被排除的四类**（**原始文件、连接后的行、单条预测、训练产物**）**——**⭐ 即**结论与汇总指标入库，**而**任何可以反推到个体的中间物**都不入库****；**② **它指出结果的单位是「源货币单位的正记录金额」**，**且**「币种与最终结算状态未获独立核实」****——**⭐ 这些恰恰是保险数据分析里**最容易静默出错**的两处（**可与 [[claimscope-benchmark]] 本身的「按保单分组」关切并读**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **实测仓库里确实有它声称的那些**结论与对账产物****——**逐名为**：**`reports/evaluation.md`、`reports/eda.json`、`reports/data_quality.json`、`reports/count_reconciliation.csv`、`reports/classification_uncertainty.json`、`reports/gamma_coefficients.csv`、`reports/high_cost_importance.csv`、以及 `reports/figures/` 下 `heldout_diagnostics.png` 与 `training_costs.png`**；**`docs/` 下七份文档**（**`findings.md`、`methodology.md`、`dataset_selection.md`、`engineering.md`、`project_status.md`、`git_workflow.md`、`review_guide.md`**）；**`examples/request.json` 与 `examples/response.json`**（**实测存在**）；**`models/.gitkeep`**（**即模型目录被清空、只留占位**）；**`pyproject.toml`**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **`docs/methodology.md` 逐字被 README 描述为「方法论与**泄漏登记表**」（methodology and leakage register）**——**⭐ 即**泄漏被当作一份**要登记的清单**而不是一件要小心的事****；**② **`reports/count_reconciliation.csv`**——**计数对账**（**⭐ 即**它把「两边的行数对得上吗」做成了一个入库的产物****）；**③ **`models/.gitkeep`**——**模型目录**实测为空占位**，**与第 ⑥ 点的「训练产物不入库」一致**（**⭐ 本词条**已实测**这一点**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **其复现命令逐字，且区分了 Windows 与 Linux/macOS 两套，并给出**锁定的依赖与版本****——**逐字含** **「Tested with **Python 3.12.14**.」**、**`pip install -r requirements-lock.txt`**、**`python -m claimscope.cli run`**、**`python -m pytest -q`**、**以及** **`python scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild`**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **明确写出测试所用的 Python 版本**；**② **用**锁定的依赖文件**而非 `requirements.txt`**；**③ ⭐ **`scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild`**——**⭐ 即**存在一个**重跑并校验发布**的脚本****（**⚠️ 本词条**未运行它**——**见标注 ③**）。**⑨ ⭐ **其自述定位与「先读什么」的引导也值得记**：**README 逐字给出**「Review first」**一节**，**依次指向 `docs/findings.md`（**发现与解读**）、`reports/evaluation.md`（**生成的模型对照**）、`docs/dataset_selection.md`（**数据集可行性决策**）、`docs/methodology.md`（**方法论与泄漏登记表**）、`docs/review_guide.md`（**代码走读与面试问题**）**⭐⭐
