**claimscope-benchmark**（ClaimScope，倉庫 `ThomsonThomas-V/claimscope`）**是一份用**公開數據**做的理賠成本與嚴重度研究**：**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 210 KB、創建於 2026-09-08、最後推送 2026-09-08、無 topics**（**均落在解凍窗口之後**）；**⚠️ 實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 在 70 個條目中實測不存在——屬「完全未聲明」形態）**；**README 實測 10,066 位元組（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 70 個條目**。**其自述逐字為**：**「**Insurance Claim Cost & Severity Intelligence** — an independent data-science portfolio project built with public data. **No affiliation with Allianz; no proprietary data, pricing, underwriting process, or branding is reproduced.**」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「只報別人能重算的數」**中的**第三種，也是四條裡唯一**把「我的模型輸給了一個常數」當作主要發現發布**的一條**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其主要發現寫在 README 最前面，且結論是**負面的****——**逐字為**：**「**Main finding:** limited policy features provide **weak predictive signal**. **Validation selected the constant mean severity baseline**; high-cost classification performs **modestly above prevalence**. This repository demonstrates **a reproducible investigation with transparent negative results, not a production insurance decision system**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① 「**驗證環節選中了常數均值嚴重度基線**」——**即**按流程走完模型選擇之後，選出來的是「就用平均值」****（**⭐ 多數項目不會發布「我的候選模型全部輸給了一個常數」；**而它與第 336 輪 [[inforsight]] 的「六代模型、五次失敗、一次成功」同屬**把失敗留在記錄裡****）；**② **「高成本分類僅略高於基準發生率」**——**即**它給出的不是「提升多少倍」而是**與發生率相比只高一點****；**③ **「可復現研究…而不是一個生產用保險決策系統」**——**與本輪其餘兩條的「不是什麼」寫法同源**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**原本的研究問題收窄了**，並把理由寫成一條**數據可得性判斷****——**逐字為**：**「**The original early/final-cost idea was narrowed because the public source cannot establish first-report feature timing or final settlement maturity.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**原本想做「早期成本 vs 最終成本」，但**因為公開數據源無法確立「首次報案時點上的特徵可得性」與「最終結算的成熟度」，故主動收窄到「已存在理賠的記錄金額」****——**⭐ 這兩條恰好是本站連續多輪反覆出現的兩種失敗（**時間洩漏**與**結算成熟度**）；**而它的處理是**改問題**而不是**假裝數據支持原問題****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **數據來源的可重算性做得比本站已收多數條目更硬**——**逐字為**：**「Original `freMTPL2freq` and `freMTPL2sev` files from [CASdatasets](…), **pinned to an immutable repository revision and SHA-256 checksums**. This run uses **677,991 policies and 26,444 claim records**, linked by policy ID. **A row remains a severity record; amounts are not aggregated into policy-level losses.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① **釘到不可變修訂 + SHA-256 校驗和****（**⭐ 即**別人可以確認拿到的是同一份字節**——**這是「別人能重算」的**基礎層****）；**② **677,991 張保單與 26,444 條理賠記錄按保單 ID 關聯**；**③ **「一行仍是一條嚴重度記錄，金額未被匯總為保單級損失」**——**⭐ 一條**單位與口徑聲明****，**它確定了後續所有指標的含義****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其工作流逐字，其中兩處正是**防洩漏措施****——**逐字為**：**「Pinned source → quality checks → SQLite → SQL join → **policy-group split** → **train-only preprocessing** → validation selection → held-out evaluation → saved pipelines → FastAPI inference」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩處值得記**：**① **按**保單**分組切分**（**而不是按行隨機切分**）——**⭐ 即**同一張保單的多條理賠記錄不會被分到訓練集與測試集兩邊****（**這正是第 336 輪 [[inforsight]] 用**聚類自助法**處理同一問題的同一關切**）；**② **預處理**只在訓練集上擬合****——**⭐ 這兩步是**最容易漏、也最不容易從指標上發現**的洩漏來源****。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **它刻意不用 notebook，理由是一句很實在的話**——**逐字為**：**「**An EDA notebook is unnecessary: executable modules regenerate the summaries and plots without hidden notebook state.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「可執行模組能在沒有隱藏 notebook 狀態的情況下重新生成摘要與圖」**——**⭐ 即**拒絕 notebook 的理由是**隱藏狀態****（**單元格可以按任意順序執行、中間變量不落在任何可複核的地方**），**而替代方案是**模組 + 真實 SQL 連接 + 計數對賬****（**⭐ 實測其 `sql/` 與 `reports/count_reconciliation.csv` 都存在**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **「哪些入庫、哪些不入庫」的界線逐字**：**「Raw files, joined rows, individual predictions, and trained artifacts are excluded from Git.」**；**「Outcomes are **positive recorded amounts in source monetary units**; **currency and final settlement status are not independently verified**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩處值得記**：**① **被排除的四類（原始文件、連接後的行、單條預測、訓練產物）**——**⭐ 即**結論與匯總指標入庫，**而**任何可以反推到個體的中間物**都不入庫****；**② **它指出結果的單位是「源貨幣單位的正記錄金額」，且**「幣種與最終結算狀態未獲獨立核實」****——**⭐ 這些恰恰是保險數據分析裡**最容易靜默出錯**的兩處**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **實測倉庫裡確實有它聲稱的那些**結論與對賬產物****——**逐名為**：**`reports/evaluation.md`、`reports/eda.json`、`reports/data_quality.json`、`reports/count_reconciliation.csv`、`reports/classification_uncertainty.json`、`reports/gamma_coefficients.csv`、`reports/high_cost_importance.csv`、以及 `reports/figures/` 下 `heldout_diagnostics.png` 與 `training_costs.png`**；**`docs/` 下七份文檔**（**`findings.md`、`methodology.md`、`dataset_selection.md`、`engineering.md`、`project_status.md`、`git_workflow.md`、`review_guide.md`**）；**`examples/request.json` 與 `examples/response.json`**；**`models/.gitkeep`**；**`pyproject.toml`**⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① **`docs/methodology.md` 逐字被描述為「方法論與**洩漏登記表**」**——**⭐ 即**洩漏被當作一份**要登記的清單**而不是一件要小心的事****；**② **`reports/count_reconciliation.csv`**——**計數對賬**（**⭐ 即**把「兩邊的行數對得上嗎」做成了一個入庫的產物****）；**③ **`models/.gitkeep`**——**模型目錄**實測為空佔位**，**與第 ⑥ 點一致****。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **其復現命令逐字，區分 Windows 與 Linux/macOS 兩套，並給出**鎖定的依賴與版本****——**逐字含** **「Tested with **Python 3.12.14**.」**、**`pip install -r requirements-lock.txt`**、**`python -m claimscope.cli run`**、**`python -m pytest -q`**、**`python scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild`**⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① 明確寫出測試所用的 Python 版本**；**② 用**鎖定的依賴文件****；**③ ⭐ **`scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild`**——**⭐ 即**存在一個**重跑並校驗發布**的腳本****。**⑨ ⭐ **其「先讀什麼」引導值得記**：**README 逐字給出**「Review first」**一節**，**依次指向 `docs/findings.md`（**發現與解讀**）、`reports/evaluation.md`（**生成的模型對照**）、`docs/dataset_selection.md`（**數據集可行性決策**）、`docs/methodology.md`（**方法論與洩漏登記表**）、`docs/review_guide.md`（**代碼走讀與面試問題**）**⭐⭐ **兩處值得單獨記**：**① **「數據集可行性決策」被單獨列為一篇文檔****——**⭐ 即**「這份數據能不能支持這個問題」是一個**有記錄的決策****；**② **`review_guide.md` 逐字含「代碼走讀與**面試問題**」**——**⭐ 這與它自述 portfolio project 一致，**本詞條如實記入：該倉庫**同時是一份求職作品集****。**⑩ ⭐ **其非關聯聲明逐字且具體**：**「No affiliation with Allianz; **no proprietary data, pricing, underwriting process, or branding is reproduced.**」**——**本詞條如實記入**（**⚠️ 其數據集中出現的公司名並未被本詞條轉述**）。**⑪ ⭐ 可與 [[casdatasets]]、[[fremtpl2]]、[[fremtpl2-python-tutorial]]、[[claim-frequency]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-severity]]、[[motor-loss-reserving-dl]]、[[loss-models-computer-labs]]、[[insurance-calibration]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[rf-pipeline-calibration-reserving]] 並讀**。

**claimscope-benchmark** (ClaimScope, repository `ThomsonThomas-V/claimscope`) **is a study of claim cost and severity built on public data**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 210 KB repository, created 2026-09-08 and last pushed 2026-09-08, no topics** (**all GitHub API measurements, both after the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file at all (`LICENSE` absent among the 70 entries — the "no statement whatever" form)**; **the README measures 10,066 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 70 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"**Insurance Claim Cost & Severity Intelligence** — an independent data-science portfolio project built with public data. **No affiliation with Allianz; no proprietary data, pricing, underwriting process, or branding is reproduced.**"** It is the third of this round’s four takes on **reporting only numbers someone else can recompute**, **and the only one that publishes "my model lost to a constant" as its main finding**.

Verifiable details (**all read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its main finding sits at the very top and is negative** — **verbatim**: **"**Main finding:** limited policy features provide **weak predictive signal**. **Validation selected the constant mean severity baseline**; high-cost classification performs **modestly above prevalence**. This repository demonstrates **a reproducible investigation with transparent negative results, not a production insurance decision system**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things worth noting**: **"validation selected the constant mean severity baseline" means that after running model selection, what was selected was "just use the average"** (**⭐ few projects publish "every candidate model lost to a constant"; the same family as round 336’s [[inforsight]] with six generations, five failures and one success — leaving the failure in the record**); **"modestly above prevalence" reports a small margin over the base rate rather than a lift multiple**; **and its "not a production insurance decision system" mirrors the round’s other entries**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It narrowed its own research question and wrote the reason as a data-availability judgement** — **verbatim**: **"**The original early/final-cost idea was narrowed because the public source cannot establish first-report feature timing or final settlement maturity.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **the original early-versus-final-cost idea was dropped because the public source cannot establish feature availability at first report or the maturity of final settlement** — ⭐ **precisely the two failures that recur across this site (temporal leakage and settlement maturity); and its response was to change the question rather than pretend the data supports the original one**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its data provenance is more recomputable than most entries the site holds** — **verbatim**: **"Original `freMTPL2freq` and `freMTPL2sev` files from [CASdatasets](…), **pinned to an immutable repository revision and SHA-256 checksums**. This run uses **677,991 policies and 26,444 claim records**, linked by policy ID. **A row remains a severity record; amounts are not aggregated into policy-level losses.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: **pinned to an immutable revision with SHA-256 checksums, so anyone can confirm they hold the same bytes — the base layer of "someone else can recompute it"**; **677,991 policies and 26,444 claim records linked by policy ID**; **and "a row remains a severity record; amounts are not aggregated into policy-level losses" — a units-and-basis statement that fixes the meaning of every later metric**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its workflow is verbatim and two of its steps are leakage controls** — **verbatim**: **"Pinned source → quality checks → SQLite → SQL join → **policy-group split** → **train-only preprocessing** → validation selection → held-out evaluation → saved pipelines → FastAPI inference"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Two things**: **splitting by policy group rather than randomly by row, so multiple claims from one policy cannot land on both sides of the split** (**the same concern round 336’s [[inforsight]] addressed with a clustered bootstrap**); **and preprocessing fitted on the training set only** — ⭐ **the two leakage sources most easily missed and least visible in the metrics**. **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ It deliberately avoids notebooks, for a very practical reason** — **verbatim**: **"**An EDA notebook is unnecessary: executable modules regenerate the summaries and plots without hidden notebook state.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **notebooks are rejected because of hidden state** (**cells can run in any order and intermediate variables live nowhere reviewable**), **and the substitute is modules plus real SQL joins plus count reconciliation** (**`sql/` and `reports/count_reconciliation.csv` are measurably present**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its boundary between what is committed and what is not is verbatim**: **"Raw files, joined rows, individual predictions, and trained artifacts are excluded from Git."**; **"Outcomes are **positive recorded amounts in source monetary units**; **currency and final settlement status are not independently verified**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Two things**: **the four excluded classes — raw files, joined rows, individual predictions and trained artefacts — mean conclusions and aggregate metrics are committed while anything traceable back to an individual is not**; **and it flags that outcomes are positive recorded amounts in source monetary units with currency and final settlement status not independently verified — precisely the two places insurance data analysis goes quietly wrong**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ The repository measurably holds the conclusion and reconciliation artefacts it claims** — namely **`reports/evaluation.md`, `reports/eda.json`, `reports/data_quality.json`, `reports/count_reconciliation.csv`, `reports/classification_uncertainty.json`, `reports/gamma_coefficients.csv`, `reports/high_cost_importance.csv`, and `heldout_diagnostics.png` and `training_costs.png` under `reports/figures/`**; **seven documents under `docs/`** (**`findings.md`, `methodology.md`, `dataset_selection.md`, `engineering.md`, `project_status.md`, `git_workflow.md`, `review_guide.md`**); **`examples/request.json` and `examples/response.json`**; **`models/.gitkeep`**; **and `pyproject.toml`** ⭐⭐ **Three things worth noting**: **`docs/methodology.md` is described verbatim as the methodology and **leakage register** — leakage treated as a list to be registered rather than a thing to be careful about**; **`reports/count_reconciliation.csv` makes "do the counts agree" a committed artefact**; **and `models/.gitkeep` means the model directory is measurably an empty placeholder, consistent with trained artefacts being excluded**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its reproduction commands are verbatim, split for Windows and Linux/macOS, with a pinned dependency file and version** — **verbatim including** **"Tested with **Python 3.12.14**."**, **`pip install -r requirements-lock.txt`**, **`python -m claimscope.cli run`**, **`python -m pytest -q`** and **`python scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild`** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: **the tested Python version is stated**; **the locked requirements file is used**; **and ⭐ `scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild` exists — a script that reruns and verifies the release**. **⑨ ⭐ Its "review first" guidance is worth noting**: **the README gives a "Review first" section pointing in order to `docs/findings.md` (findings and interpretation), `reports/evaluation.md` (the generated model comparison), `docs/dataset_selection.md` (the dataset feasibility decision), `docs/methodology.md` (methodology and leakage register) and `docs/review_guide.md` (code walkthrough and interview questions)** ⭐⭐ **Two things worth separate note**: **"dataset feasibility decision" is its own document, making "can this data support this question" a recorded decision rather than a default assumption**; **and `review_guide.md` contains code walkthrough and interview questions, consistent with its self-description as a portfolio project — recorded plainly: the repository is also a job-seeking portfolio**. **⑩ ⭐ Its non-affiliation statement is verbatim and specific**: **"No affiliation with Allianz; **no proprietary data, pricing, underwriting process, or branding is reproduced.**"** — **recorded as such; ⚠️ company names appearing in its dataset are not restated here**. **⑪ ⭐ Readable with the site’s public-data, frequency-severity and reserving entries**: [[casdatasets]], [[fremtpl2]], [[fremtpl2-python-tutorial]], [[claim-frequency]], [[insurance-frequency-severity]], [[insurance-severity]], [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]], [[loss-models-computer-labs]], [[insurance-calibration]], [[verified-reserving]] and [[rf-pipeline-calibration-reserving]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as none** — **`LICENSE` is absent among the 70 entries and the README has no licence section**, **the "no statement whatever" form**; **⚠️ and the third-party package it uses declares GPL (>= 2), with the README asking readers to consult its provenance and usage record before redistribution** — **the entry therefore notes that reuse of its code and result artefacts needs the author’s authorisation, while its data is separately bound by the upstream package’s licence**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No code was read, no command was run, and no document content was read** — **so its main finding, its workflow, its two leakage controls and its data provenance are recorded only as the README states them**; ⭐ **what this check measured is that the file each mechanism corresponds to exists** (**seven documents under `docs/`, eight files and two figures under `reports/`, two files under `examples/`, `models/.gitkeep`, `pyproject.toml`, `sql/`, `scripts/` and `tests/`**) — **⚠️ but a file existing does not mean its contents and conclusions are as the README says**; **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No metric value was verified** — **⚠️ the README gives no specific figures in the sections read, and `reports/evaluation.md` and `docs/findings.md` were not read**, **so no metric value is restated**; **`scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild` was not run, no test was run and nothing was installed**. **④ ⚠️⭐ The procedural correctness of "validation selected the constant mean baseline" was not verified** — **⚠️ which is the point that most needs testing here**: **"the baseline won" may be an honest negative result or may reflect a defect in the pipeline or feature engineering**; **⚠️ the leakage register in `docs/methodology.md` was not read, no modelling code was read and no model-comparison artefact was inspected, so the entry neither affirms nor denies the conclusion** (**⭐ it records only that the author reports it**). **⑤ ⚠️⭐ Whether the policy-group split and train-only preprocessing actually hold in the code was not verified** (**no source or pipeline configuration was read**); ⭐ **this is the second thing to verify next here, because if those two do not hold, the meaning of "the baseline won" changes**. **⑥ ⚠️⭐ Its data provenance and permitted use were not verified** — **no CASdatasets licence terms were checked and the GPL claim was not verified**; **the entry does not claim its data use is compliant**. **⑦ ⚠️** This check verified **the repository metadata, the README in full, and the complete list of all 70 entries**; **the README’s opening, main finding, Review first list, dataset section, workflow and repository layout, reproduction commands and the reason for avoiding notebooks were read in detail**; ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install Python, run any command or test, read any source, read any document under `docs/`, read any file under `reports/`, read any query under `sql/`, or open any figure**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ Its relationship to any entity (including the one named in its non-affiliation statement) was not verified**, **nor whether this is coursework, a personal project or commissioned work**. **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its "limited policy features provide weak predictive signal" holds for any other dataset, market or line of business** — **⚠️ its conclusion is bounded by its data source, its target definition and its feature set**; **nor is any model claimed unusable for insurance pricing or underwriting decisions**. **⑩ ⭐ At ★0, 0 forks, created and pushed on 2026-09-08**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**. **⑪ ⭐ No topics**. **⑫ The README is in English** — **recorded as such, and whether other language versions exist was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/ThomsonThomas-V/claimscope` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field NONE, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 10,066-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; **all 70 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**confirming the seven `docs/` files, eight files and two figures under `reports/`, two files under `examples/`, `models/.gitkeep` and `pyproject.toml`, and the absence of any `LICENSE`**); **nothing was cloned, no Python was installed, no command or test was run, no source or document content was read, no result file was read and no figure was opened**.

This repository demonstrates a reproducible investigation with transparent negative results, not a production insurance decision system.」——三处已写明：①「验证环节选中了常数均值严重度基线，即按流程走完模型选择之后选出来的是就用平均值」（并注明多数项目不会发布「我的候选模型全部输给了一个常数」，与第 336 轮 inforsight 的六代五败一胜同属把失败留在记录里）；②「高成本分类仅略高于基准发生率，即给出的不是提升多少倍而是与发生率相比只高一点」；③「可复现研究…而不是一个生产用保险决策系统」；⭐⭐⭐其收窄研究问题的理由逐字「The original early/final-cost idea was narrowed because the public source cannot establish first-report feature timing or final settlement maturity.」——「原本想做早期成本 vs 最终成本，但因为公开数据源无法确立首次报案时点的特征可得性与最终结算的成熟度，故主动收窄到已存在理赔的记录金额；这两条恰好是本站连续多轮反复出现的两种失败（时间泄漏与结算成熟度），而它的处理是改问题而不是假装数据支持原问题」已写明；⭐⭐⭐数据来源逐字「pinned to an immutable repository revision and SHA-256 checksums. This run uses 677,991 policies and 26,444 claim records, linked by policy ID. A row remains a severity record; amounts are not aggregated into policy-level losses.」——三处已写明：钉到不可变修订加 SHA-256 校验和（别人可以确认拿到的是同一份字节，是「别人能重算」的基础层）、677,991 张保单与 26,444 条理赔记录按保单 ID 关联、以及「一行仍是一条严重度记录、金额未被汇总为保单级损失」这一单位与口径声明确定了后续所有指标的含义（未核实该声明在代码中是否成立）；⭐⭐⭐工作流逐字「Pinned source → quality checks → SQLite → SQL join → policy-group split → train-only preprocessing → validation selection → held-out evaluation → saved pipelines → FastAPI inference」——两处防泄漏措施已写明：按保单分组切分（而不是按行随机切分，即同一张保单的多条理赔记录不会被分到训练集与测试集两边，与第 336 轮 inforsight 的聚类自助法同一关切）与预处理只在训练集上拟合（最容易漏、也最不容易从指标上发现的泄漏来源）；⭐⭐⭐拒绝 notebook 的理由逐字「An EDA notebook is unnecessary: executable modules regenerate the summaries and plots without hidden notebook state.」——「拒绝 notebook 的理由是隐藏状态（单元格可以按任意顺序执行、中间变量不落在任何可复核的地方），替代方案是模块加真实 SQL 连接加计数对账」已写明（实测 sql/ 与 reports/count_reconciliation.csv 都存在）；⭐⭐入库界线逐字「Raw files, joined rows, individual predictions, and trained artifacts are excluded from Git.」与「Outcomes are positive recorded amounts in source monetary units; currency and final settlement status are not independently verified.」——两处已写明：被排除的四类（原始文件、连接后的行、单条预测、训练产物）即结论与汇总指标入库而任何可以反推到个体的中间物都不入库；以及它指出结果的单位是源货币单位的正记录金额且币种与最终结算状态未获独立核实（这两处恰恰是保险数据分析里最容易静默出错的地方）；⭐⭐经下载 tarball 列出全部 70 个条目实测：reports/ 下 evaluation.md、eda.json、data_quality.json、count_reconciliation.csv、classification_uncertainty.json、gamma_coefficients.csv、high_cost_importance.csv 与 figures/ 下 heldout_diagnostics.png、training_costs.png；docs/ 下 findings.md、methodology.md、dataset_selection.md、engineering.md、project_status.md、git_workflow.md、review_guide.md 七份；examples/request.json 与 response.json；models/.gitkeep（模型目录为空占位，与训练产物不入库一致，此点已实测）；pyproject.toml——其中三处值得记：docs/methodology.md 逐字被描述为「方法论与泄漏登记表」（泄漏被当作一份要登记的清单而不是一件要小心的事）、reports/count_reconciliation.csv 把「两边的行数对得上吗」做成了入库产物、models/.gitkeep 实测为空占位；⭐⭐复现命令逐字区分两套系统并给出锁定依赖与版本：Tested with Python 3.12.14／pip install -r requirements-lock.txt／python -m claimscope.cli run／python -m pytest -q／python scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild——「明确写出测试所用的 Python 版本」「用锁定的依赖文件」「存在一个重跑并校验发布的脚本」三点已写明；⭐Review first 引导逐字（docs/findings.md／reports/evaluation.md／docs/dataset_selection.md／docs/methodology.md／docs/review_guide.md）——「数据集可行性决策被单独列为一篇文档（即这份数据能不能支持这个问题是一个有记录的决策）与 review_guide.md 含代码走读与面试问题（该仓库同时是一份求职作品集）」已写明；⭐非关联声明逐字「No affiliation with Allianz; no proprietary data, pricing, underwriting process, or branding is reproduced.」（其数据集中出现的公司名未被本词条转述）；⚠️⚠️本次未读任何代码、未运行任何命令、未读任何文档内容——故其主要发现、工作流、防泄漏两处、数据来源与钉定方式全部只记录为 README 如此声明；已实测的只是这些机制各自对应的文件确实存在，但文件存在不等于其中的内容与结论如 README 所述，**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；⚠️⚠️未核实其任何指标数字（README 未在本次所读部分给出具体数值，而本次未读 reports/evaluation.md 或 docs/findings.md），故不转述任何指标值；亦未运行 scripts/verify_release.py --rebuild、未运行任何测试、未安装任何依赖；⚠️⭐未核实「验证选中常数均值基线」这一结论的程序正确性——这恰恰是本条最值得被检验的一点：「基线赢了」既可能是诚实的负面结果，也可能是流程或特征工程有缺陷（例如预处理错误、切分错误、或目标变量定义不当）；本次未读 docs/methodology.md 的泄漏登记表、未读任何建模代码、未查其模型对照产物，故既不主张该结论成立也不主张其不成立，只记录作者如此报告；⚠️⭐未核实「按保单分组切分」与「仅用训练集预处理」在代码中是否确实成立（未读任何源码或管线配置），**这是本条目第二个需要后续核实之处**（因为若这两处不成立，则「基线赢了」这一结论的含义会变）；⚠️⭐未核实其数据来源与使用边界（未查 CASdatasets 的许可条款、未核实该 GPL 声明），不主张其数据使用已合规；⚠️本次核实到仓库元数据、README 全文、以及全部 70 个条目的文件清单；本次通读了 README 的开篇、主要发现、Review first 列表、数据集一节、工作流与仓库结构、复现命令与「无需 notebook」的理由；但未克隆、未安装 Python、未运行任何命令或测试、未读任何源码、未读 docs/ 下任何文档、未读 reports/ 下任何文件（含 evaluation.md 与 count_reconciliation.csv）、未读 sql/ 下任何查询、未读任何脚本、未打开任何图；⚠️未核实其与任何实体（含其非关联声明中提到者）的关系，亦未核实该研究是课程作业、个人项目还是受托工作，不主张其具有任何审计或学术权威性；⚠️不主张其「有限保单特征信号很弱」这一结论适用于任何其他数据集、市场或险种（其结论受其数据源、目标变量定义与特征集约束），亦不主张任何模型不可用于保险定价或核保决策；★0、fork 0、创建与推送均为 2026-09-08，关注度极低，不主张成熟度／正确性／已被採用；无 topics；README 为英语（已如实记入，本次未核实是否有其他语言版本）。核实手段补充说明：仓库全部 70 个条目经下载 codeload.github.com tarball 后以 tar tz 列出核对；未克隆、未安装 Python、未运行任何命令或测试、未读任何源码或文档内容、未读任何结果文件、未打开任何图

entries.title: ReguLens 保险监管文本检索评测：一个不交付聊天机器人而交付基准的项目——它把「证据召回率」定为指标，理由是这个数任何人打开语料就能复核，而法律正确性不能
entries.title_en: ReguLens, a retrieval evaluation over insurance regulatory text: a project that ships a benchmark rather than a chatbot, choosing evidence recall as its metric because anyone with the corpus open can check that number while legal correctness cannot be checked at all
entries.title_hk: ReguLens 保險監管文本檢索評測：一個不交付聊天機器人而交付基準的項目——它把「證據召回率」定為指標，理由是這個數任何人打開語料就能複核，而法律正確性不能
entries.summary: 一份针对阿联酋央行（CBUAE）保险监管文本的检索评测：它刻意不交付聊天机器人，而是交付一套基准并据此测量四种检索架构；其研究问题是「带重排序的混合检索，相对于纯词法或纯稠密检索，能否提高多跳监管问题上的证据召回率」；语料为 CBUAE 规则手册保险部分，46 份文件、解析后 763 个小节、954 个分块（512 词预算、64 词重叠）、206,705 词，采集于 2026-08-24；基准为 100 个问题，评分对象是**人工标注的答案要点**，而演示页展示的是**系统的真实记录输出**；它把「测的是什么、不是什么」写成独立一节——测的是检索质量（系统是否给出了人工标注为回答所必需的小节），**并不主张法律正确性**，其基准真值是「需要哪些小节」而不是「法律说的是什么」，并逐字说明这是一个刻意设计而不是含糊其辞，理由是「证据召回率任何打开语料的人都能客观复核，法律正确性则不能」；其自述状态为全部六个阶段完成，并且明说「其中两个实验失败了，并被当作失败来报告」；仓库含一个负对照脚本与一个基准校验脚本，另有引用校验与拒答机制以及一个交叉引用图
entries.summary_hk: 一份針對阿聯酋央行（CBUAE）保險監管文本的檢索評測：它刻意不交付聊天機器人，而是交付一套基準並據此測量四種檢索架構；其研究問題是「帶重排序的混合檢索，相對於純詞法或純稠密檢索，能否提高多跳監管問題上的證據召回率」；語料為 CBUAE 規則手冊保險部分，46 份文件、解析後 763 個小節、954 個分塊（512 詞預算、64 詞重疊）、206,705 詞，採集於 2026-08-24；基準為 100 個問題，評分對象是**人工標註的答案要點**，而演示頁展示的是**系統的真實記錄輸出**；它把「測的是什麼、不是什麼」寫成獨立一節——測的是檢索質量（系統是否給出了人工標註為回答所必需的小節），**並不主張法律正確性**，其基準真值是「需要哪些小節」而不是「法律說的是什麼」，並逐字說明這是一個刻意設計而不是含糊其辭，理由是「證據召回率任何打開語料的人都能客觀複核，法律正確性則不能」；其自述狀態為全部六個階段完成，並且明說「其中兩個實驗失敗了，並被當作失敗來報告」；倉庫含一個負對照腳本與一個基準校驗腳本，另有引用校驗與拒答機制以及一個交叉引用圖
entries.summary_en: A retrieval evaluation over UAE Central Bank (CBUAE) insurance regulatory text: it deliberately does not ship a chatbot but a benchmark, against which it measures four retrieval architectures; its research question is whether hybrid retrieval with reranking improves evidence recall on multi-hop regulatory questions compared with lexical or dense retrieval alone; the corpus is the insurance section of the CBUAE Rulebook — 46 documents, 763 sections after parsing, 954 chunks at a 512-word budget with 64-word overlap, 206,705 words, collected 2026-08-24; the benchmark is 100 questions scored against a human-labelled answer key, and the demo page shows the system’s real recorded output; a dedicated section sets out what is measured and what is not — retrieval quality, meaning whether the system surfaced the sections a human labelled as necessary, with no claim of legal accuracy, the benchmark’s ground truth being which sections are required rather than what the law says, and the entry states verbatim that this is a deliberate design decision rather than a hedge because evidence recall is objectively checkable by anyone with the corpus open while legal correctness is not; its self-reported status is all six phases complete, with two of those experiments having failed and being reported as failures; and the repository carries a negative-control script, a benchmark validator, citation validation with abstention, and a cross-reference graph
entries.body:
**cbuae-rag-benchmark**（ReguLens，仓库 `clyv/cbuae-rag-benchmark`）**是一份针对阿联酋央行（CBUAE）**保险监管文本**的检索评测**：**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 396 KB、创建于 2026-08-24、最后推送 2026-09-07、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 在 113 个条目中实测不存在——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**README 实测 35,994 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 113 个条目**。**其开篇逐字为**：**「**A retrieval evaluation over UAE insurance regulatory documents.**」**，**紧接着就是本条目最值得记的一句**（**见下**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「只报别人能重算的数」**中的**第四种，也是四条里唯一**把指标的**可复核性**本身当作选指标的理由**的一条**。

可核实信息（**均 README 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其开篇两句把整条路径的选择说清了，且第二句是对同行做法的一次直接对比**——**逐字为**：**「**Most RAG projects ship a chatbot and assert that it works. This one ships a benchmark and measures four retrieval architectures against it. The chatbot is the demo; the evaluation is the project.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「多数 RAG 项目交付一个聊天机器人并断言它可用。这一个交付一套基准，并据此测量四种检索架构。聊天机器人是演示，评测才是项目。」**——**⭐ 这是本轮主题最直接的一次表述：**它把「可断言的东西」与「可测量的东西」分开，并选择交付后者****（**可与第 334 轮 [[insurance-rag-assistant]] 并读：**那一条的贡献是「把四次检索未命中留在评测里」，而这一条把它做成了**整个项目的交付物****）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其自述状态一节含一句很少见的披露**——**逐字为**：**「**Status:** all six phases complete. Corpus, benchmark, the four-system comparison, grounded answering with citation validation and abstention, and the cross-reference graph are measured and reported below. **Two of those experiments failed, and are reported as failures.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「其中两个实验失败了，并被当作失败来报告」**——**⭐ 与第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 的「六代模型、五次失败、一次成功」、本轮 [[claimscope-benchmark]] 的「验证选中了常数均值基线」构成同一条线：**把失败留在记录里，且**归到正确的层级**（**这里归到**实验**这一层级：**六项都已测量、其中两项以失败报告****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「测的是什么、不是什么」一节是本条的核心，且它给的理由**正是本轮主题****——**逐字为**：**「This project measures **retrieval quality**: given a question, did the system surface the document sections a human labelled as necessary to answer it? This project does **not** claim legal accuracy. Determining whether an answer is legally correct requires qualified compliance expertise, which the author does not have and does not claim. **The benchmark’s ground truth is *which sections are required*, not *what the law says*.** Every metric below follows from that choice.」**；**以及最关键的三句**：**「**This is a deliberate design decision, not a hedge. Evidence recall is objectively checkable by anyone with the corpus open. Legal correctness is not.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① **它测的是**检索质量**——**即**「系统有没有给出人工标注为**回答所必需**的小节」****；**② **它明确**不主张法律正确性**，**并说明原因**（**判断法律上是否正确需要合格的合规专业知识，而作者没有、也不主张拥有**）；**③ **它指出**基准的真值是「需要哪些小节」而不是「法律说的是什么」**，**并逐字说明「以下每一个指标都由这个选择推出」**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「这是一个刻意的设计决定，不是一个含糊其辞的退路。证据召回率**任何打开语料的人都能客观复核**，法律正确性则不能。」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条候选里对「只报别人能重算的数」表述得最完整的一处**：**它不只选了那个能复核的指标，还**说明了为什么另一个不能复核**，并把后者**明确排除在主张之外****（**⚠️ 对做监管科技的同学，这一节的写法**可以直接照搬**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其研究问题逐字，且它解释了为什么监管问题需要多跳检索**——**逐字为**：**「**Does hybrid retrieval with reranking improve evidence recall on multi-hop regulatory questions, compared with lexical or dense retrieval alone?**」**；**并逐字说明问题所在**：**「Regulatory answers are rarely contained in a single passage. A question about a broker’s risk-management obligations may depend on one article establishing the duty, another defining an exception, and a third in a separate instrument setting the reporting requirement. **Keyword search retrieves documents; it does not reliably assemble the complete evidence needed to answer.**」**⭐⭐ **即**一个关于经纪商风险管理义务的问题，可能分别依赖**确立义务的条款**、**界定例外的条款**与**另一份文件中规定报送要求的条款****——**⭐ 这段对做保险合规检索的同学很实用**（**它把「多跳」具体化成了保险监管文本里的一类真实结构**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **语料规模逐字且口径齐全，含分块参数**——**逐字实测其语料表**：**「Source | **CBUAE Rulebook, Insurance section**」**、**「Documents | **46**」**、**「Sections after parsing | **763**」**、**「Chunks indexed | **954（512-word budget, 64-word overlap）**」**、**「Words | **206,705**」**、**「Date collected | **2026-08-24**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **「解析后的小节数」被单独列出**（**763**）**——**即**从 46 份文件到可检索单元之间那一步**被显式记账**；**② **分块参数给了**预算与重叠**（**512 词预算、64 词重叠**）**——**⭐ 因为**重叠大小直接影响召回率**，**故它是必报参数**；**③ **采集日期逐字给出**——**⭐ 对本行读者尤其重要：**监管文本会更新，**故「这是哪一天抓的」决定了结论的适用范围****（**⭐ 可与本轮 [[claimscope-benchmark]] 的数据钉定并读**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其基准的呈现方式逐字，且强调「真实记录的输出」**——**逐字为**：**「[Try the demo] — **100 questions, the system’s real recorded output, scored against a human-labelled answer key.**」**⭐⭐ **即**演示页上的答案不是现场生成给人看的，**而是**已记录的真实输出**，**评分对象是**人工标注的要点****（**⭐ 这与第 337 轮 [[insurance-qa-evidence]] 的「没有把合成视频当作真实交互证据」同属一类自律：**展示的是记录，不是重新演一遍**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其六项已完成工作逐字，且其中一项是**拒答**——**逐字为**：**「Corpus, benchmark, the four-system comparison, **grounded answering with citation validation and abstention**, **cbuae-rag-benchmark**（ReguLens，倉庫 `clyv/cbuae-rag-benchmark`）**是一份針對阿聯酋央行（CBUAE）**保險監管文本**的檢索評測**：**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 396 KB、創建於 2026-08-24、最後推送 2026-09-07、無 topics**（**創建在解凍窗口之前，推送落在窗口之內**）；**⚠️ 實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 在 113 個條目中實測不存在——屬「完全未聲明」形態）**；**README 實測 35,994 位元組（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 113 個條目**。**其開篇逐字為**：**「**A retrieval evaluation over UAE insurance regulatory documents.**」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「只報別人能重算的數」**中的**第四種，也是四條裡唯一**把指標的**可複核性**本身當作選指標的理由**的一條**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其開篇兩句把整條路徑的選擇說清了，且第二句是對同行做法的一次直接對比**——**逐字為**：**「**Most RAG projects ship a chatbot and assert that it works. This one ships a benchmark and measures four retrieval architectures against it. The chatbot is the demo; the evaluation is the project.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「多數 RAG 項目交付一個聊天機器人並斷言它可用。這一個交付一套基準，並據此測量四種檢索架構。聊天機器人是演示，評測才是項目。」**——**⭐ 這是本輪主題最直接的一次表述：**它把「可斷言的東西」與「可測量的東西」分開，並選擇交付後者****（**可與第 334 輪 [[insurance-rag-assistant]] 並讀**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其自述狀態一節含一句很少見的披露**——**逐字為**：**「**Status:** all six phases complete. … **Two of those experiments failed, and are reported as failures.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「其中兩個實驗失敗了，並被當作失敗來報告」**——**⭐ 與第 336 輪 [[inforsight]] 的「六代模型、五次失敗、一次成功」、本輪 [[claimscope-benchmark]] 的「驗證選中了常數均值基線」構成同一條線：**把失敗留在記錄裡，且**歸到正確的層級****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「測的是什麼、不是什麼」一節是本條的核心，且它給的理由**正是本輪主題****——**逐字為**：**「This project measures **retrieval quality**: given a question, did the system surface the document sections a human labelled as necessary to answer it? This project does **not** claim legal accuracy. Determining whether an answer is legally correct requires qualified compliance expertise, which the author does not have and does not claim. **The benchmark’s ground truth is *which sections are required*, not *what the law says*.** Every metric below follows from that choice.」**；**以及最關鍵的三句**：**「**This is a deliberate design decision, not a hedge. Evidence recall is objectively checkable by anyone with the corpus open. Legal correctness is not.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處值得記**：**① 它測的是**檢索質量****；**② 它明確**不主張法律正確性**，**並說明原因**（**判斷法律上是否正確需要合格的合規專業知識，而作者沒有、也不主張擁有**）；**③ 它指出**基準的真值是「需要哪些小節」而不是「法律說的是什麼」**，**並逐字說明「以下每一個指標都由這個選擇推出」**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「這是一個刻意的設計決定，不是一個含糊其辭的退路。證據召回率**任何打開語料的人都能客觀複核**，法律正確性則不能。」**——**⭐ 本條認為這是本輪四條候選裡對「只報別人能重算的數」表述得最完整的一處**：**它不只選了那個能複核的指標，還**說明了為什麼另一個不能複核**，並把後者**明確排除在主張之外****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其研究問題逐字，且它解釋了為什麼監管問題需要多跳檢索**——**逐字為**：**「**Does hybrid retrieval with reranking improve evidence recall on multi-hop regulatory questions, compared with lexical or dense retrieval alone?**」**；**並逐字說明問題所在**：**「Regulatory answers are rarely contained in a single passage. … **Keyword search retrieves documents; it does not reliably assemble the complete evidence needed to answer.**」**⭐⭐ **即**一個關於經紀商風險管理義務的問題，可能分別依賴**確立義務的條款**、**界定例外的條款**與**另一份文件中規定報送要求的條款****。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **語料規模逐字且口徑齊全，含分塊參數**——**逐字實測其語料表**：**「Source | **CBUAE Rulebook, Insurance section**」「Documents | **46**」「Sections after parsing | **763**」「Chunks indexed | **954（512-word budget, 64-word overlap）**」「Words | **206,705**」「Date collected | **2026-08-24**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① 「解析後的小節數」被單獨列出（763）——即從 46 份文件到可檢索單元之間那一步被顯式記賬**；**② **分塊參數給了預算與重疊**（**512 詞預算、64 詞重疊**）——**⭐ 因為**重疊大小直接影響召回率**，故它是必報參數**；**③ **採集日期逐字給出**——**⭐ **監管文本會更新，故「這是哪一天抓的」決定了結論的適用範圍****（**可與本輪 [[claimscope-benchmark]] 的數據釘定並讀**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其基準的呈現方式逐字，且強調「真實記錄的輸出」**——**逐字為**：**「**100 questions, the system’s real recorded output, scored against a human-labelled answer key.**」**⭐⭐ **即**演示頁上的答案不是現場生成給人看的，**而是**已記錄的真實輸出****（**⭐ 與第 337 輪 [[insurance-qa-evidence]] 的「沒有把合成視頻當作真實交互證據」同屬一類自律**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其六項已完成工作逐字，其中一項是**拒答****——**逐字為**：**「Corpus, benchmark, the four-system comparison, **grounded answering with citation validation and abstention**, and **the cross-reference graph**」**⭐⭐ **兩處值得記**：**① **「引用校驗與拒答」**——**⭐ 即**系統可以**選擇不回答****（**可與第 334 輪 [[insurance-rag-assistant]] 的 `answer_status`、[[claimlens]] 的四類狀態並讀**）；**② **交叉引用圖**（**對應其 `run_graph_eval.py` 與 `build_graph.py`**）**——**⭐ 即它把監管文本之間的**引用關係**也做成了一個被評測的對象**，**與第 ⑤ 點的「多跳」直接對應**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **實測其腳本目錄有 16 個腳本，其中三個很說明問題**——**逐名為**：**`download_corpus.py`、`build_corpus.py`、`browse_corpus.py`、`enrich_registry.py`、`scope_check.py`、`validate_benchmark.py`、**`negative_control.py`**、`run_eval.py`、`run_answering.py`、`run_abstractive.py`、`run_graph_eval.py`、`report_results.py`、`export_demo.py`、`build_demo_page.py`、`build_graph.py`、`promote_drafts.py`**⭐⭐⭐ **三處值得單獨記**：**① ⭐⭐ **`negative_control.py`（負對照）**——**⭐ 即**存在一個用來確認「不該有信號的地方確實沒有信號」的腳本**（**⭐ 這是本站條目裡首次見到「負對照」被做成一個獨立腳本**；**⭐ 與「基線贏了」同屬**用對照物檢驗自己的方法****）；**② **`validate_benchmark.py`（基準校驗）**與**`scope_check.py`（範圍檢查）**——**⭐ 即**基準本身**也要被校驗**；**③ **`run_eval.py` 與 `run_answering.py` 分開**——**⭐ 即**檢索評測與答案生成是**兩條獨立的運行**，**與第 ③ 點的分工一致**。**⑨ ⭐ **其代碼結構與演示頁實測**：**`src/regulens/` 下含 `api/`（`app.py`、`index.py`、`static/index.html`）與 `evaluation/`**；**`docs/` 下含 `index.html` 與 `.nojekyll`**（**即**演示頁託管在 GitHub Pages**）。**⑩ ⭐ **其自述定位逐字，且是一句明確的排除**：**「**This repository is a technical portfolio project. Nothing in it is legal, regulatory, or compliance advice.**」**——**⭐ 三項否定**。**⑪ ⭐ 可與 [[insurance-rag-assistant]]、[[insqabench]]、[[rag-assurance]]、[[valact-rag]]、[[rag-insurance]]、[[strata-insurance-corpus]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[ins-actbench]]、[[uae-health-pricing-model]]、[[insurance-qa-en]] 並讀**。

對其文本再分發的任何條款或要求****，**故**既不主張**該語料的再分發已獲許可，**也**不主張**其未獲許可**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次只讀了 README 的**開篇、狀態、「研究問題」、「測的是什麼、不是什麼」、語料表**，以及全部章節標題****——**⚠️ 即**本次**未通讀其 35,994 位元組的全文**，**⭐ 尤其**未讀 entries.body_en:
**cbuae-rag-benchmark** (ReguLens, repository `clyv/cbuae-rag-benchmark`) **is a retrieval evaluation over UAE Central Bank (CBUAE) insurance regulatory text**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 396 KB repository, created 2026-08-24 and last pushed 2026-09-07, no topics** (**both GitHub API measurements; creation before the thaw window, push inside it**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file at all (`LICENSE` absent among the 113 entries — the "no statement whatever" form)**; **the README measures 35,994 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 113 entries in total**. **Its opening line reads verbatim**: **"**A retrieval evaluation over UAE insurance regulatory documents.**"** It is the fourth of this round’s four takes on **reporting only numbers someone else can recompute**, **and the only one that makes a metric’s checkability the reason for choosing it**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its opening two sentences settle the path it took, and the second is a direct comparison with how others work** — **verbatim**: **"**Most RAG projects ship a chatbot and assert that it works. This one ships a benchmark and measures four retrieval architectures against it. The chatbot is the demo; the evaluation is the project.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **the thing that can be asserted is separated from the thing that can be measured, and the latter is what gets delivered** (**readable with round 334’s [[insurance-rag-assistant]]**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its status section contains an uncommon disclosure** — **verbatim**: **"**Status:** all six phases complete. … **Two of those experiments failed, and are reported as failures.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **two of six experiments failed and are reported as failures** — ⭐ **the same line as round 336’s [[inforsight]] (six generations, five failures, one success) and this round’s [[claimscope-benchmark]] (validation selected the constant mean baseline): failures stay in the record, classified at the right level**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The "what is measured, and what is not" section is the entry’s core, and the reason it gives is this round’s theme** — **verbatim**: **"This project measures **retrieval quality**: given a question, did the system surface the document sections a human labelled as necessary to answer it? This project does **not** claim legal accuracy. Determining whether an answer is legally correct requires qualified compliance expertise, which the author does not have and does not claim. **The benchmark’s ground truth is *which sections are required*, not *what the law says*.** Every metric below follows from that choice."**; **and the three decisive sentences**: **"**This is a deliberate design decision, not a hedge. Evidence recall is objectively checkable by anyone with the corpus open. Legal correctness is not.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things worth noting**: **it measures retrieval quality**; **it explicitly does not claim legal accuracy, and gives the reason — deciding legal correctness requires qualified compliance expertise the author does not have and does not claim**; **it states that the benchmark’s ground truth is which sections are required rather than what the law says, and that every metric below follows from that choice**; **and ⭐⭐⭐ the fullest statement in this round of "report only what someone else can recompute": it not only chose the checkable metric but said why the other one cannot be checked, and excluded it from its claims outright**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its research question is verbatim, and it explains why regulatory questions need multi-hop retrieval** — **verbatim**: **"**Does hybrid retrieval with reranking improve evidence recall on multi-hop regulatory questions, compared with lexical or dense retrieval alone?**"**; **with the problem stated verbatim**: **"Regulatory answers are rarely contained in a single passage. … **Keyword search retrieves documents; it does not reliably assemble the complete evidence needed to answer.**"** ⭐⭐ **a question about a broker’s risk-management obligations may depend on one article establishing the duty, another defining an exception, and a third in a separate instrument setting the reporting requirement**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Corpus scale is verbatim and complete in its parameters, including chunking** — **its corpus table measures verbatim as**: **"Source | **CBUAE Rulebook, Insurance section**"; "Documents | **46**"; "Sections after parsing | **763**"; "Chunks indexed | **954 (512-word budget, 64-word overlap)**"; "Words | **206,705**"; "Date collected | **2026-08-24**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: **the section count after parsing is listed separately, so the step from 46 documents to retrieval units is accounted for**; **the chunking parameters give both budget and overlap — and overlap directly affects recall, which is why it must be reported**; **and the collection date is given verbatim — a regulatory corpus changes, so the date fixes the reach of the conclusions** (**readable with this round’s [[claimscope-benchmark]] and its pinned data**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ How the benchmark is presented is verbatim, and it stresses real recorded output** — **verbatim**: **"**100 questions, the system’s real recorded output, scored against a human-labelled answer key.**"** ⭐⭐ **the answers on the demo page are not generated live for show but already recorded, scored against a human-labelled answer key** (**the same self-discipline as round 337’s [[insurance-qa-evidence]]: what is shown is the record, not a re-enactment**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its six completed pieces of work are verbatim, one of which is abstention** — **verbatim**: **"Corpus, benchmark, the four-system comparison, **grounded answering with citation validation and abstention**, and **the cross-reference graph**"** ⭐⭐ **Two things worth noting**: **citation validation and abstention mean the system may decline to answer** (**readable with round 334’s [[insurance-rag-assistant]] and its `answer_status`, and with [[claimlens]]’s four states**); **and the cross-reference graph makes the citation relationships between regulatory texts an evaluated object, matching the multi-hop point above**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ Sixteen scripts are measurably present, three of which are telling** — namely **`download_corpus.py`, `build_corpus.py`, `browse_corpus.py`, `enrich_registry.py`, `scope_check.py`, `validate_benchmark.py`, **`negative_control.py`**, `run_eval.py`, `run_answering.py`, `run_abstractive.py`, `run_graph_eval.py`, `report_results.py`, `export_demo.py`, `build_demo_page.py`, `build_graph.py` and `promote_drafts.py`** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things worth separate note**: ⭐⭐ **`negative_control.py` — a script for confirming that nothing shows a signal where none should exist, the first time the site has recorded a negative control as its own script; the same family as "the baseline won": using a control object to test your own method**; **`validate_benchmark.py` and `scope_check.py` — the benchmark itself is something to be validated, not merely an input to be used**; **and `run_eval.py` separated from `run_answering.py` — retrieval evaluation and answer generation are two independent runs, consistent with point ③**. **⑨ ⭐ Its code layout and demo page are measurable**: **`src/regulens/` contains `api/` (`app.py`, `index.py`, `static/index.html`) and `evaluation/`**; **`docs/` contains `index.html` and `.nojekyll`**, **so the demo page is hosted on GitHub Pages**. **⑩ ⭐ Its stated positioning is verbatim and is a clear exclusion**: **"**This repository is a technical portfolio project. Nothing in it is legal, regulatory, or compliance advice.**"** — **three negations**. **⑪ ⭐ Readable with the site’s insurance-retrieval, benchmark and regulatory-text entries**: [[insurance-rag-assistant]], [[insqabench]], [[rag-assurance]], [[valact-rag]], [[rag-insurance]], [[strata-insurance-corpus]], [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], [[ins-actbench]], [[uae-health-pricing-model]] and [[insurance-qa-en]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as none** — **`LICENSE` is absent among the 113 entries and the README has no licence section**; **the entry therefore advises confirming authorisation with the author before copying, modifying or redistributing its corpus, benchmark or code**; ⭐ **and notes in particular that its corpus is third-party regulatory text (the CBUAE Rulebook) — no CBUAE term or requirement on redistribution was checked, so the entry neither claims that redistributing the corpus is permitted nor that it is not**. **② ⚠️⚠️ Only the README’s opening, status, research question, "what is measured, and what is not", and corpus table were read, along with every section heading** — **⚠️ its full 35,994 bytes were not read through, and in particular `Results`, `Benchmark`, `Systems compared`, `Answering: citations and abstention`, `Phase 6: the cross-reference graph`, `Limitations`, `Development` and `Build order` were not read**; **so no result figure is restated** (**such as per-system recall, the ranking of the four architectures, or any comparison conclusion**) — **this is the entry’s largest gap and the single most important thing to verify next**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ None of its evaluation results or conclusions were verified** (**including the answer to its research question, the scoring of the 100 questions, and which two experiments failed and how**); **`run_eval.py` was not run, no result report was read, and its demo page was not opened**. **④ ⚠️⭐ How its human-labelled answer key was produced was not verified** (**who labelled, by what rules, whether anyone reviewed, and what inter-labeller agreement was**); **⚠️ and this is the entry’s single most consequential unknown, because every metric rests on the judgement of which sections are necessary to answer** — **a human judgement rather than a computable quantity** (**⭐ this is the second thing to verify next here**). **⑤ ⚠️⭐ The implementation of its citation validation and abstention was not verified** (**under what conditions the system abstains, at what rate, and whether citations point to sections that really exist**); **`run_answering.py` and any evaluation code were not read**. **⑥ ⚠️⭐ The completeness of its corpus was not verified** (**it states 46 documents and 763 parsed sections from the insurance section of the CBUAE Rulebook; the CBUAE website was not visited, the official document count was not compared, and how the boundary of the "insurance section" was drawn was not checked**); ⭐ **and this directly fixes the reach of its conclusions**. **⑦ ⚠️** This check verified **the repository metadata, the README sections named above with all section headings, and the complete list of all 113 entries**; ⭐ **the sixteen scripts under `scripts/`, `api/` and `evaluation/` under `src/regulens/`, and `docs/index.html` with `docs/.nojekyll` are all measurably present**; ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install Python, run any script, read any source, read the bodies of the README sections not named above, read any evaluation result, visit its demo page or the CBUAE website, or perform any retrieval or evaluation re-check**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ Its relationship to the Central Bank of the UAE, any regulator or any entity was not verified**, **nor whether this is coursework, a personal project or commissioned work**; **no regulatory, legal or academic authority is claimed for it** (**⭐ its own statement already declares that nothing in it is legal, regulatory or compliance advice**). **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its retrieval conclusions hold for any other regulatory corpus (including Chinese, Hong Kong or other jurisdictions’ insurance regulatory text)** — **⚠️ its conclusions are bounded by the corpus, the chunking parameters (512/64), the question set and the labelling method**. **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its 100 questions or their ground truth represent regulatory practice or compliance judgement in any sense** — **they measure whether the required sections can be retrieved**. **⑪ ⭐ At ★0, 0 forks, created 2026-08-24 and pushed 2026-09-07**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**. **⑫ ⭐ No topics**. **⑬ The README is in English** — **recorded as such, and whether Arabic or Chinese versions exist was not verified**; ⭐ **and its corpus is English regulatory text** (**whether the CBUAE Rulebook has an Arabic original was not verified**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/clyv/cbuae-rag-benchmark` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field NONE, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 35,994-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` for the sections named above with all section headings listed; **all 113 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**confirming the sixteen scripts under `scripts/`, `api/` and `evaluation/` under `src/regulens/`, and `docs/index.html` with `docs/.nojekyll`, and the absence of any `LICENSE`**); **nothing was cloned, no Python was installed, no script was run, no source was read, the bodies of the unnamed README sections were not read, no evaluation result was read, and neither its demo page nor the CBUAE website was visited**.

Legal correctness is not.」——四处已写明：①测的是检索质量（系统有没有给出人工标注为回答所必需的小节）；②明确不主张法律正确性并说明原因（判断法律上是否正确需要合格的合规专业知识，而作者没有也不主张拥有）；③基准真值是「需要哪些小节」而不是「法律说的是什么」，且每一个指标都由这个选择推出；④「这是一个刻意的设计决定而不是含糊其辞的退路，证据召回率任何打开语料的人都能客观复核，法律正确性则不能」——并注明这是本会话四条候选里对「只报别人能重算的数」表述得最完整的一处（不只选了能复核的指标，还说明了为什么另一个不能复核，并把后者明确排除在主张之外）；⭐⭐⭐研究问题逐字「Does hybrid retrieval with reranking improve evidence recall on multi-hop regulatory questions, compared with lexical or dense retrieval alone?」并逐字给出监管问题的多跳结构（一个关于经纪商风险管理义务的问题可能分别依赖确立义务的条款、界定例外的条款与另一份文件中规定报送要求的条款）与「Keyword search retrieves documents; it does not reliably assemble the complete evidence needed to answer.」；⭐⭐语料表逐字（Source: CBUAE Rulebook, Insurance section｜Documents 46｜Sections after parsing 763｜Chunks indexed 954（512-word budget, 64-word overlap）｜Words 206,705｜Date collected 2026-08-24）——三处已写明：「解析后的小节数被单独列出即从 46 份文件到可检索单元之间那一步被显式记账」「分块参数给了预算与重叠（重叠大小直接影响召回率故是必报参数）」「采集日期逐字给出（监管文本会更新，故这一天决定了结论的适用范围）」；⭐⭐基准呈现逐字「100 questions, the system’s real recorded output, scored against a human-labelled answer key.」——「演示页上的答案不是现场生成给人看的而是已记录的真实输出（与第 337 轮 insurance-qa-evidence 的没有把合成视频当作真实交互证据同属一类自律）」已写明；⭐⭐六项已完成工作逐字含「grounded answering with citation validation and abstention」与「the cross-reference graph」——「引用校验与拒答（系统可以选择不回答，可与第 334 轮 insurance-rag-assistant 的 answer_status、claimlens 的四类状态并读）」与「交叉引用图（把监管文本之间的引用关系也做成被评测的对象，与多跳直接对应）」两点已写明；⭐⭐⭐经下载 tarball 列出全部 113 个条目实测 scripts/ 下 16 个脚本：download_corpus.py／build_corpus.py／browse_corpus.py／enrich_registry.py／scope_check.py／validate_benchmark.py／**negative_control.py**／run_eval.py／run_answering.py／run_abstractive.py／run_graph_eval.py／report_results.py／export_demo.py／build_demo_page.py／build_graph.py／promote_drafts.py——三处值得单独记：①negative_control.py（负对照，即存在一个用来确认「不该有信号的地方确实没有信号」的脚本；这是本站条目里首次见到负对照被做成独立脚本，与「基线赢了」同属用对照物检验自己的方法）；②validate_benchmark.py 与 scope_check.py（基准本身也要被校验，而不只是一个被使用的输入）；③run_eval.py 与 run_answering.py 分开（检索评测与答案生成是两条独立的运行，与「测检索不等于测法律正确」的分工一致）；⭐代码结构与演示页实测：src/regulens/ 下含 api/（app.py、index.py、static/index.html）与 evaluation/；docs/ 下含 index.html 与 .nojekyll（即演示页托管在 GitHub Pages）；⭐自述定位逐字「This repository is a technical portfolio project. Nothing in it is legal, regulatory, or compliance advice.」（三项否定）；⚠️⚠️本次只读了 README 的开篇、状态、研究问题、测的是什么不是什么、语料表，以及全部章节标题——即未通读其 35,994 字节全文，尤其未读 Results／Benchmark／Systems compared／Answering: citations and abstention／Phase 6: the cross-reference graph／Limitations／Development／Build order 各节；故不转述任何结果数字（例如各系统召回率、四种架构排序或任何对照结论）——**这是本条目最大的缺口，也是最需要后续核实的一处**；⚠️⚠️未核实其任何评测结果与结论（包括其研究问题的答案、100 个问题的评分、以及两个实验失败具体指哪两个如何失败），本次未运行 run_eval.py、未读任何结果报告、未打开其演示页；⚠️⭐未核实其「人工标注的答案要点」是如何标注的（标注者是谁、标注规则是什么、是否有人复核、标注一致性如何）——而这恰恰是本条最关键的未知量：其全部指标都建立在「哪些小节是回答所必需的」这一判断上，而它是人的判断而不是可计算的量，**这是本条目第二个需要后续核实之处**；⚠️⭐未核实其「引用校验」与「拒答」的实现（系统在什么条件下拒答、拒答率多少、引用是否指向真实存在的小节），本次未读 run_answering.py 或任何评测代码；⚠️⭐未核实其语料的完整性（自述为 CBUAE 规则手册保险部分共 46 份文件、解析后 763 小节；本次未访问 CBUAE 网站、未比对官方文件数、未核实「保险部分」的边界如何划定），而这一点直接决定其结论的适用范围；⚠️本次核实到仓库元数据、README 的上述各节与全部章节标题、以及全部 113 个条目的文件清单；但未克隆、未安装 Python、未运行任何脚本、未读任何源码、未读 README 未读各节的正文、未读任何评测结果、未访问其演示页或 CBUAE 网站、未做任何检索或评测复核；⚠️未核实其与阿联酋央行、任何监管机构或任何实体的关系，亦未核实该项目是课程作业、个人项目还是受托工作，不主张其具有任何监管、法律或学术权威性；⚠️不主张其检索结论适用于任何其他监管语料（含中国、香港或其他法域的保险监管文本）——其结论受语料、分块参数（512/64）、问题集与标注方法约束；⚠️不主张其 100 个问题或其基准真值在任何意义上代表监管实务或合规判断——它们测的是能否检索到所需小节；★0、fork 0、创建於 2026-08-24、推送於 2026-09-07，关注度极低，不主张成熟度／正确性／已被採用；无 topics；README 为英语（已如实记入，本次未核实是否有阿拉伯语或中文版本；而其语料为英文监管文本，本次未核实 CBUAE 规则手册是否另有阿拉伯语正本）。核实手段补充说明：仓库全部 113 个条目经下载 codeload.github.com tarball 后以 tar tz 列出核对；未克隆、未安装 Python、未运行任何脚本、未读任何源码、未读 README 未读各节的正文、未读任何评测结果、未访问其演示页或 CBUAE 网站

entries.title: Application Fill 投保单自动填写：每条答案都带着来源文件、归因、置信度、推理与变换一起走，并把「95% 成功」标注为「客户反馈、不是字段准确率基准」
entries.title_en: Application Fill, automated insurance application completion: every answer travels with its source document, attribution, confidence, reasoning and transformation, and the reported 95% success is labelled as customer feedback rather than a field-accuracy benchmark
entries.title_hk: Application Fill 投保單自動填寫：每條答案都帶著來源文件、歸因、置信度、推理與變換一起走，並把「95% 成功」標註為「客戶反饋、不是字段準確率基準」
entries.summary: 一个把经纪人手上已有的资料自动填进保险公司投保单的工具：输入是一份已完成的投保单或一批提交文件，输出是保留原表单样式且仍可编辑的已填 PDF，凡是填进去的字段都带着字段级溯源与人工复核流程；作者自述其为经纪业务而建、已卖给经纪公司并是自用最多的工具之一；其证据表最值得记——每一行都有一个「范围」列，写明这个数字**不是**什么：「95% 成功」被标注为「客户反馈、由作者报告，不是字段准确率基准，样本量与标准化的成功定义都不在此列出」；「ACORD 表单 100% 准确」被标注为「由作者报告」且「本仓库不主张对每一份 ACORD 表单或专业险种表单都达到 100%」；专业险种那批的字段级指标「衡量的是与经纪实务成功率不同的人群与结果」；字段级溯源逐字为「来源文件、归因、置信度、推理与变换随每条答案一起走，而经纪人修改保留其自身的取值与编辑元数据」；评测纪律逐字含答案要点、关键字段计分、误填检查、空白段检查、来源缺口诊断与回归门
entries.summary_hk: 一個把經紀人手上已有的資料自動填進保險公司投保單的工具：輸入是一份已完成的投保單或一批提交文件，輸出是保留原表單樣式且仍可編輯的已填 PDF，凡是填進去的字段都帶著字段級溯源與人工覆核流程；作者自述其為經紀業務而建、已賣給經紀公司並是自用最多的工具之一；其證據表最值得記——每一行都有一個「範圍」列，寫明這個數字**不是**什麼：「95% 成功」被標註為「客戶反饋、由作者報告，不是字段準確率基準，樣本量與標準化的成功定義都不在此列出」；「ACORD 表單 100% 準確」被標註為「由作者報告」且「本倉庫不主張對每一份 ACORD 表單或專業險種表單都達到 100%」；專業險種那批的字段級指標「衡量的是與經紀實務成功率不同的人群與結果」；字段級溯源逐字為「來源文件、歸因、置信度、推理與變換隨每條答案一起走，而經紀人修改保留其自身的取值與編輯元數據」；評測紀律逐字含答案要點、關鍵字段計分、誤填檢查、空白段檢查、來源缺口診斷與回歸門
entries.summary_en: A tool that fills insurer application forms from information brokers already hold: the input is one completed application or a set of submission documents and the output is a filled PDF that preserves the original form and remains editable, with field-level provenance and a broker review workflow attached to everything that gets filled in; the author states it was built for brokerage work, sold into brokerages and used as one of his most-used tools; the most notable part is its evidence table, where every row carries a scope column stating what the number is not — the 95% success figure is labelled as customer feedback reported by the author rather than a field-accuracy benchmark, with sample size and a standardised success definition not included; the 100% accuracy on evaluated ACORD forms is labelled as author-reported, with the repository explicitly not claiming 100% on every ACORD form or specialty application; the specialty field-level metrics are said to measure a different population and outcome from brokerage-reported practical success; field-level provenance is described verbatim as source document, attribution, confidence, reasoning and transformation travelling with each answer, with broker edits retaining their own value and edit metadata; and its evaluation discipline includes answer keys, critical-field scoring, false-fill checks, blank-section checks, source-gap diagnostics and regression gates
entries.body:
**application-fill-provenance**（Application Fill，仓库 `maebied23/application-fill`）**是一个把保险经纪人手上已有的资料自动填进保险公司投保单的工具**：**实测 ★1、fork 数未核实、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 259 KB、创建于 2026-09-09、最后推送 2026-09-09、无 topics**（**⚠️ 本条元数据来自**搜索 API**，因**核心 API 配额在本轮用尽**——**见标注 ①**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 在 183 个条目中实测不存在——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**README 实测 10,343 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 183 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「**Insurance applications completed from the information brokers already have.** … Application Fill turns a completed application or a collection of submission documents into filled insurance PDFs, **with field-level provenance and a broker review workflow**.」**；**并逐字说明来历**：**「**I built this for brokerage work, sold it into brokerages, and used it as one of my most-used tools.** Customer brokerages reported a **95% success rate** when supplying submission documents or one completed application.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「每个值都要指回它的来源」**中的**第一种，也是四条里唯一**被商业化使用过**的一条**——**其溯源颗粒度是**字段级**。

可核实信息（**均 README 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其证据表是本条最值得记的一处，因为每一行都有一个**范围**列，写明这个数字**不是**什么**——**逐字实测**：**「Brokerage experience | **95% reported success** … | **Customer feedback reported by the author; not a field-accuracy benchmark. Sample size and a standardized success definition are not included here.**」**；**「Initial ACORD testing | **100% accuracy reported by the author on evaluated ACORD forms** | **Evaluation records will be added later. This repository does not claim 100% on every ACORD form or specialty application.**」**；**「Specialty expansion | … | **Their field-level metrics measure a different population and outcome from brokerage-reported practical success.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三行各拒绝一种过度解读**：**① **「95% 成功」被限定为**客户反馈、由作者报告**，**并明说不是字段准确率基准**，**且**样本量与标准化的成功定义都不在此列出****；**② **「100% 准确」被限定为**由作者报告**，**且**明确不主张对每一份 ACORD 表单或专业险种表单都达到 100%****（**⭐ 并逐字注明「评估记录将在稍后补充」——**即**这个数字当前没有可查的评估记录**）；**③ **专业险种那批的字段级指标**衡量的是**不同的人群与结果****（**⭐ 即**不许把两批数字混着引用**）**⭐⭐⭐ **本词条认为这是本站已收条目里**把「一个数字的适用范围」写得最清楚的一张表****——**它不删掉好看的数字，而是**在每个数字旁边写明它不能用在什么地方****（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**这三个数字本身**——**见标注 ③**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其字段级溯源逐字，且它点名了随每条答案走的**五项****——**逐字为**：**「**Field-level provenance: source document, attribution, confidence, reasoning and transformation travel with each answer. Broker edits retain their own value and edit metadata.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **五项逐一对应一个会被问到的问题**：**① **来源文件**（**哪个文件**）；**② **归因**（**文件的哪一处**）；**③ **置信度**（**有多确定**）；**④ **推理**（**为什么这么判**）；**⑤ **变换**（**做了哪些运算或改写**）**——**⭐ 而最后半句「经纪人修改保留其自身的取值与编辑元数据」是**同样重要**的一环：**人工改过的答案**不覆盖机器判断的痕迹，**而是**另有一套元数据****（**⭐ 对本轮主题而言，这保证的是**机器值与人改值各自的来处都不丢****）。**③ ⭐⭐ **其六步经纪人流程逐字，其中三步与溯源和可核对性直接相关**：**「**Review answers beside the PDF.** Select field overlays, filter flagged or unfilled answers, **inspect confidence and reasoning, and open source documents from attribution.**」**；**「**Edit and approve export.** Save broker corrections **with audit events** and regenerate the PDF.」**；**「**Finalize and download.** Generate the final artifact from current answers, **record its hash** and export statistics, and **obtain a signed download URL.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **在 PDF 旁边就能**从归因打开来源文件****——**⭐ 即**复核动作与证据在同一屏内完成**；**② **经纪人修改**记录审计事件****；**③ **最终产物**记录其哈希**——**⭐ 即**输出的那一份是可被指认的**（**与第 338 轮 [[amanat-telegraph-miner]] 的签名、[[claimscope-benchmark]] 的数据钉定同属一族**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「评测纪律」逐字列出了七项，是一份可直接借用的词汇表**——**逐字为**：**「**Evaluation discipline:** answer keys, **critical-field scoring**, **false-fill checks**, **blank-section checks**, **source-gap diagnostics**, cached/full pipeline modes and **regression gates**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **七项中四项值得单独记**：**① **关键字段计分**（**即**不是所有字段等权，**有些字段填错代价不同**）；**② **误填检查**（**⭐ 即**专门检查「不该填的被填了」**，**而不只是「该填的填了没」**——**与本站在第 337 轮 [[eom-aviation-pipeline]] 记录的「两个方向都查」同源**）；**③ **空白段检查**；**④ **来源缺口诊断**（**⭐ 即**专门定位「源文件里没有这个信息」的情形**，**从而把「填不出」与「填错」分开**）**⭐⭐ **对做表单抽取的同学，这四项比一个总准确率更有用**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其混合匹配的分工逐字，且给出了清晰的边界**——**逐字为**：**「**Hybrid matching:** AI identifies relevant facts and transformations; **code applies arithmetic, section gating, constraints and reuse checks**. **Deterministic spreadsheet parsing handles recognized schedules, with an AI fallback.**」**⭐⭐ **即**人工智能负责「找出相关事实与变换」，**代码负责「算术、分段门控、约束与复用检查」****——**⭐ 而确定性解析用于已识别的表格、AI 作为兜底**（**⭐ 这是本轮四条里唯一明确划出「哪一层由谁负责」的一条**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其 PDF 工程细节逐字，说明它不是提示词包装**：**「real AcroForm discovery; **application-fill-provenance**（Application Fill，倉庫 `maebied23/application-fill`）**是一個把保險經紀人手上已有的資料自動填進保險公司投保單的工具**：**實測 ★1、主語言 TypeScript、體量 259 KB、創建於 2026-09-09、最後推送 2026-09-09**（**⚠️ 本條元數據來自**搜索 API**，因**核心 API 配額在本輪用盡****）；**⚠️ 實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 在 183 個條目中實測不存在——屬「完全未聲明」形態）**；**README 實測 10,343 位元組（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 183 個條目**。**其自述逐字為**：**「**Insurance applications completed from the information brokers already have.** … **with field-level provenance and a broker review workflow**.」**；**並逐字說明來歷**：**「**I built this for brokerage work, sold it into brokerages, and used it as one of my most-used tools.**」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「每個值都要指回它的來源」**中的**第一種，也是四條裡唯一**被商業化使用過**的一條****——**其溯源顆粒度是**字段級**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其證據表最值得記，因為每一行都有一個**範圍**列，寫明這個數字**不是**什麼**——**逐字實測**：**「Brokerage experience | **95% reported success** … | **Customer feedback reported by the author; not a field-accuracy benchmark. Sample size and a standardized success definition are not included here.**」**；**「Initial ACORD testing | **100% accuracy reported by the author on evaluated ACORD forms** | **Evaluation records will be added later. This repository does not claim 100% on every ACORD form or specialty application.**」**；**「Specialty expansion | … | **Their field-level metrics measure a different population and outcome from brokerage-reported practical success.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三行各拒絕一種過度解讀**：**① **「95% 成功」被限定為**客戶反饋、由作者報告**，**並明說不是字段準確率基準**，**且**樣本量與標準化的成功定義都不在此列出****；**② **「100% 準確」被限定為**由作者報告**，**且**明確不主張對每一份 ACORD 表單或專業險種表單都達到 100%****（**⭐ 並逐字註明「評估記錄將在稍後補充」——**即**這個數字當前沒有可查的評估記錄**）；**③ **專業險種那批的字段級指標**衡量的是**不同的人群與結果******⭐⭐⭐ **本詞條認為這是本站已收條目裡**把「一個數字的適用範圍」寫得最清楚的一張表****——**它不刪掉好看的數字，而是在**每個數字旁邊寫明它不能用在什麼地方****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其字段級溯源逐字，且點名了隨每條答案走的**五項****——**逐字為**：**「**Field-level provenance: source document, attribution, confidence, reasoning and transformation travel with each answer. **application-fill-provenance** (Application Fill, repository `maebied23/application-fill`) **is a tool that fills insurer application forms from information an insurance broker already holds**: **measured ★1, TypeScript as the primary language, a 259 KB repository, created 2026-09-09 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**⚠️ this metadata comes from the **search API** because the core API quota was exhausted this round — see note ①**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file at all (`LICENSE` absent among the 183 entries — the "no statement whatever" form)**; **the README measures 10,343 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 183 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"**Insurance applications completed from the information brokers already have.** … **with field-level provenance and a broker review workflow**."**; **with its origin stated verbatim**: **"**I built this for brokerage work, sold it into brokerages, and used it as one of my most-used tools.**"** It is the first of this round’s four takes on **every value must point back to its source**, **and the only one that has been used commercially** — **its provenance granularity is the field**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its evidence table is the most notable part, because every row carries a scope column stating what the number is *not*** — **measured verbatim**: **"Brokerage experience | **95% reported success** … | **Customer feedback reported by the author; not a field-accuracy benchmark. Sample size and a standardized success definition are not included here.**"**; **"Initial ACORD testing | **100% accuracy reported by the author on evaluated ACORD forms** | **Evaluation records will be added later. This repository does not claim 100% on every ACORD form or specialty application.**"**; **"Specialty expansion | … | **Their field-level metrics measure a different population and outcome from brokerage-reported practical success.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three rows, each refusing a different over-reading**: **the 95% figure is confined to customer feedback reported by the author, explicitly not a field-accuracy benchmark, with sample size and a standardised success definition not included**; **the 100% figure is confined to author-reported, with the repository explicitly not claiming 100% on every ACORD form or specialty application** (⭐ **and noting verbatim that evaluation records will be added later — so the figure currently has no checkable record behind it**); **and the specialty field-level metrics are said to measure a different population and outcome, so the two sets of numbers may not be cited together** ⭐⭐⭐ **the entry considers this the clearest treatment of a number’s scope of applicability among the entries the site holds — it does not delete the flattering numbers, it writes beside each one where it may not be used** (**⚠️ the three figures themselves were not verified — see note ③**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its field-level provenance is verbatim and names the five things that travel with each answer** — **verbatim**: **"**Field-level provenance: source document, attribution, confidence, reasoning and transformation travel with each answer. Broker edits retain their own value and edit metadata.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **each of the five answers a question someone will ask — source document (which file), attribution (where in it), confidence (how sure), reasoning (why judged so), transformation (what arithmetic or rewriting was applied)** — ⭐ **and the final clause matters as much: a broker edit does not overwrite the trace of the machine judgement but carries its own metadata, so the origin of both the machine value and the human value is kept**. **③ ⭐⭐ Its six-step broker workflow is verbatim, and three steps bear directly on provenance and checkability**: **"**Review answers beside the PDF.** … **inspect confidence and reasoning, and open source documents from attribution.**"**; **"**Edit and approve export.** Save broker corrections **with audit events** …"**; **"**Finalize and download.** … **record its hash** and export statistics, and **obtain a signed download URL.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things: the source document can be opened from the attribution right beside the PDF, so review and evidence happen on one screen**; **broker corrections are saved with audit events**; **and the final artefact records its hash — the delivered copy is identifiable** (**the same family as round 338’s [[amanat-telegraph-miner]] signature and [[claimscope-benchmark]]’s pinned data**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its evaluation discipline lists seven items verbatim**: **"answer keys, **critical-field scoring**, **false-fill checks**, **blank-section checks**, **source-gap diagnostics**, cached/full pipeline modes and **regression gates**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four deserve separate note**: **critical-field scoring, so not all fields weigh the same**; **false-fill checks, which specifically look at what should not have been filled rather than only at what should have been** (**the same instinct as round 337’s [[eom-aviation-pipeline]] checking both directions**); **blank-section checks**; **and source-gap diagnostics, which separate "cannot be filled" from "filled wrongly"**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its hybrid-matching division of labour is verbatim**: **"AI identifies relevant facts and transformations; **code applies arithmetic, section gating, constraints and reuse checks**. **Deterministic spreadsheet parsing handles recognized schedules, with an AI fallback.**"** ⭐⭐ **AI finds the facts and transformations; code does the arithmetic, section gating, constraints and reuse checks**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its PDF engineering detail is verbatim**: **"real AcroForm discovery; coordinates and widget-to-page mapping; **nearby text enrichment for generic field names**; … **font sizing and overflow handling**"** ⭐⭐ **Two things**: **nearby-text enrichment for generic field names, because PDF form field names are often meaningless identifiers like `Text1` whose meaning can only be read from the printed wording beside them**; **and font sizing with overflow handling — the text has to fit**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its document paths and measured structure**: **completed applications, PDF policies and loss runs, Excel schedules and Word documents**; **six documents measurably present under `docs/`** (**ARCHITECTURE, EVALUATION, EXTRACTION, FEATURES, SETUP and **VALIDATION**), **plus `docs/evidence/` with subdirectories per form family** (**`docs/evidence/acord/README.md` is measurably present**), **and three manifest-type artefacts** (**`extraction-manifest.json`, `package-manifest.json` and **`specialty-baseline.json`**) ⭐⭐⭐ **Two things**: **evidence is organised per form family rather than piled into one folder**; **and `specialty-baseline.json` is a baseline snapshot, so "what it was before" is kept for later comparison**. **⑧ ⭐ Its starting point is verbatim**: **"Development first established strong performance on **ACORD forms**, then expanded into specialty applications through **progressively harder test cases**."** — ⭐ **start on the standard form, then add difficulty**. **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s form-standard, document-extraction and review-workflow entries**: [[acord]], [[acord-data-quality-monitor]], [[acord-mcp-architecture]], [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]], [[suture-vlm]], [[claims-intake-agent]], [[underwriting-workbench]], [[proof-protocol]] and [[insurance-qa-en]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Its metadata source needs explaining**: **the core API quota was exhausted this round**, **so the ★1 count, the language (TypeScript), the size (259 KB) and the created/pushed dates (both 2026-09-09) come from the **search API****; **⚠️ its fork count and topics were **not obtained** (**⚠️ this is an unverified item, not an absence of topics — recorded differently from the site’s other entries for that reason**). **② ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as none** — **`LICENSE` is absent among the 183 entries and the README has no licence section**, **the "no statement whatever" form**; **⚠️ the entry therefore advises confirming authorisation with the author before copying, modifying or redistributing its code, documentation or manifests**; ⭐ **and notes in particular that it says it was sold into brokerages, so ownership of its code and business logic may be constrained by commercial arrangements**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ None of its evidence figures were verified** (**including the 95% reported success, the 100% accuracy on evaluated ACORD forms, and the specialty field-level metrics**); **`docs/EVALUATION.md` was not read, nothing under `docs/evidence/acord/` was read, `docs/specialty-baseline.json` was not read, and no evaluation was run**; ⭐ **in particular, whether any evaluation record exists behind the 100% figure was not verified** (**the README says verbatim that evaluation records will be added later**). **④ ⭐⭐ The entry deliberately does not put "95%" or "100%" in a prominent position in its summary** — ⭐ **because the value of that evidence table lies precisely in the scope qualifiers it attaches to those numbers, and lifting the numbers out alone would discard exactly that**. **⑤ ⚠️⚠️ No source was read and no command was run** — **so the five provenance items, the hybrid-matching division, the PDF engineering detail, the six-step workflow and the seven evaluation disciplines are recorded only as the README states them**; ⭐ **what this check measured is that the files exist** (**six documents under `docs/`, `docs/evidence/acord/README.md`, three JSON manifests, `src/lib/ai/`, `package.json` and `.github/workflows/checks.yml`**) — **⚠️ but a file existing does not mean the logic and thresholds inside it are as documented**; **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **⑥ ⚠️** This check verified **the repository metadata (from the search API), the README in full, and the complete list of all 183 entries**; **the README’s opening and origin, its evidence table, the six-step broker workflow, the seven "what makes the implementation interesting" items, and the architecture diagram with the opening of the architecture section were read in detail**; ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install Node, run any command, read any source, read any document under `docs/`, read anything under `docs/evidence/`, read any JSON manifest, or open any interface**. **⑦ ⚠️ Its relationship to any brokerage, insurer or ACORD was not verified**; **no claim is made that it has been adopted by any named institution, is live, or has produced any actual application output**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its field-level provenance meets any audit, compliance or regulatory requirement**, **nor that it can replace a broker’s professional judgement** (**it describes itself verbatim as keeping the broker in control, with human review**). **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ Whether the data it handles involves real personal information was not verified**, **nor were its data-retention and privacy practices** (**⚠️ specifically: `docs/SECURITY.md` is **not** in this repository — it measurably belongs to the same author’s other repository, noted here to avoid confusion**). **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its approach applies to any specific form in a reader’s own setting**. **⑪ ⭐ At ★1, created and pushed on 2026-09-09**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⚠️ but it must also be said that it describes itself as sold into brokerages and used in practice — ⚠️ a claim this entry does not verify**. **⑫ The README is in English** — **recorded as such, and whether other language versions exist was not verified**. **Verification note**: the core API was exhausted this round (returning a rate limit error), **so metadata came from the search API and neither the fork count nor topics could be obtained**; the 10,343-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; **all 183 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com`; **nothing was cloned, no Node was installed, no command was run, no source or document content was read, and no interface was opened**.
