later，即在本次核实时点该记录尚未提供，本词条不主张该数字有任何可查依据）；⭐⭐本词条有意不把 95% 与 100% 写进摘要的显著位置，理由是其证据表的价值恰在于给这两个数字加了范围限定，而把数字单独摘出来正好会丢掉这个限定；⚠️⚠️未读任何源码、未运行任何命令——故字段级溯源五项、混合匹配分工、PDF 工程细节、六步流程与七项评测纪律全部只记录为 README 如此声明；已实测的只是相关文件确实存在（docs/ 下六份文档、docs/evidence/acord/README.md、三份 JSON 清单、src/lib/ai/、package.json、.github/workflows/checks.yml），但文件存在不等于其中的逻辑与门槛如文档所述，**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；⚠️本次核实到仓库元数据（来自搜索 API）、README 全文、以及全部 183 个条目的文件清单；本次通读了 README 的开篇与来历、证据表、经纪人六步流程、「实现上有意思的地方」七条、架构图与架构段落开头；但未克隆、未安装 Node、未运行任何命令、未读任何源码、未读 docs/ 下任何文档内容、未读 docs/evidence/ 下任何内容、未读任何 JSON 清单、未打开任何界面；⚠️未核实其与任何经纪公司、保险公司或 ACORD 的关系，不主张它被任何具名机构采用、已上线运营或已产生任何实际的投保单产出；⭐不主张其字段级溯源满足任何审计、合规或监管要求，亦不主张其可用于代替经纪人的专业判断（其自述逐字为 keeping the broker in control 与 Human review）；⚠️未核实其处理的数据是否涉及真实个人信息，亦未核实其数据留存与隐私做法——特别说明：docs/SECURITY.md 不在本仓库（实测它属同作者的另一个仓库），此处如实说明以免混淆；⚠️不主张其做法适用于本站读者所在场景的任何具体表单；★1、创建与推送均为 2026-09-09，关注度极低，不主张成熟度／正确性／已被採用；但须同时写明其自述已卖给经纪公司并在实务中使用——本词条不核实该说法（未查任何商业记录或客户评价），故既不主张其为真也不主张其为假；README 为英语（已如实记入，本次未核实是否有其他语言版本）。核实手段补充说明：核心 API 配额已用尽（返回 rate limit 错误），故元数据改用搜索 API 的值且未能取得 fork 数与 topics；仓库全部 183 个条目经下载 codeload.github.com tarball 后以 tar tz 列出核对；未克隆、未安装 Node、未运行任何命令、未读任何源码或文档内容、未打开任何界面

entries.title: QuoteLens 保单报价对照：溯源颗粒度细到「单元格→来源」，每个格子带文件、页码、摘录、字符偏移与原 PDF 分页，并且把禁用中的阶段与历史实现逐一标注出来而不是装作全都完整
entries.title_en: QuoteLens, insurance quote comparison: provenance down to cell-to-source, where every cell carries its document, page, excerpt, character offset and source PDF sheet, and where disabled stages and historical implementations are labelled rather than presented as uniformly complete
entries.title_hk: QuoteLens 保單報價對照：溯源顆粒度細到「單元格→來源」，每個格子帶文件、頁碼、摘錄、字符偏移與原 PDF 分頁，並且把禁用中的階段與歷史實現逐一標註出來而不是裝作全都完整
entries.summary: 一个把多份保险报价 PDF 做成可对照表格的工具：经 OCR、结构化抽取、按险种比较、校验、来源匹配与 Excel 导出之后，经纪人可以跨保险公司对比保障、查看某个数值背后的来源、就底层文件提问、并批准对对照结果的修改；其溯源颗粒度为「单元格→来源」——每个格子带文件引用、页码、摘录、字符偏移与源 PDF 分页，并有从副驾驶答案到表格的引用桥；其「工程透明度」一条逐字写明「活跃管线、继承下来的局限、**已禁用的阶段**与历史实现都被指明，而不是被统一呈现为完整」；它另逐字声明「不主张实测的生产准确率、响应时间保证或基准胜出」，并说明本地测试只验证特定的确定性行为，模型质量仍需在代表性文件上单独评测；演示样例逐字说明「不需要账号或 API 密钥，用的是真实的对照渲染器与溯源匹配器，配一份显式编写的参考结果；**它不模拟实时 AI 响应**」；仓库为更大应用的独立抽取，保留完整报价对照子系统、兜底算法、版本、审计设施与下游提案集成，无关产品与生产配置被排除
entries.summary_hk: 一個把多份保險報價 PDF 做成可對照表格的工具：經 OCR、結構化抽取、按險種比較、校驗、來源匹配與 Excel 導出之後，經紀人可以跨保險公司對比保障、查看某個數值背後的來源、就底層文件提問、並批准對對照結果的修改；其溯源顆粒度為「單元格→來源」——每個格子帶文件引用、頁碼、摘錄、字符偏移與源 PDF 分頁，並有從副駕駛答案到表格的引用橋；其「工程透明度」一條逐字寫明「活躍管線、繼承下來的局限、**已禁用的階段**與歷史實現都被指明，而不是被統一呈現為完整」；它另逐字聲明「不主張實測的生產準確率、響應時間保證或基準勝出」，並說明本地測試只驗證特定的確定性行為，模型質量仍需在代表性文件上單獨評測；演示樣例逐字說明「不需要賬號或 API 密鑰，用的是真實的對照渲染器與溯源匹配器，配一份顯式編寫的參考結果；**它不模擬實時 AI 響應**」；倉庫為更大應用的獨立抽取，保留完整報價對照子系統、兜底算法、版本、審計設施與下游提案集成，無關產品與生產配置被排除
entries.summary_en: A tool that turns multiple insurance quote PDFs into a comparable table: after OCR, structured extraction, line-of-business comparison, validation, source matching and Excel export, a broker can compare coverage across insurers, inspect the source behind a value, ask questions about the underlying documents and approve corrections to the comparison; its provenance granularity is cell-to-source, with each cell carrying a document reference, page, excerpt, character offset and source PDF sheet, plus a citation bridge from copilot answers into the table; one bullet states its engineering transparency verbatim — the active pipeline, inherited limitations, disabled stages and historical implementations are identified rather than presented as uniformly complete; it also states verbatim that it does not claim measured production accuracy, response-time guarantees or a benchmark win, and that local tests verify specific deterministic behaviours while model quality still requires separate evaluation on representative documents; the demo sample is described verbatim as needing no accounts or API keys and using the real comparison renderer and provenance matcher with an explicitly authored reference result, and it does not simulate a live AI response; and the repository is a standalone extraction of a larger application, retaining the complete quote-comparison subsystem along with its fallback algorithms, versioning, audit infrastructure and downstream proposal integration, with unrelated products and production configuration excluded
entries.body:
**quotelens-provenance**（QuoteLens，仓库 `maebied23/quotelens`）**是一个把多份保险报价 PDF 做成可对照表格的工具**：**实测 ★1、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 621 KB、创建于 2026-09-09、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**⚠️ 本条元数据来自**搜索 API**，因**核心 API 配额在本轮用尽****——**见标注 ①**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 在 325 个条目中实测不存在——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**README 实测 27,196 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 325 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「**Insurance quote comparison with line-specific gold standards, source-document provenance, and a copilot with human-approved edits.**」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「每个值都要指回它的来源」**中的**第二种，也是四条里**溯源坐标最细**的一条**——**其颗粒度是**单元格**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其溯源一行的六个坐标是本节最值得记的一处**——**逐字实测其功能表**：**「Provenance | **Per-cell document reference, page, excerpt, character offset, source PDF sheet, copilot citation navigation**」**⭐⭐⭐ **六项合起来使一个单元格可被精确定位到原文件的**具体位置****：**① 哪个文件**；**② 哪一页**；**③ 摘录**（**即原文那句话**）；**④ **字符偏移****（**⭐ 即**在这页的哪一段**——**这一项比页码细得多**）；**⑤ **源 PDF 分页**；**⑥ **从副驾驶答案到表格的引用桥**（**⭐ 即**提问得到答案后可以点回它引用的那个格子****）。**其目录中另有一节逐字为**「**Provenance: from a cell to its source**」**——**⭐ 即**这条链被当作一个**独立章节**来讲****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其「工程透明度」一条逐字，且它点名的是**「已禁用的阶段」****——**逐字为**：**「**Engineering transparency:** **the active pipeline, inherited limitations, disabled stages, and historical implementations are identified rather than presented as uniformly complete.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「活跃管线、继承下来的局限、**已禁用的阶段**与历史实现都被指明，而不是被统一呈现为完整」**——**⭐ 对本轮主题而言，这句话保证的是**读者不会把「界面上有这一项」误当成「这一项在跑」****；**⭐ 而这一条在本站已收条目里很少见**（**多数条目只说有什么，不说哪一部分没开**）。**而它**确实**在功能表里逐处标注**——**实测其表格中三处**：**① **Audit 行**末尾逐字为**「**final verification execution currently disabled**」**（**即**审计页存在但最终校验的执行当前是关闭的**）；**② **History 行**末尾逐字为**「**excluded from the running app**」**（**即**归档的原任务、原对照界面与产品线模板都不在运行中的应用里**）；**③ **Proposals 行**末尾逐字为**「**feature-flagged**」****⭐⭐⭐ **三处标注合起来说明：**同一张表里既有「已有」也有「当前不生效」**，**而有**feature-flagged／disabled／excluded** 三种不同性质的标注****（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**这三处标注在代码中是否属实**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「不主张什么」逐字，且是三项一起否掉**——**逐字为**：**「**This repository does not claim measured production accuracy, response-time guarantees, or a benchmark win.** Local tests verify specific deterministic behaviors; **model quality still requires separate evaluation on representative documents.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**①**不主张实测的生产准确率**；**②**不主张响应时间保证**；**③**不主张基准胜出****——**⭐ 而它同时给出了**本地测试能证明什么**的边界：**「本地测试验证的是特定的确定性行为」**，**而**模型质量需要在代表性文件上另行评测****（**⭐ 这与第 337 轮 [[insurance-qa-evidence]] 的「数据与局限」、第 338 轮 [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] 的「测的是什么、不是什么」是同一族写法**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其演示样例的说明逐字，且它点名了「不模拟」****——**逐字为**：**「The sample needs no accounts or API keys. **It uses the real comparison renderer and provenance matcher with an explicitly authored reference result; it does not simulate a live AI response.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「用的是真实的对照渲染器与溯源匹配器，配一份**显式编写**的参考结果；**它不模拟实时 AI 响应**」**——**⭐ 即**演示走的是真代码路径，**只有输入结果是预先写好的，**而这是**说明白了的****（**⭐ 与第 337 轮 [[insurance-qa-evidence]] 的「没有把合成视频当作原始交互证据」同属一类自律**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其仓库性质的声明逐字，且它把**保留了什么、排除了什么**都列出**——**逐字为**：**「This repository presents **a standalone extraction of a larger application**. It retains **the complete quote-comparison subsystem, its fallback algorithms, versioning, audit infrastructure, and downstream proposal integration**. **Unrelated products and production configuration are excluded. The original application is not required to run this project.**」**⭐⭐ **即**这是**从更大应用中抽出的独立子系统**，**保留五项**（**完整的报价对照子系统、兜底算法、版本、审计设施、下游提案集成**），**排除无关产品与生产配置**，**且**不依赖原应用即可运行****（**⭐ 对本轮主题的意义在于：**「这份仓库是整体中的哪一块」被写明了**，**故**读者不会把子系统当成完整产品**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其功能表覆盖面很广，其中四行与可核对性直接相关**——**逐字实测含**：**Quote intake**（多份报价 PDF、可选将到期保单、手动选择险种或自动检测）、**Processing**（后台任务、持久化状态、失败上报、重试与轮询）、**Extraction**（**OCR／表格解析、页码标记、按险种聚焦的提示、元数据抽取、**CGL 限额补救**、独立抽取校验**）、**V2 comparison**（**金标准引擎、逐险种规则、输出校验、分类器、确定性保障对齐、智能对齐兜底代码**）、**Comparison UI**（**保险公司卡片、相对基准指标、可折叠分段、摘要、建议、地点标签页／手风琴、原始抽取文本**）、**Copilot**（**文档搜索、表格提问、工具模式下的单元格／分段检索、来源追踪、建议问题、聊天历史、**提议的修改与确认／拒绝**）**⭐⭐ **其中四处值得记**：**① **「独立抽取校验」与「输出校验」**——**⭐ 即**抽取结果自身要被校验，而不只是被使用****；**② **「原始抽取文本」在界面上可见**（**⭐ 即**人可以对照原文看抽取得对不对**）；**③ **「相对基准指标」**（**⭐ 即**数字是相对某个基准给出的，而不是孤立的绝对值**）；**④ **「提议的修改与确认／拒绝」**——**⭐ 即**机器提修改、人决定**，**其在「人类控制」一条中逐字为**「**proposed edits are displayed before they are applied**」**（**⭐ **修改在应用之前先显示出来****）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其审计与版本方面的自述也值得记**：**Audit 行**逐字含**「Verification report model, score/status badges, audit page, change log, source checks and rate-analysis display」**（**⭐ 其中**来源检查**与**评分／状态徽章**是两条可核对性产物**）；**Lifecycle 行**逐字含**「Add a quote, create a new comparison version, inspect earlier versions, download version-specific Excel, delete comparisons」**（**⭐ **每个版本可分别下载对应的 Excel****——**即**版本的差异是可带走的**）；**Copilot 行**另有**「source tracing」****（**⭐ 即**答案可以回溯到来源**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **实测仓库结构**：**`docs/` 下八份文档**（**`ARCHITECTURE.md`、**`CODE_TOUR.md`**、`EXTRACTION.md`、**`FEATURE_MAP.md`**、`INTEGRATIONS.md`、**`KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md`**、`SECURITY.md`、**`VERIFICATION.md`**）**，**另有 `docs/extraction-manifest.json` 与 ⭐⭐ **`docs/verification-results.json`**（**一份**校验结果**产物**）**；**`src/lib/ai/`（含 `client.ts`）与 `src/lib/copilot/`**；**`package.json` 与 `.github/workflows/checks.yml`**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **`KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md` 与 `VERIFICATION.md` 各自独立成篇**（**⭐ 即**已知局限与校验是**两份要维护的文档**，而不是散落在 README 里**）；**② **`verification-results.json` 是机器可读的校验结果**（**⭐ 与第 338 轮 [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] 的结果数据文件同源**）；**③ **其 README 逐字给出「从哪开始」的引导**：**先跑 `/demo` 上的虚构样例，再看 `docs/CODE_TOUR.md`**——**⭐ 即**代码走读有一份专门的文档**。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站报价引擎、检索与核对条目并读**：[[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]、[[openrater]]、[[insurance-rag-assistant]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[proof-protocol]]、[[insurance-qa-en]]、[[application-fill-provenance]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **元数据来源与**同作者的姊妹条目相同**：**核心 API 配额在本轮用尽**，**故 ★数（1）、语言（TypeScript）、体量（621 KB）与创建／推送日期（均 2026-09-09）来自**搜索 API****；**⚠️ **未能取得其 fork 数与 topics****（**⚠️ 属**未核实**项，**而**不是**「无 topics」**）。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本条与 [[application-fill-provenance]] **出自同一作者**（`maebied23`），且均在 2026-09-09 创建与推送****——**⭐ 本词条**如实写明这一点****，**并说明本轮为何同时收录两条**：**按既定规则「不取同一作者的**兄弟仓库**」指的是**近重复**（**如第 336 轮跳过的 `Act-Gabe/GLM-Claims-Pricing` 与 `Claims-Pricing--GLM`**），**而这两个是**两个不同的产品**（**一个是投保单填写，一个是报价对照**），**共享的是溯源这一设计关切而非同一份代码****——**⚠️ 但本词条**不主张**这一判断无需复核**：**⭐ 建议后续核实**两者是否有大量共享代码或共享模块**（**若共享率高，则应考虑合并或只留其一**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **许可实测为**无****——**`LICENSE` 在 325 个条目中实测不存在**，**README 亦无许可章节**；**⚠️ 提示：**复制、修改或再分发其代码与文档前应先向作者确认授权****；**⭐ 并特别提示：**其 README **model quality still requires separate evaluation on representative documents.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **it also bounds what local tests can show** (**⭐ the same family as round 337’s [[insurance-qa-evidence]] "data and limits" and round 338’s [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] "what is measured, and what is not"**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its description of the demo sample is verbatim and names what it does not simulate**: **"The sample needs no accounts or API keys. **It uses the real comparison renderer and provenance matcher with an explicitly authored reference result; it does not simulate a live AI response.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **the demo runs real code paths, with only the input result written in advance — and that is stated** (**the same discipline as round 337’s [[insurance-qa-evidence]] and its refusal to present synthetic video as original interaction evidence**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its statement of what the repository is, is verbatim**: **"**a standalone extraction of a larger application**. It retains **the complete quote-comparison subsystem, its fallback algorithms, versioning, audit infrastructure, and downstream proposal integration**. **Unrelated products and production configuration are excluded. The original application is not required to run this project.**"** ⭐⭐ **which part of the whole this repository is, is written down, so a subsystem is not mistaken for a complete product**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its feature table is broad, and four rows bear directly on checkability** — **verbatim including**: **Extraction** (OCR and table parsing, page markers, line-focused prompts, metadata extraction, **CGL limit rescue**, standalone extraction verification); **V2 comparison** (**gold-standard engine, per-line rules, output validation, taxonomy classifier, deterministic coverage alignment, intelligent-alignment fallback code**); **Comparison UI** (**insurer cards, baseline-relative indicators, collapsible sections, summaries, recommendations, location tabs and accordions, original extracted text**); **Copilot** (document search, table questions, cell and section retrieval in tool mode, **source tracing**, suggested questions, chat history, **proposed edits with confirmation and rejection**) ⭐⭐ **Four things worth noting**: **standalone extraction verification and output validation, so extracted results are themselves verified rather than merely used**; **the original extracted text is visible in the interface, so a person can check the extraction against the source**; **baseline-relative indicators, so figures are given relative to a baseline rather than in isolation**; **and proposed edits with confirmation and rejection** — **stated verbatim in its human-control bullet as "**proposed edits are displayed before they are applied**"**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its audit and versioning statements are also worth noting**: **the Audit row contains verbatim "Verification report model, score/status badges, audit page, change log, source checks and rate-analysis display"** (**source checks and score/status badges being two checkability artefacts**); **the Lifecycle row contains verbatim "Add a quote, create a new comparison version, inspect earlier versions, download version-specific Excel, delete comparisons"** (**each version’s Excel can be downloaded separately, so version differences are portable**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Measured repository structure**: **eight documents under `docs/`** (**ARCHITECTURE, **CODE_TOUR**, EXTRACTION, **FEATURE_MAP**, INTEGRATIONS, **KNOWN_LIMITATIONS**, SECURITY and **VERIFICATION**), **plus `docs/extraction-manifest.json` and ⭐⭐ `docs/verification-results.json`**; **`src/lib/ai/` with `client.ts` and `src/lib/copilot/`**; **`package.json` and `.github/workflows/checks.yml`** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: **`KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md` and `VERIFICATION.md` are documents in their own right, so known limits and verification are maintained rather than scattered through the README**; **`verification-results.json` is machine-readable verification output, the same family as round 338’s [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] results file**; **and the README gives a where-to-start: run the fictional sample at `/demo`, then read `docs/CODE_TOUR.md`**. **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s quoting-engine, retrieval and verification entries**: [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]], [[openrater]], [[insurance-rag-assistant]], [[ratecraft]], [[proof-protocol]], [[insurance-qa-en]] and [[application-fill-provenance]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ The metadata source is the same as for the sibling entry by the same author**: **the core API quota was exhausted this round**, **so ★1, the language (TypeScript), the size (621 KB) and the created/pushed dates (both 2026-09-09) come from the **search API****; **⚠️ its fork count and topics were **not obtained** (**an unverified item and not an absence of topics**). **② ⚠️⚠️ This entry and [[application-fill-provenance]] are by the **same author** (`maebied23`) and were both created and pushed on 2026-09-09** — ⭐ **the entry says so plainly**, **and explains why both are included this round**: **the standing rule against sibling repositories from one author targets near-duplicates** (**such as round 336’s `Act-Gabe/GLM-Claims-Pricing` and `Claims-Pricing--GLM`, skipped for that reason**), **whereas these are two different products — one fills applications, one compares quotes — sharing a design concern about provenance rather than a codebase** — **⚠️ but the entry does not claim that judgement needs no re-check**: ⭐ **it suggests verifying later whether the two share substantial code or modules, in which case they should be merged or reduced to one**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as none** — **`LICENSE` is absent among the 325 entries and the README has no licence section**; **⚠️ the entry advises confirming authorisation with the author before copying, modifying or redistributing its code or documentation**; ⭐ **and notes in particular that the README describes it as a subsystem extracted from a larger application, so ownership of that upstream application and any commercial arrangements may also constrain its code**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ None of its features or claims were verified** — **that is, the six cell-to-source coordinates, the three disabled/excluded/feature-flagged labels, the eight documents, and the contents of `verification-results.json`**; **no source was read, no document under `docs/` was read, no JSON artefact was read, `/demo` was not run, and no test or verification was run**; ⭐ **what this check measured is that those files exist** — **⚠️ but a file existing does not mean the behaviour inside it is as documented**; **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **⑤ ⚠️⭐ Its statement that final verification execution is currently disabled was not verified** — **⚠️ if true, its audit capability is currently incomplete**; ⭐ **which is exactly the kind of labelling praised in point ②, and verifying it requires reading the code** (**not done here**). **⑥ ⚠️⭐ The accuracy of its provenance was not verified** (**whether the character offsets and page numbers really point at that sentence in the source file, and whether the copilot’s citation bridge points at cells that really exist**); ⭐ **this is the second thing to verify next here, because it is the entry’s central contribution to this round’s theme**. **⑦ ⚠️** This check verified **the repository metadata (from the search API), the README’s opening, its contents list, the six "what the project demonstrates" bullets, the thirteen-row feature table and the paragraph describing `/demo`** — ⭐ **that is, its full 27,196 bytes were not read through**; ⭐⭐ **and it did not clone, install Node, run any command or test, read any source, read any document under `docs/`, read any JSON artefact, run the sample, or open any interface**. **⑧ ⚠️ Its relationship to any insurer, brokerage or quote data source was not verified**; **no claim is made that it has been adopted by any institution, is live, or has produced any actual comparison**; **nor whether the quote documents it handles involve real client data** (**`docs/SECURITY.md` was not read**). **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its provenance implementation meets any audit, compliance or regulatory requirement**, **nor that its comparisons can be used to give any advice to a client**. **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its line-specific gold standards approach applies to other markets or lines**. **⑪ ⭐ At ★1, created and pushed on 2026-09-09**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**. **⑫ The README is in English** — **recorded as such, and whether other language versions exist was not verified**. **Verification note**: the core API returned a rate limit error this round, **so metadata came from the search API and neither the fork count nor topics could be obtained**; the 27,196-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` for the sections named above; **all 325 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**confirming the eight `docs/` documents, `docs/extraction-manifest.json`, `docs/verification-results.json`, `src/lib/ai/client.ts`, `src/lib/copilot/`, `package.json` and `.github/workflows/checks.yml`, and the absence of any `LICENSE`**); entries.title: Assurance Toto 法国车险数字孪生：一个由 8 个智能体代运营、CEO 保留高风险决定的模拟保险公司——每个动作都是密码学签名事件，全部可追溯靠一条哈希链追加审计日志与端到端的 correlation_id
entries.title_en: Assurance Toto, a digital twin of a French car insurer: a simulated insurer run by eight agents with the CEO retaining high-stakes decisions, where every action is a cryptographically signed event and full traceability rests on a hash-chained append-only audit log plus an end-to-end correlation_id
entries.title_hk: Assurance Toto 法國車險數字孿生：一個由 8 個智能體代運營、CEO 保留高風險決定的模擬保險公司——每個動作都是密碼學簽名事件，全部可追溯靠一條哈希鏈追加審計日誌與端到端的 correlation_id
entries.summary: 一个法国车险公司的「数字孪生」：它模拟一家 50 人的数字化车险公司并以多智能体组织的方式运行——人类 CEO 通过一个基于 Nostr 的工作台与一个精简驾驶舱监督，8 个业务智能体（销售、核保、理赔与诉讼、财务、客服、市场、合规、编排）在本地大模型上执行工作流；其治理机制逐字为「每个动作都是密码学签名事件；每一个高风险决定（超过阈值的理赔结案、定价例外、杀死开关）都需要 CEO 明确批准」，全部可追溯性靠「一条哈希链式追加审计日志与一个端到端的 correlation_id」；其定位声明把边界写得很直白——「这是一个可在沙箱运行的、面向合规的**演示器**，它**没有**取得 ACPR／RGPD 认证，且**不处理真实个人数据**（100% 合成 Faker 数据）」；仓库以 Apache-2.0 发布并含一条 CI 工作流，其智能体运行时含一个隐私匿名化模块
entries.summary_hk: 一個法國車險公司的「數字孿生」：它模擬一家 50 人的數字化車險公司並以多智能體組織的方式運行——人類 CEO 通過一個基於 Nostr 的工作台與一個精簡駕駛艙監督，8 個業務智能體（銷售、核保、理賠與訴訟、財務、客服、市場、合規、編排）在本地大模型上執行工作流；其治理機制逐字為「每個動作都是密碼學簽名事件；每一個高風險決定（超過閾值的理賠結案、定價例外、殺死開關）都需要 CEO 明確批准」，全部可追溯性靠「一條哈希鏈式追加審計日誌與一個端到端的 correlation_id」；其定位聲明把邊界寫得很直白——「這是一個可在沙箱運行的、面向合規的**演示器**，它**沒有**取得 ACPR／RGPD 認證，且**不處理真實個人數據**（100% 合成 Faker 數據）」；倉庫以 Apache-2.0 發布並含一條 CI 工作流，其智能體運行時含一個隱私匿名化模組
entries.summary_en: A "digital twin" of a French car insurance company: it simulates a fifty-employee digital car insurer running as a multi-agent organisation, where the human CEO supervises through a Nostr-based workspace and a lean cockpit while eight business agents (sales, underwriting, claims and litigation, finance, support, marketing, compliance and orchestration) execute workflows on a local model; its governance mechanism reads verbatim that every action is a cryptographically signed event and that every high-stakes decision — claim settlement above a threshold, pricing exceptions, the kill-switch — requires explicit CEO approval, with full traceability resting on a hash-chained append-only audit log and an end-to-end correlation_id; its positioning statement states the boundary plainly, calling itself a sandbox-ready, compliance-oriented demonstrator that is not ACPR or GDPR certified and that does not process real personal data, using one hundred percent synthetic Faker data; the repository is released under Apache-2.0 with a CI workflow, and its agent runtime includes a privacy anonymisation module

**assurance-toto-twin**（Assurance Toto，仓库 `leosand/assurance-toto`）**是一个法国车险公司的「数字孪生」**：**实测 ★0、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 51,865 KB、创建于 2026-07-24、最后推送 2026-09-07**（**⚠️ 本条元数据来自**搜索 API**，因**核心 API 配额在本轮用尽****——**见标注 ①**）；**⭐ 许可实测为 **Apache-2.0**，且 `LICENSE` 经 tarball 实测存在**（**本会话少见的一处**许可齐备****）；**README 已获取（本次读取其开篇）**；**仓库实测共 264 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「A commercial-grade **digital twin** of a French car insurance company operated by a CEO assisted by a **fleet of autonomous AI agents** — with **mandatory human control, full cryptographic traceability, and compliance-oriented by design**.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「每个值都要指回它的来源」**中的**第三种，也是四条里**溯源颗粒度落在「动作」上**的一条**——**它记录的不是一个字段或一个单元格的来处，**而是**每一个动作的来处**。

可核实信息（**均 README 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其运行规模的描述逐字且具体，含人数、智能体数与模型**——**逐字为**：**「Assurance Toto simulates a **50-employee digital car insurer** run as a multi-agent organization:」**；**「A **CEO (human)** supervises via a **Nostr-based workspace (Buzz)** and a lean CEO cockpit.」**；**「**8 business agents**（**sales, underwriting, claims & litigation, finance, support, marketing, compliance, orchestration**）execute workflows on a **local LLM (Ollama, `gemma4:e4b`)**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **人类 CEO 与 8 个智能体的分工**被写成了一个组织的形态**（**而不是一个「AI 助手」**）；**② **本地大模型**（**Ollama**）**——**⭐ 与其「零付费 API 依赖」的主张一致**；**③ **合规（compliance）是 8 个智能体之一**（**⭐ 即**合规被建模成一个**有自己的职能的部门**，而不是散在各处的检查项**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其治理机制逐字，且它是本条对溯源主题的核心贡献**——**逐字为**：**「**Every action is a cryptographically signed event**; **every high-stakes decision (claim settlement above a threshold, pricing exceptions, kill-switch) requires explicit CEO approval.**」**；**「Full traceability via a **hash-chained append-only audit log** and an **end-to-end `correlation_id`**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① **每个动作都签名**（**即**动作本身可被指认**）；**② **三类高风险决定被点名**（**超过阈值的理赔结案、定价例外、杀死开关**）**——**⭐ 而这三类恰好对应本行最敏感的三件事：赔、价、停****；**③ **哈希链式追加审计日志**（**⭐ 与第 336 轮 [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] 的「追加式哈希链审计，触发器拒绝 UPDATE/DELETE」是同一机制**）；**④ **端到端的 `correlation_id`**（**⭐ 即**一次业务请求穿过多个智能体与多个部门之后，其全部动作仍可被串回同一条线上****）**⭐⭐⭐ **第 ④ 点对本轮主题尤其重要**：**在**多智能体**系统里，「这个结果是谁做出来的」比在单进程系统里难得多**，**而 `correlation_id` 是把这句话变成可回答问题的机制****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其定位声明逐字，且它在一段里同时否掉两件事**——**逐字为**：**「> ⚠️ **Honest positioning** : this is a **sandbox-ready, compliance-oriented demonstrator**. It is **not ACPR/RGPD-certified** and **does not process real personal data (100 % synthetic Faker data)**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **自称「演示器」而不是产品**；**② **明确**没有取得 ACPR／RGPD 认证****（**⭐ ACPR 是法国审慎监管与处置局、RGPD 是欧盟通用数据保护条例**——**即**它点名了两个具体的、与法国车险最相关的监管／合规框架，并说自己都没拿到**）；**③ **明确**不处理真实个人数据、100% 合成数据****（**⭐ 与第 336 轮 [[claims-integrity-investigator]] 的「Synthetic, obviously fictional data only」、[[inforsight]] 的「fictional」同族**）**⭐⭐⭐ **对做智能体保险应用的同学，这一段是**可直接照搬的定位写法**：**它不掩饰自己是什么，**并且把两个最容易被人误以为已经满足的门槛**逐一点名否掉****。**④ ⭐⭐ **其商业定位的表述也逐字，但它把「卖点」与「不是什么」分开写**——**逐字为**：**「It is a **sellable demo** for French/EU auto insurers, brokers, insurtechs and transformation consultancies — designed to prove : reduced cost per claim, faster underwriting, shorter response time, **human control on high-risk decisions**, **sovereign self-hosted deployment**, and **zero paid API dependency**.」**⭐⭐ **即**它列了五项要证明的东西，**其中两项是**约束**而不是**收益****（**人类对高风险决定的控制、主权自托管部署**）——**⭐ 对本行读者，这是一个**把「合规与主权」当作卖点而不是成本**的样本**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**这五项中任何一项是否真的被证明**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **实测其智能体运行时的结构，且其中一个模块值得单独记**——**实测 `agents/_runtime/` 下含**：**`Dockerfile`、`README.md`、`package-lock.json`、`package.json`，以及 `src/` 下** `bridge/client.ts`、`composition.ts`、`config.ts`、`db/client.ts`、`index.ts`、`llm/ollama.ts`、`logger.ts`、**`privacy/anonymize.ts`**、`runtime/agent.ts`**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **`llm/ollama.ts`**——**⭐ 即**模型接口是针对**本地 Ollama** 写的**，**与其「零付费 API 依赖」一致**；**② ⭐ **`privacy/anonymize.ts`**——**⭐ 即**隐私匿名化是运行时的**一个独立模块**，**而不是一句声明**（**⭐ 这与第 ③ 点的「不处理真实个人数据」配套：**合成数据是一层，**匿名化模块是另一层**）；**③ **`logger.ts` 与 `bridge/client.ts` 分开**——**⭐ 即**日志与外部桥接各有其位**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读任何源码**，**故**不主张这些模块的功能如其名**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其技术栈逐字（以徽章形式列出）**：**TypeScript（标注为 Strict）**、**Nostr（协议）**、**Buzz by Block（驾驶舱）**、**Ollama（本地模型）**、**PostgreSQL 16**、**Docker Compose（部署）**⭐⭐ **其中三处值得记**：**① **TypeScript 标注为 Strict**（**即**开了严格模式**）；**② **PostgreSQL 16** 作为数据库**（**与第 336 轮 [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] 同源：**把不变式放在数据库层**）；**③ **Docker Compose 部署 + 本地模型**（**⭐ 即**「主权自托管」在技术栈上是有落点的**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其 README 另有两条徽章需要如实指出**：**一条逐字为**「**Tests: 75**」（**其图片地址形如 `img.shields.io/badge/tests-75%20green-…`**）**，**另一条逐字为**「**API: 0 paid dependency**」****⭐⭐ **⚠️ 本词条须指出：**「Tests: 75 green」是一张**静态徽章****（**shields.io 的 `/badge/` 静态接口**）**——**⭐ 即**它不测量任何东西，**无论测试实际是否通过都会显示为绿色****（**⚠️ 本次**未查其 CI 的实际运行结果**，**故**既不主张其 75 个测试通过，也不主张其未通过**）**；**⭐ 这与第 337 轮 [[inforsight]] 的「CI passing」静态徽章是**同一类问题**，**故本词条在此同样如实标注**（**⚠️ 本词条**不推断**作者是否有意如此**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **实测其仓库另含一条 CI 工作流**：**`.github/workflows/ci.yml`**（**实测存在**）**——**⭐ 即**它**确实有** CI 配置**，**故**那张静态徽章的问题**不是「没有 CI」，而是「徽章不反映 CI」****。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站治理、开源核心系统与合规智能体条目并读**：[[insurance-governance]]、[[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]]、[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[openimis]]、[[quorumforge]]、[[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]]、[[claims-integrity-investigator]]、[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]]、[[acpr]]、[[institut-des-actuaires]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **元数据来源需要说明**：**核心 API 配额在本轮用尽**，**故 ★数（0）、许可（Apache-2.0）、语言（TypeScript）、体量（51,865 KB）与创建／推送日期（2026-07-24／2026-09-07）来自**搜索 API****；**⚠️ **未能取得其 fork 数与 topics****（**⚠️ 属**未核实**项，**而**不是**「无 topics」**）；**⭐ README 的**字节数本次未测量**（**只读取了开篇**），**故本词条**不给其 README 规模数字****。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**只读了 README 的开篇与「它是什么」「AI 运营的保险组织」「人类控制与治理」各节的**开头****——**⭐ 即**本次**未通读其 README 全文**，**也未读其 `docs/`（若有）下任何内容****；**故**本词条所述内容限于上述各节**——**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何源码、未运行任何命令、未做任何密码学核实****——**⚠️ 故**「每个动作都是密码学签名事件」「哈希链式追加审计日志」「端到端 `correlation_id`」「三类高风险决定需 CEO 明示批准」四项**全部只记录为 README 如此声明****；**⭐ 本词条**已实测的只是**相关文件与目录确实存在****（**`LICENSE`、`.github/workflows/ci.yml`、`agents/_runtime/` 及其下九个源文件含 `privacy/anonymize.ts` 与 `llm/ollama.ts`**）**——**⚠️ 但**文件存在不等于其中的机制如文档所述**；**⭐ 尤其**未核实**其签名与哈希链的密码学实现是否正确或安全****（**本词条**不建议**任何人据此实现生产系统**）。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其「8 个智能体」是否确实都在运行、各自的权限如何、以及**杀死开关**是否真的可用**；**⚠️ 本次**未运行其 Docker Compose、未读其配置、未做任何实际调用****。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**其「100% 合成 Faker 数据」这一声明**——**⚠️ 本次**未读任何数据文件或数据生成代码****；**⭐ 而这一点直接关系到它是否可以被安全地公开演示**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其数据确实全部为合成**）。**⑥ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**其「不是 ACPR／RGPD 认证」这一否定的反面**——**⭐ 即**本词条**不主张**它**未**满足任何具体监管要求**（**⚠️ 本次**未查 ACPR 或 RGPD 的任何条款**）；**⚠️ 只记录它自己声明没有认证**。**⑦ ⚠️ **本次核实的是**仓库元数据（**来自搜索 API**）、README 的开篇与上述各节开头、以及仓库全部 264 个条目的文件清单**；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 Docker／Node／PostgreSQL、未运行任何命令、未启动任何智能体、**未读任何源码、未读其 `agents/_runtime/README.md`、未读 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的内容、未访问其任何界面或 Nostr 工作台****。**⑧ ⚠️ **未核实**其与 ACPR、任何法国或欧盟监管机构、任何保险公司或任何咨询机构的关系**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**它已被任何机构采用、已售出、已试点或已产生任何实际的保险运营效果**（**⭐ 其自述用词为「sellable demo」与「demonstrator」，**即**定位是演示**）。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其「数字孪生」这一定性在精算或运营意义上成立**——**⚠️ 本次**未核实**其是否复现了任何真实车险公司的流程、口径或数据分布**；**⭐ 对本行读者，一个「数字孪生」若不在业务口径上对应现实，**则其演示价值主要在**架构与治理**，而不在**业务结论****（**⚠️ 本词条据此建议按其治理设计而非其业务输出阅读本项目**）。**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其技术选择（本地模型、Nostr 工作台、Docker Compose）在任何意义上优于云端方案**——**只记录其自述理由（主权自托管、零付费 API 依赖）**。**⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其是否处理任何真实的客户数据或是否涉及任何真实保单**（**其自述为纯合成数据，**本词条只记录该声明**）。**⑫ ⭐ ★0、创建于 2026-07-24、推送于 2026-09-07**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑬ ⭐ 许可为 **Apache-2.0** 且 `LICENSE` 实测存在**——**⭐ 与本轮其他三条对照：**[[application-fill-provenance]]、[[quotelens-provenance]] 与 [[bill-auditor-india]] 实测**均无许可文件****；**⑭ **README 为英语**（**其内容涉及法国市场，**⚠️ 本次未核实是否有法语版本**）。**核实说明**：核心 API 于本轮返回 rate limit 错误，**故元数据改用**搜索 API** 的值，且未能取得 fork 数与 topics**；README 经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测读取开篇与上述各节开头；**仓库全部 264 个条目**经下载 `codeload.github.com` tarball 后以 `tar tz` 列出核对（**用于确认 `LICENSE`、`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 与 `agents/_runtime/` 下九个源文件均存在**）；**未克隆、未安装 Docker／Node／PostgreSQL、未运行任何命令、未启动任何智能体、未读任何源码、未做任何密码学核实、未做任何网络或 Nostr 请求**。

**assurance-toto-twin** (Assurance Toto, repository `leosand/assurance-toto`) **is a "digital twin" of a French car insurance company**: **measured ★0, TypeScript as the primary language, a 51,865 KB repository, created 2026-07-24 and last pushed 2026-09-07** (**⚠️ this metadata comes from the **search API** because the core API quota was exhausted this round**); ⭐ **licence measured as **Apache-2.0** with `LICENSE` measurably present** (**an uncommon case of a complete licence in this session**); **the repository measures 264 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"A commercial-grade **digital twin** of a French car insurance company operated by a CEO assisted by a **fleet of autonomous AI agents** — with **mandatory human control, full cryptographic traceability, and compliance-oriented by design**."** It is the third of this round’s four takes on **every value must point back to its source**, **and the one whose provenance granularity is the action** — **it records not where a field or a cell came from but where each action came from**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its operating scale is described verbatim and concretely, including headcount, agent count and model** — **verbatim**: **"Assurance Toto simulates a **50-employee digital car insurer** run as a multi-agent organization:"**; **a local model, consistent with its zero-paid-API claim**; **and compliance is one of the eight agents — modelled as a department with its own remit rather than as checks scattered elsewhere**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its governance mechanism is verbatim, and it is the entry’s core contribution to the theme** — **verbatim**: **"**Every action is a cryptographically signed event**; ⭐ **`privacy/anonymize.ts`, so anonymisation is a runtime module rather than a sentence** (**synthetic data is one layer and an anonymisation module is another**); **and `logger.ts` separated from `bridge/client.ts`** (**⚠️ no source was read, so these modules are not claimed to do what their names suggest**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its stack is verbatim as badges**: **TypeScript (marked Strict), Nostr (protocol), Buzz by Block (cockpit), Ollama (local model), PostgreSQL 16 and Docker Compose (deployment)** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: **TypeScript in strict mode**; **PostgreSQL 16, the same family as round 336’s [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] in putting invariants in the database layer**; **and Docker Compose with a local model, so sovereign self-hosting has a technical landing point**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Two further badges must be noted plainly**: **"**Tests: 75**" (with an image URL of the form `img.shields.io/badge/tests-75%20green-…`) and **"**API: 0 paid dependency**"** ⭐⭐ **⚠️ the entry notes that "Tests: 75 green" is a **static badge**, so it measures nothing and shows green regardless of whether the tests pass** (**⚠️ its actual CI result was not checked, so the 75 tests are claimed neither to pass nor to fail**); ⭐ **the same class of problem as round 337’s [[inforsight]] "CI passing" badge** (**no inference is drawn about intent**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ The repository also measurably contains a CI workflow**: **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`** — ⭐ **so it does have CI configured; entries.title: Bill Auditor 印度健康险账单逐条审核：对每一项扣减都点出背后的条款，条款不明就转人工而不猜；并把「伪造条款引用」立为一条必须保持为零的指标——理由是这是读者读不出来的那一种错
entries.title_en: Bill Auditor, line-by-line audit of Indian health insurance bills: it names the clause behind every deduction, flags a line for a human rather than guessing when no clause clearly applies, and treats fabricated clause citations as a metric that must stay at zero — because that is the one error a reader cannot catch by reading
entries.title_hk: Bill Auditor 印度健康險賬單逐條審核：對每一項扣減都點出背後的條款，條款不明就轉人工而不猜；並把「偽造條款引用」立為一條必須保持為零的指標——理由是這是讀者讀不出來的那一種錯
entries.summary: 一个逐条审核印度健康险理赔账单的工具：它把账单与治理该保单的条款逐项对照，**对每一项扣减都点出背后的条款**，**而在没有条款明确适用时把该行转人工，而不是猜一个**；其自述结果的一条纪律逐字为「以下每一个数字都是 eval/results.md 里的一行；这里没有任何数字被四舍五入、被跨次运行平均、或从更早版本沿用」；其头条结果是 44 张账单、328 行，版本记录为 v11-zero-limit-guardrail，后端为本地 qwen3:8b——**行准确率 55.2%、引用准确率 43.2%、赔付误差 56.4%、拒答召回率 90.0%、误答 3 条、回避 117 条、而伪造条款引用为 0**；它另逐字要求读者「在引用 55.2% 之前先读 KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md 第 6、7 节」，因为其答案要点是**由模型导出而非人工撰写**，并把最受影响的 72 行拿回保单 PDF 复核、72 行全查、0 行改动；其对「伪造引用」的处理最值得记：跨 v0 到 v12 全部 17 行记录**零伪造**，理由逐字为「一个引用了索引中不存在的条款的引用，是这个系统能产生的最严重失败，因为它是读者读不出来的那一种」
entries.summary_hk: 一個逐條審核印度健康險理賠賬單的工具：它把賬單與治理該保單的條款逐項對照，**對每一項扣減都點出背後的條款**，**而在沒有條款明確適用時把該行轉人工，而不是猜一個**；其自述結果的一條紀律逐字為「以下每一個數字都是 eval/results.md 裡的一行；這裡沒有任何數字被四捨五入、被跨次運行平均、或從更早版本沿用」；其頭條結果是 44 張賬單、328 行，版本記錄為 v11-zero-limit-guardrail，後端為本地 qwen3:8b——**行準確率 55.2%、引用準確率 43.2%、賠付誤差 56.4%、拒答召回率 90.0%、誤答 3 條、迴避 117 條、而偽造條款引用為 0**；它另逐字要求讀者「在引用 55.2% 之前先讀 KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md 第 6、7 節」，因為其答案要點是**由模型導出而非人工撰寫**，並把最受影響的 72 行拿回保單 PDF 複核、72 行全查、0 行改動；其對「偽造引用」的處理最值得記：跨 v0 到 v12 全部 17 行記錄**零偽造**，理由逐字為「一個引用了索引中不存在的條款的引用，是這個系統能產生的最嚴重失敗，因為它是讀者讀不出來的那一種」
entries.summary_en: A tool that audits Indian health insurance claim bills line by line: it checks the bill against the policy that governs it and names the clause behind every deduction, flagging a line for a human rather than guessing when no clause clearly applies; one discipline in its results is verbatim — every figure below is a row in `eval/results.md`, and nothing is rounded, averaged across runs or carried over from an earlier version; its headline result is 44 bills and 328 lines, recorded as `v11-zero-limit-guardrail` with a local `qwen3:8b` backend — line accuracy 55.2%, citation accuracy 43.2%, payout error 56.4%, abstention recall 90.0%, 3 false answers, 117 dodges and zero fabricated clause citations; it also instructs readers verbatim to read sections 6 and 7 of `KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md` before quoting the 55.2%, because its answer key was derived by a model rather than written by a human, and it read the 72 rows most exposed to that back against the policy PDFs, checking all 72 with none changed; and its handling of fabricated citations is the most notable part — zero across every recorded version from v0 to v12, all 17 rows, on the stated ground that a citation naming a clause absent from the index is the worst failure the system can produce because it is the one a reader cannot catch by reading
entries.body:
**bill-auditor-india**（Bill Auditor，仓库 `pavansai2608/bill-auditor`）**是一个逐条审核印度健康险理赔账单的工具**：**实测 ★0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 31,246 KB、创建于 2026-08-31、最后推送 2026-09-08**（**⚠️ 本条元数据来自**搜索 API**，因**核心 API 配额在本轮用尽****——**见标注 ①**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 在 353 个条目中实测不存在——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**README 实测 15,395 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 353 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「Audits an Indian health insurance claim bill against the policy that governs it, **line by line, and names the clause behind every deduction**. **Where no clause clearly applies, the line is flagged for a human rather than guessed at.**」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「每个值都要指回它的来源」**中的**第四种，也是四条里**把「指不出来就别答」写成硬规则**的一条****——**其溯源颗粒度是**条款**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其开篇两句就把本条的两条纪律说完了**——**①**逐条对照保单并**点出每一项扣减背后的条款****；**②**没有条款明确适用时**转人工而不是猜****——**⭐ 而这两句合起来正是本轮主题的完整表述：**每个扣减都要指回一个条款，**指不回去的就不给结论****（**⭐ 可与第 334 轮 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的「人工报价／不符合承保条件」、[[insurance-rag-assistant]] 的 `answer_status`、第 338 轮 [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] 的「拒答」并读**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其结果的呈现纪律逐字，且它把三个「不」写在一起**——**逐字为**：**「**Every figure below is a row in [`eval/results.md`](eval/results.md). Nothing here is rounded, averaged across runs, or carried over from an earlier version.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「没有任何数字被四舍五入、被跨次运行平均、或从更早版本沿用」**——**⭐ 对本轮主题而言，这三条各自封掉一种**让数字看起来更好**的做法****（**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站已收条目里**对「数字是怎么来的」表述得最简短也最硬的一句****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其头条结果表逐字实测，且版本、日期、后端与硬件口径齐全**——**版本逐字记录为** **`v11-zero-limit-guardrail`**，**日期 2026-09-04**，**后端 `ollama (qwen3:8b)`**，**检索 `cpu`**；**规模为** **44 bills, 328 lines**；**逐项为**：**「**Line accuracy**（allowed within Rs 1）| **55.2%**」**；**「Citation accuracy | **43.2%**」**；**「Payout error | **56.4%**」**；**「**Abstention recall**（flagged when it should）| **90.0%**」**；**「False answers（answered, should have flagged）| **3**」**；**「Dodges（flagged, key has an answer）| **117**」**；**「**Fabricated clause citations** | **0**」**⭐⭐⭐ **五处值得记**：**① **行准确率 55.2% 被如实放在头条**（**⭐ 一个刚过半的数**，**没有被包装**）；**② **它把拒答与误答分开计**（**拒答召回率 90.0%** 与 **误答 3 条**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **它另计一项「回避」（dodges）——「被转人工、而答案要点里其实有答案」共 117 条****（**⭐ 即**它不只惩罚「该转没转」，**也**计量「不该转却转了」**——**⭐ 这与第 337 轮 [[eom-aviation-pipeline]] 的「两个方向都查」、第 339 轮 [[application-fill-provenance]] 的「误填检查」是**同一条纪律的第三次出现****）；**④ **赔付误差 56.4% 也被列出**；**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **而伪造条款引用单列一项，值为 0****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「伪造引用」一节是本条最值得单独记住的一段，且它给出了**为什么这一类错最严重**的理由**——**逐字为**：**「**0 fabricated citations across every recorded version, v0 through v12** — all 17 rows in `results.md`. **A citation naming a clause that does not exist in the index is the worst failure this system can produce, because it is the one a reader cannot catch by reading.** **It is tracked as a metric that must stay at zero, and it has.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **跨 17 行记录、v0 到 v12 全部为零****（**⭐ 即**它把这一项当作**跨版本持续跟踪**的指标**，**而不只是一次运行的结果**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「一个引用了索引中不存在的条款的引用，是这个系统能产生的最严重失败，**因为它是读者读不出来的那一种**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条候选里**对「什么样的错最危险」回答得最准的一句****：**一个**看起来完整**的引用**（有条款号、有出处、读起来通顺）**而实际不存在**，**读者**无法通过阅读发现它****（**⭐ 对比之下，赔付算错可以被复算、拒答可以被复核，**而伪造引用**只能靠回查索引**）；**③ **「它被当作一条必须保持为零的指标来跟踪，而它保持了」****——**⭐ 即**这一项**不是「表现不错」，而是**一条不许破的线****。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「引用本数字之前先读什么」的说明逐字，且它承认了答案要点的**来处问题****——**逐字为**：**「**Read [`KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md`](KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md) sections 6 and 7 before quoting 55.2% anywhere.** It is scored against an **answer key that was derived by a model rather than written by a human**, and the section below says **what that does and does not let the number mean**. **The 72 rows most exposed to it were later read back against the policy PDFs** — [`eval/answer_key_verified.md`](eval/answer_key_verified.md), **72 of 72 checked, 0 changed.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **它给读者下了一条**引用规则**（**引用 55.2% 之前先读某文档的第 6、7 节**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是很少见的做法：**作者对「自己的数字该怎么被引用」提出了要求****；**② ⭐⭐ **它承认答案要点**由模型导出而非人工撰写****（**⭐ 即**评分标准本身不是人写的**——**这是一个很实在的自我披露**）；**③ **它说明该限制**允许与不允许**这个数字意味着什么**（**⭐ 即**不是「请谨慎使用」，而是**给出了可判定的边界****）；**④ ⭐⭐ **它把最受影响的 72 行拿回保单 PDF 复核，**72 行全查、0 行改动****（**⭐ 即**它对自己的评分标准做了一次**人工抽样复核**并公布了结果**）**⭐⭐⭐ **第 ④ 点对本轮主题尤其重要**：**它不只报告了指标，**还报告了指标的**依据被复核到什么程度****（**⭐ 而实测其 `eval/` 下确实有一族答案要点文档：**`answer_key.json`、**`answer_key_provenance.md`**、`answer_key_review.md`、`answer_key_todo.md`、**`answer_key_verified.md`****——**⭐ 其中 `answer_key_provenance.md` 与 `answer_key_verified.md` 两份的存在本身，说明**评分标准的来处与复核各有其记录****）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其演示与托管的边界逐字，且它说明了**为什么表单是禁用的****——**逐字为**：**「**Live at <https://pavansai2608.github.io/bill-auditor/>.** The interface and **one recorded example report** are there, **served as static files**. **The audit itself is not publicly hosted**: it searches a **399-clause index** and puts every line to an **8B model**, which needs a machine rather than a CDN, so **the form on that site is disabled and points at the quickstart below**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **线上只有界面与**一份已记录的示例报告**，**且是静态文件****；**② ⭐⭐ **它明说「审计本身没有公开托管」，并给出原因**（**要检索一个 **399 条款**的索引并把每一行交给一个 8B 模型，需要一台机器而不是 CDN**）；**③ **因此站点上的表单是**禁用**的，**并指向快速开始文档****（**⭐ 即**它没有做一个「能点但会失败」的表单**——**⭐ 这与第 337 轮 [[insurance-qa-evidence]] 的「被机器人拦截不算死链」、第 336 轮 [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] 的「省略而非留桩」同属一族：**能力不在，就把入口关掉并说明****）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **实测其评测与工程结构，其中四处值得记**——**实测 `eval/` 下含**：**`answer_key.json`、`answer_key_provenance.md`、`answer_key_review.md`、`answer_key_todo.md`、`answer_key_verified.md`、`audit_profile.py`、以及 **91 份账单 JSON**（`bills/B01.json`…）**；**根目录含 `KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md` 与**四份按子系统拆分的依赖文件**（**`requirements-audit.txt`、`requirements-gateway.txt`、`requirements-ingestion.txt`、`requirements-retrieval.txt`**，**外加 `requirements.txt`**）**；**`tests/e2e/` 下含 `browser_flow.py`、`capture_screenshots.py`、**`contrast_check.py`**；**`docs/` 下含四张截图**（`site-landing-1440.png`、**`audit-1440.png`**、**`jenkins-main-green.png`**、**`jenkins-prune-blocked.png`**）；**`.github/workflows/pages.yml`**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐ **`answer_key_todo.md` 与 `answer_key_review.md` 的存在说明**评分标准的完善是一个仍在进行的过程**（**有待办、有复核记录**）；**② ⭐⭐ **依赖按四个子系统拆成四份文件**——**⭐ 即**审计、网关、摄取、检索各自的依赖分开管理**（**⭐ 对做工程的读者，这比一份大的 requirements 更能说明其结构**）；**③ ⭐ **`contrast_check.py` **bill-auditor-india**（Bill Auditor，倉庫 `pavansai2608/bill-auditor`）**是一個逐條審核印度健康險理賠賬單的工具**：**實測 ★0、主語言 Python、體量 31,246 KB、創建於 2026-08-31、最後推送 2026-09-08**（**⚠️ 本條元數據來自**搜索 API**，因**核心 API 配額在本輪用盡****）；**⚠️ 實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 在 353 個條目中實測不存在——屬「完全未聲明」形態）**；**README 實測 15,395 位元組（英語）**；**倉庫實測共 353 個條目**。**其自述逐字為**：**「Audits an Indian health insurance claim bill against the policy that governs it, **line by line, and names the clause behind every deduction**. **Where no clause clearly applies, the line is flagged for a human rather than guessed at.**」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「每個值都要指回它的來源」**中的**第四種，也是四條裡**把「指不出來就別答」寫成硬規則**的一條****——**其溯源顆粒度是**條款**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其開篇兩句就把本條的兩條紀律說完了**——**①**逐條對照保單並**點出每一項扣減背後的條款****；**②**沒有條款明確適用時**轉人工而不是猜****——**⭐ 兩句合起來正是本輪主題的完整表述：**每個扣減都要指回一個條款，指不回去的就不給結論****（**可與第 334 輪 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的「人工報價／不符合承保條件」、[[insurance-rag-assistant]] 的 `answer_status`、第 338 輪 [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] 的「拒答」並讀**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其結果的呈現紀律逐字，且它把三個「不」寫在一起**：**「**Every figure below is a row in [`eval/results.md`](eval/results.md). Nothing here is rounded, averaged across runs, or carried over from an earlier version.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「沒有任何數字被四捨五入、被跨次運行平均、或從更早版本沿用」**——**⭐ 這三條各自封掉一種**讓數字看起來更好**的做法****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其頭條結果表逐字實測，且版本、日期、後端與硬件口徑齊全**：**版本 `v11-zero-limit-guardrail`**，**日期 2026-09-04**，**後端 `ollama (qwen3:8b)`**，**檢索 `cpu`**；**規模 44 bills, 328 lines**；**逐項為** **Line accuracy（allowed within Rs 1）55.2%／Citation accuracy 43.2%／Payout error 56.4%／Abstention recall（flagged when it should）90.0%／False answers（answered, should have flagged）3／Dodges（flagged, key has an answer）117／Fabricated clause citations 0**⭐⭐⭐ **五處值得記**：**① 行準確率 55.2% 被如實放在頭條（一個剛過半的數，沒有被包裝）**；**② **拒答與誤答分開計（拒答召回率 90.0% 與誤答 3 條）****；**③ ⭐⭐ **另計一項「迴避」（dodges）——被轉人工、而答案要點裡其實有答案共 117 條——即**它不只懲罰「該轉沒轉」，也計量「不該轉卻轉了」****（**⭐ 與第 337 輪 [[eom-aviation-pipeline]] 的「兩個方向都查」、本輪 [[application-fill-provenance]] 的「誤填檢查」是同**一條紀律的第三次出現****）；**④ 賠付誤差 56.4% 也被列出**；**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ 偽造條款引用單列一項，值為 0**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「偽造引用」一節最值得單獨記，且它給出了**為什麼這一類錯最嚴重**的理由**：**「**0 fabricated citations across every recorded version, v0 through v12** — all 17 rows in `results.md`. **A citation naming a clause that does not exist in the index is the worst failure this system can produce, because it is the one a reader cannot catch by reading.** **It is tracked as a metric that must stay at zero, and it has.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① 跨 17 行記錄、v0 到 v12 全部為零**（**⭐ 即**把它當作**跨版本持續跟蹤**的指標**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「一個引用了索引中不存在的條款的引用，是這個系統能產生的最嚴重失敗，**因為它是讀者讀不出來的那一種**」**——**⭐ 本詞條認為這是本輪四條候選裡**對「什麼樣的錯最危險」回答得最準的一句****：**一個**看起來完整**的引用（有條款號、有出處、讀起來通順）而實際不存在，**讀者**無法通過閱讀發現它****（**對比之下，賠付算錯可以被複算、拒答可以被複核**）；**③ 「它被當作一條必須保持為零的指標來跟蹤，而它保持了」**——**即**這一項**不是「表現不錯」，而是一條不許破的線****。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「引用本數字之前先讀什麼」的說明逐字，且它承認了答案要點的**來處問題****：**「**Read [`KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md`](KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md) sections 6 and 7 before quoting 55.2% anywhere.** It is scored against an **answer key that was **bill-auditor-india** (Bill Auditor, repository `pavansai2608/bill-auditor`) **is a tool that audits Indian health insurance claim bills line by line**: **measured ★0, Python as the primary language, a 31,246 KB repository, created 2026-08-31 and last pushed 2026-09-08** (**⚠️ this metadata comes from the **search API** because the core API quota was exhausted this round**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file at all (`LICENSE` absent among the 353 entries — the "no statement whatever" form)**; **the README measures 15,395 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 353 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"Audits an Indian health insurance claim bill against the policy that governs it, **line by line, and names the clause behind every deduction**. **Where no clause clearly applies, the line is flagged for a human rather than guessed at.**"** It is the fourth of this round’s four takes on **every value must point back to its source**, **and the one that turns "if you cannot point to it, do not answer" into a hard rule** — **its provenance granularity is the clause**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its opening two sentences state both of its disciplines** — **it checks the bill against the governing policy line by line and names the clause behind every deduction, and where no clause clearly applies it flags the line for a human rather than guessing** — ⭐ **together those two sentences are the complete statement of this round’s theme: every deduction must point back to a clause, and what cannot be pointed back gets no conclusion** (**readable with round 334’s [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] and its manual-quote and not-eligible states, [[insurance-rag-assistant]] and its `answer_status`, and round 338’s [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] and its abstention**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its presentation discipline for results is verbatim, with three negations in one sentence** — **verbatim**: **"**Every figure below is a row in [`eval/results.md`](eval/results.md). Nothing here is rounded, averaged across runs, or carried over from an earlier version.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **nothing is rounded, averaged across runs, or carried over from an earlier version — three ways of making a number look better, each closed off** (⭐ **the entry considers this the shortest and hardest statement the site holds of where a number comes from**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its headline results table is measured verbatim, with version, date, backend and hardware stated** — **version `v11-zero-limit-guardrail`**, **date 2026-09-04**, **backend `ollama (qwen3:8b)`**, **retrieval on cpu**; **scale 44 bills and 328 lines**; **row by row**: **Line accuracy (allowed within Rs 1) 55.2%; Citation accuracy 43.2%; Payout error 56.4%; Abstention recall (flagged when it should) 90.0%; False answers (answered, should have flagged) 3; Dodges (flagged, key has an answer) 117; Fabricated clause citations 0** ⭐⭐⭐ **Five things worth noting**: **line accuracy of 55.2% is reported at the top as it is, a figure barely over half, unpackaged**; **abstention and false answers are counted separately**; ⭐⭐ **a further metric counts dodges — lines flagged for a human where the answer key does have an answer, 117 of them — so it penalises not only failing to flag when it should but also flagging when it should not** (⭐ **the third appearance of the same discipline, after round 337’s [[eom-aviation-pipeline]] checking both directions and this round’s [[application-fill-provenance]] false-fill checks**); **payout error of 56.4% is listed too**; **and ⭐⭐⭐ fabricated clause citations are a row of their own, with a value of zero**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ The fabricated-citation section is the most notable passage, and it gives the reason such an error is the worst** — **verbatim**: **"**0 fabricated citations across every recorded version, v0 through v12** — all 17 rows in `results.md`. **A citation naming a clause that does not exist in the index is the worst failure this system can produce, because it is the one a reader cannot catch by reading.** **It is tracked as a metric that must stay at zero, and it has.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: **zero across 17 recorded rows from v0 to v12 — tracked across versions rather than in a single run**; ⭐⭐⭐ **"it is the one a reader cannot catch by reading" is the entry’s pick for the round’s most accurate answer to which error is most dangerous: a citation that looks complete — clause number, source, readable prose — but names something that does not exist cannot be found by reading** (**whereas a payout error can be recomputed and an abstention reviewed**); **and it is tracked as a line that must not be crossed rather than as a good result**. **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Its note on what to read before quoting the number admits a problem with the answer key’s own provenance** — **verbatim**: **"**Read [`KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md`](KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md) sections 6 and 7 before quoting 55.2% anywhere.** It is scored against an **answer key that was derived by a model rather than written by a human** … **The 72 rows most exposed to it were later read back against the policy PDFs** — [`eval/answer_key_verified.md`](eval/answer_key_verified.md), **72 of 72 checked, 0 changed.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐ **the author places a condition on how his own number may be cited**; ⭐⭐ **he concedes that the answer key was derived by a model rather than written by a human**; **he states what that does and does not let the number mean**; **and ⭐⭐ the 72 rows most exposed to it were read back against the policy PDFs — all 72 checked, none changed, a manual sampling review of his own scoring basis**. ⭐⭐⭐ **That last point matters most here: the entry reports not only the metric but how far the metric’s basis was reviewed** (⭐ **and its `eval/` measurably holds a family of answer-key documents: `answer_key.json`, **`answer_key_provenance.md`**, `answer_key_review.md`, `answer_key_todo.md` and **`answer_key_verified.md`**, whose existence means the scoring basis has both a provenance record and a verification record**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its hosting boundary is verbatim, and it explains why the form is disabled** — **verbatim**: **"**Live at <https://pavansai2608.github.io/bill-auditor/>.** The interface and **one recorded example report** are there, **served as static files**. **The audit itself is not publicly hosted**: it searches a **399-clause index** and puts every line to an **8B model**, which needs a machine rather than a CDN, so **the form on that site is disabled and points at the quickstart below**."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: **only the interface and one recorded example report are online, as static files**; ⭐⭐ **it says outright that the audit itself is not publicly hosted, with the reason**; **and so the form on the site is disabled and points at the quickstart** — ⭐ **no form that can be clicked but will fail, the same family as round 337’s [[insurance-qa-evidence]] and its bot-blocked results, and round 336’s [[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] and "omitted, not stubbed"**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its evaluation and engineering structure is measured, with four things worth noting**: **`eval/` holds `answer_key.json`, `answer_key_provenance.md`, `answer_key_review.md`, `answer_key_todo.md`, `answer_key_verified.md`, `audit_profile.py` and **91 bill JSONs** (`bills/B01.json` onward)**; **the root holds `KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md` and **four requirement files split by subsystem** (`requirements-audit.txt`, `requirements-gateway.txt`, `requirements-ingestion.txt`, `requirements-retrieval.txt`, plus `requirements.txt`)**; **`tests/e2e/` holds `browser_flow.py`, `capture_screenshots.py` and **`contrast_check.py`****; **`docs/` holds four screenshots** (`site-landing-1440.png`, **`audit-1440.png`**, **`jenkins-main-green.png`** and **`jenkins-prune-blocked.png`**); **and `.github/workflows/pages.yml`** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐ **`answer_key_todo.md` and `answer_key_review.md` show the scoring basis is still being completed**; ⭐⭐ **dependencies split four ways by subsystem**; ⭐ **`contrast_check.py` in the end-to-end tests means interface contrast is tested too, an accessibility concern**; **and the four screenshots are readable by name, with `jenkins-prune-blocked.png` indicating a CI gate that blocks a prune** (**⚠️ the image was not read; only its filename is recorded**). **⑧ ⭐ The traceability of its scoring basis is also worth noting**: **`eval/answer_key_provenance.md` is measurably present, so the answer key has a provenance record of its own** (⭐ **directly on theme: even the choice of what counts as the correct answer has to say where it came from**); **and `audit_profile.py` exists**. **⑨ ⭐⭐ The two figures of a 399-clause index and an 8B model are recorded as stated and not inferred** — **⚠️ neither the index’s composition, nor whether it really holds 399 clauses, nor the model’s actual configuration was verified**. **⑩ ⭐ Readable with the site’s insurance-retrieval, clause and claims entries**: [[insurance-rag-assistant]], [[insqabench]], [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]], [[rag-assurance]], [[evidence-review-claims]], [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]], [[proof-protocol]], [[insurance-qa-en]] and [[clausegraph]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Its metadata source needs explaining**: **the core API quota was exhausted this round**, **so ★0, the language (Python), the size (31,246 KB) and the created/pushed dates (2026-08-31 and 2026-09-08) come from the **search API****; **⚠️ its fork count and topics were **not obtained** (**an unverified item and not an absence of topics**). **② ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as none** — **`LICENSE` is absent among the 353 entries and the README has no licence section**, **the "no statement whatever" form**; **⚠️ the entry advises confirming authorisation with the author before copying, modifying or redistributing its code, answer keys or bill data**; ⭐ **and notes in particular that `eval/bills/` holds **91 bill JSONs** whose subject is the structure of real Indian health insurance claim bills** — **⚠️ whether those bills are synthetic, de-identified or real was not verified**, **so the entry claims neither that they may be redistributed nor that they may not** (**⭐ verifying the data source and de-identification is suggested**). **③ ⚠️⚠️ Only the README’s opening, its results section (headline table and fabricated-citation passage) and its demo and hosting paragraph were read** — ⭐ **its full text was not read through, nor `KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md` (especially sections 6 and 7), nor any file under `eval/`, nor any bill JSON, nor any test or script**; **so the entry is limited to those sections — this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ None of its result figures were verified** (**including line accuracy 55.2%, citation accuracy 43.2%, payout error 56.4%, abstention recall 90.0%, 3 false answers, 117 dodges and zero fabricated citations**); **`eval/results.md` was not read, no evaluation was run, `audit_profile.py` was not read, and its demo page was not visited**; ⭐ **in particular, the claim of zero fabricated citations across all 17 rows from v0 to v12 was not verified — the entry’s most worthwhile candidate for independent re-checking, since it is a cross-version consistency claim**. **⑤ ⚠️⭐ The actual configuration of its 399-clause index and 8B model was not verified**, **nor its retrieval method**. **⑥ ⚠️⭐ How far the answer key really was model-derived was not verified** (**whether entirely model-derived or human-machine mixed, and how the 72-of-72 checked, zero-changed verification was carried out**); ⭐ **this is the second thing to verify next here, because every figure in the table rests on that answer key as its denominator**. **⑦ ⚠️** This check verified **the repository metadata (from the search API), the README sections named above, and the complete list of all 353 entries**; ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install Python, run any command or evaluation, read any source, read `KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md`, read any file under `eval/`, read any bill JSON, read any test, or visit its demo page or any external link**. **⑧ ⚠️ Its relationship to any insurer, third-party administrator, hospital or regulator was not verified**; **no claim is made that it has been adopted, is live, or has been used for any real claim review**. **⑨ ⭐⭐ One risk must be written out**: **⚠️ the tool’s output is a judgment about the clause basis of claim deductions — if the zero-fabricated-citations line were broken in some version, or if the "no clear clause means refer to a human" rule were bypassed, it could produce denial reasons that look supported but are not**; ⭐ **the entry therefore does not claim it is usable for any real claim review, denial or payment decision, nor that its output could be relied on against any policyholder or provider** (**no Indian insurance regulatory or consumer-protection requirement was consulted**). **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its approach applies to other jurisdictions or lines of business** — **⚠️ its clause system, bill structure and currency (rupees) are specific to India**; ⭐ **for readers wanting to reuse the approach on Chinese or Hong Kong medical bills, the clause index and answer key would have to be rebuilt**. **⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ Whether the data it handles involves real personal information was not verified**. **⑫ ⭐ At ★0, created 2026-08-31 and pushed 2026-09-08**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⚠️ but it must also be said that it reports results recorded across v0 to v12, 17 rows — the project has indeed been evaluated across versions** (**⭐ supported by the measurably present `eval/` directory with its 91 bill JSONs**). **⑬ ⭐ Topics not obtained**. **⑭ The README is in English** — **recorded as such, and whether a Hindi or other language version exists was not verified**. **Verification note**: the core API returned a rate limit error this round, **so metadata came from the search API and neither the fork count nor topics could be obtained**; the 15,395-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` for the sections named above; **all 353 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**confirming `KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md`, the five answer-key documents and `audit_profile.py` plus the 91 bill JSONs under `eval/`, the four subsystem requirement files, `src/bill_auditor/`, three scripts under `tests/e2e/`, four screenshots under `docs/` and `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, and the absence of any `LICENSE`**); **nothing was cloned, no Python was installed, no command or evaluation was run, no source or document was read, no bill JSON was read, and its demo page was not visited**.

It is tracked as a metric that must stay at zero, and it has.」——三处已写明：①跨 17 行记录、v0 到 v12 全部为零（即把它当作跨版本持续跟踪的指标）；②⭐「一个引用了索引中不存在的条款的引用，是这个系统能产生的最严重失败，因为它是读者读不出来的那一种」——本词条认为这是本轮四条候选里对「什么样的错最危险」回答得最准的一句，并注明「对比之下，赔付算错可以被复算、拒答可以被复核，而伪造引用只能靠回查索引」；③「它被当作一条必须保持为零的指标来跟踪，而它保持了」（即这一项不是「表现不错」，而是一条不许破的线）；⭐⭐⭐「引用本数字之前先读什么」逐字「Read KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md sections 6 and 7 before quoting 55.2% anywhere. It is scored against an answer key that was derived by a model rather than written by a human … The 72 rows most exposed to it were later read back against the policy PDFs — eval/answer_key_verified.md, 72 of 72 checked, 0 changed.」——四处已写明：①⭐它给读者下了一条引用规则（作者对自己的数字该怎么被引用提出了要求）；②⭐它承认答案要点由模型导出而非人工撰写；③它说明该限制允许与不允许这个数字意味着什么；④⭐它把最受影响的 72 行拿回保单 PDF 复核、72 行全查、0 行改动（即对自己的评分标准做了一次人工抽样复核并公布了结果）；并特别写明第④点对本轮主题的意义：它不只报告了指标，还报告了指标的**依据被复核到什么程度**（实测其 eval/ 下有 answer_key.json、⭐⭐answer_key_provenance.md、answer_key_review.md、answer_key_todo.md、answer_key_verified.md——其中 provenance 与 verified 两份的存在本身说明评分标准的来处与复核各有其记录）；⭐⭐演示与托管的边界逐字「Live at https://pavansai2608.github.io/bill-auditor/. The interface and one recorded example report are there, served as static files. The audit itself is not publicly hosted: it searches a 399-clause index and puts every line to an 8B model, which needs a machine rather than a CDN, so the form on that site is disabled and points at the quickstart below.」——三处已写明：①线上只有界面与一份已记录的示例报告且是静态文件；②⭐它明说「审计本身没有公开托管」并给出原因；③因此站点上的表单是禁用的并指向快速开始文档（即没有做一个「能点但会失败」的表单，与第 337 轮 insurance-qa-evidence 的「被机器人拦截不算死链」、第 336 轮 blueeconomy-marine-insurance 的「省略而非留桩」同族）；⭐⭐实测其评测与工程结构，四处值得记：eval/ 下含 answer_key.json／answer_key_provenance.md／answer_key_review.md／answer_key_todo.md／answer_key_verified.md／audit_profile.py 与**91 份账单 JSON**（bills/B01.json…）；根目录含 KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md 与**四份按子系统拆分的依赖文件**（requirements-audit／gateway／ingestion／retrieval.txt，外加 requirements.txt）；tests/e2e/ 下含 browser_flow.py／capture_screenshots.py／**contrast_check.py**；docs/ 下含四张截图（site-landing-1440.png／audit-1440.png／jenkins-main-green.png／jenkins-prune-blocked.png）；.github/workflows/pages.yml——①⭐answer_key_todo.md 与 answer_key_review.md 说明评分标准的完善是一个仍在进行的过程；②⭐依赖按四个子系统拆成四份文件；③⭐contrast_check.py 在端到端测试里即界面的对比度也被测试（可访问性）；④docs/ 下四张截图逐名可读，其中 jenkins-prune-blocked.png 直接说明存在一道阻止裁剪的 CI 门（未读该图，只记录其文件名）；⭐实测 eval/answer_key_provenance.md 存在——即答案要点自身有一份来处记录（与本轮主题直接相合：连「用什么当标准答案」这件事也要说明它从哪来）；⭐⭐关于「一个 399 条款的索引」与「8B 模型」两处口径，本词条如实记录而不推断——未核实该索引的构成、条数是否确为 399、或该模型的实际配置；⚠️⚠️本次只读了 README 的开篇、结果一节（含头条表与「伪造引用」段）、以及演示与托管段——即未通读其全文，也未读 KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md（尤其第 6、7 节）、未读 eval/ 下任何文件、未读任何账单 JSON、未读任何测试或脚本，故本词条所述内容限于上述各节，**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；⚠️⚠️未核实其任何结果数字（含行准确率 55.2%、引用准确率 43.2%、赔付误差 56.4%、拒答召回率 90.0%、误答 3 条、回避 117 条、以及伪造引用为零）；本次未读 eval/results.md、未运行任何评测、未读 audit_profile.py、未访问其演示页；尤其未核实「零伪造引用跨 v0 到 v12 全部 17 行」这一说法，**这是本条目最值得被独立复核的一条，因为它是一条跨版本的一致性声明**；⚠️⭐未核实其「399 条款索引」与「8B 模型」的实际配置，亦未核实其检索方式；⚠️⭐未核实其答案要点由模型导出这一自述的具体程度（是全由模型导出、还是人机混合、以及 answer_key_verified.md 中 72 行「全查、0 改动」是如何执行的），**这是本条目第二个需要后续核实之处**（因为整张表的分母都建立在这份答案要点上）；⚠️本次核实到仓库元数据（来自搜索 API）、README 的上述各节、以及全部 353 个条目的文件清单；但未克隆、未安装 Python、未运行任何命令或评测、未读任何源码、未读 KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md、未读 eval/ 下任何文件、未读任何账单 JSON、未读任何测试、未访问其演示页或任何外部链接；⚠️未核实其与任何保险公司、第三方管理人、医院或监管机构的关系，不主张它已被任何机构採用、已上线运营或已用于任何真实的理赔审核；⭐⭐必须写明的一条风险：该工具的输出是对理赔扣减的条款依据判断——若其伪造引用为零这一指标在某个版本被破坏，或其「条款不明即转人工」的规则被绕过，则可能产生看起来有据、实际无据的拒赔理由；据此不主张其可用于任何真实的理赔、拒赔或赔付决定，亦不主张其输出可作为对任何保单持有人或医疗机构的依据（本次未查印度任何保险监管或消费者保护要求）；⚠️不主张其做法适用于其他法域或险种（其条款体系、账单结构与货币单位均为印度特有），若要在中文或香港的医疗险账单上复用需自行重建条款索引与答案要点；⚠️未核实其处理的数据是否涉及真实个人信息；★0、创建於 2026-08-31、推送於 2026-09-08，关注度极低，不主张成熟度／正确性／已被採用；但须同时写明其自述已记录 v0 到 v12 共 17 行结果，即该项目确实在多个版本上做过评测（这一点由其实测存在的 eval/ 目录与 91 份账单 JSON 支持）；未取得 topics；README 为英语（已如实记入，本次未核实是否有印地语或其他语言版本）。核实手段补充说明：核心 API 於本轮返回 rate limit 错误，故元数据改用搜索 API 的值且未能取得 fork 数与 topics；README 15,395 字节经 raw 实测读取上述各节；全部 353 个条目经下载 tarball 后以 tar tz 列出核对；未克隆、未安装 Python、未运行任何命令或评测、未读任何源码或文档、未读任何账单 JSON、未访问其演示页

entries.title: The Friction Ledger：从数千条公开评价出发，追问「一笔正当退款被错误扣住要付多大代价」——每个数字都必须挂且只挂一个来源标签（实测／有据／建模／待定），而「待定」时宁可不给数字
entries.title_en: The Friction Ledger: starting from thousands of public reviews to ask what a wrongly withheld legitimate refund costs, where every number must wear exactly one source tag — measured, documented, modeled or pending — and under pending no number is shown at all
entries.title_hk: The Friction Ledger：從數千條公開評價出發，追問「一筆正當退款被錯誤扣住要付多大代價」——每個數字都必須掛且只掛一個來源標籤（實測／有據／建模／待定），而「待定」時寧可不給數字
entries.summary: 一份从消费者视角出发的保险退款摩擦研究：它读的是**公开发布的评价**（以千计），只问一个朴素问题——当一笔正当退款被错误扣住时，代价有多大；其组织形式是五个「节拍」，而**每个数字都挂且只挂一个标签**：实测（我们自己数的）、有据（来自具名的公开来源）、建模（我们把算术完整打印出来）、以及**待定（数据还不够——于是不给数字，而不是给一个假的）**；它逐字承诺「每一个数字背后的凭据是 BACKING.md（主张 → 表 → 查询 → 来源）」，使读者可以「不必问任何人就把任何一个数一路追到它的证据」；它另逐字声明**不点名任何保险公司作为研究对象**，保险公司只作为**有出处的数据点**出现；其对**已发布页面的说明**尤其值得记：该页面是用一小组手写示例评价渲染的，因此**从评价里数出来的那些数（第二节的主题占比与分类器质量，属「实测」）在页面上是示例填充值而不是研究结论**，需自行重跑才能得到真实数据，并逐字说明「只有第二节的计数在已发布页面与你自己的重跑之间有差异」
entries.summary_hk: 一份從消費者視角出發的保險退款摩擦研究：它讀的是**公開發布的評價**（以千計），只問一個樸素問題——當一筆正當退款被錯誤扣住時，代價有多大；其組織形式是五個「節拍」，而**每個數字都掛且只掛一個標籤**：實測（我們自己數的）、有據（來自具名的公開來源）、建模（我們把算術完整打印出來）、以及**待定（數據還不夠——於是不給數字，而不是給一個假的）**；它逐字承諾「每一個數字背後的憑據是 BACKING.md（主張 → 表 → 查詢 → 來源）」，使讀者可以「不必問任何人就把任何一個數一路追到它的證據」；它另逐字聲明**不點名任何保險公司作為研究對象**，保險公司只作為**有出處的數據點**出現；其對**已發布頁面的說明**尤其值得記：該頁面是用一組手寫示例評價渲染的，因此**從評價裡數出來的那些數（第二節的主題佔比與分類器質量，屬「實測」）在頁面上是示例填充值而不是研究結論**，需自行重跑才能得到真實數據，並逐字說明「只有第二節的計數在已發布頁面與你自己的重跑之間有差異」
entries.summary_en: A study of insurance refund friction written from the customer’s chair: it reads publicly posted reviews by the thousand and asks one plain question — when a legitimate refund is wrongly held, what does that cost; it is organised in five beats, and every number must wear exactly one tag, being measured (counted by us), documented (from a named public source), modeled (arithmetic printed in full) or pending (not enough data yet, so no number is shown rather than a fake one); it promises verbatim that the backing behind every number is BACKING.md, a chain of claim to table to query to source, so a reader can follow any figure down to its evidence without asking anyone; it states separately and verbatim that no insurer is named as the target of the study, insurers appearing only as sourced data points; and its note about the shipped page is especially worth recording — the committed page is rendered from a small set of hand-written example reviews, so the figures counted from reviews, namely Beat 2’s theme shares and classifier quality under the measured tag, are illustrative fixtures on it rather than findings, and only Beat 2’s counts differ between the shipped page and a reader’s own rebuild
entries.body:
**friction-ledger-claimwatch**（The Friction Ledger，仓库 `jessicafalcon/claimwatch`）**是一份从消费者视角出发的**保险退款摩擦研究****：**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 1,792 KB、创建于 2026-08-31、最后推送 2026-09-10、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 在 261 个条目中实测不存在——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**README 已实测读取（本次读到其「看的是什么」一节）**；**仓库实测共 261 个条目**。**其开篇逐字为**：**「Health-insurance refunds get stuck, and the people they get stuck on say so in public, **by the thousands**. This study reads those reviews **from the customer’s chair** and asks one plain question: **when a legitimate refund is wrongly held, what does that cost?**」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把『这个数从哪来』写在它旁边」**中的**第一种，也是四条里**把这件事做成了一套命名制度**的一条**——**它不是「注意说明来源」，而是**给每个数字规定了一个必须挂的标签****。

可核实信息（**均 README 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其四个标签是本条最值得记的一处，且它明确规定了「不够就别说」的处置**——**逐字为**：**「**Every number wears exactly one tag: **Measured** (counted by us), **Documented** (from a named public source), **Modeled** (arithmetic we print in full), or **Pending** (not enough data yet — so **no number is shown, never a fake one**).**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① **「恰好一个」**（**exactly one**）**——**⭐ 即**一个数字不能同时「有据」又「建模」**，**归属必须唯一****（**⭐ 本词条认为这条限定很关键：**归属模糊正是数字被滥用的入口****）；**② **实测**（**我们自己数的**）**；**③ **有据**（**来自**具名的**公开来源**）**——**⭐ 注意是**具名**，不是「公开资料」**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **待定**——**「数据还不够，**于是不给数字，而绝不给一个假的**」****（**⭐ 这是本轮四条里**最强的一句处置规则****：**多数报告在数据不足时会写一个估计或留一个空，**而它把「不给」写成了规则本身****；**⭐ 可与第 338 轮 [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] 的「拒答」、第 339 轮 [[bill-auditor-india]] 的「条款不明即转人工」并读——**三者都在为「答不出来」规定一个正当出口**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其「凭据链」逐字，且它把链的**四段**点名了**——**逐字为**：**「**The promise behind every number is [BACKING.md](BACKING.md) (claim → table → query → source)**; the chart-by-chart structure is [SPEC.md](SPEC.md); the full rationale is [the project brief](PROJECT_BRIEF.md).」**；**以及**：**「… **so you can open the study page and follow any figure down to its evidence without asking anyone.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「主张 → 表 → 查询 → 来源」四级链**，**加上「不必问任何人」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站已收条目里**对「可追溯」建模得最清楚的一处****：**从一句主张，到一个中间表，到产生该表的查询，到最初的数据来源**（**⭐ 而实测 `BACKING.md`、`SPEC.md`、`PROJECT_BRIEF.md` 三份都在仓库根目录**，**另有 `data/snapshots/` 下 `fetched_snapshots.csv` 与 `manual_snapshots.csv` 两份快照**——**⭐ 「抓取的快照」与「人工录入的快照」分开存放，本身就是两个不同的来源等级**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其对**已发布页面**的说明是本条最有价值的一段，因为它逐节说明**哪些数是真结论、哪些是示例填充****——**逐字为**：**「**About the shipped page.** The committed study page is rendered from a small set of hand-written example reviews. **The figures we *count from reviews* — Beat 2’s theme shares and classifier quality (Measured) — are therefore illustrative fixtures on it, not findings**; your own rebuild over the captured reviews fills them from real data: `make rebuild ROWS=captured && make study`.」**；**以及**：**「**Beat 1’s rating, channel-gap and stat-row points are Documented from public sources, and Beat 3 and Beat 4 are Modeled from public claim-cost data and fixed parameters (independent of the review corpus) — all real either way. Only Beat 2’s counts differ between the shipped page and your rebuild.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① **它点明已发布页面是用**一小组手写示例评价**渲染的****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**受影响的范围精确到「第二节」****——**即**从评价里数出来的那些数（**主题占比与分类器质量，标签为「实测」**）在页面上**是**示例填充值（fixtures）而不是**结论****；**③ **它给出重跑命令**（`make rebuild ROWS=captured && make study`）；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它明确划定了**重跑前后**的差异边界**：**第一节的点是「有据」、第三节与第四节是「建模」（**且**独立于评价语料**），**故**「不管怎么算都是真的」，**而**只有第二节的计数**在已发布页面与重跑之间有差异****（**⭐ 本词条认为这是本会话对「**哪些数会变、哪些不会变**」交代得最精确的一次**——**可与第 338 轮 [[claimscope-benchmark]] 的「未能复现」声明、第 339 轮 [[bill-auditor-india]] 的「引用本数字前先读某节」并读**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其不点名原则逐字，且它区分了「研究对象」与「数据点」**——**逐字为**：**「**No insurer is named as the target of the study; insurers appear only as sourced data points.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **两个角色被分开**：**没有一家保险公司是**这项研究的对象**，**它们只作为**有出处的数据点**出现**——**⭐ 这与本站第 339 轮 [[insurance-qa-evidence]] 的**刻意省略被审计方品牌名**是**同一判断的两种写法**（**那一条是不复制品牌名，**这一条是**在设计上就不把任何公司设为对象****）；**⭐
