**friction-ledger-claimwatch**（The Friction Ledger，倉庫 `jessicafalcon/claimwatch`）**是一份從消費者視角出發的**保險退款摩擦研究****：**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 1,792 KB、創建於 2026-08-31、最後推送 2026-09-10、無 topics**（**創建在解凍窗口之前，推送落在窗口之內**）；**⚠️ 實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 在 261 個條目中實測不存在——屬「完全未聲明」形態）**；**倉庫實測共 261 個條目**。**其開篇逐字為**：**「Health-insurance refunds get stuck, and the people they get stuck on say so in public, **by the thousands**. This study reads those reviews **from the customer’s chair** and asks one plain question: **when a legitimate refund is wrongly held, what does that cost?**」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把『這個數從哪來』寫在它旁邊」**中的**第一種，也是四條裡**把這件事做成了一套命名制度**的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其四個標籤最值得記，且它明確規定了「不夠就別說」的處置**：**「**Every number wears exactly one tag: **Measured** (counted by us), **Documented** (from a named public source), **Modeled** (arithmetic we print in full), or **Pending** (not enough data yet — so **no number is shown, never a fake one**).**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處值得記**：**① **「恰好一個」**——**⭐ 即**一個數字不能同時「有據」又「建模」，**歸屬必須唯一****（**⭐ 歸屬模糊正是數字被濫用的入口**）；**② **實測（我們自己數的）**；**③ **有據（來自**具名的**公開來源）**——**⭐ 注意是**具名**，不是「公開資料」**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **待定——「數據還不夠，**於是不給數字，而絕不給一個假的**」****（**⭐ 本輪四條裡**最強的一句處置規則**：**多數報告在數據不足時會寫一個估計或留一個空，而它把「不給」寫成了規則本身****；**可與第 338 輪 [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] 的「拒答」、第 339 輪 [[bill-auditor-india]] 的「條款不明即轉人工」並讀——**三者都在為「答不出來」規定一個正當出口**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其「憑據鏈」逐字，且它把鏈的**四段**點名了**：**「**The promise behind every number is [BACKING.md](BACKING.md) (claim → table → query → source)** … **so you can open the study page and follow any figure down to its evidence without asking anyone.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「主張 → 表 → 查詢 → 來源」四級鏈，加上「不必問任何人」**——**⭐ 本詞條認為這是本站已收條目裡**對「可追溯」建模得最清楚的一處****：**從一句主張，到一個中間表，到產生該表的查詢，到最初的數據來源****（**⭐ 實測 `BACKING.md`、`SPEC.md`、`PROJECT_BRIEF.md` 三份都在倉庫根目錄，另有 `data/snapshots/` 下 `fetched_snapshots.csv` 與 `manual_snapshots.csv` 兩份快照——**⭐ 「抓取的快照」與「人工錄入的快照」分開存放，本身就是兩個不同的來源等級**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其對**已發布頁面**的說明是本條最有價值的一段，因為它逐節說明**哪些數是真結論、哪些是示例填充****：**「**About the shipped page.** The committed study page is rendered from a small set of hand-written example reviews. **The figures we *count from reviews* — Beat 2’s theme shares and classifier quality (Measured) — are therefore illustrative fixtures on it, not findings**; your own rebuild over the captured reviews fills them from real data: `make rebuild ROWS=captured && make study`.」**；**「**Beat 1’s rating, channel-gap and stat-row points are Documented from public sources, and Beat 3 and Beat 4 are Modeled from public claim-cost data and fixed parameters (independent of the review corpus) — all real either way. Only Beat 2’s counts differ between the shipped page and your rebuild.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① 它點明已發布頁面是用**一小組手寫示例評價**渲染的**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它把受影響的範圍**精確到「第二節」****——**即**從評價裡數出來的數（主題佔比與分類器質量，標籤為「實測」）在頁面上**是示例填充值而不是結論****；**③ 它給出重跑命令**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 它明確劃定了**重跑前後**的差異邊界**（**第一節「有據」、第三四節「建模」且獨立於評價語料，**故**「不管怎麼算都是真的」，**而只有第二節的計數會變**）**——**⭐ 這是本會話對「**哪些數會變、哪些不會變**」交代得最精確的一次****（**可與第 338 輪 [[claimscope-benchmark]] 的「未能復現」聲明、第 339 輪 [[bill-auditor-india]] 的「引用本數字前先讀某節」並讀**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其不點名原則逐字，且它區分了「研究對象」與「數據點」**：**「**No insurer is named as the target of the study; insurers appear only as sourced data points.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩個角色被分開**——**⭐ 與第 339 輪 [[insurance-qa-evidence]] 的**刻意省略被審計方品牌名**是**同一判斷的兩種寫法**（**那條是不複製品牌名，這條是在設計上就不把任何公司設為對象**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其**雙層呈現**的編輯原則逐字**：**「Two layers everywhere: a plain-English opening any reader can follow, then the detail one signpost down under *How we made sure*. **Rigor is never removed to simplify — it moves one layer down.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「嚴謹性從不因為簡化而被刪掉——它只是**下移一層**」**——**⭐ 對本站在做的三語百科而言，這是一條可直接借用的原則**（**即**簡版與詳版**不是兩個**刪減程度不同的事實**，而是**同一份事實的兩種展開層級****）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其結構逐字**：**五個「節拍」**；**第一節（評分、渠道差距與統計行）來自公開來源（有據）**；**第二節**是從評價裡數出來的主題佔比與分類器質量（**實測**，**即已發布頁面上為示例填充值的那一節**）；**第三、四節**由**公開的理賠成本數據與固定參數**建模（**且逐字說明獨立於評價語料**）；**⭐ 實測 `docs/PLAN.md` 存在**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **實測其規格文檔是一個**分階段系列**，且其中兩份點名了一個具體來源**：**`specs/` 下含 `TEMPLATE.md`、`phase-0a-machinery.md`、`phase-0b-contracts.md`、`phase-1-schema.md`、`phase-2-scraper.md`、`phase-3a-snapshots.md`、**`phase-3b-trustpilot.md`**、`phase-3c-trustpilot-import.md`**⭐⭐ **三處**：**① 規格按階段編號（0a／0b／1／2／3a／3b／3c）——即這份研究的做法本身是被分階段規定的**；**② `phase-2-scraper.md` 與 `phase-3*-snapshots.md` 分開——即**抓取**與**快照留存**是兩件事****；**③ ⭐ 其中兩份點名了 **Trustpilot** 作為來源——**即**其評價語料的來源是被具名寫進規格的**，**這與第 ① 點「有據 = 來自**具名的**公開來源」的定義一致****（**⚠️ 未核實其抓取是否遵守該站點條款**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **實測其數據目錄把**兩類快照分開****：**`data/snapshots/fetched_snapshots.csv` 與 `data/snapshots/manual_snapshots.csv`**，**另有 `data/damir/claim_cost_fit.csv`**⭐⭐ **兩處**：**① 抓取與人工兩類快照分文件存放（**來源等級在**存儲層**就已區分**，而不只是在文字裡說明**）；**② `claim_cost_fit.csv` 位於一個具名的 `damir` 目錄下（**即**第三／四節「建模」所依據的理賠成本數據在倉庫裡有一份對應文件**）**。**⑨ ⭐ **其複現入口逐字為 `make rebuild ROWS=captured && make study`，且實測 `Makefile` 存在**——**即**「已發布頁面」與「你自己的重跑」之間由兩條命令連接**。**⑩ ⭐ 可與 [[insurance-qa-evidence]]、[[claimscope-benchmark]]、[[cbuae-rag-benchmark]]、[[bill-auditor-india]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]]、[[proof-protocol]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **許可實測為**無****——**`LICENSE` 在 261 個條目中實測不存在**；**⚠️ 提示：**複製、修改或再分發其代碼、規格、快照數據與研究頁面內容前應先向作者確認授權****；**⭐ 並特別提示：**其 `data/snapshots/` 下存放的是**公開評價的抓取快照**（**逐字點名的來源之一為 Trustpilot**）——**⚠️ 這類內容即使本身公開，其抓取與再分發仍可能受來源站點條款約束****（**本次未查任何來源站點條款，故既不主張其可再分發也不主張其不可**）。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次只讀了 README 的**開篇、「你在看的是什麼」與「關於已發布頁面」兩節****——**⭐ 即**未通讀其五個「節拍」的具體內容，也未讀 `BACKING.md`、`SPEC.md`、`PROJECT_BRIEF.md`、`docs/PLAN.md`、任何一份 `specs/` 規格、任何數據文件或任何代碼****；**故**本詞條所述內容限於上述兩節**——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其任何數字與結論**（**含五個節拍中的任何量化結果、分類器質量、渠道差距、評分分析、以及第三四節建模出的任何值**）；**本次**未讀研究頁面、未讀 `BACKING.md`、未運行 `make rebuild` 或 `make study`、未讀任何數據文件或代碼****。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其評價語料的**來源合規性****（**它從哪些平台抓取、抓取方式是否遵守各平台條款、以及是否處理了評價作者的個人信息**）；**本次**未讀 `specs/phase-2-scraper.md` 與 `specs/phase-3b-trustpilot.md`、未查任何平台條款****；**既不主張**其語料採集合規，**也不主張**其不合規**。**⑤ ⚠️⭐ **未核實**「每個數字都掛了且只掛了一個標籤」這件事是否在**研究頁面上真的做到了**`——**本次**未打開其研究頁面、未讀任何節拍的表格或圖****；**⭐ 這恰恰是本條對本輪主題的核心貢獻，故這是本條目**第二處最需要補的****（**只記錄它**如此規定**，**不主張**它**如此執行****）。**⑥ ⚠️⭐ **未核實**其「第一節有據、第三四節建模且獨立於評價語料」這一分層在實現上是否成立**（**本次未讀任何查詢或代碼**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **本次核實到**倉庫元數據、README 的上述兩節、以及全部 261 個條目的文件清單**；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安裝 Python、未運行任何 `make` 目標、未讀任何源碼或查詢、未讀任何規格或文檔內容、未讀任何數據文件、**未打開其研究頁面**。**⑧ ⚠️ **未核實**其與任何保險公司、評價平台或監管機構的關係**；**不主張**該研究已被任何機構採用、引用或認可**；**⭐ 其自述逐字**不把任何保險公司作為研究對象**。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主張**其結論適用於任何其他市場、險種或平台**——**⚠️ 其對象為**健康險退款**這一具體環節，語料來自**消費者公開發布的評價****；**⭐ 而**評價樣本本身帶有強烈的自選擇偏誤**——**⚠️ 本詞條並未在 README 所讀部分看到對這一點的討論，故在此如實提示：**「誰會在网上公開抱怨」與「誰遇到了問題」不是同一群人****（**不主張其已處理該偏誤，也不主張其未處理——本次未讀其局限章節**）。**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其處理的數據是否涉及真實個人信息**（**評價文本常含可識別信息**）。**⑪ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、創建於 2026-08-31、推送於 2026-09-10**，**不主張其成熟度／正確性／已被採用**；**⑫ ⭐ 無 topics**；**⑬ **README 為英語**——**已如實記入，本次未核實是否有其他語言版本**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/jessicafalcon/claimwatch` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 經 raw 實測讀取開篇、「看的是什麼」與「關於已發布頁面」兩節；**全部 261 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對；**未克隆、未安裝 Python、未運行任何 `make` 目標、未讀任何源碼、查詢、規格、文檔或數據文件、未打開其研究頁面**。
entries.body_en:
**friction-ledger-claimwatch** (The Friction Ledger, repository `jessicafalcon/claimwatch`) **is a study of insurance refund friction written from the customer’s chair**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 1,792 KB repository, created 2026-08-31 and last pushed 2026-09-10, no topics** (**both GitHub API measurements; creation before the thaw window, push inside it**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file at all (`LICENSE` absent among the 261 entries — the "no statement whatever" form)**; the README was measurably read (**its opening and the "what you are looking at" section**); **the repository measures 261 entries in total**. **Its opening reads verbatim**: **"Health-insurance refunds get stuck, and the people they get stuck on say so in public, **by the thousands**. This study reads those reviews **from the customer’s chair** and asks one plain question: **when a legitimate refund is wrongly held, what does that cost?**"** It is the first of this round’s four takes on **writing down where each number came from**, **and the one that turns that into a naming system** — **rather than "remember to cite sources", it prescribes a tag each number must carry**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its four tags are the most notable point, and it prescribes what to do when data is insufficient** — **verbatim**: **"**Every number wears exactly one tag: **Measured** (counted by us), **Documented** (from a named public source), **Modeled** (arithmetic we print in full), or **Pending** (not enough data yet — so **no number is shown, never a fake one**).**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: **"exactly one" means a number cannot be both documented and modeled, so its attribution must be unique** (⭐ **ambiguous attribution is the doorway through which numbers get misused**); **measured means counted by us**; **documented means from a *named* public source, not merely "public material"**; **and ⭐⭐⭐ pending means not enough data, so no number is shown and never a fake one** — ⭐ **the strongest handling rule among this round’s four, since most reports produce an estimate or leave a blank and this one makes not producing a number the rule itself** (**readable with round 338’s [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] abstention and round 339’s [[bill-auditor-india]] referral to a human: all three legislate a legitimate exit for not answering**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its backing chain is verbatim and names the chain’s four links** — **verbatim**: **"**The promise behind every number is [BACKING.md](BACKING.md) (claim → table → query → source)** … **so you can open the study page and follow any figure down to its evidence without asking anyone.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **claim to table to query to source, plus "without asking anyone"** — ⭐ **the entry considers this the clearest modelling of traceability the site holds: from one claim, to an intermediate table, to the query that produced it, to the originating source** (⭐ **`BACKING.md`, `SPEC.md` and `PROJECT_BRIEF.md` are all measurably at the repository root, and `data/snapshots/` holds `fetched_snapshots.csv` and `manual_snapshots.csv` — separating fetched snapshots from manually entered ones is itself two provenance tiers**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its note on the shipped page is the most valuable passage, because it states section by section which numbers are findings and which are fixtures** — **verbatim**: **"**About the shipped page.** The committed study page is rendered from a small set of hand-written example reviews. **The figures we *count from reviews* — Beat 2’s theme shares and classifier quality (Measured) — are therefore illustrative fixtures on it, not findings**; your own rebuild over the captured reviews fills them from real data: `make rebuild ROWS=captured && make study`."**; **and**: **"**Beat 1’s rating, channel-gap and stat-row points are Documented from public sources, and Beat 3 and Beat 4 are Modeled from public claim-cost data and fixed parameters (independent of the review corpus) — all real either way. Only Beat 2’s counts differ between the shipped page and your rebuild.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: **it says the shipped page is rendered from a small set of hand-written example reviews**; ⭐⭐⭐ **it narrows the affected scope precisely to Beat 2** — **the figures counted from reviews, their theme shares and classifier quality under the measured tag, are fixtures on that page rather than findings**; **it gives the rebuild command**; **and ⭐⭐⭐ it draws the boundary of what changes between the shipped page and a rebuild — Beat 1 is documented and Beats 3 and 4 are modeled and independent of the review corpus, so those are real either way, and only Beat 2’s counts differ** — ⭐ **the most precise statement in this session of which numbers change and which do not** (**readable with round 338’s [[claimscope-benchmark]] "cannot reproduce" and round 339’s [[bill-auditor-india]] "read this section before quoting"**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its no-naming principle is verbatim, and it separates two roles** — **verbatim**: **"**No insurer is named as the target of the study; insurers appear only as sourced data points.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **no insurer is the object of the study and insurers appear only as sourced data points** — ⭐ **the same judgement as round 339’s [[insurance-qa-evidence]], which declined to reproduce an audited party’s brand names, expressed instead by design: this study never makes any company its target**; ⭐ **for readers here, a sample of how to study an industry without aiming at individuals inside it**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its two-layer presentation carries an uncommon editorial principle** — **verbatim**: **"Two layers everywhere: a plain-English opening any reader can follow, then the detail one signpost down under *How we made sure*. **Rigor is never removed to simplify — it moves one layer down.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **rigour is never removed to simplify, only moved one layer down** — ⭐ **a directly borrowable principle for a trilingual wiki: the simple version and the detailed version are not two facts with differing amounts deleted but two levels of unfolding of the same fact**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its structure is verbatim**: **five beats**; **Beat 1 (rating, channel gap and stat-row points) comes from public sources and is documented**; **Beat 2 counts theme shares and classifier quality from the reviews and is measured — the section that is a fixture on the shipped page**; **Beats 3 and 4 are modeled from public claim-cost data and fixed parameters, stated verbatim as independent of the review corpus**; and **`docs/PLAN.md` is measurably present**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its specification documents form a staged series, two of which name a specific source** — **`specs/` measurably contains `TEMPLATE.md`, `phase-0a-machinery.md`, `phase-0b-contracts.md`, `phase-1-schema.md`, `phase-2-scraper.md`, `phase-3a-snapshots.md`, **`phase-3b-trustpilot.md`** and `phase-3c-trustpilot-import.md`** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: **the specs are numbered by phase, so the study’s own method is prescribed in stages**; **scraping and snapshot retention are separate phases**; **and ⭐ two of them name Trustpilot as a source, so the review corpus’s origin is written into the specification — consistent with "documented means from a named public source"** (**⚠️ whether the scraping respects that site’s terms was not verified**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its data directory separates two classes of snapshot**: **`data/snapshots/fetched_snapshots.csv` and `data/snapshots/manual_snapshots.csv`**, **plus `data/damir/claim_cost_fit.csv`** ⭐⭐ **fetched and manually entered snapshots are stored in separate files, so provenance tier is distinguished at the storage layer rather than only in prose**; **and `claim_cost_fit.csv` sits under a named `damir` directory, so the claim-cost data behind the modeled beats has a corresponding file in the repository**. **⑨ ⭐ Its reproduction entry point is verbatim `make rebuild ROWS=captured && make study`, and `Makefile` is measurably present** — **two commands connect the shipped page and a reader’s own rebuild**. **⑩ ⭐ Readable with the site’s evidence and claims entries**: [[insurance-qa-evidence]], [[claimscope-benchmark]], [[cbuae-rag-benchmark]], [[bill-auditor-india]], [[evidence-review-claims]], [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] and [[proof-protocol]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as none** — **`LICENSE` is absent among the 261 entries and the README has no licence section**; **⚠️ the entry advises confirming authorisation with the author before copying, modifying or redistributing its code, specifications, snapshot data or study page**; ⭐ **and notes in particular that `data/snapshots/` holds scraped snapshots of public reviews, one named source being Trustpilot — such content, though itself public, may still be bound by the source site’s terms for scraping and redistribution** (**no source site’s terms were consulted, so the entry claims neither that redistribution is permitted nor that it is not**). **② ⚠️⚠️ Only the README’s opening, "what you are looking at" and "about the shipped page" were read** — ⭐ **the five beats’ own content was not read through, nor `BACKING.md`, `SPEC.md`, `PROJECT_BRIEF.md`, `docs/PLAN.md`, any `specs/` document, any data file or any code**; **so the entry is limited to those sections — this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ None of its numbers or conclusions were verified** (**including any quantified result across the five beats, classifier quality, channel gaps, the rating analysis, and any value modeled in Beats 3 and 4**); **the study page was not read, `BACKING.md` was not read, neither `make rebuild` nor `make study` was run, and no data file or code was read**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ The provenance compliance of its review corpus was not verified** (**which platforms it scraped, whether the scraping respects each platform’s terms, and whether reviewers’ personal information was handled**); **`specs/phase-2-scraper.md` and `specs/phase-3b-trustpilot.md` were not read and no platform terms were consulted**; **the entry claims neither that its collection is compliant nor that it is not**. **⑤ ⚠️⭐ Whether every number on the study page really carries exactly one tag was not verified** — **the study page was not opened and no beat’s table or chart was read**; ⭐ **which is precisely this entry’s central contribution to the round, making it the second thing most worth filling in here** (**the entry records only that the rule is stated, not that it is followed**). **⑥ ⚠️⭐ Whether the layering of Beat 1 as documented and Beats 3 and 4 as modeled-and-independent-of-the-review-corpus holds in the implementation was not verified** (**no query or code was read**). **⑦ ⚠️** This check verified **the repository metadata, the README sections named above, and the complete list of all 261 entries** (**including `BACKING.md`, `SPEC.md`, `PROJECT_BRIEF.md`, `Makefile`, `pyproject.toml`, `docs/PLAN.md`, eight staged specs under `specs/`, two snapshot CSVs under `data/snapshots/` and `data/damir/claim_cost_fit.csv`**); ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install Python, run any `make` target, read any source, query, specification, document or data file, or open its study page**. **⑧ ⚠️ Its relationship to any insurer, review platform or regulator was not verified**; **no claim is made that the study has been adopted, cited or endorsed by any institution**; ⭐ **it states verbatim that no insurer is the object of the study, so the entry does not claim its content constitutes an assessment of any company**. **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its conclusions apply to any other market, line or platform** — **⚠️ its subject is the health-insurance refund step specifically, and its corpus is consumer-posted reviews**; ⭐ **moreover review samples carry strong self-selection bias, and the entry did not see this discussed in the sections read, so it raises it plainly: the people who complain publicly and the people who had the problem are not the same population** (**the entry neither claims the bias is handled nor that it is not — its limitations section was not read**). **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ Whether the data it handles involves real personal information was not verified** (**review text often contains identifying details**). **⑪ ⭐ At ★0, 0 forks, created 2026-08-31 and pushed 2026-09-10**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**. **⑫ ⭐ No topics**. **⑬ The README is in English** — **recorded as such, and whether other language versions exist was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/jessicafalcon/claimwatch` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field NONE, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` for its opening, "what you are looking at" and "about the shipped page"; **all 261 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com`; **nothing was cloned, no Python was installed, no `make` target was run, no source, query, specification, document or data file was read, and the study page was not opened**.

entries.title: 意大利语 T-SQL 财险分析库：七个 KPI 每一个都同时给出定义与实现它的那一个 .sql 文件；自述为「不是企业项目，而是一条个人学习路径」
entries.title_en: An Italian-language P&C analytics database in T-SQL: seven KPIs each stated with both its definition and the single .sql file that implements it, self-described as not a company project but a personal learning path
entries.title_hk: 意大利語 T-SQL 財險分析庫：七個 KPI 每一個都同時給出定義與實現它的那一個 .sql 文件；自述為「不是企業項目，而是一條個人學習路徑」
entries.summary: 一份用意大利语写的财险业务分析数据库项目：它用 T-SQL 建一个关系型库，配一组存储过程与报表查询，目的是搞清保险业务概念（赔付率、索赔频率、续保率）如何翻译成高效的查询与可用的报表；其数据模型含四张表——客户（自然人必填税号、法人必填增值税号）、代理人（用自关联建模代理人／主管的层级）、保单（产品线、年保费、起保与到期日）、索赔（金额、状态为受理中／处理中／已结案／已关闭／已拒赔、以及类型）；**其最值得记的一处是 KPI 表**：七个 KPI 每一个都同时给出**定义**与**实现它的那一个 .sql 文件**（赔付率＝已付赔款／已赚保费，按产品与期间；索赔频率＝索赔数／有效保单，按产品；索赔强度＝每案平均金额，按产品；时间趋势＝月度赔付率带环比与三个月滚动平均；续保／流失率＝按到期年份的续保比例与流失比例；代理人排名用 RANK() 与 DENSE_RANK()；代理人层级用递归 CTE）；另含两份用 SSRS 做的报表与对应的存储过程，可导出 PDF 与 Excel，且仓库里确实提交了一份赔付率报表的 PDF；文档逐字自述「不是企业项目，而是一条个人学习路径」
entries.summary_hk: 一份用意大利語寫的財險業務分析數據庫項目：它用 T-SQL 建一個關係型庫，配一組存儲過程與報表查詢，目的是搞清保險業務概念（賠付率、索賠頻率、續保率）如何翻譯成高效的查詢與可用的報表；其數據模型含四張表——客戶（自然人必填稅號、法人必填增值稅號）、代理人（用自關聯建模代理人／主管的層級）、保單（產品線、年保費、起保與到期日）、索賠（金額、狀態為受理中／處理中／已結案／已關閉／已拒賠、以及類型）；**其最值得記的一處是 KPI 表**：七個 KPI 每一個都同時給出**定義**與**實現它的那一個 .sql 文件**（賠付率＝已付賠款／已賺保費，按產品與期間；索賠頻率＝索賠數／有效保單，按產品；索賠強度＝每案平均金額，按產品；時間趨勢＝月度賠付率帶環比與三個月滾動平均；續保／流失率＝按到期年份的續保比例與流失比例；代理人排名用 RANK() 與 DENSE_RANK()；代理人層級用遞歸 CTE）；另含兩份用 SSRS 做的報表與對應的存儲過程，可導出 PDF 與 Excel，且倉庫裡確實提交了一份賠付率報表的 PDF；文檔逐字自述「不是企業項目，而是一條個人學習路徑」
entries.summary_en: A P&C business analytics database written in Italian: it builds a relational database in T-SQL with a set of stored procedures and reporting queries, in order to work out how insurance business concepts such as loss ratio, claim frequency and retention rate translate into efficient queries and usable reporting; its data model has four tables — customers (natural persons with a mandatory tax code, legal persons with a mandatory VAT number), agents (with the agent and supervisor hierarchy modelled by a self-relation), policies (product line, annual premium, inception and expiry dates) and claims (amount, status of open, under handling, settled, closed or rejected, and type); and its most notable feature is the KPI table, where each of seven KPIs is given both its definition and the single .sql file implementing it (loss ratio as paid claims over earned premium by product and period; claim frequency as claims over active policies by product; claim severity as average amount per claim by product; a time trend of monthly loss ratio with month-on-month change and a three-month rolling average; retention and lapse rates by renewal and loss proportions per expiry year; agent ranking using RANK and DENSE_RANK; and agent hierarchy via a recursive CTE); it also contains two SSRS reports with their stored procedures, exportable to PDF and Excel, with a PDF of the loss-ratio report actually committed to the repository; and the documentation states verbatim that it is not a company project but a personal learning path
entries.body:
**insurance-analytics-tsql**（InsuranceAnalytics-TSQL，仓库 `Daddo172/InsuranceAnalytics-TSQL`）**是一份用**意大利语**写的财险业务分析数据库项目**：**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 **TSQL**、仓库体量 302 KB、创建于 2026-08-05、最后推送 2026-09-09、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 在 20 个条目中实测不存在——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**README 实测 3,418 字节（**意大利语**）**；**仓库实测共 20 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「Progetto personale per esplorare la logica di business del settore assicurativo (P&C) attraverso un database relazionale in T-SQL e una serie di stored procedure e query di reportistica.」**；**并逐字说明性质**：**「Nato per approfondire come SQL e reportistica si applicano concretamente in ambito assicurativo — **non un progetto aziendale, ma un percorso di apprendimento personale**.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把『这个数从哪来』写在它旁边」**中的**第二种，也是四条里**唯一以「每个 KPI 指向一个文件」的方式落实这件事**的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其 KPI 表是本条最值得记的一处，因为它同时给出了**定义**与**实现文件**——**逐字实测其七行**：**「**Loss Ratio** | **Sinistri pagati / Premi maturati per prodotto e periodo** | `queries/loss_ratio.sql`」**；**「**Claim Frequency** | **Numero sinistri / Polizze attive per prodotto** | `queries/claim_freq_severity.sql`」**；**「**Claim Severity** | **Importo medio per sinistro per prodotto** | `queries/claim_freq_severity.sql`」**；**「**Trend temporale** | **Loss ratio mensile con variazione MoM e rolling average 3 mesi** | `queries/trend_temporale.sql`」**；**「**Retention / Lapse Rate** | **% polizze rinnovate e % perse per anno di scadenza** | `queries/retention_lapse.sql`」**；**「**Ranking agenti** | **Classifica agenti per premi con RANK() e DENSE_RANK()** | `queries/ranking_agenti.sql`」**；**「**Gerarchia agenti** | **Navigazione gerarchia agenti/supervisori con CTE ricorsiva** | `queries/gerarchia_agenti.sql`」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **每一行都是**「KPI 名 → 它的定义 → 实现它的那一个文件」****——**⭐ 对本轮主题而言，这正是**「把『这个数从哪来』写在它旁边」的最朴素实现**：**不是靠文档解释，而是**给出那个文件的名字****；**② **定义写得像公式**（**赔付率＝已付赔款／已赚保费**、**索赔频率＝索赔数／有效保单**、**索赔强度＝每案平均金额**）**——**⭐ 而**分母各不相同**（**已赚保费 vs 有效保单 vs 案数**），**这三个数**不能互换****（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**其 SQL 是否确实按此定义实现**——**见标注 ③**）；**③ **两个 KPI 共用同一个文件**（**索赔频率与索赔强度都指向 `claim_freq_severity.sql`**）**——**⭐ 即**频率与强度被放在同一个查询里一起算****（**⭐ 这与本行**频率—强度（frequency-severity）**这一标准拆法是同一做法**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **实测其七个 `queries/` 文件**与 README 所述**逐一对应且全部存在**——**逐名为**：**`loss_ratio.sql`、`claim_freq_severity.sql`、`trend_temporale.sql`、`retention_lapse.sql`、`ranking_agenti.sql`、`gerarchia_agenti.sql`**（**六个文件对应七个 KPI**）**⭐⭐ **即**README 里那张表**不是意向，而是对仓库现状的描述****——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本条**最实在的一处可核实性****（**⭐ 可与第 338 轮 [[claimscope-benchmark]] 的「文件确实存在」类核实并读：**两处都在验证「文档说的文件是否真的在」**）。**③ ⭐⭐ **其数据模型逐字，且四张表各含一条**具名的业务约束****——**逐字实测其表**：**「**Clienti** | **Sottoscrittori di polizze. Persone fisiche (CF obbligatorio) e giuridiche (P.IVA obbligatoria).**」**；**「**Agenti** | **Agenti di vendita con gerarchia agente/supervisore modellata tramite auto-relazione.**」**；**「**Polizze** | **Contratti assicurativi con linea di prodotto, premio annuale e date di decorrenza/scadenza.**」**；**「**Sinistri** | **Rivendicazioni con importo, stato (Aperto/In Gestione/Liquidato/Chiuso/Respinto) e tipologia.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **客户表区分自然人（必填**税号 CF**）与法人（必填**增值税号 P.IVA**）**——**⭐ 这是**意大利特有的两位标识**（**CF = Codice Fiscale，P.IVA = Partita IVA**），**即**该模型是按意大利的实际主体类型建的****；**② ⭐ **代理人层级用**自关联**建模****（**⭐ 即**一张表指向自己**，**这是层级组织最省的结构**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **索赔状态是一个**五态枚举**：**Aperto／In Gestione／Liquidato／Chiuso／Respinto**（**受理中／处理中／已结案／已关闭／已拒赔**）**——**⭐ 即**拒赔（Respinto）与结案（Liquidato／Chiuso）是两个不同的终态****（**⭐ 对本行读者，这个五态划分比「开／关」二态更接近真实的理赔流程**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **其报表部分逐字，且它把**存储过程名与参数**都写明了**——**逐字实测**：**「Loss Ratio per Prodotto | `dbo.rpt_LossRatioPerPeriodo` | **Data inizio / Data fine**」**；**「Performance Agenti | `dbo.rpt_PerformanceAgenti` | **Anno (opzionale)**」**；**并逐字说明** **「Report esportabile in PDF ed Excel.」**⭐⭐ **即**两份报表各对应一个存储过程与一组具名参数**（**一份按起止日期、一份按可选年份**）**；**⭐ 实测 `procedures/` 下**两份存储过程文件确实存在**（**`rpt_LossRatioPerPeriodo.sql`、`rpt_PerformanceAgenti.sql`**）**；**⭐ 而 ⭐⭐ **实测 `docs/report-loss-ratio.pdf` 与 **insurance-analytics-tsql**（InsuranceAnalytics-TSQL，倉庫 `Daddo172/InsuranceAnalytics-TSQL`）**是一份用**意大利語**寫的財險業務分析數據庫項目**：**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 **TSQL**、體量 302 KB、創建於 2026-08-05、最後推送 2026-09-09、無 topics**（**創建在解凍窗口之前，推送落在窗口之內**）；**⚠️ 實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 在 20 個條目中實測不存在——屬「完全未聲明」形態）**；**README 實測 3,418 位元組（**意大利語**）**；**倉庫實測共 20 個條目**。**其自述逐字為**：**「Progetto personale per esplorare la logica di business del settore assicurativo (P&C) attraverso un database relazionale in T-SQL e una serie di stored procedure e query di reportistica.」**；**並逐字說明性質**：**「Nato per approfondire come SQL e reportistica si applicano concretamente in ambito assicurativo — **non un progetto aziendale, ma un percorso di apprendimento personale**.」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把『這個數從哪來』寫在它旁邊」**中的**第二種，也是四條裡**唯一以「每個 KPI 指向一個文件」的方式落實這件事**的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其 KPI 表最值得記，因為它同時給出了**定義**與**實現文件****——**逐字實測其七行**：**Loss Ratio｜Sinistri pagati / Premi maturati per prodotto e periodo｜`queries/loss_ratio.sql`**；**Claim Frequency｜Numero sinistri / Polizze attive per prodotto｜`queries/claim_freq_severity.sql`**；**Claim Severity｜Importo medio per sinistro per prodotto｜`queries/claim_freq_severity.sql`**；**Trend temporale｜Loss ratio mensile con variazione MoM e rolling average 3 mesi｜`queries/trend_temporale.sql`**；**Retention / Lapse Rate｜% polizze rinnovate e % perse per anno di scadenza｜`queries/retention_lapse.sql`**；**Ranking agenti｜Classifica agenti per premi con RANK() e DENSE_RANK()｜`queries/ranking_agenti.sql`**；**Gerarchia agenti｜Navigazione gerarchia agenti/supervisori con CTE ricorsiva｜`queries/gerarchia_agenti.sql`**⭐⭐⭐ **三處值得記**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 每一行都是**「KPI 名 → 它的定義 → 實現它的那一個文件」****——**⭐ 這正是**「把『這個數從哪來』寫在它旁邊」的最樸素實現**：**不是靠文檔解釋，而是**給出那個文件的名字****；**② 定義寫得像公式（賠付率＝已付賠款／已賺保費、索賠頻率＝索賠數／有效保單、索賠強度＝每案平均金額）——**⭐ 而**分母各不相同**（已賺保費 vs 有效保單 vs 案數），**這三個數**不能互換****（**⚠️ 未核實其 SQL 是否確實按此定義實現**）；**③ 兩個 KPI 共用同一個文件（索賠頻率與索賠強度都指向 `claim_freq_severity.sql`）——**⭐ 即**頻率與強度被放在同一個查詢裡一起算****（**與本行**頻率—強度**這一標準拆法同一做法**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **實測其七個 `queries/` 文件**與 README 所述**逐一對應且全部存在****——**逐名為** **即**兩份報表各對應一個存儲過程與一組具名參數**；**⭐ 實測 `procedures/` 下兩份存儲過程文件確實存在**；**⭐ 而 ⭐⭐ **實測 `docs/report-loss-ratio.pdf` 與 `docs/report-loss-ratio.png` 都在倉庫裡**——**即**它不只說報表可導出 PDF，**而是把一份 PDF 提交了下來****（**⭐ **insurance-analytics-tsql** (InsuranceAnalytics-TSQL, repository `Daddo172/InsuranceAnalytics-TSQL`) **is a P&C business analytics database written in Italian**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, **TSQL** as the primary language, a 302 KB repository, created 2026-08-05 and last pushed 2026-09-09, no topics** (**both GitHub API measurements; creation before the thaw window, push inside it**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file at all (`LICENSE` absent among the 20 entries — the "no statement whatever" form)**; **the README measures 3,418 bytes and is in **Italian****; **the repository measures 20 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"Progetto personale per esplorare la logica di business del settore assicurativo (P&C) attraverso un database relazionale in T-SQL e una serie di stored procedure e query di reportistica."**; **with its nature stated verbatim**: **"Nato per approfondire come SQL e reportistica si applicano concretamente in ambito assicurativo — **non un progetto aziendale, ma un percorso di apprendimento personale**."** It is the second of this round’s four takes on **writing down where each number came from**, **and the only one that implements it as "every KPI points at one file"**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its KPI table is the most notable point, because it gives both the definition and the implementing file** — **its seven rows measure verbatim as**: **Loss Ratio | Sinistri pagati / Premi maturati per prodotto e periodo | `queries/loss_ratio.sql`**; **Claim Frequency | Numero sinistri / Polizze attive per prodotto | `queries/claim_freq_severity.sql`**; **Claim Severity | Importo medio per sinistro per prodotto | `queries/claim_freq_severity.sql`**; **Trend temporale | Loss ratio mensile con variazione MoM e rolling average 3 mesi | `queries/trend_temporale.sql`**; **Retention / Lapse Rate | % polizze rinnovate e % perse per anno di scadenza | `queries/retention_lapse.sql`**; **Ranking agenti | Classifica agenti per premi con RANK() e DENSE_RANK() | `queries/ranking_agenti.sql`**; **Gerarchia agenti | Navigazione gerarchia agenti/supervisori con CTE ricorsiva | `queries/gerarchia_agenti.sql`** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **each row is "KPI name, its definition, and the single file implementing it" — the plainest possible implementation of this round’s theme: rather than explaining in prose, it names the file**; **the definitions read like formulas, and their denominators differ — earned premium, active policies, claim count — so the three cannot be substituted for one another** (**⚠️ whether the SQL really implements those definitions was not verified**); **and two KPIs share one file, with frequency and severity computed in the same query, the standard frequency-severity split**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its seven `queries/` files measurably correspond one to one with the README and all exist** — namely `loss_ratio.sql`, `claim_freq_severity.sql`, `trend_temporale.sql`, `retention_lapse.sql`, `ranking_agenti.sql` and `gerarchia_agenti.sql` (six files for seven KPIs) ⭐⭐ **so the README table is not an intention but a description of the repository as it stands** — ⭐ **the entry’s most solid checkable point, and the same kind of verification as round 338’s [[claimscope-benchmark]] confirming that the files it claims really exist**. **③ ⭐⭐ Its data model is verbatim, and each of the four tables carries a named business constraint**: **Clienti | Sottoscrittori di polizze. Persone fisiche (CF obbligatorio) e giuridiche (P.IVA obbligatoria).**; **Agenti | Agenti di vendita con gerarchia agente/supervisore modellata tramite auto-relazione.**; **Polizze | Contratti assicurativi con linea di prodotto, premio annuale e date di decorrenza/scadenza.**; **Sinistri | Rivendicazioni con importo, stato (Aperto/In Gestione/Liquidato/Chiuso/Respinto) e tipologia.** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: **the customer table distinguishes natural persons with a mandatory tax code (CF) from legal persons with a mandatory VAT number (P.IVA), two specifically Italian identifiers, so the model is built on Italy’s actual entity types**; ⭐ **the agent hierarchy is modelled with a self-relation**; **and ⭐⭐ claim status is a five-state enumeration — Aperto, In Gestione, Liquidato, Chiuso, Respinto — so rejection is a terminal state distinct from settlement and closure**, ⭐ **a closer fit to real claims handling than an open-or-closed pair**. **④ ⭐⭐ Its reporting section is verbatim and names both the stored procedures and their parameters**: **Loss Ratio per Prodotto | `dbo.rpt_LossRatioPerPeriodo` | Data inizio / Data fine**; **Performance Agenti | `dbo.rpt_PerformanceAgenti` | Anno (opzionale)**; **with "Report esportabile in PDF ed Excel."** ⭐⭐ **two reports, each with a stored procedure and named parameters, one by date range and one by optional year**; ⭐ **both stored procedures are measurably present under `procedures/`**; and ⭐⭐ **`docs/report-loss-ratio.pdf` and `docs/report-loss-ratio.png` are measurably in the repository — not merely a claim that reports export to PDF, but a PDF committed alongside** (⭐ **the report’s output and the query producing it are both inspectable**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its run order is verbatim, a five-step database build**: **1. `schema/01_create_tables.sql` (creazione tabelle e vincoli); 2. `schema/02_create_indexes.sql` (creazione indici); 3. `sample-data/01_seed_data.sql` (popolamento dati di esempio); 4. `procedures/` (creazione stored procedure); 5. `queries/` (query di analisi eseguibili singolarmente)** ⭐⭐ **table creation and index creation are separate files, so structure comes before indexes**; **and the sample data is its own step with queries declared runnable individually**. **⑥ ⭐ Its runtime requirement is verbatim and names the free edition**: **"**Requisiti:** SQL Server Developer Edition (**gratuita**), SSMS"** — ⭐ **the project states its threshold as "the free edition suffices"**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its stack and documentation output are verbatim**: **"Stack: SQL Server Developer Edition, SSMS, Report Builder (SSRS standalone)"**; **and `docs/er-diagram.png` is measurably present**, **an entity-relationship diagram**. **⑧ ⭐ Readable with the site’s data-tooling, loss-ratio and reserving entries**: [[insurance-data-tools]], [[lossratio-r]], [[run-off-tracker]], [[insurance-governance]], [[claims-reserving-benchmark]], [[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] and [[insurance-portfolio-performance]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as none** — **`LICENSE` is absent among the 20 entries and the README has no licence section**; **⚠️ the entry advises confirming authorisation with the author before copying, modifying or redistributing its schema scripts, queries or reports**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No `.sql` file’s contents were read** — **the six query files and two stored procedures were only checked for existence, not read**; **so no SQL construct, join, window-function usage or recursive CTE implementation detail is restated**; ⭐ **in particular, whether the KPI computations match the stated definitions was not verified** (**for example whether loss ratio really uses earned premium rather than written premium as its denominator — a distinction both round 335’s [[uae-health-pricing-model]] and this round’s [[insurance-portfolio-performance]] handle explicitly, so it is worth checking**); **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ Whether its sample data is synthetic was not verified** — **the README calls `sample-data/01_seed_data.sql` example data, but that file was not read**; ⭐ **given the four-table structure, where customers carry tax code and VAT number fields, real values would involve personal information, so the entry raises it plainly** (**claiming neither that it is de-identified nor that it is not**). **④ ⚠️** This check verified **the repository metadata, the README in full (3,418 bytes, Italian), and the complete list of all 20 entries** — ⭐ **and because there are only 20, every entry was checked**; ⭐⭐ **but did not install SQL Server or SSMS, run any script, read any `.sql` file’s contents, open any image or PDF, or build the database in the given order**. **⑤ ⚠️ Whether its reports can actually be deployed in SSRS and exported was not verified** (**Report Builder was not installed and no `.rdl` file was read**) — ⭐ **in fact no `.rdl` report definition appears among the 20 entries, so whether the reports are committed in a deployable form was not verified**, and **the entry does not claim they can be deployed out of the box**. **⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ Whether its four KPI definitions match Italian or EU industry conventions was not verified** (**no Italian insurance regulatory or industry statistical basis was consulted**); **the entry records only that the definitions are written as stated**. **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its approach applies to other jurisdictions** — **its customer entity types and claim status division both carry Italian practice characteristics**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ Its author’s identity, background and the project’s use were not verified** — **no claim is made that it has been adopted by any insurer, used in production or has produced any real report** (**it describes itself verbatim as a personal learning project, not a company project**). **⑨ ⭐ At ★0, 0 forks, created 2026-08-05 and pushed 2026-09-09**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**. **⑩ ⭐ No topics**; **⚠️ but the entry notes that its primary language measurably is TSQL while comparable entries in the pool are mostly Python or R — a fair amount of insurance analytics happens inside the database rather than in a notebook** (**the entry records what it saw without claiming a trend**). **⑪ The README is in Italian** — ⭐ **a new language for the site’s coverage**; **⚠️ but the entry does not claim Italian-language coverage, since no Italian keyword was searched for and this entry was found through an English descriptor (loss ratio)**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Daddo172/InsuranceAnalytics-TSQL` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence field NONE, stars, forks, language TSQL, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 3,418-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim (Italian); **all 20 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com`; **nothing was cloned, no SQL Server or SSMS was installed, no script was run, no `.sql` file’s contents were read, and no image or PDF was opened**.

entries.title_en: A P&C portfolio loss-ratio dashboard whose KPI table states the formula actually used, and whose headline figure of 7,025 carries an explicit note that it counts issues, not bad rows
entries.title_hk: 財險組合賠付率看板：KPI 表裡寫的是「實際使用的公式」，而 7,025 這個數旁邊專門註明「這是問題條數，不是壞行數」
entries.summary: 一份端到端的财险组合分析流程演示：用 Python 造合成保单与索赔数据、清洗与校验、装入 SQLite、用 SQL 算核心 KPI、导出可复用的报表表，最后做成三页 Power BI 看板；**其数据在文档开头就以警告框声明为 100% 合成**（用固定随机种子 `seed=42` 本地生成），并附带一句可核实的因果分层——**它自己指出的分析动因是「组合层面的平均值会掩盖集中高赔付的细分市场」**；**最值得记的有两处**：**① KPI 表给出的是每个指标「实际使用的公式」**，且其中两处口径与常见的粗算不同——**赔付率＝总已发生赔款／总已赚保费**（**不是已付／已出单**），**索赔频率＝索赔件数／总风险暴露年数**（**不是除以保单件数**，文档逐字解释理由是「以免部分期限保单扭曲该比率」），**并用 `NULLIF` 避免除零**；**② 它把数据质量结果总数 7,025 旁边专门注明这是「问题条数」而非唯一坏行数**，因为一条记录可能同时贡献多个问题，并声明固定种子使这些计数可复现；此外它**逐条列出自己注入的数据缺陷类型**（重复、大小写不一致、可选值缺失、日期格式错误、孤儿索赔、负财务值），**十项缺陷的数量与处置方式都列成表**（其中高额索赔明确是「标记但保留」），并有一节**自陈局限**（数据全合成、静态快照而非多期进展研究、风险等级为简化合成关系而非精算定价模型、未含费用佣金投资收益、未含再保与准备金进展与 IBNR、细分观测更少故赔付率更易波动）
entries.summary_hk: 一份端到端的財險組合分析流程演示：用 Python 造合成保單與索賠數據、清洗與校驗、裝入 SQLite、用 SQL 算核心 KPI、導出可複用的報表表，最後做成三頁 Power BI 看板；**其數據在文檔開頭就以警告框聲明為 100% 合成**（用固定隨機種子 `seed=42` 本地生成），並附帶一句可核實的分析動因——**「組合層面的平均值會掩蓋集中高賠付的細分市場」**；**最值得記的有兩處**：**① KPI 表給出的是每個指標「實際使用的公式」**，且其中兩處口徑與常見粗算不同——**賠付率＝總已發生賠款／總已賺保費**（**不是已付／已出單**），**索賠頻率＝索賠件數／總風險暴露年數**（**不是除以保單件數**，文檔逐字解釋理由是「以免部分期限保單扭曲該比率」），**並用 `NULLIF` 避免除零**；**② 它把數據質量結果總數 7,025 旁邊專門註明這是「問題條數」而非唯一壞行數**，因為一條記錄可能同時貢獻多個問題，並聲明固定種子使這些計數可復現；此外它**逐條列出自己注入的數據缺陷類型**（重複、大小寫不一致、可選值缺失、日期格式錯誤、孤兒索賠、負財務值），**十項缺陷的數量與處置方式都列成表**（其中高額索賠明確是「標記但保留」），並有一節**自陳局限**（數據全合成、靜態快照而非多期進展研究、風險等級為簡化合成關係而非精算定價模型、未含費用佣金投資收益、未含再保與準備金進展與 IBNR、細分觀測更少故賠付率更易波動）
entries.summary_en: An end-to-end demonstration of a P&C portfolio analytics pipeline: it generates synthetic policy and claims data in Python, cleans and validates it, loads it into SQLite, computes core insurance KPIs in SQL, exports reusable reporting tables and presents the result in a three-page Power BI dashboard; **the data is declared 100% synthetic in a warning box at the very top of the documentation** (generated locally with the fixed seed `seed=42`), alongside a verifiable statement of why the analysis exists at all — **that portfolio-level averages can hide concentrated high-loss segments**; **two things are most notable**: **first, its KPI table gives the formula actually used for each metric**, and two of those definitions differ from the naive calculation — **loss ratio is total incurred claim amount over total earned premium** (not paid over written), and **claim frequency is claim count over total exposure years** (not divided by policy count, with the reason stated verbatim as preventing partial-term policies from distorting the rate), **using `NULLIF` to avoid divide-by-zero**; **and second, it annotates its headline data-quality total of 7,025 as an issue count rather than a count of unique bad rows**, because one record can contribute more than one issue, while stating that the fixed seed makes those counts reproducible; it also lists the data defects it deliberately injected (duplicates, inconsistent capitalisation, missing optional values, malformed dates, orphan claims and negative financial values) with a table giving the count and handling of ten issues — high-value claims explicitly flagged but retained — and has a limitations section stating that the dataset is fully synthetic, that the analysis is a static snapshot rather than a multi-period claims-development study, that risk-band and regional effects are simplified synthetic relationships rather than actuarial rating models, that expenses, commissions and investment income are not modelled, that reinsurance, reserve development and IBNR are excluded, and that more granular segments hold fewer observations and may have more volatile loss ratios
entries.body:
**insurance-portfolio-performance**（仓库 `tabishiqbal03/insurance-portfolio-performance`）**是一份端到端的财险组合分析流程演示**：**实测 ★1、主语言 Python、仓库体量 423 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-06（在解冻窗口之内）、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 在 57 个条目中实测不存在——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**README 实测 12,500 字节**；**仓库实测共 57 个条目（49 个文件、8 个目录）**。**其自述逐字为**：**「An end-to-end insurance analytics and business intelligence workflow that simulates how a data/BI team at an insurer might monitor portfolio performance.」**；**技术栈逐字为** **「**Stack:** Python (pandas, NumPy) → SQLite → SQL reporting → Power BI」**，**并注明** **「**Optional:** Streamlit dashboard prototype is also included.」** 与 **「No paid APIs, cloud services, or subscriptions are required to run the data pipeline.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把『这个数从哪来』写在它旁边」**；**⭐ 它是四条里**落实得最制度化的一条**：**KPI 表写公式、质量数写口径、局限单列一节**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 合成声明的位置与措辞**——**其 README 第一行正文即是一个警告框，逐字为**：**「> ⚠️ **All data in this project is 100% SYNTHETIC**, generated locally with a fixed random seed (`seed=42`). It does not represent any real insurer, company, or customer. This is a portfolio/demonstration project only.」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **声明在**最前面****（**不是埋在末尾的免责声明**）；**② **100% 这个词是加粗的**；**③ **它同时否定三种误解**：**不代表任何真实保险公司、不代表任何真实公司、不代表任何真实客户**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其 KPI 表给出的是「实际使用的公式」**，**这正是本轮主题最直接的落点**——**逐字实测其四行**：**「Exposure (years) | `(policy_end_date - policy_start_date) / 365.25`」**；**「Claim Frequency | `claim count / total exposure years`」**；**「Average Claim Severity | `total incurred claim amount / claim count`」**；**「Loss Ratio | `total incurred claim amount / total earned premium`」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **它写的是**公式**，不是指标名**——**且表头逐字为**「KPI | **Formula used**」（**「实际使用的公式」**）**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **赔付率的分子分母是**「已发生赔款 ÷ 已赚保费」**——**⚠️ 即**不是「已付赔款 ÷ 已出单保费」****（**⭐ 本词条指出这是**会计口径而非直觉口径**：**已发生（incurred）含已报未付与已发生未报的估计**，**已赚（earned）只含已过风险期间对应的那部分保费**；**⭐ 该 README 自己也提到 `paid_claim_amount` 与 `incurred_claim_amount` 是**两个不同字段****——**逐字为** **「Paid claim amounts do not exceed incurred claim amounts after cleaning.」**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **索赔频率的分母是**风险暴露年数**而不是保单件数**，**且文档逐字给出理由**：**「Claim frequency is exposure-based rather than simply dividing by policy count, so partial-term policies do not distort the rate.」**——**⭐ 这是本轮所收条目里**把「为什么用这个分母」讲得最清楚的一处****；**④ **它点名了防御性写法**：**「SQL calculations use `NULLIF` where needed to avoid divide-by-zero errors.」**⭐⭐ **即**连「分母可能为零」这种情况也被写了出来**（**⭐ 一处小的、但同属「把数的来源与边界写清楚」的做法**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其数据质量一节把「7,025 是什么」写清楚了**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处**：**它先给出十个问题的**实测计数表****（**policies：可选值缺失 4,651、大小写不一致 2,004、不可解析日期被丢弃 99、日期格式错误 99、保单号重复 75、已出单保费为负 50；claims：孤儿索赔（保单号无效）16、高额索赔被标记但保留 16、索赔号重复 9、已付金额为负 6**）**，**随后逐字写道**：**「**7,025 data-quality issues were logged in total.** This is an issue count, not a count of unique bad rows, because one record can contribute more than one issue.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「这是问题条数，不是唯一坏行数」**——**⭐ 这正是本轮主题的核心：**一个总数旁边写明它计量的是什么****（**且它给出原因：一条记录可能贡献多个问题**）；**② **它说明这些数是**可复现的**：**「The fixed random seed makes these counts reproducible.」**；**③ ⭐⭐ **它先说清处置原则再给数**：**「Issues are logged and handled according to their type rather than being silently discarded.」**——**⭐ 并逐条列出处置方式**：**类别不一致会被统一、重复号记录后删除、必填日期无法解析的记录后删除、孤儿索赔删除、负的保费或赔款被当作符号录入错误予以更正、可选缺失值保留但标记、高额索赔标记但保留**⭐⭐ **即**七种问题各有各的处置**，**其中**两种是「标记但保留」而非删除****（**⭐ 这一区分很重要：**把「标记」与「删除」分开写，意味着被保留的异常仍然在数据里****）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其数据库设计为「为什么有这个视图」给出了理由**——**逐字实测其对象表**：**policies**（一行一张清洗后保单）、**claims**（一行一件清洗后索赔）、**v_claims_enriched**（索赔级视图，连接保单维度）、**v_policy_performance**（**一行一张保单**，汇总索赔件数、已发生赔款与已付赔款；**逐字理由为** **「used to avoid premium/exposure duplication when policies have multiple claims」**）、**v_portfolio_summary**（按产品、地区、风险等级、销售渠道汇总的组合表现）**⭐⭐⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **`v_policy_performance` 的存在被明确解释为**避免保费与暴露被重复计数****（**当一张保单有多件索赔时，直接连接会按索赔件数复制保费**）——**⭐ 这是本轮所见**最典型的「一个结构性决定旁边写着它防的是什么错」****；**② **它区分了「索赔级视图」与「保单级视图」**；**③ **索引建在常被筛选的字段上**（**「Indexes are created on commonly filtered policy and claim fields.」**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **其十项 SQL 报表与十个文件逐一对应，且 README 声明「十份都跑通了」**——**逐字为** **「All 10 reports run successfully through `src/run_reports.py` and are exported to `outputs/reports/` as CSV files.」**；**⭐ 实测其 `sql/` 下确有**十个编号文件**（**`01_data_quality_checks.sql` 至 `10_policy_status_analysis.sql`**）**，**⚠️ 而 ⭐⭐ **更值得注意的是它与 README 所述相符的一处**：**实测 `outputs/reports/` 下确有**十份对应的报表 CSV**（**`02_executive_kpis.csv` 至 `10_policy_status_analysis.csv`**）**，**另有**八份 `01_data_quality_checks_1.csv` 至 `_8.csv`**——**⭐ 即**十项检查中有一项（数据质量）产出了八个明细文件，而不是一份****（**⭐ 这解释了为什么数据质量那一节能有十行分项计数：**它确实逐项落盘了****）；**⭐ 此外 ⭐⭐ **实测 `outputs/reports/business_findings.md` 存在**，**README 逐字指向它**：**「See `outputs/reports/business_findings.md` for the full automatically generated findings and caveats.」**——**⭐ 即**结论是脚本生成的、且连「caveats」也一并生成****（**本词条**未读**该文件内容**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其「已验证结果」表逐字，且它把**欧元金额保留到分****——**逐字实测其十行中的主要项**：**保单数 24,901**；**有效保单 17,095**；**总已出单保费 €11,849,805.92**；**总已赚保费 €10,490,208.27**；**总已发生赔款 €7,135,059.04**；**总已付赔款 €5,202,296.75**；**索赔件数 3,063**；**组合赔付率 68.02%**；**每暴露年索赔频率 0.1331**；**平均索赔强度 €2,329.43**⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① **「已出单」与「已赚」两个保费数**并列给出**（**11,849,805.92 与 10,490,208.27**）**，**这两个数并不相等**——**⭐ 即**KPI 表里赔付率用哪个分母，在这一节里是直接可对照的****；**② **「已发生」与「已付」两个赔款数**也并列给出**（**7,135,059.04 与 5,202,296.75**）**——**⭐ 两组四数并排，使「公式里用的是哪两个」变成可核对的，而不是要读者相信**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其局限一节是自己写的、且逐条**——**逐字实测其中几条**：**「The dataset is fully synthetic and should not be interpreted as evidence about real insurers, customers or geographic risk.」**；**「The analysis is a static portfolio snapshot rather than a multi-period claims-development study.」**；**「Risk-band and regional effects are simplified synthetic relationships, not actuarial rating models.」**；**「Loss ratio is not a complete profitability measure because expenses, commissions, investment income and other costs are not modelled.」**；**「Reinsurance, reserve development and IBNR are not included.」**；**「More granular product × risk-band segments contain fewer observations and may have more volatile loss ratios.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **它明确说赔付率**不是完整的盈利度量**，**并列出未建模的项**（**费用、佣金、投资收益**）——**⭐ 这与本轮 [[insurance-analytics-tsql]] 只给公式不给口径说明形成对照**；**② ⭐⭐ **它点名未含再保、准备金进展与 IBNR**——**⭐ 即**把「这个看板看不到什么」写清楚了****（**可与本站准备金条目并读**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **最后一条自己指出「细分市场观测更少、赔付率更易波动」**——**⭐ 而 ⭐⭐ **本词条指出一处值得并读的地方**：**其「精选发现」把**细分赔付率的极值区间**作为亮点列出**（**Life／Low 最低 26.52%、Travel／Very High 最高 171.23%**）**，**其自动生成的 CV 建议句也写「ranging from 26.5% to 171.2%」**，**而它自己在局限里写了这些细分更容易波动****——**⭐ 本词条**不主张**这是矛盾**（**两个区间确实都是实测值**）**，**只指出：**读者应把极端细分值与其观测数一起读****（**⭐ 这与本站既有做法「不要把好看的数从它所属的口径栏里拎出来」同源**）。**⑧ ⭐ 其项目结构与运行方式**：**实测 `RUN_GUIDE.md` 与 `requirements.txt` 均在仓库中**（**即**有独立运行指南且依赖已声明**）**；**⭐ 其 README 的运行命令为 Windows／PowerShell 风味**（**逐字为 `python src\generate_data.py` 等五步**）**，**另有** **「The Power BI dashboard can be opened directly in Power BI Desktop from the `.pbix` file」**；**⭐ 实测 `dashboards/Insurance_portfolio_dashboard.pbix` 确实在仓库中**——**⭐ 即**看板本体是提交了二进制文件、可直接打开的****，**不是只有截图**（**⭐ 另实测 `screenshots/` 下六张图与 `outputs/charts/` 下三张图均在仓库中**；**⚠️ 本词条**未打开任何图、未打开 `.pbix`**）。**⑨ ⭐ 两处需并读的诚实细节**：**① **它自己指向一个**未提交**的文件**——**其数据质量一节逐字写实际检出问题数来自** **「`data/processed/data_quality_summary.csv`」**，**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ **实测该路径不在仓库的 57 个条目中**（**`data/` 目录本次未见于 tarball 清单**）**——**⭐ 故本词条提示：**README 引用的那份汇总 CSV 本身不在仓库里，可核对的只到 `outputs/reports/01_data_quality_checks_1..8.csv`****；**② ⭐⭐ **其输出中含一个**自动生成的文件名为 `suggested_cv_bullet.txt`**（**实测存在**）**，**⭐ 且 README 单列一节**「Interview-Friendly Summary」与「Suggested CV Bullet」**——**⭐ 本词条如实记录：**该项目明确带**求职作品集**取向****，**并据此提示读者：**读其数字时应留意它们同时承担「展示」功能****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其数字因此不实**——**其全部数字源头是固定种子的合成数据，可复现**）。**⑩ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[insurance-analytics-tsql]]、[[lossratio-r]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[claims-reserving-benchmark]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]]、[[run-off-tracker]]、[[claimscope-benchmark]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **许可实测为**无****——**`LICENSE` 在 57 个条目中实测不存在**，**README 亦无许可章节**，**属「完全未声明」形态**；**⚠️ 提示：**借鉴其清洗逻辑、SQL 或看板设计前应先向作者确认授权****。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未运行该流程的任何一步****——**未运行 `generate_data.py`、`clean_data.py`、`build_database.py`、`run_reports.py`、`generate_findings.py`**，**未建库、未执行任何 `.sql`、未打开 `.pbix`、未运行 Streamlit 应用**；**故**本词条**不主张**「十份报表都跑通」这一声明**已被本词条复现**——**⭐ 该声明是**作者所述且 README 逐字记载**，**⭐ 而本词条只能核实到**其对应的输出 CSV 确实提交在仓库里****。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何 CSV 的内容**——**⭐ 即**本词条**未核对** README 表中所列十项计数（**4,651／2,004／99／99／75／50／16／16／9／6，合计 7,025**）**是否与其提交的 **insurance-portfolio-performance**（倉庫 `tabishiqbal03/insurance-portfolio-performance`）**是一份端到端的財險組合分析流程演示**：**實測 ★1、主語言 Python、體量 423 KB、創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-06（在解凍窗口之內）、無 topics**；**⚠️ 實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 在 57 個條目中實測不存在——屬「完全未聲明」形態）**；**README 實測 12,500 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 57 個條目（49 個文件、8 個目錄）**。**其自述逐字為**：**「An end-to-end insurance analytics and business intelligence workflow that simulates how a data/BI team at an insurer might monitor portfolio performance.」**；**技術棧逐字為** **「**Stack:** Python (pandas, NumPy) → SQLite → SQL reporting → Power BI」**，**並註明** **「**Optional:** Streamlit dashboard prototype is also included.」** 與 **「No paid APIs, cloud services, or subscriptions are required to run the data pipeline.」**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把『這個數從哪來』寫在它旁邊」**；**⭐ 它是四條裡**落實得最制度化的一條**：**KPI 表寫公式、質量數寫口徑、局限單列一節**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 合成聲明的位置與措辭**——**其 README 第一行正文即是一個警告框，逐字為**：**「> ⚠️ **All data in this project is 100% SYNTHETIC**, generated locally with a fixed random seed (`seed=42`). It does not represent any real insurer, company, or customer. This is a portfolio/demonstration project only.」**⭐⭐ **三處**：**① 聲明在**最前面**（不是埋在末尾的免責聲明）；**② 100% 這個詞是加粗的**；**③ 它同時否定三種誤解**（不代表任何真實保險公司、不代表任何真實公司、不代表任何真實客戶）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其 KPI 表給出的是「實際使用的公式」**——**逐字實測其四行**：**Exposure (years)｜`(policy_end_date - policy_start_date) / 365.25`**；**Claim Frequency｜`claim count / total exposure years`**；**Average Claim Severity｜`total incurred claim amount / claim count`**；**Loss Ratio｜`total incurred claim amount / total earned premium`**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐ 它寫的是**公式**而不是指標名，且表頭逐字為**「KPI｜**Formula used**」****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 賠付率的分子分母是**「已發生賠款 ÷ 已賺保費」**——**⚠️ 即**不是「已付賠款 ÷ 已出單保費」****（**⭐ 這是**會計口徑而非直覺口徑**：**已發生含已報未付與已發生未報的估計**，**已賺只含已過風險期間對應的那部分保費**；**⭐ 該 README 自己也提到 `paid_claim_amount` 與 `incurred_claim_amount` 是**兩個不同字段**——逐字為**「Paid claim amounts do not exceed incurred claim amounts after cleaning.」****）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 索賠頻率的分母是**風險暴露年數**而不是保單件數**，**且逐字給出理由**：**「Claim frequency is exposure-based rather than simply dividing by policy count, so partial-term policies do not distort the rate.」**——**⭐ 這是本輪所收條目裡**把「為什麼用這個分母」講得最清楚的一處****；**④ 它點名了防禦性寫法**：**「SQL calculations use `NULLIF` where needed to avoid divide-by-zero errors.」**⭐⭐ **即**連「分母可能為零」也被寫了出來**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其數據質量一節把「7,025 是什麼」寫清楚了**：**先給出十個問題的**實測計數表****（**policies：可選值缺失 4,651、大小寫不一致 2,004、不可解析日期被丟棄 99、日期格式錯誤 99、保單號重複 75、已出單保費為負 50；claims：孤兒索賠（保單號無效）16、高額索賠被標記但保留 16、索賠號重複 9、已付金額為負 6**）**，**隨後逐字寫道**：**「**7,025 data-quality issues were logged in total.** This is an issue count, not a count of unique bad rows, because one record can contribute more than one issue.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「這是問題條數，不是唯一壞行數」——**⭐ 這正是本輪主題的核心：**一個總數旁邊寫明它計量的是什麼****（並給出原因：一條記錄可能貢獻多個問題）；**② 它說明這些數是**可復現的**：**「The fixed random seed makes these counts reproducible.」**；**③ ⭐⭐ 它先說清處置原則再給數**：**「Issues are logged and handled according to their type rather than being silently discarded.」**——**⭐ 並逐條列出處置方式**：類別不一致會被統一、重複號記錄後刪除、必填日期無法解析的記錄後刪除、孤兒索賠刪除、負的保費或賠款被當作符號錄入錯誤予以更正、可選缺失值保留但標記、高額索賠標記但保留**⭐⭐ **即**七種問題各有各的處置**，**其中**兩種是「標記但保留」而非刪除****（**⭐ 把「標記」與「刪除」分開寫，意味著被保留的異常仍然在數據裡**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其數據庫設計為「為什麼有這個視圖」給出了理由**：**policies**（一行一張清洗後保單）、**claims**（一行一件清洗後索賠）、**v_claims_enriched**（索賠級視圖，連接保單維度）、**v_policy_performance**（**一行一張保單**，匯總索賠件數、已發生賠款與已付賠款；**逐字理由為** **「used to avoid premium/exposure duplication when policies have multiple claims」**）、**v_portfolio_summary**（按產品、地區、風險等級、銷售渠道匯總的組合表現）**⭐⭐⭐ 三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ `v_policy_performance` 的存在被明確解釋為**避免保費與暴露被重複計數****（**當一張保單有多件索賠時，直接連接會按索賠件數複製保費**）——**⭐ 這是本輪所見**最典型的「一個結構性決定旁邊寫著它防的是什麼錯」****；**② 它區分「索賠級視圖」與「保單級視圖」**；**③ 索引建在常被篩選的字段上**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **其十項 SQL 報表與十個文件逐一對應，且聲明「十份都跑通了」**：**「All 10 reports run successfully through `src/run_reports.py` and are exported to `outputs/reports/` as CSV files.」**；**⭐ 實測 `sql/` 下確有**十個編號文件**（`01_data_quality_checks.sql` 至 `10_policy_status_analysis.sql`）**；**⭐⭐ 更值得注意**：**實測 `outputs/reports/` 下確有**十份對應的報表 CSV**（`02_executive_kpis.csv` 至 `10_policy_status_analysis.csv`）**，**另有**八份 `01_data_quality_checks_1.csv` 至 `_8.csv`**——**⭐ 即**十項檢查中有一項（數據質量）產出了八個明細文件而非一份****（**⭐ 這解釋了為何數據質量那節能有十行分項計數：**它確實逐項落盤了****）；**⭐ 另實測 `outputs/reports/business_findings.md` 存在**，**README 逐字指向它**：**「See `outputs/reports/business_findings.md` for the full automatically generated findings and caveats.」**——**⭐ 即**結論是腳本生成的、連 caveats 也一併生成****（**未讀該文件內容**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其「已驗證結果」表逐字，且把**歐元金額保留到分****：**保單數 24,901；有效保單 17,095；總已出單保費 €11,849,805.92；總已賺保費 €10,490,208.27；總已發生賠款 €7,135,059.04；總已付賠款 €5,202,296.75；索賠件數 3,063；組合賠付率 68.02%；每暴露年索賠頻率 0.1331；平均索賠強度 €2,329.43**⭐⭐ **兩處**：**① 「已出單」與「已賺」兩個保費數**並列給出**（11,849,805.92 與 10,490,208.27）**，**這兩個數並不相等**——**⭐ 即**KPI 表裡賠付率用哪個分母，在這一節裡是直接可對照的****；**② 「已發生」與「已付」兩個賠款數**也並列給出**（7,135,059.04 與 5,202,296.75）**——**⭐ 兩組四數並排，使「公式裡用的是哪兩個」變成可核對的**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其局限一節逐條**：**「The dataset is fully synthetic and should not be interpreted as evidence about real insurers, customers or geographic risk.」**；**「The analysis is a static portfolio snapshot rather than a multi-period claims-development study.」**；**「Risk-band and regional effects are simplified synthetic relationships, not actuarial rating models.」**；**「Loss ratio is not a complete profitability measure because expenses, commissions, investment income and other costs are not modelled.」**；**「Reinsurance, reserve development and IBNR are not included.」**；**「More granular product × risk-band segments contain fewer observations and may have more volatile loss ratios.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐ 它明確說賠付率**不是完整的盈利度量**並列出未建模項（費用、佣金、投資收益）**；**② ⭐⭐ 它點名未含再保、準備金進展與 IBNR**——**⭐ 即**把「這個看板看不到什麼」寫清楚了****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 最後一條自己指出「細分市場觀測更少、賠付率更易波動」**——**⭐ 而 ⭐⭐ 本詞條指出一處值得並讀的地方**：**其「精選發現」把**細分賠付率的極值區間**作為亮點列出**（**Life／Low 最低 26.52%、Travel／Very High 最高 171.23%**）**，**其自動生成的 CV 建議句也寫「ranging from 26.5% to 171.2%」**，**而它自己在局限裡寫了這些細分更容易波動****——**⭐ 本詞條**不主張**這是矛盾**（**兩個區間確實都是實測值**）**，**只指出：**讀者應把極端細分值與其觀測數一起讀****（**⭐ 與本站既有做法「不要把好看的數從它所屬的口徑欄裡拎出來」同源**）。**⑧ ⭐ 其項目結構與運行方式**：**實測 `RUN_GUIDE.md` 與 `requirements.txt` 均在倉庫中**（**有獨立運行指南且依賴已聲明**）**；**⭐ 其運行命令為 Windows／PowerShell 風味**（`python src\generate_data.py` 等五步）**，**另有** **「The Power BI dashboard can be opened directly in Power BI Desktop from the `.pbix` file」**；**⭐ 實測 `dashboards/Insurance_portfolio_dashboard.pbix` 確實在倉庫中**——**⭐ 即**看板本體是提交了二進制文件、可直接打開的****，**不是只有截圖**（**⭐ 另實測 `screenshots/` 下六張圖與 `outputs/charts/` 下三張圖均在倉庫中**；**⚠️ 未打開任何圖、未打開 `.pbix`**）。**⑨ ⭐ 兩處需並讀的誠實細節**：**① 它自己指向一個**未提交**的文件**——**其數據質量一節逐字寫實際檢出問題數來自** **「`data/processed/data_quality_summary.csv`」**，**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ **實測該路徑不在倉庫的 57 個條目中**（**`data/` 目錄本次未見於 tarball 清單**）**——**⭐ 故提示：**README 引用的那份匯總 CSV 本身不在倉庫裡，可核對的只到 `outputs/reports/01_data_quality_checks_1..8.csv`****；**② ⭐⭐ 其輸出中含一個**自動生成的文件名為 `suggested_cv_bullet.txt`**（**實測存在**）**，**⭐ 且 README 單列一節**「Interview-Friendly Summary」與「Suggested CV Bullet」**——**⭐ 如實記錄：**該項目明確帶**求職作品集**取向****，**並據此提示讀者：**讀其數字時應留意它們同時承擔「展示」功能****（**⚠️ **不主張**其數字因此不實**——**其全部數字源頭是固定種子的合成數據，可復現**）。**⑩ ⭐ 可與 並讀**。

**insurance-portfolio-performance** (repository `tabishiqbal03/insurance-portfolio-performance`) **is an end-to-end demonstration of a P&C portfolio analytics pipeline**: **measured ★1, primary language Python, a 423 KB repository, created and last pushed on 2026-09-06 (inside the thaw window), no topics** (all GitHub API measurements); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` absent among the 57 entries — the "no statement whatever" form)**; **the README measures 12,500 bytes**; **the repository measures 57 entries (49 files, 8 directories)**. **It describes itself verbatim as** **"An end-to-end insurance analytics and business intelligence workflow that simulates how a data/BI team at an insurer might monitor portfolio performance."**; **its stack is verbatim** **"**Stack:** Python (pandas, NumPy) → SQLite → SQL reporting → Power BI"**, **with** **"**Optional:** Streamlit dashboard prototype is also included."** **and** **"No paid APIs, cloud services, or subscriptions are required to run the data pipeline."** The entry belongs to this round’s theme of **writing down where each number came from**, and ⭐ **it is the most institutionalised of the four: the KPI table states its formulas, the quality figure states its unit of count, and the limitations get their own section**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① The synthetic-data declaration, its position and its wording** — **the README’s first line of body text is a warning box, verbatim**: **"> ⚠️ **All data in this project is 100% SYNTHETIC**, generated locally with a fixed random seed (`seed=42`). It does not represent any real insurer, company, or customer. This is a portfolio/demonstration project only."** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: **the declaration comes first rather than being buried at the end**; **the phrase 100% is bold**; **and it denies three misreadings at once — not any real insurer, not any real company, not any real customer**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its KPI table gives the formula actually used, which is the most direct landing point for this round’s theme** — **its four rows measure verbatim as**: **Exposure (years) | `(policy_end_date - policy_start_date) / 365.25`**; **Claim Frequency | `claim count / total exposure years`**; **Average Claim Severity | `total incurred claim amount / claim count`**; **Loss Ratio | `total incurred claim amount / total earned premium`** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐ **it gives formulas rather than metric names, under a column headed "KPI | Formula used"**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the loss ratio’s numerator and denominator are incurred claims over earned premium, not paid over written** (⭐ **an accounting definition rather than the intuitive one: incurred includes reported-but-unpaid and an estimate for incurred-but-not-reported, while earned covers only the premium attributable to the risk period already elapsed**; ⭐ **the README itself notes that `paid_claim_amount` and `incurred_claim_amount` are two distinct fields, verbatim: "Paid claim amounts do not exceed incurred claim amounts after cleaning."**); ⭐⭐⭐ **claim frequency divides by exposure years rather than policy count, with the reason stated verbatim — "Claim frequency is exposure-based rather than simply dividing by policy count, so partial-term policies do not distort the rate."** — ⭐ **the clearest statement in this round’s entries of why a particular denominator was chosen**; **and it names its defensive coding, "SQL calculations use `NULLIF` where needed to avoid divide-by-zero errors."** ⭐⭐ **so even "the denominator may be zero" is written down**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its data-quality section spells out what 7,025 is, the single most notable point in this entry**: **it first gives a measured count table for ten issues** (**policies: missing optional value 4,651; inconsistent capitalisation 2,004; dropped unparseable dates 99; malformed date 99; duplicate policy ID 75; negative written premium 50; claims: orphan claim with invalid policy ID 16; high-value claim flagged but not removed 16; duplicate claim ID 9; negative paid amount 6**) **and then states verbatim**: **"**7,025 data-quality issues were logged in total.** This is an issue count, not a count of unique bad rows, because one record can contribute more than one issue."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **"an issue count, not a count of unique bad rows" is precisely this round’s theme — a total annotated with what it measures, with the reason given that one record can contribute several issues**; **it states these counts are reproducible — "The fixed random seed makes these counts reproducible."**; **and ⭐⭐ it states its handling principle before the numbers — "Issues are logged and handled according to their type rather than being silently discarded."** — **listing the handling of each: inconsistent categories standardised, duplicate IDs logged and removed, malformed mandatory dates logged and removed, orphan claims removed, negative premium or claim values treated as sign-entry errors and corrected, optional missing values retained but flagged, and high-value claims flagged but retained**, ⭐⭐ **so seven issue types each have their own handling, and two of them are flagged rather than deleted** (⭐ **a distinction that matters: separating "flagged" from "removed" means the retained anomalies are still in the data**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its database design gives a reason for why a view exists** — **its object table measures verbatim as**: **policies** (one row per cleaned policy), **claims** (one row per cleaned claim), **v_claims_enriched** (claim-level view joined to policy dimensions), **v_policy_performance** (**one row per policy**, rolling up claim count, incurred claims and paid claims, **verbatim reason: "used to avoid premium/exposure duplication when policies have multiple claims"**), and **v_portfolio_summary** (aggregated portfolio performance by product, region, risk band and sales channel) ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **`v_policy_performance` exists and its purpose is stated as preventing premium and exposure duplication, because joining directly would replicate premium once per claim — the clearest example this round of a structural decision carrying a note of the error it prevents**; **it separates the claim-level view from the policy-level view**; **and indexes are created on commonly filtered policy and claim fields**. **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Its ten SQL reports correspond one to one with ten files, and it declares all ten ran** — **"All 10 reports run successfully through `src/run_reports.py` and are exported to `outputs/reports/` as CSV files."**; ⭐ **ten numbered files do measurably exist under `sql/` (from `01_data_quality_checks.sql` to `10_policy_status_analysis.sql`)**; **and ⭐⭐ more notably, `outputs/reports/` measurably holds ten corresponding report CSVs (`02_executive_kpis.csv` through `10_policy_status_analysis.csv`) plus eight data-quality detail files, `01_data_quality_checks_1.csv` through `_8.csv`** — ⭐ **that is, one of the ten checks produces eight detail files rather than one, which explains how the data-quality section can carry ten separate counts: it really did write each out**; ⭐ **`outputs/reports/business_findings.md` is also measurably present**, **with the README pointing at it verbatim — "See `outputs/reports/business_findings.md` for the full automatically generated findings and caveats."** — ⭐ **the findings are script-generated and even the caveats are generated with them** (**that file’s contents were not read**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its verified-results table is verbatim and carries euro amounts to the cent**: **policy count 24,901; active policies 17,095; total written premium €11,849,805.92; total earned premium €10,490,208.27; total incurred claims €7,135,059.04; total paid claims €5,202,296.75; claim count 3,063; portfolio loss ratio 68.02%; claim frequency per exposure-year 0.1331; average claim severity €2,329.43** ⭐⭐ **Two things**: **both written and earned premium are given side by side (11,849,805.92 and 10,490,208.27) and they are not equal, so which denominator the loss ratio uses is directly checkable in this section**; **and both incurred and paid claims are given side by side (7,135,059.04 and 5,202,296.75) — four numbers in two pairs, turning "which two does the formula use" into something a reader can verify rather than believe**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its limitations section is itemised**: **"The dataset is fully synthetic and should not be interpreted as evidence about real insurers, customers or geographic risk."**; **"The analysis is a static portfolio snapshot rather than a multi-period claims-development study."**; **"Risk-band and regional effects are simplified synthetic relationships, not actuarial rating models."**; **"Loss ratio is not a complete profitability measure because expenses, commissions, investment income and other costs are not modelled."**; **"Reinsurance, reserve development and IBNR are not included."**; **"More granular product × risk-band segments contain fewer observations and may have more volatile loss ratios."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **it states plainly that loss ratio is not a complete profitability measure and lists what is unmodelled — expenses, commissions and investment income**; ⭐⭐ **it names the exclusions — reinsurance, reserve development and IBNR — so what the dashboard cannot show is written down**; **and ⭐⭐⭐ the final clause itself warns that the more granular segments hold fewer observations and are more volatile** — ⭐ **while ⭐⭐ the entry notes a point worth reading together: its "selected findings" list the extremes of segment loss ratio as highlights (Life/Low lowest at 26.52%, Travel/Very High highest at 171.23%) and its auto-generated CV bullet also says "ranging from 26.5% to 171.2%", even though its own limitations warn those very segments are more volatile** — ⭐ **the entry does not call this a contradiction (both ranges are measured values) but notes that the extreme segment values should be read alongside their observation counts**, ⭐ **the same principle as the site’s existing practice of not lifting flattering numbers out of their scope column**. **⑧ ⭐ Structure and how to run it**: **`RUN_GUIDE.md` and `requirements.txt` are both measurably present, so there is a separate run guide and the dependencies are declared**; ⭐ **the run commands are Windows/PowerShell-flavoured (`python src\generate_data.py` and four more)**, **with "The Power BI dashboard can be opened directly in Power BI Desktop from the `.pbix` file"**; ⭐ **`dashboards/Insurance_portfolio_dashboard.pbix` is measurably in the repository — the dashboard itself is committed as a binary that opens directly, not just screenshots** (⭐ **six images under `screenshots/` and three more under `outputs/charts/` are also committed**; ⚠️ **no image and no `.pbix` was opened**). **⑨ ⭐ Two honest details worth reading alongside**: **it points at one file that is not committed — the data-quality section states verbatim that the detected issue counts come from "`data/processed/data_quality_summary.csv`", but ⭐⭐ that path is measurably not among the repository’s 57 entries (no `data/` directory appears in the tarball listing)** — ⭐ **so the summary CSV the README cites is not in the repository, and checking reaches only as far as `outputs/reports/01_data_quality_checks_1..8.csv`**; **and ⭐⭐ one of its generated outputs is literally named `suggested_cv_bullet.txt` (measurably present), with the README devoting a section to an "Interview-Friendly Summary" and a "Suggested CV Bullet"** — ⭐ **the entry records plainly that the project explicitly serves a job-portfolio purpose, and therefore advises reading its numbers with the awareness that they also perform a display function** (⚠️ **without claiming the numbers are untrue — their entire source is fixed-seed synthetic data and is reproducible**). **⑩ ⭐ Readable with** [[insurance-analytics-tsql]], [[lossratio-r]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[insurance-frequency-severity]], [[claims-reserving-benchmark]], [[verified-reserving]], [[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]], [[run-off-tracker]] and [[claimscope-benchmark]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as none** — **`LICENSE` is absent among the 57 entries and the README has no licence section**; **⚠️ the entry advises confirming authorisation with the author before borrowing its cleaning logic, SQL or dashboard design**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No step of the pipeline was run** — **none of the five Python scripts was run, no database was built, no `.sql` was executed, the `.pbix` was not opened and the Streamlit app was not started**; **so the claim that all ten reports run is not claimed to have been reproduced here** — ⭐ **that claim is the author’s, recorded verbatim in the README, and all this entry could verify is that the corresponding output CSVs are committed to the repository**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No CSV’s contents were read** — ⭐ **so the ten counts in the README table (4,651 / 2,004 / 99 / 99 / 75 / 50 / 16 / 16 / 9 / 6, totalling 7,025) were not checked against the committed `outputs/reports/01_data_quality_checks_1..8.csv`**; **⚠️ all that was checked is that those files exist** (⭐ **so the total is not claimed to be independently verified — the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**). **④ ⚠️⚠️ Whether its 68.02% loss ratio is correct was not verified** — **`sql/05_loss_ratio_analysis.sql` and `src/run_reports.py` were not read, and no recomputation was done**, **so the implementation is not claimed to match the stated formula**. **⑤ ⚠️ Whether its synthetic data really contains no real information was not verified** (**the README states it is 100% synthetic, generated locally from a fixed seed, but `src/generate_data.py` was not read and no data file was downloaded**); **the entry records the declaration only**. **⑥ ⚠️ Whether the `.pbix` opens in Power BI Desktop with the three pages described was not verified** (**the file was not opened**). **⑦ ⚠️ The "selected findings" values were not verified** (**`outputs/reports/business_findings.md` was not read and nothing was recomputed**). **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ No business meaning is claimed for any segment result** — ⚠️ **its region names and risk bands are synthetic labels, and its own documentation states verbatim that they should not be interpreted as evidence about real insurers, customers or geographic risk**. **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ Its author’s identity and the project’s use were not verified** — **no claim is made that it has been adopted by any insurer or used in production** (**it describes itself verbatim as a portfolio/demonstration project**). **⑩ ⭐ At ★1 with no topics**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity or adoption is claimed**; ⚠️ **but the entry notes that its README measures 12,500 bytes and is structurally complete — fifteen sections including a data dictionary, an architecture diagram, limitations and future improvements — the shape where metadata is sparse while documentation is detailed**, ⭐ **and the site requires that shape to be written down rather than letting a star count stand in for judgement**. **⑪ ⭐ This is a repository created 2026-09-06**, ⚠️ **so its snapshot-style results will change with time and with README updates** — **the entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/tabishiqbal03/insurance-portfolio-performance` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence NONE, stars, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 12,500-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; **all 57 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com`; **nothing was cloned, no script was run, no database was built, no CSV, `.sql` or `.py` contents were read, and no image or `.pbix` was opened**.
