That is a statistical limit of the short window, not a code defect; exact recovery on a noise-free series is unit-tested.」——三处已写明：①明确区分两类误差来源并指出其中一类不该去修代码；②并给出证据（在无噪声序列上能精确恢复，有单元测试）；③误差幅度被量化；⭐⭐回测误差率被要求当下界读（逐字「Everything is synthetic…the backtest error rates here should be read as a lower bound, not what you would see in production.」，并列出真实数据会带来的四件事：个案准备金变动、给付变化、季节性冲击、大额索赔）；⭐其余细节：零分母回退为 1.0 被写明；两种方法的公式逐条写出；方法落在单一文件 ratecraft/reserving.py；⭐实测其仓库结构与自述逐一对应（eval/ 五个文件、results/ 四份已提交实测输出、tests/ 七个测试文件、tests/fixtures/taylor_ashe.json、examples/sample_exhibits.xlsx、bench/benchmark.py、datagen/generator.py、RESULTS.md 均在）——即 README 点名的每一项都存在且测试文件名与三层验证逐一对应；⚠️⚠️未运行该引擎任何一步（未创建虚拟环境、未安装依赖、未运行 pytest、未运行任何 eval/ 脚本、未打开样例工作簿），故不主张其所述的 77 个测试、100% 覆盖率、四位数复现、18,680,856 的复现、200 个数据集回测或 MAPE／偏差诸值已被复现——本词条核实到的是 README 的逐字声明、fixture 文件的实际内容、以及其点名的全部文件确实存在于仓库中；⚠️⚠️未读任何 .py 文件的内容——即未核对链梯法与 BF 的实现是否与 README 所列公式一致（**这是本条最需要后续核实的一处**）、naive_oracle.py 是否确实与引擎不共享任何代码（这一点是本条第二层验证的全部价值所在，而未做代码比对）、reconcile 是否确实以「差为 0 分」为不变量、Excel 往返测试是否确实用 == 而无容差；⚠️⚠️未核实其声称的 77 tests／100% coverage；⚠️未读 RESULTS.md、results/ 下任何 JSON、examples/sample_exhibits.xlsx 的内容——即未核对 README 所引诸数是否与提交的结果文件一致；⚠️⚠️未核实其三角数据与已发表结果的转录是否正确（未访问任何论文原文，故无法判断九个因子与总额是否确为 Mack 1993 与 England & Verrall 2002 所载值）——这正是该做法的固有依赖：它把正确性押在第三方文献的转录上，而转录本身也需要被核对（已核实的是文件内确实写明了出处，而非数值本身正确）；⭐不主张其费率、准备金或任何输出可用于真实定价、报表或监管用途（其自述称一切皆合成，且明言无 Mack／随机方差估计、无 GLM 定价、无风险调整、无州报送格式，逐字为 Point estimates only）；⭐未核实其是否适用于健康险以外的险种；⭐未核实其作者身份、资历或该项目的用途；★0、fork 0，关注度为零，不主张其成熟度或已被采用；⚠️但本词条指出其仓库仅 68 KB、31 个文件却含三层验证、四个已提交结果文件、一个已提交样例工作簿与一份 RESULTS.md——即体积极小、验证结构极完整的一种形态；⚠️其与本轮同批的 policyforge-rating-engine 为同一作者，两者同属「手算／已发表参照＋不变量」这一做法的两个不同产品，本词条不主张二者无代码重叠；⚠️创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内；⚠️本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见——该仓库创建不足一个月，其内容与结果文件会变动。核实手段补充说明：仓库全部 39 个条目经下载 codeload.github.com tarball 后以 tar tz 列出核对；未克隆、未创建虚拟环境、未安装依赖、未运行任何测试或脚本、未读任何 .py／RESULTS.md／results JSON 的内容、未打开那份 .xlsx、未访问任何论文原文

entries.title: 「我把三份保单**用纸笔算了一遍，并把结果作为黄金夹具提交进仓库**」：一条「金额全程整数分、不含任何浮点」的规则，使每一份报价都能被手算复现到分（连中间值一起）
entries.title_en: I worked three policies out on paper and committed the results as golden fixtures: an integer-cents, no-float-anywhere rule that makes every quote reproducible by hand to the cent, intermediates included
entries.title_hk: 「我把三份保單**用紙筆算了一遍，並把結果作為黃金夾具提交進倉庫**」：一條「金額全程整數分、不含任何浮點」的規則，使每一份報價都能被手算復現到分（連中間值一起）
entries.summary: 一份个人车险的**费率引擎 ＋ 理赔结算计算器 ＋ 再定价工具**（回答「改一个费率因子，整本保单会怎样」），自称出发点是想在**算术层面**搞清车险定价与赔付到底怎么运作，因此全部从零写起；**其最值得记的一处是一条自设的算术规则**——**逐字为「我全程给自己定的规则：**金额是整数分，因子是以 1000 为标度缩放的整数，只在有记录的节点上做四舍五入（half up）**。**金额路径上没有一个浮点数**，这正是使每一份报价与每一次结算**可以被精确复现并被手算核对**的原因。」**——**⭐ 即它把「可手算核对」当成一个**算术设计的后果**，而不是一句承诺**；**并且它真的手算了**：**「`Quote` 对象暴露每一个中间步骤，于是你可以拿着费率表和一张纸复现任何一份保费。**我对三份完整保单正是这么做的，并把它们作为黄金夹具提交在 `fixtures/golden_quotes.json`；测试断言引擎与我的手算在**分**的层面上一致，**包括中间值**。」**；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① 同一输入两次定价必得同一保费**——**逐字「这听起来是显然的，但**它是一条被测过的性质，不是一个假设**」**；**② 三个赔付不变量（赔付不为负、不超过限额、免赔额恰好扣一次）用**两种方式**验证**——**手算的边界矩阵（覆盖在每一个免赔额、限额与上限的**下方、等于、以及高出一分**三处）＋随机扫查（**每类结算 10 万个带种子的随机案例、合计 30 万，零不变量违反**）**；**③ 它有一节专门的**「本模型不做什么」**，含「费率表是编的、不是任何保险人报备的费率、这里不为真实保险定价」「真实核保还用驾驶人记录点数、车辆符号、允许时的信用分、车联网，且建立在拟合模型上而非五因子链」「按比例分摊只是**一种**合理惯例，真实承保人可能顺序结算或协商结算」「基准是 Apple 芯片上的单线程纯 Python，且结算路径比定价路径轻得多，这就是吞吐量差 30 倍的原因」
entries.summary_hk: 一份個人車險的**費率引擎 ＋ 理賠結算計算器 ＋ 再定價工具**（回答「改一個費率因子，整本保單會怎樣」），自稱出發點是想在**算術層面**搞清車險定價與賠付到底怎麼運作，因此全部從零寫起；**其最值得記的一處是一條自設的算術規則**——**逐字為「我全程給自己定的規則：**金額是整數分，因子是以 1000 為標度縮放的整數，只在有記錄的節點上做四捨五入（half up）**。**金額路徑上沒有一個浮點數**，這正是使每一份報價與每一次結算**可以被精確復現並被手算核對**的原因。」**——**⭐ 即它把「可手算核對」當成一個**算術設計的後果**，而不是一句承諾**；**並且它真的手算了**：**「`Quote` 對象暴露每一個中間步驟，於是你可以拿着費率表和一張紙復現任何一份保費。**我對三份完整保單正是這麼做的，並把它們作為黃金夾具提交在 `fixtures/golden_quotes.json`；測試斷言引擎與我的手算在**分**的層面上一致，**包括中間值**。」**；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① 同一輸入兩次定價必得同一保費**——**逐字「這聽起來是顯然的，但**它是一條被測過的性質，不是一個假設**」**；**② 三個賠付不變量（賠付不為負、不超過限額、免賠額恰好扣一次）用**兩種方式**驗證**——**手算的邊界矩陣（覆蓋在每一個免賠額、限額與上限的**下方、等於、以及高出一分**三處）＋隨機掃查（**每類結算 10 萬個帶種子的隨機案例、合計 30 萬，零不變量違反**）**；**③ 它有一節專門的**「本模型不做什麼」**，含「費率表是編的、不是任何保險人報備的費率、這裡不為真實保險定價」「真實核保還用駕駛人記錄點數、車輛符號、允許時的信用分、車聯網，且建立在擬合模型上而非五因子鏈」「按比例分攤只是**一種**合理慣例，真實承保人可能順序結算或協商結算」「基準是 Apple 芯片上的單線程純 Python，且結算路徑比定價路徑輕得多，這就是吞吐量差 30 倍的原因」
entries.summary_en: A personal auto insurance rating engine, claims settlement calculator and re-rate tool answering what happens to a whole book if one rate factor changes, written from scratch because the author wanted to understand how personal auto pricing and claims payouts work at the arithmetic level; **its most notable feature is a self-imposed arithmetic rule** — verbatim: the rule held to the entire time is that money is integer cents, factors are integers scaled by 1000, and rounding is half up at documented points only, **with not a single float anywhere in the money path, which is what makes every quote and every settlement exactly reproducible and checkable by hand** — ⭐ **so hand-checkability is made a consequence of an arithmetic decision rather than a promise**; **and the hand arithmetic was actually done**: the quote object exposes every intermediate step so a reader can sit down with the rate tables and a piece of paper and reproduce any premium, **and that was done for three full policies and committed as golden fixtures, with tests asserting the engine matches the hand arithmetic to the cent including the intermediates**; **three further points follow the same discipline**: rating the same input twice always gives the same premium, which sounds obvious **but is a tested property rather than an assumption**; **three payout invariants — a payment is never negative, never exceeds its limit, and a deductible is applied exactly once — are verified two ways, by a hand-computed edge matrix covering losses below, at and one cent above every deductible, limit and cap, and by randomised sweeps of 100,000 seeded cases per settlement type, 300,000 in total, with zero invariant violations**; **and it devotes a section to what the model does not do**, stating that the rate tables are invented and are not filed rates from any insurer or regulator, that nothing here prices real insurance, that real rating plans use far more variables such as driving record points, vehicle symbols, credit-based scores where allowed and telematics, built on fitted models rather than a five-factor chain, that the pro rata occurrence rule is one reasonable convention while real carriers may settle sequentially or by negotiation, and that the benchmarks are single-threaded pure Python on Apple silicon with a settlement path much lighter than the rating path, which is why the throughput figures differ by thirty times
entries.body:
**policyforge-rating-engine**（仓库 `Mohith26/hartford-pc-rating-claims`，工具名 PolicyForge）**是一份个人车险的费率引擎 ＋ 理赔结算计算器 ＋ 再定价工具**：**三个部分**逐字为 **「a tabular rating engine, a claims settlement calculator, and a small tool that answers "if we change this rate factor, what happens to the whole book?"」**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **NONE**（**实测该仓库无任何许可文件**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 23 KB、创建 2026-08-24、最后推送 2026-09-08、topics 为 `actuarial`／`claims`／`deterministic`／`fintech`／`insurance`／`insurtech`／`integer-arithmetic`／`property-testing`／`python`／`rating-engine`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内**）；**README 实测 4,628 字节**；**仓库实测共 27 个条目（23 个文件、4 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「标准答案要放在被检验的系统之外」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把标准答案**手算出来并提交进仓库**的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 一条自设的算术规则，且它把「可手算核对」写成这条规则的后果**——**这是本条最值得记的一处**：**逐字为**：**「The rule I held myself to the entire time: **money is integer cents, factors are integers scaled by 1000, and rounding is half up at documented points only**. **There is not a single float anywhere in the money path, which is what makes every quote and every settlement exactly reproducible and checkable by hand.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「金额路径上没有**一个**浮点数」是一个**可被检查的强断言****——**⭐ 即**不是「尽量避免浮点误差」，而是**一个都不许有****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **因与果被写在同一个句子里**：**整数分 ＋ 定点因子 ＋ 只在记录节点四舍五入 → 每一份报价与每一次结算**可以被精确复现并被手算核对****——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里**「可核对性」被写得最像工程推导的一处**：**先定算术，再得到性质****；**③ **「只在**有记录的**节点上四舍五入」**——**⭐ 即**四舍五入的位置本身是一份**必须被记录在案的清单**（**⭐ 下 ② 中它确实逐处写出了位置**）；**④ **因子被写成**以 1000 为标度的整数****——**⭐ 即**小数也被定点化，而不是只把金额整数化**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它真的手算了，并把结果作为黄金夹具提交**——**逐字为**：**「The `Quote` object **exposes every intermediate step**, so you can sit down with the rate tables and a piece of paper and reproduce any premium. **I did exactly that for three full policies and committed them as golden fixtures in `fixtures/golden_quotes.json`; the tests assert the engine matches my hand arithmetic to the cent, including the intermediates.**」**；**并逐字写出计价链与舍入位置**：**「`base -> x territory -> x driver class -> x tier -> x coverage option`」**，**「with a **round half up to the cent after every multiplication, in that exact order**」**；**覆盖类型逐字为** **「bodily injury, property damage, collision, comprehensive, rental」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「我对三份完整保单**正是这么做的**」**——**⭐ 即**标准答案不是程序产生的，**是人拿纸笔算出来的，然后**提交进仓库作为夹具****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「包括中间值」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本条最关键的一处**：**多数项目的夹具只固定**最终值**，**而它连**每一步中间量**都要求一致**（**⭐ 即**若中间某一步的舍入位置错了，测试**会在那一步就失败**，而不是等最终值偶然对上**）；**③ **因子链的**顺序**被写明并声明为**精确顺序**（**「in that exact order」**）**——**⭐ 即**乘法可交换但**逐次舍入不可交换**，**故顺序必须固定**；**④ **对象暴露每一步**是这条做法的**接口前提**（**⭐ 即**若中间值不可读出，就不可能被断言**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其实测夹具文件是本会话所见「黄金值」落盘最完整的一次**——**本词条**实测读取** `fixtures/golden_quotes.json`：**其 `comment` 字段逐字为** **「Hand computed golden quotes against the default tables. **Every value was worked out on paper with the documented chain**: base, x territory, x class, x tier, x option, rounding half up to a cent after each multiplication. Amounts are integer cents.」**；**三条夹具各含** `name`、`territory`、`driver_class`、`tier`、`coverages`、**`expected_coverage_cents`**（**逐覆盖类型的分值**）、**`expected_total_cents`**，**以及** **`bi_intermediates`**（**责任险那一条链的五个中间值**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **注释里逐字写了「每一个值都是用纸笔按成文的链算出来的」**——**⭐ 即**该文件**自带其产生方式的说明**，**不需要另读文档才知道这些数从哪来****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**中间值也存进了夹具**（**`bi_intermediates` 含五个数**）**——**⭐ 即**上 ② 中「包括中间值」这句话**在文件层面被证实**；**③ ⭐⭐ **每一个覆盖类型**分开给分值**，**再给合计**（**⭐ 即**部分与总和都被固定，**故**合计错了但分项对、或反之，都能被发现**）；**④ **每条夹具都有**业务语义名字**（**例：`T2 youth standard, full coverage`／`T1 adult preferred, liability plus collision`／`T3 senior nonstandard, max options`**）**——**⭐ 即**夹具覆盖了三类互不相同的风险与保障组合**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「确定性」写成一条被测过的性质，而不是一个假设**——**逐字为**：**「Rating the same input twice always gives the same premium. **That sounds obvious, but it is a tested property, not an assumption.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「这听起来是显然的，但它是一条**被测过的**性质」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所收条目里**对「显然的事也要测」说得最直接的一句****（**⭐ 其 topics 里也确实有 `deterministic`**）；**② **⭐ 它与上 ① 的整数算术规则互为因果**：**正因为金额路径无浮点，确定性才是可保证的**——**而它仍然去测**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **三个赔付不变量用两种方式验证，且第二种的规模与方法都被写明**——**逐字为**：**「Three invariants hold everywhere: **a payment is never negative, never exceeds its limit, and a deductible is applied exactly once**. I verify this **two ways**. First, **a hand computed edge matrix** in `tests/test_claims_edge_matrix.py` covering **losses below, at, and one cent above every deductible, limit, and cap**. Second, **randomized sweeps: 100,000 seeded random cases per settlement type (300,000 total) with zero invariant violations**. The sweep numbers in `results/property_checks.json` **come from the same code the tests run**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **两种方式互为补充且各有分工**：**手算边界矩阵**负责**边界**（**下方／等于／高出一分**三处）**，**随机扫查**负责**广度**（**30 万案例**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「测了很多」，而是**边界与广度分开覆盖****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **边界矩阵是**手算的****（**⭐ 即**第二处「标准答案来自纸笔」**）**；**③ ⭐⭐ **「零不变量违反」是一个**零指标****（**⭐ 与上一轮 [[medical-opinion-extractor]] 的「样版判别失败 0 件」同族**）；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「扫查的数字来自测试所运行的同一份代码」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这一句很重要：**它排除了「提交的结果文件与测试跑的不是同一实现」这种情况****（**⭐ 即**公开的数字**与**被验证的行为**被绑在同一实现上**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **三个不变量的措辞本身很精确**——**逐字为「赔付不为负」「不超过其限额」「免赔额恰好扣一次」**⭐⭐ **即**第三条是**「恰好一次」而不是「至少一次」**——**⭐ 即**它同时封住了**重复扣除**与**漏扣**两个方向**（**⭐ 本词条认为这与本会话此前记过的「两个方向都查」属同一纪律的又一次出现**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **理赔结算的每一类规则都被逐条写出，且**最后一条把顺序钉住****——**逐字为**：**「**Bodily injury** applies the per person cap to each claimant, and if the capped total still exceeds the per occurrence limit **it scales everyone down pro rata using the largest remainder method in integer cents, so the payments sum to exactly the occurrence limit with no lost or invented cents**.」**；**「**Collision** caps the loss at the vehicle’s actual cash value, then subtracts the deductible **once**, floored at zero.」**；**「**Property damage** is a plain min(loss, limit).」**；**「**Rental** caps the daily rate, then caps the aggregate.」**；**「**A property style coverage** applies a coinsurance penalty (scale the loss by carried over required), then the deductible, then the limit cap, **in that fixed order**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **按比例分摊用**最大余数法**且**在整数分内**完成**，**目标是「赔付合计恰好等于每次事故限额，**没有丢失或凭空多出的分」**——**⭐ 即**它不允许分摊产生一分钱的缺口或多余**（**⭐ 这与上 ① 的整数算术是同一条规则在分摊上的应用**）；**② ⭐⭐ **碰撞险「免赔额只扣**一次**，下限为零」**——**与不变量逐字对应**；**③ ⭐⭐ **财产类保障的**三个步骤顺序被钉住**（**共保惩罚 → 免赔额 → 限额上限**）**——**⭐ 即**又一次说明顺序不可交换**；**④ **每一类的处理写成一句可核对的规则**。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「本模型不做什么」一节写得非常具体，且其中一条解释了**为什么吞吐量数字长那个样子****——**逐字为**：**「## What this does not model** The rate tables are invented. I picked numbers that look plausible for a six month personal auto term, but **they are not filed rates from any insurer or regulator, and nothing here prices real insurance**. Real rating plans also use far more variables (**driving record points, vehicle symbols, credit based scores where allowed, telematics**) and are **built on fitted models, not a five factor chain**. **The claims side handles the arithmetic of limits, deductibles, and coinsurance, not the adjusting judgment that produces the loss number in the first place.** **The pro rata occurrence rule is one reasonable convention; real carriers may settle sequentially or by negotiation.** The synthetic book is uniform-ish random, so **the re-rate distribution describes my generated book, not any real portfolio**. **Benchmarks are single threaded pure Python on Apple silicon and the settlement path is much lighter than the rating path, which is why the throughput numbers differ by 30x.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「费率表是编的。我挑了一些对半年期个人车险看起来合理的数字，**但它们不是任何保险人或监管机构报备的费率，这里不为真实保险定价**」**——**⭐ 即**对自己的数字的**权威性**给出了明确否定**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「理赔一侧处理的是限额、免赔额与共保的算术，**而不是产生那个损失数字的理算判断**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮主题里一个很重要的**边界层**：**它算的是拿到损失数字**之后**的事，而**损失数字本身的来源**被明确划到模型之外****；**③ ⭐⭐ **「按比例分摊只是**一种**合理惯例，真实承保人可能顺序结算或协商结算」**——**⭐ 即**它指出自己的做法是**一种选择而非唯一正确做法****（**⭐ 这一点对做实务的同学尤其值得记**）；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **吞吐量差异**被解释**（**单线程纯 Python、Apple 芯片、且结算路径比定价路径轻得多**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所见**对「基准数字的范围」解释得最完整的一处之一****（**⭐ 与上一轮 [[insurance-portfolio-performance]] 的「不要把好看的数从它所属的口径栏里拎出来」同源**）。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **再定价工具的参数与结果都被逐字写出，且它声明可重复**——**逐字为**：**「builds a seeded 10,000 policy synthetic book, rates it under the current tables and under a revised set（**the default scenario bumps territory T3 from 1.275 to 1.350 and the nonstandard tier from 1.450 to 1.550**），and reports the premium change distribution in basis points. On the committed scenario: **median policy change +588 bp, 95th percentile +1319 bp, 56.2 percent of policies increased, book level premium +542 bp**. **Same seed, same numbers, every run.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **情景的**具体改动数值被写出****（**T3 从 1.275 改到 1.350、非标准档从 1.450 改到 1.550**）**——**⭐ 即**读者可以**自己重算这个小例子**，而不必相信那四个结果数**；**② **四个结果指标分别**覆盖中位、尾部、占比与整本**四个视角**；**③ **「同样的种子，每次运行同样的数字」**。**⑩ ⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **复现命令逐条给出**（**建虚拟环境、安装 `pytest` 与 `pytest-cov`、运行 `pytest --cov=policyforge`、运行 `policyforge.property_checks`、`policyforge.rerate`、`policyforge.bench`**）；**② **逐字说明「测得的数字与确切的复现命令在 `RESULTS.md` 与 `results/` 目录里」**；**③ **实测其仓库结构与其自述**逐一对应**——**`fixtures/golden_quotes.json`、`policyforge/{money.py, rating.py, claims.py, rate_tables.py, rerate.py, property_checks.py, bench.py}`、`tests/{test_money.py, test_rating.py, test_golden_quotes.py, test_claims_edge_matrix.py, test_claims_property.py, test_rerate.py, test_bench.py}`、`results/{bench.json, property_checks.json, rerate_scenario.json}`、`RESULTS.md`、`pytest.ini` 全部存在**——**⭐⭐ 四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **金额被单独放进一个模块**（**`policyforge/money.py`**）**——**⭐ 即**「整数分」这条规则有一个**独立的代码归属地**，且**有一个独立的测试文件**（**`tests/test_money.py`**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **七个测试文件名与其在 README 中主张的每一项验证**逐一对应**（**手算黄金值 → `test_golden_quotes.py`；手算边界矩阵 → `test_claims_edge_matrix.py`；随机扫查 → `test_claims_property.py`；整数分 → `test_money.py`**）**——**⭐ 即**读者能从文件名看出「它到底验证了什么」**；**③ **三份结果文件对应三个可复现的实验**（**基准、性质扫查、再定价情景**）；**④ **`RESULTS.md` 存在**（**⭐ 但本词条**未读其内容**）。**⑪ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[claims-reserving-benchmark]]、[[lossratio-r]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-calibration]]、[[actuarial-math-bench]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[prediction-lab-actuarial]]、[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]]。

**policyforge-rating-engine**（倉庫 `Mohith26/hartford-pc-rating-claims`，工具名 PolicyForge）**是一份個人車險的費率引擎 ＋ 理賠結算計算器 ＋ 再定價工具**：**三個部分**逐字為 **「a tabular rating engine, a claims settlement calculator, and a small tool that answers "if we change this rate factor, what happens to the whole book?"」**。**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 **NONE**（**實測該倉庫無任何許可文件**）、主語言 Python、體量 23 KB、創建 2026-08-24、最後推送 2026-09-08、topics 為 `actuarial`／`claims`／`deterministic`／`fintech`／`insurance`／`insurtech`／`integer-arithmetic`／`property-testing`／`python`／`rating-engine`**（**創建與推送均在解凍窗口之內**）；**README 實測 4,628 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 27 個條目（23 個文件、4 個目錄）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「標準答案要放在被檢驗的系統之外」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**把標準答案**手算出來並提交進倉庫**的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 一條自設的算術規則，且它把「可手算核對」寫成這條規則的後果**：**「The rule I held myself to the entire time: **money is integer cents, factors are integers scaled by 1000, and rounding is half up at documented points only**. **There is not a single float anywhere in the money path, which is what makes every quote and every settlement exactly reproducible and checkable by hand.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「金額路徑上沒有**一個**浮點數」是一個**可被檢查的強斷言****（不是「儘量避免浮點誤差」，而是一個都不許有）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 因與果被寫在同一個句子裡**（整數分 ＋ 定點因子 ＋ 只在記錄節點四捨五入 → 每一份報價與每一次結算可以被精確復現並被手算核對）——**⭐ 這是本輪四條裡**「可核對性」被寫得最像工程推導的一處**：先定算術，再得到性質****；**③「只在**有記錄的**節點上四捨五入」**——**⭐ 即**四捨五入的位置本身是一份必須被記錄在案的名單****；**④ 因子被寫成**以 1000 為標度的整數****（小數也被定點化）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它真的手算了，並把結果作為黃金夾具提交**：**「The `Quote` object **exposes every intermediate step**, so you can sit down with the rate tables and a piece of paper and reproduce any premium. **I did exactly that for three full policies and committed them as golden fixtures in `fixtures/golden_quotes.json`; the tests assert the engine matches my hand arithmetic to the cent, including the intermediates.**」**；**並逐字寫出**計價鏈 **「`base -> x territory -> x driver class -> x tier -> x coverage option`」** 與 **「a **round half up to the cent after every multiplication, in that exact order**」**（覆蓋類型逐字為 bodily injury, property damage, collision, comprehensive, rental）**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「我對三份完整保單**正是這麼做的**」**——**⭐ 即**標準答案不是程序產生的，是人拿紙筆算出來的，然後提交進倉庫作為夾具****；**② ⭐⭐⭐「包括中間值」**——**⭐ 這是本條最關鍵的一處**：多數項目的夾具只固定**最終值**，而它連**每一步中間量**都要求一致（若中間某一步的捨入位置錯了，測試**會在那一步就失敗**）；**③ 因子鏈的**順序**被寫明並聲明為**精確順序****（乘法可交換但**逐次捨入不可交換**，故順序必須固定）；**④ 對象暴露每一步是這條做法的**接口前提****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其實測夾具文件是本會話所見「黃金值」落盤最完整的一次**——**本詞條**實測讀取** `fixtures/golden_quotes.json`：**其 `comment` 字段逐字為** **「Hand computed golden quotes against the default tables. **Every value was worked out on paper with the documented chain**: base, x territory, x class, x tier, x option, rounding half up to a cent after each multiplication. Amounts are integer cents.」**；**三條夾具各含** `name`／`territory`／`driver_class`／`tier`／`coverages`／**`expected_coverage_cents`**／**`expected_total_cents`**／**`bi_intermediates`**（責任險那條鏈的五個中間值）**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 註釋裡逐字寫了「每一個值都是用紙筆按成文的鏈算出來的」**——**⭐ 即**該文件**自帶其產生方式的說明****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它把**中間值也存進了夾具**（`bi_intermediates` 含五個數）**——**⭐ 即**「包括中間值」這句話**在文件層面被證實****；**③ ⭐⭐ 每一個覆蓋類型**分開給分值**再給合計**（部分與總和都被固定）；**④ 每條夾具都有**業務語義名字**（T2 youth standard, full coverage／T1 adult preferred, liability plus collision／T3 senior nonstandard, max options）——**⭐ 即**夾具覆蓋三類互不相同的風險與保障組合**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「確定性」寫成一條被測過的性質**：**「Rating the same input twice always gives the same premium. **That sounds obvious, but it is a tested property, not an assumption.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「這聽起來是顯然的，但它是一條**被測過的**性質」**——**⭐ 這是本站所收條目裡**對「顯然的事也要測」說得最直接的一句****（其 topics 裡也確實有 `deterministic`）；**② 它與 ① 的整數算術規則互為因果**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **三個賠付不變量用兩種方式驗證，且第二種的規模與方法都被寫明**：**「Three invariants hold everywhere: **a payment is never negative, never exceeds its limit, and a deductible is applied exactly once**. I verify this **two ways**. First, **a hand computed edge matrix** in `tests/test_claims_edge_matrix.py` covering **losses below, at, and one cent above every deductible, limit, and cap**. Second, **randomized sweeps: 100,000 seeded random cases per settlement type (300,000 total) with zero invariant violations**. The sweep numbers in `results/property_checks.json` **come from the same code the tests run**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 兩種方式互為補充且各有分工**（手算邊界矩陣負責**邊界**，隨機掃查負責**廣度**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 邊界矩陣是**手算的****（第二處「標準答案來自紙筆」）；**③ ⭐⭐「零不變量違反」是一個**零指標****（與上一輪 [[medical-opinion-extractor]] 的「樣版判別失敗 0 件」同族）；**④ ⭐⭐⭐「掃查的數字來自測試所運行的同一份代碼」**——**⭐ 排除了「提交的結果文件與測試跑的不是同一實現」這種情況****。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **三個不變量的措辭很精確**：**「賠付不為負」「不超過其限額」「免賠額恰好扣一次」**⭐⭐ **即**第三條是**「恰好一次」而不是「至少一次」**——**⭐ 即**同時封住了**重複扣除**與**漏扣**兩個方向**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **理賠結算每一類規則逐條寫出，且最後一條把順序釘住**：**BI**（先按每人上限，若合計仍超每次事故限額則**用整數分最大餘數法按比例縮減，使賠付合計恰好等於限額、沒有丟失或憑空多出的分**）；**Collision**（先封頂於實際現金價值，再**扣一次**免賠額，下限為零）；**PD**（`min(loss, limit)`）；**Rental**（先封日額再封總額）；**財產類保障**（**共保懲罰 → 免賠額 → 限額上限，按這個固定順序**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 按比例分攤用**最大餘數法**且在**整數分內**完成**，目標是「合計恰好等於限額，**沒有丟失或憑空多出的分」****；**② ⭐⭐ 碰撞險「免賠額只扣**一次**，下限為零」**（與不變量逐字對應）；**③ ⭐⭐ 財產類保障的**三個步驟順序被釘住****；**④ 每一類寫成一句可核對的規則**。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「本模型不做什麼」一節非常具體，且其中一條解釋了**為什麼吞吐量數字長那個樣子****：**「## What this does not model** The rate tables are invented. …**they are not filed rates from any insurer or regulator, and nothing here prices real insurance**. Real rating plans also use far more variables (**driving record points, vehicle symbols, credit based scores where allowed, telematics**) and are **built on fitted models, not a five factor chain**. **The claims side handles the arithmetic of limits, deductibles, and coinsurance, not the adjusting judgment that produces the loss number in the first place.** **The pro rata occurrence rule is one reasonable convention; real carriers may settle sequentially or by negotiation.** The synthetic book is uniform-ish random, so **the re-rate distribution describes my generated book, not any real portfolio**. **Benchmarks are single threaded pure Python on Apple silicon and the settlement path is much lighter than the rating path, which is why the throughput numbers differ by 30x.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「費率表是編的。我挑了一些對半年期個人車險看起來合理的數字，**但它們不是任何保險人或監管機構報備的費率，這裡不為真實保險定價**」**；**② ⭐⭐⭐「理賠一側處理的是限額、免賠額與共保的算術，**而不是產生那個損失數字的理算判斷**」**——**⭐ 這是本輪主題裡一個很重要的**邊界層**：它算的是拿到損失數字**之後**的事，而**損失數字本身的來源**被明確劃到模型之外**；**③ ⭐⭐「按比例分攤只是**一種**合理慣例，真實承保人可能順序結算或協商結算」**——**⭐ 即**它指出自己的做法是**一種選擇而非唯一正確做法****；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 吞吐量差異**被解釋****（**⭐ 這是本站所見**對「基準數字的範圍」解釋得最完整的一處之一****）。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **再定價工具的參數與結果都被逐字寫出**：**「builds a seeded 10,000 policy synthetic book, rates it under the current tables and under a revised set（**the default scenario bumps territory T3 from 1.275 to 1.350 and the nonstandard tier from 1.450 to 1.550**），and reports the premium change distribution in basis points. On the committed scenario: **median policy change +588 bp, 95th percentile +1319 bp, 56.2 percent of policies increased, book level premium +542 bp**. **Same seed, same numbers, every run.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 情景的**具體改動數值被寫出****（**⭐ 即**讀者可以**自己重算這個小例子**，而不必相信那四個結果數**）；**② 四個結果指標分別**覆蓋中位、尾部、佔比與整本**四個視角**；**③「同樣的種子，每次運行同樣的數字」**。**⑩ ⭐ **其餘可核實細節**：**① 復現命令逐條給出**；**② 逐字說明「測得的數字與確切的復現命令在 `RESULTS.md` 與 `results/` 目錄裡」**；**③ 實測其倉庫結構與其自述**逐一對應**（**`fixtures/golden_quotes.json`、`policyforge/{money.py, rating.py, claims.py, rate_tables.py, rerate.py, property_checks.py, bench.py}`、`tests/` 下七個測試文件、`results/{bench.json, property_checks.json, rerate_scenario.json}`、`RESULTS.md`、`pytest.ini` 全部存在**）**⭐⭐ 四處**：**① ⭐⭐ 金額被單獨放進一個模組**（`policyforge/money.py`）**——**⭐ 即**「整數分」這條規則有一個獨立的代碼歸屬地，且有一個獨立的測試文件**（`tests/test_money.py`）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 七個測試文件名與其在 README 中主張的每一項驗證**逐一對應****（手算黃金值 → `test_golden_quotes.py`；手算邊界矩陣 → `test_claims_edge_matrix.py`；隨機掃查 → `test_claims_property.py`；整數分 → `test_money.py`）；**③ 三份結果文件對應三個可復現的實驗**；**④ `RESULTS.md` 存在**（**⭐ 未讀其內容**）。**⑪ ⭐ 可與 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[claims-reserving-benchmark]]、[[lossratio-r]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-calibration]]、[[actuarial-math-bench]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[prediction-lab-actuarial]]、[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] 並讀**。

pytest、未運行任何測試或模組**；**故**不主張**其所述的 109 個測試、99% 覆蓋率、三份手算黃金夾具的比對、30 萬個隨機案例的零違反、或再定價的四個結果數**已被複現**——**⭐ 本詞條核實到的是**README 的逐字聲明、黃金夾具文件的實際內容、以及其點名的全部文件確實存在於倉庫中****。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未讀任何 `.py` 文件的內容****——**⭐ **policyforge-rating-engine** (repository `Mohith26/hartford-pc-rating-claims`, tool name PolicyForge) **is a personal auto insurance rating engine, claims settlement calculator and re-rate tool**, the three parts being verbatim a tabular rating engine, a claims settlement calculator, and a small tool that answers what happens to the whole book if one rate factor changes. **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **NONE** (the repository measurably has no licence file), primary language Python, a 23 KB repository, created 2026-08-24, last pushed 2026-09-08, topics `actuarial`, `claims`, `deterministic`, `fintech`, `insurance`, `insurtech`, `integer-arithmetic`, `property-testing`, `python` and `rating-engine`** (all GitHub API measurements; **both creation and push fall inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 4,628 bytes**; **the repository measures 27 entries (23 files, 4 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **the reference answer must live outside the system being tested**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the one that computed the reference answer by hand and committed it**.

entries.title: 「数据集是被做过手脚的，好让诚实可被度量」：把七个已知答案预先埋进 10 万行合成保单，让每个实验的成败都能被判定；而「代理不得看数据」不是提示词约束，是**编译期事实**（agent crate 无法 import fit 或 platform）
entries.title_en: The dataset is rigged so honesty is measurable: seven planted truths in a 100,000-row synthetic book make each experiment’s outcome decidable, while "the agent may not see the data" is a compile-time fact rather than a prompt constraint
entries.title_hk: 「數據集是被做過手腳的，好讓誠實可被度量」：把七個已知答案預先埋進 10 萬行合成保單，讓每個實驗的成敗都能被判定；而「代理不得看數據」不是提示詞約束，是**編譯期事實**（agent crate 無法 import fit 或 platform）
entries.summary: 一个精算建模代理的**实验平台原型**：你给出目标与硬性护栏，代理对着一套**真实的**保险定价模型跑七个实验，每个实验都以一份**书面裁决**收尾，唯一胜出的那个要**由人签署复核**；**其最值得记的一处是它把「诚实」做成了**可度量**的东西**——**逐字标题为「数据集是被做过手脚的，好让诚实可被度量」**：**10 万条保单、固定种子、**逐字节可重建**，并**按实验原型各埋一条已知答案**（例：真实为 U 形年龄曲线而模型用的是 5 个粗分箱 → 样条实验为候选；年龄×车龄交互**恰好为零** → 该实验在折间抖动上死掉；报备的相对数已偏离现代估计 → 被地区护栏杀掉；事故效应在 3 处后转平 → 封顶计数为候选；过散为伽马混合且与特征无关 → AIC 偏好 NB2 但提升平；里程缺失非随机且按地区成簇 → **在拟合之前就被拒绝**；样条与事故修正不同残差 → 组合实验胜出）；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① 「代理不得看数据」是**编译期事实**——逐字「`agent` crate **不能 import** `fit` 或 `platform`，因此它**永远看不到一行数据或一个拟合产物**」；**② 角色强制在 GraphQL 层而非界面层**（`approveReview` **在 resolver 里拒绝代理角色**），**且代理开复核走的是与人类相同的 mutation 路径**；**③ 「没有产物的裁决只是一个声明，所以产物随它一起交付」**（逐字）**，以及**问一个没有产物支撑的问题会得到一次**诚实的落空**而不是一次猜测**；**另有「文案里烘进去的诚实规则」一节**：**离差非负、因此只显示其变化量；跨族比较只用 AIC、绝不用离差；**每一句插入了计算数值的句子，对计算可能产生的任何取值都保持为真****
entries.summary_hk: 一個精算建模代理的**實驗平台原型**：你給出目標與硬性護欄，代理對着一套**真實的**保險定價模型跑七個實驗，每個實驗都以一份**書面裁決**收尾，唯一勝出的那個要**由人簽署複核**；**其最值得記的一處是它把「誠實」做成了**可度量**的東西**——**逐字標題為「數據集是被做過手腳的，好讓誠實可被度量」**：**10 萬條保單、固定種子、**逐字節可重建**，並**按實驗原型各埋一條已知答案**（例：真實為 U 形年齡曲線而模型用的是 5 個粗分箱 → 樣條實驗為候選；年齡×車齡交互**恰好為零** → 該實驗在折間抖動上死掉；報備的相對數已偏離現代估計 → 被地區護欄殺掉；事故效應在 3 處後轉平 → 封頂計數為候選；過散為伽馬混合且與特徵無關 → AIC 偏好 NB2 但提升平；里程缺失非隨機且按地區成簇 → **在擬合之前就被拒絕**；樣條與事故修正不同殘差 → 組合實驗勝出）；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① 「代理不得看數據」是**編譯期事實**——逐字「`agent` crate **不能 import** `fit` 或 `platform`，因此它**永遠看不到一行數據或一個擬合產物**」**；**② 角色強制在 GraphQL 層而非介面層**（`approveReview` **在 resolver 裡拒絕代理角色**），**且代理開複核走的是與人類相同的 mutation 路徑**；**③ 「沒有產物的裁決只是一個聲明，所以產物隨它一起交付」**（逐字）**，以及**問一個沒有產物支撐的問題會得到一次**誠實的落空**而不是一次猜測**；**另有「文案裡烘進去的誠實規則」一節**：**離差非負、因此只顯示其變化量；跨族比較只用 AIC、絕不用離差；**每一句插入了計算數值的句子，對計算可能產生的任何取值都保持為真****
entries.summary_en: A prototype experiment platform for an actuarial modelling agent: you state a goal and hard guardrails, the agent runs seven experiments against a real insurance pricing model, every experiment ends in a written verdict, and the single winner earns a review a human has to sign; **its most notable feature is that it makes honesty measurable** — its section heading reads verbatim that the dataset is rigged so honesty is measurable, with 100,000 policies, a fixed seed, **byte-identical regeneration**, and **one planted truth per experiment archetype** (for example a genuinely U-shaped age curve against five coarse bands makes the spline experiment a candidate; an exactly zero age-by-vehicle-age interaction makes that experiment die on fold jitter; filed relativities drifted from modern estimates get killed by the territory rail; a linear-to-three-then-flat accident effect makes the capped count a candidate; gamma-mixed overdispersion independent of features gives an AIC preference for NB2 with flat lift; mileage missing not at random and clustered by region is refused before fitting; and a spline and an accident term fixing different residuals makes the combination experiment the winner); **three further points follow the same discipline**: **first, "the agent may not see the data" is a compile-time fact — the agent crate cannot import the fitting or platform crates, so it never sees a dataset row or a fit artifact**; **second, role enforcement sits in the GraphQL layer rather than the UI, with the approval mutation rejecting the agent role in the resolver, and the agent opening reviews through the same mutation path a human would use**; **and third, a verdict without its artifact is a claim, so the artifact ships with it, while a question with no artifact behind it gets an honest miss instead of a guess**; **there is also a section of honesty rules baked into the copy**: deviance is nonnegative so only its change is displayed; cross-family comparisons use AIC and never deviance; **and every sentence that interpolates a computed number stays true for any value the computation can produce**
entries.body:
**prediction-lab-actuarial**（仓库 `ryanportfolio/lab-demo`，页面标题为 Experiments）**是一份精算建模代理的**实验平台原型****：**你给出目标与硬性护栏，代理对着一套**真实的**保险定价模型跑七个实验，每个实验以一份**书面裁决**收尾，唯一胜出的那个要**由人签署复核****。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **NOASSERTION**（**仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件，非 OSI 标准许可**）、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 2,667 KB、创建 2026-08-06、最后推送 2026-09-10、topics 为 `actuarial`／`ai-agents`／`data-visualization`／`graphql`／`human-in-the-loop`／`insurance`／`insurance-pricing`／`model-governance`／`postgresql`／`predictive-modeling`／`react`／`rust`／`typescript`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 7,908 字节**；**仓库实测共 325 个条目（231 个文件、94 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「标准答案要放在被检验的系统之外」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把标准答案**预先埋进数据**、并把边界**交给编译器**的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 一节标题就写明了本轮主题：数据集被做过手脚，为的是让诚实可度量**——**逐字为**：**「## The dataset is rigged so honesty is measurable** 100,000 policies, fixed seed, **byte-identical regeneration**. **Planted truths, one per experiment archetype**:」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「被做过手脚，为的是让诚实可被度量」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮主题**说得最锋利的一句标题**：**合成数据通常被当作不得已的替代品，而这里它被**故意设计**成一台诚实度测试仪****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **一句「逐字节可重建」**（**byte-identical regeneration**）**把「同一份」这件事推到字节级****——**⭐ 即**不是「大致相同」，而是**可逐字节比对****；**③ ⭐⭐ **「每个实验原型各埋一条已知答案」**——**⭐ 即**答案在**实验之前**就已存在于数据里**；**④ **规模与种子写明**（**10 万条保单、固定种子**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **七条被埋的已知答案与各自的结局被逐条列出，而结局含**三种失败方式**——**实测其表逐行为**：**「U 形年龄曲线 vs v12 中的 5 个粗分箱 | EXP-01 样条，候选」**；**「年龄 × 车龄的交互**恰好为零** | EXP-02，**在折间抖动上死掉**」**；**「报备的相对数已从现代估计漂移 | EXP-03，**被地区护栏杀掉**」**；**「事故效应线性到 3 然后转平 | EXP-04 封顶计数，候选」**；**「伽马混合的过散，与特征无关 | EXP-05，**AIC 偏好 NB2 但提升是平的**」**；**「里程缺失**非随机**，按地区成簇 | EXP-06，**在拟合之前被拒绝**」**；**「样条与事故项修正的是不同的残差 | EXP-07 组合，**胜出****」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **七条里只有两条成为候选、一条胜出，其余四条以**四种不同方式**未通过**（**折间抖动、护栏、AIC 偏好但提升平、拟合前拒绝**）**——**⭐ 即**这套数据不只检验「能不能找到」，还检验**能不能正确地找不到****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **EXP-06 的结局是「**在拟合之前就被拒绝**」**——**⭐ 即**一个**不该做的实验被挡在计算之前**（**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里**对「拒绝也是一种正确结果」落实得最具体的一处**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **EXP-05 的结局写法很精确**（**「AIC 偏好 NB2 但提升是平的」**）**——**⭐ 即**它区分了**统计显著性**与**业务提升**；**④ **七个实验被编号且各有原型名**（**EXP-01 至 EXP-07**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「代理不得看数据」不是提示词约束，而是编译期事实**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处**：**逐字为**：**「The UI promises "hard limits the platform checks outside the agent." **That is a compile-time fact here: the `agent` crate cannot import `fit` or `platform`, so it never sees a dataset row or a fit artifact.** It reads platform-computed summaries and writes prose. **The platform computes every guardrail number.**」**；**并逐字给出依赖关系**：**crates 分层为** **`core`（共享协议类型、零依赖）／`datagen`（确定性 10 万行合成车险保单、自带 PRNG、固定种子）／`fit`（IRLS 泊松与 NB2 GLM、自然三次样条、按暴露加权的 Gini、离差、AIC、5 折交叉验证）／`platform`（运行执行器、数据画像器、**GUARDRAILS**、报备与信度）／`agent`（剧本规划器与裁决模板，**Depends on core ONLY**）／`server`（GraphQL API、角色强制、持久化、服务前端）**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **边界被做成**依赖图上的一个事实****（**agent **不能** import fit 或 platform**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所见**对「代理做不到某件事」最强的一种保证**：**提示词可以被绕过，**而 import 不能****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「它永远看不到一行数据或一个拟合产物」**——**⭐ 即**越界不是「不该做」而是**在语言层面做不到****；**③ ⭐⭐ **「平台计算每一个护栏数字」**——**⭐ 即**护栏不是由代理自己估的，**而是由被隔离在外的另一层算好后再交给它的****；**④ **分层里 `core` 零依赖**，**而 `agent` 只依赖 `core`**（**⭐ 即**它所能知道的只有协议类型，**不包括数据与拟合产物**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **角色强制在解析器层，而不是界面层**——**逐字为**：**「Role enforcement is in the **GraphQL layer, not the UI**: `approveReview` **rejects the agent role in the resolver**. **The agent opens reviews through the same mutation path a human would use.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「在 resolver 里拒绝代理角色，而不是在界面上」**——**⭐ 即**界面不是安全边界**（**⭐ 与上 ③ 同一思路：**把约束放在下层，而不是放在会被绕过的地方****）；**② ⭐⭐ **代理开复核**走与人类相同的 mutation 路径**——**⭐ 即**它没有特权通道**（**⭐ 本词条认为这一点很实在：**如果代理有专用写入口，那就等于多了一条可被滥用的路径****）；**③ **审批是**人类专属且不可逆**的行为**（**逐字见下 ⑤**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「产物随裁决一起交付」写成了一条产品规则**——**逐字为**：**「**A verdict without its artifact is a claim, so the artifact ships with it.**」**；**并逐字给出读者能做的三件事**：**① 看这次运行**（**七个实验对着真实后端拟合，每个带 chips、折点与一份书面裁决**）；**② 打开证据**（**每张落地的卡片都带着平台留下的东西：拟合事实（**行数、参数个数、IRLS 迭代次数、离差、AIC**）、按风险十分位的提升阶梯、五个折的增量，以及**每个原型一张图，而这些图用的就是裁决所依据的同一批数字****）；**③ 就这次运行提问**（**上下文专家从这次运行的产物回答、展示它走过的步骤、引用它读过的实验、画出相关的图**，「**A question with no artifact behind it gets an honest miss instead of a guess. It reads and it draws; it cannot fit, merge, or approve anything.**」）**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「没有产物的裁决只是一个声明，所以产物随它一起交付」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里**对「主张必须带证据」写得最凝练的一句****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **图与裁决用的是**同一批数字****（**⭐ 即**不存在「文字一套、图一套」的空间**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「没有产物支撑的问题得到一次**诚实的落空**而不是一次猜测」**——**⭐ 与上一轮 [[kakekomi-corpus]] 的「gap 作为返回值」同族：**「答不了」被做成了一个**合法输出****；**④ ⭐⭐ **「它只读、只画；它**不能**拟合、合并或审批任何东西」**——**⭐ 即**能力边界被逐项否定**。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **它有一个可度量目标，而这个目标不是吞吐量**——**逐字为**：**「The measure this prototype optimizes is **not fits per second**. It is **the time from an actuarial question to a decision a skeptical reviewer can trust, sign, and reconstruct months later** — the run ledger, evidence, agent record, and frozen approval package all serve that one metric. **The AI’s job is to make human judgment scalable, never to substitute for it: approval stays a human-only, irreversible act.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **目标函数被逐字写成「从一个精算问题到一个**多疑的复核者能信任、签署、并在数月后重建**的决定所需的时间」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这比任何「提升效率」的说法都具体**（**⭐ 且它给出**三个动作**：信任、签署、**数月后重建**）；**② **四个产物各服务于同一个指标**（**运行账本、证据、代理记录、冻结的审批包**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「代理的工作是让人的判断可规模化，**绝不替代它：审批保持为人类专属且不可逆的行为**」**；**④ ⭐⭐ **它明确否掉了「每秒拟合次数」**这一常见指标**。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **「产品里没有大模型」与「构建过程用了 AI 助手」是两件被分别写明的事**——**逐字为**：**「**No LLM anywhere**: the modeling agent is a **deterministic planner** with **two-layer prose templates**（dense expert copy plus a Plain terms gloss），and the context expert **routes questions to real artifacts rather than generating text**」**；**同时实测其仓库根本身含 `CLAUDE.md`、`AGENTS.md`、`.codex/`、`.claude/`（含 `hooks/session-start.sh` 与 `reference/` 下六份参考文件，含 **`pitfalls.md`**）以及 `.agents/{CODEX-SKILL-COMPATIBILITY.md, codex-tools.md}`**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「运行时不使用任何大模型」被逐字声明**（**代理是**确定性规划器****）**——**⭐ 本词条指出这与本轮其余三条（以及本站多数 AI 条目）方向相反，**故值得单列****；**② ⭐⭐ **它给出替代方案**（**确定性规划器 ＋ 两层文案模板：专家密集文与「Plain terms」白话注释**）**——**⭐ 即**它说明了**不用大模型时文字怎么来****；**③ ⭐⭐ **上下文专家的做法是**把问题路由到真实产物**，而不是生成文本**——**⭐ 与上 ⑤ 的「诚实的落空」一致**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **但构建过程用了 AI 助手，且这一点是**公开的****（**仓库里同时提交了 Claude 与 Codex 两套配置，**并含一份两者技能系统的兼容性说明**，**以及 `pitfalls.md` 一份踩坑参考**）——**⭐ 本词条**据此把「产品无 LLM」与「构建用了 AI」明确分开，**不把两者混为一谈****。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **技能来源表把「出处不明」写成了一个具名状态**——**这是本轮主题在人文层面的延伸**：**本词条实测读取** `.claude/skills/PROVENANCE.md`**，**其开头逐字为** **「# Skill Provenance** Where each skill came from, its license, and what this repo changed. **Not loaded into context; it is reference for maintainers and public users.**」**；**其维护规则逐字为** **「**Maintenance rule:** when you materially change a forked skill, update its "Our deltas" cell here. When adding a third-party skill, add a row and keep its LICENSE/NOTICE files in the skill folder.」**；**其表头为** **「Skill | Upstream | License | **Our deltas**」**，**本词条所读部分逐行为**：**「`brainstorming` | obra/superpowers（Jesse Vincent）| MIT（in folder）| Two-lane scope calibration, authorization-safe artifacts, optional visual companion」**；**「`writing-plans` | obra/superpowers | MIT（in folder）| **Stock**」**；**「`writing-skills` | obra/superpowers | MIT（in folder）| **Stock**」**；**「`caveman` | **Community token-compression pattern (viral skill, author attribution unclear)** | **Reimplemented here** | Intensity tiers (lite/full/ultra), output budget, auto-clarity carve-outs, persistence rules」**；**「`humanizer` | Community "humanizer" de-AI-writing pattern | **Reimplemented here** | patterns.md tell catalog; voice-matching; review-only mode」**；**并另列**本仓库自产（homegrown）十二项**，**逐字「Homegrown skills are MIT, same as the repo」**；**并逐字说明其中一项的行为** **「`forge-repo-ui-skill` … **researches linked third-party sources as untrusted inputs but does not vendor their skill text**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「author attribution unclear」（作者归属不明）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这正是本轮主题：**一个**不知道**被写成了一个**具名状态**，而不是留空、也不是猜一个名字****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「Our deltas」一栏使**改动量**成为必填项**，**而**未改动者逐字写「Stock」**（**原封**）**——**⭐ 即**「我们改了什么」与「我们没改」都是被记录的状态**；**③ ⭐⭐ **许可栏出现**「Reimplemented here」（此处重新实现）**作为第三种值**——**⭐ 即**在上游不明的情况下，**它声明的是**自己的实现**而不是假称继承**；**④ ⭐⭐ **维护规则要求新增第三方技能时**保留其 LICENSE／NOTICE 文件**——**⭐ 即**出处与许可**被绑定在技能目录里**，**且它声明该文件**不载入上下文、只供维护者与公开读者参考****。**⑨ ⭐⭐⭐ **「文案里烘进去的诚实规则」一节很短但很硬**——**逐字为**：**「## Honesty rules baked into the copy** Deviance is nonnegative and **only its change is displayed**. Cross-family comparisons use **AIC, never deviance**. **Every sentence that interpolates a computed number stays true for any value the computation can produce**（the review’s shrinkage wording adapts to whatever the holdout really did）. No em dashes, no periods on display strings, and the Plain terms toggle keeps one vetted gloss line under every result.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「每一句插入了计算数值的句子，对计算可能产生的**任何**取值都保持为真」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮主题最根本的一次表述**：**它不是要求「不撒谎」，而是要求**文案在数值空间上恒真****（**⭐ 并给出实例：**复核里关于收缩的措辞会随留出集的真实表现而调整**）；**② ⭐⭐ **离差非负，因此**只显示它的变化量****——**⭐ 即**一个恒正的量不单独显示绝对值，因为绝对值本身不传递信息**；**③ ⭐⭐ **跨族比较**只用 AIC，绝不用离差****——**⭐ 即**禁止了一种常见但无效的比较**；**④ **另有两条排版规则**（**不用长破折号、显示字符串不加句点**）**与一条可读性设计**（**每个结果下方保留一行经审定的白话释义**）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **地区护栏的设计逻辑被逐字解释，且它说明了为什么「0%」本身不足够**——**逐字为**：**「Filed territory relativities **stay frozen in every fit**（they enter the offset），so **they move 0% by construction**. **The territory guardrail measures indirect zone-level average rate movement, which is nonzero because the new factors correlate with geography.** EXP-03 is the one experiment that unfreezes them, and **its direct relativity movement is what kills it**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「按构造它们移动 0%」**——**⭐ 即**它指出**一个恒为零的指标不能作为通过条件**（**⭐ 本词条认为这与上一轮 [[kakekomi-corpus]] 的「覆盖声明必须与真实件数一致」同族：**都要求一个指标**真的在测东西****）；**② ⭐⭐ **因此护栏改为测量**间接的地区层面平均费率移动**，**而它非零的原因是**新因子与地理相关****（**⭐ 即**护栏是**因为理解了机制**而设在正确的位置**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **EXP-03 是唯一解冻它们的实验，而**正是它的直接相对数移动杀死了它****。**⑪ ⭐ **验证方式写明，且又出现「手算」**：**逐字为** **「`cargo test` — fitting math **incl hand-computed Gini and deviance cases**」**，**以及** **「`npx playwright test`（against `PLAB_URL`）：screenshots both views and themes, **plus the GraphQL run-review-permission integration test**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **手算的 Gini 与离差算例**——**⭐ 即**本轮四条里**第三次**出现「标准答案是手算的」（**⭐ 与 [[policyforge-rating-engine]] 的黄金夹具、[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 的教科书三角同族**）；**② ⭐⭐ **端到端测试覆盖**两种视图与两种主题的截图**（**⭐ 即**界面层也被纳入回归**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **并有一条**针对审批权限的 GraphQL 集成测试****（**⭐ 即**上 ④ 的「resolver 拒绝代理角色」是被**测过**的，而不是仅被声明**）。**⑫ ⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **技术栈**逐字为** **「Backend: Rust, axum, async-graphql, sqlx, Postgres (Railway), nalgebra」／「Frontend: TypeScript, React, Vite, GraphQL over plain typed fetch」**；**② **运行命令给出**（**需 Rust、Node 22＋ 与一个 `DATABASE_URL`；含生成数据、纯 CLI 无库运行、迁移并服务、前端开发**）；**③ **实测其仓库结构与其自述**大体对应**——**`crates/`、`frontend/`（含 `playwright.config.ts`）、`Cargo.lock`、`Dockerfile`、`railway.json`、`scripts/ci-smoke.sh`、`docs/readme/` 下两张 PNG、`LICENSE`、`README.md` 均在**；**⭐ ④ ⚠️ **其自述逐字为** **「A example concept rough draft for Prediction Lab」**（**⚠️ 即**它**自称是概念草稿**，**而非成品**）；**⭐ ⑤ 作者署名与站点为 `Ryan Allen · fullbuild.ai`**，**并给出一个线上地址**。**⑬ ⭐ **prediction-lab-actuarial**（倉庫 `ryanportfolio/lab-demo`，頁面標題為 Experiments）**是一份精算建模代理的**實驗平台原型****：**你給出目標與硬性護欄，代理對着一套**真實的**保險定價模型跑七個實驗，每個實驗以一份**書面裁決**收尾，唯一勝出的那個要**由人簽署複核****。**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 **NOASSERTION**（**倉庫內含 `LICENSE` 文件，非 OSI 標準許可**）、主語言 TypeScript、體量 2,667 KB、創建 2026-08-06、最後推送 2026-09-10、topics 為 `actuarial`／`ai-agents`／`data-visualization`／`graphql`／`human-in-the-loop`／`insurance`／`insurance-pricing`／`model-governance`／`postgresql`／`predictive-modeling`／`react`／`rust`／`typescript`**；**README 實測 7,908 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 325 個條目（231 個文件、94 個目錄）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「標準答案要放在被檢驗的系統之外」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**把標準答案**預先埋進數據**、並把邊界**交給編譯器**的一條****。

truths, one per experiment archetype**:」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「被做過手腳，為的是讓誠實可被度量」**——**⭐ 這是本輪主題**說得最鋒利的一句標題**：合成數據通常被當作不得已的替代品，而這裡它被**故意設計**成一台誠實度測試儀****；**② ⭐⭐⭐「逐字節可重建」把「同一份」推到字節級****；**③ **創建在解凍窗口之前（2026-08-06）****——**如實記錄該日期，入選依據是**推送落在窗口之內（2026-09-10）****。**⑬ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****——**該倉庫自述為**概念草稿**且持續迭代**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/ryanportfolio/lab-demo` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 7,908 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對，**`.claude/skills/PROVENANCE.md` 的前部內容經 raw 實測讀取**；**全部 325 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對（231 文件、94 目錄）；**未克隆、未安裝 Rust 或 Node、未運行任何命令或測試、未建數據庫、未訪問其線上地址、未讀任何源碼或技能內容、未打開任何圖**。
entries.body_en:
**prediction-lab-actuarial** (repository `ryanportfolio/lab-demo`, page title Experiments) **is a prototype experiment platform for an actuarial modelling agent**: **you state a goal and hard guardrails, the agent runs seven experiments against a real insurance pricing model, every experiment ends in a written verdict, and the single winner earns a review a human has to sign**. **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **NOASSERTION** (a `LICENSE` file is present but it is not an OSI-standard licence), primary language TypeScript, a 2,667 KB repository, created 2026-08-06, last pushed 2026-09-10, topics `actuarial`, `ai-agents`, `data-visualization`, `graphql`, `human-in-the-loop`, `insurance`, `insurance-pricing`, `model-governance`, `postgresql`, `predictive-modeling`, `react`, `rust` and `typescript`** (all GitHub API measurements; creation predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it); **the README measures 7,908 bytes**; **the repository measures 325 entries (231 files, 94 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **the reference answer must live outside the system being tested**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the one that plants the answers in advance and hands the boundary to the compiler**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① A section heading states this round’s theme outright: the dataset is rigged so honesty is measurable** — verbatim: **"## The dataset is rigged so honesty is measurable** 100,000 policies, fixed seed, **byte-identical regeneration**. **Planted truths, one per experiment archetype**:"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **"rigged so honesty is measurable" is the sharpest heading this round produced, since synthetic data is normally a regrettable substitute while here it is deliberately built into a test instrument for honesty**; ⭐⭐⭐ **"byte-identical regeneration" pushes being the same dataset down to the byte level, so it is comparable byte for byte rather than approximately**; ⭐⭐ **one planted truth per experiment archetype means the answer exists in the data before the experiment runs**; **and the scale and seed are stated**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ The seven planted truths and their outcomes are listed one by one, and the outcomes include four different ways of failing** — measured rows verbatim: **a U-shaped age curve against five coarse bands in v12 leads to the spline experiment as a candidate**; **an exactly zero age-by-vehicle-age interaction makes the second experiment die on fold jitter**; **filed relativities drifted from modern estimates get killed by the territory rail**; **an accident effect linear to three then flat makes a capped count a candidate**; **gamma-mixed overdispersion independent of features gives an AIC preference for NB2 with flat lift**; **mileage missing not at random and clustered by region is refused before fitting**; **and a spline and an accident term fixing different residuals makes the combination the winner** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **only two of the seven become candidates and one wins, while four fail in four different ways — fold jitter, a guardrail, an AIC preference with flat lift, and refusal before fitting — so the data tests not only whether the system can find what is there but whether it can correctly fail to find what is not**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the sixth outcome is refusal before fitting, an experiment that should not be run being blocked before computation, the most concrete implementation this round of "refusing is also a correct outcome"**; ⭐⭐ **the fifth outcome is worded precisely, separating statistical preference from business lift**; **and the seven experiments are numbered with archetype names**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ That the agent may not see the data is a compile-time fact rather than a prompt constraint** — **the most notable point in this entry**: verbatim, **"The UI promises "hard limits the platform checks outside the agent." **That is a compile-time fact here: the `agent` crate cannot import `fit` or `platform`, so it never sees a dataset row or a fit artifact.** It reads platform-computed summaries and writes prose. **The platform computes every guardrail number.**"**; **with the crate graph stated verbatim**: **`core` holding shared protocol types with zero dependencies; `datagen` producing a deterministic 100,000-row synthetic auto book with its own PRNG and a fixed seed; `fit` implementing IRLS Poisson and NB2 GLM, natural cubic splines, exposure-weighted Gini, deviance, AIC and five-fold cross-validation; `platform` holding the run executor, data profiler, GUARDRAILS and filing plus credibility; `agent` holding the playbook planner and verdict templates and depending on core only; and `server` providing the GraphQL API, role enforcement and persistence** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the boundary is a fact about the dependency graph, since the agent crate cannot import the fitting or platform crates — the strongest guarantee this site has seen that an agent cannot do something, because a prompt can be talked around while an import cannot**; ⭐⭐⭐ **it never sees a dataset row or a fit artifact, so crossing the line is not forbidden but impossible in the language**; ⭐⭐ **the platform computes every guardrail number, so guardrails are not estimated by the agent but handed to it after being computed in the layer it is isolated from**; **and `core` has zero dependencies while `agent` depends only on `core`, so all it can know is protocol types**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Role enforcement sits in the resolver rather than the UI** — verbatim: **"Role enforcement is in the **GraphQL layer, not the UI**: `approveReview` **rejects the agent role in the resolver**. **The agent opens reviews through the same mutation path a human would use.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **rejecting the agent role in the resolver rather than the interface recognises that the interface is not a security boundary, the same reasoning as the crate boundary above**; ⭐⭐ **the agent opening reviews through the same mutation path as a human means it has no privileged channel, which matters because a dedicated write path for the agent would be one more avenue for abuse**; **and approval is a human-only, irreversible act**. **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ It makes shipping the artifact with the verdict a product rule** — verbatim: **"**A verdict without its artifact is a claim, so the artifact ships with it.**"**; **with the three things a reader can do stated verbatim**: **watch the run, in which seven experiments fit against a real backend and each lands with chips, fold dots and a written verdict**; **open the evidence, where every landed card carries what the platform kept — fit facts including rows, parameters, IRLS iterations, deviance and AIC, the lift staircase by risk decile, the five fold deltas, and one chart per archetype drawn from the same numbers the verdict was written from**; **and ask about the run, where the context expert answers from this run’s artifacts, shows the steps it took, cites the experiments it read and draws the relevant chart, since "a question with no artifact behind it gets an honest miss instead of a guess. It reads and it draws; it cannot fit, merge, or approve anything."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **"a verdict without its artifact is a claim, so the artifact ships with it" is the most compressed statement this round of evidence accompanying assertion**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the chart and the verdict use the same numbers, so there is no room for one account in prose and another in the chart**; ⭐⭐ **a question with no artifact behind it gets an honest miss rather than a guess**, ⭐ **the same family as the previous round’s gap returned as a value, with "cannot answer" made a legitimate output**; **and ⭐⭐ "it cannot fit, merge, or approve anything" denies each capability in turn**. **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ It has a measurable objective, and the objective is not throughput** — verbatim: **"The measure this prototype optimizes is **not fits per second**. It is **the time from an actuarial question to a decision a skeptical reviewer can trust, sign, and reconstruct months later** — the run ledger, evidence, agent record, and frozen approval package all serve that one metric. **The AI’s job is to make human judgment scalable, never to substitute for it: approval stays a human-only, irreversible act.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the objective is written out as the time from an actuarial question to a decision a skeptical reviewer can trust, sign and reconstruct months later, which is more concrete than any efficiency claim and names three acts: trusting, signing and reconstructing months later**; **four artifacts all serve that one metric**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the agent’s job is to make human judgment scalable and never to substitute for it, with approval staying human-only and irreversible**; **and ⭐⭐ it explicitly rejects fits per second as a measure**. **⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ That the product contains no language model and that the build used an AI assistant are stated as two separate things** — verbatim: **"**No LLM anywhere**: the modeling agent is a **deterministic planner** with **two-layer prose templates** (dense expert copy plus a Plain terms gloss), and the context expert **routes questions to real artifacts rather than generating text**"**; **while the repository root measurably carries `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.codex/`, `.claude/` including a session-start hook and six reference documents under `reference/` including a pitfalls file, and `.agents/` with a Codex skill compatibility document** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **no LLM anywhere is stated verbatim, the agent being a deterministic planner, which runs opposite to the other three entries this round and to most AI entries on this site and so is worth recording on its own**; ⭐⭐ **it offers a substitute, a deterministic planner with two-layer prose templates, a dense expert copy plus a plain-terms gloss, so it says how the text is produced without a model**; ⭐⭐ **the context expert routes questions to real artifacts rather than generating text**, consistent with the honest miss above; **and ⭐⭐⭐ the build did use an AI assistant and that is public, since both a Claude and a Codex configuration are committed along with a compatibility document between the two skill systems and a pitfalls reference — so the entry keeps "no LLM in the product" and "AI used to build it" clearly apart**. **⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ A skill provenance table makes unknown attribution a named state** — **an extension of this round’s theme into the human layer**: **this entry read `.claude/skills/PROVENANCE.md`, whose opening reads verbatim "Where each skill came from, its license, and what this repo changed. Not loaded into context; it is reference for maintainers and public users."**; **its maintenance rule reads verbatim that when a forked skill is materially changed its deltas cell must be updated, and when a third-party skill is added a row must be added and its licence and notice files kept in the skill folder**; **its columns are Skill, Upstream, License and Our deltas**, and the portion read lists **`brainstorming` from obra/superpowers (Jesse Vincent) under MIT in folder with stated deltas**; **`writing-plans` and `writing-skills` from obra/superpowers under MIT marked verbatim as stock**; **`caveman` from a community token-compression pattern described as a viral skill with author attribution unclear and marked reimplemented here**; **and `humanizer` from a community de-AI-writing pattern also marked reimplemented here**; **with twelve skills listed as homegrown and stated verbatim to be MIT like the repository**, and one of them described verbatim as researching linked third-party sources as untrusted inputs without vendoring their skill text ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **"author attribution unclear" is exactly this round’s theme: an unknown is written as a named state rather than left blank or guessed at**; ⭐⭐⭐ **an "our deltas" column makes the amount of change mandatory while unmodified forks are marked verbatim as stock, so both what was changed and what was not are recorded states**; ⭐⭐ **the licence column carries "reimplemented here" as a third value, so where the upstream is unclear it asserts its own implementation rather than claiming descent**; **and ⭐⭐ the maintenance rule requires keeping licence and notice files in the skill folder, binding provenance and licensing to the skill directory while stating that the file is not loaded into context and exists for maintainers and public readers**. **⑨ ⭐⭐⭐ Its section of honesty rules baked into the copy is short but hard** — verbatim: **"## Honesty rules baked into the copy** Deviance is nonnegative and **only its change is displayed**. Cross-family comparisons use **AIC, never deviance**. **Every sentence that interpolates a computed number stays true for any value the computation can produce** (the review’s shrinkage wording adapts to whatever the holdout really did). No em dashes, no periods on display strings, and the Plain terms toggle keeps one vetted gloss line under every result."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **every sentence that interpolates a computed number staying true for any value the computation can produce is the most fundamental statement of this round’s theme, since it does not ask the copy to avoid lying but requires it to be true across the whole space of possible values**, with the example that the review’s shrinkage wording adapts to whatever the holdout really did; ⭐⭐ **deviance being nonnegative means only its change is shown, since a strictly positive quantity carries no information as an absolute level**; ⭐⭐ **cross-family comparisons use AIC and never deviance, forbidding a common but invalid comparison**; **and two typographic rules plus a readability decision round it out**. **⑩ ⭐⭐ The territory guardrail’s design logic is explained verbatim, including why zero percent is insufficient** — verbatim: filed territory relativities stay frozen in every fit because they enter the offset, **so they move zero percent by construction**, and **the territory guardrail therefore measures indirect zone-level average rate movement, which is nonzero because the new factors correlate with geography**, with the third experiment being the one that unfreezes them and its direct relativity movement being what kills it ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **a metric that is identically zero cannot serve as a pass condition, the same family as the previous round’s requirement that a coverage claim match the real counts, since both demand that a metric actually measure something**; ⭐⭐ **the guardrail is therefore moved to an indirect measure because the mechanism is understood, so it sits in the right place**; **and ⭐⭐ the third experiment is the only one that unfreezes them, and its direct relativity movement is precisely what kills it**. **⑪ ⭐ Verification is stated, and hand computation appears a third time**: verbatim, the Rust tests cover fitting math **including hand-computed Gini and deviance cases**, and the Playwright run against a URL screenshots both views and themes **plus the GraphQL run-review-permission integration test** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **hand-computed Gini and deviance cases are the third appearance this round of a reference answer computed by hand**, ⭐ **alongside the golden fixtures and the textbook triangle**; ⭐⭐ **the end-to-end tests screenshot both views and both themes, so the interface is under regression too**; **and ⭐⭐ there is an integration test for approval permission, so the resolver rejecting the agent role is tested rather than merely asserted**. **⑫ ⭐ Other checkable details**: **the stack is stated as Rust, axum, async-graphql, sqlx, Postgres and nalgebra on the backend and TypeScript, React, Vite and GraphQL over plain typed fetch on the frontend**; **run commands are given, requiring Rust, Node 22 or later and a database URL**; **and its structure broadly matches its own account, with a crates directory, a frontend including a Playwright config, a committed lockfile, a Dockerfile, a Railway config, a CI smoke script, two readme images and a licence all present**; ⭐ **it describes itself verbatim as a rough concept draft rather than a finished product**; **and it is signed with an author name, an organisation and a live address**. **⑬ ⭐ Readable with** [[policyforge-rating-engine]], [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]], [[credibility-gated-xai]], [[insurance-calibration]], [[actuarial-math-bench]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[proof-protocol]], [[assurance-toto-twin]], [[friction-ledger-claimwatch]], [[bill-auditor-india]] and [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Licence measured as NOASSERTION (a custom licence)** — **a `LICENSE` file is measurably present**, ⭐ **but its contents were not read, so its terms are not restated and it is not claimed to be any OSI-standard licence**; ⚠️ **read that licence or ask the author before use, modification or redistribution**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No step of the platform was run** — **Rust and Node were not installed, nothing was built or tested, Playwright was not run, no database was created and the live address was not opened**; **so the seven experiments’ outcomes, the guardrail behaviour, the compile-time isolation and any fitting result are not claimed to have been reproduced** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims, the actual contents of the skill provenance file, and that the directories and key files it names really exist**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No Rust or TypeScript source, no skill definition, no reference document and no lockfile was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: whether the agent crate really cannot import the fitting or platform crates, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry and is directly checkable in the source or manifests; whether the approval mutation really rejects the agent role in the resolver; whether all guardrail numbers really come from the platform crate; and whether the seven planted truths really sit in the data generator**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ The completeness of the provenance file was not verified** — ⭐ **only its opening portion was read, listing five forked or third-party skills and twelve homegrown ones**, ⚠️ **while 24 skill definitions measurably exist, so the table is not claimed to cover all 24, and whether the remaining seven are recorded elsewhere was not verified**. **⑤ ⚠️⚠️ Its claim that no language model runs in the product was not verified** (⭐ **a checkable engineering claim, but the agent code was not read and no network observation was made**); ⭐ **the entry notes one point needing precision: the repository also commits Claude and Codex configurations, which is not a contradiction, since the former concerns the product runtime and the latter the build process, but it is not claimed that the runtime was verified to make no model calls**. **⑥ ⚠️ The live address’s contents, availability and continued operation were not verified**. **⑦ ⚠️ Its claim of byte-identical regeneration was not verified**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that the seven experiments’ outcomes represent any conclusion about real pricing modelling** — ⚠️ **the data is synthetic and the planted truths are artificial choices; the entry notes that the cost of planting known answers is that it can only test whether the system correctly reports what it was set up to find, not what it would find in real data**, ⚠️ **without calling that a defect, only stating the practice’s scope**. **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its guardrail design is usable for real model governance**, **it being a prototype that describes itself verbatim as a rough concept draft**. **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ Its author’s identity and background, and the nature of the organisation and product it belongs to, were not verified** — **no claim is made that any insurer uses it or that it runs in production**. **⑪ ⭐ At ★0 with 0 forks**, **attention is zero**, **so no maturity is claimed**; ⚠️ **but ⭐⭐ its README is only 7,908 bytes while the repository holds 231 files across six Rust crates, a frontend, two AI assistant configurations and 24 skills — the shape of a short document over a wide engineering surface**. **⑫ ⚠️ It was created before the thaw window, on 2026-08-06** — ⭐ **recorded as such, with selection resting on the push falling inside the window (2026-09-10)**. **⑬ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11** — **and since the repository describes itself as a concept draft under continued iteration, its contents will change**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/ryanportfolio/lab-demo` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence NOASSERTION, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 7,908-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, **as was the opening portion of `.claude/skills/PROVENANCE.md`**; **all 325 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**231 files, 94 directories; the entry used this to check the crates directory, the frontend, the assistant configuration directories including 24 skill definitions, the readme images and the root files**); **nothing was cloned, neither Rust nor Node was installed, no command or test was run, no database was created, the live address was not opened, no source or skill contents were read, and no image was opened**.
entries.verified_note: GitHub API 实测（repo，2026-09-11）：许可实测 NOASSERTION（⚠️实测仓库内含 LICENSE 文件，但本词条未读其内容，故不转述授权条款、不主张其为任一 OSI 标准许可；使用、改写或再分发前应读该 LICENSE 或向作者确认）｜★0｜fork 0｜TypeScript｜2,667 KB｜created 2026-08-06（⚠️解冻窗口之前）｜pushed 2026-09-10（窗口之内）｜topics: actuarial,ai-agents,data-visualization,graphql,human-in-the-loop,insurance,insurance-pricing,model-governance,postgresql,predictive-modeling,react,rust,typescript｜README 7,908 字节｜仓库实测共 325 个条目（231 文件、94 目录），本词条据其核对 crates/、frontend/（含 playwright.config.ts）、.claude/（含 hooks/session-start.sh、reference/ 下六份文件含 pitfalls.md 与 24 个 SKILL.md）、.agents/{CODEX-SKILL-COMPATIBILITY.md,codex-tools.md}、.codex/、docs/readme/ 下两张 PNG、Cargo.lock、Dockerfile、railway.json、scripts/ci-smoke.sh、LICENSE、README.md、AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.gitignore、.gitattributes、.dockerignore；⭐⭐⭐「数据集被做过手脚以让诚实可度量」一节逐字「## The dataset is rigged so honesty is measurable 100,000 policies, fixed seed, byte-identical regeneration. Planted truths, one per experiment archetype:」——四处已写明：①这是本轮主题说得最锋利的一句标题（合成数据通常被当作不得已的替代品，而这里它被故意设计成一台诚实度测试仪）；②「逐字节可重建」把「同一份」推到字节级；③「每个实验原型各埋一条已知答案」即答案在实验之前就已存在于数据里；④规模与种子写明（10 万条保单、固定种子）；⭐⭐⭐七条被埋已知答案与结局逐条列出（U 形年龄曲线 vs v12 的 5 个粗分箱 → EXP-01 样条候选；年龄×车龄交互恰好为零 → EXP-02 在折间抖动上死掉；报备相对数已从现代估计漂移 → EXP-03 被地区护栏杀掉；事故效应线性到 3 后转平 → EXP-04 封顶计数候选；伽马混合过散与特征无关 → EXP-05 AIC 偏好 NB2 但提升是平的；里程缺失非随机按地区成簇 → EXP-06 在拟合之前被拒绝；样条与事故项修正不同残差 → EXP-07 组合胜出）——四处已写明：①七条里只有两条成为候选、一条胜出，其余四条以四种不同方式未通过（折间抖动、护栏、AIC 偏好但提升平、拟合前拒绝）——这套数据不只检验能不能找到，还检验能不能正确地找不到；②⭐⭐⭐ EXP-06 的结局是「在拟合之前就被拒绝」，即一个不该做的实验被挡在计算之前（本轮四条里对「拒绝也是一种正确结果」落实得最具体的一处）；③EXP-05 的结局写法精确（区分了统计显著性与业务提升）；④七个实验被编号且各有原型名；⭐⭐⭐「代理不得看数据」是编译期事实，逐字「The UI promises "hard limits the platform checks outside the agent." That is a compile-time fact here: the agent crate cannot import fit or platform, so it never sees a dataset row or a fit artifact. It reads platform-computed summaries and writes prose. The platform computes every guardrail number.」并逐字给出依赖关系（core 零依赖／datagen 确定性 10 万行合成车险保单自带 PRNG／fit 为 IRLS 泊松与 NB2 GLM、自然三次样条、按暴露加权 Gini、离差、AIC、5 折 CV／platform 为运行执行器、数据画像器、GUARDRAILS、报备与信度／agent 为剧本规划器与裁决模板且 **Depends on core ONLY**／server 为 GraphQL API、角色强制、持久化）——四处已写明：①边界被做成依赖图上的一个事实（agent 不能 import fit 或 platform），是本站所见对「代理做不到某件事」最强的一种保证：提示词可以被绕过，而 import 不能；②「它永远看不到一行数据或一个拟合产物」，越界不是不该做而是在语言层面做不到；③「平台计算每一个护栏数字」，护栏由被隔离在外的另一层算好后再交给它；④分层里 core 零依赖而 agent 只依赖 core；⭐⭐⭐角色强制在解析器层，逐字「Role enforcement is in the GraphQL layer, not the UI: approveReview rejects the agent role in the resolver. The agent opens reviews through the same mutation path a human would use.」——三处已写明：①在 resolver 里拒绝代理角色而不是在界面上（界面不是安全边界，与 ③ 同一思路）；②代理开复核走与人类相同的 mutation 路径（它没有特权通道；若代理有专用写入口那就等于多了一条可被滥用的路径）；③审批是人类专属且不可逆的行为；⭐⭐⭐「产物随裁决一起交付」逐字「A verdict without its artifact is a claim, so the artifact ships with it.」并逐字给出读者能做的三件事（看这次运行：七个实验对着真实后端拟合，每个带 chips、折点与一份书面裁决／打开证据：每张落地卡片带着拟合事实（行数、参数个数、IRLS 迭代次数、离差、AIC）、按风险十分位的提升阶梯、五个折的增量，以及每个原型一张图，而这些图用的就是裁决所依据的同一批数字／就这次运行提问：「A question with no artifact behind it gets an honest miss instead of a guess. It reads and it draws; it cannot fit, merge, or approve anything.」）——四处已写明：①「没有产物的裁决只是一个声明，所以产物随它一起交付」是本轮四条里对「主张必须带证据」写得最凝练的一句；②图与裁决用的是同一批数字（不存在文字一套图一套的空间）；③「没有产物支撑的问题得到一次诚实的落空而不是一次猜测」（与上一轮 kakekomi-corpus 的「gap 作为返回值」同族）；④「它只读、只画；它不能拟合、合并或审批任何东西」；⭐⭐⭐可度量目标逐字「The measure this prototype optimizes is not fits per second. It is the time from an actuarial question to a decision a skeptical reviewer can trust, sign, and reconstruct months later — the run ledger, evidence, agent record, and frozen approval package all serve that one metric. The AI’s job is to make human judgment scalable, never to substitute for it: approval stays a human-only, irreversible act.」——四处已写明：①目标函数被逐字写成「从一个精算问题到一个多疑的复核者能信任、签署、并在数月后重建的决定所需的时间」（含三个动作：信任、签署、数月后重建）；②四个产物各服务于同一个指标；③「代理的工作是让人的判断可规模化，绝不替代它：审批保持为人类专属且不可逆的行为」；④它明确否掉了「每秒拟合次数」；⭐⭐⭐产品无大模型与构建用了 AI 是两件分别写明的事，逐字「No LLM anywhere: the modeling agent is a deterministic planner with two-layer prose templates (dense expert copy plus a Plain terms gloss), and the context expert routes questions to real artifacts rather than generating text」；同时实测仓库根含 CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md、.codex/、.claude/（含 hooks/session-start.sh 与 reference/ 下六份文件含 pitfalls.md）与 .agents/{CODEX-SKILL-COMPATIBILITY.md,codex-tools.md}——四处已写明：①「运行时不使用任何大模型」被逐字声明（代理是确定性规划器），与本轮其余三条及本站多数 AI 条目方向相反，故值得单列；②它给出替代方案（确定性规划器＋两层文案模板：专家密集文与 Plain terms 白话注释）；③上下文专家的做法是把问题路由到真实产物而不是生成文本；④但构建过程用了 AI 助手且这一点是公开的（同时提交 Claude 与 Codex 两套配置，含两者技能系统的兼容性说明与一份踩坑参考），本词条据此把「产品无 LLM」与「构建用了 AI」明确分开；⭐⭐⭐技能来源表把「出处不明」写成具名状态：本词条实测读取 .claude/skills/PROVENANCE.md，其开头逐字「# Skill Provenance Where each skill came from, its license, and what this repo changed. Not loaded into context; it is reference for maintainers and public users.」；维护规则逐字「Maintenance rule: when you materially change a forked skill, update its "Our deltas" cell here. When adding a third-party skill, add a row and keep its LICENSE/NOTICE files in the skill folder.」；表头为 Skill｜Upstream｜License｜Our deltas；所读部分逐行为 brainstorming｜obra/superpowers（Jesse Vincent）｜MIT（in folder）｜Two-lane scope calibration, authorization-safe artifacts, optional visual companion；writing-plans｜obra/superpowers｜MIT（in folder）｜Stock；writing-skills｜obra/superpowers｜MIT（in folder）｜Stock；caveman｜Community token-compression pattern (viral skill, author attribution unclear)｜Reimplemented here｜Intensity tiers (lite/full/ultra), output budget, auto-clarity carve-outs, persistence rules；humanizer｜Community "humanizer" de-AI-writing pattern｜Reimplemented here｜patterns.md tell catalog; voice-matching; review-only mode；并另列本仓库自产（homegrown）十二项，逐字「Homegrown skills are MIT, same as the repo」；并逐字说明其中一项「forge-repo-ui-skill … researches linked third-party sources as untrusted inputs but does not vendor their skill text」——四处已写明：①「author attribution unclear」（作者归属不明）正是本轮主题：一个「不知道」被写成具名状态，而不是留空也不是猜一个名字；②「Our deltas」一栏使改动量成为必填项，而未改动者逐字写「Stock」（原封）——「我们改了什么」与「我们没改」都是被记录的状态；③许可栏出现「Reimplemented here」作为第三种值（在上游不明时声明的自己的实现而不是假称继承）；④维护规则要求新增第三方技能时保留其 LICENSE／NOTICE 文件，且该文件声明不载入上下文、只供维护者与公开读者参考；⭐⭐⭐「文案里烘进去的诚实规则」逐字「## Honesty rules baked into the copy Deviance is nonnegative and only its change is displayed. Cross-family comparisons use AIC, never deviance. Every sentence that interpolates a computed number stays true for any value the computation can produce (the review’s shrinkage wording adapts to whatever the holdout really did). No em dashes, no periods on display strings, and the Plain terms toggle keeps one vetted gloss line under every result.」——四处已写明：①「每一句插入了计算数值的句子，对计算可能产生的任何取值都保持为真」是本轮主题最根本的一次表述（不是要求不撒谎，而是要求文案在数值空间上恒真）；②离差非负故只显示其变化量；③跨族比较只用 AIC 绝不用离差；④另有两条排版规则与一条可读性设计；⭐⭐地区护栏设计逻辑逐字「Filed territory relativities stay frozen in every fit (they enter the offset), so they move 0% by construction. The territory guardrail measures indirect zone-level average rate movement, which is nonzero because the new factors correlate with geography. EXP-03 is the one experiment that unfreezes them, and its direct relativity movement is what kills it.」——三处已写明：①「按构造它们移动 0%」，即一个恒为零的指标不能作为通过条件（与上一轮 kakekomi-corpus 的「覆盖声明必须与真实件数一致」同族：都要求一个指标真的在测东西）；②因此护栏改为测量间接的地区层面平均费率移动（护欄因为理解了机制而设在正确的位置）；③EXP-03 是唯一解冻它们的实验，而正是它的直接相对数移动杀死了它；⭐验证方式逐字（cargo test 覆盖 fitting math incl hand-computed Gini and deviance cases；npx playwright test 对 PLAB_URL 截取两种视图与两种主题，另含 GraphQL run-review-permission integration test）——三处已写明：①手算的 Gini 与离差算例是本轮四条里第三次出现「标准答案是手算的」（与 policyforge 的黄金夹具、ratecraft 的教科书三角同族）；②端到端测试覆盖两种视图与两种主题的截图；③并有一条针对审批权限的 GraphQL 集成测试（即 resolver 拒绝代理角色是被测过的而不是仅被声明）；⭐其余细节：技术栈逐字（Backend: Rust, axum, async-graphql, sqlx, Postgres (Railway), nalgebra／Frontend: TypeScript, React, Vite, GraphQL over plain typed fetch）；运行命令给出（需 Rust、Node 22＋ 与 DATABASE_URL）；实测其仓库结构与自述大致对应；⚠️其自述逐字为「A example concept rough draft for Prediction Lab」（即它自称是概念草稿而非成品）；作者署名为 Ryan Allen · fullbuild.ai 并给出一个线上地址；⚠️⚠️未运行该平台任何一步（未安装 Rust／Node、未 cargo run／cargo test、未运行 Playwright、未建 Postgres、未打开其线上地址），故不主张其所述七个实验的结局、护栏行为、编译期隔离或任何拟合结果已被复现——本词条核实到的是 README 的逐字声明、PROVENANCE.md 的实际内容、以及其点名的目录与关键文件确实存在于仓库中；⚠️⚠️未读任何 Rust／TypeScript 源码、任何技能 SKILL.md、任何 reference/ 文档或 Cargo.lock 的内容——即未核对 agent crate 是否确实不能 import fit 或 platform（**这是本条最需要后续核实的一处**，且这是一个可在源码或 Cargo.toml 中直接核对的断言）、approveReview 是否确实在 resolver 里拒绝代理角色、十个护栏数字是否确实全部由 platform 计算、七个被埋的已知答案是否确实躺在 datagen 的生成逻辑里；⚠️⚠️未核实其 PROVENANCE.md 的完整性——只读取了该文件的前部，其中列出五项 forked／third-party 与十二项 homegrown，而实测 .claude/skills/ 下有 24 个 SKILL.md，故不主张该表已覆盖全部 24 项（其余七项是否另有归属记载，本次未核实）；⚠️⚠️未核实其「运行时不使用任何大模型」这一声明（这是可被检验的工程主张，但本次未读其代理代码、未做任何网络观察）；本词条注意到一个需要精确区分的点：其仓库同时提交了 Claude 与 Codex 两套 AI 助手配置，这不矛盾（前者是产品运行时，后者是构建过程），但不主张已核实产品运行时确无模型调用；⚠️未核实其线上地址的内容、可用性或是否仍在运行；⚠️未核实其「逐字节可重建」这一声明；⭐不主张其七个实验的结局代表真实定价建模中任何结论——其数据为合成、其埋入的真相为人为设定；本词条指出「埋入已知答案」这一做法的代价是它只能检验「系统能否正确报告它被设定要发现的东西」，而不能检验它在真实数据上会发现什么（不主张这是缺陷，只如实指出这一做法的适用范围）；⭐不主张其护栏设计可用于真实模型治理；⭐未核实其作者身份、资历、或 fullbuild.ai 与 Prediction Lab 的性质；★0、fork 0，关注度为零，不主张其成熟度；⚠️但本词条指出其 README 仅 7,908 字节，而仓库有 231 个文件、含六个 Rust crate、一个前端、两套 AI 助手配置与 24 个技能——即文档不长而工程面相当宽的一种形态；⚠️创建在解冻窗口之前（2026-08-06），入选依据是推送落在窗口之内（2026-09-10）；⚠️本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见——该仓库自述为概念草稿且持续迭代。核实手段补充说明：仓库全部 325 个条目经下载 codeload.github.com tarball 后以 tar tz 列出核对；未克隆、未安装 Rust 或 Node、未运行任何命令或测试、未建数据库、未访问其线上地址、未读任何源码或技能内容、未打开任何图

entries.title_en: A content validator that lists, one by one, the class of content bugs that had actually shipped before it existed, each guard tied to a named incident — including the exact escaping bug that reached two question banks and was only caught by hand afterwards

entries.summary: 一份免费的 IFoA 精算考试自学站点（**flashcard ＋ 原创题库 ＋ 进度跟踪**，无需安装与注册），**其原创题库被描述为「原生的、IFoA 风格的题库」并逐项说明何为「风格」**：**多部分问题、指令动词（Calculate／Explain／Discuss）、以及**分数分配要加起来对****；**而进度跟踪逐字为「基于**真实的** IFoA 资格结构（**而不是编造的积分刻度**）」**；**其最值得记的一处是一个内容校验脚本，它逐条列出了「在它存在之前**真的上线过**的那一类内容 bug」**——**六道护栏，每一道都对应一次具体事故**：语法错误；**一张 flashcard 缺 `explain` 字段**（**这个站点赖以成立的「先揭示再解释」模式要求每张卡都有**）；**`$...$` 区间内的 LaTeX 命令缺少转义反斜杠**——**并给出完整机理解释**：源码需要**两个**反斜杠（`\frac`）才能在运行时字符串里得到**一个**（`\frac` 中 KaTeX 所需的那一个），**转义不足要么静默丢掉反斜杠，要么更糟——把下一个字母变成真正的 JS 转义序列（`\t` 变成一个真的制表符，悄悄吃掉文本）**，**并逐字注明「这个 bug 真的上线到了 SP7 与 SP8 题库，事后才靠人工发现」**；**题库条目的声明分数不等于其各部分分数之和**；**`maths-study/exams/<CODE>/progress.md` 缺少某个 `data.js` 已知模组的行**——**逐字称之为「模组数 bug」，它静默地把模组从站点上藏了起来，直到 `progress.md` 被手工补齐**；**同一科目内重复的模组 id、或重复的题目 id**；**并说明该脚本在 CI 中于任何触及这些文件的 push／PR 上自动运行**
entries.summary_hk: 一份免費的 IFoA 精算考試自學站點（**flashcard ＋ 原創題庫 ＋ 進度跟蹤**，無需安裝與註冊），**其原創題庫被描述為「原生的、IFoA 風格的題庫」並逐項說明何為「風格」**：**多部分問題、指令動詞（Calculate／Explain／Discuss）、以及**分數分配要加起來對****；**而進度跟蹤逐字為「基於**真實的** IFoA 資格結構（**而不是編造的積分刻度**）」**；**其最值得記的一處是一個內容校驗腳本，它逐條列出了「在它存在之前**真的上線過**的那一類內容 bug」**——**六道護欄，每一道都對應一次具體事故**：語法錯誤；**一張 flashcard 缺 `explain` 字段**（**這個站點賴以成立的「先揭示再解釋」模式要求每張卡都有**）；**`$...$` 區間內的 LaTeX 命令缺少轉義反斜杠**——**並給出完整機理解釋**：源碼需要**兩個**反斜杠（`\\frac`）才能在運行時字符串裡得到**一個**（KaTeX 所需的那一個），**轉義不足要麼靜默丟掉反斜杠，要麼更糟——把下一個字母變成真正的 JS 轉義序列（`\\t` 變成一個真的製表符，悄悄吃掉文本）**，**並逐字註明「這個 bug 真的上線到了 SP7 與 SP8 題庫，事後才靠人工發現」**；**題庫條目的聲明分數不等於其各部分分數之和**；**`maths-study/exams/<CODE>/progress.md` 缺少某個 `data.js` 已知模組的行**——**逐字稱之為「模組數 bug」，它靜默地把模組從站點上藏了起來，直到 `progress.md` 被手工補齊**；**同一科目內重複的模組 id、或重複的題目 id**；**並說明該腳本在 CI 中於任何觸及這些文件的 push／PR 上自動運行**
entries.summary_en: A free self-study site for the IFoA actuarial exams (flashcards, original question banks and progress tracking, with no install and no sign-up), whose original question banks are described as original and IFoA-style with the meaning of that style spelled out — multi-part questions, command verbs such as calculate, explain and discuss, and **mark allocations that add up** — while progress tracking is described verbatim as following the **actual** IFoA qualification structure **rather than a made-up point scale**; **its most notable feature is a content validator that lists, one by one, the class of content bugs that had actually shipped to the main branch before it existed** — **six guards, each tied to a specific incident**: a syntax error; **a flashcard missing its explain field, which the reveal-then-explain pattern the site is built around requires every card to have**; **a LaTeX command inside a math span missing its escaping backslash**, with the full mechanism explained — the source needs two backslashes so the runtime string ends up with the one KaTeX needs, and under-escaping either drops the backslash silently or, worse, **turns the next letter into a real JavaScript escape sequence, so a backslash-t becomes a literal tab and quietly eats text** — annotated verbatim that **this exact bug shipped in two question banks and was only caught by hand afterwards**; **a question bank entry whose declared marks do not equal the sum of its parts’ marks**; **a progress file missing a row for a module the site data knows about**, named verbatim as the module-count bug that **silently hid modules from the site until the progress file was hand-expanded**; **and duplicate module ids within a subject or duplicate question ids** — with the validator stated to run automatically in continuous integration on any push or pull request touching those files
entries.body:
**ifoa-study-companion**（仓库 `HandsleyD/Actuarial_Study`）**是一份免费的 IFoA 精算考试自学站点**：**flashcard ＋ 原创题库 ＋ 进度跟踪**，**逐字自称** **「No install, no sign-up required — just open the link.」**，**线上地址为 `https://handsleyd.github.io/Actuarial_Study/`**。**实测 ★1、fork 0、许可 **MIT****（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主语言 **PowerShell**、仓库体量 **368,300 KB**、创建 2026-05-06、最后推送 2026-09-09、topics 为 `actuarial`／`actuarial-exams`／`exam-prep`／`flashcards`／`ifoa`／`study-tools`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 2,941 字节**；**仓库实测共 4,355 个条目（3,710 个文件、645 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「标准答案要放在被检验的系统之外」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**唯一有一条护栏直接写明「这个 bug 真的上线过」的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README、脚本与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 一个内容校验脚本，逐条列出「在它存在之前真的上线过的那一类内容 bug」，并逐条对应事故**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处**：**本词条**实测读取** `scripts/validate-content.mjs` 的文件头，**其注释逐字为**：**「// Validates docs/data.js and docs/questions.js against **the class of content bugs that have actually shipped to main before this existed**:」**，**其后逐条列出六项**：

  **「- a syntax error in either file」**；**「- a flashcard missing its "explain" field（**the reveal-then-explain pattern this site is built around requires every card to have one**）」**；**「- a LaTeX 如实记录该日期，**其入选依据是**推送落在窗口之内（2026-09-09）****。**⑬ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****——**该仓库自述为**个人自学项目**且持续更新**（**其 README 逐字称科目覆盖范围以站点上的科目表为准**）**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/HandsleyD/Actuarial_Study` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可 MIT、★数、fork 数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 topics）；README 2,941 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**`scripts/validate-content.mjs` 的文件头注释经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字读取**；**仓库全部 4,355 个条目**经下载 `codeload.github.com` tarball 后以 `tar tz` 列出核对（**3,710 文件、645 目录；本词条据其统计 `.pdf` 结尾 1,101 个、`.pdf.md` 结尾 1,191 个、`.md` 结尾 2,337 个，核对 `docs/`、`maths-study/`（含 23 个科目目录与 `resources/` 两个子树）、`scripts/`、`supabase/`、`.github/`（含两条工作流与 agents 目录）与根目录文件**）；**未克隆、未运行任何脚本或工作流、未打开其线上地址、未读任何源码／题库／笔记／PDF 的内容、未打开任何图**。
