**ifoa-study-companion**（倉庫 `HandsleyD/Actuarial_Study`）**是一份免費的 IFoA 精算考試自學站點**：**flashcard ＋ 原創題庫 ＋ 進度跟蹤**，**逐字自稱** **「No install, no sign-up required — just open the link.」**，**線上地址為 `https://handsleyd.github.io/Actuarial_Study/`**。**實測 ★1、fork 0、許可 **MIT****（**實測倉庫內含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主語言 **PowerShell**、體量 **368,300 KB**、創建 2026-05-06、最後推送 2026-09-09、topics 為 `actuarial`／`actuarial-exams`／`exam-prep`／`flashcards`／`ifoa`／`study-tools`**（**創建在解凍窗口之前，推送落在窗口之內**）；**README 實測 2,941 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 4,355 個條目（3,710 個文件、645 個目錄）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「標準答案要放在被檢驗的系統之外」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**唯一有一條護欄直接寫明「這個 bug 真的上線過」的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README、腳本與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 一個內容校驗腳本，逐條列出「在它存在之前真的上線過的那一類內容 bug」，並逐條對應事故**：**本詞條**實測讀取** `scripts/validate-content.mjs` 的文件頭，**其註釋逐字為**：**「// Validates docs/data.js and docs/questions.js against **the class of content bugs that have actually shipped to main before this existed**:」**，**其後逐條列出六項**：**語法錯誤**；**一張 flashcard 缺 "explain" 欄位**（**這個站點賴以成立的「先揭示再解釋」模式要求每張卡都有**）；**`$...$` 區間內的 LaTeX 命令缺少轉義反斜杠**——**源碼需要**兩個**反斜杠（`\\frac`）才能在運行時字符串裡得到**一個**（KaTeX 所需的那一個），**轉義不足要麼靜默丟掉反斜杠，要麼更糟——把下一個字母變成真正的 JS 轉義序列（`\\t` 變成一個真的製表符，悄悄吃掉文本）**，**並逐字註明「this exact bug shipped in the SP7 and SP8 question banks and was only caught by hand afterwards」**；**題庫條目的聲明 "marks" 不等於其各部分 marks 之和**；**`maths-study/exams/<CODE>/progress.md` 缺少某個 `data.js` 已知模組的行**——**逐字稱之為「the "module-count bug" that silently hid modules on the site until progress.md was hand-expanded」**；**同一科目內重複的模組 id、或重複的題目 id**；**並逐字說明** **「Run locally: `node scripts/validate-content.mjs`」** 與 **「**Runs automatically in CI on any push/PR touching the files above** -- see `.github/workflows/validate-content.yml`.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「在它存在之前真的上線過的那一類內容 bug」**——**⭐ 這是本輪主題在本條裡最直接的落點**：這份校驗器的**規格來源不是設計文檔，而是一次次的真實事故****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 六道護欄中有三道**逐條點名了具體事故****（LaTeX 轉義不足真的上線到 SP7 與 SP8 題庫且事後才靠人工發現；模組數 bug 靜默地把模組從站點上藏了起來直到 `progress.md` 被手工補齊）——**⭐ 即**讀者能知道每一道檢查是為了防什麼、以及不防會怎樣****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ LaTeX 那條寫到了**機理層****（源碼兩個反斜杠 → 運行時一個 → KaTeX 所需的那一個；轉義不足的兩種後果：靜默丟掉反斜杠，或把下一個字母變成真正的 JS 轉義序列、悄悄吃掉文本）——**⭐ 這是本站所見**對一個靜默 bug 解釋得最完整的一處****；**④ ⭐⭐「聲明的分數不等於其各部分分數之和」是一條**算術不變量****，而「缺某模組的行」是一條**結構完整性檢查****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「原創、IFoA 風格」被逐項定義，並給出**三條明確邊界****：**「- **Practice exams** — **original, IFoA-style question banks**（**multi-part questions, command verbs like *Calculate*, *Explain*, *Discuss*, mark allocations that add up**）for exam-condition practice.」**；**並在後文逐字給出邊界**：**「This site is a personal, self-study project — **original content written to mirror the structure and topic weighting of the official IFoA syllabus, not a reproduction of any copyrighted IFoA past paper or study material**. **It isn’t affiliated with, endorsed by, or produced by the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries, and shouldn’t be treated as a substitute for the official Core Reading or a qualified tutor.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「IFoA 風格」不是一個形容詞，而是三個可核對的**形式特徵****（多部分問題、指令動詞、**分數分配要加起來對**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 邊界聲明同時否掉三件事**（**不隸屬**、**未獲背書**、**非由 IFoA 製作**）；**③ ⭐⭐ 並明確**不可替代**兩樣東西**（**官方 Core Reading** 與**合格導師**）；**④ ⭐⭐「鏡像官方大綱的**結構**與**主題權重**」與「**不是**任何受版權保護的 IFoA 往年試卷或學習材料的複製」被分成兩句**——**⭐ 即**「像結構」與「複製內容」被明確切開**（**⚠️ 但見下 ⑨**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **進度跟蹤的規則來自**外部機構**而不是自編刻度****：**「- **Progress tracking** — a mastery star for every flashcard you’ve nailed, a study streak, and **real Associate/Fellow tracking based on the actual IFoA qualification structure（not a made-up point scale）**. Mark a whole subject complete in one click if you already hold an exemption or a prior pass.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「基於**真實的** IFoA 資格結構（**而不是編造的積分刻度**）」**——**⭐ 即**升級規則的定義權被交給外部機構****（與上一輪 [[kakekomi-corpus]] 的「覆蓋聲明必須與真實件數一致」同一族）；**② ⭐⭐ 它照顧了豁免與既有通過**（一鍵把整科標記為完成）；**③ 另有兩項可見的鼓勵機制**（掌握星與學習連續天數）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「分數分配要加起來對」在腳本裡是一條被強制的檢查****——**⭐ 本詞條把兩處連起來看**：**README 裡它是「IFoA 風格」的三個特徵之一，而在 `validate-content.mjs` 裡它是**第六道被強制執行的護欄之一****——**⭐ 即**一個**文體約定**被升級成了一條**會失敗的檢查****（**⭐ 這是本輪四條裡**「把規範變成測試」最乾淨的一例**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其內容形態逐條寫出，且「先揭示再解釋」被解釋為一種**教學法****：**「- **Flashcards** for every module of each subject, with a **reveal-then-explain format**: see the question, try to answer it, then **reveal the answer alongside a short "why this matters" note that connects it to the wider syllabus**.」**⭐⭐ **兩處**：**① 三段式：看題 → 自己先答 → 揭示答案並附一句「為什麼這重要」**；**② 那句附註的作用被寫明為**把該點與大綱連接起來****。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其覆蓋範圍按官方大綱的四個部分陳述****（**Core Principles (CB, CM, CS)／Core Practice (CP)／Specialist Principles (SP)／Specialist Advanced (SA)**）；**⭐ 而本詞條**實測**其 `maths-study/exams/` 下有 **23 個科目目錄**（**含 CB1／CB2／CB3／CM1／CM2／CP1／CP2／CP3／CS1／CS2／SA1／SA2／SA3／SA4／SA7／SP1／SP2／SP4／SP5／SP6 等**）——**⭐ 即**README 的四段式描述與倉庫裡的科目目錄**一致且可核對**（**⚠️ 但**未逐個核對**目錄名與大綱科目一一對應**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其站點與內容工作區分開，且只有站點是發布出去的****：**「- [`docs/`](docs/) — **the study site itself（published via GitHub Pages from this folder）** - [`maths-study/`](maths-study/) — **the underlying study workspace（notes, concept indexes, past-paper work）that feeds the site’s content** - [`supabase/`](supabase/) — **optional cloud-sync setup**, see `supabase/SETUP.md` if you’re running your own fork」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「發布的是 `docs/` 這一個目錄」**（**⭐ 即**工作區與發布物被分開**，見下 ⑨**）；**② ⭐⭐ `maths-study/` 被逐字描述為**包含「往年試卷工作」（past-paper work）****（**⭐ 即**README **自己承認**該目錄裡有往年試卷相關工作**）；**③ ⭐⭐ 它考慮了**別人 fork** 的情形並給出配置入口**。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **倉庫裡還提交了一個** GitHub 代理定義**與兩條工作流****（**實測 `.github/agents/study-assistant.agent.md`、`.github/workflows/validate-content.yml`、`.github/workflows/sync-progress.yml` 與 `scripts/sync-progress-md.mjs`、`.github/readme-assets/progress-screenshot.png`、`.claude/launch.json`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 校驗腳本所聲稱的「在 CI 中自動運行」被實測核實**（`validate-content.yml` 確實存在）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ `sync-progress.yml` 與 `sync-progress-md.mjs` 的存在**說明那條「模組數 bug」**已經被工程化處理**（從「手工補齊」變成「有腳本同步」）——**⭐ 這是「事故 → 護欄 → 工具」鏈條的完整一例**；**③ ⭐⭐ 它提交了一份 AI 代理定義**（**⚠️ 未讀該文件內容**）；**④ 其站點內容另有獨立的 `docs/` 目錄與 `data.js`／`questions.js` 兩個被校驗的數據文件**。**⑨ ⚠️⚠️ **一處需要讀者自己確認的範圍問題（本詞條據文件清單如實記錄，不作侵權主張）**——**其邊界聲明說該站點是原創內容、**不是**任何受版權保護的 IFoA 往年試卷或學習材料的複製**，**而 `maths-study/` 被描述為包含「往年試卷工作」，且本詞條實測**：**倉庫中存在一整個 `maths-study/resources/past-papers/raw/` 目錄樹，其中以 `.pdf` 結尾的文件實測 **1,101 個****，**文件名形如** **`IandF_CP2_202104_Examiners_Report_v1.pdf`、`IandF_CP2_202009_Examiners_Report.pdf`**；**另存在 `maths-study/resources/source-material/` 目錄樹，其中含**具名商業教材的 PDF**（**實測到的文件名包括《Economics》（John Sloman 等）、《Introduction to Econometrics》（Oxford）、《A Primer for Unit Root Testing》（Palgrave Texts in Econometrics）等**），**以及大量以 `.pdf.md` 結尾的轉換文本（實測 1,191 個）**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **不主張**這構成侵權****（**⚠️ 未打開任何 PDF**，**文件名中的 `IandF` 與 `Examiners_Report` 只是**文件名層面的指示****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 本詞條指出的是**範圍**問題而不是**是非**問題**：**邊界聲明的主語是「這個站點」（this site），而**發布出去的是 `docs/`****——**⭐ 故**讀者若要 fork 或再分發，`docs/` 與 `maths-study/resources/` **應分別確認其條件**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 本詞條另指出：**倉庫整體聲明為 MIT（逐字「Released under the MIT License — reuse and adapt freely, with attribution.」）**，而**MIT 是作者就其**自己有權許可的部分**授予的**，**不自動涵蓋其中的第三方材料**——**⭐ 這與本輪 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 所記的同一觀察同類：**倉庫的許可與其中第三方數據的權利狀態是兩件不同的事****；**④ ⭐⭐ **已核實**的只是**這些文件存在及其文件名**，**未核實**其來源、獲得方式或任何授權狀態****。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **README 明確標註了「未獲背書」**，**而這與 GitHub 倉庫描述裡的一句相同**（**實測其描述逐字以** **「Free IFoA actuarial exam study site — flashcards, practice exams and progress tracking. Not affiliated with the IFoA.」** 收尾**）**⭐⭐ **即**該聲明在**倉庫描述與 README 兩處**都出現**。**⑪ ⭐ **其餘可核實細節**：**① 可選賬號與雲端同步被寫明為**可選**，且**默認只存在瀏覽器裡****；**② 介面含**明暗主題與移動端友好佈局**；**③ README 提供 issues 入口收集訂正與建議**；**④ `maths-study/` 下另有 `CLAUDE.md`、`ifoa-exam-overview.md`、`progress.md`、`README.md` 與一個 `.obsidian/` 配置目錄**（**⭐ 即**該工作區是一個 Obsidian 庫，且其配置文件被提交****）；**⑤ 科目目錄內部結構一致**（**實測含 `README.md`、`concepts/concept-index.md`、`flashcards/deck.md`、`modules/m01/exercises.md` 等**）。**⑫ ⭐ 可與 [[actuarial-math-bench]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[lossratio-r]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[insurance-calibration]]、[[claimscope-benchmark]]、[[prediction-lab-actuarial]]、[[policyforge-rating-engine]]、[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]、[[insurance-qa-evidence]]、[[evidence-review-claims]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⭐ **許可為 **MIT****——**實測倉庫內含 `LICENSE` 文件**，**README 逐字為「Released under the MIT License — reuse and adapt freely, with attribution.」**；**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ 本詞條**特別指出**：**MIT 是作者就其**自己有權許可的部分**授予的**，**⭐ 而**該倉庫的 `maths-study/resources/` 下實測存在 **1,101 個 `.pdf` 文件（含文件名指示為 IFoA 考官報告的往年試卷樹）與具名商業教材的 PDF**——**⚠️ 這些材料**是否在 MIT 授權範圍內，本詞條**未核實**，**亦**不主張**存在侵權**；**⚠️ 若要 fork、再分發或用於公開站點，應就 `docs/` 與 `maths-study/resources/` **分別確認條件****。**② ⚠️⚠️ **未運行該站點的任何一步****——**未 git clone、未運行 `node scripts/validate-content.mjs`、未運行任何工作流、未打開其線上地址、未構建或服務其前端**；**故**不主張**該校驗腳本能通過、六道護欄是否確實生效、或該站點是否可用**——**⭐ 本詞條核實到的是**該腳本的**文件頭註釋**、其**文件確實存在**、以及 README 所述各處結構**在倉庫中一一對應****。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未讀任何站點源碼、任何 flashcard 或題庫內容、任何一條 `.md` 筆記、任何一份 PDF、或 `study-assistant.agent.md` 的內容****——**⭐ 即**未核對**：六道護欄是否確實**在代碼中**實現**（**⚠️ 本詞條**只讀到其**註釋中的說明****——**⚠️ 這是本條最需要後續核實的一處**）；**題庫中的分數是否確實都加起來對**；**科目目錄與官方大綱科目是否一一對應**；**README 關於「原創內容」與「不是複製」的區分在**實際內容層面**如何體現**（**⭐ 這是一個**內容層**的判斷，本次完全未涉及**）。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其題目與練習的正確性、難度或與真實考試的符合度**；**⭐ 據此**不主張**該站點可用於備考決策**（**⚠️ 其 README 自己已逐字說明**不可替代官方 Core Reading 或合格導師**）。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其進度跟蹤是否確實按 IFoA 資格結構實現**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其「可選雲端同步」的實現、數據存放位置或隱私處理**。**⑦ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實** `maths-study/resources/` 下那 1,101 個 `.pdf` 與 1,191 個 `.pdf.md` 的來源、獲取方式或授權狀態****——**⚠️ 本次未打開任何一份**；**只記錄**「該類文件存在及其文件名」，**不轉述**其內容**；**⭐ 也**不主張**其邊界聲明與實際內容相衝突**——**因為**該聲明的主語是**「這個站點」**，而這些文件位於**工作區**（**且只有 `docs/` 被發布**）**，**⚠️ 二者是否一致**需要內容層的核查，本次未做****。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其與 IFoA 的實際關係**（**其自稱不隸屬、未獲背書、非由其製作**；**只記錄該聲明**）。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其作者身份、資歷或該項目是否被考生使用**。**⑩ ⭐ **★1、fork 0**，**不主張其成熟度或內容質量**；**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ 其 README 僅 2,941 位元組，而倉庫有 3,710 個文件、一個 23 科目的學習工作區、兩條 CI 工作流、一個內容校驗器與一份 AI 代理定義****——**⭐ 即**文檔很短而倉庫很大**的一種形態**；**應如實寫出，不用星數代替判斷****。**⑪ ⚠️ **主語言被判為 **PowerShell****（**⭐ 未核實**其成因**——**⚠️ 實測倉庫以 HTML／JS／md／PDF 為主**，**故**該判定未必反映倉庫的主要內容語言****）。**⑫ ⚠️ **創建在解凍窗口之前（2026-05-06）****——**如實記錄該日期，入選依據是**推送落在窗口之內（2026-09-09）****。**⑬ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****——**該倉庫自述為**個人自學項目**且持續更新****。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/HandsleyD/Actuarial_Study` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 2,941 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對；**`scripts/validate-content.mjs` 的文件頭註釋經 raw 實測逐字讀取**；**全部 4,355 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對（3,710 文件、645 目錄；據其統計 `.pdf` 結尾 1,101 個、`.pdf.md` 結尾 1,191 個、`.md` 結尾 2,337 個，核對 `docs/`、`maths-study/`（含 23 個科目目錄與 `resources/` 兩個子樹）、`scripts/`、`supabase/`、`.github/`（含兩條工作流與 agents 目錄）與根目錄文件）；**未克隆、未運行任何腳本或工作流、未打開其線上地址、未讀任何源碼／題庫／筆記／PDF 的內容、未打開任何圖**。
entries.body_en:
**ifoa-study-companion** (repository `HandsleyD/Actuarial_Study`) **is a free self-study site for the IFoA actuarial exams**: **flashcards, original question banks and progress tracking**, self-described verbatim as requiring **no install and no sign-up, just opening the link**, with a live address. **Measured ★1, 0 forks, licence **MIT** (a `LICENSE` file is measurably present), detected primary language **PowerShell**, a **368,300 KB** repository, created 2026-05-06, last pushed 2026-09-09, topics `actuarial`, `actuarial-exams`, `exam-prep`, `flashcards`, `ifoa` and `study-tools`** (all GitHub API measurements; creation predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it); **the README measures 2,941 bytes**; **the repository measures 4,355 entries (3,710 files, 645 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **the reference answer must live outside the system being tested**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the one whose guardrails each name an incident that actually happened**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README, the script and the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① A content validator that lists, one by one, the class of content bugs that had actually shipped before it existed, each tied to an incident** — **the most notable point in this entry**: **this entry read the file header of `scripts/validate-content.mjs`, whose comment reads verbatim that it validates the site data and questions against the class of content bugs that have actually shipped to the main branch before it existed**, followed by six items: **a syntax error in either file**; **a flashcard missing its explain field, which the reveal-then-explain pattern the site is built around requires every card to have**; **a LaTeX command inside a math span missing its escaping backslash, where the source needs two backslashes so the runtime string ends up with the one KaTeX needs, and under-escaping either drops the backslash silently or, worse, turns the next letter into a real JavaScript escape sequence so a backslash-t becomes a literal tab and quietly eats text — annotated verbatim that this exact bug shipped in two named question banks and was only caught by hand afterwards**; **a question bank entry whose declared marks do not equal the sum of its parts’ marks**; **a progress file missing a row for a module the site data knows about, named verbatim as the module-count bug that silently hid modules from the site until the progress file was hand-expanded**; **and duplicate module ids within a subject or duplicate question ids**; **with the header stating verbatim that it runs locally via node and runs automatically in continuous integration on any push or pull request touching those files, pointing at a named workflow file** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **"the class of content bugs that have actually shipped" makes the validator’s specification a list of real incidents rather than a design document, the most direct landing of this round’s theme in this entry**; ⭐⭐⭐ **three of the six guards name specific incidents — the escaping bug reached two question banks and was caught only by hand afterwards, and the module-count bug silently hid modules until the file was hand-expanded — so a reader learns what each check prevents and what happens without it**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the escaping item is explained at the mechanism level, from two backslashes in source to one in the runtime string to the one KaTeX needs, with both consequences of under-escaping given, the most complete account this site has collected of a silent bug, because it does not merely say to escape but explains why one missing backslash eats text**; **and ⭐⭐ the marks check is an arithmetic invariant while the missing-row check is a structural completeness check, so the guards cover both**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ The claim of being original and IFoA-style is defined item by item, with three explicit boundaries** — verbatim: **"- **Practice exams** — **original, IFoA-style question banks** (multi-part questions, command verbs like Calculate, Explain, Discuss, **mark allocations that add up**) for exam-condition practice."**; **and the boundaries stated verbatim later**: **"This site is a personal, self-study project — **original content written to mirror the structure and topic weighting of the official IFoA syllabus, not a reproduction of any copyrighted IFoA past paper or study material**. **It isn’t affiliated with, endorsed by, or produced by the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries, and shouldn’t be treated as a substitute for the official Core Reading or a qualified tutor.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **being IFoA-style is not an adjective but three checkable formal features, so it says in what specific respects it is alike**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the boundary statement denies three things at once: affiliation, endorsement, and production by the IFoA**; ⭐⭐ **and it names two things it cannot replace, the official Core Reading and a qualified tutor, so it says what should govern instead**; **and ⭐⭐ mirroring the syllabus’s structure and topic weighting is separated into its own clause from not reproducing any copyrighted paper or study material, splitting being alike in structure from copying content** (⚠️ **though see ⑨ on the scope that distinction covers**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The progress-tracking rule comes from an external body rather than an invented scale** — verbatim: **"- **Progress tracking** — a mastery star for every flashcard you’ve nailed, a study streak, and **real Associate/Fellow tracking based on the actual IFoA qualification structure (not a made-up point scale)**. Mark a whole subject complete in one click if you already hold an exemption or a prior pass."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **basing the progression on the actual IFoA qualification structure rather than a made-up point scale hands the authority to define progression to an external body**, ⭐ **the same family as the previous round’s requirement that a coverage claim match the real counts, since both refuse to let a number or rule be defined casually inside the system**; ⭐⭐ **exemptions and prior passes are accommodated with a one-click completion**; **and two visible encouragement mechanisms, a mastery star and a study streak, are included, whose effectiveness is not assessed here**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ The rule that mark allocations add up is an enforced check in the script, not just a style note** — ⭐ **this entry connects the two**: in the README it is one of the three features of being IFoA-style, **and in the validator it is one of six enforced guards, checking that a question bank entry’s declared marks equal the sum of its parts** — ⭐ **a stylistic convention upgraded into a check that can fail, the cleanest instance this round of turning a specification into a test**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its content form is stated and the reveal-then-explain pattern is explained as a teaching method** — verbatim: **"- **Flashcards** for every module of each subject, with a **reveal-then-explain format**: see the question, try to answer it, then **reveal the answer alongside a short "why this matters" note that connects it to the wider syllabus**."** ⭐⭐ **Three steps, see the question, try to answer, then reveal the answer with a short note on why it matters, where the note’s job is stated as connecting the point to the wider syllabus rather than merely encouraging**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its coverage is stated by the four parts of the official syllabus** — verbatim: **"Subjects currently covered span the **Core Principles (CB, CM, CS)**, **Core Practice (CP)**, **Specialist Principles (SP)** and **Specialist Advanced (SA)** parts of the IFoA syllabus — see the subject grid on the site for the full, current list."**; ⭐ **and this entry measured 23 subject directories under the study workspace, including most CB, CM, CP, CS, SA and SP codes, so the README’s four-part description corresponds to checkable directories in the repository** (⚠️ **though no code-by-code correspondence with the syllabus was checked**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ The site and the content workspace are separated, and only the site is published** — verbatim: **the site itself is published via GitHub Pages from that folder; the study workspace beneath it holds notes, concept indexes and past-paper work and feeds the site’s content; and there is an optional cloud-sync setup with a setup document for people running their own fork** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **only the site folder is published, so the workspace and the published artifact are separated, which matters for ⑨**; ⭐⭐ **the workspace is described verbatim as containing past-paper work, so the README itself acknowledges papers in that directory**; **and ⭐⭐ it anticipates being forked and provides a configuration entry point**. **⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ The repository also commits a GitHub agent definition and two workflows** — measured: **an agent definition for a study assistant, a content-validation workflow (which is the workflow the validator’s header names), a progress-sync workflow with a matching script, a progress screenshot asset and a launch configuration** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the validator’s claim of running automatically in continuous integration is verified, since the workflow file measurably exists**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the existence of a progress-sync workflow and script shows the module-count bug was engineering-handled by turning hand expansion into a scripted sync, a complete example of the incident-to-guardrail-to-tool chain**; ⭐⭐ **an AI agent definition is committed, so how the repository is maintained with assistance is publicly readable** (⚠️ **its contents were not read**); **and the site content has its own data and question files, both of which the validator checks**. **⑨ ⚠️⚠️ A scope question the reader must settle, recorded here from the file listing with no claim of infringement** — **the boundary statement says the site carries original content and is not a reproduction of any copyrighted IFoA past paper or study material**, **while the workspace is described as containing past-paper work, and this entry measured**: **a whole raw past-papers tree exists under the workspace containing 1,101 files ending in `.pdf`**, **with filenames such as an examiners’ report for a CP2 paper dated 202104 and another dated 202009, under paths naming CP2, paper 1, and the sitting months**; **and a source-materials tree exists containing PDFs of named commercial textbooks, including titles published by Oxford and Palgrave and a named economics textbook, along with 1,191 files ending in `.pdf.md` as converted text** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **no claim of infringement is made, since no PDF was opened and the filenames are only an indication**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the point raised is one of scope rather than of right or wrong: the boundary statement’s subject is the site, and only the site folder is published, so anyone forking or redistributing should confirm the conditions of the published site content and of the raw resources tree separately**; ⭐⭐⭐ **and the entry notes further that the repository as a whole is declared MIT with free reuse and adaptation under attribution, while MIT is granted by the author over what the author has the right to license and does not automatically cover third-party material inside it — the same observation recorded this round for the reserving engine’s published-triangle fixture, since a repository’s licence and the rights status of third-party data inside it are two different things**; **and ⭐⭐ all that was verified is that these files exist and what they are named, not their provenance, how they were obtained or any authorisation**. **⑩ ⭐⭐ The README states explicitly that it is not affiliated, and the same claim appears in the repository description** (**which measurably ends verbatim with "Not affiliated with the IFoA."**), **so the statement appears in two places**. **⑪ ⭐ Other checkable details**: **an optional account and cloud sync are stated to be optional with progress by default saved only in the browser**; **light and dark themes with a mobile-friendly layout are present**; **the README offers an issues link for corrections and suggestions**; **the study workspace also holds its own assistant instructions, an exam overview, a progress file, a readme and a committed Obsidian configuration directory, so the workspace is an Obsidian vault with its configuration in the repository**; **and the per-subject directory structure is consistent, containing a readme, a concept index, a flashcard deck and per-module exercises**. **⑫ ⭐ Readable with** [[actuarial-math-bench]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[lossratio-r]], [[verified-reserving]], [[insurance-calibration]], [[claimscope-benchmark]], [[prediction-lab-actuarial]], [[policyforge-rating-engine]], [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]], [[insurance-qa-evidence]] and [[evidence-review-claims]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⭐ Licence is MIT** — **a `LICENSE` file is measurably present** and the README states verbatim that it is released under the MIT License for free reuse and adaptation with attribution; **⚠️ but ⭐⭐ the entry notes in particular that MIT is granted by the author over the portion the author has the right to license, ⭐ while the repository’s resources tree measurably holds 1,101 `.pdf` files including a past-papers tree whose filenames indicate IFoA examiners’ reports plus PDFs of named commercial textbooks — whether those are within the MIT grant was not verified, and no claim of infringement is made**; **⚠️ anyone forking, redistributing or publishing should confirm the conditions of the site content and of the raw resources separately**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No step of the site was run** — **nothing was cloned, the validator was not run, no workflow was run, the live address was not opened, and no frontend was built or served**; **so the validator is not claimed to pass, nor the six guards claimed to work, nor the site claimed to be usable** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the validator’s file-header comment, the fact that its files exist, and that the structures the README describes correspond in the repository**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No site source, flashcard, question bank, note, PDF or agent definition was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: whether the six guards are actually implemented in code, since only the comments describing them were read, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry; whether the marks in the question banks really add up; whether the subject directories correspond to the official syllabus; and how the README’s distinction between original content and non-reproduction shows up at the content level, a judgement about content that this check did not touch at all**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ The correctness and difficulty of its questions and exercises, and their fidelity to the real exams, were not verified** (**no question was attempted and no official syllabus or paper was compared**); ⭐ **so no claim is made that the site is usable for exam-preparation decisions**, ⚠️ **its own README stating verbatim that it should not be treated as a substitute for the official Core Reading or a qualified tutor**. **⑤ ⚠️ Whether the progress tracking really follows the IFoA qualification structure was not verified**. **⑥ ⚠️ The implementation, data location and privacy handling of the optional cloud sync were not verified**. **⑦ ⚠️⚠️ The provenance, acquisition and authorisation status of the 1,101 PDFs and 1,191 converted text files under the resources tree were not verified** — ⚠️ **none was opened**; **the entry records only that such files exist and what they are named, and does not restate their contents**; ⭐ **nor is any conflict asserted between the boundary statement and the actual contents, since the statement’s subject is the site while these files sit in the workspace and only the site folder is published, and whether the two are consistent would need a content-level check that was not performed**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ Its actual relationship with the IFoA was not verified** (**it states it is unaffiliated, unendorsed and not produced by the IFoA; the entry records the statement without independently verifying it**). **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ Its author’s identity, background and whether candidates use it were not verified**. **⑩ ⭐ At ★1 with 0 forks**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity or content quality is claimed**; ⚠️ **but ⭐⭐ its README is only 2,941 bytes while the repository holds 3,710 files, a 23-subject study workspace, two CI workflows, a content validator and an AI agent definition — a short document over a large repository, whose 368,300 KB size is wholly out of proportion to its star count**, **which the site records rather than letting star counts stand in for judgement**. **⑪ ⚠️ Its detected primary language is PowerShell**, ⭐ **whose cause was not verified; ⚠️ since the repository is measurably dominated by HTML, JavaScript, Markdown and PDF, that detection may not reflect the repository’s main content language, so no stack is inferred from it**. **⑫ ⚠️ It was created before the thaw window, on 2026-05-06** — ⭐ **recorded as such, with selection resting on the push falling inside the window (2026-09-09)**. **⑬ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11** — **and the repository describes itself as a personal self-study project under continued updating, its README referring readers to the site’s own subject grid for the current list**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/HandsleyD/Actuarial_Study` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence MIT, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 2,941-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; **the file-header comment of `scripts/validate-content.mjs` was read verbatim via `raw.githubusercontent.com`**; **all 4,355 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**3,710 files, 645 directories; the entry used this to count 1,101 paths ending in `.pdf`, 1,191 ending in `.pdf.md` and 2,337 ending in `.md`, and to check the docs folder, the study workspace with its 23 subject directories and two resource subtrees, the scripts, the supabase folder, the GitHub folder with two workflows and an agents directory, and the root files**); **nothing was cloned, no script or workflow was run, the live address was not opened, no source, question bank, note or PDF contents were read, and no image was opened**.

topic weighting of the official IFoA syllabus, not a reproduction of any copyrighted IFoA past paper or study material**. **It isn’t affiliated with, endorsed by, or produced by the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries, and shouldn’t be treated as a substitute for the official Core Reading or a qualified tutor.**」——四处已写明：①「IFoA 风格」不是形容词而是三个可核对的形式特征（多部分问题、指令动词、分数分配要加起来对）；②边界声明同时否掉三件事（不隶属、未获背书、非由 IFoA 制作）；③并明确不可替代两样东西（官方 Core Reading 与合格导师）；④「镜像官方大纲的结构与主题权重」与「不是任何受版权保护的 IFoA 往年试卷或学习材料的复制」被分成两句（把「像结构」与「复制内容」明确切开，⚠️但其覆盖范围见 ⑨）；⭐⭐⭐进度跟踪规则来自外部机构，逐字「- **Progress tracking** — a mastery star for every flashcard you’ve nailed, a study streak, and **real Associate/Fellow tracking based on the actual IFoA qualification structure (not a made-up point scale)**. Mark a whole subject complete in one click if you already hold an exemption or a prior pass.」——三处已写明：①「基于真实的 IFoA 资格结构（而不是编造的积分刻度）」即升级规则的定义权被交给外部机构（与上一轮 kakekomi-corpus 的「覆盖声明必须与真实件数一致」同一族：都要求一条规则不在系统内部被随手定义）；②它照顾了豁免与既有通过；③另有两项可见的鼓励机制；⭐⭐⭐「分数分配要加起来对」在脚本里是被强制的检查——本词条把两处连起来看：README 里它是「IFoA 风格」三个特征之一，而在 validate-content.mjs 里它是六道被强制执行的护栏之一——即一个文体约定被升级成了一条会失败的检查（这是本轮四条里「把规范变成测试」最干净的一例）；⭐⭐内容形态逐字「- **Flashcards** for every module of each subject, with a **reveal-then-explain format**: see the question, try to answer it, then **reveal the answer alongside a short "why this matters" note that connects it to the wider syllabus**.」——两处已写明：①三段式（看题→自己先答→揭示答案并附一句「为什么这重要」）；②那句附注的作用是把该点与大钢连接起来（不只是鼓励而是定位到知识体系里的位置）；⭐⭐覆盖范围逐字（Core Principles (CB, CM, CS)／Core Practice (CP)／Specialist Principles (SP)／Specialist Advanced (SA)），而实测 maths-study/exams/ 下有 23 个科目目录（含 CB1-3、CM1-2、CP1-3、CS1-2、SA1-4、SA7、SP1-2、SP4-6 等）——即 README 的四段式描述与仓库里的科目目录一致且可核对（⚠️但未逐个核对目录名与大纲科目一一对应）；⭐⭐站点与内容工作区分开且只有站点发布，逐字「docs/ — the study site itself (published via GitHub Pages from this folder)；maths-study/ — the underlying study workspace (notes, concept indexes, **past-paper work**) that feeds the site’s content；supabase/ — optional cloud-sync setup, see supabase/SETUP.md if you’re running your own fork」——三处已写明：①发布的是 docs/ 这一个目录（工作区与发布物被分开）；②maths-study/ 被逐字描述为包含「往年试卷工作」（README 自己承认该目录里有往年试卷相关工作）；③它考虑了别人 fork 的情形并给出配置入口；⭐⭐⭐仓库里还提交了一个 GitHub 代理定义与两条工作流（实测 .github/agents/study-assistant.agent.md、.github/workflows/validate-content.yml、.github/workflows/sync-progress.yml 与 scripts/sync-progress-md.mjs、.github/readme-assets/progress-screenshot.png、.claude/launch.json）——四处已写明：①校验脚本所声称的「在 CI 中自动运行」被实测核实（validate-content.yml 确实存在，不是一句声明）；②sync-progress.yml 与 sync-progress-md.mjs 的存在说明那条「模组数 bug」已经被工程化处理（从手工补齐变成有脚本同步）——这是「事故→护栏→工具」链条的完整一例；③它提交了一份 AI 代理定义（⚠️未读该文件内容）；④其站点内容另有独立的 docs/ 目录与 data.js／questions.js 两个被校验的数据文件；⚠️⚠️一处需要读者自己确认的范围问题（本词条据文件清单如实记录，不作侵权主张）：其边界声明说该站点是原创内容、不是任何受版权保护的 IFoA 往年试卷或学习材料的复制，而 maths-study/ 被描述为包含「往年试卷工作」，且实测仓库中存在一整个 maths-study/resources/past-papers/raw/ 目录树，其中以 .pdf 结尾的文件实测 1,101 个，文件名形如 IandF_CP2_202104_Examiners_Report_v1.pdf、IandF_CP2_202009_Examiners_Report.pdf（路径含 CP2／CP2 Paper 1／Apr21 与 Sep20）；另存在 maths-study/resources/source-material/ 目录树，其中含具名商业教材的 PDF（实测到《Economics》（John Sloman 等）、《Introduction to Econometrics》（Oxford）、《A Primer for Unit Root Testing》（Palgrave Texts in Econometrics）等），以及大量以 .pdf.md 结尾的转换文本（实测 1,191 个）——四处已写明：①本词条不主张这构成侵权（本次未打开任何 PDF；文件名中的 IandF 与 Examiners_Report 只是文件名层面的指示，可能来自 IFoA 即 Institute and Faculty，但这只是文件名层面的指示）；②本词条指出的是一个范围问题而不是一个是非问题：其边界声明的主语是「这个站点」，而发布出去的是 docs/——故读者若要 fork 或再分发，docs/（站点与原创内容）与 maths-study/resources/（原始 PDF 与教材）应分别确认其条件；③本词条另指出：仓库整体声明为 MIT，而 MIT 是仓库作者就其自己有权许可的部分授予的许可，不自动涵盖其中的第三方材料（与本轮 ratecraft-reserving-pricing 所记同一观察同类：仓库的许可与其中第三方数据的权利状态是两件不同的事）；④已核实的只是这些文件存在及其文件名，未核实其来源、获得方式或任何授权状态；⭐⭐README 明确标注了「未获背书」，而 GitHub 仓库描述实测逐字以「Free IFoA actuarial exam study site — flashcards, practice exams and progress tracking. Not affiliated with the IFoA.」收尾——即该声明在仓库描述与 README 两处都出现；⭐其余可核实细节：可选的账号与云端同步被写明为可选且默认只存在浏览器里；界面含明暗主题与移动端友好布局；README 提供 issues 入口；maths-study/ 下另有 CLAUDE.md、ifoa-exam-overview.md、progress.md、README.md 与一个 .obsidian/ 配置目录（即该工作区是一个 Obsidian 库且其配置文件被提交）；科目目录内部结构一致（实测含 README.md、concepts/concept-index.md、flashcards/deck.md、modules/m01/exercises.md 等）；⚠️⚠️未运行该站点任何一步（未 git clone、未运行 node scripts/validate-content.mjs、未运行任何工作流、未打开其线上地址、未构建或服务其前端），故不主张该校验脚本能通过、六道护栏是否确实生效、或该站点是否可用——本词条核实到的是该脚本的文件头注释、其文件确实存在、以及 README 所述各处结构在仓库中一一对应；⚠️⚠️未读任何站点源码、任何 flashcard 或题库内容、任何一条 .md 笔记、任何一份 PDF、或 study-assistant.agent.md 的内容——即未核对六道护栏是否确实在代码中实现（**这是本条最需要后续核实的一处**；本词条只读到其注释中的说明）、题库中的分数是否确实都加起来对、科目目录与官方大纲科目是否一一对应、以及 README 关于「原创内容」与「不是复制」的区分在实际内容层面如何体现（这是一个内容层的判断，本次完全未涉及）；⚠️⚠️未核实其题目与练习的正确性、难度或与真实考试的符合度（未做任何题目、未比对任何官方大纲或试卷），据此不主张该站点可用于备考决策（其 README 自己已逐字说明不可替代官方 Core Reading 或合格导师）；⚠️未核实其进度跟踪是否确实按 IFoA 资格结构实现；⚠️未核实其「可选云端同步」的实现、数据存放位置或隐私处理；⚠️⚠️未核实 maths-study/resources/ 下那 1,101 个 .pdf 与 1,191 个 .pdf.md 的来源、获取方式或授权状态（本次未打开任何一份；只记录该类文件存在及其文件名，不转述其内容）；本词条也不主张其边界声明与实际内容相冲突（因为该声明的主语是「这个站点」，而这些文件位于工作区，且只有 docs/ 被发布；二者是否一致需要内容层的核查，本次未做）；⭐未核实其与 IFoA 的实际关系（其自称不隶属、未获背书、非由其制作，本词条只记录该声明而不独立核实）；⭐未核实其作者身份、资历或该项目是否被考生使用，不主张它被 IFoA 认可或被任何教育机构采用；★1、fork 0，关注度极低，不主张其成熟度或内容质量；⚠️但本词条指出其 README 仅 2,941 字节，而仓库有 3,710 个文件、一个 23 科目的学习工作区、两条 CI 工作流、一个内容校验器与一份 AI 代理定义——即文档很短而仓库很大的一种形态（且其 368,300 KB 的体量与星数完全不成比例），应如实写出，不用星数代替判断；⚠️主语言被判为 PowerShell（未核实其成因；实测仓库以 HTML／JS／md／PDF 为主，故该判定未必反映仓库的主要内容语言，不据此推断其技术栈）；⚠️创建在解冻窗口之前（2026-05-06），入选依据是推送落在窗口之内（2026-09-09）；⚠️本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见——该仓库自述为个人自学项目且持续更新。核实手段补充说明：仓库全部 4,355 个条目经下载 codeload.github.com tarball 后以 tar tz 列出核对；未克隆、未运行任何脚本或工作流、未打开其线上地址、未读任何源码／题库／笔记／PDF 的内容、未打开任何图

entries.title: 把许可分成两份写：**代码 MIT、数据 OGL v3** 各挂一枚徽章，再配一份 29 个数据集的来源登记表（含端点、许可、取数怪癖与**「值得绕开的死路」**）；而「海岸侵蚀」被明确声明为**已建模但不定价**，并给出四层理由
entries.title_en: A two-part licence declaration — code MIT and data OGL v3 on separate badges — plus a registry of all 29 datasets with endpoints, licences, access quirks and the dead ends worth avoiding, while coastal erosion is declared modelled but deliberately not priced with a four-part reason
entries.title_hk: 把許可分成兩份寫：**代碼 MIT、數據 OGL v3** 各掛一枚徽章，再配一份 29 個數據集的來源登記表（含端點、許可、取數怪癖與**「值得繞開的死路」**）；而「海岸侵蝕」被明確聲明為**已建模但不定價**，並給出四層理由
entries.summary: 一份英国住宅险**地理风险图**：**2,736 个邮编区**的交互式分区设色图，为**八种住宅险灾因**定价（**沉降、天气损害、洪水**（河流、海潮与地表水）、**地下水淹水、盗窃、漏失水、火灾、意外损害**），**其中四个天气驱动的灾因用一个 C-vine copula 相连**，**另四个损耗型灾因作为独立支路定价**（**并逐个给出理由**：「盗窃不随风暴路径而来、爆管听命于寒潮、住宅火灾跟从贫困度与住宅类型、意外损害跟从家庭本身」），分成 10 个费率组；**其最值得记的一处是它把「许可」按**部分**分开声明**——**实测其 README 顶部两枚徽章分别写 **`code` → MIT** 与 **`data` → OGL v3**，后者直接指向 **`DATA_SOURCES.md`**（**逐字为「全部 29 个数据集及其端点、**许可**、取数怪癖与**值得绕开的死路**」**）**；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① 一条**已建模但不定价**的灾因声明**（**海岸侵蚀被有意排除在 `premium` 之外**，**四层理由齐全**：**为何排除**（英国标准家财险不承保渐进的侵蚀，且侵蚀是**全损**而非修缮，会**悄悄毁掉评级**）、**为何仍留在 vine 里**（侵蚀由风暴驱动，作为第五维进入 C-vine）、**建的是什么**（2105 年前景内将失去的带状区内的房屋视为在该期限内损失，**并自陈两条假设**，其中「家庭在区内均匀分布」这一条**若有什么影响是低估**）、**为何不出现在好年坏年对照页**（侵蚀是**长期性而非事件性**）**）；**② 一处**把「没有这个功能」本身当成结论**的段落**（**逐字「这就是为什么没有按区的『copula 增益』图层——在校准过的频率上它只是在画蒙特卡洛噪声。**去掉它**就是结论**」**）；**③ 一处**在审计失败之后才改的配色**（**逐字「WCAG 2.1 AA 对比度在四个页面的明暗两模式下**程序化验证**（**从计算样式量测，而不是从纸上的调色板**）。`--ink-muted` 与链接颜色是在这次审计**判掉 23 个元素之后**才调深的」**）
entries.summary_hk: 一份英國住宅險**地理風險圖**：**2,736 個郵編區**的交互式分區設色圖，為**八種住宅險災因**定價（**沉降、天氣損害、洪水**（河流、海潮與地表水）、**地下水淹水、盜竊、漏失水、火災、意外損害**），**其中四個天氣驅動的災因用一個 C-vine copula 相連**，**另四個損耗型災因作為獨立支路定價**（**並逐個給出理由**：「盜竊不隨風暴路徑而來、爆管聽命於寒潮、住宅火災跟從貧困度與住宅類型、意外損害跟從家庭本身」），分成 10 個費率組；**其最值得記的一處是它把「許可」按**部分**分開聲明**——**實測其 README 頂部兩枚徽章分別寫 **`code` → MIT** 與 **`data` → OGL v3**，後者直接指向 **`DATA_SOURCES.md`**（**逐字為「全部 29 個數據集及其端點、**許可**、取數怪癖與**值得繞開的死路**」**）**；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① 一條**已建模但不定價**的災因聲明**（**海岸侵蝕被有意排除在 `premium` 之外**，**四層理由齊全**：**為何排除**（英國標準家財險不承保漸進的侵蝕，且侵蝕是**全損**而非修繕，會**悄悄毀掉評級**）、**為何仍留在 vine 裡**（侵蝕由風暴驅動，作為第五維進入 C-vine）、**建的是什麼**（2105 年前景內將失去的帶狀區內的房屋視為在該期限內損失，**並自陳兩條假設**，其中「家庭在區內均勻分布」這一條**若有什麼影響是低估**）、**為何不出現在好年壞年對照頁**（侵蝕是**長期性而非事件性**）**）；**② 一處**把「沒有這個功能」本身當成結論**的段落**（**逐字「這就是為什麼沒有按區的『copula 增益』圖層——在校準過的頻率上它只是在畫蒙特卡洛噪聲。**去掉它就是結論**」**）；**③ 一處**在審計失敗之後才改的配色**（**逐字「WCAG 2.1 AA 對比度在四個頁面的明暗兩模式下**程序化驗證**（**從計算樣式量測，而不是從紙上的調色板**）。`--ink-muted` 與鏈接顏色是在這次審計**判掉 23 個元素之後**才調深的」**）
entries.summary_en: A geospatial risk map for UK home insurance: an interactive choropleth of 2,736 postcode districts rating eight home-insurance perils (subsidence, weather damage, flood across rivers, sea and surface water, groundwater flooding, theft, escape of water, fire and accidental damage), with the four weather-driven perils joined by a C-vine copula and the attritional four priced as independent legs with a reason given for each — burglary does not arrive on the storm track, burst pipes answer to cold snaps, dwelling fires follow deprivation and dwelling type, and accidental damage follows the household itself — banded into ten rating groups; **its most notable feature is that it declares licensing part by part**, with two badges at the top of the README reading **code, MIT** and **data, OGL v3**, the latter pointing at a data-sources document described verbatim as covering all 29 datasets with their endpoints, **licences**, access quirks and **the dead ends worth avoiding**; **three further points follow the same discipline**: **first, a peril declared modelled but deliberately not priced** — coastal erosion is kept out of the premium with a four-part reason: why it is excluded (gradual coastal erosion is not covered by standard UK household policies, and erosion is a total loss rather than a repair, so it would quietly wreck the rating), why it is nevertheless kept in the vine (erosion is storm-driven and enters the C-vine as a fifth dimension), what is modelled instead (a property inside the strip projected to be lost by 2105, with two assumptions stated plainly, one of which if anything understates the exposure), and why it is absent from the good-years-versus-bad-years view (erosion is chronic rather than episodic); **second, a passage that treats the absence of a feature as itself the finding** — verbatim, this is why there is no per-district copula-uplift map layer, since at calibrated frequencies it would be drawing Monte Carlo noise, and removing it is the finding; **and third, a palette changed only after an audit failed** — WCAG 2.1 AA contrast was verified programmatically on all four pages in both light and dark modes, measured from computed styles rather than from the palette on paper, and two colour variables were darkened after that audit failed 23 elements
entries.body:
**uk-home-insurance-risk-map**（仓库 `SMcode-source/uk-home-insurance-risk-map`）**是一份英国住宅险**地理风险图****：**2,736 个邮编区**的交互式分区设色图，**为八种住宅险灾因定价**，**其中四个天气驱动的灾因用一个 C-vine copula 相连，另四个损耗型灾因作为独立支路定价**，**分成 10 个费率组**，**并有一个对照页把整本的「好年与坏年」分解开**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **NOASSERTION**（⚠️ **其成因见 ①**——**仓库内有 `LICENSE` 文件，但它同时声明了两套许可，GitHub 无法归入单一 SPDX 标识**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 **141,750 KB**、创建 2026-07-31、最后推送 2026-09-09、topics 为 `actuarial`／`copula`／`flood-risk`／`geospatial`／`insurance`／`leaflet`／`open-data`／`python`／`risk-modelling`／`uk`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 62,476 字节**；**仓库实测共 195 个条目（182 个文件、13 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「按部分声明：许可、能力、交付物与使用者各自适用什么规则」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把「许可按部分分」写得最完整的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 两枚徽章把「代码许可」与「数据许可」分开写，而数据侧挂着一份 29 个数据集的来源登记表**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处，也是本会话所见「许可范围」问题最完整的一次正面解决**：**本词条**实测其 README 顶部徽章逐字为** **「Licence: MIT」**（**链接文本为 `code-MIT`，指向 `LICENSE`**）与 **「Data: OGL v3」**（**链接文本为 `data-OGL v3`，指向 `DATA_SOURCES.md`**）**，**另有 `Live site`、`tests`（指向 `.github/workflows/tests.yml`）、`Python 3.13`、`Districts: 2,736`、`Perils: 8 insured + 1` 五枚**；**并逐字说明数据侧登记表的范围**：**「Every hazard input is **open data**, fetched by the scripts here — see **`DATA_SOURCES.md`** for all **29 datasets** with their endpoints, **licences**, access quirks and **the dead ends worth avoiding**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「代码 MIT」与「数据 OGL v3」是**两枚并列徽章**——**⭐ 本词条指出：这正好解决了本会话第 342 轮在**两条**条目里记录的同一观察（**仓库的许可与其中第三方数据的权利状态是两件不同的事**）；**而这里不是靠免责声明，而是**把两套许可并列挂在门口**，**且数据侧那份文件就是它的依据****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它给出**数据集的精确数量**（29）**并逐项列出**端点、许可、取数怪癖**——**⭐ 尤其「取数怪癖」与「**值得绕开的死路**」两栏**：**后者是本会话首次见到的**负面清单**（**不只是「数据在哪」，而是「哪条路走不通」**）**；**③ ⭐⭐ `NOASSERTION` 的成因被本条解释**（**两套许可并列 → GitHub 无法归入单一 SPDX 标识**）**——**⭐ 即**这个「无法归类」本身是**声明方式导致的**，**而不是未声明**；**④ **实测根目录含 `DATA_SOURCES.md`、`LICENSE`、`LIMITATIONS.md`、`HANDOFF.md` 四份文件**——**⭐ 即**限制与交接**各有独立文档****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它另有一份「把结论写在顶部的」范围声明，直接否定自己数字的用途**——**逐字为**：**「> ⚠️ These are **eight-peril technical premiums, not home insurance premiums**. A real policy also carries **expenses, commission and profit**. **Expect these figures to be a fraction of what you actually pay.** **This is a methodology demonstration, not a rating product.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「是八灾因**技术保费**，不是家财险保费」**——**⭐ 即**它把自己的输出**重新命名**为一个更窄的东西**；**② **它列出真实保单还会带的**三项**（**费用、佣金与利润**），**并逐字提示读者实际支付的会是这些数字的**一个零头****；**③ ⭐⭐ **「这是方法学演示，不是定价产品」**——**⭐ 一句话封掉了最常见的误用****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **一条**已建模但不定价**的灾因声明，四层理由齐全**——**这是本轮主题最锋利的一处**：**其 README 有一节标题逐字为** **「## Coastal erosion: **modelled, not priced**」**，**正文逐字为**：**「The model carries one further peril — **coastal erosion**, from the EA’s **NCERM National 2024** frontages — and it is **deliberately kept out of `premium`**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处理由层层给出**：**① **为何排除**：**「Gradual coastal erosion is **not covered by standard UK household policies**. Putting it in the technical premium would **price a loss no policy pays**, and would **quietly wreck the rating**: erosion is a **total loss of the property rather than a repair**, so where it bites it dwarfs everything else.」****——**⭐ 三条理由各不一样**（**条款不覆盖 / 为一个无人赔付的损失定价 / 全损会压倒其余一切**）**；**② **为何仍留在 vine 里**：**「Erosion is storm-driven: cliffs and beaches retreat in a handful of surge events, not on calm days. **So it belongs in the dependence structure even though it is not priced.**」**——**并给出具体参数**（**作为第五维进入 C-vine，与天气一个 Gumbel 对（θ_we），且在给定天气下与洪水的 tree-2 高斯对是三者中**最强**的（ρ_FE|W = 0.35）**）；**③ **建的是什么，并自陈两条假设**：**「A property inside the strip projected to be lost by the 2105 epoch is lost within that horizon, so the annual hazard is the district’s zone fraction spread over 80 years, at a sum-insured severity. **Two assumptions worth stating plainly:** households are taken as spread **uniformly** across the district（**coastal populations actually cluster towards the shore, so this if anything UNDERSTATES it**），and the **SMP** scenario is used — defences maintained as currently planned. The unmanaged **NFI** case is carried alongside for contrast」****——**⭐ 本词条认为「这条假设若有偏差是**低估**」是很重要的一句：**它指出了自己假设的**方向****；**④ **为何不出现在好年坏年对照页**：**「Erosion is **chronic, not episodic**. Including it would add a near-constant charge to every simulated year and **blur precisely the contrast that page exists to show**. **Capital is likewise allocated against insured losses only.**」****⭐⭐⭐ **并且它给出了**可核对的结果**：**全国层面采纳的方案把 2105 年的土地损失限制在 **250 km²**（**无防护为 435 km²**）**，**并点名具体海滨**（**Blackpool FY1、Eastbourne BN21、Bognor PO21/PO22、Crosby L22 在「Hold the Line」方案下从显著侵蚀变为**恰好为零****），**而在没有海堤的地方，**欧洲侵蚀最快的一段海岸**如实地显现（**Holderness 的 Hornsea HU18 与 Withernsea HU19 居首，其次 Suffolk 海岸的 Southwold IP18**）**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「没有这个功能」本身当成结论**——**这是本轮主题在段落层面的又一次出现**：**其 README 有一节标题逐字为** **「## Does the copula actually matter?」**，**正文先给出**测量的方式与规模**（**`scripts/dependence_check.py`，60 个区 × 40 万年**），**再给出**一个分成两半的答案****：**① **对**单栋住宅****：**联合建模使「多灾因年份」的概率变为**94 倍**（**0.11% 对独立性下的 0.0012%**）**——**但该住宅自身的 99% TVaR 几乎不动**（**+2.7%，95% 置信区间 −9.0% 至 +12.8%**，**即与零无法区分**）**，**并逐字解释为何这个区间跨零**：**「**The interval straddling zero is the finding**; its point estimate wanders between runs **precisely because it is noise**, which is why **nothing is priced off it**.」****；**② **对**组合****：**罕见联合事件停止互相抵消**，**巨灾年份的成本比独立性所隐含的**高约 8%****——**⭐ 并说明「这才是资本被设定的依据，也是 vine 在这里的原因」**。**随后逐字给出那个最锋利的结论**：**「This is why there is **no per-district "copula uplift" map layer** — at calibrated frequencies it would be **drawing Monte Carlo noise**. **Removing it IS the finding.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「去掉它**就是**结论」**——**⭐ 即**一个功能的缺席不是遗漏，而是**被测量出来的正确决定****；**② ⭐⭐ **它把「置信区间跨零」当作**发现**而不是失败**；**③ ⭐⭐ **「点估计在多次运行之间游走，**正因为它是噪声**，**所以没有任何东西按它定价**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所见**对「不要按噪声定价」写得最直接的一句****。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **测试是**结构性质测试**，且每条都指向模型所依赖的机制**——**逐字为**：**「Property tests for the machinery the model rests on: **Gumbel h-function inversion round-trips to 1e-8**, sampled margins pass **Kolmogorov–Smirnov** against U(0,1), **every vine pair recovers its target Kendall’s tau**, **Gumbel shows upper-tail dependence where the tau-matched Gaussian does not**, the 5-dim vine-implied correlation matrix **stays positive definite across the whole theta range**, and **the severity distributions reproduce the published ABI means**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **六条断言全部是**结构性的**（**往返精度、分布拟合、τ 复现、上尾相依的有无、相关矩阵正定、均值复现已发表值**）**——**⭐ 即**它测的不是「跑得通」，而是**数学性质是否成立****；**② ⭐⭐ **「Gumbel 在上尾有相依，而 τ 匹配的高斯没有」****——**⭐ 即**它测的是 copula 家族的**定性特征**；**③ **正定性在**整个 θ 范围上**都被要求**（**不是抽样几个点**）；**④ ⭐⭐ **严重度分布必须**复现已发表的 ABI 均值**（**⭐ 又一次「标准答案来自外部」**）**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **新灾因有各自的护栏，且其中一条**规定了某个东西不得被触碰****——**逐字为**：**「erosion’s frequency **must annualise over the horizon** and **must NOT be touched by the ABI frequency scaling**（**it has no published payout to calibrate against**）」**；**「the flood–erosion tree-2 pair **must come out as the strongest of the three**」**；**「the depth multiplier must leave the **exposure-weighted national mean at exactly 1.0** while still ranking a deep district above a shallow one」**；**「plus a **fallback test proving the model still runs when the depth product is absent, as it is outside England**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「它没有可据以校准的已发表赔付，**因此不得被 ABI 频率缩放触碰**」**——**⭐ 即**缺一条外部参照被**明确转成一条禁止性护栏****；**② ⭐⭐ **深度乘数必须使**按暴露加权的全国均值为恰好 1.0**、同时仍能把深区排在浅区之上**——**⭐ 即**归一化与排序**两条要求同时被测**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **一条**兜底测试**：**证明深度数据缺失时模型仍能运行**（**逐字给出理由「as it is outside England」**）**——**⭐ 即**它测的是**数据缺口下的行为**，**而不只是数据齐备时的行为****。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **「站点是被检查过的，不是被假设的」**——**这一节的写法值得整段引用**：**「## Design & accessibility** The site is **checked, not assumed**:」**，**逐字含**：**「**WCAG 2.1 AA contrast** verified **programmatically** on all four pages in **light and dark mode**（**measured from computed styles, not from the palette on paper**）. **`--ink-muted` and link colours were darkened after that audit failed 23 elements**; chart series colours are unchanged, since **those are marks not text**.」**；**「**Mobile verified at 375x812** on the live site: **no page-level horizontal overflow anywhere**, wide tables and charts scroll inside their own containers, nav fits without sideways scrolling, **tap targets >=24px**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「从计算样式量测，而不是从纸上的调色板」**——**⭐ 即**它说明了自己量的是**运行时的真实值****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「`--ink-muted` 与链接颜色是在那次审计**判掉 23 个元素之后**才调深的」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所见**对「审计失败并因此改了东西」写得最具体的一处**（**它给出了失败的数量，并把改动归因于那次失败**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「图表系列颜色不变，因为那些是**标记**而不是文字」**——**⭐ 即**它把「文字」与「图形标记」的对比度要求**分开处理****；**④ **移动端在**真实站点上 375×812 验证**，**并列出了四项具体检查**。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **一条数据完整性做法值得单独记：ABI 数据是**手工转录的**，且**明令不得覆盖往年****——**逐字为**：**「`data/abi_annual.csv` is **HAND-TRANSCRIBED** from the ABI’s full-year property releases（one every February）— **there is no feed and the site bot-blocks scrapers**. When the next one lands, **add its rows with the source URL and a published/derived flag**, **DO NOT overwrite prior years**（**the ABI restates them, and both readings are kept side by side**）」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「ABI 会重述往年数据，所以两种读法并排保留」**——**⭐ 这正是本站第 340 轮主题（**把一个数在什么口径下产生**写下来**）的一种工程实现：**它不覆盖历史，而是保留**当时发表的**与**后来重述的**两版**；**② ⭐⭐ **每行必须带**来源 URL 与「已发表／已派生」标志****；**③ **它说明了为什么必须手工转录**（**没有数据馈送，且该站点封锁抓取**）**；**④ **取数细节写到了**配额层**（**逐字「Open-Meteo free tier has a daily quota - if it 429s, rerun next day」**）**与**备份路径**（**无 CEDA 账号时的替代来源**）**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **其仓库结构支持上述主张**（**实测 182 个文件**）：**⭐ `scripts/` 下的脚本命名本身就是一套**校验清单****——**实测含 `analytic_el_check.py`（**解析式期望损失核对**）、`check_simulate_identical.py`（**检验模拟是否逐次一致**）、`check_abi_subsidence.py`、`check_calib.py`、`check_geojson.py`、`check_years.py`、`compare_rebuild.py`、`compare_gust_surfaces.py`、`compare_haduk_resolutions.py`、`anchor_budget.py`、`backtest_coverage.py` 等**；**⭐ 且 `.github/workflows/` 下实测有 **16 条工作流**——含 `tests.yml`、`pages.yml`、`rebuild.yml`、**`seed-sweep.yml`**（**种子扫查**）、**`freeze-share.yml`**、`platform-probe.yml`、`haduk-1km*.yml` 四条、`sector-model.yml`、`smd-curve.yml`、`sub-level.yml`、`scotland-theft.yml` 与 `scotland-theft-geography.yml`**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **`analytic_el_check.py` 与 `seed-sweep.yml` 两处最值得注意**：**前者暗示存在一个**与模拟并行的解析式核对**，**后者是**跨随机种子的扫查****（**⭐ 与第 341 轮 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 的「不共享代码的独立实现」同族**）；**② **校验脚本被**单独命名**且为数众多**（**⭐ 即**「检查」在这个仓库里是**一等公民**）**；**③ ⚠️ 本词条**只依据**文件名**，**未读任何脚本内容**——**故**不转述**其实现，**亦**不主张**这些检查确实如名称所示**。**⑩ ⚠️⚠️ **一处需如实指出的**描述与文档不一致****：**其 GitHub 仓库描述逐字为** **「**Four-peril** UK home insurance risk model（**subsidence, weather, flood, groundwater**）joined by a vine copula, built entirely on open data.」**，**而其 README 与徽章都说**八个灾因**（**徽章逐字 `Perils: 8 insured + 1`**，**README 逐字列出八种并把四种天气驱动的灾情交给 copula**）**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① **本词条**不主张**这是错误**（**描述可能是较早写的、或只指 copula 所连的那一部分**）**；**② ⭐⭐ **但本词条指出：**若读者只看仓库描述，会以为这是一个**四灾因**模型****——**⭐ 即**仓库描述这一处**少于** README 所述**（**⭐ 与第 341 轮 [[medical-opinion-extractor]] 的同一形态观察同族**）；**③ **已核实的只是**两处文本各自写了什么**。**⑪ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[openquake-engine]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[opendrr-riskprofiler]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]]、[[catrisk-sim]]、[[floodwise]]、[[insurance-calibration]]、[[credibility-gated-xai]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **许可实测为 **NOASSERTION****——**⭐ 本词条**已查明其成因**：**README 顶部并列两枚徽章（**`code` → MIT、`data` → OGL v3**）**，**且 `LICENSE` 文件存在**，**故 GitHub 无法归入单一 SPDX 标识****——**⭐ 即**这是**分部分声明许可**所导致的「无法归类」，**而不是未声明**；**⚠️ 但**本词条**未读 `LICENSE` 与 `DATA_SOURCES.md` 的内容**，**故**不转述**具体条款、**不主张**其 29 个数据集各自的许可状态已被核实**；**⚠️ 使用、改写或再分发其代码或数据前，应分别读 `LICENSE` 与 `DATA_SOURCES.md`**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未运行该模型的任何一步****——**未克隆、未创建虚拟环境、未安装依赖、未运行 `pytest`、未运行任何 `scripts/` 下脚本、未运行任何工作流、未打开其线上站点**；**故**本词条**不主张**其 2,736 个区、八灾因的定价、copula 的相依测量（94 倍／+2.7%／约 8%）、海岸侵蚀的情景结果（250 km² 对 435 km²）、或测试所断言的性质**已被复现**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的逐字声明、其点名的文件确实存在、以及其仓库结构（含 `DATA_SOURCES.md`、`LIMITATIONS.md`、`HANDOFF.md`、约 20 个校验脚本与 16 条工作流）**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何脚本、任何 `docs/` 页面、`LIMITATIONS.md`、`HANDOFF.md`、`DATA_SOURCES.md` 或 `LICENSE` 的内容****——**⭐ 即**本词条**未核对**：**六条性质测试是否确实如此实现**（**⚠️ 本词条**只读到 README 中对它们的描述**，**这是本条最需要后续核实的一处**）；**`scripts/analysis_el_check.py`／`analytic_el_check.py` 是否确实是一个与模拟并行的解析式核对**；**`DATA_SOURCES.md` 是否确实含 29 个数据集及其许可**（**⚠️ 这一条对读者最重要，因为**它是数据侧许可的依据****）；**两条自陈假设（均匀分布、SMP
