**uk-home-insurance-risk-map**（倉庫 `SMcode-source/uk-home-insurance-risk-map`）**是一份英國住宅險**地理風險圖****：**2,736 個郵編區**的交互式分區設色圖，**為八種住宅險災因定價**，**其中四個天氣驅動的災因用一個 C-vine copula 相連，另四個損耗型災因作為獨立支路定價**，**分成 10 個費率組**，**並有一個對照頁把整本的「好年與壞年」分解開**。**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 **NOASSERTION**（⚠️ **其成因見 ①**——**倉庫內有 `LICENSE` 文件，但它同時聲明了兩套許可，GitHub 無法歸入單一 SPDX 標識**）、主語言 Python、體量 **141,750 KB**、創建 2026-07-31、最後推送 2026-09-09、topics 為 `actuarial`／`copula`／`flood-risk`／`geospatial`／`insurance`／`leaflet`／`open-data`／`python`／`risk-modelling`／`uk`**（**創建在解凍窗口之前，推送落在窗口之內**）；**README 實測 62,476 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 195 個條目（182 個文件、13 個目錄）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「按部分聲明：許可、能力、交付物與使用者各自適用什麼規則」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**把「許可按部分分」寫得最完整的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 兩枚徽章把「代碼許可」與「數據許可」分開寫，而數據側掛着一份 29 個數據集的來源登記表**：**本詞條**實測其 README 頂部徽章逐字為** **「Licence: MIT」**（**鏈接文本為 `code-MIT`，指向 `LICENSE`**）與 **「Data: OGL v3」**（**鏈接文本為 `data-OGL v3`，指向 `DATA_SOURCES.md`**）**，**另有 `Live site`、`tests`（指向 `.github/workflows/tests.yml`）、`Python 3.13`、`Districts: 2,736`、`Perils: 8 insured + 1` 五枚**；**並逐字說明數據側登記表的範圍**：**「Every hazard input is **open data**, fetched by the scripts here — see **`DATA_SOURCES.md`** for all **29 datasets** with their endpoints, **licences**, access quirks and **the dead ends worth avoiding**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「代碼 MIT」與「數據 OGL v3」是**兩枚並列徽章**——**⭐ 這正好解決了本會話第 342 輪在**兩條**條目裡記錄的同一觀察（倉庫的許可與其中第三方數據的權利狀態是兩件不同的事）；而這裡不是靠免責聲明，而是把兩套許可並列掛在門口，且數據側那份文件就是它的依據****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它給出**數據集的精確數量**（29）並逐項列出端點、許可、取數怪癖**——**⭐ 尤其「取數怪癖」與「**值得繞開的死路**」兩欄**：**後者是本會話首次見到的**負面清單****；**③ ⭐⭐ `NOASSERTION` 的成因被本條解釋**（**兩套許可並列 → GitHub 無法歸入單一 SPDX 標識**）——**⭐ 即**這個「無法歸類」本身是聲明方式導致的，而不是未聲明****；**④ 實測根目錄含 `DATA_SOURCES.md`、`LICENSE`、`LIMITATIONS.md`、`HANDOFF.md` 四份文件**（**限制與交接各有獨立文檔**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它另有一份把結論寫在頂部的範圍聲明，直接否定自己數字的用途**：**「> ⚠️ These are **eight-peril technical premiums, not home insurance premiums**. A real policy also carries **expenses, commission and profit**. **Expect these figures to be a fraction of what you actually pay.** **This is a methodology demonstration, not a rating product.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「是八災因**技術保費**，不是家財險保費」**（把自己的輸出重新命名為一個更窄的東西）；**② 它列出真實保單還會帶的三項**（費用、佣金與利潤）並提示實際支付會是這些數字的一個零頭**；**③ ⭐⭐「這是方法學演示，不是定價產品」**（一句話封掉最常見的誤用）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **一條**已建模但不定價**的災因聲明，四層理由齊全**：**其 README 有一節標題逐字為** **「## Coastal erosion: **modelled, not priced**」**，**正文逐字為** **「The model carries one further peril — **coastal erosion**, from the EA’s **NCERM National 2024** frontages — and it is **deliberately kept out of `premium`**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處理由層層給出**：**① 為何排除**：**「Gradual coastal erosion is **not covered by standard UK household policies**. Putting it in the technical premium would **price a loss no policy pays**, and would **quietly wreck the rating**: erosion is a **total loss of the property rather than a repair**, so where it bites it dwarfs everything else.」**（**條款不覆蓋／為一個無人賠付的損失定價／全損會壓倒其餘一切**）；**② 為何仍留在 vine 裡**：**「Erosion is storm-driven… **So it belongs in the dependence structure even though it is not priced.**」**並給出具體參數（第五維進入 C-vine，與天氣一個 Gumbel 對（θ_we），且在給定天氣下與洪水的 tree-2 高斯對是三者中**最強**的（ρ_FE|W = 0.35））**；**③ 建的是什麼並自陳兩條假設**：**「**Two assumptions worth stating plainly:** households are taken as spread **uniformly** across the district（**coastal populations actually cluster towards the shore, so this if anything UNDERSTATES it**），and the **SMP** scenario is used…The unmanaged **NFI** case is carried alongside for contrast」**（**⭐「這條假設若有偏差是**低估**」指出了自己假設的**方向****）；**④ 為何不出現在好年壞年對照頁**：**「Erosion is **chronic, not episodic**…**blur precisely the contrast that page exists to show**. **Capital is likewise allocated against insured losses only.**」****⭐⭐⭐ **並給出可核對的結果**：**全國層面採納的方案把 2105 年的土地損失限制在 **250 km²**（無防護為 **435 km²**），並點名具體海濱**（Blackpool FY1、Eastbourne BN21、Bognor PO21/PO22、Crosby L22 在「Hold the Line」方案下從顯著侵蝕變為**恰好為零**），而在沒有海堤的地方，歐洲侵蝕最快的一段海岸如實顯現（**Hornsea HU18 與 Withernsea HU19 居首，其次 Southwold IP18**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「沒有這個功能」本身當成結論**：**其 README 有一節標題逐字為** **「## Does the copula actually matter?」**，**先給出測量方式與規模**（`scripts/dependence_check.py`，60 個區 × 40 萬年），**再給出一個分成兩半的答案**：**① 對單棟住宅**：聯合建模使「多災因年份」的概率變為 **94 倍**（0.11% 對獨立性下的 0.0012%），**但該住宅自身的 99% TVaR 幾乎不動**（**+2.7%，95% 置信區間 −9.0% 至 +12.8%**，即與零無法區分），**並逐字解釋**：**「**The interval straddling zero is the finding**; its point estimate wanders between runs **precisely because it is noise**, which is why **nothing is priced off it**.」**；**② 對組合**：罕見聯合事件停止互相抵消，**巨災年份的成本比獨立性所隱含的高約 8%**，**並說明「這才是資本被設定的依據，也是 vine 在這裡的原因」**。**隨後逐字給出最鋒利的結論**：**「This is why there is **no per-district "copula uplift" map layer** — at calibrated frequencies it would be **drawing Monte Carlo noise**. **Removing it IS the finding.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「去掉它**就是**結論」**（一個功能的缺席不是遺漏，而是被測量出來的正確決定）；**② ⭐⭐ 它把「置信區間跨零」當作**發現**而不是失敗**；**③ ⭐⭐「點估計在多次運行之間游走，**正因為它是噪聲**，所以沒有任何東西按它定價」**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **測試是結構性質測試，且每條都指向模型所依賴的機制**：**「Property tests for the machinery the model rests on: **Gumbel h-function inversion round-trips to 1e-8**, sampled margins pass **Kolmogorov–Smirnov** against U(0,1), **every vine pair recovers its target Kendall’s tau**, **Gumbel shows upper-tail dependence where the tau-matched Gaussian does not**, the 5-dim vine-implied correlation matrix **stays positive definite across the whole theta range**, and **the severity distributions reproduce the published ABI means**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 六條斷言全部是結構性的**（往返精度、分布擬合、τ 復現、上尾相依的有無、相關矩陣正定、均值復現已發表值）——**⭐ 即**它測的不是跑得通，而是數學性質是否成立****；**② ⭐⭐「Gumbel 在上尾有相依，而 τ 匹配的高斯沒有」**（測的是 copula 家族的**定性特徵**）；**③ 正定性在**整個 θ 範圍上**都被要求**；**④ ⭐⭐ 嚴重度分布必須復現已發表的 ABI 均值**（又一次「標準答案來自外部」）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **新災因有各自的護欄，其中一條規定了某個東西不得被觸碰**：**「erosion’s frequency **must annualise over the horizon** and **must NOT be touched by the ABI frequency scaling**（**it has no published payout to calibrate against**）」**；**「the flood–erosion tree-2 pair **must come out as the strongest of the three**」**；**「the depth multiplier must leave the **exposure-weighted national mean at exactly 1.0** while still ranking a deep district above a shallow one」**；**「plus a **fallback test proving the model still runs when the depth product is absent, as it is outside England**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「它沒有可據以校準的已發表賠付，**因此不得被 ABI 頻率縮放觸碰**」**（**缺一條外部參照被明確轉成一條禁止性護欄**）；**② ⭐⭐ 深度乘數必須使按暴露加權的全國均值為**恰好 1.0**、同時仍能把深區排在淺區之上**（**歸一化與排序兩條要求同時被測**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 一條兜底測試**：**證明深度數據缺失時模型仍能運行**（**逐字理由「as it is outside England」**）——**⭐ 即**它測的是**數據缺口下的行為****。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **「站點是被檢查過的，不是被假設的」**：**「## Design & accessibility** The site is **checked, not assumed**:」**，**逐字含** **「**WCAG 2.1 AA contrast** verified **programmatically** on all four pages in **light and dark mode**（**measured from computed styles, not from the palette on paper**）. **`--ink-muted` and link colours were darkened after that audit failed 23 elements**; chart series colours are unchanged, since **those are marks not text**.」** 與 **「**Mobile verified at 375x812** on the live site: **no page-level horizontal overflow anywhere**, wide tables and charts scroll inside their own containers, nav fits without sideways scrolling, **tap targets >=24px**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「從計算樣式量測，而不是從紙上的調色板」**；**② ⭐⭐⭐「`--ink-muted` 與鏈接顏色是在那次審計**判掉 23 個元素之後**才調深的」**——**⭐ 這是本站所見**對「審計失敗並因此改了東西」寫得最具體的一處****；**③ ⭐⭐「圖表系列顏色不變，因為那些是**標記**而不是文字」**（把兩類的對比度要求分開處理）；**④ 移動端在**真實站點上 375×812 驗證**並列出四項具體檢查**。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **一條數據完整性做法值得單獨記**：**「`data/abi_annual.csv` is **HAND-TRANSCRIBED** from the ABI’s full-year property releases（one every February）— **there is no feed and the site bot-blocks scrapers**. When the next one lands, **add its rows with the source URL and a published/derived flag**, **DO NOT overwrite prior years**（**the ABI restates them, and both readings are kept side by side**）」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「ABI 會重述往年數據，所以兩種讀法並排保留」**——**⭐ 這正是本站第 340 輪主題（把一個數在什麼口徑下產生寫下來）的一種工程實現：**不覆蓋歷史，而是保留**當時發表的**與**後來重述的**兩版****；**② ⭐⭐ 每行必須帶**來源 URL 與「已發表／已派生」標誌****；**③ 它說明了為什麼必須手工轉錄**（**沒有數據饋送，且該站點封鎖抓取**）；**④ 取數細節寫到了**配額層**（**逐字「Open-Meteo free tier has a daily quota - if it 429s, rerun next day」**）與備份路徑**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **其倉庫結構支持上述主張**（**實測 182 個文件**）：**⭐ `scripts/` 下的腳本命名本身就是一套**校驗清單****——**實測含 `analytic_el_check.py`（解析式期望損失核對）、`check_simulate_identical.py`（檢驗模擬是否逐次一致）、`check_abi_subsidence.py`、`check_calib.py`、`check_geojson.py`、`check_years.py`、`compare_rebuild.py`、`compare_gust_surfaces.py`、`compare_haduk_resolutions.py`、`anchor_budget.py`、`backtest_coverage.py` 等**；**⭐ 且 `.github/workflows/` 下實測有 **16 條工作流**——含 `tests.yml`、`pages.yml`、`rebuild.yml`、**`seed-sweep.yml`**（種子掃查）、**`freeze-share.yml`**、`platform-probe.yml`、`haduk-1km*.yml` 四條、`sector-model.yml`、`smd-curve.yml`、`sub-level.yml`、`scotland-theft.yml` 與 `scotland-theft-geography.yml`**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ `analytic_el_check.py` 與 `seed-sweep.yml` 兩處最值得注意**（前者暗示存在一個與模擬並行的解析式核對，後者是跨隨機種子的掃查；**⭐ 與第 341 輪 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 的「不共享代碼的獨立實現」同族**）；**② 校驗腳本被單獨命名且為數眾多**（**⭐ 即**「檢查」在這個倉庫裡是一等公民**）；**③ ⚠️ 本詞條只依據文件名**，**未讀任何腳本內容**。**⑩ ⚠️⚠️ **一處需如實指出的**描述與文檔不一致****：**其 GitHub 倉庫描述逐字為** **「**Four-peril** UK home insurance risk model（**subsidence, weather, flood, groundwater**）joined by a vine copula, built entirely on open data.」**，**而其 README 與徽章都說**八個災因**（**徽章逐字 `Perils: 8 insured + 1`**）**⭐⭐ **三處**：**① 本詞條**不主張**這是錯誤**（描述可能是較早寫的）；**② ⭐⭐ 但指出：**若讀者只看倉庫描述，會以為這是一個**四災因**模型****（**⭐ 即**倉庫描述這一處**少於** README 所述**）；**③ 已核實的只是兩處文本各自寫了什麼**。**⑪ ⭐ 可與 [[openquake-engine]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[opendrr-riskprofiler]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]]、[[catrisk-sim]]、[[floodwise]]、[[insurance-calibration]]、[[credibility-gated-xai]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **許可實測為 **NOASSERTION****——**⭐ 本詞條**已查明其成因**：**README 頂部並列兩枚徽章（`code` → MIT、`data` → OGL v3），且 `LICENSE` 文件存在，故 GitHub 無法歸入單一 SPDX 標識****——**⭐ 即**這是**分部分聲明許可**所導致的「無法歸類」，而不是未聲明**；**⚠️ 但**未讀 `LICENSE` 與 `DATA_SOURCES.md` 的內容**，**故**不轉述**具體條款**；**⚠️ 使用、改寫或再分發其代碼或數據前，應分別讀 `LICENSE` 與 `DATA_SOURCES.md`**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **未運行該模型的任何一步****——**未克隆、未創建虛擬環境、未安裝依賴、未運行 `pytest`、未運行任何 `scripts/` 下腳本、未運行任何工作流、未打開其線上站點**；**故**不主張**其 2,736 個區、八災因的定價、copula 的相依測量（94 倍／+2.7%／約 8%）、海岸侵蝕的情景結果（250 km² 對 435 km²）、或測試所斷言的性質**已被複現**——**⭐ 本詞條核實到的是**README 的逐字聲明、其點名的文件確實存在、以及其倉庫結構****。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未讀任何腳本、任何 `docs/` 頁面、`LIMITATIONS.md`、`HANDOFF.md`、`DATA_SOURCES.md` 或 `LICENSE` 的內容****——**⭐ 即**未核對**：六條性質測試是否確實如此實現（**⚠️ 這是本條最需要後續核實的一處**）；**`scripts/analytic_el_check.py` 是否確實是一個與模擬並行的解析式核對**；**`DATA_SOURCES.md` 是否確實含 29 個數據集及其許可**（**⚠️ 這一條對讀者最重要**）；**兩條自陳假設是否如其所述**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其 `LICENSE` 與 `DATA_SOURCES.md` 之間是否有重疊或衝突**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其八災因是否確實只覆蓋它列出的那八種**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其已發表 ABI 數值的轉錄是否正確**（**⭐ 其 README 已逐字說明該文件是手工轉錄且該站點封鎖抓取**；**⚠️ 未訪問 ABI 原始發布**）。**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主張**其技術保費可用於任何定價、承保或資本決策**（**⚠️ 其 README 自己已逐字寫明**那是八災因技術保費、不是家財險保費、實際支付會是這些數字的一個零頭、**「a methodology demonstration, not a rating product」****）。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主張**其空間粒度足以支持**單獨一個郵編區**的決策**。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主張**其氣候情景結果具有**預測**性質**。**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其作者身份、資歷或該項目是否被任何保險公司使用**。**⑪ ⭐ **★0、fork 0**，**不主張其成熟度**；**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ 其 README 達 **62,476 位元組**，倉庫有 **182 個文件**、一份限制文檔、一份交接文檔、一份 29 數據集來源登記表、約 20 個校驗腳本與 **16 條 CI 工作流****——**⭐ 即**關注度為零而工程與文檔密度極高**的一種形態****。**⑫ ⚠️ **創建在解凍窗口之前（2026-07-31）****——**如實記錄該日期，入選依據是**推送落在窗口之內（2026-09-09）**；**⚠️ 另指出：**該倉庫**連續兩輪（341、342）被延後**，**本輪終於讀取其 README 並收錄**，**故**此前兩輪日誌中的「待評」標記**至此解除****。**⑬ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/SMcode-source/uk-home-insurance-risk-map` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 62,476 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對；**全部 195 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對（182 文件、13 目錄）；**未克隆、未創建虛擬環境、未安裝依賴、未運行任何測試或腳本或工作流、未打開其線上站點、未讀任何腳本或文檔內容（除 README 的上述各節）、未打開任何圖**。
entries.body_en:
**uk-home-insurance-risk-map** (repository `SMcode-source/uk-home-insurance-risk-map`) **is a geospatial risk map for UK home insurance**: an interactive choropleth of **2,736 postcode districts** rating **eight home-insurance perils**, with **the four weather-driven perils joined by a C-vine copula and the attritional four priced as independent legs**, banded into ten rating groups, with a companion page decomposing good years against bad years. **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **NOASSERTION** (⚠️ **whose cause is established at ① — a `LICENSE` file is present, but the repository declares two licences at once, so GitHub cannot map it to a single SPDX identifier**), primary language Python, a **141,750 KB** repository, created 2026-07-31, last pushed 2026-09-09, topics `actuarial`, `copula`, `flood-risk`, `geospatial`, `insurance`, `leaflet`, `open-data`, `python`, `risk-modelling` and `uk`** (all GitHub API measurements; creation predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it); **the README measures 62,476 bytes**; **the repository measures 195 entries (182 files, 13 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **a system should be declared part by part, with each part’s applicable rules stated**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the one that declares licensing most completely part by part**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① Two badges separate the code licence from the data licence, and the data side hangs off a registry of 29 datasets** — **the most notable point in this entry and the most complete positive resolution this session has seen of the licence-scope problem**: **its top badges measure verbatim as "Licence: MIT", with link text reading code-MIT and pointing at the licence file, and "Data: OGL v3", with link text reading data-OGL v3 and pointing at the data-sources document**, **alongside badges for the live site, tests pointing at a workflow file, Python 3.13, `Districts: 2,736` and `Perils: 8 insured + 1`**; **and the scope of that registry is stated verbatim**: every hazard input is open data fetched by the scripts here, with the data-sources document covering **all 29 datasets with their endpoints, licences, access quirks and the dead ends worth avoiding** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **code MIT and data OGL v3 sit as two parallel badges, which resolves exactly the observation this session recorded in two entries in round 342 — that a repository’s licence and the rights status of third-party data inside it are two different things — and here it is resolved not by a disclaimer but by hanging both licences at the door, with the data-side document as their basis**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the dataset count is exact (29) and the columns include access quirks and, remarkably, a list of dead ends worth avoiding, the first explicit negative list this session has seen, since it says not only where data is but which routes do not work**; ⭐⭐ **the NOASSERTION licence reading is explained: declaring two licences makes single-identifier classification impossible, so the failure to classify is a consequence of how it declares rather than of not declaring**; **and the root measurably holds four named documents for data sources, licence, limitations and handoff, so limitations and handover each have their own file**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It also carries a scope warning at the top that denies the use of its own numbers** — verbatim: **"These are eight-peril technical premiums, not home insurance premiums. A real policy also carries expenses, commission and profit. Expect these figures to be a fraction of what you actually pay. This is a methodology demonstration, not a rating product."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **it renames its own output as a narrower thing, eight-peril technical premiums rather than home insurance premiums**; **it names the three things a real policy also carries (expenses, commission and profit) and tells the reader that what they actually pay will be a fraction of these figures**; **and ⭐⭐ "a methodology demonstration, not a rating product" closes off the most common misuse in one line**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ A peril is declared modelled but deliberately not priced, with a four-part reason** — **the sharpest instance of this round’s theme**: **its section heading reads verbatim "Coastal erosion: modelled, not priced"**, and the body states verbatim that the model carries one further peril, coastal erosion, from the Environment Agency’s national frontages, and that it is deliberately kept out of the premium ⭐⭐⭐ **Four reasons are given in layers**: **why it is excluded** — gradual coastal erosion is not covered by standard UK household policies, including it would price a loss no policy pays, and it would quietly wreck the rating because erosion is a total loss of the property rather than a repair, so where it bites it dwarfs everything else (**three distinct reasons: the cover does not include it, it would price an unpayable loss, and a total loss would swamp the rest**); **why it is nevertheless kept in the vine** — erosion is storm-driven, retreating in a handful of surge events rather than on calm days, so it belongs in the dependence structure even though it is not priced, **with parameters given** (it enters the C-vine as a fifth dimension with a Gumbel pair to weather and, given weather, the strongest of the tree-2 Gaussian pairs to flood); **what is modelled instead, with two assumptions stated plainly** — a property inside the strip projected to be lost by the 2105 epoch is lost within that horizon, with households taken as spread uniformly across the district, **which the README notes if anything understates the exposure since coastal populations cluster towards the shore**, and the scenario of defences maintained as currently planned, with the unmanaged case carried alongside for contrast; **and why it is absent from the good-years-versus-bad-years view** — erosion is chronic rather than episodic, so including it would add a near-constant charge to every simulated year and blur precisely the contrast that page exists to show, and capital is likewise allocated against insured losses only ⭐⭐⭐ **with checkable results**: nationally the adopted plans hold 2105 land loss to **250 square kilometres against 435 undefended**, and named seafronts go from substantial unmanaged erosion to **exactly zero** under hold-the-line plans, while where defences are absent the fastest-eroding coast in Europe shows up correctly at the top of the table. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ It treats the absence of a feature as itself the finding** — another appearance of this round’s theme at the level of a passage: **a section headed verbatim "Does the copula actually matter?"** first gives the measurement and its scale (a dedicated script, 60 districts times 400,000 years) and then a two-part answer: **for one home**, modelling the perils jointly makes a multi-peril year **94 times more likely** (0.11 percent against 0.0012 percent under independence) **but that home’s own 99 percent tail value at risk barely moves — plus 2.7 percent with a 95 percent interval from minus 9.0 to plus 12.8 percent, indistinguishable from zero** — with the interval straddling zero named verbatim as the finding and its wandering point estimate explained as being noise, which is why nothing is priced off it; **and for the portfolio**, rare joint events stop cancelling and catastrophic years cost about **8 percent more** than independence implies, which is the number capital is set against and the reason the vine is there; **followed by the sharpest conclusion**: this is why there is no per-district copula-uplift map layer, since at calibrated frequencies it would be drawing Monte Carlo noise, **and removing it is the finding** ⭐⭐⭐ **so the absence of a feature is not an omission but a measured decision**. **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ The tests are structural property tests, each tied to the machinery the model rests on** — verbatim: Gumbel h-function inversion round-trips to 1e-8; sampled margins pass a Kolmogorov-Smirnov test against a uniform; **every vine pair recovers its target Kendall tau**; **Gumbel shows upper-tail dependence where the tau-matched Gaussian does not**; the five-dimensional vine-implied correlation matrix stays positive definite across the whole parameter range; and the severity distributions reproduce the published ABI means ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **all six assertions are structural — round-trip precision, distributional fit, tau recovery, the presence or absence of upper-tail dependence, positive definiteness and reproduction of published means — so what is tested is whether the mathematical properties hold rather than whether the code runs**; ⭐⭐ **one assertion tests a qualitative family property, that Gumbel shows upper-tail dependence where the tau-matched Gaussian does not**; **positive definiteness is required across the entire parameter range rather than at sampled points**; **and ⭐⭐ the severity distributions must reproduce published external means, another appearance of the reference value coming from outside**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ The newer perils have their own guards, one of which forbids something from being touched** — verbatim: erosion’s frequency must annualise over the horizon and **must not be touched by the ABI frequency scaling, because it has no published payout to calibrate against**; the flood-erosion tree-2 pair must come out as the strongest of the three; the depth multiplier must leave the exposure-weighted national mean at exactly 1.0 while still ranking a deep district above a shallow one; **plus a fallback test proving the model still runs when the depth product is absent, as it is outside England** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the absence of an external reference is converted into a prohibitive guard — no published payout to calibrate against, therefore the scaling must not touch it**; ⭐⭐ **normalisation and ordering are both tested at once, since the multiplier must leave the national mean at exactly one while still ranking districts**; **and ⭐⭐⭐ a fallback test verifies behaviour under a data gap rather than only with complete data, with the reason given that the depth product is absent outside England**. **⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ The site is checked rather than assumed** — worth quoting in full: the section is headed "Design & accessibility" and opens verbatim with "The site is checked, not assumed", stating that WCAG 2.1 AA contrast was verified **programmatically on all four pages in light and dark mode, measured from computed styles rather than from the palette on paper**, and that two colour variables were **darkened after that audit failed 23 elements**, while chart series colours were left unchanged **since those are marks not text**; and that mobile was **verified at 375 by 812 on the live site** with no page-level horizontal overflow, wide tables and charts scrolling inside their own containers, and tap targets of at least 24 pixels ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **measuring from computed styles rather than the palette on paper means it measured the real runtime values**; ⭐⭐⭐ **two variables were darkened after that audit failed 23 elements — the most concrete account this site has collected of an audit failing and something changing as a result, since it gives the number of failures and attributes the change to them**; ⭐⭐ **chart series colours were left alone because those are marks rather than text, separating the contrast requirements of two kinds of thing**; **and the mobile checks are four named assertions made against the live site**. **⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ One data-integrity practice deserves separate recording: the ABI figures are hand-transcribed and prior years must not be overwritten** — verbatim, the annual ABI file is hand-transcribed from the association’s full-year property releases because **there is no feed and the site blocks scrapers**, and when the next release lands one must **add its rows with the source URL and a published-or-derived flag, and not overwrite prior years, because the ABI restates them and both readings are kept side by side** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **keeping both the originally published and the later restated readings side by side because the source restates them is an engineering implementation of this site’s round-340 theme of recording the basis on which a number was produced: rather than overwriting history it preserves both versions**; ⭐⭐ **every row must carry a source URL and a published-or-derived flag**; **the reason hand transcription is necessary is given (no feed, and the site blocks scraping)**; **and the fetch notes reach down to quota level, warning that a free tier has a daily quota and that a rate-limited response means rerunning the next day, with a fallback source if no academic account is available**. **⑨ ⭐⭐ The repository structure supports these claims** (**182 files measured**): ⭐ **the script names under `scripts/` are themselves a checklist**, measurably including an analytic expected-loss check, a check that simulation is identical across runs, and named checks for subsidence, calibration, geojson and years, plus comparison scripts for rebuilds, gust surfaces and resolution sets, and scripts for anchoring and coverage backtesting; ⭐ **and `.github/workflows/` measurably holds 16 workflows**, including tests, pages, rebuild, **a seed sweep**, **a freeze-and-share workflow**, a platform probe, four resolution-specific workflows, a sector model, a curve workflow, a sub-level workflow and two Scotland-theft workflows ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the analytic expected-loss check and the seed sweep are the two most notable, the former implying an analytical cross-check running alongside the simulation and the latter a sweep across random seeds — the same family as round 341’s independent implementation sharing no code**; **check scripts are individually named and numerous, so checking is a first-class citizen here**; **and ⚠️ this entry relies on filenames only, having read no script contents, so no implementation is restated and no claim is made that these checks do what their names suggest**. **⑩ ⚠️⚠️ One inconsistency between the description and the documentation must be stated** — the repository description reads verbatim as a **four-peril** UK home insurance risk model naming subsidence, weather, flood and groundwater joined by a vine copula, **while the README and the badge both say eight perils**, the badge reading verbatim `Perils: 8 insured + 1` and the README listing eight and assigning the four weather-driven ones to the copula ⭐⭐ **Three things**: **no claim is made that this is an error, since the description may be older or may refer only to the copula-joined subset**; ⭐⭐ **but a reader seeing only the repository description would take it for a four-peril model, so this is a place where the description says less than the README**; **and all that was verified is what each text says**. **⑪ ⭐ Readable with** [[openquake-engine]], [[canada-seismic-risk-model]], [[opendrr-riskprofiler]], [[gem-global-exposure-model]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]], [[catrisk-sim]], [[floodwise]], [[insurance-calibration]], [[credibility-gated-xai]], [[verified-reserving]], [[insurance-data-tools]] and [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as NOASSERTION** — ⭐ **whose cause this entry established: two badges sit in parallel at the top of the README, code under MIT and data under OGL v3, and a licence file exists, so GitHub cannot map the repository to a single SPDX identifier — a failure to classify caused by declaring licensing part by part rather than by not declaring it**; **⚠️ but neither the licence file nor the data-sources document was read, so no terms are restated and no claim is made that the licence status of all 29 datasets has been verified**; **⚠️ read both separately before using, modifying or redistributing its code or its data**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No step of the model was run** — **nothing was cloned, no virtual environment was created, no dependency was installed, `pytest` was not run, no script under `scripts/` was run, no workflow was run and the live site was not opened**; **so its 2,736 districts, its eight-peril pricing, its copula dependence measurements (the 94-fold figure, the plus 2.7 percent, the roughly 8 percent), its coastal-erosion scenario results (250 against 435 square kilometres) and the properties its tests assert are not claimed to have been reproduced** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims, that every file it names exists, and its repository structure including the four root documents, some twenty check scripts and sixteen workflows**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No script, no page under `docs/`, no limitations or handoff document, no data-sources document and no licence file was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: whether the six property tests are implemented as described, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry, since only the README’s account of them was read; whether the analytic expected-loss script really is an analytical cross-check running alongside the simulation; whether the data-sources document really covers 29 datasets with their licences, which matters most to a reader because it is the basis of the data-side licence claim; and whether the two stated assumptions are as described**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ Whether the licence file and the data-sources document overlap or conflict was not verified**, **for instance which of the two applies to derived data inside the repository**. **⑤ ⚠️ Whether the model really covers only those eight perils was not verified**. **⑥ ⚠️ Whether its transcription of published ABI figures is correct was not verified** (⭐ **the README states verbatim that the file is hand-transcribed and that the site blocks scrapers, and ⚠️ no ABI release was consulted, so the transcription cannot be judged**). **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its technical premiums are usable for any pricing, underwriting or capital decision** (⚠️ **its own README states verbatim that these are eight-peril technical premiums rather than home insurance premiums, that a real policy carries more, that actual payments will be a fraction of these numbers, and that this is a methodology demonstration rather than a rating product**). **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its spatial resolution supports a decision about a single postcode district**. **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its climate scenarios are predictive rather than scenario comparisons**. **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ Its author’s identity, background and whether any insurer uses it were not verified**. **⑪ ⭐ At ★0 with 0 forks**, **attention is zero**, **so no maturity is claimed**; entries.title: 一个「嵌入式宠物险」客户端 SDK：仓库里**只有桥接层**——承保与保单逻辑全在托管的远端流程里，连集成文档也不在仓库内；而同一产品还有 Android 与 Flutter 三个平台封装
entries.title_en: A client SDK for embedded pet insurance whose repository holds only the bridge layer, with underwriting and policy logic living in a hosted remote flow and even the integration guide kept off-repo, while the same product ships three platform wrappers
entries.title_hk: 一個「嵌入式寵物險」客戶端 SDK：倉庫裡**只有橋接層**——承保與保單邏輯全在託管的遠端流程裡，連集成文檔也不在倉庫內；而同一產品還有 Android 與 Flutter 三個平台封裝
entries.summary: 一份**内嵌式宠物险**的 iOS 客户端 SDK（Swift Package）：**把托管的保险流程嵌进 `WKWebView`**，并实现一套原生桥接（`GuavasureBridge`）以支持**原生 Razorpay 结账、文件选择、相机拍摄与合作伙伴鉴权**；**其最值得记的一处是「你拿到的到底是什么」这个边界被文件清单本身说清了**——**实测其源码目录只有十几个文件，全部属于「配置 ＋ 呈现 ＋ 桥接 ＋ 支付 ＋ 安全策略」五类**（`GuavaSureEmbedConfig`、`GuavaSureEmbedViewController`、`GuavaSureUrlBuilder`、三文件组成的 `Bridge/`、`Internal/` 下两个传输辅助、`Payment/PaymentLauncher`、`Security/Policies`），**而没有任何承保、定价、产品或保单逻辑**；**且逐字声明所嵌的是**「the **hosted** GuavaSure insurance flow」**（**托管的流程**）**，**其**完整的集成指南也不在仓库里**（**指向 `partners.guavasure.com` 上的页面**）**；**另有三处可核实事实**：**① 桥接协议在**三个平台**上共用**（**逐字「Same bridge protocol as the Android SDK and `guavasure_flutter`（pub.dev）」**，**故本词条**只收其一**，**因 iOS 与 Android 两个仓库是**同一产品按平台拆分**的近重复**）；**② 它用 **GPL-3.0** 许可发布一个**供合作方嵌入**的客户端 SDK****（**⚠️ 本词条只如实记录这一许可选择及其**可能的**含义，**不作法律结论**）；**③ 其中一条特性写的是一个**具体的工程取舍****：**「No embed reload on Safari return（**embed polls in background**）」**
entries.summary_hk: 一份**內嵌式寵物險**的 iOS 客戶端 SDK（Swift Package）：**把託管的保險流程嵌進 `WKWebView`**，並實現一套原生橋接（`GuavasureBridge`）以支持**原生 Razorpay 結賬、文件選擇、相機拍攝與合作夥伴鑑權**；**其最值得記的一處是「你拿到的到底是什麼」這個邊界被文件清單本身說清了**——**實測其源碼目錄只有十幾個文件，全部屬於「配置 ＋ 呈現 ＋ 橋接 ＋ 支付 ＋ 安全策略」五類**（`GuavaSureEmbedConfig`、`GuavaSureEmbedViewController`、`GuavaSureUrlBuilder`、三文件組成的 `Bridge/`、`Internal/` 下兩個傳輸輔助、`Payment/PaymentLauncher`、`Security/Policies`），**而沒有任何承保、定價、產品或保單邏輯**；**且逐字聲明所嵌的是**「the **hosted** GuavaSure insurance flow」**（**託管的流程**）**，**其**完整的集成指南也不在倉庫裡**（**指向 `partners.guavasure.com` 上的頁面**）**；**另有三處可核實事實**：**① 橋接協議在**三個平台**上共用**（**逐字「Same bridge protocol as the Android SDK and `guavasure_flutter`（pub.dev）」**，**故本詞條**只收其一**，**因 iOS 與 Android 兩個倉庫是**同一產品按平台拆分**的近重複**）；**② 它用 **GPL-3.0** 許可發布一個**供合作方嵌入**的客戶端 SDK****（**⚠️ 本詞條只如實記錄這一許可選擇及其**可能的**含義，**不作法律結論**）；**③ 其中一條特性寫的是一個**具體的工程取捨****：**「No embed reload on Safari return（**embed polls in background**）」**
entries.summary_en: An iOS client SDK for embedded pet insurance, distributed as a Swift package, that embeds a hosted insurance flow in a web view and implements a native bridge supporting native Razorpay checkout, file picking, camera capture and partner authentication; **its most notable feature is that what you actually receive is bounded by the file listing itself** — **its source directory measurably holds only about a dozen files, all falling into five categories, configuration, presentation, bridging, payment and security policy, with no underwriting, pricing, product or policy logic anywhere in the repository**; **and it states verbatim that what it embeds is the hosted GuavaSure insurance flow, with the full integration guide kept off-repo at a partner site**; **three further checkable facts**: **the bridge protocol is shared across three platforms** — verbatim, the same bridge protocol as the Android SDK and a Flutter package published elsewhere — **which is why only one of them is collected here, the iOS and Android repositories being near-duplicate siblings of a single product split by platform**; **it releases, under GPL-3.0, a client SDK intended for partners to embed**, a licensing choice recorded here factually with its possible implications and without any legal conclusion; **and one of its listed features records a specific engineering trade-off, that the embed does not reload on returning from Safari because it polls in the background**
entries.body:
**embedded-pet-insurance-sdk**（仓库 `guavasure/guavasure-ios`）**是一份内嵌式宠物险的 iOS 客户端 SDK**（**Swift Package**）：**把托管的保险流程嵌进 `WKWebView`，并实现一套原生桥接**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **GPL-3.0**（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主语言 Swift、仓库体量 45 KB、创建 2026-08-25、最后推送 2026-09-08、无 topics、无 homepage 字段**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内**）；**README 实测 2,767 字节**；**仓库实测共 21 个条目（15 个文件、6 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「按部分声明：许可、能力、交付物与使用者各自适用什么规则」**；**⭐ 它是四条里**把「交付物按部分分」表现得最明显的一条——**不是靠文档说明，而是**文件清单本身**就说明了****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「你拿到的是什么」由文件清单本身界定：仓库里只有桥接与呈现层**——**这是本条最值得记的一处**：**其 README 第一句逐字为** **「Swift Package that **embeds the hosted GuavaSure insurance flow in `WKWebView`** and implements `GuavasureBridge` for **native Razorpay Checkout, file pick, camera capture, and partner auth**.」**；**而 **本词条实测其源码清单逐项为**：**`Sources/GuavaSureSDK/GuavaSureEmbedConfig.swift`**（**配置**）、**`GuavaSureEmbedViewController.swift`**（**承载嵌入流程的视图控制器**）、**`GuavaSureUrlBuilder.swift`**（**URL 构造**）、**`GuavaSureEmbedWarmup.swift`**（**预热**）、**`Sources/GuavaSureSDK/Bridge/{BridgeDispatcher, BridgeInjection, BridgeScriptMessageHandler}.swift`**（**桥接三件**）、**`Sources/GuavaSureSDK/Internal/{ChunkedJsDelivery, JsStringEncoding}.swift`**（**两个传输／编码辅助**）、**`Sources/GuavaSureSDK/Payment/PaymentLauncher.swift`**（**支付启动**）、**`Sources/GuavaSureSDK/Security/Policies.swift`**（**安全策略**），**另有根目录 `Package.swift`、`LICENSE`、`README.md`、`.gitignore`**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **文件清单里**没有任何承保、定价、产品、保单或理赔逻辑****——**⭐ 即**这个 SDK 的全部工作是**把远端流程装进一个视图并把消息来回转**；**本词条认为这是本轮主题在**仓库层面**的体现：**「你拿到的是什么」不需要读文档，**看文件清单就知道****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字用**「hosted」**这个词**（**the **hosted** GuavaSure insurance flow**）**——**⭐ 即**真正的产品在别处运行****；**③ ⭐⭐ **它有一个**独立的 `Security/` 目录与 `Policies.swift`****（**⚠️ 本词条**未读该文件**，**故**不转述**其内容，**也不猜想**它管什么**）**——**⭐ 但本词条指出：**在一个只有桥接层的 SDK 里**单独给出安全策略文件**，**至少说明**嵌入第三方流程这件事**被认为有安全面**；**④ **`Internal/` 下两个辅助中有一个是**分块投递 JS****，**⭐ 即**注入脚本可能较大、需要分块**（**⚠️ 这是本词条据文件名的**推断**，**已标明为推断**）**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **集成文档不在仓库里**——**逐字为** **「**Full integration guide:** [partners.guavasure.com - iOS SDK](https://partners.guavasure.com/integration/docs/integrations/ios-sdk)」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **README 只有 2,767 字节，而它把**文档之所在**指向站外**——**⭐ 即**这个仓库不是文档的权威位置****；**② ⭐⭐ **该链接是**合作方站点上的路径**（**`partners.`** 前缀）**——**⭐ 即**它预设读者是**合作方**而不是公众****；**③ **本词条**未访问该链接**——**⚠️ 故**不转述**其内容，**亦**不主张**它可访问**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **同一个产品有三个平台封装，故本词条只收其一，并写明理由**——**逐字为** **「**Same bridge protocol as the Android SDK and `guavasure_flutter`（pub.dev）**」**；**而本词条**实测该组织（`guavasure`）下**只有两个仓库**（**`guavasure-ios` 与 `guavasure-android`，同日创建于 2026-08-25、同日推送于 2026-09-08、同为 GPL-3.0**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **本词条**只收了 iOS 这一个**，**依据是本站既定纪律「不取同一作者的**近重复**兄弟仓库」**——**⭐ 而这里 iOS 与 Android 是**同一产品按平台拆分**（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[policyforge-rating-engine]]／[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 那种「**两个不同产品**」的情形不同**）**；**② ⭐⭐ **第三个封装 `guavasure_flutter` 发布在 pub.dev 而不是 GitHub**（**⭐ 即**本站的检索形态会**漏掉它**，**已记入供后续轮次**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「同一个桥接协议」被明确写出**——**⭐ 即**三端的行为被声明为一致****；**④ **本词条**不主张**三个封装的行为确实一致**（**⚠️ 未读任何一端代码**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其许可选择值得如实记录，且它落在本轮主题上**——**该 SDK 以 **GPL-3.0** 发布**（**实测 `LICENSE` 文件存在**），**而它的用途是让**合作方把保险流程嵌进自己的 App****⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **一个供第三方嵌入的客户端 SDK 采用**传染性许可**，是「许用范围」与「交付用途」之间一处需要读者自己读条款的组合**——**⚠️ 本词条**不作任何法律结论、**不主张**这构成问题**（**⭐ 本条只如实记录**许可选择与交付用途两件事实**）；**② ⭐⭐ **它与同一组织的 Android SDK 采用同一许可**（**⭐ 即**这是**有意的产品级选择**，**而不是单个仓库的偶然**）；**③ **本词条**未读 `LICENSE` 内容**——**⚠️ 故**不转述**条款**；**⭐ 提示：**有意在自有 App 中嵌入者**应先读 `LICENSE` 或联系该组织，而不是依据本词条**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其特性清单里有一条是具体的**工程取舍**，而不是功能名**——**逐字为** **「**No embed reload on Safari return**（**embed polls in background**）」**⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **它说明了一个用户可见行为的**实现方式**（**从 Safari 返回时不重载嵌入内容，因为在后台轮询**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「优化了体验」，而是**说清了怎么做到的**；**② **其余特性也逐条具体**：**`GuavasureBridge` 的 WKWebView 通道／经 `razorpay-pod` 的原生 Razorpay 结账／**支付链接的 `SFSafariViewController` 回退**／文件选择、登出、返回三个回调／**可选的合作方代收支付处理器**／经 `GuavaSureEmbedViewController.warmup(config:)` 的**可选预热****——**⭐ 其中**「回退路径」与「代收支付」两项**都属**边界情形**（**一个是支付失败时怎么走，一个是钱由谁收**）。**⑥ ⭐ **其余可核实事实**：**① **支付走 Razorpay**（**经 `razorpay-pod`**）**——**⭐ 本词条指出：**Razorpay 是印度支付网关**，**故**可推断该产品的市场包含印度**（**⭐ 已标明为推断**）；**② **「合作伙伴鉴权」被列为桥接能力之一**（**partner auth**）**——**⭐ 即**身份来自合作方而不是该 SDK 自身**；**③ **仓库**无 topics、无 homepage 字段****（**⭐ 即**元数据很少**，**而 README 里却有合作方文档链接**）**。**⑦ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[insurance-recommendation-engine]]、[[insurance-client-attribution]]、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[uae-health-pricing-model]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ **许可为 **GPL-3.0****——**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**，**⭐ 本词条**未读其内容**，**故**不转述**条款、**不主张**任何关于其义务范围的结论**；**⚠️ 本词条特别提示**：**该仓库的用途是让合作方把保险流程嵌入自有 App**，**故**有意使用者应自行读 `LICENSE` 或联系该组织**（**⚠️ 本词条不提供法律意见**）。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未使用该 SDK 的任何一步****——**未克隆、未解析 Swift Package、未构建任何 iOS 工程、未运行任何代码、未在设备或模拟器上嵌入、未访问其合作方文档链接**；**故**本词条**不主张**该 SDK 可用、其桥接协议确实在三个平台一致、或其支付路径（含回退）确实工作**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的逐字声明与仓库的**实际文件清单**（**⭐ 而后者正是本条的主要依据**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何 Swift 源码的内容****——**⭐ 即**本词条**未核对**：**`Security/Policies.swift` 到底规定什么**；**`ChunkedJsDelivery.swift` 是否确实与分块投递注入脚本有关**（**⚠️ 本词条已把这一点标为**推断**）；**`GuavaSureUrlBuilder` 构造的 URL 指向何处**；**是否存在任何被嵌入流程之外的数据处理**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**「承保与保单逻辑全在远端」这一判断的实现层证据**——**⭐ 本词条的判断依据是**文件清单中不存在相应模块**，**⚠️ 这属于**由缺失推出的结论**，**而**不是一个被读到的实现细节**；**⭐ 本词条据此**不主张**其远端流程的具体内容或归属**（**⚠️ 甚至**不主张**该产品确实在运行**）。**⑤ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其托管流程的数据处理、隐私政策或合规状态**——**⚠️ 因其为**客户端 SDK**，**故**真正的数据处理发生在**该 SDK 之外**，**而本词条**未做任何网络观察****；**⭐ 提示：**有意集成者应就该远端流程的隐私与合规单独确认，**而不是只看这个客户端仓库**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实** `guavasure-android` 与 `guavasure_flutter` 的实际内容**（**⭐ 本词条**只核实了该组织下有两个仓库及其元数据**，**未读 Android 端或 Flutter 包**）。**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其产品（宠物险）的条款、定价或可得性**；**本词条**只记录**其客户端 SDK 的形态**。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其作者、组织的性质或该产品的实际运营状态**——**不主张**它被任何合作方采用或正在运营**。**⑨ ⭐ **★0、fork 0、无 topics**，**关注度为零**，**不主张其成熟度**；**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ 本词条指出：**其仓库**仅 45 KB、15 个文件**，**而**这 15 个文件恰好把「一个嵌入式保险客户端」的**可见部分**说清楚了**——**⭐ 即**体积极小、边界极清楚**的一种形态**。**⑩ ⚠️ **创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内（2026-08-25／2026-09-08）****。**⑪ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****——**该组织创建不足三周，其仓库会变动**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/guavasure/guavasure-ios` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可 GPL-3.0、★数、fork 数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 topics）；**该组织下全部仓库经 `https://api.github.com/users/guavasure/repos` 实测读取（返回 2 个：ios 与 android）**；README 2,767 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**仓库全部 21 个条目**经下载 `codeload.github.com` tarball 后以 `tar tz` 列出核对（**15 文件、6 目录，已列出全部条目**）；**未克隆、未构建、未运行任何代码、未读任何 Swift 源码或 `LICENSE` 内容、未访问其合作方文档链接、未做任何网络观察、未打开任何图**。

entries.body_en:
**embedded-pet-insurance-sdk** (repository `guavasure/guavasure-ios`) **is an iOS client SDK for embedded pet insurance**, distributed as a Swift package, **that embeds a hosted insurance flow in a web view and implements a native bridge**. **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **GPL-3.0** (a `LICENSE` file is measurably present), primary language Swift, a 45 KB repository, created 2026-08-25, last pushed 2026-09-08, no topics and no homepage field** (all GitHub API measurements; **creation and push both fall inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 2,767 bytes**; **the repository measures 21 entries (15 files, 6 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **a system should be declared part by part, with each part’s applicable rules stated**; ⭐ **of the four it is the one where the deliverable’s parts are bounded least by documentation and most by the file listing itself**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① What you receive is bounded by the file listing: the repository holds only the bridge and presentation layers** — **the most notable point in this entry**: **its README opens verbatim by describing a Swift package that embeds the hosted GuavaSure insurance flow in a web view and implements the bridge for native Razorpay checkout, file picking, camera capture and partner authentication**; **and this entry measured its source listing item by item as**: an embed configuration, an embed view controller, a URL builder, a warm-up type, **three bridge files covering dispatch, injection and script-message handling**, **two internal delivery and encoding helpers**, a payment launcher, **and a security policies file**, alongside a package manifest, licence, readme and gitignore at the root ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **there is no underwriting, pricing, product, policy or claims logic anywhere in the listing, so the whole job of this SDK is to put a remote flow inside a view and relay messages to and from it — this round’s theme at the repository level, since what you receive needs no documentation to establish, the file listing alone shows it**; ⭐⭐⭐ **it uses the word hosted verbatim, so the actual product runs elsewhere**; ⭐⭐ **it has a separate security directory with a policies file, and while that file was not read and nothing is said about its contents, the presence of a dedicated security policy file in an SDK that is otherwise all bridge suggests embedding a third-party flow is treated as having a security surface**; **and one of the two internal helpers concerns chunked delivery of JavaScript, so the injected script may be large enough to need chunking** (⚠️ **an inference from the filename, marked as such**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ The integration guide is not in the repository** — the README points its full integration guide at a page on a partner site ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the README is only 2,767 bytes and sends the documentation of record off-site, so this repository is not the authoritative place for the documentation**; ⭐⭐ **the link sits under a partners subdomain, so it presumes a partner reader rather than the public**; **and this entry did not visit that link, so its contents are not restated and no claim is made that it is reachable**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ One product has three platform wrappers, so only one is collected here, with the reason stated** — verbatim, the SDK uses the **same bridge protocol as the Android SDK and a Flutter package published on another registry**; **and this entry measurably found that the organisation holds exactly two repositories, the iOS and Android SDKs, created the same day, pushed the same day and under the same licence** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **only the iOS one is collected, under the site’s standing rule against collecting near-duplicate sibling repositories, since here the iOS and Android repositories are one product split by platform, unlike round 342’s case of two genuinely different products by one author**; ⭐⭐ **the third wrapper lives on another package registry rather than GitHub, so this site’s search shapes would miss it — noted for a later round**; ⭐⭐ **a shared bridge protocol is stated explicitly, so the three platforms are declared consistent in behaviour**; **and no claim is made that they really are consistent, no code having been read on any platform**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its licensing choice deserves recording and lands on this round’s theme** — **it is released under GPL-3.0, and its purpose is for partners to embed the insurance flow in their own apps** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **a copyleft licence on a client SDK intended for third-party embedding is a combination where the permitted scope and the intended delivery use need to be read together by the reader** — ⚠️ **no legal conclusion is drawn and no claim is made that this is a problem; the entry records the licence choice and the delivery purpose as two facts**; ⭐⭐ **the same licence is used on the organisation’s Android SDK, so this is a deliberate product-level choice rather than an accident of one repository**; **and the licence file was not read, so its terms are not restated** — ⭐ **anyone intending to embed it should read the licence or contact the organisation rather than rely on this entry**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ One of its listed features records a specific engineering trade-off rather than a feature name** — verbatim, there is **no embed reload on returning from Safari because the embed polls in the background** ⭐⭐ **Two things**: ⭐⭐ **it explains how a user-visible behaviour is achieved rather than merely claiming an improved experience**; **and the remaining features are equally specific**: a web-view bridge channel, native checkout through a payment pod, **a Safari view controller fallback for payment links**, file-pick, logout and go-back callbacks, **an optional partner-collected payment handler**, and optional warm-up — ⭐ **with the fallback path and the partner-collected payment both being edge cases, one about what happens when payment fails and one about who collects the money**. **⑥ ⭐ Other checkable facts**: **payment goes through Razorpay** (⭐ **an Indian payment gateway, from which an inference that the product’s market includes India is drawn and marked as an inference**); **partner authentication is listed as one of the bridge’s capabilities, so identity comes from the partner rather than from the SDK**; **and the repository has no topics and no homepage field, so metadata is sparse even though the README carries a partner documentation link**. **⑦ ⭐ Readable with** [[kong-insurance-api-bundle]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[policy-explainer-ai]], [[insurance-recommendation-engine]], [[insurance-client-attribution]], [[insurance-distributional-glm]] and [[uae-health-pricing-model]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Licence is GPL-3.0** — **a `LICENSE` file is measurably present**; ⭐ **its contents were not read, so its terms are not restated and no conclusion is drawn about the scope of its obligations**; ⚠️ **and since the repository exists for partners to embed the insurance flow in their own apps, anyone intending to use it should read the licence or contact the organisation** (⚠️ **no legal advice is offered**). **② ⚠️⚠️ No part of the SDK was used** — **nothing was cloned, the package was not resolved, no iOS project was built, no code was run, nothing was embedded on a device or simulator, and the partner documentation link was not visited**; **so it is not claimed that the SDK works, that its bridge protocol really is consistent across three platforms, or that its payment paths including the fallback really function** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and the repository’s actual file listing, the latter being this entry’s primary basis**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No Swift source was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: what the security policies file actually specifies; whether the chunked-delivery helper really concerns delivering an injected script in chunks, an inference already marked as such; where the URL builder points; and whether any data handling exists outside the embedded flow**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ The implementation-level evidence for the judgement that underwriting and policy logic live remotely was not verified** — ⭐ **that judgement rests on the absence of corresponding modules from the file listing**, ⚠️ **which is a conclusion drawn from absence rather than an implementation detail that was read**; ⭐ **so no claim is made about the contents or ownership of the remote flow**, ⚠️ **nor even that the product is running**. **⑤ ⚠️⚠️ The data handling, privacy policy and compliance status of its hosted flow were not verified** — ⚠️ **because this is a client SDK, the actual data processing happens outside it, and no network observation was made**; ⭐ **anyone integrating it should confirm the remote flow’s privacy and compliance separately rather than looking only at this client repository**. **⑥ ⚠️ The actual contents of the Android SDK and the Flutter package were not verified** (⭐ **only that the organisation holds two repositories and their metadata**). **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made about the terms, pricing or availability of its pet insurance product**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ The nature of the author and organisation and the product’s actual operating status were not verified** — **no claim is made that any partner uses it or that it is in operation**. **⑨ ⭐ At ★0 with 0 forks and no topics**, **attention is zero**, **so no maturity is claimed**; ⚠️ **but ⭐⭐ the repository is only 45 KB across 15 files, and those 15 files happen to make the visible part of an embedded-insurance client perfectly clear — a very small artifact with very clear boundaries**. **⑩ ⚠️ Its creation and push both fall inside the thaw window (2026-08-25 and 2026-09-08)**. **⑪ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11** — **and the organisation is under three weeks old, so its repositories will change**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/guavasure/guavasure-ios` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence GPL-3.0, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); **every repository under that organisation was read via the users endpoint, which returned two, the iOS and Android SDKs**; the 2,767-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; **all 21 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**15 files, 6 directories, the complete list**); **nothing was cloned, nothing was built, no code was run, no Swift source or licence file was read, the partner documentation link was not visited, no network observation was made, and no image was opened**.

SDK](https://partners.guavasure.com/integration/docs/integrations/ios-sdk)」——三处已写明：①README 只有 2,767 字节而它把文档之所在指向站外（这个仓库不是文档的权威位置）；②该链接是合作方站点上的路径（partners. 前缀，即它预设读者是合作方而不是公众）；③本词条未访问该链接（故不转述其内容，亦不主张它可访问）；⭐⭐⭐同一个产品有三个平台封装，逐字「**Same bridge protocol as the Android SDK and `guavasure_flutter`（pub.dev）**」；而实测该组织（guavasure）下只有两个仓库（guavasure-ios 与 guavasure-android，同日创建於 2026-08-25、同日推送於 2026-09-08、同为 GPL-3.0）——四处已写明：①本词条只收了 iOS 这一个，依据是本站既定纪律「不取同一作者的近重复兄弟仓库」（这里 iOS 与 Android 是**同一产品按平台拆分**，与第 342 轮 policyforge／ratecraft 那种「两个不同产品」的情形不同）；②第三个封装 guavasure_flutter 发布在 pub.dev 而不是 GitHub（即本站的檢索形態會漏掉它，已記入供後續輪次）；③「同一个桥接协议」被明确写出（三端行为被声明为一致）；④本词条不主张三个封装的行为确实一致（未读任何一端代码）；⭐⭐⭐其许可选择值得如实记录：该 SDK 以 GPL-3.0 发布而用途是让合作方把保险流程嵌进自己的 App——三处已写明：①一个供第三方嵌入的客户端 SDK 采用传染性许可，是「许用范围」与「交付用途」之间一处需要读者自己读条款的组合（⚠️不作任何法律结论、不主张这构成问题，只如实记录许可选择与交付用途两件事实）；②它与同一组织的 Android SDK 采用同一许可（即这是有意的产品级选择）；③本词条未读 LICENSE 内容（提示：有意嵌入者应先读 LICENSE 或联系该组织，而不是依据本词条）；⭐⭐特性清单里有一条是具体的工程取舍而不是功能名，逐字「**No embed reload on Safari return**（**embed polls in background**）」——两处已写明：①它说明了一个用户可见行为的实现方式（从 Safari 返回时不重载嵌入内容，因为在后台轮询），即不是「优化了体验」而是说清了怎么做到的；②其余特性也逐条具体（WKWebView 通道／经 razorpay-pod 的原生 Razorpay 结账／支付链接的 SFSafariViewController 回退／文件选择、登出、返回三个回调／可选的合作方代收支付处理器／可选预热）——其中回退路径与代收支付两项都属边界情形（一个关于支付失败时怎么走，一个关于钱由谁收）；⭐其余可核实事实：支付走 Razorpay（Razorpay 是印度支付网关，故可推断该产品的市场包含印度——已标明为推断）；「合作伙伴鉴权」被列为桥接能力之一（身份来自合作方而不是该 SDK 自身）；仓库无 topics、无 homepage 字段（元数据很少而 README 里却有合作方文档链接）；⚠️⚠️未使用该 SDK 任何一步（未克隆、未解析 Swift Package、未构建任何 iOS 工程、未运行任何代码、未在设备或模拟器上嵌入、未访问其合作方文档链接），故不主张该 SDK 可用、其桥接协议确实在三个平台一致、或其支付路径（含回退）确实工作——本词条核实到的是 README 的逐字声明与仓库的实际文件清单（后者是本条的主要依据）；⚠️⚠️未读任何 Swift 源码的内容——即未核对 Security/Policies.swift 到底规定什么、ChunkedJsDelivery.swift 是否确实与分块投递注入脚本有关（⚠️已标为推断）、GuavaSureUrlBuilder 构造的 URL 指向何处、是否存在任何被嵌入流程之外的数据处理；⚠️⚠️未核实「承保与保单逻辑全在远端」这一判断的实现层证据——本词条的判断依据是文件清单中不存在相应模块，⚠️这属于由缺失推出的结论；据此外本词条不主张其远端流程的具体内容或归属（⚠️甚至不主张该产品确实在运行）；⚠️⚠️未核实其托管流程的数据处理、隐私政策或合规状态——因其为客户端 SDK，真正的数据处理发生在该 SDK 之外，而本词条未做任何网络观察（提示：有意集成者应就远端流程的隐私与合规单独确认，而不是只看这个客户端仓库）；⚠️未核实 guavasure-android 与 guavasure_flutter 的实际内容；⭐不主张其产品（宠物险）的条款、定价或可得性；⭐未核实其作者、组织的性质或该产品的实际运营状态，不主张它被任何合作方采用或正在运营；★0、fork 0、无 topics，关注度为零，不主张其成熟度；⚠️但本词条指出其仓库仅 45 KB、15 个文件，而这 15 个文件恰好把「一个嵌入式保险客户端」的可见部分说清楚了——即体积极小、边界极清楚的一种形态；⚠️创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内（2026-08-25／2026-09-08）；⚠️本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见。核实手段补充说明：该组织下全部仓库经 https://api.github.com/users/guavasure/repos 实测读取（返回 2 个）；仓库全部 21 个条目经下载 codeload.github.com tarball 后以 tar tz 列出核对；未克隆、未构建、未运行任何代码、未读任何 Swift 源码或 LICENSE 内容、未访问其合作方文档链接、未做任何网络观察、未打开任何图

entries.title: 开篇一句话划出三条边界：**刻意不提供保险建议或保障推荐**、**AI 只起草可编辑的行政邮件草稿**、**本应用不发送任何邮件**；而那个未实现的计费端点会**明确返回 501**，并说明原因是「产品与价格 ID 以及计费政策未提供」
entries.title_en: Three boundaries in the opening sentence — it deliberately does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations, the AI only drafts editable administrative email copy, and no email is sent by the application — while the unimplemented billing endpoint returns an explicit 501 with the reason that product and price identifiers and billing policy were not supplied
entries.title_hk: 開篇一句話劃出三條邊界：**刻意不提供保險建議或保障推薦**、**AI 只起草可編輯的行政郵件草稿**、**本應用不發送任何郵件**；而那個未實現的計費端點會**明確返回 501**，並說明原因是「產品與價格 ID 以及計費政策未提供」
entries.summary: 一份面向保险经纪人的 **CRM 与续保管理平台**（自称「production-oriented MVP」）：管理**客户记录、保单、续保时间线**与**行政跟进**，**首页线上部署为 Vercel**；**其最值得记的一处是开篇一句里同时划出三条能力边界**——**逐字「It **intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations**. **AI only drafts editable administrative email copy**; **no email is sent by the application**.」**：**① 刻意不给保险建议与保障推荐；② AI 只**起草可编辑的行政邮件草稿**；③ **本应用不发送任何邮件****——**⭐ 即「AI 做什么、不做什么、以及它做的产物由谁发出」被三句分完**；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① 一个声明为未实现的端点**——**逐字「Stripe-ready protected billing endpoint（**returns 501 until products are configured**）」**，**即**未实现的部分**会明确返回「未实现」**，**而不是假装可用或静默缺失**；**② 它逐字说明**为什么**那个东西没做**——**不是「即将推出」，而是**「因为产品／价格 ID 与计费政策**未被提供**」**；**③ 它把「还不能用于真实客户数据」写成一条前置清单**——**逐字「**add rate limiting/audit retention at the platform edge before handling real client data**」**，**即**在接手真实数据之前**还需要补两样东西**；**此外它的测试清单逐项可读**（**会话完整性、未鉴权 API 授权、客户与保单输入校验、续保分桶、跟进状态计算、AI 起草端点的授权**），**续保按**逾期／0–7 天／8–30 天／31 天以上**四桶划分**，**并按环境变量表逐项注明哪些是必需、哪些是可选**（含**AI 密钥「保存在服务端、绝不暴露给浏览器」**）
entries.summary_hk: 一份面向保險經紀人的 **CRM 與續保管理平台**（自稱「production-oriented MVP」）：管理**客戶記錄、保單、續保時間線與行政跟進**，**首頁部署在 Vercel**；**其最值得記的一處是開篇一句裡同時劃出三條能力邊界**——**逐字「It **intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations**. **AI only drafts editable administrative email copy**; **no email is sent by the application**.」**：**① 刻意不給保險建議與保障推薦；② AI 只**起草可編輯的行政郵件草稿**；③ **本應用不發送任何郵件****——**⭐ 即「AI 做什麼、不做什麼、以及它做的產物由誰發出」被三句分完**；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① 一個聲明為未實現的端點**——**逐字「Stripe-ready protected billing endpoint（**returns 501 until products are configured**）」**，**即**未實現的部分會明確返回「未實現」**，**而不是假裝可用或靜默缺失**；**② 它逐字說明**為什麼**那個東西沒做**——**不是「即將推出」，而是**「因為產品／價格 ID 與計費政策未提供」**；**③ 它把「還不能用於真實客戶數據」寫成一條前置清單**——**逐字「**add rate limiting/audit retention at the platform edge before handling real client data**」**，**即**在接手真實數據之前還需要補兩樣東西**；**此外它的測試清單逐項可讀**（**會話完整性、未鑑權 API 授權、客戶與保單輸入校驗、續保分桶、跟進狀態計算、AI 起草端點的授權**），**續保按**逾期／0–7 天／8–30 天／31 天以上**四桶劃分**，**並按環境變量表逐項註明哪些是必需、哪些是可選**（含**AI 密鑰「保存在服務端、絕不暴露給瀏覽器」**）
entries.summary_en: A CRM and renewal-management platform for insurance brokers, self-described as a production-oriented MVP, covering client records, policies, renewal timelines and administrative follow-ups, deployed with Vercel and linked from its repository; **its most notable feature is that the opening sentence draws three capability boundaries at once** — verbatim: it **intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations**; **the AI only drafts editable administrative email copy**; and **no email is sent by the application** — so what the AI does, what it does not do, and who sends its output are all settled in three clauses; **three further points follow the same discipline**: **first, an endpoint declared unimplemented** — a billing endpoint is described as returning 501 until products are configured, so the unfinished part answers plainly that it is not implemented rather than appearing to work or silently vanishing; **second, the reason it was not built is stated verbatim** — not that it is coming soon, but that product and price identifiers and billing policy were not supplied; **and third, what is still missing before real data may be handled is given as a checklist**, requiring rate limiting and audit retention at the platform edge before handling real client data; **additionally its test list is itemised** (session integrity, unauthenticated API authorization, client and policy input validation, renewal categorisation, follow-up status calculation, and authorization on the AI-draft endpoint), renewals are bucketed as overdue, zero to seven days, eight to thirty days and thirty-one days or more, and an environment-variable table marks each entry required or optional, including that the AI key is kept server-side and never exposed to the browser
entries.body:
**brokerflow-renewal-crm**（仓库 `Astri299/brokerflow`，工具名 BrokerFlow）**是一份面向保险经纪人的 CRM 与续保管理平台**：**管理客户记录、保单、续保时间线与行政跟进**，**自称** **「a **production-oriented MVP** for insurance brokers」**，**其首页部署在 Vercel**（**实测 `homepage` 字段为 `https://brokerflow-nine.vercel.app`**）。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **NONE**（**实测该仓库无任何许可文件**）、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 108 KB、**创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-08（同日）**、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内**）；**README 实测 2,619 字节**；**仓库实测共 98 个条目（63 个文件、35 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「按部分声明：许可、能力、交付物与使用者各自适用什么规则」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把「能力按部分分」写得最干净的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 开篇一句里同时划出三条边界，且三条各管一件事**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处**：**逐字为**：**「BrokerFlow is a **production-oriented MVP** for insurance brokers to manage client records, policies, renewal timelines, and administrative follow-ups. **It intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations. AI only drafts editable administrative email copy; no email is sent by the application.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **第一条否掉的是**这门生意的核心产出**（**保险建议与保障推荐**）**——**⭐ 即**一个经纪人的工具**明确说自己不给建议****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **第二条把 AI 的作用**收窄到两个限定词**：「**只**起草」「**可编辑的**草稿」**——**⭐ 即**它既不自动决定内容，也不把草稿当成终稿****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **第三条回答了一个常被跳过的问题：**这个产物由谁发出****（**逐字「no email is sent by the application」，**本应用不发送任何邮件**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为三条里这一条最实在：**前两条说的是「不做什么」，这一条说的是**「做了也不会自己发出去」****；**④ **三句合起来**把「AI 做什么／不做什么／它的产物由谁发出」**分完了**，**且**全部写在第一段****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **一个**声明为未实现的端点**，而它**明确返回「未实现」****——**逐字为**：**「**Stripe-ready protected billing endpoint（returns 501 until products are configured）**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「未实现」被做成了**一个可观察的响应**（**HTTP 501**）**——**⭐ 即**调用方**不会以为它成功了**，**也不会遇到一个无解释的失败**；**② ⭐⭐ **它把这个端点**仍列在「Included（已包含）」清单里**，**同时**在括号里写明它的实际状态**——**⭐ 即**「已经有了架子」与「还不能用」**被同时说清**；**③ **本词条认为这与本站第 341 轮 [[kakekomi-corpus]] 的「gap 作为返回值」同族：**「尚不可用」被做成了一个**有类型、有名字的输出****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字说明**为什么**那件事没做，而不是说「即将推出」****——**逐字为**：**「Stripe checkout/webhooks are **deliberately prepared but not activated because product/price IDs and billing policy were not supplied**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **它区分了**代码侧已完成**与**信息侧未提供**——**⭐ 即**未实现的原因**不在代码，而在**缺失的输入**（**产品／价格 ID 与计费政策**）**；**② ⭐⭐ **「deliberately prepared」**说明架子是**有意留的****（**⭐ 即**这不是遗漏**）；**③ ⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所收条目里**对「某个东西为什么还没做」写得最不含糊的一处之一****（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 的「a pricing-based prior would be the natural fix, **and I have not built or measured one**」同类**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「还不能用于真实客户数据」写成了**一条前置清单****——**逐字为**：**「Use managed PostgreSQL with backups, configure `AUTH_SECRET` uniquely per environment, set `NODE_ENV=production`（**secure cookies;
