可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 開篇一句裡同時劃出三條邊界，且三條各管一件事**：**「BrokerFlow is a **production-oriented MVP** for insurance brokers to manage client records, policies, renewal timelines, and administrative follow-ups. **It intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations. AI only drafts editable administrative email copy; no email is sent by the application.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 第一條否掉的是這門生意的核心產出**（保險建議與保障推薦）——**⭐ 即**一個經紀人的工具明確說自己**不給建議****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 第二條把 AI 的作用收窄到兩個限定詞**（「**只**起草」「**可編輯的**草稿」）——**⭐ 即**它既不自動決定內容，也不把草稿當成終稿****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 第三條回答了一個常被跳過的問題：**這個產物由誰發出****（**「no email is sent by the application」，本應用不發送任何郵件**）——**⭐ 三條裡這一條最實在：前兩條說的是「不做什麼」，這一條說的是「做了也不會自己發出去」****；**④ 三句合起來把「AI 做什麼／不做什麼／它的產物由誰發出」分完了，且全部寫在第一段**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **一個聲明為未實現的端點，明確返回「未實現」**：**「**Stripe-ready protected billing endpoint（returns 501 until products are configured）**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「未實現」被做成了一個可觀察的響應**（HTTP 501）——**⭐ 即**調用方不會以為它成功了，也不會遇到一個無解釋的失敗****；**② ⭐⭐ 它把這個端點仍列在「Included（已包含）」清單裡，同時在括號裡寫明實際狀態**（「已經有了架子」與「還不能用」被同時說清）；**③ 這與本站第 341 輪 [[kakekomi-corpus]] 的「gap 作為返回值」同族：**「尚不可用」被做成了一個有類型、有名字的輸出****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字說明**為什麼**那件事沒做，而不是說「即將推出」**：**「Stripe checkout/webhooks are **deliberately prepared but not activated because product/price IDs and billing policy were not supplied**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 它區分了**代碼側已完成**與**信息側未提供**——**⭐ 即**未實現的原因不在代碼，而在缺失的輸入（產品／價格 ID 與計費政策）****；**② ⭐⭐「deliberately prepared」說明架子是有意留的**（不是遺漏）；**③ 這是本站所收條目裡**對「某個東西為什麼還沒做」寫得最不含糊的一處之一****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「還不能用於真實客戶數據」寫成了一條前置清單**：**「Use managed PostgreSQL with backups, configure `AUTH_SECRET` uniquely per environment, set `NODE_ENV=production`（**secure cookies; startup rejects a missing secret**），provision an OpenAI key only where drafting is desired, and **add rate limiting/audit retention at the platform edge before handling real client data**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「在處理**真實客戶數據之前**，先要在平台邊緣加上限流與審計留存」**——**⭐ 即**它把**哪一步之前不能做什麼**寫清楚了**（這是「按部分聲明」在**使用者**維度上最實用的一處：讀者據此知道它現在**不該**被用在哪裡）；**② 其餘前置項也逐條具體**（託管數據庫帶備份／每個環境用不同的 AUTH_SECRET／設 NODE_ENV=production）；**③ ⭐⭐「啟動時會拒絕缺失的密鑰」**（配置錯誤會讓服務**起不來**，而不是悄悄降級）；**④ ⭐⭐ AI 密鑰只在需要起草時才配**（不默認開啟）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其測試清單逐項可讀，且覆蓋的正是上面那三條邊界的實現面**：**「The automated test suite covers **session integrity, unauthenticated API authorization, client/policy input validation, renewal categorization, follow-up status calculation, and AI-draft endpoint authorization**.」**；**驗證命令逐字為** **「Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run build`.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 六項測試裡有兩項指向授權與鑑權**（未鑑權 API 授權、AI 起草端點的授權）——**⭐ 即**「誰能調用 AI 起草」是被測過的****；**② ⭐⭐「續保分桶」與「跟進狀態計算」被單獨列為測試項**（業務規則不只寫在文檔裡）；**③ 驗證是三件事**（類型檢查、測試、構建）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **續保按四桶劃分且邊界明確**：**「**Renewal buckets: overdue, 0–7 days, 8–30 days, and 31+ days**」**⭐⭐ **兩處**：**① ⭐⭐ 四桶的分界是**可核對的數字****（「緊迫程度」被寫成了**區間而不是形容詞**）；**②「逾期」被單列成一桶**。**⑦ ⭐ **其環境變量表逐項註明必需性與用途，且有一條隱私說明**：**`DATABASE_URL`（必需）／`AUTH_SECRET`（必需，**32+ 位元組**）／`OPENAI_API_KEY`（**起草郵件時需要；保存在服務端；絕不暴露給瀏覽器**）／`OPENAI_MODEL`（可選，**默認為 `gpt-4o-mini`**）／Stripe 變量（可選，**保留**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「保存在服務端；絕不暴露給瀏覽器」是一條**明確的安全邊界描述****；**② 必需與可選項逐行區分，且密鑰有長度要求**；**③ 模型名給出默認值**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **一處需如實指出的**已提交的演示憑據****：**「The seed login is `demo@brokerflow.local` / `DemoPassword123!`; **use it only in local development**.」**⭐⭐ **三處**：**①**演示賬號與口令被寫進 README**；**② ⭐⭐ 它逐字標註只能在本地開發使用**；**③ ⚠️ 提示：**這類演示憑據若被誤用到任何對外部署上，就是一處真實的口令弱化**——**⭐ 不主張該項目已發生這種情況，只指出該憑據是公開可讀的****。**⑨ ⭐ **其餘可核實細節**：會話用簽名且 HttpOnly 的 cookie；每個數據查詢與每個 REST 端點都做按用戶的授權；客戶、保單與跟進都有 CRUD API 與操作界面；技術棧為 Prisma ＋ PostgreSQL（含首個遷移與真實感的開發種子數據）；**AI 起草必須經經紀人複核與編輯**（逐字「OpenAI email drafting with **mandatory broker review/editing**」）；本地運行步驟逐條給出**。**⑩ ⭐ 可與 [[application-fill-provenance]]、[[bill-auditor-india]]、[[prediction-lab-actuarial]]、[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[insurance-recommendation-engine]]、[[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]]、[[insurance-client-attribution]]、[[insurance-governance]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **許可實測為 **NONE****——**實測該倉庫**無任何許可文件**，**README 亦無許可章節**；**⚠️ 故**不主張**其代碼、schema、遷移或種子數據可在任何條件下使用**，**使用或再分發前應先向作者確認授權**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **未運行該平台的任何一步****——**未克隆、未 `npm install`、未建 PostgreSQL、未運行 `db:deploy`／`db:seed`／`dev`／`test`／`typecheck`／`build`、未打開其 Vercel 地址**；**故**不主張**其平台可用、其六項測試通過、其續保分桶與跟進狀態計算正確、或其 AI 起草端點確實受授權保護**——**⭐ 本詞條核實到的是**README 的逐字聲明與其文件結構**（98 個條目）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未讀任何 `.ts`／`.tsx`／Prisma schema 或遷移文件的內容****——**⭐ 即**未核對**「每個數據查詢與每個 REST 端點都做按用戶授權」是否確實成立**（**⚠️ 這是本條最需要後續核實的一處**；**⭐ 這是一個**安全相關的斷言**，**而它在本條裡**只有 README 作依據**）；**AI 起草端點是否確實拒絕未授權調用**；**那個計費端點是否確實返回 501**；**種子數據是否確實為合成**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其種子數據是否包含任何真實個人信息****（**⭐ 其 README 稱開發種子為「realistic development seed data」**，**⚠️「realistic」不等於「合成」**，**故**不主張**其不含真實信息**）。**⑤ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其 AI 起草是否確實只生成行政郵件並保留人工複核**（**未讀其提示詞或端點實現、未做任何網絡觀察**）。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其 Stripe 相關端點是否確實返回 501**。**⑦ ⚠️ **未核實**其 Vercel 部署是否仍在運行、以及它是否被配置為生產環境**（**⚠️ 若其 `NODE_ENV=production` 未設，README 所述的啟動拒絕缺失密鑰便不生效**——**⭐ 不主張其部署存在此問題，只指出這一點無法從倉庫判斷**）。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主張**其可用於真實經紀業務**（**⚠️ 其 README 自己已逐字寫明**在處理真實客戶數據之前還需加限流與審計留存**，**且**刻意不提供保險建議或保障推薦****）。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其作者身份、資歷或該項目是否被任何經紀公司使用**。**⑩ ⭐ **★0、fork 0、無 topics**，**不主張其成熟度**；**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ 其 README 僅 2,619 位元組，而信息密度很高**（三條邊界＋一個 501 端點及其原因＋一條真實數據前置清單＋六項測試＋五行環境變量表）**——**⭐ 即**文檔很短但每一句都在劃定範圍**的一種形態****。**⑪ ⚠️ **創建與推送為同一天（2026-09-08）****——**該倉庫在被檢索到的那一刻仍非常新**。**⑫ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Astri299/brokerflow` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 2,619 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對；**全部 98 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對（63 文件、35 目錄）；**未克隆、未安裝、未建數據庫、未運行任何命令、未讀任何源碼／schema／遷移／種子內容、未打開其線上地址、未做任何網絡觀察、未打開任何圖**。
entries.body_en:
**brokerflow-renewal-crm** (repository `Astri299/brokerflow`, tool name BrokerFlow) **is a CRM and renewal-management platform for insurance brokers** covering **client records, policies, renewal timelines and administrative follow-ups**, self-described as **a production-oriented MVP for insurance brokers**, with a front end deployed on Vercel (its homepage field measurably points there). **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **NONE** (the repository measurably has no licence file), primary language TypeScript, a 108 KB repository, created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-08, no topics** (all GitHub API measurements; **creation and push both fall inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 2,619 bytes**; **the repository measures 98 entries (63 files, 35 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **a system should be declared part by part, with each part’s applicable rules stated**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the one that draws capability boundaries most cleanly**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① The opening sentence draws three boundaries at once, each governing a different thing** — **the most notable point in this entry**: verbatim, BrokerFlow is a production-oriented MVP for insurance brokers to manage client records, policies, renewal timelines and administrative follow-ups, **it intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations, the AI only drafts editable administrative email copy, and no email is sent by the application** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the first clause denies the core output of the business itself, insurance advice and coverage recommendations, so a broker’s tool states plainly that it gives no advice**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the second narrows the AI’s role with two qualifiers, that it only drafts and that the drafts are editable, so it neither decides content nor treats a draft as final**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the third answers a question that is usually skipped, namely who sends the output, stating that no email is sent by the application — of the three the most substantive, since the first two say what it does not do while this one says that even what it does do is not sent on its own**; **and together the three settle what the AI does, what it does not do, and who sends its output, all in the first paragraph**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ An endpoint declared unimplemented, which answers plainly that it is not implemented** — verbatim, a billing endpoint is protected and Stripe-ready but **returns 501 until products are configured** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **unimplemented becomes an observable response, an HTTP 501, so a caller neither assumes success nor meets an unexplained failure**; ⭐⭐ **the endpoint is still listed among what is included, with its actual state given in parentheses, so having a scaffold and not yet being usable are stated together**; **and this is the same family as round 341’s gap returned as a value, since "not yet available" becomes a typed, named output**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It states verbatim why the thing was not built rather than saying it is coming soon** — verbatim, checkout and webhooks are **deliberately prepared but not activated because product and price identifiers and billing policy were not supplied** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **it separates what is done on the code side from what was not supplied on the information side, so the reason for the gap is a missing input rather than the code**; ⭐⭐ **"deliberately prepared" says the scaffold was left on purpose rather than omitted**; **and this is among the least ambiguous accounts this site has collected of why something has not been built**, ⭐ **the same family as round 342’s note that a better prior would be the natural fix and had not been built or measured**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ It turns "not yet usable with real client data" into a checklist** — verbatim, use managed PostgreSQL with backups, configure the auth secret uniquely per environment, set the production environment variable (**secure cookies, and startup rejects a missing secret**), provision an AI key only where drafting is desired, **and add rate limiting and audit retention at the platform edge before handling real client data** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **adding rate limiting and audit retention before handling real client data states which step must precede what, the most practical instance of part-by-part declaration along the user dimension, since a reader learns where it should not yet be used**; **the other prerequisites are equally specific**; ⭐⭐ **startup rejecting a missing secret means a configuration error stops the service rather than degrading it quietly**; **and ⭐⭐ the AI key is provisioned only where drafting is wanted, so it is off by default**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its test list is itemised and covers the implementation side of those three boundaries** — verbatim, the automated suite covers **session integrity, unauthenticated API authorization, client and policy input validation, renewal categorisation, follow-up status calculation, and authorization on the AI-draft endpoint**, with verification by a type check, the test suite and a build ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **two of the six concern authorization, including authorization on the AI-draft endpoint, so who may call the drafter is tested** — ⭐ **the same family as round 342’s integration test for approval permission**; ⭐⭐ **renewal categorisation and follow-up status calculation are listed as separate test items, so business rules are not only documented**; **and verification is three commands rather than tests alone**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Renewals are bucketed four ways with explicit edges** — verbatim, overdue, zero to seven days, eight to thirty days, and thirty-one days or more ⭐⭐ **Two things**: ⭐⭐ **the edges are checkable numbers, so urgency is written as intervals rather than adjectives**; **and overdue is its own bucket rather than folded into the first interval**. **⑦ ⭐ Its environment-variable table marks each entry required or optional and contains one privacy statement** — the database URL and a 32-byte-or-longer auth secret are required, the AI key is needed to draft emails and **kept server-side and never exposed to the browser**, the model name is optional and defaults to a named small model, and the payment variables are optional and reserved ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **"kept server-side, never exposed to the browser" is an explicit statement of a security boundary rather than a general claim of being secure**; **required and optional are distinguished line by line and the secret carries a length requirement**; **and the model has a stated default, so leaving it unset still runs**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ One committed demo credential must be recorded** — verbatim, the seed login is a named demo account with a stated password, **to be used only in local development** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: **a demo account and password are written into the README**; ⭐⭐ **use is restricted verbatim to local development**; **and ⚠️ the entry notes that such a credential used on any public deployment would be a real weakening, without claiming that has happened here, only that the credential is publicly readable** (⭐ **the production environment variable and the startup rejection of a missing secret both suggest the author is aware of production configuration**). **⑨ ⭐ Other checkable details**: **sessions use signed HTTP-only cookies**; **per-user authorization is applied to every data query and every REST endpoint**; **clients, policies and follow-ups each have CRUD APIs and screens**; **the stack is Prisma with PostgreSQL, including a first migration and realistic development seed data**; **AI drafting requires mandatory broker review and editing**; **and local run steps are listed command by command**. **⑩ ⭐ Readable with** [[application-fill-provenance]], [[bill-auditor-india]], [[prediction-lab-actuarial]], [[kong-insurance-api-bundle]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[policy-explainer-ai]], [[insurance-recommendation-engine]], [[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]], [[insurance-client-attribution]] and [[insurance-governance]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as NONE** — **the repository measurably has no licence file and the README has no licence section**; ⚠️ **so no claim is made that its code, schema, migrations or seed data may be used under any conditions, and authorisation should be confirmed with the author before use or redistribution**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No step of the platform was run** — **nothing was cloned, no dependency was installed, no PostgreSQL was created, no migration, seed, development server, test, type check or build was run, and its deployed address was not opened**; **so the platform is not claimed to work, the six test areas are not claimed to pass, the renewal bucketing and follow-up status calculation are not claimed to be correct, and the AI-draft endpoint is not claimed to be authorization-protected** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and its file structure of 98 entries**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No TypeScript file, Prisma schema or migration was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: whether per-user authorization really applies to every data query and every REST endpoint, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry because it is a security-related assertion supported here only by the README; whether the AI-draft endpoint really rejects unauthorized calls; whether the billing endpoint really returns 501; and whether the seed data really is synthetic**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ Whether its seed data contains any real personal information was not verified** — ⭐ **its README calls it realistic development seed data, and ⚠️ realistic does not mean synthetic, so no claim is made that it contains none** (**no seed file was read**). **⑤ ⚠️⚠️ Whether its AI drafting really produces administrative email only and retains human review was not verified** (**no prompt or endpoint implementation was read and no network observation was made**), **and no claim is made that its use of an external model provider satisfies any particular data-protection requirement**. **⑥ ⚠️ Whether the payment-related endpoint really returns 501 was not verified**. **⑦ ⚠️ Whether its deployed address is still running and whether it is configured as production was not verified** — ⚠️ **since the startup rejection of a missing secret depends on that variable being set, and whether it is set cannot be judged from the repository**; ⭐ **no claim is made that the deployment has this problem, only that it cannot be determined here**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that it is usable for real brokerage business**, ⚠️ **its README stating verbatim that rate limiting and audit retention must be added before handling real client data, and that it deliberately provides neither insurance advice nor coverage recommendations**. **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ Its author’s identity, background and whether any brokerage uses it were not verified**. **⑩ ⭐ At ★0 with 0 forks and no topics**, **attention is zero**, **so no maturity is claimed**; ⚠️ **but ⭐⭐ its README is only 2,619 bytes and yet carries three boundaries, an unimplemented endpoint with its reason, a checklist for real-data readiness, six test areas and a five-row environment table — a very short document in which almost every sentence draws a boundary**, **which the site records rather than letting star counts stand in for judgement**. **⑪ ⚠️ It was created and pushed on the same day, 2026-09-08** — ⭐ **recorded as such, since the repository was still very new when it was found**, **and no maturity or stability is claimed**. **⑫ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11** — **and the repository will keep changing**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Astri299/brokerflow` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence NONE, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates, topics and homepage); the 2,619-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, and the entry quotes its opening boundaries, its included list, its environment table, its verification commands and its production notes; **all 98 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**63 files, 35 directories**); **nothing was cloned, nothing was installed, no database was created, no command was run, no source, schema, migration or seed contents were read, its deployed address was not opened, no network observation was made, and no image was opened**.
entries.verified_note: GitHub API 实测（repo，2026-09-11）：⚠️⚠️许可实测 NONE——实测仓库无任何许可文件、README 亦无许可章节；故不主张其代码、schema、迁移或种子数据可在任何条件下使用，使用或再分发前应先向作者确认授权｜★0｜fork 0｜TypeScript｜108 KB｜created 2026-09-08｜pushed 2026-09-08（**同日创建与推送**，均在解冻窗口之内）｜无 topics｜homepage: https://brokerflow-nine.vercel.app｜README 2,619 字节｜仓库实测共 98 个条目（63 文件、35 目录）；⭐⭐⭐开篇一句里同时划出三条边界，逐字「BrokerFlow is a production-oriented MVP for insurance brokers to manage client records, policies, renewal timelines, and administrative follow-ups. **It intentionally does not provide insurance advice or coverage recommendations. AI only drafts editable administrative email copy; no email is sent by the application.**」——四处已写明：①第一条否掉的是这门生意的核心产出（保险建议与保障推荐），即一个经纪人的工具明确说自己不给建议；②第二条把 AI 的作用收窄到两个限定词（「只起草」「可编辑的草稿」），即它既不自动决定内容，也不把草稿当终稿；③第三条回答了一个常被跳过的问题：这个产物由谁发出（no email is sent by the application）——三条里这一条最实在：前两条说的是「不做什么」，这一条说的是「做了也不会自己发出去」；④三句合起来把「AI 做什么／不做什么／它的产物由谁发出」分完了，且全部写在第一段；⭐⭐⭐一个声明为未实现的端点，逐字「Stripe-ready protected billing endpoint（**returns 501 until products are configured**）」——三处已写明：①「未实现」被做成了一个可观察的响应（HTTP 501），即调用方不会以为它成功了，也不会遇到一个无解释的失败；②它把这个端点仍列在「Included（已包含）」清单里同时在括号里写明实际状态（「已经有了架子」与「还不能用」被同时说清）；③这与第 341 轮 kakekomi 的「gap 作为返回值」同族：尚不可用被做成了一个有类型、有名字的输出；⭐⭐⭐逐字说明为什么那件事没做而不是说「即将推出」，逐字「Stripe checkout/webhooks are **deliberately prepared but not activated because product/price IDs and billing policy were not supplied**.」——三处已写明：①它区分了代码侧已完成与信息侧未提供，即未实现的原因不在代码而在缺失的输入（产品／价格 ID 与计费政策）；②「deliberately prepared」说明架子是有意留的（不是遗漏）；③这是本站所收条目里对「某个东西为什么还没做」写得最不含糊的一处之一（与第 342 轮 ratecraft 的「a pricing-based prior would be the natural fix, and I have not built or measured one」同类）；⭐⭐⭐把「还不能用于真实客户数据」写成一条前置清单，逐字「Use managed PostgreSQL with backups, configure AUTH_SECRET uniquely per environment, set NODE_ENV=production（**secure cookies; startup rejects a missing secret**），provision an OpenAI key only where drafting is desired, and **add rate limiting/audit retention at the platform edge before handling real client data**.」——四处已写明：①「在处理真实客户数据之前先要在平台边缘加上限流与审计留存」，即它把哪一步之前不能做什么写清楚了（这是「按部分声明」在使用者维度上最实用的一处：读者据此知道它现在不该被用在哪里）；②其余前置项也逐条具体（托管数据库带备份／每个环境用不同的 AUTH_SECRET／设 NODE_ENV=production）；③「启动时会拒绝缺失的密钥」（配置错误会让服务起不来，而不是悄悄降级）；④AI 密钥只在需要起草时才配（不默认开启）；⭐⭐测试清单逐项可读且覆盖上面三条边界的实现面，逐字「The automated test suite covers **session integrity, unauthenticated API authorization, client/policy input validation, renewal categorization, follow-up status calculation, and AI-draft endpoint authorization**.」与「Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run build`.」——三处已写明：①六项测试里有两项指向授权与鉴权（未鉴权 API 授权、AI 起草端点的授权），即「谁能调用 AI 起草」是被测过的（与第 342 轮 prediction-lab 的审批权限集成测试同族）；②「续保分桶」与「跟进状态计算」被单独列为测试项（业务规则不只写在文档里）；③验证是三件事（类型检查、测试、构建）而不是只有测试；⭐⭐续保按四桶划分且边界明确，逐字「**Renewal buckets: overdue, 0–7 days, 8–30 days, and 31+ days**」——两处已写明：①四桶的分界是可核对的数字（「紧迫程度」被写成了区间而不是形容词）；②「逾期」被单列成一桶；⭐环境变量表逐项注明必需性与用途，逐字（DATABASE_URL 必需／AUTH_SECRET 必需 32+ 字节／OPENAI_API_KEY 起草邮件时需要且**保存在服务端、绝不暴露给浏览器**／OPENAI_MODEL 可选默认 gpt-4o-mini／Stripe 变量可选保留）——三处已写明：①「保存在服务端；绝不暴露给浏览器」是一条明确的安全边界描述（而非泛泛的「安全」）；②必需与可选项逐行区分且密钥有长度要求；③模型名给出默认值（不填也能跑）；⭐⭐一处需如实指出的已提交的演示凭据，逐字「The seed login is demo@brokerflow.local / DemoPassword123!; **use it only in local development**.」——三处已写明：①演示账号与口令被写进 README；②它逐字标注只能在本地开发使用；③⚠️提示这类演示凭据若被误用到任何对外部署上就是一处真实的口令弱化（不主张该项目已发生这种情况，只指出该凭据是公开可读的；其 NODE_ENV=production 与「启动拒绝缺失密钥」两处说明作者对生产配置有意识）；⭐其余可核实细节：会话用签名且 HttpOnly 的 cookie；每个数据查询与每个 REST 端点都做按用户的授权；客户、保单与跟进都有 CRUD API 与操作界面；技术栈为 Prisma ＋ PostgreSQL（含首个迁移与真实感的开发种子数据）；AI 起草必须经经纪人复核与编辑（逐字「OpenAI email drafting with mandatory broker review/editing」）；本地运行步骤逐条给出；⚠️⚠️未运行该平台任何一步（未克隆、未 npm install、未建 PostgreSQL、未运行 db:deploy／db:seed／dev／test／typecheck／build、未打开其 Vercel 地址），故不主张其平台可用、其六项测试通过、其续保分桶与跟进状态计算正确、或其 AI 起草端点确实受授权保护——本词条核实到的是 README 的逐字声明与其文件结构（98 个条目）；⚠️⚠️未读任何 .ts／.tsx／Prisma schema 或迁移文件的内容——即未核对「每个数据查询与每个 REST 端点都做按用户授权」是否确实成立（**这是本条最需要后续核实的一处**；这是一个安全相关的断言，而它在本条里只有 README 作依据）、AI 起草端点是否确实拒绝未授权调用、那个计费端点是否确实返回 501、种子数据是否确实为合成；⚠️⚠️未核实其种子数据是否包含任何真实个人信息（其 README 称开发种子为「realistic development seed data」，⚠️「realistic」不等于「合成」，故不主张其不含真实信息；本次未读任何种子文件）；⚠️⚠️未核实其 AI 起草是否确实只生成行政邮件并保留人工复核（未读其提示词或端点实现、未做任何网络观察；也不主张其使用 OpenAI 的方式符合任何特定的数据保护要求）；⚠️未核实其 Stripe 相关端点是否确实返回 501；⚠️未核实其 Vercel 部署是否仍在运行、以及它是否被配置为生产环境（若其 NODE_ENV=production 未设，README 所述的启动拒绝缺失密钥便不生效——不主张其部署存在此问题，只指出这一点无法从仓库判断）；⭐不主张其可用于真实经纪业务（其 README 自己已逐字写明在处理真实客户数据之前还需加限流与审计留存，且刻意不提供保险建议或保障推荐）；⭐未核实其作者身份、资历或该项目是否被任何经纪公司使用，不主张它被采用；★0、fork 0、无 topics，关注度为零，不主张其成熟度；⚠️但本词条指出其 README 仅 2,619 字节，而信息密度很高（三条边界＋一个 501 端点及其原因＋一条真实数据前置清单＋六项测试＋五行环境变量表）——即文档很短但每一句都在划定范围的一种形态，应如实写出，不用星数代替判断；⚠️创建与推送为同一天（2026-09-08），该仓库在被检索到的那一刻仍非常新，不主张其成熟度或稳定性；⚠️本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见。核实手段补充说明：仓库全部 98 个条目经下载 codeload.github.com tarball 后以 tar tz 列出核对；未克隆、未安装、未建数据库、未运行任何命令、未读任何源码／schema／迁移／种子内容、未打开其线上地址、未做任何网络观察、未打开任何图

entries.title: 一个「谁在用」写得比「它做什么」更清楚的系统：**邀请制、多租户、给某位代理人本人与约十位互信的朋友**、**每个用户的数据完全隔离**，而它是一部**真实在跑的**保单持有人 CRM 的源码——却**没有任何许可文件、也没有数据保护声明**
entries.title_en: A system that describes who uses it more precisely than what it does — invite-only, multi-tenant, for one named agent and about ten trusted friends, with each user’s data fully isolated — and it is the source of a live policyholder CRM with no licence file and no data-protection statement
entries.title_hk: 一個「誰在用」寫得比「它做什麼」更清楚的系統：**邀請制、多租戶、給某位代理人本人與約十位互信的朋友**、**每個用戶的數據完全隔離**，而它是一部**真實在跑的**保單持有人 CRM 的源碼——卻**沒有任何許可文件、也沒有數據保護聲明**
entries.summary: 一份**马来西亚回教保险（takaful）代理人的客户关系管理系统**：自述为「**私人的、邀请制的多租户 CRM**」（**并点名其面向的是一家真实保险公司的回教保险代理人**），**部署在一个真实域名上**，**用 Laravel 12 ＋ MySQL ＋ Blade ＋ Alpine.js v3 ＋ Tailwind CSS v3 写成**；**其最值得记的一处是它对「谁在用」的界定比「它做什么」更具体**——**逐字为「一份给 Hana 与**最多约十位互信的朋友**的私人 CRM（AIA takaful agents）。**每个用户的数据完全隔离**。管理**保单持有人、线索、外联互动、展业策略，以及一个用于分享 AI 生成内容与计划产品知识的**双边市场**」**，**并逐字署名**「Built by Hana · AIA Public Takaful · Dr Takaful brand」**——**⭐ 即**使用者范围（一个人加约十个人）、隔离方式（数据完全隔离）、以及业务归属（一个具名品牌）三件事都被明确写出**；**另有三处可核实特征**：**① `README` 的主体是一份**带日期的业务功能变更日志****（**其中一节逐字为「2026-06-05 — Sales Loop Closed（Priority 1 complete）」，并逐条列出**线索→客户的内联转换（含 `converted_at` 与「Converted Lead」徽章）、报价与线索或客户的关联（可空外键＋可选下拉）、以及外联触点的策略标记（`strategy_id` 可空外键＋「Strategy Used」下拉）**）**——**⭐ 即**它的版本记录按**业务能力**而不是技术版本编号**；**② 这是**一部真实在跑的业务系统的源码**（**其根目录自述部署于一个真实域名**）；**③ ⚠️⚠️ 而它**没有任何许可文件**，**README 中也没有数据保护或隐私声明**——**⭐ 本词条把这三件事分开写：**技术形态**、**谁在用**、**以及使用者应当自己确认的两件事（可否复用、以及其中数据的状态）****
entries.summary_hk: 一份**馬來西亞回教保險（takaful）代理人的客戶關係管理系統**：自述為「**私人的、邀請制的多租戶 CRM**」（**並點名其面向的是一家真實保險公司的回教保險代理人**），**部署在一個真實域名上**，**用 Laravel 12 ＋ MySQL ＋ Blade ＋ Alpine.js v3 ＋ Tailwind CSS v3 寫成**；**其最值得記的一處是它對「誰在用」的界定比「它做什麼」更具體**——**逐字為「一份給 Hana 與**最多約十位互信的朋友**的私人 CRM（AIA takaful agents）。**每個用戶的數據完全隔離**。管理**保單持有人、線索、外聯互動、展業策略，以及一個用於分享 AI 生成內容與計劃產品知識的**雙邊市場**」**，**並逐字署名**「Built by Hana · AIA Public Takaful · Dr Takaful brand」**——**⭐ 即**使用者範圍（一個人加約十個人）、隔離方式（數據完全隔離）、以及業務歸屬（一個具名品牌）三件事都被明確寫出**；**另有三處可核實特徵**：**① `README` 的主體是一份**帶日期的業務功能變更日誌****（**其中一節逐字為「2026-06-05 — Sales Loop Closed（Priority 1 complete）」，並逐條列出**線索→客戶的內聯轉換（含 `converted_at` 與「Converted Lead」徽章）、報價與線索或客戶的關聯（可空外鍵＋可選下拉）、以及外聯觸點的策略標記（`strategy_id` 可空外鍵＋「Strategy Used」下拉）**）**——**⭐ 即**它的版本記錄按**業務能力**而不是技術版本編號**；**② 這是**一部真實在跑的業務系統的源碼**（**其根目錄自述部署於一個真實域名**）；**③ ⚠️⚠️ 而它**沒有任何許可文件**，**README 中也沒有數據保護或隱私聲明**——**⭐ 本詞條把這三件事分開寫：**技術形態**、**誰在用**、**以及使用者應當自己確認的兩件事（可否複用、以及其中數據的狀態）****
entries.summary_en: A customer relationship management system for a Malaysian takaful agent, self-described as a private invite-only multi-tenant CRM and naming the real insurer whose agents it is for, deployed at a real domain and built with Laravel 12, MySQL, Blade, Alpine.js and Tailwind CSS; **its most notable feature is that it describes who uses it more precisely than what it does** — verbatim, it is a private CRM for a named individual and about ten trusted friends, with **each user’s data fully isolated**, managing **policyholders, leads, outreach interactions, prospecting strategy, and a two-sided marketplace for sharing AI-generated content and plan product knowledge** — and it signs itself verbatim with the builder’s name, the insurer and the brand; **so the user range (one person plus about ten), the isolation model (data fully isolated) and the business affiliation (a named brand) are all stated explicitly**; **three further checkable features**: **first, the README’s body is a dated log of business features**, one entry reading verbatim as sales loop closed with priority one complete and listing an inline lead-to-client conversion carrying a conversion timestamp and a converted-lead badge, an optional link between quotations and leads or clients via nullable foreign keys, and strategy tagging on outreach touchpoints — **so its versioning is by business capability rather than by technical release**; **second, it is the source code of a live business system, the root describing deployment at a real domain**; **and third, ⚠️⚠️ it has no licence file at all and its README carries no data-protection or privacy statement** — ⭐ **so the entry keeps three things apart: the technical shape, who uses it, and the two things a reader must confirm for themselves, namely whether the code may be reused and what state any data inside it is in**
entries.body:
**drtakaful-agent-crm**（仓库 `farahanasuhaimi/cms-takaful`，自述名为 Dr Takaful CMS）**是一份马来西亚回教保险（takaful）代理人的客户关系管理系统**：**自述为** **「Private invite-only multi-tenant CRM for Malaysian takaful agents（**AIA Public Takaful**）」**，**并逐字写明其部署域名**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **NONE**（**实测该仓库无任何许可文件**）、主语言 **Blade**、仓库体量 867 KB、创建 2026-04-14、最后推送 2026-09-10、无 topics、无 homepage 字段**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 11,392 字节**；**仓库实测共 352 个条目（284 个文件、68 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「按部分声明：许可、能力、交付物与使用者各自适用什么规则」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**唯一把**使用者**这一维度写到最具体的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「谁在用」被写得比「它做什么」更具体**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处，也是本轮主题在**使用者**维度上最完整的一例**：**其 README 逐字为**：**「> **Private invite-only multi-tenant CRM** for Malaysian takaful agents（**AIA Public Takaful**）. > **Deployed at: `list.drtakaful.com`** > Built with: **Laravel 12 · MySQL · Blade · Alpine.js v3 · Tailwind CSS v3**」**；**并逐字说明使用者范围与隔离方式**：**「**A private CRM for Hana and up to ~10 trusted friends（AIA takaful agents）. Each user’s data is fully isolated.** Manages **policyholders, leads, outreach interactions, prospecting strategy, and a two-sided marketplace for sharing AI-generated content and plan product knowledge**.」**；**并逐字署名**：**「**Built by Hana · AIA Public Takaful · Dr Takaful brand**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **使用者范围的**数量级被写出**（**一个人 ＋ 最多约十位互信的朋友**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里**对「这个系统给谁用」写得最不含糊的一处**：**多数项目写「面向团队」或「面向企业」，**而它给出了一个**约十人的上限****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **隔离方式被写成一句可核对的断言**（**逐字「Each user’s data is fully isolated」，**每个用户的数据完全隔离**）**——**⭐ 即**「多租户」不只是标签，**而是**一条被声明的性质****（**⚠️ 但**本词条**未核实**其实现，**见标注 ③**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **它点名了**所面向的真实保险公司与品牌****（**并逐字署名建造者**）**——**⭐ 本词条**只如实转述其自述，**不主张**该公司对该项目有任何关系、认可或参与**（**⚠️ 亦**未核实**该署名的真实性**）；**④ ⭐⭐ **业务范围逐项列出，其中一项是一个**小范围的双边市场****（**逐字「a **two-sided marketplace** for sharing **AI-generated content and plan product knowledge**」**）**——**⭐ 即**在一个约十人的封闭群体内做一个内容与产品知识的交换场所****。**② ⭐⭐ **其 README 的主体是一份**带日期的业务功能变更日志****——**逐字其中一节的标题为** **「### **2026-06-05 — Sales Loop Closed（Priority 1 complete）**」**，**并逐条列出三项**：**① **线索 → 客户的转换**（**Leads 页上的内联「Convert」按钮；从线索数据创建客户、迁移全部接触点、标记 可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「誰在用」被寫得比「它做什麼」更具體**：**其 README 逐字為** **「> **Private invite-only multi-tenant CRM** for Malaysian takaful agents（**AIA Public Takaful**）. > **Deployed at: `list.drtakaful.com`** > Built with: **Laravel 12 · MySQL · Blade · Alpine.js v3 · Tailwind CSS v3**」**；**並逐字說明使用者範圍與隔離方式**：**「**A private CRM for Hana and up to ~10 trusted friends（AIA takaful agents）. Each user’s data is fully isolated.** Manages **policyholders, leads, outreach interactions, prospecting strategy, and a two-sided marketplace for sharing AI-generated content and plan product knowledge**.」**；**並逐字署名**：**「**Built by Hana · AIA Public Takaful · Dr Takaful brand**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 使用者範圍的**數量級被寫出****（一個人＋最多約十位互信的朋友）——**⭐ 的主體是一份**帶日期的業務功能變更日誌****：**逐字其中一節標題為** **「### **2026-06-05 — Sales Loop Closed（Priority 1 complete）**」**，**並逐條列出三項**：**① 線索 → 客戶的轉換**（Leads 頁上的內聯「Convert」按鈕；從線索數據創建客戶、遷移全部接觸點、標記 `converted_at`；客戶檔案上顯示「Converted Lead」徽章）；**② 報價與線索或客戶的關聯**（`lead_id` 與 `client_id` 為可空外鍵；創建與編輯表單上有可選的下拉；關聯到的名字顯示在報價詳情與索引上）；**③ 接觸點的策略標記**（`strategy_id` 為可空外鍵；所有接觸點記錄表單上有可選的「Strategy Used」下拉；策略顯示在互動歷史與跟進列表中）**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 它的「版本記錄」按**業務能力**編號**（「Priority 1 complete」「Sales Loop Closed」）——**⭐ 即**不是「v1.2.3 修了什麼」，而是「銷售閉環已打通」****；**② ⭐⭐ 三條都給出了**數據層面的實現要點**（`converted_at`、`lead_id`／`client_id` 可空外鍵、`strategy_id` 可空外鍵）；**③ 外鍵被寫成**可空**這一細節值得注意**（即報價**可以**不關聯到線索或客戶——一個**允許缺省的設計**）；**④ 它用**日期**給每條變更定位**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ entries.body_en:
**drtakaful-agent-crm** (repository `farahanasuhaimi/cms-takaful`, self-named Dr Takaful CMS) **is a customer relationship management system for a Malaysian takaful agent**: **it describes itself as a private invite-only multi-tenant CRM for Malaysian takaful agents**, **naming the real insurer whose agents it is for**, and states its deployment domain verbatim. **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **NONE** (the repository measurably has no licence file), detected primary language **Blade**, an 867 KB repository, created 2026-04-14, last pushed 2026-09-10, no topics and no homepage field** (all GitHub API measurements; **creation predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it**); **the README measures 11,392 bytes**; **the repository measures 352 entries (284 files, 68 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **a system should be declared part by part, with each part’s applicable rules stated**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the only one that writes the user dimension most concretely**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① Who uses it is described more precisely than what it does** — **the most notable point in this entry and the most complete instance of this round’s theme along the user dimension**: **its README reads verbatim as a private invite-only multi-tenant CRM for Malaysian takaful agents, naming the insurer, giving the deployment domain and the stack — Laravel 12, MySQL, Blade, Alpine.js and Tailwind CSS**; **then states verbatim that it is a private CRM for a named individual and up to about ten trusted friends who are that insurer’s takaful agents, that each user’s data is fully isolated, and that it manages policyholders, leads, outreach interactions, prospecting strategy and a two-sided marketplace for sharing AI-generated content and plan product knowledge**; **and signs itself verbatim with the builder’s name, the insurer and the brand** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the user range is given as an order of magnitude — one person plus at most about ten trusted friends — the least ambiguous account this round of who a system is for, where most projects say "for teams" or "for enterprises" and this one gives a ceiling of about ten**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the isolation model is stated as a checkable assertion, that each user’s data is fully isolated, so multi-tenancy is not merely a label but a declared property** (⚠️ **whose implementation was not verified**); ⭐⭐ **it names the real insurer and brand it is for and signs the builder verbatim, which this entry restates as the repository’s own account without claiming that the company has any relationship to, endorsement of, or involvement in the project, and without verifying the attribution**; **and ⭐⭐ the business scope is itemised, one part of it being a small closed two-sided marketplace for content and product knowledge among about ten people**. **② ⭐⭐ The README’s body is a dated log of business features** — one section heading reads verbatim as **sales loop closed, priority one complete, dated**, and lists three items: **an inline lead-to-client conversion** with a convert button on the leads page, creating a client from lead data, migrating all touchpoints, marking a conversion timestamp and showing a converted-lead badge; **an optional link between quotations and leads or clients** through nullable foreign keys with an optional dropdown and the linked name shown on the quotation detail and index; **and strategy tagging on touchpoints** through a nullable foreign key with an optional dropdown and the strategy shown in interaction history and follow-up lists ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **its versioning is by business capability rather than technical release, reading as priority one complete and the sales loop closed rather than as a version number and a list of fixes**; ⭐⭐ **each item gives its data-level implementation detail, so business changes and technical changes are written together**; **the foreign keys are nullable, meaning a quotation may legitimately have no lead or client attached, which is a design that permits absence**; **and each change is dated**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ It is the source code of a live business system, which raises two things that must be written separately** — **the root states verbatim that it is deployed at a real domain**, ⚠️ **and its business scope includes policyholders** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **this entry does not verify whether that deployment still runs, and did not visit that domain**; ⚠️⚠️ **it does not verify whether the repository contains any real customer personal information, since no data file, migration or seed was read and no database check was made, so it claims neither that such data is present nor that it is absent** (⭐ **which matters here, since this is a system for policyholders and a public repository holding real data would warrant attention; the entry marks the question without judging it**); ⚠️⚠️ **no data-protection or privacy statement was found in the README**, the terms for data protection, compliance and data privacy having been searched without a hit, ⭐ **and the entry does not claim this constitutes a problem, since not writing a statement is not the same as mishandling data, but notes that a reader cannot judge the data handling from it**; **and the licence is NONE, so whether the code may be reused and what state any data inside it is in are two things a reader must confirm separately**. **④ ⭐ Its stack is itemised with major versions** — Laravel 12, MySQL, Blade, Alpine.js v3 and Tailwind CSS v3 ⭐⭐ **Two things**: **all five components carry a major version, so versions are pinned rather than described as latest**; **and ⭐⭐ its detected primary language is Blade, a templating language, an unusual detection result that nevertheless agrees with the README’s own stack statement, so the detection is not noise but reflects the view layer accounting for most of the files**. **⑤ ⭐ Other checkable details**: **no licence file appears among its 352 entries, consistent with the API reading of NONE**; **its README is half a page of description plus a dated change list, so the documentation is alive**; **and at 867 KB and 284 files the codebase is not small relative to a user base of one person plus about ten**. **⑥ ⭐ Readable with** [[islamic-banking-platform]], [[bnm-insurance-takaful]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[brokerflow-renewal-crm]], [[kong-insurance-api-bundle]], [[application-fill-provenance]], [[policy-explainer-ai]] and [[insurance-governance]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as NONE** — **the repository measurably has no licence file, none appearing among its 352 entries, and the README has no licence section**; ⚠️ **so no claim is made that its code, templates, migrations or any content may be used under any conditions, and the entry notes especially that this is the source of a real business system, so anyone intending to borrow or reuse it should confirm authorisation with the author first**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No step of the system was run** — **nothing was cloned, no PHP or Composer was installed, no MySQL was created, no migration or seed was run, the application was not started, no login was attempted, and the deployment domain it names was not visited**; **so the system is not claimed to work, its full data isolation is not claimed to hold, its marketplace is not claimed to function, and the features its change log lists are not claimed to be implemented** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and the repository’s file structure**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No source, view, migration, seed or data file was read** — ⭐ **so nothing at all was checked about whether multi-tenant isolation is really implemented at the query layer, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry because it is a security-related assertion supported here only by the README; whether the named fields really exist; and whether the lead-to-client conversion really migrates all touchpoints**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ Whether the repository contains any real personal information was not verified** — ⭐ **which matters especially here, since the business scope includes policyholders and this is a running CRM; no data file, seed or migration was read and no database check was made, so the entry claims neither presence nor absence, and ⚠️ anyone intending to use it should establish this for themselves first**. **⑤ ⚠️⚠️ Whether its data handling satisfies Malaysian or any other jurisdiction’s data-protection requirements was not verified** — ⚠️ **no regulation was consulted and no data-protection statement was found in the README**; ⭐ **the entry does not claim that the absence of a statement means mishandling, only that the question cannot be settled from it**. **⑥ ⚠️ The actual relationship between the named individual, the named insurer and brand, and this project was not verified** — ⭐ **the entry restates the repository’s own account and makes no claim that the company endorses, participates in or knows of it**. **⑦ ⚠️ Whether the deployment domain still runs, and who operates it, was not verified**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that it is usable for any real agency business, client management or compliance purpose**. **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ Its author’s identity, background and the system’s actual usage were not verified**. **⑩ ⭐ At ★0 with 0 forks and no topics**, **attention is zero**, **so no maturity is claimed**; ⚠️ **but ⭐⭐ its README measures 11,392 bytes and most of that is a dated log of business changes — documentation that grows by business capability rather than a product description**, **which the site records rather than letting star counts stand in for judgement**. **⑪ ⚠️ It was created before the thaw window, on 2026-04-14** — ⭐ **recorded as such, with selection resting on the push falling inside the window (2026-09-10)**; ⭐ **and since it has been pushed continuously since April, it is a system still growing**. **⑫ ⚠️ The documentation is in English**, **the business context being Malaysian** — ⚠️ **whether Malay or Chinese documentation also exists was not verified**. **⑬ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11** — **and the repository is pushed continuously, so its change log and contents will keep changing**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/farahanasuhaimi/cms-takaful` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence NONE, stars, forks, language Blade, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 11,392-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, the entry quoting its header lines, its user description, its recent-updates section and its signature line; **all 352 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**284 files, 68 directories; the entry used this to check the root files and whether a licence file exists**); **nothing was cloned, no PHP or Composer was installed, no database was created, no command was run, no source, view, migration, seed or data contents were read, the deployment domain it names was not visited, no database or network check was made, and no image was opened**.

topics，关注度为零，不主张其成熟度；⚠️但本词条指出其 README 达 11,392 字节，而其中大部分是一份带日期的业务变更日志——即一份按业务能力生长的文档而不是产品介绍，应如实写出，不用星数代替判断；⚠️创建在解冻窗口之前（2026-04-14），入选依据是推送落在窗口之内（2026-09-10）；该仓库自 4 月创建以来持续推送，故它是一份仍在生长的系统；⚠️文档为英文（业务语境为马来西亚），未核实其是否另有马来语或中文文档；⚠️本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见。核实手段补充说明：仓库全部 352 个条目经下载 codeload.github.com tarball 后以 tar tz 列出核对；未克隆、未安装 PHP 或 Composer、未建数据库、未运行任何命令、未读任何源码／视图／迁移／种子或数据文件内容、未访问其自述的部署域名、未做任何数据库或网络检查、未打开任何图

entries.title: 「不卖、不导流、不存储」——**不是建议，是对公开数字做算术，而数字与公式都在本仓库里**；并逐字给出**为什么不抓取官方计算器**的三条理由，以及一份逐项写明的「故意不覆盖」清单
entries.title_en: Sells nothing, refers no one and stores nothing — not advice but arithmetic on public numbers, with both the numbers and the formula in this repository, and with three stated reasons for deliberately not scraping the official calculator plus an itemised list of what it deliberately does not cover
entries.title_hk: 「不賣、不導流、不存儲」——**不是建議，是對公開數字做算術，而數字與公式都在本倉庫裡**；並逐字給出**為什麼不抓取官方計算器**的三條理由，以及一份逐項寫明的「故意不覆蓋」清單
entries.summary: 一个回答「**哪家瑞士医疗保险对你最便宜**」的**静态站点**：给一个邮编与出生年，再说自己很少看医生／定期看／正在持续治疗，它就把**你所在地区可选的每一家保险公司、每一种模式与每一档免赔额**全比一遍，**数据来自瑞士联邦公共卫生局的官方保费数据**；**其最值得记的一处是它把「依据」逐条摆在明处**——**逐字「Insurek **不卖任何东西、不导流给任何人、不存储任何东西**。**它不是建议：它是对公开数字做的算术，而数字与公式都在本仓库里**。」**；**而它把整个成本问题写成**一行算术****（逐字给出 `cost(spending) = premium × 12 + min(spending, deductible) + min(10% × (spending − deductible), 700)`），**并从这行式子里跑出两个可核对的结果**：**六档成人免赔额里**只有 300 与 2500 会赢**（**其余四档在任何地区、任何支出水平下都不会最便宜**），**以及在法律规定的给付完全相同的情况下，同一地区最便宜与最贵保险公司的年差可超过一千法郎**；**另有四处同一纪律**：**① 它逐字说明**为什么不抓取官方计算器****（**理由三条：为已经是 CSV 的数字去解析脆弱的 HTML／要跟着政府网站的每次改版走／会给一个公共服务增加负载**，**而结局是「得到完全相同的数字」**）；**② 它的 Scope 一节分**已覆盖**与**故意不覆盖****（**后者含未成年人、欧盟／EFTA 参保者的保费与州级保费减免，并逐字给出理由「规则不同，而处理得不好比不处理更糟」**）；**③ 它把**代码、数据、字体**三层许可分别写明**（**代码 GPL-2.0／数据为联邦公共卫生局开放使用并署名／仓库内每个字体各带一份许可文件**）；**④ 它的 ETL 三步用意大利语命名且含一步**逐行核对****（**`etl/scarica.py` 下载、`etl/costruisci.py` 生成、`etl/verifica.py` **把生成的 JSON 与联邦 CSV 逐行对照**）
entries.summary_hk: 一個回答「**哪家瑞士醫療保險對你最便宜**」的**靜態站點**：給一個郵編與出生年，再說自己很少看醫生／定期看／正在持續治療，它就把**你所在地區可選的每一家保險公司、每一種模式與每一檔免賠額**全比一遍，**數據來自瑞士聯邦公共衛生局的官方保費數據**；**其最值得記的一處是它把「依據」逐條擺在明處**——**逐字「Insurek **不賣任何東西、不導流給任何人、不存儲任何東西**。**它不是建議：它是對公開數字做的算術，而數字與公式都在本倉庫裡**。」**；**而它把整個成本問題寫成**一行算術****（逐字給出 `cost(spending) = premium × 12 + min(spending, deductible) + min(10% × (spending − deductible), 700)`），**並從這行式子裡跑出兩個可核對的結果**：**六檔成人免賠額裡**只有 300 與 2500 會贏**（**其餘四檔在任何地區、任何支出水平下都不會最便宜**），**以及在法律規定的給付完全相同的情況下，同一地區最便宜與最貴保險公司的年差可超過一千法郎**；**另有四處同一紀律**：**① 它逐字說明**為什麼不抓取官方計算器****（**理由三條：為已經是 CSV 的數字去解析脆弱的 HTML／要跟着政府網站的每次改版走／會給一個公共服務增加負載**，**而結局是「得到完全相同的數字」**）；**② 它的 Scope 一節分**已覆蓋**與**故意不覆蓋****（**後者含未成年人、歐盟／EFTA 參保者的保費與州級保費減免，並逐字給出理由「規則不同，而處理得不好比不處理更糟」**）；**③ 它把**代碼、數據、字體**三層許可分別寫明**（**代碼 GPL-2.0／數據為聯邦公共衛生局開放使用並署名／倉庫內每個字體各帶一份許可文件**）；**④ 它的 ETL 三步用意大利語命名且含一步**逐行核對****（**`etl/scarica.py` 下載、`etl/costruisci.py` 生成、`etl/verifica.py` **把生成的 JSON 與聯邦 CSV 逐行對照**）
entries.summary_en: A static site answering which Swiss health insurance costs you least: given a postcode and a year of birth, plus whether you rarely see a doctor, see one regularly or are in ongoing treatment, it compares every insurer, every model and every deductible available where you live, using the official premium data of the Swiss Federal Office of Public Health; **its most notable feature is that it lays its basis out item by item** — verbatim, **it sells nothing, refers no one and stores nothing, and it is not advice but arithmetic on public numbers, with both the numbers and the formula in this repository**; **it reduces the entire cost question to one line of arithmetic**, given verbatim as premium times twelve plus the minimum of spending and deductible plus the minimum of ten percent of the excess capped at 700, **and two checkable results fall out of that line**: of the six adult deductibles **only 300 and 2500 ever win**, the four in the middle never coming out cheapest across every offer in a region and every level of spending, and **for benefits the law makes identical, the gap between the cheapest and the dearest insurer in the same region can exceed a thousand francs a year**; **four further points follow the same discipline**: **first, it states verbatim why it deliberately does not scrape the official calculator**, with three reasons — parsing fragile HTML for numbers already published as CSV, carrying every redesign of a government site, and putting load on a public service — and with the outcome named as arriving at identical figures; **second, its scope section separates what is covered from what is deliberately not covered**, the latter including minors, premiums for people insured in the EU or EFTA, and cantonal premium reductions, with the verbatim reason that the rules differ and handling them badly would be worse than not handling them; **third, it declares three licence layers separately** — GPL-2.0 for the code, open use with attribution for the federal data, and a licence file alongside each bundled font; **and fourth, its three-step pipeline is named in Italian and includes a verification step that checks the generated JSON against the federal CSV row by row**
entries.body:
**insurek-swiss-deductible**（仓库 `lucalevi/swiss-deductible-chooser`，站点名 Insurek）**是一份回答「哪家瑞士医疗保险对你最便宜」的静态站点**：**给一个邮编与出生年，再说自己很少看医生／定期看／正在持续治疗，它就把你所在地区可选的每一家保险公司、每一种模式与每一档免赔额全比一遍**，**数据来自瑞士联邦公共卫生局（FOPH／BAG）的官方保费数据**。**实测 ★1、fork 0、许可 **GPL-2.0**（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主语言 **JavaScript**（**⚠️ 而其自述为「Python app」，见标注 ⑦**）、仓库体量 10,388 KB、创建 2025-06-25、最后推送 2026-09-10、topics 为 `app`／`deductible`／`flask`／`franchise`／`insurance`／`python`／`switzerland`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 4,879 字节**；**仓库实测共 90 个条目（81 个文件、9 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把依据放在你能看见的地方——以及当条件本身不在那里时」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把「依据在仓库里」说得最直接、也做得最完整的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「依据在本仓库里」被写成一句话，且前面是三个否定**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处**：**逐字为**：**「Insurek **sells nothing, refers no one and stores nothing**. **It is not advice: it is arithmetic on public numbers, and the numbers and the formula are both in this repository.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「不卖、不导流、不存储」三个否定各封掉一条常见的商业模式**（**卖保单／收转介费／收集用户数据**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这比「我们不收集数据」这种单句声明更硬**：**它同时说明了**它靠什么不赚钱****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「不是建议，是对公开数字做的算术」**——**⭐ 即**它把自己的输出**降格**为一个更窄的东西**（**⭐ 与第 343 轮 [[brokerflow-renewal-crm]] 的「刻意不提供保险建议」、[[uk-home-insurance-risk-map]] 的「技术保费而非家财险保费」同族**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「而数字与公式都在本仓库里」**——**⭐ 即**读者不需要相信它，**可以自己复算**；**⭐ 本词条**实测核实了这句话**：**其 `sito/assets/calcolo.js`（**意大利语「计算」**）存在**，**`sito/dati/` 下实测 **46 个条目**（**生成的数据**）**，**而 README 逐字指明该目录为**「generated; do not edit by hand」****；**④ **它另在开头逐字说明**四种语言**（**意大利语、德语、法语、英语**）**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **整个成本问题被写成**一行算术**，而两个结论直接从这行式子里跑出来**——**逐字为**：**「Under Swiss compulsory health insurance（**KVG/LAMal**）an adult pays three things: the premium, twelve times a year; their own costs up to the deductible they chose; and above that 10% of what follows, **capped at 700 francs a year**. **The benefits are fixed by law and identical at every insurer.** So the whole question of what a year costs is **one line of arithmetic**:」**，**随后逐字给出那行式子**：**`cost(spending) = premium × 12 + min(spending, deductible) + min(10% × (spending − deductible), 700)`**；**并逐字给出两个后果**：**「First, of the six adult deductibles **only 300 and 2500 ever win** — across every offer in a region and every level of spending, **the four in the middle never come out cheapest**. Second, and larger: **for benefits the law makes identical, the gap between the cheapest and the dearest insurer in the same region can exceed a thousand francs a year**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「法律规定的给付在每家保险公司都相同」是这条式子成立的前提**——**⭐ 即**它先说明**为什么这个问题可以被化简成算术**（**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里**最漂亮的一处推理压缩**：**把「选保险」化简为三笔钱的加法**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **六档免赔额里**只有两档会赢**——**⭐ 这是一个**非常强且可自行复核的结论****（**⭐ 且它给出了适用范围：「在任何地区、任何支出水平下」**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **第二个结论把关注点从免赔额转到**保险公司之间的价差****（**⭐ 即**同一法定给付、同一地区，年差可超过一千法郎**）；**④ **公式与常量都写出来了**（**`premium × 12`、`min(spending, deductible)`、**上限 700 法郎**的 10%**）**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它的运行方式被逐条写清，且「没有后端」是它的设计**——**逐字为**：**「**There is no application server, no database and no third-party request while anyone uses the site.** A Python script runs **once a year** on the maintainer’s machine, turns the federal data files into **static JSON**, and **that is the whole backend**. The browser downloads the index, the postcode table and **one** premium file — the one for the area the visitor lives in — **under 250 KB in total**, and **does the arithmetic itself**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **三个「没有」**（**没有应用服务器、没有数据库、**使用期间没有任何第三方请求**）**——**⭐ 第三条是**隐私层面最实在的一条**：**不是「我们不存你的数据」，而是**使用期间根本不往外发请求****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「一年跑一次的 Python 脚本就是整个后端」**——**⭐ 即**后端被压缩成**一份每年更新一次的静态数据**；**③ ⭐⭐ **下载量被量化**（**索引 ＋ 邮编表 ＋ **只**那一个地区的保费文件，**合计不到 250 KB**）**——**⭐ 即**按地区切分数据**，**既省流量又不必把全国数据发到浏览器**；**④ ⭐⭐ **算术在浏览器里做**，**与 ① 的「公式在仓库里」互相印证****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字说明**为什么不抓取官方计算器**，并给出三条理由与一个结局**——**⭐ 这是本条与本轮同批 [[copart-salvage-dataset]] 的**正面反差**，值得并列阅读**：**逐字为**：**「This is the same source the federal premium calculator at **priminfo.admin.ch** is built on — **which is why Insurek does not scrape it.** **Scraping would mean parsing fragile HTML for numbers that are already published as CSV**, **carrying every redesign of a government site** and **putting load on a public service**, **to arrive at identical figures**.（Priminfo also has no JSON API for premiums: it is a server-rendered form.）」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **三条理由分别属于**技术、维护与公共资源**三个层面****（**为已有 CSV 的数字解析脆弱 HTML／跟着政府改版走／给公共服务加负载**）**——**⭐ 而不是一句「不道德」**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **结局被点名**：**「得到完全相同的数字」**——**⭐ 即**抓取的**收益为零**，**代价是三条以上的**；**③ ⭐⭐ **它另外说明了官方为何没有 API**（**是一个服务端渲染的表单**）**——**⭐ 即**它把「为什么只能抓或只能拿 CSV」的**技术前提**也写了出来**；**④ **⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所收条目里**对「我们刻意不做某件技术上做得到的事」写得最完整的一处**：**动机、代价、收益与替代方案四样俱全**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **Scope 一节分「已覆盖」与「**故意不覆盖**」，且后者带理由**——**逐字为**：**「**Covered**: adults（26+）and young adults（19–25），every canton and premium region, every insurer and model, with and without accident cover, all six deductibles — including **the roughly 1 000 combinations out of 20 000 where an insurer does not offer one of them**.」**；**「**Not covered, deliberately**: **minors**（deductibles from 0 to 600, co-insurance capped at 350, family discounts — **different rules, and handling them badly would be worse than not handling them**），**premiums for people insured in the EU/EFTA**, and **cantonal premium reductions**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「故意不覆盖」这一节的标题就把**动机**写进去了**（**deliberately**）**——**⭐ 即**缺口不是遗漏而是选择**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未成年人那一条的理由逐字为**「规则不同，而处理得不好比不处理更糟」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮主题里**最实用的一句取舍说明**（**⭐ 与第 343 轮 [[brokerflow-renewal-crm]] 的「在处理真实客户数据之前先要加什么」同类**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **覆盖的粒度到了**组合级****（**「约 20,000 个组合中有约 1,000 个是某家保险公司不提供某一档免赔额」**）**——**⭐ 即**它把**缺失本身也计入了覆盖范围**；**④ **两项未覆盖各有其性质**（**法律规则不同**与**不在本数据集内**）**。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **三层许可被分别写明，而字体那一层是**逐文件**的**——**逐字为**：**「**Licence** Code: GNU GPL-2.0, see `LICENSE`. **Data: Federal Office of Public Health, open use with attribution.**」**；**而本词条**实测其 `sito/fonts/` 下**另有两份字体许可文件**（**`LICENSE-EBGaramond.txt` 与 `LICENSE-Inter.txt`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **这是本会话**第二次**见到把「代码许可」与「数据许可」分开写**（**第一次是第 343 轮 [[uk-home-insurance-risk-map]] 的 `code` → MIT／`data` → OGL v3 两枚并列徽章**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为「两处独立出现」使这个做法从**孤例**变成了**可称许的惯例****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **而它多出第三层：**字体**（**两份许可文件与字体同目录**）**——**⭐ 即**一个静态站点实际携带**三种不同来源的权利**，**它把三种都写在明处**；**③ ⭐⭐ **数据侧的许可被写成一句**完整的话**（**「开放使用并署名」**）**，**且点名了**权利人是联邦公共卫生局****。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其 ETL 三步用意大利语命名，而第三步是**逐行核对****——**逐字为**：**「`etl/scarica.py` **downloads the federal source files**；`etl/costruisci.py` **turns them into the site’s JSON**；`etl/verifica.py` **checks the JSON against the federal CSV, row by row**」**；**「`sito/dati/` generated; **do not edit by hand**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **`verifica.py` 把**生成的 JSON 与联邦 CSV 逐行对照****——**⭐ 即**转换步骤本身是被验证的**，**而**不是只验证最终页面**（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 **insurek-swiss-deductible**（倉庫 `lucalevi/swiss-deductible-chooser`，站點名 Insurek）**是一份回答「哪家瑞士醫療保險對你最便宜」的靜態站點**：**給一個郵編與出生年，再說自己很少看醫生／定期看／正在持續治療，它就把你所在地區可選的每一家保險公司、每一種模式與每一檔免賠額全比一遍**，**數據來自瑞士聯邦公共衛生局（FOPH／BAG）的官方保費數據**。**實測 ★1、fork 0、許可 **GPL-2.0**（**實測倉庫內含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主語言 **JavaScript**（**⚠️ 而其自述為「Python app」，見標注 ⑦**）、體量 10,388 KB、創建 2025-06-25、最後推送 2026-09-10、topics 為 `app`／`deductible`／`flask`／`franchise`／`insurance`／`python`／`switzerland`**（**創建在解凍窗口之前，推送落在窗口之內**）；**README 實測 4,879 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 90 個條目（81 個文件、9 個目錄）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把依據放在你能看見的地方——以及當條件本身不在那裡時」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**把「依據在倉庫裡」說得最直接、也做得最完整的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「依據在本倉庫裡」被寫成一句話，且前面是三個否定**：**「Insurek **sells nothing, refers no one and stores nothing**. **It is not advice: it is arithmetic on public numbers, and the numbers and the formula are both in this repository.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「不賣、不導流、不存儲」三個否定各封掉一條常見的商業模式**（賣保單／收轉介費／收集用戶數據）——**⭐ 這比「我們不收集數據」這種單句聲明更硬：它同時說明了它靠什麼不賺錢****；**② ⭐⭐⭐「不是建議，是對公開數字做的算術」**（把自己的輸出降格為一個更窄的東西；與第 343 輪 brokerflow 的「刻意不提供保險建議」、uk-home-insurance-risk-map 的「技術保費而非家財險保費」同族）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐「而數字與公式都在本倉庫裡」**——**⭐ 本詞條實測核實了這句話：其 `sito/assets/calcolo.js`（意大利語「計算」）存在，`sito/dati/` 下實測 46 個條目（生成的數據），而 README 逐字指明該目錄為「generated; do not edit by hand」****；**④ 它另在開頭逐字說明四種語言**（意大利語、德語、法語、英語）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **整個成本問題被寫成一行算術，而兩個結論直接從這行式子裡跑出來**：**「Under Swiss compulsory health insurance（**KVG/LAMal**）an adult pays three things: the premium, twelve times a year; their own costs up to the deductible they chose; and above that 10% of what follows, **capped at 700 francs a year**. **The benefits are fixed by law and identical at every insurer.** So the whole question of what a year costs is **one line of arithmetic**:」**，**隨後逐字給出** **`cost(spending) = premium × 12 + min(spending, deductible) + min(10% × (spending − deductible), 700)`**，**並逐字給出兩個後果**（**「of the six adult deductibles **only 300 and 2500 ever win** — across every offer in a region and every level of spending, **the four in the middle never come out cheapest**」** 與 **「**for benefits the law makes identical, the gap between the cheapest and the dearest insurer in the same region can exceed a thousand francs a year**」**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「法律規定的給付在每家保險公司都相同」是這條式子成立的前提**（它先說明為什麼這個問題可以被化簡成算術——**本輪四條裡**最漂亮的一處推理壓縮**：把「選保險」化簡為三筆錢的加法）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 六檔免賠額裡只有兩檔會贏**（一個非常強且可自行複核的結論，且給出了適用範圍「在任何地區、任何支出水平下」）；**③ ⭐⭐ 第二個結論把關注點從免賠額轉到保險公司之間的價差****；**④ 公式與常量都寫出來了**（`premium × 12`、`min(spending, deductible)`、上限 700 法郎的 10%）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其運行方式被逐條寫清，且「沒有後端」是它的設計**：**「**There is no application server, no database and no third-party request while anyone uses the site.** A Python script runs **once a year** on the maintainer’s machine, turns the federal data files into **static JSON**, and **that is the whole backend**. The browser downloads the index, the postcode table and **one** premium file — the one for the area the visitor lives in — **under 250 KB in total**, and **does the arithmetic itself**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 三個「沒有」**（沒有應用伺服器、沒有數據庫、**使用期間沒有任何第三方請求**）——**⭐ 第三條是隱私層面最實在的一條：不是「我們不存你的數據」，而是使用期間根本不往外發請求****；**② ⭐⭐⭐「一年跑一次的 Python 腳本就是整個後端」**（後端被壓縮成一份每年更新一次的靜態數據）；**③ ⭐⭐ 下載量被量化**（索引＋郵編表＋只那一個地區的保費文件，合計不到 250 KB，即按地區切分數據）；**④ ⭐⭐ 算術在瀏覽器裡做**，**與 ① 的「公式在倉庫裡」互相印證****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字說明為什麼不抓取官方計算器，並給出三條理由與一個結局**（**⭐ 這是本條與本輪同批 [[copart-salvage-dataset]] 的正面反差**）：**「This is the same source the federal premium calculator at **priminfo.admin.ch** is built on — **which is why Insurek does not scrape it.** **Scraping would mean parsing fragile HTML for numbers that are already published as CSV**, **carrying every redesign of a government site** and **putting load on a public service**, **to arrive at identical figures**.（Priminfo also has no JSON API for premiums: it is a server-rendered form.）」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 三條理由分別屬於技術、維護與公共資源三個層面**（而不是一句「不道德」）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 結局被點名：得到完全相同的數字**（抓取的收益為零，代價是三條以上）；**③ ⭐⭐ 它另外說明了官方為何沒有 API**（是一個服務端渲染的表單）；**④ 這是本站所收條目裡**對「我們刻意不做某件技術上做得到的事」寫得最完整的一處**：動機、代價、收益與替代方案四樣俱全**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **Scope 一節分「已覆蓋」與「故意不覆蓋」，且後者帶理由**：**Covered**（adults 26+、young adults 19–25、每個州與保費地區、每家保險公司與模式、含與不含意外保障、全部六檔免賠額——**including the roughly 1 000 combinations out of 20 000 where an insurer does not offer one of them**）；**Not covered, deliberately**（**minors**（deductibles from 0 to 600, co-insurance capped at 350, family discounts — **different rules, and handling them badly would be worse than not handling them**）、**premiums for people insured in the EU/EFTA**、**cantonal premium reductions**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「故意不覆蓋」這一節的標題就把動機寫進去了**（deliberately，即缺口不是遺漏而是選擇）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 未成年人那一條的理由逐字為「規則不同，而處理得不好比不處理更糟」**（本輪主題裡**最實用的一句取捨說明**）；**③ ⭐⭐ 覆蓋的粒度到了組合級**（約 20,000 個組合中有約 1,000 個是某家保險公司不提供某一檔免賠額——**把缺失本身也計入了覆蓋範圍**）；**④ 兩項未覆蓋各有其性質**（法律規則不同 vs 不在本數據集內）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **三層許可被分別寫明，而字體那一層是逐文件的**：**「**Licence** Code: GNU GPL-2.0, see `LICENSE`. **Data: Federal Office of Public Health, open use with attribution.**」**；**而本詞條實測其 `sito/fonts/` 下另有兩份字體許可文件**（`LICENSE-EBGaramond.txt` 與 `LICENSE-Inter.txt`）**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 這是本會話第二次見到把「代碼許可」與「數據許可」分開寫**（第一次是第 343 輪 uk-home-insurance-risk-map 的兩枚並列徽章——**兩處獨立出現使這個做法從孤例變成可稱許的慣例****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 而它多出第三層：字體**（兩份許可文件與字體同目錄，即一個靜態站點實際攜帶三種不同來源的權利，它把三種都寫在明處）；**③ ⭐⭐ 數據側的許可被寫成一句完整的話並點名了權利人**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **其 ETL 三步用意大利語命名，而第三步是逐行核對**：**「`etl/scarica.py` **downloads the federal source files**；`etl/costruisci.py` **turns them into the site’s JSON**；`etl/verifica.py` **checks the JSON against the federal CSV, row by row**」**；**「`sito/dati/` generated; **do not edit by hand**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ `verifica.py` 把生成的 JSON 與聯邦 CSV 逐行對照**（轉換步驟本身被驗證，而不是只驗證最終頁面；與第 342 輪 ratecraft 的「單元格級精確相等」同族）；**② 三步各司其職且命名即其職責**；**③ ⭐⭐ 生成目錄被標註「不要手工編輯」**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **更新節奏與自動化被寫明，且自動化只提議不提交**：**「The data is refreshed **once a year, in late September**, when the FOPH approves the following year’s premiums. **A GitHub Action does the download, the rebuild and the verification, and opens a pull request when anything changed.**」**；**⭐ 而本詞條實測其工作流文件名為 `premi-nuovi.yml`（意大利語「新保費」）**⭐⭐ **兩處**：**① ⭐⭐ 自動化開 PR 而不是直接提交**（變更需要人過一眼）；**② 更新時點與原因綁定**。**⑨ ⭐ **其餘可核實細節**：**① moved from serving requests to preparing data once a year.」）——**⭐ 這是「把一件事做小」的一個很乾淨的敘述**；**② 維護者筆記為意大利語**（`LEGGIMI.md`）；**③ 本地運行方式寫明為必須起一個服務**（逐字「A real server, not a double-click: the paths are absolute and `fetch` does not work from `file://`」）。**⑩ ⭐ 可與 下任何腳本、未運行其工作流、未打開其線上站點**；**故**不主張**其比較結果、那行算術的正確性、**「只有 300 與 2500 會贏」這一結論**、或「不足 250 KB」**已被複現**——**⭐ 本詞條核實到的是**README 的逐字聲明、其點名的文件確實存在**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未讀任何源碼的內容****——**⭐ 即**未核對**：`calcolo.js` 是否確實實現那行式子**（**⚠️ 這是本條最需要後續核實的一處**）；`verifica.py` 是否確實逐行對照聯邦 CSV；`sito/dati/` 的 46 個 JSON 是否確實由聯邦數據生成**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其保費數據是否確實來自聯邦公共衛生局的官方數據集**（**其 README 點名了 opendata.swiss 上的數據集與另外兩份聯邦文件**，**⚠️ 但未訪問該數據集、未比對任何保費數值**）。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其「使用期間沒有任何第三方請求」這一聲明**（**⭐ 這是一個**可被檢驗的工程主張****；**⚠️ 未做任何網絡觀察、未讀其頁面腳本**）。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其「不存儲任何東西」這一聲明**。**⑦ ⚠️⚠️ **一處自述與技術判定不一致，已如實指出**：**其倉庫描述逐字為「**Python app** to for choosing the best deductible option…」**，**而 GitHub 主語言實測為 **JavaScript****——**⭐ 不主張這是錯誤**（**README 本身說明 Python 只在 ETL 階段運行、站點是純 HTML/CSS/JS，且其用詞是「app」而非「site」**）；**⚠️ 但**讀者若只看倉庫描述，會以為這是一個 Python 應用**；**⭐ 另如實記錄其描述中有一處語法瑕疵「to for choosing」**（**不作評價**）。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主張**其比較結果構成任何個人的最佳選擇**（**⭐ 其 README 自己已逐字寫明**它不是建議、只是對公開數字做的算術，**且**明確列出了故意不覆蓋的三類情形****）。**⑨ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其 46 個生成 JSON 即**極短的文檔承載了極高的信息密度**的一種形態**。**⑫ ⚠️ **創建在解凍窗口之前（2025-06-25）****——**如實記錄該日期，入選依據是**推送落在窗口之內（2026-09-10）****。**⑬ ⚠️ **文檔為**英語**，而代碼目錄、腳本名與維護者筆記為**意大利語****——**⚠️ 提示：**站點本身提供四種語言，**但**倉庫內的註釋與筆記以意大利語為主**。**⑭ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/lucalevi/swiss-deductible-chooser` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 4,879 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對；**全部 90 個條目**經下載 tarball 後以 `tar tz` 列出核對（81 文件、9 目錄；據其核對 `etl/` 三個腳本、`sito/assets/` 五個文件、`sito/fonts/` 下兩份許可文件、`.github/workflows/premi-nuovi.yml`、`LEGGIMI.md` 與 `sito/dati/` 的 46 個條目）；**未克隆、未運行任何腳本或工作流、未打開其線上站點、未讀任何源碼內容、未訪問聯邦數據源、未做任何網絡觀察、未打開任何圖**。
entries.body_en:
**insurek-swiss-deductible** (repository `lucalevi/swiss-deductible-chooser`, site name Insurek) **is a static site answering which Swiss health insurance costs you least**: **given a postcode and a year of birth, plus whether you rarely see a doctor, see one regularly or are in ongoing treatment, it compares every insurer, every model and every deductible available where you live**, **using the official premium data of the Swiss Federal Office of Public Health**. **Measured ★1, 0 forks, licence **GPL-2.0** (a `LICENSE` file is measurably present), primary language **JavaScript** (⚠️ **while its own description calls it a Python app — see ⑦**), a 10,388 KB repository, created 2025-06-25, last pushed 2026-09-10, topics `app`, `deductible`, `flask`, `franchise`, `insurance`, `python` and `switzerland`** (all GitHub API measurements; **creation predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it**); **the README measures 4,879 bytes**; **the repository measures 90 entries (81 files, 9 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **the basis should be placed where you can see it, and that the interesting case is when the terms themselves are not there**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it states and delivers on having the basis in the repository most completely**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① Having the basis in the repository is one sentence preceded by three negatives** — **the most notable point in this entry**: verbatim, **Insurek sells nothing, refers no one and stores nothing, and it is not advice but arithmetic on public numbers, with both the numbers and the formula in this repository** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **each of the three negatives closes off a familiar business model — selling policies, taking referral fees, and collecting user data — which is harder than a single claim of not collecting data, because it also says what it does not earn from**; ⭐⭐⭐ **"it is not advice: it is arithmetic on public numbers" demotes its own output to a narrower thing**, ⭐ **the same family as round 343’s deliberate refusal to give insurance advice and its "technical premiums rather than home insurance premiums"**; ⭐⭐⭐ **and "the numbers and the formula are both in this repository" means a reader need not trust it but can recompute it — a claim this entry verified, since a calculation script exists under the site assets, 46 generated data entries sit under the data directory, and the README marks that directory as generated and not to be edited by hand**; **and the README opens by naming the four languages the site is offered in**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ The entire cost question is reduced to one line of arithmetic, and two conclusions fall straight out of it** — verbatim, under Swiss compulsory health insurance an adult pays three things, the premium twelve times a year, their own costs up to the deductible they chose, and above that ten percent of what follows capped at 700 francs a year, and **because the benefits are fixed by law and identical at every insurer, the whole question of what a year costs is one line of arithmetic**, given verbatim as premium times twelve plus the minimum of spending and deductible plus the minimum of ten percent of the excess capped at 700; **with two consequences stated verbatim**: of the six adult deductibles **only 300 and 2500 ever win**, across every offer in a region and every level of spending, the four in the middle never coming out cheapest, and **for benefits the law makes identical, the gap between the cheapest and the dearest insurer in the same region can exceed a thousand francs a year** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the premise that the law makes benefits identical is what licenses the reduction, so it first explains why the question can become arithmetic at all — the finest compression of reasoning this round produced, turning choosing insurance into adding three amounts**; ⭐⭐⭐ **only two of six deductibles ever winning is a strong and independently checkable conclusion, given with its scope of application**; ⭐⭐ **the second conclusion shifts attention from the deductible to the spread between insurers**; **and the formula and its constants are all written out**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ How it runs is stated item by item, and having no backend is the design** — verbatim: **there is no application server, no database and no third-party request while anyone uses the site; a Python script runs once a year on the maintainer’s machine, turns the federal data files into static JSON, and that is the whole backend; the browser downloads the index, the postcode table and one premium file, the one for the area the visitor lives in, under 250 KB in total, and does the arithmetic itself** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the three absences include no third-party request while in use, the most substantive of the three on privacy grounds, since it is not that they do not store your data but that nothing is sent out at all while you use it**; ⭐⭐⭐ **a Python script running once a year being the whole backend compresses the backend into a dataset refreshed annually**; ⭐⭐ **the download is quantified, and the data is split by region so that only one area’s file is fetched**; **and ⭐⭐ the arithmetic runs in the browser, corroborating the claim that the formula is in the repository**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ It states verbatim why it deliberately does not scrape the official calculator, with three reasons and one outcome** — ⭐ **the direct contrast with this round’s salvage dataset entry**: verbatim, this is the same source the federal premium calculator is built on, **which is why Insurek does not scrape it — scraping would mean parsing fragile HTML for numbers that are already published as CSV, carrying every redesign of a government site, and putting load on a public service, to arrive at identical figures**, and the official calculator has no premium API because it is a server-rendered form ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the three reasons cover technique, maintenance and the public resource rather than a single appeal to ethics**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the outcome is named as arriving at identical figures, so the gain from scraping is zero while the costs are threefold**; ⭐⭐ **it also explains why the official source has no API, so the technical premise of the choice is given**; **and it is the most complete account this site has collected of deliberately not doing something that is technically possible: motive, cost, benefit and alternative all present**. **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Its scope section separates what is covered from what is deliberately not, with reasons** — covered: adults and young adults, every canton and premium region, every insurer and model, with and without accident cover, all six deductibles, **including the roughly one thousand combinations out of twenty thousand where an insurer does not offer one of them**; not covered deliberately: **minors, whose deductibles, co-insurance cap and family discounts follow different rules, with the verbatim reason that handling them badly would be worse than not handling them**, premiums for people insured in the EU or EFTA, and cantonal premium reductions ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the heading itself carries the motive, so a gap is a choice rather than an omission**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the reason for excluding minors is the most practical statement of a trade-off in this round**; ⭐⭐ **coverage is specified down to combinations, counting absences within the covered range itself**; **and the two exclusions differ in kind, one being different legal rules and the other being outside this dataset**. **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ Three licence layers are declared, and the font layer is per file** — verbatim, the code is GPL-2.0 and the data is the Federal Office of Public Health’s under open use with attribution; **and this entry measurably found two further licence files alongside the bundled fonts** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **this is the second time in this session that a code licence and a data licence have been declared separately, the first being round 343’s two parallel badges, and two independent occurrences move the practice from a one-off to something that can be commended**; ⭐⭐⭐ **it adds a third layer, fonts, with a licence file beside each, so a static site carries three different sources of rights and states all three**; **and ⭐⭐ the data licence is a complete phrase naming the rights holder**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Its three-step pipeline is named in Italian and its third step verifies row by row** — verbatim, one script downloads the federal source files, one turns them into the site’s JSON, and one **checks the JSON against the federal CSV row by row**, with the generated directory marked as generated and not to be edited by hand ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the conversion step is itself verified rather than only the final page, the same family as round 342’s cell-level exact equality**; **the three steps have names that state their jobs**; **and ⭐⭐ hand-editing the generated directory is warned against because it would be lost on the next rebuild**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ The refresh cadence and automation are stated, and the automation proposes rather than commits** — verbatim, the data is refreshed once a year in late September when the office approves the following year’s premiums, and **a GitHub Action does the download, the rebuild and the verification and opens a pull request when anything changed**; ⭐ **and this entry measurably found the workflow file named in Italian as "new premiums"** ⭐⭐ **Two things**: ⭐⭐ **opening a pull request rather than committing means a change needs a human look**; **and the timing is tied to its cause**. **⑨ ⭐ Other checkable details**: **the history section states where it came from, a Flask app that asked you to copy six premiums by hand out of the official calculator, with the line that the arithmetic was right and the work was on you, and where the Python went, having moved from serving requests to preparing data once a year**, ⭐ **a clean account of making a thing smaller**; **the maintainer’s notes are in Italian**; **and local running is stated to require a server, since the paths are absolute and fetching does not work from a file URL**. **⑩ ⭐ Readable with** [[uae-health-pricing-model]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[lossratio-r]], [[insurance-calibration]], [[insurance-qa-evidence]], [[uk-home-insurance-risk-map]], [[copart-salvage-dataset]], [[kokuho-rules-engine]] and [[medical-opinion-extractor]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⭐ Licence measured as GPL-2.0 for the code** — **a `LICENSE` file is measurably present and the README states the code licence verbatim**; ⭐ **but the data carries its own statement and the fonts carry two further licence files, so the repository is not claimed to have a single licence status**, ⚠️ **and none of the three layers’ terms was read in full, so all three should be confirmed separately before use, modification or redistribution**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No part of the site was run** — **nothing was cloned, no Python environment was created, no script under the pipeline directory was run, no workflow was run and the live site was not opened**; **so its comparison results, the correctness of that one line of arithmetic, the conclusion that only two deductibles ever win, and the under-250-KB figure are not claimed to have been reproduced** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and that every file it names exists**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No source was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: whether the calculation script really implements that one line, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry; whether the verification script really checks row by row against the federal CSV; and whether the 46 generated data entries really come from the federal data**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ Whether its premium data really comes from the office’s official dataset was not verified** (**the README names the open-data dataset and two further federal files, but ⚠️ that dataset was not visited and no premium value was compared**). **⑤ ⚠️ Its claim of no third-party request while in use was not verified** (⭐ **a checkable engineering claim, ⚠️ but no network observation was made and its page scripts were not read**). **⑥ ⚠️ Its claim of storing nothing was not verified**. **⑦ ⚠️⚠️ One inconsistency between the description and the technical detection is stated plainly**: **the repository description calls it a Python app while the detected primary language is JavaScript** — ⭐ **no claim is made that this is an error, since the README itself says Python runs only in the extraction stage and the site is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript**, ⚠️ **but a reader seeing only the description would take it for a Python application**; ⭐ **a grammatical blemish in the description is also recorded, without comment**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its comparison constitutes anyone’s best choice** (⭐ **its own README states verbatim that it is not advice but arithmetic on public numbers, and it lists the three things it deliberately does not cover**). **⑨ ⚠️⚠️ Whether its 46 generated data entries are in step with the federal data, and which year they cover, was not verified**. **⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ Its author’s identity, background and the site’s usage were not verified**. **⑪ ⭐ At ★1 with 0 forks**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity is claimed**; ⚠️ **but ⭐⭐ its README measures only 4,879 bytes and yet gives in one page a complete cost formula, two checkable conclusions, an itemised exclusion list with reasons, three licence layers, a three-step pipeline including a row-by-row check, and a short history — very short documentation carrying very high information density**, **which the site records rather than letting star counts stand in for judgement**. **⑫ ⚠️ It was created before the thaw window, on 2025-06-25** — ⭐ **recorded as such, its selection resting on the push falling inside the window (2026-09-10)**. **⑬ ⚠️ The documentation is in English while the code directories, script names and maintainer’s notes are in Italian** — ⚠️ **the site itself is offered in four languages, but the repository’s comments and notes are mainly Italian**. **⑭ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/lucalevi/swiss-deductible-chooser` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence GPL-2.0, stars, forks, language JavaScript, size, created/pushed dates, topics and description); the 4,879-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, and the entry quotes its three negatives, its formula and two results, its runtime, its no-scraping reasons, its scope section, its three licence layers, its pipeline and its history; **all 90 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**81 files, 9 directories; the entry used this to check the three pipeline scripts, the five site asset files, the two font licence files, the workflow file, the maintainer’s note and the 46 generated data entries**); **nothing was cloned, no script or workflow was run, the live site was not opened, no source contents were read, the federal data source was not visited, no network observation was made, and no image was opened**.
