the entry converts them to U+2018 and U+2019 per the site convention, and notes the change)」，即 runbook 不是直接下載而是要請求一份——免費與付費之間一個中間層，且被明確寫出來）；③樣本的陳列規則被量化（首頁只放最近三份）；④且它說明新增一份會擠掉一塊磚（逐字「putting a new sample on the index means **displacing a tile, not appending one**」）；⭐⭐⭐把埋點事件名逐項公開：逐字含 `(cta: PREMIUM_get_full_report_click)`／`(cta: PREMIUM_book_call_click)`／`(cta: PREMIUM_linkedin_click)`／`(cta: request_copy_click)`／`(cta: linkedin_click)`；並逐字說明郵件事件與落表位置（「newsletter-email events（**open pixel + the labelled CTAs**）; **recipient in column G, campaign id in column B**」）；並逐字給出實現（「tenziTrack.trackCta(action) — **GET beacon via Image()**; global alias window.trackCta is defined for inline onclick attributes」）——四处已写明：①埋點事件名被寫進公開 README（本詞條認為這是一處不容易的透明：多數商業站點不會公開自己的轉化事件命名與落表結構，且它說明這些事件落在哪一列）；②而同一段也披露了開信像素（open pixel）——本詞條把兩面都寫出：公開埋點分類是一種透明，而開信像素本身是收件人可被追蹤的機制；讀者應同時知道這兩件事（不主張其使用方式違反任何法域的要求，未查任何法規）；③實現方式寫明為一個經 Image() 發出的 GET 信標；④另有一個全局別名供內聯 onclick 使用；⭐⭐⭐免費報告之一給出可核對的閾值與結果：「**Two Licences, One Week — Sphere & Regis** — one week of AR movement across two licences（June 2026）」與「**How Many ARs Make a Broking Network?** — **where the 5+ threshold falls: 99 of 211 licensees qualify and hold 95.8% of matched AR entities, the top 10 hold 70%**, and ten years of licensee size structure（July 2026）」——三处已写明：①「5+ 閾值落在哪裡」即先給出一個自定閾值（5 名以上授權代表）再給出該閾值下的結果（這是「先說口徑、再說數」的又一例）；②結果給了四個數（分母、覆蓋比例與集中度都寫明）；③它點名了兩家真實持牌機構（⚠️未核實該分析的正確性，亦不主張其結論）；⭐⭐數據來源點名到官方登記冊與開放數據平台（「- **ASIC Financial Advisers Register** — **AFS Licensee and Authorised Representative CSVs from data.gov.au**」）——两处已写明：①來源是監管機構的公開登記冊且給出文件類型與來源平台（讀者可以自己去取同一份數據）；②它區分了持牌人與授權代表兩個層級；⭐倉庫根目錄可核實文件逐項為：.claude/skills/read-context/SKILL.md、CLAUDE.md、CNAME、DASHBOARD.md、DESIGN_STANDARD.md、FEEDBACK.md、about-insurance-news-top20-2026.jpg、about.html、apps-script.gs、compliance-guide.thumb.jpg、compliance/{index.html,tenzi-arcs-small.svg}、index.html、**llms.txt**、og-frame.html、og.png 與 premium-samples/、reports/、runbooks/ 三個目錄——四处已写明：①⭐⭐⭐llms.txt 的存在值得單獨指出（即該站點向語言模型提供了自己的說明文件；⚠️未讀該文件內容，故不轉述其聲明）；②CLAUDE.md 與 .claude/skills/ 說明構建過程用了 AI 助手且這一點是公開的（與第 342 輪 prediction-lab-actuarial、第 343 輪 kong-insurance-api-bundle 同類）；③DESIGN_STANDARD.md 與 FEEDBACK.md 各自獨立成文件；④apps-script.gs 是一份 Google Apps Script（⚠️未讀其內容；結合其 Analytics 一節對落表位置的描述，它很可能與埋點收數有關，但這是本詞條的推斷，已標明）；⭐其餘細節：設計約束逐條寫明（逐字「Teal ramp（#0F766E → #5EEAD4）**only inside data visualisations**; **phase hues only on runbook step cards**」與「Premium pills use the Tenzi rainbow gradient（pink → orange → purple → cyan）」）；README 含 Hosting／Newsletter integration／Dashboard／Adding a new page／Compliance guide feedback 等多個運營章節；premium-samples/ 下實測含交互式 HTML 看板與 GIF／PNG 及縮略圖（例如 afsl-health-leaderboard.html、afsl_flow_PSC_CONNECT.gif、afsl_flow_RESILIUM_INSURANCE_BROKING.gif、gi-broker-race-chart.html、gi-broking-network-threshold.html、gi-emerging-network-growth.html，文件名點到了兩家真實機構）；⚠️⚠️未打開其線上站點、未運行任何一步（未克隆、未訪問 resources.tenzi.ai、未運行任何腳本、未打開任何看板或樣本），故不主張其站點可訪問、其報告所列數字（99／211、95.8%、70%）正確、其埋點確實如文檔所述工作——本條目核實到的是 README 的逐字聲明與其經 tree 接口實測的文件清單；⚠️⚠️未讀任何頁面、報告、runbook、看板或 llms.txt 的內容——即未核對 compliance/index.html 是否確實是那份合規指南（**這是本條最需要後續核實的一處**）、premium-samples/ 下的 HTML 是否確實是可用的看板、llms.txt 裡到底聲明了什麼；⚠️⚠️未核實 ../tenzi-compliance 是否存在、是否公開、以及其內容與這裡這份副本是否一致（只核實到 README 裡寫着這句話）——故不主張該上游倉庫確實存在（但其說明至少讓讀者知道這份內容不是在這裡生產的）；⚠️⚠️未核實其埋點實現是否與文檔一致、以及其開信像素是否符合任何法域對郵件追蹤的要求（未查任何法規、未做任何網絡觀察、未讀 apps-script.gs）；本詞條把「公開了埋點分類」與「使用了開信像素」兩件事並列寫出，不主張其使用方式合規或不合規；⚠️未核實其分析是否確實基於 ASIC 登記冊數據、以及其計算是否可複現（未下載該登記冊、未複算任何數字）；⭐不主張其任何報告可用於投資、併購、招聘或合規判斷；⚠️本詞條只如實轉述 README 中出現的個人姓名、機構名與報告標題，不主張其身份、資歷或關係的真實性；⚠️未核實其作者或所屬機構的性質；★0、fork 0、無 topics，關注度為零，不主張其成熟度或影響力；⚠️但其 README 達 16,036 位元組，而倉庫有 92 個文件、一份設計標準、一份反饋渠道、一份看板說明、一個 llms.txt 與一整套交互式樣本產物——即文檔與產出都相當完整而關注度為零的一種形態，應如實寫出，不用星數代替判斷；⚠️創建在解凍窗口之前（2026-04-01），入選依據是推送落在窗口之內（2026-09-09）；⚠️README 為英文（業務語境為澳大利亞）；⚠️本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見。核實手段補充說明：文件樹經 https://api.github.com/repos/rroosshhaann/tenzi-resources/git/trees/main?recursive=1 實測讀取；未克隆、未打開其線上站點、未讀任何頁面或報告內容、未讀 llms.txt 或 apps-script.gs、未下載 ASIC 登記冊、未做任何網絡觀察、未打開任何圖

entries.title: 一份把「理赔被拒之后怎么写申诉信」开源出来的 Django 应用：**154★／44 fork**，模型本体在另一个仓库，且它对「猜错的输入」明确标注为**未确认**并声明只是临时喂给模型
entries.title_en: A Django application that open-sources how to write an appeal letter after a claim denial — 154 stars and 44 forks — with the model itself in a separate repository and with guessed inputs explicitly marked unconfirmed and transient
entries.title_hk: 一份把「理賠被拒之後怎麼寫申訴信」開源出來的 Django 應用：**154★／44 fork**，模型本體在另一個倉庫，且它對「猜錯的輸入」明確標註為**未確認**並聲明只是臨時餵給模型
entries.summary: 一份**帮助人们在医疗保险理赔被拒后生成申诉信**的 Django 应用（线上站点为 fighthealthinsurance.com）：**把「申诉信怎么写」这件事本身开源出来**；**其模型本体不在本仓库**（**逐字指向另一个仓库 `healthinsurance-llm`**），**而本站部分则把「怎么接一个模型」写得很细**——**支持本地自托管模型与多家外部生成模型（Azure 上的 Claude 与 OpenAI、DeepInfra、Anthropic 等）**，**并有一条**优先级规则****：**无论开关怎么设，**本地／内部模型（如 `fhi-legacy`）与只提供上下文的模型**始终启用****；**另有三处细节值得记**：**① 它对**猜出来的输入**明确标注为未确认**——**聊天可以给模型一个「尽力而为、未确认」的推断（如所在州），而逐字说明「该推断在设计上是临时的：它以未确认的身份喂给模型」**；**② 每次部署都对**所有已启用的模型**跑一次端到端健康检查**；**③ 它部署在 Kubernetes 上（含 Helm charts）并有**311 个测试文件****；**⚠️ 而其实测 ★154、fork 44、许可为 **NOASSERTION**（**仓库内确有 `LICENSE` 文件，但 GitHub 无法归入单一 SPDX 标识**）
entries.summary_hk: 一份**幫助人們在醫療保險理賠被拒後生成申訴信**的 Django 應用（線上站點為 fighthealthinsurance.com）：**把「申訴信怎麼寫」這件事本身開源出來**；**其模型本體不在本倉庫**（**逐字指向另一個倉庫 `healthinsurance-llm`**），**而本站部分則把「怎麼接一個模型」寫得很細**——**支持本地自託管模型與多家外部生成模型（Azure 上的 Claude 與 OpenAI、DeepInfra、Anthropic 等）**，**並有一條**優先級規則****：**無論開關怎麼設，**本地／內部模型（如 `fhi-legacy`）與只提供上下文的模型**始終啟用****；**另有三處細節值得記**：**① 它對**猜出來的輸入**明確標註為未確認**——**聊天可以給模型一個「盡力而為、未確認」的推斷（如所在州），而逐字說明「該推斷在設計上是臨時的：它以未確認的身份餵給模型」**；**② 每次部署都對**所有已啟用的模型**跑一次端到端健康檢查**；**③ 它部署在 Kubernetes 上（含 Helm charts）並有**311 個測試文件****；**⚠️ 而其實測 ★154、fork 44、許可為 **NOASSERTION**（**倉庫內確有 `LICENSE` 文件，但 GitHub 無法歸入單一 SPDX 標識**）
entries.summary_en: A Django application that helps people generate appeal letters after a health insurance claim is denied, with a live site behind it, open-sourcing the act of writing such an appeal itself; **the model itself is not in this repository** — the README points verbatim at a separate model repository — **while this side documents in detail how to connect a model**, supporting both a self-hosted local model and several external generative providers including hosted Claude and OpenAI deployments, a third-party inference service and Anthropic directly, **with a stated precedence rule: regardless of the enable-list setting, local and internal models such as the legacy one and context-only models are always enabled**; **three details are worth recording**: **first, guessed inputs are explicitly marked unconfirmed**, since the chat can seed the model with a best-effort unconfirmed guess such as the user’s state, and the README states verbatim that the guess is transient by design because it is fed to the model as unconfirmed; **second, every deployment runs an end-to-end health check across all enabled models**; **and third, it deploys on Kubernetes with Helm charts and carries 311 test files**; ⚠️ **measured at 154 stars and 44 forks with a licence reading of NOASSERTION, since although a licence file exists in the repository GitHub cannot map it to a single SPDX identifier**
entries.body:
**health-denial-appeals**（仓库 `fighthealthinsurance/fighthealthinsurance`）**是一份帮助人们在医疗保险理赔被拒后生成申诉信的 Django 应用**：**其 README 第一句逐字为** **「A Django application to help people **appeal health insurance denials**.」**，**并逐字说明它是线上站点的 Web 界面**（**逐字「This is the web interface for Fight Health Insurance… which helps users **generate appeal letters when their health insurance claims are denied**.」**）。**实测 ★154、fork 44、许可 **NOASSERTION**（**实测仓库内**确有 `LICENSE` 文件**——**经 raw 探测返回 200**——**⚠️ 但 GitHub 无法归入单一 SPDX 标识**，**见标注 ①**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 66,579 KB、**创建 2023-03-16**、最后推送 2026-09-09、无 topics、无 homepage 字段**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建远早于解冻窗口**，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 15,796 字节**；**仓库实测共 **1,239 个文件、61 个目录**（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测，`truncated` 为 false**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把平时不外传的东西拿出来」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**关注度最高的一条（154★／44 fork），也是唯一一条**面向消费者维权**的****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「申诉信怎么写」这件事本身被开源，而模型本体在另一个仓库**——**这是本条最值得记的一处**：**逐字为** **「The **ML model is generated using this repo**」**（**指向 `github.com/fighthealthinsurance/healthinsurance-llm`**）**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **界面与模型**分成两个仓库**——**⭐ 即**「谁生成信」与「信长什么样、怎么发出去」被分开**；**② ⭐⭐ **本仓库的工作被逐条写明**（**申诉信生成、多模型接入、部署**）**；**③ **⭐ 本词条认为这一点对本轮主题很贴切：**申诉是一个**通常由保险公司的理赔或客服流程把持**的动作，**而它被开源成了一条任何人都能跑的流水线****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「模型从哪里来」写得很细，且有一条**优先级规则**保护本地模型**——**逐字为**：**「**Restricting which remote models load:** Set `ENABLED_REMOTE_MODELS` to a … **Always enabled** regardless of this setting: **local/internal models（e.g. `fhi-legacy`, the self-hosted backends）and context-only models**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **「无论这个开关怎么设，**本地／内部模型与只提供上下文的模型**始终启用」**——**⭐ 即**远程模型的开关**不可能把本地能力一起关掉**（**⭐ 本词条认为这是一条**保护底线的默认值**）；**② ⭐⭐ **它给出**多家外部提供方**（**本地自托管、第三方推理服务、Azure 上托管的 Claude 与 OpenAI、Anthropic**）**，**并逐项列出所需的环境变量**；**③ ⭐ **README 含**模型注册与友好名**、**启动时打印已加载模型**等运行细节**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它对「猜出来的输入」明确标注为**未确认**，并说明这只是临时的**——**逐字为** **「The chat can seed the model with a **best-effort, unconfirmed** guess of the … **The guess is transient by design: it is fed to the model as unconfirmed**」**（**其小节标题为 GeoIP**）**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「未确认」是**写给模型看的标注****——**⭐ 即**它不是对用户的免责，**而是把**这条输入的置信状态**随输入一起交给模型**（**⭐ 与第 341 轮 [[kakekomi-corpus]] 的「`:pending-primary-source` 随条目同行」、第 343 轮 [[kong-insurance-api-bundle]] 的「值就是 `[PREMIUM]`」同族**）；**② ⭐⭐ **「在设计上是临时的」**说明它**不落库**（**⭐ 即**这条猜测不会被当成用户资料存下来**）；**③ ⚠️ **而它确实用了**GeoIP**做这件事**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出：**这是一个**推断用户所在地**的机制，**⚠️ 本词条**未评估**其隐私影响**（**未读其实现、未做网络观察**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **每次部署都跑一次**全模型健康检查****——**逐字小节标题为** **「Model backend health checks** Every deployment runs an end-to-end health check of all **enabled** model…」**⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **健康检查是**端到端**的且**逐模型**的**——**⭐ 与第 344 轮 [[lloyds-news-digest]] 的「方法健康」同类**；**② **检查对象是**已启用的**模型**（**⭐ 即**被开关关掉的模型不被计入**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其依赖与部署形态写明，且是**生产级**的**：**① **系统依赖含 `tesseract-ocr` 与 `texlive`**（**⭐ 即**它做 OCR，**并生成排好版的 PDF 信**）；**② **实测 `k8s/` 下 29 个文件、`charts/` 下 14 个文件**（**⭐ 即**Kubernetes 清单与 **Helm charts**）**；**③ **实测 `tests/` 下有 **311 个文件****（**⭐ 即**测试面很宽**）**；**④ **实测含 `conf/`、`docs/`、`scripts/`、`.coveragerc`、`.env.example`、`.claude/`**。**⑥ ⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **README 给出两种安装路径**（**Conda／micromamba 与 venv**）并**逐条说明为何不要用 `--devserver`**（**逐字「do NOT use the `--devserver` flag. The default uvicorn server properly supports WebSockets/ASGI, but runserver_plus does not.」**）**——**⭐ 即**它讲清了**为什么**某个开关不能用**；**② **它支持**聊天式交互与实时更新**（**需 WebSocket／ASGI**）；**③ **Python 3.12（3.13 部分支持）被写明**。**⑦ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[bill-auditor-india]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[insurance-qa-evidence]]、[[claimlens]]、[[claims-integrity-investigator]]、[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]]、[[medical-opinion-extractor]]、[[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **许可实测为 **NOASSERTION****——**本词条经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 探测**确证其 `LICENSE` 文件存在**（**返回 200**）**，**⚠️ 但**本词条**未读该文件的内容**，**且**GitHub 判定为 **NOASSERTION****（**⭐ 即**该许可**不是** GitHub 能识别的标准许可之一**）**——**⚠️ 故**本词条**不主张**其代码、提示词、模板或部署清单可在任何条件下使用**，**使用、改写或再分发前应先读其 `LICENSE`**；**⭐ 本词条另指出：**一个 **154★／44 fork** 的项目采用**非标准许可**，**对想复用它的人来说是一个**需要先读清楚的现实门槛****。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未运行该应用的任何一步****——**未克隆（**其 66 MB 体量本词条**未下载 tarball，改用 tree 接口**）、未装 Python 依赖或系统依赖、未配置任何模型后端、未建数据库、未运行服务、未运行其 311 个测试文件中的任何一个、未打开其线上站点**；**故**本词条**不主张**其申诉信生成、多模型接入、健康检查或任何部署配置**已被复现**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的逐字声明与其**经 tree 接口实测的文件结构**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何源码、提示词、模板或 Helm 清单的内容****——**⭐ 即**本词条**未核对**：**是否真的按其所列多后端方式接入**（**⚠️ **health-denial-appeals**（倉庫 `fighthealthinsurance/fighthealthinsurance`）**是一份幫助人們在醫療保險理賠被拒後生成申訴信的 Django 應用**：**其 README 第一句逐字為** **「A Django application to help people **appeal health insurance denials**.」**，**並逐字說明它是線上站點的 Web 界面**（**逐字「This is the web interface for Fight Health Insurance… which helps users **generate appeal letters when their health insurance claims are denied**.」**）。**實測 ★154、fork 44、許可 **NOASSERTION**（**實測倉庫內**確有 `LICENSE` 文件**——**經 raw 探測返回 200**——**⚠️ 但 GitHub 無法歸入單一 SPDX 標識**）、主語言 Python、體量 66,579 KB、**創建 2023-03-16**、最後推送 2026-09-09、無 topics、無 homepage 字段**（**⚠️ 創建遠早於解凍窗口，推送落在窗口之內**）；**README 實測 15,796 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 **1,239 個文件、61 個目錄**（**經 GitHub API tree 接口實測，`truncated` 為 false**）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把平時不外傳的東西拿出來」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**關注度最高的一條（154★／44 fork），也是唯一一條**面向消費者維權**的****。

**health-denial-appeals** (repository `fighthealthinsurance/fighthealthinsurance`) **is a Django application that helps people generate appeal letters after a health insurance claim is denied**: **its README opens verbatim by calling itself a Django application to help people appeal health insurance denials**, **and states verbatim that it is the web interface for a live service that helps users generate appeal letters when claims are denied**. **Measured ★154, 44 forks, licence **NOASSERTION** (a `LICENSE` file measurably exists, confirmed by a raw probe returning 200, ⚠️ **but GitHub cannot map it to a single SPDX identifier**), primary language Python, a 66,579 KB repository, **created 2023-03-16**, last pushed 2026-09-09, no topics and no homepage field** (all GitHub API measurements; ⚠️ **creation far predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it**); **the README measures 15,796 bytes**; **the repository measures 1,239 files and 61 directories**, read through the GitHub trees endpoint with truncation false. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **bringing out what is normally kept in-house**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the most noticed — 154 stars and 44 forks — and the only one aimed at consumer advocacy**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① Writing the appeal letter is itself open-sourced, while the model lives in a separate repository** — verbatim, the machine-learning model is generated using another repository, named in the README ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the interface and the model are split across two repositories, separating who generates the letter from what the letter looks like and how it is sent**; ⭐⭐ **this repository’s own work is itemised as appeal-letter generation, multi-model integration and deployment**; **and ⭐ appealing a denial is normally an action held by an insurer’s claims or service process, and here it becomes a pipeline anyone can run**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It documents where models come from in detail, with a precedence rule protecting local ones** — verbatim, a switch restricts which remote models load, but **regardless of that setting, local and internal models such as the legacy one and the self-hosted backends, and context-only models, are always enabled** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **the switch cannot turn off local capability along with remote models, a default that protects a floor**; ⭐⭐ **it lists several external providers, from a self-hosted local model to a third-party inference service and hosted Claude and OpenAI deployments on Azure, with the environment variables each needs**; **and it documents runtime details such as model registration under friendly names and printing the loaded models at startup**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Guessed inputs are explicitly marked unconfirmed, and the marking is described as transient** — verbatim, the chat can seed the model with a **best-effort, unconfirmed** guess, and **the guess is transient by design because it is fed to the model as unconfirmed**, under a heading naming a geolocation mechanism ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the word unconfirmed is an annotation addressed to the model rather than a disclaimer to the user: the confidence state of that input travels with it**, ⭐ **the same family as round 341’s pending-verification marker travelling with each record and round 343’s placeholder that is literally the cell value**; ⭐⭐ **being transient by design means the guess is not persisted**; **and ⚠️ it does use a geolocation mechanism to make that guess, whose privacy implications this entry noted but did not assess**. **④ ⭐⭐ Every deployment runs a health check across all enabled models** — the section heading reads verbatim that every deployment runs an end-to-end health check of all **enabled** models ⭐⭐ **Two things**: **the check is end-to-end and per model**, ⭐ **the same family as round 344’s method health**; **and the check covers the enabled set, so models switched off are excluded**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its dependencies and deployment shape are stated and production-grade**: **system dependencies include an OCR engine and a TeX distribution, so it reads scans and produces typeset PDF letters**; **29 files under a Kubernetes directory and 14 under a charts directory were measured, so there are manifests and Helm charts**; **311 files were measured under the tests directory, so the test surface is wide**; **and measured directories include configuration, docs, scripts, a coverage config, an env example and an assistant configuration**. **⑥ ⭐ Other details**: **two install paths are given, with an explicit reason not to use a particular development flag, since the default server supports WebSockets properly and the alternative does not**; **chat interaction with real-time updates is supported**; **and the Python versions supported are stated, with one partially supported**. **⑦ ⭐ Readable with** [[bill-auditor-india]], [[evidence-review-claims]], [[insurance-qa-evidence]], [[claimlens]], [[claims-integrity-investigator]], [[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]], [[medical-opinion-extractor]], [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] and [[insurance-governance]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as NOASSERTION** — **a raw probe confirmed a `LICENSE` file exists, returning 200**, ⚠️ **but its contents were not read and GitHub reads it as NOASSERTION, so it is not a standard licence GitHub recognises** — ⚠️ **so no claim is made that its code, prompts, templates or deployment manifests may be used under any conditions, and its licence should be read before use, modification or redistribution**; ⭐ **a project at 154 stars and 44 forks under a non-standard licence presents a real threshold to clear before reuse**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No part of the application was run** — **nothing was cloned, its 66 MB size having led this entry to use the trees endpoint instead of a tarball; no dependencies were installed, no model backend configured, no database created, no service started, none of its 311 test files was run, and its live site was not opened**; **so its letter generation, multi-model integration, health checks and deployment configuration are not claimed to have been reproduced** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and its file structure as measured through the trees endpoint**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No source, prompt, template or Helm manifest was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: whether the multiple backends really connect as described, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry; whether the unconfirmed guess really enters the prompt marked as unconfirmed; and whether the health check really covers every enabled model**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ The quality, legal accuracy and jurisdictional fit of the letters it produces were not verified** — ⚠️ **no letter was generated or read and no regulation was consulted**; **no claim is made that its output substitutes for a lawyer or a licensed representative**, ⚠️ **and this entry did not encounter such a statement in the portion of the README it read, which it states plainly as a limit of its reading**. **⑤ ⚠️⚠️ The actual behaviour, data flow and compliance of its geolocation guess and network tracking were not verified**. **⑥ ⚠️ How its external model providers handle the medical information users submit was not verified** — ⭐ **a substantive question for medical data flowing to third-party models** — ⚠️ **the portion of the README read was mainly deployment and configuration and did not cover privacy, so anyone intending to use it should verify this themselves**. **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ The nature of its author and organisation, whether it is a non-profit, and the operating status of its live service were not verified**. **⑧ ⭐ At 154 stars and 44 forks**, **this is the most noticed entry this session has collected**, ⭐ **which the entry records as a rare case of wide uptake without claiming any relation between stars and quality**. **⑨ ⚠️ It was created before the thaw window, on 2023-03-16** — **selection resting on the push falling inside the window (2026-09-09)**. **⑩ ⚠️ The README is in English**. **⑪ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/fighthealthinsurance/fighthealthinsurance` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence NOASSERTION, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); entries.title: 一份把**养老金改革的精算引擎**开源的项目：**「没有运行依赖、没有构建、没有服务器——仓库里的东西就是发布出去的东西」**，并把「Gompertz–Makeham、终身与联合年金、Monte Carlo、分要素人口预测、隐含补贴与内部收益率」全部放在一个 JS 文件里
entries.title_en: A project that open-sources the actuarial engine of a pension reform — with no runtime dependencies, no build and no server, so what is in the repository is exactly what is published — and puts Gompertz-Makeham, individual and joint annuities, Monte Carlo, component demographic projection, implicit subsidies and internal rate of return all in one JavaScript file
entries.title_hk: 一份把**養老金改革的精算引擎**開源的項目：**「沒有運行依賴、沒有構建、沒有服務器——倉庫裡的東西就是發布出去的東西」**，並把「Gompertz–Makeham、終身與聯合年金、Monte Carlo、分要素人口預測、隱含補貼與內部收益率」全部放在一個 JS 文件裡
entries.summary: 一份对**哥伦比亚养老金制度与 2024 年第 2381 号法律**做技术分析的**交互式平台**：含**历史序列、逐条拆解该法、改革前后计算器、**可审计的精算与人口模型**、**隐含补贴**的计量、把某个具名批评者的论点与**一手来源**逐条对照，以及一章关于自动化与人工智能**；**其最值得记的一处是它把「模型是什么」逐项写在文件表里**——**`js/models.js` 一行逐字为**「**精算引擎（**已校准的 Gompertz–Makeham**、个人与联合终身年金、第 100 号法与第 2381 号法、半缴费制、过渡、工作史与 IBL）、**Monte Carlo**、**分要素人口预测**、**按 CARF 校准的储蓄基金模型**、**隐含补贴**与**内部收益率**」**；**而另一行把「来源」写成数据结构**——**`js/data.js` 逐字含**「**编号来源、带其出处的数据序列**、时间线、**该法 95 个条文及其在 2026 年 C-264 号判决后的状态**、某评论者的专栏与论点」**；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① 逐字「**没有运行依赖、没有构建、没有服务器。仓库里的东西就是发布出去的东西。**」（**⭐ 即**「你拿到什么」被写成结构性的、而不是承诺性的**）；**② 模型**可被一条命令验证****（**逐字「`node tests/test_models.js`」，其文件表把该文件说明为「**校准用例**」**）；**③ **工作史输入不出浏览器****（**逐字「Los datos no salen del navegador」**）；**此外它把**移动端借助 AI 助手的维护流程**写成五步**（**自然语言或语音提出改动 → 代理在云端工作、开 PR → 在手机上批准后 GitHub Pages 一分钟内重新发布**），**并说明根目录的 `CLAUDE.md` 提供**引用规则、来源层级、视觉识别与「如何验证这些模型」****
entries.summary_hk: 一份對**哥倫比亞養老金制度與 2024 年第 2381 號法律**做技術分析的**交互式平台**：含**歷史序列、逐條拆解該法、改革前後計算器、**可審計的精算與人口模型**、**隱含補貼**的計量、把某個具名批評者的論點與**一手來源**逐條對照，以及一章關於自動化與人工智能**；**其最值得記的一處是它把「模型是什麼」逐項寫在文件表裡**——**`js/models.js` 一行逐字為**「**精算引擎（**已校准的 Gompertz–Makeham**、個人與聯合終身年金、第 100 號法與第 2381 號法、半繳費制、過渡、工作史與 IBL）、**Monte Carlo**、**分要素人口預測**、**按 CARF 校准的儲蓄基金模型**、**隱含補貼**與**內部收益率**」**；**而另一行把「來源」寫成數據結構**——**`js/data.js` 逐字含**「**編號來源、帶其出處的數據序列**、時間線、**該法 95 個條文及其在 2026 年 C-264 號判決後的狀態**、某評論者的專欄與論點」**；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① 逐字「**沒有運行依賴、沒有構建、沒有服務器。倉庫裡的東西就是發布出去的東西。**」（**⭐ 即**「你拿到什麼」被寫成結構性的、而不是承諾性的**）；**② 模型**可被一條命令驗證****（**逐字「`node tests/test_models.js`」，其文件表把該文件說明為「**校准用例**」**）；**③ **工作史輸入不出瀏覽器****（**逐字「Los datos no salen del navegador」**）；**此外它把**移動端借助 AI 助手的維護流程**寫成五步**（**自然語言或語音提出改動 → 代理在雲端工作、開 PR → 在手機上批准後 GitHub Pages 一分鐘內重新發布**），**並說明根目錄的 `CLAUDE.md` 提供**引用規則、來源層級、視覺識別與「如何驗證這些模型」****
entries.summary_en: An interactive platform for technical analysis of the Colombian pension system and Law 2381 of 2024, containing historical series, the law taken article by article, a before-and-after reform calculator, auditable actuarial and demographic models, measurement of implicit subsidies, a named critic’s arguments checked against primary sources, and a chapter on automation and artificial intelligence; **its most notable feature is that the models are itemised in a file table** — the actuarial engine line reads verbatim as a calibrated Gompertz-Makeham engine, individual and joint life annuities, two pension laws, the semi-contributory regime, transition, employment history and the contribution base, plus Monte Carlo, component-based demographic projection, a savings-fund model calibrated to a named fund, implicit subsidies and internal rate of return; **and another line makes provenance a data structure**, the data file holding numbered sources, data series with their origin, a timeline, all 95 articles of the law with their status after a 2026 constitutional ruling, and a named commentator’s columns and arguments; **three further points follow the same discipline**: **first, verbatim, there are no runtime dependencies, no build and no server, so what is in the repository is exactly what is published** — making what you receive a structural fact rather than a promise; **second, the models are verifiable by a single command**, with the file table describing the test file as calibration cases; **and third, employment-history input does not leave the browser**; **the README also documents a five-step mobile editing workflow through an AI assistant**, in which a change is requested in natural language or by voice, the agent works in the cloud and opens a pull request, and approving it from the phone republishes the site in under a minute, **with a root instruction file giving the agent citation rules, a source hierarchy, visual identity and how to verify the models**
entries.body:
**colombian-pension-observatory**（仓库 `Michaellara12/semanas`，站点名 SEMANAS）**是一份对哥伦比亚养老金制度与 2024 年第 2381 号法律做技术分析的交互式平台**：**其 README 首段逐字列出平台内容**——**「历史序列、**逐条拆解该法**、**改革前后计算器**、**可审计的精算与人口模型**、**隐含补贴**的计量、**把 Jerome Sanabria 的批评与一手来源逐条对照**，以及一章关于自动化与人工智能」**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **NONE**（**实测该仓库无任何许可文件**）、主语言 JavaScript、仓库体量 22,510 KB、创建 2026-09-05、最后推送 2026-09-08、topics 为 `actuarial`／`colombia`／`datos-abiertos`／`ley-2381`／`pensiones`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建日**即窗口边界，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 3,437 字节（**西班牙语**）**；**仓库实测共 114 个条目（97 个文件、17 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把平时不外传的东西拿出来」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把「平时不外传的东西」定义得最专业的一条——**养老金改革的精算引擎****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「没有依赖、没有构建、没有服务器」，并把「你拿到什么」写成**结构性事实****——**这是本条最值得记的一处**：**逐字为** **「Sin dependencias de ejecución, sin compilación y sin servidor. **Lo que está en el repositorio es exactamente lo que se publica.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **三个否定各封掉一层**（**无运行依赖／无构建／无服务器**）**——**⭐ 即**它排除了「你拿到的不是跑起来的那份」这一常见情况**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **第三句把它变成一条**关于同一性**的断言**（**「仓库里的东西**正是**发布出去的东西」**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本会话**第三次**见到同类声明（**第 344 轮 [[insurek-swiss-deductible]] 的「公式与数字都在本仓库里」、第 343 轮 [[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]] 的**反面**「仓库里只有桥接层」**），**而这一条是**三者里最强的一种表述****（**⭐ 因为它断言的是**同一**，而不只是**包含**）；**③ **本词条**实测核实了其结构基础**：**其说明的 `index.html`、`css/styles.css`、`js/` 下五个脚本、`tests/`、`vendor/tex-svg.js` 与 `build.py`**均在仓库中**（**⭐ 其中 `build.py` 被逐字标注为**可选****）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **精算引擎的构成被逐项写在一个文件表里**——**`js/models.js` 一行逐字为**：**「**Motor actuarial**（**Gompertz–Makeham calibrada**, **rentas vitalicias individuales y conjuntas**, **Ley 100 y Ley 2381**, semicontributivo, transición, historia laboral e IBL）, **Monte Carlo**, **proyección demográfica por componentes**, **modelo del Fondo de Ahorro calibrado al CARF**, **subsidios implícitos** y **tasa interna de retorno**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **九类方法被逐项列出**（**已校准的 Gompertz–Makeham 死亡率／个人与联合终身年金／两部养老金法／半缴费制／过渡／工作史与 IBL／Monte Carlo／分要素人口预测／按 CARF 校准的储蓄基金模型／隐含补贴／内部收益率**）**——**⭐ 即**读者**不必先读代码就知道这个引擎覆盖什么****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「可审计」（auditables）是本条与**本会话多条**的呼应**：**第 342 轮 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 的「三层验证」、第 344 轮 [[lloyds-news-digest]] 的「原始尝试与胜出者都留下」同属一族**（**⭐ 而这里的载体是**一条命令可跑的校准用例**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **它点名了校准对象**（**CARF** 与 **IBL**）**——**⭐ 即**模型不是凭空写的，**而是**对着具名的对象校准的****；**④ **「个人与联合年金」并列**——**⭐ 即**它覆盖了**遗属/联合生命**这一类**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其实现正确**，**见标注 ③**）。**③ ⭐⭐ **另一行把「来源」写成**数据结构**，而不是参考文献列表**——**`js/data.js` 一行逐字为**：**「**Fuentes numeradas**, series de datos **con su origen**, línea de tiempo, **los 95 artículos de la ley con su estado tras la Sentencia C-264 de 2026**, columnas y tesis de Jerome Sanabria.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「编号来源」＋「数据序列**带其出处**」**——**⭐ 即**出处是**随数据走的一个字段**，**而不是文末的一段致谢**（**⭐ 与第 340 轮 [[insurance-portfolio-performance]] 的「出典随自治体数据同行」同族**）；**② ⭐⭐ **「该法 95 个条文**及其在 2026 年 C-264 号判决后的状态**」**——**⭐ 即**它记录的不只是法条，**还有**一次合宪性判决之后每一条的状态****；**③ ⭐⭐ **它把一个具名批评者的专栏与论点**作为数据收录****，**以便与一手来源逐条对照**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是一种**把争论本身也放进证据体系**的做法**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**该对照的结论**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **模型**可被一条命令验证**，且这一点写在文件表里**——**逐字** **「`tests/test_models.js` | **Casos de calibración**」**，**并在「本地使用」一节逐字给出** **「Verificar los 可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「沒有依賴、沒有構建、沒有服務器」，並把「你拿到什麼」寫成**結構性事實****：**「Sin dependencias de ejecución, sin compilación y sin servidor. **Lo que está en el repositorio es exactamente lo que se [[verified-reserving]]、[[credibility-gated-xai]]、[[insurance-calibration]]、[[lossratio-r]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[kokuho-rules-engine]]、[[insurek-swiss-deductible]]、[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]、[[prediction-lab-actuarial]] 並讀**。

entries.body_en:
**colombian-pension-observatory** (repository `Michaellara12/semanas`, site name SEMANAS) **is an interactive platform for technical analysis of the Colombian pension system and Law 2381 of 2024**: **its opening paragraph lists the platform’s contents verbatim** — historical series, the law taken article by article, a before-and-after reform calculator, **auditable actuarial and demographic models**, measurement of implicit subsidies, a named critic’s arguments checked against primary sources, and a chapter on automation and artificial intelligence. **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **NONE** (the repository measurably has no licence file), primary language JavaScript, a 22,510 KB repository, created 2026-09-05, last pushed 2026-09-08, topics `actuarial`, `colombia`, `datos-abiertos`, `ley-2381` and `pensiones`** (all GitHub API measurements; ⚠️ **creation is on the window boundary and the push falls inside it**); **the README measures 3,437 bytes and is in **Spanish****; **the repository measures 114 entries (97 files, 17 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **bringing out what is normally kept in-house**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it defines that in-house material most professionally, as the actuarial engine of a national pension reform**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① No dependencies, no build, no server, and what you receive is made a structural fact** — verbatim, there are no runtime dependencies, no compilation and no server, and **what is in the repository is exactly what is published** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the three negatives each close off a layer, ruling out the common case where what you receive is not what runs**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the third sentence turns it into an assertion of identity rather than of containment** — ⭐ **the third time this session has seen such a claim, after round 344’s statement that the formula and the numbers are both in the repository and round 343’s opposite case where the repository holds only a bridge layer, and this is the strongest of the three because it asserts sameness rather than inclusion**; **and this entry verified its structural basis, since the page, stylesheet, five scripts, tests, a local typesetting library and an optional build script all exist in the repository**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ The composition of the actuarial engine is itemised in a file table** — verbatim, the models file holds a **calibrated Gompertz-Makeham** engine, **individual and joint life annuities**, **two pension laws**, the semi-contributory regime, transition, employment history and the contribution base, plus **Monte Carlo**, **component-based demographic projection**, **a savings-fund model calibrated to a named fund**, **implicit subsidies** and **internal rate of return** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **nine families of method are listed, so a reader knows what the engine covers without reading code**; ⭐⭐⭐ **being auditable echoes several entries this session, from round 342’s three validation layers to round 344’s retention of raw attempts alongside the winner, with the vehicle here being calibration cases runnable by one command**; ⭐⭐ **it names what the models were calibrated against rather than leaving them afloat**; **and individual and joint annuities sit side by side, covering survivorship and joint-life cases** (⚠️ **without this entry claiming the implementation is correct**). **③ ⭐⭐ Another line makes provenance a data structure rather than a reference list** — verbatim, the data file holds **numbered sources**, **data series with their origin**, a timeline, **all 95 articles of the law with their status after a 2026 constitutional ruling**, and a named commentator’s columns and arguments ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **numbered sources plus series carrying their own origin makes provenance a field travelling with the data rather than an acknowledgement at the end**, ⭐ **the same family as round 340’s citations travelling with each municipality’s record**; ⭐⭐ **it records not only the articles but each one’s status after a constitutional ruling**; **and ⭐⭐ it takes a named critic’s columns and arguments in as data so they can be checked against primary sources, putting the dispute itself inside the evidence system** (⚠️ **without verifying that comparison’s conclusions**). **④ ⭐⭐ The models are verifiable by one command, and the file table says so** — the test file is described verbatim as **calibration cases**, and the local-usage section gives the verification command verbatim ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **calibration cases test agreement with the calibration target**, ⭐ **the same family as round 344’s row-by-row check against a federal CSV**; **verification is a plain command needing no environment setup, consistent with the no-dependency claim**; **and ⚠️ this entry did not run it**. **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ It states how the most sensitive input is handled: it never leaves the browser** — verbatim, a work-history paste box accepts one line per period in a start, end, contribution-base format, weeks and an indexed contribution base are computed using the national statistics office price index, and **the data does not leave the browser** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **a work history is sensitive personal information and it is stated verbatim not to leave the browser, consistent with the no-server structure**; ⭐⭐ **the input format is specified**; **and ⭐⭐ the price index used for indexation is named**. **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ A mobile editing workflow through an AI assistant is written out in five steps, and the assistant is given rules to follow** — verbatim, open the assistant in a phone browser or app, choose the repository, **request the change in natural language, by voice or text**, for example to update figures from a July bulletin or to add a chart of transfers by year; **the agent works in the cloud, leaves the changes on a branch and opens a pull request**; and approving that pull request from the phone republishes the site through GitHub Pages in under a minute; **with a root instruction file giving the agent the project’s context — citation rules, source hierarchy, visual identity and how to verify the models** — and a note that it is worth keeping that file up to date ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **asking an agent in natural language, by voice, to change a pension-analysis site and approving it from a phone is written as a standard operating procedure — the most concrete account of AI-assisted maintenance this site has collected**; ⭐⭐⭐ **and the assistant is given four things to obey, namely citation rules, a source hierarchy, visual identity and how to verify the models, so it is not a matter of letting a model change anything but of first handing it an evidence and verification standard**; ⭐⭐ **the one-minute republish is a checkable number**; **and ⭐⭐ keeping the instruction file current is itself treated as a product to maintain**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Other details**: **the status section gives a data cut-off date, the law’s entry into force as ruled in a 2026 judgment, and the note that the project is still evolving**, so the currency of the analysis is stated; **the file table also lists a bespoke SVG chart library covering line, bar, dual axis, donut, population pyramid, histogram, heat map and tornado charts, along with the interface file, visual identity including fonts and CSS variables, and a local typesetting library so formulas work offline**; **an optional build script produces a single-file distribution**; **the site has fifteen sections**; **and local usage is either opening the page directly or serving the folder locally**. **⑧ ⭐ Readable with** [[verified-reserving]], [[credibility-gated-xai]], [[insurance-calibration]], [[lossratio-r]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[kokuho-rules-engine]], [[insurek-swiss-deductible]], [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] and [[prediction-lab-actuarial]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as NONE** — **the repository measurably has no licence file and the README has no licence section**; ⚠️ **so no claim is made that its actuarial engine, data files, chart library or any content may be used under any conditions**, ⚠️ **and the entry notes in particular that the content is a technical analysis of a national legal reform including criticism of named individuals, so authorisation should be sought before republishing or adapting it**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No part of the project was run** — **nothing was cloned, neither the verification command nor the build script was run, its live site was not opened and no calculation or simulation was performed**; **so its actuarial models, demographic projections, implicit-subsidy measurements and internal-rate-of-return results are not claimed to have been reproduced** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and its file structure, every file it names having been confirmed to exist**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No source, data file or instruction file was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: whether the models file really implements those nine families of method, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry; whether the data file really holds numbered sources and the status of 95 articles; whether the test file really holds calibration cases; and what data the mortality parameters were calibrated to**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ Whether the statutes, judgments and official statistics it cites are accurate and current was not verified** (⚠️ **no Colombian legislative or judicial source and no national statistics or fund data was consulted**); **no claim is made that its legal or demographic conclusions are correct**. **⑤ ⚠️ Its claim that data does not leave the browser was not verified** (⭐ **a checkable engineering claim, ⚠️ but no network observation was made and its page scripts were not read**). **⑥ ⚠️⚠️ Whether it really works without a network connection was not verified** (**the README states that local typesetting makes formulas work offline, but no offline test was run**). **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its calculator or models are usable for anyone’s pension decision, any policy judgement or any institution’s actuarial work**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ Its author’s identity, background and any relationship to Colombian pension institutions were not verified**; ⭐ **the restatement of a named critic’s position is recorded as existing, with no claim that the position is right or wrong**. **⑨ ⚠️ The version and origin of the bundled typesetting library were not verified** (**a third-party build committed into the repository**, ⭐ **the same class of question as rounds 343 and 344 raised about a repository’s licence versus the rights in third-party material inside it**). **⑩ ⭐ At ★0 with 0 forks**, **attention is zero**, **so no maturity or reach is claimed**; ⚠️ **but ⭐⭐ its README measures only 3,437 bytes and yet gives in one page the platform’s full contents, an actuarial engine covering nine families of method, a provenance-bearing data structure, models verifiable by one command, an identity claim that the repository is the published artifact, a mobile AI maintenance workflow and a currency statement — very short documentation carrying substantial content in a specialised field**, **which the site records rather than letting star counts stand in for judgement**. **⑪ ⚠️ Its creation is on the window boundary and its push falls inside the window** — ⭐ **among the newest repositories this session has seen**. **⑫ ⚠️ The README, code and directory names are in Spanish** — ⭐ **a new language for the site’s coverage**, ⚠️ **though Spanish-language coverage is not claimed, since this entry was found through an actuarial topic rather than a Spanish keyword**. **⑬ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Michaellara12/semanas` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence NONE, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics); the 3,437-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, the entry quoting its opening paragraph, its dependency statement, its mobile workflow, its file table, its local usage and its status; **all 114 repository entries** were listed with `tar tz` after downloading the tarball from `codeload.github.com` (**97 files, 17 directories**); **nothing was cloned, no command or test was run, its live site was not opened, no source or data file contents were read, no Colombian official source was visited, no network observation was made, and no image was opened**.

boletín de julio»*／*«agrega una gráfica de traslados por año»*）→ 代理在云端工作、把改动留在分支上并开 PR → 在手机批准后 GitHub Pages 一分钟内重新发布），并逐字说明根目录 CLAUDE.md 给代理提供「引用规则、来源层级、视觉识别，以及如何验证这些模型」且最好保持更新——四处已写明：①它把「用自然语言让代理改一个养老金分析站点」写成标准操作流程（本站所收条目里对 AI 辅助维护写得最具體的一處）；②而它指定了助手必须遵守的四项（引用规则、来源层级、视觉识别、如何验证模型），即先给模型一套证据与验证规范；③「一分钟内重新发布」把延迟写成可核对的数字；④它明确要求保持 CLAUDE.md 更新（把「给助手的规范」本身当成需要维护的产物）；⭐⭐其餘细节：状态一節逐字给出信息截止日（2026 年 9 月 5 日）、该法生效日（2027 年 4 月 1 日，據 2026 年 C-264 号判决）与「Proyecto en evolución」；文件表另列出自有 SVG 图表库（线、柱、双轴、环、人口金字塔、直方图、热力图与龙卷风图）、界面文件、视觉识别（含字体与 CSS 变量，色板白／紫／黄／蓝）与本机 MathJax（逐字「para que las fórmulas funcionen sin conexión」）；build.py 生成 dist/ 单文件与 Artifact 变体且标注为可选；站点含 15 个章节；本地使用方式写明为可直接打开 index.html 或用 python -m http.server；⚠️⚠️未运行该项目的任何一步（未克隆、未运行 node tests/test_models.js、未运行 build.py、未打开其线上站点、未运行任何计算或模拟），故不主张其精算模型、人口预测、隐含补贴计量或内部收益率结果已被复现——本詞條核實到的是 README 的逐字聲明與其文件結構；⚠️⚠️未讀任何源碼、數據文件或 CLAUDE.md 的內容——即未核對 js/models.js 是否確實實現那九類方法（**這是本條最需要後續核實的一處**）、js/data.js 是否確實含編號來源與 95 個條文狀態、tests/test_models.js 是否確實是對校準對象的用例、其死亡率參數是否確實經過校準及校準到什麼數據；⚠️⚠️未核實其引用的法律條文、判決與官方統計是否準確、是否最新（未訪問哥倫比亞立法或司法來源、未訪問 DANE 或 CARF 的數據）；不主张其法律或人口結論正確；⚠️未核實其「數據不出瀏覽器」這一聲明（這是一個可被檢驗的工程主張，但未做網絡觀察、未讀其頁面腳本）；⚠️⚠️未核實其實用時是否確實不需要聯網（其 README 稱本機 MathJax 使公式離線可用，但未斷網測試）；⭐不主张其計算器或模型可用於任何個人的養老金決策、任何政策判斷或任何機構的精算工作；⭐未核實其作者身份、資歷或與哥倫比亞養老金機構的關係；其收錄的對某位具名批評者的轉述，本詞條只如實轉述其存在，不主张其观点成立或不成立；⚠️未核實其 vendor/tex-svg.js 的版本與來源（打包進來的第三方 MathJax 構建，與第 343／344 輪記錄的「倉庫許可 vs 其中第三方材料的權利」是同一類問題）；★0、fork 0，關注度為零，不主张其成熟度或影響力；⚠️但其 README 僅 3,437 位元組，而它在一頁裡給出了平台全部內容、一個含九類方法的精算引擎、一份帶出處的數據結構、可一條命令驗證的模型、一條「倉庫即發布物」的同一性斷言、一套移動端 AI 維護流程與一份時效說明——即極短的文檔承載了一個專業領域裡相當重的内容的一種形態，應如實寫出，不用星數代替判斷；⚠️創建日即窗口邊界（2026-09-05），推送在窗口之內（2026-09-08），是本會話所見最新的一批倉庫之一；⚠️README 為西班牙語，代碼與目錄名為西班牙語——這是本條目在語言維度上的一處新增覆蓋（本會話此前已收日語、意大利語等）；⚠️不主张已覆盖西语生态（該條是由 topic:actuarial 命中的，而非西語關鍵詞）；⚠️本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見。核實手段補充說明：倉庫全部 114 個條目經下載 codeload.github.com tarball 後以 tar tz 列出核對；未克隆、未運行任何命令或測試、未打開其線上站點、未讀任何源碼或數據文件內容、未訪問任何哥倫比亞官方來源、未做任何網絡觀察、未打開任何圖

entries.title: 一个把「经纪公司平时怎么运作」整个开源的平台（西语代码库、MIT）：**每一次预测都记录模型、版本、输入特征与一句人话解释，且**从不覆盖业务记录——人的决定永远优先****；而**已上线的模型自称是「可解释的基线」并说明自己是给学习模型设的下限**
entries.title_en: A platform that open-sources how a brokerage actually operates — a Spanish-language codebase under MIT — where every prediction records its model, version, input features and a plain-language explanation and never overwrites a business record, since a human decision always wins, and where the shipped models call themselves interpretable baselines and serve as a floor for a learned model to beat
entries.title_hk: 一個把「經紀公司平時怎麼運作」整個開源的平台（西語代碼庫、MIT）：**每一次預測都記錄模型、版本、輸入特徵與一句人話解釋，且**從不覆蓋業務記錄——人的決定永遠優先****；而**已上線的模型自稱是「可解釋的基線」並說明自己是給學習模型設的下限**
entries.summary: 一份面向**保险经纪公司**的平台（西语代码库）：把「客户 → 网站 → 申请 → CRM → 顾问 → 跟进 → 成交 → 续保」这一整条链路做成**一套系统**，**并从第一次迁移起就是多租户**（**逐字「one deployment serves many brokerages」**）；**其最值得记的一处是它对「预测」的处理规则**——**逐字「**每一次预测都记录模型、它的版本、它的输入特征和一句人可读的解释，而它们**从不覆盖任何业务记录。人的决定永远优先。**」**；**而第二处是它对自己模型的定位**——**逐字「已上线的模型是**可解释的基线**，而**它们自己也这么说**。它们的职责是在没有标注数据的情况下从第一天就能用、**记录未来真实模型要训练的那些特征**，**并成为一个学习模型必须超越的下限**」**；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① **智能不是一个后加的第三阶段功能**（**逐字「它从第一次迁移起就在 schema 里」，并指向一份关于「智能层」的架构决策记录**）；**② **线索评分把**理由给顾问看****（**逐字「with the reasons shown to the advisor」**）**；**③ **演示数据全为合成、由固定种子生成**（**逐字「All demo data is synthetic and generated from a fixed seed. **No real client data is in this repository.**」**）
entries.summary_hk: 一份面向**保險經紀公司**的平台（西語代碼庫）：把「客戶 → 網站 → 申請 → CRM → 顧問 → 跟進 → 成交 → 續保」這一整條鏈路做成**一套系統**，**並從第一次遷移起就是多租戶**（**逐字「one deployment serves many brokerages」**）；**其最值得記的一處是它對「預測」的處理規則**——**逐字「**每一次預測都記錄模型、它的版本、它的輸入特徵和一句人可讀的解釋，而它們**從不覆蓋任何業務記錄。人的決定永遠優先。**」**；**而第二處是它對自己模型的定位**——**逐字「已上線的模型是**可解釋的基線**，而**它們自己也這麼說**。它們的職責是在沒有標註數據的情況下從第一天就能用、**記錄未來真實模型要訓練的那些特徵**，**並成為一個學習模型必須超越的下限**」**；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① **智能不是一個後加的第三階段功能**（**逐字「它從第一次遷移起就在 schema 裡」，並指向一份關於「智能層」的架構決策記錄**）；**② **線索評分把**理由給顧問看****（**逐字「with the reasons shown to the advisor」**）**；**③ **演示數據全為合成、由固定種子生成**（**逐字「All demo data is synthetic and generated from a fixed seed. **No real client data is in this repository.**」**）
entries.summary_en: A platform for insurance brokerages, in a Spanish-language codebase, that makes the whole chain from client through website, request, CRM, advisor, follow-up, sale and renewal into one system, multi-tenant from the first migration so that one deployment serves many brokerages; **its most notable feature is its rule for predictions** — verbatim, every prediction records the model, its version, its input features and a human-readable explanation, and none of them ever overwrites a business record, because a human decision always wins; **and its second is how it positions its own models** — verbatim, the shipped models are interpretable baselines and they say so, their job being to work from day one with no labelled data, to log the features a real model will train on, and to be a floor that a learned model has to beat; **three further points follow the same discipline**: **the intelligence is not a phase-three feature bolted onto a CRM but is in the schema from the first migration**, pointing at an architecture decision record about the intelligence layer; **lead scoring shows its reasons to the advisor**; **and all demo data is synthetic from a fixed seed, with no real client data in the repository**
entries.body:
**corredor-broker-platform**（仓库 `Scarta19/corredor`，西语意为「经纪人／中介」）**是一份面向保险经纪公司的平台**：**把「客户 → 网站 → 申请 → CRM → 顾问 → 跟进 → 成交 → 续保」整条链路做成一套系统**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **MIT**（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 542 KB、**创建与最后推送同为 2026-09-10**、无 topics、无 homepage 字段**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内**）；**README 实测 6,752 字节**；**仓库实测共 273 个条目（202 个文件、71 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把平时不外传的东西拿出来」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把「一家经纪公司平时怎么运作」开源得最完整的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它给出了关于「预测」的一条规则，而这条规则的形状在本会话里很熟悉**——**逐字为**：**「Every prediction records **the model, its version, its input features and a human-readable explanation**, and **none of them ever overwrite a business record**. **A human decision always wins.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **四件东西随每一个预测一起存下**（**模型／版本／输入特征／一句人可读的解释**）**——**⭐ 即**「这个分数是怎么来的」是**随分数走的字段**（**⭐ 与第 340 轮 [[insurance-portfolio-performance]] 的「出典随自治体数据同行」、第 342 轮 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 的「夹具含中间值」同族**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「从不覆盖业务记录」是一条**禁止性规则****——**⭐ 即**预测**不能写回并改写客户、保单等业务数据**（**⭐ 本词条认为这是本节最实在的一句：**它把「模型只能提意见」写成了**数据层面的约束****）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「人的决定永远优先」**——**把人的优先权写成一句结论**（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[prediction-lab-actuarial]] 的「审批保持为人类专属且不可逆的行为」同族**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它对自己已上线的模型给出了**定位**，而且这个定位是「我不好，我知道」**——**逐字为**：**「**The shipped models are interpretable baselines, and they say so.** Their job is to **work from day one with no labelled data**, **log the features a real model will train on**, and **be a floor that a learned model has to beat**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「可解释的基线，而它们自己也这么说」**——**⭐ 即**它**不把基线当成品**，**而是**把基线的身份写在文档里****（**⭐ 本词条认为这与第 342 轮 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 的「a pricing-based prior would be the natural fix, **and I have not built or measured one**」是同一纪律的另一种表述**）；**② ⭐⭐ **「从第一天就能用、且记录未来真实模型要训练的特征」**——**⭐ 即**基线的两个职责被分别写明**（**今天可用／为将来铺路**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「一个学习模型必须超越的下限」**——**⭐ 即**它给未来的复杂模型设了一条**必须跨过的线**（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] 的「先拟合一个简单模型、确认它是否超过机会水平」可并读**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「AI 原生」定义成**schema 层面的事**，而不是一个功能**——**逐字为**：**「The intelligence isn’t a phase-three feature bolted onto a CRM — **it’s in the schema from the first migration**（**ADR-0005**）」**；**并逐条说明它的四个用途**：**线索评分**（**逐字「which of this month’s requests to call first, **with the reasons shown to the advisor**」**）、**续保风险**（**逐字「days-to-expiry is a calendar; churn probability is a work queue」**）、**交叉销售**、**消息理解**（**逐字「people write "necesito asegurar mi carro", not "1"」**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「不是一个加在 CRM 上的第三阶段功能」**——**⭐ 即**它区分了**「把 AI 接进来」与「把 AI 设计进去」****；**② ⭐⭐ **「续保风险」那一句把日历换成了工作队列**（**⭐ 即**它改变的是**顾问看什么**，而不只是**多一个分数**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **评分**把理由给顾问看****（**⭐ 即**可解释性被当作**给使用者的功能**而不是合规装饰**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **六个模块并列且状态都是 Done**（**专业网站／智能报价器／WhatsApp 渠道／CRM／续保／看板**）**，**且 WhatsApp 一项有一个脚注**——**逐字「Built and tested end to end; **sending needs the brokerage’s own Meta Business credentials**」**（**⭐ 即**它说清了**为什么这一项在别人的部署里不能直接用****）；**② **多租户从第一次迁移起**（**逐字「one deployment serves many brokerages, each with its own catalogue, forms, pipeline and book of business」**）；**③ **架构是模块化单体**并指向另一份决策记录**（**逐字 ADR-0001**）；**④ **技术栈逐项列出**（**Python 3.13／FastAPI／SQLAlchemy 2 async／Alembic／Pydantic v2；PostgreSQL 17／Redis；Next.js App Router／TypeScript／Tailwind；scikit-learn／Anthropic SDK；uv／ruff／mypy strict／pytest／GitHub Actions**）；**⑤ **本地启动逐条给出**（**`make install`／`make up`／`make migrate`／`make seed`／`make api`／`make web`，**并逐字说明需要一个带合成业务量的演示租户**）。**⑤ ⭐ **语言维度**：**其代码库、模块名、链路图与**架构决策记录的文件名**都是**西班牙语****（**如 `docs/adr/0005-capa-de-inteligencia.md`、`docs/adr/0001-monolito-modular.md`**）**。**⑥ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[brokerflow-renewal-crm]]、[[drtakaful-agent-crm]]、[[prediction-lab-actuarial]]、[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]、[[application-fill-provenance]]、[[insurance-client-attribution]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[colombian-pension-observatory]]。

**corredor-broker-platform** (repository `Scarta19/corredor`, the Spanish word for a broker or intermediary) **is a platform for insurance brokerages** that turns the whole chain from client to website, request, CRM, advisor, follow-up, sale and renewal into one system. **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **MIT** (a `LICENSE` file is measurably present), primary language Python, a 542 KB repository, created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-10, no topics and no homepage field** (all GitHub API measurements; **creation and push both fall inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 6,752 bytes**; **the repository measures 273 entries (202 files, 71 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **bringing out what is normally kept in-house**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it open-sources how a brokerage actually operates most completely**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It states a rule about predictions** — verbatim, every prediction records **the model, its version, its input features and a human-readable explanation**, and **none of them ever overwrites a business record**, because **a human decision always wins** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **four things travel with every prediction, so how a score was produced is a field that accompanies the score**, ⭐ **the same family as round 340’s provenance travelling with each municipality’s record and round 342’s fixtures carrying their intermediates**; ⭐⭐⭐ **never overwriting a business record is a prohibitive rule, making "the model may only advise" a constraint at the data layer**; **and ⭐⭐⭐ a human decision always winning states human precedence as a conclusion**, ⭐ **the same family as round 342’s approval being a human-only and irreversible act**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It positions its own shipped models, and the positioning is that they are not good and they know it** — verbatim, **the shipped models are interpretable baselines and they say so**, their job being to **work from day one with no labelled data**, **log the features a real model will train on**, and **be a floor that a learned model has to beat** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **calling them baselines that say so writes the baseline’s identity into the documentation rather than passing it off as a product**, ⭐ **the same discipline as round 342’s note that a better prior would be the natural fix and had not been built**; ⭐⭐ **the baseline’s two duties are separated, being usable today and paving the way for tomorrow**; **and ⭐⭐ being a floor a learned model has to beat sets a line future complexity must cross**, ⭐ **readable alongside round 342’s advice to fit a simple model and check whether it clears chance level**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It defines being AI-native as a schema-level matter rather than a feature** — verbatim, the intelligence is not a phase-three feature bolted onto a CRM but **is in the schema from the first migration**, pointing at an architecture decision record about the intelligence layer; **with four uses itemised**: **lead scoring** about which of this month’s requests to call first, **with the reasons shown to the advisor**; **renewal risk**, where days-to-expiry is a calendar while churn probability is a work queue; **cross-sell**; **and message understanding**, since people write that they need to insure their car rather than pressing one ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **not being a phase-three feature separates connecting AI to something from designing AI into it**; ⭐⭐ **the renewal-risk line replaces a calendar with a work queue, changing what the advisor looks at rather than merely adding a score**; **and ⭐⭐ scoring shows its reasons to the advisor, treating explainability as a feature for the user rather than compliance decoration**. **④ ⭐⭐ Other details**: **six modules are listed with every state marked done** — professional website, intelligent quoting, a WhatsApp channel, CRM, renewals and a dashboard — **with a footnote on the WhatsApp item reading verbatim that it is built and tested end to end but that sending needs the brokerage’s own business credentials**, ⭐ **so why that item cannot be used directly in someone else’s deployment is stated**; **multi-tenancy exists from the first migration, one deployment serving many brokerages each with its own catalogue, forms, pipeline and book of business**; **the architecture is a modular monolith, pointing at another decision record**; **the stack is itemised**; **and local startup steps are given command by command, including a demo tenant seeded with a synthetic book of business**. **⑤ ⭐ On language**: **the codebase, module names, the pipeline diagram and the architecture decision record filenames are all in Spanish**. **⑥ ⭐ Readable with** [[brokerflow-renewal-crm]], [[drtakaful-agent-crm]], [[prediction-lab-actuarial]], [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]], [[application-fill-provenance]], [[insurance-client-attribution]], [[insurance-data-tools]] and [[colombian-pension-observatory]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⭐ Licence is MIT** — **a `LICENSE` file is measurably present**, ⚠️ **whose contents were not read**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No part of the platform was run** — **nothing was cloned, no dependency was installed, no database or cache was created, no make target was run, no test or type check was run, and no interface was opened**; **so its six modules are not claimed to work, its multi-tenant isolation is not claimed to hold, and its prediction-recording mechanism is not claimed to be implemented** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and its file structure**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No source, migration or docs content was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: whether every prediction really records its model, version, features and explanation, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry; whether predictions really cannot overwrite business records; whether multi-tenant isolation is really implemented at the query entries.verified_note: GitHub API 实测（repo，2026-09-11）：⭐许可实测 **MIT**（实测仓库内含 LICENSE 文件；⚠️未读其内容）｜★0｜fork 0｜Python｜542 KB｜created 2026-09-10｜pushed 2026-09-10（**同日创建与推送**，均在解冻窗口之内）｜无 topics｜无 homepage 字段｜README 6,752 字节｜仓库实测共 273 个条目（202 文件、71 目录）；⭐⭐⭐关于「预测」的一条规则，逐字「Every prediction records **the model, its version, its input features and a human-readable explanation**, and **none of them ever overwrite a business record**. **A human decision always wins.**」——三处已写明：①四件东西随每一个预测一起存下（模型／版本／输入特征／一句人可读的解释，即「这个分数是怎么来的」是随分数走的字段；与第 340 轮 insurance-portfolio-performance 的「出典隨數據同行」、第 342 轮 ratecraft 的「夾具含中間值」同族）；②「从不覆盖业务记录」是一条禁止性规则（把「模型只能提意见」写成了数据层面的约束）；③「人的决定永远优先」（与第 342 轮 prediction-lab 的「审批保持为人类专属且不可逆的行为」同族）；⭐⭐⭐对自己模型的定位逐字「**The shipped models are interpretable baselines, and they say so.** Their job is to **work from day one with no labelled data**, **log the features a real model will train on**, and **be a floor that a learned model has to beat**.」——三处已写明：①「可解释的基线，而它们自己也这么说」（不把基线当成品，而是把基线的身份写在文档里；与第 342 轮 ratecraft 的「a pricing-based prior would be the natural fix, and I have not built or measured one」是同一纪律的另一種表述）；②「从第一天就能用、且记录未来真实模型要训练的特征」（基线的两个职责被分别写明）；③「一个学习模型必须超越的下限」（与第 342 轮 insurance-claims-risk-analytics 的「先擬合一個簡單模型、確認它是否超過機會水平」可並讀）；⭐⭐⭐「AI 原生」被定義成 schema 層面的事，逐字「The intelligence isn’t a phase-three feature bolted onto a CRM — **it’s in the schema from the first migration**（**ADR-0005**）」；並逐條說明四個用途（線索評分「with the reasons shown to the advisor」／續保風險「days-to-expiry is a calendar; churn probability is a work queue」／交叉銷售／消息理解「people write "necesito asegurar mi carro", not "1"」）——三处已写明：①「不是一个加在 CRM 上的第三阶段功能」（區分了「把 AI 接進來」與「把 AI 設計進去」）；②「續保風險」那一句把日曆換成了工作隊列；③評分把理由給顧問看（可解釋性被當作給使用者的功能而不是合規裝飾）；⭐⭐其餘細節：六個模組並列且狀態都是 Done（專業網站／智能報價器／WhatsApp 渠道／CRM／續保／看板），且 WhatsApp 一項有一個腳註逐字「Built and tested end to end; **sending needs the brokerage’s own Meta Business credentials**」（說清了為什麼這一項在別人的部署裡不能直接用）；多租戶從第一次遷移起（逐字「one deployment serves many brokerages, each with its own catalogue, forms, pipeline and book of business」）；架構是模組化單體並指向另一份決策記錄（ADR-0001）；技術棧逐項列出（Python 3.13／FastAPI／SQLAlchemy 2 async／Alembic／Pydantic v2；PostgreSQL 17／Redis；Next.js App Router／TypeScript／Tailwind；scikit-learn／Anthropic SDK；uv／ruff／mypy strict／pytest／GitHub Actions）；本地啟動逐條給出（make install／up／migrate／seed／api／web，並逐字說明需要一個帶合成業務量的演示租戶）；⭐語言維度：代碼庫、模組名、鏈路圖與架構決策記錄的文件名都是西班牙語（如 docs/adr/0005-capa-de-inteligencia.md、docs/adr/0001-monolito-modular.md）；⚠️⚠️未運行該平台的任何一步（未克隆、未安裝 uv／Node／Docker、未建 Postgres 或 Redis、未運行 make 任何目標、未運行 make test、未運行 mypy 或 ruff、未打開任何界面），故不主张其六個模組可用、其多租戶隔離成立、其預測記錄機制確實實現——本詞條核實到的是 README 的逐字聲明與其文件結構；⚠️⚠️未讀任何源碼、遷移或 docs/ 內容——即未核對「每一次預測都記錄模型、版本、特徵與解釋」是否確實實現（**這是本條最需要後續核實的一處**）、預測是否確實無法覆蓋業務記錄、多租戶隔離是否確實在查詢層實現（**這是一條安全相關的斷言，而本詞條只有 README 作依據**）、兩份 ADR 是否確實如描述；⚠️未核實其自述的模組 Done 狀態與實際完成度（**其首頁另有一句逐字「in active development… modules are being built in the order set out in the roadmap」——本詞條把這兩處並列寫出：模組表說六項 Done，而狀態行說仍在開發中；⚠️不主张這是矛盾，只如實記錄並指出讀者應以後者的整體判斷為準**）；⚠️未核實其演示數據是否確實全為合成（其 README 逐字聲明由固定種子生成、倉庫中無真實客戶數據；未讀任何種子或數據文件）；⚠️⚠️未核實其調用外部模型（Anthropic SDK）時如何傳輸客戶信息（**這是一個客戶數據流向第三方模型的實質問題**；未讀其隱私或數據處理說明）；⭐未核實其作者身份、資歷或該平台是否被任何經紀公司使用，不主张它已投入生產；★0、fork 0，關注度為零，且該倉庫在被檢索到時創建不足兩天——極新的倉庫，成熟度無從判斷；⚠️創建與推送同為 2026-09-10（均在解凍窗口之內）；⚠️README 為西班牙語與英語混用（敘述為英語，領域術語、模組名與 ADR 文件名為西班牙語），不主张其已有三語版本；⚠️本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見。核實手段補充說明：倉庫全部 273 個條目經下載 codeload.github.com tarball 後以 tar tz 列出核對；未克隆、未安裝任何依賴、未運行任何命令或測試、未讀任何源碼／遷移／文檔內容、未打開任何界面、未做任何網絡觀察、未打開任何圖

entries.title: 一家挪威保险公司把自己的**设计系统**开源成 MIT 项目（★77／fork 32）：**一份合并包 ＋ 可分开使用的样式表**，**两条发布通道（稳定与预发布）的过程逐步写出**，并**逐条说明为什么要关掉 ESLint 以免与所选工具冲突**
entries.title_en: A Norwegian insurer has open-sourced its design system under MIT — 77 stars and 32 forks — with one consolidated package plus separately usable stylesheets, a two-channel release process written out step by step, and an explicit account of why ESLint should be disabled so it does not conflict with the chosen tooling
entries.title_hk: 一家挪威保險公司把自己的**設計系統**開源成 MIT 項目（★77／fork 32）：**一份合併包 ＋ 可分開使用的樣式表**，**兩條發布通道（穩定與預發布）的過程逐步寫出**，並**逐條說明為什麼要關掉 ESLint 以免與所選工具衝突**
entries.summary: 一家**挪威保险公司**（Fremtind）**把自己对外的设计系统开源**（MIT，线上为 jokul.fremtind.no）：**提供现成的 React 组件，以及用于其基础组件与设计模式（Design Patterns）的 CSS 与 SCSS 样式表**，**并说明组件与样式表现在作为**一份合并包**交付**（**`@fremtind/jokul`**），**而 CSS 仍作为单独样式表提供**——**逐字理由是「如果你不用 React，仍然可以使用 Jøkul」**；**其最值得记的一处是它把**两条发布通道的完整过程**写成了十步**——**`main` 发布稳定版；`release/next` 在每次向 `main` 推送时**自动同步**以保持预发布分支跟随已合并并已稳定发布的内容**；**若同步遇到冲突，则复用一条固定的同步分支与**一个同步 PR** 供人工解决；**当该同步 PR 不再需要时，只要同步分支里没有 `release/next` 缺失的自有提交，就自动清理****——**并给出 changeset 流程与 `pnpm release:pre:exit`／`release:version` 等具体命令**；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① 它逐条说明**为什么要把 ESLint 关掉****（**逐字「使你的 IDE 使用 Biome，以免它与我们的设置争吵」**，**并给出要取消勾选的具体项与说明「这些改动也应在 Workspace 下做」**）；**② 它有一个**挪威语的贡献者行为准则**并逐字称 Jøkul 是一个开放而积极的共同体**；**③ 实测根目录含 `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`、`.all-contributorsrc`、`.czrc`、`.changeset/`、`.husky/`、`.nvmrc` 与 `visual-regression/`**（**⭐ 即**贡献者名录、提交规范、变更集、Git 钩子、Node 版本与视觉回归各自有位置**）
entries.summary_hk: 一家**挪威保險公司**（Fremtind）**把自己對外的設計系統開源**（MIT，線上為 jokul.fremtind.no）：**提供現成的 React 組件，以及用於其基礎組件與設計模式（Design Patterns）的 CSS 與 SCSS 樣式表**，**並說明組件與樣式表現在作為**一份合併包**交付**（**`@fremtind/jokul`**），**而 CSS 仍作為單獨樣式表提供**——**逐字理由是「如果你不用 React，仍然可以使用 Jøkul」**；**其最值得記的一處是它把**兩條發布通道的完整過程**寫成了十步**——**`main` 發布穩定版；`release/next` 在每次向 `main` 推送時**自動同步**以保持預發布分支跟隨已合併並已穩定發布的內容**；**若同步遇到衝突，則複用一條固定的同步分支與**一個同步 PR** 供人工解決；**當該同步 PR 不再需要時，只要同步分支裡沒有 `release/next` 缺失的自有提交，就自動清理****——**並給出 changeset 流程與 `pnpm release:pre:exit`／`release:version` 等具體命令**；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① 它逐條說明**為什麼要把 ESLint 關掉****（**逐字「使你的 IDE 使用 Biome，以免它與我們的設置爭吵」**，**並給出要取消勾選的具體項與說明「這些改動也應在 Workspace 下做」**）；**② 它有一個**挪威語的貢獻者行為準則**並逐字稱 Jøkul 是一個開放而積極的共同體**；**③ 實測根目錄含 `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`、`.all-contributorsrc`、`.czrc`、`.changeset/`、`.husky/`、`.nvmrc` 與 `visual-regression/`**（**⭐ 即**貢獻者名錄、提交規範、變更集、Git 鉤子、Node 版本與視覺回歸各自有位置**）
entries.summary_en: A Norwegian insurer has open-sourced its design system under MIT, live at its own domain, offering ready-made React components plus CSS and SCSS stylesheets for its basic components and design patterns, with components and stylesheets now delivered as one consolidated package while the CSS remains available as separate stylesheets for the stated reason that you can still use it without React; **its most notable feature is a ten-step account of a two-channel release process** — the main branch publishes stable versions while a release-next branch is automatically synced on every push to main so the prerelease branch keeps pace with what has already been merged and stably published; **when a sync hits conflicts, a fixed sync branch and a single sync pull request are reused for manual resolution, and the sync branch is cleaned up automatically once it is no longer needed, provided it holds no own commits missing from the release branch** — with the changeset flow and specific release commands given; **three further points follow the same discipline**: **it explains item by item why ESLint should be disabled** so it does not quarrel with the chosen tooling, naming the exact checkbox to clear and noting that the same changes should be made in the workspace settings; **it carries a code of conduct written in Norwegian describing the project as an open and positive community where everyone should feel welcome**; **and its root measurably holds a code of conduct, an all-contributors configuration, a commitizen configuration, a changeset directory, git hooks, a pinned Node version file and a visual regression directory**
entries.body:
**fremtind-design-system**（仓库 `fremtind/jokul`，站点名 Jøkul）**是一家挪威保险公司（Fremtind）开源的对**外**设计系统**：**其 README 首句逐字为** **「**Jøkul** er et designsystem utviklet av Fremtind.」**（**「Jøkul 是由 Fremtind 开发的设计系统」**）。**实测 ★77、fork 32、许可 **MIT**（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 **626,003 KB**、**创建 2019-06-14**、最后推送 2026-09-10、topics 为 `design-system`／`designsystem`／`fremtind`／`react`／`sass`／`scss`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建远早于解冻窗口**，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 31,193 字节（**挪威语**）**；**仓库实测共 **1,776 个文件、551 个目录**（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测，`truncated` 为 false**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把平时不外传的东西拿出来」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**唯一由**一家保险公司自己的工程组织**发布、且已长期维护的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 一家保险公司把自己的设计系统开源出去，而交付方式被逐条说明**——**逐字为**：**「Jøkul gir deg **ferdige React-komponenter** samt **CSS- og SCSS-stilark** for de grunnleggende komponentene og **designmønstrene** til Fremtind. De følger **Fremtinds designprinsipper**.」**；**并逐字说明打包方式的变更**：**「Alle komponenter og stilark leveres nå som **én konsolidert pakke**: `@fremtind/jokul`. **CSSen er tilgjengelig som separate stilark, så om du ikke bruker React kan du fremdeles bruke Jøkul.**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「设计系统」在这里指的是**对外的组件库与设计模式**（**而不是内部文档**）**——**⭐ 即**一家保险公司把自己**面向客户的界面语言**开源了**；**② ⭐⭐ **合并包与可分用样式表**并存，**且理由逐字写给不用 React 的人****（**⭐ 即**交付形态的选择附带了**面向谁**的说明**）；**③ **组件**遵循该公司的设计原则**（**⭐ 即**这不是通用组件库，**而是**带具体品牌约束的产物****）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **两条发布通道的完整过程被写成十步，连冲突处理与自动清理都写明了**——**逐字含**：**「`main` publiserer **stabile versjoner**.」**；**「I tillegg **synkes `release/next` automatisk med `main` ved hver push til `main`**, slik at prerelease-branchen holder seg oppdatert med det som allerede er merged og publisert stabilt. **Hvis synken treffer mergekonflikter gjenbrukes en fast sync-branch og én sync-PR inn mot `release/next` for manuell konfliktløsning. Når sync-PR-en ikke lenger trengs, ryddes sync-branchen opp automatisk så lenge den ikke inneholder egne commits som mangler i `release/next`.**」**；**并逐条给出 changeset 流程与具体命令**（**`pnpm changeset`、`pnpm release:pre:exit`、`pnpm release:version`，**以及「把 `release/next` 合回 `main` 后，下一次从 `main` 的发布即为普通稳定版」**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **两条通道的**关系**被讲清**（**稳定通道 `main` 与预发布通道 `release/next`，**且后者**自动跟随前者****）**——**⭐ 即**「预发布分支不会落后于已稳定的东西」**是**被机制保证的**，**而不是靠人记得**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **冲突处理写明为**复用一条固定分支与一个 PR**（**而不是每次新建**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是一个**很具体且可复用的协作细节**；**③ ⭐⭐ **自动清理带一个**前置条件****（**「只要该分支不含 `release/next` 缺失的自有提交」**）**——**⭐ 即**防止把未合并的提交一起删掉**；**④ ⭐⭐ **命令级步骤逐条给出**，**使这套流程**可被他人照着做****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐条说明**为什么要把 ESLint 关掉****——**逐字为**：**「Vi bruker verktøyet **Biome** for både formatering og linting… **Linting og formatering skjer automatisk ved commit**, men vi anbefaler også at du setter opp IDEen din til å bruke Biome **så den ikke krangler med våre innstillinger**.」**；**并逐字给出具体操作**：**「Deretter kan du søke etter `eslint` og fjerne avkrysningen ved "Eslint: Enable", for å unngå at Eslint krangler med Biome. Sørg også for at "Eslint > Format: Enable" er skrudd av. **Disse endringene bør også gjøres under "Workspace".**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「以免它与**我们的设置争吵**」**——**⭐ 即**它承认**工具冲突是真实问题**，**并**把自己一侧的选择（Biome）讲明****；**② ⭐⭐ **它给出**可照做的具体项**（**取消勾选 "Eslint: Enable"、关掉 "Eslint > Format: Enable"**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「请自行配置」，**而是**给出确切的开关****（**⭐ 与第 341 轮 [[medical-opinion-extractor]] 的「自动禁用 OCR 并在画面说明」同族：**都拒绝**静默的工具冲突**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「这些改动也应在 Workspace 下做」**——**⭐ 即**它考虑到了**多项目工作区**这一情形**。**④ ⭐⭐ **贡献与治理面齐备，且行为准则为挪威语**——**逐字为**：**「**Jøkul er et åpent og positivt felleskap der alle skal føle seg velkommen.** Gjør deg kjent med **våre etiske regler for bidragsytere**（`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`）før du deltar med bidrag.」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **有独立的行为准则文件，**且它以挪威语撰写****；**② ⭐⭐ **其 README 的章节结构含 Code of Conduct、**Lisens** 与 **Bidragsytere（贡献者）**三节**（**⭐ 即**产权、行为与贡献者三者各有位置**）；**③ **本词条**实测**根目录另有 **`.all-contributorsrc`** 与 **`.czrc`****（**⭐ 即**使用 all-contributors 记录贡献、并使用 commitizen 规范提交信息**）。**⑤ ⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **上手要求写明**（**Node 版本由 `.nvmrc` 指定，建议经版本管理器安装**）**；**② **本地开发服务器与文档站点分开**（**README 指向站点上的指南，含**「如何对 Jøkul 做改动」**）**；**③ **实测目录规模**为 **`packages/` 1,378 个文件、`portal/` 261 个、`storybook-public/` 24 个、`utils/` 22 个、`actions/` 20 个、`.storybook/` 10 个、`visual-regression/` 2 个****——**⭐ 即**多包仓库 ＋ 文档门户 ＋ Storybook ＋ 视觉回归**（**⭐ 这也解释了其 626 MB 的体量**）。**⑥ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]]、[[corredor-broker-platform]]、[[open-source-economic-model]]、[[health-denial-appeals]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⭐ **许可为 **MIT****——**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**，**README 亦含 **Lisens** 一节**；**⭐ 而**本词条**未读该文件内容**；**⚠️ 但**本词条指出：**MIT 是**该保险公司就其自己有权许可的部分**授予的**，**⚠️ 而**一个设计系统**通常打包字体、图标或第三方组件**——**⭐ 与第 343／344／345 轮多次记录的同一问题一样：**仓库的许可与其中第三方资源的权利是两件不同的事****（**⭐ 本词条**未核实**其 `packages/` 下是否另有第三方许可文件**）。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未使用该设计系统的任何一步****——**未安装 Node 或 pnpm、未安装该包、未构建任何组件、未打开其文档站点或 Storybook、未运行任何测试或视觉回归**；**故**本词条**不主张**其组件可用、其发布流程可跑通、或其视觉回归确实生效**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的逐字声明与其**经 tree 接口实测的文件结构**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何源码、组件或配置文件的内容****——**⭐ 即**本词条**未核对**：**两条发布通道是否确实由 CI 按所述自动同步与清理**（**⚠️ 这是本条最需要后续核实的一处**）；**其组件是否确实可访问、是否符合其自述的设计原则**；**Biome 是否确实在提交时自动运行**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其无障碍性、浏览器兼容性或版本支持范围**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读其文档站点**，**亦**未运行任何审计**）。**⑤ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**该保险公司与该项目之间的实际关系、以及该项目是否被用于其真实产品**（**⭐ 其自述为**该公司开发的设计系统**；**⚠️ 本词条**未访问其产品、未核实任何部署**）。**⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**该设计系统适用于任何其他机构的产品**（**⚠️ 它带有**具体品牌的设计原则**）。**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其作者与贡献者名单的真实性**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读 `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` 或贡献者名录**）。**⑧ ⭐ **★77、fork 32**，**是本会话所收条目中关注度较高的一条****（**⭐ 且 fork 数 32 说明有相当多的人取用**）**——**⭐ 本词条**不主张**星数与质量的关系**。**⑨ ⚠️ **创建在解冻窗口之前（2019-06-14）****——**⭐ 如实记录该日期（**其创建远早于窗口**），**其入选依据是**推送落在窗口之内（2026-09-10）****。**⑩ ⚠️ **README 为**挪威语****——**⭐ 这是本条目在**语言维度上的一处新增覆盖**（**本站此前已收日语、意大利语、西班牙语等**）；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**已覆盖北欧语言生态**（**该条是**由机构轴检索命中的**，**而非挪威语关键词**）。**⑪ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/fremtind/jokul` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可 MIT、★数、fork 数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间、topics 与 homepage）；README 31,193 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对（**本词条据其引用其首句、交付方式两段、发布流程两段与 ESLint 冲突一段**）；**其 `LICENSE` 文件的存在经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 探测确认（HTTP 200）**；**其文件树经 `https://api.github.com/repos/…/git/trees/main?recursive=1` 实测读取（返回 1,776 个文件、551 个目录，`truncated` 为 false；本词条据其核对 `packages/`、`portal/`、`utils/`、`actions/`、`.storybook/`、`visual-regression/`、`.all-contributorsrc` 与 `.czrc`）**；**未克隆、未下载 tarball（626 MB 体量）、未安装任何依赖、未构建任何东西、未打开其文档站点或线上站点、未读任何源码或配置内容、未做任何网络观察、未打开任何图**。
