**vates-actuarial-engine** (repository `shanyashi2025/vates`) **is an open-source Python library for actuarial modelling**, describing itself verbatim as open-source Python packages and example implementations for actuarial models, while its agent instruction file states the purpose more concretely, verbatim monthly-step projection of assets, liabilities, funds and economic or ESG scenarios plus stochastic Monte Carlo measurement of solvency capital, depending on numpy and pandas. **Measured 1 star, 0 forks, licence **MIT** with a licence file measurably present and answering 200 to a raw probe at 1,067 bytes and 21 lines of standard MIT text, the GitHub licence field agreeing, primary language Python, a 16,934 KB repository, created 2026-03-30, last pushed 2026-09-11** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **creation and push both inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 6,506 bytes**; **the repository measures 176 files and 36 directories**, read through the trees endpoint with truncation false, holding an example workspace, the package, a graphical interface, tests, documentation, agent and readme files including a separate package-index readme, and a build configuration with a lock file. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **self-verification**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the only one whose claim to be published can be checked independently against a package index**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README, the agent instruction file, the build configuration, the measured tree and the package index**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① A model is a bound function and every run leaves a record** — the readme gives five steps, initialising a model instance, configuring a run, defining the projection function, binding it and running, and states verbatim that the run log can be found in a named results file, **while output variables are stated verbatim to be written automatically to a results CSV** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the model is a function you write and the framework owns only the time axis and the outputs**, the readme stating verbatim that the framework hands the function the time index, the period, the maximum time and the start and end dates, ⭐ **so the boundary between engine and business logic is drawn at the function signature**; ⭐⭐⭐ **every run leaves both a run log and a results CSV**, ⭐ **which this entry takes as the most concrete instance of the round’s theme here, since a run is not something that finishes and disappears but something that leaves a pair of files**, ⭐ **the same practice as the motor pricing entry of the previous round pointing every number at four output files**; ⭐⭐⭐ **outputs are declared rather than written by hand**, the readme stating verbatim that once a constant or time-indexed variable is declared the projection results are written automatically; **and ⭐⭐ stochastic runs produce three further artefacts**, the four artifact kinds being named verbatim, ⭐ **so per-path output and per-path statistics are stored separately**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It has a read-back interface keyed by coordinates and gives a checkable example value** — the readme gives two calls, one returning the whole results table and one returning a single cell by group, owner, variable and date, **with the resulting value stated verbatim** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **the key has four parts, which presupposes multi-dimensional results**; ⭐⭐ **the example value can be checked by arithmetic**, the entry noting that a documented sample output is something a reader can verify in their head, ⚠️ **though this entry did not run the code**; **and ⭐⭐ results land as CSV rather than in a database, so any tool can open them**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Stochastic runs use process-level parallelism and an interface constraint is written down** — verbatim that multiprocessing is supported **and that the bound function is executed in worker processes so it must be top-level and picklable** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **the constraint sits beside the usage rather than inside an error message, so a reader knows before writing the function what will break**; ⭐⭐ **the shape of a stochastic configuration is given**, a simulation range and a worker count being named verbatim, ⭐ **so path range and concurrency are two separate parameters**; **and ⭐⭐ the example workspace lists five model families separately**, an asset projection written both as an inline and as a top-level function, a fund projection, a Monte Carlo simulation and an economic capital measurement, **each with its own input directory, its own JSON run configuration and its own command line**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ It really is published, and that can be checked independently against a package index** — measurement of the package index gives version 0.1.7 under MIT with eight releases and a Python requirement of 3.12 or later, **and its build configuration states the distribution name verbatim with only two dependencies, a numeric library and a data-frame library, keywords naming actuarial and asset-liability modelling, and a separate readme for the package page** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **being published is a claim that can be independently verified, which this entry reads as another form of the round’s theme, proving something not by assertion but by an external index**; ⭐⭐⭐ **only two dependencies**, ⭐ **a library carrying both a projection engine and stochastic simulation pulling in very little**; ⭐⭐ **a separate readme for the package page**, ⭐ **the repository landing page and the package page each having their own description, the same idea as splitting a cheatsheet from a guide, cut a different way**; **and ⭐⭐ the Python version requirement appears in both the build configuration and the package index, so that claim has two agreeing sources**. **⑤ ⚠️⚠️ Two places where the documentation and measurement disagree are recorded as facts rather than defects**: **the agent instruction file states verbatim that there is no separate test suite or linter configuration, while measurement finds a tests directory at the top level and the build configuration configuring that test runner with an explicit test path**; **and the same file gives example paths under a directory name that does not exist at the top level, the measured top-level directory being named differently** — ⭐⭐ **from which this entry notes that a file written for an AI agent can itself fall behind its repository, and that the two places where it has fallen behind are exactly its claim to have no tests and the paths it names**. **⑥ ⭐ Other details**: **there is a graphical interface**, invoked with a documented command and a batch file, **described as wrapping the asset model behind a form that writes a run configuration and shells out to the model script**; **three single-file use cases are provided**, named verbatim as an option pricing model, an efficient frontier and an interest rate term structure; **an editable install is documented** with the import name given; entries.title: **把「用什么口径定价」做成一个参数，并另外给出破产概率**：一个 R 长寿风险包把年金定价分成**确定性**与**随机**两层，**而公平保费有两个口径**——**逐字「基于均值的（**精算中性**）」与「**基于分位数的**方法，**即把保费加载以在不利情景下保护保险人」**；**它另外单独给出**保险人破产概率****（**逐年模拟资金路径并判定破产，**返回以破产收场的模拟比例**）**；**⚠️ 而其 `LICENSE` 只有 **246 字节**、句子断在「**in the Software without restriction...**」，**而 README 与 `DESCRIPTION` 都写着 MIT**
entries.title_en: Making the pricing basis a parameter and reporting ruin probability separately: an R longevity-risk package splits annuity valuation into a deterministic and a stochastic layer and offers two premium bases, one described verbatim as mean-based and actuarially neutral and the other as quantile-based, loading the premium to protect the insurer in adverse scenarios, while ruin probability is supplied on its own by simulating the fund path and returning the share of scenarios that end in insolvency — and its licence file measures only 246 bytes, stopping mid-sentence inside the permission grant, even though the readme and the package description both say MIT
entries.title_hk: **把「用什麼口徑定價」做成一個參數，並另外給出破產概率**：一個 R 長壽風險包把年金定價分成**確定性**與**隨機**兩層，**而公平保費有兩個口徑**——**逐字「基於均值的（**精算中性**）」與「**基於分位數的**方法，**即把保費加載以在不利情景下保護保險人」**；**它另外單獨給出**保險人破產概率****（**逐年模擬資金路徑並判定破產，**返回以破產收場的模擬比例**）**；**⚠️ 而其 `LICENSE` 只有 **246 位元組**、句子斷在「**in the Software without restriction...**」，**而 README 與 `DESCRIPTION` 都寫著 MIT**
entries.summary: 一个**R 长寿风险与年金分析包**（★0、仓库体量 18 KB、**实测 **17 个文件**）：**逐字自述为**「**Longevity Risk and Annuity Analysis Toolkit**」**，**并把使用者写成三类**（**精算师、保险分析师与养老基金管理人**）；**其最值得记的一处是它把**定价口径当成一个参数****——**逐字说明公平保费支持**「**基于均值的（**精算中性**）」方法**或**「**基于分位数的**方法，**即把保费加载以在不利情景下保护保险人」**；**第二处是它**单独给出破产概率****——**逐字说明 `ruin_probability()`「**逐年模拟保险人的资金路径（加上利息、减去按生存加权的支出）并标记无力偿付，**返回以破产收场的模拟情景比例」**；**第三处是它**把随机性放在最前面****——**逐字说明 `simulate_mortality()` 用**指数改善趋势（参数 `beta`）**并叠加**标准差为 `sigma` 的高斯冲击**，**产出 `n_years × n_sim` 的死亡率路径矩阵**；**⚠️ 而本词条实测其 `LICENSE` 只有 **246 字节、7 行**、正文断在「**in the Software without restriction...**」**——**⭐ 本词条**据此推断这正是 GitHub 许可字段报 **NOASSERTION** 的原因**（**⚠️ 该推断属本词条**），**并**如实指出：**README 与 `DESCRIPTION` 都写着 MIT****
entries.summary_hk: 一個**R 長壽風險與年金分析包**（★0、體量 18 KB、**實測 17 個文件**）：**逐字自述為**「**Longevity Risk and Annuity Analysis Toolkit**」**，**並把使用者寫成三類**（**精算師、保險分析師與養老基金管理人**）；**其最值得記的一處是它把**定價口徑當成一個參數****——**逐字說明公平保費支持**「**基於均值的（**精算中性**）」方法**或**「**基於分位數的**方法，**即把保費加載以在不利情景下保護保險人」**；**第二處是它**單獨給出破產概率****——**逐字說明 `ruin_probability()`「**逐年模擬保險人的資金路徑（加上利息、減去按生存加權的支出）並標記無力償付，**返回以破產收場的模擬情景比例」**；**第三處是它**把隨機性放在最前面****——**逐字說明 `simulate_mortality()` 用**指數改善趨勢（參數 `beta`）**並疊加**標準差為 `sigma` 的高斯衝擊**，**產出 `n_years × n_sim` 的死亡率路徑矩陣**；**⚠️ 而本詞條實測其 `LICENSE` 只有 **246 位元組、7 行**、正文斷在「**in the Software without restriction...**」**——**⭐ 本詞條**據此推斷這正是 GitHub 許可字段報 **NOASSERTION** 的原因**（**⚠️ 該推斷屬本詞條**），**並**如實指出：**README 與 `DESCRIPTION` 都寫著 MIT****
entries.summary_en: An R package for longevity risk and annuity analysis, 0 stars, a repository of 18 KB measured at 17 files, describing itself verbatim as a longevity risk and annuity analysis toolkit and naming three kinds of user, actuaries, insurance analysts and pension fund managers. **Its most notable feature is that the pricing basis is a parameter**: verbatim, the fair premium function supports either a mean-based method described as actuarially neutral or a quantile-based method that loads the premium to protect the insurer in adverse scenarios. **The second is that ruin probability is supplied separately**, verbatim by simulating the insurer fund path year by year, adding interest and subtracting survival-weighted payouts, flagging insolvency and returning the proportion of simulated scenarios that end in ruin. **The third puts the stochastic element first**: verbatim, the mortality simulation evolves rates with an exponential improvement trend under a parameter and Gaussian shocks of a given standard deviation, producing a matrix of simulated paths. ⚠️ **And measurement of its licence file finds only 246 bytes across seven lines, with the text stopping mid-sentence inside the permission grant**, ⭐ **from which this entry infers the cause of the NOASSERTION reported by GitHub**, ⚠️ **an inference of this entry**, **and notes plainly that both the readme and the package description say MIT**.
entries.body:
**longevity-risk-r**（仓库 `manyagupta-21/longevityRiskR`）**是一份 R 长寿风险与年金分析包**：**逐字自述为**「**Longevity Risk and Annuity Analysis Toolkit**」**，**并逐字说明其面向**「**精算师、保险分析师与养老基金管理人**」**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可字段为 **NOASSERTION****（**⚠️ 其成因见下，**本词条已实测**）、主语言 R、仓库体量 **18 KB**、**创建 2026-03-25**、最后推送 2026-09-10、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建与推送**都在解冻窗口之内****）；**README 实测 4,894 字节**；**仓库实测共 **17 个文件、2 个目录**（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测，`truncated` 为 false；含 `man/` 9 项、`R/` 6 项，**以及 `DESCRIPTION`、`LICENSE`、`NAMESPACE`、`README.md`**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「自证：它拿什么证明自己」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**唯一一条其「自证」**反而暴露出一处不一致**的****。

可核实信息（**均 README、`DESCRIPTION`、`LICENSE` 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把**定价口径**做成一个**可选参数**，并把两个口径各自的性质写明**——**逐字为**：**「**`fair_premium()` supports a **mean**-based (**actuarially neutral**) method or a **quantile**-based method that **loads the premium to protect the insurer in adverse scenarios**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **两个口径并列给出，**且各自带一个性质标签**（**「均值口径＝**精算中性**」与「分位数口径＝**为不利情景加载**」**）**——**⭐ 即**读者一眼看到**同一个「公平保费」在两种口径下不是同一个数**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「精算中性」这个说法被用在**均值口径**上**——**⭐ 本词条认为这一处措辞值得记：**它把「中性」归属于**一种选择**，**而不是**当成默认真理****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **分位数口径的用途被说成**保护保险人****（**⭐ 即**加载的方向**与**承担者**都写明了**）**；**④ ⭐⭐ **两个口径共用同一个函数名与同一个输出结构**（**逐字给出 `method = "quantile", confidence = 0.95` 的调用与 `premium$summary` 的读法**）**——**⭐ 即**口径是**参数**，**而不是另一个函数**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**破产概率**单独做成一个函数，并把算法逐句写出**——**逐字为**：**「**`ruin_probability()` simulates the insurer fund path **year by year** (adding interest, subtracting survival-weighted payouts) and **flags insolvency**, returning the **proportion of simulated scenarios that end in ruin**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **破产的判据、算法与输出三者都写在同一句里**（**现金流怎么走／什么时候算破产／最后返回什么**）**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **破产概率**不是一个附加指标，**而是**与定价并列的一个产出**（**⭐ 逐字给出把定价结果直接喂进去的调用 `ruin_probability(mort_matrix, premium = premium$premium)`**）**——**⭐ 即**「在这个保费下，资金会怎样」**是可算的**；**③ ⭐⭐ **所有输出都带 `$summary`**（**逐字示例中每一步都以 `$summary` 收尾**）**——**⭐ 即**每个函数返回的结构**有约定的摘要入口**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **随机性是第一位的，且参数被具名**——**逐字为**：**「**`simulate_mortality()` evolves mortality rates using an **exponential improvement trend** with a mortality improvement rate `beta`, perturbed by **Gaussian shocks** with standard deviation `sigma`, producing an `n_years × n_sim` **matrix of simulated mortality paths**.」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **模型被写成两个参数**（**`beta` 趋势与 `sigma` 冲击**）**——**⭐ 即**随机性的来源**可被读者精确指出**；**② ⭐⭐ **输出形状被写明**（**`n_years × n_sim`**）**——**⭐ 即**下游函数吃什么**是明确的**；**③ ⭐⭐ **确定性路径只是随机矩阵的一个特例**（**逐字另有一个 `annuity_pv()` 从单条死亡率向量算现值**）**——**⭐ 即**「确定性」与「随机」不是两套代码**。**④ ⭐⭐ **它的功能表、包结构与文档件数都可核实**——**逐字给出 **8 个函数**及其用途**（**随机死亡率模拟／确定性年金现值／随机年金现值分布／公平或含风险加载的保费／生存概率／余命／破产概率／年金现值分布图**）**；**逐字给出包结构**（**`R/mortality.R`、`R/annuity.R`、`R/survival.R`、`R/risk.R`、`R/visualisation.R`，**外加 `man/`、`DESCRIPTION`、`NAMESPACE`、`LICENSE`**）**；**实测 `R/` 下 **6 项**、`man/` 下 **9 项**——**⭐ 即**文档与源码**一函数一档**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **安装方式与联系方式逐字给出**（**逐字 `remotes::install_github(...)`，**并给出作者姓名、一处 LinkedIn 与一处院校邮箱**）**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[mortalitylaws]]、[[stmomo]]、[[lifecontingencies]]、[[pylifecontingencies]]、[[cvmortalitymult]]、[[hmdhfdplus]]、[[mortcast]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **一处**许可正文不完整**是本条最重要的一处，且是本词条实测所得****：**其 `LICENSE` 文件**实测只有 **246 字节、7 行**，**首行是 `MIT License`、第三行是版权行，**而**正文在「**in the Software without restriction...**」处**以一个字面的三点省略号结束****——**即**它看起来是一份 MIT，**而**实际是一份**被截断的许可文本**（**⭐ 本站此前记录过「有声明无文件」「无任何声明」「自定义非 OSI」「两份并列导致 NOASSERTION」等形态，**而**「**声明是 MIT、文件却是残篇**」是**新的一种****）**；**⭐ 而其 `DESCRIPTION` 逐字写着 `License: MIT + file LICENSE`，**README 亦逐字写着「MIT © 2026 Manya Gupta」**（**⭐ 即**声明在**两处**，**而**文件本身**不足以支撑该声明**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 本词条**据此推断**：**GitHub 许可字段报 **NOASSERTION**，**正是因为该文件**无法被识别为完整的 MIT 文本**（**⚠️ 这是**本词条的解读**，**不是 GitHub 的说明**；**本词条**未查 GitHub 的许可识别逻辑**）**。**⭐⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **声明与文件可以**互相矛盾**（**此处**文件短于声明**）；**② ⭐⭐ **这种矛盾**机器能看出来而人容易看漏**（**⭐ 因为**README 与 `DESCRIPTION` 可核實資訊（**均 README、`DESCRIPTION`、`LICENSE` 與 tree 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把**定價口徑**做成一個**可選參數**，並把兩個口徑各自的性質寫明**——**逐字「**`fair_premium()` supports a **mean**-based (**actuarially neutral**) method or a **quantile**-based method that **loads the premium to protect the insurer in adverse scenarios**.」**⭐⭐⭐ 四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐兩個口徑並列給出，且各自帶一個性質標籤**（「均值口徑＝**精算中性**」與「分位數口徑＝**為不利情景加載**」——讀者一眼看到**同一個「公平保費」在兩種口徑下不是同一個數**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐「精算中性」被用在**均值口徑**上**（把「中性」歸屬於**一種選擇**，而不是當成默認真理）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐分位數口徑的用途被說成**保護保險人**（加載的方向與承擔者都寫明了）；**④ ⭐⭐兩個口徑共用同一函數名與同一輸出結構**（逐字給出 `method = "quantile", confidence = 0.95` 的調用與 `premium$summary` 的讀法——口徑是**參數**，而不是另一個函數）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **把**破產概率**單獨做成一個函數，並把算法逐句寫出**——逐字「**`ruin_probability()` simulates the insurer fund path year by year (adding interest, subtracting survival-weighted payouts) and flags insolvency, returning the proportion of simulated scenarios that end in ruin.**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐破產的判據、算法與輸出三者寫在同一句裡**；**② ⭐⭐⭐破產概率不是附加指標，而是與定價並列的一個產出**（逐字給出把定價結果直接餵進去的調用 `ruin_probability(mort_matrix, premium = premium$premium)`——「在這個保費下，資金會怎樣」是可算的）；**③ ⭐⭐所有輸出都帶 `$summary`**（每個函數返回的結構有約定的摘要入口）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **隨機性是第一位的，且參數被具名**——逐字「**`simulate_mortality()` evolves mortality rates using an exponential improvement trend with a mortality improvement rate `beta`, 個函數**及用途；逐字給出包結構（`R/mortality.R`／`annuity.R`／`survival.R`／`risk.R`／`visualisation.R`，外加 `man/`、`DESCRIPTION`、`NAMESPACE`、`LICENSE`）；實測 `R/` 下 6 項、`man/` 下 9 項——**文檔與源碼一函數一檔**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **longevity-risk-r** (repository `manyagupta-21/longevityRiskR`) **is an R package for longevity risk and annuity analysis**, describing itself verbatim as a longevity risk and annuity analysis toolkit and naming its users verbatim as actuaries, insurance analysts and pension fund managers. **Measured 0 stars, 0 forks, a licence field of NOASSERTION** — ⚠️ whose cause is measured below — **primary language R, an 18 KB repository, created 2026-03-25, last pushed 2026-09-10, with no topics** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **creation and push both inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 4,894 bytes**; **the repository measures 17 files and 2 directories**, read through the trees endpoint with truncation false, being six R files, nine manual pages and a description, licence, namespace and readme. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **self-verification**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the one whose self-description turns out to contain an inconsistency**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README, the package description, the licence file and the measured tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It makes the pricing basis a selectable parameter and states the character of each basis** — verbatim, the fair premium function supports a mean-based method described as actuarially neutral **or a quantile-based method that loads the premium to protect the insurer in adverse scenarios** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the two bases are given side by side, each with a character label, so a reader sees at once that one fair premium is not the same number under two bases**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the phrase actuarially neutral is attached to the mean basis**, ⭐ **which this entry records as worth noting, since neutrality is attributed to one of two choices rather than treated as the default truth**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the purpose of the quantile basis is stated as protecting the insurer, so both the direction of the loading and who bears it are given**; **and ⭐⭐ the two bases share one function name and one output structure**, the readme giving the call with a method and confidence argument and the way the summary is read, ⭐ **so the basis is a parameter rather than a second function**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Ruin probability is a function of its own and its algorithm is spelled out sentence by sentence** — verbatim, the function simulates the insurer fund path **year by year**, adding interest and subtracting survival-weighted payouts, **flags insolvency and returns the proportion of simulated scenarios that end in ruin** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the criterion, the algorithm and the output all sit in one sentence**, namely how the cash flows move, when insolvency counts and what is returned; ⭐⭐⭐ **ruin probability is not a supplementary metric but an output standing beside the pricing**, the readme giving a call that feeds the priced premium straight in, ⭐ **so what happens to the fund under that premium is computable**; **and ⭐⭐ every output carries a summary entry point**, each step in the quick start ending that way. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The stochastic element comes first and its parameters are named** — verbatim, the simulation evolves mortality rates using an exponential improvement trend under an improvement-rate parameter, perturbed by Gaussian shocks of a given standard deviation, **producing a matrix of simulated mortality paths** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **the model reduces to two parameters, a trend and a shock size, so a reader can point exactly at where the randomness comes from**; ⭐⭐ **the shape of the output is given, so what the downstream functions consume is unambiguous**; **and ⭐⭐ the deterministic path is only a special case of the stochastic matrix**, a separate function computing a present value from a single mortality vector, ⭐ **so deterministic and stochastic are not two code bases**. **④ ⭐⭐ Its function table, package structure and document count are all verifiable** — eight functions with their purposes are given verbatim, from stochastic mortality simulation through deterministic and stochastic annuity valuation, fair or risk-loaded premiums, survival probability, life expectancy and ruin probability to a distribution plot; **the package structure is given verbatim** as five R files plus manual pages, description, namespace and licence; **and measurement finds six entries under the R directory and nine under the manual directory**, ⭐ **one document per function**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Installation and contact details are given verbatim**, an install command plus an author name, a profile link and an institutional email address. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[mortalitylaws]], [[stmomo]], [[lifecontingencies]], [[pylifecontingencies]], [[cvmortalitymult]], [[hmdhfdplus]] and [[mortcast]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ An incomplete licence text is the most important point in this entry, and it was measured here**: **the licence file measures only 246 bytes across seven lines**, its first line reading MIT License and its third the copyright line, **while the body stops mid-sentence inside the permission grant on a literal three-dot ellipsis** — **so it looks like an MIT licence but is in fact a truncated licence text**, ⭐ **and this entry notes that where this site has previously recorded a claim with no file, no statement at all, a custom non-open-source licence and two licences in parallel leading to NOASSERTION, a claim of MIT backed by a fragment is a new shape**; **its package description states verbatim that the licence is MIT with a licence file, and the readme states verbatim MIT with a year and an author, so the claim appears in two places while the file itself is not sufficient to support it**. ⭐⭐⭐ **This entry infers that the NOASSERTION reported by GitHub arises precisely because the file cannot be recognised as complete MIT text**, ⚠️ **an interpretation by this entry rather than a statement by GitHub**, the licence-detection logic not having been examined. ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **a claim and a file can contradict each other, here the file being shorter than the claim**; ⭐⭐ **such a contradiction is easier for a machine to see than for a person, since both the readme and the description read cleanly**; **and ⭐⭐ the licence file itself should be opened before use**, ⭐ **the entry restating that a licence field, a licence section in a readme and a licence file are three different things, and that a truncated licence is the most direct example of self-verification failing**. **② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was installed or run** — **R was not installed, the install command was not run, none of the simulation, valuation, premium or ruin functions was called, no manual page was opened and no plot was produced**; **so this entry does not claim its stochastic simulation, its annuity valuation, its two premium bases or its ruin probability work as described**, ⭐ **what it verified being the verbatim readme, package description and licence file, including byte and line counts, and the file structure measured through the trees endpoint**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No R source was read**, ⭐ **so whether the exponential improvement trend and Gaussian shocks are implemented as described, whether the quantile basis really takes the stated quantile, and whether insolvency is really judged only from the fund path were not checked**. **④ ⚠️ Whether the model is actuarially appropriate was not verified** — ⭐ **its exponential improvement trend under Gaussian shocks is a simplified model, which this entry states plainly**, ⚠️ **while making no claim that it is worse than a stochastic mortality model of the kind recorded elsewhere on this site, no comparison having been made**. **⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ The density of this form is recorded plainly**: this site already holds several annuity and longevity entries, ⭐ **and what distinguishes this one is that it places ruin probability and the premium basis inside a single package, which is the reason it was collected**. **⑥ ⚠️ At 0 stars with no forks and no topics the author’s background was not verified**, ⭐ **the description and readme agreeing on the name and giving an institutional address**. **⑦ ⚠️ The version number is 0.0.0.1** as measured in the description, ⭐ **an extremely early version number, recorded as such**. **⑧ ⚠️ Creation and push both fall inside the thaw window**. **⑨ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: the repository was read on 2026-09-11 through the repository search endpoint and the GitHub API for stars, licence field, language, size and dates; scenarios.」——四處已寫明：①兩口徑並列（同一個「公平保費」在兩種口徑下不是同一個數）；②「精算中性」被用在均值口徑上（中性被歸屬於一種選擇）；③分位數口徑的用途是保護保險人（加載方向與承擔者都寫明）；④兩口徑共用同一函數名與輸出結構（method="quantile", confidence=0.95；口徑是參數而不是另一個函數）｜⭐⭐⭐破產概率單獨成函數且算法逐句寫出：逐字「`ruin_probability()` simulates the insurer fund path year by year (adding interest, subtracting survival-weighted payouts) and flags insolvency, returning the proportion of simulated scenarios that end in ruin.」——三處已寫明：①判據、算法與輸出三者同句；②破產概率與定價並列（逐字 `ruin_probability(mort_matrix, premium = premium$premium)`）；③所有輸出都帶 `$summary`｜⭐⭐⭐隨機性第一且參數具名：逐字「`simulate_mortality()` evolves mortality rates using an exponential improvement trend with a mortality improvement rate `beta`, perturbed by Gaussian shocks with standard deviation `sigma`, producing an `n_years × n_sim` matrix of simulated mortality paths.」——三處已寫明：①模型是兩個參數（beta 趨勢／sigma 衝擊）；②輸出形狀 n_years × n_sim；③確定性路徑只是隨機矩陣的特例（另有 annuity_pv()）｜⭐⭐功能表／包結構／文檔件數可核實：8 個函數逐字列出；包結構逐字（R/mortality.R／annuity.R／survival.R／risk.R／visualisation.R ＋ man/、DESCRIPTION、NAMESPACE、LICENSE）；實測 R/ 6 項、man/ 9 項（一函數一檔）｜⭐⭐安裝方式與聯繫方式逐字給出（remotes::install_github，附作者姓名、LinkedIn 與院校郵箱）｜⚠️⚠️⚠️**一處許可正文不完整（本詞條實測）**：`LICENSE` **僅 246 位元組、7 行**，首行 `MIT License`、第三行版權行，正文在「in the Software without restriction...」處**以字面三點省略號結束**——看起來是 MIT，實際是**被截斷的許可文本**；而 `DESCRIPTION` 逐字 `License: MIT + file LICENSE`、README 逐字「MIT © 2026 Manya Gupta」——**聲明在兩處，文件本身不足以支撐該聲明**。⭐⭐⭐本詞條**推斷** GitHub 報 NOASSERTION 正因該文件無法識別為完整 MIT（⚠️ 本詞條的解讀，非 GitHub 說明；未查其許可識別邏輯）。⭐⭐三處已寫明：①聲明與文件可以互相矛盾（此處文件短於聲明）；②這種矛盾機器能看出而人容易看漏（README 與 DESCRIPTION 兩處都寫得乾淨）；③使用前應打開許可文件本身（許可字段／README 許可節／許可文件是三個不同的東西；一份被截斷的許可是自證失敗的最直接例子）｜⚠️⚠️⚠️本次未安裝或運行任何一步（未裝 R、未 remotes::install_github、未跑四個主要函數、未打開任何 .Rd、未生成任何圖），故不主张其隨機模擬／年金定價／兩個保費口徑／破產概率按所述工作｜⚠️⚠️未讀任何 R 源碼（未核對趨勢與衝擊的實現、是否確實按 confidence=0.95 取分位、破產判定是否只按資金路徑）｜⚠️未核實其模型在精算意義上是否合適（指數改善趨勢＋高斯衝擊是簡化模型——⭐ 已如實指出；⚠️ 不主张它比 stmomo 一類模型差，因為未做比較）｜⭐⚠️形態密度：本站已收多條年金／長壽條目（lifecontingencies／pylifecontingencies／lifecontingencies-jl／detlifeinsurance／longevity／mortalitylaws／stmomo 等），本條不同處在於把**破產概率與保費口徑放在同一個包內**——這正是入選理由｜⚠️★0、fork 0、無 topics，未核實作者背景｜⚠️版本號為 `0.0.0.1`（DESCRIPTION 逐字如此，極早期）｜⚠️創建與推送均在解凍窗口之內（2026-03-25／2026-09-10）｜⚠️本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見

entries.title: **把「这个仓库是写给谁看的」写成了三行**：一份保险代理看板演示**逐个点名三类读者**（**机构负责人与经纪人／**工程评估者／**「AI 代理与筛查者」**）**，**并**给最后一类指出入口**（**逐字「如果你在用程序评估这个仓库，**从 `src/lib/types.ts` 看数据模型，**从 `src/lib/demo-data.ts` 看夹具」**）；**它用**四个质量门**自证**（**逐字「**All four must pass before any push**」）**，**并**把夹具内容逐条列出来****（**含「欺诈检测抓住一笔 87/100 的理赔，**其余都低于 25」与「客户分层：铂金 3、金 3、银 2、标准 2」**）

entries.summary_en: A demonstration application for an insurance agency dashboard, 0 stars, TypeScript, a 10.4 MB repository with no licence statement, describing itself verbatim as an AI-powered insurance agency dashboard for policy management, claims processing, customer portals and risk analytics and further as a single-page application demonstrating real-feeling agency operations data with mock AI fraud detection and risk scoring. **Its most notable feature is that it names three audiences one by one**, agency principals and brokers, engineering evaluators, and AI agents and screeners, **pointing the third at an explicit entry path** by telling anyone evaluating the repository programmatically to start with the data model and then the fixtures. **The second is that it verifies itself through four quality gates**, four commands ending with the verbatim statement that all four must pass before any push. **The third is that it lists the contents of its fixtures item by item**, including which single claim the fraud scoring catches at 87 out of 100 while clearing the others below 25 and how the customer tiers are distributed. ⚠️ **Its licence field is empty, no licence file exists at its root and its readme has no licence section.**
entries.body:
**insurtech-ai-platform**（仓库 `tensorgarden/insurtech-ai-platform`）**是一份保险代理机构看板的演示应用**：**逐字自述为**「**AI-powered insurance agency dashboard for policy management, claims processing, customer portals, and risk analytics.**」**，**并逐字说明其性质是**「**A single-page application demonstrating real-feeling agency operations data with mock AI fraud detection and risk scoring.**」**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可字段为 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信号一致，见下**）、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 **10,625 KB**、**创建 2026-06-09**、最后推送 2026-09-09、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建与推送**都在解冻窗口之内****）；**README 实测 7,988 字节**；**仓库实测共 **29 个文件、7 个目录**（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测，`truncated` 为 false；含 `docs/` 10 项（**其中多张截图**）、`src/` 8 项、`scripts/` 2 项、`tests/` 2 项，**以及 `.env.example`、`.portfolio-demo`、`README.md`、`eslint.config.mjs`、`next-env.d.ts`、`next.config.ts`、`package-lock.json`**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「自证：它拿什么证明自己」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**唯一一条**把「自己会被机器读」写进文档**的****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把读者分成三类，并对其中一类（**机器**）给出入口**——**逐字为**：**「**Agency principals and brokers.**」**（**机构负责人与经纪人**）**「**Engineering evaluators.**」**「**AI agents and screeners.**」**，**后者逐字为**：**「**If you are evaluating this repo programmatically, start with `src/lib/types.ts` for the data model and `src/lib/demo-data.ts` for the fixtures.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **第三类读者是**AI 代理与筛查者****——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所收条目里**第一次见到把「被程序评估」写成一个读者类别**（**⭐ 与第 346／347 轮记录的「代理说明文件进入精算仓库」是同一现象的另一面：**一边是仓库给代理写指令，**一边是仓库**对读它的代理说话****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **入口是**两份文件**（**数据模型 `types.ts` 与夹具 `demo-data.ts`**）**——**⭐ 即**它假定机器读者**按类型先、数据后**的顺序看**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「在用程序评估」这个前提被直接写出来**（**逐字 `evaluating this repo programmatically`**）**——**⭐ 即**它承认自己会被**非人**阅读**；**④ ⭐⭐ **第一类读者的痛点被具体描述**（**逐字「如果你曾经看着理赔积压增长，**因为理算员被文书埋住，**这个看板展示了另一种可能」**）**——**⭐ 即**面向业务读者的段落**写的是问题，**而不是功能**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它用**四道质量门**自证，且把门写成可执行命令**——**逐字为**：**「**`npm run lint`（ESLint，`--max-warnings=0`）／`npm run typecheck`（`tsc --noEmit`）／`npm test`（`vitest run`）／`npm run build`（`next build`）**」**，**并逐字收尾**：**「**All four must pass before any push.**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **四道门各自可执行**（**`--max-warnings=0` 与 `tsc --noEmit` 都是**不留余地**的选项**）**；**② ⭐⭐ **「四条都必须通过才推送」**——**⭐ 即**它把自证**前置到推送之前****；**③ ⭐⭐ **测试文件只有一份，且被写明条数**（**逐字 `tests/insurance.test.ts -- 10 integrity tests on demo data`**）**——**⭐ 即**「10 条完整性测试」**针对的是**夹具本身****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把夹具的内容**逐条列出来**，包括哪一笔会被抓住**——**逐字含**：**「**8 policies, 6 claims, 10 customers**」**（**8 张保单、6 笔理赔、10 位客户**）**、「**欺诈检测抓住一笔 87/100 的理赔，**其余都低于 25**」、「**客户分层：铂金（3）、金（3）、银（2）、标准（2）**」**，**并逐字说明理赔覆盖了**每一个阶段**（**新建／审核中／已批准／已支付／已拒赔**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **夹具的**规模与分布都被写出来****（**⭐ 即**读者不必打开代码就知道**数据有多大、长什么样****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「哪一笔会被抓住」被点名**（**87/100 与低于 25 两档**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是**演示类仓库里最实用的一种说明**：**它告诉你**这个演示会演示出什么**；**③ ⭐⭐ **理赔阶段逐条列出**（**五个状态**）**——**⭐ 即**状态机的形状**也在文档里**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「什么是假的」与「什么是真的」分开写**——**逐字为**：**「**All data is fictional, typesafe, and injected through a single import. The dashboard renders in one scrollable page with **zero network calls**.」**，**以及**「**It is a demo, not a product. But the architecture is real**」**，**并逐字说明数据流**「**从 `demo-data.ts` 经 `page.tsx` 流出，**没有 API 调用、没有数据库、也没有认证**」**，**以及**「**AI 风险评分与欺诈检测在演示数据里是**静态值**，**但其架构支持在同一套类型背后换入真实的提供方**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「单一注入点」是一个**可检查的性质****（**所有假数据只从一个 import 进来**）**——**⭐ 即**真实数据能以最小改动接上**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「零网络调用」也是可检查的**（**⭐ 与 [[fasal-pramaan-crop-claims]] 的「设备端检查」同向：**都是把一条隐私性质**变成可验证的结构****）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「这是演示，不是产品。**但架构是真的」**——**⭐ 即**它把**演示身份**与**架构主张**分开**；**④ ⭐⭐ **它另有一节「安全」逐条列出**（**逐字：**没有真实的 API 密钥或凭据／**所有数据为虚构且硬编码／**没有网络调用，**看板完全由静态导入渲染／**不收集用户输入、**没有表单提交／**除虚构姓名与地址外没有受保护健康信息或个人身份信息**）**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **它把**还没做的**列成一份路线图**——**逐字六项**（**真实的风险评分提供方／**按机构隔离的行级安全持久化／**警方与消防与医疗记录等文件摄取流水线／**按工作量的理算员自动分配／**多机构架构与组合层分析／**客户自助门户**）**——**⭐ 即**未做的部分**被登记，**而不是留给读者去发现**（**⭐ 与第 346 轮的「缺口登记」同族**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 其余可核实细节**：**① **技术栈逐条给出**（**逐字：Next.js 15 App Router／TypeScript 5／Tailwind CSS 3／Vitest／ESLint 9 flat config／CI 覆盖 lint、typecheck、test、build／数据层为「静态 TypeScript 夹具，**并采用与某后端兼容的 schema 设计」**）**；**② **架构逐行给出**（**`src/lib/types.ts` 放全部接口，**`src/lib/demo-data.ts` 放夹具，**`src/app/page.tsx` 单页承载所有区块**）**；**③ **启动方式两条命令**（**`npm install`、`npm run dev`，**端口一并给出**）**；**④ **README 含一组截图**（**逐字给出七张的用途**）**；**⑤ **它自述定位**（**逐字「作为给某机构的作品集演示而构建。**可供评审」**）**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]]、[[claims-integrity-investigator]]、[[claimlens]]、[[insurance-analytics-tsql]]、[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]]、[[insurerisk]]。

**insurtech-ai-platform**（倉庫 `tensorgarden/insurtech-ai-platform`）**是一份保險代理機構看板的演示應用**：**逐字自述為**「**AI-powered insurance agency dashboard for policy management, claims processing, customer portals, and risk analytics.**」**，並逐字說明其性質是**「**A single-page application demonstrating real-feeling agency operations data with mock AI fraud detection and risk scoring.**」**。**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可字段為 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信號一致，見下**）、主語言 TypeScript、體量 **10,625 KB**、**創建 2026-06-09**、最後推送 2026-09-09、無 topics**（**創建與推送都在解凍窗口之內****）；**README 實測 7,988 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 29 個文件、7 個目錄**（**經 GitHub API tree 接口實測，`truncated` 為 false；含 `docs/` 10 項（其中多張截圖）、`src/` 8 項、`scripts/` 2 項、`tests/` 2 項，以及 `.env.example`、`.portfolio-demo`、`README.md`、`eslint.config.mjs`、`next-env.d.ts`、`next.config.ts`、`package-lock.json`**）。本條目屬本輪主題**「自證：它拿什麼證明自己」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本輪四條裡**唯一一條**把「自己會被機器讀」寫進文檔**的****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與 tree 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 把讀者分成三類，並對其中一類（**機器**）給出入口**——**逐字「**Agency principals and brokers.**」「**Engineering evaluators.**」「**AI agents and screeners.**」**，後者逐字「**If you are evaluating this repo programmatically, start with `src/lib/types.ts` for the data model and `src/lib/demo-data.ts` for the fixtures.**」**⭐⭐⭐ 四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐第三類讀者是**AI 代理與篩查者****（本站所收條目裡**第一次見到把「被程序評估」寫成一個讀者類別**——與第 346／347 輪記錄的「代理說明文件進入精算倉庫」是同一現象的另一面：**一邊是倉庫給代理寫指令，一邊是倉庫對讀它的代理說話**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐入口是**兩份文件****（數據模型與夾具——假定機器讀者**按類型先、數據後**的順序看）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐「在用程序評估」這個前提被直接寫出來**（承認自己會被**非人**閱讀）；**④ ⭐⭐第一類讀者的痛點被具體描述**（逐字「如果你曾經看著理賠積壓增長，因為理算員被文書埋住，這個看板展示了另一種可能」——面向業務讀者的段落**寫的是問題，而不是功能**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **用**四道質量門**自證，且把門寫成可執行命令**——逐字「`npm run lint`（ESLint，`--max-warnings=0`）／`npm run typecheck`（`tsc --noEmit`）／`npm test`（`vitest run`）／`npm run build`（`next build`）」，並逐字收尾「**All four must pass before any push.**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐四道門各自可執行**（`--max-warnings=0` 與 `tsc --noEmit` 都是**不留餘地**的選項）；**② ⭐⭐「四條都必須通過才推送」**（把自證**前置到推送之前**）；**③ ⭐⭐測試文件只有一份且被寫明條數**（逐字 `tests/insurance.test.ts -- 10 integrity tests on demo data`——「10 條完整性測試」針對的是**夾具本身**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **把夾具的內容**逐條列出來**，包括哪一筆會被抓住**——逐字含「**8 policies, 6 claims, 10 customers**」、「**欺詐檢測抓住一筆 87/100 的理賠，其餘都低於 25**」、「**客戶分層：鉑金（3）、金（3）、銀（2）、標準（2）**」，並逐字說明理賠覆蓋了**每一個階段**（新建／審核中／已批准／已支付／已拒賠）**三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐夾具的規模與分布都被寫出**（讀者不必打開代碼就知道數據有多大、長什麼樣）；**② ⭐⭐⭐「哪一筆會被抓住」被點名**（**演示類倉庫裡最實用的一種說明**：它告訴你**這個演示會演示出什麼**）；**③ ⭐⭐理賠階段逐條列出**（五個狀態——狀態機的形狀也在文檔裡）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **把「什麼是假的」與「什麼是真的」分開寫**——逐字「**All data is fictional, typesafe, and injected through a single import. The dashboard renders in one scrollable page with zero network calls.**」與「**It is a demo, not a product. ⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信號一致指向沒有許可聲明****：GitHub 許可字段為**空（API 響應裡沒有許可對象）**、**根目錄 `LICENSE` 不存在（raw 探測 HTTP 404）**、**且 README 全文以「licen／copyright／©」檢索**零命中**——⭐ 這是一個**作品集性質的演示倉庫**，**其自述用途是**供人評審**，而**「可以讀到」與「可以再分發」是兩件事**。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次沒有運行它的任何一步****——**未安裝 Node 或依賴、未跑四條質量門、未跑那 10 條測試、未啟動開發伺服器、未打開其任何截圖**；**故不主张**該看板可構建、可運行、四條門確實全綠、或 10 條測試確實通過**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未讀其任何源碼****（未核對夾具是否確實只有一處注入點、是否確實沒有網絡調用、類型是否確實覆蓋所述實體）——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**，而它同樣**容易核實**（數一次 `import`、搜一次 `fetch`）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **一處**內部張力**如實並列，本詞條不判為錯誤、也不替它選邊****：README 的「項目故事」一節**逐字引用了**一位機構負責人的話（逐字「我一天有三個小時只是在整理理賠郵件。我知道流程裡有欺詐，但不動手翻每一份檔案我就證明不了」），並寫作「**一位機構負責人告訴我們**」；而**同一份 README 的另一節**逐字寫著全部數據為虛構、並由單一 import 注入——**本詞條只把兩處並列**：⚠️ **不主张**該引語來自真實訪談，**也不主张**它屬於虛構部分（二者的邊界該倉庫**未在自己的文字裡劃出**）。**⑤ ⭐ **一處**讀者設計**的如實評價**：本詞條認為「給機器讀者寫入口」**本身值得記**，⚠️ 但**不主张**這樣做已成為慣例（本輪四條中僅此一條；且其入口指向的是**類型與夾具**，並非行為或接口契約）。**⑥ ⚠️ **★0、fork 0、無 topics**，且未核實作者與其所屬方**（其自述「為某機構構建」，本詞條只轉述）。**⑦ ⚠️ **創建與推送均在解凍窗口之內（2026-06-09／2026-09-09）****。**⑧ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****。**核實說明**：repo 於 2026-09-11 經倉庫檢索接口與 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 7,988 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對；根目錄 `LICENSE` 的存在經 raw 探測確認（HTTP 404）；**文件清單經 GitHub API tree 接口實測（29 個文件、7 個目錄，`truncated` 為 false）**；**未克隆、未安裝任何依賴、未運行任何腳本或測試、未啟動或打開該應用、未打開任何截圖、未讀任何源碼內容、未做任何網絡觀察**。

⭐⭐⭐ **the entry path is two files, a type model and a fixture file, so the repository assumes a machine reader goes types first and data second**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the premise of programmatic evaluation is stated outright, so the repository admits it will be read by something other than a person**; **and ⭐⭐ the first audience has its problem described concretely**, the readme asking whether the reader has ever watched a claims backlog grow because adjusters were buried in paperwork, ⭐ **so the business-facing section states a problem rather than a feature list**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It verifies itself with four quality gates written as runnable commands** — verbatim, a lint command with warnings turned into errors, a type check with no emit, a test run and a build, closing with the verbatim statement that all four must pass before any push ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **each of the four gates is runnable and two of them are configured without slack**; ⭐⭐ **requiring all four before a push places self-verification ahead of publication**; **and ⭐⭐ a single test file is described with its exact count, ten integrity tests on the demo data**, ⭐ **so the tests are about the fixtures themselves**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It lists the contents of its fixtures item by item, including which entry will be caught** — verbatim, eight policies, six claims and ten customers, with fraud detection catching one claim at 87 out of 100 and clearing the others below 25, **and customer tiers distributed as three platinum, three gold, two silver and two standard**, alongside a verbatim statement that claims cover every stage from new through under review, approved, paid and denied ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the size and distribution of the fixtures are written out, so a reader knows how large the data are and what shape they have without opening the code**; ⭐⭐⭐ **which single claim will be caught is named, which this entry considers the most useful kind of statement a demonstration repository can make, since it tells the reader what the demonstration will demonstrate**; **and ⭐⭐ the claim stages are listed, so the shape of the state machine is in the documentation too**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ It separates what is fake from what is real** — verbatim that all data are fictional, typesafe and injected through a single import, **that the dashboard renders in one scrollable page with zero network calls**, and that it is a demo rather than a product **while the architecture is real**, with the data flow stated verbatim as running from the fixture file through the page component with no API calls, no database and no authentication, **and the AI risk scoring and fraud detection being static values in the demo data while the architecture supports swapping in a real provider behind the same types** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **a single injection point is a checkable property, since all fictional data enters through one import, so real data can be attached with minimal change**; ⭐⭐⭐ **zero network calls is checkable too**, ⭐ **the same direction as the crop-claims entry of the previous round turning a privacy property into a verifiable structure**; ⭐⭐⭐ **being a demo rather than a product while the architecture is real separates the demonstration status from the architectural claim**; **and ⭐⭐ a safety section lists its guarantees item by item**, no real API keys or credentials, all data fictional and hardcoded, no network calls, no user input collection or form submission, and no protected health information or personal data beyond fictional names and addresses. **⑤ ⭐⭐ What is not built is listed as a roadmap** — six items given verbatim, a real risk-scoring provider, per-agency row-level security, a document ingestion pipeline, workload-balanced adjuster assignment, a multi-agency architecture with portfolio analytics and a customer self-service portal — ⭐ **so the unbuilt part is registered rather than left to be discovered**, ⭐ **the same family as the gap register recorded two rounds earlier**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Other details**: **the stack is given item by item**, a framework, a language, a styling library, a test runner, a lint configuration, continuous integration covering four checks **and a data layer described as static typed fixtures with a backend-compatible schema design**; **the architecture is given line by line**, all interfaces in one file, fixtures in another and a single page holding every section; **two start-up commands are given with the port**; **the readme carries a set of screenshots with their purposes listed**; **and the repository describes itself as built as a portfolio demonstration and ready for review**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]], [[claims-integrity-investigator]], [[claimlens]], [[insurance-analytics-tsql]], [[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] and [[insurerisk]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Three signals agree that there is no licence statement**: **the licence field is empty, the API response containing no licence object**, **no licence file exists at the root, a raw probe returning 404**, **and the readme returns no hit for licence, copyright or the copyright sign** — ⭐ **the entry notes that this is a portfolio demonstration whose stated purpose is to be reviewed, and that being readable and being redistributable are two different things**. **② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was run** — **no runtime or dependency installed, none of the four quality gates run, none of the ten tests run, the development server not started and none of its screenshots opened**; **so this entry does not claim the dashboard builds, runs, that the four gates really pass or that the ten tests really succeed**, ⭐ **what it verified being the verbatim readme and the file structure measured through the trees endpoint**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No source was read**, ⭐ **so whether the fixtures really have a single injection point, whether there really are no network calls and whether the types really cover the stated entities were not checked** — ⭐ **the single most important thing to verify next for this entry, and one that is equally easy to check by counting imports and searching for a network call**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ One internal tension is laid side by side without being judged and without the entry taking a side**: **the readme quotes an agency owner verbatim**, saying that three hours a day go into sorting claims email and that fraud in the pipeline cannot be proven without pulling every file manually, **attributed verbatim to one agency owner telling the authors**, **while a different section of the same readme states verbatim that all data are fictional and injected through a single import** — ⭐ **this entry therefore places the two side by side only**, ⚠️ **asserting neither that the quotation came from a real interview nor that it belongs to the fictional part, since the repository does not draw that boundary in its own words**. **⑤ ⭐ One judgement about reader design is recorded plainly**: **this entry considers writing an entry path for machine readers worth noting**, ⚠️ **while making no claim that the practice is established, since only one of this round’s four does it**, ⭐ **and its entry path points at types and fixtures rather than at behaviour or interface contracts**. **⑥ ⚠️ At 0 stars with no forks and no topics, the author and their affiliation were not verified**, ⭐ **the readme saying only that it was built for a named party, which this entry reports as stated**. **⑦ ⚠️ Creation and push both fall inside the thaw window**. **⑧ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: the repository was read on 2026-09-11 through the repository search endpoint and the GitHub API for stars, fork count, the absence of a licence object, language, size, dates, topics and default branch; the 7,988-byte readme was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; the existence of a root licence file was probed and returned 404; **the file listing was read through the trees endpoint, 29 files and 7 directories with truncation false**; **nothing was cloned, no dependency was installed, no script or test was run, the application was not started or opened, no screenshot was opened, no source content was read, and no network observation was made**.
entries.verified_note: GitHub API／倉庫檢索實測（repo，2026-09-11）：★0｜fork 0｜**許可字段 NONE（API 響應無許可對象）**｜TypeScript｜**10,625 KB**｜created 2026-06-09（窗口之內）｜pushed 2026-09-09（窗口之內）｜無 topics｜默認分支 main｜README 7,988 位元組｜文件清單經 GitHub API tree 接口實測（29 文件、7 目錄，truncated=false；docs/ 10（含多張截圖）、src/ 8、scripts/ 2、tests/ 2，另有 .env.example、.portfolio-demo、README.md、eslint.config.mjs、next-env.d.ts、next.config.ts、package-lock.json）｜⭐⭐⭐把讀者分成三類並對機器讀者給出入口：逐字「Agency principals and brokers.」「Engineering evaluators.」「AI agents and screeners.」，後者逐字「If you are evaluating this repo programmatically, start with `src/lib/types.ts` for the data model and `src/lib/demo-data.ts` for the fixtures.」——四處已寫明：①第三類讀者是 AI 代理與篩查者（本站首次見到把「被程序評估」寫成讀者類別；與第 346／347 輪「代理說明文件進入精算倉庫」是同一現象的另一面）；②入口是兩份文件（類型先、數據後）；③「在用程序評估」這一前提被直接寫出；④第一類讀者的痛點被具體描述（面向業務讀者寫的是問題而不是功能）｜⭐⭐⭐四道質量門自證：逐字給出 npm run lint（--max-warnings=0）／typecheck（tsc --noEmit）／test（vitest run）／build（next build），並逐字「All four must pass before any push.」；測試文件逐字 `tests/insurance.test.ts -- 10 integrity tests on demo data`——三處已寫明：①四道門各自可執行（兩道不留餘地）；②自證前置到推送之前；③10 條完整性測試針對夾具本身｜⭐⭐⭐夾具內容逐條列出：逐字「8 policies, 6 claims, 10 customers」、「欺詐檢測抓住一筆 87/100 的理賠，其餘都低於 25」、「客戶分層：鉑金（3）、金（3）、銀（2）、標準（2）」、理賠覆蓋新建／審核中／已批准／已支付／已拒賠五階段——三處已寫明：①規模與分布都寫出；②哪一筆會被抓住被點名（演示類倉庫最實用的說明）；③狀態機形狀也在文檔裡｜⭐⭐⭐假與真分開寫：逐字「All data is fictional, typesafe, and injected through a single import. The dashboard renders in one scrollable page with zero network calls.」與「It is a demo, not a product. But the architecture is real」，數據流逐字「從 demo-data.ts 經 page.tsx 流出，沒有 API 調用、沒有數據庫、也沒有認證」，並逐字說明 AI 評分在演示數據裡是靜態值而架構支持在同樣類型背後換入真實提供方——四處已寫明：①單一注入點是可檢查的性質；②零網絡調用可檢查（與 fasal-pramaan-crop-claims 的「設備端檢查」同向）；③演示身份與架構主張分開；④另有「安全」一節逐條列出（無真實密鑰／數據虛構且硬編碼／無網絡調用／不收集輸入／除虛構姓名地址外無 PHI 或 PII）｜⭐⭐生產路線圖六項逐字（真實風險評分提供方／按機構隔離的行級安全持久化／文件攝取流水線／理算員自動分配／多機構架構與組合分析／客戶自助門戶）——未做的部分被登記（與第 346 輪缺口登記同族）｜⭐其餘：技術棧逐條（Next.js 15 App Router／TypeScript 5／Tailwind 3／Vitest／ESLint 9 flat config／CI 四項／數據層為靜態 TypeScript 夾具並採用與某後端兼容的 schema 設計）；架構逐行（types.ts 放接口、demo-data.ts 放夾具、page.tsx 單頁）；兩條啟動命令；README 含一組截圖（逐字給出七張用途）；自述「作為作品集演示而構建。可供評審」｜⚠️⚠️**三重信號一致指向無許可**：GitHub 許可字段為空（無許可對象）＋ 根目錄 LICENSE 探測 404 ＋ README 檢索 licen／copyright／© 零命中（作品集性質演示倉庫，自述用途為供人評審；「可以讀到」與「可以再分發」是兩件事）｜⚠️⚠️⚠️本次未運行任何一步（未裝 Node 或依賴、未跑四道門、未跑 10 條測試、未啟動開發伺服器、未打開任何截圖），故不主张該看板可構建可運行、四道門全綠或 10 條測試通過｜⚠️⚠️未讀任何源碼（未核對單一注入點、是否確實無網絡調用、類型是否覆蓋所述實體）——**本條目最需後續核實的一處，且易於核實（數一次 import、搜一次 fetch）**｜⭐⭐⭐**一處內部張力如實並列、不判為錯誤也不替它選邊**：README「項目故事」逐字引用一位機構負責人的話（逐字「我一天有三個小時只是在整理理賠郵件。我知道流程裡有欺詐，但不動手翻每一份檔案我就證明不了」）並寫作「一位機構負責人告訴我們」；而同一份 README 另一節逐字寫著全部數據為虛構並由單一 import 注入——本詞條只把兩處並列，⚠️ 不主张該引語來自真實訪談、也不主张它屬於虛構部分（該倉庫未在自己的文字裡劃出邊界）｜⭐一處讀者設計的如實評價：本詞條認為「給機器讀者寫入口」值得記，⚠️ 但不主张已成慣例（本輪四條中僅此一條；且其入口指向類型與夾具而非行為或接口契約）｜⚠️★0、fork 0、無 topics，未核實作者與所屬方｜⚠️創建與推送均在解凍窗口之內（2026-06-09／2026-09-09）｜⚠️本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見

entries.title: **实现以规格为准，而规格与计划各占一个目录**：一份从保险产品说明书抽取对象、属性、关系与实例并投影到图的项目**逐字写明「实现以对象关系规格为准」**（**并给出规格文件的确切路径**）；**它同时把**计划与规格分开放****（**`docs/superpowers/plans/` 与 `docs/superpowers/specs/` 各两份带日期的文件**）；**另有两处「没有就是没有」被直说**：**逐字「空库启动，无种子数据，无领域包」与「无 OCR：扫描件或加密 PDF 会提示『无法提取文本』」**
entries.title_en: The implementation follows a specification, and the specification and the plan each get their own directory: a project that extracts objects, attributes, relations and instances from insurance product documents and projects them onto a graph states verbatim that the implementation takes the object-relation specification as authoritative and gives that specification file by exact path, keeps plans and specifications in two separate directories as four dated files, and says plainly in two places what it does not have, starting from an empty store with no seed data and no domain package and giving no OCR at all, telling the user that a scanned or encrypted PDF cannot have its text extracted

entries.summary_en: A tool that turns insurance product documents into a knowledge graph — 0 stars, Python, a 100 KB repository, created and last pushed inside the thaw window — describing itself verbatim as extracting objects, attributes, relations and instances from insurance product documents and projecting them onto a graph, and stating verbatim that the implementation takes the object-relation specification as authoritative while giving that specification file by exact path. **Its most notable feature is that the basis and the plan are kept apart**: measurement finds two dated plan files and two dated specification files in two separate directories. **The second is that it writes emptiness down**, verbatim starting from an empty store with no seed data and no domain package. **The third is that it writes down what it cannot do**, verbatim giving no OCR and telling the user that a scanned or encrypted PDF cannot have its text extracted. **A further point concerns default availability**: verbatim, the rules-only extractor still works when no model key is configured.
entries.body:
**ontocore-insurance-ontology**（仓库 `Mr-Yoje/OntoCore`）**是一份把保险产品说明书变成知识图谱的工具**：**逐字自述为**「**从保险产品说明书抽取对象、属性、关系与实例，并投影到图。**」**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可字段为 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信号一致，见下**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 **100 KB**、**创建 2026-09-10**、最后推送 2026-09-11、默认分支为 `master`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建与推送**都在解冻窗口之内****）；**README 实测 1,606 字节（**中文**）**；**仓库实测共 **70 个文件、20 个目录**（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测，`truncated` 为 false；含 `backend/` 56 项、`frontend/` 23 项、`docs/` 8 项，**外加 `README.md`、`docker-compose.yml`、`.gitignore`**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「出处与占位：主张的依据，与尚未有依据的部分」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**把「依据」与「计划」放得最分明的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把**规格**指名为实现的依据，并给出确切路径**——**逐字为**：**「**实现以对象关系规格为准（见 `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-10-ontocore-objects-relations-design.md`）。**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「以対象関係規格为准」里的「为准」二字是一句**优先级声明****（**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮主题最直白的一处措辞：**它说的不是「参考」，**而是**谁说了算****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **规格文件带**日期前缀**（`2026-09-10-`）**——**⭐ 即**依据本身有**时点**；**③ ⭐⭐ **依据是**一个文件**，**而不是一句「按需求」**（**⭐ 即读者可以**去读它****）；**④ ⭐⭐ **同一句里还给出了**改显示名后图上标签同步**这一可观察行为**（**逐字见其演示路径第 4 步**）**——**⭐ 即**依据之外还有**可验证的现象**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「计划」与「规格」分成两个目录，各两份带日期的文件**——**实测其 `docs/` 下**：**`superpowers/plans/2026-09-10-ontocore-objects-relations.md`、`superpowers/plans/2026-09-10-ontocore-phase1.md`、`superpowers/specs/2026-09-10-ontocore-design.md`、`superpowers/specs/2026-09-10-ontocore-objects-relations-design.md`**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **计划与规格是**两类不同文件**，**不混放****（**⭐ 即**「打算怎么做」与「做出来应当是什么」**被分开存****）；**② ⭐⭐ **四个文件**同日创建**（**均带 `2026-09-10` 前缀**）**——**⭐ 即**这是一份**在一天之内把依据与计划都写下来的**仓库**（**⭐ 其创建日期亦为 2026-09-10**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **实测 `docs/` 共 **8 项**，**而 README 只点名其中一份**——**⭐ 即**依据**被指名，**其余**留在目录里**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「空」与「做不到」分别写出来**——**逐字为**：**「**空库启动，无种子数据，无领域包。」**与**「**无 OCR：扫描件或加密 PDF 会提示「无法提取文本」。」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **ontocore-insurance-ontology** (repository `Mr-Yoje/OntoCore`) **is a tool that turns insurance product documents into a knowledge graph**, describing itself verbatim as extracting objects, attributes, relations and instances from insurance product documents and projecting them onto a graph. **Measured 0 stars, 0 forks, a licence field of NONE** — ⚠️ three signals agreeing, as set out below — **primary language Python, a 100 KB repository, created 2026-09-10, last pushed 2026-09-11, with master as the default branch** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **creation and push both inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 1,606 bytes and is in Chinese**; **the repository measures 70 files and 20 directories**, read through the trees endpoint with truncation false, holding a backend of fifty-six entries, a frontend of twenty-three and a documentation directory of eight, plus a readme, a compose file and an ignore file. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **where a claim points and where the parts without a basis are written**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it separates the basis from the plan most clearly**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It names a specification as the authority for the implementation and gives that file by exact path** — verbatim, the implementation takes the object-relation specification as authoritative, followed by the full path of that specification file ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **taking something as authoritative is a statement of precedence rather than of reference, saying who decides rather than what was consulted**, ⭐ **which this entry takes as the plainest wording of the round’s theme**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the specification file carries a date prefix, so the basis itself has a point in time**; ⭐⭐ **the basis is a file rather than a phrase such as according to requirements, so a reader can go and read it**; **and ⭐⭐ the same sentence names an observable behaviour, labels on the graph updating when a display name changes**, ⭐ **so beside the basis there is also something to observe**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It keeps plans and specifications in two separate directories, two dated files in each** — measurement of its documentation directory finds two plan files and two specification files, all four carrying the same date prefix ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **plans and specifications are two different kinds of file and are not stored together, so how the work is to be done and what the result must be are kept apart**; ⭐⭐ **all four files were created on the same day**, ⭐ **a repository that wrote both its basis and its plan inside a single day, its creation date being the same**; **and ⭐⭐ the documentation directory holds eight entries while the readme names only one of them**, ⭐ **so the basis is named and the rest stay in the directory**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It writes emptiness and incapability out separately** — verbatim, it starts from an empty store with no seed data and no domain package, **and gives no OCR, telling the user that a scanned or encrypted PDF cannot have its text extracted** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **starting from an empty store is an architectural choice rather than a shortcoming, since nothing domain-specific is preloaded and the extraction result belongs to the user**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the absence of OCR is immediately followed by what the user will see, not a bare not-yet-supported but the sentence the user will be shown**, ⭐ **which this entry considers the most practical item in the round’s theme**; ⭐⭐⭐ **domain content is separated from the tool, the ontology being something the user writes**; **and ⭐⭐ the notification of failure sits where a feature list would sit rather than in a frequently-asked-questions section**. **④ ⭐⭐ It states which path still works without a model key** — verbatim, the key or another provider key is optional **and the rules-only extractor still works when none is set**, with the extractor offered as two named modes in the demonstration steps ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **when each path is available is stated, so a complete route exists without a key**; ⭐⭐ **the graph database is optional too, falling back to an in-memory graph, so the minimal path needs no external service**; **and ⭐⭐ two installation routes are given**, ⭐ **so a reader’s toolchain is not assumed**. **⑤ ⭐ Other details**: **the backend requires a specific Python version and the start command is given as an application factory**, ⭐ **the factory pattern being written into the command itself**; **the data directory defaults to a temporary one**; **the front end has its own install, test and development commands with the proxy target stated**; **and the four demonstration steps place review before projection**, a person accepting the type candidates before anything is projected into the graph. **⑥ ⭐ The absence of a licence is recorded plainly** below. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[acord]], [[insurance-ner-nre]], [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]], [[kgqa-insurance-product]], [[clausegraph]] and [[neo4j-gds]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Three signals agree that there is no licence statement**: **the GitHub licence field is NONE**, **neither a licence file nor a licence markdown file exists at the root of the default branch, both raw probes returning 404**, **and the readme returns no hit for licence, copyright or the copyright sign** — ⭐ **the entry notes that this is a tool which reads a user’s product documents, and that being readable and being redistributable are two different things**. **② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was run** — **no Python or Node dependency installed, the backend not started, the test suite and the front-end tests not run, no document uploaded, no graph projected and no interface opened**; entries.title: **一份文件写明「两份基线冲突时谁赢」，并禁止发明业务规则**：一个商业财险语义系统**逐字把蓝图定为「过程与范围的**唯一**事实源**」，**并逐字规定**「**两者不一致时，**本文档在过程与范围上优先，**主蓝图在架构意图上优先，**直到一份 ADR 裁定差异**」**；**它同时立了三条硬规矩**：**逐字「**如果信息缺失，就提问或标出待决事项——**不要发明业务规则**」**「**没有被写进这里或某个已批准特性目录的需求，**就不要实现它**」**「**冻结范围；**只做当前阶段与该特性所规定的东西**」**
entries.title_en: One file states which of two baselines wins when they disagree and forbids inventing business rules: a commercial property and casualty semantic system states verbatim that its blueprint is the only source of truth for process and scope, and specifies verbatim that where the two disagree the blueprint wins on process and scope while the master blueprint wins on architectural intent until an architecture decision record settles the difference, alongside three hard rules verbatim: if information is missing, ask questions or mark open decisions and do not invent business rules; if a requirement is not written here or in an approved feature folder, do not implement it; and no scope creep, building only what the current phase and feature specify
entries.title_hk: **一份文件寫明「兩份基線衝突時誰贏」，並禁止發明業務規則**：一個商業財險語義系統**逐字把藍圖定為「過程與範圍的**唯一**事實源**」，**並逐字規定**「**兩者不一致時，**本文檔在過程與範圍上優先，**主藍圖在架構意圖上優先，**直到一份 ADR 裁定差異**」**；**它同時立了三條硬規矩**：**逐字「**如果信息缺失，就提問或標出待決事項——**不要發明業務規則**」**「**沒有被寫進這裡或某個已批准特性目錄的需求，**就不要實現它**」**「**凍結範圍；**只做當前階段與該特性所規定的東西**」**
entries.summary: 一份**面向商业财险的企业语义系统**（**★1**、**MIT**、仓库体量 2.2 MB、**实测 657 个文件**）：**逐字自述其功能为**「**一次性摄取文档、保留证据、**把「来源所声称的」与「企业所接受的」分开**，**并通过 360 视图、检索、图、API、代理与对话暴露受治理的**双时态知识**」**；**其最值得记的一处是它把**谁说了算**写死在文件里**——**逐字「**本文档是过程、范围与平台基线的**唯一**事实源**」**，**并**逐字规定两份基线冲突时的优先次序**（**过程与范围归本文档、**架构意图归主蓝图，**直到一份 ADR 裁定差异**）**；**第二处是它**禁止发明****——**逐字「**如果信息缺失，就提问或标出待决事项——**不要发明业务规则**」**，**以及**逐字「**没有被写进这里或某个已批准特性目录的需求，**就不要实现它**」**与「**冻结范围**」**；**第三处是它把**跟踪表当成编译产物****（**逐字「**计划跟踪表必须始终同步。**把过期的跟踪表状态视为**流程缺陷**」**，**并**逐字「**绝不手工编辑生成的区域**」**）；**⚠️ 而其 README 逐字写着「**尚无运行时代码**」，**而实测 `engine/` 下有 **86 个 `.py` 文件**
entries.summary_hk: 一份**面向商業財險的企業語義系統**（**★1**、**MIT**、體量 2.2 MB、**實測 657 個文件**）：**逐字自述其功能為**「**一次性攝取文檔、保留證據、**把「來源所聲稱的」與「企業所接受的」分開**，**並通過 360 視圖、檢索、圖、API、代理與對話暴露受治理的**雙時態知識**」**；**其最值得記的一處是它把**誰說了算**寫死在文件裡**——**逐字「**本文檔是過程、範圍與平台基線的**唯一**事實源**」**，**並**逐字規定兩份基線衝突時的優先次序**（**過程與範圍歸本文檔、**架構意圖歸主藍圖，**直到一份 ADR 裁定差異**）**；**第二處是它**禁止發明****——**逐字「**如果信息缺失，就提問或標出待決事項——**不要發明業務規則**」**，**以及**逐字「**沒有被寫進這裡或某個已批准特性目錄的需求，**就不要實現它**」**與「**凍結範圍**」**；**第三處是它把**跟蹤表當成編譯產物****（**逐字「**計劃跟蹤表必須始終同步。**把過期的跟蹤表狀態視為**流程缺陷**」**，**並**逐字「**絕不手工編輯生成的區域**」**）；**⚠️ 而其 README 逐字寫著「**尚無運行時代碼**」，**而實測 `engine/` 下有 **86 個 `.py` 文件**
entries.summary_en: An enterprise semantic system for commercial property and casualty insurance — 1 star under MIT, a 2.2 MB repository measured at 657 files — describing itself verbatim as ingesting documents once, preserving evidence, separating what sources claim from what the enterprise accepts, and exposing governed bitemporal knowledge through 360 views, search, a graph, APIs, agents and conversation. **Its most notable feature is that who decides is written into the file**: verbatim, the document is the only source of truth for process, scope and platform baselines, and it specifies verbatim that where the two baselines disagree the document wins on process and scope while the master blueprint wins on architectural intent until an architecture decision record settles the difference. **The second is that it forbids invention**, verbatim instructing that if information is missing one should ask questions or mark open decisions and **not invent business rules**, alongside verbatim rules that a requirement not written in the document or an approved feature folder should not be implemented and that there must be no scope creep. **The third is that trackers are treated as compiled output**, verbatim requiring that planning trackers stay in sync at all times and that stale tracker state be treated as a process defect, and verbatim forbidding hand-editing of generated regions. ⚠️ **Its readme states verbatim that there is no runtime code yet, while measurement finds 86 Python files under the engine directory.**
entries.body:
**nebula-insurance-brain**（仓库 `gajakannan/nebula-insurance-brain`）**是一份面向商业财险的企业语义系统**：**逐字自述为**「**a continuously evolving enterprise semantic system for commercial Property & Casualty insurance.**」**，**并逐字说明其功能是**「**一次性摄取文档、**保留证据、**把来源所声称的与企业所接受的**分开**，**并通过 360 视图、检索、图、API、代理与对话暴露**受治理的双时态知识**」**。**实测 **★1**、fork 0、许可 **MIT**（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件，**raw 探测 HTTP 200**；**GitHub 许可字段亦为 MIT**）、主语言 HTML、仓库体量 **2,274 KB**、**创建 2026-09-06**、最后推送 2026-09-11**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建与推送**都在解冻窗口之内****）；**README 实测 3,440 字节**；**仓库实测共 **657 个文件、225 个目录**（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测，`truncated` 为 false；含 **`planning-mds/` 501 项**（**其中 **206 份 `.md`**、**111 份 `.yaml`**）、**`engine/` 149 项**（**108 个文件里 **86 个 `.py`**）、**`scripts/` 120 项**、**`neuron/` 46 项**（**30 个文件里 **20 个 `.py`**）、**`experience/` 24 项**（**20 个文件里 **8 个 `.tsx`**），**另有 `docker/`、`.github/`、`docs/`、`profiles/`、`.githooks/`、`config/`**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「出处与占位：主张的依据，与尚未有依据的部分」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**把「谁说了算」写得最硬的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README、`planning-mds/BLUEPRINT.md`、`DESCRIPTION` 式文件与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把**两份基线冲突时谁赢**写死在文件里**——**其 `planning-mds/BLUEPRINT.md` 逐字为**：**「**This document is the framework entry point and the **ONLY source of truth** for process, scope, and platform baselines.**」**，**并**另起一句逐字为**：**「**Where the two disagree, this document wins for process and scope and the master blueprint wins for architectural intent until an ADR settles the difference.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「唯一事实源」是对**过程与范围**说的，**而不是对全部**说的****——**⭐ 即**它**划定了自己权威的边界**（**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮主题**最成熟的一处**：**不是「一切以本文为准」，**而是**「这几种事以本文为准」****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **冲突时的裁决规则**被写成一句完整的条件句**（**谁赢、**赢在哪个维度、**以及**什么能推翻它**）**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **推翻机制是**一份 ADR**（**⭐ 即**分歧**有**唯一出口**，**而不是靠讨论**）；**④ ⭐⭐ **它同时说明**两份基线各自管什么**（**过程与范围**对**架构意图**）**——**⭐ 即**这不是优先级排序，**而是**分工****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它禁止发明，并把「没写下来的」当成边界**——**逐字四条**：**「**If information is missing, ask questions or mark open decisions — **do NOT invent business rules.**」**「**If a requirement is not written here or in an approved feature folder, **do not implement it.**」**「**If there is ambiguity, list questions and propose minimal default assumptions **labeled clearly.**」**「**No scope creep. Build only what is specified for the current phase and feature.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「不要发明业务规则」**是本条**最锋利的一句****（**⭐ 与第 348 轮 [[insurance-advisor-platform]] 的「把每一条编造的占位数字登记成一份文件」构成一对：**一个禁止发明，**一个把已发明的东西登记出来****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「未被写下的就不要实现」把**沉默**变成了**否定的授权****（**⭐ 即**默认答案是「不做」**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **含糊时的出口是**列问题 ＋ 明确标注的最小默认假设****（**⭐ 即**不是禁止假设，**而是**要求假设带标签****）；**④ ⭐⭐ **「冻结范围」随后紧跟一条**只做当前阶段与该特性**的限定**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把计划跟踪表当成**编译产物**，并把过期当成缺陷**——**逐字为**：**「**Planning trackers must stay in sync at all times. **Treat stale tracker state as a process defect.**」**，**以及**「**`features/REGISTRY.md`、`features/ROADMAP.md` 与 `knowledge-graph/` 投影由 `scripts/kg/compile.py` **从 `kg-source/**` 分片编译得到**；**绝不手工编辑生成的区域**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「把过期的跟踪表状态视为**流程缺陷**」**——**⭐ 即**文档不同步**在这里是**可归责的缺陷**，**而不是疏忽****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **跟踪表是**生成的**，**不是手写的****（**⭐ 即**权威在 `kg-source/**` 分片，**而不在 REGISTRY 表格里**）**；**③ ⭐⭐ **它要求**在宣布任何规划或特性门通过之前**先跑校验器**（**逐字「Run the framework tracker and story validators against this repo before declaring any planning or feature gate complete」**）**。**④ ⭐⭐ **它的**过程**本身有三段，且每段有产出**——**逐字给出三段**（**A 产品经理模式：**产出特性目录（PRD、故事、STATUS、上手指南）；**B 架构师／技术负责人模式：**产出特性装配计划、ADR、API 与 schema 契约、kg-source 分片；**C 实现模式：**产出「生产级代码 ＋ 测试 ＋ 运行说明 ＋ 每个特性一份证据包」**）**——**⭐ 即**每一段的产出被逐条列出**，**故**「做到哪一步」可被核对**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **它把框架**钉在一个提交上**，并要求**有意地推进**——**逐字给出框架名与提交哈希全值（`c218bf1776f509a30f71967a1ee79879caa9a000`，**日期 2026-09-07**）**，**并逐字要求**「**有意地推进这个钉版，**与 CI 门的工作流同步，**并把新提交记录在这里」**⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **依赖被钉到具体提交**（**⭐ 即**「用哪个版本的框架」**是文档里的一行**）；**② ⭐⭐ **推进被要求**写回文档**（**⭐ 即**升级不是一个隐式动作**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **nebula-insurance-brain** (repository `gajakannan/nebula-insurance-brain`) **is an enterprise semantic system for commercial property and casualty insurance**, describing itself verbatim as a continuously evolving enterprise semantic system for commercial property and casualty insurance and stating its function verbatim as ingesting documents once, preserving evidence, **separating what sources claim from what the enterprise accepts**, and exposing governed bitemporal knowledge through 360 views, search, a graph, APIs, agents and conversation. **Measured 1 star, 0 forks, licence **MIT** with a licence file measurably present and answering 200 to a raw probe, the GitHub licence field agreeing, primary language HTML, a 2,274 KB repository, created 2026-09-06, last pushed 2026-09-11** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **creation and push both inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 3,440 bytes**; **the repository measures 657 files and 225 directories**, read through the trees endpoint with truncation false, holding a planning directory of five hundred and one entries including two hundred and six markdown files and a hundred and eleven YAML files, an engine directory of a hundred and forty-nine entries including eighty-six Python files, a scripts directory of a hundred and twenty, a neuron directory including twenty Python files, an experience directory including eight TypeScript React files, and docker, workflow, documentation, profile, hook and configuration directories. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **where a claim points and where the parts without a basis are written**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it states who decides most firmly**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README, the blueprint and the measured tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It writes which of two baselines wins when they disagree into the file itself** — the blueprint states verbatim that the document is the framework entry point and **the only source of truth for process, scope and platform baselines**, **and states in a separate sentence, also verbatim, that where the two disagree this document wins for process and scope while the master blueprint wins for architectural intent until an architecture decision record settles the difference** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the claim to be the only source of truth is made for process and scope rather than for everything, so the document bounds its own authority**, ⭐ **which this entry considers the most mature item in the round’s theme, since it is not everything here is authoritative but these particular things are**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the rule for disagreement is written as a complete conditional naming who wins, on which dimension, and what can overturn it**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the overturning mechanism is an architecture decision record, so a disagreement has exactly one exit rather than being settled by discussion**; **and ⭐⭐ it also says what each baseline governs, process and scope against architectural intent, which is a division of labour rather than a ranking**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It forbids invention and treats what is unwritten as a boundary** — four rules are given verbatim, that if information is missing one should ask questions or mark open decisions **and not invent business rules**, that a requirement not written in the document or in an approved feature folder **should not be implemented**, that against ambiguity one should list questions and propose minimal default assumptions **labeled clearly**, and that there should be **no scope creep**, building only what the current phase and feature specify ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the instruction not to invent business rules is the sharpest sentence here**, ⭐ **and forms a pair with the previous round’s entry that registers every invented placeholder number, one forbidding invention and the other listing what has already been invented**; ⭐⭐⭐ **not implementing what is unwritten converts silence into a negative authorisation, the default answer being no**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the exit from ambiguity is listing questions plus clearly labelled minimal default assumptions, so assumptions are not forbidden but must carry a label**; **and ⭐⭐ the freeze on scope is immediately followed by a limit to the current phase and feature**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It treats planning trackers as compiled output and treats staleness as a defect** — verbatim, planning trackers must stay in sync at all times and stale tracker state is to be treated as **a process defect**, and verbatim the registry, the roadmap and the knowledge-graph projections are compiled from source shards, with generated regions never to be hand-edited ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **stale tracker state being a process defect makes documentation drift an attributable defect rather than an oversight**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the trackers are generated rather than written, so authority sits in the source shards**; **and ⭐⭐ validators must be run before declaring any planning or feature gate complete**. **④ ⭐⭐ The process itself has three phases, each with named outputs** — a product-manager mode producing feature folders, an architect mode producing assembly plans, decision records, API and schema contracts and knowledge-graph shards, and an implementation mode producing production-quality code with tests, run instructions and one evidence package per run. **⑤ ⭐⭐ It pins the framework to a specific commit and requires deliberate advancement** — the framework name and commit hash are given in full with a date, and the blueprint requires advancing the pin deliberately in step with the continuous-integration workflow and recording the new commit in the document ⭐⭐ **Two things**: ⭐⭐ **a dependency is pinned to a commit, so which version of the framework is in use is a line in the document**; **and ⭐⭐ advancing it must be written back**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Other details**: **a table assigns an owning role to each top-level path**, product manager, architect, backend developer, AI engineer, frontend developer and quality engineer; **measurement finds seven named decision records**, covering the brain owning semantics, the authoritative runtime store, one-time content extraction, separately versioned source artefacts and interpretations, a three-plane knowledge model, canonical semantic identity through a fact slot, and full bitemporality; **agent instructions, a plan review checklist, a framework adoption document and a project-level configuration file are all present**; **each clone must install a local hook**, ⭐ **so knowledge-graph reproducibility is enforced by a hook**; **and the source of the knowledge graph is separated from its product**, the source being authored and the projections and registry tables being compiled. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[clausegraph]], [[insurance-governance]], [[kgqa-insurance-product]], [[acord-mcp-architecture]], [[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]] and [[risk-management-ontology]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ A mismatch between a statement and measurement is the point needing most annotation here, and it was found by measuring**: **the readme states verbatim that the status is a planning baseline with no runtime code yet, and again verbatim that the repository remains a planning baseline with no runtime implementation, while measurement finds eighty-six Python files under the engine directory, eight TypeScript React files under the experience directory and twenty Python files under the neuron directory, with the API source directory containing modules named for the application, configuration, dependencies and errors, and a build configuration present** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **this entry does not claim which side is right**, ⚠️ **possible explanations including a readme that has not been updated alongside the code, or scaffolding not being counted as runtime code**, ⭐ **and it read none of those files, so it draws no conclusion**; ⭐⭐ **the two statements appear twice in the same readme, in the status line and again near the end, so a typo seems unlikely**; **and ⭐⭐⭐ this entry places that mismatch beside the blueprint’s prohibition on invention and its demand for synchronicity**, ⭐ **since the repository’s process discipline is written very firmly while its own status statement sits exactly where synchronisation is required, making a statement a kind of citation that itself needs maintaining**. **② ⚠️ The licence is MIT**, ⚠️ **with its contents not read**. **③ ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was run** — **no Python or Node dependency installed, neither its API nor its front end started, no test run, no compilation script run, no hook installed and no file outside the readme and blueprint opened**; **so this entry does not claim its ingestion, its bitemporal governance or its compilation flow work as described**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ Of its two hundred and six markdown files, none beyond the blueprint was read**, ⭐ **so the bodies of the seven decision records and the existence of the feature folders and evidence packages were not checked** — ⭐ **the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **⑤ ⚠️ At 1 star, the highest-attention entry of this round, with no forks, the author’s background was not verified**. **⑥ ⚠️ Creation and push both fall inside the thaw window**. **⑦ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: the repository was read on 2026-09-11 through the repository search endpoint and the GitHub API for stars, licence, language, size and dates; the 3,440-byte readme and the first fifty lines of the blueprint were read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; the licence file’s existence was confirmed by a raw probe returning 200; **the file listing, per-directory counts and extension distribution were measured through the trees endpoint, 657 files and 225 directories with truncation false**; **nothing was cloned, no dependency was installed, no script or test was run, no service was started, no hook was installed, no documentation beyond the blueprint was read, and no network observation was made**.
