entries.title: **把「一份文档怎么变成可问的东西」拆成可独立替换的几段，并说明这条组合是固定的**：一个精算与保险研究的文档情报平台**逐字写明每一段都锚在「**共享的领域服务与**稳定的 JSON 任务或资源契约**」上**，**因而逐字「**React 界面、**内置流水线与外部自动化**用的是同一份输入输出」**；**并逐字给这条流水线定了性**——**「**这条内置的接力**是**有意设计成一条固定的、可观察的组合**，**而不是一个通用的 DAG 编辑器」**
entries.title_en: Splitting how a document becomes something you can ask into separately replaceable stages and stating that the composition is fixed: a document-intelligence platform for actuarial and insurance research states verbatim that every stage rests on a shared domain service and a stable JSON task or resource contract, so that the interface, the built-in pipeline and external automation use the same inputs and outputs, and characterises the pipeline verbatim as an intentionally fixed and observable composition rather than a general directed-acyclic-graph editor
entries.title_hk: **把「一份文檔怎麼變成可問的東西」拆成可獨立替換的幾段，並說明這條組合是固定的**：一個精算與保險研究的文檔情報平台**逐字寫明每一段都錨在「**共享的領域服務與**穩定的 JSON 任務或資源契約**」上**，**因而逐字「**React 界面、**內置流水線與外部自動化**用的是同一份輸入輸出」**；**並逐字給這條流水線定了性**——**「**這條內置的接力**是**有意設計成一條固定的、可觀察的組合**，**而不是一個通用的 DAG 編輯器」**
entries.summary: 一份**面向精算与保险研究的文档情报平台**（**★3**、Python、仓库体量 7.5 MB、**实测 README 16,576 字节且中英各一份**）：**逐字自述为**「**一个 FastAPI ＋ React 的文档情报平台**，**它**会**发现、下载、编目、转换、检索**，**并**与公开网页文档和浏览器上传的本地文件对话**」**；**其最值得记的一处是它**把「可替换的边界」写清****——**逐字「**只要保持阶段契约，**一个采集器、转换引擎、分类器、分块器、嵌入提供方、知识库索引／就绪数据构建器或对话检索策略**都可以被独立替换或升级」**；**第二处是它**把这条组合刻意定成固定的****——**逐字「**这条内置的接力是**有意设计成一条固定的、可观察的组合**，**而不是一个通用的 DAG 编辑器」**；**第三处是它**把「退役」也写进状态节****（**逐字「**旧的服务端渲染／Replit 时代的工作流**已退役」**，**并逐字说明 **FastAPI 是唯一的 `/api/*` 权威、**React／Vite 是唯一维护中的界面**），**以及**逐字声明**「受管路线图已无未合并 PR」**
entries.summary_hk: 一份**面向精算與保險研究的文檔情報平台**（**★3**、Python、體量 7.5 MB、**實測 README 16,576 位元組且中英各一份**）：**逐字自述為**「**一個 FastAPI ＋ React 的文檔情報平台**，**它會**發現、下載、編目、轉換、檢索**，**並**與公開網頁文檔和瀏覽器上傳的本地文件對話」**；**其最值得記的一處是它**把「可替換的邊界」寫清****——**逐字「**只要保持階段契約，**一個採集器、轉換引擎、分類器、分塊器、嵌入提供方、**知識庫索引／就緒數據構建器或對話檢索策略**都可以被獨立替換或升級」**；**第二處是它**把這條組合刻意定成固定的****——**逐字「**這條內置的接力是**有意設計成一條固定的、可觀察的組合**，**而不是一個通用的 DAG 編輯器」**；**第三處是它**把「退役」也寫進狀態節****（**逐字「**舊的服務端渲染／Replit 時代的工作流**已退役」**，**並逐字說明 **FastAPI 是唯一的 `/api/*` 權威、**React／Vite 是唯一維護中的界面**），以及**逐字聲明**「受管路線圖已無未合併 PR」**
entries.summary_en: A document-intelligence platform for actuarial and insurance research — 3 stars, Python, a 7.5 MB repository, with a README measured at 16,576 bytes in both English and Chinese — describing itself verbatim as a FastAPI and React document-intelligence platform that discovers, downloads, catalogs, converts, searches and chats with public web documents and browser-uploaded local files. **Its most notable feature is that it writes down where replacement is possible**: verbatim, so long as the stage contract is preserved, a collector, conversion engine, classifier, chunker, embedding provider, knowledge-base index or ready-data builder, or chat retrieval strategy can be replaced or upgraded independently. **The second is that it deliberately settles the composition as fixed**, verbatim that this built-in baton is intentionally a fixed and observable composition rather than a general graph editor. **The third is that retirement is written into the status section**, verbatim that the legacy server-rendered workflow is retired, alongside verbatim statements that one service is the only authority for the API surface and one framework the only maintained interface, and that the managed roadmap has no open pull requests left.
entries.body:
**ai-actuarial-info-search**（仓库 `ferryhe/AI_actuarial_inforsearch`）**是一份面向精算与保险研究的文档情报平台**：**逐字自述为**「**AI Actuarial Info Search is a FastAPI + React document-intelligence platform for actuarial and insurance research. It discovers, downloads, catalogs, converts, searches, and chats with public web documents and browser-uploaded local files.**」**。**实测 **★3**、fork 0、许可字段为 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信号一致，见下**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 **7,520 KB**、**创建 2026-01-27**、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**⭐ 推送落在解冻窗口之内**）**；**README 实测 **16,576 字节**，**且**另有简体中文版（`README.zh-CN.md`）**；**其正文含 **17 个二级小节**与一份**指向 11 份文档的索引**（**逐字含「架构」「**死代码与质量门」「**API 迁移状态」「**Agentic RAG 指南」「**生产安全配置」与「**归档的历史文档」**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「源与生成物」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**把「哪一段可以被换掉」写得最清楚的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把每一段锚在**同一份契约**上，因而**界面、内置流水线与外部自动化**三者等价**——**逐字为**：**「**All core workflow capabilities are exposed as **independently callable CLI and/or API operations**. Each processing stage is backed by a **shared domain service and a stable JSON task or resource contract**, so **the React UI, the built-in pipeline, and external automation use the same inputs and outputs.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「同一份输入输出」是本条**最符合本轮主题的一句****——**⭐ 即**界面**不是唯一入口，**而**流水线**也不是黑箱**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **契约是**任务或资源**两类**（**逐字 `JSON task or resource`**）**——**⭐ 即**「要做一件事」与「要看一件东西」**被分成两种契约**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **三个消费者被逐个点名**（**界面／**内置流水线／**外部自动化**）**——**⭐ 即**「可被外部编排」**不是暗示，**而是明写****；**④ ⭐⭐ **它给出**新采集器的最小接入方式****（**逐字「**一个新采集器可以实现公共的 `BaseCollector` 输入输出契约——**或者**一个外部生产者可以发出**同样的存储文件与元数据契约**——**而**不必改动 Markdown 转换或之后的任何阶段」**）**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把这条组合刻意定成**固定的、可观察的**，并说明不做什么**——**逐字为**：**「**This built-in baton is **intentionally a fixed, observable composition rather than a general DAG editor**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「固定的、可观察的组合」是一个**拒绝提供通用编排**的决定****——**⭐ 本词条认为这一句很值得抄：**它把「不做通用 DAG 编辑器」**写成了一条设计结论**，**而不是**待办事项****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「可替换」与「固定」并不矛盾**（**段落可换，**而**连接顺序固定**）**——**⭐ 即**它把**灵活性的位置**限定在**段内**；**③ ⭐⭐ **它随后给出**这条固定接力的完整顺序****（**逐字：**定时采集 → Markdown → **编目／分类 → **分块 ＋ 嵌入 → **知识库成员与绑定 → **知识库索引 ＋ 就绪数据 → **对话知识库**）**——**⭐ 即**读者**可以照这条线**核对产物**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字说明**升级为什么是局部的****——**逐字为**：**「**This separation keeps future upgrades local: **a collector, conversion engine, classifier, chunker, embedding provider, KB index/Ready Data builder, or Chat retrieval strategy can be replaced or upgraded independently as long as it preserves the stage contract.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **七个可替换位置被逐个点名**（**采集器／**转换引擎／**分类器／**分块器／**嵌入提供方／**索引与就绪数据构建器／**检索策略**）**——**⭐ 即**「可替换」有**具体清单**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **条件只有一个**（**「只要保持阶段契约」**）**——**⭐ 即**约束被写成一个**准入条件**，**而不是一堆规范**；**③ ⭐⭐ **「让未来的升级保持局部」是**理由**（**⭐ 即**拆段的动机**被说明**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **它的状态节把**退役**与**路线图完成**同样当成事实来报**——**逐字含**：**「**FastAPI is the only `/api/*` authority; React/Vite is the only maintained product UI. **The legacy server-rendered/Replit-era workflow is retired.**」**，**以及**「**Roadmap completion:** Agentic RAG PRs **#133-#145**、consolidation PRs **#147-#154**、managed Feishu-plan PR-A through PR-I（**#156-#164**）are merged; **there are no open managed-roadmap PRs.**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **「退役」被写成状态的一行**（**⭐ 即**拆掉的东西**也进状态栏**）；**② ⭐⭐ **权威被收敛到一处**（**逐字「唯一的 `/api/*` 权威」**）**——**⭐ 即**同一功能**不允许有两个入口**；**③ ⭐⭐ **路线图完成度用**合并的 PR 区间**证明**（**⭐ 即**读者可以**去核对那些 PR**）**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **安全态势一节逐条给出，且多是**可检查的机制****——**逐字含**：**「**Chat/RAG selected-document context is **bounded and marked untrusted** before it reaches the model」**、「**Public URL fetching checks **unsafe schemes, private/reserved IPs, redirect target changes, and DNS/IP drift**」**、「**Browser auth pages show friendly rate-limit and system-error messages **without exposing internals**」**，**以及**「**诊断密钥与凭据状态**而不打印密钥值」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **上下文被**界定范围并标记为不可信**（**⭐ 即**「把外部文档喂给模型」**这件事的**风险处理**被写出来**）；**② ⭐⭐ **对公网取数检查**重定向目标变化与 DNS／IP 漂移**（**⭐ 即**它防的不只是首跳**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **报错不暴露内部**与**诊断不打印密钥**是两条**面向运维的约束****。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **文档转换由一份 YAML 配置驱动**，**且**逐字说明**付费／API 工具默认**不会被自动选中****（**逐字「paid/API tools are not auto-selected by default」**）**——**⭐ 即**默认不花钱**是一个默认值决策**；**② **去重用 **SHA-256**，**并**增量编目**摘要、关键词与分类**；**③ **周更摘要用一个**首次见到时间**字段**（**逐字 `files.first_seen`**），**默认任务用**上一整周**（**逐字 `relative_period: previous_week`**）**；**④ **标准向量 RAG 与 Agentic RAG **并存**；**⑤ **它有**中英两份 README****（**⭐ 即**同一份说明**有两个语言版本**）**；**⑥ **其文档索引里把**死代码与质量门**单列一份文档**（**⭐ 即**清理**也被当成一项有记录的工程**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[firecrawl]]、[[llamaindex]]、[[chroma]]、[[ragas]]、[[langfuse]]、[[mineru]]、[[label-studio]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信号一致指向**没有许可声明****：**GitHub 许可字段为 **NONE****、**实测根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 均不存在**（**raw 探测均为 HTTP 404**）、**且 README 全文以「licen／copyright／©」检索**零命中****——**⭐ 本词条指出：**这是一份**会把公开网页文档与用户上传文件读进去**的平台，**而「可以读到」与「可以再分发」是两件事****。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次**没有安装或运行它的任何一步****——**未安装 Python／Node 依赖、未启动服务、未跑 `pytest`、未配置任何模型密钥、未采集任何站点、未打开其界面**；**故**本词条**不主张**其采集、转换、编目、分块、嵌入、索引或检索**按其所述工作**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的**逐字内容**（**含其 17 小节与 11 份文档索引**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读其任何源码或那 11 份文档****（**⭐ 即**未核对**阶段契约是否确实统一、**「不再有未合并的受管路线图 PR」是否属实、**以及**安全态势那几条是否在代码里落实**）**——**⭐ 这是本条目**最需要后续核实的一处**。**④ ⚠️ **★3**（**为本轮四条中关注度最高的一条**）、**fork 0**，**且**未核实作者背景**。**⑤ ⚠️ **创建在解冻窗口之前（2026-01-27）****，**入选依据是**推送落在窗口之内（2026-09-10）**。**⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其检索结果在任何精算用途上可依赖**（**⭐ 其自述**未给出任何质量指标**，**本词条**也不据其词「就绪数据」推断质量**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/ferryhe/AI_actuarial_inforsearch` 于 2026-09-11 经仓库检索接口与 GitHub API 实测读取（★数、许可字段 NONE、语言、体量、创建／推送时间）；README **16,576 字节**经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对（**含其 17 个二级小节标题、安全态势一节与 11 份文档索引**）；根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 的存在经 raw 探测确认（均为 HTTP 404）；**⭐ 另经 `/search/issues` 实测读到其 2026-09-09 的两条 PR；**未克隆、未安装任何依赖、未运行任何命令或测试、未启动任何服务、未读任何源码或文档内容、未做其他网络观察**。

The legacy server-rendered/Replit-era workflow is retired.**」與「**Roadmap completion:** Agentic RAG PRs **#133-#145**、consolidation PRs **#147-#154**、managed Feishu-plan PR-A through PR-I（**#156-#164**）are merged; **there are no open managed-roadmap PRs.**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐「退役」被寫成狀態的一行**（拆掉的東西也進狀態欄）；**② ⭐⭐權威被收斂到一處**（逐字「唯一的 `/api/*` 權威」——同一功能不允許有兩個入口）；**③ ⭐⭐路線圖完成度用**合併的 PR 區間**證明**（讀者可以去核對那些 PR）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **安全態勢一節逐條給出，且多是**可檢查的機制****——逐字含「Chat/RAG selected-document context is **bounded and marked untrusted** before it reaches the model」、「Public URL fetching checks **unsafe schemes, private/reserved IPs, redirect target changes, and DNS/IP drift**」、「Browser auth pages show friendly rate-limit and system-error messages **without exposing internals**」，以及「診斷密鑰與憑據狀態而不打印密鑰值」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐上下文被界定範圍並標記為不可信**；**② ⭐⭐對公網取數檢查**重定向目標變化與 DNS／IP 漂移**（防的不只是首跳）；**③ ⭐⭐報錯不暴露內部**與**診斷不打印密鑰**是兩條面向運維的約束。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 其餘**：文檔轉換由一份 YAML 配置驅動，且逐字說明**付費／API 工具預設不會被自動選中**（「paid/API tools are not auto-selected by default」——**預設不花錢**是一個預設值決策）；去重用 **SHA-256** 並增量編目摘要、關鍵詞與分類；週更摘要用一個**首次見到時間**字段（`files.first_seen`），預設任務用**上一整週**（`relative_period: previous_week`）；標準向量 RAG 與 Agentic RAG **並存**；有**中英兩份 README**；其文檔索引把**死代碼與質量門**單列一份（清理也被當成一項有記錄的工程）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 可與 [[firecrawl]]、[[llamaindex]]、[[chroma]]、[[ragas]]、[[langfuse]]、[[mineru]]、[[label-studio]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信號一致指向沒有許可聲明****：GitHub 許可字段為 **NONE**、**根目錄 `LICENSE` 與 `LICENSE.md` 均不存在（raw 探測均為 HTTP 404）**、**且 README 全文以「licen／copyright／©」檢索**零命中**——這是一份**會把公開網頁文檔與用戶上傳文件讀進去**的平台，而**「可以讀到」與「可以再分發」是兩件事**。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次沒有安裝或運行它的任何一步****——**未安裝 Python／Node 依賴、未啟動服務、未跑 pytest、未配置任何模型密鑰、未採集任何站點、未打開其界面**；**故不主张**其採集、轉換、編目、分塊、嵌入、索引或檢索按所述工作**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未讀其任何源碼或那 11 份文檔****（未核對階段契約是否確實統一、「不再有未合併的受管路線圖 PR」是否屬實、安全態勢那幾條是否在代碼裡落實）——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**。**④ ⚠️ **★3**（本輪四條中關注度最高）、**fork 0**，且**未核實作者背景**。**⑤ ⚠️ **創建在解凍窗口之前（2026-01-27）****，入選依據是**推送落在窗口之內（2026-09-10）**。**⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其檢索結果在任何精算用途上可依賴**（其自述未給出任何質量指標）。**⑦ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****。**核實說明**：repo 於 2026-09-11 經倉庫檢索接口與 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 16,576 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對（含其 17 個二級小節標題、安全態勢一節與 11 份文檔索引）；根目錄 `LICENSE` 與 `LICENSE.md` 的存在經 raw 探測確認（均為 HTTP 404）；**另經 `/search/issues` 實測讀到其 2026-09-09 的兩條 PR**；**未克隆、未安裝任何依賴、未運行任何命令或測試、未啟動任何服務、未讀任何源碼或文檔內容、未做其他網絡觀察**。
entries.body_en:
**ai-actuarial-info-search** (repository `ferryhe/AI_actuarial_inforsearch`) **is a document-intelligence platform for actuarial and insurance research**, describing itself verbatim as a document-intelligence platform built on a Python web framework and a React front end that discovers, downloads, catalogs, converts, searches and chats with public web documents and browser-uploaded local files. **Measured 3 stars, 0 forks, a licence field of NONE** — ⚠️ three signals agreeing, as set out below — **primary language Python, a 7,520 KB repository, created 2026-01-27, last pushed 2026-09-10** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **the push falls inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 16,576 bytes**, with a simplified-Chinese counterpart also present, **and its body carries seventeen second-level sections and an index pointing at eleven documents**, including documents named verbatim for architecture, dead code and quality gates, API migration status, the agentic retrieval guide, production security configuration and archived historical notes. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **source and generated artefact**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it states most clearly which parts may be replaced**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It anchors every stage on the same contract, so the interface, the built-in pipeline and external automation are equivalent** — verbatim, all core workflow capabilities are exposed as independently callable command-line or interface operations, each processing stage is backed by a shared domain service and a stable JSON task or resource contract, **so that the interface, the built-in pipeline and external automation use the same inputs and outputs** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the same inputs and outputs is the line here that best fits the round’s theme, since the interface is not the only entry point and the pipeline is not a black box**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the contract comes in two kinds, a task and a resource**, ⭐ **so doing something and looking at something are two separate contracts**; ⭐⭐⭐ **three consumers are named one by one, the interface, the built-in pipeline and external automation, so being externally orchestratable is stated rather than implied**; **and ⭐⭐ the smallest way to add a collector is given**, verbatim that a new collector can implement a common base contract **or that an external producer can emit the same stored-file and metadata contract without changing conversion or any later stage**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It deliberately fixes the composition and says what it is not** — verbatim, this built-in baton is **intentionally a fixed and observable composition rather than a general graph editor** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **a fixed and observable composition is a decision to refuse general orchestration**, ⭐ **and this entry considers the sentence worth copying, since it writes not building a general graph editor as a design conclusion rather than a backlog item**; ⭐⭐⭐ **replaceable and fixed do not contradict each other, since the segments may change while the order of connection stays fixed**, ⭐ **the location of flexibility being confined inside the segments**; **and ⭐⭐ the full order of the fixed baton is then given**, from scheduled collection through conversion, cataloguing, chunking and embedding, knowledge-base binding, index and ready-data building to the chat knowledge base. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It states verbatim why upgrades stay local** — verbatim, this separation keeps future upgrades local, **a collector, conversion engine, classifier, chunker, embedding provider, knowledge-base index or ready-data builder, or chat retrieval strategy being replaceable or upgradeable independently as long as the stage contract is preserved** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **seven replaceable positions are named one by one, so replaceability has a concrete list**; ⭐⭐⭐ **there is exactly one condition, preserving the stage contract, so the constraint is written as an admission requirement rather than a specification**; **and ⭐⭐ the reason, keeping future upgrades local, is given.** **④ ⭐⭐ Its status section reports retirement and roadmap completion as facts of the same kind** — verbatim, one service is the only authority for the interface surface and one framework the only maintained product interface, **and the legacy server-rendered workflow is retired**, together with verbatim statements that several pull-request ranges are merged and **that there are no open managed-roadmap pull requests** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **retirement is one line of status, so what was taken away enters the status bar too**; ⭐⭐ **authority is narrowed to one place**, ⭐ **so the same capability may not have two entry points**; **and ⭐⭐ roadmap completion is evidenced by merged pull-request ranges, which a reader can go and check.** **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its security section lists mechanisms, most of them checkable** — verbatim, chat context from selected documents is **bounded and marked untrusted before it reaches the model**, public URL fetching checks **unsafe schemes, private and reserved addresses, redirect target changes and DNS or IP drift**, browser authentication pages show friendly rate-limit and system-error messages **without exposing internals**, **and credential state can be diagnosed without printing secret values** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **context is both bounded and marked untrusted, so the risk of feeding external documents to a model is handled explicitly**; ⭐⭐ **the fetch checks cover redirect target changes and address drift, so it defends against more than the first hop**; **and ⭐⭐ not exposing internals in errors and not printing secrets in diagnostics are two operational constraints.** **⑥ ⭐⭐ Other details**: **conversion is driven by a YAML configuration**, and paid or API-backed tools are stated verbatim **not to be auto-selected by default**, ⭐ **so not spending money by default is a default-value decision**; **deduplication uses a cryptographic hash with incremental cataloguing of summaries, keywords and categories**; **weekly summaries rest on a first-seen field with the default task covering the previous whole week**; **standard vector retrieval and agentic retrieval coexist**; **the readme exists in two languages**; **and its documentation index gives dead code and quality gates a document of their own**, ⭐ **so cleanup counts as recorded engineering**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[firecrawl]], [[llamaindex]], [[chroma]], [[ragas]], [[langfuse]], [[mineru]] and [[label-studio]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Three signals agree that there is no licence statement**: **the GitHub licence field is NONE**, **neither a licence file nor a licence markdown file exists at the root, both raw probes returning 404**, **and the readme returns no hit for licence, copyright or the copyright sign** — ⭐ **the entry notes that this is a platform which reads public web documents and user-uploaded files, and that being readable and being redistributable are two different things**. **② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was installed or run** — **no Python or Node dependency installed, no service started, no test run, no model key configured, no site collected and no interface opened**; **so this entry does not claim its collection, conversion, cataloguing, chunking, embedding, indexing or retrieval works as described**, ⭐ **what it verified being the verbatim readme, including its seventeen sections and eleven-document index**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ Neither its source nor those eleven documents were read**, ⭐ **so whether the stage contracts are really uniform, whether the claim of no open managed-roadmap pull requests is true, and whether the security mechanisms are implemented in code were not checked** — ⭐ **the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **④ ⚠️ At 3 stars, the highest-attention entry of this round, with no forks, the author’s background was not verified**. **⑤ ⚠️ It was created before the thaw window, on 2026-01-27**, **selection resting on the push falling inside the window on 2026-09-10**. **⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its retrieval results are dependable for any actuarial purpose**, ⭐ **the repository giving no quality figures, and this entry drawing no inference from its phrase ready data**. **⑦ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: the repository was read on 2026-09-11 through the repository search endpoint and the GitHub API for stars, licence field, language, size and dates; the 16,576-byte readme was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, **including its seventeen section headings, its security section and its eleven-document index**; licence file probes against the root returned 404; **two pull requests dated 2026-09-09 were additionally read through the issue search endpoint**; **nothing was cloned, no dependency was installed, no command or test was run, no service was started, no source or documentation content was read, and no other network observation was made**.

entries.title: **把官方公布的 PDF 与电子表格变成可计算的结构，并把这条箭头写出来**：一个处理美国国税局精算因子表的工具集**逐字给出整条链**——**「**90CM：PDF → 提取脚本 → CSV → Python → JSON；**2010CM 与根表：官方 XLSX／XLS → Python → JSON；**再由 C# 应用 → Excel／文本／SQL Server，**或**因子场景／网页界面 → 答案」**；**其 PDF 提取逐字说明「**用脚本化的 `pdfplumber` 提取器**，并**逐值对照 2016 年的 Tabula 参考 CSV 核验**」**
entries.title_en: Turning officially published PDFs and spreadsheets into something computable, and writing that arrow out: a toolset for United States internal revenue actuarial factor tables states the whole chain verbatim, PDF through an extraction script to CSV to JSON, official spreadsheets straight to JSON, and then an application out to spreadsheets, text, a database, or factor scenarios and a web interface for answers, with the PDF extraction stated verbatim to be done by a scripted extractor and verified value by value against a reference set of tables from another tool
entries.title_hk: **把官方公布的 PDF 與電子表格變成可計算的結構，並把這條箭頭寫出來**：一個處理美國國稅局精算因子表的工具集**逐字給出整條鏈**——**「**90CM：PDF → 提取腳本 → CSV → Python → JSON；**2010CM 與根表：官方 XLSX／XLS → Python → JSON；**再由 C# 應用 → Excel／文本／SQL Server，**或**因子場景／網頁界面 → 答案」**；**其 PDF 提取逐字說明「**用腳本化的 `pdfplumber` 提取器**，並**逐值對照 2016 年的 Tabula 參考 CSV 核驗**」**
entries.summary: 一个**处理美国国税局精算因子表（出版物 1457／1458／1459）的工具集**（★1、**C#**、仓库体量 **82 MB**、**最后推送落在窗口之内**）：**逐字自述所处理的来源为**「**美国国税局公布的**精算因子数据」**，**而**整条链被写成一行箭头**——**逐字「**90CM：PDF → `Extract90CMFromPdf.py` → CSV → Python → JSON；**2010CM 与根表：官方 XLSX／XLS → Python → JSON；**再由 C# 应用 → Excel／文本／SQL Server，**或**因子场景／网页界面 → 答案」**；**其最值得记的一处是**来源与来源核对****——**逐字说明 90CM 系列是**「**用脚本化的 `pdfplumber` 提取器从 PDF 中提取的，**并**逐值对照 2016 年的 Tabula 参考 CSV 核验**」**，**而**2010CM 与根表**「**直接由官方 XLSX／XLS 电子表格转换**」**；**第二处是它**说明提取出来的 CSV **可以从 PDF 重新生成****；**第三处是它**把「答案」建在**已提交的数据**上**（**逐字说明因子命令与网页界面**从已提交的数据计算场景**：**终身财产、**剩余权益、**年金与 **CRUT／CRAT** 因子，**并逐字注明是「**精确的公布网格查表」**）
entries.summary_hk: 一個**處理美國國稅局精算因子表（出版物 1457／1458／1459）的工具集**（★1、**C#**、體量 **82 MB**、**最後推送落在窗口之內**）：**逐字自述所處理的來源為**「**美國國稅局公布的精算因子數據」**，而**整條鏈被寫成一行箭頭**——**逐字「**90CM：PDF → `Extract90CMFromPdf.py` → CSV → Python → JSON；**2010CM 與根表：官方 XLSX／XLS → Python → JSON；**再由 C# 應用 → Excel／文本／SQL Server，**或**因子場景／網頁界面 → 答案」**；**其最值得記的一處是**來源與來源核對****——**逐字說明 90CM 系列是**「**用腳本化的 `pdfplumber` 提取器從 PDF 中提取的，並逐值對照 2016 年的 Tabula 參考 CSV 核驗**」**，而 2010CM 與根表「**直接由官方 XLSX／XLS 電子表格轉換**」；**第二處是它**說明提取出來的 CSV 可以從 PDF 重新生成****；**第三處是它**把「答案」建在**已提交的數據**上**（**逐字說明因子命令與網頁界面**從已提交的數據計算場景**：**終身財產、**剩餘權益、**年金與 **CRUT／CRAT** 因子，並逐字註明是「**精確的公布網格查表」**）
entries.summary_en: A toolset for the actuarial factor tables published by the United States internal revenue service, under a named set of publications — 1 star, C#, an 82 MB repository, last pushed inside the window — describing the data it processes verbatim as actuarial factor data published by that authority and writing the whole chain as one arrow: from PDF through an extraction script to CSV to JSON for one series, from official spreadsheets straight to JSON for another, and then out through an application to spreadsheets, text or a database, or through factor scenarios and a web interface to answers. **Its most notable feature is the source and the checking of that source**: the PDF series is stated verbatim to be extracted by a scripted extractor **and verified value by value against a reference set of comma-separated tables from another tool**, while the other series is stated verbatim to be converted directly from official spreadsheets. **The second is that the extracted tables are stated to be regenerable from the PDFs.** **The third is that its answers are built on the committed data**, the factor command and the web interface computing scenarios from it for life estates, remainders, annuities and charitable remainder trust factors, described verbatim as exact published-grid lookups.
entries.body:
**irs-actuarial-tables-processor**（仓库 `Digiman/ActuarialFactors1990Processor`）**是一个处理美国国税局精算因子表的工具集**：**逐字自述为**「**Utilities that process actuarial factor data published by the IRS（Publications 1457/1458/1459）**」**。**实测 **★1**、fork 0、许可字段为 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信号一致，见下**）、主语言 **C#**、仓库体量 **82,025 KB**、**创建 2022-04-13**、最后推送 **2026-09-09****（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**⭐ 创建远早于解冻窗口**，**推送落在窗口之内****）；**实测其**文档文件名为 `Readme.md`**（**⭐ 首字母大写、其余小写**——**⚠️ 本词条**据此指出：**按 `README.md` 惯例探测会漏掉它**），**仓库实测共 **239 个文件**，**其中含 `Docs/ActuarialTables-Research.md`、`Docs/Plan.md`、`JSONFiles/README.md`、`.github/workflows/ci.yml`，**以及 `DataFiles/2000CM/` 下多份官方表格（**`table-2000cm.xls`、`table-c-2000cm.xls`、`table-h-2000cm.xls`、`table-r2-2009.xlsx`、`table-s-2000cm.xlsx`、`table-u1-2000cm.xls`、`table-u2-2009cm.xlsx`、`table-z-2000cm.xls`**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「源与生成物」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**把「源 → 产物」这条链写得最直白的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 `Readme.md` 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把整条链写成**一行箭头**，并区分了**两种来源****——**逐字为**：**「**90CM: **PDF -> Extract90CMFromPdf.py -> CSV -> Python -> JSON**; **2010CM and root tables: official XLSX/XLS -> Python -> JSON**; then **C# app -> Excel / text / SQL Server**, or **factor scenarios / web UI -> answers**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **一行读完整个系统**（**⭐ 即**读者**不需要读代码**就知道**数据从哪来、经过谁、变成什么****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **两种来源被分开**（**一个系列的源是 **PDF**，**另一个系列的源是**官方电子表格**）**——**⭐ 即**同一条链上**不是所有源都一样**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **下游有三种去向**（**Excel／文本／SQL Server**）**，**外加**两条「算答案」的去向**（**因子场景／网页界面**）**——**⭐ 即**「生成物」在这里**不止一种**；**④ ⭐⭐ **它把「答案」写成链的终点**（**逐字 `-> answers`**）**——**⭐ 即**它承认**整条链是为了**回答问题**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它说明了**源是怎么被核对过的****——**逐字为**：**「**the 90CM-series source tables are **extracted from the PDF files with a scripted `pdfplumber` extractor**, **verified value-by-value against the 2016 Tabula reference CSVs**; the 2010CM series and the root（non-mortality）tables are **converted directly from the official IRS XLSX/XLS spreadsheets**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「逐值对照另一套工具产出的参考表」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮主题**最实在的一处**：**从 PDF 里抠数**这件事的**可信度**被**另一个来源**兜住了**（**⭐ 与第 348 轮 [[ducklm-sql-glm]] 的「与 statsmodels／scikit-learn 对到机器精度」同族**，**但这里的参照物**是另一套**PDF 取数工具**的输出**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **提取器被具名**（**逐字 `pdfplumber`**）**——**⭐ 即**「用什么抠的」**可被复核****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「直接转换」与「提取」被区分**（**2010CM 与根表**不经过 PDF）**——**⭐ 即**它**只在对的源上用对的方法****；**④ ⭐⭐ **根表被注明是**非死亡率表**（**逐字 `(non-mortality)`**）**——**⭐ 即**表的两类**被区分**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它说明提取物**可以从源重新生成****——**逐字为**：**「**`DataFiles/90CM/` — **extracted CSV files (90CM series, regenerable from the PDFs)**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **「可从 PDF 重新生成」**是**一条可检验的性质****（**⭐ 即**CSV**不是唯一副本**）；**② ⭐⭐ **数据被**分目录存放**（**`DataFiles/` 是源，**`JSONFiles/` 是处理后，**`XMLFiles/` 是生成物**）**——**⭐ 即**目录名**本身就表达了**链条上的位置****；**③ ⭐⭐ **XML 被逐字注明**不入版本库、需运行脚本生成**（**⭐ 即**哪一步的产物入库、**哪一步的产物**按需生成**被写清**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **它把「答案」建立在一份**精确查表**上，且用途逐条列出**——**逐字为**：**「**the `factor` command and the web UI **compute valuation scenarios from the committed data**: **life estates, remainders, annuities and CRUT/CRAT factors**（**IRS Publications 1457/1458/1459 semantics, exact published-grid lookups**）」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **四种计算对象逐条点名**（**终身财产／**剩余权益／**年金／**两类慈善剩余信托因子**）；**② ⭐⭐ **「精确的公布网格查表」是**一个可核对的实现选择****（**⭐ 即**它没有用插值**，**而是**查官方网格**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「语义」被归给出版物**（**⭐ 即**计算规则的出处**是**官方出版物**）**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **工程分层逐行列出**（**`DataProcessingApp.Core` 行类型与配置、**`.Logic` 通用装载／保存、**`.Data` SQL Server 批量插入、**`.Calculator` 场景计算、**`.ConsoleApp` 命令、**`.WebApi` 网页界面与 JSON 接口，**另有 `PythonDataApp`**）**；**② **测试分两套**（**C# 用 xUnit、**Python 用 pytest**）**，**而**SQL Server 集成测试**逐字注明「**CI 总是运行它们**」**、**本地则需要 Docker**（**⭐ 即**依赖被分级**）；**③ **依赖版本逐条给出**（**.NET SDK 10.0、**Python 3 与 `numpy`／`openpyxl`／`xlrd`／`pdfplumber`**）**；**④ **构建与测试命令逐条给出**（**`dotnet build`、**`dotnet test`、**`python -m pytest`**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[mortsoa]]、[[mortalitytables]]、[[human-mortality-db]]、[[soa-practice-tools]]、[[ifoa-formulae-tables]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信号一致指向**没有许可声明****：**GitHub 许可字段为 **NONE****、**实测默认分支 `main` 的根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 均不存在**（**raw 探测均为 HTTP 404**）、**且实测其 `Readme.md` 全文以「licen／copyright／©」检索**零命中****——**⭐ 本词条指出这一处尤其要紧：**该仓库**把 IRS 公布的表格一并放进版本库**（**`DataFiles/` 下多份官方 XLS／XLSX**）**——**⭐ 即**代码的权利与**其中官方文件的再分发条件**是两件事**（**⚠️ 本词条**未查任何官方条款**）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次**没有运行它的任何一步****——**未安装 .NET SDK 或 Python 依赖、未跑 `dotnet build`／`dotnet test`／`pytest`、未运行任何提取脚本、未重生成任何 CSV／JSON／XML、未运行其因子命令或网页界面、未打开其任何官方表格文件**；**故**本词条**不主张**其提取、核验、转换或因子计算**按其所述工作**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**其 `Readme.md` 的**逐字内容**、**其经 tree 接口实测的文件清单与目录结构**、**以及**官方表格文件的**存在与名称**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读其任何源码或 `Docs/` 下的两份笔记****（**⭐ 即**未核对**「逐值对照」是如何实现的、**查表是否确实精确、**以及**CI 是否确实总是运行 SQL Server 集成测试**）**——**⭐ 这是本条目**最需要后续核实的一处**。**④ ⭐ ⚠️ **一处**命名**如实记录**：**其说明文件名为 `Readme.md`**（**⭐ 本词条**据此指出**按惯例探测会漏掉它**，**⚠️ 并**不据此评价其内容**）。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其提取结果与官方 PDF 是否一致**（**⭐ 即**那条「逐值核验」**只有其自述，**本词条未复核**）。**⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其因子可用于任何实际申报或估值**（**⭐ 计算规则的出处是官方出版物，**而**本词条**未核对任何一条规则**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **创建于 2022-04-13**，**最后推送 2026-09-09****——**⭐ 入选依据是**推送落在窗口之内**。**⑧ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Digiman/ActuarialFactors1990Processor` 于 2026-09-11 经仓库检索接口与 GitHub API 实测读取（★数、许可字段 NONE、语言、体量、创建／推送时间）；**其说明文件 `Readme.md` 经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对**（**⚠️ 文件名首字母大写**）；根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 的存在经 raw 探测确认（均为 HTTP 404）；**文件清单经 GitHub API tree 接口实测（239 个文件），据其核对 `src/`、`tests/`、`db/`、`DataFiles/`、`JSONFiles/`、`XMLFiles/`、`Docs/` 与 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的存在及 `DataFiles/2000CM/` 下官方表格的文件名**；**未克隆、未安装任何依赖、未运行任何脚本或测试、未重生成任何文件、未打开任何表格或 PDF、未做其他网络观察**。

then C# app -> Excel / text / SQL Server, or factor scenarios / web UI -> answers**」**⭐⭐⭐ 四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐一行讀完整個系統**（讀者不需讀代碼就知道數據從哪來、經過誰、變成什麼）；**② ⭐⭐⭐兩種來源被分開**（一個系列的源是 PDF，另一個是官方電子表格）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐下游有三種去向外加兩條算答案的去向**（「生成物」不止一種）；**④ ⭐⭐把「答案」寫成鏈的終點**（`-> answers`——整條鏈是為了回答問題）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **說明了**源是怎麼被核對過的****——逐字「**the 90CM-series source tables are extracted from the PDF files with a scripted `pdfplumber` extractor, verified value-by-value against the 2016 Tabula reference CSVs; the 2010CM series and the root（non-mortality）tables are converted directly from the official IRS XLSX/XLS spreadsheets**」**四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「逐值對照另一套工具產出的參考表」**（從 PDF 裡摳數這件事的**可信度被另一個來源兜住**；與第 348 輪 ducklm-sql-glm 的「與 statsmodels／scikit-learn 對到機器精度」同族，但這裡的參照物是**另一套 PDF 取數工具**的輸出）；**② ⭐⭐⭐提取器被具名**（`pdfplumber`——「用什麼抠的」可被覆核）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐「直接轉換」與「提取」被區分**（2010CM 與根表不經過 PDF——只在对的源上用對的方法）；**④ ⭐⭐根表被註明是**非死亡率表**（`(non-mortality)`）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **說明提取物**可以從源重新生成****——逐字「**`DataFiles/90CM/` — extracted CSV files (90CM series, regenerable from the PDFs)**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐「可從 PDF 重新生成」是一條可檢驗的性質**（CSV 不是唯一副本）；**② ⭐⭐數據被分目錄存放**（`DataFiles/` 是源、`JSONFiles/` 是處理後、`XMLFiles/` 是生成物——目錄名表達了鏈條上的位置）；**③ ⭐⭐XML 被逐字註明不入版本庫、需運行腳本生成**。**④ ⭐⭐ **把「答案」建立在**精確查表**上，且用途逐條列出**——逐字「**the `factor` command and the web UI compute valuation scenarios from the committed data: life estates, remainders, annuities and CRUT/CRAT factors（IRS Publications 1457/1458/1459 semantics, exact published-grid lookups）**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐四種計算對象逐條點名**；**② ⭐⭐「精確的公布網格查表」是一個可核對的實現選擇**（沒有用插值，而是查官方網格）；**③ ⭐⭐「語義」被歸給出版物**（計算規則的出處是官方出版物）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ 其餘**：工程分層逐行列出（Core 行類型與配置／Logic 通用裝載與保存／Data SQL Server 批量插入／Calculator 場景計算／ConsoleApp 命令／WebApi 網頁界面與 JSON 接口，另有 PythonDataApp）；測試分兩套（C# 用 xUnit、Python 用 pytest），SQL Server 集成測試逐字註明「**CI 總是運行它們**」、本地則需要 Docker（依賴被分級）；依賴版本逐條給出（.NET SDK 10.0、Python 3 與 numpy／openpyxl／xlrd／pdfplumber）；構建與測試命令逐條給出（dotnet build／dotnet test／python -m pytest）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 可與 [[mortsoa]]、[[mortalitytables]]、[[human-mortality-db]]、[[soa-practice-tools]]、[[ifoa-formulae-tables]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信號一致指向沒有許可聲明****：GitHub 許可字段為 **NONE**、**默認分支 `main` 的根目錄 `LICENSE` 與 `LICENSE.md` 均不存在（raw 探測均為 HTTP 404）**、**且實測其 `Readme.md` 全文以「licen／copyright／©」檢索**零命中**——**這一處尤其要緊：該倉庫把 IRS 公布的表格一併放進版本庫（DataFiles/ 下多份官方 XLS／XLSX）——代碼的權利與其中官方文件的再分發條件是兩件事**（⚠️ 未查任何官方條款）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次沒有運行它的任何一步****——**未安裝 .NET SDK 或 Python 依賴、未跑 dotnet build／dotnet test／pytest、未運行任何提取腳本、未重生成任何 CSV／JSON／XML、未運行其因子命令或網頁界面、未打開其任何官方表格文件**；**故不主张**其提取、核驗、轉換或因子計算按所述工作**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未讀其任何源碼或 `Docs/` 下的兩份筆記****（未核對「逐值對照」如何實現、查表是否確實精確、CI 是否確實總是運行 SQL Server 集成測試）——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**。**④ ⭐ ⚠️ **一處**命名**如實記錄**：其說明文件名為 `Readme.md`（按慣例探測會漏掉它；⚠️ 不據此評價其內容）。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其提取結果與官方 PDF 是否一致**（那條「逐值核驗」只有其自述，本詞條未覆核）。**⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其因子可用於任何實際申報或估值**。**⑦ ⚠️ **創建於 2022-04-13**，**最後推送 2026-09-09**（入選依據是推送落在窗口之內）。**⑧ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****。**核實說明**：repo 於 2026-09-11 經倉庫檢索接口與 GitHub API 實測讀取；**其說明文件 `Readme.md` 經 raw 實測逐字核對（⚠️ 文件名首字母大寫）**；根目錄 `LICENSE` 與 `LICENSE.md` 的存在經 raw 探測確認（均為 HTTP 404）；**文件清單經 GitHub API tree 接口實測（239 個文件），據其核對 `src/`、`tests/`、`db/`、`DataFiles/`、`JSONFiles/`、`XMLFiles/`、`Docs/` 與 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的存在及 `DataFiles/2000CM/` 下官方表格的文件名**；**未克隆、未安裝任何依賴、未運行任何腳本或測試、未重生成任何文件、未打開任何表格或 PDF、未做其他網絡觀察**。
entries.body_en:
**irs-actuarial-tables-processor** (repository `Digiman/ActuarialFactors1990Processor`) **is a toolset that processes the actuarial factor tables published by the United States internal revenue service**, describing itself verbatim as utilities that process actuarial factor data published by that authority under a named set of publications. **Measured 1 star, 0 forks, a licence field of NONE** — ⚠️ three signals agreeing, as set out below — **primary language C#, an 82,025 KB repository, created 2022-04-13 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **creation far predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it**); **its documentation file measurably has a mixed-case name rather than the usual all-capitals one**, ⚠️ **which this entry notes means probing for the conventional name misses it**; **the repository measures 239 files**, including two documents under a documentation directory, a readme inside the processed-data directory, a continuous-integration workflow, **and several official spreadsheets under a source-data directory named for one of the table series, including tables for the several factor types and two later reference years**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **source and generated artefact**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it writes the chain from source to product most plainly**.

Verifiable details (**read from its documentation file and measured in the tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It writes the whole chain as one arrow and separates two kinds of source** — verbatim, one series goes from PDF through a named extraction script to CSV to JSON, **another series and the root tables go from official spreadsheets straight to JSON**, and then an application goes out to spreadsheets, text or a database, **or factor scenarios and a web interface go to answers** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the whole system reads in one line, so a reader knows where the data come from, what they pass through and what they become without reading code**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the two kinds of source are kept apart, one series starting from a PDF and another from official spreadsheets**, ⭐ **so not every source on one chain is the same kind of source**; ⭐⭐⭐ **there are three downstream destinations plus two routes that compute answers**, ⭐ **so the artefact here is not a single thing**; **and ⭐⭐ answers are written as the end of the chain**, ⭐ **the whole chain existing in order to answer questions**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It states how the source was checked** — verbatim, the first series is extracted from the PDFs with a scripted extractor **and verified value by value against a reference set of tables from another tool**, **while the second series and the root tables are converted directly from the official spreadsheets** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **verifying value by value against another tool’s output is the most substantial item in this round’s theme, since the credibility of pulling numbers out of a PDF is backed by a second source**, ⭐ **the same family as the library aligned against two reference implementations to machine precision, though the reference here is another PDF extraction tool’s output**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the extractor is named, so what did the pulling can be re-examined**; ⭐⭐⭐ **direct conversion and extraction are distinguished**, ⭐ **the right method being used on the right kind of source**; **and ⭐⭐ the root tables are marked as non-mortality**, ⭐ **so the two classes of table are distinguished**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It states that the extracted material can be regenerated from the source** — verbatim, the extracted comma-separated files are regenerable from the PDFs ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **regenerable from the PDFs is a checkable property, so the extracted files are not the only copy**; ⭐⭐ **data are split across directories by position in the chain**, the source files in one, processed files in another and generated files in a third, ⭐ **so the directory names themselves express where a file sits on the chain**; **and ⭐⭐ one generated format is stated verbatim not to be committed and to require a script.** **④ ⭐⭐ It builds its answers on exact table lookups and lists the uses one by one** — verbatim, the factor command and the web interface compute valuation scenarios from the committed data, **covering life estates, remainders, annuities and charitable remainder trust factors, under the semantics of the named publications and using exact published-grid lookups** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **four kinds of calculation are named one by one**; ⭐⭐ **exact published-grid lookups is a checkable implementation choice**, ⭐ **since it interpolates nothing and reads the official grid instead**; **and ⭐⭐ the semantics are attributed to the publications**, ⭐ **so the rules of calculation have a citable origin**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Other details**: **the engineering layering is listed line by line**, row types and configuration, generic loading and saving, database bulk insertion, scenario calculation, a console application and a web interface with a JSON API, **with a separate Python application beside them**; **tests come in two suites**, one on each language, **with the database integration tests stated verbatim to run always in continuous integration and to need a container runtime locally**, ⭐ **so dependencies are graded**; **dependency versions are given one by one**; **and build and test commands are listed**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[mortsoa]], [[mortalitytables]], [[human-mortality-db]], [[soa-practice-tools]] and [[ifoa-formulae-tables]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Three signals agree that there is no licence statement**: **the GitHub licence field is NONE**, **neither a licence file nor a licence markdown file exists at the root of the default branch, both raw probes returning 404**, **and its documentation file returns no hit for licence, copyright or the copyright sign** — ⭐ **and this matters especially here, because the repository commits the official tables alongside the code, so rights in the code and the terms for redistributing those official files are two different things**, ⚠️ **with no official terms examined**. **② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was run** — **no software development kit or Python dependency installed, no build, test or extraction script run, no extracted, processed or generated file regenerated, its factor command and web interface not run, and none of its official spreadsheets opened**; **so this entry does not claim its extraction, verification, conversion or factor calculation works as described**, ⭐ **what it verified being the verbatim documentation file, the file listing and directory structure measured through the trees endpoint, and the existence and names of the official spreadsheet files**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ Neither its source nor the two notes under its documentation directory were read**, ⭐ **so how the value-by-value verification is implemented, whether the lookups really are exact, and whether the database tests really always run were not checked** — ⭐ **the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **④ ⭐ ⚠️ One naming note is recorded plainly**: **its documentation file uses a mixed-case name**, ⭐ **so probing for the conventional name misses it**, ⚠️ **with no judgement offered on its contents**. **⑤ ⚠️ Whether its extracted results match the official PDFs was not verified**, ⭐ **the value-by-value claim resting on the repository’s own word and not re-checked here**. **⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that its factors are usable for any actual filing or valuation**, ⭐ **the origin of the calculation rules being official publications, none of whose rules were checked here**. **⑦ ⚠️ It was created on 2022-04-13 and last pushed on 2026-09-09**, ⭐ **selection resting on the push falling inside the window**. **⑧ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: the repository was read on 2026-09-11 through the repository search endpoint and the GitHub API for stars, licence field, language, size and dates; **its documentation file was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, noting that the file name is not in the conventional all-capitals form**; licence file probes against the root returned 404; **the file listing was read through the trees endpoint, 239 files, against which the presence of the source, test, database, source-data, processed-data, generated-data, documentation and workflow paths and the file names of the official spreadsheets were checked**; **nothing was cloned, no dependency was installed, no script or test was run, no file was regenerated, no spreadsheet or PDF was opened, and no other network observation was made**.

entries.title: **由一份 R Markdown 技术报告当首要文档，论文只做缩短的学术摘要**：一个为中东欧养老金计划评估长寿风险的项目**逐字写明它有两件相关产出**——**一篇投给某欧洲精算期刊的科学论文，**与**一份「**面向实务的技术报告，**由 R Markdown 生成」**，**并逐字指出**「**技术报告是**首要的项目文档**。**它包含**完整的国别推导、**诊断评论、**实务建议与附录」**，**而论文「**提供的是方法、**部分结果与跨国比较的**较短的学术摘要」**；**其生成物为**十一个中东欧国家**的动态人口死亡率表**（**另加**三个 DACH 基准国**）
entries.title_en: A technical report generated from R Markdown as the primary document, with a journal article serving only as the shorter academic summary: a project assessing longevity risk for pension plans in central and eastern Europe states verbatim that it has two related outputs, a scientific article prepared for submission to a European actuarial journal and a practitioner-oriented technical report generated from R Markdown, and states verbatim that the technical report is the primary project documentation containing the full country-level derivations, diagnostic comments, practical recommendations and appendices, while the article provides a shorter academic summary of the methodology, selected results and cross-country comparisons — the artefact being dynamic population mortality tables for eleven central and eastern European countries plus three benchmark countries
entries.title_hk: **由一份 R Markdown 技術報告當首要文檔，論文只做縮短的學術摘要**：一個為中東歐養老金計劃評估長壽風險的項目**逐字寫明它有兩件相關產出**——**一篇投給某歐洲精算期刊的科學論文，**與**一份「**面向實務的技術報告，**由 R Markdown 生成」**，**並逐字指出**「**技術報告是**首要的項目文檔**。**它包含**完整的國別推導、**診斷評論、**實務建議與附錄」**，**而論文「**提供的是方法、**部分結果與跨國比較的**較短的學術摘要」**；**其生成物為**十一個中東歐國家**的動態人口死亡率表**（**另加**三個 DACH 基準國**）**
entries.summary: 一个**为中东欧养老金计划评估长寿风险的项目**（★0、HTML、仓库体量 **426 MB**、**最后推送落在窗口之内**）：**逐字自述其目标是「**支持多个东欧国家的养老金提供方做风险管理评估，**同时也**为精算师提供把相关议题**向管理层与政策制定者讲清的工具与度量」**；**其最值得记的一处是它把**两份产出的主次写清****——**逐字「**技术报告是**首要的项目文档**」**，**而**论文「**是**较短的学术摘要**」**；**第二处是它的**生成物被逐条给出****（**动态人口死亡率表、**分年龄的死亡率改善率、**投射预期寿命、**年金现值、**以及**这些表在精算使用上的实务适用性**）；**第三处是它的**国家集**逐条列出**（**十一个中东欧国家：保加利亚、克罗地亚、捷克、爱沙尼亚、匈牙利、拉脱维亚、立陶宛、波兰、罗马尼亚、斯洛伐克、斯洛文尼亚**；**另加三个 DACH 基准国：奥地利、德国、瑞士**）
entries.summary_hk: 一個**為中東歐養老金計劃評估長壽風險的項目**（★0、HTML、體量 **426 MB**、**最後推送落在窗口之內**）：**逐字自述其目標是「**支持多個東歐國家的養老金提供方做風險管理評估，**同時也**為精算師提供把相關議題**向管理層與政策制定者講清的工具與度量」**；**其最值得記的一處是它把**兩份產出的主次寫清****——**逐字「**技術報告是**首要的項目文檔**」**，而論文「**是**較短的學術摘要**」**；**第二處是它的**生成物被逐條給出****（**動態人口死亡率表、**分年齡的死亡率改善率、**投射預期壽命、**年金現值、**以及**這些表在精算使用上的實務適用性**）；**第三處是它的**國家集**逐條列出**（**十一個中東歐國家：保加利亞、克羅地亞、捷克、愛沙尼亞、匈牙利、拉脫維亞、立陶宛、波蘭、羅馬尼亞、斯洛伐克、斯洛文尼亞**；**另加三個 DACH 基準國：奧地利、德國、瑞士**）
entries.summary_en: A project assessing longevity risk for pension plans in central and eastern Europe — 0 stars, HTML, a 426 MB repository, last pushed inside the window — stating its aim verbatim as supporting pension providers in various eastern European countries in their risk management assessments while also giving actuaries tools and measures to convey the relevant topics to management and policymakers. **Its most notable feature is that it states which of its two outputs is primary**: verbatim, the technical report is the primary project documentation, while the article provides the shorter academic summary. **The second is that its artefacts are listed one by one**: dynamic population mortality tables, age-specific mortality improvement rates, projected life expectancies, annuity present values, and the practical suitability of the resulting tables for actuarial use. **The third is that its country set is enumerated**, eleven central and eastern European countries together with three benchmark countries from the German-speaking region.
entries.body:
**cee-longevity-tables**（仓库 `kainhofer/PensionLongevity`）**是一个为中东欧养老金计划评估长寿风险的项目**：**逐字自述其目标为**「**The aim of the VIG Longevity Risk Management Project is to support pension providers in various Eastern European Countries in their risk management assessments, but also to provide actuaries with tools and measures to convey the relevant topics to the management and policymakers.**」**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可字段为 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信号一致，见下**）、主语言 HTML、仓库体量 **426,145 KB**、**创建 2026-05-31**、最后推送 **2026-09-10**、默认分支为 `master`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**⭐ 创建与推送**都在解冻窗口之内****）；**README 实测 **12,548 字节****，**其开头逐字署名作者与其所属机构**（**一位具名作者，**并列出**一个全国性精算协会与一家保险公司**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「源与生成物」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**把「哪一份产物才算正式文档」写得最明确的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把两份产出的**主次关系**写清**——**逐字为**：**「**The project consists of two related outputs: 1. a scientific article prepared for submission to the **European Actuarial Journal**. 2. a detailed **practitioner-oriented technical report, generated from R Markdown**; **The technical report is the primary project documentation.** It contains the **full country-level derivations, diagnostic comments, practical recommendations and appendices**. The EAJ article provides a **shorter academic summary** of the methodology, selected results and cross-country comparisons.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「首要的项目文档」是**技术报告而不是论文****——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所收条目里**对「什么算正式文档」给出的最不寻常的一个答案**（**⭐ 通常论文才是正式产物，**而这里**把**面向实务的长报告**放在首位**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **两份产出的**内容差别被逐条写出****（**报告含**完整国别推导、**诊断评论、**实务建议与附录**；**论文只含**方法、**部分结果与跨国比较**）**——**⭐ 即**读者知道**该读哪一份**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **技术报告的生产方式是**R Markdown 生成****（**⭐ 即**首要文档**本身是**生成物**，**源在别处**）；**④ ⭐⭐ **论文的投稿对象被点名**（**一个欧洲精算期刊**）**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「生成物」逐条列出，且末项是**适用性**本身**——**逐字为**：**「**The main focus is on: **population mortality levels**; **age-specific mortality improvement rates**; **dynamic population mortality tables**; **projected life expectancies**; **annuity present values**; **practical suitability of the resulting tables for actuarial use.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **五项里有三项是**数**、一项是**率**、**末项是**判断****（**「这些表在精算使用上的实务适用性」**）——**⭐ 即**它把**「能不能用」**也算成一项产出**（**⭐ 与第 348 轮 [[insurance-advisor-platform]] 的「哪些数还没有依据」同族**，**但这里**是对**自己的产物**提出适用性问题**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「动态」（dynamic）是表的一个属性**（**逐字 `dynamic population mortality tables`**）**——**⭐ 即**它不是一张静态表，**而是**可随年份推进的表**；**③ ⭐⭐ **预期寿命与年金现值都在列**（**⭐ 即**输出**面向**养老金与年金**两类用法**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它的国家集逐条列出，并明确区分**目标国**与**基准国****——**逐字为**：**「**The country set includes: **Bulgaria / Croatia / Czechia / Estonia / Hungary / Latvia / Lithuania / Poland / Romania / Slovakia / Slovenia**」**，**以及**「**For comparison purposes, selected Western European benchmark countries are also considered, in particular the DACH region: **Austria / Germany / Switzerland**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **十一个国家被逐个点名**（**⭐ 即**覆盖面**可核对**，**而不是「中东欧若干国」**）；**② ⭐⭐ **基准国被标为「为比较之用」**（**⭐ 即**两组国家**在方法里的角色不同**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「DACH 地区」是一个**区域缩写**（**⭐ 即**它按**语言／区域**而不是按国别大类分组**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **方法被写成一句可核对的话**——**逐字为**：**「**The mortality projections are based on a **Lee–Carter-type modelling framework**. For each country and sex, **age-specific mortality rates are analysed over time and a country-specific calibration period is selected.**」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **方法被归到一个具名框架**（**逐字 Lee–Carter 类型**）**——**⭐ 即**读者可以**去找该框架的原始文献**；**② ⭐⭐ **每个国家与性别**各自选一个校准期****（**逐字 `country-specific calibration period`**）**——**⭐ 即**参数化**是国家级的**，**而不是一套参数用到底**；**③ ⭐⭐ **它说明产出用途为**人口基准****（**逐字「这些表**意在作为精算工作的人口基准**，**尤其在养老金与年金语境下」**）**。**⑤ ⭐ 其余可核实细节**：**① **它逐字说明仓库里放的是**文档、源码与**算出来的死亡率表****（**⭐ 即**产物本身入库**）；**② **项目名里含一个保险集团的缩写**（**⭐ 即**资助或发起方被写进项目名**）；**③ **作者署名含一个全国性精算协会与一家保险公司**（**⭐ 本词条只如实转述其署名**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[mortalitylaws]]、[[stmomo]]、[[cvmortalitymult]]、[[gprmortality]]、[[mortcast]]、[[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信号一致指向**没有许可声明****：**GitHub 许可字段为 **NONE****、**实测默认分支 `master` 的根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 均不存在**（**raw 探测均为 HTTP 404**）、**且 README 全文以「licen／copyright／©」检索**零命中****——**⭐ 本词条指出这一处尤其要紧：**它**明确包含「算出来的死亡率表」与一份技术报告**，**而**「可以读到」与「可以再分发」是两件事****（**⚠️ 尤其**人口死亡率数据**通常另有来源条款——**本词条**未查任何数据来源条款**）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次**没有运行它的任何一步****——**未安装 R、未渲染那份 R Markdown 技术报告、未运行任何建模代码、未打开其任何数据或结果、未打开任何图**；**故**本词条**不主张**其 Lee–Carter 类型建模、其校准期选择或其任何一张死亡率表**按其所述工作**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的**逐字内容**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其数据来源与授权**（**⭐ 即**未核对其用的是哪一国人口数据、**是否可再分发、**以及**其「动态表」的更新时间口径**）**——**⭐ 这是本条目**最需要后续核实的一处**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其表的实务适用性**（**⭐ 其自述把这一项列为产出之一**，**而**本词条**未做任何比较或检验**）。**⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ **一处**署名与关联**如实记录**：**其 README 开头署名为**一位具名作者 ＋ **一个全国性精算协会 ＋ **一家保险公司**，**项目名里另含一个保险集团缩写**——**⭐ 本词条**只如实转述其署名，**⚠️ 不主张**其与任何机构的关系细节**。**⑥ ⚠️ **★0、fork 0、无 topics**，**且**未核实其提交历史**。**⑦ ⚠️ **仓库体量 426 MB****——**⭐ 本词条**如实记录**：**这**属于本站所收条目里体量最大的一档**，**故**本次**未下载其任何内容**。**⑧ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/kainhofer/PensionLongevity` 于 2026-09-11 经仓库检索接口与 GitHub API 实测读取（★数、许可字段 NONE、语言、体量、创建／推送时间、默认分支）；README **12,548 字节**经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对（**含其署名行、两份产出的说明、国家集与方法一节**）；根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 的存在经 raw 探测确认（均为 HTTP 404）；**未克隆、未下载其 426 MB 内容、未安装 R 或任何包、未渲染任何报告、未运行任何代码、未打开任何数据或图、未做其他网络观察**。
entries.body_hk:
**cee-longevity-tables**（倉庫 `kainhofer/PensionLongevity`）**是一個為中東歐養老金計劃評估長壽風險的項目**：**逐字自述其目標為**「**The aim of the VIG Longevity Risk Management Project is to support pension providers in various Eastern European Countries in their risk management assessments, but also to provide actuaries with tools and measures to convey the relevant topics to the management and policymakers.**」**。**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可字段為 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信號一致，見下**）、主語言 HTML、體量 **426,145 KB**、**創建 2026-05-31**、最後推送 **2026-09-10**、默認分支 `master`**（**⭐ 創建與推送都在解凍窗口之內****）；**README 實測 **12,548 位元組****，**其開頭逐字署名作者與其所属機構**（**一位具名作者，並列出一個全國性精算協會與一家保險公司**）。本條目屬本輪主題**「源與生成物」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本輪四條裡**把「哪一份產物才算正式文檔」寫得最明確的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 把兩份產出的**主次關係**寫清**——逐字「**The project consists of two related outputs: 1. a scientific article prepared for submission to the European Actuarial Journal. 2. a detailed practitioner-oriented technical report, generated from R Markdown; The technical report is the primary project documentation. It contains the full country-level derivations, diagnostic comments, practical recommendations and appendices. The EAJ article provides a shorter academic summary of the methodology, selected results and cross-country comparisons.**」**⭐⭐⭐ 四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「首要的項目文檔」是**技術報告而不是論文****（通常論文才是正式產物，而這裡把**面向實務的長報告**放在首位）；**② ⭐⭐⭐兩份產出的**內容差別被逐條寫出****（報告含完整國別推導／診斷評論／實務建議與附錄；論文只含方法／部分結果與跨國比較——讀者知道該讀哪一份）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐技術報告的生產方式是**R Markdown 生成****（首要文檔本身是**生成物**，源在別處）；**④ ⭐⭐論文投稿對象被點名**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **把「生成物」逐條列出，且末項是**適用性**本身**——逐字「**The main focus is on: population mortality levels; age-specific mortality improvement rates; dynamic population mortality tables; projected life expectancies; annuity present values; practical suitability of the resulting tables for actuarial use.**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐五項裡三項是**數**、一項是**率**、末項是**判斷****（「這些表在精算使用上的實務適用性」——**「能不能用」也算成產出**；與第 348 輪 insurance-advisor-platform 的「哪些數還沒有依據」同族，但這裡是對**自己的產物**提出適用性問題）；**② ⭐⭐⭐「動態」（dynamic）是表的一個屬性**（不是一張靜態表，而是**可隨年份推進的表**）；**③ ⭐⭐預期壽命與年金現值都在列**（輸出面向**養老金與年金**兩類用法）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **國家集逐條列出，並明確區分**目標國**與**基準國****——逐字「**The country set includes: Bulgaria / Croatia / Czechia / Estonia / Hungary / Latvia / Lithuania / Poland / Romania / Slovakia / Slovenia**」與「**For comparison purposes, selected Western European benchmark countries are also considered, in particular the DACH region: Austria / Germany / Switzerland**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐十一個國家被逐個點名**（覆蓋面可核對）；**② ⭐⭐基準國被標為「為比較之用」**（兩組國家在方法裡的角色不同）；**③ ⭐⭐「DACH 地區」是一個區域縮寫**（按語言／區域而不是按國別大類分組）。**④ ⭐⭐ **方法被寫成一句可核對的話**——逐字「**The mortality projections are based on a Lee–Carter-type modelling framework. For each country and sex, age-specific mortality rates are analysed over time and a country-specific calibration period is selected.**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐方法被歸到一個具名框架**（讀者可以去找該框架的原始文獻）；**② ⭐⭐每個國家與性別**各自選一個校準期****（參數化是國家級的，而不是一套參數用到底）；**③ ⭐⭐說明產出用途為**人口基準****（逐字「這些表意在作為精算工作的人口基準，尤其在養老金與年金語境下」）。**⑤ ⭐ 其餘**：逐字說明倉庫裡放的是**文檔、源碼與算出來的死亡率表**（產物本身入庫）；項目名裡含一個保險集團縮寫（資助或發起方被寫進項目名）；作者署名含一個全國性精算協會與一家保險公司（本詞條只如實轉述其署名）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 可與 [[mortalitylaws]]、[[stmomo]]、[[cvmortalitymult]]、[[gprmortality]]、[[mortcast]]、[[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[annals-of-actuarial-science]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信號一致指向沒有許可聲明****：GitHub 許可字段為 **NONE**、**默認分支 `master` 的根目錄 `LICENSE` 與 `LICENSE.md` 均不存在（raw 探測均為 HTTP 404）**、**且 README 全文以「licen／copyright／©」檢索**零命中**——**本條尤其要緊：它明確包含「算出來的死亡率表」與一份技術報告，而「可以讀到」與「可以再分發」是兩件事**（⚠️ 尤其人口死亡率數據通常另有來源條款——本詞條未查任何數據來源條款）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次沒有運行它的任何一步****——**未安裝 R、未渲染那份 R Markdown 技術報告、未運行任何建模代碼、未打開其任何數據或結果、未打開任何圖**；**故不主张**其 Lee–Carter 類型建模、其校準期選擇或其任何一張死亡率表按所述工作**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核實**其數據來源與授權**（未核對它用哪一國人口數據、是否可再分發、以及其「動態表」的更新時間口徑）——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其表的實務適用性**（其自述把這一項列為產出之一，而本詞條未做任何比較或檢驗）。**⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ **一處**署名與關聯**如實記錄**：README 開頭署名為一位具名作者＋一個全國性精算協會＋一家保險公司，項目名裡另含一個保險集團縮寫——本詞條只如實轉述其署名，⚠️ **不主张**其與任何機構的關係細節。**⑥ ⚠️ **★0、fork 0、無 topics**，且**未核實其提交歷史**。**⑦ ⚠️ **倉庫體量 426 MB****——本詞條如實記錄：這**屬於本站所收條目裡體量最大的一檔**，故**本次未下載其任何內容**。**⑧ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****。**核實說明**：repo 於 2026-09-11 經倉庫檢索接口與 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 12,548 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對（含其署名行、兩份產出的說明、國家集與方法一節）；根目錄 `LICENSE` 與 `LICENSE.md` 的存在經 raw 探測確認（均為 HTTP 404）；**未克隆、未下載其 426 MB 內容、未安裝 R 或任何包、未渲染任何報告、未運行任何代碼、未打開任何數據或圖、未做其他網絡觀察**。
entries.body_en:
**cee-longevity-tables** (repository `kainhofer/PensionLongevity`) **is a project assessing longevity risk for pension plans in central and eastern Europe**, stating its aim verbatim as supporting pension providers in various eastern European countries in their risk management assessments **while also giving actuaries tools and measures to convey the relevant topics to management and policymakers**. **Measured 0 stars, 0 forks, a licence field of NONE** — ⚠️ three signals agreeing, as set out below — **primary language HTML, a 426,145 KB repository, created 2026-05-31 and last pushed 2026-09-10, with master as the default branch** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **creation and push both inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 12,548 bytes and opens by naming its author together with a national actuarial association and an insurance company**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **source and generated artefact**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it states most clearly which of its products counts as the formal document**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It states the rank of its two outputs** — verbatim, the project consists of two related outputs, a scientific article prepared for submission to **a European actuarial journal** and a detailed **practitioner-oriented technical report generated from R Markdown**, and **the technical report is the primary project documentation**, containing the **full country-level derivations, diagnostic comments, practical recommendations and appendices**, while the journal article provides a **shorter academic summary** of the methodology, selected results and cross-country comparisons ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the primary document is the technical report rather than the article**, ⭐ **which this entry reads as the most unusual answer collected here to the question of what counts as the formal document, since the long practitioner-facing report is placed first and the paper second**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the difference in content between the two is spelled out**, the report holding full country-level derivations, diagnostics, recommendations and appendices **while the article holds only methodology, selected results and cross-country comparison**, ⭐ **so a reader knows which to read**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the technical report is produced from R Markdown**, ⭐ **so the primary document is itself a generated artefact whose source lies elsewhere**; **and ⭐⭐ the article’s intended venue is named.** **② ⭐⭐⭐ It lists its artefacts one by one, the last being suitability itself** — verbatim, the main focus is on population mortality levels, **age-specific mortality improvement rates**, dynamic population mortality tables, **projected life expectancies**, annuity present values, **and the practical suitability of the resulting tables for actuarial use** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **of the six items three are quantities, one is a rate and the last is a judgement**, namely whether the tables are practically suitable, ⭐ **so whether it can be used is itself counted as a product, the same family as the earlier entry recording which numbers have no basis, though here the suitability question is asked of the project’s own output**; ⭐⭐⭐ **dynamic is a property of the table**, ⭐ **so it is not a single static table but one that advances with the year**; **and ⭐⭐ projected life expectancies and annuity present values are both listed**, ⭐ **the output serving both pension and annuity uses**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its country set is enumerated and target countries are distinguished from benchmarks** — verbatim the set includes eleven named countries across central and eastern Europe, **and for comparison purposes selected western European benchmark countries are also considered, in particular the German-speaking region** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **eleven countries are named one by one, so coverage can be checked rather than left as several countries in the region**; ⭐⭐ **the benchmarks are marked as being for comparison, so the two groups play different roles in the method**; **and ⭐⭐ a regional abbreviation is used for the benchmarks**, ⭐ **so grouping follows language or region rather than broad country class**. **④ ⭐⭐ Its method is written as one checkable sentence** — verbatim, the projections are based on a **named modelling framework**, and **for each country and sex, age-specific mortality rates are analysed over time and a country-specific calibration period is selected** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **the method is attributed to a named framework, so a reader can go to its original literature**; ⭐⭐ **each country and sex gets its own calibration period**, ⭐ **so parameterisation is per country rather than one set of parameters throughout**; **and ⭐⭐ the intended use is stated as a population benchmark** for actuarial work, especially in pension and annuity contexts. **⑤ ⭐ Other details**: **the repository is stated verbatim to hold the documentation, source code and the resulting mortality tables**, ⭐ **so the artefacts themselves are committed**; **an insurance group’s abbreviation appears in the project name**, ⭐ **so the funder or sponsor is in the name**; **and the author line carries a national actuarial association and an insurance company**, ⭐ **which this entry reports as stated without claiming any detail of those relationships**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[mortalitylaws]], [[stmomo]], [[cvmortalitymult]], [[gprmortality]], [[mortcast]], [[european-actuarial-journal]] and [[annals-of-actuarial-science]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Three signals agree that there is no licence statement**: **the GitHub licence field is NONE**, **neither a licence file nor a licence markdown file exists at the root of the default branch, both raw probes returning 404**, **and the readme returns no hit for licence, copyright or the copyright sign** — ⭐ **and this matters especially here, because the repository explicitly contains computed mortality tables and a technical report, so being readable and being redistributable are two different things**, ⚠️ **population mortality data in particular usually carrying its own source terms, none of which were examined here**. **② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was run** — **no R installation, the technical report not rendered, no modelling code run, none of its data or results opened and none of its figures viewed**; **so this entry does not claim its framework, its calibration-period selection or any of its mortality tables works as described**, ⭐ **what it verified being the verbatim README**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ Its data provenance and permissions were not verified**, ⭐ **so which country’s population data it uses, whether those data may be redistributed, and what update basis its dynamic tables follow were not checked** — ⭐ **the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **④ ⚠️ The practical suitability of its tables was not verified**, ⭐ **the project listing suitability as one of its outputs while this entry made no comparison or test**. **⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ One attribution note is recorded plainly**: **the readme opens by naming an author together with a national actuarial association and an insurance company, and the project name carries an insurance group’s abbreviation**, ⭐ **which this entry reports as stated**, ⚠️ **asserting nothing about the relationships involved**. **⑥ ⚠️ At 0 stars with no forks and no topics, its commit history was not verified**. **⑦ ⚠️ The repository measures 426 MB**, ⭐ **which this entry records plainly as among the largest collected here, so nothing of its contents was downloaded**. **⑧ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: the repository was read on 2026-09-11 through the repository search endpoint and the GitHub API for stars, licence field, language, size, dates and default branch; the 12,548-byte readme was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, **including its attribution line, its account of the two outputs, its country set and its method section**; licence file probes against the root returned 404; **nothing was cloned, none of its 426 MB was downloaded, R and no package were installed, no report was rendered, no code was run, no data or figure was opened, and no other network observation was made**.

entries.title: **把十九世纪的保险地图接回现代坐标**：一个工具用**街道标签的 OCR** 自动给**桑伯恩火灾保险地图**做地理配准，**输出 IIIF 地理配准标注**；**它的评测指标是**距离****——**逐字给出每册的「**≤25 英尺**」与「**≥200 英尺**」占比**（**如 97.6%／0.0%**）；**并逐字说明为什么用 **RANSAC** 而不是最小二乘**：「**我们对自家控制点的信心**远低于对人的」**，**且**「**把正确与错误的控制点平均起来**不太可能得到好模型**」
entries.title_en: Reconnecting nineteenth-century insurance maps to modern coordinates: a tool uses optical character recognition of street labels to georeference Sanborn fire insurance maps automatically and emits a IIIF georeference annotation, with its evaluation measured in distance, giving for each volume the share of pages placed within twenty-five feet and the share beyond two hundred, and stating why it uses RANSAC rather than least squares because its confidence in its own ground control points is far lower than in a human one, so averaging a mix of correct and incorrect points is unlikely to produce a good model
entries.title_hk: **把十九世紀的保險地圖接回現代坐標**：一個工具用**街道標籤的 OCR** 自動給**桑伯恩火災保險地圖**做地理配準，**輸出 IIIF 地理配準標註**；**它的評測指標是**距離****——**逐字給出每冊的「**≤25 英尺**」與「**≥200 英尺**」佔比**（**如 97.6%／0.0%**）；**並逐字說明為什麼用 **RANSAC** 而不是最小二乘**：「**我們對自家控制點的**信心遠低於對人的」**，**且**「**把正確與錯誤的控制點平均起來不太可能得到好模型**」
entries.summary: 一个**自动给桑伯恩保险地图做地理配准的工具**（**★10**、**Apache-2.0**、Python、仓库体量 **160 MB**、**最后推送落在窗口之内**）：**逐字自述其目标为**「**自动给桑伯恩保险地图做地理配准**」**；**其最值得记的一处是它**用距离而不是比例来评测****——**逐字给出逐册结果表**，**含「**已放置页数**」（**如 27/33＝82%、103/109＝94%、124/129＝96%**）、**「**≤25 英尺**」占比**、**「**≥200 英尺**」占比**与**总分**（**如 97.6%／0.0%**）；**第二处是它**把方法选择讲成一段推理**——**逐字说明为什么用 **RANSAC** 而不是最小二乘**：**「**我们**对自家控制点的信心远低于对人的**」**；**「**把正确与错误的控制点平均起来不太可能得到好模型。**而**用 RANSAC 这种对离群点极其稳健的方法，**我们可以从噪声中找出哪怕一点点信号**」**；**第三处是它**把失败情形点名****（**逐字：**某区在 1911 年系统性改名了所有街道，**故**它在 1945 年的图上表现良好、**在 1898 年的图上表现很差****；**并逐字说**某个城市是「**噩梦场景**」**）
entries.summary_hk: 一個**自動給桑伯恩保險地圖做地理配準的工具**（**★10**、**Apache-2.0**、Python、體量 **160 MB**、**最後推送落在窗口之內**）：**逐字自述其目標為**「**自動給桑伯恩保險地圖做地理配準**」**；**其最值得記的一處是它**用距離而不是比例來評測****——**逐字給出逐冊結果表**，**含「**已放置頁數**」（**如 27/33＝82%、103/109＝94%、124/129＝96%**）、**「**≤25 英尺**」佔比**、**「**≥200 英尺**」佔比**與**總分**（**如 97.6%／0.0%**）；**第二處是它**把方法選擇講成一段推理**——**逐字說明為什麼用 RANSAC 而不是最小二乘**：**「**我們對自家控制點的**信心遠低於對人的**」**；**「**把正確與錯誤的控制點平均起來不太可能得到好模型。**而**用 RANSAC 這種對離群點極其穩健的方法，**我們可以從噪聲中找出哪怕一點點信號**」**；**第三處是它**把失敗情形點名****（**某區在 1911 年系統性改名了所有街道，**故**它在 1945 年的圖上表現良好、**在 1898 年的圖上表現很差****；**並逐字說**某城市是「**噩夢場景**」**）
entries.summary_en: A tool that georeferences Sanborn insurance maps automatically — 10 stars, Apache-2.0, Python, a 160 MB repository, last pushed inside the window — describing its goal verbatim as automatically georeferencing Sanborn insurance maps. **Its most notable feature is that it evaluates by distance rather than proportion**: a per-volume results table gives pages placed, the share within twenty-five feet and the share beyond two hundred feet, together with a score, for example 82 percent of pages placed and 97.6 percent within twenty-five feet with none beyond two hundred. **The second is that it presents its method choice as an argument**, stating verbatim why it uses RANSAC rather than least squares: its confidence in its own ground control points is far lower than in a human one, so averaging a mix of correct and incorrect points is unlikely to produce a good model, whereas a method extremely robust to outliers can find a little signal through the noise. **The third is that it names the cases where it fails**, verbatim that a borough which systematically renamed all its streets in 1911 is handled well on 1945 maps and terribly on 1898 maps, and that one city is described verbatim as a nightmare scenario.
entries.body:
**mapsnap-georeferencer**（仓库 `danvk/mapsnap`）**是一个自动给桑伯恩保险地图做地理配准的工具**：**逐字自述为**「**The goal of Mapsnap is to automatically georeference Sanborn Insurance Maps.**」**。**实测 **★10**（**为本轮四条中关注度最高的一条**）、fork 0、许可 **Apache-2.0**（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件，**raw 探测 HTTP 200**；**GitHub 许可字段亦为 Apache-2.0**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 **160,321 KB**、**创建 2026-05-14**、最后推送 **2026-09-11**、默认分支 `main`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建与推送**都在解冻窗口之内****）；**README 实测 **33,514 字节**；**仓库实测共 **387 个文件、30 个目录**（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测，`truncated` 为 false；含 `mapsnap/` 150 项、`app/` 128 项、**`testdata/` 48 项、**`gallery/` 25 项、**`images/` 23 项、**`models/` 10 项、**`scripts/` 10 项、**`baselines/` 7 项、**.github/` 4 项、`docs/` 4 项**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「接线：把它接到另一套东西上能用为止」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**唯一一条**把「接过去的东西」**用距离来度量**的****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把地图**自动接到坐标上**，并说明接出来的是什么**——**逐字为**：**「**After a few minutes, depending on the number of images in the Sanborn volume, you will get a **IIIF Georeference AnnotationPage** that you can view on Allmaps」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **产物是**一个标准化的标注页**（**逐字 `IIIF Georeference AnnotationPage`**）**——**⭐ 即**它不是一张截图，**而是**别的地图工具能读的东西**（**⭐ 这正是本轮主题：**接到**既有的查看器**上**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它有**一条两行的最小用法****（**逐字给出 `uv tool install mapsnap-cli`、**建目录、**下载清单、**在 OSM 上找一个包含该地图区域的关系、**再 `mapsnap run-loc mymap r1234567`**）**——**⭐ 即**「接线」**被压到一条命令**；**③ ⭐⭐ **输入之一是一个开放地图上的**关系编号**（**⭐ 即**它借用**别人的边界数据**来确定大致范围**）；**④ ⭐⭐ **耗时被如实说成「几分钟，**取决于该册的图幅数」****（**⭐ 即**没有承诺速度**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它用**距离**而不是「比例」来评测，且同时给出**两端的比例****——**逐字给出逐册表**：**已放置页数**（**27/33＝82%、**103/109＝94%、**124/129＝96%**）、**「**≤25 英尺**」占比**、**「**≥200 英尺**」占比**、**总分**与**一个可点的查看器链接**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **指标是**距离阈值下的占比**（**25 英尺与 200 英尺**）**——**⭐ 即**「配准得好不好」**被翻译成**可数的地理误差**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **同时报告**错得很离谱的比例**（**≥200 英尺**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是**最值得抄的一处评测设计**：**只看「有多准」不够，**还要看「有多离谱」****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **测试数据来自**志愿者手工配准**（**逐字注明「测试数据来自某志愿者站点上由人工完成的地理编码」**）**——**⭐ 即**参照物是**人的结果**；**④ ⭐⭐ **每一册都留一个**可打开的链接****（**⭐ 即**读者可以自己看它配得对不对**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**方法选择**写成一段有来有回的推理，而不是一句「用了 RANSAC」**——**逐字要点**：**先说明**其他工具用**全部控制点**拟合并用最小二乘，**「**你提供的每一个控制点都会影响模型」**；**再说明**它自己**「**用每一对控制点拟合一个候选模型，**再看这个模型能多好地解释街道标签。**最好的一对控制点被选中，**其余被丢弃。**它们对拟合没有直接影响」**；**然后给出理由**（**逐字「**我们对自家控制点的信心远低于对人的**」**；**「**」**；「**把正确与错误的控制点平均起来不太可能得到好模型。**而**用 RANSAC 这种对离群点极其稳健的方法，**我们可以从噪声中找出哪怕一点点信号」**）**；**最后**逐条列出**它为什么会错**（**OCR 误读、**街道在到达交叉口前转弯使外推失效、**标签被误解为另一条街**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「**我们对自家控制点的信心远低于对人的**」是本条**最诚实的一句****（**⭐ 即**它解释了**为什么不能借用人类的做法**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **细读后才会发现的方法差别**（**六参数仿射对四参数 Helmert、**全部控制点对每对控制点取最优**）**——**⭐ 且**它给出**量级证据**（**逐字说明在人类配准结果里**尺度各向异性**多小于 **3%**、**斜切**多小于 **3°**，**「**两者都足够接近零，**以至于不清楚它们是真实的还是配准不准确的产物」**，**故**去掉这两个参数**只需两个控制点而非三个**）**；**③ ⭐⭐ **失败机制被逐条列出并**归因到具体组件****（**⭐ 例如**短街名**（**如「AVENUE T」「K ST」「1ST ST」**）**之所以难，**逐字归因于**底层 OCR 库对长文本更好、**而单个字母（O／X／M／W）的方向是歧义的****）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「这个模型是怎么做出来的」也写出来**——**逐字要点**：**最初想用某个大模型 API 直接找交叉口**，**「**它做得还行，**但慢（**每题约 3 分钟**）、**贵（**每张约 0.10 美元**）且并不总是准确。**它在非骨架图上表现不好，**而且**过程不透明，**所以很难改进」**；**随后**意识到自己其实是在**用眼睛追踪街道标签来评价它找到的交叉口**，**于是**改让 OCR 做这件事**；**再后来**发现**「**细化那一步并没有帮助**」**，**遂**收敛到现在的模型**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **它给出了**放弃一条路线的三个可数理由**（**慢、**贵、**不透明**）**——**⭐ 其中**「过程不透明，所以难以改进」**是一句很少见的工程判断**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它说明**为什么最终回到本地 OCR****（**⭐ 即**「评价方式」**决定了**实现方式**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **它如实记录了**一个被删掉的步骤**（**⭐ 即**「细化阶段被证明没有帮助」**也留在了文档里**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **它有一节**与前人工作的对照****（**逐字说明另一篇论文的做法与它**基本相反**：**先用自定模型检测交叉口、**再用另一套 OCR 读水平或垂直条带里的街名**；**并逐字指出该做法**「**本质上无法找到斜向街道」**；**随后给出一个数字对照**——**「**至少对新奥尔良 1951，**Mapsnap 在它配准的图幅上有 **76%** 落在 **15 英尺**以内，**而该论文是 **14%****，**并**逐字自加保留**：「**我不确定他们测的是哪些地图，**而且他们还有别的判据，**所以这可能不是一个公平的比较」**）**（**⭐ 本词条认为这条**自加保留**是本条**第二处最值得抄的地方**）；**② **它有一节**明确列出考虑过的替代方案**（**用罗盘玫瑰判北、**用比例尺判尺度**）**，**并说明各自为何不用**（**逐字「**罗盘并不一定那么准，**用街道更好」**）**；**③ **它有一个**只有三个问题的问答节****（**逐字含「**这能用于其他类型的地图吗？**」「**它和某个志愿者站点是什么关系？**」「**它用 AI 吗？**」**）**——**⭐ 即**它预判了**读者最可能问的三件事**；**④ **它把**开发所借助的工具**也如实写出来**（**逐字说明两个 AI 编程工具**在让它跑起来这件事上**都起了关键作用**）**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[oldinsurancemaps]]、[[asgs]]、[[pyincore]]、[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]、[[openquake-engine]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⭐ **许可为 **Apache-2.0****（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE`，**raw 探测 HTTP 200**，**GitHub 字段亦为 Apache-2.0**）**——**⭐ 而**本词条**未读该文件内容**，**⚠️ 亦**未核实其**测试数据与图幅影像**的权利（**⭐ 其中含来自公共机构的扫描地图**——**这是「代码许可」与「其中的资料权利」两件事**）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次**没有运行它的任何一步****——**未安装其命令行工具、未下载任何清单或影像、未运行 `mapsnap`、未打开其任何查看器链接、未打开任何图**；**故**本词条**不主张**其地理配准、其评测数字或其 IIIF 产物**按其所述工作**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的**逐字内容**（**含其性能表、方法推理、失败情形与开发经过**）与**其经 tree 接口实测的目录结构**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读其任何源码或 `docs/` 下的文档****（**⭐ 即**未核对**其地址解析率是否可达、**其 RANSAC 实现与阈值选取、**以及**其四参数模型是否如其所述**）**——**⭐ 这是本条目**最需要后续核实的一处**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其性能表的数字**（**⭐ 即**表中每一行的比例**本词条**均未复核**，**也未打开那些被标注为「查看」的链接**）。**⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其方法可用于任何特定城市或年代**（**⭐ 其自述已逐字给出失败情形**，**本词条只是转述**）。**⑥ ⚠️ **★10、fork 0**，**且**未核实作者背景**。**⑦ ⚠️ **创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内（2026-05-14／2026-09-11）****。**⑧ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/danvk/mapsnap` 于 2026-09-11 经仓库检索接口与 GitHub API 实测读取（★数、许可 Apache-2.0、语言、体量、创建／推送时间、默认分支）；README **33,514 字节**经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对（**含其性能表、How it Works、Notes on the model、Prior Art 与 Questions 各节**）；`LICENSE` 的存在经 raw 探测确认（HTTP 200）；**文件清单经 GitHub API tree 接口实测（387 个文件、30 个目录，`truncated` 为 false）**；**未克隆、未安装任何依赖、未运行任何命令、未下载任何清单或影像、未打开任何查看器或图、未读任何源码或文档内容、未做其他网络观察**。
