entries.title: **把「不要编造引用」变成一条会失败的测试**：美国医疗账单申诉引擎 **PolicyCrab**——**每封草拟信在到达用户前都过一个无 LLM 的质控节点**；**它有一份 38 条法规的允许清单**，**每条都带来源 URL 与「谁在代码里断言了它」**，**并由五条守卫测试把它接到静态清单、运行时枚举与 RAG 语料三处**；**⚠️ 但本次实测到**：那份清单的默认核实日期是硬编码的，**而模块文档字符串却说「每条都应该是未核实状态」**
entries.title_en: Turning never fabricate citations into a failing test: PolicyCrab, a US healthcare bill appeals engine, passes every drafted letter through a no-LLM quality node before a user sees it, keeps a 38-entry statute allowlist where each entry carries a source URL and a note on which code asserts it, and wires that allowlist to a static list, a runtime enum and the retrieval corpus through five guard tests, while a measured default verification date in that module contradicts the same module docstring claim that every entry should still be unverified.
entries.title_hk: **把「不要編造引用」變成一條會失敗的測試**：美國醫療帳單申訴引擎 **PolicyCrab**——**每封草擬信在到達使用者前都過一個無 LLM 的質控節點**；**它有一份 38 條法規的允許清單**，**每條都帶來源 URL 與「誰在程式碼裡斷言了它」**，**並由五條守衛測試把它接到靜態清單、執行時列舉與 RAG 語料三處**；**⚠️ 但本次實測到**：那份清單的預設核實日期是硬編碼的，**而模組文件字串卻說「每條都應該是未核實狀態」**
entries.summary: **PolicyCrab**（仓库 `sharma-sugurthi/policycrab`）**是一套面向美国医疗账单的 AI 申诉引擎**：**摄入** SBC／EOB、**确定性**判定**超收与违规、**再由自主代理起草**法规申诉信**；**语言 Python 为主**、**许可 Apache-2.0**（**本次实测 `LICENSE` 正文前五行为** Apache License Version 2.0**）**、**实测 ★1**、**11,901 KB**、**创建 2026-07-05**、**推送 2026-09-10**、**默认分支 `main`**、**README 实测 7,916 字节**、**仓库实测 478 条路径（448 文件＋30 目录）**。**它在本轮主题里的价值是「接线」的**第三种样子**：**把一句自然语言要求接到一条会失败的测试上**。**⭐⭐⭐ ①** **Accuracy Core**——**逐字**「**Every drafted letter passes through a no-LLM QA node before it reaches the user**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ②** **允许清单本身就是一份「我不知道」声明**：**逐字**「**The LLM that drafts appeal letters is told "never fabricate citations", but an instruction is not a guarantee.**」**、**「**None means NOT YET HUMAN-VERIFIED.**」**、**「**The build environment this module was authored in could not reach ecfr.gov or uscode.house.gov, so every entry ships with verified_on=None.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③** **⚠️ 但本次实测到一处不一致**：**同为该文件的 `AllowedCitation` 数据类把** `verified_on` **默认写成具体日期** `"2026-09-10"`、`needs_human_verification` **默认 `False`**，**而 38 条目测没有一条显式传这两个字段**——**故按所读代码推断** `allowlist_needs_human_verification()` **会返回 False**，**`DEPLOYMENT.md` 承诺的** `ALLOWLIST_NEEDS_HUMAN_VERIFICATION` **标志当下不可达**；**⭐⭐⭐ ④** **守卫测试接在三处**（**18 条逐字法规的静态清单**、**`AppealFramework` 枚举的运行时文本**、**`knowledge_base/` 全部 markdown**），**逐字理由**「**code cannot instruct the LLM to cite something we cannot verify.**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤** **名单每条都带** `origin`——**「**代码里哪一处断言了它**」**（**即**这张表同时是「允许引用什么」与「谁在引用它」）；**⭐⭐ ⑥** **无 LLM 回归套件的文件头自己写明「它不断言什么」**（**逐字**「**It does NOT assert anything the LLM decides (contradiction analysis, letter text).**」）；**⭐⭐ ⑦** **CI 用四个假凭据把整套测试跑起来**（`SUPABASE_URL: "https://mock.supabase.co"`、三个 `mock_key`），**部署经无长期密钥的 Workload Identity Federation**。**⚠️ 本次未运行任何一步、未读任何 Python 业务源码**，**故不主张**任何计算、路由或法律结论正确；**⚠️ 本次另实测到两处文档与仓库不一致**（`scripts/build_citation_allowlist.py` 在仓库根 404、README 说的根目录 `.env.example` 未出现在清单里）。
entries.summary_hk: **PolicyCrab**（倉庫 `sharma-sugurthi/policycrab`）**是一套面向美國醫療帳單的 AI 申訴引擎**：**攝入** SBC／EOB、**確定性**判定**超收與違規、**再由自主代理起草**法規申訴信**；**語言以 Python 為主**、**許可 Apache-2.0**（**本次實測 `LICENSE` 正文前五行**）、**實測 ★1**、**11,901 KB**、**建立 2026-07-05**、**推送 2026-09-10**、**預設分支 `main`**、**README 實測 7,916 位元組**、**倉庫實測 478 條路徑（448 檔案＋30 目錄）**。**它在本輪主題裡的價值是「接線」的**第三種樣子**：**把一句自然語言要求接到一條會失敗的測試上**。**⭐⭐⭐ ①** **Accuracy Core**——**逐字**「**Every drafted letter passes through a no-LLM QA node before it reaches the user**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ②** **允許清單本身就是一份「我不知道」聲明**：**逐字**「**The LLM that drafts appeal letters is told "never fabricate citations", but an instruction is not a guarantee.**」**、**「**None means NOT YET HUMAN-VERIFIED.**」**、**「**The build environment this module was authored in could not reach ecfr.gov or uscode.house.gov, so every entry ships with verified_on=None.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③** **⚠️ 但本次實測到一處不一致**：**同為該檔案的 `AllowedCitation` 資料類別把** `verified_on` **預設寫成具體日期** `"2026-09-10"`、`needs_human_verification` **預設 `False`**，**而 38 條目測沒有一條顯式傳這兩個欄位**——**故按所讀程式碼推斷** `allowlist_needs_human_verification()` **會回傳 False**，**`DEPLOYMENT.md` 承諾的** `ALLOWLIST_NEEDS_HUMAN_VERIFICATION` **標誌當下不可達**；**⭐⭐⭐ ④** **守衛測試接在三處**（**18 條逐字法規的靜態清單**、**`AppealFramework` 列舉的執行時文字**、**`knowledge_base/` 全部 markdown**），**逐字理由**「**code cannot instruct the LLM to cite something we cannot verify.**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤** **名單每條都帶** `origin`——**「**程式碼裡哪一處斷言了它**」**；**⭐⭐ ⑥** **無 LLM 回歸套件的檔案頭自己寫明「它不斷言什麼」**；**⭐⭐ ⑦** **CI 用四個假憑證把整套測試跑起來**，**部署經無長期金鑰的 Workload Identity Federation**。**⚠️ 本次未運行任何一步、未讀任何 Python 業務原始碼**，**故不主張**任何計算、路由或法律結論正確；**⚠️ 本次另實測到兩處文件與倉庫不一致**。
entries.summary_en: **PolicyCrab** (repository `sharma-sugurthi/policycrab`) **is an AI appeals engine for US healthcare bills**: it ingests SBC and EOB documents, adjudicates overbilling and regulatory violations deterministically, then has autonomous agents draft regulatory appeal letters; **primarily Python**, **licence Apache-2.0** with the first five lines of the `LICENSE` verified this round, **measured 1 star**, **11,901 KB**, **created 2026-07-05**, **pushed 2026-09-10**, **default branch `main`**, **README measuring 7,916 bytes**, and **478 measured repository paths, being 448 files and 30 directories**. **Its value for this round is a third shape of wiring: attaching a plain-language requirement to a test that can fail.** **First, top**: the Accuracy Core, verbatim, that every drafted letter passes through a no-LLM QA node before it reaches the user. **Second, top**: **the allowlist is itself a declaration of what is not known**, verbatim, that the LLM drafting appeal letters is told never to fabricate citations but that an instruction is not a guarantee, that a missing date means not yet human-verified, and that the build environment the module was authored in could not reach ecfr.gov or uscode.house.gov, so every entry ships unverified. **Third, top, and measured this round as an inconsistency**: the dataclass in that same file defaults the verification date to a concrete date and the human-verification flag to false, while none of the 38 entries passes either field explicitly, so on the code as read the pending-review flag the deployment guide promises is currently unreachable. **Fourth, top**: the guard tests attach the allowlist in three places, a static list of 18 verbatim statutes, the runtime text of every `AppealFramework` member, and every markdown file under the knowledge base, on the verbatim reasoning that code cannot instruct the LLM to cite something we cannot verify. **Fifth, top**: every entry carries an origin field saying where in the codebase it is asserted, so the table records both what may be cited and who cites it. **Sixth**: the file header of the LLM-free regression suite states what it does not assert. **Seventh**: CI runs the whole suite against four mock credentials, and deployment uses workload identity federation rather than a long-lived key. **Nothing was run this round and no Python business logic was read, so no computation, routing or legal conclusion is claimed to be correct; two further measured mismatches between documentation and repository are recorded.**
entries.body:
**PolicyCrab**（仓库 `sharma-sugurthi/policycrab`）**是一套面向美国医疗账单的 AI 申诉引擎**：**逐字自述为**「**an AI platform built with production practices designed to help medical advocates, HR benefits managers, and individual Americans navigate the complexities of US healthcare insurance**」——**摄入** SBC／EOB 文档、**确定性**判定**超收或违规、**再由自主代理起草**法规申诉信**。**实测**：**语言以 Python 为主**、**许可 Apache-2.0**（**本次实测 `LICENSE` 正文前五行为** Apache License Version 2.0**）**、**★1**、**仓库体量 11,901 KB**、**创建 2026-07-05**、**最后推送 2026-09-10**、**默认分支 `main`**；**README 实测 7,916 字节**。**仓库经 `codeload.github.com` 的 tarball 枚举**（**本轮 GitHub 核心 API 配额已用尽**），**实测 478 条路径，其中 448 个文件、30 个目录**：`backend/` 394 条、`frontend/` 55 条、`supabase/` 11 条、`knowledge_base/` 8 条、`.github/` 3 条，**根目录另有** `README.md`、`LICENSE`、`DEPLOYMENT.md`、`SECURITY.md`、`.gitignore`。**其中可数的几组**：`backend/tests/` 下 **35 个 `test_*.py`**、`backend/app/agents/` **13 个模块**、`backend/app/engine/` **11 个模块**、`backend/app/security/` **8 个模块**、`backend/scripts/` **8 个脚本**、`supabase/migrations/` **9 个 SQL（001 到 009，按编号顺序）**、`knowledge_base/` **7 个 markdown（01 到 07）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「接线：把它接到另一套东西上能用为止」**；**本词条认为它是本轮四条里「接线」写得最严的一条**——**它把一句自然语言要求（不要编造引用）接到了一条会失败的测试上**。

**可核实信息（均 README、`SECURITY.md`、`DEPLOYMENT.md`、`ci.yml`、`citation_allowlist.py`、`test_citation_allowlist_sync.py`、`test_benchmark_deterministic.py` 与清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每一封信在到达用户之前都过一个「无 LLM」的质控节点**——**README 逐字**：**「**Accuracy Core (deterministic appeal QA): Every drafted letter passes through a no-LLM QA node before it reaches the user**」**。**⭐ 即**「**模型写的东西在给人看之前先被一套确定性检查过一遍**」**——**这不是「我们用了 AI」，而是「我们在哪一步不信任 AI」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 引用核对有两条依据，且不可核实的内容会被标出来而不是默默放行**——**README 逐字**：**「**each statute the letter cites is checked against a sourced allowlist (`app/engine/citation_allowlist.py`) and the knowledge chunks the model was actually shown; each quoted policy clause is matched against the retrieved policy pages (with page-drift detection).**」**，**紧接着**：**「**Anything unverifiable is marked**」**，**随后给出一个方括号标记**（**方括号内先是** `VERIFY:`**，再接一个省略号字符**），**末尾逐字**：**「**in the letter, never silently trusted.**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 两条依据**——**「**允许清单**」**（**这份法规在不在名单里**）**与**「**模型实际看到的片段**」（**这句引文有没有出现在喂给它的原文里**）**——**⭐ 即**「**我允许你引用什么**」与「**我刚才到底给了你什么**」**是两个独立检查**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 引文要有**页面漂移检测**（`page-drift detection`）**——**⭐ 即**它知道**「**同一句话在扫描件与文本层里可能落到不同页**」**这类具体失败**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 不可核实的不是被删掉，而是被标出来**（**`never silently trusted`**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里「不确定怎么处理」写得最好的一句**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 允许清单模块的文档字符串本身就是一份「我不知道」声明**——`backend/app/engine/citation_allowlist.py`（**实测 17,264 字节**）**开头逐字**：**「**Citation Allowlist — the set of statutes, regulations and guidance documents that PolicyCrab’s appeal letters are permitted to cite as VERIFIED.**」**，**并在 Why this exists 一节逐字**：**「**The LLM that drafts appeal letters is told "never fabricate citations", but an instruction is not a guarantee. This module is the deterministic ground truth the citation verifier (app/engine/citation_verifier.py) checks against.**」**；**字段说明逐字**：**「**source_url — the authoritative page for the provision (eCFR for CFR sections, uscode.house.gov for U.S.C. sections, dol.gov for DOL guidance).**」**与**「**verified_on — ISO date on which a human opened source_url and confirmed the provision exists and says what `display`/`aliases` claim. None means NOT YET HUMAN-VERIFIED.**」**；**并在 Sourcing discipline 一节逐字**：**「**The build environment this module was authored in could not reach ecfr.gov or uscode.house.gov, so every entry ships with verified_on=None. The verifier surfaces this as the flag ALLOWLIST_NEEDS_HUMAN_VERIFICATION until a maintainer runs `python scripts/build_citation_allowlist.py --checklist`, opens each URL, and fills in verified_on.**」**与**「**tests/test_citation_allowlist_sync.py enforces that every entry has either a verified_on date or needs_human_verification=True — silent, unsourced entries cannot be added.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一段文字**：**它区分了「我核对了」与「我没能核对」**，**并把后者写进字段语义**（**`None` 的含义被逐字定义为** NOT YET HUMAN-VERIFIED**）**，**还说明**为什么**（**构建环境连不上那两个官网**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 但本次实测到一处不一致：同一份文件里的默认值与上面那段声明相反**——**同为该文件的 `AllowedCitation` 数据类逐字为**：`verified_on: str | None = "2026-09-10"`（**注释逐字** `# ISO date; None = not yet human-verified`**）**、`needs_human_verification: bool = False`；**而本次对整份文件做正则统计的结果是**：`verified_on` **只出现在文档字符串（5 处）、该数据类字段定义（1 处）与两个函数体（2 处）里**，**没有一条 `_ENTRIES` 条目显式传它**；`needs_human_verification` **同理，条目里从不出现**。**⭐ 因此按本次所读代码推断**：38 条**全部**取默认值，**`allowlist_needs_human_verification()`**（**逐字为** `return any(e.needs_human_verification or e.verified_on is None for e in _ENTRIES)`）**会返回 False**，**`unverified_entries()` 会返回空表**；**而 `DEPLOYMENT.md` 逐字承诺**：**「**Until then every letter carries the flag `ALLOWLIST_NEEDS_HUMAN_VERIFICATION` (visible in the UI as "reference list pending review").**」**——**即**那个「待人工复核」状态**在当下不可达**。**⭐ 本词条不推测作者用意**，**只把三样东西并排放出来**：**文档字符串里的声明、数据类里的默认值、以及 38 条没有一条显式设置它的实测结果**。**⭐ 另外一处可核查的结构事实**：守卫测试的断言是「**若 `verified_on is None` 则必须 `needs_human_verification is True`；否则该字符串必须能被解析成 ISO 日期且**不晚于今天**」——**默认值是一个具体日期，所以这条守卫今天会通过**；**而它一旦运行在 2026-09-10 之前的机器时钟上就会失败**（**⭐ 即**这条守卫的通过与否**取决于墙上时钟**，**而不取决于有没有人真的打开过那些官网**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 守卫测试把允许清单接到三处，而不只是自己检查自己**——`backend/tests/test_citation_allowlist_sync.py`（**实测 4,888 字节**）**文件头逐字列出四条守则**，**其中最值得抄的是第三条**：**「**Every statute literal asserted by the deterministic engines / prompts normalizes into the allowlist — code cannot instruct the LLM to cite something we cannot verify.**」**。**本次实测的五条测试**：**① `test_allowlist_is_non_empty_and_keys_match_entries`**（**断言清单至少 20 条且键等于各条自己的 canonical**）；**② `test_every_entry_is_sourced_and_verification_state_is_explicit`**（**断言 `source_url` 以 `https://` 开头、`display` 非空、**`origin` 非空并逐字注释**「**origin must say where in the codebase this is asserted**」**，**再按上面那套日期规则检查核实状态**）；**③ `test_display_normalizes_to_canonical`** 与 **`test_every_alias_resolves_to_its_entry`**；**④ `test_code_asserted_statutes_are_in_allowlist`**——**它带一份 18 条逐字法规清单 `CODE_ASSERTED_STATUTES`**，**每条上方逐字注明由哪段代码断言**（如 `regulatory_router.get_appeal_framework_details`、`grievance.CARC_PRECEDENTS + prompt rules 13/14`、`triage NSA rule, models/claim`、`appeal_routes.LEVEL_CONFIGS`、`bill_auditor`、`carrier_intelligence`），**逐条断言它们都能归一化进允许清单**；**⑤ `test_regulatory_router_framework_details_all_verifiable`**——**它遍历 `AppealFramework` 枚举的每一个成员**，对 `governing_law` 与 `regulation` **两段实际运行时文本跑正则**，**要求每一处法规引用都落在允许清单里**（**⭐ 即**这不是静态清单的自我核对，**而是对着真实代码路径跑**）；**⑥ `test_knowledge_base_statutes_are_in_allowlist`**——**它扫描 `knowledge_base/` 下每一个 markdown 文件里的法规引用**，**要求全部落在允许清单里**，**并在目录不存在时 `pytest.skip` 且逐字给出理由**「**knowledge_base/ not present (not shipped in the production container)**」（**⭐ 即**它知道**CI 里有、生产容器里没有**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑥ 清单的每一条都带一张反向依赖图**——`AllowedCitation` 字段逐字为 `canonical`／`display`／`source_url`／`origin`／`aliases`／`kb_concept_ids`／`verified_on`／`needs_human_verification`／`note`，**其中 `origin` 的注释逐字为**「**where in the codebase this is asserted**」，**实测取值如** `regulatory_router;grievance.CARC_PRECEDENTS;deadline_calculator;carrier_intelligence`、`knowledge_base/02;state_profiles`、`grievance prompt rule 12 (MHPAEA)`、`appeal_routes.LEVEL_CONFIGS`。**⭐ 即**这张表的每一行**同时回答两个问题**：**允许引用什么**、**谁在引用它**——**这是本词条见过的最完整的一种「引用接线」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑦ 键是三套编号体系的归一化器**——**文档字符串逐字给出映射**：`29 CFR § 2560.503-1` → `29cfr2560.503-1`；`29 U.S.C. § 1132` → `29usc1132`；`ACA Section 2719` → `phsa2719`（**括注逐字** `ACA §§27xx are PHSA §§27xx`**）**；`DOL Technical Release 2010-01` → `doltr2010-01`；**并由** `citation_verifier.normalize_statute()` **产出**。**⭐ 即**同一部法规的多种写法**被压成一个键**——**这正是把 LLM 的自由文本接回确定性查找的那一层**。**⚠️ 而判例被明确排除**，**逐字为**：**「**Case law (e.g. Estate of Lokken v. UnitedHealth Group) is deliberately NOT in this list: no primary-source URL could be confirmed from this environment, so the verifier will flag case names for human review.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**我确认不了的，就不放进允许清单，但也不放过它**」。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 质控节点之外还有三件，都有可数或可核实的表述**（**均 README 逐字**）：**① Extraction Quality Gate**（**检测缺失事实时用的哨兵值**、**返回一份「去哪找」清单**、**要求提示用括号占位符而不是猜**，**并给出开关** `QUALITY_GATE_MODE=block` **在关键缺口时拒绝草拟**）；**② Transparent Success Score + Outcome Calibration**（**逐字**「**a factor-by-factor case-strength estimate shown alongside the model’s own guess**」**，**并把真实结果记进** `/api/outcomes`、**用** `GET /api/outcomes/calibration` **对着真实推翻率校准**）；**③ LLM-free regression suite**（`tests/test_benchmark_deterministic.py`，**逐字说它跑**「**all 200 benchmark cases plus 12 hand-written quality-gate cases in CI, with no model or database access**」）。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 无 LLM 回归套件的文件头自己写明「它不断言什么」**——**本次实读该文件头逐字**：**「**Runs only the deterministic engines exactly as the pipeline wires them**」**，**并列出调用链** `build_claim_from_overrides → calculate_cost → route_to_appeal_framework → calculate_appeal_deadline → deterministic_triage → evaluate_quality_gate → compute_success_score`；**还逐字给出它为什么能进 CI**：**「**No Supabase, no model calls, so it is safe for CI and finishes in seconds.**」**；**以及最值得抄的一句**：**「**It guards the ground truth the 200 synthetic cases encode (NSA detection, CARC routing, correct-denial handling) and the new Accuracy Core engines against regressions. It does NOT assert anything the LLM decides (contradiction analysis, letter text).**」**。**⭐ 即**「**我测了这些**」**与**「**我没测那些**」**写在同一个文件的最上面**——**这与本词条项目自身「写清哪些没核对」的做法是同一件事**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ CI 用四个假凭据把整套测试跑起来**——`.github/workflows/ci.yml`（**实测 2,521 字节**，**仓库里唯一的工作流**）三个 job：**① `backend-test`**（Python 3.12 与 pip 缓存、装 `requirements.txt` 与 `requirements-dev.txt`；**flake8 跑两遍**——**第一遍逐字为** `--count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics`**（只查致命类）**，**第二遍逐字带** `--exit-zero --max-complexity=10 --max-line-length=127`**（不阻断）**；**再在四个假环境变量下跑** `pytest tests/`，**逐字为** `SUPABASE_URL: "https://mock.supabase.co"`、`SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY: "mock_key"`、`SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: "mock_key"`、`GEMINI_API_KEY: "mock_key"`**）**；**② `frontend-build`**（Node 20、`npm ci`、`npm run build`）；**③ `deploy-backend`**（`needs: backend-test`，**仅在 push 到 main 时运行**，**逐字条件** `if: github.event_name == ‘push’ && github.ref == ‘refs/heads/main’`）。**⭐ 即**「**无模型、无数据库**」不是口号，**而是 CI 里那四个假值撑起来的**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 部署用无长期密钥的联邦身份**——`deploy-backend` **声明** `permissions: contents: read` **与** `id-token: write`（**逐字注释** `# Required for Workload Identity Federation`**）**，**经** `google-github-actions/auth@v2` **的 Workload Identity Federation 登录**（**工作流里逐字给出 workload identity provider 路径与服务账号邮箱**），**再以** `google-github-actions/deploy-cloudrun@v2` **部署**（`service: policycrab-backend`、`region: us-east1`、`source: ‘./backend’`）；**⭐ 即**仓库里没有长期 GCP 密钥**。**⚠️ 同一条命令逐字带** `flags: ‘--allow-unauthenticated’`**——本词条如实记录这一处**（**即**该 Cloud Run 服务以公开可调用方式部署）；**它与** `SECURITY.md` **里 Cloudflare 与速率限制那一节配套**，**本词条不对其安全性作评价**。**⭐⭐ ⑫ 安全声明分开写、分层写**（`SECURITY.md` 实测 2,975 字节）：**PHI／PII 在离开服务器前先本地清洗**（**逐字**「**The backend uses local Regex and Microsoft Presidio to scrub Protected Health Information (PHI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from user documents *before* any data is sent to external LLM providers.**」**）**；**保留策略逐字**「**API calls to primary LLM providers (Google Gemini) are configured as zero-retention (API data is not used for model training).**」**；**数据库侧**「**Row Level Security (RLS)**」**只允许用户读写自己的数据**、**管理端点要求 JWT 里带 `admin` 角色**；**网络侧**「**CloudflareMiddleware**」**逐字限定**「**When enabled**」**，**并逐字说明用途**「**blocks any incoming requests that do not originate from verified Cloudflare IP blocks, preventing direct-to-origin bypass attacks**」**。**EASF 五件**（**逐字**）：**`prompt_shields.py`**（**极快的编译正则启发式，拦已知越狱与间接注入——在输入与 RAG 上下文两处**）、**`policy_engine.py`**（**逐字**「**AI Agents cannot execute tools or sensitive actions directly. They must format a `ProposedAction` and request permission. The Policy Engine evaluates this deterministically.**」**）、**`ai_gateway.py`**（**集中中间件：输入跑提示盾、输出跑策略引擎**）、**`REQUIRE_APPROVAL`**（**逐字**「**High-risk actions, such as generating/submitting legal appeals, trigger a deterministic halt, moving the action to a human approval queue.**」**）、**`audit_logger.py`**（**每个被提议的动作与随之而来的确定性策略决定都记成结构化 JSON，逐字说明是为 SIEM 摄入优化**）。**⚠️ 本次逐字所见一处格式事实**：`SECURITY.md` 的速率限制那一行在 markdown 里写成一个**已勾选的复选框**（`- [x] Rate Limiting:`**）**——**本词条只记录这个格式事实，不推测其含义**。**⭐⭐ ⑬ 可选功能的默认关闭是被写清的，而不是含糊的**——`ORGS_ENABLED=false`（**逐字**「**With it off, the frontend hides every team control and the backend ignores the `X-Org-Id` header, so single-user behaviour is unchanged.**」**）**；**迁移 009 逐字**「**Inert until `ORGS_ENABLED=true`, so it is safe to apply at any time; existing rows are untouched.**」**；**迁移 008 逐字**「**Apply before deploying a backend that includes the Accuracy Core; the table holds no PHI and is deliberately excluded from the 30-day purge.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**可以在任何时候执行**」「**必须在部署前执行**」「**要等开关打开才生效**」**三种先后关系被分开写**。**⭐⭐ ⑭ 「删」与「不删」都写明理由**——`pg_cron` **在 30 天后删除原始 EOB 提取物**（**逐字**「**utilizes Supabase `pg_cron` to automatically delete raw, sensitive EOB extractions after 30 days**」**）**；**而**上诉结果表**逐字被排除在清理之外**，**理由是**「**the table holds no PHI**」。**⭐⭐ ⑮ 环境变量表把「安全的生产默认值」写在括号里**——`DEPLOYMENT.md` **逐字**：「**Accuracy Core (optional — defaults shown are the safe production values)**」**，**并逐条给出** `CITATION_UNVERIFIED_POLICY=annotate`（**逐字**「**annotate inserts a visible `[VERIFY: ...]` marker (original letter preserved), `strip` removes them, `off` reports only**」**）**、`CITATION_POLICY_FUZZY_THRESHOLD=0.85`、`QUALITY_GATE_MODE=warn`、`ORGS_ENABLED=false`、`ORG_INVITATION_TTL_DAYS=7`。**⭐ 即**「**默认值是什么**」与「**为什么这个默认值是安全的**」**写在同一行**。**⚠️ 本次另实测到两处文档与仓库不一致**：**①** `citation_allowlist.py` **文档字符串让人运行** `python scripts/build_citation_allowlist.py --checklist`（**未说在哪个目录**），**而该路径在仓库根返回 404**；**真实路径是** `backend/scripts/build_citation_allowlist.py`（**本次实测 200**），**`DEPLOYMENT.md` 写对了**（**逐字**「**run `python scripts/build_citation_allowlist.py --checklist` from `backend/`**」**）**——**即**两处说法**只有加上 `from backend/` 才成立**。**②** README 的仓库结构块把 `.env.example` 列在根目录，**而本次清单里只出现** `backend/.env.example`**，**根目录那一份没有出现**；**README 的 Getting Started 第 2 步逐字为**「**Copy `.env.example` to `.env` in the root directory.**」**——**即**照做的人在仓库根找不到这个文件**。**⭐ 本词条只记录这两个实测结果，不推测原因**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[health-denial-appeals]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[insurance-qa-evidence]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「一份可核查的引用清单 + 一个无 LLM 质控节点」这套做法的最小完整样本**：**逐条来源、反向的代码依赖图、三处守卫测试、以及不可核实内容的显式标记**；**其「允许清单 + 归一化键」的做法与 [[claims-integrity-investigator]]、[[claim-to-confidence]] 的取证思路相邻**，**而「用一批固定基准用例把确定性部分钉住」与 [[reliability-harness]]、[[ragas]] 的评测取向可比**；**至于[[garak]] 一类红队工具针对的提示注入，本条记录的是它自己那一套**「**Agentic Zero Trust**」**边界**——**本词条未做任何对照测试**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行它的任何一步**（**未装依赖、未起 FastAPI 或前端、未连 Supabase、未调用任何 LLM、未跑 pytest、未打开它的任何页面**），**故不主张任何功能按所述工作，也不主张任何准确率、覆盖率或合规声明成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 Python 业务源码**——**本次只读了** `README.md`、`SECURITY.md`、`.github/workflows/ci.yml`、`backend/app/engine/citation_allowlist.py`**（文档字符串、数据类与函数定义，并对其余部分做正则统计）**、`backend/tests/test_citation_allowlist_sync.py`**（全文）**、`backend/tests/test_benchmark_deterministic.py`**（文件头）**、`DEPLOYMENT.md`**（前半）** **与一份完整文件清单**，**故不主张**成本计算、截止日计算、申诉路由、质量门、成功评分与信函文本的任何正确性。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**：**这是一套面向美国医疗账单与监管申诉的工具**，**其法律与监管准确性本词条完全没有核实**——**不应据本条目采信任何法律结论，也不应据本条目认为它能替代专业意见**；**本词条只记录它的工程质量与「如何标注不确定」这一做法**。**③ ⚠️ 关于 ④ 那一处默认值**：**这是本词条对代码的读解，不是运行结果**——**本次未运行** `allowlist_needs_human_verification()` **或任何测试**，**也未读完整个仓库**；**若某条目以本次正则未覆盖的形式设置该字段，本词条的读解会不成立**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实「200 条基准用例」与「12 条手写质控用例」的实际条数**（**只读到文件头注释**）；**未核实** `knowledge_base/` 七个文件的实际内容与其中法规引用是否真的都能归一化。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** `--allow-unauthenticated` **部署的当前实际状态**（**未访问该服务、未核实其 URL、未发出任何请求**）；**未核实** Cloudflare 是否启用（**`SECURITY.md` 逐字为** When enabled**）**；**未核实** Microsoft Presidio **是否真的在本地运行**；**未核实** `pg_cron` 任务在生产是否启用（**只读到迁移文件存在与 README 的说法**）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实** 提示盾与策略引擎是否真的拦得住任何东西（**未读这两个模块的实现，未做任何注入测试**）。**⑦ ⚠️ ★1，本次未记录 fork 数；未核实其生产使用范围、用户数或是否有真实用户；未核实作者背景。**⑧ ⚠️ 许可字段为 Apache-2.0，本次实测 `LICENSE` 正文前五行为** Apache License Version 2.0**，**未读全文**。**⑨ ⚠️ 创建 2026-07-05 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-10 在窗口之内**——**本条的缺口是「把法规引用接进允许清单、并用无 LLM 质控节点把不可核实内容标出来」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**（**池内 [[health-denial-appeals]]、[[claims-integrity-investigator]]、[[insurance-qa-evidence]]、[[evidence-review-claims]] 覆盖相邻场景，但不是「允许清单 ＋ 反向代码依赖图 ＋ 三处守卫测试」这一形态**）。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑪ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用时，把原文里的 ASCII 撇号（如 `PolicyCrab’s`、`model’s`、`provider’s`）写作 ’，**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**；**`README` 与 `DEPLOYMENT.md` 里的方括号标记 `VERIFY` 在 README 中以省略号字符结尾、在 DEPLOYMENT.md 中以三个句点结尾**——**本词条按 DEPLOYMENT.md 的写法引用**。

**PolicyCrab**（倉庫 `sharma-sugurthi/policycrab`）**是一套面向美國醫療帳單的 AI 申訴引擎**：**逐字自述為**「**an AI platform built with production practices designed to help medical advocates, HR benefits managers, and individual Americans navigate the complexities of US healthcare insurance**」——**攝入** SBC／EOB 文件、**確定性**判定**超收或違規、**再由自主代理起草**法規申訴信**。**實測**：**語言以 Python 為主**、**許可 Apache-2.0**、**★1**、**倉庫體量 11,901 KB**、**建立 2026-07-05**、**最後推送 2026-09-10**、**預設分支 `main`**；**README 實測 7,916 位元組**。**倉庫經 `codeload.github.com` 的 tarball 列舉**（**本輪 GitHub 核心 API 配額已用盡**），**實測 478 條路徑，其中 448 個檔案、30 個目錄**：`backend/` 394 條、`frontend/` 55 條、`supabase/` 11 條、`knowledge_base/` 8 條、`.github/` 3 條。**其中可數的幾組**：`backend/tests/` 下 **35 個 `test_*.py`**、`backend/app/agents/` **13 個模組**、`backend/app/engine/` **11 個模組**、`backend/app/security/` **8 個模組**、`backend/scripts/` **8 個腳本**、`supabase/migrations/` **9 個 SQL（001 到 009）**、`knowledge_base/` **7 個 markdown（01 到 07）**。本條目屬於本輪主題**「接線：把它接到另一套東西上能用為止」**；**本詞條認為它是本輪四條裡「接線」寫得最嚴的一條**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、`SECURITY.md`、`DEPLOYMENT.md`、`ci.yml`、`citation_allowlist.py`、`test_citation_allowlist_sync.py`、`test_benchmark_deterministic.py` 與清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每一封信在到達使用者之前都過一個「無 LLM」的質控節點**——**README 逐字**：**「**Accuracy Core (deterministic appeal QA): Every drafted letter passes through a no-LLM QA node before it reaches the user**」**。**⭐ 即**「**模型寫的東西在給人看之前先被一套確定性檢查過一遍**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 引用核對有兩條依據，且不可核實的內容會被標出來而不是默默放行**——**README 逐字**：**「**each statute the letter cites is checked against a sourced allowlist (`app/engine/citation_allowlist.py`) and the knowledge chunks the model was actually shown; each quoted policy clause is matched against the retrieved policy pages (with page-drift detection).**」**，**並逐字**：**「**Anything unverifiable is marked**」**，**隨後是一個方括號標記**（**內先是** `VERIFY:`**，再接一個省略號字元**），**末尾逐字**：**「**in the letter, never silently trusted.**」**。**⭐ 三處值得記**：**① 兩條依據**——**「**允許清單**」與「**模型實際看到的片段**」是兩個獨立檢查**；**② 引文要有**頁面漂移偵測**；**③ 不可核實的不是被刪掉，而是被標出來**（**`never silently trusted`**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 允許清單模組的文件字串本身就是一份「我不知道」聲明**——`citation_allowlist.py`（**實測 17,264 位元組**）**開頭逐字**：**「**Citation Allowlist — the set of statutes, regulations and guidance documents that PolicyCrab’s appeal letters are permitted to cite as VERIFIED.**」**，**並逐字**：**「**The LLM that drafts appeal letters is told "never fabricate citations", but an instruction is not a guarantee. This module is the deterministic ground truth the citation verifier (app/engine/citation_verifier.py) checks against.**」**；**欄位說明逐字**：**「**verified_on — ISO date on which a human opened source_url and confirmed the provision exists and says what `display`/`aliases` claim. None means NOT YET HUMAN-VERIFIED.**」**；**並逐字**：**「**The build environment this module was authored in could not reach ecfr.gov or uscode.house.gov, so every entry ships with verified_on=None. The verifier surfaces this as the flag ALLOWLIST_NEEDS_HUMAN_VERIFICATION until a maintainer runs `python scripts/build_citation_allowlist.py --checklist`, opens each URL, and fills in verified_on.**」**與**「**tests/test_citation_allowlist_sync.py enforces that every entry has either a verified_on date or needs_human_verification=True — silent, unsourced entries cannot be added.**」**。**⭐ 即**它區分了「我核對了」與「我沒能核對」**，**並把後者寫進欄位語義**，**還說明**為什麼**（**建置環境連不上那兩個官網**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 但本次實測到一處不一致：同一份檔案裡的預設值與上面那段聲明相反**——**`AllowedCitation` 資料類別逐字為** `verified_on: str | None = "2026-09-10"`、`needs_human_verification: bool = False`；**而本次對整份檔案做正則統計的結果是**：`verified_on` **只出現在文件字串、該欄位定義與兩個函式體裡**，**沒有一條 `_ENTRIES` 條目顯式傳它**。**⭐ 因此按本次所讀程式碼推斷**：38 條**全部**取預設值，**`allowlist_needs_human_verification()` 會回傳 False、`unverified_entries()` 會回傳空表**，**而 `DEPLOYMENT.md` 逐字承諾**「**Until then every letter carries the flag `ALLOWLIST_NEEDS_HUMAN_VERIFICATION` (visible in the UI as "reference list pending review").**」**——**即**那個「待人工複核」狀態**在當下不可達**。**⭐ 本詞條不推測作者用意**，**只把三樣東西並排放出來**。**⭐ 另一處可核查的結構事實**：守衛測試斷言「**若 `verified_on is None` 則必須 `needs_human_verification is True`；否則該日期必須**不晚於今天**」——**預設值是一個具體日期，所以這條守衛今天會通過**；**而它在 2026-09-10 之前的機器時鐘上會失敗**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 守衛測試把允許清單接到三處**——`backend/tests/test_citation_allowlist_sync.py`（**實測 4,888 位元組**）**文件頭逐字列出四條守則**，**最值得抄的是第三條**：**「**Every statute literal asserted by the deterministic engines / prompts normalizes into the allowlist — code cannot instruct the LLM to cite something we cannot verify.**」**。**本次實測的五條測試**：**① 清單至少 20 條且鍵等於 canonical**；**② 每條必須 https 來源、非空 display、非空 origin**（**逐字註解**「**origin must say where in the codebase this is asserted**」**），**再按日期規則檢查核實狀態**；**③ display 歸一化必須等於 canonical、每個別名必須能解析**；**④ `test_code_asserted_statutes_are_in_allowlist`**——**帶一份 18 條逐字法規清單**，**每條上方逐字註明由哪段程式碼斷言**，**逐條斷言它們都能歸一化進允許清單**；**⑤ `test_regulatory_router_framework_details_all_verifiable`**——**遍歷 `AppealFramework` 列舉的每一個成員**，**對 `governing_law` 與 `regulation` 兩段實際執行時文字跑正則**；**⑥ `test_knowledge_base_statutes_are_in_allowlist`**——**掃描 `knowledge_base/` 下每一個 markdown 裡的法規引用**，**目錄不存在時 `pytest.skip` 並逐字給出理由**「**not shipped in the production container**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑥ 清單的每一條都帶一張反向依賴圖**——`AllowedCitation` 欄位逐字為 `canonical`／`display`／`source_url`／`origin`／`aliases`／`kb_concept_ids`／`verified_on`／`needs_human_verification`／`note`，**`origin` 的註解逐字為**「**where in the codebase this is asserted**」。**⭐ 即**這張表的每一行**同時回答兩個問題**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑦ 鍵是三套編號體系的歸一化器**——**逐字映射**：`29 CFR § 2560.503-1` → `29cfr2560.503-1`；`29 U.S.C. § 1132` → `29usc1132`；`ACA Section 2719` → `phsa2719`（**括註逐字** `ACA §§27xx are PHSA §§27xx`**）**；`DOL Technical Release 2010-01` → `doltr2010-01`。**⚠️ 而判例被明確排除**，**逐字為**：**「**Case law (e.g. Estate of Lokken v. UnitedHealth Group) is deliberately NOT in this list: no primary-source URL could be confirmed from this environment, so the verifier will flag case names for human review.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 質控節點之外還有三件**（**均 README 逐字**）：**Extraction Quality Gate**（**哨兵值、去哪找清單、括號佔位符、`QUALITY_GATE_MODE=block` 拒絕草擬**）；**Transparent Success Score + Outcome Calibration**（**逐字**「**a factor-by-factor case-strength estimate shown alongside the model’s own guess**」**，**並以 `/api/outcomes` 與 `GET /api/outcomes/calibration` 對真實推翻率校準**）；**LLM-free regression suite**（**逐字**「**all 200 benchmark cases plus 12 hand-written quality-gate cases in CI, with no model or database access**」）。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 無 LLM 回歸套件的檔案頭自己寫明「它不斷言什麼」**——**逐字**：**「**Runs only the deterministic engines exactly as the pipeline wires them**」**，**並列出呼叫鏈** `build_claim_from_overrides → calculate_cost → route_to_appeal_framework → calculate_appeal_deadline → deterministic_triage → evaluate_quality_gate → compute_success_score`；**逐字**「**No Supabase, no model calls, so it is safe for CI and finishes in seconds.**」**；**最值得抄的一句**：**「**It guards the ground truth the 200 synthetic cases encode (NSA detection, CARC routing, correct-denial handling) and the new Accuracy Core engines against regressions. It does NOT assert anything the LLM decides (contradiction analysis, letter text).**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ CI 用四個假憑證把整套測試跑起來**——`.github/workflows/ci.yml`（**實測 2,521 位元組**，**倉庫裡唯一的工作流**）三個 job：**`backend-test`**（Python 3.12；**flake8 跑兩遍**，**第一遍只查致命類** `--select=E9,F63,F7,F82`，**第二遍** `--exit-zero` **不阻斷**；**再在四個假環境變數下跑** `pytest tests/`，**逐字為** `SUPABASE_URL: "https://mock.supabase.co"`、`SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY: "mock_key"`、`SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: "mock_key"`、`GEMINI_API_KEY: "mock_key"`**）**；**`frontend-build`**（Node 20、`npm ci`、`npm run build`）；**`deploy-backend`**（`needs: backend-test`，**僅在 push 到 main 時運行**）。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 部署用無長期金鑰的聯邦身份**——**聲明** `id-token: write`（**逐字註解** `# Required for Workload Identity Federation`**）**，**經** `google-github-actions/auth@v2` **登入**，**再以** `deploy-cloudrun@v2` **部署**（`service: policycrab-backend`、`region: us-east1`、`source: ‘./backend’`）；**⭐ 即**倉庫裡沒有長期 GCP 金鑰**。**⚠️ 同一次命令逐字帶** `flags: ‘--allow-unauthenticated’`**——本詞條如實記錄**。**⭐⭐ ⑫ 安全聲明分開寫、分層寫**（`SECURITY.md` 實測 2,975 位元組）：**PHI／PII 在離開伺服器前先本地清洗**（**Regex 與 Microsoft Presidio**）；**逐字**「**API calls to primary LLM providers (Google Gemini) are configured as zero-retention (API data is not used for model training).**」**；RLS 只允許使用者讀寫自己的資料、管理端點要求 JWT 帶 `admin` 角色；**`CloudflareMiddleware` 逐字限定**「**When enabled**」**；**EASF 五件**（**`prompt_shields.py`／`policy_engine.py`／`ai_gateway.py`／`REQUIRE_APPROVAL`／`audit_logger.py`**），**其中逐字值得記兩條**：**「**AI Agents cannot execute tools or sensitive actions directly. They must format a `ProposedAction` and request permission. The Policy Engine evaluates this deterministically.**」**與**「**High-risk actions, such as generating/submitting legal appeals, trigger a deterministic halt, moving the action to a human approval queue.**」**。**⚠️ 本次逐字所見一處格式事實**：速率限制那一行在 markdown 裡是一個**已勾選的複選框**（`- [x] Rate Limiting:`**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑬ 可選功能預設關閉是被寫清的**——`ORGS_ENABLED=false`（**逐字**「**With it off, the frontend hides every team control and the backend ignores the `X-Org-Id` header, so single-user behaviour is unchanged.**」**）**；**遷移 009 逐字**「**Inert until `ORGS_ENABLED=true`, so it is safe to apply at any time; existing rows are untouched.**」**；**遷移 008 逐字**「**Apply before deploying a backend that includes the Accuracy Core; the table holds no PHI and is deliberately excluded from the 30-day purge.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑭ 「刪」與「不刪」都寫明理由**——`pg_cron` **在 30 天後刪除原始 EOB 提取物**；**而上訴結果表逐字被排除**，**理由是**「**the table holds no PHI**」。**⭐⭐ ⑮ 環境變數表把「安全的生产預設值」寫在括號裡**——**逐字**「**Accuracy Core (optional — defaults shown are the safe production values)**」**，**並逐條給出** `CITATION_UNVERIFIED_POLICY=annotate`（**逐字**「**annotate inserts a visible `[VERIFY: ...]` marker (original letter preserved), `strip` removes them, `off` reports only**」**）**、`CITATION_POLICY_FUZZY_THRESHOLD=0.85`、`QUALITY_GATE_MODE=warn`。**⚠️ 本次另實測到兩處文件與倉庫不一致**：**①** 文件字串給的路徑 `scripts/build_citation_allowlist.py` **在倉庫根 404**，**真實路徑是** `backend/scripts/build_citation_allowlist.py`（**200**），**`DEPLOYMENT.md` 寫對了**（**逐字**「**from `backend/`**」**）**；**②** README 結構塊把 `.env.example` 列在根目錄，**而清單裡只有** `backend/.env.example`。**⭐ 本詞條只記錄這兩個實測結果，不推測原因**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[health-denial-appeals]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[insurance-qa-evidence]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「一份可核查的引用清單 ＋ 一個無 LLM 質控節點」這套做法的最小完整樣本**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行它的任何一步**，**故不主張任何功能按所述工作，也不主張任何準確率、覆蓋率或合規聲明成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何 Python 業務原始碼**——**本次只讀了** README、`SECURITY.md`、`ci.yml`、`citation_allowlist.py`**（文件字串、資料類別與函式定義，並對其餘部分做正則統計）**、`test_citation_allowlist_sync.py`**（全文）**、`test_benchmark_deterministic.py`**（檔案頭）**、`DEPLOYMENT.md`**（前半）** **與一份完整清單**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**：**這是一套面向美國醫療帳單與監管申訴的工具**，**其法律與監管準確性本詞條完全沒有核實**。**③ ⚠️ 關於 ④ 那一處預設值**：**這是本詞條對程式碼的讀解，不是執行結果**——**未運行任何函式或測試，也未讀完整個倉庫**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實「200 條基準用例」與「12 條手寫質控用例」的實際條數**；**未核實** `knowledge_base/` 七個檔案的內容。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實** `--allow-unauthenticated` **部署的當前實際狀態**（**未發出任何請求**）；**未核實** Cloudflare 是否啟用；**未核實** Presidio **是否真的在本地運行**；**未核實** `pg_cron` 在生產是否啟用。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**提示盾與策略引擎是否真的攔得住任何東西。**⑦ ⚠️ ★1，未記錄 fork 數；未核實生產使用範圍與作者背景。**⑧ ⚠️ 許可欄位為 Apache-2.0，本次實測 `LICENSE` 正文前五行，**未讀全文**。**⑨ ⚠️ 建立 2026-07-05 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-10 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「把法規引用接進允許清單、並用無 LLM 質控節點把不可核實內容標出來」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑪ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用時，把原文裡的 ASCII 撇號寫作 ’，以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（引文內容未改）**；**方括號標記 `VERIFY` 在 README 中以省略號字元結尾、在 DEPLOYMENT.md 中以三個句點結尾，本詞條按 DEPLOYMENT.md 的寫法引用**。
entries.body_en:
**PolicyCrab** (repository `sharma-sugurthi/policycrab`) **is an AI appeals engine for US healthcare bills**, describing itself verbatim as an AI platform built with production practices designed to help medical advocates, HR benefits managers and individual Americans navigate the complexities of US healthcare insurance: it ingests SBC and EOB documents, adjudicates overbilling and regulatory violations deterministically, and has autonomous agents draft regulatory appeal letters. **Measured**: **primarily Python**, **licence Apache-2.0** with the first five lines of `LICENSE` read this round, **1 star**, **11,901 KB**, **created 2026-07-05**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **default branch `main`**; **the README measures 7,916 bytes**. **The repository was enumerated this round through a `codeload.github.com` tarball**, because the core API quota was exhausted, **and measures 478 paths, being 448 files and 30 directories**: `backend/` 394, `frontend/` 55, `supabase/` 11, `knowledge_base/` 8 and `.github/` 3, with the root files `README.md`, `LICENSE`, `DEPLOYMENT.md`, `SECURITY.md` and `.gitignore`. **Countable groups include 35 test modules under `backend/tests/`, 13 modules under `backend/app/agents/`, 11 under `backend/app/engine/`, 8 under `backend/app/security/`, 8 scripts, 9 numbered SQL migrations and 7 knowledge-base markdown files.** This entry belongs to this round theme, **wiring something up until another system can use it**; **this entry considers it the most rigorous of the round four, because it attaches a plain-language requirement, never fabricate citations, to a test that can fail**.

**Verified information, all measured from the README, `SECURITY.md`, `DEPLOYMENT.md`, `ci.yml`, the citation allowlist module, the citation sync test, the deterministic benchmark header and the file listing**: **first, top: every letter passes through a no-LLM quality node before a user sees it**, verbatim as the Accuracy Core description stating that every drafted letter passes through a no-LLM QA node before it reaches the user. **That is not a claim of using AI but a statement of where AI is not trusted.** **Second, top: citation checking has two independent bases and unverifiable content is marked rather than silently passed**, verbatim: each statute the letter cites is checked against a sourced allowlist under `app/engine/citation_allowlist.py` and the knowledge chunks the model was actually shown, and each quoted policy clause is matched against the retrieved policy pages with page-drift detection; then, verbatim, anything unverifiable is marked in the letter and never silently trusted, the marker being a bracketed `VERIFY:` followed by an ellipsis. **So what the system permits you to cite and what it actually showed you are two separate checks, quoted clauses get page-drift detection, and unverifiable material is annotated rather than deleted.** **Third, top: the allowlist module docstring is itself a declaration of what is not known** — verbatim, that the allowlist is the set of statutes, regulations and guidance documents the appeal letters are permitted to cite as verified; that the model is told never to fabricate citations but an instruction is not a guarantee, so the module is the deterministic ground truth the citation verifier checks against; that a missing verification date means not yet human-verified; that the build environment the module was authored in could not reach ecfr.gov or uscode.house.gov, so every entry ships unverified; and that a maintainer must run the checklist script, open each URL and fill the date in. **This entry considers that passage the most copyable text of the round, because it distinguishes what has been checked from what could not be checked, gives the latter a place in the field semantics, and states why.** **Fourth, top, and measured this round as an inconsistency against that same passage**: the `AllowedCitation` dataclass in that very file defaults the verification date to a concrete date, `2026-09-10`, and the human-verification flag to false, while a regex count over the whole file finds `verified_on` only in the docstring, that field declaration and two function bodies, with **no `_ENTRIES` entry passing either field explicitly**. **So on the code as read, all 38 entries take the defaults, `allowlist_needs_human_verification()` returns false and `unverified_entries()` returns an empty list, which makes the pending-review flag that `DEPLOYMENT.md` promises — carried by every letter until a maintainer fills the dates in, and shown in the UI as a reference list pending review — unreachable at present.** **This entry does not speculate about intent; it places three measured things side by side: the docstring statement, the dataclass default, and the fact that none of the 38 entries sets it.** **A further structural fact is checkable: the guard asserts that if the date is absent then the flag must be true, and otherwise that the date parses and is not in the future, so with a hard-coded default the guard passes today and would fail on any machine whose clock is earlier than that date, meaning its outcome depends on the wall clock rather than on anyone having opened the source pages.** **Fifth, top: the guard tests attach the allowlist in three places rather than only checking itself** — the sync test header lists four rules verbatim, the most copyable being that every statute literal asserted by the deterministic engines or prompts must normalize into the allowlist, because code cannot instruct the LLM to cite something we cannot verify. **The measured tests are**: that the allowlist is non-empty with keys matching their own canonical values; that every entry has an https source, a non-empty display string and a non-empty origin, with the verbatim comment that origin must say where in the codebase this is asserted, followed by the date rule; that every display normalizes to its canonical key and every alias resolves; that a list of 18 verbatim statutes, each annotated with the module that asserts it, all normalize into the allowlist; that every member of the `AppealFramework` enum has its runtime governing-law and regulation text scanned for statute references that must all be in the allowlist; and that every statute reference in every knowledge-base markdown file is in the allowlist, with the test skipping and stating verbatim that the directory is not shipped in the production container when it is absent. **So the allowlist is wired to a static list, to a live enum and to the retrieval corpus at once.** **Sixth, top: every entry carries a reverse dependency map** — the dataclass fields are canonical, display, source URL, origin, aliases, knowledge-base concept ids, verification date, the human-verification flag and a note, where the origin comment says verbatim that it records where in the codebase this is asserted, and measured values name modules such as the regulatory router, the grievance precedents, the deadline calculator, the carrier intelligence module, a knowledge-base chapter and the appeal route level configurations. **Each row therefore answers both what may be cited and who cites it.** **Seventh, top: the keys normalize three different numbering systems** — verbatim mappings from a CFR section to a compact key, from a U.S.C. section to another, from an ACA section to its PHSA equivalent, with the parenthetical note that ACA sections 27xx are PHSA sections 27xx, and from a DOL technical release to its own key. **And case law is deliberately excluded**, verbatim, because no primary-source URL could be confirmed from the build environment, so case names are flagged for human review instead: what could not be confirmed is kept out of the allowlist but is not allowed to pass silently either. **Eighth: beyond that node there are three more controls with countable or checkable statements**, all verbatim from the README: an extraction quality gate that detects the sentinel values substituted when facts are missing, returns a where-to-find-it checklist, tells the drafting prompt to use bracketed placeholders instead of guessing, and can refuse to draft at all on critical gaps; a transparent success score with outcome calibration that shows a factor-by-factor case-strength estimate alongside the model own guess and records what actually happened so the score can be calibrated against real overturn rates; and an LLM-free regression suite that runs the deterministic engines over 200 benchmark cases plus 12 hand-written quality-gate cases in CI with no model or database access. **Ninth: the header of that suite states what it does not assert** — measured verbatim, that it runs only the deterministic engines exactly as the pipeline wires them, listing the call chain from claim construction through cost calculation, appeal-framework routing, deadline calculation, deterministic triage and the quality gate to the success score; that with no database and no model calls it is safe for CI and finishes in seconds; and the most copyable sentence of all, that it guards the ground truth the 200 synthetic cases encode against regressions and **does not assert anything the LLM decides**, naming contradiction analysis and letter text. **What was tested and what was not are written at the top of the same file.** **Tenth: CI runs the whole suite against four mock credentials** — the only workflow in the repository has three jobs. The backend job installs Python 3.12 and both requirement files, runs flake8 twice, first with a fatal-only selection and then non-blockingly with a complexity cap and a line-length cap, and then runs the whole test directory with a mock Supabase URL and three mock keys for Supabase and Gemini in the environment. **No model and no database is therefore not a slogan but four fake values in CI.** **Eleventh: deployment uses federated identity instead of a long-lived key** — the deploy job needs the backend job, runs only on pushes to main, declares read access to contents and write access to the identity token, as the verbatim comment says, required for workload identity federation, authenticates through the Google auth action with a workload identity provider and service account named in the workflow, and deploys with the Cloud Run action to a named service in a named region from the backend directory. **⚠️ The same command carries a flag allowing unauthenticated access, recorded here as measured**: the service is deployed as publicly invocable, which belongs alongside the Cloudflare and rate-limiting section of the security document; **no security judgement is offered**. **Twelfth: the security statements are separated and layered** — the security document measures 2,975 bytes and states verbatim that the backend uses local regular expressions and Microsoft Presidio to scrub protected health information and personally identifiable information from user documents before any data is sent to external model providers, that calls to the primary model provider are configured as zero-retention, that row level security restricts users to their own rows and administrative endpoints require an admin role in the token, and that a middleware optionally blocks requests not originating from verified Cloudflare address blocks to prevent direct-to-origin bypass. **The enterprise AI security framework is five named pieces**: prompt-injection shields using compiled regular expressions on both input and retrieved context, a deterministic policy engine that requires agents to submit a proposed action and request permission rather than act directly, a gateway running the shields on input and the policy engine on output, a human approval queue that deterministic halts route high-risk actions such as generating or submitting legal appeals into, and persistent structured audit logging of every proposed action and resulting decision, optimised for ingestion by security information systems. **One formatting fact is recorded exactly as seen: the rate-limiting line in that markdown file is a ticked checkbox, and no meaning is inferred from that.** **Thirteenth: optional features are documented as off by default rather than left vague** — the team workspace flag defaults to false, verbatim, with the frontend hiding every team control and the backend ignoring the team header so single-user behaviour is unchanged; migration 009 is inert until the flag is true and therefore safe to apply at any time with existing rows untouched; and migration 008 must be applied before deploying a backend that includes the accuracy core, since its table holds no protected health information and is deliberately excluded from the purge. **Three different orderings, can apply at any time, must apply before deploying, and takes effect only once the flag is on, are written apart.** **Fourteenth: both deleting and not deleting carry a stated reason** — a scheduled database job automatically deletes raw sensitive EOB extractions after thirty days, while the appeal outcome table is deliberately excluded from that purge, verbatim, because the table holds no protected health information. **Fifteenth: the environment table states which defaults are the safe production values** — verbatim, that the accuracy-core variables are optional and the defaults shown are the safe production values, then listing the policy for unverifiable citations, where annotate inserts a visible bracketed verify marker with the original letter preserved while strip removes them and off only reports, a fuzzy-match threshold for quoted clauses, the quality gate mode, the team workspace flag and an invitation lifetime. **⚠️ Two further mismatches between documentation and repository were measured this round**: the allowlist docstring tells a maintainer to run the checklist script without saying from which directory, and that path returns 404 from the repository root, the real path being under `backend/scripts/`, which the deployment guide gets right by saying to run it from `backend/`; and the README repository-structure block lists an environment example file at the root, while the listing contains only the one under `backend/`, so the getting-started instruction to copy that root file cannot be followed as written. **Both results are recorded without speculation about cause.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[health-denial-appeals]], [[evidence-review-claims]] and [[insurance-qa-evidence]]**, because **it is the smallest complete sample of the pattern: a checkable citation list plus a no-LLM quality node**, with per-entry sources, a reverse code dependency map, guard tests in three places and explicit marking of what cannot be verified; its allowlist-and-normalisation approach sits next to the evidentiary thinking in [[claims-integrity-investigator]] and [[claim-to-confidence]], while pinning the deterministic part with a fixed benchmark set is comparable in spirit to the evaluation stance of [[reliability-harness]] and [[ragas]]; as for prompt-injection red-teaming of the kind [[garak]] addresses, this entry records only the boundary this project calls Agentic Zero Trust, **and no comparison test was run here**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no part of it was run** — no dependencies installed, no backend or frontend started, no Supabase connection, no model call, no test run and none of its pages opened — **so no function is claimed to work as described, and no accuracy, coverage or compliance statement is claimed to hold**. **Second, no Python business logic was read**: this round read only the README, the security document, the CI workflow, the citation allowlist module (its docstring, dataclass and function definitions, with a regex pass over the rest), the citation sync test in full, the header of the deterministic benchmark file, the first half of the deployment guide and a complete file listing, **so nothing is claimed about the correctness of cost calculation, deadline calculation, appeal routing, the quality gate, the success score or the letter text. This is the item most in need of later verification: this is a tool for US medical billing and regulatory appeals, and its legal and regulatory accuracy was not examined at all — no legal conclusion should be taken from this entry, and it should not be treated as a substitute for professional advice; only its engineering practice and its way of marking uncertainty are recorded.** **Third, the default-value finding is a reading of the code rather than a run result**: no function or test was executed and the repository was not read in full, so if some entry sets that field in a form the regex pass did not cover, the reading does not hold. **Fourth, the claimed counts of 200 benchmark cases and 12 hand-written quality-gate cases were not verified**, only the header comment was read, and the contents of the seven knowledge-base files were not checked. **Fifth, the current state of the unauthenticated deployment flag was not verified** — the service was not visited, its URL was not confirmed and no request was sent — nor was whether Cloudflare is enabled, since the security document says when enabled, nor whether Presidio really runs locally, nor whether the scheduled purge job is enabled in production. **Sixth, whether the prompt shields and policy engine actually block anything was not verified**; their implementations were not read and no injection test was run. **Seventh, one star, with the fork count not recorded, production reach, user numbers and whether any real users exist were not verified, nor was the background of the authors. Eighth, the licence field is Apache-2.0 and the first five lines of the licence file were read, but not the whole text. Ninth, the creation date of 2026-07-05 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-10 is inside it, and the named gap is that the pattern of wiring statutory citations into an allowlist and marking unverifiable material through a no-LLM quality node had no counterpart in the pool**, even though `[[health-denial-appeals]]`, `[[claims-integrity-investigator]]`, `[[insurance-qa-evidence]]` and `[[evidence-review-claims]]` cover neighbouring ground. **Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.** **Eleventh, quotation convention: ASCII apostrophes in the original English were rendered as curved apostrophes to keep this entry free of ASCII single quotes, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged, and the bracketed verify marker is quoted in the three-period form used by the deployment guide rather than the ellipsis-character form used by the README.**

entries.title: **把「分布拟合」这件事收成一个界面**：R 包 **FitVerse**（CRAN 1.0-2，2026-09-06 发布）——**52 个分布族 × 三种估计方法**（MLE／矩法／**L-矩**），**AIC／BIC 与三种拟合优度检验自动选优**；**⭐ 每个方法都带一条文献出处（DOI／ISBN）**；**⭐ 而它在 GitHub 上只有一个**只读 CRAN 镜像仓库**，**连 README 都没有**——**登记在 CRAN，文档在 DESCRIPTION**
entries.title_en: Collecting distribution fitting into one interface: the R package FitVerse, released on CRAN as 1.0-2 on 2026-09-06, covering 52 distribution families across three estimation methods including L-moments, with automatic best-fit selection by AIC, BIC and three goodness-of-fit tests, attributing every method to a cited source with a DOI or ISBN, while its only GitHub presence is a read-only CRAN mirror repository that carries no README at all, so its documentation lives in the DESCRIPTION and on CRAN rather than in a repository.

entries.summary: **FitVerse**（CRAN 包，`FitVerse` 1.0-2）**是 2026-09-06 发布的一个 R 分布拟合包**：**逐字自述支持**「**52 distribution families spanning symmetric, right-skewed, heavy-tailed, bounded, and extreme-value shapes**」**与三种估计方法**「**Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Method of Moments (MOM), and L-Moments (L-MOM)**」**；**自动选优用** AIC、BIC **与三种拟合优度检验**（Kolmogorov-Smirnov、Anderson-Darling、Cramer-von Mises）；**并逐字自述服务对象包括**「**survey sampling, hydrology, and actuarial workflows**」。**本条目属于本轮主题**「登记与出处」**，**它同时是两端的好样本**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 出处**——**每一个方法都带一条可核查的文献**（**L-矩** Hosking 1990 **附 DOI**、**Hosking and Wallis 1997 附 ISBN**；**AIC** Akaike 1974 **附 DOI**；**BIC** Schwarz 1978 **附 DOI**；**bootstrap 区间** Efron and Hastie 2016 **附 ISBN**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 登记**——**它在 GitHub 上只有一个**只读 CRAN 镜像仓库 `cran/FitVerse`**（**实测 2026-09-06／07 推送、2026-09-01 创建、★0、无 README**），**真正的文档是** DESCRIPTION **与 CRAN 页**——**⭐ 即**一个包**完全可以只登记在 CRAN**，**而**不拥有一个开发仓库**。**⭐⭐ ③ 它接在池内已有的四个包上**：`Imports` **实测含** `actuar`（≥3.1.0）、`fitdistrplus`（≥1.1.0）、`lmomco`（≥2.3.7）、`evd`（≥2.3.3），**而** [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] **本站已有条目**。**⚠️ 本次未安装 R、未运行该包、未读其参考手册**，**故不主张**任何拟合结果、选优结论或数值精度。
entries.summary_hk: **FitVerse**（CRAN 套件，`FitVerse` 1.0-2）**是 2026-09-06 發布的一個 R 分布擬合套件**：**逐字自述支援**「**52 distribution families spanning symmetric, right-skewed, heavy-tailed, bounded, and extreme-value shapes**」**與三種估計方法**「**Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Method of Moments (MOM), and L-Moments (L-MOM)**」**；**自動選優用** AIC、BIC **與三種擬合優度檢定**（Kolmogorov-Smirnov、Anderson-Darling、Cramer-von Mises）；**並逐字自述服務對象包括**「**survey sampling, hydrology, and actuarial workflows**」。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「登記與出處」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 出處**——**每一個方法都帶一條可核查的文獻**（**L-矩** Hosking 1990 **附 DOI**、**Hosking and Wallis 1997 附 ISBN**；**AIC** Akaike 1974 **附 DOI**；**BIC** Schwarz 1978 **附 DOI**；**bootstrap 區間** Efron and Hastie 2016 **附 ISBN**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 登記**——**它在 GitHub 上只有一個**唯讀 CRAN 鏡像倉庫 `cran/FitVerse`**（**實測 2026-09-06／07 推送、2026-09-01 建立、★0、無 README**），**真正的文件是** DESCRIPTION **與 CRAN 頁**——**⭐ 即**一個套件**完全可以只登記在 CRAN**，**而**不擁有一個開發倉庫**。**⭐⭐ ③ 它接在池內已有的多個套件上**：`Imports` **實測含** `actuar`（≥3.1.0）、`fitdistrplus`（≥1.1.0）、`lmomco`（≥2.3.7）、`evd`（≥2.3.3），**而** [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] **本站已有條目**。**⚠️ 本次未安裝 R、未運行該套件、未讀其參考手冊**，**故不主張**任何擬合結果、選優結論或數值精度。
entries.summary_en: **FitVerse**, a CRAN package at version 1.0-2, **is an R distribution-fitting package published on 2026-09-06**: verbatim, it **supports 52 distribution families spanning symmetric, right-skewed, heavy-tailed, bounded, and extreme-value shapes**, with three estimation methods, being maximum likelihood, method of moments and L-moments; automatic best-fit selection uses AIC and BIC together with three goodness-of-fit tests, namely Kolmogorov-Smirnov, Anderson-Darling and Cramer-von Mises; and its own description names survey sampling, hydrology **and actuarial workflows** as the settings it is designed to support. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance, and the package is a good sample of both ends**: every method is attributed to a checkable source, with a DOI for the Hosking L-moment paper, ISBNs for the Hosking and Wallis book and the Efron and Hastie book, and DOIs for the Akaike and Schwarz model-selection papers; **and on GitHub its only presence is a read-only CRAN mirror repository**, measured as pushed on 2026-09-06 or 2026-09-07, created 2026-09-01, with no stars and **no README**, so the real documentation is the DESCRIPTION file and the CRAN page, which shows that a package can be registered on CRAN without owning a development repository at all. **It also wires onto packages this wiki already carries**: its Imports field lists actuar, fitdistrplus, lmomco and evd, and `[[fitdistrplus]]`, `[[lmomco]]` and `[[evd]]` already have entries here. **R was not installed this round, the package was not run and its reference manual was not read, so no fitting result, selection outcome or numerical accuracy is claimed.**
entries.body:
**FitVerse**（CRAN 包，**版本 1.0-2**）**是一个把「给连续单变量数据拟合参数分布」收成一个界面的 R 包**，**逐字自述为**「**Provides a unified, user-friendly interface for fitting parametric probability distributions to continuous univariate data.**」**。**本次实测的 CRAN 记录**：**`Date/Publication: 2026-09-06 22:40:14 UTC`**、**`Packaged: 2026-09-06 10:55:39 UTC; karunareddy`**、**`License: GPL (>= 3)`**、**`Depends: R (>= 4.1.0)`**、**`NeedsCompilation: no`**、**`RoxygenNote: 7.3.2`**、**`VignetteBuilder: knitr`**；**维护者** `Karuna G. Reddy`（**附 ORCID `0000-0002-9467-4668`**，**单位邮箱为奥克兰大学**），**另一位作者** `M. G. M. Khan`。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记与出处：让别人查得到，也让每个数回得去**」**；**本词条认为它是本轮四条里把「出处」写得最规整的一条**，**也是把「登记」这件事暴露得最彻底的一条**。

**可核实信息（均 CRAN 页、DESCRIPTION 与 r-universe 实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 内容是可数的两组**——**逐字**「**52 distribution families spanning symmetric, right-skewed, heavy-tailed, bounded, and extreme-value shapes**」**与**「**three estimation methods: Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Method of Moments (MOM), and L-Moments (L-MOM)**」**；**自动选优逐字为**「**Automatic best-fit selection is performed using AIC, BIC, and goodness-of-fit tests (Kolmogorov-Smirnov, Anderson-Darling, Cramer-von Mises (CvM))**」**。**⭐ 即**一个拟合包该说清的三件事**（**候选分布有几族**、**参数怎么估**、**怎么判谁更好**）**都被写成了可数的条目**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 每一个方法都带一条文献出处**——**DESCRIPTION 里逐字**：**L-矩**「**L-moment estimation follows Hosking (1990) <doi:10.1111/j.2517-6161.1990.tb01775.x> and Hosking and Wallis (1997, ISBN:9780521430456)**」、**AIC**「**Model selection via AIC follows Akaike (1974) <doi:10.1109/TAC.1974.1100705>**」、**BIC**「**follows Schwarz (1978) <doi:10.1214/aos/1176344136>**」、**bootstrap 区间**「**follow Bootstrap confidence intervals follow Efron and Hastie (2016, ISBN:9781107149892)**」。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处写法**：**它没有说「我们用业界标准方法」，而是把每个方法接到一篇具体文献上**（**三条 DOI 加两条 ISBN**）——**⭐ 即**「你用这个方法，你可以去查它是谁提出的、原始定义是什么」**；**本词条在现场核对了这五条标识的形态**（**三条 DOI 前缀与两条 ISBN-13 长度均完整**），**⚠️ 但未打开任何一条链接、未核对文献内容与实现是否一致**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它明确点名了「精算」这一使用场景**——**逐字**：**「**FitVerse is designed to support data characterisation in survey sampling, hydrology, and actuarial workflows, where identifying the underlying distribution of a variable is a prerequisite for downstream modelling and inference.**」**。**⭐ 即**它把自己定位为**下游建模的前置步骤**（**先确定变量服从什么分布**），**而不是一个端到端的定价工具**——**这与本站 [[insurance-distributional]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-severity]] 一类条目所讨论的下游工作正好接得上**。**⭐⭐ ④ 产物是可核查的几样**——**逐字**：**每拟合一个模型都产出**「**a publication-quality diagnostic plot: a histogram overlaid with the fitted density curve and the estimated PDF formula annotated directly on the figure**」（**⭐ 即**图上直接标出估计出来的 PDF 公式**，**而不是只画一条曲线**）；**另有** `plotly` **交互版**、**参数估计与** return levels **的 bootstrap 置信区间**、**跨多列的批量拟合**（**逐字说明用于**「**automated workflows and web-upload use cases**」）、**JSON 序列化**（**逐字说明用于接** `Shiny`**）**、**以及自动生成 HTML／PDF 报告**。**⭐ 即**「**结果能不能交给别人**」**被当成一等功能**（**JSON、报告、图上公式三样都是交付物**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 它在 GitHub 上只有一个只读镜像，而且没有 README**——**本次实测**：GitHub 仓库 `cran/FitVerse`，**`pushed_at` 为 2026-09-07、`created_at` 为 2026-09-01、★0、语言 R、体量 1 KB**，**其描述逐字为**「**This is a read-only mirror of the CRAN R package repository**」一类的 CRAN 镜像说明；**`README.md` 探测返回 404**（**本次对 `master` 分支实测，文件不存在**）。**⭐ 因此本词条如实指出**：**这个包的文档只存在于** DESCRIPTION **与 CRAN 页**，**仓库里没有 README 可读**——**⭐ 而这正是本轮主题的另一端**：**一个包可以只**登记在 CRAN**，**而**不拥有开发仓库**；**它的「登记」就是它存在的全部形式**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 它在 r-universe 上也被登记了一次**——**本次实测** r-universe 的 `cran/FitVerse` 条目：**`RemoteUrl` 为** `https://github.com/cran/FitVerse`、**`RemoteSha` 为** `8611f2c6e3`、**版本 1.0-2**、**`_registered` 为** `true`、**最近一个月下载数 88**（**来源字段逐字指向** `cranlogs.r-pkg.org`**）**。**⭐ 即**同一个包**在四层登记处各有一份记录**（**CRAN 源包**、**GitHub 只读镜像**、**r-universe 构建条目**、**cranlogs 下载统计**），**而**这四份记录的字段并不完全相同**（**例如 `Date/Publication` 只在 CRAN 与 DESCRIPTION 里有，r-universe 用的是它自己的构建时间戳**）。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 它接在池内已有的包上**——`Imports` **逐字含** `actuar (>= 3.1.0)`、`mc2d (>= 0.1.18)`、`evd (>= 2.3.3)`、`sn (>= 2.1.0)`、`fitdistrplus (>= 1.1.0)`、`lmomco (>= 2.3.7)`、`ggplot2 (>= 3.4.0)`、`goftest (>= 1.2.3)`、`gridExtra (>= 2.3)`，**以及** `stats`、`graphics`、`grDevices`、`utils`、`tools`；**其中** [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] **本站已有条目**（**⭐ 即**本站已收录分布拟合这条线上游的三个包**，**本条补上的是把三者收在一个界面下的那一层**）；`Suggests` **逐字含** `shiny`、`bslib`、`DT`、`plotly`、`testthat`、`knitr`、`rmarkdown`、`kableExtra`、`jsonlite`、`base64enc`、`MASS`、`GeneralizedHyperbolic`、`truncnorm`。**⭐ ⑧ 与既有条目的对照**：**本站 [[actuarialmath]]、[[actuariat-python]]、[[loss-data-analytics]]、[[insurance-quantile]] 等条目覆盖相邻工作**，**而本条记录的是另一种取向**：**不重写估计与检验，而是把已有的多个上游包（`actuar`／`evd`／`fitdistrplus`／`lmomco`／`goftest`）编排成一个统一界面并补上交付物（图、报告、JSON）**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「分布拟合这条线在 2026 年 9 月又多了一层封装」的位置说明**；**对损失分布拟合、极值建模与 tail 研究**，**它提供的是一个可数的入口（52 族／3 种估计／3 种检验）**，**而它自己点名的使用场景里也包含 actuarial workflows**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装 R、没有安装该包、没有运行任何一次拟合**（**未 `install.packages`、未调用任何函数、未生成任何图或报告**），**故不主张**任何拟合结果、参数估计、选优结论、bootstrap 区间或报告输出**按所述工作**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读其参考手册与 vignette**——**本次只读了** CRAN 页正文、`DESCRIPTION` 全文（**经 `cran/FitVerse` 镜像的 `master` 分支取得**）**与 r-universe 的条目字段**，**故不主张**「52 个分布族」的实际覆盖范围、三种估计方法的具体实现、检验的临界值来源与批量模式的接口。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 五条文献标识本次只核对了形态**（**DOI 前缀与 ISBN-13 长度**），**未打开链接、未核对文献内容与该包实现是否一致**——**「它引用了 Hosking 1990」是本条的实测事实**，**「它按 Hosking 1990 实现了 L-矩」不是**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实其数值正确性**：**未与任何独立实现对照**（**例如 [[lmomco]] 或 [[evd]] 的同一族拟合结果**）；**未核实 AIC／BIC 与三种检验的实现是否有误**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** `cran/FitVerse` **是否真是「只读镜像」以及镜像的同步机制**（**本次只读到其描述与文件清单**）；**未核实该包是否有本站尚未发现的开发仓库**（**本次用 GitHub 搜索 `FitVerse` 只命中若干同名 JS 项目**）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实 CRAN 上的检查结果**（**未查它的 CRAN check 页**）、**未核实是否有 vignette 与 News**。**⑦ ⚠️ 作者背景只读到 `DESCRIPTION` 里的姓名、邮箱与一个 ORCID**，**未核实**其机构、其他工作或该包的使用范围；**★0 与镜像仓库的星数不构成质量证据**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建日期 2026-09-01 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-06／07 与 CRAN 发布日期 2026-09-06 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「只登记在 CRAN、没有开发仓库的包」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**（**池内 [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] 均以 CRAN 页为来源，但它们各自都有 GitHub 仓库**）。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。

<doi:10.1111/j.2517-6161.1990.tb01775.x> and Hosking and Wallis (1997, ISBN:9780521430456)**」、**AIC**「**follows Akaike (1974) <doi:10.1109/TAC.1974.1100705>**」、**BIC**「**follows Schwarz (1978) <doi:10.1214/aos/1176344136>**」、**bootstrap 區間**「**follow Efron and Hastie (2016, ISBN:9781107149892)**」。**⭐ 即**它沒有說「我們用業界標準方法」，**而是把每個方法接到一篇具體文獻上**（**三條 DOI ＋ 兩條 ISBN**）；**⚠️ 本次只核對了形態（DOI 前綴與 ISBN-13 長度），未打開鏈接、未核對文獻內容與實作是否一致**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它明確點名了「精算」這一使用場景**——**逐字**：**「**designed to support data characterisation in survey sampling, hydrology, and actuarial workflows, where identifying the underlying distribution of a variable is a prerequisite for downstream modelling and inference**」**——**⭐ 即**它把自己定位為**下游建模的前置步驟**。**⭐⭐ ④ 產物是可核查的幾樣**：**逐字**「**a publication-quality diagnostic plot: a histogram overlaid with the fitted density curve and the estimated PDF formula annotated directly on the figure**」（**⭐ 圖上直接標出估計出來的 PDF 公式**）；**另有** `plotly` **互動版**、**參數與** return levels **的 bootstrap 信賴區間**、**跨多列批量擬合**、**JSON 序列化**（**逐字說明用於接** `Shiny`**）**、**自動 HTML／PDF 報告**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 它在 GitHub 上只有一個唯讀鏡像，而且沒有 README**——**本次實測**：`cran/FitVerse`，**推送 2026-09-07、建立 2026-09-01、★0、語言 R、體量 1 KB**，**`README.md` 探測 404**。**⭐ 即**這個套件的文件**只存在於** DESCRIPTION **與 CRAN 頁**；**一個套件可以只**登記在 CRAN**，**而**不擁有開發倉庫**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 它在 r-universe 上也被登記了一次**——**`RemoteSha` 為** `8611f2c6e3`、**`_registered` 為** `true`、**最近一個月下載數 88**（**來源逐字指向** `cranlogs.r-pkg.org`**）**；**⭐ 即**同一個套件**在四層登記處各有一份記錄**，**而**四份記錄的欄位並不完全相同**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 它接在池內已有的套件上**——`Imports` **逐字含** `actuar (>= 3.1.0)`、`mc2d (>= 0.1.18)`、`evd (>= 2.3.3)`、`sn (>= 2.1.0)`、`fitdistrplus (>= 1.1.0)`、`lmomco (>= 2.3.7)`、`ggplot2 (>= 3.4.0)`、`goftest (>= 1.2.3)`、`gridExtra (>= 2.3)`；**其中** [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] **本站已有條目**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[fitdistrplus]]、[[lmomco]]、[[evd]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「分布擬合這條線在 2026 年 9 月又多了一層封裝」的位置說明**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝 R、沒有安裝該套件、沒有運行任何一次擬合**，**故不主張**任何擬合結果、參數估計、選優結論、bootstrap 區間或報告輸出**按所述工作**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀其參考手冊與 vignette**——**本次只讀了** CRAN 頁正文、`DESCRIPTION` 全文**與 r-universe 條目欄位**，**故不主張**「52 個分布族」的實際覆蓋、三種估計方法的實作、檢定臨界值來源與批量模式介面。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 五條文獻標識本次只核對了形態**，**未打開鏈接、未核對內容與實作是否一致**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實其數值正確性**：**未與任何獨立實作對照**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實** `cran/FitVerse` **是否真是「唯讀鏡像」與其同步機制**；**未核實**是否有本站尚未發現的開發倉庫。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實 CRAN 檢查結果、vignette 與 News**。**⑦ ⚠️ 作者背景只讀到 `DESCRIPTION` 裡的姓名、郵箱與一個 ORCID**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2026-09-01 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-06／07 與 CRAN 發布日期 2026-09-06 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「只登記在 CRAN、沒有開發倉庫的套件」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。
entries.body_en:
**FitVerse**, a CRAN package at **version 1.0-2**, **is an R package that collects fitting parametric distributions to continuous univariate data into a single interface**, stating verbatim that it provides a unified, user-friendly interface for fitting parametric probability distributions to continuous univariate data. **The CRAN record measured this round** gives `Date/Publication: 2026-09-06 22:40:14 UTC`, `Packaged: 2026-09-06 10:55:39 UTC; karunareddy`, `License: GPL (>= 3)`, `Depends: R (>= 4.1.0)`, `NeedsCompilation: no`, `RoxygenNote: 7.3.2` and `VignetteBuilder: knitr`, with the maintainer carrying an ORCID. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance: making something findable, and making every number traceable back.**

**Verified information, all measured from the CRAN page, the DESCRIPTION file and the r-universe record**: **first, the content is two countable groups**, verbatim, 52 distribution families spanning symmetric, right-skewed, heavy-tailed, bounded and extreme-value shapes, and three estimation methods, maximum likelihood, method of moments and L-moments, with automatic best-fit selection performed using AIC, BIC and Kolmogorov-Smirnov, Anderson-Darling and Cramer-von Mises tests. **The three things a fitting package should state, how many candidate families, how parameters are estimated, and how the winner is chosen, are all written as countable items.** **Second, every method is attributed to a source**: L-moment estimation follows Hosking (1990) with a DOI, and Hosking and Wallis (1997) with an ISBN; model selection via AIC follows Akaike (1974) with a DOI; via BIC follows Schwarz (1978) with a DOI; and bootstrap confidence intervals follow Efron and Hastie (2016) with an ISBN. **It does not claim to use industry-standard methods; it wires each method to a specific paper, three DOIs and two ISBNs.** **This round only the form of those five identifiers was checked, their prefixes and lengths, not the linked papers and not whether the implementation matches them.** **Third, it names actuarial work explicitly**, verbatim, as designed to support data characterisation in survey sampling, hydrology and actuarial workflows, where identifying the underlying distribution of a variable is a prerequisite for downstream modelling and inference, **which places it as a step before downstream modelling rather than an end-to-end pricing tool**. **Fourth, the outputs are checkable**: verbatim, every fitted model produces a publication-quality diagnostic plot, a histogram overlaid with the fitted density curve and the estimated PDF formula annotated directly on the figure, **so the estimated formula is printed on the chart rather than only drawn**, plus an optional interactive version through plotly, bootstrap confidence intervals for parameter estimates and return levels, batch fitting across columns for automated workflows and web-upload use cases, JSON serialisation for integration with Shiny, and automated HTML and PDF report generation; **whether the result can be handed to someone else is treated as a first-class feature**. **Fifth, its only GitHub presence is a read-only mirror and it has no README**: the measured repository is pushed on 2026-09-07, created on 2026-09-01, with zero stars, one kilobyte and a description identifying it as a read-only mirror of the CRAN package repository, and a probe for a README returns 404 on the default branch. **So its documentation exists only in the DESCRIPTION and on the CRAN page, which is the other end of this round theme: a package can be registered on CRAN without owning a development repository, and that registration is the entirety of its existence.** **Sixth, it is registered once more on r-universe**, where the measured record pins a commit SHA, reports the package as registered and reports 88 downloads in the last month from cranlogs. **The same package therefore has four separate records across four registries, and those records do not carry identical fields: the CRAN publication timestamp exists in the DESCRIPTION and on CRAN but not in the registry build record.** **Seventh, it wires onto packages this wiki already carries**: its Imports field lists actuar, mc2d, evd, sn, fitdistrplus, lmomco, ggplot2, goftest and gridExtra with version floors, and `[[fitdistrplus]]`, `[[lmomco]]` and `[[evd]]` already have entries here, so this entry supplies the layer that collects three upstream packages under one interface.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[fitdistrplus]], [[lmomco]] and [[evd]]**, because **it records where the distribution-fitting line stood in September 2026 and offers a countable entry point of 52 families, three estimators and three tests**, with actuarial workflows named among its intended uses.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, R was not installed, the package was not installed and no fit was run** — nothing was downloaded, no function was called and no plot or report was produced — **so no fitting result, parameter estimate, selection outcome, bootstrap interval or report output is claimed to work as described**. **Second, its reference manual and vignette were not read**: only the CRAN page text, the full DESCRIPTION file taken from the mirror, and the r-universe record fields were read, **so nothing is claimed about the actual coverage of the 52 families, the implementations of the three estimators, where the test critical values come from, or the batch-mode interface; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the five citations were checked only for form**, not opened and not reconciled with the implementation, so that it cites Hosking (1990) is a measured fact while that it implements L-moments as Hosking (1990) defines them is not. **Fourth, numerical correctness was not verified** against any independent implementation, nor were the AIC, BIC and goodness-of-fit implementations checked for error. **Fifth, whether the mirror really is read-only and how it synchronises was not verified**, nor was whether a development repository exists that this round did not find, the GitHub search for FitVerse having returned only unrelated JavaScript projects. **Sixth, its CRAN check results, vignettes and news file were not examined. Seventh, the author details read are only those in the DESCRIPTION: names, addresses and one ORCID; the institutional background, other work and adoption were not checked, and a mirror repository with zero stars is not evidence either way.** **Eighth, the creation date of 2026-09-01 is outside the thaw window while the push and the CRAN publication date of 2026-09-06 are inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that a package registered only on CRAN with no development repository had no counterpart in the pool**, since the pooled `fitdistrplus`, `lmomco` and `evd` entries are all sourced from CRAN pages but each of those packages also has a GitHub repository. **Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**

entries.title: **宁可报错，也不悄悄把两种粒度混在一起**：R 包 **inedemogR**（CRAN 0.1.0）——**实时取西班牙国家统计局「人口现象」域的人口／出生／死亡数据**，**并明确声明每个指标只在其来源表真正发布的那个地理层级可用**（**跨层级同调即报错**）；**⭐ 它还逐字提醒某个函数名会误导人**（**`crude_birth_rate()` 算的是粗出生率，不是总和生育率**）；**⭐⭐ 登记处把它拆成两个仓库**：**站点仓库指向包仓库**，**而 r-universe 的命名空间与 GitHub 仓库名并不一致**
entries.title_en: Refusing loudly rather than quietly mixing two granularities: the R package inedemogR, at CRAN version 0.1.0, retrieves live population, birth and death data from the Spanish national statistics institute demographic domain while stating that each indicator is available only at the geographic level its source table actually publishes, raising an error when indicators from different levels are requested together, and going out of its way to warn that one of its own function names misleads, since the crude birth rate function does not compute a total fertility rate; the registries also split it across two repositories, with a site repository pointing at the package repository and a registry namespace that does not match the GitHub repository name.
