entries.summary_en: **inedemogR**, whose repository is `jrcarob/inedemogR` while the package source sits in `jrcarob/inedemogR_package`, **is an R package that retrieves data from the Spanish national statistics institute demographic domain as tidy data frames**: population, births and deaths, fetched live through the official `ineapir` interface, with optional spatial integration through `mapSpain` and `sf`; **CRAN version 0.1.0**, by J. R. Caro-Barrera. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance, and the package provides a sample at both ends**: each indicator declares its own geographic level, verbatim, that indicators are only available at the geographic level their source table is actually published at, naming municipality-level and province-level indicators explicitly, and that requesting indicators spanning different levels in one call raises an error rather than silently mixing granularities; **it also warns verbatim that one of its own function names misleads**, noting that the crude birth rate function computes a crude rate rather than a total fertility rate and naming the three functions that give a true total fertility rate instead; **and it is split across two GitHub repositories**, a site repository created and pushed on 2026-09-09 and a package repository pushed on 2026-09-07, where the site README points at the package repository in one verbatim line, while the registry namespace and the GitHub repository name do not match. **It also carries a province-level, age and sex disaggregated mortality pipeline**, and states verbatim what this release does not include. **R was not installed this round, nothing was run and the national statistics interface was never called.**
entries.body:
**inedemogR**（**站点仓库** `jrcarob/inedemogR`；**包源码仓库** `jrcarob/inedemogR_package`）**是一个把西班牙国家统计局（INE）「人口现象」（`fenómenos demográficos`）域的数据取成整齐数据框的 R 包**，**逐字自述为**「**provides tidy access to demographic data from the Spanish National Statistics Institute (INE), specifically its "fenómenos demográficos" domain: population, births, and deaths**」**，**数据经官方** `ineapir` **接口**（**仓库** `es-ine/ineapir`）**实时获取**，**并可选接** `mapSpain` **与** `sf` **做空间整合**。**本次实测**：**CRAN 包版本 0.1.0**，**作者** `J. R. Caro-Barrera`（**引用块逐字给出** `2026` **与版本** `0.1.0`**）**；**两个 GitHub 仓库**——**站点仓库 `jrcarob/inedemogR` 创建与推送都在 2026-09-09**、**README 实测 807 字节**；**包仓库 `jrcarob/inedemogR_package` 推送日期 2026-09-07**、**README 实测 5,500 字节**；**r-universe 条目** `jrcarob/inedemogR`**（`RemoteSha` 为** `31c030eacf`**，`_registered` 为** `true`**，最近一个月下载 234，来源逐字指向** `cranlogs.r-pkg.org`**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记与出处：让别人查得到，也让每个数回得去**」**。

**可核实信息（均两个仓库的 README、r-universe 与 CRAN 记录实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每个指标都声明自己的地理层级，跨层级同调直接报错**——**包 README 逐字**：**「**Indicators are only available at the geographic level their source INE table is actually published at: `population_total` is municipality-level, `births_total`/`deaths_total` are province-level. Requesting indicators that span different levels in one call raises an error rather than silently mixing granularities — see `list_ine_indicators()`.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**它把「数据本身只发布到某一层」当成**数据的属性**，**而不是**使用者的问题**——**⭐ 即**它**不替你把市级数据摊到省级**（**也不反过来**），**而是在你写出跨层调用时报错**；**⭐ 并且它给出一个**先查再用**的入口** `list_ine_indicators()`**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字提醒某个函数名会误导人**——**逐字**：**「**Note `crude_birth_rate()` computes a *crude* birth rate (births/population), not a total fertility rate. For a true TFR, use `get_ine_births_by_age()` (age-of-mother birth counts) with `age_specific_fertility_rate()`/`total_fertility_rate()`:**」**，**随后给出可复制的三行代码**。**⭐ 即**它**没有把「c-r-u-d-e」留在函数名里让你自己发现**，**而是直接写出**「**这个函数不是你以为的那个东西**」**，**并指出正确路径**——**这也是本站 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[demography]] 一类条目反复出现的同一类问题：**指标定义差一点，结论差很远**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 登记处把它拆开了，而且拆得不一致**——**站点仓库 README 只有 807 字节**，**内容除了一句自述与安装方式外，逐字给出**：**「**Package source and issues: https://github.com/jrcarob/inedemogR_package.**」**，**且其徽章指向的是**包仓库**里的工作流**（**逐字** `jrcarob/inedemogR_package/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml`**）**——**⭐ 即**站点仓库**自己不带构建状态**，**而是把徽章接到**另一个仓库**的 CI 上**。**⭐ 而** r-universe **的命名空间写作** `jrcarob/inedemogR`**，**GitHub 上的包仓库却叫** `inedemogR_package`**——**即**同一个包在**站点仓库名**、**包仓库名**、**登记处命名空间**三处**写法并不统一**；**本词条如实记录这一处**，**不评价其好坏**。**⭐⭐ ④ 它明确分成两套并行系统，并逐字写出各覆盖什么**——**包 README 的 Status 一节逐字**：**System A** 为 `get_ine_demog()`、`get_ine_geo()`、`list_ine_indicators()`、`plot_ine_map()`，**逐字说明它实现的是**「**live retrieval and mapping of municipality/province-level total counts**」；**System B** 为 `get_ine_births()`／`get_ine_deaths()`／`get_ine_population()`、`compute_exposure()`、`compute_death_rates()`、`build_life_tables()`、`download_ine_data()`，**逐字说明它实现的是**「**a province-level, age/sex-disaggregated SHMD mortality pipeline**」，**其上再叠加汇总指标**（`age_dependency_ratio()`、`aging_index()`、`sex_ratio()`、`crude_birth_rate()`、`life_expectancy_summary()`**）与图表**（`plot_population_pyramid()`、`plot_demog_trend()`、`map_life_expectancy()`**）**；**并逐字说明两套的定位是**「**two deliberately parallel, complementary workflows — neither subsumes the other, since they operate at different geographic and demographic granularities**」。**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**`SHMD` 这个缩写在该 README 里没有展开**（**本次未读源码，故不猜**）。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 它逐字写出本版**没有**什么**——**逐字**：**「**Migration indicators are not included in this release.**」**与**「**Cleaning/harmonization helpers and projections are planned.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**已有**」与「**没有**」**写在同一节里**，**而不是留给使用者去发现**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一条完整的省级寿命流水线可被读出来**——**README 逐字注释**：**「**Life expectancy: full pipeline through life tables, then map it, bridging this province-level analysis back onto `get_ine_geo()’s spatial layer**」**，**接着是七行可复制代码**（`get_ine_population()` → `get_ine_deaths()` → `compute_exposure()` → `compute_death_rates()` → `build_life_tables()` → `life_expectancy_summary()` → `map_life_expectancy()`**）**——**⭐ 即**从取数到「把寿命画到地图上」**是一条明写的链**（**与本词条项目第 350 轮的「源与生成物」主题同形**）。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 它带一个可核对的引用块**——**逐字**：**「**If you use `inedemogR` in your work, please cite it. Run `citation("inedemogR")` for the current entry**」**，**并给出** BibTeX `@Manual` **条目**（**含标题、作者、年份、版本与 CRAN 包页链接**）。**⭐ 即**「**别人要引用你时该写什么**」**也被当成包的一部分**——**这与 [[colombian-pension-observatory]] 一类「把数据与出处一起交付」的条目取向一致**。**⭐ ⑧ 与既有条目的关系**：**本站 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[demography]]、[[mortcast]] 覆盖人口与死亡率的国际数据与方法**，**本条补上的是**一个国家统计机构官方接口的整齐化封装**（**并附一条建表到地图的链**）；**其自述的** `mapSpain` **与** `sf` **空间整合**，**与 [[spatialrisk]] 一类空间风险条目可并读但不同用途**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[demography]]、[[mortcast]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「国家统计机构的数据怎么被取成可直接建模的形状」的一个具体样本**，**而它最值得学的两点与精算无关而与数据纪律有关**：**① 数据只发布到某一层，就不要跨层混用；② 一个函数名可能误导人，那就把「它不是什么」写出来**.

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装 R、没有安装该包、没有调用过 INE 接口、没有取回任何一行数据**，**故不主张**任何函数按所述工作、不主张取回的数据正确、也不主张那条寿命流水线的数值结果。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 R 源码**——**本次只读了两个仓库的 README、r-universe 条目与 CRAN 记录**，**故不主张**指标的完整清单、`SHMD` 的含义、`build_life_tables()` 的建表方法（**是周期性生命表还是队列生命表**）、`crude_birth_rate()` 的分母口径、以及空间整合的实际实现。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实 INE 接口的稳定性与配额**，**未核实** `ineapir` **的状态与它是否仍在维护**（**本次只看到被引用**）。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** CRAN 版本 0.1.0 **与该包是否为首次发布**、**未查其 CRAN check 结果**、**未读其 vignette**（**README 逐字提到** `vignette("inedemogR-tutorial")` **覆盖每个函数与死亡率流水线的数学**，**本次未打开**）。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实「两套系统」的边界是否真如所述**（**例如 System A 是否真的只做总量、不涉年龄结构**）——**本词条只转述其自述**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者背景与该项目是否与任何机构有关**（**README 与引用块只给出个人姓名**）；**r-universe 上 234 的月下载数不构成质量证据**。**⑦ ⚠️ 站点仓库创建与推送都在 2026-09-09、包仓库推送 2026-09-07，两者都在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**一个包同时拥有站点仓库与包仓库、且两者命名与登记处命名空间不一致**这一形态**，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑨ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用时，把原文里的 ASCII 撇号（如 `get_ine_geo()` 后面的所有格）写作 ’，以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**。

**inedemogR**, whose site repository is `jrcarob/inedemogR` and whose package source lives in `jrcarob/inedemogR_package`, **is an R package that retrieves data from the Spanish national statistics institute demographic domain as tidy data frames** — population, births and deaths — **fetched live through the official `ineapir` interface**, with optional spatial integration through `mapSpain` and `sf`. **Measured this round**: **CRAN version 0.1.0**, by J. R. Caro-Barrera, with the citation block giving the year 2026 and the version explicitly; **two GitHub repositories**, the site repository created and pushed on 2026-09-09 with a README measuring 807 bytes, and the package repository pushed on 2026-09-07 with a README measuring 5,500 bytes; and an r-universe record pinning a commit SHA, reporting the package as registered and reporting 234 downloads in the last month. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance: making something findable, and making every number traceable back.**

**Verified information, all measured from the two repositories, the r-universe record and the CRAN record**: **first, every indicator declares its own geographic level and mixing levels raises an error**: verbatim, indicators are only available at the geographic level their source table is actually published at, with population totals at municipality level and birth and death totals at province level, and requesting indicators that span different levels in one call raises an error rather than silently mixing granularities, pointing the reader at the indicator listing function. **The package treats the publication level as a property of the data rather than a problem for the user**: it does not spread municipal figures onto provinces, and it fails loudly when a call crosses levels, with a way to look before you leap. **Second, it warns verbatim that one of its own function names misleads**: it notes that the crude birth rate function computes a crude birth rate, births over population, and not a total fertility rate, then gives three copyable lines naming the age-of-mother birth counts and the two functions that produce a true total fertility rate. **Rather than leaving the word crude in a function name for the reader to notice, it states directly that this is not the thing you may think it is, and points at the right path.** **Third, the registries split it apart, and not consistently**: the site README is only 807 bytes and, besides a self-description and installation instructions, gives one verbatim line naming the package repository as the place where source and issues live, and its badge points at a workflow **inside the other repository**, so the site repository does not carry its own build status but wires a badge onto another repository continuous integration. Meanwhile the registry namespace is written without the suffix that the GitHub package repository carries, **so the same package is spelled differently across the site repository name, the package repository name and the registry namespace**, which this entry records without judging. **Fourth, it splits itself into two parallel systems and states what each covers**: System A implements live retrieval and mapping of municipality and province level total counts; System B implements a province-level, age and sex disaggregated mortality pipeline, with summary indicators and charts on top; and the two are described verbatim as deliberately parallel and complementary workflows, neither subsuming the other, because they operate at different geographic and demographic granularities. **The acronym used for the mortality data source is not expanded anywhere in the README, and this entry does not guess at it.** **Fifth, it states verbatim what this release does not include**: migration indicators are not included, and cleaning, harmonisation and projection helpers are planned. **Sixth, a complete province-level life expectancy pipeline can be read straight off the README**, from population and death retrieval through exposure, death rates and life tables to a life expectancy summary and a map, described verbatim as a full pipeline through life tables that bridges the province-level analysis back onto the spatial layer, in seven copyable lines. **Seventh, it carries a checkable citation block**, telling users to run the citation function for the current entry and giving a BibTeX entry with title, author, year, version and a CRAN package URL, **so what someone should write when they cite it is treated as part of the package**. **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled `[[human-mortality-db]]`, `[[demography]]` and `[[mortcast]]` entries cover international mortality data and methods, while this entry supplies a tidy wrapper over one national statistical office interface together with a chain from table building to a map.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[human-mortality-db]], [[demography]] and [[mortcast]]**, because **it is a concrete sample of how a national statistical office dataset becomes a shape you can model directly**, and its two most transferable lessons are about data discipline rather than actuarial technique: **do not mix levels when the source only publishes at one, and if a function name can mislead, write down what it is not**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, R was not installed, the package was not installed, the statistics interface was never called and not one row of data was retrieved**, **so no function is claimed to work as described, no retrieved data is claimed correct and no numerical result of that life expectancy pipeline is claimed**. **Second, no R source was read**: only the two README files, the registry record and the CRAN record were read, **so nothing is claimed about the complete indicator list, the meaning of the acronym, whether the life table builder produces period or cohort tables, what denominator the crude birth rate uses, or how spatial integration is actually implemented — this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the stability and quota of the national statistics interface were not verified**, nor whether the API wrapper it depends on is still maintained, only that it is referenced. **Fourth, whether version 0.1.0 is a first release, the CRAN check results and the tutorial vignette that the README says covers every function and the mortality pipeline mathematics were all left unexamined**. **Fifth, whether the boundary between the two systems is really as described was not verified; this entry relays the package own statement.** **Sixth, the author background and any institutional affiliation were not checked**, the README and citation block giving only an individual name, and a monthly download count is not evidence of quality. **Seventh, both repositories were created and pushed on 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-09, inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed here**; **however, the shape of one package owning both a site repository and a package repository under names that do not match the registry namespace had no counterpart in the pool**. **Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.** **Ninth, quotation convention: where quoted text contained an ASCII apostrophe, such as the possessive after a function name, this entry renders it as a curved apostrophe to keep the entry free of ASCII single quotes, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged.**

entries.title: **「可行」是精确的，不是近似的**：Python 包 **rank-preserving-calibration**——**把分类器输出的类别概率校准到已知总体边际，同时不打乱类内排序**（**Dykstra 交替投影／ADMM／稀疏二次规划三种解法**）；**⭐ 它逐字论证「交点永不空」**（**因此失败只可能是条件数或迭代预算问题，而不可能是不可行**）；**⭐ 并逐字点名一个更差的求解器**（**OSQP 在 N=400 时返回 592 处排序违例，**却报告「已运行」**）；**⭐ 论文与实验代码同在一仓**
entries.title_en: Feasibility is exact and not approximate: the Python package rank-preserving-calibration adjusts classifier class probabilities to known population marginals without scrambling the ordering of individuals inside each class, offering Dykstra alternating projections, ADMM and a sparse quadratic program, arguing verbatim that the intersection is never empty so a failure can only ever be a conditioning or iteration-budget problem, naming a solver that is measurably worse because it returned hundreds of rank violations while reporting that it ran, and keeping the manuscript and its experiment code in the same repository as the package.
entries.title_hk: **「可行」是精確的，不是近似的**：Python 套件 **rank-preserving-calibration**——**把分類器輸出的類別機率校準到已知總體邊際，同時不打亂類內排序**（**Dykstra 交替投影／ADMM／稀疏二次規劃三種解法**）；**⭐ 它逐字論證「交點永不空」**（**因此失敗只可能是條件數或迭代預算問題，而不可能是不可行**）；**⭐ 並逐字點名一個更差的求解器**（**OSQP 在 N=400 時返回 592 處排序違例，**卻回報「已運行」**）；**⭐ 論文與實驗程式碼同在一倉**
entries.summary: **rank-preserving-calibration**（仓库 `finite-sample/rank-preserving-calibration`，PyPI 发行名 `rank_preserving_calibration` 0.9.0）**是一个把分类器输出的类概率**校准到已知总体边际**的 Python 包**：**做法是把概率投影到两个凸集的交集上**——**① 行单纯形**（**每行和为 1 且非负**）、**② 等渗列边际**（**在类内按原分数排序后取值非降，且每列和等于使用者给定的目标**）；**逐字自述目标人群为**「**Survey statisticians and machine learning practitioners**」。**本条目属于本轮主题**「登记与出处」**，**且它把「可核查」做到了少见的地步**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 结论被测试核对而不是被声明**——**逐字**「**That claim is checked against an independent convex solver in the test suite rather than asserted.**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字论证可行性是精确的**——**逐字**「**Feasibility is exact, not approximate.**」**，**并给出理由**（**每行和为 1 故总和固定为 N，**目标必须满足 `sum(M) == N`；**满足时常矩阵 `Q[i, j] = M[j] / N` 就是一个解，**故交集**永不空**）**，**据此断定失败只可能是**条件数或迭代预算**问题**，**而当目标不可行时**「**the solver warns, then raises `CalibrationError`**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字点名一个更差的工具并给出数字**——**逐字**「**OSQP, also first-order, is *worse* than Dykstra here, returning 592 rank violations at `N=400` while reporting that it ran.**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 它画出自己的上限**——**逐字**「**Above roughly `N = 6400` the exact solve becomes expensive again**」**并给出替代做法**（**放宽约束而不是等着**）；**⭐⭐ ⑤ 论文与包同仓**（`ms/` 下含 `ms.tex`、`ms.pdf`、`multiclass.bib`、`kl_theory.tex` **与三个实验脚本及其输出表**）。**⚠️ 本次未安装、未运行、未复现其任何计时**。
entries.summary_hk: **rank-preserving-calibration**（倉庫 `finite-sample/rank-preserving-calibration`，PyPI 發行名 `rank_preserving_calibration` 0.9.0）**是一個把分類器輸出的類別機率**校準到已知總體邊際**的 Python 套件**：**做法是把機率投影到兩個凸集的交集上**——**① 行單純形**、**② 等滲列邊際**；**逐字自述目標人群為**「**Survey statisticians and machine learning practitioners**」。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「登記與出處」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 結論被測試核對而不是被聲明**——**逐字**「**That claim is checked against an independent convex solver in the test suite rather than asserted.**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字論證可行性是精確的**——**逐字**「**Feasibility is exact, not approximate.**」**，**並給出理由**（**常矩陣 `Q[i, j] = M[j] / N` 就是一個解，**故交集**永不空**）**，**據此斷定失敗只可能是**條件數或迭代預算**問題**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字點名一個更差的工具並給出數字**——**逐字**「**OSQP, also first-order, is *worse* than Dykstra here, returning 592 rank violations at `N=400` while reporting that it ran.**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 它畫出自己的上限**——**逐字**「**Above roughly `N = 6400` the exact solve becomes expensive again**」；**⭐⭐ ⑤ 論文與套件同倉**（`ms/` 下含 `ms.tex`、`ms.pdf`、`multiclass.bib`、`kl_theory.tex` **與三個實驗腳本及其輸出表**）。**⚠️ 本次未安裝、未運行、未復現其任何計時**。
entries.summary_en: **rank-preserving-calibration**, housed at `finite-sample/rank-preserving-calibration` with the distribution name spelled with underscores and released on PyPI as version 0.9.0, **is a Python package that calibrates classifier class probabilities to known population marginals without scrambling the ordering of individuals within each class**: it projects probabilities onto the intersection of two convex sets, the row simplex where each row sums to one and is non-negative, and isotonic column marginals where within each class values are non-decreasing once instances are sorted by their original scores and each column sums to a user-supplied target; its own description names survey statisticians and machine learning practitioners as its audience. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance, and the package takes checkability unusually far**: its central claim is checked against an independent convex solver in the test suite rather than asserted; it argues verbatim that feasibility is exact rather than approximate, because every row summing to one fixes the grand total and the constant matrix satisfies all three constraint sets, so the intersection is never empty and a failure can only be a conditioning or iteration-budget problem, and when the targets are infeasible the solver warns and then raises an explicit error; it names a measurably worse tool with a number, reporting that another first-order solver returned 592 rank violations at N=400 while reporting that it ran; it draws its own limit by stating that above roughly six thousand four hundred rows the exact solve becomes expensive again and telling the reader to relax the constraint rather than wait; and it keeps the manuscript, its bibliography and its experiment scripts with their output tables in the same repository as the package. **Nothing was installed, run or timed this round.**
entries.body:
**rank-preserving-calibration**（仓库 `finite-sample/rank-preserving-calibration`；**PyPI 发行名** `rank_preserving_calibration`，**`pyproject.toml` 里 `name` 逐字为** `rank_preserving_calibration`，**版本** `0.9.0`）**是一个把分类器输出的类概率校准到已知总体边际的 Python 包**，**逐字自述的使用者为**「**Survey statisticians and machine learning practitioners**」。**本次实测**：**许可 MIT**（**`license = "MIT"` 且** `license-files = ["LICENSE"]`**）**、**`requires-python = ">=3.12"`**、**作者** `Gaurav Sood`、**关键词逐字为** `calibration`、`machine learning`、`multiclass`、`isotonic`、`dykstra`、`admm`；**运行依赖** `numpy>=1.20`、`scipy>=1.10`、**`clarabel>=0.9`**，**可选** `performance = numba>=0.56`；**构建后端逐字为** `uv_build>=0.12.5,<0.13`；**GitHub 提交时间为 2026-09-08**（**本次经该仓库的提交 Atom 流实测**）；**仓库文件清单经 tarball 枚举为 88 条路径**。本条目属于本轮主题**「登记与出处：让别人查得到，也让每个数回得去」**；**本词条认为它是本轮四条里把「可核查」做得最彻底的一条**。

**可核实信息（均 README、`pyproject.toml`、CI 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它说明问题出在哪，而不是只说解法**——**README 逐字**：**「**Simple post-hoc methods that apply separate logit shifts or raking to each class can scramble the ranking of individuals within a class when there are three or more classes.**」**，**并逐字给出两个约束集**：**① 行单纯形**「**each row sums to one and all entries are non-negative**」；**② 等渗列边际**「**within each class, values are non-decreasing when instances are sorted by their original scores for that class, and the sum of each column equals a user-supplied target**」。**⭐ 即**它先说清**朴素做法为什么会坏**（**类内排序被打乱**）**，**再说自己把概率投到哪两个集合的交上**——**这与本站 [[insurance-calibration]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[mapie]]、[[fortuna]]、[[puncc]] 一类「预测不确定性与校准」条目讨论的是同一类问题，但取向不同**（**这里管的是「边际对不上」，不是「覆盖率」**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 核心结论被测试核对，而不是被声明**——**逐字**：**「**The algorithm uses Dykstra’s alternating projection method in Euclidean geometry. When the specified column totals are feasible, the procedure returns a matrix that preserves cross-person discrimination within each class, matches the desired totals, and remains a valid probability distribution for each instance. That claim is checked against an independent convex solver in the test suite rather than asserted.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一句**：**它把「我的算法有这些性质」**降级成「**这些性质被另一个求解器核对过**」**——**⭐ 而**这一句同时也把边界说清了**：**被核对的是**性质**，**不是**「更快」或「更好用」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字论证「可行」是精确的**——**README 逐字为一个小节标题**：**「**Feasibility is exact, not approximate.**」**，**随后**：**「**Every row sums to one, so the grand total is fixed at `N` and the targets must satisfy `sum(M) == N`. When they do, the intersection is *never* empty — the constant matrix `Q[i, j] = M[j] / N` satisfies all three constraint sets — so a failure is a conditioning or iteration-budget problem, never infeasibility. When they do not, no matrix satisfies both constraint sets and there is no "closest point satisfying both" to return: the solver warns, then raises `CalibrationError`.**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 它给出**存在性证明的构造****（**常矩阵就是一个可行解**）——**因此把「求解失败」的归因范围**收窄成一个可检验的判断**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它拒绝「最近点」这种听起来合理的兜底**——**逐字**「**there is no "closest point satisfying both" to return**」**，**即**不可行时**不返回一个看起来像答案的东西**，**而是**先警告、**再抛错**；**③ ⭐⭐ 它顺手给出用法纠正**——**README 逐字建议先按 `M = M * N / M.sum()` 归一再调用**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 它逐字点名一个更差的工具，并给出数字**——**逐字**：**「**A sparse QP alone is not enough — OSQP, also first-order, is *worse* than Dykstra here, returning 592 rank violations at `N=400` while reporting that it ran.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮第二处最值得抄的写法**：**它把「另一个求解器不行」写成了**可复现的具体形状**（**同一问题、同一规模、一个具体数字、以及「它自己说它跑成功了」**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「我们不推荐 X」，**而是「**X 在这个规模下返回了 592 处排序违例**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 它画出自己的上限，并给出替代做法**——**逐字**：**「**Above roughly `N = 6400` the exact solve becomes expensive again**, since interior-point factorisation cost grows steeply. Relax the constraint rather than wait:**」**，**随后给出** epsilon-slack **的用法**（**逐字说明**「**which permits adjacent within-class decreases of at most `eps` and is handled exactly, by lowering the isotonic bound rather than by penalising violations**」**）**。**⭐ 即**它的边界不是「可能会慢」，**而是**一个量级**，**外加一条**「**不要等，放宽约束**」**的建议**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 三种解法的取舍被写成一张表和一组实测计时**——README 给出三行表（`qp` **默认、稀疏二次规划、内点法，逐字**「**always**」；`dykstra` **仅依赖 numpy 的参考实现，逐字**「**useful if you cannot take the solver dependency**」；`admm` **逐字**「**when you want primal/dual residual traces**」**）**，**并逐字说明三者**「**are mathematically equivalent — they solve the same convex problem, and the test suite asserts they agree**」**；**接着给出 `J=4` 下的实测计时表**（**N=25：0.03 s vs 0.002 s；N=50：9.6 s vs 0.004 s；N=100：10.5 s vs 0.01 s；N=400：dykstra**「**does not converge in 60,000 iterations**」**而 qp 为 0.12 s；N=1600：1.4 s；N=6400：50 s**）**，**并逐字给出原因**「**the two constraint sets meet at a shallow angle, which is exactly where first-order methods crawl and where an interior-point method is unaffected**」。**⭐ 即**默认值不是偏好，**而是**被计时表支撑的选择**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑦ 论文、实验与包在同一个仓库里**——**文件清单实测**：`ms/` 下有 `ms.tex`、`ms.pdf`、`multiclass.bib`、`kl_theory.tex`、`Makefile`，**以及** `ms/experiments/` **下的** `synthetic_experiment.py`、`real_data_experiment.py`、`run_experiments.py` **与输出** `synthetic_results.csv`、`real_data_results.csv`、`synthetic_table.tex`、`real_data_table.tex`、`brier_vs_rank.pdf`、`synthetic_tradeoff.pdf`。**⭐ 即**「**主张—实验—产物**」**三样在同一次提交历史里**（**⭐ 与本词条项目第 340 轮「写下每个数字从哪来」和第 350 轮「源与生成物」是同一类做法**）。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 它自己的 CI 也被审计**——`.github/workflows/` **实测含** `ci.yml`、`docs.yml`、`release.yml`、`dependabot-auto-merge.yml`、`adjacent_repo_recommender.yaml`，**并且根目录另有一个** `.github/zizmor.yml`（**zizmor 是审计 GitHub Actions 工作流安全性的工具**；**⚠️ 本词条未读该文件内容，故不主张它具体开了哪些规则**）。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 登记与引用的常规件齐全**——`CITATION.cff`、`LICENSE`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`.pre-commit-config.yaml`、`uv.lock`、`py.typed`、**以及一个** `.copier-answers.yml`（**即仓库由 copier 模板生成，并把模板答案记在仓库里**）；**README 顶部徽章逐字给出** CI、PyPI 版本、文档站（GitHub Pages）、**PyPI 下载量（进 pepy.tech）**、**Python 3.12+** 与 **MIT**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 测试是可数的十六个文件**——**文件清单实测** `tests/` 下含 `test_mathematical_guarantees.py`、`test_property_based.py`、`test_audit_regressions.py`、`test_core_algorithms.py`、`test_qp_solver.py`、`test_nearly_isotonic.py`、`test_ovr_isotonic.py`、`test_kl_calibration.py`、`test_soft_calibration.py`、`test_two_stage.py`、`test_ties_and_edge_cases.py`、`test_performance.py`、`test_analysis.py`、`test_utilities.py`、`test_...` **等共 16 个**；**其中**「**数学保证**」「**性质测试**」「**审计回归**」**三个命名本身就是在声明测试的类型**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 登记层面的一个小不一致（如实记录）**：**`pyproject.toml` 里的发行名写作** `rank_preserving_calibration`（**下划线**）**，**而同一文件 `[project.urls]` 里的仓库地址写作** `rank-preserving-calibration`（**连字符**）**；**PyPI 元数据的** `project_urls` **则指向**下划线**形式**。**⭐ 本词条实测发现**：**连字符形式是该仓库的**规范名**（**tarball 解出的目录为** `rank-preserving-calibration-main`**）**，**下划线形式**会被重定向**；**⭐ 由此产生一个可复现的检索现象**：**用 GitHub 搜索的** `repo:` **限定符写下划线形式时**，**该仓库**并不出现**（**因为它只在规范名下被索引**）**——**⭐ 本词条据此记入纪律：**当 `repo:` 检索为空时，**必须**用 raw／codeload 再探一次**，**不能据检索为空断定仓库不存在**。**⭐ ⑫ 另一处时间事实**：**PyPI 上 0.9.0 的上传时间是 2026-07-31**（**本次实测**），**而仓库提交时间是 2026-09-08**——**即**仓库在发版之后仍在推进**，**发布版本落后于仓库**；**⭐ 故本条的窗口依据是**仓库提交**，**而不是发布日**。**⭐ ⑬ 与池内条目的关系**：**本条与 [[insurance-calibration]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[mapie]]、[[puncc]]、[[fortuna]] 讨论的是相邻问题**（**校准与不确定性**），**但它处理的是**分类概率的边际校准与类内保序**，**并明确区分了「校准」与「保序」两件事**；**其「论文与实验同仓」的做法与本站在 [[credibility-gated-xai]]、[[midr]]、[[va-valuation-shap]] 一类可解释性条目里记录的做法同形**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[insurance-calibration]]、[[mapie]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「一个模型输出的概率在交给下游之前，能不能既对上已知总体又不动个次序」这一问题的完整样本**（**含存在性论证、三种解法计时、以及一条不可行时**宁可报错也不给最近点**的规则**）。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装该包、没有运行任何一次校准、没有复现任何一行计时**（**未 `pip install`、未调用 `calibrate()`、未跑 `tests/`、未打开文档站或任何示例 notebook**），**故不主张**任何解法按所述工作、不主张任何计时数字、不主张其数学性质成立。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何算法源码**——**本次只读了** README **全文**、`pyproject.toml`、**仓库文件清单与 CI 文件名**，**故不主张** Dykstra／ADMM／QP 三条路径的具体实现、`CalibrationError` 的触发条件、`nearly` 参数的语义细节与 `max_iters` 的默认值。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未读其论文**（`ms/ms.tex` **与** `ms.pdf` **本次未打开**），**故不主张**其中任何实验结果、也不主张 README 里那句「**被独立凸求解器核对**」的实际核对方式（**未读** `tests/` **下任何文件**）。**④ ⚠️ 未核实计时表**（**未在任何机器上跑过，故 0.03 s／9.6 s／592 处违例等数字均为转述**）；**未核实**「**OSQP 返回 592 处排序违例**」**这一比较是否在同版本、同设置下做出**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** `clarabel` **的许可与体量**（**README 逐字写**「**Apache-2.0, ~2.5 MB**」**，**本次只转述**）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实** PyPI 上下载量徽章所依赖的第三方统计服务当前是否可读；**未核实** GitHub Pages 文档站是否可打开。**⑦ ⚠️ `.github/zizmor.yml` 本次只看到文件存在**，**未读其内容**，**故不主张**它审计了哪些规则。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实作者背景**、**未核实**该包是否被任何生产系统使用；**⚠️ `Development Status :: 4 - Beta` 是该包自述的分类**。**⑨ ⚠️ 许可为 MIT（`pyproject.toml` 字段与** `license-files` **指向的** `LICENSE` **文件均在，**未读正文**）。**⑩ ⚠️ 仓库提交 2026-09-08 在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「论文、实验脚本与输出表同在一仓」并配一个**审计自己 CI 的配置文件**这一形态，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑫ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用时，把原文里的 ASCII 引号（**`"closest point satisfying both"` **一处）按原样保留为双引号**，**其余 ASCII 撇号一律写作 ’**——**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**。

**rank-preserving-calibration**（倉庫 `finite-sample/rank-preserving-calibration`；**PyPI 發行名** `rank_preserving_calibration`，**版本** `0.9.0`）**是一個把分類器輸出的類別機率校準到已知總體邊際的 Python 套件**，**逐字自述的使用者為**「**Survey statisticians and machine learning practitioners**」。**本次實測**：**許可 MIT**、**`requires-python = ">=3.12"`**、**作者** `Gaurav Sood`、**運行依賴** `numpy>=1.20`、`scipy>=1.10`、`clarabel>=0.9`，**可選** `performance = numba>=0.56`；**構建後端逐字為** `uv_build>=0.12.5,<0.13`；**GitHub 提交時間為 2026-09-08**（**經提交 Atom 流實測**）；**文件清單經 tarball 列舉為 88 條路徑**。本條目屬於本輪主題**「登記與出處」**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、`pyproject.toml`、CI 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它說明問題出在哪**——**逐字**「**Simple post-hoc methods that apply separate logit shifts or raking to each class can scramble the ranking of individuals within a class when there are three or more classes.**」**，**並逐字給出兩個約束集**（**行單純形**／**等滲列邊際**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 核心結論被測試核對，而不是被聲明**——**逐字**：**「**The algorithm uses Dykstra’s alternating projection method in Euclidean geometry. When the specified column totals are feasible, the procedure returns a matrix that preserves cross-person discrimination within each class, matches the desired totals, and remains a valid probability distribution for each instance. That claim is checked against an independent convex solver in the test suite rather than asserted.**」**。**⭐ 即**它把「我的演算法有這些性質」**降級成「**這些性質被另一個求解器核對過**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字論證「可行」是精確的**——**逐字**：**「**Feasibility is exact, not approximate.**」**，**隨後**：**「**Every row sums to one, so the grand total is fixed at `N` and the targets must satisfy `sum(M) == N`. When they do, the intersection is *never* empty — the constant matrix `Q[i, j] = M[j] / N` satisfies all three constraint sets — so a failure is a conditioning or iteration-budget problem, never infeasibility. When they do not, no matrix satisfies both constraint sets and there is no "closest point satisfying both" to return: the solver warns, then raises `CalibrationError`.**」**。**⭐ 三處值得記**：**① 它給出**存在性證明的構造****；**② 它拒絕「最近點」這種兜底**（**不可行時先警告、再拋錯**）；**③ 它順手給出用法糾正**（**逐字建議先按 `M = M * N / M.sum()` 歸一**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 它逐字點名一個更差的工具並給出數字**——**逐字**：**「**OSQP, also first-order, is *worse* than Dykstra here, returning 592 rank violations at `N=400` while reporting that it ran.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 它畫出自己的上限**——**逐字**：**「**Above roughly `N = 6400` the exact solve becomes expensive again**, since interior-point factorisation cost grows steeply. Relax the constraint rather than wait:**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 三種解法的取捨被寫成一張表和一组實測計時**（`qp` 預設、`dykstra` 僅依賴 numpy、`admm` 可取 primal／dual 殘差軌跡；**並逐字說明三者數學等價且測試斷言它們一致**），**另逐字給出原因**「**the two constraint sets meet at a shallow angle**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑦ 論文、實驗與套件在同一個倉庫裡**——`ms/` 下有 `ms.tex`、`ms.pdf`、`multiclass.bib`、`kl_theory.tex`，**以及** `ms/experiments/` **下的三個實驗腳本與輸出** `synthetic_results.csv`、`real_data_results.csv`、`synthetic_table.tex`、`real_data_table.tex`、`brier_vs_rank.pdf`、`synthetic_tradeoff.pdf`。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 它自己的 CI 也被審計**——`.github/workflows/` 含 `ci.yml`、`docs.yml`、`release.yml`、`dependabot-auto-merge.yml`、`adjacent_repo_recommender.yaml`，**根目錄另有** `.github/zizmor.yml`。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 登記與引用的常規件齊全**——`CITATION.cff`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`.pre-commit-config.yaml`、`uv.lock`、`py.typed`、`.copier-answers.yml`。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 測試是可數的十六個檔案**，**其中**「**數學保證**」「**性質測試**」「**審計回歸**」**三個命名本身就在聲明測試的類型**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 登記層面的一個小不一致（如實記錄）**：**發行名寫作**下劃線**，**而** `[project.urls]` **與 README 徽章寫作**連字符**；**⭐ 本次實測發現連字符形式是規範名**（**tarball 解出的目錄為** `rank-preserving-calibration-main`**）**，**而**用 `repo:` **限定符寫下劃線形式時該倉庫不出現**——**⭐ 紀律：`repo:` 檢索為空時必須用 raw／codeload 再探一次**。**⭐ ⑫ 時間事實**：**PyPI 上 0.9.0 上傳於 2026-07-31**，**而倉庫提交為 2026-09-08**——**發布落後於倉庫**，**故本條的窗口依據是倉庫提交**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[insurance-calibration]]、[[mapie]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「模型輸出的機率在交給下游之前，能不能既對上已知總體又不動個次序」這一問題的完整樣本**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝該套件、沒有運行任何一次校準、沒有復現任何一行計時**，**故不主張**任何解法按所述工作、不主張任何計時數字、不主張其數學性質成立。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何演算法原始碼**——**本次只讀了** README **全文**、`pyproject.toml`、**文件清單與 CI 檔名**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未讀其論文**（`ms/ms.tex` **與** `ms.pdf` **未打開**），**故不主張**其中任何實驗結果，**也未讀** `tests/` **下任何檔案**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實計時表**（**未在任何機器上跑過，故 0.03 s／9.6 s／592 處違例等數字均為轉述**）。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實** `clarabel` **的許可與體量**（**README 逐字寫**「**Apache-2.0, ~2.5 MB**」**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**下載量徽章所依賴的第三方統計服務與 GitHub Pages 文件站。**⑦ ⚠️** `.github/zizmor.yml` **本次只看到檔案存在，未讀內容**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核實作者背景與實際使用情況**。**⑨ ⚠️ 許可為 MIT，未讀正文**。**⑩ ⚠️ 倉庫提交 2026-09-08 在解凍窗口之內**，**故本條不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但「論文、實驗腳本與輸出表同在一倉」並配一個**審計自己 CI 的設定檔**這一形態，此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑫ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用時，原文裡的雙引號按原樣保留**，**其餘 ASCII 撇號一律寫作 ’**——**以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（引文內容未改）**。

**rank-preserving-calibration**, housed at `finite-sample/rank-preserving-calibration`, with the distribution name written with underscores and **version 0.9.0**, **is a Python package that calibrates classifier class probabilities to known population marginals**, naming survey statisticians and machine learning practitioners as its audience. **Measured this round**: **licence MIT**, with a licence file declared alongside it; **requires Python 3.12 or later**; author Gaurav Sood; keywords calibration, machine learning, multiclass, isotonic, Dykstra and ADMM; runtime dependencies on numpy, scipy and clarabel, with an optional performance extra pulling in numba; a uv-based build backend; a **GitHub commit date of 2026-09-08**, measured through the repository commit feed; and a file listing of 88 paths enumerated from a tarball. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the project metadata, the CI configuration and the file listing**: **first, it explains where the problem comes from rather than only describing its fix**, verbatim, that simple post-hoc methods applying separate logit shifts or raking to each class can scramble the ranking of individuals within a class when there are three or more classes, and then states the two constraint sets: the row simplex, where each row sums to one and all entries are non-negative, and isotonic column marginals, where within each class values are non-decreasing once instances are sorted by their original scores and each column sums to a user-supplied target. **Second, its central claim is checked rather than asserted**, verbatim: the procedure returns a matrix that preserves cross-person discrimination within each class, matches the desired totals and remains a valid probability distribution for each instance, **and that claim is checked against an independent convex solver in the test suite rather than asserted**. **The claim is demoted from a property the package has to a property another solver verified, and the same sentence states what was checked: the property, not speed and not usability.** **Third, it argues verbatim that feasibility is exact and not approximate**: because every row sums to one the grand total is fixed, so the targets must sum to the row count; when they do, the intersection is never empty, since the constant matrix that gives each entry its column target divided by the row count satisfies all three constraint sets, so a failure is a conditioning or iteration-budget problem and never infeasibility; and when they do not, no matrix satisfies both constraint sets and there is no closest point satisfying both to return, so the solver warns and then raises an explicit calibration error. **Three things are worth recording**: it supplies a constructive existence argument, which narrows the attribution of any failure into a testable judgement; it refuses the plausible-sounding fallback of returning a nearest point, choosing instead to warn and then raise; and it adds a usage correction, telling the reader to rescale the targets first. **Fourth, it names a measurably worse tool with numbers**, verbatim, that a sparse quadratic program alone is not enough, since another first-order solver is worse than Dykstra here, returning 592 rank violations at four hundred rows **while reporting that it ran**. **The rejection is written as a reproducible shape: same problem, same size, one specific number, and the fact that the tool itself claimed success.** **Fifth, it draws its own limit and gives the alternative**, verbatim, that above roughly six thousand four hundred rows the exact solve becomes expensive again because interior-point factorisation cost grows steeply, and that one should relax the constraint rather than wait, followed by the epsilon-slack usage whose effect is described verbatim as handled exactly by lowering the isotonic bound rather than by penalising violations. **The boundary is an order of magnitude rather than a vague warning about slowness.** **Sixth, the tradeoff between three solvers is written as a table plus measured timings**: a default sparse quadratic program described as usable always, a numpy-only reference implementation described as useful when the solver dependency cannot be taken, and an augmented Lagrangian variant described as useful when primal and dual residual traces are wanted, with the note that the three are mathematically equivalent and that the test suite asserts they agree; the timings then show the default winning by orders of magnitude at fifty and one hundred rows, the reference implementation failing to converge within sixty thousand iterations at four hundred rows while the default takes a fraction of a second, and the reason given verbatim being that the two constraint sets meet at a shallow angle, which is where first-order methods crawl. **Seventh, the paper, its experiments and the package share one repository**: the file listing shows a manuscript directory containing the LaTeX source, a built PDF, a bibliography and a separate theory document, plus three experiment scripts and their outputs, including two result tables in LaTeX, two CSV result files and two PDF figures. **Eighth, even its own CI is audited**, with five workflows including one whose name suggests recommending adjacent repositories, and a separate configuration file for a tool that audits the security of workflow definitions, **whose contents this entry did not read**. **Ninth, the registration and citation furniture is all present**: a citation file, a changelog, a pre-commit configuration, a lock file, a typing marker, and a template answers file recording that the repository was generated from a project template; the badges at the top of the README cover continuous integration, the published version, a documentation site, download counts through a third-party service, the Python version floor and the licence. **Tenth, the tests are a countable sixteen files**, and three of the names, mathematical guarantees, property based and audit regressions, are themselves declarations about what kind of testing is being done. **Eleventh, one small inconsistency in registration is recorded honestly**: the distribution name is written with underscores while the repository URLs in the same metadata file and in the README badges are written with hyphens, and the registry metadata points at the underscore form; **this round found the hyphenated form to be the canonical repository name**, with the underscore form redirecting, **which produces a reproducible search artefact: asking the GitHub search API for the underscore form returns nothing, because the repository is indexed only under its canonical name. The discipline recorded from this is that an empty repository-qualified search must be re-probed through raw or tarball access before concluding that a repository does not exist.** **Twelfth, one more timing fact**: the release on the package index was uploaded on 2026-07-31 while the repository was committed to on 2026-09-08, so the repository runs ahead of the release and the window evidence for this entry is the commit, not the upload. **Thirteenth, relative to existing entries**: `[[insurance-calibration]]`, `[[insurance-conformal]]`, `[[mapie]]`, `[[puncc]]` and `[[fortuna]]` cover neighbouring questions of calibration and uncertainty, while this package handles marginal calibration of class probabilities together with within-class order preservation, and it is explicit that calibration and order preservation are two different things; keeping a manuscript, its experiment scripts and their outputs in one repository matches what the `[[credibility-gated-xai]]` and `[[midr]]` entries record about reproducible explainability work.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[insurance-calibration]] and [[mapie]]**, because **it is a complete sample of one question, whether a model probability can be made to match a known population total before it goes downstream without reordering anyone**, including an existence argument, timings for three solvers, and the rule that an infeasible target produces an error rather than a nearest point.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed, no calibration was run and no timing was reproduced** — nothing was downloaded, no function was called, the test suite was not run and neither the documentation site nor any example notebook was opened — **so no solver is claimed to work as described, no timing is claimed, and none of the stated mathematical properties is claimed to hold**. **Second, no algorithm source was read**: only the full README, the project metadata, the file listing and the CI file names were read, **so nothing is claimed about the actual implementations of the three paths, the exact trigger for the calibration error, the semantics of the nearly-isotonic options or the default iteration budget; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the manuscript was not read** — neither the LaTeX source nor the built PDF was opened — **so none of its experimental results is claimed, and no file under the tests directory was read, so the way that independent-solver check is actually performed is not claimed either**. **Fourth, the timing table was not verified on any machine, so every figure quoted here, including the seconds and the count of rank violations, is a relay rather than a measurement, and whether the comparison against the other solver was made at the same version and settings was not checked. Fifth, the licence and size of the extra solver dependency were not verified**, only relayed. **Sixth, whether the third-party download-count service and the documentation site are currently reachable was not checked. Seventh, the workflow-auditing configuration file was only observed to exist, not read, so which rules it enables is not claimed. Eighth, the author background and any production use were not verified, and a beta development-status classifier is the package own description of itself. Ninth, the licence is MIT by field and by a licence file that was not read. Tenth, the commit of 2026-09-08 is inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed here; however, the shape of keeping a manuscript, its experiment scripts and their outputs in one repository alongside a configuration that audits its own continuous integration had no counterpart in the pool. Eleventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11. Twelfth, quotation convention: double quotation marks appearing inside quoted text are preserved as they appeared, while ASCII apostrophes are rendered as curved apostrophes so that this entry contains no ASCII single quote, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged.**

entries.title: **它会自己生成一份「哪些参数还没有出处」的审计报告**：**OpenFisca 突尼斯养老金模块**（PyPI `OpenFisca-Tunisia-Pension` 5.3.1，2026-09-10）——**把养老金规则写成** 63 份 YAML 参数**＋**13 个变量**＋**6 套制度**；**⭐ 它逐字公布自己的缺口**（**「**Paramètres avec référence: 31 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres sans référence: 19 / 50**」**）**；**⭐ 它还点名一部法律的出处状态是**「**à résoudre**」**；**⭐⭐ 而它把**来源文件本身**（Word 与 Excel）**放在仓库里**
entries.title_en: It generates its own audit report of which parameters still lack a source: the OpenFisca Tunisia pension module, released on the package index as version 5.3.1 on 2026-09-10, expresses pension rules as sixty-three YAML parameter files plus variables and benefit regimes, publishes its own gap counts verbatim, stating that thirty-one of fifty parameters carry a reference and nineteen do not, flags one law as still to be resolved, and keeps the source documents it transcribed from, a Word file and a spreadsheet, inside the repository.

entries.summary: **openfisca-tunisia-pension**（PyPI 发行名 `OpenFisca-Tunisia-Pension`，**版本 5.3.1**）**是 OpenFisca 微模拟框架下的**突尼斯养老金规则模块**：**许可 AGPL-3.0-or-later**、**要求 Python ≥3.10**、**依赖** `openfisca-core[web-api]`（**逐字钉在** `>=44.0.3,<45.0.0`**）与** `openfisca-tunisia>=0.80`；**实测最新版本 2026-09-10 上传**，**仓库提交同日**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「登记与出处」**，**它把「出处」做成了**可运行的产物**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它自己生成一份参数出处审计报告**——`reports/openfisca/pension_source_audit.md`**（标题逐字**「**Audit sources retraite OpenFisca Tunisia Pension**」**、**首行逐字**「**Généré le 2026-09-10 par `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py`.**」**）**，**并逐字公布自己的缺口**：**「**Fichiers paramètres retraite: 63**」**、**「**Paramètres avec valeurs ou barèmes: 50**」**、**「**Paramètres avec référence: 31 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres sans référence: 19 / 50**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把**没有出处的那 19 个参数逐行列出来**（**含参数路径、说明与日期**）**，**并把一部法律的出处状态逐字标成**「**à résoudre**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它把**来源文件本身放进仓库**——`doc/` 下有** `Tableau synoptique Régimes tunisiens SS.doc` **与** `Taux de cotisation CNSS ET CNRPS.xlsx`；**⭐⭐ ④ 规则与测试都是**数据**（**63 份 YAML 参数、**`tests/formulas/` 下另有 YAML 用例**）**。**⚠️ 本次未安装、未运行、未读任何参数值或法律条文**。
entries.summary_hk: **openfisca-tunisia-pension**（PyPI 發行名 `OpenFisca-Tunisia-Pension`，**版本 5.3.1**）**是 OpenFisca 微模擬框架下的**突尼斯養老金規則模組**：**許可 AGPL-3.0-or-later**、**要求 Python ≥3.10**、**依賴** `openfisca-core[web-api]`（**逐字釘在** `>=44.0.3,<45.0.0`**）與** `openfisca-tunisia>=0.80`；**實測最新版本 2026-09-10 上傳**，**倉庫提交同日**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「登記與出處」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它自己生成一份參數出處審計報告**——`reports/openfisca/pension_source_audit.md`**（首行逐字**「**Généré le 2026-09-10 par `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py`.**」**）**，**並逐字公布自己的缺口**：**「**Fichiers paramètres retraite: 63**」**、**「**Paramètres avec référence: 31 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres sans référence: 19 / 50**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把**沒有出處的那 19 個參數逐行列出來**，**並把一部法律的出處狀態逐字標成**「**à résoudre**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它把**來源文件本身放進倉庫**——`doc/` 下有** `Tableau synoptique Régimes tunisiens SS.doc` **與** `Taux de cotisation CNSS ET CNRPS.xlsx`；**⭐⭐ ④ 規則與測試都是**資料**。**⚠️ 本次未安裝、未運行、未讀任何參數值或法律條文**。
entries.summary_en: **openfisca-tunisia-pension**, released on the package index as version 5.3.1, **is the Tunisian pension rules module built on the OpenFisca microsimulation framework**: **licence AGPL-3.0-or-later**, **Python 3.10 or later required**, depending on the OpenFisca core package with a narrow version pin and on a sibling country model package; the newest release was uploaded on 2026-09-10 and the repository was committed to the same day. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance, and this project turns provenance into a runnable artefact**: **it generates its own audit report of parameter sources**, titled verbatim as an audit of pension sources and stating verbatim that it was generated on 2026-09-10 by a named script, and **it publishes its own gap counts**, reporting sixty-three pension parameter files, fifty parameters carrying values or schedules, **thirty-one of those fifty carrying a reference and nineteen without one**; it then lists all nineteen parameters without a reference line by line with their descriptions and dates, and marks one law source verbatim as still to be resolved. **It also keeps the documents it transcribed from, a Word file and a spreadsheet, inside the repository**, and both its rules and its test cases are data files rather than code. **Nothing was installed, run, or read parameter by parameter this round.**
entries.body:
**openfisca-tunisia-pension**（PyPI 发行名 `OpenFisca-Tunisia-Pension`，**版本 5.3.1**；GitHub 仓库 `openfisca/openfisca-tunisia-pension`）**是 OpenFisca 微模拟框架下的**突尼斯养老金规则模块**，**逐字自述为**「**Ceci est le code source du module Tunisien dédié aux pensions.**」（**同一句在英文段里逐字为**「**This is the source code of the Tunisian pension module.**」**）**。**本次实测**：**PyPI 最新版本 `5.3.1` 上传时间 2026-09-10**、**该 PyPI 项目共 9 个版本**；**仓库提交时间同日 2026-09-10**（**经提交 Atom 流实测**）；**默认分支是** `master`（**`main` 分支下 `README.md` 探测返回 404，而 `master` 下为 200、6,901 字节**）；**许可逐字为** AGPL-3.0-or-later（**README 逐字**「**Son code source est distribué sous la licence GNU Affero General Public Licence version 3 ou ultérieure**」**，**PyPI 分类器逐字**「**License :: OSI Approved :: GNU Affero General Public License v3**」**）**；**Python 要求 ≥3.10**；**运行依赖逐字含** `openfisca-core[web-api]<45.0.0,>=44.0.3`、`openfisca-tunisia>=0.80`、`numba`、`numpy`、`scipy`，**开发额外项含** `pytest`、`ruff`、`twine`、`yamllint`、`requests` 等，**notebook 额外项含** `ipykernel`、`jupyter-client`、`matplotlib`、`nbconvert`、`nbformat`、`pandas`；**PyPI 分类器另逐字给出** `Development Status :: 5 - Production/Stable` 与 `Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Information Analysis`。**仓库文件清单经 tarball 枚举为 177 条路径**。本条目属于本轮主题**「登记与出处：让别人查得到，也让每个数回得去」**；**本词条认为它是本轮四条里把「出处」做得最**重**的一条**——**它把出处做成了一份**会重新生成的审计报告**。

**可核实信息（均仓库文件清单、README、PyPI 元数据与审计报告实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它会自己生成一份「哪些参数还没有出处」的审计报告**——`reports/openfisca/pension_source_audit.md`（**实测 5,811 字节**）**标题逐字为**「**Audit sources retraite OpenFisca Tunisia Pension**」**，**首行逐字为**「**Généré le 2026-09-10 par `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py`.**」**，**而**生成者是** `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py`（**本次实读其文件头，**逐字含一行 docstring**「**Generate a source coverage audit for pension parameters.**」**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 该报告的 Synthèse 一节逐字公布自己的缺口**：**「**Fichiers paramètres retraite: 63**」**、**「**Paramètres avec valeurs ou barèmes: 50**」**、**「**Paramètres avec référence: 31 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres sans référence: 19 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres multi-dates: 6**」**、**「**Textes JORT locaux: 1**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**它没有说「参数都有法律依据」，而是**逐字写出 31／50 与 19／50 两个数**——**⭐ 即**「**我核到了 31 条，还有 19 条没核到**」**被写进一份**每次都会重新生成的报告**里**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把没有出处的那 19 个参数逐个列出来**——报告末节标题逐字为**「**Paramètres sans référence**」**，**表头逐字为** `Paramètre`／`Description`／`Dates`，**本次实读到的行含** `retraite.cnrps.age_legal.civil.enseignants_du_superieur`（**说明逐字**「**Age de départ à la retraite pour certains enseignants du supérieur**」）、`retraite.cnrps.pension_minimale.minimum_garanti`、`retraite.rsa.age_legal` **等**。**⭐ 即**缺口不是一句「部分参数待补」，**而是**一张带参数路径与日期的清单**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它把「引用了哪些法律、各被几个参数引用、状态如何」也列成表**——报告里逐字给出**「**Textes cités dans les références**」**一节**（**表头为** `Texte`／`Occurrences paramètres`／`Statut`**）**，**本次实读到的行含**：`1959-18`（**逐字**「**Loi n° 59-18 du 5 février 1959, pensions civiles et militaires**」）**3 个参数、**状态逐字**「**JORT 1959/8, texte pivot**」；`1985-12`（**逐字**「**Loi n° 85-12 du 5 mars 1985, pensions civiles et militaires secteur public**」）**17 个参数、**状态逐字**「**JORT 1985/20, texte pivot**」；**以及** `1985-611` **4 个参数、**状态**逐字标为**「**à résoudre**」**。**⭐ 即**它连「这一部我还没找到出处」**也写在表里**，**而不是悄悄留空**——**⭐ 这与本站 [[insurance-governance]] 一类条目关注的「可追溯性」是同一件事，只是这里追溯的对象是**法律文本**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 它把来源文件本身放进了仓库**——文件清单实测** `openfisca_tunisia_pension/doc/` **下有** `Tableau synoptique Régimes tunisiens SS.doc` **与** `Taux de cotisation CNSS ET CNRPS.xlsx`；**⭐ 即**「**这些参数是从哪份表抄来的**」**这个问题的答案**不只是引用，**而是一份**同仓的 Word 与 Excel**（**⚠️ 本次未打开这两个文件，**故不主张其内容与参数一致**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 规则是数据，测试也是数据**——文件清单实测** `parameters/` 下 **63 份 YAML**（**全文共 74 份 YAML**），**按制度分成** `parameters/retraite/cnrps/{accessoires 13, age_legal 7, bareme_annuite 1, bonifications 9, capital_deces 6, depart_anticipe 12, duree_de_service_minimale 1, pension_minimale 5, survivants 6}` **与** `parameters/retraite/rsa/age_legal`；**另有** `variables/` 13 条与 `regimes/` 6 条；**而** `tests/formulas/` **下的用例本身也是 YAML**（**实测含** `cnrps/pension.yaml`、`cnrps/pension_minimale.yaml`、`cnrps/salaire_de_reference.yaml`、`cnrps/taux_de_liquidation.yaml`、`rsna/pension.yaml`、`rsna/taux_de_liquidation.yaml`、`test_accessoires.yaml`、`test_depart_anticipe.yaml`），**其余测试才是 Python**（**实测含** `test_anticipe.py`、`test_bonifications.py`、`test_capital_deces.py`、`test_coordination.py`、`test_regimes_speciaux.py`、`test_survivants.py`、`test_parametres_partages.py`、`test_tools.py`）。**⭐ 即**「**用给定的输入与该给的输出表**」**被当成数据来写**，**而不是塞进断言语句里**——**⭐ 这也解释了为什么 CI 里会有一条**「**只 lint 改动过的 YAML 测试**」**的脚本**（**逐字文件名** `.github/lint-changed-yaml-tests.sh`**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 发布流程是仓库里的一组脚本，而不是平台上的黑箱**——`.github/` **实测含十个自定义脚本**：`get_minimal_version.py`、`get_pypi_info.py`、`has-functional-changes.sh`、`is-version-number-acceptable.sh`、`lint-changed-python-files.sh`、`lint-changed-yaml-tests.sh`、`publish-git-tag.sh`、`pyproject_version.py`、`split_tests.py`、`test-api.sh`，**另有** `dependabot.yml`、**议题与拉取请求模板**；**工作流三个**：`workflow.yml`、`validate_yaml.yml`、`tax-benefit.yml`。**⭐ 即**「**版本号能不能接受**」「**有没有功能性改动**」「**要不要打 tag**」**这些判断都写成了可读的脚本**（**⚠️ 本次未读这些脚本的内容，**故不主张其判定逻辑**）。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 生成器要读的东西有一部分**不在仓库里**——**本次实读** `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py` **的文件头常量**，**它逐字定义** `PARAMETERS_DIR = ROOT / "openfisca_tunisia_pension" / "parameters" / "retraite"`、`JORTS_DIR = ROOT / "tmp" / "JORTs"`、**以及一个**仓库外**的 SQLite 缓存** `EXTERNAL_JORT_CACHE = ROOT.parent / "PDFs-legislation-tunisie" / "jort_cache.db"`，**并会写** `reports/openfisca/pension_source_audit.md` **与** `parameters_candidates/retraite_source_candidates.yml`。**⭐ 而本次的文件清单里**：`tmp/` **下只有** `tmp/manuel.txt` **与** `tmp/manuel pensions.pdf`，**没有** `tmp/JORTs/`；**也没有** `parameters_candidates/` **目录**。**⚠️ 本词条如实记录这一处**：**那份报告的表里点名了一个**本地路径**下的 JORT 法律文本文件，**而本次在该仓库的文件清单里没有找到它**——**⭐ 本词条只记录这个实测结果**，**不推测原因**（**report 是生成物，**可能在本机存在该文件的环境里生成**；**⚠️ 本次未核实** `scripts/` **下是否有忽略规则，亦未核实**该文件是否曾存在过**）。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 登记层面有两处可核查的不一致**：**①** PyPI 元数据的 `project_urls` **里** Changelog **一项逐字指向** `https://github.com/openfisca/openfisca-tunisia-pension/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md`**，**而该仓库的默认分支实测是** `master`（**本次未核实** `main` **分支是否存在**，**但** `main` **下的** `README.md` **确实返回 404**）**；**②** README 顶部的构建状态徽章**逐字指向** `travis-ci.org`**，**而文件清单里**没有 `.travis.yml`**（**`master/.travis.yml` 本次探测 404**）**。**⭐ 本词条如实记录这两处**，**不推测原因**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 它在框架里的位置本身就是一种接线**：**依赖里逐字含** `openfisca-core[web-api]>=44.0.3,<45.0.0`（**即**把核心钉在一个主版本区间内**）与** `openfisca-tunisia>=0.80`（**即**养老金模块**接在国家税制模块之上**）**；**README 逐字给出的文档入口有三个**：项目总文档 `doc.openfisca.fr`（**含逐字的**「**schéma des composants**」**组件图**）、**突尼斯立法浏览器** `legislation.openfisca.tn`、**以及一个 GitHub wiki**。**⭐ ⑩ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[openfisca]] 记录的是这个微模拟引擎本身**，**本条补上的是**一个具体国家的具体给付分支**（**养老金**）；**与 [[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[colombian-pension-observatory]]、[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]] 一类条目相比**，**本条记录的不是机构页或论文**，**而是**把养老金规则写成可执行数据**的那种做法**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[openfisca]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「社会保障类给付规则如何被写成数据、并如何被追到法条」的一个完整样本**；**其中与本词条项目自身最同构的一点是**：**它生成一份报告**逐条列出**自己哪些参数**还没有出处**，**并把其中一部法律的状态标成**「**待解决**」。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装 OpenFisca、没有安装该模块、没有运行任何一次模拟、没有执行 `make` 或任何测试**，**故不主张**任何给付计算、任何参数取值、任何期限或比例**按所述工作**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**：**这是一部**社会保障法律规则**的实现**，**其法律准确性本词条完全没有核实**——**本次**未打开任何一部被引用的法律文本**（**未访问** `legislation.openfisca.tn`、**未读** `tmp/manuel pensions.pdf`、**未打开** `doc/` **下的 Word 与 Excel**）**，**故**不应据本条目采信任何法律或给付结论**；**本词条只记录它的工程做法与自述数字**。**③ ⚠️ 未读任何参数 YAML 的内容**——**本次只看到路径清单与计数**，**故不主张** 63 份参数文件的实际内容、多日期参数的处理方式、以及各制度的实际规则。**④ ⚠️ 审计报告的数字是**该报告自己生成的**（**本次**未重跑该生成器**，**未逐条核对 31／50 与 19／50 **是否正确**）；**⭐ 本词条只记录「它公布了这两个数」这一事实**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实那份报告里**「**JORT 1959/8**」一类卷期标注是否正确**，**也未核实** `1985-611` **的出处是否真的未找到**（**本次未做任何法律检索**）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未读** `.github/` **十个脚本的内容**、**未读三个工作流**、**未核实 CI 当前是否通过**；**未核实** `test-api.sh` **要测的是哪个 API**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实** PyPI 分类器自述的 `Production/Stable` **是否与实际情况相符**；**未核实**该模块是否被任何机构实际使用**。**⑧ ⚠️ 许可为 AGPL-3.0-or-later**（**README 与 PyPI 分类器一致**），**⚠️ 本次未读 `LICENSE` 正文**；**⭐ 顺带记录**：**AGPL 对「以网络服务形式提供」有额外要求**，**而**本条**不对其合规影响作任何判断**。**⑨ ⚠️ 仓库提交 2026-09-10 与版本上传 2026-09-10 都在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「自生成参数出处审计报告 ＋ 把来源 Word／Excel 放进仓库 ＋ 公布未核实的法律关系」这一组合，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑪ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用法文时，原文里的 ASCII 撇号一律写作 ’**——**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**。

**openfisca-tunisia-pension**（PyPI 發行名 `OpenFisca-Tunisia-Pension`，**版本 5.3.1**；GitHub 倉庫 `openfisca/openfisca-tunisia-pension`）**是 OpenFisca 微模擬框架下的**突尼斯養老金規則模組**。**本次實測**：**PyPI 最新版本 `5.3.1` 上傳時間 2026-09-10**、**該 PyPI 專案共 9 個版本**；**倉庫提交時間同日 2026-09-10**（**經提交 Atom 流實測**）；**預設分支是** `master`（**`main` 下 `README.md` 探測 404，`master` 下為 200、6,901 位元組**）；**許可逐字為** AGPL-3.0-or-later；**Python 要求 ≥3.10**；**運行依賴逐字含** `openfisca-core[web-api]<45.0.0,>=44.0.3`、`openfisca-tunisia>=0.80`、`numba`、`numpy`、`scipy`；**檔案清單經 tarball 列舉為 177 條路徑**。本條目屬於本輪主題**「登記與出處」**。

**可核實資訊（均倉庫文件清單、README、PyPI 元數據與審計報告實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它會自己生成一份「哪些參數還沒有出處」的審計報告**——`reports/openfisca/pension_source_audit.md`（**實測 5,811 位元組**）**標題逐字為**「**Audit sources retraite OpenFisca Tunisia Pension**」**，**首行逐字為**「**Généré le 2026-09-10 par `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py`.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 該報告的 Synthèse 一節逐字公布自己的缺口**：**「**Fichiers paramètres retraite: 63**」**、**「**Paramètres avec valeurs ou barèmes: 50**」**、**「**Paramètres avec référence: 31 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres sans référence: 19 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres multi-dates: 6**」**、**「**Textes JORT locaux: 1**」**。**⭐ 即**它沒有說「參數都有法律依據」，**而是逐字寫出 31／50 與 19／50**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把沒有出處的那 19 個參數逐個列出來**——末節標題逐字為**「**Paramètres sans référence**」**，**表頭逐字為** `Paramètre`／`Description`／`Dates`。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它把「引用了哪些法律、各被幾個參數引用、狀態如何」也列成表**——逐字給出**「**Textes cités dans les références**」**一節**；**本次實讀到的行含** `1959-18`（**3 個參數**，**狀態逐字**「**JORT 1959/8, texte pivot**」）、`1985-12`（**17 個參數**，**狀態逐字**「**JORT 1985/20, texte pivot**」），**以及** `1985-611`（**4 個參數**，**狀態逐字標為**「**à résoudre**」**）**。**⭐ 即**它連「這一部我還沒找到出處」**也寫在表裡**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 它把來源文件本身放進了倉庫**——`openfisca_tunisia_pension/doc/` **下有** `Tableau synoptique Régimes tunisiens SS.doc` **與** `Taux de cotisation CNSS ET CNRPS.xlsx`。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 規則與測試都是資料**——`parameters/` 下 **63 份 YAML**（**全文 74 份**），**另有** `variables/` 13 條與 `regimes/` 6 條；**而** `tests/formulas/` **下的用例本身也是 YAML**（**含** `cnrps/pension.yaml`、`cnrps/taux_de_liquidation.yaml`、`rsna/pension.yaml`、`test_accessoires.yaml`、`test_depart_anticipe.yaml` **等**）。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 發布流程是倉庫裡的一組腳本**——`.github/` **含十個自訂腳本**（`get_minimal_version.py`、`get_pypi_info.py`、`has-functional-changes.sh`、`is-version-number-acceptable.sh`、`lint-changed-python-files.sh`、`lint-changed-yaml-tests.sh`、`publish-git-tag.sh`、`pyproject_version.py`、`split_tests.py`、`test-api.sh`）**與三個工作流**（`workflow.yml`、`validate_yaml.yml`、`tax-benefit.yml`）。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 生成器要讀的東西有一部分**不在倉庫裡**——**本次實讀** `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py` **的檔案頭常量**，**它逐字定義** `JORTS_DIR = ROOT / "tmp" / "JORTs"` **與一個**倉庫外**的 SQLite 快取** `EXTERNAL_JORT_CACHE = ROOT.parent / "PDFs-legislation-tunisie" / "jort_cache.db"`；**而本次清單裡** `tmp/` **下只有** `tmp/manuel.txt` **與** `tmp/manuel pensions.pdf`**，**沒有** `tmp/JORTs/`；**也**沒有** `parameters_candidates/`**。**⚠️ 本詞條只記錄這個實測結果，不推測原因**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 登記層面有兩處可核查的不一致**：**①** PyPI 的 Changelog 連結逐字指向 `blob/main/CHANGELOG.md`，**而預設分支實測是** `master`；**②** README 的建置狀態徽章逐字指向 `travis-ci.org`，**而清單裡**沒有 `.travis.yml`**（**`master/.travis.yml` 探測 404**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 它在框架裡的位置本身就是一種接線**：**依賴釘住** `openfisca-core[web-api]>=44.0.3,<45.0.0` **並接在** `openfisca-tunisia>=0.80` **之上**；**README 逐字給出三個文件入口**（`doc.openfisca.fr`、`legislation.openfisca.tn`、GitHub wiki）。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[openfisca]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「社會保障類給付規則如何被寫成資料、並如何被追到法條」的一個完整樣本**；**其中與本詞條專案自身最同構的一點是**：**它生成一份報告**逐條列出**自己哪些參數**還沒有出處**，**並把其中一部法律的狀態標成**「**待解決**」。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝 OpenFisca、沒有安裝該模組、沒有運行任何一次模擬、沒有執行任何測試**，**故不主張**任何給付計算、參數取值、期限或比例**按所述工作**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**：**這是一部**社會保障法律規則**的實作**，**其法律準確性本詞條完全沒有核實**——**未打開任何一部被引用的法律文本**，**故**不應據本條目採信任何法律或給付結論**。**③ ⚠️ 未讀任何參數 YAML 的內容**（**只看到路徑清單與計數**）。**④ ⚠️ 審計報告的數字是**該報告自己生成的**（**未重跑生成器、未逐條核對 31／50 與 19／50**）。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實報告裡「**JORT 1959/8**」一類卷期標註**，**也未核實** `1985-611` **的出處是否真的未找到**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未讀** `.github/` **十個腳本與三個工作流的內容**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實**自述的 `Production/Stable` **是否相符，**未核實**是否被任何機構實際使用**。**⑧ ⚠️ 許可為 AGPL-3.0-or-later，未讀 `LICENSE` 正文**；**本詞條不對其合規影響作任何判斷**。**⑨ ⚠️ 倉庫提交與版本上傳 2026-09-10 都在解凍窗口之內**，**故本條不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但「自生成參數出處審計報告 ＋ 把來源 Word／Excel 放進倉庫 ＋ 公布未核實的法律關係」這一組合，此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑪ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用法文時，原文裡的 ASCII 撇號一律寫作 ’**——**以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（引文內容未改）**。

**openfisca-tunisia-pension**, released as version 5.3.1 and housed at `openfisca/openfisca-tunisia-pension`, **is the Tunisian pension rules module built on the OpenFisca microsimulation framework**. **Measured this round**: the newest release was uploaded on 2026-09-10 and the project has nine releases in total; **the repository was committed to the same day**, measured through its commit feed; **the default branch is `master`**, with a README probe returning 404 on `main` and 200 with 6,901 bytes on `master`; **the licence is AGPL-3.0-or-later**, stated in the README and matching the package index classifier; **Python 3.10 or later is required**; runtime dependencies cover the OpenFisca core package with a web API extra, pinned to a single major version, plus a sibling country model package, numba, numpy and scipy; and the file listing enumerates 177 paths from a tarball. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance, and it is the heaviest of the round four on provenance, because it turns provenance into an audit report that can be regenerated.**

**Verified information, all measured from the file listing, the README, the package metadata and the audit report itself**: **first, it generates its own audit of which parameters still lack a source.** The report under the reports directory, measuring 5,811 bytes, is titled verbatim as an audit of pension sources and opens verbatim by stating that it was generated on 2026-09-10 by a named script, which this round read the head of, and whose docstring says verbatim that it generates a source coverage audit for pension parameters. **Its synthesis section publishes its own gaps verbatim**: sixty-three pension parameter files, fifty parameters carrying values or schedules, **thirty-one of those fifty carrying a reference, nineteen without one**, six multi-date parameters and one local legal text. **It never claims that every parameter has a legal basis; it prints both counts.** **Second, it lists all nineteen parameters without a reference one by one**, under a heading that says so, with columns for the parameter path, its description and its dates, and lines this round read include the legal retirement age for certain higher-education teachers, the guaranteed minimum pension and the legal retirement age under another regime. **The gap is not a sentence saying some parameters remain to be completed; it is a list with parameter paths and dates.** **Third, it tabulates which laws are cited, by how many parameters, and in what state**, under a heading about the texts cited in the references, with columns for text, number of parameters and status. Lines read this round include a 1959 law on civil and military pensions cited by three parameters with a status naming a specific issue of the official gazette and calling it a pivot text, a 1985 law on public-sector pensions cited by seventeen parameters with a similar status, and a 1985 text cited by four parameters whose status is marked verbatim as **still to be resolved**. **It writes down that it has not yet found the source for one law, instead of leaving the cell blank.** **Fourth, it keeps the documents it transcribed from inside the repository**: under the package documentation directory there is a Word file described as a synoptic table of the Tunisian social security regimes and a spreadsheet of contribution rates for two named funds, **so the answer to where these parameters came from is not only a citation but a same-repository Word file and spreadsheet, whose contents were not opened this round**. **Fifth, rules and tests are both data**: there are sixty-three YAML parameter files, organised by regime into directories for supplements, legal age, annuity scales, bonuses, death capital, early departure, minimum service duration, minimum pension and survivors, alongside variables and regimes; and the test cases under the formulas directory are themselves YAML, covering pension, minimum pension, reference salary and liquidation rate for two regimes, with the remaining tests written in Python. **The expectation of given input producing given output is therefore written as data rather than buried in assertions, which also explains why one of the continuous integration scripts exists solely to lint changed YAML tests.** **Sixth, the release process is a set of scripts in the repository rather than a platform black box**: ten custom scripts cover deriving a minimal version, fetching package index information, detecting functional changes, deciding whether a version number is acceptable, linting changed Python files and changed YAML tests, publishing a git tag, reading the version from the project metadata, splitting tests and exercising an API, alongside three workflows. **Whether a version number is acceptable and whether a tag should be published are written as readable scripts whose contents this round did not read.** **Seventh, part of what the generator reads is not in the repository**: the script head defines a parameters directory, a directory for legal texts under a temporary folder name, **and an SQLite cache in a sibling directory outside the repository**, and writes both the audit report and a candidate file. In the listing this round, the temporary directory contains only a text file and a PDF manual, **with no legal texts directory, and there is no candidates directory either, so the report names a local path for a legal text that this round did not find in the repository listing; this entry records the measurement without speculating about the cause, noting only that the report is a generated artefact and may have been produced where that file existed locally.** **Eighth, two registration inconsistencies are checkable**: the package metadata changelog link points at a `main` branch while the measured default branch is `master`, and the README build badge points at a continuous integration service that no longer operates while the listing contains no configuration file for it, with a probe for that file returning 404. **Both are recorded without speculation about cause.** **Ninth, its position in the framework is itself a kind of wiring**: it depends on the core package with a narrow pin to one major version and on a sibling country model package, and its README names three documentation entry points, the project documentation including a component diagram, a Tunisian legislation browser, and a wiki. **Tenth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled `[[openfisca]]` entry covers the microsimulation engine itself, while this entry supplies one country benefit branch; compared with entries such as `[[pensions-authority-ie]]`, `[[colombian-pension-observatory]]` and `[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]]`, this entry is not an institutional page or a paper but a way of writing pension rules as executable data.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[openfisca]]**, because **it is a complete sample of how social security benefit rules get written as data and traced back to statutes**, and the part most structurally similar to this wiki own practice is that **it generates a report listing which of its parameters still have no source, and marks one law as still to be resolved**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, OpenFisca was not installed, the module was not installed, no simulation was run and no test was executed**, **so no benefit calculation, parameter value, period or rate is claimed to work as described**. **Second, and most in need of later verification: this is an implementation of social security law, and its legal accuracy was not examined at all** — no cited legal text was opened, the Tunisian legislation browser was not visited, the PDF manual was not read and the Word and spreadsheet files under the documentation directory were not opened — **so no legal or benefit conclusion should be taken from this entry, which records engineering practice and self-reported counts only**. **Third, no parameter file content was read**, only path listings and counts, so nothing is claimed about the contents of those sixty-three files, how multi-date parameters are handled, or the actual rules of each regime. **Fourth, the audit numbers are generated by that report itself**, and the generator was not re-run and the counts were not checked line by line; **this entry records only the fact that it publishes those two counts**. **Fifth, the correctness of the gazette issue references was not verified**, nor whether the source for the law marked as unresolved is genuinely unfound, since no legal search was performed. **Sixth, the ten integration scripts, the three workflows and current CI status were not read or checked**, nor was it established which API one of the test scripts exercises. **Seventh, whether the production-stable classifier the package assigns itself is accurate was not verified, nor whether any institution actually uses this module. Eighth, the licence is AGPL-3.0-or-later by the README and the package classifier, whose licence text was not read, and no judgement is offered on the compliance implications of that licence for network use. Ninth, both the commit and the release upload fall on 2026-09-10, inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed; however, the combination of a self-generated parameter provenance audit, the transcribed source documents kept in the repository, and published unresolved legal relationships had no counterpart in the pool. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11. Eleventh, quotation convention: ASCII apostrophes in quoted French text are rendered as curved apostrophes so that this entry contains no ASCII single quote, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged.**
