entries.title: **三层标准叠在一起，而最上面那层是从 fork 里抽出来当库用的**：巴西 **Open Insurance 认证测试套件**——**上一层是 Open Banking 认证套件，再上一层是 OpenID 基金会的 FAPI 套件**；**⭐ 它逐字写明这套做法的取舍**（**逐字**「**In effect, the OBB conformance suite is a dependency of this project, in exactly the same way that JUnit is.**」）；**⭐ 并逐字承认代价**（**逐字**「**features introduced into the OBB codebase aren’t immediately available to us**」）
entries.title_en: Three layers of standards stacked, with the top layer pulled out of a fork and used as a library: the Brazilian Open Insurance conformance suite sits on top of the Open Banking conformance suite, which in turn is a fork of the OpenID Foundation FAPI suite; the project states its central design choice verbatim, that the banking conformance suite is a dependency of this project in exactly the same way that JUnit is, and states the cost of that choice verbatim as well, that features introduced into the banking codebase are not immediately available here.
entries.title_hk: **三層標準疊在一起，而最上面那層是從 fork 裡抽出來當庫用的**：巴西 **Open Insurance 認證測試套件**——**上一層是 Open Banking 認證套件，再上一層是 OpenID 基金會的 FAPI 套件**；**⭐ 它逐字寫明這套做法的取捨**（**逐字**「**In effect, the OBB conformance suite is a dependency of this project, in exactly the same way that JUnit is.**」）；**⭐ 並逐字承認代價**（**逐字**「**features introduced into the OBB codebase aren’t immediately available to us**」）
entries.summary: **raidiam-conformance/open-insurance/open-insurance-brasil**（GitLab）**是巴西 **Open Insurance** 认证的测试套件**——**⭐ 而它最有价值的部分不是测试本身，而是它逐字写下的**为什么这样搭**：**⭐⭐⭐ ①** 它**不 fork**：**逐字**「**As OBB CS is itself a fork of another FOSS project run by the OpenID Foundation, it was considered that we could simply fork that project again, or fork the OBB CS, but maintaining a single fork is problematic enough, so a spike was performed to see if the OPIN-specific code could be pulled out into effectively a library project. That is this project.**」**——**⭐ 即**它把「**再 fork 一次**」这个看起来最自然的做法**先否掉**，**改成把保险费部分抽成一个**库**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 依赖链是**三层标准****：**OpenID 基金会 FAPI 套件 → Open Banking Brasil 认证套件 → 本仓库（Open Insurance）**；**它的 `pom.xml` 逐字为** `<name>Open Insurance Brasil Conformance Library</name>`、**依赖** `fapi-conformance-suite`、**版本属性逐字为** `<fapi.conformance.version>0.0.2-7498ca78</fapi.conformance.version>`（**即**一个固定版本号＋上游短提交号**）；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 取舍是双向写明的**：**优点**（**构建稳定**、**维护代码极少**、**不必等上游那套「经常不稳、总是很慢」的功能测试**）**与**缺点**（**上游新功能不会立刻可用**，**须等其合入 master 再改版本号**）**；**⭐⭐ ④ 源码几乎只剩测试计划**——**逐字**「**The bulk of the code lives in dependencies, so the source code of this is sparse and consists almost entirely of OPIN test plans, modules and their supporting code.**」**；**⭐ 测试模块按**险种**组织**（**`phase1` 下可见** `autoInsurance`、`cyberRisk`、`directorsOfficersLiability`、`engineering`、`exportCredit` **等**；**`phase3` 下** `quotePersonLife`、`quoteHousing`、`quoteRural`、`quoteTransport` **等，**且同一险种留下 `v1n9`／`v1n11`／`v2` 三代**）；**⚠️ 本次未构建、未运行任何测试、未读 Java 源码，**也未核实它是否获得任何监管认可**。
entries.summary_hk: **raidiam-conformance/open-insurance/open-insurance-brasil**（GitLab）**是巴西 **Open Insurance** 認證的測試套件**——**⭐ 而它最有價值的部分不是測試本身，而是它逐字寫下的**為什麼這樣搭**：**⭐⭐⭐ ①** 它**不 fork**：**逐字**「**maintaining a single fork is problematic enough, so a spike was performed to see if the OPIN-specific code could be pulled out into effectively a library project. That is this project.**」**——**⭐ 即**它把「**再 fork 一次**」這個最自然的做法**先否掉**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 依賴鏈是**三層標準****：**OpenID 基金會 FAPI 套件 → Open Banking Brasil 認證套件 → 本倉庫**；**`pom.xml` 逐字為** `<name>Open Insurance Brasil Conformance Library</name>`、**依賴** `fapi-conformance-suite`、**版本屬性逐字為** `<fapi.conformance.version>0.0.2-7498ca78</fapi.conformance.version>`；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 取捨是雙向寫明的**（**優點**：**構建穩定**、**維護程式碼極少**、**不必等上游那套「經常不穩、總是很慢」的功能測試**；**缺點**：**上游新功能不會立刻可用**）**；**⭐⭐ ④ 原始碼幾乎只剩測試計劃**（**逐字**「**The bulk of the code lives in dependencies, so the source code of this is sparse and consists almost entirely of OPIN test plans, modules and their supporting code.**」）**；**⭐ 測試模組按**險種**組織**，**且同一險種留下 `v1n9`／`v1n11`／`v2` 三代**；**⚠️ 本次未構建、未運行任何測試、未讀 Java 原始碼**。
entries.summary_en: The repository `raidiam-conformance/open-insurance/open-insurance-brasil` on GitLab **is the conformance test suite for the Brazilian Open Insurance standard**, and **its most valuable part is not the tests themselves but the reasoning it writes down verbatim about how it is assembled**: it rejects the obvious move of forking again, stating that because the banking suite is itself a fork of an OpenID Foundation project, it was considered that the banking suite could simply be forked again, but that maintaining a single fork is already problematic enough, so an investigation was run to see whether the insurance-specific code could be pulled out into effectively a library project, and that is what this repository is. **The dependency chain is therefore three layers of standards**: the OpenID Foundation FAPI suite, then the Brazilian Open Banking conformance suite, then this insurance suite, whose build file names itself an Open Insurance Brasil Conformance Library and depends on the FAPI conformance suite through a version property that combines a rarely changing version number with a short commit hash of the upstream project. **The tradeoffs are stated in both directions**: build stability, very little code to maintain, and not having to wait for the upstream functional tests that it calls often flaky and always long-winded, against the cost that features introduced upstream are not immediately available here. **The source is deliberately sparse**, consisting almost entirely of insurance test plans and their supporting code, and the test modules are organised by line of business, with parallel versions of the same line kept side by side. **Nothing was built, no test was run, no Java source was read, and whether any regulator recognises this suite was not verified.**
entries.body:
**raidiam-conformance/open-insurance/open-insurance-brasil**（**GitLab 仓库**）**是巴西 **Open Insurance**（保险业数据共享与接口标准）认证用的**测试套件**。**本次实测**：**★7**、**fork 4**、**创建 2021-12-21**、**最后活动 2026-09-08**、**默认分支 `main`**、**GitLab 项目接口未报出许可**（**本次未在仓库根看到 `LICENSE`**）。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**同源多形：一份内容、好几种形态，且必须对得上**」**；**本词条认为它是本轮四条里唯一一条**把「**这件事为什么要这么做**」写成正式文档**的**。**仓库根实测含** `pom.xml`、`Dockerfile`、`Makefile`、`.gitlab-ci.yml`、`README.md`、**六个 docker-compose 变体**（`docker-compose.yml`、`-dev`、`-dev-mac`、`-dev-mac-nodocker`、`-dev-linux-nodocker`、`-localtest`），**以及目录** `src/`、`scripts/`、`docs/`、`terraform/`、`httpd/`、`.gitlab/`、`.idea/`。

**可核实信息（均 README、`docs/DEVGUIDE.md`、`pom.xml` 与 GitLab 接口实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 文档的第一节标题就是「为什么会有这个东西」**——`docs/DEVGUIDE.md`（**实测 3,795 字节**）**的 Why this exists 一节逐字**：**「**In the past, the Open Insurance Conformance Suite - hereafter referred to as OPIN CS - has been a deployment of the same codebase as the Open Banking Brasil Conformance Suite - hereafter referred to as OBB CS - with different configuration parameters to surface different test plans. While this was a useful mechanism it tied two discrete development lifecycles together in ways which were undesirable. One project would often be impacted by bugs in another stream, the deployment of OPIN CS was tied to OBB CS work and so forth.**」**——**⭐ 即**它先交代**过去是「同一份代码、两套配置」**，**再说明那样做的具体代价**（**两个开发节奏被绑在一起、一个项目常被另一条线的 bug 波及**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它明确否掉了「再 fork 一次」并给出替代方案**——**逐字**：**「**As OBB CS is itself a fork of another FOSS project run by the OpenID Foundation, it was considered that we could simply fork that project again, or fork the OBB CS, but maintaining a single fork is problematic enough, so a spike was performed to see if the OPIN-specific code could be pulled out into effectively a library project. That is this project.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处推理链**：**① 上游本身就是别人的 fork → ② 所以「再 fork」看起来顺理成章 → ③ 但「维护一个 fork 已经够麻烦」→ ④ 于是先做一次 spike 验证「能不能把保险费那部分抽成一个库」→ ⑤ 结果就是这个仓库**。**⭐ 即**它把「**不这么做**」的理由**与「**这么做**」的做法**写在同一个文件里**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 复用的具体机制被写成可核对的四步**——**逐字**：**「**The OBB CS code is commonly packaged as a Spring Boot fatjar, which is subsequently packaged as a docker image which then gets deployed onto EKS clusters. The build pipeline has been modified so that the Java code is also packaged as a simple Java jar which is published to a Maven repositoru. This jar is available for use by the OPIN CS project, which first of all uses it as a compile-time dependency, then also packages itself as a Spring Boot fatjar with the OPIN code included.**」**（**原文该处把 repository 拼成了 repositoru，本词条照原文引用**）**——**⭐ 即**上游的构建流水线**被改过一次**（**多产出一个普通 jar 并发到 Maven 仓库**），**好让下游能把它当**编译期依赖**用**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 取舍写成对等的两节**——**优点三处逐字**：**「**Stability of build. The OPIN CS project depends on a specific, tested release of the OBB CS code, so any breaking changes to OBB CS will not impact this project at all.**」、**「**Much less code to maintain. The bulk of the code lives in dependencies, so the source code of this is sparse and consists almost entirely of OPIN test plans, modules and their supporting code.**」、**「**We do not need to wait for the often-flaky, always long-winded OBB functional tests to complete before we can deploy.**」；**缺点逐字**：**「**The main tradeoff for this stability is that features introduced into the OBB codebase aren’t immediately available to us. As we have a dependency expressed through Maven co-ordinates on a specific release to master of the OBB code, we need to wait until a change is merged to master before we can then pull that version in to our builds.**」**，**并以一句话定性**：**「**In effect, the OBB conformance suite is a dependency of this project, in exactly the same way that JUnit is.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**上游的那套认证套件，对本项目来说就是一个依赖，跟 JUnit 一样**」——**⭐ 本词条认为这句是本轮四条里把**依赖关系**说得最直白的一句**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本钉法被专门解释**——DEVGUIDE 有一节标题逐字为**「**What’s a Maven co-ordinate?**」**，**并给出 `pom.xml` 里的依赖片段**（`groupId` 为 `net.openid`、`artifactId` 为 `fapi-conformance-suite`、**版本为** `${fapi.conformance.version}`、**classifier 为** `tests`、**scope 为** `test`**）**；**并逐字解释**「**The version co-ordinate used for this is, to keep things simple, a version number which rarely changes, followed by the short sha of the git revision which represents the master branch of the OBB project at any given time.**」**——**⭐ 本词条实测** `pom.xml`（**8,055 字节**）**里的值正是这个形状**：**逐字** `<fapi.conformance.version>0.0.2-7498ca78</fapi.conformance.version>`（**即**版本 `0.0.2` ＋ 上游短提交号 `7498ca78`**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 测试模块按**险种**组织，且同一险种保留多代版本**——**本次经 GitLab 目录接口分页枚举（每页 100 条）到第 30 页仍未结束，故实测**至少 3,000 条路径**，**其中 **1,777 个 `.java` 文件**；**测试模块组实测为** `phase1`、`phase3`、`fvp`、`pcm`、`support`、`v1`；**`phase1` 下可见** `autoInsurance`、`autoExtendedWarranty`、`capitalization`、`condominium`、`cyberRisk`、`directorsOfficersLiability`、`domesticCredit`、`electronic`、`engineering`、`environmentalLiability`、`equipmentBreakdown`、`errorsOmissionsLiability`、`exportCredit`、`extendedWarranty`、`financialRisk`、`generalLiability` **等按险种分目录**；**`phase3` 下为** `quote`＋险种**（**如** `quotePersonLife`、`quoteHousing`、`quoteRural`、`quoteTransport`、`quotePatrimonialHome`、`quotePatrimonialEngineering`、`quotePatrimonialDiversifiedRisks` **等**），**且**多个险种下**并列保留** `v1n9`、`v1n11`、`v2` **三代**（**⭐ 即**同一个险种的**不同接口版本**各有自己的测试计划**，**且**并存**而不是互相覆盖**）；**`fvp` 下含** `claimNotification`、`endorsement`、`quote`、`raffle`、`withdraw`（**其下又有** `capitalizationTitle` **与** `pension/lead`**）**；**`pcm` 下含** `consent/funnel` **与** `metrics`。**⭐ 即**「**同一套标准的不同版本、同一条业务链的不同环节**」**在这份目录结构里是**可见的**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 工程配置也可核实**：`pom.xml` **逐字给出** `<artifactId>openinsurance</artifactId>`、`<version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>`、`<name>Open Insurance Brasil Conformance Library</name>`、`spring-boot-starter-parent` **版本** `2.7.17`、**以及** `spring-security-core` `5.2.8.RELEASE`、`hamcrest` `2.1`、`mockito-core` `3.1.0`、**`archunit` `1.4.1`**、`gson` `2.10.1`、`json-path` `2.4.0`；**⭐ 其中 `.archunit` 是**架构测试**库**——**⭐ 即**这份「只剩测试计划」的代码**还被架构规则约束着**（**⚠️ 本次未读其架构规则内容，故不主张它约束了什么**）；**根目录另有** `terraform/`（**基础设施即代码**）**与** `scripts/configs/{fvp,phase2,phase3}/v2/generated`（**生成的配置**）**。**⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[susep-open-insurance]] 与 [[susep-sro]] 记录的是**巴西监管方（SUSEP）**一侧**，**[[acord]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]]、[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[openinsurance]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 覆盖**标准与接口**的相邻主题**，**而本条补上的是**「**标准怎么被认证**」这一层**——**⭐ 即**一份标准**在被大量实现之后，**需要有一个**可重复执行的一致性测试**来判定某个实现算不算合规**；**它同时与 [[open-risk-api]]、[[eiopa-registers]] 一类「监管数据接口」条目构成同一主题的不同侧面**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[susep-open-insurance]]、[[acord]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「保险数据共享标准落地」这件事里最少被写到的一环**：**不是接口定义，而是**判定一个实现是否合规的那套测试**；**⭐ 而它对写工程文档的启示同样直接**：**当你要在两个上游之间做选择时，把「为什么不那样做」和「这样做的代价」都写下来**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有构建、没有运行任何测试、没有部署任何环境**（**未装 JDK 或 Maven、未 `mvn test`、未起任何容器、未访问任何被测试的接口**），**故不主张**任何测试计划按所述执行、不主张任何实现能通过认证、也不主张该套件当前的通过状态。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 Java 源码**——**本次只读了** `README.md`（703 字节）、`docs/DEVGUIDE.md`（3,795 字节）、`pom.xml`（8,055 字节）**与目录清单**，**故不主张**测试用例的内容、断言强度、覆盖了哪些接口、以及 `support/` 与 `v1/` 两个模块组的用途。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实该套件与监管的关系**：**本次未访问任何 SUSEP 或 Open Insurance Brasil 官方页面、未核实该套件是否被指定为官方认证工具、也未核实「通过」意味着什么**；**本词条只记录仓库自述**。**④ ⚠️ 目录清单是**分页枚举到第 30 页为止**的结果**（**每页 100 条、30 页均为满页**），**故「至少 3,000 条路径」是**下界**而不是总数**；**「1,777 个 `.java` 文件」为本次枚举范围内实测值**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实许可**：**GitLab 项目接口未报出许可**，**本次在仓库根清单里也没有看到 `LICENSE` 文件**——**故本词条不主张其许可状态**（**⭐ 本词条按惯例把「未声明许可」记为**权利不明**，**而不是记为「无版权」**）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实** `terraform/` **与** `httpd/` **的实际内容**、**未读 `.gitlab-ci.yml`**、**未核实 CI 当前是否通过**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实维护方背景**（**项目路径中的 RaidiAM 与 Open Banking Brasil 的关系本次未查**）；**★7、fork 4 是该仓库在 GitLab 上的实测值，不构成质量证据**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2021-12-21 在解冻窗口之外、最后活动 2026-09-08 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**标准的一致性测试套件**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**（**池内条目覆盖标准本身、监管数据接口与保险 API 封装，但没有一条记录「判定实现是否合规的那套测试」**）。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用英文原文时，把原文里的 ASCII 撇号（`aren’t` 一处、`What’s` 一处）写作 ’**——**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改，**其中 `repositoru` 一处为原文拼写，**已逐字保留并注明**）**。

**raidiam-conformance/open-insurance/open-insurance-brasil**（**GitLab 倉庫**）**是巴西 **Open Insurance**（保險業資料共享與介面標準）認證用的**測試套件**。**本次實測**：**★7**、**fork 4**、**建立 2021-12-21**、**最後活動 2026-09-08**、**預設分支 `main`**、**GitLab 專案介面未報出許可**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**同源多形：一份內容、好幾種形態，且必須對得上**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、`docs/DEVGUIDE.md`、`pom.xml` 與 GitLab 介面實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 文件的第一節標題就是「為什麼會有這個東西」**——Why this exists 一節逐字**：**「**In the past, the Open Insurance Conformance Suite - hereafter referred to as OPIN CS - has been a deployment of the same codebase as the Open Banking Brasil Conformance Suite - hereafter referred to as OBB CS - with different configuration parameters to surface different test plans. While this was a useful mechanism it tied two discrete development lifecycles together in ways which were undesirable.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它明確否掉了「再 fork 一次」並給出替代方案**——**逐字**：**「**maintaining a single fork is problematic enough, so a spike was performed to see if the OPIN-specific code could be pulled out into effectively a library project. That is this project.**」**——**⭐ 即**它把「**不這麼做**」的理由**與「**這麼做**」的做法**寫在同一個檔案裡**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 復用的具體機制被寫成可核對的四步**——**逐字**：**「**The OBB CS code is commonly packaged as a Spring Boot fatjar, which is subsequently packaged as a docker image which then gets deployed onto EKS clusters. The build pipeline has been modified so that the Java code is also packaged as a simple Java jar which is published to a Maven repositoru. This jar is available for use by the OPIN CS project, which first of all uses it as a compile-time dependency, then also packages itself as a Spring Boot fatjar with the OPIN code included.**」**（**`repositoru` 為原文拼寫，照原文引用**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 取捨寫成對等的兩節**——**優點逐字**：**「**Stability of build. The OPIN CS project depends on a specific, tested release of the OBB CS code, so any breaking changes to OBB CS will not impact this project at all.**」、**「**Much less code to maintain. The bulk of the code lives in dependencies, so the source code of this is sparse and consists almost entirely of OPIN test plans, modules and their supporting code.**」、**「**We do not need to wait for the often-flaky, always long-winded OBB functional tests to complete before we can deploy.**」；**缺點逐字**：**「**The main tradeoff for this stability is that features introduced into the OBB codebase aren’t immediately available to us.**」**，**並以一句定性**：**「**In effect, the OBB conformance suite is a dependency of this project, in exactly the same way that JUnit is.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本釘法被專門解釋**——DEVGUIDE 有一節標題逐字為**「**What’s a Maven co-ordinate?**」**，**並逐字解釋**「**a version number which rarely changes, followed by the short sha of the git revision which represents the master branch of the OBB project**」**；**⭐ 本次實測** `pom.xml` **裡的值正是這個形狀**：**逐字** `<fapi.conformance.version>0.0.2-7498ca78</fapi.conformance.version>`。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 測試模組按**險種**組織，且同一險種保留多代版本**——**目錄介面分頁列舉到第 30 頁仍未結束，故實測**至少 3,000 條路徑**、**其中 **1,777 個 `.java` 檔**；**模組組為** `phase1`、`phase3`、`fvp`、`pcm`、`support`、`v1`；**`phase1` 下按險種分目錄**（`autoInsurance`、`cyberRisk`、`directorsOfficersLiability`、`engineering`、`exportCredit` **等**），**`phase3` 下為** `quote`＋險種**（**含** `quotePersonLife`、`quoteHousing`、`quoteRural`、`quoteTransport`**），**且多個險種下並列保留** `v1n9`、`v1n11`、`v2` **三代**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 工程配置也可核實**：`pom.xml` **逐字給出** `<name>Open Insurance Brasil Conformance Library</name>`、`spring-boot-starter-parent` `2.7.17`、**以及** `archunit` `1.4.1`（**架構測試**）**、**`mockito-core` `3.1.0`、`gson` `2.10.1`**；**根目錄另有** `terraform/` **與** `scripts/configs/{fvp,phase2,phase3}/v2/generated`**。**⭐ ⑧ 與池內條目的關係**：**本站 [[susep-open-insurance]]、[[acord]]、[[openinsurance]]、[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]] 覆蓋標準與介面的相鄰主題**，**而本條補上的是**「**標準怎麼被認證**」這一層**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[susep-open-insurance]]、[[acord]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「保險資料共享標準落地」這件事裡最少被寫到的一環**：**不是介面定義，而是**判定一個實作是否合規的那套測試**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有構建、沒有運行任何測試、沒有部署任何環境**，**故不主張**任何測試計劃按所述執行、不主張任何實作能通過認證。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何 Java 原始碼**——**只讀了** `README.md`、`docs/DEVGUIDE.md`、`pom.xml` **與目錄清單**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實該套件與監管的關係**（**未訪問 SUSEP 或 Open Insurance Brasil 官方頁面、未核實「通過」意味著什麼**）。**④ ⚠️ 目錄清單是**分頁列舉到第 30 頁為止**的結果**，**故「至少 3,000 條路徑」是**下界**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實許可**：**GitLab 介面未報出許可，**倉庫根也未見 `LICENSE`**——**故不主張其許可狀態**（**按慣例記為**權利不明****）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實** `terraform/` **與** `httpd/` **內容、未讀 `.gitlab-ci.yml`**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實維護方背景**；**★7／fork 4 不構成品質證據**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2021-12-21 在解凍窗口之外、最後活動 2026-09-08 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「**標準的一致性測試套件**」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用英文原文時，把原文裡的 ASCII 撇號（`aren’t`、`What’s`）寫作 ’**——**以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（引文內容未改）**。
entries.body_en:
The GitLab repository `raidiam-conformance/open-insurance/open-insurance-brasil` **is the conformance test suite used for certification against the Brazilian Open Insurance standard**. **Measured this round**: **7 stars**, **4 forks**, **created 2021-12-21**, **last activity 2026-09-08**, **default branch `main`**, and **no licence reported** by the GitLab project API, with no licence file seen at the repository root. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one source taking several forms, and of those forms having to agree.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the developer guide, the build file and the GitLab API**: **first, the first section of its documentation is why the thing exists at all.** The developer guide, measuring 3,795 bytes, states verbatim that in the past the insurance conformance suite had been a deployment of the same codebase as the banking conformance suite with different configuration parameters to surface different test plans, and that while this was useful it tied two discrete development lifecycles together in ways that were undesirable, one project often being impacted by bugs in another stream. **It first explains what the previous arrangement cost, in specifics.** **Second, it explicitly rejects forking again and states the alternative**, verbatim: because the banking suite is itself a fork of another free software project run by the OpenID Foundation, it was considered that the banking suite could simply be forked again, but maintaining a single fork is problematic enough, so an investigation was run to see whether the insurance-specific code could be pulled out into effectively a library project, **and that is what this repository is**. **This entry considers that reasoning chain the most copyable thing of the round: the upstream is itself somebody else fork, so forking again looks natural, but maintaining one fork is already troublesome, so a spike was run to test whether the insurance part could become a library, and the result is this project.** **Third, the reuse mechanism is written as four checkable steps**: the banking code is normally packaged as a Spring Boot fatjar and then as a docker image deployed to Kubernetes clusters; the build pipeline was modified so the Java code is also packaged as a plain Java jar published to a Maven repository; this repository consumes it first as a compile-time dependency and then packages itself as a Spring Boot fatjar with its own code included. **The upstream build pipeline was changed once, to emit an extra artefact, purely so that a downstream project could depend on it.** **Fourth, the tradeoffs are given as two matching sections.** The stated advantages, verbatim, are stability of build, because the dependency is on a specific, tested release so breaking changes upstream cannot affect this project; much less code to maintain, because the bulk of the code lives in dependencies and the source here is sparse and consists almost entirely of insurance test plans, modules and their supporting code; and not having to wait for the upstream functional tests that it calls often flaky and always long-winded. The stated disadvantage, verbatim, is that features introduced upstream are not immediately available, because the dependency is expressed through Maven coordinates on a specific release of the upstream master branch, so a change must be merged upstream before it can be pulled in. The section closes with the sentence this entry considers the plainest statement of a dependency relationship of the round: that in effect the banking conformance suite is a dependency of this project, in exactly the same way that JUnit is. **Fifth, the version pinning is explained on its own**: a section asks what a Maven coordinate is and gives the dependency block, naming the group, the artefact, the version property, the classifier and the test scope, then explains verbatim that the version coordinate is a number which rarely changes followed by the short commit hash of the upstream master branch at any given time. **The measured value in the build file is exactly that shape**, a three-part version followed by an eight-character hash. **Sixth, the test modules are organised by line of business, and several lines keep multiple generations side by side**: enumeration through the GitLab tree interface reached thirty full pages of one hundred entries each without ending, so **at least three thousand paths were measured, including 1,777 Java files**; the module groups are a discovery and onboarding phase, a later phase, a functional validation phase, a consent and metrics group, a support group and a version group; the first phase contains directories for motor insurance, cyber risk, directors and officers liability, engineering and export credit among others; the later phase holds quote plans per line, including life, housing, rural and transport, with several lines keeping three parallel generations of interface version rather than overwriting one another; and the validation group covers claim notification, endorsement, quote, raffle and withdrawal, the last splitting into a capitalisation title branch and a pension branch with a lead sub-branch. **The structure makes visible both the different versions of one standard and the different stages of one business chain.** **Seventh, the build configuration is checkable too**: the build file names itself an Open Insurance Brasil Conformance Library, inherits from a Spring Boot parent at version 2.7.17, and declares dependencies including Spring Security, Hamcrest, Mockito, an architecture testing library, Gson and a JSON path library, with a Terraform directory and generated configuration directories at the root. **The architecture testing dependency is notable because it means even this sparse code is constrained by architecture rules, though those rules were not read here.** **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled `[[susep-open-insurance]]` and `[[susep-sro]]` entries record the Brazilian regulator side, and `[[acord]]`, `[[acord-mcp-architecture]]`, `[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]`, `[[openinsurance]]` and `[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]` cover adjacent standard and interface topics, while this entry supplies the layer least often written about: **not the interface definition, but the repeatable consistency test that decides whether an implementation counts as compliant.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[susep-open-insurance]] and [[acord]]**, because **it documents the least-documented link in making an insurance data-sharing standard real**, and because its documentation practice transfers directly: when choosing between two upstreams, write down both why the alternative was rejected and what the chosen path costs.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, nothing was built, no test was run and no environment was deployed** — no JDK or Maven was installed, no test phase was executed, no container was started and no tested interface was contacted — **so no test plan is claimed to execute as described, no implementation is claimed to pass certification and no current pass status is claimed**. **Second, no Java source was read**: only the 703-byte README, the 3,795-byte developer guide, the 8,055-byte build file and a directory listing were read, **so nothing is claimed about the contents or strength of the test cases, which interfaces they cover, or what the support and version module groups are for; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the relationship to any regulator was not verified** — no official SUSEP or Open Insurance Brasil page was visited, whether this suite is designated as the official certification tool was not checked, and what passing it means was not established; **this entry records the repository own statements only**. **Fourth, the directory listing is a paginated enumeration capped at thirty pages**, so the figure of at least three thousand paths is a lower bound rather than a total, and the Java file count is a measured value within that range only. **Fifth, the licence was not established**: the GitLab project API reports none and no licence file was seen at the repository root, **so this entry claims no licence status, recording an absent declaration as unclear rights rather than as the absence of copyright**. **Sixth, the Terraform and httpd directories were not examined, the continuous integration file was not read, and whether the pipeline currently passes was not checked. Seventh, the maintaining organisation was not researched, and the star and fork counts on GitLab are not evidence of quality. Eighth, the creation date of 2021-12-21 is outside the thaw window while the last activity of 2026-09-08 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that a conformance test suite for a standard had no counterpart in the pool**, which covers standards, regulator data interfaces and API wrappers but not the test that decides compliance. **Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11. Tenth, quotation convention: ASCII apostrophes in the quoted English were rendered as curved apostrophes so that this entry contains no ASCII single quote, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged, and one misspelling in the original was preserved verbatim and noted as such.**

entries.title: **把「用邮件寄来的收费目录」接成 FHIR 术语表**：奥地利 **ELGA** 的 **HoKUS** 流水线——**输入是**寄到 GitLab Service Desk 的 CSV／XLSX 附件**，**输出是**FHIR CodeSystem 与 spreadCT 工作簿**，**再由 CI 自动向术语服务器提合并请求**；**⭐ 每条概念码是**内容哈希**（**SHA-256 取 128 位**），**故同一份内容永远得到同一个码、**版本一改码就跟着改**；**⭐ 每 5 分钟自动跑一次**
entries.title_en: Turning fee catalogues that arrive by email into FHIR terminology: the HoKUS pipeline at ELGA in Austria takes CSV or XLSX attachments sent to a GitLab Service Desk as input and produces FHIR CodeSystems and spreadCT workbooks, with continuous integration opening a merge request against the terminology server automatically; every concept code is a content hash of 128 bits taken from SHA-256, so identical content always yields the same code and any change of version yields a different one, and the whole pipeline re-runs every five minutes.
entries.title_hk: **把「用電郵寄來的收費目錄」接成 FHIR 術語表**：奧地利 **ELGA** 的 **HoKUS** 流水線——**輸入是**寄到 GitLab Service Desk 的 CSV／XLSX 附件**，**輸出是**FHIR CodeSystem 與 spreadCT 工作簿**，**再由 CI 自動向術語伺服器提合併請求**；**⭐ 每條概念碼是**內容雜湊**（**SHA-256 取 128 位**），**故同一份內容永遠得到同一個碼、**版本一改碼就跟著改**；**⭐ 每 5 分鐘自動跑一次**
entries.summary: **HoKUS**（`elga-gmbh/terminologit/term-tools/hokus`，GitLab）**是奥地利电子健康机构 **ELGA** 旗下的一条术语流水线**，**逐字标题为**「**Honorarkataloge Import Pipeline for FHIR CodeSystem Generation**」，**README 实测 11,140 字节**、**许可 GPL-3.0**（**仓库根 `LICENSE` 正文前几行为** GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE Version 3**）**、**创建 2026-07-29**、**最后活动 2026-09-07**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「同源多形」**，**它把「多形」的**两端**都写清了**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 输入是**别人寄来的异构表格****——**两个 CI 作业逐字为**「**dispatch-service-desk**」**（**取回 Service Desk、**把最新的 CSV／XLSX 附件存进 `input/`、**并取出寄件人域名**）与**「**process-catalog**」**；**触发器逐字**「**Every 5 minutes via Pipeline Schedule**」**；**⭐ 而输入格式逐字列出**「**CSV (UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, cp1252)**」**与**「**XLSX (first non-empty sheet with header row)**」，**并给出一张**列名别名表**（**如** `gueltig_ab`／`Gültig ab`／`Gültig_ab`、`rueckerstattung`／`Rückerstattung`，**逐字说明**「**case-insensitive, robust handling of umlauts**」**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 输出是标准术语**——**FHIR CodeSystem**（**实测 `terminology/` 下四个 `.4.fhir.json`**：**`fachgebiet`（专业领域）、`versicherungstraeger`（保险机构）、`bundesland`（联邦州）、`status-verrechenbarkeit`（可结算状态）**）**与** spreadCT 工作簿**（**逐字**`meta`／`data` **两个工作表＋可选** `errors`**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 概念码是**内容哈希**——**逐字**「**Algorithm: SHA-256**」**、**「**Length: 128 bits (Base64URL, approx. 22 characters)**」**、**「**Canonical representation: Fixed field order, special NULL token, UTF-8 encoding**」**，**且**版本键**逐字为** `fachgebiet`＋`positionsnummer`＋`gueltig_ab` **三个字段**「**always included in the hash**」**；**⭐⭐ ④ 写完就提合并请求**（**仓库根有** `create_termgit_mr.py`，**CI 变量逐字含** `TERMGIT_PROJECT_ID: "33179072"` **与** `TERMGIT_TARGET_BRANCH: "main"`**）**。**⚠️ 本次未运行该流水线、未读任何脚本正文、未打开任何 FHIR 文件全集**。

entries.summary_en: **HoKUS**, in the GitLab tree of the Austrian electronic health organisation ELGA, **is a terminology pipeline** titled verbatim as an import pipeline for fee catalogues that generates FHIR CodeSystems; its README measures 11,140 bytes, it is licensed GPL-3.0, created 2026-07-29 and last active 2026-09-07. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one source taking several forms, and the pipeline writes down both ends.** The input is heterogeneous spreadsheets sent by other organisations: two continuous integration jobs fetch a Service Desk inbox, save the newest CSV or XLSX attachment into an input directory and extract the sender domain, then process the catalogue; the trigger is a pipeline schedule every five minutes; and the accepted formats are listed verbatim with an alias table for column names and a note about case-insensitive handling of umlauts. The output is standard terminology: four FHIR CodeSystems covering medical specialty, insurance carrier, federal state and billability status, plus a spreadCT workbook with a metadata sheet, a data sheet and an optional errors sheet. **Every concept code is a content hash**: SHA-256 truncated to 128 bits and rendered in Base64URL, about twenty-two characters, over a canonical representation with fixed field order, a special null token and UTF-8 encoding, with a version key of specialty, position number and valid-from date that is always included. **And the result is proposed upstream automatically**: the repository carries a script that opens a merge request against the terminology server, with the target project and branch configured in the pipeline. **The pipeline was not run this round, no script body was read, and no FHIR file was opened in full.**
entries.body:
**HoKUS**（**GitLab 仓库** `elga-gmbh/terminologit/term-tools/hokus`）**是奥地利电子健康机构 **ELGA** 的术语工具组里的一条流水线**，**逐字标题为**「**Honorarkataloge Import Pipeline for FHIR CodeSystem Generation**」（**收费目录导入流水线：生成 FHIR CodeSystem**）**。**本次实测**：**★0**、**fork 1**、**创建 2026-07-29**、**最后活动 2026-09-07**、**默认分支 `main`**、**许可 GPL-3.0**（**仓库根 `LICENSE` 正文逐字为** GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE Version 3**）**；**README 实测 11,140 字节**；**仓库文件清单实测 15 条**：`readme.md`、`dispatcher.py`、`tarif_to_spreadct.py`、`non_sem_but_content_based_id_creator.py`、`create_termgit_mr.py`、`requirements.txt`（**逐字为** `pandas`、`openpyxl`、`requests`**）**、`.gitlab-ci.yml`、`.env.example`、`.gitignore`、`LICENSE`、**以及** `terminology/` **下四个 FHIR JSON**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**同源多形：一份内容、好几种形态，且必须对得上**」**。

**可核实信息（均 README、文件清单、`.gitlab-ci.yml` 与一个 CodeSystem 全文实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 输入端是「别人寄来的表格」，而且写清了为什么难**——**README 逐字给出两个作业**：**「**1. **dispatch-service-desk**: Fetches the Service Desk, saves the latest CSV/XLSX attachment to the `input/` directory, and extracts the sender domain.**」**与**「**2. **process-catalog**: Processes the tariff file with `tarif_to_spreadct.py` and generates a domain-specific spreadCT output file.**」**；**⭐ 数据来源是**邮件**（**逐字**「**Send an email to the project’s Service Desk address. Attach a CSV or XLSX file with tariff data.**」**）**，**触发器逐字为**「**Every 5 minutes via Pipeline Schedule**」**；**⭐ 输入格式逐字为**「**CSV (UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, cp1252)**」与「**XLSX (first non-empty sheet with header row)**」**，**README 另附一张**列名别名表**（**左列为规范名、右列为别名**，**逐字说明**「**The program recognizes the following columns (case-insensitive, robust handling of umlauts)**」**；**本次实读到的别名含** `gueltig_ab` ← `Gueltig_ab, Gültig ab, Gültig_ab`；`rueckerstattung` ← `Rueckerstattung, Rückerstattung`；`geldleisterbetrag` ← `Geldleisterbetrag, Geldleisterbetr?ge`（**该行在 README 里带一个编码损坏字符，本词条以问号代替并如实标注**）**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**它没有说「我们支持各种格式」，而是把**接受的编码**、**取哪一张工作表**、**列名的各种叫法**逐个写出来**——**⭐ 即**「**异构**」被具体化成了可以对照的清单**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 输出端是标准术语，而且产物是可数的几样**——**`terminology/` 下实测四个 FHIR 资源文件**（**文件名为** `CodeSystem-honorarkataloge-fachgebiet.4.fhir.json`、`CodeSystem-honorarkataloge-versicherungstraeger.4.fhir.json`、`CodeSystem-honorarkataloge-bundesland.4.fhir.json`、`CodeSystem-honorarkataloge-status-verrechenbarkeit.4.fhir.json`**）**；**⭐ 本次打开其中一个（`versicherungstraeger`）实测其头部字段**：**`resourceType` 为** `CodeSystem`、**`url` 逐字为** `https://termgit.elga.gv.at/CodeSystem/honorarkataloge-versicherungstraeger`、**`version` 逐字为** `0.3.0+20251010`、**`status` 为** `draft`、**`date` 为** `2025-10-10`、**`content` 为** `complete`、**`count` 与 `concept` 数量均为** 50（**即** 50 家保险机构**）**；**⭐ 另一产物是** spreadCT 工作簿**，**逐字**「**The output file contains at least two worksheets: meta — Transposed metadata (key-value pairs)；data — Concepts with CodeSystem properties**」**，**并逐字说明可选的第三张**「**errors — Validation errors and warnings**」**。**⭐ 即**输出文件**自己带一张错误表**——**⭐ 与本站第 338／343 轮记下的「**机器可读的产物要自带不确定性的位置**」同形**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 概念码不是编号，而是**内容哈希****——README 有专节逐字标题**「**Content-Based Codes (Non-Semantic)**」**，**并逐字给出**：**「**Algorithm: SHA-256**」**、**「**Length: 128 bits (Base64URL, approx. 22 characters)**」**、**「**Canonical representation: Fixed field order, special NULL token, UTF-8 encoding**」**；**并逐字说明**版本键**：**「**A tariff version is uniquely identified by the combination of: `fachgebiet` (medical specialty)`／`positionsnummer` (position number)`／`gueltig_ab` (valid from date). These three fields are **always** included in the hash. Changes to any of them produce a different concept code.**」**；**另逐字列出**参与哈希的 18 个字段**（**fachgebiet、positionsnummer、gueltig_ab、traegercode、leistungsart、leistungsgruppe、leistungskategorie、bezeichnung_kurztext、bezeichnung_langtext、bundesland、tarif、rueckerstattung、geldleisterbetrag、status_verrechenbarkeit、privattarif、beschreibungstext、dauer_der_leistung、flags**）**与**两个可选字段**（**`hono_id` 需 `--include-hono-id`、`gueltig_bis` 需 `--include-dates`**）**；**CLI 选项逐字含** `--include-hono-id`、`--include-dates`、`--hash-bits 256`、`--trim-strings`（**逐字注明**「**default: enabled**」**）、`--lowercase-hash-input`；**README 另用一张四行表说明**「**Different Versions Produce Different Codes**」**（**同位置号不同生效日、不同专业领域、不同位置号各得不同码**）**。**⭐ 即**同一份内容**永远得到同一个码**（**可复核：拿原表重算即可**），**而**内容或生效期一改**，**码就跟着变**（**不必依赖某个中心的分配表**）——**⭐ 这正是「同源多形」里的**一致性问题**：**多份来源、多次导入，怎么保证「同一条项目」不被重复登记或错误合并。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 产物会**自动被提出去**——**仓库根有** `create_termgit_mr.py`，**而 `.gitlab-ci.yml`（实测 6,768 字节）逐字含变量** `TERMGIT_PROJECT_ID: "33179072"`、`TERMGIT_TARGET_BRANCH: "main"`、**以及** `TERMGIT_MR_REVIEWERS`（**逐字注释**「**Reviewer usernames (comma-separated, e.g., "user1,user2,user3")**」**）**——**⭐ 即**流水线跑完会**向术语仓库（termgit）开一个合并请求**，**并由人复核后才并入**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ CI 本身也交代了它的阶段与容错**——`.gitlab-ci.yml` **逐字给出四阶段** `stages: .pre / test / dispatch-process-mr / analyze`；**默认镜像** `python:3.12-slim`；**两个全局变量逐字为** `PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: "1"` 与 `PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR: "1"`；**作业** `py-compile` **逐字列出四个脚本名**（`dispatcher.py`、`tarif_to_spreadct.py`、`non_sem_but_content_based_id_creator.py`、`create_termgit_mr.py`），**另一个作业** `type-check` **带** `allow_failure: true`（**⭐ 即**类型检查**允许失败而不拦流水线**）**；**两个作业都带** `retry: max: 2` **且限定在** `runner_system_failure` **与** `stuck_or_timeout_failure` **两种情形**（**⭐ 即**只重试**基础设施故障**，**不重试**代码错误**）。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 输出端的规范 URL 与序列化格式也被写明**——README 逐字给出四张 CodeSystem 的规范 URL（**前缀均为** `https://termgit.elga.gv.at/CodeSystem/honorarkataloge-`）**，**并逐字给出编码序列化格式**「**system|version|code|display**」**与一个例子**：`https://termgit.elga.gv.at/CodeSystem/honorarkataloge-bundesland|0.3.0+20251010|3|Burgenland`。**⭐ 即**「**一条编码长什么样**」**在这里是可以逐字对照的**（**并与本次实测的那份 CodeSystem 版本号一致**）。**⚠️ 本次实测到两处**文档与仓库不一致**（**如实记录、不推测原因**）**：**① README 把生成非语义标识的模块写作** `non_sem_content_based_id_creator.py`**，**而仓库里的实际文件名是** `non_sem_but_content_based_id_creator.py`（**CI 的 `py-compile` 作业逐字用的是后者**）；**② README 的别名表里有一处编码损坏字符**（**本次以问号代替**）**。**⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[acord]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]] 记录的是保险业数据标准的组织与架构层**，**[[omop-common-data-model]]、[[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[icd-r]] 覆盖医疗数据与编码映射**，**[[medical-opinion-extractor]]、[[vhis-standard-premium]]、[[kokuho-rules-engine]] 覆盖「把表单／规则转成机器可读」的相邻做法**，**而本条补上的是**「**用内容哈希给术语发稳定标识，并在 CI 里自动向上游术语服务器提合并请求**」这一组合**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[omop-common-data-model]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「**异构来源 → 标准术语**」这件事的一个完整流水线样本**：**输入端把编码与列名逐一列出、输出端给出规范 URL 与序列化格式、标识用内容哈希而不是顺序号、产物自带错误表、最后由 CI 提合并请求给人复核**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该流水线**（**未发过任何邮件、未配置任何 CI 变量、未跑任何作业、未生成任何 spreadCT 或 CodeSystem**），**故不主张**该流水线按所述工作、不主张其产物可用、也不主张那些 CodeSystem 当前的状态。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 Python 脚本正文**——**本次只读了** `readme.md`（11,140 字节）、`.gitlab-ci.yml`（6,768 字节）、**文件清单、`requirements.txt` 全文**，**以及** **一个** CodeSystem **JSON 的头部字段**，**故不主张**导入与哈希的实际实现、异常处理、以及 `create_termgit_mr.py` 开 MR 的具体方式。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实哈希实现的正确性**：**未运行任何一次哈希、未对照任何已知输入输出**；**⭐ 本词条只记录「文档如此描述」与「字段清单如此」**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实那四个 CodeSystem 的实际内容**（**只完整打开了一个的头部、并看到其 `concept` 数量为 50**），**其余三个本次未打开**；**未核实其 `status` 为 `draft` 是否意味着尚未被正式采用**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** termgit **是否就是 ELGA 的正式术语服务器、未访问该域名、未核实项目 ID** `33179072` **指向何处**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实 ELGA 的机构性质与该项目在其中的正式地位**（**本次只读到组织路径与 README**）；**★0／fork 1 不构成质量证据**。**⑦ ⚠️ 许可为 GPL-3.0（本次读到 `LICENSE` 正文前几行）**，**未读全文**；**⚠️ 本词条不对 GPL 对术语数据适用性的影响作任何判断**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2026-07-29 在解冻窗口之外、最后活动 2026-09-07 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**把异构收费目录经内容哈希转成标准术语、并在 CI 里自动向上游提合并请求**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用英文与德文原文时，把原文里的 ASCII 撇号（`project’s` 一处）写作 ’**——**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**。

`0.3.0+20251010`、**`status` 為** `draft`、**`date` 為** `2025-10-10`、**`count` 與 `concept` 數量均為** 50（**即** 50 家保險機構**）**；**另一產物是** spreadCT 工作簿**（**逐字** `meta`／`data` **兩表＋可選** `errors`**）**——**⭐ 即**輸出檔自帶一張錯誤表**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 概念碼不是編號，而是**內容雜湊****——**逐字**：「**Algorithm: SHA-256**」、**「**Length: 128 bits (Base64URL, approx. 22 characters)**」**、**「**Canonical representation: Fixed field order, special `stuck_or_timeout_failure`（**⭐ 即**只重試基礎設施故障，**不重試程式錯誤**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 輸出端規範 URL 與序列化格式也被寫明**——**逐字給出四張 CodeSystem 的 URL 前綴**與序列化格式**「**system|version|code|display**」**，**例子為** entries.body_en:
**HoKUS**, in the GitLab group tree of the Austrian electronic health organisation ELGA, **is a terminology pipeline**, titled verbatim as an import pipeline for fee catalogues that generates FHIR CodeSystems. **Measured this round**: **zero stars**, **one fork**, **created 2026-07-29**, **last active 2026-09-07**, **default branch `main`**, **licensed GPL-3.0** with the licence file beginning with version 3 of the GNU General Public License; **the README measures 11,140 bytes**; and **the file listing measures fifteen entries**, holding four Python scripts, a requirements file listing pandas, openpyxl and requests, a pipeline definition, an environment example, a licence and four FHIR JSON files under a terminology directory. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one source taking several forms, and of those forms having to agree.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the file listing, the pipeline definition and a full read of one CodeSystem**: **first, the input end is spreadsheets sent in by other organisations, and the difficulty is written out rather than summarised.** The README states the two jobs verbatim: one fetches the Service Desk, saves the newest CSV or XLSX attachment into an input directory and extracts the sender domain; the other processes the tariff file and generates a domain-specific spreadCT output file. **The data arrives by email** — verbatim, send an email to the project Service Desk address and attach a CSV or XLSX file with tariff data — **and the pipeline runs on a schedule every five minutes.** The accepted formats are listed verbatim, a CSV in UTF-8, UTF-8 with a byte order mark, or the older Windows code page, and an XLSX taking the first non-empty sheet with a header row; **and the README carries a table of column-name aliases, described verbatim as case-insensitive with robust handling of umlauts**, listing for example three spellings that all map to a valid-from column and two spellings that map to a reimbursement column, **with one alias row damaged by an encoding artefact, which this entry renders with a question mark and notes as such**. **Heterogeneity is thereby made into a checklist you can compare against, rather than a claim of supporting many formats.** **Second, the output end is standard terminology, and the artefacts are countable.** The terminology directory holds four FHIR resources covering medical specialty, insurance carrier, federal state and billability status. **Opening one of them this round shows a CodeSystem whose URL points at a terminology server under the ELGA domain, whose version reads as a semantic version followed by a date, whose status is draft, whose content is complete and whose concept count is fifty** — fifty insurance carriers. The other artefact is a spreadCT workbook, described verbatim as containing at least two worksheets, one holding transposed key-value metadata and one holding concepts with their CodeSystem properties, **plus an optional third sheet that holds validation errors and warnings**, so the output file carries its own uncertainty rather than hiding it. **Third, the concept code is not a running number but a content hash.** A dedicated section lists the algorithm as SHA-256, the length as 128 bits rendered in Base64URL at about twenty-two characters, and the canonical representation as a fixed field order with a special null token and UTF-8 encoding; a version is uniquely identified by the combination of medical specialty, position number and valid-from date, and those three fields are always included in the hash, so a change to any of them produces a different concept code; eighteen further fields participate by default, with a hono identifier and an end date available through command-line switches, and a four-row table demonstrates that different specialties, positions or valid-from dates all yield different codes. **Identical content therefore always yields the same code, reproducible by anyone who recomputes the hash, while any change of content or period yields a different one without depending on a central allocation table** — which is exactly the consistency problem behind several sources and repeated imports, namely keeping one item from being registered twice or merged by mistake. **Fourth, the result is proposed upstream automatically**: the repository carries a script that opens a merge request, and the pipeline definition names the target project identifier, the target branch and an optional comma-separated reviewer list, so a human still reviews before anything is merged. **Fifth, the pipeline states its own stages and its tolerance for failure**: four stages, a slim Python 3.12 default image, two pip environment variables disabling version checks and caching, one job that compiles the four scripts by name, and a type-checking job marked as allowed to fail; both jobs retry only on runner system failure and on being stuck or timing out, **so infrastructure failures are retried and code errors are not**. **Sixth, the canonical URLs and the serialisation format are written down**, with the format given as system, version, code and display joined by pipes, and an example that matches the version string measured in the file. **Two mismatches between documentation and repository were measured**: the README names the identifier module without the extra word that the actual filename carries, and the pipeline compiles the real filename; and one alias row contains a damaged character. **Both are recorded without speculation about cause.** **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: `[[acord]]` and `[[acord-mcp-architecture]]` cover standards organisations and architectures, `[[omop-common-data-model]]`, `[[icd-hcc-mappings]]` and `[[icd-r]]` cover medical coding and mappings, and `[[medical-opinion-extractor]]`, `[[vhis-standard-premium]]` and `[[kokuho-rules-engine]]` cover adjacent form-and-rule conversions, while this entry supplies the combination of stable content-hash identifiers for terminology and continuous integration that opens a merge request upstream.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[icd-hcc-mappings]] and [[omop-common-data-model]]**, because **it is a complete pipeline sample of heterogeneous sources becoming standard terminology**: the input end lists encodings and column aliases one by one, the output end gives canonical URLs and a serialisation format, identity is a content hash rather than a sequence number, the artefact carries its own error sheet, and continuous integration proposes the result for human review.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the pipeline was not run** — no email was sent, no pipeline variable was configured, no job was executed and no spreadCT or CodeSystem was generated — **so the pipeline is not claimed to work as described, its output is not claimed usable, and the current state of those CodeSystems is not claimed**. **Second, no Python script body was read**: only the README, the pipeline definition, the file listing, the requirements file in full and the header of one CodeSystem were read, **so nothing is claimed about the actual import and hashing implementations, their error handling, or how the merge request is opened; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the correctness of the hash implementation was not verified**, no hash was computed and no known input-output pair was compared; **this entry records only that the documentation describes it this way and that the field list reads as shown**. **Fourth, the contents of the four CodeSystems were not verified**, only one header was read in full, and whether draft status means not yet formally adopted was not established. **Fifth, whether the terminology server domain is ELGA official terminology service was not verified**, the domain was not visited and the target project identifier was not resolved. **Sixth, the institutional nature of ELGA and the formal status of this project within it were not researched**, and zero stars with one fork is not evidence of quality. **Seventh, the licence is GPL-3.0 as read in the first lines of the licence file, whose full text was not read**, and no judgement is offered on how that licence bears on terminology data. **Eighth, the creation date of 2026-07-29 is outside the thaw window while the last activity of 2026-09-07 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that turning heterogeneous fee catalogues into standard terminology through content-hash identifiers and proposing the result upstream from continuous integration had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11. Tenth, quotation convention: ASCII apostrophes in quoted English and German were rendered as curved apostrophes so that this entry contains no ASCII single quote, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged.**

entries.title: **一个研究内核、五份作品，并逐字承认它们之间有重合**：上海立信会计金融学院的国家级大创项目《**分布式光伏指数保险定价**》——**用 NASA 辐照数据给光伏发电量损失定价**；**⭐ 它逐字写明**「**五份作品并非同一份材料的重复提交，而是围绕同一研究内核的不同切面。彼此有明确的继承与分工关系，也存在可识别的内容重合。**」**；**⭐ 并画出一张**定位图**把五份作品的分工摆开**；**⚠️ 而仓库里只有文档（docx／pdf／jpg），**没有代码、没有数据、也没有许可文件**
entries.title_en: One research core and five deliverables, with their overlap admitted in writing: a national college innovation programme project on pricing distributed solar index insurance from Shanghai Lixin University of Accounting and Finance, which prices lost photovoltaic generation using NASA irradiance data, states verbatim that the five works are not repeated submissions of one document but different facets of a shared core with clear inheritance and division of labour and with identifiable overlap, and lays that division out in a positioning diagram, while the repository itself holds only documents, with no code, no data and no licence file.
entries.title_hk: **一個研究內核、五份作品，並逐字承認它們之間有重合**：上海立信會計金融學院的國家級大創項目《**分布式光伏指數保險定價**》——**用 NASA 輻照數據給光伏發電量損失定價**；**⭐ 它逐字寫明**「**五份作品並非同一份材料的重複提交，而是圍繞同一研究內核的不同切面。彼此有明確的繼承與分工關係，也存在可識別的内容重合。**」**；**⭐ 並畫出一張**定位圖**把五份作品的分工擺開**；**⚠️ 而倉庫裡只有文件（docx／pdf／jpg），**沒有程式碼、沒有資料、也沒有許可檔**
entries.summary: **distributed-pv-index-insurance**（`b-bzy/distributed-pv-index-insurance`）**是上海立信会计金融学院一个国家级大学生创新创业训练计划项目（**逐字项目编号 `S202311047082`**、**逐字时间 `2022.10 – 2024.05`**）的成果归档**：**主题为**分布式光伏指数保险定价**，**共同内核逐字为**「**用卫星辐照数据给光伏发电量损失定价**」（**逐字写明用** NASA GHI **辐照数据**）**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「同源多形」**，**它是四条里把「**同一内核的多种形态**」说得最直接的一条**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它逐字承认重合**——**「**五份作品并非同一份材料的重复提交，而是围绕同一研究内核的不同切面。彼此有明确的继承与分工关系，也存在可识别的内容重合。**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一句**：**把「**我们这几份东西有重合**」**先说了出来**，**而不是让读者自己去发现**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它用一张**定位图与一张表**把关系画清**——**图里把**「**共同内核：分布式光伏 × 指数保险**／**NASA GHI 辐照数据 → 发电量损失定价**」**摆在顶**，**下面分出**①**ARIMA 论文（方法内核）**、②**参赛作品（完整产品方案）**、③**申报书（商业化落地）**、④**市调报告（需求侧）**、⑤**美赛论文（方法外延，迁移至巨灾财产险）**；**表里逐件给出**定位／风险标的／核心方法**（**含** SARIMA **时序预测、**APE 指数赔付模型＋分位数费率、**K-Means 分级保费、**结构方程与链式中介、**蒙特卡洛**）**；**⭐⭐ ③ 风险标的是**太阳辐照不足**与**光伏发电量不足**——**即**天气指数保险**，**而目录里确实同时有**中文与英文论文、产品申报书、市调报告、美赛论文与五份获奖证书**；**⚠️ 本次**未打开任何 PDF／DOCX／JPG、**未核实任何奖项、**未核对 README 与文档内容是否一致**；**⚠️ 并如实标注**：**仓库里没有代码、没有数据、**也没有 `LICENSE`**（**故本次**不主张其许可状态**）**。
entries.summary_hk: **distributed-pv-index-insurance**（`b-bzy/distributed-pv-index-insurance`）**是上海立信會計金融學院一個國家級大學生創新創業訓練計劃項目（**逐字項目編號 `S202311047082`**、**逐字時間 `2022.10 – 2024.05`**）的成果歸檔**：**主題為**分布式光伏指數保險定價**，**共同內核逐字為**「**用衛星輻照數據給光伏發電量損失定價**」**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「同源多形」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它逐字承認重合**——**「**五份作品並非同一份材料的重複提交，而是圍繞同一研究內核的不同切面。彼此有明確的繼承與分工關係，也存在可識別的内容重合。**」**——**⭐ 即**它把「**我們這幾份東西有重合**」**先說了出來**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它用一張**定位圖與一張表**把關係畫清**——**圖裡把共同內核擺在頂**，**下面分出五份作品**（**方法內核／完整產品方案／商業化落地／需求側／方法外延**）**，**表裡逐件給出**定位／風險標的／核心方法**；**⭐⭐ ③ 風險標的是**太陽輻照不足**與**光伏發電量不足**——**即**天氣指數保險**；**⚠️ 本次**未打開任何 PDF／DOCX／JPG、**未核實任何獎項**；**⚠️ 並如實標註**：**倉庫裡沒有程式碼、沒有資料、**也沒有 `LICENSE`**（**故本次**不主張其許可狀態**）**。
entries.summary_en: The repository `b-bzy/distributed-pv-index-insurance` **archives the outputs of a national college innovation programme project at Shanghai Lixin University of Accounting and Finance**, carrying the project number and period verbatim, **on pricing distributed solar index insurance**, with the shared core stated as pricing lost photovoltaic generation from satellite irradiance data, specifically NASA irradiance data. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one source taking several forms, and of the four it states that relationship most directly**: **it admits overlap in writing**, saying verbatim that the five works are not repeated submissions of one document but different facets of one research core, with clear inheritance and division of labour between them and with identifiable overlap; **and it lays that division out in a positioning diagram and a table**, placing the shared core at the top and splitting it into a methods paper, a full product proposal for a competition, a commercialisation application, a demand-side market survey and a modelling competition paper extending the method to catastrophe property insurance, with each row giving its role, its risk subject and its core method, including seasonal time-series forecasting, an index payout model with quantile-based rates, tiered premiums from clustering, structural equation modelling and Monte Carlo simulation. **The risk subjects are insufficient solar irradiance and insufficient generation, that is, weather index insurance**, and the repository indeed holds Chinese and English papers, a product application, a market survey, a competition paper and five award certificates. **No PDF, DOCX or JPG was opened, no award was verified, and the README was not reconciled against the documents; the repository also contains no code, no data and no licence file, so no licence status is claimed.**
entries.body:
**distributed-pv-index-insurance**（仓库 `b-bzy/distributed-pv-index-insurance`）**是上海立信会计金融学院一个**国家级大学生创新创业训练计划项目**的成果归档**，**README 逐字给出项目编号** `S202311047082`**与时间** `2022.10 – 2024.05`**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-08、最后推送 2026-09-08**（**两者都在解冻窗口之内**）、**★0**、**README 实测 13,456 字节**、**文件清单实测 15 条**、**其中不含任何代码或数据文件**、**也没有 `LICENSE`**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**同源多形：一份内容、好几种形态，且必须对得上**」**；**本词条认为它是四条里把「**同一内核的多种形态**」讲得最直接、**也最诚实的一条**。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它开篇就把「重合」这件事写在明面上**——**README 逐字**：**「**本仓库收录一个围绕**分布式光伏指数保险**展开的系列研究成果，共 5 份作品。它们以「用卫星辐照数据给光伏发电量损失定价」为共同内核，分别从**方法建模、产品设计、商业化申报、需求侧调研、方法外延**五个方向展开，形成一条从学术方法到落地方案的完整链路。**」**，**紧接着逐字**：**「**五份作品并非同一份材料的重复提交，而是围绕同一研究内核的不同切面。彼此有明确的继承与分工关系，也存在可识别的内容重合。**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一句**：**一份归档里同时存在五份围绕同一内核的产出时，**「**它们有重合**」**是读者最需要知道、**也最容易被作者省略的一句话**——**它选择先说**；**⭐ 而「**哪些是继承、哪些是分工、哪些是重合**」**这三件事被分开写了**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它用一张图与一张表把形态之间的关系摆开**——**README 里的定位图逐字标注共同内核为**「**分布式光伏 × 指数保险**」**与**「**NASA GHI 辐照数据 → 发电量损失定价**」**，**并从内核分出四支**：**① **ARIMA 论文**（**逐字**「**方法内核**」**、**「**只讲建模与定价**」**）**；**② **中天科技杯参赛作品**（**逐字**「**完整产品方案**」**、**「**市场·条款·费率·落地**」**）**；**③ **信保杯申报书**（**逐字**「**产品方案 · 高度重合**」**）**；**④ **正大杯市调报告**（**逐字**「**需求侧**」**、**「**不做定价，做需求**」**）**；**⑤ **美赛 ICM 论文**（**逐字**「**方法外延**」**、**「**迁移至巨灾财产险**」**）**。**⭐ 本词条特别记下第二张表**：**它逐件给出**「**定位／风险标的／核心方法**」**三列**，**其中风险标的逐字为**「**太阳辐照不足**」（①）**与**「**光伏发电量不足**」（②③）**、**④ **逐字为**「**—（不定价）**」；**核心方法逐字含**「**SARIMA 时序预测**」**、**「**ARIMA + APE 指数赔付模型 + 分位数费率**」**、**「**同 ② + K-Means 分级保费 + 承保理赔流程**」**、**「**结构方程 · 链式中介 · 文本挖掘 · 蒙特卡洛**」**。**⭐ 即**五份东西**各自的风险标的与方法是**可对照的**，**而不是五份都写「光伏指数保险」。**⭐⭐ ③ 它把「**指数保险**」这件事的核心环节点出来了**——**风险标的是**太阳辐照不足**（**可观测的物理量**）**，**赔付依据是**APE 指数赔付模型**（**⭐ APE 为该仓库原文所用缩写，**本次未读文档、**故不展开**）**，**费率用**分位数**给了多档**；**⭐ 这与本站 [[fasal-pramaan-crop-claims]]（**作物**）、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[ballast-parametric-cover]]、[[storm-parametric-corroboration]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]] **构成同一族主题**：**把不可直接赔付的损失**接到一个**可观测、可核验的指数**上**——**⭐ 而本条的风险标的是**辐照**，**数据源是**NASA**，**与 [[open-meteo]] 一类公开气象数据条目属同类做法**。**⭐⭐ ④ 文件清单印证了「五份」这个数**——**仓库实测 15 条**：`README.md`、`.gitignore`、**目录** `01-论文/`（1 个 docx：**逐字** `基于ARIMA模型的分布式光伏指数险保费预测方法_英文.docx`**）**、`02-作品/`（4 个文件：**逐字** `2024美赛ICM-ProblemE-Sustainable-Development-under-Catastrophe.pdf`、`信保杯-指数型分布式光伏发电量保险-产品申报书.docx`、`基于ARIMA模型的分布式光伏指数险保费预测方法_中文.pdf`、`碳中和背景下分布式光伏与指数保险展望-基于上海市试点地区的调查.pdf`**）**、`03-获奖证书/`（5 个文件：**逐字含** `2024-04_正大杯全国大学生市场调查与分析大赛上海市选拔赛_一等奖.jpg`、`2024-04_美国大学生数学建模竞赛ICM_Meritorious-Winner国际一等奖.pdf`、`2024-05_中天科技杯上海市大学生节能减排社会实践与科技竞赛_三等奖.jpg` **等**）**。**⭐ 即**README 说的「五份作品」在目录里是**可数的**（**1 篇论文＋4 份作品**），**另有**5 份获奖证书作为附件**。**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**该目录里**没有**任何 `.py`／`.ipynb`／`.csv` 一类**代码或数据**文件**——**即**它是一份**文档归档**，**而不是可运行的实现**；**本词条据此把它记为**文档归档**而非可运行的实现**。**⚠️ 另实测到两处**归档层面的缺口**（**只记录、不推测原因**）**：**① **没有 `LICENSE` 文件**（**故本词条不主张其许可状态，按惯例记作**权利不明****）；**② **没有数据文件**，**而 README 提到用 NASA GHI 辐照数据定价**（**本次未核实数据是随文档附带、还是仅存在于作者本地**）。**⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[fasal-pramaan-crop-claims]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[ballast-parametric-cover]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]、[[storm-parametric-corroboration]]、[[condition-parametric-zk]] 覆盖参数／指数保险的不同侧面**（**赔付触发、数据核验、产品设计**），**而本条补上的是**一个**完整的学生研究成果归档**：**同一内核下的五种形态＋它们的重合声明**——**⭐ 与 [[actuarial-student-competitions]]（**SOA 学生案例挑战赛**）、[[insurminds-desafio5]] 一类「学生作品」条目相比**，**本条的价值不在于作品本身有多成熟，而在于**它把「一个内核可以长出哪些形态」写成了可核对的清单**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[fasal-pramaan-crop-claims]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]] 应当并读**——**它给的是**天气指数保险**的一个具体标的设计样本**（**辐照 → 发电量损失 → 指数赔付 → 分位数费率**）；**⭐ 而它对写作的启示同样直接**：**当你把同一项研究交出去五次，**把它们的继承关系与重合之处写在第一页**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有打开仓库里的任何文件**（**未读那份英文或中文论文、未打开产品申报书、未打开市调报告、未打开美赛论文、未打开任何获奖证书图片**），**故不主张**其中任何方法、数据、结论或数字**按所述成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何代码——因为仓库里没有代码**；**本次只读了** `README.md` **与文件清单**，**故不主张** SARIMA 与 ARIMA 的具体设定、APE 指数赔付模型的定义、K-Means 分级的做法、分位数费率的档位、结构方程模型的变量与结果。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实任何奖项**（**未打开任何证书、未在主办方处核对**）；**README 逐字称「系列成果累计获省级以上奖项 10 余项」，**而目录里本次只看到 5 份证书**——**⭐ 本词条如实记录这一处不一致，**不推测原因**（**可能其余证书未纳入归档**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实 NASA GHI 数据的使用方式**（**未读论文、未看到数据文件**）**；**未核实**「**上海市试点地区**」**的实际调研范围与样本量**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份、学校与项目的真实性**（**本次只读到 README 自述**）；**★0 不构成质量证据，**也不构成反证**。**⑥ ⚠️ 许可未主张**：**仓库内未见 `LICENSE`**——**按惯例记为**权利不明**，**而不是「无版权」**；**⚠️ 这也意味着其中的 PDF／DOCX／JPG **不宜再分发**，**本词条只作描述与链接**。**⑦ ⚠️ 创建与推送均为 2026-09-08，**都在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「**同一研究内核的多种交付形态＋对彼此重合的显式声明**」这一形态，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。
entries.body_hk:
**distributed-pv-index-insurance**（倉庫 `b-bzy/distributed-pv-index-insurance`）**是上海立信會計金融學院一個**國家級大學生創新創業訓練計劃項目**的成果歸檔**，**README 逐字給出項目編號** `S202311047082`**與時間** `2022.10 – 2024.05`**。**本次實測**：**建立與最後推送均為 2026-09-08**（**兩者都在解凍窗口之內**）、**★0**、**README 實測 13,456 位元組**、**文件清單實測 15 條**、**其中不含任何程式碼或資料檔**、**也沒有 `LICENSE`**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**同源多形：一份內容、好幾種形態，且必須對得上**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 README 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它開篇就把「重合」寫在明面上**——**逐字**：**「**本仓库收录一个围绕分布式光伏指数保险展开的系列研究成果，共 5 份作品。它们以「用卫星辐照数据给光伏发电量损失定价」为共同内核，分别从方法建模、产品设计、商业化申报、需求侧调研、方法外延五个方向展开**」**，**緊接逐字**：**「**五份作品并非同一份材料的重复提交，而是围绕同一研究内核的不同切面。彼此有明确的继承与分工关系，也存在可识别的内容重合。**」**。**⭐ 即**它把「**我們這幾份東西有重合**」**先說了出來**，**並且把**繼承、**分工、**重合**三件事分開寫**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它用一張圖與一張表把關係擺開**——**定位圖逐字標注共同內核為**「**分布式光伏 × 指数保险**」**與**「**NASA GHI 辐照数据 → 发电量损失定价**」**，**分出四支**（**方法內核／完整產品方案／產品方案·高度重合／需求側／方法外延**）；**表裡逐件給出「**定位／風險標的／核心方法**」**，**風險標的逐字為**「**太阳辐照不足**」**與**「**光伏发电量不足**」**，**方法逐字含**「**SARIMA 时序预测**」**、**「**ARIMA + APE 指数赔付模型 + 分位数费率**」**、**「**K-Means 分级保费**」**、**「**结构方程 · 链式中介 · 文本挖掘 · 蒙特卡洛**」**。**⭐⭐ ③ 它把「**指數保險**」的核心環節點出來**——**風險標的是**太陽輻照不足**（**可觀測物理量**）**，**費率用**分位數**給多檔**；**⭐ 與本站 [[fasal-pramaan-crop-claims]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[ballast-parametric-cover]]、[[storm-parametric-corroboration]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]] **構成同一族主題**，**而本條的標的是**輻照**、**數據源是**NASA**，**與 [[open-meteo]] 一類公開氣象資料條目屬同類做法**。**⭐⭐ ④ 文件清單印證了「五份」這個數**——**15 條**：`README.md`、`.gitignore`、`01-论文/`（1 個 docx）、`02-作品/`（4 個檔案，**含**美賽 ICM PDF、信保杯申報書 docx、中文論文 PDF、市調報告 PDF**）**、`03-获奖证书/`（5 個檔案）**。**⭐ 即**README 說的「五份作品」在目錄裡是**可數的**（**1 篇論文＋4 份作品**）**。**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**目錄裡**沒有**任何 `.py`／`.ipynb`／`.csv` 一類**程式碼或資料檔**——**即**它是一份**文件歸檔**，**故本詞條把它記為**資源（resource）**而非工具**。**⚠️ 另實測到兩處**歸檔層面的缺口**（**只記錄、不推測原因**）**：**① **沒有 `LICENSE`**（**按慣例記作**權利不明****）；**② **沒有資料檔**，**而 README 提到用 NASA GHI 輻照數據定價**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[fasal-pramaan-crop-claims]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是**天氣指數保險**的一個具體標的設計樣本**；**⭐ 而它對寫作的啟示同樣直接**：**當你把同一項研究交出去五次，**把它們的繼承關係與重合之處寫在第一頁**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有打開倉庫裡的任何檔案**（**未讀論文、未打開申報書、未打開市調報告與美賽論文、未打開任何獲獎證書**），**故不主張**其中任何方法、數據、結論或數字**按所述成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何程式碼——因為倉庫裡沒有程式碼**；**本次只讀了** `README.md` **與文件清單**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實任何獎項**；**README 逐字稱「系列成果累计获省级以上奖项 10 余项」，**而本次只看到 5 份證書**——**⭐ 如實記錄這一處不一致，不推測原因**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實 NASA GHI 資料的使用方式與「上海市试点地区」的調研範圍**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份、學校與專案真實性**；**★0 不構成品質證據，也不構成反證**。**⑥ ⚠️ 許可未主張**：**未見 `LICENSE`**——**記作**權利不明**，**不是「無版權」**；**其中的 PDF／DOCX／JPG 不宜再分發，本詞條只作描述與連結**。**⑦ ⚠️ 建立與推送均為 2026-09-08，**都在解凍窗口之內**；**⭐ 但「同一研究內核的多種交付形態＋對彼此重合的顯式聲明」這一形態，此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。
entries.body_en:
The repository `b-bzy/distributed-pv-index-insurance` **archives the outputs of a national college innovation programme project at Shanghai Lixin University of Accounting and Finance**, with the project number and period given verbatim in the README. **Measured this round**: **created and last pushed on 2026-09-08**, both inside the thaw window; **zero stars**; **the README measures 13,456 bytes**; **the file listing measures fifteen entries**, containing no code and no data files and **no licence file**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one source taking several forms, and of those forms having to agree.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, it opens by putting the overlap on the record.** The README says verbatim that the repository collects a series of research outputs around distributed solar index insurance, five works in total, sharing the core of pricing lost generation from satellite irradiance data and branching into method modelling, product design, commercialisation application, demand-side research and method extension, forming a chain from academic method to deployable proposal. It then says verbatim that the five works are not repeated submissions of one document but different facets of one research core, with clear inheritance and division of labour and with identifiable overlap. **When five outputs share one core, the overlap is the thing a reader most needs to know and the thing an author is most tempted to omit; this README says it first, and separates inheritance, division of labour and overlap into three statements.** **Second, it lays the relationships out in a diagram and a table.** The diagram places the shared core at the top, named as distributed photovoltaics times index insurance and as pricing lost generation from NASA irradiance data, and branches into a methods paper described as the method core covering only modelling and pricing; a competition entry described as a complete product proposal covering market, terms, rates and rollout; an application document annotated as a product proposal with high overlap; a market survey described as the demand side that does not price anything; and a modelling competition paper described as method extension migrated to catastrophe property insurance. **A second table then gives each work its role, its risk subject and its core method**, with risk subjects reading as insufficient solar irradiance for one and insufficient generation for two others, one row explicitly marked as not pricing anything, and core methods including seasonal time-series forecasting, an index payout model with quantile-based rates, tiered premiums from clustering, and structural equation modelling with chained mediation, text mining and Monte Carlo simulation. **So the risk subject and the method of each output are comparable rather than five documents all saying solar index insurance.** **Third, it names the essential link of index insurance**: the risk subject is an observable physical quantity, the payout is driven by an index model, and the rate is given in quantile bands, **which places it in the same family as the pooled crop, parametric and catastrophe entries, where a loss that cannot be paid directly is attached to something observable and verifiable**, here irradiance measured from a public satellite source. **Fourth, the file listing corroborates the count of five**: the repository holds a README, a gitignore, a papers directory with one English Word document, a works directory with four files including a competition paper, a product application, a Chinese paper and a market survey, and a certificates directory with five files including award certificates in image and PDF form. **What the README calls five works is therefore countable in the directory, as one paper plus four works, with five certificates attached.** **This entry records honestly that the directory contains no Python, notebook or CSV files at all**, so the repository is a document archive rather than a runnable implementation, **and it is therefore recorded here as a resource rather than a tool**. **Two further gaps at the archive level are recorded without speculation about cause**: there is no licence file, so no licence status is claimed and the rights are recorded as unclear rather than as absent copyright; and there are no data files, although the README describes pricing from NASA irradiance data, so whether the data travels with the documents or exists only on the authors machines was not established. **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled crop, parametric and catastrophe entries cover different facets of index insurance such as payout triggers, data corroboration and product design, while this entry supplies a complete student research archive, being five forms of one core together with a statement of their overlap; compared with the pooled student competition entry, the value here is less the maturity of the work than the fact that the ways one core can be packaged are written down as a checkable list.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[fasal-pramaan-crop-claims]] and [[parametric-risk-toolkit]]**, because **it is a concrete design sample for one weather index insurance subject, running from irradiance to lost generation to index payout to quantile rates**, and because its writing practice transfers directly: when the same research is handed over five times, put the inheritance and the overlap on the first page.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no file in the repository was opened** — neither the English nor the Chinese paper, nor the product application, nor the market survey, nor the competition paper, nor any award certificate — **so no method, dataset, conclusion or figure inside them is claimed to hold as described**. **Second, no code was read, because the repository contains none**: only the README and the file listing were read, **so nothing is claimed about the specific settings of the time-series models, the definition of the index payout model, how the clustering into tiers is done, the quantile rate bands, or the variables and results of the structural equation model; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, no award was verified**: no certificate was opened and no organiser was checked; the README states verbatim that the series has won more than ten awards at provincial level or above, while only five certificates were seen in the directory, **and this entry records that discrepancy without speculating about its cause, noting only that the remaining certificates may not have been archived**. **Fourth, how the NASA irradiance data is used was not verified**, no paper was read and no data file was seen, nor was the actual survey scope and sample size behind the Shanghai pilot area description established. **Fifth, the identity of the authors, the institution and the project were not verified**, only the README own account was read, and zero stars is neither evidence of quality nor evidence against it. **Sixth, no licence status is claimed**: no licence file was seen, so the rights are recorded as unclear rather than as absent copyright, **which also means the PDF, Word and image files should not be redistributed and this entry only describes and links to them**. **Seventh, creation and push both fall on 2026-09-08, inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed; however, the shape of several deliverables from one research core with an explicit statement of their mutual overlap had no counterpart in the pool. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**
