It does not mean corroboration failed」与「Partial corroboration stated as partial is worth more than complete attestation to a standard met on a sample.」、逐字说明同源机构一致不构成独立确认、逐字给出十三个年度（2010–2022）与 NVSR 表 B 完全一致与 2023 计数被佐证而率未获佐证（理由为不同人口基与精度过粗）、2024 无来源、corroborated_measures 让弱主张保持弱；另逐字给出两条不变量（sum(bands)+not_stated==annual deaths 与 sum(bands)==annual population，for all 15 years, with no tolerance）与外部检查（粗死亡率复现 WONDER 公布的 Crude Rate 列，全 15 年）、--discover/--reconcile/--check（>0.5% drift 退出非零）、fetch 路径不写 data/raw/*.csv、原始导出文件故意提交并带 SHA-256｜⚠️未运行任何一步（未 bootstrap、未跑测试、未跑 src.fetch 或 src.report、未读任何 CSV 行），不主张分解结果、佐证比例或数据不变量按所述成立｜⚠️未读 STATUS.md／UAT_CHECKLIST.md／docs/denominator-methods.md 正文（只读存在与字节数）——本条目最需后续核实的一处｜⚠️未核实任何外部断言（未访问 NVSR、CDC WONDER；未核对十三个年度一致、2023 计数佐证、以及「NCHS 曾给出两个不同的 2020 粗死亡率」）｜⚠️README 内部有一处数字不一致（开头 14 of 15 对正文十三＋2023），如实记录为不一致且不调和｜⚠️未读测试代码，未核实「测试断言机器写不了 verified_by」是否真的存在，只转述原文｜⚠️未核实作者身份与机构关联；★0 不构成质量证据｜⚠️许可 BSD-3-Clause（Zenodo 字段与仓库 LICENSE 一致），未读正文｜⚠️Zenodo 记录创建与仓库推送均 2026-09-07 在解冻窗口之内，无需窗口例外；但「四列证据等级＋机器不能写核签＋改动即撤销签名＋空白不等于失败」此前池内无对应物｜⚠️本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见；引号约定：英文引文中的 ASCII 撇号写作 ’

entries.title: **一个人群、逐年滚动，所以跨文件对得上**：`synthmed`——**生成符合 ResDAC 传输规范（FTS）的合成 Medicare 理赔数据**（**MEDPAR／MBSF**），**输出是**定宽 DAT 文件**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它维持**单一内部受益人队列并逐年前推**，**因此**人口学特征、ID、地点与诊断史在各文件之间保持一致**；**⭐ 并**故意注入**真实数据质量问题**（**种族错编、**出生日期漂移、**与州相关的空 ID**）；**⭐ 每个作者标出**自己做了哪一部分****（**Zenodo DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22648509`，v0.2.0，Apache-2.0**）
entries.title_en: One cohort rolled forward year by year, so the files agree across years: synthmed generates synthetic Medicare claims data conforming to a set of ResDAC file transfer specification schemas, emitting fixed-width DAT files, and it maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries which it rolls forward one year at a time so that demographics, identifiers, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files, while deliberately injecting realistic data-quality errors such as race miscoding, date-of-birth drift and state-correlated null identifiers, with each author credited for the specific part they built.
entries.title_hk: **一個人群、逐年滾動，所以跨檔案對得上**：`synthmed`——**生成符合 ResDAC 傳輸規範（FTS）的合成 Medicare 理賠資料**（**MEDPAR／MBSF**），**輸出是**定寬 DAT 檔**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它維持**單一內部受益人隊列並逐年前推**，**因此**人口學特徵、ID、地點與診斷史在各檔案之間保持一致**；**⭐ 並**故意注入**真實資料品質問題**（**種族錯編、**出生日期漂移、**與州相關的空 ID**）；**⭐ 每個作者標出**自己做了哪一部分****（**Zenodo DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22648509`，v0.2.0，Apache-2.0**）
entries.summary: **synthetic-resdac-claims（`synthmed`）**（**Zenodo 记录** `22648509`；GitHub 仓库 `ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims`）**是一个 Python 包**，**逐字自述为**「**a Python package that generates synthetic ResDAC / Medicare claims data (MEDPAR, MBSF) as fixed-width DAT files that conform to a set of ResDAC File Transfer Specification (FTS) schemas**」。**本条目属于本轮主题**「存证」**，**它在**可引用性**与**内部一致性**两端都给了样本**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 单一队列、逐年前推**——**逐字**「**The generator maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries and rolls it forward year-by-year so that demographics, IDs, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**故意**注入数据质量问题**——**逐字**「**Realistic data-quality errors (race miscoding, date-of-birth drift, state-correlated null IDs) are injected on the way through.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**可用的合成数据**」不是「**干净的数据**」**，**而是**带着真实缺陷的数据****；**⭐⭐ ③ 作者分工逐条写明**（**含**「**original design and prototype implementation**」、「**HMO / Buy-In enrollment indicator sampler (sticky Markov-chain model)**」、「**packaging, refactor into a Python library, and input data provenance**」**，**且**四人都带 ORCID 与单位**）；**⭐⭐ ④ 引用机制是可机读的**——`CITATION.cff`（**2,943 字节**，CFF 1.2.0**）**逐字含**「**GitHub renders a "Cite this repository" button in the right sidebar when this file is present at the repo root.**」**，**并在** `identifiers` **里指向同伴的 Zenodo 数据 DOI**；**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本被钉住**——**Zenodo 的关联标识逐字为** `https://github.com/ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims/tree/v0.2.0`（**关系** `isSupplementTo`**）**。**⚠️ 本次未安装、未生成任何数据、未读定宽格式的规范细节**。
entries.summary_hk: **synthetic-resdac-claims（`synthmed`）**（**Zenodo 記錄** `22648509`；GitHub 倉庫 `ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims`）**是一個 Python 套件**，**逐字自述為**「**a Python package that generates synthetic ResDAC / Medicare claims data (MEDPAR, MBSF) as fixed-width DAT files that conform to a set of ResDAC File Transfer Specification (FTS) schemas**」。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「存證」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 單一隊列、逐年前推**——**逐字**「**maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries and rolls it forward year-by-year so that demographics, IDs, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**故意**注入資料品質問題**——**逐字**「**Realistic data-quality errors (race miscoding, date-of-birth drift, state-correlated null IDs) are injected on the way through.**」**；**⭐⭐ ③ 作者分工逐條寫明**（**含**「**original design and prototype implementation**」「**packaging, refactor into a Python library, and input data provenance**」**，**四人皆附 ORCID 與單位**）**；**⭐⭐ ④ 引用機制可機讀**（`CITATION.cff`，CFF 1.2.0**）**；**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本被釘住**（**關聯標識逐字為** `https://github.com/ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims/tree/v0.2.0`**）**。**⚠️ 本次未安裝、未生成任何資料**。
entries.summary_en: The project synthetic-resdac-claims, also called synthmed, archived on Zenodo and hosted on GitHub, **is a Python package that generates synthetic Medicare claims data as fixed-width DAT files conforming to a set of national data-archive file transfer specification schemas**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of evidence and citability, and it provides a sample at both ends**: it maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries and rolls it forward year by year so that demographics, identifiers, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files; **it deliberately injects realistic data-quality errors on the way through, naming race miscoding, date-of-birth drift and state-correlated null identifiers**, which means usable synthetic data here is not clean data but data carrying realistic defects; **each of the four authors is credited for the specific part they built**, from the original design and prototype through an enrolment indicator sampler described as a sticky Markov-chain model, to packaging and the refactor into a library and responsibility for input data provenance, with every author carrying an ORCID; the citation mechanism is machine-readable, with a citation file that notes GitHub will render a cite-this-repository button when the file sits at the repository root, and whose identifiers point at a companion dataset DOI; and the archived version is pinned, since the Zenodo related identifier points at a version-tagged GitHub path. **Nothing was installed, no data was generated, and the fixed-width specification was not read this round.**
entries.body:
**synthetic-resdac-claims**（**包名** `synthmed`；**GitHub 仓库** `ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims`；**Zenodo 记录** `22648509`）**是一个生成**合成 Medicare（美国联邦医疗保险）理赔数据**的 Python 包**，**逐字自述为**「**a Python package that generates synthetic ResDAC / Medicare claims data (MEDPAR, MBSF) as fixed-width DAT files that conform to a set of ResDAC File Transfer Specification (FTS) schemas**」。**本次实测**：**Zenodo 记录** —— **DOI 逐字为** `10.5281/zenodo.22648509`**、概念 DOI 为** `10.5281/zenodo.22648508`**、**版本** `v0.2.0`**、**类型** Software**、**许可** Apache-2.0**、**创建与更新均为 2026-09-07**、**1 个文件**（**逐字名为** `ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims-v0.2.0.zip`**）**、**访问权限** open**；**四位作者均附 ORCID**（**`Belakurski, Pavel`、`Chumack, Mark`、`Etin, Dmitry`、`Bouzinier, Michael`**）**；**关键字逐字为** `medicare`、`resdac`、`synthetic-data`、`claims`、`medpar`、`mbsf`**；**关联标识逐字为** `https://github.com/ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims/tree/v0.2.0`（**关系** `isSupplementTo`**）**；**GitHub 仓库** —— **创建 2026-05-16、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**语言 Python**；**文件实测**：`README.md` 14,142 字节、`CITATION.cff` 2,943 字节、`LICENSE` 11,357 字节（**Apache-2.0**）**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**存证：编号、版本、许可，以及把每个数追回它的来源**」**。

**可核实信息（均 README、`CITATION.cff` 与 Zenodo 元数据实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它维持**单一队列并逐年前推**，**故跨文件的一致性是被设计出来的****——**README 逐字**：**「**The generator maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries and rolls it forward year-by-year so that demographics, IDs, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files. Realistic data-quality errors (race miscoding, date-of-birth drift, state-correlated null IDs) are injected on the way through.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮值得抄的一处**：**生成**多年、多文件**的合成数据时，**最容易被忽略的是「**同一个人在不同年份的文件里是不是同一个人**」——**⭐ 这里的解法不是事后对齐，而是**一开始就只有一个人群**（**single internal cohort**），**逐年前推时**人口学与诊断史**随之演化**；**⭐ 而更值得记的是它**故意**往里加错**：**「**合成数据**」的目的不是「**干净**」，**而是「**能在上面测方法、**包括测出错处理**」——**种族错编、**出生日期漂移、**与州相关的空 ID**三样**都是**真实数据里会遇到的具体缺陷**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它按**规范**输出，而不是按自己的方便**——**逐字说明输出为**「**fixed-width DAT files that conform to a set of ResDAC File Transfer Specification (FTS) schemas**」，**关键字另逐字含** `medpar` **与** `mbsf`（**两类 Medicare 数据文件**）**；**⭐ 即**生成器要服从**别人定的布局**（**定宽、**字段位置固定**）**，**而不是输出一张通用表格**——**⭐ 这与本站第 349 轮记下的「**格式即契约**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ③ 作者分工被逐条写明，**且每人附 ORCID 与单位****——**README 的 Authors 一节逐字为**：**`Pavel Belakurski`**（**Northwestern University**）——**「**original design and prototype implementation**」**，**并逐字指向原型仓库** `ChilliPenguin/SynthMed`；**`Mark Chumack`**（**University of Massachusetts Amherst**）——**「**HMO / Buy-In enrollment indicator sampler (sticky Markov-chain model)**」**；**`Dmitry Etin`**（**Deggendorf Institute of Technology**）；**`Michael Bouzinier`**（**Harvard University**）——**「**packaging, refactor into a Python library, and input data provenance**」**。**⭐ 即**「**谁做了什么**」**写在 README 正面**，**且**最后一人的职责里**明确包含**输入数据的出处**（**input data provenance**）**——**⭐ 这与本词条项目自身的纪律**同向**。**⭐⭐ ④ 引用机制是可机读的，而且指向两份不同的东西****——`CITATION.cff`（**2,943 字节**）**内容逐字含**：**版本行** `cff-version: 1.2.0`；**注释逐字**「**GitHub renders a "Cite this repository" button in the right sidebar when this file is present at the repo root.**」；**类型** `type: software`；**作者四项**（**各含** `family-names`／`given-names`／`orcid`，**两人另含** `alias` **与** `affiliation`**）**；**`message` 逐字为**「**If you use this software in academic work, please cite it using the metadata below. The companion synthetic dataset is archived on Zenodo at the DOI given under `identifiers`.**」**；**⭐ README 的 Citation 一节另给出一条**与代码不同的**引用**——**一位作者 2026 年的**数据集**条目**（**逐字标题**「**Synthetic Medicare-Like Inpatient Claims and Beneficiary Data Conforming to ResDAC FTS Layouts**」**）**，**DOI 逐字为** `10.5281/zenodo.18915558`**。**⭐ 即**「**引用这个软件**」与「**引用这份数据**」**是两个不同的条目、**两个 DOI**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里**登记分层**做得最清楚的一处**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本被钉在具体标签上**——**Zenodo 的关联标识不是指向仓库首页，而是逐字指向** `.../tree/v0.2.0`**；**⭐ 即**「**这一版存档对应的是哪一次提交**」**是可核对的**（**读者可从 Zenodo 一步走到该标签**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 状态被如实标注**——**README 的 Status 一节逐字开头为**「**Alpha — functional and exercised end-to-end at production scale**」——**⭐ 即**它同时说清了两件事：**成熟度是**Alpha**，**而**使用程度是**在生产规模上端到端跑过****（**⭐ 本词条如实指出：这两者并不矛盾，但都不等于**经过第三方验证****）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]] 记录的是**官方发布的去标识化样本**，**[[insurance-datasets-synthetic]]、[[gen-syn]]、[[synthpop]]、[[sdv]]、[[ctgan-r]]、[[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]] 覆盖**合成数据生成**的不同做法**，**[[hcc-python]]、[[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[medicare-claims-pricer]]、[[cms-open-data]] 覆盖**Medicare 侧的数据与编码**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**按官方**定宽传输规范**生成、**并**自带真实缺陷**的合成理赔数据**」这一形态**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**其**合成**性质意味着**不能**用它推断真实的美国医疗费用或人群特征**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]、[[gen-syn]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「**在没有真数据时怎么造一份能用、且知道它哪里脏的数据**」这一问题的样本**；**⭐ 其中三点可以直接照抄**：**① 一开始就只维护一个人群，**别事后对齐**；**② 故意注入**具名的缺陷类型**，**而不是造一份过分干净的假数据**；**③ 把**软件引用**与**数据引用**分成两个 DOI**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装该包、没有生成任何数据、没有读任何 DAT 文件**，**故不主张**其生成器按所述工作、不主张其输出真的符合 ResDAC 的 FTS 规范、**也不主张那些注入的错误类型与真实数据中的分布相似**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何源码**——**本次只读了** `README.md`（14,142 字节）、`CITATION.cff`（2,943 字节）、**Zenodo 元数据与文件清单**，**故不主张**「**单一年度队列**」的实际实现、`sticky Markov-chain** 的具体做法、以及**错误注入的比例与机制**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核对 ResDAC FTS 规范本身**（**未访问 ResDAC 任何页面**），**故不主张其「**符合规范**」这一说法**——**⭐ 本词条只记录「**它自述符合**」**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实 README 中那条**同伴数据集 DOI**（`10.5281/zenodo.18915558`）**的内容**（**未打开该记录**）**，**也未核实它与本软件包的版本关系**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**「**生产规模端到端跑过**」这一说法**（**无证据、**无第三方验证**）**；**⚠️ ★0、**无外部引用记录**，**均不构成质量证据，**也不构成反证**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实四位作者与其单位的关系**（**只读到 README 自述与 ORCID**）**；**未核实原型仓库** `ChilliPenguin/SynthMed` **是否与其有代码继承关系**。**⑦ ⚠️ 许可为 Apache-2.0**（**Zenodo 字段与仓库 `LICENSE` 一致**），**未读许可正文**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「**合成数据**」**本身**可能另有条款**（**本次未见单独的数据许可声明**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ Zenodo 记录创建 2026-09-07 与仓库推送 2026-09-10 都在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「**按官方定宽规范生成、**维持单一人群跨年一致、**并故意注入具名数据缺陷、**且软件与数据分开引用**」这一组合，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**合成数据**不得用于推断真实的医疗费用、**患病率或人群差异**。

**synthetic-resdac-claims**（**套件名** `synthmed`；**GitHub 倉庫** `ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims`；**Zenodo 記錄** `22648509`）**是一個生成**合成 Medicare（美國聯邦醫療保險）理賠資料**的 Python 套件**。**本次實測**：**Zenodo 記錄** —— **DOI 逐字為** `10.5281/zenodo.22648509`**、概念 DOI 為** `10.5281/zenodo.22648508`**、**版本** `v0.2.0`**、**類型** Software**、**許可** Apache-2.0**、**建立與更新均為 2026-09-07**、**1 個檔案**、**四位作者均附 ORCID**；**關鍵字逐字為** `medicare`、`resdac`、`synthetic-data`、`claims`、`medpar`、`mbsf`；**關聯標識逐字為** `https://github.com/ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims/tree/v0.2.0`（`isSupplementTo`**）**；**GitHub 倉庫** —— **建立 2026-05-16、最後推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**Python**；**檔案實測**：`README.md` 14,142 位元組、`CITATION.cff` 2,943 位元組、`LICENSE` 11,357 位元組**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**存證**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、`CITATION.cff` 與 Zenodo 元數據實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它維持**單一隊列並逐年前推**，**故跨檔案的一致性是被設計出來的****——**逐字**：**「**The generator maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries and rolls it forward year-by-year so that demographics, IDs, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files. Realistic data-quality errors (race miscoding, date-of-birth drift, state-correlated null IDs) are injected on the way through.**」**。**⭐ 即**最容易被忽略的是「**同一個人在不同年份的檔案裡是不是同一個人**」，**而解法不是事後對齊，**而是一開始就只有一個人群**；**⭐ 更值得記的是它**故意**加錯**——**「**合成資料**」的目的不是「**乾淨**」，**而是「**能在上面測方法、**包括測出錯處理**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它按**規範**輸出**（**逐字**「**fixed-width DAT files that conform to a set of ResDAC File Transfer Specification (FTS) schemas**」**）**；**⭐ 即**生成器要服從**別人定的佈局**，**而不是輸出一張通用表格**。**⭐⭐ ③ 作者分工逐條寫明，且每人附 ORCID 與單位**——**`Pavel Belakurski`（Northwestern University）**逐字負責**「**original design and prototype implementation**」**；**`Mark Chumack`（UMass Amherst）**逐字負責**「**HMO / Buy-In enrollment indicator sampler (sticky Markov-chain model)**」**；**`Michael Bouzinier`（Harvard University）**逐字負責**「**packaging, refactor into a Python library, and input data provenance**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 引用機制可機讀，且指向兩份不同的東西**——`CITATION.cff`（2,943 位元組）**逐字含** `cff-version: 1.2.0`、**「**GitHub renders a "Cite this repository" button in the right sidebar when this file is present at the repo root.**」、**`type: software`**；**README 另給出一條**與程式碼不同的**引用**（**同伴資料集**，**DOI 逐字為** `10.5281/zenodo.18915558`**）**——**⭐ 即**「**引用這個軟體**」與「**引用這份資料**」**是兩個條目、兩個 DOI**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本被釘在具體標籤上**（**關聯標識逐字指向** `.../tree/v0.2.0`**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 狀態如實標註**——**逐字開頭為**「**Alpha — functional and exercised end-to-end at production scale**」**（**⭐ 成熟度是 Alpha，**使用程度是生產規模跑過**，**兩者都不等於第三方驗證**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：**本站 [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]] 記錄官方去識別化樣本**，**[[gen-syn]]、[[synthpop]]、[[sdv]]、[[ctgan-r]] 覆蓋合成資料生成的不同做法**，**而本條補上的是**「**按官方定寬傳輸規範生成、**維持單一人群跨年一致、**並故意注入具名缺陷**」**；**⭐ 並如實指出**合成資料**不能用來推斷真實的美國醫療費用或人群特徵**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]、[[gen-syn]] 應當並讀**——**⭐ 其中三點可以直接照抄**：**① 一開始就只維護一個人群；**② 故意注入**具名的缺陷類型**；**③ 把**軟體引用**與**資料引用**分成兩個 DOI**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝該套件、沒有生成任何資料、沒有讀任何 DAT 檔**，**故不主張**其生成器按所述工作、不主張其輸出真的符合 ResDAC FTS 規範。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何原始碼**——**只讀了** `README.md`、`CITATION.cff`、**Zenodo 元數據與檔案清單**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核對 ResDAC FTS 規範本身**（**未訪問 ResDAC 任何頁面**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實同伴資料集 DOI 的內容與版本關係**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實「**生產規模跑過**」這一說法**；**★0 與無外部引用不構成品質證據**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實四位作者與其單位的關係**；**未核實原型倉庫的繼承關係**。**⑦ ⚠️ 許可為 Apache-2.0，未讀正文**；**⭐ 但未見單獨的資料許可聲明**。**⑧ ⚠️ Zenodo 記錄建立 2026-09-07 與倉庫推送 2026-09-10 都在解凍窗口之內**；**⭐ 但「按官方定寬規範生成＋單一人群跨年一致＋故意注入具名缺陷＋軟體與資料分開引用」此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 合成資料不得用於推斷真實醫療費用或人群差異**。
entries.body_en:
The project synthetic-resdac-claims, also called synthmed, archived on Zenodo and hosted on GitHub, **is a Python package that generates synthetic Medicare claims data**. **Measured this round**: on the archive side, a version DOI, a concept DOI, **version 0.2.0**, resource type Software, **licence Apache-2.0**, **created and updated on 2026-09-07**, a single file, open access, four creators each carrying an ORCID, keywords naming Medicare, the national data archive, synthetic data, claims and the two claim file families, and one related identifier pointing at a version-tagged GitHub path and marked as supplementing it; on the repository side, **created 2026-05-16**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, zero stars, Python, with a README of 14,142 bytes, a citation file of 2,943 bytes and a licence file of 11,357 bytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of evidence and citability.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the citation file and the archive metadata**: **first, it maintains a single cohort rolled forward year by year, so consistency across files is designed in rather than fixed afterwards.** Verbatim, the generator maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries and rolls it forward year by year so that demographics, identifiers, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files, and realistic data-quality errors, naming race miscoding, date-of-birth drift and state-correlated null identifiers, are injected on the way through. **When generating multi-year, multi-file synthetic data, the easiest thing to overlook is whether the same person in different years is the same person; the answer here is not post-hoc alignment but starting from one population only.** **What is more notable is that it deliberately adds errors: the point of synthetic data is not to be clean but to be something methods can be tested on, including their error handling, and the three named defect classes are concrete failures that occur in real data.** **Second, it emits according to somebody else specification rather than its own convenience**, describing its output verbatim as fixed-width DAT files conforming to a set of national archive file transfer specification schemas, with keywords naming both claim file families. **The generator must obey a layout defined elsewhere, with fixed widths and fixed field positions, rather than emitting a general-purpose table.** **Third, the division of labour is written out author by author, each with an ORCID and an affiliation**: one author is credited verbatim with the original design and prototype implementation and linked to a prototype repository; a second with the enrolment indicator sampler described as a sticky Markov-chain model; a third by affiliation only; and a fourth verbatim with packaging, the refactor into a Python library and **input data provenance**. **Who did what sits on the front page of the README, and the last author responsibility explicitly includes the provenance of the input data.** **Fourth, the citation mechanism is machine-readable and points at two different things**: the citation file declares format version 1.2.0 and notes verbatim that GitHub renders a cite-this-repository button when the file is present at the repository root; it sets the type to software; and it lists four authors with names, ORCIDs, and for two of them an alias and an affiliation, with a message telling users to cite the software using the metadata below while noting that the companion synthetic dataset is archived on Zenodo at the DOI given under identifiers. The README separately gives a citation for a 2026 dataset release with its own DOI, titled as synthetic Medicare-like inpatient claims and beneficiary data conforming to the archive layouts. **Citing the software and citing the data are therefore two entries with two DOIs.** **Fifth, the archived version is pinned to a specific tag**, since the related identifier points at a version-tagged path rather than a repository home page, so which commit this archive corresponds to is checkable in one step. **Sixth, the status is stated honestly**: the README opens its status section by calling the project alpha while also saying it is functional and exercised end-to-end at production scale, **which states maturity and usage separately, and neither is third-party validation**. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: the pooled official de-identified sample entry records a regulator-released extract, the pooled synthetic data entries cover several generation approaches, and the pooled Medicare coding and pricing entries cover that side of the data, while this entry supplies generation against an official fixed-width transfer specification with a single cohort held consistent across years and named defects injected deliberately, and software and data cited separately. **It is stated plainly that synthetic data must not be used to infer real US medical costs or population characteristics.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]] and [[gen-syn]]**, because **it answers how to build usable data when no real data is available while still knowing where it is dirty**, and three of its practices can be copied directly: maintain one population from the start rather than aligning afterwards, inject named defect classes rather than producing unrealistically clean fake data, and separate the software citation from the data citation into two identifiers.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed, no data was generated and no DAT file was read**, **so the generator is not claimed to work as described, its output is not claimed to conform to the archive specification, and the injected defect classes are not claimed to resemble real distributions**. **Second, no source code was read**: only the README, the citation file, the archive metadata and the file listing were read, **so nothing is claimed about the actual implementation of the single-cohort roll-forward, the sticky Markov-chain sampler, or the rates and mechanisms of error injection; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the archive specification itself was not checked**, no archive page was visited, so the claim of conformance is recorded as the project own statement rather than as a verified fact. **Fourth, the companion dataset DOI given in the README was not opened**, and its relationship to this package version was not established. **Fifth, the claim of being exercised at production scale was not verified** and has neither evidence nor third-party validation here, while zero stars and no recorded external citations are neither evidence of quality nor evidence against it. **Sixth, the four authors and their stated affiliations were not verified beyond the README and the ORCIDs, nor was the code lineage from the prototype repository. Seventh, the licence is Apache-2.0 by both the archive field and the repository licence file, whose text was not read, and no separate data licence statement was seen. Eighth, both the archive record and the repository push fall inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed; however, the combination of generation against an official fixed-width specification, a single cohort kept consistent across years, deliberately injected named defects, and separate citations for software and data had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that synthetic data must not be used to infer real medical costs or population differences.**

entries.title: **一份 59 亿字节的「复现包」：它把整篇论文的代码与数据压成一个可引用的编号**（Zenodo DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22659308`）——**作者三人**、**均附 ORCID**、**关键词只有三个**（**genetic prediction、**adverse selection、**insurance**）；**⭐ 它**没有**任何指向代码仓库的关联标识**（**即**这份包**只存在于存档里**）**；**⭐ 版本字符串自带日期**（`v0.9.2  （2026-07-29）`**）**，**而**记录创建于 2026-09-08****
entries.title_en: A replication package of nearly six gigabytes that compresses an entire paper code and data into one citable identifier: a Zenodo record whose three creators each carry an ORCID, whose keywords are exactly genetic prediction, adverse selection and insurance, which carries no related identifier pointing at any code repository, so the package exists only in the archive, and whose version string carries its own date while the record itself was created later.

(forthcoming). Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection. Econometrica.**」**——**⭐ 即**它把「**代码与数据**」作为**论文的一个可引用附件**交付**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「存证」**，**它是四条里把「**可引用**」的**最简形态**展示得最清楚的一条**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 只有一个文件**——**逐字名为** `Replication-Package.zip`，**实测 6,344,986,631 字节**（**约 5.9 GiB**），**并附一个** md5**校验和**（**逐字为** `md5:5f0f0b9d2d308ed1c3e58e8182c680e1`**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**没有任何关联标识****（**本次实测其 `related_identifiers` 为空**）**——**⭐ 即**这份包**不在任何代码仓库里**（**至少**Zenodo 上没有登记指向某个仓库**）**，**读者只能从存档里下载**；**⭐⭐ ③ 版本字符串与创建时间分开**——**版本逐字为** `v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)`（**版本名里自带一个更早的日期**）**，**而记录创建于 2026-09-08**；**⭐⭐ ④ 元数据极简**：**关键词只有三个**（`Genetic prediction`、`Adverse selection`、`Insurance`**）**、**许可** CC-BY-4.0**、**访问权限** open**、**无禁运期**、**无备注**；**⭐⭐ ⑤ 登记分层**：**版本 DOI** 与**概念 DOI** 分开**，**故**引用可指向「**这一版**」或「**这个复现包**」**。**⚠️ 本次未下载该压缩包、**未读其中任何文件**（**5.9 GiB，**且**内容构成未核实**）**；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**本条的价值在**登记与引用形态**，**而不在其内容的可核性****。

entries.summary_en: The Zenodo record titled as a replication package for a paper on genetic prediction and adverse selection, under a version DOI and a concept DOI, **delivers one paper code and data as a single citable attachment**: its description states verbatim that it is the replication package for a forthcoming article in a leading economics journal by three named authors. **This entry belongs to the round theme of evidence and citability, and of the four it shows the simplest possible form of citability**: a single file named as a replication package, measured at more than six billion bytes, roughly five point nine gibibytes, carrying an md5 checksum; **no related identifier at all**, so the package is not registered as living in any code repository and a reader can only obtain it from the archive; **a version string that carries its own earlier date while the record itself was created later**; deliberately minimal metadata, with exactly three keywords, namely genetic prediction, adverse selection and insurance, a Creative Commons attribution licence, open access and no embargo; and both a version DOI and a concept DOI, so a citation can point either at this version or at the replication package as an idea. **The archive was not downloaded and none of its files were read this round, and this entry states plainly that its subject is the registration and citation form rather than the checkability of the content.**
entries.body:
**Replication Package for: Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection**（**Zenodo 记录** `22659308`）**是一篇论文的**复现包**。**本次实测**：**DOI 逐字为** `10.5281/zenodo.22659308`**、概念 DOI 为** `10.5281/zenodo.22659307`**、**版本逐字为** `v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)`**、**类型** Software**、**许可** CC-BY-4.0**、**创建与更新均为 2026-09-08**、**访问权限** open**、**无禁运期**、**记录无备注字段**；**文件**只有 **1 个**，**逐字名为** `Replication-Package.zip`，**实测** 6,344,986,631 字节**，**并附校验和** `md5:5f0f0b9d2d308ed1c3e58e8182c680e1`**；**三位作者**逐字为** `Azevedo, Eduardo`（**ORCID** `0000-0001-6048-6506`**）**、`Beauchamp, Jonathan P`（**ORCID** `0000-0002-4935-4016`**）**、`Karlsson Linnér, Richard`（**ORCID** `0000-0001-7839-2858`**）**；**关键词逐字只有三个**：`Genetic prediction`、`Adverse selection`、`Insurance`。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**存证：编号、版本、许可，以及把每个数追回它的来源**」**；**本词条认为它是四条里把「**可引用**」的**最简形态**展示得最清楚的一条**——**⭐ 而它也同时暴露了这种形态的**边界**。

**可核实信息（均 Zenodo 元数据实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 整篇论文的代码与数据被压成一个文件、一个编号**——**描述逐字为**「**Replication package for: Azevedo, E., Beauchamp, J.P., and Karlsson Linnér, R. (forthcoming). Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection. Econometrica.**」**；**⭐ 即**这份归档**不是一篇论文**，**也不是一个软件项目**，**而是「**论文的复现材料**」这一**独立可引用的对象**——**⭐ 本词条认为这正是「**存证**」的最简形态：**一个压缩包 ＋ 一个 DOI ＋ 一行「**它对应哪篇论文**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**没有任何关联标识**——**本次实测其 `related_identifiers` 为空****，**即**既没有指向代码仓库、**也没有指向论文的 DOI、**也没有指向该论文的预印本**。**⭐ 本词条如实记录这一处**：**⭐ 它与本站第 346／352 轮记下的「**来源与生成物要能互相找到**」**相反**——**在这里，**论文与复现包之间**只靠**描述里那句话**相连**，**而**没有机器可读的链接**（**⚠️ 本词条只记录「**Zenodo 元数据里没有**」这一事实，**不推测作者是否有意如此**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 版本字符串自带一个**更早**的日期，**而记录创建更晚**——**版本逐字为** `v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)`**，**删除线**（**若按「**版本名里的日期 = 该版本形成时间**」理解**）**它**比记录的创建时间 2026-09-08 **早约六周****；**⭐ 即**「**我什么时候把它提交到存档**」与「**这一版是什么时候形成的**」**是两件事——**⭐ 而后者只能从版本字符串里读出**（**⚠️ 本词条未核实该日期含义**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 元数据极简到几乎只有必要项**——**关键词三个、**许可一个、**访问权限一个、**文件一个、**作者三个**；**⭐ 即**它**没有**填 `notes`、**没有**填资助信息、**没有**填关联标识**；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这不是缺陷，而是**一种取舍**——**存档记录**只承担「**编号、版本、许可、作者**」四件事**，**其余交给论文本身**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 两层 DOI 的分工**——**版本 DOI**（`10.5281/zenodo.22659308`）**指向**这一次提交**，**概念 DOI**（`10.5281/zenodo.22659307`）**指向**这个复现包**（**跨版本不变**）**；**⭐ 即**引用者可以选「**我引的是这一版**」或「**我引的是这个概念**」——**⭐ 这与 Zenodo 对所有记录的统一做法一致**（**本站池内已有 8 条 Zenodo 来源条目为同一形态**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 主题与池内条目的关系**：**关键词只有三个，**而三个都在本站的射程内**（**基因预测、**逆选择、**保险**）**——**⭐ 逆选择是保险经济学的核心议题之一**，**而「**用基因信息预测风险**」**把它推进到**信息与公平**的层面**；**⭐ 本站 [[insurance-fairness]]、[[insurance-fairness-ldp]]、[[underwriting-decision-safety]]、[[insurance-governance]] 覆盖**公平性、**承保决策与治理**，**[[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]] 覆盖**定价方法的论文形态**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**论文复现包**」这一形态**（**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这在本站池内**并非全新**——池内已有 [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]] 与 [[frmtpl-scaling-laws]] 这类「**论文＋代码**」组合**，**但**以**单一压缩包＋DOI＋无仓库关联**的形式出现的**，此前没有**）**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]、[[insurance-fairness]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「**一篇论文的复现材料可以长什么样**」的一个极简样本**：**一个压缩包、**一个 DOI、**一条 md5、**三个关键词**；**⭐ 而它对本站最有价值的一点是**反面的**：**它提示「**只把东西放进存档**」会让**代码与论文之间缺少机器可读的连接**——**⭐ 这与本站第 346／352 轮「**来源与生成物要互相指得回去**」的纪律正好对照**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**那份 6.3 GB 的压缩包、**没有解压、**没有读其中任何文件**（**未读代码、**未读数据、**未读 README**）**，**故不主张**其中任何方法、结果、数据或结论**成立**；**⭐ 本词条**只知道「**有这样一个文件、这么大、这个校验和**」**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核实该压缩包的内容构成**（**是否含数据、**是否含代码、**是否含受限数据**）**——**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**一份 5.9 GiB 的「**复现包**」**很可能包含**大体量数据**（**例如基因型数据**），**而**其**许可与再分发条件**可能与**记录级许可（CC-BY-4.0）**并不相同**——**⚠️ 本次未核实，**故**不对其可否再分发作任何主张**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实论文本身**：**未查该文是否已在 Econometrica 发表或仍在**forthcoming**状态、**未读摘要或正文、**未核实三位作者与该文的对应关系**；**⚠️ 描述里的**forthcoming**是**本次所见的原文措辞**，**本词条**不据此判断其发表状态**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实版本字符串** `v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)` **里日期的含义**（**本次只记录该日期早于记录创建时间**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实 `related_identifiers` 为空**是否只是**本记录**未登记**（**本词条只主张「**该字段本次为空**」）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实三位作者的身份与机构**；**⚠️ 未记录下载量与引用数**。**⑦ ⚠️ 许可为 CC-BY-4.0（记录字段）**，**本次**未见独立许可文本**；**⭐ 本词条按惯例区分「**记录级许可**」与「**包内数据自身的权利**」**，**并因此**不对其再分发作任何主张**。**⑧ ⚠️ 记录创建 2026-09-08 在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「**单一压缩包＋DOI＋md5＋无仓库关联**」这一**极简复现包**形态，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。

**Replication Package for: Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection**（**Zenodo 記錄** `22659308`）**是一篇論文的**複現包**。**本次實測**：**DOI 逐字為** `10.5281/zenodo.22659308`**、概念 DOI 為** `10.5281/zenodo.22659307`**、**版本逐字為** `v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)`**、**類型** Software**、**許可** CC-BY-4.0**、**建立與更新均為 2026-09-08**、**訪問** open**、**無禁運**；**檔案只有 1 個**（`Replication-Package.zip`**，**實測 6,344,986,631 位元組**，**附 md5 校驗和**）**；**三位作者均附 ORCID**；**關鍵詞逐字只有三個**：`Genetic prediction`、`Adverse selection`、`Insurance`。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**存證**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Zenodo 元數據實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 整篇論文的程式碼與資料被壓成一個檔案、一個編號**——**描述逐字為**「**Replication package for: Azevedo, E., Beauchamp, J.P., and Karlsson Linnér, R. (forthcoming). Genetic Prediction and Adverse Selection. Econometrica.**」**——**⭐ 即**這份歸檔**不是論文、**也不是軟體專案**，**而是「**論文的複現材料**」這一**獨立可引用的對象**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**沒有任何關聯標識****——**實測其 `related_identifiers` 為空****，**即**既未指向程式碼倉庫、**也未指向論文 DOI 或預印本**——**⭐ 即**論文與複現包之間**只靠描述裡那句話相連**，**而**沒有機器可讀的連結**（**⭐ 本詞條只記錄「**該欄位本次為空**」**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 版本字串自帶一個**更早**的日期**（`v0.9.2  (2026-07-29)`**，**比記錄建立時間 2026-09-08 早約六週**）**——**⭐ 即**「**何時提交存檔**」與「**這一版何時形成**」**是兩件事**。**⭐⭐ ④ 元數據極簡**（**關鍵詞三個、**許可一個、**檔案一個**，**未填備註、**未填資助、**未填關聯**）**——**⭐ 不是缺陷，而是取捨**：**存檔記錄只承擔「**編號、版本、許可、作者**」。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 兩層 DOI 的分工**（**版本 DOI 指向這一次提交，**概念 DOI 跨版本不變**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 主題與池內條目的關係**：**三個關鍵詞都在本站射程內**（**基因預測、**逆選擇、**保險**）**；**本站 [[insurance-fairness]]、[[underwriting-decision-safety]]、[[insurance-governance]] 覆蓋公平性、**承保決策與治理**，**[[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]] 覆蓋論文形態**——**⭐ 但**以「**單一壓縮包＋DOI＋無倉庫關聯**」形式出現的複現包**，此前池內沒有**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]、[[insurance-fairness]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「**論文複現材料可以長什麼樣**」的極簡樣本**；**⭐ 而它對本站最有價值的一點是**反面的**：**只把東西放進存檔**，**會讓**程式碼與論文之間缺少機器可讀的連接**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載**那份 6.3 GB 壓縮包、**沒有解壓、**沒有讀其中任何檔案**，**故不主張**其中任何方法、結果、資料或結論**成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核實該壓縮包的內容構成**（**是否含資料、**是否含受限資料**）**——**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**；**⭐ 並如實指出**：**一份 5.9 GiB 的複現包**很可能包含**大体量資料**，**而**其**權利條件**可能與**記錄級許可（CC-BY-4.0）**不同**——**⚠️ 故**不對其可否再分發作任何主張**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實論文本身**（**未查是否已發表、**未讀摘要或正文**）**；**描述裡的**forthcoming**是本次所見原文措辭**，**不據此判斷發表狀態**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實版本字串裡日期的含義**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實關聯欄位為空是否只是本記錄未登記**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實三位作者身份與機構**；**未記錄下載量與引用數**。**⑦ ⚠️ 許可為 CC-BY-4.0（記錄欄位）**，**未見獨立許可文本**；**按慣例區分「**記錄級許可**」與「**包內資料自身的權利**」**。**⑧ ⚠️ 記錄建立 2026-09-08 在解凍窗口之內**；**但「單一壓縮包＋DOI＋md5＋無倉庫關聯」這一極簡複現包形態，此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。
entries.body_en:
The Zenodo record titled as a replication package for a paper on genetic prediction and adverse selection **is the reproducibility artefact of that paper**. **Measured this round**: a version DOI and a concept DOI; a version string that is a semantic version followed by a date in parentheses; resource type Software; **licence CC-BY-4.0**; **created and updated on 2026-09-08**; open access with no embargo and no notes field; **exactly one file**, named as a replication package and **measured at 6,344,986,631 bytes**, roughly five point nine gibibytes, **carrying an md5 checksum**; three creators, each with an ORCID; and **exactly three keywords**, being genetic prediction, adverse selection and insurance. **This entry belongs to the round theme of evidence and citability, and of the four it shows the simplest possible form of citability while also exposing that form boundaries.**

**Verified information, all measured from the archive metadata**: **first, an entire paper code and data is compressed into one file and one identifier.** The description states verbatim that this is the replication package for a forthcoming article in a leading economics journal by three named authors. **The archive is therefore neither a paper nor a software project but a separately citable object that holds a paper reproducibility material**, which this entry considers the minimal form of citability: one archive, one identifier, and one line saying which paper it belongs to. **Second, it carries no related identifier at all**: the related-identifiers field is empty, so it points neither at a code repository nor at the paper DOI nor at a preprint. **The paper and its replication package are joined only by that sentence in the description, with no machine-readable link**, which runs opposite to the project convention recorded in earlier rounds that sources and generated artefacts should be able to find each other. **This entry records only the measured fact that the field is empty in this record and does not speculate about the authors intent.** **Third, the version string carries an earlier date than the record itself**: the version reads as a semantic version followed by a date, and that date is about six weeks earlier than the record creation date, **so when the package was deposited and when this version was formed are two different things, and the latter is legible only from the version string, whose meaning was not verified here.** **Fourth, the metadata is minimal to the point of containing almost only the necessary fields**: three keywords, one licence, one access right, one file and three authors, with no notes, no funding information and no related identifiers. **This is not a defect but a tradeoff in which the archive record carries only the identifier, the version, the licence and the authors, leaving everything else to the paper.** **Fifth, the two DOI layers divide the work**: the version DOI points at this submission while the concept DOI is stable across versions, so a citation can say either that it refers to this version or to the replication package as an idea, which matches the uniform practice already visible in the eight Zenodo-sourced entries in the pool. **Sixth, the subject relates to existing entries**: all three keywords fall inside this wiki range, since genetic prediction, adverse selection and insurance touch the core of insurance economics, and the pooled fairness, underwriting decision safety and governance entries cover the fairness and decision side while the pooled ratemaking scaling paper entry covers the paper-with-code form. **This entry does, however, state plainly that a paper-plus-code combination is not new to the pool; what is new is a replication package appearing as a single archive with a DOI and no repository link.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]] and [[insurance-fairness]]**, because **it is a minimal sample of what a paper reproducibility material can look like, being one archive, one identifier, one checksum and three keywords**, and because **its most useful lesson is a negative one: depositing material in an archive without linking it leaves code and paper joined only by prose**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the six-gigabyte archive was not downloaded, not extracted, and none of its files were read** — no code, no data, no README — **so no method, result, dataset or conclusion inside it is claimed to hold; this entry knows only that such a file exists, at that size, with that checksum**. **Second, the contents of the archive were not established**, including whether it contains data, whether it contains restricted data, and in what proportion; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **It is also stated plainly that a package of nearly six gigabytes is likely to contain substantial data, such as genotype data, and that the rights attaching to such data may differ from the licence recorded at the record level, so no claim is made here about whether it may be redistributed.** **Third, the paper itself was not verified**: whether it has appeared or is still forthcoming was not checked, no abstract or text was read, and the correspondence between the three creators and the article was not established; the word forthcoming is the wording seen in the record and is not used here to infer publication status. **Fourth, the meaning of the date inside the version string was not verified**, only that it precedes the record creation date. **Fifth, whether the empty related-identifiers field merely reflects an omission in this record was not established**; this entry claims only that the field was empty when measured. **Sixth, the three creators and their affiliations were not verified, and download and citation counts were not recorded. Seventh, the licence is CC-BY-4.0 by the record field and no separate licence text was seen; this entry follows the project convention of distinguishing a record-level licence from the rights attaching to the data inside the archive, and therefore makes no claim about redistribution. Eighth, the record was created on 2026-09-08, inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed; however, the shape of a minimal replication package consisting of a single archive, a DOI, a checksum and no repository link had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**

entries.title: **「矩不存在时，它返回 NA，而不是一个没有总体对应物的数字」**：R 包 **hgr**（The hidden grammar of reserving，v0.5.0）——**出发点是「经典准备金方法其实是可信度估计量」这一句**；**把**负二项链梯（NB-CL）**、**统一可信度准备金（UCR）**、**Mack 无分布模型**与**复合负二项–Gamma（CNBG）**收进一个框架**；**⭐ 它逐字写出自己**在哪些地方不该被信任****（**「**for anything that matters**」**请用 bootstrap 或后验，**别用闭式方差**）**；**⭐ 并逐字点名两个诊断**回答的不是同一个问题**
entries.title_en: When a moment does not exist it returns a missing value rather than a number with no population counterpart: the R package hgr, titled the hidden grammar of reserving at version 0.5.0, starts from the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators and unifies negative binomial chain ladder, unified credibility reserving, a distribution-free model and a compound negative binomial gamma amount model, while stating verbatim which of its own outputs should not be trusted for anything that matters and naming two diagnostics that answer different questions so that a portfolio can pass one while failing the other.
entries.title_hk: **「矩不存在時，它回傳 NA，而不是一個沒有總體對應物的數字」**：R 套件 **hgr**（The hidden grammar of reserving，v0.5.0）——**出發點是「經典準備金方法其實是可信度估計量」這一句**；**把**負二項鏈梯（NB-CL）**、**統一可信度準備金（UCR）**、**Mack 無分布模型**與**複合負二項–Gamma（CNBG）**收進一個框架**；**⭐ 它逐字寫出自己**在哪些地方不該被信任****；**⭐ 並逐字點名兩個診斷**回答的不是同一個問題**
entries.summary: **hgr**（**The hidden grammar of reserving**，**包版本 0.5.0**；GitHub `robin-vo/hgr`）**是一个通用保险准备金方法的 R 包**，**它的一句话出发点逐字为**「**based on the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators**」**——**⭐ 即**链梯、**Bornhuetter-Ferguson、**Cape Cod **在他这套里是**同一个可信度框架的特例**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-01-29、最后推送 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**语言 R**；**许可** GPL (>= 3)**（`DESCRIPTION` 字段；**而**仓库内**未见 `LICENSE` 文件**）**；**依赖极轻**（`Imports` 只有 `MASS`、`stats`、`graphics`**）**，**而** `Suggests` 里含** `ChainLadder`、`MCMCpack`、`rstan (>= 2.26.0)`、`testthat (>= 3.0.0)`、`ggplot2`**；**本条目属于本轮主题**「反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上」**，**它是本轮靠**「**谁在 README 里提到我们已收录的工具**」**这一搜索找到的**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得抄**：**① **矩不存在就返回 NA****——**逐字**「**The package enforces this and returns `NA` for the mean and standard error where they do not exist, rather than a number with no population counterpart.**」**；**② **逐字指名「**别用哪个函数**」****——**逐字**「**use the bootstrap or the posterior, not `delta_method_var()`, for anything that matters**」**；**③ **两个诊断不是一个门槛****——**逐字**「**They answer different questions and a portfolio can pass one while failing the other.**」**。**⚠️ 本次未安装 R、**未运行任何模型、**未复现其任何覆盖率数字**。
entries.summary_hk: **hgr**（**The hidden grammar of reserving**，**套件版本 0.5.0**；GitHub `robin-vo/hgr`）**是一個通用保險準備金方法的 R 套件**，**出發點逐字為**「**based on the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators**」。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-01-29、最後推送 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**R**；**許可** GPL (>= 3)**（`DESCRIPTION` 欄位；**倉庫內未見 `LICENSE`**）**；**依賴極輕**（`Imports` 只有 `MASS`、`stats`、`graphics`**）**，**而** `Suggests` 含 `ChainLadder`、`MCMCpack`、`rstan (>= 2.26.0)`、`testthat`、`ggplot2`**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得抄**：**① **矩不存在就回傳 NA****（**逐字**「**rather than a number with no population counterpart**」**）**；**② **逐字指名「**別用哪個函式**」**（**「**use the bootstrap or the posterior, not `delta_method_var()`, for anything that matters**」**）**；**③ **兩個診斷不是一個門檻**（**「**a portfolio can pass one while failing the other**」**）**。**⚠️ 本次未安裝 R、未運行任何模型**。
entries.summary_en: The R package hgr, titled the hidden grammar of reserving and released at version 0.5.0, **collects general insurance reserving methods into one framework**, and its one-line starting point states verbatim that it is based on the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators, **which means chain ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson and Cape Cod appear here as special cases of a single credibility framework**. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-01-29**, **last pushed 2026-09-09**, **one star**, language R; **licence GPL version 3 or later by the description field**, though **no licence file is present in the repository**; and dependencies are unusually light, with only MASS, stats and graphics as imports, while the suggested packages include the chain ladder R package, a Markov chain package, Stan, testthat and ggplot2. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry**, and it was found by asking which repositories mention a tool this wiki already holds. **Three passages are worth copying**: where a moment does not exist the package returns a missing value rather than a number with no population counterpart; it names verbatim the function not to trust, telling readers to use the bootstrap or the posterior rather than the closed-form variance for anything that matters; and it ships two diagnostics rather than one threshold, saying explicitly that they answer different questions and a portfolio can pass one while failing the other. **R was not installed, no model was run, and none of its coverage figures was reproduced this round.**
entries.body:
**hgr**（**逐字全名**「**The hidden grammar of reserving**」）**是一个通用保险准备金方法的 R 包**，**本次实测版本为** `0.5.0`**。**本次实测**：**GitHub 仓库** `robin-vo/hgr`**，**创建 2026-01-29、最后推送 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**语言 R**；**许可**为 `GPL (>= 3)`（**`DESCRIPTION` 字段**；**⭐ 而本次文件清单里**未见 `LICENSE` 文件****）；**作者** `Robin Van Oirbeek`（**⭐ 其 `Authors@R` 里的** ORCID **字段为空字符串**——**本词条如实记录**）**；**依赖**：`Imports` **逐字只有** `MASS`、`stats`、`graphics`，`Suggests` **逐字含** `ChainLadder`、`MCMCpack`、`rstan (>= 2.26.0)`、`testthat (>= 3.0.0)`、`ggplot2`；**另有** `Encoding: UTF-8`、`Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE)`、`RoxygenNote: 7.2.3`、**以及** `Config/testthat/edition: 3`。**仓库文件清单实测 65 条**：`DESCRIPTION`、`NAMESPACE`、**四个 R 源文件**（`cnbg.R`、`multinomPI.R`、`nbcl.R`、`ucr.R`**）**、`README.md`（**8,165 字节**）、**四个示例脚本**（`examples/`**）**、**一个 Stan 模型**（`inst/stan/cnbg_exact.stan`**）**、**以及约 55 个 `man/*.Rd` 帮助文件**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上**」**——**⭐ 本轮的方法正是从**我们已经收录的工具**出发**，**去看**谁在它的 README 里用到它**（**本例是在**「**谁提到** `ChainLadder`**」**这一问下找到的**）**。

**可核实信息（均 `DESCRIPTION`、README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把整套方法的出发点压成一句话，而且那句话本身是一个**观点****——`DESCRIPTION` 逐字**：**「**Implements a unified framework for macro-level reserving in non-life insurance, based on the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**经典准备金方法并不是彼此无关的几套公式，**而是**同一个可信度估计框架在不同权重下的特例**」**——**⭐ 而它把这个观点落成了可运行的包**：**逐字**「**UCR nests Chain-Ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, and Cape Cod as special cases with data-adaptive credibility weights.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把「**矩不存在**」这件事做成了返回值**——**README 逐字**：**「**Tiered moment reporting**: `(1-W)/W` is Beta-prime, whose k-th moment is finite only when `c·F > k`. **The package enforces this and returns `NA` for the mean and standard error where they do not exist, rather than a number with no population counterpart.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**一个数**没有总体对应物**时，**正确的输出不是**一个看起来合理的数字**，**而是**缺失**——**⭐ 而「**enforces this**」**说明这不是文档建议，**而是**代码里的约束**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字指出自己的哪个函数**不该用****——**README 逐字给出**：**「**At the triangle sizes actually encountered the estimator is upward-biased by roughly a third at `I = 10`, and the closed-form asymptotic variance understates the true variance by a factor of two to sixteen; **use the bootstrap or the posterior, not `delta_method_var()`, for anything that matters**.**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 它给出**偏差的量级与发生条件**（**「**在 I = 10 时上行偏差约为三分之一**」**）**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它给出**闭式方差低估的倍数区间**（**「**两倍到十六倍**」**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「**可能不准**」，**而是**一个区间**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 它点名**具体函数**并给出替代**（**用 bootstrap 或后验**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 两个诊断不是一个门槛**——**README 逐字**：**「**Two diagnostics, not one threshold**: `diagnose_c()` reports the portfolio-specific operability bound `c†(τ) = τ/π₀` and, separately, the heterogeneity screen with its measured error rates. **They answer different questions and a portfolio can pass one while failing the other.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**这套方法在这个组合上能不能报数**」**与「**这个组合本身是否同质**」**是**两个独立问题**——**⭐ 本词条认为这比「**设一个阈值**」**更难也更有用**：**因为它要求作者**分别测出两个诊断的**实际错误率**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 它逐字给出「**插件法**」与「**积分法**」的**覆盖率差多少****——**逐字**：**「**The plug-in costs about 6 coverage points at `I = 10` under correct specification; integrating over `c` recovers about two of them and removes most of the conditional miscalibration across triangles.**」**。**⭐ 即**两种做法**都不完美**，**而**差多少被写明了**（**插件法在正确设定下仍损失约 6 个百分点覆盖率，**积分只补回约 2 个**）**——**⭐ 本词条如实标注**：「**约**」字是原文措辞**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 它连一处数学修正都写明了后果**——**逐字**：**「**a partial-column moment method with the subcomposition correction (the partial-column proportions carry concentration `c·F_k`, not `c`; **without the correction the estimator is inconsistent**)**」**。**⭐ 即**「**不做这个修正，估计量就不一致**」**——**不是「**更差**」，**而是**不一致**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 内容与方法可数**——`DESCRIPTION` **逐字列出它包含**：**负二项链梯（NB-CL）**、**统一可信度准备金（UCR）**、**Mack 的无分布模型**、**经典 Bühlmann-Straub 可信度理论**、**与模型无关的预测区间（Dirichlet-Multinomial 参数自举）**、**以及复合负二项–Gamma（CNBG）金额三角模型与其可识别性边界诊断**；**并逐字说明 CNBG 那一块**「**characterises what a paid-loss triangle can and cannot identify about reserve uncertainty**」，**以及它自带**「**the paper’s simulation calibration as its defaults**」**、**两种**working-likelihood **后验**（**论文的联合 (kappa, A) 网格 ＋ 一个 **Godambe 调整**的替代**）**、**一个精确的**frailty-augmented HMC **后验**（**对应仓库里的** `inst/stan/cnbg_exact.stan`**）**、**一个 kappa 后验诊断**（**逐字含论文的** regime **与** KL-tier **分类，**并**flags when amount-only inference is unsupported**）**、**以及** Fisher／Godambe／van Trees **信息界**（**逐字**「**that reproduce the paper’s published table at the package defaults**」**）**。**⭐ 即**「**一个三角能告诉我们什么、**不能告诉我们什么**」**在这里是**可计算的诊断**，**而不是一句免责**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 安装方式与登记位置**——README 逐字给出 `devtools::install_github("robin-vo/hgr")`**，**而**本次**未在 CRAN 上看到该包**（**⭐ 即**它的登记处只有 GitHub 与帮助文件**）**；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这与第 352 轮记下的 [[fitverse-r]]（**只在 CRAN、**只有只读镜像**）**恰好相反**——**两种「**只在一个登记处**」的形态**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[chainladder]] 与 [[chainladder-python]] 覆盖**链梯的实现**，**[[reservingmodels]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]]、[[deeptriangle]]、[[reserving-ml]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[oneyear-correlated-chainladder]] 覆盖**准备金方法与验证**，**[[clmplus]]、[[gi-loss-reserving]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]、[[reserving-robust]] 覆盖**相邻取向**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**把经典方法统一成可信度估计量**」这一**理论框架**，**以及**「**矩不存在就返回 NA、**并指名不要用哪个函数**」这一**输出纪律**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[chainladder]]、[[reservingmodels]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「**同一批准备金方法其实是一个框架的特例**」这一视角**，**并附一套**逐条写明偏差与覆盖代价**的自述**；**⭐ 其中两点可以直接照抄**：**① 一个数**没有总体对应物**时返回缺失值；② 明确写出**哪个函数只适合做参考、**不适合做结论**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装 R、没有安装该包、没有拟合任何模型**（**未 `install_github`、未跑任何示例、未跑其测试**），**故不主张** NB-CL／UCR／CNBG **按所述工作**，**也不主张**其任何覆盖率、偏差或信息界数字**成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 R 源码**（**只读了** `DESCRIPTION`、`README.md` **与文件清单；**四个 `.R` 文件与 55 个 `.Rd` **未打开**），**故不主张** UCR 的可信度权重如何估计、CNBG 的可识别性诊断如何实现、`NA` 返回在哪些函数里真的生效。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未读** `inst/stan/cnbg_exact.stan` **与** `examples/` **下任何脚本**；**未核实**「**精确的** frailty-augmented HMC **后验**」**这一说法与其**采样设置**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实那些**数字**（**约三分之一的上行偏差、**两到十六倍的低估、**约 6 个覆盖率百分点、**「**复现论文已发表表格**」**）——**本次**未运行、**未对照论文**（**⭐ 原描述里的**「**the paper’s**」**指哪一篇，**本次**未核实**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实与 CRAN 的关系**：**本次**未在 CRAN 上检索该包名**，**故**只主张「**本次未见其在 CRAN**」**而不是「**它不在 CRAN**」。**⑥ ⚠️ 许可为 GPL (>= 3)（`DESCRIPTION` 字段）**，**⭐ 而**仓库内未见 `LICENSE` 文件****——**按惯例**以字段为准并如实指出缺文件**；**未读任何许可正文**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份**（**只读到姓名与一个**空的 ORCID 字段**）**；**★1 不构成质量证据**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2026-01-29 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**把经典准备金方法统一为可信度框架、**并自带可识别性诊断**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**（**池内覆盖各种实现与取向，但未有一条以**可信度理论**为主干**）。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。
entries.body_hk:
**hgr**（**逐字全名**「**The hidden grammar of reserving**」）**是一個通用保險準備金方法的 R 套件**，**本次實測版本為** `0.5.0`**。**本次實測**：**GitHub 倉庫** `robin-vo/hgr`**，**建立 2026-01-29、最後推送 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**R**；**許可**為 `GPL (>= 3)`（**`DESCRIPTION` 欄位**；**⭐ 本次清單裡未見 `LICENSE` 文件****）；**作者** `Robin Van Oirbeek`（**⭐ 其 `Authors@R` 的 ORCID 欄位為空字串，本詞條如實記錄**）**；**依賴**：`Imports` **逐字只有** `MASS`、`stats`、`graphics`，`Suggests` **逐字含** `ChainLadder`、`MCMCpack`、`rstan (>= 2.26.0)`、`testthat (>= 3.0.0)`、`ggplot2`**；**另有** `RoxygenNote: 7.2.3` **與** `Config/testthat/edition: 3`**。**文件清單實測 65 條**：`DESCRIPTION`、`NAMESPACE`、**四個 R 源檔**（`cnbg.R`、`multinomPI.R`、`nbcl.R`、`ucr.R`**）**、`README.md`（**8,165 位元組**）、**四個示例腳本**、**一個 Stan 模型**（`inst/stan/cnbg_exact.stan`**）**、**約 55 個 `man/*.Rd`**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**反向：誰接在我們已經收的東西上**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 `DESCRIPTION`、README 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 出發點是一句話，而那句話本身是一個**觀點****——**逐字**：**「**Implements a unified framework for macro-level reserving in non-life insurance, based on the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators.**」**，**並逐字**「**UCR nests Chain-Ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, and Cape Cod as special cases with data-adaptive credibility weights.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**矩不存在**」被做成了返回值**——**逐字**：**「**`(1-W)/W` is Beta-prime, whose k-th moment is finite only when `c·F > k`. The package enforces this and returns `NA` for the mean and standard error where they do not exist, **rather than a number with no population counterpart.**」**——**⭐ 即**一個數**沒有總體對應物**時，**正確輸出不是**一個看似合理的數字，**而是**缺失**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字指出自己哪個函式**不該用****——**逐字**：**「**the estimator is upward-biased by roughly a third at `I = 10`, and the closed-form asymptotic variance understates the true variance by a factor of two to sixteen; **use the bootstrap or the posterior, not `delta_method_var()`, for anything that matters**.**」**——**⭐ 即**不是「**可能不準**」，**而是**偏差量級、**低估倍數區間與**具體函式名**。**⭐⭐ ④ 兩個診斷不是一個門檻**——**逐字**：**「**Two diagnostics, not one threshold**: `diagnose_c()` reports the portfolio-specific operability bound `c†(τ) = τ/π₀` and, separately, the heterogeneity screen with its measured error rates. **They answer different questions and a portfolio can pass one while failing the other.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 它逐字給出兩種做法的**覆蓋率差多少****——**「**The plug-in costs about 6 coverage points at `I = 10` under correct specification; integrating over `c` recovers about two of them.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 連一處數學修正的後果都寫明**——**「**the partial-column proportions carry concentration `c·F_k`, not `c`; **without the correction the estimator is inconsistent**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 內容可數**：`DESCRIPTION` **逐字列出** NB-CL、UCR、Mack 無分布模型、Bühlmann-Straub 可信度理論、Dirichlet-Multinomial 參數自舉區間、**與** CNBG **金額三角模型及其可識別性邊界診斷**；**並逐字說明 CNBG**「**characterises what a paid-loss triangle can and cannot identify about reserve uncertainty**」**，**且自带**「**the paper’s simulation calibration as its defaults**」**、**兩種** working-likelihood **後驗**、**一個精確** HMC **後驗**、**一個 kappa 後驗診斷**（**flags when amount-only inference is unsupported****）**、**與** Fisher／Godambe／van Trees **資訊界**（**逐字**「**reproduce the paper’s published table at the package defaults**」**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 登記位置**：**安裝逐字為** `devtools::install_github("robin-vo/hgr")`**，**本次未在 CRAN 見到該套件**——**⭐ 與第 352 輪的 [[fitverse-r]]（**只在 CRAN、**只有唯讀鏡像**）**恰好相反**，**是另一種「**只在一個登記處**」**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[chainladder]]、[[reservingmodels]] 應當並讀**——**⭐ 其中兩點可直接照抄**：**① 一個數**沒有總體對應物**時回傳缺失值；② 明確寫出**哪個函式只適合做參考**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝 R、沒有安裝該套件、沒有擬合任何模型**，**故不主張** NB-CL／UCR／CNBG **按所述工作**，**也不主張**任何覆蓋率、偏差或資訊界數字**成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何 R 原始碼**（**只讀** `DESCRIPTION`、`README.md` **與文件清單**）。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未讀** `inst/stan/cnbg_exact.stan` **與** `examples/` **下任何腳本**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實那些數字**（**約三分之一上行偏差、**兩到十六倍低估、**約 6 個覆蓋率百分點、「**複現論文已發表表格**」**），**未對照論文**（**「**the paper’s**」指哪一篇本次未核實**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實與 CRAN 的關係**（**只主張「**本次未見**」**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 許可為 GPL (>= 3)（`DESCRIPTION` 欄位）**，**⭐ 而倉庫內未見 `LICENSE`**；**未讀任何許可正文**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份**；**★1 不構成品質證據**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2026-01-29 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「把經典準備金方法統一為可信度框架、並自带可識別性診斷」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。
entries.body_en:
The R package hgr, whose full title is the hidden grammar of reserving, **is a package of general insurance reserving methods**, measured this round at **version 0.5.0**. **Measured facts**: the GitHub repository was **created 2026-01-29** and **last pushed 2026-09-09**, with **one star** and R as the language; the licence field reads GPL version 3 or later **while no licence file is present in the repository**; the author field carries a name but an empty ORCID string, which this entry records as measured; and dependencies are unusually light, with only three imports and a suggested list containing the chain ladder package, a Markov chain package, Stan, testthat and ggplot2. **The file listing measures sixty-five entries**, holding a description file, a namespace, four R source files, a README of 8,165 bytes, four example scripts, a single Stan model and roughly fifty-five help files. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry, and this round method was to start from tools we have already collected and ask who uses them**, in this case asking who mentions the chain ladder package in a README.

**Verified information, all measured from the description file, the README and the file listing**: **first, the starting point is one sentence, and that sentence is a claim**: verbatim, the package implements a unified framework for macro-level reserving in non-life insurance, based on the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators, and unified credibility reserving nests chain ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson and Cape Cod as special cases with data-adaptive credibility weights. **Classical reserving methods are not several unrelated formulas but special cases of one credibility estimator under different weights, and that view is shipped as runnable code.** **Second, a moment that does not exist became a return value**: verbatim, the ratio used is Beta-prime, whose k-th moment is finite only when the product of the concentration parameter and a factor exceeds k, and the package enforces this and returns a missing value for the mean and standard error where they do not exist rather than a number with no population counterpart. **When a number has no population counterpart, the correct output is absence rather than a plausible-looking figure, and the word enforces indicates that this is a constraint in the code rather than advice in the documentation.** **Third, it names verbatim which of its own functions should not be used**: the estimator is upward-biased by roughly a third at the triangle sizes actually encountered, the closed-form asymptotic variance understates the true variance by a factor of two to sixteen, and readers should use the bootstrap or the posterior rather than the closed-form variance function for anything that matters. **The bias is given as a magnitude with the condition under which it occurs, the understatement is given as a multiplier range rather than as a warning that results may be inaccurate, and a specific function is named along with its replacements.** **Fourth, two diagnostics rather than one threshold**: one reports the portfolio-specific operability bound and, separately, the heterogeneity screen with its measured error rates, and they answer different questions so that a portfolio can pass one while failing the other. **Whether the method can report on this portfolio at all and whether the portfolio is itself homogeneous are two independent questions, and this entry considers that harder and more useful than setting a single threshold, because it requires measuring the error rates of each diagnostic separately.** **Fifth, it states how much coverage the plug-in approach costs**: about six coverage points at the smaller triangle sizes under correct specification, of which integrating over the concentration recovers about two, and the integration also removes most of the conditional miscalibration across triangles. **Neither approach is perfect and the difference between them is quantified, with the word about being the original wording.** **Sixth, even a mathematical correction is given with its consequence**: a partial-column moment method with a subcomposition correction is used because the partial-column proportions carry a scaled concentration rather than the concentration itself, and without the correction the estimator is inconsistent, **which is a stronger statement than merely being worse**. **Seventh, the contents are enumerable**: the description lists negative binomial chain ladder, unified credibility reserving, a distribution-free model, classical credibility theory, model-agnostic prediction intervals via a parametric bootstrap, and a compound negative binomial gamma amount-triangle model with its identification-boundary diagnostics; it says of that last part verbatim that it characterises what a paid-loss triangle can and cannot identify about reserve uncertainty; and it ships the paper simulation calibration as its defaults, a working-likelihood posterior in two variants, an exact posterior, a diagnostic carrying the paper regime and tier classification that flags when amount-only inference is unsupported, and three information bounds that reproduce a published table at the package defaults. **What a triangle can and cannot tell you is therefore a computable diagnostic rather than a disclaimer.** **Eighth, where it is registered**: installation is given verbatim through a GitHub installer call, and **this round did not find the package on CRAN**, which is the exact opposite of the shape recorded last round for a package present only on CRAN behind a read-only mirror: two different forms of existing in only one registry. **Ninth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled chain ladder entries cover implementations, the pooled reserving method entries cover methods and verification, and the pooled packages with adjacent orientations cover other approaches, while this entry supplies both the theoretical frame that unifies the classical methods as credibility estimators and the output discipline of returning a missing value where a moment does not exist while naming the function that should not be trusted.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[chainladder]] and [[reservingmodels]]**, because **it offers the view that a family of reserving methods are special cases of one framework**, together with a self-description that quantifies its own bias and coverage cost, and because **two of its practices transfer directly: return absence when a number has no population counterpart, and write down which function is for reference only rather than for conclusions**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, R was not installed, the package was not installed and no model was fitted** — nothing was installed from GitHub, no example was run and no test was executed — **so negative binomial chain ladder, unified credibility reserving and the amount-triangle model are not claimed to work as described, and none of the coverage, bias or information-bound figures is claimed to hold**. **Second, no R source was read**: only the description file, the README and the file listing were read, and neither the four source files nor the fifty-five help files were opened, **so nothing is claimed about how the credibility weights are estimated, how the identification diagnostics are implemented, or in which functions the missing-value return actually takes effect; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the Stan model and the example scripts were not read**, so the claim of an exact posterior is relayed rather than verified. **Fourth, none of the quoted numbers was verified** — not the one-third bias, not the two-to-sixteen multiplier, not the six coverage points, and not the claim of reproducing a published table — no run was performed and **the paper referred to in the description was not identified or consulted**. **Fifth, the relationship to CRAN was not established**; this entry claims only that the package was not seen there this round, not that it is absent. **Sixth, the licence is GPL version 3 or later by the description field while no licence file is present**, which is recorded as measured, and no licence text was read. **Seventh, the author identity was not verified beyond a name and an empty ORCID field, and one star is not evidence of quality. Eighth, the creation date of 2026-01-29 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-09 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that unifying classical reserving methods as credibility estimators, together with a built-in identifiability diagnostic, had no counterpart in the pool**, which covers implementations and orientations but nothing built on credibility theory as its backbone. **Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**

entries.title: **一个「暂存区」仓库：57 个寿险产品、六个国家，**每一条监管引用都是可点的链接****：`lifelib-dev/lifelib-products`——**逐字自述为**「**This repository is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib.**」**，**并逐字说明**「**It is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on**」**；**⭐ 57 个产品**各自带一个**可执行的参考模型**，**并**逐格断言**复现其技术说明里的算例**（**实测：美国 12／英国 7／日本 9／法国 9／德国 10／韩国 10**）**；**⭐ 仓库里还有**18 个自己的文档工具脚本****（**检查锚点、生成引用链接、以及把法规引用取消链接等**）
entries.title_en: A staging repository holding fifty-seven life insurance products across six countries where every regulatory citation is a working link: the lifelib-products repository states verbatim that it is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib, and verbatim that it is a staging ground rather than a package to install or depend on, with each of the fifty-seven products shipping an executable reference model that reproduces its own technical notes worked example asserted cell by cell, and with eighteen documentation tooling scripts of its own for checking anchors, generating citation links and unlinking specification citations.
entries.title_hk: **一個「暫存區」倉庫：57 個壽險產品、六個國家，**每一條監管引用都是可點的連結****：`lifelib-dev/lifelib-products`——**逐字自述為**「**This repository is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib.**」**，**並逐字說明**「**It is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on**」**；**⭐ 57 個產品**各自帶一個**可執行的參考模型**，**並**逐格斷言**複現其技術說明裡的算例**（**實測：美國 12／英國 7／日本 9／法國 9／德國 10／韓國 10**）**；**⭐ 倉庫裡還有**18 個自己的文件工具腳本****
entries.summary: **lifelib-products**（`lifelib-dev/lifelib-products`）**是一个「**暂存区**」仓库**，**逐字自述为**「**This repository is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib.**」**，**并逐字定性**「**It is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on: each library under `lifelib/libraries/` is written in the shape lifelib expects, and is drafted, reviewed and held to standard here until it lands upstream as a lifelib library of its own.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-03、最后推送 2026-09-11**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**、**README 17,095 字节**、**tarball 解出 1,835 条路径**；**许可**：**⚠️ 本次文件清单里**未见 `LICENSE` 文件****。**本条目属于本轮主题**「反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上」**，**它是本轮四条里**体量最大、覆盖面最宽**的一条**：**⭐ 它收录的是**主要寿险产品的产品规格，按国家组织**（**逐字**「**a library of product specifications for major life insurance products, organized by country**」**）**，**并附**建立负债现金流预测参考实现**所需的文档**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得抄**：**① **每个产品都有可执行的参考模型，且逐格断言****——**逐字**「**All fifty-seven products ship an executable reference model in `<library>/products/<product>/`, beside the documents that specify it — twelve in `lifelib/libraries/uslib/`, seven in `lifelib/libraries/uklib/`, nine in `lifelib/libraries/jplib/`, nine in `lifelib/libraries/frlib/`, ten in `lifelib/libraries/delib/` and ten in `lifelib/libraries/krlib/`, each one reproducing its own technical notes’ worked example, asserted cell by cell.**」**；**② **六套库都「**在形状上就是 lifelib 的库**」****——**逐字**「**All six are lifelib libraries in shape: they sit at the path lifelib puts its libraries on, they render as Sphinx page trees, and every regulatory citation in them is a working link.**」**；**③ **仓库自带 18 个文档工具脚本**（**本次实测** `tools/` 下含 `check_anchors.py`、`gen_citation_links.py`、`unlink_spec_citations.py`、`separate_citations.py`、`gen_scaffolding.py`、`gen_input_files.py`、`doccheck.py`、`md_lint.py` **等**）**。**⚠️ 本次未安装 lifelib／modelx、**未运行任何产品模型、**未核对任何监管引用是否真的可点**。
entries.summary_hk: **lifelib-products**（`lifelib-dev/lifelib-products`）**是一個「**暫存區**」倉庫**，**逐字自述為**「**This repository is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib.**」**，**並逐字定性**「**It is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on**」。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-03、最後推送 2026-09-11**、**★0**、**Python**、**README 17,095 位元組**、**tarball 解出 1,835 條路徑**；**⚠️ 本次清單裡未見 `LICENSE` 文件**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得抄**：**① **每個產品都有可執行的參考模型，且逐格斷言****（**逐字**「**each one reproducing its own technical notes’ worked example, asserted cell by cell**」**）**；**② **六套庫都「**在形狀上就是 lifelib 的庫**」**（**逐字**「**they sit at the path lifelib puts its libraries on, they render as Sphinx page trees, and every regulatory citation in them is a working link**」**）**；**③ **倉庫自带 18 個文件工具腳本**（**實測** `tools/` 下含 `check_anchors.py`、`gen_citation_links.py`、`unlink_spec_citations.py` **等**）**。**⚠️ 本次未安裝 lifelib／modelx、未運行任何模型**。
entries.summary_en: The repository lifelib-products **is a staging area rather than a released library**, stating verbatim that it is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib and verbatim that it is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on, with each library written in the shape the upstream project expects and held to standard until it lands upstream as a library of its own. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-03**, **last pushed 2026-09-11**, zero stars, primarily Python, **a README of 17,095 bytes**, **1,835 paths in the extracted archive**, and **no licence file present**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry, and of the four it is the widest in coverage**: it holds **a library of product specifications for major life insurance products organised by country**, together with the documentation needed to build reference implementations of liability cash flow projection models. **Three passages are worth copying**: all fifty-seven products ship an executable reference model beside the documents that specify it, each reproducing its own technical notes worked example and asserted cell by cell; all six libraries are upstream libraries in shape, sitting at the path the upstream project puts its libraries on, rendering as Sphinx page trees, and **carrying regulatory citations that are working links**; and the repository carries eighteen documentation tooling scripts of its own for checking anchors, generating citation links and unlinking specification citations. **lifelib and its modelling engine were not installed, no product model was run, and no regulatory citation was checked for reachability this round.**
entries.body:
**lifelib-products**（GitHub 仓库 `lifelib-dev/lifelib-products`）**是一个「**暂存区**」仓库**——**⭐ 逐字自述为**「**This repository is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib. It is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on: each library under `lifelib/libraries/` is written in the shape lifelib expects, and is drafted, reviewed and held to standard here until it lands upstream as a lifelib library of its own.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-03、最后推送 2026-09-11**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**、**README 17,095 字节**；**tarball 枚举 1,835 条路径**（**约 10.8 MB 压缩包**）；**⭐ 而**本次文件清单里**未见 `LICENSE` 文件****（**故本词条**不主张其许可状态**，**按惯例记作**权利不明****）**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上**」**——**⭐ 本条的线索来自**本站已收录的 [[lifelib]]**：**由它所属组织的另一个仓库**往上找**，**发现了这个**体量大得多**的暂存区**。**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**按本站惯例（**同一作者／组织的**近重复姊妹仓库**须谨慎**）**，**本条**属于「**同一组织的不同产品**」**，**故本条目**只记录该仓库自述与实测结构**，**并未做任何代码层面的比较**（**即**不主张它与池内 [[lifelib]] 有或没有代码重合**）**。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它收录的是**按国家组织的寿险产品规格 ＋ 参考实现文档****——**逐字**：**「**What it holds is a library of **product specifications for major life insurance products, organized by country**, together with the documentation needed to build **reference implementations of liability cash flow projection models** (lifelib/modelx style), organized by product type and country.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 覆盖范围被逐国、逐类写清，**且本次实测与自述一致****——**README 逐字**：**「**Current coverage: United States (6 individual life and 6 individual annuity product types), United Kingdom (7 product types, including pension annuities), Japan (9 product types, three of them 第三分野 health products), France (9 product types, five of them built on *assurance vie*), Germany (10 product types, organised on the *Drei-Schichten-Modell*) and Korea (10 product types, four of them 제3보험 third-sector products).**」**；**⭐ 本次实测逐库产品目录数**：**`uslib` 12、**`uklib` 7、**`jplib` 9、**`frlib` 9、**`delib` 10、**`krlib` 10**，**合计 **57****——**⭐ 与 README 逐字所写的**「**All fifty-seven products**」**及分国数字**逐项吻合**（**⭐ 本词条现场核对了这个加总：6＋6＝12、7、9、9、10、10 共 57**）**。**⭐ 即**这份清单**不是「**覆盖若干国家**」**，**而是**可以逐项点数**的**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 每个产品都带**可执行的参考模型**，**且**逐格断言****——**逐字**：**「**All fifty-seven products ship an executable reference model in `<library>/products/<product>/`, beside the documents that specify it — twelve in `lifelib/libraries/uslib/`, seven in `lifelib/libraries/uklib/`, nine in `lifelib/libraries/jplib/`, nine in `lifelib/libraries/frlib/`, ten in `lifelib/libraries/delib/` and ten in `lifelib/libraries/krlib/`, each one reproducing its own technical notes’ worked example, asserted cell by cell.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**「**文档里的算例**」**与「**代码里的实现**」**之间**不是靠人读**对齐的**，**而是**逐格断言**（**asserted cell by cell**）**——**⭐ 即**每份技术说明里的那张表**都被当成**测试用例**。**⭐⭐ ④ 六套库「**在形状上就是上游的库**」**——**逐字**：**「**All six are lifelib libraries in shape: they sit at the path lifelib puts its libraries on, they render as Sphinx page trees, and **every regulatory citation in them is a working link**.**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「**在形状上就是**」**——**即**这些库**不需要在合并时改结构**，**因为它们**已经放在上游要求的路径上**；**② ⭐⭐ **它们渲染成 Sphinx 页面树**——**即**文档结构也是按上游约定组织的**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **每一条监管引用都是可点的链接**——**⭐ 本词条认为这一条最实用**：**寿险产品规格里**监管条款是核心内容**，**而**引用一旦断链，**规格就只剩下说法**（**⚠️ 本次未抽查任何一条链接是否真的可点**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 仓库自带 18 个文档工具脚本**——**本次实测** `tools/` 下逐字含：`add_citation_anchors.py`、`check_anchors.py`、`doccheck.py`、`fix_doc_roles.py`、`fix_docstring_lists.py`、`fix_docstring_tables.py`、`fix_relative_links.py`、`gen_citation_links.py`、`gen_input_files.py`、`gen_scaffolding.py`、`md_lint.py`、`mdspans.py`、`rewrite_paths.py`、`separate_citations.py`、`unlink_spec_citations.py` **等**。**⭐ 即**「**保持引用可点、**锚点正确、**脚手架一致**」**这件事被**工具化**了**——**⭐ 而其中** `unlink_spec_citations.py` **与** `separate_citations.py` **两个名字**尤其值得记**：**一个把法规引用**取消链接**、**一个把引用**分离出来**（**⚠️ 本次未读脚本内容，故不主张其具体行为**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 顶层另有**合并相关的文档**——**实测根目录含** `MERGE.md`、`USLIB-MERGE-PLAN.md`、`README.md`、`.gitignore`、`requirements.txt`、`doc/`（**含** `Makefile` 与 `make.bat`**）**、`lifelib/`、`tools/`**——**⭐ 即**「**怎么把它并进上游**」**也写在仓库里**（**⚠️ 本次未读这两份合并文档**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 状态与日期写明**——**README 逐字**「**Status:** Draft, 2026-08-30.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[lifelib]] 记录的是**上游库本身**，**[[modelx]] 记录其建模引擎**，**[[aggregate-python]]、[[mies]]、[[ifrs17-calculation-engine]]、[[cashflower]]、[[tryangle]]、[[pymort]]、[[heavytails]] 覆盖**负债现金流与精算建模**的相邻实现**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**按国家组织的产品规格 ＋ 逐格断言的参考实现 ＋ 引用可点性工具链**」这一组合**；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**池内此前**没有**以「**产品规格库**」**为主体**的条目**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[lifelib]]、[[modelx]] 应当并读**——**它给的是**主要市场的寿险产品**如何被写成**可执行的规格**的一个大规模样本**（**六个国家、**五十七个产品、**每个都带可运行模型与逐格断言**）；**⭐ 而它对本站最有借鉴的一点是**：**「**文档里的算例**」应当被**当成测试**，**而不是当成人读的示例**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装 lifelib 或 modelx、没有运行任何产品模型、没有跑任何断言**，**故不主张**这 57 个参考模型按所述工作、不主张其**逐格断言**真的通过**、也不主张其文档算例与代码一致**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何产品规格或技术说明的正文**——**本次只读了** `README.md` **与文件清单**（**1,835 条路径的目录结构**），**故不主张**任何一个产品的条款结构、**负债现金流口径、**或各国监管依据的具体内容**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未读** `tools/` **下 18 个脚本、**未读** `MERGE.md` **与** `USLIB-MERGE-PLAN.md`**——**故不主张**其工具链的实际行为与合并计划**。**④ ⚠️ 未核对「**每一条监管引用都是可点链接**」**——**本次**未抽查任何一条链接**（**未访问任何监管机构页面**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实许可**：**本次未见 `LICENSE`**，**故**记作**权利不明**而**不是**「**无版权**」**；**⚠️ 这也意味着其中的规格文档**不宜再分发**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者／组织背景**、**未核实与上游 lifelib 的关系细节**（**只读到自述**）**；**★0 不构成质量证据**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未做任何代码级比较**：**本词条**不主张**本仓库与池内 [[lifelib]] 有或没有代码重合**——**⭐ 这是按本站「**同一组织的不同产品可并存但须说明未作比较**」的惯例如实标注**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2026-08-03 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-11 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**按国家组织的寿险产品规格库 ＋ 逐格断言的参考实现 ＋ 自带引用完整性工具链**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用英文原文时，把原文里的 ASCII 撇号（`notes’` 一处）写作 ’**——**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**。
