**lifelib-products**（GitHub 倉庫 `lifelib-dev/lifelib-products`）**是一個「**暫存區**」倉庫**——**⭐ 逐字自述為**「**This repository is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib. It is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on: each library under `lifelib/libraries/` is written in the shape lifelib expects, and is drafted, reviewed and held to standard here until it lands upstream as a lifelib library of its own.**」。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-03、最後推送 2026-09-11**、**★0**、**Python**、**README 17,095 位元組**；**tarball 列舉 1,835 條路徑**；**⭐ 本次清單裡未見 `LICENSE` 文件****（**故不主張其許可狀態，**按慣例記作**權利不明****）**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**反向：誰接在我們已經收的東西上**」**——**⭐ 線索來自本站已收錄的 [[lifelib]]**。**⭐ 並如實指出**：**本條屬「**同一組織的不同產品**」**，**故只記錄自述與實測結構**，**未做任何代碼層面的比較**。

**可核實資訊（均 README 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它收錄的是**按國家組織的壽險產品規格＋參考實作文件****（**逐字**「**a library of product specifications for major life insurance products, organized by country**」**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 覆蓋範圍逐國逐類寫清，且與實測一致**——**逐字**「**United States (6 individual life and 6 individual annuity product types), United Kingdom (7 product types, including pension annuities), Japan (9 product types, three of them 第三分野 health products), France (9 product types, five of them built on assurance vie), Germany (10 product types, organised on the Drei-Schichten-Modell) and Korea (10 product types, four of them 제3보험 third-sector products)**」**；**⭐ 本次實測逐庫產品目錄數為** 12／7／9／9／10／10，**合計 57**，**與自述**逐項吻合**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 每個產品都帶可執行的參考模型，且**逐格斷言****——**逐字**「**All fifty-seven products ship an executable reference model in `<library>/products/<product>/`, beside the documents that specify it — twelve in `lifelib/libraries/uslib/`, seven in `lifelib/libraries/uklib/`, nine in `lifelib/libraries/jplib/`, nine in `lifelib/libraries/frlib/`, ten in `lifelib/libraries/delib/` and ten in `lifelib/libraries/krlib/`, each one reproducing its own technical notes’ worked example, asserted cell by cell.**」**——**⭐ 即**文件裡的算例**被當成**測試用例**。**⭐⭐ ④ 六套庫「**在形狀上就是上游的庫**」**——**逐字**「**they sit at the path lifelib puts its libraries on, they render as Sphinx page trees, and every regulatory citation in them is a working link**」**——**⭐ 三處值得記**：**在形狀上就是**、**渲染成 Sphinx 頁面樹**、**每條監管引用都是可點連結**（**⚠️ 本次未抽查任何連結**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 倉庫自带 18 個文件工具腳本**——`tools/` 下逐字含 `check_anchors.py`、`gen_citation_links.py`、`unlink_spec_citations.py`、`separate_citations.py`、`gen_scaffolding.py`、`gen_input_files.py`、`doccheck.py`、`md_lint.py` **等**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 頂層另有**合併文件**（`MERGE.md`、`USLIB-MERGE-PLAN.md`**）與** `doc/`**；**⭐⭐ ⑦ 狀態逐字為**「**Status:** Draft, 2026-08-30.**」**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[lifelib]]、[[modelx]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是主要市場壽險產品如何被寫成**可執行規格**的大規模樣本**；**⭐ 而它最值得借鑑的一點是**：**「**文件裡的算例**」應當被**當成測試**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝 lifelib 或 modelx、沒有運行任何產品模型、沒有跑任何斷言**，**故不主張**這 57 個模型按所述工作、不主張逐格斷言真的通過**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何產品規格或技術說明的正文**——**只讀了** `README.md` **與文件清單**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未讀** `tools/` **下 18 個腳本與兩份合併文件**。**④ ⚠️ 未核對「**每條監管引用都是可點連結**」**（**未抽查任何一條**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未見 `LICENSE`**，**記作**權利不明**而**不是**「**無版權**」**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實作者／組織背景與與上游的關係細節**；**★0 不構成品質證據**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未做任何代碼級比較**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2026-08-03 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-11 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「按國家組織的壽險產品規格庫＋逐格斷言的參考實作＋自带引用完整性工具鏈」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用英文原文時，把原文裡的 ASCII 撇號（`notes’`）寫作 ’**——**以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（引文內容未改）**。
entries.body_en:
The repository lifelib-products **is a staging area rather than a released library**, stating verbatim that it is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib and verbatim that it is a staging ground rather than a package to install or depend on, with each library written in the shape the upstream project expects and drafted, reviewed and held to standard until it lands upstream as a library of its own. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-03**, **last pushed 2026-09-11**, zero stars, primarily Python, **a README of 17,095 bytes**, **1,835 paths enumerated from the archive**, and **no licence file present**, so no licence status is claimed and the rights are recorded as unclear. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry, and its lead came from a pooled entry**, since it was found by looking at another repository belonging to the same organisation as the pooled upstream library. **This entry states plainly that it records a different product from the same organisation, so only the stated description and the measured structure are recorded, and no code-level comparison was made.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, what it holds is a library of product specifications for major life insurance products organised by country**, together with the documentation needed to build reference implementations of liability cash flow projection models, organised by product type and country. **Second, the coverage is written out country by country and product class by product class, and it matches measurement**: the README names the United States with six individual life and six individual annuity product types, the United Kingdom with seven product types including pension annuities, Japan with nine including three health products in a specific Japanese market segment, France with nine of which five are built on a French life product wrapper, Germany with ten organised on a three-pillar model, and Korea with ten including four third-sector products. **The measured product directory counts per library are twelve, seven, nine, nine, ten and ten, summing to fifty-seven, which matches the stated figure item by item; this entry checked that addition on the spot, so the coverage claim is something that can be counted rather than a vague statement of covering several countries.** **Third, every product ships an executable reference model, and the technical notes worked examples are asserted cell by cell**: verbatim, all fifty-seven products ship an executable reference model beside the documents that specify it, distributed twelve, seven, nine, nine, ten and ten across the six libraries, each one reproducing its own technical notes worked example, asserted cell by cell. **The alignment between the table printed in the documentation and the code is therefore not left to human reading but asserted per cell: every table in a technical note becomes a test case.** **Fourth, all six libraries are upstream libraries in shape**: they sit at the path the upstream project puts its libraries on, they render as Sphinx page trees, and every regulatory citation in them is a working link. **Being in shape means these libraries need no restructuring at merge time, the documentation structure follows the same convention, and, most practically, regulatory clauses are the core content of a life product specification, so a broken citation would leave the specification as mere assertion, though no link was sampled for reachability this round.** **Fifth, the repository carries eighteen documentation tooling scripts of its own**, measured in a tools directory and including scripts for adding citation anchors, checking anchors, documentation checking, fixing roles, docstring lists, docstring tables and relative links, generating citation links, input files and scaffolding, markdown linting, markdown spans, rewriting paths, separating citations and unlinking specification citations. **Keeping citations clickable, anchors correct and scaffolding consistent has been turned into tooling**, and the last two of those names are the most interesting, one apparently unlinking specification citations and one separating them, **though the scripts were not read so their actual behaviour is not claimed**. **Sixth, the top level also holds merge documentation**: a merge file, a merge plan for one of the libraries, a README, an ignore file, a requirements file, a documentation directory with make files, the libraries directory and the tools directory, **so how to merge this into the upstream project is written down in the repository too, though those two merge documents were not read**. **Seventh, the status and its date are stated**: verbatim, draft as of 2026-08-30. **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled upstream library entry records the library itself, the pooled modelling engine entry records the engine, and the pooled liability cash flow and actuarial modelling entries cover neighbouring implementations, while this entry supplies product specifications organised by country, reference implementations asserted cell by cell, and a tool chain for citation integrity. **This entry states plainly that no pooled entry previously took a product specification library as its subject.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[lifelib]] and [[modelx]]**, because **it is a large-scale sample of how life insurance products in major markets are written as executable specifications**, with six countries, fifty-seven products, and a runnable model plus per-cell assertions for each, and because **its most transferable lesson is that a worked example printed in documentation should be treated as a test rather than as an illustration**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, neither the upstream library nor its modelling engine was installed, no product model was run and no assertion was executed**, **so the fifty-seven reference models are not claimed to work as described, the per-cell assertions are not claimed to pass, and the documentation examples are not claimed to agree with the code**. **Second, no product specification or technical note body was read**: only the README and the file listing of 1,835 paths were read, **so nothing is claimed about any product structure, liability cash flow definition or the regulatory basis in any country; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, neither the eighteen tooling scripts nor the two merge documents were read**, so their actual behaviour and the merge plan are not claimed. **Fourth, the claim that every regulatory citation is a working link was not checked**, no link was sampled and no regulator page was visited. **Fifth, the licence was not established**: no licence file was seen, so the rights are recorded as unclear rather than as absent copyright, **which also means the specification documents should not be redistributed**. **Sixth, the author and organisational background and the details of the relationship to the upstream project were not verified beyond the stated description, and zero stars is not evidence of quality. Seventh, no code-level comparison was made, and this entry makes no claim about whether this repository shares code with the pooled upstream library**, following the project convention that different products from one organisation may both be recorded provided the absence of comparison is stated. **Eighth, the creation date of 2026-08-03 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-11 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that a life product specification library organised by country, with reference implementations asserted cell by cell and a self-contained citation integrity tool chain, had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11. Tenth, quotation convention: the ASCII apostrophe appearing inside quoted English was rendered as a curved apostrophe so that this entry contains no ASCII single quote, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged.**

entries.title: **在纯 CPU 上复现 ICLR 2025 的表格模型论文，然后在保险数据上做了论文没做的一组对比**：`Flan246/tabm-reproduction`——**90 次训练（10 数据集 × 3 模型 × 3 种子）**、**逐项对照论文**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而保险那一组的结论是**反的****——**逐字**「**保险数据原创实验：GBDT 仍全面领先**」**（**LightGBM 泊松偏差 0.5740、**Gini 0.3491，**含调参 131 秒；**最佳神经网络 TabM 为 0.5927／0.3020，**单次训练 29 分钟且未收敛**）**；**⭐ 并逐字记下**一个工具为何失效****（**TabPFN v2 不支持 exposure offset，**故在该任务设定下失真**）
entries.title_en: Reproducing an ICLR 2025 tabular model paper on CPU alone and then running a comparison the paper did not run, on insurance data: ninety trainings across ten datasets, three models and three seeds compared item by item against the paper, with the insurance result going the other way, since gradient boosting still leads across the board with a measured deviance and Gini advantage and a training time of about two minutes against twenty-nine minutes for the best neural model which had not converged, and with the reason one tool failed recorded explicitly, namely that it does not support an exposure offset.
entries.title_hk: **在純 CPU 上複現 ICLR 2025 的表格模型論文，然後在保險資料上做了論文沒做的一組對比**：`Flan246/tabm-reproduction`——**90 次訓練（10 資料集 × 3 模型 × 3 種子）**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而保險那一組的結論是**反的****（**逐字**「**保险数据原创实验：GBDT 仍全面领先**」**）**；**⭐ 並逐字記下**一個工具為何失效****（**TabPFN v2 不支援 exposure offset**）
entries.summary: **tabm-reproduction**（`Flan246/tabm-reproduction`）**是一个**论文复现 ＋ 保险数据原创对比**项目**：**逐字自述为**「**在纯 CPU 环境复现 ICLR 2025 论文 TabM（Tabular Multiple Predictions，Gorishniy et al.，arXiv 2410.24210，官方仓库 yandex-research/tabm）的核心结果，并在保险索赔频率数据（freMTPL2）上做了一组超出论文范围的原创对比实验（深度集成 vs GBDT vs TabPFN）**」。**本次实测**：**创建与最后推送同为 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**主语言 Python**、**README 9,140 字节**、**许可 MIT**（**`LICENSE` 逐字前两行为** MIT License／Copyright (c) 2026 Flan246**）**、**文件清单实测 46 条**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上」**，**它的数据来源正是本站已收录的 [[casdatasets]]**（**freMTPL2**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得抄**：**① **复现结果是可数的****——**逐字**「**10 个数据集 × 3 个模型（MLP / TabM / TabM-mini）× 3 seed 共 90 次训练，TabM 系在全部 10 个数据集上优于 MLP，方向与论文完全一致**」**，**并给出数值保真的对照**（**逐字**「**california 上 TabM 负 RMSE -0.4410 vs 论文 -0.4414**」**）**；**② **它在保险数据上得到与论文**相反**的结论，并如实写出来****——**逐字**「**保险数据原创实验：GBDT 仍全面领先**」，**并给出三个可比的数**（**LightGBM 泊松偏差 0.5740／Gini 0.3491／含调参 131 秒；**TabM 0.5927／0.3020／单次训练 29 分钟且未收敛**）**；**③ **它逐字说明某个工具**为什么在该任务上不能用****——**逐字**「**TabPFN v2 因不支持 exposure offset 在该任务设定下失真**」。**⭐⭐ 过程留痕**：`report/` **下 8 份阶段报告**（**含** `phase0_notes.md`／`phase1_report.md`／`phase2_report.md`／`phase3_cleanup.md`／`reproduction_report.md`**）**，`env/` **下三份按阶段分开的锁定文件**，`results/` **下逐数据集 CSV 与四份运行日志**。**⚠️ 本次未运行任何训练、**未读任何报告正文**。
entries.summary_hk: **tabm-reproduction**（`Flan246/tabm-reproduction`）**是一個**論文複現＋保險資料原創對比**專案**：**逐字自述為**「**在纯 CPU 环境复现 ICLR 2025 论文 TabM（Tabular Multiple Predictions，Gorishniy et al.，arXiv 2410.24210）的核心结果，并在保险索赔频率数据（freMTPL2）上做了一组超出论文范围的原创对比实验（深度集成 vs GBDT vs TabPFN）**」。**本次實測**：**建立與最後推送同為 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**Python**、**README 9,140 位元組**、**許可 MIT**、**文件清單 46 條**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「反向」**，**其資料來源正是本站已收錄的 [[casdatasets]]**（freMTPL2**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得抄**：**① **複現結果可數**（**「**10 个数据集 × 3 个模型 × 3 seed 共 90 次训练**」**，**並給出數值保真對照**）**；**② **它在保險資料上得到與論文**相反**的結論並如實寫出**（**「**保险数据原创实验：GBDT 仍全面领先**」**）**；**③ **它逐字說明某工具**為何不能用**（**「**TabPFN v2 因不支持 exposure offset 在该任务设定下失真**」**）**。**⚠️ 本次未運行任何訓練、未讀任何報告正文**。
entries.summary_en: The project tabm-reproduction **reproduces an ICLR 2025 tabular deep learning paper and then adds an original comparison the paper did not run, on insurance data**. **Measured this round**: **created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-09**, **one star**, primarily Python, **a README of 9,140 bytes**, **an MIT licence** whose file names its copyright holder and year, and **forty-six paths in the file listing**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry, and its data comes from a package this wiki already holds**, specifically the insurance claim frequency dataset distributed with the collection of actuarial datasets. **Three things are worth copying**: the reproduction result is countable, being ninety trainings across ten datasets, three models and three seeds, with the tabular model family beating the plain multilayer perceptron on every dataset in the same direction as the paper, and with numerical fidelity reported against the paper to four decimal places; it reaches the opposite conclusion on insurance data and writes that out plainly, showing that gradient boosting still leads across the board with a specific Poisson deviance, a specific Gini, and a training time of about two minutes including tuning, against the best neural model at a worse deviance and Gini with twenty-nine minutes per training and no convergence; and it states verbatim why one of the tools could not be used in that task setting, namely that it does not support an exposure offset. **The process is also traceable**: eight phase reports, three separate dependency lock files by phase, per-dataset result files and four run logs. **No training was run and no report body was read this round.**
entries.body:
**tabm-reproduction**（GitHub 仓库 `Flan246/tabm-reproduction`）**是一个**论文复现 ＋ 保险数据原创对比**项目**，**README 逐字自述为**「**在纯 CPU 环境复现 ICLR 2025 论文 TabM（Tabular Multiple Predictions，Gorishniy et al.，arXiv 2410.24210，官方仓库 yandex-research/tabm）的核心结果，并在保险索赔频率数据（freMTPL2）上做了一组超出论文范围的原创对比实验（深度集成 vs GBDT vs TabPFN）**」。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-09、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**⭐ 即**该仓库**当天创建、当天推送**）、**★1**、**主语言 Python**、**README 9,140 字节**、**许可 MIT**（**`LICENSE` 逐字前两行为** `MIT License`／`Copyright (c) 2026 Flan246`**）**；**文件清单实测 46 条**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上**」**——**⭐ 其保险那一组实验的数据正是本站已收录的 [[casdatasets]] 里的** freMTPL2**（**公开保险索赔频率与赔付额数据**）**。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 复现的规模与结论都是可数的**——**README 逐字**：**「**论文核心结论 10/10 复现成立：10 个数据集 × 3 个模型（MLP / TabM / TabM-mini）× 3 seed 共 90 次训练，TabM 系在全部 10 个数据集上优于 MLP，方向与论文完全一致。**」**；**并逐字给出数值保真**：**「**数值保真度高：california 上 TabM 负 RMSE -0.4410 vs 论文 -0.4414；30 格中绝大多数偏差小于 seed 间标准差，MLP 行几乎逐位重合（证明 pipeline 保真）。**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 它把「**复现成立**」**写成一个可数的分数**（**10/10**）**与一个可加总的训练次数**（**90**）**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它把**自己的数与论文的数并排**（**-0.4410 对 -0.4414**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「**结果一致**」，**而是**给出差多少**；**③ ⭐⭐ 它给出一个**判据**说明偏差可接受**（**「**绝大多数偏差小于 seed 间标准差**」**）**——**⭐ 即**用**随机性本身的尺度**做参照**，**而不是用一个任意阈值**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它在保险数据上的结论与论文相反，而且写了出来**——**README 逐字**：**「**保险数据原创实验：GBDT 仍全面领先**。freMTPL2 索赔频率任务上，LightGBM（Poisson deviance 0.5740、Gini 0.3491、含调参训练 131 s）全面优于最优 NN（TabM 0.5927 / 0.3020 / 单次训练 29 分钟且未收敛）；TabM 稳定优于同结构 MLP（deviance -0.0068、Gini +0.024），集成增益真实存在但不足以反超 GBDT；TabPFN v2 因不支持 exposure offset 在该任务设定下失真。**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**三件事同时做了**——**① 它给了一个**与所复现论文方向相反**的结果**（**在该任务上树模型仍更强**）**；**② 它把**「**增益存在**」与「**增益足够**」分开说**（**TabM 优于同结构 MLP 是真的，**但**不足以反超 GBDT**）**；**③ 它指出**某个工具为什么不能用**，**而不是让它给出一个坏数字**（**TabPFN v2 不支持 exposure offset**）**——**⭐ 与本词条项目第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ③ 过程留痕可数**——**文件清单实测**：`report/` **下 8 份 markdown**（**逐字含** `datasets_inventory.md`、`phase0_notes.md`、`phase1_prep_notes.md`、`phase1_report.md`、`phase2_data_notes.md`、`phase2_report.md`、`phase3_cleanup.md`、`reproduction_report.md`**）**；`env/` **下三份按阶段分开的锁定文件**（`requirements.lock`、`requirements-paper.lock`、`requirements-phase2.lock`**）**；`results/phase1/` **下** 12 份 CSV（**含** `SUMMARY.csv`、`efficiency.csv` **与逐数据集结果**）**；`results/phase2/` **下** `comparison.csv`、`results.jsonl` **与四份运行日志**；`results/smoke_results.tsv`；`scripts/` **下 5 个脚本**（`run_smoke.py`、`phase1_queue.sh`、`aggregate_phase1.py`、`prepare_fremtpl2.py`、`phase2_fremtpl2.py`**）**。**⭐ 即**「**官方流水线一套环境、**自有增量一套环境**」**被分成**三份锁定文件**——**⭐ 这是本轮四条里**过程留痕**做得最细的一条**。**⭐⭐ ④ 不入库的东西被写明**——**README 的目录结构注释逐字标注**：`data/raw/` **为**「**freMTPL2 OpenML 原始下载（parquet + csv，不入 git）**」**，`.venv/` **与** `.venv-paper/` **各标**「**不入 git**」**，`third_party/tabm/` **标为**「**官方仓库克隆（Apache-2.0）**」**，`third_party/models/` **标**「**tabpfn-v2-regressor.ckpt（TabPFN v2 权重，不入 git）**」。**⭐ 即**「**哪些东西为了让别人能重跑就必须自己下载**」**被逐条说明**（**⭐ 而非只写一句「**数据需自行获取**」**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[casdatasets]]、[[fremtpl2]] 覆盖**保险公开数据集**，**[[tabpfn]]、[[tabpfn-insurance]] 覆盖**表格基础模型**，**[[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]、[[frmtpl-scaling-laws]] 覆盖**在同类数据上的建模研究**，**[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、[[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[burncost]]、[[ratecraft]] 覆盖**定价侧的 GLM／GBDT 做法**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**在同一个保险频率任务上，把深度集成、GBDT 与表格基础模型摆在一起比，**并把结论写成与论文方向相反**」这一形态**。**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**其结论只针对**该数据集的该任务设定**，**不能外推到所有表格任务**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[casdatasets]]、[[tabpfn-insurance]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「**保险定价里到底该用树模型还是神经网络**」这一问题上**一份带具体数字与具体任务设定的对照**；**⭐ 而它对本站最有借鉴的三点**：**① 复现要给出「**自己的数 vs 原论文的数**」；**② 「**有增益**」与「**增益足够**」要分开说**；**③ 一个工具**不适用于该设定时**，**要说明原因，而不是让它输出一个坏数字**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行任何训练、没有安装任何依赖、没有复现任何一个数**（**未跑** `run_smoke.py` **或任何 phase 脚本、**未读任何 CSV 或日志**），**故不主张** 90 次训练的结论、**不主张**任何 deviance／Gini／RMSE 数值、**也不主张**其与原论文「**方向一致**」这一判断**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读 `report/` 下 8 份报告任何正文**（**本次只读文件清单与 README**），**故不主张**各阶段的判断、数据集清单、参数设定与「**未收敛**」的判定依据**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实原论文与官方仓库**：**未打开 arXiv 2410.24210、**未访问** yandex-research/tabm**，**故不主张**「**复现了论文核心结果**」**这一说法成立**（**⭐ 本词条只转述其自述**）。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** freMTPL2 **数据的获取与许可**（**⚠️ 该数据是**公开数据集**，**但**其**再分发条件**本次未核实**）**；**亦**未核实** TabPFN **权重的许可与来源**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** LightGBM 与 TabM 的**超参搜索预算是否可比**（**⭐ 原文给出**「**含调参训练 131 s**」**，**而** TabM**「**单次训练 29 分钟**」**——**⚠️ 两者口径不同，**本词条**不据此判定比较是否公平**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份**（**只读到** LICENSE **里的** `Flan246`**）**；**★1 不构成质量证据**。**⑦ ⚠️ 许可为 MIT（`LICENSE` 存在，**本次读到前两行**）**，**未读正文**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**仓库内**第三方克隆与权重**均**不入 git**（**自述**）**，**故其许可范围**只覆盖本仓库自身的代码与文档**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建与推送均为 2026-09-09，**都在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「**在保险频率任务上把深度集成、GBDT 与表格基础模型三方对照、**并写出与论文相反的结论**」这一形态，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。
entries.body_hk:
**tabm-reproduction**（GitHub 倉庫 `Flan246/tabm-reproduction`）**是一個**論文複現＋保險資料原創對比**專案**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-09-09、最後推送 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**Python**、**README 9,140 位元組**、**許可 MIT**（**`LICENSE` 逐字前兩行為** `MIT License`／`Copyright (c) 2026 Flan246`**）**；**文件清單 46 條**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**反向：誰接在我們已經收的東西上**」**——**⭐ 其保險那一組實驗的資料正是本站已收錄的 [[casdatasets]] 裡的** freMTPL2**。

**可核實資訊（均 README 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 複現的規模與結論都可數**——**逐字**「**论文核心结论 10/10 复现成立：10 个数据集 × 3 个模型（MLP / TabM / TabM-mini）× 3 seed 共 90 次训练**」**；**並逐字給出數值保真**「**california 上 TabM 负 RMSE -0.4410 vs 论文 -0.4414**」**與判據**「**绝大多数偏差小于 seed 间标准差**」**。**⭐ 即**不是「**結果一致**」，**而是**差多少被寫明，**且**以**隨機性本身的尺度**為參照**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它在保險資料上的結論與論文相反，而且寫了出來**——**逐字**「**保险数据原创实验：GBDT 仍全面领先。freMTPL2 索赔频率任务上，LightGBM（Poisson deviance 0.5740、Gini 0.3491、含调参训练 131 s）全面优于最优 NN（TabM 0.5927 / 0.3020 / 单次训练 29 分钟且未收敛）；TabM 稳定优于同结构 MLP（deviance -0.0068、Gini +0.024），集成增益真实存在但不足以反超 GBDT；TabPFN v2 因不支持 exposure offset 在该任务设定下失真。**」**——**⭐ 即**三件事同時做了：**給出與論文方向相反的結果**、**把「**增益存在**」與「**增益足夠**」分開說**、**指出某工具**為何不能用**。**⭐⭐ ③ 過程留痕可數**：`report/` **下 8 份 markdown**、`env/` **下三份按階段分開的鎖定檔**、`results/phase1/` **下 12 份 CSV**、`results/phase2/` **下** `comparison.csv` **與** `results.jsonl` **及四份日誌**、`scripts/` **下 5 個腳本**。**⭐⭐ ④ 不入庫的東西被寫明**——**目錄註解逐字標注** `data/raw/`**（**parquet + csv，**不入 git**）**、**`.venv/` **與** `.venv-paper/`**、**`third_party/tabm/`**（**官方倉庫克隆，**Apache-2.0**）**、**`third_party/models/`**（**TabPFN v2 權重，**不入 git**）**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[casdatasets]]、[[tabpfn-insurance]] 應當並讀**——**⭐ 三點最值得借鑑**：**① 複現要給出「**自己的數 vs 原論文的數**」；② 「**有增益**」與「**增益足夠**」要分開說；③ 工具不適用時要說明原因，而不是讓它輸出壞數字**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行任何訓練、沒有安裝任何依賴、沒有複現任何一個數**，**故不主張** 90 次訓練的結論、**不主張**任何 deviance／Gini／RMSE 數值。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀 `report/` 下 8 份報告任何正文**（**只讀文件清單與 README**）。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實原論文與官方倉庫**（**未打開** arXiv 2410.24210、**未訪問** yandex-research/tabm**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實** freMTPL2 **的獲取與許可，**亦未核實** TabPFN **權重的許可與來源**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實** LightGBM 與 TabM 的**超參預算是否可比**（**兩者口徑不同，**不據此判定比較是否公平**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份**；**★1 不構成品質證據**。**⑦ ⚠️ 許可為 MIT，未讀正文**；**第三方克隆與權重不入 git，**故其許可範圍只覆蓋本倉庫自身的程式碼與文件**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立與推送均為 2026-09-09，在解凍窗口之內**；**但「在保險頻率任務上把深度集成、GBDT 與表格基礎模型三方對照、並寫出與論文相反的結論」此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。
entries.body_en:
The project tabm-reproduction **reproduces an ICLR 2025 tabular deep learning paper and then adds an original comparison that the paper did not run, on insurance claim frequency data**. **Measured this round**: **created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-09**, **one star**, primarily Python, **a README of 9,140 bytes**, **an MIT licence** whose first two lines name the licence and a copyright holder with the year 2026, and **forty-six paths in the file listing**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry, since the insurance experiment uses the dataset distributed with a collection this wiki already holds.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, the scale and the outcome of the reproduction are countable.** The README states verbatim that the paper core conclusions are reproduced ten out of ten, across ten datasets, three models and three seeds, ninety trainings in total, with the tabular model family beating the plain perceptron on all ten datasets in the same direction as the paper; and it gives numerical fidelity, reporting a negative root mean squared error of minus zero point four four one zero on one dataset against the paper minus zero point four four one four, noting that most of the thirty cells differ by less than the standard deviation between seeds and that the perceptron rows almost coincide digit for digit, which it presents as evidence that the pipeline is faithful. **A reproduction is therefore expressed as a countable fraction and a total number of runs, its own numbers are placed beside the paper numbers rather than described as consistent with them, and the acceptability criterion is the scale of randomness itself rather than an arbitrary threshold.** **Second, the insurance result goes the other way and is written out**: the README states verbatim that the original insurance experiment shows gradient boosting still leading across the board, giving a specific Poisson deviance, Gini coefficient and training time including tuning for the gradient boosting model, all better than the best neural network at a worse deviance and Gini with twenty-nine minutes per training and no convergence, while the tabular model family does beat a perceptron of the same structure with a deviance improvement and a Gini improvement, so an ensemble gain exists but is not enough to overtake gradient boosting, and finally that one tool distorts on this task setting because it does not support an exposure offset. **Three things are done at once: a result pointing the opposite way from the reproduced paper, a separation between a gain existing and a gain being sufficient, and an explanation of why a tool cannot be used rather than letting it produce a bad number, which matches the project convention of refusing rather than pretending.** **Third, the process is traceable and countable**: eight phase reports including a dataset inventory, phase notes for four phases and a summary reproduction report; three separate dependency lock files, one for the main environment, one for the official pipeline and one for the additional phase; twelve result files for the first phase including a summary and an efficiency table; a comparison file, a JSON lines result file and four run logs for the second phase; a smoke-test result file; and five scripts including a smoke runner, a queue script, an aggregator and two data preparation and experiment scripts. **The official pipeline and the author own incremental work are kept in separate environments, which is the most detailed process record of the round four.** **Fourth, what is deliberately not committed is stated**: the raw download of the insurance dataset is annotated as not going into git, both virtual environments are annotated the same way, the third-party clone is annotated with its licence, and the downloaded model weights are annotated as not committed. **Which items a reader must fetch themselves in order to re-run is therefore spelled out line by line rather than summarised as obtaining the data yourself.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the insurance datasets, the tabular foundation models, modelling studies on the same data, and pricing-side generalised linear and boosting approaches, while this entry supplies a three-way comparison on one insurance frequency task that reaches a conclusion opposite to the reproduced paper. **This entry states plainly that the conclusion applies only to this dataset and task setting and cannot be extrapolated to all tabular tasks.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[casdatasets]] and [[tabpfn-insurance]]**, because **it is a comparison with concrete numbers and a concrete task setting for the question of whether insurance pricing should use tree models or neural networks**, and because **three of its practices transfer directly: a reproduction should print its own number beside the paper number, a gain existing should be separated from a gain being sufficient, and a tool that does not apply to a setting should be explained rather than allowed to emit a bad number**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no training was run, no dependency was installed and no number was reproduced** — no smoke runner and no phase script was executed and no result file or log was read — **so the ninety-training conclusion is not claimed, no deviance, Gini or error figure is claimed, and the judgement that the direction agrees with the paper is not claimed**. **Second, no report body was read**, only the file listing and the README, **so the judgements of each phase, the dataset inventory, the parameter settings and the basis for declaring non-convergence are not claimed; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, neither the original paper nor the official repository was verified**: the preprint was not opened and the official repository was not visited, **so the claim of reproducing the paper core results is relayed rather than established**. **Fourth, neither the acquisition and licensing of the insurance dataset nor the licensing and provenance of the model weights was verified**, and although the dataset is public, its redistribution terms were not checked. **Fifth, whether the hyperparameter search budgets of the two competing approaches are comparable was not verified**: the README gives a training time for one including tuning and a per-run time for the other, **and this entry does not use those two figures to judge whether the comparison is fair**. **Sixth, the author identity was not verified beyond the name in the licence file, and one star is not evidence of quality. Seventh, the licence is MIT and its text was not read, and since the third-party clone and the model weights are reportedly not committed, the licence scope covers only this repository own code and documents. Eighth, creation and push both fall on 2026-09-09 inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed; however, the shape of a three-way comparison of deep ensembles, gradient boosting and a tabular foundation model on one insurance frequency task, reporting a conclusion opposite to the reproduced paper, had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**

entries.title: **它不给你一个干净的三角，而是**先造一整条理赔生命周期、再自己把它弄脏、再用 SQL 洗干净****：`mouad-asb/loss-reserving-engine`——**四个 R 文件串成一条链**（**数据生成 → DuckDB 清洗与建三角 → 载入 → Shiny 看板**）；**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Rather than using a pre-cleaned triangle, the presented pipeline simulates the entire claims lifecycle from scratch, injecting realistic noise (mixed date formats, zero payments, subrogation)**」**；**⭐ 终点是**Mack 链梯 ＋ ODP 自举**两种准备金估计**
entries.title_en: Instead of handing you a clean triangle it first generates an entire claims lifecycle, then dirties it on purpose and then cleans it with SQL: the loss reserving engine at mouad-asb strings four R files into one chain, from data generation through DuckDB cleaning and triangle construction to loading and a Shiny dashboard, stating verbatim that rather than using a pre-cleaned triangle the pipeline simulates the entire claims lifecycle from scratch and injects realistic noise such as mixed date formats, zero payments and subrogation, and ending at two reserving estimates, a deterministic chain ladder and a stochastic bootstrap.
entries.title_hk: **它不給你一個乾淨的三角，而是**先造一整條理賠生命週期、再自己把它弄髒、再用 SQL 洗乾淨****：`mouad-asb/loss-reserving-engine`——**四個 R 檔串成一條鏈**（**資料生成 → DuckDB 清洗與建三角 → 載入 → Shiny 看板**）；**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Rather than using a pre-cleaned triangle, the presented pipeline simulates the entire claims lifecycle from scratch, injecting realistic noise (mixed date formats, zero payments, subrogation)**」**；**⭐ 終點是**Mack 鏈梯＋ODP 自舉**兩種準備金估計**
entries.summary: **loss-reserving-engine**（`mouad-asb/loss-reserving-engine`）**是一条通用保险的准备金流水线**，**逐字自述为**「**A loss reserving pipeline for general insurance, combining actuarial methods with a stochastic simulation engine and an interactive Shiny dashboard.**」。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-05-08、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**主语言 R**、**README 10,323 字节**、**文件清单只有 6 条**（**四个 R 文件 ＋ README ＋ 一份原始理赔交易 CSV**）；**⚠️ 仓库内**未见 `LICENSE` 文件****。**本条目属于本轮主题**「反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上」**——**⭐ 它接在本站已收录的 [[chainladder]] 方法体系上**（**终点为** Mack 链梯与 ODP 自举**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得抄**：**① **它不拿现成的干净三角**，**而是**自己造数据、**自己弄脏、**自己洗****——**逐字**「**Rather than using a pre-cleaned triangle, the presented pipeline simulates the entire claims lifecycle from scratch, injecting realistic noise (mixed date formats, zero payments, subrogation), then uses a SQL layer to clean and construct the development triangle**」**；**② **整条链被画成一张五行图**（`01_stoch_data_generator.R` → `02_sql_engine.R`（**DuckDB**，**产出** `insurance_reserving.duckdb` **与** `v_incremental_triangle` **视图**）→ `global.R` → `app.R`（**Mack 链梯 ＋ ODP 自举**）**）**；**③ **仿真是**有参数的**、**不是随意的**（**泊松计数 λ=1500、**年增 5%；**对数正态赔付 μ=8.5／σ=1.5、**年通胀 4%；**Weibull 报案延迟 shape=1.2／scale=30**）**，**并逐字给出选择理由**。**⚠️ 本次未运行任何一步、**未读四个 R 文件**。
entries.summary_hk: **loss-reserving-engine**（`mouad-asb/loss-reserving-engine`）**是一條通用保險的準備金流水線**，**逐字自述為**「**A loss reserving pipeline for general insurance, combining actuarial methods with a stochastic simulation engine and an interactive Shiny dashboard.**」。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-05-08、最後推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**R**、**README 10,323 位元組**、**文件清單只有 6 條**；**⚠️ 未見 `LICENSE`**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「反向」**——**⭐ 它接在本站已收錄的 [[chainladder]] 方法體系上**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得抄**：**① **它不拿現成的乾淨三角**，**而是**自己造資料、自己弄髒、自己洗**；**② **整條鏈被畫成五行圖**（生成 → DuckDB 清洗與建三角 → 載入 → Shiny（**Mack 鏈梯＋ODP 自舉**）**）**；**③ **仿真是**有參數的**（**泊松 λ=1500／年增 5%；**對數常態 μ=8.5、σ=1.5／年通脹 4%；**Weibull 延遲 shape=1.2／scale=30**）**。**⚠️ 本次未運行任何一步、未讀四個 R 檔**。
entries.summary_en: The loss reserving engine at mouad-asb **is a reserving pipeline for general insurance**, described verbatim as combining actuarial methods with a stochastic simulation engine and an interactive Shiny dashboard. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-05-08**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, zero stars, primarily R, **a README of 10,323 bytes**, **and a file listing of only six entries**, being four R files, the README and one raw claims transactions file, **with no licence file present**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry, and it builds on the chain ladder method family this wiki already holds**, ending at a deterministic Mack chain ladder and a stochastic bootstrap. **Three things are worth copying**: rather than starting from a clean triangle it generates the data itself, dirties it itself and then cleans it, stating verbatim that instead of using a pre-cleaned triangle the pipeline simulates the entire claims lifecycle from scratch and injects realistic noise such as mixed date formats, zero payments and subrogation before using a SQL layer to clean and construct the development triangle; the whole chain is drawn as a five-line diagram running from a stochastic data generator through a database layer that ingests, cleans and builds the triangle into a view, then a loader and finally a dashboard holding two reserving methods; and the simulation is parameterised rather than arbitrary, with a Poisson claim count with an annual growth factor, a log-normal severity with an inflation adjustment, and a Weibull reporting delay, each accompanied by a stated reason for the choice. **Nothing was run and none of the four R files was read this round.**
entries.body:
**loss-reserving-engine**（GitHub 仓库 `mouad-asb/loss-reserving-engine`，**逐字标题**「**Loss Reserving & Risk Analytics Engine**」）**是一条通用保险的准备金流水线**，**逐字自述为**「**A loss reserving pipeline for general insurance, combining actuarial methods with a stochastic simulation engine and an interactive Shiny dashboard.**」。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-05-08、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**主语言 R**、**README 10,323 字节**；**⭐ 文件清单实测只有 6 条**：`01_stoch_data_generator.R`、`02_sql_engine.R`、`app.R`、`global.R`、`raw_claims_transactions.csv`、`README.md`——**⚠️ 其中**未见 `LICENSE` 文件****（**故本词条**不主张其许可状态**，**按惯例记作**权利不明****）**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上**」**——**⭐ 本条的方法终点正是本站已收录的 [[chainladder]] 那一族**（**Mack 链梯与 ODP 自举**）**。

**可核实信息（均 README 实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**数据从哪来**」当成流水线的第一段，而且**故意先弄脏再洗****——**README 逐字**：**「**Rather than using a pre-cleaned triangle, the presented pipeline simulates the entire claims lifecycle from scratch, injecting realistic noise (mixed date formats, zero payments, subrogation), then uses a SQL layer to clean and construct the development triangle, and finally applies two industry-standard reserving methods with an interactive dashboard for exploring results.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**多数准备金示例**从一份干净的三角开始**，**于是把「**数据清洗**」这一整段**留在示例之外**；**⭐ 而它把清洗**当成流水线的一段**，**并**先注入三类真实缺陷**（**日期格式混杂、**零赔付、**代位追偿 subrogation**）**，**再用 SQL 把它们处理掉**——**⭐ 即**「**能处理脏数据**」这件事被**演示**了，**而不是被**声称**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 整条链被画成一张五行图，每一段都有明确输入输出**——**README 逐字的架构块为**：**`01_stoch_data_generator.R`（**逐字**「**Simulate claims lifecycle → raw_claims_transactions.csv**」**）→ `02_sql_engine.R`（**逐字**「**DuckDB ingestion + cleaning + triangle construction → insurance_reserving.duckdb (v_incremental_triangle view)**」**）→ `global.R`（**逐字**「**Load triangle from DB → cumulative triangle matrix**」**）→ `app.R`（**逐字**「**Shiny dashboard**」，**其下并列两法**：**「**Mack Chain Ladder (deterministic point estimate)**」**与**「**ODP Bootstrap (stochastic)**」**）**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 中间那一段是**数据库**（**DuckDB**）**，**且**产出的视图名**被写出来**（**`v_incremental_triangle`**）**——**⭐ 即**「**三角**」在这里是**一个 SQL 视图**，**而不是内存里的一个矩阵**；**② ⭐⭐ 两种准备金方法被并列成**确定性点估计**与**随机结果**两条**（**Mack 对 ODP 自举**）**；**③ ⭐⭐ 每一段都写明**输入与输出**（**CSV → DB 视图 → 累计矩阵 → 看板**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 仿真是**有参数的**，**且每个参数给出理由****——**README 逐字给出**：**计数**「**N_t ~ Poisson(λ · g^t), λ = 1500, g = 1.05**」**，**理由逐字为**「**A 5% annual growth rate reflects a typical expanding general insurance portfolio.**」；**赔付**「**U_i ~ LogNormal(μ = 8.5, σ = 1.5) × (1.04)^{t - t_0}**」**，**理由逐字为**「**Log-Normal is the standard actuarial choice for severity — it captures the right-skewed distribution of insurance losses where large claims are rare but extremely costly.**」；**报案延迟**「**D_i ~ Weibull(shape = 1.2, scale = 30)**」**，**并逐字说明**「**The Weibull shape > 1 produces a distribution where most claims are reported**」（**本次所读到的句子在此处截断，本词条不补全它**）**。**⭐ 即**这三个分布**都不是默认值**，**而是**各带一句「**为什么用它**」**——**⭐ 与本词条项目第 340 轮「**写下每个数字从哪来**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ④ README 的目录结构是可数的**——**它自带一份**目录**（**逐字含** `Overview`／`Background`／`Architecture`／`Data Simulation`／`SQL Layer`／`Reserving Methods`／`Shiny Dashboard`／`Setup`／`Usage`／**`Further Work`**／`References`**）**——**⭐ 即**「**还没做什么**」（`Further Work`）**与**「**参考文献**」（`References`）**被列为独立小节**，**而不是省略**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[chainladder]]、[[chainladder-python]] 覆盖**链梯实现**，**[[stochastic-reserving-england]]、[[reservingmodels]]、[[actuarial-reserving]]、[[gi-loss-reserving]]、[[verified-reserving]] 覆盖**准备金与随机方法**，**[[duckdb]] 覆盖**该数据库**，**[[great-expectations]]、[[sdv]] 覆盖**数据校验与合成数据**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**用 DuckDB 当清洗层、**并在一个看板里并置确定性链梯与随机自举**」这一组合**；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**它只有 6 个文件、★0、且未见许可**，**故本条的定位是**「**一个结构清楚的小型样本**」**，**而不是一个成熟工具**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[chainladder]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「**从脏数据到准备金估计**」的一条完整且**可数的链**（**四个文件、**五个步骤、**三种注入缺陷、**两种准备金方法**）；**⭐ 而它对本站最有借鉴的一点是**：**把「**清洗**」当流水线的一段来演示，**而不是假设数据已经干净**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装 R、没有运行任何一步**（**未跑 `01_stoch_data_generator.R`、**未建过 DuckDB、**未启动 Shiny 看板、**未跑任何准备金估计**），**故不主张**该流水线按所述工作、**不主张**其三角构造与准备金结果正确**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 R 源码**——**本次只读了** `README.md` **与文件清单**，**故不主张**清洗规则的具体实现、**三角构造的算法、**Shiny 交互细节、**以及两种方法的具体参数**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** DuckDB **视图** `v_incremental_triangle` **是否真的存在**（**未打开该数据库**——**⭐ 且该 `.duckdb` 文件**不在仓库里**，**故它只在运行生成后才存在**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实 README 里被截断的那句关于** Weibull **延迟的说明**（**本次所读文本在该句处中断**）**；**故**本词条**不补全它**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实其「**两种业界标准方法**」**这一说法**（**Mack 与 ODP 自举**）**与**本站已收录条目**的实现是否一致**；**⚠️ 未核实** Mack **模型的标准误公式在该实现中是否正确**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与项目背景**；**★0 不构成质量证据**。**⑦ ⚠️ 许可未主张**：**未见 `LICENSE`**，**记作**权利不明**而**不是**「**无版权**」**；**⚠️ 故其中的代码与 CSV **不宜再分发**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2026-05-08 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-10 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**把数据清洗作为准备金流水线的一段、**并在一张看板里并置确定性链梯与随机自举**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。

**可核實資訊（均 README 實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**資料從哪來**」當成流水線第一段，而且**故意先弄髒再洗****——**逐字**：**「**Rather than using a pre-cleaned triangle, the presented pipeline simulates the entire claims lifecycle from scratch, injecting realistic noise (mixed date formats, zero payments, subrogation), then uses a SQL layer to clean and construct the development triangle, and finally applies two industry-standard reserving methods with an interactive dashboard for exploring results.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**能處理髒資料**」被**演示**了，**而不是被**聲稱**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 整條鏈被畫成五行圖**——**逐字**：`01_stoch_data_generator.R`（「**Simulate claims lifecycle → raw_claims_transactions.csv**」）→ `02_sql_engine.R`（「**DuckDB ingestion + cleaning + triangle construction → insurance_reserving.duckdb (v_incremental_triangle view)**」）→ `global.R`（「**Load triangle from DB → cumulative triangle matrix**」）→ `app.R`（「**Shiny dashboard**」，**並列**「**Mack Chain Ladder (deterministic point estimate)**」**與**「**ODP Bootstrap (stochastic)**」**）**。**⭐ 即**「**三角**」在這裡是**一個 SQL 視圖**，**而不是記憶體裡的一個矩陣**。**⭐⭐ ③ 仿真是**有參數的**，**且每個參數給出理由****——**逐字**：`N_t ~ Poisson(λ · g^t), λ = 1500, g = 1.05`（**理由**「**A 5% annual growth rate reflects a typical expanding general insurance portfolio.**」）、`U_i ~ LogNormal(μ = 8.5, σ = 1.5) × (1.04)^{t - t_0}`（**理由**「**Log-Normal is the standard actuarial choice for severity**」）、`D_i ~ Weibull(shape = 1.2, scale = 30)`。**⭐⭐ ④ README 自带目錄**（**含** Architecture／Data Simulation／SQL Layer／Reserving Methods／Shiny Dashboard／Setup／Usage／**Further Work**／References**）**——**⭐ 即**「**還沒做什麼**」與「**參考文獻**」是獨立小節**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：**本站 [[chainladder]]、[[duckdb]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]]、[[gi-loss-reserving]] 覆蓋相鄰主題**；**⭐ 本詞條如實指出**：**它只有 6 個文件、★0、且未見許可**，**故定位是「**一個結構清楚的小型樣本**」。**

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[chainladder]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「**從髒資料到準備金估計**」的一條完整且**可數**的鏈**；**⭐ 最值得借鑑的一點是**：**把「**清洗**」當流水線的一段來演示**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝 R、沒有運行任何一步**，**故不主張**該流水線按所述工作、**不主張**其三角構造與準備金結果正確**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何 R 原始碼**——**只讀** `README.md` **與文件清單**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** DuckDB **視圖** `v_incremental_triangle` **是否真的存在**（**未打開該資料庫，**且該檔**不在倉庫裡**，**只在執行後才產生**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實 README 裡被截斷的那句關於** Weibull **延遲的說明**（**本次所讀文本在該句處中斷**）**——**本詞條不補全它**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**「**兩種業界標準方法**」**與本站已收錄實作是否一致**，**未核實** Mack **標準誤公式在該實作中是否正確**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份**；**★0 不構成品質證據**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未見 `LICENSE`**，**記作**權利不明**；**其程式碼與 CSV **不宜再分發**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2026-05-08 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-10 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「把資料清洗作為準備金流水線的一段、並在一張看板裡並置確定性鏈梯與隨機自舉」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。
entries.body_en:
The loss-reserving engine, titled as a loss reserving and risk analytics engine, **is a reserving pipeline for general insurance**, described verbatim as combining actuarial methods with a stochastic simulation engine and an interactive dashboard. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-05-08**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, zero stars, primarily R, **a README of 10,323 bytes**, and **a file listing of only six entries**, namely four R files, a README and one raw claims transactions file, **with no licence file present**, so no licence status is claimed and the rights are recorded as unclear. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry, and its methods end exactly at the chain ladder family this wiki already holds.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README**: **first, where the data comes from is the first stage of the pipeline, and it deliberately dirties the data before cleaning it.** The README states verbatim that rather than using a pre-cleaned triangle, the pipeline simulates the entire claims lifecycle from scratch, injecting realistic noise such as mixed date formats, zero payments and subrogation, then uses a SQL layer to clean and construct the development triangle, and finally applies two industry-standard reserving methods with an interactive dashboard for exploring results. **Most reserving examples begin from a clean triangle and therefore leave the entire cleaning stage outside the example, while here cleaning is a named stage of the pipeline, three realistic defects are injected first, and SQL then removes them, so the ability to handle dirty data is demonstrated rather than asserted.** **Second, the whole chain is drawn as a five-line diagram with an explicit input and output at each stage**: a stochastic generator simulates the claims lifecycle into a raw transactions file; a database layer performs ingestion, cleaning and triangle construction into a database file exposing an incremental triangle view; a loader reads the triangle from the database into a cumulative triangle matrix; and a dashboard holds two methods side by side, a deterministic Mack chain ladder and a stochastic bootstrap. **The triangle here is a SQL view rather than a matrix in memory, the two methods are presented as a deterministic point estimate and a stochastic result, and every stage states what it consumes and what it produces.** **Third, the simulation is parameterised and every parameter carries a reason**: claim counts follow a Poisson distribution with a stated annual growth factor and the explanation that a five percent growth rate reflects a typical expanding general insurance portfolio; ultimate severity follows a log-normal distribution with a stated inflation adjustment and the explanation that log-normal is the standard actuarial choice for severity because it captures the right-skewed distribution of insurance losses where large claims are rare but extremely costly; and reporting delays follow a Weibull distribution with a shape above one, whose consequence is explained in a sentence that the text read this round cut off at that point. **None of the three distributions is a default; each comes with one sentence saying why it was chosen, which matches the project convention of writing down where each number came from.** **Fourth, the README table of contents is countable and includes sections for what has not been done yet and for references**, rather than omitting them. **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover chain ladder implementations, the database engine, stochastic reserving methods and general insurance loss reserving, while this entry supplies the combination of using a database as the cleaning layer and placing a deterministic chain ladder beside a stochastic bootstrap in one dashboard. **This entry states plainly that the repository holds only six files, has no stars and shows no licence, so it is recorded as a small, clearly structured sample rather than a mature tool.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[chainladder]] and [[stochastic-reserving-england]]**, because **it is a complete and countable chain from dirty data to a reserve estimate, being four files, five stages, three injected defect classes and two reserving methods**, and because **its most transferable lesson is to demonstrate cleaning as a stage of the pipeline rather than assuming the data is already clean**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, R was not installed and no stage was run** — the generator was not executed, no database was built, the dashboard was not started and no reserve was estimated — **so the pipeline is not claimed to work as described and neither its triangle construction nor its reserve results are claimed correct**. **Second, no R source was read**: only the README and the file listing were read, **so nothing is claimed about the actual cleaning rules, the triangle construction algorithm, the dashboard interaction, or the parameters of the two methods; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the named database view actually exists was not verified**, since the database was not opened, and in any case that file is not in the repository and exists only after a run. **Fourth, the sentence about the reporting delay distribution that the README text cut off mid-sentence this round was not verified, and this entry does not complete it.** **Fifth, whether the two methods described as industry standard match the implementations already recorded in this wiki was not verified, nor was the correctness of the chain ladder standard error formula in this implementation. Sixth, the author identity and project background were not verified, and zero stars is not evidence of quality. Seventh, no licence status is claimed**: no licence file was seen, so the rights are recorded as unclear rather than as absent copyright, **which also means the code and the CSV should not be redistributed**. **Eighth, the creation date of 2026-05-08 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-10 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that treating data cleaning as a stage of a reserving pipeline, with a deterministic chain ladder and a stochastic bootstrap placed side by side in one dashboard, had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**

entries.title: **预注册的校准审计：十个死亡率预测族、七种不确定性机制，在疫情这道断点上**：仓库 `Hamid-Jahani/mortality-calibration-under-shift`——**`PREREGISTRATION.md` 在**第一次用真实数据拟合之前就已提交**，**并附** sha256**（**逐字** `bbbe3860a5446d063e186e56555afa893b07c36cf15a990d07567471affe50be`**）**；**⭐ 结论里有一条是**对己不利**的**（**逐字**「**The registered one-sided H2 is refuted.**」**）；**⭐ 而最实用的一条是**年金因子**那条****（**Lee–Carter 对 ä₆₅ 的名义 95% 区间在**平静期**只覆盖 **0.253****）**
entries.title_en: A pre-registered calibration audit of ten mortality forecasting families and seven uncertainty mechanisms across a pandemic break, in a repository whose preregistration file was committed with a SHA-256 hash before the first model was fitted to real data, whose findings include one that refutes its own registered hypothesis, and whose most practical warning is that a nominal ninety-five percent interval for an annuity factor covered only about a quarter of realisations even in the quiet stable period.

entries.summary_en: The repository mortality-calibration-under-shift, subtitled as a pre-registered calibration audit of ten forecasting families and seven uncertainty mechanisms across a pandemic break, **is a reliability audit rather than a new model**: it states verbatim that it is a reliability audit of probabilistic mortality forecasts across a structural break, and that the contribution is the audit and the reusable evaluation protocol rather than a new architecture. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-25**, **last pushed 2026-09-08**, **one star**, primarily TeX, **licensed MIT** with a licence file naming the author and year, and **192 paths in the extracted archive**, including twenty-three test files, seven documentation files, twenty-one scripts and a full paper directory with twelve figure PDFs and complete LaTeX sources. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream using the upstream as a yardstick, since it uses a pooled mortality modelling package as its numerical oracle and a pooled mortality database as its data.** **Four things are worth copying**: the preregistration carries a hash and states that it was committed before the first model was fitted to real data, with every later deviation recorded in four numbered addenda; one of the registered hypotheses is refuted by the results and that refutation is stated as the headline; seven methodology rules are described verbatim as binding rather than aspirational, including a rule that a random split must never be used because mortality panels leak trivially; and the fact that the data cannot be redistributed is stated together with a route to obtain it and a checksum manifest. **Nothing was run and no paper body was read this round.**
entries.body:
**mortality-calibration-under-shift**（GitHub 仓库 `Hamid-Jahani/mortality-calibration-under-shift`）**是一份关于**概率型死亡率预测**的**可靠性审计****，**README 的标题与副标题逐字为**「**Do Mortality Prediction Intervals Survive a Pandemic? A Pre-Registered Calibration Audit of Ten Forecasting Families and Seven Uncertainty Mechanisms Across the COVID-19 Break.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-25、最后推送 2026-09-08**、**★1**、**主语言 TeX**；**许可 MIT**（**`LICENSE` 逐字前两行为** `MIT License`／`Copyright (c) 2026 Hamid Jahani`**）**；**tarball 枚举 192 条路径**，**其中** `tests/` **23 个文件、**`docs/` **7 份、**`scripts/` **21 个、**`paper/` **含** 12 张图 PDF ＋ `figures-manifest.json` ＋ `main.tex` ＋ `references.bib` ＋ `sections/` 10 个 `.tex` ＋ **一个 `submission/` 提交包**（**含** `COMPLIANCE.md` **与** `supp/S1-preregistration.tex` **到** `S6-infeasible.tex`**）**；**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游当成尺子**」**——**⭐ 它把本站已收录的 [[stmomo]] 当作**数值预言机**，**并以 [[human-mortality-db]] 为数据源**。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它明说自己**不是**在提出新模型**——**逐字**：**「**A reliability audit of probabilistic mortality forecasts across a structural break. **The contribution is the audit and the reusable evaluation protocol — not a new architecture.** Model family and uncertainty mechanism are **crossed factors** (50 admissible cells, `docs/GRID.md`), so coverage failure can be attributed to the architecture or to the uncertainty machinery bolted onto it.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**「**模型族**」与「**不确定性机制**」被做成**交叉因子**（**50 个可容许格**）**——**⭐ 即**当区间覆盖失败时，**你**能分辨**是**架构的问题**还是**后来加上去的那套不确定性机制的问题**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 预注册带哈希，且写明**早于第一次拟合****——**逐字**：**「**Status: complete. All three pre-registered regimes are swept, QA-gated (zero machine-failure rows) and analysed; the paper draft is written from them. `PREREGISTRATION.md` was committed 2026-08-25 — sha256 `bbbe3860a5446d063e186e56555afa893b07c36cf15a990d07567471affe50be` — before the first model was fitted to real data, and every deviation since is recorded in the four addenda and `docs/STATUS.md`.**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **给出 sha256**——**⭐ 即**「**我事先写下了什么**」**可被第三方校验**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **明确「**早于第一次用真实数据拟合**」**——**⭐ 因为**「**先注册**」这件事只有在**时间顺序**上成立才有意义**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **所有偏离**记在四份 addenda 里****（**文件清单实测确有** `PREREGISTRATION-ADDENDUM-1.md` **到** `-4.md`**）**——**⭐ 即**违背预注册不是被隐藏，**而是**被登记**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它把一条**注册假设的否定**当成头条**——**逐字**：**「**The registered one-sided H2 is refuted. The two-sided |coverage − nominal| grows from stable to shift in only 27 of 50 cells. Coverage falls in 34 of 50, but that is degradation only for arms that began below nominal: over-covering arms move toward nominal. The break sorts families by which side of nominal they started on.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**疫情这道断点**」**并没有普遍把区间变得更差**——**它按**各模型族原本偏在哪一侧**来分类**；**⭐ 本词条认为这与本站第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**：**预注册的价值正在于**结果与预期不符时你得照写**。**⭐⭐ ④ 结论里有一条**对实务最有用****——**逐字**：**「**H5 is the practical warning. Annuity-factor intervals are far worse than rate-level ones and are already broken in quiet periods: Lee–Carter’s nominal 95% interval for ä₆₅ covers 0.253 of realisations in the stable control.**」**。**⭐ 即**名义 95% 的区间在**平静期**只覆盖约 **四分之一**——**⭐ 而**这条恰好是**年金（ä₆₅）**而非**死亡率本身**的区间**，**也就是**精算实务真正要用的那个量**。**⭐ 另两条结论逐字为**：**平静期对照下经典原生区间已只覆盖 **0.702**（Lee–Carter）、**0.682**（Poisson-LC）、**0.731**（APC/RH），**而名义为 0.95**——**⭐ 即**「**大部分失准在疫情之前就存在了**」（**逐字**「**Most miscalibration predates the pandemic.**」**）**；**以及**「**H3 holds universally — joint path coverage is below marginal in 100 of 100 (regime, cell) pairs.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 七条方法学规则被逐字称为**「**binding, not aspirational**」****——**逐字七条**：**① `PREREGISTRATION.md` **在第一次拟合之前提交并带哈希**；**② **只用扩展窗口的时间切分**，**「**Never a random split — mortality panels leak trivially.**」；**③ **超参只在**内层时间切分**上调，**绝不在测试集上调**；**④ **每个模型都要输出**预测分布**，**而不是点预测**；**⑤ **评测框架在接触真实数据之前**先用**已知 Lee–Carter 数据生成过程**的**合成真值**验证过**（**⭐ 文件清单里确有** `tests/test_synthetic_calibration.py`**）**；**⑥ **Python 的 Lee–Carter 与 R 的 StMoMo 在 α、β、k 上**达到数值一致**（**逐字给出**「**β relative difference 2.4e-14**」**）**；**⑦ **每个集成成员的**随机种子**都被记录**。**⭐ 即**这七条**每一条都可以被检查**，**而不是「**我们很小心**」。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 数据不可再分发，**并且给了自取路径与校验清单****——**逐字**：**「**The `Dataset/` tree is **not committed**. HMD’s user agreement restricts redistribution: obtain the data yourself from <https://www.mortality.org/Data/ZippedDataFiles> after free registration. `data/MANIFEST.sha256` pins the exact file vintage this work uses. Verify a local copy from the repository root: `sha256sum -c data/MANIFEST.sha256`**」**。**⭐ 即**「**我不能把数据给你**」**之后紧接**「**你可以自己取，**取到之后用这个清单核对版本**」**——**⭐ 而数据版本逐字为**「**49 populations, vintage 15 Jun 2026**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 研究过程被留下了可数的痕迹**——**文件清单一处可数**：`docs/` **下有** `GRID.md`、`SPLIT-SPEC.md`、`PIPELINE.md`、`NEURAL-SPEC.md`、`PRIOR-ART.md`、`DATA-PREREQS.md`、`STATUS.md`；`literature/` **下有** `INDEX.md`、`TRIAGE.md`、`GAP-ANALYSIS.md`、`GET-THESE.md`、`MISSING.md`；`scripts/` **下有 21 个**，**含** `oracle_parity.R`、`final_qa.py`、`verify_quotes.py`、`time_cells.py`、`sweep_cost.py`、`make_figures.py`、`make_tables.py`、`make_submission_zip.sh` **与** `server_*` **一组**；`src/mortcal/` **下** `models/`（**lc、cbd、rh、svar、neural、gp**）、**`uq/`**（**bootstrap、conformal、neural**）、`eval/scores.py`、`data/hmd.py`、`lifetable.py`、`splits.py`、`inference.py`、`runner.py`；**运行方式逐字为** `uv run pytest -q`（**Python 3.12 由 uv 固定**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这三点尤其值得抄**：**① **文献一节自带**「**还缺哪些**」**（`MISSING.md`）**与**「**要弄到这些**」**（`GET-THESE.md`**）**；**② **有一个脚本叫** `verify_quotes.py`**（**⚠️ 本次未读其内容，故不主张它核对什么**）**；**③ **投稿包与工作稿分开**（`paper/` **与** `paper/submission/`**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[human-mortality-db]] 提供数据**，**[[stmomo]]、[[mortalitylaws]]、[[mortcast]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[mortality-dynamics]]、[[mortalityforecast]]、[[affinemortality]]、[[bayesmortalityplus]] 覆盖死亡率建模方法**，**[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[verified-reserving]] 覆盖可复现与验证**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**预注册审查 ＋ 交叉因子网格 ＋ 把同名假设的否定写进结论**」这一形态**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[stmomo]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「**这些模型的区间到底可不可信**」这一问题上**一份带具体覆盖率数字的审计**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的三点**：**① 预注册要**带哈希并写明时间顺序**；**② 结果与预期不符时**照写**，**并把偏离记在**附录**里**；**③ 数据**不能再分发时**，**给出**自取路径 ＋ 版本校验清单**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**（**未跑** `uv run pytest`、**未跑任何 sweep、**未生成任何表或图、**未取 HMD 数据**），**故不主张**其任何覆盖率数字、**不主张** H1–H5 的结论、**也不主张**其校验门（**合成真值、**StMoMo 一致性、**生命表一致性**）真的通过**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读论文任何正文**——**本次只读了** `README.md` **与文件清单**，**未打开** `paper/main.tex`、**10 个** `sections/*.tex`、**投稿包** `submission/`**、**也未读** `PREREGISTRATION.md` **与四份 addenda 的正文**（**⭐ 本次只看到它们**存在**与其在 README 中被引用的方式**）**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `PREREGISTRATION.md` **的**实际提交时间**与其**sha256 是否与 README 所述一致**——**⭐ 本词条只转述 README 的说法**（**⭐ 且**未用 `git log` 核对该文件的历史**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**「**50 个可容许格**」**与**「**100 of 100**」**这两个计数的构成**（**未读** `docs/GRID.md`**）**；**未核实** `docs/STATUS.md` **里记了哪些偏离**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实数据来源与许可细节**：**未访问** mortality.org **或 HMD 的用户协议页**，**故**「**HMD 的用户协议限制再分发**」**这一说法**本次**只记录为**该项目自述**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与所属机构**；**★1 不构成质量证据**；**⚠️ 该项目**未被任何期刊接收**这一事实**本词条不主张也不推测**（**README 只说**「**the paper draft is written from them**」**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 许可为 MIT（`LICENSE` 存在，**本次读到前两行**）**，**未读正文**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**数据本身**受 HMD 协议约束**，**与代码的 MIT 许可**是两件事**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2026-08-25 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-08 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**预注册审查 ＋ 模型族与不确定性机制的交叉网格 ＋ 把注册假设的否定写进结论**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**本词条不主张该项目覆盖率的数字可用于任何具体定价或准备金判断**。

A Pre-Registered Calibration Audit of Ten Forecasting Families and Seven Uncertainty Mechanisms Across the COVID-19 Break.**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-25、最後推送 2026-09-08**、**★1**、**TeX**；**許可 MIT**（`LICENSE` 逐字前兩行為 `MIT License`／`Copyright (c) 2026 Hamid Jahani`**）**；**tarball 列舉 192 條路徑**（`tests/` 23 個、`docs/` 7 份、`scripts/` 21 個、`paper/` 含 12 張圖 PDF ＋ `main.tex` ＋ `references.bib` ＋ `sections/` 10 個 `.tex` ＋ 一個提交包**）**；**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：把上游當尺子**」**——**它把已收錄的 [[stmomo]] 當**數值預言機**，**以 [[human-mortality-db]] 為資料源**。

**可核實資訊（均 README 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它明說自己**不是**在提出新模型**——**逐字**「**The contribution is the audit and the reusable evaluation protocol — not a new architecture. Model family and uncertainty mechanism are crossed factors (50 admissible cells, `docs/GRID.md`)**」**——**⭐ 即**當區間覆蓋失敗時，**你**能分辨**是**架構的問題**還是**後來加上去的不確定性機制**的問題**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 預註冊帶雜湊，且寫明**早於第一次擬合****——**逐字**「**`PREREGISTRATION.md` was committed 2026-08-25 — sha256 `bbbe3860a5446d063e186e56555afa893b07c36cf15a990d07567471affe50be` — before the first model was fitted to real data, and every deviation since is recorded in the four addenda and `docs/STATUS.md`.**」**——**⭐ 三處值得記**：**給出 sha256**、**寫明時間順序**、**所有偏離記在四份 addenda**（**清單實測確有** `PREREGISTRATION-ADDENDUM-1.md` **到** `-4.md`**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它把一條**註冊假設的否定**當成頭條**——**逐字**「**The registered one-sided H2 is refuted. The two-sided |coverage − nominal| grows from stable to shift in only 27 of 50 cells. Coverage falls in 34 of 50, but that is degradation only for arms that began below nominal: over-covering arms move toward nominal.**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 結論裡有一條**對實務最有用****——**逐字**「**Annuity-factor intervals are far worse than rate-level ones and are already broken in quiet periods: Lee–Carter’s nominal 95% interval for ä₆₅ covers 0.253 of realisations in the stable control.**」**——**⭐ 即**名義 95% 的區間在**平靜期**只覆蓋約**四分之一**，**而這條恰好是**年金**而非死亡率本身的區間**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 七條方法學規則逐字被稱為**「**binding, not aspirational**」**（**含**「**Never a random split — mortality panels leak trivially.**」**、**「**每個模型都要輸出預測分布**」**、**「**評測框架先用合成真值驗證**」**、**「**Python Lee–Carter 與 R StMoMo 在 α、β、k 上數值一致（β relative difference 2.4e-14）**」**、**「**每個集成成員的種子都記錄**」**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 資料不可再分發，**並給出自取路徑與校驗清單****——**逐字**「**HMD’s user agreement restricts redistribution: obtain the data yourself after free registration. `data/MANIFEST.sha256` pins the exact file vintage**」**（**資料版本逐字為**「**49 populations, vintage 15 Jun 2026**」**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 過程留痕可數**：`docs/` 7 份、`literature/` **5 份（含** `MISSING.md` **與** `GET-THESE.md`**）**、`scripts/` 21 個（**含** `oracle_parity.R`、`verify_quotes.py`、`final_qa.py`**）**、`src/mortcal/` **含** models（lc／cbd／rh／svar／neural／gp**）與** uq（bootstrap／conformal／neural**）**；**執行逐字為** `uv run pytest -q`**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[stmomo]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 應當並讀**——**⭐ 三點最值得借鑑**：**① 預註冊要**帶雜湊並寫明時間順序**；② 結果與預期不符時**照寫**，**並把偏離記在附錄**；③ 資料不能再分發時，**給出自取路徑＋版本校驗清單**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行該專案任何一步**，**故不主張**其任何覆蓋率數字、**不主張** H1–H5 的結論、**也不主張**其校驗門真的通過**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀論文任何正文**——**只讀** `README.md` **與文件清單**，**未打開** `paper/main.tex`、`sections/*.tex`、投稿包、**也未讀** `PREREGISTRATION.md` **與四份 addenda 的正文**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** `PREREGISTRATION.md` **的實際提交時間與其 sha256 是否與 README 所述一致**（**未用** `git log` **核對**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**「**50 個可容許格**」**與**「**100 of 100**」**這兩個計數的構成**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實 HMD 用戶協議細節**（**未訪問** mortality.org**）**，**該說法只記為**專案自述**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份與機構**；**★1 不構成品質證據**。**⑦ ⚠️ 許可為 MIT，未讀正文**；**⭐ 資料本身受 HMD 協議約束，**與代碼許可**是兩件事**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2026-08-25 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-08 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「預註冊審查＋交叉網格＋把註冊假設的否定寫進結論」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 不主張其覆蓋率數字可用於任何具體定價或準備金判斷**。
entries.body_en:
The repository mortality-calibration-under-shift **is a reliability audit of probabilistic mortality forecasts**, titled and subtitled as asking whether mortality prediction intervals survive a pandemic and describing itself as a pre-registered calibration audit of ten forecasting families and seven uncertainty mechanisms across a pandemic break. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-25**, **last pushed 2026-09-08**, **one star**, primarily TeX, **licensed MIT** with a licence file naming the author and year, and **192 paths in the extracted archive**, including twenty-three test files, seven documentation files, twenty-one scripts, and a paper directory holding twelve figure PDFs with a figures manifest, a main LaTeX file, a bibliography, ten section files and a full submission package with a compliance note and six supplementary files. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream using the upstream as a yardstick, because it uses a pooled mortality modelling package as its numerical oracle and a pooled mortality database as its data.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, it states that it is not proposing a new model**: verbatim, it is a reliability audit of probabilistic mortality forecasts across a structural break, and the contribution is the audit and the reusable evaluation protocol rather than a new architecture; model family and uncertainty mechanism are crossed factors across fifty admissible cells, so a coverage failure can be attributed to the architecture or to the uncertainty machinery bolted onto it. **When interval coverage fails, you can therefore tell whether the architecture or the uncertainty layer added on top is responsible, which this entry considers the most copyable idea of the round.** **Second, the preregistration carries a hash and states that it predates the first fit**: verbatim, the preregistration file was committed on a stated date with a full SHA-256 hash before the first model was fitted to real data, and every deviation since is recorded in four addenda and a status file. **The hash means a third party can check what was written in advance, the phrase before the first fit makes the ordering explicit, and the fact that all deviations are logged in four numbered addenda means departing from the preregistration is registered rather than hidden.** **Third, it makes the refutation of one of its own registered hypotheses a headline**: verbatim, the registered one-sided hypothesis is refuted, the two-sided distance between coverage and nominal grows from stable to shift in only twenty-seven of fifty cells, coverage falls in thirty-four of fifty, but that counts as degradation only for arms that began below nominal, since over-covering arms move toward nominal, and the break sorts families by which side of nominal they started on. **The pandemic break did not uniformly make intervals worse; it reclassified families according to the side of nominal they started on, and the value of preregistration is exactly that an unexpected result still has to be written down.** **Fourth, one finding is the practical warning**: annuity-factor intervals are far worse than rate-level ones and are already broken in quiet periods, with a nominal ninety-five percent interval for an annuity factor covering only about a quarter of realisations in the stable control. **The interval that actuarial practice actually needs is the annuity one rather than the mortality rate one, and it is the worse of the two.** Two further findings are stated verbatim: most miscalibration predates the pandemic, with classical native intervals in the quiet stable control covering about seventy, sixty-eight and seventy-three percent against a nominal ninety-five; and joint path coverage is below marginal coverage in one hundred of one hundred regime and cell pairs. **Fifth, seven methodology rules are described verbatim as binding rather than aspirational**: the preregistration is committed and hash-stamped before the first fit; expanding-origin temporal splits only are used, never a random split, because mortality panels leak trivially; hyperparameters tune on an inner time split and never on the test set; every model emits a predictive distribution rather than a point forecast; the evaluation harness is validated against synthetic truth from a known data-generating process before it touches real data, which the file listing corroborates with a synthetic calibration test; the Python implementation matches the R oracle to numerical tolerance on all three parameters, with a reported relative difference of about two in ten to the fourteenth; and seeds are recorded per ensemble member. **Every one of those rules is checkable rather than being a claim of care.** **Sixth, the data cannot be redistributed and the repository says so while providing a route and a checksum manifest**: the dataset tree is not committed, the database user agreement restricts redistribution, readers are told to obtain the data themselves after free registration, a manifest pins the exact file vintage, and verification is a checksum command. **Refusing to hand over the data is immediately followed by how to get it yourself and how to confirm you got the same version**, with the vintage stated as forty-nine populations from a June 2026 release. **Seventh, the research process leaves countable traces**: seven documentation files including grid, split specification, pipeline, neural specification, prior art, data prerequisites and status; five literature files including an index, a triage, a gap analysis, a to-get list and a list of what is missing; twenty-one scripts including an oracle parity script in R, a final quality gate, a quote verification script, a cell timing script, a sweep cost script and figure and table builders; and a source package with data, model, uncertainty, evaluation, life table, split and inference modules covering six model families and three uncertainty mechanisms, run through a pinned Python environment. **Three of those are especially worth copying: the literature section carries its own list of what is still missing and what to obtain; there is a script whose name suggests verifying quotes; and the submission package is kept separate from the working draft.** **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries supply the mortality database and the modelling methods, and pooled entries cover reproducibility and verification, while this entry supplies pre-registered auditing, a crossed-factor grid and the practice of putting the refutation of a registered hypothesis into the conclusions.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[stmomo]] and [[human-mortality-db]]**, because **it is an audit with concrete coverage numbers for the question of whether these model intervals can be trusted at all**, and because **three practices transfer directly: preregister with a hash and state the ordering in time, write the result down even when it contradicts the expectation and log deviations in an appendix, and when data cannot be redistributed give a route to obtain it plus a version checksum**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no test suite, no sweep, no table or figure generation and no data retrieval — **so none of its coverage numbers is claimed, none of the five hypotheses is claimed to be settled, and none of its validation gates is claimed to pass**. **Second, no paper body was read**: only the README and the file listing were read, and neither the main LaTeX file, the ten section files, the submission package, nor the preregistration file and its four addenda were opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the actual commit date of the preregistration file and whether its hash matches the README statement were not verified**, since its history was not inspected; **this entry relays the README statement only**. **Fourth, the composition of the fifty admissible cells and of the one-hundred-of-one-hundred count was not verified**, nor was what deviations the status file records. **Fifth, the database user agreement was not consulted**, so the claim that redistribution is restricted is recorded as the project own statement. **Sixth, the author identity and affiliation were not verified, and one star is not evidence of quality; this entry neither claims nor speculates about whether the paper has been accepted anywhere**, the README saying only that the draft is written from the results. **Seventh, the licence is MIT and its text was not read, and this entry states plainly that the data itself is governed by a separate agreement, which is a different matter from the code licence. Eighth, the creation date of 2026-08-25 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-08 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that a pre-registered audit with a crossed grid of model families and uncertainty mechanisms, and a registered hypothesis refuted in its own conclusions, had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that none of its coverage figures should be used for any specific pricing or reserving judgement.**

entries.title: **一条热带气旋巨灾建模链，从风暴轨迹到损失、再从一百年历史轨迹到随机事件集**：仓库 `christianwirths/NatCat`——**⭐ 九段链条**逐段成模块**（**数据 → 轨迹 → 致灾因子 → 脆弱性 → 暴露 → 损失 → 随机事件集 → 财务模块 → 出图**）**；**⭐ 而其中**暴露那一段**可以调用已收录的 [[climada]]**（**逐字** `geo = ["cartopy", "climada"]`**）**；**⚠️ 自述 0.1.0**、**★1**
entries.title_en: An open tropical-cyclone catastrophe-modelling chain that runs from storm track to loss and from a century of historical tracks to a stochastic event set, with each link of the chain as its own module and the exposure link able to call an existing open catastrophe-model platform as an optional dependency.
entries.title_hk: **一條熱帶氣旋巨災建模鏈，從風暴軌跡到損失、再從一百年歷史軌跡到隨機事件集**：倉庫 `christianwirths/NatCat`——**⭐ 九段鏈條**逐段成模組**（**資料 → 軌跡 → 致災因子 → 脆弱性 → 暴露 → 損失 → 隨機事件集 → 財務模組 → 出圖**）**；**⭐ 其中**暴露那一段**可以調用已收錄的 [[climada]]**（**逐字** `geo = ["cartopy", "climada"]`**）**；**⚠️ 自述 0.1.0**、**★1**
entries.summary: **natcat-tc-modelling**（`christianwirths/NatCat`，**包名逐字** `natcat` **0.1.0**）**是一个**开放的热带气旋巨灾建模框架****——**README 逐字自述**「**An open tropical-cyclone catastrophe-modelling framework: from storm track to loss, and from a century of historical tracks to a stochastic event set with exceedance-probability curves.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2025-12-09、最后推送 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**主语言 Jupyter Notebook**；**许可 MIT**（**`LICENSE` 逐字** `MIT License`／`Copyright (c) 2026 Christian Wirths`**）**；**tarball 枚举 154 条路径**（**11 个测试文件、**3 个 notebook、**`docs/` 下** `api/` **10 页与** `methodology/` **5 页**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游当成引擎与输入**」**——**它把已收录的 [[climada]] 当作**可选的暴露生成后端****（**逐字** `geo = ["cartopy", "climada"]`**）**，**并与 [[tcrm]]、[[ibtracs]]、[[spatialrisk]]、[[openquake-engine]] 同属巨灾建模一侧**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **它把「建模链」**拆成九个可单独替换的模块****（**数据、轨迹、致灾因子、脆弱性、暴露、损失、随机事件集、财务、出图**）**——**⭐ 即**链条上的每一段都可以被别人换掉**；**② **随机事件集用**经验马尔可夫轨迹生成器**，**在一九〇〇至二〇二〇年大西洋 best track 上标定****；**③ **`docs/methodology/limitations.md` 单独立页列局限**。**⚠️ 本次未运行任何一步、**未做与其它巨灾平台的对比**。
