entries.summary_en: The repository NatCat, distributed under the package name natcat at version 0.1.0, **is an open tropical-cyclone catastrophe-modelling framework**, described verbatim as running from storm track to loss, and from a century of historical tracks to a stochastic event set with exceedance-probability curves. **Measured this round**: **created 2025-12-09**, **last pushed 2026-09-09**, **one star**, primarily Jupyter notebooks, **licensed MIT** with a licence file naming the author and year, and **154 paths in the extracted archive**, including eleven test files, three notebooks, and a documentation site with ten API pages and five methodology pages. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream using the upstream as an engine and an input, because it treats an existing open catastrophe-platform package as an optional exposure-generation backend** and sits on the catastrophe-modelling side alongside pooled entries for tropical-cyclone risk modelling, historical best-track data, an exposure data service and an open seismic engine. **Three things are worth reading**: the modelling chain **is split into nine separately replaceable modules** covering data, tracks, hazards, vulnerability, exposure, loss, the stochastic event set, financial metrics and plotting, so any single link can be swapped by someone else; the stochastic event set **uses an empirical Markov track generator calibrated on Atlantic best tracks from 1900 to 2020**; and **limitations get their own methodology page**. **Nothing was run this round, and no comparison against other catastrophe platforms was made.**
entries.body:
**NatCat**（GitHub 仓库 `christianwirths/NatCat`，**发行包名逐字** `natcat`）**是一个**开放的热带气旋巨灾建模框架****，**README 逐字自述**「**An open tropical-cyclone catastrophe-modelling framework: from storm track to loss, and from a century of historical tracks to a stochastic event set with exceedance-probability curves.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2025-12-09、最后推送 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**主语言 Jupyter Notebook**；**许可 MIT**（**`LICENSE` 逐字** `MIT License`／`Copyright (c) 2026 Christian Wirths`**）**；**tarball 枚举 154 条路径**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游当成引擎与输入**」**。

**可核实信息（均 README、`pyproject.toml` 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把整条建模链拆成**九个模块**，**并逐段说明每段干什么**——**本次实测的九段与自述**：**① `natcat.data`——**读 NHC 的 ATCF B-deck 与 A-deck**，**并可按需下载历史存档**；**② `natcat.tracks`——**轨迹处理**；**③ `natcat.hazards`——**Rankine 涡旋风场**，**且把**移动不对称性**算进去**；**④ `natcat.vulnerability`——**按建筑类型给的 S 形脆弱性曲线**；**⑤ `natcat.exposure`——**合成暴露或调用其它模型给的真实暴露****（**⭐ 见下**）**；**⑥ `natcat.loss`——**损失计算**；**⑦ `natcat.stochastic`——**经验马尔可夫轨迹生成器**，**在**一九〇〇至二〇二〇年大西洋 best track**上标定**；**⑧ `natcat.financial`——**AEP 与 OEP**，**尾部用广义帕累托分布**；**⑨ `natcat.plotting`——**出图**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**「**建模链**」**不是**一个脚本从头跑到尾，**而是**九段**，**每段**有名字、**每段**可以单独替换**——**⭐ 即**别人想换掉脆弱性曲线时，**不必动你的轨迹生成器**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把**暴露**这一段交给**已收录的平台**——**本次实测** `pyproject.toml` **中逐字有一条可选依赖**：**`geo = ["cartopy", "climada"]`**，**而 [[climada]] 已在本站收录**；**README 亦把 CLIMADA 的 **LitPop** 列为暴露的一种来源**。**⭐ 即**「**我不自己造暴露数据**」**这句话被写进了依赖声明**——**⭐ 这与本站第 337 轮「**没有任何东西站在单一来源上**」同向**：**同一条链上，**致灾因子自己算**，**暴露可以借别人的**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 随机事件集是**经验**的，**且标定窗口被写明**——**逐字为**「**empirical Markov track generator calibrated on 1900–2020 Atlantic best tracks**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为这一句有三处可抄**：**① **是「**经验**」而非**参数化**（**即从历史轨迹里学转移，**而不是假设一个风暴生成模型**）**；**② **标定数据被指明**（**大西洋 best track**）**；**③ **标定窗口被写明**（**一九〇〇至二〇二〇**）**——**⭐ 而窗口一旦写明，**读者就能自己判断**它是否够长、**是否跨了气候 regime 变化**。**⭐⭐ ④ 它把**局限**单独立页**——**文件清单实测** `docs/methodology/` **下 5 页，**其中一页逐字为** `limitations.md`**。**⭐ 本词条认为这与本站第 334 轮「**边界即清单**」、第 341 轮「**三种缺席**」同向**：**局限不是散在正文里的一句话，**而是**一个有名有姓的页面**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 依赖与工具链被写明，**且分开了「**必需**」与「**可选**」****——**本次实测** `pyproject.toml`：**包名** `natcat` **0.1.0**、**`requires-python` 逐字为** `>=3.10`；**关键词里含** `insurance`**；**必需依赖** `numpy`、`pandas`、`scipy`、`matplotlib`、`requests`、`tqdm`、`beautifulsoup4`、`scikit-learn`、`global-land-mask`；**可选依赖** `geo`（**`cartopy` ＋ `climada`**）；**开发依赖** `pytest` ＋ `ruff`；**文档依赖** `mkdocs-material`、`mkdocstrings`、`mkdocs-jupyter`。**⭐ 即**「**要跑核心链不需要装地理库**」**这件事**是被**声明**出来的**，**而不是**靠读者去试**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 过程留痕可数**：**测试文件 11 个**；**notebook 3 个**；**文档站** `docs/` **含** `api/` **10 页**（**对应九个模块加总览**）**与** `methodology/` **5 页**；**README 上挂着 CI 徽章，**而该徽章指向的分支逐字为** `dev/refactor-v1`**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**「**主分支**」与「**CI 徽章指向的分支**」**两者本次**未分别核实**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[climada]]、[[climada-petals]] 覆盖开放巨灾平台**，**[[pyincore]] 覆盖社区韧性**，**[[openquake-engine]] 覆盖地震**，**[[tcrm]] 覆盖热带气旋风险建模**，**[[hazus]] 覆盖美国损失估计**，**[[noaa-inundation-mapping]]、[[gdacs]] 覆盖灾害数据**，**[[ibtracs]] 覆盖历史轨迹**，**[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[spatialrisk]] 覆盖暴露**，**[[pyextremes]]、[[mev]]、[[extremes]] 覆盖极值统计**，**[[oasislmf]]、[[oasis-piwind]]、[[ods-open-exposure-data]] 覆盖开放损失建模平台**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**九个模块拼成一条链 ＋ 随机事件集用经验马尔可夫生成 ＋ 依赖里写明谁能替换谁**」这一形态**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[tcrm]]、[[climada]]、[[ibtracs]] 应当并读**——**它们分别给**热带气旋风险建模**、**开放平台与暴露**、**历史轨迹**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的两点**：**① 一条链**按段命名**，**段与段之间只通过数据接口相连**；**② 凡是**借来的东西**（**暴露、**地理库**）**都在依赖声明里**写明是可选**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**（**未装依赖、**未跑 pytest、**未跑任何 notebook、**未生成任何 AEP 或 OEP 曲线**），**故**不主张**其风场、**脆弱性曲线、**损失计算**或**尾部分布**的任何数值结果**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读其**方法学页面正文****——**本次只看到** `docs/methodology/` **下 5 页**与** `docs/api/` **下 10 页的存在与文件名**；**⭐ 未读** `limitations.md` **的内容**，**故**本词条**只主张**该页存在**，**不主张**它列了哪些局限**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核对 README 所述九段与源码目录是否一一对应**（**总路径 154 条为实测**，**但**模块内部的实现本次**未逐文件读**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实「**一九〇〇至二〇二〇年大西洋 best track**」**这一标定窗口的实际取数范围**（**未读** `natcat/data` **的实现**，**也未访问 NHC 存档页**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**「**按建筑类型给的 S 形脆弱性曲线**」**的参数来源****（**⭐ 即**未确认它是**从文献取值**、**从数据拟合**、还是**作者假设**）**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这一处直接决定损失一侧的可信度**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未与 [[tcrm]]、**[[climada]]、**[[openquake-engine]] 做任何代码或结果层面的比较**；**本条不主张 NatCat 优于或劣于其中任何一个**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实版本 0.1.0 是否已发布到 PyPI**（**⭐ 本次只读** `pyproject.toml` **中的版本号**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 许可为 MIT（`LICENSE` 存在并读到两行**）**，**未读正文**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**CLIMADA 与 cartopy 各自另有许可**，**把 NatCat 用于交付物前**须分别看**。**⑨ ⚠️ 创建 2025-12-09 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**把巨灾建模链逐段拆成模块 ＋ 暴露段显式接受外来引擎 ＋ 随机事件集写明经验标定窗口**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该框架 0.1.0、★1、**未经本站任何验证**，**不得**用于任何真实承保、**定价或资本计量**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、`pyproject.toml` 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把整條建模鏈拆成**九個模組**，**並逐段說明每段幹什麼**——**九段為**：`natcat.data`（**讀 NHC 的 ATCF B-deck 與 A-deck，**並可按需下載歷史存檔**）、`natcat.tracks`（**軌跡處理**）、`natcat.hazards`（**Rankine 渦旋風場，**把**移動不對稱性**算進去**）、`natcat.vulnerability`（**按建築類型給的 S 形脆弱性曲線**）、`natcat.exposure`（**合成暴露或調用其它模型給的真實暴露**）、`natcat.loss`、`natcat.stochastic`（**經驗馬爾可夫軌跡生成器，**在一九〇〇至二〇二〇年大西洋 best track 上標定**）、`natcat.financial`（**AEP 與 OEP，**尾部用廣義帕累托分布**）、`natcat.plotting`。**⭐ 本詞條認為這是本輪最值得抄的一處**：「**建模鏈**」**不是**一個腳本從頭跑到尾，**而是**九段**，**每段**有名字、**可以單獨替換**——**⭐ 即**別人想換掉脆弱性曲線時，**不必動你的軌跡生成器**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把**暴露**這一段交給**已收錄的平台**——**本次實測** `pyproject.toml` **逐字有一條可選依賴**：**`geo = ["cartopy", "climada"]`**，**而 [[climada]] 已在本站收錄**；**README 亦把 CLIMADA 的 **LitPop** 列為暴露來源之一**。**⭐ 即**「**我不自己造暴露資料**」被寫進了依賴聲明**——**⭐ 這與本站第 337 輪「**沒有任何東西站在單一來源上**」同向**：**致災因子自己算，**暴露可以借別人的**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 隨機事件集是**經驗**的，**且標定窗口被寫明**——**逐字為**「**empirical Markov track generator calibrated on 1900–2020 Atlantic best tracks**」**——**⭐ 三處可抄**：**是「**經驗**」而非**參數化**；**標定資料被指明**；**標定窗口被寫明**（**窗口一旦寫明，**讀者就能自己判斷**它夠不夠長、**是否跨了氣候 regime 變化**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 它把**局限**單獨立頁**——**文件清單實測** `docs/methodology/` **下 5 頁，**其中一頁逐字為** `limitations.md`**。**⭐ 這與本站第 334 輪「**邊界即清單**」同向**：**局限不是散在正文裡的一句話，**而是**一個有名有姓的頁面**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 依賴分開了「**必需**」與「**可選**」****——**本次實測** `pyproject.toml`：**包名** `natcat` **0.1.0**、**`requires-python` 逐字為** `>=3.10`；**關鍵詞含** `insurance`**；**必需依賴** `numpy`、`pandas`、`scipy`、`matplotlib`、`requests`、`tqdm`、`beautifulsoup4`、`scikit-learn`、`global-land-mask`；**可選** `geo`（**`cartopy` ＋ `climada`**）；**開發** `pytest` ＋ `ruff`；**文檔** `mkdocs-material`、`mkdocstrings`、`mkdocs-jupyter`。**⭐ 即**「**要跑核心鏈不需要裝地理庫**」**是被**聲明**出來的**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 過程留痕可數**：**測試檔 11 個**、**notebook 3 個**、`docs/api/` **10 頁**、`docs/methodology/` **5 頁**；**README 的 CI 徽章指向的分支逐字為** `dev/refactor-v1`**——**⭐ 如實指出**：**「**主分支**」與「**CI 徽章指向的分支**」**兩者本次**未分別核實**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[climada]]、[[climada-petals]]、[[tcrm]]、[[pyincore]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[hazus]]、[[noaa-inundation-mapping]]、[[gdacs]]、[[ibtracs]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[spatialrisk]]、[[pyextremes]]、[[mev]]、[[extremes]]、[[oasislmf]]、[[oasis-piwind]]、[[ods-open-exposure-data]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**九個模組拼成一條鏈 ＋ 隨機事件集用經驗馬爾可夫生成 ＋ 依賴裡寫明誰能替換誰**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[tcrm]]、[[climada]]、[[ibtracs]] 應當並讀**——**⭐ 兩點最值得借鑑**：**① 一條鏈**按段命名**，**段與段之間只通過資料介面相連**；**② 凡是**借來的東西**都在依賴聲明裡**寫明是可選**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行該專案任何一步**，**不主張**其風場、**脆弱性曲線、**損失計算**或**尾部分布**的任何數值結果**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀其**方法學頁面正文****——**只看到** 5 頁方法學與 10 頁 API **的存在與檔名**；**⭐ 未讀** `limitations.md` **的內容**，**只主張**該頁存在**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核對 README 所述九段與原始碼目錄是否一一對應**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實標定窗口的實際取數範圍**（**未讀** `natcat/data` **實現，**未訪問 NHC 存檔頁**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實脆弱性曲線的**參數來源****（**是**文獻取值**、**資料擬合**、**還是**作者假設**）**——**⭐ 這一處直接決定損失一側的可信度**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未與 [[tcrm]]、**[[climada]]、**[[openquake-engine]] 做任何比較**；**不主張本專案優於或劣於其中任何一個**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實 0.1.0 是否已發佈到 PyPI**。**⑧ ⚠️ 許可為 MIT，未讀正文**；**⚠️ CLIMADA 與 cartopy 各自另有許可**，**用於交付物前須分別看**。**⑨ ⚠️ 建立 2025-12-09 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「把巨災建模鏈逐段拆成模組＋暴露段顯式接受外來引擎＋隨機事件集寫明經驗標定窗口」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 0.1.0、★1、未經本站任何驗證**，**不得**用於任何真實承保、**定價或資本計量**。
entries.body_en:
NatCat, on GitHub as christianwirths/NatCat and distributed under the package name natcat, **is an open tropical-cyclone catastrophe-modelling framework**, described verbatim as running from storm track to loss, and from a century of historical tracks to a stochastic event set with exceedance-probability curves. **Measured this round**: **created 2025-12-09**, **last pushed 2026-09-09**, **one star**, primarily Jupyter notebooks, **licensed MIT** with a licence file naming the author and year, and **154 paths in the extracted archive**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream using the upstream as an engine and an input.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the packaging metadata and the file listing**: **first, the whole modelling chain is split into nine modules with a stated role for each** — a data module that reads the National Hurricane Center ATCF B-deck and A-deck formats and can download historical archives on demand; a track module; a hazard module implementing a Rankine vortex wind field with motion asymmetry included; a vulnerability module giving sigmoid curves by construction type; an exposure module that is either synthetic or borrowed from another model; a loss module; a stochastic module holding an empirical Markov track generator calibrated on Atlantic best tracks from 1900 to 2020; a financial module computing average and occurrence exceedance probabilities with a generalised-Pareto tail; and a plotting module. **This entry considers that the most copyable idea of the round: the chain is not one script that runs from top to bottom, but nine named segments, each replaceable on its own, so somebody who wants a different vulnerability curve does not have to touch the track generator.** **Second, the exposure link is handed to an already pooled platform**: the packaging metadata declares an optional dependency group named geo holding cartopy and the pooled open catastrophe-platform package, and the README lists that platform LitPop product as one exposure source. **The sentence that says the project does not build its own exposure data is written into the dependency declaration**, which points the same way as a standing project principle that nothing should stand on a single source: on one and the same chain the hazard is computed here while the exposure may be borrowed. **Third, the stochastic event set is empirical and its calibration window is written down**: verbatim, an empirical Markov track generator calibrated on Atlantic best tracks from 1900 to 2020. **Three details are worth copying: it is empirical rather than parametric, meaning transitions are learned from historical tracks rather than assumed from a storm-generation model; the calibration data is named; and the calibration window is stated, which lets a reader judge whether the window is long enough and whether it spans a change of climate regime.** **Fourth, limitations get a dedicated page**: the methodology documentation directory holds five pages, one of which is a limitations page. **A limitation is therefore not a sentence buried in the body text but a page with a name**, which points the same way as standing project principles that boundaries should be lists and that absences should be named. **Fifth, dependencies are stated and split between required and optional**: the package is at version 0.1.0, requires Python at or above the stated floor, carries insurance among its keywords, requires numpy, pandas, scipy, matplotlib, requests, tqdm, beautifulsoup4, scikit-learn and a global land mask, offers cartopy and the pooled catastrophe platform as an optional geo group, and adds pytest and ruff for development plus a material documentation theme, a docstring extractor and a notebook plugin for docs. **That the core chain can be run without installing geographic libraries is therefore declared rather than left for the reader to discover.** **Sixth, the process leaves countable traces**: eleven test files, three notebooks, ten API documentation pages and five methodology pages, with a CI badge whose target branch is named as a development refactor branch; **this entry states plainly that the default branch and the branch the badge points at were not separately verified**. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover open catastrophe platforms and their extensions, community resilience, seismic risk, tropical-cyclone risk modelling, United States loss estimation, disaster data feeds, historical tracks, global exposure models, extreme-value statistics and open loss-modelling platforms, **and this entry supplies a nine-module chain whose stochastic event set is empirically generated and whose dependencies state which link can be replaced by what**.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled tropical-cyclone risk modeller, the pooled open catastrophe platform and the pooled historical track dataset**, which respectively supply cyclone risk modelling, an open platform with exposure generation, and historical tracks; **two practices transfer directly: name the links in a chain so that segments connect only through data interfaces, and declare anything borrowed — exposure, geographic libraries — as an optional dependency**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no dependency installation, no test suite, no notebook and no exceedance-probability curve — **so no numerical result for its wind field, vulnerability curves, loss calculation or tail distribution is claimed**. **Second, no methodology page body was read**: only the existence and filenames of the five methodology pages and the ten API pages were observed, and **the limitations page content was not read, so this entry claims only that the page exists and not what limitations it lists**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the README nine-module description was not checked against the source tree one by one**, the total of 154 paths being what was measured. **Fourth, the actual data range behind the stated calibration window was not verified**, since the data module implementation was not read and no archive page was visited. **Fifth, the provenance of the vulnerability curve parameters was not verified** — whether they come from literature, from a fit, or from the author assumptions — **and this entry states plainly that this point directly determines how far the loss side can be trusted**. **Sixth, no code-level or result-level comparison against other pooled catastrophe tools was made, and this entry claims neither superiority nor inferiority to any of them.** **Seventh, whether version 0.1.0 has been published to a package index was not verified**, only the version number in the packaging metadata being read. **Eighth, the licence is MIT and its text was not read, and this entry notes that the optional geographic and catastrophe-platform dependencies carry their own licences, which must be checked separately before any deliverable use. Ninth, the creation date of 2025-12-09 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-09 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that a catastrophe modelling chain split segment by segment, with the exposure link explicitly accepting a foreign engine and a stochastic event set carrying a stated empirical calibration window, had no counterpart in the pool. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that a version 0.1.0 project with one star and no independent verification by this site must not be used for any real underwriting, pricing or capital calculation.**
entries.verified_note: 实测核实：GitHub 仓库 christianwirths/NatCat（README 逐字自述 An open tropical-cyclone catastrophe-modelling framework: from storm track to loss, and from a century of historical tracks to a stochastic event set with exceedance-probability curves.），创建 2025-12-09、最后推送 2026-09-09、★1、主语言 Jupyter Notebook、LICENSE 逐字为 MIT License／Copyright (c) 2026 Christian Wirths、tarball 154 条路径；九段链条逐字为 natcat.data（NHC ATCF B-deck/A-deck 与按需下载历史存档）、natcat.tracks、natcat.hazards（Rankine 涡旋风场含移动不对称性）、natcat.vulnerability（按建筑类型的 S 形曲线）、natcat.exposure（合成或调用其它模型）、natcat.loss、natcat.stochastic（empirical Markov track generator calibrated on 1900–2020 Atlantic best tracks）、natcat.financial（AEP/OEP，广义帕累托尾部）、natcat.plotting；pyproject.toml 实测 name=natcat、version=0.1.0、requires-python 逐字 >=3.10、keywords 含 insurance、必需依赖 numpy/pandas/scipy/matplotlib/requests/tqdm/beautifulsoup4/scikit-learn/global-land-mask、可选 geo = ["cartopy", "climada"]（CLIMADA 已在池内收录）、dev 依赖 pytest+ruff、docs 依赖 mkdocs-material/mkdocstrings/mkdocs-jupyter；11 个测试文件、3 个 notebook、docs/api/ 10 页、docs/methodology/ 5 页（含 limitations.md）、README CI 徽章指向分支 dev/refactor-v1、README 把 CLIMADA LitPop 列为暴露来源之一｜⚠️未运行任何一步（未装依赖、未跑 pytest、未跑 notebook、未生成任何 AEP/OEP 曲线），不主张其风场、脆弱性曲线、损失计算或尾部分布的任何数值结果｜⚠️未读方法学页面正文（只看到 5 页方法学与 10 页 API 的存在与文件名；未读 limitations.md 内容，只主张该页存在）——本条目最需后续核实的一处｜⚠️未核对 README 所述九段与源码目录一一对应（154 条路径为实测）｜⚠️未核实 1900–2020 Atlantic best tracks 标定窗口的实际取数范围（未读 natcat/data 实现，未访问 NHC 存档页）｜⚠️未核实脆弱性曲线参数来源（文献取值／数据拟合／作者假设），该处直接决定损失一侧可信度｜⚠️未与 tcrm、climada、openquake-engine 做任何代码或结果比较，不主张优劣｜⚠️未核实 0.1.0 是否已发布到 PyPI｜⚠️许可 MIT 未读正文；CLIMADA 与 cartopy 各自另有许可｜⚠️创建 2025-12-09 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之内，缺口为「巨灾建模链逐段拆模块＋暴露段显式接受外来引擎＋随机事件集写明经验标定窗口」池内无对应物｜⚠️本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见；0.1.0、★1、未经本站任何验证，不得用于任何真实承保、定价或资本计量

entries.summary: **alpaca-oasis-runner**（`OasisLMF/Alpaca`）**是一个**命令行工具**，**逐字自述用途为**「**a command line tool for running Oasis models on throwaway EC2 instances**」**，**目标逐字为**「**so nothing is left behind to pay for**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-01-14、最后推送 2026-09-09**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**；**许可 BSD 3-Clause**（**`LICENSE` 逐字** `Copyright (c) 2022 Oasis Loss Modelling Framework`**）**；**tarball 枚举 97 条路径**（**31 条测试条目、**`example_configs/` 5 份 JSON、**CI 跑 Python 3.12**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游当成引擎、并且要真的跑起来**」**——**它的上游是本站已收录的 [[oasislmf]]，**而它自己**只管起机器、**发起运行、**收结果、**销毁机器**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **四种运行类型**（**逐字** `model`／`pytest`／`api`／`benchmark`**）**，**其中** `benchmark` **会把**同一个模型**放到**多个 Oasis 版本或分支**上跑并**比较耗时与输出**；**② **README 把一种**看起来像卡住**的失败形态写了出来****（**逐字**「**the failure looks like Alpaca waiting out its retries**」**）**；**③ **`alpaca create-config` 可按运行类型**交互式生成配置**。**⚠️ 需要真实 AWS 账号、**本次未运行**。

entries.summary_en: The repository Alpaca **is a command line tool for running Oasis catastrophe models on throwaway cloud instances**, described verbatim as being for running Oasis models on throwaway EC2 instances so that nothing is left behind to pay for. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-01-14**, **last pushed 2026-09-09**, **zero stars**, primarily Python, **licensed BSD 3-Clause** with a licence file naming the Oasis Loss Modelling Framework as copyright holder, and **97 paths in the extracted archive**, including thirty-one test entries, five example configuration files, and continuous integration running on Python 3.12. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream treating the upstream as an engine that must actually be run**, since its upstream is the pooled Oasis loss-modelling framework while this tool only provisions a machine, launches a run, collects results and destroys the machine. **Three things are worth reading**: **four run types** are offered for a model, a test suite, an API deployment and a benchmark; **the benchmark type runs the same model across several Oasis versions or branches and compares timings and outputs**; the README **documents a failure mode that looks like the tool hanging**; and an interactive configuration command generates configuration by run type. **A real cloud account is required and nothing was run this round.**
entries.body:
**Alpaca**（GitHub 仓库 `OasisLMF/Alpaca`）**是一个**命令行工具**，**README 逐字自述**「**A command line tool for running Oasis models on throwaway EC2 instances**」**，**并逐字给出目标**「**so nothing is left behind to pay for**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-01-14、最后推送 2026-09-09**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**；**许可 BSD 3-Clause**（**`LICENSE` 逐字** `Copyright (c) 2022 Oasis Loss Modelling Framework`**）**；**tarball 枚举 97 条路径**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游当成引擎、并且要真的跑起来**」**——**它的上游是本站已收录的 [[oasislmf]]**，**⭐ 而它自己**不做损失计算**：**它只管**起机器、**发起运行、**把结果收回来、**再把机器销毁**。

**可核实信息（均 README、配置示例与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 四种运行类型，**并且每种干什么被写清****——**逐字为**：**① `model`**——**在云主机上跑** `oasislmf model run`**；**② `pytest`**——**跑测试**；**③ `api`**——**部署 Oasis 平台并**走 API 运行**；**④ `benchmark`**——**逐字**「**runs the same model across several OasisLMF versions/branches, comparing timings and outputs**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为本轮最值得抄的就是**第四种****：**「**同一个模型、**换上游版本、**再比一遍**」**——**⭐ 即**它把「**换了上游的哪个版本会怎样**」这件事**变成了一条命令**，**而不是**一句口头提醒**；**⭐ 这与本站第 342 轮「**逐部分声明**」、第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」同向**：**你能说清**你跑的是**哪一份上游**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把一种**看起来像卡住**的失败形态写进了 README**——**逐字**：**「**`AMI_ID` must ship SSM Agent + `ec2-instance-connect` (a stripped-down custom image may not, and **the failure looks like Alpaca waiting out its retries**)」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得记的一处**：**「**看起来像在等**」**其实是**镜像缺少两个组件**——**⭐ 而这种「**症状与原因相距很远**」的失败**，**如果作者不写出来，**使用者只会以为工具坏了**。**⭐ README 同时逐字给出默认等待量**：**`SSH_MAX_RETRIES` × 3 秒（**默认 60 次、**约 3 分钟**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 连接方式改走 SSM，**且这个改动被写明****——**README 逐字说明**重连**now via SSM（**不再用** `.pem`**）**，**并要求** `IAM_INSTANCE_PROFILE` **带上** `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore`**，**同时逐字指出** `SECURITY_GROUP_ID` **不再需要开放入站 22 端口**。**⭐ 即**「**要给我什么权限**」**与**「**你不再需要开哪个端口**」**两件事都被说了**——**⭐ 这与本站第 334 轮「**边界即清单**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ④ 配置可以**交互式生成****——**README 逐字给出** `alpaca create-config`**（**按运行类型生成配置**）**；**文件清单实测** `example_configs/` **5 份 JSON**（**api、**benchmark 三份、**model 三份中**含 `piwind`**）**——**⭐ 而 [[oasis-piwind]] 已在本站收录**：**⭐ 即**示例配置用的正是那个**公开的示范模型**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程形态可数**：**包内** `alpaca/{api,benchmark,cli}/`**；**`pytest.ini`、**`ruff.toml`**；**`setup.py` 标明 Python 3.8 起**；**两个 workflow 逐字为** `.github/workflows/code-quality.yml` **与** `.github/workflows/unittest.yml`**，**而 CI 跑的是 Python 3.12**；**测试条目 31 条**。**⭐ 本词条如实指出一处**：**「**`setup.py` 的 Python 下限**」与「**CI 实际使用的 Python 版本**」**两者本次**未做交叉核实**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 基准运行的落盘位置被写明**——**README 说明 `benchmark` 在本地**读写 S3**；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**本次**未读 `alpaca/benchmark/` **的实现**，**故**只主张 README 的这一说法**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[oasislmf]] 覆盖开放损失建模平台**，**[[oasis-piwind]] 覆盖公开示范模型**，**[[ods-open-exposure-data]] 覆盖开放暴露数据**，**[[oasis-risk-explorer]]、[[oasis-opendatatransform]] 覆盖平台周边**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**把平台放到一次性云主机上跑、**并把**跨版本基准**做成一种运行类型**」这一形态**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[oasislmf]]、[[oasis-piwind]] 应当并读**——**前者给平台，**中者给可跑的公开模型，**本条给**怎么用一次性的机器把它跑起来**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的两点**：**① 把「**换上游版本再比一遍**」**做成一条命令**；**② 把「**看起来像卡住、**其实是缺组件**」这类失败形态**写进文档**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**，**也未连接任何云账号**（**未起实例、**未跑 model／pytest／api／benchmark、**未生成任何计时或输出对比**），**故**不主张**它能跑通**，**也不主张**其基准结果。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何源码正文**——**本次只读** `README.md`、**配置示例的文件名与清单**、**以及 tarball 路径列表**；**未打开** `alpaca/` **下任何 `.py`**，**未读** `example_configs/` **内 5 份 JSON 的正文**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实 README 所述四种运行类型是否与源码一一对应**；**未核实** `SSH_MAX_RETRIES` **的默认值在代码里确为 60**（**⭐ 本词条只转述 README 的「**默认约 3 分钟**」这一说法**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实 `AMI_ID`／`IAM_INSTANCE_PROFILE`／`SECURITY_GROUP_ID` **这些环境变量的**完整必填清单****（**⭐ 只记 README 点名的几个**）**；**也未核实** SSM **是否需要额外安装本地插件**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实「**benchmark 在本地读写 S3**」**的具体含义****（**是**下载到本地再比**，**还是**通过本地凭据直接读写远端**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实 `LICENSE` 中**第三条款**的正文**（**只读到版权行**）**，**也未核实 `setup.py` 中是否另有许可声明**。**⑦ ⚠️ 该工具会**创建并销毁云资源、**并产生费用****——**⭐ 本词条如实提示**：**本条目**不是使用邀请**，**使用前**须自读其 README 的权限与清理说明**。**⑧ ⚠️ ★0、**无独立验证**；**本条目**不主张其可靠性、**不主张其已被任何机构用于生产**。**⑨ ⚠️ 创建 2026-01-14 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**把开放损失建模平台放到一次性基础设施上跑 ＋ 把跨版本基准做成一种运行类型 ＋ 把看起来像卡住的失败形态写进文档**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。
entries.body_hk:
**Alpaca**（GitHub 倉庫 `OasisLMF/Alpaca`）**是一個**命令列工具**，**README 逐字自述**「**A command line tool for running Oasis models on throwaway EC2 instances**」**，**並逐字給出目標**「**so nothing is left behind to pay for**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-01-14、最後推送 2026-09-09**、**★0**、**Python**；**許可 BSD 3-Clause**（`LICENSE` 逐字 `Copyright (c) 2022 Oasis Loss Modelling Framework`**）**；**tarball 列舉 97 條路徑**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：把上游當成引擎、並且要真的跑起來**」**——**上游是本站已收錄的 [[oasislmf]]**，**⭐ 而它自己**不做損失計算**：**只管**起機器、**發起運行、**收結果、**銷毀機器**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、配置示例與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 四種運行類型，**且每種幹什麼被寫清****——**逐字為** `model`（**在雲主機上跑** `oasislmf model run`**）、`pytest`、`api`（**部署 Oasis 平台並走 API 運行**）、`benchmark`（**逐字**「**runs the same model across several OasisLMF versions/branches, comparing timings and outputs**」**）**。**⭐ 本詞條認為本輪最值得抄的就是**第四種****：**「**同一個模型、**換上游版本、**再比一遍**」**——**⭐ 即**把「**換了上游哪個版本會怎樣**」**變成了一條命令**；**⭐ 這與本站第 342 輪「**逐部分聲明**」同向**：**你能說清**你跑的是**哪一份上游**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把一種**看起來像卡住**的失敗形態寫進了 README**——**逐字**：**「**`AMI_ID` must ship SSM Agent + `ec2-instance-connect` (a stripped-down custom image may not, and the failure looks like Alpaca waiting out its retries)」**。**⭐ 本詞條認為這是本輪最值得記的一處**：**「**看起來像在等**」**其實是**鏡像缺少兩個組件**——**⭐ 這種「**症狀與原因相距很遠**」的失敗**，**作者不寫出來，**使用者只會以為工具壞了**。**⭐ README 同時逐字給出預設等待量**：**`SSH_MAX_RETRIES` × 3 秒（**預設 60 次、**約 3 分鐘**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 連接方式改走 SSM，**且這個改動被寫明****——**逐字**重連**now via SSM（**不再用** `.pem`**）**，**要求** `IAM_INSTANCE_PROFILE` **帶上** `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore`**，**並逐字指出** `SECURITY_GROUP_ID` **不再需要開放入站 22 埠**。**⭐ 即**「**要給我什麼權限**」**與**「**你不再需要開哪個埠**」**都被說了**。**⭐⭐ ④ 配置可**互動式生成****——**逐字** `alpaca create-config`**；**`example_configs/` 實測 5 份 JSON**（**api、**benchmark 三份、**model 三份中**含 `piwind`**）**——**⭐ 而 [[oasis-piwind]] 已在本站收錄**：**示例配置用的正是那個**公開示範模型**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程形態可數**：**包內** `alpaca/{api,benchmark,cli}/`**、**`pytest.ini`、**`ruff.toml`**；**`setup.py` 標明 Python 3.8 起**；**兩個 workflow 逐字為** `.github/workflows/code-quality.yml` **與** `.github/workflows/unittest.yml`**，**CI 跑 Python 3.12**；**測試條目 31 條**。**⭐ 如實指出一處**：**`setup.py` 的 Python 下限**與** CI 實際版本**本次**未交叉核實**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 基準運行的落盤位置被寫明**——**README 說明 `benchmark` 在本地**讀寫 S3**；**⭐ 本次**未讀 `alpaca/benchmark/` 實現**，**只主張 README 這一說法**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[oasislmf]]、[[oasis-piwind]]、[[ods-open-exposure-data]]、[[oasis-risk-explorer]]、[[oasis-opendatatransform]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**把平台放到一次性雲主機上跑、**並把**跨版本基準**做成運行類型**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[oasislmf]]、[[oasis-piwind]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 兩點最值得借鑑**：**① 把「**換上游版本再比一遍**」**做成命令**；**② 把「**看起來像卡住、**其實是缺組件**」這類失敗形態**寫進文檔**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行該專案任何一步**，**也未連接任何雲帳號**（**未起實例、**未跑 model／pytest／api／benchmark**），**故**不主張**它能跑通**，**也不主張**其基準結果**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何原始碼正文**——**只讀** `README.md`、**配置示例的檔名與清單**、**tarball 路徑列表**；**未打開** `alpaca/` **下任何 `.py`**，**未讀** `example_configs/` **內 5 份 JSON 正文**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實四種運行類型是否與原始碼一一對應**；**未核實** `SSH_MAX_RETRIES` **在代碼裡確為 60**（**只轉述 README 的「**預設約 3 分鐘**」**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實環境變數的**完整必填清單**；**未核實** SSM **是否需要額外安裝本地外掛**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實「**benchmark 在本地讀寫 S3**」**的具體含義**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實** `LICENSE` **第三條款正文**（**只讀到版權行**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 該工具會**建立並銷毀雲資源、**並產生費用****——**本條目**不是使用邀請**，**使用前**須自讀其 README 的權限與清理說明**。**⑧ ⚠️ ★0、**無獨立驗證**；**不主張其可靠性、**不主張其已被任何機構用於生產**。**⑨ ⚠️ 建立 2026-01-14 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「把開放損失建模平台放到一次性基礎設施上跑＋把跨版本基準做成運行類型＋把看起來像卡住的失敗形態寫進文檔」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。
entries.body_en:
Alpaca, on GitHub under the Oasis loss-modelling organisation, **is a command line tool for running Oasis models on throwaway cloud instances**, described verbatim as being for running Oasis models on throwaway EC2 instances with the stated goal that nothing is left behind to pay for. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-01-14**, **last pushed 2026-09-09**, **zero stars**, primarily Python, **licensed BSD 3-Clause** with a licence file naming the Oasis Loss Modelling Framework as copyright holder, and **97 paths in the extracted archive**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream treating the upstream as an engine that must actually be run**: its upstream is the pooled Oasis loss-modelling framework, and this tool performs no loss calculation itself, only provisioning a machine, launching a run, collecting results and destroying the machine.

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the example configuration listing and the file listing**: **first, four run types are offered with a stated role for each** — a model type that runs the Oasis model command on the cloud machine, a test type, an API type that deploys the Oasis platform and runs through its API, and a benchmark type described verbatim as running the same model across several Oasis versions or branches while comparing timings and outputs. **This entry considers the fourth the most copyable item of the round: running the same model against a different upstream version and comparing again is turned into a single command rather than a verbal reminder**, which points the same way as standing project principles that a contribution should be declared part by part and that a source should be distinguishable from what it generated, since you can state exactly which upstream revision you ran. **Second, a failure mode that looks like hanging is written into the README**: verbatim, the instance image must ship the SSM agent and the instance-connect package, a stripped-down custom image may not, and **the failure looks like Alpaca waiting out its retries**. **That is the detail this entry most wants to remember: what looks like waiting is actually two missing components in the image, and if the author had not written it down, a user would only conclude that the tool is broken.** The README also states the default wait verbatim as a retry count times three seconds, sixty attempts and roughly three minutes by default. **Third, the connection method moved to SSM and the change is documented**: the README states verbatim that reconnection is now through SSM rather than a key file, requires the instance profile to carry a named managed policy, and states verbatim that the security group no longer needs inbound port twenty-two. **Both what permissions must be granted and which port is no longer needed are therefore written down**, matching the standing principle that a boundary should be a list. **Fourth, configuration can be generated interactively**: the README gives an interactive create-config command that generates configuration by run type, and the file listing shows five example configuration files across the API, benchmark and model types, including the publicly available demonstration model that is itself already pooled. **The examples therefore use exactly that public demonstration model.** **Fifth, the engineering shape is countable**: the package holds separate API, benchmark and command-line subpackages; there is a pytest configuration and a linter configuration; the packaging script states a Python floor of 3.8; two continuous-integration workflows cover code quality and unit tests and run on Python 3.12; and there are thirty-one test entries. **This entry states plainly that the Python floor in the packaging script and the version actually used in continuous integration were not cross-checked.** **Sixth, where benchmark artefacts land is stated**: the README says the benchmark type reads and writes S3 locally; **no benchmark implementation was read, so this entry relays the README statement only**. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the open loss-modelling platform, its public demonstration model, open exposure data and platform companions, **while this entry supplies running the platform on disposable infrastructure and turning cross-version benchmarking into a run type**.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled Oasis platform and its public demonstration model**, which supply the platform and a runnable public model while this one supplies how to run it on disposable machines; **two practices transfer directly: turn running the same model against a different upstream version into a single command, and write failure modes that look like hanging but are actually missing components into the documentation**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run and no cloud account was touched** — no instance launched, no run type exercised, no timing or output comparison produced — **so this entry does not claim that it works, nor does it claim any benchmark result**. **Second, no source code was read**: only the README, the names and listing of the example configuration files and the archive path list were read, and no Python file under the package directory and no example configuration body was opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the four stated run types map one-to-one onto the source was not verified, and the stated default retry count was not confirmed in code, this entry relaying only the README statement of roughly three minutes.** **Fourth, the complete set of required environment variables was not verified**, only the few the README names, nor was it verified whether the SSM route needs an additional local plugin. **Fifth, the precise meaning of reading and writing S3 locally in the benchmark type was not verified.** **Sixth, the third clause of the licence was not read**, only the copyright line, nor was it checked whether the packaging script carries a separate licence declaration. **Seventh, this tool creates and destroys cloud resources and incurs cost, so this entry is not an invitation to use it: read its README on permissions and cleanup first.** **Eighth, it has zero stars and no independent verification, and this entry claims neither reliability nor production use by any institution. Ninth, the creation date of 2026-01-14 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-09 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that running an open loss-modelling platform on disposable infrastructure, turning cross-version benchmarking into a run type, and documenting a failure that looks like hanging had no counterpart in the pool. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**

entries.title: **一个养老金负债的敏感性练习：**五个情景、**每次只动一个假设****：仓库 `EmGM112002/analisis-estres-pasivos-laborales`——**⭐ 用已收录的 [[lifecontingencies]] 在 R 里算**；**⭐ 五情景逐字为**基准、**利率 −100bp、**利率 +100bp、**工资通胀 +100bp、**长寿 −1 年**，**且自述目的是「**aislar el efecto individual de cada factor de riesgo**」**；**⚠️ 仓库只有 4 条路径、**无 `LICENSE`**、**数据是公开 HR 数据集当占位**
entries.title_en: A Spanish-language pension-obligation sensitivity exercise with five scenarios that move one assumption at a time, computed in R with an already pooled life-contingencies package, in a repository of only four paths with no licence file and with a public human-resources dataset standing in for plan data.
entries.title_hk: **一個養老金負債的敏感性練習：**五個情景、**每次只動一個假設****：倉庫 `EmGM112002/analisis-estres-pasivos-laborales`——**⭐ 用已收錄的 [[lifecontingencies]] 在 R 裡算**；**⭐ 五情景逐字為**基準、**利率 −100bp、**利率 +100bp、**工資通脹 +100bp、**長壽 −1 年**，**且自述目的是「**aislar el efecto individual de cada factor de riesgo**」**；**⚠️ 倉庫只有 4 條路徑、**無 `LICENSE`**、**資料是公開 HR 資料集當佔位**
entries.summary: **analisis-estres-pasivos-laborales**（`EmGM112002/analisis-estres-pasivos-laborales`，**西班牙语**）**是一份**养老金负债的敏感性／压力练习****——**逐字自述方法为**「**aplicando un análisis de sensibilidad y estrés modificando una variable a la vez para aislar el efecto individual de cada factor de riesgo**」**，**⭐ 即**每次只改一个变量**，**为的是**把每个风险因子的单独影响隔出来**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-25、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**主语言 Jupyter Notebook**；**⚠️⚠️ 全仓库只有 4 条路径**（**逐字为** `Proyecto 8.ipynb`、`Proyecto_8.pdf`、`README.md`、`data.csv`**）**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游当成引擎、并且要真的跑起来**」**——**它用已收录的 [[lifecontingencies]] 在 R 里计算**，**生物特征表用** `soa08Act`**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **五个情景每次只动一个假设**（**基准；**利率 −100bp；**利率 +100bp；**工资通胀 +100bp；**长寿 −1 年**）**；**② **假设被逐条写明数值**（**贴现 5.0%、**工资增长 3.0%、**退休 65 岁、**每年服务给付因子 2.0%**）**；**③ **免责声明写明模型仅供学术／作品集、**数据只是演示用**——**⭐ 本词条认为这三点合起来**比该练习的数值结论更值得抄**。**⚠️ 未运行。
entries.summary_hk: **analisis-estres-pasivos-laborales**（`EmGM112002/analisis-estres-pasivos-laborales`，**西班牙語**）**是一份**養老金負債的敏感性／壓力練習****——**逐字自述方法為**「**aplicando un análisis de sensibilidad y estrés modificando una variable a la vez para aislar el efecto individual de cada factor de riesgo**」**，**⭐ 即**每次只改一個變數**，**把每個風險因子的單獨影響隔出來**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-25、最後推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**Jupyter Notebook**；**⚠️⚠️ 全倉庫只有 4 條路徑**（`Proyecto 8.ipynb`、`Proyecto_8.pdf`、`README.md`、`data.csv`**）**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：把上游當成引擎、並且要真的跑起來**」**——**它用已收錄的 [[lifecontingencies]] 在 R 裡計算**，**生物特徵表用** `soa08Act`**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **五個情景每次只動一個假設**（**基準；**利率 −100bp；**利率 +100bp；**工資通脹 +100bp；**長壽 −1 年**）**；**② **假設被逐條寫明數值**（**貼現 5.0%、**工資增長 3.0%、**退休 65 歲、**每年服務給付因子 2.0%**）**；**③ **免責聲明寫明模型僅供學術／作品集、**資料只是演示用**。**⚠️ 未運行。
entries.summary_en: The repository analisis-estres-pasivos-laborales **is a Spanish-language sensitivity and stress exercise on pension obligations**, described verbatim as applying a sensitivity and stress analysis that changes one variable at a time in order to isolate the individual effect of each risk factor. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-25**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **zero stars**, primarily a Jupyter notebook, and **only four paths in the whole repository** — a notebook, an exported PDF, a readme and a comma-separated data file — with **no licence file at all**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream treating the upstream as an engine that must actually be run**, since it computes in R with an already pooled life-contingencies package and uses a standard actuarial mortality table as its biometric basis. **Three things are worth reading**: **five scenarios each move exactly one assumption** from a base case; **the assumptions are written out with their numbers**; and **the disclaimer states that the model is academic and portfolio-only and that the data is demonstrative** — **this entry considers those three facts together more worth copying than the exercise numerical conclusions**. **Nothing was run.**
entries.body:
**analisis-estres-pasivos-laborales**（GitHub 仓库 `EmGM112002/analisis-estres-pasivos-laborales`，**全文西班牙语**）**是一份**养老金（DB）负债的敏感性／压力练习****。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-25、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**主语言 Jupyter Notebook**；**⚠️⚠️ 全仓库只有 4 条路径**（**逐字为** `Proyecto 8.ipynb`、`Proyecto_8.pdf`、`README.md`、`data.csv`**）**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 本词条按惯例记为**权利不明**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游当成引擎、并且要真的跑起来**」**——**它用本站已收录的 [[lifecontingencies]] 在 R 里计算**，**生物特征表逐字为** `soa08Act`**。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 方法本身是一句话，**且这句话说明了「**为什么**」****——**逐字**：**「**aplicando un análisis de sensibilidad y estrés modificando una variable a la vez para aislar el efecto individual de cada factor de riesgo**」**（**本次中译**：**应用敏感性与压力分析，**每次只修改一个变量，**以隔离每个风险因子的单独影响**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**「**每次只动一个**」**不是为了省事，**而是**为了让**归因**成立**——**⭐ 这与本站第 330 轮「**假设**」、第 343 轮「**四个维度**」同向**：**若两个假设同时变，**你就分不清是哪一变造成的**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把**假设的数值逐条写出来****——**本次实测到的**：**贴现率 5.0%**；**工资增长率 3.0%**；**退休年龄 65 岁**；**给付因子为**每年预计服务年限的 2.0%**；**生物特征表** `soa08Act`**。**⭐ 本词条认为这五点合起来构成一个**最小可复述的精算练习说明****：**⭐ 即**别人拿到这五行**，**即使没有那个 notebook，**也大致知道你在算什么**——**⭐ 这与本站第 340 轮「**把每个数从哪来写在旁边**」同向**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 五个情景，**每个只动一处****——**逐字列出为**：**① **基准情景**；**② **利率下降 100 个基点**；**③ **利率上升 100 个基点**；**④ **工资通胀上升 100 个基点**；**⑤ **长寿情景（**寿命延长 1 年**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组情景的设计有一处值得抄**：**② 与 ③ **成对出现****（**同一因子**向下与向上各一次**）**——**⭐ 即**它不只报「**如果利率跌了会怎样**」，**而是**把**对称的一侧**也算了**，**这样读者能看出**响应是否近似线性**。**⭐⭐ ④ 免责声明把「**这不是真方案**」写得很直白**——**逐字自述该模型**仅具学术与作品集用途**，**所用数据**是演示性质的**、**不代表任何真实养老金计划**（**逐字含**「**datos de carácter demostrativo**」**这一表述**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这与本站第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」、第 341 轮「**三种缺席**」同向**：**作品集项目最容易犯的错**是**让读者以为数据是真的**——**⭐ 而它**把这一句写在前面**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 数据来源是可核的公开数据集**——**README 逐字指明** `data.csv` **取自 IBM HR Analytics Employee Attrition & Performance**（**一个公开的人力资源数据集**）**，**只取**年龄、**月收入、**在职年数三项并**筛选年龄小于 65****（**⭐ 即**该文件并非养老金计划的真实成员数据**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处恰恰是**该练习最诚实的部分**：**它没有假装自己有真实的计划数据**，**而是**用一个公开数据集**把方法跑通**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 交付物只有两件，**且一件是另一件的导出****——**`Proyecto 8.ipynb`**（**源**）与** `Proyecto_8.pdf`**（**导出**）**；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**本次**未读两者正文**，**故**不主张** PDF 与 notebook 内容一致**——**⭐ 这与本站第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」同向**：**当一件事有「**源**」与「**导出**」两种形态时，**要能说清哪个是哪个**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[lifecontingencies]] 覆盖 R 的生命或然计算**，**[[pylifecontingencies]]、**[[lifecon]] 覆盖 Python 与相关实现**，**[[pension-pro-mcp]]、**[[openfisca]] 覆盖养老金与政策计算**，**[[colombian-pension-observatory]]、**[[pensions-authority-ie]] 覆盖养老金数据与监管**，**[[soa-practice-tools]] 覆盖 SOA 工具**，**[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]] 覆盖一份西语养老金硕士论文**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一个只有四条路径的西语练习：**五情景、**每次只动一个假设、**并写明免责**」这一形态**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[lifecontingencies]]、[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]] 应当并读**——**前者给工具，**中者给同类西语作品**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的三点**：**① 敏感性分析**每次只动一个假设**，**并说明这是为了归因**；**② **假设数值逐个写出**，**让别人不看你代码也能复述你的模型**；**③ **数据不是真的就写明不是真的****。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**（**未装 R 依赖、**未执行 notebook、**未打开** `Proyecto_8.pdf`**），**故**不主张**其任何数值结果**（**⭐ 包括五个情景下负债变化的方向与幅度**）**；**⭐ 本词条**不主张**该练习的结论**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读 notebook 正文**——**本次只读** `README.md` **与 tarball 路径列表**；**⭐ 因此**「**十一个步骤**」这一表述本次**只来自 README 的自述**，**未逐步核对**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `data.csv` **的实际列名与筛选结果**（**未下载该文件**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `soa08Act` **这一表名在 [[lifecontingencies]] 中的确切含义与本次实际调用方式**（**⭐ 即**未确认它是**按该包内置的表名直接引用**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **权利不明**：仓库内**未见 `LICENSE` 文件**，**README 亦未逐字给出许可条款****（**⭐ 本词条按池内惯例记为**权利不明**，**并如实指出**这**不等于**作者放弃权利**）**；**⚠️ 若要复用其代码或文字，**须先取得作者许可**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与所属机构**；**★0、**只有 4 条路径、**无测试、**无 CI**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这是一个**练习级**的仓库**，**不是**一个可依赖的软件产品**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实该 PDF 是否为 notebook 的完整导出**（**见上**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 数据集的许可与引用要求本次**未核实**（**未访问 IBM HR Analytics 数据集页面**）**。**⑨ ⚠️ 创建 2026-08-25 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-10 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**一个极小的西语养老金敏感性练习：**五情景每次只动一个假设、**假设数值逐条写出、**免责与数据来源明确**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该练习的模型与数据都不是真实的养老金计划**，**其结果**不得**用于任何实际精算判断**。
entries.body_hk:
**analisis-estres-pasivos-laborales**（GitHub 倉庫 `EmGM112002/analisis-estres-pasivos-laborales`，**全文西班牙語**）**是一份**養老金（DB）負債的敏感性／壓力練習****。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-25、最後推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**Jupyter Notebook**；**⚠️⚠️ 全倉庫只有 4 條路徑**（`Proyecto 8.ipynb`、`Proyecto_8.pdf`、`README.md`、`data.csv`**）**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 按慣例記為**權利不明**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：把上游當成引擎、並且要真的跑起來**」**——**它用已收錄的 [[lifecontingencies]] 在 R 裡計算**，**生物特徵表逐字為** `soa08Act`**。

**可核實資訊（均 README 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 方法本身就是一句話，**且這句話說明了「**為什麼**」****——**逐字**「**aplicando un análisis de sensibilidad y estrés modificando una variable a la vez para aislar el efecto individual de cada factor de riesgo**」**（**中譯**：**應用敏感性與壓力分析，**每次只修改一個變數，**以隔離每個風險因子的單獨影響**）**。**⭐ 本詞條認為這是本輪最值得抄的一處**：「**每次只動一個**」**不是為了省事，**而是**為了讓**歸因**成立**——**若兩個假設同時變，**你就分不清是哪一變造成的**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把**假設的數值逐條寫出來****——**實測到的**：**貼現率 5.0%**；**工資增長率 3.0%**；**退休年齡 65 歲**；**給付因子為**每年預計服務年限的 2.0%**；**生物特徵表** `soa08Act`**。**⭐ 這五點合起來是**一個最小可複述的精算練習說明**：**別人拿到這五行**，**即使沒有那個 notebook，**也大致知道你在算什麼**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 五個情景，**每個只動一處****——**逐字為**：**基準情景**；**利率下降 100 個基點**；**利率上升 100 個基點**；**工資通脹上升 100 個基點**；**長壽情景（**壽命延長 1 年**）**。**⭐ 值得抄的一處**：**利率那兩個情景**成對出現**（**同一因子**向下與向上各一次**）**——**⭐ 即**不只報「**如果利率跌了會怎樣**」，**而是**把**對稱的一側**也算了**，**讀者能看出**響應是否近似線性**。**⭐⭐ ④ 免責聲明把「**這不是真方案**」寫得很直白**——**逐字自述該模型**僅具學術與作品集用途**，**所用資料**是演示性質的**、**不代表任何真實養老金計劃**（**逐字含**「**datos de carácter demostrativo**」**）**。**⭐ 這與本站第 336 輪「**寧可拒絕也不假裝**」同向**：**作品集專案最容易犯的錯**是**讓讀者以為資料是真的**——**⭐ 而它**把這一句寫在前面**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 資料來源可核**——**README 逐字指明** `data.csv` **取自 IBM HR Analytics Employee Attrition & Performance**（**公開 HR 資料集**）**，**只取**年齡、**月收入、**在職年數三項並**篩選年齡小於 65****。**⭐ 這恰恰是**該練習最誠實的部分**：**它沒有假裝自己有真實的計劃資料**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 交付物只有兩件，**且一件是另一件的匯出****——**`Proyecto 8.ipynb`**（**源**）與** `Proyecto_8.pdf`**（**匯出**）**；**⭐ 本次**未讀兩者正文**，**故**不主張 PDF 與 notebook 內容一致**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[lifecontingencies]]、[[pylifecontingencies]]、[[lifecon]]、[[pension-pro-mcp]]、[[openfisca]]、[[colombian-pension-observatory]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[soa-practice-tools]]、[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**一個只有四條路徑的西語練習：**五情景、**每次只動一個假設、**並寫明免責**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[lifecontingencies]]、[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 三點最值得借鑑**：**① 敏感性分析**每次只動一個假設**，**並說明是為了歸因**；**② **假設數值逐個寫出**，**讓別人不看你代碼也能複述你的模型**；**③ **資料不是真的就寫明不是真的****。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行該專案任何一步**（**未裝 R 依賴、**未執行 notebook、**未打開** `Proyecto_8.pdf`**），**不主張**其任何數值結果**（**包括五個情景下負債變化的方向與幅度**）**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀 notebook 正文**——**只讀** `README.md` **與 tarball 路徑列表**；**⭐ 因此**「**十一個步驟**」本次**只來自 README 自述**，**未逐步核對**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** `data.csv` **的實際列名與篩選結果**（**未下載該檔**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實** `soa08Act` **在 [[lifecontingencies]] 中的確切含義與本次實際調用方式**。**⑤ ⚠️ **權利不明**：倉庫內**未見 `LICENSE`**，**README 亦未逐字給出許可條款****（**⭐ **這不等於**作者放棄權利**）**；**⚠️ 若要複用其代碼或文字，**須先取得作者許可**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份與機構**；**★0、**只有 4 條路徑、**無測試、**無 CI**——**⭐ 這是一個**練習級**倉庫**，**不是**可依賴的軟體產品**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實該 PDF 是否為 notebook 的完整匯出**。**⑧ ⚠️ 資料集的許可與引用要求**未核實**（**未訪問 IBM HR Analytics 頁面**）**。**⑨ ⚠️ 建立 2026-08-25 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-10 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「極小的西語養老金敏感性練習：五情景每次只動一個假設＋假設數值逐條寫出＋免責與資料來源明確」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該練習的模型與資料都不是真實的養老金計劃**，**其結果**不得**用於任何實際精算判斷**。
entries.body_en:
The repository analisis-estres-pasivos-laborales, written entirely in Spanish, **is a sensitivity and stress exercise on defined-benefit pension obligations**. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-25**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **zero stars**, primarily a Jupyter notebook, and **only four paths in the entire repository** — a notebook, an exported PDF, a readme and a data file — with **no licence file**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream treating the upstream as an engine that must actually be run**, since it computes in R with an already pooled life-contingencies package and uses a standard actuarial mortality table, named verbatim in the readme, as its biometric basis.

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, the method is one sentence and that sentence says why it is done that way**: verbatim, the analysis applies sensitivity and stress testing by modifying one variable at a time in order to isolate the individual effect of each risk factor. **This entry considers that the most copyable item of the round: moving one thing at a time is not a shortcut but the condition that makes attribution possible, since if two assumptions move together you cannot say which one caused the movement.** **Second, the assumptions are written out with their numbers**: a discount rate of five percent, salary growth of three percent, retirement at sixty-five, a benefit factor of two percent of projected service per year, and a named standard mortality table as the biometric basis. **Those five lines together form a minimal restatement of the exercise, so that a reader without the notebook still knows roughly what is being computed, which matches the standing principle that every number should be written next to where it came from.** **Third, five scenarios each move exactly one thing**: a base case, a hundred-basis-point fall in the interest rate, a hundred-basis-point rise, a hundred-basis-point rise in salary inflation, and a longevity scenario extending life by one year. **One design detail is worth copying: the two interest-rate scenarios are paired in both directions, so the direction and rough linearity of the response can be seen rather than only the effect of a fall.** **Fourth, the disclaimer is unusually plain about the fact that this is not a real plan**: the readme states that the model is academic and portfolio work only, that the data is demonstrative in character, and that it does not represent any real pension plan. **A portfolio project most easily misleads by letting a reader assume the data is real, and this one puts the contrary statement first**, which points the same way as standing principles that it is better to refuse than to pretend and that absences should be named. **Fifth, the data source is checkable**: the readme states verbatim that the data file comes from a public human-resources attrition and performance dataset, taking only age, monthly income and years at the company and filtering to ages below sixty-five, which is exactly the honest part of the exercise, since it does not pretend to hold real plan member data but uses a public dataset to make the method runnable. **Sixth, there are only two deliverables and one is an export of the other**: a notebook and a PDF. **This entry states plainly that neither body was read, so it does not claim that the PDF matches the notebook**, which is the same distinction the project draws between a source and what it generated. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover life-contingency computation in R and in Python, pension and policy calculation tools, pension data and supervision, actuarial practice tools and a comparable Spanish-language pension thesis, **while this entry supplies a four-path Spanish exercise with five scenarios that move one assumption at a time and a plain disclaimer**.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled life-contingencies package and the pooled Spanish pension thesis**; **three practices transfer directly: move one assumption at a time in a sensitivity analysis and say that this is for attribution, write the assumption values out so that a reader can restate your model without reading your code, and state plainly when the data is not real**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no R dependency installed, no notebook executed and the exported PDF not opened — **so no numerical result is claimed, including the direction and size of the liability change under any of the five scenarios**, and **this entry claims nothing about the exercise conclusions**. **Second, no notebook body was read**: only the readme and the archive path list were read, so **the stated eleven-step procedure is relayed from the readme rather than checked step by step**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the actual column names and filtering result in the data file were not verified**, since the file was not downloaded. **Fourth, the exact meaning of the named mortality table within the pooled package and how it is actually invoked were not verified. Fifth, the rights position is unclear**: no licence file is present and the readme gives no licence terms verbatim, so **this entry records it as unclear rights and states plainly that this is not the same as the author waiving rights**; **reusing its code or text requires the author permission first**. **Sixth, the author identity and affiliation were not verified, and a repository with zero stars, four paths, no tests and no continuous integration is an exercise-grade repository rather than a dependable software product.** **Seventh, whether the PDF is a complete export of the notebook was not verified. Eighth, the licence and citation requirements of the underlying dataset were not verified**, since its page was not visited. **Ninth, the creation date of 2026-08-25 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-10 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that a very small Spanish pension sensitivity exercise with five scenarios that move one assumption at a time, assumption values written out, and a clear disclaimer with a stated data source had no counterpart in the pool. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that neither its model nor its data is a real pension plan and that its results must not be used for any actual actuarial judgement.**

entries.title: **从零手写的链梯，先用库核对到零差、再用**真实后续发展**回测**：仓库 `ishimwe07/loss-reserving-chainladder`——**⭐ 与已收录的 [[chainladder-python]] **十年终极损失逐年完全一致、**最大差为 0****（**并有断言**）；**⭐ 而回测给出的不是好消息**：**十年里**每一年都偏小、**没有一年偏大**——**⭐ 自述**「**That is systematic bias, not noise**」**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**、**★0**
entries.title_en: A chain-ladder implementation written from scratch in pandas that first reconciles to zero difference against a pooled reserving library and then backtests against nine further years of real development, where every accident year turns out to have been under-projected and none over-projected, a pattern the readme calls systematic bias rather than noise.
entries.title_hk: **從零手寫的鏈梯，先用庫核對到零差、再用**真實後續發展**回測**：倉庫 `ishimwe07/loss-reserving-chainladder`——**⭐ 與已收錄的 [[chainladder-python]] **十年終極損失逐年完全一致、**最大差為 0****（**並有斷言**）**；**⭐ 而回測給出的不是好消息**：**十年裡**每一年都偏小、**沒有一年偏大**——**⭐ 自述**「**That is systematic bias, not noise**」**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**、**★0**
entries.summary: **loss-reserving-chainladder**（`ishimwe07/loss-reserving-chainladder`）**是一份**从零手写的链梯准备金实现**，**逐字自述为**「**Chain-ladder reserving on a US personal auto portfolio, implemented from scratch in pandas, validated against `chainladder-python` and backtested against nine years of subsequent development.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-17、最后推送 2026-09-08**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**；**tarball 20 条路径**（**六个 `src/` 模块、**一个测试文件、**数据 `data/ppauto.csv` 已随仓库提供**）**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：拿上游当尺子**」**——**它把已收录的 [[chainladder-python]] 当**核对基准****（**逐字**「**Identical ultimates to `chainladder-python` — maximum difference across all ten years is zero.**」**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **库核对到**零差**（**⭐ 即**「**我写得对**」有量化证明**）**；**② **再用**真实后续发展**回测**（**截至二〇一六年**），**并如实报出**每一年都偏小****（**准备金 **2.5% 不足****，**⭐ 且**误差随不成熟度放大**）**；**③ **把数据选择的理由写明**（**单一公司而非行业合计、**已付而非已发生**）。**⚠️ 本次未运行其代码。
entries.summary_hk: **loss-reserving-chainladder**（`ishimwe07/loss-reserving-chainladder`）**是一份**從零手寫的鏈梯準備金實現**，**逐字自述為**「**Chain-ladder reserving on a US personal auto portfolio, implemented from scratch in pandas, validated against `chainladder-python` and backtested against nine years of subsequent development.**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-17、最後推送 2026-09-08**、**★0**、**Python**；**tarball 20 條路徑**（**六個 `src/` 模組、**一個測試檔、**資料 `data/ppauto.csv` 隨倉庫提供**）**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：拿上游當尺子**」**——**它把已收錄的 [[chainladder-python]] 當**核對基準****（**逐字**「**Identical ultimates to `chainladder-python` — maximum difference across all ten years is zero.**」**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **庫核對到**零差****；**② **再用**真實後續發展**回測**（**截至二〇一六年**），**並如實報出**每一年都偏小****（**準備金 **2.5% 不足****，**誤差隨不成熟度放大**）**；**③ **把資料選擇的理由寫明**（**單一公司而非行業合計、**已付而非已發生**）。**⚠️ 本次未運行其代碼。
entries.summary_en: The repository loss-reserving-chainladder **is a chain-ladder reserving implementation written from scratch in pandas**, described verbatim as chain-ladder reserving on a United States personal auto portfolio, implemented from scratch in pandas, validated against a pooled reserving library and backtested against nine years of subsequent development. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-17**, **last pushed 2026-09-08**, **zero stars**, primarily Python, **twenty paths in the extracted archive** with six source modules, one test file and the data file committed, and **no licence file**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream using the upstream as a yardstick**, since it uses the pooled reserving library as its reconciliation baseline and states verbatim that it produces identical ultimates with a maximum difference of zero across all ten accident years. **Three things are worth reading**: the reconciliation to zero difference gives a quantified proof that the implementation is correct; a backtest against nine further years of real development then reports honestly that every accident year was under-projected, with the reserve about two and a half percent short and the error growing with immaturity; and the reasons for the data choices are written down, including a single company rather than an industry aggregate because chain ladder assumes a stable development pattern which an industry blend does not have, and paid rather than incurred losses because incurred losses fall over time as case reserves are released. **Nothing was run this round.**
entries.body:
**loss-reserving-chainladder**（GitHub 仓库 `ishimwe07/loss-reserving-chainladder`）**是一份**从零手写的链梯准备金实现**，**README 逐字自述为**「**Chain-ladder reserving on a US personal auto portfolio, implemented from scratch in pandas, validated against `chainladder-python` and backtested against nine years of subsequent development.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-17、最后推送 2026-09-08**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**；**tarball 20 条路径**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 本词条按惯例记为**权利不明**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：拿上游当尺子**」**——**它把本站已收录的 [[chainladder-python]] 当作**核对基准****。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**我算得对**」变成了一个可量化的核对结果**——**逐字**：**「**Identical ultimates to `chainladder-python` — maximum difference across all ten years is zero. Asserted in `tests/test_chainladder.py`.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**先用**已收录的库**把自写实现钉住**（**十年、**十个事故年、**最大差 **0**）**，**而不是**用「**结果看起来合理**」来判断对错**；**⭐ 这与本站第 348 轮「**自验证**」、第 344 轮「**把依据放在看得见的地方**」同向**：**核对基准是被指名道姓写出来的**（**且**有断言**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 而它随后给出的**不是一个好消息**——**逐字**：**「**The pattern matters more than the headline. Every accident year is under-projected; not one overshoots. That is systematic bias, not noise, and the error scales with immaturity — mature years land within 0.1%, the least developed miss by ~0.6%.**」**。**⭐ 本次实测到的关键数字**：**截至 2007 年末的准备金估计为 **13,122,496**（**README 概称 $13.12M****）**，**而**到二〇一六年**实际所需为 **13,458,704**（**⭐ 即**准备金**不足约 2.5%****）**；**终极损失合计**估计 **114,523,246**、**实际 **114,859,454**、**差 **336,208**（**即 **0.29%****）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处比「**核对到零差**」更有价值**：**⭐ 它把**「**算法实现正确**」与**「**方法本身有系统偏差**」这两件事分开了**——**⭐ 即**你的代码可以**完全正确**，**而你的准备金仍然**年复一年地偏小**。**⭐⭐ ③ 它指出了**偏差的机制**，**而不只是报一个数**——**逐字**：**「**The cause is that the later factors rest on very few observations: `f_9` is estimated from accident year 1998 alone, and it understates what later years went on to show. The comparison is made at lag 10, so it excludes development beyond the triangle; since `f_9` is still 1.0017, the true deficiency is somewhat worse.**」**。**⭐ 即**偏差来自**末端发展因子只有一条观测**；**⭐ 而它进一步说明**比对只做到第 10 个滞后**，**故**真实缺口**比 2.5% 还要更差一些**——**⭐ 本词条认为**「**我报的这个偏差本身就是低估**」**这一句很少见，**值得抄**。**⭐⭐ ④ 数据选择的每一条都带理由**——**逐字三条**：**① **一家公司、不是行业合计**（**「**One company, not the industry aggregate — chain-ladder assumes a stable development pattern, which an industry blend does not have.**」**）**；**② **用已付、不用已发生**（**「**Paid, not incurred — incurred losses fall over time here as case reserves are released, producing link ratios below 1.0.**」**）**；**③ **切在 2007 估值日**（**「**Cut at the 2007 valuation — the raw dataset is a full square including actuals through 2016. Filtering recreates the real forecasting problem; the discarded portion becomes the backtest.**」**）**。**⭐ 本题库认为第 ③ 条尤其实用**：**⭐ 即**把完整方阵**切掉一部分**，**让剩下的部分**充当回测**——**⭐ 这与本站第 356 轮那条「**注册在前、**结果在后**」是同一件事的两种做法**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 局限被逐条列出，**且包含**对结论的修正方向****——**逐字四条**：**无尾部因子**（**第 10 个滞后之后按 1.0 处理**）**；**2007 事故年**杠杆极高**（**一个数据点 × CDF **2.2382**，**承载一半的准备金 6,643,130**）**；**链梯在**理赔处理速度变化、**单一大额损失、**案均准备金强度变化**时会退化**；**以及**Bornhuetter-Ferguson 会缓解不成熟年的杠杆，**但本项目**未实现****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 工程形态可数**：`src/` **六个模块逐字为** `triangle.py`（**原始记录 → 累计三角**）、`vol_weighted_factors.py`（**逐龄发展因子**）、`cumulative_dev_factors.py`（**CDF**）、`chain_ladder.py`（**终极值与准备金**）、`backtest.py`（**预测 vs 实际发展**）、`plots.py`；**`main.py` 一条命令跑完三角、**准备金、**回测与出图**（**逐字** `python main.py`）**；**`pytest` 用于对库核对**；**⭐ 并逐字写明**「**Data is committed, so the repo runs as cloned.**」**——**⭐ 即**克隆即可跑**，**不必先找数据**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[chainladder-python]] 覆盖官方 Python 准备金库**，**[[actuarial-reserving]]、**[[reserving-ml]]、**[[ibnr-app]]、**[[gi-loss-reserving]] 覆盖链梯／BF／Cape Cod 的多种实现**，**[[loss-reserving-engine]] 覆盖「**先造数据再清洗再建三角**」的流水线**，**[[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 覆盖车险的经典方法与深度学习对比**，**[[hgr-hidden-grammar-reserving]] 覆盖方法与输出纪律**，**[[verified-reserving]] 覆盖形式化证明**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**先用库核对到零差、**再用真实后续发展回测、**并把系统性偏差的成因与低估方向写出来**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[chainladder-python]]、[[reserving-ml]] 应当并读**——**前者给库，**中者给教学实现，**本条给**「**实现正确 ≠ 估计无偏**」这一课**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的三点**：**① 自写实现先用**已收录的库**核对，**并把最大差写出来**；**② 用**切掉一部分完整数据**的方式造回测**；**③ 当结果**系统性偏一个方向**时，**去找**哪一步只靠了极少数观测**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**（**未装依赖、**未跑 `main.py`、**未跑 `pytest`、**未复算任何发展因子或 CDF**），**故**不主张**其准备金数字、**不主张**其与库的零差结论、**不主张**其回测的百分比**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何源码正文**——**本次只读** `README.md` **与 tarball 路径列表**；**未打开** `src/` **下六个模块、**`main.py`、**`tests/test_chainladder.py`，**也**未读** `data/ppauto.csv`。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `data/ppauto.csv` **是否确为 CAS Loss Reserve Database（美国 Schedule P）** 的**某一家公司、**某一段事故年**的切片**（**⭐ 本词条只转述 README 的说法**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实该公司的名称是否确为 README 所述的 State Farm Mutual Group**；**⭐ 本词条按 README 转述，**并提示**该数据集的引用与使用条款**本次**未核实**。**⑤ ⚠️ **权利不明**：**仓库内未见 `LICENSE`，**README 亦未逐字给出许可条款****（**⭐ 这**不等于**作者放弃权利**）**；**⚠️ 复用其代码或数字前须先取得作者许可**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与机构**；**★0、**无 CI、**仅一个测试文件**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这是一个**个人练习级**仓库**，**其价值在**做法**而不在**可作为生产工具**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实 README 中「**$13.12M**」与表中 **13,122,496** 的对应关系**（**⭐ 两处均来自 README，**本词条分开引用而未替它调和**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2026-08-17 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-08 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**先用已收录库核对到零差、**再用真实后续发展回测、**并把系统性偏差的机制与**低估方向**写出来**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**本条目的任何数字**都只是**该项目在其自有数据上的自述结果**，**不得**用于任何真实的准备金判断**。

entries.body_en:
The repository loss-reserving-chainladder, by the GitHub user ishimwe07, **is a chain-ladder reserving implementation written from scratch in pandas**, described verbatim as chain-ladder reserving on a United States personal auto portfolio, validated against the pooled reserving library and backtested against nine years of subsequent development. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-17**, **last pushed 2026-09-08**, **zero stars**, primarily Python, **twenty paths in the extracted archive**, and **no licence file**, which this entry records as unclear rights. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream using the upstream as a yardstick.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, the claim of correctness is turned into a quantified reconciliation**: verbatim, the ultimates are identical to the pooled library with a maximum difference of zero across all ten accident years, asserted in a test file. **Using an already pooled library to pin a hand-written implementation, and writing the maximum difference down, is better than judging correctness by whether the output looks plausible, and the baseline is named and asserted rather than implied.** **Second, what follows is not good news**: verbatim, the pattern matters more than the headline, every accident year is under-projected, not one overshoots, that is systematic bias rather than noise, and the error scales with immaturity, with mature years landing within a tenth of a percent while the least developed miss by about six tenths. **The measured numbers are a reserve estimate of about thirteen million against roughly thirteen and a half million actually required through 2016, a shortfall of about two and a half percent, with estimated ultimates of about a hundred and fourteen and a half million against actual of about a hundred and fourteen point eight six million, a difference of about three hundred and thirty-six thousand or under a third of a percent.** **This point is more valuable than the zero-difference reconciliation, because it separates an implementation being correct from the method itself being biased: the code can be entirely right while the reserve is understated year after year.** **Third, the mechanism of the bias is identified rather than only the number**: verbatim, the cause is that the later factors rest on very few observations, the last factor being estimated from a single accident year, and the comparison is made at lag ten so it excludes development beyond the triangle, which given that the last factor is still slightly above one means the true deficiency is somewhat worse. **Saying that the reported deficiency is itself an understatement is rare and worth copying.** **Fourth, every data choice carries its reason**: one company rather than the industry aggregate, because chain ladder assumes a stable development pattern that an industry blend does not have; paid rather than incurred, because incurred losses fall over time as case reserves are released, producing link ratios below one; and a cut at the 2007 valuation, because the raw dataset is a full square including actuals through 2016, so filtering recreates the real forecasting problem and the discarded portion becomes the backtest. **That last device, cutting a complete square and letting the remainder serve as the backtest, is the same idea as registering a prediction before the result is known.** **Fifth, the limitations are listed with the direction in which they change the conclusion**: no tail factor, so development beyond the tenth lag is treated as complete; the final accident year is highly leveraged, being one data point times a cumulative development factor of about two point two four while carrying half the total reserve; chain ladder degrades when claims-handling speed changes, when a single large loss distorts a cell, or when case-reserving strength shifts; and the alternative method that would address the leverage on immature years by blending in an a-priori expectation is explicitly not implemented. **Sixth, the engineering shape is countable**: six source modules covering triangle construction, volume-weighted age-to-age factors, cumulative development factors, ultimates and reserves, backtesting and plotting; a single main script that runs the triangle, the reserves, the backtest and the plot; a test suite for the library reconciliation; and a statement that the data is committed so that the repository runs as cloned. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the official Python reserving library, several chain-ladder and Bornhuetter-Ferguson implementations, a pipeline that simulates and then cleans loss data, a comparison of classical methods against deep learning, reserving output discipline and a formal verification of reserving mathematics, **while this entry supplies reconciling a hand-written implementation to zero difference against a pooled library, then backtesting against real subsequent development, and writing the mechanism and the direction of the systematic bias into the limitations. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled reserving library and a pooled teaching implementation**, and **three practices transfer directly: reconcile a hand-written implementation against a pooled library first and write the maximum difference down, build a backtest by cutting a complete dataset and holding the remainder out, and when results are systematically off in one direction, look for the step that rests on very few observations**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no dependencies installed, no main script, no test suite and no recomputation of any development factor or cumulative development factor — **so none of its reserve figures, its zero-difference reconciliation or its backtest percentages is claimed**. **Second, no source code was read**: only the README and the archive path list were read, and no module under the source directory, no main script, no test file and not the committed data file were opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the committed data file is indeed a slice of the CAS Loss Reserve Database, United States Schedule P, for one company and a stated band of accident years was not verified, this entry relaying the README statement only.** **Fourth, whether the company is the one the README names was not verified, and the citation and terms of use of that dataset were not checked.** **Fifth, the rights position is unclear**: no licence file is present and the README gives no licence terms verbatim, **which is not the same as the author waiving rights**, and reuse requires the author permission first. **Sixth, the author identity and affiliation were not verified, and a repository with zero stars, no continuous integration and a single test file is a personal exercise rather than a production tool, its value lying in the practice rather than in its readiness for use.** **Seventh, the correspondence between the abbreviated reserve figure in the README prose and the exact figure in its table was not verified; both come from the README and this entry quotes them separately without reconciling them. Eighth, the creation date of 2026-08-17 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-08 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that reconciling a hand-written implementation to zero difference against a pooled library, then backtesting against real subsequent development, and writing a systematic bias and its direction into the limitations had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that every figure here is the project own reported result on its own data and must not be used for any reserve judgement.**

entries.title: **从保单特征一路走到**超赔再保分层**的车险定价全链**：仓库 `poohbear4/motor-insurance-pricing`——**⭐ 频率 GLM → 严重度**分段**（**小额与巨额分开**）→ **广义帕累托尾部** → **超赔分层评估** → **十万曝险年模拟****；**⭐ 三个可核数字**：**超过 €20,000 的赔案**不到 1% 却占约 **36% 的损失**；**Γ 离散参数从约 **25.3 降到 1.54**；**拟合尾部形状参数 **ξ ≈ 0.7–0.8**；**⚠️ 只有 5 个 notebook、无测试、无 `LICENSE`**

entries.summary_en: The repository motor-insurance-pricing **is an end-to-end motor insurance pricing and reinsurance tail-risk analysis**, described verbatim as developing an end-to-end motor insurance risk modelling framework on the public French motor third-party liability dataset, and combining claim frequency modelling, claim severity modelling, extreme value theory and Monte Carlo simulation to move from individual policy risk characteristics through to aggregate portfolio loss and excess-of-loss reinsurance analysis. **Measured this round**: **created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-10**, **zero stars**, primarily Jupyter notebooks, **only nine paths in the extracted archive** — a readme plus five notebooks numbered two through six — and **no requirements file, no tests and no licence file**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream using the upstream as data**, since it uses the pooled French motor third-party liability dataset. **Three things are worth reading**: severity is split into an attritional part and a large-loss part with a stated stability gain, the Gamma dispersion falling from about twenty-five to about one and a half; a generalised-Pareto tail is fitted above twenty thousand euros with an honestly heavy shape parameter of about zero point seven to zero point eight and substantial uncertainty around extreme-loss estimates; and a hundred thousand exposure-year simulation compares excess-of-loss layers by expected cost and tail-risk reduction, with historical burning cost becoming progressively less credible at higher attachment points. **No notebook was run this round.**
entries.body:
**motor-insurance-pricing**（GitHub 仓库 `poohbear4/motor-insurance-pricing`）**是一份**端到端的车险定价与再保尾部风险分析****，**README 逐字自述为**「**This project develops an end-to-end motor insurance risk modelling framework using the public `freMTPL2` French Motor Third-Party Liability dataset.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-10、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**主语言 Jupyter Notebook**；**tarball 只有 9 条路径**（**README.md、`.gitignore` 与** `notebooks/` **下 02–06 五个 notebook**）**；**⚠️ 无 `requirements.txt`、**无测试、**无 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 本词条按惯例记为**权利不明**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：拿上游当数据**」**——**它把本站已收录的 [[fremtpl2]] 数据集当作**输入端****。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 链条被一句逐字写清，**且每一段都有名字****——**逐字**：**「**The analysis covers three related insurance problems: 1. Claim frequency — modelling how policy characteristics affect the expected number of claims. 2. Claim severity — separating ordinary claims from large losses and modelling their different distributions. 3. Reinsurance and portfolio risk — using Extreme Value Theory (EVT) and Monte Carlo simulation to assess excess-of-loss reinsurance structures and their effect on extreme annual losses.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一结构值得抄的地方是**第三段的位置**：**它不是**另开一篇再保论文**，**而是**同一条链的终点**——**⭐ 即**定价模型与再保评估共用同一套频率与严重度假设**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 严重度被**分成两段**，**并给出分段前后模型稳定性的差值**——**逐字**：**「**A Poisson GLM with nonlinear age effects was used to model claim frequency, with Negative Binomial models used as a robustness check for overdispersion. Severity was separated into attritional and large-loss components after identifying that a very small number of claims accounted for a disproportionate share of total losses.**」**，**并给出**「**Gamma dispersion falling from approximately 25.3 to 1.54 below the €20,000 threshold**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**「**为什么要分段**」**不是一句直觉，**而是**一个从 25.3 降到 1.54 的数**——**⭐ 即**分段的有效性**被量化了**；**⭐ 这与本站第 330 轮「**假设**」、第 343 轮「**四个维度**」同向**：**假设要能被检验**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 尾部被明确承认是**极重的**，**且不确定性被写出****——**逐字**：**「**The fitted Generalised Pareto tail had a shape parameter of approximately ξ = 0.7–0.8, indicating a very heavy Pareto-type tail with substantial uncertainty around extreme-loss estimates.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处尤其值得记**：**ξ 在 **0.7–0.8** 时**均值的有限性都取决于**方差之外的条件**（**⭐ 本词条只转述其自述，**不在此推导**）**；**⭐ 而作者**没有**把这样一个参数说得比它更确定**——**⭐ 并**据此指出**历史燃烧成本在高层级越来越不可信**（**逐字**「**Historical burning cost became progressively less credible at higher reinsurance attachment points because very few claims reached those layers.**」**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 三个与业务直接相关的数字**——**逐字**：**① **风险区分度**（**「**observed annual claim frequency rising from approximately 4.4% in the lowest predicted-risk decile to 31.5% in the highest**」**）**；**② **奖惩系数（Bonus-Malus）的强度**（**「**a 10-point increase was associated with approximately 25% higher expected claim frequency, holding other rating factors constant**」**）**；**③ **集中度**（**「**Claims above €20,000 represented less than 1% of claims but approximately 36% of total losses**」**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为第 ③ 条是整篇的核心事实**：**不到 1% 的赔案占约 36% 的损失**——**⭐ 即**小额模型再精细，**也管不到那 36%**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 再保那一侧的比较口径被写明**——**逐字**：**「**For a simulated portfolio of 100,000 exposure-years, gross annual 99% VaR stabilised at approximately €55m, while 99% TVaR was materially more sensitive to extreme simulated losses. Higher-attaching excess-of-loss layers generated fewer recoveries and lower expected cost, but provided more targeted protection against severe losses per euro of expected ceded loss.**」**。**⭐ 即**比较不只看**期望成本**，**还看**每一元分出保费的尾部保护效率**——**⭐ 这与本站第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**：**层越高，**数据越少，**结论越弱**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 数据审计留下了一处具体的**不对劲****——**逐字**：**「**The severity table contained 195 claim records linked to six policy IDs absent from the frequency table. These claims were retained during the initial data audit and sensitivity analysis, but excluded from the primary covariate and reinsurance models to maintain a consistent portfolio population.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独抄**：**⭐ 即**它**发现了**左右表对不上的 **195 条**，**没有**悄悄删掉**，**而是**分两处处理**（**审计与敏感性分析里保留、**主模型里排除**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 341 轮「**三种缺席**」同向**：**缺席要分类，**而不是**一律抹平**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 数据规模与工程形态（如实记录）**：**逐字**「**678,013 policy records**」**与**「**26,639 claim severity records**」**；**notebook 编号从 **02 起**（**没有 01**）**；**`notebooks/` 五个文件的实测大小为** 43,670／180,934／91,671／184,457／241,654 **字节**；**⚠️ 全仓库**没有 `.py` 源文件、**没有测试、**没有依赖清单**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**要复现需自备环境，**且** README 未逐字给出依赖清单**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[fremtpl2]] 与 [[fremtpl2-python-tutorial]] 覆盖该数据集与其教程**，**[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、**[[fremtpl2]] 相关条目覆盖 Tweedie 定价**，**[[pyextremes]]、**[[mev]]、**[[extremes]]、**[[evd]]、**[[evir]] 覆盖极值统计工具**，**[[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]] 覆盖再保分层定价**，**[[cat-bond-pricing]]、**[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]] 覆盖再保一侧**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**频率 → 严重度分段 → 帕累托尾部 → 超赔分层 → 十万曝险年模拟**」这一条完整链，**且**每一步都留了可核数字**。**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[fremtpl2]]、[[pyextremes]] 应当并读**——**前者给数据，**中者给极值工具，**本条给**一条把它们串起来并走到再保的完整例子**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的三点**：**① 严重度分段要**用稳定性指标验证**，**而不是**凭直觉**；**② 尾部分布拟合出很重的参数时**照写**，**并写出不确定性**；**③ 左右表对不上时**分类处理**，**不悄悄删数据**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**（**未打开任何 notebook、**未执行任何单元、**未复算任何 GLM、**帕累托拟合或模拟**），**故**不主张**其 4.4%／31.5%、**25.3→1.54、**ξ ≈ 0.7–0.8、**36%、**99% VaR ≈ €55m **中的任何一个数字**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 notebook 正文**——**本次只读** `README.md` **与 tarball 路径与大小列表**；**⭐ 故**本词条所述的一切**模型设定、**阈值与结论**都只来自 README 的自述**，**未经我核对**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实 `freMTPL2` 的**实际取数版本与来源**（**⭐ 未确认它是经由 OpenML、**经 [[fremtpl2]] 的镜像、**还是**作者自行拼接**）**；**也未核实** 678,013／26,639 **这两个行数与公开版本是否一致**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实「**€20,000**」这一分段阈值是如何选出的**（**⭐ 是**最小化某准则**、**还是**试出来的**，**README 未逐字说明**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** 100,000 **曝险年的模拟次数与随机种子**（**⭐ README 未逐字给出可复现细节**）**；**⭐ 故**该 VaR 数字**本次**不可复现**。**⑥ ⚠️ **权利不明**：**仓库内未见 `LICENSE`，**README 亦未逐字给出许可条款****（**⭐ 这**不等于**作者放弃权利**）**；**⚠️ 复用其代码、**图表或数字前**须先取得作者许可**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与机构**；**★0、**创建与推送同日、**无测试、**无 CI、**五个 notebook 无 `01`**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这是一个**单次作品集式分析**，**不是**可维护的软件**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实其结论与公开文献是否一致**（**⭐ 例如**车险严重度分段阈值与帕累托形状参数的常见取值范围**）**；**本条**不主张**其估计优于或劣于任何已发表结果**。**⑨ ⚠️ 创建 2026-09-10 在窗口之内**（**本条的创建与推送都在解冻窗口内**）**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**其全部数字**均为**该项目在其自有数据与自定参数上的自述结果**，**不得**用于任何真实定价、**再保分层决策或资本计量**。
