entries.summary_en: The repository rentenlueckenrechner, titled in German as a personal retirement planner, **is a retirement-gap calculator built with Vite, React and TypeScript**, described verbatim as estimating the net pension gap and the capital required at the start of retirement while showing wealth trajectories, key figures and an annual table, and stating verbatim that the results are model calculations rather than financial advice or forecasts. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-13**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **zero stars**, primarily TypeScript, **a hundred and thirty paths in the extracted archive** with feature-scoped source, tests and two continuous-integration workflows, and **no licence file in the repository even though the bundled data-licence document states that the code licence is in one**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one profession written in different languages.** **Three things are worth reading**: the model assumptions are written into the readme one by one, including that returns act on capital at the start of the year while contributions and withdrawals occur at the end, that there is a single global monthly savings rate, and that costs are deducted differently depending on the return source; data licensing is separated from code licensing with an explicit statement that commercial use of the derived data is not allowed; and a German statutory period life table is used only to display survival probabilities, with an explicit statement that the life table does not change the financial simulation. **The application was not run this round.**
entries.body:
**rentenlueckenrechner**（GitHub 仓库 `MaTeuff-bot/rentenlueckenrechner`，**全文德语**，**逐字标题** `Persönlicher Ruhestandsplaner`**）**是一个**退休缺口计算器****——**README 逐字自述为**「**Der Rentenlückenrechner ist eine Vite/React/TypeScript-App zur vereinfachten Ruhestandsplanung. Er schätzt die Netto-Rentenlücke und das benötigte Kapital zum Rentenbeginn und zeigt Vermögensverläufe, Kennzahlen und eine Jahrestabelle. Die Ergebnisse sind Modellrechnungen, keine Finanzberatung oder Prognosen.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-13、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**主语言 TypeScript**；**tarball 130 条路径**；**⚠️ 仓库内**没有 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 见下**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**母语：同一个专业，用不同语言写出来**」**。

**可核实信息（均 README、`package.json`、`DATA_LICENSES.md`、`AGENTS.md` 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 模型假设被逐条写进 README，**包括时间顺序**——**逐字**：**「**Die jährlichen Buchungszeilen (das Jahresledger) sind die maßgebliche Berechnungsgrundlage. Ansparphase und Ruhestand werden in Jahresschritten simuliert; Kennzahlen, Diagramm und Tabelle leiten sich aus den Simulationsergebnissen ab. **Renditen wirken auf das Kapital am Jahresanfang, Einzahlungen und Entnahmen erfolgen am Jahresende.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**「**收益作用于年初资本、**存取发生在年末**」**这句话**决定了每一年的结果**，**而**很多计算器**恰恰不写它**——**⭐ 这与本站第 330 轮「**假设**」、第 340 轮「**把每个数从哪来写在旁边**」同向**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 数据许可与代码许可**分开，**并写明商业限制****——**`DATA_LICENSES.md` 逐字**：**「**This repository separates application code licensing from bundled dataset licensing.**」**；**对 JST 宏观史数据库 R.6 的衍生序列逐字给出**：**来源网址、**所用文件 `JSTdatasetR6.dta`、**许可信号**「**Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)**」、**以及**「**Commercial use: not allowed for this bundled derived dataset.**」**；**⭐ 并逐字给出一个**可替换性**的判断**「**The calculator treats JST as a replaceable dataset provider. A future commercial version can replace the non-commercial JST-derived snapshots with a commercially licensed or permissively licensed provider without changing the historical bootstrap model.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄的地方是**它区分了三件事**：**代码的许可、**数据集的许可、**以及**数据源是否可替换****——**⭐ 与之对照**：**本次实测**仓库内**并没有 `LICENSE` 文件**，**而 `DATA_LICENSES.md` 逐字写着代码「**covered by the repository’s code license in `LICENSE`, if present**」**——**⭐ 本词条**如实记录这一处不闭合**，**不替它解释**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 生命表被明确限定**只用于显示**，**不进入财务模拟****——**逐字**：**「**Optional lässt sich die Überlebenswahrscheinlichkeit aus der gebündelten Destatis-Periodensterbetafel 2023/2025 für Deutschland anzeigen, bedingt auf das aktuelle Alter. Risikokarten verbinden diesen statistischen Kontext mit dem Aufbrauchrisiko. **Die Sterbetafel ist keine individuelle Lebenserwartungsprognose und verändert die Finanzsimulation nicht.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处尤其值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**图上同时出现生存概率与耗尽风险**」**最容易让读者以为**两者在同一模型里耦合**，**而作者**主动说明它们没有**——**⭐ 这与本站第 347 轮「**防误读**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ④ 收益来源的机制被写清**——**逐字**：**① **历史自助法**（**bootstrap**）「**zieht verfügbare Kalenderjahre mit Zurücklegen: Ein Jahr kann mehrfach vorkommen**」**（**有放回抽样，**同一年可出现多次**）**；**② **历史收益与历史通胀**共用同一个被抽中的年份**（**且限于两者的共同数据区间**）**；**③ **合成来源**按给定的收益与波动假设生成**独立路径**，**逐字说明**「**sie verkürzen den historischen Überschneidungszeitraum nicht**」**（**即**合成源不会缩短历史共同区间**）**；**④ **通胀则有一份历史来源与一个固定假设**。**⭐ 本词条认为**第 ② 点最值得抄**：**「**抽中的那一年是同一个**」**这一句**把**收益与通胀的相关性**交代掉了**——**⭐ 而**不写这句话**，**读者无从知道两者是否独立抽样**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 一处**不对称**被主动说明****——**逐字**：**「**Jeder Baustein hat ein Feld für jährliche TER/Kosten. Bei Proxy-/indexähnlichen und synthetischen Quellen wird der eingetragene Kostensatz von der Jahresrendite abgezogen. Bei den gebündelten ETF-Renditequellen gilt die TER bereits als im Kurs berücksichtigt; dort wird auch ein zusätzlich eingetragener Baustein-Kostensatz aktuell **nicht** abgezogen.**」**。**⭐ 即**同一个输入框在不同来源下**行为不同**，**而**这一点被写出来**——**⭐ 这与本站第 335 轮「**不要悄悄降级**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 数据来源的**性质**被限定**——**逐字**：**两份**打包的 ETF 参考**（`IUSQ.DE` iShares MSCI ACWI 与** `EUNM.DE` iShares MSCI EM**）来自**经调整的 Yahoo Finance 欧元 Xetra 报价**，**逐字声明**「**Sie sind keine offiziellen Fonds-NAV- oder offiziellen Total-Return-Reihen und garantieren keine vollständige Abbildung der Gesamtrendite.**」**，**并逐字说明**「**Die App ruft zur Laufzeit keine Marktdaten ab.**」**（**运行时**不抓取行情**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 结果该怎么读被写明**——**逐字**：**图上是**今日购买力的资本**；**含所选来源期望年收益的**计划值**、**中位数 **P50**、**以及 **P10–P90** 区间**；**⭐ 而**「**Aufbrauchwahrscheinlichkeit**」**被逐字定义**为「**der Anteil der Pfade mit Kapital von 0 € oder weniger zum jeweiligen Alter**」**（**某年龄时资本归零或为负的路径占比**）**；**并对**对数坐标**做了说明**（**非正资本放在轴的下缘、**过高的 P90 可为可读性截断、**且不影响 tooltip 与风险卡里的底层数值**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 边界与存储被写明**——**逐字四条**：**不做自动个人税务计算或法定 KV／PV 计算**（**可选一个引导式手工 GKV／PV 估算**）**；**不做任意实时 ETF 搜索或数据导入**；**不做个人化 ETF 回测**；**不做可选的自定义提取策略**；**⭐ 并逐字写明存储**「**Gültige Szenario-Eingaben werden ausschließlich lokal im Browser in `localStorage` gespeichert. Es gibt keine serverseitige Speicherung oder geräteübergreifende Synchronisierung**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 仓库里有两处**很当代**的痕迹（本次实测）**：**① **`AGENTS.md`**——**给 AI 编码代理的规则**，**逐字含**「**Treat the yearly ledger rows as the source of truth for calculations. Summary cards, charts, and tables should derive from the same simulation result instead of recomputing separate business logic.**」**、**「**Keep the model framework-free. Validation, normalization, deterministic simulation, required-capital search, stochastic returns, and mortality helpers belong outside React.**」**、**以及**「**UI code may orchestrate state and rendering, but should not own financial formulas.**」**；**⭐ 即**「**公式不许住进 UI**」**被写成了明文约束**；**② **`docs/insurance-capital-estimator.md`** 开头逐字为**「**PR1: inactive insurance capital-income accounting foundation. Rule verification date: 2026-09-10. This module is not imported by the application, scenario simulator, capital search, bootstrap paths, persistence, or UI. Only tests use it.**」**——**⭐ 即**一个**尚未接入**的模块**被明确标注为**未接入**，**并给出规则核对日期**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 工程形态可数**：`package.json` 逐字为**名称 **rentenlueckenrechner**、**版本 **1.0.0**、**依赖** `@vitejs/plugin-react`、`react`、`react-dom`、`recharts`、`vite`、`zod`**，**脚本** `dev`／`build`／`lint`／`preview`／`test`**，**⚠️ **`license` 字段缺失****；**另有** `eslint.config.js`、**`.github/workflows/pages.yml` 与** `pr.yml`**、**`scripts/generateDestatisLifeTable.mjs` 与** `generateHistoricalReturnData.py`**（**⭐ 后者说明历史收益数据是**脚本生成的**）**；**`AGENTS.md` 并逐字指明回生表来源为** Destatis GENESIS 数据集 `12621-0001`**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[cee-longevity-tables]]、**[[atlas-actuarial]] 属同一大类（**长寿与寿险**）**，**[[pension-pro-mcp]]、**[[openfisca]]、**[[colombian-pension-observatory]] 覆盖养老金计算与观测**，**[[mortalitytables]]、**[[longevity]]、**[[demography]]、**[[hmdhfdplus]] 覆盖生命表工具与数据**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一个面向个人的退休缺口计算器：**把假设逐条写清、**把数据许可与代码许可分开、**并把生命表限定为**只显示**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该应用任何一步**（**未 `npm install`、**未 `npm run build`／`test`／`dev`、**未打开任何界面、**未复算任何一条路径或耗尽概率**），**故**不主张**其任何数值结果**（**⭐ 包括净缺口、**所需资本、**耗尽概率与 P10／P50／P90 区间**）**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何源码正文**——**本次只读** `README.md`、**`package.json`、**`DATA_LICENSES.md`、**`AGENTS.md`、**`docs/insurance-capital-estimator.md` **开头**、**以及 tarball 路径列表**；**未打开** `src/` **下任何 `.ts`／`.tsx`、**两个生成脚本、**两份 workflow、**`docs/gkv-pv-rules-2026.md`，**也**未看**任何测试文件正文**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `AGENTS.md` **中所述「**财务公式不得住在 UI 里**」**在代码里**是否**真的成立**（**⭐ 本词条只核实该文件存在与其**明文规则**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `docs/insurance-capital-estimator.md` **所述「**该模块未被应用、**模拟器、**资本搜索、**bootstrap、**持久化与 UI 引用，**仅测试使用**」**这一说法**——**⭐ 本词条只读该文档开头**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**生命表**的实际来源与结构**（**⭐ `AGENTS.md` 指为 Destatis GENESIS `12621-0001`**，**但**本次**未访问该数据集、**也未读生成的 TS 文件**）**；**也未核实**「**2023/2025**」**这一区间**的具体含义**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实两份 ETF 参考序列的**口径**（**⭐ README 明说它们**不是官方 NAV／总回报序列**，**本词条**只转述**）**；**也未核实** Yahoo Finance **条款**与 `DATA_LICENSES.md` **所述是否一致**。**⑦ ⚠️ **权利状态不正常**：**仓库内没有 `LICENSE` 文件**，**而 `DATA_LICENSES.md` 逐字指向「**the repository’s code license in `LICENSE`, if present**」**；**⭐ 本词条**如实记录这一处不闭合**，**并按惯例记为**权利不明**——⭐ 这**不等于**作者放弃权利**；**⚠️ 复用其代码前须先取得作者许可**；**⚠️ 数据一侧更受限**（**JST 衍生序列**不得商用**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与机构**；**★0**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**本项目**文档质量明显高于其使用规模**，**其价值在**如何把假设与许可写清楚**，**而不在**是否已被人使用****。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核实该计算器与**德国法定养老金规则**（**如 2026 年 GKV／PV 规则**）**的对应关系**（**⭐ `docs/gkv-pv-rules-2026.md` 存在，**但本次未读**）**——**⚠️ 本条**不得**被理解为任何养老金或税务意见**。**⑩ ⚠️ 创建 2026-08-13 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-10 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**一个个人向退休模型：**把时间顺序等假设逐条写出、**把数据许可与代码许可分开并标注不得商用、**并把生命表限定为只显示不进模型**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该应用自己就写着结果不是建议也不是预测**。

**rentenlueckenrechner**（GitHub 倉庫 `MaTeuff-bot/rentenlueckenrechner`，**全文德語**，**逐字標題** `Persönlicher Ruhestandsplaner`**）**是一個**退休缺口計算器****——**README 逐字自述為**「**Der Rentenlückenrechner ist eine Vite/React/TypeScript-App zur vereinfachten Ruhestandsplanung. Er schätzt die Netto-Rentenlücke und das benötigte Kapital zum Rentenbeginn und zeigt Vermögensverläufe, Kennzahlen und eine Jahrestabelle. Die Ergebnisse sind Modellrechnungen, keine Finanzberatung oder Prognosen.**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-13、最後推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**TypeScript**；**tarball 130 條路徑**；**⚠️ 倉庫內**沒有 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 見下**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**母語：同一個專業，用不同語言寫出來**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、`package.json`、`DATA_LICENSES.md`、`AGENTS.md` 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 模型假設逐條寫進 README，**包括時間順序****——**逐字**「**Die jährlichen Buchungszeilen (das Jahresledger) sind die maßgebliche Berechnungsgrundlage. Ansparphase und Ruhestand werden in Jahresschritten simuliert; Kennzahlen, Diagramm und Tabelle leiten sich aus den Simulationsergebnissen ab. Renditen wirken auf das Kapital am Jahresanfang, Einzahlungen und Entnahmen erfolgen am Jahresende.**」**——**⭐ 「**收益作用於年初資本、**存取發生在年末**」**決定了每一年的結果**，**而**很多計算器不寫它****。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 資料許可與代碼許可**分開，**並寫明商業限制****——**`DATA_LICENSES.md` 逐字**「**This repository separates application code licensing from bundled dataset licensing.**」**；**對 JST 宏觀史 R.6 衍生序列逐字給出來源網址、**所用檔案 `JSTdatasetR6.dta`、**許可信號**「**CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**」**、**以及**「**Commercial use: not allowed for this bundled derived dataset.**」**；**⭐ 並逐字給出**可替換性**判斷**「**The calculator treats JST as a replaceable dataset provider. A future commercial version can replace the non-commercial JST-derived snapshots with a commercially licensed or permissively licensed provider without changing the historical bootstrap model.**」**。**⭐ 即**它區分了三件事**：**代碼許可、**資料集許可、**資料源是否可替換****；**⭐ 而本次實測**倉庫內並無 `LICENSE` 文件**，**而該文件逐字寫著代碼「**covered by the repository’s code license in `LICENSE`, if present**」**——**⭐ 本詞條**如實記錄這處不閉合**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 生命表被限定**只用於顯示**，**不進入財務模擬****——**逐字**「**Optional lässt sich die Überlebenswahrscheinlichkeit aus der gebündelten Destatis-Periodensterbetafel 2023/2025 für Deutschland anzeigen, bedingt auf das aktuelle Alter. Risikokarten verbinden diesen statistischen Kontext mit dem Aufbrauchrisiko. Die Sterbetafel ist keine individuelle Lebenserwartungsprognose und verändert die Finanzsimulation nicht.**」**——**⭐ 「**圖上同時出現生存機率與耗盡風險**」**最容易讓人以為兩者耦合**，**而作者**主動說明它們沒有**。**⭐⭐ ④ 收益來源機制寫清**：**歷史自助法**「**zieht verfügbare Kalenderjahre mit Zurücklegen: Ein Jahr kann mehrfach vorkommen**」**；**歷史收益與歷史通脹**共用同一個被抽中的年份**（**限於共同資料區間**）**；**合成來源**生成獨立路徑**且逐字「**sie verkürzen den historischen Überschneidungszeitraum nicht**」**；**通脹另有固定假設**。**⭐ 「**抽中的那一年是同一個**」**把收益與通脹的相關性交代掉了****。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 一處**不對稱**被主動說明****——**逐字**「**Jeder Baustein hat ein Feld für jährliche TER/Kosten. Bei Proxy-/indexähnlichen und synthetischen Quellen wird der eingetragene Kostensatz von der Jahresrendite abgezogen. Bei den gebündelten ETF-Renditequellen gilt die TER bereits als im Kurs berücksichtigt; dort wird auch ein zusätzlich eingetragener Baustein-Kostensatz aktuell nicht abgezogen.**」**——**⭐ 同一個輸入框在不同來源下行為不同，**而這點被寫出來****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 資料來源的**性質**被限定**：`IUSQ.DE`／`EUNM.DE` **兩份打包 ETF 參考來自經調整的 Yahoo Finance 歐元 Xetra 報價**，**逐字**「**Sie sind keine offiziellen Fonds-NAV- oder offiziellen Total-Return-Reihen**」**，**並逐字**「**Die App ruft zur Laufzeit keine Marktdaten ab.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 結果怎麼讀被寫明**：**今日購買力的資本**；**計劃值／**中位數 P50／**P10–P90 區間**；**「**Aufbrauchwahrscheinlichkeit**」**逐字定義為「**der Anteil der Pfade mit Kapital von 0 € oder weniger zum jeweiligen Alter**」**；**並說明對數座標的處理**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 邊界與存儲被寫明**：**不做自動稅務或法定 KV／PV 計算**（**可選手動 GKV／PV 估算**）**、**不做即時 ETF 搜尋或資料匯入**、**不做個人化 ETF 回測**、**不做自訂提取策略**；**逐字**「**Gültige Szenario-Eingaben werden ausschließlich lokal im Browser in `localStorage` gespeichert.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 兩處很當代的痕跡**：**`AGENTS.md`**（**給 AI 編碼代理的規則**，**逐字含** Treat the yearly ledger rows as the source of truth for calculations. Rule verification date: 2026-09-10. This module is not imported by the application, scenario simulator, capital search, bootstrap paths, persistence, or UI. Only tests use it.**」——**⭐ 即**一個**尚未接入**的模組被明確標成未接入**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 工程形態可數**：`package.json` 為**名稱 **rentenlueckenrechner**、**版本 **1.0.0**、**依賴** `@vitejs/plugin-react`、`react`、`react-dom`、`recharts`、`vite`、`zod`**，**腳本** `dev`／`build`／`lint`／`preview`／`test`**，**⚠️ **`license` 欄位缺失****；**另有** `eslint.config.js`、**兩個 workflow（pages／pr）**、**`scripts/generateDestatisLifeTable.mjs` 與** `generateHistoricalReturnData.py`**；**`AGENTS.md` 並指明生命表來源為** Destatis GENESIS `12621-0001`**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 與池內條目的關係**：[[cee-longevity-tables]]、[[atlas-actuarial]]、[[pension-pro-mcp]]、[[openfisca]]、[[colombian-pension-observatory]]、[[mortalitytables]]、[[longevity]]、[[demography]]、[[hmdhfdplus]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**個人向退休缺口計算器：假設逐條寫清＋資料許可與代碼許可分開並標註不得商用＋生命表限定為只顯示**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

The repository rentenlueckenrechner, written entirely in German and titled as a personal retirement planner, **is a retirement-gap calculator built with Vite, React and TypeScript**, described verbatim as estimating the net pension gap and the capital required at the start of retirement while showing wealth trajectories, key figures and an annual table, and stating verbatim that the results are model calculations rather than financial advice or forecasts. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-13**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **zero stars**, primarily TypeScript, **a hundred and thirty paths in the extracted archive**, and **no licence file**, while the bundled data-licence document refers to a code licence file that does not exist. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one profession written in different languages.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the package manifest, the data-licence document, the agent instructions file and the file listing**: **first, the model assumptions are written into the readme one by one, including the ordering in time**: verbatim, the annual ledger rows are the authoritative basis for calculation, the accumulation and retirement phases are simulated in yearly steps, the key figures, chart and table derive from the simulation results, **returns act on capital at the start of the year while contributions and withdrawals occur at the end of the year**. **That sentence determines every year of the projection, and it is exactly the sentence most calculators omit.** **Second, data licensing is separated from code licensing and the commercial restriction is stated**: the data-licence document says verbatim that the repository separates application code licensing from bundled dataset licensing; for the derived return snapshots it gives the source address, the dataset file used, the licence signal as a Creative Commons non-commercial share-alike licence, and the sentence that commercial use is not allowed for the bundled derived dataset; and it adds a replaceability judgement verbatim, that the calculator treats that database as a replaceable dataset provider, so a future commercial version can substitute a commercially licensed provider without changing the historical bootstrap model. **Three things are therefore distinguished: the code licence, the dataset licence, and whether the data source can be swapped. Against that, this entry measured that no licence file exists in the repository while the data-licence document states that the code is covered by one, and records the gap without explaining it away.** **Third, the life table is confined to display and does not enter the financial simulation**: verbatim, the survival probability from a bundled German statutory period life table for 2023 and 2025 can optionally be shown conditioned on current age, risk cards connect that statistical context to depletion risk, and the life table is not an individual life-expectancy forecast and does not change the financial simulation. **Showing survival probability and depletion risk on the same screen most easily suggests that the two are coupled inside one model, and the author states in advance that they are not.** **Fourth, the return-generation mechanics are written out**: the historical bootstrap draws available calendar years **with replacement**, so one year can occur several times; historical return sources and historical inflation share the same drawn year from their common data range; synthetic sources generate separate paths from given return and volatility assumptions under a simplified normal distribution and, verbatim, do not shorten the historical overlap period; and inflation offers one historical source and one fixed assumption. **The sentence that the drawn year is the same one disposes of the correlation question between returns and inflation, which a reader otherwise cannot answer.** **Fifth, an asymmetry is stated rather than hidden**: verbatim, every portfolio building block has an annual cost field, for proxy or index-like and synthetic sources the entered cost rate is subtracted from the annual return, whereas for the bundled exchange-traded-fund return sources the total expense ratio already counts as included in the price and an additionally entered block cost rate is currently not subtracted there. **The same input field therefore behaves differently depending on the source, and that is written down.** **Sixth, the nature of the data is qualified**: the two bundled fund reference profiles are derived from adjusted market prices in euros on a German exchange, with the statement verbatim that they are not official fund net asset value or official total-return series and do not guarantee a complete representation of total return, and that the application fetches no market data at runtime. **Seventh, how to read the results is stated**: capital is shown in today purchasing power, with the plan value using the expected annual return of the selected sources, the median, and a tenth-to-ninetieth percentile band, and the depletion probability is defined verbatim as the share of paths with capital of zero euros or less at each age, together with an explanation of how the logarithmic axis handles non-positive values and why very high upper-band values may be capped for readability without changing the underlying values in tooltips and risk cards. **Eighth, limits and storage are stated**: no automatic personal tax calculation and no statutory health or long-term-care insurance calculation, though an optional guided manual estimate is offered; no arbitrary live fund search or data import; no individual fund backtest; and no selectable personalised withdrawal strategy, with valid scenario inputs stored **only locally in the browser**, with no server-side storage and no cross-device synchronisation. **Ninth, two very contemporary artefacts were measured in the repository**: an agent instructions file for AI coding assistants, stating verbatim that the yearly ledger rows are the source of truth for calculations and that summary cards, charts and tables should derive from the same simulation result instead of recomputing separate business logic, that the model must stay framework-free with validation, normalisation, deterministic simulation, required-capital search, stochastic returns and mortality helpers outside React, and that user-interface code may orchestrate state and rendering but should not own financial formulas; and a documentation file opening with a numbered change note recording that the module is an inactive insurance capital-income accounting foundation with a rule-verification date, that it is not imported by the application, the scenario simulator, the capital search, the bootstrap paths, the persistence layer or the user interface, and that only tests use it. **A module that is not wired in is therefore labelled as not wired in, with the date on which its rules were checked.** **Tenth, the engineering shape is countable**: the manifest gives the name, version 1.0.0, dependencies for React, charting, the build tool and schema validation, and scripts for development, build, lint, preview and test, **with no licence field**; there is a linter configuration, two continuous-integration workflows for pages and pull requests, and two data-generation scripts, one for the life table and one for the historical return series, the agent instructions further naming the statistical office dataset from which the mortality data is generated. **Eleventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover longevity and life-insurance tooling, pension calculation and observation, and life-table tooling and data, **while this entry supplies a personal retirement-gap calculator that writes its assumptions out one by one, separates data licensing from code licensing with an explicit non-commercial flag, and confines the life table to display. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled longevity and life-table entries**; **four practices transfer directly: write out the ordering in time of cash flows, such as returns at the start of the year and contributions and withdrawals at the end; separate data licensing from code licensing and put a non-commercial restriction where it can be seen; say whether a statistic shown on a chart entered the model or not; and document each case where one input field behaves differently depending on the source**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the application was not run at all** — no dependency installation, no build, test or development server, no interface opened and no path or depletion probability recomputed — **so none of its numerical results is claimed, including the net gap, the required capital, the depletion probability and the percentile band**. **Second, no source code was read**: only the readme, the package manifest, the data-licence document, the agent instructions file, the opening of one documentation file and the archive path list were read, and no TypeScript source, no generation script, no workflow and no statutory-rules document was opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the rule that financial formulas must not live in the user interface actually holds in the code was not verified**, only the existence of the rule and its text. **Fourth, the statement that the insurance capital module is imported only by tests was not verified**, only the opening of that document being read. **Fifth, the actual source and structure of the life table were not verified**, since neither the statistical office dataset nor the generated file was inspected, nor was the meaning of the stated two-year range. **Sixth, the conventions behind the two fund reference series were not verified, nor were the market-data provider terms compared against the data-licence document. Seventh, the rights position is abnormal**: no licence file is present, while the data-licence document points to one that would be there if present; **this entry records the gap and marks the rights as unclear, which is not the same as the author waiving rights**, so reuse of the code requires the author permission first, and the data side is more restricted still because the derived series may not be used commercially. **Eighth, the author identity and affiliation were not verified, and this entry notes that the project documentation considerably exceeds its usage, so its value lies in how assumptions and licences are written down rather than in adoption.** **Ninth, the correspondence between this calculator and German statutory pension rules was not verified**, the relevant rules document existing but not being read, **so nothing here may be read as pension or tax advice. Tenth, the creation date of 2026-08-13 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-10 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is a personal retirement model that writes its assumptions out item by item, separates data licensing from code licensing with a non-commercial flag, and confines a life table to display, which had no counterpart in the pool. Eleventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and notes that the application itself states that its results are neither advice nor forecasts.**

entries.summary_en: The repository act3000-a26 **is a public repository for a university risk-theory course** at a Canadian francophone actuarial school, running in the autumn 2026 term, with the instructor and two teaching assistants named. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-18**, **last pushed 2026-09-09**, **zero stars**, primarily R, **thirty-six paths in the extracted archive**, and **no licence file**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one profession written in different languages.** **Three things are worth reading**: computational solutions to past examinations are kept in their own directory, with seventeen R scripts named by year, by whether the paper was a midterm or a final, and by whether the track was the traditional or the computer-based one, spanning 2012 to 2018; three revision guides target three specific techniques, namely allocations, discretisation and the fast Fourier transform; and an inconsistency between the readme directory tree and the actual file listing is recorded — the tree omits the examination directory and lists another directory twice. **No script was run this round.**
entries.body:
**act3000-a26**（GitHub 仓库 `pleblanc0/act3000-a26`，**全文法语**）**是一份**大学风险理论课程的公开仓库****，**README 逐字给出课名与单位**「**ACT-3000 Théorie du risque**」、「**École d’actuariat de l’Université Laval**」、「**Automne 2026**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-18、最后推送 2026-09-09**、**★0**、**主语言 R**；**tarball 36 条路径**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 本词条按惯例记为**权利不明**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**母语：同一个专业，用不同语言写出来**」**。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 历年考卷的**机算解法**被单独放在一个目录里，**且命名把三个维度都编进去了****——**本次实测** `examens/` **下共 **17 个 `.R` 文件****，**逐字为**：`final-info-2012.R`、`final-info-2015.R`、`final-info-2016.R`、`final-info-2017.R`、`final-trad-2012.R`、`final-trad-2015.R`、`final-trad-2016.R`、`final-trad-2017.R`、`partiel-info-2012.R`、`partiel-info-2015.R`、`partiel-info-2016.R`、`partiel-info-2017.R`、`partiel-info-2018.R`、`partiel-trad-2012.R`、`partiel-trad-2015.R`、`partiel-trad-2016.R`、`partiel-trad-2017.R`、`partiel-trad-2018.R`**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 同一个课名**同时有**传统笔算卷**（`trad`）与**机算卷**（`info`）**，**而**机算卷的解法**被**按年份逐份公开**——**⭐ 即**学生看到的不是**「**一份示例**」，**而是**八年里**这门课的机算部分**实际被怎么考、怎么解**；**⭐ 这与本站第 345 轮「**把平时留在内部的东西拿出来**」同向**：**历年解题脚本**通常只留在助教本机**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 三个复习指南各自对准一门技术**——**实测** `revision/` **下逐字为** `guide-allocations.R`、`guide-discretisation.R`、`guide-fft.R`。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组文件名本身就是一条信息**：**风险理论里**聚合损失的数值计算**通常绕不开三件事**——**分配方法（**allocations**）**、**离散化（**discretisation**）**与**快速傅里叶变换（**FFT**）**——**⭐ 即**它把「**这一章的难点**」**写成了**三个可执行文件**，**而不是**一句「**见教材第几章**」。**⭐⭐ ③ 课程运转被逐条列出**——**README 逐字给出**：**教师为** Etienne Marceau（**professeur titulaire，**École d’actuariat**）**；**两名助教为** Philippe Leblanc **与** Omar Essakine**；**目录职责逐字为** `ateliers/`（**séances de dépannage 的材料**）、`exercices/`（**历年考试与部分课后题的机算解法**）、`ressources/`（**补充阅读与参考**）、`revision/`（**复习关键概念的文件与工具**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**ateliers = 答疑场次材料**」**这一条值得记**：**⭐ 即**它区分了**讲课**、**答疑**与**复习**三条不同的线**。**⭐⭐ ④ 实测到两处**README 与文件清单不一致**（本词条如实记录、**不替它调和**）**：**① **README 的目录树里**没有 `examens/`**，**而**实测该目录存在并含 17 个文件**；**② **README 的目录树**把 `exercices/` 写了两遍**（**一行写「**历年考试的机算解法**」、**另一行写「**部分课后题的机算解法**」**）**——**⭐ 即**目录树里**少了一个目录、**多了一行重复**，**而**实际结构**正好相反**（**examens／exercices 两个目录都存在**）**。**⭐ 这与本站第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」、第 352 轮「**登记与出处**」同向**：**文档描述的结构**与**仓库实际结构**是两件事**，**而**核对它们**只需要一份文件清单**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 交作业之外的东西也可数**：**`ateliers/codes/ateliers-partie-1.R`**（**答疑课第一部分代码**）**与** `ateliers/diapos/atelier-1.pdf`、`atelier-2.pdf`**（**两次答疑的幻灯片**）**；**`exercices/exercices-chapitre-1.R` 至** `-3.R`**（**前三章课后题**）**；**⭐ 实测全仓 **36 条路径****、**tarball 约 **1.5 MB****（**⭐ 其中大部分是两份 PDF**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 仓库形态（如实记录）**：**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`、**无测试、**无 CI、**无依赖清单**（**⭐ 即**要跑这些 `.R` 需**自备环境**）**；**⚠️ README 里**教师邮箱与办公时间**仍是占位符**——**逐字为**「**Courriel : [adresse à compléter]**」**与**「**Heures de bureau : [horaire à compléter]**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**这份 README **并未写完**，**而**它同时**写着完整的课程结构**；**⭐ 本词条**如实记录而不推测原因****。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[cran-actuarial-task-view]] 覆盖 R 生态的精算任务视图**，**[[r-for-actuaries-2026]]、**[[cas-python-workshop]]、**[[pe-pricing-analytics]]、**[[actuarial-python-lab]]、**[[insurance-pricing-course]]、**[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]] **act3000-a26**（GitHub 倉庫 `pleblanc0/act3000-a26`，**全文法語**）**是一份**大學風險理論課程的公開倉庫****，**README 逐字給出課名與單位**「**ACT-3000 Théorie du risque**」、「**École d’actuariat de l’Université Laval**」、「**Automne 2026**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-18、最後推送 2026-09-09**、**★0**、**R**；**tarball 36 條路徑**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**（**按慣例記為**權利不明**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**母語：同一個專業，用不同語言寫出來**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 README 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 歷年考卷的**機算解法**單獨放在一個目錄裡，**命名把三個維度都編進去****——**實測** `examens/` **下共 **17 個 `.R`****：`final-info-2012/2015/2016/2017.R`、`final-trad-2012/2015/2016/2017.R`、`partiel-info-2012/2015/2016/2017/2018.R`、`partiel-trad-2012/2015/2016/2017/2018.R`**。**⭐ 即**同一門課**同時有**傳統筆算卷**（`trad`）與**機算卷**（`info`）**，**而**機算卷的解法**按年份逐份公開**——**⭐ 學生看到的不是**「**一份示例**」，**而是**八年裡這門課的機算部分**實際被怎麼考、怎麼解**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 三個複習指南各自對準一門技術**——`revision/` **下逐字為** `guide-allocations.R`、`guide-discretisation.R`、`guide-fft.R`**——**⭐ 風險理論裡**聚合損失的數值計算**通常繞不開**分配方法、**離散化與**快速傅里葉變換**——**⭐ 即**把「**這一章的難點**」**寫成**三個可執行檔案**。**⭐⭐ ③ 課程運轉被逐條列出**：**教師** Etienne Marceau（professeur titulaire）、**兩名助教** Philippe Leblanc 與 Omar Essakine**；**目錄職責逐字為** `ateliers/`（**答疑場次材料**）、`exercices/`（**歷年考試與部分課後題的機算解法**）、`ressources/`（**補充閱讀**）、`revision/`（**複習關鍵概念的文件與工具**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 實測到兩處**README 與文件清單不一致****：**README 目錄樹**沒有 `examens/`**，**而實測該目錄存在並含 17 個檔案**；**而且**目錄樹把 `exercices/` 寫了兩遍****。**⭐ 即**目錄樹**少了一個目錄、**多了一行重複**，**而**實際結構**正好相反**；**⭐⭐ ⑤ 其他可數**：`ateliers/codes/ateliers-partie-1.R`、`ateliers/diapos/atelier-1.pdf` 與 `atelier-2.pdf`、`exercices/exercices-chapitre-1.R` 至 `-3.R`**；**全倉 **36 條路徑****、**tarball 約 **1.5 MB**（**多為兩份 PDF****）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 倉庫形態**：**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`、**無測試、**無 CI、**無依賴清單**；**⚠️ README 裡**教師郵箱與辦公時間仍是佔位符**（**逐字** Courriel : [adresse à compléter] **與** Heures de bureau : [horaire à compléter]**）——**⭐ 即**這份 README **並未寫完**，**而**它同時**寫著完整的課程結構**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[cran-actuarial-task-view]]、[[r-for-actuaries-2026]]、[[cas-python-workshop]]、[[pe-pricing-analytics]]、[[actuarial-python-lab]]、[[insurance-pricing-course]]、[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]]、[[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[open-exam-prep]]、[[asm-fm-formula-trainer]]、[[soa-practice-tools]]、[[actuarial-math-bench]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**大學風險理論課：歷年考卷機算解法按年份與卷別公開＋把複習難點做成三個指南檔案**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[cran-actuarial-task-view]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 三點最值得借鑑**：**① 歷年**機算解法**公開**比一份示例更有用**；**② 把一章的難點**做成可執行檔案**；**③ 寫目錄樹時**要與實際結構核對****。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行該專案任何一步**（**未裝 R、**未執行 `examens/` 與 `revision/` 下任何腳本、**未打開任何 PDF**），**不主張**任何腳本可運行、**不主張**其解法正確**、**也不主張**這些腳本與歷年考試題面對應**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何原始碼正文**——**只讀** `README.md` **與 tarball 路徑列表**；**未打開** `examens/` 下 17 個 `.R`、**`exercices/` 三個、**`revision/` 三個、**`ateliers/codes/ateliers-partie-1.R`，**亦未看**兩份答疑 PDF**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實這些 `.R` 是否真的對應檔名裡的年份與卷別****（**只核實**檔名與目錄結構**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實課程**是否含講義或考綱**（**實測目錄中**未見講義**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實該課程與**拉瓦爾大學精算學院官方課程頁面**是否一致**（**未訪問任何大學網站**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實教師與助教身份**（**只轉述 README 署名**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **權利不明**：**未見 `LICENSE`、**README 未逐字給出許可條款****（**⭐ **這不等於**作者放棄權利**）**；**⚠️ 課程材料與歷年考卷**通常另有歸屬**（**課程與學校**）**，**複用前須先取得授權**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核實該倉庫**是否為課程官方倉庫**還是助教個人整理**；**★0、**無 CI、**無測試**。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核實 README 中佔位符為何未填**（**本詞條不推測**）**。**⑩ ⚠️ 建立 2026-08-18 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「大學風險理論課公開倉庫：歷年考卷機算解法按年份與卷別公開＋複習難點做成指南檔案＋README 與文件清單的不一致被如實記錄」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該倉庫是**教學材料**，**不得**當作任何考試或專業結論的依據**。
entries.body_en:
The repository act3000-a26, written entirely in French, **is a public repository for a university risk-theory course**, titled with a course code and the phrase for risk theory, attributed to the actuarial school of a Canadian francophone university, running in the autumn 2026 term. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-18**, **last pushed 2026-09-09**, **zero stars**, primarily R, **thirty-six paths in the extracted archive**, and **no licence file**, which this entry records as unclear rights. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one profession written in different languages.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, computational solutions to past examinations are kept in a directory of their own and the file names encode three dimensions at once**: seventeen R scripts were measured, named by year, by whether the paper was a midterm or a final examination, and by whether the track was the traditional written one or the computer-based one, spanning 2012 to 2018, with several years represented in both tracks and both paper types. **The same course therefore has both a traditional and a computer-based paper, and the computational solutions of the computer-based papers are published year by year, so what a student sees is not one worked example but eight years of how this part of the course was actually examined and solved.** **Second, three revision guides each target one technique**: measured verbatim as a guide on allocations, a guide on discretisation and a guide on the fast Fourier transform. **Those file names are themselves information: numerical computation of aggregate losses in risk theory tends to run through allocation methods, discretisation and the fast Fourier transform, and the repository turns the difficulty of that chapter into three runnable files rather than a pointer to a textbook chapter.** **Third, how the course runs is itemised**: the instructor is named as a full professor at the actuarial school and two teaching assistants are named, and the directory responsibilities are given verbatim as materials for help sessions, computational solutions to past examinations and some exercises, supplementary readings and references, and documents and tools for revising key concepts. **Distinguishing lecture materials, help sessions and revision material as three separate lines is worth noting.** **Fourth, two inconsistencies between the readme and the file listing were measured and are recorded here without being reconciled**: the readme directory tree does not mention the examination directory, which nonetheless exists with seventeen files in it, and the tree lists the exercise directory twice with two different descriptions, even though both the examination and the exercise directories actually exist. **A documented structure and an actual structure are two different things, and checking them takes nothing more than a file listing.** **Fifth, what else is countable**: help-session code for the first session, two sets of help-session slides as PDFs, and exercise scripts for the first three chapters, with thirty-six paths and an archive of about one and a half megabytes, most of which is the two PDFs. **Sixth, the repository shape, recorded plainly**: **no licence, no tests, no continuous integration and no dependency list**, so running these scripts requires assembling the environment yourself; and the readme still contains placeholders for the instructor email address and office hours, verbatim as an address to be completed and a schedule to be completed. **That the readme was never finished while it nonetheless documents the full course structure is recorded here without speculation as to why.** **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the R actuarial task view, various courses and workshops, and examination banks and practice tools, **while this entry supplies a university risk-theory course repository that publishes the computational solutions of past examinations by year and paper type, turns revision difficulties into guide files, and whose readme disagrees with its own file listing. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled examination database and the pooled R actuarial task view**; **three practices transfer directly: publishing years of computational solutions is more useful than one worked example, turning a chapter difficulty into runnable files helps more than a pointer, and a directory tree should be checked against the actual structure, which is exactly how the two inconsistencies here were found**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no R installed, no script under the examination or revision directories executed and no PDF opened — **so this entry does not claim that any script runs, that any solution is correct, or that these scripts correspond to the examination papers whose years they carry**. **Second, no source code was read**: only the readme and the archive path list were read, and no examination script, exercise script, revision guide, help-session script or PDF was opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the scripts actually correspond to the years and paper types in their file names was not verified**, only the file names and directory structure being checked. **Fourth, whether the course includes lecture notes or a syllabus was not verified**, no such file appearing in the measured listing, though this entry does not rule out their being elsewhere. **Fifth, the course was not compared against the university official course page**, no university website having been visited. **Sixth, the instructor and assistant identities were not verified**, only the readme attribution being relayed. **Seventh, the rights position is unclear**: no licence file is present and the readme gives no licence terms verbatim, **which is not the same as the author waiving rights**, and course materials and past examination papers usually belong to someone else — the course and the institution — so reuse requires permission first. **Eighth, whether this is the official course repository or a teaching assistant personal collection was not verified**, the readme not saying; the repository has zero stars, no continuous integration and no tests. **Ninth, why the placeholders in the readme were never filled in was not verified, and this entry does not speculate. Tenth, the creation date of 2026-08-18 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-09 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is a public university risk-theory course repository that publishes past-examination computational solutions by year and paper type, turns revision difficulties into guide files, and whose readme disagrees with its own file listing, which had no counterpart in the pool. Eleventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the repository is teaching material and must not be treated as the basis for any examination or professional conclusion.**

entries.title: **日语车险查定实操课：把**四种性质不同的数据**放在同一个地方对撞**：仓库 `sfc-gh-kdaigo/insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson`——**⭐ 一句核心判断**：**「**価格マスタとの突合だけでは架空計上は見抜けず、画像分析だけでは単価の妥当性は判断できません**」**；**⭐ 而**记分规则被逐条写死****（**图像不一致 30 分／**单价超 15% 25 分／**工时指数超 30% 25 分／**零件号不在主数据 15 分**）**；**⭐ 五个案件给出了**判定与分数**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**、**★0**
entries.title_en: A Japanese-language hands-on for non-life insurance claims adjustment that matches four kinds of differently shaped data in one place, with a written scoring rule for each fraud pattern, per-case verdicts and scores for five demonstration claims, and a stated reason why price-master matching alone cannot detect fabricated line items and image analysis alone cannot judge whether a unit price is reasonable.
entries.title_hk: **日語車險查定實操課：把**四種性質不同的資料**放在同一個地方對撞**：倉庫 `sfc-gh-kdaigo/insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson`——**⭐ 一句核心判斷**：**「**価格マスタとの突合だけでは架空計上は見抜けず、画像分析だけでは単価の妥当性は判断できません**」**；**⭐ 而**記分規則被逐條寫死****（**圖像不一致 30 分／**單價超 15% 25 分／**工時指數超 30% 25 分／**零件號不在主數據 15 分**）**；**⭐ 五個案件給出了**判定與分數**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**、**★0**
entries.summary: **claims-adjustment-cortex-handson**（`sfc-gh-kdaigo/insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson`，**日语**）**是一份**车险损害查定（協定業務）的 AI 实操课材料****——**逐字自述题材为**「**自動車事故の損害査定と修理見積の不正検知**」**，**并逐字点出方法上的关键**「**事故車の画像、修理工場から届く見積書PDF、部品定価・標準作業指数のリファレンスマスタ、そして保険約款という性質の異なる4種類のデータを1つのプラットフォーム上で突き合わせ**」**。**本次实测**：**创建与最后推送同为 2026-09-07**、**★0**、**主语言 Jupyter Notebook**；**tarball 28 条路径**（**5 张事故车图 ＋ **5 张参考图 ＋ **1 份约款 PDF ＋ **3 份估价单 PDF ＋ **两个 SQL 安装脚本 ＋ **一个 notebook 与两个 SQL**）**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**母语：同一个专业，用不同语言写出来**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **逐条写明「**哪种手口需要哪种数据**」**，**并给出**记分规则**；**② **五个案件**给出判定与分数**（**含一个总分 0 但需要**重拍照片**的案件**）**；**③ **实测耗时**逐段列出**（**SMALL 仓库下从零到全部跑完约 3 分半**）**。**⚠️ 全部数据自述为虚构。
entries.summary_hk: **claims-adjustment-cortex-handson**（`sfc-gh-kdaigo/insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson`，**日語**）**是一份**車險損害查定（協定業務）的 AI 實操課材料****——**逐字自述題材為**「**自動車事故の損害査定と修理見積の不正検知**」**，**並逐字點出方法關鍵**「**事故車の画像、修理工場から届く見積書PDF、部品定価・標準作業指数のリファレンスマスタ、そして保険約款という性質の異なる4種類のデータを1つのプラットフォーム上で突き合わせ**」**。**本次實測**：**建立與最後推送同為 2026-09-07**、**★0**、**Jupyter Notebook**；**tarball 28 條路徑**（**5 張事故車圖 ＋** 5 張參考圖 ＋** 1 份約款 PDF ＋** 3 份估價單 PDF ＋** 兩個 SQL 安裝腳本 ＋** 一個 notebook 與兩個 SQL**）**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**母語：同一個專業，用不同語言寫出來**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **逐條寫明「**哪種手口需要哪種資料**」**，**並給出**記分規則**；**② **五個案件**給出判定與分數**（**含一個總分 0 但需要**重拍照片**的案件**）**；**③ **實測耗時**逐段列出**（**SMALL 倉庫下從零到全部跑完約 3 分半**）**。**⚠️ 全部資料自述為虛構。
entries.summary_en: The repository insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson, written in Japanese, **is a hands-on exercise for artificial-intelligence-assisted motor insurance damage assessment and repair-estimate fraud detection**, described verbatim as matching four kinds of differently shaped data — accident vehicle images, repair shop estimate PDFs, reference masters of part prices and standard labour indices, and policy wording — on a single platform, and demonstrating how cases an adjuster should look at are surfaced mechanically. **Measured this round**: **created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-07**, **zero stars**, primarily a Jupyter notebook, **twenty-eight paths in the extracted archive** with five accident images, five reference images, one policy wording PDF, three estimate PDFs, two setup scripts, one notebook and two further SQL files, and **no licence file**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one profession written in different languages.** **Three things are worth reading**: it states pattern by pattern which fraud technique requires which data, and it writes the scoring rule down for each; it gives a verdict and a score for each of five demonstration cases, including one with a total score of zero that nonetheless needs the photographs retaken; and it lists measured runtimes step by step, with the whole exercise taking about three and a half minutes from a standing start on a small warehouse. **All data is stated to be fictional.**
entries.body:
**insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson**（GitHub 仓库 `sfc-gh-kdaigo/insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson`，**全文日语**）**是一份**车险损害查定与修理估价舞弊检测的 AI 实操材料****——**README 逐字自述题材为**「**自動車事故の損害査定と修理見積の不正検知**」**，**并逐字写明方法**「**事故車の画像、修理工場から届く見積書PDF、部品定価・標準作業指数のリファレンスマスタ、そして保険約款という性質の異なる4種類のデータを1つのプラットフォーム上で突き合わせ、アジャスターが見るべき案件を機械的に浮かび上がらせるまでを体験します。**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-07、最后推送 2026-09-07**、**★0**、**主语言 Jupyter Notebook**；**tarball 28 条路径**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 本词条按惯例记为**权利不明**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**母语：同一个专业，用不同语言写出来**」**。

**⭐ 引号约定**：**本条目所引 SQL 中原为 ASCII 单引号者一律写作**弯引号**（**U+2018 与 U+2019**）（**如** `‘ANY_REGION’` 与 `‘SNOWFLAKE_SSE’`**）**，**以便与条目自身的引号区分**。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 核心判断是一句：**每种手口需要的数据不同****——**逐字**：**「**厄介なのは、不正の手口ごとに検出に必要なデータが違うという点です。**」**，**并逐条列出四组**：**① **零件单价虚报** → **估价明细 ＋**零件定价主数据**；**② **工时指数虚报** → **估价明细 ＋**标准工时指数主数据**；**③ **虚假列项（**把没坏的地方也写上**）** → **估价明细 ＋**事故车图像**；**④ **型号不符的零件** → **估价明细 ＋**按型号的零件主数据**；**⭐ 随后逐字给出结论**：**「**価格マスタとの突合だけでは架空計上は見抜けず、画像分析だけでは単価の妥当性は判断できません。画像・PDF・マスタを同じ場所で突き合わせられることが、この検知を成立させています。**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**一个检测器对应一种手口、**一种手口需要一组特定数据**」**被写成了一张**四行表**——**⭐ 而**结论句**说明**为什么这四类数据必须**在同一处**能对上**（**⭐ 只对价格主数据**看不出虚假列项，**只看图像**判断不了单价**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 343 轮「**四个维度**」、第 337 轮「**没有任何东西站在单一来源上**」同向**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 记分规则被**逐条写死，**而不是**留给模型自由发挥****——**本次实测的 README 逐字给出四项**：**① **图像一致性**——**图像上无法确认损伤的部位被列项**，**每件 30 分**；**② **零件单价**——**估价单价 > 定价 × 1.15**，**每件 25 分**；**③ **工时指数**——**估价指数 > 标准指数 × 1.30**，**每件 25 分**；**④ **零件编号**——**主数据中不存在**，**每件 15 分**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处尤其值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**要用 AI 挑出要人工看的案件**」**这件事**被拆成**四个可核的阈值**——**⭐ 而**阈值本身**写在文档里**（1.15 倍与 1.30 倍）**，**不是**藏在提示词里**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 五个案件给出**判定、**分数与依据****——**实测 README 逐字列出**：**CLM-2024-0003（**ノート E13**）**要精査 **75 分**，**依据逐字为**「**画像の損傷は「左」ヘッドランプだが「右」を計上／マスタ未登録の部品番号**」**；**CLM-2024-0005（**ヤリスクロス**）**要精査 **55 分**，**依据为**「**左フロントフェンダ板金 指数9.5 vs 標準3.8（+150%）**」**；**CLM-2024-0004（**N-BOX JF5**）**要確認 **25 分**，**依据为**「**リヤバンパフェイス 46,800円 vs 定価 37,400円（+25%）**」**；**CLM-2024-0002（**アルファード**）**問題なし **0 分**；**⭐ CLM-2024-0001（**プリウス**）**問題なし **0 分****，**但理由栏逐字为**「**提出画像に損傷が写っておらず申告内容と不一致（再撮影対象）**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为最后这一条最值得记**：**⭐ 即**总分为 0 的案件**并没有被当成「**没事**」**——**它被标为**需要重拍照片**——**⭐ 这与本站第 341 轮「**三种缺席**」、第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**：**分数为 0 与**无需处理**是两件事**。**⭐⭐ ④ 四类数据被放在**同一库的四个层**里，**且层与层之间的动作被命名****——**实测目录结构逐字为**：`INSURANCE_CLAIMS_DB` **下** `INTEGRATIONS`（**Git 集成**）、**`REPAIR_REFERENCE`**（**VEHICLES 5 件、**PARTS 33 件、**LABOR_INDEX 54 件、**LABOR_RATES 12 件**）、**`RAW`**（**CLM_CLAIMS 5 件、**CLM_IMAGES 10 件、**CLM_REPAIR_SHOPS 5 件、**CLM_ESTIMATES_RAW 3 件、**CLAIM_IMAGES_STAGE、**DOCS_STAGE**）、**`STAGING`**（**PARTS_MASTER 合并零件与指数、**DAMAGE_ASSESSMENT 图像 AI 原始结果、**ESTIMATE_DETAILS 估价明细、**YAKKAN_PARSED 约款解析、**YAKKAN_CHUNKS 约款分块**）、**`ANALYTICS`**（**DT_DAMAGE_ASSESSMENT 一行一部位、**DT_PRICE_ANOMALY 主数据核对结果、**DT_IMAGE_CONSISTENCY 图像一致性、**DT_FRAUD_RISK_SCORE 案件风险分、**DT_SHOP_PERFORMANCE 工场别实绩**）、**`APP`**（**YAKKAN_SEARCH_SVC 约款检索、**SV_CLAIMS 案件查询、**SV_FRAUD 舞弊分析、**CLAIMS_ADJUSTER_AGENT 协定业务助手**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**分层的名字本身就是一份说明书**：**主数据**、**原样数据**、**中间层**、**分析层**、**应用层**——**⭐ 即**「**原始数据不许直接进模型**」**被结构表达出来**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 用到的能力被列成表，**每项都写了用在哪****——**实测 README 逐字列出**：**FILE 类型与 `TO_FILE()`**（**在 notebook 单元格里直接显示stage 上的图像，**并把同一对象交给 AI**）、**`AI_COMPLETE`（**Vision**）**（**从事故车图像判定损伤部位、**程度与修法**）、**`response_format`**（**把输出固定为 OBJECT 型，**免去自由文本解析**）、**`AI_EXTRACT`**（**把估价单 PDF 的明细表结构化为一行一明细**）、**`AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT`**（**保留版式地文本化约款 PDF**）、**`SPLIT_TEXT_RECURSIVE_CHARACTER`**（**按条文近似分块**）、**Cortex Search**（**日语约款向量检索，**逐字给出用 `voyage-multilingual-2`**）、**Semantic View**（**自然语言生成 SQL**）、**Cortex Agent**（**跨结构化与非结构化数据的编排**）、**Dynamic Tables**（**把核对逻辑声明式地定义**）。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**把核对逻辑写成声明式的 Dynamic Table**」**这一条值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**什么算不一致**」**可以被**重新计算**，**而不必**每次跑一遍脚本**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 实测耗时逐段列出，**且区分「**跑」与「**讲」****——**实测 README 逐字给出**：**`git_setup.sql` 21 秒（**含讲解约 5 分**）、**`setup.sql` 46 秒（**约 10 分**）、**`src/01_ai_functions.ipynb` 63 秒（**约 40 分**）、**`src/02_cortex_search.sql` 46 秒（**约 15 分**）、**`src/03_cortex_agent.sql` 15 秒（**约 25 分**）**；**⭐ 并逐字说明**「**実行時間は SMALL ウェアハウスでの実測値です（ゼロ状態から通しで約3分半）**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**跑一遍要多久**」与「**讲一遍要多久**」**是两列**——**⭐ 这直接决定**这材料能否在一节课里讲完**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 环境前提被列成表，**且说明**为什么不需要本地上传****——**逐字**：**Snowflake 试用账号即可**、**角色 **`ACCOUNTADMIN`**、**区域任意**（**跨区推理在 `setup.sql` 里开启**）、**只需浏览器**（**不需要 SnowSQL 或 CLI**）**；**⭐ 并逐字说明**「**ファイルは Git 連携経由で Snowflake に取り込むため、参加者側での `PUT` 作業は発生しません**」**。**⭐ 即**把「**你不需要装什么**」**也写出来了**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 故障排查一节把**症状与原因**对应起来**——**实测逐字含**：**`COPY FILES` 不复制文件 → **未执行** `ALTER GIT REPOSITORY ... FETCH`**；**stage 上文件不可见／`DIRECTORY()` 为空 → **需要** `ALTER STAGE ... REFRESH`，**并逐字说明**「**Directory Table は自動更新されません**」；**`TO_FILE()` 图像不显示 → **检查 stage 是否用** `ENCRYPTION = (TYPE = ‘SNOWFLAKE_SSE’)`（**客户端加密的 stage 读不了 FILE 型**）、**须在 notebook 或 worksheet 结果网格里执行**、**并逐字指出**「**`BUILD_SCOPED_FILE_URL()` はURL文字列を返すだけで画像は表示されません**」；**`AI_COMPLETE` 报 Model is unavailable → **需** `ALTER ACCOUNT SET CORTEX_ENABLED_CROSS_REGION = ‘ANY_REGION’`，**或**把模型从 `claude-sonnet-4-5` 换成** `pixtral-large`／`claude-4-sonnet`／`llama4-maverick`**；**`PROMPT()` 报「**第 1 参数必须是常量**」→ **改用占位符传列**；**日语列别名报语法错 → **别名要用双引号包起来**；**`AI_EXTRACT` 抽取值串到邻列 → （**README 该条在本次取回内容中未完整**，**⭐ 本词条不替它补全**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一节值得抄的地方是**它把「**看起来像平台坏了**」的几种情况**逐条归因**——**⭐ 与本站第 356 轮那条「**看起来像 Alpaca 在等重试**」是同一类写作**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 语言细节被当成问题写出来**——**逐字**「**日本語のカラム別名で構文エラーになる → `AS 見積額` のように日本語の別名を使う場合はダブルクォートで囲んでください**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处与**本轮主题**直接相关**：**⭐ 即**「**用日语做数据工程**」**会碰到**自己的语言带来的语法坑**——**⭐ 而它被写进了排查清单**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 数据性质与文件清单（实测）**——**逐字**：**「**データは全て架空のデモ用データです。実在の人物・企業・団体とは一切関係ありません。同梱の約款PDFもハンズオン用に作成した架空の約款です。**」**；**实测路径为** `data/images/claims/CLM-2024-0001_accident.jpg` **至** `-0005` **共 5 张**、**`data/images/reference/CLM-2024-0001_reference.jpg` 至** `-0005` **共 5 张**、**`data/pdf/auto_insurance_yakkan.pdf`**、**以及** `estimate_CLM-2024-0003.pdf`／`-0004.pdf`／`-0005.pdf` **三份**——**⭐ 即**五件案件里**只有三件附估价单**，**与 README 里** `CLM_ESTIMATES_RAW 見積書PDFメタ 3件` **一致**（**⭐ 本词条只并列这两个数，**不推测为何另两件没有**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[clausegraph]]、**[[medical-opinion-extractor]]、**[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]] 覆盖条款与单据解析**，**[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]]、**[[databricks-smart-claims]]、**[[aws-insurance-underwriting-genai]]、**[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]] 覆盖理赔与云上保险平台**，**[[parsr]] 一类条目覆盖文档抽取**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**四种性质不同的数据（**图像／**估价单 PDF／**主数据／**约款**）在同一处对撞 ＋**把每种手口的记分规则写死 ＋**把 AI 定位成**挑出要人工看的案件**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。**

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[clausegraph]]、[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的四点**：**① **数据种类与手口对应**——**检测能力由**能对撞哪些数据**决定，**而不是**由模型大小决定**；**② **记分阈值写明**（**1.15 倍、**1.30 倍**）**，**而**不是藏在提示词里**；**③ **分数为 0 ≠ 无需处理**（**该重拍照片就要写出来**）**；**④ **把「**跑一遍多久／讲一遍多久**」分成两列**。

entries.body_en:
The repository insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson, written entirely in Japanese, **is a hands-on exercise for artificial-intelligence-assisted motor insurance damage assessment and repair-estimate fraud detection**, described verbatim as matching four kinds of differently shaped data — accident vehicle images, repair shop estimate PDFs, reference masters of part prices and standard labour indices, and policy wording — on a single platform, and demonstrating how cases an adjuster should look at are surfaced mechanically. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-07**, **last pushed 2026-09-07**, **zero stars**, primarily a Jupyter notebook, **twenty-eight paths in the extracted archive**, and **no licence file**, which this entry records as unclear rights. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one profession written in different languages.**

**Quotation convention**: SQL literals that were written with ASCII single quotes are reproduced here with typographic single quotes, for instance the cross-region setting value, so that they are distinguishable from the quotation marks of this entry itself.

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, the central judgement is one sentence: each fraud technique needs different data**: verbatim, the awkward part is that the data required for detection differs by technique, followed by a four-row table in which inflated part unit prices need the estimate lines plus the part price master, inflated labour indices need the estimate lines plus the standard labour index master, fabricated line items for undamaged parts need the estimate lines plus the accident vehicle images, and wrong-model parts need the estimate lines plus the model-specific parts master; the conclusion is then stated verbatim, that matching against the price master alone cannot see through a fabricated line item and image analysis alone cannot judge whether a unit price is reasonable, and that being able to match images, PDFs and masters in the same place is what makes the detection possible. **One detector per technique, and each technique needing its own specific data, is written down as a four-row table, and the closing sentence explains why those four kinds of data must be matchable in one place.** **Second, the scoring rules are written down rather than left to the model**: four checks with points each — image consistency, where a part whose damage cannot be confirmed in the image is billed, at thirty points per item; part unit price, where the estimated price exceeds the list price by more than fifteen percent, at twenty-five points per item; labour index, where the estimated index exceeds the standard index by more than thirty percent, at twenty-five points per item; and part number, where the number does not exist in the master, at fifteen points per item. **Turning detection into a few checkable thresholds whose values are written in the documentation rather than buried in a prompt is the point worth copying.** **Third, five cases receive a verdict, a score and a stated basis**: one case scores seventy-five and is marked for close review on the grounds that the image shows damage to the left headlamp while the right one was billed and that a part number is absent from the master; a second scores fifty-five and is marked for close review because a panel labour index of nine point five against a standard three point eight is a hundred and fifty percent above standard; a third scores twenty-five and is marked for confirmation because a rear bumper fascia was estimated at forty-six thousand eight hundred yen against a list price of thirty-seven thousand four hundred, twenty-five percent above; and two cases score zero with no problem found. **The last of those carries a stated reason that the submitted photograph shows no damage and does not match the declaration, and is therefore marked as needing to be re-photographed: a zero score is not the same as requiring no action.** **Fourth, the four kinds of data sit in four named layers of one database**, with an integrations layer, a repair reference layer containing five vehicles, thirty-three parts, fifty-four labour indices and twelve labour rates, a raw layer holding the claims, images, repair shops, estimate metadata and two staging areas, a staging layer joining parts with indices and holding image analysis output, structured estimate lines and parsed and chunked policy text, an analytics layer with one row per damaged part, master-matching results, image consistency checks, a per-case risk score and per-shop performance, and an application layer with policy search, a claims semantic view, a fraud semantic view and an adjuster assistant. **The layer names are themselves documentation, and the separation expresses the rule that raw data must not go straight into a model.** **Fifth, the platform capabilities used are listed with where each is used**: a file type and its display function so an image on a stage can be shown inside a notebook cell and passed on as the same object, a vision completion function that judges damaged parts and repair methods from accident photographs, a response-format setting that fixes output to a structured object and removes free-text parsing, a table extraction function that turns an estimate PDF into one row per line item, a layout-preserving document parser for policy wording, a recursive text splitter, a Japanese-language vector search with the embedding model named verbatim, a semantic view for natural-language SQL, an agent for orchestration across structured and unstructured data, and dynamic tables that define the matching logic declaratively. **Defining the matching logic as a declarative dynamic table is worth noting separately, because what counts as inconsistent can then be recomputed rather than re-scripted.** **Sixth, the measured runtimes are listed step by step and separated from teaching time**: twenty-one seconds for the Git setup, forty-six for environment setup, sixty-three for the notebook, forty-six for the search step and fifteen for the agent step, with the readme stating verbatim that the times are measured on a small warehouse and that the whole run takes about three and a half minutes from a standing start, while the accompanying explanation time is given as roughly five, ten, forty, fifteen and twenty-five minutes. **How long it takes to run and how long it takes to teach are two different columns, and that directly determines whether the material fits in one class.** **Seventh, the prerequisites are tabulated and it is stated why no local upload is needed**: a trial account suffices, the account administrator role is required, any region works because cross-region inference is enabled by the setup script, and only a browser is needed, with the readme stating verbatim that files are imported through Git integration so participants never have to run an upload command. **What you do not need to install is stated as well.** **Eighth, the troubleshooting section maps symptoms to causes**: files not being copied means the fetch step was not run; an empty directory listing needs a stage refresh, with the readme stating verbatim that the directory table does not update automatically; an image not displaying requires the stage to use server-side encryption because a client-side encrypted stage cannot read the file type, requires execution in a notebook or result grid, and is accompanied by the note that the URL-building function returns only a URL string and does not display the image; a model-unavailable error requires enabling cross-region inference at the account level or switching to one of three named alternative models; a prompt function error means the first argument must be constant and columns must be passed as placeholders; and a syntax error with a Japanese column alias means the alias must be quoted. **Attributing the failures that look like a broken platform is the same kind of writing as describing a failure that looks like a tool waiting out its retries.** **Ninth, a language detail is treated as a problem worth documenting**: Japanese column aliases cause syntax errors unless enclosed in double quotes, which this entry notes is directly relevant to the round theme, because doing data engineering in Japanese runs into syntax traps created by the language itself. **Tenth, the data is declared fictional and the file listing was measured**: the readme states verbatim that all data is fictional demonstration data unrelated to any real person, company or organisation and that the bundled policy wording PDF was created for the exercise; the measured paths contain five accident images, five reference images, one policy PDF, and only three estimate PDFs, which agrees with the stated count of three estimate records and is recorded here as two parallel numbers without speculating as to why the other two cases have none. **Eleventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover policy and document parsing, claims and cloud insurance platform material and document extraction, **while this entry supplies four differently shaped data kinds matched in one place, a written scoring rule per fraud technique, and an agent positioned as surfacing the cases a human must review. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled clause-graph and claims-analytics entries**; **four practices transfer directly: detection capability is set by which data kinds can be matched rather than by model size; write the scoring thresholds down instead of hiding them in a prompt; a zero score is not the same as requiring no action; and split how long a run takes from how long a class takes**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no platform account opened, no SQL or notebook executed, no platform function called and no case score or runtime recomputed — **so this entry claims neither the verdicts and scores, nor that the layered structure can actually be built, nor the runtimes**. **Second, no code was read**: only the readme and the archive path list were read, and neither setup script, none of the three files under the source directory and no image or PDF was opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the full text of one troubleshooting entry about extracted values shifting into an adjacent column could not be read**, because the retrieved readme was truncated at that point, and this entry does not complete it. **Fourth, whether the platform functions and dynamic-table syntax exist in the current platform version was not verified**, no vendor documentation having been consulted, nor was it verified whether the named embedding model is still the default. **Fifth, the environment behind the measured times was not verified**, only the warehouse size being stated. **Sixth, whether the images and estimate PDFs actually correspond to the stated verdicts was not verified**, no image or PDF having been viewed, **so this entry relays the readme verdicts and does not claim that the detection logic is correct**. **Seventh, the rights position is unclear**: no licence file is present and the readme gives no licence terms verbatim, **which is not the same as the author waiving rights**, and since the material involves a cloud platform and third-party models their terms apply separately. **Eighth, the author identity was not verified**, the account name prefix following that vendor internal naming convention but no identity or affiliation having been confirmed; the repository has zero stars, no tests and no continuous integration. **Ninth, the declaration that all data is fictional was not verified**, this entry relaying it only, and anyone reusing the demonstration data must still confirm that no third-party rights attach. **Tenth, whether the material matches any real insurer claims process was not verified**, and nothing here may be read as an opinion on any claim or any fraud determination. **Eleventh, both the creation and the push fall on 2026-09-07, inside the thaw window, so this entry has no window exception to declare. Twelfth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**

entries.title: **英国 MOT 车检的**队列统计**：样本只给 Volvo，**而且许可写明「**evaluation only**」**：Kaggle 数据集 `donaldmsimpson/uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset`——**⭐ 一句值得抄的话**：**「**Nobody should pay for raw DVSA MOT data — the anonymised release is free and open under the Open Government Licence. This dataset is the engineering between that raw feed and a usable cohort statistic.**」**；**⭐ 而「**工程**」指的是**两件事**：**把 **4,030 个原始车型字符串归一成 **347 个车型**（**全英 **216,686 个品牌车型组合、**覆盖率 **98.72%****）**，**以及一个**五档缺陷严重度分类**；**⚠️ 许可为**仅评估用、**不得再分发、**不得用于核保或生产**
entries.title_en: A cohort-level UK vehicle-inspection reliability dataset published as a Volvo-only evaluation sample under a licence that permits inspection but not redistribution or production use, whose stated value is not the raw open-government feed but the normalisation of thousands of free-text model strings into hundreds of models and a five-tier defect severity taxonomy.

This dataset is the engineering between that raw feed and a usable cohort statistic.**」**；**⭐ 而「**工程**」指的是**兩件事**：**把 **4,030 個原始車型字串歸一成 **347 個車型**（**全英 **216,686 個品牌車型組合、**覆蓋率 **98.72%****）**，**以及一個**五檔缺陷嚴重度分類**；**⚠️ 許可為**僅評估用、**不得再分發、**不得用於核保或生產**
entries.summary: **uk-vehicle-reliability-sample**（Kaggle 数据集 `donaldmsimpson/uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset`）**是一份**英国车辆可靠性队列统计**的**免费评估样本****——**逐字自述为从 DVSA MOT 检验记录派生的队列级统计**（**首次通过率、**缺陷模式、**严重度分类、**里程分段行为与**生存曲线**，**粒度到**品牌 × 车型 × 制造年 × 燃料类型**）**，**并逐字标明**「**This is a free evaluation sample covering Volvo only.**」**。**本次实测**：**最后更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 4**、**1,225,083 字节**、**可用性评分 0.94**、**下载 20 次、**收藏 4**；**标签含** insurance**；**⭐ 许可逐字为**「**Other (specified in description)**」**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：抽样**」**——**⭐ 它给的三条纪律最值得抄**：**① **「**免费的是原始数据，不是这层工程**」**（**逐字**「**The DVSA feed has no model taxonomy, only free-text trim strings**」**）**；**② **只给聚合、**并逐字声明没有个人数据**（**逐字**「**no registration marks, no VINs, no keeper or owner identity, and no per-vehicle rows**」**）**；**③ **许可写明**仅评估、**不得再分发、**不得进生产或核保**。**⚠️ 本次未下载任何文件。
entries.summary_hk: **uk-vehicle-reliability-sample**（Kaggle 資料集 `donaldmsimpson/uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset`）**是一份**英國車輛可靠性隊列統計**的**免費評估樣本****——**逐字自述為從 DVSA MOT 檢驗記錄派生的隊列級統計**（**首次通過率、**缺陷模式、**嚴重度分類、**里程分段行為與**生存曲線**，**粒度到**品牌 × 車型 × 製造年 × 燃料類型**）**，**並逐字標明**「**This is a free evaluation sample covering Volvo only.**」**。**本次實測**：**最後更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 4**、**1,225,083 位元組**、**可用性評分 0.94**、**下載 20 次、**收藏 4**；**標籤含** insurance**；**⭐ 許可逐字為**「**Other (specified in description)**」**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：抽樣**」**——**⭐ 三條紀律最值得抄**：**① **「**免費的是原始資料，不是這層工程**」**；**② **只給聚合、**並逐字聲明沒有個人資料**；**③ **許可寫明**僅評估、**不得再分發、**不得進生產或核保**。**⚠️ 本次未下載任何檔案。
entries.summary_en: The Kaggle dataset uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset **is a free evaluation sample of cohort-level UK vehicle reliability statistics**, described verbatim as cohort-level statistics derived from vehicle inspection records covering first-time pass rates, defect patterns, a severity taxonomy, mileage-band behaviour and survival curves at the grain of make, model, manufacture year and fuel type, and stated verbatim to be a free evaluation sample covering one make only. **Measured this round**: **last updated 2026-09-10**, **version 4**, **about 1.2 megabytes**, **a usability rating of about 0.94**, twenty downloads and four votes, tagged with insurance, and **licensed as other with the terms specified in the description**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case sampling**, and **three disciplines are worth copying: the free thing is the raw feed rather than this engineering layer, only aggregates are published with an explicit statement that no registration marks, vehicle identification numbers, keeper identities or per-vehicle rows are present at any tier, and the licence states plainly that the sample is for evaluation only and may not be redistributed or used in production, underwriting or a paid service**. **No file was downloaded this round.**
entries.body:
**uk-vehicle-reliability-sample**（Kaggle 数据集 `donaldmsimpson/uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset`，**逐字标题** `UK Vehicle Reliability: Volvo MOT Sample`**）**是一份**英国车辆可靠性队列统计**的**免费评估样本****——**逐字自述为**「**Cohort-level UK vehicle reliability statistics derived from DVSA MOT test records: first-time pass rates, defect patterns, a severity taxonomy, mileage-band behaviour and survival curves at make × model × manufacture year × fuel type.**」**。**本次实测**：**最后更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 4**、**1,225,083 字节**、**可用性评分 **0.94****、**下载 20 次、**浏览 45 次、**收藏 4、**公开 notebook 1 个**；**标签逐字含** `tabular`、`automobiles and vehicles`、`transportation`、`insurance`**；**所有者与创建者同为一人**（`DonaldMSimpson`**）**；**⭐ 许可字段逐字为**「**Other (specified in description)**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：抽样**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Kaggle 数据集页的元数据与描述实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一句话划清了「**免费的是什么**」**——**逐字**：**「**Nobody should pay for raw DVSA MOT data - the anonymised release is free and open under the Open Government Licence. **This dataset is the engineering between that raw feed and a usable cohort statistic.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**原始数据是公共的**」**与**「**能用来做队列统计的那一层不是**」**被一句话分开**——**⭐ 这与本站第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」同向**：**免费的源头 ＋ 收费的加工层**，**而**作者**没有**把两者混在一起说**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 而「**工程**」被具体化成一个**可核的归一化比例****——**逐字**：**「**The DVSA feed has **no model taxonomy**, only free-text trim strings. For Volvo alone the source holds **4,030 raw model strings** which normalise to **347 models**」**，**并给出四行对照例**（`XC60 + B5 MHEV AWD AUTO`、`XC60 ULTRA T8 PHEV AWD AUTO`、`XC60 + BLK ED B5 MHEV AWD AUTO`、`XC60 ULTIMTE T8 RECHARGE AWD A` **均归为** `XC60`**）**；**⭐ 全英范围逐字为**「**Across the full UK bundle the source holds **216,686** distinct make-and-model combinations; normalisation coverage is **98.72%**.**」**，**并逐字说明**「**The join is documented in `NORMALISATION.md`, which is itself part of the product.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**4,030 → 347**」**这个比值**就是**「**为什么 MOT 数据不能直接按车型分组**」**的答案**；**⭐ 而**归一化规则本身被当作**产品的一部分**公开**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 缺陷严重度分类被说明**哪些部分是原始数据里拿不到的****——**逐字**：**「**A hand-built severity model applied at approximately **1.87 billion** defect rows in production, rolled up to cohort level. Raw MOT gives you a text blob; this gives you weighted severity by tier (`advisory`, `safety_wear`, `mechanical_safety`, `structural_concern`, `dangerous`). **This is the part that is not recoverable from the raw feed.** Raw MOT failure text is dominated by consumables - tyres and brakes top almost every cohort, which tells you nothing. The taxonomy separates structural failure (corrosion, mounts, subframes - expensive, often terminal) from routine wear.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是整份说明里最有信息量的一段**：**⭐ 它先说**原始失败文本被耗材（**轮胎与刹车**）主导**、**因此「**什么都说明不了**」，**再说**自己的分类**把结构性失效**（**锈蚀、**机脚、**副车架**）**与**例行磨损**分开**——**⭐ 即**「**我加的不是数据，是分得清的类别**」。**⭐⭐ ④ 五处「**已替你修正**」被逐条命名****——**逐字五条**：**① **未完成结果的抑制**（**结果历史不完整时** `pass_rate_reliable = false`**）**；**② **里程异常分离**（**真实调表约 **4.5%**，**与**打错与单位错误**分开**）**；**③ **里程单位不可混**（**`MI`／`KM` 标签约 **0.6%** 标错，**逐字**「**do not average across units**」**）**；**④ **混合动力按内燃机归类**；**⑤ **复检不计入首次结果**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**如果我不管，这个天真管线会掉进哪些坑**」**被写成五条**——**⭐ 这与本站第 335 轮「**不要悄悄降级**」、第 347 轮「**防误读**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 「**产出文件 ＋ 每份行数**」被列表写明**——**实测描述中六个 parquet 与一个 CSV 逐字为**：`volvo_cohort_stats.parquet` **2,094 行**、`volvo_defect_patterns.parquet` **5,029 行**、`volvo_defect_severity.parquet` **6,284 行**、`volvo_survival.parquet` **9,844 行**、`volvo_mileage_band_pass.parquet` **2,860 行**、`volvo_mileage_percentiles.parquet` **175 行**、`volvo_preview.csv` **20 行**；**⭐ 并逐字说明**「**Every file carries `snapshot_date`, `generated_at` and `source`**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**每个文件都带快照日期与来源**」**这一条最实用**：**⭐ 即**拿到文件的人**不必去猜它是哪天的切片**——**⭐ 快照日逐字为** `2026-09-06`**、**筛选条件逐字为** `vehicle_count > 50`**、**队列数 **2,094****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 局限被逐条写出，**并指出一个**最容易用错的字段****——**逐字含**：**仅 MOT 记录**（**无融资、**全损、**失窃标记或车主历史**）**；**小于阈值的队列被排除**（**样本噪声大**）**；**`pass_rate_reliable = false` 的队列**须过滤掉**；**燃料标签来自 DVSA 且不完美**（**混动按内燃机归类**）**；**⭐ 以及**「**`vehicle_count` is not the mileage denominator. Use `mileage_sample_count`**」**，**并给出一个具体反例**「**the 1988 `340` has **14,085 vehicles and zero usable readings**, so its `avg_mileage` is `NULL`**」**；**以及**「**Snapshot, not a live feed.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为那个「**14,085 辆车、**零条可用读数**」**的例子极值得抄**：**⭐ 即**一个列名**（`vehicle_count`）**看起来像分母**，**其实不是**——**⭐ 而**指出这一点**只需要一个反例**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 许可与归属被分成**三层写清****——**逐字**：**① **许可**「**evaluation only - this is **not** an open dataset**」**，**并逐字限定**「**You may download, inspect and evaluate it. You may not redistribute it or use it in a production product, underwriting model or paid service without a commercial licence.**」**；**② **公共部门信息**「**Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.**」**；**③ **派生字段归属**「**CarHunch-derived fields (normalisation, severity taxonomy, cohort statistics, survival curves and related analysis) are © Donald Simpson Limited.**」**，**并逐字声明**「**CarHunch is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, DVSA or DVLA.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是**三层归属**（**许可／**公共部门信息／**派生字段**）**的干净写法**——**⭐ 与之对照**：**本站第 358 轮那条退休计算器**把数据许可与代码许可分开**，**而这一条**把**同一份数据里的三种权利**分开**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 「**同一份样本、三个平台**」被写明**——**逐字给出**完整数据集与许可的联系页（`carhunch.com/data`**）、**同一份样本在 Hugging Face 的地址**、**以及**在 GitHub 的地址**，**并逐字说明**「**This is not an export made for sale - it is the layer behind a live public site, so you can inspect the same figures rendered for humans at carhunch.com before licensing the files.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**你可以先在网页上看同一批数字，**再决定要不要买文件**」**——**⭐ 这与本站第 353 轮「**同源多形**」同向**：**同一内容以**网页、**HF、**GitHub、**Kaggle 四种形态出现**，**而**哪一种可再分发**被写明**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 覆盖范围与用途被写明**——**逐字**：**全量包覆盖** MOT **classes 1–7**（**含**摩托车与轻型商用车**，**并列出若干品牌**）**；**而**本样本按定义只有汽车**；**用途逐字列出五类**（**二手车保修与核保**、**经销商／拍卖／再营销工具**、**配件与服务修复平台**、**车辆数据商与车队分析**、**研究者与记者**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**用途一栏里的「**with a structural-versus-routine-wear split for reserving**」**值得注意**：**⭐ 即**它明确指向**准备金**用途**，**而**许可却禁止**未经商业许可用于核保或生产**——**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两句**，**不替它调和**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 工程细节与可复现入口**——**实测描述给出** `pandas` 与 **DuckDB** 两种读法**，**并给出**最小示例**（**按 `pass_rate_reliable` 过滤后取 `pct_with_dangerous_defect` 最大的十个队列**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**「**先过滤可靠性标记、**再排序**」**这个顺序本身**就是纪律**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]、**[[insurance-datasets]] 覆盖保险数据资源一侧**，**[[uk-home-insurance-risk-map]] 覆盖英国的风险地图**，**[[copart-salvage-dataset]] 覆盖事故车残值一侧**，**[[insurance-data-tools]]、**[[synthetic-resdac-claims]] 覆盖数据工具与合成数据**，**[[stressed-insurance-datasets]] 覆盖压力化数据集**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**只给聚合、**只给一个品牌、**并写明仅评估用**的车检统计样本 ＋**把「**哪一层是免费的、**哪一层是加工出来的**」写成一句话**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[uk-home-insurance-risk-map]]、[[copart-salvage-dataset]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① **许可要写明能做什么、**不能做什么**（**含**不得进生产与核保**）**；**② **只发聚合时**逐字声明没有个人数据**；**③ **每个文件带**快照日期与来源**；**④ **把「**看起来像分母但其实是分母**」的字段**用一个反例指出来**；**⑤ **同一份内容在多平台上时**，**说清哪一版可再分发**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有下载该数据集的任何文件**（**未取任何 parquet 或 CSV、**未计算任何通过率或生存曲线**），**故**不主张**其行数以外的任何数值结果**（**⭐ 行数亦只来自描述中的表格**）**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核实 Kaggle 的**下载是否需要登录**——**⭐ 本次**只用公开的元数据接口取到描述**，**未尝试下载文件**；**⭐ 故**「**免费评估样本**」**在实际取用环节是否需要账号**，**本次**未核实**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** 4,030 → 347**、**216,686**、**98.72%**、**1.87 billion** 与 **4.5%／0.6%** 这些数字**（**⭐ 本词条只转述描述**）**；**⚠️ 特别是**「**约 18.7 亿行缺陷记录**」**这一规模，**本次**无任何独立核对**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `volvo_cohort_stats.parquet` **等文件的**实际列名**（**描述称** `SCHEMA.md` **有完整文档，**但该文件**可能在完整包里、**本次未取得**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** `pass_rate_reliable` **这一标记**在数据里**如何取值与占比**（**⭐ 描述只说**须过滤**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**生存曲线**的具体定义**（**描述只说**「**how many vehicles from a manufacture year are still being MOT-tested in later years**」**）**；**也未核实** 1988 年 `340` 那个反例**是否与数据一致**。**⑦ ⚠️ **许可须逐条遵守**：**⭐ 本条**明确提示**——**该数据集**不是开放数据**，**不得再分发、**不得用于生产、**核保或付费服务**；**⭐ 其派生字段**归** Donald Simpson Limited**；**⭐ 其公共部门信息部分**适用** Open Government Licence v3.0**。**⚠️ 本条目**不构成任何使用许可**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实作者与公司**（**CarHunch 与 Donald Simpson Limited**）**的实际关系与注册信息**；**也未核实该数据集与 CarHunch 线上站点显示的数字是否一致**（**⭐ 本次**未访问该站点**）**。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核实其与** DVSA **官方发布**的关系**（**⭐ 描述自述**不与 DVSA／DVLA 有关联或获其背书**，**本词条**只转述**）**。**⑩ ⚠️ 未核实 **Kaggle** 上的**版本 4** **与** Hugging Face／GitHub 上同名样本**是否同一份**（**⭐ 描述称**同一份样本**，**但本次**未逐平台比对**）**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**⭐ 数据集**最后更新 2026-09-10（**在解冻窗口之内**）**，**而**其内容快照日逐字为 **2026-09-06**（**恰在窗口边界**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两个日期**。**⑫ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**其统计**只覆盖 MOT 记录**，**不含融资、**全损与车主历史**，**不得**用于任何具体的核保或定价判断**。
