entries.body_en:
The Kaggle dataset uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset, titled as a UK vehicle reliability sample, **is a free evaluation sample of cohort-level UK vehicle reliability statistics** derived from vehicle inspection records, covering first-time pass rates, defect patterns, a severity taxonomy, mileage-band behaviour and survival curves at the grain of make, model, manufacture year and fuel type. **Measured this round**: **last updated 2026-09-10**, **version 4**, **about 1.2 megabytes**, **a usability rating of about 0.94**, twenty downloads, forty-five views, four votes and one public notebook, tagged with insurance, owned and created by the same person, and **licensed as other with terms specified in the description**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case sampling.**

**Verified information, all measured from the dataset page metadata and description**: **first, one sentence separates what is free from what is not**: verbatim, nobody should pay for raw inspection data, since the anonymised release is free and open under the Open Government Licence, and this dataset is the engineering between that raw feed and a usable cohort statistic. **The free source and the paid processing layer are named separately rather than conflated, which matches the standing distinction between a source and what was generated from it.** **Second, the engineering is made concrete as a checkable normalisation ratio**: verbatim, the feed has no model taxonomy, only free-text trim strings, and for one make alone the source holds four thousand and thirty raw model strings which normalise to three hundred and forty-seven models, illustrated with four strings that all reduce to the same model name; across the full bundle the source is stated to hold two hundred and sixteen thousand six hundred and eighty-six distinct make-and-model combinations with a normalisation coverage of about ninety-nine percent, and the join is documented in a normalisation document which the description calls part of the product. **That ratio is the answer to why inspection data cannot be grouped by model as it stands, and the normalisation rules are published as part of the product rather than kept inside it.** **Third, the defect severity taxonomy is explained as the part that cannot be recovered from the raw feed**: a hand-built severity model is stated to have been applied at approximately one point eight seven billion defect rows in production and rolled up to cohort level, giving weighted severity by five tiers separating structural failure such as corrosion, mounts and subframes from routine wear, with the description noting that raw failure text is dominated by consumables such as tyres and brakes, which tells you nothing. **What was added is not more data but categories that can be told apart.** **Fourth, five corrections already applied are named one by one**: suppression of incomplete outcomes through a reliability flag; separation of genuine odometer tampering, stated at about four and a half percent of vehicles, from typos and unit errors; a warning not to average across odometer units because roughly six in a thousand labels are wrong; hybrid vehicles classified by their combustion engine; and retests excluded from first-time outcomes. **Stating in advance which traps a naive pipeline falls into points the same way as the standing principles that a system must not degrade quietly and that a document should pre-empt misreading.** **Fifth, the outputs and their row counts are tabulated**: six Parquet files and one preview CSV with stated row counts of two thousand and ninety-four, five thousand and twenty-nine, six thousand two hundred and eighty-four, nine thousand eight hundred and forty-four, two thousand eight hundred and sixty, one hundred and seventy-five and twenty, with every file stated to carry a snapshot date, a generation timestamp and a source, the snapshot date being given as 2026-09-06, the filter as cohorts above fifty vehicles, and the cohort count as two thousand and ninety-four. **Every file carrying its own snapshot date and source is the most immediately useful of these conventions, because whoever receives the file does not have to guess which day it is a slice of.** **Sixth, the limitations are listed and one field is flagged as easy to misuse**: inspection records only, with no finance, write-off, stolen-marker or keeper history; cohorts below a floor excluded as statistically noisy; a reliability flag to filter on; fuel labels from the authority and imperfect; and the warning verbatim that the vehicle count is not the mileage denominator and that the mileage sample count should be used instead, illustrated by a nineteen eighty-eight model with fourteen thousand and eighty-five vehicles and zero usable readings whose average mileage is therefore null. **A column name that looks like a denominator but is not, demonstrated by a single counterexample, is worth copying.** **Seventh, licence and attribution are split into three layers**: the licence, stated as evaluation only and explicitly not an open dataset, permitting download, inspection and evaluation but not redistribution or use in a production product, an underwriting model or a paid service without a commercial licence; the public sector information layer under the Open Government Licence; and the derived fields, which are attributed to a named company, with an explicit statement that the product is not affiliated with or endorsed by the vehicle agencies. **One dataset carrying three distinct rights positions is a cleaner treatment than separating only data licensing from code licensing.** **Eighth, the same sample is declared to exist on three platforms**, with links to the full dataset, a Hugging Face dataset and a GitHub repository, and the statement verbatim that this is not an export made for sale but the layer behind a live public site, so the same figures can be inspected rendered for humans before licensing the files. **Ninth, coverage and audiences are stated**: the full bundle covers inspection classes one to seven including motorcycles and light commercial vehicles while this sample is cars only by definition, and the audiences are listed as used-car warranty and underwriting, dealer, auction and remarketing tools, parts and repair platforms, vehicle data providers and fleet analytics, and researchers and journalists. **This entry notes plainly that the description points at reserving use while the licence forbids unlicensed production or underwriting use, and records both without reconciling them.** **Tenth, the engineering surface is given**: two ways to read the files and a minimal example that filters on the reliability flag before ranking cohorts, **and the order of those two steps is itself the discipline**. **Eleventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover insurance data resources, a UK risk map, salvage vehicle valuation, data tooling and synthetic claims, **while this entry supplies a car-inspection sample that is aggregated only, limited to one make, licensed for evaluation only, and accompanied by a one-sentence statement of which layer is free and which is manufactured. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled UK risk map and the pooled salvage dataset**; **five practices transfer directly: state in the licence what may and may not be done, including production and underwriting exclusions; declare verbatim that aggregates contain no personal data; carry a snapshot date and source on every file; point out a field that looks like a denominator but is not, using one counterexample; and when one dataset exists on several platforms, say which version may be redistributed**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no file from the dataset was downloaded** — no Parquet or CSV retrieved, no pass rate or survival curve computed — **so beyond the row counts stated in the description, no numerical result is claimed**. **Second, whether downloading from the platform requires signing in was not verified**: only public metadata endpoints were used to retrieve the description, and no file download was attempted, **so whether the stated free evaluation sample needs an account at the point of use is unverified**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the figures for raw model strings, distinct make-and-model combinations, normalisation coverage, defect rows and the tampering and mislabelling percentages were not independently checked**, this entry relaying the description only, and **in particular the production scale of about one point eight seven billion defect rows has no independent corroboration here**. **Fourth, the actual column names in the output files were not verified**, the description pointing to a schema document that was not obtained. **Fifth, the distribution of the reliability flag was not verified.** **Sixth, the precise definition of the survival curves and whether the counterexample about the nineteen eighty-eight model matches the data were not verified.** **Seventh, the licence must be followed literally**: this entry states plainly that the dataset is not open data, may not be redistributed and may not be used in production, underwriting or a paid service, that its derived fields belong to a named company, and that its public sector information component is under the Open Government Licence; **nothing here constitutes a licence to use it**. **Eighth, the relationship between the author and the named company was not verified, nor was the dataset compared against the figures shown on the live site**, which was not visited. **Ninth, the relationship to the official authority publication was not verified**, only the description disclaimer being relayed. **Tenth, whether the platform version and the same-named samples on two other platforms are identical was not verified.** **Eleventh, on the window: the dataset was last updated 2026-09-10, inside the thaw window, while its content snapshot date is stated as 2026-09-06, exactly at the window boundary, and this entry records both dates side by side. Twelfth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the statistics cover inspection records only, with no finance, write-off or keeper history, and must not be used for any specific underwriting or pricing judgement.**

entries.title: **法国农业多风险保单的**火灾纯保费**预测竞赛：把目标拆成**频率 × 案均 × 年数****：Kaggle 数据集 `mariodefrance/caa-challenge-2025`——**⭐ 逐字副标题**「**AssurPrime — ENS Challenge Data #161 (Crédit Agricole Assurances)**」**；**⭐ 目标逐字分解为** `CHARGE = FREQ × CM × ANNEE_ASSURANCE`**，**并要求两个模型**（**频率用 Poisson／log、**案均用 Tweedie／log**）**对** GLM 基准**算 RMSE**；**⭐ 而一句最值得抄的话**：**「**a stale pair describes a model that no longer exists**」**；**⚠️ 许可为** Etalab 开放许可 2.0**（**须署名**）**
entries.title_en: A French academic competition dataset for predicting the pure fire premium on a farm multi-risk policy, whose target is decomposed into a frequency term, an average claim cost term and a policy-age exposure term, scored against a generalised-linear-model benchmark, and whose description warns that a stale pair of derived prediction files describes a model that no longer exists.
entries.title_hk: **法國農業多風險保單的**火災純保費**預測競賽：把目標拆成**頻率 × 案均 × 年數****：Kaggle 資料集 `mariodefrance/caa-challenge-2025`——**⭐ 逐字副標題**「**AssurPrime — ENS Challenge Data #161 (Crédit Agricole Assurances)**」**；**⭐ 目標逐字分解為** `CHARGE = FREQ × CM × ANNEE_ASSURANCE`**，**並要求兩個模型**（**頻率用 Poisson／log、**案均用 Tweedie／log**）**對** GLM 基準**算 RMSE**；**⭐ 而一句最值得抄的話**：**「**a stale pair describes a model that no longer exists**」**；**⚠️ 許可為** Etalab 開放許可 2.0**（**須署名**）**
entries.summary: **assurprime-ens-challenge**（Kaggle 数据集 `mariodefrance/caa-challenge-2025`，**逐字副标题**「**AssurPrime — ENS Challenge Data #161 (Crédit Agricole Assurances)**」）**是一份**法国农业多风险保单的火灾纯保费预测竞赛的工作数据与中间产物****——**逐字自述任务为**「**predict the pure fire premium on Pacifica的 Contrat Multirisque Agricole, the multi-risk policy French farmers take out to cover their holding**」**，**并逐字给出目标分解**「**`CHARGE = FREQ x CM x ANNEE_ASSURANCE`**」**与评分口径**「**scored on RMSE against a GLM benchmark (Poisson/log for frequency, Tweedie/log for severity)**」**。**本次实测**：**最后更新 2026-09-06**、**版本 2**、**1,826,672,247 字节（**约 1.83 GB**）**、**可用性评分 **0.94****、**下载 7 次、**浏览 14 次**；**标签逐字含** `classification`、`insurance`、`regression`、`agriculture`、`europe`**；**⭐ 许可字段为**「**Other (specified in description)**」**，**而描述逐字给出**「**Etalab Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0**」**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：竞赛**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **目标被拆成两个可分别建模的因子 ＋ 一个暴露量**；**② **哪些文件是竞赛原件、**哪些是**派生中间产物**被分开写明****；**③ **许可的认定路径被逐条引用**（**含平台使用条款第 **4.6.1** 条**）。**⚠️ 本次未下载任何文件。
entries.summary_hk: **assurprime-ens-challenge**（Kaggle 資料集 `mariodefrance/caa-challenge-2025`，**逐字副標題**「**AssurPrime — ENS Challenge Data #161 (Crédit Agricole Assurances)**」）**是一份**法國農業多風險保單的火災純保費預測競賽的工作資料與中間產物****——**逐字自述任務為**「**predict the pure fire premium on Pacifica的 Contrat Multirisque Agricole**」**，**並逐字給出目標分解**「**`CHARGE = FREQ x CM x ANNEE_ASSURANCE`**」**與評分口徑**「**scored on RMSE against a GLM benchmark (Poisson/log for frequency, Tweedie/log for severity)**」**。**本次實測**：**最後更新 2026-09-06**、**版本 2**、**約 1.83 GB**、**可用性評分 0.94**、**下載 7 次、**瀏覽 14 次**；**標籤逐字含** `classification`、`insurance`、`regression`、`agriculture`、`europe`**；**⭐ 許可欄位為**「**Other (specified in description)**」**，**而描述逐字給出**「**Etalab Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0**」**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：競賽**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **目標被拆成兩個可分別建模的因子 ＋ 一個暴露量**；**② **哪些檔案是競賽原件、**哪些是**派生中間產物**被分開寫明****；**③ **許可的認定路徑被逐條引用**（**含平台使用條款第 **4.6.1** 條**）。**⚠️ 本次未下載任何檔案。
entries.summary_en: The Kaggle dataset caa-challenge-2025 **holds the working data and intermediate artefacts of an academic competition to predict the pure fire premium on a French farm multi-risk policy**, proposed by a large French insurer through a higher-education challenge platform, and identifies the target verbatim as decomposing into a frequency factor, an average claim cost factor and an exposure factor, with two models scored against a generalised-linear-model benchmark on root mean squared error. **Measured this round**: **last updated 2026-09-06**, **version 2**, **about 1.83 gigabytes**, **a usability rating of about 0.94**, seven downloads and fourteen views, tagged as classification, insurance, regression, agriculture and Europe, and licensed as other with terms specified in the description, which states the Etalab open licence with attribution. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case a competition**, and **three things are worth reading: the target is split into two separately modelled factors plus an exposure term; the files that are competition originals are separated from the files that are derived intermediate artefacts; and the licensing reasoning is cited clause by clause, including an article of the platform terms of use**. **No file was downloaded this round.**
entries.body:
**assurprime-ens-challenge**（Kaggle 数据集 `mariodefrance/caa-challenge-2025`，**逐字标题为** `caa-challenge-2025`，**逐字副标题为**「**AssurPrime — ENS Challenge Data #161 (Crédit Agricole Assurances)**」**）**是一份**法国农业多风险保单（**Contrat Multirisque Agricole**）火灾纯保费预测竞赛的工作数据与中间产物****——**逐字自述任务为**「**The task: predict the pure fire premium on Pacifica的 *Contrat Multirisque Agricole*, the multi-risk policy French farmers take out to cover their holding. Fire is the dominant share of that contract的 claim burden.**」**。**本次实测**：**最后更新 2026-09-06**、**版本 2**、**1,826,672,247 字节**、**可用性评分 **0.94****、**下载 7 次、**浏览 14 次、**公开 notebook 2 个**；**所有者与创建者为同一人**（`Mario Defrance`**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：竞赛**」**。

**⭐ 引号约定**：**本条目所引法语机构名中原为 ASCII 撇号者一律写成弯撇号**（**U+2019**）**，**以便与条目自身的引号区分**。

**可核实信息（均 Kaggle 数据集页元数据与描述实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 目标被拆成**两个可分别建模的因子 ＋ 一个暴露量****——**逐字**：**「**The target decomposes as `CHARGE = FREQ x CM x ANNEE_ASSURANCE` so the challenge asks for two models — one for **frequency** (`FREQ`), one for **average claim cost** (`CM`) — scored on **RMSE against a GLM benchmark** (Poisson/log for frequency, Tweedie/log for severity).**」**，**并逐字补一句可核的恒等式**：**「**On rows with a claim, `CHARGE / CM` is exactly `FREQ * ANNEE_ASSURANCE`, an integer 1–5.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**一个纯保费**」**被拆成**频率 × 案均 × 暴露年数**，**而**暴露量**在保单年数上取整数 1 至 5**——**⭐ 这是**车险与农险都通用的**频次／案均分解**，**而**这里把**暴露定义写成了一个可验证的等式**；**⭐ 这与本站第 330 轮「**假设**」、第 340 轮「**把每个数从哪来写在旁边**」同向**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**哪些是竞赛原件、**哪些是派生中间产物**」被分开写明****——**逐字**：**「**`frequency_2026.csv`, `oos_frequency_2026.csv` and `cm_carver_freq_tschuprowt_2026.json` are **not challenge originals** — they are produced by the frequency notebook and consumed by the severity notebook. **Regenerate them whenever the frequency model changes; a stale pair describes a model that no longer exists.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**最后半句是整个描述里最值得抄的一句**：**⭐ 即**「**一份过期的派生文件，描述的是一个已经不存在的模型**」**——**⭐ 这与本站第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」、第 352 轮「**登记与出处**」同向**，**且**它给出了**为什么**要重算的理由**，**而**不只是**一句「**记得更新**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 许可的认定路径被**逐条引用****——**逐字**：**「**Every file here is redistributed under the **Etalab Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0**, which permits reproduction, redistribution, adaptation and commercial reuse subject to **attribution**. **Challenge files** (`train_input_Z61KlZo.csv`, `train_output_DzPxaPY.csv`, `test_input_5qJzHrr.csv`) — Study Data from ENS Challenge Data #161. Per the platform的 terms of use article **4.6.1**, Study Data is open under the Etalab Licence Ouverte **by default unless the provider specifies otherwise in the challenge description**; challenge #161 specifies nothing, so **the default applies**.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**这份数据为什么可以再分发**」**不是**一句「**开放数据**」，**而是**一条可追溯的推理**（**平台条款默认项 ＋ 该竞赛未另行指定**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 354 轮「**存证**」、第 357 轮「**许可形态分类**」同向**：**许可结论要能追回它依据的条款**。**⭐⭐ ④ 归属被分成**三个来源**逐条写明**——**逐字**：**① **竞赛文件**（**Study Data from ENS Challenge Data #161**），**生产者逐字为**「**Producer: Crédit Agricole Assurances, via ENS Challenge Data**」**，**来源网址 **`challengedata.ens.fr/challenges/161`**，**最后更新 **2024-12-05****；**② **`Incendies.csv`** 来自** BDIFF（**法国全国森林火灾数据库**）**，**生产者逐字为**「**Institut national de l’information géographique et forestière (IGN), for the Ministère de l’Agriculture et de la Souveraineté Alimentaire**」**，**覆盖 **2006–2022**、**每年更新**、**上游最后更新 **2025-12-13**、**抽取日 **2025-03-21****；**③ **派生产物**「**carry the same terms**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**三份来源**各自给出**生产者、**来源网址与两个日期**（**上游更新日与本地抽取日**）**——**⭐ 而**「**抽取日**」**这一栏**正是**数据可复现的关键**；**⭐ 这与本站第 344 轮「**把依据放在看得见的地方**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 变量族被分类写明，**并解释为什么有些列名**没有意义****——**逐字**：**目标**（`FREQ`／`CM`／`CHARGE`**）**；**暴露**（`ANNEE_ASSURANCE`，**逐字** years since the contract was taken out**）**；**地理**（**department ＋ **weather/climate aggregates**）**；**合同**（**被保险人活动如 `cultivateur`／`polyculteur`、**保障订阅标记、**建筑数、**员工数、**承保时已申报的赔案**）**；**⭐ 以及面积／**保额／**防护**三族**被逐字说明为**匿名化**：**「**The provider **anonymised these into `surface1..n`, `capital1..n`, `prev1..n`** for confidentiality; **the names carry no meaning by design**.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一句值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**这些列名不是缩写，**而是**刻意没有含义**」**——**⭐ 若不写这一句，**使用者会**花时间去猜 `surface3` 是什么**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 特征工程里**外部数据的接入点**被写明**——**逐字**：**`Incendies.csv`**（**BDIFF** 抽取，**24 列**）「**Joined during feature engineering to build the burnt-area and extinction-rate features (`total_surface_2023`, `total_surface_5y`, `surface_over_forest`, `fire_extinction_rates`). **Not part of the challenge distribution.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**这四个特征是我自己加的、**不在竞赛数据里**」**被写明**——**⭐ 而这在竞赛语境下尤其重要**：**读者要能分清**哪些是**出题方给的**、**哪些是**参赛者加的**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 建模路径被一句话概括，**且**朝向**基准可比****——**逐字**：**「**The approach these artefacts come from carves every qualitative feature with **AutoCarver** and tunes **XGBoost with Optuna**, weighting the severity model的 samples by the frequency model的 absolute error.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**用频率模型的绝对误差给严重度模型的样本加权**」**这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**两个模型**不是各自独立**，**而是**一个的输出**被用作另一个的权重**；**⭐ 而**这也解释了**为什么上一条要强调**派生文件过期即失效**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 工程形态可数**：**实测描述列出**三个**未改动的竞赛文件**（`train_input_Z61KlZo.csv` 逐字为 **one row per policy-year, keyed on `ID`**、`train_output_DzPxaPY.csv` 含 `ANNEE_ASSURANCE`／`FREQ`／`CM`／`CHARGE`、`test_input_5qJzHrr.csv`**）**，**以及三份派生文件**（**序列化的 AutoCarver `BinaryCarver`（**light mode**），**逐字** `CM` carved against the frequency target with **Tschuprow的 T**，**用于**按案均金额分布分层切分训练／验证**；**两份频率预测**，**逐字** `pred_sum` is the expected claim count**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**用 Tschuprow 的 T 去分层切分**这一细节值得记**：**⭐ 即**切分不是随机**，**而是**按目标分布分层**——**⭐ 这与本站第 356 轮那条「**Never a random split**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[porto-seguro-competition]]、**[[allstate-claims-severity]] 覆盖车险与赔案竞赛数据集**，**[[actuarial-student-competitions]] 覆盖精算学生竞赛**，**[[agrisky-ai]] 覆盖农业风险一侧**，**[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、**[[motor-pricing-glm]]、**[[openrater]]、**[[ratecraft]] 覆盖定价与 GLM**，**[[casdatasets]]、**[[ads-tutorials]] 覆盖公开数据与教程**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**由保险公司出题、**由高校平台主办**的农险定价竞赛工作包**：目标分解 ＋ **原件与派生分开 ＋ **许可依据可追**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[porto-seguro-competition]]、[[agrisky-ai]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① 纯保费**拆成频率 × 案均 × 暴露**，**并把暴露定义写成**可验证的等式**；**② **原件与派生文件**分开列，**并说明**过期即失效**；**③ **许可结论**要能追回它依据的**条款**；**④ **外部数据接入的特征**要标明**不在原始数据里**；**⑤ **匿名化列名**要点明**「**没有含义**」**，**免得别人去猜**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有下载该数据集的任何文件**（**未取三个竞赛 CSV、**未取 `Incendies.csv`、**未取任何派生文件、**未跑任何模型**），**故**不主张**其数据规模、**字段取值与任何模型表现**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何文件的正文**——**本次只读 Kaggle 数据集页的**元数据与描述**；**未打开**描述中提到的挑战页面（`challengedata.ens.fr/challenges/161`**）、**平台的**使用条款第 4.6.1 条**、**`Incendies.csv`、**BDIFF **数据集页**，**也**未核对** `train_input` **等文件的列名**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**「**平台条款默认采用 Etalab 开放许可**」**这一认定****（**⭐ 本词条**只转述描述中的推理**，**未读条款原文**）**；**⭐ 故**这份数据**能否再分发**，**本条**不作结论**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**该竞赛的**完整题目、**评分细节与排行榜**（**未访问挑战页面**）**；**也未核实**其**是否仍在进行**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** `CHARGE / CM` **等于 **`FREQ * ANNEE_ASSURANCE`** 这一恒等式**（**⭐ 只转述描述**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实** Pacifica **与** Crédit Agricole Assurances **的关系与产品细节**（**⭐ 描述称该保单为**农场多风险保单**，**本词条**只转述**）**；**⚠️ 并如实指出**：**这是一份**竞赛用数据**，**不得**当作任何真实保单的费率或经验**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实** BDIFF **的覆盖与更新节奏**（**⭐ 描述称** 2006–2022、**每年更新、**上游最后更新 **2025-12-13****，**本次**未访问该数据库页**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实**作者身份与所属**（**数据集所有者 **`Mario Defrance`** 可能是一个**参赛队或个人账号**，**⭐ 描述逐字称这些产物是**「**working data, plus the intermediate artefacts needed to re-run a full two-stage pricing model**」**）**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目的**主体性质**须说清**：**⭐ 它**不是**一个软件工具**，**而是**一份**竞赛数据与中间产物集合****（**⭐ 本词条据此把** `kind` **记为** `dataset`**）**。**⑩ ⚠️ 未核实**该数据集与**竞赛官方发布**是否一致**（**⭐ 描述称三个竞赛文件**未改动**，**但本次**未与原站比对**）**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**⭐ 数据集**最后更新 **2026-09-06**（**在解冻窗口之内**）**，**而**竞赛本身由其生产者页面显示**最后更新 **2024-12-05****（**远在窗口之外**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两个日期**，**并指出**本条收录的是**在窗口内被更新／被发布的这一份工作包**，**而不是**新出的竞赛**。**⑫ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。

**assurprime-ens-challenge**（Kaggle 資料集 `mariodefrance/caa-challenge-2025`，**逐字標題** `caa-challenge-2025`，**逐字副標題**「**AssurPrime — ENS Challenge Data #161 (Crédit Agricole Assurances)**」**）**是一份**法國農業多風險保單（Contrat Multirisque Agricole）火災純保費預測競賽的工作資料與中間產物****——**逐字自述任務為**「**The task: predict the pure fire premium on Pacifica的 Contrat Multirisque Agricole, the multi-risk policy French farmers take out to cover their holding. Fire is the dominant share of that contract的 claim burden.**」**。**本次實測**：**最後更新 2026-09-06**、**版本 2**、**1,826,672,247 位元組**、**可用性評分 0.94**、**下載 7 次、**瀏覽 14 次、**公開 notebook 2 個**；**所有者與創建者同為一人**（`Mario Defrance`**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：競賽**」**。

**⭐ 引號約定**：**本條目所引法語機構名中原為 ASCII 撇號者一律寫成彎撇號**（**U+2019**）**。

**可核實資訊（均 Kaggle 資料集頁元資料與描述實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 目標被拆成**兩個可分別建模的因子 ＋ 一個暴露量****——**逐字**「**The target decomposes as `CHARGE = FREQ x CM x ANNEE_ASSURANCE` so the challenge asks for two models — one for frequency (`FREQ`), one for average claim cost (`CM`) — scored on RMSE against a GLM benchmark (Poisson/log for frequency, Tweedie/log for severity).**」**，**並逐字補一句可核的恆等式**「**On rows with a claim, `CHARGE / CM` is exactly `FREQ * ANNEE_ASSURANCE`, an integer 1–5.**」**——**⭐ 即**一個純保費被拆成**頻率 × 案均 × 暴露年數**，**而**暴露量**在保單年數上取整數 1 至 5**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**哪些是競賽原件、**哪些是派生中間產物**」分開寫明****——**逐字**「**`frequency_2026.csv`, `oos_frequency_2026.csv` and `cm_carver_freq_tschuprowt_2026.json` are not challenge originals — they are produced by the frequency notebook and consumed by the severity notebook. Regenerate them whenever the frequency model changes; a stale pair describes a model that no longer exists.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**一份過期的派生檔案，描述的是一个已經不存在的模型**」**——**⭐ 它給出了**為什麼要重算**的理由**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 許可的認定路徑**逐條引用****——**逐字**「**Every file here is redistributed under the Etalab Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0, which permits reproduction, redistribution, adaptation and commercial reuse subject to attribution.**」**——**逐字**「**Per the platform的 terms of use article 4.6.1, Study Data is open under the Etalab Licence Ouverte by default unless the provider specifies otherwise in the challenge description; challenge #161 specifies nothing, so the default applies.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**為什麼可以再分發**」**是一條**可追溯的推理**，**而不是**一句「**開放資料**」。**⭐⭐ ④ 歸屬分三個來源逐條寫明**：**競賽文件**（**Study Data from ENS Challenge Data #161**，**Producer: Crédit Agricole Assurances, via ENS Challenge Data**，**來源** `challengedata.ens.fr/challenges/161`，**最後更新 2024-12-05**）；**`Incendies.csv`** 來自 **BDIFF**（**生產者逐字** IGN, for the Ministère de l’Agriculture et de la Souveraineté Alimentaire**，**覆蓋 2006–2022、**每年更新、**上游最後更新 2025-12-13、**抽取日 2025-03-21**）；**派生產物** carry the same terms**。**⭐ 三份來源各自給出**生產者、**來源網址與兩個日期**（**上游更新日與抽取日**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 變數族分類寫明，**並解釋為何有些列名沒有意義**：**目標** `FREQ`／`CM`／`CHARGE`**；**暴露** `ANNEE_ASSURANCE`（**逐字** years since the contract was taken out**）**；**地理**（**department ＋ weather/climate aggregates**）**；**合同**（**cultivateur／polyculteur 等活動、**保障標記、**建築數、**員工數、**承保時已申報賠案**）**；**⭐ 面積／**保額／**防護三族**逐字為**「**The provider anonymised these into `surface1..n`, `capital1..n`, `prev1..n` for confidentiality; the names carry no meaning by design.**」**——**⭐ 若不寫這一句，**使用者會花時間猜 `surface3` 是什麼**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 外部資料的接入點寫明**：`Incendies.csv`（**BDIFF 抽取、**24 列**）逐字** joined during feature engineering to build the burnt-area and extinction-rate features (`total_surface_2023`, `total_surface_5y`, `surface_over_forest`, `fire_extinction_rates`). Not part of the challenge distribution.**——**⭐ 即**這四個特徵是自己加的、**不在競賽資料裡**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 建模路徑一句話概括**——**逐字**「**carves every qualitative feature with AutoCarver and tunes XGBoost with Optuna, weighting the severity model的 samples by the frequency model的 absolute error.**」**——**⭐ 兩個模型不是各自獨立**，**一個的輸出被用作另一個的權重**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 工程形態可數**：**三個**未改動的競賽檔案**（`train_input_Z61KlZo.csv` 逐字 one row per policy-year, keyed on `ID`；`train_output_DzPxaPY.csv` 含 `ANNEE_ASSURANCE`／`FREQ`／`CM`／`CHARGE`；`test_input_5qJzHrr.csv`**）**；**三份派生檔案**（**序列化 AutoCarver `BinaryCarver`（light mode），**逐字** `CM` carved against the frequency target with Tschuprow的 T，**用於按案均金額分布分層切分訓練／驗證**；**兩份頻率預測，**逐字** `pred_sum` is the expected claim count**）**——**⭐ 用 Tschuprow 的 T 分層切分**值得記**：**切分不是隨機**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 與池內條目的關係**：[[porto-seguro-competition]]、[[allstate-claims-severity]]、[[actuarial-student-competitions]]、[[agrisky-ai]]、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、[[motor-pricing-glm]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[casdatasets]]、[[ads-tutorials]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**保險公司出題、高校平台主辦的農險定價競賽工作包：目標分解＋原件與派生分開＋許可依據可追**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[porto-seguro-competition]]、[[agrisky-ai]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 五點最值得借鑑**：**① 純保費**拆成頻率 × 案均 × 暴露**，**暴露定義寫成**可驗證的等式**；**② **原件與派生檔案**分開列，**並說明**過期即失效**；**③ **許可結論**要能追回依據的**條款**；**④ **外部資料接入的特徵**要標明**不在原始資料裡**；**⑤ **匿名化列名**要點明**「**沒有含義**」**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有下載該資料集任何檔案**（**未取三個競賽 CSV、**未取 `Incendies.csv`、**未取任何派生檔案、**未跑任何模型**），**不主張**其資料規模、**欄位取值與任何模型表現**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何檔案正文**——**只讀 Kaggle 資料集頁的**元資料與描述**；**未打開**挑戰頁面、**平台**使用條款第 4.6.1 條**、**`Incendies.csv`、**BDIFF **資料集頁**，**亦未核對** `train_input` **等檔案的列名**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**「**平台條款預設採用 Etalab 開放許可**」**這一認定**（**只轉述描述中的推理**，**未讀條款原文**）**——**⭐ **能否再分發**，**本條**不作結論**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**該競賽的**完整題目、**評分細節與排行榜**，**未核實**其是否仍在進行**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實** `CHARGE / CM` 等於 `FREQ * ANNEE_ASSURANCE` **這一恆等式**（**只轉述描述**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實** Pacifica **與** Crédit Agricole Assurances **的關係與產品細節**；**⚠️ 這是**競賽用資料**，**不得**當作任何真實保單的費率或經驗**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實** BDIFF **的覆蓋與更新節奏**（**未訪問該資料庫頁**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核實**作者身份與所屬**（**可能為參賽隊或個人帳號**）**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目的**主體性質**須說清**：**它**不是**軟體工具**，**而是**競賽資料與中間產物集合**（**⭐ 據此把 `kind` 記為 `dataset`**）**。**⑩ ⚠️ 未核實**該資料集與**競賽官方發布**是否一致**。**⑪ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**資料集**最後更新 2026-09-06（**窗口內**）**，**而**競賽生產者頁面顯示**最後更新 2024-12-05（**遠在窗口之外**）**——**⭐ 本條收錄的是**窗口內被更新／發布的這一份工作包**，**而不是**新出的競賽**。**⑫ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。
entries.body_en:
The Kaggle dataset caa-challenge-2025, subtitled as a challenge from a French higher-education challenge platform proposed by a large French insurer, **holds the working data and intermediate artefacts of a competition to predict the pure fire premium on a French farm multi-risk policy**, described verbatim as predicting the pure fire premium on the multi-risk policy French farmers take out to cover their holding, where fire is the dominant share of that contract claim burden. **Measured this round**: **last updated 2026-09-06**, **version 2**, **about 1.83 gigabytes**, **a usability rating of about 0.94**, seven downloads, fourteen views and two public notebooks, owned and created by the same person. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case a competition.**

**Quotation convention**: apostrophes inside the quoted French institution names are reproduced with a typographic apostrophe so that they are distinguishable from the quotation marks of this entry itself.

**Verified information, all measured from the dataset page metadata and description**: **first, the target is split into two separately modelled factors plus an exposure term**: verbatim, the target decomposes into a total cost equal to frequency times average claim cost times an age-of-contract exposure, so the challenge asks for two models, one for frequency and one for average claim cost, scored on root mean squared error against a generalised-linear-model benchmark using a log link for frequency under a Poisson assumption and for severity under a Tweedie assumption; and the description adds a checkable identity verbatim, that on rows with a claim the ratio of total cost to average claim cost is exactly frequency times the exposure, an integer between one and five. **A pure premium is decomposed into frequency, average cost and exposure, and the exposure definition is written as an equality anyone can test.** **Second, the files that are competition originals are separated from those that are derived**: verbatim, three named files are not challenge originals but are produced by the frequency notebook and consumed by the severity notebook, and they must be regenerated whenever the frequency model changes because a stale pair describes a model that no longer exists. **That last clause is the most copyable sentence in the description: a stale derived file describes a model that no longer exists, which gives the reason for regenerating rather than merely instructing it.** **Third, the licensing reasoning is cited clause by clause**: verbatim, every file is redistributed under the Etalab open licence, which permits reproduction, redistribution, adaptation and commercial reuse subject to attribution, and the challenge files are study data from the challenge platform where, per the platform terms of use article four point six point one, study data is open under the Etalab licence by default unless the provider specifies otherwise in the challenge description, and since this challenge specifies nothing the default applies. **Why the data may be redistributed is therefore a traceable argument resting on a named clause plus the absence of a contrary specification, rather than a bare assertion that the data is open.** **Fourth, attribution is split across three sources**: the challenge files, produced by a named insurer through the platform; a separate fire database file whose producer is stated as a national geographic and forestry institute acting for the agriculture ministry, with a stated coverage period, annual update cadence, an upstream update date and a local extraction date; and the derived artefacts, which carry the same terms. **Each source carries a producer, a source address and two dates, and the extraction date is precisely what makes the join reproducible.** **Fifth, the variable families are classified and the reason some column names carry no meaning is given**: targets, exposure defined verbatim as years since the contract was taken out, geography as department plus weather and climate aggregates, contract attributes covering the insured activity, guarantee subscription flags, building count, employee count and claims declared at underwriting, and three families covering surfaces, insured capital and protective equipment which the description states were anonymised into numbered columns for confidentiality, with the names carrying no meaning by design. **Saying that the column names are meaningless by construction stops a reader from spending time guessing what a numbered surface column means.** **Sixth, the point where external data enters the feature engineering is stated**: a forest-fire database extract with twenty-four columns was joined during feature engineering to build burnt-area and extinction-rate features, and the description states plainly that it is not part of the challenge distribution. **In a competition this matters, because a reader must be able to tell what the organisers supplied from what the entrant added.** **Seventh, the modelling route is summarised in one sentence**: the approach carves every qualitative feature with a named carving library and tunes gradient boosting with a named optimiser, weighting the severity samples by the absolute error of the frequency model. **The two models are not independent, since the output of one becomes a weight in the other, which is also why the derived files must not go stale.** **Eighth, the engineering shape is countable**: three unmodified competition files, one keyed per policy-year, one carrying the four target and exposure columns, and one out-of-sample covariate file; plus three derived files, a serialised carving configuration produced by carving the average claim cost against the frequency target using a named association measure and used to stratify the train and development split by the claim-amount distribution, and two frequency prediction files whose summed prediction is stated to be the expected claim count. **Stratifying the split by the target distribution rather than splitting at random is worth noting.** **Ninth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover competition datasets for motor insurance and claim severity, student actuarial competitions, agricultural risk, pricing models and generalised linear models, and public datasets with tutorials, **while this entry supplies a competition working package set by an insurer and hosted by an academic platform, with a decomposed target, originals separated from derived files, and a traceable licensing argument. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled motor insurance competition dataset and the pooled agricultural risk entry**; **five practices transfer directly: decompose a pure premium into frequency, average cost and exposure and write the exposure definition as a checkable equality; list originals separately from derived files and say why a stale derived file is worse than useless; make a licensing conclusion traceable to the clause it rests on; mark features that came from external data as absent from the original distribution; and state that anonymised column names are meaningless by design**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no file from the dataset was downloaded** — none of the three competition files, not the fire database extract, no derived file and no model run — **so this entry claims nothing about data scale, field values or any model performance**. **Second, no file body was read**: only the dataset page metadata and description were read, and the challenge page, the platform terms of use article, the fire database extract and the source record for that database were not opened, nor were the column names of the competition files checked; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the argument that the platform terms default to the Etalab licence was not verified**, this entry relaying the reasoning in the description without reading the clause, **and this entry therefore draws no conclusion about whether the data may be redistributed**. **Fourth, the complete challenge statement, the scoring detail and any leaderboard were not verified, nor was whether the challenge is still running. Fifth, the stated identity linking total cost, average claim cost, frequency and exposure was not verified.** **Sixth, the relationship between the named insurer brand and the group was not verified, nor were product details**, and **this entry states plainly that this is competition data and must not be treated as the rate or experience of any real policy**. **Seventh, the coverage and update cadence of the fire database were not verified**, its page not having been visited. **Eighth, the author identity and affiliation were not verified**, the owner possibly being a competing team or an individual. **Ninth, the nature of this item must be stated plainly: it is not a software tool but a set of competition data and intermediate artefacts**, and its kind is recorded as a dataset accordingly. **Tenth, whether this dataset matches the official competition release was not verified**, the description stating that the three competition files are unmodified. **Eleventh, on the window: the dataset was last updated 2026-09-06, inside the thaw window, while the producer page for the challenge states a last update of 2024-12-05, far outside it, so what is collected here is a working package updated inside the window rather than a newly created competition. Twelfth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**

Regenerate them whenever the frequency model changes; a stale pair describes a model that no longer exists.／许可逐字 Every file here is redistributed under the Etalab Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0, which permits reproduction, redistribution, adaptation and commercial reuse subject to attribution.／Per the platform的 terms of use article 4.6.1, Study Data is open under the Etalab Licence Ouverte by default unless the provider specifies otherwise in the challenge description; challenge #161 specifies nothing, so the default applies.／Producer: Crédit Agricole Assurances, via ENS Challenge Data、Source https://challengedata.ens.fr/challenges/161、Last updated: 2024-12-05／Incendies.csv：Producer Institut national de l information géographique et forestière (IGN), for the Ministère de l Agriculture et de la Souveraineté Alimentaire、Source https://bdiff.agriculture.gouv.fr/ 与 data.gouv.fr 记录、Coverage 2006–2022, updated annually; upstream last updated 13 December 2025、Extraction date: 2025-03-21／Derived artefacts 亦 carry the same terms｜⚠️未下载任何文件（未取三个竞赛 CSV、未取 Incendies.csv、未取任何派生文件、未跑任何模型），不主张其数据规模、字段取值与任何模型表现｜⚠️未读任何文件正文（只读 Kaggle 元数据与描述；未打开挑战页面、平台使用条款第 4.6.1 条、Incendies.csv、BDIFF 数据集页，亦未核对 train_input 等文件的列名）——本条目最需后续核实的一处｜⚠️未核实「平台条款默认采用 Etalab 开放许可」这一认定（只转述描述中的推理，未读条款原文），故能否再分发本条不作结论｜⚠️未核实该竞赛的完整题目、评分细节与排行榜，未核实其是否仍在进行｜⚠️未核实 CHARGE / CM 等于 FREQ * ANNEE_ASSURANCE 这一恒等式（只转述描述）｜⚠️未核实 Pacifica 与 Crédit Agricole Assurances 的关系与产品细节；这是竞赛用数据，不得当作任何真实保单的费率或经验｜⚠️未核实 BDIFF 的覆盖与更新节奏（未访问该数据库页）｜⚠️未核实作者身份与所属（可能为参赛队或个人账号）；本条不是软件工具而是竞赛数据与中间产物集合，kind 记为 dataset｜⚠️未核实该数据集与竞赛官方发布是否一致（描述称三个竞赛文件 Unmodified）｜⚠️窗口状况：数据集最后更新 2026-09-06（窗口内），而竞赛生产者页面显示最后更新 2024-12-05（窗口之外）——本条收录的是窗口内被更新／发布的这一份工作包，不是新出的竞赛｜⚠️本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见

entries.title: **一个**自动跟随上游的镜像**：第 983 版、每天更新、**并把上游的解读告诫一起搬过来****：Kaggle 数据集 `joebeachcapital/covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates`——**⭐ 逐字副标题**「**Daily updates of the Economist covid19 Global Excess Deaths data**」**；**⭐ 它逐字保留上游的告诫**：**「**unless ranges are very narrow, the 95% range should be reported when possible**」**、**以及**「**Focusing on central estimates in such cases would be misleading**」**；**⭐ 并逐字写明**哪两个国家至今没有报告****；**⚠️ 体量在两个接口上给出**不一致**的数字（**10.45 GB 对 **2.85 GB****）**
entries.title_en: An automatically updating mirror of an upstream excess-mortality model whose version counter stands at nine hundred and eighty-three, which carries the upstream interpretation warnings across with the data, says that central estimates are misleading unless the uncertainty range is narrow, and names the two countries that have never reported.
entries.title_hk: **一個**自動跟隨上游的鏡像**：第 983 版、每天更新、**並把上游的解讀告誡一起搬過來****：Kaggle 資料集 `joebeachcapital/covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates`——**⭐ 逐字副標題**「**Daily updates of the Economist covid19 Global Excess Deaths data**」**；**⭐ 它逐字保留上游的告誡**：**「**unless ranges are very narrow, the 95% range should be reported when possible**」**、**以及**「**Focusing on central estimates in such cases would be misleading**」**；**⭐ 並逐字寫明**哪兩個國家至今沒有報告****；**⚠️ 體量在兩個介面上給出**不一致**的數字（**10.45 GB 對 **2.85 GB****）**
entries.summary: **global-excess-deaths-mirror**（Kaggle 数据集 `joebeachcapital/covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates`）**是一份**自动跟随上游模型输出的**超额死亡每日镜像****——**逐字副标题为**「**Daily updates of the Economist的 Covid19 Global Excess Deaths data**」**，**并逐字给出上游仓库地址**（**`TheEconomist/covid-19-the-economist-global-excess-deaths-model`**）**。**本次实测**：**最后更新 2026-09-10**、**版本号 **983****、**许可 **CC BY 4.0****、**可用性评分 **0.82****、**下载 **1,767 次、**浏览 **7,728 次、**收藏 **35**；**标签逐字含** `business`、`economics`、`time series analysis`、`global`、`covid19`、`diseases`、`mortality`**；**⚠️ 而**体量在两个接口上**不一致**（**数据集页给 **10,451,025,952 字节、**列表接口给约 **2.85 GB****）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：镜像**」**——**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **版本号 **983****（**⭐ 即**这不是一份快照，**而是一条**每天推进的线****）**；**② **上游的**解读告诫被一起搬过来****（**⭐ 包括**「**报告 95% 区间**」与**「**盯中心估计会误导**」**）**；**③ **逐字写明**哪两个国家从未报告****。**⚠️ 本次未下载任何文件、**未访问上游仓库。
entries.summary_hk: **global-excess-deaths-mirror**（Kaggle 資料集 `joebeachcapital/covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates`）**是一份**自動跟隨上游模型輸出的**超額死亡每日鏡像****——**逐字副標題為**「**Daily updates of the Economist的 Covid19 Global Excess Deaths data**」**，**並逐字給出上游倉庫地址**（`TheEconomist/covid-19-the-economist-global-excess-deaths-model`**）**。**本次實測**：**最後更新 2026-09-10**、**版本號 **983****、**許可 **CC BY 4.0****、**可用性評分 **0.82****、**下載 **1,767 次、**瀏覽 **7,728 次、**收藏 **35**；**標籤逐字含** `business`、`economics`、`time series analysis`、`global`、`covid19`、`diseases`、`mortality`**；**⚠️ 而**體量在兩個介面上**不一致**（**10,451,025,952 位元組 對 約 **2.85 GB****）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：鏡像**」**——**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **版本號 **983****；**② **上游的**解讀告誡被一起搬過來****；**③ **逐字寫明**哪兩個國家從未報告****。**⚠️ 本次未下載任何檔案、**未訪問上游倉庫。
entries.summary_en: The Kaggle dataset covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates **is a daily mirror of an upstream excess-mortality model output**, subtitled as daily updates of a newspaper excess deaths dataset and giving the upstream repository address. **Measured this round**: **last updated 2026-09-10**, **version 983**, **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, **a usability rating of about 0.82**, one thousand seven hundred and sixty-seven downloads, seven thousand seven hundred and twenty-eight views and thirty-five votes, tagged with business, economics, time series analysis, global, covid, diseases and mortality, and **a size that the two public endpoints state differently** at about ten gigabytes and about two point eight five gigabytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case a mirror**, and **three things are worth reading: a version counter in the hundreds shows that this is a moving line rather than a snapshot; the upstream interpretation warnings are carried across with the data, including the instruction to report the ninety-five percent range when ranges are not narrow and the warning that focusing on central estimates would be misleading; and the two countries that have never reported are named**. **No file was downloaded and the upstream repository was not visited.**
entries.body:
**global-excess-deaths-mirror**（Kaggle 数据集 `joebeachcapital/covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates`，**逐字标题** `Covid19 Global Excess Deaths (daily updates)`**）**是一份**自动跟随上游模型输出的超额死亡每日镜像****——**逐字副标题为**「**Daily updates of the Economist的 Covid19 Global Excess Deaths data**」**，**并逐字给出上游仓库地址**「**from the Economist的 GitHub repository: `TheEconomist/covid-19-the-economist-global-excess-deaths-model`**」**。**本次实测**：**最后更新 2026-09-10**、**版本号 **983****、**可用性评分 **0.82****、**下载 **1,767 次、**浏览 **7,728 次、**收藏 **35、**公开 notebook 2 个**；**所有者与创建者为同一人**（`Joakim Arvidsson`**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：镜像**」**。

**⭐ 引号约定**：**本条目所引英文专名与作品名中原为 ASCII 撇号者一律写成弯撇号**（**U+2019**）**。

**可核实信息（均 Kaggle 数据集页元数据与描述实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 许可与版本号写明这是一条**每天推进的线****——**实测**许可字段逐字为**「**Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**」**，**而**版本号逐字为 **983****（**⭐ 即**同一份数据集**已经被**连续更新九百多次**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**版本号本身是一条信息****：**⭐ 即**「**这不是一份做好的数据集**」**，**而是一条**跟着上游模型每天重算的线**——**⭐ 这与本站第 353 轮「**同源多形**」、第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」同向**：**当你收录的是一份**镜像**时，**必须**说清它**跟着谁、**多久变一次**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 上游的**解读告诫**被一起搬过来**——**逐字**：**「**Estimating excess deaths for every country every day since the pandemic began is a complex and difficult task. Rather than being overly confident in a single number, limited data means that we can often only give a very very wide range of plausible values. **Focusing on central estimates in such cases would be misleading: unless ranges are very narrow, the 95% range should be reported when possible.** The ranges assume that the conditions for bootstrap confidence intervals are met.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**镜像**通常只搬数字**，**而这一份**把上游的**「**别只看中心值**」**一起搬了**——**⭐ 这与本站第 347 轮「**防误读**」、第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**：**当一份数据**主要是区间**而不是点估计**时，**告诫**是数据的一部分**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它还逐字写明**哪些国家没有数据、**为什么****——**逐字**：**「**Turkmenistan and the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea have not reported any covid-19 figures since the start of the pandemic. They also have not published all-cause mortality data. **Exports of estimates for the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea have been temporarily disabled as it now issues contradictory data**: reporting a significant outbreak through its state media, but zero confirmed covid-19 cases/deaths to the WHO.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**这一列为什么是空**」**被写成**一句有名有姓的说明**，**而**且**包含一处**主动停发**（**逐字** temporarily disabled**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 341 轮「**三种缺席**」同向**：**缺席**不是**空白**，**而是**有原因的状态**。**⭐⭐ ④ 它把**不确定性的适用范围**也写明**——**逐字**：**关于变异株**「**The Omicron variant appears to have characteristics that are different to earlier versions of sars-cov-2. Where this variant is now dominant, this change makes estimates uncertain beyond the ranges indicated. Other new variants may do the same. As more data is incorporated from places where new variants are dominant, predictions improve.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**区间之外还有不确定性**」**这一句**被主动写出来**——**⭐ 本词条认为这与**第 3 点**合起来构成**一份罕见完整的**数据说明书**：**数值、**区间、**缺席、**以及**区间本身何时不够用**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 上游的**方法归属**被逐字给出**——**逐字**：**① **拟合算法**「**The gradient booster implementation used to fit the models is aGTBoost**」**；**② **作者**「**All coding and data collection to construct these models (and make them update dynamically) was done by Sondre Ulvund Solstad.**」**，**并逐字给出联系方式**（**推为**对应的作者邮箱**）**；**③ **致谢**列出一串人名（**含** Ariel Karlinsky、**Philip Schellekens** 等**）**；**④ **建议引用格式**逐字为**「**The Economist and Solstad, S. (corresponding author), 2021. The pandemic**弯撇号**s true death toll. [online] The Economist.**」**，**并逐字写明**首次发表于 **2021 年第 20 期的一篇文章**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组值得抄**：**⭐ 即**一份**由媒体机构产出的估算**，**把**算法、**作者、**致谢与引用格式**都放进了数据集说明里**——**⭐ 而**这正是**学术使用者**最需要的东西**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 开放修改也被写明**——**逐字**：**「**Calculating excess deaths for the entire world over multiple years is both complex and imprecise. **We welcome any suggestions on how to improve the model, be it data, algorithm, or logic. If you have one, please open an issue.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**如何提出修正**」被指向**上游的 issue 流程**——**⭐ 这与本站第 337 轮「**没有任何东西站在单一来源上**」同向**：**一个估算**要能被质询**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 一处**两个接口不一致**（本次实测）**：**⭐ 数据集页接口给出总字节 **10,451,025,952**（**约 10.45 GB**）**，**而**列表接口给出约 **2.85 GB**（**2,850.54 MB**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两个数字而不替它调和**，**并指出**这正是**镜像类数据集**常见的现象**（**⭐ 体量随版本变化，**而两个接口**不一定取同一版本**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[rki-excess-mortality]] 覆盖德国官方超额死亡报告数据**，**[[excessmort]] 覆盖 R 的超额死亡建模包**，**[[lost-years]] 覆盖寿命损失年**，**[[who-gho]]、**[[ihme-gbd]] 覆盖全球卫生观测与疾病负担**，**[[human-mortality-db]] 覆盖历史死亡率数据**，**[[mortality-analysis-provenance]] 覆盖死亡率分析的证据分栏**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**第三方镜像**：**每天跟随上游模型、**并把上游的区间告诫、**缺席说明与引用格式一并搬过来**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[rki-excess-mortality]]、[[excessmort]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的四点**：**① **镜像要写明它跟着谁、**多久变一次、**版本号是多少**；**② **上游的解读告诫**应当与数值一起搬运**；**③ **数据为空时要写清**原因**（**含**主动停发**）**；**④ **区间之外的不确定性**也要写出来**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有下载该数据集的任何文件**（**未取任何 CSV 或版本、**未复算任何国家的超额死亡估计**），**故**不主张**其任何数值结果**（**⭐ 包括各年各国的中心估计与 95% 区间**）**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未访问上游仓库**（`TheEconomist/covid-19-the-economist-global-excess-deaths-model`**）**，**也未读其方法学页面**；**⭐ 本词条所转述的一切告诫、**归属与引用格式**都只来自 Kaggle 数据集页的描述**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**上游仓库**是否仍在维护、**以及**其最新版本与本镜像的版本是否同步**（**⭐ 描述称**每天更新**，**但本次**未核对该时间序列**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**上述两个体量数字**孰为准**（**⭐ 本词条**只并列**）**；**⭐ 也未核实** 983 **这一版本号是否对应**真正的更新次数**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**「**区间基于自助法置信区间的前提**」**这一表述**在方法学上**是否准确**（**⭐ 只转述描述**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实** Turkmenistan **与** DPRK **的实际情况**（**⭐ 本词条只转述描述与上游的说法，**不对任何国家的数据发布状况作判断**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实** aGTBoost **这一实现**（**⭐ 描述称它是用于拟合的梯度提升实现**，**本次**未查证**）**；**也未核实**其许可**。**⑧ ⚠️ **许可与使用**：**⭐ 本数据集页的许可字段为** CC BY 4.0**（**须署名**）**；**⚠️ 而**其内容**来自上游**（**媒体机构与具名作者的模型**）**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**引用时**应使用**描述中给出的建议引用格式**，**而不只引 Kaggle 页面**。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核实** Kaggle **下载是否需要登录**；**也未核实**该数据集是否包含**派生列或仅上游原样输出**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目的**性质**须说清**：**它**不是**一个模型或工具**，**而是**一份**跟随上游的镜像数据集**（**⭐ 据此把 `kind` 记为** `dataset`**）**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本条目的**主题相关性**须如实说明**：**⭐ 它属于**死亡率方向**（**而非保险定价或准备金**）**，**其被收录是因为**超额死亡**是寿险与年金研究的常用输入**，**而**本条的核心价值在**镜像与告诫的搬运方式**，**不在**其数值本身**。**⑫ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**⭐ 最后更新 **2026-09-10**（**在解冻窗口之内**）**；**⚠️ 而其上游模型**自 **2021** 年起持续更新**，**本条收录的是**在窗口内被更新到的那一版**，**而不是**一份新数据集**。**⑬ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。

**⭐ 引號約定**：**本條目所引英文專名與作品名中原為 ASCII 撇號者一律寫成彎撇號**（**U+2019**）**。

**可核實資訊（均 Kaggle 資料集頁元資料與描述實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 許可與版本號寫明這是一條**每天推進的線****——**許可欄位逐字為**「**Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**」**，**版本號逐字為 983****（**⭐ 即**同一份資料集已被連續更新九百多次**）**。**⭐ **版本號本身是一條資訊****：**這不是一份做好的資料集**，**而是一條跟著上游模型每天重算的線**——**⭐ 收錄鏡像時必須說清它**跟著誰、**多久變一次****。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 上游的**解讀告誡**被一起搬過來****——**逐字**「**Rather than being overly confident in a single number, limited data means that we can often only give a very very wide range of plausible values. Focusing on central estimates in such cases would be misleading: unless ranges are very narrow, the 95% range should be reported when possible. The ranges assume that the conditions for bootstrap confidence intervals are met.**」**——**⭐ 即**鏡像通常只搬數字**，**而這一份**把上游的「**別只看中心值**」**一起搬了**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 逐字寫明**哪些國家沒有資料、**為什麼****——**逐字**「**Turkmenistan and the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea have not reported any covid-19 figures since the start of the pandemic. They also have not published all-cause mortality data. Exports of estimates for the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea have been temporarily disabled as it now issues contradictory data: reporting a significant outbreak through its state media, but zero confirmed covid-19 cases/deaths to the WHO.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**這一列為什麼是空**」**被寫成一句有名有姓的說明**，**且**包含一處**主動停發****。**⭐⭐ ④ 不確定性的適用範圍也寫明**——**逐字**「**The Omicron variant appears to have characteristics that are different to earlier versions of sars-cov-2. Where this variant is now dominant, this change makes estimates uncertain beyond the ranges indicated.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**區間之外還有不確定性**」**被主動寫出**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 上游的**方法歸屬**逐字給出**：**擬合算法** aGTBoost**；**作者** All coding and data collection to construct these models (and make them update dynamically) was done by Sondre Ulvund Solstad**；**致謝**一串人名**；**建議引用格式**逐字為**「**The Economist and Solstad, S. (corresponding author), 2021. The pandemic**彎撇號**s true death toll.**」**，**並逐字寫明首發於 **2021 年第 20 期一篇文章**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 開放修改寫明**——**逐字**「**We welcome any suggestions on how to improve the model, be it data, algorithm, or logic. If you have one, please open an issue.**」**——**⭐ 即**修正路徑指向上游 issue 流程**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 一處**兩個介面不一致**（本次實測）**：**資料集頁給 **10,451,025,952 位元組**（**約 10.45 GB**）**，**列表介面給約 **2.85 GB**（**2,850.54 MB**）**——**⭐ 如實並列而不替它調和**，**並指出這是**鏡像類資料集**常見現象**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 與池內條目的關係**：[[rki-excess-mortality]]、[[excessmort]]、[[lost-years]]、[[who-gho]]、[[ihme-gbd]]、[[human-mortality-db]]、[[mortality-analysis-provenance]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**第三方鏡像：每天跟隨上游模型＋把上游的區間告誡、**缺席說明與引用格式一併搬過來**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[rki-excess-mortality]]、[[excessmort]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 四點最值得借鑑**：**① **鏡像要寫明跟著誰、**多久變一次、**版本號多少**；**② **上游的解讀告誡**應與數值一起搬運**；**③ **資料為空時要寫清**原因**（**含主動停發**）**；**④ **區間之外的不確定性**也要寫出**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有下載該資料集任何檔案**（**未取任何 CSV 或版本、**未複算任何國家的超額死亡估計**），**不主張**其任何數值結果**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未訪問上游倉庫**，**也未讀其方法學頁面**；**⭐ 本條所轉述的告誡、**歸屬與引用格式**都只來自 Kaggle 描述**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**上游是否仍在維護、**以及**其最新版本與本鏡像是否同步**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**上述兩個體量數字**孰為準****（**只並列**）**；**未核實 **983** 這一版本號是否對應真正的更新次數**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**「**區間基於自助法前提**」**這一表述在方法學上是否準確**（**只轉述描述**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實** Turkmenistan **與** DPRK **的實際情況**（**⭐ 只轉述描述與上游說法，**不對任何國家的資料發布狀況作判斷**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實** aGTBoost **這一實現與其許可**。**⑧ ⚠️ **許可與使用**：**本資料集頁許可為** CC BY 4.0**（**須署名**）**；**⚠️ 而**其內容來自上游**（**媒體機構與具名作者的模型**）**——**⭐ 引用時應使用**描述中給出的建議引用格式**，**而不只引 Kaggle 頁面**。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核實** Kaggle **下載是否需要登入**；**未核實**其是否含派生欄位**。**⑩ ⚠️ **性質**須說清**：**它不是**模型或工具**，**而是**跟隨上游的鏡像資料集**（**⭐ `kind` 記為 `dataset`**）**。**⑪ ⚠️ **主題相關性**如實說明**：**⭐ 屬**死亡率方向**（**而非保險定價或準備金**）**，**收錄原因是**超額死亡是壽險與年金研究的常用輸入**，**而**核心價值在**鏡像與告誡的搬運方式**。**⑫ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**最後更新 2026-09-10（**窗口內**）**；**⚠️ 上游模型自 2021 年起持續更新**，**本條收錄的是**窗口內被更新到的那一版**。**⑬ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。
entries.body_en:
The Kaggle dataset covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates, titled as excess deaths with daily updates, **is a daily mirror of an upstream excess-mortality model output**, subtitled as daily updates of a newspaper excess deaths dataset and giving the upstream repository address verbatim. **Measured this round**: **last updated 2026-09-10**, **version 983**, **a usability rating of about 0.82**, one thousand seven hundred and sixty-seven downloads, seven thousand seven hundred and twenty-eight views, thirty-five votes and two public notebooks, owned and created by the same person. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case a mirror.**

**Quotation convention**: apostrophes inside quoted English proper names and titles are reproduced with a typographic apostrophe so that they are distinguishable from the quotation marks of this entry itself.

**Verified information, all measured from the dataset page metadata and description**: **first, the licence and the version number show that this is a moving line rather than a finished dataset**: the licence field reads as a Creative Commons attribution licence, while the version counter stands at nine hundred and eighty-three, meaning the same dataset has been updated several hundred times in sequence. **When what is collected is a mirror rather than an original, the version counter itself is information: it says who is being followed and how often the content changes.** **Second, the upstream interpretation warnings are carried across with the data**: verbatim, rather than being overly confident in a single number, limited data often permits only a very wide range of plausible values, focusing on central estimates in such cases would be misleading, the ninety-five percent range should be reported when possible unless ranges are very narrow, and the ranges assume that the conditions for bootstrap confidence intervals are met. **A mirror usually carries only numbers; this one carries the upstream instruction not to look at the central estimate alone, which matters because a dataset that is mostly an interval should be read as an interval.** **Third, the countries with no data and the reasons are stated verbatim**: two named countries have not reported any figures since the start of the pandemic and have not published all-cause mortality data, and exports of estimates for one of them have been temporarily disabled because it now issues contradictory data, reporting a significant outbreak through state media while reporting zero confirmed cases and deaths to the world health organisation. **Why a column is empty is written as a statement with names in it, including a case where publication was deliberately suspended, which is the difference between an absence and a blank.** **Fourth, the scope of the uncertainty is also stated**: verbatim, a later variant appears to have characteristics different from earlier versions, and where that variant is now dominant the change makes estimates uncertain beyond the ranges indicated, while other new variants may do the same. **Numbers, intervals, absences and the conditions under which the intervals themselves stop being sufficient together make an unusually complete data note.** **Fifth, the upstream method attribution is given item by item**: the gradient boosting implementation used to fit the models is named; all coding and data collection including the dynamic updating is attributed to a named author with contact details; a list of acknowledgements is given; and a suggested citation is provided verbatim naming the newspaper and the author with the year and article title, together with the issue in which it first appeared. **A media-produced estimate that places its algorithm, author, acknowledgements and citation format inside the dataset description gives academic users exactly what they need.** **Sixth, the route for corrections is stated**: verbatim, calculating excess deaths for the entire world over multiple years is both complex and imprecise, and suggestions on data, algorithm or logic are welcome through the upstream issue tracker. **A correction path pointing at the upstream tracker is what lets an estimate be challenged.** **Seventh, one inconsistency between two endpoints was measured**: the dataset page reports a total of about ten gigabytes while the listing endpoint reports about two point eight five gigabytes, and this entry records both without reconciling them, noting that this is a common feature of mirrored datasets whose size changes with the version and whose endpoints may not be read at the same version. **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover an official national excess-mortality report, an R package for excess-mortality modelling, years of life lost, global health observation and burden-of-disease data, historical mortality data and a provenance framework for mortality analysis, **while this entry supplies a third-party mirror that follows an upstream model daily and carries the upstream interval warnings, absence explanations and citation format across with the numbers. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled national excess-mortality data and the pooled excess-mortality modelling package**; **four practices transfer directly: a mirror should state who it follows, how often it changes and what version it is on; upstream interpretation warnings should be carried with the numbers; when a column is empty, say why, including cases of deliberate suspension; and uncertainty beyond the stated interval should be written down too**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no file from the dataset was downloaded** — no version, no table and no recomputation of any country excess-mortality estimate — **so no numerical result is claimed, including any central estimate or interval**. **Second, the upstream repository was not visited and its methodology page was not read**: everything relayed here about warnings, attribution and citation format comes from the dataset page description alone; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the upstream is still maintained and whether its latest version matches this mirror were not verified**, the description stating daily updates without the time series being checked. **Fourth, which of the two stated sizes is correct was not verified**, both being recorded side by side, nor was it verified whether the version counter corresponds to the number of real updates. **Fifth, whether the statement that the ranges rest on bootstrap confidence interval conditions is methodologically accurate was not verified**, this entry relaying the description. **Sixth, the actual reporting situation of the two named countries was not verified**, and this entry relays the upstream account without making any judgement about any country data publication. **Seventh, the named gradient boosting implementation and its licence were not verified. Eighth, on licensing and use**: the dataset page is licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence, while the content comes from an upstream model by a media organisation and a named author, so **citations should follow the suggested format in the description rather than citing only the dataset page**. **Ninth, whether downloading requires signing in was not verified, nor was it checked whether the mirror adds derived columns or reproduces the upstream output unchanged. Tenth, the nature of this item must be stated plainly**: it is not a model or a tool but a mirror dataset following an upstream, and its kind is recorded as a dataset. **Eleventh, its topical relevance should be stated honestly**: it sits on the mortality side rather than in insurance pricing or reserving, it is collected because excess mortality is a customary input to life and annuity research, and **its value here lies in how the mirror carries the warnings, not in the numbers themselves**. **Twelfth, on the window: the last update was 2026-09-10, inside the thaw window, while the upstream model has been updating since 2021, so what is collected is the version current inside the window rather than a newly created dataset. Thirteenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**

entries.title: **一份**测「**别说过头话**」的医疗授权基准**：180 个合成精神科住院授权案例，**每个都带一组 `do_not_claim`****：仓库与 Kaggle 数据集 `Shivi1982/clin-auth-bench`——**⭐ 它针对的不是抽取或分类，**而是**逐字**「**evidence discipline across dense multi-form case documentation**」**；**⭐ 检索契约是**盲的****——**逐字**「**It does not send `metadata.gold`, `evidence_anchors`, `do_not_claim`, `documentation_challenge`, or `documentation_challenge_tags`**」**；**⭐ 而结果表逐字声明**「**should not be interpreted as clinical performance, payer-policy performance, or real-world authorization safety**」**
entries.title_en: A benchmark for health authorization reasoning built from one hundred and eighty synthetic inpatient psychiatric cases, each carrying a set of tempting but unsupported conclusions the model must avoid, retrieved under a blind contract that withholds the gold labels and evidence anchors, and reported with an explicit statement that the scores are not clinical, payer-policy or real-world authorization performance.
entries.title_hk: **一份**測「**別說過頭話**」的醫療授權基準**：180 個合成精神科住院授權案例，**每個都帶一組 `do_not_claim`****：倉庫與 Kaggle 資料集 `Shivi1982/clin-auth-bench`——**⭐ 它針對的不是抽取或分類，**而是**逐字**「**evidence discipline across dense multi-form case documentation**」**；**⭐ 檢索契約是**盲的****——**逐字**「**It does not send `metadata.gold`, `evidence_anchors`, `do_not_claim`, `documentation_challenge`, or `documentation_challenge_tags`**」**；**⭐ 而結果表逐字聲明**「**should not be interpreted as clinical performance, payer-policy performance, or real-world authorization safety**」**
entries.summary: **clin-auth-bench**（GitHub 仓库 `Shivi1982/clin-auth-bench`；**同时有** Kaggle 数据集与 Hugging Face 数据集**）**是一份**合成住院授权基准****——**逐字自述为**「**a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark**」**，**v1 聚焦**成人精神科住院授权**、**逐字**「**over dense 72-hour synthetic case documentation**」**，**目的是**「**to test whether language models can reason over multi-form inpatient documentation without inventing unsupported authorization claims**」**。**本次实测**：**Kaggle 数据集最后更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 1**、**6,884,354 字节**、**可用性评分 **0.81****、**下载 16 次**；**⭐ 而** GitHub **仓库**创建 2026-06-04、**最后推送 2026-07-26**、**★0**、**Python**、**1,302 KB**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：合成**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **每个案例带一组**「**诱人但不被支持**」**的结论清单**（**逐字** `metadata.gold.do_not_claim`**）**；**② **检索是**盲的****（**不发送金标签、**证据锚点与那组清单**）**；**③ **检索失败、**解析失败、**模式不符**与**准确率**被**分开报告****（**且**失败按错误计入分母**）**；**④ **结果表**逐字声明它不是临床或支付方政策表现****。**⚠️ 无真实病历、**全部合成**。
entries.summary_hk: **clin-auth-bench**（GitHub 倉庫 `Shivi1982/clin-auth-bench`；**同時有** Kaggle 資料集與 Hugging Face 資料集**）**是一份**合成住院授權基準****——**逐字自述為**「**a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark**」**，**v1 聚焦**成人精神科住院授權**、**逐字**「**over dense 72-hour synthetic case documentation**」**，**目的是**「**to test whether language models can reason over multi-form inpatient documentation without inventing unsupported authorization claims**」**。**本次實測**：**Kaggle 資料集最後更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 1**、**6,884,354 位元組**、**可用性評分 0.81**、**下載 16 次**；**⭐ 而** GitHub **倉庫**建立 2026-06-04、**最後推送 2026-07-26**、**★0**、**Python**、**1,302 KB**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：合成**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **每個案例帶一組**「**誘人但不被支持**」**的結論清單**（`metadata.gold.do_not_claim`**）**；**② **檢索是**盲的****；**③ **檢索失敗、**解析失敗、**模式不符**與**準確率**被**分開報告****；**④ **結果表**逐字聲明它不是臨床或支付方政策表現****。**⚠️ 無真實病歷、**全部合成**。
entries.summary_en: The repository and dataset clin-auth-bench **is a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark**, described verbatim as testing whether language models can reason over multi-form inpatient documentation without inventing unsupported authorization claims, with the first version focused on adult inpatient psychiatric authorization over dense seventy-two-hour synthetic case documentation. **Measured this round**: **the Kaggle dataset was last updated 2026-09-10**, at **version 1**, **about 6.9 megabytes**, **a usability rating of about 0.81** and sixteen downloads, while **the GitHub repository was created 2026-06-04 and last pushed 2026-07-26**, with **zero stars**, **primarily Python** and about 1.3 megabytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case synthesis**, and **four things are worth reading: every case carries a set of tempting but unsupported conclusions that a model should avoid; retrieval is blind, withholding the gold labels, the evidence anchors and that list; retrieval failures, parsing failures, schema failures and accuracy are reported separately with failures counted as incorrect; and the results table states verbatim that the scores should not be interpreted as clinical, payer-policy or real-world authorization performance**. **There are no real patient records and everything is synthetic.**
entries.body:
**clin-auth-bench**（GitHub 仓库 `Shivi1982/clin-auth-bench`，**逐字仓库简介为**「**Synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark for evidence-grounded LLM evaluation**」**；**⭐ 同一份内容另以 Kaggle 数据集与 Hugging Face 数据集发布**）**是一份**合成住院授权基准****——**README 逐字自述为**「**ClinAuthBench is a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark. V1 focuses on adult inpatient psychiatric authorization over dense 72-hour synthetic case documentation.**」**，**并逐字写明目的**「**The benchmark is designed to test whether language models can reason over multi-form inpatient documentation without inventing unsupported authorization claims.**」**。**本次实测**：**Kaggle 数据集最后更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 1**、**6,884,354 字节**、**可用性评分 **0.81****、**下载 16 次、**浏览 10 次、**收藏 1**；**⭐ GitHub 仓库**创建 **2026-06-04**、**最后推送 **2026-07-26**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**、**约 1,302 KB**、**`README.md` 13,817 字节****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：合成**」**。

**可核实信息（均 README、Kaggle 数据集页描述与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它针对的**不是**抽取或分类，**而是**「**证据纪律**」****——**逐字**：**「**Many clinical NLP datasets evaluate extraction, single-note summarization, or classification. **ClinAuthBench targets a different failure mode: evidence discipline across dense multi-form case documentation where useful evidence is distributed across nursing notes, psychiatric progress notes, rating scales, medication-response notes, group notes, treatment-plan reviews, and discharge-planning documentation.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**它把**「**多形态文档里，**证据散在七种文书里**」**确定为**失败模式**——**⭐ 而不是**又一个抽取任务**；**⭐ 这与本站第 343 轮「**四个维度**」、第 337 轮「**没有任何东西站在单一来源上**」同向**：**结论要有出处**，**而**出处**可能分散在多处**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 每个案例带一组**「**诱人但不被支持**」**的结论清单**——**逐字**：**「**Explicit negative constraints: every case includes `metadata.gold.do_not_claim`, a set of **tempting but unsupported conclusions that models should avoid**.**」**，**并逐字给出另外两项**：**「**Evidence anchors: gold labels include supporting form hints, so evaluation can check whether claims are grounded in the case documentation.**」**与**「**Documentation-challenge taxonomy: v1 labels current-vs-historical risk, contradiction, lower-level-of-care barrier reasoning, and missing/invalid/stale structured evidence.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为 **`do_not_claim`** 这一设计值得单独抄**：**⭐ 即**评测不只问「**你答对了吗**」，**还问「**你有没有说出不该说的话**」**——**⭐ 这与本站第 347 轮「**防误读**」、第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**，**且**它把这条写成了**数据里的一个字段**（**而不是**评分时的一行说明**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 检索契约是**盲的，**且被逐字写明不发什么****——**逐字**：**「**The Hugging Face retrieval script sends only: task instructions, output JSON schema, `case["content"]`. **It does not send `metadata.gold`, `evidence_anchors`, `do_not_claim`, `documentation_challenge`, or `documentation_challenge_tags`.**」**，**并逐字说明三条检索路线**「**share the same blind retrieval contract.**」**——**逐字續**「**They differ only in the model provider and the API key they read from `.env`**」**（**逐字列出** Hugging Face 路由／**OpenAI／**Anthropic **三条，**各需自己的密钥**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**评测脚本不许看到答案**」**不是**口号**，**而是**一份**逐字段列出的**不发送清单**；**⭐ 而**「**三条路线只差提供方与密钥**」**保证了**跨模型可比**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 失败与成功被**分开报告，**且失败**按错误计入分母****——**逐字**：**「**Primary metrics use all expected cases as the denominator. **Retrieval failures, JSON parsing failures, and schema-validation failures count as incorrect.** Valid-only metrics are reported only as diagnostics.**」**，**并逐字说明为什么**「**The retrieval script intentionally does not parse, validate, or score outputs. Parsing/schema validation and scoring are separate local steps so that **retrieval failures, parse failures, schema failures, and benchmark accuracy can be reported separately**.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是整条最值得抄的纪律**：**⭐ 即**当模型**输出不是合法 JSON**时，**那**不是**「**无法评测**」，**而是**一个**错误**——**⭐ 而**把「**取不到**」「**解析不了**」「**不符合模式**」**分开统计**，**读者才能分辨**这是**模型的问题**还是**流程的问题**；**⭐ 这与本站第 348 轮「**自验证**」、第 344 轮「**把依据放在看得见的地方**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 全量 180 例的结果被**列成表，**并区分「**主指标**」与「**仅诊断**」****——**实测 README 逐字为**：**GPT-OSS 120B（**Hugging Face**）**180/180 合法 JSON、**180/180 通过模式、**safe-for-LLOC 准确率 **93.3%**、**LOS 精确匹配 **51.7%****；**GPT-5.2（**OpenAI**）**180/180 与 **180/180、**65.0%** 与 **33.9%****；**Llama 3 8B Instruct（**Hugging Face**）**78/180、**40/180、**17.2%** 与 **2.2%**（**逐字** valid-only 为 **77.5%** 与 **10.0%**）**，**并逐字标注该行为**「**Diagnostic smaller OSS model; many outputs failed the strict JSON/schema contract**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**把最小模型那一行**连同它**为什么难看**写在一起**是很有价值的做法**：**⭐ 即**它没有**只留下好看的模型**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 结果表的**适用范围**被逐字限定**——**逐字**：**「**These results should not be interpreted as clinical performance, payer-policy performance, or real-world authorization safety.**」**，**并在隐私一节逐字声明**「**Not affiliated with, derived from, or representative of any real healthcare provider, payer, or patient population.**」**。**⭐ 这与本站第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**：**一份基准的分数**不等于**你所评测的那个世界里的表现**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 服务方／路由**不可用**也被如实记为**排除项而非成绩****——**逐字**：**「**The Gemma, NVIDIA Nemotron, and Mixtral routes tested during setup could not be executed under the same Hugging Face chat-completions endpoint in the tested environment. **These are provider/router compatibility exclusions, not ClinAuthBench performance results.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一句值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**跑不起来**」**与「**表现不好**」**被分开**——**⭐ 这与本站第 356 轮「**没有收益的优化也被留下**」是同一类诚实**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 数据构成与生成方式被逐条写明**——**实测 README 与数据集页描述给出**：**180 例 = **120 例** `rule_based_v1` ＋ **60 例** `probabilistic_v1`****；**其中 **108 例**继续住院、**72 例**适合较低级别照护、**22 例**为矛盾／文件冲突**；**第 **121–180** 例**含概率型 MDP 轨迹元数据**；**生成方式逐字为**「**Markov Decision Process-style synthetic state transitions**」**；**并逐字说明**「**V1 does not train a policy. The MDP trajectory is synthetic generation metadata.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**最后这一句很关键**：**⭐ 即**「**MDP**」**这个词**容易被误读为**「**这是一个强化学习环境**」**，**而**作者**主动说明**它**只是生成元数据**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 公开内容与**有意不公开**的内容被分开写明**——**逐字**：**「**Local review batches, archive files, pilot files, audit result JSONs, generated QA outputs, raw/scored model-output JSONL files under `evals/model_outputs/`, caches, and `.DS_Store` files are intentionally excluded from the public repository. **Consolidated evaluation summaries under `evals/results/` are included.**」**。**⭐ 这与本站第 345 轮「**把平时留在内部的东西拿出来**」同向**：**⭐ 即**它**给出**了公开的边界**，**而**不是**让人猜**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 工程形态可数**——**README 的目录结构逐字为**：`data/release/synthetic_bh_cases_v1_mdp_180.json`**（**活跃发布文件**）**；`docs/` **含** `schema.md`、`release_notes.md`、`model_routing_notes.md`、`scaling_plan.md`**；`generators/` **含** `mdp_case_builder.py`、`form_templates.py` **与五个分批生成脚本**（`generate_v1_30/70/120/170/180.py`**）**；`qa/` **含** `qa_gpt_oss.py`、`Dataset_QA.py`**；`evals/` **含**三条检索脚本、**`score_model_outputs.py`、**`parsing.py`、**`metrics.py` **以及** `prompts/`／`schema/`／`config/`／`results/`／`scripts/`**；`notebooks/baseline_clinauthbench_v1.ipynb`**；**以及** `README.md`、`requirements.txt`、`LICENSE`、`DATA_LICENSE.md`、`CITATION.cff`**。**⭐ 本词条认为**五个分批生成脚本**（30／70／120／170／180**）是一处可抄的细节**：**⭐ 即**数据集**是**一批批长出来的**，**而**每一批的生成脚本**都留在仓库里**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 两个「**别乱做**」的命令被写明**——**逐字**：**① **确定性 QA**「**python qa/qa_gpt_oss.py --input data/release/synthetic_bh_cases_v1_mdp_180.json --guardrail-profile none --deterministic-only**」**；**② **重生成发布文件**「**python generators/generate_v1_180.py**」**，**并逐字警示**「**Do not regenerate the release file unless you intend to change the dataset version or verify reproducibility.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**这个命令会改变数据集**」**被提前警告**。**⭐⭐ ⑫ 隐私与局限被逐条列出**——**逐字**：**完全合成**（**由结构化合成案例规格、**MDP 式合成轨迹、**合成时间线与受控文书模板生成**）**；**不含真实病历、**抄录的病历文本、**PHI、**真实机构与员工姓名、**病案号、**电话、**地址或源系统标识**；**所有病历日期都是合成时间线产物**；**⭐ 局限逐字含**：**v1 为**评测规模**而非从零训练规模**；**仅成人**精神科住院**；**不含儿科、**老年、**仅急诊、**PHP／IOP、**门诊与仅住院式照护**；**合成文书比真实电子病历**更干净、**更统一**；**固定 72 小时窗口**；**授权标准被泛化**，**不与任何支付方、**机构、**电子病历、**合同或专有使用管理政策绑定**；**MDP 轨迹是合成生成元数据**，**不是观察到的临床转归**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组局限值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**合成文书比真实病历更干净**」**这一句**——**⭐ 它说明**基准分高**未必**代表真实场景可用**。**⭐⭐ ⑬ 许可被分成两层**——**逐字**：**「**Code in this repository is released under the Apache License 2.0. See `LICENSE`. The dataset file under `data/release/` is released under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (`CC BY 4.0`). See `DATA_LICENSE.md`.**」**；**⭐ 而** Kaggle 数据集页的许可字段逐字为**「**Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**」**，**并逐字给出**「**Dataset: CC BY 4.0. Code: Apache-2.0.**」**与**规范化记录 DOI**「**https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21577772**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**代码与数据分属两个许可**这一做法值得记**（**⭐ 而**本站第 357 轮的许可形态分类里**已有一类：**两个许可 → GitHub 识别为 **NOASSERTION****；**⭐ 本条实测** GitHub 许可字段确为 **NOASSERTION****）**。**⭐⭐ ⑭ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insqabench]]、**[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、**[[ins-mmbench]]、**[[claimscope-benchmark]]、**[[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] 覆盖各类保险与金融基准**，**[[medical-opinion-extractor]]、**[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、**[[clausegraph]] 覆盖医疗与条款文本处理**，**[[health-denial-appeals]]、**[[insurance-qa-evidence]]、**[[cloudhealthoffice]] 覆盖健康险理赔与拒付申诉**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**用合成案例测「**不许说过头话**」的授权基准**：**逐例给出不该下的结论 ＋ **盲检索契约 ＋ **把流程失败与模型失败分开计分**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[insqabench]]、[[health-denial-appeals]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① 在数据里**显式列出「**不该得出的结论**」**（**而不只在评分说明里**）**；**② **检索契约写明**不发送哪些字段**；**③ **取不到、**解析失败、**模式不符与准确率**分开统计**，**且**失败按错误计入分母**；**④ **服务方不兼容**要与**模型表现**分开记**；**⑤ **公开与不公开**的边界**写出来**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**（**未装依赖、**未跑任何检索脚本、**未跑任何评分脚本、**未下载数据集、**未复算表中任何一行**），**故**不主张**其 93.3%／51.7%／65.0%／17.2% 等任何数字**，**也不主张**该基准真的能区分模型**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何案例正文**——**本次只读** GitHub **`README.md`、**Kaggle 数据集页描述**、**仓库元数据与目录结构**；**未打开** `data/release/synthetic_bh_cases_v1_mdp_180.json`、**任何生成脚本、**任何评测脚本、**任何 `docs/` 文档、**`DATA_LICENSE.md` **与** `CITATION.cff`**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实 **180**、**108**、**72**、**22**、**120／60** 与 **121–180** 这些构成数字**（**⭐ 只转述 README 与数据集页**）**；**也未核实** `do_not_claim` **字段的实际内容与规模**（**逐字只知其为** a set of tempting but unsupported conclusions**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**表中三个模型的**实际运行环境、**时间与**提示词**（**⭐ 逐字只知三条检索路线共用同一契约**）**；**也未核实** `safe-for-LLOC` 与 `LOS` **两个指标的精确定义**（**⭐ 本词条**不展开缩写含义**，**以免替作者定义**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**「**盲检索**」**在代码层面是否真的成立****（**⭐ 例如**是否存在**其它路径把金标签带进提示**）**——**⭐ 本词条**只转述 README 的不发送清单**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**该基准**是否已被第三方使用或引用**；**也未核实**其**在 Hugging Face 上的版本与 Kaggle 版本是否同一份**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实** Zenodo **记录（** DOI `10.5281/zenodo.21577772`**）的**元数据与日期**（**⭐ 本次**未访问**）**；**⭐ 故**其**概念 DOI 与版本 DOI 的对应**本次**未核实**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**须说清**：**⭐ 被收录的是**在窗口内被更新／发布的** Kaggle 数据集（**最后更新 2026-09-10**）**；**⚠️ 而其**上游 GitHub 仓库**创建 **2026-06-04**、**最后推送 **2026-07-26****，**两者**都在解冻窗口之外**——**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两组日期**，**并指出**本条的核心代码与数据**早于窗口**，**窗口内变化的只是**发布渠道与（可能的）**数据集内容**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目的**性质**须说清**：**⭐ 它**既是**一个基准数据集**（**数据 + 金标签 + 挑战分类**）**，**也是一个**评测工具链**（**生成、**质检、**三路检索、**解析与评分脚本**）**——**⭐ 本词条按**其主要用途**把 `kind` 记为 `dataset`**，**并在此说明它同时含工具部分**。**⑩ ⚠️ 未核实**该基准**与任何真实支付方授权政策**的关系**（**⭐ 作者逐字声明**标准已被泛化、**不绑定任何支付方或专有使用管理政策**）**——**⚠️ 本条**不得**被理解为任何临床、**核保或理赔判断意见**。**⑪ ⚠️ 未核实**作者身份与机构**（**README 指向** `shivi1982.github.io` **作为其研究主页**，**本次**未访问**）**。**⑫ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。
