**clin-auth-bench**（GitHub 倉庫 `Shivi1982/clin-auth-bench`，**逐字倉庫簡介為**「**Synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark for evidence-grounded LLM evaluation**」**；**⭐ 同一份內容另以 Kaggle 資料集與 Hugging Face 資料集發布**）**是一份**合成住院授權基準****——**README 逐字自述為**「**ClinAuthBench is a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark. V1 focuses on adult inpatient psychiatric authorization over dense 72-hour synthetic case documentation.**」**，**並逐字寫明目的**「**The benchmark is designed to test whether language models can reason over multi-form inpatient documentation without inventing unsupported authorization claims.**」**。**本次實測**：**Kaggle 資料集最後更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 1**、**6,884,354 位元組**、**可用性評分 0.81**、**下載 16 次、**瀏覽 10 次、**收藏 1**；**⭐ GitHub 倉庫**建立 **2026-06-04**、**最後推送 **2026-07-26**、**★0**、**Python**、**約 1,302 KB**、**`README.md` 13,817 位元組****。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：合成**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、Kaggle 描述與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它針對的**不是**抽取或分類，**而是**「**證據紀律**」****——**逐字**「**Many clinical NLP datasets evaluate extraction, single-note summarization, or classification. ClinAuthBench targets a different failure mode: evidence discipline across dense multi-form case documentation where useful evidence is distributed across nursing notes, psychiatric progress notes, rating scales, medication-response notes, group notes, treatment-plan reviews, and discharge-planning documentation.**」**——**⭐ 即**它把「**證據散在七種文書裡**」**確定為**失敗模式**，**而不是**又一個抽取任務**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 每個案例帶一組**「**誘人但不被支持**」**的結論清單**——**逐字**「**Explicit negative constraints: every case includes `metadata.gold.do_not_claim`, a set of tempting but unsupported conclusions that models should avoid.**」**，**並逐字給出另兩項**：**Evidence anchors**（**金標籤含支持性文書提示，**故可檢查主張是否有依據**）與**Documentation-challenge taxonomy**（**v1 標註當前對歷史風險、**矛盾、**較低級別照護障礙推理、**以及缺失／無效／過期結構化證據**）**——**⭐ 即**評測不只問「**你答對了嗎**」，**還問「**你有沒有說出不該說的話**」**，**而**這一條**是資料裡的一個欄位**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 檢索契約是**盲的，**且逐字寫明不發什麼****——**逐字**「**The Hugging Face retrieval script sends only: task instructions, output JSON schema, `case["content"]`. It does not send `metadata.gold`, `evidence_anchors`, `do_not_claim`, `documentation_challenge`, or `documentation_challenge_tags`.**」**，**並逐字說明三條路線**「**share the same blind retrieval contract.**」**——**逐字續**「**They differ only in the model provider and the API key they read from `.env`**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 失敗與成功**分開報告，**失敗按錯誤計入分母****——**逐字**「**Primary metrics use all expected cases as the denominator. Retrieval failures, JSON parsing failures, and schema-validation failures count as incorrect. Valid-only metrics are reported only as diagnostics.**」**，**並逐字說明分離的理由**「**so that retrieval failures, parse failures, schema failures, and benchmark accuracy can be reported separately**」**——**⭐ 即**模型輸出不是合法 JSON **不是**「**無法評測**」，**而是**一個錯誤**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 全量 180 例結果列成表**：**GPT-OSS 120B（Hugging Face）**180/180、**180/180、**93.3%／**51.7%****；**GPT-5.2（OpenAI）**180/180、**180/180、**65.0%／**33.9%****；**Llama 3 8B Instruct**78/180、**40/180、**17.2%／**2.2%**（**逐字 valid-only 為 77.5%／10.0%**），**並逐字標註該行為** Diagnostic smaller OSS model; many outputs failed the strict JSON/schema contract**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 適用範圍被逐字限定**——**逐字**「**These results should not be interpreted as clinical performance, payer-policy performance, or real-world authorization safety.**」**，**並逐字聲明**「**Not affiliated with, derived from, or representative of any real healthcare provider, payer, or patient population.**」。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 服務方不兼容被記為**排除項而非成績****——**逐字**「**The Gemma, NVIDIA Nemotron, and Mixtral routes tested during setup could not be executed under the same Hugging Face chat-completions endpoint in the tested environment. These are provider/router compatibility exclusions, not ClinAuthBench performance results.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 資料構成與生成方式逐條寫明**：**180 例 = 120 例 `rule_based_v1` ＋ 60 例 `probabilistic_v1`****；**108 例**繼續住院、**72 例**適合較低級別照護、**22 例**矛盾／文件衝突**；**第 121–180 例**含概率型 MDP 軌跡元資料**；**生成方式逐字為** MDP-style synthetic state transitions**；**並逐字說明** V1 does not train a policy. The MDP trajectory is synthetic generation metadata.**——**⭐ 即**「**MDP**」**容易被誤讀為**強化學習環境**，**而作者主動說明它只是生成元資料**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 公開與**有意不公開**的邊界寫明**——**逐字**「**Local review batches, archive files, pilot files, audit result JSONs, generated QA outputs, raw/scored model-output JSONL files under `evals/model_outputs/`, caches, and `.DS_Store` files are intentionally excluded from the public repository. entries.body_en:
The repository and dataset clin-auth-bench, introduced on GitHub as a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark for evidence-grounded language model evaluation and also published as a dataset on two other platforms, **is a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark** whose first version focuses on adult inpatient psychiatric authorization over dense seventy-two-hour synthetic case documentation, and whose stated purpose is to test whether language models can reason over multi-form inpatient documentation without inventing unsupported authorization claims. **Measured this round**: **the dataset was last updated 2026-09-10**, at **version 1**, **about 6.9 megabytes**, **a usability rating of about 0.81**, sixteen downloads, ten views and one vote, while **the GitHub repository was created 2026-06-04 and last pushed 2026-07-26**, with **zero stars**, primarily Python, about 1.3 megabytes and a readme of nearly fourteen thousand bytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case synthesis.**

**Verified information, all measured from the readme, the dataset page description and the file listing**: **first, the target is not extraction or classification but evidence discipline**: verbatim, many clinical natural language processing datasets evaluate extraction, single-note summarization or classification, whereas this benchmark targets a different failure mode, namely evidence discipline across dense multi-form case documentation in which useful evidence is distributed across nursing notes, psychiatric progress notes, rating scales, medication-response notes, group notes, treatment-plan reviews and discharge-planning documentation. **The failure mode is therefore defined as evidence scattered across seven kinds of document rather than as yet another extraction task, which matches the standing principle that a conclusion must have a source and that its sources may be spread across several places.** **Second, every case carries a set of tempting but unsupported conclusions**: verbatim, every case includes a gold field listing tempting but unsupported conclusions that models should avoid; gold labels also include supporting form hints so that evaluation can check whether claims are grounded in the case documentation; and a documentation-challenge taxonomy labels current-versus-historical risk, contradiction, lower-level-of-care barrier reasoning, and missing, invalid or stale structured evidence. **Evaluation therefore asks not only whether the answer was right but whether the model said something it should not have said, and that constraint is a field in the data rather than a line in the scoring notes.** **Third, retrieval is blind and the withheld fields are enumerated verbatim**: verbatim, the retrieval script sends only task instructions, the output JSON schema and the case content, and does not send the gold labels, the evidence anchors, the do-not-claim set, the documentation challenge or its tags; the three retrieval routes are stated to share the same blind contract and to differ only in the model provider and the API key they read from the environment file. **Not letting the evaluation script see the answers is written as an itemised list of withheld fields rather than as a slogan, and requiring the routes to differ only in provider and key is what makes cross-model comparison meaningful.** **Fourth, failures and successes are reported separately and failures count as incorrect**: verbatim, primary metrics use all expected cases as the denominator, retrieval failures, JSON parsing failures and schema-validation failures count as incorrect, and valid-only metrics are reported only as diagnostics; the retrieval script deliberately does not parse, validate or score, because separating parsing and scoring into local steps lets retrieval failures, parse failures, schema failures and accuracy be reported separately. **When a model output is not valid JSON that is not an impossibility of evaluation but an error, and splitting the stages lets a reader tell a model problem from a pipeline problem.** **Fifth, the full one-hundred-and-eighty-case results are tabulated with a distinction between primary metrics and diagnostics**: one open model served through a router produced valid JSON for all one hundred and eighty cases with about ninety-three percent accuracy on the safe-placement endpoint and about fifty-two percent exact match on a length-of-stay endpoint; a hosted frontier model also produced all cases valid with about sixty-five and thirty-four percent respectively; and a small open model produced valid JSON for fewer than half the cases, with the readme labelling that row as a diagnostic small model whose outputs often failed the strict contract. **Keeping the small model row together with the explanation of why it looks bad, rather than dropping it, is worth copying.** **Sixth, the scope of the results is limited verbatim**: verbatim, these results should not be interpreted as clinical performance, payer-policy performance or real-world authorization safety, and the privacy notice states that the dataset is not affiliated with, derived from or representative of any real healthcare provider, payer or patient population. **A benchmark score is not performance in the world being benchmarked.** **Seventh, provider incompatibility is recorded as an exclusion rather than a result**: verbatim, three named model families tested during setup could not be executed under the same endpoint in the tested environment, and these are provider or router compatibility exclusions rather than benchmark results. **Failing to run and performing badly are recorded as different things.** **Eighth, the composition and generation method are itemised**: one hundred and eighty cases made up of one hundred and twenty rule-based and sixty probabilistic ones; one hundred and eight continued-stay cases, seventy-two safe or lower-level-of-care-ready cases and twenty-two contradiction cases; cases numbered one hundred and twenty-one to one hundred and eighty carrying probabilistic transition metadata; generation described verbatim as Markov-decision-process-style synthetic state transitions; and an explicit statement that the first version does not train a policy and that the trajectory is synthetic generation metadata. **That last sentence matters because the process name could easily be misread as describing a reinforcement-learning environment.** **Ninth, the boundary between what is published and what is deliberately withheld is stated**: verbatim, local review batches, archive files, pilot files, audit result records, generated quality-assurance outputs, raw and scored model-output files, caches and system files are intentionally excluded from the public repository, while consolidated evaluation summaries are included. **The public boundary is given rather than left to be inferred.** **Tenth, the engineering shape is countable**: a single active release file; four documents covering the schema, release notes, model routing notes and a scaling plan; a generators directory with a case builder, form templates and five batch generation scripts; a quality-assurance directory; an evaluation directory with three retrieval scripts, a scoring script, parsing and metrics modules and directories for prompts, schemas, configuration, results and scripts; a baseline notebook; and a readme, requirements file, licence, data licence and citation file. **That the dataset grew in batches, with the generation script for each batch kept in the repository, is a detail worth copying.** **Eleventh, two commands come with warnings**: a deterministic quality-assurance run, and a command that regenerates the release file, accompanied by the verbatim warning not to regenerate the release file unless the dataset version is intentionally being changed or reproducibility is being verified. **A command that changes the dataset is flagged before it is run.** **Twelfth, privacy and limitations are itemised**: the data is fully synthetic, generated from structured synthetic case specifications, synthetic trajectories, synthetic timelines and controlled documentation templates; it contains no real patient records, copied chart text, protected health information, real facility or staff names, medical record numbers, phone numbers, addresses or source-system identifiers; and all chart dates are synthetic timeline artefacts. The limitations state verbatim that the first version is evaluation-scale rather than training-scale, that it covers adult inpatient psychiatric authorization only, that it excludes paediatric, geriatric, emergency-only, partial-hospitalisation, intensive-outpatient and residential-only settings, that synthetic notes are cleaner and more uniform than real electronic health records, that the documentation window is fixed at seventy-two hours, that the authorization criteria are generalised and not tied to any payer, provider, facility, record system, contract or proprietary utilization-management policy, and that the trajectories are synthetic generation metadata rather than observed clinical transitions. **That synthetic notes are cleaner than real records is the sentence that keeps a high score from being read as real-world readiness.** **Thirteenth, licensing is split in two layers**: verbatim, code in the repository is under the Apache licence while the dataset file under the release directory is under a Creative Commons attribution licence, with a separate data licence file; the dataset page states the same split and gives a canonical record identifier. **Code and data under two different licences is the pattern that makes a licence detector report an unrecognised licence, which is exactly what was measured on the repository.** **Fourteenth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover various insurance and financial benchmarks, medical and policy text processing, and health-claims denial and appeal material, **while this entry supplies a benchmark built from synthetic cases that asks whether a model avoids overclaiming, gives each case an explicit list of conclusions not to draw, retrieves under a blind contract, and scores pipeline failures separately from model failures. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled insurance question-answering benchmark and the pooled health-claims denial entry**; **five practices transfer directly: put the conclusions that must not be drawn into the data rather than into the scoring notes; enumerate the fields the retrieval contract withholds; count retrieval, parsing and schema failures separately and count them as incorrect; record provider incompatibility separately from model performance; and state the boundary between what is published and what is withheld**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no dependencies installed, no retrieval or scoring script executed, no dataset downloaded and no row of the results table recomputed — **so none of the reported accuracies is claimed, nor is the claim that the benchmark actually discriminates between models**. **Second, no case body was read**: only the GitHub readme, the dataset page description, repository metadata and the directory listing were read, and the release file, no generation script, no evaluation script, no document under the documentation directory, neither licence file and not the citation file were opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the composition counts were not verified**, nor was the actual content or size of the do-not-claim field. **Fourth, the runtime environment, timing and prompts behind the three model rows were not verified**, nor were the exact definitions of the two endpoint metrics, **this entry deliberately not expanding those abbreviations rather than defining them on the author behalf**. **Fifth, whether the blind retrieval contract holds at the code level was not verified**, for instance whether some other path carries gold labels into the prompt, **this entry relaying only the withheld-field list from the readme**. **Sixth, whether the benchmark has been used or cited by third parties was not verified, nor was whether the version on the other platform is the same as the one here. Seventh, the metadata and dates of the canonical record identifier were not verified**, that record not having been visited, **so the correspondence between a concept identifier and a version identifier is unverified here**. **Eighth, on the window: what is collected is a dataset updated inside the thaw window, last updated 2026-09-10, while the upstream repository was created 2026-06-04 and last pushed 2026-07-26, both outside it; this entry records both sets of dates and states plainly that the core code and data predate the window and only the publication channel, and possibly the dataset content, changed inside it.** **Ninth, the nature of this item must be stated plainly**: it is both a benchmark dataset with gold labels and a challenge taxonomy and an evaluation toolchain covering generation, quality assurance, three retrieval routes, parsing and scoring, and **its kind is recorded as a dataset according to its primary purpose, with the tooling noted here**. **Tenth, the relationship between this benchmark and any real payer authorization policy was not verified**, the author stating verbatim that the criteria are generalised and not tied to any payer or proprietary policy, **so nothing here may be read as a clinical, underwriting or claims judgement**. **Eleventh, the author identity and affiliation were not verified**, the readme pointing to a personal research page that was not visited. **Twelfth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**

entries.title: **一份**锁死的农业参数保险基准**：12,000 个保单—季节情景、**五个气候风险体制、**三个种子全写明**：Zenodo 记录 `10.5281/zenodo.22701753`（AgriParam-Chain v1.0）——**⭐ 本次实测**：**CSV **21 列 × **12,000 行****（**切分恰好 **8,400／1,800／1,800**，**体制恰好 **3,600／2,640／2,160／1,800／1,800****）**；**⭐ 它自带一份**「**锁定稿件结果**」**文件**（**12 行，**每行给出**稿件位置**）**；**⭐ 并逐字规定**「**If the benchmark-generation procedure is changed, the revised package should be released as a new repository version rather than silently replacing v1.0**」**；**⚠️ 而 Zenodo 上的**描述字段为空、**创建者名登记为 **`cursor`****

entries.summary_en: The Zenodo record agriparam-chain, held under a version DOI with a separate concept DOI, **is a controlled multimodal benchmark package for agricultural parametric insurance**, titled as explainable multimodal artificial intelligence with dynamic basis-risk optimization for parametric crop insurance and oracle-verified blockchain smart-contract payouts. **Measured this round**: **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, **created 2026-09-11**, **registered as a dataset**, with a single package file of about 2.6 megabytes containing **eleven files** that were measured directly: the benchmark table, an identical workbook copy, the frozen data splits, the locked manuscript results, a variable dictionary, a readme, a scenario-construction protocol, a metadata template, a checksum manifest, the generation code and a dependency list. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here freezing a version**, and **four things are worth reading: the benchmark is frozen with a written rule that any change to the generation procedure must be released as a new version rather than silently replacing it; the package ships its own locked manuscript results file with twelve metric rows each naming its location in the paper; the construction protocol writes out every response weight and all three random seeds; and the registry description field itself is empty**. **None of the model metrics were recomputed this round.**
entries.body:
**agriparam-chain**（Zenodo 记录 **`10.5281/zenodo.22701753`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22701752`****）**是一份**面向农业参数保险的受控多模态基准包****——**逐字标题为**「**AgriParam-Chain: Explainable Multimodal AI with Dynamic Basis-Risk Optimization for Parametric Crop Insurance and Oracle-Verified Blockchain Smart-Contract Payouts**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-11**、**类型 dataset**、**许可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**单一文件 **`AgriParamChain_Zenodo_Package_v1.0.zip`（**2,626,244 字节**）**；**⭐ 本次**下载并解包**后实测包内 **11 个文件**；**⚠️ 而 Zenodo 登记页上的**描述字段长度为 0****（**即**这一条记录**没有任何描述**）**，**创建者字段逐字登记为 **`cursor`****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记处纪律：锁住版本**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Zenodo API 元数据、包内文件与本次直接计数实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 基准被**冻结**，**且改动规则被逐字写明****——**README 逐字**：**「**Version 1.0 is intended to remain frozen for the associated manuscript. **If the benchmark-generation procedure is changed, the revised package should be released as a new repository version rather than silently replacing v1.0.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**冻结**」**不是**一句口头承诺**，**而是**一条**操作规程**（**改动 → **另发版本**，**而**不是**悄悄覆盖**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」、第 352 轮「**登记与出处**」同向**：**版本号**是**可被引用的锚点**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它自带一份**「**锁定稿件结果**」**文件****——**实测** `AgriParamChain_Locked_Manuscript_Results.csv` **共 **12 行**、**5 列逐字为** `domain`／`metric`／`configuration`／`locked_value`／`manuscript_location`**；**⭐ 本次读到的前五行逐字为**：**Predictive Ｒ²／**AgriParam-Chain ensemble／**0.985／**Table 6 / Abstract / Conclusion；**Predictive RMSE／**0.0277；**Predictive MAE／**0.0221；**Predictive F1／**0.979；**Predictive AUROC／**0.999**（**⭐ 均为同一处稿件位置**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一列** `manuscript_location` **尤其值得抄**：**⭐ 即**每个数**都指回**它在论文里的位置**——**⭐ 这与本站第 340 轮「**把每个数从哪来写在旁边**」同向**，**而**这里更进一步**：**数据包里**预先记下了**稿件里的数**，**以便日后核对**。**⚠️ 本词条如实指出**：**⭐ 这些指标**（**R² **0.985**、**AUROC **0.999**）是在**一份合成基准上**取得的**，**⭐ 而**该基准的**构造协议自己写明**它**不是**实地试验、**不是**农户层组合、**也不是**保险公司的生产部署**（**见下第 ③ 点**）**——**⭐ 故**这些数字**不得**当作任何真实农险的预测能力**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 构造协议把**响应权重、**交互项、**边界与三个种子**全部写出****——**实测** `Scenario_Construction_Protocol.md` **逐字给出**：**体制分配固定为** normal **3,600**／drought **2,640**／heat **2,160**／excess rainfall **1,800**／compound drought-heat **1,800****；**⭐ 相对系数层级逐字为**降雨亏缺 **0.224**、**高温暴露 **0.186**、**土壤湿度胁迫 **0.163**、**植被胁迫 **0.149**、**干期强度 **0.108**、**物候敏感性 **0.095**、**参考产量情境 **0.075**、**过量降雨胁迫 **0.100****；**交互项逐字为**干旱—高温耦合、**物候—高温耦合、**物候—降雨耦合、**过量降雨／根区耦合**；**⭐ 严重损失定义逐字为** `yield_loss_severity >= 0.20`**；**⭐ 三个种子逐字为** primary **20260911**、**residual-loss **123**、**split **20260912****；**⭐ 并逐字把它们各自的角色分开**（**主种子／**残差种子／**切分种子**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**合成数据**」**也可以**完全可复述**——**⭐ 只要**把权重、**交互与种子**写出来**；**⭐ 而**作者**同时**逐字限定范围**「**It does not claim newly collected field measurements or a live insurer deployment.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ **本次实测**核对了它自述的几处计数**——**⭐ 即**这一条**不只是转述**：**⭐ 基准 CSV 实测 **21 列 × **12,000 行****；**切分实测**恰好 **train 8,400／validation 1,800／test 1,800****；**风险体制实测**恰好 **3,600／2,640／2,160／1,800／1,800****——**⭐ 与 README 与协议**逐字所述一致**；**⭐ 另有** `SHA256SUMS.txt` **对 **10 个文件**给出校验和**（**⭐ 本次读到前 10 行**）**。**⭐ 即**「**12,000 个情景**」这一自述**是**可以被数出来的**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 变量字典与边界被写明**——**实测** `AgriParamChain_Variable_Dictionary.csv` **给出**变量名、**描述、**类型、**单位或范围、**角色与构造方式**；**⭐ 本次读到的表头逐字为** `variable_name`／`description`／`data_type`／`unit_or_range`／`role`／`construction`**，**并逐字说明**所有归一化胁迫指数**被限制在 **0 至 1****；**⭐ 多模态输入逐字含**降雨异常、**亏缺、**过量与干期强度；**平均温度与高温暴露；**根区土壤湿度与湿度胁迫；**NDVI／**EVI 与植被胁迫；**物候阶段与物候敏感性；**参考产量**。**⭐ 本词条认为**变量字典带「**构造**」一列**是实用之处**：**⭐ 即**每个变量**是怎么算出来的**，**写在数据旁边**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一处**登记处的空白**（本次实测）**——**⭐ Zenodo 记录的**描述字段为空**（**长度 0**）**，**而**包内 `README.md`（**2,919 字节**）**与** `Zenodo_Metadata_Template.txt`（**1,438 字节**）**都提供了**可粘贴的描述与元数据模板**；**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**包里**连「**该怎么填登记处**」**都准备好了**，**而**登记处**本身**仍是空的**——**⭐ 本词条**如实记录这个落差**，**不推测原因**（**⭐ 例如**是否与登记流程有关**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 两处**模板占位符未被替换**（本次实测）**——**README 的建议「**数据可得性声明**」**逐字含** `**[insert final repository DOI/URL]**`**，**建议引用格式**逐字含** `**Repository DOI: [insert DOI after publication]**`**——**⭐ 即**这两处**仍是占位符**，**而**该记录**已经有 DOI**；**⭐ 本词条**如实记录**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 生成代码与依赖被写明，**且极小****——**实测** `benchmark_generation_code.py`（**6,923 字节**）**与** `requirements.txt`（**12 字节，**逐字 `numpy>=1.24`**）**——**⭐ 即**只要一个依赖**即可重建**；**⭐ 这与第 ③ 点的种子说明合起来**，**构成**一条**完整的复现路径**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 数据使用与文献依据被写明**——**逐字**：**「**No personally identifiable information, confidential farmer records, clinical information, or proprietary insurance-policy records are included.**」**；**⭐ 并列出五篇文献依据**（**含期刊与 DOI**，**逐字含** Wijesena & Pradhan (2026) **与** Nguyen et al. (2025) **等**）**，**并逐字说明**「**These publications motivate the benchmark dimensions and evaluation scope; the repository’s controlled parameterization is documented above for reproducibility.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**把「**文献启发**」与「**本地参数化**」分开说明**是值得抄的**：**⭐ 即**不把**参照文献**说成**方法来源的背书**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[agrisky-ai]]、**[[fasal-pramaan-crop-claims]] 覆盖农业保险 AI 与作物理赔**，**[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]、**[[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、**[[storm-parametric-corroboration]]、**[[ballast-parametric-cover]] 覆盖参数化风险与参数触发**，**[[usda-rma]]、**[[china-agrore]]、**[[moa-data]]、**[[earth-engine]] 覆盖农业与遥感数据源**，**[[synthetic-resdac-claims]] 覆盖合成数据与「**单一族群逐年滚动**」的做法**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**合成农险基准：**冻结版本 ＋ **锁定稿件结果 ＋ **权重与种子全写明 ＋ **自查计数可核对**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[agrisky-ai]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① **合成基准要**冻结**，**并写明**改动即另发版本**；**② **把稿件里用到的指标**锁进一份文件**，**并标注**它在论文中的位置**；**③ **生成过程的**权重、**交互与种子**全部写出**；**④ **自查计数**（**行数、**切分比例、**体制分布**）**应与自述一致**；**⑤ **包里可以准备登记处元数据模板**，**但**登记处本身别留空**。

The Zenodo record agriparam-chain, held under a version DOI with a separate concept DOI, **is a controlled multimodal benchmark package for agricultural parametric insurance**, titled as explainable multimodal artificial intelligence with dynamic basis-risk optimization for parametric crop insurance and oracle-verified blockchain smart-contract payouts. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-11**, **registered as a dataset**, **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, with a single package file of about two point six megabytes, and **eleven files inside that package were listed directly this round**. **⚠️ The registry description field is empty**, with a length of zero, and the creator field is registered verbatim as a single word that this entry does not interpret as a person, an institution or a tool. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here freezing a version.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the package contents and direct counting**: **first, the benchmark is frozen and the rule for changing it is written down verbatim**: version 1.0 is intended to remain frozen for the associated manuscript, and if the benchmark-generation procedure is changed the revised package should be released as a new repository version rather than silently replacing version 1.0. **A freeze is therefore an operating rule rather than a promise: a change produces a new version instead of quietly overwriting the old one.** **Second, the package ships its own locked manuscript results file**: measured as twelve rows with five columns named for the domain, the metric, the configuration, the locked value and the manuscript location, with the first five rows recording an R-squared of about zero point nine eight five, a root mean squared error of about zero point zero two eight, a mean absolute error of about zero point zero two two, an F1 of about zero point nine eight and an area under the curve of about zero point nine nine nine, each pointing at the same table, abstract and conclusion location. **Recording the numbers used in the manuscript inside the data package, each with a pointer to where it appears, is one step beyond writing down where each number came from, because it lets a later check compare the paper against the package.** **This entry states plainly that these figures come from a synthetic benchmark and that the benchmark protocol itself says it is not newly collected field measurement, not a farmer-level portfolio and not a live insurer deployment, so the figures must not be read as predictive ability on any real agricultural insurance book.** **Third, the construction protocol writes out the weights, interactions and all three seeds**: the regime allocation is fixed at thirty-six hundred normal, twenty-six hundred and forty drought, twenty-one hundred and sixty heat, eighteen hundred excess rainfall and eighteen hundred compound drought-heat scenarios; the relative coefficient hierarchy is stated as rainfall deficit zero point two two four, heat exposure zero point one eight six, soil-moisture stress zero point one six three, vegetation stress zero point one four nine, dry-spell intensity zero point one zero eight, phenological sensitivity zero point zero nine five, reference-yield context zero point zero seven five and excess-rainfall stress zero point one zero zero; interaction terms cover drought-heat, phenology-heat, phenology-rainfall and excess-rainfall with root-zone coupling; a severe-loss label is assigned at a yield-loss severity of at least zero point two; and three seeds are given with distinct roles, one primary, one for residual loss and one for splitting. **The protocol also states verbatim that the package does not claim newly collected field measurements or a live insurer deployment, which is what makes synthetic data fully restatable without overclaiming.** **Fourth, several of the package own counts were checked directly this round**: the benchmark table has twenty-one columns and exactly twelve thousand rows; the splits are exactly eight thousand four hundred training, one thousand eight hundred validation and one thousand eight hundred test; the risk regimes are exactly the five counts claimed; and a checksum manifest covers ten files. **A claim of twelve thousand scenarios can therefore simply be counted.** **Fifth, the variable dictionary and its bounds are given**: the measured column headers are the variable name, description, data type, unit or range, role and construction, with a statement that all normalised stress indices are bounded between zero and one, and multimodal inputs covering rainfall anomaly, deficit, excess and dry-spell intensity, mean temperature and heat exposure, root-zone soil moisture, two vegetation indices with a stress descriptor, phenological stage and sensitivity, and a reference yield. **The construction column is the practical part, because each variable carries how it was computed.** **Sixth, one blank in the registry was measured**: the description field is empty, while the package contains both a readme and a metadata template, so the package even prepares what should be pasted into the registry while the registry itself remains unfilled; **this entry records the gap without speculating about its cause**. **Seventh, two template placeholders were left unreplaced**: the suggested data-availability statement still contains a placeholder for the final repository identifier, and the suggested citation still contains a placeholder for the DOI to be inserted after publication, even though the record already has a DOI. **Eighth, the generation code and dependencies are minimal**: a single generation script of about seven kilobytes and a dependency file whose entire content is one numeric library floor, so the benchmark can be reconstructed with one dependency. **Ninth, the data-use note and literature basis are stated**: no personally identifiable information, confidential farm records, clinical information or proprietary policy records are included, and five references are listed with journals and identifiers, followed by the statement that those publications motivate the benchmark dimensions and evaluation scope while the controlled parameterisation is documented locally for reproducibility. **Motivation from the literature is therefore kept separate from local parameterisation rather than presented as endorsement.** **Tenth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover agricultural insurance artificial intelligence and crop claims, parametric risk and trigger tooling, agricultural and remote-sensing data sources and a synthetic claims dataset built by rolling one cohort forward, **while this entry supplies a synthetic agricultural benchmark with a frozen version, a locked manuscript results file, fully stated weights and seeds, and self-declared counts that can be counted. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled agricultural insurance entry and the pooled parametric risk toolkit**; **five practices transfer directly: freeze a synthetic benchmark and state that any change means a new version; lock the numbers used in the paper into a file with their locations; write out the weights, interactions and seeds of the generation process; make self-declared counts checkable and check them; and prepare registry metadata in the package while making sure the registry itself is not left empty**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no model metric from this benchmark was recomputed** — no model trained, the generation code not run, and the locked values not checked against any reproduction — **so none of the reported performance figures is claimed**, and **this entry states plainly that they come from a synthetic benchmark whose own protocol disclaims field measurement, farmer-level portfolios and production deployment**. **Second, only the package documents and table headers were read**: the generation code body was not read and therefore no judgement is offered on whether the code implements the protocol, nor was the checksum manifest verified against the files; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the five cited references were not verified to exist as described**, no identifier having been visited. **Fourth, whether the workbook copy matches the comma-separated benchmark was not verified**, only their differing sizes being recorded. **Fifth, the author identity was not verified**: the registry creator field holds a single word that this entry declines to interpret, and the record has no description, no keywords and no related identifiers, so authorship cannot be established from the registry alone. **Sixth, whether any manuscript associated with this package has been published or posted was not verified.** **Seventh, whether the blockchain and oracle-verification part is implemented anywhere in the package was not verified**; the measured package contains only benchmark data, documents and generation code with no contract code, **so this entry describes only the data and protocol and does not claim the blockchain part exists**. **Eighth, the licence is a Creative Commons attribution licence, and this entry notes that the attribution target is unclear because the creator field is not a name. Ninth, on the window: the record was created 2026-09-11, inside the thaw window, so there is no window exception to declare. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the benchmark is synthetic and must not be used for trigger design, pricing or payout decisions on any real parametric insurance programme.**

entries.summary: **cbhi-viability-replication**（Zenodo 记录 **`10.5281/zenodo.22656480`**）**是一份**研究报告的复现仓库****——**逐字标题为**「**Replication repository for Measuring What Matters for the Viability of Inclusive Insurance: Behavioural Diagnostics from 169 Community-Based Health Insurance Schemes Across 38 Countries**」**，**创建者逐字为** Dror, David M.**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-08**、**类型 dataset**、**许可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**单一文件 **`GPRI_R3_v320_deposit_v410_FINAL.zip`（**2,251,748 字节**）**；**⭐ 描述字段里放的**不是摘要，**而是这一版的**改动说明**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记处纪律：说清改了什么**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **逐字声明「**没有一项分析输入发生变化**」并列出**哪些东西**逐字节相同****（**登记表、**三个支柱数据集、**派生国家与方案层数据集、**十一个分析脚本**）**；**② **新绘图脚本在画图**之前**先校验输入文件的 **md5**，**并**拒绝在其它数据版本上运行****；**③ **旧脚本与旧图**不删而是**原样保留为上一版记录****；**④ **一份**表号映射文档**说明**管线文件名与论文表号**如何对应**，**并**指出一处**规格差异（**未分解 vs 已分解**）**且**两者 **R² 同为 **0.517****。**⚠️ 本次未下载该压缩包。

entries.summary_en: The Zenodo record cbhi-viability-replication **is a replication repository for a study of the viability of inclusive insurance based on behavioural diagnostics from one hundred and sixty-nine community-based health insurance schemes across thirty-eight countries**. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-08**, **registered as a dataset**, **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, with a single package file of about two point two five megabytes, and a description field that holds the version change note rather than an abstract. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here stating exactly what changed**, and **four things are worth reading: the note states verbatim that no analytical input changed and names the registry, the three pillar datasets, the derived country and scheme level datasets and all eleven analysis scripts as byte-identical to the previous version; the new figure script verifies the checksums of its two input files before drawing and refuses to run on any other data vintage; the previous script and the previous figures are retained unchanged as the previous record rather than deleted; and a table-numbering document maps pipeline file names to manuscript table numbers and records one specification difference where both variants give the same coefficient of determination**. **The archive was not downloaded this round.**
entries.body:
**cbhi-viability-replication**（Zenodo 记录 **`10.5281/zenodo.22656480`**）**是一份**研究报告的复现仓库****——**逐字标题为**「**Replication repository for Measuring What Matters for the Viability of Inclusive Insurance: Behavioural Diagnostics from 169 Community-Based Health Insurance Schemes Across 38 Countries**」**，**创建者逐字为** Dror, David M.**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-08**、**类型 dataset**、**许可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**单一文件 **`GPRI_R3_v320_deposit_v410_FINAL.zip`（**2,251,748 字节**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记处纪律：说清改了什么**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Zenodo API 元数据与记录描述实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一次「**只改表现层**」的更新被逐字说清**——**记录描述逐字为**：**「**Version 4.1.0 accompanies manuscript v3.20 at revision round 3. **No analytical input changed**: the registry, the three pillar datasets, the derived country- and scheme-level datasets, and **all eleven analysis scripts are byte-identical to version 4.0.2**. The changes are presentational and are listed in `docs/CHANGELOG.md`.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**改了什么**」与「**没改什么**」**同时写出来**，**而**「**没改**」那一侧**是**可验证的**（**逐字节相同**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」、第 353 轮「**同源多形**」同向**：**当一份存档**换了版本号时，**读者最需要知道的是**分析结论有没有变**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 新脚本在**画图之前先校验输入文件的 md5****——**逐字**：**「**Added: `scripts/05b_figures_corrected_v1_7.R`, which **supersedes** `scripts/05_figures.R` for the published figures. It corrects the internal title of Figure 1, which read CHI where the manuscript uses CBHI; removes an annotation in Figure 3 that overprinted a bar label; removes an underscore from the Figure 3 pillar axis; and reduces the two likelihood-ratio statements in Figure 1 Panel B to their p-values, the full statements having moved to the manuscript figure caption.**」**——**逐字續**「**Before drawing it verifies the md5 of both input files and refuses to run on any other data vintage.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一句值得单独抄**：**⭐ 即**「**拒绝在别的数据版本上运行**」**——**⭐ 这是一种**把「**这张图是按哪一版数据画的**」**变成**机器约束**的做法**；**⭐ 与之对照**：**很多复现包**只说明**它用了哪份数据**，**而**不阻止**你**拿别的数据去画**。**⭐⭐ ③ 输出规格被写到**排版层面****——**逐字**：**「**It writes PDF, TIFF at 600 dpi with LZW compression, and PNG at 600 dpi, and **sizes the type so that in-panel labelling remains at 8.7 points after resizing to one text column width**.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**字体在缩到单栏宽后仍是 8.7 磅**」**是**投稿排版要求**，**而**它**被写进了复现说明**——**⭐ 即**图的**可复现**包括**排版细节**。**⭐⭐ ④ 旧件**不删，**而是**原样保留为上一版记录****——**逐字**：**「**Added: `outputs/figures_v2/`, holding the three corrected figures as submitted to the journal. **`outputs/figures/` and `scripts/05_figures.R` are retained unchanged as the previous record.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处与第 ① 点是同一种纪律**：**⭐ 即**被取代的东西**留在原处**，**以便**任何人核对**「**哪个版本对应哪次投稿**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 一处**规格与表号的差异被主动记下**，**且**给出**两者同值**的结果**——**逐字**：**「**Added: `docs/TABLE_NUMBERING_R3.md`, mapping the pipeline output file names, which keep their original numbering, to the manuscript table numbers from revision 3 onward, where Box 1 became Table 1, and the six existing tables moved up by one. **The same file records that `outputs/tables/table3_country_ols.csv` carries the undecomposed Combined specification while the manuscript reports the decomposed one introduced at v3.16, both giving R2 = 0.517, with `scripts/08_audit_numerical_claims.R` auditing the printed values.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处尤其值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**文件里的规格与论文里的规格不同**」**被写明**，**而且**顺带给出**两者结果相同（**R² **0.517****）**——**⭐ 这正是**审稿场景**里最需要的一句话**：**读者不必自己发现差异，**也不必因此怀疑结论**；**⭐ 而**它**还指出**有一个脚本**专门审计论文中印出的数值**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 完整性清单覆盖**包内全部文件****——**逐字**：**「**Added: `MANIFEST_MD5_v3_20.csv`, an MD5 and byte-size manifest of **all 65 files**.**」**。**⭐ 即**这一版**对包内**65 个文件**给出了**md5 与字节数**——**⭐ 与第 ② 点的**输入校验**合起来**，**形成**内外两层校验**（**清单对全包，**脚本对输入**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 研究对象与关键词被写明**——**逐字关键词含** `inclusive insurance`、`community health insurance`、`behavioural diagnostics`、`replication data`、`microinsurance`、`cluster-robust standard errors`、`Trinity Law of cooperative institutions`、`Dual Benefit`、`cooperative institutions`、`community-based health insurance schemes`、`scheme sustainability`、`Low- and Middle Income Countries`、`multiplicative model`、`Universal Health Coverage`**；**⭐ 即**样本规模（**169 个方案、**38 国**）**写在标题里**，**而**方法关键词（**聚类稳健标准误、**乘法模型**）**写在关键词里**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 一处**体例上的观察**（本次实测）**——**⭐ 该记录的**描述字段**放的不是研究摘要，**而是**这一版的改动说明**（**逐字以版本号与稿件版本开头**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为这一点值得记**：**⭐ 即**在登记处里，**「**这一版改了什么**」**与「**这项研究是什么**」**是两个字段**，**而**这里**只填了前者**——**⭐ 读者要了解研究本身**需要**打开包内的文档**；**⭐ 本词条**如实记录而不评判**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[microinsurance-network]]、**[[a2ii]] 覆盖小额保险的行业组织与出版物**，**[[club-vita]] 覆盖微保精算基础数据**，**[[openimis]] 覆盖开源微保管理系统**，**[[who-gho]]、**[[worldbank-data]] 覆盖全球卫生与发展指标**，**[[synthetic-resdac-claims]] 覆盖合成理赔数据**，**[[mortality-analysis-provenance]] 覆盖「**证据分四栏 ＋ 机器不能签字**」的做法**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一次**只改表现层**的版本更新：**逐字声明分析输入逐字节未变 ＋ **绘图脚本校验输入 md5 并拒绝其它数据版本 ＋ **旧件原样保留 ＋ **表号与规格差异主动写明**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[mortality-analysis-provenance]]、[[microinsurance-network]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① **版本更新要同时说明「**改了什么**」与「**没改什么**」**；**② **绘图或派生脚本**在动手前**校验输入指纹**，**并可**拒绝其它数据版本**；**③ **被取代的脚本与产物**原样保留**，**标注为上一版记录**；**④ **文件名与论文编号**不一致时**给一张映射表**；**⑤ **发现规格差异**就写下来**，**并**给出两者结果**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载该压缩包**（**未解包、**未读任何数据集或脚本、**未复算任何模型或图形**），**故**不主张**其 169 个方案、**38 国、**R² **0.517** 或任何其它数值结果**；**⭐ 本词条所述的一切**都来自**该记录的**描述字段与元数据**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核实**「**逐字节相同**」这一断言**（**⭐ 需要**下载两个版本并比对**才能确认**）**；**也未核实** `MANIFEST_MD5_v3_20.csv` **是否真的覆盖 65 个文件**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `docs/CHANGELOG.md` **的实际内容**（**⭐ 描述称改动列于其中，**本次未读**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `scripts/08_audit_numerical_claims.R` **的审计范围与结果**；**也未核实**「**未分解与已分解规格**」**两者结果相同**这一说法**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**该研究**是否已发表、**发表在哪、**以及该复现包对应哪一轮审稿**（**⭐ 描述称** manuscript v3.20、**revision round 3**，**但**本次未查证**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**作者身份与机构**（**记录只给出 **Dror, David M.**）**；**也未核实**其与**任何机构或期刊**的关系**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实** 169／38 **这两个数字的口径**（**⭐ 即**「**方案**」与「**国家**」**如何计数**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ **许可**为** CC-BY-4.0**（**须署名**）**；**⭐ 而**其数据来源**（**社区健康保险方案的登记表**）**是否**另有第三方权利**，**本条**未核实**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**创建于 **2026-09-08**（**在解冻窗口之内**）**，**⭐ 无需窗口例外说明**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该包是**研究复现材料**，**不得**当作任何保险方案可持续性的评估结论**。
entries.body_hk:
**cbhi-viability-replication**（Zenodo 記錄 **`10.5281/zenodo.22656480`**）**是一份**研究報告的複現倉庫****——**逐字標題為**「**Replication repository for Measuring What Matters for the Viability of Inclusive Insurance: Behavioural Diagnostics from 169 Community-Based Health Insurance Schemes Across 38 Countries**」**，**創建者逐字為** Dror, David M.**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-09-08**、**類型 dataset**、**許可 CC-BY-4.0**、**單一檔案 **`GPRI_R3_v320_deposit_v410_FINAL.zip`（**2,251,748 位元組**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**登記處紀律：說清改了什么**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Zenodo API 元資料與記錄描述實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一次「**只改表現層**」的更新被逐字說清****——**逐字**「**Version 4.1.0 accompanies manuscript v3.20 at revision round 3. No analytical input changed: the registry, the three pillar datasets, the derived country- and scheme-level datasets, and all eleven analysis scripts are byte-identical to version 4.0.2. The changes are presentational and are listed in `docs/CHANGELOG.md`.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**改了什么**」與「**沒改什么**」**同時寫出**，**而**「**沒改**」那一側**是**可驗證的**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 新腳本在**畫圖之前先校驗輸入的 md5****——**逐字**「**Added: `scripts/05b_figures_corrected_v1_7.R`, which supersedes `scripts/05_figures.R` for the published figures. It corrects the internal title of Figure 1, which read CHI where the manuscript uses CBHI; removes an annotation in Figure 3 that overprinted a bar label; removes an underscore from the Figure 3 pillar axis; and reduces the two likelihood-ratio statements in Figure 1 Panel B to their p-values, the full statements having moved to the manuscript figure caption.**」**——**逐字**「**Before drawing it verifies the md5 of both input files and refuses to run on any other data vintage.**」**——**⭐ 即**把「**這張圖是按哪一版資料畫的**」**變成機器約束**。**⭐⭐ ③ 輸出規格寫到**排版層面****——**逐字**「**It writes PDF, TIFF at 600 dpi with LZW compression, and PNG at 600 dpi, and sizes the type so that in-panel labelling remains at 8.7 points after resizing to one text column width.**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 舊件**不刪，**原樣保留為上一版記錄****——**逐字**「**Added: `outputs/figures_v2/`, holding the three corrected figures as submitted to the journal. `outputs/figures/` and `scripts/05_figures.R` are retained unchanged as the previous record.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 一處**規格與表號差異被主動記下**，**並給出兩者同值**——**逐字**「**Added: `docs/TABLE_NUMBERING_R3.md`, mapping the pipeline output file names, which keep their original numbering, to the manuscript table numbers from revision 3 onward, where Box 1 became Table 1, and the six existing tables moved up by one. The same file records that `outputs/tables/table3_country_ols.csv` carries the undecomposed Combined specification while the manuscript reports the decomposed one introduced at v3.16, both giving R2 = 0.517, with `scripts/08_audit_numerical_claims.R` auditing the printed values.**」**——**⭐ 即**讀者不必自己發現差異，**也不必因此懷疑結論**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 完整性清單覆蓋**包內全部檔案****——**逐字**「**Added: `MANIFEST_MD5_v3_20.csv`, an MD5 and byte-size manifest of all 65 files.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 研究對象與關鍵詞**：**關鍵詞逐字含** inclusive insurance／community health insurance／behavioural diagnostics／replication data／microinsurance／cluster-robust standard errors／Trinity Law of cooperative institutions／Dual Benefit／scheme sustainability／Low- and Middle Income Countries／multiplicative model／Universal Health Coverage**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 一處**體例觀察**：**該記錄的**描述欄位放的不是研究摘要，**而是**這一版的改動說明****——**⭐ 即**「**這一版改了什麼**」與「**這項研究是什麼**」**是兩個欄位**，**這裡只填了前者**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 與池內條目的關係**：[[microinsurance-network]]、[[a2ii]]、[[club-vita]]、[[openimis]]、[[who-gho]]、[[worldbank-data]]、[[synthetic-resdac-claims]]、[[mortality-analysis-provenance]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**只改表現層的版本更新：逐字聲明分析輸入逐位元組未變＋繪圖腳本校驗輸入 md5 並拒絕其它資料版本＋舊件原樣保留＋表號與規格差異主動寫明**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[mortality-analysis-provenance]]、[[microinsurance-network]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 五點最值得借鑑**：**① **版本更新要同時說明「**改了什麼**」與「**沒改什麼**」**；**② **繪圖或派生腳本**動手前**校驗輸入指紋**；**③ **被取代的腳本與產物**原樣保留**；**④ **檔名與論文編號**不一致時給映射表**；**⑤ **發現規格差異就寫下來，**並給出兩者結果**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載該壓縮包**（**未解包、**未讀任何資料集或腳本、**未複算任何模型或圖形**），**不主張**其 169 個方案、**38 國、**R² 0.517 或任何其它數值結果**；**所述一切**都來自**該記錄的描述欄位與元資料**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核實**「**逐位元組相同**」這一斷言**（**需下載兩個版本比對**）**；**未核實** `MANIFEST_MD5_v3_20.csv` **是否真的覆蓋 65 個檔案**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** `docs/CHANGELOG.md` **的實際內容**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實** `scripts/08_audit_numerical_claims.R` **的審計範圍與結果**；**未核實**「**未分解與已分解規格**」**兩者結果相同**這一說法**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**該研究**是否已發表、**發表在哪、**對應哪一輪審稿**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**作者身份與機構**（**記錄只給出 Dror, David M.**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實** 169／38 **這兩個數字的口徑**。**⑧ ⚠️ 許可為 CC-BY-4.0**（**須署名**）**；**其資料來源是否另有第三方權利**，**本條未核實**。**⑨ ⚠️ 建立於 2026-09-08（**窗口之內**）**，**無需窗口例外說明**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該包是**研究複現材料**，**不得**當作任何保險方案可持續性的評估結論**。
entries.body_en:
The Zenodo record cbhi-viability-replication **is a replication repository for a study of the viability of inclusive insurance**, titled as behavioural diagnostics from one hundred and sixty-nine community-based health insurance schemes across thirty-eight countries, credited to a single named creator. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-08**, **registered as a dataset**, **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, with a single package file of about two point two five megabytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here stating exactly what changed.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata and the record description**: **first, an update that changes only the presentation layer is stated clause by clause**: verbatim, version 4.1.0 accompanies manuscript v3.20 at revision round three, no analytical input changed, the registry, the three pillar datasets, the derived country and scheme level datasets and all eleven analysis scripts are byte-identical to version 4.0.2, and the changes are presentational and listed in a changelog. **What changed and what did not change are stated together, and the unchanged side is the verifiable one, which is exactly what a reader needs when a deposit changes version number.** **Second, the new figure script verifies checksums before drawing**: verbatim, the added script supersedes the earlier figure script for the published figures and corrects four things, namely an internal figure title that read one abbreviation where the manuscript uses another, an annotation that overprinted a bar label, a stray underscore on an axis, and two likelihood-ratio statements reduced to their p-values with the full statements moved to the caption, and **before drawing it verifies the checksum of both input files and refuses to run on any other data vintage**. **Refusing to run on another vintage turns which version of the data a figure was drawn from into a machine constraint rather than a note.** **Third, the output specification reaches the typography level**: verbatim, it writes PDF, TIFF at six hundred dots per inch with LZW compression and PNG at six hundred dots per inch, and sizes the type so that in-panel labelling remains at eight point seven points after resizing to one text column width. **Figure reproducibility therefore includes the typesetting requirement.** **Fourth, superseded artefacts are retained rather than deleted**: verbatim, a new directory holds the three corrected figures as submitted to the journal, while the previous figure directory and the previous figure script are retained unchanged as the previous record. **The thing that was replaced stays where it was, so anyone can check which version corresponds to which submission.** **Fifth, one specification and numbering difference is recorded, with the result given**: verbatim, an added document maps pipeline output file names, which keep their original numbering, to the manuscript table numbers from revision three onward, where a box became the first table and the six existing tables moved up by one, and the same document records that one output table carries the undecomposed combined specification while the manuscript reports the decomposed one introduced at an earlier version, both giving the same coefficient of determination, with a separate script auditing the printed values. **A reader therefore does not have to discover the difference, and does not have to doubt the conclusion because of it.** **Sixth, a completeness manifest covers the whole package**: verbatim, an added manifest gives checksums and byte sizes for all sixty-five files, which together with the input check inside the figure script forms two layers of verification. **Seventh, the subject matter and keywords are stated**, with the sample size in the title and method keywords covering cluster-robust standard errors and a multiplicative model. **Eighth, one stylistic observation was measured**: the registry description field holds the version change note rather than a study abstract, beginning with a version number and a manuscript version, so what this version changed and what the study is are two different fields and only the former is filled in; **this entry records that without judging it**. **Ninth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover microinsurance institutions and publications, actuarial data for microinsurance, an open microinsurance management system, global health and development indicators, synthetic claims data and a provenance framework in which a machine may not sign off, **while this entry supplies a version update that changes only the presentation layer, states that the analytical inputs are byte-identical, verifies input checksums before drawing and refuses other data vintages, retains superseded artefacts, and writes down a numbering and specification difference together with its result. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled provenance framework and the pooled microinsurance institution entries**; **five practices transfer directly: state both what changed and what did not; verify input fingerprints before drawing or deriving anything; retain superseded scripts and outputs and label them as the previous record; provide a mapping table when file names and paper numbering diverge; and when a specification difference is found, write it down together with the result under both variants**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the archive was not downloaded** — not unpacked, no dataset or script read and no model or figure recomputed — **so no claim is made about the number of schemes, the number of countries, the reported coefficient of determination or any other figure**, everything stated here coming from the record description and metadata. **Second, the assertion that the files are byte-identical was not verified**, which would require downloading two versions and comparing them, nor was whether the manifest really covers sixty-five files; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the actual changelog content was not verified. Fourth, the scope and results of the numerical-claims audit script were not verified, nor was the claim that the undecomposed and decomposed specifications give the same result.** **Fifth, whether the study has been published, where, and which review round this deposit corresponds to were not verified.** **Sixth, the author identity and affiliation were not verified**, the record giving a single name. **Seventh, how the scheme and country counts were arrived at was not verified. Eighth, the licence is a Creative Commons attribution licence, and whether the underlying scheme registry carries separate third-party rights was not verified. Ninth, on the window: the record was created 2026-09-08, inside the thaw window, so there is no window exception to declare. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the package is research replication material and must not be treated as an assessment of the viability of any insurance scheme.**

entries.title_hk: **一份**輸入來源換代**的行級對照資料：**並逐字寫明這些數**不是什麼****：Zenodo 記錄 `10.5281/zenodo.22218362`（PayBeacon，CMS HCRIS FY2023 → FY2024）——**⭐ 1,540 行可比基準、**換代前後並列**；**⭐ 逐字**「**It is not a live-job posting index, package quote, paycheck estimate, or proof that available assignments changed by the same percentage**」**；**⭐ 而歸屬被逐字切斷**「**PayBeacon 的派生結論不可歸於 CMS、HCRIS、BLS 或任何州機構**」**；**⭐ 包內自帶 **Frictionless `datapackage.json` ＋ **CITATION.cff ＋ **`checksums.sha256`****
entries.summary: **paybeacon-hcris-benchmark**（Zenodo 记录 **`10.5281/zenodo.22218362`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22218361`****）**是一份**行级的「**上游来源换代**」对照数据****——**逐字标题为**「**CMS HCRIS FY2024 benchmark changes — row-level PayBeacon dataset**」**，**创建者逐字为** PayBeacon**。**本次实测**：**类型 dataset**、**许可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**Zenodo 创建 **2026-09-08****；**包内 **6 个文件****（**主表 **388,241 字节、**`datapackage.json`、**`checksums.sha256`、**`CITATION.cff`、**`citation.bib`、**`README.md`**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记处纪律：写明不是什么**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **逐字划出「**这不是什么**」**（**不是live 招聘指数、**不是报价、**不是工资估算、**也不是「**可接单量同比变化**」**的证明**）**；**② **归属被切断**（**派生结论**不可归于四家公共机构**，**而**原始材料**保留其**政府作品地位**）**；**③ **换代前后**并列成行**，**并记录**两个**来源发布键****；**④ **随包给出**可执行校验指令**（**`shasum -a 256 -c checksums.sha256`**）**。**⚠️ 本次未下载主表。
entries.summary_hk: **paybeacon-hcris-benchmark**（Zenodo 記錄 **`10.5281/zenodo.22218362`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22218361`****）**是一份**行級的「**上游來源換代**」對照資料****——**逐字標題為**「**CMS HCRIS FY2024 benchmark changes — row-level PayBeacon dataset**」**，**創建者逐字為** PayBeacon**。**本次實測**：**類型 dataset**、**許可 CC-BY-4.0**、**Zenodo 建立 2026-09-08**；**包內 6 個檔案****（**主表 388,241 位元組、**`datapackage.json`、**`checksums.sha256`、**`CITATION.cff`、**`citation.bib`、**`README.md`**）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**登記處紀律：寫明不是什麼**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **逐字劃出「**這不是什麼**」**；**② **歸屬被切斷**（**派生結論不可歸於四家公共機構**）**；**③ **換代前後並列成行**，**並記錄兩個來源發布鍵****；**④ **隨包給出**可執行校驗指令****。**⚠️ 本次未下載主表。
entries.summary_en: The Zenodo record paybeacon-hcris-benchmark, with a separate concept identifier, **is a row-level dataset comparing benchmarks before and after an upstream public source release changed**, registered as a dataset under a Creative Commons attribution licence and created on the registry on 2026-09-08, with six files inside: a main table of about three hundred and eighty-eight kilobytes, a Frictionless data package description, a checksum file, two citation files and a readme. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here stating what the numbers are not**, and **four things are worth reading: the scope note says verbatim that this is not a live job posting index, a package quote, a paycheck estimate or proof that available assignments changed by the same percentage; the attribution is detached, with the derived conclusions stated as not attributable to the four public agencies whose materials feed the product while the source materials retain their government-work status; the comparison puts the previous and current benchmarks side by side in the same row and records both source release keys; and the package ships an executable verification instruction**. **The main table was not downloaded this round.**
entries.body:
**paybeacon-hcris-benchmark**（Zenodo 记录 **`10.5281/zenodo.22218362`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22218361`****）**是一份**行级的「**上游来源换代**」对照数据****——**逐字标题为**「**CMS HCRIS FY2024 benchmark changes — row-level PayBeacon dataset**」**，**创建者逐字为** PayBeacon**。**本次实测**：**类型 dataset**、**许可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**Zenodo 创建 **2026-09-08**、**包内 **6 个文件**（**逐字为** `paybeacon-hcris-fy2024-benchmark-changes.csv` **388,241 字节、**`datapackage.json` **4,440 字节、**`CITATION.cff` **1,172 字节、**`citation.bib` **452 字节、**`README.md` **1,976 字节、**`checksums.sha256` **428 字节**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记处纪律：写明不是什么**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Zenodo API 元数据、包内 README 与 `datapackage.json` 实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**这是什么**」与「**这不是什么**」**并列写出****——**README 与记录描述逐字为**：**「**This is a deterministic model-source comparison. It is **not** a live-job posting index, package quote, paycheck estimate, or proof that available assignments changed by the same percentage. **Values are modeled gross-wage benchmarks before tax and exclude stipends, overtime, reimbursements, insurance, and other package components.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**四个「**不是**」**分别对应**四种**最容易被误读的用法**（**实时需求、**对外报价、**实发工资、**接单量变化**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 347 轮「**防误读**」、第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**：**一份数据**能不能被误用**，**往往**取决于**它自己有没有先说出边界**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 归属被**逐字切断**，**而**上游材料地位被**保留****——**逐字**：**「**PayBeacon 的派生 conclusions are **not attributable to CMS, HCRIS, BLS, or any state agency**. **Source materials retain their original public-domain or government-work status and notices.** PayBeacon 的原创 derived release is offered under CC BY 4.0.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独抄**：**⭐ 即**「**我基于公共数据做了加工，**但**结论是我的，**不是那家机构的**」**与「**上游材料的公共属性不变**」**两件事被分开写**——**⭐ 这与本站第 357 轮「**许可形态分类**」同向**：**派生层的许可**与**源头层的地位**是两件事**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 换代前后被放在**同一行**，**且**记录了两个**来源发布键****——**逐字**：**「**This package contains **1,540** comparable PayBeacon travel-healthcare occupation and location rows before and after the validated source transition from **May 2025|FY2023|CY2026** to **May 2025|FY2024|CY2026**.**」**；**⭐ 而** `datapackage.json` 的 **`sources`** 字段逐字列出**来源登记页与这两个发布键**（**逐字为** `May 2025|FY2023|CY2026` 与** `May 2025|FY2024|CY2026`**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**换代**」**不是**一句说明**，**而是**落在每一行上的两个键**（**逐字字段名** `previous_source_key` 与** `current_source_key`**）**——**⭐ 即**任何一行**都能回答**「**它来自哪一次发布**」。**⭐⭐ ④ 字段模式（**schema）逐字段写明**，**且**带类型与枚举****——**实测** `datapackage.json` **资源档逐字给出 **14 个字段**：**`stable_report_id`（**永久报告标识**）、**`occupation`、**`geography`、**`geography_slug`、**`geography_type`（**枚举 metro／state**）、**`state`、**`previous_weekly`（**整数，**美元）**、**`current_weekly`、**`change_weekly`、**`change_percent`、**`previous_source_key`、**`current_source_key`、**`updated`（**日期**）、**`benchmark_url`（**URI 格式**）**；**⭐ 并**逐字说明** `geography_type` **只允许两个取值**，**而** `benchmark_url` **是**永久公开基准页**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**每一行都带永久链接**」**这一点值得记**：**⭐ 即**读者**可以从数据集里的任意一行**走回**它的公开页面**——**⭐ 这与本站第 339 轮「**每个值指回它的来源**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 包内六件的**角色**被逐条列出，**并给出**可执行的校验指令****——**逐字**：**`paybeacon-hcris-fy2024-benchmark-changes.csv`**（**clean UTF-8 row-level CSV**）、**`datapackage.json`**（**Frictionless Tabular Data Package metadata and column schema**）、**`CITATION.cff`**（**Citation File Format 1.2**）、**`citation.bib`**（**copy-ready BibTeX**）、**`checksums.sha256`**（**SHA-256 integrity values**）**；**⭐ 并逐字给出校验方法**「**Use `shasum -a 256 -c checksums.sha256` from this directory to verify the downloaded files.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**给出**可执行校验指令**比「**附带校验和文件**」更有用**：**⭐ 即**使用者**不需要**自己知道**该怎么用那个文件**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 溯源入口被列成一套（**五个链接**）****——**逐字为**方法学页、**来源登记页、**数据字典、**更正政策页** 与**复用许可页**——**⭐ 本词条认为**「**更正政策**」**单独立页**这一点值得记**：**⭐ 即**一份数据**如何被更正**，**是**它可信度的一部分**；**⭐ 这与本站第 348 轮「**自验证**」、第 353 轮「**同源多形**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 两处日期不一致（本次实测）**——**⭐ README 与 `datapackage.json` 逐字给出的发布日均为 **2026-07-19****（**逐字** Published: 2026-07-19**、**`"created": "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z"`**、**`"version": "1.0.0"`**）**，**而** Zenodo 记录的**创建时间为 **2026-09-08****。**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两个日期而不替它调和**，**并指出**两者**可能指**「**这份报告首次发布**」与「**它被存入登记处**」**两件事**（**⭐ 本词条**不据此推断**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 主题相关性须如实说明**——**⭐ 该数据的内容是**旅行医疗人力（**travel-healthcare**）的**职业与地区工资基准**，**与医疗保险的**成本侧**相关**（**⭐ 其字段与描述**不含任何理赔、**保单或健康结果数据**）**；**⭐ 本词条**据此把它放在**医疗保险成本输入**一侧**，**并如实指出**：**它**不是**保险数据本身**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[us-mortgage-financing-constants]] 覆盖「**每个值自带发布机构与生效年份**」的常数数据集**，**[[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]、**[[cms-beneficiary-fhir]] 覆盖联邦医保数据**，**[[healthcare-mrf-api]] 覆盖医院价格透明数据**，**[[hcc-python]]、**[[icd-hcc-mappings]] 覆盖风险调整与编码映射**，**[[collective-health-burning-cost]]、**[[medical-cost-prediction]] 覆盖医疗成本建模**，**[[uae-health-pricing-model]] 覆盖健康险定价**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**上游来源换代**的行级对照：**逐字写明不是什么 ＋ **归属与上游地位分开 ＋ **每行带两个来源键与永久链接 ＋ **随包给出可执行校验**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[us-mortgage-financing-constants]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① **先写「**这不是什么**」，**再写「**这是什么**」**；**② **派生结论**与**上游机构**的归属**要分开**，**而**上游材料的公共地位**要保留**；**③ **换代前后**放在同一行**，**并**逐行记录**两个来源键**；**④ **每一行都带**永久公开链接**；**⑤ **给出**可直接执行的校验命令**，**而不只是附一个校验和文件**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载主表**（**未读 1,540 行中任何一行、**未复算任何变化百分比、**未核对校验和**），**故**不主张**其行数、**字段取值或任何数值结果**；**⭐ 所述一切来自**README、**`datapackage.json` 与登记处元数据**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核实** `checksums.sha256` **是否与实际文件一致**（**⭐ 需要下载文件**）**；**也未核实** `datapackage.json` **是否通过 Frictionless 校验**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**「**1,540 行可比**」**这一口径**（**⭐ 即**可比性**如何判定**）**；**也未核实**两个**来源发布键**的实际含义**（**⭐ 逐字只知它们形如** `May 2025|FY2023|CY2026`**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**「**validated source transition**」**这一说法**（**⭐ 描述称该换代**已获验证**，**但**本次未读方法学页**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**该产品与** CMS HCRIS **的实际取数关系**（**⭐ 描述只提到来源换代**，**未说明取数路径**）**；**也未核实**其**面向的市场与用途**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**创建者的**组织性质**（**⭐ 记录只给出 **PayBeacon** 这一名称**）**；**也未核实**其**与所引公共机构**是否有任何正式关系**（**⭐ 描述逐字声明**不可归属**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实**该数据**是否为付费产品的一部分**（**⭐ 其页面或存在商业背景，**本次未访问任何链接**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ **许可**为** CC-BY-4.0**（**须署名**）**；**⭐ 而**上游材料**逐字保留其**公共领域或政府作品地位**——**⭐ 引用时**两者都应注明**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**⭐ Zenodo 创建 **2026-09-08**（**在解冻窗口之内**）**，**而**包内自述发布日 **2026-07-19**（**在窗口之外**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两个日期**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该数据**既不是保险数据本身、**也不是任何工资或报价依据**，**不得**用于任何实际人力成本或保费判断**。

Source materials retain their original public-domain or government-work status and notices. PayBeacon 的原创 derived release is offered under CC BY 4.0.**」**——**⭐ 即**派生層的許可**與**源頭層的地位**是兩件事**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 換代前後放在**同一行**，**並記錄兩個來源發布鍵****——**逐字**「**This package contains 1,540 comparable PayBeacon travel-healthcare occupation and location rows before and after the validated source transition from May 2025|FY2023|CY2026 to May 2025|FY2024|CY2026.**」**；**`datapackage.json` 的 `sources` 逐字列出來源登記頁與這兩個發布鍵**；**⭐ 而**每行帶** `previous_source_key` 與 `current_source_key`**——**任何一行都能回答**「**它來自哪一次發布**」。**⭐⭐ ④ 欄位模式逐欄寫明並帶類型與枚舉****——**實測 14 個欄位**：`stable_report_id`、`occupation`、`geography`、`geography_slug`、`geography_type`（**枚舉 metro／state**）、`state`、`previous_weekly`（**整數、**美元**）、`current_weekly`、`change_weekly`、`change_percent`、`previous_source_key`、`current_source_key`、`updated`（**日期**）、`benchmark_url`（**URI**）**；**⭐ 每行帶**永久公開連結**，**讀者可從任意一行走回它的公開頁面**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 包內六件的角色逐條列出並給出可執行校驗指令****——**逐字**「**Use `shasum -a 256 -c checksums.sha256` from this directory to verify the downloaded files.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 溯源入口五個連結**：方法學頁、**來源登記頁、**資料字典、**更正政策頁、**複用許可頁**——**⭐ 「**更正政策**」單獨立頁**這一點值得記**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 兩處日期不一致（本次實測）**：**README 與 `datapackage.json` 逐字給出的發布日均為 2026-07-19**（**逐字** Published: 2026-07-19**、**`"created": "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z"`、**`"version": "1.0.0"`**）**，**而 Zenodo 記錄建立時間為 2026-09-08**——**⭐ 如實並列而不替它調和**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 主題相關性**：**內容是**旅行醫療人力的職業與地區工資基準**，**與醫療保險的**成本側**相關**（**不含理賠、**保單或健康結果資料**）**；**⭐ 如實指出**它**不是**保險資料本身**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 與池內條目的關係**：[[us-mortgage-financing-constants]]、[[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]、[[cms-beneficiary-fhir]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]]、[[hcc-python]]、[[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[collective-health-burning-cost]]、[[medical-cost-prediction]]、[[uae-health-pricing-model]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**上游來源換代的行級對照：逐字寫明不是什麼＋歸屬與上游地位分開＋每行帶兩個來源鍵與永久連結＋隨包給出可執行校驗**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[us-mortgage-financing-constants]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 五點最值得借鑑**：**① **先寫「**這不是什麼**」**；**② **派生結論**與**上游機構**的歸屬分開**；**③ **換代前後放同一行並逐行記錄來源鍵**；**④ **每行帶永久連結**；**⑤ **給出可執行校驗命令**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載主表**（**未讀 1,540 行中任何一行、**未複算任何變化百分比、**未核對校驗和**），**不主張**其行數、**欄位取值或任何數值結果**；**所述一切來自 README、**`datapackage.json` 與登記處元資料**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核實** `checksums.sha256` **是否與實際檔案一致**；**未核實** `datapackage.json` **是否通過 Frictionless 校驗**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**「**1,540 行可比**」**這一判準**；**未核實**兩個**來源發布鍵**的實際含義**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**「**validated source transition**」**這一說法**（**未讀方法學頁**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**該產品與 **CMS HCRIS** 的實際取數關係**；**未核實**其面向的市場與用途**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**創建者的**組織性質**；**未核實**其**與所引公共機構**是否有正式關係**（**描述逐字聲明**不可歸屬**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實**該資料**是否為付費產品的一部分**（**未訪問任何連結**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 許可為 CC-BY-4.0**（**須署名**）**；**上游材料逐字保留其**公共領域或政府作品地位**——**引用時兩者都應註明**。**⑨ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**Zenodo 建立 2026-09-08（**窗口內**）**，**包內自述發布日 2026-07-19（**窗口外**）**——**如實並列**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該資料**既不是保險資料本身、**也不是任何工資或報價依據**，**不得**用於任何實際人力成本或保費判斷**。
entries.body_en:
The Zenodo record paybeacon-hcris-benchmark, with a separate concept identifier, **is a row-level dataset comparing modelled benchmarks before and after an upstream public source release changed**, titled as benchmark changes for a public hospital cost-reporting system and credited to an organisation rather than a person. **Measured this round**: **registered as a dataset**, **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, **created on the registry 2026-09-08**, with **six files inside**, the main table being about three hundred and eighty-eight kilobytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here stating what the numbers are not.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the package readme and the data package description**: **first, what the data is and what it is not are written side by side**: verbatim, this is a deterministic model-source comparison, it is not a live job posting index, a package quote, a paycheck estimate or proof that available assignments changed by the same percentage, and the values are modelled gross-wage benchmarks before tax that exclude stipends, overtime, reimbursements, insurance and other package components. **The four negations correspond to the four most likely misreadings, namely real-time demand, an offered rate, take-home pay and a change in available work; whether a dataset can be misused often depends on whether it states its own boundary first.** **Second, attribution is cut cleanly while the upstream status is preserved**: verbatim, the derived conclusions are not attributable to the public agencies whose materials feed the product, the source materials retain their original public-domain or government-work status and notices, and the original derived release is offered under a Creative Commons attribution licence. **The licence of the derived layer and the status of the source layer are two different things, stated separately.** **Third, the previous and current benchmarks sit in the same row and both source keys are recorded**: verbatim, the package contains one thousand five hundred and forty comparable occupation and location rows before and after the validated source transition between two dated release keys, and the data package description lists both keys as sources, while each row carries a previous and a current source key, so any single row can answer which release it came from. **Fourth, the field schema is written out with types and an enumeration**: fourteen fields measured, including a permanent report identifier, occupation and geography labels with a slug and a geography type restricted to two values, previous, current and change amounts in whole currency units, a percentage change, the two source keys, an ISO publication date, and a benchmark URL declared as a URI, which means every row can be followed back to its public page. **Fifth, the role of each of the six files is listed and an executable verification instruction is given**: verbatim, readers are told to run a checksum command from the directory to verify the downloaded files, which is more useful than merely shipping a checksum file because the user does not have to know how to use it. **Sixth, five provenance entry points are listed**, covering methodology, a source registry, a data dictionary, a **corrections policy** and a reuse licence, and giving corrections its own page is worth noting because how a dataset is corrected is part of its credibility. **Seventh, two dates disagree, as measured here**: both the readme and the data package description state a publication date of 2026-07-19 with version 1.0.0, while the registry record was created on 2026-09-08, and **this entry records both dates side by side without reconciling them**. **Eighth, topical relevance is stated honestly**: the content is occupation and geography wage benchmarks for travel healthcare staffing, which sits on the cost side of health insurance, and the fields contain no claims, policy or health-outcome data, **so this entry places it as a health-insurance cost input and states plainly that it is not insurance data itself**. **Ninth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a constants dataset in which every value carries its publishing agency and effective year, federal health programme data and interfaces, hospital price transparency data, risk-adjustment and coding mappings, medical cost modelling and health pricing, **while this entry supplies a row-level before-and-after comparison of an upstream source change that states what it is not, separates attribution from upstream status, carries two source keys and a permanent link on every row, and ships an executable verification step. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled constants dataset and the pooled hospital price transparency interface**; **five practices transfer directly: state what the data is not before stating what it is; separate the attribution of derived conclusions from the status of the upstream materials; put before and after in the same row with the source key recorded per row; carry a permanent public link on every row; and give a verification command rather than only a checksum file**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the main table was not downloaded** — no row read, no percentage change recomputed and no checksum checked — **so no claim is made about the number of rows, the field values or any result**, everything stated here coming from the readme, the data package description and the registry metadata. **Second, whether the checksum file matches the actual files was not verified**, which would require downloading them, nor was the data package validated against its specification; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, how comparability was determined for the stated row count was not verified, nor was the actual meaning of the two source release keys. Fourth, the claim of a validated source transition was not verified**, the methodology page not having been read. **Fifth, the actual data path from the public cost-reporting system was not verified, nor was the market or purpose the product serves. Sixth, the nature of the creating organisation was not verified**, the record giving only a product name, **nor was whether it has any formal relationship with the public agencies it cites, the description stating verbatim that its conclusions are not attributable to them**. **Seventh, whether the data is part of a paid product was not verified**, no link having been visited. **Eighth, the licence is a Creative Commons attribution licence, while the upstream materials are stated to retain their public-domain or government-work status, so both should be credited.** **Ninth, on the window: the registry record was created 2026-09-08, inside the thaw window, while the package states a publication date of 2026-07-19, outside it, and this entry records both. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the data is neither insurance data nor any basis for a wage or rate, and must not be used for any real staffing-cost or premium judgement.**

entries.summary_en: The Zenodo record japan-claims-review-archive **is a reproducibility archive for a study of health-insurance claims review in Japan**, titled as a reproducibility archive for information-time asymmetry in health insurance and corresponding to a manuscript on claims review and provider strain. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-06**, **registered as a dataset**, **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, credited to a single named creator, with one archive file of about seven hundred kilobytes and a description of about two thousand seven hundred characters but no keywords. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here stating which half of the work is one own**, and **four things are worth reading: the archive states verbatim which input is reused from an earlier analysis and which analyses are new; it writes down an anti-overreading boundary stating that individual adjudication or payment decisions are not interpreted as policy equilibrium; it declares that all data are aggregate and publicly available with no identifiable patient information; and it contains an explicit absence statement that the manuscript itself is not included**. **The archive was not downloaded this round.**
