**japan-claims-review-archive**（Zenodo 记录 **`10.5281/zenodo.22482556`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22482555`****）**是一份**日本医疗保险查定与再审查研究的可复现归档****——**逐字标题为**「**Reproducibility archive for Information-Time Asymmetry in Health Insurance**」**，**对应手稿逐字为**「**Information-Time Asymmetry in Health Insurance: A Clifford–Information–Fractional Analysis of Claims Review and Provider Strain in Japan**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-06**、**类型 dataset**、**许可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**创建者逐字为** Masanobu, Kubota**、**单一文件 **`IJHEM_CIF_Zenodo_v1.0.0.zip`（**716,523 字节**）**；**⭐ 描述字段实测 **2,740 字符**、**而**关键词字段为空**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记处纪律：说清哪一半是自己的**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Zenodo API 元数据与记录描述实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它逐字说明**哪一部分输入是复用、**哪一部分是新增****——**逐字**：**「**The provider-side 1990–2024 series was **originally developed in a related analysis of institutional adaptation and dynamic welfare loss** and is **reused here as a derived provider-state input**. **The novel analyses in this repository concern payer-side claims-review data, provider–payer associations, and the combined CIF representation of insurer–provider information asymmetry.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**一份归档里**哪些东西**是自己新做的**、**哪些是**从别处搬来的**，**被**逐项分开写**——**⭐ 这与本站第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」、第 352 轮「**登记与出处**」同向**：**当一份材料**既有新分析又有旧序列**时，**「**新在哪**」**必须说清**，**否则**读者会把**旧序列**当成**这次的工作**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它写下了一条**反过度解读**的边界****——**逐字**：**「**Importantly, **individual claims adjudication or payment decisions are not interpreted as policy equilibrium**. The accompanying analysis distinguishes routine payment decisions from the broader policy state.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处尤其值得抄**：**⭐ 即**个案层面的**正常支付决定**与**制度层面的**失衡**是两件事**，**而**作者**在归档里**先把这条讲明**——**⭐ 这与本站第 347 轮「**防误读**」、第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**：**当研究对象的**聚合结论**可能被**倒推回个案**时，**这句话**必须写在前面**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它给出**聚合级声明**与**缺席声明****——**逐字**：**「**Social welfare loss may persist when reimbursement rules, review criteria, and other institutional parameters remain misaligned with changing clinical, economic, workforce, and technological conditions **even while individual claims continue to be processed normally**. **All data are aggregate and publicly available. No individual-level, identifiable, or confidential patient information is included.** The repository is intended to support transparency and reproducibility of the empirical analyses; **the manuscript itself is not included in this archive.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**最后半句值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**手稿不在这里**」**被明确写出**——**⭐ 这与本站第 341 轮「**三种缺席**」同向**：**归档缺了什么**要说明**，**而**不是**让读者找半天**。**⭐⭐ ④ 归档内容被逐项列出**——**逐字含**：**日本 **1990 至 2024 年**的**提供方侧 Fisher 状态序列**（**重建**）**；**来自**公开的**社会保险诊疗报酬支付基金**统计的**支付方侧**查定、**再审查、**退回与恢复数据**；**对齐后的**提供方与支付方年度数据集**；**关联分析与**精确置换检验**；**派生的 **CIF** 状态指标、**Fisher 距离与**Clifford 耦合度量**；**复现经验计算与图表的代码**；**以及**方法学说明、**变量定义、**来源文档、**元数据、**引用信息与**校验和**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**中间分析产物 ＋ 图表再生材料**」**被列进归档**是实用之处**：**⭐ 即**复现不止于**能重跑代码**，**还包括**能重新出图**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 分析框架被一段话解释**——**逐字**：**该框架为 **Clifford–Information–Fractional（CIF）**架构**，**其中** Clifford 部分代表提供方与支付方状态的**多轴交互**，**Information **部分使用**基于 Fisher 信息的状态距离**，**Fractional **部分检验**观察到的持久性是否**需要长记忆动态**，**而**不是**先验假定**它存在**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**不是先验假定**」**这一句值得记**：**⭐ 即**长记忆**是**检验的对象**，**而**不是**模型的前提**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 数据来源与隐私边界被写明**——**逐字**：**支付方侧数据来自**公开的社会保险诊疗报酬支付基金统计**；**而**全文数据为**聚合且公开**、**不含任何**个案级、**可识别或机密病人信息**。**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这**不等于**数据没有版权或再利用限制**（**⭐ 描述**未逐字给出**上游数据的再利用条款**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 一处**登记处的空白**（本次实测）**——**⭐ 该记录的**关键词字段为空**（**而**描述长达 2,740 字符**）**，**且**创建者只有一人**；**⭐ 本词条**如实记录**，**不据此判断质量**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 主题相关性须如实说明**——**⭐ 这份材料**与保险的关系在**医疗保险的**支付与查定环节**（**即**支付方与提供方之间的**信息不对称**）**，**而**不是**精算定价或准备金**；**⭐ 其价值在**「**查定与再审查数据如何被组织成可复现的分析**」**，**以及**上面四条**归档纪律**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[kokuho-rules-engine]]、**[[kakekomi-corpus]] 覆盖日本医保规则与语料**，**[[japan-fsa-statistics]]、**[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]] 覆盖日本金融与寿险统计**，**[[medical-opinion-extractor]] 覆盖医疗意见书抽取**，**[[claims-integrity-investigator]] 覆盖索赔完整性审查**，**[[insurance-qa-evidence]] 覆盖保险问答的证据**，**[[mortality-analysis-provenance]] 覆盖证据分栏与「**机器不能签字**」**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**医保查定归档：**逐字说明哪一半是复用的 ＋ **反过度解读边界 ＋ **聚合级声明 ＋ **缺席声明**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[mortality-analysis-provenance]]、[[claims-integrity-investigator]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① **归档里**哪些是新做的、**哪些是搬来的**要逐项写明**；**② **聚合结论**不得被倒推回个案**——**这句边界要写在前面**；**③ **声明数据为聚合且不含可识别信息**；**④ **缺什么就写什么**（**例如手稿不在归档内**）**；**⑤ **把「**中间产物与出图材料**」也算作复现的一部分**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载该压缩包**（**未解包、**未读任何数据、**代码或中间产物、**未复算任何指标或图**），**故**不主张**其任何数值结果**；**⭐ 所述一切来自**登记处描述与元数据**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核实**包内**是否真的含有**描述所列的**每一类内容**（**⭐ 例如**中间分析产物、**图表再生材料与校验和**）**——**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**提供方侧 1990–2024 序列的**重建方法**与**其相关前作**；**也未核实**支付方侧数据的**具体来源口径**（**⭐ 描述只提到**公开的社会保险诊疗报酬支付基金统计**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** CIF **框架**（**Clifford／**Information／**Fractional 三部分**）**的实际实现**与**其统计性质**；**⭐ 本词条**不对该框架的正确性作任何判断**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**该手稿是否已发表、**发表在哪（**⭐ 压缩包文件名含 **`IJHEM`** 这一缩写，**但**本词条**不据此推断出版方**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**作者身份与机构**（**记录只给出 **Masanobu, Kubota** 这一姓名**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实**上游公开统计数据的**再利用条款**（**⭐ 描述只说**数据为公开且聚合**）**；**⚠️ 故** CC-BY-4.0 **是否覆盖其上游数据**，**本次**未核实**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实**该研究**与任何监管或支付政策**的关系**；**⚠️ 本条**不得**被理解为任何理赔、**支付或监管判断意见**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**创建于 **2026-09-06**（**恰在解冻窗口边界**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实记录该日期**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该材料是**研究复现归档**，**不得**用于任何实际的查定、**支付或定价决策**。

entries.body_en:
The Zenodo record japan-claims-review-archive, with a separate concept identifier, **is a reproducibility archive for a study of health-insurance claims review and re-review in Japan**, titled as a reproducibility archive for information-time asymmetry in health insurance and corresponding to a manuscript analysing claims review and provider strain. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-06**, **registered as a dataset**, **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, credited to a single named creator, with one archive file of about seven hundred kilobytes and a description of about two thousand seven hundred characters while the keyword field is empty. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here stating which half of the work is one own.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata and the record description**: **first, the archive states verbatim which input is reused and which analyses are new**: the provider-side series for a thirty-five-year period was originally developed in a related analysis of institutional adaptation and dynamic welfare loss and is reused here as a derived provider-state input, while the novel analyses concern payer-side claims-review data, provider and payer associations, and the combined representation of insurer and provider information asymmetry. **When a single package contains both earlier material and new work, saying which is which is what stops a reader from attributing the old series to the new study.** **Second, an anti-overreading boundary is written down**: verbatim, individual claims adjudication or payment decisions are not interpreted as policy equilibrium, and the accompanying analysis distinguishes routine payment decisions from the broader policy state. **A finding at the aggregate level must not be read backwards onto individual decisions, and that sentence belongs at the front.** **Third, the archive gives both an aggregation statement and an absence statement**: verbatim, welfare loss may persist when reimbursement rules, review criteria and other institutional parameters remain misaligned with changing clinical, economic, workforce and technological conditions even while individual claims continue to be processed normally; all data are aggregate and publicly available with no individual-level, identifiable or confidential patient information included; and the manuscript itself is not included in this archive. **Saying plainly that the manuscript is not here is the same discipline as naming what an archive lacks rather than leaving a reader to search.** **Fourth, the archive contents are itemised**: a reconstructed provider-side state series for Japan from 1990 to 2024; payer-side adjudication, re-review, return and restoration data derived from publicly available national medical fee payment fund statistics; aligned provider and payer annual datasets; association and exact permutation analyses; derived state metrics, information distances and coupling measures; code for reproducing the empirical calculations and figures; and methodological notes, variable definitions, source documentation, metadata, citation information and checksums. **Counting intermediate analysis outputs and figure-regeneration material as part of reproducibility is the practical point, because reproducing a study includes being able to redraw its figures.** **Fifth, the analytical framework is explained in one paragraph**: a three-part architecture in which one component represents multi-axis interaction between provider and payer states, a second uses a Fisher-information-based state distance, and a third tests whether observed persistence requires long-memory dynamics rather than assuming it a priori. **Treating long memory as something to be tested rather than assumed is the part worth noting.** **Sixth, the data source and privacy boundary are stated**: payer-side data come from publicly available national medical fee payment fund statistics, and all data are aggregate and publicly available with no identifiable or confidential patient information. **This entry notes plainly that this is not the same as saying the upstream data carries no reuse restrictions, which the description does not address verbatim.** **Seventh, one blank in the registry was measured**: the keyword field is empty while the description runs to about two thousand seven hundred characters, and there is a single creator; **this entry records that without drawing a quality conclusion from it**. **Eighth, topical relevance is stated honestly**: the connection to insurance lies in the payment and review stage of health insurance, namely information asymmetry between payers and providers, rather than in actuarial pricing or reserving, and **the value here lies in how review and re-review data are organised into a reproducible analysis and in the four archival disciplines described above**. **Ninth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover Japanese health insurance rules and corpora, Japanese financial and life insurance statistics, medical document extraction, claims integrity review, insurance question-answering evidence and a mortality provenance framework, **while this entry supplies a claims-review archive that states which half of its inputs is reused, draws an anti-overreading boundary, declares aggregation and declares an absence. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled mortality provenance framework and the pooled claims integrity tooling**; **five practices transfer directly: itemise which part of an archive is new and which is reused; state up front that aggregate findings must not be read back onto individual decisions; declare that data are aggregate with no identifiable information; name what is missing, such as a manuscript not included; and count intermediate outputs and figure material as part of reproducibility**.

The Clifford component represents multi-axis interaction between provider and payer states, the Information component uses Fisher-information-based state distance, and the Fractional component tests whether observed persistence requires long-memory dynamics rather than assuming it a priori.／The repository includes: the reconstructed provider-side Fisher-state series for Japan, 1990–2024; payer-side adjudication, re-review, return, and restoration data derived from publicly available Social Insurance Medical Fee Payment Fund statistics; aligned provider–payer annual datasets; association and exact permutation analyses; derived CIF state metrics, Fisher distances, and Clifford coupling measures; code for reproducing the empirical calculations and figures; methodological notes, variable definitions, source documentation, metadata, citation information, and checksums.／The provider-side 1990–2024 series was originally developed in a related analysis of institutional adaptation and dynamic welfare loss and is reused here as a derived provider-state input. The novel analyses in this repository concern payer-side claims-review data, provider–payer associations, and the combined CIF representation of insurer–provider information asymmetry.／Importantly, individual claims adjudication or payment decisions are not interpreted as policy equilibrium. The accompanying analysis distinguishes routine payment decisions from the broader policy state.／Social welfare loss may persist when reimbursement rules, review criteria, and other institutional parameters remain misaligned with changing clinical, economic, workforce, and technological conditions even while individual claims continue to be processed normally.／All data are aggregate and publicly available. entries.summary_en: The server why-lingxi-insurance-mcp, registered in the official MCP registry under a Chinese domain namespace and backed by a repository, **is an artificial-intelligence-native insurance data platform for the Chinese market** whose readme opens by stating that it is not an insurance marketplace but structured insurance infrastructure for agents to call. **Measured this round**: the registry holds two version records published on the same day, both active, with a remote endpoint at whylingxi.cn; **this round actually called that endpoint, completing an MCP handshake and retrieving the tool list**, which includes a schema tool, a product search tool, a product detail tool and a comparison tool. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts**, and **four things are worth reading: the positioning sentence that this is not a marketplace but infrastructure; the tools and field descriptions retrieved by an actual call, including a recommended calling order and a default of not returning reasoning traces; a disagreement between the registry and the repository on coverage counts; and eleven access surfaces including agent-to-agent, an OpenAI-compatible route, an agent card, an OpenAPI description and a plain-text file for language models**. **Only the tool list was called once this round; no quote or underwriting call was made.**
entries.body:
**why-lingxi-insurance-mcp**（MCP 注册处 **`cn.whylingxi/insurance`**，**仓库 **`lpb123/whylingxi-insurance-mcp`****）**是一个**面向中国保险市场的 AI 原生保险数据平台****——**仓库 README 逐字标题为**「**WhyLingxi — China Insurance Intelligence Platform**」**，**并逐字划清定位**「**不是保险商城 —— 是给 AI Agent 调用的结构化保险基础设施。**」**。**本次实测**：**注册处记录 **`3.1.0` 与** `3.1.1` **两条版本**（**发布时间均为 **2026-06-02T10:23:56Z**、**状态 **active**、**远程端点逐字为** `https://whylingxi.cn/mcp`**）**；**⭐ 本次**实际调用该端点**（**MCP 握手 ＋ **工具清单**）**，**取回工具**逐字含** `get_schema`、`search_products`、`get_product_detail`、`compare_products` 等**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**注册处里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均注册处元数据、仓库 README 与本次实测调用所得）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 定位句逐字把「**不是商城**」写在最前****——**逐字**：**「**面向中国保险市场的 AI 原生保险数据平台。通过统一的 MCP 服务为 AI Agent 提供保险产品搜索、对比、推荐、精确报价与核保预检能力。**不是保险商城 —— 是给 AI Agent 调用的结构化保险基础设施。**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**它先说**自己**不是**什么**（**不是面向人的商城**）**，**再说**自己是**什么**（**面向 Agent 的基础设施**）**——**⭐ 这与第 360 轮那条「**先写这不是什么**」同向**，**而**这里的对象是**产品定位**而不是数据。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 本次调用取回了**工具与字段**，**且带一条**调用顺序**建议****——**实测** `get_schema` **的描述逐字为**「**获取调用策略和字段优先级。调用流程：(1)收集用户age后即可调recommend (2)有health_conditions时自动附带核保结论 (3)include_reasoning默认false，Agent自行组织语言 (4)返回的source_url可直接给用户作为投保链接。**」**；**⭐ 另外三个工具的参数逐字为**：`search_products`（**险种枚举逐字为**医疗险／重疾险／意外险／定期寿险／终身寿险／年金险／旅游险／团险；**另有** age、budget、keyword、limit**）、`get_product_detail`（**product_id ＋ **compact 精简模式**）、`compare_products`（**2 至 5 款对比**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄的地方是**它把**「**先收集什么、**再调什么**」**写进了工具的**返回内容**里**：**⭐ 即**调用顺序**不是**外部文档，**而是**工具自己会告诉你**。**⚠️ 本词条如实指出两处**：**① **`include_reasoning` 默认 false****（**即**默认不返回推理过程，**由 Agent 自己组织语言**）**；**② **返回的 `source_url` 可直接作为投保链接****（**⭐ 即**这是一个**带转化入口**的设计**，**本词条**只如实转述**，**不评判其合规性**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 登记处与仓库的**覆盖数字不一致**（本次实测）**——**注册处描述逐字为**「**Insurance search, recommendation, premium calc & underwriting for China. **65 insurers, 483 products**.**」**（**中文版逐字为**「**保险产品搜索、推荐、保费试算、核保预检。覆盖**65家保司483款产品****」**）**，**而仓库 README 逐字为**「**覆盖 **158 家保司 | 489 款在售产品 | 8 大险种 | 实时精确报价****」**。**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两组数字而不替它调和**，**并指出**这是一个**跨登记处与仓库的常见落差**（**⭐ 与第 360 轮记下的**「**登记处描述可能滞后**」同向**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 接入面被列成一张表，**共 **11 个****——**逐字含**：**MCP（**Streamable HTTP）**、**A2A（**Google Agent-to-Agent，**支持自然语言与结构化两种模式）**、**OpenAI 兼容接口**（**可替代 OpenAI API）**、**REST 对话**、**Agent Card 两处**（`/.well-known/agent.json` 与**别名** `agent-card.json`**）、**OpenAPI 规范**、**MCP Manifest**（`/.well-known/mcp.json`**）、**OpenAI 插件清单**（`ai-plugin.json`**）、**`llms.txt`**、**以及开发文档页**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组**接入面**值得记**：**⭐ 即**同一个能力**同时披了**面向不同生态的外壳**（**Agent 间、**模型工具调用、**插件、**纯文本说明**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 353 轮「**同源多形**」同向**，**而**这里是**同一个服务**对多种 Agent 协议**各出一版**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 九个工具与四类使用场景被写明**——**README 逐字列出九个工具**（`get_schema`／`search_products`／`get_product_detail`／`compare_products`／`recommend`／`get_premium`／`answer_question`／`check_underwriting`／`chat`**）**，**并逐字给出五类面向 Agent 的场景**（**保险规划、**理财顾问、**家庭保障、**养老规划、**健康咨询**）**与四类面向开发者的接入**（**MCP 集成、**OpenAI 工具调用、**A2A 委托协作、**自定义顾问应用**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**`check_underwriting`（**核保预检**）与**`get_premium`（**精确保费**）**是两个**最接近精算实务**的工具**——**⭐ 而**本次**未调用**它们**（**见下**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurance-ai-mcp]]、**[[insuranceoracle]]、**[[ai-insurance-multiagent-mcp]]、**[[insurancea2amcp]] 覆盖面向 Agent 的保险服务**，**[[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]、**[[insurance-actuarial-cn]]、**[[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]]、**[[insurance-recommendation-engine]] 覆盖中国市场一侧**，**[[insurance-qa-en]]、**[[insurance-qa-evidence]] 覆盖保险问答与证据**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一个中国市场 AI 原生保险数据平台：**以 **MCP／**A2A／**OpenAI 兼容**多协议对外、**把调用顺序写进工具描述、**并把**投保链接**作为返回值**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[insuranceoracle]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的四点**：**① 产品定位**先写「**我不是什么**」**；**② **调用顺序**最好由工具自己说明**（**而不是**只写在外部文档里）**；**③ **多次登记或多处描述时**要核对数字是否一致**；**④ **同一能力对多种 Agent 协议各出一版**时**要有一张接入面清单**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**只做了一次 MCP 握手与一次工具清单调用**（**未调用任何报价、**核保预检、**推荐或问答工具、**未提交任何个人或健康信息**），**故**不主张**其报价、**核保结论、**产品数据或覆盖数字的准确性**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**未读该仓库 README 的全文**（**只读了前段与工具、**接入两张表**）**，**也未读**其文档页、**OpenAPI 规范或 **`llms.txt` 的内容**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**「**158 家保司／489 款产品**」**与「**65 家／483 款**」**孰为当前**（**⭐ 本词条**只并列两处自述**）**，**也未核实**其数据来源与更新频率**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**该服务的**运营主体、**资质与**定价模式**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**其返回的** `source_url` **被描述为**可直接用作投保链接**，**而**这一点**在合规上意味着什么**，**本词条**不作判断**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**保险知识问答与条款解读**的内容从何而来**（**⭐ 是否引用条款原文、**是否有出处标注**）**——**⚠️ 这对精算与合规用途**至关重要**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实** A2A **与** OpenAI 兼容**两个接入面**是否**与 MCP 端点提供同一套能力**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实**该服务**是否收集或留存调用方数据**（**⭐ 其**隐私政策**本次**未访问**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**⭐ 注册处两条记录的发布时间均为 **2026-06-02****（**在解冻窗口之外**）**，**而**本次**实测的是**当下端点**——**⭐ 本词条**如实记录这一处**，**并指出**本条收录的缺口是**「**一个中国市场 AI 原生保险数据平台：**多协议接入 ＋ **把调用顺序写进工具描述**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该服务**不是**保险商城、**也不是**持牌建议渠道**，**其输出**不得**当作投保、**核保或精算判断依据**。

**why-lingxi-insurance-mcp**（MCP 註冊處 **`cn.whylingxi/insurance`**，**倉庫 `lpb123/whylingxi-insurance-mcp`****）**是一個**面向中國保險市場的 AI 原生保險資料平台****——**倉庫 README 逐字標題為**「**WhyLingxi — China Insurance Intelligence Platform**」**，**並逐字劃清定位**「**不是保险商城 —— 是给 AI Agent 调用的结构化保险基础设施。**」**。**本次實測**：**註冊處記錄 `3.1.0` 與 `3.1.1` 兩條版本**（**發布時間均為 2026-06-02、**狀態 active、**遠端端點逐字為** `https://whylingxi.cn/mcp`**）**；**⭐ 本次**實際調用該端點**（**MCP 握手 ＋ 工具清單**）**，**取回工具**逐字含** `get_schema`、`search_products`、`get_product_detail`、`compare_products` 等**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**註冊處裡的東西：調用一次才算數**」**。

**可核實資訊（均註冊處元資料、倉庫 README 與本次實測調用所得）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 定位句把「**不是商城**」寫在最前****——**逐字**「**不是保险商城 —— 是给 AI Agent 调用的结构化保险基础设施。**」**——**⭐ 即**先說自己**不是**什麼，**再說**自己是**什麼**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 本次調用取回**工具與欄位**，**並帶一條**調用順序**建議**——**`get_schema` 描述逐字**「**获取调用策略和字段优先级。调用流程：(1)收集用户age后即可调recommend (2)有health_conditions时自动附带核保结论 (3)include_reasoning默认false，Agent自行组织语言 (4)返回的source_url可直接给用户作为投保链接。**」**；**另三個工具**：`search_products`（**險種枚舉**醫療險／重疾險／意外險／定期壽險／終身壽險／年金險／旅遊險／團險；**另有** age／budget／keyword／limit**）、`get_product_detail`（product_id ＋ compact**）、`compare_products`（**2 至 5 款**）**。**⭐ 即**調用順序**不是外部文檔，**而是**工具自己會告訴你**。**⚠️ 兩處如實指出**：`include_reasoning` **預設 false**；**返回的** `source_url` **可直接作為投保連結**（**⭐ 這是**帶轉化入口**的設計，**只如實轉述**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 登記處與倉庫的**覆蓋數字不一致**（本次實測）**——**註冊處逐字** 65 insurers, 483 products（**中文版**覆蓋65家保司483款產品**）**，**而**倉庫 README 逐字**覆蓋 158 家保司 | 489 款在售產品 | 8 大險種**——**⭐ 如實並列而不替它調和**。**⭐⭐ ④ 接入面 **11 個****：**MCP（Streamable HTTP）**、**A2A**、**OpenAI 相容介面**、**REST 對話**、**Agent Card 兩處（**含別名**）**、**OpenAPI**、**MCP Manifest**、**OpenAI 插件清單**、**`llms.txt`**、**開發文檔**——**⭐ 即**同一個能力**披了**面向不同生態的外殼****。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 九個工具與四類場景**：`get_schema`／`search_products`／`get_product_detail`／`compare_products`／`recommend`／`get_premium`／`answer_question`／`check_underwriting`／`chat`**；**⭐ 其中** `check_underwriting`（**核保預檢**）與** `get_premium`（**精確保費**）**最接近精算實務**，**而本次**未調用**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[insuranceoracle]]、[[ai-insurance-multiagent-mcp]]、[[insurancea2amcp]]、[[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]、[[insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[insurance-recommendation-engine]]、[[insurance-qa-en]]、[[insurance-qa-evidence]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**中國市場 AI 原生保險資料平台：**多協議對外＋**把調用順序寫進工具描述＋**把投保連結作為返回值**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[insuranceoracle]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 四點最值得借鑑**：**① 產品定位**先寫「**我不是什麼**」**；**② **調用順序**最好由工具自己說明**；**③ **多處描述時**要核對數字是否一致**；**④ **同一能力對多協議各出一版**時要有一張接入面清單**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**只做了一次 MCP 握手與一次工具清單調用**（**未調用任何報價、**核保預檢、**推薦或問答工具、**未提交任何個人或健康資訊**），**不主張**其報價、**核保結論、**產品資料或覆蓋數字的準確性**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**未讀該倉庫 README 全文**，**也未讀**其文檔頁、**OpenAPI 規範或** `llms.txt` **的內容**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**「**158 家／489 款**」**與「**65 家／483 款**」**孰為當前**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**該服務的**運營主體、**資質與**定價模式**；**其** `source_url` **被描述為可直接用作投保連結**，**此點在合規上意味什麼**，**本詞條**不作判斷**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其**問答與條款解讀**的內容來源與出處標註**——**⚠️ 這對精算與合規用途至關重要**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實** A2A **與** OpenAI 相容**兩個接入面**是否提供同一套能力**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實**該服務**是否收集或留存調用方資料**（**未訪問其隱私政策**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**註冊處兩條記錄發布時間均為 2026-06-02（**窗口之外**）**，**而**本次實測的是**當下端點**——**如實記錄**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該服務**不是**保險商城、**也不是**持牌建議渠道**，**其輸出不得**當作投保、**核保或精算判斷依據**。
entries.body_en:
The server why-lingxi-insurance-mcp, registered in the official MCP registry under a Chinese domain namespace with a GitHub repository, **is an artificial-intelligence-native insurance data platform for the Chinese market**, titled as a China insurance intelligence platform and stating in its readme that it is not an insurance marketplace but structured insurance infrastructure for agents to call. **Measured this round**: the registry holds two version records published on the same day in June, both active, with a remote endpoint on the vendor domain; **this round completed an MCP handshake against that endpoint and retrieved the tool list**, which includes a schema tool, a product search tool, a product detail tool and a comparison tool. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the repository readme and the call made this round**: **first, the positioning sentence puts what the service is not at the front**: verbatim, it is an artificial-intelligence-native insurance data platform for the Chinese market that provides product search, comparison, recommendation, precise premium quotation and underwriting pre-check through a unified service, and **it is not an insurance marketplace but structured insurance infrastructure for agents to call**. **Saying what a product is not before saying what it is, applied to positioning rather than to data, is the most copyable line of this entry.** **Second, the call returned tools with field descriptions and a recommended calling order**: the schema tool states verbatim that after collecting the user age the recommendation tool can be called, that when health conditions are present an underwriting conclusion is attached automatically, that including reasoning traces defaults to false with the agent composing its own wording, and that the returned source URL can be given to the user directly as an application link; the search tool enumerates eight insurance categories and takes age, budget, keyword and a limit; the detail tool offers a compact mode; and the comparison tool covers two to five products. **The calling order is therefore delivered by the tool itself rather than living only in external documentation.** **This entry states plainly that reasoning traces are off by default and that the returned source URL is described as usable as an application link, which is a conversion path; this entry relays that without judging its compliance.** **Third, the registry and the repository disagree on coverage, as measured here**: the registry description states sixty-five insurers and four hundred and eighty-three products, while the repository readme states one hundred and fifty-eight insurers and four hundred and eighty-nine products across eight categories with real-time precise quotation. **This entry records both sets of numbers side by side without reconciling them, and notes that this is a common lag between a registry description and a repository.** **Fourth, the access surfaces are tabulated and number eleven**: a streaming HTTP MCP endpoint, an agent-to-agent endpoint with both natural-language and structured modes, an OpenAI-compatible chat completions route, a REST chat route, an agent card plus a compatibility alias, an OpenAPI description, an MCP manifest, an OpenAI plugin manifest, a plain-text file for language models, and a documentation page. **One capability wearing many shells for different ecosystems is the same shape as a source appearing in several forms, applied here to protocols.** **Fifth, nine tools and four audience situations are listed**: the tools cover schema, search, detail, comparison, recommendation, precise premium, question answering, underwriting pre-check and chat; the agent-facing situations cover insurance planning, wealth advice, family protection, retirement planning and health consultation; and the developer-facing routes cover MCP integration, OpenAI tool calling, agent-to-agent delegation and custom applications. **Of these, the underwriting pre-check and the precise premium tools are the two closest to actuarial practice, and neither was called this round.** **Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover agent-facing insurance services, China-market insurance material and insurance question answering with evidence, **while this entry supplies a China-market artificial-intelligence-native insurance data platform that speaks several agent protocols, puts its calling order inside the tool descriptions, and returns an application link. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled insurance oracle and the pooled compliance-oriented MCP server**; **four practices transfer directly: state what a product is not before what it is; let the tool itself describe the calling order; check whether multiple descriptions agree on the same numbers; and keep a list of access surfaces when one capability is offered under several agent protocols**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, only one MCP handshake and one tool-list call were made** — no quotation, underwriting pre-check, recommendation or question-answering tool was called, and no personal or health information was submitted — **so no claim is made about the accuracy of its quotations, underwriting conclusions, product data or coverage counts**. **Second, the repository readme was not read in full**, only its opening and its two tables, and its documentation page, OpenAPI description and plain-text model file were not read; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, which of the two coverage figures is current was not verified**, and neither was the data source or update frequency behind them. **Fourth, the operating entity, licensing status and pricing model were not verified**; the returned source URL is described as usable as an application link, **and this entry makes no judgement about what that implies for compliance**. **Fifth, where the question-answering and policy-interpretation content comes from, and whether it cites sources, was not verified, which matters greatly for actuarial or compliance use. Sixth, whether the agent-to-agent and OpenAI-compatible surfaces offer the same capabilities as the MCP endpoint was not verified. Seventh, whether the service collects or retains caller data was not verified**, its privacy policy not having been visited. **Eighth, on the window: both registry records were published in June, outside the thaw window, while the endpoint measured here is current, and this entry records that; the gap named for this entry is that an artificial-intelligence-native Chinese insurance data platform offering several agent protocols and putting its calling order inside tool descriptions had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the service is neither a marketplace nor a licensed advisory channel and that its output must not be used as a basis for application, underwriting or actuarial judgement.**

entries.summary_en: The server family state-auto-quotes-mcp, registered as one entry per United States state, **is a batch of motor insurance price servers** whose records were all published within about five seconds of each other, with five of them stating verbatim that the figures are not a quote and that the publisher is not yet licensed in that state, while two carry different wording. **Measured this round**: seven state records, all at version 1.0.0, all active, none with a repository field, each pointing at a remote endpoint on its own domain. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts**, and **four things are worth reading: calling the Texas endpoint returned eight tools, where the registry entry describes the server in a single sentence; the eligibility check comes before any personal details are collected; what is sold is de-identified demand records with the five-digit postcode explicitly excluded; and consent has scopes, with every delivery and refusal receipted and a revocation endpoint**. **Only the tool list was retrieved this round; no information was submitted and no marketplace tool was called.**
entries.body:
**state-auto-quotes-mcp**（MCP 注册处 **`com.texasautoquotes/insurance`** 等同族记录）**是一个**按美国各州批量登记的「**公开车险均价**」MCP 家族****——**本次实测**：**七个州逐条为**加州（`com.californiacarquotes/insurance`）、**佛州（`com.flautoquotes/insurance`）、**佐治亚（`com.georgiaautoquotes/insurance`）、**内华达（`com.nevadaautoquotes/insurance`）、**纽约（`com.newyorkautoquotes/insurance`）、**俄克拉何马（`com.oklahomaautoquotes/insurance`）、**得州（`com.texasautoquotes/insurance`**）**；**版本均为 **1.0.0**、**状态 **active**、**`repository` 字段均缺**（**⭐ 即**登记处没有给出源码仓库**）**，**远程端点逐字为** `https://<州>autoquotes.com/mcp`**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**注册处里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均注册处元数据与本次实测调用所得）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 七条记录在**约五秒内**被批量登记**（本次实测）**——**逐条发布时间逐字为** 得州 **2026-09-04T21:40:57Z**、**加州与佛州 **21:40:58Z**、**纽约 **21:41:00Z**、**佐治亚与内华达 **21:41:01Z**、**俄克拉何马 **21:41:02Z**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**登记处的时间戳**本身暴露了**这是一次脚本化的批量发布**——**⭐ 这与本站「**同作者同形近重复**」的判定规则**直接相关**：**当**七条记录**在五秒内出现、**命名同构、**描述同构**时，**按规则**只收族中一条**，**并在条目里说明**这是一个族**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 描述里**免责声明并不一致**（本次实测）**——**五条逐字为**「**«州名»的 published auto insurance averages. **Not a quote; we are not licensed here yet.**」**，**而**内华达与得州两条**逐字改为**「**Auto insurance prices for «州名» drivers, **from rates the state publishes.**」**。**⭐ 本词条**如实并列两种措辞而不替它调和**，**并指出**这正是**批量发布**常见的**细节漂移**（**⭐ 与第 360 轮记下的**「**登记处描述可能滞后或不一致**」同向**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 本次**实际调用**了得州端点，**取回的工具数远超登记处的描述**——**登记处对该服务只有一句话**，**而**握手后 `tools/list` **实测返回 **8 个工具****：`check_eligibility`、`get_quotes`、`pull_requests`、`data_use_terms`、`request_agent_contact`、`register_agency`、`market_data`、`agency_status`**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**登记处里一句话的东西**，**调用一次之后**是**一条完整的业务闭环**——**⭐ 而**这与第 360／361 轮反复出现的**「**登记 ≠ 可用 ≠ 完整**」同一主题**：**要判断一个 MCP 服务做什么**，**必须**调用它的工具清单**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 而它其实是一条**带同意范围的线索市场****——**实测工具描述逐字为**：**① **资格门**「**Check whether we can return quotes for a state **before any personal details are collected**. **Call this first.** Returns the states we are licensed in, what we can do in each, and how many licensed agents can take a request there.**」**；**② **报价**「**Return indicative auto insurance prices from multiple carriers, **where this entity is licensed to show them**. **Takes rating facts only — no name, phone, email, SSN or licence number is required for an indicative price.** Where we are not licensed to show prices, the request is still registered and **a quote_id returned** so licensed agents can quote it. **If facts are missing the server asks for exactly what it needs and nothing more.**」**；**③ **同意与转交**「**Needs the quote_id **」**——**逐字續**「**, the consumer的 name and phone, and **the consumer的 explicit consent to be contacted** **」**——**逐字續**「** **Under scope `contact_consumer` up to 4 licensed agents receive the request and contact details; `sell_identity` additionally permits sharing with marketing partners.** **Nothing leaves without the consent. Every delivery and refusal is receipted, and `POST /forget` revokes.**」**；**④ **数据用途条款**「**What happens to anything you send us: who receives it, for what purpose, how long it is kept, how your human revokes it, and **the exact consent wording to present before `request_agent_contact`**. **Machine readable so you can evaluate the exchange before making it.**」**；**⑤ **卖出的一侧**「**Buy provenance-qualified, de-identified demand records **」**——**逐字續**「** only requests backed by a **cryptographically or IP-verified agent, or a phone-verified consumer outcome**. **User-agent claims, legacy rows, probes and impostors are quarantined and unavailable for sale.** **」**——**逐字續**「** **Never a name, phone, email, date of birth or five-digit ZIP.**」**；**⑥ **机构侧**「**register the agency to receive consented consumer requests in its states. Needs the agency name, the producer NPN（National Producer Number）and its state **」**——**逐字續**「** **The licensed contact confirms by a link sent to their email; nothing is delivered before that.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组值得抄的地方有**三处**：**（**a**）**同意**不是**一句提示**，**而是**两个具名范围**（**`contact_consumer` 与 **`sell_identity`**）**，**而**且**由人来给**；**（**b**）**每次投递与拒绝都出**回执**，**且**撤销有专门端点**；**（**c**）**卖出的数据**明确**去掉姓名、**电话、**邮箱、**出生日期与五位数邮编**，**并**把**未验证的 Agent**、**探针与冒充者**列为**隔离不售****。**⚠️ 本词条如实指出**：**⭐ 这句话**恰好覆盖本次的行为**——**本次正是一次**探针**，**⭐ 而**按服务自述，**探针数据**不会进入可售数据集**；**⭐ 本词条**据此强调**：**本次**未调用** `get_quotes`、**`request_agent_contact`、**`market_data` 或 `pull_requests` **中的任何一个**，**也**未提交任何姓名、**电话或地址**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insuranceoracle]]、**[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、**[[property-hazard-mcp]]、**[[root-insurance-mcp]]、**[[bima-mcp]]、**[[claims-triage-mcp]] 覆盖面向 Agent 的保险服务**，**[[insurance-recommendation-engine]]、**[[higson-motor-insurance-demo]] 覆盖车险报价与业务规则**，**[[insurance-fairness-ldp]]、**[[insurance-governance]] 覆盖数据治理与公平性**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一条**按州批量登记的车险线索市场：**先查牌照再收资料 ＋ **同意分两个具名范围 ＋ **投递与拒绝都出回执并可撤销 ＋ **卖出数据去掉直接标识**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[insuranceoracle]]、[[insurance-governance]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① **收集任何资料之前**先查**能不能服务**；**② **同意要写成**具名范围**，**而**不是**一个布尔量**；**③ **投递与拒绝**都留回执**，**并**提供**撤销入口**；**④ **对外提供的记录**去掉**直接标识**（**含**五位数邮编**）**；**⑤ **批量发布的东西**在登记处会留下**时间戳痕迹**，**识别同一族并不难**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**只做了一次 MCP 握手与一次工具清单调用**（**未调用** `get_quotes`／`request_agent_contact`／`market_data`／`pull_requests`／`register_agency` **中的任何一个、**未提交任何姓名、**电话、**地址或同意**），**故**不主张**其报价质量、**线索真实性、**回执机制或**撤销机制的实际行为**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**只调用得州一个端点**（**⭐ 其余六州**按同族处理、**未逐个调用**）**——**⚠️ 故**「**八个工具在同族各州是否一致**」**本次**未核实**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `pull_requests` **所述** x402 **与 **402 状态**的实际返回**；**也未核实** `market_data` **的定价、**最小起订量与**免费样本**（**⭐ 描述称**样本与模式在 `/data.json`**，**本次**未访问**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `register_agency` **所需的 **NPN**（**全国生产者编号**）**如何被验证**，**也未核实**「**首个机构在本州免费**」**这一创始期安排的具体条款**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**牌照声明**是否属实**（**⭐ 描述称**返回「**我们已获牌的州**」**）**，**也未核实其**运营主体**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**该服务**面向消费者时的**信息披露**与**同意界面**（**⭐ 本次**只看到机器可读条款的工具**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**七条记录发布于 **2026-09-04**（**比解冻窗口起点早两天**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**按州批量登记的车险线索市场：**资格门前置 ＋ **同意分范围 ＋ **回执与撤销 ＋ **卖出数据去标识**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该服务**面向的是**线索转交**，**其「**均价**」不是报价**（**⭐ 服务自己就这么写**）**，**不得**当作任何核保或定价依据**。

User-agent claims, legacy rows, probes and impostors are quarantined and unavailable for sale.** **」**——**逐字續**「** **Never a name, phone, email, date of birth or five-digit ZIP.**」**；**⑥ 機構側**「**The licensed contact confirms by a link sent to their email; nothing is delivered before that.**」**。**⭐ 三處值得抄**：**（**a**）同意**不是一個布林量**，**而是**兩個具名範圍**；**（**b**）每次投遞與拒絕都出**回執**，**且**撤銷有專門端點**；**（**c**）賣出的資料**去掉姓名、**電話、**郵箱、**出生日期與五位數郵編**，**並**把**未驗證的 Agent、**探針與冒充者**列為**隔離不售****。**⚠️ 如實指出**：**這句話**恰好覆蓋本次的行為**——**本次正是一次**探針**，**而**按服務自述，**探針資料**不會進入可售資料集**；**⭐ 本次**未調用** `get_quotes`／`request_agent_contact`／`market_data`／`pull_requests` **任何一個**，**也未提交任何姓名、**電話或地址**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insuranceoracle]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[property-hazard-mcp]]、[[root-insurance-mcp]]、[[bima-mcp]]、[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[insurance-recommendation-engine]]、[[higson-motor-insurance-demo]]、[[insurance-fairness-ldp]]、[[insurance-governance]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**按州批量登記的車險線索市場：先查牌照再收資料＋同意分兩個具名範圍＋投遞與拒絕都出回執並可撤銷＋賣出資料去掉直接標識**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[insuranceoracle]]、[[insurance-governance]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 五點最值得借鑑**：**① **收集任何資料之前**先查**能不能服務**；**② **同意寫成**具名範圍**；**③ **投遞與拒絕**都留回執並提供撤銷入口**；**④ **對外提供的記錄**去掉**直接標識**；**⑤ **批量發布的東西**在登記處會留下**時間戳痕跡****。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**只做一次 MCP 握手與一次工具清單調用**（**未調用** `get_quotes`／`request_agent_contact`／`market_data`／`pull_requests`／`register_agency`、**未提交任何姓名、**電話、**地址或同意**），**不主張**其報價質量、**線索真實性、**回執或**撤銷機制的實際行為**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**只調用得州一個端點**（**其餘六州按同族處理、**未逐個調用**）——**⚠️ 故**「**八個工具在同族各州是否一致**」**本次未核實**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** x402 **與** 402 狀態**的實際返回**；**未核實** `market_data` **的定價、**最小起訂量與免費樣本**（**未訪問** `/data.json`**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實** NPN（**全國生產者編號**）**如何被驗證**，**未核實**「**首個機構在本州免費**」**的具體條款**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其**牌照聲明**是否屬實**，**未核實其運營主體**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**其**面向消費者時的信息披露與同意界面**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**七條記錄發布於 2026-09-04**（**比窗口起點早兩天**）**——**本條的缺口是**「**按州批量登記的車險線索市場：資格門前置＋同意分範圍＋回執與撤銷＋賣出資料去標識**」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該服務**面向線索轉交**，**其「**均價**」不是報價**，**不得**當作任何核保或定價依據**。
entries.body_en:
The server family state-auto-quotes-mcp, registered as one record per United States state, **is a batch of motor insurance price servers** whose seven measured records were all published between the fifty-seventh second of one minute and the second second of the next on a single day in early September, at identical version, all active, and none with a repository field, each pointing at a remote endpoint on its own domain. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata and the call made this round**: **first, seven records were published within about five seconds of each other**, which this entry notes exposes a scripted batch publication and is directly relevant to the standing rule about near-duplicate siblings from one author, under which only one member of a family is collected and the family is described. **Second, the disclaimer wording inside the family is not uniform**: five records state verbatim that the figures are published averages and that this is not a quote because the publisher is not licensed in that state yet, while two records instead say the prices come from rates the state publishes. **This entry records both wordings side by side without reconciling them, as an instance of the detail drift that batch publication tends to produce.** **Third, calling the Texas endpoint returned far more than the registry entry describes**: the registry describes the server in one sentence, while an MCP handshake followed by a tool list returned **eight tools**, covering eligibility, indicative quotes, pulling routed records, data-use terms, requesting agent contact, registering an agency, buying de-identified demand data, and checking agency status. **A single sentence in a registry can be a complete business loop once called, which is why the tool list, not the registry description, is what tells you what a server does.** **Fourth, what the server actually is, is a lead marketplace with consent scopes**: verbatim, eligibility is checked before any personal details are collected, and the tool says to call it first, returning the states the publisher is licensed in and how many licensed agents can take a request there; indicative prices take rating facts only, with no name, phone, email, social security number or licence number required, and where the publisher is not licensed to show prices the request is still registered and a quote identifier is returned so licensed agents can quote it, with the server asking for exactly what it needs and nothing more when facts are missing; connecting a consumer requires the quote identifier, a name and a phone number, and the consumer explicit consent, under a scope where up to four licensed agents receive the request and details or a wider scope that additionally permits sharing with marketing partners, with the statement that nothing leaves without consent, that every delivery and refusal is receipted, and that a forget endpoint revokes; a data-use-terms tool returns who receives anything sent, for what purpose, how long it is kept, how the human revokes it, and the exact consent wording to present, machine readable so the exchange can be evaluated before it is made; the sell side covers provenance-qualified, de-identified demand records backed only by a cryptographically or IP-verified agent or a phone-verified consumer outcome, with user-agent claims, legacy rows, probes and impostors quarantined and unavailable for sale, and with names, phone numbers, emails, dates of birth and five-digit postcodes never included; and the agency side requires the agency name, the producer national number and the appointed states, with the licensed contact confirming by a link sent to their email and nothing delivered before that. **Three of those are worth copying: consent is not a boolean but two named scopes; every delivery and refusal is receipted and revocation has its own endpoint; and the sold data drops direct identifiers while unverified agents, probes and impostors are quarantined from sale.** **This entry notes plainly that the quarantine sentence covers exactly what this round did, since this round was a probe, and therefore states that none of the quote, contact, market-data or pull tools was called and that no name, phone number or address was submitted.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover agent-facing insurance services, motor insurance quoting and business rules, and data governance and fairness, **while this entry supplies a per-state batch of motor insurance lead-marketplace servers that gate on licensing before collecting anything, split consent into named scopes, receipt every delivery and refusal while offering revocation, and drop direct identifiers from what is sold. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled insurance oracle and the pooled insurance governance entries**; **five practices transfer directly: check whether you may serve before collecting anything; write consent as named scopes rather than a boolean; receipt every delivery and refusal and expose a revocation path; strip direct identifiers from anything offered outward; and recognise that batch-published registry entries leave timestamp traces that make family membership easy to detect**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, only one MCP handshake and one tool-list call were made**, with none of the quote, contact, market-data, pull or agency-registration tools called and no name, phone number, address or consent submitted, **so no claim is made about quote quality, lead authenticity, or the actual behaviour of the receipt and revocation mechanisms**. **Second, only the Texas endpoint was called**, the other six being treated as family members without individual calls, **so whether the eight tools are identical across the family was not verified**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the actual response for a payment-required state was not verified, nor were the pricing, minimum purchase or free sample of the market-data tool**, the described sample file not having been visited. **Fourth, how a producer national number is validated was not verified, nor were the terms of the free founding period for the first agencies in a state. Fifth, whether the licensing claims are accurate was not verified, nor was the operating entity identified. Sixth, the consumer-facing disclosure and consent interface was not verified**, only the machine-readable terms tool having been seen. **Seventh, on the window: the seven records were published two days before the thaw window opened, and following the project convention of naming the gap, the gap here is that a per-state batch of motor insurance lead-marketplace servers with a licensing gate, scoped consent, receipts and revocation, and de-identified sale data had no counterpart in the pool. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the service is about lead handoff, that its published averages are not a quote as the service itself says, and that they must not be used as a basis for underwriting or pricing.**

Machine readable so you can evaluate the exchange before making it.）、request_agent_contact（Connect the consumer with licensed insurance agents who can quote firm and bind. Needs the quote_id ／, the consumer的 name and phone, and the consumer的 explicit consent to be contacted ／ Under scope contact_consumer up to 4 licensed agents receive the request and contact details; sell_identity additionally permits sharing with marketing partners. The licensed contact confirms by a link sent to their email; nothing is delivered before that. The first agencies in a state receive leads free for a founding period, then prepaid credits by card.）、market_data（Buy provenance-qualified, de-identified demand records ／ only requests backed by a cryptographically or IP-verified agent, or a phone-verified consumer outcome. User-agent claims, legacy rows, probes and impostors are quarantined and unavailable for sale. Qualified rows are de-identified（age band, ZIP3, vehicle, coverage, mileage band, prices shown, door, verified agent identity and outcome）. Never a name, phone, email, date of birth or five-digit ZIP. ／ Without payment the result is a 402 with the price and a preview count. A free sample and the schema are at /data.json.）、agency_status（／ its states, rail, terms, founding period, queued and delivered counts, credit balance, and whether the licence was verified. Requires the buyer key issued at confirmation.）｜⚠️本次只做一次 MCP 握手与一次工具清单调用（未调用 get_quotes／request_agent_contact／market_data／pull_requests／register_agency 中任何一个，未提交任何姓名、电话、地址或同意），不主张其报价质量、线索真实性、回执或撤销机制的实际行为｜⚠️本次只调用得州一个端点（其余六州按同族处理、未逐个调用），故「八个工具在同族各州是否一致」未核实——本条目最需后续核实的一处｜⚠️未核实 x402 与 402 状态的实际返回；未核实 market_data 的定价、最小起订量与免费样本（未访问 /data.json）｜⚠️未核实 NPN（全国生产者编号）如何被验证，未核实「首个机构在本州免费」的创始期条款｜⚠️未核实其牌照声明是否属实，未核实运营主体｜⚠️未核实其面向消费者时的信息披露与同意界面（本次只看到机器可读条款工具）｜⚠️窗口状况：七条记录发布于 2026-09-04（比解冻窗口起点早两天），缺口为「按州批量登记的车险线索市场：资格门前置＋同意分范围＋回执与撤销＋卖出数据去标识」池内无对应物｜⚠️本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见；该服务面向线索转交，其「均价」不是报价（服务自己就这么写），不得当作任何核保或定价依据

entries.summary_en: The two registry entries enquiry-consent-mcp **are freight and marine insurance enquiry servers whose only function is to hand a person to a human broker**, both published on the same day in September, both at version 1.0.0 and active, each with a remote endpoint on its own domain, and both pointing at the same repository address which was measured to return not found. **This round completed a handshake, retrieved the tool list and called two read-only tools**, obtaining three tools whose collective title states that what you get is an enquiry with a human rather than a purchase and not a guaranteed quote. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts**, and **four things are worth reading: the machine-readable statement that this is not a purchase and no quote is guaranteed; a two-step submission with a confirmation token and an emailed link that a provider must wait for; a sentence telling readers to consult the bill of lading rather than trusting any summary including its own; and a sentence explaining why no price appears on the site at all**. **The repository address named by the registry was measured to return not found.**
entries.body:
**enquiry-consent-mcp**（MCP 注册处 **`com.freightinsurancecost/site`** 与 **`com.marineinsurancecost/site`**）**是两个**只做「**转人工**」的货运与海运保险询价 MCP****——**本次实测**：**两条记录均在 **2026-09-06** 发布**（**逐字为** `2026-09-06T21:11:10Z` 与** `2026-09-06T21:22:14Z`**）**、**版本 **1.0.0**、**状态 **active**、**远程端点逐字为** `https://freightinsurancecost.com/mcp` **与** `https://marineinsurancecost.com/mcp`**，**且**两条记录**都指向**同一个仓库地址** `https://github.com/joeetdev/venture-estate`**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**注册处里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均注册处元数据与本次实测调用所得）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 登记处的描述**被截断**，**而**调用后才知道它是什么**（本次实测）**——**注册处里两条描述逐字为**「**Freight Insurance Cost: the site的 own MCP server — enquiry (enquiry = a human handoff, not a**」**——**逐字續**「****」**（**海运那条同构**）**，**即**描述**在登记处被截断**；**而**本次握手后取回的**服务自述逐字为**「**Freight Insurance Cost (https://freightinsurancecost.com/): the site的 own MCP server, served from its domain. **Sea freight insurance is priced on value, route and packing. Why carrier liability is not insurance, and what general average means.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**登记处一句话 ＋ **调用后一段自述**」的落差**，**与第 361 轮前一条**（**登记处一句话、**调用后八个工具**）是同一现象的两个样本**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 三个工具**整体上只做一件事：**把人交给**人****——**实测工具逐字为**：**① `enquiry_describe`**，**标题逐字**「**What you get: an ENQUIRY with a human (not a purchase, not a guaranteed quote)**」**，**描述逐字**「**Read first. The two registry entries enquiry-consent-mcp, both published on the same day in September, both at version 1.0.0 and active, each with a remote endpoint on its own domain, and both naming the same repository address, **are freight and marine insurance enquiry servers whose only job is to hand a person to a human broker**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata and the call made this round**: **first, the registry description is truncated, and only a call reveals what the server is**: the registry text stops with the phrase about an enquiry being a human handoff, while the handshake returns the server own summary stating that sea freight insurance is priced on value, route and packing and that the server explains why carrier liability is not insurance and what general average means. **A one-line registry entry and a paragraph of self-description after a call is the same gap seen in the previous entry of this round.** **Second, all three tools do one thing, which is to move a person to a person**: verbatim, the describing tool is titled as what you get being an enquiry with a human rather than a purchase and not a guaranteed quote, and its description says to read it first, states plainly that the submission tool starts an enquiry with human providers who quote directly, that nothing is bought, ordered or paid, that no quote is guaranteed and that it is free, and that it also returns who receives the details, the consent wording and how the person confirms; a second tool returns the enquiry form structure; and the third is titled as submitting an enquiry to human providers in two steps, not a purchase. **None of the three tools looks up a rate, computes a premium or compares prices; the whole server is a handoff, and that is stated in the tool titles.** **Third, submission takes two calls plus a confirmation token, and a provider sees nothing until the person clicks an emailed link**: verbatim, the first step takes the answers and a consent flag, validates them and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token which are to be shown to the person, and the second step is made only if the person agrees, with the same answers, the consent flag and the token, after which the enquiry is submitted and the person receives an email with a link they must click before any provider sees it; consent means the person has read and agreed to the provided sentence about their details going to cargo insurance brokers who will contact them directly. The input schema marks the consent flag as required and forbids additional properties. **Consent is therefore a chain of verifiable state transitions rather than a prompt: a returned summary and consent sentence, a person who agrees, a second call carrying the token, and an emailed confirmation before any provider gains visibility.** **Fourth, a read-only call returns a machine-readable list of what this is not**: the measured response includes flags stating that this is not a purchase and that no quote is guaranteed, along with the cost described as free and with no obligation, a citation line and a page address; a field stating that this is not a purchase, not an order, not a booking and not a guaranteed quote or price, and that the providers decide whether and what to quote; and a field naming the operator as a limited company, stating that the site is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any agency or company named on it and that nothing on it is legal, customs, regulatory or trade advice, that the operator takes no commission and carries no paid placements, that no premium or rate is published because marine cargo cover is priced individually on commodity, value, route, packing and claims history, that carrier liability limits are terms of the carriage contract and of the applicable convention so the bill of lading should be read rather than any summary including this one, and that regulatory positions are summarised from the agencies own pages on the date shown and are a starting point rather than a substitute. **Three of those sentences are worth copying: no commission and no paid placements as an independence statement; an explicit reason for an absence, namely why no price appears here; and an instruction to the reader to go back to the original document rather than trusting this summary, including its own.** **Fifth, the form structure is retrievable**: the fields tool returns a form title and per-field definitions with keys, labels, types, whether required, step and options, the first three measured being a required cargo type selection, a required shipment value band selection and an optional packing selection. **Sixth, one gap between the registry and reality was measured**: both records name the same repository address, and that address was measured to return not found, so no source or readme could be read. **Seventh, the operator is named in the response**, and the maintainer name of the sibling package described in the next entry of this round matches it; **this entry records the fact without inferring a relationship**. **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover freight and marine insurance material, agent-facing insurance services, and insurance data governance and fairness, **while this entry supplies enquiry servers that do nothing but hand a person to a human, declare in machine-readable form that this is not a purchase, require a two-step submission with a token and an emailed confirmation before any provider sees anything, and instruct the reader to consult the original document rather than any summary including their own. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled insurance governance entry and the pooled freight insurance entry**; **five practices transfer directly: make what you are not into machine-readable fields; split consent into verifiable state transitions; give a reason for an absence rather than leaving a blank; tell the reader not to trust your own summary and point at the original document; and actually open any repository address a registry names**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, only a handshake, a tool list and two read-only tool calls were made**, with the submission tool never called, no cargo, value, route or contact details submitted and no consent flag set, **so the actual behaviour of the submission flow, including token validation, email delivery and visibility timing, is not claimed**. **Second, only the freight endpoint was explored in detail**, the marine one yielding only a tool list, **so whether the two are identical in tools and form was not checked field by field**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the repository address named by the registry was measured to return not found, so no source code or readme could be read**, and everything stated here comes from registry metadata and endpoint responses. **Fourth, the registration, address and regulatory status of the named operating company were not verified, nor was its relationship to any broker or insurer, the response stating that it has none.** **Fifth, the accuracy of the independence claim about taking no commission and carrying no paid placements was not verified**, only recorded as a self-description. **Sixth, the actual sources and date stamps behind its regulatory summary were not verified. Seventh, whether the third server in the same family shares one implementation with these two was not verified**, this entry recording only that they name the same repository address. **Eighth, on the window: both records were published 2026-09-06, inside the thaw window, so there is no window exception to declare. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the service is neither a purchase nor a quote nor legal or customs advice, as the service itself says, and must not be used as a basis for any application or rate.**

entries.summary_en: The npm package and registry entry damagerestore-claims-index **turn one derived statistic, the median paid water damage claim, into a full set of agent tools**, described verbatim as an MCP server over a real sourced dataset and as served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer. **Measured this round**: the package is licensed MIT, was created and modified within about fifty minutes on the same day in September, carries two versions, depends on a shared toolkit package, and is only about one point six kilobytes with four files, of which the entry point is six hundred and thirty-eight bytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts**, and **four things are worth reading: one of the seven tools is dedicated to provenance, source, computed date, licence and citation; the package promises verbatim that every answer carries its source and licence; the full dataset is also offered as a resource; and the registry description is truncated while the package description carries the complete sentence, so the same item holds different amounts of information in two registries**. **The package entry point was not executed this round and no dataset tool was called.**
entries.body:
**damagerestore-claims-index**（npm 包 **`@ellul-estate/damagerestorehq-com-claims-index-mcp`** 与 MCP 注册处 **`com.damagerestorehq/claims-index`**）**是把**一个派生统计量**做成一整套 Agent 工具的做法****——**逐字自述为**「**An MCP server over a real, sourced dataset.**」**，**并逐字写明交付方式**「**served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer**」**，**其主题逐字为**「**DamageRestore HQ: the median paid water damage claim, read from NFIP claim records (2023 to 2026)**」**。**本次实测**：**npm 许可 **MIT****、**创建 **2026-09-06T17:04:32Z**、**修改 **2026-09-06T17:54:29Z**、**两个版本**（`0.1.0` 与 `1.0.0`**）**、**包体 **1,643 字节 / 4 个文件****（**`package.json`／**`server.json`／**`README.md`／**`bin.mjs` 638 字节**）**、**维护者逐字为 **`ellul-estate`****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**注册处里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均注册处元数据与 npm registry 元数据与包内文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 七个工具里有一个**专做来源与引用****——**包内 README 逐字列出七个工具及其回答什么**：`dataset_columns`（**模式：列、**哪些是数值、**行数与**出处**）、`dataset_search`、`dataset_row`、`dataset_compare`、`dataset_stats`、`dataset_top`，**以及** `dataset_provenance`（**逐字**「**the source, computed date, licence and citation**」**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**它把「**这份数据是哪来的、**什么时候算的、**许可是什么、**该怎么引用**」**做成**一个可调用的工具**——**⭐ 这与本站第 339 轮「**每个值指回它的来源**」、第 354 轮「**可引用性**」同向**，**而**这里是**把可引用性当成一个工具接口**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**每个回答都带来源与许可**」是逐字承诺**——**逐字**：**「**The full dataset is also offered as a CSV resource.**」**与**「**Source: FEMA. **Every answer carries the dataset page and licence.** The data is free to cite with a link to https://damagerestorehq.com/data.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一句值得抄**：**⭐ 即**不是「**请注明来源**」**这种**对外要求**，**而是**「**我给出去的每个回答**自带来源与许可**」**这种**对内约束**——**⭐ 与之对照**：**多数数据服务**把引用要求**写在条款里**，**而**不**放在**每次返回**里**。**⭐⭐ ③ 交付形态被拆成**包 ＋ 注册处 ＋ 数据页三处****——**实测**：**npm 包为 **stdio 传输**（**入口 `bin.mjs`**，**依赖 `@ellul-estate/mcp-kit`**）**，**安装方式逐字为** `npx @ellul-estate/damagerestorehq-com-claims-index-mcp`**；**注册处同日给出**两条记录**（`0.1.0` 与** `1.0.0`**）**，**其中一条的** `packages` **字段指向同一个 npm 包**；**而**数据本身另在**网站页** `https://damagerestorehq.com/data` **发布**，**许可条款另在** `https://damagerestorehq.com/terms`**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**同一个东西**在**三个地方**各有形态**（**可安装的包、**可发现的注册处条目、**给人看的数据页**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 353 轮「**同源多形**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ④ 同一条目在两个登记处**信息量不同**（本次实测）**——**注册处的描述**被截断**，**逐字止于**「**read from NFIP claim records (2023 to**」**——**逐字續**「****」**；**而** npm 上的**同句完整**，**逐字为**「**read from NFIP claim records (**2023 to 2026**)**」**。**⭐ 本词条**如实并列两处**，**并指出**：**⭐ 即**登记处的**截断**会让**读者**看不到**最关键的时间范围**——**⭐ 这与第 361 轮前两条**（**登记处一句话、**真实内容更多**）是同一类落差**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本与发布节奏可核**——**npm 元数据实测**：**创建 **2026-09-06T17:04:32Z**、**修改 **2026-09-06T17:54:29Z****（**约 **50 分钟**内**从 `0.1.0` **到** `1.0.0`**）**，**两版**均带**完整性哈希**（**v1.0.0 为 **sha512**）**，**而**注册处**两条记录的**发布时间同为 **2026-09-06****；**⭐ 本词条认为**「**首版到正式版相隔 50 分钟**」**本身是一条信息**：**⭐ 即**这是一个**当天成形的发布**，**而**不是**长期维护的包**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一处**登记处字段与现实不符**（本次实测）**——**注册处 `1.0.0` 记录的** `repository` 字段逐字为** `https://github.com/joeetdev/venture-estate`**，**npm 元数据里 **v1.0.0 的** `repository` 亦逐字为** `git+https://github.com/joeetdev/venture-estate.git`**；**而**该地址**实测返回 **404****（**仓库页与原始文件均不可得**）**。**⭐ 本词条**如实记录**，**并指出**这与**同族的两个询价服务**（**见上一条**）**指向**同一个 404 地址**——**⭐ 即**这三条记录**共用**一个**不可访问的仓库字段**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、**[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]、**[[rfema]] 覆盖美国国家洪水保险计划（**NFIP）数据与工具**，**[[claims-api]]、**[[insurance-qa-evidence]] 覆盖理赔与证据**，**[[insuranceoracle]]、**[[property-hazard-mcp]] 覆盖面向 Agent 的保险服务**，**[[us-mortgage-financing-constants]] 覆盖「**每个值自带来源**」的常数数据**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一个派生统计量配七个工具：**其中一个是**来源与引用工具** ＋ **逐字承诺每个回答自带来源与许可 ＋ **完整数据另作 resource 提供**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[us-mortgage-financing-constants]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① 把「**来源、**计算日期、**许可与引用**」**做成一个工具**，**而不是**一句条款**；**② **让每次返回**自带来源与许可**；**③ **完整数据**可另作 **resource** 提供**；**④ **同一个东西在多个登记处时**要检查描述是否被截断**；**⑤ **发布节奏**（**首版到正式版相隔多久**）**可以当作成熟度线索**。

**⚠️ 本条目如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有执行该 npm 包的入口、**也没有调用任何数据集工具**（**未取任何水损理赔数字、**未跑 `npx`、**未连任何 MCP 客户端**），**故**不主张**其数据、**统计或**「**每次返回都带来源**」这一承诺的实际行为**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**未读包内 `bin.mjs` 的正文**（**⭐ 该文件仅 638 字节，**推测为**依赖 `@ellul-estate/mcp-kit` 的薄封装**，**但**本词条**不作此判断**）**，**也未读** `server.json` **与** `package.json` **正文**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `dataset_provenance` **返回的来源字段**是否**真的包含计算日期与许可**（**⭐ 只读到 README 的表格**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其**数据来源**是否确为** FEMA／**NFIP 记录**，**也未核实** 2023 至 2026 **这一范围**的**实际覆盖与更新频率**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**「**median paid water damage claim**」**这一指标的口径**（**⭐ 即**分母、**是否含税、**是否按年或按州**）**——**⚠️ 这对任何比较都关键**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**数据许可与 npm 的 **MIT 许可**是否**覆盖不同对象**（**⭐ README 把**数据许可指向网站条款页**，**而**包本身为 MIT**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实**发布者**（`ellul-estate`／** `Ellul Solutions Ltd`）**与该网站的关系**，**也未核实其**是否**与被引用机构（**FEMA）**有任何关系**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**⭐ 该包与注册处记录**均成于 **2026-09-06**（**在解冻窗口之内**）**——**⭐ 无需窗口例外说明**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该指标是**衍生统计**，**不得**当作任何理赔、**定价或核保依据**。

**damagerestore-claims-index**（npm 包 **`@ellul-estate/damagerestorehq-com-claims-index-mcp`** 與 MCP 註冊處 **`com.damagerestorehq/claims-index`**）**是把**一個派生統計量**做成一整套 Agent 工具的做法****——**逐字自述為**「**An MCP server over a real, sourced dataset.**」**，**並逐字寫明交付方式**「**served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer**」**，**其主題逐字為**「**DamageRestore HQ: the median paid water damage claim, read from NFIP claim records (2023 to 2026)**」**。**本次實測**：**npm 許可 MIT**、**建立 2026-09-06T17:04:32Z**、**修改 2026-09-06T17:54:29Z**、**兩個版本（`0.1.0` 與 `1.0.0`）**、**包體 1,643 位元組／4 個檔案**（**`bin.mjs` 638 位元組**）**、**維護者逐字為 `ellul-estate`****。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**註冊處裡的東西：調用一次才算數**」**。

**可核實資訊（均註冊處元資料、npm registry 元資料與包內檔案實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 七個工具裡有一個**專做來源與引用****——**README 逐字列出**：`dataset_columns`（**模式：列、**哪些是數值、**行數與出處**）、`dataset_search`、`dataset_row`、`dataset_compare`、`dataset_stats`、`dataset_top`、**以及** `dataset_provenance`（**逐字**「**the source, computed date, licence and citation**」**）**——**⭐ 即**把「**這份資料哪來的、**何時算的、**許可是什麼、**該怎麼引用**」**做成一個可調用工具**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**每個回答都帶來源與許可**」是逐字承諾**——**逐字**「**The full dataset is also offered as a CSV resource.**」**與**「**Source: FEMA. Every answer carries the dataset page and licence.**」**——**⭐ 即**不是對外要求「**請註明來源**」，**而是**對內約束「**我每次返回都自帶來源與許可**」。**⭐⭐ ③ 交付形態拆成三處**：**npm 包為 stdio 傳輸**（**入口 `bin.mjs`**、**依賴 `@ellul-estate/mcp-kit`**、**逐字安裝方式** `npx @ellul-estate/damagerestorehq-com-claims-index-mcp`**）**；**註冊處同日兩條記錄**；**資料另在** `https://damagerestorehq.com/data` **發布**，**條款在** `/terms`**——**⭐ 即**同一個東西在三個地方各有形態**。**⭐⭐ ④ 同**一條目在兩個登記處**資訊量不同**（本次實測）**：**註冊處描述被截斷**（**逐字止於** read from NFIP claim records (2023 to**」**——**逐字續**「****）**，**而** npm 上同句完整**（**逐字** 2023 to 2026**）**——**⭐ 即**截斷會讓讀者**看不到**最關鍵的時間範圍**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本與發布節奏可核**：**npm 建立 2026-09-06T17:04:32Z、**修改 **2026-09-06T17:54:29Z****（**約 50 分鐘內**從 `0.1.0` 到 `1.0.0`**）**，**兩版**均帶**完整性雜湊**；**註冊處兩條記錄發布時間同為 2026-09-06**——**⭐ 即**這是一個**當天成形的發布****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一處**登記處欄位與現實不符**（本次實測）**：**註冊處 `1.0.0` 與** npm v1.0.0 的** `repository` 欄位**均逐字指向** `github.com/joeetdev/venture-estate`**，**而該位址**實測 404****——**⭐ 即**這條與同族兩個詢價服務**共用**一個**不可訪問的倉庫欄位**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]、[[rfema]]、[[claims-api]]、[[insurance-qa-evidence]]、[[insuranceoracle]]、[[property-hazard-mcp]]、[[us-mortgage-financing-constants]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**一個派生統計量配七個工具：其中一個是來源與引用工具＋逐字承諾每個回答自帶來源與許可＋完整資料另作 resource 提供**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[us-mortgage-financing-constants]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 五點最值得借鑑**：**① 把「**來源、**計算日期、**許可與引用**」**做成工具**；**② **讓每次返回**自帶來源與許可**；**③ **完整資料**另作 resource 提供**；**④ **同一東西在多登記處時**要檢查描述是否被截斷**；**⑤ **發布節奏**可當成熟度線索**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有執行該 npm 包入口、**也未調用任何資料集工具**（**未取任何水損理賠數字、**未跑 `npx`、**未連 MCP 客戶端**），**不主張**其資料、**統計或「**每次返回都帶來源**」這一承諾的實際行為**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**未讀包內 `bin.mjs` 正文**（**該檔僅 638 位元組**，**推測為薄封裝**，**但**本詞條不作此判斷**）**，**也未讀** `server.json` **與** `package.json` **正文**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** `dataset_provenance` **返回的來源欄位**是否**真的含計算日期與許可**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其資料來源是否確為 **FEMA／**NFIP 記錄**，**未核實** 2023 至 2026 的**實際覆蓋與更新頻率**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**「**median paid water damage claim**」**的口徑**（**分母、**是否含稅、**是否按年或按州**）**——**⚠️ 這對任何比較都關鍵**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**資料許可與 npm **MIT 許可**是否**覆蓋不同對象**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實**發布者**與該網站的關係**，**未核實**其與被引用機構（**FEMA）**是否有任何關係**。**⑧ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**包與註冊處記錄均成於 2026-09-06（**窗口之內**）**，**無需窗口例外說明**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該指標是**衍生統計**，**不得**當作任何理賠、**定價或核保依據**。
entries.body_en:
The npm package and registry entry damagerestore-claims-index **turn one derived statistic, the median paid water damage claim read from national flood insurance claim records, into a full set of agent tools**, described verbatim as an MCP server over a real sourced dataset and as served as an agent-callable dataset with its source and licence on every answer. **Measured this round**: the package is licensed MIT, was created and modified within about fifty minutes on the same day in September, carries two versions, depends on a shared toolkit package, and is only about one point six kilobytes across four files, the entry point being six hundred and thirty-eight bytes; the maintainer name matches the operator named by the sibling enquiry servers described in the previous entry. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the package registry metadata and the package contents**: **first, one of seven tools is dedicated to provenance and citation**: the readme lists tools for the schema including which columns are numeric and the row count and provenance, for search, for row lookup, for comparison, for statistics over a numeric column, for the highest or lowest rows, and a provenance tool described verbatim as returning the source, computed date, licence and citation. **Turning where the data came from, when it was computed, what the licence is and how to cite it into a callable tool goes one step beyond writing provenance down, because the citation becomes part of the interface.** **Second, the promise that every answer carries source and licence is stated verbatim**: the full dataset is also offered as a comma-separated resource, the source is named as a federal agency, and every answer is stated to carry the dataset page and licence, with the data free to cite with a link. **This is an inward constraint rather than an outward request, where most data services put the citation requirement in terms and conditions rather than in each response.** **Third, the delivery is split across three places**: a package distributed for standard input and output transport with an install command and a shared toolkit dependency; two registry records published the same day; and the dataset itself published on a website page with a separate terms page. **One artefact in three forms is the same shape as a source appearing several ways.** **Fourth, the same item holds different amounts of information in two registries**: the registry description is truncated mid-sentence at the start of the year range while the package description carries the complete sentence naming the full range, **so truncation in a registry can hide the one detail a reader needs most**. **Fifth, versioning and publishing tempo are checkable**: the package was created and then modified about fifty minutes later, moving from an initial version to a first release, both carrying integrity hashes, with both registry records published the same day. **A first release arriving fifty minutes after the initial version is itself information: this is a same-day publication rather than a long-maintained package.** **Sixth, one registry field does not match reality, as measured here**: both the registry record and the package metadata name the same repository address, and that address was measured to return not found, **so this record shares an unreachable repository field with the two enquiry servers described in the previous entry**. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover national flood insurance data and tooling, claims interfaces and evidence, agent-facing insurance services and a constants dataset in which every value carries its own source, **while this entry supplies a single derived statistic shipped with seven tools, one of which is a provenance and citation tool, a verbatim promise that every answer carries source and licence, and the full dataset offered separately as a resource. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled constants dataset and the pooled flood insurance tooling**; **five practices transfer directly: make source, computed date, licence and citation a callable tool rather than a clause; make every response carry its own source and licence; offer the full data as a separate resource; check whether a description has been truncated when the same item appears in several registries; and read publishing tempo as a maturity signal**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package entry point was not executed and no dataset tool was called** — no claim value retrieved, no command run and no MCP client connected — **so neither the data and statistics nor the actual behaviour of the promise that every answer carries its source is claimed**. **Second, the entry point and the two metadata files inside the package were not read**, the entry point being only six hundred and thirty-eight bytes and therefore presumed to be a thin wrapper over the shared toolkit, **a presumption this entry does not assert**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the provenance tool really returns a computed date and a licence was not verified**, only the readme table having been read. **Fourth, whether the source really is the national flood insurance claim records was not verified, nor was the actual coverage and update frequency behind the stated year range. Fifth, the definition of the headline metric was not verified** — its denominator, whether it is gross of tax, and whether it is annual or per state — **and that definition matters for any comparison**. **Sixth, whether the data licence and the package licence cover different things was not verified. Seventh, the relationship between the publisher and the website, and between the publisher and the federal agency credited as the source, were not verified. Eighth, on the window: both the package and the registry records date from 2026-09-06, inside the thaw window, so there is no window exception to declare. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the metric is a derived statistic and must not be used as a basis for any claim, pricing or underwriting decision.**

entries.summary_en: The npm package progressive-mcp-connector **is an MCP connector named after a large United States motor insurer**, described verbatim as a connector providing tools to get quotes, look up policies, check claims, manage payments, retrieve identification cards, get coverage recommendations and request roadside assistance for personal agents. **Measured this round**: licensed MIT, at version 1.0.1, created in March and last modified in mid June, with two versions in total, a single dependency on the official protocol SDK, and a single named maintainer; **its metadata declares neither a repository nor a homepage**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of what sits in a package registry, where only a call counts**, and **four things are worth reading: seven capability areas listed verbatim; seven feature descriptions covering claims timelines with adjuster information, identification cards in three formats, and roadside dispatch with live arrival time and tracking; installation and client configuration instructions; and the absence of any repository or any statement of authorization or affiliation**. **The connector was not installed and not called this round.**
entries.body:
**progressive-mcp-connector**（npm 包 `@striderlabs/mcp-progressive`）**是一个**以一家美国大型车险公司命名**的 MCP 连接器****——**逐字自述为**「**Progressive Insurance MCP connector for personal AI agents. Provides tools to get quotes, look up policies, check claims, manage payments, retrieve ID cards, get coverage recommendations, and request roadside assistance.**」**。**本次实测**：**许可 **MIT****、**版本 **1.0.1****、**创建 **2026-03-15T13:08:50Z**、**最后修改 **2026-06-17T13:21:08Z**、**共 **2 个版本****、**唯一依赖逐字为** `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`**、**维护者逐字为** `markswendsen`**、**关键词逐字含** `mcp`／`progressive`／`insurance`／`ai`／`agent`**；**⭐ 而**其 npm 元数据中**没有** `repository`**、**也没有** `homepage`****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**包登记里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均 npm registry 元数据与包内 README 实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 七类能力被逐字列出**——**逐字为**「**Provides tools to get quotes, look up policies, check claims, manage payments, retrieve ID cards, get coverage recommendations, and request roadside assistance.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得记的地方是**它的范围**：**⭐ 即**七类里有**三类直接是人身份与金钱操作**（**管理付款、**取电子保险卡、**请求道路救援**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 361 轮那条**车险线索市场**相比**更进一步**：**后者止于**转交人工**，**而**这一条声称**直接操作**保单与付款**。**⭐⭐ ② 七条功能说明逐字给出，**其中三条涉及**对人的追踪或替代凭证****——**逐字含**：**即时报价**（**车险、**家财、**租客**）**；**保单查询**（**含完整保障与保费明细**）**；**理赔追踪**（**逐字** with timeline, adjuster info, and pending actions**）**；**付款管理**（**逐字** view balance, pay, set up autopay, update methods**）**；**保障建议**（**按个人情况给出**）**；**⭐ 电子保险卡**（**逐字** in text, PDF, or wallet pass format**）**；**⭐ 道路救援**（**逐字** dispatch with live ETA and tracking**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**电子保险卡可导出为钱包凭证**」与**「**救援带实时到店时间与追踪**」**这两条尤其值得注意**：**⭐ 即**它们**把**线下身份凭证与位置追踪**接进了**Agent 工具**——**⭐ 这类能力的**授权边界**（**谁能调、**调谁的数据**）**在元数据里**看不到**。**⭐⭐ ③ 安装与客户端配置被写明**——**逐字给出** `npm install @striderlabs/mcp-progressive`**，**并给出 **Claude Desktop **的配置文件路径**（**逐字含** `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为这一处是**可核的**：**⭐ 即**任何想验证的人**都知道**该改哪个文件、**装哪个包**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 三处**缺席**（本次实测）**：**① **没有 `repository` 字段**（**⭐ 即**无法核对源码**）**；**② **没有 `homepage` 字段**（**⭐ 即**没有给出任何官方页面**）**；**③ **包内未出现**任何授权、**隶属或免责声明****（**⭐ 本词条所读到的 README 前段**未含此类语句**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这三处缺席**是本条最需要如实记录的部分**：**⭐ 即**一个**以真实保险公司命名**、**并声称能操作**保单与付款**的第三方包**，**在**登记处**只留下了**一个维护者名与一个包名**——**⚠️ 本词条**不对其性质作任何判断**，**只记录**可核实的事实与缺席**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[root-insurance-mcp]]、**[[insuranceoracle]]、**[[property-hazard-mcp]]、**[[bima-mcp]]、**[[claims-triage-mcp]]、**[[guidewire-mcp]] 覆盖面向 Agent 的保险连接器**，**[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、**[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 覆盖资格与合规核验**，**[[higson-motor-insurance-demo]]、**[[insurance-recommendation-engine]] 覆盖车险报价与推荐**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一个**以真实承保人命名、**声称可操作保单与付款**的第三方 MCP 连接器：**功能清单很完整、**而**授权与源码**两栏为空**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[root-insurance-mcp]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的三点**：**① **能力清单要写全**（**包括**对人的凭证与位置**这类敏感项**）**；**② **凡涉及**保单、**付款与身份凭证**的能力**，**授权边界**必须写在**能被看到的地方**；**③ **在包登记处发行时**，**仓库与官方页面**是**最基本的可核项**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装该包、**没有调用任何工具、**也没有运行任何客户端**（**未取任何报价、**未查任何保单、**未发起任何付款或救援请求**），**故**不主张**其任何能力**实际可用**、**也不主张**其与**任何保险公司**存在任何关系**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**只读了 npm 元数据与包内 README 的前段**（**未读其全部章节**）**，**也未读**其 TypeScript 源码**（**⭐ 包内是否含源码、**是否仅类型定义**，**本次**未核实**）**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其工具**是否真的连到**该保险公司的公开接口**、**还是**仅返回**模拟或示例数据****——**⚠️ 这是本条最关键的一处**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**该包**是否已获**任何授权、**是否与该保险公司**有任何关系**；**⭐ 本词条**只记录**元数据中未见此类声明**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**许可（**MIT）是否与**其可能调用的接口条款**相容**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**维护者身份**（**⭐ 只有一个 npm 用户名**）**，**也未核实**该用户名下的其它包**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**最后修改 **2026-06-17**（**在解冻窗口之外**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**一个以真实承保人命名、**声称可操作保单与付款的第三方 MCP 连接器：**功能清单完整而**授权与源码为空**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**本条**不是**对该包的推荐**，**其是否可用、**是否合规**，**须由使用者自行核实**。
