entries.body_en:
The npm package progressive-mcp-connector, named after a large United States motor insurer, **is a protocol connector for personal agents**, described verbatim as providing tools to get quotes, look up policies, check claims, manage payments, retrieve identification cards, get coverage recommendations and request roadside assistance. **Measured this round**: licensed MIT, at version 1.0.1, created in mid March and last modified in mid June, with two versions, a single dependency on the official protocol SDK and one named maintainer; **the metadata declares neither a repository nor a homepage**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of what sits in a package registry, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from the package registry metadata and the package readme**: **first, seven capability areas are listed verbatim**, covering quotes, policy lookup, claims, payments, identification cards, coverage recommendations and roadside assistance. **Three of those are operations on a person identity or their money, namely managing payments, retrieving an identification card and requesting roadside assistance, which goes further than a lead handoff because it claims to touch the policy and the purse directly.** **Second, seven feature descriptions are given**, including instant quotes for auto, home and renters; policy lookup with full coverage and premium detail; claims tracking with timeline, adjuster information and pending actions; payment management covering balance, payment, autopay and method updates; personalised coverage recommendations; identification cards in text, PDF or wallet pass format; and roadside dispatch with live arrival time and tracking. **Exporting an identification card as a wallet pass and attaching live location tracking to a dispatch are the two worth pausing on, because they connect offline identity credentials and location into agent tools, and the authorization boundary for who may call them and whose data they touch is not visible in the package metadata.** **Third, installation and client configuration are written out**, with the install command and the configuration file path for one desktop client, which is the part that makes the package checkable by anyone who wants to try it. **Fourth, three absences were measured**: no repository field, no homepage field, and no statement of authorization, affiliation or disclaimer in the part of the readme read here. **A third-party package named after a real insurer and claiming to operate on policies and payments therefore leaves nothing in the registry but a maintainer name and a package name; this entry states the facts and the absences and draws no conclusion about the package nature.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover agent-facing insurance connectors, eligibility and compliance verification, and motor insurance quoting and recommendation, **while this entry supplies a third-party connector named after a real carrier that claims policy and payment operations while leaving authorization and source both blank. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled insurance connectors and the pooled verification server**; **three practices transfer directly: write the capability list in full, including any capability that touches a person credentials or location; put the authorization boundary where it can be seen whenever a capability touches policies, payments or identity documents; and treat a repository and an official page as the minimum checkable evidence when publishing to a package registry**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed, no tool was called and no client was run** — no quote obtained, no policy looked up and no payment or dispatch requested — **so this entry does not claim that any capability works, nor does it claim any relationship between this package and any insurer**. **Second, only the registry metadata and the opening of the readme were read**, not every section and not any source code, **so whether the package contains source at all was not verified**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether its tools actually connect to a real insurer interface or return simulated data was not verified, which is the most important open question about this package. Fourth, whether the package has any authorization or any relationship with the named insurer was not verified**; this entry records only that no such statement appears in the metadata read. **Fifth, whether its permissive licence is compatible with the terms of any interface it might call was not verified. Sixth, the maintainer identity was not verified**, only a registry user name being visible, nor were other packages under that name. **Seventh, on the window: the last modification was in mid June, outside the thaw window, and following the project convention of naming the gap, the gap here is that a third-party connector named after a real carrier, claiming policy and payment operations while leaving authorization and source blank, had no counterpart in the pool. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that it is not a recommendation of the package and that whether it works and whether it is compliant must be verified by whoever intends to use it.**

entries.body:
**claimdesk-analytics-mcp**（npm 包 `claimdesk-analytics-mcp`）**是一个**财险理赔分析 MCP 服务器****——**逐字自述为**「**MCP server for insurance claims analytics — portfolio analysis, adjuster performance scorecards, loss development triangles, trend reports, and industry benchmark comparisons for P&C insurance operations.**」**。**本次实测**：**许可 **MIT****、**版本 **0.1.0****（**⭐ 且**仅此一版**）**、**创建与最后修改**同为 **2026-05-12**（**逐字** `2026-05-12T19:33:51Z` 与** `19:33:52Z`**）**、**依赖逐字为** `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` **与** `zod`**、**维护者逐字为** `crawde`**；**⚠️ 而**元数据中**没有** `repository`**、**也没有** `homepage`****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**包登记里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均 npm registry 元数据与包内 README 实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 五个工具被逐字列出，**且每个都写了它回答什么****——**逐字为**：**① `analyze_claims_portfolio`**「**Loss ratios, severity, frequency, reserve adequacy, and actionable insights**」**；**② `adjuster_scorecard`**「**Weighted performance scoring, rankings, peer comparison, improvement plans**」**；**③ `loss_development`**「**Chain-ladder loss development triangles, IBNR projections, ultimate loss ratios**」**；**④ `claims_trend_report`**「**Frequency/severity/loss ratio trends with forecasting and alerts**」**；**⑤ `benchmark_analysis`**「**Compare your metrics against industry benchmarks (ISO, NAIC, AM Best, NCCI)**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**第 ③ 项最值得记**：**⭐ 即**链梯三角、**IBNR 与**终极赔付率**这三件事**正是**准备金工作的核心词汇**，**而**它们**在一个**通用的 MCP 服务器**里**出现**——**⭐ 这与本站第 355／356 轮覆盖的**准备金工具**（**[[verified-reserving]]、**[[loss-reserving-engine]]、**[[hgr-hidden-grammar-reserving]] 等**）**相比**，**差别在**交付形态**：**前者是库或脚本，**这一条是**给 Agent 调用的服务**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**理算员评分卡**」是本条最需要如实标注的一处**——**逐字为**「**Weighted performance scoring, rankings, peer comparison, improvement plans**」**，**即**对一个**具体的人**做**加权评分、**排名与同侪比较**，**并**给出**改进计划****。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**同一个工具包里**既有**对物（**三角、**IBNR）的统计**，**也有**对人（**理算员）的评分**——**⭐ 而**后者**涉及**公平性、**申诉与治理**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**在**元数据里**看不到**评分权重、**数据来源、**复核机制或**申诉渠道**的任何说明**，**也不主张**该功能**是否被实际使用**。**⭐⭐ ③ 十二个业务条线被列出**——**逐字为** Auto、**Property、**General Liability、**Workers Comp、**Cyber、**Professional Liability、**Health、**Homeowners、**Commercial Property、**Marine、**Umbrella、**Product Liability**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**覆盖的条线**比**一家公司的实际经营范围**更宽**——**⭐ 而**一个**通用工具**声称**同时懂十二条线**时，**读者**应当先问**每一条线的口径从哪来**。**⭐⭐ ④ 基准分析点名了**四家来源，**而这四家的性质各不相同****——**逐字为**「**industry benchmarks (ISO, NAIC, AM Best, NCCI)**」**：**⭐ 即**ISO **是**数据与标准机构**、**NAIC **是**州监管者协会**、**AM Best **是**评级机构**、**NCCI **是**工伤险的费率与统计机构**——**⭐ 本词条认为**把四者并列**是**可核的**（**各自口径不同**）**，**而**元数据里**没有给出**任何一份基准的**具体来源、**版本或**许可**——**⚠️ 故**本词条**只记录其自述**，**不主张**其基准**真实可核对**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 安装与配置被写明，**且**付费档位被标出**——**逐字给出** `npx claimdesk-analytics-mcp`**，**并给出 **Claude Desktop **的配置片段**；**环境变量逐字含** `CLAIMDESK_API_KEY`（**逐字标注为** Optional，**用于** premium analytics features**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**可选密钥对应高级功能**」**这一设计值得记**：**⭐ 即**免费部分**与**付费部分**的边界**写在环境变量上**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ ⚠️ 三处**须如实标注**：**① **与池内条目**同作者****——**本站 [[claims-triage-mcp]] 的维护者/仓库同样出自 `crawde`**（**⭐ 本词条**据此明确声明**：**两者**是两个不同的包**，**本词条**未做任何代码级比较**）**；**② **没有仓库字段**，**故**本次无法核对实现**；**③ **只有 **0.1.0** 一个版本、**创建与修改**相隔 **1 秒****——**⭐ 即**这是一次**单次发布**，**没有后续维护痕迹**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[claims-triage-mcp]]、**[[claimpilot-harness]]、**[[digital-claims-management]] 覆盖理赔流程与分诊**，**[[loss-reserving-engine]]、**[[verified-reserving]]、**[[hgr-hidden-grammar-reserving]]、**[[reserving-ml]]、**[[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 覆盖准备金方法**，**[[claims-integrity-investigator]]、**[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] 覆盖理赔风险分析**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**把**组合分析、**理算员评分、**链梯与 IBNR、**趋势预测与**同业基准**打包成五个 Agent 工具**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[verified-reserving]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的四点**：**① **工具说明要写清「**它回答什么**」**（**本条五条都做到了**）**；**② **凡对**人**做评分的功能**，**要在文档里说明**权重、**数据与申诉**；**③ **引用同业基准时要给出**具体来源与版本**，**而不只是机构缩写**；**④ **免费与付费的边界**要写在**能被看到的地方**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装该包、**没有调用任何工具**（**未生成任何损失报告、**未计算任何赔付率或 IBNR、**未对任何理算员评分**），**故**不主张**其任何功能可用**、**也不主张**其任何计算结果**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**只读了 npm 元数据与包内 README**，**未读任何源码**（**⭐ 且元数据未给仓库地址，**故也难以找到源码**）**——**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其**基准来源**（**ISO／**NAIC／**AM Best／**NCCI）**是否**真的被授权引用**，**也未核实**任何一份基准的**口径与版本**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其**链梯与 IBNR 实现**是否符合**通行方法**（**⭐ README 未提到任何文献或验证**）**——**⚠️ 而**这直接决定**其输出能否被引用**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**理算员评分卡**的**权重、**数据来源与**公平性考量**；**⚠️ 本词条并如实提示**：**在**雇佣与绩效场景**使用自动评分**可能涉及**合规与伦理问题**，**须由使用者自行评估**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**维护者身份**（**⭐ 只知 npm 用户名**）**；**也未核实**其与池内 [[claims-triage-mcp]] 的关系**（**⭐ 本词条**只指出**两者同出一个用户名**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该包创建于 **2026-05-12**（**在解冻窗口之外**）**，**且**自那以后**未再更新**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**把准备金与理赔分析打包成五个 Agent 工具、**并含**理算员评分卡**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该服务**不是**任何持牌精算意见**，**其输出**不得**直接用于准备金、**定价或人事决定**。

**claimdesk-analytics-mcp**（npm 包 `claimdesk-analytics-mcp`）**是一個**財險理賠分析 MCP 伺服器****——**逐字自述為**「**MCP server for insurance claims analytics — portfolio analysis, adjuster performance scorecards, loss development triangles, trend reports, and industry benchmark comparisons for P&C insurance operations.**」**。**本次實測**：**許可 MIT**、**版本 0.1.0（**僅此一版**）**、**建立與最後修改**同為 **2026-05-12**、**依賴逐字為** `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 與 `zod`**、**維護者逐字為** `crawde`**；**⚠️ 而**元資料中**沒有** `repository`**、**也沒有** `homepage`****。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**包登記裡的東西：調用一次才算數**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 npm registry 元資料與包內 README 實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 五個工具逐字列出，**且每個都寫了它回答什麼****：`analyze_claims_portfolio`（**Loss ratios, severity, frequency, reserve adequacy, and actionable insights**）、`adjuster_scorecard`（**Weighted performance scoring, rankings, peer comparison, improvement plans**）、`loss_development`（**Chain-ladder loss development triangles, IBNR projections, ultimate loss ratios**）、`claims_trend_report`（**Frequency/severity/loss ratio trends with forecasting and alerts**）、`benchmark_analysis`（**Compare your metrics against industry benchmarks (ISO, NAIC, AM Best, NCCI)**）**——**⭐ 第 ③ 項最值得記**：**鏈梯三角、**IBNR 與**終極賠付率**正是**準備金工作的核心詞彙**，**而**它們**出現在一個通用的 MCP 伺服器裡**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**理算員評分卡**」是最需如實標註的一處**——**逐字** Weighted performance scoring, rankings, peer comparison, improvement plans**——**⭐ 即**同一個工具包裡**既有**對物的統計**，**也有**對人的評分**；**⭐ 而**元資料裡**看不到**評分權重、**資料來源、**覆核機制或**申訴渠道**的任何說明**。**⭐⭐ ③ 十二個業務條線**：Auto、Property、General Liability、Workers Comp、Cyber、Professional Liability、Health、Homeowners、Commercial Property、Marine、Umbrella、Product Liability**——**⭐ 一個通用工具聲稱同時懂十二條線時**，**讀者應先問**每條線的口徑從哪來**。**⭐⭐ ④ 基準分析點名四家來源**（**ISO／**NAIC／**AM Best／**NCCI**）**——**⭐ 四者性質不同**（**數據與標準機構／**監管者協會／**評級機構／**工傷險費率統計機構**）**，**而**元資料**未給出**任何一份基準的**具體來源、**版本或**許可****。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 安裝與配置**：`npx claimdesk-analytics-mcp`**；**環境變數逐字含** `CLAIMDESK_API_KEY`（**逐字標註為** Optional，**用於** premium analytics features**）**——**⭐ 即**免費與付費的邊界**寫在環境變數上**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ ⚠️ 三處須如實標註**：**與池內 [[claims-triage-mcp]] **同維護者用户名**（**⭐ 兩者是不同的包，**本詞條未做任何代碼級比較**）**；**沒有倉庫欄位**；**只有 0.1.0 一版、**建立與修改相隔 1 秒**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[claimpilot-harness]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[loss-reserving-engine]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[hgr-hidden-grammar-reserving]]、[[reserving-ml]]、[[motor-loss-reserving-dl]]、[[claims-integrity-investigator]]、[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**把組合分析、**理算員評分、**鏈梯與 IBNR、**趨勢預測與**同業基準打包成五個 Agent 工具**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[verified-reserving]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 四點最值得借鑑**：**① **工具說明要寫清「**它回答什麼**」**；**② **對人做評分的功能**要說明**權重、**數據與**申訴**；**③ **引用同業基準要給出來源與版本**；**④ **免費與付費的邊界**要寫在看得見的地方**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝該包、**沒有調用任何工具**，**不主張**其任何功能可用**、**也不主張**其任何計算結果**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**只讀了 npm 元資料與 README**，**未讀任何原始碼**（**且元資料未給倉庫位址**）——**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其**基準來源**是否**真的被授權引用****，**未核實**任何基準的口徑與版本**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其**鏈梯與 IBNR 實現**是否符合通行方法**（**README 未提任何文獻或驗證**）**——**⚠️ 這直接決定其輸出能否被引用**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**理算員評分卡的權重、**資料來源與公平性考量**；**⚠️ 在僱傭與績效場景使用自動評分**可能涉及**合規與倫理問題**，**須由使用者自行評估**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**維護者身份**；**未核實**其與 [[claims-triage-mcp]] 的關係**（**只指出兩者同出一個用户名**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**該包建立於 2026-05-12（**窗口之外**）**，**其後未再更新**——**缺口是**「**把準備金與理賠分析打包成五個 Agent 工具、**並含理算員評分卡**」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該服務**不是**任何持牌精算意見**，**其輸出不得**直接用於準備金、**定價或人事決定**。
entries.body_en:
The npm package claimdesk-analytics-mcp **is a property and casualty claims analytics server for agents**, described verbatim as covering portfolio analysis, adjuster performance scorecards, loss development triangles, trend reports and industry benchmark comparisons for insurance operations. **Measured this round**: licensed MIT, at the single version 0.1.0, created and last modified one second apart on the same day in May, depending on the official protocol SDK and a schema validator, maintained by one registry user name, and **declaring neither a repository nor a homepage**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of what sits in a package registry, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata and the package readme**: **first, five tools are listed verbatim with what each answers**: a portfolio tool returning loss ratios, severity, frequency, reserve adequacy and actionable insights; a scorecard tool returning weighted performance scoring, rankings, peer comparison and improvement plans; a loss development tool returning chain-ladder triangles, incurred-but-not-reported projections and ultimate loss ratios; a trend tool returning frequency, severity and loss ratio trends with forecasting and alerts; and a benchmark tool comparing metrics against four named industry sources. **The third of those is the one to note, because chain-ladder triangles, incurred-but-not-reported amounts and ultimate loss ratios are the core vocabulary of reserving, and here they appear inside a general-purpose agent server rather than in a library or a script.** **Second, the adjuster scorecard is the component this entry flags most strongly**: it is described verbatim as weighted performance scoring with rankings, peer comparison and improvement plans, meaning the same package that computes statistics about triangles also scores individual people. **The metadata shows no scoring weights, no data source, no review mechanism and no appeal channel, and this entry does not claim whether the feature is used in practice.** **Third, twelve lines of business are listed**, covering auto, property, general liability, workers compensation, cyber, professional liability, health, homeowners, commercial property, marine, umbrella and product liability. **A general tool claiming to understand twelve lines at once invites the question of where each line definitions come from.** **Fourth, the benchmark tool names four sources of very different kinds**, namely a data and standards body, a state regulator association, a rating agency and a workers compensation statistical organisation, all four appearing in one parenthesis with **no specific dataset, version or licence given anywhere in the metadata**, so this entry records the claim without asserting that the benchmarks are checkable. **Fifth, installation and configuration are written out**, with an install command, a desktop client configuration snippet, and an optional environment variable whose description states that it unlocks premium analytics features, **which is where the boundary between the free and paid parts is drawn**. **Sixth, three points must be stated plainly**: the package shares its registry user name with a pooled claims triage server, so **this entry states explicitly that they are two different packages and makes no code-level comparison**; there is no repository field, so the implementation could not be inspected; and there is exactly one version whose creation and modification timestamps are one second apart, meaning a single publication with no later maintenance. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover claims triage and claims process tooling, several reserving methods and tools, and claims risk analysis, **while this entry supplies a package that bundles portfolio analysis, adjuster scoring, chain-ladder and incurred-but-not-reported calculations, trend forecasting and industry benchmarks into five agent tools. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled claims triage server and the pooled verified reserving entry**; **four practices transfer directly: describe each tool by what it answers; when a feature scores people, document the weights, the data and the appeal route; give a specific source and version when citing industry benchmarks rather than an acronym; and put the boundary between free and paid where it can be seen**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed and no tool was called** — no loss report generated, no loss ratio or incurred-but-not-reported amount computed and no adjuster scored — **so no claim is made about whether any feature works or about any computed result**. **Second, only the registry metadata and the readme were read, and no source code was read**, the metadata giving no repository address in any case, **which is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the four benchmark sources are actually licensed for use was not verified, nor were the definitions or versions of any benchmark. Fourth, whether the chain-ladder and incurred-but-not-reported implementations follow standard methods was not verified**, the readme citing no literature or validation, **which directly determines whether its output can be cited**. **Fifth, the weights, data sources and fairness considerations of the adjuster scorecard were not verified; this entry notes plainly that automated scoring in employment or performance settings may raise compliance and ethical questions that the user must assess.** **Sixth, the maintainer identity was not verified**, only a registry user name being visible, nor was the relationship to the pooled claims triage server established, **this entry recording only that the two share a user name**. **Seventh, on the window: the package was created in May, outside the thaw window, and has not been updated since**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that bundling reserving and claims analytics into five agent tools, including an adjuster scorecard, had no counterpart in the pool. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the service is not a licensed actuarial opinion and that its output must not be used directly for reserving, pricing or personnel decisions.**

**@emilgroup/insurance-sdk**（npm 包 `@emilgroup/insurance-sdk`）**是**一家欧洲保险集团**对外发布的**保险业务 SDK****——**本次实测**：**许可逐字为** `Unlicense`**、**历史版本共 **472 个**、**首个版本发布于 **2022-07-21**、**当前稳定版 **1.107.0****（**2026-07-20**）**、**解包后 **961 个文件／**4,062,441 字节****；**⚠️ 而**它的 **README 是空的**（**⭐ 逐字：**长度为 0**）**、**元数据里**没有** `repository` 字段****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**包登记里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均 npm registry 元数据实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 窗口内唯一的活动痕迹是 beta 通道**——**⭐ 本次实测**在 **2026-09-07、**09-08、**09-09** 三天内**发布过 **1.107.1-beta.50**、**`-beta.51`**、**`-beta.52`**、**`-beta.53`** 四个 **beta 版本**（**⭐ 即**窗口内有动作**）**；**⭐ 而 **dist-tags **里** `latest` **仍指 **1.107.0****（**发布于 **2026-07-20**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这一处最值得记**：**⭐ 即**一个包**在窗口内确实在动**，**但**动的是 **beta**、**稳定线不动**——**⭐ 故第 360 轮的规矩在此多出一问**：**「**窗口内**有更新**」这句话**若不锁通道**就是**不完整**的**。**⭐⭐ ② 四年、**472 个版本、**与一个**空的 README****——**⭐ 按本站的**邮政分拣规矩**，「**README 过短**」通常是**拒收信号**；**⭐ 本条**是**例外**（**⭐ 故本词条**如实标注**）：**其 **4.06 MB、**961 个文件**、**四年、**472 个版本**都**指向一个**被真实维护的包**，**而 **README 为 0 字节****——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一对反差本身**就是一个可教学的样本**：**包的大小与版本数**证明**它被使用**，**而 README 的空白**证明**它对读者**不加解释**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 能力只能从**生成类型**读出**——**⭐ 本次**读了包内**模型文件**，**可见的实体逐字含** quotation、**booking、**policy、**premium 计算、**policy activation、**bank transfer、**approval limit** 等**——**⭐ 即**一个**从**报价（quotation）到**出单（booking）**、**再到**保单激活（policy activation）**的业务漏斗**；**⭐ 并含**保费计算、**银行转账与**审批限额**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这四项**合起来**说明**它**覆盖的不是**单一接口**，**而是**一条**承保到收付的链路**。**⭐ 同时**其 **OpenAPI 生成**痕迹**（**⭐ 由文件结构与命名可见**）**也说明**它为**内部或合作方**暴露 API 而生成**，**并非**为教学或**开源协作而写**。**⭐⭐ ④ 许可逐字为 **Unlicense****——**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**`Unlicense` **是**一种**放弃著作权的许可**，**⭐ 但**元数据许可**与**实际文件头**是否一致**本次**未逐文件核对**；**⭐ 并**如实提示**：**企业发布的 SDK **即使**标为 Unlicense**，**其**服务端、**商标与**业务规则**仍**受其他权利约束**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、**[[titanium-insurance-core]]、**[[clarity-sdk]] 覆盖保险 API、**核心系统与 SDK**，**[[openinsurance]] 覆盖开放保险数据共享**，**[[digital-claims-management]] 覆盖理赔数字化**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一家保险集团自己发布的**业务 SDK**，**且**窗口内的活动**只在 **beta 通道**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最能教的是一个**读包的习惯**：**先看 **dist-tags**（**谁才是当前版本**）**、**再看 **time**（**窗口内有没有动、**动在哪条通道**）**、**再看 **README**（**它有没有打算向读者解释**）**、**最后才读类型**（**它到底能做什么**）**——**⭐ 四步之后**，「**这个包在更新**」这句话**才有确切含义**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装该包、**没有调用任何接口**（**未发起任何报价、**未计算任何保费、**未激活任何保单**），**故**不主张**其任何功能可用**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **README 为 0 字节**——**⭐ 故**本条目对其能力的描述**全部来自**包内**生成类型与文件结构**，**不是**来自**任何作者说明**；**⭐ 这一处**须由读者自行复核**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其 **beta 通道**的实际含义**（**可能对应**预发布环境、**也可能对应**尚未公布的接口**）**——**⭐ 本词条**不主张**任何关于其 **beta 用途**的判断**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其与**该集团任何线上服务**的对应关系**，**也未核实**该 SDK **是否可以**在集团之外使用**（**⭐ 元数据无仓库、**无文档链接**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**许可文件**与元数据许可**是否一致**；**⭐ 并**如实提示**：**即使**代码许可宽松**，**商标、**接口文档与**服务端规则**仍可能**另有约束**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**维护者身份**（**⭐ 只知作用域名**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该包**创建于 **2022-07-21**（**远在窗口之外**）**，**而**窗口内**有 **beta 发布**（**⭐ 见上**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**一家保险集团发布的**业务 SDK**，**其窗口内活动只出现在 **beta 通道**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该 SDK **不是**任何持牌精算或合规意见**，**其**费率、**限额与**审批规则**须**由使用机构自行负责**。

**可核實資訊（均 npm registry 元資料實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 窗口內唯一活動痕跡是 beta 通道**——**本次實測**在 **2026-09-07、**09-08、**09-09** 三天內**發布過 **1.107.1-beta.50**、**`-beta.51`**、**`-beta.52`**、**`-beta.53`** 四個 **beta 版本**；**⭐ 而 dist-tags** 裡 `latest` **仍指 1.107.0**（**2026-07-20**）**——**⭐ 這一處最值得記**：**⭐ 即**一個包**在窗口內確實在動**，**但動的是 beta、**穩定線不動**——**⭐ 故第 360 輪的規矩在此多出一問**：**「**窗口內有更新**」若不鎖通道**就是**不完整**的**。**⭐⭐ ② 四年、**472 個版本、**與一個**空的 README****——**按本站郵政分揀規矩**，「**README 過短**」通常是**拒收信號**；**本條是例外**（**如實標註**）：**4.06 MB、**961 個檔案、**四年、**472 個版本**都指向**一個被真實維護的包**，**而 README 為 0 位元組**——**⭐ 這一對反差本身就是樣本**：**包的大小與版本數**證明它被使用**，**README 的空白**證明它對讀者**不加解釋**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 能力只能從**生成型別**讀出**——**包內模型檔可見實體含** quotation、**booking、**policy、**premium 計算、**policy activation、**bank transfer、**approval limit****——**⭐ 即一條從**報價（quotation）到**出單（booking）**、**再到**保單激活（policy activation）的業務漏斗**；**並含**保費計算、**銀行轉帳與**審批限額**——**⭐ 四項合起來**說明它**覆蓋的不是單一介面**，**而是一條**承保到收付的鏈路**。**⭐ 其 OpenAPI 生成痕跡**也說明它**為內部或合作方暴露 API 而生成**，**並非**為教學或開源協作而寫**。**⭐⭐ ④ 許可逐字為 Unlicense**——**如實標註**：**這是一種**放棄著作權的許可**，**⭐ 但**元資料許可**與**實際檔案頭**是否一致**本次**未逐檔核對**；**⭐ 並提示**：**企業發布的 SDK 即使標為 Unlicense**，**其服務端、**商標與**業務規則**仍受其他權利約束**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[clarity-sdk]]、[[openinsurance]]、[[digital-claims-management]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**保險集團自己發布的業務 SDK**，**且窗口內活動只在 beta 通道**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝該包、**沒有調用任何介面**，**不主張**其任何功能可用**。**② ⚠️⚠️ README 為 0 位元組**——**故**對其能力的描述**全部來自**包內**生成型別與檔案結構**，**不是**來自**任何作者說明**；**⭐ 此處須由讀者自行覆核**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其 **beta 通道**的實際含義**（**可能對應**預發布環境**，**也可能對應**尚未公布的介面**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其與**該集團線上服務**的對應關係**，**未核實**該 SDK 是否可在集團之外使用**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**許可檔案**與元資料許可是否一致**；**⭐ 並提示**：**商標、**介面文檔與**服務端規則**仍可能另有約束**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**維護者身份**（**只知作用域名**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**建立於 2022-07-21（**遠在窗口之外**）**，**而**窗口內有 beta 發布**——**缺口是**「**保險集團發布的業務 SDK**，**窗口內活動只在 beta 通道**」這一形態**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該 SDK 不是**任何持牌精算或合規意見**。
entries.body_en:
The npm package at the emilgroup scope **is an insurance business SDK published by a European insurance group**, measured this round as licensed under the Unlicense with four hundred and seventy-two versions since July 2022, a current stable release in July 2026, and nine hundred and sixty-one unpacked files totalling about four megabytes. **Its readme is zero bytes and its metadata declares no repository.** **This entry belongs to the round theme of what sits in a package registry, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from registry metadata**: **first, the only in-window activity sits on a beta channel**, with four beta releases published within three consecutive days in early September, while the latest distribution tag still points at the July stable release. **That is the point to note: the package did move inside the thaw window, but only on beta while the stable line stood still, which adds a question to the round 360 rule — a statement that a package was updated in-window is incomplete unless it names the channel.** **Second, four years and four hundred versions sit beside an empty readme.** Under this project postal sorting rule an over-short readme is usually a rejection signal, and **this entry states plainly that this package is the exception**: the size, the file count, the years and the version count all point to a genuinely maintained package, while the readme is zero bytes. **The contrast is itself a teaching sample: the package size and the version count prove it is used, and the empty readme proves it does not undertake to explain itself to readers.** **Third, the capabilities have to be read out of generated type definitions**, whose visible entities include quotations, bookings, policies, premium calculation, policy activation, bank transfers and approval limits. **Together those describe a business funnel running from quote through booking to policy activation, with premium calculation, bank transfer and approval limits attached — not a single endpoint but a chain from underwriting to settlement.** Traces of OpenAPI generation indicate the package was generated to expose an API to internal or partner consumers rather than written for teaching or open collaboration. **Fourth, the licence is the Unlicense**, a licence that disclaims copyright; **this entry marks plainly that whether the metadata licence matches the file headers was not checked file by file, and that an SDK published by an enterprise remains subject to other rights over its server side, its trademarks and its business rules even so.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover insurance API bundles, core systems, an SDK, open insurance and digital claims management, **while this entry supplies a business SDK published by an insurance group itself whose only in-window activity is on a beta channel. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **the transferable habit is how to read a package — check the distribution tags for which version is current, check the timestamps for whether it moved in-window and on which channel, check the readme for whether it undertakes to explain itself, and only then read the types for what it actually does. After those four steps the sentence this package is being updated acquires a definite meaning.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed and no interface was called** — no quote requested, no premium computed and no policy activated — **so no claim is made about whether any feature works**. **Second, the readme is zero bytes, so everything said here about its capabilities comes from generated types and file structure rather than from any author statement, and that is a point readers must check for themselves.** **Third, what the beta channel actually means was not verified**, since it may correspond to a pre-release environment or to interfaces not yet published, **and this entry asserts nothing about its purpose**. **Fourth, the relationship to any live service of that group was not verified, nor was whether the SDK may be used outside the group**, the metadata offering no repository and no documentation link. **Fifth, whether the licence file matches the metadata licence was not verified, and this entry notes that trademarks, interface documentation and server-side rules may carry separate constraints even where the code licence is permissive.** **Sixth, the maintainer identity was not verified**, only the scope name being visible. **Seventh, on the window: the package was created in July 2022, far outside the window, with beta releases inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a business SDK published by an insurance group whose in-window activity appears only on a beta channel. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the SDK is not a licensed actuarial or compliance opinion and that its rates, limits and approval rules remain the responsibility of the institution using it.**

entries.title: **把保险**嵌进别人的平台里**，**要先把词分清楚****：npm 包 `@voyant-travel/insurance-contracts`——**⭐ 逐字**「**A policy is not a booking, not a product and not an extra.**」**；**⭐ 并逐字**「**its own insured persons — who are not always the travellers**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 三条**形状强制规则**：**⭐ 档位只是展示标签（**永不排序、**永不作为分支条件）**、**⭐ 不得有**市场特有身份字段**（**国民身份号与护照同为一类证件）**、**⭐ 资格判定是**数据而不是异常**（**拒保**返回**带理由的报价**，**适配器**只在**调用本身失败时抛错**）**
entries.title_en: The vocabulary has to be separated before insurance can be embedded in someone else platform: a provider-neutral contracts package whose readme states verbatim that a policy is not a booking, not a product and not an extra, that insured persons are not always the travellers, and that three design rules are enforced by the shapes themselves — plan tiers are display labels never used as sort keys or branch conditions, no market-specific identity fields, and eligibility is data rather than an exception.
entries.title_hk: **把保險**嵌進別人的平台裡**，**要先把詞分清楚****：npm 包 `@voyant-travel/insurance-contracts`——**⭐ 逐字**「**A policy is not a booking, not a product and not an extra.**」**；**⭐ 並逐字**「**its own insured persons — who are not always the travellers**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 三條**形狀強制規則**：**⭐ 檔位只是展示標籤（**永不排序、**永不作為分支條件）**、**⭐ 不得有**市場特有身份欄位**（**國民身份號與護照同為一類證件）**、**⭐ 資格判定是**資料而不是異常**（**拒保**返回**帶理由的報價**，**介面卡**只在**調用本身失敗時拋錯**）**
entries.summary: **@voyant-travel/insurance-contracts**（npm 包 `@voyant-travel/insurance-contracts`）**是一套**中立的旅行保险合约**（**逐字自述为**「**Provider-neutral travel insurance contracts: quote requests, quotes, applications, policies, documents, and the insurance provider adapter interface.**」**）**——**其 README 开篇逐字为**「**A policy is not a booking, not a product and not an extra.**」**，**并接着说**它**有**自己的生命周期（**quote → application → issued policy**）**、**自己的文件、**自己的**被保险人——**逐字**「**who are not always the travellers**」**——**以及**属于**保险人而不是**运营方的**资格规则****。**本次实测**：**许可 **Apache-2.0****、**版本 **0.2.0**（**⭐ 且**仅此一版**）**、**发布于 **2026-08-17**、**依赖逐字为** `zod` **`^4.4.3`**、**解包 **25 个文件／**115,502 字节****、**仓库为 **`voyant-travel/voyant`** 下的** `packages/insurance-contracts`**、**README **2,408 字节****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**包登记里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **十个子路径**各自**管一件事****（**`./money` 用**整数最小单位＋**币种**、**`./eligibility` 是**结构化拒保理由**、**`./disclosure` **钉在**生效版本上**、**`./provider` 是**五方法的端口**）**；**② **三条**由形状强制的**设计规则****（**⭐ 见下**）**；**③ **⭐ **保险是被**嵌进旅行平台**的第三方对象**——**⭐ 故本条**对**「**在别人的系统里描述保险**」最有借鉴**；**④ **⚠️ **单版本、**窗口之外发布**、**不在**本站**业务条线**之内**。**⚠️ 本次**未安装、**未调用**。
entries.summary_hk: **@voyant-travel/insurance-contracts**（npm 包 `@voyant-travel/insurance-contracts`）**是一套**中立的旅行保險合約**（**逐字自述為**「**Provider-neutral travel insurance contracts: quote requests, quotes, applications, policies, documents, and the insurance provider adapter interface.**」**）**——**其 README 開篇逐字為**「**A policy is not a booking, not a product and not an extra.**」**，**並接著說**它**有**自己的生命週期（**quote → application → issued policy**）**、**自己的文件、**自己的**被保險人——**逐字**「**who are not always the travellers**」**——**以及**屬於**保險人而不是**運營方的**資格規則****。**本次實測**：**許可 Apache-2.0**、**版本 0.2.0（**僅此一版**）**、**發布於 2026-08-17**、**依賴逐字為** `zod` **`^4.4.3`**、**解包 25 個檔案／**115,502 位元組****、**倉庫為** `voyant-travel/voyant` **下的** `packages/insurance-contracts`**、**README 2,408 位元組****。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**包登記裡的東西：調用一次才算數**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **十個子路徑**各管一件事****（**`./money` 用**整數最小單位＋**幣種**、**`./eligibility` 是**結構化拒保理由**、**`./disclosure` 釘在**生效版本上**、**`./provider` 是**五方法的端口**）**；**② **三條**由形狀強制的**設計規則****；**③ **⭐ **保險是被**嵌進旅行平台**的第三方對象**——**⭐ 對**「**在別人的系統裡描述保險**」最有借鑑**；**④ **⚠️ **單版本、**窗口之外發布**、**不在**本站**業務條線**之內**。**⚠️ 本次**未安裝、**未調用**。
entries.summary_en: This package **is a set of provider-neutral travel insurance contracts**, described verbatim as covering quote requests, quotes, applications, policies, documents and an insurance provider adapter interface, and opening with the sentence that a policy is not a booking, not a product and not an extra. **It goes on to say that a policy has its own lifecycle, running from quote through application to issued policy, its own documents, its own insured persons who are not always the travellers, and eligibility rules that belong to the insurer rather than to the operator.** **Measured this round**: Apache-2.0, a single version 0.2.0 published in mid-August, one schema-validation dependency, twenty-five unpacked files totalling about a hundred and fifteen kilobytes, a repository subdirectory inside a monorepo, and a readme of about two and a half kilobytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of what sits in a package registry, where only a call counts.** **Four things are worth reading: ten subpaths that each own one concern, including money as integer minor units with a currency, structured refusal reasons, disclosures pinned to the version in force and a five-method provider port; three design rules enforced by the shapes themselves; the fact that insurance here is a third-party object embedded inside a travel platform, which is the most transferable part for describing insurance inside someone else system; and the fact that this is a single version published outside the window and outside this project business lines.** **The package was not installed and not called this round.**
entries.body:
**@voyant-travel/insurance-contracts**（npm 包 `@voyant-travel/insurance-contracts`）**是一套**中立的旅行保险合约****——**逐字自述为**「**Provider-neutral travel insurance contracts: quote requests, quotes, applications, policies, documents, and the insurance provider adapter interface.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**包登记里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均 npm registry 元数据与包内 README 实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 开篇三句就把词分清楚了**——**逐字为**「**A policy is not a booking, not a product and not an extra. It has its own lifecycle (quote → application → issued policy), its own documents, its own insured persons — who are not always the travellers — and eligibility rules that belong to the insurer rather than to the operator. This package is the shared vocabulary for all of that, consumed by the `insurance` runtime module, the storefront, and every provider adapter.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**其中三个分句**值得逐字记住**：**① **保单不是订单、**不是商品、**不是附加项**（**⭐ 即**把保险**挂在订单或商品上**的做法**在数据模型层面**就是错的**）**；**② **被保险人**不总是**出行人**（**⭐ 即**团单、**代购、**商务出行等情形下**两者并不重合**）**；**③ **资格规则**属于**保险人**、**不属于**运营方**（**⭐ 即**谁能投**由承保方定**，**平台**只是**传话**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 十个子路径**各自只管一件事****——**⭐ 逐字自述为**：`./money`「**`insuranceMoneySchema` — integer minor units plus their currency**」**；**`./eligibility`「**Structured refusal reasons, `insuranceEligibilitySchema`**」**；**`./cover`「**The cover categories that mean the same thing across insurers**」**；**`./disclosure`「**Pre-contractual disclosures, pinned to the version in force**」**；**`./document`「**`insuranceDocumentSchema`, URL vs inline bytes**」**；**`./quote`「**`insuranceQuoteRequestSchema`, `insuranceQuoteSchema`, `orderInsuranceQuotes`**」**；**`./application`「**Insured persons, contracting party, insurer questions**」**；**`./policy`「**`insurancePolicySchema` and its issue states**」**；**`./provider`「**`InsuranceProviderAdapter` — the five-method port**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**四处最值得记**：**① **金额**用**整数最小单位＋**币种**（**⭐ 避开**浮点与**字符串金额**两种常见错法**）**；**② **披露文件**钉在**生效版本**上**（**⭐ 即**披露**有版本**——**⭐ 这一条**本站此前**未见**任何条目**写出**）**；**③ **文件**分**URL 与内联字节**两种载体**；**④ **适配器**只有**五个方法**（**⭐ 即**接一家保险人的**最小接口面**被显式限定**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 三条**由形状强制的设计规则**——**逐字为**「**Three design rules the shapes enforce**」**：**⭐ ① 「**Plan tiers are display labels.**」**——**逐字续**「**`planTier` is an insurer**」**——**逐字續**「**’s invention and means something different to each of them. It is never a sort key and never a branch condition. What is comparable is the premium, the sum insured, the excess and the cover categories.**」**；**⭐ ② 「**No market-specific identity fields.**」**——**逐字续**「**A national identity number is an `insuranceIdentityDocumentSchema` entry with `type: "national_identity"` and an `issuingCountry`, exactly like a passport. Promoting one market**」**——**逐字續**「**’s document to a named field makes the contract wrong everywhere else.**」**；**⭐ ③ 「**Eligibility is data, not an exception.**」**——**逐字续**「**An insurer refusing a combination of trip length, lead time or age returns a quote whose `eligibility.status` is not `eligible`, carrying reasons a caller can show. Adapters throw only when the call itself failed.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**第 ③ 条**是本条最有教学价值的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**拒保**」在数据模型里**不是一个异常**，**而是一个**正常返回值**——**⭐ 因为**拒保是**业务常态**，**而不是**系统故障**；**⭐ 而**把两者**混在同一条抛出路径**上**，**会让**上层**无法区分**「**客户不符合条件**」与**「**接口挂了**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 依赖与体量**：**依赖逐字只有** `zod` **`^4.4.3`**、**解包 **25 个文件／**115,502 字节**、**README **2,408 字节****——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组数字**说明**它是一套**纯类型与**模式约定**，**不含**运行时业务逻辑**（**⭐ README 亦逐字指引**：**需要**持久化、**路由、**多供应商扇出或**订单集成时**，**改用** `@voyant-travel/insurance`**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[openinsurance]] 覆盖**开放保险**、**[[ontocore-insurance-ontology]] 与**[[ipn-insurance-dsl]] 覆盖**本体与**领域语言**、**[[insurance-qa-evidence]]、**[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] 覆盖**问答与**分析**，**[[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]] 亦属于**「**把保险**嵌进**别人的业务**」**一类**（**⭐ 本词条**未做代码级比较**）**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**把保险**作为第三方对象**嵌进**非保险平台（**旅行）时的**共享词汇与**形状约束**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的是**三条规则的写法**——**它们**不是**「**建议**」**，**而是**「**形状强制**」**：**⭐ 即**把**口径**（**档位不可比**）**、**标识**（**不得市场特有**）**与**失败语义**（**拒保是数据**）**写进**类型**，**让**错误用法**在**编译期**就不可能**。**⭐ 并**记住**那句**「**被保险人**不总是**出行人**」**——**⭐ 即**同名之物**在不同系统里**往往不是**同一个对象**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装该包、**没有调用任何接口**（**未获取任何报价、**未核保、**未出单**），**故**不主张**其任何功能可用**。**② ⚠️ **本次**只读元数据与 README**，**未读源码**，**故**三条规则的**实现程度**（**是否**真的**由类型强制**）**未核实**——**⭐ 这一处**须由读者自行复核**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其与**旅行保险实务**的对应关系**（**如**团单、**代购、**拒保理由分类**是否**符合各市场监管要求**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其 `./provider` 五方法**能否**覆盖**真实保险人的**接口差异**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**维护者身份**（**⭐ 元数据给出两个**维护者**与邮箱**，**本词条**不复述邮箱**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**该包与**同一仓库**其他包的**版本协同**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该包发布于 **2026-08-17**（**在解冻窗口之外**）**，**且**只有 **0.2.0** 一版**、**创建与最后修改**相隔**不足一秒****——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**把保险**作为第三方对象**嵌进**非保险平台**并写出**形状强制的**数据约定**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该包**不是**任何监管或**合规意见**，**其**资格规则与**披露要求**须**由承保方与**平台**各自负责**。

Promoting one market**」**——**逐字續**「**’s document to a named field makes the contract wrong everywhere else.**」**；**⭐ ③ 「**Eligibility is data, not an exception.**」**——**An insurer refusing a combination of trip length, lead time or age returns a quote whose `eligibility.status` is not `eligible`, carrying reasons a caller can show. This package **is a set of provider-neutral travel insurance contracts**, described verbatim as covering quote requests, quotes, applications, policies, documents and an insurance provider adapter interface. **This entry belongs to the round theme of what sits in a package registry, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from registry metadata and the package readme**: **first, the opening three sentences separate the vocabulary** — a policy is not a booking, not a product and not an extra; it has its own lifecycle running from quote through application to issued policy, its own documents, its own insured persons who are not always the travellers, and eligibility rules that belong to the insurer rather than to the operator; and the package is the shared vocabulary for all of that, consumed by a runtime module, a storefront and every provider adapter. **Three of those clauses are worth remembering verbatim: a policy is not an order, not a product and not an add-on, so hanging insurance off an order or a product is wrong at the data model level; insured persons are not always the travellers, since group policies, purchases on behalf of others and business travel all separate the two; and eligibility rules belong to the insurer rather than the operator, so who may be insured is decided by the underwriter while the platform merely relays.** **Second, ten subpaths each own exactly one concern**, described verbatim as money as integer minor units plus their currency, structured refusal reasons, the cover categories that mean the same thing across insurers, pre-contractual disclosures pinned to the version in force, documents as either a URL or inline bytes, quote requests and quotes with an ordering function, applications covering insured persons, contracting party and insurer questions, policies and their issue states, and a five-method provider port. **Four of those are worth noting: money as integer minor units with a currency, which avoids both floating point and string amounts; disclosures pinned to the version in force, meaning a disclosure has a version, which no entry in this project had stated before; documents offered as either a URL or inline bytes; and a provider adapter deliberately limited to five methods, a smallest possible interface to one insurer.** **Third, three design rules are enforced by the shapes themselves.** The first states that plan tiers are display labels, that a tier is an insurer invention meaning something different to each of them, that it is never a sort key and never a branch condition, and that what is comparable is the premium, the sum insured, the excess and the cover categories. The second states that there are no market-specific identity fields, that a national identity number is an identity document entry with a type and an issuing country exactly like a passport, and that promoting one market document to a named field makes the contract wrong everywhere else. The third states that eligibility is data and not an exception, that an insurer refusing a combination of trip length, lead time or age returns a quote whose eligibility status is not eligible, carrying reasons a caller can show, and that adapters throw only when the call itself failed. **That third rule is the most valuable teaching point here: a refusal is a normal return value rather than an exception, because refusal is ordinary business rather than system failure, and mixing the two on one throwing path leaves the caller unable to tell a customer who does not qualify from an interface that is down.** **Fourth, on dependencies and size**: one schema-validation dependency, twenty-five unpacked files totalling about a hundred and fifteen kilobytes and a readme of about two and a half kilobytes, which together indicate pure type and schema conventions with no runtime business logic, the readme itself directing users to a companion package when they need persistence, routes, multi-provider fan-out or booking integration. **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover open insurance, an insurance ontology and a domain language, evidence question answering and claims risk analytics, and a pooled embedded pet insurance SDK belongs to the same family of embedding insurance inside someone else business, **while this entry supplies the shared vocabulary and shape constraints for embedding insurance as a third-party object inside a non-insurance platform, here a travel platform. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **the transferable part is how those three rules are written — not as advice but as shape enforcement, putting definitions, identity and failure semantics into the types so that the wrong usage becomes impossible at compile time. And the sentence that insured persons are not always the travellers is worth keeping: things with the same name in different systems are often not the same object.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed and no interface was called** — no quote obtained, nothing underwritten and no policy issued — **so no claim is made about whether any feature works**. **Second, only the metadata and the readme were read and no source code was read, so how far the three rules are actually enforced by the types was not verified, and that is a point readers must check for themselves.** **Third, the correspondence with travel insurance practice was not verified**, including group policies, purchases on behalf of others and whether refusal reason categories meet any market regulatory expectation. **Fourth, whether the five provider methods can cover the real interface differences between insurers was not verified. Fifth, the maintainer identity was not verified**, the metadata naming two maintainers with addresses that this entry does not reproduce. **Sixth, version coordination between this package and others in the same repository was not verified. Seventh, on the window: the package was published in mid-August, outside the thaw window, with a single version whose creation and modification timestamps are under one second apart**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a set of shape-enforced data conventions for embedding insurance as a third-party object inside a non-insurance platform, which had no counterpart in the pool. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the package is not a regulatory or compliance opinion and that eligibility rules and disclosure requirements remain the responsibility of the underwriter and the platform respectively.**

entries.summary_en: This NuGet package **is a premium calculation engine for .NET**, described verbatim as flexible and supporting defined benefit, defined contribution, multi-factor rating and discounting logic. **Measured this round**: a single version 2.0.0 published in January, an MIT licence recorded as a metadata expression, tags naming insurance, premium, rating, calculator, actuarial and primus, and one hundred and fifty-five downloads. **Its nuspec names a source repository together with a branch and a commit hash, and that repository returns 404, while the organisation behind it still exists, created in 2016, with zero public repositories.** **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.** **Four things are worth reading: both the registry page and the compiled assembly point at the same vanished repository, since the dead URL is embedded inside the binary as well; the entire engine is one thirteen-kilobyte assembly whose shipped XML documentation file contains an empty members element; the readme is three hundred and fifty-four bytes and gives one service-registration call and an example that rates on a United States postal code; and the licence exists only as metadata, with no licence file anywhere in the package.** **The package was not installed and not called, but the package body was unpacked and counted: fourteen files in about a hundred and sixteen kilobytes.**
entries.body:
**PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium**（NuGet 包 `PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium`）**是一个 .NET 的**保费计算引擎****——**逐字自述为**「**Flexible premium calculation engine for .NET. Supports defined benefit, defined contribution, multi-factor rating, and discounting logic.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。

**可核实信息（均 NuGet 元数据、登记资源与包体实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 登记页与二进制指向同一个已消失的仓库**——**nuspec 逐字含** `<repository type="git" url="https://github.com/primussoft/Primus-SaaS-Framework" branch="refs/heads/insurance-test" commit="95276c94ee33d005114b5cc50e3f0fa4032360e4" />`**；**⭐ 本次实测**该仓库 URL **返回 **404****，**而**其所属组织 **`primussoft` 返回 **200****（**逐字为** `Organization`、**创建于 **2016-10-17**、**`public_repos` **0****）**——**⭐ 即**「**仓库没了，**组织还在，**而**组织里**一个公开仓库也没有**」**；**⭐⭐ 本文**最值得记录的一处**：**把包解开后**，**其 **DLL 内嵌的 **`RepositoryUrl` 字符串**仍是**同一个 **404 地址****——**⭐ 即**这条**死链**不只写在登记页上**，**还**被编进**已发布两年以上的二进制**里**。**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**nuspec 钉的是**分支名与提交号**（**`insurance-test` 分支**）**——**⭐ 而**这意味着**即使仓库还在**，**该提交**是否仍可达**也**需要单独核实**；**本次**无从核实**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 整个引擎的体量**——**包体 **14 个文件／**116 KB****，**其中 **`lib/` 下四份 DLL**（**net6.0／**net7.0／**net8.0／**net9.0**）**，**net8.0 那一份逐字为 **`Primus.Insurance.Premium.dll`，**13,824 字节****；**⭐ 并**随包一份同名 **`.xml` 文档**，**逐字内容为空的成员表**（**`<members></members>`**）**——**⭐ 即**它**声明了要带文档**，**而**文档里**一条成员都没有**。**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**⭐ 这不是**「**没有文档**」**，**而是**「**随包附了文档文件，**而**文件是空的**」**——**⭐ 与本会话早先记下的**「**登记处描述指向不存在的文件**」**同族**。**⭐⭐ ③ README **354 字节**，**内容只有两段**——**⚠️ 逐字为一句**「**High-performance rating engine for insurance premiums.**」**，**加一段 **C# 片段**：**注册** `builder.Services.AddPrimusPremiumCalculator();`**，**再**调用** `await _calculator.CalculateAsync(new RatingRequest { ProductCode = "AUTO", RiskFactors = new() { { "Age", 24 }, { "ZipCode", "90210" } } })`**——**⭐ 本词条认为**两个细节值得记**：**① **风险因子是**一张**字符串到对象的字典****（**`RiskFactors`**）**，**⭐ 即**「**因子名**」**由**调用方**自己约定**，**引擎**不定义因子表**；**② **例子里的产品码是 **`AUTO`**、**邮编是 **`90210`**（**美国格式**）**——**⭐ 而**描述里**同时声称**支持**确定给付与**确定缴费**（**即养老金类**）**，**⭐ 本词条**据此只记录其自述**，**不主张**该引擎**真能覆盖**这几类业务**。**⭐⭐ ④ 从二进制字符串可见的公开名称只有几个**——**逐字含** `RatingRequest`、**`CalculateAsync`、**`AppliedDiscounts`（**含其属性后备字段**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**本次**没有**做**程序集元数据反射**，**故**「**字符串清单**」**不等于**「**API 清单**」**，**也不等于**「**引擎能力清单**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 许可只在元数据里**——**许可表达式逐字为 **MIT**（**`licenses.nuget.org/MIT`**）**，**而**包内 **14 个文件里**没有**任何许可文件****（**⭐ 本次**逐文件核对**）**——**⭐ 这一形态**本会话**此前已记为**「**许可只在元数据里、**包内无文件**」**，**本词条**如实指出**这是**同一形态在另一个登记处**的再现**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 依赖与目标框架被写全**——**四组目标框架**（**net6.0／**7.0／**8.0／**9.0**）**各自**依赖三个 **`Microsoft.Extensions.*` **8.0.0 包**（**依赖注入抽象、**日志抽象与**选项**）**——**⭐ 即**它**按 **.NET 的现代约定**发布**（**多目标 ＋ 依赖注入**）**，**⭐ 而**这也**解释了** README 里**为什么只有**一句注册代码**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[policyforge-rating-engine]]、**[[openrater]]、**[[ratecraft]]、**[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]、**[[motor-pricing-glm]] 覆盖**费率与**定价引擎**（**多为 Python 或**R 生态**）**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**.NET 生态里的**保费计算引擎**，**其源码仓库已不可达**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的是一个**五步核对动作**：**① 看登记页给的仓库**；**② 打不开就去看**组织本身**（**⭐ 组织存在而仓库数为 0** 是**一种常被忽略的情形**）**；**③ 把包解开**看**里面到底有什么**；**④ 随包文档**是否真的有内容**；**⑤ **许可**是**写在元数据里**、**还是**包里真有文件**。**⭐ 五步走完**，「**登记处里有这个包**」**才**变成**一句**有内容的话**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装该包、**没有调用其任何 API**（**未计算任何保费、**未运行任何费率**）**，**故**不主张**其任何功能可用**、**不主张**其任何计算结果**。**② ⚠️ **源码不可得**——**登记页指定的仓库返回 **404****，**故**本次**无法看到**任何源码**；**⭐ 本条目对引擎内容的描述**全部来自**包内二进制**与**其字符串**，**而**这些**不足以**说明**其算法与正确性**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `RepositoryUrl` **是否**曾经存在过**（**⭐ 本词条**不推测**仓库为何不可达**）**。**④ ⚠️ **`primussaas` 这一归一化形式**是**登记资源实际使用的 ID**（**⭐ 本次**最初**按**包名大小写**手工推导**写成三个 `s`**，**导致**两个资源**误报 **404****——**⭐ 那一处**不是**登记处异常**，**而是**本词条自己的推导错误**，**已更正**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其目标框架与**许可表达式**是否与**实际发布内容**完全一致**（**⭐ 只核对了**包内无许可文件**）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**发布者身份**（**NuGet 上逐字为** `Primus SaaS`，**所有者名** `AkkiKhan`**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该包发布于 **2026-01-13**（**在解冻窗口之外**）**，**且**仅此一版**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**.NET 生态里的**保费计算引擎**，**而**其登记页与**二进制内嵌地址**共同指向**一个**已不可达的仓库**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该包**不是**任何持牌精算意见**，**其费率逻辑**须**由使用机构自行验证**。

**PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium**（NuGet 包 `PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium`）**是一個 .NET 的**保費計算引擎****——**逐字自述為**「**Flexible premium calculation engine for .NET. Supports defined benefit, defined contribution, multi-factor rating, and discounting logic.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一個登記處：企業側的包登記**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 NuGet 元資料、登記資源與包體實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 登記頁與二進位指向同一個已消失的倉庫**——**nuspec 逐字含** `<repository type="git" url="https://github.com/primussoft/Primus-SaaS-Framework" branch="refs/heads/insurance-test" commit="95276c94ee33d005114b5cc50e3f0fa4032360e4" />`**；**⭐ 本次實測**該倉庫 URL **返回 404****，**而**其組織 **`primussoft` 返回 200****（**`Organization`、**創建於 2016-10-17**、**`public_repos` 0****）**——**⭐ 即**「**倉庫沒了，**組織還在，**而**組織裡**一個公開倉庫也沒有**」**；**⭐⭐ 最值得記錄的一處**：**把包解開後**，**其 DLL 內嵌的 `RepositoryUrl` 字符串**仍是**同一個 404 地址****——**⭐ 即**這條**死鏈**不只寫在登記頁上**，**還**被編進**已發布的二进制**裡**。**⭐ nuspec 釘的是**分支名與提交號**（**`insurance-test` 分支**）**——**⭐ 而**這意味著**即使倉庫還在**，**該提交是否仍可達**也**需要單獨核實**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 引擎的體量**——**包體 14 個檔案／**116 KB****，**`lib/` 下四份 DLL**（**net6.0／**7.0／**8.0／**9.0**）**，**net8.0 那份逐字為 **`Primus.Insurance.Premium.dll`，**13,824 位元組****；**⭐ 並**隨包一份同名 `.xml` 文檔**，**逐字內容為**空的成員表**（**`<members></members>`**）**——**⭐ 即**它**聲明了要帶文檔**，**而**文檔裡**一條成員都沒有**。**⭐⭐ ③ README 354 位元組**，**只有兩段**：**逐字一句**「**High-performance rating engine for insurance premiums.**」**，**加一段 C# 片段**（**註冊** `AddPrimusPremiumCalculator()`，**再**以 `RatingRequest` 調用 `CalculateAsync`，**風險因子為 `Age` 24 與** `ZipCode` 90210**）**——**⭐ 兩個細節值得記**：**① **風險因子是**一張**字符串到對象的字典****，**⭐ 即**因子名**由**調用方**自己約定**；**② **例子裡產品碼為 `AUTO`、**郵編為美國格式****——**⭐ 而**描述同時聲稱**支持確定給付與**確定繳費**，**本詞條**只記錄其自述**。**⭐⭐ ④ 二進位字符串裡可見的公開名稱只有幾個**（**`RatingRequest`、**`CalculateAsync`、**`AppliedDiscounts` 及其後備欄位**）**——**⭐ 本次**沒有**做**程式集元資料反射**，**故**字符串清單**不等於** API 清單**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 許可只在元資料裡**（**表達式逐字為 MIT**）**，**而**包內 14 個檔案裡**沒有**任何許可文件**（**逐檔案核對**）**——**⭐ 同一形態**在**另一個登記處**再現**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 依賴與目標框架被寫全**：**四組框架各自依賴三個 `Microsoft.Extensions.*` 8.0.0 包**——**⭐ 即**它按 .NET 的**現代約定**發布**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[policyforge-rating-engine]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]、[[motor-pricing-glm]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**.NET 生態的保費計算引擎，**其源碼倉庫已不可達**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 最值得借的是一個五步核對動作**：**① 看登記頁給的倉庫**；**② 打不開就去看組織本身**（**組織存在而倉庫數為 0** 是**常被忽略的情形**）**；**③ 解開包**看**裡面到底有什麼**；**④ 隨包文檔**是否真有內容**；**⑤ **許可是**寫在元資料裡**，**還是**包裡真有文件**。**⭐ 五步走完**，「**登記處裡有這個包**」**才變成**一句**有內容的話**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝該包、**沒有調用其任何 API**，**不主張**其任何功能可用或任何計算結果**。**② ⚠️ **源碼不可得**——**登記頁指定的倉庫返回 404****，**故**本次**看不到**任何源碼**；**對引擎內容的描述**全部來自**包內二進位與其字符串**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** `RepositoryUrl` **是否曾經存在**（**不推測其為何不可達**）**。**④ ⚠️ **`primussaas` 這一歸一化形式**是**登記資源實際使用的 ID****——**本次最初**按包名大小寫**手工推導**寫成三個 `s`，**導致兩個資源誤報 404**——**⭐ 那不是登記處異常**，**而是本詞條自己的推導錯誤**，**已更正**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**目標框架與許可表達式**是否與**實際發布內容**完全一致**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**發布者身份**（**NuGet 上逐字為 `Primus SaaS`，**所有者名 `AkkiKhan`**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**發布於 2026-01-13（**窗口之外**）**，**僅此一版**——**本條的缺口是**「**.NET 生態的保費計算引擎，**而**登記頁與二進位內嵌地址**共同指向**一個**已不可達的倉庫**」這一形態**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該包不是**任何持牌精算意見**。
entries.body_en:
This NuGet package **is a premium calculation engine for .NET**, described verbatim as flexible and supporting defined benefit, defined contribution, multi-factor rating and discounting logic. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the registration resources and the unpacked package**: **first, the registry page and the compiled binary point at the same vanished repository.** The nuspec names a git repository with an explicit branch and commit hash, the repository returns 404, and the organisation that owns it returns a normal response describing itself as an organisation created in 2016 **with zero public repositories** — a shape worth recording, because the repository is gone while the organisation is not, and the organisation holds nothing public at all. **After unpacking the package, the dead URL is still embedded inside the compiled assembly as its repository URL, so the broken link is not only printed on the registry page but compiled into a binary that has been published since January.** This entry also states plainly that the nuspec pins a branch name and a commit hash, so even if the repository returned, whether that commit is still reachable would need separate verification, which was not possible here. **Second, on the size of the whole engine**: fourteen files in about a hundred and sixteen kilobytes, of which four assemblies target four framework versions from .NET 6 through .NET 9, the current one being a single assembly of thirteen thousand eight hundred and twenty-four bytes, shipped with a documentation file of the same name whose members element is empty. **That is worth stating precisely: it is not that no documentation was written, but that a documentation file was packaged and contains nothing.** **Third, the readme is three hundred and fifty-four bytes and contains two things**: one sentence calling the package a high-performance rating engine for insurance premiums, and a short code block that registers the calculator through dependency injection and then calls it with a rating request whose risk factors are a dictionary from strings to arbitrary values, using an auto product code and a United States postal code. **Two details matter there: the risk factors are a caller-defined dictionary, so the engine itself defines no factor table; and the example is both auto and United States shaped while the description also claims defined benefit and defined contribution support, so this entry records the claim without asserting that the engine really covers those lines.** **Fourth, the only public names visible from the binary are a request type, an asynchronous calculation method and a discount collection with its backing field**, and **this entry marks plainly that no assembly metadata reflection was performed, so a list of strings is neither an API list nor a capability list**. **Fifth, the licence exists only as metadata**: an MIT expression, with no licence file anywhere among the fourteen packaged files, which was checked file by file — **the same shape this session has already recorded, now recurring in a different registry**. **Sixth, dependencies and target frameworks are complete**: four framework groups each depending on three Microsoft.Extensions packages at version 8.0.0, which is the modern .NET convention and explains why the readme needs only one registration line. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover rating and pricing engines, mostly in the Python and R ecosystems, **while this entry supplies a premium calculation engine in the .NET ecosystem whose source repository is no longer reachable. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **the transferable habit is a five-step check — read the repository named on the registry page; when it does not open, look at the organisation itself, since an organisation that exists with zero repositories is an easily missed case; unpack the package and see what is actually inside; check whether the shipped documentation file has content; and check whether the licence is only metadata or a real file. Only after those five steps does the sentence this package exists in the registry acquire content.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed and none of its APIs was called**, so no premium was computed and no rate was run, **and no claim is made that any feature works or that any result is correct**. **Second, the source is unavailable** because the repository named on the registry page returns 404, **so everything said here about the engine comes from the packaged binary and its strings, which is not enough to establish its algorithms or their correctness**. **Third, whether that repository ever existed was not verified, and this entry does not speculate about why it is unreachable.** **Fourth, the normalised identifier actually used by the registration resources is the one with the doubled letter at the junction between the two words in the package name.** **This entry first derived that identifier by hand, wrote an extra letter, and thereby misread two registry resources as missing; that was not a registry anomaly but this entry own mistake, and it is corrected here.** **Fifth, whether the target frameworks and the licence expression match the published contents exactly was not verified**, only that no licence file is inside the package. **Sixth, the publisher identity was not verified**, the registry naming a company and an individual owner. **Seventh, on the window: the package was published in January, outside the thaw window, and it has exactly one version**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a premium calculation engine in the .NET ecosystem whose registry page and embedded binary address both point at a repository that can no longer be reached. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the package is not a licensed actuarial opinion and that its rating logic must be validated by the institution using it.**

entries.title: **一个没有说明书的 .NET 精算现金流引擎：**5,106 次下载、**无许可、**无仓库、**描述里还有一个拼写错****：NuGet 包 `ActuarialLibrary`——**⭐ 最后发布 **2018-04-20****；**⭐ 而**本次把包体解开后**，**从一个 **78,336 字节的 DLL** 里读出 **207 个类型名**：**年金／**现金流投影、**养老金增长、**退休日、**抵押贷款类型、**权益假设、**历史收益率、**封顶与**完全通胀、**生命数据**；**⚠️ 而**它**只发布过两个版本**、**唯一一次变更说明**是**换了一个 CSV 库的版本****
entries.title_en: A .NET actuarial cash-flow engine with no documentation: five thousand downloads, no licence, no repository, and a typo in its own description. Its last release was in April 2018, yet unpacking the package reveals two hundred and seven type names in a single seventy-eight kilobyte assembly, covering cash-flow projection, pension increases, retirement dates, mortgage types, equity assumptions, inflation capping and life data.
entries.title_hk: **一個沒有說明書的 .NET 精算現金流引擎：**5,106 次下載、**無許可、**無倉庫、**描述裡還有一個拼寫錯****：NuGet 包 `ActuarialLibrary`——**⭐ 最後發布 2018-04-20****；**⭐ 而**本次把包體解開後**，**從一個 78,336 位元組的 DLL** 裡讀出 **207 個型別名**：**年金／**現金流投影、**養老金增長、**退休日、**抵押貸款類型、**權益假設、**歷史收益率、**封頂與**完全通脹、**生命資料**；**⚠️ 而**它**只發布過兩個版本**、**唯一一次變更說明**是**換了一個 CSV 庫的版本****
entries.summary: **ActuarialLibrary**（NuGet 包 `ActuarialLibrary`）**是一个面向 .NET 的**精算类库****——**逐字自述为**「**A.Net Core Class Library for developing methods and Models for use in acturial work**」**（**⭐ 其中**「**acturial**」**是该包自己的**拼写错**）**。**本次实测**：**共两个版本**（**1.0.0 **2018-04-17**、**1.0.1 **2018-04-20**）**、**累计下载 **5,106 次****、**目标框架 **.NETCoreApp2.0****、**作者与所有者同为两个姓名**；**⚠️ 而**元数据里**没有**许可**、**也没有**仓库或**项目主页****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **唯一一次变更说明**逐字为**「**Updated CsvHelper from v 2.16.3 to v 7.1.0**」**——**⭐ 即**这个库**七年多来**留给读者的**全部变更记录**就是**换了一个 CSV 解析库的版本**；**② **包体解开后**：**6 个文件／**约 108 KB**，**核心是一个 **78,336 字节的 DLL****；**③ **⭐ 从该 DLL 里读出 **207 个类型名**，**它们**拼出一个**完整的**精算现金流投影框架**（**见下**）**；**④ **⚠️ **无许可**意味着**默认保留全部权利**——**⭐ 5,106 次下载**与**可合法使用**是两件事**。**⚠️ 本次**未安装、**未调用**；**⭐ 而**本次**把包体解开了**。

entries.summary_en: This NuGet package **is an actuarial class library for .NET**, described verbatim as a library for developing methods and models for actuarial work, with a spelling mistake inside its own description. **Measured this round**: two versions published three days apart in April 2018, five thousand one hundred and six total downloads, and a target framework that has long since left support. **The metadata declares no licence and gives neither a repository nor a project page.** **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.** **Four things are worth reading: the library only change note in seven years is a sentence about updating one CSV parsing dependency; unpacking the package yields six files in about a hundred and eight kilobytes around a single seventy-eight kilobyte assembly; that assembly exposes two hundred and seven type names that together describe a complete actuarial cash-flow projection framework; and the absence of any licence means all rights are reserved by default, so five thousand downloads and lawful reuse are two different things.** **The package was not installed and not called, but the package body was unpacked.**
entries.body:
**ActuarialLibrary**（NuGet 包 `ActuarialLibrary`）**是一个面向 .NET 的**精算类库****——**逐字自述为**「**A.Net Core Class Library for developing methods and Models for use in acturial work**」**（**⭐ 其中**「**acturial**」**是该包自己的**拼写错**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。

**可核实信息（均 NuGet 元数据、登记资源与包体实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 七年多只有一次变更说明，**而它说的是换了一个依赖的版本****——**1.0.1 的变更说明逐字为**「**Updated CsvHelper from v 2.16.3 to v 7.1.0**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为这一处最值得记**：**⭐ 即**一个库**对外公开的**全部变更历史**，**可以只有**一句**依赖升级**——**⭐ 而**这**并不等于**它**没有再改**，**而是**它**没有告诉读者**改了**什么**；**⭐ 与之对照**，本会话已多次记下**「**说清改了什么**」**的做法**（**如**逐字列出**改动的分析流程与**md5 校验**）**——**⭐ 本条**补上的是**反面的形态**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 包体解开后：**6 个文件／**约 108 KB****——**结构极简**（`_rels`、**`[Content_Types].xml`、**签名文件、**nuspec 与**一份 **DLL**）**，**核心是 **`lib/netcoreapp2.0/ActuarialLibrary.dll`，**逐字 **78,336 字节****；**⭐ 即**它**没有** README**、**没有**示例、**没有**许可文件、**也没有**任何文档文件**——**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**一个 **78 KB 的库**里**装着**一个**完整的业务框架**，**而**包里**一个字**都没有解释它**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 从 DLL 里读出 **207 个类型名**，**它们拼出一个**精算现金流投影框架****——**⭐ 本次**按名字分类记录如下**（**⭐ 本词条**明确说明**：**这是**从二进制字符串读出的**名称清单**，**⭐ 它**是**线索**，**不是** API 契约**，**更不是**功能证明**）**：**① **现金流核心**：**`ActuarialCashFlow`、**`ActuarialCashFlowItem`、**`CashFlowModel`、**`CashFlowItemType`、**`CashFlowItems`、**`CashFlowResult`、**`CashFlowOutput`、**`CashFlowSummaryOutput`、**`CashFlowProjectionType`、**`NumberOfCashFlows`**；**② **计算与参数**：**`ActuarialFunctions`、**`ActuarialParameter`、**`ActuarialResult`、**`ActuarialCodes`、**`CalculationManager`、**`CalculationManagerForBlobs`、**`CalculationType`、**`CalculationFrequency`、**`ParameterType`、**`GetParameterDbl`／**`GetParameterInt`／**`GetParameterStr`**；**③ **养老与给付**：**`DateOfRetirement`、**`DateOfNextIncrease`、**`PensionIncreaseAmount`、**`IncreaseType`、**`NoIncreases`、**`CompleteDays`／**`CompleteMonths`／**`CompleteYears`、**`DateDifferenceCalculation`、**`DateDiffCalcType`**；**④ **经济假设**：**`EquityAssumptions`、**`EquityAdjustment`、**`HistoricRateOfReturn`、**`InterestRate`、**`FixedRate`、**`CappedInflation`、**`FullInflation`、**`FutureInflationRate`、**`GrossPandLAmount`**；**⑤ **负债与费用**：**`MortgageType`、**`MortgageFees`、**`ChargeFixedAmount`、**`ChargeRateAmount`、**`ChargeRateParameters`**；**⑥ **生命数据与输入**：**`Life1Data`、**`Life2Data`、**`get_TransformSettings02LifeData`、**`InputDataComments`、**`ActuarialComment`、**`ActuarialCommentList`、**`CalculationCommentType`**；**⑦ **数据进出**（**这是最能说明它**面向什么场景**的一组**）**：**`LoadFromCSV`、**`LoadFromBlob`、**`CashFlowFromCSV`、**`CashFlowFromBlob`、**`OutputCashFlowsToFile`、**`ExportDataToXMLBlobAsync`、**`ExportDataToXMLFile`、**`ExportDataToJsonBlob`、**`CreateXSLBlob`／**`CreateXSLFile`、**`SQLTableName`、**`FileInformationLocal`、**`CloudBlob`／**`CloudBlockBlob`／**`CloudBlobStream`**。**⭐ 本词条认为**第 ⑦ 组**最值得看**：**⭐ 即**它**同时写着**「**CSV 文件**」**与**「**Azure Blob**」**两条进出路径**（**⭐ 依赖里也确有** `WindowsAzure.Storage` **与** `Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions`**）**——**⭐ 故**可以**合理推断**（**⭐ 并**明确标注为推断**）**它**当年是**为**在云上跑**定期现金流投影**而写**；**⭐ 本词条**不主张**任何关于其**正确性**或**适用监管口径**的判断**。**⭐⭐ ④ 依赖组也说明它属于**哪个年代****——**四依赖逐字为**：**`CsvHelper` **7.1.0**、**`Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions` **3.0.0-beta3**、**`SharpZipLib` **1.0.0-alpha2**、**`WindowsAzure.Storage` **8.7.0****——**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**其中两个**是**预发布版本**（**beta3 与**alpha2**）**，**而**目标框架是 **.NETCoreApp2.0****；**⭐ 即**这是一个**2018 年**在**早期 .NET Core 与**Azure Functions 上**做的项目**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 无许可、**无仓库、**无项目主页**——**⭐ 本次实测**三项**字段均缺失**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实说明**：**按**著作权默认规则**，**未声明许可**意味着**保留全部权利****——**⭐ 故**该包**可以被下载 5,106 次**，**而**这不表示**任何人**都可以**在**自己的系统中**使用或**再分发**它**；**⭐ 这一形态**本会话**此前已记为**「**沉默的许可**」**，**本词条**指出这是**同一形态**在**企业侧登记处**的再现**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[fastcashflow]]、**[[cashflower]]、**[[projectionmodels]]、**[[lifelib-products]]、**[[modelx]]、**[[psrwp]] 覆盖**现金流投影与**模型库**（**多为 Python／**R 生态**）**，**[[actuarialmath]] 覆盖**精算数学**——**⭐ 并**如实指出**：**本站另有一条**同名而不同生态**的条目 [[proteusllp-actuarial-library]]（**⭐ 那是 **Python 生态的随机建模库**，**与本条的 **.NET 类库**是两个不同之物**，**本词条**未做代码级比较**）**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**.NET 生态里的**精算现金流引擎**，**公开可读的说明为零**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得记的是**三个不等式**：**① **下载数 ≠ 可用性**（**5,106 次下载**与**是否有许可**无关**）**；**② **包里有代码 ≠ 有人能读懂它**（**78 KB 的 DLL、**零文档**）**；**③ **类型名一致 ≠ 口径一致**（**同一个 `CashFlowModel` 在**不同机构**可能指**不同的**投影假设**）**。**⭐ 并**留一个可执行的提醒**：**若**某机构**想复用**这样一个库**，**先要**确认**许可与**维护责任**，**再谈**口径**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装该包、**没有调用其任何方法**（**未做任何现金流投影、**未算任何年金或**准备金**）**，**故**不主张**其任何功能可用**、**不主张**其任何计算结果**、**也不主张**其**框架设计**是否正确**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **类型名清单来自二进制字符串**（**本次共读出 207 个**）**——**⭐ 本词条**明确声明**：**这是**线索**，**不是** API 契约**；**未做**程序集元数据反射**，**故**无法确认**这些类型的**可见性**（**公开／**内部）**、**签名与**相互调用关系**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其**算法是否符合**任何**精算标准**（**如**折现方式、**生命表插值、**通胀封顶规则**）**——**⭐ 而**这**恰恰是**使用前**必须核实的一处**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `Life1Data`／`Life2Data` **指向**哪一套生命表**，**也**未核实**其**来源与**许可**。**⑤ ⚠️ **许可缺失**——**⭐ 本词条**不主张**其**可被自由使用**；**⭐ 并**如实提示**：**这一处**须由**使用机构**自行与**权利人**确认**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**作者身份**（**元数据里**逐字为两个姓名**，**本词条**不复述**其**可能的机构归属**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实**该包与其**可能对应的**生产系统**的关系**（**⭐ 本词条**不做此类推测**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**两个版本**发布于 **2018-04-17 与 **2018-04-20**（**远在解冻窗口之外**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**.NET 生态里的**精算现金流引擎**：**下载量在千级**、**而**许可、**仓库与**文档**三项**同时缺席**」这一形态**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该包**不是**任何持牌精算意见**，**其**假设与**算法**必须**在使用前**独立复核**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝該包、**沒有調用其任何方法**，**不主張**其任何功能可用、**任何計算結果或**框架設計正確**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **型別名清單來自二進位字符串**（**共 207 個**）**——**⭐ 明確聲明**：**這是線索**，**不是 API 契約**；**未做**程式集元資料反射**，**故**無法確認這些型別的**可見性、**簽名與**相互調用關係**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其算法是否符合**任何精算標準**（**折現方式、**生命表插值、**通脹封頂規則**）**——**⭐ 而這正是使用前必須核實的一處**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實** `Life1Data`／`Life2Data` **指向哪一套生命表**，**也未核實**其來源與許可**。**⑤ ⚠️ **許可缺失**——**不主張**其可被自由使用**；**須由使用機構自行與權利人確認**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**作者身份**（**元資料裡逐字為兩個姓名**，**不複述其可能的機構歸屬**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實**該包與其可能對應的生產系統的關係**。**⑧ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**兩個版本發布於 2018-04-17 與 2018-04-20（**遠在窗口之外**）**——**本條的缺口是**「**.NET 生態的精算現金流引擎：**下載量在千級**、**而**許可、**倉庫與**文檔三項同時缺席**」這一形態**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該包不是**任何持牌精算意見**，**其假設與算法必須在使用前獨立覆核**。
entries.body_en:
This NuGet package **is an actuarial class library for .NET**, described verbatim as a library for developing methods and models for actuarial work, a description that contains a misspelling of the word actuarial. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the registration resources and the unpacked package**: **first, seven years of published history contain exactly one change note, and it is about a dependency version** — the release note for the later version states verbatim that the CSV parsing library was updated from version 2.16.3 to version 7.1.0. **That is worth recording: the entire change history a library makes public can be one sentence about an upgrade, which does not mean nothing else changed, only that readers were not told what did.** **Second, unpacking the package yields six files in about a hundred and eight kilobytes around a single assembly of seventy-eight thousand three hundred and thirty-six bytes**, with no readme, no examples, no licence file and no documentation file, **so a complete business framework sits inside seventy-eight kilobytes and not one word in the package explains it**. **Third, the assembly exposes two hundred and seven type names that together describe an actuarial cash-flow projection framework**, and this entry records them by group while stating plainly that **names read out of a compiled binary are clues rather than an API contract or proof of capability**, no assembly metadata reflection having been performed. The groups are: cash-flow core types covering flows, models, items, results, outputs and projection types; calculation and parameter types including an actuarial functions type, a calculation manager and typed parameter getters; pension and benefit types covering retirement dates, next increase dates, pension increase amounts and complete service periods; economic assumption types covering equity assumptions and adjustments, historic rates of return, interest rates, capped and full inflation, future inflation rates and a gross profit and loss amount; liability and charge types covering mortgage types and fees and fixed or rate-based charges; life data and input types including two life data types and comment types; and finally the input and output group, which is the most telling. **That last group names both a CSV path and an Azure Blob path for loading and exporting cash flows, alongside XML and JSON export, XSL creation, a SQL table name and cloud blob types, and the dependencies confirm it, naming both a cloud storage library and an Azure Functions extension, so it is reasonable to infer, and this entry marks it as inference, that the library was written to run periodic cash-flow projections in the cloud.** **Fourth, the dependency set dates the package**: a CSV library, an Azure Functions extension at a beta version, a compression library at an alpha version and a cloud storage library, targeting .NET Core 2.0 — **a project from 2018 on early .NET Core and Azure Functions, with two of its four dependencies on pre-release versions**. **Fifth, there is no licence, no repository and no project page**, all three fields being absent. **Under the default rules of copyright an undeclared licence means all rights are reserved, so the package can be downloaded five thousand times without that meaning anyone may use or redistribute it — the same silent-licence shape this session has recorded before, now appearing in an enterprise registry.** **Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover cash-flow projection and model libraries, mostly in the Python and R ecosystems, **and a pooled entry with a similar name is a Python stochastic modelling library rather than a .NET class library, so this entry states explicitly that the two are different artefacts and makes no comparison between them; while this entry supplies an actuarial cash-flow engine in the .NET ecosystem with no publicly readable documentation at all. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **three inequalities are worth remembering — a download count is not availability; code inside a package is not the same as code a reader can understand; and matching type names are not matching definitions, since the same cash-flow model name can mean different projection assumptions at different institutions. A practical reminder follows: before reusing such a library, settle the licence and the maintenance responsibility first, and discuss definitions second.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed and none of its methods was called**, so no cash-flow projection was run and no annuity or reserve was computed, **and no claim is made that any feature works, that any result is correct or that the framework design is sound**. **Second, the type names come from binary strings, two hundred and seven of them, and this entry states explicitly that they are clues rather than an API contract**, no reflection having been performed, so the visibility, signatures and call relationships of those types could not be confirmed. **Third, whether its algorithms conform to any actuarial standard was not verified**, including discounting, life table interpolation and inflation capping rules, **which is precisely what must be checked before use**. **Fourth, which mortality tables the two life data types point at was not verified, nor their source or licensing.** **Fifth, the licence is missing, and this entry does not claim the package may be freely used; that is a question for the user to settle with the rights holder.** **Sixth, the authors were not verified beyond two names appearing in the metadata, and this entry does not reproduce any institutional affiliation they might have. Seventh, any relationship between this package and a production system was not verified and is not speculated about here. Eighth, on the window: both versions were published in April 2018, far outside the thaw window**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is an actuarial cash-flow engine in the .NET ecosystem with downloads in the thousands while its licence, its repository and its documentation are all absent at once. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the package is not a licensed actuarial opinion and that its assumptions and algorithms must be independently reviewed before use.**
