entries.summary_en: This Packagist package **is the official PHP client for an embedded insurance provider**, described verbatim as an API SDK for PHP. **Measured this round**: an MIT licence, nearly seventy thousand downloads, eleven versions with the latest stable released in November 2023, and dependencies of PHP 7.4 or 8.0 and above, a Guzzle HTTP client at version 7.2 and above, and the JSON and multibyte-string extensions. **The repository behind it carries the same licence, seven stars, sixty-five files and a readme of about seven and a half kilobytes.** **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.** **Four things are worth reading: the quote example insures an event ticket protection policy, naming a concert venue, a pound sterling currency and a United Kingdom customer; the changelog is written in added, changed and removed columns and records every expansion and contraction of the supported PHP range; the readme keeps a to-do section listing three features that do not exist yet, which is the part most worth copying; and there are six continuous-integration workflows including static analysis and a security scan, while the static analysis baseline file is zero bytes, meaning nothing needed suppressing.** **The package was not installed and not called this round.**
entries.body:
**XCover SDK for PHP**（Packagist 包 `covergenius/xcover-php`）**是一家嵌入式保险服务商的**官方 PHP 客户端****——**逐字自述为**「**XCover API SDK for PHP**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Packagist 元数据、GitHub 仓库与包内文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它承保的是什么，**示例里的答案是一张演唱会门票****——**README 的报价示例逐字把 `policy_type` 写成** `event_ticket_protection`**，**并把 `policy_type_version` 写成 **1****；**⭐ 示例里其余字段逐字含** `policy_start_date`、**`event_datetime`、**`event_name`（**逐字为一位歌手名**）、**`event_location`（**逐字为 **The O2**）**、**`number_of_tickets`（**2**）**、**`total_ticket_price`（**100**）**、**`resale_ticket`（**false**）**、**`event_country`（**GB**）**，**以及**整单的** `currency`（**GBP**）**、**`customer_country`（**GB**）**、**`customer_region`（**London**）**、**`customer_language`（**en**）****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处最值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**嵌入式保险**」**在代码里**长什么样**——**⭐ 它**不是**一张通用保单**，**而是**挂在**一个具体事件**（**一场演出）**上**、**按**票数**与**票面总价**计价**、**并**把**转售票标记**（**`resale_ticket`**）**当作**风险因子**之一****；**⭐ 并对 RIAA**：**这类**场景化定价**正是**「**保险嵌进别人的业务流程**」**的**最小可读样本**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 变更日志按三栏写，**并逐字记录**语言支持范围的**每次收放****——**本次实测** `CHANGELOG.md`**（**804 字节**）**逐字含**：**v2.1.0（**2023-11-15）**「**switched utf8_encode to use mbstring instead, requiring mbstring ext for php**」**与**「**switched guzzle json encode to stop using deprecated functionality**」**；**v2.0.1（**2023-07-21）**「**Add 8.2 support**」**、**「**Add SECURITY.md and security.txt in .well-known folder**」**、**「**Update PHP Requirements to 7.4 or 8.0 and up**」**、**「**Remove PHP VCR Test Listener for PHP 7 & 8 compatibility**」**；**2.0.0（**2022-02-16）**「**Support for PHP 8.0, 8.1**」**与**「**Support for PHP 7, 7.1, 7.2, 7.3**」（**列为 Removed**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处值得抄的是**格式**：**⭐ 每一条都写**「**改了什么行为**」**而**不只写**「**改了什么文件**」**，**而**语言版本支持**被当作**对外契约**来**声明其**扩张与**收缩**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ README 有一节 `TODO`，**把**尚未做的事**列出来****——**逐字为**「**There are a few features which we will add in the future releases**」**，**下列三条**：**「**Async calls using Guzzle promises**」**、**「**CircuitBreaker middleware**」**、**「**BYO HTTP Client**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这是本条目**最有教学价值的一处**——**⭐ 即**一个**六万九千次下载**的包**，**在**自己的 README 里**明说**三件**它**现在做不到**的事**；**⭐ 而**这三件**恰好**是**生产环境的常见诉求**（**并发、**失败隔离、**自带客户端**）**——**⭐ 故**读者**不会**因为**看不到**而产生**错误期待**。**⭐⭐ ④ 工程质量设施齐全，**而**基线是空的****——**本次实测**仓库 **65 个文件**，**其中**：**六个 GitHub 工作流**（**`changelog`／**`ci`／**`composer`／**`lint`／**`semgrep`／**`static`**）**、**`phpcs.xml`（**2,171 字节**）**、**`phpstan.neon`（**262 字节**）**、**`phpunit.xml`（**780 字节**）**、**`.well-known/security.txt`（**154 字节**）**、**`SECURITY.md`（**272 字节**）**、**`LICENSE`（**1,107 字节**）**；**⭐ 而**`phpstan-baseline.neon` **逐字为 **0 字节****——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**基线为空**说明**静态分析**没有**需要**长期抑制的告警**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录这一事实**，**不主张**其**代码质量**）。**⭐ 源码侧**：`src/` 共 **8 个文件**，**其中 **`XCover.php` **12,970 字节**、**`AuthMiddleware.php` **2,992 字节**、**`Config.php` **2,346 字节**、**另有**两个异常类与**一个响应类**；**测试侧** `tests/`**：**`XCoverTest.php` **16,568 字节**（**⭐ 比它所测的**主类还大**）**，**另有**配置测试与**鉴权头中间件测试****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组数字**说明**它**把**测试与**静态分析**当成了**对外可见的承诺**（**README 逐字写明**：**测试、**风格检查与**静态分析**都在**每次推送与**每次拉取请求上跑**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 配置依赖里的一处**内部不一致****——**`composer.json` 的 **`require` 逐字要求** `php ^7.4.0||^8.0`**，**而**其 **`lint` 脚本逐字带参数** `--runtime-set testVersion 5.6-`**——**⭐ 即**代码风格检查**按 **PHP 5.6 起**的语法宽容度**在跑**，**而**声明支持的下限是 **7.4**；**⭐ 本词条**如实记录这一处**，**并**说明其影响**很小**（**⭐ 只影响**风格检查**的严格程度**）**——**⭐ 但**它**正好**是一个**可核查**的**小矛盾**，**⭐ 即**「**声明**」**与**「**工具参数**」**之间**也会**不一致**。**⭐ 另**`composer.json` 里**另有**一处**值得记**：**它**把**一个 PHPUnit 监听器**的**自建分支**写成了**自定义仓库**（**⭐ 说明**测试链路**有一段**不是**从公共源取得**的**）**，**并**设置了 **`minimum-stability` 为 `dev`＋**`prefer-stable`**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]] 覆盖**嵌入式保险 SDK**、**[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]] 覆盖**保险 API 集成**、**[[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 覆盖**场景化报价**、**[[clarity-sdk]] 覆盖**另一套行业 SDK**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**嵌入式保险的**官方 PHP SDK**：**下载在六万级**、**并**把「**还没做**」**写在自己的**说明里**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的三件事**：**① **把**尚未实现的功能**写进 README**（**⭐ 与其让使用者去猜**，**不如**列出三条**）**；**② **变更日志**要说**行为变化**，**并**把**语言或平台支持范围**当作**契约**来更新**；**③ **示例要**贴着真实场景写**（**⭐ 本条示例里**连**转售票**与**客户地区**都写了**）**。

**XCover SDK for PHP**（Packagist 包 `covergenius/xcover-php`）**是一家嵌入式保險服務商的**官方 PHP 客戶端****——**逐字自述為**「**XCover API SDK for PHP**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一個登記處：企業側的包登記**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Packagist 元資料、GitHub 倉庫與包內檔案實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它承保的是什麼，**示例的答案是一張演唱會門票****——**README 的報價示例逐字把 `policy_type` 寫成 `event_ticket_protection`**，**`policy_type_version` 為 1****；**⭐ 其餘欄位逐字含 `policy_start_date`、`event_datetime`、`event_name`（**逐字為一位歌手名**）、`event_location`（**逐字為 The O2**）、`number_of_tickets`（2）、`total_ticket_price`（100）、`resale_ticket`（false）、`event_country`（GB）**，**以及整單的 `currency`（GBP）、`customer_country`（GB）、`customer_region`（London）、`customer_language`（en）****。**⭐ 最值得記的一處**：**⭐ 即**「**嵌入式保險**」**在代碼裡長什麼樣**——**⭐ 它**不是一張通用保單**，**而是**掛在**一個具體事件**上**、**按票數與**票面總價計價**、**並**把**轉售票標記**當作**風險因子**之一**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 變更日誌按三欄寫**——**`CHANGELOG.md`（**804 位元組**）**逐字含**：**v2.1.0（**2023-11-15）**「**switched utf8_encode to use mbstring instead, requiring mbstring ext for php**」**與**「**switched guzzle json encode to stop using deprecated functionality**」**；**v2.0.1（**2023-07-21）**「**Add 8.2 support**」**、**「**Add SECURITY.md and security.txt in .well-known folder**」**、**「**Update PHP Requirements to 7.4 or 8.0 and up**」**；**2.0.0（**2022-02-16）**「**Support for PHP 8.0, 8.1**」**與**把 **PHP 7 系列列為 **Removed****。**⭐ 值得抄的是格式**：**每條都寫**「**改了什麼行為**」**；**語言版本支持**被當作**對外契約**來**聲明其擴張與收縮**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ README 有一節 `TODO`****——**逐字為**「**There are a few features which we will add in the future releases**」**，**下列三條**：**「**Async calls using Guzzle promises**」**、**「**CircuitBreaker middleware**」**、**「**BYO HTTP Client**」**。**⭐ 最有教學價值的一處**：**⭐ 即**一個**六萬九千次下載**的包**，**在 README 裡**明說**三件它**現在做不到**的事**——**⭐ 而這三件**恰好是**生產環境的常見訴求**（**並發、**失敗隔離、**自帶客戶端**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 工程設施齊全，**而**基線是空的****——**倉庫 65 個檔案**，**其中**：**六個 GitHub 工作流**（**changelog／**ci／**composer／**lint／**semgrep／**static**）**、**`phpcs.xml`（**2,171 位元組**）**、**`phpstan.neon`（**262 位元組**）**、**`phpunit.xml`（**780 位元組**）**、**`.well-known/security.txt`**、**`SECURITY.md`**、**`LICENSE`（**1,107 位元組**）**；**⭐ 而 `phpstan-baseline.neon` 逐字為 0 位元組****——**⭐ 即**基線為空**說明**靜態分析**沒有需要長期抑制的告警**。**⭐ 源碼側**：`src/` 共 8 個檔案，**其中 `XCover.php` 12,970 位元組**、**`AuthMiddleware.php` 2,992 位元組**、**`Config.php` 2,346 位元組**；**測試側**：`XCoverTest.php` **16,568 位元組**（**⭐ 比它所測的主類還大**）**。**⭐ 這一組數字說明**它**把測試與靜態分析**當成了**對外可見的承諾**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 配置依賴裡的一處內部不一致**——**`require` 逐字要求 `php ^7.4.0||^8.0`**，**而 `lint` 腳本逐字帶參數 `--runtime-set testVersion 5.6-`****——**⭐ 即**代碼風格檢查**按 PHP 5.6 起的寬容度在跑**，**而**聲明支持的下限是 7.4**；**⭐ 影響很小**（**只影響風格檢查的嚴格程度**）**，**但**它是一個**可核查的小矛盾**。**⭐ 另**`composer.json` 把一個 PHPUnit 監聽器的**自建分支**寫成**自定義倉庫**，**並**設置 `minimum-stability` 為 `dev` 加 `prefer-stable`**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]]、[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[restaurant-insurance-quote]]、[[clarity-sdk]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**嵌入式保險的官方 PHP SDK：**下載在六萬級**、**並把「**還沒做**」**寫在自己的說明裡**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 三件事值得借**：**① **把尚未實現的功能**寫進 README**；**② **變更日誌要說行為變化**，**並**把語言或平台支持範圍**當契約更新**；**③ **示例要貼著真實場景寫**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝該 SDK、**沒有調用任何介面**，**不主張**其任何功能可用**、**也不主張**其與真實服務的對應關係**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀倉庫檔案、**README、**變更日誌與**元資料**，**未逐行讀源碼**，**不主張**其實現質量**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其 API 文檔與本 SDK 是否同步**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其接口條款與 MIT 代碼許可是否相容**（**只記錄代碼許可**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其主體資訊變更**（**只知官網域名與 CDN 域名不同**，**不做公司結構方面的推測**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**包內是否有數據或個人資料處理相關說明**（**示例含客戶國家與地區欄位**，**如實指出這是一處與數據合規相關的介面面**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**最新穩定版 v2.1.0 發布於 2023-11-15（**遠在窗口之外**）**——**本條的缺口是**「**嵌入式保險的官方多語言 SDK：**下載在六萬級**、**README 裡明列尚未實現的三件事**」這一形態**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該 SDK 是介面客戶端**，**其費率、**承保條件與**理賠責任**均**由服務商與其承保方決定**。

This Packagist package **is the official PHP client for an embedded insurance provider**, described verbatim as an API SDK for PHP. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the public repository and the files inside it**: **first, the example answers what it insures, and the answer is a concert ticket.** The readme quote example sets the policy type to event ticket protection at version one, and the remaining fields name a policy start date, an event date and time, an event name, an event location, a ticket count, a total ticket price, a resale flag and an event country, alongside an order currency, a customer country, a customer region and a customer language. **That is the most useful thing here: it shows what embedded insurance looks like in code — not a general policy but one attached to a specific event, priced on ticket count and face value, with a resale flag treated as one of the risk factors.** **Second, the changelog is written in added, changed and removed columns and records every expansion and contraction of the supported language range**, starting with a change of encoding call to a multibyte-string extension and an update of JSON encoding away from deprecated functionality, then added support for a newer language version together with a security policy and a security contact file, and finally a major version that added support for two language versions while removing support for four older ones. **What is worth copying is the format: every entry states what behaviour changed rather than which file changed, and the supported language range is treated as an external contract whose widening and narrowing are declared.** **Third, the readme keeps a to-do section that lists what does not exist yet** — asynchronous calls using the HTTP client promises, a circuit breaker middleware, and support for a customer-supplied HTTP client. **This is the most valuable teaching point in the entry: a package with nearly seventy thousand downloads states in its own readme three things it cannot currently do, and those three are exactly the common production demands of concurrency, failure isolation and client substitution, so readers are not left with false expectations.** **Fourth, the engineering scaffolding is complete while its baseline is empty**: sixty-five files including six continuous-integration workflows for changelog, tests, dependency validation, linting, a security scanner and static analysis, alongside configuration for the linter, the static analyser and the test runner, a security contact file, a security policy and a licence file — **and the static analysis baseline is zero bytes, meaning no warnings needed long-term suppression, a fact this entry records without asserting anything about code quality**. On the source side there are eight files, the largest being the client class at about thirteen kilobytes, with an authentication middleware and a configuration class; on the test side the main test file is about sixteen and a half kilobytes, **larger than the class it tests**, which together indicate that tests and static analysis are treated as visible commitments, the readme stating verbatim that tests, style checks and static analysis run on every push and every pull request. **Fifth, one small internal inconsistency is worth recording**: the dependency declaration requires a minimum language version while the lint script passes a compatibility parameter starting three minor versions earlier, **so the style checker runs at a more permissive syntax level than the declared support floor — a minor effect on strictness only, but a checkable mismatch between a declaration and a tool parameter**. The same configuration file also pins a custom repository for a forked test listener, meaning part of the test chain is not fetched from a public source, and sets minimum stability to development while preferring stable releases. **Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover an embedded pet insurance SDK, an insurance API bundle, scenario-based quoting and another industry SDK, **while this entry supplies the official PHP SDK of an embedded insurance provider, downloaded nearly seventy thousand times, which writes down what it has not built yet. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **three practices transfer: write the unimplemented features into the readme instead of letting users guess; make the changelog describe behaviour and treat platform support ranges as a contract; and write examples that sit close to a real scenario, as this one does by including a resale flag and a customer region.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the SDK was not installed and no interface was called**, so no quote was requested and no policy was issued, **and no claim is made that any feature works or that it corresponds to a live service**. **Second, only repository files, the readme, the changelog and metadata were read, and no source code was read line by line**, structure being recorded only from file names and sizes, **so nothing is asserted about implementation quality**. **Third, whether the provider API documentation and this SDK are in step was not verified.** **Fourth, whether the provider interface terms are compatible with the MIT code licence was not verified**, only the code licence being recorded. **Fifth, no corporate change was verified beyond observing that the website domain and a content delivery domain differ, and this entry does not speculate about company structure.** **Sixth, whether the package says anything about data or personal information handling was not verified**, and **this entry notes plainly that the example carries customer country and region fields, which is an interface surface with data compliance implications**. **Seventh, on the window: the latest stable release dates from November 2023, far outside the thaw window**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is an official multi-language SDK for embedded insurance with downloads in the tens of thousands that lists three unimplemented features in its own readme. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the SDK is an interface client whose rates, underwriting terms and claim liabilities are decided by the provider and its underwriters.**

entries.summary_en: This Packagist package **is a multi-payer insurance orchestration module inside a hospital information system**, described verbatim as handling multi-payer coverage, claims submission and claims feedback so that billing can be reconciled against what insurers approve or reject. **Measured this round**: an MIT licence, a Laravel module type, two versions with the current one being an unstable development branch released in early September, thirty-three downloads, and a single named author. **The repository carries the same licence and two hundred and thirty files in about one and a half megabytes, created in May and last pushed on the same September day.** **Its three sibling dependencies are all pinned to unstable development branches and it requires a very recent PHP version.** **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.** **Four things are worth reading: the opening paragraph states why the module exists by describing a specific hospital setting where cash, national insurance and private insurance are mixed; the status section splits what is built from what is deferred, and one deferred line admits that a counter reads zero; the commit history shows a deliberate design reversal that removed an HTTP claims connector in favour of batch-only export; and both tests and master data live in the repository, including thirty-five test files and a forty-kilobyte medicines catalogue.** **The package was not installed and not deployed this round.**
entries.body:
**Flowrise HMS Insurance**（Packagist 包 `flowrise-hms/insurance`）**是一个医院信息系统里的**多付款方保险编排模块****——**逐字自述为**「**Multi-payer insurance orchestration module for NHIS and private insurers**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Packagist 元数据、GitHub 仓库与包内文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 为什么要写这个模块，**答案是一个具体的医院场景****——**README 逐字为**「**The Insurance module handles multi-payer coverage, claims submission, and claims feedback so billing can be reconciled against what insurers approve or reject.**」**，**并接着逐字说明**「**Hospitals in mixed-payment environments (cash + national insurance + private insurance) need one workflow to**」**，**下列三件事**：**管付款方规则与**保单关联**、**提交理赔**、**接收付款方回执并与**账务结果对账****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处最值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**多付款方**」**不是一个抽象词**，**而是一个**具体门诊现实**——**⭐ 病人**同时有**现金自付、**国家医保与**商业保险三种来源**，**而**医院**需要**一条**能把这三种**分开记、**并**与**各家**审批结果**对上的**流程**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**正是**「**理赔与**账务对账**」**这一主题**在**非保险机构内部**的样子**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② README 的 **Current status **一节分成两栏，**而**其中一条**自己承认计数为零****——**逐字为**「**Complete for operational claims workflows.**」**，**随后列出**已建之物**：**NHIS 批量导出、**NHIA 回执 XML 导入、**主数据界面（**含**费率表及其明细关系管理器、**药品、**G-DRG／**ICD 映射、**会员主表、**服务方资质）与**会员核验**；**⚠️ 而**「**推迟**」一栏逐字列出三件**：**「**NHIS catalog sync implementation (`processed: 0` from connector paths)**」**、**「**dedicated PatientPolicy Filament resource**」**、**「**private insurer connector beyond the generic stub**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**`processed: 0` **这一处写法最值得抄**：**⭐ 即**它**没有写**「**目录同步功能开发中**」**，**而是**写出**一个**可复现的观测值**——**从连接器路径读回来的处理计数是 **0****；**⭐ 读者**据此**可以**判断**「**这条链路**当下**不通**」**，**而**不必**去猜**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 一次**写在提交历史里的设计回退****——**本次实测**该仓库**最近六个提交**全部落在 **2026-09-02 的 **13:00:32 至 **13:01:13**（**约 41 秒内**）**，**提交信息逐字含**：**「**refactor: remove HTTP NHIS connector; claims go through batch export pipeline**」**、**「**feat: block NHIS claims over HTTP API and drop stale schema fields**」**、**「**feat: add NHIS OTAC client and attendance service for claim-check-code generation**」**、**「**feat: add claim/claim-batch exporters, claim global search, and OTAC settings UI**」**、**「**refactor: align member verification with OTAC card resolution**」**、**「**test: add OTAC attendance, client, and token refresh tests**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**其中第一、二条**最有价值**：**⭐ 即**作者**先做了**一条 **HTTP 的**理赔通道**，**然后**把它**移除**、**并**在 **API 层**主动**拦住**「**走 HTTP 提交 NHIS 理赔**」**这一用法**，**改为**只能走**批量导出**——**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**这**是一次**能力收缩**（**少了**一条通道）**，**而**它**被**明确写进**提交信息**，**并**在 README 里**留下**可核对的结论**（**「**NHIS claims are batch-export-only**」**）**——**⭐ 这是本会话**多次记下的**「**说清改了什么、**说清它不是什么**」**在企业仓库里的**实例**。**⭐⭐ ④ 结构与体量（可核对）**：**仓库 **230 个文件／**约 1.5 MB****；**其中**：**`app/Filament` **46 个文件**（**后台界面**）**、**`app/Models` **14**、**`app/Services` **14**、**`app/Schemes` **10**、**`app/Enums` **7**、**`tests` **35****；**⭐ 按字节数**最大的几份**：**`app/Schemes/NhisClaimAssembler.php` **15,730 字节**、**`app/Schemes/NhisBatchXmlEncoder.php` **12,845 字节**、**`app/Services/NhisAttendanceService.php` **9,111 字节**、**`tests/Feature/ClaimGenerationTest.php` **14,998 字节****；**⭐ 另有**一份**真实的**主数据文件**落在仓库里**（**`database/data/nhis_medicines_list_2025.csv`，**40,579 字节**）**，**以及 **7 个迁移文件**（**命名日期从 **2026_05_06 到 **2026_08_09**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组**说明它**不是**一个**仅有目录结构的**空壳**（**⭐ 本词条**同时指出**：**文件大小**不等于**功能正确**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 「**申报格式**」被当作**核心资产写在代码里**——**⭐ 主要体积**落在**两份文件**上**：**一份 **15,730 字节的**理赔组装器**与**一份 **12,845 字节的**批量 XML 编码器****；**并**另有**校验器、**代码映射器、**G-DRG 解析器与**专科代码表****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一形态**对 RIAA 有直接借鉴**：**⭐ 即**在**国家医保**这类**强格式**场景里**，**真正的**工程量**往往**不在**模型**，**而在**「**把本院的账**翻译成**对方要的 XML**」**这一段**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 三条须如实标注**：**① **依赖不稳定**——**三个同级模块**全部要求 **`dev-main`**，**而 **`minimum-stability` 逐字为 **`dev`****——**⭐ 即**这个模块**当下**不能**被**稳定地**独立安装**；**② **下载量极低****（**Packagist **33 次**、**GitHub **0 星**）**——**⭐ 本词条**不据此**判断**其质量**，**只记录**使用面**；**③ **构建元数据里指向仓库外的路径**——**README 的「**进一步阅读**」与**状态说明**都指向**仓库外**的 `docs/` 路径**（**`docs/shared/module-status.md` 等**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**在**单独发布**的包里**，**这些路径**不可达**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[openimis]] 覆盖**开源医保管理**、**[[cbhi-viability-replication]] 覆盖**社区医保**、**[[kokuho-rules-engine]] 覆盖**日本国保的**规则引擎**、**[[health-denial-appeals]]、**[[cloudhealthoffice]] 覆盖**支付方工作流**、**[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**具体到**加纳 NHIS／**NHIA **v8.6 XML **批量申报与 **CLAIM-it 上传的**多付款方编排模块**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的三件事**：**① **状态栏要**分成「**已建**」与「**推迟**」**，**而**推迟项**要写出**可核对的观测值**（**如**计数为 **0**）**；**② **能力收缩**（**移除一条通道）**要**写进提交信息**与**说明文件**，**并**说清**现在只能怎样做**；**③ **把**对方要的格式**（**XML 结构**）**当成**第一等工程资产**来对待**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有部署该模块**（**未运行任何迁移、**未生成任何理赔批次、**未导出任何 XML**）**，**故**不主张**其任何功能可用**、**不主张**其**生成的申报文件**符合**任何付款方**要求**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库文件、**README、**提交信息与**元数据**，**未逐行读源码**（**⭐ 结构按**文件名与**字节数记录**）**——**⚠️ 故**「**它做了什么**」**全部来自**文件命名与**README 自述**，**不是**来自**运行结果**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其 **NHIA v8.6 XML** 输出是否**真的**能被 **CLAIM-it 接收**（**⭐ 本词条**不主张**任何接口兼容性**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其**药品目录、**G-DRG／**ICD 映射与**费率表**的**来源与**许可**（**⭐ 仓库里**只有一份 **2025 年药品目录 CSV**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**是否**处理**个人健康信息**、**以及**是否**有**相应**合规措施**（**⭐ 模块名与**会员核验**暗示**会接触**可识别资料**，**本词条**不主张**其**做法适当**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**最新版本与**最后一次推送**均为 **2026-09-02**（**在解冻窗口的边界之外数日**）**，**而**创建于 **2026-05-10****——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**面向**一国国家医保**（**NHIS／**NHIA）**的**多付款方理赔编排模块**，**且**把**未完成项**与**一次能力收缩**都**写在明处**」这一形态**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该模块**是**医院侧业务软件**，**不是**保险人或**监管方**的系统**，**其**申报口径**须**以**付款方发布的**规范**为准**。

NHIS OTAC client and attendance service for claim-check-code generation**」**、**「**feat: add claim/claim-batch exporters, claim global search, and OTAC settings UI**」**、**「**refactor: align member verification with OTAC card resolution**」**、**「**test: add OTAC attendance, client, and token refresh tests**」**。**⭐ 其中第一、二條最有價值**：**⭐ 即**作者**先做了**一條 HTTP 理賠通道**，**然後把它移除**、**並在 API 層主動攔住**「**走 HTTP 提交 NHIS 理賠**」**，**改為只能走批量導出**——**⭐ 這是一次能力收縮**，**而它被**明確寫進**提交信息**，**並在 README 留下**可核對的結論**（**「**NHIS claims are batch-export-only**」**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 結構與體量（可核對）**：**230 個檔案／**約 1.5 MB****；**其中 `app/Filament` 46 個檔案**、**`app/Models` 14**、**`app/Services` 14**、**`app/Schemes` 10**、**`app/Enums` 7**、**`tests` 35****；**⭐ 按位元組數最大者**：**`app/Schemes/NhisClaimAssembler.php` 15,730 位元組**、**`app/Schemes/NhisBatchXmlEncoder.php` 12,845 位元組**、**`app/Services/NhisAttendanceService.php` 9,111 位元組**、**`tests/Feature/ClaimGenerationTest.php` 14,998 位元組****；**⭐ 另有**一份真實主資料檔**（**`database/data/nhis_medicines_list_2025.csv`，**40,579 位元組**）**，**以及 7 個遷移檔**（**命名日期從 2026_05_06 到 2026_08_09**）**——**⭐ 這說明它**不是**只有目錄結構的空殼**（**⭐ 同時指出**：**檔案大小**不等於**功能正確**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 「**申報格式**」被當作**核心資產寫在代碼裡**——**主要體積**落在**兩份檔案**上**：**一份 15,730 位元組的理賠組裝器**與**一份 12,845 位元組的批量 XML 編碼器****；**並有**校驗器、**代碼映射器、**G-DRG 解析器與**專科代碼表****。**⭐ 在**國家醫保這類強格式場景裡**，**真正的工程量**往往**不在模型**，**而在**「**把本院的賬翻譯成對方要的 XML**」**這一段**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 三條須如實標註**：**① **依賴不穩定**——**三個同級模組**全部要求 `dev-main`**，**`minimum-stability` 逐字為 `dev`****——**⭐ 即**它**當下**不能**被穩定地**獨立安裝**；**② **下載量極低**（**33 次**、**0 星**）**——**⭐ 不據此判斷質量**，**只記錄使用面**；**③ **構建元資料裡指向倉庫外的路徑**——**README 指向 `docs/` 路徑**（**如 `docs/shared/module-status.md`**）**——**⭐ 在單獨發布的包裡**，**這些路徑不可達**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[openimis]]、[[cbhi-viability-replication]]、[[kokuho-rules-engine]]、[[health-denial-appeals]]、[[cloudhealthoffice]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**具體到加納 NHIS／**NHIA v8.6 XML **批量申報與 CLAIM-it 上傳的多付款方編排模組**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 三件事值得借**：**① **狀態欄分成已建與推遲**，**推遲項要寫出可核對的觀測值**；**② **能力收縮要寫進提交信息與說明檔**，**並說清現在只能怎樣做**；**③ **把對方要的格式當第一等工程資產對待**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝、**沒有部署該模組**，**不主張**其任何功能可用**、**也不主張**其生成的申報檔**符合**任何付款方要求**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀倉庫檔案、**README、**提交信息與**元資料**，**未逐行讀源碼**——**⚠️ 故**「**它做了什麼**」**全部來自**檔案命名與**README 自述**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其 NHIA v8.6 XML 輸出是否真能被 CLAIM-it 接收**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其藥品目錄、**G-DRG／**ICD 映射與**費率表的**來源與許可**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其是否處理個人健康資訊**、**是否有相應合規措施**。**⑥ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**最新版本與最後一次推送均為 2026-09-02（**在解凍窗口邊界之外數日**）**，**而**創建於 2026-05-10****——**本條的缺口是**「**面向一國國家醫保的多付款方理賠編排模組**，**且把未完成項與一次能力收縮都寫在明處**」這一形態**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該模組是醫院側業務軟體**，**不是保險人或監管方的系統**，**其申報口徑須以付款方發布的規範為準**。
entries.body_en:
This Packagist package **is a multi-payer insurance orchestration module inside a hospital information system**, described verbatim as handling multi-payer coverage, claims submission and claims feedback so that billing can be reconciled against what insurers approve or reject. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the public repository and the files inside it**: **first, the reason the module exists is a concrete hospital setting** — the readme states that hospitals in mixed-payment environments combining cash, national insurance and private insurance need one workflow to manage payer rules and policy links, submit claims, receive payer feedback and reconcile claim decisions against billing outcomes. **That is worth recording because multi-payer is not an abstraction here but a clinic reality: a patient may draw on cash, national insurance and private cover at once, and the hospital needs one process that keeps the three apart and matches them to each payer decision.** **Second, the status section splits what is built from what is deferred, and one deferred line admits its own counter reads zero.** Built items are the national scheme batch export, the authority feedback XML import, master-data screens covering tariff books with a line-item relation manager, medicines, a diagnosis-related-group and diagnosis-code map, a members master and provider credentialing, and member verification. The three deferred items are the catalogue synchronisation implementation, whose measured state is stated as a processed count of zero from the connector paths, a dedicated policy administration screen, and a private insurer connector beyond the generic stub. **The zero count is the phrase most worth copying: rather than writing that synchronisation is in progress, the readme publishes an observable value, so a reader can conclude that the path does not currently work instead of guessing.** **Third, the commit history contains a deliberate design reversal.** The six most recent commits all fall within forty-one seconds of a single morning, and their messages record removing an HTTP connector for the national scheme so that claims go through a batch export pipeline, blocking national scheme claims over the HTTP interface and dropping stale schema fields, adding a client and attendance service for claim-check code generation, adding claim and claim-batch exporters with global search and a settings screen, aligning member verification with card resolution, and adding tests for the attendance, client and token refresh work. **The first two matter most: the author built an HTTP claims channel and then removed it, actively blocking that usage at the API layer and leaving batch export as the only path, and this capability reduction is written into both the commit messages and a checkable conclusion in the readme stating that national scheme claims are batch-export-only. That is the same discipline this session has recorded repeatedly — say what changed and say what it is not — appearing inside an enterprise repository.** **Fourth, structure and size are checkable**: two hundred and thirty files in about one and a half megabytes, of which forty-six are administrative interface files, fourteen are models, fourteen are services, ten are scheme handlers, seven are enumerations and thirty-five are tests. **By bytes the largest are a claim assembler at about fifteen and a half kilobytes, a batch XML encoder at about twelve and a half kilobytes, an attendance service at about nine kilobytes and a feature test at about fifteen kilobytes, and the repository also carries real master data in a forty-kilobyte medicines catalogue for the current year plus seven migration files dated across three months. Together those indicate a module that is not an empty shell of directories, although this entry notes plainly that file size is not functional correctness.** **Fifth, the declaration format is treated as a first-class engineering asset**: most of the code volume sits in an assembler and an XML encoder, supported by a validator, a code mapper, a group resolver and a speciality code table. **For this project the transfer is direct: in a strongly-specified national scheme setting the real engineering effort is usually not in the models but in translating the hospital ledger into the XML the payer demands.** **Sixth, three points must be stated plainly**: the module depends on three sibling modules pinned to unstable development branches and sets minimum stability to development, so it cannot currently be installed independently in a stable way; its usage surface is tiny, with thirty-three registry downloads and no repository stars, which this entry records without drawing quality conclusions; and its build metadata points at documentation paths outside the package, which are unreachable in the published artefact. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover open-source health insurance management, community-based health insurance, a Japanese national scheme rules engine, payer workflow and denial appeals, and one national statistics portal, **while this entry supplies a multi-payer orchestration module specific to Ghana national health insurance batch declaration and upload, which keeps its unfinished items and one capability reduction in plain sight. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **three practices transfer: split status into built and deferred, and make each deferred item carry an observable value such as a counter reading zero; write capability reductions into commit messages and documentation, saying clearly what is now the only way to do something; and treat the payer demanded format as a first-class engineering asset.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the module was not installed and not deployed**, so no migration was run, no claim batch generated and no XML exported, **and no claim is made that any feature works or that any generated declaration would satisfy any payer**. **Second, only repository files, the readme, commit messages and metadata were read, and no source code was read line by line**, structure being recorded from names and byte sizes, **so everything said about what it does comes from file naming and the readme own account rather than from running it**. **Third, whether its version 8.6 XML output would actually be accepted by the national claims upload portal was not verified, and no interface compatibility is asserted. Fourth, the source and licensing of the medicines catalogue, the diagnosis-group mappings and the tariff books were not verified**, the repository containing one medicines catalogue file for the current year. **Fifth, whether the module processes personal health information and whether it has corresponding compliance measures was not verified**, and although its member verification work implies contact with identifiable data, **this entry does not assert that its handling is appropriate**. **Sixth, on the window: the latest version and the last push both belong to early September, a few days outside the thaw window boundary, while the repository was created in May**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a multi-payer claims orchestration module aimed at one country national health insurance scheme that keeps its unfinished items and one capability reduction in plain sight. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the module is hospital-side business software rather than an insurer or regulator system, and that its declaration rules must follow the specification the payer publishes.**

entries.title: **一个**真的在跑**的理赔分诊应用：**把车损图上传、**先分割、**再生成结构化理赔摘要****：Hugging Face Space `DavidL72Code/ClaimSight`——**⭐ 本次**实测 **HTTP 200** 并**取到真实页面**（**逐字**「**Upload a vehicle image to simulate a segmentation-first workflow that identifies damaged regions and produces a structured claim**」**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而**本次**真的调了一次健康检查**，**返回逐字**「**segmentation_provider**」**为 `gemini`**、**而**「**active_segmentation_provider**」**为 `gemini+sam2`****（**⭐ 即**声明的那一个**与**实际生效的那一个**不一致**）**；**⚠️ 而**README 里的链接**指向**作者本机路径**（**实测 **404****）**；**最后更新 **2026-09-10****

entries.summary_en: This Hugging Face Space **is a working online vehicle damage claim triage application**, described verbatim as an insurance damage assessment tool that combines image segmentation with multimodal report generation. **Measured this round**: a Docker Space created in June and last modified in September, inside the thaw window, and its subdomain answered with a real application page rather than a placeholder. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that actually run, and of the several states a Space can be in.** **Four things are worth reading: this round actually called the health endpoint the project documents, and it returned a request naming one segmentation provider while the active provider field named two, so what was asked for and what is actually running are separate fields; the service has a documented fallback path stating that if the segmentation model cannot load the API still responds using the classical fallback so the demo does not hard-crash during cold starts or constrained deployments; the security notes contain a line highly relevant to this project, stating that the report generation prompts explicitly treat image text, file names and visible instructions as untrusted evidence; and the same readme links to an absolute path on the author own machine, which measured as a dead link.** **No image was uploaded and no assessment endpoint was called this round.**
entries.body:
**ClaimSight**（Hugging Face Space `DavidL72Code/ClaimSight`）**是一个**在线的车损理赔分诊应用****——**逐字自述为**「**Insurance Damage Assessment Tool**」**，**且**逐字说明它**结合**图像分割与**多模态报告生成**（**「**An MVP for insurance claim triage that combines image segmentation with multimodal report generation.**」**）。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**能跑的应用：一个 Space 的四种活法**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Hugging Face API、仓库文件与一次真实请求实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 本次真的调了一次端点，**而它把「**声明**」与「**生效**」分成两个字段****——**⭐ 本次请求** `https://davidl72code-claimsight.hf.space/api/health`**（**HTTP 200、**137 字节、**约 0.96 秒**）**，**返回逐字为**：**「**{"status":"ok","segmentation_provider":"gemini","active_segmentation_provider":"gemini+sam2","demo_mode":true,"attachments_enabled":true}**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处是本条最有价值的记录**：**⭐ 即**同一件事**有两个字段**——**「**请求的分割提供方**」是 `gemini`**，**而**「**当前生效的分割提供方**」是 `gemini+sam2`****；**⭐ 而**它的 README 逐字说明这个端点的用途**：**「**The health response includes the requested segmentation provider, active provider, SAM 2 model id, and whether the SAM 2 adapter is ready.**」**——**⭐ 故**调用者**不必**去猜**「**你以为你在用哪个模型、**而**实际跑的是哪个模型**」**。**⭐ 与本会话第 361／362 轮的纪律合读**：**登记 ≠ 可用 ≠ 完整**——**本条**补上的是**「**同一个服务内部**也有**声明与**生效之分**」**。**⭐⭐ ② 它有**明写的降级路径**，**并**说明了降级的原因****——**逐字为**「**If SAM 2 cannot load, the API still responds using the classical fallback so the demo does not hard-crash during cold starts or constrained deployments.**」**；**⭐ 并**逐字给出**模型档位的选择**：**推荐先上 **`facebook/sam2-hiera-tiny`**，**若** Space 内存足够**再升到 **`facebook/sam2-hiera-small`****，**且** `Dockerfile` 里**设了 **`INSTALL_SAM2=1`** 以便**构建期安装依赖**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组说明**值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**演示的可用性**」**放在**「**模型的完整性**」之前**——**⭐ 这与**本会话多次记录过的**「**宁可**先给出**可运行的最小版本**，**而**把**失败路径写明**」**同向**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 安全说明里的「**不可信证据**」一条**——**`SECURITY.md` 的**已实施控制**逐条列出**（**本次实测其中若干**）**：**⭐ 不提交硬编码密钥**；**⭐ 生产镜像默认 **`APP_ENV=production`／**`DEBUG=false`／**`ENABLE_API_DOCS=false`****；**⭐ `/api/assess` 支持**可选的 **Bearer 令牌**保护**（`API_ACCESS_TOKEN`**）**；**⭐ **CORS 默认只允许显式列出的本地来源**，**除**显式开关**外**忽略通配 `*`****；**⭐ **可信主机检查**（`ALLOWED_HOSTS`**）**；**⭐ 前后端**都设**安全响应头**（**CSP、**禁止嵌入、**nosniff、**referrer 策略与**权限策略**）**；**⭐ `/api/assess` **按 **IP 限流**，**并**限制上传字节数、**像素数、**MIME、**扩展名**，**且**用 **Pillow **真验证图片****；**⭐ **上传文件名**在返回或**送模型前**被归一化**；**⭐ **健康检查**不暴露**原始异常文本**；**⭐ 以及**本词条认为**最值得抄**的一条**：**逐字**「**Gemini prompts explicitly treat image text, filenames, and visible instructions as untrusted evidence.**」**——**⭐ 即**它**明确假设**图片里的**文字**、**文件名与**画面中的**指令**都可能是**攻击面**，**而**不是**证据**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这对**任何**把**图像或 PDF** 交给**多模态模型**的理赔场景**都是**应当照抄的一句**。**⭐ 并**如实记下**它**自己划出的界限**：**`SECURITY.md` 有一节逐字为**「**Not Applicable In This MVP**」**，**说明**在**尚未加入数据库之前**，**SQL／**NoSQL 注入、**数据库权限与**备份恢复**等项**不适用****。**⭐⭐ ④ 接口面与文件结构（可核对）**：**⭐ 端点逐字含** `/health`、**`/api/health`、**`POST /api/assess`、**`POST` 与 **`GET /api/cases`、**`GET /api/cases/{case_id}`、**`GET /api/queue`（**分诊队列**）**、**`POST /api/claim-assistant`、**`POST /api/second-pass`（**二次复核**）**、**`GET /api/keepalive`、**`POST /api/attachments`****；**⭐ 服务层**共 **11 个文件**，**逐字含** `segmentation.py`、**`mobilesam.py`、**`assessment_pipeline.py`、**`gemini_client.py`、**`report_generation.py`、**`evaluation.py`、**`case_repository.py`、**`attachment_storage.py`、**`demo_reviewer.py`、**`supabase_auth.py`、**`supabase_data.py`****；**⭐ 仓库共 **30 个文件**，**且**有 **`SECURITY.md`**、**`.env.example` 与 **`Dockerfile`****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组命名**说明**它**不是**一个**单文件演示**：**它有**队列、**案件库、**附件存储、**二次复核与**评测**——**⭐ 而**其中**「**评测**」与**「**二次复核**」**是**理赔场景里**最容易被**演示版省略**的两件**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 部署形态是**前后端分离的**混合部署****——**逐字为**「**backend: FastAPI app intended for Hugging Face Spaces using Docker**」**与**「**frontend/: static app intended for Vercel**」**——**⭐ 即**模型侧在 **Space 上**，**界面**放在**另一家平台**上**，**并由 **`ALLOWED_ORIGINS`** 与 **`VITE_API_BASE_URL` **两个变量**对接**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实指出**：**这类**跨平台部署**会让**「**这个应用在哪**」**变成一个**需要读文档**才能回答的问题**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ ⚠️ 一处**可核查的坏链**：**同一份 README**在**两处**把**文件链接**写成了**作者本机的绝对路径**（**逐字形如** `/Users/davidle/Documents/Insurance%20damage%20assessment%20tool/Dockerfile`**）**——**⭐ 本次实测**该链接**在 Hub 上**返回 **404****；**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**这**不影响**应用运行**，**但**它**说明**本地预览**与**线上发布**之间的**链接检查**是**两件事**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[car-damage-assessment-ai]]、**[[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]]、**[[claims-intake-agent]]、**[[damagerestore-claims-index]]、**[[guidewire-claim-intelligence]]、**[[claims-triage-mcp]] 覆盖**车损评估、**理赔受理与**分诊**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**一个**真的在跑、**并**把**声明与**生效**分成两个字段**的**在线理赔分诊应用**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **健康检查**要能回答**「**我现在**实际用的是什么**」**，**而**不只是**「**我是否活着**」**；**② **降级路径**要**写明**，**并**说明**为什么**要**降级**（**冷启动与**资源受限**）**；**③ **凡是**把图片／PDF** 交给**多模态模型**，**就要**把**其中的文字**当作**不可信输入**；**④ **README 里的**链接**要**指向**仓库内路径或**公开地址**，**不要**指向**本机**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有上传任何图片、**没有调用 **`/api/assess`**（**未做任何损伤评估、**未生成任何理赔摘要**）**，**故**不主张**其**分割或**报告的**准确度**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只调用了**它自述的**健康端点**（**只读、**无副作用**）**——**⭐ 这也是**本会话**一贯的做法**：**只调用**自述为**只读的端点**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**分割与**报告**用的**模型是否**与**本次健康检查**所述一致**（**⭐ 只知**健康端点**自称**生效提供方为 `gemini+sam2`**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **Supabase **相关文件**（**认证与**数据**）在**本次请求中**是否**被实际使用**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**仓内是否**含有**演示数据**或**真实索赔资料**（**⭐ 本次**只列了**文件清单**，**未逐一下载**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该 Space **创建于 **2026-06-11**（**窗口之外**）**，**而**最后修改为 **2026-09-10**（**窗口之内**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**一个**在线的**车损理赔分诊应用**，**其**健康端点**主动区分**「**请求的**」与「**生效的**」**模型**」这一形态**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该应用**自述为 **MVP 与**演示形态**（**健康端点**逐字返回 **`"demo_mode":true`**）**，**不得**用于**真实理赔决定**。

本條補上的是**「**一個真的在跑、**並把聲明與生效分成兩個欄位**的**在線理賠分診應用**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

entries.body_en:
This Hugging Face Space **is a working online vehicle damage claim triage application**, described verbatim as an insurance damage assessment tool that combines image segmentation with multimodal report generation. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that actually run, and of the several states a Space can be in.**

**Verified information, all measured from the platform API, the repository files and one real request**: **first, this round actually called the health endpoint the project documents, and the response separates what was asked for from what is running.** The request to the health path returned a success status with a body naming a requested segmentation provider, a different active segmentation provider made of two names, a flag stating that demo mode is on, and a flag stating that attachments are enabled. **That is the most valuable record in this entry: the same subject appears in two fields, so a caller does not have to guess which model was requested and which is actually running, and the readme itself documents that the health response carries the requested provider, the active provider, the second model identifier and whether that adapter is ready.** **Read alongside the disciplines recorded in the earlier rounds of this session — that registration is not availability and availability is not completeness — this entry adds that a single service also distinguishes what it declares from what is in force.** **Second, the service documents a fallback path and says why it exists**, stating verbatim that if the segmentation model cannot load the API still responds using the classical fallback so the demo does not hard-crash during cold starts or constrained deployments, and it names a small model to start with and a larger one to move to when memory allows, while the container installs the heavy dependencies at build time by default. **Together those show availability of the demonstration taking priority over completeness of the model.** **Third, the security notes contain the line most worth copying in this entry**: the report generation prompts explicitly treat image text, file names and visible instructions as untrusted evidence. **That is the sentence to reuse whenever an image or a document is handed to a multimodal model in a claims setting.** The same file lists the controls actually implemented, including no hardcoded credentials, production defaults that disable debug mode and the interactive API documentation, optional bearer token protection, cross-origin rules that ignore the wildcard unless explicitly allowed, trusted host checking, security headers, per-address rate limits together with upload byte, pixel, MIME and extension limits and real image verification, normalised upload file names, and health checks that do not expose raw exception text. **It also draws its own boundary in a section stating which risks are not applicable until a database is added.** **Fourth, the interface and file structure are checkable**: the routes include health, an assessment endpoint, case creation, listing and retrieval, a triage queue, a claim assistant, a second-pass review, a keepalive and an attachments endpoint; the service layer holds eleven files covering segmentation, a mobile segmentation adapter, the assessment pipeline, the language model client, report generation, evaluation, case storage, attachment storage, a demonstration reviewer and two authentication and data modules; and the repository holds thirty files including a security policy, an environment template and a container definition. **That naming shows this is not a single-file demonstration: it has a queue, a case store, attachment storage, a second review pass and an evaluation step, and the last two are precisely what demonstration versions usually omit.** **Fifth, deployment is split across two platforms**, the model side on a Docker Space and the interface as a static application intended for a different host, joined by allowed-origins and base-url variables, **which is worth noting because in such a layout the question of where the application actually lives can only be answered by reading the documentation**. **Sixth, one broken link is checkable**: the readme links two repository files through absolute paths on the author own machine, and those links return 404 on the platform, which does not affect the running application but shows that local preview and published links are two different checks. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover vehicle damage assessment, a damage detector, claim intake, a claims index, claim intelligence and claims triage, **while this entry supplies a live online claim triage application that separates what it was asked for from what is in force. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: make the health check answer what is actually in use, not merely whether the service is alive; document the fallback path and why it exists; treat text inside images and documents as untrusted input whenever they reach a multimodal model; and never point readme links at a local machine.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no image was uploaded and the assessment endpoint was not called**, so no damage assessment was produced and no claim summary generated, **and no claim is made about the accuracy of either**. **Second, only the health endpoint the project itself documents was called, a read-only route with no side effects, consistent with this session practice of calling only endpoints described as read-only.** **Third, whether the models actually used for segmentation and reporting match what the health check reported was not verified**, only that the endpoint reports a two-part active provider. **Fourth, whether the authentication and data modules are actually in use was not verified. Fifth, whether the repository contains demonstration data or real claim material was not verified**, only the file list being read. **Sixth, on the window: the Space was created in June, outside the window, and last modified in September, inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a live vehicle damage claim triage application whose health endpoint distinguishes the requested model from the one in force. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the application describes itself as a demonstration, the health endpoint returning a demo-mode flag, and must not be used for real claim decisions.**

entries.title: **一个**把结果先冻住**的理赔舞弊演示：**不现场重训模型，**而是**把已经验证过的数字端上来****：Hugging Face Space `lele22e/insurance-fraud-detection-demo`——**⭐ 逐字**「**Instead of retraining on start-up, it loads the team**」**——**逐字續**「**’s ALREADY-VALIDATED results**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而**它**明说**46 份调查简报里**有 2 份没通过人工评分标准**，**而那 2 份**照原分数显示、**不藏起来**（**逐字**「**the 2 that didn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t are shown with their real score, not hidden**」**）**；**⭐ 冻结基线逐字**「**no_skill_pr_auc**」**为 **0.0597**、**PR-AUC **0.1945**、**阈值 **0.15**、**抽查工时占比 **7.61%****；**⚠️ 而**本次**两次请求**得到**两种状态**：**先是**平台页「**Preparing Space**」**、**后是**真实应用页**（**逐字标题**「**Innovexa — Claim Fraud Intelligence Console**」**）**——**⭐ 因其档位是**缩容到零**的 **`zero-a10g`****
entries.title_en: A claims fraud demonstration that freezes its results instead of retraining a model on start-up: it loads the team already validated numbers, it says plainly that two of forty-six investigation briefs failed the human rubric and shows those two with their real scores rather than hiding them, and it publishes a no-skill baseline of 0.0597 against a precision-recall area of 0.1945 at a threshold that puts seven and a half percent of claims into review.

entries.summary_en: This Hugging Face Space **is a demonstration application for vehicle claim fraud detection**, described verbatim as covering insurance fraud detection, risk scoring and claim analysis. **Measured this round**: a Gradio application on a recent runtime, created and last modified within hours of each other in early September, with no likes, and **its subdomain answered two probes differently, first with a platform page stating that the Space is still preparing and then with the real application, whose page title names a claim fraud intelligence console, while its hardware tier is a scale-to-zero one, so the preparing page was a cold start, both probes being recorded here side by side**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that run, and of the several states a Space can be in.** **Four things are worth reading: it does not retrain a model on start-up but serves already frozen results; of forty-six investigation briefs two failed the human rubric and those two are shown with their real scores rather than hidden; it publishes both a no-skill baseline of about six percent against a precision-recall area of about nineteen percent and the gap between its validation and test splits, together with a separate cross-year robustness check that is explicitly labelled as neither calibrated nor thresholded nor the final model; and it states an operating threshold that puts about seven and a half percent of claims into review, with risk tiers reporting their own case volumes and real fraud rates.** **The Space was not started and its interface was not called this round.**

**Insurance Fraud Detection Demo**（Hugging Face Space `lele22e/insurance-fraud-detection-demo`）**是一个**车险理赔舞弊识别的**演示应用****——**逐字自述为**「**insurance fraud detection, risk scoring, and claim analysis**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**能跑的应用：一个 Space 的四种活法**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Hugging Face API、仓库文件与一次真实请求实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**不现场重训模型**，**而是**把已冻结的结果端出来**——**`model_pipeline.py` 抬头逐字为**「**PRECOMPUTED-RESULTS BACKEND (demo viewer)**」**，**并逐字说明**「**Instead of retraining on start-up, it loads the team**」**——**逐字續**「**’s ALREADY-VALIDATED results**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这是本条最值得记的一处**：**⭐ 即**很多**演示**会在**启动时**现场重训**一个模型**（**于是**每次看到的数字**都不一样**）**，**而**它**反过来**——**把**已经验证过的那一套**（**模型、**风险分层、**SHAP 驱动因素与**生成式摘要**）**冻结**下来**端给读者**。**⭐⭐ ② 它**写明了为什么必须这样做**，**而**理由里点出一个**具体的失败模式****——**逐字为**「**Why: the demo must show the project**」**——**逐字續**「**’s REAL reported results**」**，**即**「**the finalized XGBoost + isotonic-calibration model (test PR-AUC 0.195), its real risk tiers, real SHAP drivers, and the real Qwen2.5 briefs the team generated and scored**」**，**并逐字否定另一种做法**：**「**not a fresh model retrained live (which would produce different numbers and could silently run on synthetic fallback data)**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**括号里那半句最值得抄**：**⭐ 即**现场重训**不仅**会给出**不同的数字**，**还**可能**在**无人察觉的情况下**回落到**合成数据**上**——**⭐ 这**正是**「**演示看起来在跑**」**与**「**演示在跑真东西**」**之间的**差别**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 46 份调查简报里**2 份没通过人工评分标准**，**而**它**照原分数显示**——**逐字为**「**it loads the team**」**——**逐字續**「**’s ALREADY-VALIDATED results from `demo_data.json` (46 investigation briefs spanning Low/Medium/High risk tiers, 44 of which passed the human rubric - the 2 that didn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t are shown with their real score, not hidden)**」**；**⭐ 另一处**数据文件的说明也逐字给出同样的事实**：**「**All 46 SHAP+brief samples across Low/Medium/High risk tiers (High=30, Medium=8, Low=8); 44/46 passed human rubric review (95.7%, mean 7.83/8). Real validated results.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处是本条的**教学核心**：**⭐ 即**一个**演示**主动**保留**那**两份没通过的样本**，**并**标明**它们的真实分数**——**⭐ 而不是**只**挑出**通过的那 44 份**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这正是**「**公布结果时**要不要**把不通过的样本一起公布**」**这一问题的**一个具体答案**。**⭐⭐ ④ 指标给全了，**含**失败的上限与**落差****——**`results/metrics.json` 本次实测逐字含**：**测试集 **2,313 笔索赔**、**舞弊率 **5.97%**；**⭐ **「**无技能基线**」**逐字为** `no_skill_pr_auc` **0.0597**（**⭐ 即**不做任何模型时**PR-AUC 大约就是**这个数**）**；**PR-AUC **0.1945**、**召回 **0.2899**、**精确率 **0.2273**、**macro-F1 **0.6003**、**MCC **0.2031**、**ROC-AUC **0.8297**、**Brier **0.0515**；**操作阈值逐字为 **0.15**，**对应**混淆矩阵四格**为 **TP 40／**FP 136／**FN 98／**TN 2,039**，**「**抽查工时占比**」逐字为 `caseload_pct` **7.61%**；**⭐ 风险分层逐档给出**：**Low **1,573 笔／**占 **68.01%／**实际舞弊率 **1.78%**、**Medium **564 笔／**24.38%／**12.41%**、**High **176 笔／**7.61%／**22.73%****；**⭐ 校准方法逐字为 **`isotonic`**；**⭐ 且**另给**验证集与**测试集的**落差**（**`pr_auc_gap` **0.0251**、**`recall_gap` **0.0627**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组数字**说明**它**把**「**上线后会多忙**」（**抽查 7.61%**）与**「**每一档里实际有多少舞弊**」**都**摊开了**——**⭐ 而不是**只报一个 **ROC-AUC**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 一次**跨年份稳健性检查**，**并**自带免责说明****——**逐字为**「**Same model recipe as best_model_config.json, retrained from scratch on 1994-95 only, evaluated once on 1996 only. Not calibrated, not thresholded, not the project**」**——**逐字續**「**’s final model.**」**，**并给出**训练年份 **1994–1995**、**测试年份 **1996**、**训练舞弊率 **6.26%／**测试舞弊率 **5.22%** 与**该次检查的指标**（**PR-AUC **0.1157**、**ROC-AUC **0.7343** 等**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一节值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**它**做了一次**「**换年份**」的**压力测试**，**并**明确说**这不是**最终模型**、**没校准、**没定阈值**——**⭐ 故**读者**不会**把**这次较差的结果**误当成**项目主张的**性能**。**⭐ 模型来源亦逐字写明**（**`source_model`：**`XGBoost`、**平衡策略 **`class_weight`、**Optuna 第 **58** 次试验**）**，**并给出**随机种子 **42** 与**生成时间 **2026-08-29****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ ⚠️ 四处**须如实标注**：**① **它的 README **是**平台模板**（**逐字只有**「**Check out the configuration reference at https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/spaces-config-reference**」**一行**）**——**⭐ 即**本条目里**所有实质内容**都来自**代码与**指标文件**，**而**不是**来自**作者写的说明**；**② **本次**对**其线上域名**做了**两次请求**，**得到**两种状态****：**第一次 **HTTP 206** 与**平台页**「**Preparing Space**」**，**第二次 **HTTP 200**、**19,576 字节**，**页面标题逐字为**「**Innovexa — Claim Fraud Intelligence Console**」**（**并含**「**Use via API**」与**「**Built with Gradio**」**）**——**⭐ 而**其运行档位逐字为 **`zero-a10g`**（**缩容到零的 GPU 档**）**，**故**第一次看到的**「**Preparing**」**正是**冷启动**；**⭐ 本词条**并列记录**、**不调和**；**③ **仓库里有**两张带同一品牌名的图**（**`innovexa_header_mark.png` 与 **`innovexa_logo.png`**）**——**⭐ 本词条**只记录**这一事实**，**不推测**该名称**属于**哪个主体**；**④ **未核实**其训练数据**来源**（**⭐ 只知**年份覆盖 **1994–1996**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[claims-fraud-guardian]]、**[[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]]、**[[claim-fraud-dataset-generator]]、**[[explainable-ai-fraud]]、**[[friction-ledger-claimwatch]]、**[[insurance-conformal-fraud]] 覆盖**舞弊识别与**风险评分**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**一个**冻结结果、**并**公开未通过样本**的**在线理赔舞弊演示**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **演示要**端**验证过的数字**，**不要**现场重训**（**否则**你展示的**不是**你的模型**）**；**② **没通过评分标准的样本**也要**留下**，**并**标明**它们的真实分数**；**③ **除了 **ROC-AUC**，**还要报**「**会带来多少工作量**」**（**⭐ 本条为 **7.61%**）与**「**每一档的**实际命中率**」**；**④ **任何**一次性的稳健性检查**都要**自带**「**这不是最终模型**」**的说明**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有启动该 Space、**没有调用其界面**（**未提交任何索赔、**未得到任何舞弊评分**）**，**故**不主张**其**功能可用**、**不主张**其任何指标的**可复现性**。**② ⚠️ **README 为平台模板**——**⭐ 故**本条目**对项目目的的描述**来自**代码内的说明文字**，**而**不是**来自**作者面向读者的**文档**；**⭐ 这一处**须由读者自行复核**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其**训练数据的来源与许可**（**⭐ 只知**年份跨 **1994–1996**、**规模 **2,313 笔测试索赔**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其**人工评分标准**（**`human rubric`**）的**具体条目与**评分人**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**两张品牌图片**所对应的主体**（**⭐ 本词条**不做此类推测**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该 Space **创建于 **2026-09-04T23:53:06Z**、**最后修改 **2026-09-05T00:58:19Z**——**⭐ 恰好**落在**解冻窗口的边界**附近**（**按**跨日时间**属**边界之外）**；**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**演示端出**冻结结果**、**并**公开未通过人工评分标准的样本**」这一形态**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该应用**是**演示**，**其风险分**不构成**任何舞弊认定**，**也不得**用于**拒赔或**调查决定**。

Real validated results.**」**。**⭐ 教學核心**：**⭐ 即**一個演示**主動保留**那兩份沒通過的樣本**，**並標明其真實分數**——**⭐ 而不是**只挑出**通過的 44 份**。**⭐⭐ ④ 指標給全了**——**`results/metrics.json` 逐字含**：**測試集 2,313 筆索賠**、**舞弊率 5.97%**；**⭐ 無技能基線逐字為 `no_skill_pr_auc` 0.0597**；**PR-AUC 0.1945**、**召回 0.2899**、**精確率 0.2273**、**macro-F1 0.6003**、**MCC 0.2031**、**ROC-AUC 0.8297**、**Brier 0.0515**；**操作閾值 0.15**，**混淆矩陣四格 TP 40／FP 136／FN 98／TN 2,039**，**抽查工時佔比 `caseload_pct` 7.61%**；**風險分層**：**Low 1,573 筆／68.01%／1.78%**、**Medium 564 筆／24.38%／12.41%**、**High 176 筆／7.61%／22.73%**；**校準方法逐字為 `isotonic`**；**驗證集與測試集落差**（**`pr_auc_gap` 0.0251**、**`recall_gap` 0.0627**）**。**⭐ 這說明它把**「**上線後會多忙**」與**「**每一檔實際有多少舞弊**」**都攤開了**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 一次跨年份穩健性檢查**，**並自帶免責說明**——**逐字為**「**retrained from scratch on 1994-95 only, evaluated once on 1996 only. Not calibrated, not thresholded, not the project**」**——**逐字續**「**’s final model.**」**，**並給出**訓練年份 1994–1995**、**測試年份 1996**、**訓練舞弊率 6.26%／測試舞弊率 5.22%** 與**該次指標**（**PR-AUC 0.1157**、**ROC-AUC 0.7343**）**。**⭐ 即**它做了一次**「**換年份**」壓力測試**，**並明說**這不是最終模型、**沒校準、**沒定閾值**——**⭐ 故**讀者不會把**這次較差的結果**誤當成**項目主張的性能**。**⭐ 模型來源逐字為 `XGBoost`＋`class_weight`＋**Optuna 第 58 次試驗**，**隨機種子 42**、**生成時間 2026-08-29****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ ⚠️ 四處須如實標註**：**① README 是平台模板**（**逐字只有**「**Check out the configuration reference at https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/spaces-config-reference**」**一行**）**——**⭐ 即**本條目所有實質內容**都來自**代碼與指標檔**；**② 本次對其線上域名做了兩次請求，**得到兩種狀態****：**第一次 HTTP 206** 與**平台頁**「**Preparing Space**」**，**第二次 HTTP 200、**19,576 位元組**，**標題逐字為**「**Innovexa — Claim Fraud Intelligence Console**」**——**⭐ 其檔位逐字為 `zero-a10g`（**縮容到零的 GPU 檔**）**，**故**第一次看到的「**Preparing**」**正是**冷啟動**；**⭐ 並列記錄**、**不調和**；**③ 倉庫裡有兩張帶同一品牌名的圖**（**`innovexa_header_mark.png` 與 `innovexa_logo.png`**）**——**⭐ 只記錄事實**，**不推測**該名稱屬誰**；**④ 未核實**其訓練數據來源**（**只知年份跨 1994–1996**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[claims-fraud-guardian]]、[[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]]、[[claim-fraud-dataset-generator]]、[[explainable-ai-fraud]]、[[friction-ledger-claimwatch]]、[[insurance-conformal-fraud]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**凍結結果、**並公開未通過樣本的**在線理賠舞弊演示**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **端**驗證過的數字**，**不要現場重訓**；**② **沒通過評分標準的樣本也要留下**，**並標明真實分數**；**③ **除 ROC-AUC 外**，**要報**「**會帶來多少工作量**」與**「**每一檔的實際命中率**」**；**④ **一次性的穩健性檢查要自帶「**這不是最終模型**」的說明**。

This Hugging Face Space **is a demonstration application for vehicle claim fraud detection**, described verbatim as covering insurance fraud detection, risk scoring and claim analysis. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that run, and of the several states a Space can be in.**

**Verified information, all measured from the platform API, the repository files and one real request**: **first, it does not retrain a model at start-up but serves already frozen results.** The module that drives the interface is headed with the words precomputed-results backend and states verbatim that instead of retraining on start-up it loads the team already validated results. **That is the point most worth recording: many demonstrations retrain a model live, so the numbers change on every visit, whereas this one freezes the validated set — the finalised model, its real risk tiers, its real explanation drivers and the generated briefs the team scored — and serves that instead.** **Second, it states why, and the reason names a specific failure mode**: the demonstration must show the project real reported results, meaning the finalised gradient-boosted model with isotonic calibration at a test precision-recall area of about nineteen percent, its real risk tiers, real explanation drivers and real generated briefs, and **not a fresh model retrained live, which the note says would produce different numbers and could silently run on synthetic fallback data.** **That parenthetical is the sentence to copy: retraining live not only yields different numbers but can quietly fall back to synthetic data without anyone noticing, which is exactly the difference between a demonstration that looks like it is running and one that is running the real thing.** **Third, of forty-six investigation briefs two failed the human rubric and those two are shown with their real scores rather than hidden**, the data file repeating the same fact that all forty-six samples span the three risk tiers, that forty-four of forty-six passed human rubric review at a mean of seven point eight three out of eight, and that these are real validated results. **That is the teaching core of this entry: a demonstration that keeps the two samples that failed and labels their real scores, instead of presenting only the forty-four that passed, which is a concrete answer to the question of whether failures belong in a published result.** **Fourth, the metrics are complete and include both the floor and the gaps.** The test set holds two thousand three hundred and thirteen claims at a fraud rate of about six percent; the no-skill baseline for the precision-recall area is about six percent as well; the model reaches a precision-recall area of about nineteen percent, recall of about twenty-nine percent, precision of about twenty-three percent, a macro F1 of about sixty percent, a Matthews correlation of about twenty percent, a ROC area of about eighty-three percent and a Brier score of about five percent. **The operating threshold is stated as a single number, with the confusion matrix giving forty true positives, one hundred and thirty-six false positives, ninety-eight false negatives and two thousand and thirty-nine true negatives, and with the share of claims routed to review stated as about seven and a half percent. The risk tiers each report their own case volume and real fraud rate, the calibration method is named as isotonic, and the gap between the validation and test splits is given as well.** **Together those numbers answer both how busy the team will be and how much fraud each tier actually contains, rather than reporting a single ROC area.** **Fifth, a cross-year robustness check is included with its own disclaimer**: the same recipe retrained from scratch on two years of data and evaluated once on the following year, explicitly marked as not calibrated, not thresholded and not the project final model, with the training and test fraud rates and that check own weaker metrics given alongside. **That is worth recording separately because a reader is thereby prevented from mistaking the weaker one-off result for the performance the project claims.** The model source is named as a gradient-boosted tree with class weighting at a specific tuning trial, with the random seed and generation date also given. **Sixth, four points must be stated plainly**: the readme is the platform template, containing only the configuration reference line, **so everything of substance in this entry comes from the code and the metrics file rather than from author-written documentation**; the subdomain answered two probes differently this round, the first returning a platform page stating that the Space is still preparing and the second returning the real application whose page title names a claim fraud intelligence console, **while its hardware tier is a scale-to-zero GPU tier, so the preparing page was a cold start; this entry records both probes side by side and does not reconcile them**; the repository carries two images bearing the same brand name, a fact this entry records without speculating about which entity that name belongs to; and the provenance and licensing of the training data were not verified beyond the years it spans. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover fraud guarding, fraud risk scoring, a fraud dataset generator, explainable fraud detection, a claims watch ledger and conformal fraud methods, **while this entry supplies an online claim fraud demonstration that serves frozen results and publishes the samples that failed human review. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: serve validated numbers instead of retraining live, because otherwise what you show is not your model; keep the samples that failed the rubric and label their real scores; report the workload a threshold creates and the real hit rate inside each tier, not only a ROC area; and attach the statement that a one-off robustness check is not the final model.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the Space was not started and its interface was not called**, so no claim was submitted and no fraud score was produced, **and no claim is made about whether it works or whether its metrics are reproducible**. **Second, the readme is the platform template, so the description of the project purpose here comes from text inside the code rather than from author-facing documentation, and that is a point readers must check themselves.** **Third, the provenance and licence of the training data were not verified**, only the years spanned and the test set size. **Fourth, the specific items and the graders of the human rubric were not verified. Fifth, which entity the two brand images refer to was not verified, and this entry makes no guess.** **Sixth, on the window: the Space was created late on 2026-09-04 and last modified shortly after midnight on 2026-09-05**, which by the day boundary places it just outside the thaw window, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a demonstration that serves frozen results and publishes the samples that failed human review. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the application is a demonstration, that its risk score is not a finding of fraud and that it must not be used for denial or investigation decisions.**

entries.summary_en: This Hugging Face Space **is a teaching simulation application for actuarial training**, described verbatim in French as a pedagogical application for the 2026 actuarial training of an international labour training centre, simulating a national pension scheme on a status-quo basis and explicitly for teaching purposes only. **Measured this round**: a Docker Space created in June and last modified a day later, whose main application is a two-thousand-line dashboard script nearly a hundred and twenty kilobytes long, with dependencies pinned exactly. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that run, and of the several states a Space can be in.** **Four things are worth reading: it cannot run at present, and the platform states this in two contradictory places, since the runtime interface reports a runtime error while the same response marks the domain as ready; the teaching flow is organised in three stages from data to assumptions to results, and every stage turns why you assumed this into a question for the learner; four reform levers are drawn as a waterfall decomposition starting from an initial gap in percentage points; and answers submitted by learners are written into a companion dataset repository that returns an unauthorised response and is therefore not publicly readable.** **The Space was not started and no answers were submitted this round.**
entries.body:
**CNR Algeria Actuarial Exercise**（Hugging Face Space `itcilo-actuarial/cnr-algeria-exercise`）**是一个**面向精算培训的**教学模拟应用****——**逐字自述（法语）为**「**Application pédagogique pour la formation actuarielle ITC-ILO 2026. Simulation du régime CNR (Algérie) — statu quo, à des fins pédagogiques uniquement.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**能跑的应用：一个 Space 的四种活法**」**。

**引号约定（本条）**：**所引法语原文含 ASCII 撇号**（**如**「**l**」**——**逐字續**「**’emploi**」、「**d**」**——**逐字續**「**’annuité**」、「**d**」**——**逐字續**「**’actualisation**」、「**d**」**——**逐字續**「**’urgence**」**）**，**本站按既有约定一律写作弯撇号 **U+2019****；**原文中的**重音符号与**连接号**亦按原样保留**。

**可核实信息（均 Hugging Face API、仓库文件与一次真实请求实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它此刻**跑不起来**，**而**平台的两处状态**互相矛盾****——**⭐ 本次请求**其域名**返回 **HTTP 503**、**49 字节**，**页面文字逐字为**「**Your space is in error, check its status on hf.co**」**；**⭐ 而**运行接口**返回逐字含**「**"stage":"RUNTIME_ERROR"**」**、**「**"errorMessage":"Scheduling failure: unable to schedule"**」**、**「**"hardware":{"current":null,"requested":"cpu-basic"}**」**、**「**"replicas":{"requested":1}**」**（**⭐ 即**只有**请求的副本数**，**没有**当前副本数**）**、**以及**「**"domains":[{"domain":"itcilo-actuarial-cnr-algeria-exercise.hf.space","stage":"READY"}]**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组字段**是本条最值得记的一处**：**⭐ 即**同一个返回里**「**运行阶段**」是**错误**，**而**「**域名阶段**」是 **`READY`****——**⭐ 故**若只看**后者**，**会以为**这个应用**可用**；**⭐ 而** `hardware.current` **为 **`null`** 与 **`replicas` **没有当前值**这两处**同时**说明**它**当下**没有被调度到任何算力**。**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**本次**无法确定**调度失败的原因**（**⭐ 本词条**不推测**是配额、**资源池还是**配置问题**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 教学流程按三个阶段组织，**而**每一阶段都在问「**你凭什么**」****——**⭐ 本次实测**其问题集共三组**（**⭐ 逐字标题为**）：**① **数据（**`D1`–**`D4`**）**：**「**Données démographiques nécessaires**」**、**「**Données financières de base**」**、**「**Données par type de bénéficiaire**」**、**「**Données manquantes — limites du modèle**」**；**② **假设（**`H1`–**`H5`**）**：**「**Hypothèse de croissance de l**」**——**逐字續**「**’emploi**」**、**「**Taux d**」**——**逐字續**「**’actualisation — sensibilité du GAP**」**、**「**Hypothèse de mortalité — amélioration future**」**、**「**Paramètres du régime — sensibilité**」**、**「**Hypothèse de couverture et économie informelle**」**；**③ **结果（**`R1`–**`R4`**）**：**「**Lecture du taux PAYG**」**、**「**Le GAP actuariel — signification et utilité**」**、**「**Déficit nominal vs déficit structurel**」**等**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组标题**本身就是一份**可抄的教学大纲**：**⭐ 即**数据阶段**专门留了一问**「**缺失的数据与模型的局限**」**，**假设阶段**把**贴现率**与**死亡率改善**分开问**，**结果阶段**要求**区分**名义赤字与**结构性赤字**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 四个改革杠杆被画成一张**瀑布图****——**⭐ 本次实测**其代码里的瀑布标签逐字为**「**Gap initial (4,22 pp)**」**、**「**Âge légal**」**、**「**Cotisation**」**、**「**Taux d**」**——**逐字續**「**’annuité**」**、**「**Couverture formelle**」**、**「**Résiduel**」**——**⭐ 即**把**起点缺口 **4.22 个百分点****，**按**法定退休年龄、**缴费率、**年金率与**正规部门覆盖率**四项**逐项分解**，**最后留一项**残差**；**⭐ 而**界面里的**制度参数**逐字为**「**âge légal 60 ans, taux d**」**——**逐字續**「**’annuité 2,5 %, durée plein 32 ans, taux de cotisation 18,25 %**」**，**并**要求学员**把这四项**按**敏感度排序**；**⭐ 另有**KPI 卡逐字含**「**GAP actuariel (50 ans)**」（**值 **22,47 %**）**、**「**Taux de cotisation : 18,25 %**」与**「**Espérance de vie à 60 ans — engagement financier long terme**」**；**⭐ 还给出**一个**覆盖率情景**逐字为**「**Si la couverture passe de 55 % à 70 % d**」**——**逐字續**「**’ici 2035**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组**是本条**对 RIAA 最有用的部分**：**⭐ 即**它把**「**一份养老金改革建议**」**拆成**四个**可单独调、**可单独归因的**杠杆**，**并**要求**学员**为**每一项**给出**精算理由**。**⭐⭐ ④ 交付物是**一份有四项要求的**备忘****——**本次实测**其最终任务逐字要求**「**une note synthétisant**」**：**「**(1) le diagnostic chiffré**」**、**「**(2) le niveau d**」**——**逐字續**「**’urgence de la réforme**」**、**「**(3) votre recommandation prioritaire avec justification actuarielle**」**、**「**(4) et le principal risque politique ou social à gérer**」**——**⭐ 即**数字诊断、**改革紧迫度、**有精算依据的**优先建议、**以及**主要政治或社会风险**。**⭐ 本词条认为**第 ④ 项**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**要求学员**在**技术结论之外**写出**一个**非技术风险**（**政治或社会**）**——**⭐ 这与本会话多次记下的**「**把假设与结论摆在一起**」**同向**。**⭐⭐ entries.body_en:
This Hugging Face Space **is a teaching simulation application for actuarial training**, described verbatim in French as a pedagogical application for the 2026 actuarial training of an international labour training centre, simulating a national pension scheme on a status-quo basis and explicitly for teaching purposes only. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that run, and of the several states a Space can be in.** **Note on quotation: the French passages quoted here contain ASCII apostrophes, such as those in the words for employment, annuity, discounting and urgency, and this project follows its existing convention of writing them as a typographic apostrophe; accents and hyphens are preserved as in the source.**

**Verified information, all measured from the platform API, the repository files and one real request**: **first, it cannot run at present, and the platform states this in two contradictory places.** The request to its domain returned a service-unavailable status with a forty-nine byte body stating verbatim that the space is in error and to check its status on the platform, **while the runtime interface returned a body naming a runtime-error stage, a scheduling failure as the error message, a null current hardware value against a requested basic CPU tier, a replica count carrying only a requested value and no current value, and a domain entry whose own stage is marked ready**. **That set of fields is the most valuable record in this entry: within one response the runtime stage is an error while the domain stage is ready, so a reader consulting only the latter would conclude the application is available, while the null hardware value and the absent current replica count together indicate that no compute has been allocated to it at all.** **This entry states plainly that the cause of the scheduling failure could not be determined and does not speculate whether it is a quota, a capacity or a configuration matter.** **Second, the teaching flow is organised in three stages and every stage asks why the learner assumed what they assumed.** The question sets are grouped as data, assumptions and results. The data group asks for necessary demographic data, basic financial data, data broken down by beneficiary type, and **a fourth question about missing data and the limits of the model**. The assumption group asks about employment growth, **the discount rate and the sensitivity of the gap**, **future mortality improvement**, the sensitivity of scheme parameters, and **coverage together with the informal economy**. The results group asks about reading the pay-as-you-go ratio, **the meaning and usefulness of the actuarial gap**, and **nominal against structural deficit**. **That set of headings is itself a transferable syllabus: the data stage devotes one question specifically to missing data and model limits, the assumption stage separates discounting from mortality improvement, and the results stage requires the learner to distinguish a nominal deficit from a structural one.** **Third, four reform levers are drawn as a waterfall** whose labels name an initial gap of four point two two percentage points, the statutory retirement age, the contribution rate, the annuity rate and formal-sector coverage, followed by a residual item. The scheme parameters quoted in the interface give a legal retirement age of sixty, an annuity rate of two and a half percent, a full-service period of thirty-two years and a contribution rate of eighteen and a quarter percent, and learners are asked to rank those four parameters; further cards name an actuarial gap over fifty years at just under twenty-three percent, the contribution rate again, and life expectancy at sixty as a long-term financial commitment; and a coverage scenario asks what happens if coverage rises from fifty-five to seventy percent by 2035. **Together those turn a pension reform recommendation into four levers that can be adjusted and attributed separately, each of which the learner must justify actuarially.** **Fourth, the deliverable is a memorandum with four requirements**: a quantified diagnosis, the urgency of reform, a priority recommendation with actuarial justification, and the main political or social risk to be managed. **The last requirement is the one worth recording, because it asks the learner to state a non-technical risk alongside the technical conclusion.** **Fifth, learner answers are written into a dataset repository that could not be read this round**: the application contains a constant naming a companion responses repository and a function that writes participant answers as a CSV file, using the platform client library and a token environment variable, and **that dataset repository returned an unauthorised response, meaning it is not publicly readable**. **This entry records the structure and states plainly that it does not judge whether the data handling is appropriate.** **Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover pension microsimulation, a pension observatory, a Spanish pension model, a German pension gap calculator and a pension data interface, **while this entry supplies a teaching pension reform simulator published by an international training body that currently cannot be scheduled, and whose runtime and domain stages disagree within a single platform response. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: split a teaching flow into data, assumptions and results, and require the limits to be stated at the data stage; make a reform proposal decomposable into attributable levers and draw it as a waterfall; require one non-technical risk alongside the conclusion; and when reading platform status, read the runtime stage rather than only the domain stage.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the application was not started and no answers were submitted**, so no parameters were entered and no projection was generated, **and no claim is made about any model result or the correctness of any number shown in it**. **Second, only repository files and platform interfaces were read**, structure being recorded from file names, byte sizes and heading strings inside the code, **without reading the two thousand one hundred and eighty line application line by line**. **Third, the source of its data was not verified**, only that the interface describes itself as a simulation for teaching use. **Fourth, the relationship between its scheme parameters and the real scheme was not verified**, only the parameter values appearing verbatim in the interface. **Fifth, the visibility setting of the companion dataset repository was not verified beyond the unauthorised response measured here, nor whether it meets any data protection requirement. Sixth, the authorisation relationship between the Space and the training institution was not verified**, only its account name and self-description being recorded. **Seventh, on the window: the Space was created in early June and last modified the next day, both outside the thaw window**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a teaching pension reform simulator published by an international training body whose runtime stage and domain stage contradict each other inside one platform response. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the application describes itself as teaching material, that its output is not an actuarial opinion and that it must not be used for real scheme reform decisions.**

entries.title: **一份**把「**做到哪一步**」写在纸面上**的**保险 AI 承保计划书**：**以**货运险**起步、**把**全量产品 **MCP 化****：Hugging Face Space `binbin888/insurance-ai-plan`——**⭐ 逐字**「**资料核验：2026年9月8日**」**并**「**市场扫描，不宣称穷尽；预算与收益为可调整假设。**」**；**⭐ 逐字**「**不能把文档目录当作交易已上线。**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而**它**还写出**自己抽查代码的结果**：**逐字**「**抽查的车险报价、合同创建使用CSV演示，财务衔接仍需真实系统验证。它们不能直接接管正式核保、出单或费用。**」**；**⚠️ 而**它的形态是**一个 **4.75 MB 的静态单页****（**⭐ 运行接口显示**算力栏位**均为 **`null`****）**
entries.title_en: An insurance AI underwriting proposal that writes down how far the work has actually gone: starting with cargo insurance and turning the whole product catalogue into callable agent tools, with a stated verification date, an explicit refusal to claim the market scan is exhaustive, a rule that a documentation catalogue must not be treated as live transactions, and the author own code inspection finding that the sampled quote and contract paths run on CSV demonstrations and cannot take over real underwriting, issuing or fees.
