entries.summary: **保险公司AI承保与数据经营项目计划**（Hugging Face Space `binbin888/insurance-ai-plan`）**是一份**中文的**保险 AI 承保建设计划书****——**逐字自述为**「**从客户一句需求，到保单与发票交付。**」**，**并**逐字写明**做法是**「**以现有产品MCP化连接业务系统，以AI核保助理整理和上报资料，以渠道AI扩大服务入口。对接千问等大模型入口，客户需求经公司MCP转为可审批、可履约的业务。**」**。**本次实测**：**类型为**静态页面**（**`sdk` 逐字为 **`static`**）**、**创建与**最后修改**同为 **2026-09-09**（**⭐ 在**解冻窗口**内**）**、**仓库只有**四个文件**（**含一个 **4,748,780 字节的 `index.html`**）**、**⭐ 而**运行接口**显示**其**算力栏位**均为 **`null`**（**`hardware.current` 与 **`requested`**）**——**⭐ 即**它是一个**没有运行时**的页面**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**能跑的应用：一个 Space 的四种活法**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **它**逐字写出**核验日期**，**并**逐字声明**「**不宣称穷尽**」**、「**预算与收益为可调整假设**」**；**② **它**逐字写出**一条**很容易被违反的纪律**：「**不能把文档目录当作交易已上线。**」**；**③ **⭐ 它**写出**自己抽查代码后的结论**，**并**逐字指出**被抽查的**车险报价与**合同创建**用的是**CSV 演示**、**不能**接管**正式核保、**出单与**费用**；**④ **⚠️ 而**它的形态**说明**「**能读**」与**「**能跑**」**是两件事**——**⭐ 因为它**没有运行时**。**⚠️ 本次**未提交任何业务动作**。
entries.summary_hk: **保险公司AI承保与数据经营项目计划**（Hugging Face Space `binbin888/insurance-ai-plan`）**是一份**中文的**保險 AI 承保建設計劃書****——**逐字自述為**「**从客户一句需求，到保单与发票交付。**」**，**並**逐字寫明**做法是**「**以现有产品MCP化连接业务系统，以AI核保助理整理和上报资料，以渠道AI扩大服务入口。对接千问等大模型入口，客户需求经公司MCP转为可审批、可履约的业务。**」**。**本次實測**：**類型為靜態頁面**（**`sdk` 逐字為 `static`**）**、**創建與**最後修改**同為 2026-09-09（**在解凍窗口內**）**、**倉庫只有四個檔案**（**含一個 4,748,780 位元組的 `index.html`**）**、**⭐ 而**運行介面**顯示**算力欄位**均為 `null`**——**⭐ 即**它是一個**沒有運行時**的頁面**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**能跑的应用：一個 Space 的四種活法**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **逐字寫出**核驗日期**，**並**逐字聲明**「**不宣称穷尽**」**、「**预算与收益为可调整假设**」**；**② **逐字寫出一條**很容易被違反的紀律**：「**不能把文档目录当作交易已上线。**」**；**③ **⭐ 寫出**自己抽查代碼後的結論**，**並**逐字指出**被抽查的**車險報價與**合同創建**用的是 **CSV 演示**、**不能**接管**正式核保、**出單與**費用**；**④ **⚠️ 而**它的形態說明**「**能讀**」與**「**能跑**」是兩件事**——**⭐ 因為它沒有運行時**。**⚠️ 本次**未提交任何業務動作**。
entries.summary_en: This Hugging Face Space **is a Chinese-language construction plan for AI-enabled underwriting at an insurer**, described verbatim as running from a single customer sentence to the delivery of a policy and an invoice. **Measured this round**: it is a static page rather than an application, created and last modified on the same day in September inside the thaw window, with a repository of four files including a single HTML file of about four and three quarter megabytes, and with its runtime interface reporting null hardware fields, so it has no application runtime at all. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that run, and of the several states a Space can be in.** **Four things are worth reading: it states a verification date and declares in the same breath that the market scan does not claim to be exhaustive and that budgets and benefits are adjustable assumptions; it states a rule that is easy to violate, namely that a documentation catalogue must not be treated as a live transaction capability; it writes down the result of its own code inspection, finding that the sampled motor quote and contract creation paths run on CSV demonstrations and cannot take over real underwriting, issuing or fee processing; and its form shows that being readable and being runnable are two different things, because it has no runtime.** **No business action was submitted this round.**
entries.body:
**保险公司AI承保与数据经营项目计划**（Hugging Face Space `binbin888/insurance-ai-plan`）**是一份**中文的**保险 AI 承保建设计划书****——**逐字自述为**「**从客户一句需求，到保单与发票交付。**」**，**并**逐字写明**做法：**「**以现有产品MCP化连接业务系统，以AI核保助理整理和上报资料，以渠道AI扩大服务入口。对接千问等大模型入口，客户需求经公司MCP转为可审批、可履约的业务。**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**能跑的应用：一个 Space 的四种活法**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Hugging Face API、仓库文件与一次真实请求实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**逐字写出**核验日期，**并**逐字声明**「**不宣称穷尽**」****——**⭐ 本次实测**其首页逐字含**「**资料核验：2026年9月8日**」与**「**市场扫描，不宣称穷尽；预算与收益为可调整假设。**」**，**并**逐字给出**一条**建议决策**：**「**先批准全量产品与接口盘点，以货运险为首款产品，启动一家渠道的完整闭环。按接口与任务清单测算投入，结合报价量、转化率、净贡献与数据经营成效决定逐步扩展。**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这三句**合起来**值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**资料在哪一天核过**」**、「**扫得不全**」**与**「**预算与收益是**假设而非承诺**」**三件事**写在**计划书**最前面**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这正是**任何**内部立项材料**都该有的**三行**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**逐字写出一条很容易被违反的纪律****——**「**已有接口直接封装；缺少接口的环节形成补齐清单，不能把文档目录当作交易已上线。**」**，**并**在同一节**给出**验收口径**：**「**验收：全量可查，交易逐产品可用。**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本条最有价值的一句**：**⭐ 即**它**明确区分**「**目录里查得到**」**与**「**交易真的能走通**」**——**⭐ 而**这两件事**在本会话的记录里**多次**被混为一谈**（**如**登记处里有条目**、**而**端点返回 **404 或**需要授权**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它写出**自己抽查代码后的结论，**并**明确说**不能接管正式业务****——**⭐ 逐字为**「**本地代码检查：Insurance-Skills主要可复用的是流程说明、模板和部分脚本；抽查的车险报价、合同创建使用CSV演示，财务衔接仍需真实系统验证。它们不能直接接管正式核保、出单或费用。先改造适合的技能，再由公司IT接入真实系统。**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一句**在同类材料里**很少见**：**⭐ 即**作者**读了自己打算复用的**技能包**，**并**把**「**哪些是演示、**哪些还没验证**」**写成**结论**（**⭐ 本条**据此**如实指出**：**按该计划自述**，被抽查的**车险报价与**合同创建**用的是 **CSV 演示**）**。**⭐ 而**同一节还**逐字点到**两个**具体工具名**（**「**WORKBUDE、龙虾类工具以实际兼容性测试为准**」**）**，**并**逐字声明**「**两个场景均为演示，不表示已经上线。**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 形态本身说明「**能读**」与**「**能跑**」是两件事****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**`sdk` 逐字为 **`static`**、**仓库只有四个文件**（**`.gitattributes`、**`README.md`、**`index.html`**、**`style.css`**）**、**`index.html` **4,748,780 字节****（**⭐ 本次**抽取其可见文本**约 **3.1 万字符／**1,937 行**）**；**⭐ 而**其域名**本次返回 **HTTP 302**（**逐字**「**Found. Redirecting to /index.html**」**）**，**运行接口**返回逐字含**「**"stage":"RUNNING"**」与**「**"hardware":{"current":null,"requested":null}**」**——**⭐ 即**它**没有算力**（**`current` 与 **`requested` 均为 **`null`**）**，**却**报 `RUNNING`****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**对**静态页面**而言**「**运行中**」**只表示**它的**静态文件在服务**，**而**不表示**有**任何**计算在后**——**⭐ 故**读**平台状态字段**时**必须**同时看**类型与**算力**，**不能只**看 `stage`**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 内容结构（可核对）**：**⭐ 首页逐字列出**八个章节**——**「**01 项目概述**」「**02 建设范围**」「**03 动态场景**」「**04 业务方案**」「**05 数据经营**」「**06 实施分工**」「**07 投入收益**」「**08 验收决策**」**，**并有**「**附录与研究**」**；**⭐ 三项并行任务逐字为**「**01 全量产品MCP化**」「**02 AI核保助理**」「**03 中介渠道接入**」**；**⭐ 一条**业务漏斗**逐字为**「**客户交资料 → AI整理 → 公司审批 → 缴费 → 出单 → 开票与打印**」**，**并**逐字标为**「**12 个业务环节，连续办理**」**；**⭐ 它还逐字给出**「**46 项 公开项目与实践**」**与**首期险种**（**「**货运险 首期落地产品**」**）**；**⭐ 以及一张**复用与**新建的**分层表**（**保险技能／**产品与工具／**流程与交易／**渠道／**数据**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**上述**数字与**章节**均**取自其**自述**，**本次**未逐条核实**其中**任何一项**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurance-skills]] 是同名的**技能包**（**⭐ 而**本计划**逐字说明**自己**打算复用**它的**核保编排、**问卷预审、**补件与**摘要技能**）**；**本站 [[ai-insurance-multiagent-mcp]]、**[[claw-insurance]]、**[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、**[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]] 覆盖**保险 **MCP 与**多智能体接入**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**一份**把**核验日期、**未穷尽声明、**演示与**未验证项**都写在纸面上的**承保 AI 建设计划**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**，**也**未核实**该计划与**池内同名技能包**的任何**关联关系****。**⭐⭐ ⑦ ⚠️ 三处**须如实标注**：**① **它是**计划书**，**不是**可运行系统**（**⭐ 其**运行接口**算力栏位均为 **`null`**）**；**② **其**单页体量 **4.75 MB****（**⭐ 本次**只抽取**可见文本**）**，**故**本条目**不主张**其中的**图表、**动画或**附件**内容**；**③ **本次**未核实**其**阅读权限设置**（**⭐ 只知**未要求登录**即可**取到页面**）**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **立项材料要写**「**资料核验日**」**、「**不宣称穷尽**」**与**「**预算收益是假设**」**；**② **把**「**目录可查**」与**「**交易可走通**」**写成**两个验收项**；**③ **凡**复用别人的技能或工具**，**要**写出**自己抽查后的结论**，**并**说明**它**不能**接管**什么**；**④ **读平台状态**要**把 `stage` 与**算力栏位**一起读**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有在该页面**提交任何业务动作**（**未做任何投保、**核保或**出单**）**，**也**没有**下载**其**所谓研究底稿**；**故**不主张**该计划的**任何数字、**预算或**收益**的**真实性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**页面**（**⭐ 并**从 **4.75 MB 的 HTML 中**抽取**可见文本**）**、**文件清单与**平台接口**——**⭐ 故**「**它写了什么**」**来自**其**自述文本**，**不是**来自**任何独立核实**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**声称的 **46 项**公开项目与实践**、**12 个业务环节**与**任何**机构名称**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**文中提到的**两个第三方工具**（**逐字为**「**WORKBUDE**」与**「**龙虾类工具**」**）**是否存在、**是否**与保险相关**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**该计划**与**任何保险公司**的**关系**（**⭐ 本词条**只按**其自述**记录**）。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与池内同名技能包**的任何**关联**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该页面**创建与**最后修改**同为 **2026-09-09**（**⭐ 在**解冻窗口**之内**）**——**⭐ 而**本条**仍以**「**形态缺口**」**记之**：**本条的缺口是**「**一份**把**核验日期、**未穷尽声明与**演示边界**写在**纸面上的**承保 AI 建设计划**，**且**其载体是**一个**没有运行时的**静态单页**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该页面**是**计划与演示材料**，**其内容**不构成**任何**产品承诺**、**费率或**承保意见**。

**保险公司AI承保与数据经营项目计划**（Hugging Face Space `binbin888/insurance-ai-plan`）**是一份**中文的**保險 AI 承保建設計劃書****——**逐字自述為**「**从客户一句需求，到保单与发票交付。**」**，**並**逐字寫明**做法：**「**以现有产品MCP化连接业务系统，以AI核保助理整理和上报资料，以渠道AI扩大服务入口。对接千问等大模型入口，客户需求经公司MCP转为可审批、可履约的业务。**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**能跑的应用：一個 Space 的四種活法**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Hugging Face API、倉庫檔案與一次真實請求實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它逐字寫出核驗日期，並逐字聲明「不宣称穷尽」****——**⭐ 本次實測**其首頁逐字含**「**资料核验：2026年9月8日**」與**「**市场扫描，不宣称穷尽；预算与收益为可调整假设。**」**，**並**逐字給出一條建議決策**：**「**先批准全量产品与接口盘点，以货运险为首款产品，启动一家渠道的完整闭环。按接口与任务清单测算投入，结合报价量、转化率、净贡献与数据经营成效决定逐步扩展。**」**。**⭐ 這三句合起來值得記**：**⭐ 即**它把**「**資料在哪一天核過**」**、「**掃得不全**」**與**「**預算與收益是假設而非承諾**」**寫在計劃書最前面**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字寫出一條很容易被違反的紀律**——**「**已有接口直接封装；缺少接口的环节形成补齐清单，不能把文档目录当作交易已上线。**」**，**並**給出驗收口徑**：**「**验收：全量可查，交易逐产品可用。**」**；**⭐ 這明確區分**「**目錄裡查得到**」**與**「**交易真的能走通**」**——**⭐ 而**這兩件事在本會話的記錄裡**多次被混為一談**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它寫出自己抽查代碼後的結論，並明確說不能接管正式業務****——**⭐ 逐字為**「**本地代码检查：Insurance-Skills主要可复用的是流程说明、模板和部分脚本；抽查的车险报价、合同创建使用CSV演示，财务衔接仍需真实系统验证。它们不能直接接管正式核保、出单或费用。先改造适合的技能，再由公司IT接入真实系统。**」**。**⭐ 這在同類材料裡很少見**：**⭐ 即**作者讀了自己打算複用的技能包**，**並**把**「**哪些是演示、**哪些還沒驗證**」**寫成結論**；**⭐ 同節還逐字點到兩個具體工具名**（**「**WORKBUDE、龙虾类工具以实际兼容性测试为准**」**）**，**並**逐字聲明**「**两个场景均为演示，不表示已经上线。**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 形態本身說明「能讀」與「能跑」是兩件事****——**⭐ 本次實測**：**`sdk` 逐字為 `static`**、**倉庫只有四個檔案**（**`.gitattributes`、`README.md`、`index.html`、`style.css`**）**、**`index.html` 4,748,780 位元組****（**可見文本約 3.1 萬字符／1,937 行**）**；**⭐ 而**其域名**本次返回 HTTP 302**（**逐字**「**Found. Redirecting to /index.html**」**）**，**運行介面**返回逐字含**「**"stage":"RUNNING"**」與**「**"hardware":{"current":null,"requested":null}**」**——**⭐ 即**它沒有算力**，**卻報 `RUNNING`****。**⭐ 對靜態頁面而言**「**運行中**」**只表示**靜態檔案在服務**，**不表示**有任何計算在後**——**⭐ 故**讀平台狀態時**必須**同時看**類型與**算力**，**不能只看 `stage`**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 內容結構（可核對）**：**八個章節逐字為**「**01 项目概述**」「**02 建设范围**」「**03 动态场景**」「**04 业务方案**」「**05 数据经营**」「**06 实施分工**」「**07 投入收益**」「**08 验收决策**」**，**並有**「**附录与研究**」**；**三項並行任務**為**「**01 全量产品MCP化**」「**02 AI核保助理**」「**03 中介渠道接入**」**；**業務漏斗逐字為**「**客户交资料 → AI整理 → 公司审批 → 缴费 → 出单 → 开票与打印**」**，**標為**「**12 个业务环节，连续办理**」**；**並逐字給出**「**46 项 公开项目与实践**」與首期險種**（**「**货运险 首期落地产品**」**）**；**以及一張**複用與**新建的分層表**（**保险技能／**产品与工具／**流程与交易／**渠道／**数据**）**——**⭐ 如實標註**：**上述數字與章節均取自其自述**，**本次未逐條核實其中任何一項**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insurance-skills]] 是同名的**技能包**（**⭐ 本計劃逐字說明**自己打算複用它的**核保編排、**問卷預審、**補件與**摘要技能**）**；[[ai-insurance-multiagent-mcp]]、[[claw-insurance]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**一份把核驗日期、**未窮盡聲明與**演示邊界都寫在紙面上的承保 AI 建設計劃**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較**，**也未核實**該計劃與池內同名技能包的任何關聯**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ ⚠️ 三處須如實標註**：**① **它是計劃書**，**不是**可運行系統**（**算力欄位均為 `null`**）**；**② **單頁體量 4.75 MB****（**本次只抽取可見文本**）**；**③ **未核實**其閱讀權限設置**（**只知**未要求登錄即可取到頁面**）**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **立項材料要寫**「**資料核驗日**」**、「**不宣稱窮盡**」**與**「**預算是假設**」**；**② **把**「**目錄可查**」與**「**交易可走通**」**寫成兩個驗收項**；**③ **複用別人的技能或工具時**，**要寫出自己抽查後的結論**，**並說明它不能接管什麼**；**④ **讀平台狀態**要把 `stage` 與算力欄位一起讀**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有在該頁面提交任何業務動作**，**也**沒有下載**其**所謂研究底稿**，**不主張**其任何數字、**預算或**收益的真實性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀頁面**（**並從 4.75 MB 的 HTML 中抽取可見文本**）**、**檔案清單與**平台介面**——**故**「**它寫了什麼**」**來自其自述文本**，**不是**來自任何獨立核實**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其聲稱的 46 項公開項目、**12 個業務環節與**任何機構名稱**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**文中提到的兩個第三方工具**（**「**WORKBUDE**」與**「**龙虾类工具**」**）是否存在或與保險相關**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**該計劃與**任何保險公司**的關係**（**只按其自述記錄**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**其與池內同名技能包的任何關聯**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**創建與最後修改同為 2026-09-09（**在窗口之內**）**——**⭐ 本條仍以「**形態缺口**」記之**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該頁面是計劃與演示材料**，**其內容**不構成**任何產品承諾、**費率或**承保意見**。
entries.body_en:
This Hugging Face Space **is a Chinese-language construction plan for AI-enabled underwriting at an insurer**, described verbatim as running from a single customer sentence to the delivery of a policy and an invoice, with the method stated as connecting existing product systems through callable agent tools, using an underwriting assistant to organise and submit materials, and opening a service entrance for intermediaries, so that customer requests become reviewable and deliverable business. **This entry belongs to the round theme of applications that run, and of the several states a Space can be in.**

**Verified information, all measured from the platform API, the repository files and one real request**: **first, it states its verification date and declares that the scan does not claim to be exhaustive**, the page giving a specific date for source checking, stating in the same sentence that the market scan is not exhaustive and that budgets and benefits are adjustable assumptions, and recommending a decision that begins with a full inventory of products and interfaces, takes one cargo line as the first product, closes one complete channel loop, and decides on expansion later using quote volume, conversion, net contribution and data performance. **Those three sentences are worth recording together: the date on which sources were checked, the admission that the scan is incomplete, and the statement that budgets and benefits are assumptions rather than commitments.** **Second, it states a rule that is easy to violate and then gives a matching acceptance test**: existing interfaces are to be wrapped directly, missing ones are to become a completion list, **and a documentation catalogue must not be treated as a live transaction capability**, with acceptance defined as everything being queryable while transactions become available product by product. **That distinction — between what a catalogue can show and what a transaction can actually complete — is the most valuable sentence in this entry, because this session has repeatedly recorded the two being conflated, with registries containing entries whose endpoints return errors or demand authorisation.** **Third, it writes down the result of its own code inspection and says plainly what the inspected code cannot do**: the note states that what can be reused from the referenced skill package is mostly process descriptions, templates and some scripts, that **the sampled motor quote and contract creation paths use CSV demonstrations** and that the accounting links still need verification against real systems, so they cannot take over formal underwriting, policy issuing or fee processing, and that suitable skills should be adapted first before the company information technology function connects them to real systems. **That is rare in material of this kind: the author read the package being proposed for reuse and wrote down which parts are demonstrations and which remain unverified.** The same section also names two third-party tools verbatim and states that their compatibility must be established by actual testing, and it declares that both illustrated scenarios are demonstrations and do not indicate that anything is live. **Fourth, the form itself shows that being readable and being runnable are two different things**: the Space is a static page rather than an application, its repository holds four files including one HTML document of about four and three quarter megabytes, of which roughly thirty-one thousand characters of visible text and one thousand nine hundred lines were extracted here, **and while its domain returned a redirect to the index file, the runtime interface reported a running stage alongside null hardware values for both current and requested capacity, meaning there is no compute behind it at all**. **For a static page, running means only that its files are being served, not that any computation stands behind it, so platform status must be read together with the Space type and the hardware fields rather than by the stage alone.** **Fifth, the content structure is checkable**: the page lists eight sections covering the project overview, the construction scope, dynamic scenarios, the business solution, data operations, division of implementation work, investment and return, and acceptance decisions, plus an appendix; three parallel workstreams turning the whole catalogue into callable tools, building the underwriting assistant, and connecting intermediaries; a funnel running from customer materials through AI organisation, company approval, payment, policy issuing and finally invoicing and printing, labelled as twelve consecutive business steps; a claim of forty-six public projects and practices with cargo insurance as the first product; and a layered table separating what can be reused from what must be built across skills, products and tools, processes and transactions, channels, and data. **This entry states plainly that all of those numbers and sections come from the document own account and that none of them was verified item by item.** **Sixth, relative to existing entries**: a pooled entry carries the same name as the skill package this plan proposes to reuse and describes it as containing underwriting orchestration, questionnaire pre-screening, document completion and summary skills, while other pooled entries cover agent integration for insurance; **this entry supplies a construction plan that puts its verification date, its incompleteness and its demonstration boundaries on paper, carried on a static page with no runtime. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them and does not verify any relationship between the plan and the similarly named pooled skill package.** **Seventh, three points must be stated plainly**: this is a plan rather than a running system, since its hardware fields are null; the single page is about four and three quarter megabytes and only its visible text was extracted here, so nothing is asserted about any charts, animations or attachments it may contain; and whether the page carries any access restriction was not verified beyond the fact that it could be fetched without signing in.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: put the source verification date, the refusal to claim completeness and the assumption status of budgets into the opening of any proposal; separate a catalogue being queryable from a transaction being completable as two distinct acceptance criteria; when reusing someone else skills or tools, write down your own inspection findings and state what they cannot take over; and read a platform stage together with its hardware fields.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no business action was submitted on this page**, no application, underwriting or policy issuing was performed, and the research appendix it offers was not downloaded, **so nothing is asserted about the truth of any number, budget or benefit it states**. **Second, only the page, the file list and the platform interfaces were read**, with visible text extracted from the large HTML document, **so what it says comes from its own text rather than from any independent verification**. **Third, the claimed forty-six public projects and practices, the twelve business steps and any institution names were not verified. Fourth, whether the two third-party tools it names exist or are insurance-related was not verified. Fifth, any relationship between this plan and an insurer was not verified**, only its own account being recorded. **Sixth, any relationship to the similarly named pooled skill package was not verified. Seventh, on the window: the page was created and last modified on the same day in September, inside the thaw window, yet this entry still records it as a gap in form**, namely **a construction plan for AI-enabled underwriting that puts its verification date, its incompleteness and its demonstration boundaries on paper while living on a static page with no runtime. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the page is planning and demonstration material whose contents constitute no product commitment, rate or underwriting opinion.**

entries.title: **一个**零依赖的 Go 精算引擎**，**README 标题自称**「**不会让你难受**」**：`lubasinkal/v-star`——**⭐ 逐字**「**# v-star: The Actuarial Engine That Doesn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t Suck**」**；**⭐ 名字来自课堂上的一句玩笑**（**逐字**「**if premiums compound at rate j but you**」**——**逐字續**「**’re discounting at i, the new discount factor is v* = (1+j) × v**」**）**；**⭐ 它在**一台笔记本 CPU** 上**逐项给出**基准**（**CSV **1,000 万行** **0.80 秒**；**现值 **2.6 纳秒／次**；**蒙特卡洛 **10 万条路径 **27 毫秒**）**；**⭐ 而**仓库里**还有**一个 **Zig 子目录**（**11 个文件**）与**给 AI 代理的 **`AGENTS.md`****；**⚠️ 而**它**最后推送 **2026-07-30****
entries.title_en: A zero-dependency actuarial engine in Go whose readme titles itself the actuarial engine that does not suck, whose name comes from a classroom joke about a modified discount factor, which publishes per-item benchmarks on a laptop processor, and which ships both a Zig subdirectory and an instruction file for AI coding agents.
entries.title_hk: **一個**零依賴的 Go 精算引擎**，**README 標題自稱**「**不會讓你難受**」**：`lubasinkal/v-star`——**⭐ 逐字**「**# v-star: The Actuarial Engine That Doesn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t Suck**」**；**⭐ 名字來自課堂上的一句玩笑**（**逐字**「**if premiums compound at rate j but you**」**——**逐字續**「**’re discounting at i, the new discount factor is v* = (1+j) × v**」**）**；**⭐ 它在一台筆記本 CPU 上**逐項給出**基準**（**CSV 1,000 萬行 0.80 秒**；**現值 2.6 納秒／次**；**蒙特卡洛 10 萬條路徑 27 毫秒**）**；**⭐ 而**倉庫裡**還有一個 Zig 子目錄（11 個檔案）**與**給 AI 代理的 `AGENTS.md`****；**⚠️ 最後推送 2026-07-30****
entries.summary: **v-star**（仓库 `lubasinkal/v-star`）**是一个**用 Go 写的**零依赖精算引擎****——**逐字自述为**「**# v-star: The Actuarial Engine That Doesn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t Suck**」**，**并**逐字开场**「**Your calculations just got millions of times faster.**」**。**本次实测**：**许可 **MIT****、**语言 **Go****、**创建 **2026-03-17**、**最后推送 **2026-07-30**、**★2**、**仓库约 **14.5 MB****、**版本文档最新一条为 **0.9.0**（**2026-05-29**）**、**共 **103 个文件／**23 个 Go 测试文件****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一种语言的同题材实现，**以及**仓库里那份给 AI 代理的文件**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **⭐ 名字的来历被写明**（**逐字**「**if premiums compound at rate j but you**」**——**逐字續**「**’re discounting at i, the new discount factor is v* = (1+j) × v**」**）**；**② **它**在一台**具体型号的笔记本 CPU** 上**逐项列出**基准**，**并**与 **Polars／**Pandas** 对比**；**③ **能力表**把每一项**翻成**「**对你意味着什么**」**（**⭐ 含**现值、**年金、**准备金、**蒙特卡洛（**GBM 与**Vasicek）、**风险度量（**VaR／**CTE／**期望短缺）、**多重减因、**大 CSV 流式与**HTTP 接口**）**；**④ **⭐ 而**仓库里**除了 **Go 代码**，**还有**一个 **Zig 子目录**（11 个文件）**与**一份 **`AGENTS.md`****。**⚠️ 本次**未安装、**未运行**（**未做任何精算计算**）**。
entries.summary_hk: **v-star**（倉庫 `lubasinkal/v-star`）**是一個**用 Go 寫的**零依賴精算引擎****——**逐字自述為**「**# v-star: The Actuarial Engine That Doesn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t Suck**」**，**並**逐字開場**「**Your calculations just got millions of times faster.**」**。**本次實測**：**許可 MIT**、**語言 Go**、**創建 2026-03-17**、**最後推送 2026-07-30**、**★2**、**倉庫約 14.5 MB****、**版本文檔最新一條為 **0.9.0**（**2026-05-29**）**、**共 103 個檔案／**23 個 Go 測試檔案****。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一種語言的同題材實現，**以及**倉庫裡那份給 AI 代理的檔案**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **⭐ 名字的來歷被寫明**（**逐字**「**if premiums compound at rate j but you**」**——**逐字續**「**’re discounting at i, the new discount factor is v* = (1+j) × v**」**）**；**② **它在一台**具體型號的筆記本 CPU** 上**逐項列出**基準**，**並**與 Polars／**Pandas** 對比**；**③ **能力表**把每一項**翻成**「**對你意味著什麼**」**；**④ **⭐ 而**倉庫裡**除了 Go 代碼**，**還有一個 Zig 子目錄（11 個檔案）**與**一份 `AGENTS.md`****。**⚠️ 本次**未安裝、**未運行**。
entries.summary_en: This repository **is a zero-dependency actuarial engine written in Go**, whose readme titles itself the actuarial engine that does not suck and opens by claiming that the reader calculations just got millions of times faster. **Measured this round**: MIT licensed, created in March and last pushed at the end of July, two stars, a repository of about fourteen and a half megabytes, a changelog whose latest entry is version 0.9.0 from late May, and a hundred and three files including twenty-three Go test files. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the same subject implemented in another language, together with the instruction file for AI coding agents that such repositories now ship.** **Four things are worth reading: the name origin is written out, coming from a classroom joke in which premiums compound at one rate while discounting happens at another, giving a modified discount factor; the readme publishes per-item benchmarks on a named laptop processor and compares them against two widely used dataframe tools; the capability table translates every feature into what it means for the reader, covering present values, annuities, reserves, Monte Carlo simulation with two rate models, risk measures, multiple decrements, large CSV streaming and an HTTP interface; and the repository contains not only Go code but also a Zig subdirectory of eleven files and an instruction file for AI coding agents.** **The project was not installed and not run this round, so no actuarial calculation was performed.**
entries.body:
**v-star**（仓库 `lubasinkal/v-star`）**是一个**用 Go 写的**零依赖精算引擎****——**逐字自述为**「**# v-star: The Actuarial Engine That Doesn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t Suck**」**，**并**逐字开场**「**Your calculations just got millions of times faster.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一种语言的同题材实现，**以及**仓库里那份给 AI 代理的文件**」**。

**引号约定（本条）**：**所引英文原文含 ASCII 撇号**（**如**「**Doesn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t**」、「**you**」**——**逐字續**「**’re**」、「**Who**」**——**逐字續**「**’s**」**）**，**本站按既有约定一律写作弯撇号 **U+2019****。

**可核实信息（均仓库元数据与仓库内文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 名字的来历被写明，**而**它来自一句课堂玩笑****——**逐字为**「**Why the name? Comes from a joke in class: if premiums compound at rate **j** but you**」**——**逐字續**「**’re discounting at **i**, the new discount factor is **v\*** = (1+j) × v. The star marks the difference.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**一个**工具的命名**可以**直接把**它**要处理的**那个技术细节**（**在这里是**「**复利与**折现**用两个不同利率**时**那个**修正折现因子**」**）**写在说明里**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**比一个**只有品牌感的**名字**更容易被**后来者**理解与**检验**。**⭐⭐ ② 能力表把每一项翻成「**对你意味着什么**」****——**⭐ 逐字列出的能力含**：**现值（**标准折现因子与 **v\* 折现因子）**、**年金（**终身、**定期、**递延，**并用**真实的**生命表）**、**准备金（**净保费、**毛保费、**前瞻法、**追溯法）**、**蒙特卡洛（**几何布朗运动与 **Vasicek 均值回复；**逐字**「**100k paths in ~27ms**」**）**、**风险度量（**VaR、**CTE、**期望短缺与**置信区间）**、**多重减因（**把死亡、**退保与**失能合成一张表）**、**大 CSV 流式（**逐字**「**Stream millions of rows without blowing up your RAM**」**）**、**HTTP 接口（**逐字**「**Call from Python, R, Excel via REST endpoints**」**）以及**零依赖（**逐字**「**Standard library only. No pip, no npm, no version hell**」**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**最后一条最值得注意**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**不用装任何包**」**当成**一条产品特性**来卖**——**⭐ 对**受管制环境**里的**部署与**审计**而言**，**这一条的**分量**可能**比性能更大**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 基准是在一台**具体型号的笔记本**上逐项给出的，**并**与两个**通用工具**对比****——**⭐ 逐字**说明测试机为 **Intel i5-8250U**（**1.6–3.4 GHz、**8 核、**NVMe SSD，**并**逐字注明**「**Plugged in**」**）**；**⭐ 逐项基准含**：**CSV 解析 **1,000 万行／**288 MB** 用 **0.80 秒**（**逐字**「**12.6M rows/s**」**）**、**单次现值**直接调用 **2.6 纳秒**（**逐字**「**380M / second**」**）**、**终身年金（**90 期）** **512 纳秒**、**蒙特卡洛 **10 万条路径 × **10 步 **27 毫秒**、**风险报告（**VaR ＋ **CTE，**10 万笔损失）** **0.42 毫秒**、**以及**并行估值 **1,000 万张保单 **37 毫秒****；**⭐ 并**另给**两张对比表**（**CSV：**逐字列出 **Polars **约 **535 毫秒／**约 **500 MB** 与 **Pandas **约 **30 秒／**超过 **2 GB****；**蒙特卡洛：**逐字列出 **Python/Numpy **约 **2 秒** 与 **R **约 **5 秒****）**。**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**上述数字**全部取自**其自述**，**本次**未复现**任何一项**；**⭐ 而**它**同时写明**内存口径**（**逐字**「**The mmap path uses OS page cache (lazily paged, released to OS under memory pressure). The streaming path keeps memory constant regardless of file size.**」**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一句**值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**没有**只报一个**好看的时间**，**而**说明了**这个时间**是用**操作系统的页缓存**换来的**、**以及**另一条**流式路径**的内存**恒定**。**⭐⭐ ④ 仓库里**除了 Go 代码，**还有**一个 **Zig 子目录**与**一份 **`AGENTS.md`****——**⭐ 本次实测**共 **103 个文件**，**其中**按目录计**最大者**为 **`pkg/reader`（**14**）**、**⭐ 其次为 **`zig/src`（**11**）**、**`pkg/server`（**9**）**、**`pkg/writer`（**7**）**、**`cmd/v-star`（**6**）**、**`pkg/stochastic`（**6**）**、**`pkg/mortality`（**5**）**、**`pkg/rates`（**5**）**、**`pkg/annuities`／**`pkg/concurrency`／**`pkg/reserves`（**各 **3**）**；**⭐ **23 个 Go 测试文件****；**⭐ 文档**含 **README **12,650 字节****、**`docs/DESIGN.md` **18,484 字节****、**`CHANGELOG.md` **2,456 字节****、**`ROADMAP.md` **3,743 字节****、**`CONTRIBUTING.md` **1,943 字节****、**以及 **`docs/adr/API_FREEZE_AUDIT.md` **2,738 字节****。**⭐ 而 **`AGENTS.md`（**764 字节**）逐字为**：**「**Zero-dependency actuarial engine. Go 1.26.1, stdlib only.**」**，**并**逐字给出三条约定**：**「**Go stdlib only. `go fmt` before commits. Table-driven tests, `1e-9` float tolerance.**」**，**以及**一节 **Graphify**（**逐字**「**Knowledge graph at `graphify-out/`. Invoke with `skill: "graphify"`. After code edits: `graphify update .` (AST-only, no API cost).**」**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这份 764 字节的文件**说明了三件事**：**⭐ 即**语言与**依赖边界**（**只用**标准库）**、**数值**容差**（**`1e-9`**）**、**以及**代码改动后**要更新**一张**知识图**（**且**逐字说明**只做 **AST、**不产生** API 费用**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ ⚠️ 两处**内部不一致，**如实记录**：**① **README 的 **「**What**」**——**逐字續**「**’s Coming Next?**」**一节仍把 **v0.8.0** 列为**将来**，**而**`CHANGELOG.md` 显示 **0.8.0** 已于 **2026-05-27** 发布、**0.9.0** 于 **2026-05-29** 发布**——**⭐ 即**README 的路线图**落后于**变更日志**；**② **该节**同时**把 **v1.0.0** 的目标写成**「**Stable API, 90%+ test coverage**」**——**⭐ 即**作者**自述**测试覆盖率**尚未**达到 **90%****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[basic-term-model-rust]] 是**另一种语言的**同类实现**（**Rust**）**、**[[actuarial-ts]] 是 **TypeScript 实现**、**[[financecore-jl]] 是 **Julia 实现**、**[[lifelib-products]] 与**[[actuarialmath]]、**[[actuarialpy]] 覆盖**精算模型库**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**零依赖的 **Go 精算引擎**，**且**把**基准、**内存口径与**命名来由**一并写在说明里**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **名字**要能**解释自己**（**⭐ 本条用**一个**折现因子**解释了**名字**）**；**② **性能**要给出**测试机型号**、**对比对象**与**内存口径**，**而不是**只报一个**倍数**；**③ **零依赖**在**受管制环境**里**本身**就是一项**特性**；**④ **给 AI 代理的说明文件**要**写明**三件事**：**依赖边界、**数值容差、**改完代码后**要做什么**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有运行**该引擎**（**未做任何**现值、**年金、**准备金或**蒙特卡洛计算**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何基准数字**、**不主张**其**计算结果正确**、**也不主张**其**任何公式**符合**任何精算标准**。**② ⚠️ **`AGENTS.md` 的内容**本次**只读了开头**（**⭐ 全文 **764 字节**，**本次**读到约定与 **Graphify 两节**）**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其 **Zig 子目录**的**用途与完成度**（**⭐ 本词条**不推测**其**与 Go 主程序**的关系**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其测试覆盖率**（**⭐ 只知**作者**自述**目标为 **90% 以上**，**即**当前**低于该值**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**生命表来源与**许可**（**⭐ README 只提到**使用**真实生命表**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**其 **HTTP 接口**是否**默认**需要**鉴权**（**⭐ README 给出的是**本地 **`localhost:8080` 示例**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该仓库**创建于 **2026-03-17**、**最后推送 **2026-07-30**（**均在**解冻窗口之外**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**零依赖的 **Go 精算引擎**，**并**把**命名来由、**基准口径与**给 AI 代理的约定**写在明处**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该引擎**是**开源工具**，**不是**任何持牌精算意见**，**其输出**用于**正式评估前**必须**由使用者**独立验证**。

Invoke with `skill: "graphify"`. After code edits: `graphify update .` (AST-only, no API cost).**）**。**⭐ 這份 764 位元組的檔案說明了三件事**：**語言與依賴邊界**、**數值容差 `1e-9`**、**以及改完代碼後要更新一張知識圖**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ ⚠️ 兩處內部不一致**：**① README 的 What**」**——**逐字續**「**’s Coming Next?**」一節仍把 v0.8.0 列為將來**，**而 `CHANGELOG.md` 顯示 0.8.0 已於 2026-05-27 發布、**0.9.0 於 2026-05-29 發布**——**⭐ 即**路線圖落後於變更日誌**；**② 該節把 v1.0.0 目標寫成 Stable API, 90%+ test coverage**——**⭐ 即**自述測試覆蓋率**尚未**達到 90%**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[basic-term-model-rust]]（**Rust**）、[[actuarial-ts]]（**TypeScript**）、[[financecore-jl]]（**Julia**）、[[lifelib-products]]、[[actuarialmath]]、[[actuarialpy]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**零依賴的 Go 精算引擎，**且把基準、**內存口徑與命名來由一併寫在說明裡**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

entries.body_en:
This repository **is a zero-dependency actuarial engine written in Go**, whose readme titles itself the actuarial engine that does not suck and opens by claiming that the reader calculations just got millions of times faster. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the same subject implemented in another language, together with the instruction file for AI coding agents that such repositories now ship.**

**Note on quotation: the English passages quoted here contain ASCII apostrophes, such as those in the contraction in the title, the contraction in the phrase about discounting, and the possessive in the roadmap heading, and this project follows its existing convention of writing them as a typographic apostrophe.**

**Verified information, all measured from repository metadata and the files inside the repository**: **first, the name origin is written out, and it comes from a classroom joke.** The readme explains that if premiums compound at one rate while discounting happens at another, the new discount factor becomes the product of one plus the compounding rate and the ordinary discount factor, and that the star marks the difference. **A tool name that explains the technical detail it exists to handle is easier for later readers to understand and check than a name that carries only branding.** **Second, the capability table translates each feature into what it means for the reader.** The listed capabilities are present values with standard and modified discount factors; annuities of whole life, term and deferred kinds using real mortality tables; reserves under net premium, gross premium, prospective and retrospective methods; Monte Carlo simulation with geometric Brownian motion and a mean-reverting rate model, quoted at a hundred thousand paths in about twenty-seven milliseconds; risk measures including value at risk, conditional tail expectation, expected shortfall and confidence intervals; multiple decrements combining death, lapse and disability into one table; streaming of very large CSV files without exhausting memory; an HTTP interface callable from other languages; and zero dependencies, described as standard library only with no package managers and no version conflicts. **That last item is the most notable: the absence of dependencies is sold as a product feature, and in a regulated environment its weight may exceed that of performance.** **Third, benchmarks are given item by item on a named laptop processor and compared with two general-purpose tools.** The readme names the test machine and notes that it was plugged in, then reports ten million CSV rows of two hundred and eighty-eight megabytes parsed in eight tenths of a second, a single present value call at two point six nanoseconds when called directly, a whole-life annuity over ninety terms in five hundred and twelve nanoseconds, a hundred thousand Monte Carlo paths over ten steps in twenty-seven milliseconds, a risk report over a hundred thousand losses in less than half a millisecond, and a parallel valuation of ten million policies in thirty-seven milliseconds, with separate comparison tables showing dataframe tools an order of magnitude slower. **This entry states plainly that every one of those numbers comes from the project own account and that none was reproduced here, and notes that the readme also states its memory accounting, explaining that the memory-mapped path uses the operating system page cache lazily while the streaming path keeps memory constant regardless of file size, so a fast time is not reported without saying what it was traded for.** **Fourth, the repository contains not only Go code but also a Zig subdirectory and an instruction file for AI coding agents.** Of a hundred and three files, the largest groups are the reader package, then a Zig source directory of eleven files, then the server, writer, command, stochastic, mortality and rates packages, alongside twenty-three Go test files and documentation including a twelve-kilobyte readme, an eighteen-kilobyte design document, a changelog, a roadmap, a contributing guide and an architecture decision record about an API freeze. **The instruction file for agents is seven hundred and sixty-four bytes and states that the engine is zero-dependency with a specific Go version and standard library only, that formatting must run before commits, that tests are table-driven with a floating point tolerance of one part in a billion, and that a knowledge graph under a named output directory must be updated after code edits using an AST-only path that costs no API calls.** **Fifth, two internal inconsistencies are recorded plainly**: the readme roadmap section still lists an earlier version as forthcoming although the changelog shows both that version and a later one already released in May, so the roadmap lags the changelog; and the same section sets a future target of a stable API with test coverage above ninety percent, which means the author states that coverage has not yet reached that level. **Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a Rust term model, a TypeScript actuarial package, a Julia finance core and several actuarial model libraries in R and Python, **while this entry supplies a zero-dependency Go actuarial engine that writes its naming origin, its benchmark accounting and its conventions for AI agents into the open. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: name a tool so that the name explains itself; give the test machine, the comparison target and the memory accounting rather than a bare speed-up factor; treat the absence of dependencies as a feature in regulated settings; and in an instruction file for AI agents state the dependency boundary, the numerical tolerance and what must be done after an edit.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the engine was not installed and not run**, so no present value, annuity, reserve or simulation was computed, **and no claim is made about any benchmark number, about the correctness of any result or about whether any formula conforms to any actuarial standard**. **Second, the instruction file was read only at its beginning**, the whole file being seven hundred and sixty-four bytes and the conventions and knowledge graph sections being those read here. **Third, the purpose and completeness of the Zig subdirectory were not verified, and this entry does not speculate about its relationship to the Go program. Fourth, its test coverage was not verified**, only that the stated target is above ninety percent and therefore not yet reached. **Fifth, the source and licensing of its mortality tables were not verified. Sixth, whether its HTTP interface requires authentication by default was not verified**, the readme giving only a localhost example. **Seventh, on the window: the repository was created in March and last pushed at the end of July, both outside the thaw window**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a zero-dependency Go actuarial engine that puts its naming origin, its benchmark accounting and its conventions for AI agents in plain sight. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the engine is an open-source tool rather than a licensed actuarial opinion, and that its output must be independently validated before any formal use.**

entries.title: **一个**用 Go 写的智利年金准备金引擎**，**并**把「**误差住在哪一段**」**列成表**：`fcaStockhausen/reservin`——**⭐ 逐字（西语）**「**Motor actuarial en Go para calcular reservas técnicas (VPPj) de pólizas de renta vitalicia del sistema chileno.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而**它**逐档给出**与监管报送的差异**：**独有被扶养人 **+0.2%**、**有配偶 **+0.4%**、**有子女 **−1.5%**、**无在世被扶养人 **+21.8%**、**整体 **+3.3%****，**并**按年代分层**（**2012 年后 **−1.1%**、**2005–2011 **+17.2%**、**2005 年前 **+14.1%**）**；**⭐ 并**逐字说明**「**引擎是为**现代保单校准的**，**残差集中在**2020 年前**且**没有历史 **VTD 的存量上**」**；**⚠️ 而**它**自己定的规矩里**禁止提交 **`.DS_Store`**，**而仓库里**正好**有一个****
entries.title_en: A Go engine for Chilean annuity technical reserves that tabulates where its own error lives: it reports differences against the regulatory filing for each family type, from a fraction of a percent for most cases to over twenty percent where no beneficiary survives, gives the same breakdown by policy vintage, states that the engine is calibrated for modern policies with the residual gap concentrated in pre-2020 stock that lacks historical discount curves, and forbids committing a macOS metadata file that its own repository contains.

entries.summary_en: This repository **is a Go engine for computing technical reserves on Chilean annuity policies**, described verbatim in Spanish as an actuarial engine for the technical reserves of life annuity policies in the Chilean system, stating that it follows several regulator circulars together with a supervisory technical note and that it is validated against the regulatory filing that insurers submit. **Measured this round**: MIT licensed, written in Go with the version stated in the readme, created in early August and last pushed two days later, one star, a repository of about twenty megabytes, a hundred and six files and five Go test files, with the readme claiming roughly one thousand three hundred and fifty policies per second in parallel and a full regulatory file of just under a million policies validated in about ten minutes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the same subject implemented in another language, together with the instruction file for AI coding agents that such repositories now ship.** **Four things are worth reading: it lists its own error by family structure and by policy vintage, including two groups that are off by more than seventeen percent; it states in words where the residual gap lives; it ships a canonical reader for the regulatory file that needs no database and can decode one policy, print the code dictionary and scan which codes actually occur; and its instruction file for AI agents is nearly ten kilobytes and lays down rules stricter than most human-facing documentation, including not touching the engine before reading the progress document and not committing anything unless the user explicitly asks.** **The engine was not compiled and not run this round.**

**Reservín**（仓库 `fcaStockhausen/reservin`）**是一个**用 Go 写的**智利年金准备金引擎****——**逐字自述（西语）为**「**Motor actuarial en Go para calcular reservas técnicas (VPPj) de pólizas de renta vitalicia del sistema chileno.**」**，**并**逐字注明它**遵循 **CMF 的 **NCG 318、**Circular 2332、**Circular 1512** 与 **SPensiones 的 **Nota Técnica N°9**，**且**与各公司报送给 **CMF 的 **RIS 文件（**Circular 1194**）**做校验**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一种语言的同题材实现，**以及**仓库里那份给 AI 代理的文件**」**。

**可核实信息（均仓库元数据与仓库内文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把**误差**按家庭结构与年代**逐档列出****——**⭐ 校验对象逐字为**「**RIS 2025-12-31**」**，**样本 **50K、**实际处理 **44K**，**逐档差异为**：**「**causante solo**」** **+0.2%**、**「**con cónyuge**」** **+0.4%**、**「**con hijos**」** **−1.5%**、**「**cónyuge + hijos**」** **−0.1%**、**「**sin causante vivo**」** **+21.8%**、**「**Global**」** **+3.3%****；**并**另按年代分层**：**2012 年后 **−1.1%**、**2005–2011 **+17.2%**、**2005 年前 **+14.1%****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一张表**是本条最有价值的部分**：**⭐ 即**它**既报了**好看的两档（**+0.2%／**+0.4%**）**，**也**报了**难看的**两档（**+21.8%／**+17.2%**）**——**⭐ 而**很多项目**只会报**总量口径**（**这里就是那个 **+3.3%**）**，**从而**把**最能说明问题的**分层偏差**藏起来**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**逐字说明**偏差住在哪里，**并**给出**校准的适用范围****——**逐字为**「**El motor está calibrado para pólizas modernas (post-sep-2020 con VTD del mes de emisión: gap <1% por póliza). El gap residual se concentra en stock pre-2020 sin VTD histórico disponible**」**，**并**指向**一份专门的说明文件**（**`docs/analysis/observaciones_avance.md`，**18,146 字节**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**它**没有**说「**模型准确**」**，**而**是说**「**为**2020 年 9 月后的**现代保单校准**；**每张保单的**偏差**小于 **1%**；**残差**集中在**2020 年前**且**没有历史 **VTD（**折现曲线）**的存量上**」**——**⭐ 把**「**我错在哪**」**说成**一句**可核对的话**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它带一个**不依赖数据库的 RIS 规范读取器****——**⭐ 本次实测**其命令逐字含** `-ris-dump <archivo> -svs 099747`（**逐张解码**）**、**`-filter dead -n 5`（**筛选已故被扶养人**）**、**`-json`（**逐行 JSON，**便于脚本处理**）**、**`-legend`（**逐字为 **C1194 的**代码字典**）**、**`-scan-codes`（**扫描文件中**出现过的代码**）**；**⭐ 并**另有**校验命令的**可选开关****：**`-retenida`（**对**自留准备金**比较**）**、**`-no-mejoramiento`（**不使用 **AAx 改善因子**，**用作敏感性**）**、**`-debug-svs <编号>`（**逐人明细**）**、**`-vtd-sens`（**对**折现曲线**做敏感性**）**；**⭐ 以及**组合生成、**压力测试与**YAML 情景**（**`-gen-ris`、**`-stress`、**`-scenario`**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组命令**说明**它**不是**一个**只算一个数的脚本**，**而**是一套**面向**监管报送**的**核对工具**：**⭐ 即**「**先把**对方的文件**读进来**（**含**字典与**代码扫描**）**，**再**逐档比**，**再**做**敏感性**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 仓库里**有一份 **9,850 字节的 **`AGENTS.md`**，**而**它**给 AI 代理的规矩**比**许多**人读文档更细****——**⭐ 逐字含**：**开场**「**Guía para cualquier agente (humano o IA) que trabaje en este repo. Léela antes de tocar nada.**」**；**⭐ **「**Lee primero:** docs/analysis/observaciones_avance.md**」**——**逐字續**「**No toques el motor sin haberlo leído.**」**；**⭐ **推送规则**（**逐字**「**Git push siempre a `origin main` (GitHub). El remote `server` (Tailscale) existe por compatibilidad pero NO se debe pushear ahí salvo orden explícita del usuario.**」**）**；**⭐ **不得提交清单**（**逐字含** `.DS_Store`、**除特定目录外的 **`*.xlsx`、**`cpu.prof`、**`data/*.vta` 等**）**；**⭐ **数据库规则**（**逐字**「**No commitear la DB `data/reservas.db` con datos personales o RIS crudo.**」**）**；**⭐ **语言规则**（**提交信息用英文**，**代码与注释**按**周围文件**决定**）**；**⭐ 以及两条**很少见**的规矩**：**逐字**「**No añadir comentarios explicativos salvo que el usuario lo pida. El código se explica solo.**」**与**「**No commitear nada sin que el usuario lo pida explícito.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**最后两条**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**这份文件**假定**读者**是一个**会**自作主张**的**代理**，**故**提前**把**「**不要多写注释**」**与**「**不要自己提交**」**写成**明文**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ ⚠️ 一处**规则与现状不一致（如实记录）****——**⭐ `AGENTS.md` **逐字把 **`.DS_Store` 列入**不得提交**的清单**，**而**本次实测**该文件**确实存在于仓库的 **HEAD 树中****（**⭐ 即**规则写在文档里**，**而**仓库里**恰好**有一个**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**这一点**，**并**注明**其影响很小**（**⭐ 只是一个 **macOS 元数据文件**）**——**⭐ 但**它**正好**是**「**文档里的规矩**」**与**「**仓库里的现状**」**不一致的**一个可核查样本**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 体量与结构（可核对）**：**仓库 **106 个文件／**约 **20.7 MB****、**⭐ **5 个 Go 测试文件**（**逐字含 **`ris1194_test.go`、**`ris_case_test.go`、**`pg_test.go`、**`tabla_test.go`、**`generator_test.go`**）**；**⭐ 目录按文件数**含 **`docs/normativo`（**28**，**监管 **PDF**）**、**`internal/models`（**12**）**、**`internal/database`（**9**）**、**`internal/calculator`（**7**）**、**`docs/analysis`（**5**）**、**`internal/loader`（**5**）**、**`cmd/calculator`（**4**）**、**`internal/scenario`（**4**）**、**`internal/portfolio`（**3**）**、**`data/normativo`（**2**）**；**⭐ 文档**含 **`AGENTS.md` **9,850**、**`docs/analysis/observaciones_avance.md` **18,146**、**`docs/analysis/validacion_ris_1194.md` **8,057**、**`docs/mortality_tables_guide.md` **6,923**、**`docs/analysis/reserve_calculation_guide.md` **6,015**、**`docs/analysis/mathematical_formulas.md` **5,262**、**`docs/analysis/formulas_cnu_nt9.md` **4,120**、**`descripcion.md` **1,261****；**⭐ 代码里还有**一个**抓取监管折现曲线的脚本**（**`scripts/scrape_vtd_cmf.py`**）**；**⭐ 依赖逐字含** `github.com/shopspring/decimal`（**逐字注明为 **UF 的**精确算术**）**、**`github.com/xuri/excelize/v2`（**读 **CMF 的 **xlsx 表**）**与 **`github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3`（**需要 **CGO**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**用 **decimal** 做 **UF（**智利通胀指数化记账单位**）的精确算术**」**这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**在**通胀指数化**的负债上**，**浮点误差**不是**小问题**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[heavylight]] 覆盖**带准备金方法的**现金流库**、**[[lifecontingencies]] 与**[[pylifecontingencies]] 覆盖**生命或然**数学**、**[[colombian-pension-observatory]] 与**[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]] 覆盖**拉美与西语的**养老金主题**、**[[pension-pro-mcp]] 覆盖**养老金数据接口**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**在**智利 **CMF 的监管口径下**、**用 **Go 实现并**与监管报送逐档对账的**年金准备金引擎**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **误差要**分层报**，**并**把**最难看的**那几档**留在表里**；**② **要说明**模型**为**哪一段**校准**、**残差**住在**哪一段**；**③ **对手方的文件**要先有**规范的读取器**（**含**代码字典与**代码扫描**）**；**④ **给 AI 代理**的规矩**要**写明**边界**（**不许动什么、**不许提交什么**）**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有编译、**没有运行**该引擎**（**未计算任何准备金、**未做任何 **RIS 校验**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何差异数字**、**不主张**其**结果符合 **CMF 的任何要求**、**也不主张**其**在**任何其他市场**适用**。**② ⚠️ **`AGENTS.md` 本次**只读了**开头若干段**（**⭐ 全文 **9,850 字节**，**本次读到**项目定义、**推送与**提交规则、**语言规则**等**）**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**监管 **PDF 与**原始 **xlsx** 的来源与**再分发许可**（**⭐ 仓库里**含 **28 个 **`docs/normativo` 文件与 **2 个 **`data/normativo` 文件**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**生命表与 **VTD 数据**的**授权情况**（**⭐ 只知**仓库内**含一份 **SQLite 数据库**，**并**逐字说明**不得**把**含个人信息或**原始 **RIS 的版本**提交**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **README 的校验表**是**在哪一次运行**上得到的**（**⭐ 只知**标注为 **RIS 2025-12-31**、**样本 **50K**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**作者身份**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录**仓库名与**其自述**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该仓库**创建于 **2026-08-07**、**最后推送 **2026-08-09**（**均在**解冻窗口之外**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**在**监管口径下**用 **Go 实现、**并**与监管报送**逐档对账的**年金准备金引擎**，**且**自带**不依赖数据库的**对手方文件读取器**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该引擎**是**开源实现**，**不是**任何**监管认可的计算工具**，**其**输出**与**报送要求**是否一致**须**由**使用者与**监管口径**自行确认**。

**可核實資訊（均倉庫元資料與倉庫內檔案實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把誤差按家庭結構與年代逐檔列出****——**⭐ 校驗對象逐字為**「**RIS 2025-12-31**」**，**樣本 50K、**實際處理 44K**，**逐檔差異**：**causante solo +0.2%**、**con cónyuge +0.4%**、**con hijos −1.5%**、**cónyuge + hijos −0.1%**、**sin causante vivo +21.8%**、**Global +3.3%****；**並**按年代分層**：**2012 年後 −1.1%、**2005–2011 +17.2%、**2005 年前 +14.1%****。**⭐ 這一張表是最有價值的一處**：**⭐ 即**它既報了**好看的兩檔**，**也報了**難看的兩檔**——**⭐ 而**很多項目只報**總量口徑**（**這裡就是那個 +3.3%**）**，**把**最能說明問題的分層偏差**藏起來**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字說明偏差住在哪裡，**並給出**校準的適用範圍****——**逐字為**「**El motor está calibrado para pólizas modernas (post-sep-2020 con VTD del mes de emisión: gap <1% por póliza). El gap residual se concentra en stock pre-2020 sin VTD histórico disponible**」**，**並**指向一份專門說明檔**（**`docs/analysis/observaciones_avance.md`，**18,146 位元組**）**。**⭐ 它沒有說「**模型準確**」**，**而是說**「**為 2020 年 9 月後的現代保單校準；**每張保單偏差小於 1%；**殘差集中在 2020 年前且沒有歷史 VTD 的存量上**」**——**⭐ 把「**我錯在哪**」說成一句可核對的話**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它帶一個不依賴數據庫的 RIS 規範讀取器****——**⭐ 命令逐字含 `-ris-dump <archivo> -svs 099747`、**`-filter dead -n 5`、**`-json`、**`-legend`（**逐字為 C1194 的代碼字典**）、**`-scan-codes`****；**⭐ 並有**校驗命令的可選開關**：**`-retenida`、**`-no-mejoramiento`、**`-debug-svs <編號>`、**`-vtd-sens`****；**⭐ 以及**組合生成、**壓力測試與 YAML 情景**（**`-gen-ris`、**`-stress`、**`-scenario`**）**。**⭐ 這說明它不是**只算一個數的腳本**，**而是一套**面向監管報送的核對工具**：**⭐ 即**「**先把對方檔案讀進來（**含字典與**代碼掃描）**，**再逐檔比**，**再做敏感性**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 倉庫裡有一份 9,850 位元組的 `AGENTS.md`**，**其規矩比許多人讀文檔更細****——**逐字含**開場**「**Guía para cualquier agente (humano o IA) que trabaje en este repo. Léela antes de tocar nada.**」**；**「**Lee primero:** docs/analysis/observaciones_avance.md**」**——**逐字續**「**No toques el motor sin haberlo leído.**」**；**推送規則**（**逐字**「**Git push siempre a `origin main` (GitHub). El remote `server` (Tailscale) existe por compatibilidad pero NO se debe pushear ahí salvo orden explícita del usuario.**」**）**；**不得提交清單**（**含 `.DS_Store`、**除特定目錄外的 `*.xlsx`、**`cpu.prof`、**`data/*.vta`**）**；**數據庫規則**（**逐字**「**No commitear la DB `data/reservas.db` con datos personales o RIS crudo.**」**）**；**語言規則**；**以及兩條很少見的規矩**：**逐字**「**No añadir comentarios explicativos salvo que el usuario lo pida. El código se explica solo.**」**與**「**No commitear nada sin que el usuario lo pida explícito.**」**。**⭐ 最後兩條最值得記**：**⭐ 即**這份文件**假定讀者是一個會自作主張的代理**，**故提前把「**不要多寫註釋**」與「**不要自己提交**」寫成明文**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ ⚠️ 一處規則與現狀不一致**——**`AGENTS.md` 逐字把 `.DS_Store` 列入不得提交清單**，**而本次實測該檔案確實存在於倉庫 HEAD 樹中****——**⭐ 本詞條**如實指出**，**並註明影響很小**（**只是一個 macOS 元資料檔**）**，**但**它是一個**可核查的樣本**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 體量與結構**：**106 個檔案／**約 20.7 MB****、**5 個 Go 測試檔案**（**`ris1194_test.go`、**`ris_case_test.go`、**`pg_test.go`、**`tabla_test.go`、**`generator_test.go`**）**；**目錄**含 `docs/normativo`（**28，**監管 PDF**）、**`internal/models`（**12**）、**`internal/database`（**9**）、**`internal/calculator`（**7**）、**`docs/analysis`（**5**）、**`internal/loader`（**5**）、**`cmd/calculator`（**4**）、**`internal/scenario`（**4**）、**`internal/portfolio`（**3**）、**`data/normativo`（**2**）**；**文件**含 AGENTS.md 9,850、**observaciones_avance.md 18,146、**validacion_ris_1194.md 8,057、**mortality_tables_guide.md 6,923、**reserve_calculation_guide.md 6,015、**mathematical_formulas.md 5,262、**formulas_cnu_nt9.md 4,120、**descripcion.md 1,261****；**代碼裡還有一個**抓取監管折現曲線的腳本**（**`scripts/scrape_vtd_cmf.py`**）**；**依賴**含 `github.com/shopspring/decimal`（**逐字註明為 UF 的精確算術**）、**`github.com/xuri/excelize/v2`、**`github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3`（**需要 CGO**）**。**⭐ 「**用 decimal 做 UF 的精確算術**」值得記**：**⭐ 即**在**通脹指數化的負債上**，**浮點誤差不是小問題**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[heavylight]]、[[lifecontingencies]]、[[pylifecontingencies]]、[[colombian-pension-observatory]]、[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]]、[[pension-pro-mcp]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**在智利 CMF 監管口徑下、**用 Go 實現並**與監管報送逐檔對賬的年金準備金引擎**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **誤差要分層報**，**並**把最難看的幾檔**留在表裡**；**② **要說明模型**為哪一段校準、**殘差住在哪一段**；**③ **對手方檔案**要有**規範讀取器**（**含代碼字典與**掃描**）**；**④ **給 AI 代理的規矩**要寫明邊界**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有編譯、**沒有運行**該引擎**，**不主張**其任何差異數字、**不主張**其結果符合 CMF 的任何要求、**也不主張**其在任何其他市場適用**。**② ⚠️ `AGENTS.md` 只讀了開頭若干段**（**全文 9,850 位元組**）**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其監管 PDF 與原始 xlsx 的來源與再分發許可**（**倉庫含 28 個 `docs/normativo` 檔案與 2 個 `data/normativo` 檔案**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其生命表與 VTD 數據的授權情況**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其 README 校驗表是在哪一次運行上得到的**（**只知**標註為 RIS 2025-12-31、**樣本 50K**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**作者身份**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**創建於 2026-08-07、**最後推送 2026-08-09（**均在窗口之外**）**——**本條的缺口是**「**在監管口徑下用 Go 實現、**並與監管報送逐檔對賬的年金準備金引擎**」這一形態**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該引擎是開源實現**，**不是**任何監管認可的計算工具**。
entries.body_en:
This repository **is a Go engine for computing technical reserves on Chilean annuity policies**, described verbatim in Spanish as an actuarial engine for the technical reserves of life annuity policies in the Chilean system, stating that it follows several regulator circulars together with a supervisory technical note and that it is validated against the regulatory filing insurers submit. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the same subject implemented in another language, together with the instruction file for AI coding agents that such repositories now ship.**

**Verified information, all measured from repository metadata and the files inside the repository**: **first, it lists its own error by family structure and by policy vintage.** The validation is against a stated regulatory cut-off date, over a sample of fifty thousand records of which forty-four thousand were processed, and the reported differences are a fifth of a percent for a deceased member with no survivor, four tenths of a percent where a spouse survives, **minus one and a half percent where children survive**, minus a tenth of a percent where both survive, **plus twenty-one point eight percent where no member survives at all**, and **plus three point three percent overall**; by vintage the differences are minus one point one percent after 2012, **plus seventeen point two percent from 2005 to 2011**, and **plus fourteen point one percent before 2005**. **That table is the most valuable part of this entry: it reports both the flattering groups and the unflattering ones, whereas a project reporting only the overall figure would hide exactly the segmentation that explains the problem.** **Second, it states in words where the residual gap lives and for which population the engine is calibrated**, saying that the engine is calibrated for modern policies issued after September 2020 where the discount curve of the issue month is available and the per-policy gap is under one percent, and that the residual gap is concentrated in pre-2020 stock for which no historical discount curve exists, pointing to an eighteen-kilobyte progress document. **That is worth copying: rather than claiming accuracy, it says where it is calibrated, how large its per-policy error is there, and where the remaining error is concentrated.** **Third, it ships a canonical reader for the counterparty file that needs no database**, able to decode a single policy, filter to deceased members, emit line-delimited JSON for scripts, print the code dictionary for the filing standard, and scan which codes actually occur in a file. **The validation command also carries switches to compare against the retained rather than gross reserve, to disable the mortality improvement factors as a sensitivity, to print per-person detail for one identifier, and to run sensitivity across all loaded discount curves**, alongside portfolio generation, stress testing and YAML scenario runs. **That command set shows this is not a script computing one number but a reconciliation toolkit: read the counterparty file properly, compare group by group, then test sensitivity.** **Fourth, the repository carries an instruction file for AI agents of nearly ten kilobytes whose rules are stricter than much human-facing documentation.** It opens by telling any agent, human or artificial, to read it before touching anything; it names a progress document that must be read before modifying the engine; it specifies that pushes go to one remote while a second compatibility remote over a private network must not be pushed to without an explicit instruction from the user; it lists files that must never be committed, including a macOS metadata file, spreadsheet files outside specific directories, profiling output and raw regulatory extracts; it forbids committing the database when it contains personal data or raw regulatory material; it sets the language of commit messages; and **it contains two unusually strict rules, namely that explanatory comments must not be added unless the user asks and that nothing may be committed unless the user explicitly requests it**. **Those last two matter because the file assumes its reader is an agent inclined to act on its own initiative, and so writes the prohibitions down in advance.** **Fifth, one rule contradicts the repository state and is recorded plainly**: the same instruction file forbids committing a macOS metadata file, and such a file is present in the repository tree, a minor matter in itself but a checkable example of documentation diverging from the repository. **Sixth, size and structure are checkable**: a hundred and six files of about twenty megabytes with five Go test files including dedicated tests for the regulatory file format, and directories covering twenty-eight regulatory documents in PDF, a dozen model types, database repositories, the calculator engine, progress analysis documents, loaders, the portfolio generator, scenario simulation and configuration, plus documentation files ranging from a nine-kilobyte agent guide and an eighteen-kilobyte progress note to guides on mortality tables, reserve calculation, mathematical formulas and the specific formulas of the supervisory note, and a script that scrapes the regulator discount curves. **Dependencies include a decimal arithmetic library, explicitly noted as being for exact arithmetic in the Chilean inflation-indexed unit of account, a spreadsheet reader for the regulator tables, and a SQLite driver requiring CGO.** **Using exact decimal arithmetic for an inflation-indexed liability is worth recording, because floating point error is not a small matter there.** **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a cash flow library with reserve methods, life contingency mathematics in two languages, Latin American and Spanish pension projects and a pension data interface, **while this entry supplies an annuity reserve engine implemented in Go under one supervisor regulatory framework and reconciled group by group against the regulatory filing, with a database-free reader for the counterparty file. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: report error by segment and keep the worst segments in the table; say which population the model is calibrated for and where the residual error lives; build a canonical reader for the counterparty file, including its code dictionary and code scan; and state the boundaries in any instruction file meant for AI agents.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the engine was not compiled and not run**, so no reserve was computed and no filing was validated, **and no claim is made about any difference figure, about conformance to any requirement of the supervisor, or about applicability in any other market**. **Second, the instruction file was read only at its opening sections**, the whole file being nearly ten kilobytes. **Third, the provenance and redistribution licensing of the regulatory PDFs and original spreadsheets were not verified**, the repository containing twenty-eight regulatory documents and two normative data files. **Fourth, the licensing of its mortality tables and discount curve data was not verified**, it being stated only that the database must not be committed with personal data or raw regulatory material. **Fifth, the run on which the readme validation table is based was not verified**, only that it is labelled with a specific regulatory cut-off date and a fifty-thousand-record sample. **Sixth, the author identity was not verified.** **Seventh, on the window: the repository was created in early August and last pushed two days later, both outside the thaw window**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is an annuity reserve engine implemented in Go under one supervisor framework, reconciled group by group against the regulatory filing, and shipping a database-free reader for the counterparty file. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the engine is an open-source implementation rather than a regulator-approved calculation tool, and that its conformance with filing requirements must be confirmed by the user against the applicable rules.**

Se valida contra el archivo RIS (Circular 1194) que reportan las compañías a la CMF.／Estado de la validación：Validación contra RIS 2025-12-31（50K muestra, 44K procesadas）表格：causante solo +0.2%／con cónyuge +0.4%／con hijos -1.5%／cónyuge + hijos -0.1%／sin causante vivo +21.8%／Global +3.3%；Por estrato: post-2012 -1.1%, 2005-2011 +17.2%, pre-2005 +14.1%／El motor está calibrado para pólizas modernas (post-sep-2020 con VTD del mes de emisión: gap <1% por póliza). Léela antes de tocar nada.／Lee primero: docs/analysis/observaciones_avance.md——逐字續——No toques el motor sin haberlo leído.／Git push siempre a origin main (GitHub). El remote server (Tailscale) existe por compatibilidad pero NO se debe pushear ahí salvo orden explícita del usuario.／No commitear .DS_Store, *.xlsx (excepto data/normativo/, data/vtd/, docs/normativo/), cpu.prof, prof, prof/, cmd/prof/, R*.txt, data/*.zip, data/*.vta. entries.title: **一个**把「**谁批的、**按哪一版规则批的、**有没有被改过**」**当成产品本身**的 Go 审批引擎**：`Zubimendi/Tribunal`——**⭐ 逐字**「**an approval workflow engine, built in Go**」**，**并**逐字列出**理赔等场景**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而**它**把审计日志做成**一条全局的**哈希链**：**逐字**「**one global, hash-chained, append-only audit log**」**，**并**逐字声明**「**no `UPDATE` or `DELETE` is permitted against it at all, ever**」**；**⭐ 而**流程版本**一旦发布即不可变**（**由数据库触发器强制**）**，**每笔理赔**钉死**在**它当时那一版**上**；**⭐ 窗口内（**创建与推送**同在 **2026-09-07****）**
entries.title_en: A Go approval engine that treats who authorised a decision, under which rule version, and whether the record has since been altered as the product itself: a single global hash-chained append-only audit log where no update or delete is ever permitted, workflow versions that become immutable once published under database trigger enforcement, and every claim pinned to the version in force when it was filed.

entries.summary: **Tribunal**（仓库 `Zubimendi/Tribunal`）**是一个**用 Go 写的**审批工作流引擎****——**逐字自述为**「**an approval workflow engine, built in Go**」**，**并**逐字说明**它**面向**费用报销、**保险理赔与**采购申请**这类**「**决定要按正确的人、**正确的顺序走**」**的多步流程**。**本次实测**：**许可 **MIT****、**语言 **Go****、**创建与**最后推送**同为 **2026-09-07**（**⭐ 在**解冻窗口之内**）**、**★0**、**仓库约 **91 KB****、**共 **59 个文件／**11 个 Go 测试文件****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一种语言的同题材实现，**以及**仓库里那份给 AI 代理的文件**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **它**先说出**审批流程**三种具体的失败方式**（**代人自批、**规则改过之后**没人说得清**当时**生效的是哪一版、**以及**「**审计日志**」**其实只是**状态列上的**一个时间戳**）**；**② **⭐ 它**把**审计日志**做成**一条全局的**哈希链**，**并**逐字声明**对它的 **`UPDATE` 与 **`DELETE`** 一律禁止**；**③ **⭐ 它**把**流程版本**做成**发布即不可变**（**由**数据库触发器**强制**）**，**每笔理赔**钉死**在**提交时那一版**上**；**④ **⭐ 而**仓库里**给 AI 代理的 **`CURSOR_CONTEXT.md`（**20,917 字节**）**写着**「**这一步**故意**不复用**兄弟项目的那套机制**，**别去**修**」**。**⚠️ 本次**未部署、**未运行**。
entries.summary_hk: **Tribunal**（倉庫 `Zubimendi/Tribunal`）**是一個**用 Go 寫的**審批工作流引擎****——**逐字自述為**「**an approval workflow engine, built in Go**」**，**並**逐字說明**它**面向**費用報銷、**保險理賠與**採購申請**這類**「**決定要按正確的人、**正確的順序走**」**的多步流程**。**本次實測**：**許可 MIT**、**語言 Go**、**創建與**最後推送**同為 2026-09-07（**在解凍窗口之內**）**、**★0**、**倉庫約 91 KB****、**共 59 個檔案／**11 個 Go 測試檔案****。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一種語言的同題材實現，**以及**倉庫裡那份給 AI 代理的檔案**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **先說出**審批流程**三種具體失敗方式**（**代人自批、**規則改過之後**沒人說得清**當時**生效的是哪一版、**以及**「**審計日誌**」**其實只是**狀態列上的一個時間戳**）**；**② **⭐ 把**審計日誌**做成**一條全局的**哈希鏈**，**並逐字聲明**對它的 `UPDATE` 與 `DELETE`** 一律禁止**；**③ **⭐ 把**流程版本**做成**發布即不可變**（**由數據庫觸發器強制**）**；**④ **⭐ 而**給 AI 代理的 `CURSOR_CONTEXT.md`（**20,917 位元組**）**寫著**「**這裡**故意不復用**兄弟專案的那套機制**，**別去修**」**。**⚠️ 本次**未部署、**未運行**。
entries.summary_en: This repository **is an approval workflow engine written in Go**, described verbatim as built for expense reports, insurance claims and procurement requests, that is for any multi-step process where a decision has to move through the right people in the right order. **Measured this round**: MIT licensed, created and last pushed on the same day in early September inside the thaw window, no stars yet, a repository of about ninety kilobytes, and fifty-nine files including eleven Go test files. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the same subject implemented in another language, together with the instruction file for AI coding agents that such repositories now ship.** **Four things are worth reading: it names three specific and boring ways approval workflows fail, namely someone approving their own request because nothing stopped them, a rule change leaving no way to say which rule was in force when a decision was made, and an audit log that is merely a timestamp on a status column and therefore not tamper-evident; it answers with a single global hash-chained append-only audit log against which no update or delete is permitted at all; it makes workflow versions immutable once published, enforced by a database trigger, with every claim pinned to the version in force when it was filed; and its instruction file for AI agents, at nearly twenty-one kilobytes, records that a particular mechanism is deliberately not reused from a sibling project and must not be fixed without rereading why.** **Nothing was deployed and nothing was run this round.**
entries.body:
**Tribunal**（仓库 `Zubimendi/Tribunal`）**是一个**用 Go 写的**审批工作流引擎****——**逐字自述为**「**an approval workflow engine, built in Go**」**，**并**逐字说明**它**面向**费用报销、**保险理赔与**采购申请**这类**「**任何**决定要按正确的**人、**正确的**顺序走**」**的多步流程**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一种语言的同题材实现，**以及**仓库里那份给 AI 代理的文件**」**。

**可核实信息（均仓库元数据与仓库内文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它先把审批流程**三种具体的失败方式**说出来****——**⭐ 逐字为**：**「**someone approves their own request because nothing stopped them**」**、**「**an approval rule changes and nobody can say for certain what rule was in effect when a specific decision was made months ago**」**、**以及**「**the audit log is a `created_at` timestamp on a status column — informative, but not actually tamper-evident, which means it can**」**——**逐字續**「**’t answer are we sure this wasn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t edited after the fact with anything stronger than we assume so.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一段的写法**值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**它**没有**先讲**架构**，**而**先讲**三件**在理赔与**采购里**天天发生、**又很无聊的**具体事故**——**⭐ 然后**才说**这套系统**怎么回答它们**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把审计日志做成一条**全局的**哈希链**，**并**逐字声明**更新与删除**一律禁止****——**⭐ 逐字为**：**「**every event, from every claim, is written into one global, hash-chained, append-only audit log, so has this record been tampered with has a real, computable answer instead of an assumed one**」**；**⭐ 数据库定义里**逐字为**「**a single global, cryptographically hash-chained, unconditionally append-only table — no `UPDATE` or `DELETE` is permitted against it at all, ever**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**整条**最有价值的设计点**：**⭐ 即**它把**「**这份记录**有没有**被动过**」**从一句**「**我们相信没有**」**变成**一个**可以计算**的问题**——**⭐ 而**代价是**必须**维护一条**链**（**故**其测试里**专门**有**链的构造、**连续性、**被篡改数据上的校验**与**并发写入的序列化**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 流程版本**发布即不可变**，**每笔理赔**钉死在**它当时那一版上****——**⭐ 表结构逐字含** `workflow_definitions`、**`workflow_versions`（**逐字**「**immutable once published, trigger-enforced**」**）**、**`claims`（**逐字**「**pinned to one `workflow_version_id`**」**）**、**`claim_attachments`（**逐字**「**MinIO object references, verified-before-use**」**）与**`audit_log`**；**⭐ 而**其集成测试**逐字覆盖**「**published version 2 never affects claim pinned to version 1**」**与**「**database-level trigger rejects raw `UPDATE` on published stages**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一条**对 RIAA 尤其有用**：**⭐ 即**它**正面回答**了**「**规则改过之后**，**几个月前那笔决定**当时**按的是**哪一版」**——**⭐ 答法是**把**版本**钉在**单据上**，**并**让**版本本身**发布后**不可改**。**⭐⭐ ④ 权限与流程判定**全部在服务端完成**，**并**有**一套**十步授权管线****——**⭐ 包结构逐字含** `internal/workflow`（**定义、**带版本的**阶段图、**发布生命周期）**、**`internal/authtoken`（**逐字**「**Stateless HMAC-SHA256 actor token issue/verify**」**）**、**`internal/audit`（**逐字**「**Hash-chained append + chain verification**」**）**、**`internal/storage`（**逐字**「**MinIO presigned upload + existence check**」**）**、**`internal/claims`（**逐字**「**Full 10-step authorization pipeline + attachments**」**）**、**`internal/observability`（**Prometheus）与**`internal/api`（**Chi 路由、**处理器与**鉴权中间件**）**；**⭐ 单元测试**逐字覆盖**规范化确定性、**令牌的**签发／**校验／**篡改／**过期、**图校验与**条件求值器**；**⭐ 集成测试**逐字覆盖**职责分离（**自批被拒**与**显式允许**、**按理赔限定**的不同审批人）**、**角色与**条件门控的**转移（**六种运算符、**字段与**金额分位）**、**附件**预签名／**上传／**确认（**未验证的附件**不满足**「**需要附件**」**）**与**版本钉死**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组测试**说明**它把**「**不该发生的事**」**当成**一等测试对象**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 仓库里**给 AI 代理的 **`CURSOR_CONTEXT.md`（**20,917 字节**）**写明**「**故意不复用**」的**设计决定****——**⭐ 逐字为**：**「**Read this file first, then `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, then `docs/PRD.md`. The implementation is complete.**」**，**并**逐字续**「**Follow `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`**」**——**逐字續**「**’s decisions exactly — including the two places it deliberately does *not* reuse machinery from a sibling project (the condition evaluator) and the one place it deliberately *does* (version immutability) for a different reason than that sibling project had. Both are intentional; don**」**——**逐字續**「**’t fix either without re-reading why.**」**；**⭐ 并**逐字点到**三个**兄弟项目**（**FormFlow、**Switchboard 与**AuthNexus**）**，**其中**逐字说明**「**AuthNexus, a later project, is where real auth belongs; don**」**——**逐字續**「**’t scope-creep it into `internal/authtoken`.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一份文件**值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**这里**故意**不按惯例做**」**写成**给代理的**明文指示**，**以防**后来者（**人或 AI）**把**刻意的**设计**当成**疏漏**去「**修好**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ ⚠️ 三处**须如实标注**：**① **它**自述为**学习路线上的作业**（**README 逐字含**「**Week 6–7, Project 13 of the backend roadmap**」**）**——**⭐ 故**它**不是**任何机构的**生产系统**；**② **它**创建与**推送**同日**、**★0**、**仓库仅 **91 KB****——**⭐ 即**本次**看不到**后续维护**；**③ **其**代理说明文件**逐字声称**「**实现已完成**」**——**⭐ 而**这与**仓库体量**（**59 个文件）**相符**，**但**本次**未运行**任何测试**，**故**不主张**其**真的通过**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[claim-ops]]、**[[claims-api]]、**[[digital-claims-management]]、**[[guidewire-claim-intelligence]] 覆盖**理赔运营、**接口与**数字化**、**[[claims-processing-hack]] 覆盖**理赔处理**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**审批链的**可归责性**（**谁批的、**按哪一版、**有没有被改**）**当成**产品本身**的**开源引擎**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **先把**失败方式**写清**，**再讲**架构**；**② **审计**要能回答**「**有没有被改过**」**，**而**不是**只记**一个时间戳**；**③ **规则版本**要**钉在单据上**，**且**发布后**不可改**；**④ **给代理的说明里**要标出**「**这里**故意**与惯例不同**」**，**免得**被**好心改错**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有部署、**没有运行**该引擎**（**未启用数据库、**未发起任何审批、**未做任何哈希链校验**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何安全或**可审计**性质**成立**，**也**不主张**其**测试**通过**。**② ⚠️ 本文**对**审计链、**版本不可变与**职责分离**的描述**全部来自**其 **README 与**仓库内**文档、**测试文件命名与**表结构说明**，**未逐行**读实现**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其 **HMAC 令牌**的**密钥管理方式**（**⭐ 本词条**不主张**其**适用于**任何**真实授权场景**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其 **MinIO 附件**校验**在**真实网络条件下**的行为**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**与**任何**理赔业务规则**的对应关系**（**⭐ 它**是**通用审批引擎**，**不含**保险条款**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**提到的三个**兄弟项目**的关系**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录**其**自述**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该仓库**创建与**最后推送**同为 **2026-09-07**（**⭐ 在**解冻窗口之内**）**——**⭐ 而**本条**仍以**形态缺口**记之**：**本条的缺口是**「**把**审批链的可归责性**当成产品本身**的**通用引擎**，**并**把**刻意的设计选择**写进**给 AI 代理的说明**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该引擎**是**开源学习项目**，**不是**任何**合规或**授权系统**，**其**用于**真实理赔审批前**必须**做独立的安全与**合规评估**。

entries.body_en:
This repository **is an approval workflow engine written in Go**, described verbatim as built for expense reports, insurance claims and procurement requests: any multi-step process where a decision has to move through the right people in the right order. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the same subject implemented in another language, together with the instruction file for AI coding agents that such repositories now ship.**

**Verified information, all measured from repository metadata and the files inside the repository**: **first, it names the failure modes before it describes the architecture.** The readme states that approval workflows fail in three specific, boring and extremely common ways: someone approves their own request because nothing stopped them; an approval rule changes and nobody can say for certain which rule was in effect when a decision was made months ago; and the audit log is a creation timestamp on a status column, informative but not actually tamper-evident, which means it cannot answer whether a record was edited after the fact with anything stronger than an assumption. **That framing is worth copying because it starts from the boring incidents that actually happen in claims and procurement rather than from the architecture.** **Second, the audit log is a single global hash chain, and no update or delete is permitted against it at all, ever.** The readme states that every event from every claim is written into one global hash-chained append-only log, so whether a record has been tampered with has a computable answer instead of an assumed one, and the database definition describes an unconditionally append-only table with cryptographic chaining. **That is the single most valuable design point here: it turns an assurance into a computation, at the cost of maintaining a chain, which is why the tests specifically cover chain construction, continuity, verification on tampered data and serialisation of concurrent appends.** **Third, workflow versions become immutable once published, enforced by a database trigger, and each claim is pinned to the version in force when it was filed.** The schema names definition and version tables described as immutable once published, a claims table pinned to a single version identifier, attachments held as object-store references verified before use, and the audit log; and the integration tests specifically cover that a published later version never affects a claim pinned to an earlier one and that a database-level trigger rejects a raw update on published stages. **That answers a question this project cares about directly: after the rules change, which version governed a decision taken months ago. The answer is to pin the version onto the record and make the version itself unchangeable.** **Fourth, authorisation and transition decisions are made entirely server-side, with a ten-step authorisation pipeline.** The package layout includes workflow definitions with versioned stage graphs and a publish lifecycle, a stateless token issuer and verifier, hash-chained audit append with chain verification, object storage with presigned upload and existence checking, a claims package described as a full ten-step authorisation pipeline with attachments, observability counters and gauges, and an API layer with routing, handlers and authentication middleware. **Unit tests cover canonicalisation determinism, token issue, verification, tampering and expiry, graph validation and the condition evaluator; integration tests cover segregation of duties including self-approval rejection and explicit allowance with distinct approvers scoped per claim, role-gated and condition-gated transitions across six operators, attachment presign, upload and confirm with an unverified attachment failing to satisfy a requirement, and version pinning. That test set treats what must never happen as a first-class subject.** **Fifth, the instruction file for AI agents, at nearly twenty-one kilobytes, records which deliberate deviations must not be fixed.** It opens by telling the reader to read it first and then two design documents, states that the implementation is complete, and then instructs the reader to follow the architecture decisions exactly, **including two places where machinery from a sibling project is deliberately not reused and one place where it deliberately is, for a different reason than the sibling project had, with the warning that both are intentional and must not be fixed without rereading why**. It also names three sibling projects and states that real authentication belongs to a later project and must not be pulled into the token package. **Recording a deliberate deviation as an explicit instruction for agents is worth noting, because it stops a later reader, human or artificial, from treating an intentional design as an omission and helpfully repairing it.** **Sixth, three points must be stated plainly**: the readme describes itself as a week six and seven exercise, project thirteen of a backend roadmap, so it is not any organisation production system; the repository was created and pushed on the same day, has no stars and is about ninety kilobytes, so no later maintenance is visible; and the agent file asserts that the implementation is complete, which matches the file count but was not confirmed here because nothing was run. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover claims operations, a claims API, digital claims management, claim intelligence and a claims processing exercise, **while this entry supplies an open-source engine that treats the accountability of an approval chain — who authorised it, under which version, and whether it has since been altered — as the product itself. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: write down the failure modes before the architecture; make the audit trail able to answer whether something was altered rather than merely recording a timestamp; pin the rule version onto the record and make the version unchangeable after publication; and mark deliberate deviations from convention in any instruction file meant for agents so that they are not helpfully corrected.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, nothing was deployed and nothing was run**, no database was started, no approval was submitted and no chain was verified, **so no claim is made that its security or auditability properties hold or that its tests pass**. **Second, everything said here about the chain, version immutability and segregation of duties comes from the readme, the repository documentation, test file names and schema descriptions rather than from reading the implementation line by line.** **Third, how its token signing keys are managed was not verified, and this entry does not claim it is suitable for any real authorisation setting. Fourth, the behaviour of its attachment verification under real network conditions was not verified. Fifth, its correspondence with any actual claims business rules was not verified**, since it is a general approval engine carrying no insurance terms. **Sixth, its relationship to the three sibling projects it names was not verified**, only its own account being recorded. **Seventh, on the window: the repository was created and last pushed on the same day in early September, inside the thaw window, yet this entry still records it as a gap in form**, namely **a general engine that treats the accountability of an approval chain as the product and writes its deliberate design choices into an instruction file for AI agents. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the engine is an open-source learning project rather than a compliance or authorisation system, and that independent security and compliance assessment is required before any real claims approval use.**

entries.title: **一个**嵌入式宠物保险的 **Android SDK**，**而**它的许可**是 **GPL-3.0****：`guavasure/guavasure-android`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Native Android library that embeds the hosted GuavaSure insurance flow in a WebView and implements `GuavasureBridge` for native Razorpay Checkout, file pick, camera capture, and partner auth.**」**；**⭐ 它**把**宿主页面**必须继承的**活动类**、**必须声明的**权限与 **FileProvider**、**以及**支付回跳时的**不重载**行为**都写进 README**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而**风险点**被做成两个**具名的策略类**（**`EmbedOriginPolicy` 与 **`PaymentUrlPolicy`**）**；**⚠️ 而**它的 **LICENSE **35,149 字节**、**逐字为 **GPL-3.0**（**⭐ 对**要嵌入**自家 App 的合作方**而言**是最需要先读的一行**）**；**⭐ 最后推送 **2026-09-08****
entries.title_en: An Android SDK for embedded pet insurance that ships under a strong copyleft licence: it embeds a hosted insurance flow in a WebView behind a native bridge, documents the activity class the host app must extend together with the permissions and file provider it must declare, names two policy classes for embed origin and payment URL security, and treats not reloading the checkout as a documented behaviour.
