**Darshana Insurance Auto-Login**（Firefox 擴充 `darshana-insurance-auto-login`）**是一個**在**保險門戶上**自動填**登入憑據與**一次性驗證碼**的**瀏覽器擴充****——**逐字自述為**「**Automatically fills login credentials and OTP verification codes on insurance portals.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**瀏覽器裡的保險工具**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Mozilla 擴充登記介面實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**一次性驗證碼**」也納入自動填寫範圍****——**⭐ 即**多因素認證的設計意圖是「**第二因素不與可能被竊取的第一因素同處一地**」**，**而把驗證碼交給同一個擴充會削弱這一意圖**——**⭐ 本條**如實記錄這一功能**，**但**不主張**其是否存在補償性措施**，**也不主張**其是否違反任何門戶的使用條款**。**⭐⭐ ② 目標寫的是「**保險門戶**」****——**⭐ 即**保險業工作流裡有大量需反覆登入的外部系統**（**承保、**理賠、**保司後台與**比價平台**）**——**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**若真要自動化這些門戶**，**要處理的是憑據管理與授權邊界**，**不只是頁面填充**。**⭐⭐ ③ ⚠️ 可核查性極低****——**日活為 1****、**許可逐字為 `All Rights Reserved`**、**⭐ 無**主頁**、**無**倉庫位址**、**發布者逐字為 `DIC`****；**包體 24,798 位元組**、**版本 `1.1.0`**、**創建 2026-05-22**、**最後更新 2026-05-25****——**⭐ 即**外部幾乎沒有任何可用於評估它如何處理憑據的資訊**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 與同平台另一條保險擴充共同的問題****——**本輪另一條只有一句自述、**同樣閉源、**日活為 0**——**⭐ 即**「**自述一句話＋**許保留全部權利＋**無倉庫＋**極少使用者**」四件同時出現**，**外部既不能審計**，**也無法從使用者反饋獲得信號**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[application-fill-provenance]]、[[cyber-risk-platform]]、[[cyber-risk-classification]]、[[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]]、[[ifraudsimulator]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把門戶登入憑據與一次性驗證碼一起自動化的保險瀏覽器擴充，**並由此暴露憑據信任邊界**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **凡涉及憑據的自動化要先問信任邊界在哪**；**② **第二因素自動化的代價要寫明**；**③ **門戶使用條款可能禁止這類自動化（**未核實**）**；**④ **「**自述一句話、**無倉庫、**無人用**」應被當作信號**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝、**沒有使用**該擴充**，**不主張**其功能**、**憑據處理方式**，**也不主張**其是否符合任何門戶的使用條款**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀擴充登記介面返回的元資料**，**未讀**其包內容**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**發布者身份**（**只知三個字母的顯示名**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其是否會把憑據發送到任何外部**（**不推測其行為**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**文中涉及的任何保險門戶是否允許此類自動化**。**⑥ ⚠️ 日活為 1**，**不主張**它已被廣泛使用**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 本條不是安全評估**。
entries.body_en:
This extension **fills login credentials and one-time verification codes into insurance portals on the user behalf**, described verbatim as automatically filling credentials and one-time codes on insurance portals. **This entry belongs to the round theme of insurance tooling inside the browser.**

**Verified information, all measured from the Mozilla add-on registry interface**: **first, it extends automation to one-time verification codes, which this entry flags separately.** The point of a second factor is that it does not sit in the same place as a first factor that might be stolen, so handing the code to the same extension weakens that intent. **This entry records the feature without claiming whether any compensating control exists, such as local-only storage, and without claiming whether it breaches any portal terms of use.** **Second, its stated target is insurance portals, which is exactly the shape of the insurance working day.** Underwriting, claims and insurer back offices, along with comparison platforms, all involve repeated logins to external systems, **so automatic login is the direct automation of that repetition; for this project it also points at the real problem, namely that automating such portals requires handling credential management and authorisation boundaries, not merely filling fields.** **Third, verifiability is very low**: one daily user, an all-rights-reserved licence, no homepage, no repository and a three-letter publisher name, with a package of about twenty-five kilobytes at version 1.1.0, created in May and last updated three days later with nothing since. **Externally there is almost no information with which to judge how it handles credentials, which is precisely the part of a browser extension most in need of assessment.** **Fourth, it shares a problem with another insurance extension on the same platform**, whose description is a single sentence, which is likewise closed and which has no visible users. **Read together they show the shared shape of this surface: a one-sentence description, an all-rights-reserved licence, no repository and negligible usage appearing at once, a combination under which an outsider can neither audit the tool nor draw any signal from user feedback.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the provenance of application material, cyber risk platforms and classifications, and insurance fraud risk scoring, **while this entry supplies a browser extension that automates both portal credentials and one-time codes for insurance, and the credential trust boundary that comes with it. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: ask where the trust boundary sits before automating anything involving credentials; state the cost of automating a second factor; recognise that portal terms may prohibit such automation, which this entry did not verify; and treat a one-sentence description, no repository and no visible users as a signal rather than as neutral.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the extension was neither installed nor used**, no login was attempted on any insurance portal, **so no claim is made about its functionality, about how it handles credentials, or about compliance with any portal terms of use**. **Second, only the metadata returned by the registry was read**, not the package contents. **Third, the publisher identity was not verified**, only a three-letter display name being visible. **Fourth, whether it transmits credentials anywhere was not verified, and this entry does not speculate about its behaviour. Fifth, whether any portal named in this context permits such automation was not verified. Sixth, with a single daily user this entry does not claim wide usage. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that it is not a security assessment, and that anyone considering an automatic login tool should make their own security and compliance judgement.**

entries.title: **把**公司的**网络安全评分**放进**承保人的浏览器****：Firefox 扩展 `rankiteo-cyber-rating`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Rankiteo provides a way to cyber underwriters to get a company cyber score.**」**；**⭐ 即**它**面向的是**网络安全险（**cyber）的**承保人**，**并**在**浏览器里**给出**一个公司的**网络评分****；**⭐ 发布者主页逐字为 **`https://www.rankiteo.com`**、**版本 **`1.0.0`**、**创建 **2026-03-23**、**更新 **2026-03-26****；**⚠️ 而**其**日活为 **0**、**包体 **12,400 字节**、**许可逐字为 **`All Rights Reserved`****、**⭐ 无**仓库地址****
entries.title_en: Putting a company cyber score inside the underwriter browser: an extension aimed at cyber underwriters that returns a cyber score for a company, published by a commercial site at a single version created and updated within three days in March, with no daily users, a twelve-kilobyte package, an all-rights-reserved licence and no repository.

entries.summary: **Rankiteo Cyber Underwriter & Cyber Rating**（Firefox 扩展 `rankiteo-cyber-rating`）**是一个**在**浏览器里**给出**公司网络安全评分**的**扩展****——**逐字自述为**「**Rankiteo provides a way to cyber underwriters to get a company cyber score.**」**，**即**它**明确**面向**网络安全险（**cyber）的**承保人**。**本次实测**：**版本 **`1.0.0`**、**创建 **2026-03-23**、**最后更新 **2026-03-26****、**包体 **12,400 字节****、**⭐ 日活为 **0****、**许可逐字为 **`All Rights Reserved`****、**发布者主页逐字为 **`https://www.rankiteo.com`****（**⭐ 即**一个**商业站点）**、**⭐ 无**仓库地址**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**浏览器里的保险工具**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **⭐ 它把**承保资料**放到了**浏览器里**——**⭐ 即**承保人**在**浏览**一家公司的**网站或**资料时**，**可以**直接**取到**一个**评分**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**正是**「**核保辅助**」**从**内部系统**走向**浏览器**的**一个具体形态**（**⭐ 与**本轮**另一条**代理系统扩展**互为**对照**：**一个**来自**厂商系统**，**一个**来自**外部数据商**）**；**② **⭐ 它的**目标用户**写得**很窄**（**逐字为 **`cyber underwriters`**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**面向**一个**具体**岗位**做工具**，**在**保险科技**里**并不常见**（**⭐ 而**这**也**意味着**评分口径**的**解释责任**落在**那个岗位**身上**）**；**③ **⭐ 包体 **12KB****——**⭐ 即**它**只是**一个**取数与**展示的**外壳**，**评分**必然**由**服务端**计算并返回**（**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**评分方法**与**数据来源**因此**完全**不透明**）**；**④ **⚠️ 而**日活为 **0**、**单版本 **`1.0.0`**、**无仓库**、**许可保留全部权利****——**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**本次**无法**评估**其评分的**方法、**数据来源与**稳定性**，**故**不主张**其**评分**可用于**任何**承保决定**。**⚠️ 本次**未安装、**未使用**。
entries.summary_hk: **Rankiteo Cyber Underwriter & Cyber Rating**（Firefox 擴充 `rankiteo-cyber-rating`）**是一個**在瀏覽器裡**給出**公司網絡安全評分**的**擴充****——**逐字自述為**「**Rankiteo provides a way to cyber underwriters to get a company cyber score.**」**，**即**它明確**面向**網絡安全險（**cyber）的**承保人**。**本次實測**：**版本 `1.0.0`**、**創建 2026-03-23**、**最後更新 2026-03-26**、**包體 12,400 位元組**、**⭐ 日活為 0****、**許可逐字為 `All Rights Reserved`**、**發布者主頁逐字為 `https://www.rankiteo.com`**、**⭐ 無倉庫位址****。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**瀏覽器裡的保險工具**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **⭐ 把承保資料放到瀏覽器裡**——**⭐ 即**承保人在瀏覽一家公司的網站或資料時**，**可直接取到一個評分**——**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**這是「**核保輔助**」從內部系統走向瀏覽器的具體形態**；**② **⭐ 目標用戶寫得很窄**（**逐字為 `cyber underwriters`**）**；**③ **⭐ 包體 12KB**——**⭐ 即**它只是一個取數與展示的外殼**，**評分必然由服務端計算**——**⭐ 故**評分方法與數據來源完全不通明**；**④ **⚠️ 而**日活為 0、**單版本 `1.0.0`、**無倉庫、**許保留全部權利****——**⭐ 本次無法評估其評分的方法、**數據來源與**穩定性**。**⚠️ 本次**未安裝、**未使用**。
entries.summary_en: This extension **puts a company cyber score inside the browser of an underwriter**, described verbatim as providing cyber underwriters with a way to obtain a company cyber score, so its stated audience is specifically cyber underwriters. **Measured this round**: a single version 1.0.0 created in late March and updated three days later, a package of twelve kilobytes, no daily users, an all-rights-reserved licence, a publisher homepage on a commercial site and no repository. **This entry belongs to the round theme of insurance tooling inside the browser.** **Four things are worth reading: it moves underwriting material into the browser, so while reading a company website or file an underwriter can obtain a score on the spot, which is a concrete form of underwriting assistance moving out of internal systems and into the browser, and it contrasts with another extension this round that comes from a vendor system while this one comes from an outside data provider; its stated audience is very narrow, naming cyber underwriters, and building a tool for one specific job role is uncommon in insurance technology, which also means the responsibility for interpreting the score falls on that role; the package is only twelve kilobytes, so it is a shell for fetching and displaying a score, and therefore the scoring method and its data sources are entirely invisible to the user; and with no daily users, a single version, no repository and an all-rights-reserved licence, nothing here allows the method, data sources or stability of the score to be assessed, so this entry does not claim the score can support any underwriting decision.** **The extension was not installed or used this round.**
entries.body:
**Rankiteo Cyber Underwriter & Cyber Rating**（Firefox 扩展 `rankiteo-cyber-rating`）**是一个**在**浏览器里**给出**公司网络安全评分**的**扩展****——**逐字自述为**「**Rankiteo provides a way to cyber underwriters to get a company cyber score.**」**，**即**它**明确**面向**网络安全险（**cyber）的**承保人**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**浏览器里的保险工具**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Mozilla 扩展登记接口实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把**承保资料**放到了**浏览器里****——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本条的核心**：**⭐ 即**承保人**在**浏览**一家公司的**网站、**资料或**公开信息时**，**可以**就地**取到**一个**评分**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**正是**「**核保辅助**」**从**内部系统**走向**浏览器**的**一个具体形态**；**⭐ 且**本轮**另一条**扩展**来自**代理管理系统厂商**，**而**本条**来自**一个**外部数据商**——**⭐ 两者**对照**可以**看出**「**浏览器**」**在**保险业**里**同时**承载**两类工具**：**厂商把**自家系统**延伸到浏览器**、**数据商把**外部评分**推送到浏览器**。**⭐⭐ ② 目标用户**写得很窄****——**⭐ 逐字为 **`cyber underwriters`**（**网络安全险**承保人）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**在**保险科技**里**，**明确**面向**一个**具体**岗位**做工具**并不常见**（**⭐ 多数**工具**面向**「**保险业**」**或**「**代理人**」**这类**更宽的**群体**）**——**⭐ 而**「**面向某一岗位**」**的**另一面**是**：**评分的**解释责任**落在**该岗位**身上**，**而**工具**本身**不承担**解释**。**⭐⭐ ③ 包体 **12KB**，**故**评分**必然**在**服务端**算好****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**包体逐字 **12,400 字节****、**版本 **`1.0.0`**、**创建 **2026-03-23**、**最后更新 **2026-03-26****、**发布者主页逐字为 **`https://www.rankiteo.com`****、**发布者显示名逐字为 **`Jeremy`****。**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**评分方法、**数据来源**与**更新频率**都**不在**扩展里**，**而**在**服务端**——**⭐ 故**使用者**能看到的**只有**一个数字**与**可能的**解释文本**，**而**看不到**它**怎么来的**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 可评估信息几乎为零****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**日活为 **0****、**评分次数 **0**、**许可逐字为 **`All Rights Reserved`****、**⭐ 无**仓库地址**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实标注**：**⭐ 本次**无法**评估**其**评分口径、**数据来源**与**稳定性**，**故**不主张**其**评分**可用于**任何**承保决定**；**⭐ 并**如实指出**：**若**一类**评分**被**用于**承保**，**则**它**至少**应说明**「**评分**基于**哪些**可核查的**输入**、**多久**更新一次、**对哪些**行业适用**」**——**⭐ 而**本条**自述**没有**提供**这些**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[cyber-kittens]] 覆盖**网络安全风险**、**[[cyber-risk-platform]] 与**[[cyber-risk-classification]] 覆盖**网络风险平台与**分类**、**[[underwriting-workbench]] 与**[[underwriter-os]] 覆盖**核保工作台**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把公司网络评分**推送到**承保人浏览器**的**外部数据商扩展**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **承保辅助**可以**贴着**承保人的**浏览器**走**（**⭐ 但**要**说清**评分**从哪来**）**；**② **面向具体岗位**的工具**要**写明**解释责任**；**③ **薄客户端**意味着**方法**不可见**，**故**要有**替代的**口径说明**；**④ **评分**若**进入**承保流程**，**至少**要**给出**输入、**更新频率与**适用范围**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有使用**该扩展**（**未对**任何公司**取过**任何**评分**）**，**故**不主张**其**评分**的**正确性**、**不主张**其**方法**是否**合理**、**也**不主张**其**可用于**任何**核保、**定价或**承保决定**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**扩展登记接口返回的**元数据**（**名称、**发布者、**版本、**日活、**许可、**包体大小与**链接字段**）**，**未读**其**包内容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**评分**的**输入数据来源**、**计算方法**、**更新频率**与**适用范围**（**⭐ 本条**对此**不作推测**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**发布者**与**任何**保险公司**的**合作关系**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**需要**付费或**账号**才能**取到**评分**（**⭐ 主页**指向**一个**商业站点**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **日活为 **0****，**故**本条**不主张**它**已被**任何**承保人**使用**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**网络安全评分**属于**第三方数据**，**其**用于**核保前**必须**独立验证**，**并**说明**其**局限**。

**Rankiteo Cyber Underwriter & Cyber Rating**（Firefox 擴充 `rankiteo-cyber-rating`）**是一個**在瀏覽器裡**給出**公司網絡安全評分**的**擴充****——**逐字自述為**「**Rankiteo provides a way to cyber underwriters to get a company cyber score.**」**，**即**它明確**面向**網絡安全險（**cyber）的**承保人**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**瀏覽器裡的保險工具**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Mozilla 擴充登記介面實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 把承保資料放到瀏覽器裡****——**⭐ 即**承保人在瀏覽一家公司的網站、**資料或**公開資訊時**，**可就地取到一個評分**——**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**這是「**核保輔助**」從內部系統走向瀏覽器的具體形態**；**⭐ 且**本輪另一條擴充來自代理管理系統廠商**，**而本條來自一個外部數據商**——**⭐ 兩者對照可見「**瀏覽器**」在保險業同時承載兩類工具**。**⭐⭐ ② 目標用戶寫得很窄**（**逐字為 `cyber underwriters`**）**——**⭐ 即**明確面向一個具體崗位做工具並不常見**，**而**其另一面是評分的解釋責任落在該崗位身上**。**⭐⭐ ③ 包體 12KB，**故評分必然在服務端算好****——**包體逐字 12,400 位元組**、**版本 `1.0.0`**、**創建 2026-03-23**、**最後更新 2026-03-26**、**發布者主頁逐字為 `https://www.rankiteo.com`**、**發布者顯示名逐字為 `Jeremy`****——**⭐ 即**評分方法、**數據來源與**更新頻率都不在擴充裡**，**使用者只看到一個數字**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 可評估資訊幾乎為零****——**日活為 0**、**評分次數 0**、**許可逐字為 `All Rights Reserved`**、**⭐ 無倉庫位址****——**⭐ 故**本次無法評估其評分口徑、**數據來源與**穩定性**，**不主張**其評分可用於任何承保決定**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[cyber-kittens]]、[[cyber-risk-platform]]、[[cyber-risk-classification]]、[[underwriting-workbench]]、[[underwriter-os]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把公司網絡評分推送到承保人瀏覽器的外部數據商擴充**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **承保輔助可貼著瀏覽器走，但**要說清評分從哪來**；**② **面向具體崗位要寫明解釋責任**；**③ **薄客戶端意味著方法不可見**；**④ **評分進入承保流程**至少要給出**輸入、**更新頻率與**適用範圍**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝、**沒有使用**該擴充**，**不主張**其評分的正確性**、**方法是否合理**，**也不主張**其可用於任何核保、**定價或**承保決定**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀擴充登記介面返回的元資料**，**未讀**其包內容**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其評分的輸入數據來源、**計算方法、**更新頻率與**適用範圍**（**不作推測**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**發布者與任何保險公司的合作關係**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其是否需要付費或帳號才能取到評分**。**⑥ ⚠️ 日活為 0**，**不主張**它已被任何承保人使用**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 網絡安全評分屬第三方數據**，**用於核保前必須獨立驗證**。
entries.body_en:
This extension **puts a company cyber score inside the browser of an underwriter**, described verbatim as providing cyber underwriters with a way to obtain a company cyber score, so its stated audience is specifically cyber underwriters. **This entry belongs to the round theme of insurance tooling inside the browser.**

**Verified information, all measured from the Mozilla add-on registry interface**: **first, it moves underwriting material into the browser**, so while reading a company website, file or public information an underwriter can obtain a score on the spot. **That is a concrete form of underwriting assistance moving out of internal systems and into the browser, and it contrasts with another extension this round that comes from an agency management system vendor while this one comes from an outside data provider; read together they show the browser carrying two kinds of insurance tool at once, vendors extending their own systems into it and data providers pushing outside scores into it.** **Second, the stated audience is very narrow**, naming cyber underwriters. **Building a tool for one specific job role is uncommon in insurance technology, where most tools address the industry or agents as a whole, and the other side of that narrowness is that responsibility for interpreting the score falls on the role rather than on the tool.** **Third, the package is only twelve kilobytes, so the score must be computed server-side.** The version is 1.0.0, created in late March and last updated three days later, with the publisher homepage on a commercial site and a one-word display name. **The scoring method, its data sources and its refresh frequency therefore live on the server rather than in the extension, so all a user sees is a number and possibly an explanation, without seeing where it came from.** **Fourth, almost nothing is available for assessment**: no daily users, no ratings, an all-rights-reserved licence and no repository. **Nothing here allows the method, data sources or stability of the score to be assessed, so this entry does not claim the score can support any underwriting decision; it also notes plainly that a score used in underwriting should at least state which checkable inputs it rests on, how often it refreshes and to which sectors it applies, none of which the description provides.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover cyber risk, cyber risk platforms and classifications, and underwriting workbenches, **while this entry supplies an outside data provider extension that pushes a company cyber score into the underwriter browser. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: underwriting assistance can follow the underwriter browser, provided the origin of the score is stated; a tool aimed at a specific role should say who is accountable for interpretation; a thin client hides the method, so a substitute statement of definitions is needed; and a score entering an underwriting process should state its inputs, refresh frequency and scope.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the extension was neither installed nor used**, no score was obtained for any company, **so no claim is made about the correctness of its score, about whether its method is sound, or about its suitability for any underwriting, pricing or acceptance decision**. **Second, only the metadata returned by the registry was read**, not the package contents. **Third, the inputs, calculation method, refresh frequency and scope of its score were not verified, and this entry does not speculate about them.** **Fourth, any partnership between the publisher and any insurer was not verified. Fifth, whether payment or an account is required to obtain a score was not verified**, the homepage pointing at a commercial site. **Sixth, with no daily users this entry does not claim that any underwriter uses it. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that a cyber score is third-party data which must be independently validated and whose limits must be stated before it is used in underwriting.**

entries.title: **一份**把「**房主保险涨价**」与「**出租回报**」拼进**同一张县地图**的**静态图谱****：`groundtruth-atlas`——**⭐ 自述逐字**「**One county dashboard for housing return and homeowners-insurance risk.**」**；**⭐ 数据来源**逐字列出**Zillow Research、HUD FMR、Census ACS、美国财政部 FIO／NAIC PCMI、参议院预算委员会与 OpenFEMA****；**⭐ 县表**共 **2,995 行**，**⭐ 而**列名里**直接写着 **`prem2021_SOURCED`** 与 **`prem2025_MODELED`****；**⭐ 自评逐字**「**an editorial screening gauge, not an actuarial score**」**
entries.title_en: A static atlas that puts homeowners-insurance repricing and rental returns on one county map: it calls itself one county dashboard for housing return and homeowners-insurance risk, names its sources down to Zillow Research, HUD fair market rents, the Census ACS, the Treasury FIO and NAIC premium series, a Senate Budget Committee release and OpenFEMA, ships a county table of two thousand nine hundred ninety-five rows whose column names themselves mark which figures are sourced and which are modelled, and describes itself in writing as an editorial screening gauge rather than an actuarial score.
entries.title_hk: **一份**把「**房主保險漲價**」與「**出租回報**」拼進**同一張縣地圖**的**靜態圖譜****：`groundtruth-atlas`——**⭐ 自述逐字**「**One county dashboard for housing return and homeowners-insurance risk.**」**；**⭐ 數據來源**逐字列出**Zillow Research、HUD FMR、Census ACS、美國財政部 FIO／NAIC PCMI、參議院預算委員會與 OpenFEMA****；**⭐ 縣表**共 **2,995 行**，**⭐ 而**列名裡**直接寫着 **`prem2021_SOURCED`** 與 **`prem2025_MODELED`****；**⭐ 自評逐字**「**an editorial screening gauge, not an actuarial score**」**
entries.summary: **Groundtruth Atlas**（`topninja/groundtruth-atlas`）**是一份**把「**美国县级房主保险**」与「**出租回报**」**放进同一张地图**的**静态图谱****——**逐字自述为**「**One county dashboard for housing return and homeowners-insurance risk.**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 星标 **9****、**创建与推送**均在 **2026-09-11****、**仓库 **17,637 KB****、**主语言 **HTML****、**⚠️ 无许可证****；**⭐ 站点 **https://topninja.github.io/groundtruth-atlas/** 返回 **200**、**52,733 字节****；**⭐ 县表 **`cap-rate/data/processed/cap_rate_county.csv`** 返回 **200**、**307,657 字节**、**2,995 行****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**窗口内新建的项目**」**——**⭐ 即**本轮不再问「**老库这周又改了什么**」**，**而是问**「**这两周刚开始做、**且**已经拿得出东西的项目是哪些**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **列名把「**来源**」与「**建模**」分开写**（**`prem2021_SOURCED`**／**`prem2025_MODELED`**）**——**⭐ 即**出处**可以**下沉到**列名**里**，**而**不必**只写在**文档**里**；**② **自评逐字为**「**an editorial screening gauge, not an actuarial score**」**——**⭐ 即**作者**自己**写明**这**不是**精算分数**；**③ **重定价指数的四个权重逐字公开**（**0.35／0.25／0.20／0.20**）**——**⭐ 即**一个**筛选指标**的**秘密**常常**只有**权重**；**④ **口径限制逐条列出**（**FIO 公开数据止于 **2022****、**2023 的非续保率来自**参议院预算委员会**、**FAIR plan、Citizens 与超额与剩余市场不在 FIO 数据内**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未使用、**未复核**其**任何建模数字**。
entries.summary_hk: **Groundtruth Atlas**（`topninja/groundtruth-atlas`）**是一份**把「**美國縣級房主保險**」與「**出租回報**」**放進同一張地圖**的**靜態圖譜****——**逐字自述為**「**One county dashboard for housing return and homeowners-insurance risk.**」**。**本次實測**：**⭐ 星標 9**、**創建與推送**均在 **2026-09-11**、**倉庫 17,637 KB**、**主語言 HTML**、**⚠️ 無許可證**；**⭐ 站點**返回 **200**、**52,733 位元組**；**⭐ 縣表**返回 **200**、**307,657 位元組**、**2,995 行**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**窗口內新建的項目**」**——**⭐ 即**本輪不再問「**老庫這週又改了什麼**」**，**而是問**「**這兩週剛開始做、**且**已經拿得出東西的項目是哪些**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **列名把「**來源**」與「**建模**」分開寫**（**`prem2021_SOURCED`**／**`prem2025_MODELED`**）**；**② **自評逐字為**「**an editorial screening gauge, not an actuarial score**」**；**③ **重定價指數的四個權重逐字公開**（**0.35／0.25／0.20／0.20**）**；**④ **口徑限制逐條列出**（**FIO 公開數據止於 2022**、**2023 非續保率來自參議院預算委員會**、**FAIR plan、Citizens 與超額與剩餘市場不在 FIO 數據內**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未使用、**未覆核**其任何建模數字**。
entries.summary_en: **Groundtruth Atlas** is a static atlas that puts United States county-level homeowners insurance and rental returns on one map, describing itself verbatim as one county dashboard for housing return and homeowners-insurance risk. **Measured this round**: nine stars, created and pushed on the same day, a repository of roughly seventeen megabytes in HTML, no licence file, a live site returning two hundred with about fifty kilobytes, and a county table of two thousand nine hundred ninety-five rows of roughly three hundred kilobytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of projects newly created inside the window**, meaning the question this round is not what long-standing repositories changed this week but which projects were started in the last two weeks and already have something to show. **Four things are worth reading: the column names themselves separate sourced figures from modelled ones, with one column suffixed as sourced and another as modelled, so provenance lives in the schema rather than only in prose; the project describes itself in writing as an editorial screening gauge rather than an actuarial score; the four weights of its repricing index are published openly, which suggests that what is usually withheld in such an index is only the weighting; and the limitations are listed one by one, including that the public Treasury series ends in 2022, that non-renewal rates come from a Senate committee release, and that residual and excess markets are outside the federal data.** **Nothing was used and no modelled figure was re-derived this round.**
entries.body:
**Groundtruth Atlas**（`topninja/groundtruth-atlas`）**是一份**把「**美国县级房主保险**」与「**出租回报**」**拼进同一张地图**的**静态图谱****——**逐字自述为**「**One county dashboard for housing return and homeowners-insurance risk.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**窗口内新建的项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与站点实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 列名把「来源」与「建模」分开写****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**县表 **`cap-rate/data/processed/cap_rate_county.csv`** 返回 **200**、**307,657 字节**、**2,995 行**（**首行为列名**）**，**列名逐字包含 **`prem2021_SOURCED`**、**`prem2022_SOURCED`**、**`prem2025_MODELED`**、**`cap_at_current_ins_pct_MODELED`**、**`insurance_drag_bps`**、**`ins_pct_of_rent`**、**`nonrenew2023_pct`**、**`tax_rate_source`****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**这个数是查来的**」与「**这个数是我们算的**」**可以**不写在**文档**里**，**而是**写在**列名**里**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**一份**建模表**要**交给**别人**（**同事、**评审、**客户**）**，**则**「**把出处编码进字段名**」**是**成本极低、**收益很高**的做法**；**⭐ 而**它**同时**让**下游**无法**在**引用时**把**建模值**误当成**公开统计值**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 自评逐字写明「不是精算分数」****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**仓库 README（**9,529 字节**、**214 行**）**在**重定价指数**一节**逐字写道**「**The result is an editorial screening gauge, not an actuarial score.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一句**值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**一个分数**」**最难**的**不是**算出来**，**而是**说清**它**不能**用来**做什么**——**⭐ 该自述**正好**把**「**筛选**」与**「**精算**」**分开**，**而**这**与**本站**一贯强调的**「**风险沟通要看口径**」一致**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 指数的权重与公式逐字公开****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出**「**0.35 × premium-escalation percentile + 0.25 × 2023 non-renewal percentile + 0.20 × paid-loss-ratio percentile + 0.20 × recent-disaster-declaration percentile**」**；**⭐ 并逐字给出**租金回报口径**：「**gross income = 12 × monthly rent**」**、**「**operating stack = gross income × 23%**」**（**逐字注明由 **5% 空置、**8% 管理、**10% 维护与资本开支**组成**）**、**「**NOI = gross income − operating stack − property tax − premium**」**；**⭐ 2023 至 2025 的保费尾部**逐字为 **+12.7%**、**+10.4%**、**+6.0%****（**并逐字注明**「**These estimates are a national nowcast, not county quotes.**」**）**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 数据谱系与口径限制逐条列出****——**⭐ 逐字列出的来源包括**：**Zillow Research**（**2026 年 5 月文件**）**、**HUD Fair Market Rents**（**FY 2026**）**、**U.S. Census ACS**、**U.S. Treasury FIO 与 NAIC PCMI**（**2025 年 1 月发布、**数据止于 2022**）**、**U.S. Senate Budget Committee**（**2024 年 12 月发布、**数据止于 2023**）**、**OpenFEMA Disaster Declarations Summaries**、**Census ZCTA 与县关系文件**（**2020**）**、**S&P Global**（**作为 2023 至 2025 锚点**）**、**us-atlas 县界几何**（**counties-10m**）**；**⭐ 限制**逐字包括**：**ZHVI 是**中档自住房指数**、**不是**投资买入价**；**ZORI 是**要价租金**、**HUD FMR 是**第 40 百分位**、**两者**不等价**；**FIO 公开记录**为**经组合平滑的邮编均值**、**且**不覆盖**全部市场**；**每单保费**同时**反映**保障与保额变化**，**不只**反映**费率**；**FAIR plan、**Citizens 与**超额与剩余市场**都在**FIO 公开数据之外**；**县级汇总**掩盖**房产层面的差异**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程形态**：**⭐ 无构建步骤**（**逐字**「**There is no application build and no package install.**」**）**、**D3 与 TopoJSON 本地自带**（**逐字注明**「**no runtime CDN dependency**」**）**、**地图色阶按**第 3 至 97 百分位**计算**（**逐字注明**以免**极端值**把**整张图压平**）**、**县税率缺失或非法时**用 **1.1% 回退值**并**在**档案卡里**标注**；**⭐ 页面状态**用**URL 片段**编码**（**参数逐字为 **`m`**、**`l`**、**`y`**、**`s`**、**`c`**、**`v`****）**；**⭐ 仓库里**另有**两条**可重跑管线**（**`cap-rate/pipeline/fetch.sh` + `build.py`**、**`premium/pipeline/fetch.sh` + `build.py`**）**，**且**原始件**（**ACS 数据文件、**FMR 表格**）**随仓库提供**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[gip125-auto-loss-cost]] 覆盖**车险损失成本报告**、**[[catrisk-sim]] 覆盖**巨灾组合损失模拟**、**[[parametric-risk-toolkit]] 覆盖**参数化风险**、**[[climada-petals]] 覆盖**气候风险建模**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把公开监管与行业数据**直接**拼成**面向**县级地图**的**可浏览图谱**」这一形态**，**并且**把**保费与租金回报**放在**同一个选择上下文**里**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的五件事**：**① **把出处写进列名**（**`_SOURCED`**／**`_MODELED`**）**；**② **对自己造的指标**，**主动**写明**它不能用来做什么**；**③ **公开权重**，**让**指数**可被质疑**；**④ **把**数据年份**与**发布年份**分开记**（**本条里**数据止于 2022**、**发布在 2025 年 1 月**）**；**⑤ **对**聚合数据**要**先说明**它**掩盖了什么**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有使用**该图谱**（**未在浏览器里操作地图**、**未下载其数据后重算**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何指标**的**数值正确性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据、**README 文本**、**站点响应头与字节数**、**县表首行与行数**，**未逐行核对**数据内容**。**③ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**——**⚠️ 本词条**如实指出**：**「**可公开阅读**」**与**「**已授予使用许可**」**在**法律上**是**两件事**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**模型口径**是否**适用于**美国以外市场**（**⭐ 其数据全部为**美国来源**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**任何**保险公司的关系**（**⭐ 逐字署名**只提到**原作者与两项前身项目**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该图谱**是**筛选工具**，**不是**精算意见**，**也**不是**投资建议**。
entries.body_hk:
**Groundtruth Atlas**（`topninja/groundtruth-atlas`）**是一份**把「**美國縣級房主保險**」與「**出租回報**」**拼進同一張地圖**的**靜態圖譜****——**逐字自述為**「**One county dashboard for housing return and homeowners-insurance risk.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**窗口內新建的項目**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與站點實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 列名把「來源」與「建模」分開寫****——**縣表**返回 **200**、**307,657 位元組**、**2,995 行**，**列名逐字包含 **`prem2021_SOURCED`**、**`prem2022_SOURCED`**、**`prem2025_MODELED`**、**`cap_at_current_ins_pct_MODELED`**、**`insurance_drag_bps`**、**`ins_pct_of_rent`**、**`nonrenew2023_pct`**、**`tax_rate_source`****。**⭐ 即**「**這個數是查來的**」與「**這個數是我們算的**」**可以**不寫在文檔裡**，**而是**寫在列名裡**——**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**把出處編碼進欄位名**成本極低、**收益很高**，**且**令**下游**無法**把建模值**誤當成**公開統計值**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 自評逐字寫明「不是精算分數」****——**README（**9,529 位元組**、**214 行**）**逐字寫道**「**The result is an editorial screening gauge, not an actuarial score.**」**；**⭐ 即**一個分數**最難**的不是**算出來**，**而是**說清**它不能做什麼**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 指數的權重與公式逐字公開****——**重定價指數逐字為**「**0.35 × premium-escalation percentile + 0.25 × 2023 non-renewal percentile + 0.20 × paid-loss-ratio percentile + 0.20 × recent-disaster-declaration percentile**」**；**租金口徑**逐字為**月租乘 12**、**營運堆疊 23%**（**逐字由 5% 空置、**8% 管理、**10% 維護與資本開支組成**）**；**2023 至 2025 保費尾部**逐字為 **+12.7%**、**+10.4%**、**+6.0%****，**並逐字註明**這是**全國 nowcast**、**不是**縣級報價**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 數據譜系與口徑限制逐條列出****——**來源逐字包括**Zillow Research**（**2026 年 5 月檔案**）**、**HUD FMR**（**FY 2026**）**、**Census ACS**、**美國財政部 FIO 與 NAIC PCMI**（**2025 年 1 月發布、**數據止於 2022**）**、**參議院預算委員會**（**2024 年 12 月發布、**數據止於 2023**）**、**OpenFEMA**、**Census ZCTA 與縣關係檔**（**2020**）**、**S&P Global** 與 **us-atlas 縣界**；**限制逐字包括**：**ZHVI 不是投資買入價**、**ZORI 與 HUD FMR 不等價**、**FIO 記錄為經平滑的郵編均值**、**每單保費同時反映保障變化**、**FAIR plan、**Citizens 與**超額與剩餘市場**不在**FIO 數據內**、**縣級匯總掩蓋**房產層面差異**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程形態**：**無構建步驟**、**D3 與 TopoJSON 本地自帶**（**無執行期 CDN 依賴**）**、**色階按第 3 至 97 百分位計算**、**縣稅率缺失時用 1.1% 回退值並在檔案卡標註**、**頁面狀態用 URL 片段編碼**（**`m`**、**`l`**、**`y`**、**`s`**、**`c`**、**`v`****）**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[gip125-auto-loss-cost]]、[[catrisk-sim]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]、[[climada-petals]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把公開監管與行業數據拼成**面向**縣級地圖**的**可瀏覽圖譜**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **把出處寫進列名**；**② **主動寫明指標不能做什麼**；**③ **公開權重**；**④ **分開記數據年份與發布年份**；**⑤ **先說明聚合數據掩蓋了什麼**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有使用**該圖譜**，**不主張**其任何指標的數值正確性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料、**README 文本**、**站點字節數**與**縣表首行與行數**，**未逐行核對數據內容**。**③ ⚠️ 該倉庫**無許可證檔案**——**「**可公開閱讀**」與「**已授予使用許可**」在法律上是兩件事**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其口徑是否適用於美國以外市場**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其與任何保險公司的關係**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該圖譜是篩選工具**，**不是**精算意見**，**也**不是**投資建議**。
entries.body_en:
**Groundtruth Atlas** is a static atlas that puts United States county-level homeowners insurance and rental returns on a single map, describing itself verbatim as one county dashboard for housing return and homeowners-insurance risk. **This entry belongs to the round theme of projects newly created inside the window.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the live site**:

**First, the column names themselves separate sourced figures from modelled ones.** The county table in the repository returns two hundred with roughly three hundred kilobytes and two thousand nine hundred ninety-five rows, and its header names columns whose suffixes mark provenance directly, including premium columns suffixed as sourced for the earlier years and as modelled for the projected year, together with insurance drag in basis points, insurance as a share of rent, a non-renewal percentage, and a column naming the source of each county tax rate. **The distinction between a figure that was looked up and a figure that was computed can therefore live in the schema rather than only in prose.** **For a student who has to hand a modelled table to somebody else, encoding provenance in field names costs almost nothing and prevents a downstream reader from mistaking a modelled value for an official statistic.**

**Second, the project states in writing that it is not an actuarial score.** The repository description, which runs to about nine and a half kilobytes over two hundred and fourteen lines, says verbatim that the result is an editorial screening gauge and not an actuarial score. **What is hardest about publishing a score is not computing it but stating what it must not be used for, and this sentence draws the line between screening and actuarial work.**

**Third, the weights and formulas of the index are published openly.** The repricing index is given verbatim as a weighted sum of four percentile ranks, with the weights stated as thirty-five, twenty-five, twenty, and twenty hundredths for premium escalation, non-renewal, paid loss ratio, and recent disaster declarations. The rental model is stated in the same place, with gross income as twelve months of rent, an operating stack of twenty-three percent broken down into vacancy, management, and maintenance assumptions, and net operating income as gross income minus that stack, property tax, and premium. The modelled premium tail for the recent years is given as increases of twelve point seven, ten point four, and six percent, and is labelled verbatim as a national nowcast rather than county quotes.

**Fourth, the data lineage and the limits of each source are listed one by one.** The named sources include Zillow Research files from this year, HUD fair market rents for the current fiscal year, the Census American Community Survey, the Treasury Federal Insurance Office premium series released in January 2025 with data through 2022, a Senate Budget Committee release from December 2024 with data through 2023, OpenFEMA disaster declarations, a Census postal-code to county relationship file, commercial rate anchors, and public county geometry. **The limitations are equally explicit: the home value index is not an investor purchase price; asking rent and the fair market rent fallback are not equivalent; the federal records are composition-smoothed postal-code means; premium per policy reflects coverage and insured value as well as rate; residual and excess markets fall outside the federal data; and county aggregation hides property-level differences.**

**Fifth, on engineering form**: there is no build step and no package install, the charting and geometry libraries are vendored locally rather than loaded from a content network at runtime, the map colour scale is computed between the third and ninety-seventh percentiles so that extremes do not flatten the map, a fallback tax rate is labelled wherever the county rate is missing, page state is encoded in the URL fragment through six short parameters, and two rebuild pipelines with their raw input files are included in the repository.

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover automotive loss costs, catastrophe portfolio simulation, parametric risk, and climate risk modelling, **while this entry supplies the form of a browsable county atlas assembled directly from public regulatory and industry data, keeping premium pressure and rental return inside one selection context. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: put provenance in the field names; state what a self-made indicator must not be used for; publish the weights so the index can be contested; record the data vintage separately from the publication date; and describe what aggregation hides before anyone uses the numbers.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the atlas was not used this round**, no map was operated in a browser and no data was downloaded and recomputed, **so no claim is made about the correctness of any figure**. **Second, only metadata, the description text, response sizes, and the header and row count of the county table were read**, and the data rows were not checked line by line. **Third, the repository carries no licence file**, and **being publicly readable and being licensed for use are two different things**. **Fourth, whether the methodology transfers outside the United States was not verified**, all of its sources being American. **Fifth, no relationship to any insurer was verified**, the only attribution naming the original author and two predecessor projects. **Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the atlas is a screening tool rather than an actuarial opinion or investment advice.**

entries.title: **一个**把「**车辆身份、**维修史与**证据**」当**基础设施**做、**并**把**保险公司**列为**下游**使用者的**平台仓库****：`motivra`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Vehicle intelligence & service infrastructure for Africa.**」**；**⭐ 逐字写明**目标**是**成为**「**the default rails on which insurers, dealers, fleets, parts suppliers and lenders operate**」**；**⭐ 实测**共 **241 个文件**（**74 个 Go、**24 个 SQL 迁移、**54 个前端 TS／TSX、**49 个 Markdown**）**；**⭐ 七条收入线逐字**按 **MVP → Wave 3／6／7** 排期**，**其中**「**Enterprise APIs**」**逐字为**「**Metered access for insurers, dealers, lenders, marketplaces**」**；**⭐ 许可证逐字为 **Apache-2.0****；**⭐ 而**其自述**逐字为**「**bootstrapped in September 2026**」**
entries.title_en: A platform repository that treats vehicle identity, service history, and evidence as infrastructure and lists insurers among its downstream users: it describes itself as vehicle intelligence and service infrastructure for Africa, states in writing that it aims to become the default rails on which insurers, dealers, fleets, parts suppliers and lenders operate, ships two hundred forty-one files of which seventy-four are Go, twenty-four are SQL migrations, and forty-nine are documentation, schedules seven revenue streams by phase with metered enterprise API access for insurers among them, carries an Apache licence, and says of itself that the repository was bootstrapped in September of this year.

entries.summary_en: This is a platform repository that treats vehicle service and its evidence chain as infrastructure, describing itself as vehicle intelligence and service infrastructure for Africa and stating in writing that it aims to become the default rails on which insurers, dealers, fleets, parts suppliers, and lenders operate. **Measured this round**: created on the eighth of September and last pushed the next day, a repository of about seven hundred kilobytes whose main language is Go, an Apache licence, two stars, and topic tags that include insurance technology, Kenya, mobile money, vehicle history, and offline-first operation; **the file tree holds two hundred forty-one files and about one and a half megabytes uncompressed, including seventy-four Go files, twenty-four SQL migrations, fifty-four front-end TypeScript files, and forty-nine documentation files**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of projects newly created inside the window.** **Four things are worth reading: insurance appears here as a downstream consumer rather than as the subject, because the product first builds vehicle identity, verifiable service history, and evidence, and only then lets insurers, dealers, fleets, and lenders connect to it; the seven revenue streams are scheduled by named phases from the minimum viable product to later waves, so the business model is written as checkable staged commitments; the repository describes itself in writing as having been bootstrapped this September and commits to a policy of no vanity metrics, plainly stating that there are no real customer figures yet; and the technology stack is given line by line with the reason each component earns its place, which makes the table itself useful preparation material for an engineering interview.** **The platform was neither deployed nor run this round, and whether its mobile money integration actually works was not verified.**
entries.body:
**Motivra**（`Roy-Wanyoike/Motivra`）**是一个**把「**车辆维修与**证据链**」做成**基础设施**的**平台仓库****——**逐字自述为**「**Vehicle intelligence & service infrastructure for Africa.**」**，**并**逐字写明**它**要成为**「**the default rails on which insurers, dealers, fleets, parts suppliers and lenders operate**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**窗口内新建的项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 保险在这里是**下游**，**而**不**是**主语****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README（**19,060 字节**、**271 行**）逐字把**问题**描述为**「**a **missing infrastructure layer**: vehicle identity, verified service history, and a coordinated service network**」**，**并逐字写道**「**Whoever builds that layer becomes the system of record for millions of vehicles**」**；**⭐ 而**保险**在**收入表**里**逐字**作为**接入方**出现**（**「**Enterprise APIs**」**一行**逐字为**「**Metered access for insurers, dealers, lenders, marketplaces**」**，**阶段**逐字为 **Wave 7+**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 RIAA **最有价值**：**⭐ 即**「**保险科技**」**不**只有**「**做一个**保险产品**」**一种**路径**——**⭐ 另**一条**是**先**掌握**一项**保险公司**必须**依赖的**数据**（**可验证的**维修与**检测证据**）**，**再**成为**它的**供应方**；**⭐ 而**这**正好**解释了**为什么**许多**保险创新**从**「**车况**」「**医疗记录**」「**房产风险**」**这类**上游数据**切入**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 七条收入线**逐字**按阶段**排期****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**七条**收入线**与**阶段**：**服务费**（**MVP**）**、**检测与报告**（**Wave 3**）**、**配件毛利**（**Wave 6**）**、**修理厂网络**（**Wave 6**）**、**车队 SaaS**（**Wave 7**，**逐字称为**「**the recurring-revenue engine**」**）**、**企业 API**（**Wave 7+**）**、**客户订阅**（**逐字为 **Later**）**；**⭐ 并逐字给出**经营纪律**「**optimize contribution margin + retention + customer satisfaction — never GMV alone**」**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**把**收入**拆成**「**现在就能收**」**与**「**以后**才收**」**两段**，**是**对**自己**与**投资人**都**诚实的**写法**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 「**Honest status**」**逐字**承认**起步阶段****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**This repository was bootstrapped in September 2026. It is at the very beginning: architecture and engineering governance land first, then implementation waves.**」**，**并逐字声明**「**We hold ourselves to a no-vanity-metrics policy — when numbers appear in this README, they will be real customers, real jobs, real revenue, real retention.**」**；**⭐ 而**本次**实测**仓库**并非**只有**文档**：**241 个文件**中**Go 74 个**、**SQL 迁移 **24 个**、**前端 **TS／TSX 54 个****——**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实记录**：**⭐ 即**「**自述**仍在**起步**」**与**「**已有**可数的**实现文件**」**同时**成立**，**两者**并不**矛盾**（**README 说的**是**架构与治理**先行**）**；**⭐ 但**本词条**不**据此**推断**其**功能完成度**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 技术栈**逐项**给出**理由****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**后端 **Go（**`chi`、**`connect-go`／gRPC、**`sqlc`、**`pgx`）**、**契约 **OpenAPI + Protobuf**、**数据 **PostgreSQL + PostGIS**、**缓存 **Redis**、**事件 **NATS JetStream**（**事件名逐字形如 **`vehicle.created.v1`**、**`payment.completed.v1`**）**、**工作流 **Temporal**、**对象存储 **S3 兼容**、**搜索 **OpenSearch**、**分析 **ClickHouse**、**前端 **Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + TanStack Query + Zod**、**移动端 **React Native + SQLite（**逐字注明**离线优先：**本地状态、**发件箱、**同步队列、**冲突解决**）**、**基础设施 **Docker／Kubernetes／Helm／OpenTofu／Argo CD**、**可观测 **OpenTelemetry／Prometheus／Grafana／Loki／Tempo****；**⭐ 并逐字说明**推送通道**为 **SMS 与 WhatsApp**、**支付**为 **M-Pesa 优先**且**金额**以**整数**最小单位**记账**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一节**可直接**当作**面试材料**：**⭐ 即**「**你**为什么**选它**」**比**「**你**用了**什么**」**更**能**说明**工程判断**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[hedvig-ugglan]] 覆盖**数字保险公司**自建并**开源**的平台**、**[[xcover-php-sdk]] 覆盖**保险 API 的**接入层**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**车辆维修与**证据链**为**入口**、**把**保险**放在**下游**的**新兴市场**基础设施**」这一形态**（**⭐ 逐字面向**肯尼亚**内罗毕**起步**）**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **想清**「**谁**是**上游数据**、**谁**是**下游买家**」**；**② **收入线**按阶段**排期**，**并**写明**现在**不收**什么钱**；**③ **把**没有的数字**写成**「**还没有**」**，**而**不**用**别的东西**顶替**；**④ **技术选型**要**配**理由**；**⑤ **离线优先**在**新兴市场**是**前提**、**不**是**卖点**；**⑥ **保险**可以是**你的**客户**，**而**不**一定**是**你的**产品**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有部署、**没有运行**该平台**（**未安装 **Go 依赖**、**未起**任何服务、**未调用**任何支付通道**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何功能**可用**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**、**README 全文**与**仓库树**（**文件名与**字节数**）**，**未读**其**Go 源码**与 **SQL 迁移**内容**。**③ ⚠️ README **含**面向**投资人的**章节**（**逐字含**「**For investors**」**）**，**⚠️ 本词条**只**转述**其中**可核实**的**表述**，**不**对其**商业判断**作**评述**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **M-Pesa**、**SMS／WhatsApp** 与**任何**第三方服务的**集成**是否**真的打通**（**⭐ 只**见**自述与**依赖选择**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**任何**保险公司、**车队或**修理厂**的关系**；**⭐ 星标仅 **2****，**⚠️ 本词条**不**把**关注度**当成**质量**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**代码**与**文档**之间**是否**一致**（**例如**迁移**是否**可跑、**事件**是否**真的**发布**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该仓库**是**平台工程**，**不是**保险产品**，**也**不是**承保或**投资意见**。

**Motivra**（`Roy-Wanyoike/Motivra`）**是一個**把「**車輛維修與**證據鏈**」做成**基礎設施**的**平台倉庫****——**逐字自述為**「**Vehicle intelligence & service infrastructure for Africa.**」**，**並**逐字寫明**它**要成為**「**the default rails on which insurers, dealers, fleets, parts suppliers and lenders operate**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**窗口內新建的項目**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 保險在這裡是下游，**而**不是主語****——**README（**19,060 位元組**、**271 行**）逐字把問題描述為**「**a missing infrastructure layer: vehicle identity, verified service history, and a coordinated service network**」**；**保險**在收入表裡**逐字**作為**接入方**出現**（**Enterprise APIs** 一行逐字為**「**Metered access for insurers, dealers, lenders, marketplaces**」**，**階段逐字為 **Wave 7+**）**；**⭐ 即**保險科技**不只有**「**做一個保險產品**」**一條路**——**另**一條**是**先掌握**保險公司**必須依賴的**數據**（**可驗證的**維修與檢測證據**）**，**再**成為**其供應方**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 七條收入線**逐字**按階段**排期****——**服務費（**MVP**）**、**檢測與報告（**Wave 3**）**、**配件毛利與**修理廠網絡（**Wave 6**）**、**車隊 SaaS（**Wave 7**，**逐字為 the recurring-revenue engine**）**、**企業 API（**Wave 7+**）**、**客戶訂閱（**逐字 Later**）**；**並逐字給出**經營紀律**「**optimize contribution margin + retention + customer satisfaction — never GMV alone**」**。

**⭐⭐ ③ Honest status 逐字承認起步階段****——**逐字**「**This repository was bootstrapped in September 2026.**」**與**「**We hold ourselves to a no-vanity-metrics policy — when numbers appear in this README, they will be real customers, real jobs, real revenue, real retention.**」**；**而**實測倉庫**並非**只有文檔**：**241 個檔案**中**Go 74 個**、**SQL 遷移 24 個**、**前端 TS／TSX 54 個****——**⭐ 即**「**自述仍在起步**」**與**「**已有可數的實現檔案**」**同時成立**，**但本詞條**不**據此推斷**功能完成度**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 技術棧逐項給出理由****——**後端 **Go（`chi`、**`connect-go`／gRPC、**`sqlc`、**`pgx`）**、**契約 **OpenAPI + Protobuf**、**數據 **PostgreSQL + PostGIS**、**事件 **NATS JetStream**（**逐字形如 **`vehicle.created.v1`**、**`payment.completed.v1`**）**、**工作流 **Temporal**、**分析 **ClickHouse**、**前端 **Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui**、**移動端 **React Native + SQLite（**逐字註明離線優先**：**本地狀態、**發件箱、**同步隊列、**衝突解決**）**、**可觀測 **OpenTelemetry／Prometheus／Grafana／Loki／Tempo****；**推送逐字為 **SMS 與 WhatsApp**，**支付逐字為 **M-Pesa 優先**且**金額以整數最小單位記賬**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[hedvig-ugglan]]、[[xcover-php-sdk]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**以車輛維修與證據鏈為入口、**把保險放在下游的新興市場基礎設施**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **想清上游數據與下游買家**；**② **收入線按階段排期**；**③ **沒有的數字就寫還沒有**；**④ **選型要配理由**；**⑤ **離線優先在新興市場是前提**；**⑥ **保險可以是你的客戶**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有部署、**沒有運行**該平台**，**不主張**其任何功能可用**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料**、**README 全文**與**倉庫樹**，**未讀**其 Go 源碼與 SQL 遷移內容**。**③ ⚠️ README **含**面向投資人的章節**，**本詞條**只轉述可核實的表述**，**不**對其商業判斷作評述**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其 M-Pesa、**SMS／WhatsApp** 與任何第三方服務的集成是否真的打通**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其與任何保險公司、**車隊或修理廠的關係**；**星標僅 2**，**本詞條**不**把關注度當成質量**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其代碼與文檔是否一致**（**例如遷移是否可跑、**事件是否真的發布**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該倉庫是平台工程**，**不是**保險產品**，**也**不是**承保或投資意見**。
entries.body_en:
This is a platform repository that treats vehicle service and its evidence chain as infrastructure, describing itself as vehicle intelligence and service infrastructure for Africa and stating in writing that it aims to become the default rails on which insurers, dealers, fleets, parts suppliers, and lenders operate. **This entry belongs to the round theme of projects newly created inside the window.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface**:

**First, insurance appears here downstream rather than as the subject.** The description of about nineteen kilobytes over two hundred seventy-one lines frames the problem in writing as a missing infrastructure layer of vehicle identity, verified service history, and a coordinated service network, and states that whoever builds that layer becomes the system of record for millions of vehicles. **Insurance appears in the revenue table as a consumer, where the enterprise interface row reads verbatim as metered access for insurers, dealers, lenders, and marketplaces at a later phase.** **This matters for a student because insurance technology is not only a matter of building an insurance product: another route is to own data that an insurer must depend on, such as verifiable repair and inspection evidence, and to become its supplier, which is exactly why so much insurance innovation enters through upstream data about vehicles, medical records, or property risk.**

**Second, seven revenue streams are scheduled by named phase.** The description lists a service fee at the minimum viable product stage, inspections and reports at the third wave, parts margin and a garage network at the sixth, fleet software subscriptions at the seventh where they are called the recurring-revenue engine, metered enterprise interface access beyond that, and a customer subscription left to a later stage. **It also states an operating discipline of optimising contribution margin, retention, and customer satisfaction rather than gross merchandise value alone, which is a written way of separating what can be charged now from what is only charged later.**

**Third, the project admits its early stage in writing.** The description says the repository was bootstrapped this September and is at the very beginning, with architecture and engineering governance landing first and implementation waves after, and commits to a policy of no vanity metrics, promising that any numbers appearing later will be real customers, jobs, revenue, and retention. **Measured against that, the tree is not documentation only: of two hundred forty-one files, seventy-four are Go, twenty-four are SQL migrations, and fifty-four are front-end TypeScript files.** **The statements that the project is early and that countable implementation files exist are both true and do not contradict each other, but this entry does not infer functional completeness from file counts.**

**Fourth, the technology stack is given with a reason per component.** Go services with explicit routing, contract, and database tooling, contract-first interfaces, a relational store with geospatial support, an event log with versioned domain events, a durable workflow engine, object storage, a search engine, a columnar analytics store, a typed front-end stack, an offline-first mobile client with local state and a sync queue, declarative infrastructure with continuous delivery, and an observability set from metrics to traces. **The description also states that notifications are delivered through messaging channels people already use and that payments start with mobile money, with amounts held as integer minor units.** **A table of this kind, in which every choice carries its justification, is directly usable as interview preparation, because why a component was chosen says more about engineering judgement than what was chosen.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a digital insurer own platform released as open source and an insurance interface software development kit, **while this entry supplies the form of emerging-market infrastructure that enters through vehicle service evidence and places insurance downstream, starting from a single African city. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: work out who owns the upstream data and who buys downstream; schedule revenue streams by phase and write down what is not charged yet; write missing numbers as missing rather than substituting something else; justify each technology choice; treat offline operation as a premise in emerging markets rather than a feature; and remember that an insurer can be your customer without being your product.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the platform was neither deployed nor run**, no dependencies were installed, no service was started, and no payment channel was called, **so no claim is made that any of its functionality works**. **Second, only repository metadata, the description in full, and the file tree with names and sizes were read**, not the Go source or the SQL migrations. **Third, the description includes a section addressed to investors, and this entry only transcribes the verifiable statements without commenting on the commercial judgement.** **Fourth, whether its mobile money, messaging, or any third-party integrations actually work was not verified**, only the stated intent and dependency choices being recorded. **Fifth, no relationship to any insurer, fleet operator, or repair network was verified, and with only two stars this entry does not treat attention as a measure of quality. Sixth, whether the code and the documentation agree, for instance whether the migrations run or the events are really published, was not verified. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the repository is platform engineering rather than an insurance product or an underwriting or investment opinion.**

entries.title: **一个**把**健康险理赔裁决**做成**三代理串行**、**再**用**确定性闸门**收口的**可观测系统****：`meridian-claims-observability`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**not a toy example**」**；**⭐ 三代理**逐字为**保单核验、病史查询、欺诈与例外**，**再**接**一个 deterministic decision gate****；**⭐ 工具**逐字**经 **MCP（stdio）** 调用**而**不是**直接函数调用**（**`check_coverage`／`lookup_medical_history`／`fraud_score`**）**；**⭐ 本地模型**逐字为 **Ollama `qwen2.5:7b`（6GB 显存）**，**回退**为 **OpenRouter 免费层****；**⭐ 评测**逐字**由真实 **Langfuse Dataset** 支撑**（**逐字**「**not a hardcoded fixture**」**）**；**⭐ 许可证**逐字为 **MIT**
entries.title_en: A health-insurance claims-adjudication system built as three sequential agents closed by a deterministic gate, and instrumented end to end: it states in writing that it is not a toy example, runs policy verification, medical history, and fraud-and-exception agents behind a deterministic decision gate, has its agents call tools through a standard protocol server rather than direct function calls, uses a local seven-billion-parameter model on a six-gigabyte card with a free hosted fallback, backs its evaluation dashboard with a real observability dataset rather than a hardcoded fixture, and carries an MIT licence.
entries.title_hk: **一個**把**健康險理賠裁決**做成**三代理串行**、**再**用**確定性閘門**收口的**可觀測系統****：`meridian-claims-observability`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**not a toy example**」**；**⭐ 三代理**逐字為**保單核驗、病史查詢、欺詐與例外**，**再**接**deterministic decision gate****；**⭐ 工具**逐字**經 **MCP（stdio）** 調用**而**不是**直接函數調用**；**⭐ 本地模型**逐字為 **Ollama `qwen2.5:7b`（6GB 顯存）**，**回退**為 **OpenRouter 免費層****；**⭐ 評測**逐字由**真實 **Langfuse Dataset** 支撐**（**逐字**「**not a hardcoded fixture**」**）**；**⭐ 許可證**逐字為 **MIT**
entries.summary: **Meridian Claims**（`ashishpatel26/CNCF-LLM-Observability-Multi-Agent-Demo`）**是一个**健康险理赔裁决的**多代理演示系统****——**逐字自述为**「**A real, running health-insurance claims-adjudication system**」**，**并**逐字声明**「**not a toy example**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 星标 **2****、**复刻 **2****、**创建 **2026-09-04T05:59:36Z****、**最后推送 **2026-09-06T08:57:24Z****、**仓库 **3,298 KB****、**许可证逐字 **MIT****、**主语言 **HTML****、**主题标签 **14 个****；**⭐ 其文档站点 **https://ashishpatel26.github.io/CNCF-LLM-Observability-Multi-Agent-Demo/** 返回 **200**、**15,263 字节****；**⭐ README **10,122 字节**／**174 行****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**窗口内新建的项目**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **LLM 代理之后**接**一个**确定性闸门**（**逐字 **deterministic decision gate**）**——**⭐ 即**「**模型提意见、**规则做决定**」**这一**分工**在**理赔场景**里**是可审计的**前提**；**② **工具**逐字**经过 **MCP 服务器**调用****（**逐字注明**「**agents call tools through CrewAI MCP adapter, not direct function calls**」**）**——**⭐ 即**工具**与**代理**解耦**，**同一个**工具层**可以**换**编排框架**；**③ **评测**逐字**由真实 **Langfuse Dataset** 支撑**（**逐字**「**not a hardcoded fixture**」**）**，**并逐字记录**一次**真实事故**：**开发期**一个**种子数据缺口**让**某笔理赔**路由错误**，**正是**被**评测发现**并**修好**；**④ **可**在**便宜的硬件上**跑起来**（**逐字**：**本地 **Ollama `qwen2.5:7b`** 跑在 **6GB 显存**上**、**回退 **OpenRouter 免费层**、**逐字注明**「**No Docker/Podman required**」**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未部署、**未运行**该系统**（**⭐ 其登录闸门**逐字为 **`admin`**／**`admin`**，**并**自述**「**demo-only, not a real auth boundary**」**）**。
entries.summary_hk: **Meridian Claims**（`ashishpatel26/CNCF-LLM-Observability-Multi-Agent-Demo`）**是一個**健康險理賠裁決的**多代理演示系統****——**逐字自述為**「**A real, running health-insurance claims-adjudication system**」**，**並**逐字聲明**「**not a toy example**」**。**本次實測**：**⭐ 星標 2**、**複刻 2**、**創建 2026-09-04T05:59:36Z**、**最後推送 2026-09-06T08:57:24Z**、**倉庫 3,298 KB**、**許可證逐字 MIT**、**主語言 HTML**、**主題標籤 14 個**；**⭐ 文檔站點**返回 **200**、**15,263 位元組**；**⭐ README 10,122 位元組／174 行**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**窗口內新建的項目**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **LLM 代理之後**接**確定性閘門**（**deterministic decision gate**）**——**⭐ 即**「**模型提意見、**規則做決定**」**；**② **工具**逐字**經 **MCP 伺服器**調用**（**逐字**agents call tools through CrewAI MCP adapter, not direct function calls**）**；**③ **評測**逐字由**真實 Langfuse Dataset** 支撐**（**逐字**not a hardcoded fixture**）**，**並記錄**一次**真實事故**：**種子數據缺口**令**某筆理賠**路由錯誤**，**被評測發現並修好**；**④ **可在**便宜硬件上跑**（**本地 qwen2.5:7b 跑在 6GB 顯存**、**回退 OpenRouter 免費層**、**逐字**No Docker/Podman required**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未部署、**未運行**該系統**（**⭐ 其登入閘門逐字為 **`admin`**／**`admin`****，**並自述**「**demo-only, not a real auth boundary**」**）**。
entries.summary_en: This is a health-insurance claims-adjudication demonstration system built from three sequential agents, describing itself in writing as a real, running claims-adjudication system and explicitly as not a toy example. **Measured this round**: two stars, two forks, created on the fourth of September and last pushed on the sixth, a repository of roughly three megabytes, an MIT licence, and fourteen topic tags; **its documentation site returned two hundred with about fifteen kilobytes, and its description runs to ten kilobytes over one hundred seventy-four lines**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of projects newly created inside the window.** **Four things are worth reading: the language-model agents are closed by a deterministic decision gate, which is what makes the division between a model that proposes and a rule that decides auditable in claims work; tools are reached through a standard protocol server rather than by direct function calls, so the tool layer is decoupled from the orchestration framework; the evaluation dashboard is backed by a real observability dataset rather than a hardcoded fixture, and the project records a genuine incident in which a seed-data gap let a claim route incorrectly and was caught and fixed through evaluation; and the whole stack is meant to run on modest hardware, with a local seven-billion-parameter model on a six-gigabyte card, a free hosted fallback, and an explicit note that no container runtime is required.** **The system was not deployed or run this round, and its login gate is described as being for demonstration only rather than as a real authentication boundary.**
entries.body:
**Meridian Claims**（`ashishpatel26/CNCF-LLM-Observability-Multi-Agent-Demo`）**是一个**健康险理赔裁决的**多代理演示系统****——**逐字自述为**「**A real, running health-insurance claims-adjudication system**」**，**并**逐字声明**「**not a toy example**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**窗口内新建的项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 三代理之后**接**确定性闸门****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出**工作流**为**保单核验（**`check_coverage`**）→ 病史查询（**`lookup_medical_history`**）→ 欺诈与例外（**`fraud_score`**）→ 决策闸门（**逐字 **deterministic**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**在**理赔**这类**有**金钱后果**的**流程**里**，**「**谁做决定**」**必须**能**在**事后**指认**——**⭐ 若**决定**由**模型**给出**，**则**审计**只能**复现**一次**概率**；**⭐ 若**决定**由**规则**给出**，**而**模型**只**提供**输入**与**理由**，**则**每一次**拒绝或**赔付**都**可以**被**逐条**解释**；**⭐ 这是**把**AI 放进**受监管流程**的**第一步**分工**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 工具层**经过 **MCP**，**而**不是**直接调用****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**a local MCP server (stdio) serving `check_coverage`, `lookup_medical_history`, `fraud_score`**」**，**并逐字注明**「**agents call tools through CrewAI MCP adapter, not direct function calls**」**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一点**对 RIAA **尤其有用**：**⭐ 即**工具**与**编排框架**解耦**之后**，**同一套**工具**可以**换**框架**（**逐字提到的 **CrewAI** 只是**当前选择**）**，**而**工具**本身**可以**被**单独**测试**与**替换**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 评测**有真实数据集**，**并**记录了**一次真实事故****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写明**评测仪表盘**「**shows decision-routing pass/fail per seeded claim, backed by a real Langfuse Dataset — not a hardcoded fixture**」**；**⭐ 并逐字写道**：**开发期**「**A real failure was caught and fixed this way during development (a seed-data gap that let a claim route incorrectly)**」**，**细节**见其**演示脚本文件**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一条**是**本轮**最值得**别的项目**学的**：**⭐ 即**把**「**评测抓到过什么**」**写进**文档**，**比**把**「**我们很重视评测**」**写进**文档**有用**得多**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 全链路可观测的工具选择****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**逐字技术栈**为**后端 **Python 3.12（`uv`）**、**CrewAI（顺序流程）**、**FastAPI、**SQLite****；**可观测**逐字为**Langfuse Cloud**，**含**追踪、**会话（**每笔理赔一个**）**、**用户（**按患者标注**）**、**数据集与**数据集运行**与**评分**，**并**另有**一个**由应用自管的 **LLM 裁判**做**持续的**有据性打分**；**⭐ README 逐字说明**分工**：**SQLite 是**应用自己的**运营存储**，**Langfuse 是**可观测与评测的**记录系统**，**界面里**每一个**查看追踪**的链接**都**指回**它**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 跑起来**的门槛**写得**很低****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**逐字写明**本地 **Ollama `qwen2.5:7b`** 跑在 **6GB 显存** 的 **GPU** 上**，**回退**为 **OpenRouter 免费层**；**逐字注明**「**No Docker/Podman required**」**；**⭐ 并逐字说明**登录闸门**为 **`admin`**／**`admin`**、**且**「**demo-only, not a real auth boundary**」**——**⭐ 本词条**如实转述**这一句**：**⭐ 即**作者**自己**标注了**它**不是**安全边界**，**而**这**正好**是**学生**做**演示系统**时**应当**有的**自觉**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[claims-integrity-investigator]] 覆盖**理赔侧的**确定性与**欺诈指标审查**、**[[azure-medical-claims-processing]] 覆盖**云厂商的**医疗理赔参考实现**、**[[insurance-fraud-frozen-demo]] 覆盖**车险欺诈的**演示空间**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**多代理 + **MCP 工具层** + **确定性闸门** + **真实评测数据集**」**这一**组合**，**并且**把**本地小模型**的**可行性**写成了**前提**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **模型提意见**、**规则做决定**；**② **工具**放**协议层**（**MCP**）**，**不**写死在**框架里**；**③ **评测集**要**是**真的**数据集**，**而**不是**代码里的**硬编码样本**；**④ **把**评测抓到的事故**写进**文档**；**⑤ **演示系统**的**认证**要**自己**标注**不是**安全边界**；**⑥ **在**6GB 显存**与**免费层**上**把**整条链**跑通**，**是**可复现的**最低标准**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有部署、**没有运行**该系统**（**未跑 **`uv run`** 任何命令**、**未起**前后端、**未调用**任何模型或可观测服务**）**，**故**不主张**其**裁决逻辑**的**正确性**、**也**不主张**其**评测结果**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**、**README 文本**、**仓库树条目**与**文档站点响应**，**未读**其**源代码**与 **`PRD.md`** 内容**。**③ ⚠️ 其自述**「**real, running**」**与**「**not a toy example**」**均为**作者**表述**，**⚠️ 本词条**如实转述**，**未**独立验证**其**在**真实业务规模**下的**表现**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**工具返回的**病患与**保单数据**是**模拟数据**（**⭐ README 逐字提到 **`mcp_server.py`** 内含 **mock data**，**故**本条**按**模拟数据**理解**，**并**标注为**依据自述**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**任何**健康险公司**的关系**；**⚠️ 并如实指出**：**本项目**名称**含 **CNCF**，**但**本条**只**按**仓库自述**记录**，**未**主张**其**为**任何基金会的**正式项目**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该系统**是**工程演示**，**不是**理赔决定**，**也**不是**合规意见**。
entries.body_hk:
**Meridian Claims**（`ashishpatel26/CNCF-LLM-Observability-Multi-Agent-Demo`）**是一個**健康險理賠裁決的**多代理演示系統****——**逐字自述為**「**A real, running health-insurance claims-adjudication system**」**，**並**逐字聲明**「**not a toy example**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**窗口內新建的項目**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 三代理之後**接**確定性閘門****——**工作流逐字為**保單核驗（**`check_coverage`**）→ 病史查詢（**`lookup_medical_history`**）→ 欺詐與例外（**`fraud_score`**）→ 決策閘門（**逐字 deterministic**）**；**⭐ 即**在理賠這類**有金錢後果的流程裡**，**「**誰做決定**」**必須**事後可指認**——**決定由規則給出**、**模型只提供輸入與理由**，**每次拒絕或賠付才可被逐條解釋**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 工具層經過 MCP，**而**不是直接調用****——**逐字**「**a local MCP server (stdio) serving `check_coverage`, `lookup_medical_history`, `fraud_score`**」**，**並逐字註明**「**agents call tools through CrewAI MCP adapter, not direct function calls**」**；**⭐ 即**工具與編排框架解耦**，**同一套工具可換框架**，**亦可單獨測試與替換**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 評測有真實數據集，**並**記錄了一次真實事故****——**逐字**「**backed by a real Langfuse Dataset — not a hardcoded fixture**」**；**並逐字寫道**開發期**「**A real failure was caught and fixed this way during development (a seed-data gap that let a claim route incorrectly)**」**；**⭐ 即**把**「**評測抓到過什麼**」**寫進文檔**，**比**寫**「**我們很重視評測**」**有用得多**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 全鏈路可觀測的工具選擇****——**技術棧逐字為**Python 3.12（`uv`）、**CrewAI（順序流程）**、**FastAPI、**SQLite**；**可觀測逐字為**Langfuse Cloud**（**追蹤、**會話每筆理賠一個、**用戶按患者標註、**數據集與評分**，**另有**應用自管的 LLM 裁判**做**持續有據性打分**）**；**README 逐字說明分工**：**SQLite 是應用運營存儲**，**Langfuse 是可觀測與評測的記錄系統**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 跑起來的門檻寫得很低****——**本地 **Ollama `qwen2.5:7b`** 跑在 **6GB 顯存**，**回退 **OpenRouter 免費層**，**逐字註明**「**No Docker/Podman required**」**；**登入閘門逐字為 **`admin`**／**`admin`****，**且逐字**「**demo-only, not a real auth boundary**」**——**⭐ 即**作者自己標註**它不是安全邊界**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[claims-integrity-investigator]]、[[azure-medical-claims-processing]]、[[insurance-fraud-frozen-demo]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**多代理 + MCP 工具層 + 確定性閘門 + 真實評測數據集**」**這一組合**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **模型提意見、**規則做決定**；**② **工具放協議層**；**③ **評測集要是真的數據集**；**④ **把評測抓到的事故寫進文檔**；**⑤ **演示系統的認證要自己標註**；**⑥ **在 6GB 顯存與免費層上跑通整條鏈**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有部署、**沒有運行**該系統**，**不主張**其裁決邏輯**的正確性**與**評測結果**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料、**README 文本**、**倉庫樹**與**文檔站點響應**，**未讀源碼與 PRD.md 內容**。**③ ⚠️ 其自述**「**real, running**」**與**「**not a toy example**」**均為作者表述**，**本詞條**只如實轉述**，**未**獨立驗證**其在真實業務規模下的表現**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**工具返回的病患與保單數據是否模擬**（**README 逐字提到 **`mcp_server.py`** 內含 **mock data**，**本條據此理解並標註來源為自述**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其與任何健康險公司的關係**；**⚠️ 本條**只按倉庫自述記錄**，**未主張**其為任何基金會的正式項目**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該系統是工程演示**，**不是**理賠決定**，**也**不是**合規意見**。
entries.body_en:
This is a health-insurance claims-adjudication demonstration built from three sequential agents, describing itself in writing as a real, running claims-adjudication system and explicitly as not a toy example. **This entry belongs to the round theme of projects newly created inside the window.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the language-model agents are closed by a deterministic gate.** The described workflow runs policy verification, medical history lookup, and fraud-and-exception scoring, and then a decision gate explicitly labelled deterministic. **In a process with monetary consequences the question of who decides has to be answerable afterwards, and if the decision comes from a rule while the model supplies inputs and reasons, every denial or payment can be explained line by line, which is the first division of labour required to put model assistance inside a regulated process.**

**Second, the tool layer is reached through a protocol server rather than by direct calls.** The description names a local protocol server over standard input and output exposing coverage checking, medical history lookup, and fraud scoring, and states verbatim that agents call tools through the orchestration framework adapter rather than by direct function calls. **Decoupling tools from the orchestration framework means the same tool layer can be carried to another framework and can be tested and replaced on its own.**

**Third, the evaluation has a real dataset behind it and the project records a real incident.** The description states that the dashboard shows decision-routing pass or fail per seeded claim backed by a real observability dataset rather than a hardcoded fixture, and records that a genuine failure was caught and fixed this way during development, namely a seed-data gap that let a claim route incorrectly, with the story kept in a presentation script file. **Writing down what the evaluation actually caught is far more useful to a reader than asserting that evaluation is taken seriously.**

**Fourth, the observability stack is chosen deliberately.** The stated stack is a recent Python runtime managed by a fast package runner, a sequential multi-agent framework, a modern web framework, and a local SQLite store, with tracing, sessions one per claim, users tagged by patient, and datasets with runs and scores held in a hosted observability platform, plus an application-managed language-model judge for continuous groundedness scoring. **The description also separates the roles: the local database is the application own operational store, while the observability platform is the system of record for tracing and evaluation, and every view-trace link in the interface points back to it.**

**Fifth, the entry cost is stated to be low.** A local seven-billion-parameter model runs on a six-gigabyte card as the primary, with a free hosted tier as fallback, and the description states that no container runtime is required. **The login gate is documented as a fixed demonstration pair of credentials and described in writing as being for demonstration only rather than as a real authentication boundary, which is exactly the self-labelling a student demonstration system ought to carry.**

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover deterministic claims-side integrity review, a cloud vendor medical claims reference, and a vehicle fraud demonstration space, **while this entry supplies the combination of multiple agents, a protocol-level tool layer, a deterministic decision gate, and a real evaluation dataset, and treats local small-model feasibility as a premise rather than a claim. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: let the model propose and the rule decide; put tools at a protocol layer instead of inside the framework; make the evaluation set a real dataset rather than samples hardcoded in the source; write down the incidents evaluation caught; label a demonstration login as not being a security boundary; and treat running the whole chain on a small local model and a free tier as the reproducibility floor.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the system was neither deployed nor run**, no command was executed, no front or back end was started, and no model or observability service was called, **so no claim is made about the correctness of its adjudication logic or about its evaluation results**. **Second, only repository metadata, the description text, the repository tree, and the documentation site response were read**, not the source or the product requirements document. **Third, the claims that it is real and running and not a toy example are the author own words and are transcribed without independent verification at realistic business scale.** **Fourth, whether the patient and policy data returned by the tools is synthetic was not verified independently**, the description naming mock data inside the protocol server module, which is recorded here as a claim taken from the description. **Fifth, no relationship to any health insurer was verified**, and although the project name contains a foundation acronym, this entry records only what the repository says and does not claim it to be an official foundation project. **Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the system is an engineering demonstration rather than a claims decision or a compliance opinion.**
