entries.summary_en: This is a dissertation reproducibility package of code and notebooks on contagion mitigation in stochastic insurance and reinsurance networks, stating in writing that the code was used in the production of a dissertation submitted for a masters course in financial mathematics with data science. **Measured this round**: created and pushed on the same evening about twenty-seven minutes apart, a repository of roughly sixty-five megabytes whose main language is notebook format, no stars, no licence, twenty files in all, comprising six Python modules between fourteen and thirty-one kilobytes, six notebooks of which the largest approaches fifty-eight megabytes, and a description of only six hundred eighty bytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of projects newly created inside the window and is this round only academic entry.** **Four things are worth reading: the relationship to the literature is stated in writing, the work extending published ruin-probability results for risk processes in stochastic networks, which is the part of a dissertation most worth showing because it says which step of the ladder the author stood on; the part left outside the dissertation is labelled in writing; the contagion channels are split into separate modules, one file per channel, which makes the structure legible to a reader outside the field; and the repository is at the same time thinly documented, with a description of a few hundred bytes and leftover system and compiled-python files committed alongside the code.** **None of its code was run this round.**
entries.body:
**Contagion Mitigation in Stochastic Insurance-Reinsurance Networks**（`hirshal/insurance-network-contagion`）**是一份**硕士论文的**代码与笔记本复现包****——**逐字自述为**「**Code used in the production of my dissertation**」**，**课程逐字为**「**MSc Financial Mathematics with Data Science**」（**University of Bath**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**窗口内新建的项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 与文献的关系逐字写清****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写明**其**扩展**的是**「**Ruin Probabilities for Risk Processes in Stochastic Networks**」**，**并**逐字署为 **Amini 等人（2023）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**对**一份**硕士论文**来说**，**最**值得**对外**暴露的**信息**不是**「**我做了很多**」**，**而是**「**我的结果**接在**谁的**哪一步**之后**」**——**⭐ 因为**只有**这一层**信息**让**读者**能**判断**你**贡献的边界**，**也**让**后来者**知道**能不能**接着**往下做**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 没有纳入论文的部分**也**逐字标出****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**三个**纾解渠道**为**「**bail-ins, bail-outs (NOT INCLUDED IN DISSERTATION) and price floors**」**，**并**逐字说明**价格下限**是在**抛售**构成**独立传染渠道时**考察的**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一处**同样**值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**我试过**但**没写进论文**」**与**「**我没做**」**是**两种**不同的**诚实**，**而**把**前者**标出来**，**对**读者**是**净收益**。**⭐ 而**本次**实测**仓库树**确实**同时**含 **`bailout_functions.py`（24 KB）** 与 **`augmented_exogenous_network_bailout.ipynb`（24,910 KB）****——**⭐ 即**代码**在**，**论文**不收**，**README **把**这一点**说明**了**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 结构按「**一种渠道一个模块**」拆开****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**20 个文件**中**6 个 Python 模块**逐字为 **`bailin_functions.py`（31 KB）**、**`firesale_functions.py`（27 KB）**、**`bailout_functions.py`（24 KB）**、**`endogenous_functions.py`（19 KB）**、**`functions.py`（18 KB）**、**`exogenous_functions.py`（14 KB）****；**6 个 notebook** 逐字为 **`augmented_exogenous_network_bailin.ipynb`（57,699 KB）**、**`augmented_exogenous_network_bailout.ipynb`（24,910 KB）**、**`endogenous_network_simulation.ipynb`（17,367 KB）**、**`augmented_exogenous_network_firesale.ipynb`（234 KB）**、**`exogenous_network_simulation.ipynb`（98 KB）**、**`cramer_lundberg.ipynb`（43 KB）****；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一结构**对**复现**有**实际帮助**：**⭐ 即**当**一条渠道**一个文件**时**，**读者**可以**只读**自己**关心**的**那条**；**⭐ 而**`cramer_lundberg.ipynb`** 说明**作者**把**经典**破产模型**也**单列**了一节**——**⭐ 即**把**课程**里**学过的**起点**与**论文**的**扩展**放在**同一仓库**里**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 仓库体感**：**文档稀薄、**体积几乎全是笔记本****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 仅 **680 字节**（**7 行**）**、**仓库 **65,278 KB****，**其中**6 个 notebook** 合计**约 **98 MB** 量级**（**⭐ 以**单个文件**字节数**相加**）**；**⭐ 并**实测**含 **`.DS_Store`（8 KB）** 与 **`__pycache__`** 下**6 个 **`.pyc`****（**逐字为 **cpython-312**，**即**环境**为 **Python 3.12**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**记录**这一体感**：**⭐ 即**一份**学术复现包**可以**同时**是**「**结果**可查**」**与**「**说明**很少**」**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**正好**是**一份**反面清单**：**⭐ 如果**你**自己**要**把**毕业论文**放上 **GitHub**，**则**把 **README **写成**「**怎么跑、**数据从哪来、**每个文件**做什么**」**只需要**半小时**，**而**它**决定**别人**会不会**真的**用**你的**工作**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[catrisk-sim]] 覆盖**巨灾组合的**随机模拟**、**[[polaris-re]] 覆盖**个险再保定价的**建模库**、**[[rcmdrplugin-riskdemo]] 覆盖**风险与**破产理论**的**教学演示**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**一篇**硕士论文**级别的**网络传染**与**纾解策略**复现包**」这一形态**：**它**不**提供**产品**，**而**提供**一条**可读的**研究路径**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **写清**自己**接在**哪篇文献**之后**；**② **把**没写进论文的部分**标注出来**；**③ **一种**机制**一个文件**；**④ **README **要**写**怎么跑**，**而**不是**只写**写了什么**；**⑤ **上传前**清掉 **`.DS_Store`** 与 **`__pycache__`****。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**其任何代码或笔记本**（**未安装 **Python 依赖**、**未执行**任何 **`.py`** 或 **`.ipynb`****）**，**故**不主张**其**模拟结果**、**不主张**其**复现性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**、**README 全文**（**680 字节**）**与**仓库树**（**文件名与**字节数**）**，**未读**任何**代码或笔记本内容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**该论文**是否**已提交、**是否**通过、**以及**其**评分**或**结论**——**⚠️ 本词条**只**按**仓库自述**记录**课程与**学校**。**④ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**——**⚠️ 学术代码**常常**没有**许可**，**但**「**论文**可用**」**不**等于**「**代码**可**再分发**」**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**仓库体积**里**有多少**是**笔记本输出**（**⭐ 只**逐文件**报告**字节数**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该仓库**是**学术复现材料**，**不是**保险产品**，**也**不是**投资或**承保建议**。
entries.body_hk:
**Contagion Mitigation in Stochastic Insurance-Reinsurance Networks**（`hirshal/insurance-network-contagion`）**是一份**碩士論文的**代碼與筆記本復現包****——**逐字自述為**「**Code used in the production of my dissertation**」**，**課程逐字為**「**MSc Financial Mathematics with Data Science**」（**University of Bath**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**窗口內新建的項目**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 與文獻的關係逐字寫清****——**README 逐字寫明**其擴展的是**「**Ruin Probabilities for Risk Processes in Stochastic Networks**」**，**並逐字署為**Amini 等人（2023）**；**⭐ 即**對一份碩士論文來說**，**最值得對外暴露的**不是**「**我做了很多**」**，**而是**「**我的結果接在誰的哪一步之後**」**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 沒有納入論文的部分也逐字標出****——**三個紓解渠道逐字為**「**bail-ins, bail-outs (NOT INCLUDED IN DISSERTATION) and price floors**」**，**並逐字說明**價格下限是在**拋售構成獨立傳染渠道時考察**；**⭐ 即**「**我試過但沒寫進論文**」**與**「**我沒做**」**是兩種不同的誠實**；**本次實測**倉庫樹**確實同時含** `bailout_functions.py`（24 KB）** 與 **`augmented_exogenous_network_bailout.ipynb`（24,910 KB）****。

**⭐⭐ ③ 結構按「一種渠道一個模組」拆開****——**6 個 Python 模組**逐字為 **`bailin_functions.py`（31 KB）**、**`firesale_functions.py`（27 KB）**、**`bailout_functions.py`（24 KB）**、**`endogenous_functions.py`（19 KB）**、**`functions.py`（18 KB）**、**`exogenous_functions.py`（14 KB）****；**6 個 notebook** 逐字為 **57,699 KB**、**24,910 KB**、**17,367 KB**、**234 KB**、**98 KB**、**43 KB****；**⭐ 即**一條渠道一個檔案**讓讀者**只讀**自己關心的那條**，**而** `cramer_lundberg.ipynb`** 把**經典破產模型**單列一節**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 倉庫體感：文檔稀薄、**體積幾乎全是筆記本****——**README 僅 680 位元組（7 行）**、**倉庫 65,278 KB**，**6 個 notebook 合計約 98 MB 量級**；**並實測含** `.DS_Store`（8 KB）** 與 **`__pycache__`** 下 **6 個 `.pyc`****（**逐字為 cpython-312，即環境為 Python 3.12**）**；**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**這正好是一份反面清單**——**把 README 寫成「**怎麼跑、**數據從哪來、**每個檔案做什麼**」只需半小時**，**而它決定別人會不會真的用你的工作**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[catrisk-sim]]、[[polaris-re]]、[[rcmdrplugin-riskdemo]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**一篇碩士論文級別的網絡傳染與紓解策略復現包**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **寫清接在哪篇文獻之後**；**② **標出沒寫進論文的部分**；**③ **一種機制一個檔案**；**④ **README 要寫怎麼跑**；**⑤ **上傳前清掉 `.DS_Store` 與 `__pycache__`****。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有運行**其任何代碼或筆記本**，**不主張**其模擬結果**與**復現性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料**、**README 全文**與**倉庫樹**，**未讀**任何**代碼或筆記本內容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**該論文是否已提交、**是否**通過、**以及**其結論**——**只按倉庫自述**記錄**課程與學校**。**④ ⚠️ 該倉庫無許可證檔案**——**學術代碼常常沒有許可**，**但**「**論文可用**」**不**等於**「**代碼可再分發**」**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**倉庫體積裡有多少是筆記本輸出**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該倉庫是學術復現材料**，**不是**保險產品**，**也**不是**投資或承保建議**。
entries.body_en:
This is a dissertation reproducibility package of code and notebooks on contagion mitigation in stochastic insurance and reinsurance networks, stating in writing that the code was used in the production of a dissertation submitted for a masters course in financial mathematics with data science at a British university. **This entry belongs to the round theme of projects newly created inside the window.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface**:

**First, the relationship to the literature is stated in writing.** The description names the paper it extends, on ruin probabilities for risk processes in stochastic networks, and credits it to named authors and a year. **For a masters dissertation the most valuable thing to expose is not how much was done but which step of an existing ladder the result stands on, because that is what lets a reader judge the boundary of the contribution and lets a successor know whether the next step is available.**

**Second, the part left outside the dissertation is labelled in writing.** The three mitigation channels are listed as bail-ins, bail-outs, and price floors, with the second marked in capital letters as not included in the dissertation, and the description explains that price floors are examined when fire sales act as a separate channel of contagion. **Trying something and leaving it out of the write-up is a different kind of honesty from never doing it, and marking the former is a net gain for the reader.** **The repository tree does in fact contain both a bail-out module of twenty-four kilobytes and a bail-out notebook of nearly twenty-five megabytes, so the code exists while the dissertation excludes it, and the description says so.**

**Third, the structure is split one channel per module.** Six Python modules are present, covering bail-ins, fire sales, bail-outs, endogenous dynamics, exogenous dynamics, and shared functions, ranging from fourteen to thirty-one kilobytes, alongside six notebooks, of which the largest approaches fifty-eight megabytes and the smallest is tens of kilobytes. **When one channel is one file a reader can open only the channel they care about, and a separate notebook on the classical ruin model puts the starting point learned in coursework in the same repository as the extension.**

**Fourth, the repository is thinly documented while its size is almost entirely notebooks.** The description is a few hundred bytes over seven lines, the repository is roughly sixty-five megabytes, and the six notebooks account for the overwhelming majority of it. **Leftover system files and six compiled-python files built by a recent interpreter version are also committed, which shows the working environment but also the lack of cleanup.** **For a student preparing to publish a thesis repository, this doubles as a checklist of what to avoid: writing down how to run the code, where the data comes from, and what each file does takes half an hour and decides whether anyone actually uses the work.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover stochastic catastrophe portfolio simulation, a life reinsurance pricing library, and a teaching demonstration of risk and ruin theory, **while this entry supplies the form of a dissertation-grade reproducibility package on network contagion and mitigation, which offers not a product but a readable research path. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: state which paper your work continues; mark what was tried but left out; keep one mechanism per file; write the description so that it explains how to run the work and not only what was written; and remove system and compiled-python files before publishing.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, none of its code or notebooks was run**, no dependencies were installed and no file was executed, **so no claim is made about its simulation results or its reproducibility**. **Second, only repository metadata, the description in full, and the file tree with names and sizes were read**, not the contents of any code or notebook. **Third, whether the dissertation was submitted, passed, or concluded anything was not verified**, the course and institution being recorded only as the repository states them. **Fourth, the repository carries no licence file**, and for academic code the common absence of a licence means that a readable paper does not imply redistributable code. **Fifth, how much of the repository size consists of stored notebook output was not verified**, only per-file sizes being reported. **Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the repository is academic reproduction material rather than an insurance product or investment or underwriting advice.**

entries.title: **一个**把**智利金融监管机构**（CMF）**几乎全部公开数据**做成 **MCP 服务器**的**开源项目****：`mcp-cmf-chile`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Servidor Model Context Protocol (spec 2026-07-28, dual-era: también responde el handshake initialize legacy 2025-11-25)**」**；**⭐ 两种暴露方式实测**：**经典模式 **88 个工具**、**定义**约 **37,000 tokens／请求****，**代码模式 **2 个工具**、**固定约 **736 tokens****（**⭐ 自述**「**Es un 98 por ciento menos**」**）**；**⭐ 一条硬规则逐字**「**una herramienta jamás decide por el agente qué parte del dato merece verse**」**；**⭐ 覆盖逐字含**「**registro de depósito de pólizas**」**（**保单**存放登记**）**；**⭐ 许可逐字 **MIT****；**⭐ 法律声明逐字**「**no está afiliado ni respaldado por la CMF**」**
entries.title_en: An open-source project that turns almost all public data of the Chilean financial market regulator into a model context protocol server: it states in writing that it implements the protocol specification with dual-era support including the legacy initialisation handshake, exposes the same eighty-eight operations in two measured ways where the classic mode carries about thirty-seven thousand tokens of tool definitions per request and the code mode holds a fixed cost near seven hundred thirty-six tokens for a ninety-eight percent reduction, adopts a hard rule that a tool never decides for the agent which part of the data deserves to be seen, covers the policy deposit registry among its domains, carries an MIT licence, and states in writing that it is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by the regulator.

entries.summary: **MCP para la CMF de Chile**（`JoaquinMulet/mcp-cmf-chile`）**是一个**把**智利金融市场委员会**（CMF）**公开数据**接给 **AI 代理**的 **MCP 服务器****——**逐字自述为**「**Servidor Model Context Protocol**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 星标 **2****、**创建 **2026-08-08****、**最后推送 **2026-09-11****、**仓库 **2 MB****、**主语言 **TypeScript****、**许可证逐字 **MIT****、**默认分支 **`master`****；**⭐ README **14,192 字节**／**272 行****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**用母语关键词找项目**」**——**⭐ 本轮**不**用英语词**，**而**用**西／葡／德／土／意／日／韩／中八种语言的**保险词**检索 **GitHub**，**本条**是**其中**西班牙语一路的**结果**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **同一批 **88 个操作**，**两种暴露方式**的**令牌成本实测**（**37,000** 对 **736**）**——**⭐ 即**「**工具数量**」**本身就是**上下文预算**，**而**这**在**保险这类**字段极多**的**领域**尤其致命**；**② **一条硬规则逐字**「**una herramienta jamás decide por el agente qué parte del dato merece verse**」**（**工具**永不**替代理决定**哪一部分数据**值得看）**——**⭐ 即**过滤**交给**调用方的**代码**，**而**不**交给**工具**；**③ **它**指名**修掉的**一个真实缺陷**：**经典模式的**文本摘要**不**含 **`url` 列****，**于是**代理**可能**找到了**一张保单**、**却**永远**读不到**它****（**⭐ 因为**模型**只**看得到**文本块**，**`structuredContent`** 只**对**程序调用方**存活**）**；**④ **法律声明逐字**「**no está afiliado ni respaldado por la CMF**」**——**⭐ 即**「**用**监管机构的**公开数据**」**与**「**代表**监管机构**」**是**两件事**。**⚠️ 本次**未安装、**未连接**该服务器**。

entries.summary_en: This is a model context protocol server that connects artificial-intelligence agents to the public data of the Chilean financial market regulator, describing itself in writing as a model context protocol server. **Measured this round**: two stars, created on the eighth of August and last pushed on the eleventh of September, a repository of about two megabytes in TypeScript, an MIT licence, and a default branch named master, with a description of about fourteen kilobytes over two hundred seventy-two lines. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language**, since this round searched a code host with insurance words in Spanish, Portuguese, German, Turkish, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese instead of English, and this is the Spanish-language result. **Four things are worth reading: the same eighty-eight operations are exposed in two ways whose token cost is measured, roughly thirty-seven thousand tokens of tool definitions per request in the classic mode against a fixed cost near seven hundred thirty-six tokens in the code mode, which shows that the number of tools is itself a context budget and that this matters most in a domain with as many fields as insurance; a hard rule states in writing that a tool never decides for the agent which part of the data deserves to be seen, so filtering belongs to the caller code rather than to the tool; the project names the real defect it fixed, namely that the classic mode text summary carried no url column, so an agent could find a policy document and never be able to read it, because the text block is the only part of a protocol response a model sees while structured content survives only for programmatic callers; and the legal notice states in writing that the project is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by the regulator, which is the distinction between using an authority open data and speaking for it.** **The server was neither installed nor connected this round.**
entries.body:
**MCP para la CMF de Chile**（`JoaquinMulet/mcp-cmf-chile`）**是一个**把**智利金融市场委员会**（CMF）**公开数据**接给 **AI 代理**的 **MCP 服务器****——**逐字自述为**「**Servidor Model Context Protocol (spec 2026-07-28, dual-era: también responde el handshake initialize legacy 2025-11-25)**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**用母语关键词找项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 同一批操作，两种暴露方式，令牌成本被实测出来****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出**两条端点**：**经典模式**「**88 herramientas, una por operación**」**，**其**定义**逐字**「**unos 37 mil tokens medidos**」**；**代码模式**「**2 herramientas**」**，**逐字**「**un costo fijo de unos 736 tokens**」**，**并逐字总结**「**Es un 98 por ciento menos, y no crece si mañana hay 200 operaciones.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本轮**最值得**抄下来**的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**把工具数量当上下文预算**」**——**⭐ 在**保险这类**字段极多**的**领域**（**保单、**批单、**准备金、**科目）**，**一个**领域接口**动辄**几十上百个**操作**，**若**每个**操作**一个工具**，**则**光是**工具定义**就**吃掉**上下文**；**⭐ 而**代码模式的**做法**是**把**目录**留在**服务器**里**（**逐字**：**「**El catálogo nunca entra a tu contexto, solo entra lo que devuelvas.**」**）**，**让**模型**写一小段 **JavaScript**去**筛**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 一条硬规则：工具不替代理决定「哪一部分数据值得看」****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字**列出一条**项目级硬规则**「**una herramienta jamás decide por el agente qué parte del dato merece verse**」**，**并逐字说明**「**Dentro del código, cada operación devuelve su JSON completo**」**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一条**对 RIAA **最实用**：**⭐ 即**「**工具**该**返回**完整字段**、**由**调用方**按**自己的**目的**过滤**」**，**而**不**该**在**工具里**替**用户**决定**看**哪几列**；**⭐ 因为**「**该看哪几列**」**恰恰**取决于**业务问题**，**而**工具**作者**通常**不知道**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它指名修掉的一个真实缺陷：文本块里有保单、却读不到保单****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写道**：**「**El resumen en texto del modo clásico no traía la columna url, así que un agente podía encontrar una póliza y no tener nunca cómo leerla.**」**，**并逐字给出**原因**：**「**El bloque de texto es lo único que un modelo ve de una respuesta MCP; el structuredContent sobrevive solo para quien llama por programa.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这是**本轮**最具体的一处**工程教训**：**⭐ 即**协议层的**「**结构化内容**」**与**模型**实际**看得到**的东西**不**是**一回事**——**⭐ 而**一个**域接口**若**把**关键**的**定位信息**（**URL、**ID、**页码**）**只**放在**摘要文本**之外**，**就**会**出现**「**找得到、**读不到**」**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 覆盖范围与两种模式之外的实务细节（逐字可核）****——**⭐ 覆盖逐字包括**：**上市公司**（**按名称／**RUT／**代码检索、**IFRS 与 **NCH** 财务报表、**重大事实、**股东、**董事会、**处罚、**决议、**股东大会、**年报、**ESG 指标、**分红）**、**共同基金**（**3,400 只以上**的目录**）、**投资基金**、**经济指标**（**官方 **API v3**：**UF、**美元、**欧元、**TAB、**UTM、**IPC 等**）**、**监管规范**、**保险**（**逐字含**「**registro de depósito de pólizas**」**，**即**保单**存放登记**）**、**XBRL、**签署文件**与**银行系统**；**⭐ 另逐字提到** **BEST** 统计站点**（**逐字为 **5,180 个表**与 **34,023 条序列**）**；**⭐ 工程侧逐字**：**`registro.ts`** 从 **`src/tools/`** 派生**目录**、**`cmf-client.ts`** 做**中央 **HTTP 客户端**（**逐字含**白名单、**UA、**cookie、**限流、**重试）**、**`cache.ts`** 做 **LRU 与 **TTL****；**⭐ 限流逐字**为**对 **CMF** 每主机**每秒 1 次请求****；**⭐ 并逐字提示**其**签名链接**是**短暂的**（**逐字**：**「**no los comparta ni los trate como URLs permanentes**」**）**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[cmf-chile]] 收录的是**该监管机构**自己的**统计入口****，**而**本条**是**第三方**把**同一机构**公开数据**做成**代理接口**；**[[apra-mcp]] 与 **[[fema-nfhl-mcp]] 是**同一形态**（**监管数据 ＋ **MCP）在**其他辖区**的先例****——**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**本条**与 **[[cmf-chile]]** 的**关系**是**「**数据源**」与**「**接口**」**，**而**不**是**两个**数据源**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **先数**工具**会**吃掉**多少**上下文**，**再**决定**暴露方式**；**② **返回**完整数据**、**把**过滤**留给**调用方**；**③ **把**定位信息**（**URL／ID**）**放进**模型**真能看到的**文本里**；**④ **限流**与**缓存**是**接口**的**一等公民**；**⑤ **用**公开数据**时**主动**写明**「**不**代表**该机构**」**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有连接**该 MCP 服务器**（**未取回**任何 **CMF** 数据、**未调用**任何工具）**，**故**不主张**其**任何操作**可用**、**也**不主张**其**数据**与**官方源**一致**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **TypeScript** 源码**；**⭐ 文中**两个**令牌数**（**37,000** 与 **736**）**为**作者**在 **README 中的**自述**，**⚠️ 本词条**如实转述**，**未**独立复现**。**③ ⚠️ 其**托管端点**（**逐字为 **`cmf-mcp.kumocloud.cl`）**本次**未**请求**，**故**其**在线可用性**未核实**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**数据**是否**有**延迟**、**是否**与**监管机构**官网**同步**。**⑤ ⚠️ 法律声明**逐字已标出**「**no está afiliado ni respaldado por la CMF**」**，**⚠️ 本词条**据此**提示**：**涉及金融决定**要**回到**官方源**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该服务器**是**接口**，**不是**投资建议**。
entries.body_hk:
**MCP para la CMF de Chile**（`JoaquinMulet/mcp-cmf-chile`）**是一個**把**智利金融市場委員會**（CMF）**公開數據**接給 **AI 代理**的 **MCP 伺服器****——**逐字自述為**「**Servidor Model Context Protocol (spec 2026-07-28, dual-era: también responde el handshake initialize legacy 2025-11-25)**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**用母語關鍵詞找項目**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 同一批操作、兩種暴露方式，令牌成本被實測出來****——**經典模式逐字**「**88 herramientas, una por operación**」**，**定義逐字**「**unos 37 mil tokens medidos**」**；**代碼模式**「**2 herramientas**」**、**逐字**「**un costo fijo de unos 736 tokens**」**，**並逐字總結**「**Es un 98 por ciento menos, y no crece si mañana hay 200 operaciones.**」**；**⭐ 即**把工具數量當上下文預算**——**代碼模式**把目錄**留在伺服器**（**逐字**El catálogo nunca entra a tu contexto, solo entra lo que devuelvas**）**，**讓模型**寫一小段 JavaScript 去篩**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 硬規則：工具不替代理決定「哪一部分數據值得看」****——**逐字**「**una herramienta jamás decide por el agente qué parte del dato merece verse**」**，**並逐字說明**「**Dentro del código, cada operación devuelve su JSON completo**」**；**⭐ 即**工具返回完整欄位**、**由調用方**按**自己的目的**過濾**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它指名修掉的缺陷：文本塊裡有保單、卻讀不到保單****——**逐字**「**El resumen en texto del modo clásico no traía la columna url, así que un agente podía encontrar una póliza y no tener nunca cómo leerla.**」**，**並逐字給出原因**「**El bloque de texto es lo único que un modelo ve de una respuesta MCP; el structuredContent sobrevive solo para quien llama por programa.**」**；**⭐ 即**協議層的結構化內容**與**模型**實際看得到的東西**不**是**一回事**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 覆蓋與實務細節（逐字可核）****——**覆蓋逐字含**上市公司、**共同基金（**3,400 隻以上**）、**投資基金、**經濟指標（**官方 API v3**）、**監管規範、**保險**（**逐字含 registro de depósito de pólizas**）**、**XBRL、**簽署文件**與**銀行系統**，**另含 **BEST** 站點**（**逐字 5,180 個表**與 **34,023 條序列**）**；**工程側逐字**含 **`registro.ts`**、**`cmf-client.ts`**（**白名單、**UA、**cookie、**限流、**重試）**、**`cache.ts`**（**LRU 與 TTL**）**；**限流逐字**為**每主機每秒 1 次請求**；**簽名連結**逐字**「**no los comparta ni los trate como URLs permanentes**」**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[cmf-chile]]、[[apra-mcp]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]——**⭐ 本條**是**第三方**把**同一機構**公開數據**做成**代理接口**，**與 **[[cmf-chile]]** 的**關係**是**「**數據源**」與**「**接口**」**；**本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **先數工具**吃掉多少上下文**；**② **返回完整數據、**過濾留給調用方**；**③ **把定位資訊放進模型真能看到的文本**；**④ **限流與緩存是一等公民**；**⑤ **用公開數據時**主動寫明**不代表該機構**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝、**沒有連接**該 MCP 伺服器**，**不主張**其任何操作可用**；**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料與 README 文本**，**未讀**其 TypeScript 源碼**；**⭐ 兩個令牌數（**37,000** 與 **736**）為**作者自述**，**本詞條**如實轉述而未獨立復現**；**③ ⚠️ 其託管端點**本次**未**請求**，**在線可用性**未核實**；**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其數據是否有延遲、**是否與官網同步**；**⑤ ⚠️ 法律聲明逐字已標出**「**no está afiliado ni respaldado por la CMF**」**，**涉及金融決定**要**回到官方源**；**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該伺服器是接口**，**不是**投資建議**。
entries.body_en:
This is a model context protocol server that connects artificial-intelligence agents to the public data of the Chilean financial market regulator. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the same operations are exposed in two ways and the token cost of each is measured.** The description gives two endpoints: a classic mode with eighty-eight tools, one per operation, whose definitions are stated in writing to measure about thirty-seven thousand tokens, and a code mode with two tools at a fixed cost near seven hundred thirty-six tokens, summarised in writing as ninety-eight percent less and constant even if there were two hundred operations tomorrow. **Treating the number of tools as a context budget is the single most transferable idea here, because a domain interface in insurance easily has dozens or hundreds of operations, and one tool per operation means the definitions alone consume the context. The code mode instead keeps the catalogue inside the server, stating in writing that the catalogue never enters the context and only what the caller returns does, and lets the model write a short piece of JavaScript to filter.**

**Second, a hard rule states that a tool never decides for the agent which part of the data deserves to be seen.** The description adds that inside the code path every operation returns its complete JSON. **The lesson is that a tool should return full fields and let the caller filter according to its own purpose, because which columns matter depends on the business question and the tool author usually does not know it.**

**Third, the project names the real defect it fixed: finding a policy without being able to read it.** The description states that the classic mode text summary carried no url column, so an agent could find a policy and never have a way to read it, and explains that the text block is the only part of a protocol response a model sees while structured content survives only for programmatic callers. **This is the most concrete engineering lesson of the round, because structured content at the protocol layer and what the model actually sees are two different things, and any domain interface that keeps the locating information such as a URL, an identifier, or a page number outside the summary text will produce lookups that cannot be followed.**

**Fourth, the coverage and the operational details are stated in writing.** Listed companies with search by name, tax identifier or ticker, financial statements, essential facts, shareholders, board, sanctions, resolutions, meetings, annual reports, environmental and social indicators and dividends; mutual funds with more than three thousand four hundred funds; investment funds; economic indicators through the official interface; regulation; insurance including the policy deposit registry; extensible business reporting language documents; signed documents; and banking systems, plus the regulator statistical site described as more than five thousand tables and more than thirty-four thousand series. **On the engineering side, the description names a registry module that derives the catalogue from the tool sources, a central client that handles the allowlist, user agent, cookies, rate limiting, and retries, and a cache module with least-recently-used eviction and time to live; the outward rate limit is stated as one request per second per host, and signed links are described as ephemeral and not to be shared or treated as permanent addresses.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: a pooled entry covers the regulator own statistics portal, **while this entry is a third-party agent interface over the same authority public data, and pooled entries already cover analogous regulator-data interfaces for other jurisdictions. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them, and states plainly that the relationship to the pooled portal entry is one of data source to interface rather than two data sources.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: count how much context the tools consume before choosing how to expose them; return complete data and leave filtering to the caller; put locating information into the text a model actually sees; treat rate limiting and caching as first-class parts of an interface; and state plainly when public data is used without any endorsement by the authority.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the server was neither installed nor connected**, no regulator data was retrieved and no tool was called, **so no claim is made that any operation works or that its data matches the official source**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the TypeScript source, and **the two token figures are the author own measurements transcribed here without independent reproduction**. **Third, its hosted endpoint was not requested this round**, so its online availability was not verified. **Fourth, whether its data lags the authority website was not verified. Fifth, the legal notice already states in writing that the project is not affiliated with or endorsed by the regulator, and this entry therefore advises returning to the official source for financial decisions. Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the server is an interface rather than investment advice.**

entries.title: **一份**把**保险公司公开数据、**政府事故统计与**检察机关办案记录**三类来源**对齐核查**的**复现包****：`tres-fuentes-tamaulipas`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Paquete de replicación — auditoría de observabilidad AXA / ATUS / Fiscalía**」**；**⭐ 范围逐字为**「**Tamaulipas y Nuevo León, 2019–2023**」**；**⭐ 三类来源逐字**为 **AXA／I2DS 开放数据**、**INEGI 的 **ATUS**、**以及**两州检察机关**经**国家透明平台**取得的**办案记录****（**⭐ 逐字附**卷宗号 **`811197026000256`**、**公函号 **`FGJ/DGAJDH/IP/12551/2026`**、**案号 **`SAI/314/2026`****）**；**⭐ 逐字声明**「**ninguna contiene datos personales**」**；**⭐ 许可证逐字 **MIT****
entries.title_en: A replication package that reconciles three classes of source, an insurer open data release, national government crash statistics, and prosecutors investigation records, for two Mexican states over five years: it describes itself in writing as a replication package for an observability audit of an insurer, a government crash register, and a prosecutors office, states its scope as two states between 2019 and 2023, lists the four public sources with the transparency-platform file numbers and official letter identifiers under which the prosecutors records were obtained, states in writing that none of them contains personal data, and carries an MIT licence.
entries.title_hk: **一份**把**保險公司公開數據、**政府事故統計與**檢察機關辦案記錄**三類來源**對齊核查**的**復現包****：`tres-fuentes-tamaulipas`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Paquete de replicación — auditoría de observabilidad AXA / ATUS / Fiscalía**」**；**⭐ 範圍逐字為**「**Tamaulipas y Nuevo León, 2019–2023**」**；**⭐ 三類來源逐字**為 **AXA／I2DS 開放數據**、**INEGI 的 ATUS**、**以及**兩州檢察機關**經**國家透明平台**取得的**辦案記錄****（**⭐ 逐字附**卷宗號 **`811197026000256`**、**公函號 **`FGJ/DGAJDH/IP/12551/2026`**、**案號 **`SAI/314/2026`****）**；**⭐ 逐字聲明**「**ninguna contiene datos personales**」**；**⭐ 許可證逐字 MIT****
entries.summary: **tres-fuentes-tamaulipas**（`antoniobarreda-glitch/tres-fuentes-tamaulipas`）**是一份**把**三类**道路事故**记录对齐核查**的**复现包****——**逐字自述为**「**Paquete de replicación — auditoría de observabilidad AXA / ATUS / Fiscalía**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 创建与推送均在 **2026-09-10****、**仓库 **9 MB****、**主语言 **Python****、**许可证逐字 **MIT****、**星标 **0****、**README **3,864 字节**／**81 行****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**用母语关键词找项目**」**——**⭐ 本条**由**西班牙语词 **`siniestros`**（**事故／**理赔）**一路取得**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **三类来源**里**两类**是**公开数据、**一类**是**依法申请取得****——**⭐ 逐字附上**透明平台**卷宗号、**公函号与**案号**，**即**「**这份材料**是怎么**拿到的**」**可**被**第三方**复算**；**② **逐字声明**四类来源**均**不含**个人数据**，**并**说明**办案记录**只**按**单位、**日期、**罪名与**市镇**标识**；**③ **脚本 **01 至 08** 有**先后与**替代关系****——**⭐ 逐字注明 **04 与 **05** 是**旧版**（**当时**用**坐标矩形**而非**城市多边形**）**，**保留**只为**对照**，**现行结果**以 **08** 为准**；**④ **提交前**的**八个**统计决定点**被**单列成文件****——**⭐ 逐字要求**「**Lee PROCESSOS.pdf**」**并**在**流水线**上**标红**八处**待确认**的**统计选择**。**⚠️ 本次**未运行**其脚本、**未复核**其数字**。
entries.summary_hk: **tres-fuentes-tamaulipas**（`antoniobarreda-glitch/tres-fuentes-tamaulipas`）**是一份**把**三類**道路事故**記錄對齊核查**的**復現包****——**逐字自述為**「**Paquete de replicación — auditoría de observabilidad AXA / ATUS / Fiscalía**」**。**本次實測**：**⭐ 創建與推送均在 2026-09-10**、**倉庫 9 MB**、**主語言 Python**、**許可證逐字 MIT**、**星標 0**、**README 3,864 位元組／81 行**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**用母語關鍵詞找項目**」**——**本條由**西班牙語詞 `siniestros`** 一路取得**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **三類來源**中**兩類**是**公開數據、**一類**依法申請取得****——**逐字附**卷宗號、**公函號與**案號**；**② **逐字聲明**四類來源**均不含**個人數據**，**辦案記錄**只按**單位、**日期、**罪名與**市鎮**標識**；**③ **腳本 01 至 08** 有**先後與替代關係****——**04 與 05** 為**舊版**（**坐標矩形**而非**城市多邊形**）**，**保留**只為**對照**，**現行結果**以 08 為準**；**④ **提交前的八個統計決定點**單列成文件**（**逐字**Lee PROCESSOS.pdf**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未運行**其腳本、**未覆核**其數字**。
entries.summary_en: This is a replication package that reconciles three classes of road-crash record, describing itself in writing as a replication package for an observability audit of an insurer, a government crash register, and a prosecutors office. **Measured this round**: created and pushed on the tenth of September, a repository of about nine megabytes in Python, an MIT licence, no stars, and a description of about four kilobytes over eighty-one lines. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language and was reached through the Spanish word for crash claims.** **Four things are worth reading: two of the three source classes are published open data while the third was obtained by formal request, and the file number, official letter identifier, and case number are printed so that how the material was obtained can be checked by a third party; the description states in writing that none of the sources contains personal data and that the prosecutors records identify cases only by unit, date, offence, and municipality; the scripts are numbered from one to eight with an explicit statement that two earlier scripts are superseded because the geographic cut changed from a coordinate rectangle to an urban polygon and are kept only for comparison, so the current results come from script eight; and the eight statistical decision points that must be confirmed before submission are gathered into a separate document that the description tells the reader to open first.** **None of the scripts was run and none of the numbers was re-derived this round.**
entries.body:
**tres-fuentes-tamaulipas**（`antoniobarreda-glitch/tres-fuentes-tamaulipas`）**是一份**把**三类**道路事故**记录对齐核查**的**复现包****——**逐字自述为**「**Paquete de replicación — auditoría de observabilidad AXA / ATUS / Fiscalía**」**，**范围逐字为**「**Tamaulipas y Nuevo León, 2019–2023**」**，**并**逐字说明**它**是**为**投稿 **ICSC-CITIES 2026** 的**手稿**准备的**合作材料**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**用母语关键词找项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 三类来源的取得方式被逐字写明，**其中一类是**依法申请****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出四类来源**：**AXA／I2DS 开放数据**（**逐字**：**保险公司**通过**国际数据科学研究所**发布的**开放数据**）**、**INEGI 的 **ATUS**（**城市与城郊**陆路交通事故统计）**、**两州检察机关**的**办案记录**（**逐字注明**经**国家透明平台**申请取得，**并逐字给出**卷宗号 **`811197026000256`**、**公函号 **`FGJ/DGAJDH/IP/12551/2026`**、**案号 **`SAI/314/2026`****）**、**以及 **INEGI **EDR** 死亡登记**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**在**「**数据**」**这个词**下面**，**来源**至少**有三类**：**企业**自愿**公开的**、**政府**例行**统计的**、**以及**只能**依法**申请**才能**拿到的****——**⭐ 而**把**取得路径与**文号**写出来**，**是**让**结果**可复核**的**前提**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**你**的**论文**用了**非公开**来源**（**监管报表、**理赔明细）**，**则**把**申请路径**写清**，**比**只写**「**数据来自**某机构**」**有用**得多**。

**⭐⭐ ② 隐私口径逐字声明****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字**写**「**Las cuatro fuentes son públicas y ninguna contiene datos personales.**」**，**并**逐字说明**办案记录**的**标识方式**（**逐字**：**按**单位、**日期、**罪名与**市镇**，**不含**受害者**可识别信息**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实转述**这一声明**，**⚠️ 但**不**据此**认定**其**合规性**（**⭐ 合规判断**不**是**本词条**能做的**）**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 脚本的**版本关系**被**明说****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**脚本 **01 至 08** 的**产出**，**并**逐字注明 **04 与 **05** 是**「**旧版**」**（**逐字**：**当时**用的是**坐标矩形**而**不是**城市多边形）**，**逐字**：**「**Se conservan para poder comparar, pero los resultados vigentes son los de 08.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**复现包**的**好习惯**：**⭐ 即**旧脚本**不删**、**但**标明**哪一份**才是**现行结果**——**⭐ 而**这**正好**避免**「**后来者**跑了**旧脚本**、**得出**旧结论**」。

**⭐⭐ ④ 提交前的**统计决定**被**单列**且**逐条**等待确认****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字要求**「**Lee PROCESSOS.pdf. Recorre el pipeline paso a paso y marca en rojo los ocho puntos donde hay una decisión estadística que debe confirmarse antes del envío, con la pregunta concreta en cada uno.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这是**本轮**最值得**其他项目**学的**一条**：**⭐ 即**把**「**这一步**为什么**这样选**」**从**代码注释**里**提出来**，**变成**一份**待确认清单**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**论文**或**模型**交付前**，**列出**所有**统计选择点**（**口径、**剔除规则、**分层、**去重、**基准）**并**逐条**确认**，**通常**比**再调一次**模型**更能**提高**结论的**可信度**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 交付物清单与范围限制****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**目录逐字含** `datos/tamaulipas`（**六城市的**三类来源**＋**已按**城市／**城郊**分层的 **`estratos_*.csv`** ＋**每城市、**每分辨率的 **H3 网格）**、`datos/nuevo_leon`（**州检察机关**完整回复**与**六市镇**汇总）**、`datos/inegi`（**死亡率校验、**城市 **AGEB、**合并后的**城市多边形 **`.gpkg`（**逐字注明**可用 **QGIS** 打开）**）**、`resultados/`（**主表逐字为 **`matriz_urbano.csv`**、**结构性下限表 **`pisos_urbano.csv`**、**城郊汇总 **`periurbano_resumen.csv`****）**、`scripts/`（**01 至 08**）**；**⭐ 并逐字写明**范围限制**「**este paquete contiene únicamente datos de Tamaulipas y Nuevo León**」**（**不**含**其他五地**）**；**⭐ 依赖逐字**为 **pandas、**numpy、**h3、**scipy、**geopandas、**shapely、**openpyxl****。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[japan-claims-review-archive]] 是**同一形态**（**一份**可引用的**可复现归档**）**，**[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] 覆盖**理赔数据的**分析**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**保险公司的**开放数据**与**政府统计、**司法记录**放在**同一坐标系里**核对**」这一**做法**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **写清**每一类来源**的**取得路径**（**含**申请文号**）**；**② **四类来源**里**谁**含**个人信息**要**先声明**；**③ **旧脚本**保留但**标明**谁**是**现行版**；**④ **把**统计决定点**做成**待确认清单**；**⑤ **分层**（**城市／**城郊）**要**有**依据**（**本条用**城市多边形**与 **H3 网格**）**；**⑥ **数据**对外发布前**想好**可引用**（**本条**逐字提到**将来**接 **Zenodo** 取 **DOI**）**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**其任何脚本**（**未安装 **pandas／**geopandas／**h3**、**未下载**其数据**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何数字**、**不主张**其**结论**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **`PROCESOS.pdf`**、**未读**其脚本内容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**隐私声明**是否**符合**墨西哥**或**任何辖区**的**法律要求**（**⭐ 本词条**只**转述**作者**自己的声明**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**该手稿**是否**已被 **ICSC-CITIES 2026** 接收**、**也**未核实**其**同行评审状态**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**保险公司开放数据**的**授权范围**是否**允许**本复现包**再分发**（**⭐ 本条**只**按**其**逐字来源**记录**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**H3 网格**与**城市／城郊分层**的**阈值**选择依据**（**⭐ 逐字提示**读者**去看**那**八点清单**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该复现包**是**研究方法材料**，**不是**保险产品**，**也**不是**法律意见**。
entries.body_hk:
**tres-fuentes-tamaulipas**（`antoniobarreda-glitch/tres-fuentes-tamaulipas`）**是一份**把**三類**道路事故**記錄對齊核查**的**復現包****——**逐字自述為**「**Paquete de replicación — auditoría de observabilidad AXA / ATUS / Fiscalía**」**，**範圍逐字為**「**Tamaulipas y Nuevo León, 2019–2023**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**用母語關鍵詞找項目**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 三類來源的取得方式被逐字寫明，**其中一類依法申請****——**四類來源逐字為**：**AXA／I2DS 開放數據**（**保險公司**經**國際數據科學研究所**發布**）**、**INEGI 的 ATUS**、**兩州檢察機關辦案記錄**（**逐字附**卷宗號 **`811197026000256`**、**公函號 **`FGJ/DGAJDH/IP/12551/2026`**、**案號 **`SAI/314/2026`****）**、**INEGI EDR 死亡登記**；**⭐ 即**數據至少有**三類**：**企業自願公開、**政府例行統計、**依法申請取得**——**寫出取得路徑與文號**是**可複核的前提**。

**⭐⭐ ② 隱私口徑逐字聲明****——**逐字**「**Las cuatro fuentes son públicas y ninguna contiene datos personales.**」**，**並逐字說明**辦案記錄**只按**單位、**日期、**罪名與**市鎮**標識**；**本詞條**只轉述**作者聲明**，**不**據此**認定**合規性**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 腳本的版本關係被明說****——**逐字**「**Se conservan para poder comparar, pero los resultados vigentes son los de 08.**」**（**04 與 05** 為**舊版**：**坐標矩形**而非**城市多邊形**）**；**⭐ 即**舊腳本不刪**、**但標明誰是現行版**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 提交前的統計決定被單列****——**逐字**「**Lee PROCESSOS.pdf. Recorre el pipeline paso a paso y marca en rojo los ocho puntos donde hay una decisión estadística que debe confirmarse antes del envío, con la pregunta concreta en cada uno.**」**；**⭐ 即**把**「**為什麼這樣選**」**從代碼註釋**變成**待確認清單**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 交付物與範圍限制****——**目錄逐字含** `datos/tamaulipas`（**三類來源＋**分層 `estratos_*.csv`＋**H3 網格**）、`datos/nuevo_leon`、`datos/inegi`（**含 `.gpkg`，逐字註明可用 QGIS 打開**）、`resultados/`（**主表 `matriz_urbano.csv`**、**`pisos_urbano.csv`**、**`periurbano_resumen.csv`**）、`scripts/`（**01 至 08**）**；**範圍逐字**「**este paquete contiene únicamente datos de Tamaulipas y Nuevo León**」**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[japan-claims-review-archive]]、[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把保險公司開放數據與政府統計、**司法記錄放在同一坐標系核對**」**這一做法**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **寫清每類來源的取得路徑**；**② **先聲明哪類含個人信息**；**③ **舊腳本標明誰是現行版**；**④ **統計決定點做成待確認清單**；**⑤ **分層要有依據**；**⑥ **發布前想好可引用（**Zenodo 取 DOI**）**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有運行**其任何腳本**，**不主張**其任何數字與結論**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料與 README 文本**，**未讀**其 `PROCESOS.pdf` 與腳本內容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**其隱私聲明是否符合任何轄區法律要求**（**只轉述作者聲明**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**該手稿是否已被 ICSC-CITIES 2026 接收**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其保險公司開放數據的授權範圍是否允許再分發**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其 H3 與分層閾值的選擇依據**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該復現包是研究方法材料**，**不是**保險產品**，**也**不是**法律意見**。
entries.body_en:
This is a replication package that reconciles three classes of road-crash record for two Mexican states over five years, describing itself in writing as a replication package for an observability audit of an insurer, a government crash register, and a prosecutors office, and stating in writing that it is material prepared for co-authors of a manuscript submitted to a conference. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, how each class of source was obtained is stated in writing, and one of them was obtained by formal request.** The four sources are open data released by an insurer through an international data science institute, the national crash statistics programme, prosecutors investigation records obtained through the national transparency platform with the file number, official letter identifier, and case number printed, and the national death registry. **Under the single word data there are at least three kinds of source: voluntarily published corporate data, routine government statistics, and material that can only be obtained by formal request, and writing out the acquisition path with its official identifiers is what makes results checkable. If a dissertation uses non-public sources such as regulatory filings or claim records, recording the request path is far more useful than saying only that the data came from an institution.**

**Second, the privacy position is stated in writing.** The description says the four sources are public and none contains personal data, and explains that investigation files are identified only by unit, date, offence, and municipality without identifying details of victims. **This entry transcribes that statement and does not treat it as a compliance finding, since compliance is not something this entry can establish.**

**Third, the relationship between script versions is made explicit.** The scripts run from one to eight, and two earlier ones are labelled as superseded because the geographic cut changed from a coordinate rectangle to an urban polygon; they are kept for comparison while the current results come from script eight. **Keeping old scripts without deleting them while marking which one produced the current results is a good habit, because it is exactly what stops a later reader from running the old script and reporting the old conclusion.**

**Fourth, the statistical decisions that must be confirmed before submission are gathered into a single document.** The description instructs the reader to work through the pipeline step by step and mark in red the eight points where a statistical decision needs confirmation before submission, with the concrete question attached to each. **Lifting the why of each choice out of code comments into a confirmation checklist is the most transferable practice of this round, because listing every statistical choice such as definitions, exclusion rules, stratification, deduplication, and benchmarks and confirming them one by one usually raises the credibility of a conclusion more than another round of modelling does.**

**Fifth, the deliverables and the scope limits are stated.** The directory holds the three source classes for six cities together with stratified tables and hexagonal grid cells per city and resolution, the full response of the second state prosecutors office with a summary of six municipalities, national validation and urban polygon geometry files that open in a geographic information system, result tables headed by a main urban matrix, a structural floor table, and a peri-urban summary, and the numbered scripts. **The scope limit is stated in writing: the package contains data for two states only and not the other five regions belonging to other lines of the project.**

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: a pooled entry is the same form of citable reproducibility archive and another covers claims-data analytics, **while this entry supplies the practice of checking an insurer open data release against government statistics and judicial records inside one coordinate system. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: record the acquisition path of every source including official request identifiers; state which sources contain personal information before anyone asks; keep old scripts but mark which is current; turn statistical decisions into a confirmation checklist; justify stratification rather than asserting it; and plan for citability, as this package states its intention to attach a persistent identifier once the manuscript is published.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, none of the scripts was run**, no dependencies were installed and no data was downloaded, **so no claim is made about any figure or conclusion**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the accompanying process document or the scripts. **Third, whether the privacy statement satisfies the legal requirements of any jurisdiction was not verified**, only the author own statement being transcribed. **Fourth, whether the manuscript has been accepted by the conference named in the description was not verified, nor was its peer review status. Fifth, whether the licence of the insurer open data release permits redistribution in this package was not verified. Sixth, the basis for the hexagonal grid and the stratification thresholds was not verified, the description itself directing the reader to the eight-point checklist. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the package is research method material rather than an insurance product or a legal opinion.**

entries.title_en: A Korean multi-agent system that chains dashcam video, fault-ratio determination, and insurance response documents into one service: it describes itself in writing in Korean as a multi-agent traffic-accident response service covering dashcam analysis, fault-ratio checking, and insurance document drafting, splits work across four agents for orchestration, vision, retrieval, and documents, produces an incident statement and a rebuttal opinion letter as PDF files, and carries a disclaimer stating in writing that its analysis is for reference and does not replace the final judgement of an insurer, a dispute review committee, or a legal expert.

entries.summary_en: This is a Korean multi-agent service for handling traffic accidents, describing itself in writing in Korean as a multi-agent traffic-accident response service that spans dashcam video analysis, fault-ratio determination, and the drafting of insurance response documents. **Measured this round**: no stars, created on the third of September and last pushed on the ninth, a repository of about eighty megabytes whose main language is Python, no licence file, and a default branch named main, with a description of about three kilobytes over ninety-four lines in Korean and a file tree of seven hundred twenty-nine files including two hundred fourteen Python files and more than four hundred images. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language and was reached through the Korean word for insurance.** **Four things are worth reading: four agents each own one stage, for orchestration, vision, retrieval, and documents, and the description states in writing that the design deliberately does not hand every task to a single model; retrieval uses augmented generation over similar cases so that the fault ratio comes with its expected value and its supporting evidence rather than as a bare number; the output is a submittable document, namely an incident statement and a rebuttal opinion letter exported as a PDF, which grounds a judgement in a file that can actually be handed to an insurer; and the disclaimer states in writing that the analysis is for reference only and does not replace the final judgement of an insurer, a dispute review committee, or a legal expert.** **The system was not run this round: no video was uploaded and no document was generated.**
entries.body:
**FAIRWAY（Car Defender）**（`soyeekim/FAIRWAY`）**是一个**韩国**多代理**交通事故应对**服务****——**逐字自述为**「**블랙박스 영상 분석부터 과실비율 확인, 보험 대응 문서 작성까지 지원하는 Multi-Agent 기반 교통사고 대응 서비스**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**用母语关键词找项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 四个代理各管一段，**而**不**是**一个模型**包办****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出四个代理**：**编排代理**（**逐字**：**对话、**状态、**任务协调）**、**视觉代理**（**逐字**：**行车记录仪**视频分析）**、**检索代理**（**逐字**：**相似案例与**依据检索）**、**文书代理**（**逐字**：**保险应对文书撰写）**，**并**逐字说明理由**「**하나의 AI 모델에 모든 작업을 맡기지 않고, 각 영역에 특화된 Agent가 협업하는 구조로 설계했습니다**」（**⭐ 即**「**不**把**所有工作**交给**一个模型**，**而**由**各领域**专精的**代理**协作」**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一句**是**全篇**最值钱的**表述**：**⭐ 即**「**为什么**要**多个代理**」**的**答案**不**是**「**更先进**」**，**而**是**「**每个环节**的**失败模式**不同**」**——**⭐ 视频理解**错**与**文书措辞**错**，**在**理赔场景**里**代价**完全**不同**。

**⭐⭐ ② 过失相抵比例**带**依据**，**而**不**是**一个**裸数字****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**功能表逐字**把**五件事**并列**：**行车记录仪分析**、**对话式信息确认**、**相似案例检索**（**逐字**：**RAG、**语义检索、**提供判断依据）**、**过失相抵比例分析**（**逐字**：**事故脉络分析、**预期比例、**以依据为中心的结果）**、**保险应对文书**（**逐字**：**事故经过书、**反驳意见书、**PDF）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一点**对 RIAA **很关键**：**⭐ 即**在**争议场景**里**，**「**一个比例**」**和**「**一个比例＋**它**引用的**相似案例**」**是**两种**交付物**——**⭐ 前者**只能**被接受或**被拒绝**，**后者**可以**被**逐条**反驳**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 产出落在「**能交出去的文书**」上****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字把**文书类型**写成**两件具名文件**（**事故经过书 **`사건경위서`**、**反驳意见书 **`반박의견서`**）**，**并**逐字列出**技术栈**：**后端 **Python／**FastAPI／**Pydantic／**SQLAlchemy**、**数据库 **PostgreSQL／**SQLite／**Alembic**、**实时 **SSE**、**文书 **PDF 生成与**邮件**、**基础设施 **Docker／**Nginx／**AWS EC2**、**测试 **pytest 与 **Ruff**；**⭐ 目录逐字**为 **`ai/`、**`server/`、**`design/`****；**⭐ 本词条**认为**：**⭐ 把**终点**设成**「**一份**保险流程里**真的**会用到的**文件**」**，**比**设成**「**一个**聊天回答**」**更容易**验证**——**⭐ 因为**文书**有**格式**、**有**收件人**、**也**有**可核对**的**事实项**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 免责声明逐字写清边界****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 末尾逐字为**「**본 서비스의 분석 결과는 참고용이며, 보험사·분쟁심의위원회 또는 법률 전문가의 최종 판단을 대신하지 않습니다.**」（**⭐ 即**「**本服务**的分析结果**仅供参考**，**不**替代**保险公司、**纠纷审议委员会**或**法律专家**的**最终判断」**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实转述**并**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**过失相抵比例**」**在**韩国**是**由**纠纷审议机制**裁定的**事项**，**而**一个**自动生成的**比例**只能**是**「**主张**」**，**不**是**「**结论**」**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**凡**输出**涉及**争议分配**的**数字**，**都**要**有**这一句**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 仓库体量**与**构成**（**如实记录）**：**⭐ 本次实测**：**729 个文件**、**其中 **409 个 **`.png`****（**⭐ 即**仓库 **80,556 KB** 里**有相当一部分**是**界面与示例截图**）**、**214 个 **`.py`**、**67 个 **`.md`****；**⚠️ 无许可证文件****——**⭐ 本词条**据此**提示**：**「**公开可读**」**与**「**可被使用**」**是**两件事**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[claimsight-damage-assessment]] 与 **[[car-damage-assessment-ai]] 覆盖**车辆损伤**评估**、**[[fss-korea-insurance]] 是**韩国**金融监督院的**保险统计**、**[[korea-ai-accountability]] 覆盖**韩国**的 **AI 问责**框架****——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**从**视频证据**到**争议比例**再到**可提交文书**」**这一**链条**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **多代理**的**理由**要**写成**「**各环节失败模式不同**」**；**② **争议类数字**必须**带**依据**（**相似案例**）；**③ **终点**设成**可提交的**文书**，**而**不**是**对话**；**④ **免责声明**要**指名**谁**才是**最终判断者**；**⑤ **截图**会**让**仓库**很大**，**发布前**想清**哪些**要**进库**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**该系统**（**未上传**任何**行车记录仪**视频**、**未调用**任何模型**、**未生成**任何文书**）**，**故**不主张**其**视频理解**能力**、**不主张**其**过失相抵比例**的**准确度**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**、**README 全文**与**仓库树**（**文件名与**字节数**）**，**未读**其 **Python** 源码**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**相似案例库**的**来源**（**⭐ 未见到**公开的**判例或**审议数据**来源说明**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**输出文书**是否**被**任何**保险公司**或**机构**接受**。**⑤ ⚠️ 其**自述的**检索与**判定**是否为**规则**、**统计**或**模型**驱动**，**本次**未核实**（**⭐ 只知**技术栈**含 **RAG 与**语义检索**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该系统**是**辅助工具**，**不是**理赔决定**，**也**不是**法律意见**。
entries.body_hk:
**FAIRWAY（Car Defender）**（`soyeekim/FAIRWAY`）**是一個**韓國**多代理**交通事故應對**服務****——**逐字自述為**「**블랙박스 영상 분석부터 과실비율 확인, 보험 대응 문서 작성까지 지원하는 Multi-Agent 기반 교통사고 대응 서비스**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**用母語關鍵詞找項目**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 四個代理各管一段，**而**不是**一個模型包辦****——**四個代理逐字為**編排代理（**對話、**狀態、**任務協調）**、**視覺代理（**行車記錄儀影片分析）**、**檢索代理（**相似案例與依據檢索）**、**文書代理（**保險應對文書撰寫）**，**並逐字說明理由**「**하나의 AI 모델에 모든 작업을 맡기지 않고, 각 영역에 특화된 Agent가 협업하는 구조로 설계했습니다**」**；**⭐ 即**多代理的理由**不是**「**更先進**」**，**而是**「**每個環節的失敗模式不同**」**。

**⭐⭐ ② 過失相抵比例帶依據****——**功能表逐字並列**行車記錄儀分析、**對話式資訊確認、**相似案例檢索（**RAG、**語義檢索、**提供判斷依據）**、**過失相抵比例分析（**預期比例、**以依據為中心的結果）**、**保險應對文書（**事故經過書、**反駁意見書、**PDF**）**；**⭐ 即**「**一個比例**」與**「**一個比例＋**它引用的相似案例**」**是**兩種交付物**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 產出落在「能交出去的文書」上****——**文書逐字為**兩件具名文件**（**`사건경위서`**、**`반박의견서`**）**；**技術棧逐字含**Python／**FastAPI／**Pydantic／**SQLAlchemy、**PostgreSQL／**SQLite／**Alembic、**SSE、**PDF 與**郵件、**Docker／**Nginx／**AWS EC2、**pytest 與**Ruff**；**目錄逐字為** `ai/`、`server/`、`design/`**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 免責聲明逐字寫清邊界****——**逐字為**「**본 서비스의 분석 결과는 참고용이며, 보험사·분쟁심의위원회 또는 법률 전문가의 최종 판단을 대신하지 않습니다.**」**；**⭐ 即**自動生成的比例**只能**是**「**主張**」**，**不**是**「**結論**」**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 倉庫體量與構成****——**729 個檔案**、**409 個 `.png`**、**214 個 `.py`**、**67 個 `.md`**；**⚠️ 無許可證檔案****——**「**公開可讀**」**與**「**可被使用**」**是**兩件事**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[claimsight-damage-assessment]]、[[car-damage-assessment-ai]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[korea-ai-accountability]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**從影片證據到爭議比例再到可提交文書**」**這一鏈條**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **多代理的理由要寫成「各環節失敗模式不同」**；**② **爭議類數字必須帶依據**；**③ **終點設成可提交的文書**；**④ **免責聲明要指名誰才是最終判斷者**；**⑤ **截圖會讓倉庫很大**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有運行**該系統**，**不主張**其影片理解能力**與**過失相抵比例的準確度**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料、**README 全文**與**倉庫樹**，**未讀**其 Python 源碼**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**其相似案例庫的來源**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其輸出文書是否被任何保險公司或機構接受**。**⑤ ⚠️ 其檢索與判定是否為規則、**統計或模型驅動**，**本次未核實**。**⑥ ⚠️ 該倉庫無許可證檔案**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該系統是輔助工具**，**不是**理賠決定**，**也**不是**法律意見**。
entries.body_en:
This is a Korean multi-agent service for handling traffic accidents, describing itself in writing in Korean as a multi-agent traffic-accident response service covering dashcam analysis, fault-ratio checking, and the drafting of insurance response documents. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, four agents each own one stage rather than one model doing everything.** The description lists an orchestration agent for conversation, state, and task coordination, a vision agent for dashcam video analysis, a retrieval agent for similar cases and supporting evidence, and a document agent for insurance response drafting, and states the design rationale in writing: rather than entrusting every task to one model, the structure was designed so that agents specialised per domain collaborate. **The reason for multiple agents is therefore not that it is more advanced but that each stage has a different failure mode, and a mistake in video understanding and a mistake in document wording carry very different costs in a claims setting.**

**Second, the fault ratio comes with its evidence rather than as a bare number.** The feature table places dashcam analysis, conversational confirmation, similar-case retrieval described as augmented generation with semantic search providing the basis for judgement, fault-ratio analysis described as context analysis with an expected ratio and an evidence-centred result, and insurance response documents alongside each other. **In a dispute setting a ratio and a ratio that cites the similar cases behind it are two different deliverables, because the first can only be accepted or rejected while the second can be contested point by point.**

**Third, the output is a document that can actually be handed over.** Two named documents are produced, an incident statement and a rebuttal opinion letter, exported as PDF, and the stated stack covers a Python web framework with validation and object-relational tooling, relational databases with migrations, server-sent events for real time, PDF generation and email, containers with a reverse proxy on a cloud instance, and a test and lint toolchain. **Setting the endpoint as a file the insurance process really uses, rather than a chat answer, makes the system easier to verify, because a document has a format, a recipient, and checkable factual items.**

**Fourth, the disclaimer states its boundary in writing**, saying that the analysis is for reference only and does not replace the final judgement of an insurer, a dispute review committee, or a legal expert. **In this jurisdiction the fault apportionment is a matter decided through a dispute review mechanism, so an automatically produced ratio can only be a claim rather than a conclusion, and any output that allocates a disputed loss ought to carry that sentence.**

**Fifth, the repository size and composition are recorded as measured**: seven hundred twenty-nine files, of which more than four hundred are images, two hundred fourteen Python files, and sixty-seven documents, with the repository reaching about eighty megabytes. **There is no licence file, so publicly readable and usable are two different things.**

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover vehicle damage assessment, Korean supervisory insurance statistics, and Korean accountability frameworks for artificial intelligence, **while this entry supplies the chain from video evidence to a disputed ratio and then to a submittable document. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: justify multiple agents by differing failure modes per stage; attach evidence to any disputed number; make the endpoint a submittable document rather than a conversation; name in the disclaimer who the final decision maker actually is; and remember that screenshots bloat a repository, so decide what belongs in it before publishing.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the system was not run**, no dashcam video was uploaded, no model was called, and no document was generated, **so no claim is made about its video understanding or about the accuracy of its fault ratio**. **Second, only metadata, the description in full, and the file tree with names and sizes were read**, not the Python source. **Third, the origin of its similar-case library was not verified**, no public statement of the case or review data behind it being found. **Fourth, whether its output documents are accepted by any insurer or institution was not verified. Fifth, whether its retrieval and assessment are rule-based, statistical, or model-driven was not verified**, the stated stack only indicating augmented generation and semantic search. **Sixth, the repository carries no licence file. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the system is an assistance tool rather than a claims decision or legal advice.**

entries.title: **一份**把「**保险经纪公司**的**AI 操作系统**」**写到**逐模块**与**逐状态**的**重建中仓库****：`autobrokers-intelligence-os`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**plataforma SaaS multi-tenant de inteligência artificial para corretoras de seguros**」**；**⭐ 重建公式逐字为**「**AutoBrokers.ai = Product Layer + Smith Runtime Engine + AutoBrokers Domain Brain**」**；**⭐ 而**其**「**当前状态**」**逐字列出**已完成 14 项**（**Web **Next.js、**API **FastAPI、**Supabase／**Redis／**Qdrant／**MinIO 均已配置**）**与**未完成 13 项**（**含逐字**「**integração real com seguradoras**」**与**「**produção**」**）**；**⭐ 三条运行时纪律逐字为**「**ResultVision é referência, não runtime**」**、**「**Agent OS é fonte de domínio, não runtime ativo**」**、**「**intake bruto é sensível e bloqueado para uso direto**」**；**⭐ 仓库树实测 **2,365 个文件**（**852 个 **`.py`**、**569 个 **`.ts`／**`.tsx`**、**520 个 **`.md`**、**127 个 **`.sql`**、**124 个 **`.jsonl`****）**
entries.title_en: A mid-rebuild repository that documents an insurance broker artificial-intelligence operating system down to each module and each state: it describes itself in writing as a multi-tenant software-as-a-service artificial-intelligence platform for insurance brokers, states its rebuild formula as a product layer plus a runtime engine plus a domain brain, lists fourteen things that already work, from the web client and the interface service to the configured support services, alongside thirteen that do not, including real insurer integration and production, adopts three runtime rules stating that one legacy system is a reference rather than a runtime, that another is a domain source rather than an active runtime, and that raw intake is sensitive and blocked from direct use, and ships a tree of more than two thousand files dominated by Python, TypeScript, documentation, SQL, and structured log lines.

entries.summary_en: This is a repository for a multi-tenant artificial-intelligence platform aimed at insurance brokerages, describing itself in writing as a multi-tenant software-as-a-service artificial-intelligence platform for insurance brokers. **Measured this round**: created in early June and last pushed on the tenth of September, a repository of about thirty-two megabytes whose main language is Python, no licence file, no stars, a description of about twenty-five kilobytes over one thousand four hundred thirty-eight lines in Portuguese, and a tree of two thousand three hundred sixty-five files including eight hundred fifty-two Python files, five hundred sixty-nine TypeScript files, five hundred twenty documents, one hundred twenty-seven SQL files, and one hundred twenty-four line-delimited data files. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language and was reached through the Portuguese word for insurance brokerage.** **Four things are worth reading: the current-state section is split in writing into fourteen things that already work and thirteen that do not, the latter including real integration with insurers and production deployment; three runtime rules state plainly what is a reference, what is current, and what is blocked; the rebuild formula is written as a product layer plus a runtime engine plus a domain brain, so an older system is decomposed into parts and reassembled rather than thrown away; and the mix of five hundred twenty documents with one hundred twenty-four line-delimited data files shows a repository that is simultaneously a documentation set and a store of structured records.** **The system was not run this round and no claim is made that any of its services actually works.**
entries.body:
**AutoBrokers Intelligence OS**（`Amandico100/AutoBrokers-Intelligence-OS`）**是一份**面向**保险经纪公司**的**多租户 **AI 平台**仓库****——**逐字自述为**「**a fundação técnica, operacional e estratégica do AutoBrokers.ai, uma plataforma SaaS multi-tenant de inteligência artificial para corretoras de seguros**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**用母语关键词找项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 「**当前状态**」**被**逐项**分成**能跑**与**不能跑**两栏****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**十四项**已完成**：**沙箱已装、**使用 **EasyPanel、**Web **Next.js** 可用、**API **FastAPI** 可用、**Supabase 沙箱已配置、**Redis、**Qdrant、**MinIO 均已配置、**后台可访问、**租户登录可用、**租户聊天可用、**AutoBrokers 在沙箱中可回应、**规范文档在 **`docs/canon/`**、**历史文档已移入 **`docs/_archive/`****；**⭐ 并逐字列出**十三项**尚未完成**：**最终设计系统、**最终 **UX、**最终侧边栏、**Auxiliares 模块、**完整 **Vault、**有安全策展的 **RAG、**在新运行时中重建的 **Atendimento、**已移植的 **corredores、**真实 **WhatsApp、**真实 **InfoCap／**Quiver、**Docling／**worker 的最终流程、**⭐ **与保险公司的真实对接**（**逐字**：**integração real com seguradoras**）**、**⭐ **生产环境**（**逐字**：**produção**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这两栏**是**本轮**最值得**单独**记下的**一处**：**⭐ 即**一份**AI 产品**的**真实进度**，**可以**用**「**能跑／**不能跑**」**两栏**说清**——**⭐ 而**其中**最**关键的**两条**（**与**保险公司**对接、**上生产**）**都**还在**未完成**栏里**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**演示**与**落地**之间**，**通常**差的**正是**这两条**。

**⭐⭐ ② 三条**运行时纪律**把**参考物**、**现行物**与**封禁物**分开****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**ResultVision é referência, não runtime**」**、**「**Agent OS é fonte de domínio, não runtime ativo**」**、**「**intake bruto é sensível e bloqueado para uso direto**」**、**并**逐字规定**「**/dashboard deve permanecer chat-first**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组**纪律**解决**的**是**重建期**特有的**混乱**：**⭐ 即**当**一个产品**有**三代**实现**并存**时**，**「**哪个**还算数**」**必须**写下来**——**⭐ 否则**代理（**人或 **AI）**会**照着**旧实现**改**新代码**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 重建公式与**三种智能**的分层****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出**公式**「**AutoBrokers.ai = Product Layer + Smith Runtime Engine + AutoBrokers Domain Brain**」**，**并逐字说明**产品层**管**品牌、**体验、**导航、**模块与**最终语言**；**⭐ 另逐字区分**三类智能**（**AutoBrokers 本体、**服务代理、**辅助模块）**与**七个主模块**（**含 **Conectores（**连接器）**、**Conhecimento（**知识）**、**Admin Global**）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**：**⭐ 即**把**「**领域大脑**」**单独**命名**，**是**承认**领域知识**与**运行时**可以**分开演进**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**你**要**做**保险 **AI 产品**，**把**知识层**（**条款、**费率、**流程）**与**编排层**分开**，**将来**换**模型**或**换**框架**时**代价**最小**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 仓库构成**说明**它**同时**是**文档库**与**数据／轨迹库****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**仓库树 **2,365 个文件**、**合计约 **43,109 KB****（**⭐ 而**接口 **`size` 字段为 **32,880 KB**）**，**逐个扩展名**为 **`.py` 852**、**`.md` 520**、**`.ts` 313**、**`.tsx` 256**、**`.sql` 127**、**`.jsonl` 124**、**`.html` 27**、**`.json` 25**、**`.csv` 7**、**`.patch` 7**、**`.xlsx` 2** 等**；**顶层目录逐字**含 **`.agents`、**`.github`、**`app`、**`backend`、**`components`、**`docling-service`、**`docs`、**`hooks`、**`infra`、**`lib`、**`public`、**`scripts`、**`supabase`、**`types`****；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即 **520 个 Markdown** 与 **一个 **`.agents`** 目录**，**说明**这**是**一个**由 **AI 代理**参与**维护的**文档密集**仓库**——**⭐ 而**其中**哪些**是**规范**、**哪些**是**历史**，**由**其**逐字指定的 **`docs/canon/`** 与 **`docs/_archive/`** 两个目录**来**区分**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurancepro-crm]]、**[[brokerflow-renewal-crm]] 与**[[corredor-broker-platform]] 覆盖**代理与**经纪的**业务平台**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**多租户 **AI 平台**形态**重建**经纪公司**作业系统**」这一形态**，**并且**把**重建进度**写成**可核对**的**两栏**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **用**「**能跑／**不能跑**」**两栏**替代**含糊的**进度描述**；**② **重建期**要**写清**哪个**实现**还算数**；**③ **知识层**与**编排层**分开**命名**；**④ **把**「**与**保险公司**对接**」**与**「**上生产**」**单独**列为**里程碑**；**⑤ **规范文档**与**历史文档**分目录**；**⑥ **原始**输入（**intake）**若**敏感**，**默认**封禁**直接使用**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**该系统**（**未安装依赖、**未起任何服务、**未连接 **Supabase／**Redis／**Qdrant／**MinIO**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何服务**可用**、**也不主张**其**自述的**已完成项**在**我**环境**中**成立**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**、**README 全文**与**仓库树**（**文件名与**字节数**）**，**未读**其 **Python／**TypeScript** 源码**、**未读**其 **520 个 Markdown** 中的**任何一篇**。**③ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**——**⭐ 且**它**逐字**含**「**Termos proibidos como marca visível**」（**禁止作为可见品牌的术语）**一节**，**说明**其**品牌与**使用边界**有**自定规则**，**⚠️ 本词条**不**替代**其**许可判断**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**与**任何**保险公司**或**经纪公司**有**真实**业务关系**（**⭐ 其**自述**明确说**「**与**保险公司的真实对接**」**尚未完成）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**以**真实客户数据**运行**（**⭐ 逐字只说**沙箱与**租户登录**可用**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ README **含**产品与**商业定位**表述**，**⚠️ 本词条**只转述**可核实**的**状态**与**结构**，**不**对其**商业前景**作**评述**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该仓库**是**平台工程**，**不是**保险产品**，**也**不是**承保或**投资意见**。

**AutoBrokers Intelligence OS**（`Amandico100/AutoBrokers-Intelligence-OS`）**是一份**面向**保險經紀公司**的**多租戶 AI 平台**倉庫****——**逐字自述為**「**uma plataforma SaaS multi-tenant de inteligência artificial para corretoras de seguros**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**用母語關鍵詞找項目**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 「當前狀態」被逐項分成能跑與不能跑兩欄****——**已完成十四項逐字含**沙箱已裝、**EasyPanel、**Web Next.js 可用、**API FastAPI 可用、**Supabase／Redis／Qdrant／MinIO 已配置、**後台可訪問、**租戶登錄與**租戶聊天可用、**AutoBrokers 在沙箱中可回應、**規範文檔在 `docs/canon/`、**歷史文檔在 `docs/_archive/`**；**未完成十三項逐字含**最終設計系統、**最終 UX、**側邊欄、**Auxiliares 模組、**完整 Vault、**有安全策展的 RAG、**重建的 Atendimento、**已移植的 corredores、**真實 WhatsApp、**真實 InfoCap／Quiver、**Docling／worker 最終流程、**⭐**integração real com seguradoras**、**⭐**produção****；**⭐ 即**最關鍵的兩條**（**與保險公司對接、**上生產**）**都還在未完成欄**。

**⭐⭐ ② 三條運行時紀律****——**逐字**「**ResultVision é referência, não runtime**」**、**「**Agent OS é fonte de domínio, não runtime ativo**」**、**「**intake bruto é sensível e bloqueado para uso direto**」**、**並規定**「**/dashboard deve permanecer chat-first**」**；**⭐ 即**重建期**必須寫清**哪個實現還算數**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 重建公式與分層****——**逐字**「**AutoBrokers.ai = Product Layer + Smith Runtime Engine + AutoBrokers Domain Brain**」**；**另逐字區分**三類智能與**七個主模組**（**含 Conectores、**Conhecimento、**Admin Global**）**；**⭐ 即**把領域大腦單獨命名**，**承認**知識層與**運行時**可分開演進**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 倉庫構成****——**2,365 個檔案**、**約 43,109 KB**（**介面 size 欄位為 32,880 KB**）**，**逐擴展名**為 `.py` 852、`.md` 520、`.ts` 313、`.tsx` 256、`.sql` 127、`.jsonl` 124** 等**；**頂層目錄逐字含** `.agents`、`.github`、`app`、`backend`、`components`、`docling-service`、`docs`、`hooks`、`infra`、`lib`、`public`、`scripts`、`supabase`、`types`**；**⭐ 即**規範與歷史**由 **`docs/canon/`** 與 **`docs/_archive/`** 區分**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insurancepro-crm]]、[[brokerflow-renewal-crm]]、[[corredor-broker-platform]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**以多租戶 AI 平台形態重建經紀公司作業系統**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **用「**能跑／**不能跑**」兩欄替代含糊進度**；**② **重建期寫清哪個實現還算數**；**③ **知識層與編排層分開命名**；**④ **把「**與保險公司對接**」與「**上生產**」單列為里程碑**；**⑤ **規範與歷史文檔分目錄**；**⑥ **敏感原始輸入默認封禁直接用**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有運行**該系統**，**不主張**其任何服務可用**、**也不主張**其自述的已完成項在我環境中成立**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料、**README 全文**與**倉庫樹**，**未讀**其 Python／TypeScript 源碼**、**未讀**其任何一篇 Markdown**。**③ ⚠️ 該倉庫無許可證檔案**，**且逐字含**「**Termos proibidos como marca visível**」**一節**，**本詞條**不替代其許可判斷**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否與任何保險公司或經紀公司有真實業務關係**（**其自述**明確說**與保險公司的真實對接尚未完成**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否以真實客戶數據運行**（**逐字只說**沙箱與租戶登錄可用**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ README **含產品與商業定位表述**，**本詞條**只轉述可核實的狀態與結構**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該倉庫是平台工程**，**不是**保險產品**，**也**不是**承保或投資意見**。
entries.body_en:
This is a repository for a multi-tenant artificial-intelligence platform aimed at insurance brokerages, describing itself in writing as the technical, operational, and strategic foundation of a multi-tenant software-as-a-service artificial-intelligence platform for insurance brokers. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the current-state section is split item by item into what runs and what does not.** Fourteen finished items are listed in writing: the sandbox is installed, a panel tool is in use, the web client works, the interface service works, and the sandbox database, cache, vector store, and object store are configured, with the administration area reachable, tenant login and tenant chat working, the assistant responding inside the sandbox, canonical documents under one directory and historical documents moved to an archive directory. **Thirteen unfinished items are listed beside them**, including the final design system, the final user experience, the final sidebar, one module as a finished product, a complete secrets vault, retrieval with safe curation, a rebuilt service desk, ported broker components, real messaging integration, two real external systems, a definitive document-processing flow, **real integration with insurers**, and **production**. **Being able to say plainly which parts run and which do not is the most valuable thing to copy here, and in this case the two most consequential items, real insurer integration and production, both sit in the unfinished column, which is usually exactly the gap between a demonstration and a deployment.**

**Second, three runtime rules separate what is a reference, what is current, and what is blocked.** The description states in writing that one legacy system is a reference rather than a runtime, that another is a domain source rather than an active runtime, and that raw intake is sensitive and blocked from direct use, and it also fixes a product rule that one dashboard must remain conversation-first. **This set of rules addresses the specific confusion of a rebuild period, because when three generations of an implementation coexist, which one still counts has to be written down, or both human and machine contributors will modify new code according to an obsolete design.**

**Third, the rebuild formula and the layering are stated.** The description gives the formula as a product layer plus a runtime engine plus a domain brain, explains that the product layer owns brand, experience, navigation, modules, and final language, distinguishes three classes of intelligence, and names seven main modules including connectors, knowledge, and global administration. **Naming the domain brain separately acknowledges that domain knowledge and runtime can evolve apart, and for anyone building an insurance product it is the cheapest future-proofing available, because it is what lets the model or the orchestration framework be replaced later.**

**Fourth, the repository composition shows it is simultaneously a documentation store and a record store.** The tree holds more than two thousand three hundred files totalling about forty-three megabytes, while the interface size field reports just under thirty-three megabytes, and the extension breakdown is dominated by eight hundred fifty-two Python files, five hundred twenty documents, five hundred sixty-nine TypeScript files, one hundred twenty-seven SQL files, one hundred twenty-four line-delimited data files, and a handful of spreadsheets and patches. **The presence of more than five hundred documents and an agent configuration directory indicates a documentation-dense repository maintained with machine assistance, and which documents are normative and which are historical is settled by the two directories the description names for exactly that purpose.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover agency and brokerage business platforms, **while this entry supplies the form of rebuilding a brokerage operating system as a multi-tenant artificial-intelligence platform and writes the rebuild progress as a checkable pair of columns. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: replace vague progress language with a runs and does-not-run pair of columns; state which implementation still counts during a rebuild; name the knowledge layer separately from the orchestration layer; list real integration and production as their own milestones; keep normative and historical documentation in separate directories; and block sensitive raw intake by default.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the system was not run**, no dependencies were installed, no service was started, and none of the named support services was connected, **so no claim is made that any service works or that the stated finished items hold in this environment**. **Second, only metadata, the description in full, and the file tree with names and sizes were read**, not the source code and not any of the five hundred documents. **Third, the repository carries no licence file and includes a section listing terms prohibited as visible brands, so this entry does not substitute for its licensing position. Fourth, whether it has any real business relationship with an insurer or brokerage was not verified**, its own description stating that real insurer integration is unfinished. **Fifth, whether it runs on real customer data was not verified**, the stated status mentioning only a sandbox and tenant login. **Sixth, the description contains product and commercial positioning, and this entry transcribes only the checkable status and structure without commenting on commercial prospects. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the repository is platform engineering rather than an insurance product or an underwriting or investment opinion.**

entries.title_en: An agentic tool that distills a gradient-boosted model into an interpretable generalised linear model while an actuary signs off each decision: it states in writing that it is an agentic pricing tool with a human in the loop at every key decision, runs feature selection, categorical grouping, boosted-model training, distillation, and linear fitting as five stages, lets the actuary approve, reject, or leave a remark on each proposed variable and reject any fitted term with a wrong sign or unacceptable p-value, outputs a rating factor table where exponentials of coefficients are read as multiplicative relativities against a base level of one, and carries an MIT licence.
