**Análisis del Mercado Chileno de Seguros de Vida**（`JuanIgnacioPal/analisis-mercado-seguros-vida-chile`）**是一份**智利寿险市场的**端到端 **BI 项目****——**逐字自述为**「**Proyecto end-to-end de Business Intelligence con datos 100 % sintéticos, inspirado en conceptos e indicadores del mercado asegurador chileno.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**把此前各轮记为「**待评**」的条目**逐条判定**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 限制写得比结论还细，**而**这**正是**本条**最值得记**的地方****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 有**专门一节**「**Limitaciones metodológicas**」**（**方法学限制）**，**逐条**包括**：**① **数据与公司**100 % 合成**，**仅**用于**教育与**作品集**；**② **ROE** 因**合成数据的**合理性限制**被**排除**在**主要结论之外**；**③ **合成偿付能力**是**教育性指标**，**并逐字**「**no reproduce la metodología regulatoria oficial de la CMF**」（**不**复现 **CMF** 官方**监管方法）**；**④ **「**净组合余额＝新被保人−注销**」**与**存量变动**不**完全对账**，**故**逐字**「**no se interpretan como churn, retención o persistencia**」（**不**解释为**流失、**留存或**续保率**）**；**⑤ **直接保费**与**分产品保费之和**存在**四舍五入差异**；**⑥ **赔付率、**费用与**技术利润率**之间**的**关系**因**构造公式**而**部分**机械**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一节**是**整份作品**里**最**有价值**的**部分**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**这份**数据**不**能**回答**什么**」**写在**结论**旁边**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**任何**用**合成或**脱敏**数据的**分析**，**都**应**列出**同一张**清单**（**哪个**指标**被**剔除、**哪条**因果**是**构造**出来的、**哪组**数字**对不上账**）**。

**⭐⭐ ② SQL 当控制层，**先给**控制值**表****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**SQL se utilizó como capa de control antes de construir la visualización.**」**，**并逐字列出**2025-T4** 的**控制值**：**直接保费 **`2.435.934 MM CLP`**、**环比 **`4,77 %`**、**同比 **`4,29 %`**、**加权赔付率 **`55,70 %`**、**费用率 **`12,79 %`**、**技术结果 **`736.330 MM CLP`**、**技术利润率 **`31,51 %`**、**合成偿付能力 **`180,48 %`**、**有效被保人 **`9.134.304`**、**被保人同比 **`-3,83 %`****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一做法**对**数据**工作**很**实用**：**⭐ 即**先**在**查询层**把**关键指标**固定成**可**比对的**控制值**，**再**做**可视化**——**⭐ 这样**当**报表**与**查询**不一致**时**，**先**怀疑**报表**，**而**不**是**先**怀疑**数据**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 数据规模与结构**逐字**可核****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**数据集逐字为**144 个观测**、**12 家**虚构寿险公司、**12 个季度**（**2023-T1 至 **2025-T4）、**39 个**原始变量**、**性质逐字 **`100 % sintéticos`****；**变量**覆盖**财务、**商业、**运营、**资本、**组合与**产品结构****；**⭐ 并逐字提供**数据字典、**KPI 字典、**SQL 方法学**与**数据质量审计**四份**文档**；**⭐ 维度模型**逐字**含**维度表**与**事实表**，**并**给出**2025-T4** 的**主要对账**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 执行建议**方向**明确**，**且**反对**「**一个分数**」****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**五条**建议**，**其中**两条**对本站读者**尤其**值得抄**：**逐字**「**Evaluar eficiencia técnica y fortaleza de capital por separado, evitando un score único con ponderaciones arbitrarias.**」（**把**技术效率与**资本实力**分开评估**，**避免**用**任意权重**合成**一个**分数）**；**逐字**「**Implementar conciliaciones stock–flujo de cartera antes de utilizar altas y cancelaciones como base para métricas de churn, retención o persistencia.**」（**在**把**新增与**注销**当作**流失／**留存／**续保**指标的**基础之前**，**先**做**存量与**流量的**对账）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这两条**是**本轮的**可迁移**结论**：**⭐ 即**「**先对账，**再算比率**」**与**「**不要**把**不同性质**的**强度**强行**合成**一个**分数**」。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ ⚠️ 一处**内部不一致**（**本词条**如实指出）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 的**英文摘要**逐字写**「**Data analytics portfolio project examining the Chilean life insurance market using public CMF data.**」**（**使用**公开的 **CMF** 数据）**，**而**正文**数据集**一节**与**方法学限制**逐字**写的是 **100 % sintéticos****；**⭐ 本词条**不**猜测**其**原因**，**只**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**当**一份**作品**同时**面向**西班牙语与**英语**读者**时**，**两个**版本的**口径**（**尤其**是**数据**性质**）**必须**一致**——**⭐ 这**也**是**为什么**本词条**把**数据**性质**单独**列出**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[cmf-chile]] 是**同一国**监管机构**的**统计入口**、**[[insurance-analytical-case-studies]] 覆盖**保险**分析案例**、**[[insurance-portfolio-performance]] 覆盖**组合**绩效**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**合成面板 + **SQL 控制层 + **维度模型**的**端到端**作品**、**并**把**数据**局限**写清**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **限制清单**要**逐条**写**，**并**放在**结论**旁边**；**② **先**定**控制值**，**再**做**可视化**；**③ **对账**不成立**时**，**不要**用**该差额**算**比率**；**④ **不要**用**任意权重**合成**单一**分数**；**⑤ **合成数据**要**写明**哪些**指标**因此**不可用**（**本条**剔除 **ROE）**；**⑥ **多语言**版本**的**口径**必须**一致**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**其 **SQL** 查询、**没有打开**其 **Power BI** 模型**（**未下载**其数据集**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何指标**的**计算**正确性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **`.pbix` 模型**、**未读**其 **SQL 脚本**与**四份**文档**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**合成数据**的**生成方法**（**⭐ 逐字**只**说明**为**合成**，**未**给出**生成**过程**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**控制值**与**合成数据集**是否**一致**（**⭐ 本次**未下载**数据**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否为**任何**课程**或**机构**的**项目**（**⭐ 逐字**含**课程式**表述**与**作品集**定位**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该作品**是**教学**与**作品集**项目**，**其**数字**不**代表**智利**寿险市场**的**真实**表现**，**也**不是**精算意见**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐ ③ 數據規模與結構****——**144 個觀測、**12 家虛構壽險公司、**12 個季度（**2023-T1 至 2025-T4）、**39 個原始變量、**性質逐字 `100 % sintéticos`**；**另附**數據字典、**KPI 字典、**SQL 方法學**與**數據質量審計****。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ ⚠️ 一處內部不一致****——**英文摘要逐字**using public CMF data**，**而正文與限制逐字為 `100 % sintéticos`**；**本條不猜原因**，**只指出多語言版本口徑必須一致**。

entries.body_en:
This is an end-to-end business intelligence project on the Chilean life insurance market, stating in writing that it uses wholly synthetic data inspired by the concepts and indicators of that market. **This entry belongs to the round theme of adjudicating the items earlier rounds had parked for review.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the limitations are written in more detail than the conclusions, and that is the most valuable part of the work.** A dedicated section lists them one by one: the data and the companies are wholly synthetic and used only for education and portfolio purposes; return on equity was excluded from the main conclusions because of a plausibility limitation of the synthetic dataset; the synthetic solvency figure is an educational indicator that does not reproduce the regulator official methodology, stated in writing; the identity defining net portfolio balance as new insureds minus cancellations does not fully reconcile with the change in the stock of policyholders, so those flows are not interpreted as churn, retention, or persistence; direct premium and the sum of premiums by product differ by rounding inherent to synthetic construction; and the relationships among loss ratio, expenses, and technical margin are partly mechanical because of the formula used to build the technical result. **Putting the list of what the data cannot answer next to the conclusions is exactly what any analysis built on synthetic or de-identified data should do, naming which measure was dropped, which relationship is an artefact of construction, and which figures do not reconcile.**

**Second, queries are used as a control layer and control values are published first.** The description states that structured queries were used as a control layer before the visualisation was built, and lists control values for the latest quarter: direct premium, quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year growth, weighted loss ratio, expense ratio, technical result, technical margin, synthetic solvency, policyholders in force, and their year-on-year change. **Fixing key measures as comparable control values in the query layer before building a dashboard means that when a report and a query disagree, the report is suspected first rather than the data.**

**Third, the scale and structure of the data are checkable.** The dataset is stated as one hundred forty-four observations across twelve fictional life insurers and twelve quarters with thirty-nine original variables, described as wholly synthetic, covering financial, commercial, operational, capital, portfolio, and product-mix variables, and accompanied by a data dictionary, a measure dictionary, a query methodology, and a data quality audit. **A dimensional model with dimension and fact tables and a published main reconciliation for the latest quarter completes the chain from raw file to dashboard.**

**Fourth, the recommendations take a clear direction and argue against a single score.** Two of the five are especially transferable: evaluating technical efficiency and capital strength separately rather than merging them into one score with arbitrary weights, and implementing portfolio stock-and-flow reconciliations before using additions and cancellations as the basis for churn, retention, or persistence measures. **Reconcile first and compute ratios second, and do not force intensities of different natures into a single number.**

**Fifth, this entry notes one internal inconsistency.** The English summary describes the project as examining the market using public regulator data, while the data section and the limitations state that the data are wholly synthetic. **This entry does not speculate about the cause; it simply notes that when a work addresses both Spanish-speaking and English-speaking readers, the two versions must agree on the nature of the data, which is also why this entry records that nature separately.**

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the same country regulator statistics portal, insurance analytical case studies, and portfolio performance, **while this entry supplies the form of an end-to-end work built from a synthetic panel with a query control layer and a dimensional model that writes its data limits out. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: write the limitations one by one beside the conclusions; fix control values before visualising; never compute a ratio from a difference that does not reconcile; avoid arbitrary weights in a single score; state which measures synthetic data makes unusable, as this project does with return on equity; and keep multilingual versions consistent in their definitions.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, neither the queries nor the dashboard model were run**, no dataset was downloaded, **so no claim is made about the correctness of any computed measure**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the dashboard model, the query scripts, or the four accompanying documents. **Third, how the synthetic data were generated was not verified**, the description stating only that they are synthetic. **Fourth, whether the control values agree with the synthetic dataset was not verified**, the data not being downloaded. **Fifth, whether the project belongs to any course or institution was not verified**, the description carrying course-like wording and a portfolio positioning. **Sixth, the repository carries no licence file. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the work is a teaching and portfolio project whose figures do not represent the real Chilean life market and are not an actuarial opinion.**

entries.title: **一个**德国**保险与金融比价门户**，**并**带一条**很**少见的**测试**：**用**无头浏览器**逐页**断言**「**恰好一个**计算器可见**」**——`sichervergleich-portal`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Ein deutsches Vergleichsportal für Versicherungs- und Finanzprodukte (KFZ, Haftpflicht, Hausrat, PKV, BU, Baufinanzierung u. v. m.).**」**；**⭐ 结构逐字为**27 个详情页**、**5 个**分类路由组****；**⭐ 而**其**每个**险种**的**计算器**是**逐字**「**Live-Partner-Rechner**」**（**合作方**实时**计算器）**，**并**带**「**Single-Injection-Guard**」**防**重复**iframe****；**⭐ 测试逐字**「**lädt jede Detailseite in headless Chrome und prüft, dass genau 1 sichtbarer Rechner gerendert wird**」**；**⚠️ 仓库**无许可证**
entries.title_en: A German insurance and finance comparison portal that ships an unusual test: it loads every detail page in a headless browser and asserts that exactly one calculator is visible. It describes itself in writing as a German comparison portal for insurance and finance products across motor, liability, household contents, private health, occupational disability, and mortgage financing; it is organised as twenty-seven detail pages across five category route groups; each line calculator is a live partner widget with a guard against duplicate injection; and it carries a script that verifies the single-visible-calculator property on every page, while the repository has no licence file.
entries.title_hk: **一個**德國**保險與金融比價門戶**，**並**帶一條**很**少見的**測試**：**用**無頭瀏覽器**逐頁**斷言**「**恰好一個**計算器可見**」**——`sichervergleich-portal`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Ein deutsches Vergleichsportal für Versicherungs- und Finanzprodukte (KFZ, Haftpflicht, Hausrat, PKV, BU, Baufinanzierung u. v. m.).**」**；**⭐ 結構逐字為 27 個詳情頁、**5 個分類路由組****；**⭐ 每個險種的計算器逐字為**「**Live-Partner-Rechner**」**，**並帶**「**Single-Injection-Guard**」**防重複 iframe****；**⭐ 測試逐字**「**lädt jede Detailseite in headless Chrome und prüft, dass genau 1 sichtbarer Rechner gerendert wird**」**；**⚠️ 倉庫**無許可證**

entries.summary_en: This is a German insurance and finance comparison portal, describing itself in writing as a German comparison portal for insurance and financial products covering motor, liability, household contents, private health, occupational disability, and mortgage financing. **Measured this round**: created in late August and last pushed on the ninth of September, a repository of about eight megabytes in TypeScript, no stars, no licence file, and a default branch named master, with a description of about seventeen hundred bytes over forty-five lines. **This entry belongs to the round theme of adjudicating the items earlier rounds had parked for review.** **Four things are worth reading: the portal itself carries no pricing logic, because each line calculator is a live partner calculator embedded in a frame, which means comparison on such a portal is generally a matter of handing the user to a partner calculator rather than computing anything locally; the defect that follows from that design is handled head-on with a guard against duplicate frames under development-mode double rendering; and the property is then turned into a test, since a script loads every detail page in a headless browser and asserts that exactly one visible calculator renders, which this entry considers the most transferable idea of the round, because a business assertion like only one calculator may appear on a page can be checked page by page; finally the structure and search-engine groundwork are complete, with twenty-seven detail pages across five category route groups and generated robots, sitemap, not-found handling, and per-page metadata.** **The portal was neither built nor run this round, and no partner calculator was opened.**
entries.body:
**SicherVergleich**（`Ilker-Arkon/versicherungsvergleich-portal`）**是一个**德国**保险与金融比价门户****——**逐字自述为**「**Ein deutsches Vergleichsportal für Versicherungs- und Finanzprodukte (KFZ, Haftpflicht, Hausrat, PKV, BU, Baufinanzierung u. v. m.).**」**，**技术栈逐字为 **Next.js 16（**App Router、**Turbopack）**、**React 19、**Tailwind CSS v4** 与 **Lucide** 图标**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**把此前各轮记为「**待评**」的条目**逐条判定**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 门户自身**不含**定价逻辑**，**计算器**是**合作方的**实时**组件****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**Live-Partner-Rechner je Sparte (`components/PartnerWidget.tsx`)**」**（**每个**险种**一个**合作方**实时**计算器）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**改变了**「**比价门户**」**在**保险分发**里的**位置**：**⭐ 即**门户**提供**的**不是**「**一套**自己的**费率引擎**」**，**而**是**「**分类、**导流与**呈现**」**——**⭐ 费率**与**核保**仍**在**合作方**手里**（**以 **iframe** 形式**嵌进**页面）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**解释了**为什么**这类**门户**的**技术难点**常常**不是**定价**，**而**是**「**页面**与**嵌入组件的**一致性**」**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 一个**具体缺陷**被**正面**处理**：**重复 **iframe****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**Single-Injection-Guard gegen doppelte iframes (React StrictMode)**」**；**⭐ 本词条**如实说明**这一句**所指**的**问题**：**⭐ 即**在**开发模式**下**（**React **StrictMode）**组件**会**被**渲染两次**，**若**没有**防护**，**页面上**会**出现**两个**计算器**——**⭐ 而**在**生产环境**里**，**类似的**重复**注入**会**带来**两个**后果**：**用户**在**错的那个**里**填了**资料**，**以及**合作方**按**两次**曝光**计费**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 而**它**把**这一点**做成了**可自动化的**断言****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出**一条**校验脚本**（**逐字**：**`node scripts/verify-widgets.mjs`**）**，**并逐字说明**其**行为**：**「**Der Test lädt jede Detailseite in headless Chrome und prüft, dass genau 1 sichtbarer Rechner gerendert wird**」（**逐页**在**无头 **Chrome** 里**加载**，**断言**恰好**渲染出 **1 个**可见的**计算器）**；**⭐ 并逐字注明**前提**（**需要**一个**运行中的**开发服务器**与**已安装的 **Google Chrome**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这是**本轮**最值得**抄**的一条**工程做法**：**⭐ 即**把**业务规则**写成**「**可数的**断言**」**（**恰好**一个、**至少**一个、**不得**重复）**，**再**用**无头浏览器**逐页**验证**——**⭐ 这**比**人工**点开**二十七页**可靠**得多**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**你的**产品**有**「**一页只能有一个**报价入口**」**这类**规则**，**它**就**可以**被**测试**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 结构**与 **SEO 基础**逐字**齐全****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**27 个详情页**分布在**5 个**分类**路由组**（**逐字**：**`(mobilitaet)`、**`(sach-wohnen)`、**`(gesundheit)`、**`(vorsorge)`、**`(finanzen)`**）**；**⭐ 并逐字列出 **`robots.ts`**、**`sitemap.ts`**、**`not-found.tsx`**、**`metadataBase`／**`openGraph`**、**经 **`lib/seo.ts` 的**逐页元数据**、**favicon **`app/icon.svg`****；**⭐ 部署逐字为 **Vercel**（**逐字**：**`npx vercel --prod --yes`**）**，**并逐字提示**生产环境**要**设置 **`NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`****；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一节**对**「**做**一个**能**被**搜索到的**保险**内容站**」**很**实用**——**⭐ 即**门户**的**流量**主要**来自**搜索**，**而**逐页**元数据**与**站点地图**是**前提**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[corredor-broker-platform]] 覆盖**经纪**业务平台**、**[[xcover-php-sdk]] 与 **[[emilgroup-insurance-sdk]] 覆盖**把**保险**嵌入**合作方**的**接口层**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**比价门户**以**合作方**计算器**为**内容**、**并**用**无头浏览器**守住**单一**注入**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **想清**门户**自己**算**什么**、**合作方**算**什么**；**② **嵌入**第三方**组件**要**防**重复**注入**；**③ **把**业务规则**写成**可数断言**并**自动化**；**④ **逐页**元数据**与**站点地图**是**流量**前提**；**⑤ **生产**配置**要**显式**（**如**站点 **URL）**；**⑥ **README **即使**只有**几十行**，**也**能**把**关键**取舍**说清**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有构建、**没有运行**该门户**（**未执行 **`npm run build`**、**未启动**开发服务器**、**未打开**任何**合作方**计算器**）**，**故**不主张**其**页面**可用**、**也**不主张**其**校验脚本**通过**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**（**1,706 字节**）**，**未读**其 **TypeScript** 源码**。**③ ⚠️ 其**计算器**为**合作方**组件**，**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**其**合作方**是谁**、**是否**已**取得**授权**、**以及**其**数据**如何**收集**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**该门户**是否**已在**生产**上线**（**⭐ 逐字**只**给出**部署命令**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**内容**（**产品**说明、**费率**表述）**是否**符合**德国**监管**对**比价**与**广告**的**要求**。**⑥ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**，**且**默认分支**为 **`master`**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该门户**是**技术实现**，**不是**保险**报价**，**也**不是**投保建议**。

**SicherVergleich**（`Ilker-Arkon/versicherungsvergleich-portal`）**是一個**德國**保險與金融比價門戶****——**逐字自述為**「**Ein deutsches Vergleichsportal für Versicherungs- und Finanzprodukte (KFZ, Haftpflicht, Hausrat, PKV, BU, Baufinanzierung u. v. m.).**」**，**技術棧逐字為**Next.js 16（**App Router、**Turbopack）**、**React 19、**Tailwind CSS v4** 與 **Lucide****。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**把此前各輪記為「**待評**」的條目**逐條判定**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 門戶自身不含定價邏輯****——**逐字**「**Live-Partner-Rechner je Sparte (`components/PartnerWidget.tsx`)**」**；**⭐ 即**門戶提供的是分類、**導流與呈現**，**費率與核保仍在合作方手裡（**以 iframe 嵌入）**；**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**這類門戶的技術難點常不是定價**，**而是**頁面與嵌入組件的一致性**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 重複 iframe 的缺陷被正面處理****——**逐字**「**Single-Injection-Guard gegen doppelte iframes (React StrictMode)**」**；**⭐ 即**開發模式下組件渲染兩次時**，**若無防護會出現兩個計算器**——**生產環境中類似重複注入會帶來兩個後果**：**用戶在錯的那個裡填資料**、**合作方按兩次曝光計費**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 而它把這一點做成可自動化的斷言****——**逐字**「**Der Test lädt jede Detailseite in headless Chrome und prüft, dass genau 1 sichtbarer Rechner gerendert wird**」（**腳本逐字為 `node scripts/verify-widgets.mjs`**，**前提是**運行中的開發伺服器與已安裝的 Google Chrome**）**；**⭐ 即**把業務規則寫成可數斷言**，**再用無頭瀏覽器逐頁驗證**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 結構與 SEO 基礎逐字齊全****——**27 個詳情頁分佈在 5 個分類路由組**（**逐字**`(mobilitaet)`、`(sach-wohnen)`、`(gesundheit)`、`(vorsorge)`、`(finanzen)`**）**；**並逐字含** `robots.ts`、`sitemap.ts`、`not-found.tsx`、`metadataBase`／`openGraph`、**經 `lib/seo.ts` 的逐頁元數據**；**部署逐字為** `npx vercel --prod --yes`**，**生產環境要設 `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`****。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[corredor-broker-platform]]、[[xcover-php-sdk]]、[[emilgroup-insurance-sdk]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**比價門戶以合作方計算器為內容、**並用無頭瀏覽器守住單一注入**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **想清門戶自己算什麼**；**② **嵌入第三方組件要防重複注入**；**③ **業務規則寫成可數斷言並自動化**；**④ **逐頁元數據與站點地圖是流量前提**；**⑤ **生產配置要顯式**；**⑥ **README 即使只有幾十行也能說清關鍵取捨**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有構建、**沒有運行**該門戶**，**不主張**其頁面可用**、**也不主張**其校驗腳本通過**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料與 README 文本（1,706 位元組）**，**未讀**其 TypeScript 源碼**。**③ ⚠️ 其計算器為合作方組件**，**未核實**合作方是誰、**是否已取得授權、**以及數據如何收集**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**該門戶是否已在生產上線**（**逐字只給出部署命令**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其內容是否符合德國監管對比價與廣告的要求**。**⑥ ⚠️ 該倉庫無許可證檔案**，**默認分支為 `master`**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該門戶是技術實現**，**不是**保險報價**，**也**不是**投保建議**。
entries.body_en:
This is a German insurance and finance comparison portal, describing itself in writing as a German comparison portal for insurance and financial products spanning motor, liability, household contents, private health, occupational disability, and mortgage financing, and built on a current React framework generation with a utility-first styling system. **This entry belongs to the round theme of adjudicating the items earlier rounds had parked for review.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the portal itself carries no pricing logic; the calculators belong to partners.** The description names a live partner calculator per line inside a single component. **This changes where a comparison portal sits in insurance distribution: the portal supplies categorisation, referral, and presentation while rates and underwriting stay with the partner, embedded in a frame. It also explains why the hard engineering problem on such a site is usually not pricing but consistency between the page and the embedded component.**

**Second, one concrete defect is handled head-on, namely duplicate frames.** The description names a single-injection guard against duplicate frames under development-mode double rendering. **In development a component renders twice, and without a guard two calculators appear on the page; in production a similar duplicate injection produces two consequences, a user filling in the wrong one and a partner being billed for two impressions.**

**Third, the property is then turned into an automatable assertion.** A verification script loads every detail page in a headless browser and asserts that exactly one visible calculator renders, and the description notes the precondition of a running development server and an installed browser. **Writing a business rule as a countable assertion and checking it page by page in a headless browser is far more reliable than opening twenty-seven pages by hand, and any product rule of the form only one quote entry may appear on a page can be tested the same way.**

**Fourth, the structure and search-engine groundwork are complete.** Twenty-seven detail pages sit across five category route groups for mobility, property and housing, health, provision, and finance, and the description lists generated robots and sitemap files, a not-found route, base metadata and open graph tags, per-page metadata through a shared search module, and a favicon, with deployment through a hosting command and an explicit note to set the public site address in production. **Traffic for a portal comes mostly from search, so per-page metadata and a sitemap are preconditions rather than refinements.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a broker business platform and interface layers that embed insurance into partner channels, **while this entry supplies the form of a comparison portal whose content is partner calculators, guarded by a headless browser check for single injection. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: decide what the portal computes and what the partner computes; guard against duplicate injection when embedding third-party components; express business rules as countable assertions and automate them; treat per-page metadata and a sitemap as traffic preconditions; make production configuration explicit; and note that a description of a few dozen lines can still state the key trade-offs.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the portal was neither built nor run**, no build command was executed, no development server was started, and no partner calculator was opened, **so no claim is made that its pages work or that its verification script passes**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description, about seventeen hundred bytes, were read**, not the TypeScript source. **Third, the calculators are partner components, and this entry did not verify who the partners are, whether authorisation was obtained, or how data is collected. Fourth, whether the portal is live in production was not verified**, only a deployment command being given. **Fifth, whether its content meets German regulatory expectations for comparison and advertising was not verified. Sixth, the repository carries no licence file**, and its default branch is named master. **Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the portal is a technical implementation rather than an insurance quote or a purchase recommendation.**

entries.title_en: An agentic retrieval-augmented generation system for German insurance documents that makes safety and audit a layer of its own: it describes itself in writing as an intelligent system for processing and answering questions about insurance documents, is organised into document handling and indexing, retrieval and reasoning, and a safety and audit layer, combines lexical and semantic retrieval with model-based re-ranking, writes structured audit logs for full traceability of every processing step, and automatically detects changes to source documents and re-indexes them; the repository carries no licence file.

entries.summary_en: This is an agentic retrieval-augmented generation system for German insurance documents, describing itself in writing as an intelligent system for processing and answering questions about insurance documents. **Measured this round**: created in November and last pushed on the eleventh of September, a repository of about one hundred thirty megabytes in Python, no stars, no licence file, a main branch, and a description of about nine kilobytes over two hundred sixty-five lines. **This entry belongs to the round theme of probing four registry surfaces, finding them empty, and then clearing the review backlog**, because this round measured four hundred ten packages published inside the window on a major statistical package repository, of which the actuarial task view lists forty-seven and forty-two are already on this site, an eighty-nine percent coverage rate, and therefore drew its entries from the parked list instead. **Four things are worth reading: safety and audit is a layer of its own rather than a by-product of logging, with audit logging, safety checks, and session management named together; retrieval is hybrid, combining lexical search with a semantic vector store, then re-ranked by a model, with self-checking and query rewriting on top; the index notices when source documents change and rebuilds itself, so an amended wording does not leave a silently stale index behind; and the model roles are finely divided, with one model answering, a smaller one re-ranking and compressing context, another routing and self-checking, and a dedicated embedding model.** **The system was neither installed nor run this round, and its audit log fields were not verified.**
entries.body:
**MVA — Agentic RAG System for Insurance Documents**（`8815479082eisa/MVA_Versicherung_Langchain`）**是一个**德语**保险文档**的**代理式 **RAG 系统****——**逐字自述为**「**Ein intelligentes Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) System für die Verarbeitung und Beantwortung von Fragen zu Versicherungsdokumenten.**」**，**其**目标**逐字**为**「**indiziert, durchsucht und präzise Antworten mit Quellenangaben generiert**」（**索引、**检索**并**生成**带**来源**的**精确**回答）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**先探空四个注册处面，再清待评清单**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 「**安全与审计**」**是**独立一层**，**而**不**是**日志**顺带**产物****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出三层架构**：**① **文档处理与索引层**（**逐字**：**Document Handling & Indexing Layer**：**文档处理、**切块、**嵌入生成、**持久化存储）**；**② **检索与推理层**（**逐字**：**Retrieval & Reasoning Layer**：**混合检索、**重排、**自查、**查询改写、**回答生成）**；**③ **安全与审计层**（**逐字**：**Safety & Audit Layer: Audit-Logging, Safety-Checks, Session-Management**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一分层**是**本条**最值得记**的**一处**：**⭐ 即**在**保险**场景**里**，「**能不能**追溯到**某一句**回答**是**基于**哪一段**文档**」**与**「**回答**准不准**」**是**两个**独立**需求**——**⭐ 把**审计**写成**架构**里的**一层**，**意味着**它**不**依赖**某个**框架**恰好**留下**的**日志**。

**⭐⭐ ② 混合检索、**模型重排、**自查与**查询改写**四件事**叠在一起****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**功能逐字列出**：**混合检索**（**逐字**：**Kombination aus BM25 (lexikalisch) und semantischer Vektorsuche (ChromaDB)**）**、**模型重排**（**逐字**：**GPT-4o-mini zur Relevanzbewertung**）**、**自查与**查询改写**（**逐字**：**Automatische Relevanzprüfung und Query-Optimierung**）**、**代理式路由**（**逐字**：**Intelligente Entscheidung zwischen Retrieval und direkter Antwort**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组**对 RIAA**有**直接**用处**：**⭐ 即**「**检索不到**就**直答**」**与**「**检索到**但**不相关**」**是**两种**不同**失败**，**而**上述**四步**分别**在**对付**它们**——**⭐ 尤其是**「**路由**」**与**「**自查**」**，**恰好**是**许多**演示**系统**省略**的**两步**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 索引**会**自己**发现**源文档变更**并**重建****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**Automatische Index-Verwaltung: Erkennt Änderungen an Quelldokumenten und re-indiziert automatisch.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一点**在**保险**场景**里**比**在**通用**知识库**里**更**重要**：**⭐ 即**条款与**费率表**会**改版**，**而**一个**不**知道**自己**过期**的**索引**会**让**回答**看**起来**很**确定**却**引用**旧版本**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**凡是**把**文档**做成**检索库**的**项目**，**都**应**回答**「**源文档**改了**，**它**怎么**知道**」**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 模型分工**逐字**细化到**四个角色****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**模型用途**：**生成**回答用 **`gpt-4o`**、**重排与**上下文压缩用 **`gpt-4o-mini`**、**路由与**自查与**查询改写**用 **`gpt-3.5-turbo`**、**嵌入**用 **`text-embedding-3-large`****；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**这**是**一种**成本**与**质量**的**显式**取舍**（**重活**给**大模型**，**杂活**给**小模型**）**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**成本**估算**时**要**按**角色**拆**，**而**不要**按**「**一次**问答**」**笼统**估算**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程形态**逐字**可核****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**后端逐字为 **Python 3.11＋**FastAPI＋**LangChain＋**ChromaDB＋**OpenAI API****；**前端逐字为 **React 18＋**TypeScript＋**Vite＋**Tailwind CSS****；**README 并逐字含**安装、**网页与 **CLI 两种用法、**API 端点、**项目结构、**配置、**工作原理、**审计日志**与**错误处理**各一节**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⚠️ 仓库体量 **131,405 KB** 而**主语言**为 **Python**，**⭐ 说明**其中**相当一部分**是**文档**与**依赖**产物**（**⭐ 本次**未核验**具体构成**）**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurance-rag-assistant]]、**[[mongodb-rag-insurance]] 与 **[[valact-rag]] 覆盖**保险文档**问答**、**[[claims-rag-co-investigator]] 覆盖**理赔**侧检索**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**审计**做成**架构**一层**、**并**让**索引**自动**跟随**源文档**变更**」这两点**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **审计**要**单独成层**，**不**依赖**框架日志**；**② **混合检索**＋**重排**＋**自查**＋**路由**四步**各有**分工**；**③ **索引**必须**能**发现**源文档变更**；**④ **模型**按**角色**选**档**，**并**按**角色**算**成本**；**⑤ **回答**必须**带**来源**；**⑥ **安全与**会话管理**要**有**明确归属**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有运行**该系统**（**未建 **ChromaDB**、**未调用**任何 **OpenAI** 接口、**未索引**任何**文档**）**，**故**不主张**其**回答**质量**、**不主张**其**重排**与**自查**的**有效性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **Python** 与 **React** 源码**。**③ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**审计日志**的**字段**是否**足以**支撑**逐句**追溯**（**⭐ 逐字**只**说**审计日志**与**可追溯性**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**索引**的**变更检测**是**按**文件**指纹**、**时间戳**还是**其他**机制**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**任何**保险公司**或**监管**的关系**（**⭐ 仓库名**含 **`MVA_Versicherung`**，**而**本条**只**按**自述**记录**，**不**推断**其**机构归属**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该系统**是**检索工具**，**不是**条款解释**，**也**不是**理赔或**合规意见**。

**MVA — Agentic RAG System for Insurance Documents**（`8815479082eisa/MVA_Versicherung_Langchain`）**是一個**德語**保險文檔**的**代理式 RAG 系統****——**逐字自述為**「**Ein intelligentes Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) System für die Verarbeitung und Beantwortung von Fragen zu Versicherungsdokumenten.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**先探空四個註冊處面，再清待評清單**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 「**安全與審計**」**是獨立一層****——**三層逐字為**Document Handling & Indexing Layer**、**Retrieval & Reasoning Layer**、**Safety & Audit Layer: Audit-Logging, Safety-Checks, Session-Management**；**⭐ 即**審計**不**依賴**框架**恰好**留下的**日誌**。

**⭐⭐ ② 混合檢索、**模型重排、**自查與**查詢改寫**四步分工****——**逐字含**Kombination aus BM25 (lexikalisch) und semantischer Vektorsuche (ChromaDB)**、**GPT-4o-mini zur Relevanzbewertung**、**Automatische Relevanzprüfung und Query-Optimierung**、**Intelligente Entscheidung zwischen Retrieval und direkter Antwort**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 索引會自己發現**源文檔變更****——**逐字**Automatische Index-Verwaltung: Erkennt Änderungen an Quelldokumenten und re-indiziert automatisch.**；**⭐ 即**條款改版後**不會留下**悄悄過期**的索引**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 模型分工細化到四角色****——**生成用 `gpt-4o`**、**重排與壓縮用 `gpt-4o-mini`**、**路由與自查用 `gpt-3.5-turbo`**、**嵌入用 `text-embedding-3-large`**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程形態****——**後端逐字為**Python 3.11＋FastAPI＋LangChain＋ChromaDB＋OpenAI API**；**前端逐字為**React 18＋TypeScript＋Vite＋Tailwind CSS**；**⚠️ 倉庫 131,405 KB**，**其中相當部分為文檔與依賴產物**（**本次未核驗構成**）**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insurance-rag-assistant]]、[[mongodb-rag-insurance]]、[[valact-rag]]、[[claims-rag-co-investigator]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**審計成層＋**索引自動跟隨源文檔**」**這兩點**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **審計單獨成層**；**② **四步分工各有其職**；**③ **索引能發現源文檔變更**；**④ **模型按角色選檔並按角色算成本**；**⑤ **回答帶來源**；**⑥ **安全與會話管理有明確歸屬**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝、**沒有運行**該系統**，**不主張**其回答質量與重排、**自查的有效性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料與 README 文本**，**未讀**其 Python 與 React 源碼**。**③ ⚠️ 該倉庫無許可證檔案**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其審計日誌欄位是否足以支撐逐句追溯**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其索引變更檢測機制（**指紋、**時間戳或其他**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其與任何保險公司或監管的關係**（**倉庫名含 `MVA_Versicherung`**，**本條只按自述記錄**，**不推斷機構歸屬**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該系統是檢索工具**，**不是**條款解釋**，**也**不是**理賠或合規意見**。
entries.body_en:
This is an agentic retrieval-augmented generation system for German insurance documents, stating in writing that it indexes, searches, and generates precise answers with source citations. **This entry belongs to the round theme of probing four registry surfaces, finding them empty, and then clearing the review backlog.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, safety and audit is a layer of its own rather than a by-product of logging.** The description gives three layers: document handling and indexing, covering processing, chunking, embedding generation, and persistent storage; retrieval and reasoning, covering hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, self-checking, query rewriting, and answer generation; and a safety and audit layer named together with audit logging, safety checks, and session management. **In insurance the requirement to trace which passage an answer came from is separate from the requirement that the answer be right, and making audit a layer of the architecture means it does not depend on whichever logs a framework happens to leave behind.**

**Second, four techniques are stacked deliberately.** The description names hybrid retrieval combining lexical search with a semantic vector store, model-based re-ranking for relevance, automatic relevance checking with query optimisation, and agentic routing that decides between retrieval and a direct answer. **Failing to retrieve and retrieving something irrelevant are two different failures, and these four steps address them separately, with routing and self-checking being exactly the two steps that demonstrations usually omit.**

**Third, the index notices when source documents change and rebuilds itself.** The description states that index management detects changes to source documents and re-indexes automatically. **This matters more in insurance than in a generic knowledge base, because wordings and rate tables are revised, and an index that does not know it is stale will produce answers that read as confident while citing an old version, so any project that turns documents into a searchable store should be able to answer how it learns that the source changed.**

**Fourth, model roles are divided finely.** One model answers, a smaller one re-ranks and compresses context, another routes and self-checks, and a dedicated embedding model handles vectors. **This is an explicit trade of cost against quality, putting the heavy work on a large model and the routine work on small ones, and a cost estimate should be built per role rather than per question.**

**Fifth, the engineering form is checkable.** The stated back end is a recent Python runtime with a web framework, a generation framework, a persistent vector store, and a hosted model interface, while the front end is a current React setup with TypeScript and utility styling, and the description carries sections on installation, two usage modes, interface endpoints, project structure, configuration, how it works, audit logs, and error handling. **The repository is large relative to its main language, which suggests that a considerable part of it is documentation and dependency artefacts, although the composition was not verified.**

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover insurance document question answering and claims-side retrieval, **while this entry adds the two points of audit as an architectural layer and an index that follows source changes. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: make audit its own layer rather than relying on framework logs; give hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, self-checking, and routing distinct jobs; make the index able to detect source changes; choose models per role and cost them per role; cite sources in answers; and give safety and session management an explicit owner.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the system was neither installed nor run**, no vector store was created, no hosted model was called, and no document was indexed, **so no claim is made about answer quality or about the effectiveness of its re-ranking and self-checking**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the Python or React source. **Third, the repository carries no licence file. Fourth, whether its audit log fields are sufficient for sentence-level traceability was not verified**, the description only claiming audit logging and traceability. **Fifth, whether change detection works by file fingerprint, timestamp, or another mechanism was not verified. Sixth, no relationship to any insurer or regulator was verified**, and although the repository name mentions insurance, this entry records only what the project says and does not infer institutional affiliation. **Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the system is a retrieval tool rather than a wording interpretation, claims decision, or compliance opinion.**

entries.summary_en: This is a data and dashboard project on road crashes in a Latin American capital between 2015 and 2020, describing itself in writing as a dashboard for analysing road crash data in that city built with Python. **Measured this round**: created on the sixth of September inside the window and pushed on the tenth, a repository of about forty-eight megabytes in Python, one star, an unclassified licence field, eleven topic tags, and a tree of thirty-one files including a dozen scripts, a dozen charts, one geographic data file, and one spreadsheet. **This entry belongs to the round theme of probing four registry surfaces, finding them empty, and then clearing the review backlog.** **Four things are worth reading: the project automates not only the charts but the conclusions, stating in writing that it generates statistical charts and plain-language conclusions automatically, which is useful for teaching and briefing but needs care in risk communication because a sentence of prose usually drops the sample size and the definitional caveats; the analysis covers time, district, cause, vehicle, and person involved, so one crash table can serve both transport and motor insurance purposes; the outputs include a geographic data file alongside a spreadsheet, serving map readers and table readers at once; and the licence field is unclassified, which means that although the upstream crash statistics are typically public, authorisation for the data and the code must be confirmed separately before use.** **Its scripts were not run and its charts were not opened this round.**
entries.body:
**Dataset Vial Bogotá**（`gamessi/Dataset-Vial-Bogota`）**是一份**波哥大**2015 至 2020 年**道路事故**的**数据与仪表板项目****——**逐字自述为**「**Dashboard de análisis de siniestralidad vial en Bogotá entre (2015-2020), desarrollado con Python.**」**，**用途逐字**为**「**procesa y analiza un conjunto de datos de siniestros viales de Bogotá para identificar patrones**」**（**处理**并**分析**数据**以**识别**模式）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**先探空四个注册处面，再清待评清单**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**写结论**」**也**自动化**了**，**而**这一点**值得**两面看****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**El programa genera automáticamente gráficos estadísticos y conclusiones en lenguaje natural, permitiendo obtener una visión general de los principales comportamientos de los datos.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**两面**：**⭐ 一面**是**它**对**教学**与**快速**简报**很**省事**（**读者**不**必**先**学会**读**图）**；**⭐ 另一面**是**自然语言**结论**通常**会**丢掉**样本量**、**口径**与**不确定性**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**要**把**这种**自动结论**放进**任何**对外**材料**，**必须**同时**给出**分母**与**数据**口径**，**否则**它**会**把**「**观察**」**说成**「**事实**」**。

**⭐⭐ ② 分析维度**覆盖**五类，**且**同时**服务**交通**与**车险****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**它**要**识别的**模式**：**「**tiempo, localidades, causas, vehículos y personas involucradas**」（**时间、**行政区、**原因、**车辆与**涉事人员）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一组**维度**是**本条**对**保险**侧**的**实际**价值**：**⭐ 即**一张**事故**表**若**同时**有**时间、**地点、**原因**与**车辆**，**则**它**既**可以**做**道路安全**分析**，**也**可以**作为**车险**风险**因素的**公开**参照**——**⭐ 而**「**行政区**」**这一维度**在**定价**与**渠道**分析**里**尤其**常用**（**⭐ 尽管**它**通常**与**其他**变量**相关**）**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 仓库构成**与**输出形态****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**仓库树**共 **31 个文件**（**逐字**：**`.py` **12**、**`.png` **12**、**`.gitignore` 1**、**`.geojson` 1**、**`.xlsx` 1**、**`.md` 1**、**其他 3**）**，**合计约 **50,933 KB****（**⭐ 而**接口 **`size` 字段为 **47,627 KB**）**；**⭐ 输出**逐字**含**统计图**与其**展示页**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**「**12 张三 **12** 个脚本**」**的**比例**说明**这份**项目**的**重心**在**图**与**结论**，**而**不**在**可**复用的**建模**代码**。

**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 许可状态**不明，**而**这**决定**它**能**被**用**到什么程度****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**接口 **`license`** 字段逐字为 **`NOASSERTION`****（**GitHub** 无法**判定**许可）**，**且**仓库**无**明显**许可**文件**；**⭐ 本词条**因此**提示**：**⭐ 即**道路事故**与**死亡**数据**通常**来自**公开**统计**（**各市**与**国家**机构）**，**而**「**数据**公开**」**与**「**这份**整理**与**代码**可**再分发**」**是**两件事**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**引用**这类**二次**整理**时**，**要**回到**原始**发布方**确认**口径**与**授权**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] 覆盖**理赔**数据分析**、**[[copart-salvage-dataset]] 覆盖**车辆**残值**数据集**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**公开**道路事故**数据**＋**自动**结论**」这一**形态**，**并**与**本轮**另一条**（**墨西哥**三来源**对齐核查**复现包）**在**方法**取向上**形成**对照**（**一条**强调**对账**与**限制**，**一条**强调**自动**出图**与**出结论）**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **自动**结论**必须**配**分母**与**口径**；**② **维度**设计**要**同时**想**交通**与**保险**两类**用途**；**③ **输出**兼顾**地图**与**表格**使用者的**习惯**；**④ **二次**整理**的**数据**要**回到**原始**发布方**确认**授权**；**⑤ **脚本**与**图**的**比例**反映**项目**重心**，**要**按**用途**选**。

entries.body_en:
This is a data and dashboard project on road crashes in a Latin American capital between 2015 and 2020, stating in writing that it processes and analyses those records to identify patterns. **This entry belongs to the round theme of probing four registry surfaces, finding them empty, and then clearing the review backlog.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the project automates not only charts but conclusions, and that deserves two-sided treatment.** The description states that the program automatically generates statistical charts and plain-language conclusions so that a general view of the main behaviours can be obtained. **On one hand this saves effort in teaching and quick briefings, since a reader does not first have to learn to read the charts; on the other hand prose conclusions usually drop the sample size, the definitions, and the uncertainty, so anything of this kind used in external material must carry its denominator and its definitional basis, or it will turn an observation into a statement of fact.**

**Second, the analysis covers five dimensions and serves both transport and motor insurance purposes.** The description lists the patterns it identifies as time, district, cause, vehicle, and person involved. **A crash table carrying time, place, cause, and vehicle can support road safety analysis and also serve as a public reference for motor insurance risk factors, and the district dimension in particular is widely used in pricing and distribution analysis, although it is usually correlated with other variables.**

**Third, the repository composition and output forms are checkable.** The tree holds thirty-one files, of which a dozen are scripts, a dozen are images, one is a geographic data file, and one is a spreadsheet, totalling about fifty megabytes, while the interface reports a slightly smaller figure. **A ratio of a dozen charts to a dozen scripts shows that the centre of gravity of this project is the charts and their conclusions rather than reusable modelling code.**

**Fourth, the licence status is unclear, and that decides how far the material can be used.** The interface reports an unclassified licence and no licence file is evident. **Road crash and fatality statistics normally come from public statistical releases, but the data being public and this particular tidy-up plus code being redistributable are two different things, so anyone citing such a secondary compilation should return to the original publisher to confirm both definitions and permission.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover claims-data analytics and a vehicle salvage dataset, **while this entry supplies the form of public road crash data with automated conclusions, and it forms a contrast with another entry from this round, a multi-source reconciliation package that emphasises accounts and limits, whereas this one emphasises automatic charts and prose. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: pair automated conclusions with denominators and definitions; design dimensions for both transport and insurance uses; serve map readers and table readers alike; confirm permission with the original publisher for secondary compilations; and choose the centre of gravity of a project according to its purpose.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, none of its scripts was run**, no dependencies were installed and no chart was generated, **so no claim is made about any statistical conclusion**. **Second, only repository metadata, the description, and the file tree were read**, not the twelve scripts and not any chart. **Third, the original publishers of its data and how it was obtained were not verified**, the description listing no source table. **Fourth, whether the automatic conclusions come from rule templates or a model was not verified, the text saying only that they are generated automatically. Fifth, its licence status was not verified**, the interface reporting an unclassified value. **Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the project is a data analysis work whose conclusions are neither road safety advice nor an insurance pricing opinion.**

**Actuarial Life & Health Auto News Dashboard**（`ChiayuuW/actuarial-news-dashboard`）**是一个**只做**三段**的**精算资讯看板****——**逐字自述为**「**This is a simplified dashboard with only three sections**」**，**三段逐字为 **New**（**近七日**自动**收集**的**寿险／健康险**精算**消息）**、**Job**（**精算**就业市场**观察）**与 **Source**（**精选**核心**信源）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**先探空四个注册处面，再清待评清单**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每条卡片**逐字**带六项**，**其中**「**为什么重要**」**是**必填****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**Each card includes source, category, priority, summary, why it matters, and read-more link.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**本条**最值得**别的**信息**项目**学**的**：**⭐ 即**「**为什么**这条**值得**看**」**若**不**写成**字段**，**读者**就**只能**从**标题**猜**——**⭐ 而**在**信息**过载**的**行业里**，**「**摘要＋**为什么重要**」**这**两项**的**写作**成本**，**通常**就是**一个**资讯**产品**与**一个**链接**列表**的**分野**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**任何**「**每日**情报**」**类**小工具**，**都**建议**把**这六项**定成**固定**字段**。

entries.body_en:
This is an actuarial information dashboard that does only three things, stating in writing that it is a simplified dashboard with three sections covering recently collected life and health actuarial news, a job market watch, and curated sources. **This entry belongs to the round theme of probing four registry surfaces, finding them empty, and then clearing the review backlog.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, every card carries six fields, and why it matters is one of them.** The description states that each card includes source, category, priority, summary, a why-it-matters note, and a read-more link. **If the reason an item is worth reading is not a field, the reader can only infer it from a headline, and in an industry with too much information the writing cost of a summary plus a why-it-matters line is usually what separates an information product from a list of links, so any daily-intelligence style tool is worth designing with those six fields fixed.**

**Second, the jobs section follows skills rather than only openings.** The description names it as an actuarial job-market watch with search links across life, health, actuarial data analysis, and pricing and reserving, and states that it tracks common skills to watch for in job descriptions. **Job titles change slowly while the skills named inside job descriptions change quickly, and treating the former as an index and the latter as a signal is a reproducible way to handle career information.**

**Third, three ways of running it map onto three kinds of user.** The description gives a local path in which installing Python, unzipping the package, and double-clicking a batch file installs dependencies, runs the crawler, generates the data file, and starts a local server; a manual path of three commands; and a hosted path in which uploading the files to a repository and enabling pages lets a daily automated job update the data file. **Offering one tool at three levels of entry is itself a demonstration of design trade-offs, because students who do not program, developers, and people who want long-running automation all have different thresholds.**

**Fourth, the positioning is explicit: a job-seeking aid rather than an industry database.** The sources section is described in writing as curated core sources for a career transition into life and health actuarial work. **Naming the intended user makes the trade-offs, only three sections and only a recent window, reasonable, and the lesson is to write down who the tool is for before deciding how many parts it has.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover an actuarial community hub, an Asian actuarial job market, and a salary guide, **while this entry supplies the form of a self-hosted three-section information dashboard with a daily automated update. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: make the why-it-matters note a field; track skills rather than only titles in career information; offer one tool at three levels of entry; name the intended user before choosing features; and let a scheduled job take over updating.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the crawler was not run, no data file was generated, and the dashboard was not opened**, **so no claim is made about what it collects or about whether its news and job links currently work**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the crawler or the front end. **Third, whether the priority and why-it-matters fields are produced by rules, templates, or a model was not verified. Fourth, the origin and permissions of the source list were not verified**, the text only calling them curated core sources. **Fifth, the repository carries no licence file. Sixth, whether its crawling respects the terms and robots rules of the sites it visits was not verified**, this entry recording only the stated automatic collection. **Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the dashboard is an information tool whose content is neither career nor investment advice.**

entries.summary_en: This is an internal customer relationship system for an insurance sales organisation in Korea, describing itself in writing as an internal system that runs per-member customer database assignment, customer management, consultation management, contract management, performance management, internal notifications, and internal scheduling inside one company system. **Measured this round**: created on the eleventh of May and last pushed on the tenth of September, a repository of about forty megabytes in TypeScript, no stars, no licence file, a main branch, and a description of about five and a half kilobytes over one hundred twenty-three lines. **This entry belongs to the round theme of probing four registry surfaces, finding them empty, and then clearing the review backlog, and it adds a Korean setting, since earlier entries related to that market were mostly statistical or accountability-oriented.** **Four things are worth reading: the first business rule it addresses is how the customer database is allocated among team members, which in a sales organisation is itself a core rule rather than a feature detail; the modules cover the whole chain from consultation through contract to performance, together with internal notifications and scheduling; delivery includes a Flutter mobile application whose sources sit in a subdirectory and which requires a one-time platform scaffolding command before the Android folder exists; and configuration and secret discipline are stated in writing, naming a database connection string, a signing secret, and a web authorisation client pair, with an instruction not to commit environment files or real secrets.** **The system was neither deployed nor run this round.**
entries.body:
**Insurance CRM**（`raonisi/boa`）**是一个**韩国**保险销售组织**的**内部 **CRM 系统****——**逐字自述（韩语）为**「**보험 영업 조직을 위한 내부 CRM 시스템. 팀원별 고객 DB 배정, 고객관리, 상담관리, 계약관리, 실적관리, 내부 알림, 내부 일정관리를 하나의 사내 전산에서 운영합니다.**」**，**英文自述逐字**为**「**Insurance CRM is an internal CRM for an insurance sales organization.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**先探空四个注册处面，再清待评清单**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**首先**要**解决**的**是**「**客户**名单**怎么**在**团队**内**分配**」****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字把**第一项**写成**「**customer DB assignment**」**，**并**逐字列出**其余**模块**：**「**consultations, contracts, performance, schedules, notifications, users, teams, downloads, settings, and bulk customer import**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**本条**最值得记**的**业务**细节**：**⭐ 即**在**以**佣金**驱动**的**销售**组织**里**，「**这个**客户**归**谁**」**决定**了**收入**归属**，**故**它**是**一条**硬**规则**（**通常**伴随**保护期、**转移与**回收**逻辑）**——**⭐ 而**这**恰恰**是**通用 **CRM** 不**提供**的**部分**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**看**一个**保险 **CRM**，**先**看**它**怎么**处理**名单**归属**。

**⭐⭐ ② 模块**覆盖**「**咨询 → **合同 → **业绩**」**并**含**内部**协同****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**逐字模块**含**咨询管理**、**合同管理**、**业绩管理**、**内部通知**与**内部日程**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**这**是**一条**「**从前台**咨询**到**后台**业绩**」**的**完整**最小**闭环**（**⭐ 而**本会话**此前**收集的**经纪 **CRM** 多**以**续保**或**报价**为**切口）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**要**做**渠道**或**销售**分析**，**这类**系统的**模块**划分**本身**就是**一份**数据**模型**草稿**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 交付**含 **Flutter／Android** 应用，**并**逐字**说明**首次**脚手架**步骤****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**Internal CRM app sources live under `apps/boa`.**」**，**并逐字**给出**首次**设置**（**逐字**：**the one-time `flutter create . --platforms=android` step to generate the `android/` folder**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**很**诚实**：**⭐ 即**它**说明**「**仓库里**有**应用**源码**，**但**平台**目录**要**你**自己**生成**」**——**⭐ 这**避免**了**把**生成物**提交**进**版本**控制**（**⭐ 与**其**机密**纪律**一致）**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 配置与机密**纪律**逐字**写明****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**环境变量**：**`DATABASE_URL`**（**逐字**：**MySQL connection string used by Drizzle and the server**）**、**`JWT_SECRET`**（**逐字**：**session/cookie signing secret**）**、**`GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`** 与 **`GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`**（**逐字**：**Google OAuth 2.0 Web application client**）**，**并逐字提示**「**Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill in real values. Do not commit `.env` or any real secrets.**」**，**且**逐字**说明**生产**认证**已**直接**使用 **Google OAuth 2.0**、**旧 **Manus／WebDev** 变量**在**生产**中**不**再**需要**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一节**是**本轮**最值得**抄**的**运维**习惯**之一**：**⭐ 即**把**「**哪些**是**机密**、**怎么**给**值、**不**要**提交**什么**」**写在 **README** 前**半**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**三行**能**避免**作品集**里**最常见的**事故**（**把**密钥**推进 **Git**）**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[brokerflow-renewal-crm]] 与 **[[insurancepro-crm]] 覆盖**经纪**业务平台**、**[[corredor-broker-platform]] 覆盖**经纪**门户**、**[[drtakaful-agent-crm]] 覆盖**代理 **CRM**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**保险**销售组织**的**内部**系统**＋**移动端**＋**名单**分配**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **先**定义**名单**归属**规则**；**② **模块**按**咨询→**合同→**业绩**串**；**③ **通知**与**日程**属于**业务**功能**，**别**当**附属**；**④ **生成物**不**提交**进仓库**，**用**一行**命令**重建**；**⑤ **机密**要**列出**名字**与**用途**，**并**在 **README 里**警告**不**要**提交**；**⑥ **认证**方案**要**说明**从**旧**方案**迁移**到**新**方案**的**状态**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有部署、**没有运行**该系统**（**未安装 **Node** 与 **Flutter**、**未连**任何**数据库**、**未做**任何**登录**）**，**故**不主张**其**功能**可用**、**也**不主张**其**名单**分配**规则**正确**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **TypeScript** 源码**。**③ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**，**⚠️ 而**其**面向**「**内部**使用**」**的**定位**提示**：**公开**可读**不**等于**可**用于**生产**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**曾**在**真实**销售**组织**里**运行**（**⭐ 逐字**只**自称**为**内部**系统**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**名单**分配**是否**含**保护期**、**回收**与**争议**处理**（**⭐ 逐字**只**写 **customer DB assignment**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**处理**真实**客户**个人信息**，**以及**其**合规**状态**（**⭐ 本词条**只**按**其**配置**纪律**记录**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该系统**是**内部**业务**工具**，**不是**保险产品**，**也**不是**合规意见**。

**Insurance CRM**（`raonisi/boa`）**是一個**韓國**保險銷售組織**的**內部 CRM 系統****——**逐字自述（韓語）為**「**보험 영업 조직을 위한 내부 CRM 시스템. 팀원별 고객 DB 배정, 고객관리, 상담관리, 계약관리, 실적관리, 내부 알림, 내부 일정관리를 하나의 사내 전산에서 운영합니다.**」**，**英文自述逐字為**「**Insurance CRM is an internal CRM for an insurance sales organization.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**先探空四個註冊處面，再清待評清單**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 首先要解決的是「**客戶名單怎麼在團隊內分配**」****——**逐字第一項為**customer DB assignment**，**其餘模組逐字為**consultations, contracts, performance, schedules, notifications, users, teams, downloads, settings, and bulk customer import**；**⭐ 即**在以佣金驅動的銷售組織裡**，「**這個客戶歸誰**」**決定收入歸屬**，**是硬規則**（**常伴保護期、**轉移與**回收**）**——**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**看一個保險 CRM**，**先看它怎麼處理名單歸屬**。

**⭐⭐ ② 模組覆蓋「**諮詢→**合同→**業績**」****——**並含**內部通知與**日程**；**⭐ 即**這是一條從前台諮詢到後台業績的完整最小閉環**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 交付含 Flutter／Android 應用****——**逐字**Internal CRM app sources live under `apps/boa`.**，**並逐字說明首次需執行**the one-time `flutter create . --platforms=android` step to generate the `android/` folder**；**⭐ 即**生成物不提交進版本控制**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 配置與機密紀律逐字寫明****——**`DATABASE_URL`（**MySQL connection string used by Drizzle and the server**）、**`JWT_SECRET`（**session/cookie signing secret**）、**`GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`／`GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`（**Google OAuth 2.0 Web application client**）**，**並逐字**Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill in real values. Do not commit `.env` or any real secrets.**，**且說明**生產已直接用 Google OAuth 2.0、**舊 Manus／WebDev 變數不再需要**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[brokerflow-renewal-crm]]、[[insurancepro-crm]]、[[corredor-broker-platform]]、[[drtakaful-agent-crm]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**保險銷售組織的內部系統＋**移動端＋**名單分配**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **先定義名單歸屬規則**；**② **模組按諮詢→**合同→**業績串**；**③ **通知與日程是業務功能**；**④ **生成物不提交進倉庫**；**⑤ **機密列出名字與用途並警告不要提交**；**⑥ **說明認證方案的遷移狀態**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有部署、**沒有運行**該系統**，**不主張**其功能可用、**也不主張**其名單分配規則正確**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料與 README 文本**，**未讀**其 TypeScript 源碼**。**③ ⚠️ 該倉庫無許可證檔案**，**而其面向「**內部使用**」的定位提示**：**公開可讀不等於可用於生產**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否曾在真實銷售組織裡運行**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其名單分配是否含保護期、**回收與**爭議處理**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否處理真實客戶個人信息及其合規狀態**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該系統是內部業務工具**，**不是**保險產品**，**也**不是**合規意見**。
entries.body_en:
This is an internal customer relationship system for an insurance sales organisation in Korea, describing itself in writing as an internal system that runs per-member customer database assignment alongside customer, consultation, contract, performance, notification, and scheduling management within one company system. **This entry belongs to the round theme of probing four registry surfaces, finding them empty, and then clearing the review backlog.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the very first thing it addresses is how the customer database is allocated among team members.** The description names per-member customer database assignment first and then lists consultation management, contract management, performance management, schedules, notifications, users, teams, downloads, settings, and bulk customer import. **In a commission-driven sales organisation the question of who owns a customer determines who earns from it, so it is a hard rule rather than a feature detail, usually accompanied by protection periods, transfer, and clawback logic, and that is precisely the part a generic customer system does not provide, so when evaluating an insurance sales system the allocation rule is the first thing to read.**

**Second, the modules cover the chain from consultation through contract to performance**, together with internal notifications and internal scheduling. **This forms a complete minimum loop running from front-office consultation to back-office performance, whereas the brokerage systems collected earlier in this session entered through renewal or quoting instead.** **For anyone building distribution or sales analytics, the module split of such a system is itself a draft data model.**

**Third, delivery includes a Flutter mobile application with the one-time scaffolding step stated.** The description says the application sources live in a subdirectory and gives the one-time command that generates the platform folder. **Stating that the repository contains application sources while the platform directory must be generated locally is an honest arrangement, because it keeps generated artefacts out of version control, consistent with the secret discipline described alongside it.**

**Fourth, configuration and secret discipline are spelled out.** The description lists a database connection string for a MySQL server used by the data layer, a session and cookie signing secret, and a web authorisation client pair, and instructs the reader to copy an example environment file, fill in real values, and not commit the environment file or any real secrets, adding that production authentication now uses the hosted authorisation provider directly and that legacy variables are no longer required. **Naming which values are secret, how they are supplied, and what must not be committed belongs near the top of a description, and those three lines prevent the most common accident in a portfolio repository, which is pushing credentials into version control.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover brokerage business platforms, a broker portal, and an agent system, **while this entry supplies the form of an internal system for an insurance sales organisation with a mobile client and explicit list allocation. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: define the allocation rule for customer lists first; thread modules from consultation through contract to performance; treat notifications and scheduling as business functions rather than accessories; keep generated artefacts out of the repository and rebuild them with one command; list the names and purposes of secrets while warning against committing them; and state where an authentication migration stands.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the system was neither deployed nor run**, no runtime or mobile toolchain was installed, no database was connected, and no sign-in was attempted, **so no claim is made that its features work or that its list allocation rule is correct**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the TypeScript source. **Third, the repository carries no licence file**, and its positioning as an internal system is a reminder that being publicly readable is not the same as being usable in production. **Fourth, whether it has ever run inside a real sales organisation was not verified**, the text only calling itself an internal system. **Fifth, whether its list allocation includes protection periods, clawback, or dispute handling was not verified**, the text only mentioning customer database assignment. **Sixth, whether it processes real customer personal information and what its compliance position is were not verified**, this entry recording only its stated configuration discipline. **Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the system is an internal business tool rather than an insurance product or a compliance opinion.**
